unit.source: In Port Santa, inside a room featuring a lone card table,
unit.target: In Porto Santa, intra conclave quod mensam unicam ludorum cartarum habebat,

unit.source: Lumian and Lugano, their appearances altered and attire changed, met the black‐market merchant claiming lineage to Dariège.
unit.target: Lumian et Lugano, quorum specie mutata et vestitu commissato erant, convenere cum mercatore clandestino qui originem Dariège affirmabat.

unit.source: Seated at the head of the table, he sported a white shirt and a black vest, a glass of pale malt‐colored white wine at his fingertips and a slowly burning cigar between them.
unit.target: Consedit in capite mensae, gerens camisiam albi et vestem nigram, habens poculum vini albi pallidi colore malto in digitis suis et cigarum lente ardentem inter ea.

unit.source: He did embody the heritage of the Dariège region with slightly sunken eye sockets, slightly curled black hair, and piercing blue eyes reminiscent of a cloudless sky over a towering mountain.
unit.target: Ipse repraesentabat hereditatem regionis Dariège, cum orbibus paulo deprimis, capillis nigris modice crispatis, et oculis caeruleis acutis, qui similes erant caelo sine nubibus super montem excelsum.

unit.source: His thin cheeks and thick stubble suggested a man in his thirties.
unit.target: Genæ eius tenuæ et barba spissa indicabant virum triginta annos natus.

unit.source: “Good afternoon, Mr. Valerio,” Lugano greeted in Highlander.
unit.target: «Bonum postmeridie, domine Valerio,» salutavit Lugano in lingua Highlander.

unit.source: Valerio, casting a glance at his armed bodyguards, responded with a smile in Intisian, flavored with a distinct Dariège accent.
unit.target: Valerio, custodios armatos conspiciens, respondit cum risu in Intisian mixto distincto accentu Dariège.

unit.source: “It’s been a long time since I’ve returned home.
unit.target: «Iamdudum est ex quo domum redii.

unit.source: It’s a pleasure to see you.”
unit.target: Gaudium est te videre.»

unit.source: “Indeed, Mr. Valerio,” Lumian replied in Intisian, his voice also tinged with a Dariège accent.
unit.target: «Revera, domine Valerio,» respondit Lumian in Intisian, voxque eius quoque notata accentu Dariège.

unit.source: While shepherds excelled at navigating the perils of the wilderness, an inherent wariness of authorities in settled human areas lingered.
unit.target: Dum pastores pericula solitudinis navigare perite utebantur, innata tamen timor erga auctoritates in sedibus humanis permanebat.

unit.source: Valerio nodded subtly and inquired, “Did you come from Larnaca?”
unit.target: Valerio submisse annuit et quaesivit, «Venistine ex Larnaca?»

unit.source: “Yes, I just finished attending the trade fair there,” Lumian replied smoothly.
unit.target: «Ita, modo feria mercaturae ibi peracta est,» respondit Lumian leniter.

unit.source: Having learned about Larnaca from the shepherds in Cordu, Lumian was well aware of the monthly trade fair that transformed the suburbs into a bustling marketplace.
unit.target: Ex pastoribus Corduinis de Larnaca discens, Lumian bene sciebat feriam mercaturae menstruam quae suburbia in forum vivum converteret.

unit.source: Shepherds from far and wide flocked to the event, seizing opportunities to trade lamb, wool, cheese, and other goods.
unit.target: Pastores ex longinquo congregati sunt, occasiones arripientes ad mercandum agnum, lanam, caseum, aliaque bona.

unit.source: Valerio then delved into the topic of migration and Dariège’s folklore.
unit.target: Deinde Valerio in thema migrationis et fabularum Dariège disseruit.

unit.source: Lumian, well-versed in the subject from a shepherd’s perspective, provided insightful answers.
unit.target: Lumian, ex prospectu pastoris bene instructus, responsa perspicua dedit.

unit.source: In the midst of the conversation, he felt a bit disoriented.
unit.target: In media colloquio paulo confusus se sensit.

unit.source: Recollections of his sister’s occasional threats echoed in his mind: “If you don’t study hard, I’ll send you off to be a shepherd!”
unit.target: Memoria minarum sororis occasionalium in animo suo resonabat: “Nisi diligenter studes, te ad pastorem mittam!”

unit.source: Now, irony had it that he found himself playing the role of a shepherd.
unit.target: Iam ironice se in munere pastoris agere invenit.

unit.source: After some time, Valerio nodded in satisfaction and took a puff of his cigar.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Valerio laetus annuit et cigarum suum inspiravit.

unit.source: “You’re quite wise.
unit.target: «Valde sapiens es.

unit.source: Grazing in the suburbs doesn’t require identification, but settling in the city requires it.
unit.target: Pascendi in suburbis identificatio non requiritur, sed sedes in urbe id postulatur.

unit.source: I’ll get you two sets as soon as possible.
unit.target: Mox tibi duas copias procurabo.

unit.source: In the future, if you encounter any difficulties, you can come to me.
unit.target: In futurum, si difficultates occurrant, ad me venire potes.

unit.source: I might not be of much help, but having one more person will give you more ideas.
unit.target: Fortasse non multum auxiliabor, sed una persona addita tibi plura consilia conferet.

unit.source: We’re all from Dariège, so we naturally have to have each other’s backs.”
unit.target: Omnes ex Dariège sumus, ergo invicem sustentare debemus.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised by the black‐market merchant’s enthusiasm.
unit.target: Lumian non miratus est de alacritate mercatoris clandestini.

unit.source: Uniting the people of one’s homeland would create an exploitable force that couldn’t be ignored!
unit.target: Populum patriae unire vires expoliabiles crearet, quas non neglegere possis!

unit.source: It was reminiscent of the Savoie Mob.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat Savoie Catervae.

unit.source: In the beginning, the pioneers, mostly Savoyards working as laborers and attendants, paved the way for the big bosses of the Savoie Chamber of Commerce.
unit.target: Initio, pioneeri, plerumque Savoyenses laborantes ut operarii et ministri, viam sternuerunt ingentibus ducibus Camarae Commercii Savoie.

unit.source: They expanded operations, safeguarded assets, and contributed immeasurably.
unit.target: Operas dilataverunt, bona tueri curaverunt, et incommensurabiliter contulerunt.

unit.source: As for how many Savoyards might end up living a less than honest life or end up dead on the streets, the wealthy merchants turned a blind eye.
unit.target: Quot Savoyenses vitam non honeste agere aut in viis mori poterunt, divites mercatores indifferenter respexerunt.

unit.source: Lumian applied the acting techniques learned from Jenna and Anthony Reid’s guidance to commend Valerio’s noble character.
unit.target: Lumian technicas agendi, quas a Jenna et Anthony Reid didicerat, ad laudandum nobilem Valerio ingenium adhibuit.

unit.source: With a smile, Valerio offered a piece of advice.
unit.target: Subrisu, Valerio aliquod consilium obtulit.

unit.source: “If you want to survive here, it’s best to convert to Earth Mother as soon as possible.
unit.target: «Si hic superesse vis, optime est quam primum ad Matrem Terram converteris.

unit.source: Find a good lady to marry and have a few children as soon as possible.
unit.target: Bene mulierem quaere, quam in matrimonium ducas, et quam primum paucos liberos habeas.

unit.source: Only then will you avoid hidden trouble.”
unit.target: Tunc tantum evitabīs insidias occultas.»

unit.source: Is urging marriage and childbearing a tradition in the Feynapotter Kingdom?
unit.target: Estne suadere matrimonium et procreationem traditionem in Regno Feynapotter?

unit.source: Lumian criticized and smiled bitterly.
unit.target: Lumian reprehendit et amarissime subrisit.

unit.source: “Without copper coins, there won’t be any good girls.”
unit.target: «Sine nummis cupreis, bonae puellae non erunt.»

unit.source: This Dariège proverb echoed in the room, signifying the difficulty for the poor, especially shepherds, to attract fine ladies and start families.
unit.target: Hoc proverbium Dariège in conclave resonabat, significans difficultatem pauperum, praesertim pastorum, ut pulchras feminas attrahant et familias constituant.

unit.source: “This is Feynapotter, not Dariège,” Valerio remarked, taking a sip of his white wine.
unit.target: «Hoc est Feynapotter, non Dariège,» inquit Valerio, dum poculum vini albi degustabat.

unit.source: “The good ladies here value robust bodies and bravery.
unit.target: «Hae bonae feminae hic corpora robusta et fortitudinem aestimant.

unit.source: The money can wait after you get married.”
unit.target: Post matrimonium pecunia exspectari potest.»

unit.source: Perplexed, Lumian questioned, “Why?
unit.target: Perplexus, Lumian quaesivit, «Cur?

unit.source: “Men like that are more suited for reproduction, and they possess the ability to impregnate good ladies,” Valerio explained with a smile.
unit.target: «Homines tale idonei sunt ad procreationem, et facultatem habent bonas feminas fecundandi,» explicavit Valerio subrisu.

unit.source: “This place is different from Dariège.
unit.target: «Hoc locum a Dariège differt,

unit.source: The essence of many things lies in fertility and reproduction.
unit.target: essentia multarum rerum in fertilitate et procreatione iacet.

unit.source: Only by understanding this can you truly understand Feynapotter and praise the mother of all things!”
unit.target: Solum hoc intellegendo vere possis Feynapotter intellegere et matrem omnium rerum laudare!”

unit.source: The black‐market merchant rose, spreading his feet slightly and raising his hands high.
unit.target: Mercator clandestinus surrexit, pedes paulo diffundens et manus alte levans.

unit.source: No wonder Feynapotter teems with people in the Northern Continent.
unit.target: Non mirum quod Feynapotter abundet hominibus in Continente Septentrionali.

unit.source: Without their knack for land improvement and food cultivation, sustaining such a population would be impossible.
unit.target: Sine arte terrae emendationis et agriculturae, talem populum sustentare impossibile esset.

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he probed, “Mr. Valerio, I heard there’s a sea prayer ritual next month.
unit.target: Lumiani cogitationes celeriter erant, dum percontabatur: “Domine Valerio, audivi ritu orationis maritimae mense proximo esse.

unit.source: Any chance to make some money?”
unit.target: Num occasio pecuniam faciendi sit?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Valerio replied, taking a seat.
unit.target: «Ita,» respondit Valerio, consedens.

unit.source: “Port Santa stays relatively warm in November.
unit.target: «Porto Santa in Novembri relative calidum est,

unit.source: When my grandfather first came, he rented a wooden box to store popsicles, gathered a pile of ice from the factory, and covered them up.
unit.target: Cum avus meus primum venit, arcam ligneam locavit ad conservanda gelata, glaciei moles ex fabrica collegit et ea operuit.

unit.source: Then, he waded into the crowd, selling popsicles and ice cubes, earning his first bucket of gold.
unit.target: Deinde in turbam ingrediens, gelata et cubos glaciei vendens, primam situlam auri adeptus est.

unit.source: You can still do it now, but the competition is fiercer.
unit.target: Nunc id facere potes, sed certatio vehementior est.

unit.source: You might even need to rent a bicycle for a larger thermal wooden box to hit more ritual venues.”
unit.target: Forsitan etiam birota conducere opus erit, ad ampliorem arcam ligneam thermalem ad plura loca rituum ascendenda.

unit.source: “Many ritual venues?” Lumian asked.
unit.target: «Multa loca rituum?» quaesivit Lumian.

unit.source: Valerio replied with a smile, “This is a grand event for all of Port Santa.
unit.target: Valerio, subrīdens, respondit: “Hoc magnum eventum est pro omni Porto Santa,

unit.source: Different processes happen in various places.
unit.target: Processūs diversi in variis locis fiunt.

unit.source: There’s the Dance of the Sea at the port, a parade of flower boats across the city, a sea boat race, the vigil ritual in Milo Village, and the core sea sacrifice.”
unit.target: Hic est Saltatio Maris ad portum, pompa navium floriferarum per urbem, certamen naviculorum maritimorum, rituum vigiliae in vico Milo, et sacrificium maris principale.”

unit.source: “What’s the sea sacrifice?” Lumian inquired curiously.
unit.target: «Quid est sacrificium maris?» quaesivit Lumian curiosus.

unit.source: Valerio slowly shook his head.
unit.target: Valerio caput negavit.

unit.source: “I don’t know the specifics.
unit.target: «Nescio singula.

unit.source: All I know is that the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea board a special boat, head to a certain area beyond the port with sacrifices from fishermen and sea merchants, and perform a unique ritual.
unit.target: Omne quod scio est quod Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris in navem specialem ascendunt, ad locum certum ultra portum cum sacrificiis piscatorum atque mercatorum maritimorum pergunt, atque singularem ritum faciunt.

unit.source: The detailed process is known only to those who’ve been there.”
unit.target: Processus exactus solum eis notus est, qui ibi fuerunt.”

unit.source: “The Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea?” Lumian kept picking keywords.
unit.target: «Gubernator Maris, Puellae Maris?» iterum verba clavis evocabat Lumian.

unit.source: This perfectly aligned with the situation of a Dariège shepherd who had just arrived in Port Santa.
unit.target: Hoc perfecte congruebat cum re pastoris Dariège, qui modo in Porto Santa advenerat.

unit.source: Valerio smiled and said, “The crucial part of the Sea Prayer Ritual is selecting a man as the Governor of the Sea and four girls as the Maidens of the Sea.
unit.target: Valerio subrisus dixit, «Pars crucialis Ritu Orationis Maritimae est eligere virum ut Gubernatorem Maris et quattuor puellas ut Puellae Maris.

unit.source: They’ll lead a parade through the city on a flower boat before boarding a special fishing boat at the port.
unit.target: Eos ducent pompa per urbem in navicula florum ornata, antequam in navem piscandi specialem ad portum ascendant.

unit.source: Sailing during the Dance of the Sea, they signal the start of the race.
unit.target: Navigantes dum Saltatio Maris agitur, initium certaminis significant.

unit.source: Later, they circle the port, entering the oldest local fishing village, Milo, for a night.
unit.target: Postea portum circumeunt, intrantes in veterrimum vicum piscatorium localem, Milo, per noctem.

unit.source: At 7 a.m. the next morning, they reboard the boat and head to the sea sacrificial ground with the offerings.”
unit.target: Hora septima matutina diei sequente, navem iterum conscendunt ac ad locum sacrificii maris cum oblationibus properant.

unit.source: The chosen Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea… A sea prayer ritual with multiple segments… Lumian repeated the key parts inwardly.
unit.target: Elegit Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris… Ritus Orationis Maritimae in pluribus partibus… Lumian partes clavis interioribus repetit.

unit.source: Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat as he made a connection.
unit.target: Subito cor eius subsiluit, dum coniunctionem perceperit.

unit.source: This was very similar to the Lent celebration in the Dariège mountains and the Spring Elf!
unit.target: Hoc valde simile erat celebrationi Quadragesimae in montibus Dariège et Elfo Veris!

unit.source: Though in reality, Lent celebration didn’t involve Ava’s head being chopped off or blood splattering, the dream scene left a deep impression on Lumian.
unit.target: Quamquam in re, celebratio Quadragesimae non implicabat decollationem capitis Avae nec sanguinis dispersionem, scaena somniorum profundam impressionem in Lumian reliquit.

unit.source: He instinctively associated the Lent celebration with something sinister and terrifying.
unit.target: Instinctive, celebratio Quadragesimae aliquid sinistrum ac terribile coniunxit.

unit.source: Doesn’t the sea prayer ritual here resemble the Lent celebration?
unit.target: Nonne hic ritu orationis maritimae simile est celebrationi Quadragesimae?

unit.source: Upon second thought, Lumian felt that the similarity didn’t explain the issue.
unit.target: Secundo cogitato, Lumian sensit similitudinem quaestionem non explanare.

unit.source: This was a common process in mysticism—the creation of a specific symbol to represent the sacrificial target to achieve the desired effect.
unit.target: Hoc erat modus communis in mysticis—creatio signi specifici ad repraesentandum scopum sacrificii, quo effectus desideratus perveniret.

unit.source: This was evident in many folklore rituals.
unit.target: Hoc manifeste in multis rituibus popularibus apparuit.

unit.source: “How are the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea chosen?” Lumian asked curiously.
unit.target: «Quomodo eliguntur Gubernator Maris et Puellae Maris?» quaesivit Lumian curiosus.

unit.source: Could it be, like the Spring Elf, they’re elected by all the residents of Port Santa?
unit.target: Forsitan, ut Elfo Vernali, ab omnibus incolis Porto Santa eliguntur?

unit.source: Could one gain a high reputation and enjoy hidden benefits after the ritual?
unit.target: Num quis famam praeclaram adipisci atque beneficia occulta post ritu frui possit?

unit.source: Valerio took another drag from his cigar.
unit.target: Valerio aliam tragam ex cigar suo traxit.

unit.source: “They’re chosen by the committee members of the Fisheries Guild, the oldest guild in Port Santa.
unit.target: «Eliguntur a membris commissionis Gildae Piscatoriae, veterissimae in Porto Santa,

unit.source: They keep the specific criteria and whether they want to vote a secret.
unit.target: qui retinent criteria specifica et utrum suffragium in secreto ferre velint.

unit.source: Even the official members of the Fisheries Guild don’t know.”
unit.target: Etiam membra officialia Gildae Piscatoriae nescunt.»

unit.source: With that, the black‐market merchant grinned.
unit.target: Hoc audito, mercator clandestinus subrisit.

unit.source: “I also aim to become the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: «Etiam conor fieri Gubernator Maris.

unit.source: They say it comes with many perks, but no one spills the details.”
unit.target: Dicunt id cum multis commodis esse, sed nemo singula revelat.»

unit.source: “How have the previous Governors of the Sea fared?” Lumian was more concerned about this matter.
unit.target: «Quomodo se habuerunt praeteriti Gubernatores Maris?» quaesivit Lumian, hac re pluris sollicitus.

unit.source: Valerio was taken aback.
unit.target: Valerio obstupefactus est.

unit.source: He thought for a moment before shaking his head.
unit.target: Paulisper cogitavit antequam caput negaret.

unit.source: “I’m not sure.
unit.target: «Nescio.

unit.source: Each Governor of the Sea serves only a one-year term.
unit.target: Omnis Gubernator Maris solum unius anni mandatum habet.

unit.source: Once they step down, they seem to be relocated.
unit.target: Postquam secedunt, relocati esse videntur.

unit.source: Anyway, they can’t stick around in Port Santa to avoid clashes with the new Governor.
unit.target: Quocumque modo, in Porto Santa manere non possunt ut certaminibus cum novo Gubernatore vitent.

unit.source: Heh heh, they’re surely offered hefty compensation and allowed to bring their families.”
unit.target: Heh heh, certissime eis compensatio magna oblata est et familias suas adducere permittitur.

unit.source: Relocated? Were they truly relocated, or did they face something else?
unit.target: Relocati? Num revera relocati sunt, an aliam rem obvenerunt?

unit.source: Lumian, drawing from past experiences, couldn’t help but think of something ominous and dreadful in the face of such a ritualistic folklore.
unit.target: Lumian, ex praeteritis experimentis inspiratus, non potuit quin aliquid ominosum et terribile coram tali ritu populari cogitaret.

unit.source: Regarding the Governor of the Sea’s subsequent experiences during the sea prayer ritual, it did sound peculiar.
unit.target: De posteris experimentis Gubernatoris Maris in ritu orationis maritimae, res peculiares sonabant.

unit.source: Lumian thought for a moment and, adopting the tone befitting his current guise, inquired, “What about the Maidens of the Sea?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper cogitavit et, more suae praesentis personae apto, interrogavit, «Quid de Puellis Maris?»

unit.source: “They’re a hit among sea merchants, fishing company shareholders, and fishermen and sailors.
unit.target: «Illae inter mercatores maritimos, socios societatis piscatoriae, piscatores et nautas summopere carae sunt,

unit.source: Everyone wants to wed the Maidens of the Sea, a symbol of the sea’s blessing.
unit.target: omnes velle nubere Puellis Maris, quae symbolum benedictionis maris sunt.

unit.source: Explore various fishing villages, the Fisheries Guild, and the homes of sea merchants, and you’ll find many influential grandmothers who were once Maidens of the Sea.”
unit.target: Explora varia vica piscatoria, Gildam Piscatoriam atque domos mercatorum maritimorum, et invenies multas avias notabiles, quae olim Puellae Maris fuerunt.»

unit.source: Valerio’s face brimmed with envy, as if he too harbored dreams of marrying a Maiden of the Sea and becoming a true sea merchant.
unit.target: Vultus Valerio invidia repletus erat, quasi ipse somnia haberet Puellam Maris in matrimonium ducendi et verum mercatorem maritimum fieri.

unit.source: This mirrors the hidden benefits of being a Spring Elf…
unit.target: Hoc imitatur beneficia occulta status Elfi Vernalis…

unit.source: Lumian suppressed the urge to raise his right hand and stroke his chin.
unit.target: Lumian impetum reprimit ne dextram manum tolleret et mentum suum foveret.

unit.source: Knowing when to cease, he refrained from pressing further.
unit.target: Sciente quando desinendum esset, amplius instare non voluit.

unit.source: After depositing 50 gold risot, he exited Valerio’s illegal casino with Lugano.
unit.target: Postquam 50 risot aureos deposuit, exiit ex cassino illicitō Valerio cum Lugano.

unit.source: Ludwig didn’t come with them.
unit.target: Ludwig non venit cum illis.

unit.source: Instead, he was stationed in a nearby family restaurant equipped with a children’s entertainment facility, overseen by specialized caretakers and a provided meal.
unit.target: Sed constitutus erat in caupona familiae proxima, quae cum facilitate ludicra puerorum instructa erat, a curatoribus peritis administrata et cum mensa provisa.

unit.source: In Feynapotter, numerous industries supported parents in raising children and alleviating stress.
unit.target: In Feynapotter, innumerabiles industriae parentes adiuverunt in liberorum educandis et sollicitudinem levandam.

unit.source: Intis and other countries lacked such facilities, and even if they existed, they were accessible only to the elite.
unit.target: Intis aliisque nationibus talia instituta defuerunt, et etiam, si exsisterent, solum ad optimos accedebant.

unit.source: Trier, catacombs.
unit.target: Trier, catacumbae.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna descended to the third level with their flickering white candles.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna ad gradum tertium descendere coeperunt cum candelis albis micantibus.

unit.source: Feeling a bit less stifled, Franca turned her head and inquired, “What’s the name of the tomb we’re after?”
unit.target: Sentiente paulo minus oppressa, Franca caput vertit et interrogavit, «Quid est nomen sepulcri quem quaerimus?»

unit.source: Jenna didn’t hesitate and replied, “The Thorn and Shieldwall Tomb.”
unit.target: Jenna non dubitavit et respondit, «Sepulcrum Spinae et Muri Scutarii.»

unit.source: 540 Entrustee
unit.target: 540 Mandatarius

unit.source: 540 Entrustee
unit.target: 540 Mandatarius

unit.source: Pa! Franca swiftly kicked away the hand bone attempting to block her path, deftly avoiding a trip.
unit.target: Pa! Franca celeriter calcitravit ossum manuum, qui viam suam obstruere conabatur, callide lapsum vitans.

unit.source: “Aren’t you tired of this? Can’t you try something different?” she cursed, turning her head to inspect the road sign beside her.
unit.target: “Nonne fessa es hac re? Non potes aliquid diversum conari?” maledixit, vertens caput ad signum viae iuxta se inspiciendum.

unit.source: It indicated they had finally reached their destination.
unit.target: Indicabat eos tandem metam attigisse.

unit.source: Each level of the catacombs sprawled vast, evident by the multitude of remains it accommodated.
unit.target: Quisque gradus catacumbarum latissime se extendebat, manifestus ex multitudine reliquiarum quas continebatur.

unit.source: The road signs at each node could only display seven or eight iconic names and nearby tombs.
unit.target: Signa viae in singulis nodis tantum septem aut octo nomina iconica et sepulcra proxima exhibere poterant.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna relied on returning to the small sacrificial square and starting anew to locate the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna confidebant in reditu ad parvum forum sacrificii et novo initio ut invenirent Sepulcrum Spinarum et Scuti.

unit.source: Unlike the fourth-level tomb, mostly sealed off and devoid of corpses and bones along the way, this place was strewn with scattered bones and decaying items, emitting a faint, uncomfortable stench.
unit.target: Dissimile ab sepulcro gradus quarti, quod plerumque clausum erat et sine cadaveribus ac ossibus in via, hic locus erat dispersus ossibus sparsis et rebus putrescentibus, levem et incommodam fœtorem emittens.

unit.source: Jenna glanced at the pile of bones outside and observed a few thin metal plates inlaid on the tomb wall.
unit.target: Jenna aspexit molam ossium foris et animadvertit paucas tenues laminas metallicas in pariete sepulcri inpositas.

unit.source: Their surfaces were blurry, showing signs of severe corrosion.
unit.target: Eorum superficies erant turbatae, signa graves corrosionis ostendentes.

unit.source: Only the shieldwall and thorn symbol could be vaguely discerned.
unit.target: Tantum symbolum scuti et spinarum vage perceptum erat.

unit.source: Whether there were other patterns remained impossible to tell.
unit.target: Num alia ornamenta inesse, declarari non poterat.

unit.source: “No wonder it’s called the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.” Franca sighed.
unit.target: “Non mirum quod appellatur ‘Sepulcrum Spinarum et Scuti’.” Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, illuminated by the dim yellow candlelight, she noticed companion items arranged in a groove on the tomb’s inner wall.
unit.target: Simul, sub luce candelae flavae pallidae, animadvertit res consortes in sulco in pariete interno sepulcri dispositas.

unit.source: Some were made of wood, weathered and decayed, while others were glass and porcelainware, in the form of fragments.
unit.target: Quaedam ex ligno facta erant, vetustate et corruptione labefacta; aliae ex vitro et fictili, fragmentaria, erant.

unit.source: The only intact item was a glass bottle, its surface inlaid with carved patterns resembling gold and adorned with a unique golden lid.
unit.target: Unum solum obiectum intactum erat poculum vitrum, cuius superficies figuris sculptis quasi aureis inlinata et operculo unico aureo ornata.

unit.source: Perhaps due to the metal’s protection, the glass bottle didn’t shatter, but it appeared murky and less transparent.
unit.target: Fortasse propter metallorum protectionem, poculum vitrum non confractum est, sed opacum et minus perspicuum apparuit.

unit.source: “It’s exquisite, almost like art,” Franca commented, puzzled.
unit.target: “Exquisitum est, quasi ars,” Franca dixit, perplexa.

unit.source: “Why didn’t the catacomb workers take it away?”
unit.target: “Cur operarii catacumbarum id non abstulerunt?”

unit.source: It seemed quite valuable!
unit.target: Videtur valde pretiosum esse!

unit.source: “Perhaps it was placed in this tomb after the catacombs were completed,” Jenna speculated.
unit.target: “Fortasse post completionem catacumbarum hoc sepulcrum inpositum est,” Jenna coniectavit.

unit.source: The two Demonesses didn’t linger on the topic.
unit.target: Duae daemonissae de re non remanserunt.

unit.source: Jenna retrieved one of the Mirror Substitutions and handed it to Franca.
unit.target: Jenna unam ex Substitutionibus Specularibus arripuit et Francae tradidit.

unit.source: With a swift leap, Franca vaulted over the seemingly silent but dangerous skeletons, gracefully landing at the entrance of the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb.
unit.target: Celeriter saltans, Franca scheletra, quae silentia videntur sed periculosa erant, transiluit, gratus ad introitum Sepulcri Spinarum et Scuti perveniens.

unit.source: After confirming her surroundings and receiving no warnings from her spirituality, Jenna cautiously approached the groove on the side wall along the ground, avoiding the pale-white bones.
unit.target: Postquam circumiecta loca sua comprobavit et nullas monitiones ex spiritualitate accepit, Jenna caute accessit ad sulcum in pariete laterali iuxta terram, vitans ossa albidissima.

unit.source: Instinctively, she reached out with her right hand but withdrew it.
unit.target: Instinctu, dextram manum protulit, sed eam retraxit.

unit.source: An old handkerchief from her pocket was produced, shielding her palm from direct contact with the antique tearcatcher.
unit.target: Ex sinu eius extractum est antiquum sudarium, quod palmas eius a directo contactu cum vetusto lacrimario protegabat.

unit.source: The tears in the tearcatcher had long dried up.
unit.target: Lacrimae in lacrimario diu exsiccatae erant.

unit.source: Jenna scrutinized the tearcatcher for a moment before stowing it away.
unit.target: Jenna lacrimarium paulisper examinavit antequam recondidit.

unit.source: She retraced her steps and leaped to Franca’s side.
unit.target: Iter suum repetivit et ad latus Francae salivit.

unit.source: “You completed the commission so easily?” she whispered uncertainly.
unit.target: “Tam facile commissionem perfecisti?” susurravit, incerta.

unit.source: It was a stark contrast to the disappearance of the Deep Valley Cloister’s gatekeeper she had previously accepted.
unit.target: Id prorsus contrarium erat ad evanitionem custos claustri Vallis Profundae, quam prius susceperat.

unit.source: Franca scoffed and replied, “What kind of difficulty do you want for a 1,000 verl d’or commission?”
unit.target: Franca irridens respondit, “Qualem difficultatem vis pro commissione mille verl d’or?”

unit.source: Jenna summarized her experience seriously, “That’s true. The challenge lies in understanding the hidden dangers in the third level of the tomb.”
unit.target: Jenna serio experienciam suam resumens dixit, “Ita est. Provocatio consistit in intellegendis periculis latentibus in gradu tertio sepulcri.”

unit.source: Solow Motel.
unit.target: Solow Motel.

unit.source: As Lumian, reverting to Louis Berry, strode into the front hall, his gaze fell upon a vibrant scene.
unit.target: Ut Lumian, revertens ad Louis Berry, in atrium ingressus, oculos suos in scenam vibrantem inciderunt.

unit.source: A young brown-haired girl, clad in a red dress adorned with black patterns, swayed gracefully in a corner.
unit.target: Puella iuvenis, capillis fuscis, induta vestimento rubro cum figuris nigris ornata, in angulo eleganter oscillabat.

unit.source: From time to time, she paused to refine her dance moves.
unit.target: Interdum subsistebat ut motus saltationis suae emenderet.

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he approached the front desk.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinabant, dum ad mensam receptalem accessit.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, he inquired, “What’s she doing?”
unit.target: Occasione usus, interrogavit, “Quid facit illa?”

unit.source: This time, he spoke in Intisian.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, in Intisiano locutus est.

unit.source: The grizzled boss, his cheekbones etched with sunburnt marks, appeared taken aback.
unit.target: Praefectus canus, cui ossa faciei maculis solis notatis erant, videbatur obstupefactus.

unit.source: Responding in Intisian with a Dariège accent, he explained, “She’s my granddaughter, Isabella. She’s practicing the Dance of the Sea for the performance next month.”
unit.target: Respondens in Intisiano cum accentu Dariège, explicavit: “Ea est neptis mea, Isabella. Saltationem Maris exercet ad spectaculum proximo mense.”

unit.source: “Dance of the Sea… Dance of the Sea for the sea prayer ritual?” Lumian hadn’t anticipated this revelation.
unit.target: “Saltatio Maris… Saltatio Maris pro ritu precationis maris?” Lumian hanc revelationem non praevidit.

unit.source: Instinctively, he smiled and remarked, “That would make many girls jealous, wouldn’t it?”
unit.target: Instinctu, risum tulit ac dixit: “Hoc multarum puellarum invidiam excitaret, nonne?”

unit.source: The boss grinned.
unit.target: Praefectus subridens erat.

unit.source: “This isn’t like becoming a Maiden of the Sea. Not many people will be jealous, but participating in the Dance of the Sea performance can indeed make her proud and happy for a long time.”
unit.target: “Hoc non est idem ac fieri Puella Maris. Pauci invidiam erunt, sed participatio in spectaculo Saltationis Maris eam vere superbam et laetam per longum tempus facere potest.”

unit.source: As Lumian signaled for Lugano to guide Ludwig back to their room, he casually inquired of the boss, “Did you come from Dariège?”
unit.target: Dum Lumian Lugano signavit ut Ludwig ad cubiculum redirigeretur, casualiter rogavit praefectum: “Venistine ex Dariège?”

unit.source: “That’s right. I’m a Guillaume,” the boss said with a self-deprecating smile.
unit.target: “Ita est. Ego sum Guillaume,” dixit praefectus cum risu auto-derisorio.

unit.source: Otta Guillaume.
unit.target: Otta Guillaume.

unit.source: When I saw your identification this morning, I thought about greeting you in Intisian, but I gave up in the end.
unit.target: Cum identificationem tuam hoc mane vidi, cogitavi te in Intisiano salutare, sed tandem desistī.

unit.source: You know, Intisians aren’t the best bunch.
unit.target: Scis, Intisiani non sunt optimi.

unit.source: Even among my fellow villagers, I’ve come across a few with questionable morals.
unit.target: Etiam inter vicinos meos aliquos cum moribus dubiosis conveni.

unit.source: “How long have you been in Port Santa?” Lumian asked with genuine interest, resting his right elbow on the front desk.
unit.target: “Quamdiu in Port Santa mansisti?” Lumian sincere rogavit, dexterum cubitum super mensam receptalem reclinans.

unit.source: Otta Sr. pondered seriously.
unit.target: Otta Senior serio meditatus est.

unit.source: “Quadraginta annos, I reckon.
unit.target: “Quadraginta annos, puto.

unit.source: Probably forty years.
unit.target: Fortasse quadraginta annos.

unit.source: Back then, I was an assistant in a caravan.
unit.target: Illo tempore, adiutor in caravana eram.

unit.source: I met my wife here and decided to stay.
unit.target: Hic uxorem meam conveni et decrevi manere.

unit.source: Heh heh, she’s now a nagging old lady.
unit.target: Heh heh, nunc est vetula querula.

unit.source: Always fussing about how to dress when it gets cold or reminding me to head home for dinner, leaving the motel to the assistants.
unit.target: Semper curat quomodo se indueat cum frigore adveniat, aut me admonens ut ad domum cenam petam, motel adiutorum tradidit.

unit.source: She manages everything so well that I don’t have to worry.
unit.target: Omnia ita optime regit, ut mihi cura non sit necessaria.

unit.source: How great is that?
unit.target: Quam egregium hoc est!

unit.source: It’s rare to encounter such a woman in Dariège.
unit.target: Raro talem mulierem in Dariège invenitur.

unit.source: Lumian endured Otta Sr.’s ramblings for a while before cutting to the chase.
unit.target: Lumian aliquantisper verba Otta Senioris sustinuit antequam ad rem perveniret.

unit.source: “I’ve been invited by a friend to Port Santa to witness the sea prayer ritual.”
unit.target: “A amico invitatus sum ad Port Santa ut ritum precationis maris intuerer.”

unit.source: “It’s quite lively. The entire port will be in euphoria,” Otta Sr. praised without hesitation.
unit.target: “Valde vivax est. Totus portus in exultatione erit,” Otta Senior sine mora laudavit.

unit.source: Lumian cast a glance at Isabella, still engrossed in her practice, and casually remarked, “I heard there was an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Lumian Isabellae, quae adhuc in exercitatione versabatur, intuebat ac dixit leviter: “Audivine casus in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti fuisse?”

unit.source: “No?” Otta Sr. responded with a puzzled expression.
unit.target: “Non?” respondit Otta Senior, vultu perplexo.

unit.source: “I watched the flower boat parade, the boat race, and the Dance of the Sea. There were no accidents.”
unit.target: “Spectavi pompa navia floribus, certamen navale, et Saltationem Maris. Nulli casus fuerunt.”

unit.source: Frowning, he fell into deep thought.
unit.target: Fruncens superciliis, in cogitationem profundam cecidit.

unit.source: “However, Sandro did mention that the number of shipwrecks has increased significantly this year.
unit.target: “Tamen, Sandro meminit numerum naufragiorum hoc anno significanter incrementum esse.

unit.source: We’ve encountered more pirates, and our fishing gains haven’t been as good as last year’s…
unit.target: Piratas plures incidimus, et quaestus piscandi nostri non fuerunt tam boni quam anni praeteriti…

unit.source: Was there really an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual? Was it the vigil ritual or the sea sacrifice?
unit.target: Revera ne casus in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti evenit? An fuit ritus vigiliae aut sacrificium maris?

unit.source: Did the old fogeys at the Fisheries Guild conceal the problem?
unit.target: Num senes in Gremio Piscandi problema celaverunt?

unit.source: “Who’s Sandro?” Lumian pressed.
unit.target: “Quis est Sandro?” Lumian instanter quaesivit.

unit.source: Otta Sr. smiled again.
unit.target: Otta Senior iterum subridit.

unit.source: “It’s my child, Isabella’s father. He works as a clerk in the government, and his wife is a teacher at the grammar school.”
unit.target: Filius meus est, pater Isabellae. Operatur ut scriba in re publica, et uxor eius magistra in schola grammatica est.

unit.source: Is Port Santa’s sea prayer ritual genuinely effective? Has its protective power diminished after the April Fool’s prank?
unit.target: Num ritus precationis maris Port Santa vere efficax sit? Num eius virtus protectiva post iocum Aprilis Stultorum diminuta sit?

unit.source: Lumian’s mind flashed with the information he’d gathered earlier.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani fulsit cum notitia priore collecta.

unit.source: Of the three peripheral April Fool’s members involved in the prank, one journeyed to Torres, Gaia Province’s capital, to customize a unique golden ring.
unit.target: Ex tribus membris perifericis Aprilis Stultorum ioci participibus, unus iter fecit ad Torres, caput Provinciae Gaiae, ut anulum aureum unicum conficeret.

unit.source: Another handled the bribery of the Fisheries Guild, sending the lamb along with the golden ring as an offering to the specially prepared ship for the sea sacrifice.
unit.target: Alter curavit de subornatione Gremii Piscandi, mittens agnum una cum anulo aureo, ut oblatio esset destinata navi specialiter praeparatae pro sacrificio maris.

unit.source: The third, disguised as a reporter, shadowed the Fisheries Guild committee members, observing and documenting their reactions.
unit.target: Tertius, ut diurnarius dissimulatus, membris comitatus Gremii Piscandi secutus est, reactiones eorum observans et notans.

unit.source: The elderly’s mix of shock, terror, and anger upon receiving the news was a source of long-lasting delight for the April Fool’s participants.
unit.target: Mixtura stuporis, terroris et irae in senibus, cum nuntium acceperunt, fons erat diuturni delectationis pro participantibus Aprilis Stultorum.

unit.source: After seeking more details about the sea prayer ritual, Lumian bid farewell to Ol’ Otta and ascended to his suite upstairs.
unit.target: Postquam plura de ritu precationis maris quaesivit, Lumian valedixit Ol’ Otta et in conclave superiore ascendit.

unit.source: At 4 p.m. in Trier, Quartier de l’Observatoire, near Place du Purgatoire.
unit.target: Hora quarta post meridiem in Treviris, Quartiere de l’Observatoire, prope Place du Purgatoire.

unit.source: After donning a hooded black robe and transforming her face into the dramatic persona of Showy Diva, Jenna followed the feedback from her contact and reached a street that specialized in funeral items.
unit.target: Postquam vestem nigrum cum capite operato induta et vultum suum in personam dramaticam “Showy Diva” transformavit, Jenna responsa a suo contacto secuta est et ad viam, quae rebus funebris specialiter dedicata erat, pervenit.

unit.source: Most Trieriens passing by appeared fairly ordinary, but a handful sported white masks, brandished blunt scythes, and adorned themselves in black robes.
unit.target: Plerique Trevirenses transeuntes videbantur satis ordinarii, sed pauci larbas albas gerebant, falces obtusas portabant, et se in vestimentis nigris ornabant.

unit.source: They posed as undead messengers from folklore, sewing white skulls and other artistic elements onto their shoulders…
unit.target: Sibi posuerunt ut nuntii mortuorum ex fabulis, suturis calvarias albas atque alia ornamenta artis in umeros suos afferentes…

unit.source: Thanks to their presence and the unique atmosphere of Trier, Jenna, dressed as a warlock with a hood concealing her features, blended seamlessly into the surroundings.
unit.target: Propter praesentiam eorum et atmosphaeram unicam Trevirensis, Jenna, induta ut venefica cum cappa quae lineamenta eius celabat, in circumiectos perfecte se integra fecit.

unit.source: She paused in a quiet corner and retrieved the exquisite tearcatcher.
unit.target: In angulo quieto subsistebat et lacrimarium exquisitum arripuit.

unit.source: Before long, someone resembling her approached and, in a gravelly voice, inquired, “How much for this tearcatcher?”
unit.target: Mox aliquis similis illi accessit et, voce aspera, interrogavit: “Quantum hoc lacrimarium constat?”

unit.source: “1,000 verl d’or,” Jenna responded, her excitement bubbling.
unit.target: “Mille verl d’or,” Jenna respondit, excitatio eius effervescens.

unit.source: This marked her first successfully executed commission.
unit.target: Hoc marcabat primam commissionem feliciter perfunctam.

unit.source: “1,001 verl d’or,” countered the warlock-dressed man.
unit.target: “Mille et unus verl d’or,” replicavit vir, indutus ut warlock.

unit.source: Upon the secret signal matching, Jenna insisted on charging only 1,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Postquam signum secretum conveniens, Jenna instenter exigebat solum mille verl d’or.

unit.source: Once the confirmation was mutual, she handed over the tearcatcher, received the reward, and discreetly departed.
unit.target: Postquam confirmatio mutua fuit, illa lacrimarium tradidit, praemium accepit, et caute discessit.

unit.source: With the tearcatcher in hand, the hooded figure navigated the nearby streets, taking nearly fifteen minutes to circle back to Place du Purgatoire and approach a street bench at the edge.
unit.target: Lacrimarium manu tenens, figura cappa induta per vias vicinas iter fecit, fere quindecim minuta sumens ut ad Place du Purgatoire redeat et ad subsellium viarum adveniret.

unit.source: A man sat there, engrossed in a newspaper.
unit.target: Vir ibi sedebat, diurnum ephemeridem legens.

unit.source: The hooded figure presented the exquisite tearcatcher, adorned with intricate hollowed-out golden patterns, and whispered, “I’ve completed your commission. Will it offset the money I owe you?”
unit.target: Figura cappa induta praebuit lacrimarium exquisitum, ornatum figuris aureis excavatis intricatis, et submurmuravit: “Commissionem tuam perfeci. Num hoc compensabit pecuniam quam tibi debeo?”

unit.source: The person on the bench lowered the newspaper, looked up, revealing a clerk with curly black hair, sunken eyes, and thick lips.
unit.target: Persona in subsellio ephemeridem deiecit, surrexit, et patefecit scribam cum capillis nigris crispis, oculis inflexis, et labiis crassis.

unit.source: A crystal-like monocle adorned his right eye.
unit.target: Monoculus, quasi crystallinus, ornabat oculum dextum eius.

unit.source: “Monsieur Monette?” the hooded figure pressed in confirmation.
unit.target: “Monsieur Monette?” inquit figura cappa induta in confirmationem.

unit.source: Monette accepted the tearcatcher, gently tracing the golden patterns with a slow smile playing on his lips.
unit.target: Monette lacrimarium accepit, aureas figuras leniter digitis percurrens, dum lente subridente labris eius fulgebat.

unit.source: Solow Motel, fifth-floor suite.
unit.target: Solow Motel, conclave in quinto tabulato.

unit.source: Lumian spent the entire afternoon within the confines of his room at the Solow Motel.
unit.target: Lumian totam postmeridianam in cubiculo suo apud Solow Motel egit.

unit.source: Lounging on a recliner, he swayed gently, engrossed in his ongoing study of Highlander.
unit.target: In lecto reclinato, leniter oscillabat, atque in suo studio de Highlander versatus est.

unit.source: Now and then, he leafed through travel books detailing the customs of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Interdum paginas in libris itinerum volvens, praecepta consuetudinum Regni Feynapotter perlegebat.

unit.source: As evening approached, Lugano, who had ventured downstairs for a chat, returned to Lumian’s room.
unit.target: Cum vespera appropinquabat, Lugano, qui deorsum ad colloquendum ivit, ad cubiculum Lumiani rediit.

unit.source: Leaning in, Lugano lowered his voice and shared, “Boss, there’s a Madame looking for you.”
unit.target: Accedens, Lugano vocem demittens dixit, “Praefectus, quaedam Madame te quaerit.”

unit.source: Madame… Lumian felt a chill run down his spine upon hearing that term, and the muscles in his back tensed.
unit.target: Madame… Lumian sensi frigus per dorsum, et musculi in dorso tensi sunt, audito hoc verbo.

unit.source: Which “Madame” could this be?
unit.target: Quae “Madame” hoc esse potest?

unit.source: After a brief pause, Lumian realized that Lugano was referring to an ordinary Madame, not the “Madame” of the Beyonder world.
unit.target: Post breve moram, Lumian intellexit Lugano de ordinarie Madame loqui, non de “Madame” mundi Beyonder.

unit.source: “Which Madame, and what brings her here?” Lumian inquired calmly, sitting up and addressing his translator.
unit.target: “Quae Madame, et quid eam hic adducit?” Lumian tranquille interrogavit, surgens et interpres suum alloquens.

unit.source: Lugano shook his head and replied, “She didn’t say. Just mentioned having something to entrust to the renowned adventurer, Louis Berry.”
unit.target: Lugano caput negavit et respondit, “Non dixit; solum memoravit se aliquid mandare habere ad clarissimum adventorem, Ludovicum Berry.”

unit.source: Lugano emphasized the term “renowned adventurer.”
unit.target: Lugano terminum “renomatus adventor” eminenter enuntiavit.

unit.source: 541 Simple Entrustment
unit.target: 541 Commissio Simplex

unit.source: 541 Simple Entrustment
unit.target: 541 Commissio Simplex

unit.source: How did my reputation spread so quickly?
unit.target: Quomodo fama mea tam celeriter pervagata est?

unit.source: Even if the rumor of me hunting Burman arrived in Port Santa two days before the Flying Bird, the entrustee would have to take time to determine where I live, the authenticity of the news…
unit.target: Etiam si rumor de me Burman venaturum in Port Santa duobus diebus ante Aves Volantes pervenisset, commissarius tempus capere oporteret ut determinaret ubi habitarem atque veracitatem nuntii.

unit.source: Lumian estimated a few days before someone sought his services, and this led his thoughts to the unnatural ‘Madame.’
unit.target: Lumian aestimavit paucis diebus antequam aliquis eius officia petisset, et hoc animos eius ad Dominam insolitam duxit.

unit.source: He stood up and said to Lugano, “Invite that Madame in.”
unit.target: Surgens, dixit ad Lugano: “Illam Dominam intus invita.”

unit.source: With those words, Lumian stooped to pick up the distinctive golden straw hat from the small round table.
unit.target: Verbis illis, Lumian se inclinavit ad tollendum pileum stramineum aureum, distinctum, ex parva mensa rotunda.

unit.source: He aimed to make Louis Berry’s image more memorable, adding a touch of flair to his persona.
unit.target: Scopum habebat ut imaginem Ludovici Berry magis memorabilem redderet, addens aliquod decus ad personam eius.

unit.source: In no time, Lugano escorted a woman in her thirties into the room.
unit.target: Mox, Lugano mulierem in annis tricenariis aetatis in conclave comitavit.

unit.source: She wore a loose-fitting white dress adorned with red flowers, accentuating her curves.
unit.target: Induta erat veste alba soluta, ornata floribus rubris, quae eius lineamenta illustrabat.

unit.source: Port Santa’s women, in contrast to the Dariège region just across the mountain, favored glamorous and stylish attire, embodying a romantic and liberated aesthetic—reflecting the traditional taste of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Mulieres Porti Santae, contra regionem Dariège trans montem, amabant vestimenta decora et elegans, quae aestheticam romanticam et liberatam efferebant, repraesentantes gustum traditionalem Regni Feynapotter.

unit.source: The lady, with long brown hair tied up and a healthy complexion, entered without a maid.
unit.target: Domina, cum capillis longis brunneis alligatis et facie sana, sine ancilla intravit.

unit.source: Her azure eyes, framed by thick eyelashes, focused on Lumian, who held the golden straw hat.
unit.target: Oculi eius caerulei, ciliaribus crassissimis ornati, in Lumian spectabant, qui pileum stramineum aureum tenebat.

unit.source: Her red lips moved, and though Lumian couldn’t grasp every word, the name “Louis Berry” was discernible in her pronunciation.
unit.target: Labia eius rubra moveruntur, et quamquam Lumian non singula verba capere potuit, nomen “Louis Berry” in eius dictione perceptum erat.

unit.source: Promptly, Lugano initiated the translation.
unit.target: Celeriter, Lugano translationem incepit.

unit.source: “The Madame says, Honorable Monsieur Louis Berry, I’ve heard about your hunt of the Demon Warlock. I wonder if you’re willing to help my family solve a problem.”
unit.target: “Domina dicit: ‘Honorabile Domine Louis Berry, audivi de tua venatione Daemoni Incantatoris. Miror num paratus sis auxilium ferre familiae meae ad quaestionem solvendam.’”

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze shifted from the jeweled bead bracelet on the lady’s wrist to her beautiful and mature face.
unit.target: Aspectus Luminum a armilla gemmata in manu dominae ad faciem eius pulchram et maturam migravit.

unit.source: “What’s your name?”
unit.target: “Quod nomen tibi est?”

unit.source: “Giorgia,” the lady replied after Lugano translated.
unit.target: “Giorgia,” respondit domina postquam Lugano interpretatus est.

unit.source: Lumian repeated, acknowledging the lady’s name with a smile,
unit.target: Lumian iteravit, nomen dominae cum risu agnoscens,

unit.source: “Madame Giorgia, what would you like to entrust me with?”
unit.target: “Domina Giorgia, quid vis mihi committendum?”

unit.source: Giorgia listened attentively to Lugano’s translation and spoke in Highlander with a slight local accent, “An evil creature has appeared in my household. I need your help eliminating it.”
unit.target: Giorgia attente auscultavit translationem Lugani et in lingua Highlandensis leviter cum accentu locali locuta est: “Creatura mala in domo mea apparuit. Auxilium tuum ad eam exstirpandam mihi opus est.”

unit.source: Lumian, though grasping the gist, awaited Lugano’s translation by casting his gaze at him.
unit.target: Lumian, licet rem caperet, translationem Lugani exspectabat, eum intuens.

unit.source: When Lugano conveyed Giorgia’s words in Intisian, Lumian chuckled and said, “I’m sorry, I forgot to invite the beautiful Madame to have a seat.
unit.target: Cum Lugano verba Giorgiae in Intisian tradidisset, Lumian subridens dixit: “Ignosce mihi, oblitus sum invitare pulcherrimam Dominam ut sedere possit.”

unit.source: “The great adventurer Gehrman Sparrow taught us that manners are very important.”
unit.target: “Magnus peragrator Gehrman Sparrow nos docuit modos valde esse magni momenti.”

unit.source: Gesturing toward the sofa, Lumian settled onto the divan, attempting to caress Ludwig’s head, like a godfather.
unit.target: Gestu ad sofam indicato, Lumian in divano sede fecit, conans caput Ludovigi teneriter tractare, quasi patrinus.

unit.source: Ludwig quickly shifted his position, avoiding Lumian’s attempt to treat him as a child.
unit.target: Ludwig celeriter suam positionem mutavit, vitans Luminum eum tamquam puerum tractare.

unit.source: As Giorgia took her place in an armchair, Lumian, shaking his golden straw hat, leaned forward.
unit.target: Dum Giorgia in sella sedebat, Lumian, pileum aureum stramineum concutiente, se inclinavit in ante.

unit.source: “Since it’s an evil creature, why don’t you just find a clergyman of the Earth Mother Church to handle it?”
unit.target: “Quoniam creatura mala est, cur non quaeris sacerdotem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ad eam curandam?”

unit.source: Giorgia looked at Lugano and listened attentively.
unit.target: Giorgia ad Lugano aspexit et attente audivit.

unit.source: She pursed her thick lips and replied in Highlander,
unit.target: Labia eius crassa contraxit, et in lingua Highlandensis respondit,

unit.source: “We don’t want the Church to know about this. It will damage our family’s reputation.”
unit.target: “Nolumus Ecclesiam de hoc agnoscere; nam famae familiae nostrae nocet.”

unit.source: Is that why you are entrusting me, a foreigner who will leave after watching the sea prayer ritual? And that’s after confirming my ability to deal with that evil creature…
unit.target: Num idcirco me committis, peregrinus, qui post ritum orationis maritimae discessurus es? Et hoc, postquam facultatem meam ad illam creaturam malam superandam comprobas?

unit.source: Lumian, pondering this choice, shifted his gaze away from Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian, haec considerans, oculos suos a Lugano avertit.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he inquired, “Tell me more about that evil creature.”
unit.target: Post breve mora, interrogavit: “Dic mihi plura de illa creatura mala.”

unit.source: After a brief pause, Giorgia contemplated and then shared, “It resembles a tailless lizard.
unit.target: Post breve mora, Giorgia meditata, dixit: “Similis est lacertae sine cauda.”

unit.source: It attacked everyone in the household, killing a few maids and valets and devoured their bodies.
unit.target: Omnes in domo aggressus est, paucos ancillas et valetos necans, corpora eorum devoravit.

unit.source: Our family’s bodyguards fired on it and injured it, but they failed to kill it because it has very strong scales.
unit.target: Custodes corporis familiae nostrae in eam telis iacuerunt et vulneraverunt eam, sed interficere non potuerunt, quoniam squamae eius valde robustae sunt.

unit.source: We could only chase it to the basement and lock it up.
unit.target: Illam solum ad cellam subterraneam insequi potuimus et clauserimus.

unit.source: We thought it would slowly starve to death from hunger and thirst.
unit.target: Putavimus eam paulatim fame et sitim morituram iri.

unit.source: To our surprise, nearly two weeks later, it’s still alive and trying to break open the basement door.
unit.target: Ad nostram admirationem, fere post duas septimanas, adhuc vivit et ianuam cellae subterraneae aperire conatur.

unit.source: It doesn’t seem very dangerous.
unit.target: Illa non videtur valde periculosa esse.

unit.source: They could repel it with ordinary firearms…
unit.target: Illam armis ordinariis repelli poterant.

unit.source: They didn’t mention why the lizard appeared.
unit.target: Non narraverunt cur lacerta apparuerit.

unit.source: It appears that this is why they aren’t willing to seek out the Church of Earth Mother and the local government to handle it…
unit.target: Videtur hoc esse quod ideo non volunt Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et regimen locale quaerere ad hoc tractandum.

unit.source: Lumian thoughtfully compared the few words he understood to the content translated by Lugano and confirmed that the guide hadn’t embellished or redacted any content.
unit.target: Lumian, diligentissime meditans, pauca verba quae intellexit cum contento a Lugano translato comparavit et confirmavit ut in translatione nihil additum aut subtractum fuisset.

unit.source: Lumian then casually inquired, “Were there any casualties among the bodyguards?”
unit.target: Lumian deinde leviter interrogavit: “Fueruntne inter custodes familiae nostrae quaedam laesiones?”

unit.source: Giorgia, after the translation, shook her head slowly.
unit.target: Giorgia, post translationem, lente caput concussit.

unit.source: “No fatalities. Two were injured, but nothing severe. Yes, that monster made the entire room feel like it had been dragged into the deep sea, affecting normal movements.”
unit.target: Nullae fatalitates. Duo vulnerati sunt, sed nihil grave. Ita, ille monstrum totum conclave effecit ut quasi in altum mare trahiturus esset, motus normales afficiens.

unit.source: As if dragged into the deep sea… There’s indeed certain Beyonder phenomena, but it seems relatively weak… Deep sea… Lumian’s interest was piqued as he earnestly inquired about the details.
unit.target: Velut quasi in altum mare trahiturus esset… Vere sunt quaedam phaenomena Beyonder, sed videntur relative debilia… Mare profundum… Intererat Luminum, qui ardenter de singulis quaesivit.

unit.source: After a series of responses, Giorgia said gently, “Monsieur Louis Berry, we’re willing to pay you 15,000 risot, but you have to promise not to publicize this matter.”
unit.target: Post seriem responsionum, Giorgia leniter dixit: “Domine Louis Berry, parati sumus tibi 15,000 risot solvere, sed promittendum est ut hanc rem non publices.”

unit.source: 15,000 gold risot? According to your description, the monster is worth at most 5,000 gold risot. The remaining 10,000 should be a hush money, right?
unit.target: 15,000 risot aurei? Secundum descriptionem tuam, monstrum valere potest ad non plus quam 5,000 risot aureos. Reliqua 10,000 debent esse pecunia tacita, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian smiled and said in broken Highlander, “Sure thing.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit in lingua Highlander disrupta: “Certe.”

unit.source: Rising from his seat, Lumian announced in Intisian, “I want to observe the situation at the scene.”
unit.target: Surgens a sede, Lumian in Intisian annunciavit: “Volo statum rerum in situ observare.”

unit.source: Giorgia stood up and listened to Lugano’s translation.
unit.target: Giorgia surrexit et translationem Lugani auscultavit.

unit.source: She wasn’t surprised by Louis Berry’s request.
unit.target: Giorgia non mirata est de petitione Ludovici Berry.

unit.source: Familiar with adventurers and bounty hunters, she understood the importance of assessing the situation firsthand and making thorough preparations.
unit.target: Experta in adventoribus et venatoribus praemiorum, intellexit momentum conditionem directe inspiciendi et praeparationes diligenter faciendas esse.

unit.source: It meant survivability or success for the elites.
unit.target: Hoc significabat vel salutem vel prosperitatem pro electis.

unit.source: “Now?” Giorgia sought confirmation.
unit.target: “Nunc?” quaesivit Giorgia.

unit.source: Lumian comprehended the word and affirmed in Highlander, “Now.”
unit.target: Lumian verbum intellexit et in lingua Highlander affirmavit: “Nunc.”

unit.source: Adorning his golden straw hat, he made his way to the door, supplementing in Intisian, “Also, prepare a sumptuous dinner for me, my godson, and my translator.”
unit.target: Indutus pileo stramineo aureo suo distinctivo et manum Ludovigi tenens, Lumian ad ianuam accessit, addens in Intisian: “Praeterea, parate cenam opulentam mihi, padrino meo, et interpreti meo.”

unit.source: Giorgia, slightly taken aback by the translation, watched Lumian’s departure.
unit.target: Giorgia, translatione paulo obstupescens, discessionem Lumiani observavit.

unit.source: She couldn’t shake the feeling that this adventurer possessed a distinct quality compared to those she had encountered before.
unit.target: Non potuit disicere sensum quod hic peragrator indole distinctus esset comparatus ad eos quos antea convenerat.

unit.source: Port Santa, Saint Lana Street.
unit.target: Port Santa, Via Sanctae Lanae.

unit.source: To the northeast of the city stood multi‐story villas adorned with gardens, lawns, and stables.
unit.target: Ad septentrionem urbis steterunt villae pluristratificatae, ornatae hortis, pratellis, et stabulis.

unit.source: Giorgia’s residence occupied number 21 on this street.
unit.target: Domus Giorgiae numerum 21 in hac via occupabat.

unit.source: The five‐story villa boasted brownish‐red outer walls, adorned with statues of Angels and Saintesses from the Earth Mother Church, along with symbols depicting waves and fishing.
unit.target: Villa quinque stratorum parietes exteriores rubro-brunneos habebat, ornatos statuis Angelorum et Sanctorum de Ecclesia Matris Terrae, simul cum symbolis fluctuum et piscandi.

unit.source: Wearing his distinctive golden straw hat and holding Ludwig’s hand, the latter carrying a red school bag, Lumian trailed behind Giorgia, accompanied by her maid and valet.
unit.target: Indutus pileo stramineo aureo suo distinctivo et manum Ludovigi tenens, qui sacculum scholasticum rubrum gerebat, Lumian post Giorgia secutus est, comitatus ancilla eius et servo.

unit.source: Together, they entered the villa’s hall, which also served as a spacious dance floor beneath a tall, dome ceiling.
unit.target: Simul intraverunt atrium villae, qui etiam spatiosum saltatorium sub tecto cupulato constituebatur.

unit.source: As Lumian stepped inside, he felt unseen eyes upon him from the circular railings on the upper floors.
unit.target: Cum Lumian introit, sensit oculos invisos eum inspicientes a balustradibus circularibus in tabulatis superioribus.

unit.source: It’s indeed a household with multiple families sharing one roof. There are quite a few people…
unit.target: Vere est domus cum plurimis familiis sub uno tecto. Multi homines adsunt…

unit.source: Lumian mused, choosing not to look up, smiling inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, nolens sursum intuere, intus subridens.

unit.source: The concealed observers remained hidden.
unit.target: Observatores absconditi manserunt.

unit.source: Giorgia then summoned two legally armed bodyguards, leading Lumian and the entourage down to the second basement where the iron-black door stood tightly shut.
unit.target: Giorgia deinde duos custodes corporis legaliter armatos convocavit, qui Luminum et comitatus duxerunt ad cellam subterraneam secundam, ubi ianua ferrea atra strenue clausum stabat.

unit.source: As if sensing someone approaching, the door slammed as if struck by a powerful force.
unit.target: Quasi aliquem appropinquare sentiens, ianua subito, quasi vi potentissima icta, clauserit.

unit.source: “It’s inside,” Giorgia stated, pointing at the iron door with a complicated expression.
unit.target: “Intus est,” inquit Giorgia, ianuam ferream ostendens vultu perplexo.

unit.source: Lumian, understanding without the need for translation, pressed down on his golden straw hat and directed, “Take my godson to the living room for pre-dinner dessert.”
unit.target: Lumian, intellegens sine translatione indigeo, pileum aureum stramineum deprimens, dixit: “Ducite padrinum meum in conclave ad praecenam.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he strode towards the subterranean iron door without a backward glance.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, profectus est versus ianuam ferream subterraneam sine retrospectu.

unit.source: Upon hearing Lugano’s translation, Giorgia and the maid hastily guided Ludwig back to the surface.
unit.target: Ex audita translatione Lugani, Giorgia et ancilla celeriter Ludovigum ad superficiem duxerunt.

unit.source: A bodyguard caught up to Lumian, his expression serious, and handed him a pewter-black key.
unit.target: Unus custos corporis, qui Luminum adsecutus est, vultu serio, clavem nigrum dedit.

unit.source: Without delay, the two bodyguards drew their revolvers, positioning themselves to aim at the iron door, preventing the monster from escaping.
unit.target: Sine mora, duo custodes corporis arma revolutoria eduxerunt, se ordinantes ad ianuam ferream intendere, ne monstrum effugeret.

unit.source: Lumian methodically inserted the key into the lock, unlocking it.
unit.target: Lumian clavem methodice in serram inseruit, eam aperiens.

unit.source: He tossed the key aside and effortlessly pushed the iron door open with one hand.
unit.target: Clavem abiecit et sine labore una manu ianuam ferream aperuit.

unit.source: In an instant, the monster’s figure came into view.
unit.target: In momento, figura monstri apparuit.

unit.source: A humanoid lizard, adorned with glistening, robust scales, met Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Lacerta humanoidea, squamis nitidis et robustis ornata, oculos Luminum occurrit.

unit.source: Where there were no scales, smooth, sinister snake-like skin was exposed.
unit.target: Ubi squamae defuebant, cutis levis et sinistra, serpentiformis patebat.

unit.source: The monster’s eyes were vertical, and they glowed with a nearly transparent light.
unit.target: Oculi monstri erant verticales, et luce paene perspicua fulgebant.

unit.source: Its mouth harbored sharp teeth that formed a menacing vortex.
unit.target: Os eius dentes acutos continebat, qui minacem vorticem efficiebant.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian felt the air around him grow dense, like shackles enveloping him, clearly impeding his normal movements.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian sensit aerem circa se densum fieri, quasi vincula eum amplectens, motus naturales eius impedientes.

unit.source: The moisture gave the sensation of plunging into the deep sea, enduring pressure from all directions.
unit.target: Umor dabat sensum quasi in mare profundo immergendi, pressuram ex omnibus partibus ferens.

unit.source: The humanoid lizard lunged forward, and Lumian’s body leaned towards the enemy as if pulled by a vortex.
unit.target: Lacerta humanoidea impetum fecit, et corpus Luminum adversō inclinatum est, quasi a vortice tractum.

unit.source: Yet, the obvious smile on his lips persisted as he calmly attempted to pivot.
unit.target: Tamen, risus evidens in labris eius perseverabat, dum tranquille conabatur se convertere.

unit.source: Suddenly, a latent power surged within him, allowing him to break free from the air’s constraints.
unit.target: Subito, vis latens in eo erupit, quae ei permisit a vinculis aeris se liberare.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly rotated his body, swinging his right fist from below.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter corpus suum rotavit, dextram pugnus ex deorsum ferens.

unit.source: Instantly, crimson flames, nearly white, ignited from his fist, spreading to his forearm, resembling a dazzling fire serpent.
unit.target: Statim, flammae rubrae, paene albae, ex pugno eius incensae sunt, in brachium diffundentes, instar serpentis ignis fulgurantis.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: The punch struck the humanoid lizard’s chest and abdomen, causing the flames to compress.
unit.target: Pugno, lacertae humanoidae pectus et abdominum percussi sunt, unde flammae comprimuntur.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: The humanoid lizard was sent flying, crystalline scales splattering from its chest and abdomen, resulting in a massive wound.
unit.target: Lacerta humanoidea in aera proiecta est, squamae crystallinae ex pectore et abdomine eius dispersae sunt, ingens vulnera relicta.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t give chase. With one hand in his pocket, he changed his right fist to a palm and gently pushed forward.
unit.target: Lumian insequi non instituit. Una manu in marsupio posita, dextram pugnus in palmam mutavit et leniter impulit.

unit.source: Crimson, nearly white fireballs materialized before him, whistling into the wound on the lizard’s chest and abdomen.
unit.target: Globuli ignis rubri, paene albi, coram eo apparuerunt, in vulnera pectoris et abdominis lacertae sibilantes.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble!

unit.source: The monster disintegrated, its flesh and blood splattering across the ground.
unit.target: Monstrum dissolutum est, et caro atque sanguis eius per terram dispersae sunt.

unit.source: Lumian observed for a few moments before adjusting his golden straw hat.
unit.target: Lumian pauca momenta observavit, deinde pileum aureum stramineum suum rectavit.

unit.source: He turned around and walked towards the stairs leading to the surface.
unit.target: Se vertit et ambulavit ad scalas quae ad superficiem ducunt.

unit.source: The two armed and vigilant bodyguards maintained their original posture, still in a daze, unable to comprehend what had transpired.
unit.target: Duo custodes armati et vigilantissimi statum proprium retinuerunt, adhuc attoniti, non intellegentes quid accidisset.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t “rouse” them as he ascended the stairs.
unit.target: Lumian eos non excitavit dum scalas ascendebat.

unit.source: Upon hearing the explosion, Giorgia, on the ground, left the lounge with Lugano and approached the staircase.
unit.target: Audita explosione, Giorgia in terra, ex conclavi cum Lugano discessit et ad scalas accessit.

unit.source: She saw Lumian coming up.
unit.target: Vidit Lumian ascendere.

unit.source: “Have you confirmed the situation?” Madame Giorgia asked with concern.
unit.target: “Num rem confirmavisti?” inquit Domina Giorgia cum sollicitudine.

unit.source: Lumian replied with a smirk, “It’s resolved.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Res soluta est.”

unit.source: 542 Abnormal Situation
unit.target: 542 Conditio Insolita

unit.source: 542 Abnormal Situation
unit.target: 542 Conditio Insolita

unit.source: It’s resolved? It’s already resolved?
unit.target: Numquid solutum est? Numquid iam solutum est?

unit.source: Giorgia suspected that the translator had made a mistake.
unit.target: Giorgia suspicata est quod interpres erravit.

unit.source: Instinctively, she asked, “Is there a quick solution, or has it already been resolved?”
unit.target: Instinctu, rogavit: "Estne solutio celeris, an iam solutum est?"

unit.source: Lugano cast a sympathetic glance at the beautiful madame, experiencing the same emotions he felt when reading about how his employer had slain the Demon Warlock.
unit.target: Lugano oculos misericorditer in pulchram dominam iecit, eadem affecta sentiens quae sensit dum legebat quomodo patronus eius daemonis incantatoris interfecerat.

unit.source: How could a monster confined to the basement by ordinary armed bodyguards compare to Burman, who had a bounty of 600,000 verl d’or?
unit.target: Quomodo poterat monstrum, a custodibus armatis vulgo ordinatis in subterra reclusum, comparari cum Burman, qui praemium sexcentis milibus "verl d’or" habebat?

unit.source: Despite finding it unnecessary, Lugano respectfully conveyed Giorgia’s words to Lumian.
unit.target: Quamvis id inutile existimans, Lugano verba Giorgiae Luminiano reverenter tradidit.

unit.source: Lumian removed the golden straw hat from his head and said, “You may instruct the servants to clean the basement.”
unit.target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum de capite abstulit et dixit: "Ministris impera ut cella subterranea purgetur."

unit.source: Upon hearing Lugano’s translation, Giorgia’s pupils dilated as she looked at Lumian in bewilderment, unsure of what to say.
unit.target: Auditis Lugani interpretationibus, dilatatae sunt pupillae Giorgiae, dum in Luminiano stupefacta aspiceret, nescia quid dicere debeat.

unit.source: At that moment, a bodyguard guarding the basement ran up.
unit.target: Illo momento, custos cellae subterraneae, qui eam custodiebat, accessit celeriter.

unit.source: Upon seeing Giorgia, he immediately leaned over, lowered his voice, and whispered something to her.
unit.target: Videns Giorgiam, statim se inclinavit, vocem demisit, et ei aliquid susurravit.

unit.source: Giorgia’s expression shifted a few times before she smiled and said to Lumian, “As expected of the renowned adventurer. I previously suspected that your hunt for the Demon Warlock was merely a rumor. Now, I completely believe it. Your might is enough to resound throughout the Five Seas.”
unit.target: Vultus Giorgiae aliquoties mutatus est, deinde subridet et Luminiano dixit: "Ut decet insigne adventorem. Prius suspicabam venationem tuam daemonis incantatoris solum rumor esse. Nunc autem omnino credo. Vis tua satis est ut per quinque maria resonet."

unit.source: She paused for a moment and said apologetically, “I’m sorry; we haven’t had time to prepare dinner. We might need you to wait in the lounge for a while.”
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit et excusata dixit: "Ignosce; tempus non habuimus cenam praeparare. Forsitan te necesse habebimus in conclavi aliquantum exspectare."

unit.source: “Better to have me wait than a beautiful lady,” Lumian replied with a smile.
unit.target: "Praestat me exspectare quam pulchram dominam," Lumian risu respondit.

unit.source: That’s basic courtesy!
unit.target: Hoc est fundamentum comitatis!

unit.source: He followed Giorgia’s maid into the lounge specially catered for Ludwig to enjoy the pre-dinner dessert.
unit.target: Ancillam Giorgiae secutus est in conclave, specialiter provisum, ut Ludwig ante cenam dulcia degustaret.

unit.source: Giorgia and her bodyguard descended into the basement.
unit.target: Giorgia et custos eius in cellam subterraneam descenderunt.

unit.source: A sense of relief washed over her as she surveyed the blood-stained room, finding no trace of the humanoid lizard; it had completely vanished.
unit.target: Sententia levationis eam perfudit dum conclave sanguine maculatum perlegi, nulla vestigia reptilis humanoidis inveniens; plane evanuerat.

unit.source: Dinner unfolded in a private chamber, exclusive to Lumian, his companions, and Giorgia.
unit.target: Cena in camera privata, Luminiano, comitibus eius, et Giorgiae destinata, habita est.

unit.source: The lady’s maid attended to them, serving dishes and pouring wine.
unit.target: Ancilla dominae illis adfuit, fercula ministrans et vinum effundens.

unit.source: Lumian, intrigued by his surroundings, noted how the expansive mansion accommodated the needs of its diverse occupants.
unit.target: Lumian, circumstantiis suis captus, animadvertit quomodo ampla villa necessitatibus incolarum variorum satisficeret.

unit.source: Small private rooms outside the grand banquet hall ensured the privacy of gatherings.
unit.target: Parvae camerae privatae extra magnam aulam convivii secretum conventuum curabant.

unit.source: The meal was a delight for everyone.
unit.target: Cibus omnibus voluptas fuit.

unit.source: Lumian received 15,000 risot in banknotes;
unit.target: Lumian quindecim milia risot in chirographis accepit;

unit.source: Giorgia appeared visibly at ease;
unit.target: Giorgia manifeste soluta videbatur;

unit.source: Ludwig appreciated the villa’s chefs;
unit.target: Ludwig coquos villae laudavit;

unit.source: and Lugano experienced a high-end banquet for the first time.
unit.target: et Lugano primum convivium elegantissimum expertus est.

unit.source: The great adventurer, usually one to boast and joke while not in his monster-hunting cold persona, lightened the atmosphere at the dining table.
unit.target: Magnus adventor, qui solebat gloriari et iocari, cum persona frigida ad monstrorum venationem non induta esset, atmosphaeram mensae cenatoriae levavit.

unit.source: This pleasant ambiance continued until Lumian departed from 21 Saint Lana Street alongside Ludwig and Lugano.
unit.target: Hic amoenus ambitus perseveravit donec Lumian, una cum Ludovico et Lugano, ex 21 via Sanctae Lanae discessit.

unit.source: Lugano, slightly flushed from the white wine, gazed back at the brightly lit building and sighed deeply.
unit.target: Lugano, ex vino albo paulum rubicundus, ad aedificium lucide illustratum respexit et altum suspiravit.

unit.source: “I wonder when I’ll have a house this grand, with numerous servants and chefs, and a wife like Giorgia.”
unit.target: Miror quando domum tam magnam, cum multis servis et coquos, atque uxorem ut Giorgia habebo.

unit.source: Lumian teased, “Your emphasis is on the last part, isn’t it?”
unit.target: Lumian iocose dixit: "Emphasis tua in ultima parte est, nonne?"

unit.source: Lugano chuckled sheepishly and replied, “Well, based on your description, I might as well have been capable of taking down that humanoid lizard too.”
unit.target: Lugano modeste risit et respondit: "Bene, ex tuâ descriptione, fortasse etiam illam reptilem humanoidem superare potueram."

unit.source: It meant he possessed the skills to tackle a mission worth 30,000 verl d’or!
unit.target: Id significabat eum peritia habuisse ad missionem triginta milia "verl d’or" valoris aggrediendam!

unit.source: With a few more successful missions, Lugano’s dream could become a reality!
unit.target: Cum paucis aliis missionibus prosperis, somnium Lugani in rem veram fieri posset!

unit.source: “With guns and special bullets prepared in advance, coupled with ample combat experience, a Planter is indeed capable,” Lumian carefully assessed his guide.
unit.target: "Armis et bullis specialibus praeparatis antea, una cum ampla experientia in proelio, Planter certe id efficax est," Lumian diligenter ducem aestimavit.

unit.source: He avoided using “Doctor” to refer to Lugano, as this Sequence primarily bestowed healing superpowers and didn’t offer significant improvement in combat.
unit.target: Vitavit uti verbo "Doctor" ad Lugano referendo, nam haec Series praecipue virtutes curativas supernaturales tribuebat neque proelio magnas emendationes praebebat.

unit.source: Lugano was delighted to hear this, sensing a newfound hope in his life.
unit.target: Lugano hoc audito laetatus est, novam spem in vita sua sentiens.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at him and added with a smile, “However, if you were to accept this commission, the reward might only be two to three thousand risot.
unit.target: Lumian ad eum respexit et subridenti addidit: "Attamen, si hanc commissionem acciperes, praemium fortasse solum duo vel tria milia risot erit.

unit.source: “The rest accounts for the premium based on the great adventurer’s reputation and the hush money for such a renowned figure.
unit.target: Reliqua constat ex pretio praemii fundato in famae adventoris claritate et mutuum silenti pro tali celebritate.

unit.source: That’s why you need to hunt down Demon Warlock before you can accept such a lucrative mission.
unit.target: Ideo oportet te Daemonem Warlock venari, priusquam talem missionem lucrativam accipias.

unit.source: The smile on Lugano’s face gradually faded.
unit.target: Subridens vultus Lugani paulatim evanuit.

unit.source: If I could hunt down Demon Warlock, my dream would be fulfilled.
unit.target: Si Daemonem Warlock venari possem, somnium meum perfici posset.
