unit.source: I wouldn’t have to be an adventurer!
unit.target: Non oporteret me adventorem esse!

unit.source: Lumian paid no mind to the translator’s emotional shifts.
unit.target: Lumian mutationibus affectuum interpretis non curavit.

unit.source: He glanced back at the large five-story villa and said thoughtfully, “The Matriarch of this family didn’t appear even until the end…”
unit.target: Retro respexit ad magnam villam quinque tabularum et meditatus dixit: "Matriarcha huius familiae ne ad finem quidem apparuit..."

unit.source: While it was understandable that the other family members hadn’t shown themselves, logically speaking, as the head of the family, the Matriarch should have at least expressed her gratitude to the adventurer who had helped them resolve the problem.
unit.target: Quamquam intellegendum erat ceteros familiares se non ostentavisse, ratione loquendo, ut caput familiae, matriarcha saltem gratiam suam adventori exprimere debuisset.

unit.source: “That’s correct. A woman of Giorgia’s age shouldn’t be the head of such a large family,” Lugano acknowledged, sensing the anomaly.
unit.target: "Recte dicis. Femina aetate Giorgiae non debet esse caput familiae tam amplae," Lugano agnovit, anomaliam sentiens.

unit.source: He refrained from bringing up the potential absence of a Matriarch in the villa.
unit.target: Abstulit a proposu de deesse matriarchae in villa.

unit.source: In extended families like this, there were likely more than one older woman who had given birth.
unit.target: In familiis extensis huius generis, probabiliter plus quam una femina senior, quae partum habuerat, exstiterunt.

unit.source: If one Matriarch passed away, another would soon assume the role.
unit.target: Si una matriarcha decedat, altera mox officium suscipiet.

unit.source: Additionally, the Earth Mother Church was renowned for its adept treatment of illnesses in the Northern and Southern Continents.
unit.target: Insuper, Ecclesia Matris Terrae celeber erat propter artem sollertem in curatione morborum in Continentiis Septentrionalibus et Meridionalibus.

unit.source: The Feynapotter Kingdom’s average lifespan surpassed that of Loen, Intis, Feysac, and other nations.
unit.target: Vita media regni Feynapotter superabat vitam mediam Loen, Intis, Feysac, aliisque nationibus.

unit.source: Plenty of individuals lived beyond the age of 70, especially with Giorgia’s family’s wealth providing ample medical resources.
unit.target: Multi ultra annos septuaginta vixerunt, praesertim cum divitiae familiae Giorgiae opes medicas amplas praebebant.

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze and took a few steps.
unit.target: Lumian oculos avertit et paucos passus fecit.

unit.source: “Go to the bar tonight and inquire about Giorgia’s family.”
unit.target: Vade ad cauponam hac nocte et de familia Giorgiae inquiro.

unit.source: As he spoke, he counted out 1,000 risot for Lugano.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, mille risot pro Lugano numeravit.

unit.source: “This covers your expenses for your activities during this period, including Ludwig’s meal expenses when I’m out.”
unit.target: Hoc operitur expensis tuis pro tuis activitatibus huius temporis, inclusive expensis convivii Ludovici cum absum.

unit.source: “Yes, Boss.” Lugano appreciated his employer’s generosity the most.
unit.target: "Etiam, Domine." Lugano benignitatem patroni sui maxime aestimavit.

unit.source: Near midnight, the Doctor returned to the suite at Solow Motel, reeking of alcohol.
unit.target: Prope mediam noctem, Doctor ad conclave Solow Motel rediit, alcoholi odores efferens.

unit.source: He addressed Lumian, who was observing Ludwig eat supper, “I got the info. Giorgia is the wife of Rubió Paco, a shareholder of Port Santa’s Fisheries Company and a committee member of the Fisheries Guild. The Paco family’s Matriarch is Rubio’s mother, Martha.”
unit.target: Ad Lumian se addressit, qui Ludovicum cenam edentem spectabat, "Notitiam accepi. Giorgia est uxor Rubió Paco, socii Societatis Piscatoriae Portus Sanctae et membrum commissionis Gremii Piscatorum. Matriarcha familiae Paco est mater Rubi, Martha."

unit.source: Committee member of the Fisheries Guild… Lumian instantly focused.
unit.target: Membrum commissionis Gremii Piscatorum... Lumian statim attendit.

unit.source: This was a person knowledgeable about the complete process of the sea prayer ritual and the accident from last year.
unit.target: Hic erat homo peritus de integro processu ritus orationis maris et de casu anni praeteriti.

unit.source: “What else did you find out?” Lumian asked casually.
unit.target: "Quid aliud invenisti?" Lumian leviter rogavit.

unit.source: Lugano rambled on for a while before adding, “By the way, Martha was once a Maiden of the Sea.”
unit.target: Lugano aliquantisper loquebatur, deinde addens: "Praeterea, Martha olim Puella Maris fuit."

unit.source: Maiden of the Sea…
unit.target: Puella Maris...

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds.
unit.target: Lumian aliquot momenta meditatus est.

unit.source: She had been sought after by a specific crowd before marrying into the Paco family?
unit.target: Ab aliquo coetu peculiario quaesita fuit antequam in familiam Paco coniugaretur?

unit.source: He asked, “Did you find out anything about Martha’s recent situation?”
unit.target: Rogavit: "Num quid de recenti Marthae re invenisti?"

unit.source: “No.” Lugano shook his head.
unit.target: "Non." Lugano caput concussit.

unit.source: Lumian leaned back in his chair, as if preparing to doze off, not pressing for more information.
unit.target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit, quasi obdormiscendum parans, ulteriora non quaerens.

unit.source: The next day, he stayed at the Solow Motel, awaiting Valerio’s preparations for his local identification documents.
unit.target: Die sequenti, ad Solow Motel permanuit, praeparationes Valerii pro documentis identitatis localibus exspectans.

unit.source: As evening approached, his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, emerged from the void and handed him a letter.
unit.target: Vesperi accedente, nuntius eius, Penitent Baynfel, ex vacuo emergens ei epistolam tradidit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the charred corpse, still engulfed in viscous black flames, and casually asked, “Who sent it?”
unit.target: Lumian ad cadaver comburatum, adhuc in viscosis flammis nigris involutum, respexit atque leviter rogavit: "Quis id misit?"

unit.source: Only five people were aware of his messenger’s summoning incantation.
unit.target: Solum quinque homines incantationem vocationis nuntii eius noverunt.

unit.source: “A woman very close to death and darkness,” Baynfel replied.
unit.target: "Mulier ad mortem et tenebras valde appropinquata," Baynfel respondit.

unit.source: Lumian unfolded the letter and read the familiar handwriting: “There’s a gathering scheduled for 10 tonight…”
unit.target: Lumian epistolam explicavit et notam manu consuetam legit: "Conventus ad horam decimam hac nocte ordinatus est..."

unit.source: This was from Hela. Before leaving Trier, Lumian had specifically summoned Hela’s messenger and informed her of his messenger’s summoning method. With his frequent travel and changes in residence, it was impractical to summon Hela’s messenger each time he stayed in a motel. Hence, he made such arrangements to convenience her in getting him.
unit.target: Hoc a Hela erat. Prius Trier relinquens, Lumian nuntium Helae specialiter convocaverat et eam de modo vocationis nuntii sui informaverat. Propter itinerationes frequentes et mutationes domicilii, invocare nuntium Helae quoties in motel mansisset inopportunum erat. Ideo talia ordinavit ut ei convenire possent in eum convocandum.

unit.source: Each messenger was intricately bound to its master. Through the mystical connection of the contract, the messenger could track the contracted target regardless of their changing locations.
unit.target: Quisque nuntius arcte domino suo ligatus erat. Per nexum mysticum contractus, nuntius destinatum persequi poterat, ubicumque loca mutantur.

unit.source: The Research Society has another gathering… Lumian dismissed Baynfel and moved to the window of the master bedroom.
unit.target: Societas Investigationis alium conventum habet... Lumian Baynfel dimisit et ad fenestram cubiculi principali progressus est.

unit.source: He peered into the distance, toward the mottled mountain range to the northeast.
unit.target: Longinquus intuebatur, versus catena montium variegatorum ad septentriones.

unit.source: Under the afterglow of the setting sun, the mountains seemed to doze in the burning sky.
unit.target: Sub fulgore solis occurrentis, montes quasi in caelo ardenti obdormire videbantur.

unit.source: Lumian silently observed for a moment, then retrieved the silver Lie earring and placed it on his left earlobe.
unit.target: Lumian silentiose paulisper contemplatus est, deinde argenteum subauralium "Lie" iteravit et in lobulo auris sinistra posuit.

unit.source: In an instant, his hair transformed, turning golden and elongating downward.
unit.target: In momento, capilli eius transformati sunt, aurei facti et in longum deorsum extendentes.

unit.source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian, cloaked in a black robe, hood, and a silver-white half-mask with a “Muggle” label, materialized.
unit.target: Hora decima vespertina, in antiquo et ruinoso palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian, indutus veste nigra, capuce, et dimidia larva argenteo-alba cum inscriptione "Muggle", apparuit.

unit.source: He immediately spotted Franca, who wore an Assassin suit and had pulled down her hood.
unit.target: Statim Francam animadvertit, quae vestem sicarii gerebat et caput velamen deplexerat.

unit.source: Franca, no longer concealing their amicable relationship, leaned in and lowered her voice.
unit.target: Franca, iam relationem amicabilem non celans, se inclinavit atque vocem demisit.

unit.source: “Port Santa didn’t have a Derangement outbreak, I suppose?”
unit.target: "Portus Sanctus non habuit epidemiam perturbationis, ut opinor?"

unit.source: “I’m not the embodiment of calamity,” Lumian replied.
unit.target: "Non sum incarnatio calamitatis," Lumian respondit.

unit.source: He then said to Franca, “Help me inquire in different teams later if there are any potions, charms, or items that can allow me to master a language in a short period of time—not true mastery, but the kind that allows mastery for a short period.”
unit.target: Tum Francae dixit: "Adiuvam me in diversis coetibus postea inquirere, si qua sint potiones, charmes, aut res, quae mihi sinant linguam in brevi tempore dominari — non vere dominatio, sed genus quod temporarie regnere sinit."

unit.source: Franca asked in confusion, “Don’t you have a translator?”
unit.target: Franca confundens rogavit: "Num interpretem non habes?"

unit.source: Lumian smiled and said, “It’s just that I suddenly had an idea. When everyone thinks I don’t know Highlander, I can understand what they’re talking about. Perhaps it can bring about unexpected gains.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Modo repente mihi idea orta est. Cum omnes putent me linguam Highlander nescire, intellegere possum quid dicantur. Forsitan ex hoc inopinata beneficia proveniant."

unit.source: Your scheming heart is truly stained! After Franca playfully cursed him, she wanted to praise Aurore’s beautiful lips and smile, one that ought to be seen more often, but her rationality made her give up on the idea to avoid triggering Lumian.
unit.target: Cor insidiosum tuum vere maculatum est! Postquam Franca eum luderet maledixit, vellet oscularum et risus Aurore pulcherrimos laudare, qui saepius ostendi deberent, sed eius rationalitas eam coegit idea relinquere ne Lumian concuteretur.

unit.source: She glanced at a corner of the palace and said, “The team most likely to obtain such items is actually the Academy. However, it’s inconvenient for you to ask. It can easily arouse suspicion. Coincidentally, I’m heading to the Academy team today to inquire if anyone knows who the owners of the ancient tombs in Trier’s catacombs are. Heh heh, many of them are considered semi-historians. If no one knows, I’ll get 007 to delve into the Church’s confidential information.”
unit.target: Angulum palatii intuens dixit: "Turma quae verisimiliter talia res obtineat re vera Academia est. Sed tibi inquirere incommodum est; facile suspicionem excitabit. Casu, hodie ad turmam Academiae me conferam ut inquiream si quis sciat quis possideat antiqua tumula in catacumbis Trevirensibus. Heh heh, multi ex eis semi-historiographi habentur. Si nemo sciat, 007 mittam ut in res secretas Ecclesiae penetret."

unit.source: “Why do you ask?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: "Cur quaeris?" Lumian supercilia levavit.

unit.source: Franca recounted how she and Jenna had obtained a new Mirror World Fragment in the catacombs.
unit.target: Franca narravit quomodo ipsa et Jenna novum Fragmentum Mundi Specularis in catacumbis obtinuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian listened attentively and scoffed.
unit.target: Lumian attente audivit et irridens derisit.

unit.source: “Aren’t you guys too bold? Jenna has been inspired by your courage!”
unit.target: "Nonne estis nimis audaces? Jenna ex vestra fortitudine incitata est!"

unit.source: As soon as he finished speaking, he saw 007 approaching menacingly.
unit.target: Statim finito loquendo, vidit 007 minaciter accedentem.

unit.source: 543 Same Dream
unit.target: 543 Somnium Idem

unit.source: 543 Same Dream
unit.target: 543 Somnium Idem

unit.source: Wearing a lion headgear, 007 intercepted Franca’s path, gritting his teeth.
unit.target: Gerens galeam capitis leonis, 007 iter Francae intercepit, dentes contraxit.

unit.source: "Hidden Blade, thanks to your intel, I might be deployed on a mission right now."
unit.target: "Hidden Blade, propter notitiam tuam, fortasse nunc in missionem mittar."

unit.source: "Huh?" Franca didn’t quite get it.
unit.target: "Heu?" Franca non prorsus intellexit.

unit.source: Deployed on a mission?
unit.target: Missus in missione?

unit.source: If you’re out, who do I report problems to in Trier?
unit.target: Si abes, cui in Treveris problemata referam?

unit.source: 007 glanced at Muggle, standing silently beside them, and took a deep breath.
unit.target: 007 Muggle, qui iuxta eos silentiose stabat, aspexit et halitum profundum cepit.

unit.source: "I might head to Feynapotter as an assistant to retrieve that Sealed Artifact."
unit.target: "Fortasse ad Feynapotter pergam ut adiutor in rem sigillatam recuperandam."

unit.source: "It’s Intis’ loss, and it wouldn’t be good for it to end up in the hands of the Feynapotter Kingdom."
unit.target: "Intis damnum est, nec bene esset si in manibus Regni Feynapotter perveniret."

unit.source: "Will the Feynapotterians allow you to enforce the law in their country? Isn’t transnational cooperation troublesome?"
unit.target: Num Feynapotteriani tibi sinent legem in terra sua exsequi? Nonne cooperatio transnationalis incommodum est?

unit.source: Franca roughly understood 007’s concerns.
unit.target: Franca circiter intellexit curas 007.

unit.source: 007 pondered for a moment and said, "We’re still working through the process, but the Feynapotterians aren’t too opposed this time. They want to eliminate the hidden dangers of the Sealed Artifact ASAP. They have precautions to take and can’t spare many to surround and intercept it, so they might as well borrow our strength."
unit.target: 007 paulisper meditatus est et dixit, "Processu adhuc laboramus, sed Feynapotteriani hoc tempore non nimis obstinati sunt. Volunt pericula occulta Rese Sigillatae quam primum tollere. Habent cautiones ad suscipiendum et non possunt multos parare ad eam circumveniendam et intercipiendam, itaque fortasse vim nostram mutuabuntur."

unit.source: The Church of Earth Mother and the Feynapotter Kingdom need to be vigilant.
unit.target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae et Regnum Feynapotter vigilantare debent.

unit.source: Are they short on manpower?
unit.target: Num copia hominum deficit?

unit.source: This is a problem with a single Church country.
unit.target: Hoc est problema patriae unius Ecclesiae.

unit.source: They don’t have the resources like a combination of two or three Churches.
unit.target: Non habent opes, ut ex coniunctione duarum vel trium Ecclesiarum.

unit.source: Wait, that doesn’t make sense.
unit.target: Exspecta, hoc non habet sensum.

unit.source: The Feynapotter Kingdom has a royal family, and Beyonders of the Church don’t only follow the pathway of their deity.
unit.target: Regnum Feynapotter familiam regiam habet, et Beyonders Ecclesiae non solum viam dei sui sequuntur.

unit.source: Lumian sensed something amiss from 007’s words.
unit.target: Lumian ex verbis 007 aliquid inordinatum sensit.

unit.source: This made him feel that the hidden dangers in the Feynapotter Kingdom were no less than those in countries with multiple deities and Churches.
unit.target: Hoc eum fecit sentire, pericula occulta in Regno Feynapotter non minus esse quam in nationibus cum multiplicibus deis et Ecclesiis.

unit.source: "Is that so…"
unit.target: "Ita vero…"

unit.source: Franca suddenly had an idea.
unit.target: Franca subito ideam accepit.

unit.source: "I have a way to ensure you don’t have to be deployed!"
unit.target: "Viā habeo qua efficere possum ut non necesse sit te in missionem mittere!"

unit.source: "What way?" 007 asked skeptically.
unit.target: "Quae via?" rogavit 007 dubia mente.

unit.source: Franca smiled and said, "If you’re on an important mission in Trier, there’s no need for you to be deployed."
unit.target: Franca subridet et dixit, "Si in missione magni momenti Treveris adsis, non opus est ut mittaris."

unit.source: "Important mission…" 007 repeated in a low voice, suddenly having an ominous feeling.
unit.target: "Missione magni momenti…" repetivit 007 voce demissa, repente sensu ominoso affectus.

unit.source: Franca seized the opportunity and said, "We’ve located another Mirror World Fragment in an ancient tomb on the fourth level of the catacombs."
unit.target: Franca occasionem arripuit et dixit, "Invenimus alium Fragmentum Mundi Specularis in sepulcro antiquo in quarto gradu catacumbarum."

unit.source: Now, we have a lead to pursue the Mirror People in Trier.
unit.target: Nunc habemus inditium ad persequendos Homines Speculares in Treveris.

unit.source: If you report it and convey that you’re conducting an investigation, you likely won’t end up in Feynapotter.
unit.target: Si id referas et indicaveris te inquisitionem agere, probabiliter in Feynapotter non pervenies.

unit.source: 007 stared at Franca, dressed in an assassin suit, for a moment.
unit.target: 007 paulisper Francam, habitu sicarii induta, aspexit.

unit.source: He raised his hand to rub his forehead and spoke gravely, "Thanks a lot, Hidden Blade!"
unit.target: Manum levavit ad frontem terere et graviter locutus est, "Multas gratias, Hidden Blade!"

unit.source: Franca pretended not to catch 007’s underlying message and continued,
unit.target: Franca simulavit nescire quid 007 insinuaret et continuavit,

unit.source: "The tomb is situated near the Crazy Mushroom Cave."
unit.target: "Sepulchrum prope antrum fungorum insanorum situm est."

unit.source: "Its door is wide open, and there are no conspicuous signs."
unit.target: "Ianuam eius late apertam esse, et nullæ signa conspicua apparent."

unit.source: "Please gather information from the catacombs about its construction date, its occupants, and the ancient family it belongs to."
unit.target: "Quaeso, colligas informationes ex catacumbis de die constructionis eius, de incolis eius, et de familia antiqua cuius est."

unit.source: "Only then can we determine why the peculiar Mirror People entered and met their demise there."
unit.target: "Tum solum possumus determinare cur insoliti Homines Speculares iluc intraverint et ibi interierint."

unit.source: 007 took a deep breath and slowly exhaled.
unit.target: 007 halitum profundum cepit et lente exhalavit.

unit.source: "You’re a perfect boss for me."
unit.target: "Optime praefectus es mihi."

unit.source: All you know is to assign me missions!
unit.target: "Omne quod scis, est mihi missiones imponere!"

unit.source: Franca let out a hollow laugh and shifted the topic.
unit.target: Franca risum inanium edidit et rem mutavit.

unit.source: "Do you have any idea what’s happening in the Crazy Mushroom Cave?"
unit.target: "Habesne aliquam ideam quid in antrum fungorum insanorum fiat?"

unit.source: "Mushrooms are somehow thriving in that silent, dark, and tightly sealed place."
unit.target: "Fungi aliquo modo florent in illo loco silente, obscuro, et arcte clauso."

unit.source: "Moreover, it seems to be the only location in the fourth-level catacombs where mushrooms grow."
unit.target: "Praeterea, videtur sola esse regio in catacumbis gradu quarto, quo fungi crescunt."

unit.source: 007 nodded gently and replied, "I have some knowledge about that.
unit.target: 007 leniter annuit et respondit, "De hoc aliquam scientiam habeo.

unit.source: Once upon a time, I was quite intrigued by the mushroom cave.
unit.target: Olim antrum fungorum insanorum me maxime admirari fecit.

unit.source: I conducted an investigation and discovered that it was initially quite ordinary—a naturally formed cave among the ancient tombs.
unit.target: Inquisitionem feci et inveni eum initio satis ordinarium esse—antrum naturale inter sepulchra antiqua formatum.

unit.source: When the catacombs were completed, some of the ancient corpses were relocated there.
unit.target: Cum catacumbae confectae essent, nonnulli ex antiquis cadaveribus ibi repositi sunt.

unit.source: Within a few weeks, it became overrun with mushrooms and sealed off.
unit.target: In paucis hebdomadibus, antrum fungis abundanter repletum est et obclusum factum est.

unit.source: The Beyonder powers brought about by the seal’s formal formation combined with the problem of certain ancient corpses created such a Crazy Mushroom Cave?
unit.target: Potestne fieri ut potentiae Beyonder, ex formali formatione sigilli, una cum quaestione nonnullorum antiquorum cadaverum, talem Caverna Fungorum Insanorum creaverint?

unit.source: Lumian analyzed the reason thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian causam diligenter examinavit.

unit.source: Observing Muggle’s attentive silence, 007 nodded courteously and turned to head towards the Sanctuary team.
unit.target: Observans silentiam Muggle attentam, 007 comiter annuit et se ad turmam Sanctuarii convertit.

unit.source: Franca couldn’t help but chuckle.
unit.target: Franca non potuit quin subridere.

unit.source: "He’s so polite to you. If only he knew that most of his troubles and fatigue stemmed from you, his expression would be quite the sight."
unit.target: Ille tibi tam urbanus est. Si autem sciret plerumque difficultates et lassitudinem suam ex te oriri, vultus eius praeclarus esset.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian responso subridens.

unit.source: "But the Mirror People situation has nothing to do with me."
unit.target: "Sed res Hominum Specularium ad me nihil refert."

unit.source: As they conversed, they strolled toward the corner where the Academy team congregated.
unit.target: Dum colloquebantur, ambulaverunt ad angulum ubi turba Academiae conveniebat.

unit.source: Midway, Lumian suddenly turned to Franca.
unit.target: In medio itinere, Lumian repente se ad Francam vertit.

unit.source: "Do you think any member of the Research Society, especially those in Trier, might have been replaced by the Mirror People?"
unit.target: "Credisne aliquum membrum Societatis Investigationis, praesertim in Treveris, ab Hominibus Specularibus substitutum esse?"

unit.source: "That’s impossible… Don’t scare me!" Franca sounded alarmed.
unit.target: "Id impossibile est… Noli me terrere!" inquit Franca, territa.

unit.source: Lumian fought the urge to pout, not wanting to destroy his sister’s beautiful image.
unit.target: Lumian conatum vultum contritum ostendere repressit, ne imaginem sororis suae pulchram everteret.

unit.source: "What’s impossible? Any Trier citizen could be replaced by the Mirror People, even if they’re part of a secret organization."
unit.target: "Quid est impossibile? Quisque civis Treverensis a Hominibus Specularibus substitui potest, etiam si pars sint societatis secretae."

unit.source: "Moreover, most in the Research Society are Beyonders with a strong spirit of exploration. Their encounters with Beyonder incidents are more frequent than regular folks."
unit.target: "Praeterea, plerique in Societate Investigationis sunt Beyonders, robusto spiritu explorationis praediti. Eorum congressiones cum casibus Beyonder frequentiores sunt quam cum plebe."

unit.source: Franca nodded seriously, acknowledging the potential risk couldn’t be disregarded.
unit.target: Franca serio annuit, agnoscens periculum potentiale neglegi non posse.

unit.source: "As a Review Committee member, you should liaise with Madame Hela and the others, observe discreetly," Lumian reminded her.
unit.target: "Ut membrum Commissionis Recensionis, debes cum Domina Hela et aliis consociari atque discrete observare," admonuit Lumian.

unit.source: There lingered uncertainty about whether the Mirror People of transmigrators retained their pre‐transmigration memories.
unit.target: Incertitudo manebat utrum Homines Speculares transmigratorum praetransmigrationis memoriam retinerent.

unit.source: If they did, they could bypass the Committee’s safeguards easily.
unit.target: Si id fecerint, facile praesidia Commissionis praeterire possent.

unit.source: Their interactions within the Research Society could go undetected unless they caused harm, staying concealed.
unit.target: Interactiones eorum intra Societatem Investigationis latent, nisi laedissent, manentes absconditae.

unit.source: "Understood," Franca responded with solemnity.
unit.target: "Intellectum," respondit Franca sollemniter.

unit.source: At that moment, many familiar members of Lumian’s team gathered in the corner, including Professor, Associate Professor, Headmaster, Periodic Table, Bear, Griffin, and Isotope.
unit.target: Illo momento, multi noti membri turmae Lumiani congregaverunt in angulo, inter quos Professor, Professor Associatus, Magister, Tabula Periodica, Ursus, Gryphus, et Isotope.

unit.source: Some wore different disguises than before, though Lumian had grown accustomed to their diverse outfits.
unit.target: Nonnulli alias species gerebant quam ante, cum Lumian ad eorum vestimenta varia consuetus esset.

unit.source: They were individuals who wouldn’t attend a masquerade ball in the same attire twice.
unit.target: Erant homines qui non bis eandem vestem in convivio larvari gererent.

unit.source: Regardless, their general body shape, language, and chest labels helped others accurately identify them.
unit.target: Attamen, habitus corporis eorum, lingua, et tituli pectorales aliis eos accurate agnoscere adiuvabant.

unit.source: After exchanging greetings, Lumian and Franca each took a seat.
unit.target: Postquam salutationes dimitterunt, Lumian et Franca singuli sedere consederunt.

unit.source: After a few minutes, Franca raised her hand and said,
unit.target: Post paucas minutas, Franca manum levavit et dixit,

unit.source: "Is anyone selling Language Comprehension-type items? I know someone who’s going overseas and wants to acquire some."
unit.target: "Num quis vendit res generis comprehensionis linguisticae? Novi aliquem qui in terras exteriores proficiscitur et aliqua comparare vult."

unit.source: Upon hearing her request, some chuckled, while others pursed their lips.
unit.target: Audita petitione eius, quidam subriserunt, alii labras contraxerunt.

unit.source: The former wanted to inquire if her friend was herself, while the latter recalled the key member of April Fool’s who had caused numerous catastrophes in the Research Society.
unit.target: Primum, quidam voluerunt scire si amica eius ipsa esset, dum alii revocaverunt membrum clavi Aprilis Stulti, qui multas calamitates in Societate Investigationis attulit.

unit.source: Bear, encased in a brown bear hide, spoke in ancient Feysac in a muffled voice, "I have a Language Comprehension charm that achieves a similar effect."
unit.target: Ursus, in pellibus ursinae fusca involutus, antiqua Feysac lingua voce molli locutus est: "Habeo incantationem comprehensionis linguisticae quae effectum similem praestat."

unit.source: "Language Comprehension charm?" Franca asked with interest.
unit.target: "Incantatio comprehensionis linguisticae?" inquit Franca cum studio.

unit.source: Having been fluent in ancient Feysac for many years, she had become relatively proficient in Loen, Highlander, and other languages of the Northern Continent. However, she lacked knowledge of the Southern Continent’s languages.
unit.target: Multos annos antiquam Feysac linguam loquens, facta est relativae peritiae in Loen, Highlander, atque aliis linguis Continenti Septentrionali. Attamen, de linguis Continenti Meridionalis parum sciebat.

unit.source: The Academy team member with the code name "Bear" glanced at Hidden Blade with his coffee-colored eyes.
unit.target: Membrum turmae Academiae, cum codice "Ursus", Hidden Blade oculis colore cafeo aspexit.

unit.source: "Yes, its essence is to temporarily strengthen and alter the Body of Heart and Mind, improving understanding, reasoning, and communication.
unit.target: "Ita, eius essentia est ut corpus cordis et mentis temporarie roborare atque mutare, intellegentiam, rationem, et communicationem augens."

unit.source: It also imparts a portion of the corresponding language’s knowledge.
unit.target: Etiam portionem scientiae linguae tradit.

unit.source: Using one lasts seven days.
unit.target: Usus unius septem dies durat.

unit.source: Currently, Language Comprehension charms are divided into three types.
unit.target: Nunc, incantationes comprehensionis linguisticae in tres species dividuntur.

unit.source: The lowest level is for all ancient Feysacian languages.
unit.target: Genus infimum ad omnes linguas antiquas Feysacianas destinatur.

unit.source: Creating them is the least difficult.
unit.target: Facilima est eorum creatio.

unit.source: You only need…
unit.target: Solum opus est…

unit.source: Bear paused, making a conversion based on the current exchange rate.
unit.target: Ursus subsedit, conversionem ex currente cursu nummario faciens.

unit.source: "A thousand verl d’or."
unit.target: "Mille verl d’or."

unit.source: "The middle level covers all ordinary languages.
unit.target: Genus medium omnes linguas ordinarias complectitur.

unit.source: It costs 2,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Pretium est 2,000 verl d’or.

unit.source: At the highest level, you can temporarily master a designated supernatural language.
unit.target: In genere supremo, potes linguam supernaturalem designatam temporarie dominari.

unit.source: 5,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: "5,000 verl d’or."

unit.source: Hidden Blade, which one do you want?
unit.target: Hidden Blade, quem elige?

unit.source: Franca listened attentively, sensing a subtle expression of pity and regret in Bear’s gaze.
unit.target: Franca auscultavit attente, sensu subtili miserationis ac paenitentiae in aspectu Ursi.

unit.source: Is he pitying me for daring to drink the Witch potion back then?
unit.target: Num me miseratur, quia audus sum potionem strigae bibere tunc?

unit.source: Franca wondered silently.
unit.target: Franca silentio quaerebat.

unit.source: Without looking at Muggle, she made the decision.
unit.target: Non Muggle intuens, consilium cepit.

unit.source: "Three lowest-level Language Comprehension charms, one mid-level. Uh, can I get a discount?"
unit.target: "Tres incantationes comprehensionis linguisticae generis infimi, una de genere medii. Eh, licetne mihi pretium minui?"

unit.source: She believed Lumian would eventually track down Hisoka in the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Credidit Lumian tandem Hisokam in Continente Meridionali deprehensurum esse.

unit.source: It was better to prepare a Mid-level Language Comprehension charm now.
unit.target: Melius erat nunc incantationem comprehensionis linguisticae generis medii parare.

unit.source: "No." Bear shook his head.
unit.target: "Non." Ursus caput concussit.

unit.source: "Alright," Franca said, lacking talent for bargaining.
unit.target: "Recte," dixit Franca, ingenio mercandi carens.

unit.source: She habitually asked for a discount to avoid potential future regret.
unit.target: Saepe petebat pretium decrescere, ne futura paenitentia occurreret.

unit.source: After Franca paid and settled on the delivery method, Professor, adorned with a black butterfly mask, surveyed the area.
unit.target: Postquam Franca solvit et modum traditionis constituit, Professor, ornata masca papilionis nigrae, regionem inspexit.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, she spoke up.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus meditationis, illa locuta est.

unit.source: "Associate Professor, I and a few Warlocks I know have been having strange dreams lately.
unit.target: "Professor Associatus, ego et pauci magi quos novi sum, nuper somnia insolita habuimus.

unit.source: In these dreams, there’s a wilderness with many indistinct figures wandering around.
unit.target: In his somniis, vastitas cum multis figuris indistinctis errantibus exstat.

unit.source: "Have any of you had one too?"
unit.target: "Habecne vestrum aliquis tale somnium habuit?"

unit.source: She directed her inquiry towards the other Warlocks in the Academy team.
unit.target: Interrogationem suam ad alios magos turmae Academiae direxit.

unit.source: Wilderness… Wandering figures… Could this be related to some Madame’s Paramita?
unit.target: Silva… figuræ vagantes… Num hoc ad aliquam Paramitam Dominae pertineat?

unit.source: Lumian, concealed behind a silver-white half-mask, furrowed his brow slightly.
unit.target: Lumian, post larvam dimidiatam argenteo-albam celatus, leviter supercilium contraxit.

unit.source: It seemed unlikely that a Warlock would dream of Paramita.
unit.target: Parum credibile videbatur ne magus tale Paramitae somnium haberet.

unit.source: Why would they?
unit.target: Cur id facerent?

unit.source: Observing other Warlocks expressing that they had similar dreams, but the frequency and clarity decreased over time, Lumian, acting as Aurore, nodded and posed a question instead of providing an answer.
unit.target: Observans alios magos similia somnia habere, sed quorum frequentia et claritas tempore decrescere videbantur, Lumian, ut Aurore se gerens, annuit et quaestionem posuit pro responsione.

unit.source: "When did you guys start having this dream?"
unit.target: "Quando coepistis hoc somnium habere?"

unit.source: Could it be an abnormality caused by the Hidden Sage?
unit.target: Num anormalitas, a Saggio Occulto causa effecta, sit?

unit.source: Professor had clearly made confirmation on this matter.
unit.target: Professor hoc negotium clare confirmaverat.

unit.source: "The two of us and some friends started after the night of the terrifying storm in Trier—last month."
unit.target: "Nos duo et nonnulli amici coepimus post noctem tempestatis terribilis in Treveris—mense proximo."

unit.source: She knew that Muggle was also in Trier and knew the exact night she referred to.
unit.target: Scivit Muggle etiam in Treveris esse et noctem exactam de qua loquebatur.

unit.source: The sudden, terrifying downpour occurred the night the Hostel ritual was activated…
unit.target: Imber subitus et terribilis evenit nocte qua rituale Hostel activatum est...

unit.source: Could it be influenced by the leaked power of the seal?
unit.target: Num id potentia sigilli effusa influat?

unit.source: Is there a high-level power of the Mystery Pryer pathway sealed inside?
unit.target: Num potentia alta viae Mystery Pryer intus sigillata sit?

unit.source: Or were the fallen monks of the Deep Valley Cloister connected to the Hidden Sage?
unit.target: An monachi lapsi ex claustro Vallis Profundae ad Saggio Occulto pertinuerunt?

unit.source: Did this evil god secretly do something that left some power in the real world?
unit.target: An hic deus malus occulto quicquam fecit, quod aliquam potentiam in mundo reali reliquit?

unit.source: Lumian pondered and then said, "I heard something happened to Trier’s Deep Valley Cloister that night, and the Savant pathway and the Mystery Pryer pathway are neighboring pathways."
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, deinde dixit, "Audivi aliquid evenisse claustro Vallis Profundae Treveris illa nocte, et via Savant et via Mystery Pryer sunt viæ vicinae."

unit.source: Professor, Associate Professor, and the others turned their gaze to Muggle.
unit.target: Professor, Professor Associatus, et ceteri vultum suum ad Muggle converterunt.

unit.source: They hadn’t expected their companion, who had recently moved to Trier, to possess such secretive knowledge about the local area.
unit.target: Non exspectaverunt comitem suum, qui nuper in Treveris habitaret, talem arcanam scientiam de regione locali possidere.

unit.source: Lumian continued slowly, "Shouldn’t we inquire with people from the Savant pathway and see if they had similar dreams?"
unit.target: Lumian lente continuavit, "Num non debemus rogare homines ex via Savant, ut videamus num similia somnia haberent?"

unit.source: Good idea! Franca silently praised.
unit.target: Optima sententia! Franca silentio laudavit.

unit.source: 544 Threat
unit.target: 544 Minatio

unit.source: 544 Threat
unit.target: 544 Minatio

unit.source: Professor agreed with Lumian’s suggestion, believing it could help verify certain things.
unit.target: Professor consentiit suggestioni Lumiani, credens illud posse ad quaedam certiora comprobanda efficere.

unit.source: Both Professor and Associate Professor went to another team and found Stonemason, who was known for crafting mystical items.
unit.target: Et Professor atque Professor Associatus ad aliam turmam accesserunt et Lapidarium invenerunt, qui notus erat ad res mysticas conficiendas.

unit.source: Dressed in a doctor’s white coat with a saucepan over his head, Stonemason’s azure eyes focused on the Academy Warlocks through two specially dug holes.
unit.target: Indutus veste alba medica cum sartagine super caput, oculi caerulei Lapidarii incantatores Academiae per duas specialiter foditas foramina intuebantur.

unit.source: He nodded and said, “Recently, I’ve also been having strange dreams related to a wilderness.
unit.target: Caput inclinavit et dixit: “Nuper etiam somnia mira pertinebant ad desertum.

unit.source: However, in addition to the endless wilderness and wandering figures, there are also some peculiar scenes in my dreams.”
unit.target: At praeter infinita deserta et vagantes figuras, nonnulla scaena insolita in somniis meis apparuerunt.”

unit.source: As expected, it affects the neighboring pathways of Mystery Pryer and Savant…
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur, hoc semitas vicinas Mystery Pryer et Savant afficit…

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly as Professor pressed further, “What scenes are they?”
unit.target: Lumian leviter inclinavit, dum Professor ulterius interrogabat, “Quae scaenae sunt illae?”

unit.source: Stonemason’s voice echoed within the saucepan.
unit.target: Vox Lapidarii intra sartaginem resonavit.

unit.source: “I see scenes of primitive humans independently creating fire for the first time.
unit.target: “Video scaenas hominum primitivorum, qui ignem primo tempore sui ipsorum more creant.

unit.source: Ancient humans making sacrifices to the sky and land.
unit.target: Antiqui homines, caelum et terram sacrificabant.

unit.source: There were many similar scenes, but they were very vague.
unit.target: Multae similes scaenae erant, sed erant valde indistinctae.

unit.source: I was in a dream and couldn’t scrutinize them carefully.
unit.target: In somnio eram neque eas diligenter perscrutari poteram.

unit.source: I can’t remember the exact situations clearly.
unit.target: Non possum exactas res clare meminisse.

unit.source: “According to the Savant pathway’s Beyonders, this is a fragment of civilization.”
unit.target: “Secundum Beyonders semitae Savant, hoc est fragmentum civilizationis.”

unit.source: Upon hearing Stonemason’s response, Lumian’s forehead twitched imperceptibly.
unit.target: Audito responsu Lapidarii, frons Lumiani vix perceptibiliter contremuit.

unit.source: It reminded him of the moment he heard a peculiar sound accompanying scenes while wearing the Mystery Prying Eye in Fourth Epoch Trier!
unit.target: Illud illi reminiscibatur tempore quo sonum peculiare audiverat, qui scaenas comitabatur, dum Oculum Mystery Pryer in Quarta Epoch Trier gerebat!

unit.source: As the scenes unfolded, a chorus of voices echoed one name: Celestial Master!
unit.target: Dum scaenae patebant, chorus vocum unum nomen resonabat: Magister Caelestis!

unit.source: Was what I received a fragment of a civilization?
unit.target: Num id quod accepi erat fragmentum civilizationis?

unit.source: The Eye of Truth correspond to the Mystery Pryer pathway.
unit.target: Oculus Veritatis semitae Mystery Pryer respondet.

unit.source: Upon their use, they activated the powers of neighboring pathways, revealing corresponding sounds?
unit.target: Eorum usu, vires semitarum vicinarum excitaverunt, revelantes sonos correspondentes?

unit.source: But there is a prerequisite, a special environment…
unit.target: Sed est praevia condicio, ambitus peculiaris…

unit.source: Fourth Epoch Trier holds remnants of advanced powers from the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways.
unit.target: Trier, in Quarta Epoch, reliquias virium provectarum ex semitis Mystery Pryer et Savant continet.

unit.source: Celestial Master—the term is similar to the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings which influences Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways.
unit.target: Magister Caelestis—terminus hic similis est Caelesti Honorabili Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus, qui semitas Videntis, Discipuli, et Praedonis afficit.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Celestial Master correlates with the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways.
unit.target: Interim, Magister Caelestis semitis Mystery Pryer et Savant convenit.

unit.source: Lumian fell into deep thought after his initial shock.
unit.target: Lumian post primum stupefactum in altam meditationem incidit.

unit.source: Franca glanced at him, perplexed by his limited participation in the discussion.
unit.target: Franca eum intuebatur, perplexa parvae eius participationis in disputatione.

unit.source: After a moment, Lumian snapped out of his daze.
unit.target: Post aliquantum, Lumian ex sua torpore evigilavit.

unit.source: Considering Professor, Stonemason, and others’ speculations, he carefully stated, “The sudden downpour in Trier is an outward manifestation of a catastrophe, much like the Deep Valley Cloister.
unit.target: Consideratis speculationibus Professoris, Lapidarii, et aliorum, Lumian caute dixit: “Impromptus imber in Trier est externa species cladis, similis Claustri Vallis Profundae.

unit.source: “I suspect that a high-level power leaked during the catastrophe, affecting Beyonders from two neighboring pathways.
unit.target: Suspicio est quod potentia altissima in clade effusa sit, afficiens Beyonders ex duabus semitis vicinarum.

unit.source: The impact is more pronounced for those in Trier but relatively minor for those outside.”
unit.target: Impulsus in Trier magis notabilis est, sed extra parvus.

unit.source: At this point, Lumian smirked.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Lumian subridens egit.

unit.source: “I’ve observed that Warlocks outside Trier experienced significant decreases in the frequency and clarity of their wilderness dreams.
unit.target: “Animadverti Incantatores extra Trier in frequentia et claritate somniorum de solitudine significanter diminutos esse.

unit.source: Strangely, none of the Warlocks in Trier mentioned this.”
unit.target: Inusitatum est, nullus Incantator in Trier hoc dixerit.

unit.source: Bear in a brown bear skin suit nodded approvingly.
unit.target: Ursa, induta veste ex cute ursi fusci, approbans inclinavit.

unit.source: Professor and others concurred with Lumian’s hypothesis, relieved that the situation was indeed improving.
unit.target: Professor atque alii cum hypothesi Lumiani consenserunt, solati quod res vere meliorabantur.

unit.source: They couldn’t help but marvel at Muggle’s remarkable growth after surviving the April Fool’s trap.
unit.target: Non potuerunt non mirari mirabili incrementu Muggle, postquam insidias Aprilis Stultorum superaverat.

unit.source: Franca then inquired about the owner of the ancient tomb beside the Crazy Mushroom Cave in Trier’s catacombs.
unit.target: Franca deinde quaesivit de domino sepulchri antiquati iuxta Specum Fungorum Insaniae in catacumbis Trier.

unit.source: No one knew the answer.
unit.target: Nemo responsum sciebat.

unit.source: The Warlocks in Trier offered to assist in the investigation, but there were no guarantees of finding anything.
unit.target: Incantatores in Trier auxilium ferre in investigatione obtulerunt, sed nulla fides erat aliquid inveniendi.

unit.source: Franca had already entrusted this matter to 007.
unit.target: Franca iam hanc rem 007 committerat.

unit.source: Her current focus was on uncovering any Mirror People who might have infiltrated the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, thanks to Lumian’s teachings.
unit.target: Praesens eius cura erat in detegendo quibusvis Hominibus Specularibus, qui fortasse in Societatem Inquisitionis Baboonum Crispor Capillorum penetraverunt, gratia Lumiani doctrinae.

unit.source: After agreeing on the reward, she left the Academy team and headed towards Hela.
unit.target: Post consensum de praemio, illa turmam Academiae reliquit et versus Helam se contulit.

unit.source: After discussing the Mirror People situation with Hela, Lumian emerged from the corner where the Academy team was located, ready to gather mysticism knowledge from the death domain with the Purgatory team.
unit.target: Postquam de re Hominum Specularium cum Hela disseruerunt, Lumian e angulo ubi turba Academiae collocata erat emergens, paratus scientiam mysticam ex dominio mortis cum turba Purgatorii colligere.

unit.source: Franca immediately approached Lumian, lowered her voice, and asked with a smile, “What were you thinking when Stonemason recounted his dream? It seemed like you had thought of something important.”
unit.target: Franca statim ad Lumian accessit, vocem minuendo, et subrisu quaesivit: “Quid cogitabas cum Lapidarius somnium suum narravit? Videbatur quasi aliquid magni momenti excogitaveris.”

unit.source: Hadn’t I shared what I saw and heard after using the Eye of Truth underground?
unit.target: Num non communicaveram id quod vidi et audivi postquam Oculus Veritatis subterraneus usus sum?

unit.source: That shouldn’t be the case.
unit.target: Non oportet ita esse.

unit.source: I won’t forget sharing matters involving the Celestial Master with Franca…
unit.target: Non obliviscar de rebus ad Magister Caelestis pertinentibus cum Franca communicasse…

unit.source: Lumian’s heart suddenly stirred, feeling that his spirituality was hindering this matter.
unit.target: Cor Lumiani repente concitatus est, sentiens spiritualitatem suam rem hanc impedire.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, he responded, “It’s rather complicated and involves high-level powers. I’ll write to Madam Magician later and see if I can share it with you.”
unit.target: Post aliquod cogitandi tempus, respondit: “Haec satis implicata sunt et potentias altiores involvunt. Postea ad Magistram Magicam scribam et videam an tecum communicare possim.”

unit.source: “All right,” Franca said eagerly. “Don’t forget!”
unit.target: “Recte,” Franca acriter dixit. “Noli oblivisci!”

unit.source: Her curiosity was piqued.
unit.target: Curiositas eius excitata est.

unit.source: At that moment, Hela, still dressed as a black widow, approached Lumian and asked, “Any progress in tracking Ultraman and Bard?”
unit.target: Illo momento, Hela, adhuc induta ut nora atra, ad Lumian accessit et rogavit, “Quid progressum est in vestigatione Ultraman et Bard?”

unit.source: “Not at the moment. I’m still compiling the necessary information,” Lumian replied truthfully.
unit.target: “Non adhuc. Pergam colligens informationes necessarias,” Lumian veraciter respondit.

unit.source: Hela nodded slightly and replied, “If you need assistance, don’t hesitate to reach out to me or Gandalf.”
unit.target: Hela leviter inclinavit et respondit, “Si auxilio indiges, noli dubitare me aut Gandalf adire.”

unit.source: The primary objective for most members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society was to eliminate the April Fool’s traitors.
unit.target: Propositum principale plurimorum membrorum Societatis Inquisitionis Baboonum Crispor Capillorum erat perditores Aprilis Stultorum tollere.

unit.source: “Got it.” Lumian had no plans to confront the key members of April Fool’s on his own.
unit.target: “Intelligo.” Lumian consilia non habebat claves membrorum Aprilis Stultorum solus oppugnandi.

unit.source: Undoubtedly, it was optimal for him to carry out the final execution.
unit.target: Indubitanter, optimum fuit ei ultimam exsecutionem perficere.

unit.source: Upon returning to the real world, Lumian noticed that night was falling.
unit.target: Revertens in mundum reale, Lumian animadvertit noctem cadere.

unit.source: He set out a stack of late-night snacks for Ludwig and summoned Madam Magician’s messenger.
unit.target: Paravit ac composuit catervam eduliorum nocturnorum ad Ludwigum et advocavit nuntium Magistram Magicam.

unit.source: After freshening up—washing his face, brushing his teeth, and snuffing out the wall lamp—he settled into bed.
unit.target: Postquam se refecerat—vultum lavans, dentes purgans, et lampam muralem exstinguens—in lecto se collocavit.

unit.source: Just then, a sense of alertness surged through him.
unit.target: Tunc, sensus vigilantiae per eum subito pervagatus est.

unit.source: He sat up suddenly, focusing on a specific spot in the room.
unit.target: Subito evigilavit, in certo loco in camera intendens.

unit.source: Outside the window, a faint crimson glow shimmered.
unit.target: Extra fenestram, tenuus ruber splendor micabat.

unit.source: In one corner, a shadow swiftly expanded, reaching up to the ceiling, forming a silhouette resembling two goat horns.
unit.target: In uno angulo, umbra celeriter se propagavit, usque ad laquearia perveniens, figuram efformans quae duo cornua caprarum similia videbatur.

unit.source: It was as if a devil had emerged from the dark abyss.
unit.target: Sicut si diabolus e profundo tenebrarum abysso emergisset.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyebrows twitched as he stared at the colossal black shadow.
unit.target: Supercilia Lumiani concitata sunt dum ingentem umbram nigram intuebatur.

unit.source: The devil-like shadow resonated with a deep and imposing voice.
unit.target: Umbra, quasi diabolus, resonabat voce profunda et imponente.

unit.source: “Lowly human, you must answer my question truthfully.”
unit.target: “Humane ignobilis, quaestioni meae veraciter respondeas.”

unit.source: It spoke in Intisian.
unit.target: In Intisiana lingua locutus est.

unit.source: Lumian cracked his neck gently and asked, “What’s the question?”
unit.target: Lumian leniter collum flectit et quaesivit: “Quaestio quid est?”

unit.source: The devilish figure rumbled in a deep tone, “What did the Paco family’s Giorgia hire you to do?”
unit.target: Figura diabolica in voce profunda rugivit: “Quid tibi familiae Paco, a Giorgia, curavit ut faceres?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “What do human affairs have to do with a devil like you? I’m a professional adventurer. I won’t betray my employer.”
unit.target: “Quid res humanas ad te, diabolus, attinet? Ego sum peritus viator. Dominum meum non proderim.”

unit.source: The devilish shadow growled, “Then I’ll use your blood as the answer!”
unit.target: Umbra diabolica rugivit: “Tum sanguinem tuum ut responsum adhibebo!”

unit.source: Before it completed its sentence, its aura surged, and the crimson moonlight in the room instantly succumbed to darkness, shrouding the space in a chilling aura.
unit.target: Antequam sententiam finiret, aura eius insurgens est, et lux rubra lunae in conclavi statim in tenebras cecidit, spatium in aura frigida circumdata.

unit.source: The corners of Lumian’s mouth curled up.
unit.target: Anguli buccarum Lumiani incurvati sunt.

unit.source: With a swift press of his left hand, he catapulted from the bed like a cheetah, propelling himself towards the ceiling.
unit.target: Celeriter, manu sinistra premit, se ex lecto proiecit velut cheetah, se ad laquearia impellens.

unit.source: Overhead, darkness enveloped him, resembling an abyssal reflection.
unit.target: Supra, tenebrae eum circumtexebantur, repraesentantes speciem abyssi.

unit.source: In a sudden twist, Lumian’s body turned pitch black, almost zero in thickness.
unit.target: In subito conversione, corpus Lumiani totum atrum factum est, fere nullo spissitudinis.

unit.source: He morphed into a shadow creature and seamlessly melded into the darkness!
unit.target: Mutatus est in creaturam umbratilis, atque sine intermissione in tenebras se incorporavit!

unit.source: Within the dimly illuminated fishnet of shadows, Lumian spotted the “devil.”
unit.target: In rete tenebrarum vix illuminatarum, Lumian “diabolum” animadvertit.

unit.source: Standing just over a meter tall, the creature was child-sized, yet its skin was creased like that of an elderly man in his seventies or eighties.
unit.target: Stans paulo plus quam uno metro altus, creatura erat parva ut infans, sed cutis eius plicata erat sicut senis septuagenarii aut octogenarii.

unit.source: Its disproportionately large head featured protruding eyes, presenting a grotesque visage that was beyond Lumian’s knowledge of creatures.
unit.target: Caput eius, disproportionate magnum, oculis eminentibus ornatum, faciem abominabilem exhibebat, quae ultra notitiam Lumiani de creaturis patebat.

unit.source: In the form of a shadow, Lumian “swam” toward it, aiming to ensnare the peculiar creature that manifested the devil’s projection. He planned on pulling it out of the darkness and controlling it with the Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: In forma umbratilis, Lumian ad illam “natavit”, studens capere illam creaturam peculiaram, quae manifestationem diaboli praebebat. Consilium cepit eam ex tenebris traere et incantatione Harrumph subigere.

unit.source: Many of Lumian’s abilities were constrained in the shadow creature form.
unit.target: Multae facultates Lumiani in forma creaturae umbratilis coartatae erant.

unit.source: The short, malevolent creature with wrinkled skin appeared defenseless against the shadow’s entanglement, surprising Lumian, who had anticipated fierce resistance.
unit.target: Creatura parva, maligna, cum cute rugosa, defensionem carentem videbatur adversus vincula umbrae, quod Lumian, acri repugnatione expectata, miratus est.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he prepared to depart, leaving the shadow to detain its captive.
unit.target: Sine mora, se parare discedere constitui, relinquens umbram captivum retinere.

unit.source: Just then, the darkness surrounding him brightened, illuminated by the light from the “sky.”
unit.target: Ille instante, tenebrae circa eum clarificatae sunt, luce e “caelo” data.

unit.source: Instinctively, Lumian looked up and witnessed the pure darkness rapidly dissolving, unveiling a colossal star hanging in the void.
unit.target: Instinctive, Lumian surrexit et conspexit puras tenebras celeriter evanescere, revelantes ingentem stellam in vacuo pendere.

unit.source: The star bore a faint blue hue, resembling a demonic eye.
unit.target: Stella tenuit levem nuancem caeruleam, quae oculo daemoni similis videbatur.

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian felt his blood freeze, involuntarily snapping out of his shadow creature form.
unit.target: In uno instante, Lumian sensit sanguinem suum congelari, et involuntarie ex forma umbratili evanescere.

unit.source: The big-headed “shorty,” adorned with wrinkles, seized the chance to break free from its constraints, swiftly merging into the pale-blue starlight and disappearing from sight.
unit.target: Parvus cum capite ingenti, rugulis ornatus, occasionem arripuit ut a vinculis evaderet, celeriter in lucem pallidae caeruleae stellarum miscentem et evanescens a conspectu factus est.

unit.source: After a moment, Lumian fully recovered. He stared at the now-normal room, sinking into contemplation.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Lumian plene restitutus est. In camera iam normali conspecta, in meditatione cecidit.

unit.source: What in the world was that thing? It seemed so weak, yet it came to intimidate me!
unit.target: Quid erat iste in mundo? Videbatur tam infirmum, sed ad me terrendum venerat!

unit.source: Nevertheless, the blinking star held an air of peculiarity.
unit.target: Attamen, stella micans aerem singularitatis habebat.

unit.source: Why not just send the star to frighten me right away? After suppressing me, it didn’t seize the opportunity to attack. Even though I regained some mobility upon escaping the shadows, I was still relatively slow… Lumian mused silently.
unit.target: Cur non statim stellam mittebis ad me terrendum? Postquam me opprimas, occasionem ad oppugnandum non arripuit. Etsi aliquam mobilitatem recuperavi ex umbris effugiens, adhuc tardus eram… Lumian tacite meditatus est.

unit.source: While he couldn’t grasp the full picture, certain details became apparent.
unit.target: Cum totam imaginem comprehendere non posset, quaedam indicia manifesta facta sunt.

unit.source: No wonder Giorgia didn’t casually enlist a foreign adventurer with Beyonder powers to handle the humanoid lizard.
unit.target: Non mirum est quod Giorgia non leveciter extraneum viatorem cum Beyonder viribus conscripsit, ad tractandum lacertam humanoidem.

unit.source: Someone lurking in the shadows would interrogate me about the entire matter in the future.
unit.target: Aliquis latens in umbris me de tota re in futurum interrogabit.

unit.source: Only a renowned adventurer like Louis Berry, capable of hunting Demon Warlocks, can resist it.
unit.target: Solus praeclarus viator, Louis Berry, qui Demon Incantatores venari potest, id repugnare potest.

unit.source: Heh heh, earning 15,000 risot isn’t a walk in the park…
unit.target: Heh heh, lucrari 15,000 risot non est ambulatio in horto…

unit.source: The one in the shadows knows Louis Berry isn’t weak, so they didn’t dare to attack directly. Instead, they dispatched a small monster with unique abilities to intimidate me, hoping to extract information?
unit.target: Qui in umbris latet novit Louis Berry non debilem esse, itaque non ausi sunt directe oppugnare. Pro eo, parvum monstrum cum singularibus facultatibus delegaverunt, sperantes me intimidare atque informationes extrahere.

unit.source: Why not go to Giorgia’s house and ask? Their family doesn’t seem to possess any superpowers…
unit.target: Cur non ad domum Giorgiae pergeris et quaeres? Familia eorum videtur nullas vires supernaturales habere…

unit.source: Is this an internal conflict within the Fisheries Company and the Fisheries Guild?
unit.target: Numquid hic internus conflictus est intra Societatem Piscandi et Gremium Piscandi?

unit.source: Yes, it’s an opportunity to interact more deeply with the Paco family and understand the core process of the sea prayer ritual…
unit.target: Ita, est occasio ad profundiorem commercium cum familia Paco et ad intellegendum processum cardinalem rituum orationis maris…

unit.source: Shaking his head, Lumian reclined on the bed and resumed his slumber.
unit.target: Caput movens, Lumian in lecto recubuit et somnum iterum ceperit.

unit.source: Around 8 a.m. the next day, Lugano, who had gone out to buy breakfast, rushed back and said to Lumian, “Boss, those combat nuns are looking for you!”
unit.target: Circiter hora octava mane die sequente, Lugano, qui ad ientaculum emendum exierat, festinanter rediit et Lumiano dixit: “Domine, illae moniales pugnantes te quaerunt!”

unit.source: 545 Order
unit.target: 545 Ordo

unit.source: 545 Order
unit.target: 545 Ordo

unit.source: Combat nuns?
unit.target: Moniales pugnantes?

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s surprise, he felt a sudden sense of order return to society.
unit.target: Inter admirationem Luminiani, subito sensus ordinis in societatem redire ei sensit.

unit.source: In any country on the Northern Continent, wild Beyonders were unwelcome.
unit.target: In quacumque regione in Continente Septentrionali, Beyonders feri non erant grati.

unit.source: They faced control and even apprehension.
unit.target: Sub coercitione erant et etiam capti fieri possent.

unit.source: This wasn’t like colonies such as Port Farim, where renowned adventurers could freely roam the streets and boast about their experiences without the concern of official Beyonders knocking on their doors.
unit.target: Hoc non erat instar colonarum, ut Port Farim, ubi praeclari viatores in viis libere vagari poterant et de suis experimentis gloriari sine cura, ne Beyonders officiales ianuas pulsarent.

unit.source: “Boss, is there any danger?”
unit.target: “Magister, num quid periculum sit?”

unit.source: Lugano nervously inquired, his perpetual fear evident as a wild Beyonder.
unit.target: Lugano, anxie quaesivit, cum perpetuus timor eius, instar feri Beyonder, manifeste apparebat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, responding confidently, “That depends on their attitude.”
unit.target: Lumian risit, fiduciose respondens: “Id ex ipsorum habitus pendet.”

unit.source: The implication was that the nuns were the ones facing danger.
unit.target: Id significabat quod moniales ipsae periculum subire debebant.

unit.source: Lumian teased, “Aren’t you excited about the combat nuns? Shouldn’t you be thrilled that they’re here?”
unit.target: Lumian iocose dixit: “Nonne excitatus es de monialibus pugnantibus? Nonne gaudere debes quod adsunt?”

unit.source: Imagination isn’t the same as reality…
unit.target: Imaginatio non est idem ac res vera…

unit.source: Seeing his boss showing no intention of “teleporting” away with him, Lugano nervously descended and extended an invitation to the combat nuns.
unit.target: Cum videret magistrum suum nullam intentionem habere “teleportare” simul cum eo, Lugano anxie descendit et monialibus pugnantibus invitationem protulit.

unit.source: The leader was the same one Lumian had encountered before.
unit.target: Princeps erat eadem quam Lumian antea convenerat.

unit.source: Most of her naturally curly, thick black hair was neatly tucked into a black hat with white patterns.
unit.target: Major pars capillorum eius, naturaliter crispatorum et densi nigri, rite in galea nigra cum figuris albis collocata erat.

unit.source: Her bright and lively light-blue eyes, along with her thick eyebrows, bestowed upon her a unique and captivating charm.
unit.target: Oculi eius, lucidi et vivaces caerulei, cum supercilia crassissimis, ei gratiam unicam et captantem tribuebant.

unit.source: The woman in leather armor gazed at Lumian and inquired gently, “Are you the adventurer Louis Berry?”
unit.target: Femina, in lorica coriacea induta, ad Lumianem spectavit et leniter inquisivit: “Esne viator Louis Berry?”

unit.source: Lumian nodded. “Who might you be?”
unit.target: Lumian annuit. “Quis es?”

unit.source: The strikingly beautiful combat nun replied with a smile, “I’m Sister Noelia of the Fertility Order, in charge of a combat team.”
unit.target: Monialis pugnans prorsus formosa, cum risu respondit: “Sum Soror Noelia ex Ordine Fertilitatis, praeposita turmae pugnantis.”

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Laudetur Terra, laudetur Mater Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: Noelia raised her hands to the sky, her feet slightly apart.
unit.target: Noelia manus ad caelum extulit, pedes leviter separatos tenens.

unit.source: Observing that Noelia and the other combat nuns of the Fertility Order were not as judgmental as he expected, not viewing wild Beyonders as inherently evil creatures, Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Animadvertens quod Noelia et ceterae moniales pugnantibus Ordine Fertilitatis non tam censoriae viderentur, nec Beyonders feros ut innatos malos spectarent, Lumian subridet.

unit.source: “Madame, what brings you here?”
unit.target: “Domina, quid te hic attulit?”

unit.source: Noelia smiled and explained, “You’re a great adventurer who hunted Demon Warlock. If we hadn’t known you were in Port Santa, we might not have bothered. However, now that we are aware, we must come and speak with you, reminding you to abide by the corresponding order.”
unit.target: Noelia subridens explicavit: “Tu es praeclarus viator, qui Demon Warlock venatus es. Nisi scivissemus te Port Santa esse, fortasse non molestum fuissemus. At nunc, cum nos certi sumus, ad te venire atque te admonere debemus ut ordini congruo obtemperes.”

unit.source: “What order?”
unit.target: “Quid ordo?”

unit.source: Lumian inquired, anticipating the answer while holding the golden straw hat.
unit.target: Lumian quaesivit, responsum exspectans, dum galeam stramineam auream tenebat.

unit.source: The demeanor of these combat nuns made him wonder if they were official Beyonders.
unit.target: Mores harum monialium pugnantium eum faciebant interrogari, num formales Beyonders essent.

unit.source: They didn’t directly arrest him, nor did they use stern warnings.
unit.target: Non eum directe arrestiterunt, nec gravia monita adhibuerunt.

unit.source: Is this the distinction between the Church of Earth Mother and other Churches?
unit.target: Hecne discrimen est inter Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et alias Ecclesias?

unit.source: Emphasizing motherhood and respecting life?
unit.target: Maternitatis extollendo et vitae reverentia?

unit.source: Noelia’s red lips formed a beautiful smile as she spoke, “In other cities, we would issue a direct warning, bringing you under our control. If you dare to resist, you could be apprehended or even eliminated.
unit.target: Labra rubra Noeliae formaverunt venustum risum, dum loquebatur: “In aliis urbibus monitionem directam donneremus, teque sub potestate nostra adduceremus. Si ausus es resistere, capi posses aut etiam interficeraris.

unit.source: However, this is Port Santa, and many sea merchants here have a genuine need to resist pirates and protect their goods.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc est Port Santa, et multi negotiatores maritimi hic veram necessitatem habent ad piratas resistere et merces suas tueri.

unit.source: We lack the manpower to safeguard them all, so we’ve tacitly agreed to allow them to hire Beyonder bodyguards.
unit.target: Copiam virorum non habemus ad eos omnes tuendos, itaque tacite consensimus ut ipsi custodes corporales Beyonder conducere liceat.

unit.source: Monsieur Louis Berry, you are free to roam Port Santa, but you must adhere to three rules:
unit.target: Domine Louis Berry, libere Port Santa perambulare licet, sed tribus regulis obtemperare debes:

unit.source: Firstly, you cannot venture inland without our permission. To reach other cities, you need our approval.
unit.target: Primum, non potes intus in terras ire sine nostra permissione. Ad alias urbes pervenire, consensum nostrum requirere debes.

unit.source: Secondly, you cannot perform any rituals in Port Santa, consume potions for advancement, or engage in mysticism experiments.
unit.target: Secundo, in Port Santa ritus quascumque exercere, potiones ad progressionem consumere, aut experimenta mystica agere non licet.

unit.source: Thirdly, you must refrain from using your abilities to cause chaos or catastrophe.
unit.target: Tertio, debes abstinere a facultatibus tuis ad chaos aut cladem efferendas.

unit.source: Of course, if you return to Port Santa in the future, you’ll need to register with us first.
unit.target: Certe, si in posterum ad Port Santa redieris, primum te ad nos registrare debebis.

unit.source: It’s a reasonable request, and coming from the ruling Church, it’s not excessive at all… It’s even simpler and easier than obtaining a firearm permit in Port Farim or other places.
unit.target: Hoc petitum rationabile est, et quod ex Ecclesia regnante provenit, omnino non est nimis gravatum… Facilius enim et simplicius est quam licentiam sclopetariam in Port Farim aut aliis locis obtinere.

unit.source: Of course, not applying for identification in Port Farim isn’t a big deal.
unit.target: Certe, non postulare identificationem in Port Farim non est res magna.

unit.source: No one will report it, and there won’t be any issues if you don’t directly encounter the officials…
unit.target: Nemo id denuntiabit, nec quaestiones erunt, si officiales non directe occurras…

unit.source: Lumian nodded gently and replied, “Sure thing.”
unit.target: Lumian leniter annuit et respondit: “Certe!”

unit.source: At this moment, Lumian’s thoughts raced, and he couldn’t help but chuckle.
unit.target: Hoc ipso momento, cogitationes Luminiani currere coeperunt, et non potuit nisi subridere.

unit.source: “But Port Santa isn’t entirely safe. I encountered a monster last night…”
unit.target: “Sed Port Santa non prorsus tuta est. Monstrum heri nocte occursum habevi…”

unit.source: He briefly recounted how the little monster had disguised itself as a devil to intimidate him.
unit.target: Brevi enarravit quomodo parvum monstrum se ut diabolus indutus fuisset ad eum intimandum.

unit.source: While he didn’t conceal that he had accepted Giorgia’s commission, he refrained from specifying the details.
unit.target: Quamquam non celavit se mandatum Giorgiae accepisse, de singularibus non enarrare voluit.

unit.source: Noelia listened attentively and responded without surprise, “We’ll handle it. Try not to get involved in the Fisheries Guild’s matters in the future. Their internal issues will be resolved internally.”
unit.target: Noelia attente auscultavit et sine stupore respondit: “Hoc curabimus. Noli in futurum te in rebus Gildae Piscandi implicare; quaestiones internae ipsorum interne solvantur.”

unit.source: Does this mean that the Earth Mother Church refrains from interfering with the internal strife of the Fisheries Guild, allowing them complete autonomy?
unit.target: Hocne significat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae non immiscere in controversiis internis Gildae Piscandi, eos plena autonomia concedere?

unit.source: Lumian smiled and said, “I’ll do my best to avoid participation, but I’ll reserve the right to defend myself and counterattack.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Optime conabor non interesse, sed ius mihi reservabo ut me defendam et contra oppugnem.”

unit.source: Noelia didn’t offer any further comments. Her smile faded as she led the combat nuns to the door.
unit.target: Noelia nullas ulteriores commentationes adiunxit. Risus eius evanuit, dum moniales pugnantibus ad ianuam ducebat.

unit.source: In just two or three steps, she smoothly drew a straight sword from her back, half-turned, and slashed at Lumian.
unit.target: In duobus vel tribus passibus, illa leniter gladium rectum ex tergo extraxit, semivertens, atque in Lumian percussit.

unit.source: The series of movements flowed seamlessly, occurring in the blink of an eye.
unit.target: Series motuum sine intermissione fluebat, in ictu oculi eveniens.

unit.source: Lumian stared at the sword beam, neither dodging nor raising his hand to block.
unit.target: Lumian aspexit gladium, nec evasit nec manum levavit ut obsistiret.

unit.source: With a swoosh, the straight sword grazed the tip of his nose and pointed to the ground.
unit.target: Cum sibilo, gladium rectum apicem nasi eius leviter tetigit et ad terram direxit.

unit.source: Noelia smiled radiantly and nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Noelia radianti risu subridens annuit.

unit.source: “As expected of a great adventurer. Your foresight, judgment, and courage are exceptional.”
unit.target: “Ut exspectabatur a magno viatore. Praevisio, iudicium, et fortitudo tua eximiae sunt.”

unit.source: She then turned around and addressed the combat nuns who followed her.
unit.target: Deinde versa est et moniales pugnantibus, quae eam secutae erant, locuta est.

unit.source: “This is a true man. Those who only know how to flaunt their muscles and swing their swords can only be called male beasts.”
unit.target: “Hic est vir verus. Illi, qui solum musculis ostentare atque gladios iactare sciunt, bestiae masculae esse dicuntur.”

unit.source: As they spoke, the combat nuns exited Lumian’s rented suite.
unit.target: Dum loquebantur, moniales pugnantibus conclave locatum Luminiani exierunt.

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his chin, feeling a strange sensation.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et mentum palpebrans, sensum mirum sentiens.

unit.source: The sight of women openly scrutinizing men made him uncomfortable.
unit.target: Aspectus feminarum, quae viros aperte perscrutabant, eum incommodum faciebat.

unit.source: After watching Noelia and the nuns leave, Lugano lowered his voice and asked, “Boss, did a little monster really come to warn you last night?”
unit.target: Postquam Noeliam et moniales discessisse vidit, Lugano vocem demittens rogavit: “Magister, num vere parvus monstrum ad te heri nocte venisset ut te moneret?”

unit.source: “That’s right. If you were the one who completed Giorgia’s commission, it might not be just a warning.”
unit.target: “Ita est. Si tu es qui mandatum Giorgiae perfecisti, fortasse non solum monitum esset.”

unit.source: Lumian put on the golden straw hat and casually remarked as he walked towards the door, “We have an obligation to remind our employer that someone is secretly spying on their family.”
unit.target: Lumian galeam stramineam auream induit et, leviter loquens dum ad ianuam perrebat, dixit: “Debemus patronum nostrum admonere, quod aliquis clam in familiam eius speculatur.”

unit.source: Lugano was taken aback for a moment before understanding Lumian’s intentions. He grabbed Ludwig and followed closely behind.
unit.target: Lugano per momentum attonitus est, antequam intentionem Luminiani comprehenderet. Ludwigum arripuit et prope eum secutus est.

unit.source: 21 Saint Lana Street, in the activity room of a suite on the fifth floor.
unit.target: 21 Via Sanctae Lanae, in camera activitatis conclavis in quinto tabulato.

unit.source: Lumian encountered Giorgia once again.
unit.target: Lumian iterum Giorgiam occurrit.

unit.source: Dressed in a vibrant dress adorned with intricate patterns, the lady glanced at the boy, whose appetite exceeded her imagination, before turning her gaze to the adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Induta vestitu vibranti, intricatis figuris ornato, domina puellum intuebatur, cuius appetitus imaginationem eius superabat, antequam oculos convertit ad viatorem Louis Berry.

unit.source: “What brings you here?”
unit.target: “Quid te hic attulit?”

unit.source: Lugano translated professionally.
unit.target: Lugano perite interpretavit.

unit.source: “Last night, a monster came to intimidate me, but I chased it away.”
unit.target: “Heri nocte, monstrum ad me intimandum venit, sed fugavi eum.”

unit.source: Lumian briefly recounted the monster’s appearance and behavior.
unit.target: Lumian breviter enarravit quomodo monstrum apparuisset ac se comportaverit.

unit.source: Upon hearing Lugano’s account, Giorgia displayed no obvious surprise.
unit.target: Audita narratione Lugani, Giorgia nullam admirationem manifesta ostendit.

unit.source: After a few seconds of contemplation, she said, “Wait a moment.”
unit.target: Post aliquot secundas cogitationis, dixit, “Exspecta paulisper.”

unit.source: Leaving the maid and valet behind, she disappeared into an inner room.
unit.target: Relinquens ancillam atque servum, in conclave interno evanuit.

unit.source: After a few minutes, she reappeared, arm in arm with a man.
unit.target: Post paucis minutis, rursus apparuit, brachio in brachium cum viro.

unit.source: The man seemed to be in his forties, tall and gaunt, his eyes a nearly translucent blue.
unit.target: Virilis vir, quadragenarius, altus et macilento, oculis paene translucidis caeruleis, videbatur.

unit.source: His grayish-black, slightly curly hair cascaded over his shoulders like an artist’s.
unit.target: Capilli eius, nigro-cinerescenti et leviter crispati, super humeros eius labebant, quasi opera artificis.

unit.source: His appearance couldn’t be described as particularly good or bad, yet he possessed an unforgettable quality.
unit.target: Eius aspectus neque prorsus bonus neque malus dici poterat, sed tamen indolem inobliviabilem habebat.

unit.source: “This is my husband, Rubió Paco,” Giorgia introduced.
unit.target: “Hic est maritus meus, Rubió Paco,” inquit Giorgia.

unit.source: The shareholder of the Fisheries Company and a committee member of the Fisheries Guild?
unit.target: Socius societatis Piscandi et membrum consilii Gildae Piscandi?

unit.source: Lumian had gathered information about the Paco family through Lugano over the past two days.
unit.target: Lumian informationes de familia Paco per Lugano in duobus diebus antecedentibus collegit.

unit.source: Rubió’s father had initially been a prosperous fisherman who shared a boat with others.
unit.target: Pater Rubió initio piscator prosperus fuit, navem cum aliis communicans.

unit.source: After marrying Martha, who had once been a Maiden of the Sea, he gradually established himself.
unit.target: Postquam Martha, olim Puella Maris, nupsit, paulatim se statuit.

unit.source: Not only did he manage the Fisheries Company for a time, but he also ascended to become a committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Non solum aliquod tempus Societatem Piscandi administravit, sed etiam membrum consilii veterissimæ Gildae Piscandi factus est.

unit.source: Shortly after the sea prayer ritual last year, the old gentleman passed away.
unit.target: Brevi post ritum orationis maris praeteriti anni, senex ille obiit.

unit.source: With strong support from Matriarch Marta, Rubió inherited his father’s status and became the youngest committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Cum firmo auxilio Matriarcha Marta, Rubió statum patris sui heredavit et membrum consilii Gildae Piscandi iuvenissimum factus est.

unit.source: However, he no longer held a specific position at Port Santa Fisheries Company. He only held onto the shareholders’ voting rights and dividends.
unit.target: Attamen, positionem specificam in Societate Piscandi Port Santa non amplius tenebat. Tantum ius suffragii et dividendorum sociorum retinebat.

unit.source: This middle-aged man had once been rebellious. He was expected to comply with his parents’ arrangements and marry a Maiden of the Sea.
unit.target: Hic vir mediorum annorum olim rebellis erat. Exspectabatur ut parentum ordinationibus obtemperaret atque Puellam Maris in matrimonium duceret.

unit.source: However, he remained single until his early thirties and then married Giorgia, the daughter of a textile merchant.
unit.target: Attamen, solus mansit usque ad annos trigesimos initiales, atque deinde Giorgiam, filiam mercatoris textilis, coniunxit.

unit.source: If it were any other prominent family, the matriarch would have surely intervened and perhaps even banished Rubió. Yet, Martha indulged him and eventually chose to compromise.
