unit.target: Si alia familia praeclara fuisset, matriarcha certe intercessisset et fortasse Rubió exsularetur. Tamen, Martha eum indulguit et tandem ad compendium statuit.

unit.source: Before Lugano could commence with the translation, Rubió spoke in less fluent Intisian, “We can communicate directly. When I was young, I often took a boat out to sea and visited places like Port Farim.”
unit.target: Antequam Lugano translationem inciperet, Rubió in lingua Intisiana, minus eleganter, dixit: “Directe communicare possumus. Quando iuvenis eram, saepe navem in mare ducebam et loca sicut Port Farim visitabam.”

unit.source: “Monsieur Rubió, I don’t think there’s a need for communication, and I don’t intend to find out why the monster came looking for me. I’m just here to inform you about this.”
unit.target: “Domine Rubió, non opinor necesse esse colloquium, nec intendo scire cur monstrum ad me quaereretur; hic solum sum ut tibi hoc narrem.”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the puzzled Giorgia and suspected that Rubió had switched to Intisian not out of politeness but to keep his wife in the dark about something.
unit.target: Lumian ad perplexam Giorgiam aspexit et suspicatus est Rubió in linguam Intisianam conversum esse, non ex urbanitate, sed ut uxorem suam de aliqua re celaret.

unit.source: Rubió nodded gently and said, “I understand your concerns. I merely wish to entrust you with another mission.”
unit.target: Rubió leniter annuit et dixit: “Intelligo sollicitudines tuas; tantum volo tibi aliam missionem tradere.”

unit.source: “What mission?” Lumian asked with a smile.
unit.target: “Quae missio?” subridens quaesivit Lumian.

unit.source: Rubió calmly replied, “My mother, Martha, hails from Milo Village. Recently, she wishes to return and meet the current Governor of the Sea to request his permission to seek treatment at the Church of Earth Mother. Yes, my mother hasn’t been in good health recently. She can’t get out of bed.”
unit.target: Rubió tranquille respondit: “Mater mea, Martha, ex vico Milo provenit. Nuper vult redire atque convenire cum Praefecto Maris, ut licentiam eius petat ad curam quaerendam in Ecclesia Matris Terrae. Ita, mater mea nuper non valde sana fuit; ex lecto surgere non potest.”

unit.source: Martha is still alive? Lumian was slightly surprised.
unit.target: Mater Martha adhuc vivit? Lumian paulo miratus est.

unit.source: Experienced as he was, he deduced that the monster might have been transformed by Martha, based on the absence of the matriarch, the Paco family’s reluctance to expose the humanoid lizard, and the fact that she was once a Maiden of the Sea!
unit.target: Experto se, deduxit monstrum a Martha transformatum esse, propter absentiam matriarchae, familiae Paco reticentiam reptilem humanoidem exponendi, et eo quod illa olim Puella Maris fuisset!

unit.source: The sea prayer ritual wasn’t just an honor for the Maidens of the Sea. Perhaps there was also hidden corruption that might erupt at some point in time.
unit.target: Ritus orationis maris non solum honorem Puellarum Maris attulit; fortasse etiam corruptio abscondita aliquando erumpere potuit.

unit.source: But now, from what Rubió had said, Martha was still alive. Previously, she had only been seriously ill.
unit.target: Sed nunc, ex verbis Rubió, Martha adhuc vivit; antea sola graviter aegrota erat.

unit.source: Where did that humanoid lizard come from? Lumian suppressed his puzzlement and asked in confusion, “Why does Madame Martha need the Governor of the Sea’s permission to seek treatment?”
unit.target: Unde iste reptilis humanoides orta est? Lumian perplexitatem repressit et, confusus, rogavit: “Cur Domina Martha licentiam Praefecti Maris ad curam petendam requirit?”

unit.source: Rubió’s expression shifted, a mix of disgust and resistance evident in his words.
unit.target: Vultus Rubió mutatus est, miscens odium et repugnationem, quae in verbis eius notabilis erat.

unit.source: “All Maidens of the Sea have to follow the orders of the Governor of the Sea when dealing with Church-related matters. Failing to do so would be blasphemous to the sea prayer ritual.”
unit.target: “Omnes Puellae Maris debent imperata Praefecti Maris in rebus Ecclesiasticis parere; id non facere ritui orationis maris blasphemia efficiat.”

unit.source: 546 Monitor
unit.target: 546 Monitor

unit.source: 546 Monitor
unit.target: 546 Monitor

unit.source: Following the Governor of the Sea’s orders holds more weight than reverence for the Church…
unit.target: Mandata gubernatoris maris exsequenda magis ponderosa sunt quam veneratio Ecclesiae…

unit.source: The Earth Mother Church appears indifferent.
unit.target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae indifferens videtur.

unit.source: Lumian chose not to push further.
unit.target: Lumian non voluit ulterius insistere.

unit.source: He nodded subtly and stated, “I’ll take on this commission without expecting compensation, but I do have a request.”
unit.target: Subtiliter annuit et dixit: “Hanc commissionem suscipiam sine praemio exspectando, sed habeo rogationem.”

unit.source: “What might that be?” Rubió asked cautiously.
unit.target: “Quid id esse possit?” caute rogavit Rubió.

unit.source: A cunning smile formed on Lumian’s lips.
unit.target: Risus callidus in labiis Lumiani apparuit.

unit.source: “I’m here to witness the sea prayer ritual, but I’ve heard only a select few can observe its core segments. I seek such an opportunity.”
unit.target: “Hic ad observandum ritum precationis maris adsum, sed audivi pauci electi solum segmenta eius centralia videre posse. Talis occasionem quaero.”

unit.source: Rubió remained silent for a prolonged moment.
unit.target: Rubió diu tacuit.

unit.source: Giorgia, unable to contain her curiosity, questioned her husband in Highlander about the conversation and his concerns.
unit.target: Giorgia, curiositatem reprimere non valens, marito suo in lingua Highlander de colloquio et eius sollicitudine interrogavit.

unit.source: Lugano seized the chance to approach Lumian and translated the couple’s exchange.
unit.target: Lugano opportunitatem ad Lumian accedendi arripuit et sermonem coniugum interpretatus est.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyebrows twitched imperceptibly upon hearing they were genuinely considering allowing him to pose as a sailor and board the special sacrificial ship.
unit.target: Supercilia Lumiani imperceptibiliter contorti sunt, audito eum, quod vere consultabant ut eum nauta fingere et in navem sacrificii specialem conscendere permitterent.

unit.source: Is Rubió Paco truly considering my request?
unit.target: Num Rubió Paco vere meam rogationem considerat?

unit.source: I’m merely offering an outrageous deal to test if I can glean details about the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Solum negotium insolitum offero ad testandum an possim ritu precationis maris notitias detegere.

unit.source: I don’t intend to leverage this seemingly straightforward task to gain access to the last two segments of the ritual!
unit.target: Non intendo hoc officium, quod simpliciter videtur, uti ad accessum ad duas ultimas partes ritu precationis maris obtinendum!

unit.source: It remained a secret harbored by the Fisheries Guild for over a millennium, the wellspring of their power and prestige!
unit.target: Secretum permanuit a Gilda Piscatorum per plus mille annos, fons potentiae et famae eorum!

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind, he strongly suspected that the commission to send Madame Martha to Milo Village to meet the current Governor of the Sea carried a high risk.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem Lumiani celeriter transibant, firmiter suspicabatur commissionem, ad mittendam Dominae Marthae in vicum Milo ad conveniendum gubernatorem maris praesentem, magnum periculum ferre.

unit.source: It wasn’t a task for any random Beyonder.
unit.target: Hoc non erat opus cuiuslibet ignoti Beyonder.

unit.source: Therefore, Rubió Paco was reluctant to let go of Louis Berry, the proven adventurer.
unit.target: Itaque Rubió Paco non voluit dimittere Louis Berry, viatorem probatum.

unit.source: But where could the danger lie?
unit.target: Sed ubi periculum latere potest?

unit.source: This is Port Santa, not the islands on the sea or the remote towns of the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Hoc Portus Santa est, non insulae in mari nec oppida remota continenti meridionali.

unit.source: Which Beyonder would dare to attack me on the streets in broad daylight?
unit.target: Quis Beyonder auderet me in plateis pleno die oppugnare?

unit.source: Aren’t they afraid of being captured by the combat nuns and turned into fertilizer for the land?
unit.target: Nonne timent ne ab monachis pugnacibus capiantur et in stercus terrae vertantur?

unit.source: One can’t underestimate the power of an orthodox Church!
unit.target: Ne potentiam Ecclesiae orthodoxae subestimes!

unit.source: Unless someone possesses a special ability, like Loki’s, to kill me undetected on the bustling streets, or if a Saint with godhood personally takes action, aiming to end the battle before the Church of Earth Mother reacts… But it can’t be that exaggerated.
unit.target: Nisi quis facultatem specialem, ut Loki, habet ut me absque detectione in viis fervidis occidat, aut si Sanctus cum divinitate personaliter agere incipiat, propositum habens pugnam finire antequam Ecclesia Matris Terrae respondeat… Sed id non potest esse tam exaggeratum.

unit.source: It’s such a trivial matter…
unit.target: Res tam levissima est…

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, Rubió and Giorgia reached a conclusion.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabat, Rubió et Giorgia conclusionem attigerunt.

unit.source: The former said to Lumian, “I cannot permit your participation in the last two segments of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Priore inquit ad Lumian: “Non possum tuam participationem in ultimis duobus segmentis ritu precationis maris sinere.

unit.source: It is a blasphemy against the sea.
unit.target: Est sacrilegium contra mare.

unit.source: Those involved will face expulsion from Port Santa, including their family.
unit.target: Qui in re haec versantur, expulsionem ex Portu Santa subibunt, etiam familia eorum!

unit.source: “However, I am willing to allow you to conceal yourself in Milo Village in advance and witness the ancient performances during the vigil ritual.”
unit.target: “Tamen paratus sum te sinere antea in Vicum Milo te celare et, durante ritu vigiliæ, antiquos spectaculos adspicere.”

unit.source: So, I can’t directly witness the vigil ritual, but I can partake in the accompanying folklore performance?
unit.target: Itaque non possum directe ritu vigiliæ adspectare, sed possum in spectaculo folklorico comitante participare?

unit.source: Did Ultraman, Bard, and Mad Lady use a similar method to approach the core of the sea prayer ritual and complete the most crucial part of the prank?
unit.target: Num Ultraman, Bardus, et Domina Insana similibus modis ad medium ritu precationis maris accesserunt et partem maxime cruciale ioci perfecerunt?

unit.source: Lumian noticed that Rubió had already made a significant concession and no longer insisted.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit Rubió iam magnam concessionem fecerat, nec amplius instaret.

unit.source: He smiled and replied, “Deal.”
unit.target: Risus extulit et respondit: “Pactum.”

unit.source: Without waiting for a response, he “kindly” suggested, “Let’s send Madame Martha to Milo Village today, shall we? We mustn’t delay when it comes to illnesses. Get her treatment as soon as possible.”
unit.target: Non responsum expectans, benigne insinuavit: “Mitteamus Domina Marthae hodie in Vicum Milo, nonne? Morbis non differamus; celeriter illi medicinam adferamus.”

unit.source: Rubió hesitated for a moment before saying, “My mother is already asleep.
unit.target: Mater mea iam dormit.

unit.source: She’s been resting a lot lately.
unit.target: Nuper multum quiescit.

unit.source: Forcing her awake will impact her body and mind.
unit.target: Eam excitare corpus et mentem eius afficiet.

unit.source: How about tomorrow morning?
unit.target: Quid de mane cras?

unit.source: Is some advanced preparation needed?
unit.target: Nonne opus est aliqua praeparatione provecta?

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian meditans annuit.

unit.source: “No problem.”
unit.target: «Nulla quaestio.»

unit.source: He cast a quick glance at Lugano, and his heart skipped a beat.
unit.target: Lugano celeriter aspexit, et cor eius palpitare coepit.

unit.source: “Monsieur Rubió, my interpreter is, in fact, an excellent doctor.
unit.target: «Domine Rubió, interpres meus revera medicus egregius est.

unit.source: Moreover, he doesn’t adhere to the beliefs of the Earth Mother, nor is he affiliated with any Church.
unit.target: Praeterea, nec fidem Matris Terrae sequitur, nec cum aliqua Ecclesia coniungitur.

unit.source: If he were to treat your mother, you probably wouldn’t need to seek the Governor of the Sea’s permission in advance.
unit.target: Si matrem tuam curaret, verisimiliter non opus esset ut gubernatoris maris permissionem praevie quaereres.

unit.source: Lumian emphasized the word “doctor.”
unit.target: Lumian verbum “medicus” extulit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Rubió Paco shook his head and said, “We trust the Church’s doctors more.
unit.target: Sine mora, Rubió Paco caput movit et inquit: “Medicos Ecclesiae magis confidimus.

unit.source: My mother is my most important family.
unit.target: Mater mea mihi familia praecipua est.

unit.source: I don’t want her to take any unnecessary risks.
unit.target: Nolo ut pericula supervacua illi subeunda sint.

unit.source: What he implied was that he couldn’t vouch for the medical skills of the interpreter.
unit.target: Id quod ille insinuavit significabat, se non posse artes medicas interpres confirmare.

unit.source: He couldn’t use the Paco family’s matriarch as an experiment.
unit.target: Non potuit matriarcham familiae Paco uti in experimento.

unit.source: Lumian was actually looking forward to sending Madame Martha to Milo Village because it meant he might meet the current Governor of the Sea and have a chance to learn something.
unit.target: Lumian revera exspectabat Dominae Marthae mittendam ad Vicum Milo, quoniam id significabat se praesens gubernatorem maris contingere posse atque aliquid discere.

unit.source: He had only suggested that Lugano treat the matriarch to test Rubió.
unit.target: Solum suadebat ut Lugano matriarcham curaret, ut Rubió probaret.

unit.source: The result of the probe revealed many hidden secrets in this matter!
unit.target: Exitus indagationis multas arcana huius rei revelavit!

unit.source: Having agreed to escort Madame Martha and her maid to the Governor of the Sea at 9 a.m. the following day, Lumian led Ludwig and Lugano out of the main house at 21 Saint Lana Street.
unit.target: Cum convenissent ut Domina Martha et ancilla eius gubernatori maris ad horam nonam mane diei sequentis comitabantur, Lumian Ludwig et Lugano ex domo principali in via Saint Lana 21 duxit.

unit.source: Giorgia walked them all the way to the door.
unit.target: Giorgia eos ad ianuam duxit.

unit.source: Lumian nonchalantly remarked, “Does the Governor of the Sea have to reside in Milo Village?”
unit.target: Lumian leviter inquit: “Num gubernator maris in Vicum Milo habitare debet?”

unit.source: With Lugano’s translation, Giorgia nodded slightly and said, “The Governor of the Sea resides in the building where the vigil ritual is held every night. He can move freely during the day, but he can’t leave Port Santa.”
unit.target: Per Lugani interpretationem, Giorgia leviter annuit et inquit: “Gubernator maris in aedificio residet ubi ritu vigiliae omni nocte celebratur. Diurno tempore libere movere potest, sed Portum Santa relinquere non potest.”

unit.source: The building where the vigil ritual is held? The essence of the vigil ritual is to allow a quasi‑Governor of the Sea to enter the residence and replace the former Governor of the Sea, waiting to be officially appointed by the sea the next day?
unit.target: Aedificium ubi ritu vigiliae celebratur? Anima huius rituo est ut quasi gubernator maris intra domum ingrediatur et pristinus gubernator subrogetur, exspectans ut mare proximo die officialiter eum constituat?

unit.source: Lumian speculated, combining his mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Lumian speculatus est, scientia mystica sua coniuncta.

unit.source: He smiled and asked, “What are the perks of being Governor of the Sea?”
unit.target: Risus extulit et quaesivit: “Qua sunt beneficia esse gubernator maris?”

unit.source: After hearing the translation, Giorgia fell silent for a few seconds before saying, “Among the fishmongers, the merchants, he’s already the true governor in their eyes.”
unit.target: Audita interpretatione, Giorgia paucis momentis siluit, deinde inquit: “Inter piscatores et mercatores, iam verus gubernator est.”

unit.source: It wasn’t an answer, just a whisper of truth.
unit.target: Non erat responsum, sed tantum susurrus veritatis.

unit.source: Lumian nodded without pressing further.
unit.target: Lumian annuit sine ulteriore impetu.

unit.source: He led Ludwig and Lugano through the iron gates.
unit.target: Ludwig et Lugano per portas ferreas duxit.

unit.source: After taking a few steps along the verdant path in the forest, he suddenly looked up.
unit.target: Postquam paucos passus in via viridi per silvam fecit, subito surrexit et ad caelum respexit.

unit.source: On a branch stood a gray‑feathered myna.
unit.target: In ramo stabat myna plumata cinerea.

unit.source: Lumian gave it a cursory glance and continued on, his steps brisk towards the waiting carriage.
unit.target: Lumian illud celeriter intuebatur et perrexit, passibus agilibus versus currum exspectantem.

unit.source: After a while, the myna flapped its wings and flew up.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, myna alas pulsavit et surrexit volavit.

unit.source: After circling a few times, it circled a house two streets away before dipping down towards an open window.
unit.target: Post aliquot circuitus, domum duabus plateis remotam circumvolvit, deinde ad fenestram apertam decedens.

unit.source: It landed on a middle‑aged man’s forearm and spoke in precise Highlander, “Louis Berry is back at the Paco house! He stayed nearly half an hour!”
unit.target: In antebrachium viri mediocris consedit et in lingua Highlander precisa dixit: “Louis Berry ad domum Paco rediit! Fere dimidiam horam mansit!”

unit.source: The middle‑aged man, dressed in gray clothes with disheveled brown hair, resembling a suburban farmer, fed the myna a few self‑made rice grains and said, “Observe further and see if Rubió Paco and Giorgia will go out today.”
unit.target: Vir mediocris aetatis, vestitu griseo indutus, capillis fuscis inordinatis, quasi agricolae suburbani similis, mynae aliquot grana oryzae sua confecta dedit et dixit: “Observa amplius et vide si Rubió Paco et Giorgia hodie exibunt.”

unit.source: After the myna flew out of the window, the middle‑aged man exhaled and turned around.
unit.target: Postquam myna e fenestra volavit, vir mediocris suspiravit et conversus est.

unit.source: Suddenly, his eyes froze as he saw someone sitting in the only armchair!
unit.target: Subito, oculi eius immobiliter steterunt, cum aliquem in unica sella bracchiali sedere vidit!

unit.source: The man had black hair and green eyes, wearing a white shirt, a black vest, dark pants, and a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Vir capillos nigros et oculos virides habebat, indutus camisia alba, lorica nigra, bracas obscuras, et pileum stramineum aureum gestans.

unit.source: Louis Berry!
unit.target: Louis Berry!

unit.source: Adventurer Louis Berry!
unit.target: Louis Berry, audax viator!

unit.source: The middle‑aged man’s back arched slightly, and his feet parted slightly, but he took no further action.
unit.target: Dorsum viri mediocris leviter arcitum est, pedes paulum separaverunt, sed nihil amplius egerit.

unit.source: Lumian leaned back in his chair and engaged in casual conversation in Intisian, as if he had been expected.
unit.target: Lumian in sella sua reclinavit et sermonem casualem in Intisian gessit, quasi exspectatus esset.

unit.source: “What did you have your bird spy on?”
unit.target: «Quid voluisti ut avis tua specularetur?»

unit.source: The middle‑aged man fell silent for a moment before speaking in somewhat awkward Intisian, “Watch if anyone enters or exits Paco’s house, and see if there’s anything unusual there.”
unit.target: Vir mediocris parum tacuit antequam in Intisian paulo ineptam loquens dixit: “Observa si quis domum Paco intrat aut exit, et vide si quid insolitum ibi accidat.”

unit.source: “Very honest.” Lumian nodded approvingly. “Who asked you to do it?”
unit.target: «Valde honestum,» Lumian annuit approbans. «Quis te ad hoc faciendum rogavit?»

unit.source: He was pleased that the other party knew some Intisian.
unit.target: Laetatus est quod altera pars nonnullas notiones Intisianae haberet.

unit.source: Otherwise, he could only rely on key words to communicate or capture him to have Lugano translate.
unit.target: Alioquin solum verbis clavis inniti posset, aut eum capere ut Lugano interpretaret.

unit.source: “Juan Oro,” the middle‑aged man replied without hesitation.
unit.target: «Juan Oro,» respondit vir mediocris sine mora.

unit.source: Juan Oro… The president of the Fisheries Guild and the former village chief of Milo Village?
unit.target: Juan Oro… Praeses Gildae Piscatorum et quondam dux vici Milo?

unit.source: Lumian smiled and said, “I’m surprised you’re so forthright.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Miror te tam aperte loqui!”

unit.source: The middle‑aged man forced a smile and said, “I don’t think I’m stronger than Demon Warlock and can defeat you.”
unit.target: Vir mediocris risum simulavit et dixit: “Non puto me fortiorem esse quam Daemon Warlock et te superare posse.”

unit.source: “That’s right. Those who understand the situation and themselves can live longer.”
unit.target: «Ita est. Qui rem et se intellegunt, diutius vivere possunt.»

unit.source: Lumian crossed his right foot over his left leg.
unit.target: Lumian pedem dextrum super crurum sinistrum imposuit.

unit.source: “Why is Juan Oro monitoring the Paco family?”
unit.target: «Cur Juan Oro familiam Paco inspicit?»

unit.source: “I don’t know, and there’s no need for me to know.
unit.target: «Nescio, neque mihi opus est id scire.»

unit.source: “I’ll receive a reward as long as I pass on what I see,” the middle‑aged man replied sincerely.
unit.target: «Praemium accipiam, dummodo id quod video tradam,» respondit vir mediocris sincere.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at him for a few seconds before saying, “Did you send that little monster last night?”
unit.target: Lumian eum paucis momentis intuens dixit: “Misitne illud parvum monstrum hesterno nocte?”

unit.source: The middle‑aged man was taken aback.
unit.target: Vir mediocris obstupefactus est.

unit.source: “What little monster? What happened last night?”
unit.target: «Quid parvum monstrum? Quid hesterno nocte accidit?»

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and stood up without explaining.
unit.target: Lumian subridens stetit et surrexit sine explicatione.

unit.source: “What’s your name?” he asked as he walked towards the door.
unit.target: «Quid est tibi nomen?» inquit, ambulans ad ianuam.

unit.source: The middle‑aged man hesitated for a moment before answering truthfully, “Sanches.”
unit.target: Vir mediocris paulum dubitavit antequam veraciter respondit: “Sanches.”

unit.source: Lumian opened the door, walked out, and disappeared from Sanches’s sight.
unit.target: Lumian ianuam aperuit, exiit, et ab Sanches conspectu evanuit.

unit.source: Upon his return to Solow Motel, Lumian noticed a folded letter resting on the master bedroom’s desk.
unit.target: Rediens ad Solow Motel, Lumian litteram plicatam in mensa cubiculi principalis reposam animadvertit.

unit.source: Skillfully unfurling it, he found the distinct handwriting of Madam Magician.
unit.target: Abiliter eam evolvens, invenit caligraphiam distinctam Dominae Magician.

unit.source: “You can share those matters with the Two of Cups, but avoid delving into excessive detail.
unit.target: «Has res potes cum Duobus Poculis communicare, sed cave ne nimiam subtilitatem ingeras.»

unit.source: “I refrained from elaborating on the voices you heard and the fragments of civilization you glimpsed earlier as they remain too advanced for your understanding.
unit.target: «Abstuli a prolixa exponendo de vocibus quas audivisti et de fragmentis civilitatis, quae antea conspexisti, quoniam nimis provectae sunt ad tuam intellegentiam.»

unit.source: Simply remember not to heed random sounds or sights in an ancient ruin like Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: «Memento ne fortuitos sonos aut imagines in ruina antiqua, sicut Trier Aetatis Quartae, attendas.»

unit.source: Also, caution your Warlock associates—
unit.target: Etiam, cave socios tuos Warlock—

unit.source: it’s acceptable to occasionally take in the Hidden Sage’s indoctrination, but they mustn’t fully believe in Him.
unit.target: acceptabile est interdum indoctrinationem Sapiens Occulti capere, sed in eum plene credere non debeant.

unit.source: His state is precarious.
unit.target: Status eius precarius est.

unit.source: After incinerating the letter, Lumian contemplated for a moment and decided to “teleport” back to Trier to inform Franca in person and avert any potential mishaps.
unit.target: Litteram incineratam, Lumian paulisper meditatus est et decrevit se ad Trier “teleportare”, ut Francam personaliter certiorem faceret et eventus malos praecaveret.

unit.source: Trier, nestled within the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 at 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Trier, in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativæ, Apartamentum 702 in 9 Rue Orosai.

unit.source: As Lumian materialized, Franca and Jenna were engrossed in perusing a stack of ancient information from an unknown source.
unit.target: Cum Lumian apparuit, Franca et Jenna in perlegi fasciculum antiquarum notitiarum ex fonte ignoto occupatae erant.

unit.source: “Hey, could you ‘teleport’ outside and knock? It’s quite startling when you suddenly appear like that!” Franca nearly tensed the formless spider silk she’d permanently set up in the room.
unit.target: «Heus, potesne extra “teleportare” et pulsare? Mirum est, cum subito appareas taliter!» Franca paene contraxit sericum araneum informem, quod in conclavi constanter posuerat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “With a Witch’s spiritual perception, what’s the difference between me ‘teleporting’ outside the door and appearing in the living room?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Cum perceptione spirituali Magae, quaenam est differentia inter me extra ianuam “teleportare” et in camera vivendi apparere?”

unit.source: “Why the sudden return?” Franca paused before asking, “Madame Magician said you could share about that matter?”
unit.target: «Cur tam subito redieris?» Franca paulisper cessavit antequam quaresceret: «Domina Magician dixit te de hac re communicare posse?»

unit.source: “What’s going on?” Jenna queried, looking puzzled.
unit.target: «Quid agitur?» Jenna quaesivit, aspectu perplexo.

unit.source: She stood up and prepared to leave.
unit.target: Surgens stetit et se ad discedendum praeparavit.

unit.source: “Yes,” Lumian replied to Franca’s question, but he made no attempt to stop Jenna from leaving.
unit.target: «Ita,» Lumian respondit Francae, sed nihil conatus est Jenna discedere prohibere.

unit.source: Nor did Franca intervene.
unit.target: Neque Franca intercedit.

unit.source: Once Jenna had retreated to her bedroom, Lumian turned to Franca and disclosed, “When they discussed the wilderness dream, it made me recall the voices and visions I encountered in Fourth Epoch Trier. They’re connected to the Celestial Master!”
unit.target: Postquam Jenna ad cubiculum suum recessit, Lumian ad Francam se vertit et enuntiavit: “Cum de somnio silvestri disseruissent, mihi recordatae sunt voces et visionibus quas in Trier Aetatis Quartae occurrerant. Illae cum Magistro Caelesti coniunctae sunt!”

unit.source: 547 Source of Familiarity
unit.target: 547 Fons Familiaritatis

unit.source: 547 Source of Familiarity
unit.target: 547 Fons Familiaritatis

unit.source: “Is this related to the Celestial Master?”
unit.target: „Num hoc ad Magister Caelestis attinet?“

unit.source: Franca’s interest piqued.
unit.target: Francæ studium excitatum est.

unit.source: Confusion enveloped her.
unit.target: Confusio eam involvit.

unit.source: “In the Fourth Epoch Trier, what did you see or hear that we didn’t?”
unit.target: „In quarta aetate Trier, quid vidistine aut audivistine quod nos non vidimus?“

unit.source: Everyone had been together unless it was before they met, but Jenna should have been aware!
unit.target: Omnes simul erant, nisi ante congressum, sed Jenna id scire debuit!

unit.source: Without pausing for Lumian’s response, Franca contemplated for a moment and suggested, “Could it be the aftereffects of using the Eye of Truth?”
unit.target: Sine mora pro responso Lumiani, Franca paulisper meditata est et proposuit: „Num sequela usus Oculi Veritatis sit?“

unit.source: She recalled Lumian’s abnormal behavior during that time.
unit.target: Illo tempore recordata est de insolitis moribus Lumiani.

unit.source: “Yes, that’s right.”
unit.target: „Ita, recte.“

unit.source: Lumian nodded, pulled up a chair, and settled down.
unit.target: Lumian annuit, sellam attulit, et consedit.

unit.source: He described the collision of two rocks, sparks flying, and the ensuing blaze that engulfed dry leaves and withered branches, amid echoing voices chanting “Celestial Master.”
unit.target: Descripsit collisionem duorum lapidum, scintillas volitantes, et ignem subsequens qui folia arida et ramos aridatos devoravit, inter voces resonantes quae „Magister Caelestis“ canebant.

unit.source: The more Franca listened, the more her focus intensified.
unit.target: Quo magis Franca auscultabat, eo magis intentio eius intensificabatur.

unit.source: Uncharacteristically, she refrained from interrupting.
unit.target: Inusitate, ipsa interrumpere non ausa est.

unit.source: As she listened, her gaze gradually shifted, seemingly lost in reminiscence and distant thought.
unit.target: Dum auscultabat, oculi eius paulatim versa erant, quasi in recollectione et longinqua cogitatione absorbi.

unit.source: Once Lumian finished recounting, Franca remained motionless for what felt like an eternity, frozen like a mechanical doll paused mid‐action.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian enarrationem finivit, Franca permansit immota, quod quasi aeternitate sensa esset, velut statua mechanica in medio actu congelata.

unit.source: After several seconds, she abruptly straightened up, pinched her nose, and forced a smile.
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, subito se erexit, nasum comprimens, et risum fingens ostendit.

unit.source: “As anticipated, the Celestial Master is part of our world.
unit.target: „Ut praevidebatur, Magister Caelestis pars mundi nostri est.

unit.source: “The fragments of civilization you received bear a striking resemblance to some aspects of my country’s history, yet there are differences… Could it be the true history concealed beneath the surface?
unit.target: Fragmenta civilizationis, quae accepisti, notabilem similitudinem ad quaedam partes historiae patriae meæ ostendunt, attamen differentiae adsunt… Num vera historia sub superficie abscondita sit?“

unit.source: “The Celestial Master is attempting to interfere and breach into this world, wielding significant influence over the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways, much like the way the Celestial Worthy affects Seers, Apprentices, and Marauders?
unit.target: „Magister Caelestis conatur in hunc mundum penetrare atque intromittere, vim magnopere habens in semitis ‘Mystery Pryer’ et ‘Savant’, similiter ut ‘Celestial Worthy’ super Vates, Discipulos, et Praedones afficit?“

unit.source: “Could the depravity among some of the monks in the Deep Valley Cloister and the peculiar state of the Hidden Sage be linked to the Celestial Master?”
unit.target: „Num pravitas inter aliquos monachos in claustro Vallis Profundae et status peculiaris Sapiens Occulti ad Magister Caelestis coniungi possint?“

unit.source: Franca’s thoughts crystallized as she spoke, her eyes sparkling like a serene lake.
unit.target: Cogitationes Francæ crystallizatae sunt dum loquebatur, oculi eius quasi lacus serenus scintillantes.

unit.source: “That’s my hunch too,” Lumian concurred with Franca.
unit.target: „Id quoque mihi suspicor,“ Lumian cum Franca consensit.

unit.source: Franca rose and paced, seemingly alone, contemplating how to follow this trail and unveil the truth behind the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s transmigration.
unit.target: Franca surrexit et ambulabat solitaria, meditans quomodo hanc vestigium sequeretur et veritatem de translatione Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum detegeret.

unit.source: After a few minutes, she muttered to herself, “The connection between the two worlds is stronger than I expected. It’s not just through the River Styx…
unit.target: Post paucos minuta, sibi ipsi submurmuravit: „Coniunctio inter duos mundos fortior est quam exspectabam. Non solum per flumen Styx…“

unit.source: “We should still be able to find many traces of the interaction between the two worlds…”
unit.target: „Adhuc plurima vestigia interactionis inter duos mundos reperire debemus…“

unit.source: Franca halted her pacing and fixed her gaze on Lumian.
unit.target: Franca vestigia sua sistit et oculos in Lumiano fixavit.

unit.source: “When we grow stronger and amass enough gold, I want you to summon Chen Tu again, the Armored Shadow. He should possess some insight into the Celestial Master.”
unit.target: „Quando firmiores fiamus et satis aurum colligemus, volo ut Chen Tu iterum evocetur, Umbra Loricata; ille aliquam prudentiam de Magistre Caelesti habere debet.“

unit.source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed.
unit.target: „Bene,“ Lumian respondit.

unit.source: Franca lapsed into silence once more, her mind retracing an unknown memory.
unit.target: Franca iterum in silentium cecidit, mens eius memoriam ignotam revocans.

unit.source: A few moments later, she produced four brass metal plates and handed them to Lumian.
unit.target: Post aliquos momenta, quattuor laminas aeneas produxit et Lumiano tradidit.

unit.source: “The Language Comprehension charms you wanted. The one with the most intricate patterns allows you to understand the languages of the Southern Continent. The others are for the ancient Feysac language family. The activation incantation is the word ‘knowledge’ in ancient Hermes.”
unit.target: „Incantamenta Cognitionis Linguae, quae volebas. Illud, cum figuris intricatis ornatum, tibi sinit linguas Continenti Meridionali intellegere; cetera ad antiquam familiam linguae Feysac pertinent. Formula activationis est verbum ‚scientia‘ in antiquo Hermete.“

unit.source: She and the Bear had completed the delivery through Madame Hela’s messenger. The other party proved quite efficient.
unit.target: Ea et Ursus per nuntium Dominae Helae traditionem perfecerunt. Pars altera se admodum efficax exhibuit.

unit.source: After Lumian handed Franca the money, he “teleported” out of Trier and back to Port Santa.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian Francæ pecuniam tradidit, e Trier discessit et ad Portum Santa celeriter rediit.

unit.source: In the hushed aftermath, Jenna cautiously opened the bedroom door and stuck her head out.
unit.target: In silentio subsequente, Jenna cauta ostium cubiculi aperuit et caput extraxit.

unit.source: “Has Lumian left?”
unit.target: „Abiitne Lumian?“

unit.source: “Yes,” Franca replied, her emotions subdued.
unit.target: „Ita,“ Franca respondit, affectus eius temperati.

unit.source: Jenna glanced at her but didn’t press for more information. Instead, she redirected the conversation to the stack of information related to the underground tomb.
unit.target: Jenna eam intuebatur, sed non plura quaesivit; conversatiōnem autem ad congeriem informationum de sepulcro subterraneo redirigit.

unit.source: Late at night.
unit.target: Sero nocte.

unit.source: Franca returned to her room.
unit.target: Franca ad cubiculi suum rediit.

unit.source: Glancing at the small analyzer, the accompanying typewriter, and the radio transceiver, she didn’t sit down to chat as usual. Instead, she climbed into bed.
unit.target: Aspiciens parvum analysatorem, machinam scribendi consociatam, et radiophonem, non consedit ad colloquendum ut more solito; proinde in lectum se ascendit.

unit.source: Sitting in the middle of the bed, leaning against the pillow, hugging her legs and curling up, Franca’s gaze unfocused on the crimson moon and stars outside the window.
unit.target: In medio lecti sedens, contra pulvinar recubans, crura complectens et se convolvens, oculi Francæ in lunam rubram et stellas extra fenestram vacue spectabant.

unit.source: Lumian’s words today plunged her into nostalgia, but the more her emotions fluctuated, the less she wanted to reveal vulnerability.
unit.target: Verba Lumiani hodie eam in nostalgiam traxerunt, sed quo magis affectus eius fluctuant, eo minus voluit vulnerabilitatem ostendere.

unit.source: She endured it, pretending to have recovered.
unit.target: Id sustinuit, simulans se iam sanatum esse.

unit.source: Only when solitude enveloped her, as the night fell silent and the seemingly eternal stars adorned the sky, did she shed her thick “armor” and sink deep into her emotions.
unit.target: Solum cum solitudo eam amplectebatur, cum nox tacebat et stellæ quasi aeternæ caelum ornabantur, ipsa crassam „armuram“ abstulit et in affectus suos alte se cecidit.

unit.source: After an indeterminate amount of time, Franca lowered her head, burying her face between her knees.
unit.target: Post tempus indeterminatum, Franca caput inclinavit, faciem inter genua sua deponens.

unit.source: That night, she delved into a multitude of dreams.
unit.target: Illa nocte in multitudinem somniorum se immergit.

unit.source: Broad shoulders carried her as a child, a touch of white hair at the temples, dishes not particularly delicious but always suited her tastes.
unit.target: Umeri lati eam portabant in pueritia; capilli albi ad tempora apparuerunt, et fercula, non prorsus sapida sed semper gustui eius conveniebant.

unit.source: Pure emotions of her youth, memories of being the “atmosphere livening machine,” and her “broadminded” self all danced in fragmented sequences…
unit.target: Affectus puri iuventutis, memoriae ut „machina atmosphaeram vivificans“ atque imagines sui „amplem mentis“, omnes in particulis fragmentis saltabant…

unit.source: As her two decades unfolded in her dreams, she unknowingly opened her eyes, feeling the coldness on her face.
unit.target: Dum duo decennia eius in somniis evoluta erant, nesciente oculos aperuit, et frigorem in facie sentiuit.

unit.source: Reluctant to move, she lingered in the moment.
unit.target: Nolens movere, in illo momento manebat.

unit.source: Suddenly, a recollection struck her.
unit.target: Subito, recordatio eam percussit.

unit.source: Back on the fourth level of the catacombs, she and Jenna had encountered a man who seemed strangely familiar.
unit.target: In quarto gradu catacumbarum illa et Jenna viro convenerunt, qui mirabiliter familia videbatur.

unit.source: Initially, she believed that the original owner of her body had encountered him.
unit.target: Initio existimavit quod quondam possessor corporis eius eum convenisset.

unit.source: Now, the reason for his familiarity became clear.
unit.target: Nunc ratio huius familiaritatis manifesta facta est.

unit.source: The man bore an uncanny resemblance to someone from her home country before transmigration!
unit.target: Vir incredibilem similitudinem exhibebat ad aliquem ex patria eius ante transmigrationem!

unit.source: Despite altering his appearance to thwart immediate recognition, Franca was now certain that his facial features differed from those she had encountered in this world.
unit.target: Quamquam aspectum suum mutavit ut recognitioni impediret, Franca nunc certa erat eius lineamenta faciei ab illis, quae in hoc mundo convenissent, dissimilia esse.

unit.source: Softer, less chiseled!
unit.target: Mollior, minus sculptus!

unit.source: With a mix of fear and excitement, Franca sat up and pondered, Could it be that, aside from us transmigrating souls, there are others who physically transmigrated? Or has someone mastered the ability to freely traverse between both worlds?
unit.target: Cum timore et exsultatione mixtis, Franca surrexit et meditata est: „Num praeter animas nostras translatas, alii corpore migraverint? An aliquis facultatem adeptus est libere inter ambos mundos perambulandi?“

unit.source: After breakfast, Lumian stepped into the master bedroom’s washroom and retrieved a low-level Language Comprehension charm from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Post ientaculum, Lumian in cubiculi domini balneum ingressus est, et ex sacco Viatoris incantamentum pro cognitione linguae humilis gradus eduxit.

unit.source: “Knowledge,” he whispered in ancient Hermes.
unit.target: „Scientia,“ susurravit in antiquo Hermete.

unit.source: The brass-like charm ignited with bluish-green flames and swiftly vanished.
unit.target: Incantamentum, quasi aeneum, flammas viride-caeruleas accendit et celeriter evanuit.

unit.source: Instantly, Lumian felt an abnormal clarity in his mind, as if an avalanche of additional knowledge had flooded in, unveiling the structural origins and connections of numerous words.
unit.target: Statim, Lumian in mente sua claritatem insolitam sensit, quasi avalanche scientiae additae irruisset, originem structurarum atque nexuum plurium verborum pandens.

unit.source: Today’s agenda: a visit to the oldest fishing village, perhaps meeting the Governor of the Sea. Mastering Highlander in secret seemed imperative to avoid missing crucial clues!
unit.target: Agenda huius diei: visita ad antiquissimum vicum piscatorium, fortasse conventus cum Gubernatore Maris. Peritiam in arte „Highlander“ secreto assequi videbatur necessarium, ne indicia vitalia amitterentur!

unit.source: The charm’s effects would last for seven days.
unit.target: Effectus incantamenti per septem dies manebunt.

unit.source: Leaving the bedroom, Lumian took Ludwig and Lugano to 21 Saint Lana Street in a rental carriage, where they met Martha, the matriarch of the Paco family.
unit.target: Ex cubiculi discessit, et Lumian Ludwig et Lugano ad numerum 21 viae Sanctae Lanae in curru conducto duxit, ubi Martha, matriarcha familiae Paco, convenit.

unit.source: Martha didn’t look like she was in her sixties, with only faint wrinkles at the corners of her eyes, appearing more in her early fifties based on her eyes, nose, mouth, and brows. Her features retained a unique charm.
unit.target: Martha non videbatur sexagenaria, cum solis levibus rugis in angulis oculorum; ex oculis, naso, ore, et superciliis potius quinquaginta annos insinuans, lineamenta eius venustate singulari ornata retinebant.

unit.source: At that moment, the old lady with grayish-black hair and light-blue eyes wore a black, widow-like dress and a dark, old-styled bonnet.
unit.target: Eo momento, vetula, capillis nigris cum griseis mixtis et oculis caeruleis, veste nigra quasi vidua induta, et pileo vetere obscuro ornata erat.

unit.source: Pale-faced, she was supported by two young maids as they boarded a four-wheeled, four-seater carriage.
unit.target: Facie pallida, a duabus iuvenibus ancillis sustentata erat, dum in currum quattuor rotarum quattuor-locorum conscenderentur.

unit.source: “Monsieur Berry, I’ll be relying on you,” Rubió Paco nodded at Lumian beside the carriage.
unit.target: „Domine Berry, in te confido,“ Rubió Paco Lumiano iuxta annuit.

unit.source: He was to accompany his mother to Milo Village to meet the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Ille matrem suam comitari debuit ad Vicum Milo, ut Gubernatorem Maris conveniret.

unit.source: Lumian directed Ludwig to Giorgia.
unit.target: Lumian Ludovici ad Giorgia direxit.

unit.source: “Please keep an eye on him until I return from Milo Village.”
unit.target: „Quaeso, eum observa, donec a Vico Milo redeam.“

unit.source: Rubió translated this time.
unit.target: Hac vice Rubió interpretatus est.

unit.source: Giorgia smiled and replied, “Don’t worry, I’ll make sure there’s plenty of food.”
unit.target: Giorgia subridens respondit: „Noli timere, curabo ut copia cibi sit.“

unit.source: She had already realized that this boy had the appetite of two or three adults, but as the godson of a great adventurer, it was understandable that he was special.
unit.target: Illa iam intellexerat puer hunc appetitum duorum vel trium adultorum habere, sed ut filius adoptivus magni audacis viatoris, id intellegendum erat: peculiaris esset.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t concerned about Ludwig’s treatment in the Paco household.
unit.target: Lumian de modo tractandi Ludovici in domo Paco non anxius fuit.

unit.source: He feigned his understanding of Highlander and waited for Lugano’s translation before saying, “A meal every two hours.”
unit.target: Simulavit se arti „Highlander“ periti esse et translationem Lugani exspectavit, deinde dixit: „Cibus quot duabus horis.“

unit.source: With that, he sat on the right side of the carriage driver and didn’t enter the carriage.
unit.target: His dictis, in parte dextro gubernatoris currus sedebat, et currum non intravit.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lugano had no choice but to choose the seat to the left of the carriage driver.
unit.target: Videns hoc, Lugano nihil aliud potuit facere quam sedem ad partem sinistram gubernatoris eligere.

unit.source: Before doing so, he diligently translated Lumian’s final instructions.
unit.target: Ante hoc, diligenter Lumiani ultimas instructiones vertit.

unit.source: Although he didn’t know what would happen if Ludwig starved, he felt that it wouldn’t be good, so he emphasized it twice.
unit.target: Quamquam nesciebat quid eveniret si Ludovicus esuriret, sensit id non fore bonum, itaque bis hoc confirmavit.

unit.source: As the carriage set off, Giorgia processed the translation.
unit.target: Cum currus profectus est, Giorgia translationem processit.

unit.source: “A meal every two hours? Two hours?”
unit.target: „Cibus quot duabus horis? Duas horas?“

unit.source: The Paco family’s carriage rolled along the grayish-white stone-paved street.
unit.target: Currus familiae Paco per viam lapide stratum, cinereo-albo, volvebat.

unit.source: Lumian leaned against the carriage wall, retracted his right leg, and stepped on the edge of the carriage driver’s seat.
unit.target: Lumian in parietem currus recubuit, crus dextro retraxit, et ad limen sedis gubernatoris accessit.

unit.source: Lugano glanced at him, feeling a bit uneasy.
unit.target: Lugano eum intuebatur, paulo turbatus se sentiens.

unit.source: A seasoned bounty hunter, Lugano sensed something awry in this seemingly ordinary mission that prompted Rubió to assist his employer in hiding in Milo Village.
unit.target: Lugano, venator peritus mercedarius, sensit aliquid anomale in hac missione apparenter ordina, quae Rubió impellit ut dominum suum in Vico Milo celare curaret.

unit.source: His heart raced as he observed armed pedestrians on the street, fearing an imminent attack from the crowd.
unit.target: Cor eius celeriter pulsabat, dum pedestres armatos in via intuerebatur, metuens impetum imminens multitudinis.

unit.source: Under the October sun still blazing in Port Santa, the streets, damp from the previous night’s heavy rain, hadn’t completely dried.
unit.target: Sub sole Octobri adhuc ardente in Porto Santa, viae, ex imbre noctis præcedentis madidae, nondum plane siccatae erant.

unit.source: Lugano yearned to reach Milo Village quickly.
unit.target: Lugano vehementer cupiebat ad Vicum Milo celeriter pervenire.

unit.source: Glancing at Lumian, he noticed that Lumian had narrowed his eyes.
unit.target: Intuens Luminum, animadvertit eum oculos angustatos habere.

unit.source: Lowering his straw hat, Lumian seemed to be peacefully napping, showing no signs of nervousness.
unit.target: Strigi pileum deponens, Lumian tranquillo somno quiescere videbatur, nullas indicia perturbationis ostendens.

unit.source: Phew… With a powerhouse like him around, there shouldn’t be a problem… Lugano silently reassured himself.
unit.target: Phew… Cum tali viro potentissimo adesset, problema esse non debebat… Lugano tacite se consolatus est.

unit.source: The carriage headed north, leaving Port Santa and reaching a village nestled against the Dariège mountain range, overlooking the azure sea.
unit.target: Currus ad septentrionem se contulit, Portum Santa relinquens, et ad vicum, in montes Dariège adfixum, mare caeruleum intuens, pervenit.

unit.source: Fishing boats set off, accompanied by the resonant singing and chirping of seabirds.
unit.target: Navigia piscatoria profecti sunt, comitantur cantu resonante et stridore avium marinarum.

unit.source: Milo Village’s buildings exuded a historic feel.
unit.target: Aedificia Vici Milo sensum antiquitatis efferebant.

unit.source: Brown, yellow, and beige stone-brick outer walls, blackened at the lower half, gave them character.
unit.target: Muri exteriores ex lateribus lapideis brunneis, flavis et beige, in parte inferiori nigro fusis, indolem eis dederunt.

unit.source: Though the wooden components had been replaced, weeds still clung.
unit.target: Quamquam elementa lignea substituta erant, herbae adhuc haerebant.

unit.source: A small cathedral belonging to Earth Mother stood near the mountain, and facing the fishing village dock was the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Parva cathédralis, quae Matri Terrae pertinebat, iuxta montem stabat, et opposita ad pontem vici piscatorii, domus Gubernatoris Maris erat.

unit.source: The four-story building, with a white backing and gray bricks, resembled a cathedral and a sacrificial ground more than a human residence.
unit.target: Aedificium quattuor tabularum, cum albo subnixo et lateribus griseis, cathédrali et loco sacrificatorio magis simile erat quam domicilium humanum.

unit.source: As they arrived safely at their destination, Lugano sighed in relief and jumped off the carriage.
unit.target: Cum tuto pervenerent, Lugano leviter suspiravit et de curru exsalivit.

unit.source: Two maids supported Madame Martha as they headed toward the Governor of the Sea’s building, accompanied by Rubió Paco.
unit.target: Duae ancillae Dominae Marthæ eam sustentabant, dum iter faciebant ad aedificium Gubernatoris Maris, comitatae Rubió Paco.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lugano heard his employer’s voice.
unit.target: Subito, Lugano vocem patroni sui audivit.

unit.source: “Take a look at what’s wrong with that old lady.”
unit.target: „Aspice quid in illa vetula male sit.“

unit.source: Uh… Lugano glanced at Lumian, who had appeared beside him, wearing a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Heu… Lugano in Luminum intuebatur, qui iuxta eum apparuit, indutus pileo striga aureo.

unit.source: He raised his hand and gently tapped his forehead, activating his Spirit Vision.
unit.target: Manum levavit et frontem leniter percussit, spiritus visionem activans.

unit.source: Observing Madame Martha’s back for a few seconds after she entered the Governor of the Sea’s residence, he frowned and said, “Most notably is the excessive loss of blood and weak vitality…”
unit.target: Observans dorsum Dominae Marthæ per paucos secundos postquam in habitaculum Gubernatoris Maris intravit, rugam fecit et dixit: „Praecipue est sanguinis nimia amissio et debilis vitalitas…“

unit.source: Lugano hesitated before concluding, “It doesn’t look like illness. It looks more like an injury.”
unit.target: Lugano cunctatus est antequam concluderet, „Non videtur morbus. Magis videtur laesio.“

unit.source: 548 Governor of the Sea
unit.target: 548 Praefectus Maris

unit.source: 548 Governor of the Sea
unit.target: 548 Praefectus Maris

unit.source: Injured?
unit.target: Vulneratus?

unit.source: Injured by the humanoid lizard?
unit.target: Vulneratus a lacerta homini simili?

unit.source: Lumian made a casual guess after hearing Lugano’s judgment.
unit.target: Lumian, postquam iudicium Lugani audivit, coniecturam levem fecit.

unit.source: He stood by the carriage, his gaze naturally surveying the surroundings of the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Stabat iuxta currum, oculos naturaliter versus circumiecta sedis Praefecti Maris intendens.

unit.source: The location was close to the fishing village’s docks, with boats sailing into the sea and fishing nets secured to the reefs.
unit.target: Locus erat prope portus vici piscatorii, ubi naves in mare navigabant et retia piscatoria ad scopulos alligata erant.

unit.source: Around nearby houses, women were busy processing seafood, turning them into salted fish and jerky.
unit.target: Circa domos proximas, feminae opera elaborandi cibaria marina agebant, ea in pisces salsos et siccos transformantes.

unit.source: Children ran along various village roads, playing games.
unit.target: Pueri per varias vias vici currabant, ludos ludentes.

unit.source: Though different from Cordu, the essence of the scene remained similar.
unit.target: Quamquam a Cordu diversa, essentia scaenae similis manebat.

unit.source: In front of the Governor of the Sea’s residence stretched a sizable square where Lumian and the others awaited Madame Martha, Rubió Paco, and their emergence.
unit.target: Ante sedem Praefecti Maris forum amplum se extendebat, in quo Lumian et ceteri Madame Martha, Rubió Paco, et eorum adventum exspectabant.

unit.source: Children gathered in a corner, arranging numerous shells and engaging in an acting game.
unit.target: Pueri in angulo congregati, multas conchas disponentes et ludum scaenicum ludentes.

unit.source: The eldest, dressed in a linen shirt, declared, “I’m the Governor of the Sea!”
unit.target: Puer senior, tunica lintea indutus, declaravit: “Ego Praefectus Maris sum!”

unit.source: “I’ll be the guard!”
unit.target: Ego custos ero!

unit.source: “I’m the mother,” the other children replied.
unit.target: “Ego mater sum,” responderunt ceteri pueri.

unit.source: The youngest hopped around, asking, “What about me? What about me?”
unit.target: Puer minimus saltans, rogans: “Quid de me? Quid de me?”

unit.source: The child playing the role of the Governor of the Sea pondered for a moment and said, “You can be the Child of the Sea.”
unit.target: Puer, qui partes Praefecti Maris agebat, paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Potes esse Puer Maris.”

unit.source: Child of the Sea? What’s that?
unit.target: Puer Maris? Quid hoc est?

unit.source: Lumian, though not looking, listened intently to the children’s discussion.
unit.target: Lumian, quamquam non spectabat, attenter sermonem puerorum auscultavit.

unit.source: These kids may not understand many terms, but their lack of confidentiality made them unwitting carriers of information.
unit.target: Hi pueri fortasse multa verba non comprehendebant, sed eorum secretum retinendi carentia eos inconsulte notitiae portatoribus faciebat.

unit.source: The adults in Milo Village wouldn’t be overly vigilant against such young children, who might inadvertently reveal details remembered in their daily games.
unit.target: Adulti vici Milo non nimis vigilant contra tales pueros parvos erant, qui forte in ludis quotidianis singula nota pateficere possent.

unit.source: Recalling his experiences in Cordu, Lumian recognized the value of sounding out children and playing games with them.
unit.target: Experientias in Cordu recolens, Lumian agnovit pretium puerorum audendi et ludendi cum illis.

unit.source: It was a subtle way to glean insights into family matters.
unit.target: Era subtilis modus ad res familiares cognoscendas.

unit.source: After absorbing the children’s discussions and gauging the time, Lumian adjusted his golden straw hat and headed straight for the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Postquam sermonem puerorum absorpsit et tempus aestimavit, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum suum regulavit atque recta via ad sedem Praefecti Maris contulit.

unit.source: Lugano was taken aback and swiftly followed Lumian.
unit.target: Lugano obstupefactus est et celeriter Luminum secutus est.

unit.source: Two “guards” in brownish-green shirts and pants, each armed with a rifle, blocked the entrance of the cathedral and sacrificial ground, fixing their gaze on Lumian.
unit.target: Duo custodes, induti tunicis et braccis fusco-viridibus, quarum singuli sclopetos gerebant, ostium cathedralis et area sacrificii obstruxerunt, oculos in Luminum fixantes.

unit.source: “Halt!” the “guards” shouted.
unit.target: “Sta!” clamaverunt custodes.

unit.source: Undeterred, Lumian continued forward, speaking in Intisian nonchalantly, “I don’t understand what you’re saying.”
unit.target: Ne perturbatus, Lumian progreditur, loquens Intisiane non sollemne: “Non intellego quid dicatis.”

unit.source: With a swoosh, the two “guards” raised their rifles, aiming at the outsider in the golden straw hat.
unit.target: Subito, duo custodes sclopeta erexerunt, ad externum in pileo stramineo aureo intenti.

unit.source: Lugano hurriedly translated, “They won’t let you in.”
unit.target: Lugano festinanter interpretatus est: “Non sinent te intrare.”

unit.source: Ignoring his guide, Lumian neither sped up nor slowed down as he approached the white building with gray bricks.
unit.target: Neglegens ducem, Lumian neque celeravit neque tardavit, dum ad aedificium album lateribus griseis instructum accedebat.

unit.source: A cold glint flickered in the blue eyes of the two “guards” as they squeezed their triggers.
unit.target: Dum manubrios stringebant, fulgor frigidus in oculis caeruleis duorum custodum micuit.

unit.source: At that moment, the outsider in the golden straw hat vanished from their sight.
unit.target: Illo momento, externus in pileo stramineo aureo ex conspectu eorum evanuit.

unit.source: He melded into the sunlit shadows of the governor’s residence.
unit.target: Se in umbras solis illustratas sedis Praefecti absorpsit.

unit.source: In the next instant, Lumian reappeared from a shadow in the foyer behind them and continued walking.
unit.target: In proximo momento, Lumian ex umbra atrii post eos iterum apparuit et ambulare continuavit.

unit.source: It was as if the distance between them had been erased.
unit.target: Quasi distantia inter eos deleta esset.

unit.source: The two “guards,” with keen senses, quickly turned around, peering behind them. However, Lumian had already entered the building, leaving the foyer.
unit.target: Duo custodes, sensibus acutissimis, celeriter conversi sunt, post se speculantes; sed Lumian iam in aedificium intraverat, atrium relinquens.

unit.source: Outside, Lugano stood in a daze, uncertain whether to take the risk of following and acting as a translator or to prioritize his own safety.
unit.target: Foris, Lugano stupefactus stabat, dubiens an periculum sequeretur ac fungendo munere interpreti, an propriam salutem praeferret.

unit.source: After passing through the foyer, Lumian suddenly noticed the space ahead darkening.
unit.target: Postquam atrium pertransiit, Lumian subito animadvertit spatium ante se obscurari.

unit.source: The dome, just over ten meters tall, emanated an inaccessible aura.
unit.target: Cúpula, paulo plus quam decem metris alta, aura inaccessibilis emanabat.

unit.source: Aqua-blue walls adorned with various reliefs caught his eye.
unit.target: Muri caeruleo-aquae, variis effigiis ornati, oculos eius ceperunt.

unit.source: Unlike the typical statues of Angels and Saints, these depicted objects from the sea—
unit.target: Contra statuas angelorum et sanctorum consuetas, haec obiecta maris depingebant—

unit.source: starfish, corals, numerous fish, lobsters, and crabs.
unit.target: Asterias, coralla, pisces multi, astaci, et cancri.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian sensed the reliefs coming to life, casting a dangerous gaze at him.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian sensit reliefia animari, atque in eum oculos periculosos iacere.

unit.source: No, they weren’t alive.
unit.target: Minime, non erant vivi.

unit.source: The building itself seemed alive, instinctively rejecting intruders and exerting layers of pressure.
unit.target: Aedificium ipsum quasi vivantem videbatur, instinctive intrusos reiciebat atque strata pressurarum exercebat.

unit.source: Lumian’s steps instantly became heavy, as if burdened by hundreds of kilograms of food.
unit.target: Gressus Luminiani statim graviores facti sunt, quasi centum modis cibi onerati.

unit.source: Within his field of vision, Martha, the Paco family’s matriarch, knelt diagonally on the ground with her legs crossed.
unit.target: In conspectu eius, Martha, matriarcha familiae Paco, in terra diagone genua flectit et crura sua transversa posuit.

unit.source: Rubió Paco stood at a distance.
unit.target: Rubió Paco loco remoto stetit.

unit.source: The two maids also knelt, their backs turned towards the entrance hall, as if unwilling to look at a certain important figure.
unit.target: Duae ancillae quoque in genua ceciderunt, tergum ad atrium convertentes, quasi figurae certae magni momenti inspicere non velint.

unit.source: Directly opposite the high dome lay a “carpet” made of fish skin.
unit.target: Contrario directe cúpulae altae, iacebat tapete ex cute piscium confectum.

unit.source: A young man in a retro white robe reclined on it, propping himself up with his elbows as he quietly observed Martha.
unit.target: Iuvenis in vestitu albo retroposito super illud recubuit, cubitis innixus, dum tranquille Martam contemplabatur.

unit.source: Four other beautiful women adorned the “carpet.”
unit.target: Quattuor aliae feminae pulchrae tapetem ornabant.

unit.source: One knelt behind the lad, serving as his cushion.
unit.target: Una post puerum in genua cecidit, quasi eius pulvinar fungens.

unit.source: Another peeled late-ripened grapes and delicately fed them to the lad.
unit.target: Altera uvas sero maturatas depilavit et leviter puerulo dedit.

unit.source: The remaining two held trays with alcohol, food, and towels, each standing in a separate spot.
unit.target: Duae reliquae patinas tenebant, in quibus alcoholum, cibus, et lintea erant, singuli in diversis locis statentes.

unit.source: Their pregnant bellies were unmistakably visible, radiating a maternal glow.
unit.target: Ventres eorum, gravidique, manifeste apparebant, maternum splendorem diffundentes.

unit.source: Upon Lumian’s sudden entrance, the lad appeared alarmed, sitting up straight and seeking solace in the embrace of the woman behind him.
unit.target: Ad subitum ingressum Luminiani, puer consternatus apparuit, recta sedens et solacium in amplexu feminae post eum quaerens.

unit.source: Sensing the abnormality, Rubió turned around and saw the adventurer he had hired, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Anomaliam sentiens, Rubió se convertere fecit et adventatorem quem conductum habuerat, Louis Berry, conspexit.

unit.source: His pupils dilated slightly as he urgently spoke in Intisian, “Why did you come in?”
unit.target: Pupillae eius paulo dilatatae erant, dum festinanter in Intisiana loquebatur: “Cur intravisti?”

unit.source: Only then did Lumian pause and smile.
unit.target: Tum demum Lumian subsedit et subridens.

unit.source: “I’m a professional adventurer. You’ve been inside for too long. I’m worried something might happen.”
unit.target: “Adventator professionalis sum. Intra nimis diu mansistis. Vereor ne quid eveniat.”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian sensed dangerous gazes from various parts of the building.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian aspectus periculosos ex variis partibus aedificii sensit.

unit.source: Rubió fell silent for a moment before saying, “Don’t worry. Just wait outside for us to come out.”
unit.target: Rubió paulisper tacuit, deinde dicens: “Noli timere. Sola extra exspecta ut nos exeamus.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lumian chuckled, turned around, and sauntered into the foyer, acting as if the dangerous gazes didn’t exist.
unit.target: “Bene,” subridens Lumian dixit, se convertit atque in atrium ambulavit, quasi aspectus periculososi non exsisterent.

unit.source: Back in the foyer, he faced the two “guards” and their rifles without giving them a glance as he walked past.
unit.target: In atrio reversus, se opposuit duobus custodibus et eorum sclopetis, eosque nullo quidem aspectu attento transeundo.

unit.source: The expressions of the “guards” shifted, but they refrained from firing, allowing Lumian to exit the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Vultus custodum commutati sunt, sed ignem non fecerunt, sinentes Luminum domum Praefecti Maris exire.

unit.source: Lugano breathed a sigh of relief, grateful he wouldn’t be hunted down by the people of Milo Village.
unit.target: Lugano suspiravit leviter, gratus quod a populo vici Milo non insequeretur.

unit.source: Despite being a Beyonder, facing more than one armed soldier still made him uneasy.
unit.target: Quamquam Beyonder erat, adversus plures milites armatos se opponere eum tamen perturbabat.

unit.source: Glancing at Lumian, he hesitated to ask why his employer insisted on barging in.
unit.target: Aspiciens in Luminum, dubitavit rogare cur dominus eius irrumpere insisteret.

unit.source: Lumian settled back beside the carriage driver, tucking in his legs with one bent and the other extended, allowing his right arm to rest on it.
unit.target: Lumian se recubavit iuxta aurīgum currus, genu alterum flectens, alterumque extendens, sinens dextro brachio in eo quiescere.

unit.source: After nearly ten minutes, Rubió Paco and his mother, Martha, emerged from the cathedral-like building.
unit.target: Post fere decem minuta, Rubió Paco et mater eius, Martha, ex aedificio simile cathedrali emerserunt.

unit.source: Rubió took a deep look at Lumian and said, “Let’s go. The Governor of the Sea has agreed to let my mother receive treatment at the Church.”
unit.target: Rubió Luminum diligenter contemplatus est et dixit: “Eamus. Praefectus Maris consensit ut mater mea in Ecclesia curationem accipiat.”

unit.source: Is that lad the current Governor of the Sea?
unit.target: Num puer iste praesens Praefectus Maris est?

unit.source: He looked weak and appeared panicked.
unit.target: Videbatur infirmus et consternatus apparuit.

unit.source: How can he protect Port Santa’s fishermen and sea merchants for a year?
unit.target: Quomodo possit piscatores Portus Santae et mercatores maris per annum protegere?

unit.source: Or does he lack abilities but possess a special symbol?
unit.target: An ei facultates desunt, sed symbolum speciale possidet?

unit.source: Did the April Fool’s prank cause an accident at last year’s sea prayer ritual?
unit.target: Num iocus Aprilis Stultorum casum in ritu precationis maris anni praeteriti effecit?

unit.source: This Governor of the Sea might have failed to receive the sea’s boon or appointment, but the Fisheries Guild members conceal the matter to avoid causing panic, treating him as the real Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Hic Praefectus Maris fortasse dona maris non accepit, sed sodales Gildis Piscandi rem occultant ne pavor oriantur, eum tamquam verum Praefectum Maris tractantes.

unit.source: He must know about what happened back then…
unit.target: Oportet eum scire quid tunc acciderit…

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian cogitabunde annuit.

unit.source: He smiled and asked Rubió in Intisian, “Then, should we thank Earth Mother for Her love and care or the Governor’s approval?”
unit.target: Subridens, Lumian Rubió Intisiana lingua rogavit: “Ergo, gratias agamur Matri Terrae pro amore et cura, an approbationi Praefecti?”

unit.source: Rubió didn’t respond and followed his mother, Martha, into the carriage.
unit.target: Rubió non respondit et matrem suam, Martha, in currum secutus est.

unit.source: Lugano hurriedly took a seat on the other side of the carriage driver, watching as the horse circled around and changed direction, gradually departing from the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Lugano festinanter sedit in altera parte aurīgī, spectans equum circumagere et directionem mutare, paulatim a sede Praefecti Maris discedens.

unit.source: Phew… Lugano sighed from the bottom of his heart.
unit.target: Phew… Lugano ex imo corde suspiravit.

unit.source: This commission doesn’t seem dangerous…
unit.target: Haec commissio non periculosum videtur esse…

unit.source: Apart from his employer insisting on barging into the Governor of the Sea’s residence, there were no surprises.
unit.target: Praeterquam quod dominus eius irrumpere in sedem Praefecti Maris insistit, nulla erant inopinata.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “That’s because I’m here. If it were just you, those hidden observers might have already come knocking.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens induxit et dixit: “Idcirco quia ego adsum. Si solus esses, illi observatores occulti fortasse iam ad ianuam pulsavissent.”

unit.source: Lugano fell silent, observing as his employer pointed at the Governor of the Sea’s mansion, resembling a cathedral, and uttered a phrase in Highlander word by word.
unit.target: Lugano tacuit, observans ut dominus eius in mansionem Praefecti Maris, quae cathedrali similis erat, indicaret et verba in lingua Highlander singula proferret.

unit.source: “What. Will happen if. Blown up?”
unit.target: “Quid. Accidet, si explositus fueris?”

unit.source: Lugano shuddered, his hair standing on end.
unit.target: Lugano contremuit, et capilli eius erecti sunt.

unit.source: He glanced at the astonished carriage driver and advised his employer in Intisian, “You’ll probably be hunted down by the entire Port Santa.”
unit.target: Aspectans aurīgum currus stupitum, dominum eius in Intisiana admonuit: “Forsitan totus Portus Santa te insequentur.”

unit.source: Lumian smiled and averted his gaze, remaining silent.
unit.target: Lumian subridens oculos avertit atque silentium retinuit.

unit.source: Only then did Lugano realize.
unit.target: Tum demum Lugano intellexit.

unit.source: His employer was testing someone!
unit.target: Dominus eius aliquem probabat!

unit.source: Why else would he use Highlander, a language he hadn’t mastered yet?
unit.target: Cur aliter utaretur lingua Highlander, quam nondum perit?

unit.source: He was testing the reactions of the carriage driver and Madame Martha in the carriage!
unit.target: Probabat reactiones aurígī et Madame Marthae in curru!

unit.source: Listening to Martha and Rubió’s conversation, Lumian noted the mother and son barely spoke during the journey, perhaps due to Martha’s poor health, with occasional moans of pain.
unit.target: Audiens sermonem inter Martha et Rubió, Lumian animadvertit matrem et filium vix loqui in itinere, fortasse ob mala valetudine Marthae, cum interdum gemitibus doloris.

unit.source: As the carriage left Milo Village, the driver suddenly pulled the reins, stopping the horses.
unit.target: Dum currus vicum Milo relinquit, aurīgus repente funibus traxit, equos sistens.

unit.source: An old man with a black cane had appeared in front of the carriage.
unit.target: Senex cum baculo nigro ante currum apparuit.

unit.source: With dark and white hair, eyes as blue as the sea, and wearing common fishermen’s clothes, the wrinkled face of the old man could have killed a mosquito with its folds.
unit.target: Capillis atris et albis, oculis tam caeruleis quam mare, et vestimenta piscatorum communia gerens, vultus rugosus senis muscam per plicas interficere potuisset.

unit.source: “Mr. Oro…” the carriage driver whispered, his expression tense, uncertain how to react.
unit.target: “Domine Oro…” sussurravit aurīgus currus, vultu tenso, nesciens quomodo ageretur.

unit.source: Juan Oro? Lumian thought. The president of the Fisheries Guild and the former village chief of Milo Village?
unit.target: Juan Oro? Lumian cogitavit. Praeses Gildis Piscandi et pristinus dux vici Milo?

unit.source: Supported by a young man resembling him, Juan Oro approached the Paco family’s carriage with his cane.
unit.target: Iuveni, qui eum similis erat, Juan Oro cum baculo suo ad currum familiae Paco appropinquavit.

unit.source: In the carriage, Rubió and Martha remained silent.
unit.target: In curru, Rubió et Martha taciti mansērunt.

unit.source: At that moment, a revolver appeared on Juan Oro’s forehead, pressing the cold muzzle against his flesh.
unit.target: Illo momento, apparuit revolver in fronte Juan Oro, cum tubus frigidus in carnem eius premens.

unit.source: Lumian raised his chin slightly and looked at the president of the Fisheries Guild. With a calm expression, he asked, “Who allowed you to approach this carriage?”
unit.target: Lumian mentum leviter erexit et praesidem Gildis Piscandi aspexit, vultu tranquillo, quaerens: “Quis tibi accessum huic currui permisit?”

unit.source: 549 True Purpose
unit.target: 549 Verus Propositum

unit.source: 549 True Purpose
unit.target: 549 Verus Propositum

unit.source: The young man supporting Juan Oro glanced up at Lumian, who sat beside the carriage driver with one leg bent, the other propped up.
unit.target: Vir iuvenis, qui Iuanum Oro sustinebat, sursum aspexit Luminum, qui iuxta aurīgum currus sedebat, alterum genu flexum, alterum autem extendentem tenens.

unit.source: His eyes blazed with undisguised anger.
unit.target: Oculi eius manifesto furore ardenter fulgebant.

unit.source: The carriage driver jumped in fright and desperately tried to distance himself from Lumian.
unit.target: Aurīgus currus metu impulsus est et desperanter conatus est se a Luminum recedere.

unit.source: However, with a horse in front of him and Lugano on his left, dodging proved impossible in his haste.
unit.target: Attamen, cum equus coram eo esset et Lugano ad sinistram, effugere in tanta festinatione impossibile apparuit.

unit.source: Lugano swallowed hard, blaming his employer for being overly aggressive.
unit.target: Lugano asperrime glutit, dominum suum nimis impetuosum esse accusans.

unit.source: Is he trying to imitate Gehrman Sparrow?
unit.target: An conatur Gehrman Sparrow imitari?

unit.source: But his employer hadn’t exhibited such madness before; instead, he seemed intelligent!
unit.target: Sed dominus eius talem insaniam antea non demonstraverat; immo, intelligens videbatur!

unit.source: Juan Oro, an elderly man with mottled black hair, seemed oblivious to the revolver pointed at his forehead.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro, senex cum capillis atris maculatis, videbatur revolveri in fronte eius directo non animadvertisse.

unit.source: He turned his head, stepped aside from the firearm, and continued forward.
unit.target: Caput vertit, a sclopeto se recessit, et iter continuavit.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian pulled the trigger without hesitation.
unit.target: Illud observans, Lumian sine mora manubrium premere constituit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: A yellow bullet shot from the revolver, heading straight for the side of Juan Oro’s head.
unit.target: Globulus flavus e revolvero emissus est, recta ad latus capitis Iuan Oro tendens.

unit.source: At some point, a palm intercepted the bullet, causing it to decelerate and spin.
unit.target: Aliquando, palma bullam interceptavit, quae retardationem atque verterationem ei attulit.

unit.source: The bullet landed in the palm, feeling as if it had fallen into a thick swamp.
unit.target: Bulla in palma cecidit, quasi in paludem densam lapsa esset.

unit.source: The wide, bronzed hand belonged to the young man supporting Juan Oro.
unit.target: Manus lata, aenea, iuveni, qui Iuanum Oro sustinebat, pertinebat.

unit.source: He glared at Lumian, his lips curling in disdain. Then, he bellowed, “Have you lost your mind?”
unit.target: Iuvenis Luminum aspexit, labris in fastidio contractis; tum exclamavit: “Mentem amisisti?”

unit.source: Before he could finish, fiery crimson orbs, nearly white in hue, materialized right in front of him, barely a meter away.
unit.target: Antequam finire posset, orbes rubri flammei, paene albi colore, statim ante eum apparuerunt, vix uno metro distantibus.

unit.source: They surrounded him in a blaze.
unit.target: Eum circumdederunt igni ferventi.

unit.source: Almost instantly, Lumian felt as though he’d been ripped from reality.
unit.target: Fere statim, Lumian sensit quasi ex realitate eriperetur.

unit.source: The carriage disappeared from beneath him, the ground vanished from his sight, and he found himself in an endless void of darkness.
unit.target: Currus a sub eo evanuit, terra ex conspectu eius evanuit, atque se in vacuo interminabili tenebrarum invenit.

unit.source: The crimson fireballs, almost white, were controlled by an unseen force and changed direction, hurtling down from their original path.
unit.target: Globuli rubri ignis, paene albi, a vi invisibili moderabantur et cursum mutaverunt, e via originaria praecipitant.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: They collided with the roadside dozens of meters away, carving deep, massive craters.
unit.target: Collisuerunt cum latere viae, decem metris procul, crateres profundos et ingentes secantes.

unit.source: The horses, startled, reared up, neighing in terror.
unit.target: Equi, turbati, surrexerunt et in timore hinnientes.

unit.source: The carriage driver instinctively pulled at the reins, struggling to calm the panicked animals.
unit.target: Aurīgus currus instinctu funibus traiecit, animalia perturbata sedare conans.

unit.source: The “illusion” Lumian experienced dissolved with the explosion.
unit.target: Illusio quam Lumian experiebatur, cum explosione dissoluta est.

unit.source: He saw Juan Oro and the lad again.
unit.target: Iterum Iuanum Oro et puerum conspexit.

unit.source: Juan Oro, deeply wrinkled with his beard and hair standing on end, lifted his black cane and growled in a low voice, “Have you had enough?”
unit.target: Iuanus Oro, barba profunda rugosa et capillis erectis, baculum nigrum attollens, voce gravi increpavit: “Satisne habes?”

unit.source: Lumian grinned and raised his revolver once more, aiming it at the president of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Lumian subridens revolverum iterum elevavit, ad praesidem Gildis Piscandi intendens.

unit.source: At that moment, Rubió Paco’s voice echoed from the rear carriage.
unit.target: Illo momento, vox Rubió Paco ex parte posteriori currus resonavit.

unit.source: “Let them through,” he spoke in Intisian.
unit.target: “Transeant,” in Intisiana dixit.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian lower his arm and offer a smile in Intisian.
unit.target: Tum demum Lumian brachium deponens et in Intisiana subridens locutus est.

unit.source: “My employer says you’re free to pass.”
unit.target: “Dominus meus dicit te libere transeare.”

unit.source: He acted as if he couldn’t comprehend Juan Oro and the lad’s Highlander.
unit.target: Se gessit quasi linguam Highlander Iuan Oro et pueri comprehendere non posse.

unit.source: Juan Oro observed him for a moment before shifting his attention.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro eum paulisper observavit antequam attentionem suam verteret.

unit.source: Using his cane, he circled around to the side of the carriage.
unit.target: Baculo suo utens, ad latus currus circumivit.

unit.source: The lad supporting him shot a glare at Lumian, but he was at a loss for cuss words since Lumian couldn’t understand.
