unit.target: Puer, qui eum sustinebat, Luminum intuebatur, sed verba obscena invenire non poterat, quoniam Lumian non intellegebat.

unit.source: Juan Oro glanced at the window and calmly inquired, “Martha, I heard you’re not feeling well?”
unit.target: Iuanus Oro ad fenestram aspexit et tranquille inquit: “Martha, audivi te non bene esse?”

unit.source: “Yes,” the old lady weakly replied through the glass.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit vetula per vitrum debiliter.

unit.source: Juan Oro nodded.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro annuit.

unit.source: “Has the Governor given you permission to seek treatment? Do you need my help in pleading your case?”
unit.target: “Num Praefectus tibi licentiam dedit ut curationem quaeras? An auxilium meum in causa tua petenda opus est?”

unit.source: “He’s already given permission,” Rubió replied on behalf of his mother.
unit.target: “Iam concessum est,” Rubió pro matre sua respondit.

unit.source: “That’s good.” Juan Oro nodded slightly and didn’t press further.
unit.target: “Id bonum est.” Iuanus Oro leviter annuit et amplius non insistit.

unit.source: He turned and slowly walked toward the building housing the Governor of the Sea’s residence, using his cane as a crutch.
unit.target: Se convertit et lente ambulavit ad aedificium sedis Praefecti Maris, baculo suo uti scapula.

unit.source: The young man supporting him shot a final glare at Lumian before refocusing on the old man.
unit.target: Iuvenis, qui eum sustinebat, Luminum ultimam intuebatur, deinde ad senem rediit.

unit.source: Lumian adjusted his posture, acting as if nothing had transpired. He said to Lugano, “The carriage can continue forward.”
unit.target: Lumian se statim constituit, quasi nihil fuisset, et ad Lugano dixit: “Currus procedere potest.”

unit.source: Lugano snapped out of his daze and quickly directed the startled carriage driver to soothe the horses and exit Milo Village as soon as possible.
unit.target: Lugano ex stupore egressus est et celeriter aurīgum currus instruxit, ut equos sedaret et ex vico Milo quam primum exiret.

unit.source: Without any issues, they made their way back to 21 Saint Lana Street.
unit.target: Sine ulla difficultate, iter redierunt ad 21 Plateam Sanctae Lanae.

unit.source: Lumian retrieved Ludwig, his mouth still glistening with oil, from Giorgia and smiled at Rubió Paco.
unit.target: Lumian Ludwig, cuius os adhuc oleo nitidum lucebat, a Giorgia recepit et Rubió Paco subridens aspexit.

unit.source: “Remember your promise. Otherwise…”
unit.target: “Memento promissionis tuae. Aliter…”

unit.source: He smiled and left the statement hanging.
unit.target: Subridens, dictum in suspenso reliquit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry,” Rubió replied in Intisian.
unit.target: “Noli timere,” Rubió in Intisiana respondit.

unit.source: After Louis Berry, his godson, and the interpreter departed, Giorgia sighed in relief and glanced at her husband.
unit.target: Postquam Louis Berry, filius spiritualis eius, et interpretus discesserunt, Giorgia leviter suspiravit et ad maritum suum aspexit.

unit.source: “I’ve never seen a child eat so much. He must be abnormal!”
unit.target: “Numquam vidi puerum tam multum edentem. Extra ordinem esse debet!”

unit.source: “Otherwise, Louis Berry wouldn’t have let him stay with us so easily,” Rubió responded, unfazed.
unit.target: “Aliter, Louis Berry eum non sineret tam facile nobiscum manere,” Rubió respondit, impassibilis.

unit.source: Aquina Street, Solow Motel.
unit.target: Via Aquina, Solow Motel.

unit.source: After shutting the door, Lugano couldn’t resist asking Lumian, “W-why were you so aggressive? He’s the president of the Port Santa Fisheries Guild, a big shot. And, we’re in Milo Village!”
unit.target: Postquam ostium clausit, Lugano non potuit se continere rogare Luminum: “Cur tam impetuosus fuisti? Ipse praeses Gildis Piscandi Portus Sanctae est, vir magnus. Et nos in vico Milo sumus!”

unit.source: He suspected his employer had some hidden agenda.
unit.target: Suspicabat dominum suum aliquod occultum propositum habere.

unit.source: Lumian gave his guide a glance and grinned.
unit.target: Lumian ducem aspexit et subridens fēcit.

unit.source: “Why else? When making a scene in public, it’s unlikely both parties can go all out. It’s the perfect chance to test them, see what they’re made of. Trying it under the cover of night, when no one cares about the Earth Mother Church’s authority and the Feynapotter government? That would be way too risky.”
unit.target: “Cur aliter? Cum in publico scaenam fingis, vix utrumque totum se dare potest. Occasio perfecta est eos probandi, quid sint facti. Conari hoc sub tegmine noctis, cum nemo de auctoritate Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et regimine Feynapotter curat? Id nimis periculosum esset.”

unit.source: If Lumian had discovered that Juan Oro had godlike powers, he’d need to act quickly and call for backup!
unit.target: Si Lumian detexit Iuanum Oro divinam potentiam habere, celeriter agere et subsidium vocare debuisset!

unit.source: “Ah, I see…” Lugano had an epiphany.
unit.target: “Ah, intelligo…” inquit Lugano, habens epiphania.

unit.source: His employer’s craziness was just a facade. Every radical move had an ulterior motive!
unit.target: Follia domini eius merum simulacrum erat. Omnis motus radicalis causam ulterioris habebat!

unit.source: But why is he in Port Santa? Is he planning something during the sea prayer ritual? Why target people from the Fisheries Guild?
unit.target: Sed cur in Portu Sancta est? Num quid in ritu precationis maris parat? Cur homines ex Gilde Piscandi petere conatur?

unit.source: That sounds very dangerous!
unit.target: Id valde periculosum sonat!

unit.source: Should I resign early and forget about the remaining paycheck?
unit.target: Num ante tempus dimittere et reliquam mercedem obliviscere debeam?

unit.source: Lumian observed the silent interpreter and strolled over to a reclining chair in the living room, settling in with a smile. He leaned back and relaxed.
unit.target: Lumian interpreter silentem observavit et ad sellam reclinabilem in conclavi se contulit, subridens. Se recubavit et quietus est.

unit.source: What he’d told Lugano was just one layer of the motivations behind his recent actions—the most surface-level one.
unit.target: Id quod Luminum Lungano dixerat, erat solum unum stratum motivationum actionum recentium eius — maxime superficiale.

unit.source: Most importantly, Lumian aimed to send a clear message with his radical actions:
unit.target: Maxime, Lumian intendebat nuntium perspicuum per actus radicales suos transmitti:

unit.source: He was in Port Santa to investigate the sea prayer ritual, unafraid of the Fisheries Guild or Milo Village. He possessed the strength and courage to back it up!
unit.target: Ipse in Portu Sancta erat ut ritum precationis maris indagaret, nec Gildem Piscandi nec Vicum Milo timebat; fortitudinem et audaciam ad id confirmandum habebat!

unit.source: Breaking into the Governor of the Sea’s residence or casually pointing a gun at Juan Oro’s head and firing—all of it was to convey this information.
unit.target: Intrandi sedem Praefecti Maris aut leviter ad caput Iuanum Oro sclopetum intendere atque ignem emittere — omnia ad hanc informationem tradendam erant.

unit.source: Lumian believed there were dissatisfied people in Port Santa regarding the Fisheries Guild’s sea prayer ritual. After all, the primary beneficiaries were fishermen, sea merchants, and those in related industries, not representative of the entire Port Santa population.
unit.target: Lumian credidit in Portu Sancta homines esse dissidentes de ritu precationis maris Gildis Piscandi; nam principales beneficiarii erant piscatores, mercatores maris, et alii in industriis connexis, qui totum populum Portus Sanctae non repraesentabant.

unit.source: For instance, even though the Church of Earth Mother and the Port Santa government had allowed the Fisheries Guild autonomy and excluded outsiders from involvement, someone bold enough to investigate, regardless of consequences, might tempt others. Could they silently or even covertly support this person to stir up trouble for their benefit?
unit.target: Exempli causa, quamquam Ecclesia Matris Terrae et gubernatio Portus Sanctae Gildem Piscandi autonomiam concesserunt et externos a participatione excluserunt, aliquis audax ad investigandum, consequentias non curans, alios fortasse concitare posset. Possentne tacite aut etiam occulte hunc hominem sustinere ad tumultum pro suo commoditate excitandum?

unit.source: Likewise, the beneficiaries wouldn’t be united. Some gaining meant others losing; the powerful had jealous rivals. While not wanting the sea prayer ritual to end, they likely desired those in power to suffer and vacate their positions.
unit.target: Similiter, beneficiarii non erant unitate. Quidam lucrabant, alii amittebantur; potentes invidiosi rivales habebant. Neque volentes ritum precationis maris finiri, verisimiliter optabant ut potentes pati et munera sua relinquere.

unit.source: Lumian, by setting up a flag to investigate the sea prayer ritual and displaying decisiveness, steadfastness, and strength, didn’t need to painstakingly gather clues. From his residence, he could receive various pieces of information, openly and covertly, and compare them to determine authenticity.
unit.target: Lumian, vexillum ponens ad ritum precationis maris investigandum et decisionem, constantiam, ac fortitudinem ostendens, non necesse habebat accuratissime indicia colligere. Ex domo sua varias informationes, sive patentiter sive occulte, accipere et comparare poterat ut authenticitatem determinaret.

unit.source: For an outsider with limited time, this was the fastest and most effective way to uncover the entire sea prayer ritual process and the truth about last year’s accident.
unit.target: Pro extraneo cum tempore limitato, haec erat via celerrima et efficacissima ad totum processum ritus precationis maris et veritatem de casu anni praeteriti detegendum.

unit.source: For the key member of April Fool’s lurking in the shadows, possibly setting a trap, this was a strategic move to draw attention to adventurer Louis Berry and raise suspicion.
unit.target: Pro membro clavem Aprilis Stultorum, qui in umbris insidet, fortasse insidias parans, haec consilium erat strategicum ad adventatorem Louis Berry attrahendum et suspicionem excitandam.

unit.source: In due time, armed with the acquired information and discovered clues, Lumian had a chance to expose them through their own trap.
unit.target: Tempore debito, cum informationes adeptas atque indicia detecta haberet, Lumian occasionem habuit eos per suas insidias revelare.

unit.source: Of course, the main drawback of this plan was its relative danger. Putting himself in the spotlight was a risk, but in the pursuit of prey, risks were inevitable. Moreover, Lumian had plenty of allies.
unit.target: Certe, principalis defectus huius consilii erat periculum eius relativum. Se in lucem poni periculum erat, sed in praedandi conatu pericula ineluctabilia erant. Praeterea, Lumian multos socios habebat.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind, he realized that becoming a Conspirer had given him a clearer understanding of the situation and the conflicts between various groups. Using a term favored by Aurore, he developed a deeper insight into conspiracies: “The most brilliant conspiracy is an open conspiracy!”
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per Luminum mentem percurrebant, intellexit quod conspiratorem fieri ei clariorem intellectum de re et conflictibus inter diversos coetus dederit. Verbum a Aurore amatum adhibens, perceptionem profundam de coniurationibus evolvit: “Optima coniuratio est coniuratio aperta!”

unit.source: This became a key principle for his future acting.
unit.target: Hoc factum est principium cardinalem pro futuris eius actibus.

unit.source: Around 2 p.m., Lumian spotted his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, emerging from the void and handing him a letter.
unit.target: Circiter hora secunda post meridiem, Lumian nuntium suum, Penitentem Baynfel, ex vacuo emergentem et ei epistulam tradentem, conspexit.

unit.source: Puzzled, he asked, “Who’s it from?”
unit.target: Perplexus, rogavit: “A quo haec sunt?”

unit.source: Haven’t those he needed to communicate with already been reached?
unit.target: Num non iam contigi sunt, cum quibus communicare debebat?

unit.source: “It’s from the tall Demoness,” Baynfel replied.
unit.target: “Ex alta Demonissa,” respondit Baynfel.

unit.source: What’s up with Franca again? Lumian took the letter and began reading.
unit.target: “Quid iterum cum Franca?” Lumian epistulam accepit et legere incepit.

unit.source: The man she and Jenna encountered on the fourth level of the catacombs is suspected to be from the world where the Celestial Master resides—the world before her transmigration?
unit.target: Vir, quem illa et Jenna in plano quarto catacumbarum invenerunt, suspicatur ex mundo esse, ubi Magister Caelestis habitat—mundo ante eius transmigrationem?

unit.source: Lumian’s pupils dilated slightly.
unit.target: Pupillae Luminum paulo dilatatae sunt.

unit.source: This was different from the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society; they had transmigrated through their souls, but these individuals had brought their bodies over!
unit.target: Hoc differebat a membris Societatis Investigandae Simiorum Crispis Capillis; illi per animas suas transmigraverunt, sed hi corpora sua attulerunt!

unit.source: In the midst of his surprise, Lumian pondered a crucial question.
unit.target: In medio stuporis sui, Lumian quaestionem crucem meditatus est.

unit.source: Why would someone like that venture into the fourth level of the catacombs?
unit.target: Cur aliquis talis in planum quartum catacumbarum ingredi ausus esset?

unit.source: Was it because the Samaritan Women’s Spring lay sealed there, along with the River Styx’s overflowing water that bridged the two worlds?
unit.target: Num quia fons Feminarum Samaritanarum ibi clausus iacebat, una cum aqua exuberante fluminis Styxi, quae duos mundos coniungebat?

unit.source: Had similar individuals entered our world before? If so, why hadn’t they left any trace like Emperor Roselle and the other transmigrators?
unit.target: Num similes homines ante in nostrum mundum intraverunt? Si ita, cur nullum vestigium reliquerunt, ut Imperator Roselle et ceteri transmigratores?

unit.source: Franca and Jenna’s expedition to the fourth level of the catacombs appears laden with coincidences. Not only did they uncover a new Mirror World Fragment, but they also encountered such a person.
unit.target: Expeditio Francae et Jennae ad planum quartum catacumbarum coincidibus plena videtur. Non solum novum Fragmentum Mundi Specularis detexerunt, sed etiam talem hominem convenere.

unit.source: After penning a letter to Franca, Lumian was about to request Lugano to translate today’s newspapers when footsteps echoed from the corridor.
unit.target: Postquam epistulam Francae scripsit, Lumian paulo petere parabat, ut Lugano diurnos hodiernos transferret, cum vestigia pedum ex corridorio resonarent.

unit.source: His eyebrows twitched as he pulled up an armchair, facing the door.
unit.target: Supercilia eius convulsa erant, dum sellam levabat, ad ostium spectans.

unit.source: Knock, knock, knock. A few seconds later, a knock resounded on their suite’s door.
unit.target: Toc, toc, toc. Post paucas secundas, pulsus in ianuam conclavis eorum resonavit.

unit.source: “Who is it?” Lugano inquired.
unit.target: “Quis est?” inquit Lugano.

unit.source: A mature and gentle voice floated from beyond the door.
unit.target: Vox matura et mitis e trans ianuam effluens audiebatur.

unit.source: “I’m Noelia of the Fertility Order.”
unit.target: “Ego sum Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis.”

unit.source: Upon hearing this name, Lumian leaned back slightly and offered a smile.
unit.target: Audito hoc nomine, Lumian paulum se recubavit et subridens ostendit.

unit.source: He sensed that his digestion of the Conspirer potion had progressed a bit further.
unit.target: Sensit digestionem potionis Conspiratoris paulum longius processisse.

unit.source: 550 Effects of the Sea Prayer Ritual
unit.target: 550 Effectūs Ritūāli Maris Precātiōnis

unit.source: 550 Effects of the Sea Prayer Ritual
unit.target: 550 Effectūs Ritūāli Maris Precātiōnis

unit.source: Lumian hesitated, embodying the character of the adventurer—Louis Berry—
unit.target: Lumian haesitavit, personam audācentis exploratoris —Louis Berry— incarnans.

unit.source: grappling with the unfamiliarity of Highlander.
unit.target: Luctans cum alienitate Highlanderis.

unit.source: Once Lugano finished translating Noelia’s words, he nodded gently, sporting a welcoming smile as he spoke in Intisian, “Come in, please.”
unit.target: Postquam Lugano verba Noeliae interpretatus est, leniter annuit, vultu amabili subridente, dum in lingua Intisiana loquebatur: “Intrā, quaeso.”

unit.source: Simultaneously, he rose from his seat.
unit.target: Simul ex sede surrexit.

unit.source: Lugano, who had already reached the door, opened it.
unit.target: Lugano, qui iam ad ianuam pervenerat, eam aperuit.

unit.source: The figure outside indeed proved to be Noelia, the combat nun of the Fertility Order.
unit.target: Figura foris vere Noelia erat, monialis pugnatrix Ordinis Fertilitatis.

unit.source: Contrary to expectation, she wasn’t cloaked in black or adorned with religious headwear.
unit.target: Contrā exspectationem, neque in veste nigra involuta erat neque habitu religioso ornata.

unit.source: Her thick, black, curly hair flowed over her brown leather armor, and her lively light-blue eyes exuded energy.
unit.target: Crines eius densi, nigri et crispati super loricam ex corio fusco factam fluēbant, et oculi eius vividi caerulei energiam efferebant.

unit.source: Lumian noticed the pair of straight swords strapped to Noelia’s back and the revolver at her waist.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit par gladierum rectorum, alligatorum in tergo Noeliae, atque revolverum ad latus eius.

unit.source: Smiling, he stepped forward.
unit.target: Subridens accessit.

unit.source: “Thank you for your assistance.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago pro auxilio tuo.”

unit.source: Previously dependent on Lugano’s translation, Noelia replied in Intisian, “How did you know I was here to help?”
unit.target: Praevia translatione Lugani innixa, Noelia in Intisiana respondit: “Quomodo scivisti me huc venisse ut auxilium ferrem?”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t conceal his intentions for today’s performance.
unit.target: Lumian consilia sua pro hodierna representatione non celavit.

unit.source: He raised his hand, pointing at his head, indicating deduction.
unit.target: Manum levavit, ad caput suum indicans, deductionem exprimens.

unit.source: Of course, his gratitude stemmed from her aid in digesting the Conspirer potion.
unit.target: Certe, eius gratitudo ex auxilio ejus ad potionem Conspiratoris digestam oriri videbatur.

unit.source: Noelia’s thick eyebrows twitched approvingly as she nodded.
unit.target: Supercilia Noeliae densa approbante motu tremuerunt, dum illa annuit.

unit.source: Then, she turned her gaze to Lugano and Ludwig, as if seeking Lumian’s opinion on whether to have them leave.
unit.target: Deinde, oculos suos ad Lugano et Ludwigum vertit, quasi sententiam Lumiani de eorum discessu quaerens.

unit.source: Lugano’s expression made it clear he preferred not to be part of it.
unit.target: Vultus Lugani clare ostendebat se non velle participare.

unit.source: Sparing Lugano, Lumian gestured for him to take Ludwig outside, perhaps for street snacks.
unit.target: Lugano parcens, Lumian ei signavit ut Ludovicum extra duceret, fortasse ad edulia viaria.

unit.source: After the two departed the suite, Lumian remarked to Noelia, “You actually know Intisian. You didn’t say a word of it earlier.”
unit.target: Postquam duo conclave reliquerunt, Lumian Noeliae edixit: “Revera linguam Intisiana nosti; neque unum verbum antea dixeris.”

unit.source: Noelia replied with a smile, “We often take turns guarding the mountain passes in the southern foothills of the Pyraez mountain range.”
unit.target: Noelia subridente respondit: “Saepe vicissim custodimus transitūs montium in collibus australis Pyraez.”

unit.source: The Pyraez range, termed by the Feynapotter Kingdom, referred to the Dariège mountain range.
unit.target: Catena montium Pyraez, a Regno Feynapotter dicta, ad montes Dariège pertinebat.

unit.source: Shepherds frequently traversed it, entering the plains and pastures of Gaia and other provinces.
unit.target: Pastores eam frequenter transierunt, ingrediens planities et prata Gaiae aliarumque provinciarum.

unit.source: Without awaiting Lumian’s further inquiry, Noelia tucked her hair behind her ear and grinned.
unit.target: Non exspectans ulteriorem interrogationem Lumiani, Noelia crines suos post auriculam condidit et subridens risit.

unit.source: “It’s impolite to have a lady standing and chatting with you.”
unit.target: “Non est urbanum, mulierem stantem tecum colloquens esse.”

unit.source: Only then did Lumian invite Noelia to sit on the divan while he chose the armchair.
unit.target: Tum demum Lumian Noeliam invitavit ut in divano consederet, dum ipse in sellā brācchiāta sedebat.

unit.source: Noelia gazed at him and continued, “Port Santa’s sea prayer ritual dates back to the late Fourth Epoch.
unit.target: Noelia eum intuebatur et continuavit: “Rituale maris precationis Portus Santae a proximo fine Quartae Aetatis originem habet.

unit.source: It’s over a thousand years old and can be considered ancient.
unit.target: Plus quam mille annos habet et antiqua esse habetur.

unit.source: The Church once purged it, relocating all relevant insiders and purifying all participants.
unit.target: Ecclesia olim id purgavit, internos pertinentes transferens et omnes participantes purificans.

unit.source: However, less than a hundred years later, someone here began secretly conducting the sea prayer ritual again.”
unit.target: Sed minus centum annos post, aliquis hic arcane rituale maris precationis iterum exsequi coepit.

unit.source: She didn’t explain why she shared this history; it seemed like she was merely recounting.
unit.target: Non explicavit cur hanc historiam narrasset; videbatur eam tantummodo referre.

unit.source: “They didn’t continue purging it afterward?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: “Num postea illud purgare non perseveraverunt?” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Noelia pursed her red lips and replied with a solemn expression, “In this matter, the brass’s orders are often contradictory.
unit.target: Noelia labra rubra contraxit et respondit, vultu solenne: “In hoc negotio, mandata a praefectis saepe sunt contradictoria.

unit.source: Sometimes, they let our Fertility Order handle it; other times, they signal us to observe for a while.
unit.target: Aliquando sinunt Ordinem Fertilitatis nostrum rem gerere; alias nobis signum dant ut paulisper observemus.

unit.source: All of this has been permitted by a second-in-command Blessed.”
unit.target: Haec omnia concessa sunt a secundo praefecto Beatō.

unit.source: Lumian, drawing knowledge from Madam Magician, the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, and other sources, had come to understand that the Earth Mother Church operated on two major systems: Favored and Blessed.
unit.target: Lumian, ex doctrina Dominae Magicae, Societatis Inquisitionis Simiae Crispatae, et ex aliis fontibus, intellexit Ecclesiam Matris Terrae in duobus ordinibus principalibus operari: Favored et Blessed.

unit.source: Favored referred to Beyonders of the Earth and Moon pathways among clergymen.
unit.target: ‘Favored’ erat appellatio ad eos, qui per vias Terrae et Lunæ inter clericos ambulabant.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Blessed encompassed Beyonders of other pathways favored by the Earth Mother.
unit.target: Interim, ‘Blessed’ comprehendebat eos, qui per alias semitas ab Matre Terra fovēbantur.

unit.source: Orders from a Favored required at least one second-in-command Blessed to be valid.
unit.target: Mandata a ‘Favored’ requirebant saltem unum sub praefectum ‘Blessed’ ad valida esse.

unit.source: Without this, they risked being considered products of the influence of evil gods and demons.
unit.target: Sine hoc, periclitabantur ut putarentur effectus influentiae deorum malignorum et daemonum.

unit.source: Lumian found the Earth Mother Church’s intricate system perplexing, seemingly designed to guard against the Favored.
unit.target: Lumian systema intricatum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae perplexum invenit, quasi destinatum ad contra ‘Favored’ tegendum.

unit.source: Nevertheless, he believed that there must be a reason behind such complexity.
unit.target: Tamen credidit rationem hujus complexitatis exsistere oportere.

unit.source: Having undergone numerous experiences, he became increasingly aware that seemingly inconspicuous rules in the mystical world often held lessons etched in blood.
unit.target: Experientiis multis affectus, paulatim intellexit regulae in mundo mystico, quamquam vix conspicuae, saepe lectiones sanguine insculptas continere.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian inquired, “Are you a Favored or a Blessed?”
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, Lumian quaesivit: “Esne Favored an Blessed?”

unit.source: “I’m a Blessed,” Noelia replied without delving into the specifics of her pathway.
unit.target: “Ego sum Blessed,” respondit Noelia, nec in singulis semitibus viae sui intravit.

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly, indicating for her to continue.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit, indicans ei ut perseueraret.

unit.source: Noelia smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Noelia subridens suspiravit.

unit.source: “After a long period of repetition, we eventually reached an unspoken agreement to allow the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: “Post longum tempus repetitionis, tandem tacita consentientia attigimus, ut rituale maris precationis concederetur.

unit.source: At the very least, it brought prosperity to Port Santa without causing social chaos or significant disruptions beyond the participants.
unit.target: Saltem, prosperitatem Portus Santae afferebat, nec tumultum sociale aut perturbationes notabiles extra participantes causans.

unit.source: That decision was made ages ago, and while ancient dossiers provide a rough understanding, the exact reasons convincing matriarchs, presidents, and archbishops remain elusive.
unit.target: Decisio illa abhinc facienda fuit, et quamquam antiquae tabulae rationem approximatam praebent, causae exactae, quae matriarcas, praesides et archiepiscopos convicerent, adhuc incertae manent.

unit.source: Essentially, the sea prayer ritual has evolved into a traditional folklore in Port Santa, fostering prosperity in maritime trade and fisheries.”
unit.target: Essentialiter, rituale maris precationis in popularem traditionem in Portu Santa evolutum est, prosperitatem in mercatura maritima et piscatione fovens.

unit.source: Crossing her arms over her chest, Noelia intoned with piety, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace.”
unit.target: Brachia in pectore transfigurans, Noelia pietose inlitteravit: “Pretiosus amplexus vitae, gratia messis.”

unit.source: Lumian, intrigued, narrowed his eyes and inquired, “Why did you change the prayer gesture?”
unit.target: Lumian, studiosus, oculos contraxit et quaesivit: “Cur gestum precationis mutavisti?”

unit.source: Is there a problem?
unit.target: Estne quaestio?

unit.source: Noelia opened her eyes and grinned.
unit.target: Noelia oculos aperuit et subridens risit.

unit.source: “This was a gesture frequently used in the past, but as Earth Mother regained some lost authority, we adopted a new posture for formal occasions.”
unit.target: “Hic gestus olim saepe adhibitus fuit, sed cum Mater Terrae aliquam auctoritatem recuperavit, novam habitum ad occasiones formales sumpsimus.”

unit.source: She rose, positioning her legs slightly apart, hands raised high, and passionately explained to Louis Berry as if preaching.
unit.target: Surgens, crura paulum separata, manibus alte levatis, ardenter ad Ludovicum Berry quasi praedicans explanavit.

unit.source: “The feet connect to the benevolent earth, and the palms reach towards the spiritual sky.
unit.target: “Pedes ad terram benevolentem coniunguntur, et palmae ad caelum spirituale tendunt,

unit.source: In the middle resides the light of life.
unit.target: in medio habitat lumen vitae.

unit.source: This is the domain of the Mother of All Things.”
unit.target: “Hoc est regnum Matris Omnium Rerum.”

unit.source: One can regain some of Their lost authority? Lumian was puzzled, but that wasn’t the focal point.
unit.target: Possit aliquanta auctoritas amissa recuperari? Lumian stupefactus erat, sed id non erat punctum principale.

unit.source: Noelia settled back into her seat and continued, “While we haven’t deciphered the core process of the sea prayer ritual, years of surveillance have yielded some insights.”
unit.target: Noelia in suam sedem revertit et continuavit: “Cum processum cardinalem rituālis maris precationis nondum enodaverimus, anni vigilantiae nonnulla indicia profecerunt.”

unit.source: “The Governor of the Sea, who successfully gains the sea’s favor, wields the power to control this stretch of the sea, preventing shipwrecks.
unit.target: “Praefectus Maris, qui favorem maris efficaciter adipiscitur, potestatem habet hanc partem maris regere, naufragia prohibens,

unit.source: However, this seemingly comes at the cost of their lives and something more.
unit.target: sed hoc, ut videtur, eorum vitam atque aliquid additum exigit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the ritual triggers rapid reproduction and thriving life in the area, ensuring fishermen a bountiful harvest.
unit.target: Simul, ritus celerem reproductionem et vitam vigentem in regione incitat, piscatoribus metum copiosum praebens.

unit.source: It also intertwines with fate; families with Maidens of the Sea in their lineage tend to experience good fortune, not just due to preferential treatment.”
unit.target: Etiam cum fato connexus est; familiae, in quibus in stirpe Mulieres Maris sunt, bonae fortunæ occurrere solent, non tantum ob favorem specialem.

unit.source: The sea prayer ritual’s effects are intricate, wielding the power of the sea domain and influencing fate, reproduction, and abundance…
unit.target: Effectūs rituālis maris precationis intricati sunt, potentiam dominii maris habentes et fatum, reproductionem, atque abundantiam afficientes…

unit.source: Lumian struggled to grasp the reasons behind these occurrences.
unit.target: Lumian conatus est ut rationes harum eventuum caperet.

unit.source: Noelia peered into Lumian’s face, her eyes bright yet gentle, and said, “The committee members of the Fisheries Guild, some villagers from Milo Village, and participants in the core process of the sea prayer ritual have all acquired mystical powers.
unit.target: Noelia in faciem Lumiani intuebatur, oculis suis lucidis sed mansuets, et dixit: “Membri commissionis Guildae Piscariorum, quidam incolae ex vico Milo, atque participantes in processu cardinali rituālis maris precationis omnes vires mysticas adepti sunt.

unit.source: We once confronted the little devils you encountered.
unit.target: Olim adversati sumus parvis diabolis quos invenisti.

unit.source: When pursuing certain criminals, we discovered them transformed into lizard-like monsters.”
unit.target: Dum certos sceleratos persequentes essemus, eos invenimus in monstra lacertiformia transformatos.

unit.source: Humanoid lizards? Similar to the Paco family’s? Lumian hadn’t anticipated obtaining any clues from Noelia.
unit.target: Lacertae humanoides? Similes familiae Paco? Lumian non speraverat ullas indicia a Noelia consequiturum esse.

unit.source: Noelia smiled.
unit.target: Noelia subridet.

unit.source: “Later, we found a commonality among those who can transform into lizard-
unit.target: “Postea, invenimus similitudinem inter eos, qui in lacertas —

unit.source: like monsters.”
unit.target: similia monstris.”

unit.source: “What is it?” Lumian couldn’t conceal his curiosity.
unit.target: “Quid est?” Lumian curiositatem celare non potuit.

unit.source: Noelia replied with a faint smile, “Their mothers were once Maidens of the Sea.”
unit.target: Noelia leniter subridente respondit: “Matres eorum olim Mulieres Maris erant.”

unit.source: Maidens of the Sea’s children? Child of the Sea? Which of Rubió’s siblings did I kill? Not only did he transform into a humanoid lizard, but he also went mad and severely injured his mother? Lumian swiftly connected the dots, sensing he had grasped the essence of the Paco family’s commission.
unit.target: Filia Mulierum Maris? Proles Maris? Quorum ex Rubió sororibus aut fratribus interfeci? Non solum in lacertam humanoidem transformatus est, sed etiam insanus factus est et matrem suam graviter laesit? Lumian celeriter nexus connexit, intuens se essentiam mandati familiae Paco comprehensum esse.

unit.source: Yet, confusion crept in.
unit.target: At confusio insidiā orta est.

unit.source: If this information is known to families with Maidens of the Sea, why would the Paco family conceal it from Juan Oro and other committee members in the Fisheries Guild?
unit.target: Si haec notitia nota est familiis, in quibus Mulieres Maris adsunt, cur familia Paco ab Juan Oro aliisque membris commissionis Guildae Piscariorum celaret?

unit.source: Noelia didn’t seek his thoughts and teased, “After confirming the link between the lizard-like monsters and the sea prayer ritual, we intentionally alerted the Fisheries Guild committee members.
unit.target: Noelia non quaesivit eius sententias et iactavit: “Postquam nexum inter monstra lacertiformia et rituale maris precationis confirmavimus, membris commissionis Guildae Piscariorum conscie nos admonuimus.

unit.source: Since then, no such criminals have surfaced.
unit.target: Ex tunc, nulli tam scelerati apparuerunt.

unit.source: They show discipline and restraint.
unit.target: Eos disciplina et temperantia ostendunt.

unit.source: This is why, at times, I understand why the brass tacitly permit the sea prayer ritual in Port Santa.
unit.target: Idcirco, aliquando, intellego cur duces tacite rituale maris precationis in Portus Santae permittant.

unit.source: The participants are more obedient and easily controlled compared to adventurers like you.”
unit.target: Participantēs magis oboedi sunt et facile moderantur, comparati ad adventores similes tibi.

unit.source: Noelia implied: “I just advised you to stay away from the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Noelia insinuavit: “Modo tibi suasi ut a Guildā Piscariorum abstineres.

unit.source: Yet, the next day, you stormed into the Governor of the Sea’s residence, pointing a gun at Juan Oro’s head.
unit.target: At tamen, die sequenti, in domum Praefectī Maris irruit, sclopeton ad caput Juan Oro intendens.

unit.source: That’s much more troublesome than those involved with the sea prayer ritual!”
unit.target: Id multo magis molestum est quam illi, qui rituale maris precationis implicati sunt!

unit.source: Lumian smiled, choosing not to comment.
unit.target: Lumian subridit, decernens non commentari.

unit.source: Noelia pondered for a moment, locking eyes with him.
unit.target: Noelia paulum meditata est, oculos cum eo iungens.

unit.source: “I’m not sure why you’re investigating the sea prayer ritual, and I don’t want to know.
unit.target: “Nescio quare rituale maris precationis investiges, nec cupio scire.

unit.source: What I can say is, if your actions endanger all of Port Santa, we will step in and expel you.
unit.target: Quod dicere possum est: si acta tua totum Portum Santa in periculum adducunt, interveniemus et te expellemus.

unit.source: With that condition, we might offer some assistance.”
unit.target: Hoc praesupposito, fortasse aliquod auxilium praebere possumus.

unit.source: Lumian picked up the straw hat beside him and pressed it against his chest.
unit.target: Lumian petasum stramineum iuxta se levavit et ad pectus suum appressit.

unit.source: “It would be an honor.”
unit.target: “Honos esset.”

unit.source: Noelia left the Earth Mother Church’s objectives in this matter unspoken, and Lumian chose not to delve into it.
unit.target: Noelia de propositis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in hoc negotio non enuntiavit, et Lumian deliberare noluit.

unit.source: The combat nun of the Fertility Order rose, making her way toward the door.
unit.target: Monialis pugnatrix Ordinis Fertilitatis surrexit, ad ianuam properans.

unit.source: With her left hand on the handle, she abruptly turned around, her eyes sparkling as she asked with a smile, “Do you want to have a child here?”
unit.target: Manu sinistra in manubrio posita, subito versa est, oculis micantibus, et subridens quaesivit: “Visne hic infans habere?”

unit.source: Lumian was taken aback.
unit.target: Lumian obstupefactus est.

unit.source: “Madame, aren’t you changing the subject too quickly?”
unit.target: “Domina, num rem nimis citissime mutas?”

unit.source: Noelia’s eyes held a maternal glint as she said with pity, “According to our assessment, the sea prayer ritual is at least as dangerous as a Saint or a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact when fully utilized for a short period.
unit.target: Oculi Noeliae, maternum scintillam gerentes, dixerunt: “Secundum iudicium nostrum, rituale maris precationis saltem tam periculosum est quam Sanctus vel Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus I, cum ad breve tempus plene adhibetur.

unit.source: I don’t know what you’re up to, but once you’re involved in this matter, you can’t escape just because you want to.
unit.target: Nescio quid agas, sed quondam implicatus in hoc negotio, non poteris solum propter voluntatem tuam evadere.

unit.source: Before that, have you considered leaving a descendant for yourself?
unit.target: An prius contemplastī te ipsam posteritatem relinquere?

unit.source: I can help you.”
unit.target: Te adiuvare possum.

unit.source: Are your Earth Mother Church’s combat nuns way of inviting someone to a one‑night stand so special?
unit.target: Num vestrum modus monialium pugnacium Ecclesiae Matris Terrae aliquem ad unam noctem congressionem invitandi tam peculāris est?

unit.source: Lumian was momentarily speechless.
unit.target: Lumian momento mutus erat.

unit.source: Noelia spoke sincerely, “Descendants are the continuation of our lives.
unit.target: “Proles sunt continuatio vitārum nostrārum,” sincere voce Noelia dixit.

unit.source: Flowers wither and fall to the ground, only to bloom into a more brilliant scenery the next year.
unit.target: Flores marcescunt et in terram cadunt, ut post annum in scaenam clariorem renascant.

unit.source: Are you really not considering having a descendant?”
unit.target: Num vere non intentas posteritatem tibi generare?

unit.source: “Not for now,” Lumian replied with a cold expression.
unit.target: “Nunc non,” respondit Lumian vultu glaciali.

unit.source: Noelia expressed regret, “Whenever you think it through, come to me.”
unit.target: Noelia paenitentiam demonstravit: “Quotiescumque meditaveris, ad me veni.”

unit.source: With that, she opened the door and walked out.
unit.target: Hoc facto, ianuam aperuit et exiit.

unit.source: 551 Coming One After Another
unit.target: 551: Uno post alium venturi

unit.source: 551 Coming One After Another
unit.target: 551: Uno post alium venturi

unit.source: As Lumian observed Noelia disappearing down the corridor, he pondered the idea of adding another catchphrase: “You Feynapotterians.”
unit.target: Cum Lumian Noeliam in corrido evanescere aspexit, excogitavit addere dictum celebre: "Vos Feynapotteriani."

unit.source: Nevertheless, Noelia’s kindness served as a reminder that delving into the sea prayer ritual wasn’t a straightforward endeavor.
unit.target: Nihilominus, benignitas Noeliae admonitionem ferebat quod in ritum orationis maris penetrare non esset res simplex.

unit.source: The associated risks demanded the Church of Earth Mother’s serious consideration.
unit.target: Pericula consociata exigebant gravem considerationem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Despite this, Lumian believed that many dangers could be sidestepped, and he wasn’t inclined to actively confront them.
unit.target: Hac non obstante, Lumian credebat multa pericula vitari posse, nec se ad illora actuose oppugnanda inclinare.

unit.source: His primary objective wasn’t to unveil the truth behind the sea prayer ritual and eradicate the influence of folklore on Port Santa, preventing its inhabitants from transforming into monsters.
unit.target: Propositum principale eius non erat veritatem de ritu orationis maris detegere et vim fabularum in Portu Santa eradicare, ne incolae in monstra converterentur.

unit.source: His true goal lay in unraveling the details of the April Fool’s prank to track down Ultraman and Bard, executing them one by one.
unit.target: Verus autem finem eius constituit detegere subtilitates ludicri Aprilis ut Ultraman et Bard deprehenderet atque eos singillatim interfeceret.

unit.source: With Port Santa plagued by numerous problems and abscesses, Lumian saw no need to expose them; he could withdraw in a timely manner.
unit.target: Cum Portu Santa multis difficultatibus et abscessibus vexaretur, Lumian non videbat necessitatem eos patefacere; sufficiebat ut tempore recederet.

unit.source: Concealing his true motives was a fundamental principle of acting as a Conspirer!
unit.target: Occultare veras causas suas erat praeceptum fundamentale agendi ut Conspirator!

unit.source: This could lead others to misinterpret his decisions and react incorrectly during critical moments.
unit.target: Hoc alios ad decisiones eius male interpretandas et in momentis criticis male agendum inducere poterat.

unit.source: After shutting the door, Lumian grabbed the golden straw hat and settled into the recliner.
unit.target: Postquam ostium clausit, Lumian cepit pileum stramineum aureum et in sellā reclinata consedit.

unit.source: Smirking at the corridor, he muttered to himself with interest, Who will be the next to provide information?
unit.target: Subridens ad corrido, se ipso cum studio submurmuravit: "Quis erit proximus informationem praebendus?"

unit.source: Rubió Paco, who clearly dislikes the Maidens of the Sea and detests such matters, or the families who have lost their positions as committee members of the Fisheries Guild for many years?
unit.target: Rubió Paco, qui manifeste puellas Maris oderit et talia detestatur, aut familias quae per multos annos munera membrorum Consilii Gildae Piscandi amiserunt?

unit.source: Beneath the bright sunlight outside the window, Lumian swiftly flipped through the textbooks he had purchased, hoping to memorize and grasp more relevant knowledge.
unit.target: Sub splendenti solis luce extra fenestram, Lumian celeriter pervolvit libros doctrinales quos emit, sperans plura notitiae utiles memoriter retinere ac intellegere.

unit.source: He couldn’t wait until the charms’ effects wore off, leaving nothing in his mind.
unit.target: Non poterat exspectare ut effectus incantamentorum evanuerent, nihil in mente reliquentes.

unit.source: About an hour later, unfamiliar footsteps echoed through the corridor.
unit.target: Circiter post unam horam, vestigia ignota per corrido resonaverunt.

unit.source: Knock, knock, knock.
unit.target: Tunc, tunc, tunc.

unit.source: Another knock resonated on his door.
unit.target: Aliud pulsus in ostio eius resonavit.

unit.source: “Who is it?” Lumian inquired in simple Highlander.
unit.target: “Quis est?” inquit Lumian in lingua simplici Highlander.

unit.source: “The book you bought has arrived,” the motel owner, Otta Guillaume, replied in Intisian.
unit.target: “Liber quem emis advenit,” respondit dominus moteli, Otta Guillaume, in Intisian.

unit.source: The book I bought?
unit.target: Liber quem emis?

unit.source: When have I ever bought a book?
unit.target: Quando librum umquam emi?

unit.source: Lumian pondered, standing up thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, surgens animo diligenter.

unit.source: He opened the door and received a cheaply packaged but colorful book from the old man.
unit.target: Ostium aperuit et accepit librum parvo pretio sarcinatum sed variegatum a senex.

unit.source: The title of the book was “Travel around Feynapotter.”
unit.target: Titulus libri erat "Iter per Feynapotter."

unit.source: Lumian pretended not to get the title written in Highlander and chuckled at himself.
unit.target: Lumian simulavit se non comprehendere titulum scriptum in lingua Highlander et de se ipsos subridens.

unit.source: “I’ll have to wait for my interpreter to swing back and decode it for me. Might not even wrap my head around it before I bid Feynapotter farewell by flipping through a dictionary.”
unit.target: "Exspectare mihi oportet interpretem meum redeuntem et id mihi enucleandum. Forte quidem ne prorsus intellegam id, antequam Feynapottere vale dicam per perlustrationem dictionarii."

unit.source: Otta Sr. expressed his understanding.
unit.target: Otta Senior suam intellegentiam exprimuit.

unit.source: “When I first landed in Port Santa, seven or eight mates shared an Intisian-Highlander dictionary.
unit.target: "Cum primum in Portu Santa adveni, septem vel octo sodales unum dictionarium Intisiano-Highlander communicaverunt.

unit.source: None of us dared to venture out solo.
unit.target: Nemo nostrorum ausus est solus egredi.

unit.source: But after hanging around a bit and pushing ourselves to chat with the locals, we gradually got the hang of it.
unit.target: Sed post aliquod tempus versantes et nos ad locutionem cum vernaculis impellentes, paulatim consuetudinem ei attiguimus.

unit.source: Truth be told, Highlander’s quite similar to Intisian.
unit.target: Re veritate, lingua Highlander valde similis est Intisianae.

unit.source: Lumian chatted briefly with Otta Sr. before heading back to his room, sinking into the recliner with “Travel around Feynapotter” in hand.
unit.target: Lumian breviter cum Otta Senior locutus est antequam ad cellam suam rediret, consedens in sellā reclinata cum "Iter per Feynapotter" in manu.

unit.source: He turned the book over, gripping its spine and giving it a shake.
unit.target: Librum vertit, costam eius arripiendo et eum concussit.

unit.source: A folded white paper tumbled out.
unit.target: Excidit charta alba plicata.

unit.source: Lumian caught it and flicked it open with a swift motion.
unit.target: Lumian eam cepit et celeriter aperuit.

unit.source: Written on it was Intisian:
unit.target: In ea in lingua Intisiana scripta erat:

unit.source: “The Maidens of the Sea are also not allowed to leave Port Santa or tie the knot with outsiders.
unit.target: "Puellae Maris nec Portu Santa discedere neque cum externis coniunctionem nuptialem inire licebit.

unit.source: But exceptions have cropped up over the years.
unit.target: Sed exceptiones per annos ortae sunt.

unit.source: “Feynapotter’s women dig romance before tying the knot and chase after love.
unit.target: Feminæ Feynapotter ante nuptias ducendas amorem quaerunt et eum persequuntur.

unit.source: The ladies of Port Santa are no different.
unit.target: Mulieres Portu Santa non differunt.

unit.source: Throughout the past millennium, plenty of Maidens of the Sea have bolted to preserve their love or freedom.
unit.target: Per millenium praeteritum, multae Puellae Maris fugerunt ut amorem aut libertatem suam servarent.

unit.source: Around 30 to 40 have made it out.
unit.target: Circiter triginta ad quadraginta effugerunt.

unit.source: The most recent case dates back over 20 years.
unit.target: Novissimus casus plus quam viginti annos retrorsum dat.

unit.source: A Maiden of the Sea married an Intisian and had a kid.
unit.target: Una Puella Maris nupta est cum Intisiano et prolem peperit.

unit.source: We’re unsure if she’s still alive because the Fisheries Guild has been hunting her down.
unit.target: Nescimus utrum illa adhuc viva sit, quia Gildae Piscandi eam venantur.

unit.source: Her child’s name is Nolfi.
unit.target: Prole eius Nolfi vocatur.

unit.source: You might know her.
unit.target: Forsitan eam nosti.

unit.source: She’s already back in Port Santa.
unit.target: Iam redivit in Portu Santa.

unit.source: Nolfi?
unit.target: Nolfi?

unit.source: Batna Comté’s lover?
unit.target: Batna Comté amator?

unit.source: She’s actually a child of a Maiden of the Sea.
unit.target: Ea revera proles Puellae Maris est.

unit.source: She even dragged her “partner” to Port Santa to witness the sea prayer ceremony…
unit.target: Etiam socium suum ad Portu Santa traxit ut caerimoniam orationis maris videret…

unit.source: Lumian sometimes felt something was off with Nolfi while on the Flying Bird, but he never guessed she was so tied up with the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Lumian aliquando sensit aliquid de Nolfi esse alienum dum in "Flying Bird" navigaret, sed numquam suspicatus est eam tam implicatam in ritu orationis maris esse.

unit.source: This made him wonder about Nolfi’s real reasons for returning to Port Santa.
unit.target: Hoc eum ad mirandum de veris causis Nolfi ad Portu Santa redire incivit.

unit.source: Batna Comté might find himself in a mind-boggling mess over this romantic fling.
unit.target: Batna Comté se in perplexa confusione ob hanc amorosam relationem versari posse reputare potest.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes shifted down as he read the last line.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani deorsum versati sunt, dum ultimam lineam legebat.

unit.source: “Once you’re out of these waters and Port Santa, the mystical powers from the sea prayer ritual weakens significantly.
unit.target: "Quoniam ex his aquis et Portu Santa exeas, vires mysticae ex ritu orationis maris notabiliter minuantur.

unit.source: Against folks from other regions, the Fisheries Guild mostly wrangles them using adventurers, bounty hunters, and professional assassins.”
unit.target: Contra homines e regionibus aliis, Gildae Piscandi plerumque eos retinent per adventarios, venatores praemiatos, et sicarios professos.

unit.source: Is this a go ahead to meddle with the sea prayer ritual and dig into it?
unit.target: Num hoc indicat ut in ritu orationis maris immiscear et eum perscrutem?

unit.source: As long as I could slip out of Port Santa and these waters, the Fisheries Guild’s committee members would be powerless against me?
unit.target: Dummodo ex Portu Santa et his aquis effugere possim, membri consilii Gildae Piscandi adversus me impotentes fient?

unit.source: Lumian had no clue about the identity of the person who delivered the paper and the intel.
unit.target: Lumian nesciebat quis esset qui chartam atque notitias attulerit.

unit.source: After all, he hadn’t seen many folks’ handwriting in Port Santa, but he could unmistakably sense their eagerness and anticipation.
unit.target: Postremo, non multum scripturam hominum in Portu Santa viderat, sed eorum ardorem ac exspectationem indubitanter sentire poterat.

unit.source: Crimson flames roared to life, consuming the white paper laden with information.
unit.target: Flammae coccineae in vitam fremuerunt, chartam albidam cum notitiis oneratam devorantes.

unit.source: Lumian reclined, sipping on Feynapotter Kingdom’s famed Manzan, the top-tier white wine produced in specific regions without dilution.
unit.target: Lumian recubuit, sorbillans Manzan celeberrimum Regni Feynapotter, optimum album vinum ex regionibus certis sine diluendo productum.

unit.source: He absentmindedly flipped through the book “Travel around Feynapotter” penned in Highlander.
unit.target: Mente levata, pervolvit librum "Iter per Feynapotter" in lingua Highlander scriptum.

unit.source: The author raved about Feynapotter Kingdom’s diverse culinary delights, praising beef, mutton, and pork while expressing disdain for the local tobacco, likening it to smoking chili.
unit.target: Auctor de diversis deliciis culinae Regni Feynapotter extollens, bubulam, ovam, et porcinam laudabat, simulque tabacum locale detestans, id fumo piperis comparans.

unit.source: After a stretch, Lugano returned to the suite with Ludwig, bearing a stack of street snacks—roasted baby octopuses, lamb loin, fried fish, potatoes, corn omelet, and pork rolls.
unit.target: Post quacumque exercitatione, Lugano cum Ludwig ad conclavam rediit, ferens copiam cibi viarii—octopodes infantes tosti, lumbus agni, pisces fritti, tubera, omeletam de frumento maizo, et involucra porcina.

unit.source: Lumian had long set aside “Travel around Feynapotter.”
unit.target: Lumian diu librum "Iter per Feynapotter" deponerat.

unit.source: He rose and addressed Lugano,
unit.target: Surgens, Lugano allocutus est,

unit.source: “Don’t forget to change your appearance tomorrow to fetch our new IDs. Also, figure out where Batna Comté will be in the next two days. I want to share a drink with him.”
unit.target: "Noli oblivisci cras species tuam mutare ad cognoscendum nostra nova ID; item, invenias ubi Batna Comté in proximis duobus diebus erit. Volo cum eo potum communicare."

unit.source: “Alright, alright.” Lugano couldn’t fathom why his employer suddenly wanted to locate the finely dressed adventurer, but he sensed it wasn’t as simple as a casual drink.
unit.target: "Recte, recte." Lugano non potuit intellegere cur dominus eius subito viatorem eleganter vestitum detegere vellet, sed sensit id non tam simplex esse quam merus potus.

unit.source: After assigning the task, Lumian grabbed the sun straw hat and casually mentioned as he sauntered toward the door, “I’m stepping out for a bit. I’ll be back before dinner.”
unit.target: Munus assignato, Lumian pileum stramineum solis cepit et leviter dixit, dum ad ostium procedebat: "Exeo paulo; ante cenam revertar."

unit.source: “D-do you need any translations?” Lugano asked instinctively.
unit.target: "Num tibi translationes opus sunt?" inquit Lugano instinctim.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “I’m just taking a stroll, getting a feel for the terrain. No need to chat with anyone. Don’t worry, I won’t lose my way.”
unit.target: "Modo ambulo, terram explorans. Non opus est cum aliquo colloqui. Noli solliciti esse, viam meam non aberrabo."

unit.source: Lugano tersely acknowledged and refrained from probing further.
unit.target: Lugano breviter assentivit et ulterius inquisire cessavit.

unit.source: He trusted that his employer’s adept body language skills would make simple communication a breeze.
unit.target: Confidebat dominum suum per calliditatem gestuum simplicem communicationem efficere posse.

unit.source: Once out of Solow Motel, Lumian ambled down the street.
unit.target: Exiit Solow Motel, et Lumian per viam lente ambulavit.

unit.source: He aimed to set the stage for those attempting to reach him and see if the Fisheries Guild would seize the chance to make a move.
unit.target: Intellexit fore ut illis qui eum pervenire conabantur occasionem pararet, et ut videret si membri Consilii Gildae Piscandi occasionem caperent ad agendum.

unit.source: Solow Motel, fifth-floor suite.
unit.target: Solow Motel, conclave in quinto tabulato.

unit.source: As Ludwig polished off the fermented grape juice, he leaped from the chair and headed briskly to the washroom.
unit.target: Dum Ludwig succum viniferum fermentatum perrexerat, ex sella saluit et festinanter ad latrinam profectus est.

unit.source: Lugano slouched on the sofa, reluctant to budge.
unit.target: Lugano in sofa incurvatus remansit, non cogens se movere.

unit.source: After tending to the child for nearly two hours, fatigue had settled in.
unit.target: Post curam pueri per fere duas horas egit, lassitudo se imposuit.

unit.source: Lugano yearned for a break.
unit.target: Lugano quietem desiderabat.

unit.source: His plan was to gather intel on Batna Comté and rendezvous with the spirited Feynapotter ladies at the bar later in the night.
unit.target: Propositum eius fuit de Batna Comté notitias colligere et cum animosis feminis Feynapotter postea in taberna convenire.

unit.source: Ludwig entered the washroom, lifted the toilet lid, and half-closed his eyes.
unit.target: Ludwig in latrinam intravit, operculum latrinae attollit, et oculos semiclusa habuit.

unit.source: As he relieved himself with determination, a slim silhouette emerged from the shadows in the corner.
unit.target: Dum se constanter evacuabat, gracilis figura ex umbris in angulo apparuit.

unit.source: The black shadow took the form of an insect, about the thickness of a finger, with long bristles on its surface resembling spoiled food.
unit.target: Umbra nigra formam insectoris assumpsit, crassitudine digiti comparata, cum longis setis in superficie, quas similes cibo corrupto videbantur.

unit.source: Its bristles fluttered, extending like tentacles, reaching out to touch everything in its path.
unit.target: Setae eius fluctuant, extendentes quasi tentaculi, omnia in via attingere conabantur.

unit.source: As it twisted, the black shadow silently crept up behind Ludwig.
unit.target: Dum se verteret, umbra nigra silentio post Ludwig se subiecit.

unit.source: It abruptly stood up and plunged its head into Ludwig’s cervical spine.
unit.target: Subito surrexit et caput suum in spinam cervicalem Ludovici impulit.

unit.source: At that moment, it caught sight of the boy’s brown eyes.
unit.target: Illo momento oculos fuscos pueri conspexit.

unit.source: Abruptly, it froze, holding its shape like a snake rearing its upper body.
unit.target: Subito immobilis factum est, formam suam retinens sicut serpens, qui suum corpus superius extollit.

unit.source: Ludwig, at some point, had ceased urinating and half-turned around.
unit.target: Ludwig, aliquando, mictionem desiit et semiclusus se convertere coepit.

unit.source: He extended his right palm and seized the black shadow.
unit.target: Manum dextram extendit et umbram nigram rapuit.

unit.source: The shadow didn’t put up a fight.
unit.target: Umbra nullam resistentiam ostendit.

unit.source: In the next instant, the chubby boy, Ludwig, shoved the black shadow into his mouth.
unit.target: In instante secundo, puer pinguis, Ludwig, umbram nigram in os suum coniecit.

unit.source: Amidst distinct chewing sounds, the lower half of the shadow’s body twisted upward, melding with the blurry flesh in front of it.
unit.target: Inter sonos masticandi distinctos, dimidia pars inferior corporis umbrae surrexit, confluitque cum carne confusa in fronte eius.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Ludwig consumed the black shadow as if it were a bowl of Feynapotter noodles.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, Ludwig umbram nigram consumpsit, velut catillus Nudorum Feynapotter.

unit.source: He licked his lips, appearing as though he wanted another serving.
unit.target: Labia sua lambit, quasi alteram portionem appetiret.

unit.source: Outside Aquina Street, in the café adorned with flowers on every table.
unit.target: Extra viam Aquina, in caupona quae in omni mensa floribus ornata erat.

unit.source: Along the way, Lumian stumbled upon two street brawls.
unit.target: In via, Lumian incidit in duas certationes viarias.

unit.source: He snagged a skewer of Port Santa’s roasted octopuses for a quick bite, yet no one approached him discreetly, attempted to stuff him with something, or whispered secret messages.
unit.target: Accepit spicula octopodum Portu Santa tostum ad celerem edendum, sed nemo secreto accessit, nihil eum implere conatus aut arcana nuntia susurravit.

unit.source: There were no covert attacks.
unit.target: Nullae erant incursiones clandestinae.

unit.source: Under the radiant sky and brilliant sun, he chose a quiet corner in a café, ordering a glass of Torres coffee with milk, relishing its rich bitterness with patience.
unit.target: Sub caelo radianti et sole fulgente, angulum quietum in caupona elegit, poculum cafeae Torres cum lacte iussit, amaritudinem eius dives patienter degustans.

unit.source: As time drifted by, a woman donned in a blue veil and an exquisite dress suddenly took a seat across from Lumian.
unit.target: Cum tempus laborem faceret, femina caeruleo velamine et veste exquisita repente trans Lumian consedit.

unit.source: She scanned the surroundings and swiftly raised the blue fishnet hanging from the brim of her hat.
unit.target: Ea circumiecta inspexit et celeriter rete caeruleum ex orificio pilei pendentem levavit.

unit.source: It wasn’t a woman—it was a man.
unit.target: Non femina erat—sed vir.

unit.source: A man dressed in women’s attire, with distinctive features and grayish-blue eyes that couldn’t conceal the anxiety on his face.
unit.target: Vir in veste feminea indutus, notis distinctis et oculis griseo-caeruleis, qui sollicitudinem in facie non celare poterant.

unit.source: Lumian’s pupils widened.
unit.target: Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt.

unit.source: He recognized the man in the feminine garb.
unit.target: Virum in veste feminea agnovit.

unit.source: It was the current Governor of the Sea!
unit.target: Hic erat praesens Gubernator Maris!

unit.source: The same Governor of the Sea whom Martha had bowed to in the cathedral‐like building, served by numerous maids!
unit.target: Eundem Gubernatorem Maris, quem Martha in aedificio quasi cathedrali, a plurimis ancillis ministrato, reverenter inclinavit!

unit.source: He sought me out? The one coming to me is actually him?
unit.target: Ille me quaesivit? Is, qui ad me venit, vere ille est?

unit.source: Lumian was both astonished and oddly convinced that this made sense.
unit.target: Lumian et obstupuit et mirum modo persuasus est hoc sensum habere.

unit.source: Noticing that the adventurer Louis Berry had identified him, the Governor of the Sea lowered the blue veil, shrouding his face once more.
unit.target: Animadvertens adventorem Ludovicum Berry eum agnovisse, Gubernator Maris velamen caeruleum deiecerat, faciem suam iterum involvens.

unit.source: Then, he hushed his voice and spoke in Highlander, filled with desire and concern, “Save me! Save me!”
unit.target: Tum vocem sedavit et in lingua Highlander locutus est, cupiditate et sollicitudine plenus, "Salva me! Salva me!"

unit.source: 552 Fake and Reality
unit.target: 552 Falsum et Realitas

unit.source: Lumian didn’t find the current Governor of the Sea’s plea for help surprising.
unit.target: Lumian supplicationem gubernatoris maris hodierni ad auxilium petendum non invenit miram.

unit.source: He raised his left hand and touched his ear.
unit.target: Manum sinistram levavit et aurem tetigit.

unit.source: In Intisian, he asked, “What are you saying? I only understand the word ‘help.'”
unit.target: In Intisiano rogavit: “Quid dicis? Verbum ‘auxilium’ solum intelligo.”

unit.source: The current Governor of the Sea, disguised as a woman, appeared dumbfounded, as if the language barrier was unexpected.
unit.target: Gubernator Maris hodiernus, in habitu feminali tectus, apparuit attonitus, quasi discrimen linguae inopinatum esset.

unit.source: Having racked his brains and risked his life to reach Louis Berry, the Governor of the Sea found himself unable to convey his request due to the language barrier!
unit.target: Strenue meditabatur atque vitam suam periclitans ut Ludovicum Berry attingeret, gubernator Maris invenerat se ob discrimen linguae petitionem suam exprimere non posse!

unit.source: Maintaining his pretense of not understanding Highlander, Lumian calmly took out a dark‑red fountain pen and a stack of post‑it notes, handing them over.
unit.target: Se praetendens linguam Highlander non intellegere, Lumian tranquille extraxit calamus atroruberum et acervum schedarum adnotandarum, quos tradidit.

unit.source: “Write down everything you want to say. I’ll get someone to translate it.”
unit.target: “Scribe omnia quae dicere vis. Curabo ut aliquis ea interprete faciat.”

unit.source: This time, he used Intisian again but gestured with the fountain pen to guide the other party on what to do.
unit.target: Hoc tempore iterum Intisiano usus est, sed calamo atrorubro gestum dedit ut alteri indicaret quid faciendum esset.

unit.source: If the Governor of the Sea is illiterate and unable to write Highlander, it would be troublesome…
unit.target: Si gubernator Maris inliteratus esset et linguam Highlander scribere non posset, hoc molestum foret…

unit.source: I would have to resort to communicating with individual words and body language.
unit.target: Debebo ad verba singula et corporea signa communicanda recurrere.

unit.source: I don’t want to reveal my knowledge of Highlander yet…
unit.target: Nolo adhuc scientiam meam de lingua Highlander patefacere…

unit.source: Lumian thought with concern.
unit.target: Lumian cum sollicitudine cogitavit.

unit.source: In Intis and Feynapotter, there were numerous illiterate individuals.
unit.target: In Intis et Feynapotter multissimi inliterati erant.

unit.source: The Governor of the Sea, after a brief moment of confusion, grasped Louis Berry’s intentions.
unit.target: Gubernator Maris, post breve momentum confusionis, intensionem Ludovicum Berry intellexit.

unit.source: He took the fountain pen and note and began scribbling.
unit.target: Calamus atroruberus schedamque cepit et scribere coepit.

unit.source: Lumian observed with a composed expression.
unit.target: Lumian, vultu composito, observavit.

unit.source: Despite being on the opposite side, with a Hunter’s vision and spatial imagination, he easily discerned the content of the written message:
unit.target: Etsi in parte adversa versabatur, cum venatoris visione et spatii phantasia utebatur, facile intellexit contentum scripti nuntii:

unit.source: “Please help me. Rescue me out of Port Santa! I’m not the true Governor of the Sea!”
unit.target: “Quaeso, adiuva me! Eme me ex Portu Santa! Non sum verus gubernatoris maris!”

unit.source: Not the true Governor of the Sea… Lumian suppressed the urge to raise his eyebrows and refrained from directly asking, maintaining an appearance of complete ignorance of the words.
unit.target: Non verus gubernator Maris… Lumian impetum supercilium tollendi repressit et directe quaerere non ausus est, speciem omnino ignorantiae verborum servans.

unit.source: He desired to see what additional information the current Governor of the Sea would reveal before considering his next set of questions.
unit.target: Volebat videre quid additum gubernator Maris hodiernus revelaret, antequam alias interrogationes consideraret.

unit.source: The man dressed in feminine attire paused for two seconds before continuing,
unit.target: Vir, in habitu feminali indutus, duas secundas cessavit antequam perrexit,

unit.source: “The true Governor of the Sea died during last year’s sea prayer ritual.”
unit.target: “Verus gubernator Maris per ritum orationis maris anni praeteriti obiit.”

unit.source: Dead? The genuine Governor of the Sea perished during the sea prayer ritual?
unit.target: “Mortuus? Verus gubernator Maris in ritu orationis maris periit?”

unit.source: Lumian felt a sudden surge of joy at this revelation.
unit.target: Lumian subito impetum gaudii ob hanc revelationem sensit.

unit.source: I can finally see the tail of the key members of April Fool’s!
unit.target: Denique vestigia membrorum praecipuorum April Folliae conspicio!

unit.source: One consequence of their prank last year was the predetermined Governor of the Sea’s failure to successfully perform the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Una ex consequentiis ioci anni praeteriti fuit quod gubernator Maris praedefinitus ritu orationis maris feliciter perficiendo defecit.

unit.source: He suffered a backlash from Beyonder powers and lost his life!
unit.target: Ab potentibus Beyonder repulsus, vitam amisit!

unit.source: This aligned with the revelations from Otta Guillaume, the Solow Motel owner, and his son, a government department clerk, regarding an increase in shipwrecks, a decline in fish harvests, and disrupted trade.
unit.target: Hoc convenit cum revelationibus a Otta Guillaume, domino Solow Motel, et filio eius, schedario departmenti, de incremento naufragiorum, de deminutione piscum messium, et de commercio perturbato.

unit.source: The imposter Governor of the Sea wrote swiftly, as if fearing someone might catch up to him at any moment.
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor celeriter scribebat, quasi timebat aliquem eum omni momento assequi posse.

unit.source: “I was chosen by Juan Oro and the Fisheries Guild to impersonate the Governor of the Sea for a year because I resemble the true Governor of the Sea.”
unit.target: “A Juan Oro et Gildae Piscandi electus sum, ut per annum gubernatorem Maris impersonarem, quoniam verum gubernatorem Maris similem sum.”

unit.source: This was to prevent fishermen and sea merchants from knowing about their grave mistake and the slip-up that caused the sea prayer ritual to fail.
unit.target: Hoc erat ut piscatores et mercatores maris de grave errore et lapsu, qui ritu orationis maris defecerat, nescirent.

unit.source: Such a failure has not occurred in recent centuries.
unit.target: Talis defectus in annis recentibus non evenit.

unit.source: Now that I know this secret, they won’t let me leave alive.
unit.target: Iam, cum hoc secretum sciam, non sinent me vivo discedere.

unit.source: After the Governor of the Sea handover ritual is completed and the vigil begins, I’ll undoubtedly be killed.
unit.target: Postquam ritu traditionis gubernatoris Maris peractis erunt et vigilia incipient, certissime interfectus ero.

unit.source: “I never wanted to play the role of Governor of the Sea.”
unit.target: “Numquam volui munus gubernatoris Maris agere.”

unit.source: It was a blasphemy against the sea, but they pointed a gun at me, claiming they had already killed someone who refused to cooperate.
unit.target: Blasphemia erat contra mare, sed mihi telum intuebantur, dicentes se iam aliquem interfectum esse, qui cooperari recusaverat.

unit.source: The Church and the government won’t intervene in the Fisheries Guild’s affairs.
unit.target: Ecclesia Mater Terrae in negotiis internis Gildae Piscandi non immiscetur, nec gubernatio intercedet.

unit.source: You’re the only one daring enough to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence and confront Juan Oro with a gun.
unit.target: Tu solus es qui audeas in domicilium gubernatoris Maris irrumpere atque Juan Oro cum telum oppugnare.

unit.source: I can only seek your help.
unit.target: Solum auxilium tuum quaerere possum.

unit.source: Over the past year, I’ve saved up quite a bit of money.
unit.target: Per annum praeteritum multam pecuniam servavi.

unit.source: I can give it all to you—
unit.target: Omnia tibi dare possum—

unit.source: 100,000 gold risot!
unit.target: 100,000 risot aurei!

unit.source: “I’ve heard about your recent exploits. I believe you have the strength. I implore you to help me!”
unit.target: “Audivi de recentibus rebus tuis. Credo te vim habere. Rogo te, adiuva me!”

unit.source: Quite educated… Lumian, after studying the three completed post‑it notes, sensed that the imposter Governor of the Sea differed from ordinary fishermen, vendors, or workers based on his grammar and vocabulary.
unit.target: Lumian, postquam tres completas schedas notularum perlegit, sensit gubernatorem Maris impostorem ab ordinariis piscatoribus, mercatoribus, et operariis in grammatica et vocabulario differri.

unit.source: Phew… After jotting down his reasons and request, the fake Governor of the Sea set aside the fountain pen and slid three post‑it notes filled with Highlander words to Lumian.
unit.target: Fheu… Postquam causas ac petitionem sua scribebat, gubernator Maris impostor calamus stilum deponit et tres schedas notularum, verbis linguae Highlander impletas, Lumiano tradidit.

unit.source: With a quick glance, Lumian contemplated using Highlander words and body language.
unit.target: Cum celeriter intuitus esset, Lumian consilium cepit uti verbis linguae Highlander atque gestu corporali.

unit.source: “Help? Your. Family?”
unit.target: “Auxilium? Tua. Familia?”

unit.source: The fake Governor of the Sea hastily wrote down a response: “My parents passed away a few years ago. I don’t have any other relatives. I was originally an employee of the Fisheries Company.”
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor festinanter responsum scribebat: “Parentes mei paucis annis abhinc mortui sunt. Nullos alios cognatos habeo. Originarie operarius Societatis Piscandi fui.”

unit.source: It’s no surprise Juan Oro and his associates dared to “kidnap” this person to be the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Non mirum est quod Juan Oro et socii eius ausi sint hunc hominem “rapire” ut gubernatorem Maris fieret.

unit.source: The Earth Mother Church refrains from meddling in the Fisheries Guild’s internal affairs.
unit.target: Ecclesia Mater Terrae in negotiis internis Gildae Piscandi non immiscetur.

unit.source: If it affects other citizens, they will still handle it…
unit.target: Si alios cives afficiat, illud tamen curabunt…

unit.source: Lumian pretended to ask first and planned to find someone later to translate the response.
unit.target: Lumian simulavit se primum quaerere et postea aliquem invenire consilium ceperat, ut responsum interprete faceret.

unit.source: “Servant girls. Pregnant?”
unit.target: “Ancillae? Gravidæ?”

unit.source: He inquired about the maids in the Governor of the Sea’s residence and the reason for their pregnancies.
unit.target: Rogavit de ancillis in domicilio gubernatoris Maris et de causis eorum graviditatis.

unit.source: The fake Governor of the Sea, concealed behind a blue veil, displayed no change in expression.
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor, sub caeruleo velamine absconditus, nullam expressionis mutationem ostendit.

unit.source: His right hand trembled slightly as he wrote: “The Governor of the Sea will receive the same treatment as the ruler of Port Santa.”
unit.target: Manus dextra eius leviter tremuit dum scribebat: “Gubernator Maris eandem condicionem passurus est ac rector Portus Santa.”

unit.source: He can do whatever he wants and directly visit them, enjoying the treatment an owner can receive.
unit.target: Quidquid velit facere potest et eos directe visitare, fruens ratione tractationis quam dominus accipere potest.

unit.source: I couldn’t help it.
unit.target: Non potui me continere.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian nearly laughed aloud.
unit.target: Observans hoc, Lumian paene alta voce risit.

unit.source: Even in captivity, he’s focused on such matters?
unit.target: Etiam in captivitate, an talibus rebus animum intendit?

unit.source: Does he believe he can’t escape and is resigned to his imminent demise?
unit.target: Creditne se effugere non posse et ad mortem imminere resignatum esse?

unit.source: Is he seeking enjoyment while he still can?
unit.target: Quaeritne voluptatem dum adhuc facultatem habet?

unit.source: The fake Governor of the Sea added: “I can also tax those people and forcefully allocate their market share, but they will listen to me. However, I dare not go too far. Otherwise, Juan Oro will privately whip me with his cane and threaten to kill me.”
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor addidit: “Possum etiam illos tributare et eorum mercatum vi coegerundum distribuere, sed me audient; tamen, non ultra procedere audeo; alioquin Juan Oro secreto me baculo flagellabit et me interficere minabitur.”

unit.source: So, this is the source of your savings?
unit.target: Ergo, hoc est fons tuarum pecuniarum servatarum?

unit.source: Well, he can’t control the weather or the tides.
unit.target: Bene, non potest caeli tempestatem neque aestus regere.

unit.source: After all, he’s merely a false Governor…
unit.target: Postremo, ipse solum falsus gubernator est…

unit.source: Lumian took the fake Governor of the Sea’s new post‑it note and pondered for a moment before asking in a clumsy manner, “Original. Governor. Where?”
unit.target: Lumian schedam notularum novam falsi gubernatoris Maris arripuit et paulo meditatus est antequam ineleganter quaesivit: “Originalis. Gubernator. Ubi?”

unit.source: He inquired about the whereabouts of the former Governors of the Sea.
unit.target: Interrogavit ubi veteres gubernatores Maris erant.

unit.source: Noelia, the combat nun of the Fertility Order, hadn’t raised this issue before.
unit.target: Noelia, monialis pugnax Ordinis Fertilitatis, hanc quaestionem antea non attulit.

unit.source: It was unclear if she deemed it unimportant, chose not to disclose it for some reason, or lacked the corresponding information.
unit.target: Incerto erat utrum eam neglegere arbitratus sit, sive de causa non divulgaverit, sive informatione adaequata caruerit.

unit.source: The fake Governor of the Sea wrote: “I don’t know. I heard a maid from Milo Village mention it before. She’s Juan Oro’s granddaughter. She said that all the Governors of the Sea will eventually return to the sea.”
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor scribebat: “Nescio. Audivi ancillam ex vico Milo prius id effari. Ea est nepos Juan Oro. Dixerat omnes gubernatores Maris tandem ad mare redire.”

unit.source: Return to the sea… That doesn’t sound promising…
unit.target: Redire ad mare… Id non pollice sonat…

unit.source: Heh heh, designating Juan Oro’s granddaughter as your maid.
unit.target: Heh heh, designans netam Juan Oro ut ancillam tuam.

unit.source: Are you seeking revenge for the oppression from her grandfather?
unit.target: Vultisne vindictam ferre propter iniuriam ab avo eius?

unit.source: And Juan Oro agreed to it, indirectly retaliating by lashing you?
unit.target: Et Juan Oro hoc assentiavit, indirecte te baculo flagellans retributisque?

unit.source: Juan Oro and his sons are married to Maidens of the Sea, and there’s a chance his granddaughter is a lizard‑like monster…
unit.target: Juan Oro et filii eius nuptos sunt cum Puellis Maris, et fortasse neta eius monstrum lacertiforme est…

unit.source: How would you feel if you knew you were sleeping with a humanoid lizard?
unit.target: Quomodo te sentires, si scires te cum lacerta humanoide cubitare?

unit.source: Lumian criticized the fake Governor of the Sea internally.
unit.target: Lumian gubernatorem Maris impostorem internis cogitationibus reprehendit.

unit.source: He seemed to ponder for a moment, as if unable to comprehend the other party’s writing, and changed the question.
unit.target: Videbatur paulisper meditari, quasi scripturam alterius intellegere non posset, et quaestionem mutavit.

unit.source: “Juan Oro. Powerful?”
unit.target: “Juan Oro. Potens?”

unit.source: The fake Governor of the Sea suddenly shuddered.
unit.target: Gubernator Maris impostor repente contremuit.

unit.source: Swiftly, he wrote: “He’s very powerful. He’s a monster! He can suffocate people and cause them to die in pain!”
unit.target: Celeriter scribebat: “Valde potens est. Monstrum est! Homines suffocare potest et eos in dolore mori facere!”

unit.source: After writing this, the fake Governor of the Sea glanced at the sun outside the window.
unit.target: Post hoc scribens, gubernator Maris impostor solem extra fenestram aspexit.

unit.source: He set down the fountain pen, stood up, and bowed to Lumian.
unit.target: Calamus stilum deponens, surrexit et Lumiano se inclinavit.

unit.source: Then, swaying in his elegant dress, he made his way toward the café’s back door and departed.
unit.target: Tum, in vestimento eleganti oscillante, ad posticam cauponae perrexit et discessit.

unit.source: He appeared anxious about his “disappearance” during the shopping trip potentially raising suspicions from the bodyguards.
