unit.target: Apparuit anxius de sua “evanitione” in itinere mercandi, ne a custodibus suspectus fiat.

unit.source: Lumian observed his departure, crumpling the post‑it notes into a ball in his palm.
unit.target: Lumian eius discessum observavit, schedas notularum in manu sua in pilam congregans.

unit.source: Crimson flames trickled from between his fingers before swiftly dissipating.
unit.target: Flammae coccineae inter digitos eius stillabant, antequam celeriter evanuerent.

unit.source: After sprinkling the ashes into the bottle with flowers, Lumian picked up the partially finished Torres coffee and took a sip.
unit.target: Postquam cineres in amphoram cum floribus sparsi sunt, Lumian partim finitum caffeum Torres sustulit et parum biberat.

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced as he analyzed the information that concerned him the most.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani festinanter currabat, dum informationes, quae eum maxime afficiebant, diligenter examinabat.

unit.source: Is what the imposter said true?
unit.target: Num id quod impostor dixit verum est?

unit.source: Could an ordinary person find an opportunity to escape their bodyguards and approach me?
unit.target: Potestne homo ordinarius occasionem invenire ut custodes suos effugiat et ad me accedat?

unit.source: Is it possible that Juan Oro and the others secretly prompted him to set a trap for me, waiting for me to fall into it?
unit.target: Num potest fieri ut Juan Oro et ceteri occulte eum impellerint ut mihi laqueum poneret, exspectantes ut in eum incidam?

unit.source: During the April Fool’s prank, the specially crafted golden ring, lacking Beyonder powers, was concealed within the lamb’s body.
unit.target: Inter iocum April Folliae, annulus aureus specialiter fabricatus, carens viribus Beyonder, in corpore agni celatus est.

unit.source: The lamb was taken as a sacrifice on the Governor of the Sea’s ship…
unit.target: Agnus pro sacrificio in nave gubernatoris Maris sublatus est…

unit.source: Is April Fool’s meant to substitute something with this ring?
unit.target: Num April Follia hoc annulo aliquid substituere intendit?

unit.source: Is there another sacrificial ring similar to it?
unit.target: Estne alius annulus sacrificii similis huic?

unit.source: Did the Governor of the Sea’s appointment fail last year because the crucial sacrificial ring turned out to be a fake and couldn’t be utilized?
unit.target: Num constitutio gubernatoris Maris anno praeterito defecit, quia annulus sacrificii praecipuus falsus esse apparuit et adhiberi non potuit?

unit.source: This implies that key members of April Fool’s or their subordinates are on the special ship.
unit.target: Hoc significat quod membra praecipua April Folliae aut subditi eorum in nave speciali adsint.

unit.source: Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to deceive the committee members of the Fisheries Guild and surreptitiously replace important items…
unit.target: Alioquin membris consilii Gildae Piscandi decipere et res maximas clandestine substituere non potuissent…

unit.source: Based on the information I’ve gathered, there aren’t many sailors on that ship.
unit.target: Ex informationibus congregatis, pauci nautae in illa nave adsunt.

unit.source: The only passengers are the Governor of the Sea, four Maidens of the Sea, and a few individuals guiding them through the ritual.
unit.target: Vectores unici sunt gubernator Maris, quattuor Puellae Maris, et paucī qui eos per ritu dirigunt.

unit.source: Who among them is connected to April Fool’s?
unit.target: Quis inter eos ad April Follia pertineat?

unit.source: The Fisheries Guild must have conducted an investigation afterward.
unit.target: Gildae Piscandi postea inquisitionem egisse oportet.

unit.source: I wonder if they’ve drawn any conclusions…
unit.target: Miror num conclusiones aliquas extraxerint…

unit.source: I can’t dismiss the possibility that the deceased Governor of the Sea is linked to April Fool’s.
unit.target: Non possum possibilitatem negare quod gubernator Maris defunctus ad April Follia coniungatur.

unit.source: Maybe he was completely deceived, thinking that by changing the ring and causing the ritual to fail, he could avoid returning to the sea like the previous Governors of the Sea.
unit.target: Forsitan plane deceptus est, putans quod annulum mutando et ritu deficendo redire ad mare, sicut gubernatores Maris pristini, vitari posset.

unit.source: However, Bard, Mad Lady, and Ultraman may not have cared about his life at all…
unit.target: Attamen Bard, Mad Lady, et Ultraman fortasse penitus de vita eius non curaverunt.

unit.source: What’s the purpose of April Fool’s? Is it merely a prank for their own amusement, or does it harbor a deeper motive?
unit.target: Quid est propositum April Folliae? Num solum iocus ad ipsorum voluptatem est, an altior finis insidet?

unit.source: Ordinary April Fool’s members might engage purely for entertainment.
unit.target: Membra ordinaria April Folliae fortasse solum ad delectationem se conferant.

unit.source: As for the key members, truth and lies are invariably intertwined…
unit.target: Quoad membra praecipua, veritas et mendacia inextricabiliter inter se sunt.

unit.source: Sitting in the café until the sun neared the horizon, Lumian donned the straw hat and leisurely made his way back to the Solow Motel.
unit.target: Sedens in caupona usque ad horizontem solis, Lumian pileum stramineum induit et ad Solow Motel lente rediit.

unit.source: Late at night, Lugano returned from the bar, emanating the scent of alcohol.
unit.target: Sero nocte, Lugano ex taberna rediit, efferens odorem alcoholis.

unit.source: He approached Lumian and said,
unit.target: Ad Lumian accedens, dixit:

unit.source: “I’ve inquired with adventurers and bounty hunters about Batna and his lover. They all claim not to have seen them in the past few days. As soon as they arrived at Port Santa, it was as if they vanished.”
unit.target: “Interrogavi cum adventoribus et venatoribus praemiatorum de Batna et amator eius. Omnes affirmant se eos paucis diebus praeteritis non vidisse. Statim, quo Portum Santa advenissent, quasi evanuerunt.”

unit.source: Vanished? Nolfi, being the child of a Maiden of the Sea, wouldn’t be so clandestine if she were merely returning to Port Santa and the Fisheries Guild…
unit.target: Evanuerunt? Nolfi, cum filia Puellae Maris sit, non ita occultē ageret, si solum ad Portum Santa et Gildam Piscandi rediret…

unit.source: Could she be involved in something related to the sea prayer ritual and convinced Batna to join her?
unit.target: Num illa in aliquo, quod ad ritu orationis Maris pertinet, implicata sit et Batnam ad se conciliaret?

unit.source: Yet, they were targeted upon their return?
unit.target: At, redierunt, et illi quasi scopum electi sunt?

unit.source: Perhaps she possesses significant knowledge… I can’t personally search for them right now.
unit.target: Forsitan ipsa notitiam amplam possidet… Ego eos nunc personaliter quaerere non possum.

unit.source: I need to be more visible as an adventurer…
unit.target: Mihi opus est ut adventor magis conspicuus sim.

unit.source: Lugano isn’t the most reliable source…
unit.target: Lugano non est fons maxime fidus.

unit.source: What about Noelia, the nun?
unit.target: Quid de Noelia, monialis?

unit.source: A flurry of speculations raced through Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Multae speculationes celeriter per mentem Lumiani transierunt.

unit.source: As his thoughts raced, he suddenly realized the kind of assistance he should seek from the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes eius festinanter currabant, subito intellexit quod genus auxilii a Eques Ensis quaerendum esset.

unit.source: 553 Half-Fairy
unit.target: 553 Dimidiata Nympha

unit.source: 553 Half-Fairy
unit.target: 553 Dimidiata Nympha

unit.source: Lumian remained composed, not rushing to summon the messenger of the Minor Arcana, the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Lumian manebat sedatus, non festinans nuntium Arcanae Minoris, Equitem Gladii, vocare.

unit.source: His patience persisted as he waited for a particular individual.
unit.target: Patientia eius perseveravit, dum exspectabat aliquem destinatum.

unit.source: Since expressing a strong desire to investigate the sea prayer ritual and taking action, only three waves of people had contacted him today, openly or covertly.
unit.target: Ex eo quod vehementer cupivisset ritum precationis maritimae explorare et agere, hodie solum tres undae hominum, sive aperte sive occulte, eum contulerunt.

unit.source: Yet, the person he awaited the most had not shown up.
unit.target: Attamen, persona quam maxime exspectabat nondum apparuit.

unit.source: Maybe Rubió Paco prefers to wait until late at night when there’s no one around?
unit.target: Forsitan Rubió Paco mavult exspectare usque ad noctem serotinam, cum nemo adest?

unit.source: Shaking off his thoughts, he smiled at Lugano.
unit.target: Cogitationes removens, ad Lugano subridens.

unit.source: “Batna just began his fling with Nolfi.
unit.target: “Batna modo negotium amoris cum Nolfi incipit.

unit.source: He might want to explore all the villages, towns, pastures, and vineyards around Port Santa before the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Fortasse velit explorare omnes vicos, oppida, prata, et vineas circa Portum Santum ante ritum precationis maritimae.

unit.source: If you hear anything about him later, inform me.
unit.target: Si posthac quid de eo audieris, mihi nuntia.

unit.source: There’s no need to deliberately inquire.
unit.target: Non opus est intentionaliter quaerere.

unit.source: Lugano didn’t think it was a big deal and smiled understandingly.
unit.target: Lugano non existimavit rem magnam esse, et intellegenter subridens.

unit.source: “Maybe he even took on some missions along the way—earning some bucks while traveling.”
unit.target: “Forsitan etiam aliquas missiones perrexit, pecuniam parvam merens.

unit.source: Once the interpreter and Ludwig retired to their rooms, Lumian settled into a recliner and casually perused the Highlander textbooks under the soft glow of the gas wall lamp.
unit.target: Cum interpres et Ludwig ad cubicula sua recedebant, Lumian in solio reclinato se instituit et leviter libros Highlander sub molli luce lampadis murariae gasii perlegit.

unit.source: As time passed, the night grew quieter.
unit.target: Tempore cedente, nox quietior facta est.

unit.source: Lumian, confirming no further intel would arrive that night, pondered the situation.
unit.target: Lumian, certo scito nihil amplius illam nocte venturum esse, rem meditatus est.

unit.source: Stroking his chin, he pondered this matter.
unit.target: Mentum frotans, hanc rem meditatus est.

unit.source: It seems more people are observing.
unit.target: Videtur plures homines spectare.

unit.source: Unless the great adventurer’s investigation makes a breakthrough and remains unscathed, they won’t easily place their bets until I demonstrate greater reliability or value.
unit.target: Nisi investigatio magni audaci exploratoris novam viam patefecerit atque intactus mansisset, non facile sortes suas constituent, donec maiorem constantiam aut valorem ostenderim.

unit.source: The trio who reached out today possesses distinct traits.
unit.target: Trio, qui hodie se contulerunt, proprietates distinctas habent.

unit.source: One affiliated with the Earth Mother Church, insulated from losses even if their gamble fails.
unit.target: Unus, Ecclesiae Matris Terrae affiliatus, a damnis immunus, etiam si alea sua deficeret.

unit.source: Would the Fisheries Guild risk confrontation with the cathedral and the Fertility Order?
unit.target: Num Gildia Piscaria certamen cum cathedral et Ordine Fertilitatis capere auderet?

unit.source: The second, the imposter Governor of the Sea, faces high odds of death during the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Secundus, impostor Praefectus Maris, magnas probabilitates mortis in ritu precationis maritimae habet.

unit.source: He’d clutch at any chance for survival.
unit.target: Omnem occasionem ad salutem arripere volebat.

unit.source: Additionally, his lack of confidence in both the Earth Mother Church and Port Santa’s government makes him value the adventurer capable of defeating the Demon Warlock more.
unit.target: Praeterea, infirma fiducia in et Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et gubernationem Portus Sancti efficit ut adventorem, qui Daemonium Magum superare valeat, magis aestimet.

unit.source: However, his plea might be a trap by the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Tamen supplicatio eius fortasse insidiae a Gildia Piscaria est.

unit.source: The third, elusive figure hinted at useful clues without divulging the sea prayer ritual’s secret…
unit.target: Tertius, figura elusoria, indicia utilia insinua est, sed secretum ritus precationis maritimae non revelavit…

unit.source: After careful contemplation, Lumian gained deeper insight into the mindsets and choices of various factions.
unit.target: Post accuratam meditationem, Lumian profundius mentes et decisiones variarum factionum intellexit.

unit.source: Conspiracies often manipulated human emotions, exploiting the circumstances at hand.
unit.target: Coniurationes saepe affectus humanos manipularunt, circumstantias praesentis usus facientes.

unit.source: Lumian found himself increasingly fascinated by these two aspects.
unit.target: Lumian se magis ac magis his duobus aspectibus fascinari invenit.

unit.source: This was both a daily routine and an essential necessity.
unit.target: Hoc erat tam consuetudo cotidiana quam necessitas vitalis.

unit.source: Putting aside the Highlander textbook, Lumian returned to his bedroom.
unit.target: Librum Highlander deieciens, Lumian ad cubiculum suum rediit.

unit.source: Closing the door, a black mark on his body emitted a faint glow.
unit.target: Claudens ianuam, atrum signum in corpore suo levem lucem edidit.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Vas Fictum!

unit.source: Lumian enveloped the entire room within the Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: Lumian totam conclave in Vas Fictum complectus est.

unit.source: The entry conditions were simple—only spirit world creatures.
unit.target: Conditiones ingressus erant simplices—solae creaturae mundi spirituum.

unit.source: Ripple-like light briefly adorned the walls, floor, and ceiling of the bedroom before swiftly vanishing, leaving everything appearing entirely ordinary.
unit.target: Lumen undarum simile paulisper parietes, pavimentum, et laquearia cubiculi ornavit, deinde celeriter evanuit, omnia omnino ordinaria relinquens.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian compose the letter and arrange the ritual.
unit.target: Tunc solum Lumian epistulam composuit et ritum ordinavit.

unit.source: He sanctified the dagger, erected a wall of spirituality, and lit the candle representing him.
unit.target: Pugionem sanctificavit, murum spiritualitatis erexit, et candelam, quae eum repraesentat, accendit.

unit.source: Stepping back, he spoke in ancient Hermes, “I!”
unit.target: Retrocedens, in antiqua lingua Hermetica locutus est: “Ego!”

unit.source: Then, switching to Hermes, he said, “I summon in my name:
unit.target: Deinde, in lingua Hermetica vertens, dixit: “In nomine meo evoco:

unit.source: “A peculiar creature wandering above the world, a half-fairy who fiddles with melodic strings, a messenger that belongs solely to the Knight of Swords…”
unit.target: “Creatura peculosa per orbem errans, dimidiata nympha, quae chordas melodicas ludit, nuntius qui solum Equesti Gladii est…”

unit.source: The orange candle flame transformed instantly into a deep blue hue, expanding to half the size of a human.
unit.target: Flamma candelæ aurantii statim in profundum caeruleum colorem conversa est, ad dimidiem hominis magnitudinem expandens.

unit.source: In the blue radiance, a figure of blood‑red hue emerged from the candle flame.
unit.target: In splendore caeruleo, figura sanguine rubra ex flamma candelæ exorta est.

unit.source: Resembling a female human in form, it shared traits with a creature Lumian had encountered in Cordu’s ruins.
unit.target: Forma femina humanae similis, proprietates habebat cum creatura quam Lumian in ruinis Cordi convenerat.

unit.source: Devoid of skin or external coverings, it exposed bloody muscles, bluish‑black blood vessels, ghastly white tendons, oily yellow fat, and large red or white fascia.
unit.target: Sine cute aut tegumentis externis, musculos sanguinolentos, vasa sanguinea nigrocaerulea, tendines horride albos, adipem flavum oleosum, et fascias magnas rubras aut albas patefecit.

unit.source: Lumian studied the 1.7‑meter‑tall Knight of Swords messenger and pondered silently, Does Half‑Fairy mean it’s divided internally?
unit.target: Lumian, nuntium Equestis Gladii, qui 1.7 metrorum altus erat, consideravit tacite, atque meditatus est: “Num Dimidiata Nympha internis partibus divisa sit?”

unit.source: I assumed it would be either split vertically or horizontally…
unit.target: Existimavi id aut verticaliter aut horizontaliter divisi esse…

unit.source: Don’t you know how to fiddle with melodic strings? Where are they?
unit.target: Nescisne quomodo chordis melodicis modulandum exerceas? Ubi illa sunt?

unit.source: With these musings racing through his mind, Lumian handed the folded letter to the messenger and politely uttered in Hermes, “Kindly deliver this to the Knight of Swords.”
unit.target: His cogitationibus in mente cursantibus, Lumian epistulam plicatam nuntio tradidit et comiter in lingua Hermetica dixit: “Quaeso, hanc ad Equestem Gladii perfer.”

unit.source: As his strength grew, Lumian became increasingly aware that most messengers he encountered could be lethal—if unafraid to unleash the corruptive source, Termiboros.
unit.target: Crescente vi, Lumian paulatim intellexit plerosque nuntios quos conveniebat letales esse posse—si non timebant fontem corruptionis, Termiboros, efferre.

unit.source: Though Lumian couldn’t gauge the strength of the Knight of Swords’ messenger—the Half‑Fairy—all his experience urged him to maintain politeness.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian virtutem nuntii Equestis Gladii—Dimidiatae Nymphae—non aestimare potuit, omnis eius experientia eum ad urbanitatem retinendam adhortabatur.

unit.source: The black and white eyeballs of the Half‑Fairy, embedded in the blood‑colored face, darted around before gently nodding and accepting the letter.
unit.target: Oculi nigri et albi Dimidiatae Nymphae, in facie sanguinea colorata insiti, circumvolitaverunt antequam leniter annuens epistulam accepit.

unit.source: It spoke with a clear, pleasant voice akin to a mountain stream’s flow, “I’ll deliver it promptly.”
unit.target: Ea loquebatur voce clara et amoena, instar sonitus fluminis montani, “Celeriter id perferam.”

unit.source: How melodious.
unit.target: Quam melodiosa.

unit.source: It’s like a bard strumming a guitar… Lumian snapped out of his reverie.
unit.target: Instar bardus citharam pulsans est… Lumian ex meditatione sua evigilavit.

unit.source: He suddenly grasped the reason for the messenger’s melodic string prefix.
unit.target: Subito intellexit causam praefixi chordarum melodicarum nuntii.

unit.source: “Thank you.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago.”

unit.source: He bowed politely.
unit.target: Comiter inclinavit.

unit.source: Observing the Half‑Fairy about to retreat into the blue candle flame, Lumian couldn’t suppress his curiosity and inquired, “What would you do if given human skin?”
unit.target: Observans Dimidiatam Nympham, quae in flammam candelæ caeruleæ se retrahere parata esset, Lumian curiositatem reprimere non potuit et quaesivit: “Quid facies, si cutem humanam accipias?”

unit.source: The Half‑Fairy fixed its black‑and‑white eyes on Lumian for a few seconds.
unit.target: Dimidiata Nympha oculos nigros et albos in Lumian paucis momentis fixit.

unit.source: As it delved into the blue candle flame, it left behind a melodious voice, “I’ll put it on.”
unit.target: Dum in flammam candelæ caeruleæ se immergit, post se vocem melodiosam reliquit: “Induem illud.”

unit.source: You’ll embody whoever’s skin you wear? Has the Half‑Fairy always sought its other half? Lumian speculated.
unit.target: Num incarnabis eum, cuius cutem geres? Num Dimidiata Nympha semper alteram partem suam quaesiverit? Lumian hoc speculatus est.

unit.source: At that moment, he recalled an unfinished promise.
unit.target: Illo momento, promissum imperfectum meminit.

unit.source: Help the Abscessed Hand find its body!
unit.target: Adiuvā Manum Abscessam corpus suum invenire!

unit.source: This pledge determined whether Lumian could attain godhood and advance to Sequence 4.
unit.target: Hoc pactum definivit num Lumian deitatem adipisci posset et ad Ordinem Quartum ascendere.

unit.source: However, being only a Sequence 6, he wasn’t in a rush.
unit.target: Attamen, cum solum esset in Ordine Sexto, non festinabat.

unit.source: Late at night, in Trier’s market district, within an empty room.
unit.target: Nocte sero, in regione mercatoria Treverensi, intra conclave vacuum.

unit.source: Franca, clad in an assassin suit, was having her first face‑to‑face encounter with 007.
unit.target: Franca, habitu sicario induta, primum conventum facie ad faciem cum 007 habebat.

unit.source: As moments drifted by, 007 strode in, sporting a brown lion headgear and a double‑breasted coat.
unit.target: Dum momenta transibant, 007 incedebat, gerens galeam leonis fuscae et vestem duplici pectorali.

unit.source: After confirming his identity, Franca pushed back her hood, emerging from the shadows.
unit.target: Postquam identitatem confirmavit, Franca cucullum suum repellens ex umbris emergit.

unit.source: “What brings us to this in‑person discussion?” 007 inquired, his brow furrowed.
unit.target: “Quid nos ad hanc in persona disputationem ducit?” interrogavit 007, fronte contrahente.

unit.source: His instincts screamed to decline, yet he sensed the gravity of the situation.
unit.target: Instinctus eius ad recusandum clamare videbantur, attamen gravitatem rei sensit.

unit.source: Failing to act promptly could result in a colossal catastrophe.
unit.target: Celeriter agere non potuisse ingentem catastropham inferre posset.

unit.source: Ultimately, he acceded to Hidden Blade’s request for a meeting.
unit.target: Denique petitioni Hidden Blade de conventu assensit.

unit.source: Franca chuckled, emotions swirling within.
unit.target: Franca subridens, interiores animi motus circumvolitantes, ridebat.

unit.source: “It’s a good thing.”
unit.target: “Bona res est.”

unit.source: “I’m skeptical when it comes from you, Hidden Blade,” 007 expressed his concern openly.
unit.target: “A te, Hidden Blade, dubito,” 007 aperte curam suam efferens dixit.

unit.source: Franca clarified her reason for requesting an “offline” meeting, “It’s true. I need your help to find someone.
unit.target: Franca causam suam ad conventum “offline” petendum enuntiavit: “Verum est. Auxilio tuo aliquem invenire mihi opus est.

unit.source: Telegrams can’t convey a portrait.
unit.target: Telegrammata picturam transmittere non possunt.

unit.source: I can’t craft a digital image using just words and dots, can I?”
unit.target: Imaginem digitalem tantis verbis et punctis solis conficere non possum, an non?

unit.source: 007 regarded Franca with suspicion.
unit.target: 007 Francam cum suspicione contemplavit.

unit.source: “Simply seeking help to locate someone? No ulterior motives?”
unit.target: “Solum auxilium quaeris ad aliquem inveniendum? Nulla ulterior voluntas est?”

unit.source: Franca chuckled.
unit.target: Franca subridens ridebat.

unit.source: “For now, that’s all I can divulge.”
unit.target: “Nunc tantum hoc patefacere possum.”

unit.source: “That only heightens my apprehension.”
unit.target: “Id solum sollicitudinem meam auget.”

unit.source: 007 keenly sensed the search for this individual might harbor a crucial issue.
unit.target: 007 acerrime sensit quaesitum huius individui rem gravem latere.

unit.source: Otherwise, Hidden Blade, having witnessed catastrophic events, wouldn’t have taken it so seriously.
unit.target: Alio modo, Hidden Blade, catastropha visa, non id tam graviter sustinuisset.

unit.source: She wouldn’t have insisted on an offline meeting and handing over the portrait personally.
unit.target: Non institeret ad conventum offline et picturam personaliter tradere.

unit.source: More likely, she would have left it somewhere for retrieval.
unit.target: Verisimiliter, eam alicubi relinquisset ad recuperationem.

unit.source: Franca produced a portrait, drawn through dream divination and ritualistic magic, and passed it to 007.
unit.target: Franca picturam, per divinationem somniorum et magiam ritualem confectam, 007 tradidit.

unit.source: Upon receiving it, 007’s hand naturally emitted a sunlight‑like glow, revealing the photo‑like drawing in the dark night.
unit.target: Accipiens, manus 007 naturaliter radiante luce solari similis effudit, ostendens picturam quasi photographicam in nocte obscura.

unit.source: The depicted figure wore a black robe, with his head slightly turned, revealing very short dark hair that seemed freshly grown.
unit.target: Figura depingata vestem nigrum gerebat, capite leviter converso, ostendens crines breves et obscuros, quasi nuper creti.

unit.source: The facial contours on his side profile were gentle, and his sickly pale‑white skin contrasted with his dark brown eyes, which were not sunken enough.
unit.target: Lineamenta faciei lateralis eius lenia erant, et cutis pallida, quasi aegrota, contraria erat oculis fusco‑brunneis, quae non satis demissae erant.

unit.source: Initially, 007 perceived nothing remarkable, but trusting Hidden Blade’s knack for stirring trouble, he scrutinized it for more than ten seconds.
unit.target: Initio, 007 nihil insolitum percepit, sed fidens in arte Hidden Blade ad tumultum excitandum, illud plus quam decem secundis perscrutatus est.

unit.source: Beneath the lion’s headgear, his brow furrowed as he whispered, “This doesn’t seem like someone from any country in the Northern Continent.”
unit.target: Sub galea leonis, supercilium contraxit dum susurravit, “Hic non videtur ex quacumque terra in Continente Septentrionali esse.”

unit.source: Franca smiled playfully and self‑deprecatingly.
unit.target: Franca ludenter et sui ipsius deprecatione subridens ridebat.

unit.source: “Don’t you think he resembles us from before we transmigrated?”
unit.target: “Non putasne eum simile esse nobis, antequam transmigrati essemus?”

unit.source: 007 froze, as if struck by lightning.
unit.target: 007 immobilis factus est, quasi fulmine percussus.

unit.source: He studied the drawing repeatedly and fell silent for nearly 20 seconds before saying,
unit.target: Illud pictum iterum atque iterum examinavit et paene viginti secundis tacitus mansit, antequam dixerit,

unit.source: “Hidden Blade, do you understand what you’re saying?”
unit.target: “Hidden Blade, intellegisne quid dicis?”

unit.source: Franca raised her head slightly and said in a deep voice, “I suspect he came from that country from our world.
unit.target: Franca paulum caput attollens, voce profunda dixit, “Suspicio eum ex illa terra nostrae mundi venit.

unit.source: “Muggle, I, and the others found signs of interaction between both worlds before!”
unit.target: “Muggle, ego et ceteri signa interactionis inter utrumque mundum prius invenimus!”

unit.source: “When? What signs?” 007 interjected, fighting the urge to grab Hidden Blade’s shoulder and shake her for every bit of information.
unit.target: “Quando? Quae signa?” interposuit 007, contendens impulsum ut humerum Hidden Blade arriperet atque eam concuteret pro singulis informationis particulis.

unit.source: Franca chuckled.
unit.target: Franca subridens ridebat.

unit.source: “I’m not at liberty to answer you.
unit.target: “Non licet mihi tibi respondere.

unit.source: I can only reveal it after discussing with Muggle and the others.
unit.target: Illud tantum patefacere possum postquam cum Muggle et ceteris colloquar.

unit.source: There are many secrets involved.
unit.target: Multa arcana implicata sunt.

unit.source: First, discreetly search for the person in the portrait.
unit.target: Primum, caute quaere personam in pictura.

unit.source: I encountered him on the fourth level of the catacombs.”
unit.target: Eum in quarto gradu catacumbarum conveni.

unit.source: 007 struggled to contain his impatience, resisting the temptation to handcuff Hidden Blade for details.
unit.target: 007 impatiens conabatur impetum suum continere, resistens temptationi ut Hidden Blade ad notitias particulariter vincirentur.

unit.source: Through gritted teeth, he said, “Can’t you guys discuss it first before involving me?”
unit.target: Inter dentes contritos, dixit: “Num prius ea disputare non potestis, antequam me implicetis?”

unit.source: I was just considerate of your emotions, afraid that you’d lose control upon receiving so much information at one go…
unit.target: Mihi solum cura erant affectus vestri, timeo ne, simul tantam informationem accipiatis, moderationem amitteretis…

unit.source: Franca let out a hollow laugh and replied,
unit.target: Franca risum vacuam edidit et respondit,

unit.source: “It’s not time to meet Muggle and the others yet.
unit.target: “Nondum tempus est Muggle et ceteros conveniendi.

unit.source: I need to find him urgently, afraid he might leave Trier.
unit.target: Eum celeriter inveniendum habeo, ne Trier relinqueret.

unit.source: “Calm down, calm down.
unit.target: “Quiesce, quiesce.

unit.source: You can’t hide your desire to kill me.”
unit.target: Non potes celare desiderium tuum me interficendi.

unit.source: Franca smiled sheepishly, fading into the shadows.
unit.target: Franca verecunde subridens in umbras evanuit.

unit.source: Holding the portrait, 007 took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
unit.target: Picturam tenens, 007 altum spiritum traxit et lente expiravit.

unit.source: Feynapotter Kingdom, Port Santa, Solow Motel.
unit.target: Regnum Feynapotter, Portus Sanctus, Solow Motel.

unit.source: After breakfast, Lumian had just returned to the master bedroom when he sensed a sudden chill.
unit.target: Post ientaculum, Lumian modo ad cubiculum principale redierat, cum subitam frigiditatem sensit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a tarot card materialized on the desk.
unit.target: Simul, charta taroti in mensa apparuit.

unit.source: The card depicted a knight running with a sword in hand.
unit.target: Charta depictum ostendebat equitem currens gladium in manu gerentem.

unit.source: Minor Arcana card, Knight of Swords!
unit.target: Charta Arcana Minor, Eques Gladii!

unit.source: 554 Favor
unit.target: 554 Beneficium

unit.source: 554 Favor
unit.target: 554 Beneficium

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze fixated on the Minor Arcana card before he noticed another person standing in front of the full‐body mirror in the room.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani in charta Arcanae Minoris firmiter insitus erat, priusquam alium hominem coram speculum totius corporis in conclavi stantem animadvertit.

unit.source: The man sported a white shirt and a black vest, his face unusually pale and his brown hair tousled, suggesting he had just woken up.
unit.target: Vir tunicam albam et loricam nigrum gerebat; vultus eius insolite pallidus, capilli fusci inconditi erant, indicantes eum nuper evigilavisse.

unit.source: For some inexplicable reason, Lumian sensed a conflicting demeanor in this person—elusive yet restrained.
unit.target: Aliqua ratione inexplicabili, Lumian indolem contrariam in hoc homine sensit—elusivam tamen cohibitam.

unit.source: The brown eyes held an indescribable weight, akin to staring into an abyss.
unit.target: Oculi fusci grave pondus ineffabile ostendebant, quasi in abyssum intuerentur.

unit.source: “Knight of Swords?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: „Eques Gladii?“ inquit Lumian.

unit.source: The man nodded subtly and responded, “Seven of Wands, how may I assist you?”
unit.target: Vir subtiliter annuit et respondit: „Septem Virgae, quomodo te adiuvare possum?“

unit.source: Surprised, Lumian questioned, “How do you know I’m the Seven of Wands?”
unit.target: Miratus, Lumian interrogavit: „Quomodo scis me esse Septem Virgae?“

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t disclosed his exact code name in the letter, merely stating he sought help from the Knight of Swords as guided by Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lumian in epistola nomen suum secretum exacte non revelaverat, sed solum indicavit se auxilium a „Eque Gladii“ petivisse, iuxta praeceptum Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords spoke slowly, as if holding back something.
unit.target: Eques Gladii lente loquebatur, quasi aliquid retineret.

unit.source: “Ma’am Hermit informed me that the Seven of Wands, affiliated with Madam Magician, would soon arrive in Feynapotter, possibly in need of intel or assistance.”
unit.target: „Domina Eremita“ mihi nuntiavit Septem Virgae, Dominae Magicae affiliatae, mox in Feynapotter adveniturum esse, fortasse auxilio aut notitia indigentes.

unit.source: Madam Magician intentionally communicated with Ma’am Hermit about me, Lumian realized.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit Domina Magica de ipso cum Domina Eremita consilio intentione communicavisse.

unit.source: “I need your help locating two individuals in Port Santa and the surrounding seas.
unit.target: „Auxilium tuum mihi opus est ad duos homines in Port Santa et in maribus circumstantibus inveniendos.

unit.source: Try not to alert any factions.”
unit.target: Quaeso, noli ullam factionem excitare.“

unit.source: “Be specific,” the Knight of Swords replied, economical with his words.
unit.target: „Esto specificus,“ respondit Eques Gladii, verbis suis parcus.

unit.source: Lumian shared Batna Comté and Nolfi’s details, adding, “I’m not certain if they’re still alive.
unit.target: Lumian notitias de Batna Comté et Nolfi communicavit, addens: „Non certo scio an adhuc vivant.

unit.source: They might have become corpses by now.”
unit.target: Forsitan iam cadavera facta sint.“

unit.source: As he spoke, he handed two photo‐like sketches to the Knight of Swords—a unique skill he’d acquired from Aurore’s grimoires and his expertise in ritualistic magic.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, duas imagines quasi photographicas Eques Gladii tradidit – artem unicam, quam ex grimoriis Aurore et peritia in magica rituali adeptus erat.

unit.source: These images, directly replicated from his mind, bore an uncanny resemblance to photographs.
unit.target: Hae imagines, eodem modo ex mente eius replicatae, ad photographias insolitam similitudinem ostendebant.

unit.source: The ritualistic magic involved in creating such images demanded a suitable and secure target for prayer—a practice more common among official Beyonders who had orthodox gods to appeal to.
unit.target: Magia ritualis ad tales imagines creandas, obiectum idoneum et tutum ad precationem postulabat – consuetudo quae magis apud Beyonders officiales, qui deos orthodoxos invocabant, fere erat.

unit.source: Wild Beyonders rarely resorted to praying to dangerous entities for trivial matters.
unit.target: Beyonders feri raro ad entia periculosa, pro rebus levibus, precari consueverunt.

unit.source: Being part of the Tarot Club, Lumian straddled both worlds, with the ability to seek aid from Mr. Fool or tap into Madam Magician’s strength.
unit.target: Societate Taroticā membrum esse, Lumian utrumque mundum complexus erat, facultatem habens auxilium a Domino Stulto petendi aut vim Dominae Magicae adipisci.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords studied the photo‐like sketches before affirming, “I’ll help you find them as soon as possible.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii delineationes quasi photographicas perspexit, antequam affirmavit: „Te adiuvabo ut eos quam primum invenias.“

unit.source: There was no demand for payment or any immediate request, prompting Lumian to sigh.
unit.target: Nulla solutio aut petitio immediata adfuit, id quod Lumian in suspirio effudit.

unit.source: Organizations do have their advantages!
unit.target: Corporationes vero commoda habent!

unit.source: Internal assistance often translated into favors, subtly binding individuals to reciprocal obligations.
unit.target: Auxilium internum saepe in beneficia convertebatur, subtiliter homines ad obligationes reciprocas alligens.

unit.source: Some preferred setting clear prices rather than owing favors, but Lumian didn’t entertain such thoughts.
unit.target: Nonnulli meliora putabant certa pretia statuere quam beneficia deberent, sed Lumian talia non cogitavit.

unit.source: Securing the Knight of Swords’ presence and help was already a considerable favor in itself.
unit.target: Obtinentia praesentiae et auxilii Eques Gladii iam ipsa magnum beneficium constituebatur.

unit.source: He pondered for a moment and then inquired, “What mission do you have in Feynapotter? Do you need my assistance?”
unit.target: Paululum meditatus est, deinde interrogavit: „Quam missionem in Feynapotter geris? Opusne tibi est auxilio meo?“

unit.source: The Knight of Swords paused briefly before responding, “The matter in Feynapotter is wrapping up, but I’ll be heading to the Southern Continent soon.
unit.target: Eques Gladii breviter cessavit, deinde respondit: „Res in Feynapotter ad finem pervenitur, sed mox ad Continentem Meridionalem profecturus sum.

unit.source: I might require your help there.”
unit.target: Ibi fortasse auxilium tuum requirebo.“

unit.source: “Sure thing,” Lumian agreed.
unit.target: „Certe,“ consensit Lumian.

unit.source: Intrigued, he asked, “Is Ma’am Hermit also overseeing matters in the Southern Continent?”
unit.target: Stupefactus, interrogavit: „Num Domina Eremita etiam in Continentem Meridionalem res curat?“

unit.source: Wasn’t she too busy?
unit.target: Nonne nimis occupata erat?

unit.source: Madam Magician had indicated that this Major Arcana card holder primarily dealt with sea‐related affairs and a clandestine organization dedicated to the Hidden Sage, with little involvement in the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Domina Magica indicaverat hunc titulum Arcanae Maioris praecipue negotiis maritimis et cum societate clandestina, quae Sapiens Occultus dedicata erat, agere, cum parva participatione in Continente Meridionale.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords replied in a subdued tone, “It’s a personal matter, unrelated to Ma’am Hermit.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii leniter respondit: „Res privata est, quae ad Dominam Eremitam non pertinet.“

unit.source: “Got it,” Lumian acknowledged.
unit.target: „Intelligo,“ inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Many of his past tasks weren’t orchestrated by Madam Magician, and even his mission in Port Santa to track down April Fool’s key member was considered personal business if it didn’t involve the Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Multa ex operibus eius praeteritis a Domina Magica non moderabantur, atque etiam missio in Port Santa ad membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti quaerendum negotiō personale habebatur, nisi ad Celestem Dignum implicaretur.

unit.source: After a two‐second pause, the Knight of Swords added, “Moreover, I’m only temporarily under Ma’am Hermit’s command.”
unit.target: Post pausam duarum secundarum, Eques Gladii addidit: „Praeterea, solum ad tempus sub imperio Dominae Eremitae sum.“

unit.source: What does he mean by temporarily subordinate?
unit.target: Quid vult significare quod temporarie subiectus sit?

unit.source: Can one switch to other Major Arcana card holders in the future?
unit.target: Poteritne quisquam in futurum ad alios tenentes Arcanae Maioris transire?

unit.source: Lumian wondered.
unit.target: Lumian quaerebat.

unit.source: Without explanation, the Knight of Swords’ form suddenly turned ethereal and disappeared.
unit.target: Sine explicatione, forma Eques Gladii subito in aethera versa evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian, without activating his Spirit Vision, couldn’t catch the departing figure in time.
unit.target: Lumian, Spiritus Visionem non activans, effugientem figuram non tempore apprehendere potuit.

unit.source: It doesn’t feel like teleportation or blending into the shadows…
unit.target: Non videtur quasi teleportatio aut in umbras fusio…

unit.source: After a quick assessment, he changed into a brownish-green short-sleeved shirt and loose brownish-yellow pants commonly seen in Port Santa.
unit.target: Post celerem aestimationem, mutavit in tunicam brevem manica viridi-brunnea et bracas laxas flavo-brunae, quae in Port Santa vulgo visae sunt.

unit.source: Exiting the master bedroom, Lumian tossed the Lie earring to Lugano.
unit.target: Exiens ex cubiculo principali, Lumian anulum „Lie“ ad Lugano iacuit.

unit.source: “Go to Valerio and get the new IDs.
unit.target: „Vade ad Valerio et novas identificationes cape.

unit.source: Remember the face you used when you last saw him.”
unit.target: Memento vultum quem, cum eum novissime videras, adhibuisti.”

unit.source: “I remember it clearly.”
unit.target: „Evidenter memini,“ respondit Lugano.

unit.source: Lugano took the Lie earring.
unit.target: Lugano anulum „Lie“ tulit.

unit.source: As Lugano was about to proceed with his disguise, Lumian halted him.
unit.target: Dum Lugano ad persona mutandam procedere parabat, Lumian eum retinuit.

unit.source: “Find a secluded spot after leaving the room to use it. When you return, shift back to your original appearance before entering the motel.”
unit.target: „Inveni locum secretum postquam ex cella exeas, ut id adhibeas. Cum redieris, ad formam pristinam tuam revertere antequam in motel ingrediaris.”

unit.source: Doesn’t this mean I’ll have this mystical item to myself for a while?
unit.target: Nonne hoc significat me hanc rem mysticam per aliquam tempus soli habere?

unit.source: Aren’t you worried I might take off with it?
unit.target: Nonne tibi est sollicitudo ne eam auferam?

unit.source: It’s not just unique; it’s valuable!
unit.target: Non solum unica est, sed etiam pretiosa!

unit.source: Lugano refrained from probing further.
unit.target: Lugano ulteriora explorare abstinuit.

unit.source: Following his employer’s instructions, he took the Lie earring, a bag containing his disguise, and exited the room.
unit.target: Obsequens praeceptis patroni sui, anulum „Lie“, saccum qui larvam contineret, tulit atque ex cella discessit.

unit.source: Observing Lugano’s departure, Lumian picked up a golden straw hat and addressed Ludwig, “There’s plenty of food in my bedroom.
unit.target: Lumian, Lugano discedentem observans, pileum faino aureum sumpsit et Ludovico alloquutus est: „Multum cibi in cella mea est.

unit.source: Stay put until I’m back.”
unit.target: Manete hic donec redeam!”

unit.source: “Sure thing,” Ludwig agreed, seemingly eager.
unit.target: „Certe,“ inquit Ludwig, vix occulto studio evidens.

unit.source: Would someone exploit the absence of his guardians to attack him, the boy?
unit.target: Num aliquis, ab absentia curatorum eius, puero oppugnare conetur?

unit.source: Lumian, passing by the sofa, casually placed the golden straw hat on Ludwig’s head.
unit.target: Lumian, per sofa transeuntem, leviter pileum faino aureum in caput Ludovici posuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he switched to a common round-rimmed felt hat and left the suite gradually.
unit.target: Simul, ad pileum vulgare, circumfusum ex felle, mutavit et conclave paulatim reliquit.

unit.source: He wasn’t concerned about Ludwig being alone in the motel.
unit.target: Non curabat de Ludovico solitario in motel esse.

unit.source: In fact, those who might come into contact with the boy faced more significant risks.
unit.target: Revera, illi qui puero contingere possent, pericula graviora subibant.

unit.source: Lumian adjusted his hat in the corridor and activated Shadow Transformation.
unit.target: Lumian pileum in corridoro temperavit atque Transmutationem Umbrae activavit.

unit.source: Swiftly, he transformed into a pure shadow, blending into the darkness at the base of the walls on both sides.
unit.target: Celeriter se in umbram puram transformavit, miscens in obscuritate ad bases murorum utriusque.

unit.source: In the dark, veiled void, Lumian inhaled the scent of the gray amber perfume he had deliberately left on the Lie earring, using it to track Lugano.
unit.target: In obscuro et velato vacuo, Lumian odorem unguenti ambrae cinereae, quem diligenter in anulo „Lie“ deposuerat, inhalavit ad Lugano persequendum.

unit.source: His intent wasn’t merely to determine whether the interpreter was problematic but to anticipate a potential attack.
unit.target: Intentio eius non tantum erat indagare utrum interpres problematibus afficeretur, sed etiam oppugnationem potentialem praevidere.

unit.source: With adventurer Louis Berry probing the sea prayer ritual and presenting himself as resolute and radical, it was likely the Fisheries Guild and Milo Village would swiftly react in a decisive manner, eliminating this outsider to dissuade others and factions from clandestinely stirring.
unit.target: Cum adventor Ludovicus Berry ritum marinum precationis exploraret et se firmum atque radicale ostenderet, verisimile erat ut Gilda Piscaria et Vicus Milo celeriter et decise agirent, hunc extraneum eliminantes ut alios atque factiones clandestine excitari deterrerent.

unit.source: In this scenario, Lumian, Lugano, and Ludwig were at risk.
unit.target: In hoc casu, Lumian, Lugano, et Ludwig in periculo erant.

unit.source: He specifically tasked Lugano to seek Valerio alone for the IDs, intending to see if Juan Oro and others had their eyes on his companions, seizing an opportunity to strike Lugano.
unit.target: Specialiter mandavit Lugano ut solus ad Valerium pro identificationibus properaret, intentus videre num Juan Oro et alii comites eius observarent, ut occasio ad ictum Lugano caperetur.

unit.source: This strategy allowed Lumian to swiftly intervene if needed, rescuing Lugano while potentially neutralizing some Beyonders from the Fisheries Guild, showcasing the adventurer’s strength and instilling confidence in onlookers, compelling further attempts.
unit.target: Haec consilium Lumian celeriter intervenire sinxit, Lugano servans, dum fortasse quibusdam Beyonders ex Gilda Piscaria neutralizaret, vi adventoris ostendens et fiduciam in spectantibus instillans, ulteriora conamina adhortans.

unit.source: However, the Fisheries Guild and Milo Village might not act immediately.
unit.target: Attamen, Gilda Piscaria et Vicus Milo fortasse non statim agere poterunt.

unit.source: They might feign vulnerability, luring hidden adversaries to reveal themselves before eliminating them in one fell swoop.
unit.target: Possunt vulnerabilitatem fingere, adversarios occultos alliciendo ut se revelent, antequam eos uno impetu tollant.

unit.source: Lumian shadowed Lugano to Valerio’s underground casino, observing him pay the remaining 50 gold risot for two local IDs.
unit.target: Lumian, Lugano ad casinum subterraneum Valerii secutus, eum spectabat dum reliquos 50 aureos “risot” pro duabus identificationibus localibus solvet.

unit.source: No attack… Could it be the Fisheries Guild is fishing, or did they fail to recognize Lugano after he used the Lie earring?
unit.target: Nulla oppugnatio… Num Gilda Piscaria piscationem exercet, aut Lugano postquam anulum „Lie“ usus est, non agnoscere potuerunt?

unit.source: Lumian pondered the potential reasons while traversing through the shadows.
unit.target: Lumian de causis potentialibus meditatus est, dum per umbras transibat.

unit.source: Lugano hurriedly avoided lingering on the streets, well aware that his employer had incurred the wrath of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Lugano festinanter evitavit in viis morari, pleno conscius quod patronus eius iram Gildae Piscariae adeptus esset.

unit.source: He feared being ambushed by those unwilling to target Lumian, dragged into an alley, and subjected to a brutal beating.
unit.target: Timebat ne ab iis, qui Lumian petere nollebant, in angulum traheretur atque saeviter percussus esset.

unit.source: Seeking refuge in a crevice between two buildings near Solow Motel, he swiftly reverted to his altered appearance.
unit.target: Quaerens asylum in fovea inter duas aedificia prope Solow Motel, celeriter ad speciem mutatam rediit.

unit.source: Removing the Lie earring, he switched into his customary black formal suit, finally exhaling a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Anulum „Lie“ removens, in vestem formalem nigrum propriam se convertit, tandem suspirium solacii efferens.

unit.source: He turned onto Aquina Street and made his way back to the motel’s entrance.
unit.target: Conversus est in Aquina Street et ad introitum motel perrexit.

unit.source: Several tramps lay dozing on both sides of the street, basking lazily in the sunlight.
unit.target: Plures mendici in utraque parte viae obdormientes iacebant, solis radiis pigritia foventes.

unit.source: Lumian was aware that unlike the severe tramp situation in the Loen Kingdom and the Intis Republic, Feynapotter’s tramp issue was less acute due to fertile soil, ample pastures, and the Church’s modified agricultural methods, resulting in surplus food production.
unit.target: Lumian sciebat quod, contrarie ad severam condicionem mendicorum in Regno Loen et in Re Publica Intis, quaestio mendicorum Feynapotter minus acuta esset, ob solum fertilis, prata ampla et rationes agriculturae Ecclesiae mutatas, quae ad superfluum cibum ducebantur.

unit.source: Here, food was notably cheaper, about 15 to 20% lower compared to Intis and other countries.
unit.target: Hic cibus notabiliter vilior erat, circiter 15 ad 20% minore comparatus ad Intis et alias terras.

unit.source: Previously, before the Loen Kingdom began importing food from Feynapotter, the price of rye bread of the same weight was nearly twice as high.
unit.target: Prius, antequam Regnum Loen cibum ex Feynapotter importare coepit, pretium panis secale eiusdem ponderis fere bis tantum altum erat.

unit.source: Despite the abundance, bankrupt farmers, herders, and city dwellers ended up as tramps due to land acquisition, loan sharks, and other reasons.
unit.target: Non obstante abundantia, agricolae in ruina, pastores, et cives urbium propter possessionem agrorum, usurarios, et alias causas mendici facti sunt.

unit.source: However, they received free food from various sources like the cathedral of Earth Mother, the Fertility Order, government departments, and charitable organizations, which although not filling, prevented starvation, allowing them to recuperate and find new opportunities.
unit.target: Sed cibum gratuitum ex variis fontibus, sicut a catedralibus Matris Terrae, Ordine Fertilitatis, officiis gubernationis, et organizationibus caritatis, acceperunt; quae, quamquam non satiabant, famem prohibebant, ita ut se recreare atque novas occasiones invenire possent.

unit.source: As Lugano neared Solow Motel, Lumian, concealed in the shadows, sensed a disturbance.
unit.target: Dum Lugano Solow Motel appropinquabat, Lumian, in umbris absconditus, tumultum sensit.

unit.source: Three tramps on the street abruptly stiffened, adjusting their postures unnaturally.
unit.target: Tres mendici in via repente rigidi facti sunt, habitus suos inusitate accommodantes.

unit.source: In an instant, they sprang to their feet like puppet marionettes, drawing revolvers in an odd manner and aiming at Lugano from three different angles.
unit.target: In momento ad pedes exsurgere coeperunt, velut marionettæ, revolveros insolite extrahentes et ex tribus angulis ad Lugano intendentes.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Bang! Bang! Bang!

unit.source: Their white-eyed state left Lugano no room to evade as they pulled their triggers successively.
unit.target: Eorum oculi candidi Lugano nullum spatium ad effugiendum reliquerunt, dum sinistra sua successive trahebantur.

unit.source: 555 Monster Illustrated
unit.target: 555 Monstra Illustrata

unit.source: 555 Monster Illustrated
unit.target: 555 Monstra Illustrata

unit.source: It wasn’t until three tramps pointed revolvers at him that Lugano sprang into action.
unit.target: Nisi postquam tres vagabundi in eum revolvera intendere coeperunt, Lugano ad agendum subito exsurgit.

unit.source: As a seasoned bounty hunter, he had no time to discern where the assailants planned to shoot.
unit.target: Ut venator peritus praedae, tempus non habebat ad perscrutandum quo hostes iaculaturos essent.

unit.source: He pushed off with strength in his feet, swiftly lunging to the side.
unit.target: Pedibus validis impulsus, celeriter ad latus se protulit.

unit.source: He dodged two bullets, but the third one was too close, altering his trajectory
unit.target: Duas globulas vitavit, sed tertia nimis prope erat, iter eius mutans.

unit.source: —inevitably striking him.
unit.target: —inevitabiliter eum percutiens.

unit.source: In midair, Lugano did something unconventional.
unit.target: In aere, Lugano rem insolitam egit.

unit.source: Instead of curling up to shield vital spots, he extended his body, using his palm to shield his chest.
unit.target: Pro cur se convolvere ad loca vitalia tuenda, corpus suum extendit, et palma pectoris munus tulit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bum!

unit.source: The bullet connected with his right rib, unleashing a vivid spray of blood.
unit.target: Globulus costam dexteram eius percussit, vividam sanguinis effusionem edens.

unit.source: With a thud, Lugano landed on the street, rolling forward to evade subsequent shots.
unit.target: Cum strepitu, Lugano in platea cecidit, volvens ad ictus posteriores vitandos.

unit.source: In the midst of his lunge, Lumian’s form materialized from the shadows by the roadside.
unit.target: In medio impetu suo, figura Lumiani ex umbris iuxta viam apparuit.

unit.source: He delivered a powerful punch to the tramp who had just fired.
unit.target: Vagabundo, qui modo tela iaculaverat, ictum validum dedit.

unit.source: With a resounding thud, the tramp’s eyes rolled back, and he crumpled, unconscious.
unit.target: Cum strepitu sonoro, oculi vagabundi retrorsum voltabantur, et ipse corruit, inanimatus.

unit.source: Lumian returned to the shadows and swiftly moved behind another tramp.
unit.target: Lumian ad umbras rediit, et celeriter post alium vagabundum se contulit.

unit.source: Before he could fire a second shot, Lumian punched him behind the ear.
unit.target: Priusquam vagabundus alterum ictum iaculareret, Lumian eum post auriculam percussit.

unit.source: As the tramp collapsed, Lugano skillfully evaded the second bullet fired by the remaining assailant.
unit.target: Dum vagabundus corruit, Lugano callide secundum globulum a reliquo aggressore iaculatum vitavit.

unit.source: In that tense moment, passersby and elderly women chatting on the street scattered, desperately seeking cover.
unit.target: In illo momento angustae tensionis, transeuntes et senes feminae in platea colloquentes se disperserunt, refugium acriter quaerentes.

unit.source: The surroundings seemed eerily vacant.
unit.target: Ambitus insolitē desertus videbatur.

unit.source: Shadows danced as Lumian emerged from the darkness beside the last assailant.
unit.target: Umbræ saltabant dum Lumian ex tenebris iuxta ultimum aggressorem emergit.

unit.source: Extending his right palm, he seized the other’s neck.
unit.target: Dextram palmam extendens, cervicem alterius prehendit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, the assailant’s mouth opened naturally, emitting a slender black shadow.
unit.target: Paene simul, os aggressoris naturaliter aperiebatur, tenui nigro umbram efferens.

unit.source: An insect, as thick as a finger, with tentacle-like bristles floating on its body, lunged straight for Lumian’s neck.
unit.target: Insectum, digito crasso, cum setis tentaculosis in corpore suo fluitantibus, directe ad Lumiani cervicem impetum fecit.

unit.source: “Hmph!”
unit.target: Hem!

unit.source: Two pale-white beams of light flickered in Lumian’s nostrils.
unit.target: Duo radii pallido-albi lucis in naribus Lumiani micabant.

unit.source: The slender, peculiar black insect lost its strength, gently descending into his raised left palm.
unit.target: Insectum tenuem et insolitum nigrum vim amisit, leniter in palmam sinistram elevatam descendens.

unit.source: As anticipated… Lumian withdrew his right hand from the tramp’s neck, unfazed.
unit.target: Ut praedictum erat... Lumian dextram manum a vagabundi cervice abstulit, imperturbatus.

unit.source: The tramp’s eyes returned to normal.
unit.target: Oculi vagabundi ad statum consuetam redierunt.

unit.source: Clutching his revolver, he staggered backward, leaning against the wall before slumping to the ground in a daze.
unit.target: Revolverum tenens, retro titubavit, ad parietem inclinatus, deinde in terram languide cadens.

unit.source: Lumian paid him no heed.
unit.target: Lumian eum non curavit.

unit.source: Utilizing the shadows, he swiftly approached an unconscious tramp, noticing a small, bloodless wound on the back of his cervical spine.
unit.target: Utens umbris, celeriter ad vagabundum inanimatum accessit, parvum vulneris, sine sanguine, in dorso colli eius notans.

unit.source: Another slender, bristle-covered black insect darted out, attempting escape.
unit.target: Alter insectum nigrum, tenuis et setis indutum, exsilit, effugere conans.

unit.source: Lumian’s hand, engulfed in crimson flames, seized it.
unit.target: Manus Lumiani, in flammis coccineis ardentibus, illud rapuit.

unit.source: After a few struggles, the insect emitted a cooked fragrance.
unit.target: Post paucas conatus, insectum odorem coctum effudit.

unit.source: Subsequently, Lumian employed a similar method to handle the strange black insect emerging from another tramp’s body.
unit.target: Postea, Lumian eandem rationem ad tractandum insolitum insectum nigrum ex corpore alii vagabundi emergentem adhibuit.

unit.source: During this procedure, Lugano half-squatted on the street, his left palm flickering with a clear light as he pressed it against the gunshot wound on his right rib.
unit.target: Interim, Lugano in platea ad dimidium genu flectens sedebat, palmo sinistro luce clara micante, illam contra vulnera telorum in costa dextra premens.

unit.source: The charred wound immediately contracted, ceasing to ooze blood.
unit.target: Vulnus exustum statim contraxit, sanguis effluere desinens.

unit.source: Drawing a dagger, Lugano skillfully “picked” a yellow bullet from the wound with precision and efficacy.
unit.target: Acuto sumpto, Lugano peritia “extraxit” globulum flavum ex vulneri, cum subtilitate et efficacia.

unit.source: With that accomplished, he generated a faint light in his left palm, pressing it against the wound.
unit.target: Hoc confecto, lumen tenuissimum in palmo sinistro gignit, et illud contra vulnera premens.

unit.source: The injury squirmed and swiftly fused, reducing to a fifth of its original size in no time.
unit.target: Vulnus contortus celeriter adunatus est, statim ad partem quintam originis redactus.

unit.source: Lugano had intentionally stretched, hoping the bullet would hit a spot he could conveniently handle!
unit.target: Lugano se proposito extendit, sperans globulum in locum incidere, quem facile administrare posset!

unit.source: As he retrieved a bandage to tend to the remaining wound, Lumian approached, extending his free right palm.
unit.target: Dum fascia ad reliquum vulnerum curandum acciperet, Lumian accessit, dextram manum liberam extendens.

unit.source: Understanding his employer’s gesture, Lugano returned the Lie earring, expressing relief, “Fortunately, I’m a Doctor. As long as I’m not killed on the spot, gunshot wounds aren’t a big deal.”
unit.target: Comprehendens gestum datori suo, Lugano restituit monile “Lie”, levamen exprimens: “Felix, medicus sum. Dummodo in situ non occidar, vulnera telorum parva sunt.”

unit.source: Silently, Lumian donned the silver Lie earring.
unit.target: Tacite, Lumian monile argenteum “Lie” inductus est.

unit.source: Leaning down, he pressed and swiped at Lugano’s wound, transferring it to the back of his right hand.
unit.target: Inclinans se, vulnera Lugani premens et circumactans, eam in dorsum dextrae manus transferuit.

unit.source: Due to the disparity in location and Lugano’s pre-treatment, the wound regressed into a small scrape—one akin to scraping against a rough wall.
unit.target: Ob diversitatem locorum et praeviam curationem Lugani, vulnus in parvam laniationem rediit, similem ad repugnationem contra parietem asperum.

unit.source: “…” Lugano stared at the wound that didn’t even require a bandage, falling into a prolonged silence.
unit.target: “…” Lugano vulneri intuens, quod ne fascia quidem requirebatur, in longam silentii statum cecidit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and remarked, “Why else do you think I let you carry Lie?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Quare aliud putas me te portare Lie permissurum esse?”

unit.source: “…” Lugano gaped, uncertain of what to say.
unit.target: “…” Lugano attonitus stetit, nesciens quid diceret.

unit.source: Surveying the area, Lumian instructed, “Take the three tramps’ guns and wait for the police to arrive.
unit.target: Ambitum percepit, Lumian praecepit: “Accipe arma trium vagabundorum et exspecta adventum vigilum.”

unit.source: Report that you were attacked.
unit.target: Narrā quod aggressus es.

unit.source: After giving your statement, if there’s nothing else, take Ludwig to the Fertility Order’s entrance and have them uphold justice and maintain order in Port Santa.”
unit.target: Postquam relationem dederis, si nihil aliud, Ludwig ad introitum Ordinis Fertilitatis ducas, et iustitiam servare ac ordinem in Portu Santa conservare iube.

unit.source: “Alright, alright.” Lugano hurriedly stood up.
unit.target: “Bene, bene.” Lugano festinanter surrexit.

unit.source: Just as he took two steps toward the dazed tramp, realization struck.
unit.target: Dum duo gradus ad vagabundum obnubilatum fecit, repente intellectus eum percussit.

unit.source: He turned around and blurted, “What about you? Where are you going?”
unit.target: Se vertit et exclamavit, “Quid de te? Quo vadis?”

unit.source: In his haste, he had forgotten to use honorifics.
unit.target: In festinatione, honores verba non adhibere oblitus erat.

unit.source: Lumian simply chuckled, saying nothing.
unit.target: Lumian leviter risit, nihil dicens.

unit.source: I sent you to the Fertility Order to inform them of my intentions—to let them know!
unit.target: Te ad Ordinem Fertilitatis misi ut de propositis meis eos certiores facerem—ut notum faceres!

unit.source: Lumian proceeded towards Solow Motel, leaving crimson flames in his wake that incinerated the blood dripped by Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian versus Solow Motel processit, relinquens flammas coccineas in vestigiis, quae sanguinem a Lugano stillantem combusterunt.

unit.source: As he advanced, Lumian lowered his voice and asked, “Temiboros, do you recognize these insects?”
unit.target: Dum processit, Lumian vocem demittit et quaesivit: “Temiboros, agnoscisne haec insecta?”

unit.source: Termiboros remained silent.
unit.target: Termiboros tacuit.

unit.source: Upon reaching the suite on the fifth floor, Lumian observed Ludwig eagerly awaiting him.
unit.target: Ad conclave in quinto tabulato perveniens, Lumian Ludovicum animo avido eum exspectantem observavit.

unit.source: His heart stirred as he spread his left palm, revealing three black insects.
unit.target: Cor eius concitato, palmo sinistro extendens, tres insecta nigra ostendit.

unit.source: Casually, he inquired, “Do you know what these are?”
unit.target: Levis animo, quaesivit: “Scisne quid haec sint?”

unit.source: Ludwig nodded obediently, speaking swiftly, “Batings Black Insect, a creature from Planet Heveen 3.”
unit.target: Ludwig obediebili modo annuens celeriter locutus est: “Insectum Nigrum Batings, creatura ex Planeta Heveen 3.”

unit.source: Rich in various proteins and possessing high energy levels.
unit.target: Divitis variis proteinis et altis viribus energeticae praeditum.

unit.source: They invade human bodies via the cervical spine, controlling their nervous systems to manipulate them to their advantage.
unit.target: Corporibus humanis per spina cervicali invadunt, nervorum systemata regentes ut ipsos ad suam utilitatem gubernent.

unit.source: These Batings Black Insects ceased evolving generations ago.
unit.target: Hi Insecta Nigra Batings generationes abhinc evolvere desierunt.

unit.source: While controlling the nervous system, the host’s movements stiffen, and their eyes roll back.
unit.target: Regendo systema nervosum, motus hospitis rigidantur, et oculi retrorsum vertuntur.

unit.source: They seldom directly kill the host, but their larvae, once laid, absorb the host’s energy, indirectly leading to their demise.
unit.target: Raro hospitem directe interficere solent, sed larvæ eorum, semel positae, energiam hospitis absorbunt, et ita ad ipsorum exitium ducunt.

unit.source: In ancient times, many of their ancestors received boons.
unit.target: Antiquitus, multi maiorum eorum beneficia recepērunt.

unit.source: Though their descendants no longer possess these, their body structures adapted to the boon’s power were inherited, eventually evolving into this special species with minor Beyonder-level powers.
unit.target: Quamquam posteri eorum haec iam non possident, sed structurae corporales, dono potentiae accommodatae, hereditate obtentae, tandem in hanc speciem specialem cum parvis viribus Beyonder similis evolutae sunt.

unit.source: Consider it a special spirit world creature or a degenerated Beyonder creature.
unit.target: Id considera creaturam ex mundo spirituum specialem vel creaturam Beyonder degeneratam.

unit.source: After the long explanation, Ludwig gazed at Lumian longingly, asking, “That’s all I have to say. Can I eat them now?”
unit.target: Post longam expositionem, Ludwig Lumianum desiderio intuentem interrogavit: “Hoc tantum habeo dicendum. Possumne ea nunc edere?”

unit.source: You really know… You make it sound so real.
unit.target: Scis vere… Illud tam verum sonare facis.

unit.source: The Batings Black Insect, Planet Heveen 3.
unit.target: Insectum Nigrum Batings, Planeta Heveen 3.

unit.source: What’s happening… The alien planets Aurore mentioned?
unit.target: Quid fit... Planetæ extranei quos Aurore memoraverat?

unit.source: Lumian was taken aback.
unit.target: Lumian obstupuit.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised that Ludwig had the desire to consume the Batings Black Insects.
unit.target: Lumian non miratus est quod Ludwig desiderium edendi Insecta Nigra Batings haberet.

unit.source: This guy could even gnaw on live rats!
unit.target: Hic etiam muribus viventibus roere poterat!

unit.source: The insects even emitted a rather pleasant fragrance after being roasted.
unit.target: Insecta etiam odorem satis iucundum emiserunt postquam torrefacta sunt.

unit.source: Lumian stared at Ludwig for a few seconds before handing over the three Batings Black Insects in his hand.
unit.target: Lumian per paucos secundos in Ludovicum intuebatur, antequam tria Insecta Nigra Batings in manu ei tradidit.

unit.source: Ludwig didn’t hide his delight.
unit.target: Ludovicus gaudium suum non celavit.

unit.source: He swiftly devoured two of the roasted insects, relishing the explosion of juices in his mouth.
unit.target: Celeriter duas ex insectis torrefactis devoravit, gustans explosionem succorum in ore suo.

unit.source: He half-closed his eyes, and an unusual fluctuation seemed to surge within him.
unit.target: Semicis oculos clausit, et fluctus insolitus intus in eo quasi exarsit.

unit.source: Lumian furrowed his brow in confusion but refrained from intervening.
unit.target: Lumian frontem contraxit confusus, sed intervenire coartatus est.

unit.source: Having used the Mystery Prying Glasses to discover that there appeared to be something beneath Ludwig’s skin, coupled with Ludwig’s daily behavior and the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom’s stance, Lumian speculated that the boy was a monster in human guise, sealed by the Church to carry out tasks inconvenient for deploying clergymen.
unit.target: Utendo Speculis Arcanis ad detegendum quasi aliquid sub cute Ludovici latere, necnon ex more cotidie agendi Ludovici atque positione Ecclesiae Dei Cognitionis et Sapientiae, Lumian coniecerit puerum esse monstrum sub specie hominis, a Ecclesia sigillatum ad officia incommoda pro clericis exsequenda.

unit.source: Regarding the Reader pathway controlled by the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, it held various applications at the Body of Heart and Mind level.
unit.target: Quoad viam Lectorem a Ecclesia Dei Cognitionis et Sapientiae regendam, illa varia usus habebat in gradu Corporis, Cordis atque Mentis.

unit.source: It was reasonable to assume why Ludwig’s mind had suffered damage after being sealed, rendering him seemingly foolish.
unit.target: Rationabiliter putabant cur mens Ludovici post sigillum laesus esset, ita eum quasi stultum reddens.

unit.source: After 20 to 30 seconds, Ludwig opened his eyes and rushed to the dining table.
unit.target: Post viginti ad tricenam secundis, Ludwig oculos aperuit et ad mensam ientaculi festinavit.

unit.source: Grabbing a small steel table knife, he carefully placed the remaining Batings Black Insect on the tablecloth and skillfully cut it open, removing numerous black fascias.
unit.target: Parvum cultellum ex ferro mensale arripiens, reliquum Insectum Nigrum Batings super linteum mensae diligenter posuit et arte secavit, plures fascias nigras removens.

unit.source: Ludwig poured a glass of Manzan and arranged the fascia and the shell of the Batings Black Insect on the table, adding the black juice squeezed from the insect’s body.
unit.target: Ludwig poculum Manzan effudit et fasciam atque testam Insecti Nigri Batings in mensa disposuit, addens sucum nigrum ex corpore insecti exprimitum.

unit.source: Lumian observed as the pale-golden liquor swiftly transformed into a dark-red, almost black hue, emitting dense bubbles.
unit.target: Lumian intuens, liquamen pallido-aureum celeriter in colorem rubrum paene nigrum mutatum et densas bullas emittere incipit.

unit.source: Once the bubbles subsided, Ludwig lifted the peculiar cocktail.
unit.target: Postquam bullae defecerunt, Ludwig potum mixtum insolitum sustulit.

unit.source: Only then did he remember Lumian’s presence.
unit.target: Tum tantummodo memor fuit praesentiae Lumiani.

unit.source: Stammering, he asked, “Can I —can I drink a little?”
unit.target: Balbutiens, quaesivit: “Possumne—possumne paulum bibere?”

unit.source: A sealed Body of Heart and Mind indeed… Lumian smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Certe Corpus Cordis ac Mentis sigillatum… Lumian subridens et suspirans dixit.

unit.source: “Drink up.”
unit.target: “Bibe.”

unit.source: Gulp! Gulp! Ludwig finished the small amount of dark-red nearly black liquor and expressed satisfaction to Lumian, saying, “After concocting the Batings Black Insect’s bodily fluids, it can enhance the physique of those who drink it for the first time to a certain extent.
unit.target: Guttus! Guttus! Ludwig parvum modum liquaminis obscuri-rubri, paene nigri, finivit, et satisfactionem suam Lumiano exprimit: “Postquam fluidis corporis Insecti Nigri Batings concoctis, id figuram illorum qui primum bibunt ad aliquem modum augere potest.

unit.source: It grants everyone the ability to paralyze primate creatures within two hours.
unit.target: Omnibus dat facultatem creaturas primatas intra duas horas paralysare.

unit.source: Yes, it will only be effective through contact.
unit.target: Ita, tantum per contactum efficax erit.

unit.source: Th-this is turning the Batings Black Insect into something akin to charms?
unit.target: Ha—hoc Insectum Nigrum Batings in aliquid simile talismanis redigit?

unit.source: Moreover, it provides permanent effects and short-term Beyonder powers…
unit.target: Praeterea, effectus permanens et breves potentias Beyonder offert…

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s surprise, he sensed that Ludwig had undergone significant changes.
unit.target: Inter stuporem Lumiani, sensit Ludovicum mutationes significantes passi esse.

unit.source: He had never demonstrated the ability to prepare such food before!
unit.target: Numquam antea facultatem ad talia edulia praeparanda ostensum habuerat!

unit.source: Lumian didn’t delve deeper and calmly remarked, “Take Lugano to the Fertility Order’s entrance later and ensure he informs Noelia about the attack.”
unit.target: Lumian non ulterius intravit et tranquille dixit: “Postea Lugano ad introitum Ordinis Fertilitatis ducas, et curare ut Noelia de impetu certiorem fiat.”

unit.source: “Alright.” In a good mood, Ludwig readily agreed.
unit.target: “Bene.” Ludwig, bono animo, facile consentivit.

unit.source: Meanwhile at the port district—while Ludwig and Lugano arrived at the Fertility Order.
unit.target: Interea in regione portuaria—dum Ludwig et Lugano ad Ordinem Fertilitatis pervenissent.

unit.source: Wearing a golden straw hat, Lumian strolled towards the square dominated by an Ocean Waves statue.
unit.target: Gerens pileum stramineum aureum, Lumian ad forum, quod statua Undarum Oceanorum dominabatur, ambulavit.

unit.source: His attention focused on the grayish-black house adorned with the Port Santa Fisheries Guild’s sign.
unit.target: Animus eius ad domum fuscovirilis ornata signo Societatis Piscatoriae Portus Santae intendit.

unit.source: The four- or five-story castle-like ancient structure was rumored to be over a millennium old, having been destroyed and rebuilt centuries ago.
unit.target: Structura antiqua, castelli similis, quattuor aut quinque tabulata, fama erat plus mille annos nata, quondam deleta et saeculis refecta.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes traced the intricate symbols on the wall, which included iron hooks and fishing nets.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani symbola intricata in pariete secuti sunt, quae includebant hamulos ferreos et rete piscatorium.

unit.source: Adjusting his straw hat, he proceeded towards the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Pileum stramineum aptans, ad Societatem Piscatoriam processit.

unit.source: 556 Violent Beating
unit.target: 556 Violenta Percussio

unit.source: 556 Violent Beating
unit.target: 556 Violenta Percussio

unit.source: The encampment of the Fertility Order in Port Santa sprawled along the city’s edge, nestled near the suburbs.
unit.target: Castra Ordinis Fertilitatis in Portu Santa per limitem urbis se extendebant, prope suburbia condita.

unit.source: It claimed an entire street, complete with fields, orchards, and a variety of livestock, providing a self-sufficient haven for the nuns when they weren’t on missions.
unit.target: Totam viam occupabat, cum agris, hortis, et varietate pecorum instructa, qua monialibus otium proprium dabatur, cum missionibus non adfuerunt.

unit.source: Lugano gripped Ludwig’s hand and raised his eyes to the green vines entwining the cloister’s spire, with the Sacred Emblem of Life at its center.
unit.target: Lugano manum Ludovici prehendit et oculos levavit ad virides uvas circum turrim claustri infixas, in qua Sacrum Emblema Vitae in medium collocatum erat.

unit.source: A simple depiction of a baby amidst wheat ears, flowers, spring water, and other symbols.
unit.target: Depictio simplex infanti inter spigas tritici, flores, aquam fontis, et alia symbola.

unit.source: Turning to Noelia, he uttered, “I was attacked. Just wrapped up my statement at the police station.”
unit.target: Ad Noeliam conversus dixit: “Me oppugnatum sum. Mox testimonium meum in statione vigilum finivi.”

unit.source: Noelia, adorned with a black hat adorned with white patterns, blending religion and combat, furrowed her brow and inquired, “Where’s Louis Berry?”
unit.target: Noelia, pileo nigro cum figuris albis ornata, quae religionem et pugnam miscet, frontem contraxit et interrogavit: “Ubi est Louis Berry?”

unit.source: Rather than delving into the specifics of Lugano’s assault, she honed in on the whereabouts of Louis Berry, the great adventurer.
unit.target: Non ad intrandum in singularia oppugnationis Lugani se dedit, sed potius quaerebat ubi esset Louis Berry, magnus viator.

unit.source: Lugano shook his head and replied earnestly, “I don’t know. He told me to come here after giving my statement and inform you that I was attacked.”
unit.target: Lugano caput concussit et vere respondit: “Nescio. Mihi dixit ut post testimonium meum hic accederem et te certiorem facerem me oppugnatum esse.”

unit.source: Noelia’s expression shifted to solemnity.
unit.target: Vultus Noeliae ad sollemnitatem mutatus est.

unit.source: In the bustling port district, standing before the robust grayish-black edifice of the Fisheries Guild,
unit.target: In vivace regione portuaria, stans coram robusto aedificio cinereo–nigro Societatis Piscatoriae,

unit.source: Lumian, now garbed in a white shirt, black vest, and brown pants, topped with a golden straw hat, casually strode to the building.
unit.target: Lumian, nunc in camisā albā, loricā nigra et braccīs fuscīs indutus, atque pileō stramineō aureō completus, ad aedificium leviter processit.

unit.source: The two guards stationed here lacked guns, carrying only straight swords on their backs and daggers at their waists, blending in with the multitude of passersby.
unit.target: Duo custodes hic positi tormenta non gerebant, sed solum gladios rectos in tergo et pugiones ad latus portantes, inter multitudinem transeuntorum se conciliantes.

unit.source: “Who are you looking for?” Both guards extended their hands simultaneously, halting Lumian’s advance.
unit.target: «Quem quaeris?»

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t “comprehend” Highlander. Without hesitation, he drew his revolver, pointed it towards the sky, and squeezed the trigger.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit “Highlander” intellegere.

unit.source: Amidst the gunshot’s echo, he slipped between the two guards, entering the castle-like abode of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Inter sonitum sclopetorum, inter duos custodes se fugiens, in aedificium quasi castelli Societatis Piscatoriae ingrediit.

unit.source: The guards exchanged uncertain glances but refrained from intervening.
unit.target: Custodes oculos incertos inter se commutaverunt, sed intervenire non ausi sunt.

unit.source: One of them dashed towards the port’s police station, while the other hurried into the grayish-black building, aiming to report to his superior and seek guidance.
unit.target: Unus eorum ad stationem vigilum portus festinavit, dum alter in aedificium cinereo–nigrum properavit ut superiori referret atque consilium quaereret.

unit.source: Clutching his revolver, Lumian advanced at a measured pace. Beneath the puzzled stares of the staff, who hastily sidestepped, he traversed the hall and ascended the stairs leading to the committee member’s office.
unit.target: Revolver suum tenens, Lumian gradibus modicis procedebat.

unit.source: Just as he approached the second floor, a figure appeared before him.
unit.target: Mox, cum ad secundum tabulatum appropinquaret, figura coram eo apparuit.

unit.source: Bronze-hued skin, broad and sturdy physique, black hair, and blue eyes characterized the young man who had aided the Fisheries Guild’s president, Juan Oro.
unit.target: Cutis aerea, corpus lato et robustum, capilli nigri et oculi caerulei iuvenem extollebant, qui praesidi Societatis Piscatoriae, Juan Oro, auxilium tulit.

unit.source: He was Fernandez Oro, the old man’s grandson.
unit.target: Ille erat Fernandez Oro, nepos senis.

unit.source: Fernandez glared at Lumian ascending step by step, gritting his teeth.
unit.target: Fernandez ad Lumian, qui gradatim ascendebat, intueri coepit, dentes strenue contrivens.
