unit.source: “How dare you intrude into the guild!”
unit.target: «Quo audes in societatem irrumpere!»

unit.source: Lumian paid him no heed. He maintained a steady pace, neither hastening nor slowing as he approached the entrance to the second floor.
unit.target: Lumian eum non attendit.

unit.source: Fernandez masked his expression, his back slightly arched, and his eyes appeared to radiate an ominous glow.
unit.target: Fernandez vultum suum celavit, dorso paulum incurvato, et oculi eius lumen ominosum radiabant.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian sensed a significant dimming of the ambient light.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian lucis ambientis notabilem diminutionem sensit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, an intangible force descended from above, entwining around his feet, making him feel shorter and causing his body to sway.
unit.target: Simul, vis intangibilis ex alto descendit, pedes eius involvens, eum brevioris sensu efficit et corpus vacillare incitavit.

unit.source: Fernandez, in contrast, seemed to grow taller, casting dense shadows that engulfed the corridor’s meager light.
unit.target: Fernandez, contra, altior videri solebat, umbras densas proiciens quae lumen exiguum corridoris occulgebant.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: Advancing, Fernandez swung his right fist towards Lumian’s head.
unit.target: Procedens, Fernandez pugnus dextrum suum ad caput Lumiani ferivit.

unit.source: A gusty wind permeated the space, propelling the fist with hammer-like force, guided by an unseen magnet.
unit.target: Ventus impetuosus spatium pervasit, pugnum quasi malle impellens, ignoto magnete ductum.

unit.source: Lumian gazed upward as something within him erupted, shattering the binding force.
unit.target: Lumian sursum aspexit, cum aliquid intus in eo erupisset, vim ligantem frangens.

unit.source: His thighs swelled suddenly, and his loose brown pants constricted.
unit.target: Femoribus eius subito inflatis et braccae fuscae, quae olim erant laxae, contraxerunt.

unit.source: He grew taller seemingly out of thin air, sleeves and pants tightening around bulging muscles.
unit.target: Altior factus est, quasi ex aere, manicae et braccae circa musculosos conspicuos arcte cohibebantur.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bum!

unit.source: A left punch from Lumian met Fernandez’s incoming fist in a thunderous collision, causing the stairs to quiver and sway.
unit.target: Pugno sinistro a Lumiano, cum pugnus imminens Fernandez in collisione tonitruali occurrit, scalae trepidare et vacillare coegerunt.

unit.source: Fernandez, forced back two steps, bore no fear but a hint of joy on his face.
unit.target: Fernandez, duos gradus retrorsum coactus, timorem non sed parvam laetitiam in vultu gerebat.

unit.source: Retreating, his eyes darkened with a touch of brilliance.
unit.target: Retrocedens, oculi eius parvo fulgore obscurabantur.

unit.source: Raising his left hand, a dark-green light swiftly concentrated on his unusually rough fingertips.
unit.target: Levans manum sinistram, lumen viride obscurum celeriter in digitos eius insolito asperos concentratum est.

unit.source: The light transformed into a ray, silently hurtling towards Lumian, momentarily immobilized by the collision.
unit.target: Lumen in radium conversum est, silentio versus Lumian volans, momento collisione immobilis factus.

unit.source: Fernandez chose close combat from the start, creating an opening for the ray, capable of disrupting the human structure and inducing swift internal injuries.
unit.target: Fernandez ab initio modum pugnandi proximum elegit, angum pro radio efficiens, qui structuram humanam disrumpere et vulnera interna celeriter inferre posset.

unit.source: The dark-green danger ray matched the speed of light. Lumian, unable to dodge in advance, could only watch as it struck between his chest and abdomen.
unit.target: Radius periculi viridis obscuri luci celeritate aequabat.

unit.source: Yet, the dark-green ray pierced through, striking only an illusion.
unit.target: Attamen radius viridis obscuri pertransiit, tantum illusionem feriens.

unit.source: Leveraging the Ascetic’s accumulated strength in clashing with Fernandez, Lumian had seized the chance to arch his back and stand in place like an arc, deftly evading potential sneak attacks.
unit.target: Vi asceticorum in pugna cum Fernandez collecta utens, Lumian occasionem cepit dorsum suum arcum fingere atque in loco quasi arcus stantem, callide insidias evitans.

unit.source: In this intricate dance, he even employed the Niese Face, creating an illusion of himself still standing upright!
unit.target: In hoc saltatione intricata etiam Niese Faciem usus est, creans illusionem seipsum adhuc erectum stantem!

unit.source: Gradually, the dark-green ray dissipated, vanishing around the corner of the stairs.
unit.target: Paulatim, radius viridis obscuri dissipatus est, circa angulum scalarium evanescens.

unit.source: Suddenly, a crimson fire, nearly white-hot, erupted from Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Subito, ignis ruber, paene candide calens, ex corpore Lumiani erupit.

unit.source: Transformed into a fireball, he hurtled towards Fernandez, who had just regained his footing.
unit.target: Transmutatus in globum ignis, ad Fernandez festinans pervenit, qui modo pedes reciperaverat.

unit.source: Fernandez’s pupils constricted, seemingly challenged by the blaze.
unit.target: Pupillae Fernandez contractae sunt, quasi igne provocatae.

unit.source: Swiftly, he sidestepped, clenched his right hand into a fist, and yanked it down.
unit.target: Celeriter, se declinavit; dextram manum in pugnus comprimens eam deiecit.

unit.source: An invisible force tugged Lumian to the ground, but undeterred, he dispersed the flames, reappearing with feet firmly planted on the corridor floor.
unit.target: Vis invisibilis Lumian ad terram trahebat; sed non deterritus, flammas disperdidit et re apparuit, pedibus ferme in pavimento corridoris positis.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: His massive form stomped heavily, causing the building to sway.
unit.target: Eius immanis forma graviter calcitravit, aedificium vacillare faciens.

unit.source: In a single stride, he stood before Fernandez, who had just risen.
unit.target: Unico passu, coram Fernandez stetit, qui modo surrexit.

unit.source: His left fist, wreathed in crimson, nearly white flames, collided with Fernandez.
unit.target: Pugnus sinistrum, flammis rubris paene candidis circumvolutus, cum Fernandez collidit.

unit.source: Without a moment to activate his superpowers, Fernandez raised his arms hastily to block.
unit.target: Nullo momento facultatum suarum superarum excitandarum, Fernandez celeriter bracchia levavit ad obstruendum.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: Flames erupted as Lumian’s punch sent the young man flying, crashing into the partially open side office, demolishing the wooden desk.
unit.target: Flammae erupere coeperunt, dum pugno Lumiani iuvenem volitantem projiceret, in officium lateralem semiapertum collidens, mensam ligneam delevit.

unit.source: Capitalizing on Fernandez’s disorientation and pain, Lumian followed, rushing into the office and delivering another punch with his left fist.
unit.target: Ex confusione et dolore Fernandez lucratus, Lumian festinanter in officium intrans et alterum pugnum manu sinistra perferens secutus est.

unit.source: Boom! Crimson flames, nearly white, illuminated the room as the punch explosively struck Fernandez’s chest.
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: The flames were contained by an unseen force, preventing them from entirely obliterating Fernandez’s chest.
unit.target: Flammae a vis invisibili cohibitae sunt, ne totum pectus Fernandez deleantur.

unit.source: Instead, they crumpled, clouding the target’s vision.
unit.target: Proinde, contritae sunt, obiecti visionem obscurantes.

unit.source: Expressionless, Lumian halted, gazing at the semi-conscious Fernandez.
unit.target: Sine expressione, Lumian cessavit et ad Fernandez semi–conscientem aspiciens stetit.

unit.source: He raised his left hand.
unit.target: Manum sinistram levavit.

unit.source: A colossal crimson fireball, nearly white, condensed rapidly, poised to act as a Reaper.
unit.target: Globulus magnus ignis ruber, paene candidus, celeriter condensatus est, paratus ut Messor ageret.

unit.source: In the next instant, the fireball shot forth, homing in on Fernandez.
unit.target: In proximo momento, globus ignis subito proiecit, ad Fernandez contendens.

unit.source: Abruptly, it ascended, passing the target, and collided with the wall behind the desk.
unit.target: Subito, ascendit, obiectum transiens, et muro post mensam occurrit.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: Blazing white and red flames burst through the glass window, the wall, and ignited outside the Fisheries Guild building, creating fiery clouds in the air.
unit.target: Flammae candidae et rubrae per fenestram vitream, murumque, et extra aedificium Societatis Piscatoriae eruptae sunt, nubes ignis in aere creantes.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian felt as though he entered a dark and profound void. Distant, resplendent stars blinked like vigilant eyes.
unit.target: Prope simul, Lumian sensit quasi in vacuum obscurum et profundum intravisset;

unit.source: Once more, he confronted Juan Oro, an elderly man with deeply etched wrinkles.
unit.target: Iterum, se confrontavit cum Juan Oro, senex rugis altissime incisis.

unit.source: At that moment, Noelia had rushed to the square where the statue of the waves stood, shouting towards the building with a fallen window frame,
unit.target: Illo momento, Noelia ad forum cucurrit, ubi statua fluctuum stabat, et, tenens lapsam structuram fenestrarum, ad aedificium clamavit.

unit.source: “Stop!”
unit.target: «Siste!»

unit.source: At the sound of the combat nun’s voice, Lumian sighed with regret, swiveled his revolver, and holstered it under his armpit. Juan Oro and the surrounding void vanished.
unit.target: Ad sonitum vocis monialis pugnantis, Lumian maere suspiravit, revolver suum vertit et sub brachio recondidit.

unit.source: A few minutes later, Juan Oro emerged from the grayish-black building of the Fisheries Guild with his walking stick.
unit.target: Paucis post, Juan Oro ex aedificio cinereo–nigro Societatis Piscatoriae cum baculo ambulatorio emersit.

unit.source: In a deep voice, he addressed Noelia, “He attacked Fernandez. You must apprehend him!”
unit.target: Voce profunda, ad Noeliam dixit: “Fernandez oppugnavit. Illum apprehendere debes!”

unit.source: Noelia cast a cold glance at the president of the Fisheries Guild and retorted, “Should I then invite Fernandez to the police station to assist in the investigation of the Aquina Street shooting?
unit.target: Noelia, praesidi Societatis Piscatoriae oculis frigide intuita, respondit: “An ergo Fernandez ad stationem vigilum invitare debeam, ut in inquisitione caedis in Via Aquina assistat?”

unit.source: “All of you, calm down and jointly maintain order in Port Santa. Otherwise, do you think the Church can’t handle any of you?”
unit.target: “Omnes vos, quieti sitis et communiter ordinem in Portu Santa conservetis. Alioquin, putasne Ecclesiam vestram non posse quemquam ex vobis tractare?”

unit.source: In the final words, the combat nun shifted her gaze to Lumian, issuing a warning as a gesture of fairness.
unit.target: In verbis finalibus, monialis pugnantis oculos in Lumian convertere coepit et monitionem aequitatis gestu edidit.

unit.source: Juan Oro fell silent for a moment before stating, “I don’t know anything about the Aquina Street shooting.”
unit.target: Juan Oro per momentum tacuit, deinde dixit: “Nihil de caede in Via Aquina scio.”

unit.source: With that, he turned and limped back to the Fisheries Guild with his cane, where many employees rushed to assist him.
unit.target: Hoc facto, conversus est et claudicatione cum baculo rediit ad Societatem Piscatoriae, ubi multi operarii ad eum festinanter convenerunt.

unit.source: Observing this, Noelia led her combat team to “escort” Lumian away.
unit.target: Observans hoc, Noelia duxit turmam suam pugnantem ut Lumian extrinsecus comitetur.

unit.source: Once out of the port district, the combat nun instructed her team members to slow down and create some distance, walking alongside Lumian herself.
unit.target: Egressis e regione portuaria, monialis pugnantis turmam suam imperavit ut tardius moverentur et aliquam distantiam inter se creassent, ipsa Lumian comitans ambulans.

unit.source: “You’re making things difficult for us. Order, understand? Superficial order must be maintained.” Noelia raised her hand, pinching both sides of her forehead. “Fortunately, you didn’t really kill Fernandez. Otherwise, I would have had no choice but to carry out the arrest.”
unit.target: “Vos res nobis difficiles facitis. Ordo, intellegitis? Ordo superficialis conservandus est.”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “If I truly wanted to kill Fernandez, he wouldn’t have survived until your intervention or Juan Oro’s rescue.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Si Fernandez vere occidere voluissem, ille non superfuisset usque ad auxilium vestrum aut ad servationem Juan Oro.”

unit.source: His words held undeniable truth.
unit.target: Verba eius veritatem innegabilem continebant.

unit.source: Noelia was taken aback. After a few seconds of contemplation, she spoke, “Are you displaying your attitude, strength, and confidence for the onlookers? Simultaneously, do you wish for Juan Oro to misjudge your capabilities based on this encounter?”
unit.target: Noelia obstupuit; post paucas secundae meditationis, dixit: “An habitum, virtutem, et fiduciam tuam spectatoribus ostendis? Simul, visne ut Juan Oro facultates tuas ex hoc congressu male aestimet?”

unit.source: Lumian remained silent. With a smile, he looked ahead and remarked, “Where did the former Governors of the Sea end up?”
unit.target: Lumian silentium servavit. Subridente, prospiciens dixit: “Ubi finiverunt pristini gubernatores maris?”

unit.source: Noelia fell silent for a moment before answering, “On the surface, they were dispatched to various locations. However, according to our observations, it takes at least four to five months, or no more than three years, for these Governors of the Sea to mysteriously vanish without a trace. There are often no signs of a struggle at the scene, and their families remain unharmed.”
unit.target: Noelia paulo tacuit antequam respondit: “In superficie, variis locis dispersi sunt. Sed, secundum observationes nostras, saltem quattuor ad quinque menses aut non amplius quam tres annos requiritur ut hi gubernatores maris mysteriose sine vestigio evanescant. Saepe nulla signa certaminis in loco apparent, et familiae eorum intactae manent.”

unit.source: Did they return to the sea voluntarily? Lumian smiled and said, “See, didn’t I gain something from dealing with Fernandez just now?”
unit.target: Redieruntne ad mare libere?

unit.source: The Church of Earth Mother now seemed more willing to share information.
unit.target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae nunc videbatur magis parata esse ad informationes communicandas.

unit.source: Noelia wasn’t upset. She smiled and added, “No one reveals all their cards from the start. Once your investigation reaches a certain point, we’ll provide more.”
unit.target: Noelia non irata erat. Subridens addidit: “Nemo ex initio omnia sua recludit. Quoniam investigatio vestra ad certum gradum perveniet, plura dabimus.”

unit.source: Lumian stared at the azure sea beside him, contemplating for a moment.
unit.target: Lumian ad mare caeruleum iuxta se aspexit, paulisper meditabundus.

unit.source: “You haven’t disclosed the intentions of your Earth Mother Church in this matter.”
unit.target: “Non enuntiavistis quid propositum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae vestrae in hac re sit.”

unit.source: Noelia’s eyes flickered. Suddenly, she raised her hand and pointed at the arguing pedestrians ahead, shouting, “Street brawls are prohibited!”
unit.target: Oculi Noeliae micaverunt.

unit.source: Before completing her sentence, she sprinted over with her team, leaving Lumian alone.
unit.target: Antequam sententiam compleret, turma sua currens, Lumian solum reliquit.

unit.source: Lumian scoffed and slowly shook his head.
unit.target: Lumian irridens caput lente concussit.

unit.source: Late at night, as Lumian was about to retire for the night, he heard the deep and hoarse voice of the Knight of Swords, as if suppressing something.
unit.target: Nocte sero, cum Lumian ad quietem nocturnam se praepararet, vocem profundam et rauquam Equitis Gladii audivit, quasi aliquid reprimens.

unit.source: “Clues to the whereabouts of the two targets have been found.”
unit.target: “Indicia de locis duorum scoporum reperta sunt.”

unit.source: 557 Purpose
unit.target: 557 Propositum

unit.source: 557 Purpose
unit.target: 557 Propositum

unit.source: Already?
unit.target: Iam?

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t anticipated the Knight of Swords making progress this swiftly—in just a day.
unit.target: Lumian non praevidit Equestem Gladii tam celeriter progredi—in uno die.

unit.source: Trusting his gut, he turned, meeting his reflection in the full-length mirror.
unit.target: Confidens suo instinctu, se vertit atque in speculo plenissimo imaginem suam conspexit.

unit.source: There stood the disheveled, pallid-faced Knight of Swords, a sudden appearance.
unit.target: Ibi stabat Eques Gladii, inconditus vultu pallido, adventus subitus.

unit.source: “Just clues?” Lumian mused, distilling the essence of the other’s words.
unit.target: "Sola indicia?" meditatus est Lumian, essentiam verborum alterius extrahens.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords shot him a gaze, tightly reined, and uttered, “The day after hitting Port Santa, they visited Balançat Ship Rental, asking about renting a boat for fishing. Vanished since.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii ei aspectum iniecit, oculos strictissime continens, et locutus est:

unit.source: Those words sparked a fleeting thought in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Illa verba in animo Lumiani brevem cogitationem excitaverunt.

unit.source: Quite romantic.
unit.target: Valde romanticum est.

unit.source: As expected of a three-halves Intisian and half-Feynapotterian duo.
unit.target: Sicut exspectatum erat ab duobus, quorum unus erat sesqui Intisianus et dimidius Feynapotterianus.

unit.source: Opting for a fishing date!
unit.target: Piscandi diem optaverunt!

unit.source: If only Nolfi didn’t carry the Maiden of the Sea’s lineage and this wasn’t Port Santa; then, romance might’ve been their motive.
unit.target: Utinam Nolfi originem Puellae Maris non gerebat et hoc non esset Portus Santa; tum amor fortasse eorum causa fuisset.

unit.source: Regrettably, reality doesn’t entertain “ifs.”
unit.target: Infeliciter, veritas non accipit “si.”

unit.source: Lumian sighed, pondering Nolfi and Batna’s true intentions.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, atque de veris propositis Nolfi atque Batna meditatus est.

unit.source: Port Santa teemed with fishermen, yet not all owned boats.
unit.target: Portus Santa piscatoribus suffulgebat, sed non omnes naves habebant.

unit.source: The lower-class ones either worked on vessels for a set pay or pooled funds to rent or buy.
unit.target: Qui classe humiliori adhaerebant, aut in navibus pro certis mercedibus laborabant aut pecuniam conligebant ut navem louerent vel emere possent.

unit.source: Balançat’s profits came from these folks, not the tourists or middle-class sightseers.
unit.target: Lucrum Balançat ex his hominibus proveniebat, non ex turistis aut mediis classis visitatoribus.

unit.source: This wasn’t a city known for tourism.
unit.target: Haec non erat urbs notabilis ob turismum.

unit.source: In Lumian’s contemplation, the Knight of Swords pressed on, “Nolfi handled the price inquiry, but Batna cooperated without resistance.”
unit.target: In cogitatione Lumiani, Eques Gladii continua vocem edidit:

unit.source: Did Batna truly perceive it as a date?
unit.target: Num Batna id vere ut diem conventus intellexit?

unit.source: For Intisians, it holds allure.
unit.target: Nam Intisiani id attrahitur.

unit.source: No wonder he didn’t resist.
unit.target: Non mirum quod non repulit.

unit.source: Renting a boat for a sea excursion… Lumian pondered, his mind racing with possibilities.
unit.target: Navem locare ad maritimam expeditionem… Lumian meditatus est, mente plurimis optionibus fervens.

unit.source: Was Nolfi planning to intercept the incoming Governor of the Sea during the sea prayer ritual or collide with their ship loaded with gunpowder?
unit.target: Num Nolfi destinabat gubernatorem maris venturum intercipere, in ritu precationis maritimae, aut cum nave eorum, pulvere onerata, collidere?

unit.source: Perhaps she intended to replace them at a critical juncture?
unit.target: Forsitan illa, in momento critico, eos substituere intenderat?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts whirred with conjectures.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani cum coniecturis vibrabant.

unit.source: Then, a sudden recollection jolted him.
unit.target: Tum repentina memoria eum concussit.

unit.source: Various sources mentioned a crucial detail about the sea prayer ritual: The final and pivotal part unfolded in a special sea area beyond the port.
unit.target: Plures fontes indicaverunt rem maximi momenti de ritu precationis maritimae:

unit.source: Details and the location were undisclosed to those who hadn’t witnessed it.
unit.target: Singula et situs non patefacta erant illis, qui id non viderunt.

unit.source: A new hypothesis formed in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Nova hypothesi in animo Lumiani formata est.

unit.source: Nolfi’s mother, a fleeing Maiden of the Sea, likely visited that special sea and might have shared pertinent information with her daughter.
unit.target: Mater Nolfi, Puella Maris in fugitivam ducta, verisimiliter illam mare speciale visitavit et forsitan cum filia sua informationes pertinentes communicavit.

unit.source: Was Nolfi’s motive for renting the boat to reach that unique sea area?
unit.target: Num propositum Nolfi in conducendo nave erat ad illam areae maris singularis pervenire?

unit.source: What lay there?
unit.target: Quid ibi iacebat?

unit.source: The core of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Nucleus rituum precationis maritimae.

unit.source: Did this imply something, an entity, or power concealed in that zone?
unit.target: Num hoc aliquid, entitatem, vel vim, quae in illa regione abscondita est, implicabat?

unit.source: Was the ritual designed to harness something extraordinary?
unit.target: Num ritu paratum erat ad aliquam rem extraordinariam colligendam?

unit.source: Did Nolfi aim to seize the item and establish herself as the permanent Governor of the Sea?
unit.target: Num Nolfi propositum habebat rem occupare et se gubernatorem maris permanentem constituere?

unit.source: Or did she intend to obliterate it, terminating Port Santa’s tradition of selecting the Governor and Maidens through the sea prayer ritual?
unit.target: An illa destinavit eam delere, terminans traditionem Portus Santae gubernatorem atque Puellas per ritu maris precationis eligendi?

unit.source: If obtaining the item were easy, the Fisheries Guild committee members would have done it long ago.
unit.target: Si rem adipisci facile posset, membra Collegii Piscariorum id iam olim perfecissent.

unit.source: Human nature tends to selfishness.
unit.target: Natura humana ad avaritiam tendit.

unit.source: Leaving a boon for the Maidens’ children is improbable unless one stumbles upon a stroke of fortune and knows the right approach to secure, elude danger, and navigate the situation…
unit.target: Relinquere beneficium pro liberis Puellarum improbabile est, nisi quis fortunam contingat et recte sciat quomodo id assecurari, pericula elabi, et rem regere possit…

unit.source: Destruction might indeed be the simpler route…
unit.target: Vastatio forsitan vere via simplicior est…

unit.source: As his thoughts raced, Lumian looked up slightly.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes eius currerent, Lumian paulum surrexit.

unit.source: Could April Fool’s key members have orchestrated a prank to steal the item or its uniqueness?
unit.target: Num clares membra Aprilis Insulorum iocum paravissent ut rem aut eius unicitatis furtum commissum?

unit.source: Had they succeeded?
unit.target: Num feliciter consecuti sint?

unit.source: This was a pivotal question.
unit.target: Haec quaestio crucialis erat.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords observed Lumian in silence, not disrupting his contemplation.
unit.target: Eques Gladii Lumian in silentio conspexit, eius cogitationem non turbans.

unit.source: He stood motionless, resembling a lifeless figure.
unit.target: Stabat immotus, ut figura mortua similis.

unit.source: After a while, Lumian asked with curiosity, “How did you manage to trace Nolfi and Batna in just one day?”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Lumian curiositate interrogavit:

unit.source: The Knight of Swords, in a deep tone, responded, “Gathering information from the spirit world and conducting a field investigation. After their departure from the Balançat Ship Rental, all pertinent information was either concealed or eliminated, making it impossible to locate them again.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii, voce profunda, respondit:

unit.source: Isn’t this the premise of certain divinations… Nolfi and Batna didn’t take precautions against divination before visiting the ship rental company, but they did so afterward?
unit.target: Num haec non sint praemissa aliquam divinationis…

unit.source: This doesn’t add up.
unit.target: Hoc non congruit.

unit.source: Either they never take precautions, or they do it consistently, unless they are both novices who only remember to guard against divination after inquiring about the boat’s price…
unit.target: Aut numquam caveant, aut constanter id faciunt, nisi utrumque novici sint, qui solum post quaesitum pretii navis meminerunt cavere a divinatione…

unit.source: Yes, a more plausible explanation is that ship rental falls within the fisheries and sea trade-related industries, deeply intertwined with the committee members of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Ita, explicatio magis probabilis est quod navium conductio in negotiis piscariorum et mercaturae maritima cadit, arcte conexa cum membris Collegii Piscariorum.

unit.source: Nolfi and Batna, as outsiders, inquiring about the price of a ship rental attracted attention, and their identities were exposed, leading to their “disappearance”…
unit.target: Nolfi et Batna, ut externos, de pretio navis locationis quaerentes, attentionem excitaverunt, et identitates eorum patefactae sunt, unde ad eorum "evanitionem" pervenerunt…

unit.source: The note revealing that Nolfi is the child of the Maidens of the Sea might come from the owner or a shareholder of the Balançat Ship Rental?
unit.target: Num nota, qua Nolfi filia Puellarum Maris declaratur, a possessor aut socia Balançat Navium Locationis provenit?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts gradually became clearer.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani paulatim clariores factae sunt.

unit.source: He gazed at the Knight of Swords, pondering how to request him to continue the investigation.
unit.target: Eum, Equestem Gladii, aspexit, meditans quomodo rogaret ut inquisitionem pergeret.

unit.source: At that moment, the Knight of Swords took the initiative to say, “I’ll delve deeper into the ship rental company.”
unit.target: Illo momento, Eques Gladii instanter dixit:

unit.source: “Thank you,” Lumian expressed his gratitude sincerely.
unit.target: "Gratias tibi ago," inquit Lumian sincere.

unit.source: Then, he witnessed the Knight of Swords’s figure swiftly becoming transparent and vanishing.
unit.target: Tum testis fuit ut figura Equestis Gladii celeriter translucida evanuerit.

unit.source: Transformed into a soul-like entity?
unit.target: Mutatus in entitatem quasi animae?

unit.source: Wraith?
unit.target: Umbra?

unit.source: Lumian discerned more details this time.
unit.target: Lumian hac vice plura notata habuit.

unit.source: This led him to suspect that the Knight of Swords belonged to the temperance faction of the Church of The Fool.
unit.target: Hoc eum ad suspicandum duxit, ut Eques Gladii ad factionem temperantiae Ecclesiae Stulti pertinere videatur.

unit.source: His subsequent journey to the Southern Continent was likely to deal with the indulgence faction of the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: Iter posticum eius ad Continentem Australem probabiliter contendebat ad factionem indulgentiae Scholae Rosae.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he shed his clothes, donned a faded cotton shirt, and reclined on the bed.
unit.target: Sine mora, vestimenta deiecit, camisiam ex cotone elapsam induit, et in lecto recubuit.

unit.source: Late at night in Trier, Franca strolled beneath intermittently-lit street lamps, clad in a thick tweed shirt and pants that clung to her legs.
unit.target: Sero nocte in Trier, Franca sub lampadibus plateis intermittenter illuminatis ambulabat, induta crassa camisa et braccis quae cruribus adhaerebant.

unit.source: Even without makeup and deliberately concealing her appearance in the darkness and shadows, numerous inebriated individuals still approached her upon glimpsing her back or side profile, behaving like tiny flying insects circling under the gas street lamps on a summer’s night.
unit.target: Etiam sine ornamentis faciei, et, in tenebris volutam, vultum suum celans, multi ebrii eam tamen appropinquabant, cum tergum aut partem lateralem intuebantur, se habentes quasi parva insecta volitantia sub lampadibus viariis gasi in nocte aestiva.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Ictus!

unit.source: Franca’s ponytail swayed slightly as she sent a particular drunkard flying with a sidekick.
unit.target: Capillatus Francae in cauda leviter oscillabat, dum certum ebrium cum comitante in aethera projecit.

unit.source: The drunkard screamed and vomited on the ground.
unit.target: Ebrius clamavit atque in solo vomuit.

unit.source: Franca pursed her lips in disdain and muttered to herself, “Pleasure sure brings trouble.”
unit.target: Franca labra in spreto contraxit et sibi dixit:

unit.source: It’s manageable during the day, but some overconfident types try to flirt at night.
unit.target: Diurno tempore haud difficulter sunt, sed quidam superbi noctu amicitates incitare conantur.

unit.source: And there’s malice all around when I’m out.
unit.target: Ac ubi egomet extra, malitia circumfusa est.

unit.source: Even the hero who rescues a damsel in distress aims to strike up a conversation later…
unit.target: Etiam heros, qui puellam in periculo servat, postea colloquium inire intendit…

unit.source: However, those scoundrels came expecting joy and anticipation, only to receive a beating and the accompanying pain.
unit.target: Attamen, illi scelesti gaudium et exspectationem sperabant, sed potius percutiendi ac dolorem adepti sunt.

unit.source: Right, could this be considered a simplified version of pleasure causing affliction?
unit.target: Num hoc dicitur modus simplicior, quo voluptas incommoda parit?

unit.source: It was precisely because Franca wanted to experience this and potentially find an opportunity to digest the potion that she didn’t sneak through the shadows and move undetected.
unit.target: Prorsus nam Franca hoc experiri voluit et fortasse occasionem ad potionem digestam cognoscendam, ideo non per umbras subrepens nec inobservata ingressa est.

unit.source: After a while, Franca slipped into the shadows and reached the empty room where she had previously met 007.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Franca in tenebras lapsa est et ad conclave vacuum pervenit, ubi prius 007 convenit.

unit.source: Her associate had mentioned that he’d discovered information about the ancient tomb beside the Crazy Mushroom Cave on the fourth level of the catacombs through the Church’s resources and municipal archives.
unit.target: Socius eius commemoravit se notitias de antiquo tumulo iuxta Specum Fungi Insani in quarto gradu catacombarum per subsidia Ecclesiae et archivorum municipalium reperisse.

unit.source: However, it wasn’t safe to disclose it in the telegram group, no matter how close their bonds were.
unit.target: Attamen, id in grege telegrapho divulgare non erat tutum, quacumque arcti vinculi essent.

unit.source: Therefore, he compiled the details and left them at the designated spot for Franca to retrieve.
unit.target: Ita singularia collegit et in loco designato deposuit, ut Franca illa detegeret.

unit.source: Franca conducted a brief search and found two folded sheets of thin paper.
unit.target: Franca brevem inquisitionem fecit et duas chartas papyraceas tenues, plicatas, reperit.

unit.source: She unfolded them and swiftly skimmed the content.
unit.target: Eas explicavit et celeriter perlegit quid continerent.

unit.source: As an Assassin, even in the dimmest environment, she could decipher the words:
unit.target: Sicaria, etiam in obscurissimo loco, verba perspicere poterat:

unit.source: “The ancient tomb where you found the Mirror World Fragment belongs to a noble family from the Fourth Epoch’s Tudor Empire.
unit.target: "Sepulcrum antiquum, in quo Fragmentum Mundi Specularis repertum est, familiae nobilis ex Imperio Tudorico Aetatis Quartae competit.

unit.source: Their last name is Tamara.
unit.target: Cognomen eorum est Tamara.

unit.source: I haven’t located specific details about the members in that tomb, but I’ve stumbled upon something odd.
unit.target: Non reperi singula de membris in sepulcro illo, sed aliquid insolutum detexi.

unit.source: “Not only does the fourth level house Tamara family tombs, but there are also tombs on the third level, such as the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb and the Impartial Tomb.
unit.target: "Non solum sedes sepulcrorum familiae Tamara in quarto gradu subsunt, sed etiam in tertio gradu sepulcra, sicut Sepulcrum Spinarum et Murum Scuti, et Sepulcrum Impar.

unit.source: Why aren’t they grouped together…”
unit.target: Cur non congregantur…

unit.source: Franca’s gaze froze.
unit.target: Aspectus Francae rigidus factus est.

unit.source: Isn’t the Thorns and Shieldwall Tomb where Jenna completed her tearcatcher mission?
unit.target: Num non est Sepulcrum Spinarum et Murum Scuti, ubi Jenna missionem "tearcatcher" absolvit?

unit.source: The mission they used as a pretext involved the Tamara family, and the tomb where they found the Mirror World Fragment belonged to them too!
unit.target: Missio qua ut praetextum usi sunt, de familia Tamara versa erat, et sepulcrum, in quo Fragmentum Mundi Specularis invenit, eorum quoque erat!

unit.source: Wasn’t this an extraordinary coincidence?
unit.target: Num hoc non fuit casus insolitus?

unit.source: Could it be a manifestation of mystical laws?
unit.target: Num hoc manifestatio legum mysticarum esse possit?

unit.source: Franca collected herself and continued reading.
unit.target: Franca se congregavit, et deinceps legere continuavit.

unit.source: “…I can’t access more detailed Tamara family information at my level.
unit.target: "…Notitiam familiae Tamara in subtiliore forma ad meum gradum accedere non possum.

unit.source: Figure something out yourself.”
unit.target: Quaere tibi solutionem.

unit.source: Hmm… Franca nodded, resolved to report the entire situation to Madam Judgment, seeking insights and information from the Tarot Club.
unit.target: Hmm… Franca annuit, decrevit totam rem ad Domnam Iudicium referre, perspicacitatem et informationes a Societate Taroti quaerens.

unit.source: In the early morning, on Aquina Street in Port Santa.
unit.target: Mane, in via Aquina in Portus Santa.

unit.source: In a house diagonally opposite Solow Motel, Lumian, his appearance transformed, stood by a window in a room.
unit.target: In domo diagonaliter opposita Solow Motel, Lumian, specie mutata, stabat iuxta fenestram in cella.

unit.source: Clutching the new ID provided by Valerio, he surveyed the suite where he, Lugano, and Ludwig were lodged, as well as the street below.
unit.target: Tenens novum ID a Valerio datum, perspexit conclave, in quo ipse, Lugano et Ludwig hospitabantur, atque viam deorsum.

unit.source: Now, he aimed to play the role of an ordinary bounty hunter who had taken on a confidential assignment, diligently monitoring the adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Nunc propositum habebat ut venator praedatorus ordinarius ageret, qui secretum mandato subegisset, adventorem, Ludovicum Berry, diligenter observans.

unit.source: Given Louis’s assertive conduct in recent days, it was likely that all the well-informed individuals in Port Santa knew of this great adventurer’s desire to investigate the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Ob modum Ludovici assertivum diebus recentibus, verisimile erat omnes personas bene informatas in Portus Santa scire cupiditatem huius magni adventoris de investiganda ratione precationis maritimae.

unit.source: The probability was high that Bard and other pivotal members of April Fool’s would be in tow!
unit.target: Alta probabilitas erat ut Bard et ceteri membris cardinalibus Aprilis Insulorum eos se haberent!

unit.source: 558 Tamara Family
unit.target: 558 Familia Tamara

unit.source: 558 Tamara Family
unit.target: 558 Familia Tamara

unit.source: Lumian savored the tang of fermented grape juice bought from a street vendor as he coolly surveyed the suite rented by the adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Lumian gustavit saporem succi uvae fermentatae, quem a venditore ambulanti empsit, dum aequo animo conclavum adventoris, Ludovicus Berry, speculabatur.

unit.source: He occasionally cast a discerning eye over Aquina Street, on the lookout for any potential monitors.
unit.target: Nonnumquam per viam Aquina oculos incisos misit, quaerens si quis potentialis monitor appareret.

unit.source: A little over half an hour ago, Lumian had transformed his appearance and changed into a different outfit.
unit.target: Paulo plus quam dimidiā hora abhinc, Lumian speciem suam transformaverat et vestem diversam induerat.

unit.source: He had seemingly “teleported” to a nearby street before returning to secure a suitable room.
unit.target: Videnter “teleportatus” est in viam propinquam perveniens, antequam rediret ad conclavum aptum obtinendum.

unit.source: Soon enough, Lumian spotted Lugano cautiously heading out to fetch an extra breakfast for Ludwig.
unit.target: Cito, Lumian animadvertit Lugano cautissime exiens ad extra ientaculum pro Ludovico petendum.

unit.source: A chuckle escaped him.
unit.target: Risus effugit eum.

unit.source: This guy was still spooked from yesterday’s attack.
unit.target: Hic vir adhuc ex impetu heri territus erat.

unit.source: However, unless the members of the Fisheries Guild had succumbed to the corrupting influence of superpowers, losing control of their emotions and rational thinking, it was improbable for them to target Lugano, the interpreter and guide.
unit.target: Nisi sodales Guildae Piscandi potentiarum corruptivarum influxui cederent, et temperamentum sensuum ac rationis amitterent, improbabile erat ut Lugano, interpretum et ducem, eligere conarentur.

unit.source: Louis Berry’s response the previous day had sent a clear message to everyone:
unit.target: Responsio Ludovicus Berry die praeterito omnibus perspicuum nuntium misit:

unit.source: If you can’t take me out directly, keep your sights off those around me.
unit.target: Si me directe occidere non potestis, oculos vestros a circumstantibus abstinete.

unit.source: You might eliminate me, but I, Louis Berry, can do the same.
unit.target: Me forte extinguere poteritis, sed ego, Ludovicus Berry, id eodem modo efficere possum.

unit.source: There’ll come a time when your Fisheries Guild’s committee members, your kids, and descendants travel without protection or lack strength.
unit.target: Tempus venerit quo sodales commissi Guildae Piscandi, liberi vestri atque posteri, sine tutela peregrinabunt aut virtute deficient.

unit.source: Wanna guess if I’d dare to make a move or if I have the capability?
unit.target: Velitisne coniectare an moveam an potentiam habeam?

unit.source: Either find an opportunity to bring me down with all you’ve got, or play nice!
unit.target: Aut occasionem invenite me omni viribus deicere, aut bene age!

unit.source: Faced with such a resolute “answer,” the rational committee members of the Fisheries Guild would know what to do.
unit.target: Responsione tam firma obviam, sodales rationis in commissis Guildae Piscandi scire debebant quid agendum esset.

unit.source: Louis Berry, the adventurer, wasn’t bound by official rules like a Beyonder or a cop.
unit.target: Ludovicus Berry, adventor, non officialibus regulis, ut Beyonder vel custos, obligatus erat.

unit.source: Expecting him not to involve family in the game was unrealistic.
unit.target: Exspectatio, ne familiam in ludo implicaretur, irrationabilis erat.

unit.source: Moreover, considering his recent behavior and the circulating rumors, he was a daring adventurer, reminiscent of Gehrman Sparrow.
unit.target: Praeterea, his rebus recentibus et rumoribus diffundentibus consideratis, audax adventor erat, similis Gehrman Sparrow.

unit.source: Known for his aggression, madness, and coldness, there were no limits to what such a person might do.
unit.target: Notus ob impetum, insaniam, et frigorem, nullae erant limites ad ea quae talis homo efficere poterat.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian wasn’t letting his guard down entirely.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian custodiam suam non penitus demisit.

unit.source: Lugano would either have Ludwig’s “company” in the future, or he’d be under Lumian’s watchful eye at all times.
unit.target: Lugano aut futurum erit particeps comitatus Ludovici, aut semper sub vigilantia Lumiani remanebit.

unit.source: After all, beyond the Fisheries Guild, many individuals in Port Santa were secretly plotting to exploit this opportunity for their own gain.
unit.target: Nihilominus, ultra Guildam Piscandi, multi in Porto Santa occulte machinabantur ut hanc occasionem pro utilitate sua exponerent.

unit.source: Disguised as Fisheries Guild members, they could attack the interpreter and godson of the adventurer Louis Berry, intensifying the conflict and stirring up trouble prematurely.
unit.target: Sub specie sodalium Guildae Piscandi, impetum facere poterant in interpretum atque filium adoptivum adventoris Ludovicus Berry, conflictum intensificantes et tumultum praecoquenter excitantes.

unit.source: Ignoring conspiracies at this level would be unacceptable for a Conspirer.
unit.target: Coniurationes huius gradus ignorare a Coniuratore inacceptabile erat.

unit.source: After Lugano returned to his suite on the fifth floor of Solow Motel with a heap of breakfast, Lumian purposefully avoided looking at the high-backed chair, seemingly adorned with a golden straw hat, positioned strategically at the dining table.
unit.target: Postquam Lugano cum multitudo ientaculi ad conclavum suum in quinto tabulato Solow Motel rediit, Lumian conscio animo vitavit introspectare sellam altum dorsu, quae videbatur ornata pileo aureo stramineo ad mensam prandii constitutam.

unit.source: He turned on his heel and exited the room, ready to explore the surroundings.
unit.target: Calcaneum verteret et conclavum reliquit, paratus ambitum explorare.

unit.source: Stepping into the corridor, Lumian immediately spotted a burly man standing near the staircase, barely reaching 1.7 meters in height.
unit.target: Ingrediens in corridorium, Lumian statim animadvertit virum robustum iuxta scalas stantem, vix altitudinem 1.7 metrorum attingentem.

unit.source: The man, with brown hair, brown eyes, and rugged skin, held a distinctive long mouth cigarette between his lips, fixing his gaze on Lumian.
unit.target: Vir, capillis fuscis, oculis fuscis, et cute rudi, cigarettam longam distinctivam inter labia tenebat, oculosque in Lumian fixos habebat.

unit.source: In Highlander, the man inquired, “Who sent you here to keep an eye on Louis Berry?”
unit.target: In lingua Highlander, vir rogavit: “Quis te huc misit ut Louis Berry inspicias?”

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but let out a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit sed molliter subridere.

unit.source: “Are you not here to monitor Louis Berry yourself?
unit.target: “Nonne hic es ut ipse Louis Berry inspicias?

unit.source: “I didn’t even inquire about your sender. Why the sudden curiosity?”
unit.target: “Me quidem non interrogavi de mittente tuo; cur ista subito curiositas?”

unit.source: He responded in flawless Highlander as well.
unit.target: Ipse quoque in lingua Highlander perfecte respondit.

unit.source: The man, with the long mouth cigarette dangling, contemplated for a moment before nodding in agreement, making way for the stairs.
unit.target: Vir, cum cigaretta longam inter labia pendente, paulisper meditatus est antequam annuit consensu, viam ad scalas aperiens.

unit.source: Lumian strolled past him, descending the staircase step by step.
unit.target: Lumian praeter eum ambulavit, scalas gradatim descendens.

unit.source: As he departed, the man’s gaze took on a gradually ominous edge.
unit.target: Cum discesserit, oculus viri paulatim in minacem aciem vertit.

unit.source: He raised his left hand, delicately twisting the special long mouth cigarette.
unit.target: Manum sinistram attollens, subtiliter cigarettam longam peculiarem flexit.

unit.source: Taking a deep breath, he exhaled into the cigarette, and in silence, a slender steel needle shot forth from the charred tobacco, aimed directly at Lumian’s back, mere two meters away.
unit.target: Altum spiritum inspirans, in cigarettam effudit, et silentio, acus chalybea gracilis ex tabaco combusto proiecit, directe in tergum Lumian, a solis duorum metrorum distantem.

unit.source: It was a blow dart, originating from certain tribes in the primitive forests of the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Illa erat telum flatu, oriundum ex quibusdam tribubus in silvis primitivis Continentis Australis.

unit.source: Typically, blow darts were one to two meters long, making them unsuitable for concealment or sneak attacks.
unit.target: Typice, telina unius ad duorum metrorum longitudine erant, quod eas ad latentiam aut furtivas incursiones inhabiliter destinabat.

unit.source: However, bounty hunters, followers of the God of Steam and Machinery with strong hands, modified them into a more portable version—only slightly longer than regular cigarettes.
unit.target: Attamen, venatores praemiis, sequaces Dei Vaporis et Machinarum robustis manibus, ea in versionem magis portabilem mutaverunt—modo paulo longiores quam sigarettae vulgares.

unit.source: While this modification increased portability and its concealed nature, it sacrificed some power and limited its range to a mere four to five meters.
unit.target: Dum haec modificatio portabilitatem et occultationem augebat, aliquam potentiam sacrificavit et ambitum eius ad solum quattuor ad quinque metrorum restringebat.

unit.source: When paired with specially crafted arrows carrying anesthetic and lethal toxins, it remained a favored tool among bounty hunters on both Northern and Southern Continents.
unit.target: Cum sagittis specialiter confectis, quae anesthetica et toxina letalia ferrebant, instrumentum delectum inter venatores praemiis in Continente Septentrionali et Australi permanebat.

unit.source: The man had concealed the blow dart within the long mouth cigarette, intending to lull the target and strike when the opportune moment arrived.
unit.target: Vir telum flatu in cigaretta longa abscondit, propositum habens victimam soporem inducere et ictum inferre cum tempus opportunum advenerit.

unit.source: His objective: to subdue Lumian and extract information about the identity of his employer.
unit.target: Eius propositum: Lumian sedare et notitiam de identitate patroni sui extrahere.

unit.source: The steel needle flashed past, but Lumian seemed to have anticipated the attack.
unit.target: Acus chalybea praetercursit, sed Lumian videtur impetum praescivisse.

unit.source: Just as the man blew air to propel the needle, Lumian swiftly bent forward, arched his spine, and dodged the blow dart in an almost inhuman contortion.
unit.target: Dum vir aerem sufflavit ad acus proiciendam, Lumian celeriter se inclinavit, dorsum flexit, et telum flatu, fere inhumanam contortionem exsequens, evasit.

unit.source: With a soft poof, the steel needle embedded itself into the wooden staircase.
unit.target: Molli ‘poof’ sono, acus chalybea in scala lignea se insedit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: He fainted.
unit.target: Evanuit.

unit.source: Swiftly recovering from his contorted evasion, Lumian bent down, scooped up the unconscious assailant, and dragged him into his rented room.
unit.target: Celeriter a sua contorta evasione recuperatus, Lumian se inclinavit, aggressorem inanimatum sustulit, et in conclavum locatum traxit.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the assailant’s unconscious state, Lumian administered a dose of truth serum and calculated the time for him to regain consciousness.
unit.target: Ex inanimati status aggressoris usus, Lumian dosum serum veritatis administravit et tempus computavit quo ille ad conscientiam redeat.

unit.source: Examining the unremarkable, ordinary face of his assailant, Lumian calmly listened to the panicked shout.
unit.target: Inspectans faciem simplicem aggressoris, Lumian placide auscultavit clamoris pavidum.

unit.source: “I just wanted to incapacitate you and find a spot to interrogate you about your employer!
unit.target: “Tantum te incapacitare et locum invenire volui, ut de tuo patrono te interrogarem!

unit.source: “The poison on the arrow is just an anesthetic!”
unit.target: “Venenum in sagittā tantum anestheticum est!”

unit.source: Squatting in front of the man, Lumian smiled and responded, “Now, let me ask you, who’s your employer?”
unit.target: In genu coram viro prostratus, Lumian subridens respondit: “Nunc, permitte me quaerere: quis est patronus tuus?”

unit.source: “It's Juan Oro!” the brown-haired, brown-eyed man blurted out.
unit.target: “Est Juan Oro!” exclamavit vir capillis fuscis et oculis fuscis.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and probed further, “Is that so?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens ulterius interrogavit: “Ita est?”

unit.source: “Yes, no, it’s actually someone else…” At this point, horror overcame the man, and he fell silent.
unit.target: “Ita, non, revera aliquis alius est…” Tum, horror viro intravit, et ille tacuit.

unit.source: Lumian prompted him patiently.
unit.target: Lumian eum patienter incitavit.

unit.source: “Who is it?”
unit.target: “Quis est?”

unit.source: After struggling for a few seconds, the man involuntarily spoke,
unit.target: Post paucas secundas luctationis, vir involuntarie locutus est,

unit.source: “Rubió Paco.”
unit.target: “Rubió Paco.”

unit.source: Rubió… Why is he keeping tabs on me?
unit.target: Rubió… Cur me perscrutatur?

unit.source: Does he seek to gain from the adventurer’s activities?
unit.target: Num ex operibus adventoris lucrum quaerit?

unit.source: Is that why he didn’t approach me discreetly to share information?
unit.target: Num idcirco tacite ad me non accessit, ut informationem communicaret?

unit.source: Lumian nodded subtly and straightened up.
unit.target: Lumian subtiliter annuit et se recte erexit.

unit.source: “Your breath stinks. Remember to brush your teeth more often.”
unit.target: “Spiritus tuus foetidus est. Memento dentes tuos pluries purgare.”

unit.source: “…” The assailant looked perplexed, unable to fathom why the conversation had taken this turn.
unit.target: “…” Aggressor perplexus videbatur, neque intellegere poterat cur sermo ita vertisset.

unit.source: Nonetheless, he replied half-heartedly, “I'm not a fan of brushing my teeth.”
unit.target: Attamen, respondit semidiligenter: “Non sum fautor dentes purgandi.”

unit.source: Lumian shook his head in disdain, uninterested in the blow dart as a trophy.
unit.target: Lumian caput in contemptu concussus est, non curo telum flatu ut trophaeum servare.

unit.source: Leaving the room, he left a parting message: “Make sure to lock the door behind me.”
unit.target: Ex conclavi egressus, nuntium valedictorium relinquit: “Cura ut ostium post me claudatur.”

unit.source: In Trier, within Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Franca and Jenna’s rented apartment.
unit.target: In Treveris, intra Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorativa, habitaculum Francae et Jennæ locatum erat.

unit.source: They had already received Madam Judgment’s response via Rabbit Chasel.
unit.target: Iamdudum acceperant responsum Dominae Judgment per Rabbit Chasel.

unit.source: Before departing, Rabbit Chasel, adorned with a miniature top hat, shrunken gold-rimmed glasses, and a diminutive black trench coat, made an unusual request.
unit.target: Ante discessum, Rabbit Chasel, parvo pileolo, oculis aureis parvis fusis, et nigro trench coat parvulo indutus, rogationem insolitam fecit.

unit.source: “Can I use a custom-made revolver as compensation for delivering the next five letters?”
unit.target: “Possumne revolverum specialiter confectum uti, ut praemium pro traditione quinque epistularum futurarum habeam?”

unit.source: Jenna’s mouth hung open, momentarily taken aback.
unit.target: Os Jennæ patebat, instante stupefactum.

unit.source: “Sure.”
unit.target: “Certe.”

unit.source: She questioned, “Why can’t you conjure one yourself?”
unit.target: Ea interrogavit: “Cur te ipse non potes unum creare?”

unit.source: Similar to your top hat, glasses, and trench coat.
unit.target: Sicut pileus tuus, oculi, et trench coat.

unit.source: “They have no practical use, but I hope the revolver does. The bullets need to be custom-made too,” Rabbit Chasel explained earnestly.
unit.target: “Non habent usum practicum, sed spero revolverum utile fore. Balistae quoque specialiter conficiendae sunt,” explicavit Rabbit Chasel studiose.

unit.source: Jenna blinked and acquiesced.
unit.target: Jennæ palpebravit et assentivit.

unit.source: Once the messenger departed, Franca commented with a peculiar expression,
unit.target: Postquam nuntius discessit, Franca cum vultu peculiario commentum fecit:

unit.source: “Why does it feel like it has shifted from pursuing knowledge to pursuing strength?”
unit.target: “Cur videtur studium translatum esse ex quaerenda scientia in quaerendam virtutem?”

unit.source: Jenna wanted to defend Rabbit Chasel but struggled to find a compelling excuse.
unit.target: Jennæ volebat Rabbit Chasel defendere, sed vix invenit rationem persuasivam.

unit.source: Instead, she cursed, “It’s not necessarily a bad thing. It might even aid me in future battles!”
unit.target: Pro eo, maledixit: “Non necessario res mala est. Fortasse etiam in futuris proeliis mihi auxilio erit!”

unit.source: “Moreover, the stronger the messenger, the safer the letter deliveries.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, quo fortior nuntius, eo tutiores traditio epistularum erit.”

unit.source: Franca, lacking a messenger, suddenly felt a twinge of envy. Without delay, she unfolded Madam Judgment’s reply.
unit.target: Franca, nuntiis carens, subito invidiam sensit. Statim responsum Dominae Judgment evolvit.

unit.source: “The Tamara family, one of the five noble families from the Fourth Epoch’s Tudor Empire, held a hereditary duke aristocratic title, akin to the Amon you’re familiar with, albeit slightly lower in status.
unit.target: “Familia Tamara, una ex quinque familiis nobilibus Imperii Tudoriani Quartae Aetatis, titulum ducalem hereditarium tenebat, similem Amon, quem nosti, licet statura paulo inferiori.

unit.source: “In the era when the gods roamed the land, families capable of becoming great nobles undoubtedly possessed angelic powers. According to the information, the Tamara family had existed for many years before Alista Tudor became the Blood Emperor. They were renowned nobles from the previous empire.
unit.target: In aetate, cum dii terram peragrabant, familiae, quae ad magnam nobilitatem idoneae erant, indubitanter vires angelicas habebant. Ex informationibus, familia Tamara per multos annos exstiterat antequam Alista Tudor Imperator Sanguinis factus est. Erant nobilitates praeclarae imperii priore.

unit.source: “They had the coat of arms changed once and two internal divisions. This is why Tamara was buried on different levels of the catacombs at different times.
unit.target: “Arma gentilis semel mutata sunt et duas divisiones internas constitutae; ideo familia Tamara in diversis gradibus catacumbarum, variis temporibus, sepulta erat.

unit.source: “Initially, their coat of arms consisted of thorns, a shieldwall, and vertical swords. Later, it became an open door, with the vertical sword acting as the crack.
unit.target: Initio, arma eorum constabant ex spinis, muro scuti, et gladiis verticalibus; postea, factum est ostium apertum, in quo gladius verticalis quasi hiatrum fungebatur.

unit.source: “This represents a significant change in the Tamara family. It shifted from being dominated by the Justiciar pathway to being dominated by the Apprentice pathway. However, no corresponding historical information has appeared for the time being.
unit.target: Hoc mutationem significantem in familia Tamara repraesentat. Ab itinere Iusticiar regendo ad viam Apprenticis dominantem transitum fecit; sed ad hunc tempore nulla notitia historica correspondens apparuit.

unit.source: “A small number of members of the Tamara family, who adhere to the Judgment pathway, have survived to this day and are secretly active.
unit.target: Parvus numerus membrorum familiae Tamara, qui viam Iudicii sequuntur, usque ad hunc diem supervixerunt et occulte agunt.

unit.source: “The other Tamara group had established a close connection with the Demoness family during the Tudor Empire’s era. During the Fifth Epoch, a secret organization known as the Theosophy Order emerged. It had Demoness figures and originated from Tamara’s Apprentice pathway. There’s reason to believe that they are still cooperating.
unit.target: Altera coetus Tamara tempore Imperii Tudoriani cum familia Demoness coniunctionem strictam constituit. In Quinta Aetate, ordo secretus nomine Ordo Theosophiae apparuit. Eorum figurae Demoness erant et ex via Apprenticis Tamara oriundi sunt; ratio est credendi eos adhuc cooperari.

unit.source: “This Tamara group has been estranged from the other one for many years, refusing to acknowledge each other.
unit.target: Hic coetus Tamara per multos annos ab altero alienatus est, recusans se invicem agnoscere.

unit.source: “The Tamaras of the Judgment pathway also experienced a division. The exact situation is unknown…
unit.target: Tamarae viae Iudicii quoque divisionem passae sunt; status exactus ignotus est…

unit.source: Upon reading this, Franca and Jenna shared the same thought.
unit.target: Hoc lecto, Franca et Jennæ eandem sententiam habuerunt.

unit.source: The Tamara family is indeed connected to the Demonesses!
unit.target: Familia Tamara certe cum Demonesses conexa est!

unit.source: They continued reading the contents of the letter.
unit.target: Continuerunt epistulae contenta legere.

unit.source: “The person who led you to the Tamara family’s tomb and discovered the Mirror World Fragment is likely targeting that special mirror world and the Demoness Sect. Don’t worry for the time being. Just be vigilant against coincidences, theft, and scams around you…”
unit.target: “Persona quae te ad sepulcrum familiae Tamara duxit et Fragmentum Mundi Speculi detexit, verisimiliter illud mundum speculi peculiare atque Sectam Demoness intendit. Interim ne solliciti sitis; tantum vigiletis contra casus, furtum, et scamas circa vos…

unit.source: In the ensuing days, Lumian, along with Lugano and Ludwig, remained unharmed.
unit.target: In diebus sequentes, Lumian una cum Lugano et Ludwig incolumis mansit.

unit.source: Port Santa seemed to settle back into a semblance of normalcy. Those secretly observing displayed no indications of advancing further.
unit.target: Portus Santa videbatur ad statum ordinarii redeuntem; qui occulte observabant, nullas indicia progressionis ostenderunt.

unit.source: Just as Lumian contemplated taking further actions to elucidate all details before the sea prayer ritual in early November, the Knight of Swords brought fresh information regarding Nolfi and Batna.
unit.target: Ita dum Lumian cogitabat ulteriora agere, ut omnia ante caerimoniam orationis maritimae in initio Novembris explanaret, Eques Gladii novas de Nolfi et Batna attulit.

unit.source: His face maintaining a pale-white hue, he spoke to Lumian, “I’ve identified a suspect involved in the kidnapping of the two targets. Should I handle it alone, or shall we proceed together?”
unit.target: Vultus eius, pallide albus manens, ad Lumian locutus est: “Suspectum deprehendi qui in abductione duorum versabatur. Solus agere debeam, an simul procedamus?”

unit.source: 559 Top-Notch Collaborator
unit.target: 559 Collaborator Eximius

unit.source: 559 Top-Notch Collaborator
unit.target: 559 Collaborator Eximius

unit.source: After making his decision, Lumian had a chance to inquire, “Who’s the suspect?”
unit.target: Postquam consilium cepit, Lumian occasionem habuit rogandi: “Quis est suspectus?”

unit.source: “Lato Guiaro,” the Knight of Swords announced.
unit.target: “Lato Guiaro,” inquit Eques Gladii pronuntiavit.

unit.source: Lumian recognized this individual.
unit.target: Lumian hunc cognovit.

unit.source: He was also a committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Etiam membrum Collegii Piscariorum erat.

unit.source: Not only did he own shares in three large fishing boats and the Port Santa Fisheries Company, but he was also involved in shipbuilding, ice production, and other industries.
unit.target: Non solum partes in tribus navibus piscatoriis magnis et in Societate Piscaria Portus Santa possidebat, sed etiam in navium fabricanda, glacie producenda, aliisque industriis versabatur.

unit.source: Someone in his family had already married a Maiden of the Sea over a hundred years ago.
unit.target: Aliquis ex familia eius iam ante plus quam centum annos Puellam Maris in matrimonium duxit.

unit.source: Lumian asked thoughtfully, “What’s Lato Guiaro’s connection to Balançat Ship Rental?”
unit.target: Lumian quaesivit cum cogitatione: “Quae est relatio Lati Guiaro ad Balançat Ship Rental?”

unit.source: “He’s a creditor of the company and has arranged employment for many relatives there,” the Knight of Swords replied succinctly.
unit.target: “Creditorem societatis est et plurimos cognatos ibi munivit,” respondit Eques Gladii succincte.

unit.source: “It all adds up.” Lumian nodded in agreement and paused to reflect.
unit.target: “Omnia conveniunt,” annuit Lumian, et pausavit ut consideraret.

unit.source: “Let’s convene at the crossroads of Saint Lana Street and Golden Wheat Street. How about meeting in three minutes?”
unit.target: “Conveniamus ad intersectionem viae Sanctae Lanae et viae Tritici Aurei. Quid de conventu post tres minuta?”

unit.source: He had never set foot in Lato Guiaro’s extended family estate, so he lacked the corresponding spirit world coordinates.
unit.target: Numquam in praedium familiae extensae Lati Guiaro ingressus erat, itaque notae mundi spirituum ei defuerunt.

unit.source: His only teleportation option was Saint Lana Street, relatively close to their target.
unit.target: Unica eius via translocationis erat via Sanctae Lanae, quae ad metam proxime sita erat.

unit.source: He needed to utilize Spirit World Traversal discreetly to evade any surveillance.
unit.target: Oportuit ut per transitus mundi spirituum caute uteretur, ne ullam vigiliam attraheret.

unit.source: “Sure.” The Knight of Swords dissolved into transparency and disappeared instantly.
unit.target: “Certe.” Eques Gladii in transparentiam dissolutus statimque evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian spent two minutes hydrating, donning a vest and a straw hat.
unit.target: Lumian duos minutas aquam sumendo, tunicam et petasos stramineos induens egit.

unit.source: Only then did the faint glow of the black mark on his right shoulder illuminate.
unit.target: Tunc tantum leviter fulgor atri notae in dextro humero eius lucebat.

unit.source: In an instant, his figure vanished from the shrouded room.
unit.target: In momento, eius figura ex conclavi occulto evanuit.

unit.source: At the crossroads of Saint Lana Street and Golden Wheat Street, Lumian materialized from a concealed corner.
unit.target: Ad intersectionem viae Sanctae Lanae et viae Tritici Aurei, Lumian ex angulo occultato apparuit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords, now sporting disheveled brown hair, a switched flaxen-colored shirt, and a dark brown vest, stood at the fringe of the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Eques Gladii, nunc cum capillis fusco inconditis, camisiae flavae mutatae, et vestimento fusco obscuro indutus, ad limitem lunae rubri stetit.

unit.source: His pallid face and oppressive eyes hinted at an underlying transformation, as if he could shed his human guise at any moment, revealing a monstrous form fueled by pent‑up desires.
unit.target: Vultus eius pallidus et oculi opprimi insinuebantur de transformatione subiecta, tamquam quovis momento vestem humanam amittere posset, monstram formam ex desideriis repressis efferens.

unit.source: While others might miss these subtleties, Lumian, being an Ascetic, possessed a heightened sensitivity to such situations.
unit.target: Dum alii has subtilitates praetermittere possent, Lumian, asceta, sensibilitatem exquisitam ad tales casus habebat.

unit.source: The temperance faction, indeed… Lumian mused at the Knight of Swords’s appearance, entertaining a whimsical thought.
unit.target: Temperantiae factionem, certe… Lumian de specie Equis Gladii meditabatur, animum leviter ad rem levem concipiens.

unit.source: Bro, ever considered embracing Inevitability? As an Alms Monk or an Ascetic, you’d spare yourself from enduring so much!
unit.target: Frater, numquamne cogitasti fatum inevitablem amplecti? Ut monachus eleemosynarius aut asceta, te ipsum a tanta cruciatu liberabis!

unit.source: Of course, Lumian merely toyed with the idea and wouldn’t actually propose it.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian solum cum illa cogitatione lusus est, et re vera id proponere non voluit.

unit.source: Without the right strokes of luck, the boon of an evil god could gradually corrupt Beyonders within the potion system, eventually transforming them into humanoid monsters aligned with the evil deity.
unit.target: Nisi bona fortuna adsisset, donum dei mali paulatim Beyonders intra systema pocionis corrumpere poterat, eos tandem in monstra anthropomorpha ad deum malum consociata transformans.

unit.source: Nevertheless, his musings hinted at the potential synergy between specific Sequences of the boon system and potion system.
unit.target: Attamen, eius cogitationes indicabant potentialem synergiam inter certas sequentias systematis doni et systematis pocionis.

unit.source: “Let’s proceed.” As the Knight of Swords remained silent, Lumian took the lead and spoke.
unit.target: “Procedamus.” Cum Eques Gladii tacitus maneret, Lumian duxit et locutus est.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords nodded, and they followed the shadows along the street, turning into Golden Wheat Street at a measured pace, heading north.
unit.target: Eques Gladii annuit, et se umbras per viam secuti sunt, quae in via Tritici Aurei, gradu moderato, conversabatur, ad septentriones.

unit.source: Soon, they reached a five‐story building resembling a small castle.
unit.target: Mox pervenerunt ad aedificium quinque tabulatum, quod parvo castello simile videbatur.

unit.source: Observing the illuminated windows and grayish‑blue outer walls, the Knight of Swords pointed at a specific glass pane, noting,
unit.target: Intuens fenestras illuminatas et parietes exteriores griseo‑caeruleos, Eques Gladii ad particularem vitrum ostendit, dicens:

unit.source: “That’s Lato’s bedroom. He and his wife sleep in separate rooms.”
unit.target: “Id est cubiculum Lati. Ipse et uxor eius in separatis cellis dormiunt.”

unit.source: The gathered intelligence is impressively detailed… Lumian acknowledged silently and inquired, “What’s your plan?”
unit.target: Intelligentiae collectae singulariter accuratae sunt… Lumian tacite agnovit et quaesivit: “Quid consilium tuum?”

unit.source: “Sneak in and take control of the target,” the Knight of Swords responded succinctly.
unit.target: “Intrā furtim et propositum occupa,” respondit Eques Gladii succincte.

unit.source: Isn’t that a bit too straightforward and crude?
unit.target: Nonne id paulo nimis apertum et crassum non est?

unit.source: The Guiaro family likely employs more than just ordinary Beyonders.
unit.target: Familia Guiaro verisimiliter plus quam ordinarios Beyonders adhibet.

unit.source: Some members may have gained powers through the sea prayer ritual…
unit.target: Nonnulli membri fortasse virtutem per ritum preces maris adepti sunt…

unit.source: Lumian recalled the unique characteristics of a Wraith and assessed his capabilities.
unit.target: Lumian singularia umbrae revocavit et eius facultates aestimavit.

unit.source: With one hand in his pocket, he casually remarked, “Okay.”
unit.target: Una manu in sinu positam, leve dixit: “Bene.”

unit.source: With those words, his form dissolved into a shadow, seamlessly merging with the darkness.
unit.target: His verbis, eius figura in umbram dissoluta est, cum tenebris perfecte coniungens.

unit.source: Beside him, the Knight of Swords had already vanished.
unit.target: Apud eum, Eques Gladii iam evanuerat.

unit.source: Utilizing the shadows cast on the building’s outer wall, Lumian deftly infiltrated Lato Guiaro’s room.
unit.target: Utens umbris in pariete exteriore aedificii proiectis, Lumian callide in cubiculum Lati Guiaro invasit.

unit.source: In an instant, his target came into view.
unit.target: Instante, propositum eius apparuit.

unit.source: A middle‑aged man, with slightly curly black hair and dark brown eyes, adorned in a dark‑blue cotton robe, greeted Lumian’s sight.
unit.target: Vir medii aetatis, capillis nigeris modice crispis et oculis fusco brunneis, in veste caerulea ex cotone indutus, Lumianum salutavit.

unit.source: His long face featured a neatly trimmed thick beard.
unit.target: Facies eius longa barbam spissam ac rite concisam ostendebat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s expression morphed into one of fear, and his body froze.
unit.target: Vultus Lati Guiaro in formam timoris versus est, et corpus eius immobilis factum est.

unit.source: He stumbled toward the shadow concealing Lumian.
unit.target: Procidit ad umbram quae Lumian abscondebat.

unit.source: In the reflection within each eye of the Fisheries Guild committee member, Lumian spotted the pale‑faced Knight of Swords, clad in a dark brown vest and flaxen‑colored shirt, with disheveled brown hair!
unit.target: In speculo, quod in singulis oculis membri Collegii Piscariorum apparuit, Lumian equitem gladii, cui vultus pallidus, vestis fusca et camisia flava erant, cum capillis brunneis inconditis, conspexit!

unit.source: Observing Lato Guiaro losing control of his body, unable to utter a sound, Lumian stepped out of the shadow, returning to his original form.
unit.target: Observans Lato Guiaro corpus suum imperium amittere et nihil pronuntiare posse, Lumian ex umbra processit, ad formam suam originalem rediens.

unit.source: An oppressive heaviness enveloped the air around him, akin to the weight of seawater.
unit.target: Gravis onus opprimens, sicut pondus aquae maris, aerem circa eum complectebat.

unit.source: Apart from this, nothing seemed amiss.
unit.target: Praeter hoc, nihil aliud anomale apparuit.

unit.source: With a controlled step, Lumian approached Lato Guiaro, a sensation akin to moving through a swamp.
unit.target: Cum gradu moderato, Lumian Lato Guiaro accessit, cum sensu quasi per paludem ambularet.

unit.source: He refrained from resorting to the direct use of the Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: Ab directamine usu Incantationis Harrumph cohibuit.

unit.source: Firstly, the other party seemed powerless and could be managed through alternative means, saving his spiritual energy.
unit.target: Primum, adversarius impotens apparuit et per alios modos regeri poterat, ita energiam spiritualem servans.

unit.source: Secondly, Lumian hesitated due to uncertainty about whether the Spell of Harrumph would incapacitate both of them, given the forceful possession of Lato Guiaro by the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Secundo, Lumian haesitavit, incertus utrum Incantatio Harrumph utrumque eorum incapacitet, dato quod Lato Guiaro a Eques Gladii vim fortiter possidebat.

unit.source: Retrieving a bottle of sedative from the Bliss Society, Lumian unscrewed the cap and brought it to Lato Guiaro’s nose.
unit.target: Ex Societate Beatitudinis, Lumian lagunculam sedativam obtulit, operculum solvens atque ad nasum Lati Guiaro duxit.

unit.source: Fanning the opening with his hand to hasten the gas’s flow, after about ten seconds, the committee member of the Fisheries Guild closed his eyes and slumped into unconsciousness.
unit.target: Excitans aperturam manu ad accelerandum flumen gasii, post circiter decem secundos, membrum Collegii Piscariorum oculos clausit et in inscientiam cecidit.

unit.source: Remarkably, he remained standing, not collapsing to the ground.
unit.target: Mirum quidem, mansit stans, neque in terram corruit.

unit.source: The Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana card holder, the Knight of Swords, maintained absolute control over Lato Guiaro’s body.
unit.target: Tenens cartam Minor Arcana Taroti, Eques Gladii absolutum imperium super corpus Lati Guiaro retinuit.

unit.source: This is even simpler than employing teleportation and the Spell of Harrumph… I’ve faced numerous Beyonders before, but never have I subdued one without laying a hand on them.
unit.target: Hoc quidem etiam simplicius est quam teleportationem et Incantationem Harrumph adhibere… Multos Beyonders ante aggressus sum, sed numquam aliquem sine tactu meo vinctum fecerim.

unit.source: I strolled up casually, administering the sedative.
unit.target: Casualiter ambulavi, sedativum applicavi.

unit.source: A Wraith truly stands as an exceptional ally, capable of harmonizing with any Sequence of any pathway…
unit.target: Umbra vere stat ut socius eximi, qui quacumque sequentia cuiusque itineris congruentiam efficere potest…

unit.source: Yes, a Wraith remains impervious to anesthetic gasses.
unit.target: Ita, umbra immunis gasorum anestheticorum manet.

unit.source: The Bliss Society’s sedative had no effect on him.
unit.target: Sedativum Societatis Beatitudinis ei nullum effectum habuit.

unit.source: As Lumian observed the noiseless resolution, he almost felt as if he hadn’t partaken in the skirmish at all.
unit.target: Dum Lumian quietam solutionem spectabat, paene sensit quasi in proelio omnino non interfuisset.

unit.source: He returned the Bliss Society sedative to his concealed pocket and retrieved a canister of truth serum.
unit.target: Sedativum Societatis Beatitudinis in sinum occultum reddidit et phialam serum veritatis abstulit.

unit.source: Seizing the moment, he administered nearly a third of it to Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Momento capto, fere tertiam eius partem Lato Guiaro infudit.

unit.source: Sensing that the sedative’s impact might be short‑lived on Beyonders with unknown traits like Lato Guiaro, he hastened to complete his preparations before the target regained consciousness.
unit.target: Sentiens effectum sedativi breviter perseveraturum esse in Beyonders speciebus ignotis ut Lato Guiaro, festinavit praeparationes absolvere, priusquam meta iterum conscie fieret.

unit.source: Within 20 to 30 seconds, Lato Guiaro’s eyes fluttered open.
unit.target: Inter viginti ad triginta secundos, oculi Lati Guiaro subinde aperiti sunt.

unit.source: First, he encountered Louis Berry, the adventurer in the golden straw hat, adorned with a faint smile.
unit.target: Primum convenit Ludovicum Berry, viatorem cum petaso stramineo aureo, leviter risu ornatum.

unit.source: Subsequently, he discovered himself seated on a chair at some indeterminate moment, facing the divan in the bedroom.
unit.target: Postea se invenit sedens in sella aliquo tempore incerto positus, frontaliter ad divanum in cubiculo spectans.

unit.source: Lato attempted to scream, but his vocal cords rebelled, rendering him motionless.
unit.target: Lato clamare conatus est, sed chordae vocis eius recalcitraverunt, eum immobilis reddentes.

unit.source: “Have you grasped your situation?” Lumian reclined on the sofa, placing his right foot on his left knee.
unit.target: «Intellexistine condicionem tuam?» inquit Lumian, reclinatus in sofa, pedem dextum super genu sinistrum ponens.

unit.source: He spoke in Intisian.
unit.target: In Intisiano locutus est.

unit.source: Fear etched across Lato’s face, rendering him unable to nod or respond.
unit.target: Timor in facie Lati incisus est, faciens ut neque annueret neque responderet.

unit.source: While he possessed certain abilities, Lato was certain they wouldn’t suffice against the adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Etsi certas facultates habebat, Lato certus erat illa non sufficere adversus viatorem Ludovicum Berry.

unit.source: They would likely result in a renewed coma or a swift lightning strike.
unit.target: Probabiliter illa ad novam comam aut ictum fulmineum celerem convertentur.

unit.source: “What do you want?” Lato suddenly inquired.
unit.target: «Quid vis?» Lato subito quaesivit.

unit.source: He, too, knew Intisian.
unit.target: Et ipse Intisian sciebat.

unit.source: Attempting to raise his hand in surprise to touch his neck, he found himself immobilized.
unit.target: Conans manum ex stupore elevare ut collum attingeret, se invenit immobilis.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro lapsed into silence.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro silentio cecidit.

unit.source: With a smile, Lumian responded, “I have a few questions for you. Answer them satisfactorily, and I might consider letting you live until tomorrow to assist me in spreading the word about this affair.”
unit.target: Cum subrisu, Lumian respondit: “Nonnullas quaestiones tibi habeo. Illis satis responde, et fortasse te ad diem crastinum vivere permittam, ut mihi in huius rei divulganda auxilies.”

unit.source: Lato remained silent for a moment before consenting, “What do you want to know?”
unit.target: Lato parum silentium tenuit, deinde assentiendo, “Quid vis scire?”

unit.source: Lumian casually shook his right ankle.
unit.target: Lumian leviter tarsum dextro concussit.

unit.source: “Are Nolfi and Batna with you?”
unit.target: «Num Nolfi et Batna te comitantur?»

unit.source: “Yes,” Lato responded with a strong inclination to divulge information.
unit.target: «Ita,» inquit Lato, forte promptus ad informationem divulgandam.

unit.source: “They’re locked up in the basement. They’re still alive. I just want to use them.”
unit.target: «In cella subterra celati sunt. Adhuc vivunt. Illos solum uti volo.»

unit.source: “For what?” Lumian inquired, intrigued.
unit.target: «Ad quid?» inquit Lumian, curiosus.

unit.source: Lato’s lips trembled as he explained, “I intend to use them to lead you to the location of the sea sacrificial ritual and guide you to rent a boat there.”
unit.target: Labia Lati tremuerunt dum explicabat: “Intendo eos uti, ut te ad locum ritus sacrificii maris ducam et te ad navem ibi conducere moneam.”
