unit.source: “So, you’re the one who wrote that note…” Lumian exclaimed in realization. “How do you plan to guide me?”
unit.target: “Ita, tu es qui illud nota scripsisti…” exclamavit Lumian cum intellectione. “Quomodo me ducere cogitas?”

unit.source: Lato struggled to articulate his actions, but his mouth moved faster than his thoughts.
unit.target: Lato conatus est verba exprimere, sed os eius celerius quam cogitationes movebatur.

unit.source: “I want you to discover that Nolfi and Batna intend to rent a boat and head out to sea. Then, I’ll arrange for them to seize an opportunity to escape and relay something to you, letting you know the significance of the sea area.”
unit.target: “Volo ut cognoscas Nolfi et Batna navem conducere atque in mare proficisci intendere. Deinde disponam ut occasionem capiant ad effugiendum et aliquid tibi tradant, ut significationem regionis maris tibi inducant.”

unit.source: “And then?” Lumian inquired with curiosity.
unit.target: “Et deinde?” inquit Lumian, curiosus.

unit.source: Lato sealed his lips shut but eventually spoke.
unit.target: Lato labia sua cohibuit, sed postremo locutus est.

unit.source: “What they will tell you is the truth, but they are unaware of one thing: “Never engage a Child of the Sea in a sea battle! Juan Oro awaits you in that sea region, ready to bury you entirely!”
unit.target: “Quod tibi dicent, verum erit, sed unum nesciunt: ‘Nunquam puero maris in proelio marino incumbas! Juan Oro te in illa regione maris exspectat, paratus te omnino sepulturam dare!’”

unit.source: So, the Fisheries Guild planted a deceptive trail through the clue about Nolfi, posing as a turncoat to lure me into a trap and eliminate me…
unit.target: Ita, Collegium Piscariorum vestigium fallax per indicem de Nolfi posuit, se pro proditore praetendens, ut me in laqueum alliceret et deleat…

unit.source: If I hadn’t swiftly revealed my intent to investigate the sea prayer ritual, exposing Nolfi and Batna to exploitation, they might already be sleeping with the fishes…
unit.target: Nisi celeriter propositum meum de investigatione ritus orationis maris revelavero, Nolfi et Batna ad exploitationem patefieri, iam fortasse cum piscibus quiescerent…

unit.source: The skirmish against Lugano was crafted to deceive me…
unit.target: Pugna adversus Lugano ad me decipiendum parata erat…

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he heard Lato express confusion, “You haven’t even started your investigation. How did you find me? You merely sent your interpreter to inquire about Nolfi and the others’ whereabouts. There was no follow-up…”
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani festinabant, audivit Lato dicere: “Investigationem tuam quidem ne coepisti. Quomodo me invenisti? Interpretrem solum misisti ut quaereres de locis Nolfi et ceterorum. Postea nihil secutum est…”

unit.source: Lumian’s smile held a cryptic undertone as he disclosed, “Do you think I’m here alone to investigate the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Risus Lumiani subtextum arcani habuit, dum declaravit: “Putasne me solum hic esse ad investigandum ritum orationis maris?”

unit.source: “I represent the will of many. Numerous comrades lurk in the shadows of Port Santa.”
unit.target: “Voluntas multorum me repraesentat. Numerosi sodales in umbris Portus Santa latent.”

unit.source: Lato felt a chill course through his stiffened body, lending credence to Lumian’s words.
unit.target: Lato frigus per corpus rigidum suum percusit, dictis Lumiani corroborans.

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his chin.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et mentum suum carexit.

unit.source: “Where does your power come from?”
unit.target: “Unde tua potentia provenit?”

unit.source: Lato’s throat constricted as he answered, “From the sea. Each sea prayer ritual grants us strength.”
unit.target: Guttur Lati contraxit, cum respondit: “Ex mari. Quisque ritus preces maris vires nobis tribuit.”

unit.source: “Unfortunately, the ritual failed last year. We received no replenishment for two years, and everyone weakened to varying degrees. Otherwise, Juan Oro would have finished you long ago. He would have cast your lifeless form into Wave Square, a stark warning to those who cross us!”
unit.target: “Infeliciter, ritus anno praeterito defecit. Biennium nullam repletionem accepimus, et omnes ad diversos gradus infirmati sunt. Alioquin, Juan Oro te iam pridem conficeret. Te in Forum Undarum sepulceret, ut acerbum monitum illis qui nos oppugnant daret!”

unit.source: Similar to a boon? Theoretically, even without replenishment, a boon’s power will gradually wane… Lumian pondered for a moment and remarked,
unit.target: “Simile dono? Theoretice, etiam sine repletione, vis doni paulatim decrescet… Lumian paulisper meditatus dixit,”

unit.source: “The sea prayer ritual is a large‑scale boon‑seeking ritual, with the Governor of the Sea as the primary sacrifice?”
unit.target: “Ritus orationis maris est amplus ritus donum quaerens, cum Gubernator Maris ut principale sacrificium fungatur?”

unit.source: Lato contemplated for a moment before responding, “He serves as both sacrifice and host. Juan Oro and we act as assistant hosts.”
unit.target: Lato paulisper contemplatus respondit: “Ille ut sacrificium et hospes fungitur; Juan Oro et nos ut hospites adiutores agimus.”

unit.source: “The sea prayer ritual is essentially a marriage to the sea and appeasing it. The boon is a byproduct.”
unit.target: “Ritus orationis maris essentia matrimonium cum mari et eius appeasatio est; donum autem effectus secundarius est.”

unit.source: “Marriage to the sea?” Lumian suddenly found his imagination lacking.
unit.target: “Matrimonium cum mari?” inquit Lumian, repentinus quod imaginationis eius deesset.

unit.source: 560 Traces
unit.target: 560 Vestigia

unit.source: 560 Traces
unit.target: 560 Vestigia

unit.source: Lato rarely divulged details about the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Lato vix enarrare solebat singula de ritu orationis maris.

unit.source: He spoke with a weighty demeanor, “Yes, the Governor of the Sea ties the knot with the sea, quelling its violence and bringing peace.
unit.target: Gravitate loquebatur Lato: “Ita vero, Praefectus Maris nodum cum mari iungit, eius vim reprimens atque pacem afferens.

unit.source: They truly become the spouse of the sea, commanding authority over this stretch of water.
unit.target: Revera fit maris maritus, super hac aquarum parte imperium praedicans.

unit.source: “As the assistant and deputy hosts, we also gain varying degrees of in Port Santa receive some boons, although they are limited in number.”
unit.target: “Ut adiutores et vice hospites, etiam in Portu Santa aliquas benefactiones variis modis accipimus, quamvis numerus eorum limitatus sit.”

unit.source: So, the Governor of the Sea is synonymous with Husband of the Sea.
unit.target: Itaque Praefectus Maris idem valet ac Vir Maris.

unit.source: The assistant and deputy hosts are like close friends or family busy assisting at a wedding, naturally earning gratitude.
unit.target: Adiutores et vice hospites sunt quasi amici intimi vel cognati, nuptiis auxilio occupantes, unde naturaliter gratiam consequantur.

unit.source: Those with the sea bloodline are akin to children attending a wedding, typically gaining some candy…
unit.target: Qui sanguine marino insiti sunt, similes pueris nuptiarum adstant, plerumque aliquod dulcedinem adepti…

unit.source: Lumian attempted to comprehend Lato Guiaro’s description of the sea prayer ritual by combining reality and wedding traditions in novels.
unit.target: Lumian conatus est intellegere enarrationem Lati Guiaro de ritu orationis maris, realitatem et nuptiarum traditiones in fabulis coniungendo.

unit.source: Intrigued, he inquired, “Does the Governor of the Sea engage in those acts with the sea?”
unit.target: Cautus interrogavit: “Num Praefectus Maris istis actibus cum mari se implicat?”

unit.source: Aren’t weddings supposed to conclude with newlyweds consummating their marriage?
unit.target: Nonne nuptiae finem habere debent cum nuptis matrimonium consummant?

unit.source: “Of course!” Lato affirmed, “After the wedding, the sea will bind itself to the four Maidens of the Sea.
unit.target: “Certe!” Lato asseruit, “Post nuptias, mare se ligabit ad quattuor Virgines Maris.

unit.source: Through their union with the Governor of the Sea, the first child of each Maiden of the Sea is a noble with a pure sea bloodline, possessing the strongest Beyonder powers.
unit.target: Per coniunctionem cum Praefecto Maris, primogenitus cuiusque Virgines Maris erit nobilis cum puro sanguine marino, potentissimas vires Beyonder habens.

unit.source: “Why four and not one Maiden of the Sea? It’s because individual humans can’t endure the vastness, expansiveness, weight, and transcendence of the sea. Enough partners are needed to share the burden.”
unit.target: “Cur quattuor et non una Virgo Maris? Quia singuli homines immensitatem, extensionem, pondus, atque sublimitatem maris tolerare non possunt; plures socii necessarii sunt ut onus dividatur.”

unit.source: The more I listen, the more ominous it becomes…
unit.target: Quo magis ausculto, eo minacius videtur…

unit.source: Marrying a Maiden of the Sea is akin to marrying a remnant of the sea’s power.
unit.target: Nuptio Virgini Maris similis est matrimonium reliquiae potentiae maris.

unit.source: It’s no wonder they’re highly valued, and their destinies change.
unit.target: Non mirum est eos magni aestimari atque fata eorum mutari.

unit.source: The only challenge is acknowledging and loving their wife’s first child.
unit.target: Unicum impedimentum est primogenitum uxoris agnoscere atque diligere.

unit.source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and remarked, “And the Governor of the Sea can withstand the passion of the sea?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Atque Praefectus Maris potestne passionem maris ferre?”

unit.source: And it was four at a time.
unit.target: Et quattuor simul erant.

unit.source: Lato, devoid of pity or sympathy, stated, “One of the two most crucial purposes of the vigil ritual is to utilize the house and some of the sea spawn concealed within it to transform the Governor of the Sea’s body, enabling them to withstand the violent and unrestrained sea.
unit.target: Lato, carens misericordia aut compassione, dixerat: “Una ex duobus propositis maxime essentialibus ritu vigiliae est ut domum et aliqua semina maris, quae intus latent, adhibeat ad corpus Praefecti Maris transformandum, ita ut violentum et immoderatum mare ferre valeat.”

unit.source: “That’s why the Governor of the Sea can only serve for a year. Even with the physical transformation, the power acquisition, and the Beyonder enhancement, they won’t endure much longer.”
unit.target: “Ideo Praefectus Maris solum unius anni fungitur. Etiam cum transformatione corporali, acquisitione potentiae, atque incremento Beyonder, diutius non perferet.”

unit.source: Consumable. The husband of the sea is a consumable…
unit.target: Consumibilis. Vir Maris consumibilis est…

unit.source: Lumian sighed inwardly and queried, “Then why would the Governor of the Sea return to the sea after leaving office?”
unit.target: Lumian intus sufflavit et interrogavit: “Cur igitur Praefectus Maris, postquam officia relinquit, ad mare revertatur?”

unit.source: “No one knows the exact reason, but there’s a certain conjecture.
unit.target: “Nemo causam certam novit, sed quaedam coniectura est.

unit.source: Juan Oro believes that the sea doesn’t allow those who were once its husband to start a new life.
unit.target: Juan Oro credit mare non sinere eos, qui olim maritus Maris fuerunt, vitam novam inchoare.

unit.source: And I believe that the modifications of the vigil ritual, the intrusion of spousal intercourse, and the influence of maritime authority make the Governor of the Sea more and more like a sea creature and less human.
unit.target: Et ego credo mutationes ritu vigiliae, intrusiones congressus coniugalis, atque imperium maritimum Praefectum Maris magis magisque ad creaturam maris similem et minus humanum reddere.

unit.source: Eventually, he will inevitably return to the sea that gives him peace and comfort.”
unit.target: Postremo, inevitabiliter ad mare, quod ei pacem atque solatium affert, revertetur.”

unit.source: Lato felt that his deduction was correct.
unit.target: Lato sensit deductionem suam esse rectam.

unit.source: What exactly is the sea you’re referring to?
unit.target: Quidnam est mare, ad quod referis?

unit.source: Is it a natural spirit or a creature beyond, controlling the sea?
unit.target: Estne numen naturale aut creatura extra, quae mare regit?

unit.source: Lumian replayed Lato Guiaro’s answers in his mind before asking, “Sea spawn? Like the wrinkled monsters that can disguise themselves as devils, and the long black insects that control humans by burrowing into their necks?”
unit.target: Lumian in mente responsa Lato Guiaro recoluit, antequam rogavit: “Semina maris? Sicut monstra rugosa, quae se habere possunt ut daemones, et insecta nigra longa, quae homines regunt, se fodientes in cervicibus eorum?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Lato responded, yearning for a cigarette but unable to move his hands.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Lato, desiderans cigarettam, sed manibus movere non potens.

unit.source: “We, the Children of the Sea, are spawn of the sea.
unit.target: “Nos, Filii Maris, sumus semen maris.

unit.source: One of our duties is guiding certain sea spawn from the depths to settle on land using our Beyonder powers, helping them reproduce.”
unit.target: Una ex officiis nostris est ducendo quaedam semina maris e profundis ad terram consederi, viribus Beyonder adhibendis, ut ea multiplicentur.

unit.source: However, Ludwig mentioned that the Batings Black Insects originate from another planet, not some sea spawn…
unit.target: Tamen, Ludwig annotavit insecta Nigra Batings ex alio planeta originaria esse, non ex aliquo semine maris…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t rush to ask about the Children of the Sea’s Beyonder powers; instead, he focused on the details of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Lumian non festinavit rogare de viribus Beyonder Filii Maris; sed potius in singulis minutis ritu orationis maris intendit.

unit.source: “What’s the other vital purpose of the vigil?”
unit.target: “Quid est alterum propositum vitale ritu vigiliae?”

unit.source: Lato’s expression hinted: “Don’t you understand what weddings are about?”
unit.target: Vultus Lato insinuavit: “Nonne intellegis quid nuptiae sint?”

unit.source: “Well, there’s the exchange of rings for marriage.
unit.target: “Bene, adsunt commercium annulorum pro nuptiis.

unit.source: And the vigil ritual modifies the Governor of the Sea’s body, attaching a unique trait to a fixed golden ring, matching it to the sea bride’s identity.”
unit.target: Et ritu vigiliae corpus Praefecti Maris mutatur, ad annulum aureum fixum proprietate unicam adnexus, qui congruens fiat cum identitate sponsae Maris.

unit.source: A unique golden ring… Lumian perked up and said, “And then?”
unit.target: Annulus aureus unicus… Lumian excitatus dixit: “Et deinde?”

unit.source: During last year’s April Fool’s prank, fringe members received orders to acquire a gold ring from Torres and conceal it within the lamb sacrifice’s stomach!
unit.target: Per iocum Aprilis Stultorum anni praeteriti, membra marginaria mandata acceperunt ut annulum aureum a Torres adipirent et eum intra ventrem agni sacrificii celarent!

unit.source: “Then, following the completion of the other rituals, the Governor of the Sea will take the golden ring and cast it directly into the sea before the ship.
unit.target: “Deinde, post cetera ritu perfuncta, Praefectus Maris annulum aureum recipiet et eum directe in mare ante navem iaciet.

unit.source: He will utter in a unique language from the depths,
unit.target: Eloquent in lingua singulari e profundis,

unit.source: ‘We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion!’”
unit.target: ‘Te sponsamus, o mare, ut signum verae atque perpetuae dominationis!’”

unit.source: “If the sea consents to this union, gentle waves will stir, transforming into pure white foam petals that will shower over the four Maidens of the Sea.
unit.target: “Si mare huic coniunctioni consentierit, leves fluctus agitabuntur, qui in petala candida spumosa pura transformabuntur et super quattuor Virgines Maris effunderentur.

unit.source: “The returned ring carries symbolic weight, signifying authority over the waters surrounding Port Santa[1].”
unit.target: “Annulus reditus pondus symbolicum fert, significans auctoritatem super aquas circum Portum Santa[1].”

unit.source: Just the waters encompassing Port Santa? From the indications, it seems it’s not the true sea, but rather something that affects this specific area of the waters…
unit.target: Solum aquae, quae Portum Santa circumstant, videtur? Ex indiciis videtur non esse verum mare, sed aliquid quod hanc specificam partem aquarum afficit…

unit.source: Lumian paused briefly before speaking, “How do you express ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’ in that peculiar language?”
unit.target: Lumian brevi momento cessavit antequam loqui inciperet: “Quomodo dicitur ‘Te sponsamus, o mare…’ in illa lingua insolita?”

unit.source: Lato Guiaro contemplated for a moment before emitting a chattering sound.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro paulisper meditatus est, deinde sonum stridulentem edidit.

unit.source: Under the influence of the Language Comprehension charms, Lumian failed to grasp its meaning.
unit.target: Sub incantationum intellegentiae linguae impulsu, Lumian eius significationem capere non potuit.

unit.source: He concluded it wasn’t part of the Northern Continent’s languages.
unit.target: Concluxit eam non esse partem linguarum Continenti Septentrionalis.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he observed the Knight of Swords in Lato’s eyes slightly shaking his head.
unit.target: Simul observavit Equestrem Gladii in oculis Lato, qui leviter caput concutiebat.

unit.source: If the Knight of Swords truly belongs to the temperance faction that parted ways from the Rose School of Thought to align with the Church of The Fool, he should possess knowledge of the Southern Continent’s language.
unit.target: Si Eques Gladii vere ad factionem temperantiae pertineat, quae se a Schola Rosi Opinionum separatam congregavit ut Ecclesiae Stulti consocietur, debet scientiam linguae Continenti Meridionalis habere.

unit.source: Additionally, with his high Sequence and extensive tenure as a Beyonder, he must have encountered most supernatural tongues.
unit.target: Praeterea, cum altis gradibus et longis annis ut Beyonder functus sit, debet plerasque linguas supernaturales expertus esse.

unit.source: Does this imply it’s not from the language family of the Southern Continent, let alone ancient Hermes, Dragonese, Elvish, or other mystical languages?
unit.target: Num hoc implicat non esse eam ex familia linguarum Continenti Meridionalis, nedum ex sermone antiquo Hermes, Dragonese, Elvish aut aliis linguis mysticis?

unit.source: Lumian regarded Lato Guiaro with an intrigued grin.
unit.target: Lumian Lato Guiaro intuens cum risu curiose delectato spectabat.

unit.source: “Are you certain those words translate to ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’?”
unit.target: “Certus es haec verba vertere in ‘Te sponsamus, o mare…’?”

unit.source: Lato hesitated briefly before explaining, “Probably. This is a language passed down from ancient times, existing since the sea prayer ritual. There are only a few sentences…”
unit.target: Lato paulisper dubitavit antequam explicavit: “Fortasse. Haec lingua ex antiquis temporibus tradita est, exstans ab initio ritu orationis maris. Sententiae paucae tantum sunt…”

unit.source: He’s not sure… They hadn’t systematically mastered the language, only capable of uttering two or three sentences based on the legacy… Lumian sensed there might be more to it than Lato’s description; there was no denial if the true meaning was akin to “Open Sesame.”
unit.target: Non est certus… Illi linguam non per systema didicerunt, sed tantum duas vel tres sententias ex tradita hereditate profecerunt; Lumian sensit plura esse posse quam Lato enarravit, neque refutabantur, si verus sensus similis “Aperi Sesamum” fuisset.

unit.source: The folks from the Fisheries Guild and Milo Village might have been akin to the individuals Aurore and Franca spoke of.
unit.target: Populi ex Gremio Piscariorum et Milo Vicus fortasse similes erant illis personis de quibus Aurore et Franca locuti sunt.

unit.source: They employed a peculiar language, its true meaning eluding them as they substituted it with their own interpretation.
unit.target: Linguam peculiare utebantur, cuius verus significatus eis evaniebat, dum suam interpretationem adhibebant.

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, his expression remained unchanged.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, vultus eius immutatus remansit.

unit.source: “Does the Governor of the Sea safeguard the ring after he acquires the special trait?”
unit.target: “Num Praefectus Maris annulum custodit postquam proprietatem specialem adipiscit?”

unit.source: “No,” Lato responded, shaking his head.
unit.target: “Non,” respondit Lato, caput concutiens.

unit.source: “In addition to the Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea, and sailors in charge of controlling the ship, there are four pure-blooded Children of the Sea acting as deputy hosts.
unit.target: “Praeter Praefectum Maris, Virgines Maris, et nautas gubernantes, quatuor sunt Filii Maris ex pura stirpe, qui ut vice hospites funguntur.

unit.source: They guide the Governor and the Maidens through the ritual stages, teaching the unique call to marriage.
unit.target: Illi Praefectum atque Virgines per gradus ritu ducunt, et unicam vocem ad matrimonium docent.

unit.source: The golden ring is held by one of the deputy hosts and only handed over to the Governor when needed.
unit.target: Annulus aureus ab uno ex hospitibus vicariis tenetur, atque solum Praefecto Maris traditur, cum necessitatibus oriri videntur.

unit.source: The Governor of the Sea doesn’t have a chance to switch ritual rings…
unit.target: Praefectus Maris occasionem non habet ut annulos rituos mutet…

unit.source: Suppressing his anxiety, Lumian continued at a measured pace, “Did the sea prayer ritual fail last year?”
unit.target: Anxietatem reprimens, Lumian modeste pergebat: “Num ritu orationis maris anno praeterito defecit?”

unit.source: Lato initially seemed taken aback, but then relief crossed his face.
unit.target: Lato primo stupefactus apparuit, sed deinde levamen vultum suum ostendit.

unit.source: “Did the imposter seek your help?”
unit.target: “Num impostor auxilium tuum quaesivit?”

unit.source: “Yes, for some reason, the sea prayer ritual failed.
unit.target: “Ita, quaedam ratione, ritu orationis maris defecit.

unit.source: The sea’s rage claimed the lives of the Governor of the Sea and the four Children of the Sea serving as deputy hosts.
unit.target: Ira maris vitas Praefecti Maris atque quattuor Filii Maris, qui ut hospites vicarii agebant, subtraxit.

unit.source: Only the Maidens of the Sea and some sailors survived.
unit.target: Solum Virgines Maris et quidam nautae supervixerunt.

unit.source: The four deputy hosts are dead? Just as Lumian uncovered clues about April Fool’s, he sensed the link had been abruptly severed.
unit.target: Quatuor hospitibus vicariis mortui sunt? Eodem tempore, dum Lumian vestigia de ioco Aprilis Stultorum deprehendit, sensit nexum subito disrumpi.

unit.source: The individuals with the best chance of substituting the ceremonial ring had all perished in the unsuccessful sea prayer ritual!
unit.target: Qui optimam facultatem habebant annulum caerimonialem substituendi, omnes in ritu orationis maris inepto perierunt!

unit.source: Lumian thought for a moment before inquiring, “What happened to the surviving Maidens of the Sea and sailors?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde rogavit: “Quid accidit superviventibus Virginibus Maris et nautis?”

unit.source: “They’re still alive, but under strict surveillance.”
unit.target: “Adhuc sunt in vita, sed sub rigida vigilantia.”

unit.source: Realizing that the failure to last year’s sea prayer ritual was exposed, Lato, not dwelling on the survivors’ details, continued, “We arranged marriages for the four Maidens of the Sea who lack actual sea powers with ordinary family members.
unit.target: Intellexit defectum ritu orationis maris anni praeteriti patefactum esse; Lato, de superviventium singularitatibus non demorans, continuavit: “Nuptias ordinavimus pro quattuor Virgines Maris, quarum vera potentia marina caret, cum membris familiaribus ordinariis.

unit.source: Though it won’t bring about a Beyonder-level change, it has its benefits.
unit.target: Quamquam mutationem ad gradum Beyonder non afferet, tamen sua beneficia praebet.

unit.source: “The sailors, from Milo Village, received some benefits from Juan Oro but are restricted from leaving Milo Village until this year’s sea prayer ritual succeeds.”
unit.target: “Nauta, ex Milo Vicus, aliqua beneficia a Juan Oro receperunt, sed exire ex Milo Vicus prohibiti sunt, donec ritu orationis maris huius anni succedat.”

unit.source: Shifting gears, Lumian asked, “Did the sailors transport the sacrificial lambs and other offerings for the marriage to the sea to the deck?”
unit.target: Mutans rimam, Lumian rogavit: “Num nautae agnos sacrificatorios et alia munera pro nuptiis cum mari in tabulam navis transporterunt?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Lato nodded.
unit.target: “Ita.” Lato annuit.

unit.source: “Sailors handle such cumbersome and laborious tasks.”
unit.target: “Nautae talia onera gravia et laboriosa gerunt.”

unit.source: Within the ranks of sailors, one among Bard, Mad Lady, or Ultraman had sneaked in.
unit.target: Inter nautas, unus, sive Bard sive Mad Lady sive Ultraman, late insinuatus est.

unit.source: If the other side held a stronger Beyonder power or a mystical item from the Marauder pathway, they could snatch the genuine ceremonial ring during the exchange, swapping it with a counterfeit…
unit.target: Si altera pars potentiam Beyonder robustiorem aut rem mysticam ex via Marauder haberet, genuinum annulum caerimonialem tempore commercii rapere poterant, eum autem falso commutantes…

unit.source: It wouldn’t be a surprise that the Marauder pathway, influenced by the Celestial Worthy, has key April Fool’s members wielding matching strengths or artifacts…
unit.target: Non mirum est, cum via Marauder, sub incitamento a Celestial Worthy, principales membri Aprilis Stultorum vim aut artificia congrua gerant…

unit.source: Lumian swiftly suspected this.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter hoc suspicatus est.

unit.source: He turned to Lato Guiaro, keeping his tone composed.
unit.target: Se convertit ad Lato Guiaro, tonum suum placidum servans.

unit.source: “Tell me about the four Maidens of the Sea and the survivors from last year among the sailors.”
unit.target: “Narra mihi de quattuor Virgines Maris et de superviventibus ex anno praeterito inter nautas.”

unit.source: Lato recounted the details from memory.
unit.target: Lato ex memoria enarravit singula.

unit.source: Having absorbed the specifics about the potential targets, Lumian inquired further, “Were all participants in the sea sacrificial part thoroughly checked?”
unit.target: Postquam singularia de scopis potentialibus comprehensit, Lumian rogavit: “Num omnes participes in parte sacrificii maris diligenter examinati sunt?”

unit.source: “Absolutely. No unauthorized items allowed onboard to maintain the ritual’s integrity.
unit.target: “Absolute. Nullae res non licitae admittuntur in nave ut integritas ritu servetur.

unit.source: And before the ship reaches its destination, Juan Oro will vigilantly oversee using his powers,” Lato elaborated.
unit.target: Et antequam navis ad destinatum pervenerit, Juan Oro viribus suis vigilanter inspexiet, dixerat Lato.

unit.source: As anticipated, Lumian nodded subtly.
unit.target: Ut praedictum, Lumian subridet et annuit.

unit.source: “What powers does Juan Oro wield?”
unit.target: “Quae vires Juan Oro habet?”

unit.source: [1] Adapted from the Marriage of the Sea ceremony of the Venice Doge set to be hanged.
unit.target: [1] Adaptatum ex caerimonia Maris nuptiarum Dogonis Venetiarum ad suspendendum constituta.

unit.source: 561 Language of the Stars
unit.target: 561 Lingua Stellarum

unit.source: 561 Language of the Stars
unit.target: 561 Lingua Stellarum

unit.source: Lato Guiaro struggled to keep silent, but the words burst out of him.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro silentium tenere conabatur, sed verba e eo erupta sunt.

unit.source: After a long internal battle, he finally responded, “He’s the most powerful among us.
unit.target: Post longam internam pugnam, tandem respondit: “Inter nos potentissimus est.

unit.source: Before joining the Fisheries Guild committee, he served as a deputy host on the sea sacrifice ship a whopping 11 times.
unit.target: Antequam in commissionem Gildis Piscariorum se iunxit, decies undecim vice ut vice hospitis in nave sacrificii marini functus est.

unit.source: He gained numerous boons and established a solid connection with the sea.
unit.target: Multa beneficia adeptus est et nexum solidum cum mari constituit.

unit.source: “He can fly.
unit.target: “Volare potest.

unit.source: If he’s not afraid of losing lifespan, he can temporarily take control of these waters on behalf of the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Si non timet vitam amittere, his aquis pro gubernatore maris ad tempus imperium suscipere potest.

unit.source: He possesses other special abilities, though they’re rarely revealed.
unit.target: Alias facultates speciales habet, sed raro revelantur.

unit.source: We’re not entirely sure either.
unit.target: Nos etiam non plene certi sumus.

unit.source: What we do know is that the failure of last year’s sea prayer ritual significantly weakened him.”
unit.target: Quod scimus, defectus ritus orationis maris anni superioris eum maxime debilitavit.”

unit.source: Lato paused and couldn’t resist adding, “First and foremost, we are astronomers.
unit.target: Lato pausavit et non potuit impedire se addere: “Primum et ante omnia, astronomi sumus.

unit.source: Our expertise lies in observing the stars’ transformations and calculating their patterns.
unit.target: Peritia nostra consistit in observatione transformationum stellarum et in figuris eorum computandis.

unit.source: Keep in mind that the annual sea prayer ritual doesn’t have a fixed date.
unit.target: Memento ritus orationis maris annui diem fixum non habere.

unit.source: It could happen any day during the first week of November.
unit.target: Hoc fieri potest quovis die intra primam hebdomadinem Novembri.

unit.source: This is because, to enter that special area that communicates with the sea, the stars need to be in specific positions to open the corresponding passageway.
unit.target: Hoc enim est, quod ad ingressum in illam regionem specialem, quae cum mari communicat, stellae in certis locis esse debent ad viam correspondens aperiendum.

unit.source: “The date of a similar phenomenon varies from year to year.
unit.target: “Dies huiusmodi rei ex anno in annum variat.

unit.source: Astronomers with sufficient knowledge must predict it in advance through observation and calculation.”
unit.target: Astronomi satis periti eam per observationem et computationem praevidere debent.”

unit.source: The idea of Fisheries Guild committee members being astronomers seems comical and absurd…
unit.target: Idea membrorum commissionis Gildis Piscariorum astronomos esse ridicula et absurda videtur…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t interrupt Lato Guiaro’s narrative.
unit.target: Lumian narrationem Lato Guiaro non interpellavit.

unit.source: The self-proclaimed astronomer continued his explanation.
unit.target: Astronomus, se ipse proclamans, explicationem suam continuavit.

unit.source: “Secondly, we are humans who worship the sea and the cosmos.
unit.target: “Secundo, homines sumus qui mare et caelum colunt.

unit.source: We can receive revelations and guidance of fate from the changes in tides, the waves of the sea, and the trajectories of the stars, avoiding danger and making the right choices.
unit.target: Revelationes et consilia fati ex mutationibus aestuum, fluctuum maris, et trajectoriarum stellarum accipere possumus, periculum vitantes atque recte decernentes.

unit.source: Many times, we refer to such revelations and guidance as the Language of the Stars.”
unit.target: Saepe tales revelationes et monitiones Lingua Stellarum appellamus.”

unit.source: The Language of the Stars… sounds pretty dangerous.
unit.target: Lingua Stellarum… satis periculosa videtur.

unit.source: How do you know it’s not something risky like Termiboros or Ludwig winking at you?
unit.target: Quomodo scis non esse rem periculosam, ut Termiboros aut Ludwig, qui tibi oculos intermittenter conludet?

unit.source: Lumian resisted the urge to shake his head and sighed inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian impetum caput concutiendi repulit et intime suspiravit.

unit.source: “Furthermore, we are descendants of the sea and the cosmos, serving as clergymen who offer sacrifices to them.
unit.target: “Praeterea, progenies maris et caeli sumus, sacerdotes qui eis sacrificia celebrant.

unit.source: We can manipulate the power of the land to completely immobilize the target or make them float.
unit.target: Potestatem terrae regere possumus ut obiectum omnino immobilis fiat aut levetur.

unit.source: We can emit rays from the cosmos, causing damage to the enemy’s body structure and weakening them.
unit.target: Radios ex caelo emitti possumus, qui structuras hostium laedunt et eos debilitant.

unit.source: Without the corresponding superpowers to treat them, they will face an irreversible and agonizing death.
unit.target: Sine viribus supernis necessariis ad eos curandos, mortem irreversibilem et agonizantem patiuntur.

unit.source: We can also create a powerful magnetic effect.
unit.target: Etiam validum effectum magneticum efficere possumus.

unit.source: Combined with the power of the land, we can generate a half-real illusion.
unit.target: Coniuncta cum potestate terrae, illusionem semiveram creari possumus.

unit.source: We call it the Cosmic Void.”
unit.target: Illud vocamus Vacuitatem Cosmicanam.”

unit.source: Lato’s expression gradually turned fanatical.
unit.target: Vultus Lato paulatim in fanaticum mutatus est.

unit.source: From a mysticism perspective, the Beyonder characteristics of the Children of the Sea involve the land and the cosmos.
unit.target: Ex prospectu mystico, proprietates extraordinariae Filiorum Maris terram et caelum amplectuntur.

unit.source: According to Aurore’s knowledge, it encompasses gravity, radiation, and electromagnetism.
unit.target: Secundum scientiam Aurore, id comprehendit gravitatem, radationem, et electromagnetismum.

unit.source: Furthermore, due to gravity and electromagnetism, they also possess some illusionary and spatial abilities.
unit.target: Praeterea, propter gravitatem et electromagnetismum, quoque quasdam facultates illusionarias et spatiales habent.

unit.source: Lumian, rephrasing Lato Guiaro’s words for easier comprehension, couldn’t help but criticize inwardly, “Hey, you’re the Children of the Sea, not the Children of the Stars.
unit.target: Lumian, verba Lato Guiaro ad facilius intellegendum redimens, intus reprehendere non potuit: “Heus, filii Maris estis, non filii Stellarum!

unit.source: Why don’t I see many sea-related powers…
unit.target: Cur non multas potentias maritimas video…

unit.source: Lato took a deep breath and continued, “We are also the navigators of the sea and the cosmos.
unit.target: Lato altum spiritum cepit et perrexit dicens: “Etiam nos sumus nautae maris et caeli.

unit.source: We can find the right path under any circumstances, guided by the performance of the sea and the stars.
unit.target: Viam rectam invenire possumus in omnibus condicionibus, ducti signis maris et stellarum.

unit.source: We can use this power to help others.”
unit.target: Hanc vim ad alios adiuvandos uti possumus.”

unit.source: “Without our guidance, ships can’t enter that special water even on the correct date.
unit.target: “Sine nostro ductu, naves illas aquas speciales, etiam in die expedito, ingredi non possunt.

unit.source: That’s why Nolfi insisted on returning to Port Santa before setting off.
unit.target: Ideo Nolfi in Portum Santa redire instavit priusquam proficisceretur.

unit.source: Although she knew the coordinates and route of the sea sacrificial land from her mother, she would never have reached it if she didn’t set off from Port Santa.
unit.target: Quamquam notitia habebat de coordinatis et itinere terrae sacrificii maris a matre sua, eam numquam attingeret, nisi proficisceretur ex Portu Santa.

unit.source: The spawn that come to land from the seabed also rely on our abilities in this area to survive the fog, vortex, and storms without losing their way in the sea route or being swallowed by darkness.
unit.target: Proles, quae ex fundo maris in terram veniunt, etiam in nostris facultatibus confidunt, ut nebula, vorago, et tempestates superent, iter maris non amittendo nec a tenebris devorentur.

unit.source: Navigators… Lumian suddenly recalled the strange fish he had encountered on the Flying Bird, the Mutated Bannerfish, who could control the waves.
unit.target: Navigatores… Lumian subito recordatus est piscium insolitorum quos in "Flying Bird" invenerat, Bannerfish Mutata, qui fluctus regere poterant.

unit.source: They were also known as Death Navigators!
unit.target: Illi etiam Navigatores Mortis vocati erant!

unit.source: “Have you heard of the strange fish known as Death Navigators?”
unit.target: “Audivistine de piscibus insolitis, qui Navigatores Mortis vocantur?”

unit.source: Lumian interrupted Lato Guiaro’s account.
unit.target: Lumian narrationem Lato Guiaro interpellavit.

unit.source: Lato hesitated for a moment before responding,
unit.target: Lato paulisper vacillavit antequam respondit,

unit.source: “Yes, they’re also spawn of the sea.
unit.target: “Ita, etiam proles maris sunt.

unit.source: We all suspect that they were transformed from the Governors of the Sea who returned to the sea.”
unit.target: Omnes suspicamus eos ex Gubernatoribus Maris, qui ad mare redierunt, transformatos esse.”

unit.source: Transformed from the Governors of the Sea?
unit.target: Transformatos ex Gubernatoribus Maris?

unit.source: Lumian raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: Lumian supercilia erexit.

unit.source: Lato swallowed and explained, “They should still be fused with the sea, so future generations will be born, but their strength is inferior to theirs.
unit.target: Lato deglutivit et explicavit: “Adhuc cum mari coniungi debent, ut generationes futuras oriantur, sed eorum potentia minus quam eorum est.

unit.source: In the past, they only roamed those waters.
unit.target: In praeterito, solum in illis aquis vagabantur.

unit.source: In recent years, for some reason, they occasionally swam out and returned.
unit.target: In annis recentioribus, quaedam causa, aliquoties extra e aquas exsiluere et redierunt.

unit.source: After the sea prayer ritual failed last year, this situation became even more frequent.
unit.target: Post defectum ritus orationis maris anni superioris, haec condicio etiam frequentior facta est.

unit.source: Did the failure of the ritual cause the Death Navigators to go out more frequently?
unit.target: Num defectus ritus Mortis Navigatores frequentius exire causa fuit?

unit.source: Did the Death Navigators lure sailors to those special waters?
unit.target: Num Mortis Navigatores nautas ad illas aquas speciales alliciebant?

unit.source: Were they ultimately devoured by the sea?
unit.target: Num tandem a mari devorati sunt?

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced with questions, but he knew that Lato Guiaro couldn’t answer them.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani plurimas quaestiones affluebatur, sed sciebat Lato Guiaro eas respondere non posse.

unit.source: Lato returned to the main topic.
unit.target: Lato ad rem principalem rediit.

unit.source: We can still manipulate the waves to a certain extent and influence the tides, but we can’t compare to Juan Oro, much less the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Fluctus ad certum modum regere et aestus mores afficere possumus, sed nos cum Juan Oro, nedum gubernatore maris, comparari non possumus.

unit.source: That’s more like a Child of the Sea? That’s why they think it’s easier to bury me in the sea?
unit.target: Nonne hoc magis convenit ut Filius Maris? Idcirco putant me in mari facilius sepeliri?

unit.source: Lumian pondered as he inquired about a few more details. He then lowered his right foot from his left knee and slowly stood up.
unit.target: Lumian meditabatur dum plura percontabatur. Dein dextrum pedem a sinistro genu abstulit et lente surrexit.

unit.source: Nodding at the Knight of Swords in Lato’s eyes, Lumian said to Lato Guiaro, “Last request, release Nolfi and Batna.”
unit.target: Noddans ad Equum Gladii, qui in oculis Lato appareret, Lumian Lato Guiaro dixit: “Ultimam petitionem: libera Nolfi et Batna.”

unit.source: With that, Lumian walked to the bedroom window.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Lumian ad fenestram cubiculi ambulavit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the Knight of Swords, who had possessed Lato Guiaro, vanished.
unit.target: Simul, Eques Gladii, qui Lato Guiaro possidebat, evanuit.

unit.source: The committee member of the Fisheries Guild regained control of his body.
unit.target: Membrum commissionis Gildis Piscariorum iterum dominatum sui corporis obtinuit.

unit.source: As Lumian left, Lato Guiaro couldn’t help but express his confusion, fear, and a hint of uncontrollable emotion, “I thought you’d kill me once you got the information…”
unit.target: Dum Lumian discedebat, Lato Guiaro confusionem, timorem, et parvam passionis indomitabiles exprimere non potuit, dicens: “Putabam te me interficere, simulquam informationem adeptus esses…”

unit.source: Otherwise, wouldn’t it expose the fact that you have many hidden helpers, the secret of a faction behind you, and the uniqueness of your helpers?
unit.target: Alioquin nonne patefieret quod multos adiutores occulte haberes, secretum factionis tibi adsistentis, atque singularem virtutem auxiliatorum tuorum?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t look back and continued forward.
unit.target: Lumian non retrospexit et procedebat.

unit.source: On the way, he pressed down on his golden straw hat and smiled.
unit.target: In itinere, pileum stramineum aureum premebat et subridens ridebat.

unit.source: “To you, this might be important, but not to me.”
unit.target: “Tibi hoc fortasse grave sit, sed mihi non.”

unit.source: Just as Lato Guiaro was about to say something, he saw the body of the adventurer, Louis Berry, suddenly turn black and thin, transforming into a shadow that disappeared from the crimson moonlight’s reach.
unit.target: Ita ut Lato Guiaro aliquid dicere parabat, vidit corpus viatoris Ludovici Berry subito in nigrum et tenue mutari, convertens in umbram quae lumine lunaris coccinei evanuit.

unit.source: After staring at the darkness for a while, Lato adjusted the collar of his robe and left the master bedroom.
unit.target: Postquam aliquantisper in obscuritate aspexit, Lato scapulam vestis suae temperavit et ex cubiculo principali discessit.

unit.source: He personally headed to the basement to release Nolfi and Batna.
unit.target: Ipse ad cellam subterraneam properavit ad Nolfi et Batna liberandos.

unit.source: Opposite the building where his family resided, beneath a row of verdant trees,
unit.target: Contra aedificium, in quo familia eius habitabat, sub serie arborum viridium,

unit.source: Lumian leaned leisurely against the black gas streetlamp pole, gazing at the glass windows illuminated by the light.
unit.target: Lumian tranquille ad columnam lucernae nigrae recubuit, spectans fenestras vitreas, quae lumine illustratae erant.

unit.source: The disheveled, pale-faced Knight of Swords materialized behind him and asked in a deep voice, “Are you really not going to kill him?”
unit.target: Eques Gladii, facie soluta pallide, post eum apparuit et voce profunda rogavit: “Num vere eum non interficies?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “If we kill him, who’s going to inform Juan Oro that I have powerful helpers and the support of a powerful faction lurking in the shadows?”
unit.target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Si eum interficimus, quis Juan Oro certiorem faciet me potentes adiutores et sustentationem factionis robustae in umbris latentis habere?”

unit.source: He couldn’t just toss tarot cards at Lato Guiaro’s corpse, could he?
unit.target: Nonne non potuit simpliciter chartas taroci in corpus Lato Guiaro conicere?

unit.source: Furthermore, the problem lay in the fact that no one knew that the adventurer, Louis Berry, was a Minor Arcana cardholder of the Tarot Club.
unit.target: Praeterea, quaestio erat quod nemo sciebat viatorem Ludovicum Berry chartas Minoris Arcanae in Taroci Club tenere.

unit.source: Upon hearing Lumian’s response, the Knight of Swords pondered for a moment before vanishing into the darkness.
unit.target: Audito responsu Lumiani, Eques Gladii per momentum meditatus est, antequam in tenebras evanuerit.

unit.source: Before long, Batna emerged from the house where Lato Guiaro’s extended family resided, clutching his rapier and revolver.
unit.target: Non multo post, Batna ex domo, ubi familia Lato Guiaro habitabat, emergit, rapier et revolver tenens.

unit.source: Upon seeing Lumian, they looked a little ashamed and approached him with slow steps.
unit.target: Videns Lumian, parum verecundi videbantur et lente accesserunt ad eum.

unit.source: “Thank you for saving us,” Nolfi, adorable in a blouse and brown pants, expressed her sincere gratitude.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago quod nos servavisti,” inquit Nolfi, amabilis in pallio et braccis fuscis, sincera gratiam exprimens.

unit.source: Batna said, “I’m well aware of Nolfi’s intentions and haven’t been deceived by her. I sympathize with the tragic fate of these sea spawn and hope to help her end all of this.”
unit.target: Batna dixit, “Certe consilia Nolfi mihi nota sunt nec ab ea deceptus sum. Misericordia afficio fatum tragicum huius prole maris et spero me ei subvenire ut totum hoc finiat.”

unit.source: Lumian looked at Nolfi.
unit.target: Lumian Nolfi spectavit.

unit.source: “What kind of tragic end will it lead to?”
unit.target: “Quo genere fatale exitum hoc adducet?”

unit.source: The committee members of the Fisheries Guild seemed quite pleased.
unit.target: Membra commissionis Gildis Piscariorum satis laeta videbantur.

unit.source: Nolfi fell silent for a moment before saying, “All Maidens of the Sea and Children of the Sea eventually transform into a lizard-like humanoid monster.
unit.target: Nolfi paulisper siluit, antequam dixit: “Omnes puellae maris et filii maris tandem in monstrum humanoidem, simile lacertae, se transformant.

unit.source: Perhaps earlier, perhaps later, my mother passed away because she was attacked by assassins hired by the Fisheries Guild and wanted to die as a human.
unit.target: Fortasse prius, fortasse postea, mater mea perivit, quia a sicariis a Gildis Piscariorum conductis oppressa est et mori ut homo cupiebat.

unit.source: Not only did she refuse treatment, but she also inflicted some damage on herself.”
unit.target: Non solum curationem recusavit, sed etiam sibi ipsi damna attulit.”

unit.source: In that case, the humanoid lizard at Rubió Paco’s house is a common sight in families around Port Santa.
unit.target: Ergo, lacertae humanoides in domo Rubió Paco visae sunt vulgo inter familias circa Portum Santa.

unit.source: Why the need for secrecy?
unit.target: Cur igitur hoc secreto servari debet?

unit.source: Lumian turned to Batna with a smile, asking, “Did you know Nolfi would transform into a humanoid lizard?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Batna, cum subridente se vertens, rogavit: “Scisne Nolfi in lacertam humanoidam se transformaturam esse?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Batna expressed that he didn’t mind.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Batna, nihil sibi molestum esse.

unit.source: At that moment, Nolfi inquired, “Then do you know what a humanoid lizard looks like?”
unit.target: Illo momento, Nolfi interrogavit: “Scisne quo modo lacerta humana videatur?”

unit.source: As she spoke, the rather attractive female adventurer’s eyes widened. Shimmering illusory scales appeared on her body, and her skin transformed into that of a snake.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, oculi illae adventurae feminae decori dilatati sunt; squamae illusoriae nitidae in ea apparuerunt, et cutis eius in serpentis similitudinem mutata est.

unit.source: Batna jumped in fright, taking a step back involuntarily.
unit.target: Batna timore exsiliavit, et inopinato gradus retrorsum fecit.

unit.source: Lumian continued to ask Nolfi, “Why didn’t you rent a boat at a nearby port and find a sailor to sail it over? Why choose a ship rental company in Port Santa?”
unit.target: Lumian perrexit interrogans Nolfi: “Cur navem in porto proximo non locastisti atque nautae consilium inquirendi causa eam transvecturam optasti? Cur societatem navium locationis in Portu Santa eligis?”

unit.source: Nolfi undid the phantom scales, reverting to her original appearance, frustration and embarrassment evident in her voice.
unit.target: Nolfi scalas phantasmatum dissolvit, ad formam pristinam revertens, cum ira et verecundia in voce manifeste exprimentibus.

unit.source: “In Port Santa, people often rent boats for fishing and sightseeing. This should be a very ordinary thing…”
unit.target: “In Portu Santa, homines saepe naves locant ad piscandum et ad visitandum. Hoc res prorsus ordinaris esse debet…”

unit.source: Lumian sighed helplessly.
unit.target: Lumian infelix suspiravit.

unit.source: “Did you know that last year’s sea prayer ritual failed?
unit.target: “Scisne ritum orationis maris anni superioris defecisse?

unit.source: The Fisheries Guild will be on high alert this year, investigating all unstable factors.
unit.target: Gilda Piscariorum hoc anno vigilantia summa erunt, omnes incertas condiciones investigantes.

unit.source: Besides, the sea prayer ritual is only a few days away.
unit.target: Praeterea, ritus orationis maris in paucis diebus appropinquat.

unit.source: It’s inevitable to start paying attention to those who rent boats to go out to sea.”
unit.target: Inevitabile est incipere observare eos, qui naves locant ad mare proficiscendum.”

unit.source: Nolfi and Batna remained silent, resembling two students.
unit.target: Nolfi et Batna silentes mansuerunt, instar duorum discipulorum.

unit.source: After a moment, Nolfi asked in surprise and suspicion, “Did the sea prayer ritual fail last year?”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Nolfi, stupore et suspicione affecta, interrogavit: “Defecitne ritus orationis maris anni superioris?”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t answer immediately.
unit.target: Lumian statim non respondit.

unit.source: He thought for a moment and said,
unit.target: Post paulum cogitavit et dixit,

unit.source: “You want to end the sea prayer ritual with just the two of you? What gave you the confidence?”
unit.target: “Vultisne totum ritum orationis maris solum inter vos duos finire? Quid vobis fiduciam dedit?”

unit.source: Nolfi pursed her lips and stated, “As long as I can enter those waters and find the palace, I have a way to destroy it and end everything.”
unit.target: Nolfi labra contraxit et dixit: “Dummodo in eas aquas ingredi possim et palatium inveniam, viam habeo id delere et omnia finire.”

unit.source: “Palace?” Lumian’s eyebrows twitched.
unit.target: “Palatium?” Lumian supercilia subito contraxit.

unit.source: Nolfi nodded.
unit.target: Nolfi annuit.

unit.source: “When my mother was possessed by the sea, she saw a strange palace through her spirituality and the connection between them. It’s located at the bottom of the sea. It’s the palace of the sea!”
unit.target: “Cum mater mea ab mari possessa esset, palatium insolitum per eius spiritualem connectionem vidit. Illud in imo mari situm est. Id est palatium maris!”

unit.source: 562 Changed Plans
unit.target: 562 Consilia Mutata

unit.source: 562 Changed Plans
unit.target: 562 Consilia Mutata

unit.source: Palace?
unit.target: Palatium?

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t anticipated gaining information that Lato Guiaro lacked from Nolfi.
unit.target: Lumian non praevidebat notitiam ab Nolfi acquirere, quam Lato Guiaro non habebat.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he inquired, “What’s the palace like?”
unit.target: Post brevem moram interrogavit: “Qualis est palatium?”

unit.source: Was it an ancient relic or the abode of some natural spirit?
unit.target: An erat reliquia antiqua an domus alicuius spiritus naturae?

unit.source: Could the sea prayer ritual be tapping into the palace’s inner power?
unit.target: Num ritus orationis maritimae potentiam internam palatii excitare possit?

unit.source: Nolfi shook her head.
unit.target: Nolfi caput negans movit.

unit.source: “My mother couldn’t give a detailed description.”
unit.target: Mater mea descriptionem accuratam praebere non potuit.

unit.source: “She just mentioned that the palace is unlike any structure on land.”
unit.target: Illa tantum dixit palatium esse diversum ab quacumque structura in terra.

unit.source: “It boasts a peculiar design, with smooth curves and a reflective metallic sheen.”
unit.target: Illud praestat consilium peculiare, cum curvis lenibus et nitore metallico refulgente.

unit.source: “Overall, it’s silver-gray.”
unit.target: In summa, est argentocinereus.

unit.source: Lumian envisioned the palace based on Nolfi’s account, though lacking specifics, he could only conjure an approximate image.
unit.target: Lumian, ex Nolfi relatu, palatium repraesentavit; sed, carens particularibus, solam imaginem approximatam in mente effingere potuit.

unit.source: He grinned and remarked, “If that’s truly the sea palace, do you honestly believe you two can bring it down?
unit.target: Risus ostendens et dixit: “Si vere id est palatium maritimum, num vere creditis vos duo illud deicere posse?

unit.source: “If you struggle against Lato Guiaro and his crew, how do you plan to breach the sea spawn’s defenses?
unit.target: Si adversus Lato Guiaro et eius turbam luctamini, quomodo consilium habetis defensionem semen maris transgredi?

unit.source: How will you escape the sea’s fury?”
unit.target: Quomodo furorem maris evadetis?

unit.source: Nolfi paused for a moment before responding, “I have my ways.”
unit.target: Nolfi paulisper subsedit antequam respondit: “Viae meae sunt.”

unit.source: She didn’t elaborate on the method.
unit.target: Illa modum non explanavit.

unit.source: Could a Child of the Sea, likely below Sequence 7 in strength, truly destroy the sea palace?
unit.target: Num Puer Maris, probabiliter infra gradum VII in virtute, vere palatium maritimum delevare potest?

unit.source: An entity capable of unleashing violent storms across the entire sea…
unit.target: Entitas, quae tempestates feroces per totum mare efferre possit…

unit.source: Lumian pondered, forming a sudden hypothesis.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, subito hypothesim formans.

unit.source: Was Nolfi’s confidence rooted in collaboration with others?
unit.target: Num fiducia Nolfi in coniunctione cum aliis innata esset?

unit.source: Had she not returned to Port Santa without adequate preparations?
unit.target: Num illa ad Port Santa sine idoneis praeparationibus non redierit?

unit.source: As Lumian’s mind raced, he shifted his gaze toward Batna.
unit.target: Dum mens Lumiani correbat, oculos ad Batna convertit.

unit.source: Batna Comté, who had inadvertently distanced himself from Nolfi by two to three steps, had just re-sheathed his rapier and concealed his revolver.
unit.target: Batna Comté, qui casu a Nolfi duobus ad trium passus se distatus erat, geradeum suum modo reclusit et revolverum celavit.

unit.source: Sensing Lumian’s scrutiny, he grinned sheepishly and explained, “I’m here for support and to command the ship.
unit.target: Senseo Lumiani vigilantiam, rideo verecunde et dixit: “Ad auxilium et gubernandum navigium adsum.

unit.source: You might not know, but I served as a second mate for a while before becoming an adventurer.”
unit.target: Fortasse nescitis, sed aliquantisper, secundus nauta fui, antequam viator factus sim.

unit.source: In other words, he implied:
unit.target: Aliter, insinuavit:

unit.source: I’m not sure about Nolfi’s plan either.
unit.target: Non certo scio de consilio Nolfi.

unit.source: Whether she succeeds or not doesn’t concern me much.
unit.target: Sive succedit, sive non, non multum mihi refert.

unit.source: I’ve fulfilled my duty as a lover by providing some assistance.
unit.target: Officium amantis meum explere feci, auxilio praebendo.

unit.source: I can tell that you come from a good background based on your refined attire and grooming…
unit.target: Aptissime video te ex bona familia originem habere, ex vestitu tuo exquisito et decoro habitu…

unit.source: Initially, I thought you ran away from home, enchanted by Gehrman Sparrow’s adventure story, and went to sea to become an adventurer.
unit.target: Initio putavi te e domo fugisse, incantatus fabulae adventurarum Gehrman Sparrow, et in mare profectum esse ut viator.

unit.source: Now, it seems your family recommended you to be a second mate to gain work experience.
unit.target: Nunc videtur familia tua tibi suadisse ut secundus nauta fias, ad experientiam laboris adipiscendam.

unit.source: After a while, you resigned and chose the path of an adventurer…
unit.target: Post aliquo tempore, cessasti officium et iter viatoris elegisti…

unit.source: Lumian was unsure how to assess Batna’s romanticism.
unit.target: Lumian non certus erat quomodo Batnae amorositas aestimari posset.

unit.source: Glancing at him, he commented, “Do you realize how dangerous this situation is?”
unit.target: Eum intuens, inquit: “Scisne quam periculosum sit hic casus?”

unit.source: Batna cleared his throat and replied, “I thought the Children of the Seas wouldn’t be too formidable.
unit.target: Batna guttur purgavit et respondit: “Putabam Pueros Maris non esse nimis formidabiles.

unit.source: Nolfi and I have sparred before.”
unit.target: Nolfi et ego olim certavimus.

unit.source: Lumian eyed Batna for a couple of seconds before redirecting his gaze to Nolfi.
unit.target: Lumian Batnam aliquot secundis intuens, deinde oculos ad Nolfi verterit.

unit.source: “What are your plans moving forward?”
unit.target: “Quae sunt consilia vestra in posterum?”

unit.source: Without directly inquiring about hidden collaborators, Lumian circumvented the question, aiming to lower Nolfi’s guard and uncover any hints from her responses.
unit.target: Ne directe de sociis occultis interrogare vellet, Lumian quaestionem circumvenit, ut custodiam Nolfi minuere et indicia ex responsionibus eius detegeret.

unit.source: “We’ve been exposed and targeted by the Fisheries Guild.”
unit.target: “Manifesti facti sumus et a Gildia Piscaria destinati.”

unit.source: “Our original plan is no longer viable.”
unit.target: “Consilium nostrum originale iam non valet.”

unit.source: “I intend to lay low until the sea prayer ritual concludes.”
unit.target: “Intendo manere in obscuro, donec ritus orationis maritimae concluatur.”

unit.source: “Why not just leave?” Batna interjected, expressing surprise on Lumian’s “behalf.”
unit.target: “Cur non solum eundi?” intercessit Batna, pro Lumiano stuporem exprimens.

unit.source: He believed that once Nolfi’s motives and identity were revealed, she would promptly abandon this operation and devise an alternative plan for a future sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Putabat, cum motivi et identitas Nolfi revelata essent, eam celeriter hanc operationem desinere et consilium alterum pro futuro ritu orationis maritimae excogitare.

unit.source: Nolfi fell silent for a moment before revealing, “If the sea prayer ritual succeeds, and I’m still in Port Santa, being a Child of the Sea with a relatively pure bloodline, I should be able to gain a certain boon…”
unit.target: Nolfi paulisper silentium amplectita est antequam revelaret: “Si ritus orationis maritimae succedet, et dum Port Santa maneo, ut Puer Maris, stirpe relative pura, certum donum adipisci debeam…”

unit.source: She paused, briefly gazing at the ground.
unit.target: Illa paulisper cessavit, terram brevi intuens.

unit.source: “Although it might hasten my transformation into a humanoid lizard, it can also enhance my strength…”
unit.target: “Quamquam potest transformationem meam in lacertam humanoidem accelerare, fortitudinem meam etiam augere potest…”

unit.source: A subtle sorrow lingered in her words.
unit.target: Subtilis tristitia in verbis eius latuit.

unit.source: Batna stared blankly, his mouth agape, but no words escaped him.
unit.target: Batna stultiter intuens, ore patent, sed verba non effluere.

unit.source: Lumian raised his hand, adjusting the golden straw hat on his head.
unit.target: Lumian manum attollit, pileum aureum ex stramine in capite suo aptans.

unit.source: Using a well-known line from the Adventurer series, he remarked, “This is both a blessing and a curse.”
unit.target: Utitur notae lineae ex serie Adventurarum, et inquit: “Hoc est et benedictio et maledictum.”

unit.source: As Louis Berry prepared to depart, Nolfi once again expressed her sincere gratitude.
unit.target: Dum Louis Berry discedere parabat, Nolfi rursus sinceram gratiam suam expressit.

unit.source: “I don’t know how to express my gratitude.”
unit.target: “Nescio quomodo gratiam meam exprimam.”

unit.source: “If you need any help, feel free to come to me.”
unit.target: “Si auxilio egetis, libenter ad me venite.”

unit.source: “You can find me too,” Batna chimed in.
unit.target: “Et me invenire potestis,” inquit Batna.

unit.source: Caught between staying with Nolfi or leaving Port Santa, he hesitated.
unit.target: Inter manere cum Nolfi vel Portum Santa relinquere captus, moratus est.

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze swept across their faces, and he suddenly smiled.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani per vultus eorum transierunt, et ille subito subridens est.

unit.source: “Coincidentally, I have something for you two to do.”
unit.target: “Fortuito, aliquid habeo quod vobis duobus faciendum sit.”

unit.source: Nolfi was taken aback but nodded gently.
unit.target: Nolfi obstupefacta est, sed leniter annuit.

unit.source: “Just shoot.”
unit.target: “Modo iacula!”

unit.source: Having bid farewell to Nolfi and Batna, Lumian stealthily returned to Solow Motel from the shadows.
unit.target: Nolfi et Batna valedixit; Lumian clam ex umbris ad Solow Motel rediit.

unit.source: Emerging from the darkness in the corner of the master bedroom, he found the Knight of Swords standing by the curtains, silently observing him under the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Exiens e tenebris anguli cubiculi principalis, invenit Eques Gladii iuxta cortinas stantem, eum sub rubro lunari lumine silentem observantem.

unit.source: Why do you always appear like a scene from a ghost story… Is this a Wraith trait or a manifestation of the potion’s influence?
unit.target: Cur semper velut scaena ex fabula phantasmatis appareas? Estne hoc indoles Wraith aut effectus potionis manifestus?

unit.source: Lumian critiqued, expressing gratitude,
unit.target: Lumian reprehendit, gratias exprimens,

unit.source: “Thank you for your assistance.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago pro auxilio.”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords remained silent.
unit.target: Eques Gladii siluit.

unit.source: He looked at Lumian and inquired, “After controlling Lato Guiaro, it seems you’ve altered your original plan?”
unit.target: Eum Lumian aspiciens, inquit: “Post moderationem Lato Guiaro, videtur consilium tuum originale mutatum esse?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens est.

unit.source: “You’re quite perceptive, but I changed my mind perhaps a little earlier or later than the moment you specified.”
unit.target: “Es perspicax, sed mutavi consilium meum fortasse paulo ante aut post tempus, quod indicasti.”

unit.source: “How can an original plan be executed without any changes?”
unit.target: “Quomodo consilium originale sine mutatione exsequi potest?”

unit.source: “That’s not the mark of a Conspirer but an omnipotent and omniscient one.”
unit.target: “Hoc non est notum coniuratoris, sed notum omnipotentis et omniscientis.”

unit.source: “During the planning process, one must adjust their approach based on feedback, new information, and changes in the situation, while ensuring the true motive remains intact.”
unit.target: In processu consiliandi, viam sibi accommodare oportet ex commentariis, novis informationibus atque mutationibus rerum, dum tamen verum propositum manet intactum.

unit.source: Hence, concealing his true motives was crucial.
unit.target: Ergo, celare vera proposita eius maximi momenti erat.

unit.source: It was akin to the many paths between the starting point and the end, with often only one true conclusion.
unit.target: Id erat simile multis viis inter initium et finem, quibus saepe una tantum vera conclusio existit.

unit.source: This point was the most vulnerable to blockages and ambushes.
unit.target: Hic punctum maxime vulnerabile erat ad obstacula et insidias.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords listened quietly and then silently vanished by the window.
unit.target: Eques Gladii tranquille auscultavit, deinde silentio iuxta fenestram evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian allowed himself to relax, washed up, and retired to bed, sleeping soundly until six in the morning.
unit.target: Lumian se totum relaxare permisit, se lavavit, et in lectum se recepit, firmiter dormiens usque ad horam sextam mane.

unit.source: Following breakfast provided by the motel, he directed Lugano to take Ludwig to the streets for some snacks.
unit.target: Post prandium quod a motel praebitum erat, iussit Lugano ut Ludwig in vias ad aliquas delicias duceret.

unit.source: Observing their departure through the closed door, Lumian returned to the master bedroom, where the curtains still hung.
unit.target: Perspectans eorum discessum per ianuam clausam, Lumian ad cubiculi principalis rediit, ubi cortinae adhuc pendent.

unit.source: In the dimness, he pulled out the armchair from the desk and settled in.
unit.target: In tenebris, sellam ex mensa extraxit et consedit.

unit.source: After an indeterminate period, he suddenly noticed glimmers in the depths of the darkness.
unit.target: Post indefinitum tempus, subito micas in profundis tenebrarum animadvertit.

unit.source: He felt himself suspended in midair, devoid of solid ground beneath his feet or a backrest behind him.
unit.target: Sensit se in aere suspendi, terra firma sub pedibus aut subsidio tergo carentem.

unit.source: Lumian maintained a stoic expression as he gazed into the profound void with a cosmos-like backdrop.
unit.target: Lumian vultum stoicum servavit, dum in profundum vacuum cum aspectu cosmos simili intuens erat.

unit.source: From a distance, Juan Oro, the president of the Fisheries Guild, approached, attired in a formal suit and wielding a walking stick.
unit.target: Ex longinquo, Juan Oro, praesidens Gildiae Piscariae, accessit, vestitus in habitu formali, et baculo ambulatorio utebatur.

unit.source: Lumian looked at the old man in silence, displaying no surprise, as if anticipating Juan Oro’s arrival.
unit.target: Lumian senem silentiter respexit, sine ullo stupore, quasi adventum Juan Oro exspectans.

unit.source: As the distance closed to a certain extent, Juan Oro’s wrinkles trembled as he uttered in Intisian, “Milo Village was once obliterated, along with the sea spawn that ventured onto the land.
unit.target: Cum distantia ad certum finem accedisset, rugis Juan Oro tremuerunt, dum in Intisiano enuntiabat: “Vicus Milo olim deleptus est, una cum semine maris qui in terram profectus est.

unit.source: Yet, we stand here today.”
unit.target: Attamen hodie hic stamus.

unit.source: “As long as the sea endures, as long as the cosmos persists, as long as Port Santa remains a forbidden land for death, we can resurface from the sea’s depths, regardless of the blows we endure or the loss of our descendants.
unit.target: Dum mare perstat, dum cosmos perseverat, dum Portus Santa ut terra mortis vetita manet, ex profundis maris resurrecti esse possumus, non obstante ictibus susceptis aut posteritatis nostrae amissione.

unit.source: We can rebuild Milo Village and initiate the sea prayer ritual anew.”
unit.target: Vicuum Milo reficere et ritum orationis maritimae noviter incipere possumus.

unit.source: “This is attested by the clergyman of the Earth Mother Church, their combat ascetics, and their nuns.
unit.target: Hoc confirmant sacerdos Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, ascetae bellicosi, et moniales.

unit.source: “If we, the Children of the Sea, are truly pushed to the edge of a precipice, we possess the courage and determination to drag the enemy into the abyss.
unit.target: Si nos, Pueri Maris, vere ad margines praecipitis propulsi simus, animos et constantiam habemus ut hostem in abyssum trahere possimus.

unit.source: This is because we firmly believe in our indestructible spirit and the ability to rebuild our village, preventing its extinction.”
unit.target: Hoc est quod firmiter credimus in spiritu nostro indestructibili et facultate vicum nostrum reficiendi, ut eius exstinctionem impediamus.

unit.source: You share all this with me to convey that the Fisheries Guild and Milo Village’s sea spawn are unafraid of threats, possessing both the ability and courage to face powerful enemies.
unit.target: Haec omnia mihi narrare conaris, ut significes Gildiam Piscariam et semen maris Vici Milo non timere minas, sed habere et facultatem atque fortitudinem ad hostes potentes oppugnandos.

unit.source: Furthermore, you suggest that the corresponding legacies will endure, resurfacing from the sea in the future.
unit.target: Praeterea, suggeris has traditiones perseveraturos esse, in futurum ex mari resurrecturos.

unit.source: It’s akin to a warning, cautioning me not to go too far.
unit.target: Id instar admonitionis est, monens me ne nimis progrediar.

unit.source: Otherwise, they won’t hesitate to engage in an internecine conflict…
unit.target: Alioquin, non dubitabunt certamen internum aggredi.

unit.source: Lumian comprehended Juan Oro’s veiled message and chose not to respond.
unit.target: Lumian nuntium velatum Juan Oro intellexit, et statuit non respondere.

unit.source: He silently observed the old man, waiting for him to continue.
unit.target: Eum senem silentiter intuens, expectabat ut prosequeretur.

unit.source: Juan Oro’s azure eyes reflected the image of the black-haired, green-eyed adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Oculi azurii Juan Oro repraebant imaginem adventoris, cui capilli nigri et oculi virides erant.

unit.source: In a resonant voice, he questioned, “What do you and the forces supporting you desire?
unit.target: In voce resonante, inquit: “Quid vos atque vires vestras concupimini?

unit.source: What is your aim?
unit.target: Quid est propositum vestrum?

unit.source: We won’t tolerate the disruption of the sea prayer ritual, nor will we abandon the foundations laid in Port Santa.”
unit.target: Non tolerabimus interruptionem ritus orationis maritimae, nec fundamenta Portus Santae posita relinquere.

unit.source: Realizing that adventurer Louis Berry is not only formidable but also backed by a faction, they must perceive me as a tough adversary.
unit.target: Intellegens adventorem Louis Berry non solum formidabilem sed etiam factione sustentatum, me ut adversarium durissimum agnoscere debere.

unit.source: If they were to confront me head-on, they might find it challenging to prevail.
unit.target: Si me frontem oppugnarent, difficile eis erit praevalere.

unit.source: Hence, he’s here to negotiate, seeking to exchange concessions for my withdrawal?
unit.target: Ergo hic adest ut negociem, quaerens concessionibus pro mea recessione commutandis?

unit.source: Is he attempting to assert his bottom line and strength to dissuade me from rash actions, leaving both sides with a way out?
unit.target: Num conatur sua limina et virtutem demonstrando me a impetu imprudente deterrere, utrisque partibus viam evasionis relinquens?

unit.source: Lumian showed no surprise.
unit.target: Lumian nullam admirationem ostendit.

unit.source: He glanced around and remarked, “Why isn’t there a chair?
unit.target: Cur non est sella?

unit.source: I prefer discussing matters while seated.”
unit.target: Malo de rebus disputare dum sedens sum.

unit.source: After a brief silence from Juan Oro, the armchair reappeared behind Lumian, and he resumed his original posture.
unit.target: Post brevem silentium a Juan Oro, sellam post Lumian iterum apparuit, et ille statum suum originalem assumpsit.

unit.source: Lumian calmly gazed at Juan Oro, the Fisheries Guild president, and stated, “Would you believe me if I told you I never intended to disrupt the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Lumian tranquille ad Juan Oro, praesidem Gildiae Piscariae, respexit, et inquit: “Credesne mihi, si dicerem me numquam intendisse ritum orationis maritimae perturbare?”

unit.source: “Never intended to disrupt the sea prayer ritual…” Juan Oro repeated, his deep wrinkles furrowing.
unit.target: “Numquam intentum fuisse perturbare ritum orationis maritimae…” iteravit Juan Oro, rugis profundis contristis.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “As long as you’re willing to spare the innocent, like the fake Governor of the Sea, cooperation isn’t out of the question.”
unit.target: Lumian pergebat: “Dummodo innocentes parcere velis, sicut falsus Praefectus Maris, cooperatio non excluditur.”

unit.source: “Cooperation?” Juan Oro couldn’t conceal his astonishment.
unit.target: “Cooperatio?” non potuit Juan Oro stuporem celare.

unit.source: He scrutinized the adventurer who had forcefully intervened in the Fisheries Guild’s affairs upon arriving at Port Santa.
unit.target: Adventorem, qui vi interfuit rebus Gildiae Piscariae in Porto Santa, perspexit.

unit.source: Lumian had stormed the Governor of the Sea’s residence, blown up the Fisheries Guild’s main building, and nearly killed his grandson.
unit.target: Lumian domum Praefecti Maris invasit, aedificium principale Gildiae Piscariae deleuit, et paene nepos eius interficit.

unit.source: He wondered if his hearing had slowed down like the other elders.
unit.target: Mirabatur num auditus eius, ut aliorum seniorum, tardiores factus esset.

unit.source: A smile gradually spread across Lumian’s face.
unit.target: Subridens paulatim per faciem Lumiani diffusus est.

unit.source: He leaned back in his chair and snapped his fingers, igniting a crimson flame.
unit.target: Se in sella recedens, digitos sesuit et flammam rubram excitavit.

unit.source: “Yes, cooperation.”
unit.target: “Ita, cooperatio.”

unit.source: 563 Another Attempt
unit.target: 563 Alterus Conatus

unit.source: 563 Another Attempt
unit.target: 563 Alterus Conatus

unit.source: Upon learning the intricacies of Louis Berry’s collaboration and his unwavering commitment, Juan Oro found himself questioning the reliability of his own ears once again.
unit.target: Notis intricatis consortionis Ludovici Berry et eius indefessae dedicationis adeptus, Iuanus Oro iterum se ipsos interrogavit de fidelitate aurium suarum.

unit.source: It wasn’t that the other party’s demands were outrageous or absurd, making it sound like some kind of jest.
unit.target: Non enim postulata alterius partis erant indecentes nec absurda, ita ut quasi iocus videbantur.

unit.source: On the contrary, the Fisheries Guild could fulfill his desires with minimal effort, without requiring a substantial payment.
unit.target: Contra vero, Corporatio Piscatoria desideria eius minimo opere exsequi poterat, sine magno pretio postulato.

unit.source: This went beyond Juan Oro’s initial expectations.
unit.target: Hoc transgressit initiales exspectationes Iuani Oro.

unit.source: Prior to meeting Louis Berry, he had mentally prepared himself for potential ruthless “extortion.”
unit.target: Ante Ludovicum Berry convenire, se mente praeparaverat ad extortionem inhumanam.

unit.source: After all, considering the ease with which the other party subdued Lato Guiaro and displayed strength against the Fisheries Guild, Oro had anticipated a tougher negotiation.
unit.target: Postremo, cum consideraret quomodo altera pars Lato Guiaro subiecit et contra Corporatum Piscatorium vim ostendit, Oro duriorem tractationem praevidit.

unit.source: Surprisingly, Louis Berry proved to be more amenable to discussion than Oro had envisioned.
unit.target: Admirabiliter, Ludovicus Berry ad colloquium magis paratus esse apparuit quam Oro praevidisset.

unit.source: This led Juan Oro to contemplate whether there might be some deception at play.
unit.target: Hoc adduxit Iuanum Oro ad considerandum utrum aliqua deceptio in ludo esset.

unit.source: He wondered if, in the future, Berry would abruptly turn against him during their collaboration, breaking the promises made.
unit.target: Mirabatur num in futurum Berry, dum collaborabant, repente adversus eum verteret, promissa fregens.

unit.source: Lumian observed the wrinkled old man silently, refraining from clarifying his intentions.
unit.target: Lumian senem rugosum silentio observavit, a propositis suis explanandis abstinens.

unit.source: Explaining might expose his true motives, and the timing wasn’t right yet.
unit.target: Explicare eius veros intentos detegere posset, et tempus nondum idoneum erat.

unit.source: After careful consideration, Juan Oro let out a sigh of age.
unit.target: Post diligentem considerationem, Iuanus Oro suspirium senectutis edidit.

unit.source: “We can accede to your request.”
unit.target: «Ad petitionem tuam consentire possumus.»

unit.source: “However, throughout our collaboration, we will remain vigilant and formulate contingency plans.”
unit.target: «Attamen, per nostra collaborationem, vigiles manebimus et consilia subsidia pariemus.»

unit.source: Lumian smiled, rising from the suspended armchair in the void.
unit.target: Lumian subridens ex sellā suspendita in vacuo surrexit.

unit.source: He extended his right hand to Juan Oro.
unit.target: Manum dexteram ad Iuanum Oro extendit.

unit.source: “Pleasure working with you.”
unit.target: «Mihi placet tecum operari.»

unit.source: Juan Oro shook his hand and remarked, “You’re not as crazy as you seem…”
unit.target: Iuanus Oro manum eius concussit et inquit, «Non es tam insanus quam videaris…»

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and smirked.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et subridens.

unit.source: “Of course, I’ve always been a clever, rational, and polite adventurer.”
unit.target: «Certe, semper fui callidus, rationabilis, et urbanus viator.»

unit.source: Juan Oro wasn’t in the mood for idle chatter.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro ad inanem sermonicam non se paratus habebat.

unit.source: He nodded at Louis Berry and stated, “Given your preference for discretion in our collaboration, I should depart now.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro ad Ludovicum Berry annuens dixit, «Quoniam ex tua discretione in nostra cooperatione, nunc discedere mihi oportet.»

unit.source: Otherwise, my visit might become known to others.”
unit.target: Alioquin, adventus meus aliis patebit.
