unit.source: Lumian took a moment to contemplate before responding, “I’ll dispatch my concealed companion to Milo Village tomorrow night.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde respondit: «Socium meum occultum cras vespere ad Vicum Milo mittam.»

unit.source: Ensure the surviving sailors from last year’s ritual are brought to your main building in advance and kept under control.”
unit.target: Fac ut nautae supersistentes ex ritu anni praeteriti ad aedificium principale tuum praevideantur et sub moderamine retineantur.

unit.source: “Agreed.” Juan Oro didn’t object; this was one of the terms they had agreed upon.
unit.target: «Consentio.» Iuanus Oro non objicit; hoc una ex conditionibus concordatis erat.

unit.source: As the cane-wielding old man prepared to leave, Lumian called out thoughtfully,
unit.target: Dum senex baculo utens discedere parabat, Lumian meditabundus exclamavit:

unit.source: “I’m a man of my word. I promised Giorgia I wouldn’t disclose the details of the commission to anyone.
unit.target: «Vir sum verbi mei. Promisi Giorgiae me commissionis singularia neminimo aliqui revelaturum esse.»

unit.source: “But I have a question for you. Have any Children of the Sea from the Paco family gone missing recently or not been seen for an extended period?”
unit.target: «Sed habeo tibi quaestionem. Num aliqui Filii Maris ex familia Paco nuper evanuerunt vel diu non visi sunt?»

unit.source: He hinted that his inquiry was linked to the Paco family’s commission.
unit.target: Indicavit quaestionem suam cum commissione familiae Paco conexam esse.

unit.source: Juan Oro’s expression darkened as he contemplated for more than ten seconds.
unit.target: Vultus Iuani Oro obscuratus est, dum per plus quam decem secunda meditabat.

unit.source: “The Paco family’s Children of the Sea have made appearances recently.
unit.target: «Filii Maris familiae Paco nuper apparuerunt.

unit.source: “At first, I thought something had happened to Rubió’s mother, Martha, that we shouldn’t know about.
unit.target: «Initio putavi aliquid evenisse matri Rubió, Martha, quod nescire debuimus.

unit.source: Yet, it turns out she’s still fine, just severely injured.”
unit.target: At, apparuit eam adhuc esse incolumem, sed graviter laesa est.

unit.source: No missing Children of the Sea from the Paco family?
unit.target: Nonne nulli Filii Maris ex familia Paco absentes sunt?

unit.source: Where did the humanoid lizard come from?
unit.target: Unde orta est lacerta, quae humano similis est?

unit.source: Lumian was alarmed.
unit.target: Lumian consternatus est.

unit.source: His initial thought was that the Paco family might be involved with other Children of the Sea.
unit.target: Prima eius cogitatio fuit quod familia Paco fortasse cum aliis Filiis Maris implicaretur.

unit.source: His second thought was that one of the Paco family’s Children of the Sea might have been replaced.
unit.target: Secunda eius cogitatio fuit quod unus ex Filiis Maris familiae Paco substitutus esset.

unit.source: Is the impostor parading around with the original’s face, while the real individual had transformed into a humanoid lizard, meeting their demise at the hands of the great adventurer?
unit.target: Num impostor, vultum originalis ferens, vagatur, dum verus homo in lacertam, similem homini, conversus est atque a magno viatore interfectus est?

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but associate the substitute and the frequent appearances of the person in question with a Sequence name: Faceless!
unit.target: Lumian non potuit quin substitutum et frequentes manifestationes personae in quaestione ad nomen Sequenciae: Faceless coniungeret!

unit.source: It aligned with the Lie earring’s Sequence—the previous Sequence of Marionettist Loki!
unit.target: Consonabat cum Sequencia "Lie Earring"—praevia Sequencia Marionettistae Loki!

unit.source: Could it be that after Loki’s resurrection, he infiltrated Port Santa and clandestinely replaced a key member of the Paco family?
unit.target: Num fieri potuit ut post resurrectionem Loki, Portum Santae infiltratus, et clandestine membrum praecipuum familiae Paco substituisset?

unit.source: Was his goal to set a trap for me and execute something during the sea prayer ritual, continuing what he had left incomplete the previous year?
unit.target: Num finis eius esset mihi laqueum parare et aliquid exsequi in ritu orationis maris, continuans id quod anno praeterito relictum erat?

unit.source: With these thoughts swirling, Lumian couldn’t help but experience a blend of excitement and fear.
unit.target: His cogitationibus circumvolantibus, Lumian excitatio et timor miscendi affectus sensit.

unit.source: However, upon further consideration, he dismissed the notion.
unit.target: Attamen, post ulteriora consideratione, notionem illa destitit.

unit.source: If Loki had genuinely substituted an essential member of the Paco family, there wouldn’t be any humanoid lizard sightings.
unit.target: Si Loki vere membrum essentiale familiae Paco substituisset, appariciones lacertae hominiformis nullae fuisset.

unit.source: He could have discreetly resolved the issue and erased all traces, avoiding such an obvious loophole!
unit.target: Potuisset rem caute solvere et vestigia omnia delere, ita ut talem evidens hiatus vitaret!

unit.source: Moreover, Rubió Paco wasn’t the sole Child of the Sea in the Paco family.
unit.target: Praeterea, Rubió Paco non erat solus Filius Maris in familia Paco.

unit.source: Martha, as a Maiden of the Sea, also wielded the residual power of the sea.
unit.target: Martha, ut Puella Maris, etiam potentiam residuam maris gerebat.

unit.source: How could they struggle against a humanoid lizard whose strength hadn’t reached the Mid-Sequence?
unit.target: Quomodo poterant pugnare contra lacertam hominiformem, cuius vis ad "Mid-Sequence" nondum pervenisset?

unit.source: Why would they take the risk of exposing the secret and hiring an external adventurer, Louis Berry, to handle the situation?
unit.target: Cur periculum suscipere velint ut secretum patefacerent et adventorem externum, Ludovicum Berry, ad rem administrandam conducerent?

unit.source: With Lumian’s comprehension of the sea prayer ritual and sea spawn deepening, it left him even more bewildered about the Paco family’s previous decisions.
unit.target: Cum cognitione Lumiani de ritu orationis maris et maris progenie augebat, eum adhuc magis de decisionibus praeteritis familiae Paco perplectum reliquit.

unit.source: He believed that crucial information was concealed within.
unit.target: Credidit informationes maximi momenti intus absconditas esse.

unit.source: He turned to Juan Oro, organizing his thoughts.
unit.target: Ad Iuanum Oro se vertit, suas cogitationes ordinans.

unit.source: “Are descendants of the same Maidens of the Sea prohibited from attacking each other?”
unit.target: «Num descendentibus eademum Puellarum Maris inter se pugnare vetitum sit?»

unit.source: “There’s no such restriction.” Juan Oro dismissed Lumian’s speculation.
unit.target: «Talis restrictio non est.» Iuanus Oro speculatio Lumiani reiecit.

unit.source: Lumian deliberately mused aloud, “Then why did the Paco family intentionally hire an outsider like me for the commission instead of utilizing their own Beyonders?”
unit.target: Lumian deliberanter voce edixit, «Cur ergo familia Paco expresse extraneum, ut me conduceret pro commissione, potius quam proprios Beyonders adhiberet?»

unit.source: Juan Oro maintained his serious expression.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro vultum gravem retinuit.

unit.source: “It’s for the same reason I hired someone to monitor Paco’s house.
unit.target: «Idem est, quod aliquem conducui ut domum Paconis custodiret.»

unit.source: That’s why I sent the Little Devil to interrogate you.
unit.target: Quare Parvum Diabolum ad te interrogandum misi.

unit.source: That’s why I needed to meet Martha.”
unit.target: Quare mihi necessarium fuit Martha convenire.

unit.source: You call that wrinkled, old man-like monster “Little Devil”?
unit.target: Num illud rugosum, senile monstrum, "Parvus Diabolum" vocas?

unit.source: Lumian nodded gently and asked, “The Paco family must be harboring a significant secret.”
unit.target: Lumian leniter annuit et quaesivit, «Familia Paco certe magnum secretum celat.»

unit.source: He refrained from delving deeper and watched as Juan Oro turned away, walking off with his cane.
unit.target: Non ulterius indagare voluit et spectabat, dum Iuanus Oro se avertit, baculo suo ambulans.

unit.source: Soon, the Cosmic Void around him dissipated, and he “returned” to the draped master bedroom of the suite, seated in the armchair before the desk.
unit.target: Mox, Vacuitas Cosmica circa eum evanuit, et ille "rediit" ad cubiculum magnum ornatum suite, sedens in sellā ante mensam.

unit.source: Lumian smiled, pivoted, grasped the curtain, and drew it open.
unit.target: Lumian subridens se vertit, cortinam arripuit et aperuit.

unit.source: The morning sun flooded in, casting a radiant glow.
unit.target: Sol matutinus irrumpit, splendore radiante effusus.

unit.source: The next night, within the ancestral house of the Oro family in Milo Village, a structure only one floor shorter than the residence of the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Nocte secunda, intra domum maiorum familiae Oro in Vicus Milo, structura tantum uno tabulato breviore quam residentia Gubernatoris Maris.

unit.source: The building had undergone numerous renovations, showcasing a fusion of antiquated and modern architecture.
unit.target: Aedificium plurimas renovationes habuerat, ostendens mixturam architecturae antiquae et modernae.

unit.source: Blackened gray stone walls stood alongside concrete pillars, and beneath the seaweed-covered roof lay red‐ringed tiles.
unit.target: Muri lapidei grisei nigriti iuxta columnas concreti stabant, et sub tecto operto algis marinis tegulae rubro‐annulatae iacebant.

unit.source: The door to the first-floor lounge had been shut, leaving only an elderly man with a black cane—Juan Oro—and his cherished grandson—Fernandez Oro—
unit.target: Porta ad primum tabulatum conclave clausa erat, relinquens solum senem cum baculo nigro—Iuanus Oro—et nepotem carum—Fernandez Oro—

unit.source: alongside eight unconscious villagers of Milo Village sprawled on the ground.
unit.target: una cum octo incolis vicanis inconscientes in terra iacentes.

unit.source: Suddenly, a shadow flickered in a corner of the room, and a figure materialized.
unit.target: Subito, umbra in angulo conclavis micavit, et figura materialiter apparuit.

unit.source: Standing just over 1.7 meters tall, the figure possessed an ordinary face and sported a brownish-green short-sleeved shirt, loose brownish-yellow pants, strapless leather shoes with vents, and a short circular felt hat.
unit.target: Stans paulo plus quam 1.7 metra altus, figura faciem ordinarum habebat atque indutus erat tunica brevis manica fusco-viride, bracas laxas fusco-flavas, calceos ex coriaceo sine cingulis cum foramina, et petasum feltrinum breve rotundum.

unit.source: “Who are you?” Juan Oro inquired in Intisian.
unit.target: «Quis es tu?» Iuanus Oro in Intisiana quaesivit.

unit.source: As one of Port Santa’s strongest sea merchants, he had sailed numerous times between the ages of 30 and 50.
unit.target: Ut unus ex fortissimis negotiatoribus maritimis Portus Santae, multoties navigaverat inter annos 30 et 50.

unit.source: It was only natural for him to comprehend Intisian.
unit.target: Naturale erat ei Intisianam linguam intellegere.

unit.source: The man responded fluently in Highlander, “I’m Louis Berry’s companion. You can call me Charname.”
unit.target: Vir in lingua Highlander fluenter respondit, «Socius sum Ludovici Berry. Me Charname vocare potes.»

unit.source: It doesn’t seem like the spirit-type Beyonder Lato encountered…
unit.target: Non videtur esse ut spiritus generis Beyonder quem Lato occurrit…

unit.source: Louis Berry has more than one companion lurking in the shadows…
unit.target: Ludovicus Berry plus quam unum socium in tenebris latitantem habet…

unit.source: Juan Oro rejoiced that he had chosen negotiation first.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro exsultavit quod primum negotiationem elegisset.

unit.source: With these thoughts racing through his mind, he glanced at Fernandez, whose face remained pale, and understood that he wasn’t entirely pleased.
unit.target: His cogitationibus per mentem currantibus, ad Fernandez intuens, cuius facies pallida manebat, intellexit eum non omnino laetum esse.

unit.source: It was common for young lads to be calculating about who suffered and who benefited, often forgetting their most essential motives.
unit.target: Communiter iuvenes computabant, quis pati et quis lucrari, saepe obliti suarum principalium volitionum.

unit.source: “You can start questioning them,” Juan Oro instructed the man known as Charname.
unit.target: «Potes incipere eos interrogare,» Iuanus Oro viro Charname noto imperavit.

unit.source: “Over the past year, we’ve employed various methods to determine if they’re lying or not.
unit.target: «Per annum praeteritum, variis modis investigavimus utrum mendacium dicerent aut non.

unit.source: We’ve even exploited the uniqueness of other sea spawn.
unit.target: Etiam singularitatem aliorum progenie maris adhibuimus.

unit.source: All the results indicate that they’ve told the complete truth and concealed nothing.
unit.target: Omnia indicia ostendunt eos plenam veritatem dixerint neque quidquam celaverint.

unit.source: The failure of the sea prayer ritual has nothing to do with them.
unit.target: Defectus ritu orationis maris nihil ad eos pertinet.

unit.source: Charname’s lips curved into a smile as he replied, “How would I know if I don’t give it a shot myself?”
unit.target: Labia Charname in risum conversae sunt, et respondit: «Quomodo id scirem, nisi ipse conarer?»

unit.source: Approaching the unconscious sailors, he retrieved a dagger and stabbed their fingertips one by one, smearing the corresponding blood on various spots on the back of his hand.
unit.target: Accedens nautas inconscientes, hasta tulit et singulos digitos percussit, sanguinem in diversis partibus dorsum manus suae imprimitens.

unit.source: Amidst the pain, the sailors began to awaken one after another.
unit.target: Inter dolorem, nautae uno post alium evigere coeperunt.

unit.source: In front of them, Charname produced a mirror and smiled.
unit.target: Coram illis, Charname speculum produxit et subridens.

unit.source: “Your blood will reveal if you’re lying and if you’re the genuine person.
unit.target: «Sanguis vester ostendet num mentimini et num persona vera sitis.

unit.source: If anyone deceives me, their blood will burn on the mirror, and they’ll face the same fate.
unit.target: Si quis me decipiat, sanguis eius in speculo ardebit, et eandem sortem patiendum habebit.

unit.source: “Alright, answer them one by one.”
unit.target: «Ita, responde uno post alium.»

unit.source: As Charname spoke, he calmly transferred the blood from the back of his hand to the mirror, a strange sight as it seemed to seep into the glass.
unit.target: Dum Charname loquebatur, sanguinem ex dorso manus suae ad speculum tranquilliter transtulit, spectaculum mirum, quod quasi in vitrum se infunderet.

unit.source: The sailors glanced at Juan Oro, realizing this was another investigation into the cause of the sea prayer ritual’s failure last year.
unit.target: Nautae Iuanum Oro intuentes animadvertierunt hoc aliam inquisitionem de causa defectus ritu orationis maris anni praeteriti esse.

unit.source: Skilfully, they recounted their experiences, leaving no details omitted.
unit.target: Arte, suas experientias enarraverunt, nullum singulum omittentes.

unit.source: After hearing their accounts, Charname asked thoughtfully, “Were Iru and Salah responsible for transporting the lamb sacrifices?”
unit.target: Postquam narrationes audivit, Charname cogitabundus rogavit: «Eramne Iru et Salah responsables ad transportanda agnorum sacrificia?»

unit.source: “Yes,” all the sailors replied in unison.
unit.target: «Ita,» omnes nautae simul responderunt.

unit.source: Charname pressed on, “Did they both perish during the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Charname continuavit: «Num uterque in ritu orationis maris perierit?»

unit.source: The surviving sailors nodded, confirming that their two companions had been thrown overboard in the tidal wave of the failed ritual, never to surface again.
unit.target: Nautae supersistentes annuerunt, confirmantes duos socios suis in fluctibus ritu orationis maris defuncti proieci esse, nec umquam iterum apparuerint.

unit.source: Turning to Juan Oro, Charname inquired, “Do you have any belongings from Iru and Salah? Clothes they’ve worn many times, toothbrushes not discarded, and the like.
unit.target: Conversus ad Iuanum Oro, Charname rogavit, «Habesne aliqua supellex de Iru et Salah? Vestimenta quoties gestaverunt, dentifricia nondum abiecta, et similia?»

unit.source: “I want to try summoning their spirits.
unit.target: «Volo spiritus eorum evocare.

unit.source: Although most of their spirits would have dissipated over the past year and can’t remember effective information, the state of their spirits can reveal certain things, such as deep resentment and hatred.”
unit.target: Quamquam pleraque eorum spiritus per annum praeteritum evanuerunt et informationem efficacem meminisse non possint, status eorum spirituum quaedam revelare potest, ut profunda invidia et odium.

unit.source: Juan Oro shook his head.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro caput gyravit, negans.

unit.source: “We attempted it after the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: «Post ritum orationis maris id conati sumus.

unit.source: We couldn’t summon their spirits.
unit.target: Non potuimus spiritus eorum evocare.

unit.source: Those consumed by the raging sea would have their spirits devoured as well.”
unit.target: Illi, a mari furioso devorati, spiritus eorum quoque vellentur.

unit.source: Charname chuckled and suggested, “Let’s give it another shot. There’s nothing to lose by trying.”
unit.target: Charname subridens risit et suadit: «Iterum conemur. Nihil amittendum est per conatum.»

unit.source: Juan Oro pondered for a moment and agreed.
unit.target: Iuanus Oro paulisper meditatus et consentivit.

unit.source: He immediately instructed Fernandez to retrieve Iru’s extracted tooth and Salah’s clothes, previously used for spirit channeling.
unit.target: Statim Iuanus Oro Fernandez imperavit ut dentem Iru extractum et vestimenta Salah, quae antea ad spiritus evocandos adhibita erant, adduceret.

unit.source: Then, they observed as Charname set up the altar and initiated a summoning ritual.
unit.target: Deinde, observaverunt dum Charname aram instituit et ritum evocationis initium fecerit.
«Ego!

unit.source: “I summon in my name:
unit.target: «Ego in nomine meo evoco:

unit.source: “The sailor of Port Santa’s Milo Village, a man named Iru Adela, the owner of this tooth…”
unit.target: «Nauta Vicus Milo Portus Santae, vir nomine Iru Adela, huius dentis possessor…

unit.source: A gust of wind blew, and the altar’s candle flame took on a dark-green hue.
unit.target: Inflavit ventus, et flamma candelæ aræ viridi obscuro colore induta est.

unit.source: A blurry figure quickly materialized.
unit.target: Figura obscura celeriter apparuit.

unit.source: Success? He actually succeeded?
unit.target: Successus? Vere successit?

unit.source: Fernandez’s pupils dilated as he gazed above the candle flame.
unit.target: Pupillae Fernandez dilatatae sunt, dum super flammam candelæ spectabat.

unit.source: The figure vaguely resembled Iru, but it showed no signs of drowning; its skin was pale-white and swollen.
unit.target: Figura vix Iru similis erat, sed nullas signa submersionis ostendebat; cutis eius pallide alba et tumida erat.

unit.source: Instead, its face was covered in blood, and there was an evident wound on its forehead.
unit.target: Proinde, facies eius sanguine operta erat, et vulneratio manifesta in fronte eius videbatur.

unit.source: The specter’s eyes brimmed with pain and hatred.
unit.target: Oculi phantasmatis dolore atque odio repleti erant.

unit.source: 564 Individual Roles
unit.target: 564 Munera Individualia

unit.source: 564 Individual Roles
unit.target: 564 Munera Individualia

unit.source: Looking at the specter suspected to be Iru, Juan Oro’s expression shifted.
unit.target: Spectram, quem Iru esse putabatur, intuebatur; vultus Juan Oro mutatus est.

unit.source: Back then, even though they had missed the optimal time for spirit channeling, they still managed to learn about the deaths on the first day and found items that could accurately pinpoint the target.
unit.target: Illo tempore, quamquam tempus optimum ad spiritus evocandos amiserant, tamen didicerunt de mortibus primi diei et repererunt res, quae scopum exacte designare poterant.

unit.source: Utilizing the Little Devil’s ability, they completed the summoning, but none of the deceased spirits appeared.
unit.target: Donum Parvi Diaboli adhibito, evocationem perfecerunt, sed nulli spiritus defuncti apparuerunt.

unit.source: This led them to believe that the human spirits that angered the sea would be devoured.
unit.target: Hoc eos fecit credere spiritus humanos, qui mare iraserunt, devoratos iri.

unit.source: No further attempts were made.
unit.target: Nulla conamina ulteriora facta sunt.

unit.source: Nearly a year later, the summoning had actually succeeded!
unit.target: Paene post annum, evocatio vere successit!

unit.source: Moreover, it appeared that Iru hadn’t drowned at sea but had been shot.
unit.target: Praeterea videbatur Iru non in mari submersum esse, sed in eum telum iactum fuisse.

unit.source: This was entirely different from the backlash caused by the failure of the sea prayer ritual!
unit.target: Hoc omnino differebat ab ulteriore incommodo, quod ex defectione ritus precationis maris ortum erat!

unit.source: Charname used Hermes to inquire about the spirit suspected to be Iru, but the target was already in a daze and couldn’t recall anything.
unit.target: Charname Hermem ad rogandum de spiritu, qui Iru esse putabatur, usus est; sed destinatus iam in stupore versabatur et nihil recordari poterat.

unit.source: Even his appearance had become blurry, assimilated by the environment.
unit.target: Etiam eius species obscurata erat, ambiente absorpta.

unit.source: Charname concluded the ritual and used Salah’s clothes, worn over many years, to summon the spirit of the other deceased.
unit.target: Charname ritum conclusit et vestimenta Salah, per multos annos induta, ad spiritum alterorum defunctorum evocandum usus est.

unit.source: This time, nothing happened.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, nihil accidit.

unit.source: Charname refrained from further attempts.
unit.target: Charname ab ulterius conatibus abstinuit.

unit.source: He extinguished the candle’s flame and dispelled the wall of spirituality.
unit.target: Flammam candelæ exstinxit et murum spiritualitatis dissolvit.

unit.source: In Highlander, he addressed Juan Oro, “The problem has become clearer.”
unit.target: In Highlander, Juan Oro allocutus est: "Quaestio clarius facta est."

unit.source: Juan Oro didn’t respond.
unit.target: Juan Oro non respondit.

unit.source: Instead, he turned to his grandson, Fernandez.
unit.target: Immo, ad nepotem suum, Fernandez, se vertit.

unit.source: “Take them out and send them home.”
unit.target: "Eos extrahite et domum mittite."

unit.source: “Instruct each of them.”
unit.target: "Unicuique eos instruite."

unit.source: “Alright.” Although Fernandez yearned to hear Charname’s conjecture and understand the subsequent events, he didn’t dare disobey his grandfather’s orders.
unit.target: “Bene.” Quamquam Fernandez concupivit audire sententiam Charname et subsequenta intellegere, non ausus est praecepta avi sui contraria agere.

unit.source: He hurriedly led the surviving sailors out of the lounge and closed the door.
unit.target: Festinanter nautas superstes e conclavi duxit et ianuam clausit.

unit.source: After a few moments, Juan Oro shifted his gaze to Charname, whose features didn’t stand out.
unit.target: Post pauca momenta, Juan Oro oculos vertit ad Charname, cuius lineamenta non eminuerunt.

unit.source: “Are you suggesting that the Iru who perished during the sea prayer ritual was an imposter?”
unit.target: "Num putas Iru, qui per ritum precationis maris periit, impostorem fuisse?"

unit.source: Charname asked with a smirk, “Why do you think the fake Iru is really dead? The others might have been swallowed by the sea, but not him.”
unit.target: Charname subridens quaesivit: "Cur putas falsum Iru vere mortuum esse? Alii fortasse a mari devorati sunt, sed ille non?"

unit.source: Disregarding the miraculous resurrection, nobody present could prove that the fake Iru had indeed fallen into the sea.
unit.target: Resurrectionem miraculosa negellecta, nemo hic potuit probare falsum Iru revera in mare cecidisse.

unit.source: Observing Juan Oro’s silence, Charname pressed on, “The real Iru should have been assassinated by those saboteurs days or even weeks before the sea prayer ritual.”
unit.target: Silentiā Juan Oro observato, Charname pergit: "Verus Iru ab illis sabotoribus, diebus aut etiam hebdomadibus ante ritum precationis maris, interfectus esse debuisse."

unit.source: No, he was more likely to have been kidnapped, killed by a gun a period after the sea prayer ritual completed; after all, the living cannot have their spirit channeled.
unit.target: Non; potius verisimile erat ut post ritum precationis maris, aliquantisper, raptus et telis ictus interfectus esset; nam viventibus spiritus evocable non esse potest.

unit.source: Later, someone disguised themselves as him and lived in Milo Village for a period.
unit.target: Postea, aliquis se in eius effigie indutus, in vico Milo per tempus vixit.

unit.source: Without arousing suspicion, they boarded the Governor of the Sea’s wedding ship as a sailor.
unit.target: Sine suscitando suspicionem, in navem nuptialem Praefecti Maris ut nauta conscenderunt.

unit.source: “Right, is Iru the kind with no living elders, no spouse, no kids, and not residing with siblings?”
unit.target: "Recte, num Iru sit genus quod neque maiores vivos habeat, neque coniugem, neque liberos, neque apud fratres aut sorores degat?"

unit.source: Juan Oro’s eyes narrowed as he spoke, “More or less."
unit.target: Oculi Juan Oro contracti sunt, et inquit: "Fere ita."

unit.source: Their grandmother passed away over a decade ago.
unit.target: Avia eorum abhinc plus quam decem annos mortua est.

unit.source: His parents, Children of the Sea, established a separate family.
unit.target: Parentes eius, Filii Maris, familiam separatam condiderunt.

unit.source: After reaching adulthood, they lost control of their powers, turning into pure sea spawn.
unit.target: Ad adultam aetatem perventos, potestates suas amiserunt et in genuinam progeniem maris conversi sunt.

unit.source: We had to send them back to the sea.
unit.target: Eos ad mare redire oportuit.

unit.source: “As expected, they picked the sailor with the least difficult disguise,” Charname remarked with a sigh.
unit.target: "Ut exspectabatur, nauta cum dissimulatione leviori delectus est," Charname suspirans dixit.

unit.source: Juan Oro frowned and said, “Yet, everyone boarding the ship undergoes a routine inspection by another sea spawn to confirm authenticity.”
unit.target: Juan Oro frontem contraxit et dixit: "Attamen, quisque navem conscendens a alio progenie maris per inspectionem solitam ad veracem identitatem confirmandam subit."

unit.source: Charname chuckled.
unit.target: Charname subridens risit.

unit.source: “As you said, it’s a routine inspection, and in this world, many disguises require specific methods or deeper identification to uncover.”
unit.target: "Ut dixisti, inspectio solita est, et in hoc mundo, multa simulamina modis specificis aut indagatione altiore detegenda sunt."

unit.source: Juan Oro nodded solemnly.
unit.target: Juan Oro graviter annuit.

unit.source: Charname kindly suggested with a hint of flaunting, “Next time, it might be wise to draw blood from everyone boarding the ship and compare it to their closest relatives.
unit.target: Charname beniter, cum levitatione ostendendi, suadet: "Proximo tempore, sapienter erit sanguinem ex omnibus navem conscendentibus extrahere et cum cognatis proximis comparare.

unit.source: It could reveal their true bloodline.”
unit.target: Illud veram eorum sanguinis originem detegere posset."

unit.source: “That’s an idea,” Juan Oro tersely acknowledged.
unit.target: "Id consilium est," Juan Oro breviter agnovit.

unit.source: Over the centuries, the sea prayer ritual had encountered no issues, so they hadn’t considered refining the details.
unit.target: Per saecula, ritus precationis maris nullas difficultates habuerat, ideoque singularia non concocta censuerunt.

unit.source: Juan Oro inquired, “What do those who disrupted the ritual want?”
unit.target: Juan Oro rogavit: "Quid volunt illi qui ritum perturbaverunt?"

unit.source: “We’re not certain either,” Charname shrugged, glancing towards the curtained window that led to the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: "Nec nos certi sumus," Charname umeris iactans, aspiciens versus fenestram velamentis opertam, quae ad domicilium Praefecti Maris ducebat.

unit.source: Juan Oro sensed a hint in Charname’s allusion to something Louis Berry had mentioned earlier.
unit.target: Juan Oro sensum invenit in allusione Charname ad aliquid, quod antea a Ludovico Berry dictum erat.

unit.source: He subtly nodded and added, “When this year’s sea prayer ritual succeeds, we’ll release Miguel and allow him to live in Torres.
unit.target: Subtiliter annuit et addidit: "Cum ritus precationis maris huius anni successerit, Miguel dimittemus et ei licebit in Torres vivere.

unit.source: By then, the failure of last year’s ritual won’t remain a secretive burden.”
unit.target: Tum defectus ritus anni priori non permanebit ut onus arcanum.

unit.source: There’s no need for us to harm Miguel.”
unit.target: Non opus est nobis Miguel laedere."

unit.source: “Miguel?” Charname inquired thoughtfully.
unit.target: "Miguel?" Charname cogitato quaesivit.

unit.source: “He’s the false Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: "Ille falsus Praefectus Maris est.

unit.source: He used to work for the Fisheries Company, and his lineage traces back to Milo Village,” Juan Oro explained succinctly.
unit.target: Olim pro Societate Piscatoria laboravit, et stirps eius ad Vicum Milo redegit," succincte explicavit Juan Oro.

unit.source: Charname diverted his gaze, a faint smile gracing his lips.
unit.target: Charname oculos avertit, et leviter risum in labiis suis exhibens.

unit.source: “He’s had his year of indulgence.
unit.target: "Annum indulgentiae suæ habuit.

unit.source: Fear may linger, but everything comes with a price.”
unit.target: Timor manere potest, sed omnia pretium habent.”

unit.source: The companion of the great adventurer paused, curiosity lighting up his eyes.
unit.target: Socius magni viatoris subsistebat, et curiositas oculos eius illuminabat.

unit.source: “Did your ancestor come from the depths of the sea, or did ordinary fishermen suddenly gain inspiration and enlightenment, mastering the art of pleasing the sea and gaining its favor?” he inquired.
unit.target: "Num maior vester ex abyssis maris ortus sit, an piscatores simplices subito inspirationem ac illuminatiam adepti, artem mari placendi atque eius gratiam obtinuerint?" inquit.

unit.source: Juan Oro took a moment of silence before responding, “We don’t know.
unit.target: Juan Oro paulum silentium tulit antequam respondit: "Nescimus.

unit.source: Both possibilities are equally plausible.
unit.target: Utraque possibilitas aequaliter verisimilis est.

unit.source: Milo Village was once eradicated by the Earth Mother Church.
unit.target: Vicus Milo olim ab Ecclesia Matris Terrae exterminatus est.

unit.source: Many legacies were severed, and we’re left clueless about our ancestors’ origins.
unit.target: Multae hereditates disiectae sunt, et de originibus maiorum nostrorum ignoramus.

unit.source: On a personal note, I lean towards the second theory.
unit.target: Quoad me, secundam theoriam praefero.

unit.source: We’re different from typical sea spawn.
unit.target: Nos a progenie maris ordinaria differtur.

unit.source: The children we bear initially resemble humans.
unit.target: Filii quos procreamus initio hominibus similes sunt.

unit.source: It’s only as they absorb more of the sea’s power that they transform into humanoid lizards.
unit.target: Modo, cum potentiam maris amplius absorberent, in lacertas humanoides se converterent.

unit.source: Additionally, while our strength weakens, theirs does not.”
unit.target: Praeterea, dum nostra robur debilitatur, eorum non fit.

unit.source: Charname nodded in agreement.
unit.target: Charname consensum annuit.

unit.source: “I’m inclined to think the second scenario is more likely too.”
unit.target: "Secundam rem etiam verisimiliorem esse puto."

unit.source: He then asked, “Have all traces of Milo Village’s ancestors truly been erased?
unit.target: Deinde quaesivit: "Num omnia vestigia maiorum Vicī Milo vere exstirpatum sint?

unit.source: Is there no evidence left?”
unit.target: Num nullae probationes remanserunt?"

unit.source: Juan Oro studied Charname for a moment before revealing, “There’s some residual evidence in the underground chamber of the Governor of the Sea’s residence, but it’s just symbols and patterns.
unit.target: Juan Oro aliquantisper Charname inspectus, deinde revelavit: "Aliqua residualia probatione in camera subterranea domicilii Praefecti Maris inveniuntur, sed tantum sunt symbola et figurae.

unit.source: They’re meaningless and indecipherable.
unit.target: Nullum sensum habent atque indecripta sunt.

unit.source: If you want to see them, wait until the vigil ritual.
unit.target: Si ea videre vis, exspecta usque ad ritum vigilii.

unit.source: But aren’t you concerned about the risk of exposing our collaboration by going to the Governor of the Sea’s residence now?”
unit.target: Sed num non solliciti estis de periculo, quod societatem nostram patefacere conemur, nunc ad domicilium Praefecti Maris eundi?

unit.source: “Fair point.”
unit.target: "Recte dicis."

unit.source: After obtaining other details, Charname abruptly receded into the shadows in the corner and vanished.
unit.target: Post alias notitia adeptus, Charname subito in umbras anguli recedens evanuit.

unit.source: Juan Oro watched as the great adventurer’s companion disappeared and released a slow sigh.
unit.target: Juan Oro observavit, dum comes magni viatoris evanuerat et lente suspiravit.

unit.source: He sensed a storm brewing around Port Santa.
unit.target: Sentivit tempestatem circa Portum Santa imminentem.

unit.source: In the master bedroom of the fifth-floor suite at Solow Motel.
unit.target: In cubiculo principali suite quinti tabulati apud Solow Motel.

unit.source: Emerging from the shadows, Charname adorned the silver Lie earring behind his left ear.
unit.target: Emergens ex umbris, Charname ornavit anulum argenteum "Lie" post auriculam sinistram.

unit.source: His eyes swiftly transformed, becoming as clear as a lake, and his flaxen-tinted hair cascaded over his shoulders.
unit.target: Oculi eius celeriter mutati sunt, evincentes ut lacus, et capilli flavis coloribus tincti super humeros decurrebant.

unit.source: Franca, still radiating astonishing charm despite her male attire, tossed the earring back to Lumian.
unit.target: Franca, adhuc admirabilem gratiam efferens, licet vestimenta virilia gereret, anulum ad Lumian reiecit.

unit.source: She retrieved a black rubber band from her pocket and tied her long hair into a high ponytail.
unit.target: Ex sacculo suo fasciam elasticam nigrum extraxit et capillos longos in colem altum alligavit.

unit.source: “I’ve discovered traces of Bard!” the Demoness of Pleasure exclaimed with joy.
unit.target: "Vestigia Bard detexi!" Demonissa Voluptatis cum gaudio exclamat.

unit.source: “Why Bard and not the other two?”
unit.target: "Cur Bard et non reliquorum duorum?"

unit.source: Lumian sat in an armchair in front of the desk, tightly drawn curtains behind him.
unit.target: Lumian in solio ante mensam sedebat, et post eum stringebant cortinae.

unit.source: Deliberately returning to Trier and bringing Franca to Port Santa for her assistance, Lumian believed himself inferior to the Demoness of Pleasure in divination and spirit channeling.
unit.target: Causim ad Trier rediens et Francam ad Portum Santa pro auxilio adducens, Lumian se inferiori Demonissae Voluptatis in divinatione et spiritus evocando esse putavit.

unit.source: Rather than wasting the truth serum, he sought Franca’s direct help.
unit.target: Quamquam serum veritatis non consumpsit, auxilium directum Francae petivit.

unit.source: Additionally, he wanted Franca to assume the guise of his other identity, completely separating “him” from the adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Atque insuper, voluit Francam induere personam alterae identitatis suae, eum a viatore Ludovico Berry omnino segregans.

unit.source: This would enable him to deceive those secretly monitoring him and potentially execute future deceptions.
unit.target: Hoc ei licebit eos, qui eum occulte speculabantur, decipere et fortasse futuras fallacias efficere.

unit.source: Franca shared her findings from the spirit channeling today and the completed conversation.
unit.target: Franca communicavit inventa sua ex hodierno spiritus evocando et sermonem completum.

unit.source: “The fake Iru must first possess powers akin to a Faceless’s, followed by adept thieving skills.
unit.target: "Falsus Iru primum potestas similes Faceless habere debet, deinde peritiam furtandi subsequens.

unit.source: Long ago, I Know Someone mentioned that Bard is a Sequence 6 Prometheus of the Marauder pathway.
unit.target: Iamdudum, quidam notus dixit Bard esse Sequenciam VI Promethei ex via Maraudantium.

unit.source: It’s highly likely he’s even stronger now.
unit.target: Valde verisimile est eum nunc etiam fortiorem esse.

unit.source: If others hadn’t confirmed that Loki wasn’t involved in last year’s sea prayer ritual prank, at least not openly, he would have been the most suitable to impersonate Iru.
unit.target: Si alii non confirmassent quod Loki in iocum ritus precationis maris anni praeteriti, saltem non palam, ille aptissimus fuisset ad Iru impersonandum.

unit.source: Now, the probability of Iru being Bard is higher.
unit.target: Nunc, verisimilitudo ut Iru sit Bard augescit.

unit.source: As a Mid-Sequence Marauder Beyonder, perhaps he possesses an item similar to Lie.
unit.target: Ut mediocris ordinis Maraudantium Beyonder, fortasse rem similem "Lie" possidet.

unit.source: Maybe he prayed to that Celestial Worthy, undergoing a change in physique and appearance.
unit.target: Fortasse illi ad Illum Caelestem Dignum oravit, mutationem in forma corporali et specie subiens.

unit.source: Additionally, he could be imbued with mystical anti-divination and anti-prophecy traits.
unit.target: Praeterea, possit imbui proprietatibus mysticis, oppositis divinationi et prophetiae.

unit.source: Marauder is one of the three pathways most easily influenced by Celestial Worthy.”
unit.target: Maraudarius est unus ex tribus viis, quibus Illum Caelestem Dignum facile influere potest.”

unit.source: Lumian listened quietly, and a smile gradually formed on his face.
unit.target: Lumian tranquille audivit, et risus paulatim in facie eius oratus est.

unit.source: “Bard’s role and purpose in last year’s ritual are essentially clear.
unit.target: "Munus et propositum Bard in rito anni praeteriti fere clarum sunt.

unit.source: He disguised himself as a sailor, boarded the ship, stole the genuine ceremonial ring, and replaced it with a fake one.
unit.target: Se tamquam nauta simulans, navem conscendit, verum annulum caerimonialis furatus est, et illud falso substituit.

unit.source: Then, he willingly leaped into the sea, feigning his death to make his escape!”
unit.target: Deinde, libenter in mare saltavit, mortem simulans, ad effugium suum fugiendum!”

unit.source: Lumian paused briefly before continuing, “The question now is, what roles did Mad Lady and Ultraman play in this matter?
unit.target: Lumian breviter cessavit antequam pergeret dicens: "Nunc quaestio est: quaecumque munera Mad Lady et Ultraman in hac re gesserunt?

unit.source: So far, their presence doesn’t seem to affect the final failure of the sea prayer ritual.”
unit.target: Adhuc, eorum praesentia videtur non influere in defectum finalem ritus precationis maris.

unit.source: Franca pursed her lips and paced back and forth.
unit.target: Franca labra contraxit et iter faciens circum ambulavit.

unit.source: “Mad Lady might handle receiving and communication.
unit.target: "Mad Lady fortasse res accipiendas et communicandas administrare potest.

unit.source: For instance, after Bard jumped into the sea, she could ‘teleport’ over and whisk him away to prevent him from being consumed by the tumultuous sea.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, postquam Bard in mare saltavit, illa eum "teleportare" potuit et abripere, ne ab intimo mari tumultuoso devoraretur.

unit.source: Only a Traveler possesses such an ability.
unit.target: Solum Viator talem facultatem habet.

unit.source: Ultraman is likely responsible for providing information about the sea prayer ritual and devising the corresponding plan.
unit.target: Ultraman verisimiliter responsalis est pro informatione de rito precationis maris praebenda et consilium congruens excogitandum.

unit.source: But that can’t be all.
unit.target: Sed id non omnia esse potest.

unit.source: He probably has other roles…”
unit.target: Forte alia etiam munera habet…

unit.source: Lumian leaned back in his chair, stroking his chin thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit, mentum diligenter perlustans.

unit.source: “I concur with your hypothesis about Mad Lady, but according to the information we have, entering those special waters requires guidance from the Children of the Sea, following a specific route.
unit.target: "Hypothesim tuam de Mad Lady assentior, sed secundum notitiam nostram, ad ingressum illarum aquarum specialium ducatio a Filiis Maris necessaria est, sequendo iter determinatum.

unit.source: How did Mad Lady ‘teleport’ inside?
unit.target: Quomodo Mad Lady intus se "teleportavit"?

unit.source: Was she lurking on the ship?
unit.target: Num in nave insidiabat?

unit.source: Or does Bard carry some special coordinates with him?
unit.target: An Bard quaedam signa specialia secum fert?

unit.source: It’s certainly not a physical item; otherwise, it would have been discovered.
unit.target: Certe, non res physica est; alioquin deprehensa fuisset.

unit.source: As for Ultraman, I’ve always suspected he’s a native of Port Santa with a profound understanding of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Quoad Ultraman, semper suspicatus sum eum indigena Portus Santae esse, et ritum precationis maris penitus intellegere.

unit.source: He likely orchestrated the prank last year.”
unit.target: Forte iocum anni praeteriti condidit.”

unit.source: At this point, Lumian stood up.
unit.target: Ad hunc punctum, Lumian surrexit.

unit.source: “My intuition suggests that if we can uncover Ultraman’s actions in last year’s prank and identify his role beyond being the mastermind, we can discern April Fool’s true motives in this matter!”
unit.target: "Intuitio mea suadet, si actus Ultraman in ioco anni praeteriti detegere possimus et eius munus ultra moderatoris agnoscamus, veros Aprilis Folli propositos in hac re discerere poterimus!"

unit.source: 565 Possible Breakthrough
unit.target: 565 Possibile Inventionem

unit.source: 565 Possible Breakthrough
unit.target: 565 Possibile Inventionem

unit.source: Franca’s emotions were stirred by Lumian’s words, and she responded with anticipation, “Then it’s akin to catching a fox by its tail.
unit.target: Motus Francae ex verbis Luminiani excitatus est, et cum exspectatione respondit: “Tum simile est vulpem cauda sua capere.

unit.source: When the time comes, we’ll summon good helpers and strive to eliminate a few more key members of April Fool’s!
unit.target: Quando tempus venerit, auxilia bona convocabimus et conabimur aliquos clavos partis Aprilis Stulti tollere!

unit.source: As she spoke, she gritted her teeth.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, dentes strinxit.

unit.source: Despite Lumian and Franca making various guesses and deductions about Ultraman’s role in last year’s prank, none of them felt they had grasped the key to the mystery.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumianus et Franca varias coniecturas atque deductiones de parte Ultramanis in ioco anni praeteriti fecerunt, nemo sentit se arcanum verum comprehendisse.

unit.source: Franca exhaled and said, “Phew, there are still some important puzzle pieces missing.
unit.target: Franca suspiravit et dixit: “Hei, adhuc quaedam momenta puzzle magni momenti deficiunt.

unit.source: See if you can fish out more details.”
unit.target: Vide utrum plura indicia deprehendere possis.

unit.source: She needed to return to Trier.
unit.target: Eam ad Trier redire oportuit.

unit.source: Lumian tersely acknowledged her words and asked thoughtfully, “How’s your search for the Tamara family’s descendant going?”
unit.target: Lumian verbis eius breviter assensit et quaesivit, “Quomodo procedit investigatio tui descendentis familiae Tamarae?”

unit.source: “Nothing yet, but Madam Judgment intends to inform the other Major Arcana card holders about this.
unit.target: “Nihil adhuc, sed Domina Iudicium reliquos possessoros cartarum Maior Arcana certiorem facere intendit.

unit.source: She hopes they can help keep an eye out,” Franca briefly explained her situation.
unit.target: Sperat etiam eos vigilem fore,” Franca brevi ratione condicionem suam exposuit.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at her face and said, “I have an investigative direction.”
unit.target: Lumian vultum eius intuens dixit: “Rerum inquisitioni viam habeo.”

unit.source: “What?” Franca perked up.
unit.target: “Quid?” Franca subito excitata exclamat.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curled up.
unit.target: Labra Luminiani convoluta erant.

unit.source: “Investigate the other members of the Demoness Sect in Trier.
unit.target: “Investiga reliquos Sectae Daemonissae membros in Trier.

unit.source: Given the close ties between certain members of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect, they might even be collaborating to establish the secret organization, Theosophy Order.
unit.target: Propter nexūs arctos inter nonnullos ex familia Tamara et Sectae Daemonissae, fortasse etiam cooperantur ut condatur societas secreta, Ordo Theosophiae.

unit.source: There’s a chance that one of them could directly join the Demoness Sect.
unit.target: Exsistit casus, ut unus eorum directe Sectae Daemonissae se iungat.

unit.source: Moreover, considering Madam Judgment’s mission for you to infiltrate the Demoness Sect, discern the Primordial Demoness’s current state and issues, why not investigate other Demonesses?
unit.target: Praeterea, habita missione Dominae Iudicii ut in Sectae Daemonissae insinuaris et statum atque quaestiones Daemonissae Primordialis perscrutaris, cur alias Daemonissas non investiges?

unit.source: Are you going to wait until you reach the level of a powerhouse like a Demoness of Red before gathering information?
unit.target: Exspectabisne, donec attingas statum potentiae, sicut Daemonissa Rubra, antequam informationes colligas?

unit.source: Do you believe there will be enough Angel-level Hunter Beyonder characteristics to aid your return to your original gender at that point?
unit.target: Credisne fore ut satis habebis notis angelicis Hunter Beyonder, quae ad auxilium reditus ad generis originem tuam conferant?

unit.source: “Why the Demoness of Red?” Franca instinctively focused on this question.
unit.target: “Cur Daemonissa Rubra?” Franca instinctu quaestioni huic intendit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens est.

unit.source: “Have you forgotten your nickname, Madame Red Boots?”
unit.target: “Oblitus esne sobri nomine tuo, Domina Ruber Calceorum?”

unit.source: Franca smiled awkwardly.
unit.target: Franca, quidem moeva, risum oblata est.

unit.source: “Isn’t that to create a persona with characteristics that can be easily changed when you’re on the run?
unit.target: “Nonne id ad creandum identitatem pertinet, quarum notae facile mutari possunt cum in fugā sis?

unit.source: It’s clearly different from the description on the wanted poster.
unit.target: Manifestum est hanc rem ab descriptione in tabula quaesitionis esse diversa.

unit.source: Ahem, isn’t it too dangerous to investigate other Demonesses under the watchful eyes of the Demoness of Black?”
unit.target: Ehem, nonne nimis periculosum est alias Daemonissas sub oculis vigilantibus Daemonissae Nigrae explorare?”

unit.source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and smiled meaningfully.
unit.target: Lumian supercilia attollens et risu significante subridens respondit.

unit.source: “Why are you investigating the Tamara family?”
unit.target: “Cur familias Tamarae investigas?”

unit.source: “Investigating Mirror People,” Franca replied subconsciously.
unit.target: “Homines Specularum investigo,” Franca subconscie respondit.

unit.source: Lumian asked again, “And who assigned you the Mirror People investigation?”
unit.target: Lumian iterum quaesivit: “Et quis tibi mandavit ut Homines Specularum investigares?”

unit.source: “The Demoness of Black…”
unit.target: “Daemonissa Nigra…”

unit.source: Franca immediately shut her mouth.
unit.target: Franca statim os clauserunt.

unit.source: She then muttered to herself, “However, an intricate balance needs to be struck.
unit.target: Deinde sibi murmuravit: “Attamen, subtilis aequilibrium statuendum est.

unit.source: The source of the intel must be fabricated nicely; otherwise, we’ll still be suspected.”
unit.target: Fons notitiarum pulchre fingendus est; aliter denuo suspecti erimus.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t say anything else.
unit.target: Lumian nihil amplius dixit.

unit.source: He grabbed Franca’s shoulder and planned to send her back to Trier.
unit.target: Ea Francae umerum arripuit et consilium cepit eam ad Trier remittere.

unit.source: Franca glanced at the curtained window and eagerly said, “Remember to ask me for help when you visit the combat nuns in the future.”
unit.target: Franca fenestram cortinata intuita, ardenter dixit: “Memento me rogere auxilium, cum futuras moniales pugnantis visitas.”

unit.source: She arrived in Port Santa in the afternoon and spent a long time using the fake name—Charname—she chose herself, and the face on Lumian’s fake ID to travel about.
unit.target: Postmeridie in Port Santa advenit atque diu sub nomine ficticio—Charname—quo ipsa delectata est, una cum imagine in ID ficta Luminiani, pererravit.

unit.source: With her fluent Highlander, she quickly grasped the folklore and combat nuns’ styles.
unit.target: Linguā Highlander fluente, celeriter fabulas populares et modos monialium pugnatorum percogit.

unit.source: Lumian scoffed dismissively.
unit.target: Lumian irrise despiciens exclamavit.

unit.source: “Don’t even think about it. You can’t impregnate them.”
unit.target: “Ne quidem cogita; has concipere non potes.”

unit.source: Franca replied indignantly, “Theoretically, it’s not impossible, but it’s quite dangerous.
unit.target: Franca indignanter respondit: “Theoretice, non est impossibile, sed certe periculosum est.

unit.source: Think about it, Madame Pualis.”
unit.target: Cogita de hoc, Domina Pualis.”

unit.source: Lumian was left speechless.
unit.target: Lumian sine verbis relicto est.

unit.source: “Besides, giving birth isn’t the only important thing in life…”
unit.target: “Praeterea, partus non solum res magni momenti in vita est…”

unit.source: Franca continued to search for an excuse.
unit.target: Franca ulterius excusationem quaerere continebat.

unit.source: Lumian exhaled silently and activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Lumian tacite suspiravit et signum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

unit.source: He disappeared from the master bedroom with Franca, who was still talking.
unit.target: Ex conclavi principali cum Franca, quae adhuc loquebatur, evanuit.

unit.source: In no time, Lumian reappeared at the exact spot he had left.
unit.target: Mox in eodem loco, unde abiit, Lumian apparuit.

unit.source: Shaking his head and teasing Franca, he eased back into the armchair.
unit.target: Capite concussus et Francam ludens, in sella relaxavit.

unit.source: It had to be acknowledged that bantering and joking with friends, free from the need for caution, proved helpful in relieving the pent-up emotions within him.
unit.target: Agnoscendum est iocos ac ludos cum amicis, sine sollicitudine, adiuvare ad levandas animorum cogitationes repressas.

unit.source: Having regained his composure, Lumian reclined in his chair, sorting through the information on the sea prayer ritual and various rhetoric in his mind.
unit.target: Compositum repetens, Lumian in sella recubuit, percurrens notitias de ritu precationis maris et varias rhetoricas in mente sua.

unit.source: He sought details that might unveil traces of Ultraman’s existence and confirm any overlooked issues.
unit.target: Quaerebat indicia quae vestigia Ultramanis existentiae detegere et quaestiones neglectas confirmare possent.

unit.source: As a Conspirer, Lumian didn’t require jotting down key points on paper.
unit.target: Ut Coniurator, Lumian puncta clavis in charta scribere non necesse habebat.

unit.source: He relied on his eyes to decipher the hints.
unit.target: Oculis confidebat ut subtilia enodaret.

unit.source: All the information formed a colossal spiderweb in his mind, slowly weaving and transforming.
unit.target: Omnis informatio ingentem telam araneam in mente eius texit, lente intertexens et transformans.

unit.source: After a while, he abruptly sat upright.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus repente rectus consedit.

unit.source: A breakthrough had been unearthed that could expose the essence of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Inventum erat breakthrough, quod essentiam ritu precationis maris revelare posset.

unit.source: Lumian stood and exited the master bedroom.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et ex conclavi principali egreditur.

unit.source: He spotted Ludwig devouring a crispy potato omelet at the dining table in the living room.
unit.target: Ludwigum conspexit, qui omeletam patatae crispam in mensa conviviali deglutiebat.

unit.source: Seated across from the boy, Lumian smiled as he retrieved the mutated black spider’s compound eye, a spiritual ingredient lacking Beyonder characteristics.
unit.target: Ad oppositum puero sedens, Lumian subridet, dum accipiebat oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato, ingredientem spiritualem carentem notis Beyonder.

unit.source: Ludwig immediately glanced up at Lumian.
unit.target: Ludwig statim ad Lumianum respexit.

unit.source: “Can you eat this?” Lumian flicked the black compound eye.
unit.target: “Potesne hoc edere?” Lumian oculum compositum nigrum distulit.

unit.source: Ludwig vigorously nodded.
unit.target: Ludwig vehementer annuit.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: Intrigued, Lumian took out the Mystery Prying Glasses and inquired, “Can you eat this?”
unit.target: Curiosus, Lumian Specula Mysterii exprompsit et quaesivit: “Potesne hoc edere?”

unit.source: “Not yet,” Ludwig honestly replied.
unit.target: “Nondum,” Ludwig sincero respondit.

unit.source: Not yet.
unit.target: Nondum.

unit.source: In other words, perhaps in the future?
unit.target: Aliter, fortasse in futurum?

unit.source: Lumian stowed away the Mystery Prying Glasses and placed the mutated black spider’s compound eye on the dining table before him.
unit.target: Lumian Specula Mysterii recondidit et oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato in mensa conviviali ante se posuit.

unit.source: “I’d like you to translate something.
unit.target: “Velim ut aliquid transferas.

unit.source: If you can provide the correct answer, it’s yours for consumption.”
unit.target: Si rectam responsionem praebere potes, tibi ad edendum tradetur.”

unit.source: Ludwig gulped and agreed, “Okay.”
unit.target: Ludwig voraciter edax annuit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Lumian recalled Lato Guiaro’s strange pronunciation and emitted a chattering sound.
unit.target: Lumian insolita pronuntiatiōnem Lato Guiaro meminit et sonum striduli edidit.

unit.source: Finally, he said, “That’s the general idea.”
unit.target: Denique dixit: “Id est sensus generalis.”

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head in disappointment.
unit.target: Ludwig caput demisit in maerore.

unit.source: “I don’t know.”
unit.target: “Nescio.”

unit.source: He paused briefly before adding, “But I think I’ve heard it somewhere.
unit.target: Brevi intervallo cessavit antequam addidit: “Sed puto me id alicubi audivisse.

unit.source: It’s somewhat familiar.”
unit.target: Aliquantopere nota est.”

unit.source: Had most of his memories and knowledge been sealed when his Body of Heart and Mind was sealed?
unit.target: Num pleraque memoriae eius atque scientia sigillata fuerunt, cum Corpus Cordis ac Mentis eius obstrictum est?

unit.source: Under Ludwig’s reluctant gaze, Lumian returned the mutated black spider’s compound eye to his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Sub oculis reticentibus Ludovici, Lumian oculum compositum ex aranea nigra mutato in sacculus viatoris reddidit.

unit.source: Ludwig shoved a mouthful of potato omelet into his mouth and mumbled, “If you can find a creature that understands this language for me to eat, I can translate for you.”
unit.target: Ludwig osculum omeletam patatae in os suum impulerat et murmure dixit: “Si invenire potes creaturam quae hanc linguam intellegat, ut eam mihi edendum offeram, ego pro te transferam.”

unit.source: Wh… Lumian asked in surprise, “Can you acquire a certain ability or knowledge by consuming something?”
unit.target: “Heu…”, Lumian obstupefactus quaesivit: “Licetne tibi aliquam facultatem aut scientiam per aliquid consumendum adipisci?”

unit.source: “There’s a time limit, and it depends on the specific situation,” Ludwig succinctly explained without elaborating.
unit.target: “Tempus limitatum est, et ex singulari condicione dependet,” Ludwig breviter explicavit sine ampliori expositione.

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian cogitabunde annuit.

unit.source: “Were you able to reveal information about the Batings Black Insect because you had consumed that kind of insect shortly before?”
unit.target: “Fuitne tibi revelare notitias de Insecto Nigro Batings quia illud insectum nuper consumpsisti?”

unit.source: Ludwig nodded.
unit.target: Ludwig annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, it wanted to ambush me.
unit.target: “Ita, me insidiari volebat.

unit.source: It had been waiting for a long time.”
unit.target: Diuturno tempore exspectaverat.”

unit.source: That explains it.
unit.target: Hoc explicat.

unit.source: I had thought you had recovered some of your memories and knowledge.
unit.target: Putabam te aliquas memorias atque scientiam revisam esse.

unit.source: Indeed, a paralyzing attack wouldn’t only target Lugano.
unit.target: Revera, impetus paralyticus non solum Lugano petiverit.

unit.source: After all, this could turn into a trap at any moment…
unit.target: Postremo, hoc omni momento in insidias verti potest…

unit.source: Lumian stood up and left the dining table, returning to the master bedroom under Ludwig’s pitiful gaze.
unit.target: Lumian surgens a mensa conviviali discessit, ad conclavi principali revertens sub oculis Ludovici miserandis.

unit.source: He had no means to find Ludwig a creature that understood the Language of the Sea.
unit.target: Non habebat viam ut Ludwig inveniret creaturam quae Linguam Maris intellegat.

unit.source: The Fisheries Guild members couldn’t be certain if their interpretation was accurate.
unit.target: Membra Guildae Piscariorum certi esse non poterant utrum interpretatio eorum recta esset.

unit.source: After entering the master bedroom and closing the door, Lumian lowered his voice and said, “Temiboros, do you understand that language?
unit.target: Postquam in conclavi principali ingressus et ostium clausit, Lumian vocem demisit et dixit: “Temiboros, hanc linguam intellegis?

unit.source: Do you know the true meaning of that sentence?”
unit.target: Scisne verum sensum illius sententiae?”

unit.source: Termiboros’s majestic voice echoed in Lumian’s ears.
unit.target: Vocis Termibori magnificae in aure Luminiani resonaverunt.

unit.source: “In any case, it doesn’t mean ‘We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion.’”
unit.target: “Quocumque modo, hoc non significat: ‘Te amplectimur, o mare, ut signum veri et perpetui imperii.’”

unit.source: With that, Termiboros fell silent again, showing no intention of explaining the true meaning to Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Termiboros iterum tacuit, nulam intentionem ostendens verum sensum Luminiano explanandi.

unit.source: Dammit, might as well not answer!
unit.target: Male, potius ne respondeas!

unit.source: You confirmed my guess but didn’t unveil the true content!
unit.target: Coniecturam meam confirmavisti, sed verum contentum non develavisti!

unit.source: Heh heh, could it be that you’re just pretending to understand?
unit.target: Heh heh, num simulas te intellegere?

unit.source: Lumian cursed inwardly, feeling that Termiboros, the Angel of Inevitability, was becoming less direct and straightforward than before.
unit.target: Lumian intus maledixit, sentiens Termiboros, Angelus Inevitabilitatis, minus directe atque perspicue fieri quam olim.

unit.source: He didn’t comprehend the art of sophistry.
unit.target: Artem sophisticam non intellexit.

unit.source: Gradually, He learned how to infuriate!
unit.target: Paulatim didicit quomodo ad irascendum pervenire!

unit.source: Lumian composed himself and settled back into the armchair.
unit.target: Lumian se composuit et in sellam iterum recubuit.

unit.source: Unfolding the letter, he began writing to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Epistulam explicans, scribere incepit ad Dominam Magicam.

unit.source: Detailing his travels, he recounted what he had observed in Port Santa.
unit.target: Iter suum enarrantem, narrare coepit quae in Port Santa observaverat.

unit.source: Finally, he pieced together the pronunciation and wrote down the words to the unknown language.
unit.target: Denique pronuntiatiōnem componens verba linguae ignotae conscripsit.

unit.source: He gave the interpretation of what the Fisheries Guild believed: “We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion.”
unit.target: Interpretationem dabat eorum, quas Gilda Piscariorum credebat: “Te amplectimur, o mare, ut signum veri et perpetui imperii.”

unit.source: Then, he made a request: “Madam, have you encountered this language before?
unit.target: Tum rogavit: “Domina, antehac hanc linguam invenistine?

unit.source: Do you know its true meaning?”
unit.target: Novistine verum eius sensum?”

unit.source: After folding the letter, Lumian initiated a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Epistulam condensata, Lumian ritum inivit et “pupulam” nuntium convocavit.

unit.source: The “doll” messenger, adorned in a light-gold dress, emerged from the candle’s flame and surveyed its surroundings.
unit.target: Nuntius “pupula”, ornatus tunica aurea leviter fulgente, ex flamma candelae emersit et circumiectorum inspiciens.

unit.source: In a menacing tone, it declared, “Don’t let that filthy child near me!”
unit.target: Tono minatorio declaravit: “Noli illud spurcum puerum mihi appropinquare!”

unit.source: “He’s dining outside.
unit.target: “Foris cenat.

unit.source: He won’t enter without my permission.”
unit.target: Non intrabit nisi consensu meo.”

unit.source: For some reason, Lumian sensed hidden fear in the “doll” messenger’s aggressive words.
unit.target: Quacumque ratione, Lumian metu occulto in verbis aggressivis nuntii “pupulae” sensit.

unit.source: The messenger nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Nuntius ex laetitia annuit.

unit.source: “Keep an eye on it! If it acts up, don’t feed it!”
unit.target: “Observa illud! Si male agit, noli alere!”

unit.source: Using it as a substitute name… Lumian smiled and said, “If I don’t feed him, something even more terrifying might happen.”
unit.target: Hoc ut nomen substitutum utens… Lumian subridens dixit: “Si non alam ei, aliquid etiam terribile accidere potest.”

unit.source: The messenger fell silent for a moment before saying, “Then feed it more!”
unit.target: Nuntius paulisper tacuit antequam dixit: “Tum amplius alere!”

unit.source: With that, the doll-like messenger swiftly withdrew the folded letter into the candle flame.
unit.target: Hoc facto, nuntius similis pupula celeriter epistulam condensatam in flammam candelae retraxit.

unit.source: Lumian concluded the ritual, extinguished the candle’s flame, and gazed at the master bedroom’s door.
unit.target: Lumian ritum confecit, flammam candelae exstinxit, atque ostium conclavi principali contemplatus est.

unit.source: He muttered to himself, “It’s indeed a dangerous sealed creature…”
unit.target: Sibi susurravit: “Vere est creatura clausa periculosa…”

unit.source: He then retrieved the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brise and opened it to take a look.
unit.target: Deinde horologium aureum e Salle de Bal Brise rapuit et aperuit ut intueretur.

unit.source: Suddenly, he transformed into a shadow, seamlessly blending into the darkness.
unit.target: Subito in umbram se convertere coepit, in tenebris perfecte miscendo.

unit.source: There was still something to attend to tonight.
unit.target: Hodie adhuc aliquid est quod curandum sit.

unit.source: In the port district, atop the Fisheries Guild’s castle-like building, Lumian found Lato Guiaro waiting on the spot resembling a tower, dressed in a formal suit.
unit.target: In regione portuaria, super aedificium simile castelli Guildae Piscariorum, Lumian invenit Lato Guiaro in loco, qui turri similis exspectabat, habitu formali indutus.

unit.source: “Are you on duty tonight?” Lumian casually pressed down on his golden straw hat, as if engaging in casual conversation with a friend.
unit.target: “Esne in officio hac nocte?” Lumian, fortuito pileum foliosum aureum deprimens, quasi amico colloquium levem habens, inquit.

unit.source: Lato, the middle-aged man, sighed and said, “Originally, no, but since you wanted to come over, that’s the case.
unit.target: Lato, vir mediātus aetatis, suspiravit et respondit: “Initio non, sed quoniam advenire voluisti, ita evenit.

unit.source: We can’t let an old man like the president do it, right?”
unit.target: Senem ut praesidem id peragere non sinere possumus, nonne?

unit.source: Without further ado, Lumian conjured delayed crimson, nearly white fireballs and hurled them into various corners of the tower.
unit.target: Nullo mora, Lumian globos ignis cremoreos paene albos, moram tenuem evocavit, et in variis angulis turris iactavit.

unit.source: Having completed this task, he waved at Lato Guiaro and melted back into the shadows.
unit.target: Hoc negotium perfecerit, Lato Guiaro salutavit et in umbras defluit.

unit.source: Lato approached the tower’s entrance, clenching his fists in fear.
unit.target: Lato ad introitum turris accessit, manus in metu contrahens.

unit.source: In just 30 seconds, the crimson, nearly white fireballs exploded simultaneously.
unit.target: In tantis triginta secundis, globi ignis cremorei paene albi simul erupti sunt.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: The entire tower became engulfed in flames, and Lato, stationed at the entrance, was sent flying by the shockwave.
unit.target: Turris tota flammas voravit, et Lato, ad introitum stans, impetu undae in aethera proiectus est.

unit.source: Bright scales had already surfaced on his body to mitigate the damage.
unit.target: Splendida squama iam in corpore eius apparuerunt ut damna levarem.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: In less than half an hour, everyone in Port Santa who was well-informed learned something: the Fisheries Guild had been bombed!
unit.target: Minus dimidius horae, omnes in Port Santa bene noti didicerunt: Gilda Piscariorum bombata fuit!

unit.source: 566 Gathered Clues
unit.target: 566 Indicia Congregata

unit.source: 566 Gathered Clues
unit.target: 566 Indicia Congregata

unit.source: Solow Motel.
unit.target: Deversorium Solow.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the red flames in the port district, tuning in to the distant commotion, anticipating potential visitors.
unit.target: Lumian flammis rubris in regione portuaria intueri coepit, strepitum remotum auscultans et futuros hospites exspectans.

unit.source: Before long, a knock echoed on the door.
unit.target: Mox pulsus in ostio resonavit.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t wait for Lugano to wake up.
unit.target: Lumian Lugano evigilandi non exspectavit.

unit.source: He pivoted and strode to the door.
unit.target: Se vertit et ad ostium properavit.

unit.source: The moment he swung it open, Noelia, clad in brown leather armor and a wimple, stood before him.
unit.target: Mox, cum ostium aperuerit, Noelia, quae lorica coriacea fusca et pallio induta erat, coram eo stetit.

unit.source: Noelia’s expression was as cold as ice.
unit.target: Vultus Noeliae tam frigidus quam glacies erat.

unit.source: She abruptly raised her hand and uttered ancient Hermes words, “Imprison!”
unit.target: Subito manum levavit et antiqua verba Hermetica edixit: "Include!"

unit.source: Lumian found himself instantly immobilized.
unit.target: Lumian se statim immobilis invenit.

unit.source: Transparent walls or a viscous liquid seemed to encase him, turning him into an insect trapped in amber.
unit.target: Muri transparentes vel liquidum viscosum, quasi eum circumdantes, videbantur, eum in insectum in succino inclusum convertentes.

unit.source: In the next second, Noelia unsheathed a straight sword from her back.
unit.target: In secundo proximo, Noelia gladium rectum de tergo suo extulit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s pants tightened, as if he had grown taller and more robust.
unit.target: Simul, bracae Luminiani contraxerunt, quasi altior et robustior fuisset.

unit.source: An explosive force emanated from his body.
unit.target: Vis explosiva ex corpore eius emanabat.

unit.source: The transparent “amber” restraining him creaked, revealing invisible cracks.
unit.target: Succinum transparentem, quod eum retinebat, striduit, fissuras invisibiles revelans.

unit.source: With a whoosh, Noelia clutched the hilt of her straight sword with both hands, slicing through the air, carving through the already shaky “prison,” aiming for Lumian’s head.
unit.target: Cum fremitu, Noelia manubrium gladii recti utrisque manibus arripuit, per aethera secans et per carceram iam vacillam incidens, ad caput Luminiani tendens.

unit.source: Lumian’s right fist, ready to strike, collided with the side of the straight sword, a condensed crimson, almost white flame accompanying the impact.
unit.target: Pugna dextra Luminiani, ad ictum parata, ad latus gladii recti incidit, flamma rubra concentrata, paene alba, ictum comitante.

unit.source: Amidst a deep and controlled explosion, the straight sword slanted, grazing the door frame as it descended to the ground.
unit.target: Inter profundam et moderatam explosionem, gladium rectum inclinavit, limen ostii leviter tangens, dum in terram descendebat.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the situation, Noelia retreated, sheathed her sword, and inquired in Intisian, “Were you the one who blew up the Fisheries Guild?”
unit.target: Ex opportunitate usus, Noelia recessit, gladium reponens, et in lingua Intisiana interrogavit: "An tu fuisti qui Collegium Piscatorum explosisti?"

unit.source: Upon witnessing this, Lumian refrained from retaliation.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian ultionem abstinuit.

unit.source: His body returned to its normal state as he smiled and replied, “It doesn’t matter if I blew it up. What matters is whether anyone can prove it.”
unit.target: Corpus eius ad statum suum normalem rediit dum arridebat et respondit: "Non refert, si id explosi sim; refert, an quis id probare possit."

unit.source: He understood that Noelia had issued a warning and wasn’t truly targeting him.
unit.target: Intelligit Noeliam monitionem edidisse ac eum non vere propositum esse.

unit.source: Otherwise, she would have employed other Beyonder powers after the “Imprison” instead of slashing with her sword.
unit.target: Alioquin alias potentias Beyonder post "Include" adhibuisset, quam gladium secare.

unit.source: Noelia, upholding the dignity of maintaining order in Port Santa throughout the year, used a questioning tone typical for various suspects.
unit.target: Noelia, dignitatem ordinis in Port Santa per totum annum conservans, tono quaesitivo, qui a variis suspectis notus est, usus est.

unit.source: “Why did you go to such lengths? Why did you cause such a commotion?”
unit.target: "Cur adeo conatus es? Cur talem tumultum excitavisti?"

unit.source: Lumian turned his head, signaling Lugano, who had awakened at the commotion, to return to sleep in the servant’s room.
unit.target: Lumian caput vertit, Luganoque, qui ex tumultu evigilaverat, indicans, ut in cubiculo servorum ad somnum rediret.

unit.source: Walking toward the recliner in the living room, he ignored Noelia’s question and smiled.
unit.target: Ad lectum in triclinio ambulans, quaestionem Noeliae neglexit et arridebat.

unit.source: “I’ve discovered something.”
unit.target: "Aliquid reperi."

unit.source: “Like what?”
unit.target: "Quid?"

unit.source: Noelia entered the suite and closed the wooden door behind her.
unit.target: Noelia in conclave intravit et ianuam ligneam post se clausit.

unit.source: Lumian motioned toward the divan.
unit.target: Lumian ad divanum indicavit.

unit.source: “Let’s have a seat and talk.
unit.target: "Sedeamus et colloquamur.

unit.source: “I wouldn’t want you accusing me of being impolite.”
unit.target: "Nolo ut me inurbanum suspicias."

unit.source: Noelia glanced at Lumian and grinned.
unit.target: Noelia ad Luminianum respexit et subridens animadvertit.

unit.source: “What kind of politeness is there without greeting me by pressing your cheek against mine?”
unit.target: "Quale est urbanitas, nisi me salutaveris genam tuam ad meam apposendo?"

unit.source: Her demeanor was direct.
unit.target: Habitus eius directus erat.

unit.source: Lumian eased into the recliner and responded to the question, “For instance, last year’s sea prayer ritual failed.”
unit.target: Lumian in lectum reclinabilem se accommodavit et quaestioni respondit: "Exempli gratia, ritus orationis maris anni superioris defecit."

unit.source: Noelia didn’t display surprise.
unit.target: Noelia stuporem non demonstravit.

unit.source: She sat on the edge of the divan, leaning forward slightly to avoid the straight sword on her back from jabbing her.
unit.target: In margine divani sedit, leviter inclinata, ne gladium rectum in tergo suo eam percuteret.

unit.source: “What else?”
unit.target: "Quid aliud?"

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and casually remarked, “Also, the sea prayer ritual is a marriage to the sea.
unit.target: Lumian paulo meditatus fuit et leviter asseruit: "Praeterea, ritus orationis maris matrimonium cum mari est."

unit.source: “Furthermore, the Governor of the Sea is the husband of the sea, and the Maidens of the Sea embody the sea in the real world.
unit.target: "Praeterea, praefectus maris est sponsus maris, et virgines maris in mundo reali mare incarnant."

unit.source: “Whether it’s the Governor of the Sea or the Maidens of the Sea, the offspring they bear are the Children of the Sea.
unit.target: "Sive praefectus maris sive virgines maris, proles quae oriuntur sunt filii maris."

unit.source: “The first one possesses the purest bloodline…”
unit.target: "Primum ex eis purissimam sanguinis stirpem possidet..."

unit.source: Though Lumian was well aware that the offspring of the women the Governor of the Sea had slept with were descendants of the sea, whether they were Maidens of the Sea or not, with his profound mystical knowledge and extraordinary insights, he couldn’t help but consider that the Governor of the Sea having his children on his own was also part of the equation.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian bene sciebat prolem feminarum, cum quibus Praefectus Maris cubuit, ex mari descendere, sive virgines maris essent sive non, cum profunda scientia mystica et perspicaciis extraordinariis usus esset, non potuit non cogitare quod etiam ipsi, Praefecto Maris filios solum generanti, pars rei haberent.

unit.source: Phew, as expected, the more you know, the easier it is to be corrupted.
unit.target: Eheu, ut exspectabatur, quanta scias, tanto facilius corrumpitur.

unit.source: I wouldn’t have thought so in the past…
unit.target: Numquam antea ita putavi...

unit.source: Lumian sighed inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian intus suspiravit.

unit.source: Noelia, in surprise and admiration, sighed.
unit.target: Noelia, stupefacta et admiratione afflata, suspiravit.

unit.source: “You’ve made faster progress in your investigation than I anticipated.”
unit.target: "Progressus in investigatione tua celerior fuit quam exspectavi."

unit.source: “Most of it pieced together in such a short time.”
unit.target: "Plerumque in tam brevi tempore composita est."

unit.source: It’s been quite a while.
unit.target: Iam diu praeteriit.

unit.source: My Language Comprehension charm will expire tomorrow.
unit.target: Carmen meum ad intellectum linguae cras exspirabit.

unit.source: I wonder how much I’ll retain from this enhanced week of study…
unit.target: Miror quantum ex hac hebdomade studii aucta retinebo...

unit.source: Lumian grinned and teased, “Don’t tell me you think my reputation as a great adventurer was just boasting?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens et ludens respondit: "Noli mihi dici te famam meam ut magni viatoris solum iactationem fuisse?"

unit.source: “Claiming a bounty of 300,000 gold risot for the Demon Warlock certainly isn’t a boast,” Noelia diplomatically acknowledged, indicating she didn’t underestimate someone capable of hunting down such a target.
unit.target: "Fama mercedis trecentis milibus auri risot pro Daemoni Warlock vindicata certe non est iactatio," Noelia diplomate agnuit, ostendens se neminem subestimasse qui talem metam venari posset.

unit.source: Content, she nodded and continued, “While many Beyonders wield impressive abilities, their intelligence often falls short.
unit.target: Contenta, annuit et perrexit: "Quamquam multi Beyonderes facultates admirabiles possident, eorum intelligentia saepe deficit."

unit.source: “They revel in belligerence and flaunt their might, but you’re not one of them.
unit.target: "Se in pugnacitate delectant et potentiam ostendunt, sed tu inter eos non es."

unit.source: “Still, I must caution you not to push too far.
unit.target: "Tamen moneo te ne nimis procedas."

unit.source: “Despite understanding your true motive for stirring up this commotion, we must uphold peace and order in Port Santa.
unit.target: "Quamquam verum propositum tuum ad hanc tumultum excitandum intellexi, pacem et ordinem in Port Santa servare debemus."

unit.source: “Don’t make things difficult for us.”
