unit.target: "Nolite nobis res difficiles efficere."

unit.source: Coupled with the warning, the implication is that you shouldn’t disrupt Port Santa’s current situation.
unit.target: Coniuncta cum monitione, insinuitas est ut statu praesenti Port Santae non perturbes.

unit.source: You’re free to investigate the sea prayer ritual, but stirring up trouble with the Fisheries Guild is a no-go.
unit.target: Licet tibi ritum orationis maris investigare, sed tumultum cum Collegio Piscatorum excitare prohibitum est.

unit.source: What exactly does your Church of Earth Mother aim for?
unit.target: Quid quidem finem habet Ecclesia Matris Terrae tuae?

unit.source: It seems like there’s a mixed desire—both wanting and not wanting some actions to be taken…
unit.target: Videtur esse desiderium mixtum—et quidam actiones fieri vel non fieri velle...

unit.source: Lumian contemplated Noelia’s hint, a smile playing on his lips as he spoke, “If you had been more forthcoming, I wouldn’t have had to work this hard.”
unit.target: Lumian insidias Noeliae meditatus est, subrisus labris, et dixit: "Si magis aperta fuisisses, non tam diligenter laborare mihi oporteret."

unit.source: Noelia offered a polite yet awkward smile.
unit.target: Noelia, comiter sed dubie, subridens se ostendit.

unit.source: “We lack extensive intel.
unit.target: "Notitia ampla nobis deest.

unit.source: “All I can say is the Church allows the sea prayer ritual and the Fisheries Guild to obtain power from the sea for a reason, unrelated to our ability to solve it.
unit.target: "Omnia quae dicere possum, sunt: Ecclesia ritum orationis maris et Collegium Piscatorum ad potentiam ex mari obtinendam sinit, ob causam a nostra solutione alienam."

unit.source: “I’m not privy to the reason—perhaps the Archbishop or our Fertility Order president could shed light.”
unit.target: "Rationem nescio—fortasse Archiepiscopus aut praeses Ordinis Fertilitatis lumen inferre possit."

unit.source: Lumian scoffed and said, “Then why allow my investigation of the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Lumian deridens dixit: "Quare igitur investigationi meae ritus orationis maris sinere?"

unit.source: With a sigh, Noelia replied, “Do we need to know? We didn’t pry into your true motives for probing the ritual, did we?”
unit.target: Cum suspiriis, Noelia respondit: "Necesse est id scire? Non penetramus in veros motus tuos ad ritum explorandum, nonne?"

unit.source: With that, the combat nun swiftly rose from the sofa, striding purposefully towards the suite’s door.
unit.target: Hoc dictis, monialis pugnax celeriter ex sofa surrexit et ad ianuam conclavis propositam properavit.

unit.source: After a few steps, she halted, a thoughtful expression crossing her face.
unit.target: Post paucos passus, sistit, vultu meditativo apparenti.

unit.source: “There are ancient traces concealed in the basement of the Governor of the Sea’s residence in Milo Village.
unit.target: "Antiquae vestigia in subterram domus Praefecti Maris in vico Milo absconsa sunt.

unit.source: They might unveil something crucial.
unit.target: "Fortasse aliquid maximi momenti revelabunt.

unit.source: It’s best to seize an opportunity to investigate.”
unit.target: "Optimum est occasionem investigandi capere."

unit.source: In the subterranean chamber beneath the Governor of the Sea’s residence?
unit.target: "In cella subterranea sub domo Praefecti Maris?"

unit.source: According to Franca’s account, Milo Village’s ancestors had left behind symbols and patterns.
unit.target: Secundum narrationem Francae, maiores vici Milo signa et exempla reliquerunt.

unit.source: Does Noelia suggest these hold vital information?
unit.target: Num Noelia sugerit haec notitiam vitalem continere?

unit.source: Is the reason for the Church of Earth Mother knowingly allowing the occurrence of the sea prayer ritual hidden in that chamber?
unit.target: Num causa cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae conscie sinat ritus orationis maris evenire, in ea cella abscondita sit?

unit.source: If Juan Oro isn’t deceptive or concealing the truth, and isn’t engaging in foul play, doesn’t that imply that the Earth Mother Church possesses a deeper understanding of Milo Village’s ancestors than their own descendants?
unit.target: Si Juan Oro non sit fallax nec veritatem celat, et pravis artibus non utatur, nonne hoc significat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae altiori ratione de maioribus vici Milo posse quam ipsi posteri?

unit.source: It makes sense.
unit.target: Sane.

unit.source: After all, they once obliterated Milo Village and eradicated the faction of those ancestors.
unit.target: Nam quondam vicum Milo deleverunt et factionem eorum maiorum exterminaverunt.

unit.source: Over the past thousand years, there has been no disruption in the legacy, maintaining a prominent position in the real world.
unit.target: Per mille annos, hereditas sine intermissione permanet, locum praeclarum in mundo reali tenens.

unit.source: Lumian observed Noelia’s departure without pressing further.
unit.target: Lumian discessum Noeliae observavit, ulteriora non rogans.

unit.source: As he returned to the master bedroom, preparing for sleep, the “doll” messenger dropped a folded piece of paper, swiftly departing without a greeting.
unit.target: Dum ad cubiculum principalem redibat, ad somnum se parans, nuntius "pupa" chartam plicatam deiecit, celeriter abscedens sine salutando.

unit.source: Ludwig isn’t that repulsive, except for being a bit ravenous and devouring everything, right?
unit.target: Ludwig non est tam abhorens, nisi quod paulum vorax sit et omnia devorat, nonne?

unit.source: Uh, Madam Magician does tend to stay up late.
unit.target: Heu, Domina Magica sero manere solet.

unit.source: She’s quickest with her replies at night…
unit.target: Nocte celerime responsa dat…

unit.source: Lumian muttered under his breath as he picked up the response.
unit.target: Lumian submurmuravit dum responsum arripiebat.

unit.source: Swiftly unfolding it, he scanned the contents.
unit.target: Celeriter evolvens, contentum perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: “Your performance in Port Santa has been impressive thus far.
unit.target: "Exsecutio tua in Port Santa usque nunc mirabilis fuit.

unit.source: “I won’t interfere or provide excessive guidance.
unit.target: "Non immiscor nec nimiam praeceptionem praebebo."

unit.source: “This is a prime chance for you to further digest the Conspirer potion.
unit.target: "Haec est praecipua occasio ut poculum Conspiratoris ulterius digeras."

unit.source: “I’ve roughly reconstructed that sentence and read it multiple times.
unit.target: "Illam sententiam fere recontexi et pluries legi."

unit.source: “It’s not in any language I know presently, but what I can confirm is its lack of natural power.
unit.target: "Non est in lingua quam nunc novi, sed quod certo scire possum, eam naturali potentiae carere."

unit.source: “However, it possesses a certain energy—language can possess such energy.
unit.target: "Attamen, quandam energiam habet—lingua enim talem energiam habere potest."

unit.source: “What does this imply?
unit.target: "Quid hoc implicat?"

unit.source: “It means that during the sea prayer ritual, it can’t serve as a sacrificial language or communicate with Beyonder items—in simpler terms, the sea.
unit.target: "Hoc significat tempore ritu orationis maris, eam lingua sacrificatoria esse non posse nec cum rebus Beyonder communicare—simpliciter, mare."

unit.source: “So why does the sea prayer ritual work?
unit.target: "Quare ergo ritus orationis maris operatur?"

unit.source: “The key may lie within the ceremonial ring.
unit.target: "Clavis fortasse in anulo caerimoniali sita est."

unit.source: “There’s a high chance it has a distinct appearance, peculiar patterns, strong spirituality, and embedded knowledge.
unit.target: "Multa verisimilitudo est ut formam distinctam, figuras peculiares, spiritualitatem fortem, et scientiam inclusam habeat."

unit.source: “The sentence relies on its pronunciation, structure, and energy to activate the ring, making it functional.
unit.target: "Sententia in eius pronuntiatu, structura, et energia fundatur, quae anulum ad operandum excitant."

unit.source: “If you can recreate the ring’s state after the vigil ritual, I’m confident I can decode its specific effects and approximate meaning.”
unit.target: "Si statum anuli post ritum vigili refigere potes, certo confido me effectus specificos eius et sensum approximatum interpretari posse."

unit.source: That makes sense.
unit.target: Id sensum habet.

unit.source: When Lato Guiaro recited the words ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’ there were no indications of natural power being invoked.
unit.target: "Cum Lato Guiaro verba 'Te adnutimus, O mare…' recitavit, nullae significationes naturae potentiae adhibitae erant."

unit.source: It must serve a different purpose…
unit.target: "Aliud proposito fungitur…"

unit.source: Lumian gained a deeper understanding of the sea sacrificial segment after reading Madam Magician’s explanation.
unit.target: Lumian altorem comprehensionem de parte sacrificii maris adeptus est postquam explanationem Dominae Magicae legit.

unit.source: Most of the clues seemed to await his infiltration of the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Plerumque indicia videbantur eum exspectare, dum in domum Praefecti Maris infiltraretur.

unit.source: The next morning, Lugano led Ludwig through the streets, grabbing breakfast according to the boy’s cravings.
unit.target: Mane sequenti, Lugano Ludovicum per vias duxit, prandium iuvenis cupiditatibus secundum capiens.

unit.source: Out of nowhere, someone hurriedly passed by, head lowered, and seemingly slipped, accidentally bumping into him.
unit.target: Ex nihilo, aliquis festinanter transivit, capite inclinato, quasi lapsus, casu in eum incidens.

unit.source: Lugano smoothly shifted his body, preventing the person from making contact.
unit.target: Lugano leniter se commutavit, impediens ut persona eum contingere posset.

unit.source: He went the extra mile, helping the individual up and hypocritically saying, “Be careful.”
unit.target: Extra studium induxit, hominem ad surgendum adiuvans et hypocrite dicens, "Cave!"

unit.source: The man quickly pressed something into Lugano’s hand,
unit.target: Vir celeriter aliquid in manum Lugani imposuit,

unit.source: muttered an apology, and seamlessly melted into the crowd.
unit.target: murmurans veniam dedit, et in turbam leniter se dissolvit.

unit.source: Lugano glanced down at his palm, revealing a crumpled white post-it note.
unit.target: Lugano in manum suam intuitus est, schedulam albam conglobulatam revelans.

unit.source: Unrushed, he didn’t immediately read the note.
unit.target: Non celeriter, schedulam statim legere non instituit.

unit.source: After securing breakfast for Ludwig, he returned to Solow Motel and briefed Lumian.
unit.target: Post prandium pro Ludovico curatum, ad Deversorium Solow rediit et Luminiano enarrauit.

unit.source: Lumian took the crumpled note, unfolding it with a nonchalant gesture.
unit.target: Lumian schedulam conglobulatam sumpsit, eam leviter evolvens.

unit.source: In delicate handwriting, it conveyed: “After last year’s ritual, the sea experienced an anomaly.”
unit.target: Sub subtili calamo scriptum, nuntiabat: "Post ritum anni superioris, mare anomaliam passi est."

unit.source: 567 Possible Leaker
unit.target: 567 Possibilis Effusor

unit.source: 567 Possible Leaker
unit.target: 567 Possibilis Effusor

unit.source: The failure of the sea prayer ritual last year caused an anomaly in the sea? Lumian couldn’t help but interpret it that way after going through the contents.
unit.target: Defectus riti precationis maritimae anno praeterito in mari anomaliam effecit? Lumian non potuit quin id ita interpretaret postquam singula argumenta perlegit.

unit.source: Studying the note in his hand, a familiar fragrance wafted to him.
unit.target: Notam in manu tenens, odor notus ad eum pervenit.

unit.source: After some thought, Lumian recalled the source: the Paco family’s Madame Giorgia’s perfume.
unit.target: Post aliquod meditabundum tempus, Lumian originem recoluit: unguentum Dominae Giorgiae ex familia Paco.

unit.source: Were they inexperienced or intentionally leaving a trace, implying the Paco family as the source of this information?
unit.target: Num erant inexperti aut studiose vestigia reliquerent ut familia Paco tamquam fons huius notitiae designaretur?

unit.source: Lumian mused to himself, recalling the sudden appearance of a humanoid lizard in the Paco family, the severe injuries to Rubió Paco’s mother Martha, and the peculiarities surrounding them.
unit.target: Lumian sibi meditatus est, recolens repentinam apparationem lacertae humanoidis in familia Paco, graves laesiones matris Rubió Paco, Martha, et res insuetas circa eos.

unit.source: Is the core issue the sea’s abnormality?
unit.target: Num ipsa anomalia maris sit quaestio primaria?

unit.source: Has it weakened the Paco family’s Beyonders, causing an ordinary person without sea lineage to transform into a humanoid lizard?
unit.target: An debilitavit Beyonder familiae Paco, ita ut homo ordinarius sine stirpe marina in lacertam humanoidem verteatur?

unit.source: Perhaps they don’t want other sea spawn to know and were lacking the strength to handle the humanoid lizard, thus seeking foreign adventurers to resolve it?
unit.target: Forsitan nolunt alii maris progenies noscere, et vi caruerunt ad tractandum lacertam humanoidem, ideo adventatores externos quaerebant ad rem solvendam?

unit.source: Lumian gained a new insight into the contradictions within the Paco family’s commission.
unit.target: Lumian novam perceptionem cepit de contradictionibus in mandato familiae Paco.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro and Juan Oro hadn’t mentioned the sea’s anomaly.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro et Juan Oro anomaliam maris non memoraverunt.

unit.source: They only noted the sea’s increased violence without the ritual’s appeasement, the frequent departure of Death Navigators from their territory, and the declining strength of the Children of the Sea.
unit.target: Notaverunt tantum auctam violentiam maris absque placatione ritu, frequentem discessum Navigatorum Mortis ex regione sua, atque declinantem potentiam Puerorum Maris.

unit.source: From their perspective, this situation seemed normal, foreseeable, and unrelated to any anomaly.
unit.target: Ex eorum prospectu, haec res visa erat normalis, praedicabilis, nec ad quamlibet anomaliam pertinens.

unit.source: Did the anomaly solely affect the Paco family, or did Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, and others intentionally conceal this matter?
unit.target: Num sola familia Paco afficiebat an Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, et alii hanc rem conscie celaverunt?

unit.source: Are they guarding against each other?
unit.target: An invicem se servent?

unit.source: Lumian speculated as he watched the note consumed by crimson flames in his palm.
unit.target: Lumian speculatus est, dum notam in palma sua, ignibus rubris devoratam, observabat.

unit.source: He leaned toward the latter possibility.
unit.target: Ad hanc verisimilitudinem inclinavit.

unit.source: If the Paco family wasn’t unique, the sea’s anomaly should have widespread effects, not solely targeting them.
unit.target: Si familia Paco unica non esset, anomalia maris effectus latius habere debebat, non solum in eos incidere.

unit.source: This understanding shed light on Rubió Paco’s disdain when speaking of the Maidens of the Sea.
unit.target: Hoc intellectus lumen afferebat in fastidium Rubió Paco, cum de Puellis Maris loquebatur.

unit.source: Discovering the truth about the Maidens of the Sea and his true lineage likely filled him with self‐loathing and contempt for the entire sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Inventio veritatis de Puellis Maris atque de stirpe sua veritate eum verisimiliter replevit auto-odium et contemptu totius ritu precationis maritimae.

unit.source: He’d rather forfeit his family’s inheritance than marry another Maiden of the Sea.
unit.target: Malit hereditatem familiae suae perdere quam aliam Puellam Maris in matrimonium ducere.

unit.source: When the sea anomaly affected the entire Paco family, these emotions reached their zenith.
unit.target: Cum anomalia maris totam familiam Paco afficeret, hae passiones apicem attigerunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s suspicion grew that Nolfi’s covert ally might be Rubió Paco.
unit.target: Crescit suspicio Lumiani, ut socius occultus Nolfi esset Rubió Paco.

unit.source: Regardless, given the Paco family’s resources and status, they could lead a comfortable life even without the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Attamen, ratione opum et status familiae Paco, vitam commodam agere poterant etiam sine ritu precationis maritimae.

unit.source: Lugano stood to the side, observing his employer as Lumian delved into deep thought after reading the note.
unit.target: Lugano stetit ad latus, dum dominum suum observabat, atque Lumian post legendam notam in profunda cogitatione se immergebat.

unit.source: A twinge of nervousness and fluster crossed Lugano’s demeanor.
unit.target: Trepidatio et perturbatio in vultu Lugano apparuerunt.

unit.source: Is something about to unfold again?
unit.target: Num aliquid rursus evenerit?

unit.source: Lumian glanced up at Lugano, his expression pensive.
unit.target: Lumian ad Lugano intuens, vultu cogitativo, aspexit.

unit.source: “Though I haven’t reached Highlander proficiency, I’ve mastered the daily words I need.
unit.target: „Quamquam disciplinam Highlander nondum adeptus sum, verba cotidiana quae mihi opus sunt callide didici.“

unit.source: My body language suffices for a normal life in Port Santa.
unit.target: „Gestus meus corporis sufficit ad vitam normalem in Port Santa.“

unit.source: Plus, the folks I’ll be dealing with know Intisian.
unit.target: „Praeterea, homines cum quibus operabor, Intisianum sciunt.“

unit.source: I can settle the remaining balance now and offer you a free ‘teleport’ back to Trier.”
unit.target: „Nunc possum reliquam rationem solvere atque tibi gratuitam 'teleportationem' ad Trier offerre.”

unit.source: Instinctively, Lugano shook his head.
unit.target: Instinctive, Lugano caput concussit.

unit.source: “You can’t attend to Ludwig when you’re in action. If I leave now, who’ll keep an eye on him?”
unit.target: „Non potes Ludwigum curare cum agitur. Si nunc discedo, quis eum custodiat?“

unit.source: It’s unclear who’s watching whom… Lumian stared at Lugano for a brief moment, sensing, for the first time, an unsettling undertone in the interpreter’s demeanor.
unit.target: Non liquet quis quem vigilet… Lumian per brevem momentum Lugano aspexit, primum subtonum inquietum in habitu interpreti sentiens.

unit.source: Despite prior attacks and potential risks, there was an inexplicable resistance to the suggestion of terminating the employment contract and taking his offer for a safe departure!
unit.target: Quamquam impetus praeteriti et pericula potentialia erant, inexplicabilis tamen resistentia fuit ad suggestionem contractus operandi rescindendi et oblationem eius pro tutam discessum accipiendi!

unit.source: It wouldn’t even cost him a verl d’or!
unit.target: Neque quidem “verl d’or” illi pretium constare debebat!

unit.source: Considering Lugano’s typical behavior and personality, Lumian assumed he would readily accept the remaining payment and leave Port Santa.
unit.target: Considerato Lugano more et indole, Lumian putavit eum solutionem reliquam facile recepturum atque Port Santa discedere.

unit.source: Reality, however, proved otherwise.
unit.target: Attamen res reales aliter se ostenderunt.

unit.source: Perhaps Lugano himself doesn’t understand the rationale behind his decision.
unit.target: Forsitan ipse Lugano rationem decisionis suae non intellegit.

unit.source: It is just an “instinctive” choice…
unit.target: Hoc solum est electio instinctiva…

unit.source: Lumian nodded subtly, opting not to press further on settling the final payment and terminating their employment contract.
unit.target: Lumian subtiliter annuit, optans non pergere ad solvendum vectigal ultimum atque contractum operis terminare.

unit.source: In Milo Village, within the Oro family’s extensively renovated ancestral house, Juan Oro lounged by the window, puffing on a hookah, his gaze fixed on the sun dipping below the horizon, casting an orange glow.
unit.target: In vico Milo, intra domum priscam familiae Oro diligenter renovatam, Juan Oro ad fenestram recubuit, fistulam fumigans, oculos in solem labentem infra horizontem intuebatur, qui lumen aurantiacum spargebat.

unit.source: His thoughts drifted to the impending sea prayer ritual, just over a week away.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius ad imminens ritum precationis maritimae vagabantur, paulo plus quam septimana abesse.

unit.source: Abruptly, he turned his head, eyeing a shadow near the door.
unit.target: Subito, vertit caput, umbram iuxta ianuam intuebatur.

unit.source: The darkness stirred, and a man with green eyes, sporting a golden straw hat, white shirt, and black vest, emerged—the adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Tenebrae excitatae sunt, et vir oculis viridibus, galea aurea straminea indutus, camisia alba ac vestimento nigro perlatus, apparuit—adventor, Louis Berry.

unit.source: “Why are you here again?” Juan Oro sighed, switching to Intisian.
unit.target: „Cur iterum hic es?” suspiravit Juan Oro, linguam suam in Intisian convertens.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, dragging a chair into the sun’s waning rays.
unit.target: Lumian risens, sellam ad radias solis minuantem traxit.

unit.source: “I’ve got another inquiry and a heads-up about a particular operation.”
unit.target: „Aliud quaestionem habeo atque praemonitionem de certa operatione.“

unit.source: Juan’s eyes narrowed.
unit.target: Oculi Juan contracti sunt.

unit.source: “What scheme are you plotting now?”
unit.target: „Quid nunc machinare conaris?“

unit.source: “Tonight, I intend to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: „Hac nocte intendo in domum Gubernatoris Maris insidiari.

unit.source: If I go unnoticed, I’ll observe the rooms where the vigil ritual is conducted.
unit.target: Si non animadvertar, locos ubi ritus vigiliae celebratur, observabo.

unit.source: If discovered, I’ll make a swift exit.
unit.target: Si detectus fuerit, celeriter exiam.

unit.source: This fits my radical persona and purported motives, doesn’t it?
unit.target: Hoc congruit cum persona mea radicali atque suppositis motivis, nonne?

unit.source: It’ll deflect suspicion from our covert collaboration,” Lumian disclosed, a hint of a smile in his explanation.
unit.target: Suspicionem a nostra collaboratione occulta avertet, inquit Lumian, paulo subridente.

unit.source: Juan Oro harbored an unexplained sense of threat from Louis Berry, yet he found no tangible evidence.
unit.target: Juan Oro sensum inexplicabilem minationis a Ludovico Berry ferebat, at nulla perspicua probatione invenit.

unit.source: Despite this, Lumian’s words resonated with an unsettling logic.
unit.target: Non obstante hoc, verba Lumiani cum logica perturbante resonabant.

unit.source: He drew a deep drag from his hookah in silence before he spoke.
unit.target: In silentio, fumum profundum ex fistula sua inhavit, antequam locutus est.

unit.source: “What are you getting at?”
unit.target: „Quid insinuis?“

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: “I’m curious to see the ring that marries the sea, its intricate engravings, and the patterns it bears.
unit.target: „Curiosus sum videre anulum quod mare coniungit, ejus inscriptiones intricatas et formas quas gerit.

unit.source: I know you’ve only crafted the ring mold and haven’t completed the ritual to infuse it with something special.
unit.target: Scio te solum formam anuli confecisse nec ritum ad eum aliquid speciale infundendum perfecisse.

unit.source: However, after serving as deputy host 11 times and assisting even more, I’m confident you’ve memorized the patterns, symbols, and structure.”
unit.target: Attamen, postquam undecies tamquam vice hospitis munus explevisti atque etiam pluries adiuvisti, certus sum te formas, symbola, atque structuram bene meminisse.

unit.source: Juan Oro stiffened, his tone turning icy.
unit.target: Juan Oro riguit, et vox eius in gelu versa est.

unit.source: “What’s your motive?”
unit.target: „Quid est propositum tuum?“

unit.source: The room’s afterglow, touched by the setting sun, dimmed suddenly, as if being pulled into another dimension.
unit.target: Splendor residuus camerae, sole occidente tactus, subito obscuratus est, quasi in aliam dimensionem traheretur.

unit.source: Unfazed, Lumian responded, “Why all the secrecy? Haven’t you heard that the ring’s design, patterns, and structure have long been exposed?”
unit.target: Imperturbatus Lumian respondit, „Cur tanta secretio? Nonne audivisti designum, figuras atque structuram anuli diu patefactos esse?“

unit.source: Juan Oro’s eyes narrowed. “When did this happen?”
unit.target: Oculi Juan Oro contracti sunt. „Quando hoc evenit?“

unit.source: Lumian arched an eyebrow.
unit.target: Lumian supercilium elevavit.

unit.source: “Didn’t my companion inform you of the true reason behind the sea prayer ritual failure?”
unit.target: „Nonne socius meus te certiorem fecit de vera causa defectus ritu precationis maritimae?“

unit.source: “He merely confirmed the fake Iru on the ship.” Juan Oro had his suspicions.
unit.target: „Ille solum Iru fictum in navi confirmavit.” Juan Oro suspiciones habuit.

unit.source: Lumian grinned, shaking his head.
unit.target: Lumian subridit et caput concussit.

unit.source: He began unraveling his deductions, starting with the custom-made fake ring in Torres and the orchestrated lamb sacrifice sent to the ship after a bribe.
unit.target: Incepit deductiones suas explicare, incipiens a falso anulo in Torres confecto et agnello sacrificio ordinato, quod post munus in navi missum erat.

unit.source: Juan Oro held his silence, his countenance growing darker.
unit.target: Juan Oro silentium retinuit, et vultus eius obscuritatem adeptus est.

unit.source: After a tense pause, he spoke in a hoarse tone, “Not many are privy to the intricacies of the Ring of the Sea Queen, and the fact that sea spawn seldom inspect the sacrificial offerings’ entrails.”
unit.target: Post brevem moram tensam, voce rauca locutus est: „Non multi sunt qui intricata Anuli Reginae Maris cognoscant, atque quod proles maris raro viscera oblationum sacrificiorum inspiciant.”

unit.source: Each of them, the Children of the Sea, veterans of countless core rituals, are still alive… Iru and Salah were oblivious…”
unit.target: Omnes hi, Pueri Maris, veteres in innumerabilibus ritibus cardinalibus, adhuc vivunt… Iru et Salah inscii erant.

unit.source: As Juan Oro’s words, spoken through gritted teeth, reached Lumian’s ears, a sudden realization dawned upon him.
unit.target: Cum verba Juan Oro, inter dentes strictos dicta, ad aures Lumiani pervenerunt, subito revelatio illi orta est.

unit.source: Ultraman is affiliated with the Fisheries Guild, a Child of the Sea endowed with numerous powers and a distinct status!
unit.target: Ultraman cum Gilda Piscandi affiliatus est, Puer Maris plurimis potentiis atque dignitate singulari praeditus!

unit.source: There’s also the possibility that he’s manipulated such an individual, establishing a clandestine “partnership.”
unit.target: Exstat etiam possibilitas eum talem hominem manipulavisse et societatem clandestinam instituisse.

unit.source: Without such a connection, how could April Fool’s possess precise details about the ceremonial ring’s appearance and exploit the sea prayer ritual’s “supervisory” loophole?
unit.target: Sine tali nexu, quomodo April Fools notitias accuratas de specie anuli caerimonialis habere et hiatus “supervisorialem” ritu precationis maritimae explere posset?

unit.source: Even though I Know Someone mentioned that Ultraman is a Sun pathway Beyonder, it doesn’t rule out his identity as a Child of the Sea.
unit.target: Etiamsi “I Know Someone” commemoravit Ultraman esse Beyonder viae Solis, id tamen non excludit eius identitatem ut Puer Maris.

unit.source: Transforming into a Child of the Sea first and then drinking the Sun pathway’s potion shouldn’t pose an issue.
unit.target: Primum in Puerem Maris transformari, deinde potionem viae Solis bibere, nullum impedimentum esse debet.

unit.source: The power of the Child of the Sea resonates with the cosmos, and the Sun and the cosmos are inherently compatible.
unit.target: Potentia Pueris Maris cum universo resonat, et Sol cum universo intrinsece compatibilia sunt.

unit.source: Is April Fool’s true motive for disrupting the sea prayer ritual preparations related to Ultraman or his collaborator aiming to fully control the power or the palace at the bottom of the sea?
unit.target: Num verus motivus April Fools perturbandi praeparationes ritu precationis maritimae ad Ultraman aut eius collaboratorem refertur, qui intendunt potentiam vel palatium in fundo maris omnino regere?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts gradually clarified.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani paulatim clarificatae sunt.

unit.source: He looked at Juan Oro with a relaxed smile and remarked, “If there wasn’t a mole, how could the sea prayer ritual be disrupted so easily?”
unit.target: Ad Juan Oro, subrisu relaxedo, aspexit et dixit: „Si non fuisset talpa, quomodo ritu precationis maritimae tam facile pertuberaretur?“

unit.source: Juan Oro had harbored similar suspicions for the past year; Lumian’s words were irrefutable.
unit.target: Juan Oro suspiciones similes per annum fovit; verba Lumiani indubitable erant.

unit.source: After some contemplation with an unpleasant expression, Juan Oro composed himself and stated, “I have to uncover the traitor before the official sea sacrifice…”
unit.target: Post aliquod spatium cogitationis, vultu incommodus, Juan Oro se composuit et dixit: „Proditorem detegere debeo ante sacrum maris officiale…“

unit.source: At this point, Juan Oro turned his gaze to Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Juan Oro oculos suos in Lumian vertit.

unit.source: “I might need your cooperation on something when the time comes.”
unit.target: „Fortasse, cum tempus advenerit, cooperationem tuam mihi opus erit.“

unit.source: “Oh, you’re fishing too?” Lumian replied with a smile, “No problem.”
unit.target: „O, et tu piscas quoque?” subridens respondit Lumian, „Nullum problema!”

unit.source: Juan Oro set down his hookah and left his seat.
unit.target: Juan Oro fistulam suam deposuit et sedem reliquit.

unit.source: He walked to the desk, retrieved a pen and paper, and began sketching.
unit.target: Ad mensam ambulavit, calamus et charta cepit, et delineare coepit.

unit.source: Nearly ten minutes later, the old man staggered to Lumian and handed him the paper.
unit.target: Fere decem minuta post, senex titubans ad Lumian accessit et chartam ei tradidit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at it and recognized six designs—representing the front, left, right, back, front, and inner parts of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Lumian illud aspexit et sex designationes agnovit—repraesentantes partes: anterior, sinistra, dextra, posterior, iterum anterior, et internam Anuli Reginae Maris.

unit.source: Each design featured intricate and mystifying symbols and patterns.
unit.target: Unumquodque consilium insignia intricata et figurae arcanae exhibebat.

unit.source: “It’s actually useless for you to obtain it. It won’t have any effect,” Juan Oro said in a low, raspy voice.
unit.target: „Revera tibi inutilis est id obtinere. Nullum effectum habebit,” inquit Juan Oro voce humili et rauca.

unit.source: The corresponding sea spawn have to use their special abilities to inscribe them on the ring and corrode them for six hours to please the sea and gain her recognition.
unit.target: Proles maris idoneae facultates suas speciales uti debent ut ea in anulo inscribant atque sex horas corrodant, ad mare placandum et eius agnitionem consequendam.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “I have no intention of replicating one.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et respondit, „Non intendo alterum replicare.“

unit.source: He was obtaining it solely to send to Madam Magician for interpretation.
unit.target: Illud obtinebat solum ut Dominae Magicae ad interpretationem tradendum.

unit.source: He then asked, “Is this the ring-making segment of the vigil ritual? Is there no other step?”
unit.target: Tum interrogavit, „Estne haec pars creationis anuli in ritu vigiliae? Num nullus alius gradus adest?“

unit.source: “There’s another step. An assistant host will take the ring to the basement and place it in front of the patterns and symbols representing our ancestors for an hour. This is a show of respect to our ancestors, like greeting the elders before a wedding,” Juan Oro explained briefly.
unit.target: „Alius gradus est. Hospes adiutor annulum in subsolum ducit et eum coram figuris atque symbolis, qui maiores nostros repraesentant, per unam horam imponet. Hoc est ostentatio reverentiae erga maiores nostros, sicut salutatio senioribus ante nuptias,” breviter explicavit Juan Oro.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian responded, “Can you also draw the patterns and symbols representing your ancestors?”
unit.target: Post aliquod spatium cogitationis, Lumian respondit, „Potesne etiam delineare figuras et symbola repraesentantia maiores tuos?“

unit.source: Juan Oro returned to the desk.
unit.target: Juan Oro ad mensam rediit.

unit.source: This time, he completed it in just two minutes.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, id intra tantum duas minutas confecit.

unit.source: Lumian took it and noticed scattered lines and arcs.
unit.target: Lumian illud accepit et lineas atque arcus dispersos animadvertit.

unit.source: Many details were missing from the middle, making it impossible to discern its original appearance.
unit.target: Multa ex mediis partibus defuerunt, ita ut eius aspectus originalis discerneri non posset.

unit.source: “Seeing it in person might allow you to make connections easier.” Juan Oro sighed again.
unit.target: „Videns id in persona, coniunctiones facilius efficere poteris,” iterum suspiravit Juan Oro.

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “Then I’ll infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence tonight.”
unit.target: „Tum hanc nocte in domum Gubernatoris Maris insidiari intendo,” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Juan Oro tersely acknowledged his words.
unit.target: Juan Oro verba eius breviter confirmavit.

unit.source: “Be careful of the sea spawn there. They have their own specialties. They might not be very strong, but they can counter certain abilities of yours.”
unit.target: „Cave proles maris ibi. Unam aliquamque specialitatem habent. Forsitan non sint valde fortes, sed certas tuas virtutes oppugnare possunt.”

unit.source: Late at night, under the crimson moonlight, Lumian appeared near the cathedral-like building.
unit.target: Nocte sero, sub lumine rubro lunae, Lumian prope aedificium quasi cathedralicium apparuit.

unit.source: 568 Patterns of the “Ancestors”
unit.target: 568 Formae "Proavorum"

unit.source: 568 Patterns of the “Ancestors”
unit.target: 568 Formae "Proavorum"

unit.source: Lumian swiveled his head towards the docks, his body seamlessly blending into the shadows beyond the moonlight’s reach.
unit.target: Lumian caput ad portum convertit, et corpus eius in umbras extra finem lucis lunaris perfecte miscens apparuit.

unit.source: Following the shadowy path, he smoothly bypassed the guards at the entrance, slipping into the sacred-looking building without a sound.
unit.target: Viam umbratam sequens, custodes ad introitum leniter praeteriit, atque in aedificium, quod specio sacra exhibebatur, sine sono se insinuavit.

unit.source: In the foyer, he came to a sudden halt.
unit.target: In atrio subito sistit.

unit.source: Amidst the dark “fishnets,” he spotted short figures with oddly large heads, bulging eyes, and wrinkled skin – like elders in miniature.
unit.target: Inter obscuras “rete piscium”, figuras breves animadvertit, quarum capita insolite magna, oculi protuberantes, et cutis rugosa erant – quasi senes in parva figura.

unit.source: Standing just over a meter tall, they were the “Little Devils” mentioned by Juan Oro, a species of sea spawn.
unit.target: Stantes paulo supra unum metrum, hi “Parvi Diaboli” a Juan Oro commemorati erant, species exordii maritimi.

unit.source: Infiltrating the shadows, these Little Devils patrolled the Governor of the Sea’s residence, using their unique abilities to prevent any unauthorized entry.
unit.target: In umbras insidiantes, hi Parvi Diaboli domicilium Praefecti Maris perscrutabant, singularibus facultatibus utendo ne quis ingressus illicitus fieret.

unit.source: Having encountered them before, Lumian knew these Little Devils weren’t formidable opponents.
unit.target: Cum eos antea obvios habuisset, Lumian scivit hos Parvos Diabolos adversarios formidabiles non esse.

unit.source: Despite their talent for blending into shadows and creating illusions, he could dispatch a team with ease.
unit.target: Quamquam artem in umbras miscendi et illusiones creandi haberent, facile coetum dimittere poterat.

unit.source: Yet, eliminating them discreetly posed a challenge.
unit.target: Attamen eos caute interficere provocationem constituere videbatur.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t be certain that dealing with one group of Little Devils wouldn’t stir up trouble and alert other creatures lurking in the building.
unit.target: Lumian non certus esse poterat quin tractatio uni coetu Parvorum Diabolorum non tumultum excitaret atque alias creaturas latentis in aedificio adsciret.

unit.source: Focused, Lumian surveyed the areas untouched by shadows.
unit.target: Concentratus, Lumian regiones in quibus umbra non invaserat perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: In the crimson moonlight, he discerned vague figures drifting in the void, intermittently appearing and disappearing.
unit.target: Sub luce rubra lunaris, figuras vagas in vacuo vagantes, interdum apparentes atque evanescentes, deprehendere potuit.

unit.source: These were fish adorned in dark-gray armor, their bulging eyes resembling meatballs at both ends.
unit.target: Hi erant pisces induti armatura obscurae cinerei, quorum oculi protuberantes globulis carnis utrinque similes erant.

unit.source: Starlight-threaded “thin threads” peeked through the gaps in their scale-like armor.
unit.target: Tenues fila, quasi siderum luminibus tincta, per hiatus in armatura squamosa inspici apparuerunt.

unit.source: The peculiar fish hovered in the air, scattering across different regions.
unit.target: Pisces insoliti in aere volitabant, diversas regiones dispergentes.

unit.source: Occasionally, they released bubbles carrying formless storms and impalement-inducing cracks.
unit.target: Interdum bullas emitterunt, quas tempestates informes atque crepitus ad impalationem inducendos portabant.

unit.source: Erupting bubbles created countless invisible spikes, setting perilous traps for teleporting “guests.”
unit.target: Bullae eruptivae innumeros spinas invisibiles creabant, insidias periculosas pro hospitibus “teleportantibus” constituentes.

unit.source: At the hall intersection and various aisles, silent three-man guard teams patrolled.
unit.target: Ad intersectoriam aulae et in variis angulis, turmae tacitarum trium custodum peragrabant.

unit.source: Their expressions betrayed nothing, but Lumian noticed slender black insects, covered in bristles, emerging from their necks and mouths.
unit.target: Vultus eorum nihil patefecerunt, sed Lumian insecta nigra gracilia, setis operta, ex cervicibus atque ore emergere animadvertit.

unit.source: After a brief inspection, the Batings Black Insects swiftly retracted into the guards’ bodies.
unit.target: Post brevem inspectionem, insecta nigra “Batings” celeriter in corpora custodum redierunt.

unit.source: The eyes of sea creature statues on the wall appeared alive, scanning the areas with a strange awareness.
unit.target: Oculi statuarum creaturarum maritimarum in pariete quasi vivos apparuerunt, regiones cum mirabili vigilantia perscrutantes.

unit.source: Just as Juan Oro said, there are a large number of different sea spawn here.
unit.target: Sicut Juan Oro dixit, hic multa genera exordii maritimi sunt.

unit.source: Infiltrating silently amidst the diverse sea spawn here proves to be a formidable task.
unit.target: Silenter inter diversa exordia maritima intrare videbatur negotium formidabile.

unit.source: Lumian, patient, opted to remain in the foyer, awaiting the right moment.
unit.target: Lumian, patienter, decrevit in atrio manere, tempus opportunum exspectans.

unit.source: In under two minutes, a thunderous bang reverberated from the dock.
unit.target: Infra duo minuta, fragor tonitruosus ex portu resonavit.

unit.source: Crimson flames shot into the sky, casting an eerie glow on nearby windows, making them quiver.
unit.target: Flammae rubrae in caelum se proiecerunt, lumen horribilem in fenestris proximis effundentes, quae tremere incitabant.

unit.source: Little Devils lurking in the shadows, Armored Monster Fish manipulating the surrounding void, Batings Black Insects orchestrating guards, and peculiar creatures concealed in the statues’ eyes—all instinctively shifted their focus to the glass window near the dock.
unit.target: Parvi Diaboli latent in umbris, Pisces Monstrorum Armati vacuum circumiectum regentes, insecta nigra “Batings” custodum dispositiones ordinantes, et creaturae insolitae in oculis statuarum absconditae—omnes instinctive ad fenestram vitrei prope portum conspectum converterunt.

unit.source: Lumian sprang into action.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter ad agendum properavit.

unit.source: He orchestrated the disturbance with a delayed explosion!
unit.target: Perturbationem cum explosione dilata ordinavit!

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, he stealthily navigated through the shadows surrounding the Little Devils and skirted the region patrolled by the Armored Monster Fish.
unit.target: Occasionem capiens, callide per umbras circum Parvos Diabolos peragravit et partem, quam Pisces Monstrorum Armati custodiebant, circumivit.

unit.source: Before other sea spawn could react, he pinpointed the room at the far end of the hall, relying on Juan Oro’s intel.
unit.target: Antequam alia exordia maritima responderent, conclave in extremo aulae locatum statuit, innixus nuntiis Juan Oro.

unit.source: A dim light emitted from the black mark on his right shoulder as he swiftly reached the door of the target room.
unit.target: Lumen pallidum ex signo nigro in umero dextro eius effulsit, cum ad ostium conclavi destinatum celeriter pervenisset.

unit.source: In a blink, he transformed into a shadow, slipping through the crack.
unit.target: In momento, umbram factus est, per fissuram delapsus.

unit.source: Inside, Lumian discovered intricate patterns and symbols etched on the floor, ceiling, and walls, reminiscent of magnified versions of Juan Oro’s hand‑drawn sacrificial ring pattern.
unit.target: Intus, Lumian figuras intricatas et symbola in pavimento, laqueari, et parietibus incisa invenit, quae similia erant ampliata exemplaria schema circuli sacrificii manu delineati a Juan Oro.

unit.source: Besides that, nothing else caught his eye.
unit.target: Praeter id, nihil aliud animadvertum est.

unit.source: Lumian deduced, During the vigil ritual, some sea spawn enter this place, condense the patterns from every direction, and carve them into the ring mold.
unit.target: Lumian coniectavit, durante ritu vigili, aliqua exordia maritima hunc locum intrare, schemata ex omnibus partibus colligere, atque ea in formam annuli incidere.

unit.source: Then, they infuse them with special energy.
unit.target: Deinde ea cum energia speciali infunduntur.

unit.source: Quickly scanning the area, he stepped out of the shadows, activating a black mark on his chest.
unit.target: Celeriter regionem perspexit et ex umbris exiit, in pectore suo signum nigrum activans.

unit.source: Nearly invisible water ripples danced on the surrounding walls, then subsided.
unit.target: Undae aquae paene invisibiles in parietibus circumiectis saltabant, deinde siluerunt.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Ampulla Fictionis!

unit.source: Lumian “enclosed” the two connected rooms into the Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: Lumian duas cellas conexas in Ampulla Fictionis inclusit.

unit.source: The entry requirement: ordinary humans.
unit.target: Conditio introitus: homines ordinarii.

unit.source: He positioned himself near the opening of the Bottle of Fiction, deliberately creating loud footsteps as he hid by the door.
unit.target: Se posuit prope ianuam Ampullae Fictionis, stridore vestigiis quidem voluntario creante, dum iuxta ostium se celavit.

unit.source: Almost instantly, certain sea spawn picked up on the disturbance.
unit.target: Paene instante, aliqua exordia maritima perturbationem conspexerunt.

unit.source: Recalling the explosion at the docks and the towering flames, they realized they had fallen into a diversion.
unit.target: Reminiscentes explosionem ad portum et flammarum altitudinem, intellexerunt se in diversionem incidisse.

unit.source: Summoning the Armored Monster Fish, Batings Black Insects, Little Devils, and their cohorts, they ordered an investigation into the ring‑making ritual venue for potential infiltrators.
unit.target: Vocantes Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, Insecta Nigra “Batings”, Parvos Diabolos, et eorum comitatus, imperaverunt investigationem in loco ritu annuli faciendi ad deprehendendos insidiatores.

unit.source: Despite attempts to rush in through the door, the sea spawn inexplicably found themselves back in the hall.
unit.target: Quamquam per ostium irrumpere temptabant, exordia maritima inexplicabiliter se in aulam redire invenerunt.

unit.source: The Armored Monster Fish, discerning the issue, released bubbles with a formless storm toward the entrance of the Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, rem perspicue cognoventes, bullas cum tempestate informi versus introitum Ampullae Fictionis emiserunt.

unit.source: As before they surged towards him, aiming to breach the room, Lumian, now a shadow creature, slipped through the crack at the base of the wooden door, quietly exiting the Bottle of Fiction and returning to the hall.
unit.target: Sicut prius ad eum contendebant, intendentes conclave irrumpere, Lumian, iam creatura umbratica, per fissuram ad radicem ostii lignei delapsus, caute e Ampulla Fictionis exiens in aulam rediit.

unit.source: His ploy successfully diverted the sea spawn’s attention, creating a chance for him to change positions.
unit.target: Consilium eius feliciter attentionem exordii maritimi avertit, sibi occasionem mutandi positionis efficiente praebens.

unit.source: Naturally, he needed to employ effective tactics a few more times!
unit.target: Naturale, necesse erat ut alias artes efficaces nonnullas iteraret!

unit.source: Anticipating the enemy’s disbelief in encountering the same trick repeatedly within a short span, Lumian knew they would assume there were alternative plans.
unit.target: Praevidens hostium incredulitatem, si idem dolus breviter atque plurimas vicibus occursus esset, Lumian scivit eos alia consilia putaturos esse.

unit.source: Of course, on the third attempt, heightened vigilance would set in.
unit.target: Certe, tertia conatu, vigilantia intensior instaurabitur.

unit.source: Everything they saw would seem like a distraction.
unit.target: Omnia, quae vident, quasi decipula videbuntur.

unit.source: When the moment arrived, Lumian could flip the strategy.
unit.target: Cum momentum advenit, Lumian strategiam convertere poterat.

unit.source: Seizing the moment when the sea spawn fixated on the Bottle of Fiction, Lumian deftly avoided the gathering of Little Devils.
unit.target: Occasionem capiens, cum exordia maritima ad Ampullam Fictionis contendere coeperunt, Lumian callide coetum Parvorum Diabolorum evitavit.

unit.source: He circled the Armored Monster Fish, reaching a corner of the hall, and once again utilized Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Circumivit Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, ad angulum aulae perveniens, atque iterum Transitus Mundi Spiritus usus est.

unit.source: This time, Lumian’s destination was the staircase leading to the basement.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, meta Lumiani erat scala quae ad cellam subterranem ducit.

unit.source: The guards, lured into the hall, left the area unmonitored.
unit.target: Custodes, in aulam alliciti, regionem sine vigiliis relinquebant.

unit.source: As Lumian’s silhouette appeared at the staircase entrance, he swiftly transformed into a shadow, slipping into the basement through the darkness.
unit.target: Cum figura Lumiani ad initium scalae apparuit, celeriter in umbram transformatus, per obscuritatem in cellam subterranem se delapsus est.

unit.source: No guards or sea spawn patrolled this seemingly unimportant area, an area that was merely a testament to the villagers of Milo Village’s reverence for their ancestors.
unit.target: Nulli custodes neque exordia maritima in hac apparenter humili regione peragrabant; ipsa regio testabatur reverentiam incolarum vici Milo erga proavos suos.

unit.source: In his shadow creature form, Lumian possessed “natural” night vision.
unit.target: In forma umbratica, Lumian naturali visione nocturna praeditus erat.

unit.source: Even without a fireball, he could vaguely discern the dark basement.
unit.target: Etiam sine pila ignifera, obscuram cellam subterranam vago modo percipere poterat.

unit.source: Despite its dampness due to proximity to the sea, the absence of a moldy odor was thanks to the various Beyonder powers within the building.
unit.target: Quamquam ob propinquitatem maris umida erat, absentia odoris putridi, gratia variis viribus “Beyonder” intra aedificium, constabat.

unit.source: At the center stood a decrepit stone platform, reminiscent of an altar for ancestor worship.
unit.target: In medio stabat suggestum lapideum decrepitus, qui ad aram cultus proavorum reminiscere videbatur.

unit.source: Surrounding it were signs of destruction, leaving only disjointed lines, arcs, and indistinct patterns.
unit.target: Circum illud signa destructionis erant, relinquentes tantum lineas disiunctas, arcus, et schemata indistincta.

unit.source: Do these fragmented symbols and patterns constitute the coat of arms of Milo Village’s ancestors? Or do they possess mystical effects?
unit.target: Num haec symbola fracta et schemata vestimentum armorum proavorum vici Milo efficiunt? An etiam proprietates mysticas habent?

unit.source: Lumian scrutinized them repeatedly, struggling to reconstruct the undamaged version in his mind.
unit.target: Lumian ea iterose perspexit, conans versionem intactam in mente sua recreare.

unit.source: Yet, he sensed that since Noelia of the Fertility Order had alluded to the revealing nature of these symbols and patterns, he might extract valuable information.
unit.target: Attamen sensit, quod ab Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis, quae ad naturam revelatricem horum symbolorum ac formarum alludebat, pretiosa notitia extrahi posset.

unit.source: What kind of information could it be?
unit.target: Qualis notitia esse posset?

unit.source: Maintaining his shadow creature form, Lumian extended into the darkness, surveying his surroundings.
unit.target: Servans formam umbraticam, Lumian in obscuritatem se extendit, ambitum suum perscrutans.

unit.source: Frowning, he whispered, Could it be that the Church of Earth Mother, fully capable of obliterating this place, deliberately left traces?
unit.target: Frontibus contritis, susurravit: “Num Ecclesia Matris Terrae, quae hunc locum penitus delere posset, conscie vestigia reliquit?”

unit.source: Does this imply that the sea prayer ritual holds some influence over them too?
unit.target: Hocne significat quod ritus orationis maritimae quoque aliquam vim super eos habeat?

unit.source: Lumian directed his gaze at the stone platform, the sacrificial offering to the ancestors, recalling Juan Oro’s details about the ring‑making ritual.
unit.target: Lumian oculos suos ad suggestum lapideum, oblationem sacrificii proavorum, convertit, recolens verba Juan Oro de ritu annuli faciendi.

unit.source: After crafting the Ring of the Sea Queen, it would rest here for an hour as a mark of respect to their ancestors.
unit.target: Postquam annulum Reginae Maris confecerat, hic per horam quiesceret ut signum reverentiae erga proavos.

unit.source: Was it placed on this partially collapsed altar?
unit.target: Num in hoc altero pariter lapsa collocatus est?

unit.source: Approaching the grayish‑black stone platform, Lumian observed no dust accumulation.
unit.target: Accedens ad suggestum lapideum cinereo‑nigro, Lumian nullam pulveris congeries observavit.

unit.source: All remaining lines converged on an empty space at the center of the circle.
unit.target: Omnes lineae residuae in spatium vacuum in centro circuli confluebantur.

unit.source: His heart stirred as he retrieved a Louis d’or, placing it in the center of the altar.
unit.target: Cor eius movebatur, cum Louis d’or recuperavit et in medio altaris posuit.

unit.source: Nothing happened.
unit.target: Nihil accidit.

unit.source: Undeterred, Lumian replaced the Louis d’or with gold risot, Mystery Prying Glasses, Flog boxing gloves, and various other items.
unit.target: Non deterritus, Lumian Louis d’or substituit per aurum risot, specula mirifica “Mystery Prying”, guantiis pugilisticis “Flog” atque variis aliis rebus.

unit.source: Yet, still no anomaly.
unit.target: Attamen, nullus effectus insolitus apparuit.

unit.source: Persistence drove him.
unit.target: Perseverantia eum impulit.

unit.source: Lumian pulled out the silver Lie earring from his pocket and positioned it on an empty space on the stone platform.
unit.target: Lumian argenteum “Lie” aureolum ex sinu extraxit et in spatio vacuo super suggestum lapideum collocavit.

unit.source: In the next moment, a surreal sensation enveloped Lumian.
unit.target: In momento proximo, sensatio insueta Lumian complectit.

unit.source: Within the stone platform, illusory lines and arcs materialized, intertwining with remnants to form two distinct patterns:
unit.target: Intra suggestum lapideum, lineae et arcus illusorii materialiter apparuerunt, et cum reliquis intertexentes duas formas distinctas effingebant:

unit.source: One pattern featured layers of doors sketched with simple strokes, while the other resembled a clock divided into twelve sectors, albeit having a single hand.
unit.target: Una figura continens strata ianuarum, simplicibus lineis delineatarum, exhibebat; altera vero similem erat horologio in duodecim partes divisum, quamquam una sola manum habens.

unit.source: Lumian observed keenly, sensing something adhering to the Lie earring.
unit.target: Lumian acriter observavit, sentiens aliquid ad “Lie” aureolum aderere.

unit.source: In an instant, the lines from the stone platform dimmed, retracted, and returned to their original positions.
unit.target: In momento, lineae e suggesto lapideo obscuratae, retractae, et ad loca initia redierunt.

unit.source: Normalcy resumed.
unit.target: Status normalis rediit.

unit.source: Are these the patterns representing Milo Village’s ancestors? Or did they gain knowledge from the initial revelations?
unit.target: Num hae figurae vestigia proavorum vici Milo efficiunt? An ex primis revelationibus notitiam acceperunt?

unit.source: Lumian sensed sea spawn surging toward the basement.
unit.target: Lumian sentivit exordia maritima in cellam subterranam impetum facere.

unit.source: After muttering to himself, he seized the Lie earring and “teleported” away.
unit.target: Postquam sibi submurmuravit, aureolum “Lie” rapuit et “teleportatus” abiit.

unit.source: In the master bedroom of the suite at Solow Motel.
unit.target: In cella principalis suite apud Solow Motel.

unit.source: As Lumian’s figure manifested, he settled down and began writing to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Cum figura Lumiani apparuit, se stabilivit et ad Dominae Magicae scribere coepit.

unit.source: Unfazed by checking the changes in the Lie earring, he intended to send it to his Major Arcana card holder for inspection.
unit.target: Sine perturbatione mutationes in aureoli “Lie” inspiciens, destinavit id ad tenentem cartae Major Arcana pro recognitione mittere.

unit.source: Recreating the patterns, symbols, structure, and various scenes from the Governor of the Sea’s residence, Lumian neatly folded several letters, arranged a ritual, and summoned the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Recreando formas, symbola, structuram, et varias scaenas ex domicilio Praefecti Maris, Lumian complures epistulas diligenter plicavit, ritum ordinavit, et “pupam” nuntium evocavit.

unit.source: Then, he patiently awaited the reply.
unit.target: Deinde, patienter responsum exspectavit.

unit.source: 569 Language Interpretation
unit.target: 569 Interpretatio Linguae

unit.source: 569 Language Interpretation
unit.target: 569 Interpretatio Linguae

unit.source: The crimson moonlight seeped through the not-so-thick curtains, casting its glow on the desk, already yellowed by the gas wall lamp’s illumination, emphasizing its presence.
unit.target: Lux rubra lunaris per non tam crassas velamina diffusus est, fulgorem suum in mensam iacitans, iam ex luce lampadis gasi flavidam factam, praesentiamque eius extollens.

unit.source: Lumian perused his freshly acquired Highlander textbook, patiently waiting for over half an hour before finally receiving a reply from Madam Magician via the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Lumian noviter adeptum librum Highlander diligenter perlustrebat, paulo plus quam dimidio horae patienter exspectans, donec tandem responsum a Domina Magica per nuntium "puppam" accepit.

unit.source: The letter was concise and spanned only two pages.
unit.target: Epistola concisa erat atque tantum duas paginas complebatur.

unit.source: “Let’s start with the basics.
unit.target: «Incipeamus a fundamentis.»

unit.source: “Combining the patterns, symbols, and structure of the ring—although I can’t precisely decipher the meaning of that sentence—I can identify its composition and the practical application of various short sentences.
unit.target: «Coniungendo formas, symbola, et structuram anuli—quamquam significationem illius sententiae precise explicare non valeo—compositio eius ac usus practicus variarum breviarum sententiarum cognoscere possum.»

unit.source: “It breaks down into three segments:
unit.target: «In tres partes dividitur:»

unit.source: “The first part serves to precisely locate the ring, facilitating the subsequent activation of special characteristics and the infusion of energy contained in the language.
unit.target: «Pars prima anulum exacte determinare parat, activationem proprietatum specialium sequentiumque infusionem energiae in lingua contentae facilitans.»

unit.source: “The second part involves injecting the energy carried by the words into the ring through resonance and other forms, activating a magic circle formed by patterns and symbols. Consider the sacrificial ring as a charm. The second paragraph is akin to its designated special activation incantation. It doesn’t necessitate invoking supernatural powers but requires prior guidance.
unit.target: «Pars secunda refert ad infusam energiam, quam verba vehunt, in anulum per resonantiam aliisque modis, circulum magicum ex formis et symbolis constitutum activans. Anulum sacrificiale ut talismanum intende. Secunda paragraphus similis est incantationi specialis activationis destinatae. Non exigit potestates supernaturales evocare, sed praevia ducatio necessaria est.»

unit.source: “In the third part, I suspect it’s a ciphertext attached to the ring. In simpler terms, once the ceremonial ring is fully activated through the first two parts, it records and carries the final ciphertext into the sea to transmit it to something.
unit.target: «In parte tertia suspicio scripturam arcanam ad anulum adnexam esse. Ut aliter dicam, cum annulus caerimonialis per duas partes plene activatus est, ultimam scripturam arcanam in mare referens ad aliquid transmittendum fert.»

unit.source: “Are you following so far? The ceremonial ring is like a special key, functional only after activation. Furthermore, it necessitates the corresponding password to open the ‘doors’ of the target.
unit.target: «Intelligisne usque ad hunc finem? Annulus caerimonialis quasi clavis specialis est, utilis solum post activationem. Insuper, requirit tesserae idoneum ad aperiendas 'portas' destinatarias.»

unit.source: “Heh heh, the actual meaning of ‘We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion’ is roughly akin to ‘a key to unlock the passageway. The password is XXXXXXXXX.’ Naturally, if translated directly, it’ll differ significantly, but that should capture the essence.
unit.target: «Heh heh, verus sensus 'Nos te sponsamus, o mare, ut signum veri atque perpetui dominionis' fere aequipollens est 'clavis ad iter recludendum. Tessera est XXXXXXXXX.' Naturaliter, si directe verteretur, signanter differet, sed hoc essentiam complecti debet.»

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t resist a smirk.
unit.target: Lumian subridere retinere non potuit.

unit.source: Recalling the solemn recitation by the previous Governors of the Sea, envisioning the act of marrying the sea, anyone familiar with the corresponding language would likely burst into laughter.
unit.target: Recordans recitationem sollemnem a pristinis Gubernatoribus Maris, ac cogitans de nuptiis maris, quisquis linguam conveniens novit, probabiliter in risum effunderet.

unit.source: What sea, what espousal, what dominion! After all the complexity, it boiled down to unlocking and opening a passageway—a simple password entry!
unit.target: Quid mare, quid sponsalia, quid imperium! Post omnem complexitatem, ad viam recludendam aperiendamque redigebatur—ingressus simplicissimus tesserae!

unit.source: Contemplating sharing this interpretation with Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, and the others, Lumian pondered their likely reactions.
unit.target: Cum hanc interpretationem cum Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, et aliis communicare cogitaret, Lumian de eorum probabilibus reactionibus meditatus est.

unit.source: No, they wouldn’t believe it. A millennium or two of misunderstanding had morphed into faith, perseverance, and legacy. Admitting a mistake wasn’t something they’d easily embrace.
unit.target: Minime, non id crederent. Mille aut biduo errorum interpretatio in fidem, perseverantiam, et hereditatem versa erat. Agnoscere errorem non facile a eis acciperetur.

unit.source: Regardless, the result would be the same. Interpretation or translation, it didn’t matter how they perceived it!
unit.target: Attamen, exitus eadem esset. Interpretatio aut translatio, qualibet ratione percepta, nihil mutabat.

unit.source: Collecting himself, Lumian turned to the second page of the letter, eager to continue reading.
unit.target: Concentratus, Lumian ad paginam secundam epistolae se vertit, avidus ulterius legendi.

unit.source: “Next is the more complicated part.
unit.target: «Proximum est pars magis intricata.»

unit.source: “The two patterns you witnessed in the Governor of the Sea’s basement have a profound history, stretching back to the early Fourth Epoch.
unit.target: «Duae formae quas in cella subterranea Gubernatoris Maris conspexisti historiam profundam habent, ad initia Quartae Aetatis extendentes.»

unit.source: “They serve as symbols of mysticism and the coat of arms of ancient nobles. One of them is linked to an acquaintance—no, a familiar Angel, Amon!
unit.target: «Illae symbola mysticae et insignia armorum antiquorum nobilitatis praebent. Una eorum ad noto—immo ad Angelum familiaris, Amon—conexa est.»

unit.source: “The pattern resembling a clock signifies the Worm of Time. It stands as the Amon family’s coat of arms.
unit.target: «Figura horologii instar quae Vermem Temporis significat, armorum familiae Amon stat.»

unit.source: Worm of Time? The Amons’ coat of arms? Why is it Him again! Lumian’s eyes narrowed, feeling as though he was still entrenched in the Amons.
unit.target: Vermis Temporis? Insignia armorum Amon? Cur ille iterum! Oculi Lumiani angustati sunt, quasi adhuc in Amonibus maneret.

unit.source: What connection did Milo Village’s ancestors, Port Santa’s sea prayer ritual, and the distinctiveness of those waters share with the Amons?
unit.target: Quid nexum habebant maiores vici Milo, ritu orationis maritimae Portus Sancti, atque singularitas aquarum illarum cum Amonibus?

unit.source: On the surface, no apparent link existed!
unit.target: In superficie, nullum nexum apparens exsistebat!

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he suddenly sensed a connection between the sea prayer ritual and the former King of Angels of the Marauder pathway.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani rapiditer voluebant, subito animadvertit nexum inter ritum orationis maritimae et pristinum Regem Angelorum in via Praedonis.

unit.source: Reflecting on the key members involved in the April Fool’s ritual prank, Bard, a Beyonder of the Marauder pathway, and Mad Lady, belonging to the neighboring Apprentice pathway, even prayed to The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth—a being with profound influence over the Marauder pathway.
unit.target: Cogitans de membris principalibus in ioco ritu Aprilis Stultorum participibus, Bard, Beyonder viae Praedonis, et Mad Lady, quae ad vicinam viam Discipulorum pertinebat, etiam oraverunt ad Celestem Dignum Caeli et Terrae—entitatem quae in via Praedonis acumen habet.

unit.source: While this didn’t directly point to the Amons, the gathering of Marauder‑related individuals suggested a reasonable association between the sea prayer ritual and the Marauder pathway.
unit.target: Cum hoc non directe Amonibus referretur, congregatio hominum pertinentes ad viam Praedonis rationabilem nexum inter ritum orationis maritimae et viam Praedonis insinuit.

unit.source: Lumian exhaled, lowering his head to read further insights from Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, caput inclinans ad ulteriores cognitiones a Domina Magica legendas.

unit.source: “The layers of doors come from the Abraham family. Yes, the Abraham family, one of the five nobles of the Tudor Empire. I previously mentioned that in the Tudor Empire, only five families hold the hereditary duke title: Abraham, Amon, Antigonus, Jacob, and Tamara. Among them, the Abrahams control the Apprentice pathway. Remember, Apprentices often represent seals.
unit.target: «Strata ostiorum a familia Abraham proveniunt. Ita, familia Abraham, una ex quinque nobilibus Imperii Tudorici. Prius dixi in Imperio Tudorico solum quinque familias titulum ducis hereditarum obtinere: Abraham, Amon, Antigonus, Jacob, et Tamara. Inter eas, Abrahami viam Discipulorum regunt. Memento, discipuli saepe sigilla repraesentant.»

unit.source: “Therefore, it’s plausible to believe that the sea prayer ritual predates previous estimates, tracing back to before the demise of the Fourth Epoch’s Tudor Empire. Encountering matters related to the Tudor Empire sure isn’t a coincidence for you, is it?
unit.target: «Ergo crederi potest ritum orationis maritimae priores aestimationes superasse, atque ad ante casum Imperii Tudorici Aetatis Quartae referre. Convenire res cum Imperio Tudorico certe non casus tibi sunt, an non?»

unit.source: “Do you now grasp the essence of the sea prayer ritual? Further explanations may not be necessary, correct?
unit.target: «Nuncne essentiam ritu orationis maritimae habes? Explicationes ulteriores fortasse non sunt necessariae, rectene?»

unit.source: “I’m starting to suspect that Milo Village’s ancestors misunderstood the initial sentence’s meaning, leading to the expansion of the sea sacrifice and vigil from the revelation. This resulted in an absurd sea marriage ritual spanning a millennium or two. It could very well be a manifestation of that individual’s mischievous nature, reveling in playing a joke on everyone, indifferent to the fate of others.
unit.target: «Incipienter suspicio maiores vici Milo primam sententiam male intellexerunt, quod ad expansionem sacrificii maritimi et vigiliæ ex revelatione duxit. Hoc in ritu nuptiarum maritimarum absurdum per mille annos vel duo effecit. Id valde esse potuit manifestatio naturae illius malitiosa, qui in omnibus iocum faciendo et sortem aliorum non curando delectabatur.»

unit.source: “See, this is what a prank should be. Those April Fool’s folks could learn a thing or two.
unit.target: «Ecce, sic esse debet iocus. Illi Aprilis Stultorum homines aliquid discere possent.»

unit.source: “If you have more questions or haven’t clarified certain aspects, feel free to write and ask.
unit.target: «Si plura interroges aut non quaedam explicata sint, libenter scribas et interroga.»

unit.source: “By the way, Lie now possesses a temporary ability lasting half a month. It can absorb a specific amount of power from a target, though this power won’t endure long. For ordinary people, it might persist for half a year or a year. However, for you, it won’t last more than a week due to the conflict with your powers.”
unit.target: «Apud rem, Lie nunc facultatem temporariam habet quae dimidio mensis perdurat. Potest quantam vim ex proposito certo absorbere, quamvis haec vis non diuturna maneat. Pro hominibus vulgo, fortasse per dimidium anni aut unum annum perseverabit; tibi autem non ultra septimā hebdomada manebit propter conflictum cum tuis viribus.»

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze from the letter, his thoughts in disarray.
unit.target: Lumian oculos a epistola avertit, mens eius in perturbatione versabatur.

unit.source: Madam Magician suggests that the uniqueness of those waters originated from the ancestor of the Abraham family and a certain Amon? The core of the sea prayer ritual was personally devised by these two Angel‑level figures. They guided the ancestors of Milo Village in Port Santa and left behind a revelation, compelling them to perform the ritual annually?
unit.target: Domina Magica suadet unicitatis aquarum illarum originem ex maioribus familiae Abraham et quendam Amon provenisse? Nucleus ritu orationis maritimae personaliter ab his duobus figuris angelicalibus compositus fuit. Illi maiores vici Milo in Portus Sanctus duxerunt et revelationem reliquerunt, coactionem eis ad ritum annuum perficiendum praebentes?

unit.source: Due to Amon’s mischievous nature, the ancestors of Milo Village misunderstood the true meaning of that sentence, thinking they were meant to marry the sea. Consequently, the core of the sea prayer ritual became increasingly complex, expanding into more segments over the years. It transformed into an extensive prank that persisted for over a millennium?
unit.target: Propter Amonis malitiosam naturam, maiores vici Milo veram sententiae significationem male intellexerunt, existimantes se destinatarios coniugii cum mari esse. Inde, nucleus ritu orationis maritimae progressu magis magisque complexus factus est, per annos in plures partes evolutus. Id in iocum vastum, per mille annos vel plura, perseverum transformatus est?

unit.source: Having comprehended Madam Magician’s hypothesis, Lumian reconsidered the essence of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Hypothesim Dominae Magicae intellexit, Lumian essentiam ritu orationis maritimae iterum meditabatur.

unit.source: Appeasing the special entity concealed at the bottom of the sea—perhaps that palace?
unit.target: Specialem entitatem, quae in fundo maris abscondita est, placans—fortasse illud palatium?

unit.source: Apprentice represents a seal… Marauder is stealing…
unit.target: «Discipulus sigillum repraesentat… Praedor rapit…»

unit.source: Stealing…
unit.target: Rapit…

unit.source: Lumian suddenly glanced down at his left chest.
unit.target: Lumian subito aspexit ad sinistram pectoris suam.

unit.source: He grasped the essence of the sea prayer ritual!
unit.target: Essentiam ritu orationis maritimae comprehensit!

unit.source: Finding a husband for the sea, pacifying its violence, genuinely pleasing it, and obtaining corresponding boons were all absurd reasons concocted by Milo Village’s ancestors after being misled!
unit.target: Invenire sponsum pro mari, violentiam eius sedare, illi veram voluptatem praestare, et boones correspondentes adipisci erant omnes rationes absurdae a maioribus vici Milo, postquam erraverunt, excogitatae!

unit.source: The essence of the sea prayer ritual was to steal boons!
unit.target: Essentia ritu orationis maritimae erat boones rapere!

unit.source: The “palace” at the bottom of the sea had been sealed by the Apprentice pathway, but the ancestor of the Abraham family worried that, over time, the seal’s power would wane, allowing the “palace” to gradually regain strength. To counter this, he enlisted Amon to devise a ritual for regularly siphoning off the restored power of the palace each year, preventing it from breaking through the seal.
unit.target: «Palatium» in fundo maris a via Discipulorum clausum erat, sed maior familiae Abraham timuit virtutem sigilli per tempus deminuturam esse, sinens «palatium» paulatim vim recuperare. Cui contrariande, Amon ad ritualem constituendum coniunxit, quo singulis annis vim recuperatam palatii regulariter extraheret, ne sigillum discerneretur.

unit.source: Consequently, after each sea prayer ritual, the sea area would become tranquil, free from excessive storms. The previous year’s failed ritual had allowed the palace to accumulate a certain degree of strength. Consequently, the sea experienced abnormality, leading to an increased number of shipwrecks, and Death Navigators departed the special sea area more frequently.
unit.target: Consequenter, post singulum ritum orationis maritimae, zona maris tranquilla facta est, tempestatibus nimis abundanti non laborans. Rituale anni priores defectum permisit palatio vim aliquam congregare. Quam ob rem, mare in anomaliam inciderit, quod ad navium naufragiorum copiam augendam duxit, et Navigatori Mortis zonam maritimam specialem frequentius reliquerunt.

unit.source: The reason for only entering the sea when the stars aligned and following a specific route to reach the destination was that only then would a complex passageway appear in the outer seal!
unit.target: Causa cur mare intraretur solum cum astra conlacerentur et viam certam sequeretur ad destinatum perveniendum, erat quod tantum eo tempore iter complexum in sigillo externo appareret!

unit.source: Lumian stood up and took a few steps forward.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et paucos passus praecedens intravit.

unit.source: Having unraveled the essence of the sea prayer ritual, he comprehended the Earth Mother Church’s motive for perpetuating it.
unit.target: Essentiam ritu orationis maritimae detegens, intellexit causam Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ad eam perpetuandam.

unit.source: Initially, the clergyman of the Earth Mother Church, lacking thorough investigations, destroyed Milo Village, putting an end to the sea prayer ritual. However, at the bottom of the building, they discovered the coat of arms representing the two nobles of the Tudor Empire, halting the final step in time. Later, they realized they needed to dispatch demigod-level Saints to deal with the unique waters each year. High-end forces were required to guard it for an extended period, making it quite troublesome. Consequently, when the sea prayer ritual resurfaced, they tacitly agreed to the reconstruction of Milo Village.
unit.target: Primum, clericus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, investigationibus exhaustis carens, vicum Milo delevit, ritui orationis maritimae finem faciens. Sed in fundamento aedificii, invenere insignia armorum, quae duos nobilissimos Imperii Tudorici repraesentabant, quae gradum ultimam tempore sistentia finierunt. Postea intellexerunt se sanctos, ad gradum semideorum, singulis annis mittere oportere ad aquas unicas tractandas. Copiae excellentes ad longum tempus custodire necesse erant, quod rem valde molestam reddidit. Consequenter, cum ritus orationis maritimae redivivisset, tacite consenserunt ad reconstructionem vici Milo.

unit.source: In most cases, the sea prayer ritual didn’t adversely affect the innocent or disrupt local order. Every Governor of the Sea possessed a certain amount of the sea’s bloodline, and while the Maidens of the Sea would eventually transform into humanoid lizards in their old age, they could alter their fates and enjoy power and wealth for 30 to 40 years or even longer.
unit.target: In plurimis casibus, ritu orationis maritimae innocentes non laedit nec ordinem localem perturbat. Omnis Gubernator Maris aliquam partem sanguinis maritimi possidebat, et dum Puellae Maris tandem in lacertulas humanoides in senectute vertere solebant, fata sua mutare et potestatem atque divitias per annos XXX ad XL aut etiam diutius frui poterant.

unit.source: For Maidens of the Sea seeking free love, the Church of Earth Mother likely tacitly consented or even aided their escape, as the chances of success were otherwise quite low.
unit.target: Puellis Maris, amorem liberum petentibus, Ecclesia Matris Terrae probabiliter tacite consenserat aut etiam eorum effugium adiuvavit, quoniam aliter casus successus satis parvi erant.

unit.source: So, why did the Fertility Order encourage me to investigate the sea prayer ritual? Why did Noelia provide some information while withholding crucial details? Lumian’s confusion swiftly dissipated.
unit.target: Ergo, cur Ordo Fertilitatis me ad indagandum ritu orationis maritimae incitavit? Cur Noelia aliqua indicia dedit dum res momenti retinuit? Confusio Lumiani celeriter evanuit.

unit.source: The real entity fishing behind the scenes was not the Fisheries Guild but the Church of Earth Mother!
unit.target: Vera entitas quae in obscuro fungens piscium non Gildus Piscationis, sed Ecclesia Matris Terrae erat!

unit.source: The failure of last year’s sea prayer ritual had alarmed the Church of Earth Mother, fearing a similar problem this year. Observing Louis Berry’s inclination to investigate the sea prayer ritual, they encouraged him to do so, allowing potential saboteurs hidden in the shadows to contact him, surface, and capture them all at once!
unit.target: Defectus ritu orationis maritimae anni praeteriti Ecclesiam Matris Terrae perterriti fecit, similem quaestionem huius anni metuentes. Louis Berry inclinantes ad ritu orationis maritimae investigandum observantes, eum ad id faciendum hortati sunt, sinentes sabatorem potentiales in umbris latentes ut eum contingerent, emergerent, omnesque simul caperent.

unit.source: Phew. Lumian exhaled, redirecting his focus to April Fool’s.
unit.target: Eheu. Lumian suspiravit, et animos suos ad Aprilis Stultorum convertit.

unit.source: Now, he was certain that April Fool’s intended to break the seal around those special waters.
unit.target: Nunc certus erat Aprilis Stultorum destinasse sigillum circa has aquas speciales rumpere.

unit.source: Last year marked the first step towards breaking the seal, but it hadn’t progressed to the point where the underwater “palace” could breach it. This year, they would undoubtedly create a similar situation once again. Otherwise, if the sea prayer ritual succeeded, their pranks from last year would be in vain!
unit.target: Anno praeterito primum gradum ad sigillum rumpendum indicatum est, sed non pervenit ad statum quo subaquaticum “palatium” illud penetrare posset.
