Hac anno, indubitanter, similem condicionem novum efficere vellent. Alioquin, si ritu orationis maritimae succederet, ioci anni praeteriti vani fuesset!

unit.source: The question now was, what would the key members of April Fool’s do? How could they seize the benefits represented by the palace and evade the corresponding dangers? Lumian stared at the gas wall lamp emitting a yellowish glow, sinking into deep thought.
unit.target: Nunc quaestio erat: quid faciebant clavi membra Aprilis Stultorum? Quomodo praemia, quae a palatio repraesentantur, capere possent et pericula corespondentia evitare? Lumian spectabat lampadam murariam gasi, quae lumine flavido effulgebat, et in cogitatione profunda mergi.

unit.source: More than a week quickly elapsed, and in the blink of an eye, the day of the sea prayer ritual arrived.
unit.target: Plus quam septimana celeriter percussa est, et in ictu oculi, dies ritu orationis maritimae advenit.

unit.source: After completing his breakfast, Lumian heard the melodic tunes of various musical instruments wafting in from the street outside.
unit.target: Postquam ientaculum suum confecit, Lumian audivit dulces sonos variarum instrumentorum musicorum ex via foris affluentes.

unit.source: With a smile, he wiped his mouth with a napkin and strolled toward the window, welcoming the bright sunlight pouring in.
unit.target: Cum risu, os suum stragulo abstulit et versus fenestram ambulavit, lucem nitidam intrantem exterius grata mente suscipiens.

unit.source: 570 Festival
unit.target: Festum DLXX

unit.source: 570 Festival
unit.target: Festum DLXX

unit.source: On Aquina Street, a two-story ceremonial boat crafted from wood, cardboard, and adorned with ribbons rolled forward, propelled by four sleek horses.
unit.target: In via Aquina, navis caerimonialis duplex ex ligno et chartacea confecta, fasciis volventibus ante ornata, a quattuor equitibus nitidis impellitur.

unit.source: This intricate vessel mimicked the Governor of the Sea’s boat, designed to economize materials and size, allowing horses to guide it through the city.
unit.target: Haec intricata navis gubernatoris maris navem imitata est, materiae et amplitudinis parcendo destinata, equos urbe ducere concedens.

unit.source: Eight men and eight women, dressed vibrantly, stood on both upper and lower levels of the flower boat.
unit.target: Octo viri et octo feminae, vestimentis vibrantibus induti, in superiore et inferiore parte navis floralis steterunt.

unit.source: They sang and danced, their joy infecting the spectators on both sides of the street.
unit.target: Cantaverunt et saltaverunt, et eorum laetitia spectatores utrinque viae inebriavit.

unit.source: Port Santa’s premier folk orchestra surrounded the ceremonial boat, playing rhythmic drumbeats and a variety of instruments such as clarinets, oboes, flauta, and strings.
unit.target: Praecipua orchestra popularis Portus Santae navem caerimonialem circuita est, tympanorum rhythmos pulsans atque instrumenta varia, ut clarineta, oboes, flauta atque chordae.

unit.source: The onlookers on the roadside were in high spirits, alternating between singing and following the ceremonial boat, hoping to catch a refreshing spray from the water droplets scattered by the sixteen men and women.
unit.target: Spectatores in margine viae laetitia eximia habebant, inter cantum atque sequendam navem caerimonialem alternantes, sperantes imbrem refrigerantem e guttis aquarum dispersis ab sexdecim viris et feminis capere.

unit.source: Observing the scene from the fifth floor of the Solow Motel, Lumian sensed that the sea prayer ritual had evolved beyond a mere sacrificial ceremony.
unit.target: Ex quinto plano Solow Motel spectans, Lumian sensit ritum maris precationis ultra solam caerimoniam sacrificii evolutum esse.

unit.source: Excluding its core aspects, it had transformed into a city-wide folklore festival.
unit.target: Elementa eius fundamentalia excluens, in festum folkloricum totius urbis versa est.

unit.source: Despite many residents of Port Santa being devout followers of the Earth Mother and not attributing spiritual significance to the sea, they embraced the festivities, dancing and celebrating on this special day.
unit.target: Etsi multi incolae Portus Santae, matrem terrae devote colentes et maris significationem spiritualem negantes, festivitatibus se delectabant, saltantes et celebrantes hac die peculiari.

unit.source: As the flower boat concluded its tour of Aquina Street, Lumian turned to Lugano and remarked,
unit.target: Dum navis floralis per viam Aquina iter perfecit, Lumian ad Lugano conversus dixit:

unit.source: “Take good care of Ludwig today. No matter which celebration you attend, ensure he’s with you.”
unit.target: “Hodie Ludwigum bene curabis. Quamlibet celebrationem frequentes, fac ut ille tecum maneat.”

unit.source: “Yes, Boss,” Lugano replied, influenced by the cheerful atmosphere of the sea prayer ritual, his emotions lifted.
unit.target: “Ita, Domine,” respondit Lugano, in alacritate ritu maris precationis impulsus, affectus levatos.

unit.source: Without wasting any time, Lumian snatched his golden straw hat, exited the suite, and descended the stairs.
unit.target: Nullum tempus amittens, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum arripuit, conclave egressus et scalas descendit.

unit.source: In the lobby, his gaze fell upon Otta Guillaume, the Solow Motel owner, doling out cash to the lady at the front desk and the two attendants—two risot each.
unit.target: In atrio, oculi eius in Otta Guillaume, dominum Solow Motel, incidit, qui pecuniam distribuens mulieri ad mensam principalem et duobus ministris—duos risot singulos—dabat.

unit.source: “Is this a holiday bonus?” Lumian inquired in Intisian.
unit.target: “Estne hoc praemium feriarum?” interrogavit Lumian in lingua Intisiana.

unit.source: “No bonus, just their compensation.”
unit.target: “Nullum praemium, solam mercedem eorum.”

unit.source: “They’re on duty at the motel today, keeping an eye on the place.”
unit.target: “Hodie in officio sunt apud motel, locum vigilantes.”

unit.source: “They’ll miss out on the sea prayer ritual and other celebrations.”
unit.target: “Ritus maris precationis aliaque celebrationes praetermittent.”

unit.source: “I’m heading to the docks to see my little cabbage dance!”
unit.target: “Eo ad moles portus ut parvam brassicam meam saltationem videam!”

unit.source: “I’ll be there too,” Lumian said with a smile, embracing the festive ambiance once again.
unit.target: “Et ego adero,” inquit Lumian cum risu, ambitum festivum iterum amplectens.

unit.source: If the sea prayer ritual lacked mystic elements, Lumian would have fully immersed himself in the festive atmosphere, reminiscent of the few years of Lent he experienced in Cordu.
unit.target: Si ritualis maris precationis elementa mystica deficerent, Lumian se penitus in ambitu festivo submersisset, memor annorum paucorum Quadragesimae quas in Cordu experivit.

unit.source: Exiting the motel, Lumian leisurely strolled towards the harbor, taking note of Port Santa’s residents bedecked in their most glamorous and festive attire.
unit.target: Ex motel egressus, Lumian lente ad portum ambulavit, incolae Portus Santae induti optimis vestimentis fulgurantibus et festivis observans.

unit.source: At a glance, the streets appeared to be awash with a sea of colors.
unit.target: Intuendo, viae apparebant inundatae mari colorum.

unit.source: His attire—a white shirt, black vest, and dark pants—made him stand out like a foreigner amidst the lively crowd.
unit.target: Indumentum eius—camisia alba, lorica nigra, et bracae atratae—eum eminere faciebat ut extraneus inter turbas vivaces.

unit.source: Lumian adorned the golden straw hat, injecting a splash of color into his appearance.
unit.target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum induit, aspectum suo colore splendidum infundens.

unit.source: The rhythmic chime of bicycle bells accompanied the passing of wooden crate-laden bicycles.
unit.target: Campanae birotarum rhythmatice tintinnabant, comitantes transitum birotarum lignearum sarcinis oneratarum.

unit.source: Vendors energetically peddled popsicles of various flavors to eager citizens anticipating the sea dance and boat race.
unit.target: Venditores alacriter popsiculas variis saporibus ad cives studiosos vendebant, qui saltationem maris et cursum navium exspectabant.

unit.source: Observing the two segments with a relaxed demeanor, Lumian savored the festivities.
unit.target: Observans duas partes cum animi quiete, Lumian festivitatibus fruebatur.

unit.source: He patiently waited until the two-story festival boat, carrying the Governor of the Sea and the Maidens of the Sea, embarked on its journey to Milo Village before departing the port.
unit.target: Patienter exspectavit, donec navis festivalis duplex, gubernatorem maris et puellas maris portans, iter ad Vicum Milo caperet antequam portum relinqueret.

unit.source: Choosing to abstain from other citizen-organized celebrations, Lumian sought refuge in a public washroom within the nearest department store, slipping into a cubicle.
unit.target: Eligens abstinere a ceteris celebrationibus civium ordinatis, Lumian refugium quaesivit in latrina publica intra proximum emporium, se in cellam insinuans.

unit.source: Triggering the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian materialized in a concealed corner of Milo Village.
unit.target: Signum nigrum in umero dextro excitando, Lumian in angulo occulto Vici Milo apparuit.

unit.source: Shifting into a shadow creature, he seamlessly infiltrated the Oro family’s blend of ancient and modern architecture, arriving at Juan Oro’s bedroom.
unit.target: Se in creaturam umbram vertens, facile infiltravit mixturam architecturae antiquitatis et novae familiae Oro, ad cubiculum Iuan Oro perveniens.

unit.source: The president of the Fisheries Guild awaited Lumian’s arrival, and upon seeing the figure of the adventurer, Louis Berry, emerge from the darkness, Juan Oro, with deep wrinkles, gestured towards the unconscious Milo villagers on the floor.
unit.target: Praeses Gremii Piscandi advenientem Lumiani exspectabat, et, cum Ludovicum Berry, exploratorem, ex obscuritate emergere vidit, Iuan Oro, rugis profundis notis, iners Milenses in pavimento significavit.

unit.source: “These are two of the four deputy hosts for the vigil and the sea sacrificial ritual. Choose one to assume his form.”
unit.target: “Hi sunt duo ex quattuor ministris vicariis pro vigilia et ritu maris sacrificii. Elige unum ut eius formam capiat.”

unit.source: This condition was pivotal for Lumian’s collaboration with Juan Oro. He sought continuous participation in the core sections of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Haec condicio clavis erat ad collaborationem Lumiani cum Iuan Oro; constantem participationem in partibus fondamentis ritus maris precationis optabat.

unit.source: Initially hesitant due to the inability to deceive other sea spawn and introduce a stranger onto the ship, Juan Oro only agreed to allow Lumian to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence before the vigil ritual, observing it discreetly.
unit.target: Primo dubitans, propter impossibilitatem alios creaturas maris decipere et hospitem in navem introducere, Iuan Oro tantum consensit ut Lumian in domum gubernatoris maris ante ritum vigiliae infiltraret, ea caute observans.

unit.source: However, with Ultraman under suspicion as a key figure in the Fisheries Guild, Lumian seized the opportunity when Juan Oro required cooperation and assistance, showcasing the abilities of the Lie earring.
unit.target: Sed, cum Ultraman sub suspecta esset ut figura clavis in Gremio Piscandi, Lumian occasionem rapuit, cum Iuan Oro cooperationem et auxilium requirebat, virtutes monili "Lie" ostendens.

unit.source: Thus, Lumian devised a plan to disguise himself as a specific deputy host and gain access to the ship.
unit.target: Itaque Lumian consilium excogitavit ut se ut determinatum ministrum vicarium fingeret et navem intraret.

unit.source: After studying one of the deputy hosts for a few moments, Lumian adorned a silver earring.
unit.target: Postquam aliquot momentum unum ex ministris vicariis observavit, Lumian auriculam argenteam induit.

unit.source: He replicated the appearance of the chosen deputy host, seamlessly blending into his guise.
unit.target: Illius ministri vicarii electi imaginem replicavit, perfecte in eius indutum se miscens.

unit.source: In no time, except for his clothing, there was no discernible difference between Lumian and the deputy host.
unit.target: Nullo tempore, excepto vestitu, discrimen inter Lumian et ministrum vicarium non erat.

unit.source: “It’s my turn,” Juan Oro said in a deep Intisian voice.
unit.target: “Meum est,” inquit Iuan Oro voce Intisiana profunda.

unit.source: He decided to take on the guise of another deputy host and personally board the ship to avert any potential mishaps.
unit.target: Constituit ut indutiam alterius ministri vicarii assumeret atque navem ipse conscenderet, ut casus adversos evitarentur.

unit.source: Concerned about Louis Berry’s involvement in the sea sacrifice and wary of lurking enemies employing unknown methods to cause trouble, Juan Oro believed that everything would converge during the sea sacrifice segment.
unit.target: De Ludovico Berry in sacrificio maris implicato sollicitus, atque hostes subdolos ignotas methodos ad molestiendum adhibentes, Iuan Oro putabat omnia in parte sacrificii maris confluere.

unit.source: Boarding the boat covertly would enable him to address unforeseen circumstances in time, delivering a strategic “surprise.”
unit.target: Clandestine navem conscendens, ei licebat ut casus inopinatos tempore opportuno tractaret, insidias stratēgicas afferens.

unit.source: Juan Oro harbored suspicions that Louis Berry might be an accomplice of last year’s saboteurs, his prior actions serving as a ploy to deceive them and allow him to openly disrupt the ritual at a crucial moment.
unit.target: Iuan Oro suspicabatur Ludovicum Berry socium esse sabotorum anni praeteriti, cujus priores actiones ut dolus ad eos decipiendos atque, in momento critico, ritualem aperte interrumpere concederent.

unit.source: Lumian casually tossed the Lie earring to Juan Oro, who proceeded to change into a dark-blue robe embroidered with various sea elements.
unit.target: Lumian leviter monile "Lie" Iuan Oro iacuit, qui in vestem caeruleam obscuram, diversis elementis maris ornatam, se mutavit.

unit.source: Upon donning the silver earring, Juan Oro experienced a remarkable control over every detail of his body.
unit.target: Auriculam argenteam induens, Iuan Oro praeclarum imperium super singula corporis sui sensit.

unit.source: Attempting to adjust the wrinkles on his face, he observed himself becoming ten to twenty years younger in the mirror.
unit.target: Rugas in facie componere conatus, in speculo se decem ad viginti annos iuveniri observavit.

unit.source: Despite his potent and diverse Beyonder powers, the president of the Fisheries Guild couldn’t help but marvel.
unit.target: Quamquam potentes et varias "Beyonder" facultates haberet, praeses Gremii Piscandi non potuit non mirari.

unit.source: “How magical.”
unit.target: “Quam magicum!”

unit.source: After completing his disguise, Lumian pointed at the unconscious deputy host.
unit.target: Consummato dissimulatione, Lumian ad ministrum vicarium iners digito monstravit.

unit.source: “Who’s responsible for keeping an eye on them and preventing their appearance before the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: “Quis eorum custodiam gerit et eorum apparitionem ante ritum maris precationis prohibet?”

unit.source: “My wife,” Juan Oro replied, already prepared.
unit.target: “Uxor mea,” inquit Iuan Oro, iam paratus.

unit.source: She, a former Maidens of the Sea and the current Matriarch of the Oro family, possessed considerable strength.
unit.target: Ea, olim puella maris et nunc matriarchae familiae Oro, viribus ingentibus instructa erat.

unit.source: While she hadn’t participated in any ring-making rituals, she was a trusted individual who wouldn’t divulge secrets.
unit.target: Quamvis nullis rituum circulorum conficiendorum particeps fuerit, fidei persona creditissima erat, nec arcana patefaceret.

unit.source: Lumian redirected the conversation, inquiring, “As the president of the Fisheries Guild, won’t you be suspected if you don’t wait for news of the successful sea prayer ritual with the other committee members?”
unit.target: Lumian sermonem redirigens rogavit: “Ut praeses Gremii Piscandi, non suspectus eris si nova de feliciter peracta ritu maris precationis cum ceteris membris commissionis exspectare non velis?”

unit.source: “No, I don’t go every year. I can also wait for news at home, and my wife will pretend to be me,” Juan Oro stated, pointing at Lie on his left ear and removing it.
unit.target: “Non, non ea quoque annuatim. Possum domi nova exspectare, et uxor mea me imitabitur,” inquit Iuan Oro, monile "Lie" ad auriculam sinistram ostendens et tollens.

unit.source: After confirming the details, Lumian inquired further, “Have you investigated any of those who nearly died and came back to life, or have their personalities undergone a significant change?”
unit.target: Confirmatis rebus, Lumian ulterius rogavit: “Investigavisti aliquos qui paene mortui sunt et ad vitam redierunt, aut num personalitates eorum signanter mutatae sint?”

unit.source: These individuals were key members of the Fisheries Guild familiar with the specific design of the Ring of the Sea Queen and the complete details of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Hi erant clāvi membri Gremii Piscandi, qui noti erant ratione certae Annuli Reginae Maris et totis rebus ritus maris precationis.

unit.source: According to Franca, every member of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society was a soul from another world, having “resurrected” in recently deceased human bodies. This information could help identify who might be Ultraman.
unit.target: Secundum Francam, omnis membrum Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispatae anima ex alio mundo erat, in nuper defunctis corporibus humanis “resurrecta.” Haec notitia ad cognoscendum qui Ultraman esse possit, utilis esse potest.

unit.source: Juan Oro slowly shook his head.
unit.target: Iuan Oro lente caput concussit.

unit.source: “No, at least not in my memory. Time was tight, so I couldn’t investigate them one by one.”
unit.target: “Non, saltem non memoravi. Tempus arctum fuit, itaque eos singulis investigare non potui.”

unit.source: The rejuvenated elder, now appearing in his prime, continued, “Remember, your name is Brian now. My name is Jorge. If you don’t understand what others are saying later, it’s fine. I’ll hint at you. When you need to answer questions, I’ll help you.”
unit.target: Senex rejuvenescentis, nunc in optima forma apparens, continuavit: “Memento, nunc nomen tuum Brian est. Mihi Jorge nomen est. Si postea verba aliorum non intellegas, nihil est; tibi insinuabo. Cum quaestionibus respondere oportet, te adiuvabo.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Lumian maintained the pretense of not knowing Highlander.
unit.target: “Recte,” inquit Lumian, simulans se Highlander nescire.

unit.source: In reality, having extensively studied under the effects of the Language Comprehension charm, he had already mastered more words and grammar.
unit.target: Revera, effectibus incantationis Comprehensionis Linguae multum studens, iam multa verba et grammaticam didicerat.

unit.source: While still unable to fully comprehend others’ words, he could grasp key words, tense, and the active and passive voice, allowing him to roughly understand the meaning.
unit.target: Etsi non omnia verba aliorum plene comprehendere poterat, vocabula clavia, tempora, atque vocem activam et passivam capere valebat, quo sensum approximatum intellegere licebat.

unit.source: Expressing himself with short sentences and simple structures presented no challenge.
unit.target: Sibi exprimere per breves sententias et simplices structuras nullum difficultatem praebebat.

unit.source: Clad in the dark-blue robe of a deputy host, Lumian entered the Governor of the Sea’s residence, guided by Juan Oro, who no longer staggered.
unit.target: Indutus in veste caerulea obscura ministri vicarii, Lumian in domum gubernatoris maris intravit, ductus a Iuan Oro, qui non iam titubabat.

unit.source: Passing through a hall adorned with sea creature statues, they reached the room where the Governor of the Sea maintained his vigil.
unit.target: Per atrium statuis creaturarum maris ornato transeuntes, ad conclave pervenerunt, ubi gubernator maris vigiliam tenebat.

unit.source: The current Governor of the Sea, Simon of the Guiaro family, was from a branch with a thin bloodline, unqualified to reside in the ancestral house.
unit.target: Gubernator maris nunc vigens, Simon ex familia Guiaro, ex stirpe tenui sanguinis, idoneus non erat in domo maiorum manere.

unit.source: At that moment, Simon sat cross-legged on the cold floor, suppressing his excitement.
unit.target: Illo momento, Simon in pavimento frigido sedebat, cruribus contrahentibus, excitamentum suum reprimentem.

unit.source: With half-closed eyes, he felt the moist air enveloping him.
unit.target: Oculis semi clausis, sentiebat aerem humidum eum amplecti.

unit.source: Although Lumian refrained from activating his Spirit Vision, he sensed various sea spawn bustling in the shadows, the void, and the statues.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian Visionem Spirituum non excitavit, diversas creaturas maris in umbris, in vacuo, et in statuis agitando sentiebat.

unit.source: Juan Oro led Lumian out of the room, guiding him to the most secluded part of the building.
unit.target: Iuan Oro Lumian e conclavi duxit, eum ad remotissimam partem aedificii ducens.

unit.source: Opening the wooden door to the servants’ quarters, Juan Oro addressed the fake Governor of the Sea, Miguel, lying on the bed.
unit.target: Aperiens ostium ligneum ad cubicula servis, Iuan Oro gubernatorem maris falsum, Miguel, qui in lecto iacebat, allocutus est.

unit.source: “Once the sea prayer ritual succeeds, you can leave, but you must depart Port Santa with the wealth you’ve amassed over the past year.”
unit.target: “Postquam ritu maris precationis feliciter completus erit, discedere potes; sed Portum Santa cum divitiis, quas per annum praeteritum consecutus es, reliquere debes.”

unit.source: Miguel sat up excitedly. “Alright, alright!”
unit.target: Miguel excitatus surrexit. “Recte, recte!”

unit.source: Though their conversation occurred in Highlander, Lumian grasped the essence.
unit.target: Quamquam sermo eorum in Highlander evenit, Lumian essentiam capivit.

unit.source: After this exchange, Juan Oro translated the conversation for Lumian, emphasizing, “You can verify if I’m lying based on Miguel’s expression.”
unit.target: Post hanc colloquium, Iuan Oro Lumiano sermonem interpretatus est, dicens: “Perscrutare potes, si mendax sim, ex vultu Migeli.”

unit.source: Lumian silently pondered, thinking, So what if you’re not lying? What you said might not be done…
unit.target: Lumian silentio meditatus est, cogitans: “Quid refert si non mendaces es? Quod dixisti fortasse non eveniet…”

unit.source: He then returned to the hall, assuming a cross-legged position opposite the other two deputy hosts.
unit.target: Deinde ad atrium rediit, sedens cruribus contractis contraposito duobus ministris vicariis.

unit.source: As time passed, midnight arrived, marking the completion of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Tempus fugit, et media nox advenit, signans completionem Annuli Reginae Maris.

unit.source: One of the deputy hosts retrieved it and guided it to the basement in the dim moonlight.
unit.target: Unus ex ministris vicariis id recepit et ad cellam sub lunari lumine tenuo duxit.

unit.source: The moment had come to pay homage to their ancestors.
unit.target: Tempus maiorum honorandum advenit.

unit.source: Lumian observed the scene in silence and suddenly had a thought.
unit.target: Lumian silentio scenam observavit et subito rem cogitavit.

unit.source: 571 Key Details
unit.target: 571 Notae Praecipuae

unit.source: 571 Key Details
unit.target: 571 Notae Praecipuae

unit.source: The Governor of the Sea’s residence hall opened into a labyrinth of rooms, its scarcity of windows allowing only a trickle of light despite the crimson moon’s glow.
unit.target: Aedes Gubernatoris Maris in labyrinthum concluum patebat, quarum fenestrarum raritas solummodo tenuam lucis stillam concedebat, non obstante splendore lunaris rubrae.

unit.source: The dimness cast a cloak of silence over the place.
unit.target: Tenebrae velut pallium silentii super locum tegebant.

unit.source: Even as the deputy host, clutching the coveted Ring of the Sea Queen, moved with caution, the floor still betrayed him with a faint echo.
unit.target: Etiam dum vice hospitis, annulum desideratum Reginae Maris tenens, cum cautela movebatur, pavimentum tamen eum tenuo sonitu prodidit.

unit.source: Lumian observed him heading towards the basement staircase, a sudden realization dawning upon him.
unit.target: Lumian eum ad scalam subterraneam properantem observavit, atque subito lumen intellegentiae in eo apparuit.

unit.source: Once in the basement, the deputy host could effortlessly switch the authentic Ring of the Sea Queen with a crafted counterfeit without alerting anyone.
unit.target: Cum in subterraneo adfuisset, vice hospitis sine labore authenticum annulum Reginae Maris cum artificiose annulo falso commutare potuit, neminem admonens.

unit.source: The other deputies were occupied in the hall, and the Governor of the Sea, undergoing physical modifications, had the Maidens of the Sea by his side.
unit.target: Alii vice hospites in atrio occupabantur, et Gubernator Maris, mutationes corporales subiens, puellas maris ad latus habebat.

unit.source: The sea spawn were scattered elsewhere.
unit.target: Proles maris alibi dispersae erant.

unit.source: Frowning, Lumian shot a sidelong glance at another deputy host.
unit.target: Frons contrita, Lumian alium vice hospitis latere intuitum dedit.

unit.source: He lowered his voice and addressed Jorge, the form Juan Oro had taken, in Intisian.
unit.target: Vox demissa, Lumian Iorgem—formam quam Iuan Oro assumpsit—in lingua Intisiana allocutus est.

unit.source: “Every year, during the vigil ritual, does a deputy host send the Ring of the Sea Queen alone to the basement, retrieving it an hour later?”
unit.target: "Quotannis, in ritu vigiliae, num vice hospitis solus annulum Reginae Maris ad subterraneum mittit ac post unum horam recipit?"

unit.source: He stressed the word “alone.”
unit.target: Verbum "solus" sublineavit.

unit.source: Juan Oro nodded subtly.
unit.target: Iuan Oro leniter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes. There’s no need for extra protection in this building…”
unit.target: "Ita. In hoc aedificio non est opus praesidio addito…"

unit.source: But just as Juan Oro was about to continue, he halted abruptly.
unit.target: Sed, ut Iuan Oro pergere paratus esset, subito cessavit.

unit.source: This presented a golden opportunity to swap the Ring of the Sea Queen unnoticed.
unit.target: Hoc occasio aurea apparuit, ut annulum Reginae Maris inobservate commutaretur.

unit.source: The fact that external enemies couldn’t breach the building didn’t mean the deputy hosts within were without their own problems!
unit.target: Quod hostes externos aedificium penetrare non poterant, non significat vice hospites in eo nullas proprias difficultates habere!

unit.source: Lumian wasted no time and turned to Juan Oro, uttering, “Should I follow, or will you take charge?”
unit.target: Lumian pro viribus non moratus est et ad Iuan Oro se vertit, dicens: "Sequarne, an tu officio fungaris?"

unit.source: Juan Oro regarded the matter gravely, rising from his seat and responding, “I’ll go.”
unit.target: Iuan Oro rem graviter contemplatus, ex sede surgens respondit: "Eo."

unit.source: Harnessing his abilities, he steadied himself and swiftly caught up with the deputy host.
unit.target: Virtutibus suis utendo se firmavit atque celeriter vice hospitem adiit.

unit.source: In a deep tone, he stated, “Let’s go together. I want to seize the chance to pay my respects to my ancestors.”
unit.target: In voce profunda, dixit: "Eamus simul. Volo occasionem capere ut maioribus meis reverentiam tribuam."

unit.source: The other deputy host raised no objections.
unit.target: Alter vice hospitis nullae objectiones attulit.

unit.source: As Lumian observed the two lighting their lanterns and descending into the basement, his mind instinctively filled in the upcoming sequence.
unit.target: Dum Lumian eos, qui lanternas accendebant et in subterraneum descendebant, observabat, mens eius instinctive sequentiam futura praevidit.

unit.source: Place the Ring of the Sea Queen on the decrepit stone platform… Offer prayers to the ancestors… Return to the surface… Re-enter and retrieve it an hour later…
unit.target: Colloca annulum Reginae Maris in vetustam lapideam suggestum… Ora pro maioribus… Redi ad superficiem… Reintroe et post unam horam recipias…

unit.source: During that hour, the Ring of the Sea Queen sits unguarded in the basement, vulnerable to any opportunistic interference…
unit.target: Per eam horam, annulus Reginae Maris in subterraneo incustoditus sedet, vulnerabilis ad quamlibet interventionem opportunisticam…

unit.source: If someone had concealed themselves there beforehand, swapping the genuine ring for a counterfeit would be a straightforward task…
unit.target: Si quis ibi antea se celaverit, genuinum annulum pro falso commutare munus facile esset…

unit.source: Certainly, infiltrating and concealing oneself in this location is no simple feat.
unit.target: Certe, in hoc loco se infiltrare atque celare non est res simplex.

unit.source: I can’t even do it; I could last a mere two minutes before being detected by the sea spawn…
unit.target: Non possum quidem; tantum duo minuta vigeam antequam a prole maris detegarer.

unit.source: The Ring of the Sea Queen has to be positioned on that worn stone platform.
unit.target: Annulus Reginae Maris in illa lapsa lapideae suggestu poni debet.

unit.source: Any deviations—deviations…
unit.target: Quaecumque aberrationes—aberrationes…

unit.source: With these thoughts swirling in his mind, Lumian suddenly recalled the transformations in the Lie earring when it rested on the weathered stone platform in the basement.
unit.target: His cogitationibus in mente circumvolantibus, Lumian subito meminit mutationum in anulo "Lie" cum in lapsa lapideae suggestu subterraneo quiesceret.

unit.source: The Seer pathway item had activated a pattern embodying an Apprentice and a Marauder, granting it the ability to siphon someone’s power that lasted half a month!
unit.target: Res semitis "Seer" exemplar activavit, in quo repraesentabantur discipulus atque praedon, tribuens facultatem ut potentiam alicui subtraheret, quae per dimidium mensem duraret!

unit.source: Lie could accomplish this feat, but what about the Ring of the Sea Queen?
unit.target: "Lie" hoc assequi potuit, sed quid de Annulo Reginae Maris?

unit.source: Though not an item of the Seer, Apprentice, or Marauder pathway, it had been meticulously crafted based on a ritual passed down by an Amon.
unit.target: Quamquam non fuit pars itineris "Seer", discipuli aut praedonis, ex subtili artificio confecta, secundum ritum Amonis traditum.

unit.source: Perhaps, over time, it could activate the unique characteristics of the basement, gradually assimilating with thieving qualities.
unit.target: Forsitan, tempore, proprietates unicas subterranei activescere posset, paulatim virtutibus furandi coniungens.

unit.source: Yes! Considering that the essence of the sea sacrificial ritual involves extracting power from the seal at the bottom of the sea and claiming it, the Ring of the Sea Queen, being a key item, should not only be capable of loosening the seal to a certain extent but also possess the power‐stealing ability.
unit.target: Ita! Cum essentia rituum sacrificii maris includat potentiam ex sigillo in fundo maris extrahendam atque postea appropriandam, Annulus Reginae Maris, res clavis existens, debet non solum posse sigillum ad aliquo gradu solvere, sed etiam facultatem potentiam furandi habere.

unit.source: It could distribute the gains among various participants in the ritual—
unit.target: Potest utilitates distribuere inter variis ritu participantibus—

unit.source: the host receiving the most, followed by the Maidens of the Sea as assistant hosts, and the deputy hosts and sailors gaining some within the ritual’s range, provided they possessed similar powers!
unit.target: Hospes, qui plurimum accipit, deinde puellae maris ut hospites adiutores, atque vice hospites et nautae nonnullum in ambitu ritu capientes, dummodo potentias similes haberent!

unit.source: In essence, Juan Oro and his companions’ understanding of the ring-making ritual is incomplete.
unit.target: In essentia, intellectus Iuan Oro et comitum suorum de ritu annuli conficiendi imperfectus est.

unit.source: The “paying homage to the ancestors” segment is integral and crucial.
unit.target: Segmentum "maioribus honorem referendi" integrum atque cruciale est.

unit.source: Without honoring the ancestors, the sea sacrificial ritual would merely open the seal without stealing the accumulated power.
unit.target: Sine maiorum honore, rituum sacrificii maris tantum sigillum aperiret, potentiam accumulata non subtraheret.

unit.source: Instead, it would erupt and disperse…
unit.target: Contra, erupturum esset atque dispergeretur…

unit.source: Lumian had just marveled at the mysticism’s terrifying complexity when a sudden alarm gripped him.
unit.target: Lumian modo de terribili mysticismi complexitate admiratus erat, cum subito clamor eum obsedit.

unit.source: He realized he had overlooked a pivotal detail.
unit.target: Intellexit se rem cardinalem neglectum esse.

unit.source: According to Madam Magician’s interpretation of the Ring of the Sea Queen’s functions and her speculations about the essence of the entire sea prayer ritual, the substitution of the genuine Ring of the Sea Queen with the fake ring customized by April Fool’s in Torres should have prevented the catastrophic phenomenon of the sea’s fury consuming the Governor of the Sea, all the deputy hosts, and some sailors in the subsequent ritual!
unit.target: Secundum interpretationem Dominae Magicarum de functionibus Annuli Reginae Maris atque de speculationibus ejus circa essentiam totius rituum precationis maris, substitutio genuini Annuli Reginae Maris cum annulo falso ab April Fool’s in Torres more confecto, debuisset praecavere phenomenon catastrophicum furoris maritimi, qui Gubernatorem Maris, omnes vice hospites, atque aliquos nautas in ritu subsequente consumeret!

unit.source: The fake ring hadn’t undergone the initial ring-making ritual, leaving its patterns, symbols, and structure devoid of the necessary mysticism characteristics.
unit.target: Annulus falsus initium ritu annuli conficiendi non passa fuit, relinquens figuras, symbola, et structuram, quae proprietatibus mysticis necessariis carebant.

unit.source: Even if the Governor of the Sea recited the prescribed words, he couldn’t infuse energy into it to open the seal!
unit.target: Etiamsi Gubernator Maris verba praescripta recitasset, in eum energiam infundere ad sigillum aperiendum non potuit!

unit.source: As a complete counterfeit, it shouldn’t have triggered any phenomena.
unit.target: Ut falsum completum, nullum phaenomenon excitare debebat.

unit.source: However, due to its incapacity to extract the amassed power, the sea area would experience more shipwrecks, and the weather would deteriorate.
unit.target: Attamen, ex eius impotentia potentiam cumulativam extrahendi, zona maris plura naufragia ferret, et tempestas deterioraretur.

unit.source: To align with the events of the previous year, the fake ring thrown by the Governor of the Sea had to complete the first part of the ring-making ritual.
unit.target: Ad eventus anni praeteriti congruendos, annulus falsus a Gubernatore Maris iactus primam partem ritu annuli conficiendi perficere debebat.

unit.source: Still, without being placed in the basement to honor the ancestor, it could only partially open the seal, unable to extract and monopolize the gathered power.
unit.target: Nisi in subterraneo ad maiorum honorem collocaretur, solum parcie sigillum aperire potuit, atque potentiam cumulativam extrahi et monopolizari non potuit.

unit.source: This incomplete process led to a sudden eruption, causing the sea to “rage”!
unit.target: Hic processus incompletus ad repentinam eruptionem duxit, quod mare "iratum" efficiebat!

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed slightly.
unit.target: Lumiani oculi leviter angustati sunt.

unit.source: As a Conspirer, he had seized the core of the matter.
unit.target: Ut conspirator, nucleum rei apprehendit.

unit.source: Two Rings of the Sea Queen were on the ship, but both were fakes.
unit.target: Duo Annuli Reginae Maris in nave erant, sed ambo falsi erant.

unit.source: The ring brought by the deputy host to the ritual ship was also a forgery.
unit.target: Annulus a vice hospitis ad navem caerimonialem delatus quoque falsum erat.

unit.source: In fact, the authentic Ring of the Sea Queen hadn’t made an appearance during last year’s sea prayer ritual!
unit.target: Revera, annulus authenticus Reginae Maris anno praeterito in ritu precationis maris non apparuit!

unit.source: The genuine Ring of the Sea Queen, which had undergone the entire ring‐making ritual as per the Fisheries Guild’s knowledge, hadn’t been placed on the stone platform in the basement to fulfill the ritual of honoring the ancestors.
unit.target: Annulus genuinus Reginae Maris, qui totum ritu annuli conficiendi iuxta scientiam Collegii Piscarii passa est, in suggestu lapideo subterraneo ad ritum maiorum honorandum non positus est.

unit.source: Consequently, it was also a sham—a counterfeit ring lacking the most crucial effect!
unit.target: Ergo etiam mendacium erat—annulus falsus, effectum maximi carens!

unit.source: The deputy host who had taken the Ring of the Sea Queen into the basement and retrieved it last year might also be part of the problem!
unit.target: Vice hospitis, qui annulum Reginae Maris in subterraneum delatus et anno praeterito receptus est, fortasse etiam pars quaestionis erat!

unit.source: The peripheral members affiliated with April Fool’s weren’t considered trustworthy.
unit.target: Membra lateralia cum April Fool’s affiliata non habebantur fideles.

unit.source: Their actions likely didn’t disrupt the overall plan.
unit.target: Eorum agendi ratio verisimiliter consilium universale non perturbavit.

unit.source: The fake ring concealed in the lamb’s stomach and the Bard’s performance likely served as preparations for subsequent investigations, camouflaging vital clues.
unit.target: Annulus falsus, in ventre agni celatus, atque spectaculum Bardi, verisimiliter praeparationes ad investigationes ulteriores ferebant, occultantes claves vitales.

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, Juan Oro and the deputy host returned to the hall.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani celeriter erant, Iuan Oro et vice hospitis in atrium redierunt.

unit.source: “It’s on the stone platform,” whispered the president of the Fisheries Guild, masquerading as Jorge, to Lumian.
unit.target: "In suggestu lapideo est," susurravit praeses Collegii Piscarii, sub specie Iorgi, ad Lumian.

unit.source: Lumian refocused his attention and casually inquired, “Who was responsible for sending the Ring of the Sea Queen to the basement last year?”
unit.target: Lumian attentionem refecit atque leviter interrogavit: "Quis annulum Reginae Maris ad subterraneum anno praeterito misit?"

unit.source: “I don’t know. Without any special arrangements, anyone can do it. The four deputy hosts in the hall last year died in the sea’s rage when the ritual failed.” Juan Oro, sensing Lumian’s suspicion, clarified.
unit.target: "Nescio. Sine aliquibus ordinationibus specialibus, quisquis id facere potest. Quattuor vice hospites in atrio anno praeterito in ira maris perierunt, cum ritu naufragavit," Iuan Oro, Lumiani suspicere sentiens, explanavit.

unit.source: Dead? Unlikely… Lumian lacked the corresponding item for spirit channeling and didn’t have time to search for it.
unit.target: "Mortui? Improbabile… Lumian rem idoneam ad spiritum canalizandum deesse sensit neque tempus in quaerendo habuit."

unit.source: All he could do was ask, “Which one of them was familiar with the ring‐making ritual and knows the details of the Ring of the Sea Queen?”
unit.target: Omnia quae ei possent fieri erant, rogare: "Quis eorum ritu annuli conficiendi peritus fuit et singula Annuli Reginae Maris novit?"

unit.source: “None of them; it was their first time serving as deputy hosts.” Juan Oro shook his head. “Besides, as I said, those who know these secrets are still alive.”
unit.target: "Nullus ex illis; primum tempus fuerunt in munere vice hospitum." Iuan Oro caput concussit. "Praeterea, ut dixi, qui has arcanas norunt, adhuc vivunt."

unit.source: If the deputy host wasn’t Ultraman… Then who was it? Lumian’s mind raced as he arrived at a conclusion.
unit.target: Si vice hospitis non erat Ultraman… Ergo quis erat? Mens Lumiani celeriter volitavit, ad solutionem perveniens.

unit.source: It was Mad Lady!
unit.target: Erat Domina Insana!

unit.source: Similar to Bard, she utilized the same technique to alter her appearance.
unit.target: Similiter Bardo, eam eandem technicam ad formam mutandam usus est.

unit.source: With Ultraman’s assistance, she assumed the guise of a deputy host, completing the final step in creating the Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Cum auxilio Ultraman, speciem vice hospitis assumpsit, gradum ultimum in creatione Annuli Reginae Maris perficiens.

unit.source: Then, she boarded the ceremonial ship with it.
unit.target: Deinde, cum eo, in navem caerimonialem conscendit.

unit.source: Lumian had been puzzled by how Mad Lady could locate the special sea and rescue Bard accurately and in time.
unit.target: Lumian mirabatur quomodo Domina Insana mare speciale invenire et Bardum tempore ac recte servare posset.

unit.source: Now, he had the answer.
unit.target: Nunc responsum habebat.

unit.source: Mad Lady was present on the ceremonial ship, right beside Bard.
unit.target: Domina Insana in navem caerimonialem praesens erat, prope Bardum.

unit.source: There was no need for coordinated locations or timing!
unit.target: Non erant necessariae coordinationes locorum aut temporum!

unit.source: Initially suspecting Mad Lady to collaborate with Bard, Lumian now realized that Bard worked with Mad Lady, providing assistance in case of unexpected developments and shouldering the responsibility of misleading investigations.
unit.target: Primum suspicatus, putans Domina Insanam cum Bardo collaborare, nunc Lumian intellexit Bardum cum Domina Insana cooperari, auxilium ferens in casibus repentinis eventuum atque onus contra investigationes fallaces suscipit.

unit.source: “Dammit, Faceless abilities are so annoying. April Fool’s is so annoying!”
unit.target: "Eheu, facultates 'Faceless' tam infestantes sunt. 'April Fool’s' etiam valde infestans est!"

unit.source: Lumian’s emotions fluctuated as he struggled to contain his emotions as he cursed.
unit.target: Affectus Lumiani fluctuabant, dum se continere conabatur, maledictus.

unit.source: Relying on his Ascetic trait, he restrained himself from erupting.
unit.target: Indolem asceticam amplectens, se ab eruptione cohibuit.

unit.source: More importantly, while he had unraveled the issues with the sea prayer ritual from last year, the identities of Ultraman and the forthcoming plans of April Fool’s remained elusive.
unit.target: Praeterea, cum quaestiones rituum precationis maris anni praeteriti elucidaverat, identitates Ultraman et consilia ventura April Fool’s adhuc incerta manebant.

unit.source: The night passed in silence.
unit.target: Nox silentio transivit.

unit.source: On an out-of-fashion sailboat in the harbor, Charname, sporting a short, round‑rimmed felt hat, emerged from the cabin and approached Nolfi, who stood at the edge of the deck.
unit.target: In navicula velae obsoleta in portu, Charname, pileum breveum et rotundum habens, ex cella emersit et Nolfi accessit, quae in margine navis stabat.

unit.source: Charname inquired, “Can we enter those special waters if we set off now?”
unit.target: Charname interrogavit: "Possumusne in has aquas speciales intrare, si nunc proficiscamur?"

unit.source: Nolfi nodded, responding, “Yes, the stars will align in a specific pattern after midnight.”
unit.target: Nolfi annuit, respondens: "Ita, astra post medium noctis in certo ordine congruentur."

unit.source: Following Lumian’s instructions, she and Batna had rented a boat for a few days from other ports along the same coastline.
unit.target: Secundum praecepta Lumiani, illa et Batna naviculam paucorum dierum ex aliis portubus iuxta eandem oram locaverunt.

unit.source: Charname chuckled, saying, “Then let’s set off!”
unit.target: Charname subridens dixit: "Ergo proficiscamur!"

unit.source: Observing the surprised and puzzled expressions of Nolfi and Batna, he explained, “If we follow the Governor of the Sea’s ceremonial ship, we’ll undoubtedly be discovered by the Fisheries Guild. Setting off an hour or two later would be meaningless. Therefore, we’ll go ahead of time and hide there, patiently waiting for an opportunity!”
unit.target: Observans vultus Nolfi et Batna insperatos et perplexos, explicavit: "Si navem caerimonialem Gubernatoris Maris sequamur, certo ab Collegio Piscario inveniemur. Proficiscere post unam vel duas horas inutilis erit. Ergo, ante tempus proficiscemur atque ibi nos abscondemus, opportunitatem patienter exspectantes!"

unit.source: Although Nolfi didn’t understand the nature of the opportunity Charname referred to, she didn’t inquire.
unit.target: Quamquam Nolfi naturam opportunitatis a Charname allatae non intellexit, quaerere non audebat.

unit.source: She responded with anticipation, “Okay.”
unit.target: Ea cum exspectatione respondit: "Bene."

unit.source: Charname then turned to Batna.
unit.target: Deinde, Charname ad Batnam se converterit.

unit.source: “Are you joining us? It will be very dangerous.”
unit.target: "Ne nobiscum iungis? Valde periculosum erit."

unit.source: Batna’s expression fluctuated. After more than ten seconds, he declared, “I’m going!”
unit.target: Aspectus Batnae fluctuavit. Post paulo plus quam decem secundas, declaravit: "Eo!"

unit.source: Charname clicked his tongue but remained silent.
unit.target: Charname linguam frotavit, sed tacitus mansit.

unit.source: At that moment, Nolfi frowned, glancing at other parts of the deck, and asked, “What about the sailors here? We can’t leave the sea without them, and they can’t handle too much danger.”
unit.target: Illo momento, Nolfi fronem contraxit, alias partes navis intuens, et rogavit: "Quid de nautae hic? Mare sine illis relinquere nequeunt, nec nimium pericula sustinere possunt."

unit.source: Charname chuckled.
unit.target: Charname subridens risum edidit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry, we have sailors who can handle danger.”
unit.target: "Noli sollicitus esse, nautae habemus qui periculum ferre possunt."

unit.source: As soon as he finished speaking, he half‑turned, raising his right hand to the third level of the cabin.
unit.target: Ut loquendi finem pervenisset, ad dimidium conversus, dextram manum ad tertium cellae gradum levavit.

unit.source: He clasped his index finger and thumb into a ring and extended his other three fingers.
unit.target: Digitum indicem et pollicem in anulo coartavit, et tres reliquos digitos protendit.

unit.source: Soon, the captain, first mate, second mate, and all the sailors emerged, their eyes tightly shut.
unit.target: Statim, capitaneus, primus adiutor navis, secundus adiutor, et omnes nautae apparuerunt, oculi arcte clausi.

unit.source: Like sleepwalkers, they lined up and walked down the gangway toward the docks.
unit.target: Velut sonambuli, ordinati se congregaverunt atque per navis scala descendentes ad molas pervenerunt.

unit.source: Batna and Nolfi’s eyes froze, as if trapped in a terrifying dream.
unit.target: Oculi Batnae et Nolfi congelaverunt, quasi in somnio terribili captivis essent.

unit.source: 572 The Real Target
unit.target: 572 Meta Vera

unit.source: 572 The Real Target
unit.target: 572 Meta Vera

unit.source: Under the crimson moonlight, the crew members stumbled towards the dock like the living dead, moving towards the various buildings concealed in the darkness.
unit.target: Sub luce lunari coccinea, nautae titubaverunt ad molam, ut mortui vivos, incedentes ad varia aedificia tenebris celata.

unit.source: In seven to eight minutes, their figures vanished from different spots.
unit.target: In septem ad octo minuta, figurae eorum ex variis locis evanuerunt.

unit.source: Immediately after, Nolfi and Batna observed pitch‐black shapes emerging at the edge of the cabin, and eerie pale‐white or dark‐green flames igniting across the deck.
unit.target: Statim post, Nolfi et Batna conspexerunt formas nigerrimas emergentes ad limitem cubiculi, atque ignes pallide albi vel obscuri viridi in ponte accendentes.

unit.source: Figures crawled out of the pitch‐black flames.
unit.target: Figurae ex ignibus nigerrimis reperebant.

unit.source: Some wore tattered clothes, and their skin visibly rotted.
unit.target: Aliqui vestimenta lacerata gerebant, et cutis eorum manifeste putrida erat.

unit.source: Others were white bones with fragments of flesh hanging from them.
unit.target: Alii erant ossa alba, ex quibus fragmenta carnis pendent.

unit.source: Pale‐white flames protruded from their eye sockets.
unit.target: Flammae pallide albae ex orbibus eorum protulere.

unit.source: These were all corpses!
unit.target: Haec omnes cadavera erant!

unit.source: Soon, a half‐rotted corpse in a dirty jacket hoisted the sail.
unit.target: Mox, cadaver semi putrescens in veste sordida, velum sublevavit.

unit.source: The corpse with a missing breastbone stowed the heavy anchor.
unit.target: Cadaver, cui sternum deesset, gravem ancora condidit.

unit.source: The other corpses took their positions, steering the sailboat slowly away from the port.
unit.target: Ceteri cadavera loca sua ceperunt, navem velariam lente a portu regentes.

unit.source: As they gazed at the decaying flesh, pale‐white bones, and sinister flames of different hues, Batna and Nolfi felt as if they had stepped into a novel world.
unit.target: Dum carnem putrescendam, ossa pallide alba, atque ignes sinistros variis coloribus intuentes erant, Batna et Nolfi quasi in novum orbem intratos se sensere.

unit.source: Horror novels! Ghostly tales!
unit.target: Fabulae horroris! Fabulae umbratæ!

unit.source: “Navigator, it’s time for you to work.”
unit.target: “Navigator, tempus est tibi laborare.”

unit.source: Charname’s voice snapped Nolfi back to reality.
unit.target: Vox Charname Nolfi ad veram realitatem revocavit.

unit.source: In the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: In domo Praefecti Maris.

unit.source: Lumian leaned against the statue‐less wall, surveying the other deputy hosts in the hall, including Juan Oro.
unit.target: Lumian in pariete sine statua recubuit, alios hospites vicarii in aula conspiciens, inter quos erat Juan Oro.

unit.source: Uncertain if any of them were genuine, they could easily be impersonated by a Faceless.
unit.target: Nesciens num quisque eorum genuinus esset, facile ab aliquo, qui faciem careret, imitari poterantur.

unit.source: In the upcoming operation, the only person he could unequivocally trust was himself.
unit.target: In operatione futura, sola persona cui sine dubio fidere poterat, ipse erat.

unit.source: An hour passed in an indescribable silence.
unit.target: Hora in silentio ineffabili transiit.

unit.source: This time, Lumian took the initiative, leading Juan Oro into the basement to retrieve the Ring of the Sea Queen, completing the “paying homage to the ancestors” segment.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian inceptum tulit, ducens Juan Oro in cellam subterraneam ad recuperandum Anulum Reginæ Maris, complens partem "honorem maiorum ferendi."

unit.source: The ring rested on the dilapidated stone platform, untouched.
unit.target: Anulus requiebat super suggestum lapideum dilapidatum, intactus.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t be certain if it was authentic, but the patterns, symbols, and structure seemed intact, and no one had lurked in the basement after inspection.
unit.target: Lumian certiorem esse non potuit utrum authentica esset, sed figurae, symbola, atque structura intactae videbantur, nec quisquam post inspectionem in cella insidiatus est.

unit.source: Maintaining his calm demeanor and a tense heart, Lumian patiently waited until 6 a.m., feeling both mental and physical fatigue dissipate.
unit.target: Conservans tranquillitatem animi et corde tensum, Lumian patienter exspectavit usque ad 6 mane, sentiens tam mentis quam corporis lassitudinem evanescere.

unit.source: Two hours later, the current Governor of the Sea, Simon, exited the vigil room with four Maidens of the Sea and approached the building’s door.
unit.target: Duo hora post, praefectus Maris hodiernus, Simon, cum quattuor puellārum Maris ex conclavi vigiliae exiit et ad ianuam aedificii accessit.

unit.source: Lumian, Juan Oro, and the other deputy hosts promptly stood up and followed.
unit.target: Lumian, Juan Oro, et ceteri hospites vicarii mox surrexerunt et accesserunt.

unit.source: The two‐story sailboat, adorned with colorful flowers, docked at the Milo Village’s docks.
unit.target: Navis velaria duotabulata, floribus variis ornata, in molibus vici Milo apposita est.

unit.source: Villagers acted as guards, blocking anyone daring to approach.
unit.target: Incolae ut custodes fungebantur, impeditendo quemquam adpropinquare audentem.

unit.source: Ascending the gangway to the deck, Lumian sensed an invisible gaze from every window, flower, and mast—a familiar feeling from when the statues in the Governor of the Sea’s residence came to life.
unit.target: Ascendens ad pontem, Lumian sensit intuitum invisibile ab omni fenestra, flore, et mástre — sensus notus ex tempore quo statuae in domo Praefecti Maris in vitam redierant.

unit.source: He calmly navigated through the gazes, adhering to Juan Oro’s instructions to stand at the left edge of the deck.
unit.target: Tranquillē per intuitus navigavit, iuxta mandata Juan Oro ut ad sinistram partem pontis staret.

unit.source: This was the designated spot for him, the deputy host named Brian.
unit.target: Hoc erat locus destinatus sibi, hospiti vicario nominato Brian.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Pum! Pum! Pum!

unit.source: On the dock of Milo Village, vibrant paper fragments burst forth from ceremonial cannons, creating a colorful display.
unit.target: In molibus vici Milo, fragmenta chartacea vibrantia e tormentis caerimoniis erupta sunt, speciem coloribus multiplicibus creantes.

unit.source: Amid the festive atmosphere, the ship set sail gradually.
unit.target: Inter celebratam atmosphaeram, navis paulatim profectus est.

unit.source: It circled Port Santa, capturing the cheers and blessings of the people before venturing toward the distant sea.
unit.target: Circum Portum Santa vecta, laudes et benedictiones populi arripiens, antequam ad mare distante profectus est.

unit.source: As the navigator, Juan Oro guided the ship into a boundless azure sea with no discernible landmarks.
unit.target: Ut navarchus, Juan Oro navem in mare caeruleum immensum sine notabilibus signis duxit.

unit.source: They weaved between left and right turns, occasionally reversing direction.
unit.target: Inter sinistros et dexteros gyris intertexebant, interdum directionem invertentes.

unit.source: Nearly an hour passed, and beneath the clear, bright sky, dense fog suddenly enveloped the ship.
unit.target: Fere una hora pertransiit, et sub caelo claro ac nitido, densus nebula navem subito involvit.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: Within the fog’s depths, waves surged like mountains.
unit.target: In profundis nebulae, undae sicut montes eruperunt.

unit.source: Any ship it touched would capsize or shatter.
unit.target: Quaecumque navis attigeretur, subverteretur aut confringeretur.

unit.source: The Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea, some sailors, and the two deputy hosts, participating in the sea sacrificial segment for the first time, were terror‐stricken by the ominous scene, their faces paling.
unit.target: Praefectus Maris, puellae Maris, quidam nautae, atque duo hospites vicarii, primum in sacrificio maritimo participantes, territi sunt a scena minaci, atque vultus eorum pallidi facti sunt.

unit.source: For Juan Oro, a veteran of many sea sacrifices, it seemed like he was observing a child’s plaything.
unit.target: Pro Juan Oro, veterano multorum sacrificiorum maritimorum, quasi lusum puerile observare videbatur.

unit.source: He directed the sailors with no emotional fluctuations, guiding the ship along the only safe sea route through the thick fog and exaggerated waves.
unit.target: Nautas, sine fluctuatione animi, imperavit; navem duxit per unicam viam maritimam tutam, per densam nebulam et undas amplificatas.

unit.source: After an unknown duration, the fog lifted, and the tidal waves miraculously subsided.
unit.target: Post tempus ignotum, nebula sublata est, et undae aestuosae mirabiliter remissae sunt.

unit.source: An ocean resembling sapphires unfolded before Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Oceanus, sapphiro similis, in conspectu Lumiani se explicavit.

unit.source: The sea appeared limitless, but the distance and sky were gray, with only a hint of sunlight seeping through.
unit.target: Mare interminabile apparuit, sed distantia et caelum cinereum erant, cum solis lumen modicum pertransiens.

unit.source: Port Santa, Solow Motel.
unit.target: Portus Santa, Solow Motel.

unit.source: Lugano stood by the window, observing as the citizens formed celebratory teams, weaving through streets and alleys, spreading their joy.
unit.target: Lugano ad fenestram stetit, observans cives turmas celebratorias formare, per vias et angustos intervalla ambulantes, laetitiam diffundentes.

unit.source: Having already taken Ludwig to witness the Governor of the Sea’s colorful flower boat ritual and participated in two spontaneous citizen‐led celebrations, Lugano returned to the suite as teatime approached.
unit.target: Iam Ludwig ducens ad videndum ritum navis florum coloratorum Praefecti Maris, et in duabus celebrationibus civium spontaneis participans, Lugano ad conclave rediit, dum tempus teae appropinquabat.

unit.source: There, he provided Ludwig with food he had purchased and prepared in advance.
unit.target: Ibi Ludwig cibum, quem antea emerat et praeparaverat, suppeditavit.

unit.source: I could still head out later.
unit.target: Postea adhuc exire potero.

unit.source: When the Governor of the Sea returns, another wave of celebrations will ensue.
unit.target: Cum Praefectus Maris redierit, alia unda celebrationum sequetur.

unit.source: Unfortunately, I can’t engage with the enthusiastic Feynapotter girls with such a child in tow… Lugano thought regretfully.
unit.target: Infeliciter, non possum implicari cum puellis Feynapotter ardentibus, habenti tale puerum… Lugano tristiter cogitavit.

unit.source: At that moment, a knock echoed on the door.
unit.target: Illo momento, pulsus ad ianuam resonavit.

unit.source: “Who is it?”
unit.target: “Quis est?”

unit.source: Lugano, a seasoned bounty hunter, heightened his guard.
unit.target: Lugano, venator peritus praedae, cautelam suam auget.

unit.source: “It’s me.”
unit.target: “Ego sum.”

unit.source: A gentle voice emanated from outside the door.
unit.target: Vox mitis extra ianuam effulsit.

unit.source: Lugano recognized her as Rubió Paco’s wife, Madame Giorgia.
unit.target: Lugano eam agnovit ut uxorem Rubió Paco, Domina Giorgia.

unit.source: She’s here to see the boss?
unit.target: Adestne ut dominum videat?

unit.source: Has something happened to the Paco family again?
unit.target: Numquid alia res accidit familiae Paco?

unit.source: Lugano glanced at Ludwig, who was eating earnestly, and quickly walked to the door and opened it.
unit.target: Lugano adspicuit Ludovicum, qui studiosus edebat, et celeriter ad ianuam processit eamque aperuit.

unit.source: Giorgia, not clad in her usual glamorous attire, wore a black dress akin to that of an old widowed matriarch.
unit.target: Giorgia, non induta habitu suo solito magnifico, sed veste atra, similis matrona vidua antiqua, erat.

unit.source: Her long, disheveled brown hair was in disarray, and her thick azure eyes betrayed an unmistakable fear and panic.
unit.target: Capilli eius longi et inconditi fusci erant dissoluti, et oculi eius densi caerulei timorem et metum manifestum prodiderunt.

unit.source: “Where’s Monsieur Louis Berry?” the lady inquired.
unit.target: “Ubi est Domine Louis Berry?” inquit illa.

unit.source: “He’s participating in various celebrations for the sea prayer ritual,” Lugano fabricated an excuse.
unit.target: “Ille in variis celebrationibus pro ritu orationis maritimae participat,” Lugano excusationem fingi conatus est.

unit.source: He observed the distressed Madame Giorgia and instinctively inquired with concern, “Did something happen?”
unit.target: Illam Dominam Giorgiam affectam observavit, et instinctive cum sollicitudine percontatus est, “Acciditne aliquid?”

unit.source: Giorgia stammered, panic and fear evident in her eyes.
unit.target: Giorgia balbutivit, cum metu et panico manifestis in oculis suis.

unit.source: “I discovered the true identity of that humanoid lizard!”
unit.target: “Veram identitatem illius lacertae humanoidis detexi!”

unit.source: That humanoid lizard? The one the boss killed?
unit.target: Illam lacertam humanoidem? Illam, quam dominus occidit?

unit.source: Amidst Lugano’s confusion, Giorgia suddenly threw herself into his arms.
unit.target: In medio confusionis Lugani, Giorgia subito se in eius bracchia iacuit.

unit.source: The fragrance permeated Lugano’s senses, momentarily hindering him from immediately pushing the madam away.
unit.target: Fragrans odor sensibus Lumiani pervadit, eum per momentum impediens ne eam statim repuleret.

unit.source: Giorgia suppressed her voice but couldn’t conceal her fear.
unit.target: Giorgia vocem repressit, sed timorem suum non potuit celare.

unit.source: “That humanoid lizard was my husband, Rubió Paco!”
unit.target: “Illo lacerta humanoide erat maritus meus, Rubió Paco!”

unit.source: “Huh?”
unit.target: “Heu?”

unit.source: Lugano was both surprised and bewildered.
unit.target: Lugano et obstupefactus et attonitus erat.

unit.source: Giorgia gritted her teeth and explained, “The one you guys saw, it’s fake!”
unit.target: Giorgia dentes strinxit et explicavit, “Illum quem vidistis, falsum est!”

unit.source: Fake?
unit.target: Falsum?

unit.source: Someone impersonated Rubió Paco, and the real Rubió Paco had transformed into a humanoid lizard, killed by the boss?
unit.target: Aliquis Rubió Paco impersonatus est, et verus Rubió Paco in lacertam humanoidem conversus, a domino occisus est?

unit.source: As this realization struck Lugano, his thoughts suddenly slowed down.
unit.target: Cum haec ratio Lugani percussit, cogitationes eius subito retardatae sunt.

unit.source: The surroundings seemed coated in a glass‐like layer.
unit.target: Circumiecta videbantur quasi in strato vitreo obtecta.

unit.source: He instinctively struggled, but Giorgia held him tightly, interrupting him with various subtle actions.
unit.target: Eum naturali impulsu certabat, sed Giorgia eum arcte tenuit, variis subtilibus actionibus eum interrumpens.

unit.source: Ludwig, engrossed in devouring a skewer of roasted octopuses at the dining table, appeared oblivious to the unfolding silent drama at the door.
unit.target: Ludwig, in devorando acus octopodum assorum ad mensam occupatus, obliviscens apparuit de silentio dramatis scaenam ad ianuam evolutam.

unit.source: In a suite diagonally across the corridor, Rubió Paco sat quietly in a recliner, wearing a faint smile.
unit.target: In conclavi diagonaliter trans coridorium, Rubió Paco quiete in lecto reclinato sedebat, levem risum gerens.

unit.source: He had orchestrated the humanoid lizard incident and hired Louis Berry to resolve it intentionally.
unit.target: Illum casum lacertae humanoidae praeordinaverat et Ludovicum Berry conductum habuit ut id propositum dirimeret.

unit.source: Firstly, he aimed to confirm the other party’s identity.
unit.target: Primum, propositum erat identitatem alterius confirmare.

unit.source: Secondly, he wanted to leave a vulnerability in the Paco family’s handling of weak monsters, ensuring others wouldn’t suspect a Faceless’s involvement to confuse the target.
unit.target: Secundo, volebat relinquere vulnerabilitatem in modo tractandi familiae Paco monstrorum infirmorum, curans ut ceteri non suspicaret interventionem alicuius "sine facie" ad scopum confundendum.

unit.source: However, he abandoned the plan to deal with Louis Berry and refrained from triggering the corresponding trap.
unit.target: Tamen consilium de tractando Ludovico Berry derelinquit et a excitando insidias pertinentes abstinuit.

unit.source: This decision wasn’t due to uncertainty about the target’s identity; the Mysteries aura on Lumian Lee’s chest couldn’t escape his notice.
unit.target: Haec decisio non ex incertitudine de identitate scopi facta fuit; aura Mysteriorum in pectore Lumiani Lee non effugere potuit eius animadversioni.

unit.source: He was unlike others.
unit.target: Ille aliis differebat.

unit.source: Instead, he had a new plan.
unit.target: Contra, novum consilium habebat.

unit.source: The overall April Fool’s operation might not align with Loki’s personal objectives!
unit.target: Universa operatio Aprilis Stultorum fortasse non congruet cum propositis personalibus Loki!

unit.source: His current focus shifted to the young boy, Ludwig.
unit.target: Focus eius nunc ad puerum iuvenem, Ludwig, convertebatur.

unit.source: To him, a sealed demigod‐level powerhouse was a gift from the Celestial Worthy!
unit.target: Ei, vis semidei clausae, donum a Caelestibus Dignis, videbatur.

unit.source: No ritualistic target could be more suitable.
unit.target: Nullus scopus ritualis magis aptus esse potuit.

unit.source: Hence, he hinted at the sea anomaly, simultaneously confusing Lumian Lee and allowing him to connect the concepts of sealing and theft, understanding what occurred during last year’s prank.
unit.target: Ergo, innuit de anomalía maris, simul Lumian Lee confundens et concedens ei notionem sigillandi atque furtum coniungere, intellegens quid anno praeterito in ludibrio actum fuerat.

unit.source: He took the initiative to board the ship and head to the sea sacrifice grounds, enticing this formidable opponent away while another force restrained him.
unit.target: Initiativam cepit ad navem conscindendam et ad loca sacrificii maritimi iter facere, hunc hostem formidolosum alliciens, dum alia copia eum retinebat.

unit.source: Now, he was ready to execute a grand performance, captivating the attention of numerous Port Santa citizens!
unit.target: Nunc paratus erat ut magnam spectaculum exsequeretur, multorum civium Portus Santa attentionem arripiens!

unit.source: The calm, gem‐like sea held no waves.
unit.target: Mare placidum, quasi gemma, fluctus non habebat.

unit.source: The four Maidens of the Sea engaged in a brief sacrificial dance, while sailors carried offerings—lambs, roosters, ox heads, and more—from the cabin, stacking them at the bow.
unit.target: Quattuor puellae Maris in brevi saltatione sacrificatoria versabantur, dum nautae oblationes portabant—agnos, gallos, capita bos, et alia—ex cella ad proram congregantes.

unit.source: With the Ring of the Sea Queen in hand, Juan Oro approached the Governor of the Sea, awaiting the groom’s gift for the proposed marriage.
unit.target: Cum Anulo Reginæ Maris in manu, Juan Oro Praefectum Maris appropinquavit, dona sponsi pro nuptiis proposita exspectans.

unit.source: Lumian, vigilant of everyone present, scanned his surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian, omnes praesentes vigilant, circumiecta perlustavit.

unit.source: Any one of them could suddenly reveal themselves as Bard, Mad Lady, Ultraman, Loki, Hisoka, or a marionette.
unit.target: Quisquis eorum subito se manifestare posset ut Bard, Mad Lady, Ultraman, Loki, Hisoka, aut marionetta.

unit.source: The gentle, rhythmic dance concluded swiftly.
unit.target: Saltatio mitis et rhythmica statim confecta est.

unit.source: Juan Oro produced the peculiar golden ring, passing it to the incumbent Governor of the Sea, Simon Guiaro.
unit.target: Juan Oro anulum aureum insuetus prodidit, illud Praefecto Maris hodierno, Simone Guiaro, tradens.

unit.source: At that moment, a person emerged openly from the cabin.
unit.target: Illo momento, unus homo ex cella palam emersit.

unit.source: A woman in a black nun’s uniform and matching hat, her expression calm yet tinged with sadness.
unit.target: Femina in uniforme monialis nigro et pileo congruenti, vultu tranquillo sed tristitia tincto, erat.

unit.source: The surrounding sailors paid her no heed, as if she were invisible.
unit.target: Nautae circumstantēs eam non curaverunt, quasi invisa esset.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian’s pupils dilated, then constricted.
unit.target: Hoc videns, pupillae Lumiani dilatatae, dein contractae sunt.

unit.source: It was the source of Derangement!
unit.target: Fons perturbationis erat!

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact lost by the Eternal Blazing Sun Church!
unit.target: Artefactum sigillatum humanoide, a Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammei amissum!

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian comprehended two things.
unit.target: In momento, Lumian duas res intellexit.

unit.source: The Death Navigators, transformed Governors of the Sea, had coincidentally appeared near the Flying Bird, stirring colossal waves.
unit.target: Nāvīgātōrēs Mortis, Praefecti Maris mutati, casu apparuerunt prope Aves Volantem, undas colossales agitantēs.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact had unconsciously set out to sea, coincidentally choosing the same destination as him—Port Santa.
unit.target: Artefactum sigillatum humanoide inconscius in mare profectum erat, casu eundum ad eundem destinatum ut ipse—Portus Santa—eligens.

unit.source: There was a purpose behind this!
unit.target: Hoc re propositum erat!

unit.source: 573 Bard
unit.target: 573 Bard

unit.source: 573 Bard
unit.target: 573 Bard

unit.source: The woman in the black nun’s attire felt Lumian’s gaze, turning her head slightly and locking eyes with him.
unit.target: Femina in veste nigra monialis Lumiani aspectum sensit, caput parum vertens atque oculos cum eo iungens.

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze met hers, filled with indescribable colors, and the figure in his line of sight vanished.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani cum eius convenit, coloribus ineffabilibus saturatus, atque figura in eius conspectu evanuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian recognized the insignificance of this occurrence.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian insignificantiam huius eventus agnovit.

unit.source: It didn’t warrant further consideration.
unit.target: Non meruit ulteriorem considerationem.

unit.source: Beside the incumbent Governor of the Sea, Juan Oro noticed the once calm azure sea undulating.
unit.target: Iuxta gubernatorem maris praesens, Juan Oro, animadvertit mare, quod olim placidum caeruleum erat, nunc undulantem.

unit.source: In the gray sky, stars barely visible to the naked eye underwent changes, stirring an inexplicable throbbing and emotional shift within him.
unit.target: In caelo griseo, stellae, vix oculis nudis perceptae, mutationes passi sunt, excitantes in eo inexplicabilem palpitationem atque motum animi.

unit.source: An anomaly?
unit.target: Anomalia?

unit.source: Juan Oro couldn’t determine if it was good or bad.
unit.target: Juan Oro determinare non potuit utrum id bonum an malum esset.

unit.source: Given the circumstances, any change was treated as an accident, potentially caused by a hidden enemy.
unit.target: Ex circumstantiis, omnis mutatio quasi casus habebatur, fortasse ab hoste occulto orta.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he forcefully thrust the Ring of the Sea Queen into the hands of the incoming Governor of the Sea, Simon, growling, “Hurry up and marry the sea!”
unit.target: Sine mora, vi compulsa, anulum reginae maris in manus gubernatoris maris adventientis, Simone, rugiens, impellit: “Festina et mare coniunge!”

unit.source: In a moment of desperation, the president of the Fisheries Guild unintentionally failed to alter his voice to sound like Jorge.
unit.target: In momento desperationis, praeses Collegii Piscandi, casu, non potuit vocem suam mutare ut similis esset Jorge.

unit.source: However, his vocal cords had changed, making him sound younger than usual.
unit.target: Attamen, chordae vocales eius mutatae erant, facientes eum iuvenius quam solet sonare.

unit.source: Simon, taken aback by the shout, didn’t notice Juan Oro’s voice shift.
unit.target: Simon, clamore obstupefactus, mutationem vocis Juan Oro non animadvertit.

unit.source: He raised his hand, clutching the Ring of the Sea Queen, and recited, “I espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion!”
unit.target: Manum levavit, anulum reginae maris prehendens, atque recitavit: “Te coniugo, o mare, ut signum verae et perpetuae dominationis!”

unit.source: With that, he threw the unique golden ring.
unit.target: Hoc facto, anulum aureum unicum iecit.

unit.source: It trembled with light, its surface covered in a gentle glow.
unit.target: Illud luce tremens erat, et eius superficies lumine levi induta erat.

unit.source: As the Ring of the Sea Queen submerged, its glow intensified and expanded to the size of a baby before transforming into a cone of light, vanishing into the azure seawater.
unit.target: Cum anulus reginae maris submersus est, fulgor eius intensior factus est atque ad magnitudinem infanti expansus, antequam in conum lucis transformaretur, in aquam caeruleam evanuit.

unit.source: In the next moment, Juan Oro, Lumian, and the rest heard a deafening boom.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, Juan Oro, Lumian, et ceteri strepitum tonitruosum audiverunt.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: The sea boiled, unleashing huge waves that catapulted the colorful flower boat into the air.
unit.target: Mare ebullivit, immensas undas efferens, quae naviculam floribus variis ornatam in aethera proiecerunt.

unit.source: A destructive aura echoed in the surroundings.
unit.target: Aura destructiva in ambitu resonabat.

unit.source: Wh… The sea’s fury!
unit.target: Heu... furor maris!

unit.source: How could this happen?
unit.target: Quomodo hoc evenire potuit?

unit.source: Juan Oro’s pupils dilated in disbelief.
unit.target: Pupillae Juan Oro incredulitate dilatatae sunt.

unit.source: He couldn’t fathom that they had angered the sea again.
unit.target: Non potuit concipere quod iterum mare iratum haberent.

unit.source: It seemed like this year’s sea prayer ritual had failed once more.
unit.target: Videbatur ritu orationis maris huius anni iterum defuisse.

unit.source: He had meticulously followed every step, witnessing the placement of the Ring of the Sea Queen on the dilapidated stone platform representing the ancestors.
unit.target: Omnem viam diligenter secutus est, et testatus est anulum Reginæ Maris super lapsum podium lapideum, quod maiores repraesentabat, positum esse.

unit.source: He personally retrieved and guarded it with utmost vigilance.
unit.target: Ipse anulum recuperavit et summa diligentia custodivit.

unit.source: Everything went smoothly!
unit.target: Omnia sine impedimento processerunt!

unit.source: How could this be?
unit.target: Quomodo hoc fieri potuit?

unit.source: As the bridal boat teetered on the verge of capsizing, Juan Oro clenched his fists, and crystalline scales resembling starlight manifested on his body.
unit.target: Dum navicula nuptialis ad naufragium labebatur, Juan Oro manus constringit, et squamae crystallinae, quae luce stellarum similes erant, in corpore eius apparuerunt.

unit.source: His eyes darkened, resembling resplendent stars emerging within.
unit.target: Oculi eius obscurati sunt, instar stellarum splendidarum intus emergentium.

unit.source: He melded with the “sea.”
unit.target: Se cum mari coniunxit.

unit.source: The crashing sound abruptly ceased, and the majestic, terrifying azure waves froze in midair, as if held tightly by an unseen hand.
unit.target: Strepitus ruentis repente cessavit, et undae caeruleae, majestosae ac terribiles, in aere immobilatae sunt, quasi manu invisibili retentae.

unit.source: In Milo Village, within the cathedral-like Governor of the Sea’s building.
unit.target: In vico Milo, intra aedificium gubernatoris maris, quod simile cathedrali apparuit.

unit.source: The imposter Governor of the Sea, Miguel, lay in the servant’s room.
unit.target: Falsus gubernator maris, Miguel, in conclavi ministrorum iacebat.

unit.source: Suddenly, he sat up and leisurely rose from the bed, a self-satisfied smile playing on his face.
unit.target: Subito, se excitavit et ex lecto lente surrexit, cum in facie risu sibi ipsi satisfacto ludenti.

unit.source: Standing before a glass window overlooking the weeds outside, he muttered to himself, It’s almost time…
unit.target: Stans ante fenestram vitream, ex qua herbae foris conspicuae erant, submurmuravit: “Fere tempus est…”

unit.source: I wonder how Juan Oro will react when he discovers the sea sacrifice has failed again. Heh heh, this is payback for all the ‘care’ he’s given me over the past year.
unit.target: Miror quomodo Juan Oro reagat, cum inveniet sacrifaciem maris iterum defuisse. Heh heh, hoc est ultio pro omni cura, quam mihi per annum praeteritum dedit.

unit.source: What’s Loki up to?
unit.target: Quid Loki agit?

unit.source: Why the sudden deviation from the original plan?
unit.target: Cur subito a consilio originali discedit?

unit.source: Isn’t he concerned about potential accidents?
unit.target: Numquid non sollicitus est de eventibus fortuitis?

unit.source: Miguel—a key member of April Fool’s, Bard—had previously disguised himself as the sailor, Iru, and boarded the ship, escaping with Mad Lady when he jumped into the sea.
unit.target: Miguel—membrum clavis Aprilis Follis, Bard—olim se sub specie nautae, Iru, celavit et navigium conscendit, cum Mad Lady effugeret, in mare insiliens.

unit.source: Their plan over the course of the past year was devised last year.
unit.target: Consilium eorum, quod totum annum praeteritum complebat, anno ultimo excogitatum est.

unit.source: They had selected locals from Port Santa who resembled the unfortunate governor.
unit.target: Loci ex Portu Santa electi erant, qui infelici gubernatorem simulabant.

unit.source: After disrupting the sea sacrifice and returning ashore, they promptly killed one of their targets, allowing Bard to assume the guise.
unit.target: Postquam sacrifacium maris perturbaverunt et in terram redierunt, unum ex propositis suis celeriter occiderunt, quo Bard personam assumere potuit.
