unit.source: Their confidence in Miguel—disguised by Bard—becoming the false Governor of the Sea stemmed from Ultraman taking charge of the matter.
unit.target: Fides eorum in Miguel, a Bard simulato, falsum gubernatorem maris fieri, ex Ultraman rem regendi suscipienda orta erat.

unit.source: To prevent potential rebellion from peripheral April Fool’s members, Bard, a former Swindler, intentionally wrote Emperor Roselle’s Secret Chronicles and handed them to Loki.
unit.target: Ut rebellionem potentialem a membris Aprilis Follis marginariis prohiberet, Bard, olim fraudator, conscie “Chronicas Secretas” Imperatoris Roselle scripsit et eas Loki tradidit.

unit.source: The latter discreetly distributed them in Trier, creating the illusion of Bard’s activity in Intis.
unit.target: Ille eas in Treviris caute disseminavit, creando illusionem activitatis Bardianae in Intis.

unit.source: This tactic prevented others from connecting Miguel—obediently residing in the Governor of the Sea’s residence—to Bard.
unit.target: Haec tactica impediit alios cum Miguel, qui in residentia gubernatoris maris oboedienter habitabat, coniungi cum Bard.

unit.source: Writing about Emperor Roselle’s romantic past indeed amused Bard, and witnessing Juan Oro’s reactions, including the lashing with a crutch before intimate encounters with his granddaughter and the wives and daughters of relevant personnel, greatly satisfied Bard’s mischievous tendencies.
unit.target: Scrībere de praeterito amoroso Imperatoris Roselle vere Bard delectabat, et videndo reactiones Juan Oro, inter quas etiam flagellatio baculo ante congressūs intimos cum nepōta et uxoribus ac filiis pertinentibus, Bardis ingenia malitiosa maxime satisfaciebat.

unit.source: However, pranks were secondary.
unit.target: Attamen ioci erant secundarii.

unit.source: Bard’s main objective in assuming the disguise of the Governor of the Sea was clear:
unit.target: Praecipuum propositum Bard in assumenda specie gubernatoris maris clarum erat:

unit.source: He gained unrestricted access to the basement of the building, believed by Milo Village’s inhabitants to be the sacrificial ground for their ancestors!
unit.target: Ille accessum ad subsolum aedificii, quod incolae vici Milo putabant esse locum sacrificii maiorum suorum, sine limitatione adeptus est!

unit.source: Despite being a fake Governor of the Sea under the watchful eyes of sea spawn in the house, he had free rein everywhere except the ring-making ritual grounds and the vigil room.
unit.target: Quamquam falsus gubernator maris, sub oculis vigilantibus progeniei maris in domo, ubique sine restrictione agebat, excepto in agris ritus anuli faciendi et in cella vigili.

unit.source: Only those two areas were off-limits unless he crossed a line.
unit.target: Illae duo sola loca erant clausae, nisi fines transgressisset.

unit.source: Moreover, Ultraman confirmed that the basement of the Governor’s residence held no value for the sea spawn.
unit.target: Praeterea, Ultraman confirmavit subsolum residentiae gubernatoris maris nullam utilitatem pro progenie maris habere.

unit.source: Except for two symbolic guards at the staircase, there were no monitors or protectors inside.
unit.target: Nisi duos custodes symbolicos ad scalas, nulli intus vigiles nec protectores erant.

unit.source: Villagers of Milo Village only visited occasionally, showing respect for the Governor of the Sea by not entering or leaving the building without permission.
unit.target: Incolae vici Milo tantum interdum visitabant, gubernatori maris reverentiam tribuentes, neque aedificium sine licentia intrantes nec exiens.

unit.source: This provided ample opportunities for Bard, the imposter Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Hoc Bard, impostor gubernator maris, multa opportunitates adeptus est.

unit.source: Thinking about the expressions of Juan Oro and Lumian Lee when they witnessed the sea prayer ritual’s failure again, Bard couldn’t help but chuckle.
unit.target: Cogitans de vultibus Juan Oro et Lumian Lee, cum iterum ritu orationis maris defecerunt, Bard non potuit se ab iocoso risu abstinere.

unit.source: He muttered in a mocking tone, You know the sea sacrifice, ring-making, and vigil happen once a year. Haven’t you considered that the ancestral sacrificial ritual can only occur annually?
unit.target: Submurmuravit in tono derisorio, “Scitis sacrificialem maris, ritum anuli conficiendi atque vigiliam semel in anno evenire. Numne existimastis ritualem sacrificii maiorum solum annuo fieri posse?”

unit.source: That dilapidated altar requires the slow accumulation of worshippers’ spirituality. It takes almost twelve months to gather the necessary enchantment.
unit.target: Illud lapsum aram requirit tardam accumulationem spiritualis cultus. Fere duodecim menses opus est ad incantationem necessariam congregandam.

unit.source: Over half a month before the basement gained serious attention, he had strategically placed an item related to one of the three pathways on the altar, openly siphoning the accumulated theft powers!
unit.target: Dimidiā mense antequam subsolum graviter attentum fuisset, rem ad unam ex tribus viis pertinentem in aram strategice posuerat, vim furtivae potentiae accumulationis aperte exhauriens!

unit.source: With this plan, Bard believed that, regardless of the success of the previous night’s ring-making ritual, regardless of how closely Juan Oro and Lumian Lee guarded against the replacement of the Ring of the Sea Queen, it wouldn’t possess the ability to steal power from the sea bottom.
unit.target: Hoc consilio, Bard credebat, quod, sive successerit ritu conficiendi anuli nocturni praeteriti, sive quantum Juan Oro et Lumian Lee contra substitutionem Anuli Reginæ Maris diligenter vigilarent, ille non esset idoneus potentiam e fundo maris furandi.

unit.source: Hence, the sea prayer ritual was destined to fail. The seal would further open, and the long-accumulated “volcano” inside would erupt!
unit.target: Itaque, ritu orationis maris deficiendum esse destinatum erat. Sigillum ulterius aperietur, et vulcanus interne, diu accumulatus, erupturus erit!

unit.source: Anyone attempting to stop it would perish!
unit.target: Quicumque id prohibere conaretur, periret!

unit.source: Last year, the reason April Fool’s took the risk of making Mad Lady a deputy host and deliberately replacing the Ring of the Sea Queen on the sacrificial ancestor’s stone platform with another item arose because the theory that the high-level stealing power could only be used once a year wasn’t entirely confirmed.
unit.target: Anno ultimo, ratio cur Aprilis Follis periculum susceperat ut Mad Lady hospitis vicaria fieret atque conscie Anulum Reginæ Maris in podium lapideum maiorum sacrificiorum alio substitueretur, orta est ex theoria, quae affirmare non potuit potentiam altissimam furandi solum semel in anno adhiberi posse.

unit.source: Although Ultraman could analyze and experiment in the basement, he refrained from doing so too frequently to avoid suspicion.
unit.target: Quamquam Ultraman in subsolum analyzare et experimenta gerere poterat, nimis saepe id facere vitavit, ne suspectio oriretur.

unit.source: Following the sea prayer ritual failure last year and the subsequent monthly experiments over the past eleven months, Bard, Ultraman, and Mad Lady were now certain that they didn’t need to go through the trouble of replacing the real Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Post defectum ritu orationis maris anno ultimo atque experimenta mensia per undecim menses subsequentes, Bard, Ultraman, et Mad Lady iam certi erant se non necesse habere verum Anulum Reginæ Maris reponere.

unit.source: Instead, they could preemptively take away the theft power. Thus, they sneered at Lumian Lee’s efforts, unconcerned about his actions or the need for destructive measures to avoid detection by the Earth Mother Church.
unit.target: Potius vim furtivae praeemptive auferre poterant. Itaque de conatibus Lumian Lee irriserunt, nihil solliciti de actionibus eius aut de mensuris destructivis ad detectionem a Ecclesia Matris Terrae vitandam.

unit.source: Despite their confidence, they still had to maintain appearances, including seeking help from Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Non obstante fiducia, tamen speciem servare oportebat, inter quae auxilium a Lumian Lee petere incluebatur.

unit.source: Bard shifted his gaze, averting it to his left hand.
unit.target: Bard conspectum suum ad manum sinistram devolvit.

unit.source: There were signs of a ring being worn there.
unit.target: Apparuerunt signa quod anulus ibi indutus esset.

unit.source: This was, in fact, the item carrying the key functions of the Ring of the Sea Queen!
unit.target: Hoc, re vera, erat res quae functiones principales Anuli Reginæ Maris portabat!

unit.source: Port Santa, Solow Motel, at the entrance of the fifth-floor suite.
unit.target: Port Santa, Solow Motel, ad introitum conclavis tabulatae quintae.

unit.source: “Hugging” Madame Giorgia, Lugano’s thoughts faltered, as if the iron gears were covered in yellow rust or lacking lubricant.
unit.target: “Amplexans” Madame Giorgia, Lugano cogitationes titubaverunt, quasi rotae ferreae flavo rubore tectae vel lubricante carentes essent.

unit.source: W-what’s… going on?
unit.target: Q-quid… agitur?

unit.source: Am I… under attack?
unit.target: Num sub impetu sum?

unit.source: No… I have to hurry… I have to… get rid… of this state…
unit.target: Non… cito agere debeo… mihi oportet… hanc conditionem tollere…

unit.source: Lugano attempted to push away the woman in his arms, only to realize she had become surprisingly heavy.
unit.target: Lugano conatus est mulierem in brachiis suis repellere, sed animadvertit eam mirum modum grave factam esse.

unit.source: Using her joints subtly, Madame Giorgia prevented him from raising his arms and legs. The movements resembled a lovers’ playful interaction.
unit.target: Subtiliter articulos suos adhibens, Madame Giorgia eum prohibuit brachia et crura tollere. Motus similes erant ludicrae amantium interationi.

unit.source: Coupled with his disjointed thoughts, even a Planter like Lugano couldn’t break free from Giorgia’s restraints.
unit.target: Cum cogitationibus suis dissociatis, etiam cultor ut Lugano vinculis Madame Giorgiae liberari non potuit.

unit.source: Panicking, Lugano opened his mouth, about to call for help.
unit.target: Perturbatus, Lugano os aperuit, auxilium clamare paratus.

unit.source: Just then, Giorgia lifted her head, pressing her red lips against his.
unit.target: Tum, Giorgia caput levavit, labra sua rubra in eius os premens.

unit.source: Lugano was momentarily taken aback.
unit.target: Lugano momento obstupefactus est.

unit.source: In the adjacent room, Jenna, disguised as a female mercenary, held a mirror to “reflect” the situation in Lumian’s living room through the glass and other items.
unit.target: In cella contigua, Jenna, sub specie mercenariae feminae, speculum tenebat ad rem in conclavi Lumiani per vitrum aliaque media reflectendam.

unit.source: Seeing Lugano and Giorgia embracing and flirting, Jenna couldn’t help but curse under her breath, “Dammit, can you even go into heat at a time like this? And in front of a child!”
unit.target: Videns Lugano et Giorgia se amplectentes atque inter se jocantes, Jenna submurmuravit maledice, “Maledictum, num quidem in hoc tempore ardorem capitis excitare potestis? Atque coram puero!”

unit.source: Considering that Franca would be joined by members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, Lumian tasked Jenna with secretly monitoring Lugano to figure out what was wrong with the interpreter.
unit.target: Cum Franca a membris Societatis Inquisitionis Simiorum Crisporum coniungeretur, Lumian Jennam commissum habuit ut clam Lugano observaret, ut cognosceret quid interpres male essent.

unit.source: As a former Showy Diva, Jenna had witnessed similar scenes and even more restrictive ones. She couldn’t fathom why they chose to display such affection at the door.
unit.target: Cum olim Diva ostentatrix fuerit, Jenna similes scaenas atque etiam magis reclusas viderat. Non potuit intellegere cur talem affectionem ad ianuam exhibere maluerint.

unit.source: At that moment, Anthony Reid, standing beside her, looked at the mirror and frowned.
unit.target: Illo momento, Anthony Reid, iuxta eam stans, speculum aspexit et fronde contremuit.

unit.source: “It doesn’t seem like they’re making out. Their actions and expressions aren’t typical of people engaged in such activities.”
unit.target: “Non videtur eos amplexari. Acta eorum et vultus non sunt proprii hominibus talibus in rebus versantibus.”

unit.source: 574 Heavy
unit.target: 574 Gravis

unit.source: 574 Heavy
unit.target: 574 Gravis

unit.source: Their actions and expressions don’t align with the typical behavior of people engaged in intimate moments?
unit.target: Actus eorum et vultus non congruunt more solito hominum, qui in intimis momentis versantur?

unit.source: Though Jenna had witnessed such scenes in the past, she hadn’t delved into the intricacies of others’ intimate interactions.
unit.target: Quamquam Jenna talia vidit, in intricata aliorum intimarum relationum penitus non se immerserat.

unit.source: Upon hearing Anthony’s words, she promptly sided with the Spectator’s perspective.
unit.target: Auditis verbis Antonii, statim sententiam Spectatoris assumpsit.

unit.source: Anthony continued, “Lugano’s body language indicates clear resistance.
unit.target: “Gestus corporalis Lugani repugnationem patentem indicat.

unit.source: His current condition is highly abnormal.”
unit.target: Status eius praesentis valde insuetus est.”

unit.source: Resisting, yet not breaking free… There’s a lack of intense movements, even though Lugano is a Sequence 8 Beyonder with a strengthened physique.
unit.target: Resistens, sed non se effugiens … motus vehementes deficiunt, quamquam Lugano est Beyonder Sequentiae VIII cum corpore firmato.

unit.source: This situation is undeniably peculiar…
unit.target: Haec condicio indubitanter insolita est…

unit.source: What kind of Beyonder powers could cause this?
unit.target: Quae potentiae Beyonder huiusmodi hoc efficere possent?

unit.source: Jenna swiftly sifted through the information about potential adversaries for this mission.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter perlegit informationes de adversariis potentialibus huius missionis.

unit.source: Most of it had been compiled by Franca, with a small section supplemented by Judgment and Madam Magician.
unit.target: Maior pars eius a Franca composita erat, cum parva parte a Iudicio et Domina Magica adiuncta.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through Jenna’s mind, a realization quickly dawned on her:
unit.target: Dum ista cogitationes per mentem Jennae traiciebantur, celeriter ei intellectus pervenerunt:

unit.source: Marionettist!
unit.target: Marionettista!

unit.source: A Sequence 5 Marionettist from the Seer pathway!
unit.target: Marionettista Sequentiae V ex via Videntium!

unit.source: According to Franca’s description of Marionettists, these Beyonders could lurk in the shadows, silently transforming their targets into autonomous marionettes from a distance.
unit.target: Secundum descriptionem Francae de Marionettistis, hi Beyonder in umbris latitare poterant, tacite obiectos suos in pupas automatas a longinquo transformantes.

unit.source: And Madam Magician’s additional information included this:
unit.target: Et additae informationes Dominae Magicae hoc comprehendebant:

unit.source: “A Marionettist manipulates a creature’s Spirit Body Threads.”
unit.target: “Marionettista filis spiritus corporis creaturae moderatur.”

unit.source: “A skilled Marionettist can establish initial control of the target’s Spirit Body Threads in five to 10 seconds, slowing down thoughts, movements, and stiffening the body.”
unit.target: “Marionettista peritus imperium initiale super filis spiritus corporis propositi intra quinque ad decem secunda instituere potest, cogitationes et motus retardans ac corpus rigescens.”

unit.source: Lugano’s current state perfectly matched the characteristics of a Marionettist’s initial control over the Spirit Body Threads!
unit.target: Status praesentis Lugani perfecte convenit cum proprietatibus initialis imperii Marionettistae super filis spiritus corporis!

unit.source: Jenna lowered her voice and said to Anthony, “Loki…”
unit.target: Jenna vocem demisit et Antonio dixit: “Loki…”

unit.source: The enemy with the codename Loki was none other than a Marionettist!
unit.target: Hostis, cui nomen in codice “Loki” attribuebatur, nihil aliud erat quam Marionettista!

unit.source: Anthony immediately grasped Jenna’s conjecture and nodded affirmatively.
unit.target: Anthony statim coniecturam Jennae perceptus est et annuit.

unit.source: No need to rush.
unit.target: Non necesse est festinare.

unit.source: It takes a Marionettist several minutes to completely transform the target into a marionette.
unit.target: Marionettista paucos minutas requirit ut obiectum totum in pupam transformet.

unit.source: We have a chance to rescue Lugano.
unit.target: Habemus occasionem Luganum servandi.

unit.source: As per the information, forcibly taking Lugano away, pushing him beyond a certain limit, or triggering him could help him break free from the Spirit Body Threads or enhance his resistance to such manipulation.
unit.target: Secundum informationem, Luganum vi eripere, eum ultra certum terminum impellere, aut excitare possit, adiuvabit ut a filis spiritus corporis se liberet aut resistantiam ad talem manipulationem augeat.

unit.source: Certainly, the most direct approach would be to locate Loki’s true form and launch a direct attack on the enemy, preventing him from concentrating on controlling Lugano’s Spirit Body Threads.
unit.target: Certe, simplicissima via esset veram formam Loki detegere et hosti impetum directum inferre, ne in regendo filis spiritus corporis Lugani incumbat.

unit.source: Jenna caught Anthony’s implication.
unit.target: Jenna animadvertit implicationem Antonii.

unit.source: Don’t hurry to rescue Lugano.
unit.target: Noli festinare Luganum servare.

unit.source: Find Loki’s true form while Loki hasn’t detected us!
unit.target: Inveni veram formam Loki, dum ille nos nondum detexit!

unit.source: The two of them had posed as a couple and checked into Solow Motel’s suite the previous night.
unit.target: Illi duo se coniugibus simul praesentarunt et priore nocte in conclavi Solow Motel insederunt.

unit.source: Once Loki was identified, dealing with a peculiar, insidious adversary with formidable abilities might be beyond their capacity.
unit.target: Postquam Loki identificatus est, agere cum hoste peculiari et insidioso cum formidabilibus viribus fortasse eorum facultates excederet.

unit.source: However, they could create a significant disturbance and “report” to the Fertility Order, responsible for local Beyonder matters.
unit.target: Attamen, possent magnum tumultum creare et ordini Fertilitatis, cui negotia localia Beyonder incumbent, referre.

unit.source: Lumian had already coordinated with Noelia in advance.
unit.target: Lumian iam antea cum Noelia convenit.

unit.source: Jenna nodded and reached for the fluorescent powder, preparing to conceal herself.
unit.target: Jenna annuit et ad pulverem fluorescentem porrigit, se celare parans.

unit.source: But in the next moment, she abandoned the idea.
unit.target: Sed in momento sequente, illud consilium deseruit.

unit.source: She recalled the information’s warning: Marionettists can directly perceive the Spirit Body Threads of different creatures.
unit.target: Meminivit admonitionem in informatione: Marionettistae fila spiritus corporis variarum creaturarum directe deprehendere possunt.

unit.source: Most invisibility effects wouldn’t work on them.
unit.target: Plurima effecta invisibilitatis in eos non valent.

unit.source: Moreover, Loki was currently manipulating Spirit Body Threads.
unit.target: Praeterea, Loki nunc filos spiritus corporis manipulat.

unit.source: How to locate Loki?
unit.target: Quomodo Loki inveniatur?

unit.source: Jenna pondered with a strong sense of urgency.
unit.target: Jenna cum vehementi urgentia sensu cogitavit.

unit.source: In the sealed waters, aboard the betrothal ship.
unit.target: In aquis clausis, in nave sponsalia.

unit.source: Lumian first witnessed the mountain-like azure waves surging, only to realize that they had frozen in the air, as if subjected to a sudden freeze.
unit.target: Primum Lumian undas caeruleas, similes montibus, impetuosas vidit, deinde animadvertit eas in aere congelatas esse, quasi subito refrigeratae.

unit.source: The surroundings emitted a violent aura, obliterating everything in its path.
unit.target: Ambiens aura violenta emanabat, omnia in itinere suo delevaans.

unit.source: The sea’s fury?
unit.target: Furor maris?

unit.source: Lumian’s heart skipped a beat.
unit.target: Cor Lumiani palpitavit.

unit.source: Similarly, he couldn’t fathom what had gone awry.
unit.target: Similiter, non potuit suspicari quid male evenisset.

unit.source: It seemed that the Ring of the Sea Queen had only unlocked the first half of the seal and hadn’t manifested the second half of its stealing effect.
unit.target: Videbatur Annulus Reginae Maris solum dimidium sigilli patefecerit, alterum autem dimidium effectus furtivi non manifestaverit.

unit.source: Nevertheless, following the completion of the ring-making ritual, the ring was indeed placed on the dilapidated stone platform.
unit.target: Attamen, post consummationem rituum ad annulum faciendum, annulus vere in suggestu lapideo ruinoso positus est.

unit.source: Lumian and Juan Oro had retrieved it together.
unit.target: Lumian et Juan Oro eum simul recuperaverunt.

unit.source: Previously uncertain if the Ring of the Sea Queen had been switched, Lumian now knew it hadn’t.
unit.target: Priore dubitatione, an Annulus Reginae Maris mutatus esset, Lumian nunc scivit non fuisse.

unit.source: This was evident as the Ring of the Sea Queen had further opened the seal.
unit.target: Id evidenter videbatur, quoniam Annulus Reginae Maris sigillum ulterius recluderat.

unit.source: A counterfeit ring, lacking the previous ritual, wouldn’t exhibit a similar function.
unit.target: Annulus falsus, ritu praevio carens, similiter functionem non exhiberet.

unit.source: Could it be that someone moved the Ring of the Sea Queen during the hour in the basement, preventing it from completing the eroding power’s duration?
unit.target: Numquid aliquis Annulum Reginae Maris in hora cellae subterranea moverit, ne potentiae erodentis tempus compleri possit?

unit.source: Or perhaps the critical stone platform in the basement was destroyed in advance, hindering the completion of the ancestral ritual?
unit.target: An fortasse suggestus lapideus critice in cella subterranea antea deletus est, impediens consummationem rituum maiorum?

unit.source: Unlikely.
unit.target: Improbabile est.

unit.source: How could the first scenario elude the attention of Juan Oro, me, and the sea spawn surveillance?
unit.target: Quomodo prima condicio ab attentione Juan Oro, mea, et speculatorum maris progeniei evadere potuit?

unit.source: The second scenario shouldn’t be inconspicuous.
unit.target: Secunda condicio non debet esse inobservabilis.

unit.source: It would undoubtedly be discovered by the sea spawn…
unit.target: Certissime ab speculatoribus maris progeniei detegetur…

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he suddenly felt a slight erosion from the destructive aura surrounding him.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani evolabant, subito levem erosionem ex aurae destructivae, quae eum circumdabat, sensit.

unit.source: His mind instantly connected to something.
unit.target: Mens eius statim ad aliquid se coniunxit.

unit.source: Vaguely, Lumian “saw” the dark-blue seabed, nearly pitch-black.
unit.target: Vague, Lumian “vidit” fundum maris, caeruleum obscurum, paene totum atrum.

unit.source: He “saw” a peculiar object partially embedded in rocks and gravel.
unit.target: Ille “vidit” obiectum peculiare, quod partim in saxis ac lapillis insertum erat.

unit.source: The object was unnaturally massive, surpassing the Fertility Order’s cloister and the Governor of the Sea’s residence combined.
unit.target: Obiectum erat insolite ingens, superans simul claustrum Ordinis Fertilitatis et domicilium Praefecti Maris.

unit.source: It bore a silver-gray hue, with sleek lines resembling a colossal spindle missing its front segment.
unit.target: Erat color argentocinerius, cum lineis nitidis, instar fusoris ingentis, cui pars anterior deest.

unit.source: At that moment, the side of the object gleamed with a radiant starlight.
unit.target: Illo momento, latus obiecti radiis stellarum fulgebat.

unit.source: Together, they appeared to form a circular, transparent door.
unit.target: Conjunctim, videbantur formare ostium circularum et perspicuum.

unit.source: Through the door, Lumian “saw” a particular scene inside.
unit.target: Per ianuam, Lumian “vidit” scenam peculiarem intus constitutam.

unit.source: Silver-gray metal walls were densely covered with special holes, resembling hives.
unit.target: Muri metallici argentocinerei densissime foraminibus specialibus tecti erant, instar alveariorum.

unit.source: In some nests, black foam bubbled as thin, bristle-covered Batings Black Insects crawled out.
unit.target: In nonnullis nidis, spuma nigra bulliebat, dum insecta nigra Batings, tenuibus setis operta, exsurgere coeperunt.

unit.source: Some nests contained more than ten compartments, with a wrinkled Little Devil lying inside, seemingly deceased and disintegrating into various forms…
unit.target: Nonnulla nidi plura quam decem compartimenta continebant, cum Parvulus Diabolus rugosus intus iacens, quasi mortuus et in varias formas dissolvens.

unit.source: As this peculiar and horrifying scene etched into Lumian’s mind, he snapped out of his stupor.
unit.target: Haec scaena peculiare et horrifica in mente Lumiani inscripta, eum ex stupefactu evexit.

unit.source: He couldn’t be bothered to ponder April Fool’s actions.
unit.target: Non curabat meditari de actionibus Aprilis Stulti.

unit.source: He swiftly deliberated on how to prevent the sealed object from going berserk and breaking free entirely.
unit.target: Celeriter deliberavit quomodo prohiberetur, ut obiectum sigillatum insanire et omnino se liberare non possit.

unit.source: The extracted power has yet to cause any harm…
unit.target: Potentia extracta adhuc nihil nocuit.

unit.source: It appears to be suppressed by Juan Oro at the expense of his life…
unit.target: Videtur a Juan Oro vitae suo sacrificio opprimi.

unit.source: If I can seize this window of opportunity to steal the released power and distribute it to everyone with a sea bloodline, there’s a chance of completing the sea sacrifice segment and allowing the sea prayer ritual to succeed…
unit.target: Si hanc fenestram opportunitatis ad potentiam dimissam surripiendam et omnibus, quae sanguine marino induti sunt, distribuendam capere possim, occasio est ut pars sacrificii maris peragatur et oratio maritima feliciter perficiatur.

unit.source: Stealing…
unit.target: Furtum…

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian contemplated two solutions:
unit.target: In instante, Lumian duas solutiones consideravit:

unit.source: Firstly, he could immediately seek help from Mr. Fool, an expert in this area, with Termiboros as a precedent.
unit.target: Primum, statim auxilium ab Domino Stulto, perito in hoc campo, Termiboros exemplum habens, petere poterat.

unit.source: Secondly, he could utilize the Lie earring, a mystical item that had gained the ability to steal others’ powers on the stone platform meant to honor the ancestors.
unit.target: Secundo, uti poterat auriculis Lie, re mystica, quae facultatem adeptus erat aliorum potentias in suggestu lapideo, qui maiores honoraret, surripere.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly discarded the first option, considering April Fool’s involvement.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter primam optionem reiecit, cum Aprilis Stulti involvemento considerato.

unit.source: With The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings backing them, seeking Mr. Fool’s assistance might not yield a response.
unit.target: Cum Auxilio Caelestis Digni Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus eos sustinentes, petere auxilium Domini Stulto fortasse responsum non pariet.

unit.source: It could potentially be a time‐consuming effort.
unit.target: Hoc conatum fortasse tempus consumens erit.

unit.source: As for the second method, Lumian sensed a strong feeling of inevitability and an undeniable sense of coincidence.
unit.target: Quoad secundam methodum, Lumian sensum validum inevitabilitatis et innegabile coniunctionis fortuitae sensit.

unit.source: Lie had recently acquired the ability to steal someone else’s power—and here it was proving beneficial in a critical moment!
unit.target: Lie nuper adeptus est facultatem alicuius potentiam surripere, et hic in momento critico beneficum esse probabatur!

unit.source: Without the luxury of time for careful analysis, Lumian made a swift decision.
unit.target: Sine tempore superfluo ad accuratam meditationem, Lumian celeriter consilium cepit.

unit.source: Put aside coincidences and inevitability for now. Resolving the current predicament was the most pragmatic approach!
unit.target: Relinquite coincidencias et inevitabilitatem pro tempore. Resolutio praesenti quaestioni erat via maxime practica!

unit.source: He then retrieved the silver Lie earring from his pocket.
unit.target: Deinde auriculam Lie argenteam de sinu suo extraxit.

unit.source: Typically, such items couldn’t be brought onto the betrothal ship—they would surely be discovered by the sea spawn.
unit.target: Plurimode, tales res in navem sponsalem feri non possent, quarum certissime a vigilibus maris progeniei invenientur.

unit.source: However, this time, Juan Oro had communicated with the sea spawn in advance, stating that he and his assistant intended to pose as deputy hosts and board the ship to guard against any potential mishaps.
unit.target: Attamen hoc tempore, Juan Oro cum progenie maris antea communicavit, declarans se et adiutorem suum ut hospites vicarii se praestituros esse et navem conscendere ad casus praecavendos.

unit.source: The sea spawn placed their trust in the president of the Fisheries Guild more than anyone else while the traitors were still at large.
unit.target: Proles maris fidem suam in praeside Gremii Piscatorii plurimum deposuerunt, dum proditores adhuc liberi erant.

unit.source: Their intelligence wasn’t particularly high, and they were especially protective of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Ingenia eorum non erant alta, atque ritum preces maris valde protegebant.

unit.source: Clutching the Lie earring, Lumian extended his spirituality.
unit.target: Auriculam Lie stringens, Lumian spiritualitatem suam extendit.

unit.source: He immediately perceived the surrounding starlight and sensed their presence.
unit.target: Statim lucem stellarum circumstantem percepit et eorum praesentiam sensit.

unit.source: Lumian subconsciously extended his hand and twisted his wrist.
unit.target: Lumian, inconsci mente, manum extulit et carpum sui vertit.

unit.source: A plethora of starlight cascaded down, rushing toward the Lie earring and enveloping him.
unit.target: Plenitudo lucis stellarum descendit, properans ad auriculam Lie et eum amplectens.

unit.source: At that moment, a person materialized in front of him.
unit.target: Illo momento, persona coram eo apparuit.

unit.source: She wore a black nun’s uniform, her face expressing profound sorrow.
unit.target: Induta est habitu monialis nigrae, cuius facies profundum dolorem exprimens erat.

unit.source: She appeared like a colossal whale suddenly leaping out of the sea without warning.
unit.target: Apparuit ut ceta ingens, subito e mari exsiliens, sine ullo praenuntiato.

unit.source: It’s her? The source of Derangement? Lumian finally recollected something he had forgotten.
unit.target: Estne illa? Fons perturbationis? Lumian tandem aliquid quod oblitus erat recollexit.

unit.source: There was indeed such a person on the ship!
unit.target: Revera, talis persona in nave erat!

unit.source: In the next instant, he sensed the humanoid Sealed Artifact becoming unusually weighty, so heavy that the surrounding void slightly bent.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, sensit Artefactum Sigillatum humanoidem insolite grave fieri, tam grave ut vacuum circumstans leviter flecteretur.

unit.source: It was so heavy that all the starlight surged toward her like the sea.
unit.target: Tam grave erat ut omnis lux stellarum, instar maris, ad eam concurreret.

unit.source: The weight was so immense that the betrothal ship began to sink, and the nearby seawater was pushed aside.
unit.target: Gravitas tam ingens erat ut navis sponsalia mergi coepit, et aquae maritimae prope repulsae essent.

unit.source: Silently, Lumian witnessed the sea around him morphing into a translucent azure mountain peak, looming over them as they descended to the seabed.
unit.target: Silentio, Lumian vidit mare circa se in cacumen montis caerulei translucidum transfigurari, super eos eminens, dum ad fundum maris descendebant.

unit.source: It resembled the walls of a deep well, and the well mouth, formed by these walls, grew more distant with each passing moment.
unit.target: Simile erat muris putei profundi, et os putei, his muris formatum, singulis momentis longius fiebat.

unit.source: Four hours ago, at the edge of the foggy sea, Nolfi said to Charname, “You have to listen to me completely from now on. Otherwise, it will be very dangerous.”
unit.target: Quattuor horis ante, ad limitem maris nebulosi, Nolfi dixit ad Charname: “Ab hoc tempore me integre audire debes; alioquin, valde periculosum erit.”

unit.source: “Sure.” Charname nodded. “But before that, we need to communicate openly.”
unit.target: “Certe.” Charname annuit. “Sed priusquam hoc fiat, aperte communicare oportet.”

unit.source: A smile gradually spread across his face.
unit.target: Subtilis risus lente per faciem eius diffusus est.

unit.source: Batna, who stood beside Nolfi, asked curiously, “What communication?”
unit.target: Batna, qui iuxta Nolfi stabat, curiose rogavit: “Quae communicatio?”

unit.source: Charname produced a metal canister and looked at Nolfi.
unit.target: Charname eduxit canistrum metallicum et Nolfi aspexit.

unit.source: “This is an agent that can make people speak the truth. I want to know if you have a secret collaborator. If so, who is it? Don’t worry, it’s not poison.”
unit.target: “Hoc est agens, qui facit ut homines veritatem loquantur. Volo scire an secretum collaboratorem habeas. Si ita, quis sit? Noli timere, non est venenum.”

unit.source: Charname unscrewed the lid and took a sip to demonstrate his sincerity.
unit.target: Charname operculum solverat et paulum bibit ut sinceritatem suam ostenderet.

unit.source: Nolfi fell silent.
unit.target: Nolfi silevit.

unit.source: “If I don’t understand the corresponding details, it’ll be challenging for me to follow your instructions,” Charname began to instigate.
unit.target: “Si non intellego singularia, difficile mihi erit instructiones tuas sequi,” Charname incipiebat instigare.

unit.source: “We’re already here. We could enter those waters at any moment and destroy the underwater palace before the sea prayer ritual. Are you truly willing to give up?”
unit.target: “Iam hic sumus. Quovis momento illas aquas intrare possumus et palatium subaquaticum ante ritum orationis maris delere; num vere paratus es cedere?”

unit.source: Nolfi remained silent for a moment before accepting the metal canister and taking a big gulp.
unit.target: Nolfi paulisper silevit, deinde canistrum metallicum accipiens magnum sorbit.

unit.source: Charname’s heart ached as he withdrew the bottle and patiently waited for the medicine to take effect.
unit.target: Cor Charname dolebatur, dum poculum abstulit et patienter medicamentum effectum exspectavit.

unit.source: 575 “Handover”
unit.target: 575 “Traditio”

unit.source: 575 “Handover”
unit.target: 575 “Traditio”

unit.source: After a while, Charname reached his limit.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Charname metam suam attigit.

unit.source: He stared at Nolfi and questioned, “Do you have any secret collaborators?”
unit.target: Nolfi intuens est et interrogavit: “Habesne collaboratores secretos?”

unit.source: Nolfi gently nodded and admitted, “Yes.”
unit.target: Nolfi leniter annuens dixitque: “Ita.”

unit.source: Batna and Charname anticipated this response, but it failed to dampen Charname’s excitement.
unit.target: Batna et Charname hanc responsionem praevidebant, sed ea excitamentum Charname non minuere potuit.

unit.source: “Who is it?”
unit.target: “Quis est?”

unit.source: Nolfi hesitated for a moment before revealing, “It’s, it’s Juan Oro!”
unit.target: Nolfi paulisper hesitavit antequam patefecit: “Iste, iste Juan Oro!”

unit.source: Juan Oro?
unit.target: Juan Oro?

unit.source: The president of the Fisheries Guild?
unit.target: Praeses Gildae Piscariorum?

unit.source: Batna was caught off guard.
unit.target: Batna repente stupefactus est.

unit.source: Charname shared the sentiment.
unit.target: Charname similem sententiam habuit.

unit.source: Could the spy be the boss?
unit.target: Num speculator dux sit?

unit.source: Despite his critique, he pressed on, “Are you sure it’s Juan Oro?”
unit.target: Quamquam eius critica non impedivit, pergebat: “Esne certus eum esse Juan Oro?”

unit.source: While instructing Juan Oro to investigate the core members of the Fisheries Guild, Lumian, who had uncovered the Earth Mother Church’s true motives, sought similar information from Noelia of the Fertility Order, which included Juan Oro, the president.
unit.target: Dum iuberet Juan Oro ad inquirendum membra principalia Gildae Piscariorum, Lumian, qui veras causas Ecclesiae Matris Terrae detexit, quaesivit similia a Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis, cuius praeses erat Juan Oro.

unit.source: Official reports indicated that Juan Oro’s health had been relatively stable.
unit.target: Relationes officiales indicabant salutem Juan Oro relative stabile fuisse.

unit.source: He had never faced serious illness or severe injury.
unit.target: Numquam morbum grave aut vulnera gravia passi est.

unit.source: Moreover, he hadn’t displayed any signs of losing control of his lizard form.
unit.target: Praeterea, nullas ostendit signa imperii formae lacertae suae amittendi.

unit.source: In essence, there was no indication that he had been possessed by Ultraman, a transmigrator.
unit.target: In summa, nihil indicium erat eum ab Ultramano, transmigratore, invasum esse.

unit.source: Naturally, a definitive judgment couldn’t be made based solely on this information.
unit.target: Naturaliter, iudicium definitum ex his tantum rebus fieri poterat.

unit.source: After all, when the original bodies of many Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society members met unfortunate fates, there were no witnesses.
unit.target: Postremo, cum corpora originalia multorum membrorum Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum casus infelices adepti essent, nulli testes fuerunt.

unit.source: Despite growing older, Juan Oro’s personality remained relatively unchanged, sans the increasingly stubborn streak and a penchant for returning to the sea.
unit.target: Quamquam senescens, indoles Juan Oro relative immota remansit, excepto increbrescenti pertinacitate et cupiditate redeundi ad mare.

unit.source: Crucially, if Juan Oro were Ultraman, many of April Fool’s disruptive actions during the sea prayer ritual would be unnecessary.
unit.target: Praecipue, si Juan Oro Ultraman esset, multae actiones perturbantes Stultorum Aprilis in ritu precationis maris supervacua essent.

unit.source: It could be executed in a simpler and more covert manner.
unit.target: Id fieri potuit modo simpliciore et magis occulto.

unit.source: Considering these factors, Charname had previously concluded that Juan Oro wasn’t a key member of April Fool’s.
unit.target: His rebus consideratis, Charname antea conclusit Juan Oro non esse membrum principale Stultorum Aprilis.

unit.source: Nolfi pursed her lips and disclosed, “It’s him. I met him six months ago in Port Rayak.”
unit.target: Nolfi labra contraxit et declaravit: “Iste est. Eum sex menses abhinc in Portu Rayak conveni.”

unit.source: Rayak, located north of the Dariège mountain range, served as a port under the jurisdiction of the Riston Province in the Intis Republic.
unit.target: Rayak, qui ad septentrionem catenae montium Dariège situm est, functus est ut portus sub iurisdictione Provinciae Riston in Re Publica Intis.

unit.source: “Met before?” Charname blurted out.
unit.target: “Prius convenisti?” exclamavit Charname.

unit.source: “Your eyes can deceive you. What you perceive doesn’t necessarily reflect reality.”
unit.target: “Oculi tui fallere possunt. Quod percipis, non necessario veritatem repraesentat.”

unit.source: Unable to hold back his desire to confide, he continued, “Just like now. The me you see isn’t equivalent to the real me. The difference is quite significant.”
unit.target: Non potendo retinere desiderium confidenti, pergebat: “Sicut nunc. Non idem ego, quem vides, sed verus ego sum. Disparitas valde magna est.”

unit.source: “Are you suggesting that the Juan Oro I encountered was an imposter?” Nolfi expressed disbelief.
unit.target: “Num putas Juan Oro quem conveni impostorem esse?” Nolfi incredulitate expressit.

unit.source: “But, he also demonstrated the ability to control the waves!”
unit.target: “Sed etiam potestatem fluctus regendi demonstravit!”

unit.source: Charname chuckled.
unit.target: Charname subridit.

unit.source: “Many Fisheries Guild committee members possess such abilities. What if one of them impersonated Juan Oro?”
unit.target: “Multi membri consilii Gildae Piscariorum tales facultates habent. Quid si quis eorum Juan Oro fingat?”

unit.source: “But, but it’s too similar…” Nolfi fell into self-doubt.
unit.target: “Sed, sed nimis simile est…” Nolfi in dubitationem incidit.

unit.source: Charname spoke casually, “Based on the intel we gathered, Juan Oro hasn’t left Port Santa for nearly a decade.
unit.target: Charname levius locutus est: “Ex notitia quam collegimus, Juan Oro paene decennium a Porto Santa non discessit.

unit.source: “He’s the president of the Fisheries Guild.
unit.target: Praeses est Gildae Piscariorum.

unit.source: He frequents the association daily.”
unit.target: Cotidie consociationem frequentat.

unit.source: While this information was used to persuade Nolfi, it wasn’t conclusive evidence.
unit.target: Haec notitia ad Nolfi persuadendum adhibita est, sed non erat probatio definitiva.

unit.source: If Juan Oro were Ultraman, he could have enlisted Mad Lady’s help to travel to Port Rayak and return in less than two hours.
unit.target: Si Juan Oro Ultraman esset, auxilium “Mad Lady” petuisset ut Portum Rayak iter faceret et intra duas horas rediret.

unit.source: Under such circumstances, hardly anyone would notice his brief absence.
unit.target: Sub talibus condicionibus, vix quis absentiam eius brevem animadvertiret.

unit.source: Nolfi fell silent, pondering, and muttered, “Then, then who could it be?”
unit.target: Nolfi tacuit, meditans, et submurmuravit: “Ergo, quis igitur id esse potest?”

unit.source: “How would I know?” Charname expressed his criticism.
unit.target: “Quomodo id sciam?” inquit Charname.

unit.source: Appearing slightly awkward, he shifted the conversation.
unit.target: Parum incommodus apparens, conversationem mutavit.

unit.source: “What kind of collaboration did the imposter Juan Oro seek with you? Do you have any means to obliterate the underwater palace and put an end to the sea prayer ritual once and for all?”
unit.target: “Quam cooperationem imposter Juan Oro tecum petiit? Habesne viam ad palatium subaquaticum delendum atque ritum precationis maris semel atque in perpetuum finendum?”

unit.source: Nolfi’s body quivered, as if grappling with an innate urge.
unit.target: Corpus Nolfi tremuit, quasi cum innato impetu certaret.

unit.source: After a brief pause, she struggled in response, “H-he’ll help me cover my tracks and disregard my existence. He’ll permit me to board a ship and infiltrate the sea sacrifice waters ahead of the Governor of the Sea’s vessel and conceal myself.
unit.target: Post brevem moram, laborans respondit: “Ille me adiuvabit vestigia mea celare atque existentiam meam neglegere. Permisit mihi navem conscendere et in aquas sacrificii maris, ante vecturam Gubernatoris Maris, introire atque me celare.

unit.source: “Then, as the Governor of the Sea unveils the Ring of the Sea Queen and utters the words of the marriage proposal, I’ll deliver a line.
unit.target: Tum, cum Gubernator Maris anulum Reginae Maris detegit et verba pro nuptiis pronuntiat, ego rem dicam.

unit.source: “My mother imparted that passage to me. It originated from her profound connection with the palace when she received the sea’s blessing. Its—its purpose is to trigger a self-destruct sequence within the palace.”
unit.target: “Mater mea hanc locutionem mihi tradidit. Ea orta est ex profunda coniunctione cum palatio, cum benedictionem maris accepisset. Propositum eius est ordinem auto-destructionis intra palatium excitare.”

unit.source: Nolfi’s words flowed more effortlessly, signifying that she had given up on resisting.
unit.target: Verba Nolfi leviter fluere coeperunt, significantes eam resistendi conatum deseruisse.

unit.source: “Self-destruction sequence? Are you certain? Do you comprehend that language from God knows where?” Charname wore an expression of skepticism.
unit.target: “Ordo auto-destructionis? Esne certus? Quidam intellegisne hanc linguam ex ignoto?” Charname vultum scepticismi gerebat.

unit.source: “That’s what my mother told me.” Nolfi conveyed her lack of understanding of the language’s meaning.
unit.target: “Id est quod mater mea mihi dixerat.” Nolfi significavit se linguam significationis non intellegere.

unit.source: Charname pressed on, “Does your mother comprehend that language?”
unit.target: Charname pergebat: “Intellegitne mater tua hanc linguam?”

unit.source: “She doesn’t, but she grasps its significance. Can you fathom it? It’s a form of spiritual communication,” Nolfi defended her mother with determination.
unit.target: “Ea non intellegit, sed significationem eius percipit. Potesne id capere? Est genus communicationis spiritualis,” Nolfi matrem suam defendit.

unit.source: “Deceiving through soul-level communication isn’t out of the realm of possibility. Moreover, it’s always simpler to dupe the illiterate,” Charname muttered his internal grievances once again.
unit.target: “Decipere per communicationem animorum non est impossibile. Praeterea, semper facilius est ignorantes decipere,” Charname iterum murmurat.

unit.source: He furrowed his brow and inquired, “Did the imposter Juan Oro inform you that the sea prayer ritual failed last year?”
unit.target: Frons contraxit et interrogavit: “Num imposter Juan Oro tibi nuntiavit ritum precationis maris anno praeterito defecisse?”

unit.source: “No. If he had, I wouldn’t have chartered a boat at Port Santa,” Nolfi expressed her frustration on the matter.
unit.target: “Minime. Si id fuisset, navem ad Portum Santa non emi,” Nolfi irata dixit.

unit.source: Had she known from the beginning that last year’s sea prayer ritual had faltered, she would have anticipated heightened vigilance at Port Santa this year.
unit.target: Si ab initio scivisset ritum precationis maris anni praeteriti defecisse, praecognoverat vigilantiam auctam in Porto Santa hoc anno.

unit.source: Those attempting to rent a boat for a sea journey would undoubtedly be on a watch list.
unit.target: Qui navem ad iter maris conducere conantur, indubitanter in indice vigilium erunt.

unit.source: Charname wore a perplexed expression.
unit.target: Charname vultum perplexum gerebat.

unit.source: “Wouldn’t that mean the imposter Juan Oro was expecting you to be apprehended by Lato Guiaro…”
unit.target: “Nonne hoc significat imposter Juan Oro te a Lato Guiaro capi expectare...”

unit.source: Half a year ago, neither April Fool’s nor anyone with ulterior motives in Port Santa had foreseen Lumian’s arrival to investigate the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Ante sex menses, nec Stultorum Aprilis nec quisquam ulterioris propositi in Porto Santa adventum Lumiani ad ritum precationis maris explorandum praevidit.

unit.source: This suggested that Nolfi’s original role wasn’t designed to lure Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc indicabat munus originale Nolfi non esse destinatum ad Lumian alliciendum.

unit.source: It might have been part of April Fool’s initial plan until they reconsidered, opting to exploit the great adventurer’s investigations.
unit.target: Fortasse pars fuit consilii initialis Stultorum Aprilis, donec reconsideraverunt, optantes investigationes magni adventarii explere.

unit.source: Under such circumstances, letting Nolfi be captured by Lato Guiaro was evidently not a mere oversight in April Fool’s plan, unless that was their intention all along.
unit.target: Sub talibus condicionibus, sinere Nolfi a Lato Guiaro capi, manifeste non fuerat simplex error in consilio Stultorum Aprilis, nisi id semper propositum eorum fuisset.

unit.source: Is Nolfi being thrown into the mix to confuse the Fisheries Guild and sow suspicion among other committee members against Juan Oro?
unit.target: Num Nolfi in mixturam iacitur ut Gildam Piscariorum confundat et suspicionem inter reliquos membros consilii adversus Juan Oro serat?

unit.source: A rift between them would hinder their cooperation.
unit.target: Divortium inter eos cooperationem impediat.

unit.source: But this strategy doesn’t seem cunning enough…
unit.target: Sed haec ratio non videtur satis callida esse…

unit.source: Is it an attempt to divert the Earth Mother Church’s attention from this year’s sea prayer ritual and redirect it towards Nolfi?
unit.target: Num conatur Ecclesiam Matris Terrae ab hoc anno ritu precationis maris avertere et ad Nolfi convertere?

unit.source: Or… or…
unit.target: Vel… vel…

unit.source: Franca, posing as Charname, had a guess.
unit.target: Franca, simulans Charname, coniecturam habuit.

unit.source: Or perhaps, Lato Guiaro is a member of April Fool’s!
unit.target: Vel fortasse Lato Guiaro membrum Stultorum Aprilis est!

unit.source: The moment Nolfi arrived at Port Santa and tried to rent a boat, she was apprehended.
unit.target: Nolfi, cum ad Portum Santa pervenisset et navem conducere conata esset, capta est.

unit.source: Not only does Lato Guiaro hold complete sway over this “collaborator,” but he also offers corresponding protection…
unit.target: Non solum Lato Guiaro hunc “collaboratorem” plene administrat, sed etiam idoneam protectionem praebet…

unit.source: Could it be that when the sea prayer ritual is on the brink of commencing, he will feign a lapse in vigilance, allowing Nolfi to escape successfully and secure a boat?
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut, cum ritus precationis maris initium capere prope sit, ille vigilantiae lapsum simul fingeat, quo Nolfi feliciter effugeret et navem assequeretur?

unit.source: With this speculation in mind, the more Franca considered Lato Guiaro, the more something felt awry.
unit.target: Hac speculatione innixa, quanto magis Franca Lato Guiaro considerabat, tanto magis aliquid male se habere videbatur.

unit.source: Whether it was the intel provided by the Knight of Swords or information from the authorities, a consistent message emerged:
unit.target: Sive notitia a Milite Gladii sive ex auctoritatibus recepta, constans nuntius emersit:

unit.source: Lato Guiaro had slept in separate rooms from his wife many years ago!
unit.target: Lato Guiaro in cellis separatis a uxore sua multos annos abhinc dormiverat!

unit.source: For transmigrators, after taking over the original owner’s body, their greatest apprehension was being exposed by those around them through various details.
unit.target: Nam transmigratoribus, postquam corpus originalis possederunt, maxima eorum sollicitudo erat, ne ab iis circumstantibus variis indicibus detegerentur.

unit.source: Among these people, the ones most likely to unveil their disguises were their deeply connected parents and spouses who shared the same bed.
unit.target: Inter eos, qui larvas suas revelare poterant, erant parentes et coniugi, qui intime conexi erant et eundem lectum communicabant.

unit.source: In particular, the latter were privy to many interaction habits unknown to others.
unit.target: Praesertim illi novebant plurimas mores interactionis, quae aliis ignotae erant.

unit.source: In such circumstances, opting to sleep in separate rooms was evidently a form of self-protection for transmigrators.
unit.target: In talibus condicionibus, eligere dormire in cellis separatis, manifeste, forma pro sua tutela erat transmigratoribus.

unit.source: Initially, Franca had a fleeting suspicion when she came across this information, but she promptly dismissed it.
unit.target: Initio, Franca suspicionem efhemeram habuit cum has notitias occurrisset, sed eam celeriter abjecit.

unit.source: Firstly, it wasn’t uncommon for a middle-aged man and his wife to have separate sleeping quarters.
unit.target: Primum, non erat insolitum virum medii aetatis et uxorem eius cellas dormitorias separatas habere.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro wasn’t the sole Fisheries Guild committee member to adopt this practice.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro non solus membrum consilii Gildae Piscariorum fuit qui hanc praxim suscepit.

unit.source: Secondly, Lato Guiaro had previously been forcibly controlled by the Knight of Swords and Lumian before being subjected to truth serum.
unit.target: Secundo, Lato Guiaro antea a Milite Gladii et Lumiano vi coercitus fuit, antequam potione veritatis subiectus esset.

unit.source: During subsequent questioning, he displayed no indications of ties to April Fool’s.
unit.target: Subsequentibus quaestionibus, nullas indicationes nexuum ad Stultorum Aprilis ostendit.

unit.source: He didn’t even betray any signs of stifling laughter when discussing marrying the sea!
unit.target: Neque quidem ostendit ullas notas risus cohibendi, cum de nuptiis cum mari loqueretur!

unit.source: However, what if Lato Guiaro, who willingly transmitted Nolfi’s information, had prepped in advance to elude the adventurer’s detection and had cloaked a portion of his memories through Hypnosis?
unit.target: Attamen, quid si Lato Guiaro, qui libenter notitias Nolfi transmisit, antea se praeparaverit ut detectionem adventarii eluderet et partem memoriarum suarum per hypnosin celasset?

unit.source: The truth serum fundamentally heightened the inclination to share with others.
unit.target: Serum veritatis fundamentice auxit inclinationem ad communicandum cum aliis.

unit.source: Anything beyond the user’s knowledge or comprehension remained veiled.
unit.target: Quidquid extra scientiam aut comprehensionem usoris erat, velatum manebat.

unit.source: The pressing question now was: where did Lato Guiaro acquire Beyonders or items with similar capabilities through April Fool’s channels?
unit.target: Quaestio premens erat nunc: ubi Lato Guiaro Beyonders vel similia instrumenta per canales Stultorum Aprilis obtinuit?

unit.source: Franca, increasingly convinced that Lato Guiaro was Ultraman, recalled a crucial detail: the current Governor of the Sea, Simon, belonged to the Guiaro family!
unit.target: Franca, magis persuasus Lato Guiaro Ultraman esse, recordatus est rei maximi momenti: gubernator maris praesentis, Simon, familiae Guiaro pertinere!

unit.source: Previously, Juan Oro had heeded her advice to conduct a blood test on everyone, excluding Lumian, who boarded the ship.
unit.target: Praecedens, Juan Oro consilium eius audivit ut in omnibus sanguinis examina facerentur, excepto Lumiano, qui navem conscendit.

unit.source: The aim was to confirm familial ties and unveil any outsiders attempting to infiltrate in disguise.
unit.target: Propositum erat nexūs familiares confirmare et externos detegere, qui sub specie dissimulandi infiltrandi conabantur.

unit.source: What if Simon Guiaro was Lato Guiaro in disguise?
unit.target: Quid si Simon Guiaro Lato Guiaro sub specie dissimulata esset?

unit.source: This method would only affirm his identity!
unit.target: Hic modus solum identitatem eius affirmaret!

unit.source: On the betrothal ship, now resting on the seabed as if weighed down by a colossal boulder,
unit.target: In nave sponsali, nunc in fundo maris, quasi ingenti saxo onerata,

unit.source: Simon Guiaro, positioned at the bow, appeared bewildered, his face a mixture of panic and confusion.
unit.target: Simon Guiaro, in prora positus, attonitus apparuit, facies eius ex pavoris et confusionis mixta.

unit.source: Yet, a faint curl formed at the corners of his mouth.
unit.target: Attamen, in angulis oris eius levis curvatura orta est.

unit.source: At that moment, the Governor of the Sea handover ritual from the previous night flashed in his mind.
unit.target: In illo momento, ritu traditionis Gubernatoris Maris ex vespera in mente eius fulsit.

unit.source: Clad in a pristine blue suit, Simon Guiaro entered the hall, noting his predecessor, Governor of the Sea Miguel, clad in a retro white robe, observing him.
unit.target: Indutus veste caerulea nitida, Simon Guiaro in aulam intravit, animadvertens praecessori suo, Gubernatori Maris Miguel, in toga alba antiquata induto, qui eum observabat.

unit.source: Following the predetermined procedure, he uttered the prearranged words.
unit.target: Secundum praeordinatum ordinem, verba praeconata edixit.

unit.source: “I’ll leave the sea to you.”
unit.target: “Mare tibi relinquam.”

unit.source: “It’s my honor,” Simon Guiaro responded solemnly as he advanced toward the other party.
unit.target: “Honor mihi est,” Simon Guiaro sollemniter respondit, dum ad alteram partem progressus est.

unit.source: Miguel extended his right hand, and Simon Guiaro reached out for a handshake.
unit.target: Miguel dextram manum protulit, et Simon Guiaro manum porrigens, eam premere coepit.

unit.source: This gesture symbolized the departure of the former Governor of the Sea and the commencement of Simon Guiaro’s role as the present Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Hoc gestu discessum pristini Gubernatoris Maris et initium muneris Simon Guiaro ut Gubernatoris Maris praesentis significabant.

unit.source: After the handshake, they passed each other by.
unit.target: Post concussum manus, invicem praeterierunt.

unit.source: As they turned their gazes in opposite directions, the corners of their lips subtly curled upwards.
unit.target: Cum oculos in contrarias partes verterent, anguli labiorum leviter sursum convoluti sunt.

unit.source: Under the scrutiny of the numerous statues surrounding them, one advanced while the other exited the hall.
unit.target: Sub vigili statueorum multitudine, unus progreditur, dum alter ex aula exit.

unit.source: 576 Palace
unit.target: 576 Palatium

unit.source: 576 Palace
unit.target: 576 Palatium

unit.source: Having transformed into Simon through a Seer pathway’s Sealed Artifact, Lato Guiaro observed the illusory starlight surrounding them, akin to seawater caught in a vortex.
unit.target: Mutatus in Simon per rem sigillatam itineris vatis, Lato Guiaro stellam illusoriam quae circum eos fulgebat contemplatus est, instar aquae maris in vortice capta.

unit.source: It cascaded down, forming a massive funnel.
unit.target: Cascavit deorsum, ingentem infundibulum formans.

unit.source: The origin of this vortex was the humanoid Sealed Artifact they had “abducted” from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church!
unit.target: Origo huius vortici fuit artifactum sigillatum humanoideo, quod ex Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardoris rapuerant!

unit.source: After the exposure of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s internal affairs and the consecutive deaths of Loki and I Know Someone, one resurrected at the cost of a precious opportunity, while the other met a permanent end.
unit.target: Post expositionem rerum internarum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crisporum et mortibus consecutivis Loki et I Know Someone, unus resurrexit, pretiosa occasione impensa, alter vero in finem perpetuum incidit.

unit.source: They adjusted their initial sea sacrifice plan and activated a backup strategy to counter potential interference from the Research Society.
unit.target: Consilium primum sacrificii maritimi accommodaverunt et stratagemata subsidiaria activaverunt ad subtrahendam interpositionem potentialem ab illa Societate.

unit.source: According to the revived Loki’s warning, Hela, the society’s vice president, had likely ascended to Sequence 4, reaching demigod status, and switched from the Death pathway to the Evernight pathway.
unit.target: Secundum monitionem Loki revivificati, Hela, vice praesidis societatis, verisimiliter ad Ordinem IV ascenderat, statum semideus adeptans, et ab itinere mortis in viam noctis aeternae transiit.

unit.source: Depending solely on Ultraman, Bard, and Mad Lady, their intricate plans would crumble before absolute strength.
unit.target: Confisi solum in Ultraman, Bard et Mad Lady, consilia eorum intricata ante vim absolutam corruerent.

unit.source: Of course, they were confident if it were just Hela alone.
unit.target: Scilicet, fiduciam habebant, si sola Hela aderat.

unit.source: Confidence wavered when considering President Gandalf, an enigma, and the other vice presidents, alongside the troublesome society members.
unit.target: Fides labefactata est, cum considerabant Praesidem Gandalf, enigmam, et ceteros vice praesides, una cum incommodis sodalibus societatatis.

unit.source: Dealing with them now seemed an insurmountable challenge.
unit.target: Aggredi eos nunc videbatur pro provocatione insuperabili.

unit.source: Starlight surged, revealing a sorrowful woman in black nun’s attire to everyone on the ship.
unit.target: Lux stellarum exsultavit, revelans mulierem lugubrem in veste monialis nigrae omnibus in nave.

unit.source: Her presence felt magnetic, as if attempting to absorb everything around her.
unit.target: Praesentia eius velut magnetica videbatur, quasi omnia circa ipsa attrahens.

unit.source: It was akin to an unusually heavy iron ball falling from the center of a taut fishing net, dragging objects down and pulling the surrounding net with it.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat pila ferrea insolita gravitate, e centro rete piscatorio tenso cadens, obiecta trahens et rete circumjacentem secum arrigens.

unit.source: In these circumstances, previously still items naturally slipped away.
unit.target: In his condicionibus, prius immobilia elementa naturaliter labebant.

unit.source: The most impacted was Juan Oro, with a potent sea bloodline and formidable sea power.
unit.target: Maxime affectus est Juan Oro, qui potentem sanguinis maritimi consanguinitatem et formidabilem vim maris habuit.

unit.source: Resisting the sea’s fury, he felt a spatial inversion, as if his front and back had switched to up and down.
unit.target: Resistens iram maris, sensit inversionem spatii, ac si partes frontales et dorsales eius in sursum atque deorsum commutatae essent.

unit.source: Like a lost person above an abyss, he involuntarily “fell” to the bottom at an accelerated speed, where the woman in black nun’s attire awaited.
unit.target: Sicut vagus super abyssum, ineluctabiliter ad imum celeriter cecidit, ubi mulier in veste monialis nigrae exspectabat.

unit.source: The deputy hosts, apart from Lumian, felt an unseen force tugging at them.
unit.target: Praefecti vicarii, praeter Lumian, senserunt vim invisibilem eos trahentem.

unit.source: Struggling, they staggered towards the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Titubantes, ad artifactum sigillatum humanoideum contendebant.

unit.source: The sea’s power within them wavered, propelling them to the surface, revealing sparkling starry scales that hinted at losing control.
unit.target: Vis maris in illis vacillabat, eos ad superficiem impellens, et squamas micantes instar stellarum revelabat, quae imperium amittere insinuabant.

unit.source: The Maidens of the Sea and the sailors on the ship struggled against the terrifying suction force, swaying on the spot.
unit.target: Mulieres maritimae et nautae in nave certabant adversus vim sugentem terribilem, in loco titubantes.

unit.source: Some experienced their skin smoothing, others felt scales emerging in their flesh, and a few shifted their feet intermittently.
unit.target: Nonnulli sensitērunt cutem suam leniorem fieri, alii squamas in carne emergere, et pauci pedes intermittenter commutatos esse.

unit.source: Lumian, though relatively unscathed, exerted considerable strength to resist the relentless pull.
unit.target: Lumian, quamquam relative intactus, vim ingentem ad repellendum trahendi inexorabilem adhibuit.

unit.source: As an Ascetic, he vaguely sensed the river of fate for everyone present surging toward the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Ut asceticus, vage sensit flumen fati omnium praesentium ad artifactum sigillatum humanoideum impellere.

unit.source: Future tributaries narrowed and converged, leading inevitably to one possibility—death.
unit.target: Futuri affluentes coarctati et convenientes, ad unum exitum inevitabilem—mortem—ducebant.

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian grasped why the humanoid Sealed Artifact could use words to curse someone to death.
unit.target: In illo momento, Lumian intellexit cur artifactum sigillatum humanoideo verbis uti posset ad maledicendum aliquem morti.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro reached out, gripping the shipboard to resist the invisible pull from the woman.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro manum extendit, praeam navis tenens, ad repellendam vim invisibilem ab illa muliere.

unit.source: His gaze scanned the people on the ship, then returned to the sea’s depths.
unit.target: Oculi eius homines in nave perinspecti sunt, deinde in profundos maris revertit.

unit.source: The ship descended, surrounded by a translucent wall of azure seawater.
unit.target: Navis descendebat, circumdata muri translucidis aquae maris caeruleae.

unit.source: Sea creatures swam within, seemingly oblivious to the anomaly.
unit.target: Creaturae maritimae intus natabant, quasi insensibiles anomaliae essent.

unit.source: In the distance, the spindle-shaped silver-gray object at the sea bottom, its tip embedded in rocks, came into view.
unit.target: In longinquo, obiectum fusiforme argenteo-cinereum in fundo maris, cuius acies in saxis insita erat, conspectum factum est.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro suppressed any sign of a smile.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro omne indicium risus repressit.

unit.source: He was nearing his destination.
unit.target: Propinabat metae suae.

unit.source: The fools from the Fisheries Guild and the oblivious Earth Mother Church might never comprehend what lay sealed at the bottom of the sea here.
unit.target: Stulti ex Gildā Piscatoria et Ecclesia Matris Terrae inscius numquam intellexerent quid hic in fundo maris sigillatum iaceretur.

unit.source: It wasn’t a so-called “palace” but a spaceship!
unit.target: Non erat quod vocaretur “palatium”, sed navis spatialis!

unit.source: A spacecraft that infiltrated during the Fourth Epoch!
unit.target: Navis spatialis, quae Aetate Quarta intravit!

unit.source: It boasted a sci‑fi dimension, housing advanced technology entwined with mystical Beyonder elements, forming the core of the entire spaceship.
unit.target: Ea gloriabatur in dimensione scientiae fictilis, technologia provecta habens cum elementis mysticis Beyonder contextis, quae cor totius astronavis constituebant.

unit.source: A locator, a petri dish, a breeding box, a key component of a Stargate—a place where a Beyonder object slumbered.
unit.target: Invenitor, vas petrii, arca generandi, pars clavis stargati—locus ubi obiectum Beyonder quiescebat.

unit.source: The Ring of the Sea Queen, crafted by the sea spawn, served as the spacecraft’s key.
unit.target: Anulus Reginae Maris, a prole maris confectus, clavis astronavis fuit.

unit.source: Only when the external seal weakened annually could it activate the spacecraft’s internal power, merging the two to crack the core seal!
unit.target: Tantum cum sigillum externum per annum infirmaretur, poterat vim internam astronavis excitare, miscens ambos ut sigillum nuclei rumpat!

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s gaze grew greedier as he stared at the faintly discernible silver‑gray behemoth.
unit.target: Aspectus Lato Guiaro avidior factus est, dum ingentem argenteo‑cinereum vix perceptibilem considerabat.

unit.source: His aim extended beyond temporary authority—to become the true Governor of the Sea and the spaceship’s owner.
unit.target: Propositum eius ultra auctoritatem temporariam protendebat—fieri verus Gubernator Maris et dominus astronavis.

unit.source: This would grant him immense power and the ability to accomplish unimaginable feats using the spaceship.
unit.target: Hoc ei daret ingentem potentiam atque facultatem ad res inauditas per astronavis exsequendas.

unit.source: The azure sea, tinged with a hint of green, encircled the ship as if respectfully escorting them into the palace of the sea.
unit.target: Mare caeruleum, leviter viridum, navem circumiaciebat, tamquam reverenter eos in palatium maris ducebat.

unit.source: Seeing the sea’s fury interrupted by the woman’s sudden appearance, making her the most perilous element, Juan Oro wasted no time deepening his connection with the sea.
unit.target: Videns furiam maris, interruptam per repentinam adventum mulieris, quae eam partem periculosissimam reddidit, Juan Oro nullo tempore cessavit ad coniunctionem cum mari augendam.

unit.source: At that moment, he temporarily became the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: In eo momento, ad tempus, factus est Gubernator Maris.

unit.source: He resisted the terrifying suction force.
unit.target: Repugnavit vim sugentem terribilem.

unit.source: Abruptly, the humanoid Sealed Artifact “departed” from the ship, entering an empty darkness.
unit.target: Subito, artifactum sigillatum humanoideo a nave discessit, in tenebras vacuas ingrediens.

unit.source: Resplendent stars flickered above, below, and to her left.
unit.target: Stellae resplendentes scintillabant supra, infra, atque ad sinistram eius.

unit.source: Ahead stood Juan Oro, covered in starlight scales, deep-eyed, and with completely white hair.
unit.target: Ante stabat Juan Oro, opertus squamis stellarum micantibus, oculis profundis, et capillis omnino albis.

unit.source: Juan Oro raised his right hand, swiping his finger.
unit.target: Juan Oro dextram manum erexit, digito submurmurans.

unit.source: The “stars” plummeted with fiery tails, stirring up waves.
unit.target: Stellae ceciderunt cum caudis ardentibus, undas excitantes.

unit.source: On the betrothal ship, everyone lost the momentum to rush to the same place.
unit.target: In nave nuptiali, omnes impetus ad eundem locum properandi amiserunt.

unit.source: However, the power they used to resist the pull couldn’t be withdrawn, causing them to fall in the opposite direction.
unit.target: Tamen vis, qua repugnaverunt attrahenti, revocari non potuit, quod faceret eos in contrariam directionem cadere.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro feigned a similar state, crashing into the bow of the ship.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro statum simile simulavit, in proram navis impingens.

unit.source: Seeing the silver‑gray behemoth approaching, his heart leaped with joy.
unit.target: Cum ingentem argenteo‑cinereum appropinquantem vidit, cor eius gaudio exsultavit.

unit.source: He was about to recite a phrase he didn’t comprehend but understood its purpose.
unit.target: Paratus erat verba recitandi, quae non penitus intellexit, sed propositum eorum scivit.

unit.source: It was a coded order to completely open the spaceship’s door and establish an energy passageway, allowing him to enter under protection!
unit.target: Illa erat mandatum codificatum ad plene aperiendum ostium astronavis et ad viam energeticae transitus instituendam, ut ei sub tutela intrandi liceret!

unit.source: April Fool’s had been established for several years.
unit.target: Dies Aprilis Stultorum per plures annos institutus erat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s decision to target the sea prayer ritual last year was influenced by the resolution of other voices from the Governor of the Sea, Maidens of the Sea, and certain sea spawn.
unit.target: Decisio Lato Guiaro, anno ultimo ad rituum precationem maritimam intendendum, evenit ex resolutione aliorum vocum a Gubernatore Maris, Virginibus Maris, et quibusdam prole maris.

unit.source: This allowed them to understand the significance of the three crucial passages.
unit.target: Hoc eos adiit ut significationem trium viis maximi momenti comprehendere possent.

unit.source: “I espouse thee, O sea…” was one of the passages, its true meaning being to inject energy into the created key and enter a password.
unit.target: “I espouse thee, O sea…” erat una ex viis, cuius verus sensus erat energiam in clavem creatae infundere atque tesserae ingredi.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro was about to recite the second paragraph, which served as an order to initiate the spaceship.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro parabat se secundum paragraphum recitare, quod ut ordo ad astronavis inchoandum valeret.

unit.source: Initially, he and Bard planned to deceive the foolish Nolfi, tricking her into reciting the words to avoid danger.
unit.target: Primum, ipse et Bard constituerunt Nolfi stulte fallere, eam convincendo verba recitare ne periculum incideret.

unit.source: Once the spaceship activated and left these waters, the sea prayer ritual would naturally conclude.
unit.target: Cum astronavis activatus est et has aquas reliquit, ritualis precationis maritimae naturaliter finem habebunt.

unit.source: There wouldn’t be any follow-up.
unit.target: Nulla postactio sequeretur.

unit.source: Whether it involved self‑destruction or not, it wasn’t a concern for her; she had achieved her essential goal.
unit.target: Sive in auto‑destructionem incidat, illa non curabat; propositum eius principale perfecit.

unit.source: However, the situation changed drastically, especially when the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society learned about the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Attamen res fundamentaliter mutatae sunt, praesertim cum Societas Investigationis Papionum Crisporum de ritu precationis maritimae novit.

unit.source: Ultraman and Bard modified their plans, roping in external aid and reducing Nolfi’s role.
unit.target: Ultraman et Bard consilia sua mutaverunt, auxilium externe adligantes et partem Nolfi minuentes.

unit.source: Eventually, she became bait to lead troublemakers, represented by Lumian Lee and Hidden Blade.
unit.target: Postremo, illa facta est esca ad ducendos tumultuosos, qui a Lumian Lee et Hidden Blade repraesentabantur.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro opened his mouth and muttered the words.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro os aperuit et verba submurmuravit.

unit.source: As he finished speaking, he looked expectantly at the spaceship at the sea bottom.
unit.target: Cum sermonem absolvit, expectanter ad astronavis in fundo maris intuitus est.

unit.source: But nothing happened!
unit.target: Sed nihil evenit!

unit.source: How is this possible?
unit.target: Quomodo hoc fieri potest?

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s heart tightened, feeling a sudden sense of danger.
unit.target: Cor Lato Guiaro contraxit, subitum periculi sensum experiens.

unit.source: With a jolt, he saw everything disintegrate like a soap bubble, vanishing.
unit.target: Cum ictu, omnia vidit quasi bulla saponaria evanescere.

unit.source: Lumian, transformed into Brian, had arrived near him at some point.
unit.target: Lumian, in Brian transfiguratus, prope eum advenerat.

unit.source: A dream!
unit.target: Somnium!

unit.source: He had been dreaming since Juan Oro pulled the humanoid Sealed Artifact into the Cosmic Void!
unit.target: Somniabat ex quo Juan Oro artifactum sigillatum humanoideo in Vacuum Cosmicum traxit.

unit.source: Hela! This name flashed through Lato Guiaro’s mind.
unit.target: Hela! Hoc nomen per mentem Lato Guiaro scintillavit.

unit.source: He had paid attention to whether there were other ships lurking around!
unit.target: Attentus erat num aliae naves latent.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, formless hands appeared around Lato Guiaro, pushing Lumian away.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius trahebantur, manus informae circa Lato Guiaro apparuerunt, Lumian repellentes.

unit.source: Then, he saw a sailboat, clearly abandoned by time, outlined in the cavity surrounded by seawater beside the betrothal ship.
unit.target: Tum, vidit naviculam velariam, manifeste tempore relictam, in cavitate circumdata aquā maritima iuxta navem nuptialem delineatam.

unit.source: Shadows clung to its canvas, and corpses stood on the observatory.
unit.target: Umbrae ad velum eius adhaerebant, et cadavera in speculatorio stabant.

unit.source: The deck was littered with decaying or boneless undead creatures.
unit.target: Pavimentum navis erat congestum creaturis putrīdīs aut ossibus carentibus, quasi mortuīs.

unit.source: At the bow of the ship, a woman dressed as a black widow stood silently.
unit.target: In prora navis, mulier, veste viduae nigrae induta, tacite stabat.

unit.source: Hela!
unit.target: Hela!

unit.source: Less than four hours ago, Franca, posing as Charname, signaled Nolfi and Batna to wait for further arrangements.
unit.target: Ante minus quam quattuor horās, Franca, se ut Charname praebens, Nolfi et Batna signum dedit ut ulteriores dispositiones exspectarent.

unit.source: Returning to the cabin, she entered the captain’s cabin and addressed Hela, standing by the window.
unit.target: Rediens ad cubicula, intravit cubiculam capitānī et ad Hela, iuxta fēnestram stantem, locuta est.

unit.source: “I’ve roughly guessed who Ultraman is, but I can’t be sure.”
unit.target: “Fere coniexi quis sit Ultraman, sed certus esse non possum.”

unit.source: “I guessed as much,” Hela replied, having overheard Franca and Nolfi’s conversation.
unit.target: “Sic coniexi,” respondit Hela, cum sermonem Francae et Nolfi auscultasset.

unit.source: Franca gritted her teeth and said, “If it’s really Lato Guiaro, there will definitely be variables on the ship. I have to quickly summon Lumian’s messenger and inform him of our guess.”
unit.target: Franca dentes contrāxit et dixit: “Si vere Lato Guiaro sit, pro certo varia erunt in nave. Celeriter nuntiarium Lumiani convocandum est atque eum de nostrīs coniectūrīs certiōrem facere debeo.”

unit.source: “Let’s wait a little longer and time it well. We’ll send the message when the deputy hosts leave the Governor of the Sea’s residence but prior to boarding the ship,” Hela advised.
unit.target: “Exspectemus paulo diutius et tempus bene disponāmus. Nuntiarium mittāmus cum hospitēs vicarii domum Gubernatōris Maris relinquant, sed ante navem conscendendum,” monet Hela.

unit.source: Franca confirmed succinctly, “Got it.”
unit.target: Franca breviter confirmāvit: “Intellectum.”

unit.source: She observed Hela, with her light‑blond hair naturally cascading over her shoulders, and her dark eyes seemingly darker as she meticulously engraved patterns and arranged items on the captain’s cabin desk.
