unit.target: Illam spectāvit, Hela, cuius capillī flavī naturaliter super umeros decurrunt, et oculī obscuriārēs videbantur dum diligenter figuras incidebat et res in mensā cubiculī capitānī ordinābat.

unit.source: With curiosity, she promptly inquired, “What’s this for?”
unit.target: Cum curiōsitāte, statim quaesivit: “Ad quid hoc?”

unit.source: “Setting up a ritual to completely conceal the entire ship, preventing anyone from discovering it. It’s impossible for me to do this on my own. I can only achieve it through a deity’s help. And She should be very willing to help.”
unit.target: “Instituendo ritu ad totam navem omnīnō tegendam, ut nemo eam detegat. Mihi sōlī hoc efficere īmpossībilis est. Tantum per auxilium deitātis hoc assequi possum, et Ea valde lībēns adiuvāre dēbet.”

unit.source: Without hesitation, Hela took off the pure silver ring embedded with a black diamond from her right hand and placed it in the center of the altar.
unit.target: Sine dubitātiōne, Hela annulum pūrum argenteum, in quo adamantum nigrum infixum erat, de manu dēstrā abstulit et in medium altāris posuit.

unit.source: On the betrothal ship, Lumian scrutinized Lato Guiaro, his body quivering with excitement.
unit.target: In nave nuptiali, Lumian Lato Guiaro inspectāvit, corpus eius exsultātiōne tremens.

unit.source: He couldn’t comprehend how the other party had thwarted the sea prayer ritual once again.
unit.target: Non potuit intellegere quōmodo altera pars ritu precationis maritimae iterum impedīret.

unit.source: After all, he had been vigilantly observing this “old friend” of his and hadn’t witnessed any ring‑switching.
unit.target: Nam ille hunc “amicum senem” eius diligenter observaverat et nullam permutationem annulī conspectus habebat.

unit.source: Nonetheless, it didn’t matter.
unit.target: Tamen, nihil refert.

unit.source: A well‑devised plan was not a fragile creation that crumbled with the slightest mistake.
unit.target: Consilium bene ordinatum non erat fragilis creatiō, quā minimo errō corrueret.

unit.source: It had to allow for enough margin for error!
unit.target: Satis locum ad errōs tolerandō conferebat!

unit.source: Similarly, Lato Guiaro couldn’t fathom how Hela and the ship had approached without triggering his detection.
unit.target: Similiter, Lato Guiaro non potuit comprehendere quōmodo Hela et navis accesserint sine actu detegendi.

unit.source: But it didn’t matter.
unit.target: Sed nihil tamen refert.

unit.source: If they hadn’t prepared for the interference of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society and Hela, they wouldn’t have taken action this time.
unit.target: Si parati non fuerunt ad obstructionem a Societāte Investigationis Papionum Crisporum et Hela, hoc tempore agere non potuerunt.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s eyes suddenly darkened, and specks of starlight illuminated.
unit.target: Oculī Lato Guiaro subito tenebrosi factī sunt, et micellae lucis stellarum relucuere.

unit.source: The surrounding azure seawater froze once more.
unit.target: Aqua maritima caerulea circumdatā iterum congela est.

unit.source: Here, he surpassed the old‑timer, Juan Oro.
unit.target: Hīc superavit senem, Juan Oro.

unit.source: He had long amassed the power to temporarily become the Governor of the Sea!
unit.target: Iamdiū potentiam congregaverat ad temporāriē Gubernatōrem Maris efficiendum!

unit.source: In the upcoming period, he would ascend to become the god of these waters!
unit.target: In temporibus futūris, ascendisset ut dēus harum aquārum fieret.

unit.target: 577 Eadem Cogitationes

unit.target: 577 Eadem Cogitationes

unit.source: On the flower ship, Lato Guiaro extended his arms, and sunlight erupted from his body.
unit.target: In nave florum, Lato Guiaro brachia extendit, et claritas solis ex corpore eius erupit.

unit.source: The sky dimmed, and the sea approached nothingness.
unit.target: Caelum obscuratum est, et mare ad nihilum appropinquavit.

unit.source: Illusory stars emerged among them, expanding like distant suns.
unit.target: Stellae illusoriae inter eos apparuerunt, dilatantes quasi soli remoti.

unit.source: In the next moment, Lato Guiaro swiftly spoke a few words in ancient Hermes with a grave expression, “God says entering dreams is ineffective!”
unit.target: Mox, in momento sequenti, Lato Guiaro celeriter pauca verba in antiqua lingua Hermes, vultu gravissimo edecit: “Deus dicit in somnia ingredi inefficax esse!”

unit.source: With the reinforcement of the sea’s power, he neared the status of a Sequence 4 demigod.
unit.target: Auxilio potentiae maris confirmato, ad statum semidei ordinis IV appropinquavit.

unit.source: This allowed him to employ the Notary’s “God says” ability more precisely, diminishing Hela’s capacity to compel people into entering dreams.
unit.target: Hoc ei concessit ut facultatem notarii “Deus dicit” accuratius adhiberet, minuens vim Helae coegendi homines in somnia ingredi.

unit.source: Without this intervention, if Hela used her ability to forcefully restrain him without guiding him into an easily interruptible dream to gather information, breaking free from such a demigod’s dream would prove challenging in a short time.
unit.target: Sine hac interventione, si Hela facultate sua eum vi cohibere conatus esset, sine eum in somnium facile interpellabile ad informationes colligendas ducendo, ex tali semidei somnio evadere breviter arduum foret.

unit.source: He would become like a feral dog under anesthesia, at Lumian Lee’s mercy.
unit.target: Fieret ut canis ferus sub sopore, ad misericordiam Lumian Lee.

unit.source: The choice of “entering dreams is ineffective” over “sleeping is ineffective” was deliberate.
unit.target: Electio “in somnia ingredi inefficax est” potius quam “dormire inefficax est” deliberata fuit.

unit.source: The former was more specific and avoided potential ambiguity related to various abilities.
unit.target: Primum specificius fuit et ambiguitatem potentialem, quae ad varias facultates pertinebat, vitavit.

unit.source: Additionally, the Evernight pathway’s induced slumber originated from being forcefully drawn into a dream, not the other way around.
unit.target: Praeterea, sopor inducitus per viam Evernight ex vi coacta in somnium ducendo oriebatur, non ex contraria causa.

unit.source: Essentially, it was a dream, not sleep.
unit.target: Essentialiter, somnium erat, non somnus.

unit.source: As Lato Guiaro pronounced the ancient Hermes phrase “entering dreams is ineffective,” his body still felt as weighty as the humanoid Sealed Artifact, though not as exaggerated.
unit.target: Dum Lato Guiaro pronuntiavit antiquam sententiam Hermeticam “in somnia ingredi inefficax est,” corpus eius adhuc tam grave videbatur quam hominiforme Artifactum Sigillatum, quamquam non tam ostentatum.

unit.source: This stirred massive waves in the surrounding seawater, attempting to fill the void.
unit.target: Hoc movit fluctus ingentes in aquis circumjacentes, vacuitatem implere conantes.

unit.source: The sailboat manipulated by the undead creatures visibly swayed, nearly capsizing, severely impeding Hela’s further movements.
unit.target: Navis, a creaturis ex mortuis revivificatis tractata, conspicuē oscillabat, paene corruens, motus ulteriora Helae graviter impediens.

unit.source: Immediately after, Lato Guiaro reclined even further.
unit.target: Immediate post, Lato Guiaro se amplius reclinavit.

unit.source: A miniature, bright sun manifested in his eyes.
unit.target: Parvus et clarus sol in oculis eius apparuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the ethereal sky and the stars emerging from the sea emitted light of varying intensities.
unit.target: Simul, caelum aetherium et stellae ex mari emergentes lucem diversarum intensitatum emiserunt.

unit.source: They interweaved, crafting a splendid and pure blazing pillar of light.
unit.target: Se intertexuerunt, columen lucis splendidum et purum ardens conficientes.

unit.source: The majestic pillar of light descended, enveloping the front half of the sailboat, where Hela stood.
unit.target: Columna lucis magnifica descendit, involvens dimidiam partem anterior navis, ubi Hela stabat.

unit.source: It melted the undead creatures there as if they had evaporated, leaving no trace of darkness.
unit.target: Illos creaturas ex mortuis revivificatas illic liquavit, quasi evanuerint, relicta nulla vestigia obscuritatis.

unit.source: Hela became engulfed by the pillar of light.
unit.target: Hela columnae lucis absorpta est.

unit.source: This was the Light of Holiness, an ability of a Sequence 5 Priest of the Light of the Sun pathway.
unit.target: Haec erat Lux Sanctitatis, facultas Sacerdotis Sequentiae V viae Lucis Solis.

unit.source: Despite not consuming a corresponding Sequence 4 potion and lacking demigod-level abilities after becoming the temporary Governor of the Sea, Lato Guiaro could elevate his acquired abilities to near Sequence 4.
unit.target: Quamquam poculum Sequentiae IV idoneum non consumpsit et facultates semideae non obtinuit postquam Provectus Maris temporarius factus est, Lato Guiaro facultates suas adeptas prope Sequentiam IV elevare poterat.

unit.source: Moreover, the Light of Holiness had undergone a mutation.
unit.target: Insuper, Lux Sanctitatis mutationem subiit.

unit.source: It no longer emanated from a single sun.
unit.target: Non iam ex uno sol emanabat.

unit.source: All the stars in the Cosmic Void contributed to its power.
unit.target: Omnes stellae in Vacuo Cosmico vim eius addiderunt.

unit.source: Coupled with the uniqueness of these waters, while not as potent as the Sequence 4 Flaring Sun of this pathway in purifying and destroying impure entities, its attack range and area of influence had significantly expanded.
unit.target: Coniuncta singularitate harum aquarum, etsi non ita potentia ut Solis Flagrantis Sequens IV huius viae in purgando et interficendo entia immunda, radius impetuum eius et spatium influentiae signanter extensum est.

unit.source: Having transmigrated into a Child of the Sea and possessing substantial boons, Lato Guiaro had carefully considered the Sun pathway potion, believing it posed no risks and might integrate with his bloodline and original abilities, bringing about remarkable changes.
unit.target: Transmigratus in Filium Maris et dotibus significativis praeditus, Lato Guiaro poculum viae Solis diligenter consideravit, creditque id nullum periculum esse et cum stirpe sanguinis eius et facultatibus originalibus integre coniungi posse, mutationes mirabiles ferens.

unit.source: The outcome aligned with his expectations.
unit.target: Eventus secundum exspectationem eius evenit.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lato Guiaro pivoted.
unit.target: Subito, Lato Guiaro se convertit.

unit.source: In the space behind him, Lumian’s figure swiftly materialized.
unit.target: In spatio post eum, figura Lumiani celeriter apparuit.

unit.source: He intended to exploit Lato Guiaro’s engagement with Hela to “teleport” closer, followed by a Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: Intendebat Lato Guiaro implicatum cum Hela ad propius teleporterandum, subsequente incantatione “Harrumph” uti.

unit.source: Gone from his eyes was any suppressed violence or madness.
unit.target: Ab oculis eius omnis violentia repressa et insania evanuerant.

unit.source: There was no fear whatsoever, as if he didn’t concern himself with the consequences of failing to assail the Governor of the Sea at close range.
unit.target: Nullus timor erat, quasi non curaret de consequentiis, si prope Gubernatorem Maris oppugnare deficeret.

unit.source: In Lato Guiaro’s dark and profound eyes, resplendent stars reflected.
unit.target: In oculis obscuris et profundis Lato Guiaro stellae splendidæ reflexæ sunt.

unit.source: Before Lumian could utter the harrumph, he plunged into the void, disappearing beneath the vast and distant cosmos.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian “Harrumph” edicere posset, in vacuum se immergit, sub vasto et remotissimo cosmo evanescens.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro withdrew his gaze and focused on the sailboat illuminated by the residual light.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro conspectum aversit et in navem vela luce residua illustratam intuebatur.

unit.source: He found an adversary like Lumian Lee repulsive.
unit.target: Inimicum, simile Lumian Lee, ei repulsivum videbatur.

unit.source: It wasn’t that he couldn’t be forcibly eliminated, but doing so might only exacerbate matters.
unit.target: Non quia vi tolli non posset, sed id tantum res aggravare poterat.

unit.source: He could potentially incur the indiscriminate wrath of a high‐ranking individual.
unit.target: Potest incurrere in iram indiscriminatam ab aliquo summo.

unit.source: His decision was to leverage the authority of the Governor of the Sea to banish his foe into a self‐created Cosmic Void, leaving him disoriented and unable to find an exit for the time being.
unit.target: Decisio eius fuit auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris adhibere ut hostem suum in Vacuo Cosmico ipso creato desterneret, relinquens eum confusum et exitu temporario inhibitum.

unit.source: Once he assumed control of the spaceship and became the true Governor of the Sea, he planned to return and calmly resolve the issue.
unit.target: Postquam gubernationem navis spatialis asumpsit et verus Gubernator Maris factus est, redire atque quaestionem placide solvere destinavit.

unit.source: At that precise moment, Juan Oro, entangled in a battle with the humanoid Sealed Artifact in his Cosmic Void, suddenly detected an anomaly.
unit.target: Illo momento, Juan Oro, in pugna cum Artifacto Sigillato hominiformi in suo Vacuo Cosmico implicatus, subito anomaliam detexit.

unit.source: His strength rapidly waned, and his dominion over the sea gradually diminished!
unit.target: Virtus eius celeriter defuit, et dominium eius super mare paulatim decrevit!

unit.source: It seemed like his temporary authority as Governor of the Sea was being usurped.
unit.target: Videbatur quod auctoritas eius temporaria ut Gubernator Maris subripienda esset.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the tidal wave capable of shattering ships vanished from the Cosmic Void, followed by the illusory cosmos itself.
unit.target: In momento, unda aestuosa, quae naves frangere posset, de Vacuo Cosmico evanuit, secuta ipsa cosmos illusorium.

unit.source: Juan Oro “reappeared” on the ship once more and “saw” the azure sea around him, towering like a mountain peak.
unit.target: Juan Oro in nave iterum “reapparuit” et “vidit” mare azureum circum eum, eminens sicut culmen montis.

unit.source: He “saw” Simon Guiaro, closely linked to the sea.
unit.target: Vidit Simon Guiaro, ad mare intime conexum.

unit.source: “It’s you!” His roar coincided with an involuntary bend, as if an invisible force pressed him down to the floor.
unit.target: “Tu es!” clamor eius coincidebat cum involuntaria flexione, quasi vis invisibilis eum ad terram deprimendum fuisset.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact had also returned, reinstating a formidable weight.
unit.target: Artifactum Sigillatum hominiforme etiam rediit, pondus formidabile restituens.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro gazed at her, his face covered in scales tinged with starlight.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro eam aspexit; facies ejus squamis micantibus, luce stellarum tinctis operta erat.

unit.source: Then, he pointed at Hela’s ship and spoke in a fluent language, “¥%…&”
unit.target: Deinde, ad navem Helae digitavit et lingua facili locutus est: “¥%…&”

unit.source: He didn’t comprehend the exact meaning of the sentence, but he understood that it could prompt the other party to attack a designated target.
unit.target: Non exacte intellexit sensum sententiae, sed animadvertit eam posse aliam partem ad certum propositum oppugnandum impellere.

unit.source: Although he harbored no fear of Hela in these waters, he remained vigilant of Gandalf and others who might be on the ship.
unit.target: Quamquam in his aquis nullus timor adversus Helam ferebatur, tamen de Gandalf aliisque, qui in nave esse poterent, vigilabat.

unit.source: Therefore, he had to give his utmost effort.
unit.target: Ergo, summam conationem dare debuit.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact’s sorrow dissipated slightly, and it nodded blankly.
unit.target: Dolor Artifacti Sigillati hominiformis paulum evanuit, et caput vacue annuit.

unit.source: Her body pivoted towards the sailboat, which bobbed in the “underwater waves.”
unit.target: Corpus eius se convertit ad navem vela, quae in undis subaquaneis fluctuabat.

unit.source: In an instant, Lato Guiaro bent down and grasped his throat.
unit.target: In instante, Lato Guiaro se inclinavit et collum suum apprehendit.

unit.source: Waa!
unit.target: Waa!

unit.source: He ejected a slender, sticky blob of flesh.
unit.target: Eiecit tenuem, viscosam globulam carnis.

unit.source: The flesh contorted and writhed, swiftly taking on a human form.
unit.target: Caro contorta et flexa est, celeriter formam humanam assumens.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro promptly straightened up and seized the moment to command,
unit.target: Lato Guiaro citissime se erexit et occasionem ceperit ut praeceptum daret,

unit.source: “Mad Lady, open the passageway to the spaceship!”
unit.target: “Domina Insana, aperi iter ad navem spatiale!”

unit.source: He wasn’t concerned that Mad Lady might usurp the position of the Governor of the Sea and become the owner of the spaceship because she lacked the sea bloodline.
unit.target: Non curabat ne Domina Insana Gubernatoris Maris locum subligere conaretur atque navem spatiale possideret, quoniam stirpis maris ei deesset.

unit.source: In the Cosmic Void crafted by Lato Guiaro, Lumian showed no urgency to find an exit or ascertain his coordinates.
unit.target: In Vacuo Cosmico Lato Guiaro creato, Lumian nullam festinationem exitum quaerendi aut suae positionis cognoscendi demonstravit.

unit.source: He simply “teleported” out.
unit.target: Simpliciter “teleportavit” foras.

unit.target: Collum suum tenuit.

unit.source: Waa!
unit.target: Waa!

unit.source: He ejected a slender, sticky blob of flesh.
unit.target: Eiecit tenuem, viscosam globulam carnis.

unit.source: The flesh contorted and writhed, swiftly taking on a human form.
unit.target: Caro contorta et flexa est, celeriter formam humanam assumens.

unit.source: Solow Motel, adjacent to Lumian’s suite.
unit.target: Solow Motel, iuxta conclave Lumiani.

unit.source: Recalling that Invisibility and Shadow Concealment were futile against Marionettists, Jenna pondered ways to locate Loki’s true form.
unit.target: Meminens quod Invisibilitas et Occultatio Umbrae contra Marionettistas vanae erant, Jenna de modis inveniendae verae formae Loki meditata est.

unit.source: Drawing on information from the Major Arcana card holders, she knew a Marionettist had to be within five meters of a target to transform individuals into marionettes.
unit.target: Ex informationibus ab tenentibus chartarum Major Arcana receptis, scivit Marionettistam esse intra radium quinquem metrorum circa cuiusdam scopum, ut singulos in marionettas converteret.

unit.source: In other words, Loki was undoubtedly within a five-meter radius of Lugano.
unit.target: Id est, Loki scilicet intra radium quinquem metrorum Lugani versabatur.

unit.source: Dammit, it’s all walls. My sight is blocked.
unit.target: Maledictum, omnes parietes sunt. Conspectus meus obstructus est.

unit.source: Otherwise, spotting Loki would be easier.
unit.target: Alio modo, Loki detegere facilius esset.

unit.source: At this hour, most guests are away, celebrating the sea prayer ritual…
unit.target: Hoc tempore, plerique hospites absunt, ritualem orationis maris celebrantes…

unit.source: Walls… If there are no walls…
unit.target: Muri… Si muri non sint…

unit.source: An idea struck Jenna.
unit.target: Idea Jenna occurvit.

unit.source: She glanced at Anthony and blurted out, “Did you bring enough money?”
unit.target: Illa oculos ad Anthonym intendens, subito exclamavit: “Attulistine satis pecuniae?”

unit.source: “What money?” In a rare instance, Anthony couldn’t decipher Jenna’s true thoughts.
unit.target: “Quae pecunia?” In raro casu, Anthony cogitationes Jennae recte discernere non potuit.

unit.source: Only then did Jenna realize her words had been too abrupt.
unit.target: Tum Jenna intellexit verba sua nimis subito esse.

unit.source: “Money to compensate the motel owner.
unit.target: “Pecunia est ad compensandum possessorem motel.

unit.source: “I plan to blow up the opposite side, diagonally opposite, and the rooms below.
unit.target: “Cogito partem adversam, diagonaliter oppositam, et cubicula inferiora explodere.

unit.source: We confirmed they’re empty.
unit.target: Confirmavimus ea esse vacua.

unit.source: If anyone’s there, it’s Loki or his marionette!
unit.target: Si quis adsit, est Loki aut eius Marionetta!

unit.source: “I’ll place the detonators here.
unit.target: “Hic detonatores ponebo.

unit.source: They affect rooms within a seven-meter radius.
unit.target: Eos cubicula intra radium septem metrorum attingunt.

unit.source: Lugano will likely be injured, but with the lady as a shield and being a Doctor, he can handle it.
unit.target: Probabile est Lugano laesum iri, sed cum Domina ut scutum fungatur et medicus sit, id tractare poterit.

unit.source: “Right, the explosion will attract the Fertility Order’s combat nuns!”
unit.target: “Ita, explosio moniales pugnantes Ordinis Fertilitatis alliciet!”

unit.source: Jenna’s train of thought gradually flowed smoothly as she spoke.
unit.target: Cogitatio Jennae leniter et paulatim fluxit dum loquebatur.

unit.source: Are you a Hunter or a Demoness? Have you been influenced by Lumian…
unit.target: “Venator esne aut Daemona? A Lumianone influentia passa es?”

unit.source: Anthony mused inwardly. “Do it. Time is running out. Lumian will cover the compensation; he’s loaded.”
unit.target: Anthony intime cogitavit: “Fac hoc. Tempus fugit. Lumian compensationes solvet; dives est.”

unit.source: Jenna hurriedly searched her backpack for detonators.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter tergo suo quaesivit detonatores.

unit.source: Simultaneously, she noticed Anthony setting up a simple altar.
unit.target: Simul, illa animadvertit Anthonyum altare simplex praeparare.

unit.source: Her heart stirred as she asked, “Do you wish to contact Madam Justice, Madam Judgment, or Madam Magician?”
unit.target: Cor eius commovit, dum interrogavit: “Visne contingere Dominam Justitiam, Dominam Iudicium, aut Dominam Magicam?”

unit.source: “Either one works,” Anthony said seriously as he prepared for the ritual.
unit.target: “Utraque operatur,” ait Anthony graviter, dum ad ritum praeparabatur.

unit.source: “Although Madam Magician won’t appear until the end to prevent Loki and his backer from noticing, she mentioned that at least two Major Arcana cards will arrive early and provide assistance at critical moments.”
unit.target: “Quamquam Domina Magica usque ad finem non apparebit, ne Loki et fautor eius animadverterent, dixit saltem duas chartas Major Arcana mane venturas esse et in momentis criticis auxilium feriturum.”

unit.source: “Got it.” Jenna had been uncertain about when to reach out for help and inform their Major Arcana cardholders, so she had been contemplating handling it herself.
unit.target: “Intellectum.” Jenna incerta erat de tempore auxilium petendi et informandi tenentes chartas Major Arcana, itaque ipsa hoc tractare cogitavit.

unit.source: Given Anthony’s readiness to risk the disapproval of the Major Arcana cardholders, Jenna was naturally inclined to opt for the safest choice.
unit.target: Cum Anthony praeparatus esset ad periculum disapprobationis tenentium chartarum Major Arcana, Jenna proprie ad optionem tutissimam inclinata est.

unit.source: As Jenna stacked the detonators and other explosives near the adjacent door, Anthony Reid erected a spiritual barrier and summoned Madam Magician’s messenger, briefing her on Loki’s appearance.
unit.target: Dum Jenna detonatores et alias explosive res iuxta ianuam adiacentem congregavit, Anthony Reid barriera spiritualis erexit et nuntium Dominae Magicæ convocavit, de aspectu Loki enarrans.

unit.source: Then, he swiftly took cover in the bathroom attached to the master bedroom, about six to seven meters away from the impending explosion.
unit.target: Deinde celerrime in balneo ad cubiculum principale adfixo abscondit, circiter sex ad septem metra a imminente explosione distantem.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: A fierce explosion tore through the fifth floor of Sauron Motel.
unit.target: Explosio ferox per quintum tabulatum Sauron Motel irrupit.

unit.source: Glass shattered, debris scattered, and crimson flames engulfed the surroundings.
unit.target: Vitrum confractum est, ruinae sparsae sunt, et flammae rubrae omnia circumiecora devoraverunt.

unit.source: 578 Marionettes
unit.target: 578 Marionettae

unit.source: 578 Marionettes
unit.target: 578 Marionettae

unit.source: Amidst the thunderous explosion, the partition separating the two suites and the one facing the corridor crumbled simultaneously, wreaking havoc on nearby furniture, the ceiling above, the floor beneath their feet, and the rooms opposite, swiftly enveloping them in a surging inferno.
unit.target: In medio tonitruosae explosionis, divisio quae duas cubicula et illud, quod ad corridorium spectabat, separabat, simul corruit, vastitatem intulit supellectili proxima, laqueari superiore, pavimento inferiore sub pedibus, et conclavi opposita, eos celeriter in ferventem incendium involvens.

unit.source: Jenna hadn’t utilized all the explosives; otherwise, the entire fifth and fourth floors of Solow Motel would have collapsed in unison.
unit.target: Jenna non omnia explosiva adhibuerat; alioquin toti tabulati quintus et quartus Solow Motel simul corruissent.

unit.source: Nevertheless, a section of the roof gave way, and the floor was strewn in chaos.
unit.target: Tamen, pars tecti cecidit, et pavimentum in confusione dispersi erat.

unit.source: The epicenter of the blast unveiled the room below.
unit.target: Epicentrum explosionis patefecit conclave inferius.

unit.source: As the walls of the adjacent rooms succumbed to the onslaught, the bricks and wood propelled by the shockwave slammed into Giorgia, causing her back to buckle, and her head to split open, unleashing a flow of vivid red blood.
unit.target: Dum parietes conclavium adjacentium impetu cedebant, lateres et ligna, quae ictu impetuoso allata erant, in Giorgiam irruerunt, facientes ut tergo eius deflexum fieret et caput eius discidum, effundentes flumen sanguinis rubri.

unit.source: Lugano snapped out of his intermittent thoughts and bodily stiffness, regaining his composure.
unit.target: Lugano e cogitationibus intermissis et corpore rigido se evexit, suam tranquillitatem restituens.

unit.source: Subsequently, he experienced searing pain as the violent shockwave, mixed with flames and debris, hurled him through the air.
unit.target: Subinde, acutum dolorem sensit, dum violenta unda ictus, cum flammis et dispersis rebus mixta, eum per aerem iactavit.

unit.source: Had it not been for Giorgia shielding him and with his robust Planter’s physique, he likely would have faced severe injuries, teetering on the brink of death.
unit.target: Nisi propter Giorgiam, quae eum protegebat, et robustam habitum Planteris, probabiliter graves laesiones passurus fuisset, in limine mortis labens.

unit.source: Limbs could have been severed, or vital points struck.
unit.target: Membra seccari potuissent, aut puncta vitalia feriri.

unit.source: Despite this, he ended up a battered mess, with a few bones broken, nearly succumbing to unconsciousness.
unit.target: Attamen, ipse vulneratus evasit, cum paucis ossibus fractis, paene in inconscientiam lapsus.

unit.source: Ludwig had sought refuge under the dining table at some point—along with his food.
unit.target: Ludwig quaesiverat refugium sub mensa cenae, simul cum cibo suo.

unit.source: With the advantage of distance and the makeshift “shield,” he only bore the impact of the collapsed table.
unit.target: Propter distantiam et improvisum scutum, solum ictum mensae corruperae tulit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Jenna and Anthony burst out of the master bedroom washroom in their suite, their gazes fixed on the adjacent rooms where walls had crumbled, filling the air with swirling dust.
unit.target: Simul, Jenna et Anthony ex balneo cubiculi principali in sua suite effugerunt, oculis in conclavia adiacentia fixa, ubi parietes corruperant, aerem cum circumvoluto pulvere implebant.

unit.source: They vaguely discerned a figure.
unit.target: Vagiter deprehenderunt quandam figuram.

unit.source: The figure, bearing a striking resemblance to Rubió Paco, stood beside the upturned recliner.
unit.target: Figura, quae Rubió Paco insigniter similis erat, iuxta lectum revolutum stetit.

unit.source: Loki! Jenna wasted no time.
unit.target: Loki! Jenna sine mora egit.

unit.source: She condensed a dark, illusory flame and sent it hurtling towards her target.
unit.target: Flammam obscuram et illusoriariam condensavit, eam versus metam celeriter iactans.

unit.source: Behind her, Anthony Reid’s eyes took on a golden tint, pupils dilating.
unit.target: Post eam, oculi Anthony Reid auro tincti sunt, pupillae dilatatae.

unit.source: He was poised to lock onto Loki, ready to unleash Frenzy—a technique that would plunge Loki into an emotionally and psychologically triggered state, rendering him incapable of rational thought and effective response.
unit.target: Paratus erat ad incidendum in Lokim, Frenzy emittendi, technica enim quae Lokim in statum affectuum et psychologicum perturbatum immergere posset, eo ut rationem cogitandi ac responsionem efficacem amitteret.

unit.source: Just as Anthony and Jenna prepared to strike, their vision darkened, and Loki vanished.
unit.target: Ita ut Anthony et Jenna ad feriendum parati essent, visio eorum obscurata est, et Loki evanuit.

unit.source: They found themselves in a void, no blue sky or white clouds above, no solid ground below—just darkness embellished with a myriad of stars.
unit.target: Eos invenit vacuum, ubi nec caelum caeruleum nec nubila alba supra, nec terra firma infra erat, sed tantum tenebrae cum innumeris stellis ornatae erant.

unit.source: Cosmic Void!
unit.target: Vacuum Cosmicum!

unit.source: This semi‐real, semi‐false illusion was a creation achievable by a Child of the Sea at a certain level.
unit.target: Haec semi‐realis, semi‐falsa illusio erat creatio a Puer Maris ad certum gradum perficiendum.

unit.source: In the void, Jenna and Anthony beheld a widowed woman in a black bonnet with subtle wrinkles in front of them.
unit.target: In vacuo, Jenna et Anthony conspexerunt feminam viduam, cum cuculla nigra et subtilibus rugis, coram eis.

unit.source: Martha!
unit.target: Martha!

unit.source: The Paco family’s matriarch, now a marionette under Loki’s control, was hidden in the room where Loki manipulated the Spirit Body Threads.
unit.target: Matriarcha familiae Paco, nunc marionetta sub potestate Loki, erat abscondita in conclavi ubi Loki Fila Spiritus Corporis manipulat.

unit.source: With sufficient preparation time, how could Loki not perform with his marionettes?
unit.target: Cum tempore sufficiente praeparatorio, quomodo Loki non cum suis marionettis agere posset?

unit.source: He had two puppets with Beyonder powers, and this was one of them.
unit.target: Duas marionettae habebat cum potentia Beyonder, et haec una ex illis erat.

unit.source: Another remained concealed, with the last slot reserved for specific situations, adaptable at will.
unit.target: Altera manebat celata, cum ultima pars ad certas res reservata esset, quae ad voluntatem adaptari posset.

unit.source: It could be switched once an enemy was under control.
unit.target: Potuit commutari, cum hostis sub potestate esset.

unit.source: When Loki posed as Rubió Paco, bringing Madam Martha to meet the Governor of the Sea, the family’s matriarch was already a marionette.
unit.target: Cum Loki se comparabat Rubió Paco, et Domina Martha ad conveniendum Praefectum Maris adducebat, matriarcha familiae iam marionetta erat.

unit.source: Thus, he had to ensure she stayed within his control range.
unit.target: Ergo, oportuit ut ea intra ambitum sui imperii remaneretur.

unit.source: Lugano discerned Madam Martha’s severe injuries primarily because a marionette was essentially comparable to a lifeless entity.
unit.target: Lugano graves laesiones Dominae Martha praecipue animadvertit, quoniam marionetta ad entitatem sine vita similis erat.

unit.source: A Marionettist’s manipulation of her Spirit Body Threads allowed her to execute various actions, mimicking living characteristics.
unit.target: Per manipulationem Filarum Spiritus Corporis a Marionettista, illa varias actiones perficere potuit, vivarum qualitatum similitudinem imitans.

unit.source: To a Sequence 8 Doctor, this appeared as grave injuries.
unit.target: Ad Medicum Sequentionis VIII, haec videbantur ut laesiones graves.

unit.source: Had Lumian not infrequently observed others’ luck without forming a habit, he would have realized that Madam Martha’s fate was off.
unit.target: Si Lumian non saepiose aliorum fortunam spectaverat, sine consuetudine formata, intellexisset fatum Dominae Martha non esse rectum.

unit.source: It was eerily still, resembling death.
unit.target: Mirabiliter quietum erat, morti simile.

unit.source: Martha, a subtle smile on her face, lifted her right hand, a spectral green light coalescing at her fingertips.
unit.target: Martha, subtile subrisu in facie, dextram manum levavit, ubi lumen viride spectrum ad digitos eius coalescebat.

unit.source: The radiance morphed into a beam that streaked towards Jenna.
unit.target: Splendor in trabem mutatus est, quae versus Jenna traiecit.

unit.source: Having heard Lumian explain the sea bloodline’s abilities, Jenna, at the sight of the spectral green light, rolled out of the Cosmic Void.
unit.target: Audito Lumiano de facultatibus sanguinis maris, Jenna, lumen viride spectrum conspecto, ex Vacuum Cosmicum evoluta est.

unit.source: Anthony followed suit.
unit.target: Anthony idem secutus est.

unit.source: He refrained from using Frenzy on Martha since a marionette, essentially dead, wouldn’t succumb to frenzy.
unit.target: Ab Anthony Frenzy in Martha non adhibitus est, quia marionetta, quasi mortua, ad frenzia succumbere non posset.

unit.source: In the next moment, they both felt a weightiness, plummeting swiftly through the empty cosmos.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, uterque gravitatem sensit, celeriter per vacuum cosmo labens.

unit.source: They experienced the weightlessness Franca occasionally mentioned.
unit.target: Experti sunt defectum gravitatis, quem Franca aliquando commemoravit.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Jenna and Anthony landed on the ground and steadied themselves, yet Martha was nowhere to be seen.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, Jenna et Anthony super terram ceciderunt et se firmaverunt, sed Martha nusquam visa erat.

unit.source: The empty cosmos was shattering inch by inch.
unit.target: Vacuum cosmos, passu passu, frangebatur.

unit.source: They were still in Solow Motel, but they had descended from the fifth floor to the fourth.
unit.target: Adsunt in Solow Motel adhuc, sed a quinto tabulato ad quartum descenderant.

unit.source: This was because the mid- to low-level Cosmic Void resembled more of an illusion.
unit.target: Hoc erat, nam Vacuum Cosmicum mediis et inferioribus gradibus illusio pluris videbatur.

unit.source: There would be a barrier akin to a wall of spirituality around them.
unit.target: Circa eos obstaculum, simile muro spiritualitatis, exstitisset.

unit.source: After falling into it, their bodies remained in reality.
unit.target: Postquam in id ceciderunt, corpora eorum in re manserunt.

unit.source: As they rolled and dodged, Martha nudged them forcefully with her formless power, causing them to plunge into the floor cavity created by the explosives.
unit.target: Dum volvebant et evitabant, Martha eos cum potentia sua informe vehementer impellit, faciens ut in cavitatem pavimenti, quam explosiva creaverant, caderent.

unit.source: Jenna didn’t hesitate.
unit.target: Jenna non dubitavit.

unit.source: She sprinted up the wall, seized a crack, and flipped back to the fifth floor where the explosion had occurred.
unit.target: Jenna murum celeriter ascendit, fissuram arripuit, et se in quintum tabulatum volvens reddidit, ubi explosio facta erat.

unit.source: She saw Lugano tending to his injuries, and Loki and Madam Martha were absent from the room diagonally opposite.
unit.target: Vidit Lugano vulnera sua curare, et Loki et Domina Martha in conclavi diagonaliter opposito abesse.

unit.source: Ludwig, who had hidden under the dining table, had vanished as well!
unit.target: Ludwig, qui sub mensa cenae se absconderat, etiam evanuerat!

unit.source: On Aquina Street, amid a lively folk celebration, Loki, having transformed into an inconspicuous passerby, carried Ludwig, who had “fallen asleep,” through the crowd.
unit.target: In via Aquina, inter festum popularis laetitiae, Loki, qui se in transeuntum ignotum converterat, Ludwig, qui obdormiverat, per turbam portavit.

unit.source: His other marionette, a Soul Assurer of the Evernight pathway, stayed concealed on the opposite side of Lumian’s suite, ready to exert influence on the target.
unit.target: Altera marionetta eius, «Animam Assecuratrix» per semitam Evernight appellata, in parte opposita suite Lumiani celata mansit, praeparata ad obiectum influendum.

unit.source: Initially, Loki had dispatched his temporary marionette, Giorgia, to handle Lugano.
unit.target: Initio, Loki marionettam temporariam suam, Giorgiam, ad Lugano operandum misit.

unit.source: He had manipulated the Doctor’s Spirit Body Threads but refrained from deploying his more potent marionettes.
unit.target: Filiis Spiritus Corporis Medici manipulaverat, sed a marionettis potentioribus adhibendis abstinuit.

unit.source: It wasn’t due to fear of alerting Ludwig, but rather a concern that an unseen adversary might be lurking in the shadows.
unit.target: Non timore Ludwig excitandi, sed de cura, ne hostis invisus in umbris lateret, fuit.

unit.source: After all, several lodgers in the motel hadn’t left for the sea prayer ritual celebrations.
unit.target: Nam multi hospites in motel nondum profecti sunt ad celebrandas ritus orationis maris.

unit.source: A couple had returned before lunchtime next door, almost synchronizing with the target.
unit.target: Par duo ante prandium ad domum vicinam redierant, paene synchroni cum scopo.

unit.source: Moreover, a Marionettist’s advancement ritual demanded a grand performance—a splendid and profound drama.
unit.target: Praeterea, ritus progressionis Marionettistae magnum spectaculum exigit—drama splendidum et profundum.

unit.source: Silent, unnoticed assassinations lacking a sufficient audience failed to meet the requirements.
unit.target: Assassinationes silentiae et imperceptae, quae sufficiens audientia caret, requisita non implebant.

unit.source: Therefore, Loki intentionally singled out Lugano first.
unit.target: Ergo, Loki primum Lugano intentione singulariter designavit.

unit.source: If there were no other foes lurking, it was akin to switching marionettes.
unit.target: Si nulli alii hostes latentes essent, erat sicut marionettae commutatio.

unit.source: If there were, he could draw them all to him and clandestinely manipulate the target with the other marionette nearby.
unit.target: Si vero alii essent, eos omnes ad se allicere poterat et, clandestine, cum altera marionetta proxima, obiectum manipulare.

unit.source: Aware that it was a sealed demigod, Loki knew its strength might be limited, but its essence remained unchanged.
unit.target: Conscius quod deum semi‑divinus clausus esset, Loki scivit vires eius limitatas esse, sed essentia eius immutata manere.

unit.source: It was impervious to many influences.
unit.target: Ad multas influentiis impervius erat.

unit.source: However, he believed the Evernight pathway’s forced sleep would still be effective.
unit.target: Attamen, credidit somnum coactum per semitam Evernight adhuc efficacem fore.

unit.source: Since this sealed demigod could experience exhaustion, hunger, and the need for rest, food, and sleep like a true child, it implied that the seal had impacted corresponding characteristics, making him akin to an ordinary person in those aspects.
unit.target: Quoniam hic deum semi‑divinus clausus lassitudinem, famem, atque necessitatem quietis, cibi, et somni, ut puer verus, experiri posset, id implicabat sigillum proprietates congruentes affecisse, eum in hisce ad hominem ordinarum similem reddens.

unit.source: At most, he would awaken faster and require less rest time.
unit.target: Maxime, celerius evigilaret atque tempus quietis brevius opus haberet.

unit.source: A few seconds would be ample time for Loki to relocate and conceal himself with the target before attempting to manipulate the other party’s Spirit Body Threads.
unit.target: Nonnulli secundi sufficiebant ut Loki locum mutaret et se cum obiectivo celaret, antequam alterorum Fila Spiritus Corporis manipularet.

unit.source: His two marionettes would act independently, confusing both enemies and the Earth Mother Church clergyman rushing over.
unit.target: Duae marionettae eius agere independentiter consueverant, confundentes hostes atque clergonem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae qui properabat.

unit.source: They would lead them on a chase spanning about 100 to 200 meters, completing the corresponding performance.
unit.target: Illos in insequentem ducere poterant, per spatium circiter a centum ad ducentos metra, spectaculum idoneum perfaciendo.

unit.source: As the time approached, the enemies would pinpoint his hiding spot through the marionettes’ trajectory, joyfully anticipating an encounter.
unit.target: Cum tempus appropinquaret, hostes locum eius absconditum per cursum marionettarum determinare poterant, congressum exspectantes cum laetitia.

unit.source: However, what awaited them would be a demigod-level marionette, leading to a terrifying and grim outcome.
unit.target: Attamen, quod eis obveniret, marionetta gradus semi‑divinus esset, quae ad exitum terribilem et tristissimum duceret.

unit.source: Under the watchful eyes of the surrounding citizens, the magnificent play would conclude.
unit.target: Sub oculis vigilantibus civium circumstantium, pulcherrimum spectaculum concludebatur.

unit.source: Loki could consume the potion and ascend to Sequence 4, becoming a Bizarro Sorcerer!
unit.target: Loki potionem consumere potuit et ad Sequentionem IV ascendere, atque Bizarro Magus fieri!

unit.source: On the betrothal ship, within Lato Guiaro’s Cosmic Void.
unit.target: In nave sponsali, intra Vacuum Cosmicum Lato Guiaro.

unit.source: This was fundamentally different from lower-middle-level abilities.
unit.target: Hoc fundamentaliter diversum erat ab facultatibus gradus inferiore‑mediis.

unit.source: It was both an illusory realm and an alternate space that could cause people to lose themselves and become abnormally fragile.
unit.target: Erat et regnum illusorium et spatium alternum, quod homines se ipsos perdere et insolite fragiles fieri faceret.

unit.source: It was akin to the Bottle of Fiction augmented with hallucinations.
unit.target: Erat quasi phiala fabularum, hallucinationibus aucta.

unit.source: The sticky blob of flesh Lumian had expelled squirmed rapidly, stretching and expanding into a discernible figure.
unit.target: Globulus carnis viscosae, quem Lumian expulit, celeriter contorquens, extendens et expandendo in figuram discernibilem conversus est.

unit.source: Cloaked in blood-red fabric with a matching hood obscuring its face in shadows, the figure revealed itself as none other than Mr. K of the Aurora Order.
unit.target: Indutus in panno rubro sanguine, cum galea congrua faciem umbris tegente, figura se revelavit ut nihil aliud quam Dominus K Ordinis Aurorae.

unit.source: To counter April Fool’s machinations, Lumian had chosen the strategy of overwhelming force.
unit.target: Ut machinamenta April Fool’s oppelleret, Lumian consilium vires opprimentis uti statuit.

unit.source: He accomplished this with overt and imposing power, complemented by meticulous arrangements.
unit.target: Id efficivit per vim apertam et imponentem, complementatam dispositionibus diligenter constitutis.

unit.source: This plan allowed for a fair margin of error.
unit.target: Hoc consilium aequam spatium erroris concessit.

unit.source: Even if Lumian made a miscalculation, as long as April Fool’s didn’t have Angel-level helpers or three or more Saints, he could salvage the situation by retaining at least one or two key members.
unit.target: Etiamsi Lumian errorem fecisset, dummodo April Fool’s non haberet adiutores angelorum gradus nec tria aut plura Sanctos, poterat rem salvari retinendo saltem unum vel duo membrum praecipuum.

unit.source: To enhance their odds, Franca extended invitations to Hela and Gandalf.
unit.target: Ad meliores casus obtinendos, Franca invitationes ad Hela et Gandalf misit.

unit.source: The Fertility Order also notified the higher-ups, ensuring the presence of a Saint overseeing Port Santa during the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Ordo Fertilitatis superiores numinavit, ut Sanctus Portus Santae, tempore ritus orationis maris, adsit.

unit.source: The Tarot Club had two Major Arcana card holders positioned nearby.
unit.target: Club Tarot duos titulares chartarum Arcanae Maioris prope constitutos habebat.

unit.source: When April Fool’s key members felt secure, Madam Magician, the Angel of Stars, would cross a long distance and descend as they prepared to depart!
unit.target: Quando membra principales April Fool’s securum sensissent statum, Domina Magician, Angelus Stellarum, longum iter transiret atque descenderet, in praeparatione discedendi!

unit.source: For extra precaution, Lumian utilized Mr. K’s finger to get him to Port Santa.
unit.target: Ad cautelam additicam, Lumian digitum Domini K adhibuit, quo eum ad Portum Santa deduceret.

unit.source: Morphing with the Rose Bishop’s power, he turned into a fleshy blob, and was concealed in Lumian’s stomach to infiltrate the betrothal ship.
unit.target: Mutans virtute Episcopi Rosae, se in globum carnosum mutavit, et in stomacho Lumiani celatus est, ut nave sponsali inpenetraret.

unit.source: Mr. K glanced up, his eyes taking on an otherworldly illusion, as if concealing hidden doors.
unit.target: Dominus K sursum respexit, et oculi eius aliam illusionem praebuerunt, quasi portas absconditas celarent.

unit.source: Swiftly scanning the Cosmic Void, he identified an escape route.
unit.target: Celeriter Vacuum Cosmicum perspexit, et viam effugiendi deprehendit.

unit.source: “Follow me,” he said to Lumian in a hoarse voice.
unit.target: “Sequere me,” rauco voce ad Lumian dixit.

unit.source: Nodding, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag, extracting the Flog boxing gloves and preparing to don them.
unit.target: Nodante, Lumian in Saccum Viatoris pervenit, chirothecas pugilatorias Flog extraxit et induere paratus est.

unit.source: If you guys still have a backup plan or if a few powerhouses don’t appear in time, I’ll draw the attention of the evil gods and create chaos.
unit.target: Si vos adhuc consilium subsidiarium habetis aut si paucae potentiae non in tempore appareant, attentionem deorum malorum alliciam et chaos creabo.

unit.source: We’ll all face the danger together. Early exits? Forget about it!
unit.target: Nos omnes periculum simul subiemus. Exitus ante tempus? Obliviscamini!

unit.source: 579 Energy Passage
unit.target: 579 Transitus Energiae

unit.source: 579 Energy Passage
unit.target: 579 Transitus Energiae

unit.source: On the betrothal boat, the humanoid Sealed Artifact ascended, her form suspended in the air.
unit.target: In nave sponsali, artifactum sigillatum humanoide ascendit, forma eius in aere suspendens.

unit.source: Striding through the atmosphere, she advanced toward the sailboat.
unit.target: Per aēr ambulans, navim velariam petivit.

unit.source: With the weight akin to a massive stone sphere, she manipulated the surrounding space, causing the target ship to shift automatically.
unit.target: Cum pondere, quod ingenti sphaera lapidea simile apparuit, spatium circumjacentem regnavit, quo navis destinata automatice commutata est.

unit.source: The two factions drew near.
unit.target: Duae factiones appropinquaverunt.

unit.source: Concurrently, the vacant eyes of the humanoid Sealed Artifact, adorned in a black nun’s attire, suddenly sparked with madness and chaos.
unit.target: Simul, oculi vacui artifacti sigillati humanoide, habitu monialis nigrae induti, subito insanitate et tumultu exarduerunt.

unit.source: Minute blood vessels protruded from the whites of its eyes, swiftly converging.
unit.target: Minutae venae sanguinis ex albis oculorum eminuerunt, celeriter confluentes.

unit.source: Accompanying her “affliction,” the Maidens of the Sea, deputy hosts, and sailors on the betrothal ship, unaware of what transpired, stood motionless.
unit.target: Comitantes eius “afflictioni”, Puellae Maris, ministri vicarii, et nautae in nave sponsali, nescii quid evenisset, immobiliter steterunt.

unit.source: Their expressions blank, eyes vacant, they succumbed to the same state as the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Vultus eorum inani, oculi vacui, in eundem statum artifacti sigillati humanoide ceciderunt.

unit.source: In that moment, within the lingering Light of Holiness on the sailboat, which had traversed the void and approached the origin of Derangement, a light abruptly vanished, swallowed by the profound darkness.
unit.target: In illo momento, intra manentem Lucem Sanctitatis in nave velaria, quae vacuum peragraverat et ad originem insaniae accesserat, lumen subito evanuit, ab imis tenebris devoratum.

unit.source: In the darkness, a tranquil voice resonated, as if reciting a beautiful poem.
unit.target: In tenebris, vox tranquilla resonavit, quasi pulchrum carmen recitaret.

unit.source: The expression of the humanoid Sealed Artifact softened significantly.
unit.target: Vultus artifacti sigillati humanoide significanter mollitus est.

unit.source: The chaos and madness in her eyes dissipated, and her steps slowed.
unit.target: Chaos et insania in oculis eius evanuerunt, et gressus eius tardaverunt.

unit.source: The other individuals on the betrothal ship also entered a state of tranquility and drowsiness.
unit.target: Ceteri in nave sponsali quoque in statum tranquillitatis et soporis inciderunt.

unit.source: Juan Oro felt the intangible force suppressing his body instantly dissipate.
unit.target: Juan Oro sensit vim intangibilem, quae corpus eius opprimebat, celeriter evanuisse.

unit.source: Straightening up abruptly, he glared angrily at Simon Guiaro, positioned at the bow of the ship.
unit.target: Subito se reficiens, iracunde spectavit ad Simon Guiaro, qui in prora navis stabat.

unit.source: The president of the Fisheries Guild had a rough idea of the other party’s identity.
unit.target: Praeses Gremii Piscationis quandam ideam de identitate alterius partis habebat.

unit.source: After all, not many comprehended the entire sea prayer ritual and knew the intricacies of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Postremo, pauci totum ritum precationis maris comprehenderunt et subtilitates Anuli Reginae Maris noverunt.

unit.source: Combined with the fact that he hailed from the same family as Simon Guiaro, there was only one answer: Lato Guiaro!
unit.target: Cum et de eadem familia originem haberet cum Simone Guiaro, sola responsio erat: Lato Guiaro!

unit.source: “You traitor!” Even the distant chanting from the darkness couldn’t pacify Juan Oro’s anger.
unit.target: “Proditor!” Ne etiam cantus remoti ex tenebris iram Juan Oro sedare potuit.

unit.source: Although no longer the temporary Governor of the Sea, he still possessed considerable strength and could be deemed formidable at sea.
unit.target: Quamquam iam non erat gubernator temporarius maris, tamen vires significantes habebat et in mari formidabilis existimabatur.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: The seawater at the bottom of the betrothal ship surged, part of it threatening to hurl everyone back to the surface, while others formed into towering peaks and crashed down on Lato Guiaro, masquerading as Simon Guiaro.
unit.target: Aquam marinam in fundo navis sponsalis surrexit; pars eius omnes ad superficiem verberari minabatur, dum aliae in cacumina excelsa congregatae in Lato Guiaro, qui ut Simon Guiaro se ostendebat, corruerunt.

unit.source: Lato abruptly pivoted, fixing his gaze on Juan Oro.
unit.target: Lato subito se vertit, oculos in Juan Oro consuens.

unit.source: The azure “peak” poised to strike him froze in midair, its descent arrested.
unit.target: Cacumen caeruleum, paratum ad eum feriendum, in aere suspenditum sistit, descensum eius coercens.

unit.source: The water’s attempt to push the betrothal ship out of this area also ceased its endeavors.
unit.target: Conatus aquae navem sponsalem ex hac regione proiciendi quoque cessavit.

unit.source: Reflected in Lato Guiaro’s eyes was the figure of Juan Oro.
unit.target: In oculis Lato Guiaro imago Juan Oro reflecta erat.

unit.source: The corners of his mouth curled up slightly as he stated a fact in a composed tone, “I am now the Governor of the Sea.”
unit.target: Anguli oris eius leviter incurvati sunt, dum rem certam leni voce declaravit: “Nunc gubernator maris sum.”

unit.source: “Your abilities, especially those affecting these waters, are completely suppressed by me. They are useless!
unit.target: ‘Virtutes tuae, praesertim quae has aquas afficiunt, a me omnino suppressae sunt. Inutiles sunt!’

unit.source: The incantation from the darkness targeted the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Incantatio ex tenebris artifactum sigillatum humanoide destinavit.

unit.source: Everything else was secondary.
unit.target: Omnia alia erant secundaria.

unit.source: As the interim Governor of the Sea, Lato Guiaro couldn’t help but be affected.
unit.target: Ut gubernator interim maris, Lato Guiaro inevitabiliter affectus est.

unit.source: However, thanks to the feedback from the sea and the sharing of the burden, it didn’t reach a profound level.
unit.target: Attamen, propter responsionem maris et oneris communiationem, effectus non profundus factus est.

unit.source: He only became more tranquil, devoid of the desire for intense combat and direct killing.
unit.target: Ipse tantum magis tranquillus factus est, desiderio pugnandi intensi et caedis directa carens.

unit.source: Compared to Juan Oro, he was more concerned about whether Gandalf was on the sailboat besides Hela.
unit.target: Ad Juan Oro comparatus, magis curabat utrum Gandalf, praeter Hela, in nave velaria adesset.

unit.source: He was more concerned about whether Mad Lady had opened the spaceship’s passageway in time.
unit.target: Magis curabat utrum Mad Lady iter navis sideralis tempore aperuisset.

unit.source: Juan Oro’s heart sank as he witnessed the azure wave suspended in midair and Lato Guiaro, seemingly indifferent to him.
unit.target: Cor Juan Oro defluit, dum unda caerulea in aere suspendita atque Lato Guiaro, quasi ad eum indifferens, conspiceret.

unit.source: At that moment, Lato turned to Mad Lady, who had reverted to her human form, and addressed his companion, clad in an unusually flamboyant blood-colored dress,
unit.target: Eo in momento, Lato se vertit ad Mad Lady, quae ad formam humanam redierat, et comitem suum alloquitur, induta veste sanguinea insolita.

unit.source: “Hurry up.”
unit.target: Festina.

unit.source: Mad Lady wasn’t particularly tall, standing at over 1.6 meters.
unit.target: Mad Lady non nimis alta erat, stans plus quam 1.6 metra.

unit.source: Her dark-blond hair was disheveled, influenced by the heaviness effect.
unit.target: Eius capilli, nigro-flavi, inordinati erant, effectu gravitatis affecti.

unit.source: None of it fluttered wantonly, pointing towards the seabed.
unit.target: Nullus capillorum eius leviter volitabat, sed ad fundum maris tendebat.

unit.source: Her face concealed by pure flesh, making it challenging to discern her original appearance.
unit.target: Vultus eius, carne pura opertus, formam originariam eius difficile patefaciebat.

unit.source: She wore a ring on each hand.
unit.target: In utraque manu annulum gerebat.

unit.source: On her left hand, there was a rose-gold ring embedded with a gem resembling crimson blood, and on her right, a simple, pure silver ring.
unit.target: In manu sinistra, annulus auro rosa tinctus, gemma rubra quasi sanguine apparens insita erat; in manu dextra, annulus simplex et argenteus purus erat.

unit.source: Mad Lady responded to Lato Guiaro with a smile, “So there are times when you’re anxious.”
unit.target: Mad Lady respondit Lato Guiaro subrisu: “Sic sunt tempora, cum anxius sis.”

unit.source: Only then did she cast her gaze at the silver-gray behemoth embedded in the seabed not far away.
unit.target: Tum solum oculos suos ad monstrum argenteo-canum, prope in fundo maris insitum, convertit.

unit.source: This lunatic… Lato Guiaro cursed inwardly.
unit.target: Hic insanus… Lato Guiaro intus maledixit.

unit.source: I Know Someone had an extremely nasty personality and subsequently succumbed to mental illness due to other reasons and was admitted to an asylum, but in contrast, Mad Lady had displayed an abnormal state of mind from the very beginning.
unit.target: I Know Someone personalitatem valde nefariam habebat, et deinde propter alias causas insaniam mentis cedere coactus, et in asylum admitte est; contra vero, Mad Lady ab initio statum mentis anormalem ostendit.

unit.source: In the past, she relied on I Know Someone’s regular treatment to barely maintain her rationality, but now, she was becoming more and more insane.
unit.target: Priore tempore, illa curationi regulari a I Know Someone innitebatur, ut vix rationalitatem retineret, sed nunc magis atque magis insanissima fiebat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro took a deep breath, focusing on the peculiar sounds emanating from within the spaceship, resisting the distant chants echoing in the darkness.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro profundum spiritum accepit, sonis peculiariis ex interiore nave siderali emittentibus intendens, ac cantionibus remotis in tenebris resonantibus resistere conatus est.

unit.source: Swiftly regaining his will to fight, he redirected his gaze to the sailboat, raising his right arm.
unit.target: Celeriter pugnandi ardorem rursus accipiens, oculos suos ad navem velariam redirigit, dextrum brachium levans.

unit.source: Upon witnessing this, Juan Oro’s sense of despair deepened.
unit.target: Hoc videns, desperatio Juan Oro profundius facta est.

unit.source: The white-haired old man clenched his fist, slamming it against his chest.
unit.target: Senex albi capillatus pugnum contraxit, et in pectus suum feriens.

unit.source: With a snap, his sternum broke, and his flesh tore open, releasing a torrent of blood that painted his body and the betrothal ship’s deck red.
unit.target: Cum sonitu, sternum eius confractum est, et caro eius lacerata, torrentem sanguinis effundens, qui corpus eius et tabulam navis sponsalis rubrum effinxit.

unit.source: As life ebbed away, Juan Oro’s white hair defied the heaviness effect, floating upwards.
unit.target: Dum vita defluebat, albi capilli Juan Oro effectui gravitatis repugnabant, sursum levitantes.

unit.source: His steps grew burdensome, each movement pressing down like a mountain on the ground.
unit.target: Gressus eius onerosi erant, omnis motus quasi mons in terram premebat.

unit.source: Just as Lato Guiaro was poised to unleash the surrounding seawater, submerging the sailboat, he suddenly realized that the sea wasn’t as obedient as before.
unit.target: Iam cum Lato Guiaro paratus esset circumjacentem aquam marinam dimittere, navem velariam submergendo, repente intellexit mare non tam obtemperare quam prius.

unit.source: His Governor of the Sea position teetered on the brink of collapse.
unit.target: Positio gubernatoris maris eius ad ruinae limen vacilabat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro turned his head once more, narrowing his eyes at Juan Oro, now covered in blood.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro iterum caput vertit, oculos contrahens in Juan Oro, qui nunc sanguine operitus erat.

unit.source: “Traitor, the sea will punish you!” Juan Oro’s dark-green eyes focused, emitting a beam of blue light.
unit.target: “Proditor, mare te puniet!” oculi eius virides obscuri Juan Oro fixos habebant, radium lucis caeruleae emittens.

unit.source: Accompanying this attack, he also intensified Lato Guiaro’s heaviness, rendering him unable to move normally.
unit.target: Comitans hoc impetum, etiam pondus Lato Guiaro augebat, ita ut movere recte non posset.

unit.source: Two beams struck Lato Guiaro simultaneously, penetrating him and sinking into the sea.
unit.target: Duo radii simul Lato Guiaro percusserunt, eum penetrantes et in mare submergentes.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s aura weakened slightly, but he wasn’t as severely injured as Juan Oro believed.
unit.target: Aura Lato Guiaro leviter debilitata est, sed non tam graviter vulneratus erat quam Juan Oro credidit.

unit.source: Sunlight burst forth from the April Fool key member who used “Ultraman” as his code name, eradicating the residual corrosive powers and altering his body structure.
unit.target: Lux solis ex membro clavi Aprilis Folli, qui “Ultraman” ut codicem suum utebatur, effulsit, residuas vires corrosivas excidens atque configurationem corporis mutans.

unit.source: He lifted his chin slightly and uttered three words with strange pronunciations.
unit.target: Mentum suum leviter sublevavit et tria verba cum insolitis pronuntiis edixit.

unit.source: This was also the language employed to activate the spaceship.
unit.target: Haec etiam erat lingua ad navem sideralem activandam adhibita.

unit.source: The implication was likely akin to granting access, equivalent to obtaining a certain amount of Governor of the Sea power without “melding” with the sea after opening a crack in the seal.
unit.target: Implicatio verisimiliter erat similis ad concedendum accessum, id est, ut quaedam potentia gubernatoris maris obtineretur, sine “coniunctione” cum mari, postquam fissura in sigillo aperta est.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s usage now was to help him seize all authority back from Juan Oro.
unit.target: Usus Lato Guiaro nunc erat ut totam auctoritatem a Juan Oro sibi restitueret.

unit.source: Hmph, foolish fellow, a group of fools.
unit.target: Hem, stulte homo, caterva stultorum.

unit.source: They hadn’t studied the sounds heard during every sea sacrifice after so many years.
unit.target: Non studuerunt sonos, qui in omni sacrificio maris per tot annos auditi erant.

unit.source: They guarded the treasure but failed to excavate it!
unit.target: Thesaurum custodiabant, sed illud effodere defecerunt!

unit.source: Sacrificing your life? Sacrificing yourself?
unit.target: Vitam tuam sacrificare? Te ipsum sacrificare?

unit.source: It’s meaningless!
unit.target: Nihil valet!

unit.source: Brains and strength are the foundation!
unit.target: Mens et vis fundamentum sunt!

unit.source: Juan Oro, still bleeding from his chest, was surprised to discover that the authority of the Governor of the Sea had shifted again.
unit.target: Juan Oro, adhuc ex pectore sanguinans, miratus est quod auctoritas gubernatoris maris iterum versa esset.

unit.source: He stared at Lato Guiaro in confusion and horror, as if looking at a true devil.
unit.target: Illum intuitus est Lato Guiaro, in confusione et horrore, quasi verum diabolum.

unit.source: Why? Why does the sea favor him more?
unit.target: Cur? Cur mare eum magis praeferat?

unit.source: Why does the sea favor this traitor more?
unit.target: Cur mare hunc proditorem magis praeferat?

unit.source: At that moment, Mad Lady, on the other side of the bow, completed reciting the incoherent order.
unit.target: In illo momento, Mad Lady, in altera parte prorae, ordinem incoherentem recitare perfecit.

unit.source: The silver-gray behemoth at the bottom of the sea trembled slightly, increasing in magnitude, causing the entire seabed and all the seawater to quake.
unit.target: Monstrum argenteo-canum in fundo maris leviter tremuit, magnitudine augens, totum substratum maris atque omnem aquam concutiens.

unit.source: Inside, beams of pure light converged and shot out from the open entrance, landing at the edge of the betrothal ship, forming a transparent tunnel-like energy passageway.
unit.target: Intus, radii lucis purae convergentes e porta aperta proiecerunt, ad margines navis sponsalis delapsi, formantes transeuntem viam energiae quasi tunnel translucidus.

unit.source: Mad Lady didn’t immediately leap into the pure light.
unit.target: Mad Lady non statim in lucem puram insiluit.

unit.source: She understood that as the spaceship opened and activated further, the power accumulated in the depths of the seal would erupt.
unit.target: Intellegebat quod, dum navis sideralis aperiretur et ulterius activaretur, potentia in profundis sigilli collecta erumpere posset.

unit.source: Everyone present, except the Governor of the Sea, would be torn apart.
unit.target: Omnes praesentes, excepto gubernatore maris, dilacerabuntur.

unit.source: But it didn’t matter.
unit.target: Sed nihil refert.

unit.source: She had a solution.
unit.target: Illa remedium habebat.

unit.source: The plain silver ring on her right hand, a gift from Bard, held the boon from honoring the ancestors.
unit.target: Annulus argenteus simplex in manu dextra eius, donum a Bard, beneficium maiorum honorandorum tenebat.

unit.source: It could steal that power and distribute it, sharing the burden with all the Children of the Sea in Port Santa.
unit.target: Illud potentiam rapere et distribuere poterat, onus cum omnibus Filiorum Maris in Port Santa communicans.

unit.source: Of course, those present would receive more.
unit.target: Certe, illi praesentes amplius acciperent.

unit.source: Whether they could endure it or not depended on fate.
unit.target: Utrum id ferre possent an non, fato pendebat.

unit.source: When the moment arrived, the Fisheries Guild members would believe the sea prayer ritual had succeeded, celebrating with joy.
unit.target: Cum momentum advenisset, membra Gremii Piscationis crediderunt ritum precationis maris feliciter effectum esse, et cum gaudio celebraverunt.

unit.source: Little did they know that their “sea” had been stolen.
unit.target: Parum sciebant quod eorum “mare” sublatum esset.

unit.source: The irony delighted Mad Lady.
unit.target: Ironia Mad Lady delectavit.

unit.source: Just as she was about to use the ring, a strong sense of Danger Premonition hit her.
unit.target: Iam, dum annulum uti pararetur, potens sensus praemonitionis periculi eam percussit.

unit.source: In a flash, her figure vanished, reappearing a few steps away.
unit.target: In momento, figura eius evanuit, et paucis passibus ultra iterum apparuit.

unit.source: A shadow rose from the deck where she had stood, but it failed to envelop her.
unit.target: Umbra ex ponte, ubi steterat, surrexit, sed eam complecti non potuit.

unit.source: Mad Lady then spotted Mr. K, draped in a blood-colored cloak and hood, and Lumian Lee, wearing the Lie earring but yet to revert to his original appearance.
unit.target: Mad Lady deinde Dominum K animadvertit, in pallio sanguineo colore induto et galea, atque Lumian Lee, auriculis “Lie” gestantem, sed nondum ad formam originariam redactum.

unit.source: Port Santa, Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Port Santa, sedes gubernatoris maris.

unit.source: Bard stood by the window, gazing at the weeds outside.
unit.target: Bard iuxta fenestram stabat, et herbas extra intuens.

unit.source: Silently calculating the time, he waited for the sea prayer ritual to progress.
unit.target: Tacite tempus computans, exspectabat ut rituum precationis maris progrediretur.

unit.source: If the sea’s boon arrived with a delay and cheers erupted from Milo Village, he would openly leave this place, abandoning those who had been deceived.
unit.target: Si beneficium maris sero advenerit et cantus ex vico Milo eruptus fuerit, hunc locum aperte reliqueret, eos qui decepti fuerant derelinquens.

unit.source: When the moment arrived, anyone attempting to stop him would be torn apart by the power of the sea.
unit.target: Quando momentum advenisset, quicumque eum sistere conaretur, vi maris dilacerabuntur.

unit.source: In the absence of a delayed collective boon, but with the sky and sea undergoing ominous changes, as if a catastrophe had struck, Bard could wait for the spaceship or Mad Lady to pick him up.
unit.target: In absentia beneficii collectivi serotinii, sed cum caelum et mare mutationes ominosas subeunt, quasi calamitas accidisset, Bard exspectare poterat ut navis sideralis aut Mad Lady eum sublevaret.

unit.source: Of course, he wouldn’t wait indefinitely.
unit.target: Certe, indefinitim exspectare non poterat.

unit.source: If there were no further developments from the sea prayer ritual within ten minutes, he would use his abilities to forcefully exit, shift positions, and conceal himself.
unit.target: Si intra decem minuta nulla nova ex rito precationis maris evenisset, facultates suas ad exitum vi compellendum, ad locos mutandos, et ad se celandos adhiberet.

unit.source: The early-stage abilities of the Marauder pathway weren’t formidable.
unit.target: Facultates initii viae raptorum non erant formidabiles.

unit.source: Bard had developed the habit of remaining vigilant as he advanced step by step.
unit.target: Bard consuetudinem evolverat ut vigilans maneret dum gradatim progrediebatur.

unit.source: As the weeds swayed in the bright sunlight and mild wind, Bard suddenly heard faint footsteps.
unit.target: Dum herbae in lumine claro et vento miti oscillabantur, Bard subito passus leves audivit.

unit.source: The sound emanated from the corridor outside, so subtle that it seemed almost like an illusion.
unit.target: Sonus ex corridori foris emanabat, tam subtilis ut paene ut illusio videretur.

unit.source: 580 Theft
unit.target: 580 Furtum

unit.source: 580 Theft
unit.target: 580 Furtum

unit.source: Bard pivoted on his heels, fixing his eyes on the door.
unit.target: Bard calcibus versatis, oculos ad ianuam intendens.

unit.source: A moment lingered in silence, but no one rapped against the wooden barrier.
unit.target: Momentum silentii perstitit, sed nemo contra obstaculum ligneum pulsavit.

unit.source: The once-present soft footsteps in the corridor had now faded into nothingness.
unit.target: Gradus molles, quondam in conclavi auditi, nunc in nihilum evanuerant.

unit.source: As a seasoned Beyonder, Bard dismissed the notion of hallucination.
unit.target: Ut peritus Beyonder, Bard notionem hallucinationis neglexit.

unit.source: Returning to the servant’s bed, he grabbed the backpack containing the spoils of the year, feigning an escape from the Governor of the Sea’s residence before confirming the outcome of the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Reversus ad lectum servi, sarcinam quae praedas anni contineret cepit, simulans effugium a domicilio Gubernatoris Maris antequam exitum ritus orationis maris confirmaret.

unit.source: Such precautions were only sensible.
unit.target: Talia cautelae vere rationabiles erant.

unit.source: Not everyone placed full trust in Juan Oro’s promises.
unit.target: Non omnes in promissionibus Juan Oro totam fiduciam collocabant.

unit.source: Bard slung the backpack over his shoulder and slyly opened the window, aiming to slip into the weeds below.
unit.target: Bard sarcinam super umerum suum imposuit et callide fenestram aperuit, intendens in herbas se delabi.

unit.source: Suddenly, a figure, standing over a meter tall, emerged from the shadows in the corner.
unit.target: Subito, figura, stans altitudine plusquam unum metrum, ex umbris in angulo emersit.

unit.source: Its disproportionately large head and wrinkled face identified it as one of the Little Devils from the sea spawn.
unit.target: Caput eius, disproportionate magnum, et facies rugosa eum designaverunt ut unum ex Diabolis Parvulis generis maris.

unit.source: The Little Devil gestured for Bard to close the glass window.
unit.target: Diabolus Parvulus indicavit Bard ad fenestram vitream claudendam.

unit.source: Just a bunch of creatures with low IQs, Bard thought, mocking them inwardly.
unit.target: Mere coetus creaturarum parvae ingenii, Bard putavit, eos interioribus ironice deridens.

unit.source: Despite generations, they have yet to master Highlander and can only barely communicate like dogs…
unit.target: Non obstante generationibus, nondum dominati sunt Highlander, et vix ut canes communicare possunt.

unit.source: Maintaining a timid expression, Bard closed the window.
unit.target: Vultu timido servantem, Bard fenestram clausit.

unit.source: Having tested the waters, he had a rough idea of where the sea spawn responsible for monitoring him were hiding.
unit.target: Aquam probato, paene sciebat ubi genera maris, quae eum observabant, se abscondere solebant.

unit.source: None of them appeared to have any connection to the soft footsteps echoing in the corridor, nor did they seem aware of them.
unit.target: Nemo ex illis videbatur aliquam relationem habere cum gradibus mollibus in conclavi resonantibus, nec videbantur eorum conscii esse.

unit.source: On the betrothal boat, Mad Lady, draped in a blood-colored dress with a portion of her face showing pure flesh and blood, instantly vanished upon spotting Mr. K and Lumian.
unit.target: In nave sponsalitia, Mad Lady, induta veste sanguine tincta, cum parte faciei suae puram carnem et sanguinem ostenderet, statim evanuit, cum Mr. K et Lumian conspexit.

unit.source: She swiftly changed her position.
unit.target: Celeriter locum mutavit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a figure materialized behind and to her side—Lumian and Mr. K.
unit.target: Simul, figura se materializavit post eam et ad latus eius — id est, Lumian et Mr. K.

unit.source: Employing their teleportation abilities, they blocked Mad Lady.
unit.target: Facultatibus teleportationis utentes, Lumian et Mr. K Mad Lady obstraxerunt.

unit.source: After Mad Lady shifted to the opposite side of the deck, the corners of her mouth, made of pure flesh and blood, curled up.
unit.target: Postquam Mad Lady ad contram partem pontis se commovit, anguli oris eius, ex pura carne et sanguine facti, convoluti sunt.

unit.source: Her grayish-green eyes gleamed with anticipation and excitement.
unit.target: Oculi eius, virido-grisei, exspectatione et exsultatione fulgebant.

unit.source: Come and attack me.
unit.target: Veni et me oppugna!

unit.source: Chase me.
unit.target: Persequere me!

unit.source: This way, no one will use the item that honored the ancestors to steal the deep power about to erupt.
unit.target: Hac via, nemo rem, quae maiores honorat, ad furtum potentiae profundae, quae eruptura est, adhibebit.

unit.source: Let’s see who reacts the fastest and ‘teleports’ out of these waters when the time comes!
unit.target: Videamus quis celerissime respondeat et ex his aquis se per translocationem evadat, cum tempus adveniet!

unit.source: For those unable to escape in time, they would undoubtedly be torn to pieces by the violent power, much like the fate that befell others on the ship!
unit.target: Eis qui tempore effugere non possunt, indubitanter a potentia violenta in frusta lacerentur, sicut fatum aliis in nave evenit.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Mad Lady swiftly turned transparent, evading Lumian’s crimson near-white fireballs and Mr. K’s light-green wind blades.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius cursabantur, Mad Lady celeriter transparentem facta est, evadens globos ignis rubro paene albos Lumian et laminae venti viridis pallidae Mr. K.

unit.source: Amidst the rumbling explosion, Ultraman Lato Guiaro was equally infuriated by Mad Lady’s actions.
unit.target: Inter fragorem explosionis, Ultraman Lato Guiaro aeque irritatus est ob actus Mad Lady.

unit.source: If he were still the temporary and complete Governor of the Sea, he wouldn’t fear the impact of the potent power in the spaceship.
unit.target: Si adhuc gubernator Maris, temporarius et plenus, esset, impetum potentis potentiae in nave spatialis non timeret.

unit.source: He hadn’t intended to release Mad Lady and use Bard’s silver ring.
unit.target: Non intendebat Mad Lady liberari et annulum argenteum Bard adhibere.

unit.source: However, the situation had changed.
unit.target: Attamen, res mutata est.

unit.source: Juan Oro, burning his life and sacrificing flesh and blood, had contested him for the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Juan Oro, vitam suam ardenter comburens et carnem sanguisque sacrificans, de auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris cum eo contendit.

unit.source: In this state, Ultraman couldn’t be certain if he was fully protected or if he would suffer some level of damage.
unit.target: In hoc statu, Ultraman certus esse non poterat utrum plene protegeretur aut aliquam laesionem caperet.

unit.source: Furthermore, not being a true demigod, he wasn’t sure if he could withstand such a blow, one that left him only injured.
unit.target: Praeterea, non vere semideus, non certus erat num talem ictum sustinere posset, qui eum solum vulneratum reliquisset.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but urge Mad Lady with his eyes, but his companion was ‘teleporting’ and didn’t have time to meet his gaze.
unit.target: Conatus est oculis Mad Lady hortari, sed comes eius se teletransportabat et tempus oculis eius contingendi non habebat.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact remained immersed in distant chanting in the darkness, oblivious to the impending sea’s fury.
unit.target: Artifactum sigillatum humanoide in canto procul in tenebris immersum manebat, obliviosum imminenti irae maris.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, corporeal starlight surged from the silver-gray behemoth at the bottom of the sea.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, lumen astrale corporeum ex behemotho argenteo-griseo in fundo maris surrexit.

unit.source: It followed the condensed energy passageway and struck the betrothal ship with a tsunami-like sound, aiming to devour everything around it.
unit.target: Illud viam energiae condensatae secutus est et navem sponsaliti per sonum tsunami similem percussit, intendens omnia circa se vorare.

unit.source: “Here it comes!” Mad Lady eagerly prepared for her extreme escape.
unit.target: «Ecce venit!» Mad Lady ardenter ad extremum effugium se praeparavit.

unit.source: Confronted with the immense wave of starlight, Lumian’s initial reaction was, Why is there another sea’s fury?
unit.target: Confrontatus immensa unda luminis astralis, prima responsio Lumian fuit: "Cur alia ira maris est?"

unit.source: Relying on his combat instincts, he immediately extended his spirituality to the Lie earring on his left ear, activating the high-level stealing power attached to the mystical item.
unit.target: Confidens in instinctibus pugnae, statim spiritualitatem suam extendit ad ornamentum "Lie" in aure sinistra, potentiam furtandi altioris gradus adhaerentem item mysticum activans.

unit.source: The starlight in his eyes took on a more tangible form, as if it had materialized.
unit.target: Lumen astrale in oculis eius magis tangibilis formam suscepit, quasi materializatum esset.
