unit.source: Lumian’s raised left hand subtly twisted his wrist.
unit.target: Manus sinistra elevata, Lumian carpum suum subtile contorsit.

unit.source: The starlight surging from the silver-gray behemoth changed its course, rushing towards Lumian in waves, engulfing the sky and the sea.
unit.target: Lumen astrale, a behemotho argenteo-griseo effluente, cursum mutavit, fluctibus versus Lumian properans, caelum et mare vorans.

unit.source: This was even more terrifying than the previous sea’s rage.
unit.target: Hoc etiam terribilius erat quam ira maris praeterita.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian felt as if an apocalypse had descended.
unit.target: In illo momento, Lumian sensit quasi apocalypsis descenderet.

unit.source: He knew very well that he couldn’t absorb all the stolen power himself.
unit.target: Sciebat bene se totam potentiam furtam ipsi absorbere non posse.

unit.source: Doing so would render him unable to endure, crushed into rotten meat on the spot, indirectly aiding Termiboros in escaping His predicament.
unit.target: Hoc faciens, ipse totam potentiam non sustinere posset, quasi in loco in carnes putridas redactus, atque sic Termiboro indirecte auxilium praestaret ad evadendum ex sua condicione.

unit.source: Fortunately, the stolen power linked to “honoring the ancestors” had the ability to disperse the boon obtained and share it with everyone present and all those with the sea bloodlines in Port Santa, similar to every successful sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Fortunate, potentia furtiva, ad maiores honorandos alligata, facultatem habebat bonum receptum diffundere et cum omnibus adstantibus atque cum omnibus qui sanguine maris in Port Santa sunt communicare, sicut in omni rito orationis maris feliciter confecto.

unit.source: Though a bit greedy and reluctant, Lumian restrained himself.
unit.target: Quamquam paulo avarus et reticentis animo, Lumian se cohibuit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he opened his left hand, seemingly grasping something, and twisted his wrist in the opposite direction.
unit.target: Sine dubitatione, manum sinistram aperuit, quasi aliquid capiens, et carpum in contrariam partem contorsit.

unit.source: Suddenly, the starlight that had darkened the sky and sea seemed to explode from within, scattering radiant starlight in every direction.
unit.target: Subito, lumen astrale, quod caelum et mare obscuraverat, quasi ex intimo explodit, radiante lumen astrale in omnes partes disseminans.

unit.source: “The stars are raining…” Franca, concealed in the cabin on the sailboat, lamented.
unit.target: «Stellae pluant...» Franca, abscondita in cella navis sub vela, lamentabatur.

unit.source: She tightly clutched the Major Arcana card belonging to Judgment in her hand.
unit.target: Arcte tenebat chartam Major Arcana iudicii in manu sua.

unit.source: This wasn’t a plea for Madam Judgment to descend directly.
unit.target: Hoc non erat precatio ut Domina Iudicium directe demergeretur.

unit.source: After all, this wasn’t within her jurisdiction.
unit.target: Postremo, hoc non intra eius iurisdictionem pertinebat.

unit.source: It was to signal the location for the Major Arcana card holders who had already gathered nearby.
unit.target: Id ad locum signandum destinatum erat pro possessoribus chartae Major Arcana, qui iam prope congregati erant.

unit.source: The beams of starlight left dazzling trails as they penetrated the bodies of those nearby and soared towards the bloodline connections farther away.
unit.target: Radia luminis astralis vestigia fulgida relinquebant, dum corpora proximorum penetrabant et versus nexus sanguinis remotiora volabant.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t control this process, so he could only sense a portion of the starlight landing on him, causing his left chest to burn and corrode his flesh.
unit.target: Lumian hunc processum regere non potuit, ergo solum partem luminis astralis, quae in eum incidebat, sentire potuit, quod sinus sinistrum eius ardebatur et carnem eius corrumpere faciebat.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he witnessed a significant amount of starlight being drawn towards the potent sea bloodline and the authority of the Governor of the Sea, surging towards Ultraman and Juan Oro.
unit.target: Simul, testimonium perhibuit quantitatem ingentem luminis astralis, quae ad potentem sanguinem maris atque ad auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris trahebatur, versus Ultraman et Juan Oro properantem.

unit.source: Undoubtedly, the humanoid Sealed Artifact received the most boons.
unit.target: Indubitanter, Artifactum sigillatum humanoide maxima beneficia accepit.

unit.source: Like the eye of a vortex, she incessantly absorbed the surrounding starlight.
unit.target: Sicut oculus vortex, illa circumstantem lumen astrale sine intermissione absorbat.

unit.source: Even the starlight heading towards Hela’s sailboat diminished noticeably.
unit.target: Etiam lumen astrale, quod ad navem Helae vela tendebat, notabiliter decrebuit.

unit.source: Ultraman experienced a replenishment, breaking free from his weakened state after Juan Oro’s two beams, swiftly reclaiming the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Ultraman repletionem sensit, ex statu debilitato post duas radios Juan Oro evasit, et celeriter auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris repetivit.

unit.source: In his moment of elation, Ultraman Lato Guiaro felt intense surprise and confusion.
unit.target: In momento exsultationis, Ultraman Lato Guiaro vehementer admirationem et confusionem sensit.

unit.source: Why can Lumian Lee also steal the spacecraft’s power?
unit.target: Cur etiam Lumian Lee potentiam navis spatialis furari potest?

unit.source: That requires a high-level stealing ability…
unit.target: Id requirit facultatem furtandi altissimo gradu…

unit.source: Hasn’t Bard’s ring already been placed on the altar to honor the ancestors? And we’ve confirmed its corresponding effects.
unit.target: Num annulus Bard iam in altare ad maiores honorandos positus non est? Et effectus eius correspondentes confirmavimus.

unit.source: Isn’t the enchantment only possible once a year?
unit.target: Num incantatio tantum semel in anno fieri non potest?

unit.source: Amidst the echoing shock, Lato Guiaro couldn’t be bothered to ponder the answer.
unit.target: Inter resonantem stupefactum, Lato Guiaro responsum meditari non curavit.

unit.source: His instinctive reaction was to swiftly crush Juan Oro.
unit.target: Instinctiva responsio eius fuit Juan Oro celeriter destruere.

unit.source: Otherwise, who knew what he, now strengthened, would do!
unit.target: Alioquin, quis sciret quid ipse, nunc roboratus, ageret!

unit.source: At that moment, Juan Oro felt a surge of regained strength.
unit.target: In illo momento, Juan Oro vim recuperatam sensit.

unit.source: He observed his cracked chest and hazy flesh, now covered in starlight scales, with blood flowing out dyed in a resplendent "color."
unit.target: Animadvertit pectus eius fissum et carnem obscuram, nunc squamis luminis astralis opertum, cum sanguine effuso, colore splendidissimo tincto.

unit.source: Gazing at Lato Guiaro, he suddenly smiled—a smile of relief, yearning, and evident anger.
unit.target: Intuens Lato Guiaro, subito subridit—risus levationis, desiderii et manifestae irae expressus est.

unit.source: His body underwent a rapid transformation, eyes turning vertical, scales growing, and limbs thickening.
unit.target: Corpus eius celeriter transformatum est, oculi verticaliter conversi, squamae creverunt, et membra crassiora facta sunt.

unit.source: In the span of a breath, he morphed into a humanoid lizard.
unit.target: In unius spiraculi spatio, in lacertam humanoidem mutatus est.

unit.source: During this process, Lato Guiaro condensed a dark-green light that descended on Juan Oro in a series of rays.
unit.target: Durante hoc processu, Lato Guiaro lucem viridem obscuram condensavit, quae in Juan Oro in seriem radiorum descendit.

unit.source: Juan Oro made no attempt to dodge; he endured it.
unit.target: Juan Oro conatum vitandi non fecit; id sustinuit.

unit.source: His aura rapidly weakened, precisely as he desired.
unit.target: Aura eius celeriter debilitata est, prorsus ut ipse desideraverat.

unit.source: His lizard-like form faded, growing increasingly translucent, as if condensed from starlight.
unit.target: Forma eius, lacertae similis, evanuit, et magis magisque translucida facta est, quasi ex lumine astrali condensata.

unit.source: Then, Juan Oro merged into the void representing the sea and spoke to Lato Guiaro with a complex expression, "I’ve returned to the sea. Come quickly too…"
unit.target: Deinde, Juan Oro in vacuum, quod mare repraesentabat, se coniunxit et Lato Guiaro, vultu multiplex, dixit: "Redii ad mare. Cito quoque veni…"

unit.source: At the last few words, Juan Oro gnashed his teeth, not concealing his deep‐seated hatred.
unit.target: Ad ultimas verba, Juan Oro dentes strinxit, profundum odium suum non celans.

unit.source: Every Child of the Sea was prepared to return to the sea, and Juan Oro was no exception.
unit.target: Omnis Puer Maris ad mare redire paratus erat, et Juan Oro non exceptione fuit.

unit.source: However, he hadn’t anticipated doing so in this manner.
unit.target: Attamen, non praevidit se hoc modo id facturum esse.

unit.source: His sole desire now was for Lato Guiaro to join him!
unit.target: Unicum eius desiderium nunc erat ut Lato Guiaro se illi coniunget!

unit.source: Juan Oro’s figure dissipated, becoming entirely a part of the “sea.”
unit.target: Figura Juan Oro dissipata est, totum in partem "maris" redacta.

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro immediately sensed a growing animosity between his title as Governor of the Sea and the waters.
unit.target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro statim sensit crescente inimicitiā inter titulum suum Gubernatoris Maris et aquas.

unit.source: The harmony that once existed had given way to a resistance emanating from the Power of the Sea.
unit.target: Concordia, quae olim exsistebat, cessavit, cedens locum resistentiae emanantis ex Potestate Maris.

unit.source: This indicated that the Governor of the Sea authority he had acquired wouldn’t be complete for some time.
unit.target: Hoc indicabat auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris, quam adeptus erat, per aliquod tempus non plene futuram esse.

unit.source: Damned old fellow! Lato Guiaro cursed inwardly, but he remained composed.
unit.target: Maledictus senex! Lato Guiaro intus maledixit, sed compositus mansit.

unit.source: He had realized that Hela was the sole demigod on the sailboat.
unit.target: Animadvertit Helam solam unicam semideum in nave vela esse.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, having received a boon from the sea and escaped the influence of the chanting, was sufficient to hold off the opposition for a while.
unit.target: Artifactum sigillatum humanoide, beneficium a mari receptum et cantionis influxu evasit, satis erat ad oppositionem aliquantisper sustentandam.

unit.source: Though uncertain why Gandalf and the others hadn’t arrived, Ultraman Lato Guiaro welcomed this turn of events.
unit.target: Quamquam incertus erat cur Gandalf et ceteri non venerint, Ultraman Lato Guiaro hanc reversionem eventuum excipiebat.

unit.source: It allowed him to focus on dealing with Lumian Lee and his ally!
unit.target: Id ei permisit ut se concentreret in negotio cum Lumian Lee et socio eius.

unit.source: Despite being an incomplete Governor of the Sea, he possessed enough strength to control adversaries below the demigod level briefly and gain entry to the spaceship first.
unit.target: Quamvis Gubernator Maris imperfectus esset, satis vim habebat ad regendos adversarios infra gradum semideorum breviter et ut primus in navem spatialis ingrediret.

unit.source: Moreover, Mad Lady’s assistance added to his advantage.
unit.target: Praeterea, auxilium Mad Lady ei commodum addidit.

unit.source: Having received the sea’s boon, Lumian contemplated his newfound capabilities.
unit.target: Beneficium maris receptum, Lumian facultates novas suas consideravit.

unit.source: Now, I seem qualified to contend for the authority of the Governor of the Sea…
unit.target: Nunc videor idoneus esse pro auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris contenderere…

unit.source: Although I can’t be considered to possess the sea bloodline and only wield some power of the sea lasting a week, far inferior to Ultraman, my fake level is high enough. I’m at the Angel level!
unit.target: Etsi non possum dici me sanguinem maris habere et solum aliquam potentiam maris, quae hebdomada perdurat, exercere, longe inferior Ultramano, gradus meus fictus satis altus est. Sum ad gradum Angeli!

unit.source: Just as Ultraman Lato Guiaro and Lumian responded swiftly, the gray sky suddenly brightened.
unit.target: Sicut Ultraman Lato Guiaro et Lumian celeriter respondebant, caelum griseum subito illustratum est.

unit.source: Thick bluish-green vines descended, shrouding the two ships and the surrounding area in torrential rain.
unit.target: Vites densae viride-caeruleae descendebant, duas naves et circumstantem locum in imbre torrenti tegentes.

unit.source: Soon, they intertwined into a giant-like forest growing above the sea.
unit.target: Mox inter se implicatae sunt in silvam gigantescam, quae supra mare crescebat.

unit.source: 581 Gap
unit.target: 581 Hiatus

unit.source: 581 Gap
unit.target: 581 Hiatus

unit.source: Upon witnessing the descent of the thick bluish‐green vines, Lumian marveled as if a real carriage could traverse their expanse.
unit.target: Cum descensum vitarum densarum virido‐caerulearum conspexisset, Lumian admiratus est, quasi currus verus per earum spatium transiret.

unit.source: It felt like a journey back to a scene from a few years ago when he would listen to his sister’s nighttime fairy tales.
unit.target: Videtur iter esse ad scenam abhinc paucis annis, cum sororis fabulas nocturnas audiret.

unit.source: The dazzling, dreamlike scene and boundless imagination seemed to materialize in reality at that very moment.
unit.target: Scaena radiosa et onirica, atque imaginatio sine finibus, videbantur in re isto ipso momento se materialiter ostendere.

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro sensed imminent danger.
unit.target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro periculum imminens sensit.

unit.source: The individual capable of such an effect couldn’t be a Low- or Mid-Sequence Beyonder; they had to be a Saint who had unlocked the door to godhood. Perhaps even beyond Sequence 4!
unit.target: Individuum tale efficere non potuit esse Beyonder ex serie inferiori aut media; debuit esse Sanctus, qui ianuam divinitatis aperuerat. Forsitan etiam ultra Sequence 4!

unit.source: Another formidable demigod had entered the scene!
unit.target: Alius semideus formidolosus in scaenam intravit!

unit.source: Who could it be?
unit.target: Quis hoc esse possit?

unit.source: Where had they emerged from?
unit.target: Unde apparuerant?

unit.source: This certainly wasn’t Gandalf.
unit.target: Hoc certe non erat Gandalf.

unit.source: While others might be unaware, Loki had thoroughly investigated the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, discovering he was a Beyonder of the Warrior pathway—a Warrior who had a penchant for research and mysticism.
unit.target: Dum alii fortasse nesciebant, Loki diligenter investigavit praesidem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum, detegens eum fuisse Beyonder in via Bellatoris — bellatorem qui studium inquisitionis et mysticismi habebat.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Lato Guiaro spotted a black shadow racing down the thick green vines.
unit.target: In instante, Lato Guiaro animadvertit umbram atram, quae per vites densas virido‐caeruleas celeriter descenderet.

unit.source: It was an enormous pumpkin drawn by numerous gray mice.
unit.target: Erat cucurbita ingens, a plurimis muribus cinereis trahente.

unit.source: A hole atop the orange pumpkin resembled a coach.
unit.target: Foramen in summo cucurbitae aurantii instar carri videbatur.

unit.source: Within, a vaguely discernible woman sat, adorned in a purple robe, with crystalline heels adorning her feet.
unit.target: Intus, mulier vago modo percepta sedebat, induta toga purpurea, et calceis crystallinis ornata.

unit.source: A pumpkin coach, mice-drawn carriage, crystal heels—WHAT THE FUCK IS THAT!?
unit.target: Currus cucurbitae, carrus ab muribus cinereis tractus, calcei crystallini — QUID DIABOLICUM EST ISTUD!?

unit.source: Who could it be?
unit.target: Quis hoc esse possit?

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s pupils dilated, and he couldn’t help but inwardly curse with the same words he used most frequently before transmigration.
unit.target: Pupillae Lato Guiaro dilatatae sunt, et intus maledixit his ipsis verbis, quae ante transmigrationem maxime usurpare solebat.

unit.source: Isn’t that Cinderella?
unit.target: Nonne illa Cinderella est?

unit.source: Did Roselle actually pen this fairy tale?
unit.target: Num Roselle vere hanc fabulam scripsit?

unit.source: Why hadn’t it gained traction, remaining unknown to most?
unit.target: Cur non usque ad favorem pervenit, manens plurimis incognita?

unit.source: For a fleeting moment, Lato Guiaro grappled with uncertainty, unable to discern whether the newcomer was a demigod aligned with another faction or a concealed powerhouse within the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
unit.target: Per brevem momentum, Lato Guiaro cum incertitudine luctatus est, neque distinguere poterat utrum novus adveniens semideus sectae alterae consociatus esset aut arcana potentia intra Societatem Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum latens.

unit.source: Regaining his composure, he cursed his ill fortune and prepared himself for a confrontation with the enigmatic demigod.
unit.target: Compositum animum recuperans, fortunam infaustam suam maledixit et se ad congressum cum semideo mysterioso praeparavit.

unit.source: Luckily, being the Governor of the Sea, he could at least temporarily impede the other party in these aquatic surroundings.
unit.target: Felix, gubernator maris, saltem pro tempore adversarium in his aquatis circumstantiis impedire poterat.

unit.source: Prior to the impending clash, Ultraman Lato Guiaro turned his gaze towards Mad Lady.
unit.target: Ante certamen imminens, Ultraman Lato Guiaro oculos convertit in Mad Lady.

unit.source: He didn’t have time to speak, but his eyes expressed the unspoken message: “Hurry up! No time for games!”
unit.target: Non tempus habebat loquendi, sed oculi eius tacitam nuntiationem efferebant: “Festina! Nullum tempus ludis!”

unit.source: Mad Lady swiftly grasped Ultraman’s urgency and, with a blink, positioned herself at the entrance of the energy passageway.
unit.target: Mad Lady celeriter percipuit urgentiam Ultraman et, in ictu oculi, se ad introitum viæ energiae collocavit.

unit.source: However, instead of materializing precisely there, she outlined her presence.
unit.target: Sed pro eo ut ibi exacte apparuisset, praesentiam suam delineavit.

unit.source: This decision was prompted by the sudden appearance of Mr. K and Lumian, seemingly having “teleported” nearby, with their sights set on the energy passageway’s entrance.
unit.target: Haec electio orta est ex subita apparitione Domini K et Lumian, qui quasi in propinquia teleportati, oculos in introitum viæ energiae fixos habebant.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: Whether from the imposing weight of the humanoid Sealed Artifact or Lato Guiaro raising his right arm, conjuring a mountainous azure wave, the water around the cave visibly swayed, teetering on the brink of collapse.
unit.target: Utrum ex grave pondus Artificii Sigillati humanoidi aut a Lato Guiaro dextram manum levante, fluctum caeruleum montuosum evocante, aqua circa speluncam manifeste agitata est, in limine ruinae vacillans.

unit.source: In that critical moment, “Cinderella,” seated in the pumpkin carriage, pushed open the door and rose to her feet.
unit.target: In illo momento critico, “Cinderella”, in curru cucurbitae sedens, ostium aperuit et in pedes surrexit.

unit.source: She extended her arms, and a massive iron-black cross materialized behind her.
unit.target: Bracchia sua protulit, et ingens crux ferro nigro post eam apparuit.

unit.source: The weight of the cross proved challenging for “Cinderella” to bear, as though it carried the concentrated sins of the entire world.
unit.target: Pondus crucis “Cinderellae” ferre difficillimum evasit, quasi peccata totius mundi condensata afferret.

unit.source: A cross?
unit.target: Crux?

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro was caught off guard as an empty room materialized before him.
unit.target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro inopinanter obstupefactus est, cum conclave vacuum ante eum apparuerit.

unit.source: Within the room, candlelight flickered, revealing a long table adorned with flesh and blood.
unit.target: Intra conclave, lumen candelae micabat, revelans mensam longam in carne et sanguine ornatam.

unit.source: On either side of the table, three obscure figures hunched over, gnawing and feasting on a gruesome banquet.
unit.target: Flanque mensae, tres figurae obscurae incurvatae erant, manducantes et devorantes convivium horrendum.

unit.source: Abruptly, the three figures turned their heads, fixing their gaze upon Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Subito, tres figurae capita converterunt, oculos in Lato Guiaro figebant.

unit.source: He stood frozen, as if their gazes had penetrated his deepest secrets, dismantling them into the essential components of spirit and flesh.
unit.target: Stetit immobilis, quasi oculi eorum arcana eius profunda penetravissent, dissipans ea in elementa essentialia spiritus et carnis.

unit.source: A chilling sensation surged from the depths of Lato Guiaro’s heart, immediately alerting him to an intense and terrifying malice.
unit.target: Ex profundis cordis Lato Guiaro, sensus frigoris effusus est, statim eum admonens de malitia intensa et terribili.

unit.source: However, the source of this malevolence wasn’t the newly arrived demigod but the silver-gray behemoth trapped at the sea’s bottom—the very spaceship Lato Guiaro sought to obtain harbored ill intentions towards him!
unit.target: Attamen, fons huius malitiae non fuit novus semideus, sed argentogriseus behemoth in fundo maris inclusus—ipsa navis spatialis, quam Lato Guiaro obtinere cupiebat, adversus eum malas intensiones habebat!

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the silver-gray behemoth retracted its authority.
unit.target: In instante, argentogriseus behemoth suam auctoritatem retraxit.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s status as the Governor of the Sea plummeted.
unit.target: Status Lato Guiaro ut gubernator maris lapsus est.

unit.source: Despite gaining a new boon, he couldn’t ascend to the demigod level.
unit.target: Quamvis novum beneficium adeptus esset, ad gradum semidei ascendere non potuit.

unit.source: The spaceship had betrayed him.
unit.target: Navis spatialis eum proditus est.

unit.source: This treachery was a result of the spell Cinderella had just unleashed—the Feast of Betrayal.
unit.target: Haec proditio orta est ex incantatione, quam Cinderella modo dimiserat—Epulum Proditoris.

unit.source: Its purpose was to temporarily awaken or bestow intelligence on a target item, compelling it to commit an act of “betrayal.”
unit.target: Propositum eius fuit re destinatā temporarie excitare aut intelligentiam tribuere, coactionem efficens ut actum “proditoris” committeretur.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro had seamlessly melded with the surrounding waters, harnessing the authority of the Governor of the Sea on a temporary basis.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro facile se cum aquis circumstantibus contulit, auctoritatem gubernatoris maris pro tempore sumens.

unit.source: The spaceship now stood as an entity he had yet to fully master.
unit.target: Navis spatialis nunc stabat ut entitas, quam nondum plene dominari potuerat.

unit.source: Objects beyond his full control were prime candidates for betrayal!
unit.target: Res, quae extra eius plenam potestatem erant, candidatae optimae pro proditione erant!

unit.source: “Cinderella” astutely sensed this vulnerability, initiating the Feast of Betrayal from the outset.
unit.target: Cinderella callide hanc infirmitatem sensit, ab initio Epulum Proditoris inchoans.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the sealed environment provided the perfect conditions for her to unleash this magic—an act she might not dare attempt elsewhere.
unit.target: Simul, ambitus clausus condiciones perfectas praebebat ad hanc magiam liberandam—actum, quem alibi forte non ausus esset.

unit.source: In that moment, surprise and fear flooded Lato Guiaro. It felt as though a frigid cascade had drenched him, sending shivers through his entire being.
unit.target: In illo momento, stupor et timor Lato Guiaro inundaverunt; videbatur quasi cataracta frigida eum perfusam fecisset, per totum corpus suum tremores inferret.

unit.source: Since merging with the sea and gaining the Governor of the Sea’s authority, Lato Guiaro had believed that ordinary Sequence 4 or even Sequence 3 demigods—commonly referred to as Saints—couldn’t swiftly overpower him in this realm.
unit.target: Postquam cum mari coniunctus et auctoritatem gubernatoris maris adeptus est, Lato Guiaro credebat semideos ordinarios Sequence 4 aut etiam Sequence 3—ut saepe “Sancti” appellantur—celeriter eum in hoc regno superare non posse.

unit.source: This belief created a sense of parity, but it hinged on him remaining within the waters to fully unleash his strength.
unit.target: Haec opinio sensum aequalitatis creavit, sed pendebat ex eo quod intra aquas maneret ut virtutem suam plene efferret.

unit.source: Yet, “Cinderella’s” mere magic stripped him of the Governor of the Sea’s authority, relegating him to Sequence 5. Without godhood, mastery over the sea slipped from his grasp.
unit.target: Attamen, sola magica Cinderellae eum de auctoritate gubernatoris maris eripuit, ad Sequence 5 deprimens; sine divinitate, dominatio maris e manibus eius lapsa est.

unit.source: Despite being a dual Sequence 5 of a potion and boon system with numerous unique abilities, Lato Guiaro harbored doubts about facing a genuine demigod.
unit.target: Quamvis duplex Sequence 5 in systemate potionis et beneficii cum plurimis facultatibus singularibus esset, Lato Guiaro dubitationes de adversando verum semideo habebat.

unit.source: A demigod temporarily shaped from an item proves fragile in the face of a true demigod.
unit.target: Semideus, ex re aliquo tempore formatum, fragile se ostendit coram vero semideo.

unit.source: So brittle that, once targeted, they wouldn’t endure even a breath… Lato Guiaro grappled with the stark realization of the fragility of a true demigod and sank into deep regret and despair.
unit.target: Tam fragiles, ut, semel admossi, ne spiritum quidem sustinerent… Lato Guiaro acerrime intellexit fragilitatem veri semidei et in profundo paenitentiae atque desperationis statu cecidit.

unit.source: At that moment, the silver-gray behemoth trembled violently, causing the energy passageway at the entrance to flicker and cast its luminance upon Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: In illo momento, argentogriseus behemoth vehementer trepidavit, faciens ut introitus viæ energiae micaret atque luminis sui fulgorem in Lato Guiaro proiiceret.

unit.source: With a whoosh, Lato Guiaro found himself hurtling uncontrollably into the spaceship through the pure energy conduit.
unit.target: Cum impetu, Lato Guiaro se invenit irrumpere in navem spatialis per canalem energiae purum sine moderamine.

unit.source: This was a facet of the spaceship’s calculated “betrayal,” aiming to turn the recent “authority holder” into a mere nutritive substrate within a petri dish!
unit.target: Hoc erat pars navis spatialis consiliatae proditionis, quae recentem “auctoritatis possessorem” in solum substratum nutritivum intra vas petrae convertere volebat!

unit.source: Lato Guiaro was initially startled, but soon a wave of joy washed over him.
unit.target: Primum Lato Guiaro obstupefactus est, sed mox fluctus laetitiae eum inundavit.

unit.source: An opportunity had presented itself!
unit.target: Occasio apparuit!

unit.source: It allowed him to infiltrate the spaceship, wrest control, and set it in motion—a chance to escape!
unit.target: Id illi permisit navem spatialis infiltrare, imperium eripere, et eam in motum adducere—occasio ad effugiendum!

unit.source: His misfortune and despair had suddenly transformed into this golden opportunity!
unit.target: Infaustitas et desperatio eius subito in hanc auream occasionem conversa erant!

unit.source: Observing the unfolding scene, Lumian wasted no time. He employed Spirit World Traversal once more, reaching the entrance of the energy passageway. Stepping in, he soared into the silver-gray behemoth.
unit.target: Observans scaenam evolutam, Lumian nullum tempus amovit. Iterum Spiritus Mundi Transitus ad introitum viæ energiae adhibuit; ingrediens, in argentogriseum behemoth se immergit.

unit.source: Mad Lady trailed closely behind, and Mr. K didn’t intervene; instead, he followed suit.
unit.target: Mad Lady proximē sequebatur, et Mr. K non intervenit; sed ipse quoque secutus est.

unit.source: Milo Village, Governor of the Sea’s residence.
unit.target: Vicus Milo, domicilium gubernatoris maris.

unit.source: Bard, strategizing an escape plan, was abruptly interrupted by cheers.
unit.target: Bard, consilium evasionis excogitans, repente plausibus interpellatus est.

unit.source: Cheers… Bard’s heart stirred, prompting him to dash out of the servant’s room towards the nearest glass window overlooking the dock.
unit.target: Plaudite… Bard cor excitatus est, et statim constituit ex conclavi servorum versus proxima fenestra vitrea, quae ad portum aspiciebat, properare.

unit.source: There, he observed the gathered villagers.
unit.target: Ibi congregatos vicanos observavit.

unit.source: Not a single sea spawn hindered the former Governor of the Sea during this process.
unit.target: Ne una quidem creatura marina quondam gubernatorem maris in hoc processu impediit.

unit.source: Many villagers raised their hands, seemingly welcoming the waves.
unit.target: Multi vicani manus elevaverunt, quasi fluctus excipientibus.

unit.source: As they praised the sea, an almost invisible glow descended, dispersing like water to different individuals.
unit.target: Dum mare laudabant, fulgor paene invisibilis descendit, sicut aqua in varios homines diffusus est.

unit.source: The nearby children joyfully shouted, “The sea prayer ritual has succeeded! The sea prayer ritual has succeeded!”
unit.target: Proximī pueri laeti exclamaverunt: “Ritus orationis maris successit! Ritus orationis maris successit!”

unit.source: That’s right, it has “succeeded”… Bard smiled.
unit.target: Ita est, successit est… Bard subrisit.

unit.source: From the looks of it, Ultraman and Mad Lady have succeeded.
unit.target: Ex aspectu, videtur Ultraman et Mad Lady successisse.

unit.source: The April Fool’s key member adjusted the collar of his crisp white shirt and hoisted a brown backpack onto his shoulders.
unit.target: Membrum cardinale Aprilis Stulti collarem vestis albae nitidae temperavit et saccum fuscum super umeros attulit.

unit.source: With an unabashed smile, he strolled into the grand hall of the Governor of the Sea’s residence, smoothly making his way out.
unit.target: Cum absque pudore subrisus, in magnum atrium domicilii gubernatoris maris ambulavit et leniter exiit.

unit.source: This time, he encountered no resistance.
unit.target: Hoc tempore nullam resistentiam invenit.

unit.source: The guards stationed at the entrance knelt on the ground, expressing gratitude to the sea for its boon.
unit.target: Custodes, ad introitum positi, in terra genu flexerunt, gratiam maris pro beneficio suo exprimentes.

unit.source: Bard took a detour to the docks, reveling in the genuine joy and praise for the sea.
unit.target: Bard iter alternum ad molas cepit, gaudio vero et laude pro mari delectatus.

unit.source: Every time he heard the townsfolk praising the sea and witnessed genuine smiles, his spirits lifted.
unit.target: Quoties cives mare laudabant et risus sinceri apparuerunt, animus eius elevabatur.

unit.source: These fools!
unit.target: Hi stulti!

unit.source: They are treating a catastrophe as a cause for celebration!
unit.target: Catastropham quasi causam celebrationis agunt!

unit.source: This is a prank, a prank on everyone in Port Santa… Bard closed his eyes in satisfaction and weaved through the crowd, heading deeper into Milo Village. His ultimate destination: the peaks of the Pyraez mountain range.
unit.target: Hoc est iocus, iocus erga omnes in Port Santa… Bard oculos claudit ex satisfactione et per turbam serpens in Vicum Milo profundius se contendens. Eius ultima destinatio: cacumina montium Pyraez.

unit.source: As a former Swindler, Bard orchestrated the sea prayer ritual operation, serving as its main planner. The plan’s success naturally brought him satisfaction.
unit.target: Ut pristinus fallax, Bard operationem ritus orationis maris ordinavit, principalis eius consiliarius fungens; successus consilii naturaliter ei satisfactionem attulit.

unit.source: Crucially, despite taking the most pivotal step in the entire operation, he assumed the least risk and exposure, avoiding direct confrontations.
unit.target: Praecipue, quamvis maximum gradum in tota operatione cepisset, minimum periculum et expositionem tulit, directos congressus vitans.

unit.source: Navigating through the mix of ancient and modern structures in Milo Village, Bard’s brow furrowed slightly.
unit.target: Per mixturam antiqualium et modernarum structurarum in Vicus Milo navigans, supercilia Bard leviter contraxit.

unit.source: A sense of unease settled upon him.
unit.target: Sensus inquietudinis eum afflixit.

unit.source: Per the initial plan, Ultraman—unhindered by strong opposition—was supposed to use the second command to open the energy passageway.
unit.target: Secundum consilium initium, Ultraman, non impeditus a valida oppositio, mandatum secundum ad viam energiae aperiendam adhibere debuit.

unit.source: Relying on his temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea, he aimed to secure safety for himself and Mad Lady within him.
unit.target: Confidens in auctoritate temporaria gubernatoris maris, intendebat securitatem sibi et Mad Lady praestare.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, he planned to eliminate all present and inflict severe injuries on potential demigod adversaries.
unit.target: Occasionem arripiens, destinavit omnes presentes occidere et adversariis potentialibus semideorum graves iniurias inferre.

unit.source: If powerhouses like Hela emerged and proved resistant to the humanoid Sealed Artifact, Ultraman—the interim Governor of the Sea—would leap into action, confronting the formidable foes head-on.
unit.target: Si potentes ut Hela emerissent et adversus Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem resisterent, Ultraman, gubernator provvisorius maris, in actionem saliturus esset, hostes formidabiles directe oppugnans.

unit.source: Mad Lady, wielding her enchanted ring, would harness the potent energy emanating from the spaceship, transforming it into a boon for everyone present, extending its reach to all the Children of the Sea in Port Santa’s vicinity.
unit.target: Mad Lady, anulo incantato gerens, potentem energiam ex navis spatialis effluentem congregabat, eam in beneficium omnibus praesentibus transformans, et vim eius ad omnes Filios Maris in vicinitate Port Santa extendens.

unit.source: This strategic move not only allowed them to sidestep danger but also granted them access to the spaceship, enabling them to activate it.
unit.target: Hoc consilium non solum eos periculum vitandi, sed etiam aditum ad navem spatialis obtinendi concedebat, ut eam activare possent.

unit.source: Despite the fact that the people had already received the sea’s boon and a few minutes had elapsed, the spaceship remained dormant, and the sky showed no signs of change.
unit.target: Quamquam populus iam beneficium maris accepit et pauca minuta transierunt, navis spatialis quieta manebat, et caelum nullas mutationis signa ostendebat.

unit.source: What had transpired during this interval?
unit.target: Quid in hoc intervallo evenit?

unit.source: With this lingering question, Bard hastened his steps.
unit.target: Haec quaestio manens, Bard celeriter ambulare coepit.

unit.source: Tap, tap, tap.
unit.target: Tap, tap, tap.

unit.source: Behind him, the faint sound of light footsteps echoed once again.
unit.target: Post eum, sonus levium vestigiorum pedum iterum resonavit.

unit.source: 582 Efficient Person-Locator
unit.target: 582 Efficiens Persona-Inquisitor

unit.source: 582 Efficient Person-Locator
unit.target: 582 Efficiens Persona-Inquisitor

unit.source: Port Santa, in the city.
unit.target: Portus Santa, in urbe.

unit.source: Loki and the unconscious Ludwig had already sought refuge in an apartment that Loki had rented many days earlier.
unit.target: Loki et Ludwig comatosus iam refugium quaesiverant in apartamento, quod Loki plurimis diebus antea locaverat.

unit.source: He began manipulating the sealed demigod’s Spirit Body Threads.
unit.target: Incepit tractare fila spiritus corporis demigodi sigillati.

unit.source: As for his two marionettes, they lurked within a radius of 100 to 200 meters, with Loki as the center, blending in with the various celebrating and passing crowds.
unit.target: Quoad duas marionettas eius, latebabant intra radium centum ad ducentos metra, cum Loki ut centrum, se commiscens cum variis turbis festantibus et praetereuntibus.

unit.source: They waited to be discovered by Lumian Lee’s teammates and the clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Exspectabant ut reperirentur a sociis Lumiani Lee et a clerico Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: This was unavoidable.
unit.target: Hoc inevitabile erat.

unit.source: A Marionettist couldn’t allow a marionette to wield their Faceless powers.
unit.target: Marionettista non poterat sinere ut marionetta potentias, quae facie carent, adhiberet.

unit.source: As for the mystical item of the Seer pathway, it was in the possession of either Bard or Mad Lady.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad rem mysticam viae Videntium, illa in potestate vel Bardi aut Dominae Insanae erat.

unit.source: In the partially destroyed suite of Solow Motel, Jenna and Anthony encountered Noelia, the combat nun, and her teammates, who had hurried over.
unit.target: In conclavi partim deleta Solow Motel, Jenna et Anthony convenerunt Noeliam, monacham pugnacem, et sodales eius, qui festinanter venerant.

unit.source: Before this, Lumian had covertly introduced the disguised Jenna and Anthony to Noelia.
unit.target: Ante hoc, Lumian secrete dissimulatos Jenna et Anthony Noeliam introduxit.

unit.source: Hence, the nuns didn’t unnecessarily question or apprehend them; they only carefully confirmed each other’s identities.
unit.target: Ita, monachae eos non supervacue interrogaverunt neque apprehenderunt; sed solum diligenter identitates invicem confirmaverunt.

unit.source: "Rubió Paco is a fake.
unit.target: "Rubió Paco fictus est.

unit.source: "He's disguised by a Marionettist.
unit.target: "A Marionettista eum dissimulavit.

unit.source: "He has captured Louis Berry’s godson.
unit.target: "Rapuit filium sponsi Louis Berry.

unit.source: "He possesses two marionettes.
unit.target: "Duas marionettas habet.

unit.source: "One is Madame Martha, the Paco family’s matriarch.
unit.target: "Una est Domina Martha, mater familiae Paco.

unit.source: "The other’s identity and abilities are unknown," Jenna recounted the recent events.
unit.target: "Alterius identitas et facultates incognitae sunt," Jenna res recentes enarravit.

unit.source: She assumed that the Fertility Order was familiar with the term Marionettist and didn’t delve into unnecessary explanations.
unit.target: Existimavit Ordinem Fertilitatis verbum Marionettista noto esse et in explicationes superfluas non intrasse.

unit.source: Their primary duty was to guard against the Intis Republic to the north, and many official Beyonders of Bureau 8 in the Intis Republic belonged to the Seer pathway.
unit.target: Officium primarium eorum erat contra Rempublicam Intis in Septentrione defendere, et multi officiales Beyonders Bureau VIII in Republica Intis ad viam Videntium pertinere solebant.

unit.source: The two sides must have had considerable interactions.
unit.target: Utraque pars debuit inter se interactiones considerabiles habuisse.

unit.source: Marionettist… Indeed, upon hearing the Sequence name, Noelia frowned slightly.
unit.target: Marionettista… Certe, audito nomen Sequentiae, Noelia leviter frontem contraxit.

unit.source: Is Intis sending spies to disrupt the sea prayer ritual?
unit.target: Num Intis speculatores mittit ut ritum orationis maritimam interrumpat?

unit.source: "That's a traitor from Intis’s Bureau 8," Jenna explained, her allegiance to Intis stronger than Lumian’s.
unit.target: "Ille est proditor Bureau VIII Intis," Jenna explicavit, eius fides Intis fortior quam Lumiani.

unit.source: Noelia understood that time was of the essence and she couldn’t discuss unrelated matters.
unit.target: Noelia intellexit tempus pretiosum esse et res extraneas tractare non posse.

unit.source: "Why seize Louis Berry’s godson?
unit.target: Cur capiatur filius sponsi Louis Berry?

unit.source: "Is he held as a hostage, or does he possess some extraordinary significance?"
unit.target: Num eum retinuerint ut captivitatis exemplum, an aliquam significationem extraordinariam habeat?

unit.source: Jenna thought for a moment and revealed the limited information she had just learned.
unit.target: Jenna paulisper meditata est et informationes limitatas, quas modo didicerat, revelavit.

unit.source: "It's a sealed demigod, a creature.
unit.target: «Est semi-deus sigillatus, creatura.

unit.source: "Loki will need substantial time to transform him into a marionette, not just a matter of minutes."
unit.target: Loki tempus considerabile requiret ut eum in marionettam convertat, non tantum in paucis minutis.

unit.source: A demigod?
unit.target: Semi-deus?

unit.source: A sealed demigod?
unit.target: Semi-deus sigillatus?

unit.source: That child with the insatiable appetite is a sealed demigod?
unit.target: Num puer ille, insatiabili appetitu praeditus, sit semi-deus sigillatus?

unit.source: Noelia’s mouth hung open in surprise and astonishment.
unit.target: Os Noeliae in stupore et admiratione patefactum erat.

unit.source: She almost questioned the reliability of her own ears.
unit.target: Paene dubitavit fidem aurium suarum.

unit.source: The supposed godson of the adventurer Louis Berry is, in fact, a sealed demigod creature?
unit.target: Num filius sponsi peragratoris Louis Berry re vera creatura semi-dei sigillati sit?

unit.source: What’s his backstory?
unit.target: Quae est eius historia?

unit.source: Why is he wandering around with a sealed demigod creature?
unit.target: Cur vagatur cum creatura semi-dei sigillati?

unit.source: Moreover, there’s talk of a humanoid Sealed Artifact, rumored to be at Grade 1, that recently surfaced in Port Santa.
unit.target: Praeterea, dicitur de Artefacto Sigillato humanoide, putato esse gradus primi, qui nuper in Portus Santa apparuit.

unit.source: It’s on par with a sealed demigod creature.
unit.target: Par est creaturae semi-dei sigillatae.

unit.source: Despite extensive searching, no one has been able to locate it.
unit.target: Non obstante lata investigatione, nemo id reperire potuit.

unit.source: If not for the disparities in appearance, gender, and age, Noelia might have suspected Ludwig to be the humanoid Sealed Artifact that the Eternal Blazing Sun Church had “misplaced.”
unit.target: Nisi ob differentias in specie, genere, et aetate, Noelia forsitan existimasset Ludovicum esse Artefactum Sigillatum humanoidem, quod Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Incandescentis “amitterat.”

unit.source: Now, an absurd idea echoed in her mind.
unit.target: Nunc, idea absurda in mente eius resonavit.

unit.source: Is it the current trend to stroll around with sealed demigod creatures?
unit.target: Estne hodierna consuetudo ambulare cum creaturis semi-dei sigillatis?

unit.source: Regaining her composure, Noelia promptly addressed her team members, "Cemilie, quickly return to the Order and inform the dean.
unit.target: Compositam recuperans, Noelia statim sodalibus suis dixit: "Cemilie, celeriter redi ad Ordinem et decano nuntia.

unit.source: Ask her to deploy all available personnel to the city.
unit.target: Roga ut totius manus, quae praesto est, in urbem mittatur.

unit.source: Locate them as soon as possible.
unit.target: Eos quam primum inveni.

unit.source: Yes, Madam Martha or Louis Berry’s godson, Ludwig.
unit.target: Ita, Domina Martha aut filius sponsi Louis Berry, Ludwig.

unit.source: After finding them, unless the situation is exceptionally urgent, refrain from acting recklessly.
unit.target: Post inveniendos, nisi res sit eximie urgens, noli imprudenter agere.

unit.source: Report first and await assistance.
unit.target: Primum refer et auxilium exspecta.

unit.source: Considering that the Marionettist had likely altered his appearance and height, and the identity and appearance of his other marionette were unknown, Noelia concentrated her search on Madam Martha, who had become a marionette, and Ludwig, who had been abducted.
unit.target: Cum Marionettista verisimiliter speciem et staturam mutaverit, et identitas ac species alterius marionettae incognitae essent, Noelia inquisitionem suam concentravit in Domina Martha, quae in marionettam versa erat, et in Ludovico, qui raptus fuerat.

unit.source: "Yes, Captain!"
unit.target: «Ita, Capitane!»

unit.source: In a bid to save time, the brown-haired Cemilie darted through the shattered glass window.
unit.target: Ad tempus servandum, Cemilie, capillis fusco, per fenestram fractam vitrei celeriter exiit.

unit.source: Utilizing the stone bricks and wood protruding from the outer wall, she leaped from the fifth floor to the street.
unit.target: Utendo lateribus lapideis et ligneis ex pariete externo eminente, a quinto tabulato in viam saltavit.

unit.source: The dean Noelia referred to was the head of the local cloister, the clergyman overseeing the Fertility Order in Port Santa—the Fertility Order’s headquarters in Torres, the capital of Gaia Province.
unit.target: Decanus, quem Noelia nominavit, erat caput claustri localis, clericus curans Ordinem Fertilitatis in Portus Santa—sedes Ordini Fertilitatis in Torres, caput Provinciae Gaiae.

unit.source: Just as Cemilie took a few steps and was about to explore the nearby streets, Jenna, Anthony, Noelia, and the others witnessed a massive bird soaring through the air.
unit.target: Ita ut Cemilie paucos passus fecit et vias proximas explorare parabat, Jenna, Anthony, Noelia, et ceteri ingentem avem per aerem volitantem conspexerunt.

unit.source: The bird’s body was grayish-black, its feathers were tough and lacked softness.
unit.target: Corpus avis erat griseo-nigrum, pennæ eius duræ erant et suavitate caruerunt.

unit.source: Its eyes appeared to be adorned with two rubies.
unit.target: Oculi eius videbantur duobus rubinīs ornati esse.

unit.source: The grayish-black bird flapped its wings and glided to the collapsed fifth-floor outer wall of Solow Motel.
unit.target: Avis griseo-nigra alas concussit et ad parietem externum quinto tabulato Solow Motel lapsum labatur.

unit.source: Only then did Jenna and Anthony realize that the grayish-black bird was sculpted from stone.
unit.target: Tandem Jenna et Anthony intellexerunt avem griseo-nigram ex lapide sculptam esse.

unit.source: It was weighty, substantial, and unyielding, yet it emanated a vibrant vitality.
unit.target: Gravissima, solida, et intransibila erat, attamen vigorem vivum emanabat.

unit.source: Perched on the back of the lifelike grayish-black bird was a woman in a brown clergyman’s robe.
unit.target: In dorso avis vividae griseo-nigræ, mulier vestita vestimentis clericalibus fuscis sedebat.

unit.source: She wore a nun’s wimple with wheat patterns and seemed to be in her thirties, but she exuded a maternal aura, as if she had nurtured many children.
unit.target: Ea portabat caput velamentum monachae cum figuris triticis et videbatur esse in annis tricesimorum, sed emanabat maternam auram, quasi multos filios nutrisset.

unit.source: The brown-haired, brown-eyed, mature, and stunning clergyman turned her gaze to Noelia and succinctly stated, "Details."
unit.target: Clericus, capillis fusco, oculis fusco, maturus, et eximie pulcher, ad Noeliam vertit et concise dixit, "Detalia."

unit.source: Noelia swiftly echoed Jenna’s words.
unit.target: Noelia celeriter verba Jennae repetivit.

unit.source: She positioned herself with a slight spread of her legs and raised her hands.
unit.target: Se collocavit cum cruribus paulum abductis et manus levavit.

unit.source: "Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!"
unit.target: «Lauda Terram, lauda Matrem Omnium Rerum!»

unit.source: The clergyman was none other than the archbishop of the Church of Earth Mother’s Gaia diocese, Agrippina.
unit.target: Clericus erat archiepiscopus diocesis Gaiae Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, Agrippina.

unit.source: Agrippina nodded gently and uttered, "I know Martha from the Paco family.
unit.target: Agrippina leniter annuit et dixit, "Martham e familia Paco novi.

unit.source: I didn’t expect her to meet such a fate.
unit.target: Non exspectabam ut talem fatum ei contingeret.

unit.source: Sigh, may the Earth Mother embrace her soul, and may the flower symbolizing her bloom again next spring.
unit.target: Heu, Mater Terrae, amplectat animam eius, et flos, qui eam repraesentat, iterum in proximo vere florere faciat.

unit.source: The archbishop delicately shifted her right foot, conveying a signal to the massive bird sculpted from grayish-black stone.
unit.target: Archiepiscopa delicatissime dextrum pedem commovit, signum tradens ad avem ingentem ex lapide griseo-nigro sculptam.

unit.source: The stone bird, pulsating with vitality, flapped its wings and ascended dozens of meters into the air.
unit.target: Avis lapidea, vitalitate pulsa, alas concussit et per decem metra vel plura in aerem ascendit.

unit.source: Agrippina extended her right hand and scattered a handful of dark-black seeds the size of rice grains.
unit.target: Agrippina dextram manum protendit et semina nigrorum, quanta sunt granuli oryzorum, disseminavit.

unit.source: With a flutter, the port’s white-headed seabirds flocked in, covering the sky.
unit.target: Cum alarum vibratione, aves marinae capite albo congregatae in portum volitarunt, caelum tegens.

unit.source: Each one gripped a seed in its beak and circled around.
unit.target: Quisque seminum in rostro tenebat et circum volitabat.

unit.source: They formed a circle within a 300-meter radius.
unit.target: Circulum intra radium trecentorum metrorum constituerunt.

unit.source: Observing this spectacle, the jubilant citizens of Port Santa, assuming that the seabirds had joined in the celebration of the successful sea prayer ritual, erupted in cheers of delight.
unit.target: Observantes hoc spectaculum, cives hilari Portus Santa, putantes aves marinae ad celebrationem ritus orationis maris felicis se adiunxisse, exclamaverunt laetitiae plausu.

unit.source: After two to three minutes, a solitary combat nun spotted Madam Martha.
unit.target: Post duos ad tres minutas, monacha pugnax solitaria Domina Martha conspexit.

unit.source: The marionette was concealed on the other side of Aquina Street.
unit.target: Marionetta in altera parte Viae Aquinae abscondita erat.

unit.source: Upon receiving the information, Agrippina turned her head and fixed her gaze into the air.
unit.target: Recepit informationem, Agrippina caput vertit et oculos in aerem fixit.

unit.source: Soon, the white-headed seabirds released the rice-sized seeds from their beaks.
unit.target: Mox aves marinae, capite albo, semina oryzacea ex rostris dimiserunt.

unit.source: Agrippina withdrew her gaze and folded her arms across her chest.
unit.target: Agrippina oculos avertit et brachia in pectore sibi implicavit.

unit.source: Each seed that touched the ground instantly sprouted and grew rapidly, morphing into thick dark-green vines.
unit.target: Quisque semen, attinctum terræ, statim germinavit et celeriter crevit, in vitis densis viridi obscuris mutatus.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Jenna, Anthony, Noelia, and the others, who were scouring the street for Ludwig and Loki, witnessed the sky darken, as if night had prematurely descended or a colossal creature had eclipsed the sunlight.
unit.target: Simul Jenna, Anthony, Noelia, et ceteri, qui vias pro Ludovico et Loki explorabant, caelum obscurari conspexerunt, quasi nox praecoce descenderet aut ingens creatura solem obtegeret.

unit.source: Vaguely, they sensed the presence of a massive pitch‑black wing covered in a membrane, casting an illusory aura.
unit.target: Vague sensit praesentiam alae ingentis nigerrimae, membranā opertae, quae auram fallacem efferebat.

unit.source: In the next moment, a crimson full moon ascended from the night, hanging high in the sky.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, plena luna coccinea ex nocte ascendit, alte in caelo pendens.

unit.source: It seemed as though a tall, slender figure was slowly advancing.
unit.target: Videbatur quasi figura alta et gracilis lente procederet.

unit.source: Crimson moonlight bathed the area surrounded by the dark‑green vines, captivating all the citizens like statues.
unit.target: Lumen lunaris coccineum aream, circumdata vitibus densis viridi obscuris, effudit, omnes cives ut statuas captivans.

unit.source: Nourished by the moonlight, the dark‑green vines swiftly expanded, swiftly encasing the streets around Aquina Street in a “forest.”
unit.target: Lunae lumine nutritae, vitibus viridi obscuris celeriter creverunt, vias circa Viam Aquina in silvam celeriter implicantes.

unit.source: Dark‑red flowers blossomed in the “forest,” densely clustered and ubiquitous.
unit.target: Flores rubro‑obscuri in silva floruerunt, densissime congregati et ubique presentes.

unit.source: The flowers emitted a faint, sweet fragrance that intermingled, gradually intensifying the scent.
unit.target: Flores levem et dulcem fragrantiẹ efferebant, quae paulatim inter se miscebantur, odorem intensum efficiebat.

unit.source: Upon inhaling this fragrance, the residents of Port Santa, as well as the rats and bedbugs in the corresponding area, entered a stupor, swaying and collapsing to the ground.
unit.target: Odorem hunc inhalantes, incolae Portus Santa, necnon mures et cimices in regione correspondenti, in stuporem ceciderunt, oscillantes et terram cadentes.

unit.source: Dammit!
unit.target: Eheu!

unit.source: Jenna understood that Archbishop Agrippina of the Church of Earth Mother was employing indiscriminate tactics to influence the area, aiming to locate and control Loki, but she still cursed internally.
unit.target: Jenna intellexit Archiepiscopam Agrippinam Ecclesiae Matris Terrae consilia indiscriminata ad regionem afficiendam adhibere, ut Loki detegeret et coegeret, sed tamen interne maledixit.

unit.source: This gaseous anesthetic jogged unpleasant memories.
unit.target: Hoc gas anestheticus memorias incommodas evocavit.

unit.source: In the past, she had nearly fallen victim to a similar gas used by that Bliss Society pervert.
unit.target: Olim paene ipsa facta erat victima gas similis, ab illa Sodalitāte Bliss perversa adhibita.

unit.source: Yet now, in the diffusing gas with a noticeable difference in smell but a similar effect, her head started to spin, and her body felt uneasy.
unit.target: At nunc, in gas diffuso, qui odore distinto sed effectu simili praeditus erat, caput eius verti coepit et corpus incommode sentiebat.

unit.source: The same was true for Anthony and Noelia.
unit.target: Idem valebat pro Anthony et Noelia.

unit.source: One bore dragon‑like scales on his skin, while the other held her breath.
unit.target: Unus squamas sicut draconis in cute gerebat, dum altera spiritum retinebat.

unit.source: At that moment, three white‑headed seabirds descended from the sky, each clutching a metallic bottle, circling Jenna and the others.
unit.target: In illo momento, tres aves marinae, capite albo, de caelo descenderunt, singula lagunculam metallicam tenentes, circa Jenna et ceteros circumvolitantes.

unit.source: Noelia glanced at Archbishop Agrippina, who was hovering in midair, and received a nod.
unit.target: Noelia conspexit Archiepiscopam Agrippinam, quae in medio aerei fluctuabat, et annuit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, she took the bottle from a white‑headed seabird’s claw and gulped it down.
unit.target: Sine mora, lagunculam e unguibus avis marinae capite albo arripuit et voravit.

unit.source: She swiftly regained consciousness, no longer affected by the gaseous anesthetic.
unit.target: Celeriter conscientiam recuperavit, nec iam gas anestheticus eam afficiens.

unit.source: Observing this, Jenna and Anthony accepted the metal bottles and consumed the sour agent.
unit.target: Observantes hoc, Jenna et Anthony lagunculas metallicas susceperunt et remedium acidum consumpsere.

unit.source: They no longer felt dizzy and weak.
unit.target: Iam non se vertiginose et infirmos sentiebant.

unit.source: The three white‑headed seabirds weakly ascended again, landing by the roadside one after another, and dozed off.
unit.target: Tres aves marinae, capite albo, languide iterum ascendere conatae sunt, trans viam una post aliam descendentes, et obdormiverunt.

unit.source: In the area surrounded by the dark‑green vine “forest,” only a marionette remained standing at that moment, impervious to the gaseous anesthetic.
unit.target: In regione, quae silva vitis viridi obscuris circumdata erat, sola marionetta illo tempore stabat, gas anestheticus non afficiens.

unit.source: Its presence was immediately exposed.
unit.target: Eius praesentia statim manifesta fuit.

unit.source: In the apartment he had pre‑rented, Loki was taken aback to discover that controlling the sealed demigod’s Spirit Body Threads was much more challenging than he had anticipated.
unit.target: In apartamento, quem prae‑locaverat, Loki obstupefactus est cum invenisset tractare fila spiritus corporis semi‑dei sigillati multo difficilius esse quam putaverat.

unit.source: This wasn’t a problem that could be resolved in ten minutes.
unit.target: Non erat quaestio quam intra decem minuta solvi posset.

unit.source: According to his initial estimate, it would take at least an hour!
unit.target: Secundum primam aestimationem eius, saltem horam capere debebit!

unit.source: Given the time, the Church of Earth Mother could turn these streets upside down!
unit.target: Tempore dato, Ecclesia Matris Terrae has vias prorsus invertere poterat!

unit.source: As the gaseous anesthetic created by the dark‑green vines and dark‑red flowers permeated the room, Loki’s initial impulse was to craft an air straw nearly 30 meters long and extend it high into the air to breathe fresh air.
unit.target: Dum gas anestheticus, a vitibus viridi obscuris et floribus rubro‑obscuris confectus, conclave pervasit, primum impulsus Loki fuit tubum aeris fere triginta metrorum longum conficere atque alte in aethera protrahere ut aerem recens spiraret.

unit.source: However, he quickly dismissed the idea.
unit.target: Sed celeriter id neglexit.

unit.source: Perhaps the demigod of the Church of Earth Mother was waiting to detect similar traces to pinpoint his location!
unit.target: Forsitan semi‑deus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae exspectabat ut vestigia similia deprehenderet ad locum suum determinandum!

unit.source: Moreover, Loki had realized that there was more than one demigod in the sky!
unit.target: Praeterea, Loki animadvertit plus quam unum semi‑deum in caelo esse!

unit.source: If there was only one, he could rely on Sealed Artifacts, bestowments, and other means to concentrate.
unit.target: Si unum solum esset, artefactis sigillatis, donis aliisque mediis inniti potuisset.

unit.source: He could conceal himself in the shadows and contend with them to see if he could endure until the marionette‑making process was completed.
unit.target: Se in umbris celare potuisset et cum illis certare ut videret an usque ad finem artificii marionettae tolerare posset.

unit.source: However, there were at least two demigods observing.
unit.target: Attamen, saltem duo semi‑dei in conspectu erant.

unit.source: More importantly, he could endure for about ten minutes, but an hour was out of the question!
unit.target: Quam maxime, circa decem minuta tolerare posset, sed hora censenda non erat!

unit.source: After weighing the pros and cons, Loki abandoned his original plan to conduct the ritual today and advance to Sequence 4 Bizarro Sorcerer.
unit.target: Ex calculo bonorum et malorum, Loki consilium suum originale deseruit ut hodie ritum perageret atque ad Sequenciam 4 Bizarro Magum procederet.

unit.source: In any case, as long as he could restrain the sealed demigod, he could find another opportunity in the future.
unit.target: In quavis re, dum semi‑deum sigillatum retinere posset, aliam occasionem in futurum reperire poterat.

unit.source: There was no need for him to perform today!
unit.target: Non opus erat ei hodie perficere.

unit.source: Why would it take an hour or more?
unit.target: Cur hora aut amplius caperet?

unit.source: Is this a demigod’s Spirit Body Threads?
unit.target: Num haec sint fila spiritus corporis semi‑dei?

unit.source: Amidst Loki’s confusion, he didn’t intend to recall the two marionettes.
unit.target: Inter confusionem Loki, duas marionettas revocare non intendit.

unit.source: He planned on using the mystical item to “teleport” away.
unit.target: Consilium habebat ut rem mysticam ad se "teleportandum" adhiberet.

unit.source: From his pocket, he retrieved a bracelet made of different‑colored gems.
unit.target: Ex sinu suo, armillam ex gemmis variis coloribus factam extraxit.

unit.source: Just as Loki was about to activate a diamond, he heard the sound of swallowing.
unit.target: Modoquam Loki iam ad adamantem activandum parabat, sonum deglutitionis audivit.

unit.source: Loki instinctively lowered his head and looked into his arms, realizing that Ludwig had awakened at some point.
unit.target: Loki instinctu caput deiecit et in brachia sua aspexit, intellegens Ludwig aliquando evigilasse.

unit.source: With a sincere expression, the boy spoke with a hint of eagerness, "I'm hungry..."
unit.target: Cum vultu sincero, puer cum aliquo desiderio dixit, "Esurivi..."

unit.source: 583 Celestial Worthy’s Revelation
unit.target: 583 Revelatio Dignitatis Caelestis

unit.source: 583 Celestial Worthy’s Revelation
unit.target: 583 Revelatio Dignitatis Caelestis

unit.source: Around the betrothal ship and sailboat, thick turquoise vines cascaded from the sky.
unit.target: Circum navem sponsalem et naviculam velis instructam, vites spissae caeruleae ex caelo descenderunt.

unit.source: They entwined, creating a “road” leading to various destinations.
unit.target: Se implicaverunt, viam creantes quae ad loca varia ducebat.

unit.source: “Cinderella” returned to the orange-yellow pumpkin coach, pulled by gray mice swiftly descending through the vines.
unit.target: “Cinderella” rediit ad currum cucurbitarium aurantioluteum, tractum a muribus cinereis celeriter per vites descendentibus.

unit.source: They approached the energy passageway formed by pure light, as if about to enter the silver-gray behemoth embedded in the seabed.
unit.target: Appropinquaverunt ad iter energiae, quod ex pura luce formato erat, quasi mox ingrediantur ingens monstrum argenteo‑cinereum in fundo maris insitum.

unit.source: Abruptly, the mischief of gray mice came to a halt.
unit.target: Subito, malitia murorum cinereorum cessavit.

unit.source: “Cinderella,” adorned in a purple robe, wore a solemn expression, purple spots dancing in her pupils.
unit.target: “Cinderella,” tunica purpurea induta, vultum solemnem gerebat, maculis purpureis in oculis saltantibus.

unit.source: “Cinderella” sensed an unusually perilous presence deep within the silver‑gray behemoth.
unit.target: “Cinderella” sensit praesentiam insolite periculosam alte in ingenti monstro argenteo‑cinereo.

unit.source: It remained motionless, as if in a deep slumber or long dead.
unit.target: Manebat immobile, quasi in profundo somno aut iam diu mortuum.

unit.source: However, in either case, her intuition warned her not to approach, lest she suffer severe corruption or similar effects.
unit.target: Tamen, in utraque re, eius intuitio eam monuit ne appropinquaret, ne graves corruptionis effectus aut similia incommoda subiret.

unit.source: Staring at the energy passageway where Lumian and company had vanished, she deliberated for a few seconds before shifting her focus to the sailboat.
unit.target: Intuens viam energeticam in qua Lumian et comites evanuerant, paulisper deliberavit antequam animum suum ad naviculam velis instructam vertit.

unit.source: With Mr. Fool’s seal on the Seven of Wands and the sealed evil god’s angel, he didn’t have to worry about the problem that even she had to be wary of—as long as he didn’t directly see those things, hear its voice, or enter the core area.
unit.target: Cum sigillo Domini Stulti in Septem Virgae et angelo dei mali sigillato, non curare debebat de re qua etiam illa cavere debebat, dummodo ille ea non directe videat, neque vocem eius audiret, neque in regionem nuclearem ingrediret.

unit.source: As for the other one, he seemed to be a Shepherd, so he didn’t mind being even crazier.
unit.target: Quod ad alterum attinet, videbatur esse Pastor; idcirco etiam insanior fieri ei non molestum erat.

unit.source: “Cinderella” observed the mast and shipboard of the sailboat cracking under the terrifying suction of the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s “heaviness” characteristic.
unit.target: “Cinderella” animadvertit mastem ac tabulam navis velis instructae, fractas sub terribili attrahitione proprietatis “gravitatis” Artificii Humanoidi Sigillati.

unit.source: She was ready to make her move when she retrieved a Roselle chess piece from her dark-purple coin bag and hurled it at the target in the black nun’s attire.
unit.target: “Cinderella” parata erat agere, cum ex sacculo nummorum purpureo‑obscuri partem scaccorum “Rosellae” extraxit et eam in scopum, indutum habitu monachae nigrae, proiecit.

unit.source: Amidst the howling wind, the Queen chess piece soared towards the humanoid Sealed Artifact, accompanied by various miscellaneous items.
unit.target: Inter ululantem ventum, regina scaccorum versus Artificium Humanoidem Sigillatum volavit, comitata variis rebus miscellaneis.

unit.source: As it descended, the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s steps towards the sailboat slowed, as if time itself was warping around her.
unit.target: Cum descendit, gressus Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati versus naviculam velis instructam retardabantur, quasi tempus ipsum circa eam torqueretur.

unit.source: This was one of the spells of “Cinderella”—the Chessboard of Ages.
unit.target: Hoc erat unum ex incantamentis “Cinderellae”—Tabula Scaccorum Aetatum.

unit.source: It had the power to decelerate the target as if they had entered an area where time moved at a different speed.
unit.target: Potentia erat ei scopum retardandi, quasi in regionem intravissent ubi tempus aliter moveretur.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity presented by the sluggish movement, “Cinderella” closed her eyes and transformed into a humanoid phantom, collapsing into the invisible coffin.
unit.target: Occasio captata ex motu tardo, “Cinderella” oculos clausit et se in phantasmam humanoidem transformavit, in sarcophagus invisibilem corruens.

unit.source: The eyelids of the humanoid Sealed Artifact drooped, as if she might succumb to sleep at any moment.
unit.target: Palpebrae Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati trudebantur, quasi quovis momento somno succumbere posset.

unit.source: Sleeping Beauty magic!
unit.target: Magia Bellae Dormientis!

unit.source: Witnessing this, Hela, aboard the sailboat, once again activated the Evernight pathway’s ability to forcibly drag people into a dream.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Hela, in navicula velis instructa, iterum activavit facultatem semitis “Evernight”, quae homines vi coercitiva in somnium trahere facit.

unit.source: Although the notarization wouldn’t immediately expire with Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s loss of the Governor of the Sea authority, it would still last until the end.
unit.target: Quamquam notarizatio non statim exstinguetur ob damnum auctoritatis “Gubernator Maris” Ultraman Lato Guiaro, tamen usque ad finem permanebit.

unit.source: However, the ability to be invalidated by notarization wasn’t entirely ineffective.
unit.target: Attamen facultas notarizatione invalidandi non omnino ineficax erat.

unit.source: It would only be weakened, and its effects would be significantly reduced.
unit.target: Illud tantum debebat debilitari, et eius effectus notabiliter minuere.

unit.source: Now, the humanoid Sealed Artifact was already fatigued, swaying and on the verge of falling asleep.
unit.target: Nunc, Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati iam defessus erat, vacillans et prope ad somnum cadendum.

unit.source: In this state, entering a dream was undoubtedly much easier.
unit.target: In hoc statu, in somnium ingredi indubitanter multo facilius erat.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, donned in a black nun’s attire, finally closed her eyes and plunged into a deep slumber.
unit.target: Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati, habitu monachae nigrae induta, tandem oculos clausit et in profundum somnum incidit.

unit.source: She entered a somewhat sorrowful dream, causing her face to contort slightly as she frowned.
unit.target: Ingressa est in somnium aliquantulum tristis, unde facies eius leviter contorta facta est dum arruebatur.

unit.source: On the sailboat, a dense darkness surged once more, enveloping the humanoid Sealed Artifact, resonating with a distant voice that brought peace and tranquility.
unit.target: In navicula velis instructa, densum tenebrarum iterum effulsit, Humanoidem Artificium Sigillatam involvens, cum voce remota quae pacem et tranquillitatem afferebat.

unit.source: It was akin to a mother reciting a poem to lull her child to sleep, fostering a serene slumber.
unit.target: Id simile erat matri carmen recitanti ad infandum puerum suum, quod somnum serenum consolidabat.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, still in her black nun’s attire, hovered in midair with her eyes tightly shut.
unit.target: Humanoidi Artificii Sigillati, adhuc habitu monachae nigrae induta, in media aere levabatur, oculis stringentibus clausis.

unit.source: She descended slowly, landing gracefully on the deck of the sailboat.
unit.target: Lente descendit, eleganter ad tabulam navis velis instructae perveniens.

unit.source: Her brows gradually relaxed, her face softened, and crystalline water droplets formed at the corners of her eyes.
unit.target: Arcus oculorum eius paulatim relaxaverunt, facies mollita est, et guttae aquae crystallinae in angulis oculorum eius constitutae sunt.

unit.source: The Maidens of the Sea, deputy hosts, and sailors, blessed by the sea and adorned with starlight scales, swiftly settled in the darkness, succumbing to sleep amidst the enchanting chanting.
unit.target: Virginiae Maris, hospitum vicarii, et nautae, mari benedicti et squamis stellae ornati, celeriter in tenebris consederunt, sub somno incidentes inter incantationes amoenissimas.

unit.source: Franca, within the sail cabin, was taken aback by the unfolding battle.
unit.target: Franca, intra cellam navis velariae, obstupefacta est a pugna evolvente.

unit.source: I‑isn’t that Cinderella?
unit.target: Nonne illa “Cinderella” est?

unit.source: I‑isn’t that Jack and the Beanstalk?
unit.target: Nonne ille “Jack et Stipes Fabae” est?

unit.source: What manner of magic is this?
unit.target: Quae natura magicae haec est?

unit.source: I‑isn’t that Sleeping Beauty?
unit.target: Nonne illa “Bella Dormiens” est?

unit.source: Who is this? Have I arrived in a fairyland?
unit.target: Quis hic est? Num in terram fabularum perveni?

unit.source: I have to admit, it’s truly dreamlike…
unit.target: Fateri debeo, vere quasi somnium est…

unit.source: Two demigods working together are undoubtedly formidable.
unit.target: Duo semidei simul laborantes indubitanter formidabiles sunt.

unit.source: They swiftly subdued the humanoid Sealed Artifact…
unit.target: Celeriter superaverunt Humanoidum Artificium Sigillatam…

unit.source: I also wish to become a demigod!
unit.target: Ego quoque semideus fieri cupio!

unit.source: A Demoness demigod would do too…
unit.target: Etiam daemonissa semidea id efficere posset!

unit.source: Regaining her senses, Franca concealed herself and sprinted out of the sailboat.
unit.target: Sensuum revocata, Franca se abscondit et ex navicula velis instructa properavit.

unit.source: Utilizing her run-up and an Assassin’s Feather Fall, she elegantly leaped onto the betrothal ship, intending to approach the energy passageway at the bow.
unit.target: Utens impetu suo et “Assassin’s Feather Fall”, eleganter in navem sponsalem saliit, intendens ad iter energiae in prora ingredi.

unit.source: Within the silver‑gray behemoth.
unit.target: Intra ingens monstrum argenteo‑cinereum.

unit.source: After Lumian traversed the energy passageway, he found himself not in the metal beehive he had seen before.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian iter energiae pertransiit, se non invenit in alveo metallico, quem antea viderat.

unit.source: Walking on the silvery‑white metal floor, he noticed a hall dozens of meters long and 20 to 30 meters wide ahead.
unit.target: Ambulans super solum metallum argenteo‑album, animadvertit atrium decies metrorum longum et latum viginti ad triginta metrorum prae se.

unit.source: In the middle of the hall, Ultraman Lato Guiaro stood, donning Simon Guiaro’s face, and shouted in delight, “(…¥#)”
unit.target: In medio atrii, Ultraman Lato Guiaro stetit, vultum Simon Guiaro indutus, et exsultans clamavit, “(…¥#)”

unit.source: This represented the first half of the command to activate the spaceship by entering the password and gaining access.
unit.target: Hoc repraesentabat dimidiem partem mandati ad spatium navale activandum, per verbum clavis ingrediendo et accessum obtinendo.

unit.source: However, there was no response from the spaceship.
unit.target: Attamen, nullum responsum ex spatio navali venit.

unit.source: Crap… It still holds ill intentions towards me and isn’t willing to grant access… This malice stems from that demigod’s ability.
unit.target: Stercus… Adhuc in me mala consilia habet nec accessum concedere vult… Haec malitia ex illa facultate semidei oritur.

unit.source: It shouldn’t last long. As long as I can stall for time, I should be able to regain control…
unit.target: Non diuturnum manere debet. Dummodo tempus differre possim, rursus imperium recuperare debeam.

unit.source: Can the humanoid Sealed Artifact hold back two demigods? Or can I rely on the spaceship’s internal layout to play “hide and seek?”
unit.target: Num poterit Humanoide Artificium Sigillatum duo semideos repugnare? Aut in interno conspectu spatii navalis confidere possum ut ludem “latere et quaerere?”

unit.source: A series of thoughts raced through Ultraman’s anxious mind.
unit.target: Seriem cogitationum per animum anxium Ultramanis festinanter percurrerunt.

unit.source: At that moment, through the translucent metal wall to the side of the hall, he saw “Cinderella” in the pumpkin coach come to a halt near the energy passageway, seemingly apprehensive about something.
unit.target: Illo momento, per parietem metallicum translucidum ad latus atrii, vidit “Cinderella” in curru cucurbitario prope iter energiae sistentem, quasi aliquid timens.

unit.source: As expected!
unit.target: Ut exspectatum est!

unit.source: She doesn’t dare to enter!
unit.target: Non audet ingredi!

unit.source: Exhilaration surged from Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s heart.
unit.target: Exsultatio ex corde Ultraman Lato Guiaro effluit.

unit.source: Before the mission kicked off, Loki had set up an altar and sought guidance from Celestial Worthy through divination.
unit.target: Antequam missio inchoaretur, Loki aram constituit et ab “Dignitate Caelestis” per divinationem consilium petivit.

unit.source: The response he got was: Contains a high risk from high‑ranking individuals. Avoidable by entering the spaceship.
unit.target: Responsum, quod accepit, fuit: altum periculum ab personis summi gradus continet; per spatium navale intrando vitari potest.

unit.source: Loki decoded this as a warning about Hela and Gandalf from the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, as well as the Saint from the Church of Earth Mother overlooking Port Santa.
unit.target: Loki hoc interpretatus est ut monitionem de Hela et Gandalf ex Societate Inquisitionis Simiae Crinitæ, necnon de Sancto ex Ecclesia Matris Terrae, quae Portum Santae supervidebat.

unit.source: These high‑ranking figures were the primary threats.
unit.target: Hi personae summi gradus erant primae minae.

unit.source: However, if he could take the reins of the mystical sci‑fi spaceship first, he believed he could outmaneuver these formidable opponents.
unit.target: Attamen, si gubernare prius posset mystico spatio navali scifi, creditur se hos formidabiles adversarios superare posse.

unit.source: Now, Lato Guiaro noticed that even without absolute control of the spaceship, the new demigod hesitated, as if haunted by an unseen fear.
unit.target: Nunc, Lato Guiaro animadvertit quod, etiam absque absoluta gubernatione spatialis, novus semideus cunctaret, quasi invisibili metu infestaretur.

unit.source: Facing something capable of unsettling a demigod left Lato Guiaro uneasy.
unit.target: Obversus aliquid quod semideum commovere posset, Lato Guiaro inquietum reliquit.

unit.source: However, armed with the spaceship’s command and password, he could soon turn potential threats to his advantage.
unit.target: Attamen, instructus imperio et verbo clavis spatii navalis, mox potuit adversarias minas in utilitatem suam verti.

unit.source: There was no need for fear.
unit.target: Nulla erat necessitas timendi.

unit.source: As Lumian was on the brink of “teleporting” behind Ultraman Lato Guiaro, they both heard a metallic clang.
unit.target: Dum Lumian prope “teleportandum” post Ultraman Lato Guiaro esse videbatur, uterque clangorem metallicum audivit.

unit.source: A silver metal door descended, sealing off the hall’s entrance and exit completely.
unit.target: Porta metallica argentea descendit, ostium et exitum atrii omnino claudens.

unit.source: The walls, ceiling, and floor transformed as metal surfaces shifted and revealed dark pipe openings.
unit.target: Muri, laquearum, et solum transmutaverunt, cum superficies metallicae moverentur atque obscuras fistulas patefierunt.

unit.source: Out gushed cerulean‑blue gas.
unit.target: Gas caeruleus effluit.

unit.source: Poison gas! Lato Guiaro’s heart raced as he grasped the situation.
unit.target: Gas venenosum! Corde Lato Guiaro palpitabat, dum rem comprehenderet.

unit.source: The spaceship, still imbued with malice, not only resisted control but also emanated lethal intent, seeking to eliminate him before its animosity subsided.
