unit.target: Spatium navale, adhuc malitia imbuta, non solum imperium repellebat sed etiam mortiferum intentum emanabat, quaerens eum delere priusquam animositas eius minuere cesseret.

unit.source: The magic of the demigod outside is malicious indeed!
unit.target: Magia semidei foris vere maligna est!

unit.source: Lumian perceived this as an instinctive strike from the silver‑gray behemoth against intruders.
unit.target: Lumian hoc perceptus est ut impetum instinctivum ab ingenti monstro argenteo‑cinereo adversariis incideret.

unit.source: Swiftly, he tapped into the power of the sea, aiming to invoke the temporary authority of the Governor of the Sea to counter the threat.
unit.target: Celeriter, ad potentiam maris recurrens, constitui auctoritatem temporariam Gubernatoris Maris evocare ad minas oppugnandas.

unit.source: He could sense that Ultraman had lost the Governor of the Sea’s position after the attack from the “Cinderella” demigod, with no immediate prospect of reclaiming it.
unit.target: Sentiebat Ultramanis locum Gubernatoris Maris post impetus semidei “Cinderellae” amittere, cum nullo proposito statim recuperandi.

unit.source: With no contenders for the authority, Lumian anticipated an easy acquisition.
unit.target: Cum nulli ad auctoritatem contenderent, Lumian facilis acquisitionem exspectabat.

unit.source: Yet, the “waters” resisted, refusing Lumian the temporary position of Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Attamen, “aquae” repellebant, Lumiano locum temporarium Gubernatoris Maris recusantes.

unit.source: Its malice seemed directed at anyone attempting control!
unit.target: Malis eius videbatur destinata esse cuique gubernare conanti!

unit.source: Undeterred, Lumian shifted his focus back to Ultraman Lato Guiaro, a crucial member of April Fool’s.
unit.target: Non perturbatus, Lumian animum rediit ad Ultraman Lato Guiaro, membro cruciario “Aprilis Stultorum.”

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s heart stirred as he shouted, “Do you want to fight here? If we don’t break out and waste no time, we’ll all die!”
unit.target: Corde Lato Guiaro commotus, clamavit: “Vultisne hic pugnare? Nisi exiremus et tempus non amittamus, omnes peribimus!”

unit.source: In this dire moment, a plan to escape the hall and relocate became paramount.
unit.target: In hoc momento critico, consilium ex atrio effugere et se alibi collocare praevaluit.

unit.source: The malice wouldn’t linger for long.
unit.target: Mala intentio non diu maneret.

unit.source: Seek vengeance in a safe space. If we perish here, who will assist in eliminating the others?
unit.target: Vindictam quaerite in loco tuto. Si hic perimus, quis alios elidere adiuvabit?

unit.source: Lumian nonchalantly flexed his wrists, donning the Flog boxing gloves, and grinned, stating,
unit.target: Lumian nonchalanter bracchia flexit, manicas pugilisticas “Flog” induens, et subridens dixit:

unit.source: “I don’t care about my own death. All that matters now is one thing: Ending you!”
unit.target: “Meam mortem non curo. Nunc una res refert: te interficere!”

unit.source: As the words left his lips, crimson flames, bordering on white, erupted from his entire being, as if he were cloaked in a fiery shroud.
unit.target: Cum verba ex labris eius exierunt, flammæ rubræ, quasi album extremum attingentes, ex tota vita eius eruperunt, quasi in velamine igneo obtectus esset.

unit.source: Not far from Lumian and Lato Guiaro, Mad Lady and Mr. K found themselves in the beehive‑like metal room, unable to enter the hall ahead.
unit.target: Non longe a Lumiano et Lato Guiaro, Mad Lady et Dominus K se in conclavi metallico, simili alveario, invenerunt, qui in atrium antecessum intrare non poterant.

unit.source: Surveying the surroundings, Mr. K’s gaze swept across the incubating Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other creatures.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, Dominus K oculus pertransivit Batings Insectum Nigerum, Parvos Diaboli, et alias creaturas.

unit.source: He nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Annuit ex satisfactione.

unit.source: “It’s indeed the power of an evil god, spawn of an evil god. Well done, Lumian! Well done! This is all part of God’s arrangement!”
unit.target: “Revera haec est potentia dei mali, generatio dei mali. Bene, Lumiane! Bene! Haec omnia pars sunt dispositionis Dei!”

unit.source: Amidst the hoarse voice, the Aurora Order Oracle turned his gaze back to Mad Lady.
unit.target: Inter vocem raucam, Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae oculos suos iterum ad Mad Lady vertit.

unit.source: Mad Lady wasn’t intimidated. Instead, she applauded in agreement with Mr. K.
unit.target: Mad Lady non timuit. Immo, una cum Domino K plausit in consensu.

unit.source: She spoke as if they were on different frequencies.
unit.target: Loquebatur quasi in diversis frequentiis essent.

unit.source: “That’s right, it’s cool, right? This is a spaceship!”
unit.target: “Ita est, mirum est, nonne? Hic est spatium navale!”

unit.source: In the next moment, Mad Lady and Mr. K vanished simultaneously and reappeared behind where the other party had been standing, as if they had negotiated a position switch beforehand.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, Mad Lady et Dominus K simul evanuerunt et reapparuerunt post locum ubi altera pars stabat, quasi antea de permutatione locorum convenissent.

unit.source: 584 “Helper”
unit.target: 584 “Auxiliator”

unit.source: 584 “Helper”
unit.target: 584 “Auxiliator”

unit.source: Inside the underwater spaceship, in the silvery hall.
unit.target: Intra navem subaquaticam, in aula argentea.

unit.source: Lumian, enveloped by crimson, nearly white flames, transformed into a fireball and hurtled towards Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Lumian, circumdatus flammis coccineis et fere albis, in globum ignis mutatus et versus Ultraman Lato Guiaro festinanter volavit.

unit.source: The key April Fool’s member remained composed.
unit.target: Membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti tranquillum mansit.

unit.source: Holding his breath, he thrust forward with his left palm.
unit.target: Spiritum continens, manu sinistra immisit.

unit.source: Lumian instantly sensed an invisible force resisting him, causing the blazing crimson fireball to decelerate abruptly, akin to a trapped insect in transparent amber.
unit.target: Lumian statim sensit vim invisibilem, quae ei opposita erat, qua globus ignis coccineus ardens subito retardaretur, sicut insectum captum in succino perspicuo.

unit.source: Seizing the moment, Lato Guiaro raised his right hand, clenching it into a fist.
unit.target: Momento usus, Lato Guiaro dextram manum elevavit, eam in pugnum conclusit.

unit.source: A ball of blazing white pure sunlight condensed and compressed, swiftly morphing into a thick, formidable laser aimed at Lumian, fused with the crimson near-white fireball.
unit.target: Globus lucis solaris candidae purae, ardens, condensatus et compressus, celeriter in densum et formidabilem laser mutatus in Lumian, qui cum globo ignis coccinei fere albi coniunctus erat, evasit.

unit.source: This ability resulted from merging the Sun pathway and the Sea boon, utilizing the power of the Sun pathway to propel the Sea boon’s Weakening Ray.
unit.target: Haec facultas ex coniunctione viae solis et beneficii maris orta est, per vim viae solis radium debilitantis beneficii maris impellendo.

unit.source: Though it no longer altered the target’s body gradually, causing various negative symptoms, its penetration and melting effects were significantly enhanced, capable of directly injuring or even killing the target.
unit.target: Quamquam non iam corpus destinatum paulatim mutabat, diversas symptomata negativa efficiebat, effectus penetrationis et liquefactionis tamen notabiliter amplificati erant, qui directe vulnerare aut etiam interficere destinatum poterant.

unit.source: In the enclosed, poisonous gas-filled environment with the constant threat of malice, Lato Guiaro sought to conclude the battle swiftly rather than wait for Lumian Lee to weaken gradually.
unit.target: In ambitu clauso, gas venenoso repleto, cum semper minā malitiae, Lato Guiaro bellum celeriter conficere contendit potius quam exspectare ut Lumian Lee paulatim debilitaretur.

unit.source: Thus, he opted for Sun Ray instead of Weakening Ray.
unit.target: Itaque radium solis pro radium debilitantis eligere statuit.

unit.source: At laser speed, Sun Ray struck the crimson fireball, melting a substantial hole into it.
unit.target: Celeritate laseris, radium solis globum ignis coccineum percussit, ingentem cavum in eo liquefaciendo fundens.

unit.source: The fireball lost its structural integrity and exploded, scattering like rain.
unit.target: Globus ignis integritatem suam amisit et explosus est, disseminatus ut pluvia.

unit.source: Yet, Lumian was nowhere among the remnants.
unit.target: Attamen, Lumian nusquam inter reliquias apparuit.

unit.source: He seemed to have vanished into thin air.
unit.target: Videbatur in aere tenuissimo evanuisse.

unit.source: Simultaneously, behind Ultraman Lato Guiaro, Lumian’s figure, adorned with the Lie earring, swiftly materialized.
unit.target: Simul, post Ultraman Lato Guiaro, figura Lumiani, cum ornamento auriculari Lie induta, celeriter apparuit.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian transformed into a fireball and soared towards Lato Guiaro, intending to force him into using Beyonder powers and counterattack.
unit.target: Initio, Lumian in globum ignis transformatus est et versus Lato Guiaro volavit, eum cogere cupiens ut potentias Beyonder adhiberet atque contra impetum pararet.

unit.source: This allowed him to “fix” his original location, not shifting prematurely, creating an opportunity to “teleport” behind the target in the fireball state for a surprise attack.
unit.target: Hoc ei permisit locum originarium suum stabile retinere, non praecoepi mutare, occasionem condere ut post scopus in statu globi ignis “teleportaret” ad impetum insidiosum.

unit.source: Having faced bestowed of the sea before, Lumian was aware of Lato Guiaro’s ability to manipulate the weight or floatation of objects using the power of the land and stars, altering their speed.
unit.target: Iam pridem beneficium maris expertus, Lumian scivit facultatem Lato Guiaro, utens potentia terrae et siderum, ut pondus vel levationem rerum regeret atque eorum celeritatem mutaret.

unit.source: To successfully use Spirit World Traversal in his fireball form, Lumian borrowed Lie’s Flame Controlling ability.
unit.target: Ut transitus Mundi Spiritus in forma globi ignis feliciter efficeret, Lumian mutuatus est facultatem regendi flammarum a Lie.

unit.source: As his figure materialized, he promptly opened his mouth and hissed at Ultraman Lato Guiaro, less than two meters away.
unit.target: Dum figura eius apparuit, celeriter os aperuit et sibilavit ad Ultraman Lato Guiaro, qui minus quam duobus metris distantem erat.

unit.source: “Ha!”
unit.target: “Ha!”

unit.source: A pale-yellow beam, resembling gas, shot towards the April Fool’s key member.
unit.target: Radius luteus pallidus, qui gas similis erat, versus membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti profectus est.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro didn’t have time to turn around, sensing the impending danger through his fate perception, a skill obtained from deciphering the Language of the Stars Beyonder powers.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro non habuit tempus se convertere, per sensum fatum imminentis periculum agnovens, arte ex Lingua Stellarum potentiarum Beyonder adeptus.

unit.source: Specks of starlight emerged in his eyes.
unit.target: Particulae fulgor stellarum in oculis eius apparuerunt.

unit.source: He identified several “passages” in the silver hall suffused with cerulean-blue gasses, imperceptible to ordinary humans.
unit.target: Plura “transitus” in aula argentea, gasibus caeruleo diffusis, ab hominibus ordinariis imperceptis, agnovit.

unit.source: Hastily choosing one, he pounced over—a navigating ability bestowed by the sea.
unit.target: Festinanter unum eligit, et super eum insilivit — ars navigationis a mari data.

unit.source: Simultaneously, uncertain of evading the attack from behind, Lato Guiaro infused the surroundings with layers of golden light.
unit.target: Simul, nescit an impetum e tergo evaderet, Lato Guiaro ambitum stratis lucis aureae imbuivit.

unit.source: This was the Purification Halo of a Sequence 5 Priest of Light of the Sun pathway.
unit.target: Hoc erat Corona Purificandi Sacerdotis Lucis in Sequentae V viae Solis.

unit.source: Amidst the harrumph, the pale-yellow beam swept past Lato Guiaro’s back, hidden somewhere in the void.
unit.target: Inter strepitum, radius luteus pallidus per tergum Lato Guiaro traiecit, alicubi in vacuo absconditus.

unit.source: The key member of April Fool’s, code name Ultraman, fainted, but his momentum remained.
unit.target: Membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti, sub nomine Ultraman, in desidiam lapsus est, sed impetum suum conservavit.

unit.source: He continued into the illusory passageway, hidden from ordinary eyes, traversing space and dimensions.
unit.target: Per transitum illusorium, ab oculis ordinariis celatum, spatium et dimensiones perambulavit.

unit.source: Lumian, within two meters, couldn’t “teleport” away in time and was enveloped by the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Lumian, intra duos metra, non potuit tempore “teleportare” et Corona Purificationis eum involvit.

unit.source: His heart ached, as if something sought to tear his body apart and crawl out.
unit.target: Cor eius dolebat, quasi aliquid conaretur corpus eius discerpere atque exire.

unit.source: Faintly, he heard the illusory ravings of the entity known as Inevitability, Mr. Fool, or both.
unit.target: Subtiliter audivit delirationes illusoriae entitatis, quae “Inevitability”, “Mr. Fool”, aut utrumque appellabatur.

unit.source: Unclear but unsettling, they made Lumian’s brain feel pulled out of his skull by an invisible hand.
unit.target: Quamquam ambigua sed perturbantia, faciebant ut cerebrum Lumiani, quasi per manum invisibile, extra cranium evelli videretur.

unit.source: Despite an Ascetic’s endurance, Lumian couldn’t help but groan in pain.
unit.target: Non obstante patientia ascetae, Lumian dolore inevitabiliter gemere coactus est.

unit.source: Collapsing to the ground, he curled up.
unit.target: Cadens in terram, se convolvit.

unit.source: A similar experience occurred in his Cordu dream, a reaction after being sprinkled by Valentine’s holy water.
unit.target: Experientia similis evenit in somnio Cordu, ut reactio postquam aquam sanctam Valentinii aspergeretur.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s Purification Halo, an advanced Sun Halo, had evolved from harmless to a partial Sun Holy Water effect.
unit.target: Corona Purificationis Lato Guiaro, corona solis provecta, ex inermitate in partem effectus aquae sanctae solis evoluta erat.

unit.source: It could exorcize evil spirits and purify the evil power within a target’s body.
unit.target: Poterat spiritus malos exorcizare et vim malignam in corpore destinato purgare.

unit.source: As Lato Guiaro lay unconscious, the Purification Halo vanished in a flash, only partially dispelling the poisonous gas.
unit.target: Dum Lato Guiaro in statu insciente iacebat, Corona Purificationis in momento evanuit, solum parcum gas venenatum dispellens.

unit.source: Similarly, the unconscious Lato Guiaro couldn’t progress through the illusory passageway, breaking free and falling three to four meters in front of Lumian.
unit.target: Similiter, Lato Guiaro inscius per transitum illusorium progredi non potuit, evadens et tres ad quattuor metra ante Lumian cadens.

unit.source: The impact left him in pain, slowly regaining consciousness.
unit.target: Impetus eum dolore affecit, paulatim conscientiam recipiens.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian slowly recovered from the intense pain induced by the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian ab intenso dolore, quem Corona Purificationis intulit, paulatim se restituit.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro, just waking up and still uncertain of the situation, instinctively re-entered the illusory passageway to increase the distance between himself and Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro, modo evigilans et rem nondum certa habens, instinctu transitum illusorium iterum ingressus est, ut distantia inter eum et Lumian Lee augeretur.

unit.source: This move aimed to avoid another strike from Lumian’s Psychic Piercing-like ability or any other unforeseen attacks.
unit.target: Hoc consilium destinatum erat ut alium ictum ex facultate psychica Lumiani, simile “Psychic Piercing”, aut alias inopinatas impetūs vitaret.

unit.source: Upon crawling back to the hall through the exit of the illusory passageway, Lumian had already raised his head and regained his composure, though his forehead was soaked in cold sweat.
unit.target: Reveniens ad aulam per exitum transitus illusorii, Lumian iam caput attollit et compositum restituit, etsi frontem frigida sudore madens habebat.

unit.source: Observing this, Lato Guiaro felt neither pity, disappointment, nor regret.
unit.target: Observans hoc, Lato Guiaro nec miserationem, nec delusionem, nec paenitentiam sensit.

unit.source: Instead, he was pleasantly surprised.
unit.target: Immo, potius, eum laete admiratus est.

unit.source: It’s effective!
unit.target: Efficax est!

unit.source: Purification Halo is effective against Lumian Lee!
unit.target: Corona Purificationis adversus Lumian Lee efficax est!

unit.source: After confirming that the adventurer Louis Berry was indeed Lumian Lee, Lato Guiaro contemplated how to strategize if he were to engage in a battle with him.
unit.target: Postquam confirmavit adventorem Ludovicum Berry re vera Lumian Lee esse, Lato Guiaro meditatus est quomodo se in bello consulere posset, si cum eo pugnarentur.

unit.source: It was simple with the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Facile erat cum auctoritate Praefecti Maris.

unit.source: He could repeatedly cast the other party into the Cosmic Void, making him lose himself over and over.
unit.target: Poterat alterum iterum atque iterum in Vacuum Cosmicum proicere, faciens ut se iterum atque iterum amitteret.

unit.source: Without the Governor of the Sea’s authority, he had to consider how to exploit Lumian Lee’s vulnerabilities.
unit.target: Sine auctoritate Praefecti Maris, cogitandum erat quomodo vulnerabilitates Lumian Lee ex usuris convertirentur.

unit.source: Lumian Lee’s unique characteristics were clear—possessing a sealing power of the same origin as the Celestial Worthy, with a high-ranking creature sealed within him.
unit.target: Proprietates unicas Lumian Lee manifestae erant—potentiam sigillandi eadem originis habentem ac cum creatura praecipua intra eum sigillata.

unit.source: Beyonders in this state often had false high-level statuses and enjoyed numerous conveniences, but they were susceptible to the Sun pathway’s abilities.
unit.target: Beyonderi in hoc statu saepe gradus altissimos falsos habebant et commoditatibus plurimis fruebantur, sed erant susceptibiles potestate viae solis.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro wasn’t certain about the effectiveness of the Sun Halo, Cleave of Purification, and other abilities, nor was he sure of the Purification Halo’s potency.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro de efficacitate Coronae Solis, “Cleave of Purification”, aliisque facultatibus non certus erat, nec de potentia Coronae Purificationis dubitabatur.

unit.source: The only certainty lay in the effectiveness of the Sun Holy Water he could create.
unit.target: Unica certitudo in efficacia aquae sanctae solis, quam creare posset, iacebat.

unit.source: Therefore, if the Purification Halo proved ineffective against Lumian Lee, he would swiftly produce Sun Holy Water and sprinkle it on him.
unit.target: Ergo, si Corona Purificationis contra Lumian Lee inefficax occideretur, celeriter aquam sanctam solis creare atque in eum aspergeret.

unit.source: Looking at Lumian, Lato Guiaro smiled, once again dyeing the surroundings golden as layer after layer spread out.
unit.target: Spectans ad Lumian, Lato Guiaro subridet, iterum circumiecta aurea colorans, dum stratum post stratum diffundebatur.

unit.source: This sealed environment was ideal for employing the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Hoc clausum ambitum ideale erat ad usum Coronae Purificationis.

unit.source: It denied Lumian Lee a chance to distance himself or “teleport” closer.
unit.target: Illud negabat Lumian Lee occasionem ut distantiam augeret aut propius “teleportaret”.

unit.source: The entire hall was essentially enveloped by the Purification Halo!
unit.target: Omnis aula prorsus Corona Purificationis complectebatur!

unit.source: Furthermore, in the spaceship, there was no fear of Lumian Lee losing control and transforming into a monster, unleashing the high-level creature within his body.
unit.target: Praeterea, in nave, nullus timor erat ne Lumian Lee moderamen amitteret et in monstrum mutaretur, efferens creaturam altam intra corpus eius.

unit.source: An intruder at this level would inevitably trigger the spaceship’s automatic defense system targeting him.
unit.target: Invasor huius gradus inevitabiliter systema defensionis automatae navis, quod in eum destinatum esset, excitaret.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro might then seize control of the spaceship!
unit.target: Lato Guiaro igitur navem possidere posset!

unit.source: Didn’t your sister tell you something Emperor Roselle once said?
unit.target: Nonne soror tua tibi aliquid dixerat, quod Imperator Roselle aliquando dixit?

unit.source: If you rely on something to obtain specialness and become stronger, you will definitely be punished because of it!
unit.target: Si in re aliqua specialitatem adipisci et fortior fieri confidas, certe pro ea punitus eris!

unit.source: Upon seeing the surging layers of golden light, Lumian raised his right hand and vanished.
unit.target: Videns strata lucis aureae emergentes, Lumian dextram manum elevavit et evanuit.

unit.source: Where is he “teleporting” to this time?
unit.target: Quo hunc “teleportat” hoc tempore?

unit.source: As long as he’s in the hall, he can’t avoid the Purification Halo!
unit.target: Dum in aula manet, Corona Purificationis vitari non potest!

unit.source: Lato Guiaro watched the other party’s struggle with certainty and a smile.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro certus et cum subridente aspiciens certamen alterius partis observabat.

unit.source: Unless Lumian Lee chose to leave the hall, it was impossible for him not to be affected by the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Nisi Lumian Lee aulam relinquere decideret, impossibile erat ne Corona Purificationis eum non afficeret.

unit.source: With the spaceship’s barrier raised, the door closed, and the place sealed, and using the unique power of the sea, if he wanted to “teleport” out, he had to first destroy the surrounding walls or metal doors to create an exit.
unit.target: Cum munimentum navis elevatum, porta clausa, et locus sigillatus esset, atque potentia unice maris utendo, si exire “teleportare” vellet, primum circumiectos muros vel portam metallicam ad exitum creandum delere debebat.

unit.source: This was also advantageous for Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Hoc quoque Lato Guiaro commode fuit.

unit.source: No one knew what the spaceship would unleash in this hall next!
unit.target: Nemo sciebat quid navis in hac aula postea evelleret!

unit.source: Layer after layer of Purification Halos rapidly “drowned” Lumian’s original location, but nothing happened.
unit.target: Stratum post stratum Coronae Purificationis celeriter locum originarium Lumiani submergebat, sed nihil evenit.

unit.source: Lumian’s figure was nowhere to be seen in the silver-white hall.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani nusquam in aula argenteo-alba apparuit.

unit.source: Wh… Lato Guiaro’s pupils constricted.
unit.target: Heu... Pupillae Lato Guiaro contractae sunt.

unit.source: Where did Lumian Lee go?
unit.target: Quo ivit Lumian Lee?

unit.source: Is his teleportation ability unaffected by the sealed interior of the spaceship?
unit.target: Num facultas ejus “teleportandi” ab interiore navis sigillato non afficitur?

unit.source: Or has he gone into hiding?
unit.target: An se occultavit?

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s heart skipped a beat; he extended his right hand and pulled.
unit.target: Cor Lato Guiaro titubavit; dextram manum extendit et traxit.

unit.source: The void in the hall stirred, unveiling an abnormal area nestled between two walls, flanked by dark holes emitting cerulean-blue gas.
unit.target: Vacuum in aula movit, revelans regionem abnormem inter duas parietes, cum hiatus obscuris gas caeruleo emittentibus.

unit.source: Creating an unstable space and hiding inside to avoid the Purification Halo? That’s true.
unit.target: Creare spatium instabile et intus celare, ut Corona Purificationis vitetur? Id verum est.

unit.source: The Purification Halo’s purpose is to exorcize, purify, warm, and provide courage.
unit.target: Propositum Coronae Purificationis est exorcizare, purgare, calefacere, atque fortitudinem praebere.

unit.source: Without substantial offensive power, it can’t destroy the structure of that space…
unit.target: Sine potestate offensiva substantiali, structuram illius spatii delere non potest…

unit.source: Lumian Lee actually possesses such an ability.
unit.target: Lumian Lee revera talem facultatem possidet.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro quickly saw through Lumian’s trick.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro celeriter insidias Lumiani perspexit.

unit.source: Calmly raising his right hand, he condensed a penetrating dark-green ray.
unit.target: Dextro manu tranquille elevante, radium obscurum viride penetrantem condensavit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he harnessed his basic control over gravity to pull at the fabricated space.
unit.target: Simul, administrationem fundamentalem gravitatis ad spatium fabricatum trahendum adhibuit.

unit.source: The dark-green ray struck the spot where it had been pulled, instantly penetrating and obliterating the structure.
unit.target: Radium obscurum viride locum, ad quem trahendum erat, percussit, statim penetrans et structuram abrogans.

unit.source: Silently shattered, the dark-green ray continued forward, hitting a silver-white full-body armor with its back turned to Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Silentio confractum, radium obscurum viride pergens in loricam totam argenteo-albam percussit, cuius tergum ad Lato Guiaro conversum erat.

unit.source: The dark-green ray, now weakened to a certain extent, faded away.
unit.target: Radium obscurum viride, iam ad certum gradum debilitatus, evanuit.

unit.source: The silver-white full-body armor suddenly pivoted, and two pairs of eyes appeared to lock onto Lato Guiaro from within the vacant helmet.
unit.target: Lorica totum corpus argenteo-album subito vertit, et duo paria oculorum ex intima galeae vacuae apparuerunt, ad Lato Guiaro intendentes.

unit.source: In the next moment, it charged toward the April Fool’s key member, forming a broadsword of light in its hand.
unit.target: In subsequenti momento, illa versus membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti impetum iniit, gladium latum lucis in manu formans.

unit.source: As the silver-white full-body armor rushed out, Lumian’s figure emerged in the corner.
unit.target: Dum lorica totum corpus argenteo-album festinanter progrediebatur, figura Lumiani in angulo emersit.

unit.source: He had utilized the terrain there to arrange a simple Bottle of Fiction, using the large hole that emitted poisonous gas as a symbolic window.
unit.target: Illic terram adhibuit ut simplicem “Bottle of Fiction” ordinaret, utens magno foramine, quod gas venenatum emitteret, quasi fenestra symbolica.

unit.source: His goal was twofold: first, to evade the influence of the Purification Halo, and second, to position the Pride Armor with its back facing Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Finis eius duplex erat: primo, influentiam Coronae Purificationis evadere; secundo, Loricam Superbiae, cuius tergum ad Lato Guiaro versa esset, constituere.

unit.source: Yes, this cursed armor might only target someone standing a certain distance behind it, but it might not.
unit.target: Ita, haec maledicta lorica forsitan solum aliquem intingeret, qui a certa distantia in tergo staret, sed fortasse non.

unit.source: What if that person not only stood more than ten meters behind it but also attempted to attack it by stabbing it in the back?
unit.target: Quid si iste non tantum plus quam decem metra in tergo staret, sed etiam conaretur eam per tergum perfodiendo oppugnare?

unit.source: The answer was clear!
unit.target: Responsum clarum est!

unit.source: Now, Lumian had a capable helper unafraid of the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Nunc, Lumian adiutor validus, Corona Purificationis non timens, habebat

unit.source: 585 Repeated “Betrayal”
unit.target: 585 Repetuta “Proditio”

unit.source: 585 Repeated “Betrayal”
unit.target: 585 Repetuta “Proditio”

unit.source: At a distance of just over ten meters, the Pride Armor covered the ground in two powerful strides, positioning itself in front of Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Ad spatium paulo ultra decem metra, armatura Superbia duobus validis gressibus terram tegebatur atque se ante Ultraman Lato Guiaro constituit.

unit.source: A broadsword, condensed from radiant light, slashed down with deadly precision.
unit.target: Ensis latum, ex luce radiante condensatus, cum letali subtilitate deorsum secabat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro had a momentary opportunity to utilize his Navigator ability, escape through hidden passageways in the void and dimensions, and evade the impending attack.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro occasionem momentaneam habuit ut facultatem Navigatoris suam uteretur, per arcana itinera in vacuo atque in dimensionibus effugeret et impetum imminentem evitaret.

unit.source: However, the sight of the silver-white full-body armor caught him off guard; he hadn’t anticipated an aggressive move before Lumian Lee could even don the armor!
unit.target: Attamen, conspectus armaturae totius corporis argenteo-albinae eum inopinato percutiit; non praevidebat motum aggressivum antequam Lumian Lee armaturam indueret!

unit.source: This momentary hesitation cost him.
unit.target: Haec momentanea haesitatio ei pretium attulit.

unit.source: The silver-white full-body armor, resembling a relentless steam locomotive, collided with him before he could vanish into the hidden tunnel.
unit.target: Armatura totius corporis argenteo-albina, instar locomotivae vaporis inexorabilis, cum eo concurrit, priusquam in tunnello abscondito evanescere posset.

unit.source: By then, it was too late, and the looming threat of being cleaved apart became imminent—a grim fate of upper and lower halves separated.
unit.target: Tunc iam sero erat, et imminens periculum dissectionis factus est—fatum crudele partium superiorum et inferiorum separatam imminens.

unit.source: In this dire circumstance, he was no earthworm with regenerative abilities; his fate seemed sealed.
unit.target: In his adversis condicionibus, non erat vermis terrenus cum facultate regenerandi; fatum eius clausum videbatur.

unit.source: Facing the approaching silver-white armor and its raised broadsword of light, scales formed from starlight protruded from various parts of Lato Guiaro’s body.
unit.target: Adspiciens armaturam argenteo-albinam appropinquantem et eius ensis lucis elevatus, squamae ex luce stellarum formatae ex variis partibus corporis Lato Guiaro eminere videbantur.

unit.source: The air quivered around him, as if an invisible tide were roaring, amplifying the tension.
unit.target: Aer circa eum tremuit, velut invisibilis aestus rugiret, tensionem amplificans.

unit.source: As per the intel gathered on April Fool’s, the power derived from the “sea” without the Governor of the Sea’s authority corresponded to a Sequence 5 at most, known as Tidal Scholar—the current state of Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Secundum notitiam collectam die Aprilis Stultorum, vis ex mari sine auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris ad maximum Sequens V pertinere videbatur, nota ut Tidal Scholar—status praesentis Lato Guiaro.

unit.source: Enveloped by an ethereal tide, Lato Guiaro swung his fist, resembling a colossal wave crashing down.
unit.target: Aestu aetherio involutus, Lato Guiaro pugnum movit, instar undae ingentis deorsum ruentis.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: His formidable punch collided with the side of the broadsword of light, forcefully diverting its trajectory.
unit.target: Pugnus eius formidolosus cum latere ensis lucis concurrit, iter eius vehementer deviando.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian materialized behind him, left hand raised.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian post eum apparuit, manu sinistra elevata.

unit.source: Indeed! I knew you’d seize this chance to teleport behind me and launch a sneak attack! Lato Guiaro was ready.
unit.target: Ita vero! Sciebam te hanc occasionem capturum esse ut post me translocaretur atque insidias inferret! Lato Guiaro paratus erat.

unit.source: Evading the silver-white full-body armor’s second strike, he imbued the surroundings in a warm golden hue.
unit.target: Evitans secundum ictum armaturae totius corporis argenteo-albinae, ambitum in calido aureo lumine imbuivit.

unit.source: Purification Halo!
unit.target: Aureola Purificationis!

unit.source: As layers of golden light surged towards Lumian, he deftly twisted his left wrist.
unit.target: Dum strati lucis aureae ad Lumian impetum fecerant, callide sinistrum articulum flexit.

unit.source: Even before that, the silver-white Lie earring on his left earlobe emitted a subtle glow, revealing various blobs of light and colors on Ultraman’s body.
unit.target: Etiam ante hoc, monile Lie, argenteo-album in lobulo auris sinistrae, subtiles fulgores edebat, variis globulis lucis et colorum in corpore Ultraman ostendentibus.

unit.source: Among them, a golden ball emitted a warm glow—the representation of the Purification Halo ability.
unit.target: Inter eos, globus aureus, calidum fulgoribus emittens, repraesentabat facultatem Aureolae Purificationis.

unit.source: With a flick of his wrist, the golden ball detached from Ultraman’s body and swiftly flew to Lumian.
unit.target: In ictu carpi, globus aureus a corpore Ultraman se divisit et celeriter ad Lumian volavit.

unit.source: Steal!
unit.target: Furare!

unit.source: Lumian successfully “stole” Ultraman’s Purification Halo!
unit.target: Lumian feliciter furtum perfecit Aureolae Purificationis Ultraman.

unit.source: The number of times the Ring of the Sea Queen could “steal” after the standard process remained unknown to Lumian.
unit.target: Numerus viciorum quibus Anulus Reginae Maris post rationem ordinariam furtari poterat, Lumiano ignotus manebat.

unit.source: However, he was certain that Lie’s “stealing” effect persisted for half a month, unaffected by his “stealing” of the sea’s power.
unit.target: Attamen, certus erat effectum furtandi Lie per dimidium mensis perseverare, nec affici a furtu potentiae maris.

unit.source: After Lie’s transformation on the ancestral altar in Milo Village, Lumian diligently experimented with Steal, honing his proficiency to ensure he could deploy it effectively in critical moments.
unit.target: Post transformationem Lie in altero maiorum apud Villam Milo, Lumian diligenter cum furtatione experimenta egit, peritiam suam exercens ut eam in momentis decisivis efficaciter adhibere posset.

unit.source: Thus, he had become relatively adept at stealing and dispersing the power of the sea.
unit.target: Ita, relativus peritus factus erat in furto et in divulgatione potentiae maris.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Ultraman’s Beyonder powers of the Sun pathway were well-documented by the Tarot Club’s information, making Lumian fully aware of what he aimed to Steal this time.
unit.target: Simul, potestas Ultraman Beyonder viae Solis a notitia Club Tarot clare descriptae erant, faciens Lumian plene conscius de eo quod hoc tempore furtum facere intendebat.

unit.source: With a solid foundation in mysticism knowledge, he felt prepared.
unit.target: Cum solidis fundamentis in mystica scientia, se paratum sensit.

unit.source: However, the challenge lay in his lack of experience “stealing” a Priest of Light’s abilities.
unit.target: Tamen, difficultas in eius inexperientia “furtandi” facultates Sacerdotis Lucis iacebat.

unit.source: He feared that locating the corresponding symbols for Purification Halo and Holy Water Creation might take too long, leaving him vulnerable to Lato Guiaro’s attacks.
unit.target: Timebat ne reperire symbola quae corresponderent ad Aureolam Purificationis atque ad creationem Aquae Sanctae nimis diu caperet, eum impetibus Lato Guiaro exposuens.

unit.source: Anticipating the Pride Armor’s frontal assault, Lumian strategically teleported four to five meters behind Lato Guiaro, enticing him to use Purification Halo.
unit.target: Praevidens impetum frontale armaturae Superbiae, Lumian cum ratione quattuor vel quinque metris post Lato Guiaro se translocavit, eum ad Aureolam Purificationis adhibendam invitatum.

unit.source: The distinction between the abilities Lumian used and those he refrained from was clear, providing him with instant recognition.
unit.target: Distinctio inter facultates quas Lumian adhibuerat et eas quas abstinuit perspicua erat, tribuens ei instan recognoscibilitatem.

unit.source: Before initiating the teleport, he activated the Lie earring and raised his left hand, ensuring he didn’t linger in the dangerous area for a moment longer.
unit.target: Antequam se translocare inciperet, monile Lie activavit et manum sinistram sublevavit, ut in regione periculosa non diutius maneret.

unit.source: The Purification Halo, despite being “stolen,” persisted and continued to surge, enveloping Lumian.
unit.target: Aureola Purificationis, quamvis “furtum” esset, perseveravit et fluebat, Lumian amplectens.

unit.source: However, it didn’t reach its intended target.
unit.target: Tamen, ad finem destinatum non pervenit.

unit.source: A formidable formless force emanated from Lumian’s body, acting as a barrier that thwarted the encroaching halo.
unit.target: Vis ingens sine forma e corpore Lumiani emanavit, fungens ut barriera quae aureolam imminientem coercebat.

unit.source: The power of the sea!
unit.target: Potentia maris!

unit.source: You have the power of the sea, and so do I!
unit.target: Tu potentiam maris habes, et ego quoque.

unit.source: During the Steal process, Lumian had reserved a portion of the sea’s power for himself.
unit.target: In processu furtandi, Lumian partem potentiae maris sibi reservaverat.

unit.source: Although not on par with Ultraman’s, it proved sufficient to repel the Purification Halo for a brief moment.
unit.target: Etsi non ad aequipollentiam Ultramanis, sufficiens erat ad repellendam Aureolam Purificationis per momentum breve.

unit.source: Calmly activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian vanished from the warm golden area, teleporting to the farthest corner from Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Calme maculam nigrum in humero dextro activans, Lumian regionem auream calidam reliquit et se translocavit ad remotissimam angulum a Lato Guiaro.

unit.source: The Purification Halo pursued relentlessly, but it reached its limit, visibly weakening.
unit.target: Aureola Purificationis pertinaciter insequebatur, sed ad finem suum pervenit, manifesto debilitata.

unit.source: Reacting swiftly, Lumian harnessed the power of the sea once more, watching as the warm golden barrier rapidly dissipated.
unit.target: Celeriter respondens, Lumian potentiam maris iterum adiunxit, spectans dum barriera aurea calida celeriter evanesceret.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Lato Guiaro’s heart skipped a beat.
unit.target: Interim, cor Lato Guiaro palpitavit.

unit.source: Intuitively, he sensed the loss of his Purification Halo ability, suspecting it had been “stolen”!
unit.target: Intuens, sensus amisisse facultatem Aureolae Purificationis eius percusso, suspiciens eam furtam esse!

unit.source: Lumian Lee’s item with the Steal effect is still operational?
unit.target: Num res Lumian Lee, quae effectum furtandi habet, adhuc operatur?

unit.source: Lato Guiaro couldn’t dwell on it.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro de ea diutius meditari non potuit.

unit.source: Dodging the Pride Armor’s heavy slashes, he fell to the ground, rolling to evade the attacks.
unit.target: Impugnata gravia ictuum armaturae Superbiae eludens, ad terram cecidit, volvens ut impetus effugeret.

unit.source: Facing the sky, he raised his right hand, clenching it.
unit.target: Ad caelo spectans, manum dextrem elevavit, eam stringens.

unit.source: Pure and blazing sunlight condensed rapidly, forming a thick ray that struck the silver-white armor’s chest.
unit.target: Lux pura atque fulgida celeriter condensata est, radium densum formans, quod pectus armaturae argenteo-albinae percussit.

unit.source: It paused momentarily, unable to penetrate, only burning and dissolving into tottering black marks.
unit.target: Momento subsedit, penetrare non valens, solum ardebant et in maculas nigras vacillantes dissolutae.

unit.source: Witnessing this and recognizing Lumian Lee as his adversary, Ultraman Lato Guiaro entertained the idea of fleeing.
unit.target: Hoc videns et Lumian Lee adversarium suum agnoscens, Ultraman Lato Guiaro consilium fugendi meditabatur.

unit.source: He decided to disengage, cease the confrontation, and seek an escape route.
unit.target: Constituit recedere, certamen finire, et viam evasionis quaerere.

unit.source: At that critical moment, instead of launching a barrage of attacks, the Pride Armor shifted its focus toward Lumian.
unit.target: Illo momento critico, potius quam multitudinem impetuum inferre, armatura Superbia attentionem suam in Lumian convertit.

unit.source: Lumian, who had previously utilized Spirit World Traversal on the betrothal ship and within the hall, found himself affected once again by the Purification Halo.
unit.target: Lumian, qui prius Spiritus Mundi Transitus in nave nuptiali atque in aula adhibuerat, se iterum ab Aureola Purificationis affectum invenit.

unit.source: His spirituality teetered on the brink of depletion, leaving him visibly fatigued and weakened.
unit.target: Spiritualitas eius in limine evanescence pendebat, eum palam fessum atque debilitatus relinquens.

unit.source: Any ordinary human in such a state near the Pride Armor would face indiscriminate attacks.
unit.target: Quisquis homo vulgaris in tali statu prope armaturam Superbiae esset, impetum indiscriminatum experiretur.

unit.source: Wh… Lato Guiaro keenly perceived the shift in dynamics.
unit.target: Heu… Lato Guiaro acerrime mutationem dynamicae sensit.

unit.source: Though unaware of the specifics, he sensed an advantage.
unit.target: Quamquam singularia ignorans, commodum sensibiliter percepit.

unit.source: Rising abruptly, he directed his attention to Lumian.
unit.target: Subito surgens, animum suum ad Lumian convertebat.

unit.source: In the next instant, the Pride Armor raised its radiant broadsword and charged towards Lumian.
unit.target: In momento proximo, armatura Superbia ensis lucidus elevatus est et in Lumian impetum fecit.

unit.source: Haha, your Sealed Artifact has betrayed you! Lato Guiaro mocked internally as he closed in, intending to exploit the silver‑white full‑body armor’s attack to create Sun Holy Water and sprinkle it on Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Haha, artifactum tuum sigillatum te prodidit! Lato Guiaro, interno risu irrisus, appropinquabat, studens impetum armaturae totius corporis argenteo‑albinae uti ad creandam Aquam Sanctam Solis et eam in Lumian Lee spargendam.

unit.source: Undeterred, Lumian took a resolute step forward.
unit.target: Intrepidus, Lumian firmiter gradum in antecessum fecit.

unit.source: Tapping into his Ascetic powers, the accumulated strength and spirituality within his body surged, replenishing his drained spirit.
unit.target: Ad potentiam asceticam accedens, vis ac spiritualitas in corpore eius congregatae effulsere, spiritum eius exhauritum reficientes.

unit.source: His body underwent a sudden transformation, growing by seven to eight centimeters and bulking up by two sizes, causing his loosely fitting deputy host’s robe to strain.
unit.target: Corpus eius subita mutazione transiit, crescens per septem ad octo centesimas et dupliciter ampliatus, ita vestimentum adiutorem eius laxius indutum ad tensionem ducens.

unit.source: The advancing Pride Armor abruptly halted, pivoting to face Lato Guiaro, who had followed closely.
unit.target: Armatura Superbia progrediens subito subsedit, convertens se ut Lato Guiaro aspiceret, qui proxime secutus erat.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s pupils contracted, and an instant heaviness enveloped his body, bringing him to a natural halt.
unit.target: Pupillae Lato Guiaro contraxerunt, et momento gravitas corpus eius obduxit, naturaliter cessare faciens.

unit.source: Simultaneously, his gaze locked onto the unusually tall figure of Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Simul, oculus eius in figuram insolitum altitudinis Lumian Lee incidit.

unit.source: The enemy teleported right in front of him, mere inches away.
unit.target: Hostis, solummodo paucis digitorum distant, ante eum se translocavit.

unit.source: Their eyes locked, reflecting each other in an intense confrontation.
unit.target: Oculi eorum se invicem constringebantur, inter se reflectentes in intensa contentionis imagine.

unit.source: With a swift whoosh, Lumian swung his right hand, adorned with the Flog boxing gloves, through the air.
unit.target: Velociter, cum subito sonitu, Lumian manum dextram – ornata manubris pugilisticis “Flog” – per aerem percussit.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s “heavy” state naturally exerted a suction force on his surroundings, a downgraded version of the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s characteristic.
unit.target: Status “gravis” Lato Guiaro in circumstantibus naturaliter vim aspirantem efferebat, versio minor propterius proprietatis artifacti sigillati humanoidis.

unit.source: Lumian’s punch encountered no repulsion; instead, it accelerated towards its target.
unit.target: Pugnus Lumiani nullam repulsionem obvenit; potius ad metam suam acceleravit.

unit.source: Unperturbed by the close‑range attacks, Lato Guiaro harbored concerns about Lumian’s Psychic Piercing ability.
unit.target: Nespertus ictibus proximis, Lato Guiaro sollicitudines de facultate psychica perforandi Lumiani gerebat.

unit.source: Unable to dodge or employ other abilities in time, he unleashed a retaliatory fist resembling a thousand tonnes of seawater, causing the sound of surging tides to echo.
unit.target: Non potens vitare vel alias facultates tempore adhibere, effudit pugnus retributionis, instar mille tonnorum aquae maris, cuius sonus fluctuum ruentium resonabat.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lato Guiaro blocked Lumian’s attack and swiftly rolled to the side, evading a surprise assault from the Pride Armor.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro impetum Lumiani obstrinxit et celeriter ad latus volvit, impetum improvisum ab armatura Superbia evitans.

unit.source: At that moment, a strong sense of greed surged within him, overshadowing his initial plan to escape.
unit.target: Illo momento, vehementer sensus avaritiae intra eum surrexit, primum consilium fugendi obumbrans.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Lumian retreated and retrieved a black bone flute with red holes from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Occasionem capiens, Lumian recedens ex sacculo itineris tibiam ossis nigrae cum foramina rubris extraxit.

unit.source: Symphony of Hatred!
unit.target: Symphonia Odii!

unit.source: While Lato Guiaro resisted the Pride Armor, Lumian brought the flute to his mouth and played a sharp, intense melody.
unit.target: Dum Lato Guiaro armaturam Superbiae repugnabat, Lumian tibiam ad os attulit et melodiam acutam atque intensam cecinit.

unit.source: Lato Guiaro’s mind buzzed, freezing him in place.
unit.target: Mens Lato Guiaro murmure pervagata, eum in loco immobilis relinquens.

unit.source: Bright blood oozed from the cracks in the starlight scales on his body.
unit.target: Sanguis lucidus ex fissuris in squamis stellae in corpore eius effluens erat.

unit.source: Emotional Detonation!
unit.target: Detonatio Affectuum!

unit.source: Pfft! The Pride Armor struck Lato Guiaro’s shoulder, splintering scales, bone, and flesh.
unit.target: Pfft! Armatura Superbia humerum Lato Guiaro percussit, scalas, ossa, et carnem dissecans.

unit.source: Closing the distance with two brisk strides, Lumian approached the nearly collapsed Lato Guiaro, his face twisted in pain.
unit.target: Duo rapidos gressus intervallum minuentes, Lumian Lato Guiaro, qui paene corruit, appropinquavit, facies dolore contorta.

unit.source: He raised the black bone flute in his hand.
unit.target: Tibiam ossis nigrae in manu attulit.

unit.source: In the moment that Lato Guiaro used the pain from the Pride Armor strike to break free from the detonated emotions, he witnessed Lumian Lee thrusting the bone flute toward him with a fierce expression.
unit.target: In illo momento, dum Lato Guiaro dolorem ictus armaturae Superbiae ad se liberandum ab affectibus detonatis adhibuit, vidit Lumian Lee tibiam ossis in se conicere, vultu ferocitate distincto.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: The bone flute effortlessly pierced Lato Guiaro’s left eye, akin to cutting through butter.
unit.target: Tibiam ossis sine labore penetravit oculum sinistrum Lato Guiaro, instar secandi butyrum.

unit.source: The eyeball of April Fool’s key member exploded, and a gruesome mix of blood and other fluids streamed out through the gaps in the black bone flute.
unit.target: Globus oculi membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum explodit, et horrida miscella sanguinis atque aliorum fluidorum per fissuras in tibia ossis nigrae effluebat.

unit.source: Even if the Symphony of Hatred only struck an ordinary part, it was tantamount to hitting a vital point.
unit.target: Etiamsi Symphonia Odii tantum partem vulgare percussisset, id aequivalebat ictui puncti vitalis.

unit.source: Striking a true vital point meant either instant death or a prolonged period of social death.
unit.target: Percutere verum punctum vitale significabat aut mortem instantaneam aut longum spatium mortis socialis.

unit.source: In this case, Lato Guiaro’s left eye and brain were undeniably vital points.
unit.target: In hoc casu, oculus sinistrum et cerebrum Lato Guiaro indubie puncta vitalia erant.

unit.source: His remaining eye widened and protruded, life force rapidly draining as he slumped to the ground.
unit.target: Oculus eius reliquus dilatatus et eminent, vis vitae celeriter defluens, dum ad terram labefactatus est.

unit.source: Lumian seized Ultraman’s neck, lifting him up.
unit.target: Lumian collum Ultraman apprehendit, eum levans.

unit.source: Releasing his right hand, which held the black bone flute, he delivered a heavy slap to Lato Guiaro’s face.
unit.target: Manum dextram dimittens, quae tibiam ossis nigrae tenebat, gravem percussum in faciem Lato Guiaro attulit.

unit.source: With a fierce expression, he growled in Intisian, “Did you go to Cordu Village to confirm the situation?”
unit.target: Vultu feroci, in lingua Intisiana, rugivit: “Ad Vicum Cordu ivistine ut rem comprobares?”

unit.source: 586 Gnawing
unit.target: 586 Rodens

unit.source: 586 Gnawing
unit.target: 586 Rodens

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro, his life rapidly slipping away, fell into a daze.
unit.target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro, vitae suae celeriter evanescente, in stuporem cecidit.

unit.source: Even his thoughts of self-preservation became blurred.
unit.target: Etiam cogitationes salutis suae obscuratae sunt.

unit.source: In the haze, he vaguely saw Juan Oro, the wrinkled old man, standing in the middle of the sea, waving with a mix of joy and mockery.
unit.target: In nebula, vix vidit Juan Oro, senex rugosus, in medio maris stantem, qui gaudio et derisio simul salutabat.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian’s voice resonated from the horizon, faint, ethereal, and elusive.
unit.target: Illo momento, vox Lumiani a horizonte resonavit, tenuis, aetheria, et elusiva.

unit.source: “Did you go to Cordu Village to confirm the situation?”
unit.target: “An in vicum Cordu ivisti ad rem comprobandam?”

unit.source: Cordu Village?
unit.target: Vicus Cordu?

unit.source: The time Mad Lady and I visited Nolfi, and went there just out of convenience?
unit.target: Tempore quo Mad Lady et ego Nolfi visitavimus, et eo tantum ex commoditate iverimus?

unit.source: Lato Guiaro lost focus, and Lumian’s figure reflected in his closed eye.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro attentionem amisit, et imaginem Lumiani in oculo suo clauso vidit.

unit.source: With the intent to annoy, he spoke his last words in Highlander.
unit.target: Causa vexandi, ultimas verba in lingua Highlander locutus est.

unit.source: “I’ve been there… with Mad Lady. It was… simply for fun… but Loki… seemed to… have ulterior…”
unit.target: “Ibi fui… cum Mad Lady. Erat… simpliciter ad ludum… sed Loki… videbatur… ulteriores habere…”

unit.source: Don’t you want to know what happened back then?
unit.target: Nonne vis scire quid tunc acciderit?

unit.source: Sure, I’ll speak in Highlander.
unit.target: Certo, in lingua Highlander loquar.

unit.source: It’s your problem if you don’t understand.
unit.target: Tuum est problema, si non intellegis.

unit.source: Your fault for not taking this language seriously in the past!
unit.target: Culpa tua est quod hanc linguam prius non graviter accepisti!

unit.source: Lato Guiaro knew his actions wouldn’t practically affect Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Lato Guiaro sciebat actus suos prorsus Lumian Lee non afficere.

unit.source: This was because Lumian Lee could find someone to perform dream divination, hypnosis, or undergo a real dream when he returned.
unit.target: Hoc enim erat, quia Lumian Lee invenire poterat aliquem qui oneiromantiam, hypnotismum, aut verum somnium peragere posset, cum rediret.

unit.source: From there, he could memorize the Highlander he spoke and find a way to translate it into Intisian or ancient Feysac.
unit.target: Unde, poterat linguam Highlander quam locutus erat meminisse et viam invenire ut eam in Intisian vel antiquam Feysac transferret.

unit.source: Still, he just wanted to annoy the other party.
unit.target: Tamen, solum alterum vexare volebat.

unit.source: About to die, he couldn’t care less about future developments.
unit.target: Mox moriturus, futuris evenimentis nihil curabat.

unit.source: “Motives…” Lato Guiaro uttered his last word as his life extinguished.
unit.target: “Causae…” Lato Guiaro ultimum verbum edixit, cum vita eius extinguebatur.

unit.source: In that final moment, he seemed to hear Lumian Lee speaking to him in Highlander, “Thank you.”
unit.target: Illo momento finali, videbatur eum audire Lumian Lee, qui in lingua Highlander ad eum loquebatur, “Gratias.”

unit.source: The “thank you” flowed naturally, carrying a strong sense of mockery.
unit.target: Ille “gratias” naturaliter effluit, vehementem derisionis sensum ferens.

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro’s intact eye bulged even more, his expression freezing on his face, his breath coming to a complete halt.
unit.target: Oculus Ultraman Lato Guiaro intactus etiam magis protrudebat, vultus eius in facie immotus, et spiritus eius omnino cessavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s right hand gripped the Symphony of Hatred once more.
unit.target: Dextera manus Lumiani iterum Symphonia Odii tenuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he released his left hand, watching Ultraman’s key member’s head rapidly detach from the black bone flute with red holes, revealing a sinister and deep blood-red hole.
unit.target: Simul, sinistram manum dimisit, spectans caput membri principali Ultraman celeriter se ab instrumento ossi nigri cum foraminibus rubris separari, revelans sinus malignus et altus, rubro sanguineus.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: Ultraman collapsed to the ground.
unit.target: Ultraman in terram corruit.

unit.source: The sticky blood on the black bone flute coalesced and dripped onto his body.
unit.target: Sanguis viscosus in flauto ossi nigri coalescit et in corpus eius stillavit.

unit.source: After the person who had backstabbed it suffered a fatal wound, Pride Armor stopped moving and stood nearby, resembling an ordinary silver-white full-body armor without any special characteristics.
unit.target: Postquam ille, qui prodidit, vulnerum fatalium affectus est, “Pride Armor” motum desiit et prope stetit, similis armatura totius corporis argenteo-albae, nulla speciali nota.

unit.source: Loki had ulterior motives? A motive other than helping the Sinners and pulling a prank?
unit.target: Loki habebat ulteriores causas? Causa alia quam peccatoribus auxilio ferendo et iocum faciendo?

unit.source: As Lumian recalled Ultraman’s confession before his death, he bent down to check what items this April Fool’s key member had.
unit.target: Cum Lumian confessionem Ultramanis ante mortem revocavit, se inclinavit ad perscrutandum quae bona haberet hic membrum clavis “April Fool’s”.

unit.source: Of course, he didn’t hold much hope.
unit.target: Certe, parvam spem habebat.

unit.source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro had disguised himself as the incoming Governor of the Sea, Simon Guiaro, to board the betrothal ship.
unit.target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro se subdole indutus erat ut venturus Praefectus Maris, Simon Guiaro, ad navem sponsalem conscenderet.

unit.source: Carrying no items, his belongings should have been handed over to Mad Lady, allowing her to conceal them using flesh and blood magic in his stomach.
unit.target: Nihil ferens, supellectilia eius tradita esse debebant Mad Lady, ut illa ea celaret utens magia carnis et sanguinis in ventre eius.

unit.source: However, Mad Lady clearly didn’t have the time or opportunity to return the items to Ultraman.
unit.target: Attamen, Mad Lady manifeste tempus nec occasionem habuit ut supellectilia ad Ultraman redirent.

unit.source: This was one of the reasons why Lumian could eliminate Ultraman, a powerful dual pathway Beyonder, in such a short period.
unit.target: Hoc erat una ex causis cur Lumian Ultraman, potentem Beyonder duplicis viae, in tam brevi tempore exterminare posset.

unit.source: If Juan Oro hadn’t tipped off the sea spawn on the bridal boat beforehand, Lumian would’ve been forced to stash his Traveler’s Bag temporarily with Mr. K.
unit.target: Si Juan Oro non praemonuisset progenies marinas in nave sponsali, Lumian coactus fuisset ut sacculum Viatoris suum pro tempore apud Domine K reposeret.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian observed a strange transformation in the corpse of Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian transformationem insolitam in cadavere Ultraman Lato Guiaro observavit.

unit.source: It swiftly faded, morphing into a semi-translucent, semi-flesh state.
unit.target: Celeriter evanuit, transformans se in statum semi-translucidum et semi-carnosum.

unit.source: Then, like it was being disintegrated by countless tiny creatures, it oozed into the silver metal floor and gradually vanished.
unit.target: Deinde, quasi a innumeris parvulis creaturis dissolveretur, exsudavit in pavimentum metallicum argenteum et paulatim evanuit.

unit.source: Soon, the remnants of flesh, starlight, and sun-like fragments left by Lato Guiaro were absorbed by the silver metallic floor, leaving behind only a Sea Governor ceremonial robe, shrouded in a faint grayish-white fog.
unit.target: Mox, reliquiae carnis, lucis sideralis, et fragmenta solis similia ab Lato Guiaro relictae ab pavimento metallico argenteo absorptae sunt, relinquentes tantum vestem caerimonialem Praefecti Maris, tenuiter cinereo-albae nebulae involutam.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the grayish-white fog got absorbed by the silver metallic floor and the mysterious structure.
unit.target: In momento, nebula cinereo-albae ab pavimento metallico argenteo ac structura mysteriosa absorpta est.

unit.source: Lumian attempted unsuccessfully to “reclaim” something.
unit.target: Lumian conatus est aliquid “recuperare”, sed frustra.

unit.source: Is this what it means to return to the sea?
unit.target: Hocne est quod significat ad mare redire?

unit.source: But why did this peculiar structure absorb the Priest of Light’s Beyonder characteristic?
unit.target: Sed cur haec structura peculiaris proprietatem Beyonder Sacerdotis Lucis absoruit?

unit.source: Just as Lumian pondered, the sound of metal grinding surrounded him.
unit.target: Ita ut Lumian meditaret, strepitus metalli fricantis eum circumdedit.

unit.source: The pitch-black holes in the surrounding walls, ceiling, and floor once again got concealed by rotating, protruding metal.
unit.target: Foramina nigerrima in parietibus, laquearibus, et pavimento circumstantibus iterum absconsa sunt ab metallo rotante et protrudente.

unit.source: No more cerulean-blue poisonous gas spewed out, saving Lumian the energy to engulf his body in a layer of crimson, almost white flames.
unit.target: Nullus amplius gas venenosa caeruleo-azurea efflatus est, servans Luminum energiam ad corpus suum in strato flammarum carminarum, paene albarum involvendum.

unit.source: Amidst the clanking sounds, two metallic doors ascended, revealing two tunnels leading to different destinations.
unit.target: Inter sonos tintinnantes, duo ianuas metallicas surrexerunt, ostendentes duo cuniculos ad diversa loca ducere.

unit.source: With the target of the betrayal now gone, the silver-gray behemoth reverted to its “normal” state.
unit.target: Cum obiectum proditionis iam evanuerat, ingens argenteo-cineraceus monstrum ad statum suum “normalem” rediit.

unit.source: Lumian peered into the depths of the tunnel ahead, his heart involuntarily racing.
unit.target: Lumian in profundum cuniculi ante se intuebat, et cor eius involuntarie vehementer pulsabat.

unit.source: Badump! Badump! He felt inexplicably nervous and uneasy.
unit.target: Badump! Badump! Sine causa anxius et inquietus se sensit.

unit.source: In Port Santa, the apartment Loki was hiding.
unit.target: In Port Santa, in apartamento in quo Loki se abscondit.

unit.source: The moment Ludwig declared, “I’m hungry,” he swiftly bowed his head and sank his teeth into Loki’s hand, gripping the gemstone bracelet as if devouring the marrow from a chicken wing.
unit.target: Illo momento, Ludwig dixerit “Esurio,” celeriter caput inclinavit et dentes suos in manum Loki immerit, gemmatis bracchiale tenens, quasi medullam ex ala gallinae devorans.

unit.source: An intense wave of pain surged through Loki’s mind.
unit.target: Intensa unda doloris per mentem Loki pertransiit.

unit.source: His immediate instinct was to deploy Paper Figurine Substitutes, a desperate attempt to break free from the current situation.
unit.target: Instinctus immediatus eius erat “Paper Figurine Substitutes” adhibere, conatus desperatus ut e hac re se liberaret.

unit.source: Yet, he hesitated, fearing that such a move might create an insurmountable distance between him and the sealed demigod, eliminating any chance of regaining control.
unit.target: Tamen cunctavit, metuens ne talis motus spatium insuperabile inter se et demideum clausum crearet, tollens omnem facultatem regiminis recuperandi.

unit.source: Amidst the gruesome symphony of bones crunching and flesh tearing, Loki snatched the falling gemstone bracelet with his free hand and forcibly pried open his mouth.
unit.target: Inter horribilem symphoniam ossium confractarum et carnis dilaniatae, Loki bracchiale gemmatis cadens manu libera arripuit et vi os suum aperuit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: A rush of air slammed into Ludwig’s head, akin to a bullet fired from the latest steam rifle, ripping through flesh and hair to reveal a ghastly white skull.
unit.target: Impulsus aeris in caput Ludovici verberavit, instar telae ex recentissimo tormento vaporario emissae, percurrens carnem et pilos, calvariam horridam albam revelans.

unit.source: However, Ludwig remained unfazed.
unit.target: Attamen, Ludwig immotus manebat.

unit.source: Gnawing on Loki’s left hand, he had already severed five fingers and devoured half of the palm.
unit.target: Mordens manum sinistram Loki, iam quinque digitos abscidit et dimidium palmae devoravit.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang! Air Bullets relentlessly pounded the boy, leaving him mangled and disfigured.
unit.target: Bang! Bang! Bang! Projectilia aerea pertinaciter puero percusserunt, eum miserrime dilaniatum et deformatum relinquentes!

unit.source: Yet, Ludwig persisted in his attentive nibbling on Loki.
unit.target: Sed Ludwig perseveravit in sua diligenti morsa in Loki.

unit.source: Crack, crack.
unit.target: Crep, crep.

unit.source: He had already crunched down on the other party’s wrist bone, a crisp sound echoing through their intertwined flesh.
unit.target: Iam os carpale alterius partis conterebat, sonus crispus per carnem eorum implicatam resonans.

unit.source: As Loki nearly blacked out from the pain, he roughly grasped what was happening.
unit.target: Dum Loki paene ex dolore obscurabatur, aspera manu intellexit quid accideret.

unit.source: The sealed demigod possessed incredible vitality.
unit.target: Demideus clausus incredibilem vim vitalem possidebat.

unit.source: Ordinary attacks and Beyonder powers couldn’t cause significant harm.
unit.target: Impulsus ordinarii et facultates Beyonder damnum grave creare non poterant.

unit.source: In simpler terms, he could put him to sleep or manipulate his Spirit Body Threads to knock him out, but killing him with regular means proved challenging.
unit.target: Simpliciter, eum ad dormiendum inducere poterat aut fila corporis spiritus eius regere ut illum incoscientem redderet, sed eum ordinariis modis occidere difficile erat.

unit.source: In such circumstances, even if the sealed demigod couldn’t utilize any abilities, lacking sufficient strength and speed, merely devouring the other party’s flesh and bones with all his might posed an abnormal challenge for many Mid-Sequence Beyonders.
unit.target: In talibus condicionibus, etiam si demideus clausus ullam facultatem adhibere non posset, carens vi et celeritate sufficienti, sola edendo carnem et ossa alterius partis omni sua potentia, provocationem insolitam pluribus Beyonder Medi-sequentibus constituit.

unit.source: Loki abandoned the idea of retrieving other mystical items and substituted himself with a paper figurine.
unit.target: Loki consilium reliquorum mysticorum rerum recuperandi reliquit et se substituit figurina papyracea.

unit.source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Ludwig, his head covered in signs of Air Bullet destruction and almost devoid of human form, raised his head.
unit.target: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Ludwig, capite suo signis destructae aeris telae et paene forma humana carens, caput attollit.

unit.source: Beside his bloodstained mouth was a piece of white paper that quickly swept into his mouth alongside the blood-colored flesh.
unit.target: Ad os eius, quod sanguine tinctum erat, erat frustum papyri albi, quod celeriter in os eius traiecit, simul cum carne sanguine colorata.

unit.source: Ludwig’s eyes reflected Loki’s outline in the corner of the room.
unit.target: Oculi Ludovici contornum Loki in angulo conclavi reflexerunt.

unit.source: Something beneath his torn skin and flesh seemed to squirm slowly, attempting to break free, but to no avail.
unit.target: Aliquid sub cute lacerata et carne eius lente contorquebatur, conans se liberare, sed frustra.

unit.source: Loki assessed the situation and the items on him.
unit.target: Loki condicionem et res in se aestimavit.

unit.source: With the Soul Assurer marionette unable to return in time, he sensibly chose not to confront the sealed demigod creature.
unit.target: Cum “Soul Assurer” marionetta tempore redeundi non posset, sapienter elegit non pugnare contra creaturam demidei clausi.

unit.source: He would flee first before considering the future.
unit.target: Primum fugiturus erat antequam futura consideraret.

unit.source: At that moment, a crimson moonlight streamed through the window.
unit.target: Illo momento, lumen lunaris rubrum per fenestram effluebat.

unit.source: The moonlight bathed the apartment, wrapping around Loki.
unit.target: Lumen lunaris apartamentum perfudit, circumvolvens Loki.

unit.source: Loki heard a fleeting voice.
unit.target: Loki audivit vocem evanescentem.

unit.source: “A strong smell of blood…”
unit.target: “Odor intensus sanguinis…”

unit.source: As the moonlight faded, a grayish-white and pitch-black paper figurine appeared on the ground.
unit.target: Dum lumen lunaris evanuit, figurina papyracea cinereo-alba et nigerrima in terra apparuit.

unit.source: Loki’s figure materialized a few hundred meters away, outside a vine forest.
unit.target: Figura Loki paucos centena passuum distante, extra lucum vitarum, apparuit.

unit.source: It was a boon bestowed by the Celestial Worthy during a prayer some weeks before this operation.
unit.target: Erat donum concessum a Caelestibus Dignis per preces aliquot hebdomadarum ante hanc operationem.

unit.source: It had been attached to a pre-prepared paper figurine, forming such a potent substitute that bordered on godhood.
unit.target: Illud ad figurinam papyraceam praeparatam adnexus erat, formans substitutum tam potentem ut ad deitatem propinquum esset.

unit.source: Drip, drip. Blood still dripped from Loki’s bitten left wrist.
unit.target: Gutta, gutta. Sanguis adhuc ex carpo sinistro, quem Loki mordebat, stillabat.

unit.source: He activated the diamond on the bracelet and swiftly faded away, preparing to teleport.
unit.target: Adamas in bracchiale activavit et celeriter evanuit, se teleportare parans.

unit.source: Port Santa, Milo Village.
unit.target: Port Santa, Vicus Milo.

unit.source: Tap, tap, tap.
unit.target: Tac, tac, tac.

unit.source: The soft patter of footsteps reverberated in Bard’s ears, causing him to tense.
unit.target: Mollis strepitus vestigiorum in auribus Bardi resonabat, eum tensum faciens.

unit.source: Bard surveyed his surroundings, finding nothing amiss.
unit.target: Bard circumstantia sua perspexit, nihil inusitatum inveniens.

unit.source: He sprinted, weaving through several buildings, yet the rhythmic tapping of footsteps persisted behind him.
unit.target: Cucurrit, inter varia aedificia serpens, sed strepitus vestigiorum rhythmice post eum perseverabat.

unit.source: Attempting to force open a door and seek refuge in a villager’s house in Milo Village,
unit.target: Tentans ostium forare et in domo vicani in Vicus Milo refugium petere,

unit.source: Bard was met with an unexpected sight.
unit.target: Bard spectaculum inopinatum invenit.

unit.source: Instead of the familiar kitchen, tables, chairs, and household items, his eyes beheld a decrepit stone platform enveloped in darkness.
unit.target: Pro coquina nota, mensis, sellis, et supellectilibus domesticis, oculi eius conspectum invenerunt vetustum tabulatum lapideum, in tenebris involutum.

unit.source: The stone platform!
unit.target: Tabulatum lapideum!

unit.source: Bard’s pupils widened, as if he had entered an unreal illusion.
unit.target: Pupillae Bardi dilatatae sunt, quasi in illusionem incredibilem intravisset.

unit.source: He found himself back at the residence of the Governor of the Sea and the altar where Milo Village’s inhabitants paid homage to their ancestor.
unit.target: Inventus est se iterum in domicilio Praefecti Maris et in altare, ubi incolae Vicus Milo maioribus suis honorem afferebant.

unit.source: Something crawled out from a crack in the worn stone platform.
unit.target: Aliquid ex fissura in vetusto tabulato lapideo emerguit.

unit.source: A translucent worm, adorned with multiple rings, swiftly expanded, transforming into a young man donned in the attire of a sea prayer ritual’s deputy host, monocle in place.
unit.target: Vermis translucidus, multis anulis ornatus, celeriter dilatatus est, transformatus in iuvenem, qui indutus erat vestitu hospitis vicarii ritus orationis maris, cum monoculo in oculo dextro.

unit.source: Seated on the weathered stone platform, the man grinned at Bard.
unit.target: Sedens in tabulato lapideo vetusto, vir Bard subridens aspexit.

unit.source: “Do you comprehend?”
unit.target: “Intelligis?”

unit.source: Bard suddenly grasped the meaning behind the question.
unit.target: Bard subito quaestionis significationem intellexit.

unit.source: Swallowing hard, he replied, “Understood.”
unit.target: Durius deglutiens, respondit, “Intellexi.”

unit.source: Since the altar had an owner and Beyonder creatures residing there, the so‐called rule that it could only be enchanted once a year for the Ring of the Sea Queen clearly didn’t hold true!
unit.target: Cum altare dominum haberet et ibi creaturae Beyonder habitabant, regula, quae dicebatur se solum semel in anno pro Anulo Reginae Maris incantari posse, plane non validum erat!

unit.source: The other party could affix the power as many times as desired!
unit.target: Alter pars potestatem, quoties vellet, adicere poterat!

unit.source: The young man, clad in a dark-blue deputy host’s sacrificial robe, toyed with the monocle in his right eye and smirked.
unit.target: Iuvenis, in veste sacrificatoria hospitis vicarii caeruleo obscuro indutus, ludebatur cum monoculo in oculo dextro et subridens arridebat.

unit.source: “Over a millennium, I’ve molded the rule that the Steal ability can only be conferred once a year. Little did I expect to deceive you all in the end.”
unit.target: “Per plus mille annos, regulam condidi, ut facultas Furtum solum semel in anno conferretur. Parum fere exspectavi ut vos omnes tandem deciperem.”

unit.source: 587 “Deceived”
unit.target: 587 “Decēptus”

unit.source: 587 “Deceived”
unit.target: 587 “Decēptus”

unit.source: Upon hearing the young man’s words, Bard felt his blood rush to his head.
unit.target: Auditis verbis iuvenis, Bardus sensit sanguinem suum celeriter in caput ascendere.

unit.source: Crafting a seemingly valid rule over a millennium to deceive others?
unit.target: Constituens praeceptum quod validum videtur per mille annos ad alios decipiendos?

unit.source: What kind of lame antique Swindler is this?
unit.target: Qualis hic claudicans antiquus impostor est?

unit.source: Bard blurted out, “The patterns on the altar and the surrounding arrangements are also fake?”
unit.target: Bard subito exclamavit: “Figurae in altare et dispositiones circumiectae quoque fictae sunt?”

unit.source: The young man in the dark-blue deputy host robe chuckled.
unit.target: Iuvenis, in veste caerulea obscura, quam ut vicarius hospitis gerebat, risit.

unit.source: “If it wasn’t real, would you have been deceived?”
unit.target: “Si non verum esset, decipiererisne?”

unit.source: “Furthermore, I occasionally venture out.
unit.target: Praeterea, interdum exeo.”

unit.source: “When I do, it grants Steal powers on my behalf.”
unit.target: Cum id facio, mihi tribuit potestates furtivas.

unit.source: “Of course, with the spirituality produced by the surrounding worshippers, it can indeed only bestow once a year.”
unit.target: Certe, cum spiritualitas ab cultoribus circumstantibus producta sit, id vere semel in anno tribui potest.

unit.source: As the young man spoke, the smile on his face widened.
unit.target: Dum iuvenis loquebatur, risus in facie eius amplius patebat.

unit.source: Bard’s forehead throbbed as he listened, feeling like he had been mocked.
unit.target: Frons Bardi pulsabat dum auscultabat, quasi derisus esset.

unit.source: According to the other party’s claim that the Steal powers could be bestowed at will, the Ring of the Sea Queen should have been complete and equipped with all its functions.
unit.target: Secundum assertionem alterius partis, quod potestates furtivas volenter tribui poterant, Annulus Reginae Maris plenus esse debuisset et omnibus functionibus instructus.

unit.source: So, why did the success of the sea prayer ritual experience such a significant delay?
unit.target: Ergo, cur successus ritus maris precationis tam magnam moram passus est?

unit.source: Unable to comprehend the situation, Bard turned around and sprinted towards the exit.
unit.target: Non rem intellegens, Bard se vertit et ad exitum cucurrit.

unit.source: It wasn’t that he hadn’t considered begging for mercy and surrendering on the spot, but these things could be done later.
unit.target: Non enim statim misericordiam petendi atque tradendi occasionem cepit, sed haec postea perfici posse arbitrabatur.

unit.source: For now, he wanted to take a gamble, betting that the other party’s claim of occasionally venturing out was a lie.
unit.target: Nunc autem voluit aleam iactare, confitens affirmationem alterius partis de interdum exeundi mendaciam esse.

unit.source: In essence, he believed he was trapped in the altar, unable to venture anywhere and influence the people around him.
unit.target: In summa putabat se in altare inclusum esse, neque alibi exeundi nec homines circa se commovendi posse.

unit.source: If he allowed himself to be intimidated and didn’t dare to escape, he would fall into the other party’s trap, cheated of his freedom and future.
unit.target: Si se sineret intimidari et effugere non audiret, in insidias alterius partis incidere debebat, libertate sua et futuro fraudatus.

unit.source: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard reached the staircase in a few steps and ran up.
unit.target: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bardus in paucis gradibus scalae accessit et ascendit currente.

unit.source: The more he ran, the happier he became. The monocle-wearing young man didn’t stop him.
unit.target: Quo magis cucurrit, eo laetior fiebat. Iuvenis, qui monoculum gerebat, eum non cohibebat.

unit.source: I made the right bet!
unit.target: Rectam aleam cepi!

unit.source: He’s the core of that altar. There’s no way to leave!
unit.target: Ipse est nucleus altaris; nulla via ad egressum est!

unit.source: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard witnessed the scene on the first floor illuminated by sunlight.
unit.target: Thud! Thud! Thud! Bard scaenam in primo tabulato, sole illustratam, conspexit.

unit.source: Amidst his ecstasy, his thoughts suddenly shattered.
unit.target: Inter extatiam suam, cogitationes eius subito dissolutae sunt.

unit.source: He felt the darkness around him being pierced by the light, shattering into pieces.
unit.target: Sensit tenebras circa se, lumine transmittendo, in fragmenta dissolutas.

unit.source: Bard bolted upright, alarmed to find himself lying in the servant’s room at the Governor of the Sea’s residence. He hadn’t left.
unit.target: Bard subito surrexit, perterrita cum se in conclavi servorum in domicilio Gubernatoris Maris iacere inveniret. Non discesserat.

unit.source: He surveyed his surroundings and heard cheers and crackers from outside.
unit.target: Circumspiciebat et ex foris plausus ac crepitus sonorum festorum audivit.

unit.source: I just had a dream?
unit.target: Modo somnium habui?

unit.source: Did it stem from a spirituality warning, helping me discover a problem with the plan?
unit.target: Num ex monitione spirituali orta est, quae me ad consilii problema detegendum adiuvit?

unit.source: As Bard pondered these thoughts, he immediately dismissed the corresponding judgment.
unit.target: Dum Bard has cogitationes considerabat, statim iudicium adaequatum deiecit.

unit.source: No, how could I have fallen asleep during the sea prayer ritual?
unit.target: Minime, quomodo in ritu maris precationis obdormiri potuerim?

unit.source: Did I start dreaming after hearing soft footsteps in my room?
