unit.target: Num somniare coepi postquam levia vestigia in cubiculo meo audivi?

unit.source: Bard rolled to his feet, slung his backpack over his shoulders, and tentatively pushed open the door, entering the corridor.
unit.target: Bard ad pedes evasit, sacculum super umeros suspensus et timide ianuam aperiens in corridorium ingreditus est.

unit.source: No longer smug with the plan that required minimal risks or combat, Bard realized he couldn’t share in the distribution of items.
unit.target: Non iam superbus de consilio, quod minimis periculis vel certamine necessarium erat, Bard intellexit se in distributione rerum participare non posse.

unit.source: He couldn’t teleport away directly, nor could he return to his original appearance or disguise himself as someone else.
unit.target: Nec directe se teleportare poterat, nec ad formam primariam redire aut se alio modo simulare.

unit.source: Upon reaching the corridor, Bard noticed the Little Devils leaving the shadows and performing a strange celebratory dance.
unit.target: Ad corridorium perveniens, Bard animadvertit Parvos Diabolos ex umbris egredientes et saltationem celebrativam insolitam agere.

unit.source: He hadn’t “communicated” with these sea spawn and knew their intelligence was roughly equivalent to that of ordinary dogs.
unit.target: Non cum his marinis progenie “communicaverat” et scivit eorum intelligentiam circa aequipollentiam canum vulgarium esse.

unit.source: They could be tamed and controlled, but direct communication was beyond them.
unit.target: Domari et regiri poterant, sed directa conversatio eis extra erat.

unit.source: However, the amazing thing was that Little Devils had the ability to record and recreate human words, even if they weren’t sure of their meanings.
unit.target: Verumtamen mirum erat quod Diaboli Parvi facultatem habebant verbis humanis recordandis et recreandis, etiamsi significationem earum ignorabant.

unit.source: Moreover, they could receive signals from their collaborators within a 100-meter radius.
unit.target: Praeterea, signa a cooperantibus suis intra centum metra radium accipere poterant.

unit.source: The Little Devils ignored Bard as well.
unit.target: Diaboli Parvi etiam Bardum neglexerunt.

unit.source: The sea prayer ritual had succeeded.
unit.target: Ritus maris precationis prosperaverat.

unit.source: According to their prior agreement, the fake Governor of the Sea could leave on his own.
unit.target: Secundum priorem conventionem, fictus Gubernator Maris solus exire poterat.

unit.source: Bard left the Governor of the Sea’s residence and realized that the guards at the entrance weren’t kneeling to thank the boon like before.
unit.target: Bard domicilium Gubernatoris Maris reliquit et animadvertit custodes ad ingressum non genu flectere ut beneficium antea gratias agerent.

unit.source: The villagers of Milo Village at the docks were the same.
unit.target: Incolae Vicus Milo apud portum idem erant.

unit.source: Apart from a few who sincerely shouted that the sea prayer ritual had succeeded, the rest merely echoed what was happening and expressed their joy, with many preferring to release crackers.
unit.target: Praeter paucos, qui sincere clamaverunt ritum maris precationis prospere fuisse, ceteri solum id quod agebatur resonare fecerunt et gaudium suum efferebant, plurimi autem praevaleant sonos bomborum emittens.

unit.source: Indeed, it was a dream.
unit.target: Revera, somnium erat.

unit.source: The villagers’ reactions in the dream were too exaggerated…
unit.target: Responsiones incolarum in somnio nimis amplificatae erant…

unit.source: I should know that based on past experiences with sea prayer rituals, only the committee members of the Fisheries Guild and a few people with strong sea bloodlines can sense the arrival of the sea’s boon.
unit.target: Ex praeteritis experientiis ritus maris precationis, scire debui quod solum membra commissionis Gildae Piscatoriae ac pauci eorum cum sanguine marino robusto adventum beneficii maris sentit.

unit.source: Others with sea bloodlines wouldn’t have a tangible sense.
unit.target: Alteri cum sanguine marino sensum tangibilem non habebunt.

unit.source: They’d slowly realize they’ve become stronger, or the changes are too weak to detect.
unit.target: Paulatim intellexerent se fortiores factos esse, aut mutationes nimis leves ad agnoscendum.

unit.source: Otherwise, the failure of the sea prayer ritual last year wouldn’t have escaped the notice of Port Santa’s citizens and would have only circulated within the core circle.
unit.target: Alioquin defectus ritus maris precationis anni pristini non evanuisset a conspectu civium Portus Sanctae et solum intra circulum nucleare diffusus fuisset.

unit.source: Bard used the environment to quickly confirm the essence of his previous encounter.
unit.target: Bard ambitum ad celeriter confirmandam essentiam pristini congressus sui usus est.

unit.source: He didn’t dare relax, nor did he “again” head to the docks to admire the villagers being fooled. Instead, he turned to the road leading to Port Santa’s city district.
unit.target: Non ausus est quiescere, nec iterum ad portum accedere ut incolas decipientes admiraret; pro eo, ad viam quae ad districtum urbis Portus Sanctae ducit se vertit.

unit.source: Just as he stepped out of the ancient village, Bard spotted a figure ahead.
unit.target: Ita ut e vico antiquo exiretur, Bard figuram in praeviso conspexit.

unit.source: The man stood over 2.4 meters tall, clad in a simple linen robe and a hood, holding a thick staff.
unit.target: Vir plus quam 2.4 metris stans, simplici lintea tunica et pallio indutus, baculo crasso tenebat.

unit.source: “Gandalf…” Bard’s heart tightened as he shouted.
unit.target: “Gandalf…” Cordis Bardi contraxit, cum clamavit.

unit.source: With the dream just now, he thought he had been exposed, so he didn’t pull off any act.
unit.target: Ex somnio nuper, putavit se detectum esse, ergo nihil simulavit.

unit.source: Gandalf, the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, was taken aback and let out a deep chuckle.
unit.target: Gandalf, praeses Societatis de Simiis Crispatis, obstupuit et profundum risum edidit.

unit.source: “You’re really fake.”
unit.target: “Vere falso es.”

unit.source: H-he’s not sure of my identity? Bard was taken aback, wishing he could slap himself.
unit.target: “Nonne certus est de identitate mea?” Bard obstupuit, sperans se ipsum verberari posse.

unit.source: Inside the underwater spaceship, in a metallic room reminiscent of a beehive.
unit.target: Intra navem subaquaticam spatialis, in conclavi metallico, quod ad alvearium similitudinem habet.

unit.source: Having failed to capture Mad Lady twice in a row, Mr. K’s body underwent a sudden transformation, expanding to nearly three meters in height.
unit.target: Bis continuatum Mad Lady capere defessus, corpus Domini K subito mutatum est, ad paene tres metra altitudinis expandens.

unit.source: Fortunately, he wasn’t adorned in actual clothes. The blood-colored cloak draped over him had morphed from his flesh and blood. Otherwise, even the loose robe would have succumbed to the drastic change.
unit.target: Fortunate, non veris vestimentis indutus erat. Pallium sanguine tinctum, super eum drapatum, ex carne et sanguine eius ortum est. Aliter, etiam laxa tunica mutationi drasticae succumbisset.

unit.source: Concurrently, Mr. K’s skin darkened, assuming the appearance of thick and formidable armor. Crooked goat horns adorned with sinister patterns sprouted from his head, and a pair of bat-like wings, encircled in crimson and blue flames, emerged from his back.
unit.target: Simul, cutis Domini K obscurata est, vestigia armorum spissorum et formidabilium assumens. Cornua caprina angusta, insignibus sinistris ornata, ex capite eius orta sunt, et par alarum vespertilionum, in flammas rubras et caeruleas circumdatus, ex dorso eius eminuit.

unit.source: A pungent smell of sulfur hung in the air.
unit.target: Odor sulphuris acer in aere pendebat.

unit.source: Being a Sequence 5 Shepherd of the Secrets Suppliant pathway, Mr. K possessed the core ability of Grazing.
unit.target: Ut Pastor Sequens V in via Secretorum Supplicantium, Dominus K facultatem centralem pascendi habebat.

unit.source: This allowed him to fuse other people’s souls with Beyonder characteristics or boon powers and utilize them uniquely.
unit.target: Hoc ei permittebat animas aliorum cum proprietatibus Beyonder seu potentia beneficii coniungere atque singillatim uti.

unit.source: It was akin to grazing lambs for a deity.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat pascere agnos pro deo.

unit.source: Each Shepherd could graze up to seven souls, controlling only one at a time.
unit.target: Quisque Pastor ad septem animas pascere poterat, uno tempore solum regens.

unit.source: In this state, Shepherds could employ their Beyonder abilities and three abilities corresponding to the souls.
unit.target: In hoc statu, Pastores facultates Beyonder atque tres facultates, quae animis respondent, adhibere poterant.

unit.source: These were chosen during Grazing and remained fixed thereafter.
unit.target: Hae in tempore pascendi delectae sunt et postea constabant.

unit.source: The most formidable aspect of Shepherds was their ability to Graze demigod-level spirits, enabling them to contend with Saints for a limited duration.
unit.target: Maxima pars pastorum erat facultas spiritus semideorum pascendi, quae eos ad certamen cum sanctis per tempus limitatum provocare licuit.

unit.source: Presently, Mr. K was using a Grazed Devil. He had selected Devil Transformation, Sulphur Fireball, and Sword of Lava in the past.
unit.target: Nunc, Domini K Diabolum pascit, et antea electum habuit: Transformationem Diaboli, Sphaeram Ignis Sulphurei, et Gladium Lavæ.

unit.source: Mr. K deliberately chose to forgo Devil’s most distinctive Danger Premonition because he believed it to be effective only when commanding the Devil’s spirit.
unit.target: Dominus K conscio elegit relinquere praenotitiam maximi periculi Diaboli, quod credebat eam solum efficacem esse cum Diaboli spiritu imperaret.

unit.source: Under normal circumstances, he couldn’t activate Grazing continuously.
unit.target: Sub condicionibus ordinariis, pascendo continue activare non poterat.

unit.source: In any case, if grave danger loomed, a divine revelation would be provided by God.
unit.target: Quocumque consitu, si gravis periculum immineret, revelatio divina ab Deo praebenda esset.

unit.source: Failure to receive such guidance indicated wrongdoing, warranting divine punishment.
unit.target: Defectus huius ductus accipere malum indicabat, quod poena divina postularetur.

unit.source: As the expansive bat wings on Mr. K’s back unfolded, light-blue fireballs condensed, numbering almost twenty.
unit.target: Dum alae vespertilionum in dorso Domini K evolutae sunt, globuli ignis caerulei lenis condensati sunt, fere viginti numerabantur.

unit.source: They indiscriminately bombarded every corner of the metallic beehive, creating an all-encompassing barrage to counter Mad Lady’s elusive “flashes” throughout the space.
unit.target: Omnem angulum alvearii metallici sine discrimine oppresserunt, efformantes universum impetum ad repellendas fulgurationes elusorias Mad Lady per spatium.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble!

unit.source: The explosion, a mix of fire and poison, wreaked havoc on the metallic hive, tearing apart the incubating Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other creatures.
unit.target: Explosio, mixtura ignis et veneni, in alvearium metallicum vastitatem attulit, dilanians Batings Black Insect, Diaboli Parvi, et alias creaturas.

unit.source: Mad Lady abruptly halted as the Sulfur Fireball condensed.
unit.target: Mad Lady subito sistit, dum sphaera ignis sulphurei condensabatur.

unit.source: Cloaked in a blood-colored dress, with grotesque flesh lumps on her face, an illusory, slowly flipping book materialized in her eyes. Faint recitations echoed around her.
unit.target: Vestis sanguine tincta induta, cum scelerosis carnis nodis in facie, liber illusorius lente volvens in oculis eius apparuit; recitationes leves circa eam resonaverunt.

unit.source: Drawing a dagger, she genuflected and drove it into the metal floor of the hive.
unit.target: Pugio sumens, genu flectens in pavimentum metallicum alvearii immergit.

unit.source: Dawn-like light ascended, forming an almost invisible wall around her.
unit.target: Lumen aurorale ascendit, formans parietem paene invisibilem circa eam.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble!

unit.source: The shockwaves from the Sulfur Fireball’s explosion and the poisonous pale-blue fireball relentlessly struck the invisible barrier, causing it to sway, yet it stood resilient.
unit.target: Undae ictuum ex explosione sphaerae ignis sulphurei et sphaerae ignis pallide caeruleae venenosae percutiebant parietem invisibilem, eam oscillare facientes, sed quidem firmiter stabat.

unit.source: This was Protection of a Warrior Sequence 5.
unit.target: Hoc erat Munimen Bellatoris Sequens V.

unit.source: Record, the core ability of a Sequence 6 Scribe of the Apprentice pathway, allowed the “recording” of others’ abilities for use, each recording usable only once.
unit.target: Recordum, facultas centralis Scriptoris Sequens VI in via Discipulorum, licebat aliorum facultates ad usum “recordari,” quarum unusquisque semel tantum adhiberi poterat.

unit.source: Scribes could even record Beyonder powers with godhood effects, but the success rate was minimal.
unit.target: Scriptoribus etiam potestates Beyonder cum effectibus deitatis recordari poterant, sed successus eorum minimus erat.

unit.source: After the explosion’s aftershocks subsided, Mr. K, donned in a blood-colored cloak and resembling a colossal Devil, wielded a broadsword composed of crimson lava and pale-blue flames. He surged towards Mad Lady in two steps, slashing down.
unit.target: Postquam remotae post explosionem tremores cessaverunt, Dominus K, indutus pallio sanguine tincto et ingenti diablo similis, gladium latum ex lava rubra ac flammis caeruleis pallidisque confectum portavit. Duobus passibus versus Mad Lady impetum fecit, caedens.

unit.source: The nearly invisible wall around Mad Lady couldn’t withstand the onslaught and finally shattered. As the illusory book in her eyes flipped, a robust and sharp Sword of Dawn materialized in her hand.
unit.target: Paries paene invisibilis circa Mad Lady impetum sustinere non potuit et denique confractus est. Dum liber illusorius in oculis eius volvens videbatur, in manu eius gladius Aurorae robustus ac acutus apparuit.

unit.source: Excitedly, she swung her two-handed light sword.
unit.target: Exsultans gladium levem duobus manibus tenens concussit.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: Mr. K’s strike sent Mad Lady, lacking a Warrior’s physique and strength, flying.
unit.target: Percussio Domini K Mad Lady volitare coegit, quae corporis et virium bellatoris caret.

unit.source: Though Mr. K hadn’t anticipated her determination to engage in close combat despite her limitations, the battle’s tempo remained unaffected. He advanced, wielding the lava broadsword once again.
unit.target: Quamquam Dominus K non antevidebat eius propositum in certamine prope aggrediendi, momentum belli constare remanebat. Progrediebatur, gladium lavæ latum iterum gerens.

unit.source: Poof! The Mad Lady he struck suddenly thinned, transforming into a paper figurine consumed by sulfurous flames.
unit.target: Poof! Mad Lady, a qua percussus est, subito tenuata, in figuram papyraceam in igne sulphureo consumpta convertit.

unit.source: Paper Figurine Substitutes!
unit.target: Substitutiones Figuræ Papyraceæ!

unit.source: Mad Lady reappeared beside a demolished metal hive, her illusory book flipping once more.
unit.target: Mad Lady iuxta alvearium metallicum destructum iterum apparuit, liber illusorius ejus iterum volvens.

unit.source: She then stretched her arms, allowing a pure and magnificent blazing pillar of light to descend from the sky and strike Mr. K, who had attacked the paper effigy.
unit.target: Deinde brachia protendit, permittebat columna pura et praeclara luminis ardentis de caelo descendere et Dominum K percussum, qui papyraceam effigiem aggressus erat, percutere.

unit.source: Priest of Light’s Light of Holiness!
unit.target: Sacerdos Lucis: Lux Sanctitatis!

unit.source: 588 Degree of Madness
unit.target: 588 Gradus Insaniae

unit.source: 588 Degree of Madness
unit.target: 588 Gradus Insaniae

unit.source: Mr. K shifted instantaneously, tapping into the Grazed Traveler’s soul.
unit.target: Mr. K statim se mutavit, animam Viatoris Pasciti attigens.

unit.source: His eyes took on an otherworldly glow, as if concealing doors to different realms.
unit.target: Oculi eius luce aliena micaverunt, quasi ostia ad alia regna celarent.

unit.source: His form faded, and in an instant, a luminous white column surrounded by flames emerged, shrouding him within its fiery embrace.
unit.target: Forma eius evanuit, et in uno momento, columna alba fulgente, flammas circumdata, apparuit, eum in igneo amplexu tegens.

unit.source: In the ensuing moment, Mr. K, stripped of his Devil guise, materialized in a corner of the metallic beehive.
unit.target: In momento sequente, Mr. K, veste Diaboli depulsa, in angulo alvearii metallici apparuit.

unit.source: His form liquefied, his flesh resembling dripping candle wax.
unit.target: Forma eius liquefacta est, et caro eius quasi cera candelae stillans videbatur.

unit.source: The Secrets Suppliant pathway symbolized corruption, its influence curtailed by the Sun pathway’s capabilities.
unit.target: Iter Secretorum Supplicantis corruptionem significabat, cuius potentia a facultatibus itineris Solis coartata erat.

unit.source: Half-melted flesh and blood cascaded onto the metal floor, seeping into it in a bizarre manner.
unit.target: Caro semi-liquefacta et sanguis in pavimentum metallicum ceciderunt, modo insolito in eum infiltrantes.

unit.source: Soon, it was absorbed by the spaceship Mad Lady had earlier detailed.
unit.target: Mox id ab nave siderali, quam Mad Lady antea descripserat, absorptum est.

unit.source: Even Mr. K felt the weight of an unseen force, as if an invisible hand pressed him down.
unit.target: Etiam Mr. K pondus vis invisibilis sensit, quasi manus invisibilis eum premeret.

unit.source: His attempts to extricate himself from the metallic floor proved futile, and he continued sinking gradually.
unit.target: Conatus eius ex pavimento metallico se liberandi frustra erant, atque paulatim demergi continuavit.

unit.source: Mad Lady, with grayish-green eyes gleaming, teleported near Mr. K.
unit.target: Mad Lady, oculis cinereo-viridibus fulgentibus, se prope Mr. K translocavit.

unit.source: Despite his blood-colored wax-drenched visage, Mr. K faced Mad Lady without a trace of fear.
unit.target: Non obstante vultu eius, qui cera sanguine tinctus apparuerat, Mr. K Mad Lady sine ullo timore opposuit.

unit.source: His focus remained fixed on the evil god’s aura emanating from the metal hive—his ultimate target.
unit.target: Attentio eius manebat ad aurem dei maligni, quae ex alveo metallico efferebatur—quod propositum ultimum eius erat.

unit.source: He switched the Grazed soul to an Arbiter pathway Beyonder, with two bolts of lightning gathering in the depths of his darkened eyes.
unit.target: Animam “Grazed” ad iter Arbiter Beyonder convertit, cum duo fulmina in profundo oculorum eius obscurorum congregata essent.

unit.source: Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Perforatio Mentis!

unit.source: Mad Lady refrained from teleporting.
unit.target: Mad Lady se non translocavit.

unit.source: The illusory book within her eyes flipped open, revealing the kaleidoscope of colors on Mr. K’s body and the shifting hues of light during his Grazed soul transitions.
unit.target: Liber illusorius in oculis eius aperuit, revelans kaleidoscopium colorum in corpore Mr. K et mutabiles lucis tintae in transmutationibus animae “Grazed.”

unit.source: Excitement illuminated Mad Lady’s face.
unit.target: Excitatio faciem Mad Lady illustravit.

unit.source: Raising her right hand, she prepared to delicately twist it clockwise.
unit.target: Manu dextra elevata, parata est eam leniter in gyrum dextrum torquere.

unit.source: Steal!
unit.target: Furare!

unit.source: This was an ability she had Recorded from Bard.
unit.target: Haec erat facultas, quam ex Bard didicerat.

unit.source: A sudden, intriguing notion captivated Mad Lady’s thoughts—she yearned to witness the aftermath of stealing the Grazing ability from a Shepherd.
unit.target: Subito, notio intrigans cogitationes Mad Lady ceperat—desiderabat videre consequentias furtum facultatis “Grazing” a Pastore.

unit.source: It was crucial to understand that her Steal ability was limited to just one from a target, devoid of any connections to the abilities that came with it.
unit.target: Maxime oportet intellegere facultatem eius furtandi ad unam tantum rem pertinere, sine ullis nexus ad facultates quae cum ea veniebant.

unit.source: In essence, after snatching the Grazing ability, the soul, characteristics, and powers under Grazing’s influence would persist within Mr. K’s body.
unit.target: Essentialiter, post facultatem “Grazing” rapuendam, anima, virtutes et proprietates eius in corpore Mr. K permanere debebant.

unit.source: In this state, Mad Lady pondered whether Shepherds would grapple with internal conflicts, the fusion of characteristics, or a loss of control akin to the switching between non‐adjacent pathways.
unit.target: In hoc statu, Mad Lady quaerebat num Pastores internis contentionibus, mixtione proprietatum, aut detrimento imperii, similis commutationi inter vias non contiguas laborarent.

unit.source: Excitement bubbled within Mad Lady as she deliberately Blinked near Mr. K, compelling him to switch Grazed souls.
unit.target: Excitatio intra Mad Lady efferebatur, dum illa deliberato ictu “blink” se prope Mr. K transposuit, eum compellens ut animas “Grazed” commutaret.

unit.source: She observed keenly, eager to discern which light aligned with Grazing.
unit.target: Ipsa diligenter contemplavit, desiderans discernere quam lucem cum “Grazing” congrueret.

unit.source: As for Mr. K’s reaction, she cared little.
unit.target: Quantum ad reactionem Mr. K, illa parum curabat.

unit.source: "You continue your fight; I continue my steal. Whoever dies first loses!"
unit.target: "Tu pugnam tuam pergas; ego furtum meum pergo. Qui primum moriatur, perit!"

unit.source: Simultaneously, the metal floor, saturated with Mr. K’s flesh, quivered unexpectedly.
unit.target: Simul, planum metallicum, Mr. K carne impregnatum, inopinato tremuit.

unit.source: A previously concealed door within the metal hive withdrew, unveiling a passageway that hinted at a silver metallic hall beyond.
unit.target: Porta, antea in alveo metallico abscondita, se recepit, detegens iter quod ad aulam metallicam argenteam ultra spectabat.

unit.source: A formidable suction force emanated from that direction.
unit.target: Vis fortis attractionis ex illa regione emansit.

unit.source: While her attempt to steal Mr. K’s Grazing ability was underway, Mad Lady—lacking the strength—was propelled into the air.
unit.target: Dum eius conatus ad furtum facultatis “Grazing” Mr. K procedebat, Mad Lady—vi carens—in caelum impellita est.

unit.source: Dark-blond hair whipped around wildly as she soared toward the origin of the anomaly.
unit.target: Capilli obscuro-flavi, furibunde circumvolitantes, dum illa ad originem anomaliae volitabat.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Mr. K remained “locked” to the metal floor.
unit.target: Interim, Mr. K in pavimento metallico “clausus” mansit.

unit.source: Though his body swayed precariously, on the verge of being pulled away, he held his ground, unsteady yet resilient.
unit.target: Quamquam corpus eius periculum circumtrebat, prope eripiendum, sed in loco suo manebat, vacillans sed constans.

unit.source: The face of the blood-colored wax-streaked Aurora Order Oracle betrayed an anxious expression.
unit.target: Vultus oraculi Ordinationis Aurorae, cera sanguine tincta, anxietatem prodidit.

unit.source: The enemy was on the verge of escape!
unit.target: Hostis fere effugiens erat!

unit.source: The source of the evil god corruption had revealed itself!
unit.target: Fons corruptionis dei mali se manifesta erat!

unit.source: Mr. K swiftly switched back to the corresponding Devil spirit, summoning a broadsword forged from crimson lava and pale-blue flames.
unit.target: Mr. K celeriter ad spiritum Diaboli aptum rediit, invocans gladium latum ex lava rubra et flammarum caeruleis pallidis confectum.

unit.source: Targeting his body adhered to the metal floor, he executed a slashing motion.
unit.target: In corpore, quod ad pavimentum metallico adnexus erat, motum secandi exercuit.

unit.source: Beneath his calf, flesh promptly separated from his main body, the incision undergoing a mesmerizing melding of half-melting and half-reforming.
unit.target: Sub crus eius, caro celeriter a corpore principali discrepat, incisione quae mixtionem quasi mediarum liquefactionis et reformationis subibat.

unit.source: Having relinquished a portion of his flesh, Mr. K allowed pale-white, moist, and freshly-formed limbs to squirm out from the severed stump.
unit.target: Dimittens partem carnis suae, Mr. K permisit membris pallide albis, humidis, ac recens formatis ex ramo secato emergere.

unit.source: Concurrently, he harnessed the formidable suction force to pursue Mad Lady and draw closer to the source of corruption.
unit.target: Simul, vim attractionis formidabilis ad usum correxit, ut Mad Lady insecutus esset atque ad fontem corruptionis propius accederet.

unit.source: In midair, he witnessed Lumian, disguised, clutching the door frame in a struggle against the menacing suction.
unit.target: In medio aere, perspexit Lumianum, late indutum, qui limam ostii retinebat in certamine adversus vim attrahentem minam.

unit.source: He observed the motionless silver‑white full‑body armor seamlessly blending with the floor.
unit.target: Observavit loricam totam argentino-albem, immobiliter, quam pavimento leniter coniunctam esse.

unit.source: Mad Lady surged ahead, on the verge of “flying” past Lumian.
unit.target: Mad Lady praepropulsa est, paene volitans praeter Lumian.

unit.source: With a wave of her right hand, she emitted a greeting‑like “hello”, her face radiating excitement and anticipation.
unit.target: Dextra manu fluctuantem, edidit quasi salutem “salve”, faciem eius ex excitatione et expectatione fulgentem ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian’s pupils constricted.
unit.target: Pupillae Lumiani contractae sunt.

unit.source: Disregarding his precarious state, he harrumphed.
unit.target: Non curans statu incerto, fremivit.

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot forth from his nostrils, accurately aimed at Mad Lady but influenced by the tangible and enigmatic suction force.
unit.target: Duo radios lucis albae ex naribus eius emiserunt, rite ad Mad Lady intunti, sed vis attractionis tangibilis atque arcana eos affluente.

unit.source: They bent and “plunged” deeper into the tunnel.
unit.target: Ipsi flecti sunt et in tunellum profundius descendebant.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian’s grip on the silver metal door frame neared its breaking point, blood seeping from the strain.
unit.target: In illo momento, tenentia Lumiani in limam ostii metallici argentei fere ad exitium accessit, et sanguis ex labore stillabat.

unit.source: Faintly, he sensed an abundance of flesh and skin deep within the tunnel, intertwining to shape a colossal structure resembling a pear‑shaped bird’s nest.
unit.target: Leviter sensit multitudinem carnis et cutis in profundo tunelli, quae se intertexebant ut formam ingentis structurae, quasi nidus avis pera figurae, concipi.

unit.source: Suspended in midair, fleshy ropes, as thick as two or three adult arms and covered in a translucent membrane, extended, linking the distant wall, the ceiling above, and the metal on the ground.
unit.target: Suspendi in medio aere, funes carnosi, tam crassi quam duo vel tres brachia adultorum, membrana translucida operti, se extendebant, parietem remotum, laquearium superiorem, et metallum in terra ligantes.

unit.source: Within these flesh and blood tendrils, specks of starlight and a mysterious dark substance flowed into the massive pear‑shaped object.
unit.target: In his tendrillis carnis et sanguinis, micellae lucis stellarum et substantia obscura arcana in ingens obiectum, forma pera simile, fluere coeperunt.

unit.source: The bird’s nest‑like structure was contracting inward, its various parts deeply sunken, delineating lines that hinted at a substantial disk.
unit.target: Structura, similis nido avium, in se compingebatur, partes variae alte deiectae, lineas formantes, quae ad discum robustum insinuabant.

unit.source: The terrifying suction force, capable of manipulating both reality and mystery, emanated from this pear‑shaped object composed of skin, flesh, and blood.
unit.target: Atrox vis aspirationis, quae et rem ac et arcanum regere posset, ex hoc obiecto formae pera, a cute, carne et sanguine confecto, emanasit.

unit.source: At that moment, the outlines on the pear‑shaped object quivered, and all the indentations bulged and expanded.
unit.target: Id momento, contorni in obiecto formae pera tremuerunt, et omnes cavitates dilatatae atque expansae sunt.

unit.source: With this transformation, fragments of starlight spilled from the fleshy bird’s nest, rushing into every cabin within the spaceship.
unit.target: Hoc mutatione, fragmenta lucis stellarum ex nido carnoso avium effusa sunt, ad omnes compartimenta intra navem sideralem festinanter descendentes.

unit.source: This event resembled the prior two releases of the sea’s power, yet lacked the grandeur and vastness, lacking the potential to rend apart anyone obstructing its path.
unit.target: Hoc eventum priorem duorum emissionum potentiae maris simile erat, sed maiestatem atque immensitatem defuit, nec habuit facultatem quemlibet iter obstare discindendi.

unit.source: Lumian could already envision the repetitive expulsion, understanding that the silver‑gray behemoth had amassed a power capable of threatening the seal.
unit.target: Lumian iam repetitam expulsionem praevidere poterat, intellectus quod ingens titulus argenteo-cinereus potestatem congregaverat, qua sigillum minari posset.

unit.source: Year after year, it required the extraction of this accumulated pressure.
unit.target: Anno post annum, haec pressio congregata extrahenda erat.

unit.source: As the abundance of starlight scattered, the formidable suction force dissipated.
unit.target: Sicut abundantia lucis stellarum dispersa est, vis suctionis formidabilis evanuit.

unit.source: With two thuds, Mad Lady and Mr. K collided with the ground.
unit.target: Duobus ictibus, Mad Lady et Mr. K cum terra colliserunt.

unit.source: One found herself in the tunnel leading to the fleshy “bird’s nest,” while the other lay in the silver hall where Lumian and Ultraman had previously battled.
unit.target: Una ipsa se invenit in tunello, qui ad nidum carnosi “avianum” ducebat, dum altera in aula argentea iacebat, ubi Lumian et Ultraman olim pugnaverant.

unit.source: Lumian released his grip, landing on the ground.
unit.target: Lumian emisit tenentiam, et in terram cecidit.

unit.source: His gaze swiftly fixated on the April Fool’s key member, adorned with clumps of flesh and blood on her face.
unit.target: Oculus eius celeriter surrexit ad membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum, quod facie agglutinata carne et sanguine ornatum erat.

unit.source: Mad Lady sprang up, exclaiming to him and Mr. K, “Did you see that? Did you see that? That’s an incubating deity. Yes, it should be a deity!”
unit.target: Mad Lady surrexit et ad eum atque Mr. K exclamavit: “Vidistisne id? Vidistisne id? Illa deitas incipientis est. Etiam, deitas esse debet!”

unit.source: Despite the intense fluctuations in Mad Lady’s emotions, Mr. K discerned no sincerity in her tone.
unit.target: Non obstante affectuum fluctuationibus intensis in Mad Lady, Mr. K ullam sinceritatem in eius voce deprehendit.

unit.source: Her mention of “deity” sounded more like “powerful and terrifying monster,” a mere description.
unit.target: Eius meminisse de “deitate” magis audiebatur ut “monstrum potentissimum et terribile,” simpliciter descriptum.

unit.source: In the next instant, Lumian materialized behind Mad Lady, who promptly vanished on the spot, “Blinking” closer to where the starlight had scattered.
unit.target: In proximo momento, Lumian post Mad Lady apparuit, quae statim in loco evanuit, translata propius ad locum ubi lux stellarum dispersa erat.

unit.source: Lumian, sensing danger instinctively, felt his heart quicken involuntarily.
unit.target: Lumian, per instinctum periculum sentiens, cor suum involuntario celeriter pulsare sensit.

unit.source: He hesitated to delve too deeply into the tunnel, avoiding proximity to the flesh and blood “bird’s nest” he had vaguely “seen” before.
unit.target: Lumian dubitavit, vere appropinquare “nido” carne et sanguine constituto in profundo tunelli non volens.

unit.source: Unimaginable horrors were certain to unfold.
unit.target: Horrores incredibiles certissime evenire debebant.

unit.source: However, Mad Lady sprinted in that direction.
unit.target: At Mad Lady in illam partem citissime cucurrit.

unit.source: Let her venture deeper and potentially meet her end?
unit.target: Liceretne illam ulterius proficisci atque fortasse mortem pati?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced, torn between decisions.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinanter vehuntur, inter decisiones divisae.

unit.source: Another second passed, and Mr. K teleported in front of Lumian, fervently pursuing Mad Lady.
unit.target: Altera secunda pertransiit, et Mr. K ante Lumian se teleportavit, ardenter Mad Lady insecutus.

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian, who had often considered himself a bit eccentric, found himself yearning for a bit more normalcy from the duo ahead of him.
unit.target: In eo momento, Lumian, qui se saepe aliquantulum eccentricum censuerat, invenerat se desiderare paulo maiorem normalitatem ab illis duobus ante se.

unit.source: While he could comprehend Mr. K’s choices and actions—rooted in unwavering faith in God and the pursuit of divine will, coupled with a hint of extremism—Mad Lady’s conduct exceeded his expectations.
unit.target: Dum intellectum habere poterat de electionibus et officiis Mr. K, fundatis in fide in Deum perpetua et in studio voluntatis divinae, addito aliquo signo extremismi, agendi ratio Mad Lady exspectationes eius superabat.

unit.source: Drawing from I Know Someone’s confession and Mad Lady’s previous behavior, Lumian detected no signs of her fanatical devotion to the Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Ex confessione “I Know Someone” et ex praeteritis actis Mad Lady, Lumian nullos vestigia devotio fanaticam ad Celestial Worthy deprehendit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, due to the ongoing conflict between the Celestial Worthy and Mr. Fool, she couldn’t always rely on protection.
unit.target: Simul, ob contentiones inter Celestial Worthy et Mr. Fool, illa non semper in tutela inniti potuit.

unit.source: This raised a question for Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc quaestionem Lumiani excitavit.

unit.source: If Mad Lady consistently courted danger, how had she managed to survive to this day?
unit.target: Si Mad Lady constanter periculum coniungeret, quomodo usque ad hanc diem superfuerit?

unit.source: April Fool’s lacked the strict hierarchy and coordination seen in the Aurora Order.
unit.target: April Fool’s caret stricta hierarchia et coordinatione, ut in Ordine Aurorae observabatur.

unit.source: Most of the time, members operated independently with minimal interaction.
unit.target: Plurimis temporibus, membra independentissime agebant, minimo commercio inter se.

unit.source: Protecting Mad Lady from the start, allowing her to grow steadily with such a mindset, seemed implausible.
unit.target: A principio Mad Lady protegi, ut cum tali animo constanter cresceret, videbatur inverisimile.

unit.source: Could it be that I Know Someone had once overseen the treatment of Mad Lady’s mental and psychological issues?
unit.target: Numquid fieri potuit ut I Know Someone olim moderaret curationem quaestionum mentis et psychologiae Mad Lady?

unit.source: After his demise, did Mad Lady’s problems exacerbate?
unit.target: Post eorum interitum, num problemata Mad Lady exacerbabantur?

unit.source: Lumian quickly formulated a plausible explanation, but considering Mad Lady’s conduct on the betrothal ship, her current state struck him as abnormal.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter rationem plausibilem elocutus est, sed de actu Mad Lady in nave nuptiali commemorata, status eius ei insolitus videbatur.

unit.source: On the betrothal ship, faced with the impending release of the sea’s power in the energy passageway, Mad Lady, though eager and seeking excitement, had an escape route.
unit.target: In nave nuptiali, cum imminentis emissionis potentia maris in via energiae adversaretur, Mad Lady, licet excitata et studens novitatem, viam effugii habebat.

unit.source: As long as she didn’t delay until the last moment, she could teleport away, avoiding the actual risk of death.
unit.target: Dum usque ad extremum tempus non moraretur, se teletranslata poterat, periculum mortalitatis verum evitans.

unit.source: Now, whatever lurked in the depths of the tunnel made Lumian, despite his feigned high level, intuitively uneasy.
unit.target: Nunc, quidquid in profundo tunelli latuit, Lumian, licet altum se praetendens, sensu intuitivo inquietum habebat.

unit.source: He believed it represented an almost certain death sentence.
unit.target: Credidit id fere sententiam mortis certissimam repraesentare.

unit.source: Yet, Mad Lady persisted in her attempt to approach!
unit.target: Tamen Mad Lady conatu accessus perseveravit!

unit.source: Could there be a reason compelling her to make contact with that object?
unit.target: Num ratione sit quae eam ad hoc obiectum contingendum impellat?

unit.source: Lumian wondered.
unit.target: Lumian miratus est.

unit.source: He suspected that Mad Lady’s actions might be part of the Celestial Worthy’s scheme, convincing her that she could confront the provocation head‑on and escape in time.
unit.target: Suspicabatur acta Mad Lady fortasse partem consilii Celestial Worthy constituere, quae eam persuasit se provocationi directe opponere atque tempore effugere posse.

unit.source: I can’t let her and that Celestial Worthy succeed…
unit.target: Non possum sinere eam atque illum Celestial Worthy succedere…

unit.source: Besides, personally, I look forward to ending her myself rather than witnessing her being swallowed by that dangerous object…
unit.target: Praeterea, personaliter, exspecto ut eam ipse finiam potius quam videam eam ab illo periculoso obiecto devorari…

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed, the desire to teleport forward and intercept Mad Lady compelling him.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani contracti sunt, cupiditate se teletranslata et Mad Lady intercipienda impulsus.

unit.source: However, preventing a Traveler from reaching a specific location in such a manner was clearly impossible.
unit.target: Attamen, vitare Viatorem ad locum certum per hunc modum pervenire manifeste impossibile erat.

unit.source: Lumian hesitated, unwilling to genuinely approach the flesh‑and‑blood “bird’s nest” deep within the tunnel.
unit.target: Lumian dubitavit, vere appropinquare “nido” carne et sanguine constituto in profundo tunelli non volens.

unit.source: Suddenly, an idea struck him.
unit.target: Subito, idea eum percussit.

unit.source: The peculiar structure’s rejection of outsiders seems to have lifted, and with Lato Guiaro, a person possessing a potent sea bloodline, deceased.
unit.target: Reiectio exterorum a singulari structura videtur evanuisse, et Lato Guiaro, persona potentem sanguinem maris possidens, defunctus est.

unit.source: Could I attempt to gain temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea to halt Mad Lady’s progress?
unit.target: Possumne conari ut auctoritatem temporariam obtineam ut Praefectus Maris ad progressum Mad Lady coercendum?

unit.source: With that in mind, Lumian embarked on his endeavor.
unit.target: Hoc mente habens, Lumian in suum conatum profectus est.

unit.source: Activating the power of the sea within him, he allowed his Astral Projection to merge and swiftly expand outward.
unit.target: Potentiam maris in se excitans, permisit projectionem astralem suam coniungi et celeriter exterius expandi.

unit.source: 589 Object Within the Nest
unit.target: 589 Res in Nido

unit.source: 589 Object Within the Nest
unit.target: 589 Res in Nido

unit.source: As Lumian’s Astral Projection expanded with the power of the sea, he immediately sensed the presence of the “waters.”
unit.target: Cum proiectio astralis Luminiani cum potentia maris expandebatur, statim praesentiam “aquarum” sensit.

unit.source: This wasn’t a genuine ocean but a fantastical sea created by radiant starlight.
unit.target: Non erat oceanus verus, sed mare phantasticum a radiante luce stellarum creatum.

unit.source: At its core lay the projection of the silver-gray behemoth.
unit.target: In medio eius iacebat proiectio ingentis bestiae cinereo‑argenteae.

unit.source: Empowered by an ample supply of the sea’s power, Lumian’s Astral Projection surged forward, merging seamlessly with the phantom.
unit.target: Virtute maris copiosae ditata, proiectio astralis Luminiani impetum fecit, cum phantasma perfecte coalescens.

unit.source: A burning sensation radiated from the left side of his chest, as if some form of acknowledgment had been received.
unit.target: Sensatio ardens ex parte sinistra pectoris eius emanabat, quasi aliqua forma agnitionis accepisset.

unit.source: His consciousness extended boundlessly, taking command of the dreamlike illusory sea.
unit.target: Conscientia eius sine fine extendebatur, imperium capiens in mari somniorum illusorio.

unit.source: In the course of this process, he glimpsed the phantoms of Juan Oro, Ultraman Lato Guiaro, and unfamiliar apparitions.
unit.target: In hoc processu perspexit phantasmata Juan Oro, Ultraman Lato Guiaro, atque apparitiones ignotas.

unit.source: Those who have returned to the sea?
unit.target: Qui ad mare redierunt?

unit.source: They seem to have transformed into water droplets in the sea…
unit.target: Videbantur quasi guttae aquae in mari conversa.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his gaze from the joyful Juan Oro and the pained Lato Guiaro, redirecting it toward the depths of the tunnel ahead.
unit.target: Lumian conspectum suum a laeto Juan Oro et dolenti Lato Guiaro abstulit, eumque versus profunda tunelis prae oculis direxit.

unit.source: From a considerable distance, he spotted Mad Lady.
unit.target: Ex longinquo, Mad Lady conspexit.

unit.source: The silver-gray behemoth harbored entities nurtured within the flesh and blood “bird’s nest.”
unit.target: Bestia cinereo‑argentea complexa entia gerebat, quae in nidore carnis et sanguinis nutrita erant.

unit.source: With the Batings Black Insect, Little Devils, and other extraterrestrial life forms, it was inevitable that they coexisted in the spirit world.
unit.target: Cum Batings Black Insect, Parvis Diabolis, et aliis formis vitae extraterrestris, inevitabile erat eos in mundo spirituum coesse.

unit.source: However, this spirit world was entirely severed from the external realm.
unit.target: Sed hic mundus spirituum omnino a regione externa separatus erat.

unit.source: Consequently, Beyonders skilled in summoning creatures from the spirit world for assistance found themselves bereft of their primary reliance.
unit.target: Itaque Beyonders, qui in evocando creaturas ex mundo spirituum ad auxilium periti erant, suam principalem fiduciam amisere.

unit.source: Teleportation executed through the spirit world, however, retained some semblance of normalcy.
unit.target: Translocatio per mundum spirituum, tamen, aliquam normalitatis speciem retinebat.

unit.source: Departing directly, however, proved impossible.
unit.target: Sed directe discedere impossibile erat.

unit.source: The only avenues were through the energy passageway at the entrance or by breaching the outer wall to connect the inner and outer spirit worlds.
unit.target: Unica via erant per viam energiae ad introitum, aut per ruinationem parietis exterioris ad coniungendum mundos spirituum internum et externum.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the closer one approached the flesh-and-blood “bird’s nest,” the more peculiar the spirit world became.
unit.target: Simul, quanto propius quis ad nidum carnis et sanguinis accedebat, tanto mirabilius mundus spirituum fiebat.

unit.source: It was as though the air gradually thickened, becoming almost tangible and impeding the approach of “birds.”
unit.target: Veluti si aer paulatim densaret, fere tangibilis fieret ac accessum “avium” impedit.

unit.source: In such an environment, coupled with the absence of a flesh-and-blood “bird’s nest,” Mad Lady found herself unable to teleport directly.
unit.target: In tali ambitu, cum absens esset nido carnis et sanguinis, Mad Lady directe se translocare non potuit.

unit.source: Her only recourse was to Blink incrementally, expending her spirituality with each maneuver.
unit.target: Unicum eius remedium fuit paulatim “Blink” facere, spiritualitatem suam singulis motibus expendens.

unit.source: Having focused on Mad Lady and the space in front of her, Lumian suddenly extended his right hand and clenched it into a fist.
unit.target: Cum Mad Lady et spatium ante eam intenderit, Lumian subito dextram manum protulit et in pugnaculum contraxit.

unit.source: The air surrounding Mad Lady immediately grew dense, as if assuming a tangible form.
unit.target: Aer circum Mad Lady statim densatus est, quasi forma tangibilis assumeretur.

unit.source: This transformation caused the illusory curtain to bend, compressing the corresponding area into a dark and transparent sphere.
unit.target: Haec transformatio velam illusorium flectere provocavit, regionem congruentem in sphaeram obscuram atque transparentem comprimendo efficiebat.

unit.source: Once more, Mad Lady’s form disappeared, but a formless force, shaped by the bending area, yanked her out and sent her plummeting.
unit.target: Iterum forma Mad Lady evanuit, sed vis informis, quae a regione flexa formata erat, eam attulit et deiecit.

unit.source: Under the authority of the Governor of the Sea, the spirit world within the sphere and the spirit world within the silver-gray behemoth were forcibly separated!
unit.target: Sub auctoritate Praefecti Maris, mundus spirituum intra sphaeram et mundus spirituum intra bestiam cinereo‑argenteam coacte separati sunt!

unit.source: However, this effect was contingent on the peculiar environment.
unit.target: Tamen hic effectus ex ambitu peculiario pendebat.

unit.source: In the external world, given Lumian’s current level and mastery of the power of the sea, completely isolating an area from the expansive and genuine spirit world proved challenging.
unit.target: In mundo externo, dato gradu Luminiani et dominio potentiae maris, secernere omnino regionem a vasto et vero mundo spirituum difficillimum apparuit.

unit.source: He could merely employ Cosmic Void to create an exit path and a door symbolizing an escape route, a tactic vulnerable to counteraction by a Traveler’s abilities.
unit.target: Unicum eius remedium erat uti “Cosmic Void” ad viam exitus et ostium repraesentans evasionis iter creandum, consilium autem ab facultatibus viatoris facile oppugnandum.

unit.source: Mad Lady attempted another Blink, yet found herself unable to escape the dark sphere’s confines.
unit.target: Mad Lady alium “Blink” conata est, sed se ex confinibus sphaerae obscurae liberare non potuisse invenit.

unit.source: She halted in place, seriously contemplating her Recorded abilities and the items in her possession that might alleviate her current predicament.
unit.target: In loco cessavit, serio de facultatibus “Recorded” suis atque rebus in sua possessione, quae condicionem eius levare possent, meditans.

unit.source: Observing her struggle, Lumian couldn’t suppress his yearning for demigod‑level powers.
unit.target: Eius luctationem contemplans, Lumian desiderium suum pro facultatibus quasi semideificis reprimere non potuit.

unit.source: As the temporary authority‑wielding Governor of the Sea—essentially a faux demigod incapable of withstanding a single spell from the “Cinderella” demigod—Lumian had ensnared Mad Lady in an inescapable dilemma.
unit.target: Ut gubernator maris temporarius auctoritate praeditus—prorsus quasi falsus demideus, incapax una tantum incantatione demideus “Cinderella” sustinere—Lumian Mad Lady in dilemma ineluctabile incidit.

unit.source: She proved challenging even for Mr. K to subdue in a brief timeframe.
unit.target: Illa etiam pro Mr. K in brevi tempore subducere difficillime videbatur.

unit.source: Mad Lady gazed into the depths of the metal tunnel, representing the flesh and blood “bird’s nest,” her face aglow with unrestrained eagerness, anticipation, and excitement.
unit.target: Mad Lady in profundum tuneli metallici, quod “nidum” carnis et sanguinis repraesentat, aspexit, vultu fulgenti impetu, exspectatione, atque alacrietate.

unit.source: Confined within the dark sphere, she yearned for escape, dissatisfied with her inability to reach the desired destination.
unit.target: Inclusa in sphaera obscura, evasionem desiderabat, indignata sua incapacitate ad metam attingendam.

unit.source: Head over there, quick!
unit.target: Vade illuc, cito!

unit.source: Head over there, quick!
unit.target: Vade illuc, cito!

unit.source: I want to go over!
unit.target: Volo ire illuc!

unit.source: The longing in her heart intensified, nearly manifesting as a tangible desire.
unit.target: Desiderium in corde eius in intensitatem crevit, paene quasi in cupiditatem tangibilem efferens.

unit.source: The desire surged into her chest, seeking to rupture the restraints and liberate her from this predicament.
unit.target: Desiderium in pectore eius irruit, quaerens vincula rumpere atque eam ex hac condicione liberare.

unit.source: Mr. K, having switched to a Traveler’s soul, swiftly caught up and saw Mad Lady.
unit.target: Mr. K, animam viatoris adoptans, celeriter ivit et Mad Lady conspexit.

unit.source: Instinctively, an illusory book materialized in his dark eyes.
unit.target: Instinctu, liber illusorius in oculis eius obscuris apparuit.

unit.source: Positioned in front of Mr. K, the book flipped through its pages while chanting in a low voice, “I came, I saw, I record.”
unit.target: Ante Mr. K positus, liber paginas suas volvens voce humilis incantans dixebat: “Veni, vidi, notavi.”

unit.source: In an instant, Mr. K underwent a transformation, manifesting as a two to three‑meter‑tall half‑giant donned in cold black armor, brandishing a dark, straight broadsword.
unit.target: In momento, Mr. K transformationem subiit, apparens tamquam semigeus duorum ad trium metrorum altus, indutus armatura nigra frigida, gladium rectum obscurum gerens.

unit.source: Having Grazed a Traveler, he had selected three Beyonder powers: Blink, Record, and the Traveler’s Door, encompassing teleportation or travel.
unit.target: Cum Viatorem laesisset, tres potentias Beyonder seligit: “Blink”, “Record”, et “Portam Viatoris”, quae teleportationem aut iter complectuntur.

unit.source: Additionally, with Record, he had acquired an ability capable of influencing godhood from a Saint of the Aurora Order.
unit.target: Insuper, per “Record”, adeptus erat facultatem divinitatem influere, ab Sancto Ordinis Aurorae.

unit.source: While only half as effective as the original, it proved sufficient to contend with Mad Lady, who had yet to approach the threshold of godhood.
unit.target: Quamvis tantum dimidia efficacia habeat quam originalis, sufficiens erat ad contendendum cum Mad Lady, quae etiam ad limen divinitatis non accesserat.

unit.source: Mr. K advanced confidently, wielding the dark, straight broadsword, prepared to strike.
unit.target: Mr. K fiduciter progressus est, gladium rectum obscurum gerens et ad ictum paratus.

unit.source: At that moment, Mad Lady’s chest was overwhelmed by an intense surge of desire.
unit.target: Illo momento, pectus Mad Lady impetu vehementi desiderii oppressum est.

unit.source: Then, she experienced a sharp, piercing pain.
unit.target: Tum acutum ac percutiens dolorem sensit.

unit.source: She didn’t need to lower her head.
unit.target: Non debuit caput inclinare.

unit.source: From the corner of her eye, she witnessed the flesh on her chest tearing apart inch by inch, the white bones snapping one by one.
unit.target: Ex angulo oculi, vidit carnem in pectore suo ad puncta discidi et ossa alba singillatimrumpi.

unit.source: A grayish‑white fog, mingled with fragments of flesh, surged forth, coalescing into a humanoid figure resembling her.
unit.target: Nebula cinereo‑alba, cum fragmentis carnis mixtis, erupit, coalescens in figuram humanoidem, ei similem.

unit.source: In an instant, it leaped out of the dark “sphere” created by Lumian and darted into the depths of the metal tunnel.
unit.target: In momento, ex sphaera obscura a Lumiano creata, exsiluit et in profundum tuneli metallici procurrit.

unit.source: Don’t be in a hurry to leave!
unit.target: Noli festinare discedere!

unit.source: Unfazed by the situation, Mad Lady’s face reflected excitement and a hint of regret.
unit.target: Indifferens re, vultus Mad Lady excitamentum atque insinuationem paenitentiae exprimebat.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Mr. K’s dark broadsword cleaved through the dark sphere, diagonally bisecting Mad Lady.
unit.target: Gladius obscurus rectus Mr. K per sphaeram obscuram secavit, dividens Mad Lady diagonaliter.

unit.source: Wearing the ring imbued with flesh and blood magic, Mad Lady didn’t succumb immediately.
unit.target: Portans anulum magicum carnis et sanguinis infusum, Mad Lady statim non cedere potuit.

unit.source: Her two halves of flesh and blood writhed, attempting to reunite, but all endeavors were obliterated by the profound darkness left in the wake of the broadsword.
unit.target: Duae quotae carnis et sanguinis eius contorquebantur, conantes se reunire, sed omnes conatus obscuritate profunda post gladium obliti sunt.

unit.source: The flesh and blood failed to reestablish a connection.
unit.target: Caro et sanguis nexum restituere non potuerunt.

unit.source: Come on, come on… Mad Lady’s relatively intact head sought to aid her body, but she swiftly perceived the annihilation of her soul.
unit.target: Age, age… Caput Mad Lady, relativum intactum, quaerebat corpus suum adiuvare, sed celeriter delationem animae suae perceptum est.

unit.source: Her vision darkened, and her unevenly separated bodies crumpled to the ground.
unit.target: Visus eius obscuratus est, et corpora eius, inaequaliter separata, in terram corruerunt.

unit.source: Unperturbed by the fate of the April Fool’s key member, Mr. K and Lumian redirected their focus to the grayish‑white figure hurtling into the depths of the metal tunnel.
unit.target: Non perturbati de fato membri clavis “April Fool”, Mr. K et Lumian conspectum converterunt ad figuram cinereo‑albam, in profundum tuneli metallici labentem.

unit.source: Comprising half fog and half flesh, the figure existed in a realm between reality and illusion.
unit.target: Ex dimidia nebula et dimidia carne constituta, figura in regno inter rem et illusionem exstabat.

unit.source: The temporary Governor of the Sea, Lumian, once again honed in on the target and its surroundings, intending to marshal every ounce of sea power at his disposal.
unit.target: Praefectus maris temporarius, Lumian iterum in metam eiusque circumiecta se vertit, omnem potentiam maris sibi adhibere studens.

unit.source: At that moment, the grayish‑white figure collapsed to the ground.
unit.target: Illo momento, figura cinereo‑alba in terram prostrata est.

unit.source: The flesh and blood originally belonging to Mad Lady seeped into the metal floor, and the grayish‑white fog was on the verge of being absorbed.
unit.target: Caro et sanguis, qui primordio Mad Lady erant, in pavimentum metallicum se infuderunt, et nebula cinereo‑alba paene absorpta erat.

unit.source: Abruptly, the entire tunnel trembled.
unit.target: Subito totus tunel tremuit.

unit.source: Lumian once again “saw” the pear‑shaped object fashioned from flesh and skin.
unit.target: Lumian iterum “vidit” obiectum in forma pirae, ex carne et cute confectum.

unit.source: The flesh membrane on its surface buckled once more, outlining a disc‑shaped contour.
unit.target: Membrana carnis in superficie eius iterum deflexa est, figuram disci delineans.

unit.source: A formidable suction force erupted.
unit.target: Vis attrahens formidabilis erupit.

unit.source: Whether Lumian—the temporary Governor of the Sea—or Mr. K, they found themselves irresistibly propelled into the depths of the metal tunnel, as if an invisible hand seized them and drew them toward the core of the silver‑gray behemoth.
unit.target: Sive Lumian—praefectus maris temporarius—sive Mr. K, se irresistibiliter in profunda tuneli metallici propelli invenerunt, quasi manus invisibilis eos ceperit atque ad cor ingentis bestiae cinereo‑argenteae traxerit.

unit.source: Mad Lady’s dismembered corpse and her belongings soared into the air, propelled towards the destination she had fervently yearned for in life.
unit.target: Corpus disiectum Mad Lady et eius possessiones in aerum volaverunt, versus destinatum, quod in vita ferventer desideraverat, propelli.

unit.source: The humanoid form outlined by the grayish‑white fog seeped deeper into the metal floor, absorbing a portion.
unit.target: Figura humanoidea, delineata a nebula cinereo‑alba, in pavimentum metallicum penitus pervenit, partem absorbens.

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian, wielding the temporary authority of the Governor of the Sea, employed his enhanced perception to “see” the flesh‑and‑blood “bird’s nest” deep within the metal tunnel more distinctly than before.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian, praefectus maris temporarius auctoritate praeditus, perceptionem suam auget, ut “videat” nidum carnis et sanguinis, profundo in tuneli metallico, magis distincte quam prius.

unit.source: The pear‑shaped object’s flesh and skin caved in, and the starlight and dark matter emanating from the surrounding flesh ropes accelerated their flow.
unit.target: Caro et cutis obiecti formae pirae delapsae sunt, et lumen stellarum atque materia obscura, ex circumjacentibus funibus carnis emanantes, fluxum suum acceleraverunt.

unit.source: Through the taut skin and flesh, Lumian vaguely sensed the object nurtured within the pear‑shaped structure.
unit.target: Per cutem et carnem rigido, Lumian vix sensu percipiebat obiectum, quod intra structuram formae pirae nutritum erat.

unit.source: It resembled a pitch‑black vortex capable of devouring all colors and light.
unit.target: Id simile erat atramento nigro vortico, qui omnes colores et lucem consumere poterat.

unit.source: While not overly large, it featured a disc‑shaped outer edge.
unit.target: Quamvis non ingens, habebat limen disci similem.

unit.source: Wh… Lumian instinctively recalled scientific concepts and simplified scenes his sister Aurore had once explained. He identified a term that matched his observations: A black hole!
unit.target: Heu… Lumian instinctu recordatus est conceptus científicos et scaenas simplicatas quas soror eius Aurore olim explanaverat. Inveni vocabulum quod observationibus suis convenit: “Foramen nigrum!”

unit.source: Did the Abraham family’s ancestor seal a black hole with Amon?
unit.target: An progenitor familiae Abraham cum Amon foramen nigrum sigillavit?

unit.source: A black hole that has yet to fully form and is still nurtured within a mother’s body from a mystical standpoint?
unit.target: Num foramen nigrum, quod adhuc plene formari non potuit et in corpore matris ex prospectu mystico nutritur, sit?

unit.source: Lumian found the idea absurd, straddling the line between scientific and mystical.
unit.target: Lumian ideam absurdam invenit, inter scientificum et mysticum limen transcendens.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he sensed a connection between the “black hole”-like object and another place.
unit.target: Simul sensit nexum inter obiectum simile “foraminis nigri” atque alium locum.

unit.source: A profound, weighty, dense, and terrifying aura loomed over the world.
unit.target: Aura profunda, gravis, densa ac terribilis super mundum imminens erat.

unit.source: With a buzzing sensation, Lumian teetered on the brink of losing consciousness.
unit.target: Cum zumbitu, Lumian in limine conscientiae amittendae trepidabat.

unit.source: Not only was his physical form being drawn towards the flesh and blood “bird’s nest,” but even his thoughts, Spirit Body, and destiny converged in that direction.
unit.target: Non solum forma corporis eius ad “nidum” carnis et sanguinis trahitur, sed etiam cogitationes, Corpus Spirituale, et fatum in eam partem conveniebant.

unit.source: It was the same for Mr. K.
unit.target: Idem etiam pro Mr. K accidebat.

unit.source: One after another, Mad Lady’s fragmented remains and a few belongings floated between them.
unit.target: Unus post alium, fractae reliquiae Mad Lady et quaedam possessiones inter se fluctuabant.

unit.source: Beyond the silver‑gray behemoth, Franca and the others felt an ominous suction emanating from the seabed.
unit.target: Ultra bestiam cinereo‑argenteam, Franca et ceteri sentiebant suctionem ominosam ex fundo maris emanare.

unit.source: It seemed as though a colossal vortex was forming, ready to engulf everything in its vicinity.
unit.target: Videtur quasi ingens vortex formari, paratus omnia in circuitu suo devorare.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: The mountainous azure waves and jade‑green seawater collapsed, filling the seabed.
unit.target: Undae caeruleae montane et aqua maris viride‑smaragdina in fundo maris collapsae sunt, fundum maris replebant.

unit.source: Abruptly, resplendent starlight descended from the sky.
unit.target: Subito, lux stellarum splendens de caelo descendit.

unit.source: Madam Magician materialized, adorned in a deep‑black Warlock robe embroidered with shimmering silver stars.
unit.target: Magistra Magica apparuit, induta in veste nigerrima Warlock, quae stellis argenteis micantibus exornata erat.

unit.source: The wielder of a Major Arcana card extended her right hand toward the silver‑gray behemoth at the seabed.
unit.target: Possessrix cardinis Magni Arcanae, dextram manum protulit versus bestiam cinereo‑argenteam in fundo maris.

unit.source: Her figure appeared in a state of overlap, intermittently clear and blurry.
unit.target: Figura eius apparuit superimposita, interdum perspicua, interdum vix distincta.

unit.source: Each radiant starlight transformed into an illusory door, seamlessly “melding” with the suction force, merging into the silver‑gray behemoth.
unit.target: Quisque lux stellarum, radiantis, in ostium illusorium transformabatur, sine intermissione cum vis attrahente miscens se et in bestiam cinereo‑argenteam coalescens.

unit.source: 590 The Truth Behind the Seal
unit.target: 590 Veritas Post Sigillum

unit.source: 590 The Truth Behind the Seal
unit.target: 590 Veritas Post Sigillum

unit.source: The surface of the massive silver-gray behemoth ignited with illusory doors, casting a star-like brilliance that darkened the sky above the sea.
unit.target: Superficies ingentis bestiae argenteo‐cinerei portis illusoriis fulgebat, proicens splendorem siderum similem qui caelum supra mare obscurabat.

unit.source: This existing seal, triggered by Madam Magician, no longer resided in a nadir due to celestial shifts.
unit.target: Hoc sigillum, a Magistra Magica excitatum, propter mutationes caelestes in fundo iam non manebat.

unit.source: Starlight descended, swiftly repairing the temporary damage inflicted upon the seal.
unit.target: Lux siderum descendit, celeriter reparans damna temporaria in sigillo intulata.

unit.source: Inside the behemoth, half of the grayish-white fog composing Mad Lady’s human form was absorbed by the metal floor, appearing as if it would sink further.
unit.target: Intra bestiam, dimidium nebulae cinereo‐albae quae formam humanam “Mad Lady” constituebat, a plano metallico absorpta est, quasi ulterius mergi posset.

unit.source: In that crucial moment, starlight permeated the walls, floor, and ceiling, materializing resplendent doors of various shapes.
unit.target: In illo momento cruciali, lux siderum pervagata est per parietes, pavimentum et laquearia, efformans portas resplendentes variis figuris.

unit.source: These doors manipulated the void, thwarting the menacing suction and expelling the grayish-white fog.
unit.target: Hae portae vacuum moderabant, repugnantes sugitioni minaci et expellentes nebulam cinereo‐albam.

unit.source: Abruptly, Lumian felt the formidable suction force from the metal tunnel’s depths dissipate.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian sensit vim sugitionis formidabilem, quae ex infimo canali metallici emanabat, evanescere.

unit.source: He “saw” the dented flesh and blood “bird’s nest” expanding again, releasing a copious amount of resplendent starlight.
unit.target: Vidit carnem et sanguinem in forma “nidus avium” deformatum iterum expandere, copiosam lucem siderum resplendentium eruentes.

unit.source: The torrent surged through different parts of the silver-gray behemoth like a flood breaching a dam.
unit.target: Torrentia per varias partes bestiae argenteo‐cinerei irruit, quasi diluvium damnum frangens.

unit.source: Lumian, Mr. K, Mad Lady’s remains, and the items undulated with the sea’s waves.
unit.target: Lumian, Dominus K, reliquiae “Mad Lady” et cetera res cum fluctibus maris undabantur.

unit.source: As they were propelled forward, they encountered resistance and erosion from the sea’s power.
unit.target: Dum impellebantur, occursit eis resistentia atque erosio ex potentia maris.

unit.source: Meanwhile, the fleshless, corporeal grayish-white phantom swayed in the vast starlight, growing fainter before gradually dissipating.
unit.target: Interim, phantasma corporale, sine carne, cinereo‐album in immensa luce siderum vacillabat, paulatim evanescens dissolvens.

unit.source: Unlike previous instances, the sea’s power did not erupt from the ocean depths this time.
unit.target: Contrario prioribus, potentia maris hoc tempore ex profundis oceani non erupit.

unit.source: Madam Magician had severed the energy passageway, successfully resealing and reinforcing the seal.
unit.target: Magistra Magica viam energeticam abscidit, sigillum iterum claudens atque confirmans.

unit.source: Madam Magician, her form seemingly illusory, raised her right hand and pointed at the betrothal ship and sailboat, her eyes mirroring the corresponding scene.
unit.target: Magistra Magica, cuius forma quasi illusoria videbatur, dextram manum levavit et navem nuptialem atque velarium navale monstravit, oculis scenam illam speculantibus.

unit.source: The two ships, along with Hela, Franca, the “Cinderella” demigod, the humanoid Sealed Artifact, the Maidens of the Sea, the remaining deputy hosts, and the sailors, vanished from the underwater cavity, instantly reappearing on the sunny, calm, turquoise sea beyond the seal.
unit.target: Duae naves, simul cum Hela, Franca, semideo “Cinderella”, artefacto humanoideo sigillato, Puellis Maris, reliquis hospitibus vicariis atque nautis, ex cavitate subaquanea evanuerunt et statim in mari solario, placido, turcico colore ultra sigillum apparuerunt.

unit.source: Crash! Mountain-like azure waves and jade-green seawater resembling well walls slammed down, filling the underwater cavity.
unit.target: Fragor! Undae caeruleae, quasi montes, et aqua marina viridi‐jade, quae parietibus puteorum similes erant, ruunt, cavitatem subaquaneam replentes.

unit.source: Madam Magician’s gaze then shifted to Lumian, Mr. K, Mad Lady’s corpse, Pride Armor, and other items.
unit.target: Deinde, aspectus Magistrae Magicae ad Lumian, Dominum K, cadaver “Mad Lady” et Armaturam Superbiae atque alias res versatus est.

unit.source: Just as she was about to relocate them, Lumian, still donning the Flog boxing gloves, suddenly felt a heavy, dense, terrifying, and brilliant aura “looking” at him from another place connected to the black hole in the flesh and blood “bird’s nest.”
unit.target: Modo cum illa eos transferre intendebat, Lumian, adhuc in manibus Flog pugnandi indutus, subito sensit gravem, densam, terribilem atque fulgentem auram, quae ex alio loco, coniuncta ad foramen nigrum in “nidus” carnis et sanguinis, eum intueri videbatur.

unit.source: Crack, crack.
unit.target: Crepitus, crepitus.

unit.source: Lumian heard his bones shattering, his skull caving in, ribs snapping, and flesh compressing layer by layer.
unit.target: Lumian audivit ossa sua ruere, cranium concavari, costae rumpi, atque carnem strato per stratum comprimere.

unit.source: After unleashing the Ascetic’s accumulated strength, he, now taller, was instantly compressed into a short, thin, and dense form.
unit.target: Postquam vires asceticas cumulatas dimiserat, ille, nunc altior, statim in brevem, tenuem atque densam formam comprimi coepit.

unit.source: Intense pain flooded his mind, and his brain began to passively contract.
unit.target: Dolor intensus mentem eius inundavit, et cerebrum eius passim contrahere incipiebat.

unit.source: After a moment, Lumian broke free from the gaze and floated into the gradually calming air.
unit.target: Post momentum, Lumian ex spectatione evasit et in aere paulatim quietante fluitavit.

unit.source: Before Madam Magician, an illusory book rapidly flipped, emitting a faint glow full of vitality.
unit.target: Ante Magistram Magicam, liber illusorius celeriter volutabat, parvam lucem vitalitatis emittens.

unit.source: It bathed Lumian’s body in light, reconstructing his broken bones and swiftly enlarging his compressed flesh, rescuing him from his near-death state.
unit.target: Illud corpus Lumiani luce perfudit, ossa fracta reficiens et carnem compressam celeriter dilatans, eum ex statu prope mortis eripiendo.

unit.source: Then, Madam Magician tossed Mad Lady’s rose‑gold ring embedded with the crimson gem to Lumian, allowing him to reassemble his flesh and blood and return to his original appearance.
unit.target: Deinde, Magistra Magica annulum ex auro roseo, gemma rubra imbutum Dominae Insolitae, Lumiani iacuit, eum permittens carnem et sanguinem iterum componere atque ad formam originalem redire.

unit.source: He was no longer a short, thin, and heavy peculiar human.
unit.target: Non iam erat homo brevis, tenuus et gravis, peculiaris.

unit.source: Simultaneously, in Port Santa, Loki’s figure faded as he entered the spirit world, preparing to teleport away.
unit.target: Simul, in Portu Santa, figura Loki evanuit, dum in mundum spirituum ingrediebatur, paratus ad se teleportandum.

unit.source: However, a dark, formless barrier appeared in front of him, blocking his path.
unit.target: Attamen, obstaculum obscurum, sine forma, ante eum apparuit, iter eius obstruens.

unit.source: Loki’s pupils dilated as he realized that at some point, he had been ensnared in a dark and transparent “sphere,” seemingly bent from the void, with “walls” everywhere, and a hidden door.
unit.target: Pupillae Loki dilatatae sunt, cum intellexit se aliquando in sphaera obscura et perspicua, quasi ex vacuo flectentem, ubique parietibus et ianuam occultam habentem, implicatum esse.

unit.source: High up in the spirit world—near the seven pure lights—Madam Magician hovered, adorned in a deep‑black Warlock robe adorned with stars.
unit.target: Alte in mundo spirituum — prope septem lucis puras — Magistra Magica manebat, induta nigerrima veste magica, stellis ornata.

unit.source: Loki’s presence registered in her eyes, and an illusory book rapidly flipped before her.
unit.target: Praesentia Loki in oculis eius manifesta erat, et liber illusorius celeriter volutatus ante eam fuit.

unit.source: She had strategically waited until the last moment to prevent Loki from receiving the Celestial Worthy’s warning, providing her an opportunity to capture him alive.
unit.target: Ea strategice exspectaverat ad ultimum momentum, ne Loki monitum a “Celestiali Digno” acciperet, sibi occasionem ad eum vivum capiendum praebens.

unit.source: Loki’s lips curled into an exaggerated smile upon understanding the situation.
unit.target: Labia Loki in risu ampliato convoluta sunt, cum rem intellexit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: His body erupted from the inside out, as if a self‑controlled bomb had been embedded in his flesh beforehand.
unit.target: Corpus eius ex intimo in exterius erupit, ac tamquam bombus sui moderatus antea in carne eius insitus esset.

unit.source: Loki’s bizarre suicide succeeded; flesh and blood splattered, and his aura dissipated.
unit.target: Suicidium insolitum Loki perfecit; caro et sanguis sparsi sunt, et aura eius evanuit.

unit.source: Madam Magician promptly lifted the seal on the area, capturing the information Loki had imprinted in the spirit world.
unit.target: Magistra Magica celeriter sigillum in regione levavit, captans informationem quam Loki in mundo spirituum inscripserat.

unit.source: The spirit world served as a repository for all information.
unit.target: Mundus spirituum depositorium omnium notitiarum erat.

unit.source: Divination often entailed revelations from the spirit world, and the matter of resurrection inevitably left corresponding information.
unit.target: Divinatio saepe revelationes e mundo spirituum afferebat, et res resurrectionis necessario informationem correspondentem relinquebat.

unit.source: As long as she found relevant information in time, Madam Magician could trace Loki to his resurrection spot and pinpoint the ancient castle documented in the Secret Order records.
unit.target: Dummodo notitiam pertinentem tempestive inveniret, Magistra Magica Loki ad locum resurrectionis eius vestigare poterat atque antiquum castrum, in tabulis Ordinis Secreti depositum, designare.

unit.source: Soon, Madam Magician obtained something.
unit.target: Statim, Magistra Magica aliquid obtinuit.

unit.source: Her figure vanished from the spirit world’s heights, navigating the endless darkness adorned with symbols.
unit.target: Figura eius evanuit ex altitudinibus mundi spirituum, navigans in tenebris infinitis symbolis ornatis.

unit.source: In the next moment, a vast grayish‑white fog materialized before her eyes.
unit.target: In proximo momento, vasta nebula cinereo‑alba coram oculis eius materializata est.

unit.source: Magician halted, gazing at the seemingly endless expanse of grayish‑white fog.
unit.target: Magistra Magica se sistit, aspiciens immensam nebulae cinereo‑albae expanse, quae inaniter videbatur.

unit.source: Under the silent, dusky sky, above the calm blue sea.
unit.target: Sub caelo silentio ac crepusculo, supra mare placidum caeruleum.

unit.source: Using Mad Lady’s ring embedded with a crimson gem, Lumian adjusted his internal organs, flesh, and bones to their original state.
unit.target: Utendo annulo Dominae Insolitae, gemma rubra inlata, Lumian organos internos, carnem et ossa ad statum pristinum restituit.

unit.source: Treading on the corporeal wind, Lumian removed the ring that enabled the use of flesh and blood magic and anxiously inquired of Madam Magician, “How’s the situation on the other two fronts?”
unit.target: Ambulans super vento corporali, Lumian annulum, qui usum magiae carnis et sanguinis permittebat, removit atque anxie Magistrae Magicam rogavit: “Quid agitur in reliquis duobus frontibus?”

unit.source: As he spoke, he sensed a mystical and indiscernible flicker from Madam Magician.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, sensit scintillationem mysticam atque imperceptibilem a Magistra Magica emanare.

unit.source: Magician smiled.
unit.target: Magistra Magica risit.

unit.source: “Loki has just been killed by me, but I couldn’t prevent his resurrection or seize the opportunity to locate his ancient castle.
unit.target: “Loki modo a me interfectus est, sed nec resurrectionem eius prohibere potui nec occasionem ad inveniendum antiquum castellum eius capere.”

unit.source: Bard has been captured by Gandalf, whom you intentionally sent to Milo Village. He’s alive.”
unit.target: “Bard ab Gandalf captus est, quem ad Vicum Milo proposito misisti. Vivus est.”

unit.source: Phew… Lumian instinctively heaved a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Heu… Lumian instinctu suspirum solatium edidit.

unit.source: Though he hadn’t captured Loki, wasting one more of Loki’s resurrections meant he had achieved his objectives.
unit.target: Quamquam Loki non cepit, iterum eius resurrectionem amittere significabat se propositum adeptum esse.

unit.source: Furthermore, Ultraman and Mad Lady had been completely eliminated, and Bard had been captured alive.
unit.target: Praeterea, Ultraman et Domina Insolita omnino exstincti erant, et Bard vivus captus est.

unit.source: The results were satisfactory.
unit.target: Eventus satisfactori erant.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian hadn’t confirmed Bard’s identity.
unit.target: Initio, Lumian identitatem Bard non confirmaverat.

unit.source: He didn’t even know if Bard had participated in the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Nescius erat etiam utrum Bard ritu precationis maris participavisset.

unit.source: However, he had a few suspects, including the fake Governor of the Sea and Juan Oro’s grandson, Fernandez.
unit.target: Attamen, aliquos suspectos habebat, inter quos falsum Praefectum Maris et nepos Juan Oro, Fernandez.

unit.source: Since most of the suspects were in Milo Village, he had Gandalf closely monitor them.
unit.target: Cum plerique suspecti in Vicum Milo essent, Gandalf eos arcte observare curavit.

unit.source: Madam Magician continued, “I relocated everyone else from these waters.
unit.target: Magistra Magica perrexit: “Reliquos ex his aquis omnes transfeci.

unit.source: I sent Mr. K of the Aurora Order back to his rented room in Port Santa.
unit.target: Dominum K Ordinis Aurorae ad cellam locatam in Portu Santa redei.

unit.source: Mad Lady’s corpse and items are floating here.”
unit.target: Cadaver Dominae Insolitae et instrumenta hic fluctuant.”

unit.source: The Major Arcana card holder opened her palm, shrouded in darkness, forming a small box.
unit.target: Possessrix chartarum Maioris Arcana palmas suas aperuit, in tenebris operta, parvam capsulam formans.

unit.source: Inside, Mad Lady’s dismembered corpse and other items had “shrunk” to the size of mosquitoes, drifting as if in another world.
unit.target: Intus, cadaver Dominae Insolitae disiunctum et cetera instrumenta ad dimensionem culicidarum redacta erant, quasi in alio mundo vagantia.

unit.source: Lumian was taken aback.
unit.target: Lumian obstupefactus est.

unit.source: He looked at the bottom of the azure sea and asked, “Is it over?”
unit.target: Aspiciebat imum maris azuri et rogavit: “Iam finitum est?”

unit.source: He had anticipated gaining control over the silver-gray behemoth eventually.
unit.target: Praevidit se tandem potiri imperio super bestiam argenteo‐cineream fore.
