unit.source: “Otherwise? Back then, even two Kings of Angels couldn’t clean up the mess.
unit.target: “Aliter? Illo tempore, etiam duo Reges Angelorum confusionem purgare non potuerunt.

unit.source: How is our Tarot Club going to handle it—unless Mr. Fool awakens,” Madam Magician replied in an amused tone.
unit.target: “Quomodo nostrum Tarot Club id administrabit—nisi Dominus Stultus excitatus fuerit?” respondit Magistra Magica alacri tono.

unit.source: Lumian recollected the items in the flesh and blood “bird’s nest” and nodded in agreement.
unit.target: Lumian instrumenta in “nidus avium” carnis et sanguinis recoluit, atque consensu annuit.

unit.source: He asked in confusion, “Is it true that sealed at the bottom is a black hole? Uh… Do you know what a black hole is?”
unit.target: Rogavit confusus: “Verumne est quod in imo sigillatum sit foramen nigrum? Eheu… Scisne quid sit foramen nigrum?”

unit.source: “I do,” Madam Magician chuckled.
unit.target: “Scio,” inquit Magistra Magica subridens.

unit.source: “And I also know that the silver-gray thing down there is a spaceship.”
unit.target: “Et etiam scio rem argenteo‐cineream illac deorsum esse navem sideralem.”

unit.source: Spaceship… Lumian was taken aback.
unit.target: Navis sideralis… Lumian obstupefactus est.

unit.source: Upon reflection, he realized that the silver-gray behemoth bore a striking resemblance to the spaceship described in his sister’s bedtime stories!
unit.target: Post considerationem, intellexit bestiam argenteo‐cineream mirabilem affinitatem habuisse cum nave siderali, quam in fabulis ad somnum sororis suae descripta erat!

unit.source: Madam Magician not only knew about spaceships but also grasped the concept of a black hole!
unit.target: Magistra Magica non solum de navibus sideralibus sciebat, sed etiam notionem foraminis nigri intellexit!

unit.source: Never underestimate high-ranking individuals.
unit.target: Numquam personas altae dignitatis subestima.

unit.source: The time‑transcending knowledge possessed by transmigrators might not be foreign to them… Lumian sighed with emotion.
unit.target: Scientia, quae tempus transcendit, quam transmigratores possident, eis non foranea esse poterat… Lumian cum affectu suspiravit.

unit.source: At that moment, he noticed that Madam Magician’s mystical flickering had vanished.
unit.target: In illo momento animadvertit scintillationem mysticam Magistrae Magicae evanuisse.

unit.source: The Major Arcana card holder gazed at the seabed and explained, “It’s a black hole, ready to form, personally created by an evil god.
unit.target: Possessrix chartarum Maioris Arcana imum maris contemplata est et explicavit: “Foramen nigrum est, formandi paratum, a deo malefico personaliter creatum.

unit.source: Constantly absorbing surrounding matter and energy, it strengthens itself, eventually becoming a true black hole.
unit.target: Continenter materiam et energiam circumstantem absorbet, se roborans, tandem verum foramen nigrum efficitur.

unit.source: “In the Fourth Epoch, the evil god seized an opportunity to send the embryonic black hole through the spaceship at the bottom of the sea.
unit.target: “In Aetate Quarta, deus maleficus occasionem cepit ad mittendum foramen nigrum embryonicum per navem sideralem in imo maris.

unit.source: The plan was for it to rapidly develop, tear apart, and devour our planet, causing the barrier to lose support and disintegrate prematurely.
unit.target: Consilium erat ut celeriter evolveretur, dissolveretur, et planetam nostrum devoraret, quo impedimentum sustentationem amitteret atque prae‐mature dissolveretur.

unit.source: True gods and angels could escape, but without the barrier’s protection, who knows what would happen.
unit.target: Veri dei et angeli evadere poterant, sed sine tutela impedimentorum, quis sciat quid eveniret.

unit.source: Fortunately, Mr. Door and Amon discovered the threat in time and took action.
unit.target: Fortunate, Dominus Ianuam et Amon minas tempore deprehenderunt et rem ceperunt.

unit.source: Yet, they couldn’t obliterate the already developing black hole.
unit.target: Attamen, foramen nigrum iam evolvens delere non potuerunt.

unit.source: Any attempts to destroy or destabilize it would only make it stronger.
unit.target: Omnis conatus ad delendum aut destabilizandum id tantum roboraret.

unit.source: The only viable solution was to seal it and patiently wait for it to weaken through repeated radiations until it ultimately evaporates.
unit.target: Sola solutio valida erat id sigillare et patienter exspectare ut per radios repetitos debilitaretur donec tandem evanueret.

unit.source: Alternatively, they could transport it and the spaceship into the cosmos, abandoning it in desolate areas.
unit.target: Aliter, id et navem sideralem in cosmo transferre poterant, relicto in regionibus desolatis.

unit.source: However, this would require Mr. Door to leave the safety of the barrier and shadow the threat continuously to prevent accidents.
unit.target: Attamen hoc significaret ut Dominus Ianuam tutelam impedimenti relinqueret et minas constanter subsequeretur ad casus evitandos.

unit.source: Moreover, it remained under the vigilant gaze of that entity, which periodically replenished its energy through their connection.
unit.target: Praeterea, remanebat sub vigilante aspectu illius entitatis, quae periodice vim suam per eorum connexionem renovabat.

unit.source: The danger was evident.
unit.target: Periculum manifeste patebat.

unit.source: That explains it… Lumian finally grasped why it had been sealed rather than destroyed.
unit.target: Hoc explicat rem… Lumian tandem intellexit cur sigillatum esset potius quam delevitum.

unit.source: Intrigued, he echoed a term, “Mr. Door?”
unit.target: Curiosus, verbum repetivit: “Dominus Ianuam?”

unit.source: It bore a striking resemblance to Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Illud notabile similitudo habebat cum Domino Stulto.

unit.source: 591 Information Gap
unit.target: 591 Lacuna Notitiae

unit.source: 591 Information Gap
unit.target: 591 Lacuna Notitiae

unit.source: Upon hearing Lumian’s inquiry, Madam Magician’s tone carried a subtle emotion.
unit.target: Audita quaestione Lumiani, tonus Dominae Magicae affectum subtilissimum gerebat.

unit.source: “Mr. Door is the ancestor of the Abraham family, the top duke among the five great nobles of the Tudor Empire.
unit.target: „Dominus Door est progenitor familiae Abraham, et dux praeclarus inter quinque magnos nobles Imperii Tudoriani.“

unit.source: It was He who sealed this spaceship.
unit.target: Ipse est, qui hanc navem sideralem sigillavit.

unit.source: Amon, on the other hand, designed the ritual that regularly siphoned power from the black hole to alleviate the pressure caused by the natural decay of the seal and hasten the black hole’s demise.”
unit.target: Amon vero instituit caerimoniam quae regulariter potentiam ex foraminis nigri subtraheret, ut pressuram ex natura sigilli corruptionis levaret atque exitium foraminis acceleraret.”

unit.source: Higher in rank than Amon… In the Tudor Empire, Mr. Door was second only to the Blood Emperor?
unit.target: Maiore dignitate quam Amon… In Imperio Tudoriano, Dominus Door erat secundus solummodo post Imperatorem Sanguinis?

unit.source: He listened intently.
unit.target: Diligenter auscultavit.

unit.source: Madam Magician sighed softly at that moment.
unit.target: Domina Magica leniter suspiravit eo tempore.

unit.source: “In a way, Mr. Door can be considered my mentor.”
unit.target: „Quodammodo, Dominus Door meum praeceptor esse potest.”

unit.source: A mentor? Your mentor is a Fourth Epoch King of Angels and the top noble in the Tudor Empire?
unit.target: Praeceptor? Tuus praeceptor est Rex Angelorum Aetatis Quartae et summus nobilis in Imperio Tudoriano?

unit.source: A figure from almost two thousand years ago…
unit.target: Figura ex fere duo milia annorum abhinc…

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t anticipated Madam Magician having such a profound background.
unit.target: Lumian non exspectavit Dominae Magicae talem profundam originem habere.

unit.source: No wonder she earned the position of the Angel of Stars beside Mr. Fool’s throne.
unit.target: Non mirum est quod consequuta est officium Angeli Stellarum iuxta thronum Domini Stulti.

unit.source: No wonder she held a Major Arcana card in the Tarot Club!
unit.target: Non mirum quod tenuit chartam Arcana Maior in Club Taroticus!

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced at Lumian, teasingly adding, “It’s true that Mr. Door guided and ‘supervised’ me in advancing along the divine path, but the method wasn’t as virtuous as you might imagine.
unit.target: Domina Magica ad Lumian respexit, ludibriose addens: „Vero, Dominus Door me in progressu per viam divinam duxit et ‘supervisavit’, sed methodus non erat tam virtuosa quam putas.

unit.source: It was far from good.”
unit.target: Longe a bono erat.”

unit.source: Far from good…
unit.target: Longe a bono…

unit.source: Lumian was surprised before connecting the dots.
unit.target: Lumian miratus est antequam res coniungere coepit.

unit.source: Combining his experiences, he made a guess.
unit.target: Experientias suas coniunxit atque coniecturam egit.

unit.source: Madam Magician had once fallen under the corruptive influence of Mr. Door but received assistance from Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Domina Magica olim sub corruptivā influentiā Domini Door cecidit, sed auxilium a Domino Stulto accepit.

unit.source: Did she join the Tarot Club because of this?
unit.target: Num propter hoc in Club Taroticus se coniunxit?

unit.source: However, from Madam Magician’s words, it seems she reconciled with Mr. Door?
unit.target: Attamen, ex verbis Dominae Magicae videtur eam cum Domino Door reconciliatam esse?

unit.source: Otherwise, she wouldn’t refer to Him as her mentor.
unit.target: Alioquin eum non tamquam praeceptor suus appellaret.

unit.source: How intriguing and surreal.
unit.target: Quam mirabile et insolitum!

unit.source: Just like how I might say in the future that the Angel of Inevitability, Termiboros, was my mentor, Lumian mused inwardly and probed, “Is Mr. Door still active?”
unit.target: Sicut in futurum dicam Angelum Inevitabilitatis, Termiboros, fuisse meum praeceptor, Lumian intus meditatus ac interrogavit: „Num Dominus Door adhuc viget?”

unit.source: Is He as lively as His peer, Amon?
unit.target: Num ipse tam vivax est quam Amon?

unit.source: Madam Magician shook her head.
unit.target: Domina Magica caput in signum negationis inclinavit.

unit.source: “He has perished.”
unit.target: „Periit.”

unit.source: I see…
unit.target: Intelligo…

unit.source: Lumian cast his gaze toward the deep, bottomless sea.
unit.target: Lumian oculos suos ad profundum, insondabilem mare contulit.

unit.source: “April Fool’s objective is to acquire that spaceship? But it seems they are unaware of the nascent black hole sealed inside…”
unit.target: „Propositum Aprilis Stulti est hanc navem sideralem adipisci? Sed videtur eos nescire de foraminis nigri nascente intus sigillato...”

unit.source: It was a formidable entity that not even a true god could completely neutralize.
unit.target: Erat entitas formidabilis, quam ne verus deus omnino exstinguere poterat.

unit.source: Once released from its seal and allowed to develop, it would compress and absorb everything in its vicinity.
unit.target: Postquam sigillo solutum et evolvere concessum est, omnia circum se comprimere atque absorbere solebat.

unit.source: Why did the key members of April Fool’s, who weren’t even at the demigod level, believe they could confront it without fear?
unit.target: Cur principales Aprilis Stulti, qui ne gradus semideorum quidem attingebant, credebant se sine metu illud oppugnare posse?

unit.source: Relying on the spaceship to contain it?
unit.target: Fidem habere in nave siderali ut eam contineret?

unit.source: That seemed improbable.
unit.target: Id improbabile videbatur.

unit.source: Only the evil god who created the black hole or an entity at Mr. Fool’s level could control it…
unit.target: Solum deus malus, qui foramen nigrum creavit, aut entitas in ordine Domini Stulti eam regere poterat…

unit.source: Mad Lady even believed that within the seal was an incubating deity or monster of a comparable magnitude…
unit.target: Domina Insana etiam credidit intra sigillum deum vel monstrum inchoatum ex comparabili magnitudine esse…

unit.source: With these thoughts in mind, Lumian’s heart stirred as he inquired in a deep voice, “Were the key members of April Fool’s misled?
unit.target: His cogitationibus mentis, cor Lumiani concitatus est dum profunda voce interrogavit: „Num praecipui Aprilis Stulti decepti sint?

unit.source: Is the Celestial Worthy’s objective to unleash the black hole and trigger an apocalyptic catastrophe ahead of schedule?
unit.target: Num propositum Dignitatis Caelestis sit foramen nigrum efferre et calamitatem apocalypticam prae tempore suscitare?

unit.source: “As long as Beyonders corrupted by Him enter the spaceship, He stands a chance of achieving His goal?”
unit.target: „Dum ‘Beyonders’ ab Ipso corrupti navem sideralem ingrediuntur, habet occasionem propositum suum assequendi?”

unit.source: He really doesn’t seem to value the lives of Ultraman, Mad Lady, Bard, and Loki…
unit.target: Revera videtur vitam Ultraman, Domina Insana, Bard, et Loki non aestimare.

unit.source: However, that is also typical of April Fool’s modus operandi.
unit.target: Atque hoc quoque est modus operandi Aprilis Stulti.

unit.source: They don’t take lives other than their own seriously!
unit.target: Vitam aliorum quam suam non diligenter curant!

unit.source: Lumian suddenly felt like laughing.
unit.target: Lumian subito risum sentire coepit.

unit.source: His satisfaction from finishing off Ultraman and Mad Lady intensified.
unit.target: Satisfactio eius ex interficio Ultraman et Domina Insana intensificata est.

unit.source: Madam Magician nodded thoughtfully and remarked, “If you hadn’t used all your resources and handled this matter with absolute strength, or if I had arrived ten to twenty seconds later and the grayish‐white fog from Mad Lady’s body had fully permeated the spaceship, the outcome might have been entirely different.
unit.target: Domina Magica cogitabunda annuit et dixit: „Nisi omnia subsidia tua usus esses ac rem hanc vi absoluta administravisses, aut si ego decem ad viginti secundis postvenissem et nebula albocinerea ex corpore Dominae Insanae navem sideralem penitus pervadisset, exitus omnino aliter fuisset.

unit.source: We wouldn’t be able to be here and discuss this matter so calmly.”
unit.target: Non esset nobis licitum hic esse et rem hanc tam tranquillē disputare.”

unit.source: Lumian reflected on the events that had transpired and muttered thoughtfully to himself, “If I hadn’t gained temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea and restricted Mad Lady’s teleportation, she might have approached the flesh-and-blood ‘bird’s nest’ incubating the black hole before your arrival.
unit.target: Lumian eventa quae acciderant recoluit et sibi submurmuravit: „Nisi imperium temporarium ut Praefectus Maris acceperim et teleportationem Dominae Insanae cohiberim, illa fortasse ad nidum carnium avium, in quo foramen nigrum incuberet, ante adventum tuum accessisset.

unit.source: She wouldn’t have manifested a humanoid form made of grayish‐white fog to infiltrate the spacecraft.
unit.target: Non se effecerat in formam hominis ex nebula cinereo-alba factam ad navem sideralem intrandam.

unit.source: If that had occurred, the situation might have been even more challenging to handle…”
unit.target: Si id accidisset, res fortasse adhuc difficilior tractationi fuisset…

unit.source: The reason he obtained temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea was because he utilized Lie to pilfer a portion of the sea’s power.
unit.target: Causa cur imperium temporarium ut Praefectus Maris adeptus esset, erat quod Lie ad portionem potentiae maris subtrahere usus est.

unit.source: This allowed him to resonate with the sea and possess a counterfeit yet highly elevated status.
unit.target: Id ei concessit ut cum mari resonaret et statum simul fictum sed altissimum haberet.

unit.source: The ability to use Lie to steal a portion of the sea’s power was granted by the Seer pathway’s mystical item, which had been imbued with a high-level power of Steal when placed on the ancestor‐honoring altar in Milo Village.
unit.target: Facultas ut Lie partem potentiae maris subtraheret concessa est per rem mysticam viae vaticae, quae in altare progenitorum honorandum in vico Milo posita, potentia “Steal” altissimi gradus imbutata erat.

unit.source: The altar could bestow high-level Steal powers on items because it was constructed by Amon…
unit.target: Altare vires “Steal” altissimi gradus in obiecta conferre poterat, quia ab Amon constructum erat…

unit.source: Constructed by Amon…
unit.target: Amon aedificavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts suddenly cleared up.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani subito perspicuae factae sunt.

unit.source: He grasped that it wasn’t just him and the others sabotaging April Fool’s; there were also influential figures in the shadows who didn’t want the Celestial Worthy to succeed!
unit.target: Intellectus eum pervenit non solum ipse et alii Aprilis Stulti sabotarent, sed etiam figuras influentes in umbris esse, qui Dignitatem Caelestem succedere noluerunt!

unit.source: Madam Magician chuckled.
unit.target: Domina Magica subridens risit.

unit.source: “Have you figured it out? I recognized what was happening when I saw Lie, now endowed with the power of Steal.
unit.target: „Intellexistine? Cognovi quid accideret, cum Lie, nunc potestate “Steal” imbutatus, viderem.

unit.source: “Some time ago, I spied on the altar beneath Milo Village and confirmed its purpose—to gather the spirituality of worshippers and accumulate enough power to trigger the bestowment of the Steal ability.
unit.target: Aliquando, altare sub vico Milo speculabar et eius propositum comprobatum habeo—spiritualitatem cultorum colligere atque satis potentiae congregare ad facultatem “Steal” conferendam.

unit.source: Given Milo Village’s population and the number of individuals with the sea bloodline, it can only be bestowed once a year.
unit.target: Ex populo vici Milo et numero hominum sanguinis marini, id unice semel in anno tribui potest.

unit.source: It can’t last more than half a month each time, and it can only be used once or twice.
unit.target: Neque plus quam dimidio mense quoque durare potest, et solum semel aut bis adhiberi potest.

unit.source: “Lie’s enhanced power far surpasses that.”
unit.target: „Potentia aucta Lie longe id superat.”

unit.source: Lumian furrowed his brow and asked, “Are you suggesting that the ‘Steal’ on Lie was directly granted by Amon?”
unit.target: Lumian frons contraxit et quaesivit: „Num putas potentiam ‘Steal’ in Lie directe a Amon concessam esse?”

unit.source: This hypothesis struck him as absurd, comical, and surreal.
unit.target: Haec hypothesis ei absurda, ridicula, et insolita videbatur.

unit.source: In the past few months, Amon had been a source of terror, causing him mental distress.
unit.target: In paucis mensibus praeteritis, Amon fons terroris, atque molestiam mentis ei afferens, fuit.

unit.source: He nearly perished in the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
unit.target: Prope periit in Fons Mulierum Samaritanarum.

unit.source: Subsequently, he informed the Tarot Club and aided the Angel of Time in eliminating most of the Amons in Trier.
unit.target: Postea, Societati Taroticae certiorem fecit et Angeli Temporis auxilio plerosque Amonos in Trier exterminare contulit.

unit.source: He also wrested a substantial debt from Amon’s parasitic form.
unit.target: Etiam debitum substantiale ex forma Amonis parasitica rapuit.

unit.source: Their relationship?
unit.target: Relatio eorum?

unit.source: It was one of deep-seated enmity!
unit.target: Erat inimicitia profunda!

unit.source: The sentiment was likely mutual.
unit.target: Forte affectus mutuus erat.

unit.source: Yet now, he was being told that Amon had covertly assisted him?
unit.target: At nunc, narratur ei quod Amon eum furtim adiuvit?

unit.source: While Lumian understood that Amon’s aid wasn’t driven by benevolence but rather to thwart the Celestial Worthy’s objectives, he couldn’t shake the feeling that the world had taken a bizarre turn.
unit.target: Dum Lumian intellexit auxilium Amonis non ex benevolentia sed ad adversanda propositis Dignitatis Caelestis datum esse, sensum tamen non poterat abicere quod mundus modo insolitum versaretur.

unit.source: Madam Magician chuckled and explained, “Perhaps, back then, there was an Amon residing within the altar.
unit.target: Domina Magica subridens explicavit: „Fortasse, tum, Amon in altare habitabat.

unit.source: “Truth be told, I didn’t anticipate that those who once instilled awe, fear, and vigilance in our discussions would occasionally collaborate with us.
unit.target: Verum dicam, non exspectabam eos, qui olim reverentiam, timorem, et vigiliam in sermo nostro inferebant, interdum nobiscum cooperare.

unit.source: Of course, don’t become complacent.
unit.target: Scilicet, ne complacere incipias.

unit.source: While we may be teammates when facing the evil gods beyond the barrier, that doesn’t extend to all matters.
unit.target: Dum socii esse possumus cum diis malis ultra limitem oppugnandis, hoc ad omnia negotia non pertinet.

unit.source: Even when dealing with the evil god’s followers, it depends on the specific circumstances.
unit.target: Etiam cum sectatoribus dei mali agitur, id circumstantiis pendet.

unit.source: They might believe they can handle it alone and use the opportunity to set a trap that could harm you.”
unit.target: Fortasse existimabunt se id soli regere posse atque occasionem ad laqueum tendendum, quod te laedere possit, adhibere.

unit.source: “Alright…”
unit.target: „Recte...”

unit.source: Lumian resisted belief, but he had no choice but to acknowledge the reality before him.
unit.target: Lumian fides repugnans, sed nullam aliud viam habuit nisi rem praesentem agnoscere.

unit.source: The truth was laid bare.
unit.target: Vera manifesta erant.

unit.source: Having been briefed, Lumian mentally reconstructed the sea prayer ritual, refining the spiderweb-like thought pattern without any critical deficiencies.
unit.target: Notitiam accepit, et Lumian in mente caerimoniam preces maris refecit, rationem cogitationis telam similem sine defectibus criticis recensens.

unit.source: The corresponding experiences and lessons surfaced in Lumian’s mind:
unit.target: Experientiae atque lectiones in animo Lumiani apparuerunt:

unit.source: April Fool’s biggest failure was not knowing that Franca and I are also members of the Tarot Club, apart from being part of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
unit.target: Maxima defectio Aprilis Stulti fuit nescire Francam et me etiam membra Club Taroticus esse, praeterquam esse partem Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crisporum.

unit.source: Moreover, the Tarot Club places great importance on matters related to the Celestial Worthy…
unit.target: Praeterea, Club Taroticus rebus ad Dignitatem Caelestem pertinentibus magnum pretium tribuit…

unit.source: There’s also an information gap between them and the Celestial Worthy, leading to their downfall…
unit.target: Exstat etiam lacuna notitiae inter eos et Dignitatem Caelestem, quae ad eorum ruinam ducit…

unit.source: Have they not considered that their goals might not align with the Celestial Worthy’s?
unit.target: Num non animadvertere putaverunt, eorum proposita non convenire posse cum Dignitate Caelesti?

unit.source: Despite me lacking information as well, I wasn’t careless.
unit.target: Quamquam et mihi notitia defuit, non temerarius fui.

unit.source: I didn’t underestimate any visible or hidden enemies.
unit.target: Nullos hostes visibiles aut occulti subestimavi.

unit.source: Even a lion uses its full strength to hunt a rabbit…
unit.target: Etiam leo totam vim suam ad leporem venandum adhibet…

unit.source: Of course, the crucial aspect is that those holding key information and concealing it are on my side in this operation.
unit.target: Certe, elementum praecipuum est quod qui informationem claram retinent et eam celant, in hac operatione mihi adsunt.

unit.source: What if they become my enemies next time?
unit.target: Quid si in futurum hostes mei fient?

unit.source: How should I deal with them…
unit.target: Quomodo eos tractare debeam?

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian sensed that his digestion of the Conspirer potion had significantly advanced, thanks to the successful hunt and the questions he had formulated.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes in mente eius volitabant, Lumian sensit digestionem potionis Conspiratoris note profectam esse, propter venationem felicem ac interrogationes suas formatas.

unit.source: Seizing this opportunity, he summarized his third acting principle:
unit.target: Hanc occasionem capiens, tertium principium agendi suum summatim enuntiavit:

unit.source: “One of the keys to a conspiracy is information.
unit.target: „Una ex clavibus ad coniurationem est notitia.

unit.source: A good Conspirer must be adept at exploiting information gaps and even take the initiative to create information gaps.”
unit.target: Bonus coniurator peritus esse debet in exploenda lacuna notitiae atque initiative eam creare.

unit.source: Closing his eyes to assess his body’s condition, Lumian felt that another major, successful conspiracy and a period of daily accumulation should allow him to completely digest the Conspirer potion.
unit.target: Oculos clausos habens ad statum corporis perscrutandum, Lumian sensit aliam magnam et felicem coniurationem, cum tempore aggregationis cotidianæ, ei concedere posse ut potionem Conspiratoris plane digeret.

unit.source: And that major conspiracy could be combined with the ritual to advance to Sequence 5 Reaper.
unit.target: Et illa magna coniuratio cum caerimonia coniungi poterat ad Sequencam 5 Reaper progrediendam.

unit.source: No further planning was needed.
unit.target: Nulla ulteriō consilia necessaria erant.

unit.source: The Reaper ritual required a conspiracy to capture a target whose Sequence was higher than his—alive.
unit.target: Caerimonia Reaper coniurationem poscebat ad captandum scopus, cuius Sequenca altior quam eius esset—vivus.

unit.source: When Lumian opened his eyes, Madam Magician transmitted the darkness in her palm to him.
unit.target: Cum Lumian oculos aperuisset, Domina Magica tenebras ex palma sua ei tradidit.

unit.source: “You’ll be in charge of distributing these items.
unit.target: „Tu eris responsalis distributionis harum rerum.

unit.source: This is something a Hunter needs to learn and do well to advance to a demigod.”
unit.target: Hoc est rem, quam Venator discere et commode agere debet ad ascensum ad semideum consequendum.”

unit.source: “Alright.”
unit.target: „Recte.”

unit.source: Lumian was accustomed to distributing spoils of war.
unit.target: Lumian ad praediorum belli distributionem assuefactus erat.

unit.source: He then added, “But before that, I’d like to meet Bard.”
unit.target: Deinde addidit: „Sed ante hoc, Bard convenire velim.”

unit.source: That, too, was a spoil of war.
unit.target: Id quoque praeda belli erat.

unit.source: In the ancient and dilapidated palace in the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian, Franca, Hela, and Gandalf materialized one after another.
unit.target: In antiquo et dilapidato palatio in Natione Semper Noctis, Lumian, Franca, Hela, et Gandalf unum post alium apparuerunt.

unit.source: They were adorned in their usual attire for Gatherings, with Lumian now assuming the guise of Muggle Aurore.
unit.target: Induti erant vestimentis consuētis conventuum, et Lumian nunc effigie Muggle Aurore se praebebat.

unit.source: Gandalf unceremoniously tossed Bard to the ground, not bothering to restrain him.
unit.target: Gandalf Bard sine caerimonia in terram iacuit, eum continere non curans.

unit.source: Bard surveyed the familiar surroundings, devoid of any notions of escape or resistance.
unit.target: Bard circumstantias notas perspexit, nullo cogitatione de fuga aut repugnatione.

unit.source: This was the concealed Nation of the Evernight, isolated from the outside world.
unit.target: Haec erat Natione Semper Noctis celata, a mundo externo segregata.

unit.source: How could he possibly flee?
unit.target: Quomodo potuit in quovis modo effugere?

unit.source: And against two demigods, how could he even attempt resistance?
unit.target: Et contra duos semideos, quomodo etiam repugnationem conari posset?

unit.source: Bard swallowed hard and spoke preemptively, “I was also bewitched by Loki!”
unit.target: Bard avidē deglutivit et praeempta loquens dixit: „Ego quoque a Loki incantatus sum!”

unit.source: All he could hope for now was that, leveraging his Sequence experience as a Swindler, he could successfully “convince” the two demigods.
unit.target: Omne quod nunc sperare poterat, erat ut, sua experientia Sequencae ut Fraudator usurpata, duos semideos feliciter “persuadere” posset.

unit.source: Noticing the silence from Hela and Gandalf, Bard added, “I can lead you to Loki’s ancient castle.
unit.target: Silentes verba Helae et Gandalfi animadvertens, Bard addidit: „Vos ad antiquum castellum Loki ducere possum.

unit.source: I know a clue, really!”
unit.target: Revera, scio aliquod indicium!”

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian Lee, masquerading as Muggle, spoke in a deep voice, “Just kill him and channel his spirit.”
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian Lee, sub specie Muggle, voce profunda locutus est: „Interfice illum et spiritum eius dirige.”

unit.source: 592 Bluff
unit.target: 592 Bluff

unit.source: 592 Bluff
unit.target: 592 Bluff

unit.source: Kill him and channel his spirit?
unit.target: Interfice eum et spiritum eius dirige?

unit.source: Bard stared at Lumian Lee, masquerading as a Muggle, a chill running down his spine as his hair stood on end.
unit.target: Bard oculos in Lumian Lee fixit, qui se ut Muggle simulabat, gelu per dorsum eius decurrens, dum capilli eius erexerentur.

unit.source: He sensed the unmistakable killing intent emanating from Lumian, causing fear to grip him.
unit.target: Sensit propositum caedis inequivocum a Lumian emanare, quod timorem in eum incitabat.

unit.source: However, a suspicion lingered in Bard’s mind; he believed Lumian was trying to manipulate him, deliberately showcasing his anger and hatred to break his psychological defenses.
unit.target: Tamen, suspicio in mente Bard permanebat; censuit Lumian eum fallere conari, iram et odium suum deliberanter ostendens ad munimenta mentis eius rumpenda.

unit.source: His suspicion arose because spirit channeling wasn’t the optimal solution.
unit.target: Suspicio eius orta est, quia directio spiritus non erat optima solutio.

unit.source: Celestial Worthy possessed a higher level than many evil gods, and the corruption of those evil gods could lead to a failed spirit channeling, what’s more someone with the Celestial Worthy’s bestowment.
unit.target: Celestial Worthy altiorem dignitatem habebat quam multi dei mali, et corruptio horum deorum malorum posset ducere ad directum spiritus infaustum; praeterea, aliquis, qui dono a Celestial Worthy praeditus esset.

unit.source: Recognizing this, Bard’s heart settled.
unit.target: Hoc agnovens, cor Bard consolatum est.

unit.source: As a Swindler, he maintained a terrified expression, stepping back two paces as he looked at Lumian.
unit.target: Ut fraudator, vultum territus tenuit, duo passus recedens dum ad Lumian spectabat.

unit.source: “I’ll spill it all, no lies. You can verify it! Don’t kill me!”
unit.target: “Omnia effundam, sine mendaciis. Potes id comprobāre! Noli me interficere!”

unit.source: Lumian approached him step by step, brandishing a dagger.
unit.target: Lumian eum gradatim appropinquavit, pugionem gerens.

unit.source: Bard turned to Hela, Gandalf, and Franca, pleading in a “panicked” tone,
unit.target: Bard ad Hela, Gandalf, et Francam se convertit, voce pavida obsecro.

unit.source: “He’s lost his mind, and you’re just going to let him be? Spirit channeling isn’t all-powerful!”
unit.target: “Iam mentem amisit; et vobis licet eum derelinquere? Directio spiritus omnipotens non est!”

unit.source: Bard deliberately used “him” as a pronoun, signaling that he knew Lumian wasn’t Muggle, as if urging them not to play along.
unit.target: Bard consulto pronomen “eum” usus est, demonstrans se scire Lumian non esse Muggle, quasi eos admonens ne ludificant.

unit.source: In two steps, Lumian arrived in front of Bard, casting his gaze at the April Fool’s key member, who couldn’t temporarily change his appearance back.
unit.target: Duo passus faciens, Lumian ante Bard pervenit, oculos immitiens in membrum clavem Aprilis Stultorum, qui speciem suam ad tempus redire non poterat.

unit.source: He raised the dagger in his hand.
unit.target: Pugionem in manu levavit.

unit.source: Bard sneered inwardly, growing more convinced that Lumian Lee wouldn’t actually end his life for spirit channeling—at least not yet.
unit.target: Bard intus subsurridens, magisque confidens factus est Lumian Lee vitam suam vere non interficere propter spiritus directum—saltem nondum.

unit.source: If his current actions weren’t an act, Gandalf and Hela would have intervened no matter what. They wouldn’t just stand by!
unit.target: Si actus eius praesens non esset simulatio, Gandalf et Hela intervenissent, quaquo modo; neque simpliciter consisterent!

unit.source: Bard strained his throat and shouted, as if terrorized, “I’ll genuinely cooperate with you! I’ll assist you in locating Loki and his ancient castle! See, I didn’t even use my powers to resist in such a situation!”
unit.target: Bard fauces tensit et clamavit, quasi territus, “Vere tecum cooperabor! Te adiuvabo ut Lokim et antiquum castellum eius invenias! Ecce, virtutes meas ne ad repugnandum in tali re quidem non usus sum!”

unit.source: As Bard shouted, he fixed his gaze on Lumian and the dagger’s tip, attempting to convey evasion and pleading through his eyes. The former conveyed fear, and the latter was a plea for mercy.
unit.target: Dum Bard clamabat, oculos suos in Lumian et apicem pugionis fixabat, conans per oculos evasionem atque obsecrationem exprimere. Primum timorem significabat, et secundum precationem misericordiae.

unit.source: Throughout this process, Bard’s heart was filled with mockery, almost void of panic.
unit.target: Per hunc processum, cor Bard iocositate plenum erat, paene carens pavore.

unit.source: Trying to deceive a Swindler?
unit.target: Conaris fraudatorem fallere?

unit.source: What a ludicrous notion!
unit.target: Quam ridicula sententia!

unit.source: I bet you’ll stop after I count to five!
unit.target: Certus sum te desinere postquam ad quinque numerabo!

unit.source: Five, four, three…
unit.target: Quinque, quattuor, tres…

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Bard’s vision suddenly turned blood‑red as the dagger thrust into his left eye, piercing through the gap in the eye socket and into his brain.
unit.target: Visio Bard subito in rubro sanguine convertebatur, cum pugio in oculum sinistrum eius peniciebatur, per foramina orbitæ transiens atque in cerebrum eius intrans.

unit.source: Impossible!
unit.target: Impossibile!

unit.source: Absolutely impossible!
unit.target: Absolute impossibile!

unit.source: Is he truly going to kill me?
unit.target: Num vere me interficiet?

unit.source: Intense pain overwhelmed Bard’s mind, prompting him to instinctively raise his right hand and press it against his face.
unit.target: Intensus dolor mentem Bard oppressit, incitans eum instinctu dextram manum levare et contra faciem premere.

unit.source: He fought in the opposite direction, striving to put some distance between himself and the dagger, the source of the agonizing damage.
unit.target: In contrariam partem pugnavit, conatus spatium inter se et pugionis, fontem doloris acerbi creare.

unit.source: Lumian reached out with his left hand, pinning Bard in place and making his struggles futile.
unit.target: Lumian manum sinistram extendit, Bard stabile retinens et eius conatus inanes faciens.

unit.source: Then, Lumian leaned forward slightly and whispered into the ear of the April Fool’s key member.
unit.target: Deinde, Lumian paulum se inclinavit et in aure membri clavi Aprilis Stultorum susurravit.

unit.source: Bard glimpsed Muggle’s beautiful face, her rosy lips moving as she whispered
unit.target: Bard intuefactus est pulchram faciem Muggle, labris rosatis movebant, dum susurrabat.

unit.source: —a whisper filled with satisfaction and mockery, “My godson has gnawed on half of Loki’s arm and knows a lot about him. I believe that knowledge surpasses yours…”
unit.target: —Susurro satisfactione et derisione pleno, “Meus filius adoptivus dimidium bracchii Loki morditus est et multa de eo novit. Credo hanc scientiam tuam superare…”

unit.source: Surpasses mine… If I had known earlier, I would have utilized my powers… Even in the midst of pain and struggle, Bard was momentarily stunned, feeling frustration, despair, and embarrassment.
unit.target: Scientia mea superatur… Si antea scivissem, virtutes meas adhibuissem… Etiam inter dolorem et certamen, Bard paulisper stupefactus est, sentiens frustrationem, desperationem, et pudorem.

unit.source: Soon, these emotions dissipated.
unit.target: Cito, hae animi motus evanuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian gripped the dagger embedded in Bard’s eye socket and twisted it a few times, crushing the frontal lobe.
unit.target: Lumian pugionem, in orbitam oculi Bard immissum, arripuit et aliquoties torquens, lobum frontale conterens.

unit.source: Observing Bard, who had now calmed down, Lumian nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Bard, qui iam tranquillus erat, spectans, Lumian cum satisfactione annuit.

unit.source: He withdrew his dagger and earnestly assisted the other party in stemming the bleeding and bandaging the wound, though he skipped the disinfectant.
unit.target: Pugionem recepit et alteri eorum strenue auxiliatus est ut sanguinem cohiberet et vulnus circumligaret, sed purgatorium non adhibuit.

unit.source: Only then did Franca approach and click her tongue.
unit.target: Tunc Franca accessit et linguam strinxit.

unit.source: “I thought you were just scaring him.”
unit.target: “Putabam te eum solum terrere.”

unit.source: That’s why she didn’t intervene. She had watched as Lumian advanced toward Bard, dagger in hand, witnessing Bard’s pleas for mercy.
unit.target: Ideo ea non intervenit. Observaverat quomodo Lumian ad Bard accesserit, pugione in manu, et preces Bardis misericordiae vidisset.

unit.source: She believed Hela and Gandalf had similar expectations.
unit.target: Credebat Hela et Gandalf similes exspectationes habere.

unit.source: When the dagger pierced Bard’s eye socket, Franca was taken aback. It was only then that she realized Lumian was serious!
unit.target: Quando pugio orbitam oculi Bard percussit, Franca obstupefacta est. Tunc tantum intellexit Lumian vero serio agere!

unit.source: No, Lumian didn’t truly intend to kill Bard. Instead, he planned to employ the April Fool’s created prank to deal with him, recreating the original state of I Know Someone.
unit.target: Non, Lumian vere Bard interficere non intendebat. Proinde, consilium habebat uti ioco a April Fool creato ad eum aggrediendum, statum originalem "I Know Someone" recriandi.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Franca asked curiously, “When did you master lobotomy?”
unit.target: Sine Lumiani responsione exspectans, Franca curiosa rogavit, “Quando lobotomiae artem didicisti?”

unit.source: Lumian wiped the blood off the dagger with a white strap and smirked mockingly.
unit.target: Lumian sanguinem de pugione stramine albo delevit et deriso risu subridens.

unit.source: “I learned it from watching the doctor perform surgery on I Know Someone.
unit.target: “Id didici ex conspectu medici qui chirurgiam in "I Know Someone" exercuit.

unit.source: “It’s such a simple procedure. As a Beyonder skilled in action, if I can’t memorize and imitate it after watching it once, it only proves that my brain has been corrupted by the potion.”
unit.target: “Processus tam simplex est. Ut Beyonder in actu peritus, si id, post unam visionem, meminisse atque imitari non possum, id solum demonstrat meum cerebrum ab potione corruptum esse.”

unit.source: Impersonating Muggle, Lumian deliberately spoke in his sister’s voice, as if she were still alive.
unit.target: Muggle imitando, Lumian deliberato in voce sororis suae locutus est, quasi illa adhuc esset viva.

unit.source: Franca looked at Aurore’s face under the hood and listened to her voice.
unit.target: Franca aspexit faciem Aurore sub pallio et vocem eius auscultavit.

unit.source: She wasn’t angered by the mockery.
unit.target: Ea derisio non irritata est.

unit.source: She only muttered, “The surgery isn’t just about inserting and stirring a few times. There are still many key points before and after the procedure. Even during the surgery, if you insert it just a bit deeper, the outcome will be entirely different.”
unit.target: Vociferavit tantum, “Chirurgia non solum consistit in aliquoties inserendo et miscendo. Multa tamen sunt puncta clavis ante ac post processum. Etiam inter ipsam chirurgiam, si paulo altius infunderis, exitus omnino diversus erit.”

unit.source: “So be it. If he really dies, we’ll commence the spirit channeling.”
unit.target: “Sic fiat. Si vere moriatur, directio spiritus incipiet.”

unit.source: Lumian casually poured the remaining truth serum into the mouth of the stunned Bard, who offered no resistance.
unit.target: Lumian relictum serum veritatis in os Bard stupefacti leviter infudit, qui nullam repugnationem ostendit.

unit.source: After completing this task, he added, “Madam Hela mentioned that this place can minimize the influence of evil gods.”
unit.target: Hoc confecto, addidit: “Domina Hela dixit hunc locum influentiam deorum malorum minuere posse.”

unit.source: “It’s only minimal, not zero. Besides, what if the problem lies in his spirit, and he self‑destructs?”
unit.target: “Minima tantum est, non nulla. Praeterea, quid si in spiritu ejus quaestio sit, et ipse se deleat?”

unit.source: Franca instinctively retorted.
unit.target: Franca instinctu respondit.

unit.source: This was why Hela hadn’t directly pulled Bard into a dream to extract his true answers.
unit.target: Idcirco Hela Bard non directe in somnium traxerat ut veras responsiones eius extraheretur.

unit.source: After all, the dream might present scenes that shouldn’t be seen. This was even more dangerous than simple verbal descriptions.
unit.target: Postremo, somnium scaenas ostendere posset, quae non videre debent; hoc etiam gravius erat quam simplices verbales descriptiones.

unit.source: Only then did Gandalf, draped in a linen robe and a hood, sigh softly.
unit.target: Tunc tantum Gandalf, indutus linteis vestibus et pallio, leniter suspiravit.

unit.source: He couldn’t bear to witness Bard’s suffering, but he didn’t discourage the actions taken.
unit.target: Non ferre potuit ut passionem Bard videre, sed actus non deterruit.

unit.source: He wasn’t the one who had been harmed by April Fool’s. He wasn’t in a position to criticize the victim’s family for their extreme actions.
unit.target: Ipse non erat qui ab April Fool’s laesus esset. Non erat in statu ut familiae victimæ propter actiones extremas reprehenderet.

unit.source: Before this operation, Hela had briefed Gandalf on Muggle’s demise and Lumian Lee’s role.
unit.target: Ante hanc operationem, Hela Gandalf de decessu Muggle et munere Lumian Lee breviter certiorem fecit.

unit.source: The president of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society sympathized with the siblings’ plight, but he also blamed himself.
unit.target: Praesidens Societatis Inquisitionis Simiorum Crispis Capillis, cum infortunio fratrum et sororum commotus, et se ipsum culpavit.

unit.source: He believed that the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society had been unrestrained. As president, he bore a heavy responsibility.
unit.target: Credidit Societatem Inquisitionis Simiorum Crispis Capillis non esse moderatam. Ut praesidens, grave officium gerebat.

unit.source: After a moment, Bard, who had undergone a “requiem” and gradually recovered from his pain, started addressing the queries of the people present.
unit.target: Post aliquod momentum, Bard, qui ‘requiem’ subiit et paulatim ex dolore restitutus est, quaestiones praesentium audientium aggredi incipiebat.

unit.source: The first to inquire was Gandalf. He peered down at the Dream Stealer and asked, “How did you come to believe in that Celestial Worthy?”
unit.target: Primum interrogans fuit Gandalf. Ad Somnium Furum intuitus, quaesivit, “Quomodo incipis credere in illum Celestial Worthy?”

unit.source: Gandalf and Hela had already gathered intel on Celestial Worthy from Franca and Lumian, and they deemed it crucial.
unit.target: Gandalf et Hela iam notitias de Celestial Worthy a Franca et Lumiano colligaverant, et id maximopere esse arbitrabantur.

unit.source: Bard responded calmly, “From the beginning. I used to be a cultural relic thief and acquired a batch of ancient items. While studying their history to ascertain their value, I deciphered the meaning of some inscriptions…”
unit.target: Bard tranquille respondit, “Ex initio. Olim fur rerum culturalium reliquiarum eram et seriem antiquitatis rerum acquisivi. Dum historiam eorum ad pretium agnoscendum perscrutabar, quasdam inscriptiones interpretatus sum…”

unit.source: Abruptly, Hela cut Bard’s narration short and said coldly,
unit.target: Subito, Hela narrationem Bardis breviter interemit et frigide dixit,

unit.source: “You don’t have to explain the full meaning. Just mention a few keywords.”
unit.target: “Non oportet totum sensum explanare. Pauca tantum verba clavis commemora.”

unit.source: Bard had no intention of arguing. He remained as docile as a sheep.
unit.target: Bard nullam contendendi intentionem habebat. Mansit mansuetus sicut ovis.

unit.source: “Keywords include: Deception, Fooling, Door of All Doors, Lord of Mysteries…
unit.target: “Verba clavis includunt: Fallacia, Simulatio, Porta Omnium Portarum, Dominus Mysteriorum…

unit.source: As Bard finished speaking, the ancient palace they were in suddenly became misty and unclear.
unit.target: Dum Bard sermonem finivit, antiquum palatium in quo erant subito in nebulam et incertum versa est.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s left chest burned again.
unit.target: Simul, pectus sinistrum Lumiani iterum ardebat.

unit.source: In the next moment, the night sky outside the palace darkened even more, and all the mist vanished.
unit.target: Segue momento, caelum nocturnum extra palatium adhuc obscure factum est, et omnis nebula evanuit.

unit.source: “Why did I feel like worms were growing in me just now?” Franca felt a lingering fear.
unit.target: “Cur mihi videtur ut vermes in me nunc tantum crescere?” Franca timorem manentem sensit.

unit.source: Merely a few names, incomplete honorific names, made her inexplicably uneasy.
unit.target: Sola pauca nomina, nomina honorifica imperfecta, eam inexplicabiliter solicam fecerunt.

unit.source: Every inch of her flesh seemed to come alive, about to transform into worms crawling out of her skin.
unit.target: Omnis parcella carnis eius videbatur animari, parata in vermes ex cute ejus conversa esse.

unit.source: One of Bard’s initial plans was to answer Lumian and company’s questions dishonestly and without reservation.
unit.target: Unus ex consiliis primariis Bard erat quaestionibus Lumiani et sociorum mendaciter et sine dubitatione responde.

unit.source: Then, he would take the initiative to reveal all the details regarding Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Deinde, incepturus erat ut omnia de Celestial Worthy notitia demonstraret.

unit.source: He wanted to see if he could secretly corrupt his enemies and shake the Nation of the Evernight’s concealments to create a “door” to escape.
unit.target: Volebat videre an hostes suos occulte corrumpere posset et occultationes Nationis Perpetuae Noctis concutere ad “portam” ad fugam creandam.

unit.source: “If I could really use this to corrupt Gandalf and Hela, why would they kill me when we’re all Celestial Worthy believers? We would definitely work together to deal with Lumian Lee!”
unit.target: “Si id revera ad corrumpendos Gandalf et Hela uti possem, cur me interficerent, cum omnes in Celestial Worthy credentes simus? Certissime simul agerem ad Lumian Lee tractandum!”

unit.source: Of course, Bard no longer harbored such thoughts. He had obtained an inevitable peace.
unit.target: Certe, Bard talia cogitare iam non habebat. Pacem inevitablem accepit.

unit.source: “Descriptions of high‑level existences often indicate danger. In this world, ignorance might not be a bad thing.” Gandalf sighed and assessed what had just happened.
unit.target: “Descriptiones existentiarum altarum saepe periculum ostendunt. In hoc mundo, ignorantia non omnino mala est.” Gandalf suspiravit et ea quae nuper evenit consideravit.

unit.source: He then inquired about the follow‑up.
unit.target: Deinde de subsequentibus quaesivit.

unit.source: Bard’s expression remained unchanged as he said, “After deciphering the words, I lost consciousness. When I woke up, I had already transmigrated to this world.
unit.target: Vultus Bard immutatus remansit, dicens, “Post verba elucidanda, conscientiam amisi. Cum experrectus essem, iam in hunc mundum transmigraveram.

unit.source: “After adapting to my new body, I instinctively recalled my previous encounters and the words I had deciphered. Then, I saw a thin gray fog emanating from my surroundings and received a revelation from the Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: “Postquam ad novum corpus meum adaptatus sum, instinctu commissi prius congressus et verba quae elucidaveram recolui. Deinde tenuem nebulam griseam ex circumstantibus meis emansam vidi et revelationem a Celestial Worthy accepi.

unit.source: “In other words, you believed in that Celestial Worthy as soon as you transmigrated, before the establishment of the Research Society?” Gandalf probed further.
unit.target: “Alio modo, credidisti in illum Celestial Worthy statim postquam transmigraveras, ante constitutionem Societatis Inquisitionis?” Gandalf ulterius rogavit.

unit.source: “Yes.” Bard’s emotions lacked any fluctuations. “Back then, I thought that if I didn’t choose to submit, believe in Him, or follow Him, I might die on the spot. When that happened, I might not have a chance to transmigrate and revive. Later, I gradually realized His greatness. He could even fool the Nation of the Evernight and prevent our problems from being discovered.”
unit.target: “Ita,” Bard respondit, cuius affectus nullas mutationes ostendebant. “Illo tempore putabam, si non elegissem cedere, in Eum credere, aut Eum sequi, statim moriturus fore. Si ita evenisset, fortasse occasionem non haberem ut transmigrarer et revivissem. Postea, paulatim magnitudinem Eius intellexi. Etiam Nationem Perpetuae Noctis fallere posset, ne problemata nostra detegerentur.”

unit.source: Gandalf pondered for a moment and asked, “How did Loki come to believe in that Celestial Worthy?”
unit.target: Gandalf paulisper meditatus est et rogavit, “Quomodo Loki credere coepit in illum Celestial Worthy?”

unit.source: 593 Fooled
unit.target: 593 Illusi

unit.source: 593 Fooled
unit.target: 593 Illusi

unit.source: In response to Gandalf’s question, Bard recounted the past with a directness that left little room for ambiguity.
unit.target: Ad quaestionem Gandalfi respondens, Bard praeterita narravit cum directitudine quae parum spatii ad ambiguitatem reliquit.

unit.source: “I don’t know.
unit.target: “Nescio.

unit.source: He didn’t tell me.
unit.target: „Non mihi dixit.

unit.source: After the founding of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, I began to notice the guy’s actions and demeanor mirroring the influence of the Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Post institutionem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum, coepi animadvertere actus et habitum eius, qui influentiam Caelestis Digni repraesentabant.

unit.source: Likewise, he saw the same in me, prompting a mutual inquiry.
unit.target: Similiter, eum idem in me conspexit, quod mutuam inquisitionem excitavit.

unit.source: Eventually, we confirmed each other’s intentions, and assembled an April Fool’s team.
unit.target: Postremo, voluntates nostras inter nos confirmavimus et turmam “Aprilis Stultorum” congregavimus.

unit.source: Gandalf and Hela probed about the Celestial Worthy, but with no breakthroughs, Lumian, disguised as a Muggle, shifted his gaze to Bard and asked, “What was your crew’s aim in disrupting the sea prayer ritual?”
unit.target: Gandalf et Hela de Caelesti Digno indagaverunt, sed sine ullis inventis; Lumian, ut Muggle simulatus, aspectum suum in Bard vertit et rogavit: “Quae fuit propositum turmae tuae in perturbando ritu precationis maris?”

unit.source: “To control the underwater spaceship.
unit.target: “Navem spatialis subaquaticam regere.

unit.source: It’s our ticket to traversing the cosmos and holding our ground against Angels to some extent…”
unit.target: Est clavis nostra ad perambulandum universum et ad locum nostrum retinendum adversus Angelos, ad modicum.

unit.source: Bard revealed April Fool’s plan.
unit.target: Bard consilium “Aprilis Stultorum” enarravit.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curved upward.
unit.target: Labia Lumiani sursum incurvata sunt.

unit.source: “Do you know what’s sealed in the depths of that spaceship?”
unit.target: “Scisne quid in profundis illius navis spatialis clausum sit?”

unit.source: At this revelation, Franca suddenly grasped the core issue.
unit.target: Ad hanc revelationem, Franca subito rem centralem intellexit.

unit.source: Spaceship?
unit.target: Navis spatialis?

unit.source: The thing at the bottom of Port Santa is a spaceship?
unit.target: Res in imo Port Santa est navis spatialis?

unit.source: Isn’t this too sci‑fi and not mystical enough?
unit.target: Nonne hoc nimis scientiae fictae pertinet atque non satis mysticum est?

unit.source: Does this world have everything?
unit.target: Habetne hic mundus omnia?

unit.source: To expedite the interrogation of Bard, a key member of April Fool’s, Lumian and Franca had entered the Nation of the Evernight without much communication.
unit.target: Ut interrogationi Bard, membri cardinalis “Aprilis Stultorum,” festinandum esset, Lumian et Franca in Nationem Perpetuae Noctis sine multis sermonibus intraverunt.

unit.source: “Spaceship…” Gandalf echoed the term, his tone brimming with unmistakable yearning.
unit.target: “Navis spatialis…” repetuit Gandalf, tono conspicuo desiderii.

unit.source: Hela maintained a silence akin to the depths of night.
unit.target: Hela silentium retinuit, quod simile erat profundis noctis.

unit.source: Bard responded to Lumian’s inquiry, “According to our interpretation of the language and the insights from the Celestial Worthy, that spacecraft functions as both a petri dish and an incubation chamber.
unit.target: Secundum nostram interpretationem linguae atque perspicientiam a Caelesti Digno, illa navis spatialis fungitur tamquam vas microbiologicum et camera incubationis.

unit.source: It’s nurturing a high‑level creature.
unit.target: Illud colit creaturam potentiae supremae.

unit.source: Control the spaceship, and you control it.
unit.target: Domina navem spatialis, et eam dominas.

unit.source: Without that control, the spacecraft alone won’t stand a chance against an Angel.”
unit.target: Sine ea potestate, navis spatialis sola nihil contra Angelum poterit.

unit.source: The smile of “Aurore” became even more alluring.
unit.target: Risus “Aurore” etiam magis alliciens factus est.

unit.source: “Ever wondered why the ancient Angel who sealed the spaceship didn’t take control of it?
unit.target: “Numquamne miratus es cur Angelus antiquus, qui navem spatialis clausit, eam non ceperit?

unit.source: Why didn’t They command the high‑level creature or destroy it outright?”
unit.target: Cur non imperaverunt creaturam potentiae supremae aut eam omnino delere?

unit.source: Bard fell silent momentarily before articulating, “It might take a considerable time for the high‑level creature to mature.
unit.target: Bard paulisper silentium tenuit, deinde dīcere coepit: “Creatura potentiae supremae ad maturitatem longum tempus postulat.

unit.source: Taking control of the spaceship would halt everything.
unit.target: Navem spatialis regere omnia sisteret.

unit.source: Patience is required until the recent few years—just before the creature is due—before it can be managed.”
unit.target: Patientia opus est usque ad paucos annos recentissimos—modo antequam creatura suam maturitatem adimpleat—antequam eam regere liceat.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile beneath the hood grew brighter.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani sub velamine clarior factus est.

unit.source: “If that’s the case, the ancient Angel who sealed the high‑level creature will definitely reappear.
unit.target: “Si ita est, Angelus antiquus, qui creaturam potentiae supremae clausit, certo iterum apparebit.

unit.source: Did you have the confidence to resist an Angel and win the spaceship?
unit.target: Num fiduciam habuisti ut Angelum resisteres atque navem spatialis obtineres?

unit.source: Or do you believe the Angel either didn’t try to decipher or couldn’t decipher the true meaning of those commands?”
unit.target: An putas Angelum vel non conatus esse mandata vera interpretari, vel non potuisse illas interpretari?

unit.source: “It’s been so many years—They might have already perished…”
unit.target: “Multos iam annos praeterierunt—fortasse iam perierunt…”

unit.source: In his dream, a creature on the altar, potentially the avatar of an ancient Angel, hinted that the Angel might still be observing Milo Village and those waters.
unit.target: In somnio, creatura in altare—fortasse avatar Angelus antiquus—insinuavit Angelum adhuc Milonis vicum et aquas observare.

unit.source: “Why didn’t we think to confirm it before embarking on the entire plan…” Bard voiced his doubts, his emotions showing no apparent shifts.
unit.target: “Cur non confirmavimus id antequam totum consilium iniremur?” dīxit Bard, dubitationes suas exprimens, cum affectūs eius nullam mutationem ostenderent.

unit.source: Lumian replied with a smile, “I can tell you that the spaceship isn’t sealed with a high‑level creature.
unit.target: Lumian subrisu respondit: “Tibi dicere possum: navis spatialis non est clausa cum creatura potentiae supremae.

unit.source: It’s an incomplete, nascent black hole.
unit.target: Est foramen nigrum inchoatum et nascens.

unit.source: Once unsealed and piloted away, it will absorb the mystical body housing it, suck you guys in, and completely take shape, tearing apart and devouring the current world.
unit.target: Postquam dissolutum et gubernatum erit, corpus mysticum, quod eum complectitur, absorbet, vos omnes attrahens, atque omnino formam capiet, mundum praesentem disrumpens atque devorans.

unit.source: “Back then, the ancient Angels didn’t attempt to control it because it was dangerous, idiot!”
unit.target: “Tum, Angeli antiqui id regere non conati sunt, quoniam periculosum erat, stulte!”

unit.source: Bard was once again taken aback, as if he had never considered such a possibility.
unit.target: Bard iterum miratus est, quasi talem possibilitatem numquam consideraverit.

unit.source: After a moment, he hesitated and said, “We… might have… been fooled…”
unit.target: Post aliquantulum, cunctatus est et dixit: “Nos forsitan decepti sumus…”

unit.source: Though Bard’s emotions remained unchanging, the blood‑colored liquid that trickled from the simple bandage down the bridge of his nose painted a tragic and mournful picture.
unit.target: Etsi affectūs Bardis stabile manserunt, liquidus sanguineus, qui ex simplici vinculo per nasum eius stillabat, imaginem tragicam et lugubrem depinxit.

unit.source: Lumian burst into laughter, his back bending slightly.
unit.target: Lumian erupit in risum, dorsum leviter flectente.

unit.source: “Do you only now realize that you’ve all been fooled by that Celestial Worthy?
unit.target: “Num modo nunc intellegitis vos omnes ab eo Caelesti Digno deceptos esse?

unit.source: He provided revelations to mislead you.
unit.target: Ipse revelationes dedit ut vos deciperet.

unit.source: Through your deaths, He could open the seal and destroy this world to achieve His goals!
unit.target: Per vestras mortes, potuit sigillum aperire et hunc mundum destruere ad proposita Sua assequenda!

unit.source: “Haha, April Fool’s, indeed an organization of fools!”
unit.target: “Haha, ‘Aprilis Stultorum’—re vera congregatio stultorum!”

unit.source: Bard fell into silence once more, then candidly expressed his thoughts.
unit.target: Bard iterum silentium cepit, deinde aperte cogitationes suas exprimens.

unit.source: “We’re fools, truly fools…”
unit.target: “Stulti sumus, vere stulti…”

unit.source: Meanwhile, Gandalf and the others had varied reactions.
unit.target: Interim, Gandalf et ceteri diversas responsiones habuerunt.

unit.source: Dammit, a black hole? Destroy this world? Franca had thought the news of a spaceship was explosive enough, but she hadn’t expected something even more terrifying to follow.
unit.target: Heu, foramen nigrum? Hunc mundum delere? Franca putavit nuntium de navis spatialis satis explosivum esse, sed aliquid adhuc terribilius sequenti non exspectaverat.

unit.source: And an entity creating a black hole?
unit.target: Et entitas foramen nigrum fingens?

unit.source: Franca, lacking direct understanding of top‑level powers, realized the magnitude of such a great existence.
unit.target: Franca, directa potentiarum summarum intellegentia carens, magnitudinem talis existentiae magni intellexit.

unit.source: Previously, she felt she had a sufficient understanding of the world. Now, she admitted frankly, I’m still a f*cking elementary school student!
unit.target: Prius putabat se satis mundi intellexisse; nunc, aperte agnovit: “Etiam adhuc sum discipulus rudis scholae elementariae!”

unit.source: Gandalf took a deep breath and said, “If I become a god, it would be so convenient for me to conduct research… Black holes…”
unit.target: Gandalf alte spiritum tulit et dīxit: “Si deus fiam, mihi valde commode erit investigare… foramina nigra…”

unit.source: Hela retrieved a metal flask from her black widow clothes and took a sip, her thoughts inscrutable.
unit.target: Hela ex vestimentis “viduae nigrae” lagena metallicam extraxit et sorbis cepit, cogitationes eius inenarrabiles.

unit.source: Lumian’s laughter echoed for a moment, providing a brief respite.
unit.target: Risu Lumiani brevi momento resonavit, levem solacium praebens.

unit.source: However, underlying pain still gripped his heart, resonating in the shadows within.
unit.target: Attamen, dolor subjacens adhuc cor eius premebat, in umbris interioribus resonans.

unit.source: It couldn’t be eradicated or dismissed.
unit.target: Nec tolli nec neglegi poterat.

unit.source: In the presence of the key members of April Fool’s, memories of his sister Aurore’s tragic fate couldn’t be ignored.
unit.target: In praesentia membrorum cardinalium “Aprilis Stultorum,” memoria tragoediae sororis suae Aurore neglegi non poterat.

unit.source: Bard stood there, a silent reminder of a fact deliberately overlooked.
unit.target: Bard ibi stetit, monefactus tacitus rei deliberanter neglectae.

unit.source: Hence, Lumian couldn’t help but utter, “kill him and channel his spirit,” resorting to action in a half‑truth manner.
unit.target: Itaque, Lumian non potuit non dīcere: “occide eum et spiritum eius dirige,” agendo in modo semivero.

unit.source: Looking at Bard, Lumian inquired, “Do you know if Ultraman and Mad Lady have been to Cordu?”
unit.target: Intuens Bard, Lumian rogavit: “Scisne utrum Ultraman et Mad Lady ad Cordu venerint?”

unit.source: “Yes,” replied Bard.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Bard.

unit.source: Part of our original plan was to find Nolfi’s child, the sea maid.
unit.target: Pars consilii nostri originalis fuit invenire filiam Nolfi, ancillam maris.

unit.source: She lived in Intis’s Riston Province.
unit.target: Illa in Provincia Riston Intis habitabat.

unit.source: A stopover at Cordu was intended to confirm Muggle’s situation and the final outcome of the prank.
unit.target: Statio apud Cordu destinata erat ad confirmandum statum “Muggle” et exitum finalem ioci.

unit.source: At the mention of “prank,” a vein on Lumian’s forehead throbbed.
unit.target: Pro mentione “ioci,” vena in fronte Lumiani pulsavit.

unit.source: “How could you be so sure that Muggle was already dead?”
unit.target: “Quomodo tam certus esse potuisti quod Muggle iam mortuus esset?”

unit.source: Hearing Lumian—disguised as a Muggle—pose this question, Gandalf let out another inaudible sigh.
unit.target: Audito Lumiani, qui ut Muggle simulabatur, hanc quaestionem posuisse, Gandalf aliud suspirium inaudibilem emisit.

unit.source: Franca sighed inwardly.
unit.target: Franca interioriter suspiravit.

unit.source: Bard shook his head.
unit.target: Bard caput concussit.

unit.source: “I’m unsure.
unit.target: “Nescio.

unit.source: Mad Lady and Ultraman went.
unit.target: Mad Lady et Ultraman profecti sunt.

unit.source: They informed me the village was wiped out.
unit.target: Mihi nuntiaverunt vicum omnino deletum esse.

unit.source: No chance for anyone to make it out alive.
unit.target: Nulla erat occasio ut quisquam vivus effugiret.

unit.source: They might have even employed divination, spirit channeling, and such to be sure.”
unit.target: Forsitan etiam divinationem, spiritus tractationem, et similia consilia ad certitudinem adhibuerunt.

unit.source: “Impossible for anyone to survive?”
unit.target: “Numquid quisquam superstes esse potest?”

unit.source: Lumian smiled. “Am I not human?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dīxit: “Nonne sum humanus?”

unit.source: Bard glanced at him and spoke his mind.
unit.target: Bard eum intuebatur et aperte dīxit.

unit.source: “You might not even pass as human anymore.”
unit.target: “Forsitan iam non videaris humanus.”

unit.source: That’s not wrong.
unit.target: Non erras.

unit.source: I’m now a humanoid Sealed Artifact with self‑awareness and fate…
unit.target: Nunc ego sum artifactum sigillatum humanoide, cum conscientia et fato…

unit.source: Lumian made a self‑deprecating remark before adding, “The number of survivors is greater than you can imagine. A certain madame, her husband, butler, and maidservant had fled.”
unit.target: Lumian se ipsum humiliter incentivus ad eius addendum dīxit: “Numerus superstitorum maior est quam imaginari potes. Quaedam domina, maritus eius, cubicularius, et ancilla effugerunt.”

unit.source: Without giving Bard a chance to respond, Lumian inquired further,
unit.target: Sine Bard opportunitatem respondendi dandam, Lumian ulterius interrogavit:

unit.source: “What was Loki trying to achieve with the Muggle incident?”
unit.target: “Quid conari voluit Loki per rem Muggle?”

unit.source: “I wasn’t deeply involved.
unit.target: “Non valde implicatus eram.

unit.source: Just tossed in a few ideas; not much in the loop,” Bard admitted honestly.
unit.target: Modo paucas ideās conieci; nihil plurimum intererat,” sincē dīxit Bard.

unit.source: “Ultraman might have a clue.
unit.target: “Fortasse Ultraman aliquam indagationem habet.

unit.source: He and Loki teamed up in other ventures.”
unit.target: Ipse et Loki in aliis negotiis se coniunxerunt.

unit.source: “In what ventures?” Lumian persisted.
unit.target: “In quibus negotiis?” perseveravit Lumian.

unit.source: Bard shook his head slowly.
unit.target: Bard caput leviter concussit.

unit.source: “Not entirely sure about the specifics. It’s tied to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.”
unit.target: “Non omnino certus sum de singularibus. Attinet ad Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Ardoris.”

unit.source: Connected to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church? Ultraman, a Sequence 5 Priest of Light on the Sun pathway… The humanoid Sealed Artifact lost by the church on the betrothal ship… Lumian’s instincts kicked in.
unit.target: Ad Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Ardoris coniunctum est? Ultraman, Sacerdos Ordinis Quintae Luminis in via Solari, et artifactum sigillatum humanoide, ab Ecclesia in nave nuptiali amissum, – Lumiani instinctus subito excitati sunt.

unit.source: “Any key April Fool’s members that are not transmigrators?”
unit.target: “Numquid sunt membri cardinales ‘Aprilis Stultorum’, qui non sint transmigratores?”

unit.source: They had previously misconstrued April Fool’s as a gang of degenerated transmigrators.
unit.target: Praeteritae opiniones fecerunt “Aprilis Stultorum” esse coetum transmigratorum degeneratorum.

unit.source: Yet, as an organization, it naturally expanded.
unit.target: Sed ut ordo, naturaliter crevit.

unit.source: After all these years, April Fool’s likely harbored more key members!
unit.target: Post tot annos, “Aprilis Stultorum” verisimiliter plures membra cardinalia albergabat!

unit.source: Bard nodded.
unit.target: Bard annuit.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: As expected… Lumian shot a glance at Franca, garbed in Assassin attire, seeking confirmation from Bard.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur… Lumian Francam intuens, quae habitu Assassina induta erat, a Bard confirmationem quaesivit.

unit.source: “One of them is a Purifier from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and he holds a decent status?”
unit.target: “Unus ex illis est Purgator ab Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris, et dignum statum habet?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Bard confirmed again.
unit.target: “Ita,” iterum confirmavit Bard.

unit.source: Thanks to him, we got wind of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact we could utilize when we altered our plan.
unit.target: Eum grātiā, de Artifactō Sigillātō Grādus I nuntiati sumus, quem in nostro consiliō adhibēre poterāmus.

unit.source: He even assisted in its escape from the seal.
unit.target: Etiam in effugiendō id ex sigillō adiuvit.

unit.source: “And who might this person be?” Franca inquired, stepping in for the absent 007.
unit.target: “Et quis hic sit?” inrogavit Franca, pro absente 007 interveniens.

unit.source: “It’s a one‑way line to Loki,” Bard indicated, revealing his lack of knowledge about the member’s true identity.
unit.target: “Est linea unius sensus ad Loki,” Bard dēclarāvit, ignorantiam suam de vera huius membris identitāte patefaciēns.

unit.source: Franca chuckled, saying, “If the Eternal Blazing Sun Church launches an inquiry, they might stumble upon some leads.”
unit.target: Franca subrīsū dīxit: “Si Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris quaestionem inchoaverit, fortasse aliquam viam ad investigandum invenient.”

unit.source: Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts weren’t just lying around. They couldn’t be pilfered casually!
unit.target: Artifacta Sigillāta Grādus I non solum undique iacebant; neque facile furto sublabi poterant!

unit.source: Lumian, noting Gandalf and Hela had no more queries, turned to Bard.
unit.target: Lumian, animadvertere Gandalfum et Helam nullās alias quaestiones habēre, ad Bard conversus est.

unit.source: “What intel do you have on Loki’s ancient castle?”
unit.target: “Quid de castello antiquo Loki scis?”

unit.source: “It goes by the name Dylan—a charming name,” Bard began.
unit.target: “Dylan vocatur—nomen decora,” incepit Bard.

unit.source: Loki once told me it’s a concealed ancient castle.
unit.target: Loki olim mihi dīxit id esse castellum antiquum celātum.

unit.source: Impossible to discover or see under normal circumstances.
unit.target: In condicionibus ordinariīs detegere aut vidēre id impossibile est.

unit.source: In simpler terms, you can’t pinpoint its location through appearance or history.
unit.target: Verbis simplicioribus, eius locum per speciem aut historiam definīre nōn potes.

unit.source: “I’ve always envied Loki inheriting such a treasure after transmigration—an ancient castle.
unit.target: “Semper invidi Loki hereditātem talis thesaurī post transmigrātiōnem—castellum antiquum,

unit.source: Later, he relied on the Celestial Worthy’s revelation and the corresponding boon to succeed.
unit.target: deinde innititur revelationī Caelestis Dignī atque dono congruente ad efficāciam consequendam.

unit.source: I once tried to swindle Castle Dylan for myself, but I failed.”
unit.target: Olim conatus sum Castellum Dylan mihi fraudāre, sed defeci.

unit.source: 594 Execution
unit.target: 594 Executio

unit.source: 594 Execution
unit.target: 594 Executio

unit.source: Franca almost chuckled in exasperation at Bard’s remark.
unit.target: Franca paene subrisit, exasperata, ad verba Bardi.

unit.source: April Fool’s not only deceived outsiders but also themselves.
unit.target: April Fool’s non solum externos, sed etiam se ipsos decipiebat.

unit.source: If they didn’t believe in Celestial Worthy, cooperation wouldn’t be on the table.
unit.target: Nisi in Caelestis Digno crederent, cooperatio in mensa non esset.

unit.source: Bard delved into his knowledge about Castle Dylan.
unit.target: Bardus in scientia sua de Castrum Dylan perscrutatus est.

unit.source: “That ancient castle used to be the domain of a secret organization known as the Secret Order.
unit.target: "Iste antiquum castrum olim erat dominium organizationis secretae, quae Ordo Secretus appellabatur.

unit.source: Loki became a member of the organization when he transmigrated.
unit.target: Loki membrum organizationis factus est cum se transmigravit.

unit.source: The story goes that the initial leader of the Secret Order personally constructed the ancient castle and concealed it over a century ago.”
unit.target: Fabula narrat primum ducem Ordo Secretus, qui ipse antiquum castrum condidit et eum ante centum annos celavit.

unit.source: Curious, Franca inquired, “Who’s leading the Secret Order now?”
unit.target: Cum curiositate, Franca rogavit: "Quis nunc ducit Ordo Secretus?"

unit.source: Bard shook his head slowly.
unit.target: Bardus caput lente concussit.

unit.source: “Loki is in the dark about that too.
unit.target: "Loki etiam de hoc ignorat.

unit.source: Only those who’ve become Bizarro Sorcerers or Sequence 4 demigods within the Secret Order can meet the leader and establish a connection with him.
unit.target: Solum illi, qui in Ordo Secretus facti sunt Magi Bizarro aut demigodi Sequentiae IV, possunt ducem convenire atque cum eo vinculum instituere.

unit.source: Others merely follow the orders of their direct superiors.
unit.target: Reliqui tantum praecepta superiorum eorum sequuntur.

unit.source: “Loki once contemplated murdering his mentor, his immediate superior in the Secret Order, to gain the Bizarro Sorcerer Beyonder characteristic and stage a grand performance.
unit.target: Olim Loki meditatus est de occidendo praeceptor suo, superiori proximus in Ordo Secretus, ut sibi proprietatem Beyonder, quam Magi Bizarro habent, adipiscatur atque magnum spectaculum constituat.

unit.source: Yet, due to his comprehension and fear of Bizarro Sorcerers, he never solidified this idea into a concrete plan.
unit.target: Attamen, propter intellectum suum et metum Magorum Bizarro, hanc mentem in consilium concretum numquam transformavit.

unit.source: Eventually, he gathered all the Bizarro Sorcerer potion ingredients in Castle Dylan and entirely abandoned his initial scheme.
unit.target: Postremo, omnes ingredimenta potionis Magorum Bizarro in Castrum Dylan congregavit atque prorsus consilium suum initiale reliquit.

unit.source: “Do you think a hidden place like Castle Dylan, with its long history, would be quiet, cold, and sinister?
unit.target: "Putasne locum occultum sicut Castrum Dylan, cum longa historia, esse quietum, frigidum, et sinistrum?

unit.source: Contrary to expectations, Loki informed me that it’s quite lively, featuring a grand performance every day.”
unit.target: Contra exspectationes, Loki mihi dixit eum valde vivum esse, ostentando magnum spectaculum cotidie.

unit.source: A grand performance… Hela recalled the pitch‐black ancient castle she had glimpsed in Loki’s dream, along with the wax‐statue‐like guests inside.
unit.target: Magnum spectaculum… Hela recordata est castrum antiquum atrum, quod in somnio Loki intuerat, atque hospitibus similes statuis ceratis.

unit.source: Deep in thought, Lumian asked Bard, “How do you suggest we locate Castle Dylan?”
unit.target: Mente profunda versatus, Lumian Bardum interrogavit: "Quomodo suades ut Castrum Dylan inveniamus?"

unit.source: “I’m still missing crucial clues,” Bard admitted sincerely.
unit.target: "Adhuc indicia crucialia mihi deficiunt," Bardus sincere confitebatur.

unit.source: If finding Castle Dylan were that straightforward, the current leader of the Secret Order would have seized it and ousted Loki.
unit.target: Si Castrum Dylan tam facile inveniretur, dux praesentis Ordinis Secretus iam eum ceperet et Loki removeret.

unit.source: No, he would’ve turned Loki into his puppet.
unit.target: Minime, Loki in instrumentum suum converteret.

unit.source: Lumian intended to inquire more thoroughly with Ludwig later, seeking any information he might have gained after consuming half of Loki’s arm.
unit.target: Lumian postea cum Ludovico plenius interrogare intendebat, quaerens notitiam quam postquam dimidium brachii Loki comederat adeptus fuisset.

unit.source: “What about Hisoka? What insights do you have on Hisoka?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: "Quid de Hisoka? Quas notitias de Hisoka habes?" Lumian interrogavit.

unit.source: Bard seemed to recollect something.
unit.target: Bardus aliquid recordari videbatur.

unit.source: “That guy doesn’t quite fit in.
unit.target: "Ille non prorsus convenit.

unit.source: He prefers going solo.
unit.target: Se solus agere mavult.

unit.source: The rare instances of collaboration are mostly with Mad Lady.
unit.target: Rarae occasiones collaborationis plerumque sunt cum Mad Lady.

unit.source: We all sense his emotions are pretty unpredictable, swinging between joy and anger.
unit.target: Omnes sentimus affectus eius esse satis incertos, inter gaudium et iram oscillantes.

unit.source: Mad Lady, however, remarked that he’s not pure enough.
unit.target: Mad Lady autem dixit eum non satis purum esse.

unit.source: He’s highly dangerous—on par with Loki.
unit.target: Valde periculosus est, par loco cum Loki.

unit.source: His specific path remains a mystery.
unit.target: Iter eius peculiare adhuc mysterium manet.

unit.source: I’ve witnessed him using his abilities twice, both times involving mystical items.
unit.target: Eum bis facultates suas utentem vidi, utrumque tempore rebus mysticis innixum.

unit.source: It’s a poker card that can change its face, showcasing the attributes of Frost and Cut respectively.
unit.target: Est tessera ludica quae faciem mutare potest, attributa Frigoris et Secandi respective ostendens.

unit.source: Word has it that Hisoka sought out an Artisan outside the Research Society to customize it after hunting a Beyonder.
unit.target: Fama est quod Hisoka Artifex extra Societatem Investigationis quaesivit ad eam aptandam postquam Beyonder venatus est.

unit.source: Regrettably, Mad Lady is dead, and there’s no means to commune with her spirit.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Mad Lady mortua est, et nullus modus est ad eius spiritum communicandum.

unit.source: She undoubtedly held more information about Hisoka…
unit.target: Indubitanter plura de Hisoka habebat…
