unit.source: Does not being pure enough mean that Hisoka isn’t as unhinged as he appears?
unit.target: Nonne quod non satis purus est, significat Hisoka non tam insanus esse quam videtur?

unit.source: Is his occasional madness a deliberate facade?
unit.target: Num insanitas eius occasionalis sit simulatio deliberata?

unit.source: Lumian pondered with a twinge of regret.
unit.target: Lumian, leviter paenitens, meditatus est.

unit.source: Even though Lumian had obtained Mad Lady’s remains, her spirit had been severely corrupted by Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian reliquias Mad Lady obtinerat, spiritus eius a Caelestis Digno graviter corruptus erat.

unit.source: Some of it had even been “washed away” by the power of the sea, completely obliterated.
unit.target: Pars eius etiam potestate maris ablutam fuit, penitus deletam.

unit.source: Lumian sighed quietly and shifted the conversation to a different topic.
unit.target: Lumian quiete suspiravit et conversationem ad alium rem convertere constituit.

unit.source: “Do you have insights into the sea’s power on Ultraman?”
unit.target: "Habesne notitiam de potentia maris in Ultraman?"

unit.source: “Indeed.”
unit.target: "Certe."

unit.source: Bard shared his findings candidly.
unit.target: Bardus inventa sua candidissime enuntiavit.

unit.source: I played a role in deciphering the extraterrestrial language, although the Celestial Worthy provided crucial revelations.
unit.target: Partem egi in lingua extraterrena explicanda, quamquam Caelestis Digno revelationes cruciales contulit.

unit.source: Additionally, the power of the sea is not exclusive to the offspring of Port Santa.
unit.target: Praeterea, potentia maris non solum ad filios Portus Santae pertinet.

unit.source: I once encountered two heretics in Lenburg with similar abilities, and I managed to extract corresponding knowledge from them.
unit.target: Olim duo haereticos in Lenburg cum similibus facultatibus conveni, atque ex his notitiam correspondentem extraxi.

unit.source: This information greatly aided my decryption efforts, revealing that this pathway is not solely tied to the sea.
unit.target: Haec notitia conatus meos ad enodationem valde adiuvit, ostendens hanc viam non solum ad mare pertinere.

unit.source: In fact, only a small portion of it involves the sea.
unit.target: Re vera, solum parva pars eius ad mare attinet.

unit.source: The power primarily emanates from the stars and the land beneath our feet.
unit.target: Potentia primarie ex stellis et terra sub pedibus nostris procedit.

unit.source: As you all are aware, our world is, after all, a planet.
unit.target: Ut omnes scitis, mundus noster enim planeta appellatur.

unit.source: The corresponding Sequence 9 is known as Astronomy Aficionado.
unit.target: Sequens IX notus est ut Amator Astronomiae.

unit.source: It focuses on acquiring knowledge of the cosmos, related information, an initial perception of reality, and enhancing one’s physique.
unit.target: Illud intendit ad scientiam caeli et orbis acquirendam, informationes pertinentes, primam perceptionem realitatis, et augmentum corporis.

unit.source: Sequence 8, named Star Worshiper, can decipher the Star Language or the Language of the Stars and receive insights into fate.
unit.target: Sequens VIII, cui nomen est "Star Worshiper", linguam stellarum interpretari potest atque fata cognoscere.

unit.source: Sequence 7, called Star Sacrificer, gains true powers through sacrificial rituals involving the stars.
unit.target: Sequens VII, vocatus "Star Sacrificer", veras virtutes per ritus sacrificatorios stellis implicatos adipisci potest.

unit.source: This encompasses Gravity Abnormality, Weakening Ray, Electromagnetic Attraction, and Cosmic Void.
unit.target: Hoc comprehendit Anomaliam Gravitatis, Radiam Debilitantis, Attractionem Electromagneticam, et Vacuitatem Cosmica.

unit.source: Sequence 6 is Navigator.
unit.target: Sequens VI est Navigator.

unit.source: They possess a deeper understanding of space and dimensions, allowing them to locate hidden passageways in the void and navigate and adjust routes between the stars.
unit.target: Illi spatium et dimensiones profundius intellegunt, quae eos sinit vias occultas in vacuo invenire et itinera inter stellas navigare atque ordinare.

unit.source: Navigating ships at sea becomes a straightforward task for them.
unit.target: Naves in mari navigare eis negotium simplex fit.

unit.source: Sequence 5, Tidal Scholar, further masters gravity and can whip up massive waves capable of shattering ships and demolishing docks.
unit.target: Sequens V, Tidal Scholar, gravitatis scientiam ulterius dominatur et undas ingentes excitare potest, quae naves conterere et molas portuum delere valent.

unit.source: As for Sequence 4, it’s known as Heavybringer.
unit.target: Quoad Sequens IV, notus est ut Heavybringer.

unit.source: Unfortunately, I’m not too certain about their specific abilities.
unit.target: Infeliciter, de eorum facultatibus specificis non satis certus sum.

unit.source: Lumian remained silent, taking a couple of steps back and signaling for Franca and the others to continue questioning.
unit.target: Lumian silentium retinuebat, paucis gradibus retrorsum processit et Francam aliosque invitavit ut quaestiones continuarent.

unit.source: His primary concern centered around Loki’s connection to Hisoka; anything else seemed less crucial.
unit.target: Praecipua eius cura erat de nexu Loki ad Hisoka; cetera minus gravia videbantur.

unit.source: Franca studied Bard for a moment before inquiring, “Have you recruited other members into April Fool’s?”
unit.target: Franca Bardum observavit et deinde rogavit: "Aliosne membris April Fool's conduxisti?"

unit.source: “Yes,” Bard admitted without hesitation.
unit.target: "Ita," Bardus sine mora respondit.

unit.source: After detailing what he knew about the April Fool’s members outside the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, Franca asked with curiosity, “Why did you choose the nickname Bard? Considering your past identity and current class, wouldn’t Kaitō or Kid be more fitting?”
unit.target: Postquam enarravit quid de membris April Fool's extra Societatem Investigationis Curly-Haired Baboons sciret, Franca cum curiositate rogavit: "Cur cognomen Bard elegisti? Considerata enim tua identitas praeterita et classis hodierna, num non potius Kaitō aut Kid aptiora videantur?"

unit.source: Bard responded calmly, “My current body was a bard, a wandering artist who often dabbled in thievery and swindling. He met his end when discovered trying to cheat others out of their money, suffering a severe beating.”
unit.target: Bardus aequo animo respondit: "Corpus meum praesens erat bardus, errans artifex qui saepius in furtum et fraudes versabatur. Finem obiit cum deprehensus esset, eo quod tentabat alios pecunia decipere, et graviter verberatus est."

unit.source: Cheat, swindle, and steal—Franca thought. You know everything; it suits you quite well.
unit.target: Fraudare, fallere, et furari—Franca cogitavit. "Tu omnia scis; tibi valde convenit."

unit.source: Franca turned to Hela and Gandalf, stating, “I have no further questions.”
unit.target: Franca ad Hela et Gandalf conversus est, dicens: "Nullas alias quaestiones habeo."

unit.source: “Neither do I,” Gandalf acknowledged, recognizing that Bard’s life was approaching its end.
unit.target: "Neque ego," Gandalf agnoscens, intellexit vitam Bardi ad finem prope esse.

unit.source: Muggle’s brother wouldn’t let him off the hook!
unit.target: Frater Muggle eum non dimisit!

unit.source: “Neither do I,” Hela added.
unit.target: "Neque et ego," Hela addidit.

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand, generating a dark-green glow at his fingertips.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum elevavit, creando scintillam viridem obscuram in digitis suis.

unit.source: The light transformed into a strange ray, penetrating Bard’s chest.
unit.target: Lux in radium insolutum conversus est, quod in pectore Bardi penetrare coepit.

unit.source: Weakening Ray!
unit.target: Radius Debilitatrix!

unit.source: Lumian still had access to a week’s worth of sea power, approaching the level of Sequence 5.
unit.target: Lumian adhuc hebdomadam potentiae maris habuit, accedens ad gradum Sequentiae V.

unit.source: Bard’s face contorted, muscles and nerves reacting instinctively.
unit.target: Vultus Bardi contortus est, musculi et nervi instinctive reagentes.

unit.source: His chest, close to his neck, rapidly melted and peeled, exposing the flesh beneath.
unit.target: Pectus eius, prope collum situm, celeriter liquefactum est et excisum, ostendens carnem subtus.

unit.source: Seeing this, Gandalf sighed again.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Gandalf iterum suspiravit.

unit.source: Gandalf sighed, condensing a straight sword with Sunrise Gleam and driving it towards Bard.
unit.target: Gandalf suspiravit, gladium rectum cum fulgore aurorae stringens, et in Bardum impellens.

unit.source: The light blade impaled Bard’s head, and he crumpled to the ground with a thud, held down by the sword.
unit.target: Lamina lucida caput Bardi impigerat, atque ille cum strepitu ad terram cecidit, gladio adstrictus.

unit.source: Bard writhed like a skinned insect, convulsing as life left his body.
unit.target: Bardus quasi insectum excorticatum se contorquebat, convulsus, dum vita ex corpore eius exibat.

unit.source: Lumian observed in silence, refraining from intervening as Gandalf freed Bard.
unit.target: Lumian in silentio observavit, non interveniens dum Gandalf Bardum liberabat.

unit.source: When Bard’s breath ceased, and he lay motionless, Lumian turned to Gandalf and Hela.
unit.target: Cum spiritus Bardi cessaverit et ille immotus iacebat, Lumian ad Gandalf et Hela conversus est.

unit.source: “Thank you for your assistance.”
unit.target: "Gratias vobis ago pro auxilio."

unit.source: “It’s our duty. We’re all accountable for the harm April Fool’s caused to the other members of the Research Society,” Gandalf responded gravely.
unit.target: "Officium nostrum est. Omnes culpabiles sumus pro damno quod April Fool’s aliis membris Societatis Investigationis intulit," Gandalf graviter respondit.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t contest.
unit.target: Lumian non contradixit.

unit.source: Instead, he disclosed, “Before the operation, I mentioned joining a secret organization before assuming my sister’s identity.
unit.target: Proinde edixit: "Ante operationem, dixi me organizationi secretam iungendum esse, antequam identitatem sororis meae assumam.

unit.source: To seek revenge, I invited members of that secret organization to assist.
unit.target: Ut ultio petenda esset, membra illius organizationis secretae ad auxilium convocavi.

unit.source: I believe you all have seen or sensed their presence.
unit.target: Credo vos omnes eorum praesentiam videritis aut sensistis.

unit.source: He strategically linked the appearance of the Tarot Club to himself, safeguarding Franca’s identity as a Minor Arcana card holder.
unit.target: Ille apparationem Tarot Club ad se coniunxit, ita identitatem Francae ut tenentis cartae Minor Arcanae servans.

unit.source: “And which organization is that?” Gandalf inquired curiously.
unit.target: "Et quae organizatione illa est?" Gandalf interrogavit cum curiositate.

unit.source: As per Hela’s account, the secret organization exhibited Angel-level power, and the demigod “Cinderella” who appeared at sea was equally formidable.
unit.target: Secundum Helae relationem, organizationes secretae potentiam ad angeli gradum exhibuerunt, et semideus "Cinderella", quae in mari apparuit, similiter formidabilis erat.

unit.source: “The Tarot Club,” Lumian revealed truthfully.
unit.target: "Tarot Club," Lumian veraciter revelavit.

unit.source: “You’re one of the Minor Arcana card holders?” Gandalf deduced.
unit.target: "Esne unus ex tenentibus cartarum Minor Arcanae?" Gandalf congetavit.

unit.source: He had heard about the Tarot Club.
unit.target: Audiverat de Tarot Club.

unit.source: Lumian nodded without denying it.
unit.target: Lumian annuit sine negatione.

unit.source: Curiosity piqued, Franca asked, “Which card represents that ‘Cinderella’ demigod? And why does her magic have such a dreamy quality? Moreover, it resembles fairy tales from before our transmigration!”
unit.target: Excitata curiositate, Franca rogavit: "Quae carta illud semideum 'Cinderella' repraesentat? Et cur magia eius talem qualitatem somnifera habeat? Praeterea, fabulis priores ante nostram transmigrationem similis est!"

unit.source: She maintained her role while genuinely expressing curiosity.
unit.target: Illam partem suam servavit, dum vere sincera curiositatem exprimebat.

unit.source: Lumian recalled Madam Magician’s guidance and grinned.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est consilium Dominae Magicae et subridens dedit.

unit.source: “Major Arcana card, The Hermit.”
unit.target: "Carta Maior Arcana, Eremita."

unit.source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “I’m uncertain about why she can transform your fairy tales into magic.
unit.target: Intermissis momentis, addidit: "Nescio cur illa fabulas vestras in magiam convertere possit.

unit.source: What I do know is that she’s closely tied to Emperor Roselle’s descendant.”
unit.target: Quod scio est eam arcte coniunctam esse cum descendantibus Imperatoris Roselle.

unit.source: “Descendant of Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette?” Franca and the others, having read numerous entries from Roselle’s diary, immediately speculated.
unit.target: "Descendens ex filia maiori Imperatoris Roselle, Bernadette?" Franca et ceteri, ex multis Rosellae commentariis lectis, statim coniectaverunt.

unit.source: “Perhaps, but it’s not Bernadette herself,” Lumian honestly disclosed.
unit.target: "Forsitan, sed ipsa Bernadette non est," Lumian sincere revelavit.

unit.source: That was the extent of his knowledge.
unit.target: Id erat totum scientiae eius.

unit.source: “Is that so…” Franca, Gandalf, and Hela felt enlightened.
unit.target: "Sic est..." Franca, Gandalf, et Hela se omnia perspicua sentierunt.

unit.source: So, it was connected to Emperor Roselle’s faction!
unit.target: Ergo, hoc erat coniunctum cum factione Imperatoris Roselle!

unit.source: It made sense for the Emperor to create fairytale magic.
unit.target: Rationabile erat imperatori magiam fabularum condere.

unit.source: After a brief pause, Lumian suggested, “You should probably prevent the Research Society from disseminating those fairy tales.”
unit.target: Post brevem moram, Lumian suadivit: "Censeo vos impedire debere disseminationem harum fabularum a Societate Investigationis."

unit.source: “Understood,” Gandalf agreed.
unit.target: "Intelligo," Gandalf assentivit.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment before stating, “I’ve concluded my involvement with the Research Society and have joined another secret organization. It’s no longer suitable for me to participate in the Research Society’s gatherings. You may find an opportunity to reveal the truth to the other members.”
unit.target: Lumian breve meditatus est antequam dixerit: "Participationem meam in Societate Investigationis finivi et in aliam organizationem secretam accessi. Iam mihi non convenit conventibus Societatis Investigationis interesse. Vos fortasse occasionem invenietis ad veritatem aliis membris revelandam."

unit.source: Gandalf and Hela exchanged glances and proposed, “You can continue playing the role of Muggle and acquire resources and assistance from the Research Society. We owe it to your sister.”
unit.target: Gandalf et Hela conspectum inter se commutaverunt et proposuerunt: "Munus Muggle agere pergere potestis et opes atque auxilium ex Societate Investigationis adipisci. Id sorori tuae debemus."

unit.source: 595 Spoils of War
unit.target: 595 Praeda Belli

unit.source: 595 Spoils of War
unit.target: 595 Praeda Belli

unit.source: Lumian wasted no time with pleasantries and accepted Gandalf’s invitation without hesitation.
unit.target: Lumian nullum tempus in amabilibus verbis consumpsit atque invitationem Gandalf sine mora accepit.

unit.source: Firstly, within the vast expanse of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society were numerous pathways.
unit.target: Primum, intra immensum spatium Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crisparum erant multae viae.

unit.source: Besides the relatively scarce Devils, he gained access to a wealth of knowledge and various items.
unit.target: Praeter relativam raritatem Diabolorum, accessum adeptus est ad copiam scientiae atque variarum rerum.

unit.source: While these might not surpass what he already possessed in strength, they held the potential to unexpectedly shine in specific situations.
unit.target: Quamquam haec fortasse non superabant id quod iam in vi habebat, tamen facultatem habebant in certis occasionibus inopinato fulgendi.

unit.source: Secondly, this decision provided him with a pretext to continue assuming the role of Aurore as a Muggle.
unit.target: Secundo, haec decisio ei praebuit causam ut munus agendi Aurore ut “Muggle” continuaret.

unit.source: It created the illusion that his sister still existed somewhere in the world.
unit.target: Illud creavit illusionem, ut soror eius in aliquo orbe terrarum adhuc exsisteret.

unit.source: After the quartet concluded their discussion about the events in the peculiar waters, Bard’s lifeless body underwent a startling transformation.
unit.target: Postquam quatuor de rebus in aquis insolitis disputaverunt, corpus inanimatum Bard transformationem mirabilem subiit.

unit.source: Ephemeral lights coalesced in the corpse’s right hand, causing both flesh and bones to crumble simultaneously.
unit.target: Lucea evanida in manu dextra cadaveris coalescebant, facientes ut et caro et ossa simul ruinarentur.

unit.source: Eventually, the palm resembled that of a baby—small and pallid.
unit.target: Postremo, palma similis facta est infantis – parva et pallida.

unit.source: The pale hue swiftly shifted, adopting a darker shade reminiscent of the ancient palace’s surroundings.
unit.target: Color pallidus celeriter mutatus est, assumens umbram obscuriorem, quae circumiecta antiqui palatii evocat.

unit.source: It was a Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic.
unit.target: Hoc erat indoles Beyonder Somnium Furtoris.

unit.source: Lumian focused his attention and detected a faint grayish‐white fog within the shrunken palm.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit et detexit nebulam griseo‐albam tenuem in palma contrahita.

unit.source: He approached Bard’s corpse, crouching down to search for additional items.
unit.target: Accedens ad cadaver Bard, se incurvans ad quaerendas res additas accessit.

unit.source: With this task accomplished, Lumian retrieved the spoils obtained from Mad Lady and Loki from his Traveler’s Bag, placing them on the decrepit stone slabs of the ancient palace.
unit.target: Hoc perfuncto, Lumian praedas a Mad Lady et Loki ex sacco viatoris sui extraxit, ea in tabulis lapideis ruenti antiqui palatii posuit.

unit.source: These included: a transparent, almost ethereal crystal, a bracelet with three diamonds flanked by four different-colored gems, a rose-gold ring adorned with crimson, blood-like gems, a simple silver ring, a dark-gold mask capable of concealing the entire face, a featureless small doll bound with white cloth, an intricate but exquisite mechanical music box, and a grayish-white brooch with a metallic gleam resembling lightning.
unit.target: Haec comprehendebant:

unit.source: Accompanied by a relatively thin blank painting album and the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic, the total count reached ten items.
unit.target: Comitante album picturae vacuo tenuo atque proprietate Beyonder Somnium Furtoris, numerus totalis rerum decem pervenit.

unit.source: Lumian then looked up and addressed Hela and Gandalf, “You can choose—
unit.target: one each.”

unit.source: “It’s our duty,” Gandalf asserted, signifying the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s commitment to rectify past errors.
unit.target: “Officium nostrum est,” asseruit Gandalf, significans studium Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crisparum ad priores errores corrigendos.

unit.source: Speaking in Aurore’s tone, Lumian, shrouded in his hood, remarked, “Duty doesn’t preclude the choice of spoils.
unit.target: Loquens in tono Aurore, Lumian, sub velamento suo, dixit: “Officium non impedit electionem praedarum.

unit.source: Just because official Beyonders must protect citizens doesn’t mean they can’t receive rewards.”
unit.target: Nam etiamsi Beyonders officiales cives tuendi sunt, non significat quod ipsi praemia recipere non possint.

unit.source: Gandalf pondered for a moment before turning to Hela.
unit.target: Gandalf paulo meditatus est antequam ad Helam conversus esset.

unit.source: Seeing her lack of objection, he sighed and conceded, “Fine.”
unit.target: Videns nullam eius objectionem, suspiravit et dixit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Lumian’s lips formed a smile as he pointed to each item, providing a concise introduction.
unit.target: Labia Lumiani risum effecerunt, dum singula obiecta indicabat, concisam introductionem praebens.

unit.source: “The illusory transparent stone is a Traveler Beyonder characteristic left behind by Mad Lady, but it’s severely corrupted.
unit.target: “Lapis perspicuus illusorius est proprietas Beyonder Viatoris, a Mad Lady relicta, sed graviter corruptus est.

unit.source: The thin gray fog emanating from it serves as evidence of this.
unit.target: Nebula tenue grisea ex eo emanans hoc testatur.

unit.source: “The Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic is similarly corrupted by that Celestial Worthy, but the severity is not extreme.
unit.target: “Proprietas Beyonder Somnium Furtoris similiter corrupta est a illo Celestiali Digno, sed severitas non est extrema.

unit.source: It’s slightly less severe than the remains of most heretics after their deaths.
unit.target: Illud paulo minus severum est quam reliquiae plerorum haereticorum post mortem.

unit.source: “That bracelet comes from Loki, known as the Seven-Stone Bracelet.
unit.target: “Armilla illa a Loki provenit, nota ut “Armilla Septem Lapidum.”

unit.source: Each diamond corresponds to a teleportation, and each colored gem corresponds to a ten-second Blink.
unit.target: Singulus adamantum correspondet ad translocationem, et singula gemma colorata respondet ad decem secundas evanescendi.

unit.source: Once used, it’s gone.
unit.target: Semel usum, evanuit.

unit.source: The drawback is that you hear random sounds when you wear it—ranging from a man having an affair to sounds from an unknown creature.
unit.target: Incommodum est quod, cum id geris, sonos fortuitos audis—ab viro adultero ad sonos creaturae ignotae.

unit.source: “This golden ring, named Blood Gold, bears an engraved inner loop with a brief sentence—’Controlling flesh and blood means controlling everything.’
unit.target: “Anulus aureus iste, nominatus “Blood Gold”, habet internum orbem insculptum cum brevi sententia: “Regere carnem et sanguinem significat omnia regere.”

unit.source: Its function enables the wearer to control their flesh and blood like a Rose Bishop.
unit.target: Eius munus induti permittit ut carnem et sanguinem regat, sicut Episcopus Rosae.

unit.source: Additionally, they can employ three flesh and blood magics—Flesh Bomb, Flesh Cloak, and Flesh Blood Fusion.
unit.target: Praeterea, tres artes magicas carnis et sanguinis uti possunt—Flesh Bomb, Flesh Cloak, et Flesh Blood Fusion.

unit.source: The drawback is repeated use may lead to dependence.
unit.target: Incommodum est quod usus repetitus ad dependentiam ducere potest.

unit.source: Ceasing to wear it results in the body collapsing into a pile of flesh and blood, unable to maintain human form.
unit.target: Desinendo id gerere, corpus in acervum carnis et sanguinis corruit, neque formam humanam servare potest.

unit.source: Continual wear may lead to madness and loss of control.
unit.target: Usus continuus potest ad insanitatem et ad imperium amittendum ducere.

unit.source: “That silver ring is a semi‑finished Ring of the Sea Queen, possessing a high‑level Steal ability usable only once.
unit.target: “Illud anulum argenteum est, semi‑perfectum Anulum Reginae Maris, praeditum facultate furtandi altioris gradus, quae semel tantum adhiberi potest.

unit.source: The drawback is that an ancient Angel will take notice of you.
unit.target: Incommodum est quod angelus antiquus te notabit.

unit.source: “The dark‑gold mask, a possession of Loki, survived his self‑destruction.
unit.target: “Larva obscura aurea, ab Loki possessa, superfuit ipsius auto‑destructionis.

unit.source: Its exact function remains unknown.
unit.target: Eius functio exacta ignota est.

unit.source: Sensing it, one might feel an intense desire to wear it, believing it would grant abnormal power.
unit.target: Sentiens id, quis intensam cupiditatem gerendi sentire potest, existimans id vim insolitam tribuere.

unit.source: Let’s call it the Demon Mask.
unit.target: Appellamus eam “Larva Daemonis.”

unit.source: “This featureless white cloth doll, a creation of Mad Lady, corresponds to the Faceless of the Seer pathway.
unit.target: “Haec pupula ex albo panno, sine lineamentis, a Mad Lady creata, correspondet semita “Sine Facie Vatis.”

unit.source: When affixed to your shoulder, adjusting its facial features and figure is akin to altering your own appearance.
unit.target: Quando ad umerum tuum adfixa est, eius lineamenta et figuram aptare simile est tuam ipsius effigiem mutare.

unit.source: Simultaneously, it empowers the wearer to master the ability to create Paper Figurine Substitutes.
unit.target: Simul, illud dat portatori facultatem dominandi artem creandi substituta figurina papyracea.

unit.source: However, only the first paper figurine proves effective.
unit.target: Sed sola prima figurina papyracea efficax est.

unit.source: Beyond these functions, it allows the wearer to employ flames for a dynamic leap and develop a certain premonition of danger.
unit.target: Praeter has functiones, portatori concedit flammis uti ad saltum dynamicum faciendum et ad certam praenotionem periculi evolvendam.

unit.source: Be warned, though— carrying it around brings weak bad luck.
unit.target: Monendum est, tamen: portans id, mala fortuna leviter parit.

unit.source: Moreover, one day, you may realize that its face mirrors yours, and you will cease to be yourself.
unit.target: Praeterea, aliquando, intelleges faciem eius tuam imitari, et tunc te ipsum desinere ut sis.

unit.source: “This mechanical music box, discovered on Loki’s corpse, is from an unknown pathway or Sequence.
unit.target: “Haec cista mechanica musica, in cadavere Loki reperta, ex via ignota vel Ordine provenit.

unit.source: It’s rumored that the music it plays has the potential to either kill or drive anyone who hears it into madness.
unit.target: Fama est quod musica quam canit possit vel occidere vel in insaniam impellere quicumque eam audierit.

unit.source: However, a prerequisite exists—you must hear the music for at least ten seconds.”
unit.target: Attamen, necessitas praevia est—debes musicam saltem decem secundis audire.

unit.source: “I just found this blank painting album from Bard.
unit.target: “Modo hoc album picturae vacuum a Bard reperivi.

unit.source: Its precise effects and drawbacks remain unknown, but based on my experience, the depictions on its pages may come to life or exhibit special effects.
unit.target: Eius effectus exacti et incommoda ignota manent, sed ex experientia mea, depictiones in paginis eius ad vitam referre vel effectus especiales exhibere possunt.

unit.source: Notably, only nine pages remain, showing signs of tearing.”
unit.target: Notabiliter, novem paginae restant, signa lacerationis ostendentes.

unit.source: “This brooch, belonging to Mad Lady, appears crafted in anticipation of the loss of the Governor of the Sea’s authority and the sea’s berserk state.
unit.target: “Haec fibula, a Mad Lady possessa, videtur confecta ad praevidendum amissionem imperii Praefecti Maris et furoris maris.

unit.source: It grants the wearer fish scales, mitigating damage and enabling underwater breathing and movement akin to a fish.
unit.target: Ea induti squamas piscis largitur, damna levans et subaquaneam respirationem atque motum, quasi piscis, praebens.

unit.source: Each strike carries the effect of Electric Shock, with a near 100% probability of triggering natural lightning strikes in thunderstorms.
unit.target: Quisque ictus habet effectum ictus electrici, cum fere centesima probabilitate ad excitandum fulmina naturalia in tempestatibus.

unit.source: Aligned with Sequence 6 or 5 of the Sailor pathway, the negative consequence is a heightened likelihood of being struck by lightning on rainy days, coupled with increased irritability and anxiety after wearing it.”
unit.target: Conformans cum Sequencae 6 vel 5 viae Nautae, effectus negativus est maior probabilitas fulminis ictus in diebus pluviis, una cum augmento irritabilitatis et anxietatis post id gerendum.

unit.source: Lumian concluded the introduction of the spoils of war, his knowledge derived from Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lumian introductionem praedarum belli conclusit, scientia sua ab Magistra Magica deducta.

unit.source: It was evident that for the success of the sea prayer ritual, April Fool’s had entrusted most of their mystical items to Mad Lady.
unit.target: Manifestum erat quod, ad successum ritu orationis maritimae, April Fool’s pleraque res mysticas sua Mad Lady tradiverunt.

unit.source: Bard had only left behind an ordinary‑looking blank painting album.
unit.target: Bard solum reliquit album picturae vacuum, quod aspectu mediocri videbatur.

unit.source: On the other hand, Loki, the leader of April Fool’s, had seemingly retained his items privately.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, Loki, dux April Fool’s, videntur res suas privatim retinuisse.

unit.source: Whether it was his nature or a deliberate choice to retrieve them for hunting Ludwig remained unknown.
unit.target: Num natura eius vel deliberata electio eas ad Ludwig venandum redhibendas essent, ignotum manebat.

unit.source: Gandalf looked at Hela.
unit.target: Gandalf Helam respexit.

unit.source: “Take your pick first.”
unit.target: “Primum elige!”

unit.source: Hela approached Lumian, carefully inspecting the ten items before singling out Mad Lady’s Traveler Beyonder characteristic.
unit.target: Hela ad Luminum accessit, decem res diligenter inspiciens, antequam proprietatem Beyonder Viatoris Mad Ladye excerperit.

unit.source: “It’s severely corrupted.
unit.target: “Graviter corruptum est.

unit.source: Whether you decide to keep it or have an Artisan craft items, it’s quite dangerous.
unit.target: “Sive id servare decernas sive per artificem res conficiendas, id periculosum est.

unit.source: “Leave it to me.”
unit.target: “Relinque id mihi.”

unit.source: In other words, she suggested that she had a method to handle it and mitigate potential harm.
unit.target: In aliis verbis, illa suadebat se rationem habere ad id tractandum et ad minuenda pericula.

unit.source: “Alright.”
unit.target: “Bene.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t object.
unit.target: Lumian non repugnavit.

unit.source: He respected the wishes of each individual and allowed them to choose whatever they wanted.
unit.target: Ipse vota singulorum respexit et eis concessit eligere quod voluerunt.

unit.source: Of course, the order of selection mattered too.
unit.target: Certe, ordo electionis quoque referrebat.

unit.source: His team would be last, and he would be last.
unit.target: Turma eius ultima erit, et ipse ultimus erit.

unit.source: Hela extended her right hand, and the night outside the ancient palace seemed to stir.
unit.target: Hela dextram manum extendit, et nox extra antiquam palatium concitari videbatur.

unit.source: The illusory crystal shrouded in grayish‑white fog vanished.
unit.target: Crystallum illusorium, in nebula griseo‑alba opertum, evanuit.

unit.source: After Hela returned to her spot, Gandalf made his selection.
unit.target: Postquam Hela ad locum suum rediit, Gandalf electionem fecit.

unit.source: Franca’s heart skipped a beat as she observed the president scrutinizing the remaining nine items.
unit.target: Cor Francae exsiluit, dum praeses novem reliquas res perscrutabatur.

unit.source: She whispered, “Don’t choose the Seven-Stone Bracelet, don’t choose the Seven-Stone Bracelet…”
unit.target: Sibilavit: “Noli eligere Armillam Septem Lapidum, noli eligere Armillam Septem Lapidum…”

unit.source: That was the teleportation she had been longing for!
unit.target: Illa erat translocatio quam optaverat!

unit.source: The Traveler Beyonder characteristic was too dangerous.
unit.target: Proprietas Beyonder Viatoris nimis periculosa erat.

unit.source: She didn’t dare to set her sights on it.
unit.target: Ea non ausa est illud petere.

unit.source: Although the Seven-Stone Bracelet was an expendable item, its advantage lay in its many uses and its relatively manageable negative effects.
unit.target: Quamquam Armilla Septem Lapidum res expendibilis erat, eius commodum in multis usibus et in effectibus negativis relativis moderatis considebat.

unit.source: Gandalf’s intense gaze fixed on the dark‑gold mask, his mutterings barely audible, “I’ve got a burning desire to delve into its powers and potential…
unit.target: Intensa oculatio Gandalf in larvam auream obscuram fixa est, murmurans vix audibiliter: “Ardens cupiditas me afficit, ut eius potentias et facultates penetrem…

unit.source: But it’s too risky.
unit.target: Sed nimis periculosum est.

unit.source: I’m itching to put it on now…
unit.target: Iam vehementer cupio id induere…

unit.source: Yes, the Blood Gold ring aids my experiments into dangerous matters.
unit.target: Ita, anulus “Blood Gold” experimenta mea in rebus periculosissimis adiuvat.

unit.source: The blank painting album requires further exploration…
unit.target: Album picturae vacuum ulterius explorandum requirit…

unit.source: The high‑level Steal ability is also worth studying…
unit.target: Facultas furtandi altae gradus quoque studenda est…

unit.source: But being noticed by an ancient Angel is no small matter…”
unit.target: Sed ab angelo antiquo notari non est res parva.

unit.source: After thorough contemplation, Gandalf turned to Hela and spoke, “Can I leave the silver ring here?
unit.target: Post longam meditationem, Gandalf ad Helam conversus dixit: “Licetne mihi illum anulum argenteum hic relinquere?

unit.source: I want to arrive half an hour early to study it before every gathering.”
unit.target: Volo dimidia hora ante conventum pervenire, ut eum diligenter studeam.

unit.source: “Alright,” Hela agreed to Gandalf’s request.
unit.target: “Bene,” Helā assensit petitioni Gandalf.

unit.source: Thus, the president of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society opted for the half‑finished Ring of the Sea Queen.
unit.target: Ita, praeses Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crisparum semiductus Anulum Reginae Maris optavit.

unit.source: Franca let out a sigh of relief and grinned at Gandalf.
unit.target: Franca leviter suspiravit et ad Gandalf risum edidit.

unit.source: “President, you really should’ve gone down the Reader pathway.
unit.target: “Praeses, vere debuisti iter Lectorem sequi.”

unit.source: “You suit their style perfectly.”
unit.target: “Stilo eorum perfecte convenis.”

unit.source: Why did he have to pick Warrior just to live up to the title of Gandalf?
unit.target: Cur necesse fuit ei Bellatorem eligere, tantum ut titulum Gandalf adipisceretur?

unit.source: Gandalf, the half‑giant in a linen robe, glanced at Franca, smiling without uttering a word.
unit.target: Gandalf, semigigante in lintea toga, Francam intuens, subridens sine verbo.

unit.source: Lumian stowed the remaining items back into his Traveler’s Bag, not affording Franca an opportunity to choose first.
unit.target: Lumian reliquas res in sacco viatoris suo recondidit, nec Francae occasionem primum eligendi dedit.

unit.source: At Port Santa, near Solow Motel, inside Loki’s rented room.
unit.target: Apud Portum Santa, prope Solow Motel, in cubiculo conducito a Loki.

unit.source: Lumian received a response from Madam Magician:
unit.target: Lumian responsum a Magistra Magica accepit:

unit.source: “Even I can’t decipher the intricate abilities of that dark‑gold mask, indicating its exceptional nature.
unit.target: “Etiam ego subtilissimas facultates illius larvae aureae obscurae explicare non possum, quæ naturam eius eximiam ostendunt.

unit.source: Inquire with Mr. K if he desires it.
unit.target: Roga a Messire K, utrum id desideret.

unit.source: If not, leave it in my care for now.
unit.target: Si non, relinque id in mea cura pro tempore.

unit.source: I’ll seal it and await the opportune moment.
unit.target: Id sigillabo et opportunum tempus exspectabo.

unit.source: It might prove useful when the time comes.
unit.target: Forsitan utile erit, cum tempus advenerit.

unit.source: Ma’am Hermit has her eyes on the mechanical music box.
unit.target: Domina Hermit oculos suos in cista mechanica musica intendit.

unit.source: Other items hold little significance for her, but this one, at least, is exquisite.
unit.target: Aliae res parum ei significant, sed haec, saltem, exquisita est.

unit.source: Mr. Moon expresses interest in the faceless doll; as for the reason, I remain in the dark.
unit.target: Messire Moon in pupula sine facie studet; de causa autem, ignotus maneo.

unit.source: I’ll entrust you with distributing the rest.”
unit.target: Reliqua tibi distribuenda tradam.

unit.source: 596 Lord’s Revelation?
unit.target: 596 Revelatio Domini?

unit.source: 596 Lord’s Revelation?
unit.target: 596 Revelatio Domini?

unit.source: In Mr. K’s temporary apartment in Port Santa,
unit.target: In habitatione temporaria Domini K in Portu Santa,

unit.source: Lumian unpacked the remaining spoils of war from his Traveler’s Bag, placing them on the coffee table.
unit.target: Lumian reliquas praedas belli ex sacculo itineris sui explicavit, eas super mensam collocans.

unit.source: He shot a glance at Mr. K, who, now adorned in a black robe with a deep hood, spoke first, “These are the gains from the operation. Perhaps there’s a revelation from the Lord among them.”
unit.target: Illum aspexit Domini K, qui, nunc veste nigra cum profunda cuculla ornatus, primum locutus est: “Haec sunt commoda expeditionis. Forsitan inter ea sit revelatio a Domino.”

unit.source: Mr. K nodded subtly, diverting his attention to the items, his gaze fixating on the dark-gold mask.
unit.target: Dominus K submisse annuit, suam attentionem ad res vertens, oculos in larvam nigro-auro fixos habens.

unit.source: In a deep, hoarse voice, he mused, “I sense something special about it. This should be a revelation from the Lord.”
unit.target: Voce profunda et rauca meditatus est: “Aliquid specialem illi sentio. Haec revera esse debet revelatio a Domino.”

unit.source: With a swift motion, Mr. K extended his right hand, pulling the strange dark‑gold mask into his grasp amidst a sudden gust of wind.
unit.target: Celeriter motu, Dominus K dextram manum protendit, larvam nigro-auro insolitam subitumque flatus venti in manum trahens.

unit.source: However, the Aurora Order Oracle didn’t put the mask on; instead, he discreetly stowed it away in a hidden pocket within his black robe.
unit.target: Attamen, Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae larvam non induit; potius eam in sinu abscondito intra vestem nigrum secreto recondidit.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Lumian was momentarily taken aback.
unit.target: Hoc conspecto, Lumian paulisper stupefactus est.

unit.source: He had been contemplating how to subtly carry out Madam Magician’s instructions, aiming to inquire if Mr. K desired the dark‑gold mask.
unit.target: Cogitabat quomodo praecepta Dominae Magicae subtiliter exsequi posset, intendens rogatque an Dominus K larvam nigro‑auro cupiret.

unit.source: Surprisingly, he had spontaneously fabricated a Lord‑given revelation as an excuse.
unit.target: Inopinanter, revelationem a Domino datae quasi excusationem sponte composuerat.

unit.source: Before Lumian could specify which item it was, Mr. K had chosen the dark‑gold mask himself.
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian declarare posset quae res esset, Dominus K ipsius larvam nigro‑auro elegit.

unit.source: Could it genuinely be a revelation from the Lord?
unit.target: Num vere revelatio a Domino sit?

unit.source: Hiss… Lumian took a deep breath.
unit.target: Sibilus… Lumian altum spiritum cepit.

unit.source: Had Madam Magician sent me to ask Mr. K because she foresaw something or glimpsed something?
unit.target: Num Domina Magica me misit ut Dominum K rogarer, quia aliquid praevidisset aut intuisset?

unit.source: These high‑ranking figures always prefer to communicate through hints and revelations.
unit.target: Hi summi dignitatis habentes semper mavult per inditia et revelationes communicare.

unit.source: Couldn’t they be more direct?
unit.target: Num non possent esse magis directi?

unit.source: Amidst his thoughts, Lumian stowed away the remaining items and earnestly addressed Mr. K,
unit.target: Inter cogitationes suas, Lumian reliquas res recondidit et sincere ad Dominum K allocutus est,

unit.source: “I didn’t expect the matter to escalate like this.
unit.target: “Non expectabam rem talem evolvere.

unit.source: I initially believed that with you and my sister’s friends from her past, it would suffice to seek vengeance.
unit.target: Primum credidi te et amicos sororis meae ex praeteritis ad ultam ultionem quaerendam satis fore.

unit.source: Yet, it spiraled into something of a much higher magnitude.
unit.target: Sed res in altitudinem multo maiorem evoluta est.

unit.source: Thankfully, my sister’s allies were vigilant and leveraged their connections.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, socii sororis meae vigilabant et nexibus suis utebantur.

unit.source: The sincerity in the first half of Lumian’s statement contrasted with the second half, which explained the influx of demigods, even Angel‑level forces, this time.
unit.target: Sinceritas primae partis dicti Lumiani dissimilis erat secundae, quae huius temporis influxum semideorum, etiam virium angelicarum, explicabat.

unit.source: He subtly shifted the blame to Franca and Aurore’s associates.
unit.target: Subtile culpam in socios Francae atque Aurorae imposuit.

unit.source: Lumian sensed a high likelihood that Mr. K might not fully buy into his explanation.
unit.target: Lumian magnae probabilitatis sensum habuit ne Dominus K explicationi eius penitus crederet.

unit.source: Disregarding the possibility of the Aurora Order’s Oracle grazing a relatively high Sequence Spectator, Lumian believed that the intentional arrangements and subtle traces left behind by the entity he believed in were sufficient evidence of constant watching, listening, and awareness.
unit.target: Negligens facultatem Oraculi Ordinis Aurorae ad spectatorem Sequentiae relativam excelsam concurrendi, Lumian credebat ordinationes conscias et vestigia subtilia a entitate in qua credidit relicuta esse testimonium constantis vigilantiae, auscultationis, atque conscientiae.

unit.source: As for Sequence 8 of the Shepherd pathway, known as Listeners, they often received revelations from that figure.
unit.target: Quoad Sequentiam VIII viae Pastoris, quae Auditores nominantur, saepe ab ea figura revelationes accipiuntur.

unit.source: Nevertheless, Lumian needed a plausible excuse.
unit.target: Tamen Lumian rationem plausibilem egere habebat.

unit.source: He couldn’t just tell Mr. K outright, “Yes, I am a member of the Aurora Order, part of the Tarot Club, and also affiliated with the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society. My Major Arcana card holder is an Angel, and I know countless demigods who can lend a hand. Besides worshiping your Lord, I also believe in Mr. Fool. Occasionally, I praise the Sun and say By Steam…”
unit.target: Non poterat simpliciter dicere ad Dominum K: “Ita vero, membrum Ordinis Aurorae sum, particeps Taroti Club, atque etiam Societati Investigationis Simiarum Crispatarum adsocio. Tenens chartam meam Major Arcana, Angelus est; et innumeros semideos novi qui auxilium ferre possunt. Praeterquam Dominum tuum adoro, etiam in Mr. Fool credo. Interdum solem laudo et dico: ‘Per Steam…’”

unit.source: Wasn’t this equivalent to provoking him in his face?
unit.target: Num hoc non essent aequivalens provocatio illi in facie?

unit.source: Unspoken truths didn’t always need to be voiced.
unit.target: Veritates inauditae non semper voce enuntiandae sunt.

unit.source: Mr. K subtly nodded.
unit.target: Dominus K submisse annuit.

unit.source: “Good job. Dealing with matters involving evil gods demands all your strength.”
unit.target: “Bene factum. Quae rebus diis malignis pertinent, totam vim vestram exigunt.”

unit.source: Then, he added, “After learning that your adversary is tied to an ancient evil god, I’ve already reported it to the higher‑ups. At that time, our Aurora Order’s Angels were likely keeping an eye. If anything truly occurred, one or more would have definitely descended.”
unit.target: Deinde addidit: “Postquam didici hostem tuum ad deum antiquum malum sociatum esse, iam id superioribus nuntiavi. Illo tempore, angeli Ordinis Aurorae nostri verisimiliter inspexerunt. Si quid vere accideret, unus vel plures certo descenderent.”

unit.source: “…” Lumian’s expression froze.
unit.target: “…” Vultus Lumiani paulisper immobilis fuit.

unit.source: Did the Aurora Order’s Angel also observe the spaceship back then?
unit.target: Num et Angelus Ordinis Aurorae nave spatiale illinc observavit?

unit.source: Isn’t this setup too exaggerated?
unit.target: Nonne haec dispositio nimis exaggerata est?

unit.source: April Fool’s isn’t even an organization with a single demigod!
unit.target: ‘Aprilis Stultitia’ non est quidem institutio cum uno semideo!

unit.source: Is Celestial Worthy such a taboo when it comes to Madam Magician and the Aurora Order?
unit.target: Num ‘Celestial Worthy’ tam vetitum nomen est apud Dominam Magicam et Ordinem Aurorae?

unit.source: It’s understandable for the Tarot Club to give it significance, especially considering its connection to Mr. Fool’s awakening.
unit.target: Intelligibile est ut Tarot Club momentum illud tribuat, praesertim propter nexum eius cum excitanda Mr. Fool.

unit.source: But why does the Aurora Order behave as if they’re confronting a formidable adversary…
unit.target: Sed cur Ordo Aurorae se gerit quasi adversarium formidabilem oppugnaretur…

unit.source: Lumian pushed aside the issue of inviting an Angel and four demigods for his revenge.
unit.target: Lumian quaestionem de invitando Angelo et quattuor semideis pro vindicta sua deponit.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but sigh at the Aurora Order’s exaggerated reaction.
unit.target: Non potuit non suspirare ob responsionem exageratam Ordinis Aurorae.

unit.source: Mr. K fixed his gaze on his subordinate and delivered a passionate lecture, “Just because high‑ranking individuals are keeping an eye on us doesn’t mean we can be lax and handle things half‑heartedly. These individuals have numerous crucial matters to attend to. They might only cast an occasional glance our way. If we don’t put in enough effort and work diligently, it could easily lead to complete failure. And in that scenario, death won’t be sufficient to atone for our sins.”
unit.target: Dominus K oculos suos in subditum suum fixit et praelectionem fervidam edidit: “Quod homines summi gradu nos observent, non significat nos laxos esse aut res dimidio animo agere. Hi homines multa gravia curare habent. Forsitan solum aliquoties nos intuentur. Si non satis operam dederimus et diligenter laboraverimus, facile totam cladem afferet. Et in tali casu, mors non sufficit ut peccata nostra expientur.”

unit.source: “Yes, yes, you’re right,” Lumian echoed Mr. K without any intention of arguing.
unit.target: “Ita, ita, recte dicis,” repetuit Lumian, Dominum K allocutus, sine ulla intentione dissensionis.

unit.source: Upon returning to Loki’s rented apartment, Lumian gathered the remaining five spoils of war and grinned at Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
unit.target: Rediens ad locum conducatus a Loki, Lumian reliquas quinque praedas belli collegit et ad Francam, Jennam, et Anthonym risu obtentavit.

unit.source: “It’s finally our turn to choose.”
unit.target: “Nunc tandem nostrum est eligere.”

unit.source: Not wanting to tease the eager Franca any further, Lumian pointed to the dining table where the items were laid out.
unit.target: Ne Francam avidam amplius provocaret, Lumian ad mensam ad cenam dispositam res demonstravit.

unit.source: “Take your pick first.”
unit.target: “Elige primum.”

unit.source: “Hehe.” Franca smiled sheepishly, shamelessly picking up the Seven‑Stone Bracelet.
unit.target: “Hehe.” Franca, timide subridens, absque verecundia armillam septem lapidum elegerat.

unit.source: She exclaimed excitedly, “I can teleport too!”
unit.target: Exclamavit excitata: “Etiam me transferre possum!”

unit.source: “Aren’t you afraid of overhearing something you shouldn’t?” Lumian teased.
unit.target: “Nonne times ne quid tibi non oportet audire?” iocose provocavit Lumian.

unit.source: Franca had already considered this issue.
unit.target: Franca iam hanc quaestionem consideraverat.

unit.source: “It’s not like I’ll wear it forever. I’ll only use it when I need it. And teleportation takes only a short time.
unit.target: “Non enim id in aeternum geram; solum id utar cum necessarium erit, et teleportatio breviter perficitur.

unit.source: If I really hear an unknown voice, the impact will be minimal. I should be fine if I remove it in time.”
unit.target: Si vere vocem ignotam audivero, effectus minimus erit. Bene se habebo, si eam tempore auferam.

unit.source: “Don’t worry. The negative effects of Beyonder items similar to charms aren’t strong. They can even be considered weak.”
unit.target: “Noli solliciti esse. Effectus adversi rerum Beyonder similium talismanis non sunt robusti; immo, putari possunt leves.”

unit.source: Lumian scoffed dismissively.
unit.target: Lumian irridebat.

unit.source: “Have you forgotten what you have on you?
unit.target: “Num oblitus es quid habeas in te?

unit.source: “Primordial Demoness figurine! Mirror World Fragment!”
unit.target: “Figura Demoressae Primordialis! Fragmentum Mundi Specularis!”

unit.source: What if she heard the Primordial Demoness’s ravings?
unit.target: Quid si audierit delirationes Demoressae Primordialis?

unit.source: Franca cleared her throat and said, “I’m now a member of the Demoness Sect and a believer in the Primordial Demoness. What’s wrong with listening to the voice of God? At most, it’ll make me excited. When the time comes, heh heh…”
unit.target: Franca guttur purgavit et dixit: “Nunc sum membrum Sectae Demoressae et in Demoressam Primordialem credo. Quid est mali in auscultatione vocis Dei? Maxime, excitabit me; cum tempus adveniet, heh heh…”

unit.source: She glanced at Lumian and Jenna, keeping her thoughts to herself.
unit.target: Aspicit ad Lumian et Jennam, cogitationes suas tacitas servans.

unit.source: “I’ll get your help!”
unit.target: “Auxilium vestrum petiam!”

unit.source: Franca immediately added, “Furthermore, my Primordial Demoness figurine and the Mirror World Fragment are stored in the Traveler’s Bag. They won’t be taken out unless absolutely necessary. It’s as if they’re sealed.”
unit.target: Franca statim addidit: “Praeterea, figura mea Demoressae Primordialis et Fragmentum Mundi Specularis in sacculo itineris servantur. Non erunt extrahenda, nisi omnino necesse sit; quasi sigillatae sunt.”

unit.source: Lumian remained silent.
unit.target: Lumian silens remansit.

unit.source: He turned to Jenna and Anthony, asking, “Which one of you wants to go first?”
unit.target: Ad Jennam et Anthonym conversus est et rogavit: “Quis ex vobis primum procedere vult?”

unit.source: “Anthony. He played a more significant role than me this time,” Jenna replied politely.
unit.target: “Anthony. Hac vice eum maiorem partem quam me egit,” Jenna comiter respondit.

unit.source: Anthony smiled.
unit.target: Anthony subridens est.

unit.source: “Are you disregarding me as an Intisian man? I still believe in ‘lady’s first.’”
unit.target: “Num me ut virum Intisianum neglegis? Ego tamen credo in ‘feminae primae’.”

unit.source: Considering Jenna’s usual Showy Diva demeanor, she might have typically responded with something like, “Those Intisian men who claim ‘lady’s first’ only want to get them in bed. Are you having such thoughts about me too?”
unit.target: Considerata consueta Jennae vultus Diva ostentator, fortasse respondisset: “Illi viri Intisiani, qui dicunt ‘feminae primae’, solum volunt eas in lecto habere. Num et de me tales cogitationes geris?”

unit.source: Jenna, despite her lack of overt actions, had a knack for teasing in a crude manner.
unit.target: Jennam, quamvis nullos gestus evidenter ostenderet, ingenium habebat ad irridendum rustice.

unit.source: However, at this moment, after exchanging glances with Lumian and Franca, she turned to Anthony with sincerity.
unit.target: Tamen, hoc momento, postquam oculos cum Lumiano et Franca communicavit, sincera ad Anthonym se vertit.

unit.source: “I’m in a dilemma. I want you to help me eliminate an option.”
unit.target: “In dilemma sum. Cupio ut me adiuvare velis ad optionem tollendam.”

unit.source: Anthony didn’t decline and assessed the remaining four items.
unit.target: Anthony non negavit et reliquas quattuor res contemplatus est.

unit.source: “The Blood Gold ring enhances my survivability and strengthens my direct attacks. However, whether it’s dependency or madness, it’s something a Psychiatrist should avoid. Furthermore, I’m now a Hypnotist. I can use Psychological Invisibility and have the protection of Dragon Scales.
unit.target: “Anulus Sanguis‑Aureus superviventiam meam auget et impetum directum meum roborat. Sed, sive sit addictio sive insanitas, rem est quam medicus mentis vitare debet. Praeterea, nunc hypnosus sum; invisibilitatem psychologicam uti possum et protectionem squamarum draconum habeo.

unit.source: Apart from underwater mobility, this brooch can only be used in close combat. Why would a Hypnotist like me engage in close combat?
unit.target: Praeterquam mobilitatem sub aquis, haec fibula solum in proelio proximo adhiberi potest. Cur ergo hypnosus ut ego in proelio proximō contendam?

unit.source: “The Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristics and blank painting album aren’t bad. If the former is crafted into a mystical item with weak negative effects, it should be very useful. However, that’s not a certainty for the moment unless I find a very good Artisan…”
unit.target: “Characteres Somnii Latronis Beyonder et album picturae vacui non sunt mali. Si prior in rem mysticam, cum effectibus adversis levibus, conficiatur, valde utilis erit. Attamen, hoc nondum certum est, nisi artificem optime convenientem reperiam…”

unit.source: Anthony decided on the blank painting album.
unit.target: Anthony album picturae vacui elegit.

unit.source: “As an information broker, I’m adept at sketching. Such an item that can create different effects is very suitable for a Hypnotist to observe first before taking action.”
unit.target: “Sicut nundinator, delineare peritus sum; talis res, quae diversos effectus conficere possit, hypnoso primum exploranda est antequam agendum sit.”

unit.source: Without needing Madam Magician’s explanation, Franca had already used Magic Mirror Divination to confirm the function of the blank painting album:
unit.target: Sine eius Dominae Magicae explicatione, Franca iam divinatione speculi magici confirmaverat munus album picturae vacui:

unit.source: “The objects drawn on it might become alive and stay so for a short period of time. They might also have different effects. The painting paper will lose its mystical effects after being used once. The negative effect is never to respond to the knocks coming from the painting paper.”
unit.target: “Res in eo depictae fortasse vivant et per brevem tempus tales manere possunt. Etiam diversos effectus praebere possunt. Charta picturalis post unum usum effectus mysticos amittet. Effectus adversus numquam respondet ad pulsus ex charta picturae veniendos.”

unit.source: Lumian and Jenna agreed that it was very similar to the abilities of Pixies.
unit.target: Lumian et Jenna convenerunt id esse valde simile facultatibus Pixarum.

unit.source: After Anthony stored the painting paper, Jenna seized the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic without hesitation.
unit.target: Postquam Anthony charta picturalis conposita est, Jenna proprietatem Somnii Latronis Beyonder sine mora arripuit.

unit.source: “Why?” Lumian inquired with amusement.
unit.target: “Cur?” inquit Lumian cum hilaritate.

unit.source: Jenna looked at him and grinned happily.
unit.target: Jenna ad eum aspexit et laete subridens.

unit.source: “It’s the most valuable! Among the remaining three items, only it corresponds to a Sequence 5. Even if it fails to become a mystical item, it can be sold for a large sum of money.”
unit.target: “Illud est pretii summi! Ex reliquis tribus rebus tantum id ad Sequentiam V convenit. Etsi in rem mysticam non convertatur, magno pretio vendi potest.”

unit.source: I still owe Franca 45,000 verl d’or. In the future, I might even purchase the Demoness of Pleasure potion formula from her.
unit.target: Adhuc Francae debeo 45,000 verl d’or. In futuro, fortasse etiam formulae potionis Demoressae Voluptatis ab ea emi possim.

unit.source: “An excellent reason.” Lumian casually glanced at the remaining two items and placed the grayish‑white lightning‑shaped brooch on his chest. “I want this. In the future, call it the Fury of the Sea.”
unit.target: “Eximia causa.” Lumian leviter reliquas duas res aspexit et fibulam similem fulmini in colore cinereo‑albo in pectore posuit. “Hoc volo. In futuro, voca illud Furorem Maris.”

unit.source: He chose the brooch over Blood Gold because, as an Ascetic, he could bear impatience and other emotions. Pure madness was too dangerous for him, given the darkness in his heart.
unit.target: Fibulam prae Anulo Sanguis‑Aureo elegit, quod ut asceticus impatiens aliosque affectus ferre poterat. Insania pura ei nimis periculosa erat, propter obscuritatem cordis sui.

unit.source: Lumian tossed the Blood Gold ring to Franca.
unit.target: Lumian anulum Sanguis‑Aureum Francae jactavit.

unit.source: “Put it in your Traveler’s Bag. Anyone can use it whenever needed. It shouldn’t be used often.”
unit.target: “Mitte illud in sacculo itineris tuo. Quicumque id uti possit, quando opus est, debeat; non frequenter adhiberi oportet.”

unit.source: “You won’t give it to Madam Magician?” Franca asked in puzzlement.
unit.target: “Num non illud dabis Dominae Magicae?” Franca mirata rogavit.

unit.source: “Do you think she’ll take a fancy to it?” Lumian stuffed the Fury of the Sea into his Traveler’s Bag and chuckled.
unit.target: “Num putas illud ei placebit?” Lumian Furorem Maris in sacculo itineris suo recludens subridens dixit.

unit.source: “Her spoils of war are naturally the humanoid Sealed Artifact, but she might return it to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.”
unit.target: “Praedae belli eius naturaliter sunt Artifacta Sigillata humaniora, sed fortasse ea ad Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammantis reddentur.”

unit.source: With that, Lumian turned to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, “Next, I’m going to do something unsuitable for others to see. Do you want to watch?”
unit.target: His dictis, Lumian ad Francam, Jennam, et Anthonym se vertit et dixit: “Proxime aliquid agam, quod aliis inspiciendi non decet. Vosne spectare vultis?”

unit.source: 597 Too Dirty
unit.target: 597 nimis sordidus

unit.source: 597 Too Dirty
unit.target: 597 nimis sordidus

unit.source: Franca’s curiosity was piqued by Lumian’s words.
unit.target: Curiositas Francae ex verbis Luminiani excitata est.

unit.source: “Is there anything we can’t see?”
unit.target: “Estne aliquid quod videre non possumus?”

unit.source: “Are you sure you want to watch? I’m afraid it will deal a strong blow to your mind,” Lumian asked in a teasing tone.
unit.target: “Certusne vis spectare? Metuo fore ut mens tua graviter percutiat,” inquit Lumian tono iocoso.

unit.source: Amused, Franca pointed at herself and retorted, “Me? I’m not a minor. My mind is very mature. Why wouldn’t I dare to look? Heh, I’m much more knowledgeable than you, boy!”
unit.target: Ludicriter, Franca se ipsam monstravit et respondit: “Ego? Non sum minor. Mens mea mature evoluta est. Cur non audeo aspicere? Eheu, multo magis eruditus sum quam tu, puer!”

unit.source: Jenna nodded in agreement, silently endorsing Franca’s claim.
unit.target: Jenna caput nutavit in consensu, tacite verba Francae confirmans.

unit.source: Without further persuasion, Lumian left the apartment and headed to the room he had rented with a fake ID to monitor himself.
unit.target: Sine ulteriore persuasione, Lumian habitationem reliquit et ad conclave quod cum identitate ficta conducerat ad se observandum se contulit.

unit.source: Lugano was staying there with Ludwig.
unit.target: Lugano ibi manebat cum Ludovico.

unit.source: Franca followed with Jenna and Anthony, muttering, “I thought it was something major. Isn’t it just going to your godson? What impact on the mind…”
unit.target: Franca cum Jenna et Antonio secuta est, murmure: “Putabam hoc esse rem maximi momenti. Nonne solum filio dei patroni tui destinatur? Quanta vim in mentem concutit…”

unit.source: Lumian signaled for Lugano to retreat temporarily.
unit.target: Lumian indicavit Lugano ut ad tempus recederet.

unit.source: Then, he retrieved two gruesome items from his Traveler’s Bag, forming a humanoid figure with them.
unit.target: Deinde duo horrenda res ex sacco viatoris sui extraxit, quibus imaginem humanam efficit.

unit.source: Maintaining an unchanged expression, Lumian looked at Ludwig and pointed at the two parts of Mad Lady’s corpse.
unit.target: Facie immutata servata, Lumian Ludovicum intuens duas partes cadaveris Dominae Insanae indicabat.

unit.source: “Is it edible?”
unit.target: “Estne edibilis?”

unit.source: Edible… Franca was taken aback.
unit.target: Edibilis… Franca stupens facta est.

unit.source: Her gaze shifted between the repulsive corpse parts and Ludwig’s boyish appearance.
unit.target: Conspectus eius inter partes cadaveris repugnantis et puerilem formam Ludovici vagabatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, she felt a wave of nausea, as if her mind had been corrupted by the imagined scene.
unit.target: Subito undam nausea sensit, quasi mens eius imaginata scena corrupta esset.

unit.source: Indeed, Lumian’s godson gained knowledge or abilities by consuming specific creatures, including humans. Memory, after all, was a form of knowledge!
unit.target: Vero, filius dei Luminiani scientiam aut facultates adipiscitur per devorandum certarum creaturarum, inter quas etiam homines erant. Memoria, postremo, erat genus scientiae!

unit.source: Franca couldn’t suppress her urge to retch, regretting her decision to witness the cannibalistic act.
unit.target: Franca impellitionem vomitus reprimere non potuit, de consilio suo actum cannibalisticum spectandi paenens.

unit.source: To make matters worse, she knew the person who had been consumed—Mad Lady. She had interacted with her before.
unit.target: Ad peius faciendum, scivit personam quae devorata fuerat—Domina Insana. Ea antea cum ea colloquium habuerat.

unit.source: Jenna’s face contorted, clearly struggling to contain her churning stomach acid. Anthony, a seasoned veteran accustomed to witnessing scenes of gore, subconsciously frowned.
unit.target: Vultus Jennae contortus erat, manifeste conans acidum ventris suum continere. Antonius, veteranus et solitus spectaculis cruentis spectare, subconscius fronem contraxit.

unit.source: Ludwig scrutinized the two bloody corpse parts in Lumian’s hands for a moment before slowly shaking his head.
unit.target: Ludwig duas partes cadaveris sanguinolentas in manibus Luminiani per breve tempus consideravit, deinde lente caput agitavit.

unit.source: “It’s too dirty.”
unit.target: “Nimis sordidum est.”

unit.source: Dirty? Could it be a reference to the severe corruption of the Celestial Worthy? Even you won’t dare to swallow it for fear of something happening?
unit.target: Sordidum? Num hoc refert ad gravem corruptionem Caelestium Dignitatum? Etiam tu non audes id deglutire ne quid eveniat?

unit.source: Lumian threw Mad Lady’s two corpse parts to the ground with regret, summoning a crimson fireball that was nearly white.
unit.target: Lumian duas partes cadaveris Dominae Insanae cum maerore in terram iecit, evocans globulum ignis rubri paene albi.

unit.source: Rather than exploding, the fireball adhered to Mad Lady’s corpse, burning and compressing it into charred dust.
unit.target: Pro his, globus ignis non explodivit, sed cadavero Dominae Insanae adhaesit, comburens et in pulverem carbonis compressum factus est.

unit.source: Amidst the dancing flames and the burning fragrance, Franca and Jenna breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Inter flammas saltantes et odorem cremoris, Franca et Jenna leviter suspiraverunt.

unit.source: Lumian pulled up a chair and sat down, addressing Ludwig, who was nonchalantly nibbling on a cupcake, “Wasn’t that person’s arm dirty?”
unit.target: Lumian sellam trahevit et consedit, Ludovico loquens, qui placentam parvam non sollicite edebat, “Nonne brachium illius personae sordidum erat?”

unit.source: He was referring to Loki.
unit.target: Ad Loki referebat.

unit.source: “Just a little. The dirtiest part isn’t on the arm,” Ludwig commented casually, as if discussing which fish were poisonous and how they should be consumed.
unit.target: “Parum tantum. Maxime sordidum non est in brachio,” Ludwig leviter commentatus est, quasi de piscibus venenosis et modo edendi dissereret.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian get to the point.
unit.target: Tum demum Lumian ad rem pervenit.

unit.source: “What did you gain from that person’s arm?”
unit.target: “Quid ex illo brachchio adipiscutus es?”

unit.source: “Some knowledge,” Ludwig replied, nonchalantly nibbling on a sponge cake covered in light cream, as if he preferred not to be disturbed while eating.
unit.target: “Aliquam scientiam,” Ludwig respondit, non sollicitus, dum placentam spongiam in cremore leviter edebat, quasi non vellet interpellari dum comediret.

unit.source: Lumian, feigning indifference, asked bluntly, “What are they?”
unit.target: Lumian, imperturbabilitatem simulans, aperto interrogavit, “Quid sunt illa?”

unit.source: Ludwig’s voice alternated between clarity and muffled tones as he replied, “Sequence Knowledge about his pathway… There are two other terms… One is Dylan… and the other is Orville…”
unit.target: Vox Ludovici inter claritatem et attenuatos tonos alternabat, dum respondit, “Notitia sequentiae de via eius... Duo alii termini sunt... Unus est Dylan... et alter est Orville...”

unit.source: Dylan? Is that the name of Loki’s ancient castle? And what’s Orville? Lumian’s curiosity peaked, prompting him to interrupt Ludwig.
unit.target: “Dylan? Num nomen est archaei castri Loki? Et quid est Orville? Curiositas Luminiani culminate pervenit, impellens eum Ludwig interrumpere.”

unit.source: “Apart from the name itself, is there any relevant knowledge?”
unit.target: “Praeter ipsum nomen, num quaedam scientia pertinent?”

unit.source: Ludwig seized the opportunity to take another bite of cake. After chewing and swallowing, he said, “No, but… these two terms seem to be connected. Orville should be the name of a place, and Dylan is the castle’s name.”
unit.target: Ludwig occasionem ad alium morsum placentae arripuit. Manducato et deglutito, dixit, “Non, sed hi duo termini coniuncti videntur. Orville nomen loci esse debet, et Dylan castri nomen est.”

unit.source: Connected… Name of a place… Castle Dylan is in Orville? Where is Orville?
unit.target: Coniuncti… Nomen loci… Castrum Dylan in Orville est? Ubi est Orville?

unit.source: Lumian turned to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, realizing they were clueless, shaking their heads in ignorance.
unit.target: Lumian ad Francam, Jennam, et Antonium versa, animadvertens eos nescios esse, et capita in ignorantia agitando.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian spoke in a deep voice,
unit.target: Post breve meditationis intervallum, Lumian voce profunda locutus est,

unit.source: “Our next priority is to find information about Orville and Dylan through our respective channels.”
unit.target: “Proximum nostrum propositum est invenire informationes de Orville et Dylan per vias nostras.”

unit.source: Getting nods of agreement from Franca and the others, Lumian asked Ludwig again, “Anything else?”
unit.target: Consensu Francae et ceterorum captus, Lumian iterum Ludovicum interrogavit, “Aliud quid?”

unit.source: “His spirituality is quite abundant, and his quality isn’t bad. He doesn’t like hard liquor or drinking freely. He only drinks champagne and occasionally has coffee. He’s a loyal advocate of tea leaves. He’s healthy, has good bowel movement, and urinates normally. He hates the smell of the washroom…” Ludwig shared the information obtained from the half arm.
unit.target: “Spiritualitas eius abundat, et natura eius non mala est. Non amat liquor durum neque libere bibit. Solum champagnam bibit et interdum caffeum sumit. Fidelis est fautor foliorum theae. Saluber est, bene motus intestinorum habet, et micturam regulariter facit. Odorem latrinae odit…” Ludwig haec notitia ex dimidio brachii communicavit.

unit.source: Franca listened with keen interest, and just as Lumian was about to interject, Ludwig divulged another piece of valuable information:
unit.target: Franca cum aviditate auscultavit, et iusto cum Lumian intervenire pararetur, Ludwig alteram pretiosam informationem divulgavit:

unit.source: “He owns Castle Dylan, but he doesn’t reside there. He only returns occasionally. He’s not the sole proprietor yet. Many areas there aren’t accessible to him. Recently, he unlocked a room and acquired a dark-gold mask.
unit.target: “Possidet Castrum Dylan, sed ibi non habitat. Solum aliquando revertitur. Nondum solus possessor est. Multae regiones illuc ei non adsunt. Nuper conclave aperuit et adeptus est larvam nigro-auream.

unit.source: “That mask will grant him immense power, but once he wears it, he’ll face terrifying matters.”
unit.target: Illa larva ei ingentem potentiam dabit, sed, cum eam induerit, res terribiles experietur.”

unit.source: Could that dark-gold mask be a relic from the original owner of Castle Dylan? Perhaps a memento from the previous leader of the Secret Order? Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Num illa larva nigro-aurea sit reliquia originalis possessoris Castri Dylan? Forsitan memento a priori ductore Ordine Secreto? Lumian cogitabundus caput nutavit.

unit.source: To him, this information wasn’t particularly crucial as the dark-gold mask had already been handed over to Mr. K. Thus, he had no reason to be concerned about it.
unit.target: Ei, haec informatio minime necessaria videbatur, cum larva nigro-aurea iam domino K tradita esset; ergo, nihil curandum habebat de ea.

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony prepared to return to Trier after the Q&A session with Ludwig, having confirmed that they had gleaned all they could.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Antonius ad Trier redire praeparabantur post sessionem quaestionum et responsionum cum Ludwig, confirmato omnia percepta esse.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian took responsibility for their return journey. Franca couldn’t bring herself to use one of the Seven-Stone Bracelets at the moment.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian reditum eorum curavit; Franca se non potuit adhibere unam ex septem lapidum armillis in praesenti.

unit.source: “By the way,” Lumian looked at Franca, pondering for a moment. “Contact the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and see if they’re willing to exchange information about the humanoid Sealed Artifact and its corresponding story. We’ll make efforts to facilitate this transaction.”
unit.target: “Praeterea,” Lumian ad Francam aspexit, paulisper meditans, “Continge Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammarum et vide si parati sint ad informationes de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo atque eius historia commutanda. Conabimur hanc transactionem facilitare.”

unit.source: Upon Bard’s mention that he was uncertain about his human status, Lumian realized his resemblance to the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Cum Bardus diceret se de sua humana natura dubitare, Lumian animadvertit eum esse simile Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo.

unit.source: However, Bard retained his rationality and clarity, possessing a relatively independent fate. Otherwise, he could be deemed a walking Grade 0 humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Attamen, Bardus rationem ac claritatem servavit, sortem suam relative independentem habens; alio modo, putaretur ambulare ut Artefactum Sigillatum humanoide gradus 0.

unit.source: This sparked Lumian’s curiosity about the humanoid Sealed Artifact, wanting to uncover what had happened to her and why she had transformed in such a manner.
unit.target: Hoc Luminiani curiositatem de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo excitavit, eo quod quaerebat quid ei contigerat et cur ita mutata esset.

unit.source: Franca nodded and instinctively said, “But, uh, that lady only mentioned the possibility of returning it, nothing definite.”
unit.target: Franca caput nutavit instinctiveque dixit, “Sed, uh, illa femina solum de facultate eius redimenti locuta est, nihil certum.”

unit.source: “We’re merely striving to facilitate the transaction. It’s not guaranteed either.” Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: “Solum conamur transactionem faciliorem reddere. Quamquam non est id certum,” inquit Lumian subridens.

unit.source: He quickly sent Franca, Jenna, and Anthony back to Trier Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative before entering Aquina Street.
unit.target: Celeriter Francam, Jennam, et Antonium ad Trier Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative redire misit, antequam in Via Aquina intraret.

unit.source: Strolling among the citizens still immersed in the afterglow of the celebration, he made his way towards Solow Motel.
unit.target: Inter cives adhuc in luce celebrationis immersos ambulans, ad Solow Motel se contulit.

unit.source: Half of the motel’s fifth floor had collapsed, and the fourth floor was severely damaged.
unit.target: Dimidium tabulati quintae Solow Motel corruit, et tabulatum quartum graviter laesum erat.

unit.source: Otta, the owner, observed the scene with sorrow and helplessness.
unit.target: Otta, dominus, scaenam cum maerore et impotentia contemplatus est.

unit.source: He wanted to cry, but the tears wouldn’t come.
unit.target: Volebat flere, sed lacrimae non veniebant.

unit.source: At a certain point, Noelia of the Fertility Order approached Louis Berry, the adventurer overseeing Solow Motel.
unit.target: Ad certo puncto, Noelia ex Ordine Fertilitatis accessit ad Ludovicum Berry, adventorem qui Solow Motel curabat.

unit.source: She spoke in a formal tone, “Your partner said you’d be responsible for the compensation.”
unit.target: Ea, tono formali, dixit: “Socius tuus annuntiavit te responsalem esse de compensatione.”

unit.source: Lumian retrieved 10,000 gold risot from his Traveler’s Bag and handed it to Noelia.
unit.target: Lumian decem milia risot aureorum e sacco viatoris sui extraxit et tradidit Noeliae.

unit.source: Noelia glanced at his black coin bag and sighed with emotion.
unit.target: Noelia in sacculum nigrum nummorum eius aspexit et cum affectu suspiravit.

unit.source: “That’s good stuff.”
unit.target: “Optima res est.”

unit.source: The combat nun then counted the compensation.
unit.target: Deinde monialis bellica compensationem numeravit.

unit.source: “10,000 risot? That’s enough to build two motels like this!”
unit.target: “Decem milia risot? Satis est ad duas moteles huiusmodi extruendos!”

unit.source: “How generous. Just as expected from an adventurer who recently bagged a bounty of 300,000 gold risot.”
unit.target: “Quam liberalis. Sicut exspectatum a aventore, qui nuper praemium trecenta milia risot aureorum adeptus est!”

unit.source: Lumian brushed off Noelia’s teasing and continued, “This is the reward from the Paco family’s commission.”
unit.target: Lumian iocum Noeliae deiecerat atque procedens dixit, “Hoc est praemium ex commissione familiae Paco.”

unit.source: “The Paco family…” Noelia fell silent.
unit.target: “Familia Paco…” Noelia tacuit.

unit.source: The Paco family’s matriarch, the current family head, and his wife—all perished in this conflict.
unit.target: Matriarcha familiae Paco, caput familiae hodiernum, et uxor eius—omnes in hoc certamine perierunt.

unit.source: Lumian pressed on, weaving through the crowd as if on a leisurely stroll.
unit.target: Lumian procedebat, per turbam intertextus, quasi leniter ambulans.

unit.source: In the dusk’s afterglow, he heard singing, seabirds chirping, and citizens animatedly discussing the past few days.
unit.target: In crepusculo post splendorem, cantus audivit, aves marinas stridulas, et cives vehementer de proximis diebus disserentes.

unit.source: “Did you see that?
unit.target: “Vidistine id?

unit.source: In the morning, seabirds came to pay their respects to the Governor of the Sea!”
unit.target: Mane, aves marinas venerandi causa ad Praefectum Maris accesserunt!

unit.source: “Is this year’s sea prayer ritual that successful?
unit.target: “Num ritus orationis maris huius anni tam felix est?

unit.source: “That’s right.
unit.target: “Ita est.

unit.source: Back then, many vines grew crazily.
unit.target: Illo tempore, multae vites insaniter creverunt.

unit.source: Many people fainted from joy.
unit.target: Multi ex gaudio ceciderunt.

unit.source: This is Earth Mother’s recognition of the sea prayer ritual!
unit.target: Hoc est agnitio Matris Terrae ritus orationis maris!

unit.source: “No, that’s not right. It represents a bumper harvest. It means this year’s fish harvest will fill ship after ship!”
unit.target: “Minime, hoc non est verum. Id repraesentat messem copiosam; hoc ergo significat messem piscariae huius anni navem post navem replebit!”

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: “Praise the Governor of the Sea!”
unit.target: “Laudate Praefectum Maris!”

unit.source: Though Lumian wasn’t privy to the Church of Earth Mother’s method to make citizens view the morning mysticism roundup as a miracle, he sensed joy and delight in everyone’s hearts.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian non versabatur in ratione Ecclesiae Matris Terrae qua cives mane mysticam colectionem ut miraculum haberent, tamen gaudium et delectationem in cordibus omnium sensit.

unit.source: Leisurely, he thought, I wonder if the remaining committee members of the Fisheries Guild have finalized the choice for the fake Governor of the Sea.
unit.target: Lente cogitans, miror num reliqui membra commissionis piscatoriae electionem falsi Praefecti Maris consummaverint.

unit.source: Sure, the real Simon Guiaro is the top contender.
unit.target: Certe, verus Simon Guiaro est optimus contenderentis.

unit.source: However, it doesn’t matter who takes the role this year.
unit.target: Attamen, nihil refert quis hanc partem hoc anno capiat.

unit.source: The power leaked by the spaceship is now in my possession.
unit.target: Potestas, quae a nave siderali effusa est, nunc in possessione mea est.
