unit.source: In the next year or even two, there won’t be frequent catastrophes in these waters.
unit.target: In anno proximo vel etiam biennio, casus catastrophici in his aquis non frequenter occurrent.

unit.source: The sea creatures will reproduce faster thanks to the ‘watering’…
unit.target: Creaturae maris celerius proliferabuntur, propter irrigationem.

unit.source: Heh heh, from a certain perspective, I’m the true Governor of the Sea—for just a week…
unit.target: Heh heh, ex aliqua parte, verus Praefectus Maris sum—modo per hebdomadam…

unit.source: In the midst of the lively parade and numerous street vendors, Lumian casually located a bar and ordered an undiluted Manzan and a large cup of locally brewed dark-gold malt beer.
unit.target: Inter vivam pompam et plures mercatorum in viis, Lumian casualiter popinam invenit atque iussit Manzan non dilutum et magnum poculum cerevisiae obscuro-aureae localiter factae.

unit.source: Placing the Manzan glass across from the small round table, he lifted his beer, clinking it.
unit.target: Posuens vitrum Manzan trans mensam parvam rotundam, cerevisiam suam attollens, sonitum reddidit.

unit.source: Then, he muttered with a smile, “Did you see that? Did you hear that? Their dance, their singing, and the sound of fish multiplying.
unit.target: Tum subridens murmuravit, “Vidistine id? Audivistine id? Saltus eorum, cantus eorum, et sonus piscis multiplicantium.

unit.source: “Isn’t this the future you desire?”
unit.target: Nonne hoc est futurum quod desideras?

unit.source: With that said, Lumian downed a mouthful of dark-gold beer.
unit.target: Dictis his, Lumian poculum cervisiae obscuro-aureae deglutivit.

unit.source: 598 Confrontation and Reconciliation
unit.target: 598 Confrontatio et Reconciliatio

unit.source: 598 Confrontation and Reconciliation
unit.target: 598 Confrontatio et Reconciliatio

unit.source: The night draped the land in darkness, and stars adorned the sky above Port Santa.
unit.target: Nox terram tenebris induta est, et stellae caelum super Port Santa ornabantur.

unit.source: The festive crowd had dispersed, leaving behind the remnants of celebration—discarded litter and the lingering scent of alcohol.
unit.target: Multitudo festiva dissoluta est, reliquias celebrationis relinquens—res abiectas et odorem alcoholis manentem.

unit.source: With the official end of the holiday, the city would soon buzz with work again.
unit.target: Cum feriae officialiter finitae sint, urbs mox iterum opere fervebit.

unit.source: Lumian lingered at the bar until closing time.
unit.target: Lumian in taberna moratus est usque ad tempus clausurae.

unit.source: As he stepped out, the deserted streets welcomed him, illuminated only by sporadic gas lamps.
unit.target: Cum egrediebatur, viae desertae eum excipiebant, solum lampadibus gasi intermisso lumine illustratae.

unit.source: The late-night air hinted at the approaching winter’s chill.
unit.target: Aër nocturnus serotinus de hiemis frigore imminenti insinuabat.

unit.source: Lumian breathed it in, feeling the crisp freshness entering his lungs.
unit.target: Lumian eam inspiravit, sentitque recentiam nitidam in pulmones suos ingredientem.

unit.source: The rhythmic crash of waves against the shore added to the night’s serenity.
unit.target: Rhythmice percussus undarum contra litus silentium nocturnum augebat.

unit.source: In seemingly high spirits, Lumian, slightly tipsy, walked past the aftermath of the celebration with hands in his pockets, unnoticed in the silent surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian, in animo altissimo apparens, paulum ebrius ambulabat praeter reliquias celebrationis, manubris in sinu suis, in silentio circumstantibus ignotus.

unit.source: He made his way back to the room rented under a false identity.
unit.target: Rediit ad conclave sub falsa identitate conductum.

unit.source: Upon opening the door, he found Lugano pacing anxiously in the living room.
unit.target: Aperiens ianuam, invenit Lugano in atrio anxie vagantem.

unit.source: “Still up?” Lumian raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: “Adhuc vigilas?” inquit Lumian, supercilium levans.

unit.source: Lugano, looking like he’d recovered from a serious injury, spoke with a complex expression,
unit.target: Lugano, qui ex gravi laesione restitutus videbatur, locutus est vultu perplexo,

unit.source: “An hour ago, Captain Noelia of the combat nuns paid you a visit. Not in armor, but a stunning dress. She has quite the figure…”
unit.target: “Hora abhinc, Capitana Noelia de monachis bellicis te visitavit. Non in armis, sed in veste splendida. Illa formam praeclaram habet…”

unit.source: “And then?” Lumian inquired, a smirk on his face.
unit.target: “Et deinde?” quaesivit Lumian, subridens.

unit.source: Lugano replied with envy, “She left disappointed when I told her you weren’t around.”
unit.target: Lugano, invidia affectus, respondit: “Illa destituta discessit, cum ei dixissem te non adesse.”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, “What’s it got to do with you? Why are you still awake after an hour?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Quid ad te hoc pertinet? Cur adhuc vigili es post horam?”

unit.source: Lugano coughed awkwardly, “I had a sudden contemplation about my future. Should I return to Trier and pursue a medical career, or should I opt for a different path?”
unit.target: Lugano, ineptum tussiens, inquit: “Subito meditatus sum de futuro meo. Redire ad Trier curriculo medico sequi, an aliud iter eligere debeam?”

unit.source: Ignoring the Doctor’s musings, Lumian, with a smile, washed up briefly and retired to his room, succumbing to sleep.
unit.target: Neglegens medici cogitationes, Lumian, subridens, breviter se lavavit et in cubiculo suo se recepit, somno cedens.

unit.source: In his dreams, recent events blended into a chaotic tapestry, weaving stranger and more bizarre stories.
unit.target: In somniis suis, recentes eventa in textum tumultuosum miscebantur, texentes fabulas insolitas et mirabiles.

unit.source: At precisely 6 a.m., Lumian awoke and promptly sat up.
unit.target: Ad horam sextam ante meridiem, Lumian expergefactus est et statim consedit.

unit.source: His thoughts sharpened as he recalled the dream.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius acutae factae sunt, dum somnium recordabatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, a detail struck him:
unit.target: Subito, minutia quidam eum percussit:

unit.source: Disregarding the possibility of the Aurora Order having covertly observed the situation, the crucial aspect of the sea prayer ritual was Amon’s utilization of the altar in Milo Village to discreetly imbue Lie with a “Steal” ability.
unit.target: Praeter considerationem facultatis Ordinis Aurorae rem clandestine observavisse, pars maximi momenti in ritu orationis maris fuit usus Amonis altaris in Vicus Milo ad Liae artem furtandi occulte tradendam.

unit.source: Without this intervention, the opening of the spaceship’s energy passageway would have led to a reversal.
unit.target: Sine hoc interventu, apertura itineris energiae navis sideralis ad inversionem duxisset.

unit.source: Deprived of the sea’s power, he couldn’t have ensnared Mad Lady with the authority of the Governor of the Sea, delaying her until Madam Magician’s arrival.
unit.target: Maris potentia carens, non potuit Dominae Furiosae sub auctoritate Praefecti Maris capere, eam differens usque ad adventum Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: However, Celestial Worthy, positioned at the pinnacle of the Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways, should possess an in‐depth understanding of Marauder abilities.
unit.target: Tamen, Caelestis Dignus, constitutus in vertice itinerum Vatis, Discipulorum, et Praedorum, debet profundam scientiam facultatum praedorum habere.

unit.source: It seemed unlikely that He hadn’t considered the possibility of an Amon hiding at the altar, granting “Steal” powers.
unit.target: Minime videbatur, ut ille non consideravisset possibilitatem Amonis ad altare latitando, facultates “furtandi” largiens.

unit.source: It made sense that He hadn’t shared this knowledge with April Fool’s; they were expendable tools, and excessive information might weaken their resolve during the operation.
unit.target: Illud sensum faciebat, ut ille hanc scientiam non communicaverit cum Aprilis Stultis; erant instrumenta expendibilia, et nimia notitia eorum constantiam in operatione debilitare posset.

unit.source: But the overall plan shouldn’t have crumbled due to this.
unit.target: Sed totum consilium ob hoc non debuit corruere.

unit.source: Were Celestial Worthy’s intentions more intricate than they seemed?
unit.target: Erantne intentiones Caelestis Digni magis intricatae quam videbantur?

unit.source: Had He secretly achieved a goal, or did Amon and His unseen ally orchestrate events in advance?
unit.target: Num ille occulte propositum assecutus esset, an Amon et socius eius invisibilis eventus praeordinaverunt?

unit.source: Had Amon truly kept watch over the altar in Milo Village without pause, last year’s sea prayer ritual might not have failed.
unit.target: Si Amon vere sine intermissione altare in Vicus Milo custodivisset, ritus orationis maris anni praeteriti fortasse non defecisset.

unit.source: There remains the prospect that He wanted to derive amusement from April Fool’s antics.
unit.target: Manet tamen prospectus, ut ille ex Aprilis Stultorum gestibus delectari vellet.

unit.source: The chaos wrought by April Fool’s last year was perhaps understandable.
unit.target: Chaos, a Aprilis Stultorum anno praeterito factus, fortasse intellegibilis erat.

unit.source: Shouldn’t the most straightforward approach this year involve discreetly allowing the completion of the Ring of the Sea Queen during the ancestor honoring ritual?
unit.target: Num non modus simplicissimus huius anni non esset, ut per ritum maiorum honorandi, Anulus Reginae Maris occultim compleretur?

unit.source: Subsequently, events could unfold with Ultraman assuming the guise of the incoming Governor of the Sea, only to be dumbfounded when the sea sacrifice ritual succeeded!
unit.target: Deinde, eventus evolvi poterant, cum Ultraman in personam venturi Praefecti Maris se mutaret, solum ut stupefactus esset, cum ritus sacrificii maris feliciter peractus esset!

unit.source: Why the convoluted path?
unit.target: Cur iter convolutum?

unit.source: What was the purpose behind these seemingly unnecessary steps?
unit.target: Quid erat proposito his gradibus, quae apparenter supervacua erant?

unit.source: There must be something I’m missing…
unit.target: Aliquid certe mihi deest…

unit.source: Lumian massaged his temples and rose from the bed.
unit.target: Lumian tempora sua massavit et ex lecto surrexit.

unit.source: The revelation didn’t surprise him.
unit.target: Revelatio eum non stupefecit.

unit.source: It would be abnormal if he quickly unraveled the true motives of every participant in such complex scenarios involving high-level entities.
unit.target: Abnormale esset, si celeriter vera consilia omnium participantium in talibus intricatis casibus altorum entium perspicuisset.

unit.source: Regardless, his goal was accomplished, and the perilous black hole in the spaceship remained sealed.
unit.target: Tamen, propositum eius peractum erat, et vorago nigerrima in nave siderali sigillatus manebat.

unit.source: The rest was not his concern.
unit.target: Cetera non erant eius cura.

unit.source: If he could decipher it, great. If not, he could always write to Madam Magician to provide a timely reminder.
unit.target: Si id perspicere posset, optime; sin non, poterat semper ad Dominam Magicam scribere ut monitionem tempestivam afferret.

unit.source: After a jog around the still-slumbering Port Santa, Lumian penned a letter to Madam Magician, detailing his reflections.
unit.target: Post cursum circa Portum Santa adhuc dormientem, Lumian epistolam ad Dominam Magicam scripsit, meditationes suas explicans.

unit.source: As Lumian finished, Lugano, who had been out gathering breakfast for Ludwig, returned to his quarters.
unit.target: Dum Lumian finem faciebat, Lugano, qui prandium pro Ludwig colligere erat, ad suas cubicula rediit.

unit.source: Taking a moment to contemplate, Lumian handed over 1,000 gold risot to Lugano.
unit.target: Aliquantulum meditans, Lumian Lugano mille risot aureos tradidit.

unit.source: With a composed tone, he stated, “I’ll be away for a few days. Take care of Ludwig. When I return, this commission will be completely over.”
unit.target: Cum tono composito, inquit: “Aliquot diebus absens ero. Cura de Ludwig. Cum rediero, haec commissio omnino finita erit.”

unit.source: When the time came, Lumian planned on taking a boat to the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Cum tempus advenisset, Lumian consilium habuit navigare ad Continentem Australem.

unit.source: Lumian intended to conspire and make preparations along the way.
unit.target: Lumian destinabat conspirare et in itinere praeparationes facere.

unit.source: His aim was to be ready for the final conspiracy and advance to Sequence 5 upon reaching his destination in the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Scopus eius erat paratus esse ad ultimam coniurationem et in Sequenciam V progredi, cum destinatum in Continente Australem attigeret.

unit.source: Without prying into his employer’s destination, Lugano nervously asked, “W- will there be any danger in the next few days?”
unit.target: Sine inquisitione de destino patroni eius, Lugano anxie quaesivit: “Num in proximis diebus aliquod periculum fore?”

unit.source: “It’s done,” Lumian replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Factus est,” respondit Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “If any other danger arises, go to the Fertility Order and seek protection.
unit.target: “Si aliud periculum oritur, ad Ordinem Fertilitatis vade et protectionem quaere.

unit.source: “Isn’t that what you’ve been anticipating?”
unit.target: “Nonne hoc est, quod exspectabas?”

unit.source: Lugano grinned sheepishly, reassured by Lumian’s demeanor.
unit.target: Lugano, verecunde subridens, Lumiani habitu securatus, risit.

unit.source: Under the shining sun of Port Santa, with delicious food and passionate women, staying a few more days seemed like a pleasant prospect!
unit.target: Sub sole fulgenti Port Santae, cum cibo delicioso et mulieribus ardentibus, paucos dies manere amoenum videbatur!

unit.source: A two‐story relay carriage raced through the village towns scattered across turquoise pastures, making its way towards the base of the Pyraez mountain range.
unit.target: Currus duplex tabulatus per oppida vicorum, disseminata in pratis caeruleo-turquoisi, festinanter cucurrit ad radices montium Pyraez.

unit.source: Maintaining his disguise as the adventurer Louis Berry, Lumian occupied a window seat in the carriage, silently observing the passing scenery.
unit.target: Servans larvam ut viator Louis Berry, Lumian in curru sellam ad fenestram occupavit, silentissime scaenam transequentem contemplans.

unit.source: Each turquoise pasture was adorned with flocks of sheep, resembling scattered clouds.
unit.target: Singula prata caeruleo-turquoisa ornata erant gregibus ovium, similes nubibus dispersis.

unit.source: Shepherds, clad in practical and mobile robes, strolled amidst the grazing animals.
unit.target: Pastores, vestimentis practicis et mobilibus induti, inter greges ovium ambulabant.

unit.source: Some had their own shacks, while others utilized small, wheeled shepherd’s huts for mobility.
unit.target: Nonnulli domos proprias habebant, alii vero parvas casas pastorales, rotis ornatas, ad mobilitatem adhibebant.

unit.source: Occasionally, local villagers attempted to drive away the incoming shepherds, only to be met with sly smiles or placated with money and supplies.
unit.target: Aliquando, vicani loci conabantur pastores adventantes depellere, sed aut risibus callidis aut pecunia et commeatibus sedati sunt.

unit.source: Faced with determined locals, the shepherds, arriving from the mountain pass, reluctantly moved to more desolate areas, contending with the watchful eyes of wild wolves and other creatures…
unit.target: Obpositi a vicanis pertinacibus, pastores, ex transitu montano advecti, invito in regiones desertiores migraverunt, contendentes cum vigilibus oculis luporum ferarum et aliorum creaturarum…

unit.source: The scenes spoken of by the Cordu shepherds presented themselves vividly to Lumian, searing a memory in his mind.
unit.target: Scaenae, quas pastores Cordu narraverunt, Lumiano vividissime apparuerunt, memoriam in animo eius ardenter incinentes.

unit.source: Two days later, the relay carriage halted at the foot of the Pyraez mountain range, pausing in a small town outside the mountain pass.
unit.target: Duo diebus post, currus duplicatus sistit ad pedem montium Pyraez, morans in parvo oppido extra transitum montanum.

unit.source: Lumian changed into a black tweed coat, preparing to venture into the mountain alone.
unit.target: Lumian vestem nigram “tweed” induit, se parans ad montem solum ingredi.

unit.source: As he ascended the mountain ridge, the cold wind intensified, rendering the wilderness almost devoid of life.
unit.target: Dum montem ascendebat, ventus frigidus intensus factus est, regionem silvestriam paene sine vita reddens.

unit.source: Navigating the sparsely vegetated mountainous terrain, Lumian followed the trails left by shepherds and merchants.
unit.target: Per terram montanam parum vegetatam, Lumian semitas, quas pastores et mercatores reliquerant, secutus est.

unit.source: Under the birdless gray sky, the desolate landscape featured withered trees and a meager stream.
unit.target: Sub caelo griseo sine avibus, terra desolata arboribus defessis et rivulo exiguo insignita erat.

unit.source: Winter’s solitude permeated the air.
unit.target: Solitudo hiemis aerem permeabat.

unit.source: In the cold solitude, it took him nearly three days to traverse the Dariège mountain range and reach the river outside Cordu.
unit.target: In frigida solitudine, fere tres dies ei necessarii erant ut rangum montium Dariège transiret et flumen extra Cordu perveniret.

unit.source: Circling the towering forest, Lumian promptly spotted the blood-colored pillar, emanating the aura of a mountain peak despite its modest height.
unit.target: Circumdans silvam imponentem, Lumian statim columnam sanguine coloratam animadvertit, quae, quamquam parva altitudine, aurae cacuminae montis emanabat.

unit.source: As Lumian gazed, footsteps approached from ahead.
unit.target: Dum Lumian intuens, vestigia pedum a fronte appropinquabant.

unit.source: A middle-aged man, clad in a leather coat and clasping his hands together, appeared.
unit.target: Vir mediā aetāte, veste coriacea indutus et manus coniungens, apparuit.

unit.source: Trembling in the cold wind, the forest ranger shouted, “Don’t go any further. That village is gone!”
unit.target: Tremens in vento frigido, custos silvae clamitavit: “Nolite ulterius procedere. Illud vicum periit!”

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes moved beyond the ranger to the collapsed and burned structures in the distance.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani ultra custodem ad ruinas combusas in longinquo versabantur.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he inquired in a deep voice, “What happened to that village?”
unit.target: Post brevem moram, voce profunda quaesivit: “Quid illi vicum accidit?”

unit.source: The forest ranger glanced around and lowered his voice, “They said they believed in demons. The villagers went crazy, burned down their houses, and walked into the abyss.
unit.target: Custos silvae circumspiciens, vocem demisit et dixit: “Dixerunt se daemonibus credere. Vicani insaniverunt, domos suas combusserunt, et in abyssum ambulaverunt.

unit.source: “Look, would a normal village be like this?”
unit.target: “Vide, num vicus ordinarius talis esset?”

unit.source: Lumian fell silent for a long time.
unit.target: Lumian diu silentium cepit.

unit.source: Seeing this, the forest ranger sincerely said, “In any case, those old men instructed me to prevent anyone from entering this village. They said that it’s bad luck; it would provoke the demons.”
unit.target: Hoc videns, custos silvae sincere dixit: “Quocunque modo, illi senes mihi praeceperunt ne quisquam hoc vicum intret. Dixerunt id esse infaustum; daemonibus provocandum esse.”

unit.source: Lumian remained silent, refraining from further inquiry.
unit.target: Lumian silentium retinuit, ulterius interrogare abstinens.

unit.source: Staring at the unfamiliar yet oddly familiar ruins, he turned away from the village entrance.
unit.target: Intuens ruinas ignotas, sed insolenter familiares, se a limine vici avertit.

unit.source: Step by step, he approached the nearest alpine pasture, the wind howling around him.
unit.target: Gradatim, se appropinquavit ad proximam pratum alpine, ventus circa eum ululans.

unit.source: The grass here had completely withered, blown away by the wind, leaving behind barren patches of brown soil.
unit.target: Hic herba plane exsiccata erat, vento dissipata, relinquens maculas aridas terrae fuscae.

unit.source: Lumian surveyed the ruins of Cordu, then located a shack abandoned by the shepherds.
unit.target: Lumian ruinas Cordu perspexit, deinde casulam ab pastoribus desertam invenit.

unit.source: Inside, he lay down, closing his eyes and remaining motionless.
unit.target: Intus, se iacuit, oculos clausit et immotus remansit.

unit.source: If only everything that had transpired before could be dismissed as a dream.
unit.target: Utinam omnia quae antea evenissent tamquam somnium neglegerentur!

unit.source: When he woke, the alpine pasture was vibrant green once more, birds returned to the sky, and Ol’ Tavern bustled with farmers and herdsmen.
unit.target: Cum evigilavit, pratum alpine iterum viridem apparuit, aves ad caelum redierunt, et Ol’ Tavern cum agricolis et pastoribus multitudine impleta erat.

unit.source: His sister persistently urged him to study, while Reimund, Ava, and the others pondered uncertain futures, unaware of the life awaiting them…
unit.target: Soror eius pertinaciter eum ad studendum hortabatur, dum Reimund, Ava, et ceteri futurum incertum meditabant, nescii de vita quae eos exspectabat…

unit.source: Abruptly, Lumian stood before Lugano and Ludwig.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian coram Lugano et Ludwig stetit.

unit.source: “You’re finally back!” Lugano exclaimed, relief evident in his voice, as if he had encountered a savior.
unit.target: “Tandem rediisti!” exclamavit Lugano, levamen in voce eius evidens, quasi salvator convenisset.

unit.source: Ludwig’s appetite had surged once more, and the 1,000 risot had disappeared faster than anticipated.
unit.target: Appetitus Ludovigi iterum surrexit, et mille risot celerius quam exspectatum evanuerant.

unit.source: Another week, and Lugano would have to contemplate using his own funds.
unit.target: Altera hebdomada, et Lugano cogitare debebit de usu propriarum pecuniarum.

unit.source: He couldn’t allow the child to go hungry; he might resort to eating him!
unit.target: Non poterat parvulum esurire permittere; fortasse ad eum edendum recurreret!

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response, saying, “The commission is over. I’ll pay the balance now. Do you want my help to teleport back to Trier, or do you prefer taking a boat yourself or crossing the Dariège mountain range?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Commissio finita est. Relictum nunc solvam. Visne auxilium meum ut te celeriter ad Trier redeam, an mavis ipse navem capere aut montes Dariège transire?”

unit.source: 599 If You Have “Power,” Use It
unit.target: Si Potestatem Habes, Utere Ea

unit.source: 599 If You Have “Power,” Use It
unit.target: Si Potestatem Habes, Utere Ea

unit.source: Lumian didn’t hurry Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian Lugano non festinavit.

unit.source: He preferred to observe the Doctor’s decision-
unit.target: Praeoptavit consilium medici observare.

unit.source: making.
unit.target: (Implicit in the previous sentence.)

unit.source: After a pause, Lugano gathered his courage and inquired, “Will you be bringing Ludwig along in the future?”
unit.target: Post mora, Lugano fortitudinem colligens interrogavit: “Num Ludwigum in futurum tecum afferes?”

unit.source: “Of course,” Lumian replied, glancing sideways at Ludwig, who was devouring a roasted octopus.
unit.target: «Certe,» respondit Lumian, ex latere intuitus ad Ludwigum, qui polypum assum edebat.

unit.source: Had he not received the 0-01 information from the Church of Knowledge, he wouldn’t have considered keeping such a child around.
unit.target: Nisi informationem 0-01 ab Ecclesia Scientiae acceperat, talem puerum retinere non cogitasset.

unit.source: However, Ludwig had proven his usefulness.
unit.target: Attamen, Ludwig utilitatem suam ostenderat.

unit.source: In the future, he might serve as another Loki trap.
unit.target: In futurum, fortasse ut aliud “Loki laqueum” fungatur.

unit.source: Lugano swallowed and offered, “I can assist you in caring for Ludwig, so you won’t need to factor him in when dealing with matters—unlike how you could simply leave whenever you pleased in the past.”
unit.target: Lugano deglutivit et proposuit: “Adiuvare te possum in Ludwig curando, ut eum in rebus non referas, prout antea quovis tempore discedere potuisti.”

unit.source: As anticipated… Lumian wasn’t taken aback by Lugano’s proposal.
unit.target: Ut praevidebatur… Lumian Lugani propositione non perterrefactus est.

unit.source: He raised his chin slightly and inquired, “Reason?”
unit.target: Levit paullo mentum et interrogavit: “Cur?”

unit.source: Lugano smiled sheepishly and explained, “During this journey, I’ve witnessed much and faced attacks.
unit.target: Lugano verecunde subrisit et explicavit: “Per hunc iter multa vidi et impetus subii.

unit.source: It made me realize that Sequence 8s are still insignificant in the mysticism world.
unit.target: Id me fecit intellegere quod sequence octo adhuc in mundo mysticae parva sunt.

unit.source: They’re ill-equipped to handle risks.
unit.target: Male instructi sunt ad pericula superanda.

unit.source: Yes, if I return to Trier and discreetly wield my Doctor powers, I’ll undoubtedly attain middle-class status.
unit.target: Ita, si ad Trier redeam et secretim potentias meae medicas adhibeam, certo statum mediocris assequemur.

unit.source: It’s not inconceivable to ascend to high society, but I fear that garnering too much fame will draw the attention of official Beyonders.
unit.target: Non impossibile est in societatem altam ascendere, sed timeo ne nimia fama attentionem officialium Beyonderorum attrahat.

unit.source: Trier isn’t as lenient as Port Santa, which is more accommodating to wild Beyonders.
unit.target: Trier non est tolerantior quam Portus Santa, qui Beyonderos feroces magis recipit.

unit.source: Furthermore, those dangerous Beyonders are always lurking around us.
unit.target: Praeterea, illi Beyonderi periculosi semper circa nos latent.

unit.source: I refuse to be defenseless the next time I’m targeted.
unit.target: Recuso esse sine defensione, si me iterum oppugnant.

unit.source: “If you refrain from participating in mysticism gatherings and solely run a clinic as a doctor, you wouldn’t be entangled in dangerous affairs.
unit.target: “Si a conventibus mysticis abstines et solum clinicam geras ut medicus, in rebus periculosis non implicaberis.

unit.source: You could easily handle ordinary thieves and bandits,” Lumian countered nonchalantly.
unit.target: Facile poteris fures et latrones comunes superare,” respondit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: Lugano shook his head.
unit.target: Lugano caput movit.

unit.source: “The Beyonder who left me his relics, enabling me to become a Planter, once warned me that once I enter the mysticism world, escape is impossible.
unit.target: “Beyonder, qui reliquias suas mihi reliquit, quibus plantator fieri potui, me olim monuit: “Cum in mundum mysticum ingredieris, evadere impossibile erit.

unit.source: Beyonder incidents will always surround us.
unit.target: Casus Beyonderorum semper nos circumvenient.

unit.source: If I’m fortunate, I might survive until natural death, but if I’m unlucky, I’ll end up like him.
unit.target: Si fortunatus fuerim, usque ad mortem naturalem superstes ero; sin infortunatus, eius sim.

unit.source: At first, I didn’t fully believe it, but the events of the past six months have increasingly convinced me of its truth.
unit.target: In initio non plene credidi, sed eventus sex mensium praeteritorum me veritati eius paulatim convincerunt.

unit.source: I did nothing, yet Rue Anarchie collapsed, and a peculiar tree sprouted.
unit.target: Nihil feci, attamen Rue Anarchie corruit et arbor insolita germinavit.

unit.source: Before you hired me, I dreamed of becoming a figure in a painting, unable to return to reality.
unit.target: Antequam me conducisti, somniavi me figuram in pictura fieri, quae re ad veritatem redire non posset.

unit.source: Upon waking up, I found myself wanted.
unit.target: Evigilans, me quaesitum esse reperi.

unit.source: This time, all I did was care for Ludwig, staying clear of any involvement, yet I was still senselessly attacked…”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, solum Ludwig curare me contuli, simul implicationum vitans, sed tamen insensate oppugnabar…

unit.source: Mm… Lumian’s expression grew more peculiar as he listened.
unit.target: Mmm… vultus Lumiani magis peculiaris factus est dum auscultabat.

unit.source: I seem to be the common denominator in all your tales…
unit.target: Videtur me esse communis elementum in omnibus tuis narratis…

unit.source: Yet, you persist in following me…
unit.target: Attamen, tu pertinacanter me sequeris…

unit.source: Is this another instance of Beyonders encountering mysticism incidents? You didn’t encounter those incidents, but me…
unit.target: Num haec iterum occasio est Beyonderorum mysticos casus experiendi? Tu non hos casus expertus es, sed me…

unit.source: Lugano continued, “I’ve also witnessed Beyonder powers like teleportation and tsunamis.
unit.target: Lugano continuavit: “Etiam vires Beyonderorum, sicut teleportatio et tsunami, perspexi.

unit.source: Being just a Sequence 8 no longer satisfies me.
unit.target: Solum esse sequence octo iam non me satiat.

unit.source: I believe I’ll find more opportunities by following you.”
unit.target: Credo me, te sequeris, plura opportunitates inveniturum esse.”

unit.source: Lumian gazed at Lugano, unsure if someone had influenced him to insist on following or if Ludwig had somehow “tamed” him to be his “nanny.”
unit.target: Lumian ad Lugano intuitus erat, incertus num aliquis eum ad te sequeris compelleret, aut num Ludwig eum aliquo modo “nutricem” fecisset.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian thought Lugano, as a Beyonder of the Planter pathway, had ties to the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Initio, Lumian putavit Lugano, ut Beyonder viae Plantatoris, nexūs haberet cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

unit.source: However, despite paying close attention, he hadn’t observed any additional communication between his guide and the Fertility Order or the Church of Earth Mother’s clergyman.
unit.target: Attamen, quamvis diligenter aspiceret, nihil de communicatione inter ducem suum et Ordinem Fertilitatis nec sacerdotem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae animadvertit.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lugano seemed like a stranger.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lugano ut ignotus apparuit.

unit.source: Seeing Lumian stay silent, Lugano smiled ingratiatingly and proposed, “I have a gift for languages.
unit.target: Videns Lumian silentem manere, Lugano complacenter subrisit et proposuit: “Donum mihi est linguarum.

unit.source: I can self-learn Dutanese from the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Possum linguam Dutanensem ex Continente Australi ipse discere.

unit.source: As long as you pay me 300 verl d’or a month and promise me a share of the spoils, I can continue to be your guide, private doctor, child caregiver, and be half a fighter.”
unit.target: Dummodo mihi tribuscenta verl d’or per mensem praestes et partem praediorum mihi promittas, possum pergere ut dux tuus, medicus privatus, puerorum curator, atque dimidius pugnator tibi sim.

unit.source: “Sure.” Lumian handed over a total of 10,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: «Ita,» Lumian totaliter decem milia verl d’or tradidit.

unit.source: “This is the final 5,000 verl d’or from before.
unit.target: Haec sunt ultima quinque milia verl d’or ex praeterito tempore.

unit.source: Additionally, you were attacked.
unit.target: Praeterea, te oppugnatum est.

unit.source: As per our agreement, I’ll pay you an extra 5,000 verl d’or, making it a total of 10,000.”
unit.target: Secundum conventum nostrum, additos tibi quinque milia verl d’or solvam, ut in summa decem milia verl d’or habeas.

unit.source: Lugano gladly accepted the payment and began packing.
unit.target: Lugano laete solutionem accepit et coepit sarcinas parare.

unit.source: Lumian seized the moment to count his cash, confirming he still possessed 1,000 verl d’or in gold, 76,000 verl d’or in gold coins, along with other coins, banknotes, and the remaining 2,000 gold risot yet to be spent.
unit.target: Lumian occasionem sumpsit numerare pecuniam suam, confirmans se adhuc possidere 1,000 verl d’or ex auro, 76,000 verl d’or in nummis aureis, necnon alias monetas, chartas monetarias, et reliqua 2,000 risot auri nondum expensa.

unit.source: As long as he refrained from acquiring Beyonder characteristics, potion formulas, mystical items, or high-end mysticism knowledge, the money he carried could sustain him for a considerable time.
unit.target: Dummodo se abstineat a proprietatibus Beyonder, formulae potionum, rebus mysticis, aut scientia mystica summi gradus, pecunia quam gerebat eum diuturno tempore sufficere poterat.

unit.source: The following morning, Lumian boarded the ship bound for Feynapotter, adopting the guise of the adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Mane sequenti, Lumian navigio ad Feynapotter conscendit, sub persona adventoris Ludovici Berry.

unit.source: Approaching the first-class suite, he turned to Ludwig, posing a thoughtful question, “In your memories, or rather, Loki’s memories, are there any peculiar creatures?
unit.target: Accedens ad cellam primae classis, ad Ludwig se vertit, quaestionem consideratam proponens: “Num in memoriis tuis, aut potius in memoriis Loki, quaedam creaturae insolitae sunt?

unit.source: They resemble lizards but are quite small.
unit.target: Sunt similes lacertis, sed satis parvi sunt.

unit.source: They can crawl into a human’s mouth, appearing transparent and blurry, suspected to be Spirit Body.
unit.target: In os hominum repere possunt, apparentes translucidis et confusis, suspicati corpus spiritale esse.

unit.source: They have brownish-green scales and dark-green eyes.
unit.target: Habent squamas brunneo-virides et oculos virides obscuros.

unit.source: This description deviated significantly from the Starlight Lizards transformed by the Children of the Sea.
unit.target: Haec descriptio signanter differebat ab “Starlight Lizards” a Pueris Maris transformatis.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig caput movit.

unit.source: “No, it’s not in the Batings Black Insect’s memories either.”
unit.target: «Non, id neque in memoriis “Batings Black Insect” est.»

unit.source: Lumian fell silent, observing Lugano as he opened the suite door with the mannerisms of a servant.
unit.target: Lumian tacuit, observans Lugano ostium cellae cum moribus ministrorum aperire.

unit.source: Another hour passed, and amidst a whistle, the ship departed Port Santa.
unit.target: Altera hora peracta, et inter sibilum, navis Portum Santa reliquit.

unit.source: After nearly two hours of sailing, the weather gradually worsened.
unit.target: Post fere duas horas navigandi, tempestas paulatim deteriorata est.

unit.source: The waves surged, and the strong winds compelled passengers on the deck to retreat to their cabins.
unit.target: Fluctus vehementer surrexerunt, et venti validi vectōs in ponte ad cellas suas recedere coegerunt.

unit.source: Observing the dusky sky, the dark clouds stirred by the wind, and the rising waves, many passengers, sailing for the first time, felt a sense of anxiety.
unit.target: Observantes caelum obscurum, nubila obscura vento motata, et fluctus ascendentes, multi vectōs, primum navigantes, anxietatem senserunt.

unit.source: Noticing the confidence of the sailors beside them, they sought reassurance, “This is a common occurrence at sea. It’s not dangerous, right?”
unit.target: Animadvertentes fiduciam nautarum adstantes, quaesiverunt solacium: “Hoc res in mari commune est. Non periculosum, nonne?”

unit.source: A Port Santa native, working as a sailor, replied with a smile, “It’s relatively common, but it can be a bit dangerous.
unit.target: Indigenus Portus Santa, qui nauta erat, subrisus respondit: “Relativum commune est, sed aliquantum periculosum esse potest.

unit.source: If the storm intensifies, we might need to seek shelter in a nearby port.
unit.target: Si tempestas augebitur, fortasse in portu proximo asylum quaerendum erit.

unit.source: But don’t worry.
unit.target: Sed noli solliciti esse.

unit.source: This year’s sea prayer ritual was a success.
unit.target: Ritus orationis maritimae huius anni successit.

unit.source: The current Governor of the Sea will protect us and prevent any shipwrecks!”
unit.target: Praefectus Maris hodiernus nos proteget et naufragia impediat!”

unit.source: Governor of the Sea… The passengers became even more uneasy upon hearing the sailor’s response.
unit.target: Praefectus Maris… Vectōs, audito responsu nautae, etiam magis turbati sunt.

unit.source: They had taken part in various sea prayer rituals and celebrations in Port Santa.
unit.target: Participaverunt variis ritibus orationis maritimae et celebrationibus in Portu Santa.

unit.source: While enjoyable, they didn’t truly believe that the Governor of the Sea could exert any significant influence on the waves.
unit.target: Quamquam iucunda, verum non crediderunt Praefectum Maris fluctus regere posse.

unit.source: Amidst their unease, they were astonished to find that the rising waves suddenly subsided.
unit.target: In medio eorum sollicitudinum, stupuerunt invenientes fluctus ascendentes subito quieti factos esse.

unit.source: Despite the dark clouds and strong winds, the seawater seemed to be pressed down by an invisible force, showing no noticeable fluctuations.
unit.target: Non obstante nubibus obscuris et ventis validis, aquae maris videbatur vi invisibili pressa esse, nec fluctuationes apparentes ostendens.

unit.source: The Port Santa natives erupted in cheers.
unit.target: Indigeni Portus Santa plausu acclamaverunt.

unit.source: “Long live the Governor! Praise the Governor of the Sea!”
unit.target: «Vivat Praefectus! Laudate Praefectum Maris!»

unit.source: Witnessing this, the passengers exchanged glances, momentarily speechless.
unit.target: Id videntes, vectōs se mutuo aspexerunt, per momentum loquela carentes.

unit.source: In the first-class suite, Lumian relaxed in a recliner, sipping undiluted Manzan.
unit.target: In cella primae classis, Lumian in sessili quiescebat, libens Manzan indivisum.

unit.source: On his lap lay a Southern Continent Dutanese introductory textbook.
unit.target: In gremio eius iacebat liber introductorius linguae Dutanensis ex Continente Australi.

unit.source: Clenching his right hand into a fist, he pulled it downward.
unit.target: Manum dextram in pugno cohibens, eam deorsum traxit.

unit.source: A section of the dark clouds in the sky descended, forming a formidable funnel.
unit.target: Pars nubium obscurarum in caelo descendit, infundibulum formans.

unit.source: Sunlight penetrated the massive hole, brightening the cabin and highlighting Lumian’s book.
unit.target: Lumen solis per ingentem hiatus penetrauit, cellam illustrans et librum Lumiani evidenter ostendens.

unit.source: Retracting his right hand, Lumian flipped through a page of the book.
unit.target: Manum dextram retractans, Lumian paginam libri volvit.

unit.source: He found the Governor of the Sea’s abilities truly advantageous at sea.
unit.target: Invenit virtutes Praefecti Maris vere utilissimas esse in mari.

unit.source: Unfortunately, he could only use it for one more day.
unit.target: Infeliciter, id solum ad unum diem usurpari poterat.

unit.source: Late at night in Trier, Angoulême returned to his residence and habitually switched on the radio transceiver.
unit.target: Sero nocte in Trier, Angoulême ad domum suam rediit et more solito radiotransmissorem activavit.

unit.source: Before long, a telegram arrived.
unit.target: Mox telegramma advenit.

unit.source: Upon seeing “Hidden Blade,” Angoulême frowned.
unit.target: Videns “Hidden Blade,” Angoulême fronem contraxit.

unit.source: “Two bits of good news and a spot of bad news. Which one do you want first?
unit.target: «Dua bona nuntia et unum malum. Quid primum audire vis?

unit.source: “I know. You must want to hear the good news first. I’ll get straight to it.
unit.target: «Scio. Primum nuntia bona audire cupis. Iam ad rem me conferam.

unit.source: The first piece of good news is that the humanoid Sealed Artifact has been located and secured.
unit.target: «Primum nuntium bonum est quod Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide repertum et securum factum est.

unit.source: You don’t have to worry about the business trip to Feynapotter.
unit.target: Negotium itineris ad Feynapotter te non sollicitandum erit.

unit.source: You can focus on investigating the Mirror People matter in peace.
unit.target: Potes in pace rem Populi Specularum investigare.

unit.source: The second piece of good news is that after communication, we’ve confirmed that the faction controlling the humanoid Sealed Artifact might return it to you.
unit.target: «Secundum nuntium bonum est quod, post communicationem, confirmavimus factionem, quae Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide regit, id tibi reddi posse.

unit.source: We’re willing to facilitate the matter, but you’ll need to provide all the information about the humanoid Sealed Artifact in exchange.
unit.target: Parati sumus rem hanc facilitare, sed oportet ut omnes notitias de Artifacto Sigillato tradas in commutatione.

unit.source: Of course, it’s just a possibility, nothing set in stone.
unit.target: Scilicet, sola possibilitas est, nihil tamen definitum.

unit.source: You won’t need to make a substantial payment until we reach an agreement.
unit.target: Non necesse erit tibi solutionem magnam facere, donec consensus pervenerit.

unit.source: Bad news. Heh heh, there’s a traitor in your Church.
unit.target: Nuntium malum: Heh heh, in Ecclesia tua est proditor.

unit.source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact was lost because of a mole!
unit.target: Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide ob talpam amisum est!

unit.source: We’re certain of this.
unit.target: Haec certo scimus.

unit.source: “Go, 007. Your chance to render meritorious service has arrived!”
unit.target: «Vade, 007. Tempus tuum ad officium meritorium praebeandum advenit!»

unit.source: After reading it in one go, Angoulême felt a sense of relief.
unit.target: Id totum uno lecto, Angoulême levamen sensit.

unit.source: This was because after the humanoid Sealed Artifact was lost, the Church’s upper echelons suspected a traitor and conducted an investigation, but to no avail.
unit.target: Hoc enim evenit, quia postquam Artifactum Sigillatum humanoide amissum erat, summae Ecclesiae proditorem suspicati sunt atque inquisitionem egerunt, sed frustra.

unit.source: There was indeed an issue with the case leading to the loss of the humanoid Sealed Artifact, but the five Purifiers in charge of that case had been cleared of any wrongdoing during the investigation.
unit.target: Verum quaestio in casu, qui ad amissionem Artifacti Sigillati humanoide duxit, exstabat, sed quinque Purificatores huius casus in inquisitione ab omni scelere absoluti sunt.

unit.source: They hadn’t performed well back then and had merely encountered an accident.
unit.target: Illi tunc non bene perfuerant et solum casu incidere evenit.

unit.source: It seems that the mole has concealed himself well… Angoulême muttered to himself.
unit.target: Videtur talpa se bene celaverit… Angoulême sibi ipsi submurmuravit.

unit.source: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai.

unit.source: Franca sat by the bed and chatted in the telegram group, waiting for Jenna to return.
unit.target: Franca iuxta lectum sedebat et in coetu telegraphii colloquia agebat, exspectans ut Jenna rediret.

unit.source: Her female companion would visit the Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra once a week to watch a theater performance and only return at midnight.
unit.target: Comitissa eius, femina, semel in hebdomada Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra visitaret ut spectaculum theatralem spectaret, atque solum media nocte rediret.

unit.source: However, the exact day she went was uncertain.
unit.target: Attamen, dies quo illa ivisset, incertus erat.

unit.source: Furthermore, she would disguise herself to prevent others from noticing her travel patterns.
unit.target: Praeterea, se celare solebat, ne alii itinerum eius consuetudinem animadverterent.

unit.source: Anthony, who lived nearby, had been busy infiltrating a circle of psychology enthusiasts, hoping to come into contact with a true Psychiatrist.
unit.target: Anthony, qui vicinique habitabat, circulum studiorum psychologiae infiltrabat, sperans ad verum Psychiatram pervenire.

unit.source: I seem to be the only one with time on my hands. I haven’t received any feedback about Mirror People…
unit.target: Videtur me solum esse qui tempus habeat. Responsum de Populo Specularum non accepi…

unit.source: Franca wasn’t the kind of person who insisted on having something on her hands. She excelled in finding joy in life.
unit.target: Franca non erat talis persona, quae constanter aliquid in manu tenere vellet. Illa in vita laetitiam reperire praeclare utebatur.

unit.source: While Franca thought about Jenna, Jenna—who had just finished watching the last play—put on a hat with a black veil and stood up to leave the theater, where many spectators were still lingering.
unit.target: Dum Franca de Jenna cogitabat, Jenna—quae nuper ultimam fabulam spectaverat—pileum cum velamine nigro induit et surrexit theatrum relinquere, ubi multi spectatores adhuc morabantur.

unit.source: At the exit, she patiently queued up and moved out.
unit.target: Ad exitum, patienter in ordinem se collocavit, et discessit.

unit.source: Suddenly, Jenna sensed a slight tremor from one of the items on her.
unit.target: Subito, Jenna levem tremorem ex una rerum quae in ea erant sensit.

unit.source: Instinctively, she reached in and realized that it was the Mirror World Fragment from the Tamara family’s tomb.
unit.target: Instinctu, intulit manum et animadvertit id esse Fragmentum Mundi Specularis ex sepulcro familiae Tamarae.

unit.source: 600 Correct Reaction
unit.target: 600 Reactio Recta

unit.source: 600 Correct Reaction
unit.target: 600 Reactio Recta

unit.source: Has something happened to the Mirror World Fragment?
unit.target: Acciditne aliquid in fragmento mundi specularis?

unit.source: Jenna was taken aback for a moment before she tensed up.
unit.target: Jenna paulisper obstupuit antequam se contraxit.

unit.source: This was unprecedented.
unit.target: Hoc inauditum erat.

unit.source: The Mirror World Fragment had never exhibited such behavior before, leaving Jenna puzzled as to its sudden activity.
unit.target: Fragmentum mundi specularis numquam antea talem modum agendi ostendit, relinquens Jennam perplexam de repentina eius activitate.

unit.source: Her mind raced, attempting to decipher its significance.
unit.target: Mens eius celeriter volabat, conans eius significationem detegere.

unit.source: Could there be a disturbance in the special Mirror World itself?
unit.target: Num in ipso mundo speculari speciali perturbatio exsistere possit?

unit.source: Or perhaps someone in close proximity to me is closely involved with the special Mirror World?
unit.target: An fortasse aliquis, qui mihi prope est, arcte cum mundo speculari speciali implicatur?

unit.source: Could this be a lead in Franca’s Mirror People investigations?
unit.target: Potestne hoc esse indicium in investigationibus de specularibus hominibus Francae?

unit.source: Jenna’s instincts urged her to scan her surroundings, searching for the source of the Mirror World Fragment’s disturbance.
unit.target: Instinctus Jennæ eam ad circumiecta scrutanda hortabant, quaerens fontem perturbationis fragmenti mundi specularis.

unit.source: Jenna controlled herself just in time as a realization hit her:
unit.target: Jenna se temperavit justo tempore, cum eam pervenerit comprehensio:

unit.source: If this phenomenon was caused by someone closely tied to the special Mirror World, there was a high chance that the “sensation” was mutual.
unit.target: Si hoc phaenomenon ab aliquo, qui arcte coniunctus erat cum mundo speculari speciali, causatum esset, magnum erat casus ut sensatio mutua esset.

unit.source: In simpler terms, while the fragment trembled slightly, there should be some anomaly on the person’s body, detectable only by themselves.
unit.target: Verbis simplicioribus, dum fragmentum leviter tremebat, debet esse quaedam anomalía in corpore, quae solum ab ipso detegi possit.

unit.source: They, too, were searching for the source of the problem.
unit.target: Et illi quoque quaerebant fontem difficultatis.

unit.source: Under such circumstances, hastily surveying her surroundings might lead to discovery by the other party.
unit.target: Sub his condicionibus, festinanter circumspiciens, ab altera parte id detegere possit.

unit.source: A thunderous strike might follow.
unit.target: Ictus tonitruosus sequi potest.

unit.source: Maintaining her composure, Jenna slowly moved out the door, her eyes fixed on the road ahead.
unit.target: Conservans suam compossitionem, Jenna lente per ostium exiit, oculi in viam ante se fixi.

unit.source: During this process, like many spectators, she turned her head slightly and glanced at the wall clock in the theater’s foyer to confirm the time: 11:05 p.m.
unit.target: Interim, sicut plures spectatores, caput leviter vertit et horologium muralem in atrio theatri intuens ad tempus confirmandum, ut notaret: 11:05 post meridiem.

unit.source: After noting the time, Jenna returned to the foyer through the exit.
unit.target: Postquam tempus animadvertit, Jenna per exitum in atrium redivit.

unit.source: The spectators around her dispersed, and the place gradually became less crowded.
unit.target: Spectatores circa eam dispersi sunt, et locus paulatim minus frequentatus factus est.

unit.source: Jenna’s Mirror World Fragment fell silent, no longer trembling abnormally.
unit.target: Fragmentum mundi specularis Jennæ quietum factum est, neque amplius insolite tremuit.

unit.source: Just now, there was no one in the foyer, and the Mirror World Fragment didn’t tremble when I watched the theater performance…
unit.target: Nunc autem, in atrio, nemo erat, et fragmentum mundi specularis non tremuit, dum spectaculum theatralem observarem…

unit.source: This means that for the abnormality to happen, both parties need to be close to each other, no more than five meters apart, like when we were squeezing for the exit in the foyer.
unit.target: Hoc significat ut, ad id insolitum eveniens, uterque pars inter se prope esse debeat, non ultra quinque metra distantia, sicut cum ad exitum in atrio constringebamur.

unit.source: Now, is everything back to normal because the distance between them has widened again?
unit.target: Nunc, num omnia ad statum normalem redierunt, quia inter eos distantia iterum ampliata est?

unit.source: Jenna’s thoughts raced as she fully displayed her theatrical acting skills.
unit.target: Cogitationes Jennæ volitabant, dum plene artes scaenicas exhibebat.

unit.source: Like ordinary spectators, she left the foyer and arrived on the street.
unit.target: Sicut spectatrices ordinariae, ex atrio discessit et in viam pervenit.

unit.source: She boarded a rental carriage belonging to the Imperial Carriage Company and paid 2.5 verl d’or in advance, her heart aching.
unit.target: Invehit currum conductum, qui ad Societatem Curruum Imperii pertinebat, et 2.5 verl d’or praestitit, corde dolente.

unit.source: If the subway and public carriages were still running at this hour, she wouldn’t have taken a rental carriage back to Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative from Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra.
unit.target: Si vehicula subterranea et publica adhuc hoc tempore cursabantur, non vehiculum conductum recipiret ab “Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative” ad “Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra.”

unit.source: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai.

unit.source: Jenna recounted her encounter to Franca and asked, “Did the Mirror World Fragment on you tremble slightly around 11:05?”
unit.target: Jenna Francæ narrationem suam recitavit et quaesivit: “Num fragmentum mundi specularis in te leviter tremuit circa 11:05?”

unit.source: “No,” Franca replied with unusual certainty.
unit.target: “Minime,” Franca respondit cum insolita certitudine.

unit.source: Without waiting for Jenna to make a judgment, she smiled awkwardly and quickly added, “I don’t think so. As you know, my Mirror World Fragment is stored in my Traveler’s Bag. Even if there’s a tremor, I can’t sense it.”
unit.target: Nullo exspectans ut Jenna iudicium faceret, illa difficulter subridens celeriter addidit: “Non puto ita esse. Ut scis, fragmentum mundi specularis meum in sacculo Viatoris repositum est. Etiamsi tremor eveniret, id sentire non possum.”

unit.source: As Jenna couldn’t help but roll her eyes, Franca tersely acknowledged and said, “Do you suspect that the abnormality in the special Mirror World caused a general change? If that’s the case, even if the item is in the Traveler’s Bag, I should be able to sense it spiritually. It’s impossible to completely ignore it.”
unit.target: Cum Jenna oculos revolvere non posset, Franca breviter assentivit et dixit: “Suspicisne an insolitas in mundo speculari speciali mutationem generalem attigisse? Si ita sit, etsi res in sacculo Viatoris sit, eam spiritualiter sentire debeam. Impossibile est eam omnino neglegere.”

unit.source: “Besides, when we put these two fragments together, there’s never been a tremor. The probability of me encountering a Mirror People is very high. Or is it a member of a specific branch of the Tamara family?” Jenna said as she walked to the full‐body mirror in the living room. She stroked the surface and whispered the secret subject she wanted to inquire about.
unit.target: “Praeterea, cum hos duos fragmentos coniungimus, numquam tremor fuit. Altissima est probabilitas ut speculares homines occurram. An immo, membrum sit particularis factionis familiae Tamarae?” inquit Jenna, ambulans ad speculum totius corporis in conclavi. Superficiem leniter perstulit et occultum argumentum, de quo interrogare volebat, submurmuravit.

unit.source: The full‐body mirror’s surface quickly darkened, surging with illusory water waves.
unit.target: Superficies speculi totius corporis celeriter obscurata est, fluctibus aquae illusoriae undantibus.

unit.source: Jenna began Magic Mirror Divination.
unit.target: Jenna incipit divinationem speculi magici.

unit.source: “At approximately 23:05 last night, the area within a ten‐meter radius of me…
unit.target: “Circiter hora viginti tres et quinque minuta heri nocte, area intra radium decem metrorum circa me…

unit.source: “At approximately 23:05 last night, the area within a ten‐meter radius of me…
unit.target: Circiter hora viginti tres et quinque minuta heri nocte, area intra radium decem metrorum circa me…

unit.source: After repeating it three times, the deep, dark mirror lit up.
unit.target: Post ter id repetitum, speculum profundum et obscurum fulsit.

unit.source: In the light, Jenna saw herself in a bonnet, the theater exit connected to the theater foyer, and the audience and attendants standing within ten meters of her.
unit.target: In luce, Jenna se vidit gerentem pileum, exitum theatri in atrium coniunctum, et spectatores ac ministros intra decem metra a se stantes.

unit.source: The spirit world faithfully recorded all this information.
unit.target: Mundus spirituum fideliter omnem hanc notitiam consignavit.

unit.source: The reflection in the mirror held a dynamic quality, not static or rigid.
unit.target: Reflexio in speculo qualitatem dynamicam habebat, non staticam nec rigidam.

unit.source: Jenna swiftly observed a woman standing a few meters ahead, abruptly turning to survey the people around her.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter observavit mulierem paucis metris ante se stantem, quae subito se convertit ut circumstantes homines inspiceret.

unit.source: Donned in a black veiled hat, the lady, seemingly in her thirties, sported light eyebrows, bright yellowish eyes, and a white complexion from makeup.
unit.target: Induta pileo nigro velato, mulier, videri annorum tricesimorum, supercilia levia, oculos nitidos flavicantes, et cutem album ex ornatu habebat.

unit.source: While not conventionally beautiful, she exuded elegance through her well‐chosen attire.
unit.target: Etsi non pulchra consueta, elegantiam per bene electum vestimentum efferebat.

unit.source: Despite her refined appearance, the lady appeared to lose her composure, scanning the surroundings as if searching for a lost lover.
unit.target: Non obstante forma subtili, mulier videtur suam compotitionem amisisse, circumiecta perscrutans, quasi amatum quæreret.

unit.source: “There’s something off about her. She reacted to the Mirror World Fragment,” Franca remarked as she joined Jenna, analyzing the image in the full‐body mirror.
unit.target: “Aliquid in ea aberrans est; illa ad fragmentum mundi specularis reactionem exhibuit,” Franca, ad Jennam se adiungens et imaginem in speculo totius corporis perscrutans, remarkavit.

unit.source: “But it’s been over an hour, and she hasn’t initiated any counter‐divination. Is she careless or utterly unfamiliar with the process?”
unit.target: “Sed iam plus quam hora praeteriit, et illa ullam contram divinationem non incepit. Num neglegens est aut prorsus ignara huius processus?”

unit.source: Jenna nodded.
unit.target: Jenna annuit.

unit.source: “Can you discern anything else?”
unit.target: “Potesne aliquid aliud detegere?”

unit.source: “Nothing more.” Franca suddenly slapped her forehead. “Gosh, we should’ve asked Anthony to take a look. A Spectator would surely glean more information.”
unit.target: “Nihil aliud,” Franca subito dixerat, fronte percussa: “Eheu, debuimus Anthoni rogare ut intueretur; Spectator certe plura notitia colligeret.”

unit.source: “You’re right…” Jenna was caught off guard.
unit.target: “Recte dicis…” Jenna mirata est.

unit.source: They still weren’t used to seeking Anthony’s assistance.
unit.target: Nondum consueti erant auxilium Anthoni petere.

unit.source: Jenna suggested, “Let’s get Anthony tomorrow morning. Calling him over this late might lead to misunderstandings. Besides, it’s not an urgent matter.”
unit.target: Jenna proposuit: “Eamus cum Anthone cras mane. Eum hac sero invitare fortasse confusionem afferet. Porro, res non est urgens.”

unit.source: “Yes, he might get the wrong idea,” Franca quickly realized.
unit.target: “Ita, fortasse male id interpretabitur,” Franca celeriter conspexit.

unit.source: The next morning, after observing the scene through the Magic Mirror Divination, Anthony pondered and commented, “Her clothes were custom‐made, suggesting a well‐off family background… Despite looking a bit lost after surveying the surroundings, she may lack knowledge about the Mirror World and its corresponding fragments. This contradicts her ability to make the Mirror World Fragment tremble. The answer often lies in the point of contradiction… Her walking style indicates good etiquette training, but her status at home isn’t particularly high.”
unit.target: Postridie mane, postquam per Divinationem Speculi Magici scaenam aspexerat, Anthony meditatus est et commentatus: “Vestimenta eius ex ordine fabricata erant, quod familias opulentas inscribit… Quamquam paulo erratica videbatur, postquam circumiecta observaverat, forsitan de Mundo Speculari eiusque fragmentis ignorantiam habeat. Hoc tamen facultatem eius, qua fragmentum mundi specularis tremere faceret, contradicit. Responsum saepe in puncto contrarietatis iacet… Modo ambulandi eius bonam institutionem elegantiae indicat, sed status eius in domo non est praecipuus.”

unit.source: Franca couldn’t help but twitch her lips as she listened to the newly advanced Hypnotist dissect the target layer by layer. It felt like she had no secrets left from him.
unit.target: Franca non potuit quin labia moveat, dum noviter progressus Hypnotista scopi telam singula excideret; videbatur nihil ab eo secretum reliquum esse.

unit.source: Spectators are truly terrifying!
unit.target: Spectatores vere terribiles sunt!

unit.source: On the other hand, Jenna listened attentively, finding similarities with character analysis in drama acting class but more concrete and detailed.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, Jenna attente auscultavit, similitudines reperiens cum analysi characterum in schola actus dramatici, sed magis concretas et accuratas.

unit.source: In a daze, she felt transported back to Théâtre de l’Ancienne Cage à Pigeons, listening to her teacher’s lecture.
unit.target: In extasi, se translata sentivit ad Théâtre de l’Ancienne Cage à Pigeons, magistri lectionem auscultans.

unit.source: “These characteristics won’t help us locate her directly. They can only offer certain clues,” Anthony concluded.
unit.target: “Hae proprietates nos non directe ad eam inveniendam adiuvabunt. Tantum aliquas claves praebere possunt,” Anthony concludit.

unit.source: “Understood. Character profiling,” Franca replied in a professional tone.
unit.target: “Intellēxī. Characterum descriptio,” Franca respondit.

unit.source: Anthony took out a piece of paper, picked up a pencil, and began sketching based on his impressions, intending to track her through various channels.
unit.target: Anthony chartam extraxit, calamum arripuit, et incepit delineare ex suis impressionibus, intendens eam per variis viis persequi.

unit.source: Casually, Franca asked, “How did you deduce that the lady’s clothes were custom‐made?”
unit.target: Levis animo, Franca quaesivit: “Quomodo deduxisti vestimenta mulieris esse ex fabricatione propria?”

unit.source: Having once been a man and transformed into a woman with a potion, she remained fixated on the beauty of clothing and dresses. She didn’t care about the store or tailor.
unit.target: Quondam vir facta et per potionem in feminam mutata, illa in pulchritudine vestimentorum et tunicarum manebat fixata; de taberna aut sarto non curabat.

unit.source: Jenna couldn’t tell either, as before becoming a Witch, she hadn’t reached the level to customize her clothes.
unit.target: Jenna quoque nesciebat, nam antequam maga facta esset, ad gradum personalis vestimentorum aptationis non pervenit.

unit.source: Anthony looked up at the two Demonesses.
unit.target: Anthony duas daemonissas respexit.

unit.source: “After becoming a Spectator, especially as an information broker, I’ve deliberately honed my observation skills. I recognize the materials and characteristics of most of Trier’s ready‐to‐wear shops and the styles of many famous tailors. The lady’s dress clearly doesn’t come from any ready‐to‐wear shops.”
unit.target: “Postquam Spectator factus sum, praesertim quasi negotiator informationum, diligenter artem observationis meæ exercebam. Materias atque proprietates plerorum tabernarum Trier, quae vestimenta pronta vendunt, et styli multorum sartorum clarorum agnoscere possum. Vestis illius plane non ex ullis tabernis praeparatis provenit.”

unit.source: Franca and Jenna revealed somewhat embarrassed expressions. Fortunately, Anthony was engrossed in his sketch and hadn’t noticed their reactions.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna vultus paulo rubicundi ostenderunt. Fortuna gratum, Anthony in sua delineatione occupatus erat nec eorum reactiones animadvertit.

unit.source: Port Santa.
unit.target: Portus Santa.

unit.source: Nolfi, clad in a blouse and a light‐colored jacket, escorted Batna to the dock.
unit.target: Nolfi, induta tunica et mantello candido, Batnam ad molum comitata est.

unit.source: Batna, sporting a half top hat, adjusted his rapier and cautiously inquired, “Are you really planning to stay here?”
unit.target: Batna, gerens dimidium pilei, gladium suum composuit et caute quaesivit: “Num vere hic manere cogitas?”

unit.source: Nolfi calmly responded, “I’m already a combat nun of the Fertility Order.”
unit.target: Nolfi tranquillime respondit: “Iam sum monialis pugnatrix Ordinis Fertilitatis.”

unit.source: “It’s just now dawning on me that the sea prayer ritual isn’t about gaining power and making a pact with an evil god. It’s about protection. It’s an act of self‐sacrifice.”
unit.target: Modo mihi instat quod ritus precationis maris non ad potentiam ac pactionem cum malo deo conficiendum sit; sed de tutela agitur. Actus sui ipsius sacrificii est.

unit.source: “In the past, members of the Fisheries Guild used their influence and wealth to entice others into becoming the Governor of the Sea and Maidens of the Sea. Now, they’ve pledged to the Earth Mother’s Church and the Fertility Order. Going forward, they’ll inform potential candidates of the possible challenges and consequences beforehand, allowing them to make their own choices. I want to stay here and oversee this.”
unit.target: Priore tempore, membri Gildis Piscandi potentiam et divitias suas adhibebant ut alios in gubernationem maris ac puellarum maris allicerent. Nunc vero se obligaverunt ad Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et Ordinis Fertilitatis. Futuro tempore, candidatos potentiales de difficultatibus et consequentiis antea certiores facient, ut sua sponte eligere possint. Hic manere volo et hoc moderari.

unit.source: “That’s good too.” Batna sighed. “Unfortunately, my destiny lies in sea adventures, and I can’t remain in one place.”
unit.target: “Id quoque bonum est.” Batna suspiravit: “Infeliciter, fatum meum in maritimis periculis iacet, nec in uno loco manere possum.”

unit.source: The lovely and endearing Nolfi nodded.
unit.target: Nolfi pulchra et amabilis annuit.

unit.source: “I understand.”
unit.target: “Intelligo.”

unit.source: She asked sincerely, “Do you wish to have a child here?”
unit.target: Ea sincere quaesivit: “Visne hic prolem habere?”

unit.source: “No, n-never mind,” Batna stammered. “I’m not mentally prepared to be someone else’s father.”
unit.target: “Non, ne refert,” Batna titubavit: “Mentis non sum ad alicuius patrem fieri paratus.”

unit.source: He didn’t want his child to turn into a humanoid lizard in the future.
unit.target: Noluit filium suum in futurum in lacertam humanoidem mutari.

unit.source: Nolfi expressed regretfully, “Alright.”
unit.target: Nolfi, paenitens, respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Waving her hand, she turned around and walked away from the dock.
unit.target: Manu movens, se convertit et a molo discessit.

unit.source: After a few steps, she abruptly turned back, revealing a bright and beautiful smile.
unit.target: Post paucos passus, subito se redegit, patefaciens clarum et pulchrum risum.

unit.source: “Regardless, I’m grateful that you could accompany me out to sea.”
unit.target: “Quocumque modo, grata sum quod me comitari potuisti ad mare.”

unit.source: Without waiting for Batna’s response, Nolfi redirected her gaze and hastened her pace, leaving the dock.
unit.target: Nolfi, non expectans responsum Batnae, oculos convertit et celerius processit, ab molo discedens.

unit.source: Batna stood there, Nolfi’s final smile lingering in his mind. Her words of joy echoed in his ears, and he suddenly felt a sense of loss.
unit.target: Batna ibi stabat, et ultimus risus Nolfi mente eius remansit. Eius verba laetitiae in auribus resonabant, et ille subito sensum amissionis percepit.

unit.source: After Nolfi’s figure vanished from the dock, the adventurer slowly boarded the ship returning to Port Farim.
unit.target: Postquam figura Nolfi ex molo evanuit, adventor lente in navem ascendit, quae ad Portum Farim redit.

unit.source: In the evening, inside the ship’s bar, Lumian raised a glass of amber sugar wine and addressed the patrons at the bar counter, “Ladies and gentlemen, I’m actually a magician. I can showcase an illusionary magic trick for you right now.”
unit.target: Vesperi, intra tabernam navis, Lumian poculum vini sacchari ambrae levavit et ad convivas in mensa tabernae dixit: “Dominae et domini, re vera magus sum. Possum nunc vobis artificium magicae illusionis ostendere.”

unit.source: He gestured towards the window.
unit.target: Ille ad fenestram indicavit.

unit.source: “Look outside.”
unit.target: “Aspicite foras.”

unit.source: Instinctively, the patrons glanced out the window and noticed that the surrounding waves had surged to a height of more than ten meters at some point, resembling a mountain.
unit.target: Instinctuose, convivae fenestram aspexerunt et animadverterunt undas circumstantias ad altitudinem plus quam decem metrorum in aliquo puncto extollentas, montem reminiscentes.

unit.source: Just as they blinked, the terror‐inspiring scene disappeared once again.
unit.target: Eodem momento, cum micabant, scaena terribilis iterum evanuit.

unit.source: Clap! Clap! Clap! The patrons applauded Lumian’s brilliant magic trick.
unit.target: Plaudite! Plaudite! Plaudite! Convivae praeclaram illusionis magicae artificium Lumiani plaudebant.

unit.source: 601 Strange Patient
unit.target: 601 Aeger Insolitus

unit.source: 601 Strange Patient
unit.target: 601 Aeger Insolitus

unit.source: Late at night, amidst another round of cheers for a magic trick, Lumian downed the candied wine in his hand and exited the bar with a smirk.
unit.target: Nocte sero, inter aliam turmam plausuum pro artis magica, Lumian vinum saccharatum in manu celeriter deglutivit et tabernam subrisu relicuit.

unit.source: He could already picture Aurore—if she were around—scoffing, “You’re so lame. You’re actually using the Governor of the Sea’s authority and power to pull off a magic trick. Deceiving those drunkards with the real thing. Is this your prank? You’re sure having a blast.”
unit.target: Iam poterat imaginari Aurorem – si praesens esset – irridentem: “Ineptus es. Vere uteris auctoritate et potestate gubernatoris maris ad artificium magicum perficiendum. Illos ebrios re vera fallendo. Estne hic ludibrium tuum? Pro certo valde te delectas.”

unit.source: Lumian responded silently, Being able to utilize superpowers and the Governor of the Sea’s authority for such matters, rather than in battle, should be what you desire, right?
unit.target: Lumian tacite respondit: “Ut superviribus et auctoritate gubernatoris maris ad huiusmodi res uti possis, potius quam in proelio, id quod cupias, nonne?”

unit.source: Isn’t this the joy and future you yearned for?
unit.target: Nonne hoc est gaudium atque futurum, quod desiderabas?

unit.source: In the corridor, illuminated by kerosene wall lamps, Lumian stepped on the creaking floor, making his way back to the first-class suite in the silent, empty surroundings.
unit.target: In vestibulo, a lamparis parietalibus kerosina illustratis, Lumian super pavimentum crepitans ambulavit, iter referens ad conclave primae classis in silentio et solitudine circumstantis.

unit.source: Snores and moans occasionally penetrated the walls on both sides.
unit.target: Stertura et gemitus interdum per parietes utrorumque latere penetrebant.

unit.source: Near the stairs, a room stood open, reflecting the dim yellow light of the fire.
unit.target: Prope scalas, conclave apertum stabat, tenuem flavam igne lucem reflectens.

unit.source: As Lumian passed by, he turned his head and observed the Sacred Emblem of Life, representing Earth Mother, engraved on the wall deep in the room.
unit.target: Dum Lumian praeteribat, caput vertit et Sacrum Signum Vitae, Matrem Terrae repraesentans, in pariete profundo incisum observavit.

unit.source: It portrayed a simple infant amidst wheat ears, flowers, spring water, and other symbols.
unit.target: Depinxit infans simplicem inter spicas tritici, flores, aquam fontis, et alia signa.

unit.source: In front of the Sacred Emblem of Life stood a man in a brown clergyman’s robe.
unit.target: Ante Sacrum Signum Vitae stabat vir in veste cleris fusca.

unit.source: He was less than 30 years old, with clean eyebrows and a light brown beard.
unit.target: Erat infra triginta annos natus, cum supercilia emaculata et barba leviter fusca.

unit.source: Holding a thick book, he preached to the men and women seated in different parts of the room.
unit.target: Tenens librum crassum, hominibus et mulieribus in diversis conclavibus sessis praedicabat.

unit.source: Lumian knew this was a prayer room, akin to a small, mobile cathedral with a dedicated clergyman in charge.
unit.target: Lumian sciebat hanc esse cellam precationis, similem parvae cathedralis mobili cum dedicato clerico praefacto.

unit.source: Common in countries that believed in only one deity, be it on long-distance ships or steam locomotives, they considered the need for believers to quietly pray and listen to teachings.
unit.target: Communia in terris quae unam deitatem colere solebant, sive in navibus longinquo itineris sive in machinis vaporiferis, aestimabant necessitatem fidelium silentiose orare et praecepta audire.

unit.source: Lumian, who could already understand Highlander, memorized the words, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace.”
unit.target: Lumian, qui iam linguam Highlander intelligere poterat, verba meminit: “Pretium amplexus vitae, gratia messis.”

unit.source: Retracting his gaze, he entered the corridor, ascending the stairs step by step.
unit.target: Conspicuum revocans, in vestibulum ingreditus, scalas gradatim ascendit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lugano, having just finished attending to Ludwig’s supper, heard a knock on the door.
unit.target: Simul, Lugano, qui nuper cenam Ludovici perficiebat, pulsationem ad ianuam audivit.

unit.source: “Who is it?” Lugano was surprised and intrigued.
unit.target: «Quis est?» inquit Lugano, miratus et alacritate captus.

unit.source: This couldn’t be his employer.
unit.target: Hoc certe non poterat esse patronus eius.

unit.source: He possessed the key and would simply open the door.
unit.target: Clavem habebat et ianuam simpliciter aperiret.

unit.source: Moreover, it was nearly 11 p.m. Who would visit at such an hour?
unit.target: Porro fere erat hora undecima noctis. Quis ad talem horam veniret?

unit.source: Could it be that a woman overheard my boasting on the deck, believed me, and came to share a pleasant night?
unit.target: Num ita evenit ut femina in ponte meam iactationem audivisset, me credisset, et ad noctem amoenam communicandam accessisset?

unit.source: As Lugano started to indulge in fantasies, he heard a feeble male voice.
unit.target: Dum Lugano in phantasia se indulgebat, vocem virilem debilem audivit.

unit.source: “I’m here to see Dr. Lugano.”
unit.target: «Ad Dr. Lugano videndum adsum.»

unit.source: Seeking a doctor… Lugano couldn’t help but frown, but he still opened the door.
unit.target: Doctor quaerens… Lugano frons contraxit, sed adhuc ianuam aperuit.

unit.source: Outside stood a man wrapped in a thick tweed coat, a stark contrast to Lugano’s linen shirt and thin pants.
unit.target: Extra stabat vir, veste tweed spissa involutus, prorsus contrarius vestimenti linteae et bracarum tenuum Luganoi.

unit.source: Lugano scrutinized the visitor.
unit.target: Lugano visitatorem diligenter examinavit.

unit.source: “I’m Lugano. What’s the matter?”
unit.target: «Ego sum Lugano. Quid agitur?»

unit.source: The man’s face was pale, his eyes dark, revealing little vitality.
unit.target: Vultus viri pallidus erat, oculi obscuri, parum vitalitatis revelantes.

unit.source: Though young, in his early twenties, he exuded a lifeless aura.
unit.target: Etsi ad initium viginti annos pertinebat, aura mortua emanabat.

unit.source: The man took a deep breath and weakly said, “You can call me Enio.”
unit.target: Vir altius spiritum assumpsit et languide dixit: «Mihi Enio vocare potes.»

unit.source: I heard that you helped several people on the deck discover the true cause of their illness and quickly improved their condition.
unit.target: Audivi te plurimos in ponte adiuvisse, ut causam veram morbi eorum detegerent et statum celeriter melioraret.

unit.source: I want you to treat me.
unit.target: Volo ut me cures.

unit.source: I have the money to pay for the consultation.
unit.target: Pecuniam habeo ad consultationem solvendam.

unit.source: Observing the fellow’s sickly appearance, Lugano sighed and replied, “Come in.
unit.target: Observans habitum aegrotum illius, Lugano suspiravit et respondit: «Intrede.»

unit.source: Keep your voice down.
unit.target: Loquere submissa voce.

unit.source: As you know, I’m the private doctor of a prominent figure.
unit.target: Ut scis, ego sum medicus privatus figurae eminenti.

unit.source: He doesn’t appreciate strangers disturbing him.
unit.target: Non amat ignotos eum disturbare.

unit.source: Once Enio settled on the sofa, Lugano, out of habit, inquired about his condition to conceal his subsequent mystical diagnosis.
unit.target: Postquam Enio in solio consedit, Lugano more consueto de statu eius interrogavit, ut posteriorem diagnosis mysticam celaret.

unit.source: “What’s wrong with your body?”
unit.target: «Quid corpus tuum affligit?»

unit.source: Enio paused for a moment before saying, “Since half a month ago, I’ve become sensitive to the cold and weak. No appetite. Runny nose, repeated coughing, and my condition is worsening.”
unit.target: Enio paulisper cessavit, deinde dicens: «Ab dimidio mense, frigore sensu atque infirmitate laboro. Nullum appetitum habeo; nasus stillans, tussim repetitam, et status meus deterioratur.»

unit.source: “Mm…” Lugano nodded, raising his right hand and tapping his forehead, as if contemplating the significance of the patient’s narrative.
unit.target: «Mm…» annuit Lugano, dextram manum levans et in frontem pulsans, quasi significationem narrationis aegroti meditatus.

unit.source: In reality, he seized the opportunity to activate his Spirit Vision, preparing to discern the other party’s illness from the color, brightness, and thickness of his Ether Body.
unit.target: Revera, occasionem arripuit ut Visionem Spiritus excitaret, praeparans morbum alterius ex colore, claritate, et crassitudine corporis aetherii discerneret.

unit.source: With a swift glance, Lugano nearly jumped out of his skin.
unit.target: Veloci aspectu, Lugano paene ex cute sua exsalivit.

unit.source: Is the patient sitting in front of me still alive?
unit.target: Num aegrotus, qui ante me sedet, adhuc vivit?

unit.source: In Lugano’s eyes, the once white glow shrouding Enio’s Ether Body, signifying overall balance, had turned a somber grayish-black.
unit.target: In oculis Luganoi, fulgor quondam albus corpus aetherii Enii involvens, aequilibrium totum significans, in tristis cinereo-nigro conversus erat.

unit.source: It was a dire indication of his severe illness, teetering on the edge of death.
