unit.target: Hoc erat indicium grave morbi severi eius, in limine mortis versans.

unit.source: Yet, it wasn’t this revelation that left Lugano shocked and bewildered.
unit.target: At non haec sola revelatio, sed alia, Lugano stupefactum atque confusum reliquit.

unit.source: What truly sent shivers down his spine was: the orange glow, symbolizing the health of excretion, detoxification, and other vital organs, had dimmed into complete darkness.
unit.target: Quod vere per dorsum eius tremores excitavit, fuit: fulgor aurantius, valetudinem excretionis, detoxicationis, aliisque organis vitalibus repraesentans, in profundam obscuritatem evanuit.

unit.source: No vestige of brightness remained, signaling the complete cessation of their functions!
unit.target: Nullum vestigium fulgoris remansit, indicans omnes eorum functiones omnino cessasse!

unit.source: Likewise, the yellow hue representing the digestive system, the green indicating the heart and regulatory system, and the blue denoting the throat and part of the nervous system had all dulled and lost their radiance.
unit.target: Similiter, color flavus, quem systema digestivum repraesentat, viridis, qui cor et systema regulatorium indicat, et caeruleus, qui gutturam et partem systematis nervosi denotat, omnes opacaverunt et splendorem amiserunt.

unit.source: Enio’s remaining hues were red on his limbs and purple on the surface of his head.
unit.target: Residua colora Enii erant: ruber in membris et purpureus in superficie capitis.

unit.source: W-what does this “diagnosis” imply?
unit.target: Quid hoc “diagnosis” implicat?

unit.source: This meant that Enio was a person with a silent heart, a dormant stomach, and internal organs that had relinquished their functions.
unit.target: Hoc significabat Enium esse hominem corde tacito, stomacho dormiente, atque internis organis functiones reliquisse.

unit.source: Yet, he could still think, move, and speak!
unit.target: Attamen, adhuc poterat cogitare, movere et loqui!

unit.source: Son of a bitch, where did this monstrosity come from!
unit.target: Filius caniculae, unde ista monstruositas orta est!

unit.source: Lugano, facing such an unprecedented “patient,” inwardly cursed, his frame trembling slightly.
unit.target: Lugano, coram hoc inusitato “aegroto” occurrente, intus maledixit, corpusque leviter trepidans.

unit.source: He dreaded the moment when the other might unexpectedly utter, “Doctor, I’m cold. Let me borrow your skin. Doctor, I’m hungry. Let me borrow your stomach and intestines…”
unit.target: Timebat illum momenti, cum alter improvise diceret: «Medice, frigide mihi est. Sume cute tua mihi prestare. Medice, esurio. Sume stomacho et intestinis tuis mihi concedas…»

unit.source: Noticing Lugano’s silence, Enio anxiously inquired, “Doctor, what illness am I suffering from?”
unit.target: Animadvertens silentium Luganoi, Enio anxiose interrogavit: «Medice, quo morbo laboro?»

unit.source: Illness? Lugano muttered to himself urgently, Snap out of it! Your heart has ceased beating; the absence of flowing blood naturally brings about a chilling sensation!
unit.target: Morbus? murmurat urgentissime Lugano ad se: “Emerge ex hoc! Cor tuum iam non pulsat; sanguinis effusis absentia naturaliter frigoris sensum affert!”

unit.source: Those with non-agitating stomachs certainly won’t have much of an appetite!
unit.target: Qui stomachos non excitant, pro certo parum appetitum habebunt!

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lugano pondered for a moment and declared,
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius transvolabant, Lugano paulisper meditatus, deinde declaravit:

unit.source: “Your condition is grave. I require further analysis and observation to draw conclusions. Can you visit me tomorrow morning?
unit.target: «Status tuus gravis est. Plura analysi et observationi mihi opus est ad conclusionem perducendam. Potesne cras mane me visitare?

unit.source: “Before that, I need to draw some of your blood for research.”
unit.target: «Ante ea, mihi opus est aliquantum sanguinis tui pro studio extrahere.»

unit.source: “No problem.” Despite Enio’s lack of confidence in Lugano, he extended his right hand with the mindset that attempting something was better than nothing.
unit.target: «Nihil est difficile.» Quamquam Enio in Lugano non confidit, dextram manum protulit, existimans aliquid conari melius esse quam nihil.

unit.source: Armed with the necessary tools, Lugano extracted some blood from Enio’s body using a needle, rubber hose, and a glass blood collection bottle.
unit.target: Instrumentis necessariis instructus, Lugano aliquantum sanguinis ex corpore Enii extraxit, utens acu, fistula elastica, et ampulla vitrea ad sanguinis collectionem.

unit.source: Despite their darkened hue, he noted a basic vitality still present.
unit.target: Non obstante colore eorum obscurato, quandam vitalitatem fundamentalem adhuc persentem notavit.

unit.source: Subsequently, he listened to Enio’s heartbeat and detected faint, but existing, beats.
unit.target: Postea, cor Enii auscultavit et pulsus levissimos, sed existentes, deprehendit.

unit.source: Curious… Lugano seized the opportunity of the consultation and prescription to subtly cast a faint light upon his palm, providing Enio with a simple treatment.
unit.target: Curiosus… Lugano occasionem consultationis et praeceptionis adhibuit, ut submissa luce palmam suam illuminaret, Enioque simplicem curationem praestans.

unit.source: Enio’s spirits lifted, and a semblance of strength returned.
unit.target: Animus Enii levatus est, et quasi vis aliqua rediit.

unit.source: “Thank you, Doctor. Your massage and medicine are effective. I appreciate it!” Enio left the suite with a cheerful expression.
unit.target: «Gratias tibi, Medice. Tuum massagium et medicina efficax sunt. Gratias ago!» Enio conclave cum vultu laeto reliquit.

unit.source: None of the previous doctors he had consulted had made the slightest improvement in his condition.
unit.target: Nullus doctorum priore quos consuluerat, minimam emendationem in statu eius adduxit.

unit.source: This time, he intended to set sail to the south, take a steam locomotive to the Church of Earth Mother’s headquarters for treatment.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, intendebat navigare ad meridiem, sumere machinamentum vaporarium, ad sedem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae pro curatione.

unit.source: Baffled, Lugano observed as Enio left.
unit.target: Stupefactus, Lugano eum observavit dum Enio discessit.

unit.source: Soon after, his employer returned.
unit.target: Mox postea, patronus eius rediit.

unit.source: He quickly recounted the encounter to Lumian, concluding with, “I’ve secured his blood. Can you find someone to divine the truth?”
unit.target: Celeriter illam occurrentiam Lumiano narravit, dicens: «Sanguinem eius colligui obtinui. Potesne aliquem invenire qui veritatem divinare valeat?»

unit.source: “Divination?” Lumian chuckled as he received the blood-filled bottle and knocked on Ludwig’s child’s room.
unit.target: «Divinatio?» inquit Lumian subridens, dum ampullam sanguinis plenae accepit et ad conclave pueri Ludovici pulsavit.

unit.source: “Take a sip and see what knowledge you can glean.” Lumian handed the bottle to Ludwig, ensuring no avenue of exploitation slipped by.
unit.target: «Paulum sorbe et vide quid scientiae capere possis.» Lumian ampullam Ludovico tradidit, curans ne qua via usurpationis effugeret.

unit.source: Ludwig’s expression remained stoic, as if sipping bedtime milk.
unit.target: Vultus Ludovici stoicus remansit, sed mirabiliter vacui et inermes, vultusque eius sine modo expressio manebat.

unit.source: He drank down the liquid in the bottle without flinching.
unit.target: Liquorem in ampulla absumpserit sine perterrito.

unit.source: Lugano was bewildered, his eyes reflecting surprise and confusion.
unit.target: Lugano stupefactus erat, oculi eius admirationem et perplexitatem efferentes.

unit.source: After tasting the blood, Ludwig spoke at an adequate pace, “Absent stomach, absent small and large intestine, absent lungs, absent liver and pancreas…
unit.target: Postquam sanguinem gustavit, Ludwig ad modum idoneum locutus est: “Absens stomachus, absentes intestina tenue et crassa, absentes pulmones, absens iejunus et pancreas…

unit.source: “It’s akin to a deceased person relying on mystic forces to persist…”
unit.target: «Simile est viro mortuo qui innititur viribus mysticis ut perseveret…

unit.source: “He won’t last a week…”
unit.target: «Non perdurabit per hebdomadam…»

unit.source: Wh… Lugano was taken aback that Ludwig not only imbibed human blood but also made somber judgments with a straight face.
unit.target: Wh… Lugano stupefactus erat quod Ludwig non solum sanguinem humanum biberit, sed etiam lugubria iudicia facie impertita pronuntiavit.

unit.source: He was also shocked to learn that Enio truly lacked those organs.
unit.target: Etiam perculsus est, cum didicerit Enium vere illa organa deesse.

unit.source: Initially, he believed it was just a loss of corresponding function.
unit.target: Initio credidit id esse tantum defectum functionum correspondentium.

unit.source: According to Ludwig, wasn’t Enio essentially a dead man?
unit.target: Secundum Ludovicum, nonne Enio essentia mortuus vir erat?

unit.source: What had he stumbled upon?
unit.target: Quid invenit?

unit.source: “What should we do?” Lugano turned to Lumian.
unit.target: «Quid faciamus?» Lugano ad Lumian se convertere.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but chuckle softly.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit quin leniter risu subridere inciperet.

unit.source: “What can we do? Locate the captain, the ship’s security supervisor, or the priest in the prayer room, and report this matter. They’ll handle it.”
unit.target: «Quid faciemus? Inveni capitaneum, praefectum securitatis navis, aut sacerdotem in cella precationis, et rem hanc refer; illi se occupabunt.»

unit.source: Lugano nodded and tentatively asked, “But won’t this expose me as a Beyonder?”
unit.target: Lugano annuit et dubius quaesivit: «Nonne hoc me ut Beyonder patefaciet?»

unit.source: “Tell them you’re Louis Berry’s servant,” Lumian advised calmly.
unit.target: «Dic eis te esse servum Louis Berry,» Lumian tranquille monuit.

unit.source: “Alright.” Lugano was fine with being a servant.
unit.target: «Recte.» Lugano contentus erat se servum esse.

unit.source: After a moment’s thought, he asked in puzzlement, “Did you hear any strange sounds at night? I occasionally hear a baby crying.”
unit.target: Post parvum cogitationem, quaestionem perplexus rogavit: «Audivistine aliquas voces insuetas nocte? Interdum audio infans flere.»

unit.source: “Baby?” Lumian asked, shaking his head. “I didn’t hear it.”
unit.target: «Infans?» inquit Lumian, caput agitando. «Non audivi.»

unit.source: Lugano pondered aloud, “Is there a baby crying on this floor?”
unit.target: Lugano palam meditatus est: «Num in hoc pavimento infans flere possit?»

unit.source: Then, he looked at Lumian.
unit.target: Tum Lumian aspexit.

unit.source: “Shall I go find the captain now?”
unit.target: «Nunc capitaneum quaeram?»

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes flickered as he smiled and said, “Tomorrow morning.”
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani micaverunt dum subridens dixit: «Cras mane.»

unit.source: “Alright,” Lugano agreed without hesitation.
unit.target: «Recte,» Lugano sine mora consentivit.

unit.source: He preferred waiting for dawn and sunlight before addressing such a peculiar issue.
unit.target: Mallebat auroram et solem exspectare priusquam talem rem insolitam tractaret.

unit.source: Reporting it at night made him sense an impending, unexpected event.
unit.target: Noctu id referre eum sentire faciebat imminens et inopinatum eventum.

unit.source: The sun provided a reassuring sense of security!
unit.target: Sol sensum securitatis consolatorium praebebat!

unit.source: Lumian didn’t question or provide further advice.
unit.target: Lumian neque quaestionem fecerit neque ulterius consilium dedit.

unit.source: He entered his room, freshened up, and went to bed.
unit.target: In cellam suam intravit, se refecit, et ad lectum se contulit.

unit.source: However, sleep eluded him.
unit.target: Tamen somnus eum elabatur.

unit.source: Instead, he half-closed his eyes, anticipating something.
unit.target: Pro eo, oculos dimidium clausit, aliquid exspectans.

unit.source: After an indeterminate period, Lumian heard a faint creak.
unit.target: Post spatium indeterminatum, Lumian levem crepitus audivit.

unit.source: The door to one of the rooms opened softly.
unit.target: Ianuam unius cellae leniter aperiebatur.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly sat up, silently approaching the door, cracking it open.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter exsurgens, silentio ad ianuam accedens et eam leviter recludens, se contulit.

unit.source: He saw a figure leisurely walk out of Lugano’s servant’s room.
unit.target: Vidit quandam figuram lente ambulantem ex cella servi Luganoi.

unit.source: It was Lugano, clad in a linen shirt.
unit.target: Erat Lugano, indutus camisia linteo.

unit.source: His eyes were open but oddly vacant and unfocused, his face devoid of expression.
unit.target: Oculi illius aperti erant, sed mirabiliter vacui et inermes, vultusque eius sine modo expressio manebat.

unit.source: As if sleepwalking, Lugano made his way to the suite’s door.
unit.target: Velut somnambulans, Lugano iter fecit ad ianuam conclavis.

unit.source: 602 “Surgery”
unit.target: 602 “Chirurgia”

unit.source: 602 “Surgery”
unit.target: 602 “Chirurgia”

unit.source: Lugano’s eyes remained open as he swung open the door to the suite, his gaze vacant.
unit.target: Oculi Lugani aperti remanuerunt, dum ostium ad conclave patefeceret, vultus eius vacuus.

unit.source: He stepped into the deserted corridor, where only the sound of crashing waves reverberated.
unit.target: Ingrediebat in coridorio deserto, ubi solus sonus fluctuum ruentium resonabat.

unit.source: In this moment, everyone, save for the sailor on night duty, succumbed to slumber.
unit.target: In hoc momento, omnes, nisi nauta in nocturna servitio, sopore ceciderunt.

unit.source: Lugano moved forward, the kerosene wall lamps around him casting an ethereal glow that mingled with the encroaching darkness.
unit.target: Lugano procedebat; lumina parietalia kerosina circum eum fulgorem aetherium efferebant, qui cum imminentibus tenebris miscebatur.

unit.source: He reached the end of the floor and halted in front of a vivid vermilion wooden door.
unit.target: Ad finem pavimenti pervenit et coram ianuam ligneam vividam rubram sistit.

unit.source: Creak. The door groaned open, and the darkness within seemed to swallow every trace of light.
unit.target: Crepitus. Ianuam gemens aperta est, et obscuritas intus omnem vestigium lucis vorari videbatur.

unit.source: Lugano traversed the obscurity with a blank expression, entering the room.
unit.target: Lugano obscuritatem perambulavit vultu inano, in conclave ingrediens.

unit.source: Behind him, the vermilion door was pulled shut by an imperceptible force.
unit.target: Post eum, ianuam rubeam, vis imperceptibilis eam claudens, retracta est.

unit.source: It was a suite.
unit.target: Conclave erat.

unit.source: The living and dining areas lay shrouded in darkness, devoid of any candlelit glow.
unit.target: Regiones ad vivendum et cenandum in obscuritate latebant, absque aliqua luce candelarum.

unit.source: The faint crimson moonlight filtered through the curtains, offering minimal visibility.
unit.target: Lumen lunaris rubrum leviter per cortinas infusum, parvam visibilitatem praebebat.

unit.source: At the dining table stood two shadowy figures.
unit.target: Ad mensam cenandi duo figurae umbratiles stabant.

unit.source: One of them appeared aged, with mostly gray hair and dark, deep blue eyes that seemed to absorb the night.
unit.target: Unus ex ipsis senectutem ostendebat, capillis fere canis et oculis obscuris, profundis caeruleis, qui noctem devorare videbantur.

unit.source: Despite the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes, the elder’s skin remained well-maintained, adorned in a loose, dark-black robe.
unit.target: Non obstante rugis in angulis oculorum eius, cutis senis bene curata erat, induta in veste laxae nigerrimae.

unit.source: Beside him stood Enio, the brown-haired, brown-eyed patient who had intruded upon Lugano that night, his pale face devoid of life.
unit.target: Iuxta eum stabat Enio, aegrotus cum capillis fuscis et oculis fuscis, qui illa nocte Lugani intravit, facie pallida sine vita.

unit.source: His vacant gaze fixated on the unadorned table.
unit.target: Vultus eius vacuus in mensa non ornata fixus erat.

unit.source: Lugano, as if sleepwalking, stood next to Enio, unusually quiet.
unit.target: Lugano, quasi somnambulans, iuxta Enion stetit, miris silentio.

unit.source: The elder in the loose black robe turned his head, fixing his gaze on Enio.
unit.target: Senex in veste nigra laxae caput convertit atque vultum in Enion ferefixit.

unit.source: The patient ambled towards the dining table, climbed on it, and lay completely motionless.
unit.target: Aegrotus ad mensam cenandi ambulavit, ascendit eam, et omnino immobilis iacebat.

unit.source: The blond elder brandished a sharp scalpel, unfastening Enio’s tweed coat, cashmere sweater, and cotton shirt.
unit.target: Senex flavus acutum scalpellum extulit, solvens vestem Enii confectam ex mixto textu (tweed, cashmere, et cotone).

unit.source: He pressed the razor-sharp blade against Enio’s chest, producing a ripping sound as he sliced through layers of flesh, creating a long wound.
unit.target: Premens laminae acutissimae in pectus Enii, sonum lacerationis edidit, dum per stratos carnis secabat, longum vulnus creans.

unit.source: As Enio’s chest and abdominal cavity lay exposed to the crimson moonlight, a void greeted the eye.
unit.target: Cum pectus et cavitas abdominalis Enii sub lumine lunaris rubri patefacta erant, vacuum oculum salutavit.

unit.source: No stomach, no lungs, no small or large intestines, liver, or kidneys.
unit.target: Nullus stomachus, nulli pulmones, nec intestina parva aut magna, nec iecur, nec renes.

unit.source: Only a weakly beating bright red heart, accompanied by a few blood vessels extending from it.
unit.target: Solum cor rubrum, debiliter pulsans, cum paucis vasculis sanguineis ex quo procedebant.

unit.source: With a swift motion, the old man in the dark-black robe manipulated the scalpel, his other hand flickering with a faint light as he pressed down.
unit.target: Celeriter, senex in veste nigra laxae scalpellum movebat, altera manus leviter luce micante, dum premebat.

unit.source: In a sequence too rapid for the eye to follow, he withdrew the still-beating heart in his left hand.
unit.target: In serie nimis celeriter facta, ut oculis sequeri non posset, cor adhuc pulsans manu sinistra abstulit.

unit.source: Enio’s chest and abdomen, now empty, displayed only a few non-bleeding blood vessels.
unit.target: Pectus et abdomen Enii, iam vacua, ostenderunt solum pauca vasa sanguinea non effusa.

unit.source: The old man closed the incision with a tight squeeze, sealing it with a flickering light.
unit.target: Senex incisionem arcte complevit, luce micante sigillans.

unit.source: Enio’s stomach returned to its original state, devoid of any scars.
unit.target: Venter Enii ad statum originem redivit, absque ullis cicatricibus.

unit.source: Throughout this extraordinary procedure, the special patient’s eyes remained open, as if untouched by the surgical ordeal.
unit.target: Per hanc praeclaram operationem, oculi peculiaris aegroti aperti remanuerunt, quasi a chirurgico periculo immunes.

unit.source: In that moment, he rolled off the dining table, ambled to the door, and exited the room.
unit.target: In illo momento, de mensa cenandi volutus est, ad ianuam ambulavit, et conclave egressus est.

unit.source: The old man opened his suitcase, revealing glass jars containing pale amber liquid, each cradling various organs: spleen, lungs, liver, kidneys, stomach, and intestines…
unit.target: Senex sarcinam suam aperuit, revelans vasa vitrea quae liquidum ambrae pallidae continent, qua singula varia organa fovebant: lien, pulmones, iecur, renes, venter, et intestina…

unit.source: Placing these items on the dining table in a peculiar order, surrounding the still gently beating scarlet heart, the old man in the loose black robe took a step back.
unit.target: His rebus in mensa cenandi ordine insolito disposis, circum cor rubrum adhuc leniter pulsantem, senex in veste nigra laxae gradum retraxit.

unit.source: He recited an ancient, malevolent, yet strangely intimate language.
unit.target: Recitavit linguam antiquam, malevolam, sed admodum intimam.

unit.source: As the unknown murmur resonated, the internal organs ascended slowly, upheld by an invisible force.
unit.target: Dum ignotus murmur resonabat, organa interna lente ascendebant, a vis invisibili sustenta.

unit.source: Their final positions varied, resembling the internal organs of a standing human.
unit.target: Ultimae positiones eorum variabantur, simulantes organa interna hominis stantis.

unit.source: The heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys emitted a faint glow simultaneously, outlining a form on the dining table.
unit.target: Cor, iecur, lien, pulmones, et renes simul leviter fulgentes, formam in mensa cenandi delineantes.

unit.source: It lacked a head, limbs, or bones, merely a corporeal essence that grew more defined.
unit.target: Non habebat caput, membra, nec ossa; sola essentia corporalis, quae magis definita videbatur.

unit.source: A baby’s cry echoed, faint yet tangible.
unit.target: Clamor infanti resonabat, mollis sed perceptibilis.

unit.source: However, the body distorted, squirmed, and disintegrated in the end.
unit.target: Attamen, corpus deformatum, contorsum, et demum dispersum est.

unit.source: The old man in the loose black robe sighed with regret.
unit.target: Senex in veste nigra laxae cum paenitentia suspiravit.

unit.source: Strangely, the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes were noticeably reduced, and much of his white hair had reverted to light gold.
unit.target: Mire, rugae in angulis oculorum eius evidentissime reductae erant, et multa capilla alba ad aurum levem redierant.

unit.source: In an instant, he appeared seven or eight years younger.
unit.target: In momento, septem vel octo annos iunior videbatur.

unit.source: Sensing his good condition, the elder turned his attention to Lugano.
unit.target: Sensu bonae valetudinis, senex ad Luganum vertit.

unit.source: Lugano, seemingly summoned, approached the dining table and lay down, awaiting with open eyes.
unit.target: Lugano, quasi convocatus, ad mensam cenandi accessit et se iacuit, oculis apertis exspectans.

unit.source: The elder unbuttoned Lugano’s linen shirt, took up the scalpel, and gestured as if deciding where to make the incision.
unit.target: Senex tunicam linteam Lugani disabiguit, scalpellum extulit, et gestus fecit quasi statuturus ubique incisionem facere.

unit.source: Suddenly, a loud bang reverberated.
unit.target: Subito, sonitus ingens resonavit.

unit.source: The vermilion door swung open, crashing into the wall.
unit.target: Ianuam rubeam vibratam aperuit, percussa in parietem.

unit.source: Crimson flames surged, illuminating the room, climbing the walls and ceiling, transforming the place into a fiery inferno.
unit.target: Flammae rubrae eruptae sunt, conclave illuminantes, ascendentes parietes et laquearia, locum in ignipotens infernum convertentes.

unit.source: Lumian, adorned in black hair, green eyes, a golden straw hat, a cotton shirt, a black vest, and dark pants, materialized at the door and entered the suite.
unit.target: Lumian, ornatus capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, pileo stramineo aureo, tunica ex cotone, vestis nigra, et braccis obscuris, apparuit ad ianuam et conclave intravit.

unit.source: He calmly addressed the old man in the loose black robe, “Don’t you know he’s my servant?”
unit.target: Ille tranquille senem in veste nigra laxae alloquitur: “Nonne scis eum esse servum meum?”

unit.source: The elder’s eyes narrowed as he readied the scalpel to descend towards Lugano’s neck.
unit.target: Oculi senis angustati sunt, dum scalpellum ad collum Lugani descendere praeparabat.

unit.source: However, his right hand refused to budge, seemingly restrained by an invisible force pushing it upward.
unit.target: At, dextra manus eius non moveretur, quasi vi invisibili sursum eam impellens, continebatur.

unit.source: In the midst of the rising crimson flames, Lumian paused, displaying no urgency to act.
unit.target: In medio flammarum rubrarum oriturarum, Lumian cessavit, nec cupiditatem agendi festinationem ostendens.

unit.source: He spoke with intrigue,
unit.target: Ille, cum studio, locutus est:

unit.source: “That surgery was quite fascinating—extracting internal organs while leaving the person alive, albeit gradually dying.
unit.target: “Chirurgia illa valde fascinabat—organa interna extrahens, dum hominem vivum reliquit, licet paulatim moriens.

unit.source: “And you used those organs for a ritual, rejuvenating yourself. Meanwhile, you nearly brought forth a peculiar lifeform.”
unit.target: Et illa organa ad ritum usus es, te rejuvenans; interea, paene formam vitae peculiarem produxisti.”

unit.source: Surprise flickered in the elder’s dark-blue eyes.
unit.target: Mirum in oculis senis caeruleis micabat.

unit.source: “How do you know?”
unit.target: “Quomodo scis?”

unit.source: Haven’t you just arrived in pursuit of your servant?
unit.target: Nonne venisti modo ad quaerendum servum tuum?

unit.source: And no one entered before you!
unit.target: Et nemo ante te intravit!

unit.source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian submollim risum edidit.

unit.source: “You don’t need to know.”
unit.target: “Non necesse est tibi scire.”

unit.source: I still have a few hours of Governor of the Sea authority.
unit.target: Adhuc paucos horas potestate Gubernatoris Maris mihi restant.

unit.source: Isn’t it easy to ‘see’ something in these waters?
unit.target: Nonne facile est aliquid in his aquis conspicere?

unit.source: Sensing Lumian’s confidence, certainty, ease, and absence of hostility, the elder fell silent briefly before expressing,
unit.target: Sensu fiduciae, certitudinis, facilitasque et hostilitatis absentiae Lumiani, senex breviter tacuit, deinde dixit:

unit.source: “Life is the most precious, so life becomes the finest sacrifice and ingredient.”
unit.target: “Vita est pretiosissima, ergo vita fit optima sacrificium et elementum.”

unit.source: He refrained from divulging details about the surgery or ritual, choosing instead to expound on his philosophy and the truth he sought.
unit.target: Ab enarratione singularum de chirurgia aut ritu recusavit, potius suam philosophiam ac veritatem quaesitam explicans.

unit.source: Praising and blaspheming life simultaneously? Lumian arched his eyebrows, finding it vaguely reminiscent of Lady Moon, Madame Night, and the bestowed of the Great Mother.
unit.target: Vitā laudāns et simul blasphemandus? Lumian supercilia elevatis hoc vagi modo reminiscens invenit Dominae Lunae, Dominae Noctis, atque munera a Magna Matre concessa.

unit.source: Carefully assessing the black-robed elder behind the dining table, Lumian, upon confirming his gender, temporarily set aside his sudden anxiety.
unit.target: Caute aestimans senem in veste nigra post mensam cenandi, Lumian, genus eius confirmato, sollicitudinem subitam pro tempore deiecit.

unit.source: Gazing down at the motionless Lugano on the dining table, Lumian casually inquired, “How did you control my servant?”
unit.target: Aspiciens in Lugano immobili in mensa cenandi, Lumian familiari modo quaesivit: “Quomodo servum meum coercuisti?”

unit.source: The elder fixed Lumian with a penetrating gaze, as if probing the depths of his intentions.
unit.target: Senex Lumian oculis penetrantibus ferefixit, quasi arcana intentionum eius indagaret.

unit.source: He pondered, weighing the decision to preach the truth or engage in a confrontation to eradicate the issue.
unit.target: Cogitabat, deliberans utrum veritatem praedicaret aut in contentionem se immitteret ad quaestionem eradicandam.

unit.source: After a brief silence, he spoke in a resonant voice,
unit.target: Post brevem silentiam, voce resonante dixit,

unit.source: “He’s a Blessed of the Great Mother. He heard the cries of the Son of God.”
unit.target: “Est benedictus a Magna Matre. Clamores Filii Dei audivit.”

unit.source: Great Mother? Lumian’s scalp tingled at the term.
unit.target: Magna Mater? Lumiani caput leviter titillatus est ad hoc verbum.

unit.source: Had it not been for the Sea Governor’s authority, Lumian would have launched a full-scale attack without allowing the elder a moment to react or explain.
unit.target: Nisi propter auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris, Lumian totum impetum intromitteret, nec seni momentum ad respondendum aut explicandum daret.

unit.source: Regardless, even if he eliminated the elder, spirit channeling remained a viable option.
unit.target: Quocumque modo, etsi senem eriperet, spiritus canalizatio optio manebat valida.

unit.source: Moreover, the elder could be fed to Ludwig!
unit.target: Praeterea, senem Ludwigo edendum tradi posset!

unit.source: Though taken aback by the elder’s possible reference to Lugano as a Blessed of Earth Mother, Lumian swiftly dismissed the apparent meaning.
unit.target: Quamquam senis, quod Lugano ut Benedictum Terrae Matris appellaret, obstupefactus, Lumian celeriter sensum apparentem reiecit.

unit.source: He was certain that Lugano was human and harbored no unusual bloodlines.
unit.target: Certus erat Luganum hominem esse et nullas stirpes insolitas gerere.

unit.source: Following Lugano’s injury at Solow Motel, Jenna collected his splattered blood and conducted Magic Mirror Divination according to Lumian’s subsequent instructions.
unit.target: Post vulnerationem Lugani apud Solow Motel, Jenna sanguinem eius sparsum collegit et Divinationem Speculi Magici, secundum praecepta Lumiani, perduxit.

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian deciphered the elder’s true meaning.
unit.target: In instante, Lumian veram significationem senis intellexit.

unit.source: The Beyonders of the Planter pathway are all Blessed of the Great Mother?
unit.target: Num omnes Beyonders semitae Planter benedicti a Magna Matre sunt?

unit.source: Where does Earth Mother stand? Planter is the main pathway of the Church of Earth Mother…
unit.target: Ubi stat Terra Mater? Planter est via principalis Ecclesiae Terrae Matris…

unit.source: Could it be… the Great Mother reigns over multiple pathways, akin to the Celestial Worthy and Mr. Fool? Planter and Sower? The names bear a striking connection…
unit.target: Num forte... Magna Mater super plures semitas regnat, instar Caelestis Digni et Domini Stulti? Planter et Sower? Nomina insigne conexa videntur.

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, his focus intensified on the existence of the Son of God.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani exactebantur, attentio eius in existentia Filii Dei intensior facta est.

unit.source: Cordu’s empty infant cradle and the honorific title of Lady Moon nurturing a deity flooded his mind.
unit.target: Cordu vacua cunabulum infantis et honorificus titulus Dominae Lunae, deum fovens, mentem eius inundaverunt.

unit.source: Dammit, why is it that the Great Mother seems entwined with children, Sons of God, and babies? Does that entity have a penchant for offspring?
unit.target: Di immortales, cur videtur Magna Mater cum pueris, Filis Dei, atque infantes implicata esse? Num illa entitas propensionem ad progeniem habet?

unit.source: Lumian smirked superficially.
unit.target: Lumian leviter subridens apparuit.

unit.source: “It seems your Son of God hasn’t truly been born.”
unit.target: “Videtur Filius Dei vester nondum vere natus esse.”

unit.source: The old man in the loose black robe suddenly became fervent.
unit.target: Senex in veste nigra laxae subito fervens factus est.

unit.source: “He’s already born in the spirit world, but He’s yet to step into the real world.”
unit.target: “Iam natus est in mundo spirituali, sed in mundum reale nondum ingressus est.”

unit.source: “Don’t you see? Just revealing His form made me a few years younger. If He were truly born, I’d instantly regain my youth!”
unit.target: “Nonne vides? Solum formam Eius revelare me paucis annis iunior fecit. Si vere natus esset, statim iuventutem meam recipirem!”

unit.source: Who knows what malevolent creation you’ve unleashed… Lumian criticized and said, “You plan to shape the Son of God’s body with just this fragment of life?”
unit.target: “Quis scit quid maleficam creationem effuderas… ” Lumian reprehendit et dixit, “Concipisne corpus Filii Dei ex hoc solum fragmento vitae formare?”

unit.source: The elder was taken aback.
unit.target: Senex obstupefactus est.

unit.source: “This is a ritual bestowed by the Great Mother’s revelation. It’s undeniably effective!”
unit.target: “Hoc est ritus a revelatione Magna Matris donatus. Indubie efficax est!”

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: “That Enio is unmistakably an ordinary person. The ritual’s effects won’t bode well. If it were a Beyonder with a robust life force, the outcome might be entirely different.”
unit.target: “Enio est indubitanter homo ordinarius. Effectus rituum non optime fore videbuntur. Si esset Beyonder cum vi vitali robusta, exitus omnino diversus foret.”

unit.source: The elder instinctively concurred, “Indeed. That’s why I intended to examine your servant’s internal organs…”
unit.target: Senex instinctive consentivit, “Certe. Ideo intenderam organa interna servi tui explorare…”

unit.source: At this juncture, the elder halted, casting a wary glance at Lumian.
unit.target: In hoc puncto, senex subsedit, et oculos cautelose in Lumian iecit.

unit.source: With a beaming smile, Lumian proposed, “Have you ever thought of sacrificing your own internal organs?”
unit.target: Cum radianti risu, Lumian proposuit: “Num umquam cogitavisti organa interna tua sacrificare?”

unit.source: “If you don’t offer yourself as a sacrifice, how can you showcase your devotion to the Great Mother and your reverence for the Son of God?”
unit.target: “Si teipsum non offeras ut sacrificium, quomodo devotionem tuam erga Magnam Matrem et reverentiam erga Filum Dei ostendere potes?”

unit.source: “Don’t fret; the Son of God will revive you and bestow youth upon you!”
unit.target: “Noli solliciti esse; Filus Dei te revivificabit atque iuventutem tibi donabit!”

unit.source: As he concluded his words, a dark-green light condensed in Lumian’s right hand.
unit.target: Dum verba sua concludebat, lumen viridem fuscum in manu dextra Lumiani condensatum est.

unit.source: 603 Organs Again
unit.target: 603 Organa Iterum

unit.source: The dark-green light morphed into a beam, slamming into the old man’s chest and sinking into the loose black robe, akin to sunlight, unstoppable.
unit.target: Lux viridis obscura in radium mutata, in pectus senis feriens et in laxum atrum pallium immergens, quasi solis radiatio, insuperabilis.

unit.source: Already appearing seven to eight years younger, the old man’s expression twisted, and every inch of exposed skin displayed signs of melting.
unit.target: Iam septem vel octo annos iuvenior apparens, vultus senis contortus est, et omnis pars cutis exposta signa liquefactionis ostendebat.

unit.source: His aura rapidly waned.
unit.target: Aura eius celeriter evanuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a burst of vigorous life force erupted from his body.
unit.target: Simul, vis vitalis vehementer ex corpore eius erupit.

unit.source: Under the melting skin, flesh and blood writhed, resisting the mutation.
unit.target: Sub cutis liquefacta, caro et sanguis convoluebantur, mutationi repugnantes.

unit.source: The black-robed old man’s eyes darkened, and he abruptly faded away.
unit.target: Oculi senis obscuraverunt, atque repente evanuit.

unit.source: In an instant, a hazy face emerged from the armchair at the dining table, blending with the brown wood, about to gain clarity.
unit.target: In momento, vultus nebulosus e solio ad mensam cenariam emersit, cum ligno fusco miscens, paene claritatem adepturus.

unit.source: At that moment, a cascade of flames descended from the crimson-flame‐covered ceiling, soaking the armchair and swiftly setting it ablaze.
unit.target: Illo momento, flammae confluentes ex laquearia, coccineo igne tegestae, descenderunt, solium impregnantes et celeriter incendentes.

unit.source: Before the brown face could fully materialize, it succumbed to the raging flames, forced to retreat.
unit.target: Antequam vultus fusci plene appareret, flammarum furoris cecidit, coactus recedere.

unit.source: Lumian lost sight and sense of the black-robed elder subsequently.
unit.target: Lumian postea conspectum et sensum senis in veste atra induti amisit.

unit.source: While surveying the surroundings, Lugano, lying on the dining table, suddenly sat up and jumped down.
unit.target: Circumiecta perspicens, Lugano, in mensa cenaria iacens, subito surrexit et desiluit.

unit.source: He stared at Lumian with vacant eyes, like a wandering zombie.
unit.target: Ad Lumian oculis vacuis, ut ambulans mortuus, aspiciebat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, raising his right hand and pointing at Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian subridens dextram manum extulit et ad Lugano indicavit.

unit.source: With this gesture, specks of brilliance shimmered in his eyes, as if the cosmos had descended.
unit.target: Hoc gestu, miculae fulgoribus in oculis eius micabant, quasi cosmos descendisset.

unit.source: Lugano found himself in an empty night sky, surrounded by twinkling stars.
unit.target: Lugano se invenit in caelo nocturno vacuo, circumdatus stellis micantibus.

unit.source: He stood rooted to the ground in a daze. Without any subsequent actions, he resembled a machine that had lost its energy and controller.
unit.target: Stetit radicatus in terra, attonitus. Nulla ulterior opera, instar machinae sine energia et moderatore carentis, videbatur.

unit.source: Having settled his servant, Lumian surveyed his surroundings once more.
unit.target: Servum suum constituto, Lumian circumiecta iterum perspexit.

unit.source: Yet, his eyes brimmed with flowing and burning crimson flames, and the black-robed elder’s figure remained elusive.
unit.target: Attamen, oculi eius replebantur flammis coccineis fluitantibus et ardentibus, et figura senis in veste atra evasiva manebat.

unit.source: Lumian’s expression remained stoic as he splayed the five fingers on his right hand, clenching them into a fist.
unit.target: Vultus Lumiani stoicus remansit, dum quinque digitos dextrae manus extendit et in pugno conclusit.

unit.source: His body suddenly grew heavy, and the flames surrounding him surged towards him like a river converging into the sea, drawn by an invisible force.
unit.target: Corpus eius subito grave factum est, et flammae quae eum circumdabant, instar fluminis in mare confluente, versus eum impulerunt, vi invisibili trahente.

unit.source: Bottles, organs from various body parts, and lightweight items in the room soared towards Lumian.
unit.target: Vascula, organa ex variis partibus corporis, et res leviores in conclavi, versus Lumian volaverunt.

unit.source: On the wooden coat rack near the door, the transparent figure of the black-robed elder protruded, pulled away by an unseen force.
unit.target: In appendice ligneo prope ostium, figura translucida senis in veste atra protuberabat, attrahita a vis invisibili.

unit.source: He fought with all his might, but he couldn’t resist the pull towards Lumian. It was akin to a piece of wood caught in a flood or a thin leaf fluttering in a fierce wind.
unit.target: Omni vi pugnavit, sed vim trahentem eum versus Lumian oppugnare non potuit. Id erat instar ligni raptum in diluvio aut folii tenuis in vento furioso volitante.

unit.source: Lumian’s left hand was already raised, and the crimson, nearly white flame in his palm rapidly turned white under the intense suction force, forming a minuscule ball.
unit.target: Manus sinistra Lumiani iam surrecta erat, et flamma coccinea, paene alba, in palma eius sub intensa vi attrahendi celeriter in albam mutata est, parvum globulum formans.

unit.source: Layers of compressed white-hot fireballs were unleashed, and the weighty and fearsome suction force dissipated.
unit.target: Strata globula ignium albidum, comprimens, emissae sunt, et vis attrahendi grave atque formidolosum evanuit.

unit.source: Pa! The black-robed elder finally landed on the floor, his vision completely engulfed by the blazing white fireball.
unit.target: Pa! Senex in veste atra tandem in solum cecidit, et visus eius a globulo albo incensi omnino absorptus est.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The blazing white fireball collided with the Beyonder conducting the sinister surgery and strange ritual.
unit.target: Globulus albus incensus cum Beyonder, qui sinistram chirurgiam atque insolitum ritum peragabat, congressus est.

unit.source: The explosion’s sound echoed into the distance but was muffled by the darkness shrouding the room, preventing it from permeating.
unit.target: Sonus explosionis in longinquum resonavit, sed tenebrae, conclavi circumdantes, eum obmutescebant ne perveniret.

unit.source: In the midst of such a violent explosion, no one on the ship heard or sensed anything awry.
unit.target: In medio tali violentae explosionis, nemo in nave quidquam iniuriosum audivit nec sensit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The black-robed elder’s body was shredded by the devastating explosion.
unit.target: Corpus senis in veste atra ab explosione devastante diruptum est.

unit.source: Countless corpse fragments were instantly charred or consumed by bright flames, scattering across every corner of the living room and dining room.
unit.target: Innumerabilia cadaverum fragmenta statim exarserunt aut a flammis nitidissimis devorata sunt, per omnem angulum atrii et triclinii disseminata.

unit.source: With spirit channeling at his disposal and Ludwig providing support, Lumian reveled in the authority of the Governor of the Sea and the nearly demigod-level power it bestowed. He cared not for what the enemy might transform into.
unit.target: Cum facultate canalizandi spiritum in promptu et Ludovico auxilium praebente, Lumian in auctoritate Praefecti Maris et in potentia paene semidei, quam illa tribueret, gaudebatur; non curabat quid hostis in formam mutatam caperet.

unit.source: Incredible. Is this what it’s like to be a demigod? Even if it’s just an illusion… Sadly, it won’t last beyond six in the morning… Lumian sighed, directing his gaze at the burning corpse fragments.
unit.target: Incredibile! Num ita est esse semideus? Etiamsi sola illusio sit, infelix est: ultra horam sextam mane non permanebit. Lumian suspiravit et oculos suos ad partes cadaverum ardentium intendit.

unit.source: A quick inspection revealed that the black-robed elder’s flesh had rapidly charred or turned to ashes. It was as if frost had met magma from a volcanic eruption.
unit.target: Examen celerum demonstravit carnem senis in veste atra celeriter combustam esse aut in cinerem redactam. Erat quasi glacies cum magmā eruptionis volcanoae convenisset.

unit.source: In a matter of seconds, only the heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys, intestines, and stomach remained in the room, along with a grayish-white half-charred brain.
unit.target: In paucissimis secundis, tantum cor, iecur, lien, pulmones, renes, intestina, et venter in conclavi remanserunt, una cum cerebro cinereo-albo semi-combusto.

unit.source: Wh… Even with his feet, Lumian could tell that something was awry.
unit.target: Eheu… Etiam per pedes suis, Lumian intellexit aliquid esse erratum.

unit.source: Except for the brain, the remnants of the enemy were all internal organs.
unit.target: Praeter cerebrum, reliquiae hostis omnia erant organa interna.

unit.source: The malevolent surgery he had just completed involved extracting someone’s internal organs to let them live as if nothing happened!
unit.target: Chirurgia nefaria quam modo perfecit constabat in extrahendis internis organis alicuius, ut vixerent quasi nihil evenisset!

unit.source: At the same time, the peculiar ritual he performed utilized the complete set of internal organs to attempt to reconstruct the so‐called Child of God’s body!
unit.target: Simul, ritus peculiaris quem peragebat, tota seriem internorum organorum adhibebat, ut corpus dicti Filii Dei reconstrueret!

unit.source: All internal organs—it was hard for Lumian not to draw a connection.
unit.target: Omnia organa interna — difficile erat Lumiano non quandam nexum trahere.

unit.source: Could it be that this fellow’s internal organs were extracted before, and he survived by piecing together others’ internal organs, becoming a Beyonder? What’s this called? Human alchemy? If it’s true, who took his internal organs? Lumian pondered silently.
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut organa interna huius hominis ante extraherentur, et ipse aggregando interna aliorum superesset, factus Beyonder?

unit.source: The stars in his eyes swiftly dissipated, and Lugano returned to the real world.
unit.target: Stellae in oculis eius celeriter evanuerunt, et Lugano ad rem veram rediit.

unit.source: From a distance of four to five meters, Lumian raised his right hand and smoothly swung it.
unit.target: Ex distantia quattuor ad quinque metrorum, Lumian dextram manum extulit et leniter circumiecit.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Ictus!

unit.source: Lugano felt the impact of an invisible force against his face.
unit.target: Lugano impulsum vis invisibilis in faciem suam sensit.

unit.source: With a sudden jolt, his eyes gradually cleared of their blank stare.
unit.target: Subito impetu, oculi eius paulatim e vultu vacuo eliberati sunt.

unit.source: The first sight that greeted Lugano was the crimson flames falling around him, extinguishing before causing any havoc.
unit.target: Prima vis quae Lugano occurrit, erant flammae coccineae circa eum cadentes, extinctae antequam cladem intulerent.

unit.source: Then, he noticed charred body parts, scattered internal organs, glass jars filled with light-amber liquid, and organs soaked in them.
unit.target: Deinde animadvertit partes corporis combustas, organa interna dispersa, urnae vitreae liquore aureo leviter repletae, et organa in eis imbuta.

unit.source: Am I still dreaming? Is this a nightmare?
unit.target: Num adhuc somnio? Estne hoc somnium nocturnum?

unit.source: Just as this thought crossed Lugano’s mind, the image of his employer, Louis Berry, with black hair and green eyes, appeared before him.
unit.target: Cum haec cogitatio Lugano menti pertransisset, imago patroni eius, Ludovicus Berry, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus, ante eum apparuit.

unit.source: Son of a bitch, this dream took an unexpected turn! Lugano shuddered and involuntarily inquired, “What happened?”
unit.target: Filius canis, hoc somnium in inopinatum versum vertit!

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked, “What dream did you just experience?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et rogavit: “Quod somnium modo experitus es?”

unit.source: What dream? Lugano confirmed his wakefulness and recollected, “I dreamed of my childhood. My mother stood at the door, urging me to come home for dinner. She even sang a nursery rhyme from my hometown…
unit.target: “Quid somnium?

unit.source: “She’s been gone for almost ten years. I miss her dearly. I kept walking towards the door, but I couldn’t reach her…”
unit.target: Ea fere decem annos abfuit; eam valde desidero.

unit.source: At that moment, Lugano realized that this wasn’t their suite. He exclaimed in shock,
unit.target: Illo momento, Lugano cernens intellexit hanc non esse eorum conclave.

unit.source: “What happened?”
unit.target: “Quid accidit?”

unit.source: With a smile, Lumian responded, “You slept until midnight and suddenly sleepwalked all the way here. An old man had plans to operate on you, remove your kidneys, and slowly turn you into a patient like Enio.”
unit.target: Cum risu, Lumian respondit: “Dormi ad mediam noctem et subito somnambulans huc perrexisisti. Senex consilium habebat te operandi, renes tollendi, et te paulatim in aegrotum, qualem Enio, converteri.”

unit.source: The more Lugano listened, the more fear gripped him. Earlier, he had wondered how someone like Enio, who had lost most of his internal organs, could still be alive, albeit turning weak—only to realize that he was so close to turning into a similar figure!
unit.target: Quo magis Lugano audiebat, eo magis timor eum oppressit.

unit.source: “Hiss…” Lugano gasped and asked with trepidation, “Where’s that old man?”
unit.target: “Hiss…” Lugano exclamavit et timide interrogavit: “Ubi est ille senex?”

unit.source: “That’s all that remains.” Lumian gestured at the internal organs and the grayish-white, half-charred brain on the ground.
unit.target: “Hoc solum remanet.”

unit.source: Without giving Lugano a chance to sigh, Lumian instructed, “Bring Ludwig here.”
unit.target: Sine Lugano tempore suspirandi, Lumian imperavit: “Adducite Ludovicum huc!”

unit.source: It was also almost time for his midnight snack.
unit.target: Iam fere tempus erat ad cenam mediam noctem parare.

unit.source: Lugano hastily left the suite, grateful for choosing to follow Lumian to the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Lugano festinanter conclave reliquit, gratus quod Lumian se ad Continens Meridionalem secutus esset.

unit.source: Otherwise, he would be at the mercy of such situations elsewhere!
unit.target: Alioquin, alibi talibus casibus subiectus futurus esset!

unit.source: Lugano believed this matter had nothing to do with Lumian. He had brought it upon himself. If it were Trier, he might have encountered a similar patient who had lost internal organs.
unit.target: Lugano credebat hanc rem nihil ad Lumian pertinere; ipse eam sibi attulit.

unit.source: Lumian watched him leave, raised his right hand, and stroked his chin.
unit.target: Lumian eum discedentem spectavit, dextram manum extulit, et mentum suum leniter tetigit.

unit.source: Simply hearing the infant’s cries from the failed ritual can influence Beyonders of the Planter pathway to sleep and act in a sleepwalking state, receiving corresponding orders?
unit.target: Sola audientia infantis clamorum ex ritu defuncto, posset influere Beyonderos semitas Plantatoris, ut dormiant atque in somnambulismo verserentur, mandata congrua accipiendos?

unit.source: Isn’t this too exaggerated? It’s an absolute suppression on the Planter pathway…
unit.target: Nonne hoc nimis exaggeratum est? Est absoluta repressio in semita Plantatoris…

unit.source: I could understand a similar phenomenon if that ritual had succeeded, and the Child of God was truly born. Yet, it’s already this powerful despite being a failed product?
unit.target: Potuero intellegere simile phaenomenon, si ille ritus successisset et Filius Dei vere natus esset; attamen iam tam potens est, quamvis productum defecerit.

unit.source: Even with the limitation of its range, it’s still terrifying… Is there a key reason I don’t know?
unit.target: Etiam cum limitata sit amplitudo eius, adhuc terribile est…

unit.source: Moreover, can only Beyonders of the Planter or Sower pathways hear the Child of God’s cries? Can the Apothecary pathway, which can interchange with the Planter pathway, also hear it?
unit.target: Praeterea, num solum Beyonderes semitarum Plantatoris aut Satorum Filii Dei clamores audire possunt?

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s thoughts, Lugano led Ludwig into the suite.
unit.target: Inter Lumiani cogitationes, Lugano Ludovicum in conclave duxit.

unit.source: Faced with this gruesome scene, Ludwig pressed his hand to his mouth and yawned.
unit.target: Ludwig manum ad os suum premit et os suum patefecit.

unit.source: “Where’s the food?”
unit.target: “Ubi est cibus?”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t make any immediate requests. Instead, he turned to Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian non statim aliquid postulavit; sed conversus est ad Lugano.

unit.source: “Guard the door.”
unit.target: “Custodi ostium.”

unit.source: With the prior experience of the blood-drinking incident, Lugano could vaguely guess what was about to happen. He didn’t dare face it directly. Upon hearing Lumian’s instructions, he heaved a sigh of relief and jogged to the corridor, closing the vermilion door behind him.
unit.target: Experientia priorum rerum sanguine sorbendarum, Lugano vago suspicari potuit quid futurum esset; non ausus est illud directe oppugnare.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian gesture towards the scattered internal organs on the ground.
unit.target: Tum demum Lumian ad organa interna in terra dispersa digitum movit.

unit.source: “Do you need me to roast it for you?”
unit.target: “Visne ut id tibi assam?”

unit.source: Ludwig shot a quick glance at Lumian.
unit.target: Ludwig celeriter ad Lumian conspexit.

unit.source: “Don’t you find it irksome? These are all human organs.”
unit.target: “Num non molestum censes? Haec omnia sunt organa humana.”

unit.source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian leniter subridens edidit.

unit.source: “In my eyes, this is already on par with a monster’s insides.”
unit.target: “In oculis meis, hoc iam par est interioribus monstri.”

unit.source: He then wore a self-deprecating expression.
unit.target: Deinde vultus eius, se ipsum deminuens, apparuit.

unit.source: “Moreover, isn’t directly consuming Beyonder characteristics to advance a Beyonder equivalent to eating someone?”
unit.target: “Praeterea, num directe sumere proprietates Beyonderorum ad Beyonder promovendum non aequivalet edendi aliquem?”

unit.source: Ludwig remained silent, taking a few steps to the side.
unit.target: Ludwig in silentio remansit, paucis passibus ad latus ambulans.

unit.source: He squatted down, picked up the old man’s heart, stuffed it into his mouth, and began to chew.
unit.target: Ludwig genu flectens, cor senis sustulit, in os suum intulit, et masticare coepit.

unit.source: Crimson blood slowly trickled from the corner of his mouth.
unit.target: Sanguis coccineus lente ex angulo oris eius stillabat.

unit.source: Lumian pulled up a chair and sat down, patiently waiting for Ludwig to finish his meal and digest.
unit.target: Lumian sellam arripuit et consedit, patienter exspectans ut Ludwig cenam finiret et digereret.

unit.source: After seven to eight minutes, Ludwig retrieved a white handkerchief from his coat pocket and wiped his mouth.
unit.target: Post septem ad octo minuta, Ludwig ex sinu pallii candidum sudarium extraxit et os suum exterruit.

unit.source: “These internal organs belong to different people. Some are Beyonders, some are ordinary folks, some old, some teenagers…”
unit.target: “Haec organa interna diversis hominibus pertinent. Quaedam sunt Beyonder, quaedam sunt homines ordinarii, quaedam senes, quaedam iuvenes…”

unit.source: “There are traces of human refinement. The aura of life is rather mixed and impure…”
unit.target: “Vestigia subtilitatis humanae adsunt. Aura vitae satis mixta et impura est…”

unit.source: “They will be controlled and influenced by the refiner…”
unit.target: “Illa regentur et ab refinator afficiuntur…”

unit.source: “Having been refined, the person doesn’t know that he’s been through this.
unit.target: Purgatus, homo nescit se hoc passum esse.

unit.source: He has complete memories of the past. This is something that can’t be achieved by refining an ordinary body.
unit.target: Habet plenam memoriam praeteritorum. Hoc est quod a purgatione corporis ordinarii assequi non potest.

unit.source: He followed Enio on board, hoping to extract the remaining organs and complete the ritual before Enio reached his destination…”
unit.target: Adiunxit Enion in nave, sperans reliqua organa extrahere et ritum complere, priusquam Enio ad finem perveniret…

unit.source: Ludwig recounted the knowledge and memories he had absorbed in a straightforward tone.
unit.target: Ludwig enarravit scientiam et memorias quas absoruerat, voce sincera.

unit.source: 604 School of God’s Descent
unit.target: 604 Schola Descensionis Dei

unit.source: Under the glow of the crimson moon, Ludwig, clad in a two-piece pajama set and a small coat, recounted the memories and knowledge he had absorbed from the black-robed elder’s half-charred brain and internal organs.
unit.target: Sub fulgore lunae coccineae, Ludwigus, indutus in duabus partibus constitutum pyjama et parvo pallio, narravit memorias ac scientiam quam ex cerebro senioris in veste nigro semi-ustae et internis membris absorpsisset.

unit.source: He did so methodically, like an emotionless time-reporting machine.
unit.target: Id methodice egit, instar machinae temporis relationis sine affectu.

unit.source: “Only the brain belongs to him. His name is Prinpino.
unit.target: “Solum cerebrum illius est. Nomen eius est Prinpino.

unit.source: “Due to his advanced age and weakened body, he delved into mysticism. Unwittingly, he drew the attention of the Great Mother and acquired a wealth of secret knowledge, evolving into a Beyonder…”
unit.target: “Ob aetatem provectam et corpus infirmum, in mysticam se immergit. Nescientemente, Magnae Matris attentionem attulit et divitias scientiae arcanae acquisivit, evolvens in Beyonder…”

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Lumian muttered with a mix of mockery and fear, “Despite gaining the Great Mother’s attention, did he not turn pregnant?”
unit.target: Audito hoc, Lumian murmure misceo derisionis et timoris incedebat: “Quamquam Magnae Matris attentionem adeptus est, nonne in graviditatem versa est?”

unit.source: Are you truly a follower of the Great Mother?
unit.target: Esne vere sectator Magnae Matris?

unit.source: Ludwig continued, “I’m uncertain when Prinpino started losing his internal organs. I failed to absorb the pertinent knowledge and memories.
unit.target: Ludwigus continuavit: “Nescio quando Prinpino interna organa amittere coepit. Pertinentem scientiam et memorias non accepi.

unit.source: “Similarly, the time he became a human refinement product remains unknown.
unit.target: Pariter, tempus quo factus est tamquam productum emendationis humanitatis ignotum manet.

unit.source: “His philosophy is:
unit.target: Philosophia eius est:

unit.source: “Humanity, once the favored and proudest children of the Great Mother, fell into folly, aging, and weakness due to their detachment from her.
unit.target: “Humanitas, olim filii praestantissimi et superbi Magnae Matris electi, in stultitiam, senectutem et infirmitatem cecidit propter separationem a ea.

unit.source: “Only by allowing the divine son of the Great Mother to descend into the world can humanity be saved. They can enter Paramita and regain their original form.
unit.target: “Solum sinendo divinum filium Magnae Matris in mundum descensum facere, humanitas servari potest; in Paramitam ingredi possunt et formam originariam recipere.

unit.source: “When the time arrives, the Great Mother will return to the real world she governs.”
unit.target: “Cum tempus adveniet, Magna Mater in verum orbem, quem regit, redibit.”

unit.source: Using the gender-oriented pronoun “she” to refer to the Great Mother instead of “She”…
unit.target: Utitur pronomine feminino “ea” ad designandam Magnam Matrem pro “She”…

unit.source: This implies that, in the eyes of individuals like Prinpino, pregnancy and childbirth are still feminine matters.
unit.target: Hoc insinuat, in oculis talium ut Prinpino, graviditas et partus adhuc res feminae esse.

unit.source: A mother must be a “she”…
unit.target: Mater debet esse “ea”…

unit.source: This differs from the Nightstalkers…
unit.target: Hoc differt a Noctivagis…

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Ludwig and nodded approvingly.
unit.target: Lumian Ludwigum aspexit et capite approbante annuit.

unit.source: Ludwig calmly detailed Prinpino’s attempts and some of his abilities.
unit.target: Ludwigus placide narrauit conatus Prinpino et nonnullas eius virtutes.

unit.source: “The birth of the Child of God requires a specific body composed of various people’s internal organs…
unit.target: “Nativitas Filii Dei corpus specificum requirit, ex variis internis membris hominum compositum…

unit.source: “This isn’t the entire descent ritual. It lacks a crucial component…
unit.target: “Hoc non est totus ritus descensus. Elementum maximi momenti caret…

unit.source: “Prinpino possesses potent self-healing abilities. As a product of human refinement, he’s immune to the influence of many Beyonder powers.
unit.target: “Prinpino potentissimas facultates autosanationis habet. Quia productum emendationis humanitatis est, multis viribus Beyonder immunis est.

unit.source: “He can indirectly control humans corrupted by the Child of God or specific Pathway Beyonders who have had direct contact with special patients. The range is 100 meters, and they must be unconscious…”
unit.target: “Homines, qui a Filio Dei corrupti sunt, vel certos Beyonder viae, qui cum patientibus specialibus directe contigerunt, indirecte regere potest. Spatium centum metrorum est, et illi incoscientes esse debent…”

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Lumian suddenly recalled a Sequence 7 Vampire of the Apothecary pathway.
unit.target: Audito hoc, Lumian subito memor tuli vampiri Sequenciae VII ex via Apothecarii.

unit.source: Such Beyonders wielded formidable self-healing abilities and could craft Blood Slaves resembling their own marionettes!
unit.target: Tales Beyonder formidabiles facultates autosanationis exercebant et servos sanguineos, qui propriis marionettis similes erant, creare poterant!

unit.source: Lumian refrained from interrupting Ludwig, patiently awaiting further details.
unit.target: Lumian Ludwigum non interpellavit, attente ulteriores singula expectans.

unit.source: “He’s adept in surgery and can directly heal others. He knows a ritual enabling a human to survive for a period even without internal organs.
unit.target: “Ille in chirurgia peritus est et alios directe sanare potest. Ritus eum novit qui homini permittit aliquod tempus vivere etiam sine internis membris.

unit.source: “He can merge with trees and wooden articles for concealment, acquire a sturdy shell, and evade detection.
unit.target: “Arboribus et rebus ligneis coniungi potest ad celandum, tegmen firmum adipisci, et detectioni evadere.

unit.source: “He can stimulate the growth and reproduction of creatures, including but not limited to rats, fleas, bedbugs, fungi, and various plants. However, it drains his vitality. His vitality can be replenished through an unsuccessful Child of God descent ritual. Every nine rituals necessitate a batch of internal organs to be replaced…
unit.target: “Crescentiam et reproductionem creaturarum stimulare potest, inter quas, sed non solum, mures, pulices, cimices, fungi, et varias plantas; sed hoc vitalitatem eius exhaurit. Vitalitas eius per ritum descensus Filii Dei ineffectuosum reparari potest. Omnibus novem ritibus, copia internorum membrorum restituenda est…

unit.source: “He can also inflict curses upon others, summon malevolent creatures, consume his life for the casting of a few nefarious arts…”
unit.target: “Praeterea maledictiones aliis inferre potest, creaturas maleficas evocare, vitam suam consumere ad efformandum nonnullas artes nefarias…”

unit.source: As Ludwig concluded, Lumian realized Prinpino’s Beyonder powers were diverse. He possessed partial Vampire abilities and embodied certain traits of the Earth pathway’s Planter, Doctor, and other Sequences. Simultaneously, he wielded a limited grasp of dark arts, expending vitality for their execution.
unit.target: Dum Ludwigus conficiebat, Lumian intellexit vires Beyonder Prinpino diversas esse. Partim facultates vampiricas possidebat et quasdam notas viae Terrae—Planter, Medicus, et alias Sequencias—in se incorporavit. Simul, modicam comprehensionem artium tenebrarum gerebat, vitalitatem ad eorum exsecutionem impensans.

unit.source: It’s akin to the amalgamation of the Apothecary, Planter, and Heretic Spellmaster pathways, yet it’s not exhaustive… Such a boon exists? The Great Mother truly reigns at the apex of these three pathways… Lumian reflected momentarily before taking Ludwig’s hand and departing the suite.
unit.target: Id simile est coniunctioni viarum Apothecarii, Planteri, et Magistri Incantationum Haereticarum, sed non est exhaustivum… Exstatne talis donum? Magna Mater vere in apice harum trium viarum regnat… Lumian paulisper meditatus, antequam manum Ludovigi arripuit et a conclavio discessit.

unit.source: He instructed Lugano, stationed at the door, “Summon the priest from the prayer room and inform him of all pertinent details you are aware of.”
unit.target: Praecipuit Lugano, qui ad ostium stabat, “Vocare sacerdotem ex conclavio precationis et omnes notitias pertinentes, quas nosti, ei enuntiā.”

unit.source: After issuing his directive, Lumian deliberated before appending, “Locate the captain first, then seek out the priest.”
unit.target: Postquam iussum dedit, Lumian deliberavit antequam addiderit: “Primum cape capitaneum, deinde sacerdotem quaere.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lugano assented reflexively before inquiring, “And yourself?”
unit.target: “Bene,” respondit Lugano reflexe, deinde interrogans: “Et tu?”

unit.source: “Of course I’m going back to bed. Should they seek an audience with me, they may wait until tomorrow morning.” Lumian gestured dismissively, guiding Ludwig along the dimly illuminated corridor to his suite.
unit.target: “Certe, ad lectum redeo. Si audientiam a me petant, mane crastino expectare possunt.” Lumian leviter gesticulavit, Ludovigum ducens per obscurum coridorium ad conclavium suum.

unit.source: Am I solely accountable? Lugano mused to himself.
unit.target: Num sola culpa mea sit?

unit.source: He suddenly noticed he stood alone at the suite’s threshold, surrounded by scattered internal organs.
unit.target: Subito animadvertit se solum stare ad limen conclavi, circumdatus dispersis internis membris.

unit.source: A shiver traversed his spine, prompting him to hasten toward the captain’s quarters.
unit.target: Horrea per spinam eius percurrerunt, eum ad cellam capitanei celeriter impellentes.

unit.source: Ten minutes later, inside the black-robed old man’s suite.
unit.target: Decem minuta postea, in conclavio senis veste nigro induti.

unit.source: The priest named Montserrat and the captain, Pedro, scrutinized the situation while listening to Lugano’s detailed account.
unit.target: Sacerdos, qui Montserrat nominatus est, et capitaneus, Pedro, rem diligenter perspexerunt dum narrationem accuratam Luganoi auscultabant.

unit.source: Nervously, Lugano disclosed to them that he was a Beyonder, a Doctor of the Planter pathway. Enio sought him out due to his exceptional skills in treating patients.
unit.target: Perturbatus, Lugano illis declaravit se Beyonder esse, Medicum viae Planteri. Enio eum quaesivit propter artes extraordinarias in curandis aegrotis.

unit.source: Later, during the late night, he experienced a sleepwalking episode.
unit.target: Postea, in media nocte, somnambulium passa est.

unit.source: When he reached the suite, he found his internal organs almost removed.
unit.target: Cum conclavium attigerit, invenit interna organa eius paene sublata.

unit.source: Fortunately, he was rescued by his employer.
unit.target: Fortunate, a conductore suo servatus est.

unit.source: Throughout the entire narrative, Lugano only omitted Ludwig’s consumption of blood, sharing everything else he knew.
unit.target: Per totam narrationem, Lugano solam consumptionem sanguinis Ludovigi omisit, reliqua omnia quae scivit divulgans.

unit.source: Pedro, the captain with the handsome brown beard, quipped half-seriously,
unit.target: Pedro, capitaneus cum barba fusca venusta, semiserio exclamat,

unit.source: “Could it be that your employer killed a passenger in this suite and deliberately scattered his internal organs everywhere, concocting such a sinister Warlock tale to deceive us?”
unit.target: “Num fieri potest ut conductor tuus in hoc conclavio viam fecit, hospitem necavit, et interna organa eius ubique disseminavit, talem obscuram fabulam Warlock contexens ad nos decipiendos?”

unit.source: Uh… Lugano found himself momentarily speechless.
unit.target: Uh… Lugano se paulisper mutum invenit.

unit.source: Indeed, this possibility couldn’t be entirely dismissed!
unit.target: Certe, hanc possibilitatem omnino negare non potuimus!

unit.source: Father Montserrat, garbed in a brown clergyman’s attire, shook his head.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, indutus vestitu clericorum fuscorum, nutuit caput.

unit.source: “After confirming Enio’s physical condition, we’ll determine the veracity of this story.”
unit.target: “Postquam condicionem corporis Enii comprobavimus, veritatem huius fabulae statuemus.”

unit.source: “I concur.” Captain Pedro stroked his beard and gazed at Lugano. “What’s your employer’s name?”
unit.target: “Consentio.” Capitaneus Pedro barbam suam traxit et ad Lugano respexit. “Quod nomen est conductoris tui?”

unit.source: “Louis Berry,” Lugano truthfully replied.
unit.target: “Louis Berry,” respondit Lugano veraciter.

unit.source: “Louis Berry…” Pedro’s eyes narrowed. “The adventurer who hunted down the Demon Warlock, Louis Berry?”
unit.target: “Louis Berry…” oculi Pedri contracti sunt. “Nonne ille adventurer, qui Demon Warlock venatus est, Louis Berry?”

unit.source: Montserrat’s eyes widened slightly.
unit.target: Oculi Montserrat leviter dilatati sunt.

unit.source: “The one collaborating with the Church in Port Santa to covertly thwart malevolent forces disrupting the sea prayer ritual, Adventurer Louis Berry?”
unit.target: “Is, qui cum Ecclesia in Porto Santa cooperatur ad malevolas vires, quae ritum orationis maritimae perturbant, occulte superandas, Adventurer Louis Berry?”

unit.source: Wh… My boss’ reputation is so renowned? Did the Church of Earth Mother inform all the clergy that Louis Berry is a friend and collaborator?
unit.target: Wh… Reputatio patroni mei tam praeclara est? Num Ecclesia Matris Terrae cunctos clericos certiorem fecit quod Louis Berry amicus et cooperatus sit?

unit.source: Yes, this ship departed from Port Santa.
unit.target: Ita, haec navis ex Porto Santa discessit.

unit.source: The priest on board must have been the first to be informed…
unit.target: Sacerdos in nave primo certior factus esse debuit…

unit.source: Lugano had considered it, but he hadn’t expected his employer’s name to be so impactful.
unit.target: Lugano id cogitaverat, sed nomen conductoris sui tam magnum momentum habere non speravit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he affirmed, “It’s him, Adventurer Louis Berry.”
unit.target: Sine dubio, confirmavit: “Is est, Adventurer Louis Berry.”

unit.source: Just as Lugano concluded his account, the entire ship was abruptly sent airborne, landing atop a wave dozens of meters tall.
unit.target: Mox, cum Lugano narrationem suam finivisset, tota navis subito in aera iacta est et in summitate undae, quae decem metrorum altitudine erat, posita est.

unit.source: No dark clouds or torrential rain accompanied the phenomenon, and there were no violent winds or lightning.
unit.target: Nullae nubes obscurae aut imber torrens fenomeno comitabantur, nec venti vehemens aut fulgura apparuerunt.

unit.source: After vaulting between the pitch-black waves several times, the steamship gently descended onto the sea’s surface, restoring calm to its surroundings.
unit.target: Postquam inter undas nigrissimas pluries saltavit, navis vaporaria leniter in superficiem maris descendit, tranquillitatem circumiectis restituens.

unit.source: Captain Pedro surveyed the wrecked suite and the sliding windows, then turned to Lugano with a deep inquiry, “Is this the power of your employer? I heard stories of someone practicing sea wave magic at the bar tonight. Was that a genuine wave?”
unit.target: Capitaneus Pedro conclavium vastatum et fenestras labentes inspectus, deinde ad Lugano versa voce interrogavit: “Estne hoc vis conductoris tui? Audivi narrationes de aliquo magiam undarum maris ad tabernam hac nocte exercendam. Fuitne illa unda vera?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Although Lugano was uncertain about the events unfolding, he attributed the display of nature’s power to his employer.
unit.target: “Ita.” Quamquam Lugano incertus de eventibus evenientibus erat, ostentationem naturae potentiae conductoris sui attribuit.

unit.source: He added, “He’s extending his greeting.”
unit.target: Addidit: “Salutem suam praebet.”

unit.source: Captain Pedro and Father Montserrat fell into contemplative silence.
unit.target: Capitaneus Pedro et Pater Montserrat in silentio cogitativo ceciderunt.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds, Pedro addressed Father Montserrat, who seemed to be in his thirties, “Does the Church possess knowledge of such surgeries and rituals?”
unit.target: Postquam plus quam decem secundis transierunt, Pedro ad Patrem Montserrat, qui in annos tricesimos videtur, accessit: “Habentne Ecclesia scientiam talium chirurgiarum et rituum?”

unit.source: Montserrat glanced at Lugano, indicating that the conversation need not be private.
unit.target: Montserrat ad Lugano aspexit, significans sermonem non esse privatum.

unit.source: The priest reflected for a moment before responding in a solemn tone, “There exists a faction of misguided Mother believers who contend that the decline of the modern world and the debasement of humanity result from their estrangement from the Mother.
unit.target: Sacerdos paulisper meditatus est antequam in tono solemni respondit: “Exstat conventus cultorum Matris errantium, qui asserunt declinationem mundi moderni et corruptelam humanitatis ex alienatione ab Matre provenire.

unit.source: “They are determined to employ any means to usher in the so‑called Child of God into the real world and invoke the Mother’s descent through the return of the Child of God.
unit.target: Intenti sunt uti quacumque modis, ut sic dictus Filius Dei in mundum verum inducatur et descensus Matris per reditum Filii Dei invoquantur.

unit.source: “We refer to them as the School of God’s Descent.”
unit.target: Illos appellamus Schola Descensionis Dei.”

unit.source: Unconvinced, Lugano inquired, “You can summon a Child of God simply by using the internal organs of ordinary people?”
unit.target: Lugano, dubitans, interrogavit: “Potesne Filium Dei evocare simpliciter utens internis membris vulgorum hominum?”

unit.source: While he lacked knowledge about the specific surgery and ritual, he could deduce that internal organs were a crucial component.
unit.target: Cum scientia de specifica chirurgia et ritu carueret, concludere potuit interna organa esse partem crucialem.

unit.source: Montserrat contemplated the remaining human organs in the suite and responded gravely,
unit.target: Montserrat reliqua organa humana in conclavio contemplatus est et graviter respondit:

unit.source: “The Child of God is the Mother’s child, and humans are also Mother Goddess’s children.”
unit.target: “Filius Dei est filius Matris, et homines quoque sunt proles Matronae.”

unit.source: Does this imply that, fundamentally, no one is superior or inferior, and they can serve as ingredients with quantity compensating for any shortcomings?
unit.target: Implocatne hoc, fundamentaliter, neminem esse superiorem nec inferior, et posse uti ut materias, quarum copia defectus compensat?

unit.source: Lugano grasped the essence of the priest’s statement, realizing how many rituals involving blood sacrifices could be explained by this theory.
unit.target: Lugano essentiam dicti sacerdotis comprehendere sensit, intellegens quot rituum sanguinis sacrificiorum hanc theoriam explicare possent.

unit.source: Father Montserrat offered no further explanation and turned to Lugano.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat nullam ulteriorem explanationem dedit et ad Lugano se vertit.

unit.source: “Convey to your employer that we will take charge from here. Assure him not to worry.”
unit.target: “Transice conductor tuo, nos hinc curaturum esse; eum certum fac ne sollicitus sit.”

unit.source: “Very well.” Lugano sighed with relief.
unit.target: “Optime.” Lugano leviter suspiravit ex solacio.

unit.source: The next morning, Lumian woke up promptly and realized he no longer possessed the power of the sea, preventing him from tapping into the Governor of the Sea’s authority.
unit.target: Postero mane, Lumian celeriter experrectus est et animadvertit se potentiam maris non amplius habere, quod eum impediat ad auctoritatem Maris Praefecti pertingendam.

unit.source: He took a regretful sip of his light beer and commenced writing to Madam Magician, detailing the issues with the School of God’s Descent and the purported birth of the Child of God in the spirit world.
unit.target: Levis cervisiae sorbet, paenitebat, et ad Magistrae Magicae scribere coepit, describens difficultates cum Schola Descensionis Dei et putatam nativitatem Filii Dei in mundo spirituum.

unit.source: Swiftly, the messenger returned, carrying Madam Magician’s response:
unit.target: Celeriter, nuntius rediit, ferens responsionem Magistrae Magicae:

unit.source: “Encountering the School of God’s Descent—I can’t ascertain whether the issue lies with you or Lugano.
unit.target: “Conventus cum Schola Descensionis Dei—nescio utrum quaestio ex te aut ex Lugano oritur.

unit.source: “The so‑called Child of God has already been born in the spirit world—it’s merely propaganda, you understand? Similar to the Church of The Fool’s Holy Bible—just listen but don’t take it seriously.
unit.target: “Sic dictus Filius Dei iam natus est in mundo spirituum—tantum est propaganda, intellegis? Simile ac Ecclesia Stultorum et sua Biblia Sacra—audite, sed non grave accipite.

unit.source: “Nevertheless, comparable incidents are unfolding, and they are brewing and evolving. This actually ties back to you. It originated from Cordu’s empty cradle, the child Madame Pualis ‘lost.’
unit.target: “Tamen, similes casus eveniunt, et fermentantur atque evolvuntur. Hoc revera ad te refert. Ex cunabulo Cordi vacuo ortus est, puer quem Domina Pualis amisit.

unit.source: “Additionally, based on various sources, Madame Night didn’t perish in Fourth Epoch Trier. She encountered or acquired something that advanced the matter of the Child of God.
unit.target: “Praeterea, ex variis fontibus, Domina Nox in Aetate Quarta Trier non decessit. Illa aliquid invenit aut adeptus est quod rem Filii Dei progressit.

unit.source: “Besides her, the Sinners’ Voisin Sanson managed to escape Fourth Epoch Trier for unknown reasons. What he encountered remains unknown…
unit.target: “Praeter eam, Voisin Sanson peccatorum obscuris causis ex Aetate Quarta Trier effugere potuit. Quod ille invenit ignotum manet…

unit.source: Voisin Sanson is still alive?
unit.target: Voisin Sanson adhuc vivit?

unit.source: Lumian was initially taken aback by the revelation in the middle of the letter, but a smile soon crept across his face.
unit.target: Lumian initio revelatione in medio epistolae obstupefactus est, sed mox risus per faciem eius diffusus est.

unit.source: At that moment, a knock echoed on his bedroom door.
unit.target: Eo momento, pulsus in ostio cubiculi eius resonavit.

unit.source: “Who is it?” Lumian, aware that it was Lugano outside, asked casually.
unit.target: “Quis est?” inquit Lumian, sciens foris Lugano esse, leve rogans.
