unit.source: Lugano replied fearfully through the wooden door, “I-I heard a baby crying again!”
unit.target: Lugano timide per ianuam ligneam respondit: “E-ego iterum audivi infans plorare!”

unit.source: 605 Lingering Effects
unit.target: 605 Effectus Perstantes

unit.source: Hearing the cries of a baby again?
unit.target: Iterumne audis gemitus infantis?

unit.source: Is he pestered by the so‐called Child of God?
unit.target: Num vexatur ab eo, qui vocatur “Filius Dei”?

unit.source: Lumian held Madam Magician’s reply, unfinished, and adjusted his sitting posture with amusement.
unit.target: Lumian tenuit responsum Dominae Magicae, imperfectum, et sedendi statum se mutavit cum hilaritate.

unit.source: He gazed at the door and said, “Come in.”
unit.target: Ianuam aspexit et dixit: “Ingredere!”

unit.source: Lugano turned the handle and cautiously pushed open the door, uncomfortably stopping in front of Lumian.
unit.target: Lugano manubrium vertit et caute ianuam aperuit, in conspectu Lumiani incommode sistens.

unit.source: His actions and demeanor, combined with his thick eyebrows, large eyes, and square face, made him appear rather comical.
unit.target: Eius actus et habitus, cum crassis superciliis, oculis magnis et facie quadrata, eum ridiculum videbant.

unit.source: “Isn’t that evil Warlock, the old man n‑named Prinpino, already dead?
unit.target: Nonne ille maleficus magus, senex Prinpino nominatus, iam mortuus est?

unit.source: Why can I still hear the cries of a baby?”
unit.target: Cur adhuc audire possum gemitus infantis?

unit.source: Lugano inquired with concern, his tone reflecting it.
unit.target: Lugano anxius quaesivit, eiusque vox curam ostendebat.

unit.source: Having consulted the just‑awakened Ludwig, he had received an answer that he hadn’t heard the baby’s cries.
unit.target: Consulto Ludwig nuper evigilato, responsum accepit quod gemitus infantis non audiverat.

unit.source: Lumian playfully shook the letter in his hand and chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian epistulam in manu sua ludenter concussit et subridens risit.

unit.source: “There are two possibilities.
unit.target: Duae sunt possibilitates.

unit.source: One is that Prinpino’s accomplices on the ship also possess the ritual to summon the Child of God.
unit.target: Una est, ut socii Prinpini in nave ritum quoque habeant ad evocandum Filium Dei.

unit.source: The other possibility is…
unit.target: Altera possibilitas est…

unit.source: Lugano pressed impatiently, “What is it?”
unit.target: Lugano impatiens quaesivit: “Quid est?”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the Doctor and grinned.
unit.target: Lumian ad Medicum aspexit et subridens.

unit.source: “Perhaps the unborn Child of God has taken a liking to you and wants to choose you as his surrogate mother.
unit.target: Fortasse, infans Dei nondum natus tibi placebat et te eligere vult ut mater vicaria.

unit.source: Thus, even though Prinpino is already dead, he’s unwilling to leave you and continues to linger by your side.
unit.target: Itaque, quamquam Prinpino iam mortuus est, noluit te relinquere et ad te permanet.

unit.source: Normally, he can’t be seen or sensed.
unit.target: Normaliter, eum videre neque sentire licet.

unit.source: Lugano’s scalp tingled as he listened.
unit.target: Dum audiebat, cutis capitis eius formidine pulsabat.

unit.source: Ignoring the question of why he was a mother and not a father, he stammered, “W-what should I do?”
unit.target: Neglexit quaestionem cur mater esset et non pater, et titubans dixit: “Quid agam?”

unit.source: “No rush.”
unit.target: “Nulla festinatio.”

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “There’s no need to hurry in such circumstances.”
unit.target: Non opus est festinare in talibus condicionibus.

unit.source: Lugano felt like his internal organs might be devoured by the so‐called Child of God at any moment, leaving only an empty cavity.
unit.target: Lugano sensit quasi organa interna eius ab eo, qui “Filius Dei” dicitur, quovis momento vorari possent, relinquendo solum cavum.

unit.source: “Of course,” Lumian said in a relaxed state.
unit.target: “Certe,” Lumian in statu relaxato dixit.

unit.source: “Aren’t you still alive?”
unit.target: Nonne adhuc vivus es?

unit.source: “Since you’re not dead, it means the situation isn’t very serious.”
unit.target: Cum non mortuus es, id significat rem non esse gravem.

unit.source: “You can take it slow.”
unit.target: Potes lente procedere.

unit.source: “There’s no hurry.”
unit.target: Nulla festinatio est.

unit.source: That seems to be the case…
unit.target: Ita videtur…

unit.source: Lugano, caught up in the conversation, nodded and asked in confusion, “Must I die before the problem becomes serious enough for it to become urgent?”
unit.target: Lugano, sermone captus, annuit et, confusione affectus, quaesivit: “Oportetne me mori, antequam quaestio satis grave fiat ut sit urgetur?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “No, it means there’s zero need to rush.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Non, nihil est necessarium festinare.”

unit.source: “If you’re already dead, what’s the hurry?
unit.target: Si iam mortuus es, cur festinas?

unit.source: Can I revive you?”
unit.target: Possumne te revivere?

unit.source: In short, there’s no need to rush?
unit.target: In summa, nihil opus est festinare?

unit.source: Lugano was taken aback.
unit.target: Lugano obstupefactus erat.

unit.source: Though he harbored doubts, his employer’s ability to crack jokes and play pranks reassured him.
unit.target: Quamquam dubitationes habebat, ingenium domini eius iocos et ludibria faciens eum consolavit.

unit.source: Evidently, his employer didn’t view the baby’s cries as a grave concern!
unit.target: Evidenter, dominus eius gemitus infantis non tam gravem rem putabat!

unit.source: Only then did Lumian unveil his true speculation.
unit.target: Tunc solum Lumian veram speculationem suam revelavit.

unit.source: “There’s a third possibility.
unit.target: Tertia possibilitas est.

unit.source: The corruption you suffered upon contact with Enio won’t dissipate so quickly, and it’s highly likely that it won’t vanish naturally.
unit.target: Corrutio, quam passi es in contactu cum Enio, non tam celeriter evanescet, et probabiliter naturaliter non evanescere possit.

unit.source: Consequently, you’ll still form a connection with the unborn Child of God.
unit.target: Consequenter, adhuc nexum cum infante Dei nondum nato constitues.

unit.source: “Then, how do I eliminate the corruption?”
unit.target: Tum, quomodo corruptionem extirpare possum?

unit.source: Lugano accepted this explanation and believed that a solution existed.
unit.target: Lugano hanc explicationem accepit et credidit solutionem exsistere.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t immediately respond to his question.
unit.target: Lumian quaestioni eius statim non respondit.

unit.source: He let Lugano stand in front of him as he perused the rest of Madam Magician’s reply.
unit.target: Permisit Lugano coram se stari, dum reliquum responsum Dominae Magicae perlegit.

unit.source: “Considering your link to the Child of God and the evil god’s angel sealed within you, encountering a member of the School of God’s Descent isn’t a mere coincidence.
unit.target: Considerato nexu tuo cum Filio Dei et malo dei angelo intra te sigillato, conventus cum membro Scholae Descensionis Dei non est mera fortuita casus.

unit.source: “However, your interpreter and guide are of the Planter pathway—that raises other issues.
unit.target: Attamen, interpres et dux tuus ex via Plantatoris sunt—hoc alias quaestiones attulit.

unit.source: It’s only natural for you to encounter matters connected to the Great Mother.
unit.target: Est naturale ut incideris in res quae ad Magnam Matrem pertinent.

unit.source: As for the problem, ponder it and inquire within yourself.
unit.target: Quoad quaestionem, medita et intra te quaere.

unit.source: I won’t spoon‑feed you the answer.
unit.target: Non tibi responsum minutatim tradam.

unit.source: Conspirers need to employ their brains more…
unit.target: Conspiratores amplius cerebra sua adhibere debent.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian looked up at Lugano without uttering a word.
unit.target: Hoc observans, Lumian in Lugano aspexit, nihil dicens.

unit.source: The Doctor’s body tensed, and a thin layer of sweat trickled down his back.
unit.target: Corpus Medici contractum est, et tenuus stratum sudoris per dorsum eius stillavit.

unit.source: “Is—is there any other problem?” Lugano stammered.
unit.target: “Est—estne alia quaestio?” Lugano titubavit.

unit.source: Lumian reclined in his chair and said contemplatively, “Clearing corruption is an entirely separate course in mysticism.
unit.target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit et meditans dixit: “Expurgatio corruptionis est disciplina omnino separata in mystica.

unit.source: I need to grasp the specifics before providing an answer.
unit.target: Mihi necesse est singula comprehendere antequam responsum praebeam.

unit.source: Having underscored the significance, he inquired, “Have you encountered similar situations before?”
unit.target: Significationem illustrato, quaesivit: “Num antea casus similes experieris?”

unit.source: Like peculiar infant cries, mystical occurrences linked to births, sorcery entwined with mothers, and so forth.
unit.target: Sicut gemitus infantium peculiares, phaenomena mystica nativitatibus connexa, et magia cum matribus implicata, et cetera.

unit.source: Lugano dared not be careless, fearing that if the corruption wasn’t rectified promptly, he might end up as an organless being.
unit.target: Lugano non ausus est neglegere, metuens si corruptio celeriter non corrigatur, ut ens sine internis membris fias.

unit.source: He meticulously sifted through his experiences over the years.
unit.target: Per annos, experientias suas diligenter perscrutatus est.

unit.source: After a moment, he tentatively said, “There’s something I’m not sure if it’s relevant…”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, titubans dixit: “Aliquid est, sed non certo scio an pertineat…”

unit.source: It was clear that he was reluctant to discuss the matter.
unit.target: Manifestum erat eum rem disputare noluisse.

unit.source: “How am I supposed to know if it’s relevant if you don’t tell me?”
unit.target: Quomodo sciam an id pertinente sit, nisi mihi dicas?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t care about privacy.
unit.target: Lumian de secretis non curabat.

unit.source: After a brief pause, Lugano cleared his throat and said, “Didn’t I mention that I became a Beyonder by obtaining a friend’s relic?”
unit.target: Post brevem intervallum, Lugano guttur suum purgavit et dixit: “Nonne dixi me Beyonder factum esse, reliquiam amici adipiscens?”

unit.source: “Yes, did you murder that friend?” Lumian inquired deliberately.
unit.target: “Ita, occidisti illum amicum?” Lumian interrogavit deliberanter.

unit.source: Lugano hastily shook his head.
unit.target: Lugano celeriter caput vertit.

unit.source: “No, he committed suicide.”
unit.target: Non, seipsum interfecit.

unit.source: “Suicide?” Lumian raised his eyebrows, finding this matter intriguing.
unit.target: “Suicide?” Lumian superciliis extulit, rem mirabilem reputans.

unit.source: Lugano finally gathered the courage and spilled it out in one go,
unit.target: Lugano tandem animum collegit, et omnia simul effudit,

unit.source: “When I worked as a bounty hunter, I utilized the hidden mountain ranges in the Dariège mountain range for smuggling operations.
unit.target: “Cum mercennarius venator essem, reconditas montium compages in catena Dariège ad contrabandam rem adhibui.

unit.source: I moved things back and forth, making a decent sum.
unit.target: Res transiundas ac reducendas moveram, et decentem pecuniam consecutus sum.

unit.source: I even aided some wanted criminals in escaping overseas.
unit.target: Etiam aliquos sceleratos in trans mare effugiendi causa adiuvavi.

unit.source: Tanko was one of them, but his escape wasn’t from Intis to Feynapotter.
unit.target: Tanko unus ex illis erat, sed eius fuga non ab Intis ad Feynapotter fuit.

unit.source: Instead, he fled from Feynapotter to Intis.
unit.target: Contra, ab Feynapotter ad Intis confugit.

unit.source: Eventually, he discovered a secluded valley deep within the mountain range and built a field of his own.
unit.target: Postremo, invenit vallem secluditam in intimo catenae montium et agrum suum condidit.

unit.source: He cultivated crops, tended to livestock, and kept to himself.
unit.target: Fruges coluit, pecora curavit, et se solum retinuit.

unit.source: I regularly visited, supplying him with essentials like salt, sugar, fabric, and other goods.
unit.target: Eum regulariter visitabam, suppeditans ei rebus essentialibus, ut sal, saccharum, pannum, et alia.

unit.source: In return, Tanko imparted mystic knowledge.
unit.target: In compensatione, Tanko scientiam mysticam tradidit.

unit.source: I never imagined leading an ordinary life, with me out there adventuring and becoming a bounty hunter.
unit.target: Numquam putavi me vitam ordinariam degere, foris versari, et venatorem praedonum fieri.

unit.source: Mysticism held a strong allure for me, and the teachings imparted by Tanko seemed invaluable at times.
unit.target: Mystica mihi alliciebat, et doctrinae ab Tanko traditae aliquando inestimabiles videbantur.

unit.source: Tanko could be an enigma.
unit.target: Tanko enigmatum videbatur.

unit.source: Sometimes, he’d fall into brooding silence, his temper as hard and unyielding as stone, as if wrestling with inner demons.
unit.target: Aliquando in silentium meditabundum incidit, et iracundia eius, dura ac inflexa ut lapis, quasi cum daemonibus internis luctans, apparuit.

unit.source: Other times, he’d be buoyant and loquacious, curious about everything around him.
unit.target: Aliis temporibus, alacer et loquax, de omnibus circum se curiosus, videbatur.

unit.source: Every so often, he’d confess to straying from the Mother’s teachings, descending into the depths of darkness.
unit.target: Interdum confitebatur se a doctrinis Matris deviisse, in tenebras profundas descendens.

unit.source: He’d lament how he drifted further from his true self, suffering the consequences.
unit.target: Lamentabatur quomodo a seipso suo recto longe discessisset, consequentias patiens.

unit.source: Occasionally, he’d voice suspicions about the Church, believing it to be deceptive, claiming the true Mother had departed long ago…
unit.target: Interdum suspiciones de Ecclesia efferebat, eam fallacem putans, dicens veram Matrem pridem discessisse…

unit.source: In that moment, Lugano couldn’t help but draw parallels between Tanko’s cryptic musings and the philosophy of the School of God’s Descent, as recounted by Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lugano non potuit non trahere comparationes inter arcana Tanko cogitationes et philosophiam Scholae Descensionis Dei, ut a Patre Montserrat enarratum est.

unit.source: Was this encounter a foreshadowing, planted in the past?
unit.target: Num hic congressus praenuntiatio fuit, in praeterito insita?

unit.source: Lugano drew in a deep breath, sensing an ominous shiver down his spine.
unit.target: Lugano halitum profundum traxit, sentiens tremorem ominosum per spinam suam.

unit.source: He rushed out his words.
unit.target: Verba celeriter effudit.

unit.source: “Last autumn, I revisited Tanko.
unit.target: “Praeterita autumno, Tankon iterum visitavi.

unit.source: We sipped his brew and discussed various things beyond the mountain.
unit.target: Potavimus potionem eius et de variis rebus extra montem disseruimus.

unit.source: “Out of the blue, he spilled that he couldn’t endure his decadent, sinful self any longer.
unit.target: “Repente, effudit se non posse amplius suam decadentem et peccatricem naturam ferre.

unit.source: The demon lurking deep within him was gaining control.
unit.target: Daemon, qui alte in eo latebat, imperium adipiscebatur.

unit.source: Tanko wanted to end his life before it consumed him entirely.
unit.target: Tanko vitam suam finire volebat, antequam ille eum omnino voraret.

unit.source: His dying wish? I deliver his stuff to Torres, the capital of Gaia Province, and hand it over to a Church of Earth Mother clergyman, preferably a Blessed.
unit.target: Ultima voluntas eius? Ego res eius ad Torres, caput Provinciae Gaiae, deferam atque tradam sacerdoti Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, optime beato.

unit.source: I pretended to agree, talked him out of it, and thought he had abandoned the idea.
unit.target: Simulavi consentire, eum dissuasi, et credidi eum consilium abiecisse.

unit.source: But the next morning, I found him dead in the field where he’d harvested grain.
unit.target: Sed mane postero eum mortuum in agro, ubi frumentum messerat, inveni.

unit.source: Golden wheat ears sprouted from his body.
unit.target: Auratae spicae tritici ex corpore eius ortae sunt.

unit.source: And, get this, he had several female reproductive organs.
unit.target: Et, ecce, plura organa feminina habebat.

unit.source: I was freaked out.
unit.target: Territus sum.

unit.source: Felt like I was dealing with a monster.
unit.target: Senti me quasi cum monstro agere.

unit.source: Now, for us bounty hunters, a dead monster is a good monster.
unit.target: Nunc, nobis mercennariis venatoribus, monstrum mortuum bonum est.

unit.source: It’s material for a paycheck.
unit.target: Est materia ad mercedem.

unit.source: Summoning courage, I went through Tanko’s things.
unit.target: Fortitudinem colligens, res Tankonis perquisivi.

unit.source: Found a golden blob, like a grain seed, but half the size of a fist, next to him.
unit.target: Inveni globum aureum, quasi semen tritici, sed dimidio pugnus magnitudinis, iuxta eum.

unit.source: Based on Tanko’s mystic know‑how, I suspected this blob was the root of his Beyonder powers.
unit.target: Ex scientia mystica Tankonis, suspicabar hunc globum radicem potentiarum Beyonder eius esse.

unit.source: After much internal wrestling, I debated whether to stick to our agreement and send this relic back to the Church.
unit.target: Post multam internam pugnam, deliberavi utrum pactum nostrum tenere et hanc reliquiam ad Ecclesiam remittere debeam.

unit.source: But in the end, greed got the better of me, and I devoured the blob.
unit.target: Sed tandem avaritia me superavit, et globum voravi.

unit.source: I’m a guilty man.
unit.target: Ego reus sum.

unit.source: Broke my promise.
unit.target: Promissum meum fregi.

unit.source: Hoping the Sun forgives me.
unit.target: Sperans Solem me ignoscere.

unit.source: Lumian listened in silence, a chuckle escaping his lips.
unit.target: Lumian silentio audivit, et subridens risus ex labiis eius effluxit.

unit.source: “You just ate it like that?”
unit.target: “Ita tantum id edisti?”

unit.source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and explained, “Yep, that’s right.
unit.target: Lugano, verecunde subridens, explicavit: “Ita, recte.

unit.source: I only learned potion formulas after becoming a Beyonder and diving into mysticism.
unit.target: Postquam Beyonder factus sum et in mystica immersus, solum formulas pocionum didici.

unit.source: I didn’t want a repeat of that experience, so I got obsessed with buying formulas.
unit.target: Illam experientiam iterare nolui, ergo formulae emendi obsessus sum.

unit.source: “You’re lucky.
unit.target: “Felix es.

unit.source: A few years earlier, and surviving that would’ve been tough.
unit.target: Paucis annis ante, id superare difficile fuisset.

unit.source: We might’ve crossed paths in the Dariège mountain range, you as a monster and me as a monster hunter,” Lumian recalled President Gandalf’s research and mocked Lugano.
unit.target: “Fortasse in catena montium Dariège conveniremus, tu ut monstrum et ego ut venatorem monstrorum,” Lumian investigationes Praesidis Gandalf revocavit et Lugano irridens deridit.

unit.source: Internally, Lumian muttered, “Emperor Roselle was right.”
unit.target: Intus, Lumian murmuravit: “Imperator Roselle recte dixit.”

unit.source: The ignorant are fearless…
unit.target: Ignorantes intrepidi sunt…

unit.source: Something’s obviously off with Tanko.
unit.target: Aliquid manifeste in Tanko aberrat.

unit.source: He probably got tangled with the evil god’s faith, corrupting the Beyonder characteristic he left behind.
unit.target: Forsitan fidem dei mali cepit, et naturam Beyonder, quam reliquit, corruptit.

unit.source: Eating it directly… no wonder you encountered the School of God’s Descent and heard baby cries.
unit.target: Eam directo edendo… non mirum est quod Scholae Descensionis Dei incidisti et gemitus infantium audivisti.

unit.source: Easy to be corrupted and influenced, encountering patients like Enio.
unit.target: Facile est corrumpi et affici, cum patientes ut Enio occurrant.

unit.source: Uneasy, Lugano asked, “Was the Planter ingredient I consumed the root of the problem?”
unit.target: Inquietus, Lugano quaesivit: “An materia Plantatoris quam consumpsi radix huius problematis fuerit?”

unit.source: He had ingested it a year prior, and even advanced.
unit.target: Illam ante annum consumpsit, et iam provectus erat.

unit.source: Was there no resolution to the problem?
unit.target: Num nullam resolutionem ad hoc problema exstitit?

unit.source: Lumian, seemingly avoiding Lugano’s beseeching gaze, feigned deep consideration as he perused the concluding segment of Madam Magician’s response.
unit.target: Lumian, visum implorantem Lugani aspectum vitans, simulavit se profunde meditari, dum partem conclusivam responsionis Dominae Magicae perlegebat.

unit.source: “I’ve pondered your earlier caution and have some theories, but presently, I cannot divulge them to you.”
unit.target: Praeteritam tuam cautelam meditatus sum et nonnullas theorias habeo; sed nunc eas tibi revelare nequeo.

unit.source: “I can only hint that Amon and the person behind Him must have orchestrated something beforehand to divert the Celestial Worthy’s attention from the pertinent issue.”
unit.target: Solum possum insinuare quod Amon et persona post eum aliquid antea composuerint, ut attentionem Caelestis Dignitatis a re pertinentia avertarent.

unit.source: “In essence, this situation seems advantageous for you and the rest of us.”
unit.target: Essentialiter, haec condicio vobis et nobis opportuna videtur.

unit.source: “For now, it’s best to feign ignorance and refrain from delving into it.”
unit.target: Nunc melius est ignorantiam fingere et in eam rem non intrare.

unit.source: “If troubled by infantile cries, seek aid from a clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother.”
unit.target: Si gemitus infantium te perturbat, auxilium a sacerdote Ecclesiae Matris Terrae quaere.

unit.source: Wh… Did Madam Magician anticipate Lugano’s lingering effects in advance?
unit.target: Num Domina Magica praevidebat effectus perstantes Lugani?

unit.source: It seems so.
unit.target: Ita videtur.

unit.source: She could discern the root cause of Lugano’s plight…
unit.target: Illa radicem causam Lugani infortunii discerere potuit.

unit.source: Lumian looked up, offering Lugano a reassuring smile.
unit.target: Lumian aspexit et Lugano solacium praebens, subridens.

unit.source: “The remedy to purge the corruption lies in seeking aid from Father Montserrat.”
unit.target: “Remedium ad corruptionem purgandam in auxilio a Patre Montserrat quaerendo iacet.”

unit.source: That’s it? After all my exposition?
unit.target: Hocne est? Post totam expositionem meam?

unit.source: If there’s truly no alternative, I would’ve taken my chances with the priest…
unit.target: Si vere nulla alternativa esset, fortunam meam cum sacerdote temptavissem.

unit.source: Lugano’s lips twitched as he mustered a strained smile.
unit.target: Labia Lugani contorquebantur, dum difficulter subrideret.

unit.source: “Very well, thank you, sir.”
unit.target: “Optime, gratias tibi ago, domine.”

unit.source: 606 Faith Conversion
unit.target: 606 Fides Conversionis

unit.source: At 8 a.m., in the prayer room on the third floor of the cabin, Lugano stepped in.
unit.target: Ad horam octavam ante meridiem, in cella precationis in tabulato tertio casae, Lugano intravit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat, draped in a brown priest’s robe, was already preaching.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, indutus veste sacerdotalis fusca, iam praedicabat.

unit.source: Five or six individuals were scattered in the rows of chairs before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Quinque vel sex homines in ordinibus sellarum ante Sacrum Signum Vitae dispersi erant.

unit.source: Without disturbing the sanctified ambiance, Lugano chose a spot at the front, near a supplicant.
unit.target: Ne sanctum ambitum turbaret, Lugano locum in fronte, prope supplicem eligit.

unit.source: As Father Montserrat concluded his sermon and closed the Holy Bible, the supplicants rose, spread their feet, and raised their palms high, chanting in unison, “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: Cum Pater Montserrat sermonem confecerit et Sacram Bibliam clausisset, supplices surrexerunt, pedes extendentes et palmas alte tollentes, una voce canentes: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: Lugano instinctively turned his head, noticing a tightly-wrapped up supplicant with brown eyes and a pale complexion in the same row—Enio, the special patient who had lost his internal organs.
unit.target: Lugano instinctive vertit caput suum, animadvertens supplicem strictissime involutum, cum oculis fuscis et vultu pallido in eodem ordine—Enio, aegrotus specialis qui organa interna amisit.

unit.source: H-he’s not dead?
unit.target: Nonne ille mortuus est?

unit.source: Wait, isn’t the evil warlock, Prinpino, supposed to be dead?
unit.target: Heu, nonne maleficus magus, Prinpino, mortuus esse deberet?

unit.source: Why is Enio, the special patient, still alive?
unit.target: Cur Enio, aegrotus specialis, adhuc vivit?

unit.source: Lugano was stunned, almost convinced he’d encountered a ghost.
unit.target: Lugano stupefactus erat, paene persuasus se phantasma convenisse.

unit.source: Being a Sequence 8 of the Planter pathway, he was ill-equipped to handle ghosts.
unit.target: Cum esset Sequens VIII in via Planter, ad phantasmata tractanda non idoneus erat.

unit.source: But then, Lugano observed that Enio’s face wasn’t as deathly pale as before.
unit.target: Sed tum, Lugano animadvertit faciem Enii non tam pallide quam antea.

unit.source: The brilliance in his eyes had returned, and vitality coursed through him.
unit.target: Splendor in oculis eius redierat, et vitalitas per eum fluebat.

unit.source: Wh… Lugano raised his hand, tapping his glabella to activate his Spirit Vision.
unit.target: Quid… Lugano levavit manum, pulsans glabellam suam ad activandam Visionem Spiritus.

unit.source: He observed Enio’s Ether Body, no longer as ashen as before.
unit.target: Animadvertit corpus aethericum Enii, iam non tam pallide quam antea.

unit.source: Whether it be the yellow hue symbolizing the digestive system, the orange hue denoting detoxification and organ excretion, or other shades, they had reverted to a semblance of normalcy, albeit faint and thin.
unit.target: Sive sit color flavus, systema digestivum repraesentans, sive color aurantiacus, detoxificationem et excretionem organorum signans, sive alias umbras, illa ad speciem normalitatis redierant, quamvis pallidae et tenues.

unit.source: Is that even possible?
unit.target: Numquid hoc fieri potest?

unit.source: Hadn’t he lost his heart, liver, spleen, lungs, intestines, stomach, and kidneys?
unit.target: Nonne amiserat cor, iecor, lienem, pulmones, intestina, ventriculum, atque renes?

unit.source: Lugano stared at Enio as though he were an aberration until Enio pivoted and pleasantly recognized him.
unit.target: Lugano Enium quasi aberrationem contemplatus est, donec Enio se vertit et eum jucunde agnovit.

unit.source: “Doctor, your treatment works wonders. I feel like I’m recovering!” Enio exclaimed joyously.
unit.target: “Doctor, curatio tua miracula facit; me sanari sentio!” exclamavit Enio laete.

unit.source: And this was just the initial treatment sans pinpointing the specific cause!
unit.target: Et hoc solum erat initium curationis, sine causae specificae investigatione!

unit.source: Lugano’s lips twitched stiffly.
unit.target: Labia Lugani rigidis motibus contrahuntur.

unit.source: “That’s reassuring, indeed.”
unit.target: “Id certe consolatur, re vera.”

unit.source: “Are you also a follower of Earth Mother?” Enio beamed, pleasantly surprised.
unit.target: “Esne etiam sectator Matris Terrae?” subridens et iucunde obstupuit Enio.

unit.source: I’m not.
unit.target: Non sum.

unit.source: Spare me the talk of Mother God or Mother…
unit.target: Noli mihi sermonem de Matre Dei aut de Matre proferre…

unit.source: As an Intisian, how can I subscribe to the Earth Mother faith?
unit.target: Quomodo, ut Intisianus, fidem Matris Terrae suscipere possum?

unit.source: Lugano gestured toward Montserrat, evading a direct response.
unit.target: Lugano manu ad Montserrat indicavit, responsionem directam vitans.

unit.source: “I need to discuss matters with the priest.”
unit.target: “Necesse est mihi cum sacerdote de rebus disserere.”

unit.source: Enio nodded.
unit.target: Enio annuit.

unit.source: “When can I seek further treatment in the morning?”
unit.target: Quando mane ulterius curationem quaerere possum?

unit.source: You don’t require treatment anymore.
unit.target: Non amplius curatione indiges.

unit.source: It’s time for recuperation and repose…
unit.target: Tempus est ad convalescentiam et quietem…

unit.source: Lugano grumbled, forcing a smile.
unit.target: Lugano gemebat, simul risum fingens.

unit.source: “In about an hour.”
unit.target: Circa unam horam.

unit.source: “Thank you, Doctor!” Enio waved, exiting the prayer room.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi, Doctor!” exclamavit Enio, manu agitando cellam precationis relinquens.

unit.source: When only Lugano and Father Montserrat remained, Lugano hushed his voice, gesturing toward the door.
unit.target: Cum solum Lugano et Pater Montserrat remanserunt, Lugano vocem suam tacuit, ad ianuam indicans.

unit.source: “H-how was he healed?”
unit.target: “Q-quomodo curatus est?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat, still relatively youthful with sincere eyes, smiled and responded, “Thanks to Earth Mother, his fortune was favorable.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, adhuc relative iuvenis et oculis sinceris, subridens respondit: “Gratias Matri Terrae, fortunam eius prosperam adeptus est.

unit.source: “As a Doctor yourself, you must be aware that internal organs can be transplanted as long as they maintain a certain level of vitality.
unit.target: ‘Quoniam doctor ipse es, scisne organa interna transplantari posse, dummodo certum gradum vitalitatis servant.

unit.source: For the ritual to succeed, Prinpino utilized his Beyonder powers to sustain the vitality of those internal organs.
unit.target: Ad ritui successum, Prinpino potentias suas Beyonder ad sustentandam vitalitatem horum organorum usus est.

unit.source: Moreover, the set he employed was extracted from Enio, eliminating the need to consider transplant rejection effects.
unit.target: Praeterea, series quam adhibuit ex Enio extracta est, eliminans necessitatem de effectibus repugnationis transplantationis considerandis.

unit.source: “Furthermore, Enio remained alive, relying on mystical power to uphold a certain level of vitality.
unit.target: “Praeterea, Enio vivus mansit, potentiam mysticam confugiens ad sustentandam certam mensuram vitalitatis.

unit.source: This was a crucial factor.”
unit.target: Hoc erat elementum praecipuum.

unit.source: “Did you perform surgery on him last night and transplant all his internal organs back?” Lugano was enlightened.
unit.target: “Num heri nocte operam chirurgicam ei perduxisti et omnia organa interna transplantavisti?” Lugano intellexit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat nodded.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat annuit.

unit.source: “For regular surgeons, this is an operation with nearly zero chances of success.
unit.target: “Pro chirurgis ordinariis, haec operatio spem successus paene nullam habet.

unit.source: Even if successful, keeping the patient alive long enough to navigate the most perilous stage is challenging.
unit.target: Etiam, si id efficitur, aegrotum vivo satis diu retinere ut periculosissimam partem transire possit, difficile est.

unit.source: However, for us, it falls within our capabilities.”
unit.target: Sed nobis, hoc in facultates nostras incurrit.

unit.source: Indeed…
unit.target: Certe…

unit.source: Compared to ordinary surgeons, Beyonder Doctors like us wield mystical powers akin to miracle-workers…
unit.target: Comparati ad chirurgos ordinarios, medici Beyonder, sicut miracula facientes, virtutes mysticas habent…

unit.source: Lugano sighed, dismissing further concern about Enio.
unit.target: Lugano suspiravit, de Enio ulterius sollicitiam relegans.

unit.source: Turning to Montserrat, he inquired with worry, “Father, I heard a baby crying again.
unit.target: Conversus ad Montserrat, anxie interrogavit: “Pater, iterum audivi infantem plorare.

unit.source: “Has that so-called Child of God set his sights on me?”
unit.target: “Num ille dictus Puer Dei in me conspectum tulit?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat reassured him, “Fear not.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat eum consolavit: “Noli timere.

unit.source: It’s an inevitable repercussion of the corresponding corruption.
unit.target: Ista est inevitabilis consequentia corruptionis correspondens.

unit.source: It will gradually dissipate over time.
unit.target: Paulatim per tempus evanescet.

unit.source: If you’re concerned about any unforeseen events or accidents on your path, I can help you eliminate them now.”
unit.target: Si de eventibus inopinatis aut casibus in via tua sollicitus es, nunc te adiuvare possum ut ea deleantur.

unit.source: Is that so?
unit.target: Num ita est?

unit.source: You’re merely a Sequence 8 Doctor.
unit.target: Tu solum es medicus Sequens VIII.

unit.source: Do you possess the capability to rid me of the remaining corruption?
unit.target: Habesne facultatem ut me a reliqua corruptione liberare possis?

unit.source: Set up an altar and seek Earth Mother’s aid?
unit.target: Altarum constitui et auxilium Matris Terrae quaere?

unit.source: Lugano remained skeptical.
unit.target: Lugano dubius remansit.

unit.source: “Thank you, Father!”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi, Pater!”

unit.source: Montserrat gestured toward Lugano’s previous spot.
unit.target: Montserrat ad locum priorem Lugani indicavit.

unit.source: “Follow the believers’ example.
unit.target: “Sequere exemplum fidelium.

unit.source: Close your eyes, listen to my preaching, and simultaneously, pray to Earth Mother.
unit.target: Oculos claude, praedicationem meam ausculta, et simul ad Matrem Terram ora.

unit.source: Remember, it’s specifically to Earth Mother, no other deity!”
unit.target: Memento, solum Matri Terrae, nullo alio deo, orandum esse.

unit.source: “Understood.”
unit.target: “Intellectum.”

unit.source: Lugano resumed his seat, crossed his arms, and shut his eyes.
unit.target: Lugano sedem suam reprisit, brachia transversa iunxit, et oculos clausit.

unit.source: As Father Montserrat delivered his sermon, Lugano silently echoed the verses of the Holy Bible.
unit.target: Dum Pater Montserrat sermonem suum proferre, Lugano versiculos Sacrae Bibliorum silentio repetebat.

unit.source: Gradually, his thoughts blurred, and amidst the discourse, Lugano discerned a mother’s gentle murmur and felt the comforting warmth of her embrace.
unit.target: Paulatim cogitationes eius evanuerunt, et inter sermonem, Lugano lenem murmur matrum perceptus est atque solaciorum calor in amplexu eius sensit.

unit.source: His tense heart eased, reminiscent of seeking solace in his mother’s arms after childhood bullying.
unit.target: Cor Lugani, quod tensum erat, lenitum est, reminiscens solacium quaesitum in amplexu matris post iniurias pueriles.

unit.source: It was a blend of dependency, reliance, and a sanctuary for the mind.
unit.target: Erat mixtio dependentiae, fiduciae, et refugii mentis.

unit.source: Unbeknownst to him, tears trickled down Lugano’s cheeks, as if purifying his body and soul.
unit.target: Mihi ignota, lacrimae per maxillas Lugani defuebant, quasi corpus et animam purgantes.

unit.source: Slowly, his emotions settled, dispelling the fear and unease.
unit.target: Paulatim affectus eius sedaverunt, timorem ac inquietudinem tollentes.

unit.source: “Done.”
unit.target: “Factum.”

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s voice seemed to waft from the distance, reaching Lugano’s ears.
unit.target: Vox Patris Montserrat ex longinquo fluitabat, ad aures Lugani perveniens.

unit.source: Opening his eyes, Lugano raised his right hand, wiping away the tears.
unit.target: Oculos aperiens, Lugano manum dexteram levavit, lacrimas abstergens.

unit.source: Standing up, he lifted his hands.
unit.target: Stans, manus suas levavit.

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: It was an almost reflexive response.
unit.target: Fere responsum quasi reflexum erat.

unit.source: In that moment, sunlight streamed through the window, casting a faint golden glow upon the prayer room, as if heralding forthcoming abundance.
unit.target: Illo momento, solis lumen per fenestram effluit, tenuem auream fulgurationem in cellam precationis iacens, quasi abundantiam venturam praeanuntiens.

unit.source: Father Montserrat nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, contentus, annuit.

unit.source: “Earth Mother has purged the corruption from your body.
unit.target: “Mater Terra corruptionem ex corpore tuo purgavit.

unit.source: Tonight, pay attention and see if you still hear the baby’s cries!”
unit.target: Hac nocte attende, et vide an adhuc clamores infantis audias.

unit.source: “Alright, Father!” Lugano replied, his body and mind now at ease.
unit.target: “Recte, Pater!” respondit Lugano, corpus et mens nunc in tranquillitate.

unit.source: The next morning, he awoke with a sense of happiness.
unit.target: Postero mane, cum laetitia replebatur, evigilavit.

unit.source: Throughout the night, he experienced no dreams of a beckoning mother, nor did he hear the cries of the so-called Child of God.
unit.target: Per noctem totam, nec somnia matris advocantis nec clamores dicti Puer Dei audivit.

unit.source: Filled with joy, Lugano, after serving Ludwig breakfast, hurried to the prayer room to share the uplifting news with Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Gaudio pleno, postquam Ludovico ientaculum obtulit, Lugano festinavit in cellam precationis, ut nuntium laetificum cum Patre Montserrat communicaret.

unit.source: Father Montserrat gazed at him for a moment and asked with a smile, “Are you interested in embracing Mother Earth?”
unit.target: Pater Montserrat eum per momentum aspexit et, subridens, rogavit: “Interesse tibi est Matrem Terram amplecti?”

unit.source: “Me?”
unit.target: “Ego?”

unit.source: Lugano hesitated before inquiring, “Are you willing to accept the conversion of a heretic?”
unit.target: Lugano haesitavit antequam rogavit: “Esne paratus conversionem haeretici accipere?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat smiled and replied, “In the Mother’s eyes, there are no heretics.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat subridens respondit: “In oculis Matris, haeretici non sunt.

unit.source: There are only children who are or are not willing to return home.”
unit.target: Sunt solum pueri qui domum redire velint aut non.

unit.source: Lugano’s heart wavered, reflecting on his past actions of merely going through the motions in cathedrals—praying, listening to preaching, and attending Mass.
unit.target: Cor Lugani vacillavit, reminiscens de actibus praeteritis, quibus tantum in ecclesiis cursu versatus erat—precando, praedicando audiendo, et Missam frequentando.

unit.source: He hadn’t truly believed in any deity, and the Church hadn’t provided substantial assistance.
unit.target: Numquam vere in ullam deitatem credidit, nec Ecclesia auxilium substantiale praebuit.

unit.source: Moreover, if I truly become a believer in Earth Mother, I might gain access to subsequent potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients from the Church or the three Orders…
unit.target: Praeterea, si vere fidem Matris Terrae accipiam, fortasse ad potionum formulas sequentium atque ingredientes Beyonder ex Ecclesia aut tribus Ordinibus perveniam…

unit.source: Even if not, I’ll surely receive corresponding mysticism guidance…
unit.target: Etiamsi non, certo recipiam instructionem mysticam correspondentem…

unit.source: Lugano hesitated, finding various excuses to convince himself.
unit.target: Lugano dubitavit, excusationes varias se ipsum persuadere quaerens.

unit.source: Father Montserrat patiently waited, not pressuring him.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat patienter exspectavit, eum non urgens.

unit.source: He simply smiled, anticipating Lugano’s decision.
unit.target: Simpliciter subridens, sententiam Lugani praevidens.

unit.source: Eventually, Lugano raised his hands.
unit.target: Postremo, Lugano manus suas levavit.

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: He responded to Father Montserrat’s proselytization in this manner.
unit.target: Ita respondit ad conversionem Patris Montserrat.

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s smile broadened as he extended his arms.
unit.target: Risus Patris Montserrat latius effusus est, dum brachia sua extendit.

unit.source: “Welcome home.”
unit.target: “Domum bene advenisti.”

unit.source: Those words oddly warmed Lugano’s heart.
unit.target: Illae verba mirabiliter cor Lugani calefecerunt.

unit.source: It felt as though, after years of wandering and adventuring, he had finally returned home.
unit.target: Videbatur quasi, post annos vagationis ac peragrationis, tandem domum redierit.

unit.source: Fatigue lifted, and a sense of grounding enveloped him.
unit.target: Lassitudo evanuit, et sensus stabilitatis eum cingebat.

unit.source: “Praise Mother Earth.”
unit.target: “Lauda Matrem Terram.”

unit.source: Lugano crossed his arms over his chest.
unit.target: Lugano brachia super pectum suum transversavit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat nodded and commenced his true preaching.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat annuit et veram praedicationem incepit.

unit.source: “You believe in the source of life, the mother of all things, the propagation of the fertile land, the symbol of the crimson moon and reproduction, as well as the destination and the starting point of everything…”
unit.target: “Credis in fontem vitae, in matrem omnium rerum, in propagationem terrae fecundae, in symbolum lunaris rubrae et reproductionis, atque in finem et initium cunctarum rerum…”

unit.source: Lugano listened attentively, committing the information to memory.
unit.target: Lugano attente auscultavit, notitias in memoria retinens.

unit.source: Though not devout yet, this might become his future sanctuary.
unit.target: Etsi nondum devotus, hoc futurum esse eius refugium poterat.

unit.source: He recognized the importance of presenting his good side at all times.
unit.target: Animadvertit momentum semper bonam imaginem suam ostendere.

unit.source: Upon returning to the first-class suite, Lugano glanced nervously at Lumian, who was engrossed in studying the Southern Continent’s Dutanese, and stammered, “I-I’ve changed my faith to Earth Mother.”
unit.target: Rediens ad conclave primae classis, Lugano anxie intuebatur Lumian, qui linguam Dutanensem Continenti Australis studebat, et balbutivit, “E-ego fidem meam ad Matrem Terram mutavi.”

unit.source: As a fellow Intisian, would he despise and scorn me?
unit.target: Ut socius Intisianus, num ille me detestaret et contemnret?

unit.source: Lumian looked up and chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et subridens risit.

unit.source: “Then make sure to radiate maternal brilliance.
unit.target: “Tunc cura ut fulgor maternus effulgeat.

unit.source: Ludwig is counting on you for some fresh fish.”
unit.target: Ludwig in te confidit pro piscibus recentibus.

unit.source: He doesn’t mind at all…
unit.target: Minime id curat…

unit.source: Lugano mumbled, not willing to let Ludwig go hungry.
unit.target: Lugano murmure dixit, nolens Ludwig famem pati.

unit.source: He embarked on a busy day.
unit.target: Se intromisit in diem occupatissimum.

unit.source: Late at night, after tending to Ludwig until bedtime, Lugano pondered briefly and decided to visit the prayer room.
unit.target: Nox sero, postquam Ludwig usque ad tempus dormiendi curavit, Lugano parum meditatus est et decrevit cellam precationis visitare.

unit.source: If the door was still ajar, he intended to offer a prayer before retiring for the night.
unit.target: Si ianua adhuc paulo aperta esset, precationem offerre voluit antequam nocte se recuberet.

unit.source: He had to make a good impression right from the beginning!
unit.target: Exordio bonam impressionem creare debebat!

unit.source: Lugano treaded the dimly lit stairs, approaching the prayer room with cautious steps on the creaking floor.
unit.target: Lugano scalis vix lucentibus gradibus perrexit, cellam precationis cum passibus cautis super pavimentum stridulum accedens.

unit.source: His footfalls grew hushed, wary of disturbing those engaged in prayer and potentially interrupting Father Montserrat’s embodiment of Mother Earth’s teachings through reproductive activities with a female believer.
unit.target: Gradus eius silentiores fiebant, metuens eos in precatione versantes non turbari atque fortasse incarnationem doctrinae Matris Terrae a Patre Montserrat, per activitates reproductionis cum credula femina interrumpi.

unit.source: Reaching the door quietly, Lugano extended his right hand, gently pushing it open.
unit.target: Ianuam quiete attingens, Lugano manum dexteram protulit eam leniter aperiens.

unit.source: The wooden door eased ajar, revealing a small gap without a sound.
unit.target: Ianuam ligneam paululum aperuit, parvum rima sine sono revelans.

unit.source: It’s not shut tight…
unit.target: Non arcte clausum est…

unit.source: Is he truly in the midst of reproduction? Lugano cautiously peered into the opening.
unit.target: Num vere in reproductione versatur? Lugano in rimam cautissime intuebatur.

unit.source: He observed the crimson moonlight enveloping the prayer room and Father Montserrat, draped in a brown priest’s robe, standing before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Animadvertit lunam rubram, quae cellam precationis et Patrem Montserrat, indutum veste sacerdotalis fusca, ante Sacrum Signum Vitae involvit.

unit.source: Folding his arms, Father Montserrat swayed gently, as if cradling a newborn child.
unit.target: Brachia sua implicans, Pater Montserrat leniter oscillabat, quasi infans recens natum cunabulum portans.

unit.source: However, there was nothing within his embrace.
unit.target: Attamen, nihil in amplexu eius erat.

unit.source: 607 Smell of Food
unit.target: 607 Odor Cibi

unit.source: Lugano’s scalp tingled as he found himself in a surreal encounter with Father Montserrat, bathed in the glow of the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Cutis capitis Lugani pulsata est, dum se in congressum surrealem cum Patre Montserrat, lumine rubro lunaris immerso, invenit.

unit.source: The sight of the priest, cradling an invisible child in his arms, sent shivers down Lugano’s spine.
unit.target: Aspectus sacerdotis, puerum invisibilem in brachiis tenens, tremores per spinam Lugani excitavit.

unit.source: Is he carrying a child?
unit.target: Portatne puerum?

unit.source: An invisible child?
unit.target: Puerum invisibilem?

unit.source: The so-called Child of God?
unit.target: Puer Dei, ut fertur?

unit.source: Frightened by the association, Lugano tried to quickly shut the door before the owner noticed, as if he had wandered into the wrong room.
unit.target: Territus ob hanc associationem, Lugano celeriter ianuam claudere conatus est antequam dominus animadvertiret, quasi in conclave erratum intravisset.

unit.source: He slipped away without making a sound.
unit.target: Sine strepitu evasit.

unit.source: Suddenly, Father Montserrat’s voice echoed in the air.
unit.target: Repente, vox Patris Montserrat in aere resonavit.

unit.source: “Are you here for prayer?”
unit.target: “Venisne hic ad orationem?”

unit.source: Lugano’s eyes tightened, and like a startled wild cat, he swiftly turned and sprinted towards the staircase.
unit.target: Oculi Lugani contracti sunt, et, ut felis ferus obstupefactus, celeriter se vertit et ad scalam properavit.

unit.source: All he could think about at that moment was his formidable employer!
unit.target: Omne quod illo momento cogitabat, solum erat de formidabili patrono suo!

unit.source: However, what met his eyes was utter darkness.
unit.target: Attamen, quod oculis eius occurrit, erat absoluta obscuritas.

unit.source: No staircase with a wooden floor in sight.
unit.target: Nulla scala cum pavimento ligneo in conspectu erat.

unit.source: In the shadows, clusters of pitch-black weeds, with plump wheat, swayed in eerie silence.
unit.target: In umbris, fasciculi herbarum nigrissimarum, cum tritico robusto, in silentio insolito fluctuant.

unit.source: Lugano’s body tensed, uncertain about the unknown that awaited him in this abyss of darkness.
unit.target: Corpus Lugani contractum est, incertum de ignoto quod in hoc abyssis tenebrarum eum exspectabat.

unit.source: “Why did you run?”
unit.target: “Cur cucurristi?”

unit.source: The weeds parted, revealing Father Montserrat, holding an invisible baby.
unit.target: Herbae se disseverunt, patefacientes Patrem Montserrat, infans invisibilis in brachiis tenens.

unit.source: Behind him, an illusionary, unusually massive oak tree stood tall.
unit.target: Post eum, quercus illusoria, insolite ingens, stabat.

unit.source: Next to the weeds, the oak tree was covered in abnormal growths, forming a chillingly simple and ominous Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Iuxta herbas, quercus abundabat crescentiis abnormibus, formans Sacrum Emblema Vitae, simplicem sed minaciter ominosum.

unit.source: As Father Montserrat, clad in a brown priest’s uniform, appeared less than three meters away, Lugano swallowed hard, offering a feeble excuse.
unit.target: Cum Patre Montserrat, indutus vestimento sacerdotali fusco, minus quam tribus pedibus apparuisset, Lugano vehementer deglutit, excusationem infirmam praebens.

unit.source: “It’s late. I didn’t want to disturb you.”
unit.target: “Serum est. Noluī te perturbare.”

unit.source: Father Montserrat remained cradling his arms, wearing a faint smile.
unit.target: Patre Montserrat manebat, brachiis suis involutus, subridente molliter.

unit.source: “What did you see?”
unit.target: “Quid vidisti?”

unit.source: Every hair on Lugano’s neck stood on end, and cold sweat broke out on his back.
unit.target: Omnis capillus in collo Lugani erectus est, et frigidus sudor in dorso eius exortus est.

unit.source: Struggling, Lugano pointed at Father Montserrat’s empty embrace, asking with difficulty, “Why are you doing this?”
unit.target: Luctans, Lugano digitum ad Patrem Montserrat, eius vacuam amplexum demonstrans, difficulter quaesivit: “Cur hoc facis?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat responded with a significant tone, “We’re all Mother’s children.”
unit.target: Pater Montserrat respondit graviter: “Omnes sumus filii Matris.”

unit.source: Lugano didn’t dare to delve further and nodded repeatedly.
unit.target: Lugano non ausus est ultra quaerere et saepius annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, yes, yes. We’re all Mother’s children.”
unit.target: “Ita, ita, ita. Omnes sumus filii Matris.”

unit.source: Father Montserrat didn’t allow him to navigate through with platitudes.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat eum non sinit ulterius per verba vana iterari.

unit.source: He deliberately added,
unit.target: Proposito addidit:

unit.source: “The child of the Great Mother.”
unit.target: “Puer Magnae Matris.”

unit.source: Great Mother… Although Lugano had anticipated this answer, his heart almost skipped a beat, and his mind went blank upon hearing it.
unit.target: Magna Mater… Quamquam Lugano hanc responsionem antevidit, cor eius paene exstoluit, et mens eius vacua facta est, audiente eam.

unit.source: Seeing that Father Montserrat had made it explicit, Lugano had no choice but to inquire,
unit.target: Videns Patrem Montserrat hoc patefecisse, Lugano non habuit aliud nisi interrogare:

unit.source: “Aren’t… aren’t you a follower of Earth Mother?”
unit.target: “Nonne… non es sectator Matris Terrae?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat felt no remorse about betraying the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat nullum dolorem habuit de proditione Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: He maintained a warm smile and explained, “Earth Mother is a facet of the Great Mother, a projection.”
unit.target: Eius subrisum calidum servavit et explanavit: “Mater Terra est pars Magnae Matris, quasi imago.”

unit.source: In this role, she watches over the lands of betrayal and the children who have strayed from the Mother’s embrace.
unit.target: In hoc munere, illa terras proditionis et filios qui ab amplexu Matris erraverunt, curat.

unit.source: Gulp… Lugano instinctively swallowed, uncertain about how to counter Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Gulp… Lugano instinctuose deglutit, incertus quomodo Patrem Montserrat repellere posset.

unit.source: Having joined the Church of Earth Mother just a day ago and attended only two sermons, he lacked the profound theological knowledge to challenge such heretics.
unit.target: Quoniam die uno abhinc Ecclesiam Matris Terrae adiunxerat et solum duas praedicacula audiverat, ei defuere profundae scientiae theologicae ad talia haereticos oppugnandos.

unit.source: He could, of course, outright deny it.
unit.target: Scilicet, id plane negare poterat.

unit.source: After all, Montserrat’s explanation sounded ominous.
unit.target: Postremo, explanatio Montserrat ominose sonabat.

unit.source: If the priest’s words were true, with the Earth Mother Church’s resources and factions, the so-called Child of God should have already been born in the real world, and the Great Mother would have returned.
unit.target: Si verba sacerdotis vera essent, cum opibus et factionibus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, puer Dei, ut fertur, iam in mundo reali natus esse debuisset, et Magna Mater redivisset.

unit.source: Yet, that hadn’t happened.
unit.target: At id non evenit.

unit.source: The current scene and the invisible pressure silenced Lugano, refraining from outright denial.
unit.target: Scaena praesentis atque pressura invisibilis Lugano silentium obtinuerunt, et eum ab aperta negatione abstinuerunt.

unit.source: What if he enraged Father Montserrat completely?
unit.target: Quid si Patrem Montserrat omnino ad iram excitaverit?

unit.source: Father Montserrat continued, “All creatures in this world are the children of the Great Mother.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat continuavit: “Omnes creaturae huius mundi sunt filii Magnae Matris.

unit.source: Some were conceived by her, some are descendants of these deities, and some, like you and me, were directly transformed from the flesh and blood of the Great Mother. We share the strongest connection with her!”
unit.target: Aliqui a ea concepti sunt, alii ex his deis descendunt, et quidam, ut tu et ego, directe ex carne et sanguine Magnae Matris transformati sumus. Nobis fortissimum vinculum cum ea est!

unit.source: Internally, Lugano couldn’t help but retort, I was born by my mother, not transformed from the flesh and blood of the Great Mother… However, his smile remained, more grimacing than joyous.
unit.target: Intus, Lugano non potuit non remittere: “Ego a matre natus sum, non ex carne et sanguine Magnae Matris transformatus.” Attamen, risus eius permanuit, magis contritus quam laetus.

unit.source: “Don’t you find the Great Mother’s believers sinister and terrifying?”
unit.target: “Nonne existimas fideles Magnae Matris sinistros et terribiles esse?”

unit.source: Father Montserrat smiled and reassured, “There’s no need to fear the return of the Great Mother. How can a mother hate her child?
unit.target: Pater Montserrat subridens et consolans respondit: “Non est causa timendi reditum Magnae Matris. Quomodo potest mater filium suum oderi?”

unit.source: You might not know, but there are many worlds beyond ours. The creatures in those places flourish under the watch of the Great Mother, constantly reproducing and growing. I’ve never heard of any species being eradicated. Instead, their numbers are increasing.
unit.target: Fortasse nescis, sed multi orbi extra nostros sunt. Creaturae in illis locis sub custodia Magnae Matris florent, constanter generantes et crescientes. Numquam audivi ullam speciem eradicatam esse. Immo, numeri eorum augentur.

unit.source: Moreover, it’s the Great Mother who granted us life. It’s her prerogative to reclaim the life she bestowed upon us. We should cooperate willingly.
unit.target: Praeterea, Magna Mater est quae nobis vitam dedit. Eius est prerogativa vitam, quam nobis dedit, recipiendi. Cooperemus libenter.

unit.source: Cooperate my rear end, you son of a sow! Lugano wasn’t bewitched.
unit.target: Coopera, podex meus, filius scrofae! Lugano non erat incantatus.

unit.source: Suddenly, he drew his concealed revolver and fired two shots at Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Repente, revolverum occultum eduxit et duo ictus in Patrem Montserrat iecit.

unit.source: Without confirming the effectiveness of the shots, he swiftly turned and sprinted toward the dark expanse filled with black weeds.
unit.target: Nihil ictuum efficacitatem comprobans, celeriter se vertit et ad vastum spatium obscurum, herbis nigrissimis repletum, properavit.

unit.source: “Waaa!”
unit.target: “Waaa!”

unit.source: Abruptly, Lugano heard an almost ethereal cry of an infant.
unit.target: Subito, Lugano audivit clamorem infantuli paene aetherium.

unit.source: It was exactly the same as the sounds he had heard several times before.
unit.target: Idem erat prorsus ac soni quos ante aliquoties audiverat.

unit.source: Lugano’s expression froze, and his pace slowed as he ran.
unit.target: Vultus Lugani stetit, et celeritas eius remissa est dum currebat.

unit.source: His eyes gradually filled with emptiness, and he turned around.
unit.target: Oculi eius paulatim vacuo impleti sunt, et se vertit.

unit.source: Step by step, he approached Father Montserrat, who was cradling an invisible baby, and the illusory, colossal oak tree.
unit.target: Gradatim accessit ad Patrem Montserrat, qui puerum invisibilem in brachiis tenens, et ad quercum illusoriam ingentem.

unit.source: “That’s our mother…
unit.target: Haec est mater nostra…

unit.source: The mother who gave us life…
unit.target: Mater quae nobis vitam dedit…

unit.source: She’s willing to accept anyone who repents, every child who returns home…
unit.target: Ea parata est accipere quemvis paenitentem, omne puerum qui domum redeat…

unit.source: If she wants to take back the life she bestowed upon us, then let her. She has the prerogative to reclaim what she gave…
unit.target: Si vult vitam, quam nobis dedit, revocare, tunc fiat. Illa habet praeeminentiam ad recipiendum quod dedit…

unit.source: Listening to Father Montserrat’s abnormally ethereal yet seemingly close voice, Lugano gradually developed a strong and heartfelt acceptance.
unit.target: Audientem vocem Patris Montserrat, quae anomale aetheria sed prope apparuit, Lugano paulatim acceptationem firmam et sincere ex corde evolvit.

unit.source: “Yes, that’s my mother…
unit.target: “Ita, haec est mater mea…

unit.source: Why would she harm me?
unit.target: Cur mihi noceret?

unit.source: She can take back what she had given…
unit.target: Ea potest recipere id quod dedit…

unit.source: Lugano walked faster and faster until he stood beside Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Lugano celerius et celerius ambulavit, donec iuxta Patrem Montserrat se constituit.

unit.source: Instantly, he felt warmth and relief. It was the scent of a mother’s embrace.
unit.target: Statim, sensit calorem et levationem; erat odor amplexus matris.

unit.source: Gradually, he experienced an indescribable moist sensation, as if a kitten were being licked by a female cat.
unit.target: Paulatim, sensit sensum umidum ineffabilem, quasi catillus a femina feli lingebatur.

unit.source: How comforting… Lugano half-closed his eyes.
unit.target: Quam solacum… Lugano semiter clausit oculos suos.

unit.source: At that moment, he heard his mother’s favorite nursery rhyme
unit.target: Illo momento, audivit canticum infans, quod mater eius maxime amabat

unit.source: —from behind him.
unit.target: —ex tergo eius.

unit.source: Why is Mom behind me? Shouldn’t she be in front? Lugano wondered vaguely.
unit.target: Cur mater mea post me est? Nonne debet esse ante me? Lugano vago animo quaerebat.

unit.source: Then, he heard his mother shouting behind him, “Don’t go over!
unit.target: Tum audivit matrem suam ex tergo clamantem: “Noli transire!”

unit.source: “Don’t move forward!
unit.target: “Noli progredi!”

unit.source: “Danger!”
unit.target: “Periculum!”

unit.source: Don’t go over… Don’t move forward… Danger… Lugano shuddered, his vacant eyes regaining a certain vigor.
unit.target: Noli transire… Noli progredi… Periculum… Lugano contremuit, oculi eius inania aliquam vim recipuerunt.

unit.source: He saw where he was—the illusory colossal oak tree and moist, warm, squirming flesh petals sprouting from it. Half of his body was already enveloped in the flesh petals, slowly pulling inward.
unit.target: Vidit ubi esset: quercus illusoria ingentis magnitudinis et petala carnis umida, calida, et contorta, quae ex ea oriebantur. Dimidium corporis eius iam in petalis carnis involutum erat, quae lente intus trahuntur.

unit.source: This was the motherly embrace he had just experienced.
unit.target: Hoc erat amplexus maternum, quem modo expertus erat.

unit.source: Lugano’s pupils dilated, and a chill ran down his spine, causing his hair to stand on end.
unit.target: Pupillae Lugani dilatatae sunt, et frigus per spinam eius cucurrit, faciens capillos eius erectos.

unit.source: He exerted strength against the viscous liquid-covered flesh with both hands, swiftly pulling away.
unit.target: Ambabus manibus vim imponebat adversus carnem liquido viscoso involutam, celeriter aufugiens.

unit.source: Father Montserrat, cradling an invisible baby, appeared beside Lugano, wearing a warm smile.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, infante invisibili in brachiis eius portaretur, apparuit iuxta Lugano, subridente calido.

unit.source: “Return. Return to the Mother’s embrace and revert to our original form.”
unit.target: “Redi. Redi ad amplexum Matris et ad formam nostram primigeniam revertere.”

unit.source: Despair gripped Lugano.
unit.target: Desperatio Lugani premebat.

unit.source: He wanted to confront the priest, but sadly, having consumed two potions—Planter and Doctor—he realized that, apart from enhanced strength and proficiency with farming tools and a scalpel, he lacked Beyonder powers directly applicable in combat. These powers included predicting the weather, identifying and nurturing seeds, treating ailments, healing wounds, stitching up souls, bestowing life, or possessing outstanding surgical abilities.
unit.target: Volebat sacerdotem oppugnare, sed, pro dolor, postquam duas pocula—Planter et Doctor—consumaverat, intellexit se, praeter vim amplificatam et peritiam in agricolis instrumentis atque scalplo, potentias Beyonder, quae directe in proelio adhiberentur, deficere.

unit.source: In the past, Lugano had relied on the combat techniques and marksmanship learned as a bounty hunter to match a Planter’s strength and firearms.
unit.target: Olim, Lugano in technicis proelii et in arte sclopetaria, quae didicerat ut venator praemiis, confidebat, ut vim Planterae et armorum ignifera aequaret.

unit.source: Nevertheless, not resisting at a moment like this meant certain death.
unit.target: Attamen, in tali momento non resistere mortem certam significabat.

unit.source: Lugano, an adventurer with a history of killing, faced immense fear as he fired at Father Montserrat and drew a sharp scalpel.
unit.target: Lugano, adventurer cum caedes memoria relicta, ingentem metum sensit dum Patrem Montserrat iecit et acutum scalpellum extraxit.

unit.source: In Lumian’s first-class cabin suite, Lumian, still engrossed in the Dutanese textbook under the kerosene wall lamp, heard a knock on the door.
unit.target: In cubiculo primae classe Lumiani, Lumian, adhuc in Dutanensi lectione sub lampada parietali kerosene occupatus, pulsationem ad ianuam audivit.

unit.source: Perplexed, he stood up, opened the door, and found Ludwig.
unit.target: Perplexus, surrexit, ianuam aperuit, et Ludwig invenit.

unit.source: Ludwig, clad in grayish-white checkered pajamas top and pants, spoke gravely,
unit.target: Ludwig, indutus in pyjama quadricolor cinereus-albidus, graviter locutus est:

unit.source: “Lugano has encountered an accident. Hurry up and save him.”
unit.target: “Lugano casum passus est. Festina et eum salva.”

unit.source: An accident?
unit.target: Casus?

unit.source: Lumian arched his eyebrows.
unit.target: Lumian supercilia arcuit.

unit.source: Knowing that Lugano could still hear the baby’s cries, Lumian had discreetly heightened his surveillance and attention on the servant, including just now.
unit.target: Scientes Lugano adhuc infantuli clamores audire posse, Lumian caute vigilantiam et attentionem in servo auxit, etiam modo.

unit.source: But how could an accident occur when Lugano had entered the Earth Mother Church’s prayer room?
unit.target: Sed quomodo casus evenire poterat, cum Lugano in conclave orationis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae intravisset?

unit.source: Ludwig continued, “I couldn’t sense his scent after he entered the prayer room.”
unit.target: Ludwig continuavit: “Non potui odorem eius sentire postquam in conclave orationis intravit.”

unit.source: “What scent?”
unit.target: “Quid odorem?”

unit.source: Lumian inquired casually, already forming a vague suspicion.
unit.target: Lumian leviter inquisivit, iam suspicionem vagam formans.

unit.source: Ludwig responded nonchalantly, “The smell of food.”
unit.target: Ludwig respondit nonchalans: “Odor cibi.”

unit.source: Lumian stretched his neck and wrists, regarding Ludwig thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian collum et carpus extendit, Ludwig attente intuens.

unit.source: “You deliberately sniffed his scent.”
unit.target: “Tu deliberate eius odorem inspiravisti.”

unit.source: Ludwig’s chubby cheeks displayed an expression that said, “What’s so odd about that?”
unit.target: Ludwig, cui gulae erant pingues, vultum exprimit, qui dicebat: “Quid in hoc tam mirum est?”

unit.source: “If he perishes and you’re busy elsewhere, who will assist me in gathering food?”
unit.target: “Si ille perit et tu alio occupatus es, quis mihi in cibi colligendo auxiliabitur?”

unit.source: “That’s a valid point.”
unit.target: “Id est argumentum validum.”

unit.source: Lumian grinned.
unit.target: Lumian subridens.

unit.source: In the darkness, enveloped by black weeds, Lugano’s scalpel sliced through the air as he attempted to strike Father Montserrat.
unit.target: In tenebris, circumdatum herbis nigrissimis, scalpellum Lugani per aerem secabat, conans Patrem Montserrat ferire.

unit.source: “Waaa!”
unit.target: “Waaa!”

unit.source: The baby’s cries echoed once more, leaving Lugano in a momentary daze, teetering on the edge of losing control.
unit.target: Clamores infantis iterum resonaverunt, relinquentes Lugano in statu momentaneo attoniti, vacillantem in limine moderationis.

unit.source: With the invisible baby cradled in his arms, Montserrat manifested on the colossal illusory oak tree and smiled down at Lugano.
unit.target: Cum infans invisibilis in brachiis eius portaretur, Montserrat in quercu illusorio ingenti apparuit atque deorsum ad Lugano subridens intuitus est.

unit.source: “Don’t resist. We originated from the Mother, and we shall return to her.”
unit.target: “Noli resistere. Ex Matre originati sumus, et ad eam reverterimus.”

unit.source: Just as the priest, with clear eyes and a warm smile, finished speaking, a knock on the door reverberated in the seemingly endless darkness, echoing among the weeds with abundant wheat.
unit.target: Simul, cum sacerdos, oculis perspicuis et subridente calido, sermonem finivit, pulsatio ad ianuam in obscuritate quasi infinita resonavit, inter herbas cum trigo abundantissimo echo resonans.

unit.source: Upon hearing the polite knock on the door, Lugano had an inexplicable thought.
unit.target: Audito urbanitate pulsatione ianuae, Lugano cogitationem inexplicablem habuit.

unit.source: How polite—to knock at the door in such a situation…
unit.target: Quam urbanum—ianuam pulsare in tali condicione…

unit.source: 608 The Way to Find Prey
unit.target: 608 Via ad Praedam Inveniendam

unit.source: The rhythmic thumping echoed only three times before escalating into a resounding bang.
unit.target: Ictus rhythmi tantum ter resonaverunt, antequam in ingentem fragorem evolverunt.

unit.source: As the sturdy wooden door flung open, the corridor bathed in the glow of kerosene wall lamps revealed a darkness entwined with overgrown weeds.
unit.target: Cum robusta porta lignea abrupte aperta esset, et corridor in luce lampadarum kerosinae effuso illustratus esset, tenebras detexit, intricatas cum exuberantia herbarum.

unit.source: Crimson flames surged forth, casting an eerie illumination.
unit.target: Flammae coccineae irruerunt, lumen terribilem diffundentes.

unit.source: In Lugano’s gaze, the illusion of the oak tree abruptly dissipated, along with Father Montserrat, cradling an unseen infant in his arms.
unit.target: In conspectu Lugani, illusio quercus repentina evanuit, simulque cum Patre Montserrat, qui infantem invisum in brachiis tenebat.

unit.source: Amidst the fiery chaos, the weeds withered, and the shadows dispersed.
unit.target: In medio ignis tumulto, herbae marcescebant, et umbrae se disperserunt.

unit.source: Lugano found himself “returned” to the humble prayer room, now aglow with the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Lugano se repperit "reditum" in humilem conclave precationis, nunc rubro lumine lunari fulgentem.

unit.source: Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, emerged at the entrance.
unit.target: Lumian, gerens pileum aureum stramineum, ad ostium apparuit.

unit.source: His eyes scanned every nook, yet Father Montserrat remained elusive.
unit.target: Oculi eius omnem angulum perlustrebant, sed Pater Montserrat elusorius manebat.

unit.source: Powers akin to the Paramita world merged with other traits, albeit incapable of creating a sufficiently independent world separate from reality.
unit.target: Potentiae, affines mundo Paramitae, cum aliis indolis coalescebant, quamquam non sufficiebant ut mundum independentem a re creare possent.

unit.source: It resembles Demon Warlock Burman gaining unique abilities through a forceful transition of pathways…
unit.target: Hoc simile est Demon Mago Burman, qui per transitionem viarum fortis facultates singulares adipisci videtur…

unit.source: Where is he hiding now?
unit.target: Ubi nunc se abscondit?

unit.source: Drawing from Ludwig’s knowledge from his food, Beyonders of the School of God’s Descent can conceal themselves in woodwork.
unit.target: Ex scientia Luidwigiana ex cibo, Beyonders Scholae Dei Descensionis se in lignaria abscondere possunt.

unit.source: Although I can’t confirm Father Montserrat’s corrupted affiliation with the School, the influence of the Great Mother is evident…
unit.target: Quamquam non possum confirmare relationem corruptam Patris Montserrat cum Schola, influentia Magnae Matris manifesta est…

unit.source: Lumian swiftly assessed the unfolding scenario.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter casum evolutum aestimavit.

unit.source: The lack of resistance from Father Montserrat, who refrained from fleeing or hiding, didn’t surprise Lumian.
unit.target: Defectus oppositionis a Patre Montserrat, qui neque fugere neque se abscondere conatus est, Lumian non stupuit.

unit.source: Performing the wave magic in the ship’s bar had been a casual display, not wanting to waste the temporary Governor of the Sea authority.
unit.target: Exercitatio magiae fluctuum in taberna navis fuit ostentatio levibus, ne temporaria auctoritas gubernatoris maris periret.

unit.source: However, the subsequent use of the colossal wave to “greet” Captain Pedro and Father Montserrat wasn’t mere showmanship.
unit.target: Attamen, usus posterius fluctus ingentis ad salutandum Capitaneum Pedrum et Patrem Montserrat non erat mera ostentatio.

unit.source: Unaware if the School of God’s Descent incident had concluded or if hidden Great Mother devotees lingered on the ship, Lumian deliberately showcased the might of a demigod Governor of the Sea to instill fear!
unit.target: Nesciens utrum casus incidentia Scholae Dei Descensionis confectus esset aut num sectatores occulti Magnae Matris in nave mansissent, Lumian deliberato affectu potentiam semidei Gubernatoris Maris ostendit, ut timorem incuteret!

unit.source: If there were no other Great Mother adherents or lurking threats, his “greeting” actions could be seen as showmanship.
unit.target: Si nulli alii sectatores Magnae Matris aut latentia pericula adessent, eius "salutationis" actus ut ostentatio viderentur.

unit.source: But if danger lurked, it would make the elusive elements cautious, forcing them to retreat deeper into hiding.
unit.target: Sed si periculum latens esset, illa elementa elusiva cauta esse coegerent, atque eos ad altiora abscondendi impellere vellent.

unit.source: Lumian planned to let the ship reach the next port, leaving the Church of Earth Mother authorities to deal with them.
unit.target: Lumian constituit navem ad proximam portum pervenire, atque auctoritates Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ad eos operandum reliquit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat, seemingly unwilling to face the adventurer Louis Berry head-on and his demigod prowess, opted for concealment, biding his time until the ship docked.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, videntur non volens adversari adventorem Ludovicum Berry et eius semideam potentiam, celationem elegit, tempus exspectans donec navis ad portum accesseret.

unit.source: Had Lugano not luckily or unluckily stumbled upon the priest cradling the unseen infant, Father Montserrat might have continued portraying himself as a competent clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother, avoiding any confrontation with Louis Berry.
unit.target: Si Lugano non casu fortuito aut infelici sacerdotem, infantem invisum complexum invenerit, Pater Montserrat fortasse se tamquam clericus idoneus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ostenderet, ne ullam certationem cum Ludovico Berry haberet.

unit.source: “F-Father Montserrat is a believer in the Great Mother! He was cradling an invisible baby!” Lugano hastily reported to Louis Berry, now realizing the gravity of the situation.
unit.target: «P-Pater Montserrat credit in Magnam Matrem! Complectebatur infantem invisum!» Lugano festinanter Luico Berry nuntiavit, iam grave rei statum persentiens.

unit.source: Cradling an invisible baby…
unit.target: Complectens infantem invisum…

unit.source: He could be hiding within the ship’s woodwork.
unit.target: Potest se abscondere in operibus ligneis navis.

unit.source: Lumian scanned the surroundings, inspecting chairs, the floor, and the Sacred Emblem of Life adorning the wooden wall.
unit.target: Lumian circumiecta perlustrebat, inspectans sellas, pavimentum, et Sanctum Emblemata Vitae, quod pariete ligneo ornatum erat.

unit.source: In an abrupt realization, he felt a stir in his heart as he approached the Sacred Emblem embodying Earth Mother.
unit.target: In repente acquirente intellectione, motum in corde sensit, cum Sanctum Emblemata, quod Matrem Terrae incarnabat, accessisset.

unit.source: Adorned with symbols of wheat, flowers, and spring water at the periphery, at its core lay a simple depiction of a baby.
unit.target: Ornatum symbolis tritici, florum, et aquae fontis ad circumferentiam, in eius nucleo simplex imago infantis iacebat.

unit.source: A baby!
unit.target: Infans!

unit.source: Advancing further, crimson flames radiated, setting the wooden floorboards and chairs ablaze.
unit.target: Progrediens porro, flammae coccineae radiante luce, pavimenta lignea et sellas igni afflixerunt.

unit.source: Coming to a halt before the Sacred Emblem of Life, Lumian extended his right hand, gently caressing the baby’s face.
unit.target: Stans ante Sanctum Emblemata Vitae, Lumian dextram manum protulit, infantis faciem leniter tractans.

unit.source: The wood instantly deteriorated, exuding a yellowish pus.
unit.target: Ligna statim corruerunt, emittens pus luteus.

unit.source: It seemed that the depiction of a baby surrounded by wheat and flowers had long decayed, shedding tears of blood.
unit.target: Videbatur imago infantis, circumdata tritico et floribus, diu deperditam esse, lacrimas sanguinis effundens.

unit.source: There’s a huge problem with the Church of Earth Mother…
unit.target: Magnum problema in Ecclesia Matris Terrae existit…

unit.source: Lumian narrowed his eyes.
unit.target: Lumian oculos contraxit.

unit.source: While unable to pinpoint the elusive Father Montserrat, he unearthed decay and darkness lurking beneath the veneer of the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Nondum possens detegere Patrem Montserrat elusivum, invenit tamen putredinem et tenebras latentes sub specie Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Observing the charred remains of the woodwork and finding no trace of Father Montserrat, with more wooden hiding spots on the steel steam ship, Lumian turned and addressed Lugano, “Take me to the captain’s cabin.”
unit.target: Observans reliquias in ligno combustas et nullum vestigium Patris Montserrat reperiens, cum plura loca abscondendi in navi ferrea vaporis esset, Lumian se vertit ad Lugano et dixit: “Duc me ad cubiculum capitani.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Lugano visibly relaxed.
unit.target: «Bene.» Lugano manifeste relaxatus est.

unit.source: Exiting the prayer room, the crimson flames within swiftly extinguished, ceasing their advance.
unit.target: Egressus ex conclave precationis, flammae coccineae intus celeriter exstinctae sunt, iter suum cessantes.

unit.source: Inside the captain’s cabin, Pedro, spotting a handsome brown beard, grimaced as adventurer Louis Berry approached.
unit.target: In cubiculo capitani, Pedro, barbam pulchram brunneam agnoscens, vultum contraxit, dum adventor Ludovicus Berry appropinquabat.

unit.source: Experienced as he was, he knew that there might be trouble on the ship.
unit.target: Cum peritus esset, intellexit fore ut in nave quaedam difficultas existeret.

unit.source: During the School of God’s Descent incident, Adventurer Louis Berry had only dispatched a servant to explain matters.
unit.target: Durante casu Scholae Dei Descensionis, Ludovicus Berry adventor solum servum misit ad res explicandas.

unit.source: Now, here he was personally visiting!
unit.target: Nunc hic ipse visitare venit!

unit.source: What did this signify?
unit.target: Quid hoc significabat?

unit.source: It pointed to a more severe complication!
unit.target: Hoc ad graviorem complicationem demonstrabat!
