unit.source: Without awaiting the captain’s inquiry, Lumian calmly asserted, “Father Montserrat has succumbed, aligning himself with an evil deity. He likely colluded with the School of God’s Descension’s evil warlock.”
unit.target: Sine captanei quaestione exspectata, Lumian tranquille asserit: “Pater Montserrat cecidit, se cum deitate mala coniungens. Probabiliter cum mago malo Scholae Dei Descensionis coniunctus est.”

unit.source: Captain Pedro’s mind jolted as if struck by a rod, momentarily buzzing and going blank.
unit.target: Mens Capitani Pedri quasi baculo icta, momento vibrans atque vacua facta est.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he cautiously inquired, “Have you already killed him?”
unit.target: Post brevissimam pausam, caute interrogavit: “Iam eum occidistine?”

unit.source: “Not yet,” Lumian truthfully responded.
unit.target: «Nondum,» Lumian vere respondit.

unit.source: “He escaped the prayer room and is now in hiding.
unit.target: «E conclave precationis effugit et nunc se abscondit.»

unit.source: Dispatch a telegram promptly, reporting this to the Church of Earth Mother and the Feynapotter government.
unit.target: Mitte celeriter telegraphem, hoc referens Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et gubernationi Feynapotter.

unit.source: My servant will provide the details.
unit.target: Servus meus singula enarraret.

unit.source: In the face of Louis Berry’s authoritative directive, Captain Pedro yielded without resistance.
unit.target: Ob praeceptum auctoritatis Ludovici Berry, Capitaneus Pedro sine repugnatione cedit.

unit.source: He shifted his attention to Lugano, absorbing the account of his conversion and Father Montserrat’s description, cradling an invisible infant.
unit.target: Animadvertit ad Lugano, audiens narrationem conversionis suae atque descriptionem Patris Montserrat, qui infantem invisum complectebat.

unit.source: Upon hearing the revelation, Pedro wore a bitter expression and admitted, “I did sense something amiss with Father Montserrat, but I never anticipated it to be this grave.”
unit.target: Audita revelatione, Pedro vultum amarum habuit et confessus est: “Aliquid in Patre Montserrat male sentiebam, sed numquam id tam grave fore putavi.”

unit.source: “What’s the issue?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: «Quid accidit?» inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Pedro sighed, explaining, “He’s a Favored, a Beyonder of the Earth pathway, the most orthodox clergyman.
unit.target: Pedro suspiravit, explicans: “Ille est ‘Favored’, Beyonder viae Terrae, clericus orthodoxus summus.”

unit.source: Typically, he needs a Blessed’s help to conduct Mass, preach to believers, and guide others into the Church.
unit.target: Plerumque auxilium “Blessed” requirit ad Missam celebrandam, fideles praedicandos, et alios in Ecclesiam ducendos.

unit.source: However, he’s the only Favored on this ship without a Blessed.
unit.target: Attamen, ille solus Favored in hac nave est sine “Blessed.”

unit.source: “I initially thought the shortage of staff in Port Santa was due to the sea prayer ritual, so I didn’t pay much heed.
unit.target: Primum putavi carentiam operariorum in Port Santa propter ritu precationis maritimae esse, ideo parum attendebam.

unit.source: But now, with Father Montserrat’s fall…
unit.target: Sed nunc, cum casus Patris Montserrat…

unit.source: Only with the assistance of a Blessed can one conduct Mass and preach to believers.
unit.target: Solum cum auxilio “Blessed” Missa celebrari et fideles praedicari possunt.

unit.source: There’s no Blessed following him…
unit.target: Nullus “Blessed” eum sequitur…

unit.source: Lumian had previously learned that Favored of the Church of Earth Mother needs at least one second-in-command Blessed for their decisions to be considered valid.
unit.target: Lumian antea didicerat Favored Ecclesiae Matris Terrae saltem unum “Blessed” subimperatorem requirere, ut eorum decisiones validae esse possent.

unit.source: Otherwise, it risks being perceived as an influence of an evil god or a demon…
unit.target: Alioquin, periculum est ut influxus dei mali aut daemonis videatur…

unit.source: An evil god…
unit.target: Deus malus…

unit.source: That Great Mother?
unit.target: Illa Magna Mater?

unit.source: Wh… Combined with recent events and his prior knowledge, Lumian suddenly grasped why the Church of Earth Mother maintained two distinct systems—
unit.target: Ha... Coniunctis recentibus eventibus atque priore cognitione, Lumian subito intellexit cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae duas rationes distinguendas servaret—

unit.source: Blessed and Favored—rather than merging them.
unit.target: “Blessed” et “Favored” — potiūs quam coniuncti.

unit.source: Madam Magician of the Apprentice pathway had mentioned occasional influence from the Celestial Worthy, unsure if it was a revelation from Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Domina Magica viae Apprendentium memoraverat interdum influxum ex “Celestial Worthy”, incerta utrum revelatio a Domine Stulto esset.

unit.source: Similar to the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings overseeing the Apprentice, Seer, and Marauder pathways, the Great Mother likely stood atop the Planter, Apothecary, and Villain pathways.
unit.target: Similiter ac “Celestial Worthy” Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus, qui vias Apprendentium, Videntes, et Marauder regit, Magna Mater verisimiliter constitit in summo loco viarum Plantatorum, Apothecariorum, et Malefactorum.

unit.source: As a result, Favored Beyonders of the Planter and Apothecary pathways would also be under the influence of the Great Mother.
unit.target: Ex his, Favored Beyonders viarum Plantatorum et Apothecariorum quoque sub influentia Magnae Matris erunt.

unit.source: The origin of the revelation, whether from Earth Mother or the Great Mother, remained unclear.
unit.target: Origo revelationis, sive ex Matre Terrae sive ex Magnae Matre, incerta erat.

unit.source: Confirmation required the input of Blessed from pathways outside these two.
unit.target: Confirmatio postulebat inputum “Blessed” ex viis extra his duabus.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Blessed monitored the status of the Favored!
unit.target: Simul, “Blessed” statum Favored observabat!

unit.source: That explains it…
unit.target: Id explanat…

unit.source: Indeed, there’s a profound and serious reason behind this seemingly absurd, wasteful, and unreasonable system design, Lumian concluded.
unit.target: Revera, Lumian conclusit esse causam profundam et gravem huius consilii systematis, quod apparenter absurdum, vastum, atque iniustum est.

unit.source: Without further words, he instructed Captain Pedro, “Send the telegram.”
unit.target: Sine ulterioribus verbis, praecepit Capitani Pedri: “Mitte telegraphem.”

unit.source: After the captain relayed Father Montserrat’s situation to the Feynapotter government and the Church of Earth Mother, Lumian contemplated how to locate Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Postquam capitaneus rem Patris Montserrat ad gubernationem Feynapotter et Ecclesiam Matris Terrae nuntiavit, Lumian cogitavit quomodo Patrem Montserrat invenire posset.

unit.source: Considering the vast sea surrounding them, unless Father Montserrat possessed teleportation or exceptional underwater travel abilities, he could only be hiding somewhere on the ship.
unit.target: Considerans immensum mare eos circumdantem, nisi Pater Montserrat facultatem teleportandi aut subaquaticam proficiscendi praestaret, solum in navi se abscondere posset.

unit.source: Lumian dismissed the idea of involving his Major Arcana card holder for such a trivial issue and resolved to devise a solution himself.
unit.target: Lumian ideam includendi tenentem chartarum Major Arcana in re tam levi reiecit et decrevit se solum ad solutionem excogitandam incumbere.

unit.source: Could I use the ship’s megaphone to insult the Great Mother, provoking Father Montserrat to reveal himself?
unit.target: Possumne megaphonum navis ad Magnam Matrem deridendam adhibere, atque sic Patrem Montserrat provocare, ut se ostenderet?

unit.source: The challenge lies in the inability to lock onto a target, potentially yielding less-than-optimal results…
unit.target: Difficultas latet in incapacitate in metam fixandi, quae fortasse effectus minus optimos praebeat…

unit.source: Burning all the ship’s woodwork? Seems like a last resort due to the presence of valuable goods in wooden crates…
unit.target: Incendendo totum opus ligneum navis? Videtur ultimum consilium esse, propter praesentiam bonorum pretiosorum in arca ligneae…

unit.source: Borrowing a bottle of Prophetic Concoction from Franca?
unit.target: Mutuare amphoram “Prophetic Concoction” a Franca?

unit.source: It requires a fresh corpse.
unit.target: Exigit corpus recens.

unit.source: Additionally, if Franca is involved, I could get her to directly employ Magic Mirror Divination…
unit.target: Praeterea, si Franca implicabitur, eam possim persuadere ut Divinationem Speculi Magici directe adhibeat…

unit.source: Playing the Symphony of Hatred bone flute and informing passengers to cover their ears prior to that?
unit.target: Canendo symphoniam odii in fistula ossium et admonendo vectores ut aures suas tegeant ante hoc?

unit.source: But it only reduces damage without averting the effects…
unit.target: Sed id solum damnum minuere potest, nec vero consequentias avertit…

unit.source: Right, ask Ludwig if he recalls Father Montserrat’s small…
unit.target: Recte, roga Luidwigi si meminerit parva de Patre Montserrat…

unit.source: Also… Yes, I can give it a try!
unit.target: Etiam… Sic, id conari possum!

unit.source: Lumian quickly came up with several solutions and decided to systematically test each one, reserving seeking help as a final option.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter plura consilia excogitavit et decrevit singula systematice tentare, auxilium petendum in extremum optionem reservans.

unit.source: He bid farewell to the captain and, under the cover of night, led Lugano back to the first-class cabin suite.
unit.target: Valedixit capitanei et, sub tegmine noctis, Lugano ad conclave primae classe duxit.

unit.source: “Do you recall Father Montserrat’s scent?” Lumian inquired of Ludwig.
unit.target: «Meministine odorem Patris Montserrat?» inquit Lumian Luidwigo.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Luidwig caput quassavit.

unit.source: “No direct contact.”
unit.target: «Nullus directus commercium.»

unit.source: “Fair enough.” Lumian turned around, offering a reassuring smile to Lugano.
unit.target: «Satis est.» Lumian conversus est, et Lugano risum fiducialem obtulit.

unit.source: “I have an experiment in mind. Work with me.”
unit.target: «Experimentum habeo in mente. Mecum labora.»

unit.source: “What kind of experiment?” Lugano asked, a tremor of fear evident.
unit.target: «Quod genus experimenti?» inquit Lugano, timoris tremore evidente.

unit.source: Lumian gestured towards the window.
unit.target: Lumian ad fenestram digitum indicavit.

unit.source: “Go to the deck. It’s more open there.”
unit.target: «Vade ad pontem navis. Ibi apertius est.»

unit.source: Uneasily, Lugano descended to the deck, bathed in the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Lugano, inquietus, ad pontem navis descendit, in luce lunari coccinea illustratus.

unit.source: His employer pulled out a full-body silver armor from his Traveler’s Bag, revealing an inscrutable smile.
unit.target: Dominus eius, ex sacco viatoris, loricam argenteam totam extraxit, risum insciti ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian recalled the Pride Armor’s particular disdain for items from the Earth and Evernight pathways.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est fastidium singularem Loricae Superbiæ erga res ex viis Terrae et Evernight.

unit.source: What if it wasn’t an item but a Beyonder?
unit.target: Quid si non res esset, sed Beyonder?

unit.source: How would it react?
unit.target: Quomodo ageret?

unit.source: Could this hatred be harnessed to pinpoint Father Montserrat’s location, given he was at least a Doctor, at a certain distance?
unit.target: Potestne hoc odium adhiberi ut locum Patris Montserrat determinet, cum saltem doctor esset, ad aliquam distantiam?

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t entirely sure, but he intended to experiment with Lugano, a fellow Beyonder of the Earth pathway, to explore the possibilities.
unit.target: Lumian non prorsus certus erat, sed decrevit cum Lugano, congener Beyonder viae Terrae, experimentum facere ad possibilitates explorandas.

unit.source: 609 Useful Armor
unit.target: 609 Armatura Utilis

unit.source: Lumian shot a quick smile at Lugano and fixed his gaze on the Pride Armor, carefully observing its reaction.
unit.target: Lumian Lugano celeriter subridit et oculos in Armaturam Superbiae defixit, reactionem eius diligenter observans.

unit.source: “What experiment? To test the effects of this armor?” Lugano questioned, a mix of apprehension and confusion in his voice.
unit.target: “Quid experimentum? Ad experimentandum effectus huius armaturae?” interrogavit Lugano, voce sollicita et confusa.

unit.source: As soon as he finished speaking, the air on the dark deck, bathed in the crimson moonlight, suddenly solidified.
unit.target: Statim postquam locutus est, aer in obscuro ponte, lumine rubro lunae immersus, subito solidificatus est.

unit.source: In the next instant, the empty armor produced a radiant broadsword, and an unseen force locked onto Lugano.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, armatura vacua gladium radiantem produxit, et vis invisibilis ad Lugano se adligavit.

unit.source: Wh… Before Lugano could react, the silver-white full-body armor surged forward, the gleaming broadsword poised to strike.
unit.target: Heu… Priusquam Lugano responderet, armatura totius corporis argenteo-alba surrexit, gladium radiante ad ictum paratum.

unit.source: In a split second, Lumian positioned himself in front of Lugano.
unit.target: In momento brevissimo, Lumian coram Lugano se posuit.

unit.source: His body expanded abruptly, almost tearing his linen shirt and black pants.
unit.target: Corpus eius repente dilatatum est, paene tunicam linteam et bracas negras lacerans.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: Lumian’s massive fist collided with the Sword of Dawn, creating a metallic clang that resonated through the air.
unit.target: Magnus pugnus Lumiani cum Gladio Auroris concurrit, creando clangorem metallicum per aerem resonantem.

unit.source: Only then did Lugano shake off his bewilderment.
unit.target: Tum demum Lugano stuporem suum delevit.

unit.source: Though unsure why the empty armor attacked him, he instinctively turned and sprinted away.
unit.target: Quamquam nescius erat cur armatura vacua eum oppugnarit, se instanter vertit et festinanter fugit.

unit.source: After covering some ground, the Pride Armor halted and stood silently.
unit.target: Post viam aliquantam percursam, Armatura Superbiae subsedit et silentiose stetit.

unit.source: The Sword of Dawn, fashioned from light, dissipated, turning into beams of light that dispersed the crimson moonlight, casting a dawn-like ambiance upon the dark deck.
unit.target: Gladius Auroris, ex luce factus, evanuit, in radios lucis transmutatus, qui lumen rubrum lunae dispergebant atque ambitum aurorae similem super obscuram pontem iaciebant.

unit.source: This sensation vanished in the blink of an eye.
unit.target: Haec sensatio in ictu oculi evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian, not daring to turn his back on the Pride Armor, repositioned himself and gauged the distance between the armor and Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian, non audens terga convertere ad Armaturam Superbiae, se iterum posuit et distantiam inter armaturam et Lugano metitus est.

unit.source: About 20 meters… factoring in Lugano’s running speed, the sensing range is approximately 15 meters… Lumian swiftly concluded.
unit.target: Circa viginti metra… consideratis celeritate Luganoi currentis, spatium sensuum fere quindecim metris esse censitum est… Lumian celeriter conclusit.

unit.source: His body reverted to its original form, and a confident smile returned to his face.
unit.target: Corpus eius ad formam originalem rediit, et risus fidus in facie eius rediit.

unit.source: It was enough. A fifteen-meter range sufficed on the ship!
unit.target: Satis erat. Ambitus quindecim metrorum in nave suffecit!

unit.source: He stowed away the Pride Armor and addressed Lugano, who was still making his way to the bow, “The experiment is over.”
unit.target: Armaturam Superbiae recondidit et Lugano adloquitur, qui adhuc ad proram navigii se ferebat, “Experimentum finitum est.”

unit.source: Huh? Lugano came to a sudden halt, realizing that Lumian had already stashed the peculiar silver-white full-body armor back into the mystical item cleverly disguised as a coin bag.
unit.target: Heu? Lugano subito subsistit, intellegens Lumian iam pecularem armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam in rem mysticam, callide simulatam ut sacculum nummorum, reconditam esse.

unit.source: Relieved, he jogged back, curiosity etched on his face as he inquired, “Did the experiment succeed?”
unit.target: Levatus, rediit currendo, vultu curiositate notato, interrogans, “Experimentum successitne?”

unit.source: “Very successful,” Lumian replied, sporting a radiant smile.
unit.target: “Valde prosperum,” respondit Lumian, subridens radiante.

unit.source: Though Lugano didn’t grasp the experiment’s significance, he had a hunch that Lumian might be exploring a way to locate Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Quamquam Lugano significationem experimenti non perspexit, innuit Lumian viam quaerendi Patrem Montserrat esse.

unit.source: Upon reaching the first-class suite, Lumian promptly instructed Lugano, “Go to the captain and ask him to gather all the Beyonders of the Earth pathway on the ship. Oh, and the Beyonders of the Apothecary pathway. I’ll be back after capturing Father Montserrat. It doesn’t matter if they don’t show up. They’ll bear the risk themselves.”
unit.target: Ad conclave primae classe, Lumian statim Lugano instruxit: “Ad capitaneum vade et roga eum ut omnes Beyonders semitae Terrae in nave congreget. Et etiam Beyonders semitae Apothecarii. Redebo post Patrem Montserrat ceperim. Nihil refert, si non appareant. Ipsi periculum ferent.”

unit.source: Unsure if Captain Pedro was aware of every unstable element on the ship and every Beyonder, Lumian planned to monitor the Pride Armor later to prevent it from targeting hidden wild Beyonders.
unit.target: Nescius an Capitanus Pedro de omnibus instabilibus elementis in nave et omni Beyonder conscius esset, Lumian consilium cepit postea Armaturam Superbiae vigilandum esse, ne Beyonders feros occulti oppigerent.

unit.source: Allowing Pedro to handle this process first would lighten his load.
unit.target: Permittens Petro hunc processum primum curare, onus eius levabitur.

unit.source: As Lugano left the suite, Lumian turned to Ludwig, who had resumed his meal.
unit.target: Dum Lugano conclave reliquit, Lumian ad Ludwig conversus est, qui cibum suum iterum capiebat.

unit.source: “Keep an eye out later and see if there’s any ‘food’ secretly lurking here.”
unit.target: “Postea exspice et vide, utrum quidam ‘cibus’ hic occulte lateat.”

unit.source: Ludwig, mouth full of cake, signaled his agreement.
unit.target: Ludwig, ore pleno placentae, consensum suum indicavit.

unit.source: Waiting for the captain’s arrival, Lumian patrolled the cabin’s top floor with the Pride Armor in his arms, but Father Montserrat remained elusive.
unit.target: Captani adventum exspectans, Lumian summum tabulatum cellae pervagatus est, cum Armaturam Superbiae in brachiis, sed Pater Montserrat manebat elusivus.

unit.source: Before long, Pedro entered the suite with the suspected security supervisor and a passenger in a low hat.
unit.target: Mox, Pedro conclave intravit cum suspecto praefecto securitatis et viatore galea humilem gestante.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t delve into details and gestured toward the sofa.
unit.target: Lumian non in subtilitates intravit et ad sofa signum dedit.

unit.source: “Wait for me here.”
unit.target: “Exspecta me hic.”

unit.source: Without waiting for a response, he pressed down on his golden straw hat and exited the room.
unit.target: Nullo responsum expectans, pileum aureum stramineum deprimens, conclave egreditur.

unit.source: Upon reaching the staircase, Lumian “pulled” out his silver-white full-body armor.
unit.target: Ad scalas perveniens, Lumian armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam extraxit.

unit.source: Gripping the Sealed Artifact’s armpits firmly with both hands, he methodically patrolled each level of the cabin.
unit.target: Utrisque manibus axillas Artifacti Sigillati firme prehendens, methodice singulos gradus cellae pervagatus est.

unit.source: Whenever he approached a distance less than 15 meters from his suite, Lumian exercised extra caution, yet the Pride Armor refrained from attacking anyone.
unit.target: Quotienscumque ad distantiam minus quam quindecim metra a sua suite appropinquaret, Lumian cautelam additam adhibebat, sed Armatura Superbiae a quolibet oppugnare cessavit.

unit.source: Could it be that, beyond five meters and with several layers of obstruction, the armor wouldn’t exhibit any additional reactions?
unit.target: Num ita sit, ultra quinque metra et cum pluribus impedimentis, ut armatura nullas reactiones additas ostenderet?

unit.source: Lumian speculated as he descended floor by floor.
unit.target: Lumian speculavit dum gradatim de tabulato descendebat.

unit.source: After nearly half an hour, he descended to the cargo cabin at the bottom.
unit.target: Post fere dimidiam horam, ad cellam sarcinarum in fundo descendit.

unit.source: Before maneuvering past stacks of wooden crates, the Pride Armor in Lumian’s grasp suddenly quivered, breaking free from his control.
unit.target: Priusquam inter acervos cistorum ligneorum se movere posset, Armatura Superbiae in manibus Lumiani repente tremuit, a potestate eius evadens.

unit.source: The silver-white full-body armor morphed a radiant broadsword.
unit.target: Armatura totius corporis argenteo-alba in gladium radiantem mutata est.

unit.source: Advancing in two strides, it swung at a wooden box tucked in the corner.
unit.target: Duobus passibus progrediens, percussit arcam ligneam in angulo absconditam.

unit.source: With a resounding clang, the wooden box splintered, and a handful of steel ingots spilled out.
unit.target: Magno clangore resonante, arca lignea scissa est, et copia ingotorum ferreorum effusa est.

unit.source: At the same moment, Montserrat’s clean, youthful visage emerged from the broken box, materializing his entire body.
unit.target: Eodem momento, vultus mundus et iuvenilis Montserrat e arca fracta emersit, corpus totum suum manifestans.

unit.source: Confronted by the gleaming broadsword of light once more, the priest’s initially sturdy frame bulked up, as if transforming into a formidable brown bear.
unit.target: Confrontatus iterum gladio lucis radiantis, corpus sacerdotis, quod initio robustum erat, expandit, quasi in ursum brunneum formidolosum transformaretur.

unit.source: Bang! With a powerful palm strike, he sent the Sword of Dawn hurtling, landing atop a wooden crate of goods behind him.
unit.target: Bang! Potenti ictu palmae, Gladius Auroris deiectus est, super arcam ligneam mercium post eum cecidens.

unit.source: This strength rivaled that of a true giant bear!
unit.target: Haec vis ursi veri gigantis aequipollens erat!

unit.source: As Father Montserrat skillfully parried the Pride Armor’s onslaught, Lumian, donned in a linen shirt, black vest, and a golden straw hat, materialized swiftly beside a stack of wooden crates behind him.
unit.target: Dum Pater Montserrat arte impetum Armaturae Superbiae paravit, Lumian, indutus tunica lintea, vestimento nigro et pileo aureo stramineo, celeriter apparuit iuxta acervum cistorum ligneorum post eum.

unit.source: “Hmph!”
unit.target: “Hmph!”

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot from Lumian’s nostrils, hitting Father Montserrat before he could even react.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naribus Luminis emerserunt, percutientes Patrem Montserrat, antequam responderet.

unit.source: Instantly, the priest’s gaze lost focus, and he crumpled to the ground, unconscious.
unit.target: Statim, oculus sacerdotis evanuit, et in terram corruit, inconscus.

unit.source: With this turn of events, vitality surged through his body like a steam engine operating at full throttle.
unit.target: His rebus, vitalitas per corpus eius efflata est, sicut machina vaporis in plenam potentiam operans.

unit.source: The robust vitality manifested as an incredibly potent self-healing ability, swiftly restoring Father Montserrat’s spirit.
unit.target: Vitalitas robusta se manifestavit ut facultas sui sanationis incredibiliter potentis, celeriter spiritum Patris Montserrat restituit.

unit.source: The Spell of Harrumph bore a resemblance to Psychic Piercing, both targeting the Spirit Body and proving challenging to defend against.
unit.target: Incantatio Harrumph similis erat Percutio Psychica, quae utrumque corpus spiritale petens et defensionem difficilem praebens erat.

unit.source: However, while the latter induced uncontrollable pain, trapping the target, the former added a sleep-inducing or unconscious state to the Spirit Body—a different form of harm.
unit.target: Attamen, dum ultima dolorem incontrolabilem inducens scopa capiebat, prima vero statum soporiferum vel inconscientem corporis spiritalis addidit—forma diversa laesionis.

unit.source: Since it was an injury, it could be healed.
unit.target: Cum vulneratio esset, sanari poterat.

unit.source: Empowered by the vigorous vitality’s transformation, Father Montserrat’s closed eyelids twitched as his eyeballs moved beneath them.
unit.target: Impulsus transformatione vitalitatis vigoris, palpebra clausa Patris Montserrat concitatae sunt, dum oculi eius sub ipsis moverentur.

unit.source: He nearly woke up before hitting the ground!
unit.target: Paene evigilavit antequam terram attingeret!

unit.source: Yet, for Lumian, a mere second of restraint from the Spell of Harrumph was sufficient.
unit.target: Sed pro Lumiano, tantum unius momenti retinentia a Incantatione Harrumph suffecit.

unit.source: Considering that Father Montserrat might also be a product of human refinement, some abilities might not be effective.
unit.target: Considerans quod Pater Montserrat etiam ex cultu humano factum esse possit, quaedam facultates fortasse non efficaciter operabuntur.

unit.source: Lumian lunged at him, extending his right hand.
unit.target: Lumian ad eum impetum fecit, dextram manum protendens.

unit.source: In his open palm, crimson flames coiled and compressed, forming a solid-looking sphere.
unit.target: In palma aperta eius, flammas rubras convolutae et compressae sunt, quae sphaeram solidam speciei formabant.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the Pride Armor raised the Sword of Dawn once more.
unit.target: Simul, Armatura Superbiae iterum Gladium Auroris elevavit.

unit.source: Just as Father Montserrat opened his eyes and instinctively regained balance, he caught sight of Louis Berry’s jade-green eyes, the dangerous crimson fireball almost white, and the broadsword of light slashing toward his head from the corner of his vision.
unit.target: Modo quod Pater Montserrat oculos aperuisset et instanter aequilibrium recuperasset, vidit oculos Louis Berry virides sicut iaspideos, globulum ignis rubri periculosum, paene album, et gladium lucis, qui ab angulo visionis ad caput eius stridens accedebat.

unit.source: With only a moment to react, he twisted to the side to evade the Sword of Dawn, but Lumian pressed the crimson, nearly white fireball against him.
unit.target: Unius momenti ad reactum, se ad latus vertit ut Gladium Auroris evaderet, sed Lumian globulum ignis rubri, paene album, contra eum pressit.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: In a resounding explosion, Father Montserrat was sent hurtling through the air.
unit.target: In clamorosa explosione, Pater Montserrat per aerem impellitus est.

unit.source: Flesh and blood erupted from his right shoulder to his abdomen, bones fractured, and squirming internal organs were laid bare.
unit.target: Caro et sanguis e humero dextro ad abdominis partem eruptae sunt, ossa fracta sunt, atque viscera interna, quasi motantia, patefacta sunt.

unit.source: His right arm dangled, on the verge of detachment.
unit.target: Brachium dextum eius pendebat, abscissioni adpropinquans.

unit.source: Yet, the robust vitality within Father Montserrat persisted. Flesh and blood wriggled within the gaping wound, miraculously healing.
unit.target: Attamen, robusta vitalitas in Patre Montserrat persistit. Caro et sanguis in vulnere ingenti contorquebantur, mirabiliter sanantes.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Thud!

unit.source: Father Montserrat crashed to the ground, accompanied by the heavy footsteps of the Pride Armor and the luminous slash of the broadsword.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat in terram corruit, comitatus gravibus vestigiis Armaturae Superbiae et fulgenti ictu gladii lucis.

unit.source: Lifting his finger, the blood and flesh expelled from his body during the explosion swiftly coalesced, transforming into a blurry, thin blood-colored figure.
unit.target: Digitum levans, sanguis et caro ab corpore eius durante explosione celeriter coalescebant, transformantes in figuram tenui, nebulosam, sanguine colore tinctam.

unit.source: This figure lunged at the silver-white full-body armor, enveloping it and infiltrating its form.
unit.target: Haec figura ad armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam impetum fecit, eam amplectens et in formam eius infiltrans.

unit.source: Abruptly, the cargo hold was bathed in Sunrise Gleam. The blood-colored figure dissolved, gradually fading away.
unit.target: Subito, cella sarcinarum Splendore Aurorae inundata est. Figura sanguine colore tincta dissoluta est, paulatim evanescens.

unit.source: The Sunrise Gleam was gentle, sparing Father Montserrat the instinctive need to shut his eyes. Consequently, his gaze reflected crimson, nearly white flaming ravens.
unit.target: Splendor Aurorae mitis erat, Patrem Montserrat a necessitate instinctiva oculos claudendi liberans. Consequenter, aspectus eius corvos rubro, paene album, flammantes repraesentabat.

unit.source: A dozen or so Fire Ravens circled Lumian, who casually kept one hand in his pocket.
unit.target: Circiter duodecim corvi ignis circa Luminum volitabant, qui leviter unam manum in sinum tenebat.

unit.source: Their eyes fixed on Montserrat, tracing distinct trajectories as they soared.
unit.target: Oculi eorum in Montserrat incumbebant, trajectorias diversas delineantes dum volitabant.

unit.source: Their aim was clear—to shred the target’s body and set each piece of flesh ablaze, preventing recovery even with his potent self-healing abilities.
unit.target: Propositum eorum manifestum erat—corpus scopum scindere et singulae particulae carnis incendere, ne regeneratio quidem fieret, etiamsi potentissima facultas sui sanationis esset.

unit.source: When each fragment was spaced 20 to 30 centimeters apart, their self-healing powers struggled to reunite them!
unit.target: Cum singula fragmenta inter se spatia 20 ad 30 centimetra habebant, potentiae sui sanationis eos congregare vix poterant!

unit.source: This wasn’t flesh and blood magic!
unit.target: Haec non erat magia carnis et sanguinis!

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s pupils dilated, and his mouth instinctively opened, emitting a sinister yet intimate voice.
unit.target: Pupillae Patris Montserrat dilatatae sunt, et os eius instinctive aperuit, vocem sinistram sed intimam edens.

unit.source: With the accompanying voice, a dense darkness descended, and wheat‐filled weeds sprouted, devouring the Sunrise Gleam that bathed the warehouse.
unit.target: Cum voce comitante, densus tenebrae descendit, et herbae, triticeis plenae, germinabant, devorantes Splendorem Aurorae, quod horreum inundabat.

unit.source: In the darkness, some of the crimson, nearly white Fire Ravens lost their way, unable to traverse the “distant” space. Gradually, they dissipated—only a fraction successfully reaching Father Montserrat.
unit.target: In tenebris, nonnulli corvi ignis rubri, paene albi, viam amiserunt, neque spatio remotum transire potuerunt. Paulatim dissipaverunt—tantum fractio feliciter ad Patrem Montserrat perveniens.

unit.source: Amidst thunderous explosions, Father Montserrat’s form turned translucent, giving rise to a colossal illusory oak tree in its place.
unit.target: Inter tonitruosas explosiones, forma Patris Montserrat translucida facta est, et loco eius ingens quercus illusorius ortus est.

unit.source: The oak tree stood unscathed amid the explosion and flames, and amidst the aftermath, the mangled form of Father Montserrat materialized on a branch adorned with mistletoe. He cradled his arms, as if holding an invisible infant.
unit.target: Quercus illusorius, in medio explosionis et flammarum, intactus stetit, et inter reliquias, forma laniata Patris Montserrat in ramo, visco ornato, apparuit. Brachia sua fovebat, quasi infantem invisibilem amplectens.

unit.source: Gazing at Lumian, he wore a genuine smile.
unit.target: Ad Luminum spectans, verum risum gerebat.

unit.source: So you’re not a demigod…
unit.target: Ergo non es semideus…

unit.source: “Waaa!”
unit.target: “Waaa!”

unit.source: For the first time, Lumian heard the ethereal, hollow cry of the baby.
unit.target: Primum, Lumian auscultavit vocem aetheriam, cavum infantis.

unit.source: “Wah wah wah!”
unit.target: “Wah wah wah!”

unit.source: Amidst the relentless cries, Lumian felt his vitality draining away. Gradually weakening, even his consciousness began to waver.
unit.target: Inter incessantes clamores, Lumian sensit vitalitatem suam defluere. Paulatim infirmatus, etiam conscientia eius vacillare coepit.

unit.source: The depleted vitality seemed to flow towards the invisible baby in Father Montserrat’s embrace, transforming into its nourishment.
unit.target: Vitalitas exhausta videbatur fluere ad infantem invisibilem in amplexu Patris Montserrat, in eius nutrimentum transformans.

unit.source: 610 “New Life”
unit.target: 610 “Nova Vita”

unit.source: In the face of the infant’s cries, which gradually weakened him, Lumian teleported immediately to Father Montserrat’s side, launching a powerful attack to disrupt the impending impact.
unit.target: In facie infantilis gemitus, qui eum paulatim debilitabat, Lumian statim ad latus Patris Montserrat se translocavit, impetum validum iniiciens ut imminentem ictum perturbaret.

unit.source: Yet, in that very moment, he observed the Pride Armor freezing in place upon hearing the infant’s cry.
unit.target: Sed in eo ipso momento animadvertit Armaturam Superbiam in loco immobilitasse, audito infantis gemitu.

unit.source: Suddenly, it crouched down and plunged the Sword of Dawn into the ground covered in dark weeds.
unit.target: Subito, ea se incurvavit et Gladium Aurorae in terram, herbis obscurissimis opertam, infigit.

unit.source: Dammit! Directly employing Hurricane of Light?
unit.target: Per deos! Num directe "Turbo Lucis" adhibetur?

unit.source: Lumian’s scalp tingled.
unit.target: Vertex Lumiani formicationem sensit.

unit.source: Without bothering to confirm, he shifted the teleportation destination, vanishing into the darkness of the illusory oak tree, and reappeared on the ship’s deck.
unit.target: Ne confirmans solertia, metam translocationis mutavit, evanescens in obscuritate quercus illusoriae, et in tabulato navis reapparuit.

unit.source: He had long recognized that Father Montserrat’s weed wilderness was inferior to the Madames’ Paramita.
unit.target: Diu intellexerat solitudinem herbarum Patris Montserrat inferior esse quam Paramita Madamarum.

unit.source: It failed to sever the deep connection between the inside and outside, nor could it prevent teleportation.
unit.target: Illud non potuit disiungere nexum profundum inter intus et foris, nec translationem prohibere.

unit.source: Its sole capability was restraining various sounds and the aftermath of battle, akin to the Bottle of Fiction, if not less.
unit.target: Unica eius facultas erat varias sonos atque eventus belli cohibere, instar Lagenae Fictae, si non minus.

unit.source: Nonetheless, this wilderness had unique abilities.
unit.target: Attamen, haec solitudo facultates singulares habebat.

unit.source: As Lumian’s figure faded into the dark wilderness, the Sword of Dawn embedded in the ground by the Pride Armor shattered, transforming into countless light fragments, creating a formidable storm that engulfed the area.
unit.target: Dum figura Lumiani in solitudinem obscuram evanuit, Gladius Aurorae, a Armatura Superbiam in terram infigta, fractus est et in innumeros fragmenta lucis conversus, tempestatem formidabilem creans quae locum totum comprehendit.

unit.source: The plump wheat-filled weeds were sliced into pieces, leaving the ground barren.
unit.target: Herbae pingues, triticeo repletes, in frusta secatae sunt, terram inanitam relinquentes.

unit.source: Father Montserrat, perched on the oak branch, couldn’t dodge in time.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, super ramum quercus insidens, tempore vitare non potuit.

unit.source: He only managed to manifest his body into something resembling wood before being consumed by the Hurricane of Light.
unit.target: Tantum potuit corpus suum in formam ligni transformare, antequam a Turbo Lucis devoraretur.

unit.source: The illusory, hollow cry of a baby abruptly ceased.
unit.target: Clamor infantis, illusorius et cavus, repente cessavit.

unit.source: When the Hurricane of Light subsided, Father Montserrat stood frozen in place.
unit.target: Cum Turbo Lucis quietus factus est, Pater Montserrat in loco congelatus stetit.

unit.source: In the next moment, his wood-like body, covered in brown bark, split open, revealing deep crevices.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, corpus eius, quasi ligni, cortice fusco opertum, scissum est, revelans profundas fissuras.

unit.source: Pa, pa, pa. Father Montserrat’s body fell to the bottom of the oak tree, piece by piece.
unit.target: Pa, pa, pa. Corpus Patris Montserrat singulis partibus in imum quercus cecidit.

unit.source: The incisions were smooth, and blood seeped out.
unit.target: Incisiones lenes erant, et sanguis effluere coepit.

unit.source: Flesh and blood were instantly absorbed by the illusory oak tree’s roots, leaving nothing behind.
unit.target: Caro et sanguis statim radicibus quercus illusoriae absorpti sunt, nihil relinquentes.

unit.source: In the middle section of the oak tree, the bark split open.
unit.target: In media parte quercus, cortex scissum est.

unit.source: Squirming, moist flesh grew out, expanding into a hole.
unit.target: Caro umida, se contorquens, exorta est, in cavum expandens.

unit.source: A human head appeared, squeezed and ejected.
unit.target: Caput humanum apparuit, compressum et eiectum.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the naked human was “born” by the illusory oak tree. It was Father Montserrat.
unit.target: In momento oculi, nudus homo a quercu illusorio "natus" est. Erat Pater Montserrat.

unit.source: He retained his adult form, his body wet and partially covered in a dirty, translucent white membrane.
unit.target: Adultam formam retinuit; corpus eius madidum erat et partim membrana alba, sordida et translucida, opertum habebat.

unit.source: New life!
unit.target: Nova vita!

unit.source: With the aid of the weed-covered darkness, the illusionary oak tree, and the invisible baby, Father Montserrat found a new lease of life!
unit.target: Auxilio obscuritatis herbis opertae, quercus illusoriae, et infantuli invisibilis, Pater Montserrat novam vitam invenit!

unit.source: His brow smoothed, and his eyes regained a youthful gleam.
unit.target: Frontales rugis levatae sunt, et oculi eius nitorem iuvenilem recuperaverunt.

unit.source: Enormous bat-like wings, shrouded in dark skin, erupted from his back, propelling him from the heart of the colossal oak to his silver-white full-body armor.
unit.target: Alae ingentes, similes vespertilionum, tegmine cute obscura circumdactae, ex dorso eius eruperunt, impellentes eum ab corde quercus ingentis ad loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam.

unit.source: The Pride Armor rose, summoning light into its hand, forging a sharp spear.
unit.target: Armatura Superbia surrexit, lucem in manum evocans, hastam acutam fingens.

unit.source: Launching the elongated lance with relentless force, it sliced through the air, embedding into Father Montserrat’s chest.
unit.target: Lancea elongata cum vi inexori proiecta, per aerem secunda, in pectore Patris Montserrat infigitur.

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s bat-like wings enveloped him, and his form shattered into palm-sized black bats.
unit.target: Alae Patris Montserrat, similes vespertilionum, eum complectebant, et forma eius in vespertiliones nigros, manudoris magnitudinis, scissa est.

unit.source: In a mesmerizing dance, the bats circled behind the Pride Armor, reforming into Father Montserrat, adorned with a grimy membrane.
unit.target: In choro incantatore, vespertiliones post Armaturam Superbiam circumvolitabant, se iterum in Patrem Montserrat reformantes, membrana sordida ornati.

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s body expanded, morphing into a colossal bear.
unit.target: Corpus Patris Montserrat ampliatum est, in ursam colossalem mutatum.

unit.source: From his palms sprouted sharp claws etched with enigmatic patterns.
unit.target: Ex palmis eius ungues acuti, figuris arcani inscripti, exortae sunt.

unit.source: With a forceful swipe, he etched five deep gouges onto the Pride Armor’s back, unveiling its hollow interior.
unit.target: Vi ictu impetuoso, quinque fossas profundas in dorso Armaturae Superbiae incisit, interiora eius cava revelans.

unit.source: The Pride Armor froze, and the air itself seemed to still.
unit.target: Armatura Superbia congelata est, et aer ipse immobilis videbatur.

unit.source: Before Father Montserrat could launch another assault, he noticed the silver-white full-body armor pivoting without warning.
unit.target: Antequam Pater Montserrat aliam impetum iniicere posset, animadvertit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam sine praemonitione verti.

unit.source: Condensing hammers, axes, and flails made of light, it slashed at Father Montserrat frenziedly.
unit.target: Malleos, securis, et verbera ex luce facta condensans, furiose in Patrem Montserrat percussit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat lowered himself, shrinking to the cleared ground, inching towards the illusionary oak tree.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat se deiecit, in terram expurgatam minuens, ad quercum illusoriam paulatim accedens.

unit.source: The ground beneath him caved, forming a rift.
unit.target: Terra sub eo conflavit, fissuram formans.

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian, sensing the end of the Hurricane of Light, teleported back into the darkness.
unit.target: In eo momento, Lumian, finem Turbo Lucis sentiens, se in tenebras revera translocavit.

unit.source: To his surprise, Father Montserrat stood unscathed, devoid of the brown priest’s attire.
unit.target: Ad mirationem eius, Pater Montserrat integerrimus stetit, vestimenta sacerdotalia fusca abest.

unit.source: Undeterred, Lumian retrieved the Symphony of Hatred bone flute from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Intrepidus, Lumian symphoniam odii tibiae ossium ex sacculo viatoris recepit.

unit.source: Seizing the moment while the Pride Armor entangled Father Montserrat, preventing the transmission of sound to the outside world, Lumian aimed to play a melody learned from Port Santa’s various celebrations—composed by a Church of Earth Mother Saint for a bountiful harvest.
unit.target: Carpendo momentum dum Armatura Superbia Patrem Montserrat implicabat, impediens sonum transmitti ad mundum externum, Lumian intenderat melodiam canere, quam ex variis celebrationibus Portus Santae didicerat—compositam ab Ecclesia Sanctae Matris Terrae pro copia messis.

unit.source: Typically, Lumian would don the Flog boxing gloves, “teleport” closer, stimulate some desire or emotion in Father Montserrat through a punch, and then play the Symphony of Hatred to trigger Flog’s aftereffects.
unit.target: Typice, Lumian braccas pugilatas Flog indueret, propius se translocans, aliquod desiderium aut affectum in Patre Montserrat per ictum excitans, atque deinde Symphoniam Odii canebat ad effectus posteros Flog excitandos.

unit.source: However, Lumian abandoned this well-practiced routine.
unit.target: Tamen, Lumian hanc praeclaram consuetudinem deseruit.

unit.source: The peculiar illusionary oak tree on the battlefield gave him pause.
unit.target: Quercus illusoria peculiaris in campo proelii eum detinuit.

unit.source: Father Montserrat had carried an invisible baby, possibly a Child of God.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat infans invisibilis portaverat, fortasse puer Dei.

unit.source: Wearing the Flog boxing gloves could attract attention and danger.
unit.target: Indutio braccarum pugilatarum Flog attentionem et periculum allicere poterat.

unit.source: If the Great Mother perceived it and allowed the Child of God to breach the illusory-reality barrier to confront him, the consequences would be dire!
unit.target: Si Magna Mater id percepisset et Puer Dei sinisset fines inter illusam et veram realitatem transgredi ut eum oppugnarent, consequentiae terribiles futuros essent!

unit.source: Moreover, Lumian suspected that heretics like Montserrat harbored evident psychological issues, making their mental states unpredictable.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian suspicabatur haereticos similes Montserrat claras quaestiones psychologicas gerere, quae statum eorum mentis incertum facerent.

unit.source: Playing the Symphony of Hatred directly could exploit this vulnerability, much like how he and Mr. K detested hearing others play the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Symphoniam Odii directe canere hanc infirmitatem expropriare poterat, sicut quomodo ipse et Dominus K alios canentes Symphoniam Odii undique fastidiebant.

unit.source: Uncertain about which weakness might be triggered or the ensuing changes, Lumian planned to roll with the uncertainties.
unit.target: Nescientes quam debilitas excitanda esset aut quae mutationes subsequentes fieri, Lumian consilium cepit incertitudinibus adsequi.

unit.source: Just as Lumian raised the Symphony of Hatred to his lips, an eerie chill crawled down his spine.
unit.target: Iam ut Lumian Symphoniam Odii ad labia levavit, frigoris insoliti formido per spinam eius serpens descendit.

unit.source: “Waaa!”
unit.target: “Waaa!”

unit.source: The spectral baby’s cries reverberated, mere inches from him.
unit.target: Clamores infantis phantasmatici resonaverunt, non multos pollices a eo distantibus.

unit.source: “Hehe, hehe.”
unit.target: “Hehe, hehe.”

unit.source: The baby’s cries morphed into laughter, as if engaged in an intriguing game with Lumian.
unit.target: Clamores infantis in risum mutati sunt, quasi cum Lumiano in ludo intriganti versarentur.

unit.source: An inexplicable stiffness gripped Lumian, freezing him momentarily.
unit.target: Rigiditas inexplicabilis Lumiani complevit, eum paulisper congelans.

unit.source: A cold aura infiltrated his body, spreading gradually to his abdomen.
unit.target: Aura frigida in corpus eius penetravit, paulatim ad abdominis regionem diffundens.

unit.source: As his life began to ebb away, merging with the cold aura, the baby in his ear oscillated between mournful wails and gleeful laughter.
unit.target: Dum vita eius defluere inchoabat, cum aura frigida coniungebatur, infans in aurā eius inter lugubria lamenta et hilarum risum oscillabat.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian plunged his consciousness into his right hand, activating Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s residual brand.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian conscientiam suam in dextram manum immergit, residuum sigillum Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor excitans.

unit.source: A violent and frenzied aura erupted from Lumian, enlarging him without relying on his Compression strength.
unit.target: Aura violenta et furibunda a Lumiano erupit, eum amplificans sine spe virtutis compressionis.

unit.source: Tangible bloodlust filled the air.
unit.target: Tangibilis cupiditas sanguinis aerem replevit.

unit.source: The invisible baby’s cries and laughter abruptly ceased, and the coldness invading Lumian’s body dissipated under the searing sensation.
unit.target: Clamores et risus infantis invisibilis repente cessaverunt, et frigora, quae corpus Lumiani invaserant, sub sensu ardenti evanuerunt.

unit.source: The dark wilderness swayed, casting a faint glow.
unit.target: Solitudo obscura oscillabat, tenui luce fulgens.

unit.source: Lumian, in control, terminated the activation and blew into the black bone flute with blood-colored holes.
unit.target: Lumian, moderans, activationem finivit et in tibiam ossis nigram cum foraminibus sanguine coloratis sufflavit.

unit.source: A noticeably jubilant melody echoed, stunning Father Montserrat locked in battle with the Pride Armor.
unit.target: Melodia evidenter laeta resonavit, stupefacens Patrem Montserrat in proelio cum Armatura Superbiam constringentem.

unit.source: His face twisted in indescribable agony.
unit.target: Vultus eius in dolore ineffabili contorti est.

unit.source: Witnessing the silver armor wielding a staff of condensed light, Father Montserrat instinctively reached out, pointing at the adversary’s feet.
unit.target: Videns loricam argenteam baculo lucis condensatae ferre, Pater Montserrat instinctive manum extendit, ad pedes adversarii intendens.

unit.source: Countless vines, weeds, and tree branches sprouted rapidly, entwining the Pride Armor and impeding its movements.
unit.target: Innumerabiles vinae, herbae, et rami arborum celeriter exortae sunt, Armaturam Superbiam implicantes et motus eius impeditantes.

unit.source: Amidst the cacophony of crashing branches and tearing vines, the Pride Armor advanced laboriously, slowed by the entanglement.
unit.target: Inter strepitum rami confractarii et ramorum laniantium, Armatura Superbia labore prosequebatur, intricamento retardata.

unit.source: Father Montserrat locked eyes with Lumian and, in a pained plea, shouted,
unit.target: Pater Montserrat oculos cum Lumiano coniunxit et, suppliciter doleo, exclamavit,

unit.source: “Run!
unit.target: “Fuge!

unit.source: “The Child of God can’t be killed!”
unit.target: “Puer Dei interficiri non potest!”

unit.source: Run? Wh… Lumian realized Father Montserrat seemed more grounded than before. The warmth in his gaze, the familiarity of home, replaced by agony and conflict.
unit.target: Fuge? Quid... Lumian animadvertit Patrem Montserrat magis terrenis quam antea esse. Calor in aspectu eius, familiaritas domus, dolore et conflictu substituta erant.

unit.source: “Run!
unit.target: “Fuge!

unit.source: “Repent to Mother Earth on my behalf!”
unit.target: “Poenitentiam age pro me ad Matrem Terram!”

unit.source: Father Montserrat screamed in hysteria.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat in hysteria clamavit.

unit.source: His naked form underwent an abnormal transformation.
unit.target: Eius forma nuda transformationem inusitatam passa est.

unit.source: Organs, symbolic of creation and incubation, sprouted under the translucent, filthy white membrane, intertwining in a horrific display.
unit.target: Organa, creationis et incubationis symbola, sub membrana alba, translucida et immunda, exortae sunt, inter se implicantes in spectaculo horribili.

unit.source: Repent to Mother Earth? Lumian vaguely understood Father Montserrat’s current state.
unit.target: “Poenitentiam age ad Matrem Terram?” Lumian vage intellexit statum praesentem Patris Montserrat.

unit.source: His corruption appeared incomplete, retaining a side that clung to faith in Earth Mother, resulting in a split personality.
unit.target: Corruptio eius imperfecta apparuit, retinens partem quae ad fidem in Matrem Terram haerebat, quae personalitatem dividendam effecit.

unit.source: Typically, the normal persona remained suppressed by the corrupted one.
unit.target: Typice, persona normalis ab illa corrupta comprimebatur.

unit.source: Is this the problem that the Symphony of Hatred triggered, allowing Father Montserrat’s normal personality to temporarily gain an advantage and regain control of his body?
unit.target: Num hic est quaestio quam Symphonia Odii excitavit, sinens normalem personalitatem Patris Montserrat ad tempus praevacare atque iterum corporis sui imperium recuperare?

unit.source: Lumian sighed, but this didn’t prevent him from condensing crimson fireballs that were nearly white, launching them towards the mutated Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, sed hoc eum non impedivit globulos ignis rubri paene albi condensare, eosque in Patrem Montserrat mutatum proicere.

unit.source: Montserrat’s countenance shifted between frigidity and anguish.
unit.target: Vultus Montserrat inter frigoris et angoris motus mutatus est.

unit.source: His body alternated between evasion and restraint.
unit.target: Corpus eius inter effugiendos et coercitionem alternabat.

unit.source: With all his might, he exclaimed, “The Child of God cannot be killed, only banished!”
unit.target: Omnibus viribus, exclamavit: “Puer Dei interficiri non potest, sed solum in exilium mittendus est!”

unit.source: As Father Montserrat spoke, the crimson fireballs, nearly white, exploded upon him.
unit.target: Dum Pater Montserrat loquebatur, globuli ignis rubri paene albi super eum explosi sunt.

unit.source: The silver-white Pride Armor breached the obstruction of vines and branches, charging forward with a light-conjured staff.
unit.target: Armatura Superbia argenteo-alba obstructionem vinearum et ramorum perrupit, et baculo lucis evocato impetu incedens progressa est.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Roncitus!

unit.source: Upon the fireball’s detonation, the fallen Father Montserrat wrested control of his body, attempting to retreat underground.
unit.target: Globuli ignis detonatione, Pater Montserrat lapsus imperium corporis sui recuperavit, conans se subter recedere.

unit.source: In that instant, Lumian materialized behind him, brandishing the black bone flute.
unit.target: In illo instante, Lumian post eum apparuit, tibiam ossium nigram extollens.

unit.source: Lumian teleported into the explosion’s epicenter, unconcerned about the potentially severe injuries from the formidable shockwave!
unit.target: Lumian se in centrum explosionis translocavit, nec curans de vulneribus gravibus, quae ex impetu terribili oriri potuerunt!

unit.source: The fireball was a decoy. The true lethal strike he primed was the Symphony of Hatred!
unit.target: Globulus ignis lusus erat. Vera ictus letalis, quem paravit, erat Symphonia Odii!

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Lumian thrust the black bone flute with blood-colored holes into Father Montserrat’s diminishing neck.
unit.target: Lumian tibiam ossium nigram cum foraminibus sanguine coloratis in collum minuendum Patris Montserrat impulit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Roncitus!

unit.source: The expanding flames engulfed them both.
unit.target: Flammae expansivae eos ambo voraverunt.

unit.source: 611 True Name
unit.target: 611 Verum Nomen

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: As Lumian’s body was ripped apart by the explosion, he drew upon an Ascetic’s tolerance for pain and a Pyromaniac’s resistance to burning, activating the black mark on his right shoulder once again.
unit.target: Cum corpus Lumiani a explosione laceratum esset, patientiam doloris ascetici atque ardoris pyromaniaci adhibuit, nigrum signum in dextro umero iterum activans.

unit.source: Alongside Father Montserrat, whose neck had been pierced by the Symphony of Hatred, he vanished into the swirling flames, reappearing at the edge of the dark wilderness.
unit.target: Una cum Patre Montserrat, cuius collum a Symphonia Odii perforatus erat, in gyrantia ignis evanuit, et ad limen obscurae solitudinis repraesentatus reintroduxit se.

unit.source: His linen shirt, black vest, and dark pants lay in tatters.
unit.target: Tunica linerea, lorica nigra, et bracae obscurae in laceratis pannis iacebant.

unit.source: The exposed parts were mangled and charred, revealing white bones in some places.
unit.target: Partes patefactae laniatae atque ustulatae erant, quarum quibusdam locis ossa alba patefaciebant.

unit.source: Father Montserrat, close to death, had the filthy, translucent white membrane on his body torn and burned away by the explosion.
unit.target: Pater Montserrat, prope mortem imminentem, membranam sordidam atque translucide albam in corpore suo ab explosione laceratam atque comburitam habebat.

unit.source: The mutated naked body with various organs below was dented and charred, with flesh and blood constantly peeling off.
unit.target: Corpus nudum mutatum, cum variis organis subiectis, depressum atque ustulatum erat, dum caro ac sanguis continue excidiebantur.

unit.source: Snap.
unit.target: Crepitus.

unit.source: As the first piece of flesh landed on the edge of the weed-covered darkness, it suddenly seeped in, as if absorbed by the soil.
unit.target: Cum prima pars carnis in limine obscuritatis herbarum opertae cecidisset, subito infusa est, quasi a terra absorpta.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Lumian’s heart stirred.
unit.target: Hoc videns, cor Lumiani excitatum est.

unit.source: He grabbed Father Montserrat’s body and activated teleportation once again.
unit.target: Corpus Patris Montserrat apprehendit et teleportationem iterum activavit.

unit.source: They left the dark wilderness and materialized on the deck bathed in crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Ex obscura solitudine discesserunt et in tabulato, in luce lunari rubro induta, apparuerunt.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the illusory oak tree in the depths of the cargo hold shed its bark, revealing moist, slippery flesh.
unit.target: Simul, quercus illusorius in profundis cellae vecturae corticem abnuit, ostendens carnem humidam atque lubricam.

unit.source: The blood-filled flesh began to squirm, but only a palm-sized figure emerged.
unit.target: Caro sanguine plena contorquebatur, sed sola figura parva, ad palmarum dimensiones similis, orta est.

unit.source: The figure, nearly the same size as the blob of flesh that had dropped from Father Montserrat and been absorbed by the wilderness, had clear eyes and a youthful appearance, resembling Father Montserrat, who had shrunk countless times.
unit.target: Figura, paene eandem magnitudinem quam massa carnis a Patre Montserrat lapsa et in solitudine absorpta habens, oculos claros atque speciem iuvenilem exhibebat, similis Patre Montserrat, qui innumeris contractionibus passa erat.

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s eyes were glazed, and his expression was rigid, showing no signs of intelligence.
unit.target: Oculi Patris Montserrat vitrei erant, et vultus eius rigidus, nullas intelligentiae notas ostendens.

unit.source: The silver-white Pride Armor rushed over and swung the re-condensed light hammer down, flattening the pixie-like Father Montserrat and turning him into a bloody pulp.
unit.target: Armatura superbiae argenteo-alba celeriter accessit et malleum lucis recondensum deiecxit, Patrem Montserrat pixia similem comprimens atque eum in pulpem sanguinolentum convertere fecit.

unit.source: Dawn lit up, melting the meat paste quickly.
unit.target: Aurora lucebat, celeriter pastam carnis liquescens.

unit.source: The illusory colossal oak tree instantly became more transparent, and the black wilderness with weeds rapidly disintegrated.
unit.target: Quercus ingens illusoria statim magis perspicua facta est, et solitudo nigra cum herbis celeriter dissoluta est.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the abnormal scene vanished.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, scena anomala evanuit.

unit.source: The cargo hold returned to its original state, but many wooden boxes had shattered, and the steel walls and floor bore obvious depressions and deep marks.
unit.target: Cella oneraria ad statum originalem rediit, sed multa arcae ligneae confractae erant, et parietes ac solum ferreum evidentes incisiones atque depressiones gerebant.

unit.source: Elsewhere, Lumian drew the Symphony of Hatred’s black bone flute and observed as Father Montserrat’s blood dripped onto the steel deck without soaking in.
unit.target: Alibi, Lumian flautam ex ossibus nigris, cuius erat Symphonia Odii, extraxit et aspexit, dum sanguis Patris Montserrat in tabulato ferreo stillabat sine imbibitione.

unit.source: Just as he breathed a sigh of relief, he heard Father Montserrat, who had fallen to the ground and entered a dying state, weakly but persistently shout, “To banish the… Child of God… you must grasp… His true name!”
unit.target: Cum levamen exhalationis edidisset, audivit Patrem Montserrat, qui in terram ceciderat atque in statum moriendum redactus esset, debiliter sed pertinaciter clamantem: “Ut exspellas… Puer Dei… necesse est ut capias… verum nomen eius!”

unit.source: "His true name is…”
unit.target: "Verum nomen eius est…"

unit.source: Suddenly, Father Montserrat’s voice vanished, but his mouth continued opening and closing.
unit.target: Subito vox Patris Montserrat evanuit, sed os eius aperiendum atque claudendum perseverabat.

unit.source: The illusory, hollow cry of a baby echoed in Lumian’s ears once more.
unit.target: Clamor infantis illusori atque vacui iterum in auribus Lumiani resonavit.

unit.source: Unlike before, the cries were distant, as if in another world.
unit.target: Contra priorem, clamores remoti erant, quasi in alio mundo.

unit.source: Lumian’s body didn’t stiffen or turn cold, rendering him immobile.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani nec riguit nec frigidum factum est, atque ita immobilis mansit.

unit.source: Is the invisible Child of God still wary of the Blood Emperor’s aura?
unit.target: Num invisibilis Puer Dei adhuc aurem Imperatoris Sanguinis timet?

unit.source: Is this instinctive fear?
unit.target: Estne hic metus instinctivus?

unit.source: Lumian quickly surveyed the surroundings and realized that the crimson moonlight on the deck, or rather, around him, had vanished.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter circumspiciens animadvertitque lunarem lucem rubrum in tabulato, vel potius circa se, evanuisse.

unit.source: The area became abnormally dark, preventing even the sound of seawater splashing.
unit.target: Regio facta est insolenter obscura, ne sonus etiam aquae maris stillantis pervenire possit.

unit.source: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”
unit.target: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”

unit.source: The baby’s cries persisted, growing louder and clearer.
unit.target: Clamores infantis perseverabant, augebantur et clariores fiebant.

unit.source: Lumian abruptly lowered his head, fixing his gaze on the breathless Father Montserrat and the stomach of the corpse before him.
unit.target: Lumian subito caput inclinavit et oculos fovens ad Patrem Montserrat anhelantem atque ad ventrem cadaveris ante se positos intenxit.

unit.source: At some indeterminate moment, the stomach bulged, as if something writhed within.
unit.target: Ad aliquum temporis incertum, venter protrudebat, quasi aliquid intus se movebat.

unit.source: Despite the already gaping wounds, a demonic blood‐red glow emanated from the belly.
unit.target: Licet vulnera jam ingentia patefacta essent, ex ventre lumen daemonium rubro sanguine fulgens emanavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed slightly as he knelt on one knee.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani paulum constricti sunt, dum in uno genu se inclinavit.

unit.source: Extending his right hand, which grasped the Symphony of Hatred, towards Father Montserrat’s distended stomach.
unit.target: Dextro manu extendens, qua Symphonia Odii teneatur, versus ventrem dilatatum Patris Montserrat contendit.

unit.source: Slash!
unit.target: Incide!

unit.source: A gentle stroke of the black bone flute cleaved open the blood‐red stomach, revealing blood‐stained intestines and internal organs.
unit.target: Subtilis ictus flauti ex ossibus nigris ventrem rubrum sanguineum dividit, revelans intestina sanguine tincta et organa interna.

unit.source: There was no sign of the so‐called Child of God or a moist, filthy baby.
unit.target: Nullum signum Pueri Dei dicti aut infanti humidum atque immundum apparuit.

unit.source: Poof! A substantial amount of transparent, pale‐yellow liquid spewed out from the ruptured blood‐colored stomach, splattering the surrounding deck.
unit.target: Poof! Magna copia liquidi pellucidi, pallidum flavī ex ventre sanguineo rupto erupebat, tabulatum circumiectum spargens.

unit.source: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”
unit.target: “Waa! Waa! Waa!”

unit.source: The baby’s cries intensified, piercing and shrill, drawing closer to Lumian.
unit.target: Clamores infantis augebantur, acuti et stridentes, propius ad Lumian accedentes.

unit.source: He seemed to be gradually overcoming His fear of the Blood Emperor’s aura out of anger and hatred.
unit.target: Videbatur ex ira et odio metum aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis paulatim superare.

unit.source: I need to find a professional to banish this invisible Child of God… Lumian, whose current spirituality allowed him two uses of Spirit World Traversal, planned on seeking assistance.
unit.target: Mihi in peritum inveniendum opus est ad exspellandum hunc invisibilem Puerum Dei… Lumian, cuius praesentis spiritualitatis facultas ei duas usus Transitus Mundi Spiritus concedebat, auxilium petere destinavit.

unit.source: Hunters weren’t experts in such matters!
unit.target: Venatores talibus rebus periti non erant!

unit.source: Yet, after activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian realized he couldn’t sense the spirit world or the coordinates he had once held.
unit.target: Attamen, postquam nigrum signum in dextro umero activatum habuit, Lumian animadvertit se nec spirituum mundum nec notiones coordinarum, quas olim habebat, sentire posse.

unit.source: The abnormal darkness induced by the Child of God’s cries appeared to seal off this area.
unit.target: Obscuritas anomala, aclamore Pueri Dei posita, hanc aream sigillare videbatur.

unit.source: This was closer to Paramita!
unit.target: Hoc propius Paramitae erat!

unit.source: I can’t find help, summon a messenger, or pray to high‐level existences… Lumian’s eyes narrowed as his heart sank.
unit.target: Non possum auxilium invenire, nuntium vocare, aut ad altos existentias precari… Oculi Lumiani contracti sunt, dum cor eius deiectum erat.

unit.source: At that moment, the invisible Child of God’s cries drew nearer, causing Lumian’s body to stiffen and turn cold once again.
unit.target: In illo momento, clamores invisibiles Puer Dei propius accedebant, quod faciebat corpus Lumiani iterum rigidari atque frigidari.

unit.source: As panic surged, Lumian, a Conspirer, swiftly devised a new plan: Exorcism Spell!
unit.target: Dum panica intulerat, Lumian, qui erat Conspirator, celeriter novum consilium excogitavit: Incantatio exorcismatis!

unit.source: One of the five ritualistic magics from Alms Monk, capable of dispelling wraiths and evil spirits.
unit.target: Una ex quinque magiis ritualibus a Monacho Eleemosynario, quae phantasmata ac malos spiritus expellere valeat.

unit.source: The unborn Child of God, invisible in the real world, bore a resemblance to wraiths or evil spirits.
unit.target: Puer Dei nondum natus, invisibilis in mundo reali, similitudinem habebat ad phantasmata aut malos spiritus.

unit.source: Lumian, untroubled by the need for a specific target in his Exorcism Spell, could firstly use his name.
unit.target: Lumian, non vexatus necessitate specifici obiecti in Incantatione Exorcismatis, primo nomine suo uti poterat.

unit.source: Secondly, he could pray to Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Secundo, ad Dominum Foll orare poterat.

unit.source: The proximity‐based response of the seal on his chest, due to the severed connection with the outside world, would provide the necessary level and strength!
unit.target: Responsio sigilli in pectore eius, fundata in propinquitate et ob nexus cum mundo externo iam disiunctos, gradum atque robur necessarium praebebat!

unit.source: An Ascetic, Lumian could simplify parts of the Exorcism Spell for a quick completion.
unit.target: Ut asceticus, Lumian quaedam partem incantationis exorcismatis ad celerem perficiendum simplicare poterat.

unit.source: The hitch was the requirement for the target’s real name and an item frequently carried.
unit.target: Difficultas constat in necessitate veri nominis obiecti ac rei solitum portae.

unit.source: Lumian lacked both.
unit.target: Lumian utrumque caruit.

unit.source: His gaze shifted to Father Montserrat’s open and deflated stomach, searching for something relevant.
unit.target: Animadvertit in ventrem apertum et depressum Patris Montserrat, aliquid pertinente quaerens.

unit.source: If unsuccessful in a minute, he planned to unleash Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s aura, attempting to scare away the invisible Child of God and break through the abnormal darkness for an indirect banishment.
unit.target: Si intra unum minutum non eveniret, proposuit aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor evadere, conatus invisibilem Puerum Dei terrere atque obscuritatem anormalem rumpere ad exspellationem indirectam.

unit.source: After scanning the area a few times, Lumian’s gaze fixed on the chaotic, blood‐stained intestines.
unit.target: Postquam regionem aliquoties perspexit, oculus Lumiani in intestina caotica sanguine maculata fixus est.

unit.source: Amidst them lay a short, flesh‐colored, bloodstained strip, clearly not fully developed.
unit.target: Inter ea iacebat stria brevis, colore carne similis, sanguine maculata, manifeste non plene evoluta.

unit.source: Wh… An incomplete umbilical cord of the Child of God?
unit.target: Quid… Funiculus umbilicalis incompletus Pueri Dei?

unit.source: If it’s truly an umbilical cord, it’s closely tied to the Child of God.
unit.target: Si vere funiculus umbilicalis existit, intime Pueri Dei iungitur.

unit.source: Connected to His flesh and blood.
unit.target: Ad carnem et sanguinem eius adnexus.

unit.source: I don’t even need to know His true name to succeed in the Exorcism Spell…
unit.target: Nec verum nomen eius scire mihi opus est ad incantationem exorcismatis efficaciter peragenda.

unit.source: Lumian retracted the Symphony of Hatred and tore off the suspected incomplete umbilical cord.
unit.target: Lumian Symphoniam Odii retractavit et funiculum umbilicalem incompletum, qui suspectus erat, abripuit.

unit.source: The illusory baby’s cries intensified.
unit.target: Clamores infantis illusori intensiores fierunt.

unit.source: Lumian shuddered and chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian tremuit et subridens iocose respondit.

unit.source: “Thank you for confirming it for me.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago quod id mihi confirmavisti.”

unit.source: He held the incomplete umbilical cord and danced a rhythmic, distorted, primitive dance.
unit.target: Funiculum umbilicale incompletum tenens, saltationem rhythmicam, distortam et primitivam egit.

unit.source: As Lumian danced, he constantly bent down, using the umbilical cord to draw corresponding symbols on the deck with Father Montserrat’s blood.
unit.target: Dum Lumian saltabat, constanter se inclinabat, utens funiculo umbilicali ad sigilla correspondens in tabulato cum sanguine Patris Montserrat delineanda.

unit.source: He simplified the patterns he needed to complete, straightened his body, and pressed his left palm, creating a crimson, nearly white flame on the symbol.
unit.target: Schemata quae perficienda erant simplicavit, corpus suum rectificavit, et palam sinistram premens in signo flammam rubro sanguinolentam, paene albinam, creavit.

unit.source: Then, he placed the umbilical cord into the flames.
unit.target: Tum funiculum umbilicale in flammas posuit.

unit.source: There was a strong symbolic meaning behind this, representing expulsion, incineration, and purification!
unit.target: Hic significatio valde symbolica erat, quae expulsionem, incinerationem, et purificationem repraesentabat!

unit.source: “Waaa!”
unit.target: “Waaa!”

unit.source: The baby’s cries heightened, sending a shiver down Lumian’s spine, causing his body to tremble slightly.
unit.target: Clamores infantis augebantur, et tremor per spinem Lumiani descendebat, faciens corpus eius paulum tremere.

unit.source: Swiftly, he positioned a lit candle atop the flame and umbilical cord.
unit.target: Celeriter, candelam accensam super flammam et funiculum umbilicale imposuit.

unit.source: Stepping back, he recited in Hermes, “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…”
unit.target: Retrocedens, in lingua Hermetica recitavit: “Stultus, qui huic aetati non competit, imperator mysticus supra nebulam cineream; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam imperat…”

unit.source: As the honorific name of Mr. Fool echoed, a wispy gray fog enveloped the surroundings.
unit.target: Dum nomen honorificum Domini Foll resonabat, nebula tenuis cinerea circumiectam involuta est.

unit.source: The unseen baby’s cries diminished, echoing in a haunting hollowness.
unit.target: Clamores infantis invisibiles minuebantur, resonantes in spatio terribili vacuo.

unit.source: Feeling a burning sensation in his left chest, Lumian advanced two steps with a determined expression.
unit.target: Sentiens ardorem in pecto sinistro, Lumian duos passus cum vultu determinato progressus est.

unit.source: He grasped the smoldering umbilical cord, flicked it thrice, and returned it to its place.
unit.target: Funiculum umbilicale fumidum arripuit, ter concussit, et ad locum suum rediit.

unit.source: He continued, “I beseech your assistance. I implore you to banish the object connected to this umbilical cord…”
unit.target: Continuavit: “Auxilium tuum obsecro. Te imploro, expelle rem quae huic funiculo umbilicali adnexa est…”

unit.source: In an instant, the crimson, nearly white, flames tainted the gray fog, burning more intensely.
unit.target: In momento, flammae rubrae, paene albae, nebulam cineream infestarunt, ardentius comburentes.

unit.source: The umbilical cord swiftly charred, revealing Father Montserrat’s transparent face marked by explosions and blood.
unit.target: Funiculum umbilicale celeriter ustum est, revelans faciem transparentem Patris Montserrat, explosionibus et sanguine insignitam.

unit.source: The hollow baby’s cries faded into the distance.
unit.target: Clamores infantis inani in longinquum evanuerunt.

unit.source: Father Montserrat’s spirit involuntarily retreated, relief evident on his pained face.
unit.target: Spiritus Patris Montserrat inviti retrocessit, solatium in vultu dolore eius manifeste ostendens.

unit.source: He was also connected to the umbilical cord, and he was now a ghost!
unit.target: Ipse quoque cum funiculo umbilicali conexus erat, et nunc umbra factus est!

unit.source: With difficulty, Father Montserrat raised his hands and shouted, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace!”
unit.target: Cum difficultate, Pater Montserrat manus extulit et clamavit: “Pretium vitae amplexus, gratia messis!”

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: His transparent Spirit Body rapidly dissipated into the darkness.
unit.target: Corpus spirituale transparentis eius celeriter in tenebras dissolutum est.

unit.source: The invisible Child of God emitted a shrill cry filled with hatred and curses.
unit.target: Puer Dei invisibilis clamor stridulus, plenus odio et maledictis, edidit.

unit.source: The cry echoed in Lumian’s head, making him feel as if he had endured Psychic Piercings repeatedly.
unit.target: Clamor in capite Lumiani resonavit, faciens eum quasi pluries ictus psychicos passi esse.

unit.source: He became extremely weak, his thoughts consumed by the pain in his soul, losing perception of the outside world.
unit.target: Valde debilis factus est, cogitationes eius dolore animi consumpta, ac perceptionem mundi externi amittens.

unit.source: Upon recovery, the abnormal darkness on the deck had vanished, and the crimson moonlight returned.
unit.target: Post recuperationem, obscuritas anomala in tabulato evanuerat, et luna rubra redivit.

unit.source: The symbols on the ground and the gray fog‐colored flames disappeared, leaving only the quietly burning candle and the charred umbilical cord.
unit.target: Symbola in terra et flammae cinereae nebulosae evanuerunt, relinquentes solum candelam tranquille ardentem et funiculum umbilicale comburitum.

unit.source: After a brief pause, Lumian bent down to extinguish the candle flame.
unit.target: Post brevem intervallum, Lumian se inclinavit ad candelam extinguendam.

unit.source: Pressing his hand to his chest, he whispered, “Thank you, Mr. Fool.”
unit.target: Presseens manum in pectus, susurravit: “Gratias tibi ago, Domine Foll!”

unit.source: After stowing away the remnants of the umbilical cord and the ritual candle, Lumian cast a glance at Father Montserrat’s still uncharacteristic corpse.
unit.target: Postquam reliquias funiculi umbilicalis et candelam ritualem recondidit, Lumian aspectum in cadavero adhuc insolito Patris Montserrat intulit.

unit.source: He unleashed his Compression power.
unit.target: Potentiam Compressionis suam exsolvit.

unit.source: His spirituality restored, weakness eased, Lumian finally felt confident enough to return to the cargo hold.
unit.target: Spiritualitate restituta et debilitate levata, Lumian denique satis confidens se sensit ad cellam onerariam redire.

unit.source: Silently, he packed the Pride Armor into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Silentiose, armaturam superbiae in sacculum viatoris suum reponit.

unit.source: Completing this task, he changed into tattered clothes and tended to his exposed wounds briefly.
unit.target: Hoc negotio peracto, vestimenta lacerata induit et vulnera sua patefacta breviter curavit.

unit.source: Enduring the pain, he returned to his suite as if nothing had occurred.
unit.target: Dolorem sustinens, rediit ad conclave suum, quasi nihil accideret.

unit.source: Addressing the captain, Pedro, and the others, he declared, “The problem has been resolved. Father Montserrat’s corpse is on the deck. His belongings will be handed over to the Church of Earth Mother. Right, a Blessed.”
unit.target: Ad capitaneum, Pedro et ceteros loquens, declaravit: “Quaestio soluta est. Cadaver Patris Montserrat in tabulato manet. Res eius tradentur Ecclesiae Matris Terrae. Recte, benedictus.”

unit.source: Lumian harbored no intention of claiming the Church of Earth Mother’s items.
unit.target: Lumian nullam intentionem habebat res Ecclesiae Matris Terrae sibi vindicare.

unit.source: Captain Pedro and the others departed in bewilderment to verify the deck situation.
unit.target: Capitaneus Pedro et cetera, stupefacti, discesserunt ut statum tabulati perscruterent.

unit.source: Lugano approached Lumian and whispered,
unit.target: Lugano Lumian appropinquavit et susurravit,

unit.source: “Is Father Montserrat really dead?”
unit.target: “Num Pater Montserrat vere mortuus est?”

unit.source: “You can take a look at his corpse,” Lumian replied with a “smile,” intending to instruct the servant to provide treatment.
unit.target: “Potes spectare cadaver eius,” respondit Lumian subridens, intendens monere servum ad curationem afferendam.
