unit.source: Lugano frowned and said, “But I vaguely heard his voice earlier. He seemed to be shouting the name of the so‐called Child of God.”
unit.target: Lugano fronem contraxit et dixit: “Sed vago olim vocem eius audivi. Videbatur nomen Puer Dei, ita dictum, clamare.”

unit.source: Shouting the so‐called Child of God’s name? Back then, Father Montserrat had indeed shouted the Child of God’s true name, but due to special reasons, it hadn’t reached the real world.
unit.target: Clamare nomen Puer Dei dicti? Olim vero, Pater Montserrat verum nomen Puer Dei clamaverat, sed propter causas speciales ad mundum realem non pervenit.

unit.source: Only Beyonders nearby corrupted by the Child of God could hear it?
unit.target: Solum Beyonders prope, corrupti a Puer Dei, illud audire poterant?

unit.source: Lumian pondered and said to Lugano, “That was before Father Montserrat’s death. What name did he call out?”
unit.target: Lumian cogitavit et Lugano dixit: “Id erat ante mortem Patris Montserrat. Quod nomen clamavit?”

unit.source: Lugano heaved a sigh of relief and recalled, “I think it was… I think it was…”
unit.target: Lugano suspiravit levamen et recordatus est: “Puto id fuisse… puto id fuisse…”

unit.source: Finally, he remembered and recited the pronunciation.
unit.target: Denique recordatus est et pronuntiavit dictionem.

unit.source: “Yes, Omebella.”
unit.target: “Ita, Omebella.”

unit.source: 612 Daybreak
unit.target: 612 Diluculum

unit.source: “Omebella.”
unit.target: “Omebella.”

unit.source: Termiboros’s resonant voice reverberated in Lumian’s ears as He echoed Lugano’s words.
unit.target: Vox resonans Termiboris in auribus Luminiani resonabat, dum verba Lugano iterabat.

unit.source: “You’ve heard of that?” Lumian hadn’t anticipated Termiboros, who had maintained silence for a considerable time, mentioning a name that left no impression on him.
unit.target: “Audivistine id?” Non exspectavit Lumian Termiboros, qui diu silentium servaverat, nomen proferre, quod nullam impressionem in eum reliquit.

unit.source: No, I’ve never heard of it before today.
unit.target: Non, numquam ante hunc diem id audīvī.

unit.source: Lugano thought it was a question directed at him.
unit.target: Lugano putāvit hanc quaestiōnem ad se directam esse.

unit.source: Termiboros fell silent, offering no response.
unit.target: Termiboros tacuit, nec responsum dedit.

unit.source: From the looks of it, it seems there is something off about the Child of God’s true name…
unit.target: Ex specie, vidētur aliquid non conveniens esse in verō nomine Fīliī Deī…

unit.source: And it sounds like a woman’s name.
unit.target: Et sonat ut nomen muliebre.

unit.source: Considering the Villain pathway’s progression to Sequence 5 Banshee, where they transition to women, and the inherent female inclination of the Earth pathway’s Sequence 0, Earth Mother, along with the influence of the Great Mother Herself, it’s quite plausible that the Child of God is a woman.
unit.target: Consideratis progressionibus viae Malefici ad Sequenciam 5 Banshee, in qua ad feminas convertuntur, et indole naturalis itineris Terrae Sequenciae 0, Mater Terrae, necnon cum influentia ipsius Magna Matris, satis verisimile est Filia Dei esse.

unit.source: It’s a logical deduction…
unit.target: Est conclusio logica…

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Lugano and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian Lugano aspexit et subridens fuit.

unit.source: “It’s fortunate you weren’t aware of this earlier.
unit.target: “Felix es quod hoc prius nesciebas.

unit.source: Otherwise, you might have found yourself linked to the so‐called Child of God.”
unit.target: Alioquin te cum quodam Filia Dei coniunxisses.”

unit.source: As Lumian spoke, his attention shifted to Ludwig, who had silently moved to the living room’s balcony.
unit.target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, attentio eius ad Ludovicum versa est, qui tacite in balconem salonis se contulit.

unit.source: Lumian approached him at a measured pace, his gaze following Ludwig’s toward the deck where Captain Pedro and others were examining Father Montserrat’s lifeless form.
unit.target: Lumian ad eum accessit gradu moderato, oculis Ludovici secutis versus tabulatum, ubi Capitaneus Pedro et alii corpus Patris Montserrat mortuum inspexerunt.

unit.source: Lumian asked thoughtfully, “Is it edible?”
unit.target: Lumian meditabundus quaesivit: “Estne id comestibile?”

unit.source: He meant whether Father Montserrat’s corpse was edible.
unit.target: Intendebat utrum corpus Patris Montserrat comestibile esset.

unit.source: While Lumian had abstained from claiming the Church of Earth Mother’s possessions, including Father Montserrat’s Beyonder characteristics, he hadn’t committed to preserving the corpse intact.
unit.target: Dum Lumian abstinuit postulare possessiones Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, inter quas propriae facultates Beyonder Patris Montserrat includebantur, non sē obligavit corpus integerrimum servare.

unit.source: In the heat of battle, it was customary for bodies to sustain damage!
unit.target: In calore pugnae, mos erat ut corpora laesione affecta essent!

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig caput quassavit.

unit.source: “Not yet.”
unit.target: “Nondum.”

unit.source: “Very well,” Lumian sighed, retracting his gaze with a tinge of regret.
unit.target: “Valde bene,” inquit Lumian suspirans, oculos retrahens cum aliquo paenitentiae dolore.

unit.source: Thus, the mystery of Father Montserrat’s inexplicable connection with the invisible Child of God remained unsolved.
unit.target: Ita, mysterium nexūs inexplicabilis Patris Montserrat cum invisibili Filia Dei manebat nondum resolutum.

unit.source: A peculiar umbilical cord had even taken root in his stomach, leaving Lumian unable to confirm if Prinpino was a byproduct refined from Father Montserrat’s remains.
unit.target: Funiculus umbilicalis insolitus etiam in ventre eius radicatus erat, relinquens Lumian certiorem esse utrum Prinpino ex reliquiis Patris Montserrat elaboratus esset.

unit.source: Indeed, Father Montserrat bore signs of severe corruption, though Lumian hadn’t anticipated his corruption to rival that of Mad Lady’s.
unit.target: Certe, Patris Montserrat signa corruptionis gravis ostendebat, quamquam Lumian eius corruptionem non praevidit ut aequipolleret corruptioni Dominae Insanae.

unit.source: Of course, it paled in comparison to the state of the Mad Lady’s corpse; even Ludwig found it too dirty.
unit.target: Certe, illud in comparatione ad statum cadaveris Dominae Insanae palluit; et Ludwig id nimis sordidum putavit.

unit.source: As for spirit channeling, Lumian understood that a spirit banished by the Exorcism Spell couldn’t be summoned for a specific duration, rendering communication impossible.
unit.target: Quoad canalizationem spirituum, Lumian intellexit spiritum, quo incantatione exorcismi expulsum erat, per certam tempus evocari non posse, communicationem impossibile reddi.

unit.source: Once this period lapsed, spirit channeling became futile.
unit.target: Postquam hoc tempus lapsum est, canalizatio spirituum vana facta est.

unit.source: Upon returning to the living room, Lumian sank into a recliner, casually unbuttoning his black vest and linen shirt.
unit.target: Rediens ad conclave, Lumian in lectum reclinavit, vestem nigrum et tunicam linteam dissolvens.

unit.source: Turning to Lugano, he remarked, “Come and treat me.”
unit.target: Conversus ad Lugano, inquit: “Veni et me curare!”

unit.source: Lugano’s eyes surveyed the makeshift bandages and the oozing wounds, expressing surprise.
unit.target: Oculi Lugani inspexerunt fascias improvisas et vulnera exsudantia, stuporem ostendentes.

unit.source: “It’s that serious?”
unit.target: “Estne ita grave?”

unit.source: Lumian, with a hint of amusement, responded, “Do you think dealing with Father Montserrat is a walk in the park?”
unit.target: Lumian, leviter subridens, respondit: “Putasne agere cum Patre Montserrat rem tam facile esse, ut ambulatio in horto?”

unit.source: “If I hadn’t taken risks, I might have been the one lying dead.”
unit.target: “Si pericula non cepissem, forsitan ego mortuus iacerer.”

unit.source: Lugano instinctively denied the suggestion, “Not what I meant.”
unit.target: Lugano instinctive respondit: “Non hoc intendebam.”

unit.source: “Why are your clothes and pants unscathed after such serious injuries?”
unit.target: “Cur vestimenta et bracae tuae post tam graves vulnera intactae sunt?”

unit.source: Lumian, enduring the pain, replied casually, “I obviously changed before coming back.”
unit.target: Lumian, dolorem ferens, respondit leviter: “Plane mutavi me antequam redierim.”

unit.source: His Traveler’s Bag proved invaluable, holding nearly a dozen identical shirts, vests, and pants, albeit varying in vest colors.
unit.target: Saccus Viatoris eius praestabat, continens fere duodecim tunicas, vestes, et bracas identicas, quamquam vestium coloribus variabantibus.

unit.source: The only casualty was the golden straw hat, consumed in the explosion, now burnt to ashes.
unit.target: Unica laesa res fuit pileus stramineus aureus, consumptus in explosione, nunc in cineres redactus.

unit.source: However, this setback hardly fazed the great adventurer, Louis Berry, who had stocked up on identical replacements before leaving Port Farim.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc casus vix moverat magnum adventorem, Ludovicum Berry, qui ante discessum Port Farim supplentes identicos congregaverat.

unit.source: This was the benefit of having a Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Hoc erat commodum habendi saccum viatoris.

unit.source: Otherwise, how could he have the space to store so many useless items with just a suitcase?
unit.target: Alioquin, quomodo potuisset spatium habere ad tot res inutiles reponendas, nisi in sola capsula?

unit.source: Lugano, choosing not to pry further, focused on tending to his employer’s injuries.
unit.target: Lugano, non ultra inquirere optans, incumbit curae vulnerum patroni sui.

unit.source: Originally considering a more intricate procedure, like cutting off charred skin, Lugano’s plans were halted by Lumian, opting for a simpler approach.
unit.target: Consilia Lugani, quae primum de procedūra magis intricāta (ut cutem ustulātam excidendum) versabantur, ab Lumiano interclusa sunt, simpliciorem viam eligens.

unit.source: Lumian had no intention of enduring the agony of anesthesia‐free surgery, knowing that he would revert to his original state at 6 a.m.
unit.target: Lumian non intendebat cruciatum chirurgiae sine anesthesiā pati, sciens se ad statum suum originalem ad horam sextam rediurum esse.

unit.source: With the pain and injuries now manageable and showing significant improvement, Lumian made his way back to his room.
unit.target: Cum dolor et vulnera nunc tolerabilia atque notabiliter meliora viderentur, Lumian ad cameram suam rediit.

unit.source: There, he unfolded a letter and began recounting the events involving Father Montserrat and the true name of the Child of God, diligently reporting to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Ibi epistulam explicavit et eventūs, qui Patris Montserrat et verī nominis Filiae Dei attinebant, enarrāre coepit, diligenter ad Magistram Magicam referens.

unit.source: Lumian consistently regarded matters related to evil gods and the so‐called Child of God with great gravity.
unit.target: Lumian constanter negotia, quae ad deos malos et ad quodam Filiae Dei spectabant, graviter considerabat.

unit.source: He believed such concerns should be left to his superiors, acknowledging the importance of involving higher authorities.
unit.target: Existimabat talia negotia ad superiores relinquenda esse, momentum autem auctoritatum superiorum agnoscens.

unit.source: Had Mr. K possessed a messenger, Lumian would have promptly dispatched a modified copy to inform the Aurora Order Oracle of the situation.
unit.target: Si Dominus K nuntium haberet, Lumian celeriter exemplar emendatum misisset ad Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae de re informandum.

unit.source: The next course of action wasn’t within the purview of an ordinary member like him or Minor Arcana; it was a concern for others to address.
unit.target: Proximum consilium non pertinebat membris ordinariīs ut ipse aut Minor Arcana; illa cura aliorum erat.

unit.source: Observing a shared stance between the Tarot Club and the Aurora Order in combating evil gods, especially those breaching the barrier, Lumian recognized his responsibility as both a minor Arcana card holder in the Tarot Club and an official member of the Aurora Order.
unit.target: Observans stantiam mutuam inter Clubum Taroticum et Ordinem Aurorae in deos malos—praecipue eos qui claustra violabantur—Lumian onus suum agnovit tamquam possessor chartārum Minor Arcana in Clubo Tarotico et membrum officiale Ordinis Aurorae.

unit.source: After meticulously recording the details, including Termiboros’s reaction, Lumian summoned the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Postquam singula diligenter recensita sunt, inter quae reactio Termiboris, Lumian nuntium “pupulam” convocavit.

unit.source: Engaged in a recent dispute with Ludwig and being in proximity to the other party, the “doll” messenger swiftly arrived and departed.
unit.target: Inter recentem discordiam cum Ludovico implicatus et in propinquitate alterius versans, nuntius “pupula” celeriter advenit atque discessit.

unit.source: It seldom lingered, avoiding casual conversations.
unit.target: Raro morabatur, vitans colloquia levia.

unit.source: In a clean and refreshing bedroom of Loen Kingdom, Backlund, Madam Magician lay peacefully in bed, immersed in a restful slumber.
unit.target: In conclāvō pūrō et refrigeriōsō regnī Loen, Backlund, Magistra Magica, pacate in lectō iacebat, sopore quietō immersa.

unit.source: Abruptly, she sat up, a puzzled expression crossing her face.
unit.target: Subito, illa surrexit, vultū perplexō ornāta.

unit.source: Spirituality warning?
unit.target: Monitio spiritualis?

unit.source: Is something significant about to unfold?
unit.target: Numquid res gravis exsistere parāta est?

unit.source: Madam Magician, having just poured a glass of Sonia blood wine and not yet delved into her astromancy, was surprised to see the “doll” messenger materialize on her desk.
unit.target: Magistra Magica, recenter poculum vini sanguinei Soniae effundens et astromanciam nondum exercēns, admirāta est quod nuntius “pupula” in mensā suā apparuisset.

unit.source: It placed a folded letter next to a dark‐red fountain pen.
unit.target: Iuxta calamum atramentārium rubrum, epistolam convolutam posuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s letter…
unit.target: Epistula Luminiani…

unit.source: Has he unearthed the issue with the Earth Mother Church’s priest?
unit.target: Num quaestiōnem sacerdōtis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae detexit?

unit.source: I didn’t guide him in vain…
unit.target: Non frustra eum duxī…

unit.source: Madam Magician mused, letting the glass float in midair.
unit.target: Magistra Magica meditāta est, poculum in aere leviter suspendēns.

unit.source: She picked up the letter and unfolded it.
unit.target: Illam epistolam sustulit et explicavit.

unit.source: As she read, her expression underwent a sudden change, and she softly repeated the name,
unit.target: Dum legebat, facies eius subito mutāta est, et leniter nomen repetivit,

unit.source: “Omebella?”
unit.target: “Omebella?”

unit.source: The true name of the invisible Child of God is this?
unit.target: Hocne verum nomen Filiae Dei invisibilis est?

unit.source: Was my spiritual warning connected to it?
unit.target: Num mea monitio spiritualis ad hoc pertinuit?

unit.source: This is something worth discussing at the Tarot Club’s regular gathering…
unit.target: Hoc est aliquid quod apud conventum ordinārium Clubi Taroticī disserendum est…

unit.source: After a moment, Madam Magician used astromancy to indirectly verify the information.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Magistra Magica astromantiam ad informationem indirectē verificandam usus est.

unit.source: She then seated herself and observed as the dark‐red fountain pen levitated.
unit.target: Deinde sese sedavit et observavit dum calamus atramentārius ruber levitabatur.

unit.source: Removing the cap, she began to inscribe her thoughts on the faux goatskin: “Omebella is a name shrouded in the fog of history. It carries a potent symbolic meaning in mysticism…”
unit.target: Caput removēns, coepit suas cogitātiōnēs in fictam pelle caprina inscribere: “Omebella nomen est caligine historiae involūtum. Potentem significationem symbolicam in mysteriīs gerit…”

unit.source: “Using Omebella as the Child of God’s true name. I don’t know if it’s tied to the mysteries of the Second Epoch when the ancient gods, predating the Ancient Sun God, ruled the land, or if the Great Mother is employing intense mystical symbolism to gradually erode Earth Mother’s authority and even Earth Mother Herself.
unit.target: “Utendo Omebella tanquam verum nomen Filiae Dei. Nescio an id ad arcāna Secundae Aetātis pertineat, cum antiquī dei, priores Deo Solis Antiquō, terram regebant, aut an Magna Mater intensam symbolicam mysticam ad auctoritatem Matris Terrae atque ipsam Maternem paulatim erodendam utātur.

unit.source: If we can unravel the secrets of the ancient era, we might find an answer.
unit.target: “Si arcāna aetātis antiquitātis explicare possimus, responsum inveniemus.

unit.source: The one the Aurora Order believes in might know something.”
unit.target: “Ille, quem Ordo Aurorae credit, fortasse aliquid sciat.”

unit.source: As Lumian read the response inked on faux goatskin, he sensed a subtle suggestion from Madam Magician, hinting at him to inquire with the Aurora Order through Mr. K.
unit.target: Dum Lumian responsum in ficta pelle caprina inscriptum legebat, subtilis admonitiōnem a Magistrā Magicā percipiebat, quae eum per Dominum K cum Ordine Aurorae interrogare incitabat.

unit.source: He continued reading.
unit.target: Continuavit legendum.

unit.source: “Simply put, Omebella belongs to the ancient giant race.
unit.target: “Simpliciter, Omebella genti gigantēā antiqua pertinet.

unit.source: Once known as the Goddess of Harvest during the era when ancient gods held sway.
unit.target: Olim, ut Dea Messis, nota erat, tempore quo antiquī dei terram regebant.

unit.source: I can’t divulge more at this time.
unit.target: Nunc amplius enarrāre non possum.

unit.source: No need to delve into this matter specifically.
unit.target: Non opus est hanc rem peculiārē examinare.

unit.source: If you come across the Earth Mother Church’s Favored, Nightstalkers, or members of the School of God’s Descent, keep a vigilant eye.
unit.target: Si occurrerint Favorītī Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, Nocturnī aut membra Scholae Dei Descendentis, oculōs vigilantes tene.

unit.source: We’ll handle the follow‐up.
unit.target: Sequentes res nos curābimus.

unit.source: Of course, when the time comes, we might assign you one or two minor missions.”
unit.target: Scilicet, cum tempus venerit, tibi unam vel duas missionēs minōrēs delegare possumus.”

unit.source: The Goddess of Harvest… indeed linked to the Earth pathway… Lumian pondered as he burned the letter with crimson flames.
unit.target: Dea Messis… certe ad viam Terrae conjuncta… meditātus est Lumian, dum epistolam flammas rubras incendebat.

unit.source: Returning to bed, he feigned sleep, attuned to the ship’s movements.
unit.target: Rediens ad lectum, somnum simulāvit, motibus navis attendēns.

unit.source: With the sunrise, his body swiftly healed, and the day unfolded without unexpected incidents.
unit.target: Cum sol oriebātur, corpus celeriter sanātum est, et diēs sine inopinātīs casibus evolūtus est.

unit.source: Lumian returned to the living room and addressed Lugano, who had been awake for an hour, showing signs of a restless night.
unit.target: Lumian ad conclāve rediit et Lugano alloquēns, quī per hōram vigilāverat, vestigiā noctis incommodae ostendēns.

unit.source: “Still hearing the baby crying?”
unit.target: “Audisne adhuc infanti plorantem?”

unit.source: “No,” Lugano replied, a mix of joy and uncertainty evident in his response.
unit.target: “Non,” respondit Lugano, ubi mixtio laetitiāe et dubiātiōnis in responso eius patebat.

unit.source: Lugano believed he needed more time to observe before drawing a final conclusion.
unit.target: Lugano putāvit se plūra tempora observāre oportēre antequam ultimam conclūsiōnem traheret.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subrīdēns risit.

unit.source: “As expected, seeking Father Montserrat’s help is the only way to completely resolve your aftereffects.”
unit.target: “Ut exspectātum est, auxilium Patris Montserrat quaerere sola via est ad effecta tua postea omnīnō solvendō.”

unit.source: Lugano nearly choked on his words.
unit.target: Lugano paene verbīs se suffocāvit.

unit.source: So, that’s why you wanted me to seek help from Father Montserrat?
unit.target: Itaque, hoc est quod voluīstī ut auxilium a Patre Montserrat quaererem?

unit.source: Killing him is the equivalent of completely resolving the aftereffects I suffered?
unit.target: Num interficere eum aequipollet effectibus meīs postea omnīnō solvendīs?

unit.source: Lumian approached the balcony and instructed Lugano, “Find Enio later and use a follow‐up consultation as an excuse to confirm his condition.”
unit.target: Lumian ad balconem accessit et Lugano inseverat: “Postea Enion invenias et consultatione subsequenti utere ut statum eius comprobes.”

unit.source: Right, Enio was saved by Father Montserrat’s surgery.
unit.target: Recte, Enio operatione Patris Montserrat servātus est.

unit.source: Since there’s something wrong with Father Montserrat, he, too, might be problematic…
unit.target: Cum quid de Patre Montserrat vitiosum sit, ipse quoque fortasse problematicus erit…

unit.source: Lugano had concerns seeking the patient, fearing potential danger.
unit.target: Lugano sollicitūdinem habebat quaerendo aegrotum, metuens periculum potentiale.

unit.source: However, as he observed the sunlight gradually brightening and the horizon turning red, a sense of relief washed over him.
unit.target: Attamen, dum paulatim solem fulgentem et horizontem rubescente observābat, sensus levātiōnis eum invasit.

unit.source: At 9 a.m., Lugano returned, informing Lumian that the special patient had recovered exceptionally well.
unit.target: Hora novā ante meridiem, Lugano rediit et Lumian certiōrem fecit specialem aegrotum eximē bene convalescentem esse.

unit.source: There were no signs of surgery failure or hidden dangers, nor indications of corruption.
unit.target: Nullae erant indicia operationis clādīs aut periculōrum occultōrum, nec indicia corruptionis.

unit.source: Around the same time, Captain Pedro approached Lumian, sharing news that the ship would temporarily dock to allow the Church of Earth Mother’s personnel to collect Father Montserrat’s corpse and relics and remove relevant individuals.
unit.target: Circiter eodem tempore, Capitaneus Pedro ad Lumian accessit, nuntiāndo navem temporāriē ad studium ceponi collocandam destinārī, ut ministros Ecclesiae Matris Terrae cadaver Patris Montserrat et reliquiās colligerent atque personās pertinēntēs removerent.

unit.source: Notably, the adventurer and his servant were explicitly excluded from this directive by the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Notabile est adventorem et servum eius ab Ecclesiā Matris Terrae expresse ex hoc praeceptō exceptōs esse.

unit.source: Lumian smiled, offering no response to the captain’s words.
unit.target: Lumian subrīdēns, verba capitānī non respondēns.

unit.source: His demeanor radiated confidence and certainty.
unit.target: Mōrēs eius fidūciam et certitūdinem efferebant.

unit.source: Around noon, several combat nuns and a priest in a brown robe boarded the ship, escorting Enio and others away.
unit.target: Circa meridiem, plures moniālēs pugnantēs et sacerdōs in vestī fuscā navem conscenderunt, Enion et alias comitantes ad sē ducēntes.

unit.source: On the balcony, Lugano observed Enio being “invited” off the ship, his expression a mix of daze and fear, powerless to resist.
unit.target: In balcone, Lugano observāvit Enion ex nave “invitārī”, vultū stupōre et metu mixtō, absque vi ad resistere.

unit.source: Lugano sighed.
unit.target: Lugano suspirāvit.

unit.source: “If he’s fine, why capture him?”
unit.target: “Si bene est, cur eum capere?”

unit.source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian leniter subrīdit.

unit.source: “Do you think it’s nonexistent just because you say so?”
unit.target: “Putesne id non exsistere solum quia ita dicis?”

unit.source: “Be optimistic—after the Church of Earth Mother confirms there’s no issue, he might secure a clerical position within the Church, interacting with combat nuns daily.”
unit.target: “Esto optimus—postquam Ecclesia Matris Terrae confirmāverit nullum esse problema, fortasse munus clericāle in Ecclesiā obtinebit, cotidie cum moniālīs pugnantibus intercedēns.”

unit.source: Lugano fell silent, then after a few seconds, he remarked, “But that also means losing his freedom. He’s a victim…”
unit.target: Lugano silevit, deinde post paucos secundōs remarkāvit: “Sed id etiam libertātem eius amittit. Victima est…”

unit.source: “Freedom?” Lumian scoffed. “The prerequisite for freedom is not endangering others.”
unit.target: “Libertās?” irridēns inquit Lumian. “Praerequisitum libertātis est, ut alīos non in periclīn adducantur.”

unit.source: Despite his stance, as he witnessed the terrified and nervous Enio and recalled the deceased Father Montserrat in his normal persona, Lumian couldn’t help but recall a peculiar phrase his sister would occasionally utter: “All living beings suffer.”
unit.target: Non obstante sua ratione, dum Enion territum et sollicitum videbat atque memoriam Patris Montserrat defunctī in forma ordināriā revocābat, Lumian non potuit quin mentem adferret peculīārem dictum, quod soror eius interdum utterābat: “Omnia viva patiuntur.”

unit.source: Ooo!
unit.target: Ooo!

unit.source: With a whistle, the ship prepared to set sail once again.
unit.target: Cum sibilō, navis iterum in navigandum parāta est.

unit.source: 613 New Commission
unit.target: 613 Nova Commissio

unit.source: A few days later, Lumian lounged on a recliner on the suite’s balcony, soaking in the sea breeze, reveling in the sunlight, and sipping an undiluted Manzan.
unit.target: Paucis diebus postea, Lumian in solio reclinato in balcone suitei iacebat, fruens aura maris, radiis solis delectatus, et Manzan non dilutum sorbens.

unit.source: From his Traveler’s Bag, he retrieved the incomplete umbilical cord from Father Montserrat.
unit.target: Ex sacculo viatoris, funem umbilicalem imperfectum a Patre Montserrat extraxit.

unit.source: The cord was completely charred, stripped of its spirituality.
unit.target: Funis umbilicalis omnino combustus erat, spiritualitate carens.

unit.source: After Lumian’s repeated confirmations, backed by Franca and Jenna’s divination, a conclusion was reached:
unit.target: Post confirmationes repetitas Lumiani, divinatione Francae et Jennae innitens, conclusio evenerat:

unit.source: After the Exorcism Spell, the umbilical cord lost its vitality.
unit.target: Post incantationem exorcismi, funis umbilicalis vitalitatem amisit.

unit.source: Moreover, lacking Beyonder characteristics, it couldn’t function as a mystical item or a main ingredient for charms, agents, weapons, or any other artifacts.
unit.target: Praeterea, proprietatibus Beyonder carens, non potuit fungor ut res mystica aut ut elementum principale ad incantamenta, agentes, arma, aut alias res artificiosas.

unit.source: All it retained now was its distinct uniqueness.
unit.target: Omnia quae nunc retinebat, singularitas distincta eius erant.

unit.source: In simpler terms, it mirrored the mark left on Lumian by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
unit.target: Simplius dictu, repraesentabat notam, quam Blood Emperor Alista Tudor in Lumiano reliquit.

unit.source: Devoid of power and incapable of emitting the fearsome aura of the Great Mother’s Child of God, Lumian couldn’t wield it to intimidate a specific target.
unit.target: Potentia carens et incapax efferendi terribilem aurem Magnae Matris Filii Dei, Lumian id uti non potuit ad aliquem scopus metu imponendum.

unit.source: Lumian surmised that it could only play a role in two scenarios.
unit.target: Lumian suspicatus est id solum in duobus casibus munus habere posse.

unit.source: Firstly, it could act as a casting ingredient, enabling specific spells to wield power beyond ordinary standards or aiding Warlocks in utilizing special spells beyond their usual repertoire.
unit.target: Primum, poterat fungor ut elementum incantandi, permittens incantationibus certis vim ultra limites ordinarios gerere, aut Warlockis auxiliandum ut incantationes speciales extra consuetudinem suam adhiberent.

unit.source: Secondly, it could serve as a supplementary ingredient incorporated during the crafting of mystical items, charms, agents, or Beyonder weapons, imparting unique effects to the final product.
unit.target: Secundo, poterat fungor ut elementum supplementarium incorporatum in fabricando rebus mysticis, amuletis, agentibus, armis, aut alias artefactis Beyonder, singularia effecta producto finali tradens.

unit.source: Naturally, Lumian also believed that such an umbilical cord fragment could prove valuable in the presence of the Great Mother’s bestowed.
unit.target: Naturaliter, Lumian etiam credidit talem fragmentum funis umbilicalis in praesentia dona Magnae Matris valde utile fore.

unit.source: For instance, even without Provocation, he could provoke intense animosity from those individuals.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, etiam sine Provocatione, poterat ab illis hominibus vehementem invidiam excitare.

unit.source: Regrettably, Witches share similarities with Pyromaniacs.
unit.target: Infeliciter, magae similes sunt pyromaniacis.

unit.source: They are restricted to utilizing various black magic bestowed by potions, unable to delve into spell study and master new incantations like Warlocks.
unit.target: Solum variis magiis nigris, potionibus donatis, utuntur et incantationum studium penetrare nec novas incantationes, ut Warlocki, magistrari possunt.

unit.source: Among these black magics, only one, the Bloodline Curse, can be paired with an umbilical cord as a casting ingredient.
unit.target: Inter has magias nigras, sola una, Maledictio Sanguinis, cum funi umbilicali ut elementum incantandi coniungi potest.

unit.source: However, the invisible Child of God has yet to manifest in the real world, rendering the curse ineffective against Him.
unit.target: Attamen, invisibilis Filius Dei nondum in mundo reali apparuit, unde maledictio adversus Eum inefficax manet.

unit.source: Cursing the Great Mother is also off the table, as Franca and Jenna might find themselves with giving birth right there and then…
unit.target: Maledicere Magnam Matrem quoque excluditur, cum Franca et Jenna fortasse statim se in partu inveniant…

unit.source: Yes, at the next meeting at the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society or any other mysticism gathering, I could aim to acquire a mystical item tied to a Warlock Sequence, then amass potent spells that employ umbilical cords or high-level items as casting ingredients.
unit.target: Ita, in proximo conventu apud “Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society” aut in alio coetu mystico, poteram conari rem mysticam, conexam cum Serie Warlock, adipisci, atque incantationes potentes, quae funibus umbilicalibus aut rebus summi gradus ut elementum incantandi adhibeantur, colligere.

unit.source: Uh… isn’t this creating several complications?
unit.target: Heu... nonne hoc complura incommoda creat?

unit.source: In Aurore’s terms, it’s akin to raising a sheep for a plate of coarse salt—nurturing it only to be eventually slaughtered and roasted…
unit.target: Ex loquela Aurore, simile est ovem nutrire ad mensam salis grossi, sed quae, postquam colata est, tandem trucidata et tosta fiat…

unit.source: I’ve not needed to seek out an Artisan for crafting mystical items lately, and the absence of primary ingredients complicates matters.
unit.target: Nuper non opus fuit mihi artifex quaerere ad res mysticas conficiendas, et defectus ingredientium principalium res complicat.

unit.source: Alternatively, should I transform it into a Beyonder weapon with limited use?
unit.target: Aliter, an id in armum Beyonder in usum limitatum convertere debeam?

unit.source: This isn’t ideal.
unit.target: Hoc non est optimum.

unit.source: There’s a contamination risk if an insufficiently skilled Artisan incorporates it as a supplementary ingredient.
unit.target: Periculum contaminationis exsistit, si artifex parum peritus id ut elementum supplementarium incorporaverit.

unit.source: It’s not worthwhile enlisting the help of a high-level Artisan for what seems like a practically useless item…
unit.target: Non est utile auxilium artificis summi gradus capere pro re quae fere inutilis videtur.

unit.source: What about fashioning charms and agents myself?
unit.target: Quid de ipsis amuletis et agentibus a me conficiendis?

unit.source: Lumian scrutinized the charred short umbilical cord for an extended period, grappling with indecision.
unit.target: Lumian funem umbilicalem exustum, brevem, diu perscrutatus est, indecisione luctans.

unit.source: Eventually, he returned it to his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Postremo, id in sacculo viatoris sui retribuit.

unit.source: Then, Lumian reached into his pocket, where a finger from Mr. K sat.
unit.target: Tum, Lumian in sinum suum immisit, ubi digitus a Domino K sedebat.

unit.source: In the past two days, he had undertaken a special “return” to Trier to brief Mr. K about Father Montserrat and the invisible Child of God.
unit.target: In duobus diebus praeteritis, iter speciale ad Trier cepit, ut Domino K de Patre Montserrat et invisibili Filio Dei exponeret.

unit.source: He received unreserved approval and praise from Mr. K.
unit.target: Accepit approbationem sincera et laudes a Domino K.

unit.source: The enthusiasm and fervor led Lumian to suspect that Mr. K might, in the next moment, sever his own arm and offer it to him.
unit.target: Laetitia et fervor Lumiani duciverunt ut suspiceret Domini K, in proximo momento, brachium suum abscindere atque illi offerre posse.

unit.source: His fingers seemed insufficient to convey the depth of his emotions!
unit.target: Digiti eius videbantur insufficientes ad profunditatem affectuum eius exponendam!

unit.source: Mr. K expressed great satisfaction with his decision to permit Lumian to leave Trier and pursue his adversaries.
unit.target: Dominus K magnam satisfactionem de sua decisione expressit, qua Lumian Trier relinquere et adversarios persequi licuit.

unit.source: He perceived it as the Lord’s revelation and commended Lumian’s peculiar affinity for heretics and incidents involving evil gods, seeing him as a walking calamity for the fallen.
unit.target: Id perspexit ut revelationem Domini et laudavit singularem affectionem Lumiani erga haereticos atque casus deorum malignorum, eumque tamquam calamitatem ambulantem pro lapsis considerans.

unit.source: How could a Beyonder of such stature confine himself to Trier?
unit.target: Quomodo Beyonder tali statura se in Trier tenere potuit?

unit.source: It was imperative to explore various locations in the Northern and Southern Continents!
unit.target: Necesse erat loca varia explorare in Continente Septentrionali et Meridionali!

unit.source: Regarding the name of the ancient Goddess of Harvest, Omebella, Mr. K didn’t exhibit a notable reaction, nor did he seek an immediate revelation from his Lord.
unit.target: Quoad nomen deae antiquitatis Messis, Omebella, Dominus K responsum notabilem non exhibuit neque revelationem immediatam a Domino petivit.

unit.source: Lumian, failing to secure an answer, bid farewell and departed.
unit.target: Lumian, responsum non obtinens, vale dixit et discessit.

unit.source: Instead, he sought out Franca, Jenna, and Anthony to share the details of the surgical removal, human refinement, and Father Montserrat’s near‐conception of the Great Mother’s Child of God as a man.
unit.target: Pro illis, Francam, Jennam, et Antonium quaesivit ut enarraret singula de excisione chirurgica, de emendatione humana, atque de prope conceptione Filii Dei Magnae Matris ut hominis ex Patre Montserrat.

unit.source: While Franca and Jenna were already acquainted with the Sowers of the Villain pathway, the connection with Father Montserrat left them feeling like they were hearing a horror story, traumatized by the bestowed of the Great Mother.
unit.target: Dum Franca et Jenna iam iter Sementariorum Malefactorum noverant, coniunctio cum Patre Montserrat eos reliquit quasi fabulam horroris audire, a dono Magnae Matris traumatizatos.

unit.source: Anthony displayed no overt reaction, but he made a rare gesture.
unit.target: Antonius nullam reactionem manifestae exhibuit, sed rarum gestum effecit.

unit.source: Unconsciously, he gently stroked his stomach.
unit.target: Inconscius, leniter ventrem suum tetigit.

unit.source: After conveying his sentiments, Lumian returned to the ship contentedly, resuming his journey to the southernmost part of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Postquam sensus suos transmisit, Lumian in nave laetus rediit, iter ad meridionalissimam partem regni Feynapotter repetens.

unit.source: Knock, knock, knock.
unit.target: Toc, toc, toc.

unit.source: Lumian had just flipped through the Dutanese textbook for a few minutes when a series of knocks echoed on the suite’s wooden door.
unit.target: Lumian vix librum Dutanensem per paucos minutas percurrebat, cum serie pulsuum in ostium ligneum suitei resonare coepit.

unit.source: Lugano, ever diligent, played the role of a servant, making his way to the door and peering through the peephole.
unit.target: Lugano, semper diligens, munus servi egit; ad ianuam processit et per speculum parvum intueri coepit.

unit.source: In the past few days, the absence of baby cries had eased his anxious heart.
unit.target: In paucis diebus praeteritis, absentia clamorum parvulorum cor eius anxium levaverat.

unit.source: This incident only heightened his gratitude for choosing to stay with his employer rather than returning to Trier.
unit.target: Hoc factum gratiam eius tantopere auxit, quod cum domino suo manere potuit, potius quam ad Trier redire.

unit.source: Lugano believed that if the issue stemmed from the Beyonder ingredients left behind by Tanko, even if he hadn’t boarded this ship, he would have encountered a similar situation sooner or later.
unit.target: Lugano credidit, si quaestio ex ingredientibus Beyonder a Tanko relictis oriretur, etiam si hanc navem non conscenderet, similem condicionem aliquando experiturum fuisse.

unit.source: Moreover, the wait wouldn’t be long — perhaps a year or even half a year.
unit.target: Praeterea, exspectatio non diu manebit — fortasse annus aut etiam dimidium anni.

unit.source: Without the aid of a powerful Beyonder like Lumian Lee, his fate would have been quite clear.
unit.target: Sine auxilio Beyonder potentis, ut Lumian Lee, fatum eius perspicuus fuisset.

unit.source: Spotting Captain Pedro outside, Lugano turned to Lumian, who was on the balcony, and informed him, "Boss, the captain is looking for you!"
unit.target: Viderunt Capitanum Pedrum extra, Lugano ad Lumian, qui in balcone erat, conversus est, et ei dixit: "Domine, capitanus te quaerit!"

unit.source: Why would the captain seek me out?
unit.target: Cur capitanus me quaereret?

unit.source: Shouldn’t we tacitly overlook what happened?
unit.target: Num id, quod accidit, non tacite praetermittere deberemus?

unit.source: Lumian closed the Dutanese textbook and returned to the living room, bathed in bright sunlight.
unit.target: Lumian librum Dutanensem clausit et ad conclave rediit, in luce solis fulgenti.

unit.source: Pedro, sporting a handsome brown beard, entered the suite and exchanged pleasantries.
unit.target: Pedro, cum barba brunnea decora gerens, in suite intravit et verba amicitiae commutavit.

unit.source: Clearing his throat, he said, "Mr. Berry, are you interested in taking on a commission? It’s a straightforward one and won’t consume much of your time."
unit.target: Gutture purgato, dixit: "Domine Berry, an commissionem suscipere vis? Ea simplex est et non multum temporis consumet."

unit.source: Straightforward? I doubt it would remain so after being entrusted to me…
unit.target: Simplex? Dubito quin ita maneat postquam mihi commissum fuerit…

unit.source: After various experiences, he gained a better understanding of his unique constitution: As a Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, harboring an evil god’s angel within him and concealed remnants of the Blood Emperor’s aura, he naturally attracted calamities, prematurely unveiling problems that might have remained hidden.
unit.target: Post varias experientias, melius intellexit singularem constitutionem suam: ut Beyonder viae Venatoris, angelum dei mali intra se portans et reliquias occultas aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis, naturaliter calamitates attrahens, atque ante tempus problemata revelans quae fortasse latere potuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t foresee how a supposedly simple commission would unfold.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit praevidere quomodo commissio, simplicis specie existens, evolveretur.

unit.source: Seated in an armchair, Lumian smiled and responded, "What commission? I’ll listen to the specifics before deciding whether to accept it."
unit.target: Sedeo in solio bracchato, Lumian subridens respondit: "Quae commissio? Specialia auscultabo antequam decernam utrum eam suscipiam."

unit.source: Pedro sighed, beginning to explain, "The destination of this voyage is Port Colla, my hometown."
unit.target: Pedro suspiravit et explanare coepit: "Destinatio huius peregrinationis est Portus Colla, oppidum meum natale."

unit.source: My wife and children live there.
unit.target: Uxor mea et liberi mei ibi habitant.

unit.source: "At the start of the year, my beloved eldest daughter, Salah, fell in love with a young man."
unit.target: "Initio anni, amata filia mea primogenita, Salah, in iuvenem amore cecidit."

unit.source: "She was passionate and eager to marry him."
unit.target: "Erat ardens et vehementer eum in matrimonium ducere cupiebat."

unit.source: "As you’re aware, in Feynapotter, marriage and family are held in high regard."
unit.target: "Ut nosti, in Feynapotter, matrimonium et familia magni aestimantur."

unit.source: "We must approach marriage cautiously and maintain it responsibly."
unit.target: "Matrimonium caute aggrediendum, et more responsabili conservandum, oportet."

unit.source: "Blindly rushing into the cathedral isn’t our way."
unit.target: "Caeca in catedrali festinatio non est via nostra."

unit.source: "Is that lad displeasing to you and your Matriarch? Are you hiring me to silence him?" Lumian teased.
unit.target: "Num ille puer tibi et matriarcha tua displicet? An me conducis ut eum silentiare faciam?" Lumian iocose replicavit.

unit.source: "Honestly, there’s no need for such trouble."
unit.target: "Sincere, talis molestia non est necessaria."

unit.source: "A captain like you surely has plenty of ways to handle inexperienced young people."
unit.target: "Capitano ut te, certe plures habes modos iuvenes inexpertos tractandi."

unit.source: "For instance, give him an opportunity and entice him into the sea trade—only for him to never return."
unit.target: "Exempli gratia, ei occasionem da et eum in mercaturam maritimam induc, ut numquam revertatur."

unit.source: Pedro chuckled dryly and responded, "I’m a law-abiding citizen. I won’t resort to such measures."
unit.target: Pedro sic subridens respondit: "Civis legibus obsequens sum. Non ad talia consilia recurram."

unit.source: A sea-faring captain with Beyonder abilities is a law-abiding citizen? Spare me the humor…
unit.target: Capitano maritimo cum facultatibus Beyonder, civis legibus obsequens? Noli mihi talia ioca afferre…

unit.source: Lumian criticized, smiling at Pedro, prompting him to continue.
unit.target: Lumian, ad Pedrum subridens reprehendens, eum ad prosequendum instigavit.

unit.source: "I probed the young man and sensed something amiss."
unit.target: "Puerum indagai et aliquid inordinatum sensi."

unit.source: "I hired adventurers to investigate him, but the two adventurers never returned," Pedro explained earnestly.
unit.target: "Conduxi adventuros ut eum indagarent, sed duo adventores numquam redierunt," Pedro sincere explicavit.

unit.source: "This raised my alarm."
unit.target: "Hoc me excitavit."

unit.source: "I don’t want my child involved with such a person. It’s too risky."
unit.target: "Nolo filium meum cum tali persona coniungi. Nimis periculosum est."

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: "Is that why you’ve sought me out?"
unit.target: "Num ideo me quaesivisti?"

unit.source: "Yes," Pedro admitted, forcing a smile.
unit.target: "Ita," Pedro agnovit, subsurridens.

unit.source: "To you, this may seem trivial, but it’s of utmost importance to me."
unit.target: "Tibi fortasse parva videatur, sed mihi maximi momenti est."

unit.source: "I’m willing to pay 20,000 gold risot as compensation."
unit.target: "Paratus sum 20,000 risot aureorum ad compensationem solvendam."

unit.source: "All spoils are yours."
unit.target: "Omnia praeda tua erunt."

unit.source: 20,000 gold risot.
unit.target: 20,000 risot aureorum.

unit.source: Being a captain seems quite lucrative…
unit.target: Esse capitaneum videtur valde lucrativum…

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked, "Are you a Beyonder of the Planter or Apothecary pathway?"
unit.target: Lumian paulo meditatus est et interrogavit: "Esne Beyonder viae Plantatoris aut Apothecarii?"

unit.source: "Are there any Beyonders from these two pathways in your family?"
unit.target: "Suntne Beyonder ex his duabus viis in familia tua?"

unit.source: What kind of question is that…
unit.target: "Qualis quaestio est ista…"

unit.source: Pedro was taken aback.
unit.target: Pedro obstupuit.

unit.source: "No."
unit.target: "Non."

unit.source: "Why haven’t you sought help from the Church?" Lumian inquired, posing a second question.
unit.target: "Cur auxilium Ecclesiae non petivisti?" Lumian interrogavit.

unit.source: Pedro’s expression darkened.
unit.target: Aspectus Pedri obscuratus est.

unit.source: After a brief silence, he sighed and replied, "As expected of an experienced adventurer."
unit.target: Post breve silentium, suspiravit et dixit: "Ut exspectabatur ab experto viatore."

unit.source: "I didn’t approach the Church because something is off with my daughter, Salah."
unit.target: "Non petivi Ecclesiam, quia in filia mea, Salah, aliquid male est."

unit.source: "Her infatuation with that young man is too intense, and she rejects reason."
unit.target: "Eius infatuatio erga illum iuvenem nimis intensa est, et rationem repellit."

unit.source: "It’s as if she’s possessed by a demon."
unit.target: "Sicut a daemone possessa sit."

unit.source: "Seeking the Church could resolve the issue, but it might also lead to a negative encounter and outcome for Salah."
unit.target: "Quaerere Ecclesiam quaestionem solvere posset, sed etiam ad infaustam congressionem et eventum pro Salah ducere posset."

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian cogitanter annuit.

unit.source: "Do you suspect that Salah has been influenced or even possessed by an unknown entity?"
unit.target: "Suspicisne fortasse Salah a ente ignoto influentam esse aut possessa esse?"

unit.source: "Yes," Pedro admitted, appearing worried.
unit.target: "Ita," Pedro agnovit, sollicite se ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian asked a few more questions and took a moment to reflect before stating, "Alright, I accept this commission."
unit.target: Lumian pauca alia interrogavit et paulisper meditatus est, deinde dicens: "Recte, hanc commissionem accipio."

unit.source: He had to consistently pursue opportunities and work towards digesting the Conspirer potion to a level where he could conduct an advancement ritual upon reaching West Balam in the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Debebat constanter occasiones persequi et ad potionem Conspiratoris digerendam operam dare, ut gradum attingeret quo ritus progressionis celebrari posset, perveniens ad West Balam in Continente Meridionali.

unit.source: Of course, saving up funds for Ludwig’s meals was another motivation.
unit.target: Certe, pecuniam ad cibos Ludovigi servandos colligere altera causa fuit.

unit.source: A few days later, at 10 p.m., in Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Trier.
unit.target: Paucis diebus post, hora decima vespertina, in Apartmento 702, 9 Rue Orosai, Quartiere Cathédralis Commémorativæ, Trier.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna glanced at Anthony, who had just knocked and entered, puzzled.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna Antonium conspexerunt, qui modo pulsavit et intravit, perplexus.

unit.source: "Why are you here at this time of day?"
unit.target: "Cur hic es in hoc tempore diei?"

unit.source: Anthony nodded.
unit.target: Antonius annuit.

unit.source: "I’ve found that woman."
unit.target: "Illam mulierem inveni."

unit.source: Huh?
unit.target: "Heu?"

unit.source: Jenna was momentarily surprised before questioning, "The woman who appeared in the Magic Mirror Divination?"
unit.target: Jenna paulisper stupefacta est, deinde interrogavit: "Mulier illa quae in Divinatione Speculi Magici apparuit?"

unit.source: The woman whose presence caused the Mirror World Fragment on me to tremble slightly?
unit.target: Mulier, cuius praesentia fragmentum Mundi Speculi in me leviter tremere faciebat?

unit.source: Anthony affirmed with certainty, "Yes."
unit.target: Antonius certo affirmavit: "Ita."

unit.source: 614 Under‐the‐table Transaction
unit.target: 614 Negotiatio sub mensa

unit.source: Delilah Le Roy, daughter of a gem merchant, already wed with offspring—a boy and girl—indulges in opera, theater, and literature.
unit.target: Delilah Le Roy, filia mercatoris gemmarum, iam nupta cum prole—puer et puella—in opera, theatro, atque litteris delectat.

unit.source: Despite the prior incident in Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra, she persists in her activities, easily located by my informant within a week…
unit.target: Non obstante praeterito casu in Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra, illa in suis negotiis perseverat atque a notario meo intra hebdomadam facile deprehenditur…

unit.source: Not one for bodyguards, she ventures out with only her lady’s maid and a valet in tow…
unit.target: Ipsa non ad custodes corporis nititur; sola cum ancilla sua et ministro exiit.

unit.source: Seated in a window booth at a street café, Jenna mentally reviewed the compiled data, observing the refined lady with makeup befitting her stature disembark from her carriage and enter Trier’s esteemed Avenue du Boulevard’s Bonnie department store.
unit.target: Sedens in cella ad fenestram cauponae viariae, Jenna data conligata mente recensuit, atque vidit elegantem mulierem, cui ornamenta faciei digna erant, e vehiculo descendere atque in praeclaram tabernam “Bonnie” Trieris, sita in Avenue du Boulevard, ingredi.

unit.source: Jenna redirected her attention, acknowledging Anthony Reid seated diagonally across from her.
unit.target: Jenna suam attentionem vertit, agnoscens Anthonym Reid, qui in diagonali parte trans eam sedet.

unit.source: “That’s her.”
unit.target: “Illa est.”

unit.source: Franca, positioned on the same side as Jenna, deliberated before speaking, “The issue at hand… Is she baiting us?
unit.target: Franca, in eadem parte quam Jenna posita, ante verba aliquam deliberavit, et inquit: “Num nos decipit?”

unit.source: If her reaction was merely surprise without understanding, we might glean little of value.
unit.target: Si eius reactio solum erat stupefactio sine intellegentia, parum utilitatis ex ea colligere possumus.

unit.source: Should she persist in her high‐profile activities despite the resonance with the Mirror World Fragment, it’s plausible that she or the person behind her seeks to draw out the Mirror World Fragment’s holder.”
unit.target: Si illa in negotiis suis eminentibus perseveraverit, non obstante resonantia Fragmenti Mundi Speculi, verisimile est eam vel illum, qui eam sequitur, tenentem Fragmenti Mundi Speculi exducere quaerere.

unit.source: Having assessed the scenario, Franca concluded, “Engaging with Delilah recklessly poses significant risks.”
unit.target: Rea re aestimata, Franca conclusit: “Temeraria conloquia cum Delilah pericula gravia nascunt.”

unit.source: “But our Magic Mirror Divination assures the safety of today’s operation,” Jenna countered.
unit.target: “Sed nostra Divinatio Speculi Magici salutem hodiernae operationis confirmat,” Jenna respondit.

unit.source: Franca smiled in response.
unit.target: Franca responso subridens effudit.

unit.source: “Place not undue faith in divination.”
unit.target: “Noli nimiam fidem in divinatione ponere.”

unit.source: “Moreover, the danger may not be immediate.”
unit.target: “Etiam periculum fortasse non statim imminet.”

unit.source: “Hastily engaging with Delilah could disrupt our future leads.”
unit.target: “Temere cum Delilah congredi potest, quae futuras nostras indagationes turbāre potest.”

unit.source: “So, we stand by? Wait a month or two until tensions ease before acting?”
unit.target: “Ergo, manemus? Exspectemus unum vel duas menses, donec tensiones minuantur, antequam agamus?”

unit.source: Jenna pondered briefly, then sat upright, revealing her plan, “I have an idea!”
unit.target: Jenna parum meditata, deinde recta consedit, consilium suum revelans: “Idea mihi est!”

unit.source: “What is it?” Franca inquired, intrigued.
unit.target: “Quid est?” Franca interrogavit, curiosa.

unit.source: Jenna pursed her lips and smiled.
unit.target: Jenna labra contraxit et subridens arriduit.

unit.source: “Employ the mystical item—Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
unit.target: “Adhibe rem mysticam—Negotio sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis.

unit.source: It grants us a discreet opportunity to interact with Delilah unnoticed.”
unit.target: Ea nobis dat discretam occasionem ut, absque notitia, cum Delilah colloquamur.

unit.source: “This way, if the issue stems from the person behind Delilah, our contact remains concealed, preserving the trail of clues.
unit.target: “Hoc modo, si quaestio ex persona post Delilah provenit, contactus noster permaneat absconditus, vestigia servata.

unit.source: And if Delilah herself is the concern, we can swiftly transition from contact to control.”
unit.target: Et, si ipsa Delilah causa sit, celeriter ab contactu ad imperium procedere possumus.”

unit.source: Franca contemplated the proposal with gravity for a brief moment.
unit.target: Franca propositum grave parum temporis meditata est.

unit.source: “It’s not implausible…”
unit.target: “Non est impossibile…”

unit.source: “I’m actually interested in testing the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction myself.”
unit.target: “Revera mihi interest experiri Negotium sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis.”

unit.source: “No need to contest it.”
unit.target: “Nulla necessitas est id adversari.”

unit.source: “I’m a Sequence higher than you, and my self‐preservation capabilities surpass yours.”
unit.target: “Ego sum gradus altior quam tu, et facultates meae ad propriam conservationem superiores sunt tuis.”

unit.source: “Even if evil entities like demons seek a trade, I can invoke Madam Judgment, a formidable Arbiter, as my witness!”
unit.target: “Etiams, si entia mala, ut daemonia, mercatum quaerant, possum Domnam Iudicium, arbitrum formidabilem, invocare ut testis meus fungatur!”

unit.source: The Demoness of Pleasure appeared eager to put the mystical item to the test.
unit.target: Daemonissa Voluptatis videbatur avidā esse ut rem mysticam probaret.

unit.source: Jenna remained silent for a few seconds before consenting, “Alright.”
unit.target: Jenna paucos secundos siluit antequam assensit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Anthony continued, “I’ll handle the brief encounter.
unit.target: Anthony pergit: “Ego brevem congressionem curabo.

unit.source: Using a Hypnotist ensures no lingering clues or traces for the person behind Delilah to discover.”
unit.target: Ut Hypnotista uter, id efficit ne ullae vestigia aut indicia personae post Delilah detegenda sint.”

unit.source: “No issue.”
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio.”

unit.source: Franca dispensed with formalities, directing her gaze at Jenna, awaiting the retrieval of the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
unit.target: Franca formalia deiecit, oculum ad Jennam dirigens, exspectans recuperationem Negotii sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis.

unit.source: Dressed in grayish-white attire with brown leather armor, Jenna, like many female mercenaries, carried a leather brown backpack.
unit.target: Induta vestimentis cinereo-albens et lorica ex pelle fusca, Jenna, sicut multae mercenariae, ferens habebat sarcinam coriaceam fuscam.

unit.source: From the backpack, she retrieved a small, dark‑painted wooden box adorned with a membrane curtain on each side, placing it on the table in the café’s private room.
unit.target: Ex sacco dorsali extraxit parvam arcam ligneam, nigro pictam, utrinque membranis ornatam, quam super mensam in conclavi privato cauponae posuit.

unit.source: Franca weighed the terms of her request against the price of the Authority Holder’s Bribe powers.
unit.target: Franca condiciones petitionis suae ponderavit ratione pretiumque potestatum corruptae Tenentis Auctoritatis.

unit.source: Rolling up the sleeve of her lady’s shirt, she reached through the membrane curtain on one side of the wooden box with a small cloth bag containing 100 Louis d’or in her right hand.
unit.target: Manicam tunicae ancillae suae revolvens, per membranam unius lateris arcis ligneae, manu dextro eduxit parvum sacculum linteum, quod centum Louis d’or continebat.

unit.source: Although the usage instructions didn’t explicitly exclude banknotes, Franca, drawing on her extensive mystic experience, opted for gold coins, a more universally accepted form of currency.
unit.target: Quamquam praecepta usus non expresse notas argentarias excludebant, Franca, ampla experientia mystica innixa, aureos nummos elegit, quos forma pecuniaria latissime recepta est.

unit.source: In the next instant, she felt contact with wrinkled and moist skin, five fingers enclosing around the cloth bag containing the gold coins.
unit.target: Deinde sensit tactum cutis rugosae et umidae, quinque digitis circumplexante sacculum linteum, quod aureos nummos contineret.

unit.source: Suppressing a momentary surge of disgust, Franca articulated her request in Hermes.
unit.target: Subprimens momentum nauseae, Franca in sermone Hermes petitionem suam expressit.

unit.source: “I desire an uninterrupted, unobserved, and highly discreet face‑to‑face encounter lasting over three minutes between my friend Anthony Reid, seated across from me, and Delilah, a member of the Le Roy gem merchant family in the nearby Bonnie department store.”
unit.target: “Cupio congressum facie ad faciem sine interruptione, non observatum ac valde discretum, quod ultra tres minuta durabit, inter amicum meum Anthonym Reid, qui trans me sedet, et Delilah, cuius pars est familiae mercatorum gemmarum Le Roy in proximo loco tabernae “Bonnie”.”

unit.source: Franca had included meticulous qualifiers, ensuring precision in the parties meeting and the manner of their encounter to avoid any distortion.
unit.target: Franca diligenter qualitates addidit, ut conventus partium atque ratio congressus sine ullo ambiguitate fieret.

unit.source: The object with the wrinkled and wet palm‑like texture lifted the cloth bag containing the gold coins and withdrew.
unit.target: Objectum, cui textura similis erat rugosae et umidae palmae, sacculum linteum aureos nummos continebat, sustulit et se recepit.

unit.source: This signified the agreement of the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction.
unit.target: Id significabat consensum Negotiationis sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis.

unit.source: Franca withdrew her right hand, using a white handkerchief to meticulously cleanse the touched area while expressing her discomfort with continuous spitting.
unit.target: Franca dextram manum revocavit, albo sudario aream tactam diligenter purgandam adhibens, dum de molestia incessantis sputationis agnitionem faciebat.

unit.source: “Where should we position ourselves while waiting for the opportunity to meet?” Anthony inquired.
unit.target: “Ubi nos collocemus dum occasionem conventus exspectamus?” Anthony rogavit.

unit.source: Franca stowed away her handkerchief, offering a smile.
unit.target: Franca sudarium suum recondidit, subridens.

unit.source: “The request specified only two individuals: yourself and Delilah Le Roy.
unit.target: “Petitum duos solum homines designavit: te et Delilah Le Roy.

unit.source: Consequently, your best chance is to shadow her until the opportunity arises.”
unit.target: Ergo, optima tibi occasio est ut eam secuta maneas, donec occasio proveniat.”

unit.source: “Fair enough…”
unit.target: “Recte.”

unit.source: At this juncture, Franca retrieved the resplendent Seven‑Stone Bracelet from her Traveler’s Bag, extending it towards Anthony.
unit.target: In hoc momento, Franca e sacculo viatori suo armillam splendidam ex septem lapidibus edidit, eam ad Anthonym extendens.

unit.source: “In case of any complications, teleport away immediately.”
unit.target: “Si qua difficultas eveniat, statim teleporte discede.”

unit.source: Observing the seriousness in the Demoness of Pleasure’s demeanor, Anthony swallowed his inclination to politely refuse and accepted the Seven‑Stone Bracelet.
unit.target: Animadvertens severitatem in habitu Daemonissae Voluptatis, Anthony modum urbanum recusandi subripuit et armillam septem lapidum accepit.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Franca suggested, “If you place trust in me, I can craft a Paper Figurine Substitute using your blood and hair.”
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, Franca proposuit: “Si mihi fiduciam tribuis, figuram papyraceam repraesentativam ex sanguine et capillis tuis fabricare possum.”

unit.source: Anthony remained silent for a few seconds before agreeing, “Okay.”
unit.target: Anthony paucos secundos siluit, tum assensum dedit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Within the confines of the Bonnie department store, Anthony swiftly pinpointed Delilah Le Roy, exercising his keen observation skills as a Hypnotist.
unit.target: Intra limites tabernae “Bonnie”, Anthony celeriter Delilah Le Roy deprehendit, acutis observationis viribus ut Hypnotista utebatur.

unit.source: Delilah stood amidst the first floor, accompanied by her lady’s maid and the valet, engrossed in a magician’s performance held by the department store to elevate the ambiance.
unit.target: Delilah in primo tabulato stetit, comitata ancilla sua et ministro, et in spectaculo magi, quod taberna departmentalis obtulit ad ambientem levandum, absorpta est.

unit.source: In the midst of the spectacle, the magician’s assistant wheeled in a substantial wooden box capable of accommodating three to four individuals.
unit.target: In medio spectaculi, minister magi ingentem arcam ligneam, quae tres ad quattuor homines capere valeat, introduxit.

unit.source: The magician, with a theatrical flourish, removed his top hat and made an announcement.
unit.target: Magi, vultu theatrali, pileum suum detraxit et pronuntiavit.

unit.source: “For my next act, I require the assistance of two fortunate members of the audience.
unit.target: “Pro proximo actu meo, auxilium duorum fortunatorum membrorum audientiae mihi necessarium est.”

unit.source: “Madame, would you do me the honor of joining me on stage?”
unit.target: “Domina, honorem mihi faceres si te in scaenam meam accedere velis?”

unit.source: The magician’s invitation was directed at Delilah Le Roy.
unit.target: Invitatio magi ad Delilah Le Roy directe versa est.

unit.source: Though hesitant, Delilah couldn’t muster a refusal and reluctantly ascended the wooden stage prepared for the magical performance.
unit.target: Licet dubitans, Delilah recusationem conficere non potuit et, invito animo, in scaenam ligneam ad spectaculum magicum destinatam ascendit.

unit.source: A weak personality and a difficulty in declining others… Perhaps influenced by the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction… Anthony vaguely anticipated the nature of the intended meeting as he observed Delilah’s demeanor.
unit.target: Indole debili et difficultate aliis recusandi… Forsitan negotio sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis impulsi… Anthony vix perspiciat naturam conventus destinati, dum Delilah habitum contemplabatur.

unit.source: With a calculated step forward, he drew the attention of the magician.
unit.target: Cum gradu computato adgrediens, animadvertit vi magi attentionem attulit.

unit.source: “This gentleman, please join us on stage as well.”
unit.target: “Hi vir, quaeso, nobiscum etiam in scaenam adiunge.”

unit.source: Feigning reluctance, Anthony awkwardly made his way up onto the stage.
unit.target: Simulans reticentiam, Anthony torpide in scaenam ascendit.

unit.source: The magician gestured toward the wooden box, instructing, “Please take a seat inside.”
unit.target: Magi ad arcam ligneam gesticulavit et praecepit: “Quaeso, intus sedete.”

unit.source: Pursing her lips, Delilah sighed and, urged by the crowd, entered the wooden box.
unit.target: Labris contractis, Delilah exhalavit et, a multitudo impulsata, in arcam ligneam ingressa est.

unit.source: Choosing a seat the furthest from her, Anthony, while there was still illumination, offered a smile and remarked, “Truth be told, I feel a bit embarrassed too.”
unit.target: Eligens sedem remotissimam ab illa, Anthony, dum adhuc lumen praesens erat, subridens locum occupavit et inquit: “Verum dicam, et ego paulum erubesco.”

unit.source: His words were delivered with a calm and genial tone, causing Delilah’s tense demeanor to ease.
unit.target: Verba eius miti et amabili toni edita levaverunt tensionem animi Delilah.

unit.source: Anthony continued, “Don’t believe me? Look me in the eye.”
unit.target: Anthony pergit: “Nonne mihi credis? Intuere oculos meos.”

unit.source: He pointed to his eyes, inviting her gaze.
unit.target: Ad oculos suos digito intendit, invitans ut eos aspiceret.

unit.source: Delilah instinctively turned her gaze toward a pair of dark brown eyes reflecting her figure.
unit.target: Instinctu, Delilah oculos convertit ad duo oculos fusce brunnea, quae figuram eius referunt.

unit.source: My figure… Delilah was caught off guard as her gaze seemed to descend into a spiraling depth.
unit.target: “Figura mea…” Delilah improvisa obstupefacta est, cum videbatur oculis in profundum spirantem demergere.

unit.source: In that moment, the magician closed the wooden box, enveloping it in darkness.
unit.target: In illo momento, magus arcam ligneam claudidit, eam in obscuritate complectens.

unit.source: Seizing the opportune moment, Anthony posed a question, “Did you experience anything unusual in Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra a week ago?”
unit.target: Occasionem capiens, Anthony quaesivit: “Num quid insolitum in Quartier de la Maison d’Opéra abhinc septimana sensisti?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Delilah responded truthfully, sensing a trustworthy demeanor.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Delilah sincera, dignitatem fiduciae sentiens.

unit.source: “What was that sensation?” Anthony inquired as the magician recited his rehearsed lines.
unit.target: “Quae fuit illa sensatio?” Anthony interrogavit, dum magus lineas exercitatas recitabat.

unit.source: “My heart started racing, and my blood felt like it was boiling,” Delilah recounted her experience.
unit.target: “Cor meum incipiebat celeriter pulsare, et sanguis meus quasi bullire videbatur,” Delilah narravit.

unit.source: “Do you know what that means?” Anthony probed further.
unit.target: “Scis quid hoc significet?” Anthony quaesivit.

unit.source: In the darkness, Delilah shook her head.
unit.target: In tenebris, Delilah caput negantem movit.

unit.source: “I’m not sure, but my real father instructed me to inform him immediately if I had similar sensations.”
unit.target: “Nescio quidem, sed verus pater meus mihi imperavit ut statim eum certiorem facerem, si similia sensa haberem.”

unit.source: “Real father?” Anthony had a hunch.
unit.target: “Verus pater?” Anthony suspicatus est.

unit.source: Delilah chuckled self‐deprecatingly, explaining, “My real father, my mother’s lover, and the current government’s Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny.”
unit.target: Delilah subridens modeste explicavit: “Verus pater meus, amator matris meae, ac praesens Minister Industriae, Moran Avigny.”

unit.source: Moran Avigny…
unit.target: Moran Avigny…

unit.source: Sensing the magician’s maneuvers with the wooden box, Anthony swiftly posed a final question.
unit.target: Animadvertens cursus magi cum arca lignea, Anthony celeriter quaestionem ultimam proposuit.

unit.source: “What did he say upon learning about your reaction?”
unit.target: “Quid dixit, cum de tua reactione cognovit?”

unit.source: “He told me not to worry and to continue living as usual,” Delilah admitted, still harboring some concerns.
unit.target: “Mihi dixit ne cures et ut vitam progrediaris ut solet,” Delilah agnovit, adhuc nonnulla angora haberens.

unit.source: Anthony acknowledged her words succinctly.
unit.target: Anthony verba eius breviter agnovit.

unit.source: “Lovely lady, I’m thrilled to share this magic moment with you.
unit.target: “Domina formosa, exsulto quod hunc magicum momentum tecum communicare possim.

unit.source: Can you provide me with something memorable?
unit.target: Potesne mihi aliquod memorabile donare?

unit.source: Perhaps a few strands of your hair.”
unit.target: Fortasse nonnullos capillos tuos.”

unit.source: His voice, deep and captivating, made Delilah feel that the request was entirely normal.
unit.target: Vox eius, profunda et ammorbida, Delilah efficivit ut petitionem penitus naturalem esse putaret.

unit.source: Consequently, she plucked a few strands of hair and handed them to Anthony.
unit.target: Itaque nonnullos capillos evellit et Anthoni tradidit.

unit.source: Upon touching the hair, Anthony sighed in relief and continued in a resonant voice, “I don’t want this to jeopardize your family.
unit.target: Tantum capillos tetigi, Anthony ex suspirio levato pergit: “Nolo ut hoc familiam tuam in periculum adducat.

unit.source: Once you step out of this wooden box and hear my snap, you’ll forget our interaction here…”
unit.target: Quam primum ex arca lignea exeieris et sonitum meum audieris, interactionem nostram hic oblivisceris…”

unit.source: As his compelling voice echoed, Delilah’s thoughts blurred.
unit.target: Dum vox eius resonans audiebatur, cogitationes Delilah obnubilabantur.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Smack!

unit.source: The wooden box opened, revealing only Anthony.
unit.target: Arca lignea aperta est, solum Anthonym revelans.

unit.source: Delilah, on the other hand, had been gracefully pulled from behind the stage by the magician.
unit.target: Delilah, autem, a mago elegantissime ab scaena retrahita est.

unit.source: The audience erupted in excited applause.
unit.target: Audientia excitato plausu effusa est.

unit.source: Once the ovation died down, the magician, hand pressed to his chest, bowed in gratitude.
unit.target: Postquam ovatio decedebat, magus manum ad pectus premebat et gratias egit inclinans.

unit.source: Without casting a glance at Delilah, Anthony snapped his fingers.
unit.target: Sine Delilah intuendo, Anthony digitos celeriter concussit.

unit.source: Intent on engaging in conversation with the man who had established a connection with her, Delilah was jolted when she heard the snap.
unit.target: Intento colloquio cum viro, qui eam coniunxerat, Delilah perterrita est, audito sonitu.

unit.source: Her body shuddered slightly, her eyes momentarily glazed over before regaining awareness.
unit.target: Corpus eius leviter tremuit, oculi paulisper obnubilati, deinde sensum recipiebant.

unit.source: Turning on her heel, she descended the wooden platform, returning to her place between the lady’s maid and valet.
unit.target: Calcaneum vertens, de scaena lignea descendit et ad locum suum inter ancillam et minister rediit.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Anthony departed at a measured pace, seamlessly blending into the crowd.
unit.target: Interim, Anthony gradu constanti discessit atque in turbam perfecte immiscuitur.

unit.source: In Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: In Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai.

unit.source: Franca applied the ashes of Delilah’s hair onto the surface of the makeup mirror using black flames, reciting the familiar incantation for the Magic Mirror Divination.
unit.target: Franca cineres capillorum Delilah in superficiem speculi cosmeticī, ignibus nigris adhibitis, imponit atque incantationem notam pro Divinatione Speculi Magici recitavit.

unit.source: Amidst the splashing water and the dark luster, Franca posed the question, “Is the owner of this hair a Mirror Person?”
unit.target: Inter strepitum aquae et obscuram nitorem, Franca quaesivit: “Estne possessor huius capillorum Persona Speculi?”

unit.source: The aged voice responded, “No.”
unit.target: Vox senilis respondit: “Non.”

unit.source: 615 Descendants
unit.target: 615 Descendentes

unit.source: Based on Anthony’s feedback, Franca had long suspected that Delilah wasn’t a Mirror Person but had some connection to them.
unit.target: Ex responsis Antonii, Franca diu suspicata erat Delilah non esse personam specularis, sed aliquam cum eis coniunctionem habere.

unit.source: Otherwise, she wouldn’t have reacted abnormally without knowing anything.
unit.target: Alioquin, nihil sciens, non ita insolite repondit.

unit.source: She raised the question during Magic Mirror Divination to ensure Delilah hadn’t made preparations in advance or been hypnotized.
unit.target: Quaestionem posuit tempore Divinationis Speculi Magici, ut curaretur Delilah neque praeparata esse neque hypnotizata.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Franca posed her second question.
unit.target: Post momentum cogitationis, Franca secundam quaestionem proposuit.

unit.source: “Is the owner of this hair a descendant of the Tamara family?”
unit.target: Estne possessor huius capilli descendens ex familia Tamara?

unit.source: Amidst the splashing water in the dim mirror, an aged voice replied, “No.”
unit.target: Inter aquam micantem in speculo opaco, vox senex respondit: “Minime.”

unit.source: Not a descendant of the Tamara family… Franca used the elimination method and chose a pre-prepared question.
unit.target: Non descendens ex familia Tamara… Franca methodum eliminationis usus est et quaestionem praeparatam elegerat.

unit.source: “Is the owner of this hair a descendant of Mirror People?”
unit.target: Estne possessor huius capilli descendens ex Populo Specularum?

unit.source: The aged voice replied in a calm and hoarse tone, “Yes.”
unit.target: Vox senex, in tono tranquillo et asperso, respondit: “Ita.”

unit.source: Yes… Franca and Jenna were both shocked and delighted.
unit.target: Ita… Franca et Jenna simul stupefactae atque delectatae erant.

unit.source: Though they had similar suspicions, confirming it stunned and terrified them.
unit.target: Quamquam suspiciones similes habebant, confirmatio illius eos attonitos atque territos fecerunt.

unit.source: How long had the Mirror People infiltrated Trier?
unit.target: Quamdiu populi specularum in Trier penetraverunt?

unit.source: Why did they have descendants in their thirties?
unit.target: Cur posteros in annis tricenariis habebant?

unit.source: Moreover, they could marry, have children, and have descendants like ordinary people…
unit.target: Praeterea, nuptias contrahere, liberos procreare, et posteros sicut homines ordinarii habere potuerunt…

unit.source: Aside from believing in the mirror’s Primordial Demoness, who had a more extreme personality and naturally harbored resentment towards Her counterpart outside the mirror, what was the essential difference between them and ordinary people?
unit.target: Praeterquam credendo in Demonessam Primordialem speculi, quae indolem vehementiorem habebat atque naturaliter in repugnantiam erga eam extra speculum inclinabatur, qua re inter eos et homines ordinarios essentialiter distinguebantur?

unit.source: Franca and the others weren’t sure if most Mirror People dissipated after death, leaving behind fragments of the mirror world, or if only a few special Mirror People like Mirror Gardner were like this.
unit.target: Franca et ceteri dubitabant utrum plerique Populi Specularum post mortem evanuerint, reliqua fragmenta mundi specularis relinquentes, aut pauci tantum speciales, ut Mirror Gardner, talibus essent.

unit.source: Combined with Delilah’s biological father, the current Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, instructing her to pay attention to abnormal reactions, Franca concluded that the high-ranking official had been replaced by a Mirror Person many years ago.
unit.target: Coniuncto cum patre biologico Delilah, hodierno Ministro Industria, Moran Avigny, qui eam admonuerat ut reactiones insuetas observaret, Franca conclusit officialem altius dignitatis ante multos annos a persona speculari substitutum esse.

unit.source: “According to the information gathered, the municipal modifications in Underground Trier, particularly the catacombs, were implemented to address the leakage of the Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal. Mirror People had already replaced the originals by then, making it reasonable for them to inhabit Trier,” Anthony said after some thought.
unit.target: Ex informationibus collectis, modificationes municipales in Underground Trier, praesertim catacumbae, institutae erant ad coercendam effusionem sigilli Trier quartae aetatis. Populi Specularum iam originales substituerant, quod rationabile faciebat eos Trier habitare, “— Anthony post aliquam cogitationem dixit.

unit.source: “The problem now is that Mirror People can actually have descendants normally.”
unit.target: Problema nunc est quod Populi Specularum revera posteros ordinarios procreare possunt.

unit.source: Jenna’s eyes flickered as she interjected, “One more thing. Did a descendant of the Tamara family bring the Mirror World Fragment into the tomb in recent decades? Or was it a special Mirror Person searching for something and ended up perishing in there?
unit.target: Oculi Jennæ micaverunt cum interposuit: “Una res adhuc: Num descendentis ex familia Tamara fragmentum Mundi Specularis in sepulchrum intra recentia decennia attulit? An fuit persona specularis specialis, qua aliquid quaerebat, quae ibi cecidit?”

unit.source: “Or could it be that before Fourth Epoch Trier sank underground or was sealed, Mirror People were already active on this land?”
unit.target: An fieri possit ut antequam Trier quartae aetatis sub terram ceciderit aut sigillum ei imponatur, Populi Specularum iam in hac terra viguerent?

unit.source: Franca hissed and said, “Your latter conjecture is a little terrifying.”
unit.target: Franca sibilavit et dixit: “Coniectura tua ultima paulum terribilis est.”

unit.source: “Our original deduction was that the special Mirror World stemmed from the War of the Four Emperors, which caused Fourth Epoch Trier to sink.
