It was closely related to the Primordial Demoness’s divine descent, Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s counterattack before death, and the demise of the Demoness of Catastrophe, Krismona. However, if Mirror People had appeared in Fourth Epoch Trier before all of that, the root cause of the problem would be even more mysterious and terrifying.”
unit.target: Conjectura nostra originalis erat quod Mundi Specularis speciale ex Bello Quattuor Imperatorum proveniret, quod Trier quartae aetatis submergeretur. Hic arcte pertinuit ad divinam descendentiam Demonessae Primordialis, ad contram impulsionem Sanguinis Imperatoris Alista Tudor ante mortem, et ad exitium Demonessae Catastrophae, Krismonae. Attamen, si Populi Specularum in Trier quartae aetatis ante omnia illa apparuisset, radix quaestionis etiam magis mysteriosa et terribilis esset.

unit.source: Fear of the unknown.
unit.target: Timor incogniti.

unit.source: Franca couldn’t help but gaze at the makeup mirror in her hand and address the dark mirror, “Am I a descendant of Mirror People?”
unit.target: Franca non potuit non oculos convertere ad speculum ornamentale in manu tenens et ad speculum obscurum dicere: “Num ego descendens Populi Specularum sum?”

unit.source: She didn’t expect an answer, knowing that Magic Mirror Divination usually allowed only three questions at most.
unit.target: Non exspectabat responsum, sciens Divinationem Speculi Magici plerumque solum tres quaestiones licere.

unit.source: She merely voiced her thoughts and was concluding the divination.
unit.target: Illa tantum cogitationes suas edixit et divinationem conficiebat.

unit.source: The mirror fell silent for a few seconds before resuming, “Your ancestor had nothing to do with Trier.”
unit.target: Speculum paucis secundis silentium cepit antequam resumere inciperet, “Progenitor tuus nihil ad Trier attinuit.”

unit.source: Oh, does that mean I can’t be related to the Mirror People? Wait a moment… Franca’s surprise reverberated in her voice.
unit.target: O, signifacne hoc quod neque ex Populis Specularum possum esse? Exspecta momentum… Admiratio Francae in voce resonavit.

unit.source: Then, a sudden realization struck her. “So, you’re not an emotionless answering machine. You don’t have to strictly adhere to the corresponding rules.”
unit.target: Tum subitum sensus eam percutit: “Ergo, non es machina responsionum sine affectu; non necesse est te stricte regulis respondentibus adhaerere.”

unit.source: The darkness on the mirror’s surface swiftly dissipated, and the aged voice ceased.
unit.target: Tenebrae in superficie speculi celeriter evanuerunt, et vox senex cessavit.

unit.source: Franca was left speechless.
unit.target: Franca muta remanebat.

unit.source: Jenna drew closer to Anthony, her words a hushed murmur, “Did you catch the helplessness in that answer?”
unit.target: Jenna ad Anthoniam accessit, verba eius murmure tacito dicens: “An animadvertisti in illa responso inopiam?”

unit.source: Anthony cast a subtle glance at Franca and nodded imperceptibly.
unit.target: Anthony subtiliter Francam aspexit et imperceptibiliter annuit.

unit.source: “Hey! Don’t whisper in front of me. I can hear you!” Franca complained, her Assassin’s keen senses picking up their conversation.
unit.target: “Heus! Noli coram me susurrare. Te audire possum!” Franca queritur, sensibus acutissimis Assassini colloquium eorum percipientibus.

unit.source: She swiftly shifted the topic, “Fortunately, it said no. If it was a yes, it would be terrifying.”
unit.target: Celeriter rem mutavit: “Felix, minime dixit. Si autem ita fuisset, terribilis foret.”

unit.source: “Hmm… Your grandfather or great-grandfather shouldn’t be Trieriens, right?”
unit.target: Hmm… Avus vel proavus tuus Trierensis non esse debet, nonne?

unit.source: “I’m not even a Trierien myself,” Anthony replied.
unit.target: “Ego quidem neque Trierensis sum,” Anthony respondit.

unit.source: Jenna tersely acknowledged.
unit.target: Jenna succincte annuit.

unit.source: “The generation of my father’s and mother’s grandfathers came to Trier.”
unit.target: “Generatio avorum patris mei et avorum matris meae ad Trier venit.”

unit.source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief, stating, “Now, the direction of the investigation is clear. The current Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny!”
unit.target: Franca leviter suspiravit et dixit: “Nunc via investigationis clarescit. Hodiernus Minister Industria, Moran Avigny!”

unit.source: She pondered whether to conduct a covert investigation to gather crucial information or to promptly inform 007 and let the Eternal Blazing Sun Church handle it.
unit.target: Illa ponderavit utrum investigationem occultam ageret ad notitias praecipuas colligendas aut statim 007 certiorem faceret et Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammei id tractare sineret.

unit.source: Opting for the latter meant potential constraints due to confidentiality principles, limiting her access to the specific details she could seek from 007.
unit.target: Eligendo alterum, id significabat possibiles limitationes ob principia secretorum, limitantes eius aditus ad singulas res ab 007 quaerendas.

unit.source: Ooo!
unit.target: Ooo!

unit.source: Amidst a whistle, a ship steered into Port Colla on the southernmost coastline of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Sub sibilo, navis in Portum Colla, in orae meridionali Regni Feynapotter, pervenit.

unit.source: It was already mid-November, and Trier was gripped by a cold winter.
unit.target: Iam medium Novembri erat, et Trier frigido hieme premebatur.

unit.source: Although Port Santa demanded thick clothing due to plummeting temperatures, Port Colla retained a warm climate.
unit.target: Etsi Portus Santa vestimenta spissiora postulabat ob temperaturas lapsas, Portus Colla tamen climatim calidum retinuit.

unit.source: Passersby adorned themselves in fancy short-sleeved shirts and loose pants, exposing their ankles.
unit.target: Viatores se ornabant tunicis elegantibus cum manica brevissima et braccis laxis, talos ostendentes.

unit.source: Unlike Port Santa, Port Colla lacked the tradition of carrying sabers or swords, but Lumian, drawing from her knowledge, knew that the people here were still rambunctious, with large-scale armed conflicts being commonplace.
unit.target: Contra Portum Santa, Portus Colla traditionem gladii vel ensis ferendi non habebat, sed Lumian, ex sua scientia ductus, scivit populum hic adhuc tumultuarium esse, cum conflictus armati magnitudine frequentes essent.

unit.source: Port Colla differed significantly from Port Santa, which thrived on pastures, plains, and mountain range mines.
unit.target: Portus Colla signanter differebat a Porto Santa, qui in pascuis, campis, et fodinis montium floruit.

unit.source: With limited arable land and scarce pastures, the inhabitants originally depended on the sea for their livelihood.
unit.target: Cum terra arabili limitata et pascua rara essent, incolae initio in mari victum quaerebant.

unit.source: Over generations, the Church of Earth Mother’s advancements in land development, seed cultivation, and livestock breeding transformed Port Colla.
unit.target: Per generationes, progressus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in terrarum expoliendo, seminum colendo, et pecoris alendo, Portum Colla transformaverunt.

unit.source: While the region achieved a level of self-sufficiency in food production, the rambunctious folk customs endured.
unit.target: Dum regio gradum sui sufficientis in producendis cibis attingit, consuetudines populorum effervescentes perseveraverunt.

unit.source: Nevertheless, Port Colla continued to be a major importer of food, serving as one of the primary trade hubs between the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Attamen, Portus Colla perstabat ut maximus cibi importator, fungens ut unum ex praecipuis centris mercaturae inter Regnum Feynapotter et Continentem Meridionalem.

unit.source: The bustling port hosted numerous foreigners and stood as a key base for the Harvest Fleet.
unit.target: Portus frequentatus numerosos externos hospitavit et ut base clavis classem Messis stabat.

unit.source: Captain Pedro, standing beside Lumian, observed the lively port scene.
unit.target: Capitaneus Pedro, iuxta Lumian stans, scaenam portus avidam aspexit.

unit.source: “It’s the dry season, so the weather isn’t as hot, and there’s not much rain. It’s the most comfortable period in Port Colla. You’re welcome to visit.”
unit.target: “Tempus siccum est, itaque non tam fervida est tempestas, nec multa pluvia sunt. Est tempus maxime commodum in Portu Colla. Libenter venire potes.”

unit.source: These words, spoken out of courtesy, hung in the air.
unit.target: Haec verba, ex urbanitate dicta, in aere manebant.

unit.source: Lumian, leaning against the shipboard, directed his gaze toward the distant sea, shrouded in what seemed like dark clouds.
unit.target: Lumian, navis tabulae incumbens, oculos suos versus mare remotum extendit, quod nubibus obscuris quasi tegitur videbatur.

unit.source: “Is that the Berserk Sea?”
unit.target: “Estne hoc Mare Furiosum?”

unit.source: The Berserk Sea divided the Northern and Southern Continents. Only when Emperor Roselle found a safe sea route could the Northern Continent’s countries cross the sea and reach the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Mare Furiosum divisit Continenta Septentrionale et Meridionalem. Solum cum Imperator Roselle viam maritimam tutam invenisset, nationes Continentis Septentrionalis mare transire et Continentem Meridionalem attingere poterant.

unit.source: Pedro nodded, a hint of solemnity in his voice. “That’s right. Without a captain and sailors familiar with those waters, a ship will undoubtedly be swallowed by the ever-changing and violent weather there. Shipwrecks occur around Port Colla every year, claiming lives.”
unit.target: Pedro annuit, leviter sollemnitate in voce: “Ita, recte. Sine capitano et nautarum istis aquis peritis, navis certe ab ingenti et mutabili tempestate devorabitur. Naufragia circa Portum Colla quotannis eveniunt, animas tollentes.”

unit.source: When the majority of the passengers disembarked, Lumian guided Ludwig and Lugano to Captain Pedro’s residence.
unit.target: Cum plerique vectores descenderunt, Lumian Ludovicum et Lugano ad domum Capitani Pedri duxit.

unit.source: He intended to assess the situation of his eldest daughter, Salah, and her lover before deciding on his next course of action.
unit.target: Consilium habebat primogenitae suae, Salah, et amanti eius perpendere, antequam de ulteriori consilio decerneret.

unit.source: Carrying a suitcase and holding Ludwig’s hand, Lugano trailed closely behind his employer.
unit.target: Dolium ferens et manum Ludovici stringens, Lugano arcte post dominum suum secedebat.

unit.source: It wasn’t until they left the dock that he realized something startling.
unit.target: Nisi postquam portum relinquerunt, factum est ut aliquid mirabilem animadvertisset.

unit.source: His employer and the captain were conversing in Highlander!
unit.target: Dominus eius et capitaneus in lingua “Highlander” colloquebantur!

unit.source: Since departing from Port Santa, his employer and most of the ship’s occupants had been using Highlander for communication.
unit.target: Ex quo Portum Santa discesserunt, dominus eius et plerique vectores navis linguam “Highlander” ad colloquendum utebantur.

unit.source: When did he learn Highlander? How had he become proficient in it?
unit.target: Quando didicit linguam “Highlander”? Quomodo in ea peritus factus est?

unit.source: As Lugano observed his employer’s retreating figure, he fell into a thoughtful silence, absorbing the relatively fluent Highlander being spoken.
unit.target: Dum Lugano figuram domini sui recedentem intuebatur, in silentium cogitativum cecidit, linguam “Highlander” satis fluenter dicentem percipiens.

unit.source: Port Colla, 7 White Shark Street, Pedro’s house.
unit.target: Portus Colla, 7 Via Albi Squali, Domus Pedri.

unit.source: A five‐story building with a green front lawn and a charming garden in the rear, it was home to nearly thirty people under Pedro’s mother’s care.
unit.target: Aedificium quinque tabulorum cum prato viridi anteriori et horto amoeno posteriore, domicilium fuit fere triginta hominibus sub cura matris Pedri.

unit.source: Passing through the iron gates, Lumian spotted a couple strolling arm in arm on the lawn.
unit.target: Per portones ferreos transeuntem, Lumian aspexit coniugium ambulantium in prato, brachiis connexos.

unit.source: They were both very young. The woman, in her early twenties, possessed brown hair, brown eyes, and a naturally fair, now‐tanned complexion.
unit.target: Ambos iuvenes erant. Femina, incipientis viginti annorum, capillos fuscos, oculos fuscos, et cutem naturaliter candida, nunc solis aestu fuscavitam, habebat.

unit.source: Although her appearance was remarkable, Lumian, accustomed to interacting with Demonesses and having a beautiful sister, deemed her merely decent.
unit.target: Quamquam species eius notabunda erat, Lumian, cum Demonessibus consuetus et cum sorore pulchra, eam solum decentem putavit.

unit.source: The man, in his mid-twenties, had ordinary features, single eyelids, and curly brown hair.
unit.target: Vir, in mediis annis vicesimis, lineamenta ordinaria, palpebras unicas, et capillos fuscos crispos habebat.

unit.source: Clad in a white shirt and dark-gray pants, he had very average looks and demeanors that would be lost in a crowd.
unit.target: Indutus camisia alba et braccis fuscis, vultum mediocris et moribus insulsis habebat, qui in turba facile evanirent.

unit.source: “Salah, let me introduce you. This is the great adventurer, Louis Berry. His legendary experiences will soon reach Colla,” Pedro joyfully introduced Lumian without a trace of gloominess.
unit.target: “Salah, te mihi coniungere sinas. Hic est magnus viator, Ludovicus Berry; eius experientiae legendariae mox Collam pertingent,” Pedro laete Lumian introduxit sine umbra tristitiae.

unit.source: Salah, sporting a fishnet hat to shield herself from the sun, approached with curiosity,
unit.target: Salah, galea reticulata ad solem protegendam gerens, cum curiositate accessit,

unit.source: “What kind of legendary experiences?”
unit.target: “Quales sunt experientiae legendariae?”

unit.source: “Does earning 300,000 gold risot from a commission count?” Pedro replied, representing Lumian with a smile.
unit.target: “Num merces trium centorum mille auri risot ex commissione conferri possunt?” Pedro respondit, Lumian cum risu repraesentans.

unit.source: “300,000 gold risot?” Salah exclaimed.
unit.target: “Trecenta milia auri risot?” exclamavit Salah.

unit.source: This was a huge fortune for most people in Feynapotter.
unit.target: Hoc ingens divitiae erat pro plurimis in Feynapotter.

unit.source: Lumian observed the father-daughter interaction with a smile. In his peripheral vision, he detected a darkening expression on Salah’s lover, a clear sign of displeasure.
unit.target: Lumian relationem inter patrem et filiam cum risu observavit. In parte laterali oculi eius, vultum obscuratum in amanti Salah animadvertit, signum clarum molestiae.

unit.source: Jealousy, vigilance, and worry? If there’s truly something amiss with him, he should be more confident… Lumian mused, unfazed.
unit.target: Invidia, vigilia, et sollicitudo? Si revera quidquam in eo aliud est, debet fiducius esse… Lumian rem cogitavit, indifferens.

unit.source: Pedro then introduced Salah’s lover.
unit.target: Pedro deinde amantem Salah introduxit.

unit.source: “Flores, Salah’s fiancé. They met in Feynapotter City.”
unit.target: “Flores, sponsus Salah. In Urbe Feynapotter convenerunt.”

unit.source: Feynapotter City, nestled in the highlands, stood as the capital of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Urbs Feynapotter, in montibus collocata, tamquam caput Regni Feynapotter stabat.

unit.source: Salah had encountered Flores there during her university studies, though Flores hailed from an ordinary family with modest educational qualifications.
unit.target: Salah ibi Flores convenerat in studiis universitatis, quamquam Flores ex familia ordinaria, modicis eruditio gradu praeditus, fuit.

unit.source: Having completed only elementary grammar school, he later established a grocery store near Highlander University.
unit.target: Quamquam tantum scholae elementariae grammaticae perfecit, postea tabernam victuariam prope Universitatem “Highlander” constituit.

unit.source: “Greetings,” Lumian nodded slightly, exuding the self-assured air of a great adventurer.
unit.target: “Salve,” Lumian leviter annuit, aerem confidentem magni viatoris efferens.

unit.source: Following the welcoming banquet, Flores departed from Pedro’s house.
unit.target: Post convivium excipiatum, Flores ex domo Pedri discessit.

unit.source: He ventured into his favorite romantic bar, settling at the counter with a discontented expression.
unit.target: In tabernam romanticam amatam se contulit, ad comptum consedit, vultu contristatus.

unit.source: While casually surveying the surroundings, he couldn’t help but notice a woman seated two or three spots away.
unit.target: Dum circumspiciebat, non potuit non animadvertere feminam sedere a duobus vel tribus locis remotam.

unit.source: Her flaxen-colored hair was elegantly tied up, and her lake-colored eyes held a crystalline glimmer.
unit.target: Capilli flavos eius elegantissime ligati erant, et oculi, colore lacus, nitidam scintillam gestabant.

unit.source: With a high nose bridge and rosy lips, even her side profile was breathtakingly beautiful.
unit.target: Cum naso eminenti et labris roseis, etiam eius aspectus lateralis stupefacte pulcher erat.

unit.source: 616 “Love”
unit.target: 616 “Amor”

unit.source: For a moment, Flores found himself captivated by her presence.
unit.target: Paulisper Flores se ab eius praesentia fascinatum invenit.

unit.source: He couldn’t resist leaning in to compliment her straightforwardly, a habit common among male Feynapotterians.
unit.target: Non potuit resistere inclinandi ut eam directe laudaret, mos viri Feynapotterianorum eum impulsum.

unit.source: “Today is my lucky day to encounter such a beautiful lady.
unit.target: «Hodie mihi dies fortunatus est ut talem pulcherrimam feminam occurrem.

unit.source: Could I be luckier to buy you a drink?”
unit.target: Fortuniorne possum esse, ut tibi potum emam?»

unit.source: The woman’s eyes flickered, and a smile graced her lips.
unit.target: Oculi mulieris micaverunt, et risus labris eius ornatus est.

unit.source: She gently shook her head, indicating that his offer wasn’t accepted.
unit.target: Illa leniter caput movit, demonstrans oblationem eius non acceptam esse.

unit.source: Undeterred, Flores wanted to say more, but he noticed the woman’s expression cooling off, prompting him to retreat to his seat.
unit.target: Non deterritus, Flores plura dicere voluit, sed animadvertebat vultum mulieris refrigerari, quod eum ad sedendum recedere impulit.

unit.source: In the following moments, he alternated between stealing glances at the woman’s figure, clad in a simple shirt and slender black pants, and observing the rim of her glass, watching it touched by her moist red lips.
unit.target: In momentis sequentibus alternē furtivos intuitus in figuram mulieris — induta simplici tunica et tenuissimis nigrīs bracae — et vigilantem contemplationem ad marginem vitrei, quo labia eius rubra umida attingebant.

unit.source: Flores’s body heated up, and his mouth grew dry.
unit.target: Corpus Flores calefaciebatur, et os eius aridum fiebat.

unit.source: The more beer he drank, the harder it became to quench his thirst.
unit.target: Quo plus cerevisiam biberat, eo difficilius fiebat sitim eius exstinguere.

unit.source: Eventually, the woman finished her light-gold Manzan, placed the tall glass on the bar counter, and gracefully left amid the soothing and elegant music.
unit.target: Postremo, mulier Manzan leviter auream finivit, altum vitrum in mensa tabernae posuit, et gratanter discessit inter musicam suavem atque elegantem.

unit.source: Flores hurriedly approached, pulling out a soft tissue that had gained popularity in recent years.
unit.target: Flores festinanter accessit, extrahens mollis linteum, quod annis recentibus favorem adeptum habebat.

unit.source: He wiped the edge of the wine glass, where the woman’s lips had just touched.
unit.target: Os vitrei purgavit, quo labia mulieris modo tetigerant.

unit.source: Then, he folded the tissue, meticulously scanning the surroundings of the bar stool.
unit.target: Deinde linteum convolvit et diligenter circumstantia subsellii tabernae perquirens inspectavit.

unit.source: He collected a few flaxen-colored long hairs, securing them in the tissue.
unit.target: Aliquot capillos longos flavos collegit, eos in linteo retinens.

unit.source: Completing this task, Flores became aware of the bartender and the nearly twenty male customers around him, all staring with a shared judgmental gaze: “Pervert!”
unit.target: Hoc munus perfunctus, Flores animadvertit tabernarium et fere viginti clientes viriles circa se, quī omnes aspectu iudiciali intuēbantur: “Perversus!”

unit.source: Flores wasn’t the sole victim of the woman’s enchantment—it extended to all the men and a few women in the bar.
unit.target: Flores non solus incantationis mulieris capti erat; ipsa influēns erat in omnes virōs et aliquās feminas tabernae.

unit.source: All of them had witnessed his perverted actions.
unit.target: Omnēs eius actiones perversās conspexerant.

unit.source: Despite the accusatory stares, Flores kept his composure and left as if nothing had transpired.
unit.target: Quamquam intuitus accusatoribus erant, Flores se compendium servavit et discessit, quasi nihil accideret.

unit.source: He vowed never to return to this bar again!
unit.target: Iuravit numquam ad hanc tabernam iterum redire!

unit.source: Yet, he harbored no regret for his actions.
unit.target: Attamen, nullam paenitentiam pro factis suis gerebat.

unit.source: On the way back to the apartment, Flores’s heart pulsed with anticipation, fueled by the promise of gains.
unit.target: In itinere ad habitationem redeundum, cor Flores exspectatione palpitatum sentiebat, spe lucri fovente.

unit.source: His pace quickened, though practicality dictated a more measured speed.
unit.target: Cursus eius acceleratus est, quamquam ratio celeritatem moderatam imperabat.

unit.source: Upon reaching his residence, he drew the curtains and retrieved an old notebook with a yellowed cover from his suitcase compartment.
unit.target: Ad domum perveniens, velamina trahebat et veterem libellum cum operculo flavido ex compartimento sarcini sui extraxit.

unit.source: Inside, a mottled note held a complex vocabulary that didn’t belong to any language from the Northern Continent, accompanied by numerous instructions in Highlander.
unit.target: Intra, libellus notā maculātā verba complexa continebat, quae cuiquam linguā Continenti Septentrionalis nequam erant, cum plurimīs praeceptīs in lingua Highlander comitātīs.

unit.source: Flores eagerly placed the tissue containing the woman’s hair and saliva on the notebook.
unit.target: Flores avidē linteum, quod capillos et saliva mulieris continebat, in libello posuit.

unit.source: He then took up the mottled note, reciting the intricate and peculiar words with marked pronunciation.
unit.target: Deinde notam maculātam sustulit, verba intricata et insueta cum distincta pronuntiātiōne recitāns.

unit.source: “Naboredisley…”
unit.target: “Naboredisley…”

unit.source: This was the love incantation Flores had chanced upon.
unit.target: Haec erat incantātiō amoris, quam Flores fortūte invenit.

unit.source: With the true name, date of birth, closely related items, or bodily fluids like flesh and blood, he could insert the medium in his notebook and recite the incantation seven times, compelling the target to fall irrevocably in love.
unit.target: Vero nomine, die natali, rebus cognātīs aut fluidīs corporis ut caro et sanguis, medietātem in libello suo inserere poterat et incantātiōnem septies recitare, cogēns ut destināta in amōre īrrēvocābile incideret.

unit.source: Flores had patiently waited for the opportune moment to orchestrate Pedro’s daughter, Salah, to fall and be injured.
unit.target: Flores patienter exspectāverat opportunum momentum, ut filiam Pedri, Salah, in amōrem incidere atque laedi fieri posset.

unit.source: His timely aid had not only garnered gratitude but also facilitated the collection of her blood, fulfilling the conditions for the love incantation.
unit.target: Auxilium eius tempestīvum non solum gratiam excitāvit, sed etiam sanguinem eius colligere facilitāvit, ita condiciōnēs incantātiōnis amoris complēns.

unit.source: Reality had validated the enchanting power of the love incantation!
unit.target: Rēs ipsa potentiam magicam incantātiōnis amoris confirmāvit!

unit.source: Flores refrained from using it again, uncertain of how to dispel its effects.
unit.target: Flores ne id iterum adhibēret abstinuit, nescius quō modō effectūs eius dissipārentur.

unit.source: If pursued by multiple women before his marriage to Salah, provoking a conflict among them could jeopardize his standing within the large family and hinder access to resources and support.
unit.target: Si ante nuptias cum Salah ab plurimīs feminīs sectūs esset, inter eas controversiā excitāta, statum eius in magna familia periclitāre atque aditus ad subsidia impedīre posset.

unit.source: However, today was different.
unit.target: Tamen hodie prorsus aliud erat.

unit.source: She was the most captivating woman he had ever encountered.
unit.target: Illa erat femina maxime fascināns quam umquam occursus esset eius.

unit.source: He was ready to pay any price to make her his own!
unit.target: Paratus erat pretium qualibet solvere, ut eam sibi assequeretur!

unit.source: Uncertainty lingered in Flores’s mind about whether the saliva-stained tissue and the naturally fallen hair could truly serve as a medium for the love incantation, but the desire to find out overwhelmed any reservations.
unit.target: Dubitatio in mente Flores manēbat, utrum linteum salīva tinctum et capillus naturaliter lapsus vere medietātem incantātiōnis amoris praestāre possent, sed desiderium explorandi omnibus cunctātīs superābat.

unit.source: Excitement and anticipation surged within him as he envisioned the possibility of witnessing such a beautiful scene, an uncontrollable smile gracing his face.
unit.target: Exsultātiō et exspectātiō in eo erumpere coeperunt, dum possibilitātem talis pulcherrimae scaenae videndi imagināret, cum risū inexsuperabili faciem eius ornante.

unit.source: “Naboredisley…”
unit.target: “Naboredisley…”

unit.source: Flores continued reciting the love incantation with abnormal devotion and enthusiasm, his heart pulsating with desire and joy.
unit.target: Flores incantātiōnem amoris cum devōtione et fervōre insuetā recitāre pergebat, cor eius desideri et gaudi pulsāns.

unit.source: “Naboredisley!”
unit.target: “Naboredisley!”

unit.source: After repeating it seven times, Flores watched in amazement as the tissue and hair burst into flames, reflecting a rainbow before swiftly turning to ashes.
unit.target: Postquam eam septies iterāvit, Flores stupēns aspexit linteum et capillos in flammās erumpere, arcum pluviālem repraesentantes, antequam celeriter in cinerem redirent.

unit.source: Success… Success! Flores couldn’t initially believe it, but immense joy struck his heart.
unit.target: Successus… Successus! Flores initīā non credidit, sed immensus gaudiō cor eius percussit.

unit.source: Surprise lingered, but Flores cared little.
unit.target: Mirātiō manēbat, sed Flores parum curābat.

unit.source: What mattered was that it worked!
unit.target: Quod refert, est quod id efficāvit!

unit.source: That captivating woman is now in love with me!
unit.target: Illa fascināns femina nunc in me amōre infixa est!

unit.source: Thoughts of what would unfold next raced through Flores’s mind.
unit.target: Cogitātiōnēs de futurīs eveniendīs per mentem Flores rapide volitāvērunt.

unit.source: He hastily closed the notebook, clipped the note, and dashed to the door without bothering to put them away.
unit.target: Libellum festinanter clausit, notam alligavit, atque ad ianuam celeriter accessit—haec omne reponere non instanter cogitāns.

unit.source: He yearned to walk the streets, confident that the lovely person must be seeking him!
unit.target: Cupībat per vīās ambulāre, certus quod pulcherrima persona eum quaerere dēbet!

unit.source: As Flores swung the door open, there she was—the woman from the bar, standing outside.
unit.target: Dum Flores ianuam pandēbat, ecce—illa, mulier ex taberna, extra stans.

unit.source: Flores’s entire being went slack under the lake-colored crystalline gaze, his balance teetering on the edge of surrender.
unit.target: Totum esse Flores languide cecidit sub aspectu crystallino colore lacūs, aequilibrium eius in limine deditionis vacillans.

unit.source: Every fiber of his being yearned to yield.
unit.target: Omnis fibra eius se concedere desiderabat.

unit.source: As the woman willingly stepped into Flores’s embrace, he eagerly enveloped her in his arms, leaning in for a kiss.
unit.target: Cum mulier libenter in amplexum Flores intrāvit, ille ea cupidē in brachiis complexus ad osculum inclinābat.

unit.source: Yet, the sensation he encountered was far from the warmth and softness he had imagined.
unit.target: Sed sensus quem percepit longe dissimulabat ab calōre et teneritāte quae imagināverat.

unit.source: Instead, it was cold and unyielding.
unit.target: Immo, frigidus erat et inexorābilis.

unit.source: Wh… Flores’s surprise turned to shock as he realized he was embracing a waist-high mirror.
unit.target: Quid… Stupor Flores in īnclīnātum pertransformatus est, cum animadvertit se speculum ad lumborum altitudinem amplecti.

unit.source: The mirror brushed against his chest, swaying back and forth, resisting his attempts to disengage.
unit.target: Speculum pectus eius leniter contrectāvit, huc illuc fluctuans, conātīs eius se liberandi repugnans.

unit.source: Flores recoiled in unnatural fear.
unit.target: Flores in timōre innātō contrāvērit.

unit.source: The lingering sensations from his earlier fantasies refused to dissipate.
unit.target: Sensationēs permanentes ex phantasiīs prīoribus dissolvere noluērunt.

unit.source: His heart froze while his body burned.
unit.target: Cor eius condenserat, dum corpus ardebātur.

unit.source: With mounting dread, he struck the mirror with increasing force.
unit.target: Cum metu crescente, speculum vi auctā percussit.

unit.source: Finally, retreating to his suitcase, Flores delivered a decisive blow, shattering the mirror with a resounding crack.
unit.target: Postremo, ad sarcinam revertus, Flores ictum dēcisīvus dedit, speculum fragore resonante confractum.

unit.source: It shattered into countless fragments, piercing Flores’s clothes, chest, stomach, and arms.
unit.target: Speculum in innumerābilēs fragmenta concidit, vestimenta eius, pectus, venter, ac brachia perforans.

unit.source: Agony surged through Flores’s body, searing his senses, snapping the fraying nerve that was already on the brink.
unit.target: Agōnia per corpus Flores diffundebat, sensūs eius flagrant, nervum iam labōrem ad finem tendentem rumpēns.

unit.source: In that moment, he tasted a euphoria unlike any other.
unit.target: In illo momento saporem laetītiānis incomparābilis degustāvit.

unit.source: Collapsing to the ground, Flores lay motionless, caught between fear, longing, anguish, and ecstasy.
unit.target: Terram corruens, Flores immotus iacebat, inter timōrem, desiderium, cruciātum, et extāsium captus.

unit.source: “It can truly assist in digesting the Pleasure potion…” Franca clicked her tongue, observing the scene unfold in the mirror of the apartment diagonally opposite Flores’s room.
unit.target: «Vere potest auxiliārī in digestiōne potionis Voluptātis…» Franca lingua crepuit, spectāns scaenam in speculō habitationis angulō opposītā ad conclāvem Flores evolvere.

unit.source: With her expertise, the spectacle before her could be deemed a novelty.
unit.target: Per artēs suās, spectaculum ante eam novitātem dīcī potuit.

unit.source: “I assured you I wouldn’t deceive you,” Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, responded with a grin.
unit.target: «Te certiōrem feci me nōn te falliturum esse,» respondit Lumian, gerens pileum aureum straminis, cum risū.

unit.source: Upon accepting the commission and identifying Flores’s primary problem of inexplicably garnering the fervent affection of a stunning girl, Lumian’s initial instinct was to deploy a Demoness to test this individual.
unit.target: Commissionem suscipiens et prīmam problemāticam Flores, scilicet inexplicābiliter ardorem amōris ab puellā stupendā accipiendi, dēprehendens, prīma eius instinctus erat daemonessam ad hunc hominem probandum mittere.

unit.source: Franca’s saliva and hair served as part of the investigation. After all, mysticism likely played a role.
unit.target: Salīva et capillī Francae partem investigationis erant. Post omnia, mystica fortasse partem egit.

unit.source: Naturally, for safety precautions, Franca had treated the saliva and hair beforehand. Thus, she devised a Mirror Substitution, a dark magic of Witches, which accurately connected to them.
unit.target: Naturaliter, ad cautelam, Franca salīvam ac capillōs praeviē curāvit. Itaque Speculī Substitutionem excogitāvit, magiam tenebrōsam strigarum, quae ad eōs exacte alligāta erat.

unit.source: Now, the results were in—splendid. Franca had subjected Flores to pleasure’s torment, exposing him to the agony of chasing fleeting satisfaction.
unit.target: Iam eventus erant—splendidī! Franca Flores ad tormentum voluptātis subiecit, eum ad cruciātum persequendi satisfactionis evanidae exponēns.

unit.source: “Curious, Flores managed to ensnare my mirror’s affection with just a single-word incantation. No ritual or supplication to any entity,” Franca mused with emotion. “Even I can’t achieve that.”
unit.target: «Curiosum est: Flores solō verbō incantātiōnis speculī meī amōrem capere potuit—nec ritu nec supplicātiōne cuiusquam entitātis adhibita,» meditāta dixit Franca cum mōtū. «Etiam ego id adipisci nōn possum.»

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response, remarking, “You can. No incantation or medium needed. Just unleash your charm.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit, «Possis; nulla incantātiō neque medium requīritur—tantum tuam venustātem effunde.»

unit.source: “…” Franca was taken aback. “You’re starting to resemble an Intisian. Or is this a result of your Feynapotter education?”
unit.target: «…» Obstupefacta, Franca exclamāvit: «Incipis instar Intisianī esse; an haec ex educatione tua Feynapotteriana provenit?»

unit.source: Pursing her lips, her gaze flickered.
unit.target: Labris contrahendīs, aspectus eius micāvit.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “There’s another issue. Pedro previously tasked two adventurers with probing Flores, but they vanished. And it appears this fellow lacks Beyonder powers.”
unit.target: Lumian pergebat: «Altera quaestiō est. Pedrum olim duo explorātōrēs ad Flores indagandum prōvīderunt, sed evanuerunt; et vidētur hic vir carēre viribus Beyonder.»

unit.source: Franca suddenly smiled. “This is intriguing… If the Mirror Substitution failed, and I fell under the sway of that incantation, falling in love with Flores, what would you do?”
unit.target: Subitā subrīdens Franca dixit: «Hoc mirum est… Si Speculī Substitutio defecisset, et ego sub imperiō incantātiōnis illae caderer, Flores in amōrem incidens, quid fēcissem?»

unit.source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian risum levem edidit.

unit.source: “Making someone vanish without a trace is simple. I don’t even need to lift a finger.”
unit.target: «Aliquem sine vestigiō evanescere facile est; ne digito quidem levāre mihi opus est.»

unit.source: Lumian was confident Ludwig could consume the fellow entirely, with counter-divination to top it off.
unit.target: Lumian confidēbat Ludovicum posse totum illum hominem devorāre, cum contradivinātiōne additā.

unit.source: Without awaiting Franca’s response, Lumian headed for the door.
unit.target: Nōn exspectāns responsum Francae, Lumian ad ianuam se contulit.

unit.source: “I’ll pay that fellow a visit. Keep vigilant for any developments and beware of mishaps.”
unit.target: «Ille hominem visitābō; vigilātea in quālibet novitāte et cave casus.»

unit.source: “Understood,” Franca replied solemnly.
unit.target: «Intellectum,» respondit Franca sollemniter.

unit.source: As Flores hadn’t managed to close the door in time, Lumian found the entrance accessible without the need to pry it open.
unit.target: Quōrum Flores non in tempore ianuam claudere potuit, Lumian ostium facile invenit, sine eo aperiendum.

unit.source: Sensing the intrusion, Flores snapped out of his daze, hastily rising to his feet.
unit.target: Intrūsiōnem sentiens, Flores ex stupefactiōne evigilavit, celeriter ad pedēs surgēns.

unit.source: By this point, Lumian had already picked up the notebook, unfolding it to the two pages displaying the mottled note.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian iam libellum sustulit, id explicāns ad duas páginas quae notam maculātam ostendēbant.

unit.source: “W-what are you doing?” Flores asked, horror etched across his face.
unit.target: «Q-quid facis?» inquit Flores, terrore vultū eius notāto.

unit.source: He immediately recognized Lumian.
unit.target: Statim Lumian agnovit.

unit.source: Louis Berry? The great adventurer Louis Berry?
unit.target: Louis Berry? Magnus explorātōr Louis Berry?

unit.source: “Did Pedro hire you to investigate me?”
unit.target: «Num Pedrum te ad me indagandum constituit?»

unit.source: Ignoring the inquiry, Lumian walked toward the window, ushering in a gust of fresh air.
unit.target: Quaestiōnem neglexit, Lumian versus fenestram ambulāvit, afferens recentem aērem.

unit.source: “A love incantation can make a woman fall in love with you. All you need is to obtain her true name…” Lumian began reciting the Highlander annotation on the mottled note in front of Flores.
unit.target: «Incantātiō amoris potest facere ut femina in te incidat; omnē quod opus est, verum nōmen eius adipisci…» Lumian incipiebat recitare annotātiōnem Highlander in notā maculātā ante Flores.

unit.source: “The incantation’s pronunciation is…”
unit.target: «Pronuntiātiō incantātiōnis est…»

unit.source: He abruptly halted without completing the recitation.
unit.target: Repentinus cessāvit, recitiōnem non complēns.

unit.source: Flores’s face had already turned a sickly grayish-white, as if he could foresee the impending demise of his reputation and his capture by the Church.
unit.target: Faciēs Flores iam in pallidum grisium albo deceptive versa erat, tamquam exitium famae suae ac Ecclesiae captūrā imminere praevidēret.

unit.source: “Where did this come from?” Lumian pointed at the mottled note and the old notebook.
unit.target: «Unde hoc ortum est?» inquit Lumian, notam maculātam et veterem libellum demonstrāns.

unit.source: Cold sweat broke out on Flores’s forehead, and his eyes gradually turned fierce.
unit.target: Sudor frigidus in fronte Flores effusus est, et oculī eius paulatim acerrimī factī sunt.

unit.source: Suddenly, he shouted, pronouncing the word in a rugged and awkward tone, “Naboredisley!”
unit.target: Subitō clamāvit, verbum in tono rūdī et ineptō pronuntiāns: «Naboredisley!»

unit.source: This time, there was no target or corresponding medium.
unit.target: Hoc tempore neque destinātum neque medium congruum aderat.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian sensed his surroundings fall silent as an ominous aura rapidly enveloped the room.
unit.target: Prope simul, Lumian sensit circumstantiās silentium referre, dum aura ominōsa conclāvem celeriter involvit.

unit.source: 617 Transaction
unit.target: Transactio 617

unit.source: Flores’s demeanor suddenly shifted, his expression turning icy, and a malevolent smile curling upon his lips.
unit.target: Mores Flores subitāneē commutatus est, vultus eius in gelu versus, atque risus malignus labris incurvans apparuit.

unit.source: His aura underwent a dramatic transformation.
unit.target: Aura eius transformationem egregiam passa est.

unit.source: He raised his gaze, Lumian’s dark hair and green eyes reflecting in his now ominous stare.
unit.target: Oculos attollit, et capilli obscuri atque oculi virides Lumiani in aspectu eius iam ominoso resplendebant.

unit.source: Lumian’s suppressed emotions, desires, and the haze surrounding him erupted like a volcano.
unit.target: Affectūs repressi, desideria, atque nebula eum circumdantes quasi vulcāno erumpebant.

unit.source: This was a force even an Ascetic’s endurance couldn’t withstand.
unit.target: Haec vis erat, quam etiam tolerantia ascētæ superare non potuit.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: Lumian’s body cracked, shrinking into a palm‑sized mirror.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani crepuit, atque in speculum mensura palmae redactum est.

unit.source: The mirror shattered completely, fragments scattering across the ground.
unit.target: Speculum omnino confractum est, fragmenta per terram dispersa erant.

unit.source: In the room diagonally opposite, Lumian materialized beside Franca, wearing a solemn expression.
unit.target: In conclavi diagonaliter opposito, Lumian iuxta Francam apparuit, vultum sollemnem gerens.

unit.source: Had he not prepared Mirror Substitution beforehand, he might have endured a double explosion of emotions and desires.
unit.target: Nisi substitutionem speculi antea praeparavisset, duplicem eruptionem affectuum et desideriorum fortasse toleravisset.

unit.source: It resembled the same outcome when evil god bestowed heard the Symphony of Hatred’s different melodies.
unit.target: Eadem eventus apparuit, sicut cum deus maleficus varias symphonias odii diffudit.

unit.source: Of course, if Franca hadn’t been lurking nearby, if he hadn’t readied Mirror Substitution, he wouldn’t have used himself as bait to “converse” with Flores.
unit.target: Scilicet, nisi Franca prope insidiasset, et nisi substitutionem speculi praeparavisset, se uti esca ad “conloquendum” cum Flores non fecisset.

unit.source: Lumian seized Franca’s shoulder, his voice deep as he uttered, “Let’s leave this place first.”
unit.target: Lumian umerum Francae arripuit, voce profunda, et dixit: “Primum hunc locum relinquamus.”

unit.source: He promptly activated the black mark on his right shoulder, in an attempt to teleport away.
unit.target: Celeriter maculam nigrum in umero dextro excitavit, conatu se translocare.

unit.source: Confronted with an adversary capable of exploiting his weaknesses and latent dangers, Lumian’s initial response was to switch to support, utilizing his corresponding abilities from a distance.
unit.target: Oppositum habens adversarium, qui infirmitates eius et pericula latenta exponere poterat, responsum initium Lumiani fuit ad auxilium transire, facultates pertinentes a longinquo adhibens.

unit.source: Franca would assume the role of the main attacker.
unit.target: Franca munus principali aggressoris suscipere destinata erat.

unit.source: However, considering Franca, a Demoness of Pleasure, hadn’t indulged herself for a long time, he feared she might not resist the explosion of desire.
unit.target: Attamen, dato quod Franca—Demonissa Voluptatis—diu se non indulgebat, timebat ne eruptioni desiderii obsistere non posset.

unit.source: It seemed prudent to retreat, regroup with others, and return later.
unit.target: Consilium videri prudenti: recedere, cum aliis coire, et postea redire.

unit.source: At that moment, a voice alternating between masculinity and femininity echoed in Lumian and Franca’s ears.
unit.target: In eo momento vox, inter virilem et feminam alternans, in auribus Lumiani et Francae resonabat.

unit.source: “There’s no rush to escape. I’ve changed my mind. I want to make a deal with you.”
unit.target: «Non est festinandum effugere. Mentem mutavi. Tecum pactum facere volo.»

unit.source: A deal? Something jolted in Lumian’s and Franca’s minds.
unit.target: Pactum? Aliquid in animis Lumiani et Francae concussit.

unit.source: After some thought, they chose to stay put.
unit.target: Post aliquam meditationem, manere constituerunt.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian sank his consciousness into his right hand, ready to activate the remnant aura of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian conscientiam suam in manu dextro demergit, paratus ad remanentem auram Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor excitandam.

unit.source: This wasn’t meant to intimidate Flores, but if his emotions and desires were triggered again, Lumian could “alert the police” in time!
unit.target: Hoc non ad Flores intimidandum destinatum erat, sed si affectūs et desideria eius iterum excitata essent, Lumian tempestive “vigiles” certiores facere posset!

unit.source: Being one of the Feynapotter Kingdom’s primary ports for trade with the Southern Continent and a key base for the Harvest Fleet, Port Colla undoubtedly housed at least one Grade 1 Sealed Artifact even without a demigod.
unit.target: Quoniam Portus Colla, unus ex principalibus portis regni Feynapotter ad commercium cum continente meridionali et basis praecipua classis Vindemiatorum erat, indubitanter saltem unum Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus I continebat, etiam sine semideo.

unit.source: Franca gazed at the wall and the air in front of her, questioning, “What deal?”
unit.target: Franca parietem et aerem ante se intuens, inquisivit: “Quid pacto?”

unit.source: Flores, dressed in a floral shirt, casually pushed open the unlatched door of the apartment and spoke in a deep, cold, and dignified manner,
unit.target: Flores, camisia florata indutus, casualiter ostium clausum aperuit et voce profunda, frigida ac digna locutus est,

unit.source: “Let me introduce myself. Naboredisley, a Demon.”
unit.target: «Permitte mihi me introducere. Naboredisley, daemon.»

unit.source: A Demon? A genuine Demon… The cost of using the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction actually materialized here–to make a deal with a Demon…
unit.target: Daemon? Vere daemon? Pretium utendi Transactione sub mensa Auctoritatis hic manifeste apparuit—ad pactum cum daemon faciendum…

unit.source: However, Lumian’s acceptance of the captain’s mission and our pursuit of Delilah are distinct matters.
unit.target: Attamen, acceptio missionis capitanei a Lumiano et nostra persecutio ad Delilah res distinctae sunt.

unit.source: If we had opted to patiently wait a month or two before engaging with Delilah instead of utilizing the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction, what would have transpired today?
unit.target: Si constitui essemus ut mensem vel duos patienter exspectaremus antequam cum Delilah ageremus, pro usu Transactionis sub mensa Auctoritatis, quid hodie eveniret?

unit.source: Could there have been a so‑called deal?
unit.target: Numquid pactum, ut fertur, esse potuisset?

unit.source: Franca smiled in surprise, suspicion, and confusion.
unit.target: Franca cum admiratione, suspicione, atque confusione subridet.

unit.source: “How can you reveal yourself as a Demon?
unit.target: “Shouldn’t a true Demon conceal their identity to lower our guard?”

unit.source: The Demon, identifying himself as Naboredisley, clenched his right fist and pressed it against his lips.
unit.target: Daemon, se Naboredisley esse declarans, dextrum pugnum contraxit et illud ad labia apposuit.

unit.source: He smiled and replied, “A true Demon is both Demon in body and mind.
unit.target: Risus efferens respondit: «Verus daemon et corpore et mente daemon est.

unit.source: I’ll inform you that you’re dealing with a Demon, but refusal isn’t an option.
unit.target: Te certiorem faciam te cum daemon agere, sed recusatio non est optio.

unit.source: I won’t obscure my identity to achieve my goals like the foolish ones.
unit.target: Non celabo identitatem meam ad metas meas assequendas, ut stulti id fecerunt.

unit.source: For instance, this man named Flores is well aware of the consequences of repeatedly reciting my true name through the notebook.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, hic vir, Flores nominatus, bene novit consequentias mei veri nominis per libellum iterum recitandi.

unit.source: Heh heh, back then, that foolish Warlock labeled it the Love Incantation, but he still couldn’t resist the temptation and couldn’t control himself.
unit.target: Heh heh, tunc ille stultus magus id Incantationem Amoris appellavit, sed tamen tentationi resistere nec se coercere potuit.

unit.source: Haha, for Demons, this gradually decaying soul that slowly descends into the Abyss is the most delectable feast.
unit.target: Haha, nam daemonibus, haec anima paulatim putrescens et lente in Abyssum descendens, epulum delectabilem maxime constituit.

unit.source: The sensation of resistance and constant decay is as unforgettable as the finest wine.
unit.target: Sensatio resistendi et continuae corruptionis tam inobliterabilis est quam optimus vinum.

unit.source: Lumian and Franca didn’t disdain or ridicule Naboredisley’s unabashed and alluring depravity.
unit.target: Lumian et Franca non contemnoverunt neque irriserunt nequitiam Naboredisley sincerae atque allicientis.

unit.source: Since a Demon had spoken, there had to be a deeper motive!
unit.target: Cum daemon locutus esset, necessaria erat aliquid ulterioris.

unit.source: Moreover, Lumian couldn’t be certain if Naboredisley was a genuine Demon or a self‑proclaimed one.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian certus esse non potuit utrum Naboredisley verus daemon esset aut se ipse proclamaverit.

unit.source: He couldn’t verify if Naboredisley was his actual name or if he had a different origin.
unit.target: Non potuit comprobari utrum Naboredisley nomen suum verum haberet aut ex alia origine proveniret.

unit.source: Although the activation of desire aligned with the traits of a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle of the Demon pathway, it wasn’t exclusive to Demons.
unit.target: Quamquam activatio cupiditatis notis Seriei V, Apostoli Desiderii in via daemonica conveniebat, illa tamen daemonibus sola non destinata erat.

unit.source: Lumian’s Symphony of Hatred could achieve a similar effect.
unit.target: Symphonia Odii Lumiani effectum similem efficere poterat.

unit.source: Franca grinned at the Demon’s incessant narrative and remarked, “That foolish Warlock probably assumed your true name as a Love Incantation because of your cues. Is that really your true name?”
unit.target: Franca daemonis ininterrotta narratione subridet et dixit: «Ille stultus magus verisimiliter tuum verum nomen ut Incantationem Amoris ob signa tua accepit. Num vere tuum nomen verum est?»

unit.source: “That’s why he’s foolish,” Naboredisley replied with a faint smile.
unit.target: «Ideo stultus est,» respondit Naboredisley subridente leviter.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t eager to rush into the transaction.
unit.target: Lumian transactioni festinandi non studebat.

unit.source: Instead, he inquired, “How did you manage to convince Flores that the Love Incantation actually works?”
unit.target: Pro eo, rogavit: «Quomodo Flores persuadisti Incantationem Amoris vere efficacem esse?»

unit.source: Naboredisley casually glanced back at Flores’s rented apartment and assumed a relaxed posture.
unit.target: Naboredisley leviter retrospexit ad locum Flores conductum et habitum relaxatum assumpsit.

unit.source: “He tried some other incantations from the notebook, and some of them worked.”
unit.target: «Alias incantationes ex libello temptavit, et nonnullae operatae sunt.»

unit.source: “He’s just an ordinary person, yet he can cast an incantation like a Warlock?” Franca expressed disbelief.
unit.target: «Homo tantum ordinarius est, sed tamen incantationem sicut magus canere potest?» Franca incredulitate exprimitur.

unit.source: Naboredisley grinned.
unit.target: Naboredisley subridens.

unit.source: “I’ve heard a very reasonable saying: ‘All things possess godhood.’
unit.target: «Audivi proverbium valde rationabile: “Omnia deitate praedita sunt.”

unit.source: “No matter how ordinary a person is, as long as they’re willing to pay the corresponding price, they can create Beyonder effects.”
unit.target: «Quamvis homo simplicissimus sit, dummodo pretium conveniens solvat, effectus transcendentales creare possit.»

unit.source: All things possess godhood… Mr. K often says this when preaching… Lumian observed Naboredisley, the self‑proclaimed Demon.
unit.target: Omnia deitate praedita sunt… Dominus K hoc saepe dicit cum praedicat… Lumian observavit Naboredisley, daemon se ipso proclamatum.

unit.source: Franca seized the opportunity to ask, “What price did Flores pay?”
unit.target: Franca occasionem captavit et interrogavit: «Quod pretium Flores solvit?»

unit.source: Naboredisley smiled meaningfully. “I already told you.”
unit.target: Naboredisley subridens significanter respondit: «Iam tibi dixi.»

unit.source: The part where the soul gradually decays and falls into the Abyss?
unit.target: Pars, in qua anima paulatim corrumpetur et in Abyssum cadit?

unit.source: Franca nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Franca cogitabunde annuit.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly grinned.
unit.target: Lumian subito subridens apparuit.

unit.source: “If he hadn’t paid the price, how could you communicate with us so easily using his body?”
unit.target: «Si pretium non solvisset, quomodo per eius corpus tam facile nobiscum communicare potuisses?»

unit.source: Naboredisley smiled back but remained silent.
unit.target: Naboredisley iterum subridens, sed tacitus mansit.

unit.source: Lumian shifted the topic.
unit.target: Lumian rem mutavit.

unit.source: “Did you have a hand in the deaths of those two adventurers who were investigating Flores?”
unit.target: «Num particeps fuisti in mortibus illorum duorum exploratorum, qui Flores investigabantur?»

unit.source: “Consider it a bit of interest,” Naboredisley replied, glancing around.
unit.target: «Putate hoc quasi parum interesse,» respondit Naboredisley, circumspiciens.

unit.source: He smiled and pulled a chair over, casually remarking, “You lack the necessary courtesy.”
unit.target: Subridens, sella traxit et leve dixit, «Comitatem necessariam carent.»

unit.source: “Because we never considered making a deal with you,” Franca deliberately stated.
unit.target: «Quia numquam tecum pactum faciendo cogitavimus,» Franca firmiter declamavit.

unit.source: “I won’t make a deal with a Demon.”
unit.target: «Non faciam pactum cum daemon.»

unit.source: Naboredisley chuckled and said, “Although it’s amusing for a Demoness to claim she won’t trade with a Demon, I can assure you that I won’t force you into a deal.
unit.target: Naboredisley subridens dixit: «Quamvis iocum sit, cum Demonissa dicat se non commerciare cum daemon, certiorem te faciam me te in pacto non coacturum esse,

unit.source: I won’t even hinder you from informing the Church of Earth Mother about Flores later.
unit.target: neque quidem tibi impediam, ut postea Ecclesiam Matris Terrae de Flores certiorem facias.

unit.source: I differ from my inept peers.
unit.target: Ab inaptis condiscipulis meis differto.

unit.source: I prefer transparent trade, avoiding the convoluted legalese of contracts where terms and conditions are twisted.
unit.target: Commercium perspicuum praefero, vitans obscuram contractuum legem, ubi termini et condiciones convoluti sunt.

unit.source: I’ll make you choose to trade with me, even knowing the content and price.
unit.target: Te cogam eligere commercium mecum, etiam cum contentum et pretium tibi nota sint.

unit.source: “I decline,” Franca replied with a smile.
unit.target: «Declino,» Franca subridens respondit.

unit.source: Naboredisley narrowed his eyes dangerously but maintained his usual amiable demeanor.
unit.target: Naboredisley oculos periculositer angustiavit, sed mores suos amabiles consuetos retinuit.

unit.source: “You can listen first before deciding if you want to accept this deal.
unit.target: «Primum audire potes, antequam decernas an hoc pactum accipias.»

unit.source: I won’t boast that I can fulfill any of your wishes, but I can help you fulfill most of them.
unit.target: Non gloriabor quod quaslibet tuas optiones implere valeam, sed plurimas eorum effici te adiuvare possum.

unit.source: This is a promise from an ancient Demon.
unit.target: Hoc est promissum ab antiquo daemon.

unit.source: “Ancient?” Lumian looked curious.
unit.target: «Antiquus?» Lumian curiosus aspexit.

unit.source: “Have you heard of the Ancient Sun God?”
unit.target: «Audivistine de Deo Solis Antiqui?»

unit.source: Naboredisley’s expression darkened subtly.
unit.target: Vultus Naboredisley subtiliter obscuratus est.

unit.source: “I’m aware.”
unit.target: «Scio.»

unit.source: “Can you tell me about Him? The deity I believe in now seems to be the resurrected Him.”
unit.target: «Potesne mihi de eo narrare? Deitas in quam nunc credo videtur ille renatus esse.»

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curled up, revealing two rows of pearly‑white teeth.
unit.target: Labia Lumiani incurvata sunt, duo ordines dentium candidissimarum ostendentes.

unit.source: “This can be used as compensation for the transaction, but it has to be paid first before we fulfill the contract.
unit.target: «Hoc pro compensatione transactionis adhiberi potest, sed primum solvi debet, antequam contractum exsequamur,

unit.source: Don’t think of fabricating it. That would be blasphemy to my Lord.”
unit.target: noli fingere illud; id erit blasphemia erga Dominum meum.»

unit.source: Naboredisley fell silent. After a few seconds, he smiled and said, “As I mentioned earlier, I can’t accomplish certain things and fulfill certain wishes. This is one of them.”
unit.target: Naboredisley tacuit. Post aliquot secundas, subridens dixit: «Ut antea dixi, quaedam efficere nec quibusdam votis servire valeo. Haec una ex his est.»

unit.source: When one’s humble enough, it’s really difficult to win a war of words…
unit.target: Cum quis satis humilis sit, verum est difficile verborum proelium vincere.

unit.source: Lumian sighed inwardly and turned to Franca, silently inquiring if she wanted to seize this opportunity to the‑table Transaction.
unit.target: Lumian intus suspiravit et ad Francam convertebatur, tacite interrogeantem an hanc opportunitatem ad transactionem “sub mensa” capere velit.

unit.source: Franca hesitated for a moment before addressing Naboredisley.
unit.target: Franca paulisper cunctata est antequam ad Naboredisley loqueretur.

unit.source: “Tell me about the deal first before I decide.”
unit.target: «Primum narra mihi de pacto, antequam decernam.»

unit.source: Naboredisley chuckled.
unit.target: Naboredisley risit.

unit.source: “A wise decision. I hope you can help me kill another Demon’s descendant. He resides somewhere in the Berserk Sea.
unit.target: «Sapienter constrinxisti. Spero te me adiuvare posse ut alium daemonis progeniem occidam; ille alicubi in Mari Furioso habitat.»

unit.source: “Don’t worry, Demon descendants are cold, cruel, and blood‑thirsty.
unit.target: Noli timere, daemonis progenies frigidae, crudeles atque sanguine sitientes sunt.

unit.source: He definitely meets the death penalty standard in your hearts.”
unit.target: Indubitanter in vestris cordibus normas supplicii mortis convenit.

unit.source: “Then why don’t you do it yourself?”
unit.target: «Tum cur ipse non facis?»

unit.source: Franca clicked her tongue.
unit.target: Franca lingua striduit.

unit.source: “You seem quite powerful.”
unit.target: «Valde potens videris.»

unit.source: Is it because you’re sealed?
unit.target: An quia sigillatus es?

unit.source: Or could it be that he can’t leave the Abyss and can only project himself onto a human like now, unable to maintain it for long?
unit.target: An fortasse non potest Abyssum relinquere et solum se in homine, ut nunc, proicere, diutius manere non valeat?

unit.source: Naboredisley replied calmly, “Any abnormal movements from me will attract the attention of the other Demon.
unit.target: Naboredisley tranquillē respondit: «Quaecumque abnorma motus a me efferentur, alii daemonis attentionem allicient.

unit.source: The reward for this transaction is that I fulfill one of your wishes.
unit.target: Merces huius transactionis est, ut unum ex tuis votis impleam.

unit.source: It’s a predetermined wish that I can fulfill.”
unit.target: Praedefinitum est votum quod exsequi possum.

unit.source: “Can you help us digest the potion in our bodies?” Lumian probed.
unit.target: «Potesne nobis adiuvare ad potionem in corporibus nostris digerendam?» Lumian interrogavit.

unit.source: Naboredisley shook his head.
unit.target: Naboredisley caput concussit.

unit.source: “I won’t lie to you. I can’t do it. The digestion of the potion is a personal matter.
unit.target: «Non mentiar vobis. Non possum id facere. Digestio potionis res privata est.

unit.source: “Of course, I can create conditions and opportunities to indirectly help you digest the potion as soon as possible, but whether you can seize those opportunities depends on yourselves.”
unit.target: «Certe, condiciones et occasiones creare possum, ut vobis indirecte ad potionem quam primum digerendam auxilium feram; sed utrum illas occasiones capere valeatis, in vobis ipsis dependent.»

unit.source: Quite honest… Franca muttered silently.
unit.target: Valde honestum… Franca tacite murmurat.

unit.source: Suddenly, she revealed a bright smile.
unit.target: Subito, ipsa nitidum subrisum ostendit.

unit.source: “This deal tempts me, but I need a reliable and powerful witness.”
unit.target: «Hoc pactum me tentat, sed mihi testem fidum et validum opus est.»

unit.source: Author’s Note: The inspiration for the love incantation in the previous chapter originated from the real world.
unit.target: Nota Auctoris: Inspiratio incantationis amoris in capitulo previo ex mundo reali orta est.

unit.source: I believe I’ve shared it on my public WeChat account before—Aphrodite’s hidden name is Nepherieri, meaning “beautiful eyes.”
unit.target: Credo me id ante in meo publico WeChat ratione communicavisse—occultum nomen Aphroditis est Nepherieri, quod “oculi pulchri” significat.

unit.source: Repeating this incantation can win a woman’s love.
unit.target: Hoc incantationem repetere potest feminae amorem vincere.

unit.source: When I read about this, I found it a little sinister.
unit.target: Cum de hoc legerim, me paulum sinistrum arbitratus sum.

unit.source: I mainly changed the pronunciation.
unit.target: Praecipue pronuntiatiōnem mutavi.

unit.source: 618 Divination Ritual
unit.target: 618 Ritus Divinationis

unit.source: Franca’s request met with a gentle shake of Naboredisley’s head.
unit.target: Petitum Francae obvenit leni gyratione capitis Naboredisley.

unit.source: “You can request the deity you believe in to bear witness when signing the contract, but I don’t want anyone else present.”
unit.target: “Deum, in quem fidem habes, petere potes ut testis fiat dum pactum signas, sed nolo ut alii adsint.”

unit.source: A chuckle escaped Naboredisley’s lips.
unit.target: Risus levis ex labris Naboredisley effugit.

unit.source: “I’m a Demon.
unit.target: Daemon sum.

unit.source: I need to be careful to avoid becoming prey.”
unit.target: Caveo ne praeda fias.

unit.source: We can recite a god’s name as a witness when signing the contract?
unit.target: Possumusne nomen dei pronuntiare ut testis, dum pactum subscribimus?

unit.source: The temptation loomed over them both.
unit.target: Tentatio super eos ambo imminebat.

unit.source: For ordinary Beyonders who held faith in the Eternal Blazing Sun or the God of Steam and Machinery, invoking a deity’s name as a witness might offer no more than psychological comfort.
unit.target: Nam Beyonders vulgares, qui fidem habebant in Sole Aeterno Ardente aut in Deo Vaporis et Machinarum, per invocationem nominis dei, ut testis, nihil praeter solacium psychologicum praestare possent.

unit.source: True gods rarely intervened in such trivial affairs of ordinary Beyonders without a proper ritual.
unit.target: Vere dii raro in talibus rebus trivialibus Beyonders vulgares interveniebant, sine rito proprio.

unit.source: Yet, as Minor Arcana card holders of the Tarot Club, Lumian and Franca followed the great existence, Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Sed ut tenentes chartarum Minorum Arcanorum in Societate Taroti, Lumian et Franca magnam existentiam, Domine Stultus, secuti sunt.

unit.source: Simply invoking his name could draw attention, a fact not lost on them.
unit.target: Simpliciter eius nomine invocato, attentionem allicere poterat, et hoc eis notum erat.

unit.source: Franca’s heart raced with uncertainty.
unit.target: Cor Francae incertitudine palpitabat.

unit.source: Should she strike a deal with the Demon under the watchful gaze of Mr. Fool, in exchange for elusive benefits?
unit.target: Num pactum faciat cum Daemone sub vigilantia Domini Stulti, pro beneficiis fugacibus?

unit.source: Naboredisley reiterated his stance.
unit.target: Naboredisley iterum suam sententiam enuntiavit.

unit.source: “This is a fair transaction.
unit.target: “Haec est transactio aequa.

unit.source: There’s no coercion.
unit.target: Nulla coactio est.

unit.source: It’s the same for you and me.
unit.target: Idem est tibi ac mihi.

unit.source: If you insist that there must be a powerful witness present, I choose to give up.”
unit.target: Si persistas ut adsit testis potens, ego opto cedere.”

unit.source: Just as Lumian contemplated the idea, Termiboros’s resounding voice echoed within his mind, “It’s best if you don’t agree. Don’t even make a false promise.”
unit.target: Dum Lumian de ea cogitabat, vox sonans Termiborosis in mente eius resonabat: “Optime est, si non consentis; ne falsam quidem promissionem facias.”

unit.source: Lumian found himself taken aback as Termiboros, an Angel of Inevitability, unexpectedly warned him about the unfolding situation.
unit.target: Lumian obstupefactus est, cum Termiboros, Angelus Inevitabilitatis, eum inopinanter de eventu monuerit.

unit.source: Alarmed, Lumian pushed aside thoughts of Termiboros’s possible intentions, choosing instead to focus on scrutinizing Naboredisley’s every move and assessing his own mental state.
unit.target: Territus, Lumian cogitationibus de intensionibus Termiborosis deponit, et potius se vertit ad perscrutandum omnem motum Naboredisley atque ad aestimandam suam mentis condicionem.

unit.source: The more Lumian delved into the matter, the more alarmed he became.
unit.target: Quo magis Lumian in rem intuebatur, eo magis territus factus est.

unit.source: Initially planning to teleport away immediately and seek help, he and Franca had gradually shifted their stance, considering Naboredisley’s propositions and exploring potential exploitations.
unit.target: Primum, cum consiliis statim discedendi et auxilium quaerendi, ille et Franca gradatim suam positionem mutaverant, propositiones Naboredisley considerantes atque opportunitates explorantes.

unit.source: Their plan had evolved from seeking the presence of a powerful Arbiter like Madam Judgment as a witness to contemplating a deal without one.
unit.target: Consilium eorum evoluta est, ab quaerendo praesentiam Arbiteris validi, ut Domina Iudicium, pro testimonium, ad cogitandum pactum sine eo conversum.

unit.source: Now, all they hoped was to ensure their safety by invoking a god’s name.
unit.target: Iam solum id sperabant ut salutem suam assecurarent, invocando nomen dei.

unit.source: Compromising one step at a time, changing bit by bit…
unit.target: Unum gradum singillatim, paulatim variando…

unit.source: This is very similar to Naboredisley’s description of degenerating bit by bit, slowly rotting one’s soul before ultimately plunging into the Abyss…
unit.target: Hoc est simile narrationi Naboredisley de paulatim degenerando, animam paulatim putrescente antequam tandem in Abyssum immitatur…

unit.source: It also said that Demons aren’t just about the body but also about the mind…
unit.target: Item dictum est daemonia non solum ad corpus, sed etiam ad mentem pertinere…

unit.source: Lumian swiftly snapped out of his reverie, sensing a possible influence from Naboredisley on both himself and Franca.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter ex sua meditatione evasit, intuens possibilem influentiam Naboredisley in se et in Francam.

unit.source: It resembled the signs of a Spectator’s presence.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat signis praesentiae Spectatoris.

unit.source: Similarly, he could glean insights through Anthony’s self-examination technique.
unit.target: Similiter, per artem sui ipsius examinandi, quam Antonius exercet, notitias colligere poterat.

unit.source: Even in this state, Franca displayed remarkable control over her emotions.
unit.target: Etiam in hoc statu, Franca eminet imperium super affectus suos ostendit.

unit.source: She turned to Lumian, seeking agreement.
unit.target: Se versa ad Lumian, consensum petens.

unit.source: With thoughts racing, the corners of Lumian’s mouth curled up slightly as he addressed Naboredisley.
unit.target: Mentibus ferventibus, anguli oris Lumiani paulum incurvabantur quam dum ad Naboredisley loquebatur.

unit.source: “We don’t require a witness, but I need to confirm something first.”
unit.target: “Testis non nobis requiritur, sed primum aliquid confirmare mihi oportet.”

unit.source: “What is it?” Naboredisley’s demeanor remained cold, yet his attitude was composed.
unit.target: “Quid est?” inquit Naboredisley; habitus eius frigidus manebat, sed animus eius compositus erat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded at Franca, conveying that he would handle the situation.
unit.target: Lumian Francae annuit, significans se rem expediendum se curaturum.

unit.source: Franca, in turn, silently acknowledged her understanding.
unit.target: Franca silentio suam comprehensionem agnovit.

unit.source: Turning back to Naboredisley, Lumian stated, “I need to verify that the name you’re using now, the name you’ll use in the contract later, is indeed your real name.”
unit.target: Conversus ad Naboredisley, Lumian ait: “Mihi necesse est probare nomen, quod nunc uteris et in pacto postea adhibebis, vere nomen tuum esse.”

unit.source: Deliberately avoiding the term “Naboredisley,” Lumian exercised caution to mitigate potential risks.
unit.target: Cautissime vitans vocabulum “Naboredisley”, Lumian id prudenter egit, ut pericula possibilia minueret.

unit.source: Naboredisley pondered for a moment before responding, “Sure. As a Demon, I don’t just dislike but also admire your caution.”
unit.target: Naboredisley paulisper meditatus respondit: “Certe. Daemon sum; non solum detestor, sed etiam tuam cautelam admiror.”

unit.source: Lumian maintained his smirk.
unit.target: Lumian subrisum suum conservavit.

unit.source: “The way to confirm is Magic Mirror Divination, a complete one.
unit.target: “Modus confirmandi est Divinatio Speculi Magici, completa.

unit.source: We’ll set up a ritual and seek answers from a hidden entity.
unit.target: Ritum instituemus et responsa a re abscondita quaeremus.

unit.source: As you know, my friend is a Demoness.
unit.target: Ut nosti, amica mea Daemona est.

unit.source: She’s quite skilled at this.”
unit.target: Ea hac re optime versata est.

unit.source: Lumian pointed at Franca as he spoke.
unit.target: Lumian in Francam monstravit, dum loquebatur.

unit.source: Indeed… we should confirm if Naboredisley is the Demon’s real name.
unit.target: Vere… debemus confirmare utrum Naboredisley verum Daemoni nomen sit.

unit.source: Otherwise, the deal would be a joke…
unit.target: Aliter, res illud iocus esset…

unit.source: Franca suddenly became alert, realizing she had been too eager to conclude the deal and had overlooked many potentially problematic details.
unit.target: Subito Franca vigilans facta est, intellegens se nimis festinasse ad pactum concludendum et multas rebus problematicis neglexisse.

unit.source: Naboredisley pondered for a moment before agreeing, “Alright, but I have to observe from within the wall of spirituality where the ritual takes place.
unit.target: Naboredisley paulisper meditatus est antequam assentivit: “Recte, sed mihi ex pariete spiritualitatis, ubi ritus perficitur, observare debeo.

unit.source: “This is a Demon’s caution. We’re worried that you’ll use Magic Mirror Divination to inform certain Demons’ natural enemies.”
unit.target: “Haec est cautela Daemoni. Nos metimus te Divinationem Speculi Magici ad certos naturales inimicos daemonum nuntiare venturum.”

unit.source: “No problem,” Lumian said with a bright smile.
unit.target: “Nullum est,” inquit Lumian, subridente laete.

unit.source: “To complete Magic Mirror Divination, I want you to write your real name on this note and bring over the ancient notebook from the opposite room.
unit.target: “Ad perficiendam Divinationem Speculi Magici, volo ut nomen tuum verum in hoc chirographo scribas et codicem antiquum ex conclavi opposito afferas.

unit.source: Naboredisley, well-versed in the intricacies of complete Magic Mirror Divination, responded with a smile, “No problem.”
unit.target: Naboredisley, bene versatus in subtilitatibus Divinationis Speculi Magici completae, respondit subridente: “Nullum est.”

unit.source: He stood up, taking the note from Lumian’s hand.
unit.target: Surrexit, accipiens schedulam de manu Lumiani.

unit.source: Using Flores’s fountain pen, he inscribed a complex word with the pronunciation “Naboredisley,” its language unknown.
unit.target: Utens calamo Florensis, verbum compositum cum pronuntiatione “Naboredisley” inscripsit, cuius lingua ignota erat.

unit.source: The self-proclaimed Demon then left for Flores’s rented apartment, retrieving the ancient notebook and the note.
unit.target: Daemon, se ipse proclamans, deinde abiit ad domum conducendam Florensis, recuperans codicem antiquum et schedulam.

unit.source: Lumian had already arranged a simple ritual, placing three candles and a mirror on an empty table.
unit.target: Lumian iam ritum simplicem instituerat, tres candelas et speculum in mensa vacua posuit.

unit.source: Before Naboredisley returned, Franca approached him and whispered, “The usual Magic Mirror Divination target?”
unit.target: Antequam Naboredisley rediret, Franca accessit eumque susurravit: “Scopus solitus Divinationis Speculi Magici?”

unit.source: Lumian shook his head, indicating they weren’t.
unit.target: Lumian caput negavit, indicans eos non esse.

unit.source: Softly uttering a single word, he said, “Him.”
unit.target: Leniter unum verbum pronuntians, dixit: “Eum.”

unit.source: A pure male pronoun.
unit.target: Pronominum masculinum purum.

unit.source: Franca’s pupils dilated as she tacitly understood whom Lumian was referring to.
unit.target: Pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, cum tacite intellexit ad quem Lumian referebat.

unit.source: The implications were self-evident!
unit.target: Implicationes manifestae erant!

unit.source: After Naboredisley handed her the ancient notebook, Franca smiled happily and said, “Demons are likely higher-level godhood creatures.
unit.target: Postquam Naboredisley ei codicem antiquum tradidit, Franca laetissima risit et dixit: “Daemones fortasse sunt creaturae divinitatis altioris.

unit.source: I can’t afford to be negligent.
unit.target: Neglegere mihi non licet.

unit.source: I plan to seek answers from a more special entity.
unit.target: Proposito meo est responsa ab entitate speciali quaerere.

unit.source: Inevitably, my companion will need to assist me during the ritual.
unit.target: Inevitabiliter, comes meus mihi in ritu auxilium ferre debebit.

unit.source: I hope you can understand what you’ll see next.
unit.target: Spero te intellegere posse quid deinceps videbis.

unit.source: If you’re unwilling, we’ll abandon this transaction.
unit.target: Si nolueris, hanc transactionem relinquemus.

unit.source: She didn’t make it sound too firm, making the “abandon the transaction” option seem more like a negotiating strategy.
unit.target: Ea non ita firmiter pronuntiavit, ita ut optio “transactionem relinquere” magis ut consilium tractationis appareret.

unit.source: Naboredisley smiled and replied, “No problem. I’ve seen too many special rituals.”
unit.target: Naboredisley subridente respondit: “Nullum est; plurimos ritus peculiares vidi.”

unit.source: His implication was clear—if there was a problem with your ritual, I would be able to tell immediately.
unit.target: Eius implicatio erat manifesta—si quaestio de tuo ritu oriretur, statim id agnoscerem.

unit.source: Franca sanctified the ritual silver dagger and created a wall of spirituality.
unit.target: Franca sanctificavit pugionem argenteum ritualem et murum spiritualitatis condidit.

unit.source: Lumian placed the ancient notebook and the note with the real name in front of the lit candle and mirror, using a small amount of Gardner Martin’s spiritual blood to draw a few complicated and strange symbols.
unit.target: Lumian codicem antiquum et schedulam, cui nomen verum inscriptum erat, ante candelam accensam et speculum posuit, parva quantitate sanguinis spiritualis Gardner Martin utens ad complura symbola perplexa et insolita delineanda.

unit.source: Observing from a distance, Naboredisley muttered, “Seeking guidance from fate… Questioning an entity in this domain?”
unit.target: A longe observans, Naboredisley submurmuravit: “Consilium a fato quaero… Interrogans entitatem in hoc regno?”

unit.source: Lumian seized the opportunity to turn around and ask, “What can I do to dispel Salah’s infatuation with Flores?”
unit.target: Lumian occasionem rapuit ad se convertere et rogavit: “Quid facere possum ut infatuationem Salah erga Flores deluderim?”

unit.source: Naboredisley smiled meaningfully and said, “Either they both perish, or they seek my approval.”
unit.target: Naboredisley subrisit signanter et inquit: “Aut uterque peribit, aut approbationem meam quaeret.”

unit.source: With the preparations complete, Franca stepped back, gazing at the three burning candles and the palm-sized makeup mirror.
unit.target: Cum omnia parata essent, Franca recedebat, intuens tres candelas ardentes et speculum parvum, simile palmae magnitudine.

unit.source: She recited an honorific name in ancient Hermes.
unit.target: Ea nomen honorificum in antiquo Hermetis recitavit.

unit.source: “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era…”
unit.target: “Stultus, qui huic aetati non competit…”

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Naboredisley’s expression changed.
unit.target: Hoc audito, vultus Naboredisley mutatus est.

unit.source: His face turned icy, and his eyes revealed a chilling cruelty.
unit.target: Facies eius frigida facta est, et oculi eius crudelitatem terribilem patefecerunt.

unit.source: Just as he was about to project Lumian and Franca’s figures in his eyes and ignite their desires and emotions, he realized that a thin gray fog emanated, making the two targets indistinct and challenging to lock onto.
unit.target: Ita ut iam proximus esset figuras Lumiani et Francae in oculis suis proicere atque eorum desideria et affectus excitare, intellexit tenuem nebulam griseam emanare, quae utrumque scopum indistincte effecit et assequi laborebat.

unit.source: Lumian gripped Franca’s forearm.
unit.target: Lumian Francae antebrachium ceperat.

unit.source: In mysticism, this signified that the two people in the ritual were one.
unit.target: In mystica, hoc significabat duas personas in ritu unum esse.

unit.source: Of course, the prerequisite was that the original ritual host didn’t resist.
