unit.target: Certe, praerequisitum erat ut hospes originalis ritu non repugneret.

unit.source: Lumian took over the ritual host’s position and recited the last two paragraphs.
unit.target: Lumian locum hospitis rituum suscepit atque duas ultimas partes recitavit.

unit.source: “The mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…”
unit.target: “Dominus arcanus super nebulam griseam; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam imperat…”

unit.source: The thick gray fog surged even more visibly, and Naboredisley, manipulating Flores’s body, grew increasingly malevolent.
unit.target: Nebula grisea densa etiam magis conspicue apparuit, et Naboredisley, corpus Floris regens, malevolentiam augebat.

unit.source: He tried to break free from the altar, attempting to shatter the wall of spirituality, but the gray fog stood as an impenetrable obstacle.
unit.target: Conatus est ab altare liberari, murum spiritualitatis perrumpere temptans, sed nebula grisea quasi obstaculum impenetrabile stabat.

unit.source: Lumian advanced two steps, presenting the note with the real name to the candle symbolizing the ritual’s host.
unit.target: Lumian duos gradus processit, schedulam cui nomen verum inscriptum erat ad candelam, quae hospitem rituum repraesentabat, exhibens.

unit.source: He ignited it and flicked it three times, dispersing ashes onto the ancient notebook.
unit.target: Illam accendit et ter pulsavit, cineres in codicem antiquum diffundens.

unit.source: After these preparations, Lumian spoke in a deep voice, “I beseech your assistance. I implore you to banish the creature named Naboredisley…”
unit.target: Post hos praeparatos, Lumian voce profunda dixit: “Auxilium tuum oro. Te obsecro, expelle creaturam, quae ‘Naboredisley’ nominatur…”

unit.source: Naboredisley, in control of Flores’s body, opened his mouth, emitting a sharp cry.
unit.target: Naboredisley, corpus Floris regens, os aperuit et acutum clamor edidit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, filth, depravity, and evil ravings echoed in Lumian and Franca’s ears.
unit.target: Simul, sordes, pravitas, et malefica deliria in auribus Lumiani et Francae resonaverunt.

unit.source: Each word seemed to assault their minds, causing their bodies to contort and their souls to decay.
unit.target: Singula verba animos eorum oppugnare videbantur, corpora eorum contorti facientes ac animas eorum putrescere.

unit.source: Yet, under the ritual’s shield and the layers of gray fog, the words appeared distant, as if emanating from the horizon.
unit.target: Attamen, sub scuto rituali et stratis nebulae griseae, verba remota videbantur, quasi ab horizonte emanarent.

unit.source: Even if Lumian and Franca strained to listen, the specifics eluded them.
unit.target: Etiam, si Lumian et Franca auscultare conabantur, singula eis evanuerunt.

unit.source: Amidst a faint shriek, pitch‑black gas emanated from Flores’s body, swiftly dissipating.
unit.target: Inter tenuem stridorem, gas nigerrimus ex corpore Floris emanavit, celeriter dissipans.

unit.source: Faces emerged from the pitch‑black gas, mouths opening and closing, cursing Lumian and Franca vehemently, only to dissolve into the gray fog.
unit.target: Vultus ex gasi nigerrimo orti sunt, ora aperiens atque claudens, Lumian et Francam vehementer maledicentes, solum ut in nebulam griseam dissolverentur.

unit.source: In a matter of seconds, the pitch‑black gas completely vanished, and Flores’s demeanor and aura returned to normal.
unit.target: In paucis secundis, gas nigerrimus omnino evanuit, et habitus atque aura Floris ad statum normalem redierunt.

unit.source: Exorcism Spell!
unit.target: Exorcismus!

unit.source: In just a few days, Lumian had employed the Exorcism Spell once more!
unit.target: In paucis diebus, Lumian iterum incantationem exorcismi adhibuit!

unit.source: From his perspective, Naboredisley, hiding his true form somewhere, had stealthily infiltrated Flores’s breath for control.
unit.target: Ex sua parte, Naboredisley, veram formam alicubi celans, subdolus spiritum Floris ad dominationem insinuaverat.

unit.source: He was akin to a Wraith evil spirit possessing another.
unit.target: Ille erat quasi umbra, spiritus malignus alterum possidens.

unit.source: Most surprising was the effectiveness of the name Naboredisley!
unit.target: Maxime mirabile erat efficacitas nominis Naboredisley!

unit.source: Of course, if this wasn’t the true name, if the Exorcism Spell proved futile, Lumian could resort to Mr. Fool’s complete honorific name to intimidate the Demon and drive it away with the gray fog and the gaze of a great existence.
unit.target: Certe, si hoc non esset verum nomen, si incantatio exorcismi futilis esset, Lumian ad totum nomen honorificum Domini Stulti confugere potuisset, ut Daemonem intimaret et eum nebulā griseā atque aspectu magni existentiae expelleret.

unit.source: This time, it wasn’t Mr. Fool’s seal on his chest that answered, but the great existence himself!
unit.target: Hoc tempore, non sigillum Domini Stulti in pectore illius respondit, sed ipsa magna existentia!

unit.source: Lumian forced a smile and said to Franca, “This fellow is less formidable than the invisible Child of God of the Great Mother.”
unit.target: Lumian subrisum compulit et Francae ait: “Hic homo minus formidabilis est quam Infans Dei invisibilis Matris Magnae.”

unit.source: Despite Naboredisley’s frenzied curse affecting his desires and emotions, requiring him to endure with his Ascetic powers, it still paled in comparison to the invisible Child of God’s ability to partially breach the gray fog’s protection of the ritual host, repeatedly creating a Psychic Piercing effect.
unit.target: Quamquam furiosa maledictio Naboredisley, quae desideria et affectus eius afficiebat atque eum virtutibus asceticis pati faciebat, adhuc parum videbatur comparata cum facultate Infantis Dei invisibilis, quae ad defensionem nebulae griseae hospitis rituum partim irrumpere poterat atque effectus psychicas percussiones iteratas creabat.

unit.source: Franca remained silent, her gaze fixed on the makeup mirror serving as decoration.
unit.target: Franca silentium retinuit, oculi eius in speculo ornamento fungente fixa erant.

unit.source: In the mirror, a faint fog permeated the air, and a vague figure approached from a distance.
unit.target: In speculo, nebulula tenuis aerem pervasit, et figura vaga ex longinquo accessit.

unit.source: 619 Chronicles
unit.target: 619 Chronicae

unit.source: Franca strained her eyes, attempting to discern the figure amidst the dimly lit surroundings.
unit.target: Franca oculos strenue conigit, figuram inter obscurum lumen circumdantium discernere conante.

unit.source: The tall buildings loomed mysteriously, their outlines blending with the fog, reminiscent of stars reflecting on a foggy night.
unit.target: Aedificia alta mysterio apparabantur, lineamenta eorum cum nebula miscebantur, quasi stellae in nocte nebulosa reflexae.

unit.source: In the distance, lights flickered, accompanied by indistinct honking sounds.
unit.target: In longinquo lumina micabant, comitantur sonitus tubarum inconfusi.

unit.source: Wh… Franca’s pupils dilated, and her eyes widened in astonishment.
unit.target: Ecce… pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, et oculi eius stupore expansae.

unit.source: Her heart, previously gripped by the effects of Naboredisley’s frenzied curse, now surged with shock.
unit.target: Cor eius, olim captum effectibus maledicti furoris Naboredisley, nunc subito pertonitum excitatum est.

unit.source: Instinctively, she focused all her might on the figure, trying to pierce through the layers of gray fog and unravel its face and clothing.
unit.target: Instinctu totam potentiam suam in figuram intendit, conans per stratos nebulae grisea penetrare atque eius faciem ac vestimenta explicare.

unit.source: However, the thin fog grew hazier, dissipating along with the fleeting images it carried.
unit.target: Attamen, tenuis nebula magis opaca facta est, evanescens cum imaginibus labilibus quas portabat.

unit.source: In just three to four seconds, the mirror on the altar reverted to its normal state.
unit.target: In tantis tribus ad quattuor secundis, speculum in altare ad statum suum normalem rediit.

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian turned to Flores, who lingered in the residual gray fog, seeking an update on Franca’s condition.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” Lumian ad Flores conversus est, qui in nebula grise residuali remansabat, quaerens de statu Francae nuntium.

unit.source: Franca, still captivated by the mirror, fell silent for a moment before speaking.
unit.target: Franca, adhuc speculo captata, momento silentium cepit antequam loqui inciperet.

unit.source: “Did you see the scene reflected in the mirror?”
unit.target: “Vidistine scaenam in speculo reflexam?”

unit.source: “I did.” Lumian reflected briefly and suggested, “Perhaps it signifies Mr. Fool’s divine kingdom.”
unit.target: “Vidi.” Lumian breviter meditatus est et proposuit, “Forsitan significat regnum divinum Domini Stulti.”

unit.source: Their prayers for the Exorcism Spell had been directed towards Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Precationes eorum pro Incantatione Exorcismi ad Dominum Stultum directae erant.

unit.source: Therefore, the mirror used to deceive Naboredisley while being ineffective in actuality was likely related to Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Itaque, speculum ad decipiendum Naboredisley usitatum, dum re vera inefficax erat, verisimiliter ad Dominum Stultum pertinuit.

unit.source: Franca stammered, “B-but the backdrop resembles the city before your sister and I transmigrated.
unit.target: Franca balbutiens dixit, “M–mē tamen scaena postica urbi similis est antequam soror tua et ego translati essemus.

unit.source: It’s like those foggy times—every building morphing into colossal creatures nestled in the fog, adorned with countless glowing eyes.
unit.target: Similis est illis temporibus nebularum—omnia aedificia in ingentes creaturas in nebula collocatas mutare videntur, ornata oculis innumerabilibus fulgentibus.

unit.source: Lumian, understanding Franca’s emotions, showed no surprise at the familiar street scenes.
unit.target: Lumian, affectus Francae intellegens, nullam admirationem pro consuetis scaenis viarum ostendit.

unit.source: Reminding his companion, he said, “Don’t forget about the Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Socii suo admonens dixit, “Noli oblivisci de Celestiali Digno.

unit.source: He has a close connection to your homeland, and he and Mr. Fool have been engaged in a dream battle.
unit.target: Ille arctam relationem cum patria tua habet, et ipse atque Dominus Stultus in pugna somniorum versati sunt.

unit.source: It’s quite conceivable that such dreamscapes can manifest in reality through rituals.
unit.target: Plenissime fieri potest ut talia spectacula somniorum per ritus in rem manifestentur.

unit.source: Franca fell into a momentary silence before releasing a sigh.
unit.target: Franca in silentium momento cecidit antequam suspirum emitteret.

unit.source: “You’re right…”
unit.target: “Recte dicis…”

unit.source: She followed with a self-deprecating laugh.
unit.target: Deinde risu auto-despectivo se commituit.

unit.source: “I got worked up for nothing.”
unit.target: “Pro nihilo commota sum.”

unit.source: Lumian mitigated the negative effects from Naboredisley and methodically extinguished the candle flames, concluding the ritual.
unit.target: Lumian effectus negativos a Naboredisley lenivit et flammas candelae methodice exstinxit, ritum concludens.

unit.source: As Franca dispelled the wall of spirituality and the wind howled, clearing away the lingering gray fog, Flores seemed to snap back to reality, no longer lost in the confusion of searching for an exit.
unit.target: Dum Franca murum spiritualitatis dissolvit et ventus ululabat, nebulam grise remanentem tollens, Flores ad rem revocari videbatur, iam non in confusione exitus quaerendi perditus.

unit.source: However, upon seeing Lumian and Franca, his face turned an even more pallid shade.
unit.target: Attamen, Lumianem et Francam videns, vultus eius etiam pallidior factus est.

unit.source: Just as he was about to plead for mercy, a sharp pain shot through Flores’s body.
unit.target: Iam cum misericordiam petere pararetur, acuta dolor per corpus Flores transeat.

unit.source: Instinctively, he lowered his head and observed a black, almost ethereal, filthy liquid oozing from his body.
unit.target: Instinctive, caput inclinavit et observavit liquidum atrum, paene aethericum, immundum ex corpore suo effluere.

unit.source: Highly corrosive, it swiftly dissolved his blood, flesh, and bones.
unit.target: Valde corrosivum, celeriter sanguinem, carnem, et ossa eius dissolvit.

unit.source: “No!
unit.target: “Non!

unit.source: “Save me!
unit.target: “Salva me!

unit.source: “Save me!”
unit.target: “Salva me!”

unit.source: Flores unleashed a blood-curdling scream, repeatedly calling for help.
unit.target: Flores clamorem terribilem edidit, iterum atque iterum auxilium vocans.

unit.source: Lumian, however, observed with interest, as though studying the toll exacted on those who made a deal with Demons.
unit.target: Lumian, attamen, cum studio contemplatus est, quasi poenam in iis qui pacto cum Daemoniis consenserunt spectans.

unit.source: In less than ten seconds, Flores’s body succumbed to corrosion, collapsing with a resounding crash, immersed in the almost illusory black liquid.
unit.target: In minus quam decem secundis, corpus Flores corrosioni cedere coepit, magno strepitu corruens, imerso in liquido nigro paene illusorio.

unit.source: Flores’s head continued to wail, his voice gradually fading.
unit.target: Caput Flores ululans perseverabat, vox eius paulatim evanescens.

unit.source: After a while, he breathed his last with wide-open eyes.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, ultimum spiritum egit cum oculis lati apertis.

unit.source: His relatively intact head swiftly disintegrated into the filthy liquid.
unit.target: Caput eius, relative intactum, celeriter in liquidum immundum dissolutum est.

unit.source: The once-illusory liquid lost its evil, mystical aura, revealing the remains of the corpse, now filled with a foul, noxious mud-like substance.
unit.target: Liquor, olim illusorius, maleficam et mysticam auram amisit, reliquias cadaveris revelans, nunc foetido luti instar substantia repletum ostendens.

unit.source: “Dealing with Demons doesn’t end well..” Franca sighed, reflecting on her earlier temptation.
unit.target: “Negotium cum Daemoniis bene finiendum non videtur…” Franca suspiravit, de priore tentatione cogitans.

unit.source: Her laughter echoed hollowly as she continued, “Thankfully, we didn’t strike a deal with that self-proclaimed ancient Demon.
unit.target: Risus eius caviter resonabat cum prosequeretur, “Benedictione, pactum non fecimus cum illo veteri Daemone seipso declarato.

unit.source: Still, I missed an opportunity to eliminate the latent threat of using the Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction.
unit.target: Attamen, occasionem amisi latentem minas ex usu Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis tollendi.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Consider this carefully.
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit, “Hoc diligenter considera.

unit.source: “I remember Madam Magician’s usage instructions, emphasizing the possibility of encountering transactions with evil entities like Demons.
unit.target: Memini praecepta usus Dominae Magicae, quae possibilitatem occurrence transactionum cum malis entibus, ut Daemoniis, extollere solebant.

unit.source: “Recall, it was about encountering a transaction, not completing one.
unit.target: Memento, de occurrence transactionis erat, non de eam perficienda.

unit.source: “You’ve faced it; you simply chose not to accept it. That fellow didn’t force you either.”
unit.target: Id expertus es; simpliciter nolivisti accipere, nec ille te compelluit.

unit.source: Franca contemplated the situation and admitted, “You make a point. It does seem that way…”
unit.target: Franca rem consideravit et confessa est, “Recte dicis. Ita videtur…”

unit.source: She clicked her tongue and glanced at Lumian.
unit.target: Lingua pulsans et ad Lumian intuentis.

unit.source: “If you had chosen the Lawyer path, you might be equally promising…
unit.target: “Si viam Advocati elegisses, aeque potens forsitan fuisset…

unit.source: “In reality, I believe that’s the norm. The Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction is, at most, equivalent to a Sequence 5.
unit.target: “Revera, hoc esse normam credo. Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis, saltem, aequivalens est ad Sequenciam V.

unit.source: Every use means one less opportunity. How could the negative effects be a transaction with a Demon?
unit.target: Quot usus, una minor occasio significatur. Quomodo effectus negativos transactioni cum Daemone esse possint?

unit.source: From what I know, Demon is a High Sequence term within the Criminal path. What does it signify? It represents a demigod!
unit.target: Ex his quae scio, Daemon terminus altus est in via Criminali. Quid significat? Imago semidei repraesentat!

unit.source: “Yes, it’s merely encountering a transaction, not completing it. There’s room for negotiation. Yet, it’s also highly dangerous.
unit.target: “Ita quidem, tantum transactio incidit, non perficiatur. Locus ad tractandum est; sed simul summopere periculosum est.

unit.source: Demons and other evil entities aren’t known for their philanthropy.
unit.target: Daemones atque alia mala entia pro philanthropia nota non sunt.

unit.source: If we refuse to trade with them, why would they spare us indefinitely?
unit.target: Si commercium cum illis neglegimus, cur nobis in aeternum parcere conarentur?

unit.source: Furthermore, predicting when we’ll encounter them is impossible, making it challenging to prepare in advance.
unit.target: Praeterea, praedicere quandocumque eos occursuros simus impossibile est, quod praeparationem difficilius reddit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “If you can’t predict it, try approaching it differently.
unit.target: “Si id praedicere non potes, alia ratione aditum age.

unit.source: After using the Authority Holder’s Under-the-table Transaction, immediately prepare and take the initiative to create an opportunity to negotiate with Demons and other evil creatures.
unit.target: Post usum Transactionis Sub-tabulum Possessoris Auctoritatis, statim para et incipe ad occasionem creandam ad tractationem cum Daemoniis aliisque malis creaturis.

unit.source: Set the pace and manage the risks.
unit.target: Celeritatem constitui et pericula regere.

unit.source: For instance, ‘invite’ Demons to Saint Viève Cathedral for a deal.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, Daemones ad Basilica Sanctae Viève “invida” ad pactum.

unit.source: The Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s main cathedral in Trier, Saint Viève Cathedral!
unit.target: Principalissima basilica Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Flammantis in Treviris, Basilica Sanctae Viève!

unit.source: Franca chuckled.
unit.target: Franca risum edidit.

unit.source: “Demons aren’t brainless zombies. Why would they willingly walk into Saint Viève Cathedral to meet their doom…”
unit.target: “Daemones non sunt zombii sine ratione. Cur enim voluntarie in Basilica Sanctae Viève ingrediantur ut fatum suum experirentur…”

unit.source: Franca suddenly halted.
unit.target: Franca subito sistit.

unit.source: Saint Viève Cathedral might not be suitable, but they did have a few hidden locations with a similar atmosphere.
unit.target: Basilica Sanctae Viève forsitan non apta sit, sed pauca loca abscondita cum simili atmosphaera habebantur.

unit.source: It wasn’t entirely impossible.
unit.target: Non plane impossibilia erant.

unit.source: For example, the sacrificial square on the third level of the catacombs, Krismona Night Pillar…
unit.target: Exempli gratia, forum sacrificii in tertio gradu catacumbarum, Columna Noctis Krismonae…

unit.source: “That’s an interesting idea,” Franca commended Lumian.
unit.target: “Illud praeclarum consilium est,” Franca Lumiano laudavit.

unit.source: “In the past, when facing the negative effects of mystical items, we always endured and waited passively.
unit.target: "In pristinis temporibus, cum effectibus negativis rerum mysticarum obviessemus, semper sustinui-mus et passive exspectavimus.

unit.source: Taking the initiative is a different approach. Hunters indeed have their own unique styles.
unit.target: Inceptum agendi alius modus est. Venatores vere proprias ac singulares rationes habent.

unit.source: Taking the initiative involved making preparations in advance and minimizing potential dangers.
unit.target: Inchoare operam significabat praeparations ante omnia facere atque pericula potentialia minuere.

unit.source: Of course, taking the initiative didn’t necessarily mean triggering the effects, but it required considering such possibilities.
unit.target: Scilicet, inceptum agendi non necessario significat effectus excitare, sed talia considerare oportet.

unit.source: Lumian glanced out the window.
unit.target: Lumian per fenestram intueri.

unit.source: “Flores’s scream has likely attracted the attention of the nearby residents.
unit.target: “Clamor Flores probabiliter attentionem incolarum vicinorum attulit.

unit.source: Someone may have called the police.
unit.target: Aliquis fortasse vigilum cohortem vocavit.

unit.source: Let’s vacate this place before examining the contents of this notebook.
unit.target: Eamus hic exire antequam codicis huius substantiam inspiciamus.

unit.source: He gathered the ancient notebook, candles, and other items from the dining table as he spoke.
unit.target: Ille codicem antiquam, candelas, et alias res ex mensa convivii congregavit dum loquebatur.

unit.source: “Agreed.” Franca surveyed the room, and dark flames silently ignited in various spots.
unit.target: “Consentitum.” Franca conclave inspiciens, et obscurae flammae silentio in diversis locis accenderunt.

unit.source: As the flames flickered, Lumian teleported Franca away, returning to the guest room of Captain Pedro’s five-story house.
unit.target: Dum flammae micabantur, Lumian Francam teletransportavit, rediens ad conclave hospitum domus capitanei Pedri quinque tabulata.

unit.source: “Go through the notebook and check if there’s a way to dispel the love incantation.
unit.target: “Perlege codicem atque vide an via sit incantationem amoris exstingui.

unit.source: I’ll verify Salah’s condition and inform Pedro about Flores’s situation and outcome.
unit.target: Statu Salah confirmabo et Pedrum certiorem faciam de re Flores atque eius eventu.

unit.source: He can handle the Church of Earth Mother and liaise with the local police.”
unit.target: Ipse curabit de Ecclesia Matris Terrae et cum vigilibus localibus consulabit.

unit.source: Lumian handed the ancient notebook to Franca before opening the door and stepping into the corridor.
unit.target: Lumian codicem antiquam Francae tradidit antequam ostium aperiret et in vestibulum ingredierit.

unit.source: Franca settled into the recliner and opened the notebook.
unit.target: Franca in solio reclinatorio consedit et codicem aperuit.

unit.source: Suddenly, she murmured to herself, Something feels off.
unit.target: Subito sibi murmurat, “Aliquid male videtur.”

unit.source: Knowing Lumian’s approach, shouldn’t he have immediately perused the notebook after the ritual, searching for a solution to dispel the love incantation?
unit.target: Lumiani consilium notum, num statim post ritum codicem perlegere debuisset, quaerens solutionem incantationis amoris exstingui?

unit.source: Why did he hastily leave the moment the police were mentioned after discussing matters with me extensively?
unit.target: Cur celeriter discessit in ipso momento quo de vigilibus dicta sunt postquam de rebus mecum plene disseruimus?

unit.source: He should be aware of the critical issue…
unit.target: Scire debet rem magni momenti…

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Franca suddenly came to a moment of realization.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabantur, Franca subito ad revelationem pervenit.

unit.source: Naboredisley’s chilling rants and wild curses had a disturbing impact on Lumian, stirring up his desires and emotions.
unit.target: Eroca verba terrifica atque ferocia maledicta Naboredisley in Lumiano perturbationem intulerunt, desideria atque affectus excitantes.

unit.source: Despite his attempts to endure the onslaught using his Ascetic powers, subtle signs of struggle manifested.
unit.target: Quamquam impetum tolerare conatus est utens viribus asceticis, subtilia signa certaminis manifeste apparuerunt.

unit.source: Franca’s eyes darted around, a sly chuckle escaping her lips.
unit.target: Oculi Francae circumvolitabant, subdolus risus labris eius effugiens.

unit.source: Lumian found Pedro in the small living room on the first floor.
unit.target: Lumian Pedrum invenit in parva triclinio primo tabulato.

unit.source: Before he could delve into Flores’s situation, the captain exclaimed in surprise,
unit.target: Priusquam de re Flores penetrare posset, capitaneus miratus exclamavit,

unit.source: “Mr. Berry, Salah came to me a few minutes ago.
unit.target: “Domine Berry, Salah mihi paucos minuta antevenit.

unit.source: She was crying in fear and pain, saying she dreamt of falling in love with Flores and couldn’t wake up.
unit.target: Flebat metu et dolore, dicens se somniasse amorem Flores atque excitari non posse.

unit.source: However, she suddenly woke up tonight, feeling like it was a nightmare, and she wishes to annul the engagement.
unit.target: Attamen, hac nocte subito expergefacta est, sensu quasi horrendo somnio, atque pactum dissolvere velle.

unit.source: “May I know how you did it?”
unit.target: “Licet scire quomodo id feceris?”

unit.source: Pedro spoke with a touch of unconscious politeness.
unit.target: Pedro cum levitate inconsciae urbanitatis loquebatur.

unit.source: She’s back to normal? Could it be because Flores is dead?
unit.target: “Rediit ad statum normalem? Forsitan quia Flores mortuus est?”

unit.source: No, more likely Naboredisley’s expulsion through the Exorcism Spell has restored those affected by the devil to normal…
unit.target: “Non; magis verisimile est exorcismi incantatione Naboredisley eos, qui a diabolo affecti erant, ad statum normalem restituisse…”

unit.source: Lumian guessed, smiling.
unit.target: Lumian suspicatus est, subridens.

unit.source: “Flores is already dead.”
unit.target: “Flores iam mortuus est.”

unit.source: “Did you kill him?” Pedro, showing no aversion to the idea of killing, was even more intrigued by the fact that Flores’s death seemed to have awakened his daughter.
unit.target: “Num eum occidisti?” Pedro, nullam repugnationem ad caedem ostendens, etiam magis admiratus est quod mors Flores filiam eius excitasse videbatur.

unit.source: “A Demon killed him.” Lumian briefly recounted the events, avoiding mentioning Naboredisley by name.
unit.target: “Daemon eum occidit.” Lumian brevius eventus narravit, nomen Naboredisley vitans.

unit.source: Instead, he handed Pedro the love incantation note tucked into an ancient notebook for a closer look.
unit.target: Pro eo, tradidit Pedro notam incantationis amoris in antiquo codice inclusam ad propiorem recognitionem.

unit.source: Finally, he said, “You handle the rest. It’s advisable to keep Salah in a cathedral or cloister for the next month or two.
unit.target: Denique dixit, “Restum tu curabis. Consulendum est Salah in basilica aut claustro retinere per proximos unum vel duo menses.

unit.source: I'm uncertain if the Demon will revisit the former victim once he recovers.”
unit.target: Nescio an daemon pristinum victimam, postquam se sanaverit, iterum visitabit.

unit.source: “Understood.” Pedro clenched his teeth, his expression somber.
unit.target: “Intellectum.” Pedro dentes contraxit, vultu graviter affecto.

unit.source: After receiving the 20,000 gold risot bounty, Lumian returned to his guest room.
unit.target: Postquam praemium 20,000 aureorum risot accepit, Lumian ad conclave hospitum rediit.

unit.source: Franca, holding the ancient notebook, frowned as she said, “This doesn’t seem like the notebook of an evil Warlock.
unit.target: Franca, codicem antīquum tenens, fronte contrasta dixit, “Hoc non videtur esse codex maligni Magi.

unit.source: It’s more like a collection of a novelty hunter’s chronicles.
unit.target: Potissimum videtur esse congeries chronicarum venatoris novitatis.

unit.source: It contains various legends of Devils and Demons from the Northern and Southern Continents spanning the past thousand years.
unit.target: Continet varias legendas de Diabolis et Daemoniis ex Continente Septentrionali et Meridionali per milia annorum praeteritorum.

unit.source: The last record appears to be over a hundred years ago.
unit.target: Ultimum documentum videtur esse plus quam centum annos abhinc.

unit.source: “Mmm… There are peculiar incantations scattered within, as if fabricated.
unit.target: “Mmm… incantationes peculiares intra dispersae videntur, quasi fictae.

unit.source: “One of them mentions a legend of a Demon on Hanth Island in the Berserk Sea.”
unit.target: Una earum memorat legendam de Daemone in Insula Hanth in Mari Frenetico.

unit.source: Lumian grasped Franca’s concern.
unit.target: Lumian sollicitationem Francae comprehendere sensit.

unit.source: Naboredisley had mentioned that the Demon descendant he sought to eliminate resided somewhere in the Berserk Sea!
unit.target: Naboredisley memoraverat Daemoni generis quem exstinguere quaerebat aliquo in Mari Frenetico habitare!

unit.source: 620 Abnormality in the Abyss
unit.target: 620 Abnormalitas in abyssō

unit.source: “Could it be that some of the Demon legends in this notebook are true?” Lumian held the yellowed notebook and flipped through a few pages.
unit.target: “Numquid quidam fabulae daemonum in hoc libello verae sint?” Lumian libellum flavum tenuit et per aliquot paginas volvit.

unit.source: Franca tersely acknowledged and said,
unit.target: Franca breviter annovit et dixit,

unit.source: “In a world where superpowers exist, where true Devils and Demons roam, many related legends must be true or have originated from the true prototype.”
unit.target: “In mundo ubi potentiae superae existent, ubi veri Diaboli et Daemones vagantur, multae fabulae cognatae verae esse debent aut ex prototypo vero orta sunt.”

unit.source: “Do you think Nabo—uh, the Demon who claimed to be ancient, might be the protagonist of one of these legends?”
unit.target: “Putasne Nabo—heu, daemon qui se antiquum esse professus est—fortasse protagonistam unius harum fabularum esse?”

unit.source: “And the Demon on Hanth Island is its archenemy, living in the real world disguised as a human.”
unit.target: “Et daemon in Insula Hanth est archinimicus eius, in mundo vero sub specie hominis habitans.”

unit.source: “It lied, claiming the other party is a descendant of a Demon and tempted us into taking risks to achieve a certain goal?”
unit.target: “Mendavit, dicens alterum daemonis posterum esse, atque nos ad pericula suscipienda ad certum finem incitavit?”

unit.source: “Perhaps,” Lumian smiled.
unit.target: “Fortasse,” risit Lumian.

unit.source: “Let’s not speculate about such matters involving high-level creatures.
unit.target: “Ne de rebus talibus, quae creaturae summi gradus attingunt, coniecturam faciamus.

unit.source: “I’ll just write to Madam Magician and report it to her.”
unit.target: “Modo ad Dominam Magicam scribam et id ea certiorem faciam.”

unit.source: Franca glanced at Lumian and chuckled.
unit.target: Franca Lumian intuens subridit.

unit.source: “You’re really proficient in dealing with management.”
unit.target: “Vere peritus es in rebus administrationis tractandis.”

unit.source: “However, it does make sense.”
unit.target: “Attamen, id perspicuum est.”

unit.source: “We know very little about real Demons.”
unit.target: “De daemonibus veris parum novimus.”

unit.source: “Making wild guesses is a waste of time.”
unit.target: “Coniecturae temere factae tempus inutile consumunt.”

unit.source: She then pointed at the notebook and said,
unit.target: Deinde ad libellum indicavit et dixit,

unit.source: “The handwriting differs from the note that wrote the Love Incantation.”
unit.target: “Scriptura differt ab illa notula, quae Incantationem Amoris scripsit.”

unit.source: “It’s not the same author.”
unit.target: “Non est eadem auctor.”

unit.source: Lumian had already sat at his desk, unfolded a piece of paper, and wrote to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lumian iam ad mensam sedebat, chartam explicavit, et ad Dominam Magicam scribebat.

unit.source: As he deliberated over his words, he responded to Franca’s words, “Does the notebook have the phrase that represents the Love Incantation?”
unit.target: Dum verba sua meditabat, respondit ad verba Francae: “Continetne hoc libellus locutionem, quae Incantationem Amoris repraesentat?”

unit.source: “I scanned through it. Nothing,” Franca replied affirmatively.
unit.target: “Perlegi. Nihil,” respondit Franca cum assenso.

unit.source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and said,
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus dixit,

unit.source: “There are two possibilities.”
unit.target: “Duae sunt possibilitates.”

unit.source: “The first is that the Demon used someone under its control to insert the Love Incantation into this notebook that records Devil and Demon legends, hoping that it could secretly spread and affect more people.”
unit.target: “Prima est, quod daemon aliquem, qui sub sua potestate erat, adhibuit ut Incantationem Amoris in hoc libello, qui fabulas Diabolorum et Daemonum continet, inscriberetur, sperans ea clandestine diffundi posse et plures afficere.”

unit.source: “The second possibility is that those who once read this notebook were unknowingly influenced by the demon and obtained a so‑called revelation.”
unit.target: “Secunda possibilitas est, quod illi, qui hunc libellum olim legerunt, daemonis incauti impulsu affecti sunt et revelationem adepti sunt.”

unit.source: “They wrote this Love Incantation and provided commentary.”
unit.target: “Hanc Incantationem Amoris scripserunt et commentarium praebuērunt.”

unit.source: “Mysticism sure is dangerous…” Franca sighed with emotion.
unit.target: “Misticismus certe periculosus est…” Franca cum affectu suspiravit.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly composed the letter and dispatched the ancient notebook and the note with the Love Incantation to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter epistolam composuit et antiquum libellum atque notam cum Incantatione Amoris ad Dominam Magicam misit.

unit.source: While awaiting a response, Franca and Lumian briefly delved into the Demon legend of Hanth Island in the Berserk Sea.
unit.target: Dum responsum exspectabant, Franca et Lumian breviter in fabulam daemonum Insulae Hanth in Mare Furiato inciderunt.

unit.source: Thirty years after Emperor Roselle discovered a safe sea route to the Southern Continent, numerous mysterious deaths of colonists and natives plagued the newly colonized Hanth Island.
unit.target: Triginta annis postquam Imperator Roselle iter maritimum tutum ad Continens Meridiionalem repperit, multas mortes mysteriosas colonorum et indigenarum nuper coloniae Insulae Hanth affligebant.

unit.source: Witnesses claimed to have seen a valley ablaze with sulfur flames in the island’s forest.
unit.target: Testes affirmaverunt se vidisse vallem in silva insulae sulphuris flammis ardentem.

unit.source: At night, pitch‑black Demons with goat horns were suspected of circling the area.
unit.target: Noctu, daemones nigerrimi cum cornibus caprinis, regionem circumire suspicabantur.

unit.source: After the authorities intervened, the mysterious deaths ceased.
unit.target: Postquam auctoritates intervenerunt, mortes mysteriosas cessaverunt.

unit.source: The owner of the notebook that chronicled the legend even attempted to explore the forest, but he failed to locate the alleged valley burning with sulfur flames.
unit.target: Possessor libelli, qui legendam enarravit, etiam temptavit silvam explorare, sed non potuit invenire vallem, quae dicitur sulphuris flammis ardere.

unit.source: As they conversed, time passed.
unit.target: Dum colloquebantur, tempus transiit.

unit.source: The doll messenger arrived with Madam Magician’s reply, the ancient notebook, and the Love Incantation note.
unit.target: Nuntius simulacrum advenerat cum responsione Dominae Magicam, antiquo libello, et nota Incantationis Amoris.

unit.source: Lumian illuminated the gas wall lamp and began reading.
unit.target: Lumian lampadem parietalem gasiferam accendit et legere inchoavit.

unit.source: Franca didn’t hesitate and leaned in.
unit.target: Franca non dubitavit et se inclinavit.

unit.source: “It’s impossible to determine its true name with just the fact that the name ‘Naboredisley’ could expel that fellow.”
unit.target: “Verum nomen eius determinare impossibile est, solum ex eo quod nomen ‘Naboredisley’ illum expellere potuit.”

unit.source: “This is because it admitted, in a short period of time, that it was its real name.”
unit.target: “Hoc est, quia brevi tempore agnovit se verum nomen suum esse.”

unit.source: “Even if it’s lying, sometimes, under certain circumstances, admitting something makes it the truth.”
unit.target: “Etiamsi mentitur, aliquando sub certis condicionibus, aliquid agnoscere veritatem facit.”

unit.source: “It possesses the corresponding mysticism connection. This is one of Mr. Fool’s authorities. Amon, too, could do it in the past.”
unit.target: “Illud habet nexum mysticum congruens. Hoc est unum ex auctoritatibus Domini Stulti. Amon quoque hoc priore tempore id efficere potuit.”

unit.source: “As you prayed directly to Mr. Fool and used his power to exorcize Naboredisley, it doesn’t matter if it’s its real name. It won’t affect the final outcome.”
unit.target: “Cum directe ad Dominum Stultum oravisses et eius vim ad expellendum Naboredisley adhibuisti, non refert an hoc verum nomen eius sit; exitum finalem non afficiet.”

unit.source: “Do you understand? Termiboros’s warning was correct. You have to be cautious even if it’s a false promise.”
unit.target: “Intellegisne? Monitio Termiboros recte fuit. Caute agendum tibi est, etiam si falsa promissio sit.”

unit.source: “If it’s truly a Demon and its true name is indeed Naboredisley, the problem ends up more complicated.”
unit.target: “Si vere daemon est et verum nomen eius re vera Naboredisley est, quaestio magis intricata fit.”

unit.source: “Since the Fifth Epoch, Demons active in the human world have either taken the form of Sealed Artifacts or come from Andariel, Beria, or Nois.”
unit.target: “Ab Quinta Aetate, daemones in mundo humano actuantes aut formam artificiorum sigillatorum adepti sunt aut ex Andariel, Beria, aut Nois oriuntur.”

unit.source: “Demons without surnames in their true names are often ancient or come from the Abyss where Devils and Demons reside. As for the Abyss’s current state, Emperor Roselle’s diary has mentions of it.”
unit.target: “Daemones, qui in veris nominibus cognomina non habent, saepe antiqui sunt aut ex abyssō, ubi Diaboli et Daemones habitant, oriuntur. Quod ad statum actuosum abyssī attinet, diarium Imperatoris Roselle de eo mentionem facit.”

unit.source: Upon reading this, Lumian turned to Franca.
unit.target: Hoc legens, Lumian ad Francam se vertit.

unit.source: In the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, he often observed others trading Emperor Roselle’s diary.
unit.target: In Societate Investigativa Papionum Crispatorum, saepe alios diarium Imperatoris Roselle commutantes observavit.

unit.source: When the April Fool’s members were still active, they would even recite the relatively comedic parts publicly.
unit.target: Cum sodales Aprilis Stultorum adhuc actuosi essent, etiam partes ridicules palam recitabant.

unit.source: However, having joined the transmigrator organization only recently, he had no interaction with translations from the past.
unit.target: Attamen, propter nuper ad societatem transmigratorum iunxi, translationibus veterum nullam interactionem habebat.

unit.source: He had no way of knowing what Abyss‑related matters the Emperor had recorded.
unit.target: Nesciebat quae de rebus abyssī Imperator conscripserat.

unit.source: Franca said with a solemn expression, “Emperor Roselle once found the entrance to the Abyss and conducted a thorough exploration.”
unit.target: Franca, vultu solemni, dixit: “Imperator Roselle olim introitum abyssī invenit et explorationem accuratam egit.”

unit.source: “As expected of Emperor Roselle,” Lumian praised instinctively and sincerely.
unit.target: “Sicut exspectabatur, Imperator Roselle,” Lumian instinctu atque sincere laudavit.

unit.source: There weren’t many people he admired—in fact, very few—but Emperor Roselle was one of them.
unit.target: Pauci erant homines quos admiraretur—revera valde pauci—sed Imperator Roselle unus ex eis erat.

unit.source: Knowing that this emperor was a transmigrator like his sister made him feel an affinity with him.
unit.target: Cognoscens hunc imperatorem, sicut sororem suam, transmigratorem esse, ei affinitatem afferebat.

unit.source: Franca continued, “In the Abyss that Emperor Roselle explored, Devils and Demons had long perished. Not a single one remained.
unit.target: Franca continuavit: “In abyssō, quem Imperator Roselle exploraverat, Diaboli et Daemones diu perierant. Ne unus quidem remansit.

unit.source: “All he saw before him were either corpses or silence.
unit.target: “Omnia quae ante eum visa erant, vel cadavera vel silentium erant.

unit.source: “This state made him feel fear. He left in a hurry without completing his exploration.”
unit.target: “Status iste timorem in eum effecit. Festinanter discessit, explorationem non perfecit.”

unit.source: “All dead?” Lumian frowned slightly. “Is the Love Incantation fellow either not a Demon or an ancient Demon from the Abyss’s core?”
unit.target: “Omnes mortui?” Lumian leviter fronem contraxit. “Num ille, cui Incantationem Amoris refertur, vel daemon non sit, vel daemon antiquus ex centro abyssī?”

unit.source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “If it’s really an ancient Demon, it might know why the Abyss underwent such an abnormality.”
unit.target: Paulatim mora facta, addidit: “Si vere daemon antiquus est, fortasse sciat cur abyssus talem abnormalitatem passa sit.”

unit.source: Franca nodded solemnly.
unit.target: Franca solemni modo annuivit.

unit.source: The duo cast their gazes at the back of Madam Magician’s reply.
unit.target: Duo oculos in tergum responsionis Dominae Magicam intuebantur.

unit.source: “I reckon you’ve already grasped the gist of the Abyss from the Two of Cups, so I won’t dive deeper.”
unit.target: “Puto te iam essentiam abyssī ex Duobus Poculis intellexisse, ideo non altius penetrare.”

unit.source: “Simply put, Naboredisley could be a potent Demon who slipped out of the Abyss’s anomaly, or it might have roamed the Northern Continent before the three major Devil clans—Nois, Beria, and Andariel—held sway.”
unit.target: “Brevi dictum, Naboredisley fortis daemon esse potuit, qui ex anomalía abyssī effugere potuit, aut in Continente Septentrionali vagatus esse, antequam tres praecipua catervae Diabolorum—Nois, Beria, et Andariel—dominari inciperent.”

unit.source: “It didn’t pledge allegiance to any ancient gods, whichever way you slice it. But dealing with an ancient Devil King who’s fled back to the Abyss isn’t something the two of you are capable of, let alone striking a bargain with it.”
unit.target: “Nulli deis antiquis fidelitatem promissit, quocumque modo aspicias; sed cum antiquo Diabolo rege, qui in abyssum rediit, agere, id non est quod vos alteri valeatis, nedum pactum conficere.”

unit.source: “You can explore the Demon legends on Hanth Island if it’s on your route, but stay cautious.”
unit.target: “Poteris fabulas daemonum in Insula Hanth explorare, si iter tuum illuc ducat, sed cave.”

unit.source: “Remember, the Abyss’s corruption is potent.”
unit.target: “Memento, corruptio abyssī potens est.”

unit.source: “It can corrupt people without their awareness.”
unit.target: “Potest homines corrumpere subdoliter, ne conscii sint.”

unit.source: “During this time, be vigilant for changes in your thoughts, concepts, emotions, and desires.”
unit.target: “Hoc tempore, vigilare debes mutationes in cogitationibus, notionibus, affectibus, et cupiditatibus tuis.”

unit.source: “If you notice anything unusual, consult a Psychiatrist for confirmation.”
unit.target: “Si quid insolitum animadvertis, ad medicum psychiatrum consule ad confirmationem.”

unit.source: “If you’re genuinely affected by the Abyss aura from Naboredisley, contact me or Judgment.”
unit.target: “Si vere aura abyssī Naboredisley te afficit, me aut Iudicium continge.”

unit.source: “Experts skilled in purifying such influences will assist you.”
unit.target: “Periti, qui in purgatione talium influentiarum periti sunt, tibi auxilium ferent.”

unit.source: “Avoid burdening Mr. Fool unnecessarily.”
unit.target: “Noli inutile onus imponere Domino Stulto.”

unit.source: “Thinking about the name ‘Naboredisley’ is okay, but refrain from writing or reading it.”
unit.target: “Cogitare de nomine ‘Naboredisley’ licet, sed scribe aut lege abstine.”

unit.source: After reading the letter, Lumian mumbled to himself, “Madam Magician seems more inclined to believe it’s a Demon and not some other hidden entity.”
unit.target: Epistolam lecta, Lumian sibi submurmuravit, “Domina Magica magis inclinatur ad credendum quod daemon sit, et non quaedam alia entitas abscondita.”

unit.source: “That’s right,” Franca echoed, puzzled.
unit.target: “Recte,” Franca miratus replicavit.

unit.source: “Let’s assume that fellow is a Demon, yet it doesn’t even have Danger Premonition, allowing us to complete the preparations for the Exorcism Spell. If we say it isn’t, it can create fluctuations and trigger our desires and emotions. I was just guessing that it’s a secret entity that possesses a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact of the Demon pathway.”
unit.target: “Assumamus illum daemon esse, sed nec praenotatio periculi eum dotat, quae nobis parationes incantationis expulsionis complere sinat. Si dixerimus eum non esse, fluctus creare potest atque desideria et affectus nostros excitare. Modo conieci eum esse entitatem occultam, quae gradum unum artifacti sigillati viae daemonicae possidet.”

unit.source: “Perhaps Madam Magician has seen more.”
unit.target: “Fortasse Domina Magica plura vidit.”

unit.source: “That fellow probably doesn’t have Danger Premonition because its true form isn’t here. It only descended with a sliver of its aura and power. Or perhaps, the danger originated from Mr. Fool, so it couldn’t sense it!”
unit.target: “Verisimiliter ille non habet praenotatio periculi, quia forma eius vera hic non adsit. Tantum descendit cum minima particula aurae et potentiae suae. Aut fortasse periculum a Domino Stulto ortum est, ideo id sentire non potuit!”

unit.source: “That makes sense,” Franca agreed before saying with a strange expression, “Ever since we became Minor Arcana cards, we’ve increasingly come into contact with the depths of the mystic world. The Demoness Sect, the mirror world, the War of the Four Emperors, the Great Mother, and a Demon of the Abyss this time… In the past, when I read Emperor Roselle’s diary, I often had the feeling that ‘that’s just how the world is.’ But now, the contents of his diary have truly come to us.”
unit.target: “Id sensum habet,” Franca assensivit, antequam vultu insolito diceret: “Ex quo facti sumus chartae Arcanae Minores, magis in profundum mundi mystici incurrimus. Sectam Daemonissarum, mundum specularum, Bellum Quattuor Imperatorum, Magnam Matrem, et hoc tempore daemonem abyssī… Olim, cum diarium Imperatoris Roselle legebam, saepe mihi videbatur ‘sic tantum mundus est.’ At nunc, contenta eius diarii vere ad nos pervenerunt.”

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian to speak, Franca added in a self‑deprecating manner, “For example, a Demoness does taste pretty good.”
unit.target: Sine exspectare Lumiano loquendum, Franca, seipsam contemnens, addidit: “Exempli gratia, daemonissa valde sapida est.”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Think about it carefully. Did you encounter these things after becoming a Minor Arcana card holder, or after getting to know me?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens inquit: “Cogita bene. Num has res postquam factus es possessor chartarum Arcanae Minores aut postquam me cognovisti, tibi occurrerunt?”

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca’s lips twitched. “You know yourself well.”
unit.target: “Heu…” labra Francae convulserunt. “Te ipsum bene nosti.”

unit.source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Directe autores in WebNovel sustenta!

unit.source: Two days later, Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano boarded a long‑distance ship set to pass by Hanth Island, en route to the Southern Continent’s West Balam.
unit.target: Duo diebus post, Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano in navem longi itineris conscenderunt, quae Insulam Hanth transire destinata erat ad Balam Occidentalem Continens Meridionalis.

unit.source: Lumian aimed to investigate the Demon’s legend and seize an opportunity to fully digest the Conspirer potion.
unit.target: Lumian intendit legendam daemonis investigare et occasionem capere ad potionem Conspiratoris plene digerendam.

unit.source: After outsmarting Naboredisley and banishing it with the Exorcism Spell, Lumian realized that his potion digestion had made significant progress.
unit.target: Postquam Naboredisley callide superavit et incantatione expulsionis eum depulit, Lumian animadvertit potionis suae digestionem progressum significativum attulisse.

unit.source: With another decent performance, he could advance the digestion further. This would eliminate the need for the final advancement ritual’s aid, allowing him to plan the subsequent matters more calmly.
unit.target: Cum alia decente demonstratione, digestionem ulterius progredi posset. Hoc necessarium auxilium ritus ultimi evelleret, ut subsequentia res tranquillime disponeret.

unit.source: Captain Pedro, accompanied by his eldest daughter Salah, and a few Favored and Blessed, expressed sincere gratitude to Lumian.
unit.target: Capitaneus Pedro, comitatus filia sua maior Salah, et pauci Electi et Benedicti, Lumiano sincera gratias egit.

unit.source: They watched as he ascended the gangway with his godson and servant, boarding the ship named ‘Berries.’
unit.target: Spectabant eum ascendere scalas navis cum filio et servo, conscendens in navem, quae “Berries” nominata est.

unit.source: Once the ship set sail, one of the Blessed appeared to sigh in relief and commented, “He’s finally left Port Colla…”
unit.target: Postquam navis profectus est, unus ex Benedictis apparuit suspirare leviter et dixit: “Denique Portus Colla reliquit…”

unit.source: Without waiting for Salah to inquire about the reason for the sigh, the Blessed, wearing a brown priest’s robe, turned to her and Pedro and advised,
unit.target: Sine exspectare ut Salah quaereret rationem suspirii, unus ex Benedictis, veste sacerdotali fusca indutus, ad eam et Pedrum conversus suadebat,

unit.source: “The circumstances at the scene of Flores’s death indicate that this matter involved a true, high‑ranking Demon. Miss Salah, it’s best if you stay in the cloister for a year to avoid any possible aftereffects.”
unit.target: “Circumstantiae in loco mortis Flores ostendunt hanc rem involvisse verum daemonum altum ordinem. Domina Salah, optimum est ut in claustro maneas per annum, ne quid postea eveniat.”

unit.source: Salah, aware of her awakening thanks to the adventurer Louis Berry’s assistance, was horrified. However, lacking personal experience, she inquired, “A year? A real Demon… What kind of Demon is that?”
unit.target: Salah, auxilio Ludovici Berry percepta, horrida fuit. Sed, experientia carens, interrogavit: “Per annum? Verus daemon… Qualis daemon iste est?”

unit.source: The Blessed, in a brown clergyman’s attire, responded solemnly, “It’s the Demons from the legends you’ve heard of, or something even more powerful.”
unit.target: Unus ex Benedictis, veste sacerdotali fusca indutus, solenniter respondit: “Daemones sunt ex fabulis quibus audivistis, aut aliquid etiam potentius.”

unit.source: “Wh…” Salah turned to her father with a face filled with fear, confusion, and disbelief.
unit.target: “Quid…” Salah ad patrem se vertit, vultu metu, confusione, atque incredulitate pleno.

unit.source: “Did you guys save me from such a Demon?”
unit.target: “Num vos me e tali daemonis effugeritis?”

unit.source: Pedro was equally surprised.
unit.target: Pedro aeque miratus est.

unit.source: He had never imagined that his daughter’s situation would involve such a terrifying existence.
unit.target: Numquam putavit rem filiae suae talem existentiam terribilem amplexuram esse.

unit.source: And Louis Berry had only received 20,000 gold risot!
unit.target: Et Ludovicus Berry solum 20,000 aureorum “risot” accepit!

unit.source: No, he actually succeeded!
unit.target: Minime, re vera prospere obtinuit!

unit.source: Pedro, having witnessed the adventurer Louis Berry’s strength through the colossal wave he created, could now grasp his power more vividly in this direct comparison.
unit.target: Pedro, viatoris Ludovici Berry vim per ingentem undam quam creavit perceptus, nunc eius potentiam in hac comparatione directa clariorem sensus est.

unit.source: In the first‑class cabin suite aboard the Berries.
unit.target: In cella primae classei in nave “Berries.”

unit.source: Lumian handed the ancient notebook and the note with Love Incantation to Ludwig and asked with a smile, “Is it edible?”
unit.target: Lumian antiquum libellum et notam cum Incantatione Amoris ad Ludovicum tradidit et cum subridente quaesivit, “Estne edule?”

unit.source: 621 Hanth Island
unit.target: 621 Insula Hanth

unit.source: Ludwig, savoring succulent roasted lamb chops, cast a quick glance at the ancient notebook and the note containing the Love Incantation.
unit.target: Ludwig, succulenta assa agnorum costulas degustans, celeriter intuebatur ad antiquam schedulam et ad notam quae Incantationem Amoris continet.

unit.source: “I can only provide details about the paper’s age, the raw materials, and the manufacturing process.”
unit.target: “Solum possum praebere notitias de aetate chartae, de materia prima, et de processu fabricandi.”

unit.source: The knowledge and concealed content inscribed on it couldn’t be extracted.
unit.target: Scientia et absconditus contentus in eo inscriptus extrahi non potuerunt.

unit.source: “Alright.” Lumian withdrew his hand, his disappointment minimal.
unit.target: “Recte.”

unit.source: He had approached Ludwig with the intention that it didn’t harm asking.
unit.target: Ad Ludwighum accessit, existimans quaerere nullum malum afferre.

unit.source: Finding nothing else of interest, he settled into the recliner, immersing himself in the warm sunlight.
unit.target: Nihil aliud delectabile inveniens, consedit in solio reclinato, se in sole calido immergens.

unit.source: Flipping through the ancient notebook filled with Demon legends,
unit.target: Pervagans per antiquam schedulam, quae fabulis daemonum plena erat,

unit.source: Lumian found it composed entirely in Highlander.
unit.target: Lumian invenit eam totam in linguā Highlander conscriptam esse.

unit.source: Flores, having only attended elementary grammar school, wouldn’t have comprehended it otherwise.
unit.target: Flores, quem solum scholae grammaticae elementariae frequentavit, id aliter non intellexisset.

unit.source: Reading with enthusiasm, as if engrossed in a gripping novel, Lumian discovered that certain legends surpassed even the thrill of contemporary horror stories, sending shivers down his spine.
unit.target: Studio legens, quasi in novam captivam, Lumian invenit certas fabulas etiam excitamentum historiarum horroris temporis hodiernarum superare, tremores per spinam eius efferentes.

unit.source: Occasionally, incantations emerged, some fabricated by the ignorant and subjected to numerous alterations.
unit.target: Interdum incantationes apparuerunt, quarum quaedam ab ignorantibus compositae erant et multis mutationibus subiectae.

unit.source: Others carried a subtle malevolence, bearing a resemblance to Naboredisley.
unit.target: Aliae subtili malevolentia praeditae erant, cum similitudine ad Naboredisley referentes.

unit.source: Lumian refrained from uttering them aloud, silently reciting them instead.
unit.target: Lumian ea non audible proferre utebatur, sed silentio recitabat.

unit.source: The first day of the Berries’ voyage unfolded in tranquil serenity.
unit.target: Primum diem itineris Berries in tranquilla serenitate evolutus est.

unit.source: Late at night, Lumian dreamt of enchanting scenes, weaving into blush-inducing stories that heightened his emotions.
unit.target: Nocte sero, Lumian somniavit de scaenis incantatoriis, fabulas texens quae ruborem excitare et affectus eius augere solebant.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian awoke.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian evigilavit.

unit.source: Sunlight filtered through the window curtains, casting a faint glow.
unit.target: Lux solis per cortinas fenestrarum transibat, tenue fulgor afferens.

unit.source: It was 6 a.m.
unit.target: Hora sexta erat.

unit.source: Lying in bed, Lumian experienced a sense of loss.
unit.target: Cubans in lecto, Lumian sensum amissionis experiebatur.

unit.source: He lacked the endurance of an Ascetic in dreams, causing certain scenes to be unusually poignant.
unit.target: Non habebat patientiam asceticorum in somniis, ita ut quaedam scaenae insolitē affectum moverent.

unit.source: Phew… Lumian exhaled, emitting a self-deprecating laugh.
unit.target: Phew… Lumian suspiravit, risum sibi ipsi auto-depressive edens.

unit.source: Almost forgot, this isn’t a boon; it’s a curse.
unit.target: Paene oblitus, hoc non beneficium est; maledictum est.

unit.source: Reverting to a physical state when Termiboros was newly sealed at 6 a.m. every morning brought benefits like fearlessness of serious injuries, no heed of energy consumption, and automatic healing.
unit.target: Rediens ad statum physicum, quo Termiboros omni mane, hora sexta, nuper sigillatus erat, beneficia afferebat, ut impaviditas vulnerum gravium, nullae solliciti de consumptione energiae, et sanatio automatica.

unit.source: Though thoughts of Cordu’s catastrophe and his sister Aurore haunted him with each reset, the initial pain gradually dulled, becoming a bearable numbness after his psychiatric treatment.
unit.target: Quamquam cogitationes de catastropha Cordi et de sorore eius Aurore eum, unicuique refectione vexabant, initialis dolor paulatim attenuebatur, evadens in tolerabilem insensibilitatem post therapiae psychiatricae suae.

unit.source: Occasionally, he felt a dull ache and emptiness.
unit.target: Interdum dolorem lentum et inaniam sentiebat.

unit.source: Lumian rose from bed and drew open the curtains, revealing two contrasting scenes of the azure sea.
unit.target: Lumian ex lecto surrexit et velamina aperuit, duas scaenas contrarias maris caerulei revelans.

unit.source: To the right, a crimson sun had just surfaced on the horizon.
unit.target: Ad dextram, sol ruber modo in horizonte apparuerat.

unit.source: To the left, fog lingered, and waves surged, shrouding the situation 100 meters away.
unit.target: Ad sinistram, nebula manebat et fluctus impetu aggrediebantur, rem centum metris abscondentes.

unit.source: Exiting the master bedroom, Lumian noticed that Lugano was already awake, captivated by the seascape.
unit.target: Exiens ex cubiculo principali, Lumian animadvertit Lugano iam evigilatum esse, a prospectu marino captus.

unit.source: “You’re in a good mood,” Lumian teased.
unit.target: «In bono animo es,» Lumian iocose arridens dixerat.

unit.source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and replied, “It’s my first time in the Berserk Sea. I’m a little excited and woke up early.”
unit.target: Lugano subridens verecunde respondit, «Prima vice in Mari Berserco sum. Paululum excitatus sum et mane evigilavi.»

unit.source: He added, “Besides, if I want to be your interpreter, I have to master Dutanese as soon as possible.”
unit.target: Adiecit, «Praeterea, si interpretus tuus esse volo, Dutanensem quam primum perdiscere debeo.»

unit.source: On the coffee table in the room lay numerous Dutanese books recently purchased by Lumian from Port Colla.
unit.target: In mensā parvā in conclāvī iacebant plures libri Dutanenses, nuper a Lumiano ex Porto Colla emptī.

unit.source: Being a primary trading port for the Southern Continent, Port Colla’s citizens had a practical need to learn Dutanese, resulting in a trend.
unit.target: Cum esset portus mercatorius primārius pro Continente Meridionali, cives Portī Colla necessitātem practicā Dutanense discendī haberent, quā consuetūdō evenit.

unit.source: Lumian easily acquired two sets of teaching materials covering elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels, along with practice materials, thanks to various teaching aids and Dutanese instructors.
unit.target: Lumian facile duas copias materialium docendī consecutus est, quās gradūs elementāri, mediocres, et provectōs complectebantur, una cum materialibus exercitationis, gratias variīs auxiliīs docendī et magistrīs Dutanensis.

unit.source: This was a stark contrast to Port Santa, where obtaining a few barely usable books required considerable effort.
unit.target: Hoc plane contrarium erat ad Portum Santa, ubi paucos lībrōs vix utī liberos obtinere magnam labōrem exigebat.

unit.source: Lumian applauded gently.
unit.target: Lumian leniter plausit.

unit.source: “Not bad.”
unit.target: «Non male.»

unit.source: Lugano pointed towards the foggy sea and explained, “Last night, I heard from a sailor on the ship that many vessels attempted to explore the sea in that direction, but they never returned.
unit.target: Lugano ad mare nebulosum demonstrāns dixit, «Heri nocte, ex nauta in nāve audīvī multae nāves maris in illā partem explorārī conātās esse, sed numquam redierunt.

unit.source: Occasionally, people would spot one of those ships quietly passing by at night with no lights or anyone on the deck.
unit.target: Interdum, hominēs unus ex illīs nāvibus noctū silenti transīre videbantur, sine luminibus nec aliquō homine in ponte.

unit.source: “They say it’s the Berserk Sea. Stick to the safe sea route; attempting unknown routes often leads to unknown and irresistible danger.
unit.target: «Dicunt hoc esse Mare Berserco. Servā iter maritimum tutum; iter ignotum conārī saepe ad perīculum ignōtum atque irresistibile ducit.

unit.source: “See, the sun is rising over there, right? The sea seems calm, but venture beyond the safe route, and we might face a sudden hurricane, a lightning storm, or even get melted by the sun and evaporated. These are tales from sailors; I’m not sure if they’re true.”
unit.target: «Vide, sol illuc oritur, nonne? Mare placidum videtur, sed si extra iter tutum proficiās, fortasse subeāmus subito turbine, fulminōsa tempestate, aut etiam sol liquefieri atque evaporāri; hae sunt fabulae nāutarum, nescio num vera sint.»

unit.source: Lumian nodded and suggested, “Look into more similar rumors.”
unit.target: Lumian annuēns suādet, «Explorā plūra similia rumorēs.»

unit.source: With his employer’s approval, Lugano’s expression brightened, finding a purpose in his work.
unit.target: Patroni consensū, vultus Lugānī illustrātus est, in operē suo prōpositum inveniēns.

unit.source: The voyage through the Berserk Sea proved relatively uneventful.
unit.target: Itinēris per Mare Berserco relative sine rebus eventibus constāvit.

unit.source: Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano managed to avoid causing any disruptions.
unit.target: Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano perturbātiōnēs efficere vitare potuērunt.

unit.source: Occasionally, they witnessed storms capable of city-wide destruction or forest-like lightning.
unit.target: Interdum tempestātēs conspexiērunt, quae totam urbem destruere poterant aut fulgūra silvestria exhibēbant.

unit.source: Sometimes, they noticed the absence of fish throughout the entire sea, creating an eerie silence akin to the legendary Underworld.
unit.target: Aliquando animadvērti sunt carēntia piscum totī marī, quietem ignotam effingentem, similem fabulōso Infernō.

unit.source: Guided by the seasoned captain, first mate, and sailors, the Berries navigated through these regions along the safe sea route.
unit.target: Dūcti ā peritō capitaneō, prīmō nāutice, et nāutīs, Berries has regionēs per iter maritimum tutum secūtī sunt.

unit.source: After a few days, the ocean-venturing steamship reached Hanth Island, the transit port.
unit.target: Post paucos diēs, nāvis vaporāriā oceānica ad Insulām Hanth, portum trānsitus, pervēnit.

unit.source: The crew replenished coal and water, conducted machine maintenance, restocked light beer, and replenished various food supplies over two days.
unit.target: Turma carboṇem et aquam refēcit, machīnārum sustentātiōnem curāvit, cervesiam levem replevit, et varia subsidia alimēntāria per duas diēs restituit.

unit.source: “There doesn’t seem to be any specialties on this island,” Lugano remarked, consulting the travel guide from Port Colla.
unit.target: «Non vidētur in hāc insulā esse specialitātēs,» Lugānō remarkāvit, ducem itinerum ex Porto Colla consulēns.

unit.source: “But due to its strategic geographical location and natural deepwater port, it’s one of the main transit ports controlled by the Feynapotter Kingdom.”
unit.target: «Sed propter situm geogrāficum stratēgicum et naturalem portum altī aquae, hic est ūnus ex portīs trānsitus prīncipālibus a Regnō Feynapotter imperātīs.»

unit.source: Specialties? Does that include Demons? Lumian critiqued silently, producing two gold risots and twirling them in his hand.
unit.target: Specialitātēs? Num hoc Daemōnēs includit?

unit.source: “I’m going to try the local self-brewed wine.”
unit.target: «Vinum locāle, proprie domestice factum, probābo.»

unit.source: He made his way to the port’s largest bar and ordered a glass of thick, pomegranate-colored local red wine, Paha.
unit.target: Ad maximam tabernam in portū iter fēcit et poculum vini rubrī locālī crassī, colōre granatō, Paha, iussit.

unit.source: Lumian struck up a conversation with a few patrons near the bar counter, deliberately approaching one with a local accent.
unit.target: Lumian colloquium incepit cum paucīs clientibus prope mensam tabernae, conscio accedēns ad ūnum cum accentū locālī.

unit.source: “I met a nice chick,” he said with a sly wink and an ambiguous smile.
unit.target: «Mulierem amoenam conveni,» inquit, cum astutā obliquīō et ambigūā risū.

unit.source: “We’re going on a date later—on a quiet night. Can you share a few local horror stories? They don’t have to be well-known, just terrifying enough, preferably with a specific location.
unit.target: Exempli grātiā, if there’s a horrifying tale about an empty house on a certain street, heh heh, I plan to take her there for our date.”

unit.source: The local, his beard dampened with ale, set down his oak beer mug and chuckled.
unit.target: Localis, barba eius cervisiā madida, poculum cervisiāe ex quercū posuit et subrīdens cachinnāvit.

unit.source: “How devious, but I like you! It’s a battle of wits between men and women. For victory, anything goes!”
unit.target: «Quam callidum, sed tē amo! Certāmen ingeniī inter vīrōs et fēminās est. Ad victoriam, quidquid agitur, valeat!»

unit.source: After a brief pause, the local suggested, “You can take her on a date at the edge of the forest outside the city.
unit.target: Post brevem intervallum, localis suādet, «Illam ad conviviā ducere potēs in mārgine silvae extra urbem.

unit.source: You know, a forest at night is always chilling. Besides, there might be more than one Demon lurking in the woods on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Scīs, silva noctū semper formidōsa est. Praeterea, fortasse plus quam ūnus Daemōn in silvīs Insulā Hanth latet.»

unit.source: “As far back as I can remember, the priests have been warning everyone against venturing deep into the forest or even thinking about cutting wood in the middle of the island.
unit.target: «Quo usque meminī, sacerdotēs omnēs monuerunt ne penitus in silvam intrārent aut de lignō secandō in mediā insulā cogitārent.

unit.source: There are many hidden dangers.
unit.target: Multa perīcula occulta sunt.

unit.source: “What kind of dangers, you ask? The priests never specify, but someone always tells me about some random person encountering a Demon with goat horns and an unpleasant sulfuric smell in the forest.
unit.target: «Qualia perīcula, quæris? Sacerdotēs numquam specificant, sed aliquis semper mihi narrat de quadam persona fortuitā, quae Daemōnem cum cornibus caprārum et odōre sulphureō infestō in silvā obvenit.

unit.source: As for those who claim to have seen the Demon with their own eyes, it’s said that they all met their demise—for some unknown reason.
unit.target: Quoad eōs qui Daemōnem propriīs oculīs vidisse affirmant, fertur eōs omnēs interitum subīisse—causa quacumque ignōta.

unit.source: “How about that? No woman isn’t afraid of a Demon. Well, except my wife. She’s even scarier than a Demon!”
unit.target: «Quid de hoc? Nulla fēmina Daemōnem non timet. Bene, nisi uxōr mea; ipsa etiam terribilius Daemōnis est!»

unit.source: Have the Demon stories on Hanth Island evolved to such an extent?
unit.target: Fueruntne fabulae Daemōnum in Insulā Hanth evolutae ad tam altum gradum?

unit.source: It resembles the legend of the Montsouris ghost, but encountering a Montsouris ghost does result in the death of an entire family.
unit.target: Similitudinem habet legendāri phantasmātī Montsouris, sed congressus cum phantasmā Montsouris totam familiam interficit.

unit.source: Hanth Island doesn’t have such an obvious characteristic… Lumian raised his glass of red wine, toasting the local before saying, “Though I’m quite charming, I doubt any chick would be willing to follow me to the edge of the forest outside the city on our first date, especially at night.
unit.target: Insulā Hanth talem proprietātem manifestam non habet… Lumian poculum vini rubrī levātum habēns, localem ad glorificandum allocūtus, antequam dīceret, «Quamquam elegans sum, dubitus habeō quin quaedam puella mē sequi volat ad limitem silvae extra urbem in nōstro primo conventū, praesertim noctū.

unit.source: Even if she’s not afraid of me doing harm, she might worry that I’m a criminal with a penchant for harming young girls.
unit.target: Etiam sī non timet ne laedam, fortasse sollicītatūr erit quō me criminatōrem esse, cui inclinātiō est ad laedendās puellās juveniles.

unit.source: How about this: Is there a legend of a serial killer? Ideally, one that haunts the city.
unit.target: Quid de hoc: num legendā de caede seriatim perpetrātā existit? Optime, qua urbē infestātur.

unit.source: Drawing from Aurore’s grimoires and the information gathered in recent months, Lumian discerned that Sequence 9 of the Demon pathway was Criminal, Sequence 8 was Coldblooded, and Sequence 7 was Serial Killer.
unit.target: Ex librīs magicis Aurore et informatione his proximīs mēnsibus collectā, Lumian intellexit Sequenciam IX viā Daemonica esse Criminalem, Sequenciam VIII esse Frigidam, et Sequenciam VII esse Homicidam Seriatim.

unit.source: The name of Sequence 7, Serial Killer, indicated that Beyonders, regardless of their grasp of the acting method, would actively or passively engage in serial killings.
unit.target: Nōmen Sequenciae VII, Homicidā Seriatim, indicābat Beyonders, quocumque modum agendī non plene comprehendentēs, sive active sive passive in caedibus seriatim implicārī.

unit.source: Although the Demon on Hanth Island had clearly surpassed Sequence 7 and evolved beyond the Serial Killer stage, Lumian wondered whether, as a high-ranking individual who had progressed through the ranks, it retained certain preferences acquired during its Serial Killer phase.
unit.target: Quamquam Daemōn in Insulā Hanth manifestē Sequenciam VII superāverat et ultra statum Homicidī Seriatim evolverat, Lumian mirābātur utrum, ut individuum in altissimum gradu profectum, quaedam praeferentiās ex tempore Homicidī Seriatim conservāret.

unit.source: Intelligent beings, be they human or of a certain creature, tended to maintain certain desires if not deliberately restrained or controlled.
unit.target: Entia intelligenta, sive humana sive ex certo genere, certos dēsideriās servare solebant, nisi conscienter cohibērentur.

unit.source: Just as humans might occasionally indulge in a drink, Demons might occasionally engage in serial killings.
unit.target: Sicut hominēs interdum in potione delectārī possunt, ita Daemōnēs interdum in caedibus seriatim versārī possunt.

unit.source: Moreover, if Naboredisley’s commission wasn’t concocted merely for a verbal agreement, the Demon of Hanth Island or its descendants should be concealed among humans.
unit.target: Praeterea, sī commissio Naboredisley non solum ex verbālī pacto constitūtā esset, Daemōn Insulā Hanth aut eius postērī inter hominēs celārī dēbent.

unit.source: The bearded local pondered for a moment before responding, “There haven’t been any serial killers. In a small place like ours, if serial murders were happening, everyone in the city would know.”
unit.target: Localis barbātus paulisper meditātus est antequam responderet, «Nullī homicidae seriatim exstitērunt. In parvō locō ut nōstrō, sī caedes seriatim evenirent, omnēs in urbē scīrent.»

unit.source: He paused, then added, “But what if someone goes missing in the forest outside the city every year? Would that count?”
unit.target: Pausāvit, deinde addidit, «Sed quid sī aliquis quotanniē in silvā extra urbem evanescat? Num id existimetur?»

unit.source: In Trier, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony managed to gather sufficient information about Moran Avigny, the current Minister of Industry.
unit.target: In Treverīs, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony satis notitiā de Moran Avigny, ministro industriae praesentis, collegērunt.

unit.source: This information included a color photograph.
unit.target: Haec notitiā complēctēbat imaginem coloris.

unit.source: In the picture, Moran Avigny displayed a striking resemblance to an Intisian.
unit.target: In imagine, Moran Avigny conspicuam similitudinem cum Intisianō ostendēbat.

unit.source: Despite his age, he exuded an air of elegance.
unit.target: Non obstānte aetāte, aerem elegantiae diffundēbat.

unit.source: In his late sixties, his once-black hair had transitioned into a distinguished gray.
unit.target: In annīs suis sexāgēsimīs proximīs, capillī eius, olim nigrī, in griseum dignum transierant.

unit.source: Refined facial features and dark gray eyes added to his overall presence, with the wrinkles on his face highlighting the passage of time.
unit.target: Rationēs faciei elegantēs et oculī obscurigrīs ad praeśentiam eius addidērunt, cum rugīs in fācie tempus transitum evidenter monstrantibus.

unit.source: “Dark gray eyes are rare in Intis…” Franca sighed.
unit.target: «Oculī obscurigrīs in Intis rārī sunt...» Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: Mid-sentence, she abruptly halted.
unit.target: In mediō dictī, repente cessāvit.

unit.source: Another individual with dark-gray eyes in Intis crossed her mind—Demoness of Black Clarice.
unit.target: Aliud individuum cum oculīs obscurigrīs in Intis illī in mentem vēnit—Daemonissa Nigrae Clarice.

unit.source: 622 Smell of Death
unit.target: 622 Odor Mortis

unit.source: Under normal circumstances, dark-gray eyes wouldn’t usually grab one’s attention.
unit.target: Sub condicionibus ordinariis, oculi cinerei obscuri non solent animos hominum capere.

unit.source: Such pupils were rare in Intis but not uncommon in places like the Loen Kingdom.
unit.target: Talia oculi Intis rara erant, sed in locis ut Regnum Loen non erant insolitae.

unit.source: However, Franca sensed that there was crucial information hidden within.
unit.target: Attamen, Franca sensit informationem maximi momenti abditam intus esse.

unit.source: Moran Avigny was suspected to be a Mirror Person.
unit.target: Moran Avigny suspicabatur esse persona speculi.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black Clarice pursued the Mirror People, and being a demigod of the Demoness pathway closely related to the Mirror World, they all shared those unusual dark gray eyes.
unit.target: Demonia Nigrae Clarice personas speculi persequebatur, et, cum semideus per viam Demonii, prope Mundi Speculorum conexus esset, omnes illos oculos cinerei obscuri insolitos habebant.

unit.source: Too much of a coincidence, isn’t it?
unit.target: Nimis fortuita res, nonne?

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” Jenna asked with concern when Franca paused.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” Jenna sollicite rogavit, cum Franca cessavit.

unit.source: Franca deliberated for a few seconds before revealing that the Demoness of Black shared the same eye color as Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Franca per paucos secundos deliberavit antequam enuntiavit Demoniam Nigrae eundem colorem oculorum cum Moran Avigny habere.

unit.source: Finally, she said, “None of the Mirror People we encountered previously had such characteristics.”
unit.target: Postremo, dixit: “Nemo ex personis speculi, quas antea conveneramus, talia attributa habuit.”

unit.source: “Only relatively special Mirror People have them? Is the Demoness of Black also a Mirror Person?” Jenna guessed, her thoughts wandering.
unit.target: “Num solum personae speculi praecipuae ea habent? Num et Demoniam Nigrae persona speculi est?” Jenna coniectavit, mentibus vagantibus.

unit.source: “Impossible,” Franca subconsciously denied. “She even tasked me with investigating the Mirror People… Right, it’s not impossible. Haven’t we read enough stories of burglars calling the police to catch thieves?”
unit.target: "Impossibile," Franca subconscie negavit. "Ipsa etiam mihi mandavit investigare personas speculi… Recte, non est impossibile. Nonne satis fabulas legimus de latronibus, qui vigilibus vocant ad fures capiendos?"

unit.source: Anthony thought for a moment and said, “Could it be a symbol of being corrupted by the mirror’s Primordial Demoness? Could special Mirror People at a certain level have such eye color? Could it be the same for a Demoness who has become a demigod and has been corrupted?
unit.target: "Antonius paulisper cogitavit et dixit, 'Num hoc sit signum corruptionis a Demoniae Primordiali speculi? Num aliquae personae speculi peculiares, ad aliquod gradum, talem colorem oculorum habere possint? Num idem contingat Demoniae, quae semideus facta et corrupta est?'"

unit.source: “No, Moran Avigny should have had dark gray eyes to begin with. It’s impossible for the Mirror People who replaced him to change the color of his eyes without attracting suspicion,” Franca pondered and deduced, “In other words, does the Demoness of Black come from the same family as the original Moran Avigny? I previously thought she belonged to the Sauron family and was Browns Sauron’s elder. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have nurtured such a simple-minded Demoness. Now, it doesn’t seem so…”
unit.target: "Non, Moran Avigny debuit a principio oculos cinerei obscuri habuisse. Impossibile est ut personis speculi, quae eum substituerunt, colorem oculorum eius mutaverint sine suspicione excitanda," Franca meditata et deduxit, "Aliter, num Demoniam Nigrae eadem familia originaria Moran Avigny proveniat?
