Olim putavi eam ad familiam Sauron pertinere et majorem fuisse quam Browns Sauron. Aliter, non talem insipientem Demoniam educasset. Nunc hoc sic videri non videtur..."

unit.source: “Not necessarily,” Franca and Jenna said in unison.
unit.target: "Non necessario," Franca et Jenna simul dixerunt.

unit.source: Everyone had a paternal and maternal side of the family.
unit.target: Omnes partes familiares paternae et maternales habebant.

unit.source: Just because they were from the Sauron family didn’t mean they weren’t from a dark-gray-eyed family!
unit.target: Etenim ex familia Sauron esse, non significat eos non esse ex familia oculis cinerei obscuri!

unit.source: Franca hesitated for a few seconds before saying, “It’s been a while since I updated the Demoness of Black on the Mirror People investigation. I plan to visit her this week and discuss Moran Avigny.”
unit.target: Franca paucos secundos dubitavit antequam dixit: “Iamdiu non renovavi Demoniam Nigrae de indagatione personarum speculi. Illam hac hebdomade visitare constitutus sum et de Moran Avigny disserere.”

unit.source: “Be careful,” Jenna cautioned.
unit.target: “Cave,” Jenna monuit.

unit.source: A gleaming smile played on Franca’s lips as she replied, “Don’t worry. She tasked me with the Mirror People inquiry, so she should anticipate some updates. If she has ties with Moran Avigny, we might see something unfolding for the Minister of Industry shortly. If not, we can seek her assistance!”
unit.target: Splendidus risus in labiis Francae ludos habebatur, dum respondebat: “Noli solliciti esse. Ipsa mihi mandavit de indagatione personarum speculi, itaque novitates aliquas se praeparare debet. Si vincula cum Moran Avigny habet, fortasse mox aliquid de Ministro Industriae eveniet. Alioquin, eius auxilium quaerere poterimus!”

unit.source: On Hanth Island, Lumian strolled through the dimly lit streets, relishing the cool sea breeze that replaced the earlier heat as he casually headed back to the Berries.
unit.target: In insula Hanth, Lumian per vias tenuiter illuminatas ambulabat, fruens frigida aura maris quae priorem calorem substituit, dum comiter ad Berries redibat.

unit.source: Hands tucked into his pockets, his mind raced with unusual activity.
unit.target: Manus in sinu reclusae, mens eius cum inusitata activitate cursabat.

unit.source: He sifted through the legends and stories he had recently gathered, attempting to uncover any hints about the elusive Demon.
unit.target: Legendas et fabulas nuper collectas perlegit, conatus ut ullos indicios de daemon effugientis detegeret.

unit.source: Had Madam Magician not issued a cautious warning, and had Naboredisley not disclosed the Demon descendant’s name and identity, Lumian might have considered using himself as bait.
unit.target: Nisi Magistra Magica cautum monitum edixisset, et Naboredisley nomen atque identitatem daemonis progeniei non revelavisset, Lumian fortasse se tamquam escam adhibere cogitavisset.

unit.source: In such circumstances, he could have showcased his malice, devised a plan with a chance of success, triggering the Demon’s Danger Premonition, luring it out to eliminate the perceived threat.
unit.target: His condicionibus, potuisset malitiam suam ostendere, consilium cum aliqua spe successus excogitare, praemonitionem periculorum daemonis excitare, eum allicere ut minationem perceptam supprimeret.

unit.source: A concealed trap would await it.
unit.target: Insidiae celatae illi exspectarent.

unit.source: It’s been a century or two.
unit.target: Iam unum vel duo saecula praeterierunt.

unit.source: Numerous adventurers have ventured to unravel the Demon legend.
unit.target: Multi viatores ausi sunt daemonis fabulam resolvere.

unit.source: Despite the Church of Earth Mother’s relentless efforts to eradicate lingering issues, there’s still no resolution.
unit.target: Non obstante indefessis conatibus Ecclesiae Matris Terræ ad removendas quaestiones moras, adhuc solutio non invenitur.

unit.source: Relying on conventional methods to track down that elusive Demon seems impractical…
unit.target: Confidens in modis conventionalibus daemonem effugientem deprehendere, id prorsus inefficax videtur…

unit.source: Looking at it from a different angle, why would the Demon choose to remain on Hanth Island?
unit.target: Ex angulo alio spectato, cur daemon vellet in insula Hanth manere?

unit.source: The Church of Earth Mother already purged it once.
unit.target: Ecclesia Matris Terræ eam iam semel purgavit.

unit.source: Why take the risk to stay?
unit.target: Cur periclitari manendo?

unit.source: If it were me, I would have relocated ages ago.
unit.target: Si ego essem, olim me translocavissem.

unit.source: As a Demon, where couldn’t I survive?
unit.target: Ut daemon, ubi non possum superesse?

unit.source: If I truly believed I was a highly intelligent criminal—a genuine Criminal—why use such a method to taunt the clergy of the Church of Earth Mother? It would become dull after all these years…
unit.target: Si vere crederem me esse scelestum ingenio praestantem—verum scelestum—cur talem modum ad irridendum clerum Ecclesiae Matris Terræ adhiberem? Id post tantos annos tediosum factum esset…

unit.source: Could there be a reason for its persistence on Hanth Island?
unit.target: Num aliqua causa sit pro eius perseverantia in insula Hanth?

unit.source: Is it perhaps partially sealed? Or is there something profoundly significant buried on the island that cannot be moved?
unit.target: Num fortasse partim clausum sit? An aliquid prorsus grave in insula sepultum sit, quod moveri non possit?

unit.source: The valley ablaze with sulfurous flames?
unit.target: Vallis sulphureis flammarum incensa?

unit.source: Moreover, Demons can live for centuries, but ordinary people cannot.
unit.target: Praeterea, daemones per saecula vivere possunt, sed homines ordinarii non possunt.

unit.source: If the Demon indeed concealed itself in human towns, it would have to change identities every few decades, potentially leaving traces.
unit.target: Si daemon vere se in urbibus humanis celaverit, identitatem singulis decadiis mutare oporteret, fortasse vestigia relinquens.

unit.source: Hanth Island serves as a transit port for trade routes between the Northern and Southern Continents.
unit.target: Insula Hanth ad portum transitus servit semitis commercii inter Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales.

unit.source: With numerous foreign settlers, the Demon can effortlessly forge a new identity.
unit.target: Cum multis colonis externis, daemon facile novam identitatem fingere potest.

unit.source: However, how can it smoothly exit the stage with its original identity?
unit.target: Sed quomodo leniter exire potest cum sua identitate originali?

unit.source: The residents here all devoutly follow Earth Mother.
unit.target: Incolae hic omnes devotissime Matrem Terræ sequuntur.

unit.source: Upon their demise, they are invariably sent to the cathedral for a wake.
unit.target: Post eorum mortem, ineluctabiliter ad cathedralem ad vigiliam mittuntur.

unit.source: Would a Demon have the audacity to feign death and undergo Earth Mother’s scrutiny and the purifying touch of holy water?
unit.target: An daemon audaciam haberet mortem simulare et subire inspectionem Matris Terræ ac tactum purificatorium aquae sacrae?

unit.source: Yes, vanishing is the optimal solution.
unit.target: Ita, evanescere optima solutio est.

unit.source: Whether through a sea adventure or disappearing into the forest, it effectively sidesteps corresponding problems.
unit.target: Sive per maritimam expeditionem sive in silvas evanescendo, problemata correlata efficaciter evitat.

unit.source: Every year, people vanish in the forest outside the city… Did the Demon purposely orchestrate some accidents, concealing its ‘death’ among them?
unit.target: Quotannis, homines in silva extra urbem evanescunt… Num daemon certissime aliqua casus composuit, mortem suam inter eos celans?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he gradually formulated deductions and speculations.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani cursabant, dum paulatim deductiones et speculationes formabat.

unit.source: This was also a tempering of a Conspirer’s powers and a method to digest the potion.
unit.target: Hoc etiam fuit temperatio virium Conspiratoris et modus ad potionem digerendam.

unit.source: He had a vague understanding of the entire situation.
unit.target: Totae rei vagam comprehensionem habebat.

unit.source: If I want to locate the Demon concealed among humans, I must find the mysterious valley ablaze with sulfur flames deep in the forest.
unit.target: Si daemonem inter homines celatum quaerere volo, necesse est invenire vallis mysticae, ardentis flammis sulphureis in profundo silva.

unit.source: To unravel the valley’s secret, I must rely on that Demon.
unit.target: Ut vallis secretum enodare possim, in eo daemone confidere debeo.

unit.source: These two matters are likely intertwined and inseparable.
unit.target: Haec duo negotia inter se vincta atque inseparabilia sunt.

unit.source: Lumian had a tentative plan for tomorrow’s investigation.
unit.target: Lumian consilium tentativum habebat pro inquisitione crastina.

unit.source: I'll begin by exploring the forest, utilizing my Hunter powers to search for the remains of the missing.
unit.target: Incipiam per silvam explorandam, uteor viribus Venatoris meis ad reliquias decessorum inveniendas.

unit.source: If I discover one or two, and they still retain some edible structure, I'll bring them back to Ludwig and determine who the deceased last encountered.
unit.target: Si unum vel duo inveniam, et adhuc structuram edibilem retinent, ad Ludwig referam et determinem quem decessos ultimo convenisse.

unit.source: Throughout this process, without alerting the clergy of the Church of Earth Mother, I'll delve deeper into the island to identify any anomalies.
unit.target: Per hoc processu, sine clericis Ecclesiae Matris Terræ admonendis, insulam penetrare conabor, ut anomalias quaslibet agnoscam.

unit.source: If they exist, what kind of anomalies they are…
unit.target: Si existunt, quales sint illae anomaliae…

unit.source: As he strolled leisurely, Lumian suddenly looked up and observed the stars in the sky veiled by dark clouds.
unit.target: Dum levis ambulabat, Lumian subito surrexit et stellas in caelo nubibus obscuris velatas aspexit.

unit.source: In an instant, torrential rain poured down.
unit.target: In momento, imber torrens effudit.

unit.source: Drops of rain misted in front of Lumian.
unit.target: Guttae pluviae coram Lumiano nebulatae erant.

unit.source: Without an umbrella, he had no choice but to dash under the eaves of a three-story building on the street and seek refuge outside a café with its lights off.
unit.target: Sine umbrella, non habuit nisi sub tegulis aedificii trium tabularum in via properare et refugium petere extra cauponam, cuius lumina erant exstincta.

unit.source: He waited for the storm to end impassively.
unit.target: Impassibiliter tempestatem finiri exspectavit.

unit.source: The few pedestrians on the road unfurled their umbrellas.
unit.target: Pauci ambulantes in via umbrellas suas evolverunt.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but chuckle as he recalled the common depiction of the Berserk Sea’s islands in the travel guide: The weather is highly erratic; remember to bring an umbrella or a hat when out.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit non ridere, recordatus repraesentationem communem insularum Maris Berserk in duce itinerario: Tempestas valde inconstans est; memento portare umbrellam aut petasum.

unit.source: Clearly, Lumian didn’t take the reminder seriously.
unit.target: Plane, Lumian monitionem non serio cepit.

unit.source: He wasn’t in a rush.
unit.target: Non festinabat.

unit.source: Leaning against the café’s two glass windows, he quietly observed the raindrops streak down and the people returning home late traverse different streets.
unit.target: Ad duas fenestras vitreas cauponae incumbentem, tranquille observavit guttae pluviae decurrere et homines, qui sero domum redeunt, per diversas vias ambulantes.

unit.source: The sound of the rain masked all movement, and white mist veiled most of his vision, creating the sensation for Lumian as if he were in another world.
unit.target: Sonus pluviae totum motum obtegebat, et nebula alba pleraque visionem eius velabat, sensum Lumiano creando quasi in alio mundo viveret.

unit.source: Observing this scene, Lumian reminisced about his wandering days.
unit.target: Haec spectans, Lumian de diebus erraticis meminisse coepit.

unit.source: Wanderers often struggled to predict the weather, making it challenging to secure refuge in cathedrals and other places in Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Vagabundi saepe difficile tempus praedicere conabantur, quod refugium in cathedralibus aliisque locis assecurare arduum faciebat. Directe auctores in WebNovel sustinete!

unit.source: Consequently, he would occasionally huddle in a corner of a street, sheltered from the rain.
unit.target: Ergo, interdum in angulo viae congregabatur, ut a pluvia tutaretur.

unit.source: He watched the rain with fear, worry, uneasiness, and gloom, praying that no other vagabond would snatch his temporary shelter.
unit.target: Imber spectabat cum metu, sollicitude, inquietude, et maestitia, orans ne alius vagabundus eius refugium temporarium arriperet.

unit.source: But now, his mood was entirely different.
unit.target: Sed nunc, eius habitus animo omnino diversus erat.

unit.source: The heavy rain in the Berserk Sea ceased as swiftly as it had arrived.
unit.target: Imber gravis in Mari Berserk celeriter cessavit, sicut subito advenit.

unit.source: In less than half an hour, only stagnant water remained on the street.
unit.target: In minus quam dimidia hora, sola aqua stagna in via remanebat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and tucked his hands back into his pockets.
unit.target: Lumian subridens manus suas in sinu redegit.

unit.source: He strolled along the wet street toward the harbor and boarded the Berries.
unit.target: Per viam madidam ad portum ambulavit et in Berries conscendit.

unit.source: Just as Lumian pushed open the door and entered, he saw Lugano wiping Ludwig’s dripping hair with a dry and fluffy towel.
unit.target: Modo ut Lumian ianuam aperiret et intraret, vidit Lugano capillos Ludwig, stillantes, linteo sicco et molli tergentem.

unit.source: Ludwig looked as if he had taken an unexpected plunge.
unit.target: Ludwig videbatur quasi non expectato lapsu cecidisset.

unit.source: “You didn’t bring an umbrella?” Lumian asked with a smile.
unit.target: “Non tulisti umbrellam?” Lumian subridens rogavit.

unit.source: Lugano replied awkwardly, “I thought I was a Planter and could predict changes in the weather in advance, so I didn’t bring an umbrella and led Ludwig to the streets to buy supper. He said he didn’t want to eat cakes and biscuits tonight. Sigh, who knew that even though I predicted a rainstorm, it only took tens of seconds before it arrived. At that time, I wanted to carry Ludwig and rush back to the ship before the rain started…”
unit.target: Lugano torpide respondit, “Putabam me esse Plantatorem et posse mutationes caeli ante tempus praedicere, itaque umbrellam non attuli et Ludwig in vias duxi ut cenam emereretur. Dixit se noluisse crustula et placentas hac nocte edere. Eheu, quis scivit, quamquam praedixeram imber, tantum paucas secundas ante adventum eius factum fuisse? Illo tempore volui Ludwig portare et festinanter ad navem redire antequam imber inciperet…”

unit.source: Seeing that the Doctor didn’t seek an objective reason and only complained about his lack of ability, Lumian kindly added,
unit.target: Videntes quod Medicus rationem obiectivam non quaereret et solum de carentia facultatis querelarentur, Lumian benigne addidit,

unit.source: “This is the weather in the Berserk Sea. Even Planters can’t predict it.”
unit.target: “Haec est tempestas in Mari Berserk. Etiam Plantatores eam non praedicere possunt.”

unit.source: This was also one of the reasons why the islands in the Berserk Sea, clearly under the rule of the Church of Earth Mother, didn’t always experience bumper harvests like the Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Hoc etiam erat una ex causis cur insulae in Mari Berserk, clarissime sub imperio Ecclesiae Matris Terræ, non semper abundantes messem, qualem Regnum Feynapotter, haberent.

unit.source: “Yes, yes, yes.” Lugano heaved a sigh of relief.
unit.target: “Ita, ita, ita.” Lugano leviter suspiravit.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Ludwig, whose hair was now dry, and casually inquired, “Do you smell anything?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Ludwig conversus, cuius capilli iam sicci erant, leviter interrogavit: “Sentisne aliquid?”

unit.source: Is there any particularly alluring “food” hidden nearby?
unit.target: Numquid est aliqua praecipue allicens “cibus” prope occulta?

unit.source: Ludwig nibbled on a tortilla and responded, “There’s the smell of death.”
unit.target: Ludwig in tortilla comedebat et respondit: “Ibi odor mortis est.”

unit.source: Smell of death? Lumian frowned slightly.
unit.target: Odor mortis? Lumian leviter fronxit.

unit.source: “Did someone die near the night market?”
unit.target: “Num aliquis prope forum nocturnum mortuus est?”

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig caput inclinat, negans.

unit.source: “When it rains, there’s the smell of death everywhere.”
unit.target: “Cum pluit, odor mortis ubique est.”

unit.source: What… what does this mean? Lumian probed, voicing his doubts.
unit.target: “Quid... quid hoc significat?” inquit Lumian, dubia enuntians.

unit.source: Ludwig replied candidly, “I don’t know. It disappeared later.”
unit.target: Ludwig aperte respondit, “Nescio. Postea evanuit.”

unit.source: It happens when it rains, but not after… Is this an abnormality from the Berserk Sea, or is it the island’s abnormality triggered by the Berserk Sea’s weather? Lumian pondered for a moment, but he wasn’t in a rush to write to Madam Magician and inquire.
unit.target: Hoc fit cum pluit, sed non postea… Num hoc sit anomalia ex Mari Berserk, aut anomalia insulae quae a tempestate Maris Berserk excitata sit? Lumian paulisper meditatus est, sed non festinabat Magistrae Magicae scribere ac quaerere.

unit.source: This was a digestion opportunity for him. He felt that he should avoid relying on the power of a high-ranking person to digest it better unless it was crucial.
unit.target: Hoc fuit occasio ad potionem digerendam; sensit se vitare debere innixus virtute personae summae, nisi res maximi momenti fuisset.

unit.source: That night, Lumian fell asleep with a heavy heart.
unit.target: Illa nocte, Lumian corde gravato obdormivit.

unit.source: In his hazy dream, he saw many familiar and unfamiliar things.
unit.target: In somnio confuso, multa nota et incognita vidit.

unit.source: The pale-white Samaritan Women’s Spring, the mountain-sized Blood Emperor’s afterimage dripping with yellowish magma, and the unknown object protruding from the spring…
unit.target: Fons Samaritarum mulierum pallide albus, imago Imperatoris Sanguinis magnitudine montana, stillans cum magmā flavolato, et objectum ignotum ex fonte eminentem…

unit.source: The scene suddenly changed, revealing Lumian wandering alone in the deep darkness underground.
unit.target: Scaena subito mutata est, ostendens Lumian solus errantem in profunda tenebris subterraneis.

unit.source: It was as if he had become the Montsouris ghost.
unit.target: Sicut si umbra Montsouris factus esset.

unit.source: 623 Grave Digging
unit.target: 623 Sepulchrorum Excavatio

unit.source: In the endless darkness, cramped quarters, and jumbled thoughts, Lumian found himself unusually frustrated, even within the confines of his dreams.
unit.target: In tenebris infinitis, in cellis angustis, et in cogitationibus confusis, Lumian se insolite vexatum invenit, etiam intra limites somniorum sui.

unit.source: He longed to rip apart the cage around him and shatter everything in his path.
unit.target: Desiderabat caveam circum se dirumpere et omnia in via sua frangere.

unit.source: Slowly, the realization dawned upon him that he was dreaming.
unit.target: Paulatim intellexit se somniare.

unit.source: He struggled to open his eyes and wake up, but his efforts were in vain.
unit.target: Conatus est oculos aperire atque evigilare, sed conatus eius frustra erant.

unit.source: Each time he thought he had finally awakened, in the blink of an eye, he plunged into a deeper darkness and a more profound dream.
unit.target: Quoties putabat se tandem evigilavisse, in ictu oculi, in tenebras altiores et somnia profundiora immergitur.

unit.source: After an unknown stretch of time, Lumian naturally awoke to some light seeping through the curtained window.
unit.target: Post tempus ignotum, Lumian naturaliter evigilavit ad aliquam lucem quae per fenestram velatam intrabat.

unit.source: It was 6 a.m.
unit.target: Erat hora sexta matutina.

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand and wiped his forehead, sensing a layer of cold sweat.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum attollit et frontem purgavit, stratum sudoris frigidi sentiens.

unit.source: Is this a spiritual warning, or had memories of the Samaritan Women’s Spring and the afterimage of the Blood Emperor haunted me after I contemplated the smell of death on Hanth Island yesterday?
unit.target: Num hoc est monitum spirituale, an memoriae Fons Mulierum Samaritarum et imago remanens Imperatoris Sanguinis me vexaverunt postquam de odore mortis in Insula Hanth cogitabam?

unit.source: Previously, I had drawn connections between the mysterious deaths of those who witnessed the Demon and the Montsouris ghost, possibly leading to a shallow corruption?
unit.target: Prius coniunxi inter mortes mysteriosas eorum qui Daemoni et phantasma Montsouris conspecti erant, fortasse ad levem corruptionem ducens?

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t accurately decipher the complete meaning of the dream.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit totam significationem somnii accurate explicare.

unit.source: All he could do was remind himself to be cautious and stay focused on his original goal for coming to Hanth Island:
unit.target: Omne quod facere potuit, fuit se admonere ut cautus esset atque in proposito originali, quo ad Insulam Hanth venisset, maneret intentus:

unit.source: To investigate the Demon legends, not to eliminate the Demon.
unit.target: Ad legendas de Daemone investigandas, non ad Daemonem exstirpandum.

unit.source: Setting aside whether he possessed the strength to face the Demon or if he needed assistance, the fact that the Church of Earth Mother had operated on the island for over a century without completely eradicating the target suggested even the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card holders might not resolve this matter entirely.
unit.target: Neglexisse utrum vires ad Daemonem oppugnandum haberet aut auxilium desideraret; quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae per plus quam centum annos in insula operata est sine metae omnino exstirpatione, significabat etiam possessoribus Chartarum Arcana in Tarot Club fortasse rem omnino non soluturum esse.

unit.source: Lumian got out of bed and retrieved the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brise.
unit.target: Lumian ex lecto evexit et horologium aureum de Salle de Bal Brise cepit.

unit.source: Opening and glancing at it: 6:01 a.m.
unit.target: Aperiens et intuebatur, apparuit: 6:01 a.m.

unit.source: Though early, Lumian felt a sense of urgency.
unit.target: Quamquam mane erat, Lumian sensum urgentiae habuit.

unit.source: The Berries would depart from Hanth Island the morning after tomorrow.
unit.target: Berries ex Insula Hanth mane postero discedent.

unit.source: He had only two days to delve into the Demon legends, unravel the truth, and identify potential suspects.
unit.target: Duo tantum dies habebat ad legendas de Daemone discendas, veritatem explicandam, et suspectos detegendos.

unit.source: If he succeeded, his Conspirer potion might very well be digested.
unit.target: Si successisset, poculum Conspiratoris eius fortasse bene digeretur.

unit.source: Gathering, screening, and utilizing information were crucial aspects of a conspiracy!
unit.target: Colligere, examinare, et adhibere informationem erant aspectus fundamentales coniurationis!

unit.source: And if Lumian were a Sequence 7 Detective of the Reader pathway, successfully solving a century-old unsolved case involving high-level powers in just two days would be a remarkable leap from initial digestion to complete digestion.
unit.target: Et si Lumian esset Detective Sequenciae 7 in via Lectoris, casum centennalem insolutum, qui potentias altissimas implicabat, in tantum duos dies solvendo, esset saltus mirabilis ab initio digestionis ad plenam digestionem.

unit.source: At 9 a.m., in the suburbs of Port Hanth, Return Cemetery.
unit.target: Hora 9 a.m., in suburbis Portus Hanth, Cimiterium Return.

unit.source: Holding a bunch of yellow flowers, Lumian navigated through the tree-lined cemetery.
unit.target: Tenens fasciculum florum flavorum, Lumian per cimiterium arboribus ornatum iter fecit.

unit.source: Armed with Ludwig’s intel and the insights from the previous night’s dream, he adjusted his plan.
unit.target: Armatus notitia Ludovici et perspicientia ex somnio noctis praeteritae, consilium suum temperavit.

unit.source: Instead of hastily venturing into the forest to search for the missing people’s remains, he decided to dig up graves here!
unit.target: Pro festinato in silvas irrumpendo ut reliquias hominum amissorum quaereret, statuit hic sepulchra fodere!

unit.source: His objective: to investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious death of someone who had glimpsed the Demon’s figure in the forest depths.
unit.target: Propositum: indagare circumstantias mortis mysteriosae cui Daemoni figuram in silvarum profundis intueri licuit.

unit.source: He aimed to discover if they would meet the same fate as those killed by the Montsouris ghost—exhibiting self-mutilation.
unit.target: Studuit cognoscere num ipsi eundem fatum accederent ac illi interfecti a phantasma Montsouris, qui se ipsos mutilabant.

unit.source: According to the gathered information, the last person to report the Demon’s presence to the Church of Earth Mother rested in a quiet corner of Return Cemetery.
unit.target: Ex informationibus collectis, novissimus qui praesentiam Daemoni Ecclesiae Matris Terrae attigit, in angulo quieto Cimiterii Return quiescebat.

unit.source: His name was Antonio Elias.
unit.target: Nomen eius erat Antonio Elias.

unit.source: Before long, Lumian, clutching the bouquet of yellow flowers, reached the grave.
unit.target: Non multo post, Lumian, fasciculum florum flavorum tenens, ad sepulcrum pervenit.

unit.source: Apart from the deceased’s name, birth and death dates, a concise epitaph adorned the stone tombstone: "This wretched man’s life was taken by a Demon."
unit.target: Praeter nomen defuncti, dies natalis et obitus, epitaphium concisum lapide inscriptum erat: "Vita huius miseri viri a Daemone sublata est."

unit.source: Lumian stooped down, placing the bouquet before the tombstone.
unit.target: Lumian se inclinavit, fasciculum florum ante monumentum lapideum posuit.

unit.source: Then, he straightened up, silently studying the stone tomb.
unit.target: Tum se erexit et tacite lapidem sepulchri contemplatus est.

unit.source: Details about Antonio Elias flashed through his mind.
unit.target: Notitiae de Antonio Elias per mentem eius fulserunt.

unit.source: A local, not a foreigner, with parents, a wife, and children.
unit.target: Indigena, non peregrinus, cum parentibus, uxore, et liberis.

unit.source: Nine months ago, during a hunting trip in the forest, he encountered a wandering Demon.
unit.target: Ante novem menses, in venatione per silvam, Daemoni vagantis occurrit.

unit.source: Fearing his imminent demise, he sought refuge in the cathedral and cloister of the Church of Earth Mother for a full five months.
unit.target: Timens mortem imminentem, quaesivit asylum in cathedrali et claustro Ecclesiae Matris Terrae per quinque menses.

unit.source: Afterwards, intending to serve as a crew member for three years, steering clear of Hanth Island and its hidden dangers, he was discovered dead at the bottom of the cabin on his second voyage…
unit.target: Postea, cum pro membrum turmae per tres annos servire intendisset, et Insulam Hanth atque eius pericula occulta vitare conaretur, in fundo cellae secundae navigationis mortuus inventus est…

unit.source: Lumian scanned the surroundings, gathering ten to twenty withered branches from beneath nearby trees.
unit.target: Lumian circumspiciebat, decem ad viginti ramos ex arboribus vicinis exaridatos colligens.

unit.source: He planted them around Antonio Elias’s tomb, forming a short, makeshift, and somewhat futile barrier.
unit.target: Illos circum sepulcrum Antonio Elias conposuit, creando parvum, improvisum, et aliquatenus vanum obstaculum.

unit.source: Lastly, he laid a withered branch flat on two adjacent branches, constructing a shaky door impassable to anyone.
unit.target: Denique, unam ramum exaridatum super duas ramas adiacentis posuit, construens ianuam instabilem, quam nemo transire poterat.

unit.source: With that completed, Lumian stepped over the "wall" and entered the grave.
unit.target: Hoc confectum, Lumian "murum" transiit et sepulcrum intravit.

unit.source: He then bent down, extending his right hand to touch the makeshift door constructed of withered branches.
unit.target: Tum se inclinavit, extendens dextram manum ad ostium improvisum ex ramis exaridis tactandum.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a black mark activated on his body.
unit.target: Simul, in corpore eius notatio nigra excitata est.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian’s figure vanished.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, figura Lumiani evanuit.

unit.source: Antonio’s tomb remained undisturbed, except for the added circle of withered branches.
unit.target: Sepulcrum Antonio intactum mansit, excepto circulo ramorum exaridatorum addito.

unit.source: In reality, Lumian had retrieved an iron pick, shovel, and other items from his just-purchased Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Revera, Lumian ex sacculo viatoris nuper empto dolabram ferream, palam, et alia instrumenta cepit.

unit.source: He began prying open the stone slabs and digging into the soil.
unit.target: Incepit lapideas laminas discindere et terram fodere.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Ampulla Ficta!

unit.source: Lumian utilized the "wall" and "door" he had fashioned to employ the Bottle of Fiction contract ability.
unit.target: Lumian muro et ianua, quas confecerat, ad usum facultatis contractus "Ampulla Ficta" adhibuit.

unit.source: In less than two minutes, relying on his understanding of the cemetery’s layout and two precise explosions, Lumian cleared the soil from the coffin and pried open the black-painted wooden plank.
unit.target: Infra duo minuta, innixus intellectione dispositionis cimiterii et duabus explosionibus precisis, Lumian terram e sarcophago purgavit et tabulam ligneam nigro pictam discidit.

unit.source: A pungent odor of decay wafted out, and Lumian casually ignited it.
unit.target: Odor acre putredinis effluit, et Lumian id casualiter incendit.

unit.source: After a brief wait, he squatted down, donned gloves, and examined the white bones, now devoid of flesh and blood.
unit.target: Post breve, se genu flectit, chirothecas induit, et ossa alba, iam sine carne et sanguine, examinavit.

unit.source: The first item he picked up was Antonio Elias’s skull.
unit.target: Primum quod sustulit, fuit cranium Antonio Elias.

unit.source: With a cursory glance, he noted cracks on the inside of the skull, while the exterior remained intact.
unit.target: Cursu intuerente, fissuras in parte interiori cranii animadvertit, dum exterior pars intacta remanebat.

unit.source: A brain explosion as the cause of death?
unit.target: Explosio cerebri, ut causa mortis?

unit.source: Lumian pondered the force required to induce such damage.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est de vi necessaria ad talem damnum inferendum.

unit.source: Regardless of the ability responsible, Antonio’s cerebrum, cerebellum, and brain stem should have exploded into mush at the time of his demise.
unit.target: Indifferenter ab abilitate responsali, cerebrum, cerebellum, et truncus cerebri Antonii in lutos dissolutos esse debuerunt tempore mortis eius.

unit.source: It seemed illogical for the hard inner cranium to crack while the soft brain remained unharmed.
unit.target: Incohense videbatur ut cranium internum durum discerperetur, dum cerebrum molle intactum maneret.

unit.source: Examining Antonio Elias’s other bones yielded no additional injuries.
unit.target: Examinata alia ossa Antonii Elias, nullae vulnerationes additae detectae sunt.

unit.source: The stains in the coffin offered no further clues.
unit.target: Maculae in sarcophago nullas alias inditia praebebant.

unit.source: Lumian concluded that Antonio’s death resulted from an internal explosion in his head.
unit.target: Lumian concludit mortem Antonii ex explosione interna in capite orta esse.

unit.source: The explosive force, while not physically strong enough to shatter his skull entirely, was sufficient to destroy his brain.
unit.target: Vis explosiva, quamvis non satis fortis ut totum cranium confringeret, sufficiens erat ad cerebrum eius destruendum.

unit.source: With Fire Infusion, I can precisely control the quantity and quality of the flames.
unit.target: Cum Infusione Ignis, possum quantitatem et qualitatem flammarum precise regere.

unit.source: I should be able to achieve a similar effect.
unit.target: Poterim effectum similem assequi.

unit.source: How did the Demon do it?
unit.target: Quomodo Daemon id fecit?

unit.source: Lumian’s comprehension of the Demon pathway came from his sister’s grimoires, information provided by the Tarot Club, and Franca’s account.
unit.target: Comprehensio viae Daemoni a grimmoriis sororis eius, ab informationibus Tarot Club datis, et narratione Francae orta est.

unit.source: He had only truly interacted with a Demon above Sequence 6 once, and that was with Naboredisley.
unit.target: Semel tantum vere cum Daemone super Sequenciam 6 communicavit, et id fuit cum Naboredisley.

unit.source: He immediately recollected the sensations when Naboredisley stirred his desires and emotions.
unit.target: Statim recoluit sensus, cum Naboredisley cupiditates et motus eius excitavit.

unit.source: The echoes of the ranting transmitted through the gray fog during Naboredisley’s expulsion and the tumult of his own desires replayed in his mind.
unit.target: Resonantia impetuosi sermonis per nebulam cineream, tempore expulsionis Naboredisley, et tumultus propriarum cupiditatum in mente eius iterum recitabantur.

unit.source: For ordinary people, inducing an upheaval in their desires before detonating them could lead to their brains exploding, given an increase in potency…
unit.target: Pro hominibus ordinariis, excitare tumultum in cupiditatibus suis antequam detonent, potest cerebra eorum explodere, si potentia augeatur…

unit.source: It shouldn’t be a challenging feat for a demigod creature like a Demon.
unit.target: Non debet esse opus difficile pro creatura semidei ut Daemon.

unit.source: Moreover, the Demon can use those ravings to achieve this remotely?
unit.target: Praeterea, Daemon his insanis sermonibus ad hoc remoto uti potest?

unit.source: As Lumian completed his deduction, he was convinced that a Demon was indeed concealed on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Cum Lumian deductionem finivisset, persuasus est Daemon re vera in Insula Hanth absconditum esse.

unit.source: A Demon of the Criminal pathway, a Demon surpassing Sequences like Devil and Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Daemon viae Criminalis, daemon qui Sequencias ut Diabolus et Desire Apostle superat.

unit.source: With this confirmation, Lumian believed it would be relatively straightforward to locate the Demon if he put his mind to it.
unit.target: Hoc confirmatione accepta, Lumian credidit fore ut relative facile Daemon reperiret, si animum suum ad id converteret.

unit.source: However, the prerequisite was finding it and not resolving the situation, all while risking his life.
unit.target: Attamen, praerequisitum erat eum reperire, non rem solvere, dum vitam suam in periculum adduceret.

unit.source: Removing the glove, he reached into his Traveler’s Bag and touched the Flog boxing gloves.
unit.target: Manicam removens, in sacculo viatoris pervenit et manicas pugilisticas Flog tetigit.

unit.source: Following the incident with the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings and the Great Mother, Lumian had already speculated that the Mother Tree of Desire stood at the peak of the Prisoner, Criminal, and Scrooge pathways.
unit.target: Post casum cum Caelesti Digno Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus et Magna Mater, Lumian iam coniectaverat Arbor Matris Desiderii in vertice viarum Captivi, Criminalis, et Scrooge esse.

unit.source: Therefore, the Rose School of Thought’s indulgence faction and some members of the Devil family believed in Her and followed Her.
unit.target: Ita, factiones indulgentiae Scholae Rosae Cogitationis et nonnulli ex membris familiae Diaboli in Eam crediderunt et eam secuti sunt.

unit.source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Autores in WebNovel directe sustinete!

unit.source: In that case, the Flog boxing gloves made from the branches of the Tree of Shadow, closely related to the Mother Tree of Desire, had a high chance of attracting the Demon’s attention within a certain range.
unit.target: In hoc casu, manicae pugilisticae Flog ex ramis Arboris Umbrae factae, proxime coniunctae cum Arbore Matris Desiderii, magnam occasionem habebant Daemoni attentionem intra certum spatium alliciendi.

unit.source: Just as its negative effects meant being observed by some hidden entities, influenced and attacked by dangerous creatures!
unit.target: Sicut effectus eius negativos significabant ut ab aliquibus entitatibus occultis observaretur, atque a creaturis periculosissimis influentibus et oppugnarentur!

unit.source: Phew, there are no useless items.
unit.target: Pheu, nullae res inutiles sunt.

unit.source: Only Beyonders who don’t know how to use them.
unit.target: Solum Beyonders, qui nesciverunt quomodo ea adhibeant.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled self-deprecatingly and withdrew his right hand from the Flog boxing gloves.
unit.target: Lumian, se ipsi autoeclamans, subriso derisorio, dextram manum ex manicis pugilisticis Flog subtraxit.

unit.source: He abandoned the plan to directly lure out the Demon.
unit.target: Consilium directe Daemonem alliciendi reliquit.

unit.source: This decision stemmed from the realization that the Demon was still active on the island, claiming lives, yet the Church of Earth Mother hadn’t eradicated it completely!
unit.target: Haec decisio orta est ex intellectione quod Daemon adhuc in insula vigens esset, vitas auferens, sed Ecclesia Matris Terrae eum omnino exstirpare non potuerat!

unit.source: Having encountered various challenges, Lumian possessed a reasonable understanding of an orthodox Church’s strength.
unit.target: Variis provocationibus occurrentibus, Lumian intelligentiam rationabilem de potentia Ecclesiae orthodoxae habebat.

unit.source: He knew that if the Church of Earth Mother genuinely committed, it could eliminate all residents suspected to be Demons and obliterate the island, similar to what the Church of Storms had done to Bansy Harbor.
unit.target: Sciebat, enim, si Ecclesia Matris Terrae vere constiteret, omnes incolas, qui Daemones suspiciebantur, exstirpare posse atque insulam delere, similiter quod Ecclesia Tempestatum in Portu Bansi fecisset.

unit.source: It wasn’t that the Church of Earth Mother lacked the will, but there was a reason holding them back.
unit.target: Non quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae voluntatis caret, sed ratio erat quae eam retardaret.

unit.source: This brought Lumian’s thoughts back to the valley burning with sulfurous flames deep in the forest.
unit.target: Hoc reduxit cogitationes Lumiani ad vallem, sulphureis flammis in profunda silva ardentem.

unit.source: He believed that the Demon couldn’t be slain under regular circumstances.
unit.target: Credidit Daemonem sub condicionibus regularibus non interficiri posse.

unit.source: It could only be sealed and constrained.
unit.target: Posset solum sigillari et cohiberi.

unit.source: As the Church of Earth Mother couldn’t achieve this, and Lumian doubted his ability to do so, enticing the Demon directly would be futile and perilous.
unit.target: Cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae hoc consequi non posset, et Lumian in sua facultate dubitaret, Daemonem directe allicere fututum et periculosum fore censuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s current strategy involved leveraging his fake level and his allure to evil gods to traverse the forest.
unit.target: Consilium praesentis Lumiani innixum erat in suo falso gradu et in allicientia diis malis, ad silvam transire.

unit.source: During critical moments, he planned to use the Flog boxing gloves to see if he could converge on the mysterious valley burning with sulfur flames to investigate the source of the Demon legends.
unit.target: In temporibus criticis, consilium habebat manicas pugilisticas Flog adhibere ut videat si in vallem mysteriosam, flammis sulphureis ardentem, convenire possit, ad fontem legendarum de Daemone investigandum.

unit.source: In the heart of the forest, surrounded by towering trees, Lumian navigated a path untouched by human presence for years.
unit.target: In corde silvae, arboribus excelsis circumdatus, Lumian viam peragrabat, quae per annos a praesentia humana intacta manebat.

unit.source: He moved forward at a measured pace.
unit.target: Procedebat passu moderato.

unit.source: From time to time, he would extract the Flog boxing gloves, relying on intuition to guide his course.
unit.target: Interdum, manicas pugilisticas Flog extraheret, innixus instinto ut viam suam dirigeret.

unit.source: After ten to twenty seconds, he stowed them away.
unit.target: Post decem ad viginti secundos, eas reponit.

unit.source: After almost an hour, the dense forest unexpectedly cleared.
unit.target: Post fere horam, silva densa inopinanter aperta est.

unit.source: A menacing brown bear emerged from behind a tree, advancing toward Lumian with ponderous steps.
unit.target: Urso fuscus minax ex post arborem emersit, et gradibus ponderosis ad Lumian accedebat.

unit.source: “Stop, foreigner!”
unit.target: “Siste, peregrine!”

unit.source: The bear’s mouth emitted a buzzing human voice.
unit.target: Os ursi vocem humanam fremitumque edidit.

unit.source: 624 More Than One?
unit.target: 624 Plusquam unum?

unit.source: Lumian remained unfazed as the brown bear uttered words in precise Highlander.
unit.target: Lumian non perturbatus remansit, dum ursus fuscus verba in lingua Highlander accurata edidit.

unit.source: Instead of fear, delight filled him–a clear sign that he had stumbled upon the correct location!
unit.target: Pro metu, gaudium eum replebat—clarum signum quod locum rectum invenerat!

unit.source: This was the Planter pathway, the main pathway of the Church of Earth Mother, known as a Druid at Sequence 5.
unit.target: Hoc erat via Plantatorum, via principalis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, nota in Sequentia V ut Druidus.

unit.source: Capable of transforming into a formidable three‐meter‐tall bear.
unit.target: Potens erat se convertere in ursum formidolosum tribus metris altum.

unit.source: Encountering a human-speaking brown bear in the desolate forest of Hanth Island hinted at his proximity to the heavily guarded area, possibly the mysterious valley of sulfur flames from Demon legends.
unit.target: Incidens ursum fuscum loquentem humano sermone in silva desolata Insulae Hanth insinuavit propinquitatem eius ad aream graviter custoditam, fortasse ad vallem flammarum sulphuris ex fabulis daemonum.

unit.source: Without the signature golden straw hat, Lumian studied the brown bear’s furry visage openly, making no effort to conceal his extraordinary nature.
unit.target: Sine insigne pileo stramineo aureo, Lumian vultum pilosum ursi fuscī aperte aspexit, nihil faciens ut naturam suam extraordinaram celaret.

unit.source: “Alright,” he sighed with regret, turning on his heels and retracing his steps.
unit.target: “Bene,” suspiravit cum paenitentia, convertens pedes et vestigia sua retrahens.

unit.source: Twenty to thirty meters away, Lumian vanished from the brown bear’s view, concealed by towering trees that had stood for over a century.
unit.target: A viginti ad triginta metra distantia, Lumian ex conspectu ursi fuscī evanuit, celatus arboribus imponentibus quae plus quam centum annos steterunt.

unit.source: He halted, leaning against a tree trunk, and casually retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Constitit, in trunco arboris innixus, et rem ex sacculo viatoris sui leviter extraxit.

unit.source: It was a pair of brown gold‐rimmed glasses–the Mystery Prying Glasses!
unit.target: Erat par speculorum fuscis cum margine aureo—Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula!

unit.source: Lumian had no intention of recklessly breaching the Church of Earth Mother’s protective circle and venturing into the sealed‐off region.
unit.target: Lumian non intendebat temere perrumpere circulum tutelarem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et in regionem clausam ingredi.

unit.source: Perhaps it was no safer than confronting the hidden Demon on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Fortasse non plus tuta erat quam daemonum occultum in Insula Hanth oppugnare.

unit.source: Without sufficient and effective information, Lumian wasn’t inclined to take such risks.
unit.target: Sine informatione sufficienti et efficaci, Lumian talia pericula capere non paratus erat.

unit.source: What if it resembled Fourth Epoch Trier?
unit.target: Quid, si Trier Quartae Aetatis simile esset?

unit.source: Lumian’s strategy involved skirting the edges of the problem zone, wielding the Mystery Prying Glasses to shift his perspective and uncover hidden truths.
unit.target: Consilium Lumiani constabat in ambulatione ad fines regionis problematicae, utens Mysteriosis Perscrutantibus Speculis ad prospectum suum mutandum et arcana occulta detegenda.

unit.source: From Lumian’s familiarity with the Mystery Prying Glasses from previous, the item’s lower level hindered his ability to directly perceive various seals.
unit.target: Ex cognitione praevia Lumiani de Mysteriosis Perscrutantibus Speculis, status inferior rei impedit directam eius facultatem variis sigillis percipiendi.

unit.source: In Trier, he had utilized them multiple times but couldn’t catch a direct glimpse of Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: In Trier, ea pluries utebatur, sed directam imaginem Trier Quartae Aetatis capere non potuit.

unit.source: Instead, he witnessed concealed elements beneath the ground, lurking in darkness, or disguised through distorted, overlooking, or prying angles.
unit.target: Pro eo, elementa sub terra abscondita, latitantia in tenebris, vel per angulos distortos, negligentes, aut perscrutandos, observavit.

unit.source: This inherent flaw safeguarded Lumian from directly encountering the Church of Earth Mother’s sealed artifact, thus averting potential catastrophe.
unit.target: Hoc vitium innatum Lumian servavit ne directe occurreret artefacto clauso Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, ita cladem potentialem avertens.

unit.source: Nonetheless, it allowed him to discern abnormal traces.
unit.target: Tamen, id eum sinit vestigia insolita percipere.

unit.source: And that was sufficient!
unit.target: Et id satis erat!

unit.source: More traces equaled more information, bringing Lumian closer to the elusive truth!
unit.target: Plura vestigia, plura indicia, Lumian ad veritatem elusivam propius attulerunt!

unit.source: Ready to teleport at a moment’s notice, Lumian positioned the brown gold‐rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose.
unit.target: Paratus ad teleportationem quolibet momento, Lumian specula fuscosa cum margine aureo in ponte nasi sui posuit.

unit.source: An unsettling dizziness gripped him, akin to being buried underground.
unit.target: Vertigo inopina eum oppressit, instar sub terra sepulti.

unit.source: Despite looking up at the soil, trees, and sky, he sensed an elevated vantage point, overseeing everything.
unit.target: Quamquam terram, arbores, et caelum contemplabat, sensum habuit prospectus excelsi, omnia intuens.

unit.source: Withering tree bark, decaying leaves, crawling insects, and animals circling a water source–all these details and buried bones spun in Lumian’s vision, inducing nausea from the depths of his soul.
unit.target: Exaridens cortices arborum, folia putrida, insecta serpitantia, atque animalia circa fontem aquae – haec omnia atque ossa sepulta in visu Lumiani revoluta erant, nauseam ex intimo animæ fundo inferentes.

unit.source: Amidst the nausea creeping from the depths of his soul, Lumian’s gaze fixated on a startling sight.
unit.target: Inter nauseam, quae ex intimo animæ fundo procedebat, oculi Lumiani in aspectu stupefacto fixi sunt.

unit.source: Silent blue flames devoured the entire landscape.
unit.target: Flammae caeruleae tacitae totam regionem devorabant.

unit.source: Whether above, below, or around the flames, the trees swiftly transformed into an inky black, dissolving into sewage.
unit.target: Sive supra, sive infra, sive circa flammas, arbores celeriter in atrum nitidum mutaverunt se, dissolventes in lutum faeculentum.

unit.source: From the decaying remnants, new trees sprouted, rapidly expanding and flourishing.
unit.target: Ex reliquiis corruptis, nova arbores ortae sunt, celeriter crescentes et florentes.

unit.source: In the midst of the blue inferno, Lumian vaguely discerned a crimson, colossal figure sprawled at the core.
unit.target: In medio caerulei incendio, Lumian vix discerpsi ingentem figuram rubram, quae in ipso centro iacuit.

unit.source: Submerged in pitch-black, viscous sewage, it sank gradually, only to be yanked upward by an invisible force.
unit.target: Submersus in lutum atrum viscosum, lente descendit, ut a vi invisibili sursum traheretur.

unit.source: This unseen power emanated from beyond the withering and burgeoning forest, from…
unit.target: Haec vis invisibilis emanabat ex ultra silvam, quae deficiens atque augens erat, ex…

unit.source: Abruptly, a pair of eyes materialized within Lumian’s line of sight.
unit.target: Subito, par oculorum in conspectu Lumiani apparuit.

unit.source: They were bloodshot, icy-blue eyes tinged with pain.
unit.target: Erant oculi, rubiginosi, caerulei glacialibus, et dolore tincti.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian removed the Mystery Prying Glasses and activated the black mark representing Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula removit et signum nigrum activavit, repraesentans transitum in Mundi Spirituum.

unit.source: Swiftly fading, he disappeared into the forest and reappeared outside the Church of Earth Mother Cathedral in Port Hanth, behind the familiar stone pillar observed earlier that morning.
unit.target: Celeriter evanescens, se in silvam abscondit et deinde extra Cathedral Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in Portu Hanth apparuit, post lapidem notum mane visum.

unit.source: After stashing the Mystery Prying Glasses back into his Traveler’s Bag, Lumian departed the secluded spot. Blending in with believers, he entered the cathedral exuding scents of wheat and milk, occupying a pew closest to the Sacred Emblem of Life. With crossed arms, he mimicked the old man in a black formal suit, feigning prayer.
unit.target: Postquam Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula in sacculo viatoris redeposuit, Lumian locum solitarium deseruit. Coniungens se cum fidelibus, intravit in cathedral Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, exhalans odores tritici et lactis, sedem in subsellio proximo Sancto Emblema Vitae occupans. Brachiis transpositis, senem in veste formali nigra imitatus est, orationem simulans.

unit.source: Only then did he exhale a sigh of relief, assured that those icy-blue eyes wouldn’t target or lock onto him.
unit.target: Tunc solum exhalavit suspirum levationis, certus illos oculos caeruleos glaciales in se non appropinquare.

unit.source: These Mystery Prying Glasses could pass through countless hands if not in my possession. Its negative effects are indeed unique and beneficial, but they’re also very dangerous… Lumian couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
unit.target: Haec Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula per innumerabiles manus transire possent, nisi in mea possessione essent. Effectus eius negativos vere unici et utiles sunt, sed etiam valde periculosi… Lumian intus suspiravit.

unit.source: Then, he analyzed the scenes witnessed through the Mystery Prying Glasses.
unit.target: Deinde, scaenas per Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula visa examinavit.

unit.source: There’s a region engulfed in sulfur flames, but the Church of Earth Mother’s trees seal it off, cycling between death and rebirth. It’s nearly impossible to spot from the outside. Even with the Mystery Prying Glasses, I can only vaguely discern its outline.
unit.target: Est regio, flammarum sulphuris absorpta, sed arbores Ecclesiae Matris Terrae eam claudent, alternantes inter mortem et renascentiam. Ex exteris vix deprehendi potest. Etiam cum Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula, solummodo eius vagam formam perspicio.

unit.source: It’s akin to lurking outside a cage and surveying the interior through the gaps in the railing.
unit.target: Simile est latitare extra caveam et intimum per intervalla trabium inspicere.

unit.source: Despite the Mystery Prying Glasses’ capabilities, they shouldn’t breach the seal.
unit.target: Non obstante facultatibus, Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula sigillum non perrumpere debent.

unit.source: That colossal, blood-colored figure resembles a small mountain, yet I can’t discern any details…
unit.target: Illa ingens figura sanguine tincta parvi montis similitudine praedita est, sed singula vix discerere possum…

unit.source: Could it be the true form of the Demon of Hanth Island?
unit.target: Num illa vera forma daemonis Insulae Hanth sit?

unit.source: How can others see it when it’s sealed inside, causing those who witness it to mysteriously vanish?
unit.target: Quomodo alii id videre possunt, cum intrā claudatur, faciens ut qui id intuentur mysteriose evanescant?

unit.source: Could there be more than one Demon on Hanth Island? The ice-blue eyes staring at me may belong to another Demon.
unit.target: Num plures daemonēs in Insula Hanth sint? Illi oculi glacie caerulei, qui ad me spectant, fortasse alteri daemonis pertinent.

unit.source: Is it utilizing the invisible connection between itself and the blood-colored Demon to prevent its descent into the pitch‑black, viscous sewage?
unit.target: Num id utitur nexu invisibili inter se et daemonem sanguine tinctum ad impediendum descensum eius in lutum atrum viscosum?

unit.source: If so, the Church of Earth Mother should eliminate the Demon active both outside and on the island. By doing so, the blood-colored Demon would lose its assistance.
unit.target: Si ita est, Ecclesia Matris Terrae daemonem, qui et extra et in insula activus est, tollere debet. Hoc modo daemon sanguine tinctus auxilium suum amitteret.

unit.source: Or does the Church of Earth Mother not want the blood‑colored Demon to completely sink into the pitch‑black sewage, letting the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon exist only to restrict its range and frequency?
unit.target: An Ecclesia Matris Terrae non vult daemonem sanguine tinctum plene in lutum atrum se submergere, sinens daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis tantum exsistere, ut eius amplitudinem atque frequentiam restringat?

unit.source: If it’s not entirely sealed, would the invisible connection between the two parties disappear? Is it because the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon will also be affected by the pitch‑black sewage?
unit.target: Si id non omnino claudatur, num nexus invisibilis inter utrumque evanescet? Num quoque daemon oculis glacie caeruleis a lutum atrum affectus erit?

unit.source: Lumian deepened his understanding and speculations regarding the Demon legends on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Lumian paulatim intellexit mentalitatem et statum fabularum daemonum in Insula Hanth, sed evidentiis sufficere non potuit.

unit.source: He sensed that his Conspirer potion had become active, showing signs of digestion, but it was still one step away.
unit.target: Sensit potionem Conspiratoris sui activatam esse, signa digestionis ostendens, sed adhuc uno gradu esse remota.

unit.source: He wasn’t in a rush to succeed. Instead, he pondered the mission that Naboredisley hadn’t entrusted to him and Franca.
unit.target: Non festinabat ad successum; potius de missione quam Naboredisley ei et Francae non commisit meditatus est.

unit.source: Killing a Demon descendant from an island in the Berserk Sea…
unit.target: Interficere descendantem daemonis ex insula in Mare Berserco…

unit.source: That’s correct, a descendant! The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon is a descendant of that blood‑colored Demon. Is that why an invisible connection binds them?
unit.target: Recte, descendantem! Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, descendantem illius daemonis sanguine tincti est. Num idcirco nexus invisibilis eos constringit?

unit.source: Does Naboredisley desire the blood‑colored Demon to fully submerge into the pitch‑black sewage?
unit.target: Num Naboredisley vult daemonem sanguine tinctum plene in lutum atrum se submergere?

unit.source: Is this beneficial or detrimental for the blood‑colored Demon?
unit.target: Num hoc prodest aut nocet daemonī sanguine tinctī?

unit.source: If it’s beneficial, it makes sense why the Earth Mother Church impedes it. Why does the blood‑colored Demon’s descendant persist in pulling and preventing its descent?
unit.target: Si id prodest, rationabile est cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae id impediat. Cur descendantia daemonis sanguine tincti perseverat in trahendo eiusque descensum prohibendo?

unit.source: Suppose the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon is under the control of the Church of Earth Mother, yet it can kill and cause disappearances. Conversely, why doesn’t it flee Hanth Island? This implies that it’s not in the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s favor if the blood‑colored Demon were to completely sink into the pitch‑black sewage. It’s even willing to forfeit its freedom to obstruct it.
unit.target: Supponatur daemon oculis glacie caeruleis sub potestate Ecclesiae Matris Terrae esse, et tamen occidere atque evanescendi casus provocare posse. Contra, cur non fugitur Insula Hanth? Id indicat non favorem esse daemonis oculis glacie caeruleis, si daemon sanguine tinctus plene in lutum atrum se submergeret. Etiam paratus est libertatem suam abdicare ut eius descensum impederet.

unit.source: If it’s not favorable, perhaps Naboredisley isn’t deceiving. It’s an adversary of the blood‑colored Demon, hoping for its complete submersion and assimilation by the pitch‑black sewage. This might have a certain impact on Hanth Island, the Berserk Sea, or even the entire world. That’s why the Church of Earth Mother seals and monitors it…
unit.target: Si non id favet, fortasse Naboredisley non decipit. Adversarius est daemonis sanguine tincti, sperans eius plene submersionem et assimilationem per lutum atrum. Hoc certe implicationem habere potest in Insula Hanth, in Mare Berserco, aut etiam in toto orbe terrarum. Propterea Ecclesia Matris Terrae id claudit et vigilet…

unit.source: Can’t they just kill it? Without the blood‑colored Demon, the issue of it sinking completely into the pitch‑black sewage would cease…
unit.target: Num illud non interficere possent? Sine daemon sanguine tincto, quaestio eius plene in lutum atrum se submergere cessaret…

unit.source: Can’t be killed?
unit.target: Num non occidi potest?

unit.source: What Naboredisley feared wasn’t that the blood‑colored Demon might sense danger, but that the Church of Earth Mother might be alerted?
unit.target: Id quod Naboredisley timebat non erat, ne daemon sanguine tinctus periculum sentiret, sed ut Ecclesia Matris Terrae alertaretur?

unit.source: Lumian gradually understood the mentality and stance of the Church of Earth Mother, the local Demon, and Naboredisley, but he lacked sufficient evidence.
unit.target: Lumian paulatim intellexit mentalitatem et statum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, daemonis locali, et Naboredisley, sed evidentiis sufficere non potuit.

unit.source: What he was most certain of now was: the pitch‑black, viscous sewage wasn’t simple!
unit.target: Quod nunc certissime sciebat erat: lutum atrum viscosum non erat simplex!

unit.source: Perhaps it was something akin to the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
unit.target: Fortasse erat aliquid simile Fons Mulierum Samaritarum.

unit.source: Furthermore, it bore a striking resemblance to the pitch‑black form of the Montsouris ghost.
unit.target: Praeterea, formam atram phantasmatis Montsouris egregie similem habebat.

unit.source: Trier’s catacombs is a labyrinth of complexity, filled with corruption and unique monsters that defy easy elimination.
unit.target: Catacumbae Trierensis labyrinthus sunt complexitatis, pleni corruptionis atque monstris singularibus, quae facile extingui non possunt.

unit.source: It’s the aftermath of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s significant accomplishment, an act that nearly brought the gods down with Him. Ultimately, He perished.
unit.target: Est effectus res magni Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor, actus qui fere deos cum eo deiecit. Denique, ipse perivit.

unit.source: What could be the reason for Hanth Island? Could it be a divine battle and the demise of a deity?
unit.target: Quid esset causa Insulae Hanth? Num pugna divina atque exitus deitatis esset?

unit.source: That’s not beyond the realm of possibility…
unit.target: Haec non excedunt fines possibilitatis…

unit.source: While my knowledge of the Fourth Epoch’s history is limited, I do know that the Berserk Sea was not as tumultuous back then.
unit.target: Quamquam scientia mea de historia Aetatis Quartae limitata est, scio Mare Berserco tunc non tam turbulentum fuisse.

unit.source: There were still interactions between the Northern and Southern Continents.
unit.target: Inter Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales adhuc commercia existēbant.

unit.source: Could it be that another emperor from the War of the Four Emperors or two emperors met Their end here, permanently reshaping the terrain and weather to give rise to the Berserk Sea?
unit.target: Num fortasse alius imperator ex Bello Quattuor Imperatorum aut duo imperatores hic occiderunt, terram atque tempestatem in perpetuum mutantes, ut Mare Berserco oriretur?

unit.source: Is this the manifestation of a deity’s power? The Blood Emperor sank a colossal city underground, forcing over a million people to live above it to contain the subsequent effects.
unit.target: Num hoc sit manifestatio potentiae deitatis? Imperator Sanguinis ingentem urbem subterraneam deiecit, cogens plus quam unam milionem hominum super eam manere ad effectus consequentis continendos.

unit.source: And the deity who perished here has been influencing the Berserk Sea for more than a thousand years. This surpasses the waters near Port Santa…
unit.target: Et deitas, quae hic perivit, Mare Berserco per plus quam mille annos affecit. Hoc aquas prope Portum Santae superat…

unit.source: As Lumian sighed, he prepared to stand up and return to the Berries to strategize his next move for gathering more information.
unit.target: Dum Lumian suspiravit, se paravit surgere et ad Berries redire ut ulterius consilium caperet ad plura indicia colligenda.

unit.source: Sensing the quietude around him, his movements softened, cautious not to disturb the prayers of the Earth Mother believers.
unit.target: Sentiens silentium circa se, motus eius molliti sunt, cavens ne preces cultorum Matris Terrae perturbaret.

unit.source: Subconsciously scanning his surroundings, Lumian noticed that the believer beside him had also finished praying and retracted his arms.
unit.target: Subconscius circumspiciens, Lumian animadvertit credulum iuxta se preces finisse atque brachia retrahesse.

unit.source: A gray-haired old man in a black formal suit with a bow tie caught Lumian’s eye.
unit.target: Senex canitie in veste formali nigra cum papiliono oculum Lumiani attraxit.

unit.source: His face bore well-defined features, and his beard was meticulously shaved.
unit.target: Facies eius lineamenta bene definitā habebat, et barba eius diligenter rasum erat.

unit.source: In the next moment, Lumian observed the elder turning his head—revealing bloodshot ice‑blue eyes.
unit.target: In proximo momento, Lumian senem caput vertentem observavit, ostendens oculos sanguine congestos et glacie caeruleos.

unit.source: 625 Repentance
unit.target: 625 Paenitentia

unit.source: Ice‑blue eyes!
unit.target: Oculi, ut glacies, caerulei!

unit.source: That Demon!
unit.target: Ille daemon!

unit.source: It’s lurking right there in the cathedral!
unit.target: Ibi in cathedralo insidiatur!

unit.source: Lumian tensed.
unit.target: Lumian se contraxit.

unit.source: Without a second thought, he tried to teleport away.
unit.target: Nullo secundo cogitatione, conatus est se translocare.

unit.source: This time, he chose Trier–the entrance to Saint Viève Cathedral!
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Trier elegit – ostium Cathedralis Sanctae Viève!

unit.source: In that moment, his reflection stared back at him in those chilling, ice‑blue eyes.
unit.target: Illo momento, imago eius eum aspexit in his terribilibus, glacie caeruleis oculis!

unit.source: His face twisted, expression sinister, eyes cold.
unit.target: Facies eius contorta, vultus malignus, et oculi frigidi!

unit.source: Soon, Lumians manifested, encircling him.
unit.target: Mox, Lumiani apparuerunt, eum circumdantes.

unit.source: There was one Lumian, eyes intoxicated, breathing heavy, face flushed red.
unit.target: Erat unus Lumian, cui oculi inebriati erant, graviter respirans, et facies rubicunda!

unit.source: Another, trembling in fear.
unit.target: Alter, metu tremens.

unit.source: Another, expressionless and resolute.
unit.target: Alter, impassibilis et constans.

unit.source: One, lost and sorrowful.
unit.target: Unus, perditus et tristis.

unit.source: Another, with no will to live.
unit.target: Alter, sine voluntate vivendi.

unit.source: And one more, eyes filled with anger and hatred, red with intensity…
unit.target: Et adhuc alter, oculis irae et odii plenis, rubris cum vehementia!

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian seemed to multiply into countless versions, each appearing tangible.
unit.target: In momento, Lumian videbatur multiplicari in innumerabiles species, quarum unaquaeque apparens erat palpabilis.

unit.source: This severely impacted his thoughts and actions, hindering him from activating the contract mark representing Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Hoc graviter cogitationes eius et actus mutavit, impediendo eum activare sigillum contractum, quod Transitus Mundi Spiritus repraesentat.

unit.source: Instinctively, he focused his remaining will on his right hand and the mark left by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
unit.target: Instinctu, reliquam voluntatem suam in manum dextram atque in sigillum ab Imperatore Sanguinis Alista Tudor relictum intendit.

unit.source: To escape this state and gain the strength to teleport away, he needed to terrify the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon!
unit.target: Ut ex hoc statu evaderet et vires ad se translocandum acquireret, necesse erat daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis terrere!

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian heard ravings filled with intense madness and depravity.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian audivit deliramenta intensae insaniae atque depravationis plena.

unit.source: His mind turned to mush, swelling dangerously.
unit.target: Mens eius in pastam se convertebat, periculosissime inflata.

unit.source: The Blood Emperor’s aura didn’t activate in time.
unit.target: Aura Imperatoris Sanguinis non in tempore activata est.

unit.source: Fragmented, emotional, and painful thoughts burst in Lumian’s mind like fireworks before gradually descending.
unit.target: Fragmentatae, affectuosae, et dolorosae cogitationes in mente Lumiani quasi pyrotechnicae eruperunt, deinde paulatim descendentes.

unit.source: An intense burning sensation in his chest anchored him, preventing complete loss of self.
unit.target: Intensus sensus ardoris in pectore eius eum tenuit, impediens ne totam sui existentiam amitteret.

unit.source: After an unknown span of time, Lumian finally regained command of his thoughts.
unit.target: Post tempus ignotum, Lumian tandem dominium cogitationum suarum recuperavit.

unit.source: His first thought was: I’m still alive?
unit.target: Prima cogitatio eius fuit: "Vivo adhuc?"

unit.source: It must have been a considerable duration since the onslaught of ravings and his subsequent awakening.
unit.target: Fieri debet ut longum tempus ab impetu deliramentorum et ejus posteriore expergiscentia transierit.

unit.source: The Demon’s power could have easily ended him multiple times!
unit.target: Potentia daemonis eum facile multoties interficere potuit!

unit.source: As Lumian concentrated on his right hand, he scrutinized the Demon with ice‑blue eyes.
unit.target: Dum Lumian in manum dextram intendit, daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis perscrutabatur.

unit.source: The white‑haired Demon, adorned in a black formal suit and bow tie, sat upright once more, facing the Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Daemon albis capillis, indutus veste formali nigra et papiliono ligato, iterum erectus sedebat, ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae spectans.

unit.source: It inclined slightly, crossing its arms over its chest.
unit.target: Levis inclinavit, brachia in pectore transversa coniungens.

unit.source: Shutting its eyes, it whispered with a pained expression, “Oh, merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions…”
unit.target: Claudens oculos, vultu dolenti, susurravit: "O mater misericors, te obsecro, miserationem tuam pro peccatis meis…"

unit.source: Merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions…
unit.target: O mater misericors, te obsecro, miserationem tuam pro peccatis meis…

unit.source: Lumian’s resolve wavered as he abandoned activating the Blood Emperor’s aura.
unit.target: Resolutio Lumiani vacillavit, cum auram Imperatoris Sanguinis activare deseruit.

unit.source: He settled beside the Demon.
unit.target: Se iuxta Daemonem collocavit.

unit.source: Observing the Sacred Emblem of Life on the altar, he waited silently, refraining from disrupting the Demon’s repentance.
unit.target: Contemplans Sacrum Emblema Vitae in altare, silentiose exspectavit, abstinens a turbando paenitentiam Daemonis.

unit.source: Contemplating his encounter, he mused quietly.
unit.target: Cogitans de congressu suo, tacite meditatus est.

unit.source: The various selves I witnessed must be genuine illusions–not existing in the physical world but within my heart and mind…
unit.target: Varii mei, quos perspexi, verae illusiones esse debent – non in mundo physico, sed in corde atque mente mea…

unit.source: Could this be a sophisticated manifestation of emotional and desire fluctuations, triggering individual emotions and desires to vie for control of the body without reaching the point of dissociation?
unit.target: Num hoc sit subtilis manifestatio fluctuum affectuum et cupiditatum, quae singulos affectus ac desideria ad certamen de potestate corporis excitat, ne ad punctum dissociationis perveniant?

unit.source: The subsequent ravings resembled Naboredisley’s frenzied curse upon expulsion.
unit.target: Deliramenta subsequentes similes erant execrationi freneticae Naboredisley ad expulsionem.

unit.source: Yet, this time, there was no shield from Mr. Fool’s gray fog. Well, not entirely absent. Otherwise, the mad river of ravings would have capsized my identity.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc tempore, nullum scutum ex nebula grisea Domini Stulti erat. Saltem non omnino absens; alioquin, flumen insanum deliramentorum identitatem meam submersisset.

unit.source: Even if I hadn’t lost control, I would have succumbed completely before the Demon found its “conscience” and started repenting…
unit.target: Etiamsi imperium meum non perderem, penitus cederem antequam daemonem suam "conscientiam" inveniret et paenitentiam inciperet…

unit.source: I believed the safest haven on Hanth Island was the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Credidi tutissimum refugium in Insula Hanth esse, scilicet cathedralem Ecclesiae Terrae Matris.

unit.source: I specifically chose it to evade the Demon.
unit.target: Illud speciatim elegi ad daemonem effugiendum.

unit.source: Surprisingly, it’s praying here…
unit.target: Mirum, hic orat…

unit.source: Judging by this, blind trust in the orthodox Church’s cathedrals might not be foolproof in the future.
unit.target: His rebus consideratis, fides caeca in cathedralibus Ecclesiae orthodoxae fortasse in futuro non omnino certissima erit.

unit.source: Without adequate information, nothing is absolute…
unit.target: Sine informatione idonea, nihil absolutum est…

unit.source: Yet, it was only within the cathedral that I survived.
unit.target: Tamen solum in cathedralo supervixi.

unit.source: Anywhere else, it would be Termiboros grappling with the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon.
unit.target: Alibi, Termiboros cum daemone oculis glacie caeruleis certare deberet.

unit.source: Then, the Angels of the orthodox Churches and the Tarot Club would descend…
unit.target: Deinde, Angeli Ecclesiarum orthodoxarum atque Tarot Club descendere coeperent…

unit.source: Lumian had formed some hypotheses and waited with assurance.
unit.target: Lumian aliquas hypothesēs finxit et cum fiducia exspectavit.

unit.source: He condensed his experiences and absorbed his lesson.
unit.target: Experientias suas condensavit et doctrinam suam absorpsit.

unit.source: After a brief span, the white‑haired, ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, donned in a black formal suit, concluded its repentance.
unit.target: Post breve tempus, daemon albis capillis et oculis glacie caeruleis, indutus veste formali nigra, paenitentiam suam conclusit.

unit.source: Its expression regained composure, but the blood vessels in its eyes deepened.
unit.target: Vultus eius compositum restituit, sed vasa sanguinea in oculis eius profundiora facta sunt.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian observe the black leather gloves on both of its hands.
unit.target: Tum tantum Lumian observavit chirothecas ex corio nigro in utraque manu eius.

unit.source: Even during confession and prayer, they remained unremoved–a departure from devout believer behavior.
unit.target: Etiam in confessione et oratione, illae non removebantur – ab more devotorum fideli differebant.

unit.source: In the human world, wearing gloves while praying was deemed disrespectful to a deity, except in emergencies or special circumstances.
unit.target: In mundo humano, gerere chirothecas dum orationem faciebat putabatur irreverens erga deum, nisi in casibus urgentibus aut specialibus condicionibus.

unit.source: The same applied to wearing a hat.
unit.target: Idem valet ad gerendum pileum.

unit.source: The Demon cast a glance at Lumian and spoke in a deep but composed voice, “You haven’t fled yet. Aren’t you afraid of angering me again?”
unit.target: Daemon, intuens Lumianum et voce profunda sed composita, dixit: "Nondum fugisti. Nonne times me iterum irascere?"

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the Sacred Emblem of Life and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae aspexit et subridens fuit.

unit.source: “I’m not. This is Earth Mother’s cathedral.”
unit.target: "Non; haec est ecclesia cathedralis Terrae Matris."

unit.source: “Weren’t we in the cathedral just now?” The Demon moderated its volume, not disturbing the other supplicants.
unit.target: "Num nuper in cathedralo fuimus?" inquit daemon, modum vocis moderans, ne ceteros supplicantes inquietaret.

unit.source: “Occasional accidents are understandable,” Lumian replied unhurriedly.
unit.target: "Casus fortuiti intellegibiles sunt," respondit Lumian leniter.

unit.source: “Moreover, I believe you can certainly control yourself in a short period. It’ll be more challenging beyond half a year.”
unit.target: "Praeterea, credo te certe te ipsum in brevi tempore regere posse. Ultra dimidium anni difficilius erit."

unit.source: The Demon also directed its gaze at the altar, its ice‑blue eyes reflecting the Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Daemon etiam altari intuens, oculis glacie caeruleis Sacrum Emblema Vitae reflectentibus, dixit:

unit.source: “Why do you think so?”
unit.target: "Cur ita putas?"

unit.source: “I’m an experienced adventurer,” Lumian said with a smile.
unit.target: "Experientiam habeo in adventuris," inquit Lumian subridens.

unit.source: I know that orthodox Churches adhere to a common rule.
unit.target: Scio Ecclesias orthodoxas regulam communem observare.

unit.source: Survivors entangled in a mysticism incident are often drawn into the Church if there’s any hidden danger.
unit.target: Qui superstiterunt et in incidentibus mysticis implicati sunt, saepe in Ecclesiam inducuntur, si periculum latens adsit.

unit.source: They become civilian staff and receive long‑term protection to prevent sudden deaths.
unit.target: Fiunt ministerii civiles et longam tutelam acquirunt ad mortem repentem impediendam.

unit.source: However, those who witnessed the Demon’s figure on Hanth Island didn’t undergo this process.
unit.target: Attamen, qui figuram Daemoni in Insula Hanth conspexerunt, hunc processum non susceperunt.

unit.source: They only received a few months of protection before departing.
unit.target: Solum paucos menses tutelam acceperunt antequam discesserunt.

unit.source: Could it be that the Church fears prolonged stays might lead to deaths even within the cathedral or cloister?
unit.target: Num Ecclesia timeat diuturnas mansiones, quae etiam in cathedralo aut claustro ad mortes ducere possint?

unit.source: In such instances, it would undoubtedly tarnish the Church’s reputation. One can’t keep a constant watch on higher‑level powers indefinitely.
unit.target: In his casibus, indubitanter famam Ecclesiae macularet; neque quisquam potest potentias superiores indefinito tempore vigilare.

unit.source: The white‑haired Demon fell silent for a few moments before confessing, “I didn’t want to kill them, but I…”
unit.target: Daemon albis capillis paucis momentis silentium tenuit, antequam confiteretur: "Non volui eos interficere, sed ego…"

unit.source: At this point, its face twisted once more, icy‑blue eyes filled with pain.
unit.target: In hoc puncto, facies eius iterum contorta est, et oculi glacie caerulei dolore pleni erant.

unit.source: Once again, it crossed its arms over its chest, resuming a low‑voiced prayer.
unit.target: Iterum brachia in pectore transversa coniunxit, et precationem voce humilis repetit.

unit.source: This time, it swiftly regained its composure.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, celeriter compositum suum restituit.

unit.source: Lumian resumed the conversation with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian colloquium subridens repetivit.

unit.source: “Don’t tell me you penned all those epitaphs for those people?”
unit.target: "Noli mihi dicere te omnes illas epitaphas pro illis hominibus scripsisse?"

unit.source: “That’s correct.” The Demon in the black suit maintained its slightly forward‑leaning posture.
