unit.target: "Ita est." Dixit daemon in veste formali nigra, qui leviter inclinata staturam retinuit.

unit.source: It seems this Demon has a rather amicable relationship with the Church of Earth Mother… Not strictly devout, but a believer nonetheless…
unit.target: Videtur hic daemon relationem amicam cum Ecclesia Terrae Matris habere… Non tam strictim devotum, sed tamen fautorem esse…

unit.source: Lumian understood that the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon wouldn’t respond even if he inquired.
unit.target: Lumian intellexit daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis non respondebit, etiam si rogasset.

unit.source: Such questions might even provoke serious consequences.
unit.target: Talia quaestiones etiam graves consequentias excitare possent.

unit.source: He had to capitalize on its stable emotions to seek some details.
unit.target: Debuit inniti stabilibus eius affectibus ut quaedam indicia perquireret.

unit.source: Before Lumian could speak, the Demon posed a question.
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian loqui posset, daemon quaestionem proposuit.

unit.source: “Foreigner, why did you come to Hanth Island?”
unit.target: "Extraneus, cur ad Insulam Hanth venisti?"

unit.source: Lumian deliberately smiled.
unit.target: Lumian deliberatē subridens fuit.

unit.source: “I previously encountered a Demon incident…”
unit.target: "Prius casum Daemonis expertus sum…"

unit.source: Lumian briefly recounted Salah’s encounter with the Love Incantation in Port Colla.
unit.target: Lumian breviter narravit de occurrentia Salaha cum Incantatione Amoris in Portu Colla.

unit.source: While leading the investigation, the suspect’s body had been suddenly commandeered by a Demon seeking a deal, which he rejected.
unit.target: Dum inquisitionem duceret, corpus suspecti subito a Daemone, qui pactum petebat, occupatum est, quod ille reiecit.

unit.source: Lumian, utilizing undisclosed official powers, had then expelled the other party.
unit.target: Lumian, officiis occultis utens, deinde adversarium expulit.

unit.source: Lumian omitted details about the Love Incantation’s content and refrained from mentioning Naboredisley’s name, fearing deep‑seated animosity that might trigger intense agitation.
unit.target: Lumian singularia de contento Incantationis Amoris omisit et nomen Naboredisley non commemoravit, metuens inimicitias profundi radicati, quae agitationem intenser excitare possent.

unit.source: Concluding, he stated, “I read in the notebook about Demon legends on Hanth Island, connected to the deal the Demon sought. Intrigued, I decided to investigate. My intention wasn’t to finish off anyone.”
I read in the notebook about Demon legends on Hanth Island, connected to the deal the Demon sought.
unit.target: In schedulo legi de legendis Daemonum in Insula Hanth, quae ad pactum, quod Daemon petebat, pertinuerunt.

unit.source: Intrigued, I decided to investigate.
unit.target: Curiosus factus, decrevi inquiri.

unit.source: My intention wasn’t to finish off anyone.
unit.target: Intentio mea non erat quemquam interficere.

unit.source: “You can’t finish off anyone either,” the Demon with ice‑blue eyes remarked candidly.
unit.target: "Neque quemquam interficere potes," daemon oculis glacie caeruleis aperte dixit.

unit.source: It continued gazing at the Sacred Emblem of Life and added in a calm, deep voice, “Curiosity kills the cat.”
unit.target: Continuavit ad Sacrum Emblema Vitae aspexitque et voce tranquila et profunda addidit: "Curiositas felem occidit."

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian leviter subridens fuit.

unit.source: “It’s indeed risky, but finding you within a day and discovering the sealed valley indicates my capabilities.”
unit.target: "Revera periculosum est, sed te intra unum diem invenire et vallem sigillatam reperire facultates meas ostendit."

unit.source: Next time, I’ll choose a safer “sanctuary.”
unit.target: Proximo tempore, tutiorem sanctuarium eligebo.

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes, with few wrinkles, smiled—an uncommon sight.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, paucis rugis, subridens est—visio rara!

unit.source: “Your methods are unconventional, but they align with the mysticism world’s underlying laws.
unit.target: "Methodi tuae non sunt consuetae, sed legibus fundamentis orbis mystici congruunt.

unit.source: “But had I not controlled myself and repented for past deeds, you would be dead. Such an investigation would have been futile.”
unit.target: "Sed nisi me temperavero et pro factis praeteritis paenitentiam egimussem, mortuus esses; talis investigatio fuisset vana."

unit.source: Lumian didn’t dispute.
unit.target: Lumian non disputavit.

unit.source: With the information he gathered, he knew there was no immediate danger in the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Ex informationibus collectis, sciebat in cathedral Ecclesiae Terrae Matris nullum periculum imminens esse.

unit.source: The recent episode proved to be a false alarm.
unit.target: Recens eventus falsum alarmum fuit.

unit.source: He shifted the topic.
unit.target: Argumentum mutavit.

unit.source: “Why did that inexplicable Demon target you?
unit.target: "Cur ille daemon inexplicabilis te oppugnare constituit?"

unit.source: “Moreover, with the strength of me and my companions, it’s likely impossible to eradicate a so‑called Demon descendant like you. Was it deliberately leading us to our demise?”
unit.target: "Praeterea, cum vi mea et comitibus meis, verisimile est ut exterminare daemonis generis descendentem ut te non possimus. Num id conscie nos ad interitum deduxit?"

unit.source: The Demon, clad in a black suit, kept its gaze fixed on the Sacred Emblem of Life and responded, “I’m not certain which one you encountered.”
unit.target: Daemon, indutus veste formali nigra, oculos in Sacrum Emblema Vitae ficiens, respondit: "Non certus sum, cuius daemonii congressum habuisti."

unit.source: It refused to disclose more.
unit.target: Negavit plura patefacere.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t dare press further, let alone provoke.
unit.target: Lumian ultra insistere non ausus est, nedum provocare.

unit.source: His mind raced, searching for an alternate approach.
unit.target: Mens eius festinanter cursit, alteram viam quaerens.

unit.source: “You seem unrestricted. Why not leave Hanth Island?
unit.target: "Videtur te esse sine vinculis. Cur Insulam Hanth non relinquis?"

unit.source: “There appears to be some force influencing you here.”
unit.target: "Videtur aliqua vis te hic afficere."

unit.source: The Demon’s expression twisted as it stated, “This is my duty and my atonement.
unit.target: Vultus daemonis contortus est, dum diceret: "Hoc est officium meum et expiatio mea."

unit.source: “Since converting to Earth Mother, there are times when I can’t resist the urge to kill, accumulating profound sins.”
unit.target: "Ex quo ad Terram Matrem conversus sum, interdum impetum interficendi repellere non valeo, peccata profunde accumulans."

unit.source: Recalling his earlier deduction, Lumian inquired casually, “Then why not fully confine yourself?”
unit.target: Meminens deductionis suae priores, Lumian leviter inquisivit: "Cur igitur te omnino non constringis?"

unit.source: “Confinement won’t suffice. I can’t do it, and it can’t be achieved that way.”
unit.target: "Constrictio non sufficit. Id facere non possum, nec eo modo effici potest."

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes displayed pain once again.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum dolorem ostendit.

unit.source: Indeed, closely tied to the blood‑colored Demon in the valley… Yet, as a Coldblooded, why does the act of killing, and the subsequent “healing” by the Church of Earth Mother’s reverence for life, still cause you pain?
unit.target: Re vera, arcte conexus Daemone sanguine colorato in valle… Attamen, ut frigidus, cur actus interficendi et postea "sanatio" per venerationem Vitae a Ecclesia Terrae Matris tibi adhuc dolorem efficit?

unit.source: Lumian decided to steer the conversation to a less sensitive realm and soothe the other party.
unit.target: Lumian decrevit sermonem ad rem minus sensibilem convertere et alteri consolari.

unit.source: In a relaxed tone, he said, “I apologize. I wasn’t courteous earlier and failed to inquire about your preferred address.”
unit.target: "Ignosce mihi. Prius non fui urbanus nec interrogavi te de forma ad te loquendum quam praeferres."

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue eyes stared blankly for a moment before responding, “Naboredisley.”
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis per momentum vacuo intuebatur, antequam responderet: "Naboredisley."

unit.source: 626 Blatant Malice
unit.target: 626 Malitia Aperta

unit.source: Naboredisley?
unit.target: Naboredisley?

unit.source: Lumian almost thought the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon was jesting with him.
unit.target: Lumian paene existimavit daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis, cum illo iocari.

unit.source: However, he swiftly confirmed a crucial detail.
unit.target: Tamen celeriter confirmavit rem maximi momenti.

unit.source: When it came to matters concerning the Love Incantation, he had never uttered the name Naboredisley!
unit.target: Cum de incantatione amoris ageretur, nomen Naboredisley numquam edixit!

unit.source: Not only did he fear that Naboredisley and the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon were adversaries, but he also adhered to Madam Magician’s instructions to abstain from writing or speaking this name.
unit.target: Non solum timebat ne Naboredisley et daemon oculis glacie caeruleis adversarii essent, sed etiam mandata Dominae Magicae, ne hoc nomen scriberetur aut diceretur, observabat.

unit.source: If so, why did the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon identify itself as Naboredisley?
unit.target: Si ita, cur daemon oculis glacie caeruleis se "Naboredisley" appellavit?

unit.source: Could it truly be the genuine Naboredisley?
unit.target: Num vere esset verus Naboredisley?

unit.source: Then, why did the repeated chanting of “Naboredisley” summon a different Demon and not the ice‑blue‑eyed one?
unit.target: Ergo, cur repetita recitatio "Naboredisley" alium daemon evocavit, non autem illum oculis glacie caeruleis?

unit.source: Or were they equals?
unit.target: An aequales erant?

unit.source: Was Naboredisley scheming to manipulate someone else into killing me?
unit.target: Num Naboredisley machinabatur ut aliquem alium me interficeret?

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s astonishment and confusion, a smile crept onto his face.
unit.target: Inter stuporem et confusionem, risus in facie eius apparuit.

unit.source: “I wouldn’t dare utter that name.”
unit.target: "Non ausus essem hoc nomen proferre."

unit.source: He was testing the Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes.
unit.target: Daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis tentabat.

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes turned towards Lumian.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis versus Lumianum se convertit.

unit.source: “You’ve heard of Naboredisley and are aware of the concealed perils of uttering this name?”
unit.target: "Audivistine de Naboredisley et novistine pericula occulta huius nominis proferendi?"

unit.source: “Yes,” Lumian replied with a grin.
unit.target: "Ita," respondit Lumian cum risu.

unit.source: From the Demon’s reaction, it seems unlikely to be the one propagating the Love Incantation…
unit.target: Ex reactione daemonis vix videtur is fuisse qui incantationem amoris diffundat…

unit.source: That’s intriguing… Lumian pondered.
unit.target: Id mirum est… Lumian meditatus est.

unit.source: Though this might unveil greater horrors and deeper secrets, as a Hunter, fear and curiosity didn’t contradict each other.
unit.target: Quamquam hoc fortasse maiora horrores et arcana revelabit, ut Venator, timor et curiositas non erant contraria.

unit.source: It was akin to how everyone in the army feared death, yet it didn’t deter them from banding together for combat.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat eo, ut omnes in exercitu mortem timebant, sed eos non prohibebat coniungere ad pugnam.

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes nodded slowly and spoke, “Here, within Earth Mother’s cathedral, you needn’t fret about uttering the name Naboredisley.”
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis lente annuit et dixit: "Hic, in ecclesia Matris Terrae, non curare debes nomine 'Naboredisley' proferendo."

unit.source: “That’s evidently not the name you typically go by.
unit.target: Plane hoc non est nomen quo solito te appellare.

unit.source: Why don’t you disclose your true name instead?”
unit.target: Cur non enuntiās nomen verum tuum?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t reply.
unit.target: Lumian non respondit.

unit.source: Instead, he posed a query.
unit.target: Immo, quaestionem proposuit.

unit.source: He had a persistent feeling that the other party intended to harm him.
unit.target: Constanter sentiebat aliam partem sibi nocere intentasse.

unit.source: Had he not encountered the Love Incantation and received guidance from Madam Magician, he might have inadvertently mentioned the concealed Demon on Hanth Island, Naboredisley, after leaving Earth Mother’s cathedral today.
unit.target: Si incantationem amoris non invenisset et Dominae Magicae consilium non accepisset, forsitan inopinato, postquam ecclesiam Matris Terrae hodie relicta esset, daemon occultus in Insula Hanth, Naboredisley, memoratus fuisset.

unit.source: That could have been troublesome!
unit.target: Id grave esse poterat!

unit.source: The Demon with ice‑blue‑eyed eyes fell silent for a few moments before stating, “The name I go by in human society holds no significance for you.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis paucos instantes siluit, deinde dixerat: "Nomen quod in societā humanā utor, tibi nihil refert.

unit.source: Moreover, after learning the name Naboredisley and uttering it at least three times outside the cathedral…
unit.target: Praeterea, postquam nomen Naboredisley didicit et saltem ter extra ecclesiam proferuit…

unit.source: At this juncture, the white‑haired Demon’s visage twitched, and a pained expression surfaced.
unit.target: In hoc momento, vultus daemonis albis capillis contremuit, et vultus doloris apparuit.

unit.source: “I will establish a connection with you.
unit.target: "Tecum nexum instituam.

unit.source: When I can no longer control myself, I may choose to end your life.
unit.target: "Cum me ipsum regere non potero, fortasse eligam vitam tuam finire.

unit.source: Ending the life of an uninformed adventurer like you, seeking to uncover the truth of Hanth Island’s legend, would bring me greater satisfaction than harming ordinary people.
unit.target: "Vitam viatoris ignoti, ut te, qui veritatem de legenda Insulae Hanth detegere conaris, interficere, mihi maiorem voluptatem attulerit quam vulgos laedere.

unit.source: I won’t feel as regretful or guilty.
unit.target: "Non me paenitebit et non culpam sentiam.

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon gazed at the Sacred Emblem of Life once more, bowed its head, and expressed remorse.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum Emblema Sacrum Vitae spectavit, caput inclinavit, et poenitentiam ostendit.

unit.source: “Oh, merciful Mother, I implore your mercy for my transgressions.
unit.target: "O mater misericors, veniam tuam pro peccatis meis imploro.

unit.source: I should not have harbored malevolent intentions…
unit.target: "Non debui malevolas intentiones fovere…

unit.source: The corners of Lumian’s mouth twitched, and his expression darkened.
unit.target: Anguli oris Luminiani titubaverunt, et vultus eius obscuratus est.

unit.source: Did you genuinely intend to harm me?
unit.target: Num vere propositum habuisti mihi nocere?

unit.source: He couldn’t afford to let his guard down for a moment when dealing with Demons.
unit.target: Non potuit quidem momentum relinquere custodiam, cum daemonibus ageret.

unit.source: Vigilance was paramount, even if it was a Demon professing allegiance to Earth Mother!
unit.target: Praecipua erat vigilantia, etiamsi daemon Matri Terrae fidem praestaret!

unit.source: Moreover, a seemingly innocuous conversation could clandestinely plant a time bomb.
unit.target: Praeterea, sermo parvus innocuus videbatur, sed occulte bombam temporis instillare poterat.

unit.source: Any other adventurer would have fallen victim to it.
unit.target: Alius quilibet viator victima eius fuisset.

unit.source: Truly befitting the Criminal pathway, known for its high IQ crimes…
unit.target: Vere decet iter criminale, notum prae scelera ingenii excelsi…

unit.source: Cold, calculating, and overtly malicious…
unit.target: Frigidus, calculans, et manifeste malitiosus…

unit.source: After the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, self‑identified as Naboredisley, concluded its repentance, Lumian feigned a nonchalant smile and remarked,
unit.target: Post daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, se vocans Naboredisley, paenitentiam confectum, Lumian risum indifferens simulavit et dixit:

unit.source: “If you truly cannot control yourself and desire to take a life, target pirates.
unit.target: "Si vere teipsum regere non potes et animam tollere cupis, piratas intende.

unit.source: It aligns with a sense of justice.”
unit.target: "Id iustitiae sensui congruit.

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s expression darkened as it retorted, “This is my prison.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis vultu obscurato respondit: "Hic est carcer meus.

unit.source: I cannot depart until I have atoned.
unit.target: "Non possum discedere, nisi paenitentiam egerim.

unit.source: If any pirates enter Port Hanth, I will make them vanish into the forest outside the city.”
unit.target: "Si quid piratarum in Portum Hanth ingrediatur, eos in silva extra urbem evanescere faciam.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and redirected the conversation.
unit.target: Lumian annuit et colloquium dirigere conatus est.

unit.source: “The Love Incantation I mentioned earlier was the name you brought up.
unit.target: "Incantatio Amoris, quam antea commemoravi, erat nomen, quod tu proposuisti.

unit.source: The Demon who proposed a deal with me also identified itself with that name.”
unit.target: "Daemon, qui mihi pactum proposuit, quoque se hoc nomine designavit.

unit.source: The gray‑haired, ice‑blue‑eyed Demon remained silent, gazing at the Sacred Emblem of Life for an extended period.
unit.target: Daemon cineraceo capillato, oculis glacie caeruleis, silentium retinuit et Emblema Sacrum Vitae diu contemplavit.

unit.source: Rather than detecting anger and animosity, Lumian sensed surprise and bewilderment.
unit.target: Potius quam iram et inimicitias deprehendens, Lumian admirationem et stupefactionem sensit.

unit.source: What… It can’t pinpoint the Demon’s true identity either?
unit.target: Quid... Nec veram daemonis identitatem determinare potest?

unit.source: Is there no direct connection between the two parties?
unit.target: Nonne inter has duas partes directa connexio existit?

unit.source: Lumian pondered inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian intime meditatus est.

unit.source: After a while, the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, self‑dubbed Naboredisley, spoke,
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, se vocans Naboredisley, locutus est,

unit.source: “According to you, the Love Incantation has been clandestinely circulating for many years, yet I’ve never established a connection with anyone outside Hanth Island.”
unit.target: "Secundum te, incantatio amoris per multos annos clandestine circulavit, attamen cum nemine extra Insulam Hanth connexus sum.

unit.source: “I’m puzzled by that too.
unit.target: "Illo quoque miror.

unit.source: Could it be that someone can intercept the direction of the name?
unit.target: Num aliquis directionem nominis intercipere possit?

unit.source: Is it conceivable to assume your identity in the future?”
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut in futurum identitatem tuam suscipias?

unit.source: Lumian feigned curiosity as an adventurer.
unit.target: Lumian, ut viator, curiositatem simulavit.

unit.source: He believed that, based on Madam Magician’s words, Mr. Fool could accomplish such a feat.
unit.target: Credebat, ex verbis Dominae Magicae innixus, Dominum Stultum talem rem perfacere posse.

unit.source: Amon was capable of it once too.
unit.target: Amon quoque olim id efficaciter perfecit.

unit.source: Whether any Demon could do it remained unknown for now.
unit.target: Num quisquam daemon id facere posset adhuc ignotum manet.

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon fell silent once more.
unit.target: Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis iterum tacuit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, it spoke with a deep voice,
unit.target: Post paucas secundas, profunda voce locutus est,

unit.source: “Foreigner, you’ve inquired enough.
unit.target: "Hospes, satis quaesivisti.

unit.source: “Let’s conclude it here.
unit.target: "Hoc hic confingamus.

unit.source: “Otherwise, you may meet your end unknowingly.”
unit.target: "Aliter, ignaro, fatum tuum continget.

unit.source: Clad in a formal black suit, the Demon self‑dubbed Naboredisley slowly rose.
unit.target: Indutus habitu nigro formali, daemon, se vocans Naboredisley, lente surrexit.

unit.source: It positioned its feet apart, raised its hands adorned with black leather gloves, and whispered,
unit.target: Pedes se dispositos, manus, chirothecis nigris coriaceis induti, tollens, susurravit,

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: "Lauda Terram, lauda Matrem Omnium!

unit.source: Then, it turned around, picked up its cane, and shuffled towards the cathedral’s door, bathed in the midday sun.
unit.target: Deinde se vertit, baculum assumpsit, et ad ostium cathedralis, sub sole meridiano, laboriose accessit.

unit.source: Lumian scrutinized the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon, realizing it wasn’t tall and appeared rather thin.
unit.target: Lumian daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis diligenter examinavit, animadvertens eum non esse altum atque tenue videbatur.

unit.source: It emitted a withered and feeble aura, resembling that of an elderly ordinary human.
unit.target: Emanabat ab eo aura marcescens atque infirmissima, similis habitu senis hominis communis.

unit.source: It hardly resembled a terrifying and mighty Demon.
unit.target: Vix remanet daemon terribilis et potens.

unit.source: Observing closely, Lumian sensed a dark, blatant malice expanding and contracting beneath the thin human skin and aged flesh.
unit.target: Attente observans, Lumian sensit malitiam obscuram et manifesta, quae sub tenuo cuti humanae et carne senili expandebatur atque contrahiebatur.

unit.source: The frightening inner core sharply contrasted with its frail appearance, yet the overall aura seemed feeble and commonplace.
unit.target: Intima essentia daemonis terribilis acuite contraria apparatu fragile eius erat, sed aura universalis videbatur debilis atque vulgata.

unit.source: This is reminiscent of Ludwig…
unit.target: Hoc Ludwig reminiscit…

unit.source: One is a child concealing an unknown monster beneath the skin, while the other is a pitch‑black Demon concealed within an old man’s body…
unit.target: Unus est puer qui monstrum ignotum sub cute celat, alter autem est daemon ater, in corpore senilis absconditus…

unit.source: Lumian exerted great effort to refrain from fixating on scrutinizing the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s luck.
unit.target: Lumian magnum conatum cepit, ne fortunam daemonis oculis glacie caeruleis perscruteret.

unit.source: The gray‑haired elder in black leather gloves, wielding a cane, slowly departed from the cathedral.
unit.target: Senex cineraceus, indutus chirothecis nigris ex coriaceo, baculo utens, cathedralem lente reliquit.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t in a rush to return to the Berries.
unit.target: Lumian ad Berries redire non festinabat.

unit.source: He remained seated in the first row, contemplating the local Demon legends, which had recently become clearer yet were shrouded in numerous mysteries.
unit.target: In prima ordine sedebat, de fabulis daemonum localium meditans, quae nuper clariora facta erant sed adhuc multis mysteriis tectae.

unit.source: Suddenly, from the corner of his eye, he spotted a brown clergyman’s uniform.
unit.target: Subito, ex angulo oculi sui, vestem clericorum fuscorum animadvertit.

unit.source: This was the attire of a clergyman from the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Haec erant vestimenta clerici Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Lumian looked up and saw a middle‑aged man with well‑defined facial features and thick eyebrows.
unit.target: Lumian extulit oculos et virum medii aetatis, faciei bene definitæ et superciliis crassioribus, vidit.

unit.source: He noticed a pair of blood‑shot, ice‑blue‑eyed eyes filled with pain.
unit.target: Animadvertit par oculorum rubentium, oculis glacie caeruleis, dolore repletos.

unit.source: Ice‑blue eyes?
unit.target: Oculi glacie caerulei?

unit.source: Dammit! Lumian’s hair stood on end as he cursed inwardly.
unit.target: Pro di immortales! Capilli Luminiani erecti sunt, dum interius maledixit.

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman sat beside Lumian, where the Demon had been.
unit.target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis iuxta Lumian sedebat, in loco ubi daemon fuerat.

unit.source: He smiled warmly and said, “Don’t provoke Boselli or attempt his suggestions.
unit.target: Calide subridens dixit: "Noli Bosellim provocare neque eius consilia temptare.

unit.source: His self‑control diminishes with age.”
unit.target: "Eius continentia cum aetate minuit.

unit.source: “Boselli? Are you referring to the old gentleman with ice‑blue eyes?” Lumian feigned ignorance.
unit.target: "Boselli? Num de viro seniore cum oculis glacie caeruleis loqueris?" Lumian ignorantiam simulavit.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: "Ita."

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman nodded slightly.
unit.target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis leviter annuit.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and grinned.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et risum afferre coepit.

unit.source: “What about you? How’s your self‑control?”
unit.target: "Quid de te? Quomodo tua continentia est?"

unit.source: “I’m much better than him.
unit.target: "Multo melius quam ille sum.

unit.source: I lose control only once every few years,” the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman replied candidly.
unit.target: "Continentiam solum semel in aliquot annis perdo," respondit clericus oculis glacie caeruleis sincera voce.

unit.source: Is he admitting that he’s also a Demon?
unit.target: Num ille agnoscit se quoque daemonem esse?

unit.source: I’m not in Earth Mother’s cathedral, but a Devil family’s dining room…
unit.target: Non in ecclesia Matris Terrae sum, sed in triclinio familiae Diaboli…

unit.source: Lumian felt a chill and couldn’t help but criticize.
unit.target: Lumian frigore affectus est et non potuit non reprehendere.

unit.source: Maintaining a composed smile, he said, “Are you acquainted with him? Are you from the same family?”
unit.target: Tranquillum risum servans, dixit: "Illum cognoscisne? Eadem familia esne?"

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman reflected for a moment and replied, “We’re all born in the Port Hanth Cloister.”
unit.target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis paulisper meditatus est et respondit: "Omnes in Claustro Portus Hanth nati sumus."

unit.source: Children born in a cloister?
unit.target: Pueri in claustro nati?

unit.source: The description made Lumian uneasy.
unit.target: Descriptio Luminian inquietum fecit.

unit.source: In other Churches, having a child in a cloister was a grave matter, deviating from the teachings of the deity, a symptom of succumbing to carnal desires and blaspheming faith.
unit.target: In aliis Ecclesiis, puer in claustro nascitur gravis quaestio erat, a doctrina deitatis deviante, signum ad desideria carnalia cedendi ac fidei blasphemii.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment before reaching a realization.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est antequam intellectum assequeretur.

unit.source: This was the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Haec erat Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

unit.source: The more nuns and monks had children in the cloister, the more aligned with the doctrine!
unit.target: Quo plura moniales et monachi in claustro nati sunt, eo magis doctrinae congruunt!

unit.source: He immediately understood why the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman and Boselli were born in the cloister.
unit.target: Statim intellexit cur clericus oculis glacie caeruleis et Boselli in claustro nati essent.

unit.source: It would conceal their origins and identities well, preventing them from implicating ordinary families.
unit.target: Eorum originem et identitatem bene celabit, ne familiis ordinariis implicarentur.

unit.source: This shattered Lumian’s previous deductions about the local Demons.
unit.target: Hoc praevias coniecturas Luminiani de daemonibus localibus fregit.

unit.source: Demons didn’t need to vanish to conceal their “corpses.”
unit.target: Daemonibus non necesse fuit evanescere ut "cadavera" sua celarent.

unit.source: The Church of Earth Mother would assist in concealing them.
unit.target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae eos celare adiuvabit.

unit.source: For instance, replacing genuine holy water with distilled water during a wake and later providing new identities and legal origins.
unit.target: Exempli causa, aquam sanctam veram aqua destillata substituendo in vigilia funebri et postea identitates novas originisque legales praebendo.

unit.source: My earlier deduction was based on the assumption that the Church of Earth Mother and the local Demons weren’t allies.
unit.target: Praevia mea coniectura innixabatur suppositione quod Ecclesia Matris Terrae et daemonia localia non erant socia.

unit.source: No wonder there are so many errors…
unit.target: Non mirum plurima esse errores…

unit.source: This is a factor I need to be mindful of when crafting conspiracies in the future.
unit.target: Hoc est factor, quem meminisse debeo dum coniurationes futuras extruo.

unit.source: If I’m mistaken, any subsequent clever arrangements will lose their significance…
unit.target: Si erraverim, quaevis subsequentes callidae consilia significationem amittent…

unit.source: It seems the Church of Earth Mother is directly offering protection to these ice‑blue‑eyed Demons, both resisting restrictions and cooperating to shield them?
unit.target: Videtur Ecclesia Matris Terrae directe hos daemonos oculis glacie caeruleis protegere, simul restrictionibus resistere et cooperari ut eos tueatur?

unit.source: Lumian reflected on his investigations over the past two days.
unit.target: Lumian de indagationibus per duas dies praeteritas meditatus est.

unit.source: This introspection couldn’t enable him to digest the potion completely, but he felt it was more beneficial than a complete digestion.
unit.target: Haec introspectio eum potionem omnino digere non potuit, sed sensit id magis utile esse quam completa digestio.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the clergyman with ice‑blue eyes and inquired with a smile, “Could it be that you’re also using the name Boselli mentioned just now?”
unit.target: Lumian ad clericum oculis glacie caeruleis spectavit et subridente quaesivit: "Num fortasse etiam nomen, quod Boselli modo dixit, uteris?"

unit.source: The ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman responded with a warm smile.
unit.target: Clericus oculis glacie caeruleis cum risu calido respondit.

unit.source: “Yes, my name is also Naboredisley.”
unit.target: "Ita, nomen meum quoque est Naboredisley."

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian to probe further, it continued, “I don’t know your background, but you can report Hanth Island to the other orthodox Churches.
unit.target: Ne Lumian ulterius indagare exspectans, perrexit: "Nescio quid tua sit origo, sed Insulam Hanth alias Ecclesias orthodoxas referre potes.

unit.source: “I believe they will advise you against delving into the truth of the Demon legends.
unit.target: "Credo eos te monere, ne veritatem fabularum daemonum investiges.

unit.source: “Just as Boselli mentioned, Foreigner, let’s conclude this here.
unit.target: "Sicut Boselli dixit, hospes, hoc hic finiamus.

unit.source: “Leave Hanth Island.”
unit.target: "Relinque Insulam Hanth.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, stood up, and departed from the cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian annuit, surrexit, et ex ecclesia discessit.

unit.source: Under the bright sunlight, he strolled along the street, his mind filled with pairs of icy‑blue eyes and the name Naboredisley.
unit.target: Sub luce solis clarae, per viam ambulavit, mente plena pariorum oculorum glacie caeruleorum et nominis Naboredisley.

unit.source: He felt a little disoriented.
unit.target: Aliquantum disorientatus se sensit.

unit.source: 627 Treatment Plan?
unit.target: Consilium Curandi 627?

unit.source: Lumian had initially theorized the presence of multiple Demons on Hanth Island, specifically the sealed blood-colored Demon and the ice-blue-eyed Demon.
unit.target: Lumian initio coniectavit de praesentia plurium daemonum in Insula Hanth, praesertim daemonem sanguine coloratum sigillatum atque daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis.

unit.source: However, to his astonishment, he discovered various ice-blue-eyed Demons—in the cathedral!
unit.target: Tamen, ad stuporem eius, invenit plures daemonos oculis glacie caeruleis in ecclesia!

unit.source: How many Demons inhabit this island?
unit.target: Quot daemones hac insula inhabitant?

unit.source: Are they all part of the same family with ice-blue eyes?
unit.target: Num omnes eandem familiam, cum oculis glacie caeruleis, constituunt?

unit.source: As expected of the Mother of All Things.
unit.target: Ut a Matre Omnium Rerum exspectatur.

unit.source: Even a Demon can be Her child.
unit.target: Etiam daemon filius eius esse potest.

unit.source: A whole nest of them!
unit.target: Totus eorum nidus!

unit.source: As thoughts swirled in Lumian’s mind, accompanied by those piercing ice-blue eyes and the name Naboredisley, he felt that his previous investigations and speculations were completely off course.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes in mente Luminiani vortebantur, comitatae oculis acutis glacie caeruleis et nomine Naboredisley, sensit indagationes atque speculationes praeteritas omnino erravisse.

unit.source: The complexity and mystery surrounding the legend of the Demons on Hanth Island surpassed his initial imagination.
unit.target: Complexitas et mysterium legendae daemonum in insula Hanth initialem eius imaginationem superaverunt.

unit.source: No, there are still gains and benefits…
unit.target: Non, adhuc sunt utilitates et beneficia…

unit.source: Speculation involves bold assumptions and careful confirmation.
unit.target: Speculatio audaces coniecturas et diligens confirmationem implicat.

unit.source: It’s normal for initial assumptions to be overturned.
unit.target: Communum est ut primae coniecturae refutentur.

unit.source: The elimination method is a crucial deduction tool…
unit.target: Methodus eliminationis instrumentum deductionis praecipuum est…

unit.source: How can there be unsolved cases that are guessed completely correct from the beginning?
unit.target: Quomodo casus insoluti, qui ab initio omnino recte coniecti sunt, exsistere possunt?

unit.source: The crucial aspect lies in consistently refuting the incorrect path through falsification and integrating new information acquired during the investigation to uncover the right one…
unit.target: Aspectus crucialis in constanti refutatione viae erroneae per falsificationem et integratione novarum informationum, quae in inquisitione adeptae sunt, ad viam rectam inveniendam consistit.

unit.source: Heh heh, if I were to take the Reader pathway, it should be relatively straightforward for me to act the role of a Detective.
unit.target: Heh heh, si viam Lectoris elegissem, satis facile mihi fore debet ut munus Detectivi peragarer.

unit.source: Discerning a conspiracy stands out as one of the primary duties of a Detective…
unit.target: Coniurationem discernere inter praecipua Detectivi officia eminet.

unit.source: Lumian reassured himself, disentangling from the impact of the two ice-blue-eyed Demons.
unit.target: Lumian se consolatus est, dissolvens ictum duorum daemonum oculis glacie caeruleis.

unit.source: He regained his clarity and rationality, no longer feeling befuddled and disoriented.
unit.target: Claritatem atque rationem iterum adeptus est, neque amplius turbatus aut confusus se sentiens.

unit.source: Under the blistering sunlight, he swiftly identified an issue.
unit.target: Sub sole ferventi, celeriter rem deprehendit.

unit.source: In the scene I witnessed through the Mystery Prying Glasses, the blood-colored Demon was pulled by an invisible force, but there was only one invisible force, and only a pair of ice-blue eyes gazed at me…
unit.target: In scena, quam per oculos indagatores mysterii conspexi, daemon sanguine coloratus ab invisibili vi tractus est, sed una tantum vis invisibilis aderat, atque solum par oculorum glacie caeruleorum ad me intuebatur.

unit.source: There’s only one ice-blue-eyed Demon closely linked to the blood-colored Demon, and that’s the elder Boselli who repented before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
unit.target: Tantum est unus daemon, oculis glacie caeruleis, qui arcte coniungitur cum daemon sanguine colorato, atque ille est senior Boselli, qui coram Insigne Sacrum Vitae paenitentiam egit.

unit.source: The others, including the ice-blue-eyed clergyman, are its descendants.
unit.target: Reliqui, inter quos etiam clericus oculis glacie caeruleis, eius posteri sunt.

unit.source: Could they be the offspring it left behind with the nuns when it used the Hanth Island’s cloister to ‘restore its youth’ and obtain a new identity?
unit.target: Possuntne illi esse progenies quas reliquit cum monachis, quum claustrum Insulae Hanth ad iuventutem restitutam et novam identitatem adipiscendam usus est?

unit.source: However, when the ice-blue-eyed clergyman mentioned Boselli, it didn’t sound like it was referring to its father, grandfather, or ancestor.
unit.target: Sed cum clericus oculis glacie caeruleis Boselli nominavit, non videbatur referre ad patrem, avum aut progenitorem.

unit.source: It was as if it was discussing a friend with whom it didn’t share an amicable relationship…
unit.target: Sicut de amico loqueretur, cui vinculum amicitiae non haberet.

unit.source: Moreover, it also identifies itself as Naboredisley…
unit.target: Porro, se ipse etiam Naboredisley appellat…

unit.source: Could this be a family name?
unit.target: Poteritne hoc esse nomen familiae?

unit.source: A significant family name among the Abyss Demons?
unit.target: Nomen familiae insignis inter daemonos Abyssos?

unit.source: Puzzled, Lumian boarded the Berries and returned to his first-class suite.
unit.target: Perplexus, Lumian in "Berries" conscendit et ad cellam suam primae classis rediit.

unit.source: At that moment, Lugano and Ludwig were relishing a lavish lunch.
unit.target: Illo tempore, Lugano ac Ludwig prandium opulentum degustabant.

unit.source: Upon spotting Lumian, the Doctor grinned sheepishly and said, “I thought you’d be indulging in the local delights on the island, so I didn’t wait for you.”
unit.target: Cum Lumianum animadvertit, Medicus verecunde subsurridens dixit: “Putabam te in deliciis loci insulae frui, ideo te non exspectavi.”

unit.source: Lumian sat down and grabbed a wheat-flavored bun. As he chewed, he asked thoughtfully,
unit.target: Lumian consedit et paniculam triticeam arripuit; dum masticabat, caute rogavit:

unit.source: “What do you know about the abilities of the Planter pathway?”
unit.target: “Quid de facultatibus viae Plantatoris nosti?”

unit.source: Lugano hesitated for a moment before truthfully responding, “Sequence 9 Planter significantly boosts my strength.
unit.target: Lugano paulisper cessavit antequam sincero respondit: “Secuencia IX Plantator vires meas significanter auget.

unit.source: I can predict the weather to a certain extent by observing clouds, wind, and other natural phenomena.
unit.target: Tempestatem ad aliquam mensuram praedicere possum, nubibus, vento, et aliis phaenomenis naturalibus inspiciens.

unit.source: I’m adept at identifying seeds and nurturing them.
unit.target: Sementes agnoscere et colere peritus sum.

unit.source: Farming tools suit me more than knives and guns.”
unit.target: Instrumenta agriculturae mihi magis conveniunt quam cultri et tormenta.”

unit.source: “Sequence 8 Doctor’s primary abilities revolve around healing.
unit.target: “Secuencia VIII Medici principales facultates in curatione consistunt.

unit.source: They can discern the patient’s specific situation through Spirit Vision.
unit.target: Per Visionem Spiritus possunt statum specificum aegroti discernere.

unit.source: They possess outstanding surgical skills, such as suturing severed limbs and transplanting internal organs.
unit.target: Praeterea, excellentem artem chirurgicam habent, ut conexuram membrorum secatorum et transplantationem organorum internorum.

unit.source: Additionally, we gain Beyonder abilities like Evil Ailment Treatment, Trauma Treatment, Soul Suture, and Life-Giving.
unit.target: Insuper, adepti sumus facultatum Beyonder, ut Curatio Morborum Malorum, Curatio Traumatica, Sutura Animae, et Vivificatio.”

unit.source: “As far as I know, the next Sequence is called Harvest Priest.
unit.target: “Quod mihi nota est, proximus sequens vocatur Sacerdos Messis.

unit.source: It mainly focuses on promoting the reproduction and growth of creatures and bringing about a bumper harvest with Beyonder powers…”
unit.target: Praecipue intendit ad promotionem reproductionis et incrementi creaturarum, atque ad abundans messis per potentias Beyonder efficiendam…”

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Lumian suddenly interrupted Lugano.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian subito Lugano interpellavit.

unit.source: “Soul Suture?
unit.target: “Sutura Animae?

unit.source: “How is this implemented?”
unit.target: “Quomodo hoc perficitur?”

unit.source: Lugano grinned sheepishly and said, “I haven’t really used this ability yet.
unit.target: Lugano, verecunde risu, dixit: “Hanc facultatem nondum vere usus sum.

unit.source: It’s used to treat soul injuries.
unit.target: Ad vulnera animae curanda ea utitur.

unit.source: As you know, some superpowers can attack the soul, making it difficult for it to heal on its own.
unit.target: Ut nosti, quaedam virtutes supernaturales animam oppugnare possunt, ita ut per se ipsa sanari difficile fiat.

unit.source: At this moment, as long as the injured let go of their bodies and minds and don’t resist, I can carry out a soul-level surgery to stitch up the corresponding wound.”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, dummodo vulnerati corpora et mentes suas dimitterint nec resisterint, possum in scala animae operationem chirurgicam ad vulneris suturam perficere.”

unit.source: Lumian’s concern wasn’t about stitching up a soul; it was another matter that provided him with a fresh perspective on the Demon legends of Hanth Island.
unit.target: In Luminiano sollicitudo non de sutura animae erat; alia enim res novam perspicientiam de legendis daemonum in insula Hanth ei attulit.

unit.source: He downed the pre-meal bun and took a sip of the golden liqueur.
unit.target: Prandii paniculam edidit et liquorem aureum sorpit.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, he inquired, “Since you can suture souls, from a different standpoint, can you also sever souls?”
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, interrogavit: “Cum animae suturam efficere possis, ex alia parte, potesne etiam animas secare?”

unit.source: Lugano fell silent.
unit.target: Lugano silentium cepit.

unit.source: After ten to twenty seconds, he responded, “Theoretically, yes, but it requires the corresponding person to completely open up their body and mind, leaving their soul unprotected.
unit.target: Post decem ad viginti secundas respondit: “Theoretice, ita; sed requirit ut persona sua corpus ac mentem penitus aperiat, relinquens animam sine tutela.

unit.source: It would be even more effective if their physical body doesn’t exist.”
unit.target: Illud etiam melius valeret, si corpus physicum non exsistat.”

unit.source: The Doctor hesitated for a moment before adding, “This can serve as an attack on the soul, but it could also be a treatment method.
unit.target: Medicus breviter dubitavit antequam addidit: “Hoc potest uti impetu contra animam, sed etiam methodus curationis esse potest.

unit.source: If a patient’s soul is corrupted by a curse, they can address it by severing the depravity and allowing their soul to gradually heal.”
unit.target: Si anima aegroti a maledictione corrupta sit, eam operari possunt separando pravitatem et sinendo animam paulatim sanari.”

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Lumian smiled and applauded softly.
unit.target: His audita, Lumian subridens leniter plausit.

unit.source: “Well said. Well said.”
unit.target: “Bene locutum. Bene locutum.”

unit.source: Lugano, being thick‑skinned, couldn’t help but feel a bit embarrassed by the praise.
unit.target: Lugano, animi duritiam habens, non potuit parum erubescere laude.

unit.source: He blurted out, “That’s just my speculation. I haven’t tested it yet.”
unit.target: Impromptu exclamat: “Hoc solum est mea speculatio; nondum id experientia probavi.”

unit.source: Lumian ignored him and proceeded to emulate what Ludwig had done.
unit.target: Lumian eum contempsit et imitari id quod Ludwig perfecerat accessit.

unit.source: He forked a lamb chop onto his plate and began cutting with determination.
unit.target: In patellam sua agnum lumbolum traiecit et cum studio secare coepit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the initial sensations when he faced the onslaught of the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon resurfaced in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Simul, sensus initii, cum daemon oculis glacie caeruleis impetum oppugnatum expertus esset, in mente Luminiani recensuerunt.

unit.source: He witnessed diverse versions of himself—a version brimming with hatred, another immersed in pain, one engrossed in lust, and another consumed by various desires and emotions…
unit.target: Se diversas partes sui conspexit: una odio repleta, altera dolore immersa, una libidine absorpta, et altera variis cupiditatibus atque affectibus consumpta…

unit.source: As Lugano detailed the process of suturing and soul‑severing, an idea sparked in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Dum Lugano processum suturae atque animarum secedendi enarrabat, idea in mente Luminiani nata est.

unit.source: What if the High‑Sequence abilities of the Planter pathway were employed to excise different aspects of the soul corresponding to various desires?
unit.target: Quid si potentiae altæ sequentiae viae Plantatoris ad excidendos diversos aspectus animae, quos diversas cupiditates respondent, adhiberentur?

unit.source: Could there truly be just one ice‑blue‑eyed Demon on Hanth Island, but its soul had been partitioned by the Saints and even Angels of the Church of Earth Mother, each becoming an individual?
unit.target: Num vere sit solus unus daemon oculis glacie caeruleis in insula Hanth, cum anima eius a Sanctis atque etiam Angelis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae divisa sit, singulis fiendo?

unit.source: On a mystical level, they remain a single entity.
unit.target: In sensu mystico unum ens manent.

unit.source: Hence, is there only one invisible force closely tied to the blood‑colored Demon?
unit.target: Itaque, num sola una vis invisibilis, quae arcte cum daemon sanguine colorato conexa sit, exsistat?

unit.source: The question now is—why would the Church of Earth Mother undertake such an action?
unit.target: Quaestio nunc est: cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae talem actionem suscipiat?

unit.source: Imposing restrictions or offering protection? Perhaps both?
unit.target: Restricta imponere aut tutela praebere? Fortasse utrumque?

unit.source: Lumian swiftly linked this with the state of the blood‑colored Demon.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter hoc cum statu daemon sanguine colorati coniunxit.

unit.source: It consistently descended into the pitch‑black sewage before being hoisted up by an unseen force.
unit.target: Constanter in cloacas atris descendebat, antequam ab invisibili vi sublevaretur.

unit.source: Splitting the soul acted as a shield for the ice‑blue Demon, preventing corruption from the power of the pitch‑black sewage?
unit.target: Divisio animae scutum fuit daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, corruptionem a potentia cloacarum atrorum prohibens?

unit.source: Wait, could the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon be the untainted segment of the blood‑colored Demon’s soul?
unit.target: Exspecta, num daemon oculis glacie caeruleis sit pars integra et immaculata animae daemon sanguine colorati?

unit.source: Is the Church of Earth Mother’s approach based on deeming the entire body beyond salvation, but parts are still considered healthy?
unit.target: An modus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae consistit, ut totum corpus ultra salutem existimet, sed aliquae partes adhuc sanum reputentur?

unit.source: Is that why a healthy soul needs to be severed into different desires?
unit.target: Itaque an anima sana in varias cupiditates secanda sit?

unit.source: The forest sealing off the mysterious valley, pitch‑black sewage, and the blood‑colored Demon displayed characteristics of rebirth, growth, depravity, death, and rebirth again…
unit.target: Silva, quae vallem arcanam obtegebat, cloacae atri, atque daemon sanguine coloratus, naturam regenerationis, incrementi, pravitatis, mortis atque rursus regenerationis exhibuerunt…

unit.source: The soul fragments of the blood‑colored Demon were given new life, enabling them to utilize the cycle of rebirth, growth, aging, death, and rebirth again to resist the corruption spreading from their true bodies?
unit.target: Fragmenta animae daemon sanguine colorati vitam novam acceperunt, quae eis permisit ut cyclum regenerationis, incrementi, senectutis, mortis atque rursus regenerationis ad corruptionem ex corporibus veris diffundentem oppugnare valeant.

unit.source: Simultaneously, relying on the existence of the healthy parts prevented the blood‑colored Demon from sinking entirely?
unit.target: Simul, innixus existentiae partium sanarum, daemon sanguine coloratus ne omnino submergeretur impedivit.

unit.source: Aging soul fragments are inherently more vulnerable to corruption from the main body, and newborns are the healthiest.
unit.target: Fragmenta animae senescens naturaliter magis ad corruptionem ex corpore principali occasionem habent, atque recenti optime valent.

unit.source: This explains why the old Boselli and the ice‑blue‑eyed clergyman are in different states…
unit.target: Hoc explicat cur senior Boselli et clericus oculis glacie caeruleis in diversis condicionibus sint…

unit.source: Such a newborn possesses a Demon’s potent soul, but its human body is exceedingly frail.
unit.target: Talis neonatus potentem animam daemonis habet, sed corpus humanum eius exiguum est.

unit.source: Yes, it aligns with my observations of Boselli.
unit.target: Ita, id congruit cum meis observationibus de Boselli.

unit.source: Its feeble and aged body encases a potent soul teeming with malevolence…
unit.target: Corpus eius infirmum atque senescentem potentem animam, malitia ferventem, amplectitur…

unit.source: This… This method of sealing and rescuing aligns with the Church of Earth Mother’s unique abilities…
unit.target: Ista… ista methodus sigillandi et eripiendi congruit cum unigenis facultatibus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae…

unit.source: With these revelations, Lumian felt enlightened.
unit.target: His revelationibus, Lumian se illuminatum esse sensit.

unit.source: Only then did he realize that he had been continuously cutting the lamb chop’s bones, producing a grinding sound.
unit.target: Tum intellexit se ossa costarum agni continue secare atque sonum molientem efficere.

unit.source: Lugano pretended not to notice or hear anything, focusing on enjoying his meal.
unit.target: Lugano simulavit nihil animadvertere aut audire, animum in cibo fruendo incumbens.

unit.source: Ludwig paid no attention to such trivial matters, wholly absorbed in the delicacies.
unit.target: Ludwig harum rerum levium nihil animadvertit, penitus in delicatissimis immersus.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his gaze and happily poured himself a glass of Paha red wine.
unit.target: Lumian oculos avertit atque laetus sibi poculum vini rubri Paha infundit.

unit.source: The confusion, disorder, loss, and disappointment he had previously experienced dissipated significantly.
unit.target: Confusio, inordinatio, amissio atque deiectio, quas antea passa erat, valde evanuerunt.

unit.source: As he drank, he leisurely pondered, “This hypothesis aligns most with the current details.”
unit.target: Dum bibeat, tranquille meditatus est: “Haec hypothesi maxime congruit cum indicibus praesentibus.”

unit.source: Unfortunately, it can’t be verified, nor do I dare to.
unit.target: Infeliciter, verificari non potest, nec ausus sum.

unit.source: And without verification and results, there’s no feedback for the potion’s digestion…
unit.target: Et sine verificatione atque eventibus, nullum responsum ad digestionem potionis praestatur…

unit.source: Forget it.
unit.target: Eia, dimitte.

unit.source: The experience and lessons I gained this time are much more important than the digestion I can still attempt in the future.
unit.target: Experientia atque lectiones, quas hoc tempore accepi, multo magni momenti sunt quam digestio, quam in futurum adhuc conari possum.

unit.source: Why does the Church of Earth Mother want to protect the blood‑colored Demon?
unit.target: Cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae daemon sanguine coloratus protegere cupit?

unit.source: Moreover, since a healthy soul has been separated and given new life, why not completely destroy and purify the corrupted true form to eliminate any hidden dangers?
unit.target: Praeterea, cum anima sana divisus novaque vita donata sit, cur non totam formam corruptam vere delendam atque purgandam esse putetur, ut omnia pericula occulta deleantur?

unit.source: There’s a high chance that this involves the world’s deep secrets…
unit.target: Magna est probabilitas quod hoc involvat arcana profunda mundi…

unit.source: Is that blood‑colored Demon the true and largest Naboredisley?
unit.target: Num iste daemon sanguine coloratus verus atque maximus Naboredisley sit?

unit.source: Was the one seeking a deal to slay Hanth Island’s Demon descendant it?
unit.target: Num ille, qui foedum quaerebat ad interficendum daemon Insulae Hanth, eius descendentia fuerit?

unit.source: Can it, in turn, affect a few soul fragments, allowing me and a Mid‑Sequence Beyonder like Franca to slay a true Demon?
unit.target: Num poterit id, vicissim, afficere pauca fragmenta animae, quae mihi atque Beyonder mediocris, qualis Franca, concedant daemonem verum interficere?

unit.source: The more Lumian contemplated, the more curious he became about the truth.
unit.target: Quo magis Lumian meditavit, eo magis de veritate inquisitivus factus est.

unit.source: However, he eventually restrained himself.
unit.target: Sed denique se continuit.

unit.source: For Beyonders at his level, this matter was concluded.
unit.target: Nam, ad gradum eius pertinentibus Beyonder, haec quaestio conclusa erat.

unit.source: After leaving Hanth Island, he would report his gains and speculations to Madam Magician and consult the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card holders.
unit.target: Postquam Insulam Hanth deseruit, lucri ac speculationes suas ad Dominam Magician referret atque cum possessoribus chartarum Major Arcana Tarot Club consuleret.

unit.source: Lumian, putting aside his investigative thoughts, felt a sense of relief.
unit.target: Lumian, cogitationes investigatorias deponens, levationem sensit.

unit.source: He spent the rest of his time leisurely strolling through Port Hanth.
unit.target: Reliquam temporis partem in Portu Hanth tranquille ambulans egit.

unit.source: To his surprise, he realized that the Berserk Sea island city, far from the Feynapotter Kingdom, didn’t have a genuine casino.
unit.target: Ad stuporem, intellexit urbem insularum Maris Furibundi, procul a Regno Feynapotter sita, genuinum casinum non habere.

unit.source: There were no criminal industries like human trafficking.
unit.target: Industriae scelestae, ut commercium humanum, non exstabant.

unit.source: It was as clean as if it had been purified by the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
unit.target: Erat tam purum, quasi Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Incandescentis illum purgasset.

unit.source: After engaging in Fighting Evil and other card games throughout the afternoon, Lumian, with wins and losses not exceeding 1 gold risot, finally grasped the reason.
unit.target: Postquam per totum postmeridiani tempus in ludis “Fighting Evil” aliisque chartaceis versatus est, Lumian, cuius lucrum ac damnum unum aureum risot non excedebat, tandem causam perspexit.

unit.source: Unable to control themselves, the ice‑blue‑eyed Demons prioritized the malevolent wrongdoers, making them vanish into the forest outside the city.
unit.target: In se continere nequentes, daemon oculis glacie caeruleis scelestores praevaluerunt, eos in silvam extra urbem evanescere fecisse.

unit.source: As time—a century or two—elapsed, Port Hanth could be deemed a city bathed in sunlight.
unit.target: Cum tempus—saeculum vel duo—transierit, Portus Hanth ut urbs lumine infusa esse potuit.

unit.source: Certainly, there were innocents among them, like Antonio Elias.
unit.target: Certe, inter eos innocentes, sicut Antonio Elias, erant.

unit.source: Late at night, in the first‑class cabin suite of the Berries.
unit.target: Sero nocte, in cella primae classis navis “Berries.”

unit.source: In his slumber, Lumian vaguely witnessed the land shrouded in sulfurous flames, and the blood‑colored Demon sprawled within the pitch‑black liquid.
unit.target: In somno, Lumian vage conspexit terram in flammis sulfurosis circumvolutam, atque daemon sanguine coloratus in liquido atri iacentem.

unit.source: 628 Terrifying Dream
unit.target: 628 Somnium Terribile

unit.source: Lumian vaguely noticed bubbles emerging from the pitch‐black liquid enveloping most of the blood‐colored Demon’s body.
unit.target: Lumian vagiter animadvertit bullas emergentes ex nigerrimo liquore, quod plerumque corpus daemonis sanguineo colore tincti circumferebat.

unit.source: The brownish‐green hue of the bubbles resembled tree warts.
unit.target: Color virido–brunneus bullarum ad verrucas arborum similis videbatur.

unit.source: In an instant, the bubbles burst, reflecting brilliant colors as they merged with the pitch‐black liquid.
unit.target: In uno momento bullae corruperunt, praeclaros colores effingentes, dum cum nigerrimo liquore confluere videbantur.

unit.source: For some reason, Lumian sensed that something was wrong.
unit.target: Quacumque re, Lumian sensit aliquid male esse.

unit.source: He wished to shut his eyes and avoid these details, but trapped in a dream, he had no control.
unit.target: Vellet oculos clausos habere et haec vitare, sed in somnio captus nullam habebat potestatem.

unit.source: In the depths of the pitch‐black liquid, a figure lurked.
unit.target: In profundis liquoris nigerrimi, figura insidiabatur.

unit.source: It raised its head slightly, gazing at the blood‐colored Demon.
unit.target: Levis caput attollens, ad daemonem sanguineo colore spectabat.

unit.source: Moist brownish‐green or light brown tree warts protruded from the figure’s body, reminding Lumian of Susanna Mattise in her Fallen Tree Spirit state.
unit.target: Ex corpore figurae verrucae arborum, sive virido–brunneae sive pallide brunnea, humidae emerserunt, quae Lumian ad Susannam Mattise in statu spiritus arboris lapsi revocaverunt.

unit.source: The distinction lay in Susanna Mattise’s tree warts, branches, and flower buds growing from her body, melding with her original form.
unit.target: Differentia consistit in verrucis arborum, ramis, et gemmis floriferis ex corpore eius crescente, quae cum forma originali coniungebantur.

unit.source: The figure’s tree warts, however, seemed to pierce out flamboyantly from the flesh and internal organs, tainted with blood.
unit.target: Verrucae figurae tamen ex carne et internis organis effulgentes apparere videbantur, sanguine tinctae.

unit.source: In his dream, Lumian instinctively raised his right hand, wiping the corners of his eyes.
unit.target: In somnio, Lumian instanter dextram manum attollit, angulos oculorum suorum delens.

unit.source: The back of his hand was stained red.
unit.target: Dorsum manus eius rubro tinctum erat.

unit.source: At some point, blood had flowed from his eyes, turning his vision a blurry red.
unit.target: Aliquando, sanguis ex oculis eius effusus est, visionem eius in rubrum nebulosum vertens.

unit.source: The figure’s overall outline appeared in the blur.
unit.target: Linea generalis figurae in turbatione apparuit.

unit.source: As if grown on a brownish‐green tree, pierced by branches, overrun by tree warts, and covered in flower buds, dripping with a viscous liquid.
unit.target: Velut in arbore virido–brunneosa crescebat, ramis perforata, verrucis abundans, et gemmis floriferis operta, liquore viscoso stillante.

unit.source: A burning sensation engulfed Lumian’s chest, prompting him to instinctively close his eyes in the dream.
unit.target: Sensus ardens pectus Lumiani invasebat, eumque instanter in somnio oculos claudere compellens.

unit.source: Yet, he was a step too slow.
unit.target: Attamen, passum nimis tardus erat.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes exploded, flooding his mind with searing pain.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani eruperunt, mentem eius acerrima dolore inundantes.

unit.source: He jolted awake, curling up in agony.
unit.target: Subito evigilavit, in dolore convolutus.

unit.source: His hands instinctively reached for his eyes, encountering a flat, sticky, and moist substance.
unit.target: Manus eius instanter ad oculos pervenire conarunt, et substantiā plana, adhaerente, et humida occurrerunt.

unit.source: The scent of blood hung heavily in the air.
unit.target: Odor sanguinis graviter in aere pendebat.

unit.source: As an Ascetic accustomed to severe injuries, Lumian took several minutes to overcome the pain that threatened to render him unconscious.
unit.target: Ut asceticus gravibus vulneribus assuetus, Lumian paucis minutis dedicavit ad dolorem superandum, qui eum in inconscientiam demittere minabatur.

unit.source: Struggling to sit up, he opened his eyes, only to be met with absolute darkness.
unit.target: Dum surgere conabatur, oculos aperuit, sed invenerat tenebras absolutas.

unit.source: No crimson moonlight, no outlines of furniture in the bedroom–he couldn’t see a thing.
unit.target: Nec luna rubra fulgebat, nec lineamenta supellectilis in cubiculo erant—nihil videbat.

unit.source: Lumian raised his hand once more, gently touching his eye sockets.
unit.target: Lumian manum iterum attollit, orbita oculorum sua leniter tangens.

unit.source: Both eyeballs had deflated, shattered beyond repair.
unit.target: Ambos bulbos oculi deflati erant, ultra reparari non potentes.

unit.source: Is it because I glimpsed something I shouldn’t have? Lumian chuckled in self‐deprecation.
unit.target: Num quia aliquid intuens videram, quod videre non deberam? Lumian, se ipsum vituperans, subridens respondit.

unit.source: It was a vision from a dream, something he never wished to witness.
unit.target: Erat visio ex somnio, aliquid quod numquam videre voluerat.

unit.source: Upon reflection, he realized that if Mr. Fool’s seal hadn’t triggered or Termiboros hadn’t activated it, his eyes might not have been the only casualties.
unit.target: Reflecto, intellexit: nisi sigillum Domini Stulti excitum esset aut Termiboros eum non activasset, oculi eius non solum laesiones patiri debuissent.

unit.source: Wiping the tip of his nose, Lumian felt moistness and caught the unmistakable scent of rust.
unit.target: Naris terens, Lumian humiditatem sensit et odor ferrugineus inconfusus cepit.

unit.source: In a surprisingly good mood, he quipped, “Luckily, it seems what’s flowing down is blood, not brain matter.”
unit.target: In animo pro certo laeto, iocose inquit: “Felix, videtur quod deorsum fluens sanguis sit, non materia cerebri.”

unit.source: He rejoiced in surviving the ordeal.
unit.target: Gaudebat quod periculum superaverat.

unit.source: Despite the tragic state of his head, Lumian’s body remained relatively unharmed, albeit a bit drained.
unit.target: Non obstante tragoedia capitis eius, corpus Lumiani relative intactum permansit, quamquam paulo exhauritum.

unit.source: Gripping the edge of the bed, Lumian pulled himself up.
unit.target: Latus lecti prehendens, Lumian se erexit.

unit.source: In a state of blindness and impaired smell, he relied on the Hunter’s instinct, navigating through his turf with a mental map.
unit.target: In caecitate et olfactu debilitato, ad instinctum Venatoris confugit, per terram suam mente delineata iter faciens.

unit.source: Bypassing furniture, he reached the living room and knocked on the servant’s door.
unit.target: Supellectilem praeteriens, ad conclave pervenit et ianuam servi pulsavit.

unit.source: “Yes, what’s the matter?” Startled, Lugano hastily opened the door, dressed in a cotton shirt and underpants that served as makeshift pajamas, fearing a repeat of the terrifying encounter with Father Montserrat.
unit.target: “Ita, quid agitur?” Perterrito, Lugano festinanter ianuam aperuit, indutus camisiae cotoni et subbraccis, quae ut temporaria pyjama fungebantur, metuens ne iterum incubi terribiles cum Patre Montserrat occurrerent.

unit.source: Under the crimson moonlight, he saw Lumian’s blood‐streaked face and empty blood‐red eyes filled with shattered fragments.
unit.target: Sub luna rubra, vidit faciem Lumiani sanguine striatam et oculos rubros vacuos, fractis particulis implutos.

unit.source: “Wh-what happened?” Lugano stammered, bewildered.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” titubante, Lugano obstupescens inquit.

unit.source: Who had beaten his employer to such a state?
unit.target: Quis dominum eius ad talem statum percussit?

unit.source: Who could inflict such harm upon his employer?
unit.target: Quis tali laesione dominum eius laedere posset?

unit.source: Why not teleport away from this perilous situation?
unit.target: Cur non statim e hac periculosa re discesseret?

unit.source: Lumian calmly pointed at his eyes.
unit.target: Lumian placide ad oculos suos demonstravit.

unit.source: “Treat them.”
unit.target: Cura eas.

unit.source: “Alright,” Lugano responded subconsciously, then added awkwardly, “With the eyeballs in such a state, there’s no way of treatment. We can only find a suitable transplant.”
unit.target: “Recte,” Lugano subconscius respondit, deinde inepte addens: “Cum bulbi oculi tali statu sint, curae via nulla existit. Tantum substitutum opportunum inveniendum est.”

unit.source: Lumian, enduring the pain, calmly stated, “No need. Just stop the bleeding and ease the pain.”
unit.target: Lumian, dolorem ferens, placide dixit: “Nihil est opus; sola sanguinis effusio sistere et dolor leniendus.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Lugano didn’t dare argue, following his employer’s instructions.
unit.target: “Recte.” Lugano non ausus est dissentire, praecepta domini sequens.

unit.source: He extended his shimmering left palm.
unit.target: Manum sinistram nitidam extendit.

unit.source: Upon contact and a simple use of a scalpel, Lumian felt a refreshing sensation in his eyes.
unit.target: Contactu et simplici scalpro usus, Lumian sensum refrigerii in oculis sensit.

unit.source: The pain became more bearable, though his vision remained absent.
unit.target: Dolor levior factus est, quamvis visio eius absens manebat.

unit.source: “You can go back to sleep,” Lumian waved dismissively, as if his loss of vision was inconsequential.
unit.target: “Redi ad somnum,” Lumian leviter exclamavit, quasi amissus visus nihil rei esset.

unit.source: With one hand in his pocket, he strolled past the Dutanese textbook on the carpet, settled into a recliner, and rocked it gently.
unit.target: Una manu in sinu, per librum Dutanensem in tapete positum ambulo, in lectum reclinatorem consedit, atque leniter eum oscillavit.

unit.source: Lugano watched in confusion and anxiety for a while before attempting to return to bed, unable to fall asleep.
unit.target: Lugano per aliquod tempus, in confusione et sollicita animo, observavit, antequam tentaret ad lectum redire, dormitum non ferens.

unit.source: When the morning sun bathed the sea’s edge, the Doctor abruptly rose from his bed, deciding to grab a cup of coffee for a pick‐me‐up.
unit.target: Cum sol matutinus limen maris illustravit, Medicus subito ex lecto surrexit, poculum caffeae capere decrevit ad animos reficiendos.

unit.source: Upon leaving the room, he witnessed his employer in motion.
unit.target: Exiens ex conclavi, dominum suum in motu conspexit.

unit.source: Lumian’s green eyes sparkled, showing no signs of injury.
unit.target: Oculi virides Lumiani micabant, nullas laesiones indicantes.

unit.source: “Y-you’re alright?” Lugano was bewildered.
unit.target: “Bene es?” Lugano, obstupescens, inquit.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a radiant smile, “That’s right.”
unit.target: Lumian radianti risu respondit: “Ita est.”

unit.source: “…” Lugano was momentarily speechless.
unit.target: “…” Lugano paulisper mutus fuit.

unit.source: How did my employer regenerate his eyeballs?
unit.target: Quomodo dominus meus oculos regeneravit?

unit.source: What kind of monster is this…
unit.target: Qualis monstrum hoc est…

unit.source: Is my role as his doctor merely to stop the bleeding and relieve the pain?
unit.target: Num officium meum ut medicus eius sit tantum sanguinis effusionem sistere et dolorem levare?

unit.source: Lumian paid no heed to the servant’s psychological turmoil.
unit.target: Lumian non attendit animi turbam servi.

unit.source: He returned to the master bedroom, drew back the curtains, laid out the paper, and picked up a dark‐black fountain pen.
unit.target: Rediit ad cubiculum magistri, cortinas retrahevit, chartam explicavit, et calamus atri nigri elexit.

unit.source: I’m still not cautious enough… He sighed suddenly.
unit.target: Non adhuc satis cautus sum… Subito suspiravit.

unit.source: After heeding the ice‐blue‐eyed Demons’ warning and preparing to depart Hanth Island with the Berries, Lumian refrained from promptly writing to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Postquam monitionem daemonum oculis glacies caeruleis habentium auscultavit et paratus erat Insulam Hanth cum Berries relinquere, Lumian celeriter ad Dominam Magicam scribere non statuit.

unit.source: He intended to observe the aftermath and wait until they were safely away from the port.
unit.target: Propositum habebat eventus observare et exspectare, donec a portu tuto recessissent.

unit.source: Unexpectedly, he had experienced such a terrifying and dangerous dream last night!
unit.target: Inopinatius, talem somnium terribile et periculosum nocte praeterita experiebatur!

unit.source: Initially suspecting that a Demon with ice‐blue eyes had lost control and covertly influenced him, Lumian later speculated that he might have been subtly corrupted when he observed the blood‐colored Demon and the pitch‐black liquid through the Mystery Prying Glasses.
unit.target: Initio suspiciens daemonem oculis glacies caeruleis vim suam amittere et tacite influere, postea Lumian coniectavit se fortasse subtiliter corruptum esse, cum daemonem sanguineo colore et nigerrimum liquorem per specula inquisitiva mysteria viderat.

unit.source: The corruption lay dormant until he slept, manifesting fully in his dream.
unit.target: Corrumpatio quiescebat, donec dormivit, et in somnio plene se ostendebat.

unit.source: Focusing his thoughts, he detailed everything witnessed and heard on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Cogitationibus suis intentis, omnia in Insula Hanth conscripta et audita singillatim enarravit.

unit.source: He replaced the name Naboredisley with the term Love Incantation.
unit.target: Nomen Naboredisley verbo “Incantatio Amoris” substituit.

unit.source: Concluding the letter, Lumian wrote sincerely, “Perhaps I’ve encountered too many Demons recently. I feel like I’ve accumulated too much corruption and want to undergo treatment.”
unit.target: Epistulam concludens, Lumian sincero animo scribit: “Forsitan nuper nimis multos daemones expertus sim; videor nimis multam corruptelam congregasse et curam pati velle.”

unit.source: Following that, Lumian conducted a ritual, summoning the doll messenger, and handed over the folded letter.
unit.target: Postea, Lumian ritu perfunctus, nuntium pupae evocavit, et epistulam plicatam tradidit.

unit.source: Accepting the letter with its right hand, the doll messenger covered its nose with its left palm and exclaimed, “You stepped on the world’s stinkiest thing!”
unit.target: Epistulam dextro manu recipiens, nuntius pupae, sinistra manu nasum operiens, exclamat: “Calcavisti rem mundi maxime foetidissimam!”

unit.source: “It stinks! It stinks!”
unit.target: Fetet! Fetet!

unit.source: “So dirty, so dirty!”
unit.target: Tam sordida, tam sordida!

unit.source: Swiftly grasping the letter between two fingers, the doll messenger vanished from the room.
unit.target: Celeriter epistulam inter duo digitos prehendens, nuntius pupae ex conclavi evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian waited briefly, but with no immediate response from Madam Magician, he decided to seek “treatment” elsewhere.
unit.target: Lumian brevi exspectavit, sed responsum immediate a Domina Magica non receptum, statuit alibi “curam” quaerere.

unit.source: His destination was the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother in Port Hanth, where he had visited the day before.
unit.target: Destinatio eius erat cathedralis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in Portu Hanth, quam die praecedente visitaverat.

unit.source: In the early morning, before the commencement of work, numerous believers gathered to listen to the preaching.
unit.target: Mane, ante initium operis, multi fideles congregati sunt ad praedicationem audiendam.

unit.source: The preacher, the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman from yesterday, expounded on a specific doctrine from the Holy Scripture.
unit.target: Praedicator, clericus oculis glacies caeruleis heri notus, doctrinam certam ex Sacra Scriptura enarravit.

unit.source: The concept that good and evil emanated from the same source, making them inseparable, was discussed.
unit.target: Conceptus, quod bonum et malum ex eodem fonte emanarent, unde inseparabiles fierent, disputabatur.

unit.source: The sermon emphasized promoting good and suppressing evil.
unit.target: Praedicatio bonum promovendi et malum reprimendi extollita erat.

unit.source: Isn’t it a little ironic to have this coming from a Demon like you? Lumian criticized and sat in the first row, listening casually.
unit.target: Nonne parum ironicum est hoc a daemon tali, ut te? Lumian reprehendens in prima fila consedit, leviter audiens.

unit.source: He soon sensed the cathedral’s vibrant vitality.
unit.target: Mox cathedralis vitalitatem vigentem sensit.

unit.source: Vegetation flourished, and mushrooms quietly sprouted.
unit.target: Vegetatio floruit, et fungi tacite germinaverunt.

unit.source: The scent of wheat and milk provided a calming atmosphere.
unit.target: Odor tritici et lactis ambitum tranquillum afferebat.

unit.source: Unconsciously, Lumian realized that his life had gained intensity.
unit.target: Inopinato, Lumian sensit vitam suam maiorem intensitatem adeptam esse.

unit.source: Each of the orthodox Churches has its own merits… he sighed silently.
unit.target: Unaquaeque Ecclesia orthodoxa sua bona habet… ille silentio suspiravit.

unit.source: After five to six minutes, the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman concluded his preaching and approached Lumian with a warm smile.
unit.target: Post quinque ad sex minuta, clericus oculis glacies caeruleis praedicationem finivit et, cum amabili risu, ad Lumian accessit.

unit.source: “Young people who are willing to listen to advice always have a bright future.
unit.target: Iuvenes, qui consilium auscultare parati sunt, semper futurum clarum habent.

unit.source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!

unit.source: Lumian observed the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman retracting his raised hands.
unit.target: Lumian vidit clericum oculis glacies caeruleis, qui manus elevatas recipiebat.

unit.source: Is he hinting that it’s “satisfied” that I stopped inquiring, exploring the forest, and searching for someone with ice‐blue eyes since noon yesterday? Lumian considered, then looked at the clergyman before speaking.
unit.target: Num insinuat se satisfactum esse quod desierim quaerere, silvam explorare, atque aliquem cum oculis glacies caeruleis, ex meridie heri, invenire? Lumian cogitavit, deinde ad clericum spectavit antequam loqui coepit.

unit.source: “However, I had a terrifying dream last night and nearly died from it.”
unit.target: “Attamen, heri nocte somnium terribile habevi et prope ex eo mortuus sum.”

unit.source: “What dream?” the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman inquired warmly.
unit.target: “Quod somnium?” clericus oculis glacies caeruleis calide quaesivit.

unit.source: “Bishop, how should I address you?” Lumian asked, deferring from providing an immediate answer.
unit.target: “Episcopus, quomodo te vocare debeam?” Lumian quaesivit, moram capiens praesens responsum dare.

unit.source: “Newman,” the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman announced its name in human society.
unit.target: “Newman,” proclamat clericus oculis glacies caeruleis, nomen suum in societate humana.

unit.source: Lumian briefly recounted the blood‐colored Demon in his dream, the pitch‐black liquid, the blurry figure, and the branches and tree warts.
unit.target: Lumian brevi relatus est daemonem sanguineo colore in somnio suo, liquorem nigerrimum, figuram nebulosam, ac ramos et verrucas arborum.

unit.source: He didn’t delve into the final injuries he had suffered.
unit.target: Non enarravit vulnera ultima quae passa fuerat.

unit.source: Bishop Newman listened quietly, gazing at Lumian for a few seconds.
unit.target: Episcopus Newman silentio auscultavit, et per paucos secundos ad Lumian intuebatur.

unit.source: “Are you willing to listen to my preaching?”
unit.target: “Esne paratus praedicationem meam audire?”

unit.source: “Sure,” Lumian agreed, curious about what the Ice‐blue‐eyed Demon had to say.
unit.target: “Certe,” Lumian consentivit, curiosus quid daemon oculis glacies caeruleis dicere haberet.

unit.source: Newman flipped open the Holy Bible in his arms and spoke in a magnetic voice, “There are two Abysses.
unit.target: Newman Biblicam Sacram in brachiis suis aperuit et voce magnetica inquit: “Sunt duo abissi.

unit.source: One is material, and the entrance is somewhere in the real world.
unit.target: Unus est materialis, et introitus alicubi in mundo reali consistit.

unit.source: The other is spiritual, and the entrance is deep in everyone’s hearts.
unit.target: Alter est spiritualis, et introitus altus in corde omnium insidet.

unit.source: Sometimes, these two Abysses are separated, but most of the time, they’re one.
unit.target: Aliquando, hi duo abissi dividentur, sed plerumque unum videntur.

unit.source: “Good intentions and evil intentions come from the same source.
unit.target: Bonae et malae intentiones eodem fonte oriuntur.

unit.source: It’s inevitable for us to harbor evil thoughts like jealousy, hatred, destruction, greed, harm, and arrogance.
