unit.target: Ineluctabiliter nobis evenit malas cogitationes sustentare, ut invidia, odium, destructio, avaritia, laesio, et superbia.

unit.source: This is normal, not sinful.
unit.target: Hoc normale est, non peccaminosum.

unit.source: “However, if we act on jealousy, hatred, greed, and arrogance, killing someone—our souls will gradually sink into the Abyss.
unit.target: Attamen, si invidia, odium, avaritiam, et superbiam aggrediemur, aliquem interficientes, animae nostrae paulatim in abissum labefactabuntur.

unit.source: “When the time comes, one can only repent to the Mother, just like this.
unit.target: Cum tempus venit, solum possumus Matri paenitere, hoc modo.

unit.source: “Merciful Mother, I have fallen into the Abyss of evil…”
unit.target: “Miseranda Mater, in abissum mali caderim…”

unit.source: Lumian listened quietly, grasping the essence of Bishop Newman’s words.
unit.target: Lumian silentio auscultavit, essentiam verborum Episcopi Newman capiens.

unit.source: He acknowledged his mistake rooted in arrogance.
unit.target: Errorem suum, in superbia radicatum, agnovit.

unit.source: His earlier ventures, marked by a proactive approach and a lack of major problems, had led him to underestimate the concealed perils of high-level matters.
unit.target: Praeterita incepta, proactiva mente et defectu maximi incommodi insignita, eum ad pericula celata rerum gravium subestimanda duxerunt.

unit.source: Standing up, Lumian raised his hands.
unit.target: Stans, Lumian manus suas attollit.

unit.source: “I understand. Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
unit.target: “Intelligo. Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

unit.source: Newman nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Newman cum satisfactio annuit.

unit.source: Returning to the Berries, Lumian read the reply, neatly folded into a square.
unit.target: Rediens ad Berries, Lumian responsum legit, in quadratum arcte plicatum.

unit.source: The letter contained spirit world coordinates and a concise directive: “Put an end to the matter on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Epistula coordinata mundi spiritualis et mandatum concisum continebat: “Exstinguite rem in Insula Hanth.

unit.source: Find time to seek treatment here.”
unit.target: Invenite tempus hic ad curationem quaerendam.”

unit.source: 629 Corruption Removal
unit.target: 629 Remotio Corruptionis

unit.source: Madam Magician had not confirmed Lumian’s speculation or delved into the deeper truth of Hanth Island’s Demon legends.
unit.target: Domina Magica speculationem Luminiani non confirmavit nec veritatem profundam fabularum daemonum Insulae Hanth perscrutata est.

unit.source: Lumian realized that this likely involved something he shouldn’t pry into at the moment, or perhaps it was best not to understand until the accumulated corruption was eliminated.
unit.target: Lumian intellexit hoc probabiliter implicare aliquid, in quo non oportuit eum interim explorare, aut fortasse melius erat non cognoscere, donec corruptio cumulata deleatur.

unit.source: Does “find time” imply that I can go whenever I want, disregarding the healer’s schedule?
unit.target: Num "tempus invenire" significat me posse ire quovis tempore, agenda curantis neglegendo?

unit.source: Has Madam Magician foreseen that there won’t be any issues?
unit.target: Num Domina Magica praevidit nullas difficultates futuras esse?

unit.source: Lumian clutched the paper with the spirit world’s coordinates and activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Lumian charta cum indicibus mundi spirituum prehendit et notam nigram in dextra humero suo activavit.

unit.source: His figure vanished from the Berries, navigating through the swirling chaos of colors.
unit.target: Figura eius ex Berries evanuit, per turbam colorum gyrantium navigans.

unit.source: Occasionally, he felt inexplicable gazes and caught glimpses of indescribable forms.
unit.target: Interdum sensit oculos inexplicabiles et conspexit species ineffabiles.

unit.source: After an unknown period, Lumian arrived at the location corresponding to the spirit world’s coordinates and stepped out.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus ignotum, Lumian ad locum, qui indicibus mundi spirituum congruebatur, pervenit et exiit.

unit.source: Before him stood a towering dome, illuminated by bright glass windows, with a mural depicting an epic scene.
unit.target: Ante eum stabat cupola excelsa, claris vitrei fenestris illuminata, cum murale scaenam epicam depingentem.

unit.source: In the midst of the hall, Lumian noticed a ball of sunlight.
unit.target: In media aula, Lumian globum solis animadvertit.

unit.source: Realization struck, prompting him to approach.
unit.target: Repentina conscientia eum percussit, idque ad appropinquandum impulsit.

unit.source: As he walked, the sunlight seemed to “spread” over, banishing shadows and darkness wherever it touched.
unit.target: Dum ambulabat, solis lumen videbatur se diffundere, expulsans umbras et tenebras quotcumque attigeret.

unit.source: Soon, Lumian found himself enveloped in the sunlight.
unit.target: Mox, Lumian se in lumine solari involutum invenit.

unit.source: Suddenly, it felt as if pure sunlight pierced through his skin, flesh, bones, and internal organs, exposing his soul.
unit.target: Subito, videbatur quasi sol purus percuteret cutem eius, carnem, ossa atque visceras, animam eius revelans.

unit.source: Bits of illusory black gas were expelled from his soul by the sunlight, portraying various of Lumian’s expressions–ferocious, pained, pleading, or intimidating.
unit.target: Particulae gasi nigri illusorii ex anima eius a lumine solari expulsae sunt, diversas effigiæ Luminiani repraesentantes – feroces, dolentes, supplicantes, aut terribiles.

unit.source: Within seconds, the black gas dissipated under the purifying sunlight.
unit.target: Per paucos secundos, gas niger sub lumine purganti evanuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian felt his heart throb, and his left chest burned.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian cor eius pulsare sensit, et pectus sinistrum ardere videbatur.

unit.source: The blazing sunlight appeared to expel and purify everything in its path.
unit.target: Lumen solis ardentis videbatur omnia in suo itinere expellere atque purgare.

unit.source: Amidst the agonizing heartache, Lumian sensed a change in the seal on his left chest, as if it was concealing itself, synchronizing with the sunlight.
unit.target: Inter dolorem cordis acri, Lumian mutationem in sigillo pectoris sinistri sensit, quasi ipse se celare conaretur, sole synchronice congruens.

unit.source: However, before the attempt could fully succeed, the sunlight took the initiative to stop, receding like a tide into the depths of the hall.
unit.target: Attamen, antequam conatus plene succederet, lumen solare inceptum cepit ut sisteret, revideret ut aestus in profundum aulae.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly returned to his usual state. Aside from the lingering discomfort in his heart, he felt significantly more at ease, as if he had suddenly caught the morning breeze and glimpsed the sunrise after an extended period of oppressive darkness.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter ad statum suum rediit. Praeter remanentem dolorem cordis, multo tranquillus se sensit, quasi subito flabra matutina cepisset et ortum solis post longum tempus opprimi tenebrarum intueretur.

unit.source: His attention was drawn to a tall man in a simple white robe standing in the depths of the hall.
unit.target: Attentio eius ad virum altum in veste alba simplici, qui in profundis aulae stabat, directa est.

unit.source: Observing the man, Lumian estimated him to be around 22 or 23 years old, towering at over two meters with an imposing aura.
unit.target: Observans virum, Lumian aestimavit eum annos XXII vel XXIII habere, plus quam duo metra altitudinis cum aspectu imponente praedito.

unit.source: Despite his height, he exuded a calm temperament, and his brownish-yellow hair was neatly styled.
unit.target: Non obstante altitudine, tranquillitatem animi efferebat, et capilli eius fusco‑flavi rite dispositi erant.

unit.source: “The residual corruption on you has been cleared,” the tall man spoke in ancient Feysac.
unit.target: "Corruptio residua in te expurgata est," vir altus in lingua antiqua Feysac locutus est.

unit.source: Lumian had a suspicion and inquired, “Are you Mr. Sun?”
unit.target: Lumian suspicatus est et interrogavit, "Esne Dominus Sol?"

unit.source: “Yes,” the young and tall man responded politely, devoid of arrogance or impatience.
unit.target: "Ita," respondit vir juvenis et altus comiter, carens superbia aut impatiens.

unit.source: He’s actually so young, but one can’t judge his age from his appearance… Lumian expressed his gratitude without delving into further questions.
unit.target: Revera, ille tam iuvenis est, sed ex specie eius aetatem iudicare non potest… Lumian gratiam suam expressit, ulteriora interroganda non faciens.

unit.source: Indicating towards the hall’s exit, Lumian asked, “Can I go out for a walk?”
unit.target: Exitu ad aulam indicans, Lumian rogavit, "Licetne mihi ambulare exire?"

unit.source: Though unaware of his location, the murals suggested it was an essential cathedral of the Church of The Fool.
unit.target: Quamquam locum suum ignorabat, picturae indicabant eam esse cathedralem essentialem Ecclesiae Stulti.

unit.source: Lumian deduced that the Major Arcana card holder, The Sun, held a prominent position in the Church, or perhaps even the top position.
unit.target: Lumian coniecerat tenentem tabulae Majoris Arcanae, Sol, locum praeclarum in Ecclesia habere, aut fortasse etiam supremum honoris locum.

unit.source: “Sure.” Major Arcana The Sun nodded.
unit.target: "Certe," annuit Majoris Arcana, Sol.

unit.source: Observing the Church of The Fool’s etiquette, Lumian pressed his hand to his chest and bowed before turning to exit the hall.
unit.target: Ecclesiae Stulti morem observans, Lumian manum ad pectum suum adpressit et inclinavit antequam aulam exire constituit.

unit.source: Once outside, the world teemed with life. Voices and figures surrounded him.
unit.target: Postquam exiit, mundus vita repleta erat. Voces et figuras eum circumdederunt.

unit.source: His initial thought: Did I accidentally step into a land of giants?
unit.target: Prima cogitatio eius: Num forte in terram gigantum casu ingressus sum?

unit.source: The shortest individuals on the street were at least 1.89 meters tall, with occasional figures reaching three to four meters.
unit.target: Minimi homines in via erant saltem 1.89 metra altitudinis, cum aliquando figurae ad tres aut quattuor metra pervenire videbantur.

unit.source: Clad in white shirts, black trench coats, and half top hats, the men carried canes resembling spears, emitting an inexplicable sense of absurdity.
unit.target: Induti tunicis albis, loricibus atris, et semi‑pileis, viri baculos similes telis gerebant, inexplicabilem sensum absurditatis emittens.

unit.source: Even the ladies matched the towering height, mostly opting for flexibility in long pants rather than skirts.
unit.target: Etiam mulieres altitudinem imponentem aequabant, plerumque longas bracas potius quam stolas praeferentes.

unit.source: Lumian surveyed the area, his gaze traversing doors exceeding four meters in height.
unit.target: Lumian circumspexit, oculis per ianuas plus quam quattuor metra alta peragrantes.

unit.source: For a moment, he fell silent, feeling like a newborn in this peculiar environment.
unit.target: Per momentum, silentium cepit, se quasi neonatum in hoc insolitum ambitu sentiens.

unit.source: However, this realization only briefly dampened his mood for exploration.
unit.target: Attamen, haec cognitio breviter animum eius ad explorationem afflixit.

unit.source: Of course, it was only a brief moment.
unit.target: Scilicet, solum momentum breve fuit.

unit.source: Trier, Trocadéro, at the entrance of a grape manor.
unit.target: Trier, Trocadéro, ad introitum villae uvarum.

unit.source: Franca clarified to the valet that her purpose was to visit Madame Clarice, and he stepped aside without guiding her.
unit.target: Franca servi declaravit propositum suum esse Madaminam Claricem visitare, et ille se recedens abiit sine ut eam duceret.

unit.source: His stance implied that she knew the way and could proceed independently.
unit.target: Habitus eius insinuabat eam viam scire et seipsam independenter pergere posse.

unit.source: Undeterred, Franca followed the path ingrained in her memory, arriving at the circular pavilion nestled among the grape trees.
unit.target: Intrepida, Franca viam in memoria insitam secuta est, ad pavilionem circularem inter arbores uvarum delatam perveniens.

unit.source: Demoness of Black Clarice, adorned in a black court dress, was seated there.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice, in veste atrā curiali ornata, ibi sedebat.

unit.source: “Good morning, Your Excellency Clarice,” Franca greeted warmly, openly admiring her beautiful face and slightly sorrowful demeanor.
unit.target: "Bonum mane, Clarice, Vestra Excellentia," Franca calide salutavit, aperte faciem eius pulcherrimam et modicum lugubrem habitum admirans.

unit.source: Demoness of Black Clarice nodded slightly and inquired, “Has there been progress in the Mirror People investigation?”
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice leviter annuit et interrogavit, "Fuitne progressus in inquisitione Populi Specularis?"

unit.source: Franca, not in a rush to respond, met Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes and remarked, “Is Browns not present?”
unit.target: Franca, non festinans respondere, oculos Clarice obscuri‑cinerei convenit et dixit, "Nonne adest Browns?"

unit.source: “She’s not my lady’s maid. She attends to her own matters,” Demoness of Black Clarice replied succinctly.
unit.target: "Non est ancilla dominae meae. Suis rebus operatur," daemonissa Nigra Clarice breviter respondit.

unit.source: “Not at the Red House Café or the hunting ground beside the forest either,” Franca observed the air’s fragrance and chose to engage in conversation with the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: "Ne in Caffenea Domus Rubrae neque in venatione iuxta silvam," Franca odorem aeris observavit et elegit cum daemonissa Nigra colloqui.

unit.source: “She has other matters to attend to,” Clarice evaded delving into Browns’ affairs.
unit.target: "Alia negotia habet curanda," Clarice evasit in rebus Browns investigandis.

unit.source: Reluctantly, Franca recounted the details of the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny’s situation, from the initial sensing of the Mirror World Fragment’s tremors after the play, substituting herself as the person involved.
unit.target: Dole, Franca enarravit singula de re Ministri Industriae, Moran Avigny, ex initio sensu tremorum Fragmenti Mundi Specularis post ludum, se substituens in persona implicata.

unit.source: Clarice remained silent, her eyes lowered in contemplation.
unit.target: Clarice silentium tenuit, oculis in meditatione demissis.

unit.source: Franca didn’t rush the Demoness of Black. Her gaze flickered between the deep gray of her eyes, the fairness of her delicate skin, the curves that stirred the soul, and the unnaturally alluring red lips.
unit.target: Franca daemonissam Nigram non festinavit. Oculi eius inter obscurum cinereum oculorum, candidam cutem delicatam, lineas animam excitantes, et labra rubea insolitum allicientes micabantur.

unit.source: She knew this wasn’t a good idea, but she couldn’t rein in her impulses. Her heart gradually heated up, and her thoughts got a bit muddled. Her mouth dried, forcing her to purse her lips intermittently.
unit.target: Sciebat hoc non esse bonum consilium, sed impulsus suos reprimere non poterat. Cor eius paulatim calefaciebatur, et cogitationes in turbationem redactae erant. Os eius siccum factum est, compelens eam ut intermissionibus labra contraheret.

unit.source: Dammit! Why am I feeling this way right now?
unit.target: Heu! Cur hoc modo me nunc sentio?

unit.source: While humans as animals can be susceptible to instincts, I’ve always maintained composure during serious discussions and encounters with high‑ranking figures.
unit.target: Dum homines, ut animalia, instinti susceptibiles sunt, ego semper constantiam servavi in gravibus disputationibus et congressionibus cum personis summi gradus.

unit.source: At most, I’ve held admiration… Could it be that the Demoness of Black is intentionally radiating her charm to draw me in? Or is there another explanation?
unit.target: Maxime, solum admirationem feci... Num daemonissa Nigra conscie suam venustatem radiare censet ut me attrahat? An alia ratio existit?

unit.source: Yes, the lingering corruption from the Demon incident must be affecting me! Though it’s subtle and doesn’t manifest in my daily life, it’s making it difficult for me to control my desires in the presence of a high‑ranking Demoness known for her feminine allure. As a result, I find myself slipping into an aroused state…
unit.target: Ita, residua corruptio ex incidente daemonum me afficere debet! Quamquam subtilis est et in vita cotidiana non manifestatur, difficile mihi reddit cupiditates meas regere in praesentia daemonissae summi gradus, nota ob venustatem feminam. Quam ob rem, me in statum excitatum labentem invenio...

unit.source: Franca gritted her teeth, refusing to succumb to the temptations of desire.
unit.target: Franca dentes stridens, tentationibus desiderii se tradere recusavit.

unit.source: Clarice looked up at her.
unit.target: Clarice ad eam respexit.

unit.source: “Has it been too long since you’ve experienced pleasure?”
unit.target: "Num diu praeteriit ex quo voluptatem percepisti?"

unit.source: “Not since my last lover passed away,” Franca replied truthfully, aware that the Demoness of Black referred to a specific kind of pleasure.
unit.target: "Non, ex quo ultimus amator meus mortuus est," Franca veraciter respondit, conscius quod daemonissa Nigra ad speciem voluptatis specialem referret.

unit.source: She explained, “As I mentioned earlier, to get close to Moran Avigny’s illegitimate daughter, I used a mystical item. Unfortunately, it had a side effect, leading to encounters with Demons and other evil entities for a transaction. I was somewhat affected.”
unit.target: Explicavit, "Ut ante dixi, ad accedendum ad filiam illegitimam Moran Avigny, rem mysticam usus sum. Infeliciter, ei effectus secundarius fuit, qui ad congressus cum daemonibus aliisque maleficis entitatibus pro transactione duxit. Paullo affecta fui."

unit.source: Clarice’s voice turned icy.
unit.target: Vox Clarice glaciali facta est.

unit.source: “Endurance is not a sustainable solution. Indulge yourself. Otherwise, the Demon pathway will become your nemesis.”
unit.target: "Patientia non est solutio sustinenda. Te indulge. Alioquin via daemonum tibi inimicus fiet."

unit.source: The Demoness of Black’s aura instantly shifted to a holy and dignified state, becoming inviolable.
unit.target: Aura daemonissae Nigrae statim in sanctam et dignam conditionem mutata est, inviolabile facta.

unit.source: Franca also sensed that she couldn’t entertain lascivious thoughts about such a captivating beauty.
unit.target: Franca quoque sensit se non posse cogitationes lascivias de tam captivante pulchritudine tenere.

unit.source: Her desires gradually subsided, and her mind cleared, breaking free from her aroused state.
unit.target: Desideria eius paulatim minuuntur, et mens eius purgata est, a statu excitatum liberata.

unit.source: Clarice redirected the conversation.
unit.target: Clarice sermonem redirexit.

unit.source: “You aim to deal with Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: "Visne te agere de Moran Avigny?"

unit.source: “He should be a crucial Mirror Person. If we can capture him or channel his spirit, we should uncover most of the Mirror People hidden in Trier. Madame, I seek your assistance,” Franca stated, laying out her thoughts.
unit.target: "Is maxime momenti persona specularis esse debet. Si eum capere aut spiritum eius adducere possimus, pleraque Populi Specularis in Trier latentis detegere debemus. Domina, auxilium tuum quaero," Franca enuntiavit.

unit.source: She avoided mentioning that Moran Avigny shared Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes and instead presented a color photo.
unit.target: Ea vitavit fateri quod Moran Avigny oculos Clarice cinereos obscuros haberet, sed potius imaginem coloratam exhibuit.

unit.source: Clarice nodded slightly and said, “You can now strategize your operation. I’ll assist during crucial moments, but for most scenarios, you must rely on yourself and the factions under your control.”
unit.target: Clarice leviter annuit et dixit, "Nunc consilium operationis tuae excogitare potes. Ego in momentis clavibus adiuvabo, sed in plurimis casibus in teipso et in factionibus sub tua potestate confidere debes."

unit.source: “No problem.” Franca didn’t conceal her excitement.
unit.target: "Nulla quaestio." Franca eius laetitiam non celavit.

unit.source: As she exited the vine‑surrounded circular pavilion, Demoness of Black Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes turned cold as she rose slowly.
unit.target: Exitu ex pavilionem circularem vineis circumdatum, oculi daemonissae Nigrae Clarice obscuri‑cinerei frigidi facti sunt, dum lente surrexit.

unit.source: In a brightly lit bar, Lumian clinked a beer glass, larger than his head, against the nearly three‑meter‑tall “giant” opposite him and gulped down the golden liquor.
unit.target: In taberna lucide illustrata, Lumian poculum cerevisiae, maius quam caput eius, contra "gigantem" paene trium metrorum altitudinis, qui adversus eum stabat, percussit et liquorem aureum ingurgitavit.

unit.source: Wiping the corners of his mouth, he chuckled.
unit.target: Angulos oris sui abstergens, risit.

unit.source: “So, this is the New City of Silver in the Bible.”
unit.target: "Ita, haec est Nova Urbs Argentea in Biblia."

unit.source: From the sermons he had heard, Lumian knew that the New City of Silver served as the headquarters of the Church of The Fool, situated in the Sonia Sea.
unit.target: Ex sermonibus quibus audierat, Lumian scivit Novam Urbem Argenteam esse sedem Ecclesiae Stulti, in Mari Sonia sita.

unit.source: It had been established by the surviving humans rescued by Gehrman Sparrow from the cursed continent of the Forsaken Land of the Gods.
unit.target: Ea constituta erat ab humanis superstitis a Gehrman Sparrow excussis ex continente maledicto Terrae Abiectarum Deorum.

unit.source: Unexpectedly, the surviving humans were towering figures, almost like giants!
unit.target: Inopinanter, homines superstites personae imponentes erant, paene ut gigantes!

unit.source: “That’s right. All the warriors here are ready to defend Mr. Fool’s Church at all times!” the nearly three‑meter‑tall giant expressed with satisfaction.
unit.target: "Recte." inquit gigantus paene trium metrorum altitudinis, "Omnes bellatores hic semper parati sunt Ecclesiam Domini Stulti defendere!"

unit.source: “You’re not bad. You worship the Angel of Redemption and believe in Mr. Fool. Just these two points alone makes us brothers!”
unit.target: "Non es malus. Angelum Redemptoris colis et in Domine Stulto credis. Haec duo tantum nos fratres faciunt!"

unit.source: He extended his right palm and slapped Lumian, nearly toppling him. It felt like a child encountering a brown bear’s paw.
unit.target: Manum dexteram extendit et Luminian percussit, fere illum corruperet. Simi similis fuit sensus, quasi puer manum ursi fusci contingens.

unit.source: Lumian forced a smile and inquired, “Can you share more about the Angel of Redemption’s deeds in the Forsaken Land of the Gods?”
unit.target: Lumian risum fingit et interrogavit, "Potesne amplius narrare de factis Angeli Redemptoris in Terra Abiecta Deorum?"

unit.source: 630 Day Tour
unit.target: Iter diurnum 630

unit.source: The nearly three‐meter‐tall giant expressed regret,
unit.target: Gigante, paene tres metra altus, paenitentiam expressit,

unit.source: “The six‐member council mandates that we can’t discuss matters not mentioned in the Holy Bible.
unit.target: “Consilium sex membrorum imperat ut de rebus, quae in Sancta Biblia non commemoratae sunt, non loqui possimus.

unit.source: As a believer of Mr. Fool, you must be familiar with the sermons and official statements.
unit.target: Ut credulus Domini Stulti, sermonibus et declarationibus officialibus notus esse debes.

unit.source: He planned to take advantage of the afternoon sun to stroll around New Silver City and teleport back to the Berries docked at Port Hanth in the evening.
unit.target: Eum consilium erat ut solis postmeridiani luce frueretur ambulans per Novam Urbem Argenteam, et vesperi ad Berries, quae in Portu Hanth fixa erant, celeriter rediret.

unit.source: In the sparsely populated yet unusually towering buildings, half-giants roamed.

unit.source: Every now and then, one or two “giants” standing over three meters tall could be spotted.

unit.target: Qui minus quam 1.8 metra erant, rarissimi erant, nisi cum vultu puerili.

unit.source: Lumian’s stature barely met the criteria, and his eyes quickly scanned the surroundings.
unit.target: Statura Lumiani vix conveniebat criteriis, et oculi eius celeriter circumspectabant.

unit.source: He observed turquoise vines snaking up the outer walls of certain houses.

unit.target: “Ita, fungi lactei,” respondit venditor semigigas sincere.

unit.source: You call that mushrooms?

unit.source: After walking more than ten meters, he brought the cup to his lips and took a sip.

unit.source: It tasted like milk!

unit.source: Just consider it a unique plant…

unit.source: Just consider it a unique plant…

unit.target: Cum tempus processisset, Lumian fungos observavit cuius odor carnes coctae, fungos qui piscis oluerent, et varias species fungorum peculiares.

unit.target: Ibi esse debent Res Sigillatae et personae formidabiles…

unit.source: Lumian diverted his attention and headed towards the spire, eager to explore the books passed down in the New City of Silver, a human settlement existing in the Forsaken Land of the Gods for thousands of years.

unit.target: Lumian se hospitem in regno gigantis sensit, dum per spatium amplexum et vix illuminatum incedebat.

unit.target: Custos bibliothecae, senex linteis indutus, spatium curabat.

unit.target: Etiam sedens, altitudinem Lumiani aequabat, et cutis eius paulo cinerea vestigia aetatis portabat.

unit.target: Lumian, non festinans licentiam ad suam explorationem quaerere, bibliothecam intravit et regulas in quolibet ordine armariorum librariorum positas sequebatur, quae ad partem librorum mythicorum ducebant.

unit.target: Digitum per librum veterem corio ligatum et aliud cum paginis recens scriptis cucurrit, eligens volumen narrans mythos creationis.

unit.source: Before the bookshelf, Lumian casually flipped through its pages, only to stuff the book back.
unit.target: Ante armarium librariarium, Lumian paginis leviter pervolvit, deinde librum iterum reponit.

unit.source: He couldn’t comprehend it!
unit.target: Id intellegere non potuit!

unit.source: The words were in Jotun!
unit.target: Verba in Jotun erant!

unit.source: This ancient language, associated with the Beyonder race of giants, possessed the ability to manipulate the forces of nature.
unit.target: Haec antiqua lingua, cum genere Beyonder gigantum coniuncta, facultatem vires naturae manipulandi habebat.

unit.source: Ranked alongside Dragonese, Elvish, and ancient Hermes, Jotun held significant importance in mysticism.
unit.target: Comparatus cum lingua Dragonese, Elvish, et antiquo Hermete, Jotun in mysticis momentum magnum habebat.

unit.source: Although Lumian had mastered ancient Hermes and Hermes, Jotun remained a language he recognized but hadn’t fully mastered.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian antiquam Hermetam adeptus erat, Jotun tamen lingua erat quam agnoverat sed plene non didicerat.

unit.source: He could barely decipher the title of the ancient book but couldn’t comprehend its contents.
unit.target: Titulum libri antiqui vix perscrutari potuit, sed eius contenta intellegere non potuit.

unit.source: A sweep of his gaze revealed a corresponding copy of the ancient book, this time written in ancient Feysac—a human language devoid of supernatural influence.
unit.target: Oculus eius, intuens, deprehendit exemplar congruum libri antiqui, hoc tempore in antiqua Feysac scriptum—lingua humana sine vi supernaturali.

unit.source: Joy surged within Lumian as he retrieved the soft-covered book and settled into the reading area near the window.
unit.target: Gaudium in Luminio effluit, cum librum tegumentum molli habentem recepisset et in area lectionis prope fenestram consedit.

unit.source: Throughout the entire process, no one intervened or issued a warning.
unit.target: Per totum processum, nemo intervenit nec monitionem edidit.

unit.source: <nulli>This library is entirely open to everyone. Even those not residing in the New City of Silver can peruse its contents, but borrowing seems to be off the table? Or perhaps, the knowledge on this level isn’t deemed confidential, Lumian mused, maintaining a steady pace.
unit.target: <nulli>Haec bibliotheca omnibus penitus aperta est. Etiam qui in Nova Urbe Argentea non habitant, eius contenta perlegi possunt, sed usus librorum videntur excludi? Vel fortasse, scientia in hoc gradu non censetur secreta, meditatusque Lumian constanter procedebat.

unit.source: He strolled past the section dedicated to Beyonder creatures, and his keen eyes snagged a book titled “Devilology.”
unit.target: Ambulans praeter partem creaturarum Beyonder dedicatam, oculi eius acuti librum titulatam “Devilology” deprehenderunt.

unit.source: <nulli>Devilology… Recalling recent encounters, Lumian snagged the corresponding copy.
unit.target: <nulli>Devilology… Meminens recentes occursus, Lumian exemplar congruum rapuit.

unit.source: In the reading area, he chose a spot shielded from direct sunlight yet bathed in ample illumination. Seated, he delved into the pages of “Devilology.”
unit.target: In area lectoria, locum elegit, qui a radicibus solis directis tutus sed luce opima illustratus esset; sedens, paginas “Devilologiae” perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: As he read, Lumian’s eyes widened, and his mouth hung slightly ajar.
unit.target: Dum legebat, oculi Lumiani dilatabantur, et os eius leviter apertum remainerat.

unit.source: He murmured to himself, <nulli>Is it really acceptable to have this kind of knowledge available to the public?
unit.target: Murmuravit ad se, <nulli>Num re vera licitum sit talem scientiam populo praesto habere?

unit.source: Each piece of information was invaluable!
unit.target: Singula notitia inestimabilia erant!

unit.source: The “Devilology” book meticulously outlined the traits and behaviors of creatures from various species after transforming into Devils.
unit.target: Liber “Devilologiae” diligenter describebat notas et mores creaturarum ex variis speciebus, postquam in Diabolos transformatae erant.

unit.source: It also provided detailed analyses of Devils with distinct personalities within the same species.
unit.target: Praeterea praebebat analysim accuratam Diabolorum cum personalitatibus distinctis intra eandem speciem.

unit.source: For those potentially facing Beyonders of the Devil pathway in combat, the value of this book rivaled that of a potent Grade 2 Sealed Artifact or its corresponding mystical item.
unit.target: Pro iis qui fortasse in pugna contra viam Diabolicam Beyonder contendunt, pretium huius libri aequipollens erat potentissimo Artefacto Sealed Gradus II aut eius mystico simili.

unit.source: <nulli>Moreover, how did the New City of Silver come by such knowledge?
unit.target: <nulli>Praeterea, quomodo Nova Urbs Argentea talem scientiam adeptus est?

unit.source: It’s improbable they could compile creature illustrations without dispatching hundreds of Devils…
unit.target: Improbabile est ut imagines creaturarum congregare possent sine mittendo centena Diaboli…

unit.source: Could it be that the half-giants and giants here are Devil Hunters?
unit.target: Num hic semigiantes et gigantes Diaboli venatores sint?

unit.source: Perhaps, in ancient times, when Devils were more active, they shared information with other factions?
unit.target: Fortasse, temporibus antiquis, cum Diaboli magis activos essent, notitias cum aliis factionibus communicabant?

unit.source: Lumian grew more alarmed as he read on.
unit.target: Lumian magis consternatus est dum perlegebat.

unit.source: Midway through, he massaged his throbbing temples, sensing a rapid depletion of his spirituality.
unit.target: In media parte, templa pulsantia massavit, sentiens rapidum spiritualitatis decrementum.

unit.source: Lumian temporarily closed “Devilology,” intending to explore the creation myths of the New City of Silver and take a well-deserved break.
unit.target: Lumian, temporarie “Devilologiam” clausit, intendens mythos creationis Novi Urbis Argenteae explorare et requiem meritam capere.

unit.source: From the very outset, the creation myth read:
unit.target: Ab initio, mythus creationis legebatur:

unit.source: “The omnipotent and omniscient god created everything before slipping into a profound slumber.
unit.target: “Deus omnipotens et omniscient, omnia creavit, antequam in profundum soporem incidisset.

unit.source: “Among the mythical races He brought into being, Giant King Aurmir, Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, Elf King Soniathrym, Vampire Ancestor Lilith, Devil King Farbauti, Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, Mutant King Kvastir, and King of Demonic Wolves Flegrea emerged as potent and crazy beings. They partitioned the authority left by the Lord, transforming into ancient deities governing the sky, land, sea, reality, the spirit world, and the astral realm…”
unit.target: “Inter gentes mythicas quas ille creavit, exstiterunt: Rex Gigantum Aurmir, Draco Imaginationis Ankewelt, Rex Elforum Soniathrym, Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith, Rex Diabolicus Farbauti, Antecessor Phoenicis Gregrace, Rex Mutatus Kvastir, et Rex Luporum Daemoniacorum Flegrea, qui erant simul potentes ac insanissimi. Diviserunt auctoritatem a Domino relicta, transformantes se in deos antiquos, qui caelum, terram, mare, realitatem, mundum spirituum atque regnum astrale gubernabant…”

unit.source: Abruptly, a dull-skinned, slightly gray finger tapped a specific spot on the page.
unit.target: Subito, digitus cutis opacae et paulo cinerea in loco certo paginae pulsavit.

unit.source: An aged, raspy voice echoed.
unit.target: Vox senilis ac rauca resonavit.

unit.source: “Do not utter this name in any Beyonder language.”
unit.target: “Noli hoc nomen in qualibet lingua Beyonder pronuntiare.”

unit.source: Lumian looked up, surprised to find the library administrator, previously immersed in his books, standing beside him seemingly out of nowhere.
unit.target: Lumian oculos extulit, miratus ut administrator bibliothecae, antea in libris immersus, iuxta se stans quasi ex nihilo apparuisset.

unit.source: As a Hunter, Lumian remained oblivious!
unit.target: Ut venator, Lumian manebat inscius!

unit.source: Partly due to the lingering dizziness from reading “Devilology,” it showcased the library administrator’s proficiency in concealing both breath and movement, given his towering stature of more than three meters.
unit.target: Partim ob vertiginem manentem ex lectione “Devilologiae”, id ostendit peritiam administratoris bibliothecae in celando tam spiritum quam motum, propter staturam eius imponentem, plus quam tribus metris.

unit.source: Lumian redirected his attention to the name indicated by the library administrator.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit ad nomen ab administrator bibliothecae indicatum.

unit.source: “Devil Monarch Farbauti.”
unit.target: “Rex Diabolicus Farbauti.”

unit.source: Without awaiting Lumian’s inquiry, the library administrator, bearing giant-like traits, shifted his finger a few centimeters and remarked, “It’s advisable to avoid pronouncing this name in any Beyonder language as well.”
unit.target: Sine exspectando quaestionem Lumiani, administrator bibliothecae, cum indolis gigantum similis, digitum paucos centimetra commovens inquit, “Optimum est hoc nomen in qualibet lingua Beyonder non pronuntiare.”

unit.source: Lumian followed the motion of the finger, silently noting the corresponding name in his mind.
unit.target: Lumian motum digiti secutus, silentiter nomen congruum in mente sua notavit.

unit.source: “Vampire Ancestor Lilith.”
unit.target: “Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith.”

unit.source: “Why am I not allowed to read about it?” Lumian expressed his ignorance without reservation.
unit.target: “Cur mihi non licet de hoc legere?” inquit Lumian, ignorantiam suam sine reservatione exprimens.

unit.source: The library administrator spoke in a deep voice, “The Devil Monarch is still alive. This formidable ancient deity remains among the living.
unit.target: Administrator bibliothecae voce profunda locutus est, “Rex Diabolicus adhuc vivit. Hic formidolosus deus antiquus inter vivos manet.

unit.source: “And the Vampire Ancestor is suspected to be alive as well. In recent times, an individual in the city experienced disturbances after uttering the name ‘Lilith’ in Jotun. Although their life wasn’t at risk, they endured prolonged suffering.”
unit.target: “Et Antecessor Vampirorum etiam suspicatur vivus esse. Nuper, aliquis in urbe perturbationes passa est postquam nomen ‘Lilith’ in Jotun edixit; quamquam vita eius in discrimine non fuit, longum dolorem passus est.”

unit.source: <nulli>Ancient deities? Entities that once governed the world before the Ancient Sun God’s era? Lumian recalled fragments of his limited knowledge and inquired thoughtfully, “Did the Ancient Sun God rescue humanity from the dominion of these ancient deities?”
unit.target: <nulli>Dei antiqui? Entia quae olim mundum ante aetatem Antiqui Dei Solis rexerunt? Lumian fragmenta scientiae suae limitatae rememoravit et quaesivit, “Num Antiquus Deus Solis humanitatem a dominio horum deorum antiqui liberavit?”

unit.source: The library administrator, towering at more than three meters, turned to the last page and pointed.
unit.target: Administrator bibliothecae, qui plus quam tribus metris altus erat, ad ultimam paginam vertit et digitum indicavit.

unit.source: Lumian read the description:
unit.target: Lumian descriptionem legit:

unit.source: “The omnipotent and omniscient god stirred from slumber, rising from the earth to vanquish the ancient deities and reclaim His authorities.
unit.target: “Deus omnipotens et omniscient, ex sopore evigilatus, ex terra surrexit ut deos antiquos superaret et potestates suas redimiret.

unit.source: “Note: In the present era, the omnipotent and omniscient god is also known as the Ancient Sun God…”
unit.target: “Nota: In aetate praesentis, deus omnipotens et omniscient quoque notus est ut Antiquus Deus Solis…”

unit.source: <nulli>Indeed… Among the eight ancient deities, Devil Monarch Farbauti is still alive, Vampire Ancestor Lilith is suspected to be alive, and the rest have perished?
unit.target: <nulli>Revera… Inter octo deos antiquos, Rex Diabolicus Farbauti adhuc vivit, Antecessor Vampirorum Lilith etiam suspicatur vivus esse, et reliqui perierunt?

unit.source: Giant King Aurmir… Why does that name sound familiar?
unit.target: Rex Gigantum Aurmir… Cur hoc nomen mihi notum videtur?

unit.source: Ah, the provincial capital renowned for its red wine and champagne.
unit.target: Ah, caput provinciae, praeclarum vinum rubrum et spumantem habens!

unit.source: What ties does it share with the Giant King?
unit.target: Quae nexus cum Rege Gigantum coniunguntur?

unit.source: Lumian cautiously inquired, “Can these two names be pronounced in ordinary human language?”
unit.target: Lumian cum cautela quaesivit, “Possuntne haec duo nomina in lingua humana communi pronuntiari?”

unit.source: “The Vampire Ancestor’s is acceptable, but it’s advisable to refrain from attempting the Devil Monarch’s. You must exercise caution even in writing it,” responded the colossal library administrator.
unit.target: “Nomen Antecessoris Vampirorum licitum est, sed optimum est nomen Rex Diabolicus non pronuntiare; etiam in scriptura cautela adhibenda est,” respondit administrator bibliothecae colossalis.

unit.source: <nulli>Exercise caution even in writing…
unit.target: <nulli>Cave etiam in scriptione…

unit.source: Are all Demons like this?
unit.target: Num omnes Daemones ita sunt?

unit.source: Yes, the deity of the Devil pathway remains alive, an ancient being since the Second Epoch…
unit.target: Ita, deus viæ Diabolicæ adhuc vivit, ens antiquus ex Secunda Aetate.

unit.source: Lumian murmured, his heart stirred.
unit.target: Lumian murmurat, et cor eius commotum est.

unit.source: He retrieved a note with the Love Incantation from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Extraxit notam cum Incantatione Amoris ex sacculo viatoris sui.

unit.source: “Have you encountered this name before? I came across a Demon who identified itself as this. Much like the others, it cannot be spoken or written, only thought.”
unit.target: “Num antea hoc nomen tibi occurrit? Obviam Daemoni veni, qui se hoc nominavit. Similiter ceteris, neque dici neque scribi potest, sed tantum cogitari.”

unit.source: The library administrator accepted the note with a hand capable of engulfing Lumian’s head. His gaze swept over the name “Naboredisley.”
unit.target: Administrator bibliothecae notam accepit manu, qua caput Lumiani complecti posset; et oculi eius percurrerunt nomen “Naboredisley.”

unit.source: He lapsed into deep contemplation. After a minute or two, he silently retrieved a copy from a concealed location within the bookshelf.
unit.target: In altam meditationem cecidit. Post minuto vel duo, exemplar ex loco occulto intra armarium librariorum silentio extraxit.

unit.source: The book’s title read: “A Summary of Rumors and Hearsay Before the Cataclysm (1)”
unit.target: Titulus libri legebatur: “Compendium Rumorum et Fabulorum Ante Cataclysmum (1)”

unit.source: <nulli>What a simple name… Lumian observed as the library administrator opened the newly-acquired book, pointing at a particular line of text.
unit.target: <nulli>Quam simplex nomen… Lumian animadvertit, dum administrator bibliothecae librum nuper adeptum aperiebat et digitum ad lineam textus certam intendebat.

unit.source: “As anticipated, it’s right here.”
unit.target: “Ut exspectatum est, hic est.”

unit.source: Lumian fixed his gaze and read silently.
unit.target: Lumian oculos fixos tenuit et silentio legit.

unit.source: “After the Devil Monarch Farbauti led the Devils back to the Abyss, occasional rumors persisted of Demons enticing humans.
unit.target: “Postquam Rex Diabolicus Farbauti Diabolos ad Abyssum reduxit, rumores occasionales de daemonibus homines allicientibus perseveraverunt.

unit.source: “The Demons operated under the following names:
unit.target: “Daemones operabantur sub nominibus sequentibus:

unit.source: “Beelbubli, Almos, Samael, Lilatan, and Naboredisley.
unit.target: “Beelbubli, Almos, Samael, Lilatan, et Naboredisley.

unit.source: “A high-ranking Demon Hunter speculated that these names conceal the aliases of Devil Monarch Farbauti…”
unit.target: “Venator daemonum summi gradus coniectatus est has nomina alias Rex Diabolicus Farbauti celare…”

unit.source: <nulli>The Devil Monarch Farbauti’s alias? Lumian felt a jolt as a thin layer of sweat coated his back.
unit.target: <nulli>Alias Rex Diabolicus Farbauti? Lumian ictum sensit, cum tenuum stratum sudoris dorsum eius tegebat.

unit.source: <nulli>Could Naboredisley be the Devil Monarch?
unit.target: <nulli>Poteritne Naboredisley esse Rex Diabolicus?

unit.source: <nulli>The sealed blood-colored Demon was the Devil Monarch?
unit.target: <nulli>Daemon sanguineo colore sigillatus erat Rex Diabolicus?

unit.source: <nulli>No, it doesn’t seem likely. If it were a genuine ancient deity, catching just a glimpse of His form wouldn’t have resulted in my eyes exploding in a dream. I would have lost control immediately… Yes, perhaps Farbauti’s pseudonym is among these names, but it doesn’t necessarily mean Naboredisley is Him… Lumian wiped his forehead with his right hand, forcing a smile as he addressed the library administrator, “As a foreigner, am I truly allowed to read these books? The knowledge they contain is exceedingly precious.”
unit.target: <nulli>Non, verisimile non videtur. Si esset verus deus antiquus, solum eius formam intueri non fuisset causa, ut oculi mei in somnio explodescerent. Statim moderamen meum amissessem. Ita, fortasse pseudonymum Farbauti inter his nominibus est, sed non necesse significat Naboredisley eum esse. Lumian frontem manu dextra purgavit, subridetque fingens, et ad administrator bibliothecae locutus est: “Ut peregrinus, num vere mihi licetur hos libros legere? Scientia, quam continent, valde pretiosa est.”

unit.source: The library administrator responded calmly, “The Chief has already informed us that you are Mr. Fool’s Blessed.”
unit.target: Administrator bibliothecae respondit tranquille: “Praefectus iam nos certiorem fecit te esse Mr. Fool’s Blessed.”

unit.source: “Very well.” Lumian found it amusing.
unit.target: “Valde bene.” Lumian hoc risu delectavit.

unit.source: Apparently, not every foreigner could access this library.
unit.target: Apparet non omnes peregrini hanc bibliothecam accedere posse.

unit.source: The library administrator offered no further warnings. He took the book chronicling pre-Cataclysm rumors and departed from Lumian’s vicinity.
unit.target: Administrator bibliothecae nullas ulteriores monitiones edidit. Librum, qui rumores prae Cataclysmum chronicabat, accepit et a loco Lumiani discessit.

unit.source: Lumian continued to alternate between reading “Devilology” and “Creation Tales,” taking breaks as needed.
unit.target: Lumian inter legendum “Devilologiam” et “Fabulas Creationis” alternavit, intervalla capiens quando opus esset.

unit.source: As evening approached, he barely concluded both books and departed from the Twin Towers.
unit.target: Cum vesper appropinquavit, vix utrumque librum perfecit et a Geminis Turribus discessit.

unit.source: Releasing his compressed spirituality, Lumian teleported back to the Berries in Port Hanth.
unit.target: Dimittens spiritualitatem compressam, Lumian se ad Berries in Portu Hanth translatus est.

unit.source: Surveying the still-bright sky, Lumian confirmed that the investigation into Hanth Island’s Demon legends had reached its conclusion.
unit.target: Caelum adhuc refulgentem intuens, Lumian confirmavit investigationem de fabulis daemonum Insulae Hanth finitum esse.

unit.source: The matter delved into complexities beyond his reach.
unit.target: Res ad subtilitates extra eius potentiam pertinebat.

unit.source: He no longer hesitated about his next steps and plans.
unit.target: Non iam de suis propositis vacillabat.

unit.source: Since he hadn’t fully digested the Conspirer potion, he resolved to head to West Balam and seek out Hisoka. There, he would hunt to digest the potion and complete the advancement ritual!
unit.target: Cum nondum potum Conspiratoris plene absorverat, decrevit se versus Balam Occidentalem ire et Hisokam quaerere. Ibi venabitur ut potionem perdigeret et ritum progressionis perficeret!

unit.source: 632 Conspiracy
unit.target: 632 Coniuratio

unit.source: Late at night, in Trier, Angoulême de François sat in front of a small analyzer and a radio transceiver, attentively listening to the clicks and observing as a “translated” telegram was produced by a mechanical typewriter.
unit.target: Nocte sero, Treveris, Angoulême de François ante parvum analysatorem et radiotransmissorem sedebat, diligenter crepitus auscultans et intuens dum telegramma “translatum” per typographum mechanicum conficiebatur.

unit.source: The signature above simply read Hidden Blade.
unit.target: Subscriptio superna simpliciter legebatur “Hidden Blade.”

unit.source: Having exchanged a few messages, Angoulême remained composed.
unit.target: Paucis nuntiis commutatis, Angoulême constanter mansit.

unit.source: He picked up the telegram and swiftly skimmed through its contents.
unit.target: Telegramma sustulit et celeriter eius contenta percurrit.

unit.source: “Um, when you’re protecting high-ranking government officials and members of parliament daily, do you tail them even during personal moments like affairs or trips to the washroom?”
unit.target: “Um, cum quotidie officiales summi gradus gubernii et parlamentarios protegis, an eos etiam in momentis privatis, ut in amatoriis aut itineribus ad latrinam, insequeris?”

unit.source: A wry smile formed on Angoulême’s face.
unit.target: Risus sardonicus in vultu Angoulême apparuit.

unit.source: He contemplated responding to Hidden Blade with, “What occupies your thoughts all day?” However, in the blink of an eye, his eyes narrowed as he tapped away on the mechanical typewriter.
unit.target: Cogitavit Hidden Blade respondere, “Quid totum diem cogitationes tuas occupant?” Attamen, in momento oculi eius adstricti sunt, dum typografo mechanico celeriter pulsaret.

unit.source: “Tell me, what crime do you intend to commit? Which high-ranking government official or member of parliament is your target for assassination?”
unit.target: “Dic mihi, quid scelus committere intendis? Quem officialem summi gradus sive membrum parlamenti interficere destinaveris?”

unit.source: Dammit! Franca, seated in the master bedroom of her apartment, squirmed uncomfortably.
unit.target: Heu! Franca, in camera principali domus suae sedens, incommode se contorquebat.

unit.source: Why did it feel like she was undergoing police interrogation?
unit.target: Cur videbatur quasi a custodibus vigilum interrogaretur?

unit.source: She dryly chuckled to herself and replied on the mechanical typewriter.
unit.target: Illa ad seipsam siccare risit et in typografo mechanico respondit.

unit.source: “I’m just curious. Following them would be awkward, and not doing so might expose a security vulnerability easily exploitable by others.”
unit.target: “Modo curiosa sum. Eos sequi incommode esset, et non faciens vulnerabilitas securitatis, quam ceteri facile adhibere possent, pateficaretur.”

unit.source: She refused to acknowledge any plans involving the Minister of Industry in the current government.
unit.target: Illa consilia quae Minister Industriae in regimine hodierno implicabantur agnoscere recusavit.

unit.source: After a while, 007 sent a new telegram.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, 007 novum telegramma misit.

unit.source: “I rarely undertake such missions.
unit.target: “Raro tales missiones suscipio.”

unit.source: Initially, I dealt with Beyonder incidents and battled cultists.
unit.target: Initio casibus Beyonder versatus sum et cultores pugnavi.

unit.source: Later, I got promoted and no longer had to participate in daily protection operations.
unit.target: Postea, promotus sum et iam non opus erat me in operibus quotidianis protectionis participare.

unit.source: “Based on my knowledge and limited experience, we have to follow the protectee wherever they go.
unit.target: “Ex scientia mea et parva experientia, protectum ubicumque vadit, sequi debemus.

unit.source: If they choose to have an affair, at least one of us will discreetly stand by the coat rack, keeping a watchful eye.
unit.target: Si relationem amatoriam eligunt, saltem unus ex nobis tacite iuxta armarium vestimentorum stabit, ac vigilans perscrutabitur.

unit.source: If time allows, we’ll investigate and confirm the identity and background of the target in advance.
unit.target: Si tempus conceditur, indagationem faciemus et identitatem ac originem destinati praevidemus.

unit.source: If the protectee enters the washroom, one of us waits by their side, guarding against potential threats from sewers, ventilation pipes, and shadows.
unit.target: Si protectus latrinam ingreditur, unus ex nobis iuxta eum exspectat, ad tuendas minas ex cloacis, fistulis ventilationis, et umbris.

unit.source: However, there’s an exception.
unit.target: Attamen, est exceptio.

unit.source: If the protectee strongly requests and writes an exemption, we can respect their privacy.
unit.target: Si protectus vehementer petit et exemptionem scribit, intimitatem eius observare possumus.

unit.source: After all, we’re not their parents obligated to protect their every move.
unit.target: Quia non sumus parentes illorum, ad protegendum omne eorum motum obligati.

unit.source: If they perish, someone else will take their place.
unit.target: Si intereunt, aliquis alius locum eorum occupabit.

unit.source: It’s not easy to find a three-legged toad, but those aspiring to be high-ranking government officials and members of parliament can fill Avenue du Boulevard.
unit.target: Non facile est invenire bufonem tribipedalem, sed qui officiales summi gradus et parlamentarios fieri cupiunt, Avenue du Boulevard implere possunt.

unit.source: Moreover, such officials and MPs don’t often possess exceptional foresight and wisdom.
unit.target: Praeterea, tales officiales et parlamentarii non saepius eximiam providentiam et sapientiam habent.

unit.source: What matters is the position they hold, not the individual.
unit.target: Quod refert, munus quod tenent, non persona ipsa.

unit.source: Very few high-ranking officials and MPs choose to write exemptions for privacy, but they tend to do so when discussing confidential matters with their team.
unit.target: Pauci officiales summi gradus et parlamentarii exemptionem pro intimitate scribere malunt, sed id faciunt cum res arcana cum suo manipulo aguntur.

unit.source: 007, did you work overtime so much that you harbor resentment? Franca chuckled inwardly.
unit.target: 007, num ita plus operatus es ut animos iracundos haberes? Franca intime subridens risit.

unit.source: She felt that 007 wasn’t as laid back as she would have liked.
unit.target: Illa sensit 007 non esse tam tranquillum, quod ipsa optaverat.

unit.source: If it were the two members from Loen, they would likely say, “It’s fine if most high-ranking officials who don’t deal with real matters or MPs who only give speeches are dead. Even curly-haired baboons in their positions would perform better. At least the baboons wouldn’t smack their heads to formulate policies or work for personal gain. They wouldn’t boast about their wisdom and desire to show off. They’d simply enjoy bananas and play happily. That’s the least harmful thing for the entire country.”
unit.target: “Si duo ex membris Loen essent, verisimiliter dicerent: ‘Non refert si plerique officiales summi gradus, qui re vera non currunt, aut parlamentarii qui solum orationes habent, mortui sint. Etiam papiones capillis crispis in suis officiis melius se gerere possent. Saltem papiones capita sua non pulsarent ad consilia formanda aut utilitatem personalem quaerendam. Non gloriarentur de sapientia et ostentatione sua. Simpliciter bananas degustarent et laeti ludirent. Hoc est minimum nocivum pro tota re publica.’”

unit.source: Franca read 007’s telegram again and turned to Jenna, who was sitting by the bed.
unit.target: Franca iterum telegramma 007 legebat et ad Jennam, quae iuxta lectum sedebat, se convertit.

unit.source: “The protective measures are tight, and there are no loopholes to exploit.”
unit.target: “Mensurae tutelae strictae sunt, nec sunt lacunae ad expoliendum.”

unit.source: “Yes, that’s the case with the Purifiers. The Machinery Hivemind and Bureau 8 should be similar.”
unit.target: “Etiam, id valet pro Purificatoribus. Machina Hivemind et Bureau 8 similiter esse debent.”

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony had been gathering information for a while and had devised several plans, but they still found it unsafe and uncertain.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony aliquod tempus informationes colligebant ac plura consilia excogitaverant, sed ea adhuc incerta et periculosa videbantur.

unit.source: Hence, they consulted 007, seeking clarification on the security situation around Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Ergo 007 consuluerunt, statu securitatis circa Moran Avigny expositionem petentes.

unit.source: Being a Cabinet Minister of a country, Moran Avigny was not an easy target for assassination.
unit.target: Cum esset minister consilii patriae, Moran Avigny non facilis meta ad caedem erat.

unit.source: Moreover, Franca and the others’ primary goal wasn’t assassination.
unit.target: Praeterea, propositum principale Francae et ceterorum non erat caedes.

unit.source: Even if they considered it, they had to factor in the time required for spirit channeling, making it even more troublesome.
unit.target: Etiam, si id considerassent, tempus necessitatis canalizationis spiritus in rationem ducendum erat, quod rem magis molestam faciebat.

unit.source: Listening to Franca’s summary of 007’s response, Jenna pondered for a moment and said, “If it were any other Demoness, they might choose to sacrifice their established legitimate identity by seducing Moran Avigny and pretending to be shy to make the minister get an exemption from the protectors. However, I don’t think that’s feasible. Moran Avigny is likely a Mirror Person, and Mirror People have a close relationship with the Demoness pathway. They might be especially wary of a Demoness approaching them.”
unit.target: Auditae Francae compilationi responsionis a 007, Jenna paulisper meditata dixit: "Si alia Demonissa esset, forsitan statuta legitima identitas sua sacrificanda elegissent, seducendo Moran Avigny et simulans pudorem, ut minister exemptionem ab protectoribus obtineret. Tamen, id non puto esse possibile. Moran Avigny verisimiliter Persona Speculi est, et Personae Speculi arctam relationem cum via Demonissae habent. Forsitan maxime caveant ne Demonissa ad eos accedat."

unit.source: Franca had initially hesitated to involve Jenna in the operation against Moran Avigny because the Demoness of Black Clarice would secretly monitor and provide assistance at critical moments.
unit.target: Primum Franca conari dubitavit Jennam in operatione contra Moran Avigny implicare, quia Demonissa Nigrae Clarice occulte monitorem haberet atque in momentis crucialibus auxilium ferre posset.

unit.source: It would be risky if she discovered Jenna using the Demoness pathway’s abilities.
unit.target: Periculosum foret, si invenisset Jennam vires via Demonissae adhibere.

unit.source: However, Jenna insisted on participating. Her reasoning was:
unit.target: Tamen, Jenna in participatione pertinere statuit. Argumentum eius erat:

unit.source: After Franca admitted to Clarice that she hadn’t experienced pleasure for a long time, the Demoness of Black would likely suspect her relationship with Franca.
unit.target: Postquam Franca Clarice confessus est se diu voluptatem non expertam esse, Demonissa Nigrae verisimiliter eius relationem cum Franca suspicaretur.

unit.source: After all, Franca had approached Browns Sauron under the guise of attending a female orgy.
unit.target: Quia Franca, sub specie conviviae feminae, Browns Sauron adiit.

unit.source: Therefore, Jenna wanted to showcase a Vampire’s abilities and combat style in front of the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Ergo, Jenna voluit virtutes et morem pugnae vampyri coram Demonissa Nigrae ostendere.

unit.source: The mystical item she currently possessed would allow her to disguise herself effectively and maintain sufficient combat strength.
unit.target: Res mystica quam nunc habet, ei licebat ut se efficaciter camufliceret et ad pugnandum satis robur retineret.

unit.source: The prerequisite was that she had to conceal the Arrow of the Bloodthirsty well and hide it under her clothes.
unit.target: Praerequisitum erat ut Sagittam Sanguinis Sitientis bene celaret et sub vestimentis absconderet.

unit.source: As for Mirror Substitution, she could explain it away with Franca since Anthony had one too.
unit.target: Quoad Substitutionem Speculi, eam cum Franca excusare poterat, nam et Anthony unam haberet.

unit.source: Franca had muttered, “Demonesses can also have pure love,” but as she finished speaking, she awkwardly changed the topic and tacitly allowed Jenna to participate.
unit.target: Franca submurmuravit, “Demonissae etiam amorem purum habere possunt,” sed loquendo finivit, et male congruenter rem mutavit atque tacite Jennam ad participandum concessit.

unit.source: “Hmm.” Franca, sitting cross-legged, nodded slightly and said, “Moran Avigny’s strength is unknown. He might be very formidable. If we attempt to seduce him, we risk becoming his prey if he’s vigilant, possibly even losing our lives. Sigh, I’d better write to Lumian and see what he thinks.”
unit.target: “Hmm.” Franca, in gremio sedens, leviter annuit et dixit, “Virtus Moran Avigny ignota est. Fortasse valde formidolosus sit. Si eum seducere conamur, periclitamur ut, si vigilat, praeda eius fiamus, forsitan etiam vitam amittamus. Heu, melius est mihi ad Lumian scribere et quid existimet cognoscere.”

unit.source: Franca chuckled self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Franca seipsam demum subridens deridebat.

unit.source: “Ever since he left Trier, my brain seems to have gone on vacation.”
unit.target: “Ex quo Trier discessit, videtur cerebrum meum in ferias ivisse.”

unit.source: She was mocking her past laziness, acknowledging that she often delegated the primary responsibility of thinking to Lumian while playing a supporting role.
unit.target: Praeteritam ignaviam suam irridens agebat, agnoscens saepe primariam munus cogitandi Lumian delegasse, dum munus subveniendi ageret.

unit.source: Jenna chuckled and said, “You’re really good at self-deprecating. That’s what I admire most about you. You’re open-minded and cheerful.”
unit.target: Jenna subridens dixit, “Valde es bonus ad teipsum deprecandum; hoc maxime in te admiror. Es mente aperta et hilaris.”

unit.source: Franca chuckled.
unit.target: Franca risit.

unit.source: “Teasing can liven up the atmosphere and foster closer relationships, but sometimes, if you can’t gauge others’ acceptance, teasing can easily turn into mockery. It’s safer to make a self-deprecating remark.”
unit.target: “Ludibria possunt atmosphaeram animare et relationes intimas fovere, sed interdum, si aliorum receptio aestimari non potest, ludibria facile in derisum versari possunt. Melius est rem de seipsum deprecantem facere.”

unit.source: As the two Demonesses conversed, a telegram clattered in. It was still from 007.
unit.target: Dum duae Demonissae colloquebantur, telegramma strepitu pervenit. Id adhuc a 007 erat.

unit.source: Franca’s eyes lit up as she read the telegram.
unit.target: Oculi Francae fulserunt dum telegramma legebat.

unit.source: The telegram read:
unit.target: Telegramma dicebat:

unit.source: “Hidden Blade, if you disclose your target and provide sufficient reason, I might be able to offer assistance and discreetly cooperate with your actions.”
unit.target: “Hidden Blade, si destinatum tuum revelaveris et causam satis praebueris, forsitan auxilium ferre et occultam cooperationem cum tuis actibus praebere possim.”

unit.source: Wow, what a bro! Franca praised inwardly as her fingers swiftly moved over the mechanical typewriter.
unit.target: “O, quid egregium, care frater! Franca intime laudes sussurravit, dum digiti eius celeriter per typographum mechanicum laborabant.”

unit.source: “Here’s the deal. I currently possess ample evidence to believe that the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, is a Mirror Person who has infiltrated Trier and assumed the original owner’s identity for decades. Haha, I didn’t reveal this earlier because I needed to acquire crucial information from Moran Avigny. If he’s captured by you, I can’t guarantee that you’ll gain access to pertinent information, so I plan to take action myself.”
unit.target: “Ecce, res est. Nunc habeo amplas probationes quo crederem Ministrum Industriae, Moran Avigny, esse Personam Speculi, qui Treverim infiltravit et identitatem pristini possessoris per decennia assumpsit. Haha, hoc ante non revelavi, quod necessarium erat mihi ad informationes maximi momenti a Moran Avigny acquirendas. Si a te capitur, non possum tibi certitudinem dare ut ad informationes pertinentes pervenias, ideo ipse consilium capere cogito.”

unit.source: “Phew… There’s hope!” Franca turned around and joyfully raised her right index and middle fingers to Jenna.
unit.target: “Phew… Spes est!” Franca se versa laetissime dexteros digitos indicem et medius ad Jennam extulit.

unit.source: Before long, 007 responded:
unit.target: Non longe post, 007 respondit:

unit.source: “Gather the results of your previous investigations and Moran Avigny’s information promptly and place it at the designated contact point. I’ll verify it first and find an opportune moment. Await my further instructions.”
unit.target: “Collige eventus investigationum tuarum priores atque informationes de Moran Avigny celeriter, et pone ea in loco destinato contactui. Ego ea primum verificabo et opportunum momentum inveniendum quaesiverim. Exspecta ulteriores instructiones meas.”

unit.source: Franca’s face lit up with joy. She pursed her lips and sent a brief telegram:
unit.target: Vultus Francae laetitia effulgebat. Labris contritis brevem telegramma misit.

unit.source: “It’s highly likely that a demigod of the Demoness Sect will be involved in this operation. Exercise caution.”
unit.target: “Probabiliter demidivus ex Secta Demonissae hoc in consilio implicabitur. Cave.”

unit.source: Jenna read it quietly and asked thoughtfully, “Are we still seeking Lumian’s opinion?”
unit.target: Jenna id quiete legebat et cogitabunda interrogavit: “Num adhuc opinionem Lumian petimus?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Franca replied without hesitation. “As the saying goes, ‘three smelly cobblers are as good as Roselle.’ With more people brainstorming, we may uncover better solutions.”
unit.target: “Ita,” Franca respondit sine mora. “Ut dicitur, ‘tria calceolarii foetidi aeque valent ac Roselle.’ Cum pluribus cogitandis, meliora consilia invenire possumus.”

unit.source: “What kind of proverb is that? Why haven’t I heard it before…” Jenna suspected that Franca was making it up.
unit.target: “Quale proverbium est hoc? Cur numquam prius audivi…?” Jenna suspicabatur Francam hoc fingere.

unit.source: The crimson moon remained unseen, with only the stars casting a faint glow.
unit.target: Luna coccinea non visa est, solis stellis leviter nitentibus tantum.

unit.source: Seated in the Berries’ first-class suite, Lumian perused Dutanese textbooks when his messenger, Penitent Baynfel, abruptly materialized before him.
unit.target: Sedens in conclavi primae classis Berries, Lumian libros Dutanenses perlegebat, cum nuntius eius, Penitent Baynfel, subito ante eum apparuit.

unit.source: Baynfel, draped in a black clergyman’s robe, resembling a charred corpse, handed over the letter.
unit.target: Baynfel, in veste nigra clericali indutus, cadaver comburitum quasi similis, epistulam tradidit.

unit.source: Lumian caught it, inhaling the lingering fragrance on the paper.
unit.target: Lumian eam arripuit, fragranti residuo in charta percepto.

unit.source: Franca’s letter… Jenna even held and read it… Lumian made a casual judgment as he observed his messenger curiously.
unit.target: Epistula Francae… Jenna etiam eam tenuit et legebat… Lumian iudicium leviter fecit, dum nuntium suum curiose contemplabatur.

unit.source: He had a persistent feeling that Penitent Baynfel harbored many untold stories, but every attempt to engage in conversation was met with stoic silence.
unit.target: Persistens sensus eum afficiebat, Penitent Baynfel multarum fabularum inauditarum recondere, sed omnis conatus colloquii in silentio stoeico evanescere.

unit.source: After Baynfel traversed into the spirit world, Lumian unfolded the letter, reclined in his chair, and leisurely read.
unit.target: Postquam Baynfel in mundum spirituum transeunxit, Lumian epistulam explicavit, in sella recubuit, et lente legere coepit.

unit.source: With 007’s help, this shouldn’t be difficult.
unit.target: Auxilio 007, hoc non difficile erit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled suddenly and whispered to himself, If it doesn’t work out, they can force the bait.
unit.target: Lumian subito subridens sibi sussurravit: “Si non procedat, insidiam coacta facere possunt.”

unit.source: Focus on the Mirror Person’s wariness of Demonesses and the potential strength they possess to lure him.
unit.target: Attende ad cautelam Personae Speculi erga Demonissas et ad potentiam quam habent ad eum allicendum.

unit.source: When Moran Avigny believes the target is a bait from the Demoness Sect, with a demigod hiding behind her, planning to take the poison pill and retreat to deliver a bomb, he’ll find himself facing one or two Angels, three to five demigods…
unit.target: Quando Moran Avigny putabit destinatum esse insidiam ex Secta Demonissae, cum demidivus post eam absconditus sit, qui pillam venenatam sumere et recedere ad bombam inferendam consilium facit, inveniet se oppositum uno aut duobus Angelis, tribus ad quinque demideis.

unit.source: However, this way, Franca’s Demoness Sect mission will be finished…
unit.target: At hoc modo, missio Sectae Demonissae Francae confecta erit…

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he crafted and discarded one plan after another.
unit.target: Cogitationes Luminum succurrentes erant, dum unum consilium post aliud excogitabat et deiciebat.

unit.source: Tomorrow, the Berries would depart from the Berserk Sea, sailing into the Southern Continent’s waters.
unit.target: Cras, Berries ab Oceano Furioso discedent, navigantes ad aquas Continenti Australis.

unit.source: When the time came, the ship wouldn’t need to navigate complex twists and turns to avoid storms, maelstroms, and mystical phenomena. It could head directly for its destination port in West Balam.
unit.target: Cum tempus advenisset, navis non oportuit circumire angulares flexus ad tempestates, maelstromata, et phaenomena mystica vitanda. Potuit directe ad portum destinatum in Occidente Balam progredi.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian sensed something and stood up.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian aliquid sensit et surrexit.

unit.source: Approaching the window, he peered out. In the darkness not far away, an ancient three-masted sailboat sailed silently.
unit.target: Accedens ad fenestram, extrinsecus contemplatus est. In obscuritate non longe, vetus navis tribus mythris silentio vecta est.

unit.source: There were no lights on the ship, and no one strolled on the deck.
unit.target: In nave nullae luces erant, nec quisquam in ponte ambulabat.

unit.source: 633 West Balam
unit.target: 633 Occidens Balam

unit.source: Lumian had heard from Lugano that ships deviating from the safe sea route might mysteriously disappear.
unit.target: Lumian ab Lugano audiverat naves, quae a via marina tuta deviasterant, mirabiliter evanescere posse.

unit.source: In a few years, they would occasionally appear at night–with no lights or people.
unit.target: Paucis annis interdum nocte apparere solebant – sine luminibus aut hominibus.

unit.source: This seemed to be the case now.
unit.target: Hoc nunc casus esse videbatur.

unit.source: In the past, Lumian might have teleported over out of curiosity, taking advantage of the three-masted sailboat’s reentry into a safe sea route to assess its internal condition.
unit.target: Priore tempore, Lumian ex curiositate fortasse translocatus esset, terentem occasionem ut vetus triceps pinnatus vellere, quod ad viam marina tutae reditus pertineret, interius statum inspiceret.

unit.source: However, after encountering the Demon legends on Hanth Island, he felt that less curiosity was better.
unit.target: Sed postquam de legendis daemonum in insula Hanth audiverat, sensit minus curiositatis melius esse.

unit.source: As long as the uninhabited ship traveling in the darkness didn’t exhibit signs of attack or an imminent danger, he could treat it as a unique spectacle of the Berserk Sea and simply observe.
unit.target: Dummodo nave in tenebris errans, quae incolāta esset, signa hostilitatis aut imminenti periculo non ostenderet, eam singularem spectaculum Maris Berserki agnosceret et tantum observaret.

unit.source: The brown ship gradually distanced itself, leaving only the billowing sails in its wake.
unit.target: Navis fusca paulatim remotam esse videbatur, relinquens solum velis inflatis vestigia sua.

unit.source: Abruptly, Lumian, utilizing his exceptional vision, spotted a face silently staring out of an open hole in the cabin’s uppermost window.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian, singulari visu utebatur, et vultum ex nigro foramine aperturae fenestræ summæ cellæ tacite aspicientem animadvertit.

unit.source: The face, shriveled and pale-white, clung tightly to the bones, devoid of flesh and blood.
unit.target: Vultus, contritus et pallide albus, ad ossa arcte adhaerebat, carentem carne et sanguine.

unit.source: Flaxen-colored hair cascaded like withered weeds.
unit.target: Capilli flavicantes quasi herbae exaridae fluere videbantur.

unit.source: The eyeballs were absent, leaving only a void of deep darkness.
unit.target: Oculi absentes erant, relinquentes solum vacuum tenebrarum infimarum.

unit.source: It resembled the head of a desiccated corpse, yet its lips were surprisingly vibrant, as if recently adorned with lipstick.
unit.target: Habet similitudo capitis cadaveris exsiccati, attamen labiis prorsus vivacibus, quasi nuper labello depictis, ornata.

unit.source: Lumian instinctively sensed the face belonged to a woman.
unit.target: Lumian intuitu suo quasi sanente sensit vultum ad feminam pertinere.

unit.source: At least, she had been a woman when alive.
unit.target: Saltem, illa femina vixit.

unit.source: He refrained from raising his right hand for a warm greeting.
unit.target: Non levavit dextram manum ad salutem calidam offerendam.

unit.source: Instead, he quietly observed as the ancient three-masted sailboat sailed beyond the safe sea route and into the dark night.
unit.target: Pro eo, tacite intuens perspexit veterem triceps pinnatum vellere ultra viam marina tutae navigare atque in noctem obscuram ingredi.

unit.source: The desiccated face, with blood‑red lips and pitch‑black eyes, blended into the darkness.
unit.target: Vultus exsiccatus, labiis sanguine rubris et oculis atris perfecta, in tenebris evanuit.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian wave his hand and offer a faint smile.
unit.target: Tunc tantum Lumian manum agitavit et levem subrisum intulit.

unit.source: “Goodbye! You won’t be missed!”
unit.target: „Vale! Te non desiderabimus!”

unit.source: He then helped Franca and the others to devise a plan to confront Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Deinde Francae aliisque consilium componere ad Moran Avigny oppugnandum adiuvavit.

unit.source: Ultimately, he opted to await further information from 007 before finalizing their strategy.
unit.target: Denique statuendum esse statuit ut ulterius ab 007 notitia acciperetur antequam consilium finaliter ficeretur.

unit.source: Conspirer wasn’t a visionary, known for conjuring conspiracies out of thin air; they required substantial information as a foundation.
unit.target: Conspirator non erat visionarius, qui ex nihilo coniurationes excitaret; informatione solida ut fundamento necessaria erant.

unit.source: When Lumian awoke at dawn, the Berries emerged from the dense, death‑carrying fog of the Berserk Sea.
unit.target: Cum Lumian aurora expergisceretur, Berries ex densa nebula morte ferente Maris Berserki emerserunt.

unit.source: Before him stretched a clear blue sea, bathed in the intense sunlight of the high sky.
unit.target: Ante eum extendebatur mare caeruleum lucidum, intenso sole caeli altissimi illustratum.

unit.source: The next day, the Berries bypassed Behrens Harbor at the northernmost tip of West Balam.
unit.target: Die sequenti, Berries portum Behrens in extremo boreali West Balam transierunt.

unit.source: Instead, they continued southwest, reaching Port Pylos by 4 p.m.
unit.target: Immo in australem occidentem pergentes, ad Portum Pylos ad horam quartam post meridiem pervenerunt.

unit.source: Situated in Matani, the port was under the rule of Admiral Querarill.
unit.target: Portus, in Matani sito, sub imperio Admiralis Querarill erat.

unit.source: Originally a colony of the Intis Republic, Port Pylos saw Intis colonists withdraw after the war a few years ago.
unit.target: Colonia olim Reipublicae Intis, Portus Pylos vidit colones Intis post bellum paucis annis abhinc se recedisse.

unit.source: Subsequently, various factions from the Feynapotter Kingdom, maintaining a favorable relationship with Admiral Querarill, took control.
unit.target: Deinde, varia factiones ex regno Feynapotter, relationem benecum Admirali Querarill servantes, imperium ceperunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s target, Hisoka, was yet to surface in Port Pylos, but Lumian knew that the two pranks he had engaged in were in Matani.
unit.target: Meta Lumiani, Hisoka, in Portu Pylos adhuc apparuisse non videbatur, sed Lumian sciebat duo iocos, quos in Matani egisset, fuisse.

unit.source: One occurred in Tizamo Town, at the outskirts of Port Pylos, closest to the forest, and the other in Devise, the southernmost gold mine city in Matani.
unit.target: Unus evenit in oppido Tizamo, in limine Portus Pylos, prope silvam, et alter in Devise, urbe fodinaria auri meridionali Matani.

unit.source: As Lumian unbuttoned the second button on his linen shirt, he remarked to Lugano in a self‑deprecating tone,
unit.target: Dum Lumian secundum nodum in veste linteo evolvens erat, ad Lugano, tono sibi ipsi humili, dixit:

unit.source: “I feel like I’m shunned by winter and have been living in a scorching environment.”
unit.target: „Sentio quasi hieme reiectus sim et in ambitu ardenti vixerim.”

unit.source: Having arrived in Port Santa during late autumn, which was relatively hot and sunny, Lumian moved on to Port Colla as Port Santa began to cool.
unit.target: Postquam Portum Santaei in autumno serotino, qui calidum et solis plenum erat, attigit, Lumian ad Portum Colla se contulit, cum Portus Santaei refrigerari coepit.

unit.source: His journey continued through what his sister called the tropics, devoid of winter and maintaining a temperature of at least around 20 degrees Celsius.
unit.target: Iter eius per spatium, quod soror sua “tropica” appellavit, sine hieme et cum recta temperatura—saltem circa viginti gradus—pergebat.

unit.source: While Trier was already in midwinter, the Southern Continent was experiencing the height of summer.
unit.target: Dum Trier iam in media hieme versabatur, Continens Meridionalis culmen aestatis experiebatur.

unit.source: This made Lumian’s specially prepared black tweed coat and Gehrman‑styled trench coat impractical.
unit.target: Hoc efficiebat ut pallium ex nigro tweed specialiter praeparatum et mantellum trench, more Gehrman, incommoda videbantur.

unit.source: “Because we’ve been traveling south all autumn,” Lugano declared authoritatively on matters of weather and seasons.
unit.target: „Quia totum autumno ad meridiem iter fecimus,” dixerat Lugano cum auctoritate de tempestatibus et temporibus.

unit.source: Lumian donned a golden straw hat and strolled down the gangway to the port, hand in hand with Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum induit et per viam navalem ad portum ambulavit, manum in manum cum Ludwig.

unit.source: He boldly embodied the traits of the adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Audacter virtutes viatoris Ludovici Berry exhibuit.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian had contemplated altering his strategy, adopting a new identity to discreetly investigate the two pranks in Matani and uncover Hisoka without drawing attention.
