unit.target: Initio, Lumian consilium mutandi rationem suam meditatus est, novam identitatem assumentem ad arcane duas iocas in Matani perscrutandas atque Hisokam detegendam, ne ullam attentionem susciperet.

unit.source: However, after Franca vividly detailed Hisoka’s usual characteristics to Anthony Reid, the Hypnotist’s profiling revealed an exceptionally aggressive trait, ranking among the top.
unit.target: Tamen, postquam Franca nitide notas consuetas Hisoka ad Antonium Reid enarravit, indagatio hypnosi demonstravit notam eximie aggressivam, inter praecipuas numeratam.

unit.source: As a result, Lumian reconsidered and returned to his role of casting out “bait.”
unit.target: Propterea, Lumian iterum meditatus est et ad munus suum “escam eiciendi” redegit.

unit.source: Yet, he couldn’t shake the feeling that success was a slim possibility.
unit.target: Attamen sensum non absolvit, quod successus vix contingere posset.

unit.source: The sea sacrificial ritual and Loki’s survival had likely provided Hisoka with a comprehensive understanding of the factions backing him.
unit.target: Ritualis marinus sacrificii atque superstitia Loki verisimiliter Hisokae plenam intellegentiam de factionibus, quae eum sustinebant, contulerunt.

unit.source: April Fool’s, with its former display of resources and energy, seemed ill‑equipped to challenge the might of the Tarot Club.
unit.target: April Fool’s, pristino opum et energiae ostensione, vix idoneus apparuit potentiam Tarot Club oppugnandi.

unit.source: And Lumian wasn’t solely relying on the Tarot Club for support.
unit.target: Nec tantum Tarot Club subsidio Lumian innitebatur.

unit.source: If he were in Hisoka’s shoes, Lumian would opt for patience.
unit.target: Si in pedibus Hisoka versaretur, Lumian patientiam optasset.

unit.source: He’d wait a month or two, allowing the vengeful enemy to grow restless and make mistakes.
unit.target: Mensis vel duo exspectaret, sinens hostem ultionis inquietari et errores committere.

unit.source: When the formidable forces behind him could no longer guarantee protection, he’d launch a surprise attack.
unit.target: Cum copiae formidabiles, quae eum sustinebant, tutelam praestare amplius non poterant, impetum insperatum proferret.

unit.source: For now, let’s not devise a plan.
unit.target: Pro tempore, consilium non constituamus.

unit.source: “I’ll consider it when I find clues,” Lumian muttered to himself.
unit.target: „Id considerabo, cum indicia inveniam,” Lumian sibi ipsi submurmuravit.

unit.source: Leaving the port alongside a throng of passengers, he reached the public carriage stop.
unit.target: Portum relinquens simul cum multitudo vecturarum, ad stativam coccionis publicae pervenit.

unit.source: Numerous rental carriages and pitch‑black or vermilion coffins were parked nearby.
unit.target: Multae carrucae conductionis et sarcophagī nigerrimi vel coccineī prope statuta erant.

unit.source: Coffins? Despite having read many travelog books on West Balam’s customs, Lumian found it absurd to witness coffins lining the roadside.
unit.target: Sarcophagī? Quamquam multas de moribus West Balam in libris itinerum legerat, Lumian absurdum invenit videre sarcophagos viam ornantes.

unit.source: Before the invasion of the Northern Continent, before East and West Balam’s division, the Balam Empire revered Death—
unit.target: Ante invasionem Continenti Septentrionalis, ante divisionem Balam Orientalis et Occidentalis, Imperium Balam Mortem venerabatur—

unit.source: the Emperor of the Underworld from the War of the Four Emperors.
unit.target: Imperator Inferorum ex Bello Quattuor Imperatorum.

unit.source: Thus, the locals valued and loved coffins, considering them objects that brought peace, tranquility, and the blessing of Death.
unit.target: Ita, incolae sarcophagos aestimabant et amabant, existimantes eos res esse quae pacem, tranquillitatem et Mortis benedictionem afferant.

unit.source: When traveling, they would lie inside, carried by people or pulled by horses and single‑horned goats.
unit.target: Iter facientes intus iaciebant, aut a hominibus portati aut equis et capris cum uno cornu tractati.

unit.source: Of course, this form of transportation was reserved for those of a certain wealth level.
unit.target: Certe, haec forma vecturae reservata erat illis, qui opes certæ habebant.

unit.source: Ordinary people couldn’t even afford lying in a coffin.
unit.target: Populi ordinarii ne in sarcophago iacere quidem se praestare poterant.

unit.source: After a momentary daze, Lumian addressed Lugano and Ludwig with interest, “Do you want to take the coffin? I plan to give it a try.”
unit.target: Post brevem stupefactionem, Lumian ad Lugano et Ludwig cum studio dixit: “Sarcofagum capere vultis? Ego id conari cogito.”

unit.source: “I-I’ll pass,” Lugano replied, finding the idea of lying in a coffin unsettling.
unit.target: “Ego praetermittam,” respondit Lugano, sentiens ideam in sarcophago iacendi perturbantem esse.

unit.source: Ludwig shifted his attention to the nearby street vendors.
unit.target: Ludwig animos suos ad venditores viarios prope convertere constituit.

unit.source: The aroma of corn and potatoes intertwined, enticing every passerby and prompting increased saliva production.
unit.target: Odor frumenti et solani mixtus, quemque transeuntem allicit et salivarum productionem incitat.

unit.source: “How lame,” Lumian teased with a smile.
unit.target: “Quam ineptus,” arridens Lumian iocose inquit.

unit.source: Approaching the four locals with disheveled black hair and dark brown skin, he raised his right hand and pointed at the pitch‑black coffin beneath the shade of a tree.
unit.target: Accedens ad quattuor incolas, qui capillis disiectis et cute fusca essent, dextram manum elevavit et ad sarcophagum nigerrimum sub umbra arboris demonstravit.

unit.source: “How much?” Lugano inquired in fluent Dutanese before Lumian could.
unit.target: “Quantum?” inquirivit Lugano, lingua Dutana fluente, antequam Lumian responderet.

unit.source: “How much?” Lugano inquired in fluent Dutanese before Lumian could.
unit.target: “Quantum?” inquirivit iterum Lugano, in lingua Dutana fluente, antequam Lumian interveneret.

unit.source: His linguistic talent was evident.
unit.target: Ars linguistica eius manifesta erat.

unit.source: Less than a month had passed since their departure from Port Santa to their arrival at Port Pylos, and he could already communicate with people in Dutanese.
unit.target: Minus quam mensis transiit ex Portu Santa ad Portum Pylos, atque iam cum hominibus lingua Dutana communicare poterat.

unit.source: Of course, his proficiency was limited to basic words and short sentences.
unit.target: Certe, eius peritia ad verba fundamentalia et sententias breves restricta erat.

unit.source: A half‑naked local in linen pants replied in Dutanese,
unit.target: Localis semi nudus in braccis linteis respondit in lingua Dutana,

unit.source: “Nearby, 40 coppet; faraway, 1 verl d’or.”
unit.target: “Prope, 40 coppet; longe, 1 verl d’or.”

unit.source: Recognizing the foreigner’s inquiry, he refrained from quoting the price in the local currency, Delexi, the Intisian term for copper coins.
unit.target: Cum quaestionem alienam agnovit, abstinuit pretium in monetis localibus, Delexi, vocato Intisiano pro nummis cupreis, indicare.

unit.source: Quite affordable.
unit.target: Valde parabile.

unit.source: This coffin, carried by four people, should be considerably cheaper than the one carried by eight… Lumian mused, appreciating the direct use of verl d’or and coppet.
unit.target: Hic sarcophagus, a quattuor fertus, multo vilior esse debet quam ille, a octo portatus… meditatus est Lumian, directum usum verl d’or et coppet laude afferens.

unit.source: It showcased the recent Intisian influence in the former colony, lost only a few years ago.
unit.target: Id demonstravit recentem influentiam Intisianam in colonia pristina, intra paucos annos amisso.

unit.source: Lumian’s grasp of Dutanese surpassed Lugano’s, thanks to the mid‑level Language Comprehension charm he had used on the ship.
unit.target: Peritia Lumiani in lingua Dutana Luganum superabat, gratia incantationis medio gradus “Language Comprehension” quam in nave usus erat.

unit.source: Learning Dutanese in this manner proved more efficient.
unit.target: Doctrina linguae Dutanae hoc modo efficius fuit.

unit.source: Regarding charm consumption, Lumian harbored no concerns.
unit.target: De incantationum consumptione, Lumian nihil sollicite habebat.

unit.source: In his view, items served a purpose, and there was no concept of waste as long as they proved useful.
unit.target: Secundum eius opinionem, res utilitati destinatae erant, nec conceptus vastitatis exsistebat, dummodo utiles proessebant.

unit.source: He couldn’t align with those miserly individuals who hoarded their wealth throughout life, only for it to benefit others after their demise.
unit.target: Non consentiebat cum illis parvo animo hominibus, qui divitias suas per vitam colebat, ut solummodo post mortem aliis prosent.

unit.source: If he urgently needed Language Comprehension charms, he could acquire them from the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society.
unit.target: Si celeriter incantationibus “Language Comprehension” opus haberet, ea comparare posset ex Societate Papionum Capillitibus Crispis.

unit.source: If their gathering didn’t align with his schedule, teleporting to various cities in Lenburg would allow him to purchase them from the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Si conventus eorum cum suo tempore non congruabat, teleportando ad varias urbes in Lenburg ea ab Ecclesia Cognitionis emere poterat.

unit.source: “Sure,” Lumian nodded at Lugano and said, “Let’s go to Hotel Orella.”
unit.target: „Certe,” annuit Lumian ad Lugano et dixit: „Eamus ad Hospitium Orella.”

unit.source: After Lugano paid 1 verl d’or, the local who had quoted the price lifted the thin coffin lid, revealing the interior covered with thick dark‑red cloth and a stiff neck pillow.
unit.target: Postquam Lugano 1 verl d’or solvit, incola, qui pretium enumeraverat, tenue operculum sarcophagi levavit, revelans interiorem tegumentum densā panno nigro‑rubro et pulvinar rigido colli constitutum.

unit.source: Excitedly, Lumian removed his golden straw hat and lay down, immediately feeling a cooling sensation enveloping his body.
unit.target: Exsultans, Lumian pileum stramineum aureum abstulit et se iacuit, statim sensu refrigerii, qui corpus suum amplectebatur, percepit.

unit.source: In the hot season, the coffin effectively dispelled the humidity.
unit.target: In aestate, sarcophagus efficaciter humiditatem exstinxit.

unit.source: Is it the coffin’s wood or the sun‑screening black paint, or perhaps the shade of the tree? It feels like stepping into a morgue in the summer—surprisingly comfortable…
unit.target: Numne lignum sarcophagi, an nigra pinguedo solis tegente, aut fortasse umbra arboris? Videtur quasi in morgheum aestate introire—mirum tamen commodum…

unit.source: Lumian observed the thin coffin lid closing, witnessing the shadows rapidly expanding until they dominated his world.
unit.target: Lumian tenue operculum sarcophagi claudens aspexit, umbras celeriter dilatantes usque ad orbem suum dominandum.

unit.source: Outside, the voices became muffled in his ears.
unit.target: Extra, voces in auribus eius obmutescebantur.

unit.source: The coffin was lifted, swaying slightly as it moved forward.
unit.target: Sarcophagus sublatus est, leviter oscillans dum procedebat.

unit.source: Within Lumian’s view, everything was dark, and his surroundings exuded a sinister, cold ambiance.
unit.target: In conspectu Lumiani, omnia obscura erant, atque ambitus eius atmosphaeram sinistram et frigidam efferebat.

unit.source: For some reason, it felt like he was walking toward death, touching it.
unit.target: Aliqua rei causa, videbatur se versus mortem ambulare, eam attingens.

unit.source: Setting aside the psychological discomfort, it isn’t bad.
unit.target: Incommoda psychologica praetermittens, non male videtur.

unit.source: The only downside is the tendency to easily fall asleep… Lumian evaluated the mode of transportation in a good mood.
unit.target: Unum tantum incommodum erat, quod facile ad somnum incidere valebat… Lumian modum vecturae in animo laeto aestimavit.

unit.source: It’s unsuitable for mixed‑gender rides, which could be more awkward.
unit.target: Non idoneum est ad vecturas generum mixtarum, quae fortasse magis incommoda esse possent.

unit.source: Heh heh, I wonder if the “romantic” Intisians have ever engaged in an affair under such circumstances?
unit.target: Heh heh, miror an Intisiani “romantici” umquam sub talibus condicionibus rem amoris gesserint.

unit.source: Nearly half an hour later, the coffin halted in front of Hotel Orella.
unit.target: Fere dimidio hora post, sarcophagus ante Hospitium Orella sistit.

unit.source: Lumian stepped out, finding himself in front of a small, man‑made valley.
unit.target: Lumian egressus est, se coram parva valle artificio facta inveniens.

unit.source: Rows of grayish‑black stone rooms encircled the inner wall of the “deep valley” until reaching the bottom.
unit.target: Sera cellarum lapidearum fuscorum et cinereorum internam murum “vallis profundae” circumdabant, donec ad imum perveniebant.

unit.source: This was Port Pylos’s most renowned Hotel Orella.
unit.target: Id erat Hotel Orella, notissimum Portus Pylos.

unit.source: Originally belonging to a Balam royal family descendant, Orella Eggers, it had been constructed with the intent of approaching death.
unit.target: Primitivē, pertinens ad descendentem familiae regiae Balam, Orella Eggers, constructum est ad mortem appropinquare.

unit.source: Later, it fell into the hands of Intis colonists.
unit.target: Postea in manibus colonorum Intis cecidit.

unit.source: Upon the Feynapotterians’ arrival, they perceived it as a symbol of entering the earth and returning to the land, prompting its transformation into a sizable hotel.
unit.target: Cum Feynapotteriani advenerunt, id ut signum ingrediendi terram et redire ad ager perceptum est, quod conversionem eius in magnum hospitium impulit.

unit.source: 634 Fresh Off The Boat
unit.target: 634 Recens ex nave

unit.source: In the well-lit lobby of Hotel Orella, aboveground, Lugano effortlessly balanced Ludwig, munching on a burrito, in one hand and clutched his suitcase in the other.
unit.target: In atrio bene illustrato Hotel Orella, super terram, Lugano Ludwig facile temperabat, dum burrito devorabat, una manu tenens alteramque manu sarcinam suam stringebat.

unit.source: His eyes darted around uneasily.
unit.target: Oculi eius anxie circumvolitabant.

unit.source: From his adventurous beginnings to trailing Lumian south, he’d never lodged in a place proudly declaring itself a “hotel” instead of a “motel.”
unit.target: Ex initiis suis audacibus ad sectam Lumiani meridianam, numquam in loco manserat qui se cum superbia “hotel” potius quam “motel” appellaret.

unit.source: He’d only encountered Trier’s renowned Grand Champs-Élysée in newspapers and magazines, learning that its construction cost a whopping 21 million verl d’or.
unit.target: Trieri celeberrimum Grand Champs-Élysée tantum in diurnis et commentariis occurrerat, discens eius constructionem constare 21 miliones “verl d’or.”

unit.source: With 800 rooms and 65 functional halls, even the most basic accommodations demanded 12 verl d’or per day in the off-season.
unit.target: Cum 800 conclavibus et 65 aulae utilibus, etiam simplicissima hospitia poscebant 12 “verl d’or” per diem in tempore extra.

unit.source: A stark contrast to Lugano’s usual frugal 3.5 verl d’or weekly motel stays.
unit.target: Contrarium ac solita modica sustentatione Lugani, qui in “motel” hebdomadali 3.5 “verl d’or” imponebat.

unit.source: The bustling metropolis of Trier had left an indelible mark on Lugano, urging him to rise above and recommend himself to Lumian.
unit.target: Trier urbs fervens indelibile vestigium in Lugano reliquit, eum hortans ut surgeret ac se Lumiano commendaret.

unit.source: Accumulating wealth, obtaining potion ingredients, and advancing to Doctor became his priorities.
unit.target: Divitias colligere, potionis ingredientes obtinere, et ad gradum Doctoris progredi facta sunt eius principale negotia.

unit.source: He aspired to join the ranks of high society!
unit.target: Societatem nobilitatis se iungere optabat!

unit.source: Only when he became a Doctor did he grasp the vastness of the Beyonder world.
unit.target: Modo, cum Doctor factus esset, immensitatem orbis Beyonder comprehendit.

unit.source: He had barely scratched its surface.
unit.target: Vix superficiem eius attingerat.

unit.source: The male receptionist, sporting curly black hair, dark brown skin, and a keen countenance, addressed Lugano in fluent Intisian.
unit.target: Recepciō virīlis, capillis atrīs crispīs, cute fusca et vultū acūtō ornātus, Lugānō in lingua Intisiānā fluente allocūtus est.

unit.source: “Would you prefer a suite or a standard room? Are you inclined towards a coffin bed or a conventional one?”
unit.target: “Velisne conclāve aut cubiculum ordinārium? An adsuescitur lectō, ut lectus sarcophāgīcum, vel audesne eligere modum tritum?”

unit.source: Lugano glanced at his employer.
unit.target: Lugānō ad dominum suum intuebātur.

unit.source: Lumian toyed with a caramel-colored East Balam cigarette wrapped in roasted tobacco leaves, bringing it to his nose for a gentle sniff.
unit.target: Lumian lusum habuit cum cigaaretā East Balam, colore caramellico, involutā in foliīs tabācī tostī, quam ad nāsum leviter attulit odorandum.

unit.source: He savored the blend of tobacco leaves, internal spices, and assorted herbs.
unit.target: Saporem mixtiōnis foliorum tabācī, specierum internārum, et herbarum variārum degustāvit.

unit.source: The aroma was mildly invigorating and redolent, tempting one to inhale deeply.
unit.target: Odor leniter vigebat et fragrābat, simulans ad altum inspirandum.

unit.source: “A suite. Standard, and closer to ground level.”
unit.target: “Conclāve. Ordinārium, et propius ad terram.”

unit.source: Lumian had sampled rental coffins for transportation and had no plans to continue sleeping in them.
unit.target: Lumian sarcophāga locandī experītus erat et nullo consiliō de illīs dormitandō permanēre decreverat.

unit.source: It wasn’t a traumatic experience, but it did alter his perception of his surroundings.
unit.target: Non fuit experientia trauminōsa, sed tamen perceptionem circa eum mutavit.

unit.source: In case of an attack, it could impede his initial response.
unit.target: In casū impetuōrum, responsum primum eius impedīre poterat.

unit.source: Lugano sighed in relief upon hearing Lumian’s decision and conveyed the employer’s request to the male receptionist.
unit.target: Lugānō ex solātiōne suspirāvit, audītō Lumiani consiliō, et petitiōnem dominī sui receptōrī virīlī trādidit.

unit.source: “8 verl d’or a day. Three days’ payment in advance,” the native male receptionist stated the price.
unit.target: “8 ‘verl d’or’ per diem. Solūtiō trīum diērum praeviā,” inquit receptōr indigenus de pretīō.

unit.source: After Lugano completed the payment, the receptionist, with a nod to his colleagues, said obsequiously, “I’ll escort you down.”
unit.target: Postquam Lugānō solutionem confēcit, receptōr, capite ad collegās subnōtā, obsequius inquit, “Te comitābor deorsum.”

unit.source: Three mechanical elevators stood at the back of the hall.
unit.target: Trēs elevātorēs mechanicī in parte postica āulae steterunt.

unit.source: Lumian and his group entered the middle door, pulling the brass handle to B3.
unit.target: Lumian et turma eius ianuam mediam intrāvērunt, manubrium aereum ad B3 trahentēs.

unit.source: Chains tightened, gears clamped, and various metal parts started to operate with resonating sounds.
unit.target: Catenae contrāxitēs sunt, rotae constitūtæ, et variae partes metallī cum sonīs resonantibus in mōtiōnem coepērunt.

unit.source: In the distance, it resembled the roar of a boiler, and white steam billowed out.
unit.target: In longinquō, fremitus caldārī imitābatur, et vapor albus effulgebat.

unit.source: As the mechanical elevator descended, the native receptionist glanced at Ludwig and smiled at Lumian.
unit.target: Dum elevātorem mechanicum deorsum descendēbat, receptōr indigenus Ludgigi spectāvit et Lumianō subrīdens aspexit.

unit.source: “Settling down in Port Pylos, are you?
unit.target: “Incolitur in Port Pylos, esne?

unit.source: “If you need info on local grammar schools and rentals in different communities, feel free to approach me.”
unit.target: Si desiderās informationem de schōlīs grammaticīs locālibus et de locātiōnibus in variīs communitātibus, libere ad mē accēde.

unit.source: In his view, anyone bringing a seven- or eight-year-old child to the Southern Continent was likely moving, not merely traveling.
unit.target: Eius iudiciō, quis puerum septem vel octo annōrum ad Continentem Meridionālem adfert, verisimiliter migrābat, non tantum iter faciens.

unit.source: After all, the child was too young for perilous long-distance journeys.
unit.target: Nam puer nimis iuvenis erat ad itinerēs periculōs longinquōs.

unit.source: Moving meant finding a house—renting or buying—and choosing a good school. These were all opportunities to make money!
unit.target: Migrātiō quidem significābat domum inveniendam—vel locandam vel emendam—et schōlam bonam eligendam; haec omnia erant occasōnes lucrandi!

unit.source: At the mention of “school,” Ludwig, munching on a roasted corn cob, suddenly stopped chewing, as if the food had lost its fragrance.
unit.target: Ad mentionem “scholae,” Ludwig, maizum tostum edendō, subito masticāre dēsiēit, quasi cibus suus odōrem amīssisset.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t oblivious to the native receptionist’s thoughts but didn’t mind. Instead, he admired the man’s shrewdness.
unit.target: Lumian cogitātiōnibus receptōris indigenī ignorare nōn potuit, sed minūs curāvit; immo callidātem eius admirābat.

unit.source: He grinned and remarked, “I’ll take a look first. We haven’t confirmed if we would stay in Port Pylos.”
unit.target: Subrīdens dīxit, “Primum incipiam aspicere. Nondum constitūtum est an in Port Pylos maneāmus.”

unit.source: At that moment, the mechanical elevator halted at B3.
unit.target: Illo momento, elevātorem mechanicum in B3 sistit.

unit.source: Entering the room on the right, with a stone fence on one side and the cold valley aisle on the other, Lumian addressed the native receptionist, “Do you know Tizamo Town?”
unit.target: Intrans in conclāve dextro, cum saepē lapidēā ad ūnum latus et corridorī frigidi in vallē ad alterum, Lumian ad receptōrem indigenum locūtus est, “Novistine oppidum Tizamo?”

unit.source: The native receptionist, aiding Lugano with the suitcase, slightly bent and led the way.
unit.target: Recepciō indigenus, Lugānō cum sarcinā adiuvāns, leviter inclinātus viam duxit.

unit.source: "I do. Many gentlemen head to Tizamo on weekends for forest hunting."
unit.target: "Scio. Multi viri in finibus hebdomādum ad Tizamo properant ad silvestrem venandam."

unit.source: "There are secret temples and mausoleums left behind by former nobles in the forest. If you want to have fun, don’t venture too deep. The primitive tribes there are barbaric and savage."
unit.target: "In silvā templa arcāna et mausolea ā pristīnīs nōbilibus relicta sunt. Si vis delectātiōnem, noli nimis alte ingredī. Tribus ibi primitīvī sunt—barbaricāe et ferocēs."

unit.source: Lumian nodded, not probing further. Upon reaching Suite 7 and entering the living room, he casually tossed a verl d’or silver coin to the native receptionist.
unit.target: Lumian annuīt, non ulterius inquisēns; ad Conclāve 7 pervenīens et in camērā convivīī intrāns, leviter nummum argenteum “verl d’or” receptōrī indigenō mīsit.

unit.source: “What’s your name?”
unit.target: "Quid est nōmen tuum?"

unit.source: The receptionist, pleasantly surprised, responded, “You can call me Ron.”
unit.target: Recepciō, laetā mirātus, respondit, "Mē Ron vocāre potēs."

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subrīdens exsolvit.

unit.source: “I might have to trouble you often in the future. For example, what’s the name of the nearest and better bars? Where is it?”
unit.target: "Forsitan te saepe in futurum molestābō. Exempli causā, quid nōmen est tabernārum proximārum et melīorum? Ubi illa sita est?"

unit.source: Ron touched the silver coin and smiled.
unit.target: Ron nummum argenteum tetigit et subrīdens risit.

unit.source: “It’s my honor to assist you.
unit.target: Meum honōrem est tē adiuvāre.

unit.source: “Head to the Man-Eating Flower Bar. Intisian is used for communication there. It’s on the street behind our hotel.”
unit.target: Dirige ad Tabernam “Man-Eating Flower.” Lingua Intisianā ibi ad communicātiōnem adhibētur. Ea in plateā post hotel nostrum sita est.

unit.source: Lumian instructed Lugano and left the room with Ron, waiting for one of the mechanical elevators.
unit.target: Lumian Lugānō instrūxit et cum Ron conclāvem reliquit, exspectāns unum ex elevātoribus mechanicīs.

unit.source: Inside, a man with a deathly pale face and vacant eyes stood.
unit.target: Intus, vir vultū mortiferō pallidō et oculīs vacuīs stabat.

unit.source: The man’s face was deathly pale, and his eyes were vacant. He wore a wrinkled shirt and pants.
unit.target: Vultus viri mortiferō pallidus erat, et oculī eius vacuī erant. Induebat camisiam rugosam et brācās.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at him without a word.
unit.target: Lumian eum sine verbō intuebātur.

unit.source: Amidst the tightening of the chain and the relatively stable elevation, the mechanical lift returned to the ground.
unit.target: Inter contractionem catenae et elevātiōnem relativē stābilī, elevātorem mechanicum ad terram rediit.

unit.source: Once the vacant-eyed man exited the lift and distanced himself from them, Ron leaned closer to Lumian and whispered, “I wanted to remind you to pretend not to see that customer.”
unit.target: Cum vir oculīs vacuīs elevatorem reliqueret et a eīs se distanseret, Ron ad Lumian propius inclinātus susurravit, "Te admonēre voluī ut simulās illum emptōrem non vidēre."

unit.source: “Who is he?” Lumian asked casually.
unit.target: "Quis est illē?" inquit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: Ron glanced around and lowered his voice.
unit.target: Ron circumspēciebat et vocem demīsit.

unit.source: “He resides in a suite at B18, a servant of Mr. Iveljsta.
unit.target: "Illē habitat in conclāve B18, servus Domini Iveljsta,

unit.source: “That gentleman’s servants don’t seem normal.”
unit.target: et servi illius dominī nōn videntur esse ordinārī."

unit.source: Of course, it’s not normal. They are walking corpses… Lumian criticized.
unit.target: Certe, nōn est normale. Ambulant cadāvera… Lumian increpāvit.

unit.source: He had already observed the servant and realized his fate was dark and that of a deceased.
unit.target: Servum iam observāverat et intellexerat fatum eius esse obscūrum et simile mortuōrum.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised to encounter such a situation in a country that once worshipped Death.
unit.target: Lumian nōn mirātus est talem condicionem in terra, quae olim Mortem collaudābat, occurrere.

unit.source: Having already seen the Blood Emperor’s afterimage, encountering a zombie was hardly shocking.
unit.target: Iam imaginem Imperatoris Sanguinis visō, occurrere zombi vix stupefactum erat.

unit.source: In the sweltering evening, Lumian bypassed the artificial deep valley where Hotel Orella stood and entered a street with an unpronounceable name.
unit.target: In vespere suffocantī, Lumian vallēm profundam artificiālem, ubi Hotel Orella stabat, praetereīit et in plateam cum nomine inpronunciabili ingressus est.

unit.source: He spotted a bar adorned with an exaggerated Man-Eating Flower.
unit.target: Animādvertit tabernam ornatam flōre “Man-Eating Flower” exaggeratō.

unit.source: Donning a golden straw hat, he lit the East Balam cigarette purchased from the hotel lobby and placed it between his lips.
unit.target: Pileo stramineō aureō indūtus, accendit cigaaretam East Balam, ex atriō hotel acquisitā, et inter labra posuit.

unit.source: Cough, cough, cough!
unit.target: Tüssis, tüssis, tüssis!

unit.source: Lumian quickly coughed, emitting white smoke from his nose.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter tussivit, fumum album e nāsō efferēns.

unit.source: His intention was to showcase his experience as an experienced adventurer by smoking East Balam cigarettes, but he hadn’t anticipated their potency.
unit.target: Propositum eius erat experientiā suā enarrantem ūtī, fumigandō cigaaretās East Balam, sed illōrum potentiam nōn praevidit.

unit.source: As someone who rarely smoked, he found it unbearable.
unit.target: Quia raro fumābat, id intolerābile invenit.

unit.source: In Cordu, various cheap alcohols abounded, but cigarettes were scarce.
unit.target: In Cordū, varia alcoholia vilia abundābant, sed cigaaretās raro inveniebantur.

unit.source: Lumian had only witnessed Pons Bénet, Louis Lund, and a few others indulging in smoking.
unit.target: Lumian tantum Pons Bénet, Louis Lund, et paucos alios fumantēs conspectus habuerat.

unit.source: After extinguishing the East Balam cigarette and tossing it into the trash can, Lumian entered the bar and skillfully approached the counter.
unit.target: Postquam cigaaretam East Balam exstinxit eamque in receptāculum abjēcit, Lumian in tabernam intrāvit et peritē ad tabulam accessit.

unit.source: He pulled up a barstool and settled in.
unit.target: Tabernariam scamnum attulit et consedit.

unit.source: Sensing the lingering smoke in his mouth, he opted for something milder.
unit.target: Fumosum in ore residuum sentiens, aliquid mite eligere constituit.

unit.source: He tapped the counter and spoke in Intisian, “A glass of kilju, the regular kind.”
unit.target: Tabulam pulsavit et in lingua Intisiānā locūtus est, "Calicem kilju, generis ordināriī."

unit.source: “Ten licks,” replied the bartender, a local man in a white shirt and black vest, his Intisian tinged with a distinct accent.
unit.target: "Decem labatōnēs," respondit caupo, vir localis in albā camisiā et nigro vestimēntō, cuius sermo Intisiānus singularī accentū distinctus erat.

unit.source: Lumian settled the bill and awaited the bartender’s pour.
unit.target: Lumian ratiōnem solvit et effūsiōnem cauponis exspectavit.

unit.source: He discreetly surveyed the area, noticing nobody paying him any heed except for a dozen wanted posters adorning the bar’s wall.
unit.target: Areae discreē inspexit, animādvertēns nemēn eum attendere, nisi duodecim posterēs desiderātōs in pariete tabernae.

unit.source: Thoughtfully accepting the amber-colored kilju, he adjusted his golden straw hat and addressed the bartender with a smile, “Do you know who I am?”
unit.target: Cautē kilju ambra colore accipiēns, pileum stramineum aureum aptavit et caupo, subrīdēns, allocūtus est, "Novistine quīs sim?"

unit.source: The bartender glanced at him and smiled back.
unit.target: Caupo eum intuebātur et subrīdens reddidit.

unit.source: “Every now and then, a self-proclaimed renowned adventurer poses that question, but I’m sorry, I don’t know you.”
unit.target: "Interdum, clarus viatōr se ipse praedicēns hanc quaestiōnem proponit, sed me paenitet, tē nōn novi."

unit.source: From the looks of it, the adventurer Louis Berry’s exploits in hunting the Demon Warlock are primarily known in the Fog Sea.
unit.target: Ex aspectū vidētur rēs gestae adventorīs Louis Berry in venātiōne Daemōnis Warlock praesertim notae esse in Mārē Nebulōso.

unit.source: My rising fame was tied to activities within the Church of Earth Mother’s sphere of influence.
unit.target: Mea fama crescente conexa erat actionibus intra sphaeram influentiāris Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Louis Berry’s reputation waned upon entering the Berserk Sea, and few in West Balam are familiar with him…
unit.target: Fama Louis Berry deminūtā est cum in Mārē Berserk intrāret, et paucī in West Balam eum cognoscunt…

unit.source: If Hisoka isn’t stationed at the docks every day, he likely doesn’t know about my arrival in Port Pylos…
unit.target: Si Hisoka nōn quotidie in molibus praesidēt, verisimiliter de adventū meō in Port Pylos nōn noviāt.

unit.source: Lumian refrained from erupting in rage at the bartender’s words.
unit.target: Lumian fūrōrum ne exārsēret verba cauponis cohibuit.

unit.source: He sipped his kilju, contemplating the situation.
unit.target: Kilju sorbuit, rem contemplāns.

unit.source: Noticing Lumian’s silence, the bartender casually smiled and remarked, “You just arrived in the Southern Continent, right?”
unit.target: Lumian silentium animādvertēns, caupo leviter subrīdēns dīxit, "Modo in Continentem Meridionālem pervenīst, nōnne?"

unit.source: “Yes, I left the Berserk Sea this morning.”
unit.target: "Immo, hoc mane Mārē Berserk reliquī."

unit.source: Lumian seamlessly assumed the role of a regular at Ol’ Tavern, recounting his story with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian munus regularis apud "Ol’ Tavern" facile assumpsit, fābulam suam subrīdēns narrāns.

unit.source: “Encountered a ghost ship in the Berserk Sea, danced with dried corpses under the moon, and repelled a Demon’s attack. Praise the Mother of All Things. You might never understand how magical and dangerous the Berserk Sea is…”
unit.target: "Navem phantasmaticam in Mārē Berserk convenī, cum cadāveribus exaridis sub lūnā saltāvī et impetum Daemōnis repulī. Laudetur Mater Omnium Rerum. Forsit numquam intellegēs quanta mōs et perīculum Mārē Berserk sit…"

unit.source: The bartender wiped the glass’s inner wall and interrupted Lumian.
unit.target: Caupo parietem interiorem vitrei evellit et Lumian interpellāvit.

unit.source: “I know. After all, that’s where Death disappeared.”
unit.target: "Scīō. Nam ibi Mors evanuit."

unit.source: “Where Death disappeared?” Lumian asked in surprise.
unit.target: "Ubi Mors evanuit?" inquirīvit Lumian mirātus.

unit.source: While he had speculated about the dangers of the Berserk Sea and abnormal weather being linked to a deity’s demise, he hadn’t expected such an easy answer.
unit.target: Cum de perīculīs Māris Berserk et tempestate insolitā, quae ad deī interitūs pertinēbant, speculāret, talem responsum facile nōn praevidit.

unit.source: The bartender regarded Lumian with an expression that implied, “You’re actually a rookie.”
unit.target: Caupo Lumian aspiciens vultū indicantī, "Revera es novitius," inquit.

unit.source: “Have you never heard of the legend of treasures at sea?
unit.target: "Numquam audīvistine de legenda thesaurōrum in māre?

unit.source: “At the top is Death’s Key. It’s said that at the end of the Fourth Epoch, Death, who had lost the Pale-White War, stirred violent waves to obstruct the returning enemy to Balam, creating insurmountable obstacles that severed the Northern and Southern Continents. However, He ultimately didn’t return to His throne and vanished. Only those with the special key can find Him, discover the treasures He left behind, and gain His boon.”
unit.target: "Ad summum est Clāvis Mortis. Dicitur quod ad finem Quartae Aetātis, Mors, quī Palae-Album Bellum perdidit, undās feroces excitāvit ut hostem rediens ad Balam obstāret, creando obstacula insuperābilia quæ Continēntēs Septentrionālēs et Meridionālēs dividerent. Tamen, nōn ad thronum Suum rediit et evanuit. Solī, quī clavem peculīārem possīdunt, Eum invenīr(e), thesaurōs quī reliquit detegere, et beneficium Suum adipisci possunt."

unit.source: The bartender’s tone was complicated.
unit.target: Tonus cauponis complicātus erat.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent.
unit.target: Lumian silentium cepit.

unit.source: He had embarked on the sea seeking revenge and held little interest in treasure legends. He hadn’t anticipated missing such crucial information.
unit.target: In māre profectus erat ultionem petēns et de legendīs thesaurōrum parum curābat. Tale informationis momentum nōn praevidit.

unit.source: Just then, the heavy wooden door of the bar creaked open.
unit.target: Tum, iānuā lignea gravis tabernae strīdorem edidit, aperta.

unit.source: The once-noisy bar hushed in an instant.
unit.target: Taberna, olim strepitōsa, statim silentium cepit.

unit.source: Sensing the shift in atmosphere, Lumian turned his body, fixing his gaze upon the door.
unit.target: Mutātiōnem atmosphaerae sentiens, Lumian se convertit et oculōs in iānuam fīxos tenuit.

unit.source: 635 Man-Eating Flower
unit.target: 635 Flos Hominum Edens

unit.source: At the entrance of the Man-Eating Flower bar, a figure strode in.
unit.target: Ad ostium tabernae Flos Hominum Edens, figura incedit.

unit.source: A woman, neither towering nor petite, clad in a conservative, deep-black dress, caught everyone’s attention.
unit.target: Femina, nec excelsa nec parva, veste conservativa atque nigro profundo induta, cunctos animos captivavit.

unit.source: Her eyebrows were meticulously drawn, her skin thickly powdered, and her cheeks adorned with noticeable blush.
unit.target: Sobria eius dubiter delineata erant, cutis spissa pulverulata, et genae rubore conspicuo ornatae erant.

unit.source: Her lips shone gorgeously, and the area around her eyes sparkled with gem-like hues.
unit.target: Labia eius pulchre fulgebant, et circa oculos, quasi gemmis, micabant.

unit.source: Despite the woman’s excessive makeup and unconventional style, her captivating brown eyes, high nose bridge, luscious lips, and curvaceous figure emitted a potent charm.
unit.target: Quamvis femina nimis ornamenta faciei et stilum insolitum adhibebat, oculi eius brunnei, altum nasorum septum, labia succulenta, atque figura curvata potentem venustatem efferebant.

unit.source: Male patrons in the bar shifted their gazes to the door, momentarily silent.
unit.target: Masculi convivae in taberna oculos ad ianuam converterunt, per momentum taciti.

unit.source: Only when the woman acknowledged a few customers with an aloof nod did the atmosphere spring to life.
unit.target: Solum cum femina paucos clientes, capite remissius annuente, eos agnoscebat, atmosphaera in vitam rediit.

unit.source: Some attempted conversation, while others raised their voices at their companions, trying to make an impression on her.
unit.target: Alii colloquium inire conabantur, dum alii vocem ad comites elevabant, ut eam afficerent.

unit.source: Without lingering, the woman navigated through the crowd and settled on the opposite side of the bar counter.
unit.target: Sine morae, femina per turbam pergressa in altera parte mensae tabernae consedit.

unit.source: Unique.
unit.target: Unica.

unit.source: If Franca were here, she’d surely strike up a conversation…
unit.target: Si Franca hic esset, certe colloquium iniretur…

unit.source: Lumian felt a twinge of regret for his companion and averted his gaze.
unit.target: Lumian parvam paenitentiam pro socio sensit et aspectum avertit.

unit.source: He smiled at the bartender and commented, “That lady seems quite popular.”
unit.target: Subridens tabernario locutus est: “Illa domina valde nota videtur.”

unit.source: The bartender wiped away the expression reserved for new adventurers and replied sternly,
unit.target: Tabernarius, vultum novis adventoribus reservatum abstergens, severo respondit:

unit.source: “She’s my boss.”
unit.target: “Illa mea domina est.”

unit.source: Boss… Lumian suddenly recalled the bar’s name and asked thoughtfully,
unit.target: “Domina…” Lumian repente nomen tabernae meminit et consideratissime quaesivit:

unit.source: “Man-Eating Flower?”
unit.target: “Flos Hominum Edens?”

unit.source: “It’s her,” the bartender lowered his voice and approached the beautifully made-up woman of indeterminate age.
unit.target: “Illa est,” tabernarius vocem demittens dixit et ad pulchre ornatam feminam incertae aetatis accessit.

unit.source: He poured her a glass of some unknown brand of Black Rand.
unit.target: Ei poculum notae incognitae Black Rand effudit.

unit.source: After the bartender returned, Lumian asked curiously,
unit.target: Postquam tabernarius rediit, Lumian curiosus interrogavit:

unit.source: “Why does she have the nickname ‘Man-Eating Flower?’”
unit.target: “Cur sibi cognomen ‘Flos Hominum Edens’ attribuitur?”

unit.source: “She seems very popular.”
unit.target: “Valde nota videtur.”

unit.source: The bartender instinctively turned his head, observing his boss as she focused on her drink and surveyed the patrons nearby.
unit.target: Tabernarius instinctive caput vertit, dominam suam observans, dum in potionem suam incumbit et convivas prope speculabatur.

unit.source: Leaning in, he whispered,
unit.target: Adplicans se, susurravit:

unit.source: “In Port Pylos, women of her caliber often relish the pursuit and adulation of men but keep them at arm’s length.”
unit.target: “In Portu Pylos, feminae huius gradus saepe delectantur insequendo et laudes virorum, sed eos a se longe servant.”

unit.source: “Our boss, however, is different.”
unit.target: “Dominam nostram autem aliter habet.”

unit.source: “If she takes a liking to you, she’ll extend an invitation for a memorable night.”
unit.target: “Si tibi placeat, te ad noctem memorabilem invitabit.”

unit.source: “Sometimes, we can hear her passion echoing through the halls upstairs…”
unit.target: “Interdum audimus passionem eius per aedes superiores resonare…”

unit.source: The bartender paused, a mix of nostalgia and desire evident on his face.
unit.target: Tabernarius subsedit, vultum ostendens, ex mixtura memoriae et cupiditatis manifeste.

unit.source: Pleasure?
unit.target: Voluptas?

unit.source: Lumian subtly frowned and inquired with a smile, “Have you ever been the object of her affections?”
unit.target: Lumian leniter frondebat et subrisu interrogavit: “Num umquam obiectum eius affectuum fuisti?”

unit.source: The bartender fell silent.
unit.target: Tabernarius silentium cepit.

unit.source: For a moment, Lumian wondered if the other would smash his head with the cup in hand.
unit.target: Per momentum, Lumian cogitavit an alter caput suum poculo in manu tenente confringeret.

unit.source: Changing the subject, Lumian asked, “Aren’t there brash men who try to force themselves on your boss?”
unit.target: Mutato argumento, Lumian quaesivit: “Nonne sunt viri audaces qui conantur se in tuam dominam cogere?”

unit.source: The bartender sighed and replied, “Remember the name of our bar.”
unit.target: Tabernarius suspiravit et respondit: “Memento nominis tabernae nostrae.”

unit.source: Man-Eating Flower… Is that what it means?
unit.target: Flos Hominum Edens… Idne hoc significat?

unit.source: Lumian grasped the meaning.
unit.target: Lumian sensum intellexit.

unit.source: “Those who tried to force themselves on our boss ended up badly.”
unit.target: “Qui in nostram dominam se cogere conati sunt, male evenere.”

unit.source: “Some were severely injured or thrown down the stairs.”
unit.target: “Quidam grave vulnerati sunt aut de scalis coniecti.”

unit.source: “Others simply vanished.”
unit.target: “Alii simpliciter evanuerunt.”

unit.source: “Even those who caught her eye would be pale the next day,
unit.target: “Etiam qui eius oculos attraxerunt, cras pallidi erant,

unit.source: They couldn’t walk properly.”
unit.target: non recte ambulare poterant.

unit.source: “That’s why she’s called ‘Man-Eating Flower.’”
unit.target: “Quare illa ‘Flos Hominum Edens’ vocatur.”

unit.source: “She embraces it.”
unit.target: “Illa id amplectitur.”

unit.source: “Eventually, she named the bar after it.”
unit.target: “Postremo, tabernam huic nomine nominavit.”

unit.source: This is a departure from the Demonesses of Pleasure’s style…
unit.target: Hoc ab more Demonissarum Voluptatis differt…

unit.source: But each demoness has her own unique approach.
unit.target: Sed quaelibet daemonissa suam rationem singularis habet.

unit.source: Franca, a Demoness of Pleasure, stands out from the rest…
unit.target: Franca, daemonissa Voluptatis, inter cetera eminuit…

unit.source: Lumian’s curiosity sated, he didn’t delve further into the bar owner.
unit.target: Curiositate Lumiani satiata, de domina tabernae profundius non exploravit.

unit.source: Instead, he retrieved an ordinary deck of poker cards from his Traveler’s Bag and asked, “Have you come across anyone using poker cards as a weapon recently?”
unit.target: Pro eo, ex sacco Viatoris suo, lamina simplicem chartarum poker extraxit et interrogavit: “Num aliquem nuper invenisti qui chartas poker ut arma utebatur?”

unit.source: According to Anthony Reid’s analysis of Hisoka, a key member of April Fool’s, Hisoka had a strong inclination towards self-expression.
unit.target: Secundum analysim Antonii Reid de Hisoka, membro principali Aprilis Stultitiae, Hisoka vehementer ad sui ipsius exprimendum inclinabat.

unit.source: After successfully creating the poker card with the ability to change its face, possessing Frost and Cut characteristics, it was clear he wouldn’t limit its use to mere April Fool’s pranks.
unit.target: Postquam chartam poker, quae faciem mutare poterat et proprietates “Frost” atque “Cut” habebat, feliciter creaverat, patens erat se eius usum non solum ad ioca Aprilis intendere.

unit.source: When engaged in combat or carrying out acts of violence, he wouldn’t hesitate to employ the mystical item to end his target’s life.
unit.target: In certamine aut actibus violentiae implicatus, non dubitaret hoc obiectum mysticum ad finem vitae propositi sui adhibere.

unit.source: This information presented a promising lead for investigation.
unit.target: Haec notitia ducem sperabilem ad indagandum praebuit.

unit.source: Regarding the two pranks orchestrated by Hisoka, they revolved around Matani and were linked to relatively confidential or significant local affairs.
unit.target: Quoad duas iocas a Hisoka ordinatas, circa Matani versabantur atque rebus localibus, aut secretis aut gravibus, coniunctae erant.

unit.source: Individuals who weren’t locals or lacked prolonged residence wouldn’t spontaneously choose this area unless they also possessed ample information to support their actions.
unit.target: Qui non locales erant aut diu incolae non fuerunt, hanc regionem non sponte elegerent, nisi notitiam satis haberent ad actiones sustinendas.

unit.source: Lumian reasonably suspected that Hisoka’s original sphere of activity centered on Matani and its neighboring regions.
unit.target: Lumian rationabiliter suspicabat originalem ambitum actionis Hisokae in Matani et regionibus contiguis esse.

unit.source: This rationale prompted his journey to Matani, despite believing that Hisoka had likely heeded Loki’s warning and evaded capture, concealing himself.
unit.target: Haec ratio iter eius ad Matani impellit, etiamsi creditum est Hisokam monitionem Loki audivisse et capere evitavisse, se celans.

unit.source: Understanding Hisoka’s past was crucial to deciphering his present and ending his future!
unit.target: Intellectus praeteriti eius crucialis erat ad eius praesens perscrutandum atque futurum terminandum!

unit.source: The native bartender scoffed at Lumian’s inquiry.
unit.target: Tabernarius indigenus ad quaestionem Lumiani irridens respondit.

unit.source: “Do you think I’d have that information?”
unit.target: “Putasne me hanc notitiam habere?”

unit.source: “Consult the patrol team.”
unit.target: “Consulta turma vigiliarum.”

unit.source: “Whether they choose to answer is another matter.”
unit.target: “Utrum respondeant, alia res est.”

unit.source: Patrol team… Lumian didn’t mind and nodded slightly.
unit.target: Turma vigiliarum… Lumian non curabat et leviter annuit.

unit.source: Established by Admiral Querarill, the ruler of Matani, the among Beyonders.
unit.target: Ab admiralio Querarill, regente Matani, inter Beyonders institutum est.

unit.source: In this state, following the withdrawal of most Intis colonial forces, the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Church of God of Steam and Machinery, and the new Cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother lacked official authority to enforce the law.
unit.target: In hoc statu, post recessionem plurimarum copiarum colonialium Intis, Ecclesia Aeternae Ardoris Solis, Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, atque nova Cathedrale Ecclesiae Matris Terrae auctoritate officiali ad legem exsequendam caruerunt.

unit.source: While these churches maintained Beyonder teams in their cathedrals across different cities, their jurisdiction was limited to self-defense and safeguarding believers within the cathedral.
unit.target: Dum hae ecclesiae turmas Beyonder in suis cathedralibus per varias urbes conservabant, jurisdictio eorum ad auto-defensionem et ad fideles intra cathedralem tuendos circumscripta erat.

unit.source: They couldn’t address matters akin to their usual spheres of influence or eliminate potential hidden dangers.
unit.target: Negotia, quae ordinatae circumferentis potentiae erant, agere aut pericula latenta tollere non poterant.

unit.source: Admiral Querarill entrusted the corresponding authority to the newly formed patrol team.
unit.target: Admiralis Querarill auctoritatem novae turmae vigiliarum tradidit.

unit.source: Some of the patrol team’s Beyonders were veterans from Admiral Querarill’s army, while others were remnants of the former Balam Empire or former adventurers and bounty hunters.
unit.target: Nonnulli ex Beyonder turmae vigiliarum veterani erant ex exercitu Admiralis Querarill, alii reliquiae olim Imperii Balam aut olim adventorum ac praedonum.

unit.source: What a simple name… Lumian pondered for a moment as he glanced at the few wanted posters on the wall.
unit.target: Quale nomen simplex… Lumian per momentum meditatus est dum paucas ephemerides “wanted” in pariete intuebatur.

unit.source: “Admiral Querarill doesn’t want adventurers turning Matani into a hunting paradise? He doesn’t want them brawling on the streets under the guise of pursuing targets on wanted posters?”
unit.target: “Admiralis Querarill num non vult adventores Matani in paradisum venationis convertere? Num non vult eos in viis, sub excusatione metas in ephemeridibus ‘wanted’ persequi?”

unit.source: The bartender shot Lumian a surprised look.
unit.target: Tabernarius Lumianum, aspectu mirato, intuebatur.

unit.source: “You’re quite sharp for an adventurer.”
unit.target: “Es acutus admodum pro adventore.”

unit.source: “In Matani, the wanted status is earned through crimes committed here. No one cares about your actions elsewhere.”
unit.target: “In Matani, status ‘wanted’ per crimina hic commissa adipisci potest. Nemo alibi actus tuos attendit.”

unit.source: As expected of one of the adventure paradises… Lumian lifted the kilju and finished it.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur in uno ex paradisibus adventurarum… Lumian kilju sustulit et perconsumpsit.

unit.source: Just as he was about to switch to a glass of West Balam–specific liquor to savor its distinct flavors, he felt a gaze upon him.
unit.target: Iam cum ad poculum liquoris West Balam, cuius sapores distinctos degustare intendebat, converteri pararetur, sensit quemquam eum intueri.

unit.source: It was the owner of the Man-Eating Flower bar, the woman in the black dress with exquisite makeup.
unit.target: Erat domina tabernae Flos Hominum Edens, femina in veste nigra, facie exquisita ornata.

unit.source: Lumian nodded calmly and shifted his focus back to the bartender.
unit.target: Lumian tranquille annuit et iterum ad tabernarium spectavit.

unit.source: While this Man-Eating Flower was undoubtedly attractive, she couldn’t match a Demoness in terms of feminine allure.
unit.target: Quamquam haec Flos Hominum Edens indubitanter decora erat, eam daemonissa voluptatis in venustate feminili superare non potuit.

unit.source: Additionally, Lumian wasn’t fond of heavy makeup.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian ornamenta gravia non delectabant.

unit.source: At that moment, the woman rose from her seat and sauntered over to Lumian.
unit.target: In illo momento, femina ex sede surrexit et ad Lumian complacide accessit.

unit.source: She curled her lips and remarked, “I can sense that you’re like me, a living volcano, but it hasn’t erupted yet.”
unit.target: Labris contrahentibus, dixit: “Sentio te simile mihi esse, quasi vulcanus vivus, sed nondum erupit.”

unit.source: “You’re still enduring and waiting in pain.”
unit.target: “Adhuc sustines et in dolore exspectas.”

unit.source: “Tonight, are you willing to feel my passion?”
unit.target: “Hac nocte, velisne passionem meam sentire?”

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his face.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et faciem suam tetigit.

unit.source: “You’re taken with me just like that?”
unit.target: “Num statim mihi attrahiris?”

unit.source: Come to think of it, I’ve been a hit with the ladies since my youth.
unit.target: Memento, ex iuventute, feminis mihi favebam.

unit.source: Being a Hunter, I’ve often found myself surrounded by all sorts of beauties…
unit.target: Ut Venator, saepe me multarum specierum pulchritudine circumdari invenio.

unit.source: Could this be the subtle influence of the True Men pathway?
unit.target: Num hoc sit subtilis influxus semitae Virorum Verorum?

unit.source: It doesn’t add up.
unit.target: Non convenit.

unit.source: According to The Adventurer series and recent sea rumors, Mr. Fool’s Oracle, Danitz, is also from the Hunter pathway, yet his romantic endeavors were fruitless, and he doesn’t boast any notable female companions…
unit.target: Secundum seriem “The Adventurer” et recentia rumora maritima, Dominus Fool’s Oracle, Danitz, quoque ex semita Venatoris est, sed conatus eius amorosi frustra fuerunt et nullam notabilem comitricem feminam gloriatur.

unit.source: Lumian muttered internally and stood up.
unit.target: Lumian intus susurravit et surrexit.

unit.source: He offered a smile and inquired, “How should I address you?”
unit.target: Subridens quaesivit: “Quomodo te alloquem?”

unit.source: “Bellotia.”
unit.target: “Bellotia.”

unit.source: The woman’s smile relaxed, making Lumian feel that she might appear even more stunning without her heavy makeup.
unit.target: Risus feminae laxatus est, faciens Lumian sentire eam sine gravibus cosmetica etiam pulchriorem videri posse.

unit.source: Lumian took off his golden straw hat, pressed it to his chest, and bowed slightly.
unit.target: Lumian pileum aureum stramineum detraxit, ad pectus apposuit, et leviter inclinavit.

unit.source: “Madam Bellotia, I appreciate your invitation, but there’s someone else I hold dear.”
unit.target: “Domina Bellotia, invitationem tuam aestimo, sed aliquis alius mihi carus est.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he disregarded Bellotia’s slightly stiffened expression and made his way past the Man-Eating Flower, heading for the bar’s entrance with composed demeanor.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, vultum Paululum rigidum Bellotiae neglexit et praeter Flos Hominum Edens processit, ad ostium tabernae, animi constantia, accessit.

unit.source: Bellotia didn’t stop him.
unit.target: Bellotia eum non retinuit.

unit.source: Like numerous patrons in the bar, she observed as he swung open the sturdy wooden door and stepped out.
unit.target: Ut multi convivae in taberna, illa eum observavit dum ostium lignea robusta aperiret et exire coepit.

unit.source: As the wooden door thudded shut behind him, Lumian sneered and muttered to himself, “I can resist even the charm of a Demoness of Pleasure.”
unit.target: Dum ostium lignea post eum ruens claudebatur, Lumian irrise submurmuravit: “Etiam daemonissae voluptatis venustati resistere possum.”

unit.source: Why take the risk with a woman of unknown origins?
unit.target: Cur periculum cape cum femina originis ignotae?

unit.source: Using someone I like as an excuse is already preserving your dignity.
unit.target: Aliquem, quem amo, uti excusatione iam dignitatem tuam servas.

unit.source: If you still seek revenge, I won’t hold back…
unit.target: Si adhuc ultio te movet, non retinebo…

unit.source: Having left the bar early, Lumian wandered through the nearby streets, exploring secluded alleys in hopes of stumbling upon incidents or criminals to gather information.
unit.target: Tabernae exitu mature, Lumian per vias prope vagatus est, angulos isolatos explorans, sperans casus aut criminosos inveniendi causa notitiam colligere.

unit.source: After turning a few corners, he suddenly heard a clanging sound emanating from a dark and deserted alley.
unit.target: Postquam pauca angula vertit, repente sonitum tintinnantem ex obscuro et desertico angulo audivit.

unit.source: Silently, Lumian approached and delved into the alley.
unit.target: Silentissime, Lumian accessit et in angulum se immergit.

unit.source: There, he witnessed an intense battle between two men.
unit.target: Ibi testatus est proelium acrum inter duos viros.

unit.source: One, with evident native characteristics, appeared in his twenties.
unit.target: Unus, cum signis indigenis manifestae, ad viginti annos natus apparuit.

unit.source: His face was pallid, and he wielded a sharp but hefty dagger in his right hand.
unit.target: Vultus ejus pallidus erat, et in dextra manu gladium acutum sed robustum gerebat.

unit.source: His left palm was slightly open, and a dark shadow hovered in it, creating a chilling atmosphere.
unit.target: Manus sinistra paulum patefacta erat, et in ea umbra atra latabat, atmosphaeram terribiliter efficiens.

unit.source: The other, in his early thirties, had ordinary facial features and an expressionless demeanor.
unit.target: Alter, in annis truentis initio, faciem communem et expressionem impassibilem habebat.

unit.source: Short, black hair framed his face, and his dark-green eyes were encircled by white.
unit.target: Breves, nigri capilli faciem eius ornabant, et oculi eius, virides obscuri, albo circumfusum erant.

unit.source: Clad in a plain white shirt and black pants, he wielded longer, sharper weapons resembling scalpels in each hand.
unit.target: Indutus camisia alba simplex et braccis nigris, in utraque manu arma longiora ac acutiora, quae scalpellis similia erant, gerebat.

unit.source: At this moment, the two engaged in a fierce battle, their weapons clashing rapidly, resonating with metallic clangs.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, duo in proelio acerbo certabant, arma celeriter inter se collidens, sonis metallicis resonantes.

unit.source: Observing the skirmish, Lumian recognized that these weren’t ordinary individuals.
unit.target: Spectans pugnam, Lumian perspexit hos non esse homines ordinarios.

unit.source: They both bore Beyonder characteristics.
unit.target: Ambo notas Beyonder habebant.

unit.source: Halting his advance, Lumian nonchalantly stood with his hands in his pockets, his right foot propped up against the wall.
unit.target: Sistens, Lumian manibus in sinu positis, dextro pede ad murum innixo, non sollicitus stetit.

unit.source: He unabashedly observed the close-quarters combat between these Beyonders.
unit.target: Absque ullo verecundo, certamen propinquo inter hos Beyonder observavit.

unit.source: 636 Catharsis
unit.target: 636 Catharsis

unit.source: In just over ten seconds, the two Beyonders locked in combat sensed an observer and instinctively distanced themselves, fixing their gaze on Lumian.
unit.target: In paulo plus quam decem secundis, duo Beyonders—in proelio coniuncti—observatorem sensitaverunt et instinctive se abstulerunt, oculos in Lumian fixaverunt.

unit.source: Casually leaning against the alley wall, Lumian chuckled and remarked,
unit.target: Casualiter ad parietem vici recumbens, Lumian subridens inquit,

unit.source: “Go on, keep fighting.”
unit.target: “Age, perge pugnare.”

unit.source: “Don’t mind me.”
unit.target: “Noli me curare.”

unit.source: With a heavy dagger in hand, the young native, his left palm slightly open, eyed the black‑haired, green‑eyed, handsome, golden straw hat‑donning Lumian with vigilance.
unit.target: Pugione gravi in manu tenens, iuvenis indigena, manu sinistra paulo aperta, Lumianum vigilantia intuebatur, qui capillis atris, oculis viridibus, formosus, et pileum ex stramine aureo gerens erat.

unit.source: Who is this?
unit.target: Quis est hic?

unit.source: What is he up to?
unit.target: Quid agit?

unit.source: The short‑haired man, armed with two odd‑shaped scalpels, was equally vigilant.
unit.target: Vir capillato brevi, duobus scalpellis forma insolita armatus, aeque vigilantia praedita erat.

unit.source: He, too, eyed Lumian and the vigilant young native.
unit.target: Ipse quoque Lumianum et iuvenem indigena vigilantem intuebatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, he crouched, arms hanging loose, and black, sulfurous smoke enveloped him completely.
unit.target: Subito genu flectit, brachia laxa pendentia, et fumus niger sulphureus eum omnino obvolvit.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile didn’t waver; his right eyebrow arched in mild interest.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani non vacillavit; supercilium dextro leniter arcuatum est.

unit.source: Unfazed, the young native extended his slightly open left hand, releasing a shadow that expanded into a distorted “black cloud.”
unit.target: Imperturbatus, iuvenis indigena manum sinistram paulo apertam protulit, umbram dimittens, quae in nubem nigram deformem expandebatur.

unit.source: This “black cloud” merged with the sulfurous smoke, swiftly clearing the alley.
unit.target: Haec nubes nigra cum fumo sulphureo coniuncta est, celerrime vicum purgans.

unit.source: The crimson moon once again illuminated the scene.
unit.target: Luna coccinea iterum scenam illustravit.

unit.source: However, the short‑haired man, with dark‑green eyes and an emotionless expression, had vanished.
unit.target: Attamen vir capillato brevi, oculis viridibus et vultu impassibili, evanuerat.

unit.source: Ran off?
unit.target: Fugitne?

unit.source: The young native was shocked, angry, and vexed.
unit.target: Iuvenis indigena stupefactus, iratus, et contrariatus erat.

unit.source: As he sought clues, he instinctively turned his head to where Lumian had been.
unit.target: Dum quaerebat signa, caput suum instanti vertit ad locum, ubi Lumian fuerat.

unit.source: No one stood before the wall.
unit.target: Nemo ante murum stabat.

unit.source: When did he leave?
unit.target: Quando discessit?

unit.source: Why didn’t I sense it at all?
unit.target: Cur id omnino non sensi?

unit.source: The young native, holding the heavy dagger, pondered in bewilderment, uncertain whether to pursue his target.
unit.target: Iuvenis indigena, pugione gravi tenens, stupefactus meditatus est, incertus utrum propositum persequi vellet.

unit.source: Relying on his spell‑like abilities, Bram skillfully escaped the alley, stowing away the two odd‑shaped scalpels.
unit.target: Innixus facultatibus suis, quae instar incantationum erant, Bram callide vicum effugit, duos scalpellos forma insolita celans.

unit.source: He navigated the dark, unlit paths, frequently changing directions in an attempt to lose his imaginary pursuer.
unit.target: Per obscuras et non illustratas vias peragravit, saepe directionem mutans, ut insequentem imaginarium perdere conaretur.

unit.source: In the process, he pried open a shoemaker’s shop on the street, donned a pair of ill‑fitting leather shoes, and discreetly handled any signs of his intrusion.
unit.target: In processu, officinam sutoriam in via aperuit, par calceorum ex coriaceo male aptos induit, et signa incursioni suae caute tractavit.

unit.source: After circling three times, Bram returned to the alley, entering a simple apartment nearby, constructed from black stones and brown wood.
unit.target: Post tres circuitus, Bram vicum redivit, intrans in simplex domicilium prope, ex lapidibus nigris et ligno fusco constructum.

unit.source: Bram opened his room and entered, closing the wooden door behind him.
unit.target: Bram cubiculum suum aperuit et intravit, ostium ligneum post se claudens.

unit.source: He finally breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Denique suspirium solacii emiit.

unit.source: Then, he withdrew a transparent glass bottle from the gray‑ish‑white cloth bag hanging from his waist.
unit.target: Deinde, e sacco panno colore griseo–albo pendentem, ampullam vitream translucidam extraxit.

unit.source: The bottle held a nearly colorless liquid, faintly tinged with red.
unit.target: Ampulla fluidum paene incolorem continebat, leviter rubro tinctum.

unit.source: Suspended within, a blood‑colored, well‑defined mouth hung open, frozen in intense pain and fear.
unit.target: Intra suspensa, os sanguine colore tinctum et distincte determinatum, apertum pendebat, dolore ac timore acerbo congelatum.

unit.source: As if admiring a masterpiece, Bram stared entranced at the glass bottle in his grasp.
unit.target: Velut opus magnum contemplans, Bram ampullam vitream in manu tenentem extasi intuebatur.

unit.source: After a moment, he averted his gaze, moved to the side of the room, and opened a cupboard.
unit.target: Post momentum, conspectum avertit, ad latus cubiculi se contulit, et armarium aperuit.

unit.source: Within the cupboard, seven or eight similar glass bottles awaited, each containing a unique lip.
unit.target: In armario, septem aut octo ampullae vitreae similes exsistebant, quarum unaquaeque labium singularem continebat.

unit.source: The hues varied, some slightly upturned, others in a pouting stance.
unit.target: Colorum variae erant; quidam leviter subversi, alii vultum contritum exhibebant.

unit.source: Bram positioned his newly acquired spoils in an empty spot, then used sticky blood‑colored paint to draw an ominous symbol.
unit.target: Bram praedae nuper acquirtae in spatio vacuo collocavit, deinde pitturam viscosam sanguine colore tinctam ad symbolum ominosum delineandum usus est.

unit.source: With the task complete, his fingers gently explored different lips through the glass bottles, as if assessing each piece in an art exhibition.
unit.target: Opus perfectum habens, digiti eius leniter diversos labia per ampullas vitreas explorabant, quasi singula in expositione artis aestimarent.

unit.source: “How twisted.”
unit.target: “Quam distortum.”

unit.source: A mocking sigh suddenly resonated in Bram’s ears.
unit.target: Subito suspirium derisorium in auribus Brami resonavit.

unit.source: Startled, he whirled around, focusing on the source of the voice.
unit.target: Stupefactus, circum se vertit, et ad fontem vocis oculos intendit.

unit.source: A golden straw hat‑donning young man with black hair and green eyes sat in an armchair by the table, the top two buttons of his white shirt now casually undone.
unit.target: Juvenis, pileum stramineum aureum gerebat, capillis atris et oculis viridibus ornatus, in solio prope mensam sedebat; duo butona suprema albae vestis eius nunc levis dissoluta erant.

unit.source: Him?
unit.target: Ille?

unit.source: Bram’s pupils dilated as he recognized the man who had witnessed his clash with the Numinous Episcopate member.
unit.target: Pupillae Brami dilatatae sunt, cum agnovisset virum, qui certamen eius cum membro Episcopatus Numinosi testatus fuerat.

unit.source: The person who had witnessed his battle with the Numinous Episcopate member!
unit.target: Ille, qui certamen eius cum membro Episcopatus Numinosi vidit!

unit.source: When did he tail me?
unit.target: Quando me secutus est?

unit.source: How did he pinpoint my location without detection…
unit.target: Quomodo locum meum sine deprehensione definivit…

unit.source: Lumian smiled and cordially responded to the other’s unspoken queries,
unit.target: Lumian subridens et comiter respondit tacitis quaestionibus alterius,

unit.source: “Hasn’t anyone informed you that the preservative in those glass bottles is quite noticeable?
unit.target: “Numquid nemo tibi nuntiavit, quod in illis ampullis vitreis conservans satis conspicuus sit?

unit.source: “Moreover, you reek of blood after killing someone.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, foetorem sanguinis geris, postquam aliquem occidisti.”

unit.source: Bram’s heart tightened.
unit.target: Cor Brami contraxum est.

unit.source: “Are you a Hunter?”
unit.target: “Esne Venator?”

unit.source: As he spoke, he moved slowly and quietly.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, lente et tacite se movebat.

unit.source: “You seem to know a lot,” Lumian replied calmly.
unit.target: “Videtur te multa scire,” Lumian sedate respondit.

unit.source: “So, why collect those lips, preserve them, and carry them with you?
unit.target: “Ergo, cur illa labia colligis, conserva et tecum feras?

unit.source: That doesn’t sound like the work of a seasoned Serial Killer.
unit.target: Id non videtur opus veterani sicarii.

unit.source: I get it.
unit.target: Intellego.

unit.source: You have the urge and the necessity to gather trophies.
unit.target: Tibi est desiderium atque necessitas trophaea colligere.

unit.source: Is it for your own satisfaction or part of a ritual?
unit.target: Estne ad tuam ipsius voluptatem, an pars rituum?

unit.source: Heh heh, desire can be destructive.
unit.target: Heh heh, desiderium destructivum esse potest.

unit.source: Even the most Cold‑blooded are prone to errors, despite their calculated demeanor, often wagering that they won’t be caught if they overlook the details.
unit.target: Etiam sanguine frigidi erroribus subiecti sunt, et licet more calculato agant, saepe putantes se non capientur, si singularia neglecta relinquant.

unit.source: Observing the twisted murderer summon black, sulfurous smoke, Lumian deduced that he was a Sequence 7 Serial Killer following the Criminal pathway.
unit.target: Observans homicidam contortum evocare fumum nigrum et sulphureum, Lumian concludit eum esse Sicarium Sequentiae VII, viam criminalem sequens.

unit.source: In the Devilology book of the New City of Silver, it was noted that upon reaching Sequence 8 Cold‑blooded, also known as the Unwinged Angel, individuals underwent inhuman changes, acquiring two or three Devil spell‑like abilities, varying from person to person.
unit.target: In libro Devilologiae Novi Urbis Argenteae, notatum est quod, pervenientes ad Sequentiam VIII Sanguine Frigidum—nota etiam ut Angelus Sine Alis—homines mutationes inhumanas subierunt, ac duos aut tres facultates similes daemonibus incantationibus acquisiverunt, quae a singulis variabantur.

unit.source: Some wielded poisonous flames, while others inflicted damaging curses.
unit.target: Quidam flammas venenosas gerebant, alii maledicta nocentia infligebant.

unit.source: The creation of black smoke was one such ability.
unit.target: Creatio fumus nigri erat una ex his facultatibus.

unit.source: Combining the target’s actions in battle, Lumian concluded he was merely a Sequence 7 Serial Killer.
unit.target: Coniunctis actis propositi in pugna, Lumian concludit eum esse nihil aliud quam Sicarium Sequentiae VII.

unit.source: Bram’s brow twitched at Lumian’s mockery and sarcasm.
unit.target: Supercilium Brami, ob derisionem et sarcasmum Lumiani, convulsum est.

unit.source: Maintaining his cool, he advanced and murmured, “Did you come here just to converse? What is it you seek from me?”
unit.target: Se refrigerans, progressus est et murmuravit: “Venisti hic tantum ut colloquaris? Quid a me quaeris?”

unit.source: As soon as he finished speaking, dense black smoke billowed from the Serial Killer, carrying a pungent sulfuric aroma.
unit.target: Statim, cum sermonem finivit, densus fumus niger a Sicario emersit, odore sulphureo acre impregnatus.

unit.source: Within the shroud of the dark smoke, Bram’s eyes deepened as he unleashed another Devil spell.
unit.target: In medio fumi obscuri, oculi Brami profundiores facti sunt, dum aliam incantationem daemonum dimisit.

unit.source: His body morphed, adopting the color of a chameleon, seamlessly blending with the spreading smoke.
unit.target: Corpus eius mutatum est, colorem chameleontis sumens, et perfecte cum fumo diffuso coalescens.

unit.source: Swift and silent, he approached the door, opened it with precision, and lunged outside.
unit.target: Celeri et tacito animo, ad ostium accessit, eum precise aperuit et foras impetum fecit.

unit.source: Bram’s vision distorted, and amidst the lingering black smoke, he glimpsed the green‑eyed man in the armchair, grinning at him.
unit.target: Visus Brami distortus est, et inter fumum nigrum manentem, vir oculis viridibus in solio sedens eum ridens intuebatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, he found himself back in the room.
unit.target: Subito se iterum in cubiculo invenit.

unit.source: Contrary to his previous orientation, he now faced away from the door.
unit.target: Nunc, priscam dispositionem contrariam habens, aostio se avertit.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Ampulla Fictionis!

unit.source: Upon infiltrating the room, Lumian’s initial action wasn’t a pose but the creation of a Bottle of Fiction, one that prevented Beyonders from exiting!
unit.target: Intratus cubiculum, prima actio Lumiani non erat simulatio, sed creatio Ampullae Fictionis, quae Beyonders exire prohibebat.

unit.source: Unfazed by the sudden wave of disappointment and frustration, Bram darted to the side within the obscurity of the black smoke obscuring his vision.
unit.target: Non perturbatus repentinae desperationis et frustrationis unda, Bram ad latus confugit, in obscuritate fumus nigri, quae visionem eius obnubilabat.

unit.source: Rolling to the bedside, he retrieved a six‑barrel machine gun.
unit.target: Volvens ad lectum, tulit tormentum sex‑canale.

unit.source: Raising the machine gun, he aimed it at Lumian and unleashed a barrage of bullets.
unit.target: Elevans tormentum sex‑canale, eum in Lumian direxit et turbam pilorum dimisit.

unit.source: Amidst the rapid gunfire, Lumian disappeared from the armchair, the furniture torn apart by the storm of metal projectiles.
unit.target: Inter rapidum telorum iacula, Lumian ex solio evanuit, supellecta a procella proiectorum metallicorum direptas.

unit.source: Gone?
unit.target: Evanuit?

unit.source: As this realization hit Bram, he instinctively glanced upward and witnessed the man in the golden straw hat descending from the ceiling.
unit.target: Cum haec conspicua Brami animadvertit, instinctu sursum aspexit et vir, pileum stramineum aureum gerentem, a laqueari descendere vidit.

unit.source: Surrounding him were numerous crimson, almost white, flaming ravens.
unit.target: Circum eum erant numerosi corvi, coccinei et paene albi, quasi igni ardentes.

unit.source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Fire Ravens assailed Bram before Lumian’s arrival.
unit.target: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Corvi ignis similes Bramo oppresserunt ante adventum Lumiani.

unit.source: Caught within the encirclement, Bram reluctantly abandoned the six‑barrel machine gun.
unit.target: Inclusus in obsidione, Bram, vix nolens, tormentum sex‑canale deseruit.

unit.source: Attempting to evade the impending explosion, he sought refuge under the bed.
unit.target: Tentans imminentem explosionem vitare, sub lectum refugium quaesivit.

unit.source: However, the crimson, nearly white Fire Ravens dissipated on their own.
unit.target: Attamen corvi ignis similes, coccinei et paene albi, sua sponte disperserunt.

unit.source: Lumian landed before him, adorned with a gray‑ish‑white lightning brooch.
unit.target: Lumian ante eum appulit, fibula fulminis cinereo‑albae induta.

unit.source: He smiled and said, “Didn’t you just ask me what I wanted?
unit.target: Subridens inquit: “Nonne modo me interrogasti quid velim?

unit.source: What I want is simple.
unit.target: Quod volo, simplex est.

unit.source: I haven’t vented for too long.
unit.target: Nondum diu effudivi.

unit.source: I’m in dire need of a humanoid sandbag.”
unit.target: Magnopere mihi opus est humanoide saccus arenae.

unit.source: As he finished speaking, Lumian swung his fist at the retreating Bram.
unit.target: Cum sermonem finivit, Lumian pugnus suus in Bram recedentem percusit.

unit.source: Instinctively, Bram raised his right arm to block.
unit.target: Instinctu, Bram brachium dextro levavit ad oppugnationem obstruendam.

unit.source: With a resounding bang, a silver‑white bolt of lightning surged from Lumian’s fist into Bram’s arm, coursing through his entire body.
unit.target: Magno strepitu, fulgur argenteo‑albus e pugno Lumiani in bracchium Brami erupit, totum corpus eius percurrens.

unit.source: Bram shuddered.
unit.target: Bram tremuit.

unit.source: Despite his inhuman transformation, a momentary paralysis gripped him.
unit.target: Non obstante mutatione inhumana, momentanea paralysi eum ceperat.

unit.source: Lumian’s other fist followed suit, crashing into Bram’s side profile.
unit.target: Alterum pugnus Lumiani secutus est, in flankem Brami impellens.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: The Serial Killer’s head tilted, and a spray of teeth accompanied by blood scattered.
unit.target: Caput Sicarii inclinatum est, et disseminata sunt dentes cum sanguine.

unit.source: Once more, silver‑white lightning enveloped Bram’s head.
unit.target: Iterum, fulgur argenteo‑albus caput Brami obvolvit.

unit.source: Bam! Bam! Bam! Lumian unleashed a barrage of punches, turning the encounter into a tempest, making Bram feel like he was caught in a thunderstorm.
unit.target: Bam! Bam! Bam! Lumian turbam pugnarum dimisit, certamen in tempestatem convertens, ita ut Bram quasi in tempestate tonitrui caperetur.

unit.source: The electric shocks made any form of retaliation or defense nearly impossible.
unit.target: Impulsi electrici quoad ullam repugnantiam aut defensionem paene impossibilem fecerunt.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Bang! Bang! Bang!

unit.source: Lumian’s expression remained icy as he relentlessly struck Bram’s face, chest, arms, and head.
unit.target: Vultus Lumiani glacialis mansit, dum pertinaciter faciem, pectus, brachia, et caput Brami percutiebat.

unit.source: The Criminal Pathway Beyonder’s chest caved, ribs cracked, face swelled, and skull fractured.
unit.target: Pectus Beyonder cecidit, costae confractae sunt, facies tumuerunt, et cranium confractum est.

unit.source: Charred marks covered his upper body after the brutal assault.
unit.target: Signa combusta corpus eius superius post impetum crudelissimum tegebant.

unit.source: After the relentless beating, Lumian clenched his fists and raised his arm.
unit.target: Post incessantem caedem, Lumian manus constringens et brachium elevavit.

unit.source: He crashed into Bram’s left shoulder.
unit.target: In humerum sinistrum Brami impetum fecit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: Bram’s left shoulder crumpled entirely.
unit.target: Humerus sinistrum Brami omnino deiectus est.

unit.source: Collapsed on the ground, twisted and gasping, Bram’s breath weakened.
unit.target: Collapsus in terram, contortus et anhelans, spiritus Brami languidus factus est.

unit.source: “That’s it? It’s fine. I can get my servant to treat you before continuing,” Lumian remarked, wearing a devilish smile that Bram recognized all too well.
unit.target: “Hoc estne? Bene est. Servum meum ad te curandum mandare possum antequam pergam,” inquit Lumian, subrisu diabolico indutus, quem Bram multum notus erat.

unit.source: Without awaiting Bram’s fearful response, Lumian removed the Fury of the Sea brooch, stowing it back into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Nullo exspectans responsum timorosum Brami, Lumian fibulam “Furoris Maris” abstulit et in sacco Viatoris recondidit.

unit.source: In a gentle tone, he inquired, “Tell me, which family are you from?”
unit.target: Dulci toni, rogavit: “Dic mihi, ex qua familia es?”
