unit.source: Bram, undergoing the initial stages of dehumanization with a robust physique, realized Lumian had purposely avoided vital points in his attacks, leaving him far from unconsciousness.
unit.target: Bram, in initialibus dehumanizationis gradibus versans, corpore robusto instructus, animadvertit Lumian propositos punctos vulnerandi vitasse, eum longe ab insentientia relinquentem.

unit.source: His mind still functioned, and thoughts raced before settling on Lumian’s smile.
unit.target: Mens eius adhuc functionabat, et cogitationes celeriter cursaverunt, antequam in risu Lumiani se collocarent.

unit.source: After a momentary silence, Bram weakly replied, “I’m a member of the Andariel family.”
unit.target: Post momentum silentii, Bram languide respondit: “Ego membrum familiae Andariel sum.”

unit.source: 637 Unexpected Information
unit.target: 637 Notitia Inopinata

unit.source: Andariel, one of the three Devil families… Lumian recognized the last name from Madam Magician and asked with a warm smile, “What brings you to Port Pylos?”
unit.target: Andariel, unus ex tribus familiis diabolicis… Lumian cognomen a Domina Magica agnovit et, risu calido, rogavit: “Quid te ad Portum Pylos ducit?”

unit.source: If it weren’t for the lineage running in Devil families for generations, with descendants naturally inclined towards the Criminal pathway, and the other option of the Prisoner pathway seemingly trouble‑free, Bram Andariel couldn’t shake the suspicion that the man before him carried the last name Nois or Beria.
unit.target: Nisi ob stirpem, quae per generationes in familiis diabolicis mansit, cum progenies naturaliter ad viam criminosam inclinatae, et altera via captivorum, quae videbatur sine difficultate, Bram Andariel suspicium abicere non potuit, quin vir ante eum cognomen Nois aut Beria ferret.

unit.source: Why did he exude more of a Devil vibe than Bram himself?
unit.target: Cur plus spiritus diabolicus effluēbat quam ipse Bram?

unit.source: Struggling, he lifted his right hand, wiping his swollen and cracked face, cleaning up the blood and flinging it to the ground.
unit.target: Luctans, dextram manum levavit, vultum tumefactum et fissum abstegens, sanguinem purgans atque in terram iactavit.

unit.source: With the task completed, Bram responded, “Firstly, it’s to gather information about Matani for the family. Secondly, it’s to find an opportunity to act as a Serial Killer. Do you know what acting is?”
unit.target: Cum munus completum esset, Bram respondit: “Primum, ad colligendas notitias de Matani pro familia; secundo, ad inveniendam occasionem ut Interfector Serialis fungar; scisne quid sit agendi ars?”

unit.source: He cooperated with Lumian by speaking in Intisian.
unit.target: Cum lingua Intisiana loqueretur, cum Lumiano cooperavit.

unit.source: Lumian nonchalantly stood before Bram, who was curled up on the ground, and remarked with a smile,
unit.target: Lumian, indifferenter, coram Bram, qui in terra convolutus iacebat, stetit et cum risu dixit:

unit.source: “Your acting is subpar. You don’t seem to be a criminal with a high IQ.
unit.target: “Ars tua histrionica mediocriter se habet. Non videaris scelestus cum ingenio altissimo.”

unit.source: “Why would the Andariel family gather information about Matani?”
unit.target: “Cur familia Andariel notitias de Matani colligere vellet?”

unit.source: Bram had no intention of concealing the truth for the family.
unit.target: Bram non intendebat veritatem pro familia celare.

unit.source: “We’re cooperating with the Rose School of Thought. They want information on this place.”
unit.target: “Cum Schola Rosi Cogitationis cooperamus, illi notitias de hoc loco quaerunt.”

unit.source: The Rose School of Thought setting its sights on Matani? That’s right.
unit.target: Schola Rosi Cogitationis in Matani intendit? Ita.

unit.source: Matani, seemingly detached from any Northern Continent nation, holds ties to the Feynapotter Kingdom, but their influence is lacking.
unit.target: Matani, quasi a qualibet natione Continenti Septentrionali separatam, nexūs ad Regnum Feynapotter retinet, sed eius potentia caret.

unit.source: With Admiral Querarill’s sway, even if the Rose School of Thought and the Andariel family dispatch only a handful of agents, resisting may prove challenging… Lumian perceived the stark contrast between the Southern and Northern Continents.
unit.target: Cum potentia admiralis Querarill agirentur, etiamsi Schola Rosi Cogitationis et familia Andariel solummodo paucos agentes mitterent, resistentia ardua videbatur… Lumian discrimen acutum inter Continentes Meridionales et Septentrionales animadvertit.

unit.source: Whether in Trier, the Feynapotter Kingdom, or the maritime colonies, Lumian encountered criminal acts and mystical disasters driven by the pursuit of strength and faith.
unit.target: Sive in Trier, sive in Regno Feynapotter, sive in colonis maritimis, Lumian scelera criminalia et calamitas mysticae, ex studio virtutis atque fidei ortae, experivit.

unit.source: Encroachments on factions or cities were rare, but West Balam presented a different scenario on his first day.
unit.target: Intrusiones in factiones aut urbes rarae erant, sed West Balam in prima die rem diversam praebuit.

unit.source: If maritime disorder resulted from chaos, the Southern Continent teemed with factional conflicts, overt or covert, causing widespread chaos.
unit.target: Si perturbatio marina ex chao orta est, Continens Meridionalis factionum conflictibus, sive apertis sive occultis, late diffusa turbam afferebat.

unit.source: Lumian, observing Bram’s wound clotting, questioned further, “What intel does the Rose School of Thought seek?”
unit.target: Lumian, vulneris Brahm coagulatum observans, interrogavit: “Quas notitias Schola Rosi Cogitationis quaerit?”

unit.source: Bram, reflecting, responded, “They want all kinds of information—cathedral locations, military camp details, patrol team compositions, port throughput, daily prices, and the locals’ lives.”
unit.target: Bram, meditans, respondit: “Omnes species notitiarum volunt—loca cathedralium, castrorum militarum singula, ordinationem manipuli vigiliarum, fluxum portus, pretia cotidiana, atque vitas incolarum.”

unit.source: Are they preparing to rule this place in the future? Lumian inquired, puzzled.
unit.target: Parantne ut in futurum hunc locum regnent? Lumian perplexus interrogavit.

unit.source: “To whom will you hand over the information you gathered? Where?”
unit.target: “Cui trades notitias quas collegisti? Ubi?”

unit.source: “It will be written and placed in the study of an empty house at 17 Aleg Street. My uncle, Devajo Andariel, will be responsible for retrieving it. We don’t usually contact each other, and I don’t know where he lives or under what identity,” Bram explained in detail.
unit.target: “Scriptum erit et in studio domus vacuae in via Aleg, numero XVII, collocabitur. Avunculus meus, Devajo Andariel, eam recipere curabit. Inter nos non solimus convenire, nec scio ubi habitet aut sub qua identitate.”

unit.source: “After becoming a Devil, his special ability is to completely skin humans and perform complicated processes to create Beyonder items with usage or time limitations. No matter who it is, as long as he wears the human skin as clothes, he can transform into the other person and complete the corresponding disguise.”
unit.target: “Postquam Diabolus factus est, facultas eius specialis constat in hominum cutem omnimodis excindere et processus intricatos peragere ad res Beyonder creandas cum limitationibus usus aut temporis. Quicumque sit, dummodo cutem humanam ut vestimentum gerat, se in illud alterum transformare atque personam conveniens obumbrare potest.”

unit.source: As Bram spoke, he wiped the blood off his body and flung it to the ground, as if obsessed with cleanliness.
unit.target: Dum Bram loquebatur, sanguinem de corpore suo abstegit et in terram iactavit, quasi puritate immodica obsessus esset.

unit.source: This was mentioned in Devilology… Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Hoc in Diabolicologia commemoratum erat… Lumian cogitans annuit.

unit.source: He pondered for a moment and asked, “Are there any traces of other Devils in Matani?”
unit.target: Paulo meditatus interrogavit: “Num alias vestigia Diaboli in Matani sint?”

unit.source: Perhaps Bram and his uncle weren’t the only ones sent by the Rose School of Thought to gather information.
unit.target: Fortasse Bram et avunculus eius non soli a Schola Rosi Cogitationis missi erant ad notitias colligendas.

unit.source: Bram shook his head.
unit.target: Bram caput concussit.

unit.source: “Not recently.
unit.target: “Non nuper.

unit.source: “However, during my investigation, I stumbled upon a string of serial murders around Port Pylos about four years back.
unit.target: “Tamen, in inquisitione mea incidit mihi series caedum seriarum circa Portum Pylos abhinc quattuor annos.

unit.source: “The victims lay dissected, the scene steeped in blood and marked by the aftermath of a fierce battle. Moreover, the seven casualties were no ordinary individuals; they were Beyonders, ranging from Sequence 7 to Sequence 8.”
unit.target: “Victimae dissectae iacebant, scaena sanguine permeata et vestigiis pugnae ferocis signata. Praeterea, septem caesi non erant homines vulgares; erant Beyonder, ab Ordine VII ad Ordinem VIII.”

unit.source: Listening intently, Lumian felt a surge of intrigue.
unit.target: Attente auscultans, Lumian impulsum curiositatis sensit.

unit.source: As per Franca’s explanation, the name “Hisoka” stemmed from a literary work hailing from the original world of transmigrators like themselves.
unit.target: Secundum explanationem Francae, nomen “Hisoka” ex opere litterario, quod ex mundo originario transmigratorum similium illis proveniebat, oritur.

unit.source: One of the character’s defining traits was an insatiable appetite for combat and the thrill of extinguishing formidable adversaries, reveling in the ecstasy and carnage of claiming lives.
unit.target: Unum ex notis principalibus eius fuit insatiabilis appetitus ad certamen et delectatio in extasi et caede vitae sumendi, adversarios formidabiles extinguendo.

unit.source: If the target was sufficiently potent, he’d patiently await their growth, perhaps even offer a nudge.
unit.target: Si propositum satis potentis esset, patienter incrementum exspectaret, fortasse etiam levi impetu incitare posset.

unit.source: Hisoka, a key member in April Fool’s, adopted this moniker as his code name, driven by an unmistakable urge for self-expression, mirroring this characteristic.
unit.target: Hisoka, membrum clavis in “April Fool’s”, hoc cognomen ut nomen codicis assumpsit, impulsus indubitabilis sui exprimendi sequens, hanc ipsius proprietatem speculans.

unit.source: Hisoka is a Beyonder of the Devil pathway.
unit.target: Hisoka est Beyonder in via Diaboli.

unit.source: Moreover, his targets are Beyonders while he was at the Serial Killer stage.
unit.target: Praeterea, proposita eius sunt Beyonder, cum ipse in statu Interfectoris Serialis versabatur.

unit.source: Unlike other Serial Killers, he doesn’t prey on the weak or ordinary people.
unit.target: Dispar ab aliis Interfectoribus Serialibus, non praedatur infirmis nec vulgaribus hominibus.

unit.source: If he had been a Serial Killer four years ago, he would likely be at least a Sequence 6 by now.
unit.target: Si quattuor annos abhinc Interfector Serialis fuisset, nunc probabiliter saltem Sequencia VI esset.

unit.source: There’s a strong chance he’s a Sequence 5… Yes, he’s concealed his identity very effectively.
unit.target: Alta probabilitas est eum esse Sequenciam V… Ita, identitatem suam valde efficaciter celavit.

unit.source: No one in the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society knows his true pathway… Lumian listened attentively to Bram’s account without interruption.
unit.target: Nemo in Societate Inquisitionis Papionum Capillatorum veram eius viam novit… Lumian Brahmi narrationem attentive et sine intermissione auscultavit.

unit.source: He eagerly pondered the possibility that Hisoka was a Devil or even a Desire Apostle in his mind.
unit.target: Studiose meditatus est de possibilitate, ut Hisoka Diabolus aut etiam Apostolus Desiderii esset.

unit.source: The curled-up Bram glanced up at him, propping his bloody palm on the ground, and straightening his body slightly.
unit.target: Bram, convolutus, eum intuitus est, palmam sanguinolentam in terram ponens et corpus paulo extollens.

unit.source: “This seems like the work of a Serial Killer. Moreover, he’s exceedingly confident in his strength and intellect, daring to target Beyonders. However, I noticed some discrepancies.”
unit.target: “Hoc videtur opus Interfectoris Serialis esse. Praeterea, nimis in sua vi et ingenio confidet, audens Beyonder petere; sed nonnulla discrepantia animadverti.”

unit.source: “What discrepancies?”
unit.target: “Quae discrepantia?”

unit.source: Lumian concealed his joy behind a gentle smile.
unit.target: Lumian laetitiam suam sub tenero risu abscondit.

unit.source: Bram shifted his palm to support himself.
unit.target: Bram palmam vertit ad se sublevandum.

unit.source: “Serial Killers’ victims often exhibit degraded behaviors. For instance, those I’ve selected typically share a common trait: they enjoy inflicting verbal harm and curses upon others for extended periods. Thus, I’d remove their lips and preserve them. However, the seven slain Beyonders had varying identities, backgrounds, and behaviors, lacking the typical degeneracy.”
unit.target: “Victimae Interfectorum Serialium plerumque mores degeneratos ostendunt. Exempli gratia, illi quos selexi commune notam habent: iis placeat verbis nocere atque maledicta diuturnis modis inferre; quapropter labia eorum removerem et conservaem; sed septem interfecti Beyonder diversas identitates, origines et mores ostenderunt, carebant degeneritate typica.”

unit.source: “Perhaps he’s merely a Beyonder with a fascination for serial killing, not necessarily acting out the Devil pathway,”
unit.target: “Forsitan is solum est Beyonder, ob studium caedum seriarum, non vero viam Diaboli in actu exprimens,”

unit.source: Lumian mused, masking his interest with a teasing tone. He added playfully, “Were you subjected to constant verbal violence as a child?”
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, studium suum cum tono iocoso abscondens, et ludenter addidit: “Num in pueritia constanti verbali violentiae affectus es?”

unit.source: And the Coldblooded and Serial Killer potions amplified corresponding resentments and psychological traumas?
unit.target: Et potiones Sanguinis Frigidi et Interfectoris Serialis respectiva rancores et traumatica psychologica amplificaverunt?

unit.source: Bram fell silent, his body gradually stretching out, no longer curled up.
unit.target: Bram siluit, corpus paulatim extendens, non iam convolutum.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian steer the conversation back to the serial murder case from four years ago.
unit.target: Tum tantum Lumian sermonem ad rem caedis seriarum abhinc quattuor annos redirigere constitui.

unit.source: “Do you have detailed information about the seven Beyonders who were killed?
unit.target: “Habesne accuratas notitias de septem Beyonder interfectis?

unit.source: “Did you identify any suspects during the initial investigation?”
unit.target: “Deprehendisti aliquos suspectos in inquisitione initiali?”

unit.source: Bram shook his head slowly.
unit.target: Bram caput lente concussit.

unit.source: “I only had read the summary provided by the patrol team, not the full investigation files.”
unit.target: “Tantum summam ab manipulo vigiliarum traditam legi, non plena documenta inquisitionis.”

unit.source: “Most of the patrol team members were seasoned Beyonders who had encountered Mutants and Devils before. Their judgment should be reliable.”
unit.target: “Plurimi ex membris manipuli vigiliarum erant periti Beyonder, qui ante Mutantes et Diaboli experti fuerant. Iudicium illorum credibile esse debet.”

unit.source: Patrol team… Lumian grinned at Bram and remarked, “Is there any other information you deem crucial to share with me? If not, let’s proceed.”
unit.target: Manipulus vigiliarum… Lumian Bram subridens aspiciens dixit: “An alias notitias habes, quae mihi esse cruciales videantur? Sin non, pergamus.”

unit.source: “Yes, of course.” Bram straightened his back abruptly.
unit.target: “Ita, scilicet.” Bram subito dorsum rectum fecit.

unit.source: In the next moment, he spat out foul words in a language Lumian had never heard before.
unit.target: In proximo momento, verba foeda in lingua, quam Lumian numquam ante audiverat, exspuit.

unit.source: Devil Language!
unit.target: Lingua Diaboli!

unit.source: As the Devil words reverberated, the blood, bloodstains, and bloody handprints that Bram had left on the ground were enveloped in a faint light.
unit.target: Dum verba Diaboli resonabant, sanguis, vestigia sanguinis, et manuum sanguinolentarum, quas Bram in terram reliquit, lumine levis circumdata erant.

unit.source: A mystical connection seemed to form between them, linking them based on their location, creating sinister symbols and patterns.
unit.target: Apparuit nexus mysticus inter eos formari, eos loco coniungens, symbola obscura et figuras creans.

unit.source: In the room’s far cupboard, glass bottles filled with lips and colorless liquid trembled suddenly, as if rocked by an earthquake.
unit.target: In armario remoto cubiculi, pocula vitrea, labris plena et liquore incoloro referta, subito tremuerunt, quasi terraemotus ea moveret.

unit.source: This marked the initiation of a ritual to summon the projection of an Abyssal Devil!
unit.target: Hoc inauguravit initium rituum ad speciem Abyssalis Diaboli evocandam!

unit.source: Serial Killers executed serial murders not solely for the thrill but also to appease the Abyssal Devils.
unit.target: Caedes Interfectorum Serialium non solum ob delectationem peraguntur, sed etiam ad placandos Abyssales Diaboli.

unit.source: Once the killing spree concluded, Serial Killers could proceed to the final step of the ritual, summoning the projection of the corresponding Abyssal Devil.
unit.target: Postquam caedes finitae sunt, Interfectorēs Serialēs ad gradum ultimum rituum procedere possunt, speciem Abyssalis Diaboli evocantes.

unit.source: This granted them the assistance needed to fulfill their desires.
unit.target: Hoc eis auxilium necessarium ad desidera perficienda tribuebat.

unit.source: Though Bram’s string of murders wasn’t entirely finished and fell short by a few targets, he had met the minimum threshold.
unit.target: Quamquam series caedum Brahmi non omnino perfecta erat et paucis scopis defuisset, tamen minimum terminum attingebat.

unit.source: It satisfied the basic quantitative requirements, allowing him to expedite the ritual.
unit.target: Id requisita quantitatis fundamentalia implevit, idque ei permittens ritu accelerare.

unit.source: Understandably, this shortcut wouldn’t yield the same effectiveness as the standard procedure.
unit.target: Intellegendum est, haec via brevis non eandem efficaciam quam procedura ordinaria praebebat.

unit.source: Yet, in the face of urgency and danger, Bram paid little heed.
unit.target: Attamen, in facie urgendi et periculi, Bram parum attendit.

unit.source: He cooperated willingly, divulging information to divert the enemy’s focus from his subtle actions.
unit.target: Ille libenter cooperatus est, notitias enarrans, ut hostis ab subtili actu suo distraheretur.

unit.source: For instance, allowing blood to drip onto the ground in a specific pattern and pressing his blood‑stained palm in a particular location.
unit.target: Exempli causa, sanguinem in terram in forma particulari stillare sinens et palmam sanguinolentam in loco determinato premens.

unit.source: These marks replaced conspicuous evil and degenerate symbols with subtler, blood‑stained alternatives.
unit.target: Haec signa, conspicua mala et symbola degenerata, substituebant alternativas subtiliores, sanguine maculatas.

unit.source: With the preparations complete, Bram could utilize the Devil Language’s “activate” to trigger the ritual, pleasing a high‑level Devil and summoning its projection to confront the enemy!
unit.target: Cum praeparationes completae essent, Bram uti poterat verbo “activate” linguae Diaboli ad ritum incitandum, altissimum Diabolum placens et eius speciem evocans ut hostem oppugnaret!

unit.source: Lumian silently observed Bram Andariel’s “handiwork,” feeling the room steeped in malevolence and tainted by corruption.
unit.target: Lumian silentiose Bram Andariel operam observabat, sentiens conclave malevolentia imbutum et corruptione tinctum.

unit.source: He raised his right hand, snapping his fingers.
unit.target: Dextram manum attoluit, digitos crepitantes pulsans.

unit.source: Bram, coldly observing him while anticipating the ritual’s protection, suddenly heard a rumbling emanate from within his body.
unit.target: Bram, eum frigidē intuentem et protectionem rituum exspectans, subito audivit fremitus ex corpore suo emanare.

unit.source: In confusion, he lowered his head and scrutinized his form.
unit.target: In confusione, caput deiecit et formam suam scrutatus est.

unit.source: Crimson flames erupted from within, inflicting the agony of violent waves tearing through his internal organs, bones, and flesh.
unit.target: Flammae coccineae ex intus erupere coeperunt, inferentes dolorem undarum violentarum quae organa interna, ossa et carnem lacerabant.

unit.source: Darkness gripped Bram’s consciousness, accompanied by searing pain.
unit.target: Tenebrae conscie Brahmi arripuerunt, comitatae dolore urente.

unit.source: The last sight before losing consciousness: A black‑haired young man with green eyes, sporting a golden straw hat, curved his lips, maintaining a warm smile. It was as though he watched a clown diligently tumble into a trap.
unit.target: Ultima visio antequam conscientiam amisit: iuvenis, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus, pileum strara aureum gerens, labra incurvata, risum calidum obtinens. Videbatur quasi spectaret histrionem diligenter in laqueum incidere.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fremitus!

unit.source: The ritual concluded prematurely. An explosion originating from Bram’s body tore him into multiple fragments.
unit.target: Ritus praecox concludebatur. Explosio ex corpore Brahm orta eum in varias partes distraxit.

unit.source: Fire Infusion and Delayed Explosion!
unit.target: Infusio Ignis et Explosio Dilata!

unit.source: As Lumian adorned the Fury of the Sea brooch and ruthlessly assailed Bram, he not only released pent‑up emotions but also covertly infused flames into Bram’s body, triggering a Delayed Explosion.
unit.target: Dum Lumian fibulam “Furiae Maris” induebatur et Brahm immitis opponebat, non solum affectus repositos dimittere sed etiam clam flammis in corpus eius infundebat, Explosio Dilata excitans.

unit.source: This precaution aimed to avert any mishaps.
unit.target: Haec cautio ad casus vitandos destinata erat.

unit.source: Moreover, there was no intention of granting forgiveness or negotiating a deal to spare Bram.
unit.target: Praeterea, nullus erat propositus veniam dare aut de pacto tractare, ut Brahm parceretur.

unit.source: Thus, there existed no psychological barrier to implanting a controlled time bomb within his body, ready to be activated.
unit.target: Ergo, nihil obstaculum psychologicum exsistebat ad bombam temporalis moderatam in corpore eius implanendam, quae activari parata esset.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fremitus!

unit.source: Corpse fragments scattered across the room, some plastering the walls. Yet, this tumultuous event remained contained within the confines of the Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: Fragmenta cadaveris per conclave sparsa sunt, nonnulla parietes adhaerentes. Attamen, hic tumultus intra limites “Vas Fictum” retentus est.

unit.source: 638 Possible Enemy
unit.target: 638 Inimicus Possibilis

unit.source: “My father bore the last name Andariel, cut down by a curse unleashed by a Devil’s projection during a ritual gone awry.
unit.target: “Pater meus nomen Andariel gerebat, occisus maledictione efferata ex projectione diaboli in ritu aberrante.

unit.source: “Inheriting his mantle, I became a Beyonder.
unit.target: “Mantellum eius hereditans, factus sum transmundanus.

unit.source: “My mother remains a mystery, perhaps just another name etched into my father’s ledger of victims…
unit.target: “Mater mea manet mysterium, fortasse solum aliud nomen in tabula victimarum patris mei insculptum…

unit.source: “Upon the murky surface of a dark mirror, Bram Andariel’s blood-drained visage recounted his origins with an impassive mask.
unit.target: “Super turbidam superficiem speculi obscuri, vultus exsanguis Bram Andariel, cum larva impassibili, originem suam enarravit.

unit.source: “Franca, ‘invited’ by Lumian, faced a full-body mirror, employing her unique magic mirror spirit channeling technique to delve into the Andariel family and the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: “Franca, a Lumiano “invitata”, speculo totius corporis intuebatur, technicam magicam speculi et spiritus transmittendi singularem adhibens ad perscrutandam familiam Andariel atque Schola Rosi Cogitationis.

unit.source: “Regrettably, Bram lingered on the fringes of the secret organization and his Devilish family. His insights were scant.
unit.target: “Infeliciter, Bram in marginibus organizationis secretae et familiae diaboli suae moratus est. Perspicaciae eius parvae erant.

unit.source: “Moreover, to divert Lumian’s scrutiny and covertly finalize the ritual preparations, he divulged truths without deceit.
unit.target: “Praeterea, ut scrutinium Lumiani avertiret et occulte praeparationes ritualis compleret, veritates sine dolo divulgavit.

unit.source: “With Spirit Channeling reaching its threshold, Franca posed a final query.
unit.target: “Cum potentia spiritus transmittendi ad apicem pervenisset, Franca quaestionem ultimam proposuit.

unit.source: “Who leads the Andariel family now?”
unit.target: “Quis nunc familiam Andariel ducit?”

unit.source: “Bram’s increasingly translucent and sinister countenance contorted abruptly.
unit.target: “Vultus Bram, magis translucens et sinistrus, subito in contorsionem versa est.

unit.source: “He—he’s dead.
unit.target: “Ipse – mortuus est.

unit.source: “He became a sacrifice!”
unit.target: “Factus est sacrificium!”

unit.source: “Sacrifice… such theatricality?”
unit.target: “Sacrificium… talis theatralitas?”

unit.source: “Before Franca could delve deeper, Bram’s figure waned swiftly, dissipating into nothingness.
unit.target: “Antequam Franca propius penetrare posset, figura Bram celeriter evanuit, in nihilum dissolvens.

unit.source: “As the Demoness of Pleasure concluded the ritual, she clicked her tongue and addressed Lumian, “The Andariel family’s state is dire. Even the patriarch can be offered as a sacrifice. Are they fully controlled by the Rose School of Thought?”
unit.target: “Dum Demonissa Voluptatis ritum concludebat, linguae sonitum edidit atque Lumiano addixit: ‘Status familiae Andariel periculosus est. Etiam paterfamilias sacrificio offeri potest. Plenene ab Schola Rosi Cogitationis dominantur?’

unit.source: “In light of the temperance faction’s alignment with the Church of The Fool within the Rose School of Thought, Franca glossed over distinctions between factions.
unit.target: “Propter consociationem factionis temperantiae cum Ecclesia Stulti intra Schola Rosi Cogitationis, Franca differentias inter factiones neglectavit.

unit.source: “After all, the Rose School likely teemed with adherents of indulgence.
unit.target: “Postremo, Schola Rosi probabiliter abundabat sectatoribus indulgentiae.

unit.source: “Lumian responded contemplatively, “The situation in the Abyss isn’t quite right either…”
unit.target: “Lumian meditato animo respondit: ‘Res in Abyssu quoque non prorsus rectae sunt…’

unit.source: “Whether Naboredisley was the pseudonym of Devil Monarch Farbauti or not, the plight of the blood-colored Demon deep within Hanth Island mirrored the Abyss’s troubles to some extent.
unit.target: “Sive Naboredisley pseudonymum fuit Monarchi Diaboli Farbauti sive non, miseria daemonis sanguine tincti in fundo Insulae Hanth, ad aliquod modum difficultates Abyssi repraesentabat.

unit.source: “With a scoff, Lumian remarked, “We’re accustomed to damning others to hell and the Abyss.
unit.target: “Cum irrisu, Lumian dixit: ‘Consuevimus alios in infernum et Abyssum damnare.

unit.source: “We believed it to be the worst place.
unit.target: “Existimabamus illud esse locum pessimum.

unit.source: “Who knew the Abyss itself could decay?
unit.target: “Quis putavit Abyssum ipsum putrescere posse?

unit.source: “It’s falling into its own abyss.”
unit.target: “In proprium Abyssum suum cadit.”

unit.source: “A hellish jest indeed.”
unit.target: “Vere infernalis iocus est.”

unit.source: “Franca glanced at the pristine night sky, less tainted by industrial pollution.
unit.target: “Franca aspexit caelum nocturnum immaculatum, minus ab pollutione industriali corruptum.

unit.source: “The crimson moon of the Southern Continent appeared clearer and brighter.
unit.target: “Luna coccinea Continentis Australi clarius atque nitidiori apparuit.

unit.source: “She steered the conversation back on track.
unit.target: “Illa colloquium iterum ad viam rectam duxit.

unit.source: “If Hisoka truly is from the Devil pathway, his actions make sense.
unit.target: “Si Hisoka vere ex via Diaboli provenit, actus eius rationem habent.

unit.source: “The Research Society was lax. Minimal filters or restrictions on its members…”
unit.target: “Societas Inquisitrix levis erat. Filtra minima ac restrictiones in membris eius habebantur…

unit.source: “Franca and Lumian were aware that the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society operated in a way that there were no Devil pathway Beyonders, but nobody knew the truth.
unit.target: “Franca et Lumian sciebant Societatem Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispitarum ita operari ut nihil Beyonder viæ Diaboli adesset, sed veritatem nemo noverat.

unit.source: “Membership didn’t entail self-declaration of pathways or proof.
unit.target: “Membri non debebant se ipsos viarum declaratione aut testimonio ornare.

unit.source: “Sequences were discerned through interactions at gatherings.
unit.target: “Series per interactiones in conventibus discernebantur.

unit.source: “Hisoka remained an enigma, his pathways and Sequence elusive even to key April Fool’s members.
unit.target: “Hisoka remanebat enigma, viæ eius et series etiam membris principalibus Aprilis Stultorum elusae erant.

unit.source: “Hisoka has always been a loner.
unit.target: “Hisoka semper solitarius fuit.

unit.source: “He rarely participates in other April Fool’s pranks.
unit.target: “Raro in aliis iocis Aprilis Stultorum participat.

unit.source: “Is he afraid of being discovered as a Devil?
unit.target: “Num timet ut Diabolus detegatur?

unit.source: “Lumian contemplated, adding, “He was most inclined to collaborate with Mad Lady, an unabashed lunatic who couldn’t care less.
unit.target: “Lumian cogitavit, addens: ‘Valde inclinus erat ad collaborandum cum Mad Lady, lunatica absque pudore, quae nihil curabat.’

unit.source: “She might even relish the prospect of testing if a Devil’s blood runs cold…
unit.target: “Fortasse etiam delectabitur spe experiendi utrum sanguis diaboli frigescere possit…

unit.source: “I sense a subtle mockery, insinuating my penchant for experimentation…
unit.target: “Subtilis derisus mihi apparet, insinens meam cupiditatem experimentandi…

unit.source: “Yet, despite being a Coldblooded, the remnant blood of the Serial Killer Bram retained a hint of warmth.
unit.target: “Attamen, quamquam frigidus animo, reliquum sanguis Necatoris Serialis Bram levem caliditatis scintillam retinebat.

unit.source: “Does Coldblooded mainly denote emotional detachment rather than literal coldness?
unit.target: “Num ‘coldeblooded’ praecipue affectuum distantiam, potius quam literalem frigoris condicionem, significat?

unit.source: “Or could it be the Southern Continent’s summer, heating up the blood of cold-blooded creatures… Franca’s musings drifted.
unit.target: “An aestate Continentis Australi, quae sanguinem creaturarum frigidorum calefacit, hoc sit… cogitationes Francae pervolabant.

unit.source: “Franca then cautioned Lumian, “If Hisoka is truly a Devil, he’ll sense your malice the moment you uncover a key clue.
unit.target: “Franca deinde Lumiano monebat: ‘Si Hisoka vere Diabolus est, malitiam tuam sentiet in eodem momento quo clavem indicium detegas.’

unit.source: “He can decide whether to strike or flee, shifting to another country to hide.
unit.target: “Ipse decernere potest utrum percutiat aut fugiet, in aliam terram migrans ad latebandum.

unit.source: “Dammit! Pursuing a Devil is a real hassle.
unit.target: “Eheu! Diabolum persequi vere molestum est.

unit.source: “When we can’t beat him, he strikes first.
unit.target: “Cum eum vincere non possumus, prius ipse percutit.

unit.source: “When we can, he’s nowhere to be found.
unit.target: “Cum possumus, nusquam invenitur.

unit.source: “We could use a Demon Hunter in times like these,” Lumian half-jokingly remarked.
unit.target: “Lumian, paulo iocose dicens, addidit: ‘Indigeamus venatorem daemonum temporibus talibus.’

unit.source: “From Devilology, Lumian knew that Sequence 4 of the Warrior pathway was the Demon Hunter—an expert in hunting Devils.
unit.target: “Ex Devilologia, Lumian scivit Sequenciam Quartam viae Bellatoris esse Venatorem Daemonum—peritum in daemonibus venandis.

unit.source: “They were natural adversaries to Devils, Desire Apostles, and even Demons.
unit.target: “Hostes naturales erant Diaboli, Apostoli Desiderii, et etiam Daemones.

unit.source: “One of the Demon Hunters’ crucial skills was concealing their actions and intentions, making it impossible for targets capable of sensing danger to detect them!
unit.target: “Una inter artibus vitalibus Venatorum Daemonum erat suos mores atque consilia celare, ita ut destinatores periculorum sentiendi eos detegere nequeant!

unit.source: “Franca concurred succinctly, “Now I see why Madam Magician sent you the spirit world’s coordinates, instructing you to visit the New City of Silver and find Mr. Sun to eliminate the remaining corruption.
unit.target: “Franca breviter assentata est: ‘Nunc intellego cur Magistra Magica tibi notitiae mundi spirituum misisset, te iubens ut Novam Urbem Argenteam visitares et Dominum Solem invenires ad reliquam corruptionem tollendam.’

unit.source: “It’s dominated by the Warrior pathway and boasts many Demon Hunters.
unit.target: “Ea via Bellatoris imperatur et plurimos Venatores Daemonum habet.

unit.source: “Though enlisting a Demon Hunter throughout the entire process might strain our resources.
unit.target: “Attamen, cum per totum processum Venatorem Daemonum adducere conemur, opes nostras fortasse onerabit.

unit.source: “That was a genuine demigod!
unit.target: “Ille vere semideus erat!

unit.source: “While dealing with Hisoka was Lumian’s personal grudge, Major Arcana card holders would also take notice, given Hisoka’s potential alignment with that Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: “Dum res cum Hisoka agendi iniuria personalis Lumiani erat, et possessores chartarum Major Arcana animadvertere incipiebant, quoniam Hisoka fortasse ad illam Dignitatem Caelestem pertinere poterit.

unit.source: “Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: “Lumian subridens ridet.

unit.source: “No need for a Demon Hunter to intervene directly.
unit.target: “Non opus est ut Venator Daemonum directe interveniat.

unit.source: “I wonder if they can craft charms, potions, or items concealing malice.
unit.target: “Miror an possint fabricare amuleta, potiones, aut res malitiam celantes.

unit.source: “If so, we can spend a hefty sum through the Tarot Club’s connections to acquire them or engage in item exchange.
unit.target: “Si vero ita est, ingentem pecuniae sumam per coniunctiones Tarot Club impendere possumus ut ea adipisci aut mercari valeamus.

unit.source: “Start inquiring soon,” Franca advised.
unit.target: “Mox inquirere incipias,” Franca monuit.

unit.source: “If Hisoka is a Desire Apostle, be cautious.
unit.target: “Si Hisoka apostolus Desiderii est, cave.

unit.source: “You carry too many random items, and some mystical items have adverse effects on emotions and desires.
unit.target: “Multa fortuita gereas, et quaedam mysticae res in affectus et desideria male operantur.

unit.source: “He could detonate them, injuring you instantly…
unit.target: “Illos detonare potest, te statim laedens…

unit.source: “As she spoke, Franca’s lips trembled before she sealed them shut.
unit.target: “Dum loquebatur, labia Francae tremuerunt antequam ea obstruxit.

unit.source: “Lumian nodded solemnly, refraining from boasting about his Ascetic abilities.
unit.target: “Lumian graviter annuit, abstinens se glorificare de facultatibus asceticis suis.

unit.source: “Having recently endured an explosion of emotions and desires, he understood it was beyond the endurance of an Ascetic, causing physical damage to the brain.
unit.target: “Nuper per explosionem affectuum et desideriorum passi, intellexit id esse ultra tolerantiam asceticorum, damnum vero cerebri inferens.

unit.source: “Franca then said, “The one chasing the Serial Killer was from the Numinous Episcopate, not a regular patrol member.
unit.target: “Franca deinde dixit: ‘Qui Necatorem Serialem insequebat, ex Episcopato Numinoso erat, non ex ordinario membro vigilantiae.’

unit.source: “The currents in Matani run deep.
unit.target: “Cursus in Matani profundi sunt.

unit.source: “The Numinous Episcopate, a clandestine organization in the Southern Continent, was rumored to trace its origins to the former royal descendants of the Balam Empire and Beyonders unwilling to forsake Death as their faith.
unit.target: “Episcopatus Numinosus, organization secreta in Continentis Australi, fertur originem suam trahere ex regia posteritate olim Balam Imperii et Beyonder, qui Mortem ut fidem suam non deseruerunt.

unit.source: “Their ultimate aim was to restore Death to His throne, ruling East and West Balam once more.
unit.target: “Finis eorum ultimus erat Mortem throno suo restituere, regnantes Orientem et Occidentem Balam iterum.

unit.source: “Lumian strolled to the window, gazing at the street.
unit.target: “Lumian ad fenestram ambulavit, viam contemplans.

unit.source: “He grinned and commented, "This is the chaotic Southern Continent."
unit.target: “Ille subridens dixit: ‘Hoc est Continentum Australe chaos.’

unit.source: “Actually, what piques my interest is why the Rose School of Thought is collecting information about the daily lives of Port Pylos residents.
unit.target: “Revera, quod mihi maxime interest, est cur Schola Rosi Cogitationis notitias de vitae cotidianis in Portu Pylos colligat.

unit.source: “It seems like they want to govern this place.
unit.target: “Videtur quod hunc locum regere velint.

unit.source: “That’s not their usual style.
unit.target: “Non est hoc more solito eorum.

unit.source: “Lumian had limited knowledge of the Rose School of Thought’s past.
unit.target: “Lumian parum de praeteritis Scholae Rosi Cogitationis noverat.

unit.source: “All he knew was their recent spree of sacrifices, leaving bloodshed wherever they occupied.
unit.target: “Omnia quae noverat erant erant recentes sacrificia eorum, sanguinis effusio ubique, ubi insederunt.

unit.source: “Running a city or port for extended periods didn’t align with their usual behavior.
unit.target: “Regere urbem aut portum per longos tempora non conveniebat more eorum.

unit.source: “Nothing is certain.
unit.target: “Nihil certum est.

unit.source: “Franca’s mind was working overtime recently.
unit.target: “Mente Francae nuper extra modum laborabat.

unit.source: “After a moment’s reflection, she added, “Regardless of the Rose School of Thought’s motives, considering the sacrifices they’ve conducted in recent years, they should have gained substantial boons from the Mother Tree of Desire.
unit.target: “Post parvum meditando, addidit: ‘Quocumque sint causae Scholae Rosi Cogitationis, consideratis sacrificiis nuper factis, magnam fortasse beneficia a Matre Arboris Desiderii adepti esse debent.’

unit.source: “Now, with Devil family members in the mix, encountering a significant Rose School of Thought member may mean dealing with a dual Bearer of potions and boons.
unit.target: “Iam, cum membra familiae Diabolicae admixta sint, congressus cum membro significativo Scholae Rosi Cogitationis posse significat tractare duplicem feritorem potionum et opum.

unit.source: “Perhaps a Zombie Recipient, Wraith Tree Spirit, or Sex Addict Apostle? Similar to a Hunter Monk like you.
unit.target: “Fortasse recipientem zombiorum, spiritum arborum umbratilis, aut apostolum voluptatis addictum? Simile venatori monacho ut tu.

unit.source: “Franca, always more adept at nicknames and unconventional thoughts than Lumian, playfully referred to Beyonders who were both Zombies and Recipients as Zombie Recipients.
unit.target: “Franca, semper callidior in cognominibus et cogitationibus insolitis quam Lumian, ludicre Beyonder, qui et zombii et recipientes erant, ‘Zombie Recipients’ nominavit.

unit.source: “Her primary intention was to caution Lumian that certain Rose School of Thought members might exploit abilities like those of the Sex Addict to provoke his desires.
unit.target: “Scopum eius erat Lumiano monere ne quaedam membra Scholae Rosi Cogitationis facultates similes ut operam voluptatis addicti ad desideria eius provocanda utantur.

unit.source: “Later, in their Desire Apostle form, they could detonate those desires, providing end-to-end service.
unit.target: “Postea, in forma Apostolorum Desiderii, illa desideria detonare possent, servitium ex initio ad finem praebentes.

unit.source: “It would be a formidable challenge.
unit.target: “Id esset provocatione formidabilis.

unit.source: “In Lumian’s condition, facing such Beyonders posed considerable danger.
unit.target: “In condicione Lumiani, opposuisse talibus Beyonder periculum notabile exhibebat.

unit.source: “Lumian chuckled, somewhat self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: “Lumian, aliquantulum se dedecorans, subridens ridet.

unit.source: “Why do I feel like a powder keg, ready to explode with the slightest touch?
unit.target: “Cur me sentio quasi pyxis pulveris, paratus ad explosionem minimo tactu?

unit.source: “Nevertheless, I don’t intend to meddle in the Rose School of Thought’s affairs.
unit.target: “Attamen, non mihi consilium est res Scholae Rosi Cogitationis immiscere.

unit.source: “I’ll write to Madam Magician and report the traces of the Rose School of Thought in Port Pylos.
unit.target: “Scribam Magistrae Magicae et referam vestigia Scholae Rosi Cogitationis in Portu Pylos.

unit.source: “Someone will investigate and handle it.
unit.target: “Aliquis id investigabit et curabit.

unit.source: “Aren’t Mr. Star and Mr. Moon among the Major Arcana card holders overseeing the Rose School of Thought?
unit.target: “Nonne Domini Stella et Luna sunt inter possessores chartarum Major Arcana, qui Scholae Rosi Cogitationis superintendunt?

unit.source: “My sole focus is Hisoka.
unit.target: “Unicum propositum mihi est Hisoka.

unit.source: “At least, we can be sure that even if he’s of the Devil pathway, he likely has no connection to the Andariel family.
unit.target: “Saltem scimus etiam, si ex via Diaboli proveniat, eum verisimiliter nullam convenientiam cum familia Andariel habere.

unit.source: “Otherwise, the Rose School of Thought wouldn’t have dispatched Bram and company for reconnaissance.
unit.target: “Aliter, Schola Rosi Cogitationis Bram et comitatu non misisset ad speculandum.

unit.source: “Bram wouldn’t have been oblivious if a family member had been active here.
unit.target: “Bram non esset inscius, nisi membrum familiae hic activum fuisset.

unit.source: “Franca hesitated for a moment before adding, “Hmm, just be careful.”
unit.target: “Franca paulisper vacillavit, tum addidit: ‘Hmm, modo cave.’

unit.source: “Having escorted Franca back to Trier, Lumian stowed away Bram’s Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic.
unit.target: “Francam ad Treveros comitatus, Lumian proprietatem Necatoris Serialis Bram Beyonder recondidit.

unit.source: “It took the form of a sharp-edged, prismatic ice cube, enveloping faint wisps of thin black gas.
unit.target: “Id assumpsit formam cubi glacies acutissimi, prismatici, tenuas nebulae nigri gas involvens.

unit.source: “Upon reaching Hotel Orella, Lumian approached the trio of mechanical elevators, pulled the handle, and stood patiently.
unit.target: “Ad Hotel Orella perventus, Lumian ad trium machinarum elevatorum accessit, manubrium traxit, et patienter stetit.

unit.source: “With a creak, the double doors opened simultaneously.
unit.target: “Cum stridore, ostia duplicia simul aperta sunt.

unit.source: “Lumian’s silhouette, elongated by the crystal chandelier behind him, was mirrored in the mechanical lift.
unit.target: “Figura Lumiani, ab candelabro crystallino post eum elongata, in machinali elevatori reflecta erat.

unit.source: “Beside him stood a slender human shadow.
unit.target: “Iuxta eum stabat umbra humana gracilis.

unit.source: 639 Bribe
unit.target: 639 Corruptio

unit.source: Lumian stood before the open mechanical elevator door, casting a glance at the slender shadow beside him.
unit.target: Lumian coram porta machinae elevatoriae apertae stetit, et umbram tenuem iuxta se intuitus est.

unit.source: With raised eyebrows, he calmly turned his head, noting the sudden presence diagonally behind him.
unit.target: Supercilia sublata, caput suum tranquille vertit, praesentiam subitaneam obliquē post se notans.

unit.source: The figure appeared as a tall, thin man draped in a complex, layered black robe.
unit.target: Figura apparuit ut vir altus et tenuis, indutus veste nigra multiplex.

unit.source: His face bore a pale‑white complexion, as though untouched by sunlight for an extended period.
unit.target: Vultus eius cutem pallidam ostendebat, quasi diu radii solaris non contrectatus esset.

unit.source: Atop his black hair sat a fluffy black hat, its edge adorned with a gently swaying white feather.
unit.target: Super capillos nigros eius, sedebat pileus niger lanuginosus, cuius ora plumula alba leniter volitans ornata erat.

unit.source: Lumian retracted his gaze and entered the mechanical elevator.
unit.target: Lumian aspectum retraxit et in machinam elevatariam intravit.

unit.source: The tall, thin man with dark brown eyes followed suit in silence.
unit.target: Vir altus et tenuis, oculis fuscis, silentio secutus est.

unit.source: Gripping the brass handle with his right hand, Lumian selected the desired floor, pressing it down to B3 as a definitive “click” echoed in response.
unit.target: Dextro manu manubrium aeneum intus prehensus, Lumian tabulatum desideratum elegerat, illud ad B3 premens, dum sonitus fixus “click” in responsione resonabat.

unit.source: After Lumian selected his intended floor, the lanky man mimicked his action, opting for B18.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian tabulatum suum destinatum elegerat, vir gracilis eius actum imitatus est, optans ad B18.

unit.source: As they awaited descent, the distant sound of steam hissing reached their ears.
unit.target: Dum descensum exspectabant, sonus vaporis sibilans ex longinquo auribus eorum pervenit.

unit.source: Gears whirred to life, chains tightened, and the luxurious mechanical elevator began its gradual descent.
unit.target: Rotae ad vitam excitatae sunt, catenae stringebantur, et luxuriosa machina elevatoria paulatim descendere coepit.

unit.source: Throughout the journey, both remained eerily silent, the atmosphere thick with unspoken tension.
unit.target: Per totum iter, ambo mirabili silentio mansere, cum atmosphaera densa tensionis tacita impleta esset.

unit.source: Upon arrival at B3, Lumian departed without a backward glance, heading toward Suite 7 with purpose.
unit.target: Adventum ad B3 perventum, Lumian sine retrospecto discessit, versus Suite 7 cum proposito properavit.

unit.source: As the metal chains continued their retreat behind him, Lumian muttered thoughtfully to himself, “Monsieur Iveljsta?”
unit.target: Dum catenae ferreae post eum recedebant, Lumian ad se meditatus murmurat, “Monsieur Iveljsta?”

unit.source: Iveljsta, residing in B18, harbored lifeless servants.
unit.target: Iveljsta, in B18 habitans, servos inanimatos habebat.

unit.source: The peculiar appearance of Iveljsta and the condition of his servants led Lumian to suspect his association with a Wraith, a Sequence 5 Wraith of the Prisoner pathway.
unit.target: Species insolita Iveljstae et status servorum eius adduxerunt Lumian suspicari eum coniunctum esse cum Umbrā, Umbrā Sequenciae V ex via Captivi.

unit.source: The Prisoner pathway, controlled by the Rose School of Thought, held sway over temperance and indulgence factions, both intertwined with the secret organization.
unit.target: Via Captivi, a Schola Rosi Cogitationis moderante, imperium habebat super factiones temperantiae et indulgentiae, quae utraque cum organizatione secreta contextae erant.

unit.source: It seemed unlikely for a Wraith not to be affiliated with the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: Videtur improbabile esse ut Umbra non coniungatur cum Schola Rosi Cogitationis.

unit.source: Could it be a rare rogue Wraith, or perhaps the vanguard of the Rose School of Thought targeting Port Pylos?
unit.target: Num esset rara Umbra vagabunda, aut fortasse praecursio Scholae Rosi Cogitationis ad Portum Pylos destinata?

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t discount the possibility of a temperance faction member.
unit.target: Lumian possibilitatem ut esset membrum factionis temperantiae non potuit neglegere.

unit.source: Yet, in the past few minutes, he discerned no evidence of Iveljsta’s protracted indulgence… Lumian resolved to detail his observations in Madam Magician’s letter.
unit.target: Attamen, in paucis minutis praeteritis, nullum signum indulgentiae diuturnae Iveljstae animadvertit; itaque Lumian statuivit observationes suas in epistola Dominae Magicae enarrari.

unit.source: Whether something was good or bad would be determined by professionals!
unit.target: Utrum aliquid bonum vel malum sit, ab peritis determinabitur!

unit.source: Returning to Suite 7, Lumian noticed Ludwig seated at the dining table, indulging in a feast from a ceramic soup pot with a silver spoon.
unit.target: Revertens ad Suite 7, Lumian animadvertit Ludovicum ad mensam epulandum sedere, convivium ex olla ceramica cum cochlea argentea degustans.

unit.source: Atop the dish, a layer of cheese infused with egg juice charred in spots.
unit.target: Super ferculo, stratum casei, succo ovorum infuso, in quibusdam partibus comburatum, iacebat.

unit.source: Through the sizable hole Ludwig had carved, Lumian glimpsed a medley of pork, beef, fish, shrimp, shells, potatoes, and tomatoes stewed together.
unit.target: Per foramen ingens, quod Ludwig effodierat, Lumian intuebar mixturam porcinae, bubulae, piscis, palaemonis, concharum, tuberorum solanaceorum, et lycopersicorum simul coctorum.

unit.source: The rich aroma of spices mingled with the meats’ essence permeated the living and dining rooms, casting a spell that stirred his appetite.
unit.target: Aroma dives specierum, cum essentia carnium miscenti, per conclavia vitae et cenandi diffuse se effudit, incantationem efficacem afferens quae appetitum eius excitavit.

unit.source: Ludwig continued to eat in silence as Lugano stood up and asked, “Would you like some? This is the local Eseo. Different chefs choose different ingredients, and the taste will vary.”
unit.target: Ludwig silentio edebat, cum Lugano surrexit et quaesivit: “Visne aliquid? Hic est Eseo localis. Diversi coqui diversa ingredientia eligunt, et sapor variabit.”

unit.source: Ludwig, without uttering a word, simply turned his head at Lugano before resuming his meal, quickening his pace.
unit.target: Ludwig, sine verbo ullo, caput ad Lugano vertit, atque cibum suum rursus assumpsit, celeritate augens.

unit.source: Taking a seat beside Ludwig, Lumian smiled at the cheese‑filled boy and said, “I was going to bring you a better supper, but I thought better of it.”
unit.target: Consedens iuxta Ludovicum, Lumian puero caseo pleno subridet et dixit: “Cenam meliorem tibi ferre intendebam, sed melius putavi.”

unit.source: Confused, Lugano inquired, “What supper?”
unit.target: Confusus, Lugano quaesivit: “Quae cena?”

unit.source: “You don’t want to know,” Lumian responded with a Devil‑like smile.
unit.target: “Nescis,” respondit Lumian cum risu diaboli similis.

unit.source: The supper he alluded to was Serial Killer Bram’s corpse.
unit.target: Cena, quam insinuabat, erat corpus Interfectoris Serialis Bram.

unit.source: Originally intending to bring a few pieces back for Ludwig to sample and discern any “nutrients” and information, Lumian reconsidered, aware of Bram’s limited knowledge about the Andariel family’s peculiarities.
unit.target: Primitim intendens paucas partes Ludovicum gustare atque nutrimenta atque informationes detegere, Lumian remedit, conscius scientiae modicae Bram de singularibus Andariel familiae.

unit.source: Thus, he abandoned the idea of feeding Ludwig out of prudence.
unit.target: Itaque, propter prudentiam, consilium Ludovicum alendi deseruit.

unit.source: From Lumian’s observations, Ludwig could derive some strength from eating, releasing the seal.
unit.target: Ex observationibus Lumiani, Ludwig ex edendo aliquam vim consequi poterat, sigillum solvens.

unit.source: However, consuming a Sequence 7 Beyonder corpse might trigger a significant change.
unit.target: Attamen, corpus Beyonder Sequenciae VII edendo, mutationem significantem excitare posset.

unit.source: Lumian feared his own strength might not suffice to manage potential complications; Ludwig could potentially turn the tables and consume him as a delicacy.
unit.target: Lumian timebat ne sua virtus ad tractandas difficultates non sufficeret; Ludwig fortasse remittere posset et eum tamquam delicium edere.

unit.source: Ludwig’s silver spoon paused briefly before he remarked, “If you didn’t bring it, why did you mention it?”
unit.target: Cochlea argentea Ludovigi paulisper cessavit, et tum dixit: “Si id non tulisti, cur id memorasti?”

unit.source: “Oh, having a little tantrum?” Lumian chuckled inwardly and said, “It’s to inform you that we’ve reached an adventurer’s paradise, a land of chaos. You’ll have ample opportunities for fine dining in the future.”
unit.target: “O, parum iratus es?” Lumian interius subridens dixit: “Hic tibi declarandum est: ad paradisum adventurarum pervenimus, terram tumultus. Futuris tibi plures occasiones ad convivium exquisitum erunt.”

unit.source: The implication was clear: do well, and I’ll remember to reward you with delicacies.
unit.target: Implicatio clara erat: age bene, et meminero te deliciis praemiis remuneratum iri.

unit.source: Ludwig, spooning a soft potato stew into his mouth, responded vaguely, “I’m not going to school.”
unit.target: Ludwig, cochleā molli pultis solanaceis in os sumens, vago respondit: “Non ad scholam ibo.”

unit.source: Does this mean that as long as he doesn’t go to school, everything else is negotiable?
unit.target: Num hoc significat quod, dummodo ad scholam non it, omnia cetera negotiabilia sint?

unit.source: Of course, the prerequisite is that I have to pay with enough delicacies… Satisfied, Lumian rose and made his way to the washroom adjoining the master bedroom, where he washed up.
unit.target: Certe, praerequisitum est ut cum deliciis satis solvam… Satis contentus, Lumian surrexit et ad latrinam, quae cubiculo principali adiacens erat, pervenit, ubi se lavavit.

unit.source: The brass faucet delivered warm water at a comfortable temperature.
unit.target: Fistula aenea aquam calidam, ad commodam temperaturam, praebebat.

unit.source: Lumian soaked a towel, relishing the refreshing steam that enveloped his face, invigorating him.
unit.target: Lumian linteum immergit, vaporis refrigerantis, qui faciem eius complectebatur, delectatus, eum revigorans.

unit.source: Hotel Orella’s utilization of a steam engine to power its mechanical elevators and machinery ensured continuous hot water, a notable feature of its service.
unit.target: Hotel Orella machinam vaporariam ad elevatoria mechanica et alia instrumenta movenda adhibens, aquam calidam permanentem praestabat, pars insignis servitii eius.

unit.source: The following morning, Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, appeared on Cania Street beside Port Pylos’s Resurrection Square.
unit.target: Postero mane, Lumian, pileum stramineum aureum gerens, apparuit in Via Cania iuxta Plateam Resurrectionis Portus Pylos.

unit.source: Once the ruling center for Intis colonists in Matani, the area bore remnants of its history with road signs and shop names in the Intisian language.
unit.target: Olim centrum regendi colonorum Intis in Matani, regio reliquias historiae suae portabat, cum signis viariis et nominibus tabernarum in lingua Intisiana.

unit.source: Lumian effortlessly traced the path beneath the Intis parasol trees, arriving at a four‑story beige house showcasing Intis’s opulent architectural style.
unit.target: Lumian facile iter sub arboribus parasolorum Intis secutus est, ad domum quattuor stratorum coloris beige perveniens, quae opulentum stilum architectonicum Intis exhibebat.

unit.source: Signs adorned in Dutanese, Intisian, Highlander, Loen, and Feysac languages marked the building: “Port Pylos Patrol Team.”
unit.target: Signa, in linguis Dutanica, Intisiana, Highlander, Loen, et Feysac inscripta, aedificium indicabant: “Portus Pylos Turma Vigiliarum.”

unit.source: Below the sign, five lines had the same meaning: “Only deals with paranormal events.”
unit.target: Sub signo, quinque lineae idem significabant: “Solum de rebus paranormalibus agitur.”

unit.source: Fully taking into account the needs of adventurers from different countries to report a case… Lumian playfully remarked as he entered the beige establishment.
unit.target: Plene intellegens necessitatem adventurarum ex diversis terris ad casus referendos, Lumian iocosus dixit, dum in aedificium beige intrabat.

unit.source: Within the hall, devoid of occupants, Lumian found a receptionist casually perusing the day’s local tabloid from a lounging position.
unit.target: In atrio, absens hominum, Lumian reperit receptorem qui ex sede quieta diurnum tabloidum localem perlegebat.

unit.source: The native, in his thirties with dark brown skin and black hair, possessed a slender face and dark brown eyes.
unit.target: Indigenus, in annis tricesimalibus versans, cum cute fusca et capillis nigris, faciem tenuem atque oculos fuscos habebat.

unit.source: Approaching, Lumian addressed him in Intisian, “I want to report a case.”
unit.target: Accedens, Lumian eum in lingua Intisiana alloquens dixit: “Casum referre volo.”

unit.source: The native glanced up, rising unsteadily.
unit.target: Indigenus sursum intuitus instabiliter surrexit.

unit.source: He opened a partition behind him, uttering a few incomprehensible words in Dutanese.
unit.target: Post se partitionem aperuit, paucas verba in Dutanica, inaudita, pronuntians.

unit.source: Lumian could barely understand him speaking in Dutanese.
unit.target: Lumian vix intellexit eum in Dutanica loquens.

unit.source: “Someone who understands Intisian or Highlander…”
unit.target: “Aliquis qui linguam Intisianam aut Highlander intellegat…”

unit.source: This won’t do. Since you don’t understand foreign languages, don’t waste time reading the newspaper. Study diligently… Maintaining a genial smile, he patiently awaited other patrol team members to appear.
unit.target: Hoc non sufficit. Quia linguas externas non intellegis, tempus ne perdas legendi diurnum. Studio diligenter exerce, et supercilio benigno servato, ceteros membros turmae vigiliarum patienter exspectabat.

unit.source: Within a mere minute or two, a young man with fluffy brown hair, who appeared as if he had fallen asleep without washing his hair the night before, swung open the door from the depths of the hall.
unit.target: In uno vel duobus minutis, iuvenis cum capillis fusco lanuginosis, qui videbatur quasi nocte praeterita sine capillos lavandis obdormatus, ostium e profundis atrii sub alacri impetu aperuit.

unit.source: Dressed in a white shirt and an unbuttoned yellow vest, he strolled toward Lumian, one hand casually tucked into his pocket.
unit.target: Indutus camisia alba et vestem flavam solutam, ambulavit versus Lumian, una manu leviter in sinu posita.

unit.source: In fluent Intisian, he inquired, “What case are you filing?”
unit.target: In lingua Intisiana fluente, interrogavit: “Quod casum referis?”

unit.source: Lumian assessed the young man, unmistakably hailing from the Northern Continent, cigarette in hand, and eyes of a brownish‑yellow hue.
unit.target: Lumian iuvenem aestimavit, indubitanter ex Continente Septentrionali oriundum, habentem cigarette in manu et oculos fuscos–flavos.

unit.source: With a reserved smile, Lumian responded, “I found a killer.”
unit.target: Cum risu constituto, Lumian respondit: “Interfector inveni.”

unit.source: Amused, the well‑defined young man gestured toward the door.
unit.target: Iuvenis, risu oblectatus, digitum ad ostium movit.

unit.source: “For killers, go to the police on the opposite street.”
unit.target: “Interfectores, ite ad vigiles in via opposita.”

unit.source: Opposite the patrol team stood Port Pylos’s police headquarters.
unit.target: In via opposita stabat praesidium vigilum Portus Pylos.

unit.source: Maintaining his composure, Lumian reiterated, “He’s a serial killer.”
unit.target: Servans se compositum, Lumian iteravit: “Interfector serialis est.”

unit.source: “Serial killer…” The young man with the cigarette muttered to himself, his shifting demeanor betraying a sudden seriousness.
unit.target: “Interfector serialis…” Iuvenis, cigarette habens, ad se murmurat, mutatio in vultu eius subitam gravitatem indicans.

unit.source: “How do you know?”
unit.target: “Quomodo scis?”

unit.source: “I found many severed lips in his house—human lips,” Lumian disclosed with a reserved smile.
unit.target: “Multa labia abscissa in domo eius inveni—labia humana,” Lumian, risu constituto, declaravit.

unit.source: “Cut‑off lips?” The young man, yet to fasten his yellow vest, pressed with urgency, “Where’s his home?”
unit.target: “Labia abscissa?” Iuvenis, qui vestem flavam suam nondum alligaverat, cum sollicitudine quaesivit: “Ubi est domus eius?”

unit.source: After a brief pause, Lumian replied, “I can’t spell the street name, but I can take you to the scene. It’s on a street near the Man‑Eating Flower bar.”
unit.target: Post brevem intervallum, Lumian respondit: “Nomine viae scribere non possum, sed te ad locum ducere possum. Ea in via prope tabernam ‘Floris Voracis’ sita est.”

unit.source: Forcing himself to calm down, the young man took a drag on his cigarette and asked, “What about the killer? Did you see his face?”
unit.target: Coacto se ad quietem, iuvenis cigarette trahens rogavit: “Quid de interfectore? Num faciem eius vidisti?”

unit.source: “He’s dead,” Lumian truthfully responded.
unit.target: “Mortuus est,” respondit Lumian sincere.

unit.source: Taken aback for a moment, the brown‑haired young man queried, “How did he die?”
unit.target: Subito obstupefactus, iuvenis capillis fusco ornatus interrogavit: “Quomodo mortuus est?”

unit.source: Lumian’s reserved smile transformed into a more open one.
unit.target: Risu moderato Lumiani, constitutus, in risum apertiorem mutatus est.

unit.source: “I killed him.”
unit.target: “Eum interfeci.”

unit.source: The young man’s expression froze in disbelief.
unit.target: Vultus iuvenis in stupefactu congelatus est.

unit.source: He scrutinized Lumian for a few seconds before inquiring, “Are you an adventurer here to collect the bounty?”
unit.target: Eum Lumian per paucos secundos perspexit, deinde quaesivit: “Esne adventor hic, ut praemium raccipias?”

unit.source: Bram’s serial murders had prompted a local wanted poster issued by Admiral Querarill.
unit.target: Caedes seriales Bram excitaverunt, quae duxerunt ad posterum localem deprehensionis a Admirali Querarill editum.

unit.source: However, the poster lacked a corresponding name or appearance, featuring only a case description due to the suspect’s unidentified status.
unit.target: Attamen, tabula nomen aut speciem respondentem non habebat, sed solam descriptionem casus exhibebat, propter statum suspecti incognitum.

unit.source: Smiling, Lumian replied, “Sort of, but you can also claim it.”
unit.target: Subridente, Lumian respondit: “Quasi, sed id etiam vindicare potes.”

unit.source: The young man cast a glance at Lumian.
unit.target: Iuvenis oculos in Lumian coniecit.

unit.source: “What would you like in exchange?”
unit.target: “Quid in commutatione desideras?”

unit.source: “I want the dossier on a serial murder case from four years ago and the relevant items you gathered,” Lumian disclosed openly.
unit.target: “Volo dossier de casu caedis serialis ex annis quattuor abhinc, atque res pertinentes quas congregavisti,” Lumian aperte declaravit.

unit.source: There might be something among them that Ludwig could consume.
unit.target: Inter ea fortasse aliquid est quod Ludovicus edere possit.

unit.source: The young man fell into contemplative silence, assessing the pros and cons.
unit.target: Iuvenis in silentio contemplativo cecidit, pros et contraria aestimans.

unit.source: Eventually, he scratched his brown hair and said, “I can show you the case dossier and related items, but you can’t take them away. You can only copy them.
unit.target: Postremo, capillos fuscos excoriavit et dixit: “Tibi dossier casus et res pertinentes ostendere possum, sed ea tibi detrahere non licet. Solum ea exscribere potes.

unit.source: Also, I need to confirm if it’s a Serial Killer at the scene.”
unit.target: Item, mihi confirmare opus est utrum in loco interfector serialis adsit.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed, extending his right hand with a smile. “Happy working with you.”
unit.target: “Bene,” inquit Lumian, dextro manu extendens cum risu, “Gaudeo operari tecum.”

unit.source: The young man shook Lumian’s hand.
unit.target: Iuvenis manum Lumiani concussit.

unit.source: “Nice working with you. You can call me Camus. What about you?”
unit.target: “Iucundum operari tecum. Me Camus vocare potes. Quid de te?”

unit.source: Lumian smiled once more.
unit.target: Lumian iterum subridens restitit.

unit.source: “Louis Berry.”
unit.target: “Louis Berry.”

unit.source: As Camus entered the door deep in the hall, preparing to gather two teammates, he pondered, “Louis Berry… Why does this name sound familiar…”
unit.target: Cum Camus ostium in profundo atrii intravit, duo sodales congregare parans, meditatus est: “Louis Berry… Cur hoc nomen mihi familiariter sonat?”

unit.source: 640 Commonality
unit.target: 640 Communitas

unit.source: On the street adorned with the words “Chilicasco” in Dutanese, Lumian led Camus and the rest of the patrol team into the apartment crafted from dark black stones and brown wood.
unit.target: In via, quae verbis “Chilicasco” in Dutanese ornata erat, Lumian Camum et reliquos manipuli custodiae in habitationem ex lapidibus atris et ligno fusco exstructam duxit.

unit.source: The moment he swung open the door to Bram’s room, a blend of charred scent and the tang of blood wafted through the air.
unit.target: Cum ostium cubiculi Brami aperiret, mixtura odoris usti et acri sanguinis per aethera diffundebatur.

unit.source: Corpse fragments lay strewn across the floor, the walls tainted with a mixture of blood and flesh.
unit.target: Fragmenta cadaveris per pavimentum sparsa erant, et parietes mixtione sanguinis atque carnis maculatae erant.

unit.source: Handprints, crimson and searing marks adorned every surface.
unit.target: Impressiones manuum, rubrae et flagrantes vestigia, omnem superficiem ornabant.

unit.source: Camus’s eyes widened, as if thrust back into the midst of a serial killing.
unit.target: Oculi Camui late pandebantur, quasi iterum in medium caedis seriei rediecti essent.

unit.source: Yet, this was a level of devastation beyond even that.
unit.target: Attamen, hic erat gradus vastationis, prorsus ultra illud eminentis.

unit.source: Turning to Lumian, Camus, despite already anticipating the grim answer, habitually inquired, “Where’s that person’s body?”
unit.target: Ad Lumian conversus, Camus, quamvis iam responsum funestum praevidisset, more consueto interrogavit: “Ubi est corpus huius hominis?”

unit.source: Lumian gestured towards the scattered remains and minced meat, responding with a grim smile, “All of these.”
unit.target: Lumian ad reliquias dispersas et carnem minutatim concisam gesticulavit, et cum risus funesto respondit: “Omnia haec.”

unit.source: Camus fell into a momentary silence before signaling his two stunned teammates to examine the scene.
unit.target: Camus momentum silentii cepit, postea duobus sociis obstupescentibus signum dedit ut scaenam inspicerent.

unit.source: He had promised to share a portion of the bounty with them, making them witnesses to his “merits.”
unit.target: Pollicitus erat partem praemii cum illis communicaturum, eos testifices suorum meritorum faciens.

unit.source: Camus hadn’t ventured alone, wary that this might be a trap set by Louis Berry, an assassination attempt by the Rose School of Thought, or other secret organizations targeting the patrol team.
unit.target: Camus non solus profectus erat, timens ne esset insidiae a Louis Berry positarum, vel conatus caedis a Schola Rosae Rationis, aut aliarum arcani naturae organizationum destinatarum turmae custodiae.

unit.source: In the Southern Continent, vigilance was a necessity!
unit.target: In Continente Meridionali, vigilantia necessitas erat!

unit.source: Approaching a cupboard, Camus fixated his gaze on lips soaked in preservatives, the tragic fate of the victims replaying in his mind.
unit.target: Accedens ad armarium, Camus oculos in labia, quae conservantibus saturata erant, fudit, dum tragoedia victimarum in mente eius iterabantur.

unit.source: After a moment of silence, Louis Berry spoke calmly, “Bram is a member of the Devil family, Andariel.
unit.target: Post momentum silentii, Louis Berry tranquille dixit: “Bram membrum est familiae Diaboli, Andariel.”

unit.source: He was instructed by the Rose School of Thought to gather information in Port Pylos and carry out the serial murders.
unit.target: Ab Schola Rosae Rationis praeceptum accepit ut in Portu Pylos informationes colligeret et caedes serias conficeret.

unit.source: His uncle, Devajo, was supposed to be his contact, but they never actually met.
unit.target: Patruus eius, Devajo, debuit esse nexus eius, sed numquam convenere.

unit.source: Instead, he left the information he collected in the study of an empty house at 17 Aleg Street…
unit.target: Proinde, reliquit informationem collectam in studio domus vacuae in via Aleg numero XVII…

unit.source: Wh– Camus and the others were initially startled, then deeply puzzled.
unit.target: Quid – Camus et ceteri initio perterriti erant, deinde profunditer perplexi sunt.

unit.source: How does Louis Berry possess such detailed knowledge?
unit.target: Quomodo Louis Berry talem subtili notitiam possidet?

unit.source: Camus couldn’t help but glance at the scattered corpse pieces, the blood-soaked walls, the handprints on the ground, and the various charred marks.
unit.target: Camus non potuit quin aspiceret fragmenta cadaveris dispersa, parietes sanguine imbutatos, impressiones manuum in terra, ac varia vestigia combusta.

unit.source: Eventually, his gaze settled on Lumian’s face.
unit.target: Tandem, oculi eius in faciem Lumiani consederunt.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a warm smile curling his lips.
unit.target: Lumian respondit cum risu calido, labia sua curvans.

unit.source: Camus and his two companions exchanged glances, refraining from questioning whether Louis Berry obtained the information through spirit channeling, torture, or if he had discerned Bram’s motives from the start.
unit.target: Camus et duo comites oculos inter se commutaverunt, abstinentes a quaestionibus num Louis Berry notitias per communicationem spirituum, tormenta, aut initio consilia Brami perceptus esset.

unit.source: Louis’s pursuit of the serial murderer wasn’t solely due to a criminal act.
unit.target: Insecutio caedis seriei a Louis non solum ex scelere oriebatur.

unit.source: “This intel is crucial,” Camus nodded, gesturing towards the severely damaged six-barrel machine gun in the room.
unit.target: “Haec informatio crucialis est,” Camus annuens dixit, ad tormentum sex-canalicum in conclave graviter laesum demonstrans.

unit.source: “We need to secure Bram’s weapon.”
unit.target: “Arma Brami tuenda sunt.”

unit.source: “No problem,” Lumian replied casually.
unit.target: “Nihil est,” respondit Lumian, leve animadvertens.

unit.source: Being a Pyromaniac, firearms held little appeal for him.
unit.target: Cum pyro-maniacus esset, arma ignifera parum illi placebant.

unit.source: Fireballs proved far more potent than the rapid fire of a six-barrel machine gun–just not as swift.
unit.target: Globuli ignis longe potentiores erant quam celeriter iacula tormenti sex-canalici, sed non tam veloci.

unit.source: Camus placed the dossier and related items on the table in front of Lumian, emphasizing, “You can only read and record.”
unit.target: Camus dossier et res correlatas in mensa coram Lumiano posuit, extollens: “Legere et notare solum potes.”

unit.source: Taking it away or damaging it is not an option.
unit.target: Eum auferre aut laedere non est optio.

unit.source: Lumian nodded subtly, taking one of the envelopes, unwinding the thread a few times, and carefully opening it.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit, unum ex involucris sumens, filamentum aliquoties detorquens, atque diligenter aperiens.

unit.source: Rather than hastily perusing the contents, he first extracted the dossier, giving it a thorough read.
unit.target: Praeferens non festinanter perlegere contenta, primum fasciculum extraxit et diligenter legit.

unit.source: The dense dossier meticulously outlined the identities, origins, possible pathways, Sequences, locations of death, the scene’s conditions, and the varied speculations and investigations conducted by the patrol team.
unit.target: Densus dossier diligenter enarrabat identitates, origines, vias posibles, sequentias, loca mortis, condiciones scaenae, et varias speculationes atque investigationes a turma custodia peractas.

unit.source: It was clear the patrol team had been diligent in their investigations, especially when new victims kept emerging.
unit.target: Manifestum erat turmam custodiae investigationibus suis diligenter laboravisse, praesertim cum novi victimae continue apparuerunt.

unit.source: Daily operations varied until the serial murders appeared to cease, leading to a slackening of efforts.
unit.target: Opera cotidiana variabantur, donec caedes seriales desistere videbantur, ad minuendum conatum ducens.

unit.source: They gradually reduced the frequency of case studies and large-scale visit trips.
unit.target: Gradatim frequentiam casuum studiorum et itinerum magnorum minuere coeperunt.

unit.source: After six months, investigations reached a standstill, concluding the dossier.
unit.target: Post sex menses, investigationes quietem attigerunt, atque dossier conclusum est.

unit.source: In the final report, the vice-captain overseeing the matter concluded: “This is a classic serial murder case committed by the Devil pathway.
unit.target: In relatione finali, vice-captain concludit: “Hic est casus classicus caedis seriei, per viam Diaboli commissus.

unit.source: Though Serial Killers seldom target only seven individuals, as more victims enhance the ritual’s efficacy, this time, all victims are Beyonders, including Mid-Sequence Beyonders.
unit.target: Etsi caedes seriales vix tantum septem homines aggrediuntur, cum plures victimae ritui efficacitatem addant, hoc tempore omnes victimae sunt Beyonders, inter quos etiam Mid-Sequence Beyonders.

unit.source: Even with just seven deaths, they are more favored by Devils, pleasing them more than 14 or even 20 ordinary people.
unit.target: Etiam solis septem mortibus, Diaboli eos magis faverunt, quam cum quattuordecim aut viginti hominibus vulgaribus.

unit.source: “The main question in this mystic case is that, aside from being Beyonders, there’s no common thread among the seven victims.
unit.target: “Quaestio principalis in hoc casu mystico est: praeterquam Beyonders esse, inter septem victimas nullus nexus communis invenitur.

unit.source: This sets it apart from previous serial murders.
unit.target: Hoc illud ab antecedentibus caedibus serialibus distinguit.

unit.source: “We hypothesize that the seven victims were active Beyonders in West Balam, likely having committed some form of killing in the past.
unit.target: “Hypothesimus septem victimas fuisse Beyonders activos in West Balam, fortasse aliquem modum caedis praeteritum commissos.

unit.source: It can be seen as a manifestation of depravity…”
unit.target: “Hoc videndum est ut manifestatio pravitatis…”

unit.source: Lumian read it meticulously, concurring with the theory that seven Beyonders surpassed 14 ordinary individuals in Devil-pleasing rituals.
unit.target: Lumian id diligenter legit, consentiens theoriae quod septem Beyonders quattuordecim homines ordinarios in ritibus Diabolicis superabant.

unit.source: This wasn’t new information to him.
unit.target: Haec ei non nova erant notitia.

unit.source: After all, ordinary people were only the third-best sacrifice, while creatures with Beyonder characteristics ranked second.
unit.target: Nam homines ordinarii solum tertia optima sacrificia erant, dum creaturae quae proprietates Beyonder habebant, loco secundo collocabantur.

unit.source: Similar situations arose in specific “acts,” particularly those requiring feedback.
unit.target: Similes casus oriebantur in quibusdam “actis,” praesertim iis quae relationem postulabant.

unit.source: It was akin to deciphering an Angel’s conspiracy, allowing Lumian to assimilate a potion more effectively than an ordinary person’s intrigue.
unit.target: Hoc simile erat ad enodationem coniurationis angeli, quod Lumian potionem magis efficaciter quam insidias hominis ordinarii assimilare potuit.

unit.source: Having grasped a general understanding of the entire serial murder case, Lumian delved into gathering information about the seven Beyonders.
unit.target: Postquam intellexit rationem generalem totius casus caedis serialis, Lumian in informationes de septem Beyonders colligendas se immerxit.

unit.source: Synthesizing Anthony’s psychological profile of Hisoka, Franca’s archetype summary and her speculations about the actor, he scoured for potential commonalities.
unit.target: Coniungens profilo psychologico Hisokae a Anthony, summariam archetypi Francae et eius speculationes de actor, quaesivit communes similitudines.

unit.source: Among the Beyonders were both men and women, one under Admiral Querarill, while another was a Death believer residing in Port Pylos.
unit.target: Inter Beyonders erant et viri et feminae: unus sub Admiro Querarill, et alter, mortis cultor, in Portu Pylos habitabat.
