unit.source: Foreign adventurers, an Intis Republic spy stationed in Matani, a peripheral member of the Rose School of Thought, and a local clergyman of the God of Steam and Machinery Church were also among the list.
unit.target: Adhuc in indice erant adventores peregrini, speculator Reipublicae Intis stationatus in Matani, membrum marginale Scholae Rosae Rationis, et sacerdos localis Ecclesiae Dei Vaporis et Machinarum.

unit.source: Judging by their identities and backgrounds, they seemingly had nothing in common.
unit.target: Ex identitatibus et originibus iudicatis, apparens nulla communia inter eos esse videbantur.

unit.source: Yet, for Lumian, who read with subjective conjectures, subtle details held significance.
unit.target: Attamen, pro Lumiano, qui cum subiectivis coniecturis legebat, subtilia particula magni ponderis erant.

unit.source: All seven victims were young, with the oldest in his early thirties, widely praised for combat talent and outstanding intelligence.
unit.target: Omnes septem victimae iuvenes erant; vetustimus eorum in incipiente tricesimo anno erat, late laudatus propter artem pugnae et acutam intelligentiam.

unit.source: Lumian mused to himself, “Are the targets Beyonders who are young, filled with potential, and have already reached a certain level of maturity?
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est: “Num scopi sunt Beyonders, qui iuvenes, plenis potentiae, atque iam ad certum gradum maturitatis perventi videntur?

unit.source: Even the two who weren’t particularly young bore the label of being famous, powerful, with limitless potential…”
unit.target: Etiam duo, qui non nimis iuvenes erant, portabant titulum celebritatis, potentiae, cum potentiale sine limite…

unit.source: Lumian gained a rough understanding of Hisoka’s selection criteria.
unit.target: Lumian sensum rudimentarium criteriorum electionis Hisokae adeptus est.

unit.source: If Franca were present, she might have noted that it matched the characteristics of the original archetype.
unit.target: Si Franca praesens fuisset, forte animadvertisset id cum notis archetypi originalis congruere.

unit.source: However, Lumian believed Hisoka would adhere to the archetype when it suited him, not letting it dictate his true motives.
unit.target: Sed Lumian putabat Hisokam archetypi sequendum esse ut ei placebat, nec sineret id veras causas eius determinare.

unit.source: Mad Lady’s evaluation of Hisoka as not being pure enough further supported Lumian’s perspective.
unit.target: Aestimatio ab “Mad Lady”, quae Hisokam non satis purum esse dixerat, opinionem Lumiani corroboravit.

unit.source: Considering the selection criteria, Lumian thought, Louis Berry fits Hisoka’s homicidal fetish.
unit.target: Consideratis criteriis electionis, Lumian putavit Louis Berry ad Hisokae homicidalem libidinem convenire.

unit.source: He clicked his tongue and retrieved items related to the case from the official envelopes.
unit.target: Linguam strinxit et res, quae ad casum pertinentes videbantur, ex involucris officialibus extraxit.

unit.source: Most were the victim’s belongings, but there were also seven thin aluminum foils stained with blackish-brown substances that didn’t belong to this group.
unit.target: Pleraque erant possessiones victimarum, sed etiam septem tenues foliis aluminii, substantiis nigro-fuscis tinctas, quae huic coetu non pertinebant, erant.

unit.source: Described in the case file, they were wrappings for the local chocolate, left at each crime scene.
unit.target: Descripta in fasciculo casus, haec erant involucra pro chocolata locali, relinqua in omni scena criminis.

unit.source: It was suspected that the murderer would peel off the thin foil after success, indulging in a piece of chocolate before dissecting the corpse.
unit.target: Supposabatur quod interfector tenue folium post successum ablatum, et antequam cadaver dissequeretur, particulam chocolatae degustare.

unit.source: As the murderer used a gloved hand to extract and consume the chocolate, no corresponding traces were left on the thin foil.
unit.target: Cum interfector manu chirotheca induta ad extrahendum et edendum chocolatum utebatur, nullae vestigia congruentes in tenue folium relicta sunt.

unit.source: Such chocolates were common in Matani, making tracking difficult.
unit.target: Talia chocolata in Matani erant communia, atque id vestigationem difficilem faciebat.

unit.source: Lumian studied the thin aluminum foil before smiling at Camus, who supervised him.
unit.target: Lumian tenue folium aluminii examinavit, et deinde Camus, qui eum vigilabat, subridente aspexit.

unit.source: “Can I take two or three?”
unit.target: “Possumne duas aut tres sumere?”

unit.source: Camus, with his brown hair, furrowed his brow.
unit.target: Camus, cum capillis fuscis, supercilium contraxit.

unit.source: “If you want to use divination or other Beyonder methods, you can do it here.”
unit.target: “Si divinationem aut alias Beyonder methodos uti velis, hic id facere potes.”

unit.source: “Just two. It won’t hinder your future investigations,” Lumian said enticingly.
unit.target: “Modo duo. Non erit impedimentum futuris inquisitionibus tuis,” Lumian allicenter dixit.

unit.source: “If you agree to help, I’ll give you an additional reward.
unit.target: “Si assentieris ut adiuvare, tibi praemium additum dabo.

unit.source: For example, a very useful summoning incantation for a spirit world creature.”
unit.target: Exempli gratia, incantationem evocationis valde utilem pro creatura orbis spirituum.

unit.source: Camus fell silent briefly before agreeing, “Deal.”
unit.target: Camus breviter silentium cepit, deinde dixit: “Pactum.”

unit.source: After nearly a minute, Camus shifted his gaze to Lumian, leisurely sitting on the side, peeling off the thin aluminum foil and savoring a piece of dark-brown chocolate.
unit.target: Post paene minutum, Camus oculos ad Lumian vertit, qui lente ad latus sedebat, tenue folium aluminii desprendens et particulam chocolatae fuscatae degustabat.

unit.source: He inquired in a deep voice, “Is this the very useful spirit world creature you mentioned?”
unit.target: Interrogavit voce profunda: “Num haec est ipsa creatura orbis spirituum, quam memorasti esse valde utilem?”

unit.source: Lumian, chewing on the fragrant chocolate, responded with a smile, “Yes, it’s one of the Rabbits of Knowledge.”
unit.target: Lumian, dum chocolatum aromaticum masticabat, subridente respondit: “Ita, una ex Cuniculis Scientiae est.”

unit.source: It can help you evade the labor of copying.
unit.target: Potest tibi auxilium ferre ne laborem recopiandi subeas.

unit.source: What do I need such a copying tool for!?
unit.target: Quid mihi opus est tali instrumento recopiandi!?

unit.source: Camus bellowed inwardly, but he restrained himself as he recalled the bounty for the serial murders and the grisly scene of Bram’s demise.
unit.target: Camus intus clamitavit, sed se continuit, reminiscens praemium pro caedibus serialibus atque scaenae horribundae Brami.

unit.source: Lumian added with a smile, “When you prefer to keep the origin of your words hidden, summon the Rabbit of Knowledge for assistance.
unit.target: Lumian, subridente, addidit: “Si mavis originem verborum tuorum celare, evoca Cuniculum Scientiae ad auxilium.

unit.source: Moreover, this is a growth-oriented spirit world creature.
unit.target: Praeterea, haec creatura orbis spirituum ad incrementum destinata est.

unit.source: It evolves based on the knowledge it receives.
unit.target: Ex scientia quam accipit evolvitur.

unit.source: Of course, it’s ideal if you can secure a contract with the spirit world creature.
unit.target: Certe, optimum est, si contractum cum hac creatura orbis spirituum assequi possis.

unit.source: Otherwise, each summoned Rabbit of Knowledge might differ, making nurturing impossible.”
unit.target: Alioquin, unusquisque evocat Cuniculus Scientiae aliter esse potest, quod colendi negotium impossibile facit.

unit.source: “Growth-oriented…” Camus echoed the term, his expression gradually softening.
unit.target: “Ad incrementum spectans…” Camus verbum repetivit, vultus eius paulatim leniens.

unit.source: “Try eating these,” he suggested with a smile.
unit.target: “Conare haec edere,” subridente suadet.

unit.source: 641 Information From Eating
unit.target: 641 Notitia Ex Edendo

unit.source: Lugano, who had been observing from the sidelines, was taken aback when Lumian handed the thin aluminum foil to Ludwig and inquired if he wanted to eat it.
unit.target: Lugano, qui ex lateribus spectabat, stupuit, cum Lumian tenuam laminam aluminii Ludovico tradidit atque rogavit num eam edere vellet.

unit.source: Despite Ludwig’s previous display of abnormal eating habits, including drinking a tube of human blood in front of Lugano, revealing all the corresponding information, Lugano still harbored reservations about feeding Ludwig just anything, especially something as unconventional as aluminum foil.
unit.target: Non obstante Ludwig prioribus exhibitionibus morum edendi anomalorum, inter quos etiam bibere tubum sanguinis humani coram Lugano, ostendens omnia informationes pertinentes, Lugano tamen dubitationes retinebat de eo quod Ludwig id quodque ederet, praesertim aliquid tam insoliti quam laminam aluminii.

unit.source: After all, Ludwig was still a child!
unit.target: Postremo, Ludwig adhuc puer erat!

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Lugano witnessed Ludwig silently accepting the old, thin aluminum foil, stuffing it into his mouth, chewing, and swallowing.
unit.target: In momento, Lugano vidit Ludovicum silentio accipere laminam tenuam vetustae aluminii, eam in os inserere, masticare, atque deglutire.

unit.source: “…” Lugano found himself in a daze.

Once Ludwig finished consuming the aluminum foil, he calmly turned to Lumian and inquired, “Which details do you need–information on the cocoa beans used, the precise quantity, additional ingredients, the origin of the aluminum foil ingredients, the production factories, or the individuals most in contact with it?”
unit.target: Postquam Ludwig laminam aluminii consumpsit, tranquille se vertit ad Lumian et quaesivit: "Quae singularia tibi necessaria sunt – informationes de fabis cocae adhibitis, de quantitate certa, de ingredientibus additis, de origine ingredientium laminæ aluminii, de officinis productionis, an de personis maxime ad eam pertinentibus?"

unit.source: Lumian shook his head slowly.
unit.target: Lumian lente caput concussit.

unit.source: “No need.”
unit.target: “Non opus est.”

unit.source: This information wouldn’t help track down Hisoka.
unit.target: Haec notitia Hisokam detegere non adiuvabat.

unit.source: Hisoka had touched the thin aluminum foil while wearing gloves, leaving behind no corresponding personal details.
unit.target: Hisoka laminam tenuam aluminii attigit, chirothecis gerens, neque ullas notabiles informationes personales reliquit.

unit.source: The patrol team had already confirmed that the chocolate packaging was common in Port Pylos, and there was nothing distinctive about the taste.
unit.target: Manipulus vigiliarum iam confirmaverat quod involucra chocolatae in Portu Pylos communia erant, et nihil de sapore distinctum erat.

unit.source: As Lumian responded, a mix of amusement and surprise washed over him.
unit.target: Dum Lumian respondebat, mixtio laetitiae et stuporis eum pervasit.

unit.source: He can even extract such information from eating?
unit.target: Possitne etiam ex edendo tales informationes extrahere?

unit.source: As expected of a monster capable of recovering just by eating and gradually breaking free from the seal’s constraints!
unit.target: Sicut exspectatum erat ab monstro, qui solum ex edendo se reficere atque paulatim a vinculis sigilli liberari poterat!

unit.source: Ludwig seemed to relish the delicacy.
unit.target: Ludwig videbatur ex hac delicia multum frui.

unit.source: After a few moments, he remarked, “The residual chocolate has a hint of depravity.”
unit.target: Post paucos momenta, dixit: "Relictum chocolatum levem vestigium depravationis habet."

unit.source: Depravity?
unit.target: Depravitas?

unit.source: Could it be that Hisoka had carried it for an extended period, corrupting it?
unit.target: Num Hisoka id per longum tempus tulerit, illud corrumpens?

unit.source: That doesn’t make sense.
unit.target: Id non rationem habet.

unit.source: Unless one was a demigod, Beyonder auras couldn’t reach such a level.
unit.target: Nisi quis semideus esset, aurae Beyonder talem gradum attingere non poterant.

unit.source: The only possibility was that they were on the brink of losing control, deep in a state of depravity.
unit.target: Unica possibilitas erat, eos ad finem imperii amittendi esse, in statu profundi depravationis.

unit.source: However, such a Beyonder’s body would undoubtedly display various abnormal details.
unit.target: Attamen, corpus huiusmodi Beyonder sine dubio varias notas anormales exhiberet.

unit.source: They wouldn’t be able to leave the house; stepping out would lead to discovery and pursuit by law enforcers.
unit.target: Domum relinquere non poterent; exire enim ad deprehensionem et insequentiam ab agentibus legis duceret.

unit.source: Could he rely on the human skin Bram mentioned for disguise?
unit.target: Num in cute humana, quam Bram memoravit, uti posset ad se dissimulandum?

unit.source: Lumian was initially puzzled, but then he asked with anticipation, “A decadent aura from the Devil pathway?”
unit.target: Lumian initio perplexus erat, sed deinde cum expectatione quaesivit: "Aura decadentia ex via Diaboli?"

unit.source: Ludwig licked his lips, savoring the taste of the chocolate residue.
unit.target: Ludwig labiis lambit, saporem residui chocolatae degustans.

unit.source: “Yes, at least a Demon’s.”
unit.target: "Ita, saltem daemonis."

unit.source: “Demon’s?” Lumian was taken aback and couldn’t help but frown.
unit.target: "Daemonis?" Lumian obstupefactus est et non potuit frontem contrahere.

unit.source: Having extensively studied Devilology, he knew that Sequence 4 of the Devil pathway was known as Demon, representing a demigod.
unit.target: Diabologiae diligenter studiosus, sciebat Sequenciam IV viae Diaboli notum esse ut Daemon, repraesentans semideum.

unit.source: If the chocolate slightly tainted with a decadent aura came from a Demon, it clearly didn’t belong to Hisoka.
unit.target: Si chocolatum leviter aura decadentis tinctum a daemon provenisset, manifeste non Hisokae esset.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t arrogantly dismissing Hisoka’s potential to have advanced to Sequence 4.
unit.target: Lumian non superbiter negabat possibilitatem Hisokae ad Sequenciam IV pervenisse.

unit.source: Instead, the aluminum foil and chocolate marks represented the state four years ago.
unit.target: Immo, signa laminæ aluminii et chocolatae statum quattuor annos abhinc repraesentabant.

unit.source: Hisoka couldn’t have been a Demon back then, unless he had become a Desire Apostle upon transmigration.
unit.target: Hisoka tunc daemon esse non potuisset, nisi post transmigrationem Apostolus Desiderii factus esset.

unit.source: If that were the case, his targets for the serial murders should have been Sequence 6 or 5 Beyonders.
unit.target: Si ita fuisset, metas eius in caedibus seriatim Sequenciae VI vel V Beyonder fuisse debuissent.

unit.source: Although Beyonders at this level were rare in Matani, Devilology didn’t specify that serial murders could only occur in one location.
unit.target: Etsi Beyonder huius gradus in Matani rari erant, Devilologia non specificavit caedes seriatim solum in uno loco evenire posse.

unit.source: “Are you certain?” Lumian looked at Ludwig for confirmation.
unit.target: "Esne certus?" Lumian Ludovicum aspexit ad confirmationem.

unit.source: Ludwig replied earnestly, “A Demon’s decadent aura has a completely different texture from Low- to Mid-Sequence Devils.”
unit.target: Ludwig sincere respondit: "Aura decadentia daemonis texturam penitus diversam habet quam daemonia, quae in Sequencia inferiori ad mediocrem incumbunt."

unit.source: Upon hearing his godson’s response, an image suddenly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Audito filii adoptivi responso, subitam imaginem in mente Lumiani orsus est.

unit.source: Hisoka standing within the wall of spirituality, engaged in a special ritual to establish a connection with a Demon.
unit.target: Hisoka, intra murum spiritualitatis stans, se implicabat in ritu speciali ad connexionem cum daemone.

unit.source: Throughout this process, a few pieces of chocolate wrapped in thin aluminum foil remained in his pocket.
unit.target: Per hoc processum, paucae particulae chocolatae in tenuī laminā aluminii involutae in sinu eius remanebant.

unit.source: They were slightly tainted by the decadent aura permeating the altar, subtly and silently transforming…
unit.target: Illi leviter tintabantur aura decadentia altare pervadente, subtiliter ac tacite se transformantes…

unit.source: Yes, when I perform a ritual, I don’t remove all my belongings in advance and leave them outside the altar unless there’s a specific mention in the ritual requirements that I should avoid…
unit.target: Ita, cum ritu ago, omnia bona mea non praeauferam neque extra altare relinquam, nisi in requisitis rituum specifica verba occurrant…

unit.source: As a Conspirer, Lumian quickly made a guess and asked Ludwig, “Can you tell which Demon’s decadent aura it belongs to?”
unit.target: Ut conspirator, Lumian celeriter coniecturam fecit et Ludovicum rogavit: "Potesne dicere cui daemonis aura decadentia pertineat?"

unit.source: Lumian’s current idea was that if Hisoka couldn’t be found in the future, he would exhaust his resources and seek the help of the New City of Silver’s Demon-Hunter experts.
unit.target: Sententia Lumiani fuit, si Hisoka in futurum reperiri non posset, opes suas consumptus esse et auxilium peritorum daemonum venatorum Novi Urbis Argenteae quaesiturus esse.

unit.source: He would set up a ritual and summon the Demon who had established a connection with Hisoka.
unit.target: Ritum constitueret et daemonem evocaret, qui cum Hisoka connexionem instituerat.

unit.source: He would have it beaten up before interrogating it for information about Hisoka.
unit.target: Illud verberaret, antequam de Hisoka informationibus interrogaret.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludovicus caput quassavit.

unit.source: “I can’t absorb such subtle information yet. All I know is that the decadent aura belongs to a family called Nois.”
unit.target: "Non possum adhuc talem subtilia notitiae absorbere. Omne quod scio est quod aura decadentia familiae nomine Nois pertinet."

unit.source: Nois, one of the three Devil families…
unit.target: Nois, una ex tribus familiis daemonum…

unit.source: The Demon responding to Hisoka’s special ritual is from the Nois family? That’s peculiar.
unit.target: Daemon, qui ad ritu speciali Hisokae respondebat, ex familia Nois erat? Id mirum est.

unit.source: How can a Demon respond to a ritual remotely?
unit.target: Quomodo daemon ad ritum remotis modis respondere potest?

unit.source: It has to be at Sequence 3, or even at the Angel level…
unit.target: Oportet eum esse in Sequencia III, vel etiam ad gradum Angeli…

unit.source: According to Devilology, Serial Killers can summon projections of Abyss Demons because those Devils can use the special properties of the Abyss to respond, not because they have reached the corresponding level.
unit.target: Secundum Devilologiam, caedentes seriatim possunt effigies daemonum Abyssi evocare, quoniam illi daemonia proprietates speciales Abyssi ad respondendum uti possunt, non quia ad gradum correspondantem pervenerint.

unit.source: However, the Nois family is a Devil family active in the real world and hasn’t entered the Abyss…
unit.target: Attamen, familia Nois est familia daemonum in mundo reali activa et in Abyssum non ingressa…

unit.source: Lumian made many connections from the Nois last name.
unit.target: Lumian multas coniunctiones ex cognomine Nois intellexit.

unit.source: He concluded by listing three possibilities:
unit.target: Conclusit enumerare tres possibilitates:

unit.source: Firstly, the Demon responding to the Hisoka ritual was none other than the Nois family’s Angel.
unit.target: Primum, daemon qui ad ritu Hisokae respondebat, nihil aliud erat quam Angelus familiae Nois.

unit.source: Secondly, it had reached Sequence 3 and was located in Port Pylos, near Hisoka.
unit.target: Secundo, ad Sequenciam III pervenit et in Portu Pylos, prope Hisokam, collocatus erat.

unit.source: Thirdly, the Nois family had a close connection to the Abyss. They could borrow the Abyss’s properties to some extent. Even a Demon could respond to prayers from afar.
unit.target: Tertio, familia Nois arctam habebat nexum cum Abyssi. Possent proprietates Abyssi ad aliquem modum adhibere. Etiam daemon ad preces a longinquo respondere posset.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked Ludwig, “Any other information?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et Ludovicum rogavit: "Alia informationes?"

unit.source: “No,” Ludwig replied, disappointing Lumian.
unit.target: "Non," Ludovicus respondit, Lumianum deprimens.

unit.source: Lumian handed over the remaining piece of aluminum foil.
unit.target: Lumian reliquam partem laminæ aluminii tradidit.

unit.source: “Try this one too.”
unit.target: "Experire hoc quoque."

unit.source: Ludwig didn’t hesitate. Like many children drawn to the sweetness lingering on wrappers, he popped the thin foil stained with chocolate into his mouth and chewed.
unit.target: Ludovicus non dubitavit. Sicut multi pueri dulcedine in involucris residuae allecti, tenuam laminam aluminii, chocolatae tinctam, in os coniecit et masticavit.

unit.source: After a moment, while Lugano snapped back to reality, Ludwig looked at Lumian and remarked, “There’s more to this one.”
unit.target: Post momentum, dum Lugano ad realitatem rediit, Ludovicus Lumian intuens dixit: "Hoc amplius est."

unit.source: “What kind of information?” Lumian knew that Ludwig’s special mention had to be of some value.
unit.target: "Quam notitiam?" Lumian sciebat mentionem specialem Ludovici quandam valorem habere.

unit.source: Ludwig responded with the air of a connoisseur, “This thin aluminum foil rested on a table marked by old blood and a splash of coffee. The blood belonged to a deceased male. The spirituality was initially potent, and the coffee was Fermo blend, unsweetened, distinctly bitter yet fragrant.”
unit.target: Ludovicus, cum ingenio perito, respondit: "Haec tenua lamina aluminii in mensa, quae notata erat sanguine vetusto et stilla café, reposita erat. Sanguis viro defuncto pertinuit. Spiritualitas initio potentissima erat, et café erat mixtura Fermo, non dulcificata, prorsus amara sed fragrantissima."

unit.source: Upon hearing Ludwig’s account, Lumian’s mind painted another vivid scene.
unit.target: Audito Ludovici enuntiato, mens Lumiani aliam scaenam vividam delineavit.

unit.source: A few pieces of chocolate wrapped in thin aluminum foil lay nonchalantly on a table, soaked in old blood and spilled coffee. They seemed to share an intimate connection for an extended period. Then, a hand reached out, snatched them up, and swiftly pocketed them before making a hasty exit.
unit.target: Paucae particulae chocolatae, in tenuī laminā aluminii involutae, in mensa non curantes iacebant, sanguine vetusto et café effuso madentes. Illae videbantur intima relatione per longum tempus cohaerere. Tum manus eis accessit, rapuit et celeriter in saccum coniecut antequam festinanter exiret.

unit.source: Connecting the dots, Lumian strongly suspected that the table had served Hisoka in a dwelling he once occupied.
unit.target: Coniungens indices, Lumian firmiter suspicabatur mensam Hisokae in domo quondam quam occupantem fuisset.

unit.source: “Do you have detailed information on the male deceased?” Lumian probed Ludwig for more insights.
unit.target: "Habesne informationes accuratas de viro defuncto?" Lumian Ludovicum interrogavit ad plura discenda.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head once more.
unit.target: Ludovicus iterum caput concussit.

unit.source: “No, unless I consume the blood directly.”
unit.target: "Non, nisi sanguinem directe consumam."

unit.source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Autoribus in WebNovel directe sustenta!

unit.source: The bloodstains likely belonged to one of the victims, Lumian surmised.
unit.target: Maculae sanguinis verisimiliter ad unum ex victimis pertinentes esse suspicabatur, Lumian coniectans.

unit.source: He pondered whether this information was documented in the case file or elsewhere.
unit.target: Meditatus est num haec notitia in fasciculo causae aut alibi documenta esset.

unit.source: Was Hisoka using “No, unless I consume the blood directly.”
unit.target: Dictebatne Hisoka "Non, nisi sanguinem directe consumam"?

unit.source: The bloodstains likely belonged to one of the victims, Lumian wondered if the table had served as an autopsy platform or perhaps an altar?
unit.target: Maculae sanguinis verisimiliter ad unum ex victimis pertinentes erant; Lumian quaerebat num mensa, ut instrumentum ad autopsiam vel fortasse ut altare, functum esset.

unit.source: Lumian mused inwardly, a tinge of disappointment clouding his thoughts.
unit.target: Lumian intime meditatus est, parva taedio delusus, cogitationes eius obscurans.

unit.source: Nevertheless, he refocused his attention on the Fermo coffee.
unit.target: Attamen, animadvertit iterum in café Fermo.

unit.source: Does this mean that Hisoka has a penchant for coffee, specifically the Fermo blend from the Paz Valley…
unit.target: Num hoc significat Hisokam tenere cafearum delectationem, praesertim mixturam Fermo ex Valli Paz?

unit.source: In the Paz Valley, nestled in the Southern Continent, boasted the renowned Fermo coffee, comparable to Feynapotter’s highlander coffee and the Southern Continent’s own version.
unit.target: In Valle Paz, in Continente Meridionali situs, praeclarum café Fermo effulgebat, comparabile café montano Feynapotter et ipsius Continenti Meridionalis versione.

unit.source: It was a luxury enjoyed mainly by the middle class for extended periods.
unit.target: Hoc erat luxus, qui praecipue a classe media per longum temporis spatium fructus est.

unit.source: In Matani, where both East and West Balam produced high-quality coffee beans, such occurrences were rare.
unit.target: In Matani, ubi et Orientalis et Occidentalis Balam semina café summo qualitate novertere soluerunt, talia casus rari erant.

unit.source: The locals had access to a plethora of excellent coffee beans.
unit.target: Indigeni ad multitudinem eximiorum seminum café accessum habebant.

unit.source: Those unfit for export were sold at affordable prices, favored by both colonists and natives.
unit.target: Ea, quae ad exportationem inidonea erant, pretio parabili vendebantur, a colonis et indigenis favebantur.

unit.source: Lugano, now fully attentive, cautiously added, “I’ve heard that those who frequent Fermo coffee appreciate its bitterness and fragrance. However, those who prefer it without sugar are a rare breed.”
unit.target: Lugano, nunc plenissime attentus, caute addidit: "Audivi eos, qui Café Fermo frequentant, amaritudinem eius et fragrantiam colere. Attamen, qui sine saccharo eam praeferunt, genus exiguum sunt."

unit.source: In essence, Hisoka’s unique taste in coffee is uncommon here…
unit.target: In essentia, singularis gustus Hisokae in café hic singulare est.

unit.source: Lumian smiled at Ludwig and remarked, “Well done. If I apprehend the target in the future, I’ll give him to you.”
unit.target: Lumian Ludiovico subridens dixit: "Bene factum. Si in futuro scopum apprehendo, illud tibi tradam."

unit.source: When the time came, Lumian would likely be a Sequence 5. Moreover, he wouldn’t give Ludwig the Beyonder characteristic. Lumian could ease his grip on the boy.
unit.target: Cum tempus advenisset, Lumian verisimiliter Sequenciae V essem. Praeterea, Ludwig proprietatem Beyonder non acciperet. Lumian tenacitatem in puero laxare posset.

unit.source: Give… The notion sent a chill down Lugano’s spine, a hint that his imagination might have run too wild.
unit.target: Da… Notio glaciem per spinam Lugani infudit, indicium afferens imaginationem nimis profligatam esse.

unit.source: To others, gifting a Beyonder of the Devil’s Pathway might relegate the recipient to a life of servitude or worse, becoming an ingredient. However, with Ludwig…
unit.target: Aliis, donatio Beyonder viae Diaboli recipienti vitam servitutis aut peius, ut pars fieri, destinare posset. Attamen, cum Ludovico…

unit.source: Lugano involuntarily shuddered.
unit.target: Lugano involuntarie tremuit.

unit.source: He didn’t dare to think about it!
unit.target: Non audebat de eo cogitare!

unit.source: Ludwig nodded, his eyes gleaming with anticipation.
unit.target: Ludovicus annuit, oculis spe relucentibus.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Lugano and said, “Don’t you have a good grasp of Dutanese? Check Port Pylos this afternoon and find out which shops sell Fermo coffee. It’s preferable if it’s one that has been operating for four to five years or longer.”
unit.target: Lumian ad Lugano conversus dixit: "Nonne bene Dutanice nosti? Revidere Portum Pylos hac postmeridiana hora et invenire tabernas, quae Café Fermo vendunt. Melius est, si ea per quattuor ad quinque annos aut diutius operetur."

unit.source: “Alright.” Lugano suddenly felt a surge of usefulness.
unit.target: "Recte." Lugano subito sensum utilitatis sensit.

unit.source: In the evening, he returned to Suite 7 at B3 and reported to Lumian, “There are only three shops selling Fermo coffee. One is on Cania Street in Resurrection Square…”
unit.target: Vespere ad Suite 7 in B3 rediit et Lumiano nuntiavit: "Tres tantum sunt tabernae Café Fermo vendentes. Una est in Via Cania in Piazza Resurrectionis…"

unit.source: “You mentioned Cania Street in Resurrection Square?” Lumian interjected.
unit.target: "Meministine Viae Cania in Piazza Resurrectionis?" Lumian interpellavit.

unit.source: “Yes, Unit 21 on that street. It’s called Matani Import and Export Shop,” Lugano confirmed.
unit.target: "Ita, Unitas XXI in illa via. Vocatur Matani Import et Export Shop," Lugano confirmavit.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent.
unit.target: Lumian tacuit.

unit.source: “Isn’t it close to Port Pylos’s patrol team?”
unit.target: "Nonne prope est manipulum vigiliarum Portus Pylos?"

unit.source: In Port Pylos, on the third floor of the building housing the patrol team.
unit.target: In Portu Pylos, in tertio pavimento aedificii, quod manipulum vigiliarum continet.

unit.source: Camus received the bounty and gave a fifth to his two companions.
unit.target: Camus praemium accepit et partem quintam duobus comitibus dedit.

unit.source: He then entered the telegraph room and inquired of the telegraphist, “Do you have a telegram for me?”
unit.target: Deinde in cellam telegraphicam intravit et a telegraphista rogavit: "Habesne mihi telegramma?"

unit.source: He had previously sent a telegram to inquire with certain friends if they had any information on Louis Berry, the adventurer.
unit.target: Prius telegramma miserat, ut quaereret a quibusdam amicis si aliqua notitia de Ludovico Berry, viatore, haberent.

unit.source: Since they were in collaboration, he needed to ascertain the other party’s situation first!
unit.target: Quoniam collaborabant, primum statum alterius partis agnoscere debebat!

unit.source: The female telegraphist, wearing a sweet smile, straightened up and responded, “Yes! From Farim.”
unit.target: Telegraphista femina, dulci risu ornata, se recta sustulit et respondit: "Ita! Ex Farim."

unit.source: 642 Visit
unit.target: 642 Visitatio

unit.source: Camus extended his thanks to the telegrapher, retrieved his telegram, and swiftly scanned its contents.
unit.target: Camus telegraphistae gratias egit, telegramma restituit, atque celeriter eius contenta perlegit.

unit.source: “Louis Berry, Intisian, hailed as the most renowned adventurer in the Fog Sea over the past six months.
unit.target: “Louis Berry, Intisianus, praeclarissimus explorator in Mare Nebula per sex menses praeteritos celebratus est.

unit.source: Sporting a distinctive golden straw hat, he successfully hunted down the Demon Warlock Burman, earning a hefty bounty of 600,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Indutus pileo stramineo aureo distinctivo, daemon magus Burman feliciter venatus est, adeptus ingentem praemium 600,000 verl d’or.

unit.source: Furthermore, he collaborated with the Earth Mother Church in Port Santa to address the crisis surrounding the Sea Prayer Ritual.
unit.target: Praeterea, cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae in Portu Santa cooperavit ad resolvendam difficultatem circa Ritum Maris Precatum.

unit.source: However, the precise details remain elusive…
unit.target: Tamen, singula exacta nondum patefacta sunt…

unit.source: Upon perusing the telegram, Camus released a silent sigh and remarked to himself, He’s truly a great adventurer.
unit.target: Telegramma perlegens, Camus silentem suspensionem edidit et ad se ipse dixit: “Vere praeclarus explorator est.”

unit.source: It’s no surprise he managed to handle that Serial Killer…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod illum interfector seriem tractare potuit…

unit.source: Camus couldn’t gauge the Demon Warlock’s true strength, but the substantial bounty spoke volumes.
unit.target: Camus vim veram Daemoni Magi non potuit metiri, sed ingens praemium multa enarravit.

unit.source: The sum of 600,000 verl d’or was a testament to the Demon Warlock’s threat level.
unit.target: Summa 600,000 verl d’or testimonium erat de gradu periculi Daemoni Magi.

unit.source: Even if Louis Berry’s fame stemmed solely from his encounter with such a formidable adversary, he undeniably stood among the great adventurers.
unit.target: Etiamsi fama Louis Berry sola ex congressu cum tali adversario formidabili orta esset, ille indubitanter inter praeclaros exploratores stabat.

unit.source: It wasn’t lost on Camus that Bram, the perpetrator of numerous murders that had kept the patrol team occupied for nearly two weeks, only carried a bounty of 50,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Non ignorabat Camus quod Bram, perpetrator plurimorum caedum, qui turbam vigilantium paene per duas hebdomadas occupaverat, solum praemium 50,000 verl d’or portabat.

unit.source: Such figures tempted Camus to consider collaboration with Louis Berry.
unit.target: Talia numerorum quantitates Camum ad considerationem cooperationis cum Louis Berry adduxerunt.

unit.source: Reflecting on the substantial 600,000 bounty and comprehending Louis Berry’s generosity, Camus tucked away the telegram and graciously commended the female telegrapher with an exaggerated flying kiss.
unit.target: Reflectens de ingenti praemio 600,000 et intellegens largitatem Louis Berry, Camus telegramma recondidit et telegraphistam feminam osculo volitante exaggerato benigne laudatus est.

unit.source: Running his fingers through his tousled brown hair, Camus descended to the hall below.
unit.target: Digitos per capillos fuscos disordinatos currens, Camus in atrium deorsum descendit.

unit.source: The evening had descended, and it wasn’t his night for duty.
unit.target: Vesper iam descenderat, et non erat nox eius ad officia exercenda.

unit.source: He could head home and take a break.
unit.target: Domum ire poterat et requiescere.

unit.source: Out of the blue, Camus’s gaze focused as he spotted the handsome Louis Berry, sporting black hair, green eyes, and a laid-back demeanor, seated on the sofa, casually playing with a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Subito, Camus oculos intendit, cum deprehenderet formosum Louis Berry, qui capillos nigros, oculos virides, et animum relaxatum gerebat, in sofa sedens pileum stramineum aureum casualiter ludere.

unit.source: Approaching cautiously, Camus inquired, “Is there anything else?”
unit.target: Accedens cautus, Camus interrogavit: “Estne aliquid aliud?”

unit.source: Lumian ceased twirling the straw hat, sat up straight, and grinned.
unit.target: Lumian pileum stramineum gyrare desiit, consedens rectus, et subridens.

unit.source: “I’ve got something else to talk to you about.”
unit.target: “Aliud habeo de quo tecum loqui.”

unit.source: Realizing that one of the three shops that could buy Fermo coffee was on Cania Street, not far from the patrol team, Lumian’s immediate thought was:
unit.target: Animadvertens quod una ex tribus tabernis quae Fermo café emere poterant in via Cania, non longe a turma vigilantium sita esset, Lumian statim putavit:

unit.source: Could Hisoka be hiding within the patrol team, perhaps as one of its members?
unit.target: Num Hisoka intra turmam vigilantium se celare possit, fortasse ut membrum eius?

unit.source: Is the most dangerous place the safest?
unit.target: Num locus periculosissimus sit tutissimus?

unit.source: After careful consideration, Lumian considered it a possibility, though not particularly likely.
unit.target: Post longam considerationem, Lumian id possibilitatem existimavit, quamquam non prorsus verisimile.

unit.source: On the one hand, among the seven Beyonders who were killed, including the Death believer in Port Pylos, the Rose School of Thought’s peripheral member, and the spy left behind in Matani by the Intis Republic, were secretive individuals, blending in with ordinary people.
unit.target: Inter septem Beyonders occisos – inter quos fiebat Mortis Credulus in Portu Pylos, membrum marginalem Scholae Rosae Rerum, et speculator relictos in Matani a Republica Intis – erant homines arcani, qui cum plebe miscere videbantur.

unit.source: Without substantial information sources, it would be challenging for Hisoka to identify them as Beyonders and target them.
unit.target: Sine abundantiis fontibus notitiarum, difficile esset Hisoka eos ut Beyonders agnoscere et oppugnare.

unit.source: This suggested that either Hisoka had a unique ability to discern Beyonders from ordinary people or possessed a mystical item granting him such insight, or he had control over an extensive information network.
unit.target: Hoc insinuat aut quod Hisoka facultatem unicam habeat ad Beyonders a plebe distinguendos, aut id item mysticum possideat, aut retia notitiarum ampla regnere valeat.

unit.source: The patrol team, being intimately familiar with Matani and Port Pylos, might have already detected something amiss with the Death believer, the Rose School of Thought’s member, and the Intis spy and been conducting surveillance.
unit.target: Turma vigilantium, quae Matani et Portum Pylos intimate noverat, forsitan iam aliquid in Mortis Credulo, in membro Scholae Rosae, et in speculatore Intis deprehendit et inspexit.

unit.source: Hisoka’s membership in the patrol team would explain his ability to uncover a Beyonder’s hidden identity and carry out the murders.
unit.target: Sodalitas Hisoka in turma vigilantium eius facultatem ad Beyonder identitatem occultam detegendam et caedes exsequendas explanaret.

unit.source: On the other hand, if Hisoka, a Devil pathway Beyonder, had joined the patrol team, suspicions would undoubtedly arise once the serial murders occurred—unless he concealed his true pathway from the start.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, si Hisoka, Beyonder viae Diaboli, turmae vigilantium se adiuniisset, indubie suspicionis oriri vellent post caedes seriem, nisi ex initio veram viam suam celasset.

unit.source: However, the patrol team differed from the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
unit.target: Tamen, turma vigilantium a Societate Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum differebat.

unit.source: Hisoka would need to use his abilities frequently during daily missions, making it difficult to conceal them for months or years.
unit.target: Hisoka in missionibus cotidianis facultates suas saepe adhibere debebit, quod eas per menses vel annos celare difficiat.

unit.source: There was no room for mishaps.
unit.target: Non erat spatium casuum evenendi.

unit.source: It wasn’t feasible for him to meticulously prepare before each mission, adorning the corresponding mystical item solely to reveal his abilities in that specific situation, right?
unit.target: Eum non liceret singulas missiones diligenter praeparare, item mysticum pertinente tantum ad facultates suas in illa re revelandas induere, nonne?

unit.source: Even as a Devil, he couldn’t pull it off!
unit.target: Etiam ut Diabolus, id non potuit perficere!

unit.source: Given that many missions had no specific target, Devils couldn’t foresee imminent danger.
unit.target: Cum multae missiones nullum obiectum certum haberent, Diaboli imminentem periculum praedicere non poterant.

unit.source: Driven by suspicion and uncertainty, Lumian took a special trip to the patrol team, visiting Camus to unearth new clues or gain inspiration to either confirm or eliminate the corresponding possibilities.
unit.target: Suspicionibus et incertitudine impulsus, Lumian iter speciale ad turmam vigilantium fecit, Camum visitans ut novas vestigia detegeret aut ad confirmandas vel excludendas possibilitates pertinentes inspirationem haberet.

unit.source: “What do you want to discuss?” Camus furrowed his brow.
unit.target: “Quid vis disserere?” inquit Camus, frontem contraxit.

unit.source: Is this guy scheming to use the morning’s bribe as leverage to threaten me?
unit.target: Num hic vir machinatur ut pagi matutinae, quasi vectigal, ad me minandum utatur?

unit.source: The dossier isn’t particularly important.
unit.target: Dossier non est maxime grave.

unit.source: Even if I lose it, it’s just a minor punishment!
unit.target: Etiamsi id amitterem, id solum parva poena est!

unit.source: Wearing his golden straw hat, Lumian rose with a smile.
unit.target: Gerens pileum stramineum aureum, Lumian subridente surrexit.

unit.source: Pointing at the door, he suggested, “How about a cup of coffee?”
unit.target: Ianuam ostendens, dixit: “Quid de poculo café?”

unit.source: After a brief contemplation, Camus responded in a deep voice, “Fine.”
unit.target: Post breve consideratione, Camus voce profunda respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Exiting the patrol team’s entrance, Lumian made his way toward the Matani Import and Export Shop.
unit.target: Exiens e introitus turmae vigilantium, Lumian se contulit ad Tabernam Importationis et Exportationis Matani.

unit.source: In the fading dusk, he immediately spotted Port Pylos’s police headquarters diagonally opposite the patrol team.
unit.target: In crepusculo evanente, statim deprehendit praetoriam policiae Porti Pylos, diagonaliter oppositam turmae vigilantium.

unit.source: Numerous individuals clad in dark-blue police uniforms moved in and out, some holding cups of coffee.
unit.target: Multi homines, induti uniformibus policiorum caeruleis obscuris, inter iras et exire movebantur, et quidam pocula café tenebant.

unit.source: Wh— Lumian’s heart stirred.
unit.target: Heu— cor Lumiani concitatum est.

unit.source: Could Hisoka not be a member of the patrol team but a high-ranking police officer at the police headquarters?
unit.target: Num Hisoka non sit membrum turmae vigilantium, sed praefectus summus in praetoria policiae?

unit.source: At a certain rank, the police collaborated with official Beyonders to access a wealth of information.
unit.target: Ad certo gradu, vigiles cum Beyonders officialibus cooperabant ad abundantiam notitiarum adipisciendam.

unit.source: Many official Beyonders’ investigations were conducted through the police due to limited manpower.
unit.target: Multae investigationes Beyonders officialium per vigiles erant, propter limitatam copiam virorum.

unit.source: If Hisoka held a significant position at Port Pylos’s police headquarters, it was plausible for him to identify the three concealed Beyonders.
unit.target: Si Hisoka locum significativum in praetoria policiae Porti Pylos teneret, probabiliter ei esset ut tres Beyonders absconditos agnosceret.

unit.source: Additionally, there would be no risk of exposing his pathway during routine missions, and acquiring his favored Fermo coffee beans would be a breeze.
unit.target: Praeterea, non esset periculum viam suam in missionibus ordinariis patefieri, et optata eius granum café Fermo facile adeptum esset.

unit.source: On the other hand, it was precisely because the Matani Import and Export Shop offered a variety of coffee beans that Hisoka fell in love with the pure, bitter, and fragrant Fermo coffee without sugar.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, propter varietatem granorum café in Taberna Importationis et Exportationis Matani, Hisoka inclinavit ad café Fermo, quod est purus, amaris, et fragrans, sine saccharo.

unit.source: However, this was just one possibility among Lumian’s speculations.
unit.target: Tamen, hoc erat solum una ex variis possibilitatibus in speculationibus Lumiani.

unit.source: For instance, Hisoka, being a bold and self-assured individual, might have visited Cania Street specifically to buy Fermo coffee, relishing the incompetence and frustration of the patrol team.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, Hisoka, vir audax et confidus, fortasse viam Caniae visitavit ad café Fermo emendum, et in inhabilitate atque frustratione turmae vigilantium delectatus est.

unit.source: Alternatively, Hisoka might not be a Beyonder of the Devil pathway but simply possessed the corresponding Sealed Artifact and had mastered a unique ritual to appease Devils.
unit.target: Aliter, Hisoka non erat Beyonder viae Diaboli, sed tantum possidebat Artifactum Sigillatum et ritum unicum ad Diabolos sedandos didicerat.

unit.source: There was also the chance that Lumian was mistaken—Hisoka might not be linked to the serial murders four years ago.
unit.target: Et etiam possibilitas erat ut Lumian errasset—Hisoka fortasse ad caedem seriem quattuor annos abhinc non pertinere.

unit.source: With these thoughts in mind, Lumian contained his excitement and entered the Matani Import and Export Shop alongside Camus.
unit.target: His cogitationibus in mente, Lumian excitamentum suum continebat et, cum Camus, in Tabernam Importationis et Exportationis Matani intravit.

unit.source: They reached the section where various coffee beans were on display and secured a seat in the attached coffee shop.
unit.target: Pervenere ad partem ubi varii granorum café ostenta erant, et in caupona annexa locum sibi comparaverunt.

unit.source: “Highlander coffee with milk and two cubes of sugar,” Camus ordered from the waiter with a sense of familiarity.
unit.target: “Café Highlander cum lacte et duobus cubis sacchari,” inquit Camus cauponario, nota familiaritate.

unit.source: Lumian, on the other hand, opted for a cup of fragrant Intis coffee.
unit.target: Lumian, ex altera parte, poculum café Intis fragrantis optavit.

unit.source: While waiting, Lumian casually observed the coffee choices of other customers.
unit.target: Dum exspectabat, Lumian leviter observavit electiones café aliorum clientium.

unit.source: Turning to Camus, he inquired, “Judging by the name, are you a Feynapotterian?”
unit.target: Conversus ad Camus, rogavit: “Nomine iudicando, esne Feynapotterianus?”

unit.source: Camus hesitated briefly before truthfully responding, “My full name is Don Givré Camus Castiya.”
unit.target: Camus breve haesitavit deinde veraciter respondit: “Plenum nomen meum est Don Givré Camus Castiya.”

unit.source: He was willing to share his full name as the telegram mentioned Louis Berry having a good working relationship with the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Paratus erat totum nomen suum communicare, quoniam telegramma commemorabat Louis Berry bonam consociationem cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “So, you’re a noble lord.”
unit.target: “Ita, es nobilis dominus.”

unit.source: The name Castiya belonged to the royal family of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and “Don” at the beginning of Camus’s name signified “Honorable,” representing his noble status.
unit.target: Nomen Castiya ad regiam familiam regni Feynapotter pertinebat, et “Don” in initio nominis Camus significabat “Honorabilis”, quod statum eius nobilitatis demonstrabat.

unit.source: Camus smiled wryly and remarked, “If I were truly a nobleman, why would I join a local patrol team in the Southern Continent?
unit.target: Camus subridens dixit: “Si vere nobilis essem, cur ad turmam vigilantium localem in Continente Meridionali accederem?”

unit.source: “Our branch has long dwindled, but I can’t deny that this last name and the Don prefix have provided me with advantages beyond those of ordinary people.
unit.target: “Ramus noster diu labefactatus est, sed fateor hunc cognomen et titulum Don mihi beneficia praebuisse ultra ea, quae vulgo possidentur.”

unit.source: I received a potion upon reaching adulthood, achieving Sequence 9 Beyonder status.
unit.target: Potionem accepi cum aetatem adultam attingerem, adeptus status Sequence IX Beyonder factus.

unit.source: However, my subsequent advancements were the result of my own efforts.
unit.target: Attamen, subsequentia mea ex propriis operibus orta sunt.

unit.source: “Accepting my 50,000 verl d’or bribe is part of your efforts?” Lumian teased inwardly.
unit.target: “Accipere subventionem meam de 50,000 verl d’or pars est operis tui?” inquit Lumian intus iocose.

unit.source: He glanced at the two cups of coffee brought by the waiter, feigning casualness as he asked, “Don’t you want to try some other coffees? Is highlander coffee your only choice?”
unit.target: Aspectans duas pocula café adlata a cauponario, leviter simulans, quaesivit: “Non visne alias café experiri? Num solum café Highlander eligis?”

unit.source: Camus raised his cup and took a sip.
unit.target: Camus poculum attoluit et sorbet.

unit.source: “I’m accustomed to its taste.”
unit.target: “Eius sapori assuefactus sum.”

unit.source: Lumian removed his golden straw hat and took a sip, smiling as he replied, “Fair enough. Just like how I can never acclimate to Fermo coffee.
unit.target: Lumian pileum stramineum aureum abstulit et poculum sumpsit, subridens, dicens: “Satis aequum; sicut nequeo ad café Fermo assuefare.”

unit.source: It’s too bitter with regular sugar, and too cloying with too much.
unit.target: Est nimis amarum cum saccharo ordinario, atque nimis saturatum dulcedine cum nimia addito.

unit.source: Some people appreciate the bitterness and fragrance of Fermo coffee, opting for just a hint of sugar.
unit.target: Nonnulli homines amaritudinem et fragrantiam café Fermo aestimant, eligentes solum levem sacchari quantitatem.

unit.source: Lumian anticipated Camus to respond with, “Yes, some even drink Fermo coffee without sugar.” However, Camus’s reply didn’t align with his expectations.
unit.target: Lumian praedixit Camum respondere: “Ita, quidam etiam café Fermo sine saccharo bibunt.” Tamen responsum Camus expectationes eius non adimplebat.

unit.source: “That’s how it goes. What’s on your mind?”
unit.target: “Ita fit. Quid tibi in animo est?”

unit.source: Internally exhaling, Lumian spoke openly, “As you can tell, I’m deeply intrigued by the serial murder case from four years ago. It’s my sole purpose in Port Pylos—a highly valuable assignment.”
unit.target: Suspirans intus, Lumian aperte dixit: “Ut vides, casus caedum serium quattuor annos abhinc me valde intricat; hoc est propositum meum solum in Portu Pylos—munus summopretiosum.”

unit.source: “Highly valuable? It’s just a Serial Killer.” Camus let out a sigh of relief upon realizing Louis Berry was interested in discussing this matter.
unit.target: “Summopretiosum? Est solum Interfector Serius.” Camus leviter suspiravit, intellexitque Louis Berry hoc argumento interesse.

unit.source: Even if he were blind, he could tell Louis Berry’s genuine concern about the serial murders four years prior.
unit.target: Etiamsi caecus esset, intueri poterat veram curam Louis Berry de caedibus seriem quattuor annos abhinc.

unit.source: Lumian vaguely explained with a smile, “This case holds secrets beyond your wildest imagination.”
unit.target: Lumian vago modo explicavit, subridens: “Hic casus arcana tenet ultra fines tuae optimae imaginationis.”

unit.source: For example, transmigrators, or that Celestial Worthy…
unit.target: Exempli gratia, transmigratores, aut ille Caelestis Dignus…

unit.source: Camus took another sip of his highlander coffee and reflected.
unit.target: Camus iterum poculum café Highlander sumpsit et meditatus est.

unit.source: “I arrived in Matani over five years ago.
unit.target: “Ad Matani perveni ante quinque annos abhinc.

unit.source: At that time, the Intisians had just departed, and the kingdom and the Church’s forces had completed their initial infiltration.
unit.target: Illo tempore, Intisiani modo discesserant, et regnum atque copiae Ecclesiae initium incursionis perfecerant.

unit.source: I sensed numerous opportunities, thinking I could leverage my last name to secure a prominent position.
unit.target: Multas opportunitates sensi, cogitans me posse cognomen meum ad locum praeclarum obtinendum adhibere.

unit.source: Hence, I took a ship across the Fog Sea.
unit.target: Itaque navem cepi trans Mare Nebulae.

unit.source: The outcome differed from my expectations, but it was still acceptable.”
unit.target: Exitus ab exspectationibus meis dissimilis erat, sed tamen acceptabilis fuit.

unit.source: Camus, in his mid-twenties, sighed as he recounted the past.
unit.target: Camus, in mediis annis viginti, suspiravit dum praeterita enarraret.

unit.source: He continued, “When the case unfolded, I was merely a Sequence 8.
unit.target: Continuavit: “Cum casus evolutus est, ego solum eram Sequence VIII.”

unit.source: Alongside a few teammates, I followed Vice-Captain Reaza to investigate.”
unit.target: Cum paucis sodalibus, secutus sum Vice-Capitaneum Reaza ad inquisitionem faciendam.

unit.source: He paused, offering Lumian a smile that seemed to convey, “If you want more information, show more sincerity.”
unit.target: Pausavit, subridens, quasi admonens: “Si plura vis, sincera ostende.”

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian was contemplating another question.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian aliam quaestionem considerabat.

unit.source: If Hisoka truly belongs to the Devil pathway and has joined the patrol team, is there a way for him to conceal his identity?
unit.target: Si Hisoka vere pertinet ad viam Diaboli et in turmam vigilantium se adiunxerit, num modus sit ut identitatem suam celaret?

unit.source: Putting himself in those shoes, Lumian realized that concealing the abilities of the Hunter pathway wouldn’t pose a problem.
unit.target: Se in illas condiciones ponens, Lumian intellexit celare facultates viae Venatoris non creare difficultatem.

unit.source: Most situations could be handled with the Ascetic pathway’s abilities and a couple of items.
unit.target: Plurimae res tractari possent cum facultatibus viae Asceticae et per pauca instrumenta.

unit.source: Of course, the usage of an Ascetic’s abilities was suspicious.
unit.target: Certe, usus facultatum Asceticorum suspectus erat.

unit.source: Could it be that Hisoka is indeed a bestowed individual who typically exhibits powers from the boon pathway?
unit.target: Num fieri possit ut Hisoka vere sit individuum donatum, qui plerumque vires ex via beneficii ostendat?

unit.source: Lumian raised his cup and took a sip of coffee, avoiding delving into the details of the serial murders.
unit.target: Lumian poculum attoluit et sorbet, vitans in subtilitates caedum serium penetrare.

unit.source: He gazed at Camus thoughtfully and inquired, “Do you have members in the patrol team skilled in divination or decryption?”
unit.target: Camus cogitabunde aspexit et rogavit: “Habesne membra in turma vigilantium peritia in divinatione aut decryptione?”

unit.source: 643 Target Suspect
unit.target: 643 Meta Suspectus

unit.source: 643 Target Suspect
unit.target: 643 Meta Suspectus

unit.source: Camus couldn’t comprehend why Louis Berry had abruptly changed the topic and neglected to charge for the pertinent information.
unit.target: Camus non poterat intellegere cur Louis Berry subitam dissertionis mutationem fecisset atque pretium pro rebus pertinentibus exigere neglexerit.

unit.source: Recollecting, he mentioned, “Yes, there’s a Magician.
unit.target: Meminens, dixit: “Ita, Magus est.

unit.source: He was initially an officer of the Admiral Guard but later got transferred to the patrol team.”
unit.target: Primum fuit officarius custodiae admiralis, sed postea ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est.

unit.source: Later… Lumian frowned slightly.
unit.target: Postea… Lumian leviter vultum contraxit.

unit.source: “When did he transfer to the patrol team?”
unit.target: “Quando ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est?”

unit.source: “Why do you ask? Last year,” replied Camus.
unit.target: “Cur rogas? Anno praeterito,” respondit Camus.

unit.source: He had no clue about Louis Berry’s inquiry, making it unclear what information was vital.
unit.target: Nullam scientiam habebat de quaestione Louis Berry, unde incertum erat quae notitia esset necessaria.

unit.source: Last year… It doesn’t seem to be Hisoka, judging by appearances… Although possibilities can’t be completely ruled out.
unit.target: Anno praeterito… Ex aspectu videtur non esse Hisoka; quamquam omnes facultates omnino excludi non possunt.

unit.source: Serving as an officer in Admiral Querarill’s guard provides opportunities for gathering intel.
unit.target: Officium gerens sub custodia Admiralis Querarill opportunitates notitiarum colligendarum praebet.

unit.source: Perhaps he didn’t purchase Fermo coffee from this Import Export Shop.
unit.target: Fortasse non empsit Fermo coffee ex hac Taberna Importationis et Exportationis.

unit.source: It could be one of the other two cafes…
unit.target: Fieri potest ut sit unus ex reliquorum duorum caféinorum…

unit.source: Even so, there’s a logical reason for buying it here.
unit.target: At tamen, ratio logica invenitur qua hic emandum sit.

unit.source: Yes, to relish watching the incompetence and frustration of the patrol team…
unit.target: Ita, ut fruatur spectando ineptiam atque frustrationem manipuli vigilum…

unit.source: Lumian temporarily placed the Magician on his suspect list.
unit.target: Lumian magum temporarie in indice suspectorum consignavit.

unit.source: He didn’t dismiss the possibility that the other party was Hisoka just because they were a Sequence 7.
unit.target: Non neglexit possibilitatem alterius esse Hisoka, solum quia ille erat Series VII.

unit.source: This was because the level of a boon might not be the same as the level brought about by potions.
unit.target: Nam gradus doni non necessario idem esse potest ac gradus, quos potiones efficiunt.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian had vaguely perceived changes beneath Matani’s surface from the Magician’s departure from Admiral Querarill’s guard to joining the patrol team.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian leviter perceptit mutationes sub superficie Matani, ab exitu Magi e custodia Admiralis Querarill ad ingressum in manipulum vigilum.

unit.source: Beyonders of the Seer pathway either originated from the Church of The Fool or were associated with Intis’s Bureau 8 or secret organizations supporting Bureau 8, like the Secret Order.
unit.target: Beyonderes viae Videntis vel ex Ecclesia Stulti orti sunt, vel coniuncti erant cum Officina VIII Intis aut cum societatibus occultis quae Officinae VIII favent, ut Ordo Secretus.

unit.source: While there were wild Beyonders, very few evolved into Magicians.
unit.target: Dum beyonderes feroces exstiterunt, pauci tamen in magos evoluti sunt.

unit.source: Coupled with Matani’s history as an Intis colony, Lumian reasonably deduced that the Magician had close ties to the Intis Republic, a fact well-known to Admiral Querarill.
unit.target: Coniuncta cum historia Matani ut colonia Intis, Lumian rite concludit magum nexūs arctos habuisse cum Republica Intis, rem quae Admirali Querarill bene nota erat.

unit.source: He retained the Magician in the guards to maintain a specific connection with Intis and handle the new Feynapotter Kingdom.
unit.target: Magum in custodia retinuit ad nexum certum cum Intis conservandum atque regendum novum Regnum Feynapotter.

unit.source: By achieving a balance of power, he could better sustain his rule.
unit.target: Per certam potentiae aequalitatem, suam dominationem melius servare poterat.

unit.source: The Magician’s departure from the Admiral Guard last year might indicate that Admiral Querarill had truly gauged the Feynapotter Kingdom’s stance after years of collaboration and had sided with them.
unit.target: Exitus Magi e custodia Admiralis anno praeterito fortasse significat Admiralem Querarill statum Regni Feynapotter post annos cooperationis recte aestimavisse et cum eis consenserit.

unit.source: Lumian’s speculation didn’t eliminate the suspicion that the Magician might be Hisoka.
unit.target: Cogitatio Lumiani suspicionem non sublata est quod magus fortasse esset Hisoka.

unit.source: Loki, from Intis and a Secret Order member, held a mid-management position in Bureau 8.
unit.target: Loki, ex Intis et membrum Ordinis Secreti, positionem mediam in Officina VIII gerebat.

unit.source: It was entirely possible for him to use the proper channels to involve Hisoka in Bureau 8’s overseas section and recruit him into the Secret Order.
unit.target: Plane erat ei possibile uti canalibus idoneis, ut Hisoka in sectionem peregrinam Officinae VIII involveretur atque in Ordine Secreto susciperetur.

unit.source: After contemplating for a moment, Lumian inquired, “Does that Magician have a fondness for Fermo coffee?”
unit.target: Post paulum meditatus, Lumian quaesivit: “Magusne ille Fermo coffee delectat?”

unit.source: He didn’t directly ask about the other party’s name and characteristics.
unit.target: Non directe quaesivit de nomine ac attributis alterius partis.

unit.source: Camus shook his head.
unit.target: Camus caput quassavit.

unit.source: “He doesn’t appreciate coffee. His preference leans towards sweet drinks like Gwadar.”
unit.target: “Non amat coffeum. Praefert potiones dulces ut Gwadar.”

unit.source: Gwadar, a well-loved local beverage in West Balam, was crafted from locally grown berries and contained a certain amount of caffeine.
unit.target: Gwadar, potio localis in Occidente Balam bene amata, ex bacis localiter crescentibus confecta erat et aliquam quantitatem caffeinae continebat.

unit.source: It had the same impact as coffee in enhancing mental strength and combating fatigue.
unit.target: Eandem vim habebat ac coffeum, quod robur mentis augeret et lassitudinem expugnaret.

unit.source: However, its hue was orange-yellow, with a hint of sweetness amidst the sourness.
unit.target: Attamen, eius color erat aurantiaco-fulvus, cum levissima dulcedine inter aciditatem.

unit.source: It served both to alleviate the sweltering heat and quench thirst.
unit.target: Utrumque ad levandam caliditatem ferventem atque ad sitim sedandam serviebat.

unit.source: Prefers sweetness… Lumian felt a sense of disappointment.
unit.target: Dulcedinem praeferens… Lumian parum delusionis sensit.

unit.source: Four years ago, Hisoka had no inkling that he would confront a monster like Ludwig in the future.
unit.target: Quattuor annos abhinc, Hisoka nescius erat se monstrum sicut Ludwig futurum oppugnaturum.

unit.source: It was unlikely for him to deliberately splash some unsweetened Fermo coffee on the table with the chocolate.
unit.target: Parum verisimile fuit ei ut deliberate Fermo coffee, sine dulcedine, super mensam cum chocolata aspergeret.

unit.source: Lumian cautiously believed now that Hisoka truly enjoyed bitter coffee.
unit.target: Lumian nunc caute credidit quod Hisoka vere amaro coffeum delectaretur.

unit.source: In that case, the Magician, with a sweet tooth, probably wasn’t Hisoka.
unit.target: In hoc casu, magus, qui dulcedinem praeferret, verisimiliter non erat Hisoka.

unit.source: Unless Hisoka meticulously maintained the traits of each identity, consistently playing the role of a Magician who relished drinking Gwadar on a daily basis.
unit.target: Nisi Hisoka diligenter singula identitatis signa serviret atque constanter partes Magi ageret, qui cotidie Gwadar bibere delectaretur.

unit.source: He wasn’t an Actor who needed to meticulously perform every aspect of his daily life!
unit.target: Non erat actor, qui cuncta vitae suae puncta diligenter perficeret!

unit.source: Moreover, he had no reason to digest Faceless!
unit.target: Praeterea, nullam habebat rationem ut “Faceless” digereretur!

unit.source: As he contemplated, Lumian’s heart skipped a beat.
unit.target: Dum meditabat, cor Lumiani paulum saltavit.

unit.source: Actor…
unit.target: Actor…

unit.source: If Hisoka is genuinely a Beyonder of the Devil pathway, apart from his belief in the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings due to transmigration, he might also be influenced by the Mother Tree of Desire in his daily life.
unit.target: Si Hisoka vere fuerit Beyonder viae Diaboli, praeter fidem suam in Divinam Dignitatem Caeli et Terrae ad Benedictiones ex transmigratione, fortasse etiam a Mater Arbore Desiderii in vita sua quotidiana influeretur.

unit.source: Could it be that the boon of the Hisoka pathway doesn’t come from one of the Celestial Worthy’s Seer, Apprentice, or Marauder, but rather from the Mother Tree of Desire?
unit.target: Num potest fieri ut donum viae Hisoka non ex uno ex Videntibus, discipulis aut marauderis Divini Digni proveniat, sed potius ex Mater Arbore Desiderii?

unit.source: The current Celestial Worthy desires the invasion of evil gods into the world within the barrier.
unit.target: Divinus Dignus Caelestis praesentis desiderat invasionem deorum malorum in orbem intra limites.

unit.source: It’s not implausible for Him to collaborate with the Mother Tree of Desire and tacitly permit Hisoka to exploit the Mother Tree of Desire…
unit.target: Non est incredibile ei cum Mater Arbore Desiderii cooperari et tacite Hisokae licentiam dare ut eam expleat…

unit.source: With a fresh train of thought, Lumian observed the now-silent Camus and took a sip of Intis coffee, offering a smile as he changed the subject.
unit.target: Nova cogitatione renovata, Lumian, Camum iam silentem observans, sorbillum coffeum Intis sumpsit et subridente rem mutavit.

unit.source: “Any Beyonders from the Prisoner pathway in the patrol team?”
unit.target: “Numquid sunt beyonderes ex via Prisoneris in manipulo vigilum?”

unit.source: He had long suspected that the Mother Tree of Desire was an evil deity at the pinnacle of the Criminal, Prisoner, and Scrooge pathways.
unit.target: Iam diu suspicabatur Mater Arbor Desiderii deum malum esse in culmine viae Criminalis, Prisoneris, et Scrooge.

unit.source: The corresponding boons likely originated from one of them or were intertwined.
unit.target: Beneficia attinentia probabiliter ex uno ex illis orta erant aut inter se intertexta erant.

unit.source: Lumian refrained from asking about the existence of the Scrooge pathway because it was even more suspicious than the Criminal pathway, also known as the Devil pathway.
unit.target: Lumian ab interrogatione de existentia viae Scrooge abstinuit, quia illa magis suspecta videbatur quam via Criminalis, quae etiam via Diaboli notissima est.

unit.source: It didn’t belong to the twenty-two paths of the divine.
unit.target: Non pertinebat ad viginti duos semitas divinas.

unit.source: It was akin to a thief being apprehended by the police and asking in confusion, “I clearly disguised myself and left no traces. How did you quickly lock onto me,” only to receive the answer, “This isn’t Trier. No ordinary person would disguise themselves as a turkey and hide in a secluded alley.”
unit.target: Hoc erat simile latro comprehenso a vigilibus, qui in confusione quaerebat: “Manifestum est me convertisse et nullas vestigia reliquisse; quomodo me celeriter deprehendistis?” ad quam responsum venit: “Hoc non est Trier; nullus homo vulgaris se in forma meleagridis fingit atque in obscuro angulo absconditur.”

unit.source: “Do you think there’s a spy from the Rose School of Thought in the patrol team?”
unit.target: “Putasne speculatorem ex Schola Rosi Sententiarum in manipulo vigilum esse?”

unit.source: Camus believed Louis Berry was casually raising the issue of the Rose School of Thought’s interest in Port Pylos.
unit.target: Camus credidit Ludovicum Berry casualiter quaestionem de studio Scholae Rosi in Port Pylos proponere.

unit.source: “No, definitely not. He adheres to temperance and doesn’t indulge at all.”
unit.target: “Non, certe non. Moderationi se adhaeret atque omnino non indulgeat.”

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: “In other words, there really is a Beyonder from the Prisoner pathway?”
unit.target: “Aliter dicendo, num vere sit Beyonder ex via Prisoneris?”

unit.source: “Yes, a Sequence 6 Zombie…” Camus confirmed.
unit.target: “Ita, Sequencia VI Zombie…” confirmavit Camus.

unit.source: Lumian interjected suddenly, “Don’t disclose who he is, what he looks like, or his characteristics. Answer a few questions first.”
unit.target: Lumian subito interpellans dixit: “Noli revelare quis sit, qualis videatur, aut eius attributa; primo pauca quaesita responde.”

unit.source: “What questions?” Camus, feeling a bit disoriented from the rapidly changing topics, planned to decide when to ask for benefits later.
unit.target: “Quae quaestiones?” inquit Camus, paulo perturbatus a celeriter mutantibus argumentis, et statuere cogitabat quando de beneficiis quaerendum esset.

unit.source: Lumian held a porcelain cup filled with Intis coffee and casually said, “When did he join the patrol team?”
unit.target: Lumian poculum ex porcelaneo plenum coffeum Intis tenens, leve dixit: “Quando ad manipulum vigilum transmissus est?”

unit.source: “Half a year after me,” Camus recalled.
unit.target: “Dimidio anno post me,” respondit Camus.

unit.source: You arrived in Matani over five years ago and joined the patrol team shortly after.
unit.target: Matani quinque annos abhinc advenisti et mox ad manipulum vigilum accessisti.

unit.source: Half a year later means that the Prisoner was already on the patrol team when the serial murder case occurred four years ago…
unit.target: Dimidio anno post me significat Prisoner iam in manipulo vigilum esse, cum casus serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc evenisset…

unit.source: Lumian’s spirits lifted as he pondered for a moment.
unit.target: Animus Lumiani levatus est, dum paulum meditabat.

unit.source: “Did he face a catastrophe in the past and nearly died?”
unit.target: “Obiitne in praeterito calamitate et paene mortuus est?”

unit.source: “No.” Camus shook his head. “At least, I don’t know.”
unit.target: “Non.” inquit Camus, caput quassans, “saltem nescio.”

unit.source: Lumian maintained his smile, showing no signs of disappointment, and said, “Does he have a liking for Fermo coffee?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens permanebat, nullis signis delusionis ostentans, et dixit: “Habetne affectionem pro Fermo coffee?”

unit.source: “Yes, he adores Fermo coffee and is the type who doesn’t add sugar,” replied Camus without much thought.
unit.target: “Ita, Fermo coffee colit et talis est qui saccharum non adicit,” respondit Camus sine multo cogitandi.

unit.source: Then, he remembered Louis Berry’s inquiry about the Magician’s preference for Fermo coffee in the patrol team.
unit.target: Tum memor fuit interrogationis Ludovici Berry de praeferentia Magi ad Fermo coffee in manipulo vigilum.

unit.source: He quickly formed a guess.
unit.target: Celeriter coniecturam fecit.

unit.source: “Is there an issue with the ones enjoying Fermo coffee? Does the culprit of the serial murders four years ago have a taste for Fermo coffee? There are very few places in Port Pylos where you can get Fermo coffee. This is one of them. Even cafes selling Fermo coffee procure the beans from here… Are you suspecting that the murderer from four years ago is part of the patrol team?”
unit.target: “Estne quaestio de illis qui Fermo coffee fruuntur? Gustatne scelestus caedes serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc Fermo coffee? Pauca sunt loca in Port Pylos, ubi Fermo coffee adipisci potest. Hoc est unum ex iis. Etiam cauponae quae Fermo coffee vendunt, ex hac regione granum colligunt… Num suspicis homicidem ex quattuor annos abhinc pars esse manipuli vigilum?”

unit.source: Impressive. You reacted swiftly and identified the core issue… Lumian inwardly praised Camus.
unit.target: Impressivum. Celeriter egisti et rem principalem agnovisti… Lumian Camum intus laudavit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a surge of joy filled his heart.
unit.target: Simul, exsultatio gaudii cor eius replevit.

unit.source: In Matani, Fermo coffee was a rare commodity, and those who preferred it without sugar were even rarer.
unit.target: In Matani, Fermo coffee rara merces erat, et qui id sine saccharo praeferebant, etiam rari erant.

unit.source: Moreover, this individual was on the patrol team and seemingly from the Prisoner pathway!
unit.target: Praeterea, hic individuum in manipulo vigilum aderat et videbatur ex via Prisoneris provenire!

unit.source: With so many conditions aligning, Lumian felt like he had caught Hisoka by the tail!
unit.target: Cum tot res congruabant, Lumian sensit se Hisoka cauda cepisse!

unit.source: To avoid triggering any sense of malice and danger, Lumian refrained from asking about the patrol team member’s name, appearance, identity, or characteristics.
unit.target: Ne ullam malitiae atque periculi impressionem excitaret, Lumian abstinuit de nomine, specie, identitate aut attributis membrorum manipuli vigilum rogare.

unit.source: Feigning ignorance about the enemy, Lumian casually asked, “Is he from around here?”
unit.target: Fingens ignorance hostis, Lumian leviter rogavit: “Estne hic ex hac regione?”

unit.source: Observing Camus’s silence, Lumian added with a smile, “I won’t claim the official bounty.”
unit.target: Observante silentio Camus, Lumian subridente addidit: “Praemium officiale non postulo.”

unit.source: Camus’s expression eased.
unit.target: Vultus Camus relaxatus est.

unit.source: “He’s a local of Port Pylos, born in Tizamo Town, which is part of Port Pylos.”
unit.target: “Ille est indigenus Portus Pylos, natus in oppido Tizamo, quod pars Portus Pylos est.”

unit.source: Though the patrol team wasn’t as stringent in member recruitment as the various Churches and governments, they still gathered basic information and conducted verifications.
unit.target: Quamquam manipulus vigilum non tam rigorose membrorum delectu utebatur quam varia Ecclesiae et regimina, tamen notitiae fundamentales colligebantur et probationes fiebant.

unit.source: Otherwise, Admiral Querarill might have to worry about being assassinated by a patrol team member investigating a Beyonder case one day.
unit.target: Alioquin, Admiralis Querarill fortasse sollicitus futurus erat ne a membro manipuli vigilum, qui causam Beyonder indagaret, occideretur.

unit.source: Tizamo Town… the location of one of Hisoka’s pranks… It fits!
unit.target: Oppidum Tizamo… locus unius Hisokae iocusum… convenit!

unit.source: Lumian controlled his excitement, preventing the corners of his mouth from curling up.
unit.target: Lumian suam ardorem moderatus est, ne anguli oris eius incurvarent.

unit.source: Regrettably, he told Camus,
unit.target: Infeliciter, ille Camum dixit:

unit.source: “Unfortunately, that doesn’t seem to be the target.”
unit.target: “Infeliciter, hoc meta non videtur.”

unit.source: This was to prevent Camus from investigating the target.
unit.target: Hoc factum est ne Camus metae indagationem faceret.

unit.source: This could potentially alert the other party to the corresponding malice!
unit.target: Hoc potuit alteram partem de malitia congruente excitare!

unit.source: “All right.” Camus shrugged.
unit.target: “Bene,” inquit Camus, umeros elevans.

unit.source: Curious, he inquired, “How did you find out that the murderer from the serial killings four years ago liked Fermo coffee?”
unit.target: Curiosus, inquisivit: “Quomodo cognovisti homicydem caedes serialis quattuor annos abhinc Fermo coffee diligere?”

unit.source: “I was already aware of such a person before starting the investigation,” Lumian replied with a meaningful tone.
unit.target: “Iam sciebam talis hominem antequam indagationem iniret,” respondit Lumian tono significativo.

unit.source: He chose not to disclose that the information came from the thin aluminum foil wrapping of the chocolate.
unit.target: Eligebat non declarare hanc informationem ex tenue lamina aluminii, quo chocolatum involutum erat, provenisse.

unit.source: Revealing this might prompt Camus to believe he could uncover more clues and reignite the investigation, potentially drawing Hisoka’s attention.
unit.target: Hoc revelatum Camum compellare posset ut credat se plura indicia deprehendere atque indagationem iterum suscitare, fortasse Hisokae attentionem attrahendo.

unit.source: With this realization, Lumian understood something.
unit.target: Hoc intellexit, Lumian aliquid comprehenderat.

unit.source: I should now be a target for Hisoka, but fishing has its benefits…
unit.target: Nunc mihi esse debet meta Hisokae, sed piscatio utilitates habet…

unit.source: Louis Berry, adorned with a golden straw hat, had bribed members of the patrol team to examine the files of the serial murder case from four years ago.
unit.target: Louis Berry, galea stragulam aurea ornatus, membra manipuli vigilum corruptit ut fasciculos casus serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc inspiciendum curaret.

unit.source: Other team members paid little attention, but if the Prisoner was indeed Hisoka, he would have detected Lumian—his adversary’s investigation into the four-year-old serial murder case.
unit.target: Ceteri membri parum attendebant, sed si Prisoner vere Hisoka fuisset, eum – investigationem adversarii sui de casu serialis homicidii quattuor annos abhinc – detegisset.

unit.source: Hisoka refrained from taking action likely because Lumian openly presented himself as Louis Berry, making no effort to hide his identity.
unit.target: Hisoka actu agere abnegavit, verisimiliter quod Lumian se manifeste ut Louis Berry exhibuerat nec ullam operam ad identitatem celandam intulisset.

unit.source: This led to the suspicion that Lumian was fishing, making Hisoka cautious of stepping into a potential trap.
unit.target: Hoc ad suspicionem duxit Lumian piscationem agere, faciens ut Hisoka cautus ficeretur ne in insidiam incidat.

unit.source: There was no sense of malice or danger perceived, as Lumian didn’t possess details about the suspect’s identity.
unit.target: Nullum sensum malitiae aut periculi perceptum fuit, quia Lumian de identitate suspecti notitiam non habebat.

unit.source: Lumian was merely preparing for a potential surprise attack from a Devil or Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Lumian tantum se parabat ad incertam repentinam incursionem ab Diabolo aut Desiderii Apostolo.

unit.source: Before, I fished to catch fish, but now my fishing is a bluff…
unit.target: Prius piscabar ad pisces capiendos, sed nunc piscatio mea simulatio est…

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts clarified as he looked at Camus and said, “Keep an eye out for anyone at the police headquarters who enjoys Fermo coffee.”
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani clarificatae sunt, dum Camum observabat, et dixit: “Cave, et observa, si quis in praesidio vigilum Fermo coffee amans adest.”
