unit.source: “All right,” Camus agreed, thinking that Louis Berry had identified the suspect as a member of the patrol team and the police through details he wasn’t aware of.
unit.target: “Bene,” respondit Camus, cogitans Ludovicum Berry suspicatum esse ut membrum manipuli vigilum et policiæ ex notitia, quam ipse ignorerat, agnosceret.

unit.source: For now, the possibility of the patrol team members was tentatively ruled out.
unit.target: Pro tempore, possibilitas membrorum manipuli vigilum caute excludebatur.

unit.source: After finishing the remaining Intis coffee and settling the bill with the corresponding verl d’or, Lumian donned the golden straw hat and maintained his smile.
unit.target: Postquam reliquum coffeum Intis consumpsit et solutionem cum correspondente verl d’or liquvit, Lumian galeam stragulam auream indutus, subridente permanebat.

unit.source: He left the Matani Import and Export Shop and Cania Street, step by step.
unit.target: Matani Importationis et Exportationis Tabernam atque viam Cania, gradatim, reliquit.

unit.source: Passing by Port Pylos’s police headquarters, he deliberately cast a few glances.
unit.target: Transiens praesidium policiæ Portus Pylos, deliberate nonnullas speculatus est.

unit.source: 644 Patrol Team
unit.target: 644 Manipulus Custodum

unit.source: Camus stood at the entrance of the Matani Import and Export Shop, casually smoking a cigarette as he observed the passing customers.
unit.target: Camus ad ostium Tabernae Importationis et Exportationis Matani stetit, cigarette leniter fumans, dum clientes transeuntes observabat.

unit.source: Despite his watchful eyes, he didn’t spot anyone purchasing Fermo coffee.
unit.target: Attente oculis suis, neminem Fermo coffee emere animadvertit.

unit.source: As the gas street lamps gradually illuminated the surroundings, casting a dark blue hue across the sky, Camus extinguished his cigarette and tossed it into a nearby trash can.
unit.target: Cum lucernae viariae a gas paulatim circumiecta illustrabant, caelum colore nigro caeruleo tinctum exhibentes, Camus cigarette exstinxit et in urna purgamentorum proxima coniecit.

unit.source: He then made his way back to the beige four‐story building that housed the patrol team.
unit.target: Deinde rediit ad aedificium quattuor tabulorum, colore “beige” notatum, quod manipulum custodum continebat.

unit.source: Originally planning to indulge in an Intis feast in a neighborhood frequented by foreigners to celebrate his unexpected windfall of 40,000 verl d’or, his plans were disrupted by Louis Berry.
unit.target: Primum consilium habebat ut se in convivio Intis, in vicinitate a peregrinis frequentata, frueretur ad celebrandam inopinatam fortunam cum 40,000 verl d’or adeptam; sed consilia eius a Ludovico Berry turbata sunt.

unit.source: By the time he returned, it was already late, and he couldn’t be bothered to wait for a top chef to prepare something special.
unit.target: Cum rediret, iam sero erat, et noluit exspectare ut coquus optimus aliquid speciale praepararet.

unit.source: Instead, he decided to return to the patrol team, pool money with his close teammates, and order takeout from a nearby restaurant.
unit.target: Pro ea re, decrevit ad manipulum custodum redire, pecunias cum sodalibus intimis congregare, et ex popina proxima cibum ad portandum imperare.

unit.source: After satisfying his hunger, he intended to relax at a bar or dance hall.
unit.target: Postquam famem suam satiavit, intendebat in caupona aut in aula saltationis se relaxare.

unit.source: While crossing the hall, Camus spotted a teammate with dark brown skin, thick lips, and a height exceeding 1.8 meters.
unit.target: Dum per aulam transibat, Camus sodalem animadvertit, cuius cutis fusca et brunea erat, labia crassa, et altitudo plus quam 1.8 metra ferebat.

unit.source: Curious, he inquired, “Why did the guy in the straw hat come looking for you again?
unit.target: Curiosus, interrogavit: “Cur ille vir pileo stramineo ornato te rursus quaerevenit?”

unit.source: “Heh, I heard you and the others caught a Serial Killer and got a bounty of 50,000 verl d’or?”
unit.target: “Heh, audivi te et ceteros interfectorem seriem cepisse et praemium 50,000 verl d’or adeptos esse?”

unit.source: In Matani, the currency was commonly denoted in verl d’or and Delexi copper coins, a system ingrained during Intis colonization.
unit.target: In Matani, moneta vulgo exprimebatur in verl d’or et nummis aereis Delexi, ratio quae per colonizationem Intis insita fuit.

unit.source: Despite Admiral Querarill’s control, there were no significant changes in this aspect.
unit.target: Non obstante potestate Admiralium Querarill, in hoc non erant mutationes notabiles.

unit.source: The only difference was a partnership with the Feynapotter Kingdom’s bank that facilitated the free exchange of verl d’or and gold risot.
unit.target: Unica differentia erat societas cum argentaria Regni Feynapotter, quae commutationem liberam verl d’or et aurum risot facilitavit.

unit.source: If he were one of the two teammates–either the Magician or the Zombie–whom Louis Berry had asked about, Camus would undoubtedly be on high alert.
unit.target: Si ex duobus sodalibus esset—aut Magus aut Zombie—de quibus Ludovicus Berry quaeserat, Camus indubitanter sollicitus foret.

unit.source: However, the person standing in front of him was Sow, a Sequence 8 Pugilist of the Warrior pathway.
unit.target: At vero, persona coram eo stans erat Sow, Pugilista Sequentiae 8 ex via Bellatoris.

unit.source: Sow had joined the patrol team as an adventurer just last year and was known for having a pleasant personality.
unit.target: Sow anno praeterito modo ad manipulum custodum ut adventor se adiunxit, et ob gratiam indolem nota erat.

unit.source: Besides a bit of laziness and a love for enjoyment, there were no significant issues.
unit.target: Praeter modicam ignaviam et amorem voluptatis, nullae difficultates notabiles erant.

unit.source: Camus laughed and said, “That’s my informant. Without him, I wouldn’t have received that much bounty.”
unit.target: Camus risit et dixit: “Hic est meus informator. Absque eo tantum praemium non adeptus essem.”

unit.source: Sow, with his single eyelids, had a realization.
unit.target: Sow, cum unico palpebro suo, aliquod animadvertit.

unit.source: “Did he come to you just now to get his share?”
unit.target: “Num modo ad te venit ut suam portionem acciperet?”

unit.source: Camus thought for a moment and replied, “That’s one reason.
unit.target: Camus paulisper cogitavit et respondit: “Hoc est unum ex motivis.

unit.source: The other reason is that he’s still investigating the serial murders from four years ago and wanted to ask me for some details.”
unit.target: Alterum autem est quod interficationes serias quadriennis abhinc adhuc indagat et mihi quaedam singula rogare voluit.”

unit.source: He had kept the case dossier hidden from the captain and vice-captains of the patrol team, but he couldn’t keep it from his teammates.
unit.target: Tabellam casus ab duce et subducibus manipuli custodum occultatam servaverat, sed ab sodalibus suis eam celare non potuit.

unit.source: Therefore, he had no intention of concealing Louis Berry’s investigation into the serial murders from four years ago.
unit.target: Ergo nullam intendebat investigationem Ludovici Berry de interficationibus seriis quadriennis abhinc celare.

unit.source: Moreover, he planned to monitor the police headquarters to identify anyone who enjoyed Fermo coffee and seemed suspicious.
unit.target: Praeterea, consilium erat praesidium vigilum observare ut quis Fermo coffee delectaretur et suspectus appareret.

unit.source: He would need his teammates’ assistance to some extent.
unit.target: Auxilium sodalium suorum ad aliquem gradum opus esset.

unit.source: “Any progress? Any chance of claiming the bounty?”
unit.target: “Quae progressio? Ulla occasio praemium accipiendi?”

unit.source: Sow, dressed in a pleated shirt and carrying a broadsword, displayed visible interest.
unit.target: Sow, indutus camisā plicatā et gladium latum ferens, conspicuum studium ostendit.

unit.source: Camus wasn’t ready to provide detailed information at the moment.
unit.target: Camus non paratus erat nunc informationes accuratas praebere.

unit.source: He vaguely responded, “He suspects that the murderer might be hiding at the police headquarters from four years ago.
unit.target: Vage respondit: “Suspicitur homicida fortasse in praesidio vigilum quadriennis abhinc latere.

unit.source: I plan to investigate discreetly.”
unit.target: Cautiter investigare intendo.”

unit.source: “Why do you think the murderer is a police officer?”
unit.target: “Cur putas homicidam esse vigilis virum?”

unit.source: Sow looked puzzled.
unit.target: Sow, perplexus, videbatur.

unit.source: Camus hadn’t discussed this with Lumian earlier, so he pondered for a moment and explained, “Consider this.
unit.target: Camus hoc antea cum Lumiano non tractaverat, itaque paulisper meditatus est et explicavit: “Considera hoc.

unit.source: In the case four years ago, only Beyonders were targeted.
unit.target: In casu quadriennio abhinc, solum Beyonders destinabantur.

unit.source: Several of them usually concealed their identities.
unit.target: Plurimi eorum identitates suas plerumque celabant.

unit.source: How could the murderer accurately locate them and know that they were Beyonders?
unit.target: Quomodo homicida eos precise localizare et scire posset eos Beyonders esse?

unit.source: Only us or those from the police headquarters at a certain rank can access that kind of information.
unit.target: Solum nos aut illos ex praesidio vigilum in certo gradu talem informationem accedere possunt.

unit.source: It’s easier to verify if there are Beyonders of the Devil pathway on the patrol team.
unit.target: Facilius est comprobari, si Beyonders viae Diaboli in manipulo custodum adsint.

unit.source: Four years ago, during their investigation, Vice-Captain Reaza had proposed this idea.
unit.target: Quadriennio abhinc, inter investigationem, Vice-Dux Reaza hanc ideam proposuerat.

unit.source: However, he only suspected that the Serial Killer was hiding within the patrol team and hadn’t considered the police headquarters or the Admiral Guard.
unit.target: Attamen, solum suspicabatur interfectorem seriem intra manipulum custodum latere et praesidium vigilum aut Custodiam Admiralii non consideraverat.

unit.source: Subsequently, the patrol team conducted an investigation and found no suspicious individuals, leading them to shift their focus.
unit.target: Postea, manipulus custodum perquisitionem perduxit et nullos individuos suspectos invenit, ita ut attentionem transferre coeperent.

unit.source: “I see a glimmer of hope and smell the fragrance of verl d’or,” Sow said with anticipation.
unit.target: “Speciem spei intueor et odorem verl d’or sentio,” inquit Sow cum exspectatione.

unit.source: “If you need help, feel free to look for me. I heard that Kolobo and the others just followed you to the scene and each got 5,000 verl d’or!”
unit.target: “Si auxilio opus est, libere me quaere. Audivi Kolobo atque alios te modo ad locum secuti esse et singuli 5,000 verl d’or adeptos esse!”

unit.source: “No problem,” Camus readily agreed.
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio,” Camus statim consentivit.

unit.source: Then, he walked past Sow and along the corridor toward his office.
unit.target: Tum, transiit praeter Sow et per corridor ad officium suum processit.

unit.source: At the door of his office, Kolobo poked his head out, observing the conversation between Camus and Sow.
unit.target: Ad ostium officii sui, Kolobo caput protraxit, colloquium inter Camus et Sow observans.

unit.source: Kolobo, about the same age as Camus, in his mid-twenties, had dark hair, azure eyes, and a slender figure.
unit.target: Kolobo, circiter eandem aetatem ac Camus habens, in mediis annis viginti natus, comam atram, oculos caeruleos, et corpus tenue habebat.

unit.source: He held a pair of black sunglasses in his hand.
unit.target: Par oculorum solariorum nigrorum in manu tenebat.

unit.source: He lowered his voice and said to Camus, “Stay away from Sow for the time being.”
unit.target: Vox suam demisit et Camus dixit: “A Sow ad tempus abstine.”

unit.source: “Why?” Camus asked, surprised.
unit.target: “Cur?” interrogavit Camus, miratus.

unit.source: Observing Sow vanish through the door leading to the hall, Kolobo averted his gaze and explained,
unit.target: Videns Sow per ostium ad aulam evanescere, Kolobo oculos avertit et explicavit:

unit.source: “I have a feeling that something bad will happen if one interacts with him during this period.”
unit.target: “Sentio aliquid mali futurum esse, si quis cum illo interagere conetur.”

unit.source: “Then why didn’t you warn him?” Camus frowned in confusion.
unit.target: “Quare ergo non eum monuisti?” Camus, frontem contrahens, interrogavit.

unit.source: As a Sequence 8 Robot of the Monster pathway, Kolobo possessed formidable spiritual perception and could vaguely sense certain things.
unit.target: Ut Robotus Sequentiae 8 ex via Monstrorum, Kolobo perceptionem spiritualem formidabilem habebat et quaedam vage sentire patebat.

unit.source: “I warned him. He thinks everything’s fine. I even reported it to the Captain.” Kolobo shrugged.
unit.target: “Eum monui. Existimat omnia esse in ordine. Etiam id Capitano renuntiavi,” dixit Kolobo, umeros levans.

unit.source: As he spoke, the thin Beyonder recalled something.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, tenuis Beyonder rem aliquam meminit.

unit.source: “That adventurer, Louis Berry, is also dangerous.
unit.target: “Ille adventor, Ludovicus Berry, quoque periculosus est.

unit.source: When I arrived at the scene this morning, I didn’t dare to look directly at him.
unit.target: Cum hac mane ad locum perveni, non ausus sum directe in eum spectare.

unit.source: Occasionally, I would glance at him and see large amounts of blood, flames, and death.
unit.target: Interdum eum intuebar, et ingentes copias sanguinis, flammarum, et mortis observabam.

unit.source: “I didn’t want to tell you at first.
unit.target: “Primum nollebam tibi dicere.

unit.source: I felt that if I said it, fate would suffocate me.
unit.target: Sentiebam quod, si id dicerem, fata me suffocerent.

unit.source: Phew, it actually seems okay to say it now.
unit.target: Pheu, nunc re vera videtur id dicere licere.

unit.source: It seems I’m too sensitive.”
unit.target: Videtur me nimis sensibile esse.”

unit.source: That dangerous? As expected of a great adventurer who received a bounty of 600,000 verl d’or at once…
unit.target: Ille periculosus? Ut exspectabatur ab magno adventore, qui simul praemium 600,000 verl d’or accepit…

unit.source: While Camus, who knew about Louis Berry’s deeds, wasn’t overly shocked, this was the first time he had heard a Monster like Kolobo describe someone in such a way.
unit.target: Quamquam Camus, qui de factis Ludovici Berry sciebat, non nimis stupuit, hoc primum erat quod audivit monstrum ut Kolobo aliquem ita describere.

unit.source: Camus patted Kolobo’s shoulder.
unit.target: Camus humerum Kolobo pulsavit.

unit.source: “Thank you. I’ll be careful.”
unit.target: “Gratias. Cavebo.”

unit.source: With that settled, he asked curiously, “Was Louis Berry the first person to give you such a feeling?”
unit.target: Ita constitutum, curiosus rogavit: “Fuitne Ludovicus Berry primus qui tibi talem sensum dedit?”

unit.source: “No, there’s another one.”
unit.target: “Minime, alius est.”

unit.source: Kolobo shook his head.
unit.target: Kolobo caput movit.

unit.source: “Who is it?” Camus was surprised.
unit.target: “Quis est?” Camus miratus est.

unit.source: Kolobo’s expression suddenly turned serious.
unit.target: Vultus Kolobo subito serio factus est.

unit.source: “I can’t say. I’ll die if I say it. I’ll die!”
unit.target: “Non possum dicere. Moriar, si dixerim. Moriar!”

unit.source: With that, the thin Beyonder swiftly left Camus’s office.
unit.target: Itaque, tenuis Beyonder celeriter officium Camus reliquit.

unit.source: Upon returning to Hotel Orella, Lumian headed straight for the master bedroom.
unit.target: Rediens ad Hotel Orella, Lumian directe ad cubiculum principale se contulit.

unit.source: In the subterranean suite, even during the scorching season, a refreshing coolness lingered in the air.
unit.target: In suite subterranea, etiam tempore aestate ardenti, refrigerans frigiditas in aere manebat.

unit.source: On the desk in the master bedroom, a neatly folded letter awaited Lumian.
unit.target: In mensa cubiculi principalis, epistula diligenter plicata Lumiano exspectabat.

unit.source: Madam Magician’s response… Lumian picked up the letter and began reading.
unit.target: Responsum Dominae Magicae… Lumian epistulam sustulit et legere coepit.

unit.source: “Excellent. You have a good understanding of yourself.
unit.target: “Optime. Bene te intellegis.

unit.source: “The Rose School of Thought and the Numinous Episcopate will be managed by dedicated personnel.
unit.target: “Schola Rosi consilii et Episcopatus Numinous a personalibus dedicatis administrabuntur.

unit.source: No need for you to take unnecessary risks.
unit.target: Non opus est tibi pericula supervacua capere.

unit.source: Concentrate on dealing with Hisoka.
unit.target: Concentra te in rebus Hisoka tractandis.

unit.source: If they request your help, you may cooperate.
unit.target: Si auxilium tuum petant, cooperari poteris.

unit.source: “The Beyonder characteristics left behind by members of the Rose School of Thought, especially those of the Devil and Prisoner pathways, come with a certain level of troublesome corruption.
unit.target: “Characteres Beyonder ab membris Scholae Rosi relicti, praesertim eorum viae Diaboli et viae Carcerarii, cum aliquo gradu corruptionis molestae veniunt.

unit.source: It’s advisable not to sell them or randomly seek out an Artisan to craft items.
unit.target: Suadetur eos non vendere aut artificem temere quaerere ad res conficiendas.

unit.source: If you need to, you can sell them to me or let me find an Artisan.
unit.target: Si opus est, eos mihi vendere potes aut me artificem invenire sinere.

unit.source: Keeping them in the Traveler’s Bag is also fine.
unit.target: Eos in sacculo Itineris servare quoque satis est.

unit.source: Compared to the Shadow Branch boxing gloves, Mr. Fool’s seal, and the attention and influence of other items on you, they’re as weak as an ordinary newborn baby.”
unit.target: Comparatis cum manubriis pugilisticis Rami Umbrae, sigillo Domini Stulti, et cum attentione atque potentia aliorum rerum in te, tam infirmi sunt quam infans ordinarius recenter natus.

unit.source: Relieved by this response, Lumian took a breath and activated the black mark on his right shoulder, vanishing from the room.
unit.target: Liberatus hac responsione, Lumian spiritum cepit et notam atram in humero dextro suo activavit, ex conclavi evanescens.

unit.source: After a while, he materialized atop a bell tower on Avenue du Boulevard in Trier.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, in turrim campanariam in Avenue du Boulevard, Trier, apparuit.

unit.source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Directe auctores in WebNovel sustine!

unit.source: Gazing at the luxurious Champs-Élysées in the distance and the already lit lamps, Lumian couldn’t hold back any longer.
unit.target: Spectans Champs-Élysées opulenta in longe et iam luminaria accensa, Lumian amplius se continere non potuit.

unit.source: He needed to carefully consider the information he had just obtained from Camus.
unit.target: Ipsam necesse habebat diligenter considerare informationes quas modo ab Camus acceperat.

unit.source: With the Berserk Sea, the Feynapotter Kingdom, and half of the Intis Republic between them, Lumian could devise a plan to hunt Hisoka without worrying about the enemy sensing malice and danger!
unit.target: Cum Mare Furiosum, Regnum Feynapotter, et dimidium Reipublicae Intis inter se essent, Lumian consilium capere poterat ut Hisoka venaret, sine metu hostium malevolentiae atque periculi sentiendi!

unit.source: Perhaps only an Angel could sense over such a distance.
unit.target: Forsitan solum Angelus tale spatium percipere posset.

unit.source: Though Lumian lacked specific information about his target or Hisoka’s identity and had no concrete plan, caution was paramount when he had the ability to be cautious.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian informationes specificas de proposito suo aut de identitate Hisoka caruit, et consilium certum non obtinebat, cautela praecipua erat.

unit.source: Relying on his Ascetic trait, he endured, putting aside thoughts of the corresponding matters.
unit.target: Innixus indole ascetica, sustinuit, cogitationes rerum pertinentium deponens.

unit.source: Only when far from Port Pylos and the Southern Continent did he carefully consider details, allowing his thoughts to run free.
unit.target: Solum cum longe a Portu Pylos et Continente Meridionali erat, singulariter subtilia examinabat, cogitationibus suis libere fluere concedens.

unit.source: After an indeterminate amount of time, Lumian vanished from the bell tower.
unit.target: Post tempus indeterminatum, Lumian ex turrim campanariam evanuit.

unit.source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
unit.target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

unit.source: The pendulum clock struck 7 p.m.
unit.target: Horologium pendulum septimam horam vespertinam sonavit.

unit.source: The next morning.
unit.target: Postridie mane.

unit.source: Upon entering the hall, Camus spotted Louis Berry, adorned in a golden straw hat, seated on a sofa in the reception area.
unit.target: In aulam ingrediens, Camus Ludovicum Berry, pileum stramineum aureum gerens, in solio in area receptionis sedere vidit.

unit.source: Why is he here again?
unit.target: Cur hic iterum adest?

unit.source: Recalling Kolobo’s warning, Camus frowned and approached with concern.
unit.target: Meminens monitionis Kolobo, Camus frontem contrahens et sollicite accessit.

unit.source: “What can I do for you this time?” he asked calmly, keeping his emotions in check.
unit.target: “Quid tibi hoc tempore facere possum?” interrogavit quiete, affectus suos temperans.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “I need some information, but it won’t be from you.
unit.target: “Informationem aliquam mihi opus est, sed non a te.

unit.source: Find a reliable teammate who isn’t privy to our discussion yesterday evening.
unit.target: Reperi sodalem fidum, qui colloquio nostro hesterno vesperi non conscius sit.

unit.source: Meet me at the Matani Import and Export Shop.
unit.target: Conveni mecum ad Tabernam Matani Importationis et Exportationis.

unit.source: “I can offer 5,000 verl d’or for this.”
unit.target: “Hinc possum offerre 5,000 verl d’or.”

unit.source: A peculiar request… 5,000 verl d’or. How generous…
unit.target: Petitum insolitum… 5,000 verl d’or. Quam liberalis…

unit.source: Is he trying to avoid a Devil’s danger premonition?
unit.target: Num conatur vitare praenotitionem periculi Diaboli?

unit.source: Camus, an experienced official Beyonder, quickly made the connection.
unit.target: Camus, Beyonder peritus et officialis, celeriter intellexit.

unit.source: He refrained from overthinking and pondered for a moment before responding, “Agreed.”
unit.target: Non nimis cogitavit et paulisper meditatus est antequam responderet: “Assentior.”

unit.source: Heading into the office area, Lumian rose and departed, making his way to the Matani Import and Export Shop nearby.
unit.target: Ad spatium officii accedens, Lumian surrexit et discessit, iter faciens ad Tabernam Matani Importationis et Exportationis prope.

unit.source: Soon, a man sat opposite Lumian, who was savoring his coffee.
unit.target: Mox, vir adversus Lumian sedebat, qui suum coffee degustabat.

unit.source: The man, with dark hair and a relatively thin build, was a member of the patrol team who had accompanied them to the scene yesterday.
unit.target: Vir, capillis atris et corpore relativamente tenue, erat sodalis manipuli custodum qui heri eos ad locum comitatus fuerat.

unit.source: Today, he wore dark-black sunglasses, giving him the appearance of a blind individual.
unit.target: Hodie, oculos solares nigrissimorum gerebat, qui ei speciem caeci exhibebat.

unit.source: “I’m Kolobo. Camus mentioned a chance to earn 5,000 verl d’or,” the patrol team member introduced himself in fluent Intisian.
unit.target: “Ego sum Kolobo. Camus de occasione 5,000 verl d’or lucrandi dixit,” sodalis manipuli custodum se fluenter in Intisiano contulit.

unit.source: Amused, Lumian observed Kolobo’s demeanor.
unit.target: Divertitus, Lumian indolem Kolobo observavit.

unit.source: Taking out a pen and paper, he counted out 5,000 verl d’or notes and slid them over.
unit.target: Calamo et charta extrahens, 5,000 verl d’or notas enumeravit et tradidit.

unit.source: “Write down the Prisoner pathway Beyonder’s name and details from the patrol team.
unit.target: “Scribe nomen et singula Beyonder viae Carcerarii ex manipulo custodum.

unit.source: Ensure I don’t catch sight of it.
unit.target: Fac ut illud mihi non conspiciatur.

unit.source: Fold it into a square after writing.”
unit.target: Post scriptionem, plica illud in quadratum.

unit.source: Kolobo, almost as if blind, fumbled for the banknotes.
unit.target: Kolobo, quasi caecus, notas monetarias torpiter quaesivit.

unit.source: He bent down and counted, nearly burying his head under the table.
unit.target: Se inclinavit et numeravit, paene caput sub mensa abscondens.

unit.source: “Why aren’t you looking at me?” Lumian asked with curiosity.
unit.target: “Cur non in me spectas?” interrogavit Lumian cum curiositate.

unit.source: Trembling, Kolobo replied, “I fear I might truly go blind.”
unit.target: Trementes, Kolobo respondit: “Timeo me vere caecum fieri posse.”

unit.source: Are you able to see something you shouldn’t? From the Monster pathway?
unit.target: Licetne tibi aliquid videre quod videre non debes? Ex via Monstrorum?

unit.source: Lumian pondered but refrained from probing further.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, sed ulteriora indagare non ausus est.

unit.source: Kolobo turned around and swiftly wrote down the corresponding information on the table behind him, folding the paper and passing it to Lumian.
unit.target: Kolobo se convertit et celeriter informationem correspondentem in mensa retro scripsit, chartam plicans et Lumiano tradens.

unit.source: Without a second glance, Lumian promptly received the information and stowed it in his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ne secundo intuitus, Lumian celeriter informationem accepit et in sacculo Itineris deposuit.

unit.source: After settling the bill for his coffee, he headed to the washroom.
unit.target: Postquam libellum pro coffee solvit, ad latrinam processit.

unit.source: His figure vanished once more.
unit.target: Figura eius iterum evanuit.

unit.source: 645 “Gifts”
unit.target: 645 “Dona”

unit.source: After Louis Berry left the coffee area, Kolobo breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Postquam Louis Berry spatium café reliquit, Kolobo suspirum levationis edidit.

unit.source: He removed his sunglasses, retrieved the 5,000 verl d’or, and counted it again.
unit.target: Oculos solares abstulit, quinque milia “verl d’or” recuperavit, et iterum numeravit.

unit.source: His gut told him this deal would work out.
unit.target: Viscera eius nuntiaverunt ei hoc commercium feliciter eveniturum esse.

unit.source: That’s the only reason he dared to risk coming to the Matani Import and Export Shop.
unit.target: Id sola erat causa cur ausus esset periculum subire ut ad tabernam importationis et exportationis Matani accederet.

unit.source: Still, his whole body had been trembling with fear.
unit.target: Tamen totum corpus eius timore tremuit.

unit.source: He couldn’t even keep his eyes open most of the time, and his hands were shaking so badly that he was surprised it was legible.
unit.target: Non poterat etiam oculos plerumque tenere apertos, et manus eius tantopere tremebant ut miraretur id legibile esse.

unit.source: Trouble always waits until it’s ready to explode, he thought, clutching his sunglasses.
unit.target: Incommodum semper exspectat donec ad erumpendum paratum fuerit, cogitavit, oculos solares tenens.

unit.source: He stood up and headed for the door.
unit.target: Surgens se insurrexit et ad ianuam contulit.

unit.source: Something was wrong.
unit.target: Aliquid male erat.

unit.source: He could feel it.
unit.target: Illud sentire poterat.

unit.source: His body tensed with some kind of danger sense he couldn’t explain.
unit.target: Corpus eius contrahuitur aliquo periculi sensu, quem explicare non poterat.

unit.source: His heart raced as he scanned the place professionally, trying to pinpoint the danger.
unit.target: Cor eius pulsat, dum peritus locum perscrutatus periculi speciem determinare conabatur.

unit.source: Kolobo’s footsteps changed–sometimes fast, sometimes slow.
unit.target: Gradus Kolobo mutantur – aliquando celeres, aliquando tardi.

unit.source: He’d zip off in one direction only to stop short a few paces later.
unit.target: In una directione festinanter se contulit, sed paucis passibus postea subsistere coepit.

unit.source: Kolobo took in the morning sun, the quiet shop that had just opened its doors, and the handful of customers scattered about.
unit.target: Kolobo solem matutinum atque tabernam quietam, quae modo ianuas aperuerat, et paucos clientes circum dispersos observavit.

unit.source: Not a single pair of eyes seemed fixed on him, and there was no one lurking in the shadows, observing his every move.
unit.target: Nulla par oculorum ad eum apposita videbatur, neque quisquam in umbris latens eius singulos motus inspicabat.

unit.source: Yet, following his instincts, his feet carried him back to the coffee shop area. That’s where he finally stopped, in front of the bathroom sign.
unit.target: At vero, instinctus sequentibus, pedes eum ad spatium café reducerunt. Ibi tandem sistit, coram indicato signo latrinarum.

unit.source: Two years as a Beyonder taught Kolobo the most important lesson: trust your gut. Without thinking, he yanked open the heavy wooden door and walked inside.
unit.target: Duo anni ut Beyonder maximum verbum Kolobo docuerunt: fida in tuo instinctu. Sine mora cogitandi, ianuam ligneam gravem evulsit et intravit.

unit.source: The Matani Import and Export Shop wasn’t some back‐alley dive. This restroom was big. Three urinals, three stalls, and gas lamps flickered on the clean tile.
unit.target: Taberna Matani Importationis et Exportationis non erat taberna vilis obscura; haec latrina ampla erat. Tres urinaria, tres cellae, et lumina gasifera in tessera puris micabant.

unit.source: Kolobo headed to the sink to splash cold water on his face. Maybe that would shake this weird danger feeling that was creeping all over him.
unit.target: Kolobo ad lavatorium se contulit ut aquam frigida in faciem effunderet. Forsitan hoc insolitum periculi sensum, quod eum circumibat, exsolvaret.

unit.source: As he looked up, a face stared back at him in the mirror.
unit.target: Cum sursum aspiceret, facies in speculo eius respiciebat.

unit.source: But it wasn’t his.
unit.target: Sed non eius erat.

unit.source: The face was freakishly white. The guy looked late twenties, with light brown skin and eyes that flashed a dark, sickly green. He stared at Kolobo with dead, cold eyes.
unit.target: Facies insolite candida erat. Vir vicesimos annos attigit videbatur, cum cute fulva et oculis obscuro, aegrotoque virentibus; Kolobo eum spectabat oculis mortuis et frigidi.

unit.source: Kolobo’s brain short-circuited as recognition hit.
unit.target: Mens Kolobo simul evanuit, cum recognitio eum percussit.

unit.source: Twanaku Tupián, the only Prisoner pathway Beyonder on their patrol team.
unit.target: Twanaku Tupián, solus Beyonder viae Carcerarii in eorum manipulo praesidii, erat.

unit.source: The guy had become a Sequence 6 Zombie last year.
unit.target: Hic vir anno ultimo Sequenciam VI Zombie factus fuit.

unit.source: He was also the first guy to ever make Kolobo’s skin crawl.
unit.target: Is etiam primus vir fuit qui cutem Kolobo pertremere fecit.

unit.source: If he told anyone else, he gut told him he’d end up dead!
unit.target: Si cuicquam alio dixeret, viscera illi nuntiaverunt eum in fine mortis futurum esse!

unit.source: When Lumian asked Kolobo to spill the beans about the Prisoner pathway Beyonder on his team, something about it felt wrong.
unit.target: Cum Lumian Kolobo rogavit ut de Beyonder viae Carcerarii in sua turma exponeret, aliquid in ea iniuriose videbatur.

unit.source: He’d almost bailed on the whole deal.
unit.target: Paene totum pactum deseruisse velle videbatur.

unit.source: He’d counted that huge 50,000 sum not out of distrust but because he needed time to think, to weigh the risk.
unit.target: Illam magnam summam quinquaginta milia non ex diffidentia sed quia tempus ad cogitandum et periculum aestimandum necessarium habebat, numeravit.

unit.source: He decided to trust his gut, but he hadn’t told Lumian about this feeling, this fear of Tupián…
unit.target: Constituit hisque viscera fidere, sed Lumian de hoc sensu, de hoc Tupián timore nihil dixit.

unit.source: And now, here Twanaku Tupián was, reflected in the mirror.
unit.target: Et nunc, ecce Twanaku Tupián in speculo reflectus erat.

unit.source: This is a Sequence 5 Wraith power.
unit.target: Hoc est vis Umbrarum Sequenciae V.

unit.source: When did he advance?
unit.target: Quando profectus est?

unit.source: Kolobo could barely think over the growing horror.
unit.target: Kolobo vix de creciente horrore cogitare potuit.

unit.source: Suddenly, his body felt like it’d been dropped into an icy lake.
unit.target: Subito corpus eius sensit quasi in lacu glaciali deiectum fuisset.

unit.source: Twanaku Twanaku’s face in the mirror vanished.
unit.target: Facies Twanaku Tupián in speculo evanuit.

unit.source: Kolobo could barely move.
unit.target: Kolobo vix se movere potuit.

unit.source: An icy coldness gripped him, the kind that chilled you to the bone.
unit.target: Frigiditas glacialis eum complexa est, quae ad ossa refrigeraret.

unit.source: It wasn’t his own hands that were moving–they lifted without him wanting them to.
unit.target: Non manus eius movebantur, sed levatae sunt sine eius voluntate.

unit.source: A voice drifted through his ears, flat and emotionless.
unit.target: Vox per aures eius diffusa est, plana et sine affectu.

unit.source: “Looks like my cover is blown. You were actually asked to provide my information.
unit.target: “Videtur tectum meum detegitum esse. Vere petitum est ut notitiam meam praebeatis.”

unit.source: “I’ll get out of Port Pylos, but I’m going to leave two gifts for Lumian Lee.”
unit.target: “Ex Portu Pylos exeiam, sed duo dona Lumian Lee relinquam.”

unit.source: What did that even mean?
unit.target: Quid hoc etiam significabat?

unit.source: What kind of gift?
unit.target: Qualis donum erat?

unit.source: And who the heck was Lumian Lee?
unit.target: Et quis autem erat Lumian Lee?

unit.source: Kolobo’s thoughts were a jumbled mess.
unit.target: Cogitationes Kolobo confusae erant.

unit.source: His own hands were tightening around his neck.
unit.target: Manus eius propriae circum collum stringebantur.

unit.source: Then, with a sickening jolt, he realized what “gift” the voice was talking about.
unit.target: Tum, cum nauseabundo tremore, intellexit de quo “donum” vox loquebatur.

unit.source: Twanaku Tupián was going to kill him and leave a gift–his dead body!
unit.target: Twanaku Tupián eum interficere et donum relinqui – corpus eius mortuum – parabat.

unit.source: But he said two gifts. What was the other one?
unit.target: Sed duo dona dixerat. Quae altera erat?

unit.source: In the four-story beige building of the patrol team.
unit.target: In aedificio quadripartito, colore beige, turmae praesidii.

unit.source: Camus sipped his Highlander coffee and read the West Balam Telegraph, contemplating the deal between Kolobo and Louis Berry.
unit.target: Camus sorbetur suum caffeum Highlander et legit “West Balam Telegraph”, pactum inter Kolobo et Louis Berry meditans.

unit.source: If successful, as an intermediary, he would receive 20% of the amount.
unit.target: Si successerit, ut mediarius, viginti centesimas summae acciperet.

unit.source: Knock, knock, knock.
unit.target: Trepitus, trepitus, trepitus.

unit.source: A gentle rap echoed on Camus’s office door.
unit.target: Mollis pulsus in ianuam officii Camus resonavit.

unit.source: “Please come in.” Though not particularly young, Camus had ample experience, leading one of the patrol team’s operations teams.
unit.target: “Quaeso, intrate.” Quamquam non nimis iuvenis, Camus amplam experientiam habebat, ducem unius turmae operativae gerens.

unit.source: If there were a vacancy for the vice-captain position, his only competition would be Twanaku Tupián of the Prisoner pathway.
unit.target: Si locum viceni capitani vacaret, unica certatio eius esset Twanaku Tupián, Beyonder viae Carcerarii.

unit.source: The Southern Continent was a chaotic place, especially in an area torn between multiple factions.
unit.target: Continentia Meridionalis locus chaos erat, praesertim in regione inter varias factiones divisus.

unit.source: Whether dealing with the bloodthirsty Rose School of Thought, the ominous Numinous Episcopate, ambitious adventurers, spies from various countries, or missionaries, danger lurked at every corner.
unit.target: Sive tractaretur cum sanguinolenta “Rose School of Thought”, sive cum ominoso “Numinous Episcopate”, sive cum ambitiosis advenis, speculatoribus ex variis nationibus, sive cum missionariis, periculum in omnibus angulis latuit.

unit.source: Some would take the initiative to assassinate patrol team members, while others would rebel and escape.
unit.target: Aliqui initium capere ausi sunt ad membra turmae praesidii interficienda, alii autem rebellare et evadere conabantur.

unit.source: Meticulous planning was not uncommon, and even the patrol team members found themselves as targets.
unit.target: Meticulosa consilia non erant insolita, et etiam membra turmae praesidii se tamquam metas inveniebant.

unit.source: Consequently, the patrol team faced casualties every year, leading to a constant need for new recruits.
unit.target: Consequenter, turma praesidii annuo casibus laborabat, quod ad perpetuam necessitatem novorum adtructorum duxit.

unit.source: Encountering more attacks had its advantages.
unit.target: Multos impetus occurrere utilia habebat.

unit.source: Victorious confrontations often yielded valuable items and Beyonder-related ingredients.
unit.target: Confrontationes victores saepe pretiosa obiecta et componentes Beyonder adferre solitae erant.

unit.source: Many of the patrol team’s advancement formulas and potions were acquired in such situations, creating a noteworthy trend.
unit.target: Multae formulae progressionis et pocula turmae praesidii in talibus condicionibus comparatae sunt, efficientes notabilem modum.

unit.source: Compared to cities of similar size in the Northern Continent, Port Pylos had an even greater number of official Beyonders, especially Mid-Sequence Beyonders.
unit.target: Comparata urbibus similis magnitudinis in Continente Septentrionali, Portus Pylos numerum Beyonder officialium etiam maiorem habebat, praesertim Beyonder mediis sequentiis.

unit.source: However, they lacked higher levels of power or corresponding Sealed Artifacts.
unit.target: Attamen gradus potentiae superiores aut artifacta sigillata correspondentes defuerunt.

unit.source: Camus found himself in a tight spot financially due to his rapid advancement outpacing his cousins.
unit.target: Camus in difficultate pecuniaria versabatur, quod celeris ascensio eius cognatos suos superabat.

unit.source: Arriving in Matani State and Port Pylos as a Sequence 9 Arbiter, he had swiftly climbed to a Sequence 7 Justiciar in just five years.
unit.target: Adveniens in Civitate Matani et Portu Pylos ut Arbiter Sequenciae IX, celeriter ad Justiciarium Sequenciae VII pervenit in quinque annis.

unit.source: His goal was to advance to Sequence 6 and become a Judge, and he had recently been gathering the funds to purchase the necessary materials.
unit.target: Propositum eius erat ad Sequenciam VI progredi et Iudicem fieri, et nuper pecunias colligebat ad materias necessarias emendas.

unit.source: If the opportunity to become a vice-captain arose, the patrol team would certainly contribute resources to aid his advancement.
unit.target: Si occasio ad viceni ducis munus oriremur, turma praesidii certe opes ad eius progressionem adiungendam offerret.

unit.source: Spoils of war weren’t always suitable for him; sometimes, he needed to trade with teammates or sell them to the patrol team for money.
unit.target: Praeda belli non semper ei opportuna erat; interdum necesse habebat cum sodalibus commercio uti aut ea turmae praesidii pro pecunia vendere.

unit.source: He patiently waited for the potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients corresponding to his pathway to appear.
unit.target: Clemens exspectabat formulas poculorum et ingredientes Beyonder qui viae eius corresponderent, apparere.

unit.source: The patrol team, being relatively new, hadn’t accumulated substantial reserves.
unit.target: Turma praesidii, nuper condita, copias substantiarum non congregaverat.

unit.source: Camus needed to find a way to purchase practical mystical items, regularly replenish charms, potions, and other essentials to stay prepared against assassinations and conflicts.
unit.target: Camus viam invenire debebat ad res mysticas utiles emendas, ad sigilla, pocula, et alia necessaria regulariter reficienda, ut contra caedes et contentiones paratus maneret.

unit.source: In such a situation, money was naturally scarce.
unit.target: In tali condicione, pecunia naturaliter rara erat.

unit.source: Chaos was a path to hell but also a ladder to the top!
unit.target: Chaos via ad inferos erat, sed etiam scala ad summum!

unit.source: Pugilist Sow entered.
unit.target: Pugil Sow intravit.

unit.source: With his brown braids gently swaying, Sow, clad in a sky-blue shirt and beige pants, approached Camus with one hand in his pocket, smiling as he asked, “Have you seen Kolobo? I need to discuss something with him.”
unit.target: Cum trichis fusci modice undantibus, Sow, indutus camisia caeli caerulei et braccis beige, accedebat ad Camus una manu in sinu posita, subridens quaerens: “Kolobone vidisti? Aliquid cum eo disserere mihi oportet.”

unit.source: Camus had already prepared a reason.
unit.target: Camus iam causam praeparaverat.

unit.source: “He went to the Import and Export Shop to buy coffee beans.”
unit.target: “Ad Tabernam Importationis et Exportationis ivit ad emendum granos café.”

unit.source: Sow tersely acknowledged, “Then I’ll wait for him to return.”
unit.target: Sow breviter respondit: “Tum exspectabo ut redeat.”

unit.source: “What’s up?” Camus asked casually.
unit.target: “Quid agitur?” Camus leviter quaesivit.

unit.source: Sow took two steps forward and smiled.
unit.target: Sow duos passus progressus est et subridit.

unit.source: “There’s an investigation we would like to involve him in. Maybe he can uncover clues that others can’t.”
unit.target: “Investigatio est in qua eum implicare velimus. Forsitan indicia detegere possit quae alii non possunt.”

unit.source: “You bastards, aren’t you concerned about Kolobo getting hurt?” Camus replied with amusement, lifting his coffee and taking a sip.
unit.target: “Vobis, improbi, nonne cura est de Kolobo laedendo?” Camus iocose respondit, caffeum levans et sorbillans.

unit.source: At that moment, Sow withdrew his right hand from his trouser pocket, holding a poker card flickering with a metallic gleam between his thumb and index finger.
unit.target: Illo momento, Sow dexteram manum ex sinu bracae extraxit, tenens chartam ludi poker, inter pollicem et indicem, metallum micantem.

unit.source: The card portrayed a grayish-white clown.
unit.target: Charta scurram cinereo-albidam repraesentabat.

unit.source: With a swift motion, Sow hurled the poker card at Camus’s head.
unit.target: Celeri motu, Sow chartam poker ad caput Camus iaculatus est.

unit.source: In the men’s washroom of the Matani Import and Export Shop.
unit.target: In latrina virorum Tabernae Matani Importationis et Exportationis.

unit.source: Kolobo finally caught his reflection in the mirror.
unit.target: Kolobo tandem imaginem suam in speculo cepit.

unit.source: His skin had turned a sickly green, and his hands were locked around his own neck, the pressure making his bones crack.
unit.target: Cutis eius viridi aegroto facta erat, et manus eius circum collum suum constringebantur, pressio ossa eius concidens.

unit.source: Twanaku Tupián stared back at him from his bright blue eyes.
unit.target: Twanaku Tupián ex oculis caeruleis splendentibus eum inspiciebat.

unit.source: Kolobo tried to scream, but nothing came out.
unit.target: Kolobo clamare conatus est, sed nihil effluere potuit.

unit.source: He wanted to run, but his legs wouldn’t move.
unit.target: Currere vellebat, sed crura eius movere non poterant.

unit.source: It was like his body wasn’t his anymore—it was killing him.
unit.target: Quasi corpus eius non esset eius; eum interficiebat.

unit.source: Ugh… A choked sound finally escaped Kolobo’s throat, too quiet for anyone to hear.
unit.target: Heu… Sonus suffocatus tandem ex gutture Kolobo evasit, nimis quietus ut quis audiret.

unit.source: Fear and despair tightened around his heart.
unit.target: Timor et desperatio circa cor eius stringebantur.

unit.source: Then, Kolobo’s fingers slipped.
unit.target: Tum digiti Kolobo lapsi sunt.

unit.source: A figure emerged from the shadows by the bathroom vents.
unit.target: Figura ex umbris iuxta foramina latrinarum apparuit.

unit.source: Lumian—black hair, green eyes, all dressed in black and white with a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Lumian — capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, totus in nigro ac albo indutus, cum pileo stramineo aureo.

unit.source: A flicker of surprise crossed his face, then understanding.
unit.target: Exsurrectio admirationis per faciem eius transiit, deinde intellectus.

unit.source: He held a black bone flute to his lips.
unit.target: Fistulam ossis nigri ad labia tenebat.

unit.source: A hum resounded, accompanied by a melancholic tune echoing from the dark red holes.
unit.target: Humitus resonabat, comitatus cantu melancholico ex foraminibus rubris tenebris sonantibus.

unit.source: Symphony of Hatred!
unit.target: Symphonia Odii!

unit.source: Why did I only sense malice and danger now…
unit.target: Cur nunc solum malitiam et periculum sentio…

unit.source: Just as this thought crossed Twanaku’s mind, Twanaku’s murderous intent exploded, fueled by the haunting melody.
unit.target: Justum ut haec cogitatio in mentem Twanaku pervenit, ejus intentio homicida subito floruit, a melodia obsessa alita.

unit.source: Silently, a figure peeled away from Kolobo’s body.
unit.target: Silentio, figura a corpore Kolobo se dislocavit.

unit.source: It was Twanaku Tupián, his light brown skin gone deathly pale.
unit.target: Erat Twanaku Tupián, cuius cutis fusca in pallorem mortiferum versa erat.

unit.source: Blood vessels bulged in his yellow eyes, threatening to burst.
unit.target: Vasa sanguinea in oculis eius flavis prolabebantur, minantia erumpere.

unit.source: The Symphony of Hatred tore into Kolobo, already weak with fear.
unit.target: Symphonia Odii in Kolobo irrupit, iam timore debilis.

unit.source: His heart almost stopped.
unit.target: Cor eius paene cessavit.

unit.source: He crumpled to the floor, barely alive.
unit.target: In terram collapsus est, vix superstes.

unit.source: Lumian stopped the melody. Holding the black bone flute, he slid back into the shadows and under the vent.
unit.target: Lumian melodiem sistit. Fistulam ossis nigri tenens, in umbras atque sub foramina redactus est.

unit.source: A moment later, he reappeared behind Twanaku Tupián, who was practically vibrating with murderous intent.
unit.target: Momento post, iterum apparuit post Twanaku Tupián, qui fere cum homicida intentio vibrabat.

unit.source: Lumian lifted the flute, its blood-colored holes gleaming ominously, and took a breath.
unit.target: Lumian fistulam levavit, foraminibus sanguine coloratis minaciter micantibus, et spiritum traxit.

unit.source: Finally, you’re here!
unit.target: Denique, hic es!

unit.source: 646 Indoor Fight
unit.target: 646 Pugna Intra

unit.source: Twanaku Tupián’s ears rang, his eyes stinging with blood.
unit.target: Aures Twanaku Tupián resonaverunt, oculi eius sanguine pungebantur.

unit.source: His mind burned, his thoughts scattering like sparks.
unit.target: Mens eius ardebat, cogitationes eius quasi scintillae dispersae erant.

unit.source: For an agonizing moment, he couldn’t process his situation, couldn’t even think about the enemy closing in.
unit.target: Per momentum cruciæ, non potuit suam condicionem percipere, nec quidem de hoste appropinquantibus meditari.

unit.source: Blood, smelling strangely metallic, trickled from his eyes and nose.
unit.target: Sanguis, insolitam metallorum odorem habens, stillabat ex oculis et naso eius.

unit.source: His pale skin darkened ominously.
unit.target: Cutis eius pallida sinistrē obscurata est.

unit.source: “Ha!”
unit.target: “Ha!”

unit.source: Lumian spat a blast of pale-yellow light, hitting the suspected Hisoka from barely two meters away.
unit.target: Lumian evomuit fulgor lucis pallido-flavae, percutiens verisimilem Hisokam a paene duorum metrorum distantia.

unit.source: Twanaku’s eyes slammed shut, and he collapsed.
unit.target: Oculi Twanaku vehementer clausi sunt, et ille cecidit.

unit.source: Before he hit the ground, Lumian’s Symphony of Hatred, a black bone flute, jabbed towards his neck.
unit.target: Antequam in terram perveniret, Symphonia Odii Lumiani, fistula ossis nigrae, in collum eius incisit.

unit.source: Instantly, the tiled bathroom floor dissolved into a vast, muddy expanse of darkness.
unit.target: Statim, pavimentum balnei latericium in immensam, lutosam extensionem tenebrarum dissolutum est.

unit.source: Arms burst upward.
unit.target: Brachia sursum erupere coeperunt.

unit.source: Some were stripped of skin, all raw muscle and glistening tendon.
unit.target: Nonnulli sine cute erant, exhibentes solum musculum crudum et tendines nitidos.

unit.source: Others twisted and ghostly, pale and transparent.
unit.target: Alii, contorti et spectrales, pallidi et transparentes erant.

unit.source: Some bore bulging eyes that spun madly, others sprouted thick green growths…
unit.target: Nonnulli oculos prominentes, furibunde gyrantes, habebant; alii spessas virides protuberationes gerebant…

unit.source: The grotesque limbs tore at Lumian and Twanaku, clawing and dragging.
unit.target: Membra deformia Lumiani atque Twanaku laniabant, ungulis rapientibus et trahentibus.

unit.source: This was Twanaku’s spell, a death-type enchantment once called Vengeful Wraith’s Entanglement, meant to summon an undead horde to paralyze his targets.
unit.target: Hoc erat incantatio Twanaku, magia mortifera, quae olim “Vindicantis Umbrae Vinculum” appellata est, destinata ad evocandum multitudinem mortuorum ad metas paralysandas.

unit.source: But as a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Devil pathway, his power twisted the spell into something new—the Fallen Abyss!
unit.target: Sed ut Mid-Sequence Beyonder per semitam Diaboli, potentia eius incantationem in rem novam convertere fecit—Abyssus Ruinosus!

unit.source: He could alter a space in advance, allowing undead or fallen creatures to lurk beneath the surface.
unit.target: Potuit spatium praeconfigurare, sinens ut creaturae mortuorum aut lapsae sub superficie latitarent.

unit.source: Anyone unfortunate enough to step inside would be grabbed by unseen arms and dragged into the muddy, pitch-black depths.
unit.target: Quicumque casu intus ingrediatur, ab armis invisibilibus capietur et in lutum profundum ac atrum trahietur.

unit.source: The Abyss would slow and weaken its victims, the icy touch of the undead stealing their strength with agonizing speed.
unit.target: Abyssus victimis celeritatem retardaret atque robur eorum subripere solebat, tactus glacialis mortuorum vires eorum cum agonia rapiebat.

unit.source: If they were pulled all the way under, they’d be corrupted and lost.
unit.target: Si omnino sublacerentur, corrupti atque perditi erunt.

unit.source: Twanaku had cast this spell in the bathroom before attacking Kolobo.
unit.target: Twanaku hanc incantationem in balneo egerat, antequam Kolobo oppugnavit.

unit.source: He hadn’t wanted any nosy employees or customers to stumble on the scene, but it turned out to be a lucky break.
unit.target: Non voluerat aliquos operarios curiosos aut clientes in hanc scenam incidere, sed fortuito feliciter accidit.

unit.source: That’s why he’d appeared in the mirror instead of right inside Kolobo’s eyes.
unit.target: Ideo in speculo apparuit, potius quam recte in oculis Kolobo.

unit.source: Lumian’s attack with the Symphony of Hatred came to an abrupt halt.
unit.target: Impulsus Lumiani cum Symphonia Odii subito cessavit.

unit.source: Countless arms wrapped around his ankles, calves, hips, and torso.
unit.target: Innumerabiles brachia circa talos, crura, coxas, et trunco eius involuti sunt.

unit.source: A wave of icy stiffness washed over him, his movements turning sluggish.
unit.target: Unda glacialis rigoris eum pervagata est, et motus eius tardos facti sunt.

unit.source: It was the same for Twanaku.
unit.target: Idem Twanaku evenit.

unit.source: With the Wraith and Desire Apostle unconscious, the Fallen Abyss slipped from his control, leaving him vulnerable.
unit.target: Cum Wraith et Desire Apostle insensati erant, Abyssus Ruinosus ex eius potestate lapsus est, reliquens eum vulnerabilem.

unit.source: His limp body was seized by the strange arms and dragged to the ground.
unit.target: Corpus eius languidum ab insolitis brachiis captum est et ad terram trahitum est.

unit.source: Nearby, Kolobo, badly injured and out for the count, was pulled into the muddy, pitch-black depths of the illusory Abyss.
unit.target: Prope, Kolobo, graviter vulneratus atque exanimatus, in profundum lutosum atque atrum Abyssum illusorium trahiturus est.

unit.source: A burst of crimson flames exploded from Lumian’s body, surrounding him like a blazing cloak.
unit.target: Exruptio flammarum rubrarum ex corpore Lumiani erupit, circumducens eum ut pallium ardens.

unit.source: The flames roared, scorching most of the arms into retreat.
unit.target: Flammae rugiebant, et pleraque brachia in retrorsum comburiebant.

unit.source: Still, some remained unaffected, their grip relentless.
unit.target: Tamen, quidam intacti remanebant, eorum prehensio inexorabilis erat.

unit.source: A creeping coldness numbed Lumian’s body, but he regained a sliver of his former agility.
unit.target: Frigus insidiosum corpus Lumiani exsensivit, sed aliquam partem pristinae agilitas recuperavit.

unit.source: Before, he could have simply lunged forward, thrusting the black bone flute towards his enemy’s neck.
unit.target: Ante, facile potuisset praecurrere, fistulam ossium nigrorum in collum hostis feriens.

unit.source: But now, the target—the one he believed was Hisoka—was about to vanish into the ground.
unit.target: Sed nunc, meta, quem credebat esse Hisoka, mox in terram evanescere parabat.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: Twanaku slammed into the ground, the impact jarring him awake.
unit.target: Twanaku in terram conruperit, cui ictus eum excitavit.

unit.source: The Spell of Harrumph’s grip faded, and he finally regained his senses.
unit.target: Vinculum Incantationis Harrumph evanuit, et tandem sensus suos recuperavit.

unit.source: His toughest moment, that relentless surge of desire, was behind him.
unit.target: Difficillimum eius momentum, illud inexorabile desiderii impetum, iam praetererat.

unit.source: Lumian lowered his head, a single scornful sound escaping him.
unit.target: Lumian caput inclinavit, et unus solus sonus contemptus ex ore eius effugit.

unit.source: “Hmph!”
unit.target: “Hmph!”

unit.source: Twin beams of white light shot out while Lumian retracted his hands, fingers slipping back into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Geminae radii lucis albae exsiluere, dum Lumian manus retraxit, digiti in Sacculum Viatoris reverterunt.

unit.source: The beams missed their mark, but horrifying, bloody arms sprouted from the ground, a gruesome forest that blocked Twanaku from their path.
unit.target: Radia meta suum non attingebant, sed horrenda sanguinolenta brachia ex terra erupere coeperunt, silva horrenda quae viam Twanaku clausit.

unit.source: With a flash of awareness, Twanaku seized control of the Fallen Abyss spell, shielding himself and attacking his enemy.
unit.target: Sub fulgore conscientiae, Twanaku incantationem Abyssus Ruinosus ceperat, se protegens atque hostem oppugnans.

unit.source: The arms hit by the Spell of Harrumph softened, sinking back into the pitch-black mud as if drained.
unit.target: Brachia, incantatione Harrumph percussa, mollita sunt, in lutum atrum recedentes, quasi exhaurita.

unit.source: Twanaku took his chance.
unit.target: Twanaku opportunitatem cepit.

unit.source: His body twisted, morphing into a dark, oozing malevolence, a shape born from the darkest shadows of his heart.
unit.target: Corpus eius contortum est, transformans se in obscuram, exsudentem malignitatem, figuram ex obscurissimis umbris cordis ornatam.

unit.source: Silently, Twanaku transformed into an illusory, viscous, and foul black liquid, merging with the muddy Abyss and vanishing.
unit.target: Tacite, Twanaku in liquorem nigrum, viscosum et immundum se transformavit, cum lutulento Abysso fusus atque evanuit.

unit.source: The evil arms, unfazed by the flames, clung to Lumian, limiting his movement.
unit.target: Membra nefaria, flammarum non perturbata, Lumiani adhaerebant, motum eius restringentes.

unit.source: His hands flew to his Traveler’s Bag, pulling out a suit of gleaming silver armor.
unit.target: Manus eius ad Sacculum Viatoris volaverunt, extrahentes loricam argenteam nitidam.

unit.source: He set the armor beside him, sinking it firmly into the pitch-black mud.
unit.target: Loricam iuxta se posuit, eam in lutum atrum firmiter submersit.

unit.source: Pride Armor!
unit.target: Lorica Superbia!

unit.source: Evil, writhing arms erupted from the illusory Abyss—and the corresponding spirit world.
unit.target: Membra nefaria, contortae, ex Abysso illusorio erupere coeperunt—et ex mundo spirituum congruentes.

unit.source: Guided by the spell, they lunged for the Pride Armor, seizing its ankles, legs, torso, and back.
unit.target: Incantatione ducti, in Loricam Superbiae impetum ceperunt, capientes eius talos, crura, truncum et dorsum.

unit.source: The Pride Armor struck back, a broadsword of pure light flashing in its hand.
unit.target: Lorica Superbia repulit, gladio lato purae lucis in manu eius micante.

unit.source: Blinding, holy light flooded the washroom.
unit.target: Lux caeca et sacra balneum inundavit.

unit.source: The shadowy arms recoiled with hisses of black smoke, retreating into the depths.
unit.target: Brachia umbratilia, sibilo fumi nigri, retrorsum in profunditates recederunt.

unit.source: The pitch‑black mud dissolved, revealing the bathroom’s stone tiles.
unit.target: Lutum atrum dissolutum est, et tegulae lapideae balnei apparuerunt.

unit.source: Kolobo, who’d been on the brink of sinking into the Abyss, lay unconscious on the floor.
unit.target: Kolobo, qui ad Abyssum labens versabatur, in pavimento incoscienter iacebat.

unit.source: Just meters away, near the washroom door, a figure of viscous black liquid prepared to flee.
unit.target: Paucis metris abhinc, prope ianuam balnei, figura liquoris nigri viscosi ad fugam praeparata erat.

unit.source: Now free, Twanaku came to a swift decision.
unit.target: Nunc liber, Twanaku celeriter consilium cepit.

unit.source: He wouldn’t waste time trying to possess Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Non tempus consumeret conatu Lumian Lee possidendi.

unit.source: Instead, he’d abandon the Matani Import and Export Shop—and Port Pylos!
unit.target: Pro eo, desereret Tabernam Matani Import et Export—atque Portum Pylos!

unit.source: It was a trap.
unit.target: Erat insidiae.

unit.source: He had to escape before it closed around him.
unit.target: Oportuit ei effugere, priusquam insidiae circa eum clauderentur.

unit.source: Staying to fight back was foolish—he couldn’t risk lingering just to satisfy his rage and murderous desire.
unit.target: Manere ad repugnandum stultum erat—non poterat periculum subire manendi solum ut iram et homicidam cupiditatem expleret.

unit.source: That would be far too dangerous!
unit.target: Id esset nimis periculosum!

unit.source: Twanaku was glad he’d chosen to give Lumian Lee those two “gifts”.
unit.target: Twanaku laetabatur quod illa duo “dona” Lumian Lee dare selegerat.

unit.source: He’d even divided his favorite mystical items to do it.
unit.target: Diviserat etiam res mysticas suas dilectissimas ad hoc faciendum.

unit.source: The patrol team should be in chaos by now, focused on a false target.
unit.target: Turma speculatorum iam in chao esse debet, falso obiecto intenti.

unit.source: The distraction would give him his chance to escape.
unit.target: Distractio ei occasionem ad effugiendum dabit.

unit.source: Before, Twanaku hadn’t been focused on killing Camus.
unit.target: Ante, Twanaku in caedem Camus non versabatur.

unit.source: His priority was taking out Kolobo and escaping.
unit.target: Propositum eius praecipuum erat Kolobo perimere et effugere.

unit.source: If everything went smoothly, there shouldn’t be problems for either side.
unit.target: Si omnia leniter evenissent, nullo utriusque partis problema exsisteret.

unit.source: Any chaos caused by Camus’s death would be a bonus—
unit.target: Omnis chaos ex morte Camus ortus bonus esset—

unit.source: distracting the enemy by having the other passing off as the real deal.
unit.target: hostem distrahens, habens alterum quasi verum simulatum.

unit.source: He’d sent that extra “gift” as a precaution, not some bloodthirsty urge!
unit.target: Illud extra “donum” misit ut cautio, non propter sanguinolentum impetum!

unit.source: In Camus’s office, nestled inside the patrol team’s beige four‑story building, a poker card shimmered with metallic light as it hurtled towards him.
unit.target: In officio Camus, intra aedificium speculatorum quattuor tabulorum colore beige, charta poqueri metallico lumine micans in eum appropinquabat.

unit.source: Coffee was the last thing on his mind.
unit.target: Coffea ultima re in mente eius erat.

unit.source: He dove behind his desk with a surge of adrenaline, planning to send the table flying back at Sow before blasting him with Psychic Piercing.
unit.target: Sub mensa sua se demisit, impulsu adrenalinæ affectus, consilium capiens mensam in Sow redire mittere antequam eum “Psychica Percussione” percuteret.

unit.source: The joker‑faced card soared over Camus’s head, missing its target.
unit.target: Charta, vultu iocoso, super caput Camus volavit, metam suam non attingens.

unit.source: But then, as if it had a mind of its own, the card swerved and plunged down, aiming for Camus’s back.
unit.target: Sed tunc, quasi animum proprium haberet, charta flectens declinavit et deiecit, ad dorsum Camus tendens.

unit.source: It seemed to melt right into him, vanishing in a flash.
unit.target: Videbatur in eum dissolvi, in ictu evanescens.

unit.source: Sow’s grin stretched wider.
unit.target: Rictus Sow latius se effundit.

unit.source: He strode to the desk, yanking the broadsword from his back.
unit.target: Incedens ad mensam, gladium latum ex dorso suo extrahens.

unit.source: Inside the men’s bathroom of the Matani Import and Export Shop.
unit.target: Intra balneum virorum Tabernae Matani Import et Export.

unit.source: A figure made of thick, black liquid slipped through the crack under the door then strangely reformed in its original spot.
unit.target: Figura ex liquore denso, nigro, per fissuram sub ianua lapsa est, deinde mirabili modo in loco originali reformata est.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Ampulla Fictiōnis!

unit.source: The moment Lumian harbored malice and took out the Symphony of Hatred from the Traveler’s Bag, Lumian had used this bathroom vent as a base, using the Bottle of Fiction to set one condition: only females could enter or exit!
unit.target: Mumento quo Lumian malitiam aluit et Symphonia Odii ex Sacculo Viatoris extraxit, hoc foramine balnei ut fundamentum usus est, Ampulla Fictiōnis ad conditionem unam statuendam: solae feminae introitum aut exitum facere poterant!

unit.source: That way, innocent customers wouldn’t stumble into the dangerous Beyonder battle.
unit.target: Ita, clientes innocentes in periculosam pugnam Beyonder non inciderent.

unit.source: And Hisoka couldn’t escape without destroying the Bottle of Fiction first!
unit.target: Et Hisoka non potuit effugere, nisi prius Ampullam Fictiōnis destruxerit!

unit.source: The black, liquid figure spread toward the vent, dodging the two white beams from Lumian.
unit.target: Figura liquida nigra ad foramine diffusa est, duas radii albae a Lumiano eludens.

unit.source: Twanaku was done with dodging.
unit.target: Twanaku eludere iam destitit.

unit.source: His body swelled and warped, transforming into a monstrous giant almost three meters tall.
unit.target: Corpus eius tumuit et contortum est, in ingentem monstrum fere trium metrorum altitudinis se transformans.

unit.source: The monster’s skin turned a dull, dark shade, and a pair of curved goat horns marked with strange patterns sprouted from his head.
unit.target: Cutis monstri in obscurum et opacum colorem versa est, et par cornua caprina curvata, insignita figuris miris, ex capite eius orta sunt.

unit.source: Colossal bat wings wreathed in blue and crimson flames lashed out, releasing a stinging, sulfurous stench.
unit.target: Alae vespertilionis colossales, involutae in flammarum caerulearum et rubrarum, se protraxerunt, odorem pungentem et sulphureum emittens.

unit.source: Devil Transformation!
unit.target: Transformatio Diaboli!

unit.source: This was the signature power of a Sequence 6 Devil from the Prisoner pathway—a boost to strength, speed, defense… everything.
unit.target: Hoc erat potentia insignis Diaboli, Sequenciae VI, ex via Captivi—a incrementum ad fortitudinem, celeritatem, defensionem… omnia.

unit.source: Lumian knew his target, the one he thought was Hisoka, was on high alert, braced to dodge his Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: Lumian sciebat metam suam, illum quem putabat esse Hisoka, in alta vigilantia versari et paratum ad incantationem Harrumph eludendum esse.

unit.source: He stopped using it.
unit.target: Desiit illud uti.

unit.source: He decided against the Symphony of Hatred too.
unit.target: Decidit etiam non uti Symphonia Odii.

unit.source: The situation was different.
unit.target: Res diversa erat.

unit.source: Before, his enemy had been fueled by bloodlust in his murder attempt on Kolobo, a perfect trigger.
unit.target: Ante, hostis eius, sanguine cupidus, in conatu caedendi Kolobo inflammatus erat, perfectum incitamentum habens.

unit.source: Now, there was only a cold, emotionless focus.
unit.target: Nunc tantum erat frigida, animi carens intentio.

unit.source: With no guarantee that the Symphony of Hatred would work —
unit.target: Nullo certo spatio quod Symphonia Odii operaretur—

unit.source: or that it wouldn’t backfire—Lumian wasn’t taking that chance.
unit.target: aut quod contrarium non eveniret—Lumian non illam fortunam arripiebat.

unit.source: Instead, a crimson spear sparked into existence.
unit.target: Pro eo, hasta coccinea subito apparuit.

unit.source: From a few meters away, he hurled it at the suspected Hisoka.
unit.target: Ex paucis metris distantia, eam in suspectum Hisoka iaculatus est.

unit.source: The second the spear left his hand, Lumian vanished.
unit.target: Secundo quo hasta manum eius reliquit, Lumian evanuit.

unit.source: He couldn’t stay put.
unit.target: Non potuit manere hic.

unit.source: Possession by the Wraith, a mind‑shattering psychic blast from a Desire Apostle, some twisted desire spell—any of those were a risk!
unit.target: Possessio a Wraith, ictus psychicus mentem confractans ab Apostolo Desiderii, et aliqua incantatio perversi desiderii—quaeque ex his pericula erant!

unit.source: 647 “Inexplicable Action”
unit.target: 647 “Actio Inexplicabilis”

unit.source: In the face of the flaming spear, Twanaku’s eyes, now crimson from the Devil Transformation, reflected dancing and burning crimson flames.
unit.target: In conspectu hastae flammeae, oculi Twanaku, nunc ex transmutatione diabolica rubicundi, effulgebant flammae saltantes et ardentes rubicundae.

unit.source: He remained unfazed.
unit.target: Non perturbatus remansit.

unit.source: Instead, he conjured an aberration–a broadsword made of crimson magma and pale-blue flames.
unit.target: Potius, evocavit aberrationem – ensis lati factus ex magma rubicundo et flammis caeruleis pallidis.

unit.source: Swiftly turning, Twanaku exposed his back to the flaming spear.
unit.target: Celeriter convertens, Twanaku terga ad hastam flammeam exposuit.

unit.source: With the magma broadsword in hand, he slashed at the foe who had seemingly teleported behind him, launching an attack.
unit.target: Manu tenens ensis magmaticus, hosti qui ut videbatur post eum teleportatus, secans impetum iniit.

unit.source: The broadsword, adorned with crimson magma and pale-blue flames, sliced through the air but missed Lumian.
unit.target: Ensis, ornatus magmatis rubicundi et flammarum caerulearum pallidorum, per aerem secabat sed Lumian non contigit.

unit.source: It left only an exaggerated mark on the wall behind, a testament to its destructive force.
unit.target: Reliquit solam notam exaggeratam in pariete posteriore, testimonium vim destructoriam exhibens.

unit.source: Had it not been for the Bottle of Fiction’s protection, the bathroom wall would have been split in half.
unit.target: Nisi ob tutelam Ampullae Fictionis, paries balnei in duas partes diviseretur.

unit.source: Even so, the bottle visibly trembled, bearing some damage.
unit.target: Attamen, ampulla palam trepidabat, aliqua damna ferens.

unit.source: The nearly white flaming spear also struck Twanaku’s back, piercing a little before being halted by the elastic dark skin and sturdy flesh.
unit.target: Hasta flammea, paene alba, etiam terga Twanaku percussit, paullo penetrans antequam elasticam, obscuram cutem et robustam carnem obsisteret.

unit.source: It failed to penetrate the Devil’s body, leaving only blackened traces from the resulting inferno.
unit.target: Non penetravit corpus Diaboli, relinquens solum vestigia nigra ex igne consequenti.

unit.source: Devils, armored in thick and tough natural protection, were resistant to flames, poison, and curses to a certain extent.
unit.target: Diaboli, armati crassa et dura tutela naturali, ignibus, veneno, et maledictis ad aliquod modum resistentes erant.

unit.source: Twanaku, in his Zombie state, possessed a steel-like body that could withstand bullets and cannonballs.
unit.target: Twanaku, in statu zombie, possidebat corpus quasi chalybeum quod bullis et globis tormentariis opponi poterat.

unit.source: Lumian’s flaming spear and fireball attacks, as well as the Fire Ravens’ onslaught, posed little threat.
unit.target: Hasta flammea Lumiani et impetus sphaerarum ignium, necnon impetus Corvorum Igneorum, parum minabantur.

unit.source: Standing still, Twanaku could endure repeated attacks without suffering severe injuries.
unit.target: Stans quietus, Twanaku impetus repetitos sine gravioribus laesionibus sustinere valebat.

unit.source: Additionally, his ability to transform into a Wraith allowed him to evade explosions effortlessly.
unit.target: Praeterea, facultas sua in umbram transformandi ei permisit explosionibus facile evadere.

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku believed that, without the support of the Tarot Club, the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, and powerful demigods, he could have tortured Lumian to death.
unit.target: “Hisoka” Twanaku credidit se, sine auxilio Taroti Club, Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispipedarum, et potentium semideorum, posse Lumian ad mortem tormentare.

unit.source: Even with teleportation, spells rendering him temporarily unconscious, and mystical items, most of Lumian’s attacks were ineffective against Wraiths and Desire Apostle Beyonders.
unit.target: Etiamsi teleportatione, incantationibus eum ad tempus inconscum reddentibus, et rebus mysticis, pleraeque impetus Lumiani adversus umbras et Apostolos Desiderii Beyonders ineficaces erant.

unit.source: The Psychic Shock and Desire Detonation further restrained him, leaving him vulnerable to the assaults of Wraiths and undead creatures.
unit.target: Impactus psychicus et detonatio Desiderii eum ulterius cohibuerunt, relinquens eum vulnerabilem ad impetus umbrarum et creaturarum mortuorum.

unit.source: Having missed his strike, Twanaku noticed Lumian’s figure reappear in midair.
unit.target: Post ictum suum fallitum, Twanaku animadvertit figuram Lumiani in medio aeri iterum apparere.

unit.source: As anticipated, Lumian had chosen to teleport behind and launch an attack.
unit.target: Ut exspectatum erat, Lumian elegit se teleportare post et impetum iniisse.

unit.source: However, there was a notable change compared to previous encounters.
unit.target: Attamen, notabilis mutatio comparata cum prioribus congressionibus apparuit.

unit.source: Hovering near the ceiling and the vent, Lumian opened his mouth and emitted a harrumph.
unit.target: Iuxta laquearia et ventilum, Lumian os aperuit et exclamavit “harrumph”.

unit.source: The moment a pale-yellow light shot out, Hisoka Twanaku’s figure faded and vanished.
unit.target: Instante quo lumen pallideflavum emiit, figura “Hisoka” Twanaku evanuit.

unit.source: In Lumian’s pupils, a devilish figure materialized–dark skin, long goat horns, bat wings on its back, and no longer wielding the Sword of Lava.
unit.target: In pupillis Lumiani, figura diabolica apparuit – cutis obscura, cornua caprina longa, alae vespertilionis in dorso, nec iam Gladio Lavae utebatur.

unit.source: Swiftly, Twanaku transformed into a Wraith, leaping into Lumian’s eyes, deftly dodging the Spell of Harrumph’s attack.
unit.target: Celeriter, Twanaku in umbram se transformavit, in oculos Lumiani saliens, callide incantationem “harrumph” ictum evitans.

unit.source: Devil Transformation didn’t impede his Wraith abilities!
unit.target: Transformatio Diabolica non impedit virtutes umbrarum eius!

unit.source: Lumian’s face paled, a dark-green hue tinting his features.
unit.target: Facies Lumiani palluit, et vultus eius viridi obscuro tinctus est.

unit.source: His hands involuntarily rose, reaching for his neck, and his body plummeted to the ground.
unit.target: Manus eius inviti surrexerunt, ad collum suum tendentes, et corpus eius in terram deiectum est.

unit.source: Prepared for such a situation, Lumian didn’t resist.
unit.target: Praeparatus ad talem condicionem, Lumian non resistit.

unit.source: While he could still struggle, he didn’t halt his hands or resist the Wraith’s control.
unit.target: Quamquam adhuc pugnare poterat, manus eius non sistit neque repugnabat imperio umbrarum.

unit.source: Instead, he sank his consciousness into his right hand.
unit.target: Potius, conscientiam suam in manum dexteram immergit.

unit.source: The frenzied, bloody aura of superiority dissipated slightly, causing Twanaku to instinctively tremble.
unit.target: Aura furibunda et sanguinea superioritatis paulo evanuit, causa Twanaku instinctive tremere faciens.

unit.source: He subconsciously detached from Lumian’s body and leaped onto the sink.
unit.target: Subconscii disiunxit a corpore Lumiani et in lavacrum saliit.

unit.source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right shoulder, vanishing before crashing to the ground.
unit.target: Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro activavit, evanescens antequam in terram corruperit.

unit.source: This time, he appeared behind the motionless silver-white full-body armor.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, apparuit post loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam immobilis.

unit.source: Behind!
unit.target: Retro!

unit.source: The Pride Armor spun around abruptly, raising the broadsword of light and slashing at Lumian in the not-too-small bathroom.
unit.target: Loricata Superbia subito circumversum est, ensim lucis elevans et in Lumian, in balneo non parvi, secans.

unit.source: Lumian employed Spirit World Traversal once more, vanishing from the silver armor’s path.
unit.target: Lumian iterum Transitus Mundi Spirituum adhibuit, evanens ex via loricae argenteae.

unit.source: Within the mirror, “Hisoka” Twanaku was somewhat bewildered.
unit.target: In speculo, “Hisoka” Twanaku paulo perplectus erat.

unit.source: Why did Lumian Lee provoke his Sealed Artifact and engage in combat with it?
unit.target: Cur Lumian Lee suum Artefactum Sigillatum provocavit et cum eo pugnavit?

unit.source: Am I not his enemy target?
unit.target: Nonne ego non sum scopus hostilis eius?

unit.source: The negative effects of a Sealed Artifact?
unit.target: Effectus adversos artefacti sigillati?

unit.source: Though he didn’t understand what was going on, Twanaku sensed danger instinctively.
unit.target: Quamquam quid ibi ageretur non intellexit, Twanaku per instinctum periculum sensit.

unit.source: His Danger Premonition, along with a possible insight from Emperor Roselle–“If something shows signs of abnormality, there must be an abnormal factor hidden. Such factors often signify danger.”
unit.target: Praemonitio Periculi eius, una cum fortasse intuitu ab Imperatore Roselle – “Si quid ostendit indicia abnormalitatis, necesse est aliquem factor anormalem latere; tales factores saepe periculum significant.”

unit.source: Without hesitation, Twanaku left the sink and leaped to the bathroom door in his colossal Devil form.
unit.target: Sine mora, Twanaku lavacrum reliquit et ad ostium balnei in forma colossali Diaboli saliit.

unit.source: Conjuring a dozen or so light-blue Sulfur Fireballs, he directed them at the wooden door in unison.
unit.target: Conjurans duodecim aut aliquot sphaeras ignis sulphuris caeruleo pallido, eas in ostium ligneum simul destinavit.

unit.source: Twanaku, who had shaken the Bottle of Fiction with his sword, knew that the current seal could be broken by brute force.
unit.target: Twanaku, qui Ampullam Fictionis gladio suo concussit, scivit sigillum praesens vi brute dissolvi posse.

unit.source: There was no need to find the true exit or kill the enemy who had constructed the seal.
unit.target: Nulla necessitas erat veram exitum quaerere aut hostem, qui sigillum aedificaverat, occidere.

unit.source: For this reason, he chose to forgo teaming up with the full-body armor to assail Lumian.
unit.target: Propter hoc, constituit a coniunctione cum lorica totius corporis abstinere, ut Lumian oppugnaretur.

unit.source: He reckoned that any further delay, even if Lumian Lee were to fall on the spot, would lead to him being surrounded, facing a lethal blow with no chance of escaping alive.
