unit.target: Putabat quod ulterius mora, etiam si Lumian Lee in loco caderet, eum circumferri atque ictui letali, sine ulla spe salutis, affici posset.

unit.source: In such a scenario, killing Lumian Lee would render the effort meaningless!
unit.target: In tali condicione, interficere Lumian Lee totum conatum inanem redderet!

unit.source: Certainly, Twanaku wasn’t about to let Lumian off easily.
unit.target: Certe, Twanaku Lumian facile dimittere noluit.

unit.source: Following the Sulfur Fireball assault, he clenched his fists and spoke a word in Devil language filled with depravity and filth.
unit.target: Post impetus sphaerarum ignis sulphuris, manus suas contraxit et verbum in lingua Diaboli, sordibus ac depravatione plenum, edixit.

unit.source: “Slow!”
unit.target: “Lente!”

unit.source: This was a manifestation of the Language of Foulness, capable of stiffening and even halting the movements of targets within a seven- to eight-meter radius for approximately two seconds.
unit.target: Hoc erat manifestatio Linguae Foetidae, quae motus scoporum intra radium septem ad octo metrorum per circiter duas secundas rigere et sistendere valebat.

unit.source: Considering the bathroom’s size, this radius covered the entire area.
unit.target: Propter magnitudinem balnei, hic radius totam aream tegebat.

unit.source: Lumian’s form reappeared.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani iterum apparuit.

unit.source: Once more, he teleported behind the Pride Armor, conjuring a crimson fireball almost white in his hand.
unit.target: Iterum, se teleportavit post Loricam Superbiam, et in manu globum ignis rubicundus, fere album, conjuravit.

unit.source: Influenced by the Language of Foulness, both Lumian and the Pride Armor moved sluggishly.
unit.target: Sub influxu Linguae Foetidae, et Lumian et Lorica Superbia lente movebantur.

unit.source: One “slowly” launched a fireball, while the other struggled to turn around, as if its joints had rusted.
unit.target: Unus lente globum ignis iacit, dum alter conabatur se vertire, quasi iuncturae eius russae essent.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The Sulfur Fireballs erupted against the bathroom door.
unit.target: Sphaerae ignis sulphuris contra ostium balnei erupere coeperunt.

unit.source: A translucent, illusory membrane materialized on the bathroom’s side.
unit.target: Membrana translucida et illusoria in latere balnei apparuit.

unit.source: Like glass, it shattered inch by inch, leaving crisscrossing marks that teetered on the brink of collapse.
unit.target: Sicut vitrum, ea pollice gradatim confracta sunt, relinquentes vestigia cruciata quae ad ruinae limen tendebant.

unit.source: The wooden door appeared charred and pieced together, reminiscent of a child’s broken toy hastily glued back together.
unit.target: Ostium ligneum apparuit ustulatum et reparatum, quod instar ludi fracti pueri festinanter adligati memorabat.

unit.source: Observing this, “Hisoka” Twanaku grasped that another strike could completely shatter the seal.
unit.target: Hoc observans, “Hisoka” Twanaku intellexit alium ictum sigillum omnino confracturum esse.

unit.source: This time, he gathered seven to eight light-blue Sulfur Fireballs.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, congregavit septem ad octo sphaeras ignis sulphuris caeruleo pallido.

unit.source: On the opposite end, Lumian’s fireball finally collided with the Pride Armor’s back, assisted by the explosive waves.
unit.target: In extremo opposito, sphaera ignis Lumiani tandem in tergum Loricae Superbiae percussit, adiuta fluctibus explosivis.

unit.source: Amidst the rumbling and clanging, the silver armor stiffened.
unit.target: Inter fremitu et clangore, lorica argentea rigescit.

unit.source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right shoulder once more and teleported away from his current location.
unit.target: Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro iterum activavit et se ab currenti loco teleportavit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, the Pride Armor overcame the effects of Slow with abnormal swiftness, swiftly turning around.
unit.target: Fere simul, Lorica Superbia effectus “Lente” celeritate insolitè superavit, circumversa celeriter.

unit.source: However, it still couldn’t lock onto its target.
unit.target: Attamen, nihilominus, in scopus suos incidere non poterat.

unit.source: Twanaku felt a surge of amusement bubbling within him but maintained an unusual vigilance.
unit.target: Twanaku sensit impulsum iocis intus effluere, sed vigilentiam insolitam retinuit.

unit.source: His only wish was that the relentless bombardment would shatter the seal completely, granting him an avenue for escape.
unit.target: Unum optabat, ut indefessa bombardatio sigillum penitus confrangeret, viam sibi evadendi praebens.

unit.source: In the next moment, the Sulfur Fireballs collided with the wooden door at the bathroom entrance.
unit.target: In proximo momento, sphaerae ignis sulphuris contra ostium ligneum introitus balnei convenerunt.

unit.source: Twanaku witnessed the silver-white full-body armor squat down, driving the broadsword of light into the ground.
unit.target: Twanaku vidit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam se procumbentem, ensim lucis in terram ferientem.

unit.source: Wh— Twanaku’s pupils dilated as he instinctively readied himself to transform into a Wraith.
unit.target: Heu— pupillae Twanaku dilatatae sunt, atque se instinctive ad umbram transformandam praeparabat.

unit.source: Yet, he held back, exercising restraint.
unit.target: Attamen, se continuit, moderationem exercens.

unit.source: Aware of the potential consequences within the Warrior pathway, he understood the risk of subjecting himself to even greater harm.
unit.target: Conscius consequentiarum in via Bellatoris, intellexit periculum se ipsum etiam gravioribus laesionibus subire.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: Simultaneously with the explosion of the Sulfur Fireballs, the Sword of Dawn, embedded in the crevice in the stone tiles by the Pride Armor, disintegrated into fragments of light.
unit.target: Simul cum explosione sphaerarum ignis sulphuris, Gladius Aurorae, in fovea in laminis lapideis iuxta Loricam Superbiae insitus, in fragmenta lucis disiunctus est.

unit.source: Densely packed, they formed a flickering, violent, and sharp hurricane that swept in all directions, filled with the intent to annihilate everything.
unit.target: Densissime dispositi, conformaverunt turbam micantem, violentam, et acutam, quae in omnes partes dispersa est, proposito omnia delere.

unit.source: Hurricane of Light!
unit.target: Turbo Lucis!

unit.source: Since it couldn’t lock onto the backstabber, it opted for a wide-ranging assault!
unit.target: Cum enim in perfidum hostem incidere non poterat, oppetationem latiorem optavit!

unit.source: The sharp and terrifying storm of light enveloped Twanaku and Kolobo on the ground.
unit.target: Tempestas acuta et terribilis lucis, Twanaku et Kolobo in terra involvit.

unit.source: Lumian materialized in front of the latter, crouched down, shielding vital points.
unit.target: Lumian coram illo apparuit, genu flectens, puncta vitalia tuens.

unit.source: He faced the formidable hurricane head-on.
unit.target: Facie in facie, turbam formidabilem contendit.

unit.source: The washroom bore the brunt of the assault.
unit.target: Balneum impetus maximos tulit.

unit.source: The urinal was wrecked, and the cubicles silently collapsed, shedding a layer of bricks.
unit.target: Urinalis dirutus est, et cubicula silentio corruperunt, dimittens stratum laterum.

unit.source: As a depraved creature, Twanaku had nowhere to hide.
unit.target: Ut creatura depravata, Twanaku nusquam se abscondere poterat.

unit.source: All he could do was endure the damage, his eyes flickering with a sharp light.
unit.target: Tantum pati damna poterat, oculis eius luce acuta micantibus.

unit.source: In the radiant blades’ storm, Lumian’s figure cracked inch by inch, shattering into numerous mirror fragments.
unit.target: In tempestate laminarum radiantium, figura Lumiani pollice gradatim confracta est, in fragmenta specularia numerosa dissoluta.

unit.source: Mirror Substitution!
unit.target: Substitutio Speculi!

unit.source: With his obstruction, Kolobo avoided fatal injuries but couldn’t escape multiple bleeding wounds.
unit.target: Ob impedimentum eius, Kolobo laesiones mortiferas vitavit, sed ex plurimis vulneribus sanguinolentis evadere non potuit.

unit.source: In Camus’s office, within the beige four-story building housing the patrol team.
unit.target: In officio Camus, intra aedificium quattuor tabulatum colore beige, quod turmam vigilantium continebat.

unit.source: Crouched behind a table, Camus’s face turned pale, tinged with a dark-green hue.
unit.target: Sub mensa sedens, facies Camus palluit, et tincta colore viridi obscuro.

unit.source: It was as if a grayish-white clown laughed exaggeratedly in his eyes.
unit.target: Sicut quasi clown cineraceus in oculis eius nimis exaggeratus ridebat.

unit.source: Camus strained to ignite bolts of lightning in his eyes, piercing Sow’s mind.
unit.target: Camus studuit in oculis suis fulminum sagittas incendere, mentem Sow pertingens.

unit.source: His betraying teammate grimaced in pain, causing his broadsword to lose strength and direction, crashing into the desk and failing to hit Camus.
unit.target: Socius eius proditor, dolore contorsus, faciebat ut ensis eius vigorem et directionem amisisset, in mensam corruit et Camum non percussit.

unit.source: In that critical moment, Camus drew a silver revolver from his right hand, aiming it not at Sow but at himself.
unit.target: In illo momento critico, Camus revolver argenteum e manu dextro extraxit, non ad Sow, sed ad se ipsum destinans.

unit.source: Across the street, in a room facing Camus’s office,
unit.target: Trans viam, in conclavi coram officio Camus,

unit.source: Jenna, holding a telescope, huddled by the curtain, closely monitored Camus’s condition.
unit.target: Jenna, telescopum tenens, se ad velum congregavit, et conditionem Camus diligenter observavit.

unit.source: Seeing the other party under attack and struggling, she swiftly grabbed the loudspeaker she had prepared and brought it to her mouth.
unit.target: Videns adversarium sub impetu esse et luctari, celeriter eductorem sonorum, quem paraverat, arripuit et ad os suum attulit.

unit.source: “Camus has been attacked!
unit.target: “Camus oppugnatum est!

unit.source: “Camus has been attacked by the Rose School of Thought!
unit.target: “Camus a Schola Rosae Cogitationis oppugnatum est!

unit.source: “Camus is being attacked in his office!”
unit.target: “Camus in officio suo oppugnatur!”

unit.source: The loudspeaker’s sound reverberated through every room of the patrol team.
unit.target: Sonus eductoris sonorum per omnes cellas turmae vigilantium resonavit.

unit.source: 648 Teamwork
unit.target: 648 Collaboratio

unit.source: On the top floor of the beige building belonging to the patrol team, a middle-aged man in a thin black suit heard Jenna’s voice.
unit.target: In tabulato superiore aedificii beige, quod turmae praesidiariae pertinebat, vir mediae aetatis in tenue veste nigra vocem Jennae audivit.

unit.source: Without bothering to trace the source of the shout, he stood up abruptly and retrieved a white human skull, seemingly carved from crystal, from his hidden pocket.
unit.target: Negligens fontem clamoris indagare, subito surrexit et album calvarium humanum, quasi ex crystallo sculptum, ex sinu secreto extulit.

unit.source: The man, a mix of Intis and West Balam lineage, held the crystal skull and recited a mysterious language with a strong sense of death.
unit.target: Vir, mixtura originum Intis et West Balam, calvarium crystallinum tenuit et linguam arcanam cum grave sensu mortis recitavit.

unit.source: In the next moment, a decaying palm extended from the void in front of him.
unit.target: In proximo momento, palma putrida ex vacuitate coram eo protensa est.

unit.source: Its joints were thick, and its skin was bleeding, revealing signs of decay.
unit.target: Articulationes eius crassae erant, et cutis eius sanguine stillabat, signa corruptionis ostendens.

unit.source: The palm belonged to a corpse that looked vaguely human but, upon closer inspection, resembled a monster.
unit.target: Palma cadaveri pertinebat, quod vago modo humanum videbatur, sed propiore inspectione monstrum simile apparuit.

unit.source: Over 1.8 meters tall, its face concealed by a rusty bronze mask, and its torso composed of corpses from various species, including lions, tigers, black wolves, baboons, giant serpents, vultures, and humans themselves–all in a severe state of rot.
unit.target: Altus plus quam 1.8 metra, facies eius sub larva aenea rubiginosa abscondita, et truncus eius ex cadaveribus variorum specierum compositus, inter quos leones, tigrides, lupi nigri, babiones, serpentes ingentes, vultures, atque ipsi homines – omnes in statu severo putredinis.

unit.source: The corpse’s bronze mask flickered with dark‐red lights in its eyes as it took a step forward, arriving in Camus’s office.
unit.target: Larva aenea cadaveris in oculis suis lucibus obscuro‐rubris micabat, dum passum in ante se faciens, ad officinam Camus pervenit.

unit.source: Faced with Camus, who had a revolver in his right hand, staggering toward his forehead, the monstrous corpse removed its bronze mask.
unit.target: Obvius Camus, qui revolverum in manu dextra gerebat et ad frontem se tendens titubabat, cadaver monstrum larvam aeneam sustulit.

unit.source: Underneath the mask, there was no nose, flesh, or bones. Only two dark‐red balls of light and a mouth that occupied four‐fifths of the head.
unit.target: Sub larva neque nasus neque caro neque ossa erant. Soli duo globi lucis obscuro‐rubri et os, quod quattuor quintas capitis occupabat, extabant.

unit.source: The mouth opened wide, revealing a pitch‑black interior.
unit.target: Os late aperuit, intimum nigerrimum revelans.

unit.source: A terrifying suction force emanated from the mouth, affecting Camus’s spirit but having no effect on the documents, newspapers, and other items on the desk. It only caused Camus’s spirit to surface, as if pulled by an invisible force, about to be plunged into hell.
unit.target: Ex ore procedebat vis terribilis sugendi, quae animam Camus attigerat sed documentis, diurnis, aliisque rebus in mensa nullum effectum habebat; sola causa fuit ut anima Camus emergeret, quasi vi invisibili tractus, in inferos imminens.

unit.source: As Camus’s Spirit Body materialized, the grayish‑white clown seeped out of his flesh, revealing its complete form–a magnified, illusory poker card.
unit.target: Cum corpus spiritale Camus apparuit, scurra cinereo‑albaceus ex carne eius effluxit, totam formam suam revelans – cartam pokeram ampliatam et illusoriam.

unit.source: The poker card had no body of its own and was swiftly drawn out by the pitch‑black mouth beneath the bronze mask. Camus’s Spirit Body struggled.
unit.target: Carta poker, propria corpori vacua, celeriter extrahita est a nigro ore sub larva aenea; corpus spiritale Camus luctabatur.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Percussio!

unit.source: The poker card materialized and fell to the ground, emitting the sound of a heavy object colliding with solid bricks, but there was no metallic sound.
unit.target: Carta poker apparuit et in terram cecidit, sonum emittere obiecti gravis, qui cum lateribus solidis concurreret, sed sonus metallicus non audiebatur.

unit.source: In the Matani Import and Export Shop, the male bathroom lay in ruins.
unit.target: In Taberna Importationis et Exportationis Matani, latrina virorum in ruinis iacebat.

unit.source: The door and the wall facing the corridor crumbled into fragments, scattering for several meters, as if a storm had passed through.
unit.target: Ianua et paries, quae coridorio opposita erant, in fragmenta conciderunt, dispersa per plures metra, quasi tempestas transisset.

unit.source: The Bottle of Fiction had lost its effect.
unit.target: Ampulla Fictionis effectum suum amisit.

unit.source: Amidst the residual fragments of light and the lingering sulfur smell, Twanaku rolled out in his Devil form.
unit.target: Inter residua fragmenta lucis et odorem sulfuris manentem, Twanaku in forma Diaboli convolutus est.

unit.source: His pitch‑black skin bore hideous wounds, and his flesh seemed to evaporate.
unit.target: Cutis eius nigerrima vulnera abhorentia portabat, et caro eius quasi evanescere videbatur.

unit.source: Half of the two curved goat horns on his head were gone, and viscous black liquid flowed from the cracks.
unit.target: Dimidium duorum cornuae caprinae incurvarum super caput eius deesset, et liquidus viscosus niger ex fissuris deflabatur.

unit.source: The bat‑like wings on his back were tattered and drooping.
unit.target: Alae vespertilionis similes in dorso eius laceratae et pendent erant.

unit.source: With Twanaku’s formidable physical strength, the Hurricane of Light from the Pride Armor shouldn’t have caused such tragic and severe damage, but he was a Devil.
unit.target: Cum vi physica Twanaku formidabili, Turbo Lucis ex Armatura Superbiae non debuit tanta tragoedia et gravia damna inferre; at ille Diabolus erat.

unit.source: The Hurricane of Light possessed the unique ability to destroy evil creatures and undead beings.
unit.target: Turbo Lucis facultatem singularem habebat ad creaturas maleficas et ambulantes mortuos vincendos.

unit.source: It was like Twanaku undergoing purification while being sliced by a fragmentary blade.
unit.target: Sicut Twanaku purificationem subiret, dum gladio fragmentario concisus esset.

unit.source: What made it more potent was their collaboration.
unit.target: Quod id magis efficaciter faciebat, erat eorum collaboratio.

unit.source: Purification weakened defense and inflicted harm on the evil creature’s spirit and flesh, while the fragmentary blade utilized purification to weaken defense and cut through flesh.
unit.target: Purificatio defensionem debilitabat ac spiritum et carnem creaturae maleficae laedebat, dum gladius fragmentarius purificationem ad debilitandum defensionem et ad carnem caedendum utebatur.

unit.source: The more wounds and the deeper they were, the better the purification effect.
unit.target: Quo plura vulnera et quo profunda erant, eo melius effectus purificationis apparuit.

unit.source: Had Twanaku not resisted in his Devil form and instead transformed into a Wraith, he might have faced severe injury, teetering on the brink of death, or even elimination.
unit.target: Si Twanaku non repulisset in forma Diaboli sed in umbram se converteret, fortasse gravia vulnera passurus fuisset, in limine mortis vacillans, aut etiam exterminationem adeptus fuisset.

unit.source: The Hurricane of Light could vanquish Wraiths and injure evil spirits.
unit.target: Turbo Lucis umbras vincere et spiritus malignos laedere poterat.

unit.source: Despite being severely injured, Twanaku, still capable of combat, calmly suppressed his tyrannical and blood‑thirsty emotions.
unit.target: Quamquam graviter vulneratus, Twanaku, adhuc pugnandi facultate praeditus, tranquille affectus tyrannicos et sanguisuge reprimēns repressit.

unit.source: Realizing he had escaped the seal, he prepared to transform into a Wraith and escape through the surrounding mirrors.
unit.target: Cum intellexisset se sigillum effugisse, praeparavit ut in umbram se converteret et per specula circumiecta evaderet.

unit.source: Just as he made this decision, a sudden sense of Danger Premonition struck him.
unit.target: Statim quo hanc decisionem ceperet, repente sensus praenotionis periculi eum percussit.

unit.source: The malice came from behind, and in the shadows outside the bathroom, Franca, dressed in an Assassin suit, emerged, raising her left hand.
unit.target: Malitia a tergo venit, et in umbris extra latrinam, Franca, induta habitu sicarii, apparuit, manum sinistram attollens.

unit.source: On her left thumb, she wore an iron‑colored ring with a thick band and a surface covered in small spikes–Ring of Punishment!
unit.target: In pollice sinistro anulum ferreum gerebat, fascia crassa et superficie parvis spiculis ornatum – Anulus Poenae!

unit.source: Franca’s lake‑blue eyes flickered with lightning, moving many times faster than the fastest bullets, shooting out silently with
unit.target: Psychic Piercing!

unit.source: Hidden Blade… Why do I only sense her malice now… The severely injured Twanaku couldn’t dodge in time and suddenly heard an illusory shattering sound.
unit.target: Lamina Occulta… Cur nunc solum eius malitiam sentio… Twanaku, graviter vulneratus, tempore evadere non potuit et subito sonitum fracturam illusorium audivit.

unit.source: The shattering sound echoed from Twanaku’s Spirit Body, and intense pain flooded his mind, compelling him to raise his hands to cover his head.
unit.target: Sonus fractus ex corporibus spirituali Twanaku resonabat, et dolor intensus mentem eius inundavit, compellens eum manus tollere ad caput tegendum.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Franca swiftly took out a mirror and reflected Twanaku in his Devil form.
unit.target: Occasionem arripiente, Franca speculum celeriter extraxit et Twanaku in forma Diaboli repraesentavit.

unit.source: Black flames ignited in her left palm as she smeared it across the mirror’s surface–
unit.target: Flammae nigrae in palma sinistra eius accensae sunt, dum eam per superficiem speculi ungebat –

unit.source: Demoness’s curse!
unit.target: Maledictio Daemonissæ!

unit.source: Black flames erupted from Twanaku’s body, but nearly two‑thirds were suppressed by his flesh and blood, leaving only a portion of the colossal Devil’s Spirit Body to be incinerated.
unit.target: Flammae nigrae ex corpore Twanaku erupserunt, sed fere duas partes trium ab carne et sanguine eius repressae sunt, relinquentes tantum partem colossalis corporis spirituali Diaboli ad incinerandum.

unit.source: Being a Devil, immune to curses to a certain extent, helped Twanaku endure the Demoness’s curse better, given his already ravaged state from the Hurricane of Light.
unit.target: Quia Diabolus erat, et ad maledicta ad aliquam rationem immunis, Twanaku maledictum daemonissæ melius sustinere potuit, praesertim statu iam devastato ex Turbo Lucis.

unit.source: Finally free from the influence of Psychic Piercing, Twanaku, with his Spirit Body engulfed in black flames, transformed into a pitch‑black, viscous liquid.
unit.target: Denique, liber a vim "Psychic Piercing", Twanaku, cum corpus spiritale in flammis nigris involutum esset, in liquidum nigerrimum et viscosum transformatus est.

unit.source: These liquids seemed to originate from the darkest corners of the human heart, representing the most sinister and shadowy desires and emotions.
unit.target: Hi liquidi videbantur ex obscurissimis angulis cordis humani oriri, repraesentantes desideria et affectus sinistrissimos atque umbratissimos.

unit.source: Twanaku abandoned Wraith Form, choosing Desire Apostle’s Desire Incarnation because Demoness’s black flames targeted the Spirit Body more.
unit.target: Twanaku formam umbræ reliquit, optans incarnationem Desiderii Apostoli, quoniam flammae nigrae daemonissæ corpus spiritale magis petebant.

unit.source: Before the pitch‑black viscous liquid could fully elongate into a human figure, he fled into the nearby darkness, sensing a strong Danger Premonition in his heart.
unit.target: Priusquam liquidum nigerrimum viscosum in figuram humanam omnino extendi potuisset, fugit in tenebras proximas, sentiens fortem praenotionem periculi in corde.

unit.source: At the corridor’s entrance, Anthony Reid, donned in military‑green attire, appeared in a blind spot.
unit.target: Ad introitum coridorii, Anthony Reid, in vestitu viridi militari indutus, in angulo obscuro apparuit.

unit.source: His eyes took on a faint golden hue, transforming into vertical pupils—Psychological Invisibility!
unit.target: Oculi eius leviter fulgore aureo colorati sunt, in pupillas verticales mutantes—Invisibilitas Psychologica!

unit.source: Frenzy!
unit.target: Furor!

unit.source: Twanaku’s mind buzzed, instantly breaking free from his Desire Incarnation state. Blood‑shot eyes and livor mortis appeared on his body, emitting sulfurous blood.
unit.target: Mens Twanaku fremuit, statim ex statu incarnationis Desiderii evadens; oculi eius rubentes et livor mortis in corpore apparuerunt, sanguinem sulfurosum efferentes.

unit.source: He entered a frenzied state. Already grievously injured and subjected to Psychic Piercing and the Demoness’s curse, he was on the verge of losing control.
unit.target: In statum freneticum incidit. Iam graviter vulneratus et sub "Psychic Piercing" atque maledictione daemonissæ, ad imperium sui amittendum labebatur.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: Light‑blue sulfur fireballs pelted the surroundings, propelled by Twanaku’s wild instincts.
unit.target: Globuli ignis sulfuris caerulei circumiectos deiecerunt, impelluntur instinctibus feris Twanaku.

unit.source: Franca’s form quickly shattered into mirror fragments, while Anthony’s body sprouted grayish‑white dragon scales. He leaped toward the wall for cover.
unit.target: Forma Francae celeriter in fragmenta speculi concidit, dum corpus Antonii squamas draconis cinereo‑albaceas edidit; ille ad parietem saliens ad tegimen confugere quaesivit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: Using up Franca’s Mirror Substitution, Lumian teleported behind the frenzied Twanaku.
unit.target: Substitutione speculi Francae adhibita, Lumian post Twanaku frenetico teletransportatus est.

unit.source: Having already unleashed the accumulated spirituality and strength within him, Lumian’s spirituality surged, no longer drained.
unit.target: Iam, postquam spiritualitas atque vis in se congregatae fuerunt, spiritualitas Lumiani erexit, non amplius exhaurita.

unit.source: Enduring the scorching sulfur flames and the blast’s impact, Lumian focused on the oblivious, frenzied Twanaku. He harrumphed.
unit.target: Flammis sulfuris comburientibus ac ictu explosionis tolerans, Lumian in Twanaku frenetico intendit et 'Harrumph!' exclamavit.

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot from his nose, hitting what appeared to be Hisoka.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso eius emissi sunt, percutientes id quod videbatur esse Hisoka.

unit.source: Twanaku collapsed, and the signs of madness began to fade.
unit.target: Twanaku cecidit, et signa insanitatis evanescere coeperunt.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t allow him to reach the ground. Extending his right hand, he grabbed Twanaku by the shoulder and teleported him into the spirit world!
unit.target: Lumian eum terram attingere non sinxit; manu dextro extendens, Twanaku ab umero arripuit et eum in mundum spiritualem teletransportavit!

unit.source: In seconds, Lumian materialized at the edge of the primitive forest near Port Pylos.
unit.target: In secundis, Lumian se materializavit ad oram silvae primitivae prope Portum Pylos.

unit.source: Even during this process, he let out a harrumph. The pale‑yellow light emitted from his mouth knocked Twanaku out again, preventing him from regaining consciousness.
unit.target: Etiam in hoc processu, 'Harrumph!' exclamavit. Lumen pallidum flavum, quod de ore eius effluens erat, Twanaku iterum incoscientem fecit, ne conscientiam recipere posset.

unit.source: At that moment, a woman stood at the edge of the primitive forest. It was Hela, dressed like a black widow but not as distant as before.
unit.target: Illo momento, femina ad oram silvae primitivae stabat. Ea fuit Hela, induta ut aranea nigra, sed non tam remota quam antea.

unit.source: Observing Twanaku, no longer in his colossal Devil state but emitting a sulfuric scent, with dark patterns on his skin, Hela nodded at Lumian and said, “It should be Hisoka.”
unit.target: Observans Twanaku, iam non in statu Diaboli colossali sed odor sulfuricus egerens et cum obscuris figuris in cute, Hela Lumiani caput annuit et dixit: “Hisoka esse debet.”

unit.source: Every time Hisoka participated in the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, he only disguised himself superficially. If Hisoka’s true identity was targeted, Hela, who was responsible for providing the gathering venue and entrance method, could still recognize him.
unit.target: Quotiescumque Hisoka in Societate Investigationis Papionum Crispi‑capillatorum participabat, se tantum superficialiter celabat; si identitas eius vera petita esset, Hela, quae locum conventus atque modum ingressus procurabat, eum adhuc agnosci posset.

unit.source: “Ha!” Lumian chuckled and added a new Spell of Harrumph to Hisoka.
unit.target: “Ha!” Lumian subridens exclamavit et novum incantamentum “Harrumph” Hisokae adiunctum est.

unit.source: Hela seized his arm and chanted an incantation.
unit.target: Hela bracchium eius arripuit et incantationem recitavit.

unit.source: The two of them, along with Hisoka, vanished like pencil drawings erased by an eraser.
unit.target: Hi duo, una cum Hisoka, evanuerunt sicut delineationes graphicae quasi ab calamaro deletae.

unit.source: In the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight.
unit.target: In antiquo et dilapidato palatio Nationis Perpetuae Noctis.

unit.source: As Lumian emerged from his concealed state, he harrumphed.
unit.target: Dum Lumian ex statu suo abscondito emersit, "Harrumph!" exclamavit.

unit.source: Two beams of white light descended, and Hisoka remained unconscious.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae descenderunt, et Hisoka inconscia permanuit.

unit.source: Hela’s tone chilled as she remarked, “I’ll let you enter the same dream.”
unit.target: Vox Helae glaciei pervulgata est, dum dixit: “Te in eundem somnium introitum concedam.”

unit.source: “Thank you.” Lumian released Hisoka, reclining against a broken stone pillar.
unit.target: “Gratias.” Lumian Hisokam dimisit, reclinans contra columnam lapidea fractam.

unit.source: Moments later, his thoughts blurred until he heard Hela’s voice.
unit.target: Momentis post, cogitationes eius confundebantur, donec vocem Helae audivit.

unit.source: “It’s done.”
unit.target: “Consummatum est.”

unit.source: Lumian snapped back, gazing into the interrogation room where Hisoka sat opposite.
unit.target: Lumian cito rediit, aspectans in cellam interrogationis, ubi Hisoka adverso sedebat.

unit.source: This member of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, Twanaku Tupián, bore light‑brown skin, a blend of Northern and Southern Continent descent. His eyes gleamed flaxen, his hair dark. While not unattractive, his demeanor exuded indifference to life.
unit.target: Hoc membrum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispi‑capillatorum, Twanaku Tupián, cutem leviter fuscam, mixturam originum Continentes Septentrionis et Meridionis gerebat. Oculi eius flavos fulgebant, capilli obscuri erant; non tamen deformis, sed indifferens ad vitam habitus eius patebat.

unit.source: At the sight, Lumian’s lips curved into a smile.
unit.target: Visu illo, labia Lumiani in risum incursaverunt.

unit.source: He had sought Hela’s assistance primarily to craft an environment where he could safely unveil his plans after capturing Hisoka alive.
unit.target: Helae auxilium quaesiverat, praesertim ut ambitum pararet in quo consilia sua, post capturam viventem Hisoka, tuto detegere posset.

unit.source: Otherwise, restraining Hisoka’s resistance would have posed a significant challenge. Communicating with him would have been impossible if he remained unconscious until his demise. Destroying Hisoka’s frontal lobe would strip away frustration, pain, and resentment, making it difficult to fulfill the requirements of the Reaper ritual.
unit.target: Alioquin, repugnationem Hisokae reprimere arduum fuisset; communicatio cum eo impossibilis fuisset, si incoscientia mansisset usque ad mortem; delendo lobum frontale eius, frustratio, dolor, atque rancor removerentur, quod difficulter exsequendum ritus Reaper redderet.

unit.source: Upon spotting Lumian, Hisoka suddenly struggled, but an invisible force held him back, preventing his transformation into a Wraith.
unit.target: Lumianem animadvertens, Hisoka repente luctatus est, sed vis invisibilis eum retinuit, ne in umbram se converteret.

unit.source: This was a dream controlled by Hela.
unit.target: Hoc erat somnium a Hela moderatum.

unit.source: Hisoka calmed down and gazed at Lumian, posing the greatest question on his mind, “How did you manage to evade my Danger Premonition?”
unit.target: Hisoka quietus factus, Lumian intuens, maximam quaestionem in mente posuit: “Quomodo praenotionem periculi mei evitavisti?”

unit.source: Lumian’s smile deepened. He looked down at Hisoka and said casually, “No need for a Demon Hunter’s assistance. A sufficient distance and a Hypnotist would do the trick.”
unit.target: Risus Lumiani profundius factus est. Ad Hisoka deorsum aspexit et leviter dixit: “Non opus est auxilio venatoris daemonum; spatium satis et Hypnotista id efficere possunt.”

unit.source: 649 Conspiracy Showcase
unit.target: DCXLIX Coniurationis Ostentatio

unit.source: Sufficient distance and a Hypnotist… Hisoka repeated Lumian’s words as if he had realized something.
unit.target: Distantia sufficiens et hypnotista… Hisoka verba Luminiani repetuit, quasi aliquid intellexisset.

unit.source: Lumian stood in front of him, looking down, and questioned, “Do you think that, apart from Demon Hunters and higher-level Beyonders of the corresponding pathway, Devils mainly get killed based on chance encounters in battles?”
unit.target: Lumian coram eo stetit, oculos deorsum fixos habens, et quaesivit: "Num putas, praeter Venatores Daemonum et Beyonders gradus superiores viæ correspondentis, diaboli praecipue ex fortuito congressu in proeliis occidi?"

unit.source: Hisoka regarded Lumian with indifference and remained silent.
unit.target: Hisoka Luminianum indifferenter intuens tacitusque mansit.

unit.source: Lumian pulled up a chair and sat down, crossing his right foot over his left knee.
unit.target: Lumian sellam arripuit et consedit, pedem dextrum super genu sinistrum transponens.

unit.source: Casually, he said, “I’ve read a mysticism book about Devils.
unit.target: Levis animo inquit: "Librum mysticum de Diabolis legi.

unit.source: It’s filled with numerous cases of hunting Devils.
unit.target: Plenus est innumeris casibus venationis Diaboli.

unit.source: It’s clear that Beyonders of most pathways rely on chance encounters to kill specific Devils.
unit.target: Manifestum est quod Beyonders plurimarum semitarum casu congressionis ad occidendos certos Diaboli nituntur.

unit.source: That’s what I believed back then.
unit.target: Id credidi tunc.

unit.source: However, when I revisited the detailed description of Devil abilities, I found a contradiction.
unit.target: Tamen, cum descriptionem subtiliter de facultatibus Diaboli iterum perlegi, contradictionem inveni.

unit.source: This is how the mysticism book describes your Danger Premonition:
unit.target: Sic liber mysticus tuam Praemonitionem Periculi describit:

unit.source: Danger Premonition, also known as Malicious Perception–if an enemy can soon cause lethal harm to a Devil and takes clear action to do so, a Devil can sense the danger in advance and grasp the source.
unit.target: Praemonitionem Periculi, quae etiam Perceptio Malitiosa appellatur—si hostis mox letalem damnum Diabolo inferre valeat et consilium certum capiat, Diabolus periculum praevidebat atque eius originem agnoscere potest.

unit.source: They can target it, kill it, take revenge, or escape, but it’s impossible to know the exact details of the plan.
unit.target: Illud possunt attrahere, occidere, ulciscendi causa agere, aut effugere, sed consilii exacta singularia cognoscere non licet.

unit.source: Different Devils have different intuition ranges–from a few minutes to a day, from a few kilometers to as wide as a city.
unit.target: Diversi Diaboli diversas intuitionis ambitus habent—ab paucis minutis ad diem, ab paucis chiliometris usque ad amplitudinem urbis.

unit.source: “What’s the contradiction between this and a battle encounter?” Hisoka asked, sitting upright, cold and curious.
unit.target: "Quae discrepantia est inter hoc et congressum proelii?" Hisoka quaesivit, consedit recte, frigide et curiosus.

unit.source: “According to this description, Devils can indeed sense a battle encounter,” Lumian said with a smile.
unit.target: "Secundum hanc descriptionem, Diaboli certe congressum proelii sentire possunt," Lumian subridente inquit.

unit.source: For example, even though I only intended to have a cup of coffee today and suddenly encountered a Devil, and had no choice but to kill him.
unit.target: Exemplum gratia, quamquam hodie solum poculum caffeum sumere volui, et subito Diabolum incidisse, nullam aliam viam habui nisi eum interficere.

unit.source: For that Devil, it’s literal.
unit.target: Illi Diabolo id vere constat.

unit.source: He should have sensed that my coffee-drinking at the café would pose a fatal danger to him in advance and that it would happen, but that’s not the case in reality.
unit.target: Illi debuisset sentire quod mea in caupona caffea bibendo illi fatale periculum praepararet atque id futurum fuisset, sed in re veritate non ita fuit.

unit.source: Observing Hisoka’s thoughtful expression, Lumian clasped his hands together.
unit.target: Hisokae vultum cogitativum observans, Lumian manus suas coniunxit.

unit.source: “This means that a Devil’s Danger Premonition doesn’t stem from fate.
unit.target: Hoc significat Praemonitionem Periculi Diaboli non ex fato oriri.

unit.source: If it were a powerful Beyonder of the Monster pathway, there’s a high chance they would suddenly feel that coffee isn’t suitable today and avoid danger.
unit.target: Si Beyonder potens semitae Monstrorum esset, magna probabilitas esset ut repente sentirent caffeam hodie inaptam esse et periculum evitarent.

unit.source: But you can’t.
unit.target: Sed tu non potes.

unit.source: Since a Devil’s Danger Premonition doesn’t stem from precognition of fate, where does it stem from?
unit.target: Cum Praemonitionem Periculi Diaboli non ex praescientia fati oritur, ex quo provenit?

unit.source: Once, a high-ranking Demon enlightened me about the concept of the Abyss.
unit.target: Olim, daemon praecipuus, me de notione Abyssi erudivit.

unit.source: According to its perspective, the Abyss holds two dimensions.
unit.target: Secundum eius rationem, Abyssus duas dimensiones continet.

unit.source: The first is physical, with an entrance hidden somewhere in the real world.
unit.target: Prima est physica, cuius ingressus in aliquo loco in mundo reali occulti sit.

unit.source: The second is in the mind, with an entrance nestled deep within everyone’s hearts.
unit.target: Secunda est mentis, cum ingressus alte in cordibus omnium sit.

unit.source: Considering this insight, I believe we need to tweak the foundation of a Devil’s Danger Premonition.
unit.target: Ex hac perspicientia, opinor fundamentum Praemonitionis Periculi Diaboli emendandum esse.

unit.source: It kicks in only when an adversary has a well-defined plan capable of inflicting fatal harm on a Devil soon.
unit.target: Operatur solum cum adversarius consilium certum habeat, quo mox Diabolo letalem damnum inferre possit.

unit.source: That’s when the Devil can sense it beforehand.
unit.target: Illo tempore Diabolus id praevidere potest.

unit.source: Got it? A more distinct thought process or intent.
unit.target: Intellexisti? Ratio cogitationis aut intentio magis distincta.

unit.source: Lumian adopted the cadence of Madam Magician to taunt Hisoka, weaving the narrative of his conspiracy.
unit.target: Lumian modum Dominae Magicae ad Hisokam irridentem adoptavit, texens narrationem coniurationis suae.

unit.source: In the beginning, I probed bit by bit and investigated step by step.
unit.target: In principio, parvis parvis perscrutatus et gradatim investigavi.

unit.source: When I stumbled upon crucial information, I purposely skirted around it, leaving me in the dark about who I was dealing with and without a rough plan to handle the target.
unit.target: Cum notitiam crucem repperissem, eam deliberanter circumvagi, relinquens me in tenebris de adversario cum quo laborarem neque consilium rudimentarium habeam.

unit.source: In simpler terms, I didn’t have clear thoughts or intentions, and there was no effective plan to cause lethal harm to you anytime soon.
unit.target: Simpliciter, cogitationes vel propositi claros non habui, nec planum efficax ad te letalem damnum inferendum habebam.

unit.source: Everything was vague, chaotic, and uncommitted, filled with variation and accidents, ensuring you couldn’t naturally sense danger.
unit.target: Omnia erant vaga, confusa et insita, plena variationibus ac accidentibus, ita ut periculum naturaliter non tibi appareret.

unit.source: However, your position alerted you when I delved into the serial murder from four years ago.
unit.target: Tamen, situs tuus te monuit, cum in caedem seriem quattuor abhinc annos percontabar.

unit.source: Since then, you’ve been using a Wraith’s ability and the patrol team members under your control to keep a vigilant eye on this matter, right?
unit.target: Ex eo tempore, usus es facultate umbrae et membris turmae vigilum sub tua potestate ad hanc rem diligenter observandam, nonne?

unit.source: Hisoka listened coldly, showing no intention of responding.
unit.target: Hisoka frigide auscultavit, nullam intentionem respondendi ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and continued, “After figuring out that you were hiding in the patrol team as a Zombie Sequence Beyonder, I resisted my urges and tried my best not to dwell on such matters. When I returned to the hotel, I immediately teleported to Trier.
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Postquam intellexi te in turma vigilum latere ut Zombie Sequence Beyonder, impulsus meos retinui atque conatus sum ne de his rebus diutius remegerem. Cum ad deversorium redii, statim ad Trier me teleportavi."

unit.source: At this distance, you won’t be able to sense that I’m formulating a plan and putting it into practice.
unit.target: In hac distantia, non poteris percipere me consilium formare et in praxim ducere.

unit.source: After coming up with a preliminary plan, I went to Hidden Blade and my two other companions to discuss a detailed plan.
unit.target: Postquam consilium praeparatorium excogitavi, ad Hidden Blade et duos alios comites meos accessi ut consilium accuratum dissererem.

unit.source: It was just past 7 p.m. Trier time.
unit.target: Erat paulo post horam septimam, secundum horam Trierensem.

unit.source: The next move involved assigning tasks.
unit.target: Actio sequens officia distribuere implicabat.

unit.source: Each of us had a role to play.
unit.target: Unusquisque nostrum munus suum habebat exsequendum.

unit.source: We underwent a Hypnotist’s Hypnotism, erasing our true purpose from memory.
unit.target: Hypnotismum hypnotistae passi sumus, deleentes nostrum verum propositum ex memoria.

unit.source: Only when a Devil like you emerged would we recall the specific details.
unit.target: Solum cum Diabolus ut te apparuisset, singula recollemus.

unit.source: My mission was to use teleportation, making it seem like I left, only to return stealthily using shadow concealment.
unit.target: Missio mea erat teleportationem uti, ita ut discessus simularer, sed deinde sub umbra occultationis furtim redeundi.

unit.source: I trailed the patrol team member I interacted with, believing that I was checking if there was anything problematic with him.
unit.target: Eum membrum turmae vigilantium, cum quo colloquium habui, secutus sum, existimans me quaerere an quid in eo male esset.

unit.source: Hidden Blade’s mission was to tail me, providing necessary vigilance and support.
unit.target: Propositum Hidden Blade fuit me persequi, praebens vigilantiam et subsidium necessarium.

unit.source: If I activated the Bottle of Fiction ability, she’d preemptively don the Ring of Punishment and lie in wait outside.
unit.target: Si facultatem "Ampulla Fictio" activavissem, illa praevius Anulum Poenae indueret atque foris in insidiis iaceretur.

unit.source: The reason for her ambush eluded her until she laid eyes on you.
unit.target: Causa insidiarum eius evanuit, donec te conspexit.

unit.source: With her combat prowess and intelligence, she instinctively knew what steps to take.
unit.target: Cum sua virtute bellica et ingenio, illa scivit quae gradus sequi deberet.

unit.source: No need for me to give detailed instructions.
unit.target: Non fuit necesse mihi singula praecepta narrare.

unit.source: The Hypnotist’s mission involved using Psychological Invisibility to wander the vicinity, just aimlessly wandering.
unit.target: Missio Hypnotistae implicabat usum invisibilitatis psychologicae ad vagandum in circuitu, quasi sine meta errans.

unit.source: As for the other Demoness, her duty was to monitor the patrol team and promptly report any issues to the authorities.
unit.target: Quoad aliam Demoness, officium eius erat turmam vigilantium observare et celeriter quaelibet incommoda ad auctoritates referre.

unit.source: Before your arrival, she too was unaware of the real reason behind her actions.
unit.target: Ante adventum tuum, ea etiam causam veram factorum suorum ignorabat.

unit.source: She simply thought we had plans involving the patrol team.
unit.target: Simpliciter putabat nos consilia habere quae turmam vigilantium implicabant.

unit.source: Before the Hypnotism wore off, none of us had intentions of confronting you.
unit.target: Antequam hypnotismus evanuerit, nemo nostrum ad te congressandi consilia habebat.

unit.source: Our individual actions couldn’t pose lethal harm to you, ensuring you couldn’t foresee it.
unit.target: Actus nostri singuli tibi letalem damnum inferre non poterant, ita ut id non praevidere posses.

unit.source: This was a premeditated encounter, a clash pitting you against multiple adversaries.
unit.target: Hoc erat congressus praemeditatus, certamen in quo te contra plures adversarios collocaverunt.

unit.source: With that final sentence, Lumian suddenly heard an illusory shattering sound.
unit.target: Ex illa ultima sententia, Lumian subito sonitum fracturam illusoriae audivit.

unit.source: He sensed that his Conspirer potion had been fully digested.
unit.target: Animadvertit potionem conspiratoris eius plene digestam esse.

unit.source: He also felt Hisoka’s seemingly cold expression, vexation, and regret growing, gnawing at his heart.
unit.target: Sentivit etiam vultum Hisokae, qui videbatur frigidus, cum vexatione et paenitentia crescientibus, cor eius voratorem.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile widened. He stood up, leaned forward, and inched his head in front of Hisoka.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani latius evasit. Surgens, se inclinavit et caput suum paulum ante Hisokam protraxit.

unit.source: He looked into Hisoka’s bloodshot flaxen-colored eyes and said, “Your biggest mistake was not leaving Port Pylos ahead of time and sticking with the patrol team.
unit.target: Oculos Hisokae, rubro-coccineos et flavos, intueri voluit et dixit: "Maxima culpa tua fuit non praeire Portum Pylos tempore et cum turma vigilantium haerere.

unit.source: “Why are you so certain I won’t track you down?”
unit.target: "Cur ita certus es me te non persequi?"

unit.source: “How do you know I enjoy Fermo coffee without sugar?” Hisoka inquired instead of answering.
unit.target: "Quomodo scis me Fermo caffeam sine saccharo frui?" Hisoka rogavit, potius quam respondens.

unit.source: Sensing his intense anger and killing intent, Lumian straightened up and replied with a smile, “My sister always says that wherever you go, you leave a trace, and I have an expert at finding traces with me.
unit.target: Sensisque impetu irae et necandi propositi intensi, Lumian se recte sustulit et subridens respondit: "Soror mea semper dicit quocumque pergis vestigium relinquere, et mihi peritus ad vestigia quaerenda comitatur.

unit.source: “Heh heh, Emperor Roselle must have said something similar. You must know what it means.”
unit.target: "Heh heh, Imperator Roselle fortasse aliquid simile dixit. Scire debes quid hoc significet."

unit.source: Hisoka’s hands tightened on the chair’s armrests as he asked again, “Why were you so sure I’ll kill Kolobo?”
unit.target: Manus Hisokae in bracchiis sellae contraxerunt, dum iterum rogavit: "Cur ita certus eras me Kolobo occisurum esse?"

unit.source: Lumian replied with a sense of satisfaction, “I wasn’t certain.
unit.target: Lumian respondit cum satisfactione: "Non certus eram.

unit.source: “Didn’t I mention I had a Demoness companion monitoring the patrol team?
unit.target: Num non dixi me habere Demoness comitem, quae turmam vigilantium observaret?

unit.source: Hidden Blade and I believed that if you ultimately choose to escape, you will definitely do something to vent your murderous desires.
unit.target: Hidden Blade et ego credidimus, si tandem fugere eligeris, certe quid agere ad necandi desideria exprimenda fore.

unit.source: Otherwise, something might happen to you, considering your Devil and Prisoner pathways.
unit.target: Alioquin, quidpiam tibi evenire potest, considerando vias tuae Diaboli et Carceris.

unit.source: And since you want to kill someone, it’s either the patrol team member who traded with me or Camus who gave me the information.
unit.target: Et quoniam aliquem interficere vis, aut membrum turmae vigilantium, qui mecum commercium fecit, aut Camus, qui mihi informationem dedit, id erit.

unit.source: It’s either at the Matani Shop or in the patrol team.
unit.target: Id vel in Taberna Matani vel in turma vigilantium sit.

unit.source: At this juncture, Lumian guessed with a smile, “You took the gamble of staying in Port Pylos and the patrol team because you wanted to seize an opportunity to kill me? Under the watchful eyes of the Tarot Club and Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, finding a chance to eliminate a promising young man like me and escape unscathed can satisfy your twisted mind to the fullest extent?”
unit.target: Hoc in momentum, Lumian subridens coniectavit: "Numquid casum fecisti manendi in Portu Pylos et in turma vigilantium, quia occasionem capturam ad me interficendum petebas? Sub oculis perspicacibus Tarot Club et Societatis Simiae Crispatae Capillatae, inveniendi facultas ad exterminandum iuvenem promissum ut me atque intactus effugiendum, menti tuae perversae ad plenissimam satiationem satisfacere potest?"

unit.source: Hisoka subconsciously licked his lips.
unit.target: Hisoka subconscie labia lambuit.

unit.source: “I initially planned to bide my time, waiting for your patience to wear thin and an opportune moment to present itself. But it seems you didn’t seek the assistance of the demigods; you only reached out to Hela.
unit.target: Primum constitui tempus me tenere, exspectans ut patientia tua laboret et occasio optima apparere posset. Sed videtur te non semideorum auxilium petivisse; solum Helam vocavisti.

unit.source: I should have struck last night.”
unit.target: Nocte praeterita, me debuisse oppugnare.

unit.source: Hisoka didn’t conceal his frustration.
unit.target: Hisoka non celavit suam frustrationem.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t immediately address the topic. After a few moments of contemplation, he said,
unit.target: Lumian statim rem non attigit; post paucis momentis considerationis, dixit:

unit.source: "Waiting for an opportunity… You’re quite confident in concealing your identity. Unafraid of normal investigations,
unit.target: "Exspectans occasionem… Tu summopere confidens es in identitatis tuae celanda, nec metuens inquisitiones ordinarias,

unit.source: "Is it because the higher-ups of the patrol team allowed a Sequence 6 of the Prisoner pathway to join?"
unit.target: "Num quia superiores turmae vigilantium concesserunt ut Sequenza VI viae Prisonis adiungeretur?"

unit.source: Hisoka sealed his lips, responding with silence.
unit.target: Hisoka labia sua clausit, silentio respondens.

unit.source: "Seems there’s a significant secret lurking here.”
unit.target: "Videtur hic secretum grave latere."

unit.source: Lumian suddenly sensed a conspiracy.
unit.target: Lumian subito coniurationem sensit.

unit.source: "Is the opportunity you’re waiting for connected to this secret?"
unit.target: "Num occasio qua exspectas huic secreto coniuncta sit?"

unit.source: "Not willing to share?”
unit.target: "Nolensne communicare?"

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: "No problem."
unit.target: Nullum est.

unit.source: "Let’s discuss something else first.”
unit.target: Disputemus primo de alio argumento.

unit.source: He bent down again, looking at Hisoka.
unit.target: Iterum se inclinavit, Hisokam intuerens.

unit.source: "In this operation, I sought only Hela.
unit.target: "In hac operatiō, solum Helam quaesivi.

unit.source: Firstly, to guard against the Nois family Demons who had made contact with you.
unit.target: Primum, ut te a Daemoniis familiae Nois, qui te contigerunt, protegerem.

unit.source: Secondly, to create an environment for a quiet conversation with you.”
unit.target: Secundo, ut ambitum ad tecum tranquillum colloquium conficerem.

unit.source: At the mention of the Nois family’s Demons, Hisoka’s gaze subtly shifted.
unit.target: Ad mentionem Daemonum familiae Nois, aspectus Hisokae subtiliter immutatus est.

unit.source: "How do you know?"
unit.target: "Quomodo scis?"

unit.source: Lumian didn’t reply. The corners of his mouth curled up even more.
unit.target: Lumian non respondit; anguli oris eius etiam magis incurvati sunt.

unit.source: "I chose Hela because I wanted to capture you alive, relying on my own strength and that of my companions."
unit.target: Helam elegi, quoniam te vivum capere volui, meo atque sociorum meorum robore innixus.

unit.source: "Each of us is weaker than you, and each of us is someone you think you can easily kill."
unit.target: Unusquisque nostrum tibi infirmior est, et unumquodque putas te facile interficere posse.

unit.source: "However, as a team, through teamwork, we’ve put you in a tight spot."
unit.target: Sed, ut turma, per laborem communem, te in angusto loco contulimus.

unit.source: "You’ll descend into hell."
unit.target: In infernum descendes.

unit.source: Hisoka shattered the chair’s armrest, but he couldn’t attack Lumian.
unit.target: Hisoka bracchia sellae fregit, sed Lumianem oppugnare non potuit.

unit.source: Observing his bloodshot eyes, Lumian retrieved a golden straw hat from his Traveler’s Bag, pressed it to his chest, and bowed.
unit.target: Observans oculos eius rubros et irritatos, Lumian pileum straminis aureum ex sacculo viatoris extraxit, ad pectum illud apposuit, et inclinavit.

unit.source: "I’ll excuse myself for a moment,” he said with a smile.
unit.target: "Me paulisper excusabo," inquit subridens.

unit.source: In the next moment, Lumian left the dream.
unit.target: In proximo momento, Lumian somnium reliquit.

unit.source: Swiftly shifting his sitting position, he leaned against a broken stone pillar.
unit.target: Celeriter sedendi locum mutans, se ad columnam lapideam fractam inclinavit.

unit.source: From his Traveler’s Bag, he retrieved Gardner Martin’s Beyonder characteristic, teeth, blood, Colorful Bearded Horned Lizard’s venom, hornbeam essential oil, and other items.
unit.target: Ex sacculo viatoris, extraxit proprietatem Beyonder Gardener Martin, dentes, sanguinem, venom ex lacertula barbata cornuta variegata, oleum essentiale ex carpino, et alias res.

unit.source: He had genuinely sensed Hisoka’s fear, anger, and frustration.
unit.target: Vere sensit timorem, iram, et frustrationem Hisokae.

unit.source: Although it occurred in a dream, it was reflected in Hisoka’s brain and body, real and intense.
unit.target: Quamquam in somnio accidit, in cerebro et corpore Hisokae reflecta erat, vera et intensa.

unit.source: He was about to concoct the Reaper potion.
unit.target: Paratus erat potionem Messoris concinnare.

unit.source: 650 Reaper
unit.target: 650 Messor

unit.source: In the ancient, crumbling palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian carefully poured Gardner Martin’s blood into a measuring cylinder and added the unusually sharp, small white bone blade that emitted a cold light.
unit.target: In antiquo palatio ruente Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian sanguinem Gardner Martin diligenter in cylindrum mensuratorium effudit et adiecit lamina ossis alba parva ac acutissima, quae lumen frigide fulgebat.

unit.source: During this process, he moved swiftly, paying no attention to the bone-blade-shaped Beyonder characteristic slicing his fingers and causing blood to flow.
unit.target: Inter hoc processum, celeriter movebat, non attendens ad Beyonder formam lamina ossis habentem, qui digitos eius secabat et sanguinem effundebat.

unit.source: Instead, he ignited crimson flames, helping the wounds contract and preventing the white bone blade from entering the potion with his blood.
unit.target: Pro eo, incendit flammas coccineas, quae vulnera ad contractionem adiuvabant et vitabant ut lamina ossis albae cum sanguine eius in potionem intraret.

unit.source: The physical pain heightened Lumian’s clarity and excitement.
unit.target: Dolor corporis claritatem atque fervorem Lumiani auxit.

unit.source: He added Gardner Martin’s two teeth, the Colorful Bearded Horned Lizard’s venom, and the hornbeam essential oil into the bright red blood.
unit.target: Ad sanguinem rubrum nitidum, adiecit duo dentes Gardner Martin, venenum lacertae barbatae cornutae coloratae, atque oleum essentiale carpini.

unit.source: Bloop! Bloop! Bubbles bubbled in the blood, and the items mysteriously dissolved.
unit.target: Bloop! Bloop! Bullae in sanguine bullabant, et res mysteriose dissolutae erant.

unit.source: Soon, black iron dregs emerged from the bright-red blood, as if an iron weapon had shattered inside.
unit.target: Mox ex sanguine rubro nitido emerserunt sedimenta nigra ferri, quasi telum ferreum intus confractum esset.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the still-slumbering “Hisoka” Twanaku, picked up the measuring cylinder, and poured the liquid into his mouth.
unit.target: Lumian conspexit “Hisoka” Twanaku, qui adhuc dormiens erat, ac cylindrum mensuratorium arripuit, liquoremque in os suum effudit.

unit.source: The pungent smell of blood, the unfamiliar taste of rust, and the burning sensation instantly filled Lumian’s mouth and pierced his brain.
unit.target: Odor acri sanguinis, gustus rubiginis ignotus, atque sensus ardens statim os Lumiani impleverunt atque cerebrum eius penetraverunt.

unit.source: It felt like being caught in a chaotic war, constantly facing blades, firearms, and relentless enemy assaults.
unit.target: Videbatur quasi in bello confuso captus esse, ubi constanter adversus laminae, arma ignifera, atque incursiones hostium inexorabiles se exhiberent.

unit.source: Wounds appeared all over his body, throbbing with pain.
unit.target: Vulnera per totum corpus eius apparuerunt, dolore pulsantia.

unit.source: Son of a sow, am I being attacked by a potion? Lumian muttered, bewildered, as he found himself locked in combat with a swarm of oncoming adversaries.
unit.target: Filius porci, num potio me oppugnet? Lumian pertonitus murmuravit, dum se in pugna cum turba hostium adventantium inclusum invenit.

unit.source: Fireballs, Fire Ravens, and blazing white spears shattered, tore through, or impaled the enemies, turning them into torches that illuminated the battlefield.
unit.target: Pilae ignis, corvi igniti, et hastae albae ardentes inimicos confrangerunt, dissecaverunt aut transfixerunt, eos in faces vertentes qui campum proelii illuminabant.

unit.source: After an unknown span of time, Lumian felt his strength waning, his spiritual energy on the brink of exhaustion.
unit.target: Post ignotum tempus, Lumian sensit virtutem suam labefactari et energiam spiritualem in limine exhauritionis esse.

unit.source: The accumulated spirituality of an Ascetic had long been unleashed.
unit.target: Spiritualitas accumulata ascetica iam diutius effusa erat.

unit.source: In that moment, a colossal figure materialized before him, radiating a formidable and intimidating aura.
unit.target: Illo momento, figura colossalis coram eo apparuit, aura formidabilis atque terribilis effulgens.

unit.source: Despite Lumian’s weakening state, he sensed the colossal figure’s fear, hatred, and frustration.
unit.target: Non obstante statu debilitato Lumiani, sensit timorem, odium atque frustrationem figurae colossalis.

unit.source: He’s afraid of me…
unit.target: Mihi timet…

unit.source: Lumian realized suddenly.
unit.target: Lumian subito intellexit.

unit.source: Summoning the last shreds of his courage, he condensed a blazing white flaming spear and hurled it at the colossal figure.
unit.target: Ultimas fortitudinis particulas evocans, hastam albam ardentem concentravit et in figuram colossalem iecit.

unit.source: A blinding white flame erupted, piercing through the colossal figure’s head.
unit.target: Flamma alba caeca erupta est, caput figurae colossalis transiens.

unit.source: Rumble.
unit.target: Tonitrua.

unit.source: The giant figure exploded from within, shattering into countless fragments.
unit.target: Figura gigantea ex intus explosa est, in innumerabiles partes confracta.

unit.source: Rumble.
unit.target: Tonitrua.

unit.source: The entire battlefield crumbled.
unit.target: Totum campum proelii corruperit.

unit.source: Lumian shook off the daze and found himself in front of a crumbling ancient palace, its stone bricks weathered by time.
unit.target: Lumian stupefactus se abiecit et conspexit se ante antiquum palatium ruentem, cujus lateres lapidei tempore ducti erant.

unit.source: Hisoka Twanaku still slumbered, and Hela stood silently by his side.
unit.target: Hisoka Twanaku adhuc dormiebat, et Hela iuxta eum silentio stabat.

unit.source: Sweat dripped from Lumian’s body, bursting into crimson sparks.
unit.target: Sudor e corpore Lumiani stillabat, in scintillas coccineas erumpens.

unit.source: Eventually, the sweat returned to normal.
unit.target: Postremo, sudor ad statum suum rediit.

unit.source: Phew… Lumian let out a relieved breath.
unit.target: Phwe... Lumian animum levatum suspiravit.

unit.source: His spirituality was rapidly recovering.
unit.target: Spiritualitas eius celeriter recuperabatur.

unit.source: He had advanced to become a Reaper.
unit.target: Adcessit ut Messor fieret.

unit.source: Having completed the ritual of capturing a higher Sequence enemy alive and revealing his conspiracy, Lumian had consumed the potion and advanced to Sequence 5, a Reaper of the Hunter pathway.
unit.target: Exsecutus ritum captivandi hostem superioris Sequentiae vivum et coniurationem eius detegendi, Lumian potionem consumpsit et ad Sequentiam V, Messor in via Venatoris, provectus est.

unit.source: Compared to his previous Sequences, Reaper bestowed three additional abilities:
unit.target: Comparato sequentiarum praecedentium statu, Messor tres facultates additas praebuit:

unit.source: The first, Weakness Investigation, allowed Lumian to discern the target’s vulnerabilities and weak points in their defenses from a mystic perspective.
unit.target: Primum, Inquisitio Debilitatum, Lumiano concessit ut infirmitates et puncta debilia in defensionibus obiecti ex prospectu mystico discerneret.

unit.source: The second, Cull, could be infused into any attack to harvest the target’s life.
unit.target: Secundum, Cull, in quemlibet impetu infundi poterat ad vitam obiecti metiendam.

unit.source: Any part struck by Cull was akin to an assault on vital points and weaknesses, dealing significant damage.
unit.target: Quaecumque pars a Cull percussa comparabatur impetu in puncta vitalia et infirmitates, ingentem damnum afferens.

unit.source: If Cull hit a genuine weakness or vital point, it could deliver a fatal blow, making it challenging for the target to withstand three consecutive attacks.
unit.target: Si Cull infirmitatem aut punctum vitalem verum percuteret, ictum mortiferum inferre poterat, difficilius rei faciens ut tres impetus consecutivi obiecto sustinerentur.

unit.source: It could even inflict real damage on demigod-level creatures, provided they didn’t block or successfully evade, and refrained from using mystic defenses.
unit.target: Etiam damnum verum in creaturas ad gradum semidei inferre poterat, dummodo neque obsisterent neque feliciter evaderent, atque defensionibus mysticis non uterentur.

unit.source: The third, Precision, enabled Lumian to precisely target a predetermined location and manipulate fireballs, Fire Ravens, and other spells that had left his body.
unit.target: Tertium, Praecisio, Lumiano permisit ut locum praedeterminatum precisa mente selegeret atque pilas ignis, corvos ignitos, atque alias incantationes, quae ex corpore eius expulsa erant, manipularentur.

unit.source: He could split a colossal fireball into hundreds, striking different targets with precision, achieving effective area-of-effect damage.
unit.target: Poterat colossalem pilam igniferam in centena dividere, diversas metas cum praecisione percutiens, damnum efficax in regione afferens.

unit.source: It was a far cry from a blanket explosion, being more efficient and effective.
unit.target: Haec longe differebat ab explosioni universali, efficacior atque utilior.

unit.source: Both Cull and Precision demanded a substantial amount of spirituality, rivaling Lumian’s current usage of teleportation.
unit.target: Et Cull et Praecisio magna quantitate spiritualis exigerunt, comparantis usui teleportationis Lumiani hodiernae.

unit.source: The exception was the combination of Precision and Fire Raven, as Fire Raven could allocate a bit of spirituality and was easily manipulated.
unit.target: Exemptio erat compositio Praecisionis et Corvi Igniti, quippe quod Corvus Ignitus parvam quantitatem spiritualis distribuere posset et facile manipulabatur.

unit.source: Even with Precision, its consumption of spirituality wasn’t significant.
unit.target: Etiam cum Praecisione, eius consumptio spiritualis non gravis erat.

unit.source: Lumian also felt a significant enhancement in his spirituality.
unit.target: Lumian etiam augmentationem notabilem spiritualitatis suae sensit.

unit.source: His mind cleared, and his life force intensified.
unit.target: Mens eius claram facta est, et vis vitae eius intensificata est.

unit.source: He could compress flames to a blazing white state in an incredibly short time, merging with flaming spears and swiftly covering dozens to hundreds of meters.
unit.target: Poterat flammas in statum albus ardentem in tempore brevissimo comprimere, cum hastis igneis coalescens et celeriter per decem ad centena metra percurrens.

unit.source: Ignoring the spirituality consumption, he could travel using this method.
unit.target: Consumptione spiritualitatis negligente, hoc modo iter facere poterat.

unit.source: While Lumian’s strength, speed, and physique had improved, he was still not resilient enough to withstand a bullet with his body.
unit.target: Quamquam vis, celeritas atque habitus corporal Lumiani meliores fuerunt, nondum tamen robustus fuit ut globulum telae corpore sustineret.

unit.source: At the entrance of the mostly collapsed male bathroom in the Matani Import and Export Shop, the silver-white full-body armor burst out, wielding a light-condensed hammer in both hands.
unit.target: Ad ostium latrinae masculinae paene collapsae in Taberna Matani Importationis et Exportationis, lorica totius corporis argenteo-alba erupit, utrisque manibus malo compresso leviter condensato utebatur.

unit.source: It searched left and right but couldn’t locate its target.
unit.target: Sinistram atque dextram exploravit, sed scopum suum invenire non potuit.

unit.source: Gradually, it seemed to “calm down.”
unit.target: Gradatim videbatur se quietare.

unit.source: From a nearby shadow, Franca emerged, her eyes assessing Kolobo within the half-collapsed bathroom.
unit.target: Ex umbra proxima Franca emersit, oculis Kolobo intra latrinam semiruentem despectans.

unit.source: His life wasn’t at risk, but his injuries were significant, and he appeared weakened.
unit.target: Vita eius non in periculo erat, sed vulnera eius gravia erant, atque videbatur debilitatus.

unit.source: He’ll be Pride Armor’s next target… Franca thought quickly.
unit.target: Iste erit meta proximus Pride Armor… Franca celeriter putavit.

unit.source: Seizing the moment while Pride Armor was still on the lookout for the backstabber and hadn’t chosen a new target, she swiftly approached.
unit.target: Tempore utens, dum Pride Armor adhuc latro insidiator vigilabat et novum scopum non elegerat, illa celeriter accessit.

unit.source: Franca grabbed the motionless silver full-body armor and deftly stowed it into her Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Franca loricam totius corporis argenteam immobilis arripuit et perite in sacculo Viatoris recondidit.

unit.source: “Meet up with Jenna!” Franca called out to Anthony, positioned outside the corridor.
unit.target: “Convenite cum Jenna!” Franca Antonio, foris in corridoro collocato, exclamavit.

unit.source: In an instant, she melted into the shadows, disappearing from sight.
unit.target: In momento, umbras sibi obnubilata, ex conspectu evanescebat.

unit.source: Surveying his newfound abilities, Lumian felt a surge of delight.
unit.target: Novas facultates considerans, Lumian impetum laetitiae sensit.

unit.source: Is this Reaper…
unit.target: Hicne Messor est…

unit.source: If I were to confront Hisoka now, breaking through his defenses wouldn’t be a concern.
unit.target: Si Hisokam nunc adversarer, defensionibus eius transgredi non esset causa anxietatis.

unit.source: My craving for combat and slaughter has intensified…
unit.target: Cupiditas mea in proelium et caedem intensificata est…

unit.source: Having adapted to the changes in his body, Lumian turned to Hela and expressed his gratitude.
unit.target: Ad corporales mutationes consuetas receptus, Lumian ad Hela se vertit et gratiam suam expressit.

unit.source: “Thank you.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago.”

unit.source: Hela, not seeing any cause for gratitude, sighed and commented, “Your team’s teamwork is impressive.”
unit.target: Hela, non agnovens rationem gratiarum, suspiravit et inquit, “Operae vestrae cooperatio mirabilis est.”

unit.source: “Madame Hela, the ritual has succeeded, but I wish to enter Hisoka’s dream again and inquire about something else,” Lumian requested.
unit.target: “Domina Hela, ritus successit, sed somnium Hisokae iterum intrare atque de alio quaerere volo,” Lumian rogavit.

unit.source: Hela nodded in agreement.
unit.target: Hela consentiens annuit.

unit.source: “The ritual requires him to remain lucid.
unit.target: “Ritus exigit ut lucidum maneat.

unit.source: He might lie, but the questioning doesn’t need him to be lucid.”
unit.target: Potest mentiri, sed quaestio non requirit ut lucidum maneat.”

unit.source: As she finished speaking, Lumian suddenly closed his eyes, slumping to the ground against a dilapidated stone pillar.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian subito oculos clausit et contra columnam lapideam dilapsam in terram collapsus est.

unit.source: The corners of his mouth remained curled up, and his expression gradually turned calm.
unit.target: Anguli oris eius incurvati manserunt, et vultus eius paulatim placidus factus est.

unit.source: In the dream’s interrogation room, Lumian took a seat across from Hisoka and addressed the captive, whose malice and desire to kill were no longer concealed.
unit.target: In conclavi interrogationis somniorum, Lumian sedeo adversus Hisoka locutus est captivo, cuius malitia et occidendi desiderium amplius non celabantur.

unit.source: “Thank you for your help. I’ve become a Reaper.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago pro auxilio. Messor factus sum.”

unit.source: Hisoka, leaning forward, seemed to forget that he could attack.
unit.target: Hisoka, se inclinans, videbatur oblitus esse se pugnare posse.

unit.source: “So what if you’re a Reaper? In a duel, I’d still kill you easily!
unit.target: “Quid, si Messor sis? In duello tamen te facile interficerem!

unit.source: If you hadn’t joined forces with Hidden Blade and relied on numbers, you would have been dead!”
unit.target: Si cum Occulta Lamine non sociavisses et numeris non innixus esses, mortuus esses!

unit.source: No longer lucid, he’s finally revealing his true thoughts in the dream…
unit.target: Iam non lucidus, tandem vera cogitationes suas in somnio effert…

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and responded, “If I can create an opportunity to fight with numbers, why should I face you one-on-one?
unit.target: Lumian risu effusus respondit, “Si casum pro pugnanda cum numeris creare possim, cur te uno contra unum oppugnarem?

unit.source: My companions are also a part of my strength.”
unit.target: Comites mei quoque partem virium mearum constituunt.”

unit.source: Hisoka spoke with malice, “Do you truly trust that Hypnotist?
unit.target: Hisoka, cum malitia, dixit, “Num vere illi Hypnotistae confidas?

unit.source: “It’s very dangerous to open up your body and mind to a Hypnotist.
unit.target: “Valde periculosum est corpus et mentem ad Hypnotistam aperire.

unit.source: Aren’t you afraid that he’ll take the opportunity to leave some hidden cues that will unknowingly bring you under his control?”
unit.target: Nonne tibi timendum est ne occasionem capiat ut aliquas signa abscondita relinquat quae te nescienter sub eius imperio inducant?

unit.source: Lumian gazed at Hisoka for a moment before breaking into a smile.
unit.target: Lumian Hisokam per momentum aspexit, deinde risum efferens.

unit.source: “Perhaps that’s why I defeated you. No wonder Mad Lady said you weren’t pure enough.
unit.target: “Forsitan ideo te vicissem. Non mirum est quod Domina Mad Lady dixit te non satis purum esse.

unit.source: “Firstly, I do trust him. We’ve been through life and death together.
unit.target: “Primum, illum confido. Vita et mors simul percursus sumus.

unit.source: Secondly, I’m willing to take such a risk to kill all of you!”
unit.target: “Secundo, ad talem periculum sum promptus ut omnes interficiam!”

unit.source: Straightening up, Lumian locked eyes with Hisoka, enunciating each word, “Even if I plunge into the Abyss, even if I descend into hell, I shall witness your tragic demise!”
unit.target: Surgens, Lumian oculos cum Hisoka composuit, singula verba articulans, “Etiamsi in Abyssum demersus, etiamsi in inferos descenderim, tuam tragicam ruinationem percipiam!”

unit.source: Hisoka fell silent.
unit.target: Hisoka tacebat.

unit.source: Lumian eased back into his seat, composed himself, and casually inquired, “I learned from Devilology that a Devil requires a ritual to advance to Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Lumian ad sedem revertens, se composuit ac leviter interrogavit, “Ex Devilologia didici quod Diaboli ritus necessarius est ad Apostolum Desiderii progrediendum.

unit.source: It’s best if it’s a special serial killing ritual.
unit.target: Optimum est, si id sit ritus specialis caedum seriatim.

unit.source: However, other than the one four years ago, there’s only been one in Port Pylos recently.
unit.target: Nisi unum quod quattuor annis abhinc fuit, nuper in Portu Pylos tantum unum evenit.

unit.source: Furthermore, I’ve already killed the murderer.
unit.target: Praeterea, iam homicidam interfeci.

unit.source: How did you advance?
unit.target: Quomodo progredieris?

unit.source: “With a boon? You couldn’t have become a Desire Apostle four years ago, could you?”
unit.target: “Cum beneficio? Non potuisti quattuor annis abhinc Apostolus Desiderii fieri, an non?”

unit.source: Hisoka responded with a smile, “Just because you don’t know doesn’t mean it didn’t happen.”
unit.target: Hisoka cum risu respondit, “Quia nescis, non oportet id non accidisse.”

unit.source: Lumian’s heart stirred.
unit.target: Cor Lumiani commotum est.

unit.source: “Was one of those two pranks to cover up your advancement ritual?”
unit.target: “Fuitne unum ex illis duobus iocis ad ritum progressionis tuum celandum?”

unit.source: Lumian ventured, drawing from the scattered information he had gleaned from the peripheral members of April Fool’s.
unit.target: Lumian audacter dixit, ex informationibus distributis ab membris laterum Aprilis Stultorum perceptis.

unit.source: They were like scattered pieces of a puzzle, each offering a fragment of the truth but lacking the full picture.
unit.target: Erant quasi fragmenta dispersa aenigmatis, quae singula veritatis particulam afferebant, sed imaginem plenam deficiebant.

unit.source: The tales spoke of chaos unleashed: a disappearance of gold in the depths of Devise, and a clash between townsfolk and a primitive tribe in Tizamo Town, resulting in tragedy.
unit.target: Fabulae de chao soluto narrabant: de auro in profundis Devise evanescente, ac de congressu inter incolas et tribum primitivam in oppido Tizamo, qui tristitiam attulit.

unit.source: Lumian suspected that Hisoka’s advancement ritual had been shrouded within the chaos of Tizamo’s prank.
unit.target: Lumian suspicabatur ritum progressionis Hisoka intra chaos ioci Tizamo latitus esse.

unit.source: Hisoka’s eyes sparkled with approval, his tone paternal.
unit.target: Oculi Hisoka approbatione fulgebant, et tonus eius paternelis erat.

unit.source: “You’re quite perceptive.”
unit.target: “Es valde perspicax.”

unit.source: Lumian seized the moment to shift the conversation.
unit.target: Lumian occasionem arripuit ut sermonem mutaret.

unit.source: “What’s up with the Nois family’s Demon?”
unit.target: “Quid de daemone familiae Nois agitur?”

unit.source: He treaded cautiously, sidestepping the Celestial Worthy and the Mother Tree of Desire, for now.
unit.target: Cautus ambulavit, praeteriens “Celestem Dignum” et “Arborem Matrem Desiderii” pro tempore.

unit.source: Hisoka’s expression turned cold.
unit.target: Vultus Hisoka frigore affectus est.

unit.source: “I aimed to utilize him to acquire something and carry out a ritual to appease him repeatedly, but he only formed a connection with me.
unit.target: “Eum adhibere intendebam, ut aliquid acquireretur et ritum ad eum saepe adplacandum peragrer, sed ille solum cum me coniunctionem instituit.

unit.source: He only granted me an opportunity two years ago.”
unit.target: Ille mihi tantum occasum duos annos abhinc dedit.

unit.source: Something… Two years ago… The pranks in the gold mine city and the town of Tizamo took place after this.
unit.target: Aliquid… Duos annos abhinc… Ioci in urbe fodinarum auri et in oppido Tizamo post hoc evenere.

unit.source: One happened at the close of the preceding year, while the other unfolded at the close of last year…
unit.target: Unum finem anni praeteriti attigit, alter in fine ultimi anni evenit…

unit.source: Lumian started suspecting that these two pranks might have motives beyond concealing the advancement ritual.
unit.target: Lumian suspicari coepit hos duos iocos habere causas extra ritum progressionis celandum.

unit.source: Before he could delve deeper, Hisoka asked vehemently and frenziedly, “Why didn’t you seek the Tarot Club’s assistance this time?”
unit.target: Priusquam altius indagare posset, Hisoka vehementer et furenter quaesivit, “Cur hoc tempore auxilium Societatis Taroti non quaesivisti?”
