unit.source: Lumian arched his eyebrows and inquired with confusion, “Why does it matter to you? Even without the Tarot Club’s aid, I could have successfully dealt with you.”
unit.target: Lumian supercilia arcuit et, confusus, interrogavit, “Cur te refert? Etiamsi Societatis Taroti auxilium non haberem, te efficaciter tractare potuissem?”

unit.source: 651 An Unfulfilled Conspiracy
unit.target: 651 Coniuratio Inexpleta

unit.source: In the beige, four-story patrol team building, Camus had managed to break free from the poker card’s influence.
unit.target: In aedificio quadristorio coloris beige, in quo turma vigilium congregata erat, Camus se a potentia chartae pokerae liberare potuit.

unit.source: He discovered Sow sprawled in a pool of blood, brutally torn apart by two zombie-like undead creatures.
unit.target: Invenit Sow in stagno sanguinis iacere, crudeler ab duabus creaturis non mortuis—similibus zombis—dilaceratum.

unit.source: In neighboring rooms, another patrol team member, under Twanaku’s control, put up a stubborn resistance.
unit.target: In cellis vicinis, alius membrum turmae vigilium, sub potestate Twanaku, pertinaciter resistit.

unit.source: His comrades had already fallen victim to the relentless assault.
unit.target: Comites eius iam impetu implacabili victi erant.

unit.source: Camus, catching his breath, hadn’t anticipated stumbling upon an assassination plot within the patrol team, putting his own life at risk.
unit.target: Camus, spiritum recipiens, non exspectavit insidiam inter turma vigilium invenire, quae vitam suam in discrimen adducebat.

unit.source: His gaze fixed on Deputy Captain Reaza, a middle-aged man in a sleek black suit controlling the undead creatures.
unit.target: Oculus eius in vice capitaneum Reaza fixus erat, virum medii aetatis, veste nigra nitida indutum, qui creaturas non mortuas imperabat.

unit.source: Confused, Camus inquired, “How did Sow end up joining the Rose School of Thought?”
unit.target: Confusus, Camus quaesivit: “Quomodo Sow ad Schola Rosi Cogitationis accessit?”

unit.source: “And why are so many members under their control?”
unit.target: “Et cur tot membra sub eorum potestate sunt?”

unit.source: Despite Camus resisting the poker card’s influence, Jenna’s earlier shout lingered in his mind.
unit.target: Quamquam Camus influxui chartae pokerae repugnabat, strepitus Jennae priore in mente eius mansit.

unit.source: Reaza, surveying the scene of blood and undead, responded after a moment of contemplation, “It’s likely Twanaku’s doing.”
unit.target: Reaza, totam scenam sanguinis et creaturarum non mortuarum intuens, post momentum considerationis respondit: “Fortasse id est opera Twanaku.”

unit.source: Twanaku… Camus recalled the questions raised by Louis Berry.
unit.target: Twanaku… Camus meminit quaestionum quas a Ludovico Berry positas fuerant.

unit.source: Was Twanaku truly responsible for the serial murders four years ago?
unit.target: Numquid Twanaku vere erat culpabilis homicidiorum seriarum ante quattuor annos?

unit.source: Could he be a Devil in disguise?
unit.target: Num poterat esse diabolus sub specie?

unit.source: Frowning, Camus grumbled, “Keeping a Zombie on the team was already a significant risk.
unit.target: Frons contrita, Camus murmurat: “Tenere zombiem in turma iam periculum grave fuit—

unit.source: Just because he can show restraint doesn’t clear him from suspicion of being a Rose School of Thought member.
unit.target: non solum quod se continere possit, sed suspicio eius de membership Scholae Rosi Cogitationis non tollitur.

unit.source: He might indulge at specific times.”
unit.target: Forsitan in quibusdam temporibus indulget.”

unit.source: Reaza, with a stern demeanor, spoke in a deep voice, “We’d confirmed he defected from the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: Reaza, vultu severo, voce profunda dixit: “Comprobavimus eum ab Schola Rosi Cogitationis defectionem fuisse.

unit.source: He believes in The Fool.”
unit.target: Credebat in Fatuum.

unit.source: “The Fool, the temperance faction?” Camus asked in surprise, not expecting such a revelation.
unit.target: “Fatuus, factio temperantiae?” inquit Camus, admirans, talem revelationem non exspectans.

unit.source: In the dream’s interrogation room, housed within the ancient and crumbling palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Hisoka couldn’t contain his amusement at Lumian’s question.
unit.target: In cubiculo interrogationis somnii, quod in antiquo et corruento palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae situm erat, Hisoka iocum suum de quaestione Lumiani continere non potuit.

unit.source: “If you had sought the Tarot Club’s assistance, I could have killed you!”
unit.target: “Si auxilium Circuli Taroti petivisses, te occidere potuissem!”

unit.source: Hisoka’s laughter reverberated, and his black shadow danced on the wall, morphing into curved goat horns and colossal bat wings.
unit.target: Risus Hisoka resonavit, et umbra eius nigra in pariete saltavit, mutans se in cornua caprina incurva et alas vespertilionum ingentium.

unit.source: Lumian caught a whiff of a conspiracy and asked in confusion and curiosity, “Why do you think so?”
unit.target: Lumian odorem coniurationis apprehendit et, confusus atque curiosus, rogavit: “Cur ita putas?”

unit.source: Hisoka rose, a murderous glint materializing in his eyes.
unit.target: Hisoka surrexit, in oculis fulgore homicidali luce manifestato.

unit.source: “If you involve the Tarot Club, they’ll undoubtedly seek my aid in your investigation.”
unit.target: “Si Circulum Taroti involueris, sine dubio auxilium meum in inquisitione tua petent.”

unit.source: At this point, Hisoka’s lips curled into an unusually flamboyant smile.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Hisoka labia in risum insolite effulgentem convoluta sunt.

unit.source: No longer conscious in the dream, he revealed his innermost self.
unit.target: Iam non somnio conscius, se intimum revelavit.

unit.source: Lumian raised an eyebrow, asking, “Are you a Minor Arcana card holder?”
unit.target: Lumian supercilium attollens rogavit: “Esne possessor cartae Arcanae Minoris?”

unit.source: Hisoka shook his head, replying with a radiant smile, “I’m a member of the temperance faction, a devotee of Mr. Fool.”
unit.target: Hisoka caput movit, et respondit radianti risu: “Factionis temperantiae membrum sum, cultor Domini Fatuus.”

unit.source: The Devil burst into laughter, bowing and exclaiming, “Praise The Fool!”
unit.target: Diabolus in risum eruptus est, se flectens atque exclamans: “Lauda Fatuum!”

unit.source: Lumian, finding it absurd and amusing, instinctively analyzed the situation.
unit.target: Lumian, id absurdum atque iocosum existimans, rem instinctive examinavit.

unit.source: Hisoka is actually a member of the Rose School of Thought’s temperance faction?
unit.target: Numquid Hisoka revera est membrum factionis temperantiae Scholae Rosi Cogitationis?

unit.source: A flamboyant and malicious Devil is actually a member of the temperance faction?
unit.target: Diabolus ostentator et malignus revera est membrum factionis temperantiae?

unit.source: Logically speaking, this was clearly impossible!
unit.target: Ratione loquendo, hoc plane impossibile erat!

unit.source: Yet, in this dream crafted by Hela, unless Hisoka possessed unique abilities to deceive, lying was unlikely.
unit.target: Attamen, in hoc somnio ab Hela confecto, nisi Hisoka facultates unicas ad fallendum haberet, mendacium vix fieri poterat.

unit.source: The only plausible explanation: he had infiltrated the temperance faction through deception and deceit!
unit.target: Unica ratio plausibilis: se per dolum et fraude in factionem temperantiae infiltraverat!

unit.source: On the surface, Hisoka seemed to be a Beyonder of the Prisoner pathway, displaying a level of restraint.
unit.target: Superficialiter, Hisoka videbatur Beyonder semitae Captivi, aliquam moderationis mensuram ostendens.

unit.source: As a non-core member of the temperance faction, he might have gone unnoticed with his issues.
unit.target: Sicut membrum non nuclei factionis temperantiae, fortasse suis rebus parum notus fuit.

unit.source: Right, is this why the Matani patrol team allowed a Prisoner pathway Beyonder to join?
unit.target: Recte, num hoc est causa cur turma Matani vigilium sineret Beyonder semitae Captivi se adiungere?

unit.source: This was more than four years ago.
unit.target: Hoc erat abhinc plus quam quattuor annos.

unit.source: Back then, Hisoka was merely a Sequence 8 Lunatic of the Prisoner pathway, not yet a Mid-Sequence Beyonder.
unit.target: Tunc, Hisoka erat solum Lunaticus Sequenciae VIII semitae Captivi, nondum Beyonder medii Sequenciae.

unit.source: As a peripheral member of the temperance faction, he likely operated without much scrutiny.
unit.target: Ut membrum perifericum factionis temperantiae, probabiliter sine magna vigilantia operabatur.

unit.source: Moreover, he probably joined the temperance faction before this, when he was weaker and less noticeable.
unit.target: Praeterea, fortasse ante hoc in factionem temperantiae se iunxit, cum infirmior atque minus conspicuus esset.

unit.source: Later, he faked receiving resources from the temperance faction and the Rose School of Thought’s attack to advance.
unit.target: Postea, se simulavit subsidia accipere ex factione temperantiae et impetus Scholae Rosi Cogitationis ad proficisciendum.

unit.source: In reality, did he rely on the Mother Tree of Desire’s boons?
unit.target: Revera, num in dona Mater Arboris Desiderii innixus esset?

unit.source: Where did those resources go?
unit.target: Quo illa subsidia pervenerunt?

unit.source: Were they secretly sold or crafted into a mystical item?
unit.target: An furtim venditae aut in rem mysticam confectae erant?

unit.source: That poker card?
unit.target: Illam chartam pokerae?

unit.source: Why did he infiltrate the temperance faction and worship Mr. Fool?
unit.target: Cur se in factionem temperantiae infiltravit et Dominum Fatuum veneratus est?

unit.source: His main goal clearly isn’t resources…
unit.target: Praecipuum propositum eius manifeste non subsidia est…

unit.source: Faith in Mr. Fool…
unit.target: Fides in Dominum Fatuum…

unit.source: With this in mind, Lumian suddenly had a guess.
unit.target: Hoc mente tractato, Lumian subito coniecturam habuit.

unit.source: Hisoka’s true aim was to infiltrate the Church of The Fool through a certain pathway and have faith in Mr. Fool!
unit.target: Propositum verum Hisokae erat Ecclesiam Fatuum per certam viam infiltrare et fidem in Dominum Fatuum habere!

unit.source: This revelation came from Celestial Worthy!
unit.target: Haec revelatio venit a Caelesti Dignitate!

unit.source: Hisoka genuinely believes in the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings.
unit.target: Hisoka sincere credit in Caelestem Dignitatem Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus.

unit.source: However, that Celestial Worthy is resisting Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Attamen, illa Caelestis Dignitas contra Dominum Fatuum opponit.

unit.source: He can clearly influence the Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways…
unit.target: Clare potest influere in semitis Vatis, Discipuli, et Maraudantium…

unit.source: Hisoka used a specific technique during prayer.
unit.target: Hisoka technicam specificam in oratione usus est.

unit.source: On the surface, he seemed to be praying to Mr. Fool, but in reality, did he receive a message from that Celestial Worthy?
unit.target: Superficialiter, videbatur se Domino Fatuum orare, sed re vera, num nuntium ab illa Caelesti Dignitate accepisset?

unit.source: This way, he wouldn’t face the risk of a false premise…
unit.target: Sic non periculum falsae praemissionis subiret.

unit.source: That’s very likely… Madam Magician mentioned that if I don’t follow the procedures when praying to Mr. Fool, the response might not be from him, but from the Celestial Worthy…
unit.target: Hoc plane verisimile est… Domina Magica dixit, si praecepta non sequer, cum ad Dominum Fatuum orandum, responsum non ab eo, sed ab illa Caelesti Dignitate fieri posse.

unit.source: Why did Celestial Worthy make Hisoka do this?
unit.target: Cur Caelestis Dignitas Hisoka ita facere iussit?

unit.source: Marauder… Steal… Could It be that He intends to gradually steal Mr. Fool’s identity and faith through this method?
unit.target: Marauder… Furare… Num ita intendit ut paulatim identitatem et fidem Domini Fatuum per hanc viam subtrahat?

unit.source: When many believers genuinely believe in Mr. Fool, but they equate him as the Celestial Worthy, the Celestial Worthy becomes The Fool?
unit.target: Cum multi credentes vere in Domino Fatuum existimant eum ut Caelesti Dignitati, illa Caelestis Dignitas fit Fatuus?

unit.source: Hiss, the more I think about it, the more terrifying it becomes…
unit.target: Sibilus, quo magis cogito, eo terribilius fit…

unit.source: Hisoka can’t do it alone.
unit.target: Hisoka id solus facere non potest.

unit.source: There must be many others who share similar beliefs…
unit.target: Oportet esse multi alii qui similia credant…

unit.source: Impressive. If the Celestial Worthy usually gathers followers, the Tarot Club would wipe them out at the slightest hint.
unit.target: Impressionans. Si Caelestis Dignitas plerumque sectatores congregat, Circulus Taroti eos minimo signo delebit.

unit.source: Yet, if their followers outwardly professed faith in Mr. Fool, not only would they escape destruction, but they’d also gain protection…
unit.target: Attamen, si fautores eorum fidem in Domino Fatuum patefecerint, non solum exitum effugirent, sed etiam protectionem acquirerent…

unit.source: How devious…
unit.target: Quam dolosus…

unit.source: Lumian swiftly deduced the situation, sensing the ominous pressure from the hidden Celestial Worthy.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter rem deduxit, pressuram ominosam a celata Caelestis Dignitate sentiens.

unit.source: Once marked by Him, failure could creep in unnoticed and strike him down unexpectedly!
unit.target: Signatum ab eo receptum, defectus poterat latentissime insidiari et eum subitam deicere!

unit.source: Considering this, Lumian recalled Port Pylos and grasped Hisoka’s confidence.
unit.target: Ratione hoc conspecta, Lumian Portum Pylos recordatus est et fiduciam Hisokae comprehendit.

unit.source: He also comprehended why Hisoka had opted to remain and wait patiently.
unit.target: Item intellexit cur Hisoka manere et patienter exspectare optasset.

unit.source: Freshly arrived in the Southern Continent and stepping into Port Pylos for the first time, Lumian lacked resources, companions, and even knowledge of Dutanese.
unit.target: Recens adveniens in Continente Meridionali atque ad Portum Pylos primum ingrediens, Lumian caruit subsidiis, sodalibus, necnon cognitione Dutanicae.

unit.source: There was a high likelihood that he’d seek aid from the Tarot Club standing behind him.
unit.target: Magna probabilitas erat ut auxilium a Circulo Taroti, qui eum subsequebatur, quaereret.

unit.source: The Major Arcana card holders of the Tarot Club wouldn’t personally intervene without a clear target due to the uncertain timeframe.
unit.target: Possessores Cartarum Majorum Arcanorum Circuli Taroti non personaliter intercederent sine clarissimo obiecto propter incertum tempus.

unit.source: They would likely dispatch a Minor Arcana card holder familiar with the Southern Continent or a faction member to assist.
unit.target: Probabiliter mitterent possessorem Cartae Minorum Arcanorum, notum in Continenti Meridionali, aut membrum factionis ad auxilium.

unit.source: Under these circumstances, who better to meet the requirements than Twanaku Tupián, a Church of The Fool’s temperance faction member from Matani, well-versed in the local situation, holding the appropriate official status, and reaching Sequence 6.
unit.target: His condicione, quis melius requisita expleat quam Twanaku Tupián, membrum factionis temperantiae Ecclesiae Fatuum ex Matani, in rebus localibus peritus, officiali dignitate praeditus, et Sequenciam VI adeptus?

unit.source: In that scenario, Lumian and Hisoka would investigate Hisoka.
unit.target: In illa re, Lumian et Hisoka Hisoka investigabunt.

unit.source: The other party would gradually grasp the situation, assess potential traps and their effectiveness.
unit.target: Pars altera paulatim rem comprehenderet, insidias potentiales et earum efficacitatem examinans.

unit.source: Hisoka could then seize the opportunity for a surprise attack, assault the mind, and trigger desires!
unit.target: Hisoka ergo occasionem capere poterat ad impetum subitum, mentem oppugnare, et desideria incitare!

unit.source: Contemplating this, Lumian acknowledged that if he failed to detect Hisoka’s malice during the investigation, the chances of succumbing to Hisoka’s hands were 100%.
unit.target: Cum hoc cogitans, Lumian agnovit quod, si Hisokae malitiam durante inquisitione detegere non potuisset, casus cessionis sub manibus eius essent centum per centum.

unit.source: He’d be a spectator as the Devil faced off against Termiboros in the form of a soul fragment.
unit.target: Ille spectatorem esset, dum Diabolus contra Termiboros in forma fracti animae certaret.

unit.source: Hisoka, informed by Loki, should have made preparations to deal with the dangerous creature within the seal.
unit.target: Hisoka, a Loki informatus, praeparationes facere debuisset ut cum creatura periculosa intra sigillum ageret.

unit.source: Perhaps relying on the Nois family’s Demon or his status as a Blessed of the Mother Tree of Desire.
unit.target: Fortasse innixus Daemone familiae Nois aut statuto ut Benedictus Mater Arboris Desiderii.

unit.source: Thankfully, Madam Magician kept reminding me that a Hunter can’t rely on high-ranking individuals behind an organization for everything.
unit.target: Gratias tamen Domina Magica me monere continuabat: venatorem in omnibus rebus non posse in summis hominibus intra organizationem innixi.

unit.source: I need to hone my skills, familiarize myself with conspiracies and battles.
unit.target: Artem meam perficiendam, coniurationes et pugnas cognoscere mihi necessarium est.

unit.source: Otherwise, I might have sought guidance from the Tarot Club as soon as I arrived in Port Pyro…
unit.target: Alio modo, consilium a Circulo Taroti quaesivissem, simul ac in Portum Pyro pervenissem…

unit.source: That would have been dangerous…
unit.target: Id periculosum fuisset…

unit.source: Grande Soeur and Emperor Roselle both mentioned that the most dangerous places are often the safest.
unit.target: Grande Soeur et Imperator Roselle ambo dixerunt loca maxime periculosa saepe esse tuta.

unit.source: Now, I must add that those who seem the safest and most reliable might pose the greatest risk…
unit.target: Nunc addere debeo quod qui tuta et fide digna videntur, maximum periculum afferre possint…

unit.source: It’s not that they’re no longer trustworthy, but the enemy will exploit this sense of security.
unit.target: Non est quod iam non sint fideles, sed hostis hunc sensum securitatis abutere vult.

unit.source: Yes, Madam Magician has also emphasized that if anything seems awry with her orders and suggestions, I should ignore them.
unit.target: Ita, Domina Magica etiam extulit, si quid in mandatis et suggestionibus eius anomale videatur, id neglegendum esse.

unit.source: Quickly contacting the other Major Arcana card holders to confirm the situation is crucial.
unit.target: Celeriter alios possessores Cartarum Majorum Arcanorum contingere ad rem confirmandam necessarium est.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the flamboyant Hisoka and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian Hisoka effusi speciem intuebatur et subridet.

unit.source: “If I hadn’t received help from a special trace expert, if Hidden Blade hadn’t been more familiar with your persona, and if I hadn’t had a Psychiatrist to profile you, and ultimately failed to find any clues or direction, I would have sought the Tarot Club’s help and looked for a guide familiar with the local situation.”
unit.target: “Nisi auxilium a perito vestigandi speciali acceperer, nisi Hidden Blade de tua persona magis notus esset, et nisi Psychiatrum ad te descriptum haberem, atque denique nullas indagationis vestigia invenire potuissem, auxilium Circuli Taroti quaesivissem et ducem in rebus localibus peritum rogavero.”

unit.source: Hisoka fell into silence.
unit.target: Hisoka silentio cecidit.

unit.source: After a few moments, he spoke up, “I get everything else, but why the sudden need for a special trace expert?”
unit.target: Post paucos momenta, locutus est: “Ceterum omnia intellego, sed cur subito opus est perito vestigandi speciali?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian risit.

unit.source: “Because it’s a gift from a true god.”
unit.target: “Quia donum est a deo vero.”

unit.source: The more time Lumian spent with Ludwig, the more he felt that letting such a dangerous individual escape the Church’s control wasn’t a decision a high-ranking member of the Church of Knowledge would make.
unit.target: Quo diutius Lumian cum Ludovigo conversatus est, eo magis sensit quod relinquere tam periculosum individuum a potestate Ecclesiae non esset consilium membri altioris Ecclesiae Cognitionis.

unit.source: There had to be a revelation from the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
unit.target: Oportuit revelationem a Deo Cognitionis et Sapientiae esse.

unit.source: Certainly, Lumian couldn’t be sure.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian non potuit certo scire.

unit.source: As far as he knew, the Knowledge pathway, also known as the Reader pathway, excelled in prophecies at high Sequence.
unit.target: Quoad sciebat, via Cognitionis, etiam via Legentis appellata, in prophetia ad altissimam Sequenciam excellere solebat.

unit.source: Hisoka fell into silence for a moment before unleashing a roar, much like a wild wolf howling beneath the moon.
unit.target: Hisoka momento silentium cepit, deinde fremitum edidit, instar lupi feri sub luna ululantis.

unit.source: Lumian reviewed the entire incident, realizing that this revenge was a clash of conspiracies.
unit.target: Lumian totum casum recognovit, intellegens hanc ultio esse congressionem coniurationum.

unit.source: Unfortunately, Hisoka didn’t grasp his personality and style well enough, nor did he comprehend his companions.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Hisoka eius indolem ac modum satis bene non apprehendit, nec comites suos intellexit.

unit.source: He could only rely on the sea prayer ritual and Loki’s first death as a guide.
unit.target: Solum in ritu preces maritimae et in prima morte Loki ut ducem confidere poterat.

unit.source: Consequently, there was a deviation, shattering his expectations despite a high likelihood of success.
unit.target: Consequenter, factum est aberratio, dissipans eius exspectationes, quamquam magna probabilitas successus erat.

unit.source: Phew… Lumian exhaled and inquired, “Who were the ones causing havoc on the patrol team’s side?”
unit.target: Phew… Lumian suspiravit et rogavit: “Qui erant illi qui in parte turmae vigilium cladem intulerunt?”

unit.source: 652 “Extreme Joy Begets Sorrow”
unit.target: 652 “Extrema Laetitia Tristitiam Parit”

unit.source: Upon hearing Lumian’s question, Hisoka’s lips curved into a smile.
unit.target: Quaestionem Lumiani audita, labia Hisokae in risum curvaverunt.

unit.source: “Those are a few Fallen, under my control.”
unit.target: “Hi sunt pauci lapsi, sub mea potestate.”

unit.source: “Fallen?”
unit.target: “Lapsi?”

unit.source: Lumian could understand the literal meaning, but he didn’t grasp the situation.
unit.target: Lumian sensum litteralem intellexit, sed rem non comprehendi potuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he criticized Hisoka.
unit.target: Simul, Hisokam reprehendit.

unit.source: This is truly a dream.
unit.target: Hoc vere somnium est.

unit.source: Emotions change so quickly.
unit.target: Affectus celeriter mutantur.

unit.source: Hisoka reminisced, “A Desire Apostle can plant a seed in others’ hearts when their emotions and desires clearly fluctuate, causing corresponding problems to worsen.
unit.target: Hisoka rememoravit, “Apostolus Desiderii semen in corda aliorum inocere potest, cum eorum affectus et desideria manifeste fluctuant, causantes ut problemata correspondentia peiorentur.

unit.source: Gradually, they lose control and degenerate.”
unit.target: Gradatim, potestate sua destituuntur et degenerantur.

unit.source: “When combined with my special abilities, I can make those humans unable to escape my control and obey only me for a long period through repeated depravities.”
unit.target: “Cum meis facultatibus specialibus coniunctis, eos homines facio ut e mea potestate effugere non valeant et mihi soli diu pareant per scelera repetita.”

unit.source: It’s akin to injecting addictive psychiatric drugs, but more mystical?
unit.target: Hoc simile est infusioni medicamentorum psychotroporum addictorum, sed magis mysticum?

unit.source: Lumian searched for analogous examples from an easy-to-understand perspective.
unit.target: Lumian quaesivit exempla analogia ex perspectiva facili intellectu.

unit.source: Suddenly, he recalled Naboredisley’s description of Demons: “Demon in body, Demon in mind…”
unit.target: Subito, recoluit descriptionem Naboredisley de daemonibus: “Daemon in corpore, daemon in mente…”

unit.source: Could this be a manifestation of the Demon within the mind?
unit.target: Numquid hoc manifestatio daemonis in mente est?

unit.source: Is Hisoka’s distinctiveness reflected in this aspect?
unit.target: Num singularitas Hisoka in hoc aspectu exprimitur?

unit.source: Could it be that the individual from the temperance faction liaising with him has been tainted by his influence, causing them to withhold reporting any irregularities?
unit.target: Num fortasse persona ex factione temperantiae, quae cum eo operatur, a eius influxu corrumpitur, ita ut ne ullam irregularitatem referat?

unit.source: Lumian gazed thoughtfully at Hisoka and inquired, “Indeed, as one would expect from an Apostle of Desire, a Demon that seduces the darkness of the mind.
unit.target: Lumian cogitato vultu ad Hisokam respexit et quaesivit, “Profecto, sicut ab Apostolo Desiderii exspectatur, daemon qui tenebras mentis seducit.

unit.source: Is this a ritual for ascending to a Demon?”
unit.target: Num hic ritus est ad daemon ascendendum?”

unit.source: “Just acclimating for now,”
unit.target: “Modo solum consuescens.”

unit.source: Hisoka didn’t refute, yet he sensed the current situation was far from ideal. It felt more like a rehearsal.
unit.target: Hisoka non refutavit, sed sensit rem praesentem longe non esse idealem; magis ut exercitationis similis videbatur.

unit.source: “You seem quite assured.”
unit.target: “Videtur te esse satis certum.”

unit.source: Following the incident in Tizamo Town at year’s end, you likely ascended to a Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Post rem in oppido Tizamo ad finem anni, verisimiliter ad Apostolum Desiderii ascendisti.

unit.source: It’s only been a year, and you’re already contemplating becoming a demigod?
unit.target: Nondum enim annus oblatus est, et iam meditatus es de te fieri semideo?

unit.source: Lumian mused briefly before questioning,
unit.target: Lumian paulum meditatus, deinde quaesivit:

unit.source: “Is it because you finally appeased that Demon from the Nois family and acquired that thing?”
unit.target: “Num propterea, quod tandem illum daemonem ex familia Nois placasti et illud adeptus es?”

unit.source: Even in his reverie, Hisoka appeared hesitant to disclose this matter.
unit.target: Etiam in somnio suo, Hisoka dubitans hanc rem enarrare videbatur.

unit.source: He responded with a hint of reluctance, “Yes.”
unit.target: Responsum dedit modico reticentiae signo: “Ita.”

unit.source: Lumian refrained from provoking Hisoka for the time being, ensuring the dream didn’t end prematurely.
unit.target: Lumian interim, a Hisoka provocando abstinuit, curans ne somnium praetempore finiretur.

unit.source: He altered his question.
unit.target: Quaestionem mutavit.

unit.source: “Where is that thing?”
unit.target: “Ubi est illud?”

unit.source: When Hisoka transformed into a Devil, his attire ruptured, and nothing unusual dropped.
unit.target: Cum Hisoka in Diabolum transformatus est, vestitus eius ruptus est, nec quidquam insolitum cecidit.

unit.source: Hisoka’s countenance contorted as he responded, “I-in Tizamo Town.”
unit.target: Vultus Hisokae contortus est, et respondit, “In oppido Tizamo.”

unit.source: Concealed in his body’s hometown, Tizamo Town… If it’s significant, why doesn’t he carry it with him?
unit.target: In oppido natali corporis eius, oppido Tizamo, celatum est… Si grave est, cur illud secum non fert?

unit.source: Lumian’s curiosity about the two pranks orchestrated by Hisoka in Tizamo Town and the gold mine city, Devise, intensified.
unit.target: Curiositas Lumiani de duobus iocis Hisoka in oppido Tizamo et in urbe fodinae auri, Devise, magis ac magis augebatur.

unit.source: After a brief pause of contemplation, Lumian inquired, “You staged a prank in Devise just to pilfer a batch of gold?”
unit.target: Post breve moram meditationis, Lumian quaesivit, “Iocum in Devise fecisti ut tantum copiam auri furarer?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Hisoka affirmed.
unit.target: “Ita,” confirmavit Hisoka.

unit.source: Have you consumed too many novels like the Gold Heist? Were you in dire need of such a large sum of money back then?
unit.target: Num nimis multas novellas quales “Gold Heist” legis? Erasne tempore illo in magna pecuniae copia vehementer indigens?

unit.source: Yes, for criminals, it’s quite normal to plan an operation to snatch gold when necessary.
unit.target: Ita, criminis consuetum est operatio constituere ad aurum rapiendum, cum opus est.

unit.source: Unlike me, who relies on hunting and the gifts of villains… Just as Lumian thought it was trivial, he suddenly considered something.
unit.target: Contra me, qui in venatione et donis pravorum confido… Sicut Lumian id parvum putavit, subito aliquid meditatus est.

unit.source: Franca has been accumulating gold for future sacrifices to the Armored Shadow, Chen Tu…
unit.target: Franca aurum colligit pro futuris sacrificiis ad Umbram Loricatum, Chen Tu…

unit.source: Could Hisoka have orchestrated a prank to obtain a substantial amount of gold for a similar sacrifice?
unit.target: Num Hisoka iocum composuisse potuit ut quantam aurum pro simili sacrificio adipisceretur?

unit.source: Lumian scrutinized Hisoka and probed, “Did you offer the gold as a sacrifice to the Nois family’s Demon?”
unit.target: Lumian Hisokam diligenter examinavit et inquisivit, “Num aurum pro sacrificio ad daemonem familiae Nois obtulisti?”

unit.source: Hisoka replied nonchalantly, “In Tizamo Town.”
unit.target: Hisoka levi animo respondit: “In oppido Tizamo.”

unit.source: “What’s in Tizamo Town?” Lumian asked.
unit.target: “Quid in oppido Tizamo est?” quaesivit Lumian.

unit.source: Hisoka appeared to snap out of his daze and exclaimed with a contorted expression, “Dream Festival, Dream Festival!”
unit.target: Hisoka ex stupore evigilare videtur et, vultu contorto, exclamavit, “Festum Somniorum, Festum Somniorum!”

unit.source: His shadow surged to life, leaping onto him and shrouding him.
unit.target: Umbra eius in vitam exsurrexit, in eum saltans et eum tegens.

unit.source: Hisoka reverted to pitch-black, transforming into a viscous, repulsive, and malevolent liquid that spread swiftly in all directions, as if determined to corrupt the interrogation room, Lumian, and the entire dream.
unit.target: Hisoka in atrum purum rediit, transformatus in liquidum viscosum, abjectum, et maleficum, quod celeriter in omnes partes se diffudit, quasi ad cellam interrogationis, Lumian, et totum somnium corrumpendum destinatus.

unit.source: Lumian promptly exited the dream and observed Hisoka, who lay asleep on the ground, displaying signs of Devilification once more.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter ex somnio exiit et Hisokam observavit, qui in terra dormiens iacebat, iterum signa diabolica ostendens.

unit.source: Furthermore, he seemed somewhat translucent.
unit.target: Praeterea, paulo translucens videbatur.

unit.source: This key member of April Fool’s was teetering on the brink of losing control!
unit.target: Hic membrum praecipuus “Aprilis Stultorum” in limine imperii amittendi vacillabat!

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian materialized a longsword crafted from blazing white flames in his hand.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian gladium longum ex flammarum alborum fulgentium in manu sua evocavit.

unit.source: The Hisoka figure before him emitted a myriad of colors, with the pale-white mark on the bridge of his nose being the least conspicuous.
unit.target: Figura Hisoka ante eum innumeros colores emittens erat, cum signum pallide albo in ponte nasi eius minimum conspicuum appareret.

unit.source: Weakness Investigation!
unit.target: Investigatio infirmitatis!

unit.source: Paleness signified a vulnerability.
unit.target: Pallor vulnerabilitatem significabat.

unit.source: Lumian hoisted the flaming sword, gripping it with both hands, and thrust downward, vanishing into the pale-white hue.
unit.target: Lumian gladium flammantem, manibus utrisque prehensum, tollit atque deorsum impulit, evanescens in pallide-albo nitore.

unit.source: The Devil-like armor, resilient flesh, and steel-like bones bestowed by Zombie endured only a second before being pierced.
unit.target: Lorica Diabolica, caro robusta, et ossa ferri similia a Zombie data, solummodo tempore uno sustinuerunt antequam perforata sint.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his blazing-white flaming sword and thrust down again.
unit.target: Lumian gladium albo flammantem retraxit et iterum deorsum impulit.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: This time, it penetrated deeper.
unit.target: Hoc tempore penitus intravit.

unit.source: Lumian extracted the blazing-white flaming sword once more and leaped up, adding his weight to the downward thrust.
unit.target: Lumian gladium albo flammantem iterum extraxit et salivit, pondus suum in impetum deorsum addens.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Lumian genuflected, and the flaming sword plunged into Hisoka’s brain, transforming into scattered flames that obliterated all weakness.
unit.target: Lumian genu flectit, et gladium flammantem in cerebrum Hisokae immergit, transformans in flammas dispersas qui omnem infirmitatem exstinxerunt.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his hands and stood up.
unit.target: Lumian manus removit et surrexit.

unit.source: Hisoka’s body, displaying signs of Devilification, twitched a few times before settling.
unit.target: Corpus Hisokae, signa diaboli effectus exhibens, aliquoties concussit antequam quietum statuit.

unit.source: Adjacent to the bridge of his nose, a two-finger-wide wound appeared grotesquely abnormal.
unit.target: Juxta pontem nasi eius, vulnus duorum digitorum latum, deformiter insolutum apparuit.

unit.source: Its surface was charred and contracted, while flames surged from within.
unit.target: Superficies eius ustulata et contracta erat, cum flammas ex intimo erumpere videbantur.

unit.source: The Devil had lost his life.
unit.target: Diabolus vitam amisit.

unit.source: How resilient. He managed to withstand three strikes like this…
unit.target: Quam validus! Tale trium ictuum tolerare potuit…

unit.source: Lumian gazed at Hisoka’s corpse and silently sighed.
unit.target: Lumian cadaver Hisokae respexit et tacite suspiravit.

unit.source: In that moment, Hisoka’s corpse swiftly turned transparent, and his light brown skin gradually faded to pale-white.
unit.target: In illo momento, cadaver Hisokae celeriter transparentem factum est, et cutis eius, luce fusca, paulatim in pallidum album decoloravit.

unit.source: Wraith… Transforming into a genuine wraith after death?
unit.target: Umbra… Fieri umbra vera post mortem?

unit.source: Just as these thoughts crossed Lumian’s mind, his surroundings abruptly darkened.
unit.target: Simul cum haec cogitationes in mente Lumiani pertransibant, ambitus eius subito obscurati sunt.

unit.source: In the depths of the darkness, a serene chant resonated, soothing one’s body and mind, inducing a reluctance to do anything but lie still.
unit.target: In profundis tenebrarum, tranquillus cantus resonavit, corpus et animam leniens, et impellens ut nihil ageret nisi quiescere.

unit.source: All escape was tranquility.
unit.target: Tranquillitas erat omnis fuga.

unit.source: Hisoka’s wraith form halted its transformation, gradually gaining a tangible quality.
unit.target: Forma umbratile Hisokae transformationem sistit, paulatim qualitatem tangibilem adipiscens.

unit.source: Finally, he perished completely.
unit.target: Denique, omnino interiit.

unit.source: What a formidable adversary to vanquish… If his wraith transformation hadn’t been halted, could he have endured as a true wraith, evolving into an evil spirit in the future?
unit.target: Quam formidolosus adversarius ad superandum… Si forma umbratilis eius non esset sistita, potuissetne ut vera umbra diuturno tempore permaneret, in malum spiritum in posterum evolvens?

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Hela beside him and spoke once more, “Thank you.”
unit.target: Lumian ad Hela, quae iuxta eum stabat, respexit et denuo dixit: “Gratias tibi ago.”

unit.source: He refrained from elaborating his conversation with Hisoka, recognizing that they had spoken in the dream created by Hela. She must be aware of it.
unit.target: De colloquio suo cum Hisoka ampliando abstinuit, agnoscens eos in somnio a Hela creato locutos esse; illa id scire debet.

unit.source: “Loki is the only one left,” Hela said coldly, her gaze fixed on Hisoka’s lifeless form.
unit.target: “Loki solus restant,” inquit Hela frigide, oculis in formam inanimatam Hisokae intentis.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent for a few seconds before stating, “He can’t be resurrected more than a few times.”
unit.target: Lumian paucos momenta silentium tulit antequam dixit: “Non potest ultra paucos vicibus resurrectus esse.”

unit.source: “At most one more time,” Hela replied with certainty.
unit.target: “Maxime semel amplius,” respondit Hela certo.

unit.source: Another time… Lumian tersely acknowledged.
unit.target: Altera vice… Lumian breviter adsentivit.

unit.source: Before long, Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic manifested, blending with the remaining goat horns above his head, transforming into a whimsical and flamboyant cluster of black crystals.
unit.target: Mox proprietas Beyonder Hisokae manifestata est, cum reliqua cornua caprina supra caput eius miscebatur, in conglobatum nigriorum crystallorum lepidum ac pomposum transformans.

unit.source: Various crystals extended in all directions, sharp and crooked.
unit.target: Varii cristalli in omnes partes se extendebant, acuti et incurvi.

unit.source: Multiple illusory, translucent faces emerged from each black crystal, their expressions alternating between malevolence, pain, madness, and confusion.
unit.target: Plures facies illusoriae translucidae ex unoquoque cristallo nigro emergere coeperunt, quorum vultus inter malitiam, dolorem, insanitatem, atque confusionem alternabantur.

unit.source: A Desire Apostle Beyonder characteristic corrupted by a Wraith boon? Lumian perceived it as more corrupting and perilous than the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic from before.
unit.target: Proprietas Beyonder Apostoli Desiderii, beneficio umbratili corrupta? Lumian id percepit ut magis corrumpens et periculosus esset quam proprietas Beyonder Serialis Homicidarum antea.

unit.source: He pointed at the Beyonder characteristic and Hisoka’s lifeless body, addressing Hela, “Can I take them all?”
unit.target: Ille monstravit proprietatem Beyonder et corpus inanimatum Hisokae, ad Hela loquens: “Possumne omnia sumere?”

unit.source: “Okay,” Hela responded without objections.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Hela sine objectione.

unit.source: In an old warehouse on an abandoned dock in Port Pylos, Franca, Anthony, and Jenna had already gathered, awaiting Lumian’s return.
unit.target: In veteri horreo super derelicto pontili in Portu Pylos, Franca, Anthony, et Jenna iam convenerant, reditum Lumiani exspectantes.

unit.source: Amidst their conversation, a figure outlined itself in the sunlight streaming through a high window.
unit.target: Inter sermonem eorum, figura se delineavit in lumine solis per altam fenestram decurrente.

unit.source: It was Lumian, wearing a golden straw hat and disguised as Louis Berry.
unit.target: Erat Lumian, galeam stramineam auream indutus et se quasi Louis Berry simulans.

unit.source: Pa!
unit.target: Pa!

unit.source: Lumian tossed Hisoka’s corpse to the ground.
unit.target: Lumian cadaver Hisokae in terram proiecit.

unit.source: Immediately after, he retrieved the Beyonder characteristic from his Traveler’s Bag and placed them near the corpse without touching them.
unit.target: Statim post, proprietatem Beyonder de sacculo Viatoris sui extraxit et prope cadaver posuit, ea non tetigens.

unit.source: Only then did he smile at Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
unit.target: Tum demum Francae, Jennae, et Anthony subrisit.

unit.source: “It’s settled.”
unit.target: “Consensum est.”

unit.source: “Is it really Hisoka?” Franca couldn’t believe it could be so straightforward.
unit.target: “Num vere Hisoka?” Franca non potuit credere id tam simpliciter evenire.

unit.source: “It’s him,” Lumian briefly explained the situation. “He was overconfident and believed there’s a high chance of killing me. He chose to stay and wait for an opportunity.”
unit.target: “Is ille,” Lumian breviter exponit, “superconfidens fuit et creditur mihi interficere posse. Manere et occasionem exspectare elegit.”

unit.source: “What gave him the confidence?” Franca’s eyes widened.
unit.target: “Quid ei confidentiam dedit?” Francae oculi dilatati sunt.

unit.source: Since everyone present held a Minor Arcana card, Lumian didn’t hold anything back.
unit.target: Quoniam omnes praesentes chartas Minoris Arcanae haberent, Lumian nihil retinuit.

unit.source: He recounted the situation, omitting the most perilous details.
unit.target: Res enarravit, singularia gravissima omittens.

unit.source: “Can that really happen… Luckily, you didn’t seek guidance from the Tarot Club.” Jenna felt a lingering fear.
unit.target: “Num vere tale fieri possit… Feliciter, non a Tarot Club consilium petivisti.” Jenna diuturnum timorem sensit.

unit.source: Franca sighed and commented, “I didn’t think our collaboration alone would be sufficient.”
unit.target: Franca suspiravit et dixit, “Non putavi solam nostram collaborationem sufficere.”

unit.source: Lumian pointed at the Beyonder characteristic and stated, “There’s too much corruption, and it’s very dangerous. I plan to seek Madam Magician’s help and find a suitable Artisan to transform it into a Sealed Artifact. Everyone has the right to use it.”
unit.target: Lumian monstravit proprietatem Beyonder et dixit, “Nimis multum corruptio est, et periculosum est. Consilium habeo auxilium Dominae Magicae petendi et artificem idoneum inveniendi, ut in artifactum sigillatum transformetur. Omnes ius habent id uti.”

unit.source: Lumian found it too sinister and corrupting. It couldn’t become a mystical item with relatively mild negative effects. It could only be the kind that required sealing.
unit.target: Lumian id nimis sinistrum et corrumpentem invenit. Non potuit fieri res mystica cum effectibus relativis levibus negativis. Tantum esse potuit genus quod sigillandum esset.

unit.source: “Absolutely.” Franca was filled with anticipation as she imagined the potential abilities of a Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: “Prorsus.” Franca anticipatione plena erat, dum potentias artifacti sigillati repraesentare conabatur.

unit.source: She suddenly recalled something and quickly blurted out, “Your Pride Armor is still in my possession. Tsk, you’ve really gotten the most out of it.”
unit.target: Subito aliquid recordatus est et celeriter exclamat, “Tua Armatura Superbiae adhuc in mea possessione est. Hem, vere ex ea maximam utilitatem tulisti.”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian risit.

unit.source: “How can I face Devils without a Warrior? I’ve always wanted to use the Pride Armor, but I didn’t expect Hisoka to choose the most convenient place like the bathroom.”
unit.target: “Quomodo Diabolos occurrere possum sine Bello? Semper volui Armaturam Superbiae uti, sed non exspectavi Hisokam locum commodissimum tamquam latrinam eligere.”

unit.source: It was a confined, tight space with a certain degree of flexibility.
unit.target: Erat spatium confinatum et arctum, cum aliquo gradu flexibilitatis.

unit.source: Franca retrieved the Pride Armor from her Traveler’s Bag and placed it on the ground.
unit.target: Franca Armaturam Superbiae e sacculo Viatoris extraxit et in terram posuit.

unit.source: Suddenly, the air in the old warehouse froze.
unit.target: Subito, aer in veteri horreo congelatus est.

unit.source: The silver-white full-body armor turned to face Lumian, condensing into a broadsword of light.
unit.target: Armatura integra argenteo-alba ad Lumian versa, in gladium lucis latiorem condensata est.

unit.source: Then, it knelt on one knee and thrust into the ground.
unit.target: Deinde, in uno genu flecta, in terram impulsa est.

unit.source: Wh— Lumian’s pupils dilated as his figure abruptly faded, disappearing from his spot.
unit.target: Heu— Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt, cum figura eius repente evanuit, ab ipso loco disparens.

unit.source: The broadsword of light split open, transforming into a devastating storm that engulfed the surroundings, obliterating numerous wooden crates.
unit.target: Gladius lati lucis discidit, atque in tempestatem perniciosam transformatus est, quae circumiecta complectitus est, et multas arcas ligneas delebat.

unit.source: Wh— Franca, Jenna, and Anthony couldn’t dodge in time and were shattered into fragments by the Hurricane of Light, reflecting brilliance.
unit.target: Heu— Franca, Jenna, et Anthony non potuerunt opportune evadere et a Turbo Lucis, splendore micante, in fragmenta disiecti sunt.

unit.source: “Dammit! Isn’t this too vengeful? How much time has passed?!” Franca cursed from a corner of the warehouse.
unit.target: “Heu! Nonne hoc nimis ulterius vindictivum est? Quam tempus praeteriit?!” Franca ex angulo horrei maledicta est.

unit.source: 653 Lumian’s Choice
unit.target: 653 Electio Lumiani

unit.source: Franca emerged from the shadows, exhaling a sigh of relief as she saw the silver-white full-body armor return to silence following Lumian’s departure from the warehouse and the absence of weak targets.
unit.target: Franca ex umbris emersit, suspirum solatii exhalans dum vidit loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam in silentium redire postquam Lumian horreum reliquit et absentia debilium obiectorum constabat.

unit.source: With caution, she approached, making sure not to position herself behind the Pride Armor, finally standing face to face with it.
unit.target: Cum cautela accessit, cavens ne se post Loricam Superbiam collocaret, tandem facie ad faciem stans eam.

unit.source: The Pride Armor remained motionless.
unit.target: Lorica Superbia immota manebat.

unit.source: Franca extended her hands, barely lifting the silver-white full-body armor and tucking it back into her Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Franca manus suas extendit, vix levans loricam totius corporis argenteo-albam et eam in saccum viatoris recondidit.

unit.source: Only then did she relax and call out, “It’s all right, it’s all right.”
unit.target: Tum solum quievit et exclamavit: “Omnia bene, omnia bene.”

unit.source: Jenna emerged from a dark corner on the other side, and Anthony suddenly appeared at the warehouse door, seemingly prepared to roll and escape at any moment.
unit.target: Jenna ex obscuro angulo altera parte emersit, et Anthony subito ad ianuam horrei apparuit, quasi paratus ad volvendum et effugiendum in quolibet momento.

unit.source: In a matter of seconds, Lumian somersaulted back from a high window, eliciting a chuckle from Franca.
unit.target: In paucis momentis, Lumian ex fenestra alta se gyravit retro, provocans Francae risum.

unit.source: “Damn it, we managed Hisoka just fine, but our own Sealed Artifact nearly wiped us out. Good thing we had substitutes. Otherwise, we might have been severely injured, if not dead,” she remarked.
unit.target: “Heu, Hisokam optime gessimus, sed nostrum proprium Artefactum Sigillatum paene nos delevit. Bene evenit quod substitutos habuimus. Alioquin graviter iniuriam passuri fuimus, si non mortui,” inquit.

unit.source: Jenna commented calmly, “This could be a funny story for Ghost Face.”
unit.target: Jenna tranquille commentavit: “Haec potuit esse fabula iocosa pro Vultu Phantasma.”

unit.source: Having moved out of the market district, she now had plenty of free time.
unit.target: Mercatus regione relicta, nunc multum temporis liberi habebat.

unit.source: Though she still owed Franca a large sum of money, she had enough assets to cover it.
unit.target: Quamquam Francae adhuc magnam pecuniae quantitatem debebat, satis opum habebat ad id solvendum.

unit.source: Thus, while completing the Tarot Club mission and trying to act, she could afford to watch a play once a week, buy magazines, newspapers, and books she had longed for but couldn’t justify purchasing, and indulge in department stores and certain restaurants she had once yearned for.
unit.target: Itaque, dum missionem Taroti Club perficeret et se agere conaret, poterat ludum scaenicum semel in hebdomada spectare, commentarios, diurnos, et libros emere, quos diu desideraverat sed emere non poterat iustificare, atque in mercatis et quibusdam popinis se delectare.

unit.source: Franca let out a hollow laugh.
unit.target: Franca risum inane edidit.

unit.source: “Who would have thought this armor would hold such a grudge? Hey Lumian, what did you do to it?”
unit.target: “Quis putavit hanc loricam talem rancorem tenere? Heus Lumian, quid in eam fecisti?”

unit.source: she inquired, directing the subsequent questions to Lumian.
unit.target: inquit, quaestiones posteras ad Lumian dirigens.

unit.source: Lumian spread his hands.
unit.target: Lumian manus suas protendit.

unit.source: “Wasn’t it just a backstab?
unit.target: “Nonne solum vulneratio in tergo fuit?

unit.source: “I thought it would be fine after disengaging and waiting for it to calm down.”
unit.target: Putabam id fore in ordine postquam discesserim et eum requiescere exspectaverim.

unit.source: Franca nodded repeatedly, offering him a way out.
unit.target: Franca recurrenter annuit, ei viam exitu praebens.

unit.source: “That’s right, I thought so too.
unit.target: “Ita, et ego ita putabam.

unit.source: “It’s all because of that armor! It doesn’t feel like armor at all!”
unit.target: “Omnia propter illam loricam sunt! Minime videtur quasi lorica!”

unit.source: After a moment of pondering, Franca said, “I wonder when it will forget that you stabbed it in the back. For now, you’ll have to leave it with me.”
unit.target: Post paulum meditando, Franca dixit: “Miror quando obliviscatur quod eam in tergo percussisti. Nunc eam mecum relinquere tibi oportet.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lumian said, feeling a twinge of regret. Such a useful Sealed Artifact was temporarily unusable.
unit.target: “Recte,” dixit Lumian, paenitentiam sentiens. Talis utilis Artefactum Sigillatum pro tempore inutilis erat.

unit.source: He glanced at Hisoka’s severely damaged corpse and the seemingly unscathed Beyonder characteristic, stowing them away in his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian oculos ad corpus Hisokae graviter laesum et ad proprietatem Beyonder, quae vix laesa videbatur, vertit, ea in sacco viatoris reponens.

unit.source: He said seriously, “I hope that the operation against the Minister of Industry will commence after the Sealed Artifact is completed. Though its negative effects will undoubtedly be severe, Desire Apostle and Wraith are definitely very useful, even if they can only unleash a portion of their abilities.”
unit.target: Serio dixit: “Spero operatio contra Minister Industriae incipere postquam Artefactum Sigillatum conficietur. Etsi effectus eius negativos sine dubio graves erunt, Apostolus Desiderii et Wraith certe valde utiles sunt, etiamsi solum partem virium suarum efferre possint.”

unit.source: “Indeed,” Franca replied, filled with anticipation.
unit.target: Profecto, respondit Franca, spe plena.

unit.source: She then turned to Lumian and asked, “Hisoka is already dead. You’ve achieved your goal in the Southern Continent. Where are you going next? Are you returning to Trier with us?”
unit.target: Deinde ad Lumian conversam, rogavit: “Hisoka iam mortuus est. Finem tuum in Continente Australi attigisti. Quo nunc pergis? Ad Trier nobiscum revertieris?”

unit.source: Lumian shook his head, as if he had already considered the answer to this question.
unit.target: Lumian caput movit, quasi responsum huius quaestionis iam cogitavisset.

unit.source: “I plan to stay in the Southern Continent for a while longer.”
unit.target: “Consilium habeo manere in Continente Australi adhuc aliquantulum.”

unit.source: “Why? To investigate Tizamo Town and the Hisoka matter? That doesn’t seem necessary,” Jenna expressed her confusion.
unit.target: “Cur? Ad explorandum Oppidum Tizamo et rem Hisokae? Id non videtur necessarium,” Jenna dixit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “This is a Hunter’s paradise, don’t you think?”
unit.target: “Hic est paradisus venatorum, nonne putas?”

unit.source: Without waiting for Franca and the others to inquire further, Lumian explained seriously, “After all that has transpired, I’ve come to realize something. For a Hunter to act well and digest swiftly, they must undergo diverse experiences.”
unit.target: Ne Francae et ceterorum ulteriora quaerenda exspectans, Lumian serio explicavit: “Post omnia quae contigerunt, aliquid intellexi. Ut venator bene ageret et celeriter res intueretur, oportet variis experientiis subire.”

unit.source: What I mean is, a Hunter’s path is more straightforward compared to other paths.
unit.target: Quod dico, via venatoris simplicior est quam aliae viae.

unit.source: It’s unlike Demonesses who must navigate pleasure, pain, while contemplating abstract and philosophical concepts which are often more intricate.
unit.target: Non est simile daemonissis, quae voluptatem et dolorem peragrandi sunt, dum etiam de notionibus abstractis et philosophicis, saepissime intricatis, meditari cogunt.

unit.source: As long as a Hunter is immersed in chaos, conflict, and constant combat, they can excel.
unit.target: Quamdiu venator in chao, contentione et perpetua pugna immersus est, excellere potest.

unit.source: Combat is akin to hunting.
unit.target: Pugna venationi similis est.

unit.source: Chaos and conflict invariably breed numerous conspiracies.
unit.target: Chaos et contentio ineluctabiliter multas coniurationes gignunt.

unit.source: Provocation smoothens these conspiracies, arson secures victory in battle, and the aftermath of such incidents reaps the lives of enemies and the spoils of victory.
unit.target: Provocatio has coniurationes lenit, incendium pugnae victoriam confirmat, et eventus talium rerum vitas hostium et praemia victoriae metit.

unit.source: Observing Franca, Jenna, and Anthony’s puzzled expressions, Lumian smiled and continued, “It’s been just over half a year since I ascended from Sequence 9 to Sequence 5. Why?
unit.target: Observans vultus perplexos Francae, Jennae, et Anthoni, Lumian subridens pergebat: “Iam paulo plus quam dimidium anni sunt ex quo a Sequencia IX ad Sequencia V ascendissem. Cur?”

unit.source: “Because I’ve been either passively or actively embroiled in a series of events.”
unit.target: “Quia sive passim sive active in seriem rerum implicatus fui.”

unit.source: Through perpetual chaos, disputes, and battles, I’ve grasped the principles of performance and found opportunities to act.
unit.target: Per perpetuum chaos, contentiones et pugnas, principia efficacitatis agendi cepi atque occasiones ad agendum inveni.

unit.source: “In essence, a Hunter doesn’t engage in elaborate acting before reaching High-Sequence Beyonder status.
unit.target: In essentia, venator in agendo elaborato non versatur antequam statum Beyonder Altæ Sequenciae perveniat.

unit.source: Though I possess some insight into fate due to my characteristics, it’s also linked to determination and willpower. It’s an integral part of combat.
unit.target: Quamquam aliquam praenotionem fati propter proprietates meas habeo, illud etiam constantiae et voluntatis coniunctum est; pars integralis pugnae est.

unit.source: Hunters are forged in the crucible of blood and fire.
unit.target: Venatores in crucibili sanguinis et ignis formantur.

unit.source: They thrive amidst chaos and conflict.
unit.target: Inter chaos et contentiones florent.

unit.source: If I aim to grow stronger, I must pursue these elements.
unit.target: Si fortior fieri cupio, hos elementa persequi mihi oportet.

unit.source: The Southern Continent offers precisely that.
unit.target: Continens Australis id prorsus praebet.

unit.source: Thus, Lumian could swiftly assimilate the Reaper potion and strive to become a Sequence 5 Fate Appropriator of the Inevitability pathway.
unit.target: Itaque, Lumian celeriter potionem Messoris assimilavit et contendere coepit ut Sequenciae V Fati Appropriator viae Inevitabilitatis fieret.

unit.source: Only by truly mastering some of fate’s abilities could Lumian hope to uncover any connection between Loki and the ancient castle when he next confronted him.
unit.target: Solum vere quasdam fati facultates percipiens, Lumian sperare potuit ut ullam nexum inter Loki et antiquum castrum detegeret, cum eum proximo tempore occurret.

unit.source: According to Franca, Lumian had to locate the respawn point of an enemy capable of resurrection and camp there!
unit.target: Secundum Francam, Lumian oportuit locum renascentiae hostis, qui ad resurrectionem valere posset, invenire et ibi castra componere!

unit.source: Certainly, the path to becoming a Fate Appropriator came with its own set of risks.
unit.target: Certe, via ad Fati Appropriatorem efficiendum periculis suis insita erat.

unit.source: Lumian’s chances of encountering Circle Inhabitant Voisin Sanson would significantly rise, whether due to the convergence of an Outer Deity’s Blessed resulting from the world’s rejection or the convergence of Inevitability powers.
unit.target: Casus Lumiani ad inveniendum Incolam Circuli Voisin Sanson insigniter augebuntur, sive ex coniunctione benedictionis Deī Externi, ex rejectione mundi resultante, sive ex coniunctione potestatum Inevitabilitatis.

unit.source: Despite his yearning for such an encounter, Lumian was aware that he wasn’t prepared to face a demigod, lacking the corresponding strength.
unit.target: Non obstante desiderio huiusmodi congressus, Lumian sciebat se non paratum esse ad semideum oppugnandum, viribus necessariis carens.

unit.source: A high-level Beyonder he could hire wouldn’t be able to constantly keep an eye on him, and the moment of encounter was beyond his control.
unit.target: Unus Beyonder altus quem conducere posset non semper eum observare valebat, et momentum congressus extra eius potestatem erat.

unit.source: Franca couldn’t hide her envy upon hearing Lumian’s plan.
unit.target: Franca invidiam suam celare non potuit, cum consilium Lumiani audivit.

unit.source: If only the Demoness pathway’s acting were that straightforward.
unit.target: Utinam modus agendi in via daemonissae tam simplex esset.

unit.source: The early stages with Assassins and Instigators were relatively direct, but as time went on, it became more complicated.
unit.target: Initia cum sicariis et instigatoribus erant relative directa, sed cum tempore res magis implicatae fiebant.

unit.source: Sigh. When I first met Lumian, I was clearly at a higher Sequence and stronger than him. It’s only been half a year, but the tables have turned… Franca felt a mix of sorrow and impulsive emotions.
unit.target: Suspiro. Cum primum Lumian convenissem, plane in Sequencia superiora eram et fortior eum fuissem. Dimidium anni tantum praeterierunt, sed res mutatae sunt… Franca miscela tristitiae et impulsivae affectuum sensit.

unit.source: After sending Franca, Jenna, and Anthony back to Trier, Lumian entered Suite 7 on B3 of Hotel Orella, signaling for Lugano to leave.
unit.target: Postquam Francam, Jennae, et Anthoni ad Trier remitterit, Lumian in Suite 7, in B3 de Hotel Orella, intravit, signum dedit ut Lugano discederet.

unit.source: Then, he carefully extracted Hisoka’s lifeless body from his Traveler’s Bag and positioned it in front of Ludwig.
unit.target: Deinde, caute corpus Hisokae inanimatum ex sacco viatoris extraxit et coram Ludovico disposuit.

unit.source: With a grin, he remarked, “Here’s my end of the bargain. Is it edible?”
unit.target: Subridens, inquit, “Ecce pars mea pacti. Num edibile est?”

unit.source: Ludwig, clutching a silver child’s knife and fork with a steak laid out before him, sprung up from his seat.
unit.target: Ludwig, tenens cultrum puerile argenteum et furcam, cum frustum carnis ante se posito, ex sede surrexit.

unit.source: As he examined the torn, half‐Devil‐like, and bloodied remains, a mix of desire and hesitation played across his face.
unit.target: Dum reliquias laceratas, semi diaboli similes, et sanguinolentas perlustrebat, mixtura cupiditatis et dubitationis in facie eius effulgebat.

unit.source: It was clear he was tempted but wary.
unit.target: Manifestum erat eum temptatum esse sed cautum.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds, Ludwig delicately picked up the child’s utensils and resolved himself.
unit.target: Post plus quam decem secundas, Ludwig leniter instrumenta pueri sustulit et decrevit.

unit.source: “A tiny bit.”
unit.target: “Paululum.”

unit.source: Without awaiting Lumian’s reply, he crouched down and extended the child’s knife and fork toward Hisoka’s still open, flaxen-colored eyes.
unit.target: Nondum responsum Lumiani exspectans, se inclinavit et cultrum ac furcam pueri ad Hisokae oculos, qui adhuc patebant et flavos colore fulgebant, protendit.

unit.source: Amidst the slicing sounds, Ludwig retrieved the Devil-like eyeballs, one on the fork and the other on the knife’s tip.
unit.target: Inter sonos secandi, Ludwig extrahivit oculos diaboli similes, unum in furca et alterum in cultri acie.

unit.source: Then, he poured a glass of orange Gwadar with one hand.
unit.target: Deinde, una manu poculum Gwadar aurantiaceum effudit.

unit.source: “There’s caffeine in this. Not suitable for children,” Lumian pointed out.
unit.target: “Hic caffeine continetur. Non aptum est pueris,” Lumian innotuit.

unit.source: Ludwig glanced at the enticing beverage, then at the eyeballs on the child’s utensils, and the half‐Devil corpse on the ground. He fell silent.
unit.target: Ludwig ad potum allicientem, deinde ad oculos in instrumentis pueri et corpus semi-diabolicum in terra aspiciens, mutus fuit.

unit.source: Lumian also fell silent.
unit.target: Lumian quoque silentium obtinuit.

unit.source: After a few moments, Ludwig submerged the eyeballs into the orange-yellow Gwadar, deliberately puncturing more holes with his fork to allow the liquid to seep out.
unit.target: Post paucos momentos, Ludwig oculos in Gwadar aurantiaco-flavum immergit, furca sua deliberanter plura foramina sculpens, ut liquorem effluere sineret.

unit.source: Then, he lifted the drink and squatted beside Hisoka’s corpse, bringing the glass to a spot where some blood still dripped.
unit.target: Deinde, poculum levavit et juxta corpus Hisokae, se genu flectens, consedit, ad locum ducens ubi adhuc aliqua sanguinis gutta stillabat.

unit.source: Bloop! Bloop! Bloop! Three drops of sulfur-scented blood fell into the fading orange beverage, swiftly tinting it with the color of blood.
unit.target: Bloop! Bloop! Bloop! Tres guttae sanguinis, sulphure odorantes, in potionem aurantiacum evanidantem ceciderunt, celeriter eam sanguinis colore tinctae.

unit.source: Ludwig swirled the liquid in the glass and consumed it.
unit.target: Ludwig liquorem in poculo circumvolvit et consumpsit.

unit.source: Lumian observed as Ludwig finished his drink, noting a clear boost in energy.
unit.target: Lumian observavit dum Ludwig potionem finivit, animadvertens energiam clarissime augeri.

unit.source: Curious, he inquired, “What’s the effect of this?”
unit.target: Curiosus, interrogavit: “Quid hoc efficit?”

unit.source: Ludwig licked his lips and responded, “Permanently enhances my spirituality, allowing me to keenly sense the aura of the Abyss. I can also command a few lower-level undead creatures.”
unit.target: Ludwig labia sua lambuit et respondit: “Spiritualitatem meam permanentiter auget, mihi permittens aurem Abyssi acutissime sentire; etiam paucos creaturas mortuorum inferiorum imperare possum.”

unit.source: “Only the first glass has this effect. Subsequent drinks of a similar nature can only temporarily heighten my perception and restore some spirituality.”
unit.target: “Sola prima poculi hoc effectum habet. Subsequentia pocula similis naturae solum temporarie perceptionem meam augeant atque aliquam spiritualitatem restituant.”

unit.source: Ludwig’s tone carried a maturity as he spoke on such matters.
unit.target: Tonus Ludovici, cum de his rebus loqueretur, maturitatem ostendebat.

unit.source: Not bad… but only you would dare to consume such a messy thing… Lumian criticized inwardly.
unit.target: Non male… sed solum tu auderes talem sordidam rem consumere… Lumian in corde reprehendit.

unit.source: He stowed away Hisoka’s remains and retreated to his bedroom, initiating a letter to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Reliquias Hisokae reponens et se in cubiculum recepit, epistolam ad Dominam Magician scribere coepit.

unit.source: The focus was on reporting Hisoka’s apparent identity, his speculations, and the issues with Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Intentio erat de identitate apparenti Hisokae, eius conjecturis, atque de quaestionibus cum Oppido Tizamo referre.

unit.source: Additionally, he proposed that the reward for these unexpected discoveries should be the transformation of Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic into a Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Praeterea, proposuit ut praemium pro his inopinatis inventis esset transformatio proprietatis Hisokae Beyonder in Artefactum Sigillatum.

unit.source: Having neatly folded the letter, Lumian produced a jagged black crystal clump and arranged a ritual.
unit.target: Epistulam diligenter plicatam, Lumian crystallum atrum angulosum produxit et ritum instituit.

unit.source: He called forth Madam Magician’s doll messenger.
unit.target: Invocavit pupam nuntiam Dominae Magician.

unit.source: Upon its emergence, the doll messenger emitted a disdainful sound, pinching its nose.
unit.target: Cum emerguit, nuntius pupae sonum spretii edidit, nasum suum prehendens.

unit.source: It pointed at Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic and remarked in a sharp voice,
unit.target: Illud ad proprietatem Hisokae Beyonder intendit et acuto voce dixerit,

unit.source: “Pack it into a box! It’s filthy!”
unit.target: “Pone illud in cista! Sordidum est!”

unit.source: Lumian retrieved a small paper box from his Traveler’s Bag and stuffed the black crystal clump inside.
unit.target: Lumian parvam cistam chartaceam ex sacco viatoris extraxit et in eam nodum crystallum atrum replevit.

unit.source: “Tie it up.”
unit.target: “Ligare illud.”

unit.source: “Stuff it in another box.”
unit.target: “Reple illud in aliam cistam.”

unit.source: “Use another box to contain them.”
unit.target: “Utere alia cista ad eos continendos.”

unit.source: The doll messenger continued with its requests.
unit.target: Nuntius pupae petitiones suas continuavit.

unit.source: Finally, it begrudgingly picked up the box and carried the letter away.
unit.target: Denique, vili animo, cistam sustulit et epistolam auferens abiit.

unit.source: Port Pylos’s patrol team.
unit.target: Turma vigilum Portus Pylos.

unit.source: Reaza informed Camus, “All the problematic team members have been purged. The rest are undergoing individual reviews. You are part of it too.”
unit.target: Reaza informavit Camus: “Omnes sodales problematici expulsi sunt; reliqui singillatim examinantur; tu quoque eorum partis es.”

unit.source: “How’s Kolobo?” Camus asked with concern.
unit.target: “Quid agit Kolobo?” Camus sollicite quaesivit.

unit.source: “He’s fine. We went to the Earth Mother Church to hire a Doctor,” Reaza replied calmly. “The major issue now is that we haven’t apprehended Twanaku. Moreover, we’re certain that he’s both a Wraith and a Desire Apostle.”
unit.target: “Is bene est; ad Ecclesiam Matris Terrae ivimus ut Medicum conduceremus,” Reaza tranquille respondit. “Praecipuum problema nunc est quod Twanaku non apprehendimus. Porro certi sumus eum simul Wraith et Apostolum Desiderii esse.”

unit.source: “How? Isn’t he too powerful?” Camus felt a twinge of fear at the thought of potential retaliation from Twanaku.
unit.target: “Quomodo? Nonne nimis potens est?” Camus metu aliquo sensit, de potestate ultio a Twanaku cogitans.

unit.source: At that moment, a patrol team member entered the office and informed Reaza and Camus, “Captain Reaza, Boss, the straw hat guy is back!”
unit.target: Membrum turmae vigilum officium intravit et Reaza et Camus informavit: “Dux Reaza, Praefecte, vir pileatus stramineus rediit!”

unit.source: 654 Bounty
unit.target: 654 Praemium

unit.source: Louis Berry is back again?
unit.target: Louis Berry iterum adest?

unit.source: Camus’s forehead twitched at the mention of the “straw hat guy.”
unit.target: Frons Camus ad mentionem viri pilei straminei contremuit.

unit.source: Since encountering the adventurer, his life had taken a tumultuous turn.
unit.target: Post adventorem congressus, vita eius cursum tumultuosum cepit.

unit.source: First, he had “captured” the murderer in a serial killing case, then he unearthed clues related to a four-year-old case.
unit.target: Primum, interficem in casu caedis seriarum “ceperat”, deinde indicia ad casum quattuor annorum pertinentia detexit.

unit.source: Subsequently, the suspect had emerged, attempting to harm him and Kolobo, throwing the patrol team into chaos.
unit.target: Postea, suspectus apparuit, conatus eum et Kolobo laedere, quo turma exploratorum in tumultum versa est.

unit.source: And now, Louis Berry was making another appearance?
unit.target: Et nunc, Louis Berry iterum appareret?

unit.source: Camus felt the weight on his chest, and his heart raced.
unit.target: Camus pondus in pectore sensit, et cor eius celeriter pulsabat.

unit.source: “Where is Louis Berry?” Reaza was already familiar with Camus’s account.
unit.target: «Ubi est Louis Berry?» Reaza iam narrationem Camus cognovit.

unit.source: The patrol team member who had brought the report hastily answered, “Sitting in the hall.”
unit.target: Membra turmae exploratorum, quae relationem attulit, festinanter respondit: “In aula sedens.”

unit.source: Reaza nodded, and he and Camus left the office, descending the stairs.
unit.target: Reaza annuit atque cum Camus officio discesserunt, scalas descendentes.

unit.source: As they walked, Camus gradually snapped out of his daze.
unit.target: Dum ambulabant, Camus paulatim ex stupore suo evasit.

unit.source: He recalled Louis Berry’s suspicions about Twanaku the previous day, how he had abandoned his theories without delving into specifics, and how the adventurer had sought him out early in the morning, hoping to gather information indirectly.
unit.target: Meminit Louis Berry de suspicionibus erga Twanaku die proximo, quomodo theorias suas relicxerat sine in rebus singulis ingredi, et quomodo adventor eum mane quaesiverit, sperans informationes indirecte colligere.

unit.source: Shortly after Kolobo handed over Twanaku’s information, the latter had been attacked, leading to a fierce battle.
unit.target: Mox postquam Kolobo notitias de Twanaku tradidit, ille aggressus est, quod acerrimam pugnam attulit.

unit.source: Did Louis Berry employ such a cautious inquiry to avoid triggering the Devil’s Danger Premonition?
unit.target: Num Louis Berry tam cautam inquisitionem ad vitandum excitandum Praemonitionem Periculi Diaboli adhibuit?

unit.source: Was buying information from Kolobo a trap targeting Twanaku?
unit.target: Num emendi informationes ab Kolobo consilium insidiosum ad Twanaku fecerit?

unit.source: No, hadn’t Twanaku sensed the corresponding danger?
unit.target: Nonne Twanaku periculum congruum sensisset?

unit.source: He could only sense it a minute or two in advance, and would it be too late by the time he discovered it?
unit.target: Ipse illud tantum ante uno vel duobus minutis sentire poterat, et num iam sero esset cum id deprehenderet?

unit.source: As a former Public Security Officer and now an Interrogator, Camus swiftly made connections and speculations.
unit.target: Ut quondam Officialis Securitatis Publicae et nunc Interrogator, Camus celeriter nexus et coniecturas fecit.

unit.source: He believed that Louis Berry had likely identified Twanaku after learning about his preference for sugarless Fermo coffee.
unit.target: Existimabat Louis Berry verisimiliter Twanaku agnoscessisse, postquam de eius praeferentia Fermo café sine saccharo cognovit.

unit.source: He hinted at suspicions regarding the police headquarters but refrained from going into specifics, fearing that Twanaku might foresee danger!
unit.target: Suspiciones de praesidio vigilum insinuavit, sed in particulas non intravit, timens ne Twanaku periculum praevidere posset!

unit.source: As for how Louis Berry set a trap for Twanaku without detection, Camus couldn’t puzzle it out for now.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad modum quo Louis Berry insidias pro Twanaku occulte posuerit, Camus ipsum adhuc explicare non potuit.

unit.source: Furthermore, he suspected that Louis Berry’s operation hadn’t been entirely successful.
unit.target: Praeterea suspicabatur operationem Louis Berry non esse plane feliciter perfecta.

unit.source: There were no signs from the Matani Import and Export Shop indicating Twanaku’s demise.
unit.target: Nullae erant signa a Taberna Matani Import et Export quae interitum Twanaku indicabant.

unit.source: This was a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle, wielding the power of a Sequence 5 Wraith.
unit.target: Hic erat Apostolus Desiderii Sequenciae V, vim habens umbrae Sequenciae V.

unit.source: Unless a demigod personally intervened, they might require two or three battle teams of Mid-Sequence Beyonders from pathways like Sun and Warrior to handle him.
unit.target: Nisi semideus ipse interveniret, possent duae vel tres turmae pugnarum Beyonderorum ex itineribus medii sequentis, ut Sol et Bellator, eum aggredi requirere.

unit.source: Alternatively, they needed to mobilize Beyonders at the level of a Sequence 5 Pirate Admiral, armed with potent mystical items.
unit.target: Aliter, necesse erat mobilitare Beyonderos ad gradu Classis Piratarum Sequenciae V, armatos cum potentibus rebus mysticis.

unit.source: Soon, Camus and Reaza spotted Louis Berry seated on the sofa in the hall’s guest area, his golden straw hat standing out in the sunlight.
unit.target: Mox Camus et Reaza Louis Berry conspexerunt sedens in sofa in area hospituaria aulae, cuius pileus stramineus aureus in sole eminentem erat.

unit.source: “Monsieur Louis Berry, what brings you here again?” Camus inquired in deep Intisian.
unit.target: «Domine Louis Berry, quid te hic iterum adfert?» quaesivit Camus in lingua Intisiana profunda.

unit.source: Louis Berry gave Camus a deep look before smiling and addressing Reaza in fluent Dutanese, “I’m here to collect the bounty.”
unit.target: Louis Berry Camusum aspectu profundo percontatus, deinde subridens et Reaza, lingua Dutanese fluente, adloquens, dixit: “Hic sum ad praemium colligendum.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he retrieved Twanaku’s head from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, caput Twanaku e sacco viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: Camus and Reaza observed the blood-stained face, the head with the broken horn, the vacant eyes, and the gruesome wound on the bridge of the nose, along with ten to twenty deep cuts.
unit.target: Camus et Reaza observaverunt faciem sanguine tinctam, caput cum cornu fracto, oculos vacuos, et vulnus horrendum in ponte nasi, simul cum decem ad viginti incisionibus profundis.

unit.source: Despite the severe damage, Camus, a former Public Security Officer, recognized the owner at a glance.
unit.target: Non obstante gravissima laesione, Camus, quondam Officialis Securitatis Publicae, dominum intuens statim agnovit.

unit.source: Twanaku Tupián!
unit.target: Twanaku Tupián!

unit.source: He succeeded? Had he truly set a trap for a Desire Apostle and managed to defeat him?
unit.target: Successitne? Vere insidias pro Apostolo Desiderii posuerat et eum superare potuit?

unit.source: Camus’s gaze shifted up, scrutinizing Louis Berry, a young man with the title of a great adventurer in the Fog Sea.
unit.target: Camus oculos sursum convertit, Louis Berry pervidens, iuvenem, cui titulus magni adventoris in Maris Nebulae attribuebatur.

unit.source: Such strength could rival any Pirate Admiral in the Five Seas!
unit.target: Tanta vis ullum Praefectum Piratarum in Quinque Maribus aequare posset!

unit.source: Of course, this assessment applied only to individual abilities, excluding the subordinates of Pirate Admirals.
unit.target: Scilicet, haec aestimatio tantum ad singulas facultates applicabatur, praefectorum piratarum subditos excludens.

unit.source: Reaza silently ascertained from a spiritual level.
unit.target: Reaza tacite, ex plano spirituali, intellexit.

unit.source: He turned to Camus and asked in Dutanese,
unit.target: Ad Camus se convertit et in lingua Dutanese rogavit:

unit.source: “Is it Twanaku?”
unit.target: «Estne Twanaku?»

unit.source: “Yes,” Camus confirmed, sighing inwardly.
unit.target: «Ita,» confirmavit Camus, suspirans interius.

unit.source: The battle between Twanaku and Louis Berry had been fierce, resulting in his tragic demise.
unit.target: Pugna inter Twanaku et Louis Berry vehementissima fuit, quae ad eius tristem interitum duxit.

unit.source: Not only were his eyes absent, but he was also covered in wounds, displaying signs of Devilification.
unit.target: Non solum oculi eius defuerunt, sed etiam vulneribus tegebatur, signa Diabolicitatis monstrans.

unit.source: Reaza looked at Lumian and pondered for a moment before speaking in Dutanese, “I wonder if you’ve seen Twanaku’s wanted poster. The bounty is only 70,000 verl d’or.”
unit.target: Reaza ad Lumian respexit et paulisper meditatus, deinde in Dutanese dixit: «Miror an posterum de Twanaku quaesitum videris. Praemium tantum est 70,000 verl d’or.»

unit.source: Back then, the bounty was set based on the criteria of a Serial Killer.
unit.target: Illo tempore, praemium definitum erat ex criteriis caedis serialis.

unit.source: It was only increased by 20,000 because this particular Serial Killer targeted Beyonders.
unit.target: Itaque addito tantum 20,000, quoniam hic interficis serialis Beyonderos destinabat.

unit.source: Lumian barely understood and switched to Intisian with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian vix intellexit et, subridente, ad linguam Intisianam vertit.

unit.source: “If I wait two days to collect the bounty, will I be able to get more?”
