unit.target: «Si duos dies exspectaverim ad praemium colligendum, amplius consequi potero?»

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Camus pondered for a moment and realized the validity of the statement.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Camus paulisper cogitavit atque veritatem illius assertionis agnovit.

unit.source: In two days, their wanted posters would depict Desire Apostle and Wraith Twanaku, who had caused the deaths of several members of the patrol team, not the Serial Killer from the past!
unit.target: In duobus diebus, posteria quaesita eorum effingent Apostolum Desiderii et Umbrae Twanaku, qui multorum membrorum turmae exploratorum mortes attulerant, non caedis serialis praeteritorum!

unit.source: Of course, with Matani’s financial resources, it was impossible to significantly raise the bounty.
unit.target: Scilicet, cum opibus pecuniariis Matani, praemium non poterat notabiliter augeri.

unit.source: At most, they could double it and report the danger to the Church of Earth Mother, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and other official organizations in the Northern Continent to see if they would be willing to increase the bounty.
unit.target: Maxime, id duplicare possent et periculum referre ad Ecclesiam Matris Terrae, Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammantis, atque alias institutiones officiales in Continente Septentrionali, ut experirentur si praemium augere velissent.

unit.source: After Camus translated Lumian’s words into Dutanese, Reaza remained silent, unsure of how to respond.
unit.target: Postquam Camus verba Lumiani in Dutanese interpretatus est, Reaza silentium tenuit, nescius quo respondeat.

unit.source: For the patrol team, 70,000 to 80,000 verl d’or was a substantial sum!
unit.target: Pro turma exploratorum, 70,000 ad 80,000 verl d’or summa considerabilis erat!

unit.source: Without waiting for a response, Lumian added with a smile, “But there’s no need to add to the bounty. Just fulfill two of my requests. Two simple ones.”
unit.target: Nullo responsionis tempore expectato, Lumian subridente addidit: «Non opus est praemium augeri; solum duas ex meis petitionibus explendae sunt. Duae simplices.»

unit.source: “What are they?” Reaza asked in a deep voice after hearing Camus’s translation.
unit.target: «Quae sunt illae?» quaesivit Reaza voce profunda postquam Camus interpretavit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response, stating, “Firstly, I want to see all the dossiers related to Tizamo Town. Secondly, I’m very curious about Twanaku’s card and want to take a look. Of course, I’ll just take a look.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: «Primum, volo videre omnes fasciculos pertinentes ad oppidum Tizamo; secundo, valde curiosus sum de tessera Twanaku atque inspicere volo—scilicet, modo inspiciam.»

unit.source: “You want to investigate last year’s incident in Tizamo Town? Isn’t your sole purpose in Port Pylos to find Twanaku?” Camus asked, puzzled.
unit.target: «Visne incidentem anni praeteriti in oppido Tizamo explorare? Nonne solum propositum tibi in Portu Pylos est Twanaku invenire?» inquit Camus, miratus.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “Need I remind you? Twanaku’s hometown is Tizamo Town.”
unit.target: «Meminisse debeo? Patria Twanaku est oppidum Tizamo.»

unit.source: Wh— Camus suddenly felt that the matter with Twanaku wouldn’t conclude with the other party’s death.
unit.target: Heu— Camus repente sensit rem de Twanaku non finituram esse cum morte alterius.

unit.source: There were still many secrets hidden behind it.
unit.target: Adhuc multa arcana latebant.

unit.source: Louis Berry had mentioned this from the beginning.
unit.target: Louis Berry hoc ab initio enuntiaverat.

unit.source: After translating their conversation for Reaza, Camus sensed that the patrol team’s previous investigation of the Tizamo Town incident might have concluded too hastily.
unit.target: Postquam sermonem inter se pro Reaza interpretatus est, Camus sensit inquisitionem praecedens incidentis oppidi Tizamo a turma exploratorum fortasse nimis festinatam esse.

unit.source: Eyeing Louis Berry, who had successfully taken down a Desire Apostle wielding Wraith powers, the chilly Reaza fell silent for a few seconds before uttering, “Who tasked you with looking into Twanaku?”
unit.target: Intuens Louis Berry, qui feliciter Apostolum Desiderii cum viribus Umbrae delevit, gelidus Reaza paucos momenta silentium tenuit, deinde quaesivit: «Quis te misit ut Twanaku explorares?»

unit.source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian inquired, “Did he declare himself a member of the temperance faction, a follower of The Fool?”
unit.target: Nullo responsione directa data, Lumian interrogavit: «Num se declaravit membrum factionis temperantiae, sectatorem The Fool?»

unit.source: “It’s not a self-proclamation. We verified it,” Reaza confidently replied after hearing Camus’s translation.
unit.target: «Non est ea ipsa proclamatio; id comprobavimus,» respondit Reaza confidenter postquam Camus interpretavit.

unit.source: As anticipated… Just making confirmation, Lumian stood up for the Church of The Fool, stating, “Traitors can surface in any organization, and there’ll be individuals with hidden agendas attempting to infiltrate.”
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur… Ad confirmationem solam, Lumian pro Ecclesia The Fool se excitavit, dicens: «Proditores in qualibet organizatione apparere possunt, et erunt homines cum occultis consiliis qui infiltrare conabuntur.»

unit.source: “That’s indeed our problem,” Camus sincerely concluded. “We shouldn’t solely rely on the organization they’re affiliated with to determine a person’s character or whether they can be recruited. We also need to observe their words and actions.”
unit.target: «Id quidem nostra quaestio est,» concludebat Camus sincere. «Non sola organizationi cui adsociantur confidere debemus ad statuere viri indolem aut si conloqui possunt; verba et facta eorum quoque observanda sunt.»

unit.source: After careful consideration, Reaza agreed to Lumian’s request.
unit.target: Post accuratam considerationem, Reaza petitionem Lumiani assensit.

unit.source: While assigning another patrol team member to aid Lumian in the process and collect the bounty, he instructed Camus to show Lumian the poker card.
unit.target: Dum alterum membrum turmae exploratorum adiuvari Lumiano in processu et praemium colligendum constitit, iubebat Camum ut Lumiano monstrasset cartam poker.

unit.source: In the cold and silent underground corridor, Camus gazed at Lumian and cautiously asked, “What are you investigating?”
unit.target: In frigido et silentioso subterraneo corridore, Camus Lumian intuitus est et caute quaesivit, «Quid investigas?»

unit.source: This had already led to the death of a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle!
unit.target: Hoc iam mortem Apostoli Desiderii Sequenciae V attulit!

unit.source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian leniter subridens risum edidit.

unit.source: “It’s dangerous to know too much.”
unit.target: «Periculosum est nimis multa scire.»

unit.source: Camus fell silent, wisely choosing not to inquire further, drawing from past experiences.
unit.target: Camus tacuit, sapienter decernens ne plura quaereret, ex priore experientia sumpto.

unit.source: As Lumian advanced, he casually asked, “How many members of the patrol team perished this time?”
unit.target: Dum Lumian progressus est, leviter quaesivit, «Quot membra turmae exploratorum hoc tempore perierunt?»

unit.source: “Four. All under Twanaku’s control.” Camus gave a self-deprecating smile.
unit.target: «Quattuor. Omnia sub potestate Twanaku sunt.» Camus modesto risu effecit.

unit.source: “We’ll be recruiting new members before the end of the year. They’re fortunate. Those with suitable pathways don’t have to worry about subsequent Sequence potions. If they aren’t from the correct pathways, they can use Sealed Artifacts.”
unit.target: «Novos membra ante finem anni conplebimus. Illi fortunati sunt. Qui viis aptis incumbunt, de potionibus sequentibus non sollicitantur; sin autem non ex rectis viis oriuntur, artefacta sigillata adhiberi possunt.»

unit.source: This was how the resources of an official organization gradually accumulated.
unit.target: Sic subsidia organizationis officialis paulatim accumulabantur.

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: “How’s Kolobo?”
unit.target: «Quomodo Kolobo est?»

unit.source: Camus’s smile grew more relaxed.
unit.target: Risus Camus magis solutus redditus est.

unit.source: “He’s fine. He’s almost healed.”
unit.target: «Bene est. Paene sanatus est.»

unit.source: As they conversed, they arrived at a room adorned with cold bones.
unit.target: Dum loquebantur, ad conclave pervenerunt, qui ossibus frigidis ornatus erat.

unit.source: A metallic poker card lay on the table in the middle.
unit.target: Cartula poker metallina in mensa medio iacebat.

unit.source: “Be careful. It will burrow into your body and control you like a Wraith,” Camus warned.
unit.target: «Cave. In corpus tuum se infiltrabit et te regere, ut Umbra, vult,» Camus monuit.

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly and approached, reaching out for the card with the ten of spades on its face.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit et accessit, manum ad cartam cum decem spatarum in facie extollens.

unit.source: A bone-like sensation entered his mind, accompanied by a chilling cold.
unit.target: Sensatio ossis similis in mentem eius intravit, comitata frigore gelido.

unit.source: Lumian’s right hand quickly became encased in a layer of frost.
unit.target: Manus dextra Lumiani celeriter in lamina pruinae circumdata est.

unit.source: The frost rapidly crystallized and extended towards his arm.
unit.target: Pruina celeriter crystallizata est et ad brachium eius extendit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, the card’s surface underwent a transformation, revealing a grayish-white joker.
unit.target: Simul, superficies cartae mutationem passa est, patefaciens ioker cinereo-album.

unit.source: It rapidly etherealized, poised to merge with Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Celeriter in aethera evanuit, paratum ad corpus Lumiani confluere.

unit.source: Silently, Lumian’s arm burst into brilliant white flames.
unit.target: Tacite, brachium Lumiani in flammis albis praeclaris erupit.

unit.source: With a swift flick of his palm, he accurately pressed his thumb onto the poker card that hadn’t completely dissipated, right onto the joker’s face.
unit.target: Celeriter, ex palmarum motu, accurate pollicem suum in cartam poker, quae nondum plane evanuerat, in faciem ioker premit.

unit.source: The poker card fell into silence.
unit.target: Cartula poker silentium cepit.

unit.source: Frost detached from Lumian’s arm, descended to the ground, and melted into water.
unit.target: Pruina a brachio Lumiani discessit, ad terram descendit, et in aquam liquefacta est.

unit.target: Alioquin, adhuc in mundo versarentur.

unit.source: At that moment, the pallor on Iveljsta’s body concentrated on his dark-brown eyes, emitting an illusory quality that seemed unreal.
unit.target: At eo tempore, pallor in corpore Iveljsta in oculos eius fuscos brunneos se concentrabat, emittens qualitatem illusoriam, quae quasi irrealis videbatur.

unit.source: Does this mean he can quickly transform into a Wraith, and his eyes are no longer his weakness?
unit.target: An hoc significat eum celeriter in Umbra transformari posse, et oculos eius non iam esse ejus infirmitatem?

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, he gestured towards the divan in the living room.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, ad divanum in conclavi indicavit.

unit.source: “Let’s chat there.”
unit.target: Ibi colloquamur.

unit.source: Ludwig, seated at the dining table, glanced at Iveljsta for a few seconds before lowering his head and continuing his meal with a succulent piece of beef.
unit.target: Ludwig, ad mensam cenandi sedens, paucos momenta in Iveljsta aspexit antequam caput inclinaret et cenam edere pergebat cum frusto bubulae succulentae.

unit.source: Iveljsta nodded slightly and entered the living room quietly, taking a seat in a corner of the divan.
unit.target: Iveljsta leviter annuit et tranquille in conclavi intravit, sedens in angulo divani.

unit.source: Are you a student at a primary school? So disciplined…
unit.target: Esne discipulus scholae primariae? Quam disciplinae te geris!

unit.source: Lumian criticized as he focused on observing Iverista’s luck.
unit.target: Lumian reprehendit, dum fortunam Iverista observabat.

unit.source: It was relatively normal and nothing special.
unit.target: Ita erat plane ordinarium et nihil speciale.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian suddenly had a few thoughts.
unit.target: At eo tempore, Lumian subito aliquas cogitationes habuit.

unit.source: Luck Observation and Weakness Investigation require the eyes to determine the target’s color.
unit.target: Observatio Fortunae et Investigatio Infirmitatis oculos requirunt ut colorem scopī determinent.

unit.source: However, one focuses on the background color, while the other captures the various colors on the surface of the body.
unit.target: Attamen, unus ad colorem ambitus intendit, dum alter diversas colores in superficie corporis observat.

unit.source: When I become a Fate Appropriator, could these two abilities fuse and mutate into a more special ability?
unit.target: Si ego fati adeptor fiam, num hae duae facultates confluere atque in facultatem specialem mutari possint?

unit.source: Why can I only use my eyes to observe these two abilities?
unit.target: Cur solum oculos meos ad has duas facultates observandas uti possum?

unit.source: Is a blind Reaper incapable of attacking a target’s weakness?
unit.target: Num caecus Messor non valeat oppugnare infirmitatem scopī?

unit.source: Similarly, is a blind Ascetic unqualified to observe others’ luck?
unit.target: Similiter, num caecus Asceticus non idoneus sit ad aliorum fortunam observandam?

unit.source: Can’t they rely on their spirituality and ears and nose?
unit.target: Nonne possunt in spiritualitate sua, auribus, et naso inniti?

unit.source: Or could it be done at a higher Sequence?
unit.target: An id fieri potest in sequentia superiori?

unit.source: Lumian eased into the armchair, positioning himself at an angle across from Iveljsta.
unit.target: Lumian se leniter in sella relaxata instituit, se in angulo opposito a Iveljsta ponens.

unit.source: Flashing a friendly smile, he asked, “What’s the matter?”
unit.target: Risu amico scintillante, quaesivit: "Quid agitur?"

unit.source: He spoke in Intisian.
unit.target: Loquebatur in Intisiana.

unit.source: Iveljsta, as silent as a corpse, straightened up.
unit.target: Iveljsta, tam silens quam cadaver, se recte erexit.

unit.source: His eyes, deep as he spoke in ancient Feysac.
unit.target: Oculi eius, profundi, cum in antiqua Feysac loqueretur.

unit.source: “Allow me to introduce myself. Iveljsta Eggers, a member of the Rose School of Thought and temperance faction under the Church of The Fool.”
unit.target: Permitte mihi me ipsum præsentare. Ego sum Iveljsta Eggers, membrum Scholae Sententiarum Rosae et factionis Temperantiae sub Ecclesia Stulti.

unit.source: Lumian’s nerves, already tense, heightened.
unit.target: Nervi Lumiani, iam tensi, augeri coeperunt.

unit.source: Nevertheless, he maintained a relaxed demeanor, confirming, "Are you Twanaku’s liaison?"
unit.target: Tamen, animo relaxato servavit, confirmans: "Esne legatus Twanaku?"

unit.source: He switched to ancient Feysac.
unit.target: Mutavit ad antiquam Feysac.

unit.source: “No,” Iveljsta shook his head, “I’ve already eliminated that member fifteen minutes ago.”
unit.target: "Non," inquit Iveljsta, capite movente, "iam illum membrum quindecim minutis abhinc exstirpsi."

unit.source: Fifteen minutes ago, when I was still with the patrol team…
unit.target: Quindecim minutis abhinc, cum adhuc cum turma vigiliarum essem…

unit.source: However, you can’t expect me to believe you just because you say so…
unit.target: Tamen, non potes exspectare ut id credam, quoniam ita dixeris…

unit.source: Lumian feigned curiosity and asked, “I recall that you arrived in Port Pylos before Twanaku was exposed. What was your original motive?”
unit.target: Lumian, curiositatem fingens, rogavit: "Memini te in Portu Pylos adveneris antequam Twanaku patefactus esset. Quid fuit propositum tuum initio?"

unit.source: “I’m investigating the primitive forest in this area. I’m still in the early stages of gathering more information,” Iveljsta replied seriously.
unit.target: "Exploro silvam primitivam huius regionis. Adhuc in initio sum plura informationes colligendi," respondit Iveljsta serio.

unit.source: “Four days ago, I came into contact with Twanaku and obtained some information from him.
unit.target: "Quattuor die abhinc, cum Twanaku conveniens, ab eo nonnullas informationes accepi.

unit.source: He seemed fine and was very restrained.
unit.target: Videbatur bene et erat valde temperatus.

unit.source: He’s indeed restrained. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be a second serial murder case in Port Pylos only after four years…
unit.target: Vere moderatus est. Alioquin non esset secunda caedes serialis in Portu Pylos nisi post quattuor annos…

unit.source: Going to the primitive forest to investigate… The primitive forest…
unit.target: Ire in silvam primitivam ad investigandum… Silva primitiva…

unit.source: On the surface, the incident in Tizamo Town was a sudden attack by a tribe in the primitive forest.
unit.target: Superficialiter, res in oppido Tizamo fuit repentina impetus a tribu in silva primitiva.

unit.source: Lumian quickly made many connections and said to Iveljsta thoughtfully, “Twanaku once did something in Tizamo Town that involved the tribes in the nearby primitive forest. Some of his important items seem to be hidden in Tizamo Town. It might also be related to a Nois family Demon of unknown Sequence.”
unit.target: Lumian celeriter multas nexiones fingens, cogitato loquens ad Iveljsta, dixit: "Twanaku olim aliquid egit in oppido Tizamo, quod tribus in silva primitiva proxima implicavit. Quaedam eius res maximi momenti videntur in oppido Tizamo celatae esse. Forsitan etiam ad Daemoni familiae Nois, cuius sequentia ignota est, attinet."

unit.source: Iveljsta listened in silence, lost in thought.
unit.target: Iveljsta silentio auscultavit, cogitatione amissus.

unit.source: After a few seconds, he said to Lumian, “Thank you for providing this information. It might not be useful for my investigation, but it can let me know what to be wary of.”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, ad Lumian dixit: "Gratias tibi ago pro hisce informationibus. Forsitan in mea inquisitione non operabuntur, sed mihi ostendere possunt quid cavendum sit."

unit.source: He didn’t specify his mission. Clearly, he needed his superior’s permission.
unit.target: Non suam missionem definitus est. Manifestum est eum licentiam superioris habere necessariam.

unit.source: Lumian responded nonchalantly, “Even if I don’t tell you now, you’ll find out tonight or tomorrow.”
unit.target: Lumian leviter respondit: "Etiamsi nunc non dico, hac nocte aut cras cognosces."

unit.source: Having already reported the matter to Madam Magician, the Major Arcana card holder would undoubtedly inform the Church of The Fool and the temperance faction in detail subsequently. It wouldn’t only be a general outline that mentioned key personnel like before.
unit.target: Iam rem ad Dominam Magician referentem, possessor tabularum Major Arcana, indubitanter postea Ecclesiam Stulti et factionem Temperantiae in detail certiorem faciet. Non esset solum conspectus generalis, in quo principales personae, ut antea, memoratae fuerunt.

unit.source: Iveljsta nodded with restraint and said, “I’m here to express my gratitude and to inform you that we’re already investigating any potential problems and latent dangers.
unit.target: Iveljsta cum moderata more annuit et dixit: "Adsum ut gratiam meam exprimam et ut tibi referam nos iam quaestiones potentiales atque pericula latentia investigare.

unit.source: “Also, if you need help in Matani, feel free to come to me.”
unit.target: "Etiam, si auxilio in Matani indiges, libere ad me accede."

unit.source: “Alright.” Lumian didn’t stand on ceremony.
unit.target: "Bene." Lumian caerimoniam non servavit.

unit.source: After delving into the more serious matters, Lumian, intrigued, asked Iveljsta, “Why did you add the Rose School of Thought prefix when you introduced yourself? You’ve already left the Rose School of Thought and joined the Church of The Fool. It sounds as if the Rose School of Thought is affiliated with the Church of The Fool.”
unit.target: Postquam in quaestiones graviores versatus est, Lumian, admiratus, Iveljsta interrogavit: "Cur praefixum Scholae Sententiarum Rosae adiecisti cum te præsentare? Iam Scholae Sententiarum Rosae discessisti et Ecclesiam Stulti accessisti. Sonat quasi Scholae Sententiarum Rosae cum Ecclesia Stulti coniungatur."

unit.source: “Our leader specifically requested this. She always believes that we are the true orthodox branch of the Rose School of Thought. Only we represent the Rose School of Thought. Those traitors should change the organization’s name, not us,” Iveljsta explained in detail.
unit.target: "Ductrix nostra hoc specialiter postulavit. Illa semper credit nos esse veram orthodoxam partem Scholae Sententiarum Rosae. Soli nos ipsi Scholae Sententiarum Rosae repraesentamus. Illos proditores nomen organisationis mutare debent, non nos," Iveljsta enixe explicavit.

unit.source: Sounds quite stubborn… Aren’t you from the temperance faction? Don’t you restrain your emotions and desires in this aspect?
unit.target: Valde pertinax sonat… Nonne es ex factione Temperantiae? Nonne mores tuos et desideria in hoc respici temperas?

unit.source: Yes, Sequence 5 is Wraith, close to evil spirits, and evil spirits have an extreme side.
unit.target: Ita, Sequencia 5 est Umbra, vicina spiritibus malis, et spiritus mali partem extremam habent.

unit.source: Is this reflected in High-Sequence Beyonders of the temperance faction’s corresponding pathway?
unit.target: Num hoc in Beyonders Sequenciae Altae, viae factionis Temperantiae correspondentis, manifestum est?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t quite understand and tried to make a guess based on the available information.
unit.target: Lumian non plene intellexit et conatus est ex informationibus praesto aliquam coniecturam facere.

unit.source: He was just chatting and had no intention of inquiring further.
unit.target: Solum colloquium agebat et nullum studium ulterioris inquisitionis habebat.

unit.source: Instead, he asked,
unit.target: Proinde, interrogavit:

unit.source: “Your last name is Eggers. Was your ancestor a member of the Balam Empire’s royal family?”
unit.target: "Cognomen tuum est Eggers. Num maior tuus antecessor membrum regiae familiae Imperii Balam fuisse?"

unit.source: “Yes,” Iveljsta replied proudly, his emotions held in check.
unit.target: "Ita," respondit Iveljsta, superbus animos moderans.

unit.source: “And my mother’s lineage is noble from the Highlands Kingdom.”
unit.target: "Et stirps matris meae ex Regno Altorum nobilis est."

unit.source: For many in the Southern Continent, the surname Eggers bore unparalleled prestige.
unit.target: Multis in Continente Meridionali, cognomen Eggers praestantiam inimitabilem portabat.

unit.source: It was a symbol of a deity who had once trod the land, a representation of Death’s dominion over the world.
unit.target: Erat symbolum deī, qui olim terram calcaverat, et repraesentatio dominationis Mortis super mundum.

unit.source: But Lumian’s curiosity wandered elsewhere.
unit.target: Sed curiositas Lumiani alio loco erravit.

unit.source: “I’ve heard that the mausoleums of the Balam Empire’s nobles are constructed upside down underground, much like this hotel.
unit.target: "Audivi mausolea nobilium Imperii Balam sub terra, inversa, aedificari, sicut hoc deversorium.

unit.source: What mystical significance does that hold?
unit.target: Quid significat hoc mysticum?

unit.source: Is it simply a way to confront death?
unit.target: Num hoc solum modus est ad mortem oppugnandam?

unit.source: And why is death associated with the underground?
unit.target: Et cur mors cum subterraneo coniungitur?

unit.source: Shouldn’t the Underworld exist in the spirit world?
unit.target: Num non debet infernum in mundo spirituum exsistere?

unit.source: This was the question that piqued Lumian’s interest upon learning about the matter.
unit.target: Haec quaestio fuit quae Lumiani studium excitavit, cum de re didicerit.

unit.source: His understanding of mysticism was limited.
unit.target: Intelligentia eius de mysticis rebus limitata erat.

unit.source: Iveljsta pondered for a moment and then explained,
unit.target: Iveljsta paulisper cogitavit, deinde explicavit,

unit.source: “I didn’t choose the Death pathway. The construction method originated from ancient times, passed down by all the Eggers ancestors, devoted to the deity who controlled death.
unit.target: "Non elegi viam Mortis. Methodus aedificandi ex temporibus antiquis orta est, a cunctis maioribus Eggers tradita, devota deo qui mortem regit.

unit.source: “He embodies the very concept of death. Emulating Him is a way to approach the source of death.
unit.target: Ipse ipsum conceptum mortis repraesentat. Eum imitari modus est ad fontem mortis accedendi.

unit.source: “This mystic explanation resonates with me the most. Over the years, I’ve heard various interpretations:
unit.target: Haec mystica explanatio maxime mihi consonat. Per annos variae interpretationes audivi:

unit.source: “Some see life and death as opposing mystical concepts. They argue that, just as we stand upright and grow upwards in life, burial upside down signifies the contradiction and connection between life and death.
unit.target: Alii vitam atque mortem ut conceptus mystici contrarii vident. Argumentantur, sicut in vita recti stamus et sursum crescimus, ita sepultura inversa contrarietatem atque nexum inter vitam et mortem significat.

unit.source: “Others believe that true hell isn’t in the spirit world or the Underworld, but deep underground. Descending further symbolizes reaching true hell and returning to the essence of death. Thus, mausoleums are built upside down, reflecting our intention to face hell, worship death, and return to the source. This is the essence and symbol of mysticism.”
unit.target: Alii vero credunt verum infernum non in mundo spirituum aut in inferis esse, sed profunde sub terra. Descensio ulterius significat verum infernum attingere et ad essentiam mortis redire. Itaque mausolea inversa aedificantur, nostra voluntate ostendens ut infernum oppugnemus, mortem colamus, atque ad fontem rediremus. Haec est essentia atque symbolum mysticismi.”

unit.source: Some Beyonders of the Death pathway don’t really approve of the Underworld…
unit.target: Nonnulli Beyonders viae Mortis vere non consentiunt inferis…

unit.source: Can you discover true hell by delving deep underground?
unit.target: Potesne verum infernum detegere per profundam inquisitionem subterraneam?

unit.source: Heh heh, hasn’t anyone informed you that the world we’re on is essentially a planet?
unit.target: Heh heh, num nemo tibi dixit mundum in quo sumus esse re vera planetam?

unit.source: Does this extension reach underground magma and the core?
unit.target: Attingitne haec extensio ad magma subterranea et ad nucleum?

unit.source: Do they believe that’s the genuine hell?
unit.target: Num hoc verum infernum esse censent?

unit.source: Going deeper will traverse the core and the magma, but that’ll merely be the other side of the planet, let alone true hell…
unit.target: Profundius descendendo, nucleum et magma percurreris, sed id solum alteram partem planetae repraesentabit, quanto minus verum infernum…

unit.source: Lumian found himself increasingly entertained as he listened.
unit.target: Lumian se magis ac magis oblectatum invenit, dum auscultabat.

unit.source: Suddenly, he was taken aback.
unit.target: Subito, stupefactus est.

unit.source: What exists on the opposite side of the planet?
unit.target: Quid in altera parte planetae existit?

unit.source: I only know of the Northern and Southern Continents.
unit.target: Solum continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales novi sunt.

unit.source: Considering the time difference, they’re nearly on the same side…
unit.target: Ratione differentiae temporis, paene in eadem parte versantur…

unit.source: If this world is genuinely a planet, there must be another side.
unit.target: Si mundus hic vere planeta sit, alteram partem esse oportet.

unit.source: But I’ve never heard of any continents—just an expansive sea?
unit.target: Sed numquam audivi de continentibus—solum mare vastum extat?

unit.source: Wait, how did those giant fellows from the New City of Silver emerge from the Forsaken Land of the Gods…
unit.target: Exspecta, quomodo illi gigantes ex Nova Urbe Argentea ex Terra Deorum Derelicta apparuerunt…

unit.source: Something must have occurred on the continent on the other side of the planet, abandoned by the deities.
unit.target: Aliquid debet evenisse in continente in altera parte planetae, ab deis derelictum.

unit.source: Could that be why it’s known as the Forsaken Land of the Gods?
unit.target: Num id sit, qua ea vocatur Terra Deorum Derelicta?

unit.source: If I have a chance in the future, I could revisit the New City of Silver and explore the library for books related to the Forsaken Land of the Gods…
unit.target: Si mihi in futurum occasio detur, possum iterum Novam Urbem Argenteam visitare et in bibliotheca libros de Terra Deorum Derelicta quaerere…

unit.source: Lumian reined in his thoughts and continued conversing with Iveljsta for a while.
unit.target: Lumian cogitationes suas moderavit et paulisper cum Iveljsta colloquium continuavit.

unit.source: Eventually, he escorted the former descendant of the Balam Empire’s royal family, a member of the temperance faction, away from this floor.
unit.target: Postremo, comitatus est pristino descendenti familiae regiae Imperii Balam, membro factionis Temperantiae, ex hoc pavimento discedens.

unit.source: Not long after returning to his room, the doll messenger arrived with a response from Madam Magician.
unit.target: Non longe postquam ad cubiculum suum rediit, advenit nuntius ex pupa cum responsione a Domina Magician.

unit.source: “The information and insights you’ve gathered this time are exceptionally valuable. It’s no wonder my spiritual perception guided me to let you visit the New City of Silver after the Hanth Island Demon incident.
unit.target: "Informationes et perspicientiae, quas hoc tempore collegisti, sunt eximie pretiosae. Non mirum est quod perceptio spiritualis mea me duxit ut te Novam Urbem Argenteam visitare post incidentem Demonis Insulae Hanth."

unit.source: “Reflecting on it, your encounter with Naboredisley seemed almost coincidental. You followed the clues to Hanth Island. Hmm, you should grasp the significance, right?
unit.target: "Cogitans, congressus tuus cum Naboredisley paene fortuito apparuit. Indicia secutus es ad Insulam Hanth. Hem, debet significatum tibi esse cognitum, nonne?"

unit.source: “The situation in this matter both reassures me and intensifies my vigilance and anxiety. When that entity stands by our side, these details are incredibly useful. However, He won’t always be with us. When our objectives clash, I can’t fathom what challenges we’ll face. The same goes for you and me.
unit.target: "Res in hac re et me consolatur et vigilantiam ac anxietatem meam auget. Cum illa entitas ad latus nostrum stat, hae singulae res valde utiles sunt. Tamen, ille non semper nobiscum erit. Cum nostra proposita concurrunt, non possum imaginari quae difficultates occurrent. Idem valet inter te et me."

unit.source: “Therefore, Hunters must rely more on their personal growth amidst blood, fire, chaos, and conflict. Many Hunters meet their end, using their bones to forge the Red Priest who conquers all.
unit.target: "Ergo Venatores debent magis inniti suae personalis evolutioni inter sanguinem, ignem, chaos, et conflictum. Multi Venatores intereunt, ossa sua ad conficiendum Rubrum Sacrum, qui omnia superat, utentes."

unit.source: “We’ve already initiated an internal review. It involves a considerable number of individuals and will take a substantial amount of time to complete. Considering your contributions, besides converting the Beyonder characteristic into a Sealed Artifact, you have the option to choose a reward. Pick one out of two. Here are your choices.
unit.target: "Iam internam recognitionem iniciavimus. Multos homines implicat et tempus considerabile ad perficiendum requiret. Consideratis contributionibus tuis, praeterquam proprietatem Beyonder in Artifactum Sigillatam converteris, habes optionem praemium eligendi. Elige unum ex duobus. Ecce optiones tuae."

unit.source: “1: the potion formula for the Hunter pathway’s Sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight. 2: I’ll assist you in divining clues about the remaining parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.”
unit.target: "1: formula potionis pro via Venatoris Sequenciae 4, 'Eques Ferreus Sanguinis.' 2: Auxiliabor tibi in divinatione inditiarum de reliquis partibus corporis 'Manus Abscessae.'"

unit.source: 657 Tizamo Town
unit.target: 657 Oppidum Tizamo

unit.source: Reading Madam Magician’s two choices, Lumian fell into deep thought.
unit.target: Legens duas electiones Dominae Magicae, Lumian in profundam cogitationem cecidit.

unit.source: These were incredible rewards!
unit.target: Haec erant praemia incredibilia!

unit.source: It had to be known that reaching Sequence 4 marked a crucial point for Beyonders, a moment of qualitative transformation.
unit.target: Sciri oportuit quod ad Sequenciam IV pervenire punctum cruciale Beyonders indicaret, momentum mutationis qualitatis esset.

unit.source: From then on, one could attain godhood and become a half-human, half-god entity.
unit.target: Ex tunc quisque deitatem adipisci poterat atque fieri entitas semi‑humana et semi‑dea.

unit.source: Most Beyonders would never get this far.
unit.target: Plerique Beyonders hanc finem numquam attingere potuerunt.

unit.source: This wasn’t just about becoming a demigod; it also included seeing or obtaining related items firsthand.
unit.target: Hoc non solum deum semideum fieri significabat; insuper pertinebat ad ea obiecta cognata primo videre aut adipisci.

unit.source: A Sequence 4 potion formula was usually priceless!
unit.target: Formula potionis Sequenciae IV plerumque inestimabilis erat!

unit.source: Moreover, this was a Sequence 4 potion formula related to Lumian’s own pathway.
unit.target: Praeterea, haec erat formula potionis Sequenciae IV, quae ad viam propriam Lumiani pertinebat.

unit.source: As for the reward of divining clues about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body, it symbolized the promise and assistance of an Angel.
unit.target: Quoad praemium ad indaganda indicia de reliquo corpore Manus Abscessae, id repraesentabat promissionem atque auxilium Angelici.

unit.source: Ordinary Beyonders wouldn’t even dream of such a chance, let alone receive an opportunity.
unit.target: Beyonders vulgares talem occasionem neque quidem in somnis habebant, nedum eam adipisci.

unit.source: They could only read about Angels gaining the Lord’s permission and responding to believers’ prayers in various Churches.
unit.target: Solum legere poterant de Angelis qui a Domino licentiam acceperunt et preces fidelium in variis ecclesiis exsequi solet.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian needed to address this issue.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian hanc rem agere debebat.

unit.source: After advancing to a Sequence 5 Reaper, his top priority was finding the remaining parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
unit.target: Postquam ad Messoris Sequenciae V progressus est, primum propositum eius fuit reliquas partes corporis Manus Abscessae invenire.

unit.source: Without completing this task, the formula, the ingredients, the digestion process, and the prepared ritual wouldn’t give him a shot at becoming a demigod in time due to the unfulfilled promise and the oath’s restrictions.
unit.target: Nisi hoc opus perfecerit, nec formula, nec ingredienta, nec processus digestionis, nec ritus praeparatus ei occasionem dedebat deum semideum fieri in tempore propter promissionem non adimpletam et iuramenti restrictiones.

unit.source: Regret wouldn’t even be an option.
unit.target: Paenitentia quidem non esset consideranda.

unit.source: Lumian had no clue how to locate it by himself.
unit.target: Lumian plane nesciebat quomodo hoc solus invenireret.

unit.source: His only plan was to mimic the incantation for summoning the Abscessed Hand and craft a new series of summoning incantations.
unit.target: Unum consilium habebat: incantationem ad evocandam Manus Abscessae imitari atque novam seriem incantationum componere.

unit.source: He hoped to summon the spirit world creature’s legs, arms, body, and head.
unit.target: Sperabat crura, brachia, corpus, et caput creaturae mundi spirituum evocari.

unit.source: However, this was a risky endeavor.
unit.target: Tamen, hoc conatum periculosum erat.

unit.source: In his dream, Lumian learned from his sister that when the summoning incantation lacked clarity and had no restrictions, the summoned entity could be unpredictable.
unit.target: In somnio suo, Lumian a sorore sua didicit quod, cum incantatio ad evocandum obscuritatem haberet atque nullas limitationes, entitas invocata esse incerta posset.

unit.source: It might be a demigod-level spirit world creature filled with malice, capable of killing the summoner instantly.
unit.target: Potest esse creatura spiritus mundi in gradum semidei, malitia plena, quae evocatorem momento interficere valeat.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t pinpoint the precise direction due to the unknown fragmentation of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
unit.target: Lumian directionem exactam determinare non potuit ob ignotam fragmentationem corporis Manus Abscessae.

unit.source: It could be a relatively intact body missing a hand, or it might have shattered into tiny, peanut‑sized fragments.
unit.target: Esse poterat corpus relative intactum, manum deesse, aut in parva fragmenta, quantitate parva, disiectum esse.

unit.source: Describing it accurately was impossible.
unit.target: Id accurate describere impossibile erat.

unit.source: He could only experiment repeatedly, narrowing down the possibilities.
unit.target: Uni poterat solum iterata experimenta facere, limites possibilitatum restringens.

unit.source: It was akin to playing with his life.
unit.target: Id erat quasi lusus cum vita sua.

unit.source: More importantly, Lumian had already combed through the comprehensive information on common spirit world creatures provided by Madam Magician.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian iam perlegit accuratam informationem de creaturis communibus mundi spirituum, quae Domina Magica praebebat.

unit.source: Still, he found nothing that seemed to be other parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
unit.target: Tamen nihil invenit quod altera pars corporis Manus Abscessae appareret.

unit.source: Lumian desired the Sequence 4 Iron‑blooded Knight potion formula and clues about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
unit.target: Lumian desiderabat formulam potionis Sequenciae IV pro equite sanguinis ferrei atque indicia de reliqua parte corporis Manus Abscessae.

unit.source: This was the reason why he couldn’t make a decision.
unit.target: Idcirco non potuit decisionem capere.

unit.source: He pondered whether to teleport back to Trier now and seek Franca or Jenna’s help in divination, hoping their spiritual insights would provide him with valuable hints.
unit.target: Cogitavit utrum nunc ad Trier teletransportari et auxilium Francae aut Jennae in divinatione quaerere vellet, sperans eorum spirituales perspicientias pretiosa indicia ei tradere.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian reached a decision.
unit.target: Inter has cogitationes, Lumian consilium cepit.

unit.source: The second option!
unit.target: Secunda optio!

unit.source: This was because he remembered something important.
unit.target: Idcirco, quod aliquid magni momenti meminisse recordatus est.

unit.source: Mr. Hanged Man’s reward had yet to materialize.
unit.target: Praemium Domini Suspendi nondum evenit.

unit.source: It was an opportunity to explore the Blue Avenger, a ghost ship that was a relic of the Tudor Empire.
unit.target: Fuit occasio ut Caeruleum Vindicem, navem larvarum quae reliquiae Imperii Tudorensis erat, exploraret.

unit.source: Considering that the Blood Emperor Alista Tudor was once a true god of the Hunter pathway and a half‑mad Red Priest, the Tudor Empire’s inheritance contained the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway, along with Beyonder ingredients and characteristics.
unit.target: Considerans quod Sanguis Imperator Alista Tudor olim verus deus semitae Venatoris atque Red Priest dimidius insanus fuerit, haereditas Imperii Tudorensis continebat formulam potionis Sequenciae IV semitae Venatoris, una cum ingredientis atque proprietatibus Beyonder.

unit.source: It was something to look forward to.
unit.target: Id erat aliquid ad quod prospiciendum esset.

unit.source: Lumian promptly sat down and penned a reply to Madam Magician, expressing his thoughts.
unit.target: Lumian statim consedit et epistolam ad Dominam Magicam scripsit, suas cogitationes enuntians.

unit.source: He also informed her that he would be heading to Tizamo Town to investigate Hisoka’s inheritance.
unit.target: Illi etiam indicavit se ad Oppidum Tizamo properaturum esse ad hereditatem Hisoka indagandam.

unit.source: At 4 p.m., Camus Castiya, accompanied by three dark‑brown Southern Continent natives, knocked on the door of Suite 7 on B3 of Hotel Orella.
unit.target: Hora quarta post meridiem, Camus Castiya, comitatus tribus indigenis coloris fuscati ex Continente Meridionali, ad ianuam Suite 7 in B3 deversorii Orella pulsavit.

unit.source: “They all hail from Tizamo, born and bred. They only ventured to Port Pylos in search of opportunities upon reaching adulthood,” Camus explained in Intisian, introducing the two men and one woman.
unit.target: «Omnes oriundi sunt ex Tizamo, in ea nati et educati; ad Portum Pylos tantum profecti sunt, occasionum quaesitis, cum ad aetatem adultam pervenerunt», explicavit Camus in Intisiano, duo viros et unam feminam introducens.

unit.source: “One is a supplier of Gwadar berries, another married a local and toils at the port, and the third took a less lawful path as a thief.”
unit.target: «Unus est suppeditator bacarum Gwadar, alter locali nupta est et ad portum laborat, tertius autem viam minus legitimam, furtim agendo, secutus est.»

unit.source: One is a relatively wealthy merchant, the other is a dockworker, and the other is a thief.
unit.target: Unus mercator relativus dives est, alter operarius portualis, tertius vero fur.

unit.source: They happen to be at three different social levels, and they are from both genders.
unit.target: Conveniunt in tribus diversis gradibus socialibus, et ex utraque parte generis sunt.

unit.source: This will allow me to understand the situation in Tizamo to the greatest extent and comprehensively.
unit.target: Id mihi licebit ut condicionem Tizamo totam atque amplecte perscrutem.

unit.source: Camus is very professional in this aspect.
unit.target: Camus in hac re valde professionalem animum ostendit.

unit.source: As expected of a former Public Security Officer… Lumian nodded slightly and asked the three subjects in fluent Dutanese, “I’m a scholar of folklore en route to Tizamo.
unit.target: Ut ex praeterito Officeri Securitatis Publicae expectabatur… Lumian leviter annuit et tribus subiectis, lingua Dutana fluente, quaesivit: “Ego studiosus fabularum populorum sum, iter faciens ad Tizamo.

unit.source: But before that, I’d like to learn more about the town.
unit.target: Sed prius quam hoc, plura de oppido cognoscere velim.

unit.source: My Dutanese is a bit rusty, so Mr. Camus will assist in translation.”
unit.target: Lingua Dutana mea paulum rudis est, itaque Domine Camus in translatione auxilio erit.

unit.source: “We’ll heed Officer Camus,” responded the eldest merchant with a smile, quickly seconded by the others.
unit.target: «Audiemus Officeri Camus,» respondit mercator senior cum risu, celeriter ab aliis subnixus.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Lugano and instructed, “I’ll take one to the master bedroom for an exchange. You can entertain the other two.”
unit.target: Lumian ad Lugano se vertit atque imperavit: “Unum ad cubiculum principale ducam pro permutando; tu autem reliquos duos curabis.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lugano replied promptly.
unit.target: “Bene,” respondit Lugano statim.

unit.source: Inside the master bedroom, Lumian courteously seated the merchant in an armchair, positioning himself at the edge of the bed.
unit.target: In cubiculo principali, Lumian mercatorem comiter in sellā collocavit, se ad margine lecti poni curavit.

unit.source: Speaking in Intisian, he inquired, “What’s the primary produce of Tizamo?”
unit.target: Lingua Intisiana loquens, quaesivit: “Quae sunt praecipua producta Tizamo?”

unit.source: Camus, translating, wore a puzzled expression.
unit.target: Camus, interpretans, vultum perplexum habebat.

unit.source: Is Louis Berry truly planning a journey to Tizamo?
unit.target: Num Louis Berry vere iter ad Tizamo parat?

unit.source: It’s evident he’s tracing Twanaku’s footsteps!
unit.target: Manifestum est eum vestigia Twanaku persequi!

unit.source: Camus assumed the role of an Interrogator, staring down at the seated merchant as he conveyed Lumian’s words.
unit.target: Camus munus Interrogatoris suscepit, mercatorem sedente aspiciens, dum verba Lumiani tradebat.

unit.source: The merchant, filled with trepidation, responded, “Sir, we mainly cultivate Gwadar berries, spices, and forest fruits.
unit.target: “Domine, praecipue bacas Gwadar, species aromaticae, et fructus silvarum colimus,” inquit mercator, metu repletus.

unit.source: Numerous plantations dot the surroundings, and we often venture into the forest for hunting, selling both meat and fur.
unit.target: Plurimae plantationes in circumstantia iacent, et saepe in silvas venandum proficiscimur, simulque carnem et pellem vendimus.

unit.source: Additionally, we cut down trees for crafting coffins.
unit.target: Praeterea, arbores caedimus ad sarcophaga conficienda.

unit.source: “That’s… that’s about it.
unit.target: “Hoc… hoc fere est—

unit.source: The remaining effort goes into planting corn and potatoes for our own consumption.”
unit.target: —et reliqua cura destinatur ad sementationem maizei et tuberorum pro nostra consumptione.

unit.source: Lumian absorbed the information and refined his understanding of Dutanese through Camus’s translation.
unit.target: Lumian notitiam sumpsit et per translationem Camusi intellectum suum linguae Dutanae consolidavit.

unit.source: Engaging in casual conversation, Lumian explored the daily lives, sustenance, and leisure activities of the Tizamo residents.
unit.target: In colloquio familiari, Lumian vitam cotidianam, victum atque otium incolarum Tizamo percontatus est.

unit.source: From the merchant’s account, Lumian painted a mental picture of Tizamo.
unit.target: Ex relatione mercatoris, Lumian imaginem animi de Tizamo confecit.

unit.source: Its populace mainly consisted of locals, with outsiders being the proprietors of nearby plantations and some acquired slaves.
unit.target: Populus eum constabat plerumque ex indigenis, cum externos tenerentur ut possessores plantatiorum vicinorum atque ut aliqui servorum adepti.

unit.source: Thanks to the hunting services provided to the Port Pylos gentry, Tizamo maintained a connection with the outside world, avoiding isolation and conservativism.
unit.target: Propter officia venandi ad nobilitatem Portus Pylos praebita, Tizamo nexum cum orbe externo retinebat, vitans segregationem et conservatismum.

unit.source: Although the faith in Death had been eradicated, traces of it lingered in daily life.
unit.target: Quamquam fides in Mortem deleta erat, vestigia eius in vita cotidiana manebant.

unit.source: The townspeople primarily believed in the Eternal Blazing Sun, yet remnants of Death faith were evident, such as frequent visits to the cemetery and the practice of not burying prematurely deceased children in coffins.
unit.target: Incolae praesertim Solem Aeternum Accendens colere solebant, attamen vestigia fidei Mortis evidentia erant, ut crebrae visitationes ad coemeteria et consuetudo puerorum praecociter defunctorum in sarcophagis sepelire non.

unit.source: Each adult prepared a coffin for themselves in advance, and the common means of travel involved using a coffin.
unit.target: Quisque adultus sibi sarcophagum ante praeparabat, et consuetudines itineris mediocriter in sarcophago usui erant.

unit.source: With keen interest, Lumian concluded the discussion and inquired, “Are you familiar with Twanaku Tupián?”
unit.target: Lumian, cum studio flagranti, sermonem concludens interrogavit: “Scitisne Twanaku Tupián?”

unit.source: Finally getting into the meat… Camus exhaled quietly and conveyed the question to the merchant.
unit.target: Postremo in rem intrante… Camus quiete suspiravit et quaestionem mercatori pronuntiavit.

unit.source: A warm smile appeared on the merchant’s face.
unit.target: Super faciem mercatoris risus calidus apparuit.

unit.source: “I do! He’s well‑known in town.”
unit.target: «Scio! Ille in oppido notus est.»

unit.source: “Why?” Camus interjected.
unit.target: “Cur?” inquit Camus.

unit.source: The merchant, with an obsequious smile, responded, “Sir, he should be your colleague.
unit.target: Mercator, risu obsequioso ornatus, respondit: “Domine, ille tibi collegae esse oportet.

unit.source: Twanaku is the first person from Tizamo to join the patrol team.
unit.target: Twanaku primus ex Tizamo est qui ad turmae custodiae accessit.

unit.source: Moreover, he’s rapidly advancing in rank.
unit.target: Praeterea, celeriter in gradu ascendit.

unit.source: He’s a source of pride for us.”
unit.target: Ipse nobis decus est.”

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but emit a soft chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit quin lenem risum edideret.

unit.source: “I’m quite curious about Twanaku’s past.”
unit.target: “Valde curiosus sum de praeteritis Twanaku.”

unit.source: The merchant’s expression shifted slightly as he glanced around.
unit.target: Vultus mercatoris paulum commutatus est, dum circumdabat.

unit.source: “Sirs, did Twanaku commit a crime?
unit.target: “Domini, num Twanaku scelus commisit?

unit.source: Did he join an organization that believes in Death?”
unit.target: Num se ad ordinationem, quae Mortem credit, contulit?”

unit.source: Quite perceptive… Lumian thought, while Camus grumbled in a low voice, “Are we doing the questioning or are you? Just answer truthfully!”
unit.target: Perceptive quidem… Lumian cogitabat, dum Camus voce humili submurmurabat: “Nosne interrogationem facimus aut tu? Sine mendacio responde!”

unit.source: Under the mental pressure of the Interrogator, the dark‑skinned merchant replied with a trembling voice, “I’ve known for a long time that this young man, Twanaku, will surely become extraordinary, but I also know he’ll one day tread the path of blasphemy against a deity.”
unit.target: Sub impetu mentis a Interrogatore, mercator obscura cutis voce tremula respondit: “Iam diu sciebam hunc iuvenem, Twanaku, certe eximium futurum esse, sed etiam scio eum aliquando iter blasphemicum adversus deum percurrere.”

unit.source: Seeing Camus and Lumian awaiting further explanation, the merchant continued, “There was a fire in the Twanaku family.
unit.target: Videntes Camum et Lumian ulteriora explananda exspectantes, mercator perrexit: “Fuit ignis in familia Twanaku.

unit.source: All his kin perished, and only he survived.
unit.target: Omnes cognati eius perierunt, solus ipse superfuit.

unit.source: According to our customs, he’s favored by a deity, spared from death.
unit.target: Secundum consuetudines nostras, a deitate favente, a morte liberatus est.

unit.source: Such individuals often go on to achieve great feats.”
unit.target: Tales saepe ad res magnas adipisci tendunt.

unit.source: The deity’s favor refers to Death here, right?
unit.target: Num hic beneficium divinitatis ad Mortem refertur, nonne?

unit.source: Not succumbing to Death is considered receiving Death’s favor?
unit.target: Non succumbere Morte, id quidem reputatur ut Mortis favorem accipere.

unit.source: Lumian interjected thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian, meditabundus, interposuit.

unit.source: “The fire happened about six years ago?”
unit.target: “Ignis ante circiter sex annos accidit?”

unit.source: “How did you know?” the surprised merchant asked.
unit.target: “Quomodo novisti?” inquit mercator obstupefactus.

unit.source: Then, slapping his forehead, he added, “I’m such a fool.
unit.target: Deinde, frontem pulsans, addidit: “Ego tam stultus sum.

unit.source: You must have investigated it beforehand.”
unit.target: “Id prius perscrutari tibi oportuit.”

unit.source: From the looks of it, the fire somehow brought Twanaku back to life, transforming him into Hisoka…
unit.target: Ex prospectu videtur ignis aliquo modo Twanaku in vitam revocasse, eum in Hisoka transformans…

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “Continue.”
unit.target: “Perge.”

unit.source: Recalling, the merchant said, “Since then, Twanaku fell silent, as if in shock.
unit.target: Meminens, mercator dixit: “Ex illo tempore, Twanaku in silentium cecidit, quasi stupens.

unit.source: He no longer participated in Mass or entered the cathedral of God.
unit.target: Iam nec in Missa participavit nec in cathedralem Dei intravit.

unit.source: Later, he left Tizamo for Port Pylos.”
unit.target: Postea Tizamo relictus ad Portum Pylos se contulit.

unit.source: Was Twanaku unafraid of scrutiny for acting so unusually?
unit.target: Num Twanaku investigationem non timebat, ob tam insolitam agendi rationem?

unit.source: Did he not bother to feign his faith?
unit.target: Num fidem suam simulare negligebat?

unit.source: By then, Hisoka had already become a Beyonder of the Devil pathway, making it impossible for him to participate in the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s Mass?
unit.target: Iam Hisoka factus erat Beyonder semitae Diaboli, quod ei impossibilis reddebat participationem in Missa Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti?

unit.source: Where did his first potion come from?
unit.target: Unde prima pocio eius orta est?

unit.source: Lumian pondered while Camus translated and asked, “Does Twanaku frequently return to Tizamo?”
unit.target: Lumian cogitabat, dum Camus interpretatus est, et quaesivit: “Num Twanaku saepe ad Tizamo revertitur?”

unit.source: “He comes back to Tizamo every year.
unit.target: “Quotannis ad Tizamo redit—

unit.source: “I’m not sure how often or for how long,” the merchant truthfully replied.
unit.target: —‘Nescio quotiens nec per quamdiu,’ respondit mercator sincere.

unit.source: “Where does he stay when he returns to Tizamo?” Lumian inquired further.
unit.target: “Ubi manet cum ad Tizamo revertitur?” interrogavit Lumian ulterius.

unit.source: The merchant smoothly replied, “At his own place.
unit.target: Mercator leniter respondit: “In domo sua.

unit.source: After joining the patrol team and amassing wealth, he rebuilt the burnt‑down house.”
unit.target: Postquam turmae custodiae se adiunxit et copias collexit, domum incensam refecit.

unit.source: Rebuilt the house that was destroyed in the fire…
unit.target: Domum, quae igne deleta erat, refecit…

unit.source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and then asked, “Are there any special folklore festivals in Tizamo?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus deinde interrogavit: “Suntne quaedam festalia specialia fabularum populorum in Tizamo?”

unit.source: 658 Deep Desire
unit.target: 658 Profundus Desiderium

unit.source: The merchant responded cautiously to Camus’s translation, “Sir, we don’t really have any special folklore festivals.
unit.target: Mercator cum cautela respondit ad translationem Camus, “Domine, revera nullos habemus festos populares speciales.

unit.source: We only celebrate two festivals every year.
unit.target: Solum duas festivitates omni anno celebramus.

unit.source: One is the Sun Sacrifice in December, and the other is the New Sun Festival in June.”
unit.target: Una est Sacrificium Solis in Decembri, et altera est Novum Festum Solis in Iunio.

unit.source: The Sun Sacrifice was a recurring festival for the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, marking the day with the longest daylight of the year when the sun reached its zenith at noon.
unit.target: Sacrificium Solis erat festum recurrens Ecclesiae Aeternae Flammantis Solis, diem designans cum luce diurna longissima anni, cum sol ad apicem meridie attingebat.

unit.source: In the Northern Continent, it took place in mid-to-late June, while in the Southern Continent, due to the reversed seasons, it occurred in mid-to-late December.
unit.target: In Continente Septentrionali hoc eveniebat ex media ad finem Iunii, dum in Continente Meridionali, ob tempora conversa, eveniebat ex media ad finem Decembri.

unit.source: The New Sun Festival, originating from the believers of the Southern Continent’s Eternal Blazing Sun, involved celebrations during the longest night and shortest days, welcoming the return of the sun and anticipating more light and warmer weather.
unit.target: Novum Festum Solis, a fidelibus Continentis Meridionalis Ecclesiae Aeternae Flammantis Solis ortum, celebrationes complectebatur per noctem longissimam et dies brevissimos, reditum solis excipiens et lucem ampliorem necnon calorem venturum praenuntians.

unit.source: This celebration often coincided with the New Year in many parts of the Southern Continent, gradually merging the two festivities.
unit.target: Haec celebratio saepe coincidebat cum Novo Anno in multis partibus Continentis Meridionalis, duo festivitates paulatim coniungens.

unit.source: The merchant explained that the citizens of Tizamo Town solely celebrated festivals connected to the Eternal Blazing Sun, having abandoned the traditions related to Death.
unit.target: Mercator explanavit cives oppidi Tizamo solum celebrasse festivitates cum Aeternae Flammantis Solis coniunctas, consuetudines mortis relictos.

unit.source: He reflected for a moment and added, “It’s been like this for a long time—since my grandfather was born.”
unit.target: Paululum cogitavit et addidit, “Iamdiu ita fuit—ex quo avus meus natus est.”

unit.source: Matani, particularly Port Pylos and the gold mine city of Devise, had been Intis’s colony for nearly a century.
unit.target: Matani, praesertim Portus Pylos et urbs fodina auri Devise, fuisset colonia Intis per fere centum annos.

unit.source: The native population was compelled to convert generations ago, becoming followers of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
unit.target: Populatio indigena, abhinc generationes conversioni coacta, facta est sectatrix Aeternae Flammantis Solis.

unit.source: This, however, was limited to areas effectively managed by colonial institutions in the past.
unit.target: Hoc tamen ad regiones limitatum erat, quae ab institutionibus colonialibus in praeterito efficaciter administrabantur.

unit.source: When Lumian arrived in Port Pylos, his first impression was: at the docks, in the heart of the city, it resembled the port cities of Intis.
unit.target: Cum Lumian ad Portum Pylos pervenit, prima eius impressio fuit: ad ripa portus, in corde urbis, similis erat urbibus portuariis Intis.

unit.source: Yet, the workers’ skin was darker and browner.
unit.target: Attamen, cutis operariorum obscurior et fusca erat.

unit.source: The streets frequented by Intisians and Feynapotterians were sparsely populated and desolate.
unit.target: Viae, quas Intisii et Feynapotteriani frequentabant, exiguo populatae erant et desolatae.

unit.source: After passing Hotel Orella and exploring other areas of Port Pylos, various buildings with West Balam characteristics emerged.
unit.target: Postquam deversorium Orella transegerunt et alias partes Portus Pylos exploraverunt, varia aedificia cum notis Occidentis Balam emerserunt.

unit.source: More pedestrians populated the streets, and the echoes of Dutanese filled the air.
unit.target: Plures pedestres vias replebant, et resonantia Dutanica aerem complebant.

unit.source: Lumian sought further details, indirectly confirming the merchant’s words.
unit.target: Lumian plura quaerebat, verba mercatoris indirecte confirmans.

unit.source: Interrogator Camus discerned no signs of deception.
unit.target: Interrogator Camus nullas deceptionis notas animadvertit.

unit.source: “What things have left a deep impression on you since you were young that you still remember from time to time?” Lumian shifted the conversation.
unit.target: "Quae res te, ex iuventute, graviter impresserunt, quas adhuc interdum meministi?" Lumian sermonem mutavit.

unit.source: Recalling, the merchant replied, “Grand funerals… Newly built coffins…
unit.target: Recordans, mercator respondit, “Magnae funebres caerimoniae… Arcae funebres nuper constructae…

unit.source: “The primitive tribe that clashes with us every year… The occasional scream at night because of them…
unit.target: “Tribus primitiva quae nobis quotannis contegitur… Vociferationes nocturnae interdum propter eos…

unit.source: “Everyone’s hardworking, calm, and well-educated. We get angry, but we don’t argue on the spot or shout. We choose to find the padre, officers, and judges to determine who’s right and who’s wrong…”
unit.target: “Omnes industrii, tranquilli, et bene eruditi sunt. Irāmur, sed neque in loco contendimus neque clamamus. Eligimus patrem, magistratus, et iudices quaerere, ut rectum ab iniusto discernerimus…”

unit.source: Camus translated the merchant’s words to Lumian, adding a few comments.
unit.target: Camus verba mercatoris Luminum vertit, nonnulla addens.

unit.source: “That’s indeed the case. I’ve been to Tizamo. The people there are very docile. Even if they’re treated unfairly, they rarely resist violently. The manor owners of the surrounding plantations love to hire them, reducing the cost of buying slaves.
unit.target: "Id vere ita est. Ad Tizamo perrexi. Populus ibi valde mansuetus est. Etsi iniuste tractentur, raro vehementer resistunt. Domini praediorum circumstantium eos libere conducere amant, sumptus emptionis servorum minuendo.

unit.source: “Of course, it’s not that they’re emotionless and won’t resist. Instead, they tend to abide by order and follow the official processes to resolve problems. I-I guess they can be considered outstanding believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun?”
unit.target: "Certe, non est quod affectibus carentes sint nec resistent. Immo ordinem servare et officiales processus sequi, quaestionibus solvendis, malunt. Credeor eos esse praestantes fidem habentes Aeternae Flammantis Solis?"

unit.source: The honorific name of the Eternal Blazing Sun contained the description “Embodiment of Order.”
unit.target: Nomen honorificum Aeternae Flammantis Solis descriptionem “Incarnatio Ordinis” continebat.

unit.source: As a member of the Feynapotter royal lineage, Camus undoubtedly believed in the Earth Mother.
unit.target: Ut membrum regiae stirpis Feynapotter, Camus indubitanter in Matrem Terram credidit.

unit.source: He knew that Louis Berry hailed from the Intis Republic and was likely a believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
unit.target: Sciebat Ludovicum Berry ex Re Publica Intis provenire et verisimiliter fidem habere Aeternae Flammantis Solis.

unit.source: Lumian stood up, extending his arms with a smile. “Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: Lumian surrexit, brachia extendens cum risu. “Laudate Solem!”

unit.source: “Praise the Sun!” The merchant hastily followed suit.
unit.target: “Laudate Solem!” Mercator festinanter secutus est.

unit.source: Lumian settled back into his seat, contemplating for a few fleeting moments.
unit.target: Lumian iterum sedebat, per paucis momentis volubiliter meditans.

unit.source: “Have you experienced any strange dreams?”
unit.target: “Num aliquos somnia insolita habuisti?”

unit.source: The merchant nodded, then shook his head.
unit.target: Mercator annuit, deinde caput negavit.

unit.source: “Many, but they slip away from memory. Do you not encounter such dreams?”
unit.target: “Multa, sed ex memoria evanescunt. Num non incidis talia somnia?”

unit.source: Indeed. Dreams often elude the control of one’s consciousness.
unit.target: Immo, somnia saepe imperium conscientiae effugiunt.

unit.source: They can reveal spiritual insights, mirror suppressed desires, or reflect events from the day.
unit.target: Possunt spiritualia consilia revelare, desideria recondita speculare, aut eventa diei referre.

unit.source: Sometimes, these elements intertwine, resulting in strange and unpredictable dreams.
unit.target: Aliquando haec elementa inter se texuntur, producens somnia insolita et imprevisibilia.

unit.source: I, too, frequently encounter such dreams.
unit.target: Ego quoque saepe talia somnia experior.

unit.source: In the past, when I battled the Demon corruption, they were even more bizarre and exaggerated…
unit.target: Olim, cum corruptionem Daemonis pugnarem, ea adhuc mirabiliora atque hyperbolica erant…

unit.source: Lumian sensed that the merchant’s response was impeccable.
unit.target: Lumian sensit responsionem mercatoris esse impeccablem.

unit.source: If the other party could pinpoint a specific strange dream, that might raise suspicion.
unit.target: Si altera pars somnium insolitum certum delineare posset, id suspicionem excitare poterat.

unit.source: Either the dream was exceptionally strange and unforgettable, or the merchant was abnormal and had prepared in advance before coming.
unit.target: Aut somnium eximie insolutum atque inobliviabile erat, aut mercator abnormis fuit et prius praeparaverat.

unit.source: After discussing other matters, Lumian escorted the merchant out of the master bedroom.
unit.target: Postquam alias res disseruerunt, Lumian mercatorem e conclavi principali secum eduxit.

unit.source: The responses of the other two Tizamons were similar to the merchant’s, only supplementing the details they observed at their level and sharing encounters with their own characteristics.
unit.target: Responsa duorum aliorum Tizamorum mercatoris similia erant, additis singularibus quae ad gradum suum observaverant, et casus proprios notis communicantes.

unit.source: Lumian found no traces of the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Lumian nullas vestigia Festi Somniorum invenit.

unit.source: If the Dream Festival is genuinely linked to Tizamo, there’s only one possibility: When the townsfolk fall asleep, they enter a dream world to celebrate the festival.
unit.target: Si Festum Somniorum vere Tizamo coniungitur, una tantum possibilitas est: cum cives obdormiant, in mundum somniorum ingrediuntur ut festum celeberent.

unit.source: Upon waking, they forget everything…
unit.target: Expergiscente, omnia obliviscuntur…

unit.source: Or, there’s another possibility.
unit.target: Aut alia possibilitas est.

unit.source: Two factions may be involved in Hisoka’s Tizamo Town prank.
unit.target: Duae factiones in ioco Hisoka de oppido Tizamo implicari possunt.

unit.source: First, the citizens of Tizamo.
unit.target: Primum, cives Tizamo.

unit.source: Second, the primitive tribe in the nearby forest.
unit.target: Secundo, tribus primitiva in silva proxima.

unit.source: Could the Dream Festival be a celebration for that primitive tribe?
unit.target: Potestne Festum Somniorum celebrare illam tribum primitivam?

unit.source: Hisoka’s prank impacted the Dream Festival, leading the primitive tribe to suddenly attack Tizamo, resulting in significant casualties and concealing the traces of his advancement ritual to Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Iocus Hisoka Festum Somniorum affecit, tribum primitivam Tizamo subito impetum facere compellens, quo magnis caedibus evenit et vestigia rituum progressionis ad Apostolum Desiderii celata sunt.

unit.source: Lumian pondered as he walked Camus and the three Tizamons to the door.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est dum Camus et tres Tizamones ad ianuam ducebat.

unit.source: Upon returning to the master bedroom, he stood before the desk and gazed at the stone wall in front of him.
unit.target: Rediens ad conclave principale, stetit ante mensam et parietem lapideum qui ante eum stabat, contemplatus est.

unit.source: His eyes flickered with anticipation and unease.
unit.target: Oculi eius exspectatione et inquietudine micabant.

unit.source: His decision to stay in the Southern Continent and actively pursue Hisoka’s inheritance was indeed to grow amid blood, fire, chaos, and conflict, securing more acting opportunities.
unit.target: Consilium eius in Continente Meridionali manendi et actu Hereditatem Hisokae persequendi re vera erat ad crescendum inter sanguinem, ignem, chaos et conflictum, atque ampliorem occasionem agendi assecurans.

unit.source: He aimed to open the door to godhood and advance to Sequence 4 as soon as possible.
unit.target: Illud intendebat: ostium deitatis aperire et ad Sequenciam IV quam primum progredi.

unit.source: The reason for his impatience was: he saw a glimmer of hope in reviving his sister!
unit.target: Causa impatiens eius erat: speciem spei reanimandae sororis suae intuebatur!

unit.source: The state of the Naboredisleys on Hanth Island provided him with that glimmer of hope.
unit.target: Status Naboredisleyorum in Insula Hanth ei illam speciem spei praebuit.

unit.source: This hope stemmed from the belief that a high-ranking figure of the Earth Mother Church might possess the ability to divide another person’s soul.
unit.target: Haec spes ex fide orta est quod figura eminentis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae animam alicuius alterius dividere valeat.

unit.source: This would allow each soul fragment to grow into a relatively separate individual through rebirth.
unit.target: Id permittet ut singula fragmenta animae per renascentiam in individua relative separata crescere queant.

unit.source: Aurore’s soul fragment was sealed within Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Fragmentum animae Aurore in corpore Lumiani sigillatum erat.

unit.source: Perhaps a high-ranking member of the Church of Earth Mother could use one or more soul fragments to resurrect Aurore in a new form!
unit.target: Forsitan membrum eminens Ecclesiae Matris Terrae unum vel plura fragmenta animae ad Aurore in nova forma resurrectum uti posset!

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t certain if such a plan could be realized or if it constituted true “resurrection,” but it was the most plausible method he had encountered so far.
unit.target: Lumian non certo sciebat an talis consilium perficere posset aut veram “resurrectionem” constitueret, sed methodus maxime plausibilis erat quam usque ad hunc diem advenerat.

unit.source: He was determined to give it a try.
unit.target: Determinatus est id conari.

unit.source: Of course, he couldn’t experiment with Aurore’s soul fragment directly.
unit.target: Certe, fragmento animae Aurore directe experimentari non potuit.

unit.source: His plan was to deliberately create some soul fragments in future cullings and seek help from the Church of Earth Mother to see if they could be reborn and if the person who returned was the same individual.
unit.target: Consilium eius erat, in futuris depurationibus, aliqua fragmenta animae deliberate creare et auxilium petere a Ecclesia Matris Terrae, ut videatur an renasci possent et an persona quae redeat eadem esset.

unit.source: Once all the details were confirmed, he would revive Aurore.
unit.target: Quotiens omnia singula confirmata essent, Aurore revivificabit.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t believe he had the qualifications to collaborate with the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Lumian non credebat se idoneum esse ad cooperandum cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Only by becoming a demigod and relying on the secret organization, the Tarot Club, could he gain the Church of Earth Mother’s attention and fulfill the transaction conditions proposed by the other party.
unit.target: Solum, factus semideus et innixus organizationi secretae, “Tarot Club”, poterat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae attentionem captare et condicionibus transactionis ab altera parte propositis obtemperare.

unit.source: For this, Lumian couldn’t wait to obtain godhood and advance to Sequence 4.
unit.target: Propter hoc, Lumian exspectare non poterat ut deitatem adipisceretur et ad Sequenciam IV procederet.

unit.source: At times, Lumian wished his sister were also a Blessed of Celestial Worthy and had inherited the ancient castle.
unit.target: Interdum Lumian optabat ut soror eius etiam esset Beata Caelestis Digna et antiquum castrum hereditasset.

unit.source: This way, her resurrection might be more straightforward.
unit.target: Hoc modo eius resurrectio fortasse simplicior esset.

unit.source: Yes, to extract Aurore’s soul fragment, I must undo Mr. Fool’s seal.
unit.target: Ita, ad extrahendum fragmentum animae Aurore, sigillum Domini Stulti dissolvere debeo.

unit.source: To undo his seal, I have to wait for Termiboros to become very weak.
unit.target: Ut sigillum eius dissolvas, exspectandum est, ut Termiboros valde infirmus fiat.

unit.source: For Termiboros to weaken, I need to continuously extract his power at a higher level.
unit.target: Ut Termiboros debilitaret, necesse est me potentiam eius ex alio gradu continuo extrahere.

unit.source: And to withstand the power of a higher level, I have to possess godhood and advance step by step…
unit.target: Et ut potentiam gradus superioris sustineam, deitatem habere ac gradatim progredi debeo…

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts gradually clarified, and he unprecedentedly yearned for an advancement.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani paulatim clarificatae sunt, et inusitate progressionem desideravit.

unit.source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Trier, Districtus Cathédralis Commemorativae, Conclave 702, 9 Via Orosai.

unit.source: Franca lay on the bed beneath a velvet blanket, her cheeks still flushed, eyes moist, and her expression unusually complicated.
unit.target: Franca iacebat in lecto sub stragula velutinum, maxillae eius adhuc rubentes, oculi humidique, et vultus eius insolite perplexus.

unit.source: Beside her, Jenna rested under the same velvet cover.
unit.target: Secum, Jenna sub eodem stragulo velutinorum quievit.

unit.source: She had slipped into a deep slumber, her brows furrowed with a mix of exhaustion, satisfaction, resistance, and nostalgia.
unit.target: Illa in profundum somnum lapsa erat, supercilia eius mixturae lassitudinis, satisfactionis, resistantiae, et nostalgiae contrita erant.

unit.source: Her outstretched arms and exposed fair skin still bore traces of the recent fervor.
unit.target: Brachia eius extenditata et cutis nuda candida adhuc vestigia recentis ardoris portabant.

unit.source: Franca gazed at Jenna and let out a sudden sigh.
unit.target: Franca Jennam aspexit et subitam suspirationem edidit.

unit.source: The experience had exceeded her expectations, yet a sense of emptiness lingered in her heart.
unit.target: Experientia ea exspectationes suae superaverat, sed sensus inanitatis in corde eius permanebat.

unit.source: It was beautiful in the moment, but what would transpire after the digestion of the Pleasure potion?
unit.target: In momento pulchrum erat, sed quid eveniret post digestionem poculi Voluptatis?

unit.source: Could physical intimacy and emotional distance coexist?
unit.target: Possuntne intimitas corporalis et distantia animi coexistere?

unit.source: Did overwhelming pleasure pave the way for sorrow? Was it the agony of sinking into oblivion while resisting salvation?
unit.target: Num voluptas opprimenti viam luctus fecit? Fuitne id dolor deprimendi in oblivionem, dum salutem repugnabat?

unit.source: Sigh… Franca released another soft sigh.
unit.target: Suspiravit… Franca aliam levem suspirationem edidit.

unit.source: She sensed that her Pleasure potion had been substantially digested.
unit.target: Sensiuit poculum Voluptatis eius admodum digestum fuisse.

unit.source: Matani State, Port Pylos.
unit.target: Status Matani, Portus Pylos.

unit.source: Lumian, sipping a glass of Gwadar, looked up and spoke to Lugano as if discussing the weather.
unit.target: Lumian, poculum Gwadar sorbillans, sursum aspexit et ad Lugano locutus est quasi de caelo dissereret.

unit.source: “We’re heading to Tizamo Town today. Will you join Ludwig and me, or will you stay here and wait for us?
unit.target: “Hodie ad oppidum Tizamo pergimus. Mecum et Ludovico ades, an hic maneas et nos exspectabis?

unit.source: “Let me warn you in advance. The situation in Tizamo Town might be very dangerous.”
unit.target: "Praemonere te ante omnia sinas. Status in oppido Tizamo fortasse valde periculosus erit."

unit.source: Very dangerous… He wanted to say he’d stay in Port Pylos, but memories of Father Montserrat flashed in his mind.
unit.target: Valde periculosum… Vellet dicere se in Portu Pylos manere, sed memoriae Patris Montserrat in mente eius fulserunt.

unit.source: Gritting his teeth, he replied, “I’m with you.”
unit.target: Dentes strinxit et respondit: “Sum tecum.”

unit.source: If danger lurked in Tizamo Town, he could rely on his boss to bail him out. But here? Only himself!
unit.target: Si periculum in oppido Tizamo latebat, magistrum suum sperare poterat ut eum eriperet. Sed hic? Solum se ipsum!

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly and didn’t say more.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit nec plura enuntiavit.

unit.source: After checking out and hitting the street, he chuckled at Lugano and Ludwig, “Do we take a coffin to Tizamo, or should we grab a carriage?”
unit.target: Postquam rem exasperavit et in viam profectus est, ad Lugano et Ludovicum risum edidit, “Utrum arcam funebrem ad Tizamo feramus, an cisium sumamus?”

unit.source: Before Lugano and Ludwig could answer, a four-wheeled, four-seater carriage rolled up from under the shade.
unit.target: Antequam Lugano et Ludovicus responderent, cisium quattuor rotarum, quattuor sedens, sub umbra profectum est.

unit.source: The carriage’s driver, a young man, kept his head low, not daring to look away.
unit.target: Auriga cisii, iuvenis, caput humile tenebat, non audens oculos avertire.

unit.source: Coming to a stop, Camus Castiya emerged. He forced a smile and said to Lumian, “Thanks for your help these past days. I’ll escort you to Tizamo.”
unit.target: Stantibus confirmatis, Camus Castiya exortus est. Risum coegit et Lumiano dedit verba: “Gratias pro auxilio his proximis diebus. Te ad Tizamo comitabiturus sum.”

unit.source: 659 Poor “Monster”
unit.target: 659 Pauper “Monstrum”

unit.source: Observing Camus’s expression, as if compelled to act at gunpoint, Lumian didn’t hold back.
unit.target: Vultum Camus observans, quasi ad agendum sub coercitione sclopetorum, Lumian non retinuit.

unit.source: He replied with a smile, “I’d like that.”
unit.target: Risus in ore habens, respondit: “Placet mihi.”

unit.source: It was evident to him that the brass of the patrol team, or even Admiral Querarill himself, was concerned about Louis Berry wandering around their territory.
