unit.target: Ei patebat quod magistratus cohortis vigiliae, vel etiam ipse Admiral Querarill, de vagatione Louis Berry in eorum territorio solliciti essent.

unit.source: Tizamo, where he was headed, was located near the primitive forest and had close ties to a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Tizamo, quo se dirigebat, prope silvam rudimentariam sita erat et nexūs proximos habebat cum Apostolo Desiderii Sequenciae V.

unit.source: Therefore, two additional patrol team members with a certain relationship with Louis Berry were sent to accompany him.
unit.target: Ergo duo sodales additi cohortis vigiliae, qui cum Louis Berry aliquo nexū coniuncti erant, ad eum comitandum missi sunt.

unit.source: Even if they couldn’t prevent trouble, they could at least send word before it became a catastrophe.
unit.target: Etiamsi incommoda vitare non possent, saltem nuntium mittere poterant antequam calamitas oriretur.

unit.source: As for why they didn’t directly stop Louis Berry from heading to Tizamo Town, it was partly because Lumian had hinted at the faction backing him when he submitted Twanaku’s head.
unit.target: Quoad causam cur Louis Berry directe prohiberi ne ad oppidum Tizamo perveniret, partim quia Lumian, cum caput Twanaku exhiberet, factionem sibi favorem insinuaverat.

unit.source: Without a conflict of principles, Admiral Querarill likely wouldn’t make things difficult for him.
unit.target: Sine conflictu principiis, Admiral Querarill verisimiliter res ei non complicaret.

unit.source: Secondly, Louis Berry’s investigations and adventures seemed to bring calamity, but they had exposed hidden dangers ahead of time.
unit.target: Secundo, inquisitiones et casus Louis Berry calamitatem parere videbantur, sed ante tempus pericula occulta patefecerant.

unit.source: If the problem remained concealed and continued to evolve, Matani and Admiral Querarill might not be able to handle it in a year or two.
unit.target: Si quaestio abscondita maneret et evolveretur, Matani atque Admiral Querarill fortasse intra unum vel duo annos id regere non possent.

unit.source: When the time came, blood might flow like a river.
unit.target: Cum tempus advenisset, sanguis ut flumen effluere posset.

unit.source: Kolobo, acting as the carriage driver, gazed ahead stonily.
unit.target: Kolobo, vecturae auriga fungens, vultū lapideo ante se aspexit.

unit.source: He fumbled for a pair of sunglasses and slid them onto the bridge of his nose.
unit.target: Manū incerta, par lenticulōrum solārium quaesivit et in pontem nasi sui induxit.

unit.source: There were no visible injuries on his body.
unit.target: In corpore eius vulnera manifesta non erant.

unit.source: As Camus held the carriage door open, he watched Louis Berry board, leading a young boy by the hand.
unit.target: Dum Camus iānam vectūrae tenēbat, spectābat Louis Berry conscendere, iuvenem puerum manu ducēns.

unit.source: “He’s going to Tizamo too?” Camus blurted in surprise.
unit.target: “Ad Tizamo quoque itur?” in obstupore exclamāvit Camus.

unit.source: He had assumed Louis Berry would leave his servant and godson at Hotel Orella, joining them later after dealing with Tizamo Town’s issues.
unit.target: Putāverat Louis Berry servum atque filiolum (godson) suum ad Hotel Orella relinqueret, et postea se cum illīs iungere, rem oppidi Tizamo solvendam.

unit.source: However, the adventurer was now bringing a young child to Tizamo, and it was evident this wasn’t a leisurely trip.
unit.target: At vero, adventor nunc puerum parvum ad Tizamo ducebat, et patebābat iter non esse otiosum.

unit.source: It was very dangerous!
unit.target: Valde periculosum erat!

unit.source: Lumian’s left foot remained on the ground, and his right foot halted at the carriage’s edge.
unit.target: Pes sinistrum Lumiani in terra mansit, et dexter pedis ad limen vectūrae stetit.

unit.source: He smiled and spoke, “My godson is fascinated by jungle fruits, the unique beasts I hunt, and various spices.”
unit.target: Risus faciens et locūtus est: “Filiolus meus fascinatur fructibus silvarum, bestiīs singulāribus quās venor, et variīs condimentīs.”

unit.source: Earlier, the Tizamons had mentioned their hometown’s specialties, highlighting the excellence of roasted meat.
unit.target: Prius, Tizamōnēs specialitātēs patriae suā memorāverant, praecipuē excellentiam carnis assātā extollentes.

unit.source: The blend of spices and the distinctive gamey flavor of wild beasts in the forest contributed to Tizamo Town’s unique delicacies.
unit.target: Miscellānea condimentōrum et singularis sapor ferārum venātiōnum in silva deliciās unicas oppidi Tizamo conferebant.

unit.source: Ludwig, already settled in the carriage, swallowed, seemingly in sync with Lumian.
unit.target: Ludwig, iam in vectūra consedit, glūtīens videbātur in harmonia cum Lumian.

unit.source: Aren’t you worried about endangering your godson? Why are you so confident?
unit.target: Nonne tibi sollicitūdō est ne filiolum tuum periclitetur? Cur tam fidēns es?

unit.source: Camus didn’t press, simply signaling Lugano with his eyes to hurry up.
unit.target: Camus non pressit, sed oculīs Lugano significāvit, ut festinaret.

unit.source: Lugano cast a glance at the peculiar carriage driver, who trembled slightly beneath his black sunglasses.
unit.target: Lugano oculōs iecit in aurigam vectūrae insolitam, quī sub lenticulīs nigrīs leviter tremēre videbātur.

unit.source: He entered the carriage and took a seat across from Lumian and Ludwig.
unit.target: In vectūrā intrāvit atque sedem collocāvit trans Lumian et Ludwig.

unit.source: Camus shut the carriage door and settled beside Kolobo.
unit.target: Camus iānam vectūrae claudēns iuxta Kolobo consedit.

unit.source: With a sigh, he remarked, “You can remove your sunglasses now. It’s been hard on you.”
unit.target: Suspirāns inquit: “Nunc lenticulās solāriās auferre potēs; te fatigāvērunt.”

unit.source: “Alright, alright, alright.” Kolobo seemed to shiver as if struck by an icy wind.
unit.target: “Bene, bene, bene.” Kolobo vidēbātur tremēre, quasi ventō glaciālī percussus esset.

unit.source: His teeth chattered, and his tremors intensified.
unit.target: Dentēs eius crepitāvērunt, et tremōrēs eius intensī factī sunt.

unit.source: Camus turned to him, surprised.
unit.target: Camus ad eum conversus est, stupēns.

unit.source: “Didn’t you strike a deal face-to-face with Louis Berry? Why are you still so afraid?”
unit.target: “Nonne cum Louis Berry facie ad faciem stipulām fecistī? Cur adhūc tam timidus es?”

unit.source: Not seeing him directly again!
unit.target: Non rursus eum directe videns!

unit.source: “Alright, alright, alright.” Kolobo removed his sunglasses, taking more than ten seconds to compose himself.
unit.target: “Bene, bene, bene.” Kolobo lenticulās solāriās removit, et plus quam decem secundīs ad se componendum tempus tulit.

unit.source: In a hushed tone, he confessed with fear, “I feel like my fingers, my arms, my insides, even my head… all eaten.”
unit.target: In tono submittō, metu confitebātur: “Sentiō digitos meōs, brachīa meā, intima necnon caput meum… omnia devorāta esse.”

unit.source: “That, that…”
unit.target: “Id, id…”

unit.source: “That what?” Camus struggled to comprehend why the Monster’s demeanor had shifted so drastically, sensing that the issue might be significant.
unit.target: “Id quid?” Camus conābātur intellegere cur habitus Monstrī tantopere mutātus esset, suspiciēns rem esse magnā.

unit.source: Kolobo swallowed hard and continued, “That… that child… is also… very dangerous!”
unit.target: Kolobo vehementer glūtīt et continuāvit: “Id… ille puer… quoque… valde periculosus est!”

unit.source: “Though I haven’t laid eyes on him, I sense a looming threat, like facing a lion, a tiger, a python, ready to eat me at any moment.”
unit.target: “Quamquam eum non intueor, minam imminēns sentio, sicut cum leone, tigre, et pythone, quōvis momento mē edere parātī sint.”

unit.source: “…” Camus was stunned, a hiss escaping his lips.
unit.target: “…” Camus obstupuit, sibilus ex labiīs eius egressus.

unit.source: Until now, Kolobo had never exhibited such fear except in the presence of three individuals radiating danger: Desire Apostle Twanaku with Wraith powers, and Louis Berry, capable of hunting Twanaku.
unit.target: Usque ad hunc diem, Kolobo talem timōrem numquam ostendit, nisi coram tribūs personīs periculum emanantibus: Apostolō Desiderī Twanaku cum viribus umbrārum, et Louis Berry, quī Twanaku venārī poterat.

unit.source: Could this boy match them?
unit.target: An hic puer illīs aequare possit?

unit.source: Is he also a Beyonder, perhaps a Sequence 5 Beyonder?
unit.target: Estne etiam Beyonder, fortasse Beyonder Sequenciae V?

unit.source: No, it’s not merely a Sequence 5 matter.
unit.target: Non, non solum res Sequenciae V est.

unit.source: Our patrol team’s captain is a Sequence 5, yet Kolobo never mentioned feeling such foreboding in his presence.
unit.target: Dux cohortis vigiliae nostrā Sequenciae V est, sed Kolobo numquam talem praemonitionem in eius praesentia sensit.

unit.source: There must be something unique about these three individuals!
unit.target: Debet aliquid unicum de his tribūs personīs esse!

unit.source: Regardless, the boy is undoubtedly extraordinary and hazardous!
unit.target: Quamquam, puer indubitanter extraordinārius atque periculosus est!

unit.source: No wonder Louis Berry is bringing his godson to Tizamo without worry.
unit.target: Non mirum est quod Louis Berry filiolum suum ad Tizamo sine cūrā ducat.

unit.source: Perhaps the child poses an even greater threat…
unit.target: Fortasse puer etiam maiorem minam ponat…

unit.source: Camus unraveled his earlier confusion, stifling his curiosity, refraining from probing further with Kolobo.
unit.target: Camus praecedentem confusioem suam explicāvit, cūriā suā cohibēns, et ulterius cum Kolobo inquisīre abstinuit.

unit.source: In the confines of the four-wheeled carriage, even with the barrier between them, Louis Berry caught wind of their hushed exchange!
unit.target: In confinibus vectūrae quattuor rotārum, etiam cum intervallō inter eōs, Louis Berry eōrum tacītum colloquium didicit.

unit.source: Considering the intel gleaned from the Fog Sea, Camus harbored suspicions that Louis Berry was a Sequence 5 Beyonder following the Hunter pathway.
unit.target: Ex Mari Nebulae perceptīs, Camus suspicātus est Louis Berry Beyonder Sequenciae V esse, viam Venātōriam sequēns.

unit.source: Those of this pathway were renowned for their sharp senses—exceptional vision, acute sense of smell, and keen hearing.
unit.target: Hi, quī hanc viam sequebantur, claros sensūs habēbant—visum eximium, olfactum acutum, atque auditiam perspicacem.

unit.source: A Beyonder of the Monster pathway is quite intriguing.
unit.target: Beyonder viā Monstrī vere mirandus est.

unit.source: Even without laying eyes on Ludwig or hearing his voice, Louis can sense his ominous aura, a being who devours everything…
unit.target: Etiamsi Ludwigum nec intueātur nec vocem eius audiātur, Louis tamen eius auram ominosam sentīre potest, entem quī omnia devorat…

unit.source: Lumian, leaning against the carriage wall, toyed with his golden straw hat, shooting Ludwig a knowing smile.
unit.target: Lumian, ad parietem vectūrae reclinātus, pileum stramineum aureum ludēbat, Ludwig subrīdēns scienter aspiciēns.

unit.source: Could it be that this “little child” has truly taken a liking to Kolobo and Camus?
unit.target: Num id fieri potest ut hic “puer parvus” Kolobo atque Camus vere amātus sit?

unit.source: Indeed. These are two Beyonders who haven’t succumbed to severe corruption.
unit.target: Immo. Hi duo sunt Beyonder, quī corruptionī gravissimāe non cederunt.

unit.source: Ludwig likely had a momentary lapse in control… Heh heh, Camus may not have noticed, but Kolobo reacted instantly, sensing the danger?
unit.target: Ludwig verisimiliter brevem imperīī lapsum habuit… Heh heh, Camus fortasse non animadvērit, sed Kolobo statim, periculum sentiēns, reaguit.

unit.source: Lumian acknowledged Ludwig with a nod.
unit.target: Lumian, capite annuēns, Ludwigum agnovit.

unit.source: “Well done. Your restraint is admirable.”
unit.target: “Bene factum. Tua continentia admiranda est.”

unit.source: Praise was due when a child behaved correctly, fostering a healthy mindset and habits!
unit.target: Laus debita est, cum puer recte se gerit, mentem sanam et mores bona fovēns!

unit.source: Ludwig remained silent, his expression conveying he was not to be treated as a child.
unit.target: Ludwig tacītus mansit, vultū suō demonstrāns se non puerum esse ad tractandum.

unit.source: A faint smile graced his lips as he retrieved a box of biscuits from his crimson school bag, nibbling on them.
unit.target: Subtilis risus labrīs eius ornābat, dum capsulam biscuitōrum ex sacco scholae rubrō extrāxit, ea menducāns.

unit.source: What restraint… What did he mean by “well done”…
unit.target: Quanta continentia… Quid per “bene factum” vōlibat dicere?

unit.source: Lugano, seated across from him, found himself perplexed.
unit.target: Lugano, trans eum sedēns, se perplexum invenit.

unit.source: Tizamo stood as the most remote town in Port Pylos, nestled against the edge of the primitive forest.
unit.target: Tizamo stetit ut remotissimum oppidum in Portū Pylos, in margine silvae rudimentariae collocātum.

unit.source: A full two hours’ journey by carriage was required to reach it.
unit.target: Iter plenum duorum horārum vectūrae ad id perveniendum requirebātur.

unit.source: Of course, for those in a hurry, an alternative route existed: boarding a steam locomotive from the port to Cahert, the southernmost town.
unit.target: Certe, pro festinantibus, via alternativā exstābat: conscendēns locomotivam vaporis ab portū ad Cahert, oppidum Continentis Septentrionalis remotissimum.

unit.source: From there, a carriage or coffin could be hired to venture northeast, shaving the travel time to Tizamo down to just an hour.
unit.target: Ex eo, vectūra aut sarcophagus conducendī licēbat, ut ad partem septentrionem iter dūcērētur, tempus itineris ad Tizamo ad tantam ūnam horam redigendo.

unit.source: However, Lumian showed no inclination towards haste.
unit.target: Attamen, Lumian nulla festinātiōnis propensiō ostendit.

unit.source: As they departed Port Pylos, the road gradually narrowed and deteriorated.
unit.target: Cum Portum Pylos relinquerent, via paulatim angustāta atque deteriorāta est.

unit.source: Yet, the carriage pressed on steadily.
unit.target: At vectūra constanter pergebat.

unit.source: Kolobo, the carriage driver, operated with precision akin to a well‑oiled machine, guiding the horses and carriage without falter.
unit.target: Kolobo, aurīga vectūrae, cum subtilitāte quasi machīna bene uncta operābātur, equōs atque vecturam sine errōre gubernābat.

unit.source: An hour slipped by, and the carriage wound its way through the forest.
unit.target: Hora praeteriit, et vectūra per silvam sinuōse iter fēcit.

unit.source: Abruptly, Lumian, pretending to slumber, snapped open his eyes.
unit.target: Subitō, Lumian, somnum fingēns, oculōs repentina aperuit.

unit.source: His body turned dark and spectral, melding with the shadows cast by the window.
unit.target: Corpus eius obscūrum et spectrūm factum est, miscēns cum umbrīs a fēnēstra proiectīs.

unit.source: Shadow Transformation!
unit.target: Transformatio Umbrārum!

unit.source: In an instant, gunshots pierced the forest’s tranquility.
unit.target: In instante, sclopeta tranquillitātem silvae percusērunt.

unit.source: Bullets whizzed from afar, some thudding into the earth, kicking up clouds of soil, while others took aim at Camus, the carriage, and the horse.
unit.target: Globuli ferreī e longinquō volitāvērunt, quidam in terram incidēns, nubes pulveris excitāns, alīi in Camum, vecturam, atque equum destināvērunt.

unit.source: Amidst the chaos, the horse crumpled, bleeding profusely, and the carriage toppled to the ground.
unit.target: Inter chaos, equus corruit, sanguine profuse effūsō, et vectūra in terram cecidit.

unit.source: Kolobo had already abandoned his perch as the driver, escaping unscathed from the barrage of gunfire.
unit.target: Kolobo iam sedem suam ut aurīga deseruerat, et ex impetu sclopetōrum intactus evādit.

unit.source: Camus leaped clear of the carriage in advance, crouching low, revolver in hand.
unit.target: Camus ante vectūrām exsiluit, procumbēns, revolver in manu tenēns.

unit.source: He maneuvered with agility, at times rolling, at others slithering deeper into the undergrowth.
unit.target: Agiliter se movere perrexit, aliquando volvēns, aliīs vero inter subvegetātiōnem serpēns.

unit.source: With each movement, he unleashed shots, seeking to suppress the unseen assailant.
unit.target: Quōque motū, ictūs emittens, conābātur hostem invisum reprimere.

unit.source: In this range, many of his abilities were restricted.
unit.target: In hoc ambitu, multa eius facultātēs restrictae erant.

unit.source: A handful of fiery crimson orbs, almost blindingly white, streaked past Camus, disappearing into the forest’s depths.
unit.target: Paucīs globulīs rubriflōrentibus, paene eximē albis, trans Camum volitāvērunt, in profundum silvae evanescēntēs.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: Amidst the thunderous explosions, the gunfire abruptly ceased.
unit.target: Inter tonitruōsōs explosiōnum strepitūs, sclopeta repentinē cessāvērunt.

unit.source: Soon after, curses in Dutanese rang out from the forest’s depths.
unit.target: Mox postea, maledicta Dutanica ex profundīs silvae resonāvērunt.

unit.source: “Go to hell, you Northern Continent bandits!
unit.target: “Abi ad inferos, vos latrōnēs Continentis Septentrionalis!”

unit.source: “Rot with your sons of bitches!
unit.target: “Putrescite, filīi canum!”

unit.source: “Come after us if you have the guts!
unit.target: “Venite post nōs, sī animōs habetis!”

unit.source: Gradually, the curses faded into the forest’s depths.
unit.target: Paulātim, maledicta in profundum silvae evanūērunt.

unit.source: Lumian emerged from the shadows of the carriage, opting not to pursue.
unit.target: Lumian e umbrīs vectūrae exiēvit, decernēns nōn insequī.

unit.source: “It’s the Resistance! What are they doing in Matani…” Camus frowned, muttering to himself in confusion.
unit.target: “Resistentia est! Quid in Matani faciunt…” Camus frontem contrāxit, inter sē, in confusiōne, murmurāns.

unit.source: In the Southern Continent, numerous Resistance factions abounded.
unit.target: In Continente Meridionali, numerōsae factionēs Resistantiae abundāvērunt.

unit.source: He couldn’t discern which faction they belonged to or their motives.
unit.target: Non poterat discernere cui factioni pertinerent aut quid propositum haberent.

unit.source: Typically, Matani, ostensibly independent from the Intis Republic and governed by Admiral Querarill, a Southern Continent native, saw little Resistance activity.
unit.target: Saepe, Matani, quae putābātur ab Intis Re Publicā separāta et ab Admirālī Querarill, indigēna Continentis Meridionalis regnāta, parvām Resistantiae activitātem videbat.

unit.source: Their primary demand was the expulsion of colonists.
unit.target: Prima eōrum postulātiō erat colōnos expellere.

unit.source: Could it be a faction of the Resistance dedicated to Death, aiming to revive Death’s influence in Matani?
unit.target: Num esset factiō Resistantiae morti dēdica­tā, quæ mortis potentiam in Matani revocāre studeret?

unit.source: Please not the Rose School of Thought‑backed Resistance.
unit.target: Quaeso, nē sit Resistantia ab Schola Rōsā Sententiarum sustināta.

unit.source: No, those lunatics… Camus returned to the carriage, puzzled.
unit.target: Non, illī insanientēs… Camus ad vectūrām rediit, perplexus.

unit.source: Lumian mulled over another matter.
unit.target: Lumian dē aliā rē meditātus est.

unit.source: Despite attaining Sequence 5 status, life still felt fragile.
unit.target: Quamquam Sequenciae V adeptus erat, vita tamen fragilis videbātur.

unit.source: Vulnerable to being shot dead!
unit.target: Vulnerābilis ad mortiferum sclopetōrum ictum!

unit.source: If a Resistance member possessed sharpshooting skills and remained beyond his observational range, sniping from over 100 meters, they could have ended his life.
unit.target: Si membrum Resistantiae callidās sclopetandī artes haberet et extra ambitum eius maneret, a centum metris ultra iacēns vitam eius finīre potuissēt.

unit.source: Reapers lacked the resilient bodies of Devils.
unit.target: Messōrēs corpora robusta Diabōlī non habēbant.

unit.source: While lacking Malicious Perception, Devils might sustain only minor wounds from rifle shots.
unit.target: Cum Malitiosam Perceptiōnem careant, Diabōlī sōlum modicōrum vulnerārum ex sclopetōrum ictibus ferre potēbant.

unit.source: Their absence of long‑range Danger Premonition characteristic of Seer pathways rendered them unable to preemptively evade.
unit.target: Eōrum deesse praevisiōnis periculi longī, quæ viis vāticīnātōrum notābilis est, eos impediēbat ut praevenīre possent.

unit.source: Granted, Lumian’s Ascetic traits bolstered his spiritual perception.
unit.target: Certe, virtūtēs ascēticae Lumiani perceptiōnem spiritualem eius corroborāvērunt.

unit.source: Anticipating danger, he had foreseen the attack.
unit.target: Praeveniēns periculum, impetum praenotāverat.

unit.source: Yet, if the adversary could nullify his spiritual perception or manipulate it effectively, conventional rifles could indeed imperil Lumian.
unit.target: Attamen, sī adversārius spiritualem perceptiōnem eius evellere aut bene moderārī posset, sclopeta ordināria vere Lumian in discrimen adducere potēbant.

unit.source: Yes, Shadow Transformation can serve as a shield.
unit.target: Ita, Transformatio Umbrārum scūtum esse potest.

unit.source: Bullets lacking special effects pose no genuine threat to shadow beings…
unit.target: Globulī, cuius effectūs specialēs deesse videntur, nullam minam veram entibus umbrārum inferunt.

unit.source: Lumian redirected his thoughts, instructing Lugano, emerging from the carriage, “Check on the horse.”
unit.target: Lumian cogitātiōnēs suās reorāvit, et Lugano, e vectūrā exiēns, iussit: “Examinā equum.”

unit.source: If it survived, attend to its injuries promptly for carriage duty.
unit.target: Sī superfuerit, celeriter vulnera eius curānda sunt ad officia vectūrae.

unit.source: If not, Ludwig would command the equine corpse to pull the carriage.
unit.target: Alioquī, Ludwig iubere equīnum cadāver trahere vectūrām daret.

unit.source: After all, Ludwig had gained the ability to command a handful of low‑level undead from a concoction brewed from Hisoka’s eyeballs.
unit.target: Postremō, Ludwig adeptus erat facultātem imperandī paucōs undead gradūs infīmōs ex mixtūra ex oculīs Hisoka cocta.

unit.source: 660 Across the Door
unit.target: 660 Trans Ostium

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lugano pushed himself up and hurried to the fallen horse, carefully examining it.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lugano se excitavit et ad equum lapsum festinavit, eum diligenter inspexiens.

unit.source: After a few seconds, he exclaimed regretfully, “It’s dead!”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, ille dolenter exclamavit: “Mortuus est!”

unit.source: The poor horse was unlucky.
unit.target: Infelix equus infortunatus fuit.

unit.source: Despite being over a hundred meters away, it was hit twice by a flurry of gunshots.
unit.target: Quamquam plus quam centum metris remoto, bis ictus est turbine sclopetorum.

unit.source: One bullet struck its side, and the other hit its head.
unit.target: Una glans in latus eius percussit, altera in caput eius percussit.

unit.source: It couldn’t be any more dead.
unit.target: Non potuit magis mortuus esse.

unit.source: In contrast, the carriage driver remained unscathed.
unit.target: In contrarium, auriga carrucae intactus mansit.

unit.source: At most, he had scraped his skin during the tumble.
unit.target: Maxime vero, in casu, cutem suam excoriavit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Kolobo, who had his back turned to him and the others, seemingly on guard against any potential attacks from the depths of the forest.
unit.target: Lumian Kolobum intuebatur, qui dorsum ad se et ceteros converterat, quasi in vigilia adversus impetum ex intimo silvae.

unit.source: He led Ludwig, who had been thrown from the carriage, to the side of the motionless, bleeding horse corpse.
unit.target: Duxit Ludovicum, qui ex carruca proiectus erat, ad latus cadaveris equi immobili et sanguinolenti.

unit.source: “Stop the bleeding,” Lumian instructed Lugano.
unit.target: “Sanguinem sistere,” Lumian Lugano imperavit.

unit.source: Why stop it when the horse is already dead?
unit.target: Cur sistere, cum equus iam mortuus sit?

unit.source: Although Lugano didn’t understand, he extended his shimmering palm.
unit.target: Etsi Lugano non intellexit, manum suam nitidam protulit.

unit.source: After the dead horse’s wounds closed, Lumian turned to Ludwig and said, “Your turn.”
unit.target: Postquam vulnera cadaveris equi clausa sunt, Lumian ad Ludovicum se vertit et dixit: “Tua vice.”

unit.source: Ludwig, dressed in a child’s formal attire, nodded slightly.
unit.target: Ludwig, indutus habitu formali pueri, leviter annuit.

unit.source: He extended his right palm, gripping the dead horse with his five fingers, and slowly raised it.
unit.target: Dextram manum protulit, quinque digitis cadaveris equi mortui tenens, et lente elevavit.

unit.source: The blood-stained corpse of the horse suddenly stood up, causing the overturned carriage to shift slightly.
unit.target: Cadaver equi sanguine maculatum subito surrexit, faciens carrucam conversam leviter moveri.

unit.source: Upon seeing this, Camus gave a barely perceptible nod.
unit.target: Videns hoc, Camus vix perceptibiliter annuit.

unit.source: Is this child from the Death pathway or the Prisoner pathway?
unit.target: Num hic puer de via Mortis aut de via Captivitatis?

unit.source: However, there’s no cold aura or corpse-like aura…
unit.target: Attamen, nec aura frigida nec aura cadaverosa est…

unit.source: After Lugano righted the carriage, the undead horse corpse continued pulling the five of them towards Tizamo.
unit.target: Postquam Lugano carrucam rectam redegit, cadaver equi animatum quinque eorum versus Tizamo trahere continuavit.

unit.source: Just before noon, Lumian spotted their destination.
unit.target: Prope meridiem, Lumian eorum destinationem animadvertit.

unit.source: It was a small town half-encircled by rubber trees, acacia trees, laurels, and other vegetation.
unit.target: Oppidum parvum erat, semi circumdatum arboribus caoutchouc, acaciarum, laurorum, et reliquarum vegetabilium.

unit.source: Several plantations dotted the muddy road, and the air was filled with different spice scents and the alluring smell of roasted meat.
unit.target: Plures plantationes viam lutosam punctabant, et aër variis aromatibus condimentorum atque odore carnis tostae delectabili impleturus erat.

unit.source: Tizamo’s buildings were unique.
unit.target: Aedificia Tizamo unica erant.

unit.source: Apart from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church cathedral, which had a distinct northern style, the rest were propped up by wooden stakes and stone pillars.
unit.target: Praeter cathedralem Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammeantis, quae stilo septentrionali distincta erat, reliqua ligneis stipulis et lapideis columnis suffulta erant.

unit.source: They were reminiscent of West Balam—the base deliberately left empty underneath.
unit.target: Reminiscebant West Balam, cuius basis intentionaliter vacuum relinqueretur.

unit.source: This was due to the humid air and abundant rainfall in many West Balam areas.
unit.target: Hoc erat propter aerem humidum et pluviam abundantem in multis regionibus West Balam.

unit.source: Water would often overflow and pool below.
unit.target: Aqua saepe effundebatur et in loco congregabatur.

unit.source: Lumian climbed down from the four-wheeled, four-seater carriage, watching the people busy with their tasks in the plantation and the town.
unit.target: Lumian de carruca quattuor rotarum et quattuor sedium descendit, spectans homines qui in plantatione atque oppido negotia agebant.

unit.source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Trier, Regio Cathēdrālis Commemorativae, Apartmentum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

unit.source: Franca reclined in the recliner, rocking gently as she recollected the previous day’s events.
unit.target: Franca in solio reclinato se recubuit, leniter oscillans, dum prioris diei res recordabatur.

unit.source: After Jenna woke up that morning, she went out to the streets to buy meat, vegetables, fruits, and bread, making Franca wonder if she had experienced a wet dream or hallucination.
unit.target: Postquam Jenna illo mane experrecta est, in vias processit ad emendum carnem, olera, fructus, et panem, quod Francam mirari fecit num somnium umidum aut visionem passi esset.

unit.source: Why did she suddenly volunteer to help me with digesting the potion?
unit.target: Cur illa subito se obtulit, ut me in digestione potionis adiuvaret?

unit.source: Compared to most Trieriens, she can definitely be considered conservative…
unit.target: Comparata cum plurimis Trierensis, illa certe conservativa esse potest…

unit.source: Moreover, she was so direct and straightforward that I almost lost my desires out of shock.
unit.target: Praeterea, tam directa et sincera erat, ut paene cupiditates meas ex stupore amitterem.

unit.source: Shouldn’t she flirt first to set the mood?
unit.target: Nonne debet illa primum leviter flirtere, ut rem animi componat?

unit.source: When the time comes, even if she doesn’t initiate, I won’t be able to control myself…
unit.target: Cum tempus advenerit, etiamsi illa non initierit, ego me ipsum non regere potero…

unit.source: The more Franca thought about it, the more puzzled she became.
unit.target: Quo magis Franca de re cogitabat, eo magis perplexa facta est.

unit.source: She felt Jenna wouldn’t normally act that way.
unit.target: Sentiabat Jennam tale non solere agere.

unit.source: After recalling Jenna’s past experiences and actions, she realized there was no issue.
unit.target: Postquam Jennae praeteritae experientiae et actus recordata sunt, intellexit nihil esse.

unit.source: That was precisely what Jenna would do!
unit.target: Id prorsus erat quod Jenna faceret!

unit.source: Jenna has a bold nature, or rather, a personality that allows her to act decisively…
unit.target: Jenna naturam audacem habet, aut potius indolem quae ei permittit constanter agere…

unit.source: After the Showy Diva singer who helped her was raped by Margot and became unstable, she was truly willing to go to extremes to assassinate Margot and avenge her friend.
unit.target: Postquam cantatrix Diva ostentatrix, quae eam adiuvit, a Margot violata et instabilis facta est, vere voluit ad extrema procedere ut Margot interficeret et amicam suam ulciscaretur.

unit.source: To that end, she even indebted herself to me for the Assassin potion and firmly became a Beyonder despite her finances…
unit.target: Ad hoc, ipsa etiam mihi se debitorum reddidit pro potione interfectoria, et constanter Beyonder facta est, non obstante suis rebus.

unit.source: At the Hugues Artois banquet, she faced the Member of Parliament protected by official Beyonders and evil gods’ minions.
unit.target: Apud convivium Hugues Artois, illa opposuit membrum Parlamentarium, qui officialibus Beyonder et ministris deorum malignorum protegebatur.

unit.source: She risked everything, disregarding her own fate.
unit.target: Omnia periclitata est, fatum suum contemnens.

unit.source: She killed the bastard who brought catastrophe to the market district and her family on the spot…
unit.target: Interficit scelestum, qui calamitatem ad mercatus districtum et familiam suam in loco attulit…

unit.source: In her heart, I should still be more important than that Showy Diva friend of hers.
unit.target: In corde eius, ego tamen magis momenti esse videbar quam illa amica Diva ostentatrix.

unit.source: Suddenly going to extremes and offering to help me with the potion’s effects is indeed something she would do…
unit.target: Subito ad extrema procedere et offerre auxilium mihi in potionis effectibus, re vera est id quod illa faceret…

unit.source: Besides, sigh, this definitely isn’t a spur-of-the-moment idea.
unit.target: Praeterea, heu, hoc certe non est consilium ex improviso ortum.

unit.source: She has asked me several times about my progress digesting the Pleasure potion and if I have a new partner.
unit.target: Ea me pluries rogavit de progressu mei in digestione potionis Voluptatis et utrum novum socium haberem.

unit.source: She even recommended Lumian…
unit.target: Etiam Lumian commendavit…

unit.source: Realizing that I haven’t found a new partner and that I’m only open-minded outwardly, she decided to act after being stirred by Lumian advancing to Sequence 5 yesterday…
unit.target: Animadvertens me novum socium non invenisse et quod me tantum exteriore animo apertum esse videar, illa statuit agere postquam a Lumiano, qui ad Sequenciam 5 heri processerat, excitata est.

unit.source: That doesn’t seem enough reason—Jenna wouldn’t sacrifice her body because of just those things.
unit.target: Id parum videtur causae sufficere—Jenna non solum his rebus corpus suum sacrificaret.

unit.source: Sigh, sacrifice…
unit.target: Heu, sacrificium…

unit.source: Could it be that she had long realized I secretly liked her and didn’t seek out a new partner because of her?
unit.target: Num forte diu intellexerit me eam occultè amabisse atque ob eam novum socium non quaesivisse?

unit.source: Could she believe she affected my digesting the Pleasure potion, causing her to act?
unit.target: Num putavit se digestionem meam potionis Voluptatis affecisse, quae eam ad agendum moveret?

unit.source: Yes! That must be it. That’s the only way she’d truly go to such extremes.
unit.target: Ita! Id certe est; hoc modo solum vere ad extrema procederet.

unit.source: Ahhh! Why can’t I find any hint of romantic love?
unit.target: Ahhh! Cur nullum vestigium amoris romanticus mihi inveniatur?

unit.source: Franca wailed inwardly.
unit.target: Franca interius gemitu lamentabatur.

unit.source: If she had known this would happen, she would have summoned her courage, toughened her resolve, and sought Lumian’s help.
unit.target: Si hoc scivisset, cor suum congregasset, animum firmaverit, et auxilium Lumiani quaesivisset.

unit.source: That way, she wouldn’t feel as conflicted and pained as she did now.
unit.target: Ita non se sentit tam conflictuoso et dolente sicut nunc.

unit.source: Of course, she didn’t seek out a new intimate partner partly because she cared about Jenna’s opinion.
unit.target: Certe, illa novum intimum socium non quaesivit, partim ob curam sententiae Jennæ.

unit.source: She had become Gardner Martin’s lover and shared his other lovers before meeting Jenna.
unit.target: Ea facta erat amica Gardner Martin, et antequam Jennam conveniret, alios amantes eius communicaverat.

unit.source: There was no changing that history, so she continued on.
unit.target: Nulla vis historiam mutandi erat; itaque illa pergebat.

unit.source: After Gardner Martin’s demise, she had claimed she wanted Browns to experience true pleasure and participate in the Demoness’s female orgies, but most of it was just talk.
unit.target: Post Gardner Martin exitium, illa affirmavit se velle ut Browns veram voluptatem experirent atque in orgiis feminis Daemones participarent, sed pleraque id solum verba erant.

unit.source: She was filled with anticipation only out of novelty.
unit.target: Ea tantum ex novitate sola spe plena erat.

unit.source: If Browns suddenly agreed, she might hesitate and make excuses.
unit.target: Si Browns subito consenserint, illa fortasse dubitaret et excusationes afferret.

unit.source: She didn’t want to leave an unrestrained image in Jenna or Lumian’s minds.
unit.target: Non volebat in mentibus Jennæ aut Lumiani imaginem insuetam relinqui.

unit.source: To put it simply, her answer to the question “Is there really no one in this world you care about?” had changed, so she was hesitant to actively pursue a new intimate partner.
unit.target: Simpliciter, responsum eius quaestioni “Num in hoc orbe vere neminem cures?” mutatum erat, ideoque illa reticenter novum intimum socium quaereret.

unit.source: Jenna had no substantial intimate experience, so she didn’t know how to set a mood for such situations.
unit.target: Jenna nullam experientiam intimam habuit, ideo nesciat quomodo rem animi ad talia condenda componat.

unit.source: She could only revert to the straightforward seduction from when she was Little Minx, but she didn’t want to deceive my feelings and make me fall deeper.
unit.target: Illam tantum redire poterat ad seductionem simplicem, quam habebat cum Little Minx esset, sed noluit affectus meos fallere et me profundius incidere.

unit.source: That's why she acted that way yesterday.
unit.target: Idcirco heri ita egit.

unit.source: Thankfully, she’s relatively level-headed.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, illa relative mente aequa est.

unit.source: She didn’t seek a lover to make me give up, allowing me to truly find a new intimate partner.
unit.target: Non quaesivit amantem, ne me deredirent, ita ut vere novum intimum socium invenire possim.

unit.source: Yes, she might think that would be giving me prolonged pain and not prolonged pleasure.
unit.target: Ita, illa fortasse putabit id mihi dolorem diuturnum, non voluptatem diuturnam, afferre.

unit.source: It would have hindered my digestion of the potion…
unit.target: Hoc digestionem meam potionis impedivisset…

unit.source: Franca felt even more dejected after piecing together the entire situation.
unit.target: Franca, totam rem coniuncta, magis oppressa se sensit.

unit.source: On the stairs leading to Apartment 702.
unit.target: In scalis ad Apartmentum 702.

unit.source: Jenna held a bag of bread and a basket of beef, vegetables, and fruits, reluctant to go back inside.
unit.target: Jenna tenebat sacculum panis et corbem bubuli, olerum, et fructuum, recusans intrare.

unit.source: Recalling yesterday’s events made her blush, unsure of how to face Franca.
unit.target: Recordationes heri faciebant ut rubeficeret, nescia quomodo Francam obiretur.

unit.source: In her previous days as a Showy Diva singer, she had witnessed others’ affection and felt it was just so-so.
unit.target: In diebus antiquis, ut cantatrix Diva ostentatrix, aliorum amorem conspexit et id mediocriter aestimavit.

unit.source: Although exciting, she thought she could endure it.
unit.target: Etiamsi excitans, credidit se id tolerare posse.

unit.source: Unexpectedly, after experiencing it for real, she realized pleasure could make people become consumed by it.
unit.target: Inopinanter, postquam id re vera experita est, intellexit voluptatem homines penitus consumere posse.

unit.source: Phew… Jenna took a few deep breaths to calm herself.
unit.target: Phew… Jenna paucos spiritus profundos cepit ad se tranquilluandum.

unit.source: What troubled her now was how to interact with Franca.
unit.target: Quod eam nunc perturbabat, erat quomodo cum Franca ageret.

unit.source: Wait, should I pretend nothing happened and face her with my usual demeanor?
unit.target: Exspecta, num simularer nihil accidisse et eam consueto animo obire debeam?

unit.source: Should I be more cheerful and take the initiative to mention yesterday, pretending it’s no big deal so Franca doesn’t mind?
unit.target: Num debeam magis laetus esse et initium capere ut heri rem meminisse, simulans nihil esse magni, ne Franca curam habeat?

unit.source: But won’t this upset her?
unit.target: Sed num hoc eam non perturbabit?

unit.source: She needs to digest the Pleasure potion…
unit.target: Ea opus habet ut potionem Voluptatis digerat…

unit.source: Besides, one pleasure encounter is definitely not enough.
unit.target: Praeterea, una congressio voluptatis certe non sufficit.

unit.source: I have to spend time with her as a couple…
unit.target: Tempus cum ea consumere debeo sicut coniuges…

unit.source: Should I keep seducing her tonight like yesterday, or wait for her to initiate?
unit.target: Num debeam seducere eam hac nocte sicut heri, aut exspectare ut illa initet?

unit.source: Dammit, how annoying!
unit.target: Heu, quam molestum!

unit.source: Jenna found such matters more vexing than assassinating powerful figures.
unit.target: Jenna talia re magis vexantia inveniebat quam figuras potentissimas interficere.

unit.source: Whether avenging herself on Margot or killing Hugues Artois, she had always felt death was the worst outcome—no big deal.
unit.target: Sive se ulciscere a Margot sive Hugues Artois interficere, illa semper sensit mortem esse exitum pessimum—nihil magni.

unit.source: However, this situation clearly hadn't reached life-or-death stakes.
unit.target: Attamen, haec condicio clare non pervenit ad gradus vitae et mortis.

unit.source: The subsequent troubles would linger.
unit.target: Incommoda subsequentia manere destinabantur.

unit.source: Jenna couldn’t help but feel frustrated at the thought of maintaining an intimate physical relationship with Franca and all the complexities involved.
unit.target: Jenna non potuit quin frustrata se sentire, cum cogitaret de retinenda relatione intima cum Franca et omnibus complexitatibus.

unit.source: She wished she could simply assassinate the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, instead.
unit.target: Vellet ut potius Ministrum Industriae, Moran Avigny, interficeret.

unit.source: Taking deep breaths to steady her emotions, Jenna analyzed how to approach this from an actress’s perspective to make Franca more accepting of future intimacies.
unit.target: Profundos spiritus hauriens ad animi tranquillitatem, Jenna perscrutavit quomodo ex prospectu actricis hanc rem accedendum facere posset, ut Franca futuras intimas relationes magis acciperet.

unit.source: She had already taken the first bold step.
unit.target: Iam primum audacem gradum fecerat.

unit.source: She definitely wasn’t willing to give up now.
unit.target: Certe nunc non voluit cedere.

unit.source: She planned to continue their relationship until Franca finished digesting the Pleasure potion’s effects.
unit.target: Consilium habebat ut relationem pergeret, donec Franca digestionem effectuum potionis Voluptatis perfecerit.

unit.source: After figuring out her next move, Jenna’s lips curled into a faint smile.
unit.target: Postquam proximam consiliam excogitavit, labia Jennæ leniter in risum incurvarunt.

unit.source: Carrying bread and ingredients, she briskly climbed the stairs and returned to Apartment 702.
unit.target: Panem et ingredientes portans, illa festinanter scalas ascendit et ad Apartmentum 702 rediit.

unit.source: As soon as she opened the door, Franca jumped up from the recliner instinctively and forced a smile.
unit.target: Cum ostium aperuisset, Franca ex solio reclinato instinctu surrexit et risum effecit.

unit.source: She said nervously, “You’re back?”
unit.target: Nervose dixit: “Rediisti?”

unit.source: Amused by Franca’s actions, Jenna chuckled and sighed inwardly.
unit.target: Ob facta Francae delectata, Jenna subridens et internis suspiravit.

unit.source: How great would it be if you didn’t want to become lovers…
unit.target: Quam pulchrum esset, si nolis amatores fieri…

unit.source: Jenna calmly walked to the dining table and placed her items on it.
unit.target: Jenna tranquille ad mensam cenariam processit et res suas in eam posuit.

unit.source: Then, she glared at Franca.
unit.target: Tum, oculis iracundis, Francam aspexit.

unit.source: “What are you waiting for? Help me!”
unit.target: “Quid expectas? Adiuva me!”

unit.source: “Alright, alright.” Franca hurried over.
unit.target: “Bene, bene.” Franca festinanter advenit.

unit.source: Seeing that Jenna wasn’t reserved or distant, nor reverted to her usual demeanor, she felt an inexplicable relief.
unit.target: Videns Jenna non esse remota nec reticens, nec consuetam indolem retinuisse, illa inexplicabilem levationem sensit.

unit.source: She even began to anticipate the night’s arrival.
unit.target: Etiam coepit adventum noctis exspectare.

unit.source: Sizzle. Sizzle.
unit.target: Fritit. Fritit.

unit.source: The juices from a piece of beef dripped onto the fire, transforming into smoke that swirled upwards, blending with the aroma of spices.
unit.target: Sucus ex segmento bubuli in ignem stillavit, transformatus in fumum qui sursum volitabat, et cum odore specierum se miscuit.

unit.source: This caused Ludwig to swallow a few mouthfuls of saliva.
unit.target: Hoc effecit ut Ludwig paucos sorbos salivae deglutiret.

unit.source: However, the boy patiently waited, not rushing the cook until the beef roasted to its optimal state.
unit.target: Attamen puer patienter exspectabat, coquinum non festinans, donec bubulus ad optimum statum assatus esset.

unit.source: Lumian turned his body and gazed at a three‐story building diagonally across from the restaurant.
unit.target: Lumian se convertit et aedificium trium tabulorum, diagonaliter trans cauponam, intuebatur.

unit.source: The yellowish‐brown house was the former residence rebuilt by Hisoka Twanaku.
unit.target: Domus flavido-brunneus erat, quae a Hisoka Twanaku refecta erat.

unit.source: 661 “Reconnaissance Tools”
unit.target: 661 “Instrumenta Exploratoria”

unit.source: During lunch, Lumian used the excuse of going to the washroom to make his way to Hisoka Twanaku’s tawny house.
unit.target: Durante prandio, Lumian excusatione ad latrinam eundum utens viam cepit ad domum fulvam Hisokae Twanaku.

unit.source: After ascending the wooden stairs and passing through the empty, open ground floor, he took out a new wire and picked the lock on the door.
unit.target: Postquam scalae ligneae ascendit et per planum imum vacuum atque apertum transiit, novum filum extraxit et seram ianuae per astutiam aperuit.

unit.source: This level was completely open-air, leaving only support pillars.
unit.target: Hic planus omnino sub caelo aperto erat, reliquis solis columnis sustentantibus.

unit.source: At a glance, it was very spacious and simple.
unit.target: Uno intuitu, amplus et simplex videbatur.

unit.source: Stepping onto the wooden floor, Lumian circled around but found signs that no one had lived here for a long time.
unit.target: In ligno pavimento ingrediens, Lumian circumambulavit, sed signa invenit quod nemo diu hic habitaverat.

unit.source: He found nothing worth further investigating.
unit.target: Nihil invenit quod ulteriori exploranda esset.

unit.source: Suddenly, a voice came from behind him.
unit.target: Subito vox ex tergo eius venit.

unit.source: “What’s the problem here?”
unit.target: “Quid hic accidit?”

unit.source: The voice belonged to Camus Castiya.
unit.target: Vox Camus Castiyae erat.

unit.source: When he saw Lumian enter Twanaku’s rebuilt house from the dining room window, he found an excuse to leave the table and hurry over.
unit.target: Cum videret Lumian per fenestram triclinarii in domum restitutam Twanaku intrare, excusationem invenit ut mensam relinqueret atque properaret.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
unit.target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

unit.source: He looked around and said, “Nothing.”
unit.target: Circumspiciens et dicens, “Nihil.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he ascended the stairs to the third floor.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, scalae ad tertium planum ascendit.

unit.source: Camus sighed silently and followed.
unit.target: Camus silentio suspiravit et secutus est.

unit.source: He felt his mentality had aged considerably when with Louis Berry, resembling someone Vice-Captain Reaza’s age.
unit.target: Sensi mentem meam multum senescere, cum Louis Berry, qui aetate Vice-Capitanei Reaza videbatur, aderat.

unit.source: “Oh, Mother Earth, I’m not even twenty-four years old!”
unit.target: “O, Mater Terra, nondum vicesimum quartum annum natus sum!”

unit.source: Although I arrived in Matani at eighteen and joined the patrol team, dealing with numerous Beyonder incidents, participating in dangerous battles, and accumulating extensive experience, I am still a young man—a laidback young man who doesn’t focus on appearances in daily life!
unit.target: Quamquam Matani adveniens, annos duodeviginti habens et in turma custodiae se coniunxissem, casus plurimos Beyonder tractans, in proeliis periculosissimis participans atque amplam experientiam colligens, adhuc iuvenis sum—iuvenis tranquillus qui in vita cotidiana speciem non attendit!

unit.source: With a solemn, vigilant mindset, Camus followed Lumian through the third-floor rooms twice, searching through all the items.
unit.target: Mente solenne et vigilante, Camus duabus vice Lumian per cubicula tertii gradus secutus est, omnia quaerens.

unit.source: “There’s nothing out of place.”
unit.target: “Nihil extraneum est.”

unit.source: After setting down a pen holder, Camus shared his assessment with Lumian.
unit.target: Postquam receptaculum calami posuit, Camus aestimationem suam cum Lumiano communicavit.

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t gained anything either.
unit.target: Lumian quoque nihil adeptus erat.

unit.source: After a moment’s contemplation, he responded, “Bring Kolobo here later and ask if there are any areas that make him uneasy, dangerous, or uncomfortable.”
unit.target: Post breve meditatione respondit: “Posthac adduc Kolobo huc et interroga an aliqua loca sint quae eum anxium, periculosum, aut incommodum faciant.”

unit.source: Having only collaborated once, he’s already adept at utilizing Kolobo’s uniqueness… Bringing Kolobo here… Why does it feel like a police officer asking a constable to bring a canine unit… Camus criticized inwardly and nodded.
unit.target: Cum semel tantum collaboravisset, iam callide uti singularitate Kolobo didicerat… Kolobo huc adducere… Cur hoc instar videtur ut vigil praefectus constabulum petat ut unitas canina apponeretur… Camus intus reprehendit et annuit.

unit.source: “Understood.”
unit.target: “Intellectum.”

unit.source: As Lumian surveyed his surroundings again, he thought, I’ll bring Ludwig over later and ask if he detects any fragrance of special ingredients.
unit.target: Dum Lumian iterum ambitum contemplabatur, cogitavit: “Posthac Ludwig adducam et interroga, utrum aliquam odorem ingredientium specialium sentiat.”

unit.source: Returning to the dining room with Camus, Lumian indulged in the Gwadar beverage, savoring the rich and intricate aroma of roasted beef, roasted chicken wings, roasted snake meat, roasted spiders, and roasted leeches…
unit.target: Rediens ad triclinarium cum Camus, Lumian potum Gwadar degustavit, sapidum et intricatum odorem bubulae tostae, alarum gallinae tostarum, carnis anguis tostae, araneorum tostarum, et sanguisugarum tostarum percipiens…

unit.source: After eating and drinking his fill, Lumian took Ludwig’s hand and led him to “Hisoka” Twanaku’s house.
unit.target: Postquam abundanter edens et bibens satiatus est, Lumian manum Ludovigi prehendit et eum ad domum “Hisoka” Twanaku duxit.

unit.source: Camus, Lugano, and Kolobo—who wore sunglasses and walked sideways like a crab—followed closely behind.
unit.target: Camus, Lugano, et Kolobo—qui oculos solares gerebant et lateraliter ambulabant sicut cancer—prope secuti sunt.

unit.source: After exploring every nook and cranny, Lumian looked at Ludwig and asked with a smile, “Is there anything edible here?”
unit.target: Postquam omnem recessum exploravit, Lumian Ludovico respexit et subridente quaesivit: “Est-ne hic aliquid edibile?”

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “No.”
unit.target: “Non.”

unit.source: Lumian led the boy down to the second level and looked at Kolobo, who had suddenly turned his back to them, and Camus.
unit.target: Lumian puerum ad secundum planum duxit et respexit ad Kolobo, qui subito tergo eorum versa erat, atque ad Camus.

unit.source: “Do any of you sense anything unusual?”
unit.target: “Numquid quisquam vestrum aliquid insolitum sentit?”

unit.source: The thin Kolobo hesitated for a moment and said, “This house feels a little cold. It doesn’t sit well with me.”
unit.target: Kolobo tenuis paulisper cunctatus est et dixit: “Haec domus paulum frigida mihi videtur; non mihi placet.”

unit.source: “Where exactly?” Lumian inquired with a calm expression.
unit.target: “Ubi exacte?” inquit Lumian vultu placido.

unit.source: Kolobo replied succinctly, “Everywhere.”
unit.target: Kolobo breviter respondit: “Ubique.”

unit.source: There’s something wrong with the entire house and even this land?
unit.target: Nonne in tota domo atque hac terra quidquam non congruum est?

unit.source: Hisoka definitely didn’t rebuild his previous home for nostalgia.
unit.target: Hisoka certe non refecit priorem domum ex desiderio praeteritorum.

unit.source: He’s not the original owner of that body, so he probably doesn’t have much attachment to this place.
unit.target: Non est originalis dominus illius corporis, ergo verisimiliter parum ad hunc locum adligitur.

unit.source: He’s also a true Coldblooded… Lumian pondered for over ten seconds and said to Lugano, Camus, and the others, “Stay here and guard against any mishaps.”
unit.target: Lumian per plus quam decem secundas meditatus est et ad Lugano, Camus, ceterosque dixit: “Manete hic et cavete ne quid eveniat.”

unit.source: He returned to the third floor and lay on a wooden bed with traces of someone having slept in it.
unit.target: Rediit ad tertium planum et in lecto ligneo iacebat, cuius vestigia aliquis dormiverat erant.

unit.source: Large, black mosquitoes flew over with crackling sounds.
unit.target: Magni nigri culices volitabant cum sonis crepitantibus.

unit.source: However, in the flickering sparks, they were ignited one by one, turning into charred corpses that floated onto the bed.
unit.target: Sed in scintillis micantibus singillatim accensi erant, facti cadavera exsiccata conversa quae in lecto levabantur.

unit.source: Lumian quickly slipped into a deep slumber.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter in profundum somnum cecidit.

unit.source: In his daze, he slowly awoke.
unit.target: In stupefactu, lente evigilavit.

unit.source: Pa! Lumian took out the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brisé, opened it, and muttered to himself, “Slept for half an hour and didn’t have any special dreams…”
unit.target: Pa! Lumian horologium aureum de Salle de Bal Brisé extraxit, aperuit, et sibi submurmuravit: “Dimidio horae dormivi neque somnia specialia habui…”

unit.source: He had always believed the Dream Festival was related to dreams, so he deliberately slept in Hisoka’s house, but nothing happened.
unit.target: Semper credebat Festum Somniorum cum somniis coniunctum esse, itaque proposito in domo Hisoka dormivit, sed nihil evenit.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the midday sun shining through the window and stood up thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian solem meridianum per fenestram fulgentem intueri et, cogitans, surrexit.

unit.source: Could the timing be off?
unit.target: Num tempus inordinatum sit?

unit.source: Must I sleep at a specific time and place to participate in the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Oportetne mihi in certo tempore et loco dormire ut in Festo Somniorum participem?

unit.source: Therefore, most Tizamo Town residents are unaware of its existence…
unit.target: Ergo, plerisque in oppido Tizamo eius existentiam nesciunt…

unit.source: When Lumian returned to the spacious but crude second level, he realized Camus and the others now had three more people with them.
unit.target: Cum Lumian ad spatiosum sed rudimentarium secundum planum rediret, animadvertit Camus et ceteros nunc tres alios cum se teneri.

unit.source: One was a man in his thirties with a painted face.
unit.target: Unus vir, in annis tricesimalibus, facie picta, erat.

unit.source: His light brown skin and thick lips gave him a relatively clean-cut look, and his black hair fell to his shoulders.
unit.target: Cutis eius fulva et labia crassa ei aspectum purum dederunt, et capilli nigri ad umeros cadebant.

unit.source: A strong pungent smell wafted from him.
unit.target: Odor fortis et acre ex eo emanabat.

unit.source: The other was a young woman wearing dark leather armor.
unit.target: Altera erat iuvenis femina, quae loricam ex coriacea obscura gerebat.

unit.source: Her brown hair was tied in two strands draped over her shoulders.
unit.target: Capilli eius fusci in duas fascias ligati erant, quae super umeros eius pendebant.

unit.source: Her light brown skin and facial features exuded a wild beauty.
unit.target: Cutis eius fulva et lineamenta faciei feram venustatem efferebant.

unit.source: She carried a hunting bow and a leather quiver of arrows on her back.
unit.target: Gerebat arcum venatorium et fistulam sagittarum ex coriacea in dorso suo.

unit.source: Another man, dressed similarly to Camus and the others in a shirt and thin pants, stood over 1.9 meters tall with an appearance leaning towards the Feysac Empire.
unit.target: Alter vir, vestitus similiter ac Camus et ceteri in tunica et braccis tenuibus, plus quam 1.9 metra altus stetit, aspectu ad Imperium Feysac inclinato.

unit.source: He had short light-blond hair, light-blue eyes, and a face bearing signs of exposure to sun and rain.
unit.target: Capilli eius breves erant, flavi et clari, oculi caerulei erant, et facies vestigia sole atque pluvia patens ostendebat.

unit.source: “They’re our colleagues, members of the Tizamo Town patrol team,” Camus introduced.
unit.target: “Sunt collegae nostri, membra turmae custodiae oppidi Tizamo,” inquit Camus.

unit.source: He pointed at the man with the white paint pattern on his face and said, “Captain of the local patrol team, Maslow.”
unit.target: Indicavit virum cui facies in albo picta erat et dixit: “Dux turmae custodiae localis, Maslow.”

unit.source: “His teammate…”
unit.target: “Socius eius…”

unit.source: Camus turned to the wild-looking woman with a bow and arrows on her back and said, “Rhea.”
unit.target: Camus ad feminam aspectu ferocissimo, quae arcum et sagittas in dorso gerebat, convertit et dixit: “Rhea.”

unit.source: “Loban, used to be an adventurer.”
unit.target: “Loban, olim advenator erat.”

unit.source: He spoke in Intisian the entire time.
unit.target: Totum tempus in Intisiana loquebatur.

unit.source: Finally, Camus addressed the three local patrol team members, “This is the great adventurer, Louis Berry. The other two are his assistant and godson.”
unit.target: Denique Camus tribus membris turmae custodiae localis allocutus est: “Hic est magnus advenator, Louis Berry. Reliqua duo sunt adiutor eius et filius spiritualis.”

unit.source: “This is the great adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: “Hic est magnus advenator, Louis Berry.

unit.source: “The other two are his assistant and godson.”
unit.target: Reliqua duo sunt adiutor eius et filius spiritualis.”

unit.source: “Great adventurer…” Maslow repeated the term and cast his gaze at Loban.
unit.target: “Magnus advenator…” repetivit Maslow et Loban intuens.

unit.source: Feysacian Loban shook his head, indicating he had never heard of him.
unit.target: Loban Feysacius caput concussit, indicans se eum numquam audivisse.

unit.source: Maslow averted his gaze and asked Lumian, “Are you here to hunt?”
unit.target: Maslow oculos avertit et Lumiano quaesivit: “Venari hic vis?”

unit.source: Tizamo Town had been a favorite hunting ground for Port Pylos’s gentry for decades.
unit.target: Oppidum Tizamo per decennia favens erat venationi pro nobilibus Portus Pylos.

unit.source: There was no shortage of residents proficient in Intisian, and the patrol team had language requirements to handle the gentry’s requests.
unit.target: Numerus incolarum peritorum in Intisiana non defuit, et turma custodiae requisita linguistica habebat ad petitiones nobilitatis perficiendas.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Something like that.”
unit.target: Lumian subridente respondit: “Aliquid simile.”

unit.source: Hunting for Hisoka’s inheritance and hidden issues was also a form of hunting.
unit.target: Venatio hereditatis Hisokae et quaestionum occultarum quoque genus venationis erat.

unit.source: Seeing the skeptical expressions on Maslow and the others’ faces, Camus hurriedly explained, “Do you remember the telegram sent last night?”
unit.target: Videns vultus scepticos Maslow et ceterorum, Camus festinanter explicavit: “Meministine telegraphum quod heri nocte missum est?”

unit.source: “You mean…”
unit.target: “Id est…”

unit.source: With her hunting bow and arrows, Rhea couldn’t help but glance at Lumian again.
unit.target: Rhea, arcum venatorium et sagittas gerens, non potuit quin iterum Lumian intueretur.

unit.source: Clearly, she, Maslow, and company had just arrived and hadn’t had time to discuss the detailed situation with Camus and Kolobo.
unit.target: Manifestum est eam, Maslow, et socios modo advenisse et nondum tempus habuisse ut de re subtili cum Camus et Kolobo dissererent.

unit.source: A telegram could only convey limited information.
unit.target: Telegramma tantum informationem limitatam tradere potuit.

unit.source: Camus nodded solemnly.
unit.target: Camus solenne annuit.

unit.source: “Monsieur Louis Berry is here to investigate the hidden issues behind Twanaku.”
unit.target: “Dominus Louis Berry hic est ad quaestiones occultas post Twanaku investigandas.”

unit.source: Using the excuse of inspecting the house again, he led the three local patrol team members upstairs.
unit.target: Uti excusatione domum iterum inspiciendi, tres membra turmae custodiae localis ad superiora duxit.

unit.source: Lugano glanced at the stairs and asked Kolobo, who had his back to them, “There’s a local patrol team in Tizamo?”
unit.target: Lugano ad scalas respexit et Kolobo, qui tergo eorum versa erat, rogavit: “Estne turma custodiae localis in Tizamo?”

unit.source: Based on his experience, there shouldn’t be any official Beyonder teams permanently stationed in the Northern Continent’s small towns and villages like Port Pylos.
unit.target: Secundum experientiam suam, non debent esse turmas Beyonder officiales permanente statutae in oppidis et vicis Continenti Septentrionali, ut Portus Pylos.

unit.source: They would typically send someone to handle issues as they arose.
unit.target: Saepe mittent aliquem ad quaestiones, ut orirent, solvendas.

unit.source: Kolobo turned his back to Lumian and Ludwig, trembling as he replied, “Most other towns don’t have them.”
unit.target: Kolobo tergo Lumiano et Ludovico conversus, tremens respondit: “Pleraeque aliae oppida illa non habent.”

unit.source: This place is rather special and is often attacked by primitive tribes.
unit.target: Hic locus satis specialis est et saepe a tribubus primitivis oppugnatur.

unit.source: Not only did our patrol team station a permanent team here, but the Admiral Guard also has Beyonders at the military camp outside town.
unit.target: Non solum turma nostra hic team permanentem statuit, sed Praesidium Admiralis etiam Beyonderes in castris militaribus extra oppidum habet.

unit.source: Lugano glanced at the strange official Beyonder who doubled as their carriage driver and couldn’t hide his curiosity.
unit.target: Lugano respexit ad insolitum officialem Beyonder, qui etiam vectorem erat, et curiositatem suam celare non potuit.

unit.source: “Why do you always have your back to us and wear black sunglasses?”
unit.target: “Cur semper tergo nobis versus es et oculos solares nigros geris?”

unit.source: “Don’t you want others to discover something’s wrong with your eyes?”
unit.target: “Num non vis ut alii detegant aliquid de oculis tuis male esse?”

unit.source: Kolobo fell silent, unsure if he should answer.
unit.target: Kolobo siluit, nescius utrum respondere deberet.

unit.source: At that moment, Camus led Maslow and the others back to the second floor.
unit.target: Illo momento, Camus Maslow et ceteros ad planum secundum redegit.

unit.source: When they looked at Lumian again, Maslow, Rhea, and Loban’s expressions turned much more serious.
unit.target: Cum iterum Lumian intuebantur, vultus Maslow, Rhea, et Loban multo graviores facti sunt.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and asked casually, “Did anything unusual happen with this house?”
unit.target: Lumian subridente leviter quaesivit: “Acciditne aliquid insolitum cum hac domo?”

unit.source: “No,” Maslow had already recalled the relevant details.
unit.target: “Non,” respondit Maslow, iam memor rerum pertinentium erat.

unit.source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Were you transferred to Tizamo after the attack last year?”
unit.target: Cum annuens, Lumian respondit: “Translati estis in Tizamo post impetus anni praeteriti?”

unit.source: He recalled the dossier had mentioned the three Beyonders stationed here perished in the primitive tribe’s attack.
unit.target: Meminuit dossier indicavisse tres Beyonderes hic stationatos in impetu tribus primitivarum perisse.

unit.source: “Yes,” Loban, the former Feysacian adventurer, replied in a rough voice.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Loban, olim Feysacius advenator, voce aspera.

unit.source: “It’s been nearly a year.
unit.target: “Fere unum annum praeteriit.

unit.source: It’s been very peaceful here.
unit.target: Hic valde pacatus fuit.

unit.source: No more attacks.
unit.target: Nulli impetus amplius.

unit.source: According to the records, the tribe in the primitive forest attacked two to three times a year in past years… Admiral Querarill’s response of sending more guards and army deterred the primitive tribe from taking the risk.
unit.target: Secundum tabulas, tribus in silva primitiva bis ad ter in annis praeteritis oppugnaverunt… Responsio Admiral Querarill, plures custodes et exercitum mittens, tribum primitivam ab periculo capiendum deterruit.

unit.source: Did they really retreat into the forest depths?
unit.target: Num vere in profunda silvae recesserunt?

unit.source: Or did the April Fool’s prank cause something to change?
unit.target: An Aprilis stultorum iocus quidquam mutavit?

unit.source: Lumian sensed something amiss.
unit.target: Lumian sensit aliquid male esse.

unit.source: After conversing for a while, Lumian prepared to take Ludwig and Lugano to check into the motel.
unit.target: Post aliquot verba, Lumian paravit ut Ludwig et Lugano ad deversorium ingrediendum duceret.

unit.source: Maslow took a few steps forward and retrieved two items from a small leather bag hanging from his waist.
unit.target: Maslow paucos gradus progrediens duo res ex parva sacculo coriaceo, a lumbis pendentem, extraxit.

unit.source: There were brown candles and a glass bottle filled with a light-yellow liquid.
unit.target: Erant candelae fuscae et lagena vitrea repleta liquore luteo pallido.

unit.source: “Mosquito repellent candles and tranquil essential oil.
unit.target: “Candelae repellentes culices et oleum essentiale tranquillum.

unit.source: I hope you get a good night’s sleep,” Maslow said in accented Intisian.
unit.target: “Spero ut bene quiescas nocte,” Maslow in Intisiana accentu dixit.

unit.source: Camus chimed in, “What he means is that this place is close to the primitive forest, and mosquitoes and poisonous insects are everywhere.
unit.target: Camus addidit: “Id quod dicit est, hic locus propinqui est silvae primitivae, atque culices et insecta venenata ubique sunt.

unit.source: Although you’re Beyonders, it won’t be pleasant if you’re accidentally bitten.
unit.target: Quamquam Beyonderes estis, non erit iucundum si fortuito morsus eritis.

unit.source: Furthermore, you won’t be able to sleep peacefully and will keep waking up.
unit.target: Praeterea, non potestis quiete dormire et assidue evigilabitis.

unit.source: “The mosquito repellent candles are made from plants that mosquitoes dislike.
unit.target: “Candelae repellentes culices ex plantis, quas culices odiscunt, factae sunt.

unit.source: Tranquil essential oil comes from certain animals, making those damned buzzing fellows stay away from you.”
unit.target: Oleum essentiale tranquillum ex quibusdam animalibus provenit, quod facit ut illi maledicti zumbantes a te recedant.”

unit.source: At this point, Camus, Maslow, Rhea, and the others suddenly realized there were no mosquitoes on the entire second level.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Camus, Maslow, Rhea, et ceteri subito animadvertere nullos culices in toto plano secundo esse.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Ludwig and accepted the candle and oil with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian ad Ludwig se convertit et candela et oleum subridente accepit.

unit.source: Then, he gently pinched his nose to confirm the pungent smell on Maslow and the others came from the tranquil essential oil.
unit.target: Deinde, leniter nasum sibi premit ut confirmaret acrem odorem in Maslow et aliis a oleo essentiali tranquillum provenire.

unit.source: After Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano left Twanaku’s house, Maslow looked at Kolobo, who had his back to everyone, in confusion.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano domum Twanaku reliquerunt, Maslow, confusus, Kolobo, qui tergo omnibus versa erat, intuebatur.

unit.source: He asked in Dutanese, “What’s wrong?”
unit.target: Interrogavit in Dutanensi: “Quid est incommode?”

unit.source: 662 Those Words
unit.target: 662 Illa verba

unit.source: Kolobo finally turned around.
unit.target: Kolobo demum se conversus est.

unit.source: He took off his sunglasses and spoke in Dutanese with a weary look,
unit.target: Subtraxit oculos solares et Dutanice, vultu fesso, locutus est,

unit.source: “My gut tells me I shouldn’t look directly at them.”
unit.target: “Venter meus mihi monet, ne eos directe intuear.”

unit.source: “I can only take a quick glance at most.”
unit.target: “Solum brevem intuentiam accipere possum.”

unit.source: “Why’s that?” Rhea asked curiously, her wildness evident as she carried her hunting bow.
unit.target: “Cur ita?” Rhea curiose rogavit, cum ferocitas eius manifesta esset, dum arcum venaticum portabat.

unit.source: “Just intuition,” Kolobo replied firmly, unsure of the reason but convinced he shouldn’t stare.
unit.target: Kolobo firmiter respondit, “Solum intuitio,” incertus de causa, sed persuasus se non directe intueri debere.

unit.source: Loban, the Feysacian, wore a pensive expression.
unit.target: Loban, Feysacianus, vultum meditabundum gerebat.

unit.source: “What’s on your mind?” Maslow, his face painted white, turned to him and asked.
unit.target: “Quid in animo tuo est?” Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat, ad eum conversus rogavit.

unit.source: The three had worked together in Tizamo Town for a year and understood each other well.
unit.target: Tres per annum in oppido Tizamo simul laboraverunt et se invicem bene intellexerunt.

unit.source: Maslow could tell Loban had thought of something from his look.
unit.target: Maslow ex vultu Loban aliquid cogitaverat animadvertit.

unit.source: Observing Camus and the others’ gazes, Loban pondered for a moment before saying,
unit.target: Observans oculos Camus aliorumque, Loban paulisper meditatus est, deinde dixit:

unit.source: “While adventuring across the Five Seas, I came across this saying: ‘Don’t look directly at God.'”
unit.target: “Dum per Quinque Maria peregrinabar, hoc proverbium inveni: ‘Noli directe Deum intueri.’”

unit.source: “Don’t look directly at God…” Camus’s forehead twitched as he whispered the phrase.
unit.target: “Noli directe Deum intueri…” frons Camus tremuit, dum verba sibilavit.

unit.source: As a Castiya family descendant, albeit from a collateral branch, he had more extensive mystical knowledge than most Beyonders.
unit.target: Ut descendentem familiae Castiyae, quamquam ex ramo collaterali, habebat scientiam mysticam amplior quam pluribus Beyonders.

unit.source: Could it be that Louis Berry and his godson were actual gods, unable to be gazed upon?
unit.target: Num fieri posset ut Ludovicus Berry et filius dei eius vere dei essent, quos directe intueri non possent?

unit.source: No, that couldn’t be right.
unit.target: Minime, id non potuit esse rectum.

unit.source: Kolobo avoided looking at Twanaku directly, yet Twanaku was merely a Sequence 5 Beyonder of the Prisoner and Criminal pathways—not even a demigod!
unit.target: Kolobo directe Twanaku intueri vitavit, sed Twanaku solum erat Beyonder Sequentionis V, in viis Captivi et Criminis—nec quidem semideus!

unit.source: “I’ve heard that before during the padre’s sermons.”
unit.target: Id antea audiveram in sermonibus sacerdotis.

unit.source: “It’s about respecting and worshiping God, right?” said Rhea, a devout Eternal Blazing Sun believer.
unit.target: “Agitur de Deum colendo et venerando, nonne?” inquit Rhea, devota fide Aeternae Solis Ardoris.

unit.source: “No, it’s not from the Church scriptures. It’s recorded in a mystical text,” Loban shook his head, rejecting her explanation.
unit.target: “Non, non est ex scripturis Ecclesiae. In textu mystico conscriptum est,” Loban caput submovit, explicationem eius reiecerat.

unit.source: Maslow let out a deep chuckle.
unit.target: Maslow risum gravem effudit.

unit.source: “Surely the great adventurer can’t literally be a deity walking among us?”
unit.target: “Certe, magnus adventor non potest vere esse deus ambulans inter nos?”

unit.source: “Maybe not a true deity,” Loban recalled,
unit.target: “Forsitan non verus deus,” Loban rememoravit,

unit.source: “But the book’s notes state it refers to a ‘Mythical Creature’.
unit.target: Sed notae libri indicant id ad “Creaturam Mythicam” referre.

unit.source: “I’m unsure what exactly that means, but if it contains the word ‘god’, it must have at least some level of godhood.
unit.target: Nescio quid id exacte significet, sed si verbum “deus” continet, saltem aliquo gradu divinitatis habere debet.

unit.source: Could that adventurer be a demigod?”
unit.target: Num ille adventor semideus esse possit?

unit.source: “It doesn’t seem that way currently,” Camus said, gradually forming a new idea.
unit.target: “Nondum ita videtur,” inquit Camus, novam cogitationem paulatim formans.

unit.source: “Perhaps the adventurer is simply one of a deity’s Blessed, carrying a divine item or aura bestowed upon him.
unit.target: “Forsitan adventor simpliciter unum ex benedictis dei sit, portans rem divinam aut auram ei concessam.

unit.source: So it’s true we can’t directly look at ‘God’, but that ‘God’ isn’t referring to him, only something he possesses.”
unit.target: Ita verum est: nos “Deum” directe intueri non possumus, sed ille “Deus” non ad se, sed ad rem quam habet, refertur.

unit.source: This could explain the situation with Twanaku very well.
unit.target: Hoc casum cum Twanaku optime explicare potest.

unit.source: “You mean like the most famous adventurer?” Loban the Feysacian realized.
unit.target: “Visne dicere sicut clarissimus adventor?” Loban Feysacianus intellexit.

unit.source: Adventurers, treasure hunters, pirates and merchants across the Five Seas now knew Gehrman Sparrow had been The Fool’s Oracle before becoming an Angel.
unit.target: Adventores, thesaurarii, piratae et mercatores per Quinque Maria iam noverunt Ludovicum Sparrow Oraculum Stulti fuisse, antequam Angelus factus esset.

unit.source: “Precisely.” Camus nodded.
unit.target: “Prorsus.” Camus annuit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he inwardly cursed.
unit.target: Simul, intime maledixit.

unit.source: Dogsh*t, why was I sent to watch over matters involving a deity’s Blessed?
unit.target: “Canis stercus, cur missus sum ad inspiciendum res de benedictis dei?”

unit.source: This was undoubtedly perilous.
unit.target: Hoc indubitanter periculosum erat.

unit.source: A moment of carelessness could lead to death!
unit.target: Unum momentum negligentiae ad mortem ducere poterat!

unit.source: Camus hadn’t wanted to accept Vice-Captain Reaza’s order the day before, but over the past five years, Reaza had saved him from the brink of death three times.
unit.target: Camus heri iussum vice‐captain Reaza non suscipere voluit, sed per quinque annos praeteritos, Reaza eum a limine mortis ter servaverat.

unit.source: He couldn’t refuse.
unit.target: Non potuit recusare.

unit.source: Otherwise, with the prestigious “Don” prefix and Castiya family name, he could have declined his superior’s orders.
unit.target: Alioquin, cum insigni praefixo “Don” et familiae Castiyae nomine, ordines superioris recusare potuisset.

unit.source: At worst, he could leave the patrol team and seek opportunities elsewhere.
unit.target: In pessimo casu, turmam vigiliarum deserere et alibi occasiones quaerere potuisset.

unit.source: After all, he had already digested the Sequence 7 Interrogator potion.
unit.target: Postremo, potionem Interrogatoris Sequentionis VII iam consumpsit.

unit.source: He had saved enough funds for his subsequent advancement thanks to Louis Berry’s two commissions.
unit.target: Satis pecuniae servaverat ad ulterioris promotionis sui comparationem, gratia duarum commissionum a Ludovico Berry.

unit.source: Even returning to his family, he wouldn’t be the type brushed aside.
unit.target: Etiam, cum ad familiam rediret, non esset ille genus, qui facile reici possit.

unit.source: But to repay Reaza’s kindness, Camus reluctantly agreed to come to Tizamo Town and monitor Louis Berry’s every move.
unit.target: At, ut Reazae beneficium reddat, Camus, invito animo, consentiens ad oppidum Tizamo venire et omnes motūs Ludovici Berry observare, accessit.

unit.source: Feeling upset, he couldn’t help but inwardly curse.
unit.target: Tristitia affectus, intus maledixit.

unit.source: As a devout and educated believer in Mother Earth, Camus wouldn’t curse with vulgar phrases like “son of a…”
unit.target: Ut devotus et eruditus credens in Mater Terra, Camus verba obscena, ut “filius…”, non proferre solebat.

unit.source: From his view, mothers were great—birth and nurturing equally important, just as the earth nurtured all things’ growth.
unit.target: Eius autem iudicio, matres erant praeclarae—natalitas et alitio aeque magni momenti, sicut terra omnium rerum incrementum fovebat.

unit.source: After discussing the adventurer Louis Berry, Loban the Feysacian turned to Camus and Kolobo, saying,
unit.target: Postquam de adventore Ludovico Berry locutus erat, Loban Feysacianus ad Camum et Kolobo se convertit, dicens:

unit.source: “When we transferred to Tizamo, we were told we could return after a year, that we wouldn’t stay forever.”
unit.target: “Cum ad oppidum Tizamo translati essemus, dictum est nobis post annum redire posse, ne in perpetuum mansuri simus.”

unit.source: “Now, nearly a year has passed, and you’re here too.”
unit.target: “Iam, fere annum transitum est, et etiam tu hic es.”

unit.source: “Does that mean we can return to Port Pylos?”
unit.target: “Num hoc significat nos ad Portum Pylos redire posse?”

unit.source: As a Feysacian, you appear tall, robust, boorish, and unintelligent, but you’re actually dishonest…
unit.target: Ut Feysacianus, altus, robustus, rusticus, et ineptus videaris, sed re vera mendax es…

unit.source: Did you discover that Louis Berry’s matter might be a huge problem and want an excuse to slip away early?
unit.target: Animadvertistine rem Ludovici Berry posse esse ingentem quaestionem et quaerebas causam ut ante tempus evades?

unit.source: Camus acutely sensed Loban’s hidden thoughts and joked, “There’s still a week left!”
unit.target: Camus subtiliter animadvertit cogitationes latentes Loban et iocose dixit, “Adhuc septimana manet!”
