unit.source: “Don’t even think about returning to Port Pylos early. We’re not here for your rotation.”
unit.target: “Ne quidem cogita redire ad Portum Pylos ante tempus. Non ad tuam vicem hic sumus.”

unit.source: At the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Apud Brieu Motel.

unit.source: This was the favorite accommodation for the gentlemen who came to Tizamo Town to hunt.
unit.target: Hoc erat praelatum hospitium virorum, qui ad oppidum Tizamo venabant ut venarentur.

unit.source: Although it couldn’t compare to Hotel Orella, it was at least relatively clean.
unit.target: Quamquam cum Hotel Orella comparari non poterat, saltem admodum mundum erat.

unit.source: Lumian’s sole reason for choosing this place was the availability of a suite.
unit.target: Unica causa quam Lumian eligere hunc locum fuit, quia suite praesto erat.

unit.source: Otherwise, he would have to rent two adjacent rooms and utilize his Hunter’s precise grasp of structures to blast through the adjoining wall without affecting the overall load‐bearing walls.
unit.target: Alioquin duas cellas contiguas conducere debebat et, arte venatoris subtili structurarum perspiciente, parietem iunctum disrumpere sine laedendo reliquos muros portantes, conari debebat.

unit.source: When departing, he’d get Lugano to replace the stone bricks and repair the opening.
unit.target: Cum discederet, petiebatur a Lugano ut lateres lapideos substitueret et aperturam repararet.

unit.source: The ground floor was equally open, supported by stone pillars.
unit.target: Piso terreno aeque apertum erat, columnis lapideis sustentatum.

unit.source: However, the three‐story building above bore a distinct Intisian flair.
unit.target: Attamen, aedificium tribus tabulatis superius indolem Intisianam ostendebat.

unit.source: The beige walls, recessed statuary niches, arched windows, and Venetian curtains made Lumian feel as if he had returned to Trier.
unit.target: Muri lutei, niche statuarum receptae, fenestrae arcuatae, et cortinae Venetiarum, Lumian efficiebant ut se quasi ad Treveros rediisset.

unit.source: When Lugano lit the mosquito repellent candle and used its slightly pungent smell to chase away the poisonous insects and mosquitoes, it became even more reminiscent.
unit.target: Cum Lugano candelam culicibus repellendam accendit et eius leviter pungentem odorem ad insecta venenata et culices fugandos usus est, rem adhuc magis memorabilem reddidit.

unit.source: This is very similar to Trieriens using sulfur’s smell to repel bedbugs… Lumian recalled his initial arrival in Trier.
unit.target: Hoc valde simile est Trierens, qui sulfuris odorem ad cimicos repellendos utebantur… Lumian primum adventum suum in Treveris meminit.

unit.source: After using sulfur’s smell to chase the bedbugs into the neighboring room, playwright Gabriel ignited it and drove them back.
unit.target: Postquam odor sulfuris cimicos in cellam proximam fugare conatus est, scriptor Gabriel eam incendit et eos repulit.

unit.source: After this back-and-forth, most bedbugs went elsewhere, leaving only a few that the doll messenger eliminated.
unit.target: Post hoc fluctuationem, plerique cimices alibi dispersae sunt, relinquentes paucos quos nuntius pupulae delevit.

unit.source: Lumian sighed silently, recalling Gabriel’s death and the deceased tenants of the Auberge du Coq Doré.
unit.target: Lumian silentio suspiravit, memor Gabrielis mortis et defunctorum incolarum Auberge du Coq Doré.

unit.source: He walked to the window and gazed at the street below.
unit.target: Ad fenestram processit et viam deorsum contemplatus est.

unit.source: The gentlemen in hunting attire and their servants on unicorns weaved through the dark-brown or light-brown townspeople, flowing into Brieu Motel, jungle restaurants, and other establishments like rivers.
unit.target: Viri in veste venatoria et servi eorum, in unicornibus, per cives fuscos aut pallidos transibant, fluentia in Brieu Motel, cauponas in silva, et alias institutiones ut flumina.

unit.source: Under the noon sun, Tizamo Town was scorchingly humid this season, making it unsuitable for outdoor activities.
unit.target: Sub sole meridiano, oppidum Tizamo non parvum erat, cum viis in duas partes distributas habens; hoc tempore ardenter humidum erat quod id in res extra aedificia agenda inhabilitabat.

unit.source: On the second floor, Lumian focused his attention and observed the passersby directly below.
unit.target: In secundo piano, Lumian animadvertit et transientes viatores directim perspiciens observavit.

unit.source: He attempted to discern any potential issues with Tizamo Town from their fortunes.
unit.target: Conatus est ex eorum fortunis quaedam problemata in Tizamo oppido discernere.

unit.source: He was prepared for backlash or corruption.
unit.target: Paratus erat ad repulsionem aut corruptionem.

unit.source: These passersby’s fortunes are normal.
unit.target: Fortuna horum transitorum ordinaria est.

unit.source: Some seem to have romantic encounters looming, some would lose money, and some might encounter a bloody calamity, but nothing too serious…
unit.target: Quidam videntur amatorias congressiones imminere, quidam pecuniam amittere, aliique calamitatem sanguinolentam pati, sed nihil nimis grave…

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze and said to Lugano, “Take Ludwig to rest. I’ll take a walk outside.”
unit.target: Lumian oculos avertit et Lugano inquit, “Ludwigum ad quietem ducas. Ego foris ambulabo.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Knowing the trip to Tizamo Town might be dangerous, Lugano had no intention of wandering out unless his boss asked him to prepare food for Ludwig.
unit.target: “Recte.” Sciens iter ad oppidum Tizamo esse periculosum, Lugano non intendebat foras vagari, nisi eius praefectus petierit ut cibum Ludwigi praepararet.

unit.source: He had no choice but to go along. Otherwise, he would be the one eaten!
unit.target: Non habuit aliam optionem quam se adiungere; aliter ipse edendus esset!

unit.source: Tizamo Town wasn’t small with streets spanning out in two directions.
unit.target: Oppidum Tizamo non erat parvum, cum viis in duas partes distributas habens.

unit.source: Lumian strolled leisurely, hands in pockets, donning a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Lumian lente ambulabat, manibus in sinu, pileum stramineum aureum gerens.

unit.source: He no longer wore the straw hat to enhance Louis Berry’s persona, but to shield himself from the sunlight.
unit.target: Iamdudum non pileum stramineum gerebat ad imaginem Ludovici Berry excitandam, sed ut se a sole defendat.

unit.source: He had intended to do so many times before.
unit.target: Id ante multoties facere intendebat.

unit.source: This was because an adverse effect of Shadow Transformation was a greater fear of sunlight than ordinary people.
unit.target: Hoc erat, quod effectus adversus Transformationem Umbrae metum solis maiorem parabat quam in hominibus vulgaribus.

unit.source: Although Lumian could endure relying on his Ascetic abilities, this would impact his condition to some extent.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian virtutibus suis asceticis patientiam ostendere posset, hoc aliquam partem condicionis eius afficere debebat.

unit.source: Why make things difficult when he could resolve it with a straw hat?
unit.target: Cur res difficiles facere, cum ea pileo stramineo solvi possit?

unit.source: Moreover, with the appearance of Louis Berry wearing a golden straw hat, the enemy wouldn’t think he was afraid of sunlight.
unit.target: Praeterea, cum Ludovicus Berry pileum stramineum aureum gerendo appareret, hostis non existimaret eum solis metuere.

unit.source: As his gaze casually shifted, Lumian spotted a girl.
unit.target: Cum aspectus eius leve volubriter mutatus esset, Lumian puellam aspexit.

unit.source: She was a typical Northern Continent native, her black hair cascading down her back like a waterfall, a few sparkling bows adorning her head.
unit.target: Ea erat genuina indigena Septentrionalis Continenti; capilli eius nigri, quasi cataracta in tergo decurrentes, et paucis nodis micantibus caput ornabant.

unit.source: Her azure-tinged eyes accentuated her sharp, delicate nose.
unit.target: Oculi eius, caeruleo tincti, nasum acutum et tenerum illustrabant.

unit.source: An unmistakable youthful aura radiated between her brows.
unit.target: Indubitus aura iuvenilis inter supercilia eius radiebatur.

unit.source: The girl wore a light, lace-trimmed, pleated white dress, but instead of high heels, she donned a pair of brown leather boots.
unit.target: Puella vestem albam levem, plicatam et lacis ornatam gerebat, sed pro calceamentis altis, calceos ex coriaceo fusco induit.

unit.source: As she conversed and laughed with companions, she danced, seemingly unconcerned about passersby’s opinions.
unit.target: Dum cum comitibus colloquebatur et ridebat, saltabat, quasi de sententiis transeuntium nihil curans.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at her again.
unit.target: Lumian eam rursus aspexit.

unit.source: It wasn’t because she was beautiful.
unit.target: Non propterea quod pulchra esset.

unit.source: Although quite lovely, her appearance and bearing couldn’t compare to a Demoness or truly beautiful humans.
unit.target: Etsi decora esset, species et habitus eius non adaequare poterant daemonis aut verorum pulchrorum hominum.

unit.source: Lumian simply sensed her personality differed from Trier’s ladies.
unit.target: Lumian facile sensit indolem eius ab mulieribus Treveris differri.

unit.source: In Trier, no matter how open-minded respectable middle and upper-class women were in private, they still publicly cared about image and others’ opinions—a product of their upbringing.
unit.target: In Treveris, quamquam feminae honorabiles mediæ et superioris ordinis in privato mente aperta erant, publice tamen de imagine et aliis opinionibus solliciti erant—effectus educationis eōrum.

unit.source: This girl exuded an air of freedom.
unit.target: Haec puella aerem libertatis efferebat.

unit.source: She could laugh loudly or spin around whenever she pleased.
unit.target: Poterat alte ridere aut se circa vertere, quotiens vellebat.

unit.source: This was distinct from an improperly raised lower-class woman’s demeanor.
unit.target: Hoc discrevit ab indolis feminae classis inferioris male educatae.

unit.source: This girl’s attire, speech and aura indicated good education and upbringing.
unit.target: Ornatus, sermo et aura huius puellae demonstrabant bonam eruditionem atque institutionem.

unit.source: “Amandina, daughter of Palms Manor’s Sir Petit, and Monsieur Robert’s fiancée,” Camus, resembling a specter, materialized from nowhere beside Lumian with the introduction.
unit.target: “Amandina, filia Palms Manor Domini Petit, et sponsa Domini Robert,” inquit Camus, quasi phantasma, ex nihilo iuxta Lumian apparuit.

unit.source: Palms Manor was a plantation near Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Palms Manor erat plantatio prope oppidum Tizamo.

unit.source: A Southern Continent girl raised without Trier’s upper‑middle‑class societal constraints…
unit.target: Puella Australis Continenti, sine vinculis societatis feminarum Treverenses superior-mediæ educata…

unit.source: As Lumian judged this, he thought of his sister Aurore.
unit.target: Cum id iudicaverit, de sorore sua Aurore meminisse coepit.

unit.source: Sometimes, Aurore displayed such a side.
unit.target: Aliquando, Aurore talem faciem exhibebat.

unit.source: However, the reasons were clearly different.
unit.target: Attamen causae clarissime diversa erant.

unit.source: “Where are you headed?” Camus inquired.
unit.target: “Quo vadis?” inquit Camus.

unit.source: Lumian retracted his gaze and replied with a smile, “The cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian oculos avertit et cum risu respondit, “Ecclesia cathedralis.”

unit.source: “Are you coming with me to praise the Sun?”
unit.target: “Venisne mecum ad Solem laudandum?”

unit.source: 663 Late Night
unit.target: 663 Tarda Nocte

unit.source: Like many cathedrals in Intis, Tizamo’s had a golden dome, resembling the sun’s reflection on the ground.
unit.target: Sicut multa cathedralia in Intis, Tizamo habebat cupulam auream, quae reflexionem solis in terra imitabatur.

unit.source: As Lumian passed through the door, he was dazzled by the walls, arches, gold leaf inlaid in the dome, a mural sprinkled with golden powder, and a golden statue.
unit.target: Cum Lumian per ostium transiret, miratus est muris, arcubus, lamina aurea in cupula insertis, pictura muralis pulvere aureo sparso, atque statua aurea.

unit.source: The sunlight streaming through the glass behind the altar made him instinctively raise his hand, wanting to press down his golden straw hat.
unit.target: Lumen solis per vitrum post altare effluens eum incitavit ut manum attolleret, cupiens galeam stramineam auream suam premeret.

unit.source: It was lunchtime, and many simply-dressed Tizamo residents sat in various pews, heads bowed in prayer.
unit.target: Hora prandi erat, et multi incolae Tizamo, simpliciter vestiti, in variis sedibus consedebant, capita in oratione inclinata.

unit.source: They didn’t mind the cathedral’s dazzling, extravagant appearance at all.
unit.target: Aspectum effulgentem et extravagantem cathedralis omnino non curabant.

unit.source: This was not only because they had always believed in the Eternal Blazing Sun since childhood, but they also had numerous gold mines in the former Balam Empire.
unit.target: Non solum quod ex pueritia in Aeternum Ardentem Solem semper crediderunt, sed etiam multas fodinas auri in olim Imperio Balam habuerunt.

unit.source: The people had a widespread fondness for gold, a hobby preserved to this day.
unit.target: Populus late amorem pro auro habebat, studium quod usque hodie conservatum est.

unit.source: Lumian shared an affinity for gold, but didn’t want to endure the scorching sunlight.
unit.target: Lumian affinitatem pro auro habebat, sed solem ardentem non tolerare volebat.

unit.source: Beside him, Camus tried explaining, “I’m not monitoring you, nor am I saying I’ll follow you everywhere to prevent accidents.
unit.target: Prope eum, Camus experiebatur explanare: “Non te observo, neque dico me ubique te sequenturum esse ad casus vitandos.

unit.source: “I’m assisting you. You’re still unfamiliar with Dutanese. You lack sufficient understanding of the situation in Tizamo and the people here. I can introduce you.”
unit.target: “Te adiuvō. Dutanice adhuc ignotus es. Non satis intellegis de condicione Tizamo atque de his hominibus; te introducere possum.”

unit.source: Lumian seized the opportunity to turn and ask with a smile, “Do you know it well?”
unit.target: Lumian occasionem rapuit ut se converteret et sub risu quaereret: “Idne bene nosti?”

unit.source: Camus ruffled his disheveled brown hair and replied without embarrassment, “If there’s anything I don’t understand, I can ask Maslow and the others to help.”
unit.target: Camus capillos suos fuscos inordinatos concussit et sine pudore respondit: “Si quid nesciam, Maslow et ceteros rogare possum ut me adiuvent.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t mind having an official Beyonder by his side.
unit.target: Lumian officialem Beyonder ad latus suum habere non curabat.

unit.source: If anything happened, he could use the extra muscle.
unit.target: Si quid eveniret, vires additas adhibere posset.

unit.source: He nodded slightly and said, “If you want to follow, go ahead.”
unit.target: Levis annuens dixit: “Si sequi velis, age.”

unit.source: As Lumian spoke, he walked towards the row of seats in front of the altar under the blazing sunlight.
unit.target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, ambulavit versus ordinem sedium ante altare sub sole ardente.

unit.source: Camus hesitated for a few seconds before finding a seat in the farthest corner of the cathedral.
unit.target: Camus paucis momentis vacillavit, deinde sedem in angulo remotissimo cathedralis invenit.

unit.source: As a believer of Earth Mother, he could freely enter and exit the cathedrals of all orthodox gods, but he couldn’t participate in acts of worship.
unit.target: Ut fidelis Matris Terrae, libere in cathedralia omnium diorum orthodoxorum intrare et exire poterat, sed in ritibus cultus participare non poterat.

unit.source: He only knew that Louis Berry had a close connection to the Church of The Fool, but he wasn’t sure if his faith was with The Fool.
unit.target: Sciebat solum Louis Berry nexum intimum habere cum Ecclesia Stulti, sed non certe an fides eius ad Stultum pertineat.

unit.source: Lumian used his Ascetic endurance to control the twitching of his facial muscles.
unit.target: Lumian tolerantiam asceticam adhibuit ut tremorem musculorum faciei temperaret.

unit.source: He sat down under the sunlight as if nothing happened and lowered his head to pray in front of the preaching padre.
unit.target: Sub sole sedebat quasi nihil accidisset et caput inclinavit ut coram praedicante padre oraret.

unit.source: The padre, a native of Port Pylos named Cali, had standard dark brown skin, sunken eyes, and a chiseled face.
unit.target: Padre, nativo Portus Pylos nomine Cali, cutem fuscam consuetam, oculos demissos et faciem sculptam habebat.

unit.source: He only had a thin layer of black hair, not wearing a clergyman’s hat.
unit.target: Habebat tantum tenue stratum capillorum nigrorum, nec petasum sacerdotale gestabat.

unit.source: In his forties with a solemn expression, he preached in unaccented Intisian.
unit.target: In annis quadragenariis, vultu solenne, in lingua Intisiana, sine accentu praedicabat.

unit.source: Lumian, feigning prayer, found himself distracted.
unit.target: Lumian, orationem simulans, se distrahisse sensit.

unit.source: Thoughts raced through his mind, making him feel as if he had returned to Cordu.
unit.target: Cogitationes per mentem eius festinanter currebant, facientes ut se quasi ad Cordum rediret.

unit.source: Back then, even when attending Mass and praying in the cathedral, he was lost in his own thoughts.
unit.target: Illo tempore, etiam dum Missam frequentabat et in cathedralis oratione orabat, cogitationibus suis absorptus erat.

unit.source: When it was almost over, he quickly praised the Sun and wished his sister would always be healthy and that he wouldn’t need much homework or test prep to get into university.
unit.target: Cum paene finivit, celeriter Solem laudavit et optavit ut soror eius semper sana esset et ne multa opera domestica vel praeparationes examinum ad universitatis admissionem necessaria essent.

unit.source: None of that came true.
unit.target: Nihil ex his verum factum est.

unit.source: After the padre finished preaching, Lumian raised his head and narrowed his eyes in the sunlight, focusing on observing the padre’s fortune.
unit.target: Postquam padre praedicationem finivit, Lumian caput attollit et oculos in sole angustiavit, intendens fortunam patris contemplari.

unit.source: There was nothing special about it.
unit.target: Nihil illud praecipuum erat.

unit.source: On the surface, there’s indeed nothing abnormal about Tizamo… Amidst sunburn-like pain, Lumian planned to avert his gaze, but his heart stirred as he activated his Reaper’s Weakness Investigation ability.
unit.target: In superficie, vere nihil abnormale de Tizamo erat… Inter dolorem quasi ustionis, Lumian consilium cepit oculos avertendi, sed cor eius movit cum facultatem Indagationis Infirmitatum Messoris activavit.

unit.source: He thought of Padre Guillaume Bénet and Father Montserrat of the Church of Earth Mother.
unit.target: Cogitavit de Padre Guillaume Bénet et Patre Montserrat Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

unit.source: Who said clergymen from orthodox Churches wouldn’t be problematic?
unit.target: Quis dixit clericos ex Ecclesiis orthodoxis non problematica fore?

unit.source: In that case, he could observe the padre’s weaknesses in advance.
unit.target: Ergo poterat infirmitates patris praevidere.

unit.source: If he truly encountered clerical depravity in the future, he could quickly resolve it.
unit.target: Si clericalem pravitatem in futuro vere occurreret, celeriter eam solvere posset.

unit.source: Various colors appeared on the padre’s body in Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Varii colores in corpore patris in oculis Lumiani apparuerunt.

unit.source: However, there was no pale‑white among them!
unit.target: Attamen, inter eos nihil candidum pallidum erat!

unit.source: This meant the padre had no weaknesses!
unit.target: Id significabat patrem nullas infirmitates habere!

unit.source: Impossible.
unit.target: Impossibile.

unit.source: Even if this padre is a Beyonder, his Sequence shouldn’t be too high.
unit.target: Etiamsi hic pater Beyonder sit, ordo eius non debet esse nimis altus.

unit.source: How can he have no weaknesses?
unit.target: Quomodo potest nullas infirmitates habere?

unit.source: The Sun pathway isn’t known for toughness and imperviousness…
unit.target: Iter Solis non notum est ob fortitudinem et inpenetrabilitatem…

unit.source: Could he be from another pathway?
unit.target: Numquid ex alia via provenire potest?

unit.source: No, all likely have weaknesses…
unit.target: Non, omnes verisimiliter infirmitates habent…

unit.source: Amidst surprise, Lumian observed more closely.
unit.target: Inter stuporem, Lumian propius observavit.

unit.source: Finally, he noticed a faint pallor.
unit.target: Denique levem pallorem animadvertit.

unit.source: It wasn’t on the padre’s body, but in the depths of his Astral Projection.
unit.target: Non in corpore patris, sed in profundis eius projectionis astralis erat.

unit.source: Does this mean his weakness lies in his spirit, fearing attacks targeting his Spirit Body?
unit.target: Num hoc significat infirmitatem eius in spiritu esse, metuens impetus in corpus spiritale suum?

unit.source: How did he manage to have no bodily weaknesses… From the looks of it, I have to dismantle his body piece by piece to kill him if I’m not targeting his Spirit Body…
unit.target: Quomodo potuit nullas infirmitates corporales habere… Ex specie, mihi opus est corpus eius singillatim dissolvere ut eum occidam, nisi corpus spiritale eius intuear.

unit.source: Lumian’s surprise quickly dissipated, replaced by joy and anticipation.
unit.target: Stupor Lumiani celeriter evanuit, gaudio et exspectatione substitutus.

unit.source: Regardless, discovering any abnormalities was a good thing!
unit.target: Attamen, abnormitates detegere bonum erat!

unit.source: This meant he was a step closer to the problem in Tizamo and the Dream Festival Hisoka had mentioned.
unit.target: Id significabat eum uno gradu propius esse ad quaestionem in Tizamo et ad Festival Somniorum, quod Hisoka memoraverat.

unit.source: “Brother, what are you looking at?” Cali asked Lumian with a smile, clutching a Bible.
unit.target: “Frater, quid aspicis?” inquit Cali, sub risu, Bibliam tenens, ad Lumian.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Looking at the sunlight on you.
unit.target: Lumian risu respondit: “Solem in te fulgentem aspicio.

unit.source: “Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: “Lauda Solem!”

unit.source: With that, Lumian stood up, spread his arms slightly, and turned to leave.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Lumian surrexit, brachia leviter extendit, et se vertit ut abiret.

unit.source: Now was not the time to delve into the abnormality in the padre’s body.
unit.target: Nunc non tempus erat in abnormitatem corporis patris penetrare.

unit.source: Padre Cali was delighted by Lumian’s response.
unit.target: Padre Cali responsu Lumiani delectatus est.

unit.source: Firstly, the other party was subtly praising him for being bathed in sunlight, akin to a deity’s blessings.
unit.target: Primum, ille subtiliter eum laudabat quod sub luce solari infusus esset, quasi benedictionibus deorum.

unit.source: Secondly, as a local clergyman without Northern blood, he had always yearned for Northern gentry’s recognition.
unit.target: Secundo, ut clericus localis sine sanguine septentrionali, semper agnitionem gentis septentrionalis desideraverat.

unit.source: After leaving the Saint-Sien Cathedral, Lumian casually had Camus circle the entirety of Tizamo twice with him, including the military camp, plantation, and the outskirts of the primitive forest.
unit.target: Postquam Cathedralem Sancti-Sien reliquit, Lumian Camum casualiter iussit ut totum Tizamo bis circumambularetur, includens castra militaria, plantationem, et terminos silvae primitivae.

unit.source: Camus eagerly introduced everyone he knew.
unit.target: Camus cunctos quos noverat avidē introduxit.

unit.source: As evening approached, Lumian made his way towards the Brieu Motel and asked, “What did you do with that dead horse?”
unit.target: Cum vesper appropinquabat, Lumian processit ad Brieu Motel et rogavit: “Quid fecisti cum illo equo mortuo?”

unit.source: “I sold it to the butcher. I’m planning to buy a new one from a nearby planter,” Camus replied matter‑of‑factly.
unit.target: “Illum vendidi ad macellarium. Novi emere a plantatore proximo constitutus sum,” Camus respondit.

unit.source: Lumian felt a twinge of disappointment for Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian paulum maerorem pro Ludwigo sensit.

unit.source: He remained silent and entered the motel.
unit.target: Silens mansit et in motel intravit.

unit.source: Late at night.
unit.target: Sero in nocte.

unit.source: In the shadows outside the Brieu Motel, Lumian emerged, no longer wearing his golden straw hat.
unit.target: In umbris extra Brieu Motel, Lumian apparuit, non iam galeam stramineam auream gerens.

unit.source: He strolled towards the yellowish‑brown house that “Hisoka” Twanaku had rebuilt.
unit.target: Ambulavit versus domum flavobruneam quam “Hisoka” Twanaku restituerat.

unit.source: It was nearly midnight, and Tizamo had grown very quiet.
unit.target: Fere media nox erat, et Tizamo valde quietum factum erat.

unit.source: Apart from a few patrolling soldiers, drunk patrons, and their companions, no one else was walking outside.
unit.target: Praeter paucos milites errantes, clientes ebrios, et socios eorum, nemo alius extra ambulabat.

unit.source: Under the crimson moonlight, Lumian passed by the bar named Giant Boa and heard a commotion inside.
unit.target: Sub luce rubro lunari, Lumian praeteriit tabernae, quae “Giant Boa” appellabatur, et intus strepitum audivit.

unit.source: In the primitive forest a few hundred meters away, the howls of wild beasts echoed intermittently.
unit.target: In silva primitiva, pauca centena passuum procul, ululatus bestiarum ferarum intermittenter resonabant.

unit.source: Lumian proceeded until he reached his destination.
unit.target: Lumian processit donec ad destinatum pervenit.

unit.source: He ascended to the third level and found the wooden bed he had slept on earlier.
unit.target: Ascendit ad tertium gradum et invenit lectum ligneum in quo ante dormiverat.

unit.source: He busied himself for a while, making preparations.
unit.target: Se occupavit per aliquod tempus, praeparationes faciens.

unit.source: He wasn’t in a hurry to lie down.
unit.target: Non festinabat se iacere.

unit.source: He looked around and muttered to himself thoughtfully, “Termiboros, have you noticed anything unusual here?”
unit.target: Circumspiciens et meditabundus, submurmuravit: “Termiboros, quid hic insolitum animadvertisti?”

unit.source: Termiboros’s majestic voice reverberated within Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Vox augustissima Termibori resonabat intra corpus Lumiani.

unit.source: “I’m using your eyes, ears, nose, spirituality, and fate to observe the outside world—just slightly more than what you see.”
unit.target: “Utendo oculis, auribus, naso, spiritualitate, et facto tuo, mundum exterum contemplor—paulo plus quam tu vides.”

unit.source: Does this mean that what I see and discover will still be restricted by my body, spirituality, and level?
unit.target: Num hoc significat quod ea, quae video et detego, adhuc a corpore, spiritualitate, et gradu meo restricta erunt?

unit.source: Hold on, this fellow is becoming more and more like a riddler.
unit.target: Attende, hic vir paulatim magis et magis aenigmaticus fit.

unit.source: He didn’t directly answer if there’s anything abnormal about this house or what’s abnormal… Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: Non directe respondit utrum quid anomale in hac domo esset, et Lumian deridens respondit.

unit.source: “Are you truly an Angel of the Fate domain? I’m already a Sequence 5, and you can’t use my eyes and spirituality to detect the problem here.
unit.target: “Esne vere Angelus Dominii Fati? Ego iam Sequens V sum, et non potes oculos meos atque spiritualitatem meam ad hanc quaestionem detegendam adhibere.

unit.source: Haven’t you noticed that a Sequence 8 of the Monster pathway can sense that this place is cold?
unit.target: Numne animadvertisti Sequens VIII viae Monstrorum hunc locum frigidum esse posse?”

unit.source: No way.
unit.target: Minime.

unit.source: Are Angels of the Inevitability pathway inferior to Sequence 8s of the Fate pathway?
unit.target: Num Angelos viae Inevitabilitatis inferiores putas quam Sequentes VIII viae Fati?

unit.source: The Monster pathway was also known as the Fate pathway.
unit.target: Via Monstrorum etiam appellabatur via Fati.

unit.source: Lumian provoked Termiboros to see if he could extract any useful information from this Angel‑level Ascetic.
unit.target: Lumian Termiborem provocavit ut videat an ex hoc ascetico angelico aliqua utilia notitia extrahere possit.

unit.source: He didn’t hold out much hope, but at least he wouldn’t lose anything.
unit.target: Non multam spem habebat, sed saltem nihil amitteret.

unit.source: Termiboros fell silent, as if He had vanished from Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Termiboros silevit, quasi ex corpore Lumiani evanuerit.

unit.source: “How tolerant. As expected of an Ascetic Angel,” Lumian mocked.
unit.target: “Quam tolerantem! Ut ex ascetico Angelo exspectabatur,” Lumian deridens inquit.

unit.source: He took out the golden pocket watch he had obtained from Salle de Bal Brise and flipped it open to confirm the current time.
unit.target: Egestim aureum horologium, quod ex Salle de Bal Brise adeptus erat, extraxit atque aperuit ut tempus currentem comprobarit.
Hora undecima et quinquaginta unus post meridiem.

unit.source: Putting away his pocket watch, Lumian lay on the wooden bed in the room.
unit.target: Horologium suum reponens, Lumian in lecto ligneo in conclavi iacuit.

unit.source: This time, he was here to see if sleeping in the house at night would trigger any abnormalities and if he could enter a special dream to participate in the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, hic aderat ut videret si dormitum in domo noctu ullam abnormitatem excitasset et si in somnium speciale intrare posset ad Festival Somniorum participantem.

unit.source: To this end, Lumian had instructed Ludwig in advance to wake him up in the house rebuilt by Twanaku if he wasn’t back by the time they had their second meal.
unit.target: Ad hoc finem, Lumian Ludwigo antea praecepit ut eum excitaret in domo a Twanaku restituta, si non rediret ante tempus secundae mensae.

unit.source: After Lumian promised there would be a feast the next day, Ludwig agreed.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian promisit diem sequentem convivium futurum esse, Ludwig consensit.

unit.source: With crackling sounds, the menacing spiders crawling on the outer walls of the house and the numerous mosquitoes in the room burned and fell, emitting a charred fragrance.
unit.target: Cum sonis crepitantibus, araneae minaces quae in parietibus exterioribus domus reperebant et numerosae culices in conclavi, combustae sunt et ceciderunt, fragrantiam carbonis emittentes.

unit.source: Relying on Cogitation, Lumian swiftly drifted into a deep slumber.
unit.target: Cogitationi innixus, Lumian celeriter in profundum somnum incidit.

unit.source: In a daze, he slowly woke up.
unit.target: Stupore affectus, lente evigilavit.

unit.source: He straightened up and realized that he was still on the wooden bed, in the master bedroom on the third floor of Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: Se rectificavit et animadvertit se adhuc in lecto ligneo, in conclavi principali tertii tabulati domus Hisoka.

unit.source: It was late at night outside the window, and the crimson moonlight seemed to be obscured by clouds.
unit.target: Extra fenestram, nocte sero erat, et rubrum lumen lunae nubibus obtectum videbatur.

unit.source: Only a small amount of light filtered through, making it abnormally dim.
unit.target: Solum parva quantitas luminis pertransibat, quae insolite obscurum faciebat.

unit.source: The howling of wild beasts in the primitive forest and the faint noise from the bar had completely ceased.
unit.target: Ululatus bestiarum ferarum in silva primitiva atque tenuis strepitus ex taberna penitus cessaverunt.

unit.source: The night had entered its most peaceful state, as silent as death.
unit.target: Nox in statum suum quietissimum intravit, tam silens quam mors.

unit.source: There’s no change… Lumian sighed in disappointment.
unit.target: Nulla mutatio erat… Lumian displicenter suspiravit.

unit.source: Just as he was about to take out his golden pocket watch to confirm the time and leave the house in the dark environment to return to the Brieu Motel, his pupils suddenly dilated and his eyes froze.
unit.target: Iam ut horologium aureum suum extraheret, ut tempus comprobarit atque domum in obscuro relinqueret ad Brieu Motel redeundum, pupillae eius subito dilatarentur et oculi eius steterunt.

unit.source: Under the dim crimson moonlight, Lumian swiftly scanned the room’s floor.
unit.target: Sub luce rubra tenui lunae, Lumian celeriter solum conclavis perspexit.

unit.source: He didn’t see mosquito corpses!
unit.target: Non vidit cadavera culicum!

unit.source: The mosquitoes he had incinerated with his Pyromaniac powers before falling asleep should have been charred on the ground, but now, they were nowhere to be found.
unit.target: Culices, quas viribus pyromaniacis ante obdormitum cremaverat, in terra combusta esse debuerunt, sed nunc nusquam reperiebantur.

unit.source: The floor was clean as if it had just been cleaned!
unit.target: Solum plane purum erat, quasi modo nuper purgatum esset!

unit.source: Could it be that someone came in while I was asleep and cleaned the room?
unit.target: Numquid aliquis intravit, dum obdormirem, et conclavum purgavit?

unit.source: I’ve planted several traps around me.
unit.target: Circum me nonnullas insidias posui.

unit.source: They can’t be easily bypassed… Wraith?
unit.target: Eas facile praeterire nemo potest… Wraith?

unit.source: Lumian instantly tensed up.
unit.target: Lumian statim tensus est.

unit.source: He took out the golden pocket watch he had previously kept in his shirt pocket under his vest and flipped it open to check the time.
unit.target: Egestim aureum horologium, quod antea in sinu tunicae sub vestimento servaverat, extraxit atque aperuit ut tempus currentem comprobarit.
Hora undecima et quinquaginta octo post meridiem.

unit.source: 664 Confirming the Boundary
unit.target: 664: Fines Confirmans

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze fixated on the golden pocket watch, his suspicions heightened by the peculiar scent in the air.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani in aureum horologium portatile fixus est, cum suspicionibus ejus a singulari odore in aere excitatis.

unit.source: He felt as though he had slumbered for more than an hour.
unit.target: Sentiit se quasi plus quam unam horam dormivisse.

unit.source: Why then had only seven minutes elapsed?
unit.target: Cur ergo tantum septem minuta praeterierunt?

unit.source: Though the unreliability of his instincts were plausible, other anomalies lurked.
unit.target: Quamquam infirmitas instinctuum eius plausibilis videbatur, alia anomalia latuerunt.

unit.source: The absence of mosquito corpses and the eerie silence hinted at peculiarities.
unit.target: Absentia cadaverum culicum et silentium horribile indicia peculiaria suggerebat.

unit.source: Lumian, drawing from his past encounters, murmured to himself, Could it be that I’ve entered a special dream?
unit.target: Lumian, ex praeteritis congressionibus inspiratus, sibi submurmuravit: “Numquid fortasse in somnium speciale intravi?”

unit.source: In the dead of night, slumbering within this tawny house leads to a peculiar dream?
unit.target: In media nocte, obdormire in hac domo fulva ad somnium peculiare ducit?

unit.source: Did “Hisoka” Twanaku rebuild the house to make it look less suspicious for him to stay there?
unit.target: Num “Hisoka” Twanaku domum refecit ut minus suspecta appareret ad eum manendum?

unit.source: But why would such a thing happen?
unit.target: Sed cur talis res evenire possit?

unit.source: Lumian bowed his head and peered ahead.
unit.target: Lumian caput inclinavit et ante oculis spectavit.

unit.source: His gaze seemed to penetrate through wooden planks and various obstacles, revealing the corresponding underground area.
unit.target: Aspectus eius per tabulas ligneas et diversa impedimenta penetrare videbatur, regionem subterraneam cognatam revelans.

unit.source: Uncertain about the origin of this anomaly, he could only speculate based on common sense and experience.
unit.target: Nescit unde haec anomalia oritur, ergo solum ex sensu communi et experientia coniectari potuit.

unit.source: In the silent darkness, Lumian shuffled his feet, producing creaking sounds as he left the house that once belonged to “Hisoka” Twanaku.
unit.target: In silentio obscuro, Lumian pedes labefaciens sonos stridulos edere fecit, dum domum quae olim “Hisoka” Twanaku pertinebat relinquebat.

unit.source: The street lay deserted, and many of the livestock on the ground floor of the buildings seemed to blend into the night.
unit.target: Via deserta iacebat, et plura pecora in plano aedificiorum in nocte coalescere videbantur.

unit.source: It was impossible to discern if they still existed.
unit.target: Non licuit discernere utrum adhuc exstiterint.

unit.source: The footsteps of patrolling soldiers had vanished completely.
unit.target: Vestigia militum speculatorum omnino evanuerant.

unit.source: A warm, humid night breeze swept through the unobstructed streets, surrounding Lumian as he headed towards the entrance of the Giant Boa bar.
unit.target: Aura calida et umida nocturna per vias expensas vehebatur, in circuitu Lumiani, dum ad ostium tabernae “Giant Boa” se dirigebat.

unit.source: Straining his ears, Lumian noticed that it was so quiet that even the rustling of insects and the buzzing of mosquitoes had ceased.
unit.target: Aures intendens, Lumian animadvertit tam quietum esse ut etiam murmur insectorum et zumus culicum cessaverit.

unit.source: His expression remained unchanged as he extended his right hand, pushing open the heavy wooden door.
unit.target: Vultus eius immotis manebat, dum dextram manum extendit et ianuam ligneam gravem aperiebat.

unit.source: Darkness shrouded the interior.
unit.target: Interior obscuritate involutum erat.

unit.source: With the dim moonlight filtering through the window and Lumian’s sharp eyesight as a Hunter, he could barely discern the outlines of the bar counter, liquor cabinet, small round table, chairs, candlestick wall lamps, and other items, but not a single human was in sight.
unit.target: Luna pallida per fenestram effluens et acuta vigilantia Lumiani ut Venatoris vix sinit distinguere figuram mensae popinae, armarii liquorarii, mensae parvae rotundae, sellarum, lampadarum parietalium, ceteraque, sed neque unus homo apparebat.

unit.source: The bar seemed to have been closed for quite some time.
unit.target: Taberna diutius clausa videbatur.

unit.source: This is even more perplexing.
unit.target: Hoc etiam magis perplexum est.

unit.source: Before I fell asleep, this bar was quite lively.
unit.target: Antequam obdormirem, haec taberna valde animata erat.

unit.source: It’s impossible for them to clear out the customers and clean every corner in seven to eight minutes.
unit.target: Impossibile est ut clientes expellent et omnia angula in septem ad octo minutis purgantur.

unit.source: Based on my experience, even though countryside bars close earlier than those in the city and aren’t bustling until two or three in the morning, they usually continue selling alcohol until midnight.
unit.target: Ex mea experientia, quamquam tabernae rusticae citius claudentur quam urbis et usitate usque ad duas vel tres matutinas non frequenti sunt, solent usque ad mediam noctem alcohol vendere.

unit.source: Also, they usually ask those who are still drinking to leave after they’re done.
unit.target: Praeterea, solent iis qui adhuc bibunt, postquam finierint, orare ut discedant.

unit.source: If they encounter a drunk who refuses to leave, it tends to cause some delay…
unit.target: Si conveniunt cum ebrioso, qui discedere recusat, id plerumque dilationem affert…

unit.source: Lumian, a regular at Cordu’s Ol’ Tavern, felt confident in making such judgments, drawing from his various experiences in different bars.
unit.target: Lumian, fidelis tabernae “Cordu’s Ol’ Tavern”, in iudicandis talibus rebus confidens, ex variis in diversis popinis experientiis inspiratus erat.

unit.source: This conviction only strengthened his belief that he was caught in what seemed to be a very real dream.
unit.target: Haec persuasio fidem eius tantopere firmavit, quod in somnio vere reali inclusus esset.

unit.source: Suddenly, memories of past events in Cordu flooded Lumian’s mind, causing his grip on the heavy wooden door of the Giant Boa bar to freeze.
unit.target: Subito, memoriae praeteritorum eventuum in Cordu repleverunt mentem Lumiani, impediendo manum eius super ianuam ligneam gravem tabernae “Giant Boa” firmiter tenere.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, he decided to leave and headed back to the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Post parvum momentum meditationis, Lumian decrevit abire et ad Brieu Motel rediit.

unit.source: Walking through the dark stairs and a corridor paved with aged planks, Lumian returned to his suite on the second floor at a moderate pace.
unit.target: Per obscuras scalis et coridorium laminis vetustis stratis ambulans, Lumian ad cubiculum suum in secundo tabulato paulatim rediit.

unit.source: He pushed open the wooden door to the child’s room.
unit.target: Ianuam ligneam ad conclave pueri aperuit.

unit.source: The dim crimson moonlight poured into the room, illuminating the sky-blue patterned blanket and bedsheets.
unit.target: Luna rubra pallida in conclave effusa est, illustrans linteum caeruleum caelo simile et stratum lecti.

unit.source: But no one was sleeping here.
unit.target: Sed nemo hic dormiebat.

unit.source: Ludwig had disappeared too.
unit.target: Ludwig quoque evanuerat.

unit.source: Combined with the strange sights on his way, Lumian strongly suspected that he was alone in this dream.
unit.target: Cum rebus insolitis in via, Lumian vehementer suspicatus est se in hoc somnio solitarium esse.

unit.source: All the townsfolk, livestock, and outsiders had vanished, leaving him in solitude in Tizamo Town!
unit.target: Omnes incolae, pecora, et extranei evanuerant, eum solum in oppido Tizamo relinquentes!

unit.source: This can’t be considered a festival unless it is named the Loneliness Festival…
unit.target: Hoc non potest festivitas haberi nisi “Festivitas Solitudinis” appelletur…

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds before leaving the Brieu Motel and heading towards the Saint-Sien Cathedral near the cemetery.
unit.target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, deinde Brieu Motel relinquens et versus Sanctam-Sien Cathedralem prope coemeterium iter fecit.

unit.source: In the dim moonlit night, the cathedral’s golden dome and various decorations on the outer walls seemed to lose their glow, settling into a deep slumber.
unit.target: In obscura nocte lunari, cupola aurea cathedralis et varia ornamenta in parietibus exterioribus lumen suum amittere videbantur, in profundam quietem incumbentes.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t want to waste energy pushing open the front door.
unit.target: Lumian nollebat vires perdere ad ianuam principalem aperiendam.

unit.source: He pried open a stained glass window and jumped in.
unit.target: Fenestram vitream colore ornatam aperuit et insiluit.

unit.source: In the night’s darkness, the place was silent and empty.
unit.target: In noctis tenebris, locus quietus et vacuus erat.

unit.source: The dome above exuded an oppressive and cold aura that was absent during the day.
unit.target: Cupola superna aurae oppressivae et frigidae, quae die absentabant, diffundebat.

unit.source: Lumian searched the area but couldn’t find Padre Cali— who had exhibited abnormalities—the deputy padre, or any odd-job workers.
unit.target: Lumian regionem perlustrare conatus est, sed nec Padre Cali— qui anomalias ostenderat— nec vice-sacerdotem, nec quisquam operarium inusitatum invenire potuit.

unit.source: I’m truly alone…
unit.target: Vere solus sum…

unit.source: Only those who sleep in Hisoka’s house can enter this special dream?
unit.target: Num solum illi, qui in domo Hisoka dormiunt, in hoc somnium speciale intrare possunt?

unit.source: Yes, and it has to be late at night.
unit.target: Ita, atque oportet nocte sero esse.

unit.source: How can the Dream Festival be held?
unit.target: Quomodo Festivitas Somniorum haberi potest?

unit.source: One can’t expect all the relevant people to line up at Hisoka’s house to sleep at a specific time, right?
unit.target: Nonne exspectandum est ut omnes pertinentes ad domum Hisoka conveniant ad certum tempore dormiendum?

unit.source: Disregarding the question of whether we can squeeze in, how did such a widespread collective act deceive the patrol team and the army outside the town?
unit.target: Neglegentes quaestionem utrum admittamur, quomodo tantum coetum latum speculatorum ac exercitus extra oppidum fallere potuerit?

unit.source: Moreover, it doesn’t seem like everyone has been pulled into the dream.
unit.target: Insuper, non videtur omnes in somnium trahi.

unit.source: The Tizamons I previously found were completely unaware…
unit.target: Tizamones quos prius inveni, omnino nescii erant…

unit.source: And the most crucial question: Since it’s a dream, why am I lucid?
unit.target: Et quaestio maximi momenti: Quia somnium est, cur lucidus sim?

unit.source: Lumian contemplated for a moment before reaching out his right hand to touch the wall adorned with the religious mural.
unit.target: Lumian per momentum meditatus est, deinde dextram manum extendens ad parietem, qui pictura religiosa ornatus erat, contingere conatus est.

unit.source: It felt cold and solid, a genuine stone.
unit.target: Frigidum et solidum sensit, verum lapidem.

unit.source: Drawing on his extensive experience in realistic dreams, Lumian pushed aside these questions, opting to begin with the simplest reconnaissance.
unit.target: Ex sua ampla experientia in somniis realibus innixa, Lumian hae quaestiones reiecit, optans incipere cum simplicissima exploratione.

unit.source: He aimed to confirm the dimensions of this dream and its boundaries.
unit.target: Constitutus est confirmare dimensiones huius somnii atque fines eius.

unit.source: Activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian connected with the spirit world.
unit.target: Notam nigrum in dextra umero suo activans, Lumian se coniunxit cum mundo spirituum.

unit.source: He “saw” every corner of Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Omnem angulum oppidi Tizamo conspectum habuit.

unit.source: Through Spirit World Traversal, he disappeared and reappeared on the packed earth path leading from Tizamo Town to Port Pylos.
unit.target: Per transitus in mundo spirituum, evanuit atque iterum apparuit in via terrae compactae, quae ab oppido Tizamo ad Portum Pylos ducit.

unit.source: Teleportation is possible… That’s true.
unit.target: Teleportatio possibilis est… Verum est.

unit.source: Since it’s a dream, nothing is impossible.
unit.target: Cum somnium sit, nihil impossibile est.

unit.source: As long as I believe it’s feasible, I should be able to do it…
unit.target: Dummodo id fateri credam, id perficere possim…

unit.source: Following the Cordu incident, Lumian delved into numerous dream-related books and sought counsel from Madam Justice, Madam Susie, Anthony Reid, and other Beyonders in the mind domain, gaining a profound understanding.
unit.target: Post casum Cordu, Lumian in multa volumina de somniis versata immersus est et consilium petivit ab Domina Iustitia, Domina Susie, Anthony Reid, aliisque ex regione mentis Beyonders, ac profundam cognitionem adeptus est.

unit.source: Slowing his pace, he headed towards Port Pylos.
unit.target: Celeritatem retardans, se contulit ad Portum Pylos.

unit.source: After walking for two to three hundred meters, the scenery ahead blurred, as if an ethereal fog was swirling.
unit.target: Duo ad trecentos metra ambulato, prospectus ante eum confundebatur, quasi aura aethera circumvolitans esset.

unit.source: Beneath the faint moonlight, the fog appeared pitch‑black.
unit.target: Sub lumine tenue lunae, nebula praeclare atra videbatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian’s spiritual intuition warned him that entering the misty area, veiled in an illusionary fog, might be perilous.
unit.target: Subito, intuitio spiritualis Lumiani eum monuit ne in regionem nebulosam, nebula illusoria operta, intraret, fortasse periculose.

unit.source: There was a high likelihood that something terrifying would occur.
unit.target: Magna erat probabilitas ut aliquid terribile eveniret.

unit.source: There are indeed limitations.
unit.target: Certe sunt limites.

unit.source: I can’t directly reach the edge of the mind…
unit.target: Non possum directe ad marginem mentis pervenire…

unit.source: Lumian decided against taking the risk.
unit.target: Lumian decrevit periculum non capere.

unit.source: He swiftly returned to Tizamo and began searching for the other boundary.
unit.target: Celeriter ad Tizamo rediit et alterum finem quaerere coepit.

unit.source: This was the area near the primitive forest.
unit.target: Haec erat regio prope silvam primitivam.

unit.source: After covering a distance of 300 to 400 meters, Lumian reached the forest’s edge.
unit.target: Postquam spatium trecentorum ad quadringentorum metrorum percusserat, Lumian limitem silvae attigit.

unit.source: Rainforest‑like vegetation stood silently in the night, resembling dense tombstones.
unit.target: Vegetatio, similis silvae pluvialis, nocte silent stabat, monumentis sepulcralibus densis similis.

unit.source: Noticing no blurry areas veiled in illusory fog, Lumian proceeded cautiously and decisively.
unit.target: Non animadvertens ullam regionem obfuscatam nebula illusoria operta, Lumian caute et certissime processit.

unit.source: Passing through drooping vines and trees, he delved deeper into the primitive forest, walking on the thick, humus‑covered ground.
unit.target: Per vites deciduas et arbores, in silvam primitivam penitus progressus est, in terra crassa humore tecta ambulans.

unit.source: Along the way, there were no dancing mosquitoes or venomous creatures concealed among the vegetation.
unit.target: In itinere, nec culices saltantes nec creaturae veneficae inter vegetationem occultae erant.

unit.source: After another 700 to 800 meters, Lumian sensed his surroundings becoming more psychedelic.
unit.target: Post alios septingentos ad octingentos metra, Lumian sensit ambitum suum magis illusorio atque mirifico factum esse.

unit.source: Some areas became blurry, others distorted, and some became clearer.
unit.target: Aliqua loca ambigua facta sunt, alia distorta, alia vero clariora.

unit.source: However, upon closer inspection, they couldn’t be seen distinctly.
unit.target: Attamen, propius inspecta, distincte videre non poterant.

unit.source: The conditions in these areas continued to fluctuate.
unit.target: Conditiones in his locis fluctuant.

unit.source: This feels more like a typical dream…
unit.target: Hoc magis instar somnii typici sentitur…

unit.source: With no warning from his spirituality, Lumian took a few more steps forward.
unit.target: Sine praedictione spirituali, Lumian paucos passus ultra fecit.

unit.source: Suddenly, the entire world shattered into scenes that interwove and materialized around him.
unit.target: Subito, universum in scaenas intertextas circa eum dissolutum est.

unit.source: Lumian’s lucidity wavered, leaving him slightly disoriented.
unit.target: Luciditas Lumiani vacillavit, eum paulo confusum relinquens.

unit.source: In the next moment, he witnessed scenes of black boulders and humans in dark robes.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, scaenas saxorum nigrorum atque hominum in loris obscuris vidit.

unit.source: One of the humans raised his head, revealing a pale‑white face with a light brown base, flaxen‑colored eyes tinged with dark green, and decent facial features.
unit.target: Unus ex hominibus caput erexit, patefaciens faciem pallidam albam cum basi fuscata, oculos flavos sub tinctura viridi nigro, et lineamenta faciei decora.

unit.source: Hisoka!
unit.target: Hisoka!

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku!
unit.target: “Hisoka” Twanaku!

unit.source: He was “Hisoka” Twanaku!
unit.target: Erat “Hisoka” Twanaku!

unit.source: The human in the dark robe, embodying “Hisoka” Twanaku’s visage, straightened up.
unit.target: Homo in veste obscura, imaginem “Hisoka” Twanaku reprensens, se recte constituit.

unit.source: His gaze seemed to transcend various scenes and fixate on Lumian.
unit.target: Aspectus eius per varia scaena transcendere videbatur et in Lumiano insistere.

unit.source: Amidst the illusory sound, the scenes around Lumian shattered.
unit.target: Inter sonum illusorium, scaenae circa Lumian dissolutae sunt.

unit.source: Lumian sat up and found himself back in the tawny building that “Hisoka” Twanaku had rebuilt.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et se iterum in aedificio fulvo invenit, quod “Hisoka” Twanaku refecerat.

unit.source: He was in the dark room with the simple wooden bed.
unit.target: In conclave obscuro cum lecto ligneo simplici erat.

unit.source: Quickly surveying his surroundings, Lumian retrieved a golden pocket watch from the left breast pocket of his shirt.
unit.target: Celeriter circumspiciens, Lumian ex sinistra sinu tunicae suae aureum horologium portatile extraxit.

unit.source: Clicking it open, he checked the time.
unit.target: Illud aperiens, tempus observavit.

unit.source: The crimson moonlight outside the window wasn’t too bright, but it wasn’t dim either.
unit.target: Luna rubra extra fenestram non nimis fulgida erat, sed neque obscura.

unit.source: The nearby Giant Boa bar had already closed, yet the howl of a wild beast echoed from the distant primitive forest.
unit.target: Taberna “Giant Boa” proxima iam clausa erat, attamen ululatus ferae bestiae ex silva primitiva remota resonabat.

unit.source: The night was silent but not deathly still.
unit.target: Nox quieta erat, sed non letale silentio.

unit.source: I’m awake? That’s more like it.
unit.target: Ego evigilavi?

unit.source: I slept for an hour or more than 40 minutes, quite close to my estimation…
unit.target: Dormivi per unam horam aut plus quam quadraginta minuta, prope secundum aestimationem meam…

unit.source: Lumian got out of bed and observed the ground.
unit.target: Lumian ex lecto exiit et terram observavit.

unit.source: As expected, he saw charred mosquito corpses and numerous insects lingering outside the window, blocked by the smell of tranquil essential oil.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur, vidit cadavera culicum combusta et multos insectos extra fenestram morantes, a odore tranquilli olei essentialis obstritos.

unit.source: Phew.
unit.target: Phew.

unit.source: He breathed a sigh of relief and contemplated the appearance of “Hisoka” Twanaku in the special dream.
unit.target: Spiravit levate animo et de aspectu “Hisoka” Twanaku in somnio speciali meditatus est.

unit.source: Since it’s a festival, Dream Festival shouldn’t be held just once—that’s what a party is.
unit.target: Cum festivitas sit, Festivitas Somniorum semel tantum habenda non est—hoc enim convivium est.

unit.source: Could Hisoka have participated in many Dream Festivals in the past few years and left some kind of mark in the dream?
unit.target: Num “Hisoka” in multis Festivitates Somniorum per annos proximos particeps fuisse possit et in somnio aliquam vestigium reliquerit?

unit.source: Is Dream Festival indeed related to that primitive tribe?
unit.target: Num Festivitas Somniorum revera ad illam tribum primitivam pertineat?

unit.source: That’s why I activated certain imprints and images recorded in the dream after venturing deep into the forest.
unit.target: Ideo quibusdam impressionibus et imaginibus, quae in somnio conscriptae sunt, postquam in silvam profunde ingressus sum, activavi.

unit.source: That’s how I saw Hisoka…
unit.target: Sic “Hisoka” vidi…

unit.source: What purpose does Hisoka intend to achieve with the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Quo fine “Hisoka” cum Festivitate Somniorum operari intendit?

unit.source: Dream Festival, Dream Festival.
unit.target: Festivitas Somniorum, Festivitas Somniorum.

unit.source: Since it’s a festival, it must be held on a fixed date.
unit.target: Cum festivitas sit, in data fixa celebranda est.

unit.source: At other times, if I enter a special dream, I won’t encounter anything, just like me tonight?
unit.target: Alio tempore, si in somnium speciale intravero, nihil occurrent, sicut hodie mihi?

unit.source: What date could it be?
unit.target: Quae dies esse potest?

unit.source: Lumian fell into deep thought.
unit.target: Lumian in cogitationem profundam cecidit.

unit.source: He quickly deduced a direction.
unit.target: Celeriter viam deduxit.

unit.source: On December 17th of last year, the primitive tribe attacked Tizamo Town, causing numerous casualties.
unit.target: Die XVII Decembris anni pristini, tribus primitiva oppidum Tizamo oppugnavit, plurimas clades inferens.

unit.source: Lumian perked up and swiftly confirmed today’s date.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertens se excitavit et celeriter diem hodiernum confirmavit.

unit.source: Dream Festival happens on December 17th, or two or three days before it, which is when April Fool’s played their prank here?
unit.target: Festivitas Somniorum celebratur die XVII Decembris, aut duo vel tres dies ante illum, quo tempore April Fools hic ludibria sua fecerunt?

unit.source: It was past 1 a.m. on December 11th.
unit.target: Iam erat post horam unam ante meridiem, die XI Decembris.

unit.source: 665 Clues
unit.target: 665 Indicia

unit.source: If the Dream Festival has a fixed date, as I suspect, it should be one of the coming days or span a few days…
unit.target: Si Festum Somniorum diem fixum habeat, ut suspicio, id inter dies proximos aut per aliquot dies dilatari oportet…

unit.source: Recently, I came to Hisoka’s house every night to sleep, trying not to miss the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Nuper, quot nocte ad domum Hisokae veni ut dormiam, ne Festum Somniorum praetermitterem…

unit.source: I also need to figure out the basic patterns of the special dream as much as possible before it begins.
unit.target: Etiam mihi necesse est, antequam incipiat, quam maxime cognoscere formas fundamentales somnii specialis…

unit.source: For example, how to leave the dream normally without entering the primitive forest…
unit.target: Exemplum gratia, quomodo somnium rite deserere possis, sine in silvam priscam ingredi…

unit.source: Lumian closed the golden pocket watch and slipped it into the breast pocket of his shirt, concealed by his vest.
unit.target: Lumian horologium aureum clausit et illud in sinum pectorale tunicae suae, veste celato, inseruit.

unit.source: He didn’t continue sleeping there.
unit.target: Ibi dormire non continuavit.

unit.source: Instead, he chose to descend the stairs and enter the streets of Tizamo.
unit.target: Pro re, descendere scalas et in vias Tizamo ingredi elexit.

unit.source: First, Ludwig would have his second supper in twenty minutes.
unit.target: Primum, Ludwig secundam cenam intra viginti minuta habebit.

unit.source: According to their agreement, if Lumian didn’t return in time, Ludwig would come over and forcefully wake him up.
unit.target: Ex consensu eorum, si Lumian tempore non rediret, Ludwig veniet et eum vi excitabit.

unit.source: Second, he had to update Madam Magician on his discoveries.
unit.target: Secundo, de inventis suis Dominae Magicae certiorem facere debebat.

unit.source: Just as Lumian stepped out of Hisoka’s house, a voice suddenly sounded from behind.
unit.target: Modo quo Lumian ex domo Hisokae exiverat, vox subito ex tergo resonavit.

unit.source: “What exactly are you investigating?”
unit.target: "Quid prorsus investigas?"

unit.source: In a dark corner where the crimson moonlight couldn’t reach, Camus Castiya emerged, dressed in a white shirt and an unbuttoned yellow vest.
unit.target: In obscuro angulo, ubi lumen lunaris rubri pervenire non poterat, Camus Castiya apparuit, indutus camisia alba et vestem flavam nondum alligatam.

unit.source: His disheveled hair collapsed from staying up too late.
unit.target: Capilli eius inordinati corruperunt ob seram vigiliam.

unit.source: At some point, the young leader of the Port Pylos patrol team’s combat team had been waiting here.
unit.target: Aliquando, iuvenis dux turmae pugnae manipuli speculatorum Portus Pylos hic exspectabat.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all, as if he had sensed Camus’ presence.
unit.target: Lumian omnino non miratus est, quasi praesentiam Camus percipuisset.

unit.source: He evaded the question and said, “Many scenes display different states during the day and at night.”
unit.target: Quaestionem evitavit et dixit: “Multae scaenae diversas formas die et nocte ostendunt.”

unit.source: “Indeed.” Camus had dealt with numerous mystical incidents that matched this description.
unit.target: “Certe.” Camus cum multis incidentibus mysticis, quae hanc descriptionem conveniebant, versatus est.

unit.source: The simplest and most common situation was that certain haunted houses appeared normal under the sunlight.
unit.target: Condicio simplicissima et communissima erat, nam quaedam domus infestatae sub sole consuete apparuerunt.

unit.source: As Lumian walked towards the Brieu Motel, he teased Camus with a smile, “Have you been awake the entire time, squatting in the shadows outside the motel, observing my movements?
unit.target: Dum Lumian versus Brieu Motel ambulabat, Camus risu irridens interpellavit: “Num totum tempus vigilasti, in umbris extra motel insidens, motus meos observans?

unit.source: “That’s tough. Careful not to suddenly drop dead.”
unit.target: “Haud facilis res est. Cave ne repente mortuus fias.”

unit.source: If Camus hadn’t known that Louis Berry had a close relationship with the Church of The Fool and didn’t mind him tagging along, he would have thought Lumian’s teasing was a warning.
unit.target: Si Camus nescivisset Ludovicum Berry arctim cum Ecclesia Stulti consociatum esse atque non molestum esse eum comitari, putavisset irrisionem Lumiani monitionem fuisse.

unit.source: Do you think I want that? Camus laughed self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Num putas me hoc velle? Camus humiliter sua risu cachinnavit.

unit.source: “I’ll be in charge of watching tonight. It’s Maslow or Rhea’s turn tomorrow.”
unit.target: “Ego hanc noctem vigilandi curam suscipiam. Cras aut Maslow aut Rhea officium habebit.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t engage in further conversation.
unit.target: Lumian ulteriorem sermonem non susceperat.

unit.source: As if lost in thought, he made his way back to the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Velut in cogitatione immersus, iter revertere ad Brieu Motel fecit.

unit.source: Camus wanted to inquire further, but he dared not.
unit.target: Camus ulterius interrogare cupiebat, sed non ausus est.

unit.source: He then saw the adventurer stop at the motel’s entrance, his back toward Camus.
unit.target: Tum vidit viatorem ad ostium motel sisti, tergo versus Camus.

unit.source: Lumian said calmly, “Before Twanaku died, he mentioned a term—Dream Festival.
unit.target: Lumian tranquille dixit: “Antequam Twanaku mortuus esset, terminum commemoravit—Festum Somniorum.

unit.source: “I’ve just discovered some traces in his house and confirmed that there’s a special dream happening in Tizamo Town.
unit.target: “Mox vestigia in domo eius detexi et confirmavi quod somnium speciale in oppido Tizamo eveniat.

unit.source: “Gather all the folklore related to dreams in this area and bring it to me as soon as possible.”
unit.target: “Collige omnem traditionem de somniis huius regionis et mihi quam primum adfer.”

unit.source: “Uh…” Camus was at a loss at first, but then his mind cleared, as if a bucket of ice‐cold water had been poured over him on a scorching summer day.
unit.target: “Eh…” Camus primum perplexus erat, sed deinde mens eius clarificata est, velut situla aquae frigidae in aestate ardenti super eum versa fuisset.

unit.source: As expected, there’s more to the Twanaku incident.
unit.target: Ut expectabatur, de casu Twanaku plura sunt.

unit.source: There’s indeed a huge problem lurking here!
unit.target: Revera ingens quaestio hic latet!

unit.source: Camus wasn’t too surprised, but his heart pounded.
unit.target: Camus parum miratus est, sed cor eius vehementer pulsabat.

unit.source: Instinctively, he replied, “Okay.”
unit.target: Instinctive respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: After agreeing, Camus realized that he had unknowingly followed Lumian’s instructions, as if the other man were the captain of a patrol team.
unit.target: Post consensu, Camus animadvertit se sublimiter praecepta Lumiani secutum esse, ac si ille vir dux turmae speculatorum esset.

unit.source: After watching Lumian enter the Brieu Motel, Camus briefly analyzed his reaction.
unit.target: Lumian in Brieu Motel intrantem spectato, Camus brevi tempore eius reactionem perspexit.

unit.source: He felt that this situation stemmed from both the intimidation brought about by Lumian’s strength and the accumulated credibility and reliability of his previous deeds.
unit.target: Sentivit hanc condicionem ex et minatione quae potentia Lumiani oriebatur, et ex auctoritate ac fidei constantia praevius factorum eius.

unit.source: I have to send a telegram back to Port Pylos to request reinforcements…
unit.target: Debebo telegraphem ad Portum Pylos redimittere ut subsidia petam…

unit.source: In addition, I need to familiarize myself with Tizamo as soon as possible and strive to move jurisdiction here within a few days…
unit.target: Praeterea, statim Tizamo cognoscere oportet mihi et contendere ut intra paucos dies hanc jurisdictionem moveam…

unit.source: After considering his next steps, Camus let out another sigh.
unit.target: Postquam proximas actiones contemplatus est, Camus alterum suspirium edidit.

unit.source: Ever since encountering Louis Berry, problems had never ceased erupting!
unit.target: Ex quo Ludovicum Berry obviam factus est, quaestiones numquam desinuerunt erumpere!

unit.source: I initially came to Tizamo to monitor his actions and prevent any accidents.
unit.target: Primum ad Tizamo veni ut eius actiones observarem et ullam cladem prohiberem.

unit.source: Why am I now investigating the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Cur nunc Festum Somniorum investigo?

unit.source: Up in the suite on the second floor of the Brieu Motel, Lumian greeted Ludwig shuffling to the dining table, having just woken up.
unit.target: In conclavi in secundo piano Brieu Motel, Lumian Ludovicum, qui ad mensam cenariam incedebat et modo evigilatus erat, salutavit.

unit.source: He then returned to the master bedroom.
unit.target: Tum ad cubiculum principale rediit.

unit.source: Before pondering his letter to Madam Magician, Lumian noticed a folded square of paper on the desk.
unit.target: Antequam de epistola ad Dominam Magicam meditabatur, Lumian quadratum papyrum plicatum in mensa animadvertit.

unit.source: A reply after midnight—so typical of Madam Magician, he thought with an inward chuckle.
unit.target: Responsum post mediam noctem—tantum typicum Dominae Magicae, cogitavit, subrisu interiori.

unit.source: He picked up the letter and conjured a blazing white fireball above his head for light, as Tizamo lacked gas lighting.
unit.target: Epistolam sustulit et globum ignis candidi ardentis super caput suum evocavit ad lucem, cum Tizamo lucernam gasi non haberet.

unit.source: Under the fireball’s incandescent glow, Lumian unfolded and read the letter:
unit.target: Sub fulgore incandescente globi ignis, Lumian evolvit epistolam et legit:

unit.source: “I’ve completed my astromancy and received a revelation about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
unit.target: “Astromantiam meam perfeci et revelationem de reliquo corpore Manus Abscessae accepi.

unit.source: “The remaining body is divided into three parts.
unit.target: “Reliquum corpus in tres partes dividitur.

unit.source: One part is highly suspected to be located in the Underworld, and the other two parts have hints closely related to Lenburg’s capital, Azshara, but they’re not actually there.
unit.target: Una pars vehementer suspicatur in Inferis situm esse, et duae partes alterae indicia habent arcte coniuncta cum capite Lenburgi, Azshara, sed vere ibi non adsunt.

unit.source: My interpretation is that the two missing body parts of the Abscessed Hand are hidden away in the City of Exiles, Morora.
unit.target: Interpretatio mea est duas partes corporea Manus Abscessae, quae desunt, in Urbe Exilium, Morora, absconditas esse.

unit.source: “Don’t you find it too coincidental?
unit.target: “Nonne hoc nimis fortuitum tibi videtur?

unit.source: “No, it’s not a coincidence at all. My astromancy results show that nearly three months ago, one of the two body parts was still located in the tombs of the Paz Kingdom in the Southern Continent, and the other part was related to some folklore in the south-central region.
unit.target: “Minime, omnino non est casus. Resultata astromantiae meae ostendunt paene tribus mensibus abhinc, unam ex duabus partibus corporis adhuc in sepulcris regni Paz in Continente Australi sitam fuisse, et alteram partem cum nonnullo fabularum genere in regione meridie centrali coniunctam esse.

unit.source: “Get my drift?
unit.target: “Capisne quid dicerer?

unit.source: Wh— Almost three months ago… As a Conspirer, Lumian grasped Madam Magician’s implication.
unit.target: Heu— paene tribus mensibus abhinc… Ut conspirator, Lumian implicationem Dominae Magicae comprehendi sensit.

unit.source: Accepting the information about the most terrifying Sealed Artifact 0-01, and masquerading as Ludwig’s godfather, was akin to accepting an olive branch offered from the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Acceptare informationem de terribili Artefacta Sigillata 0-01, et simul gerere se quasi patrus Ludovici, simile erat accipere ramum oleae a Ecclesia Cognitionis oblato.

unit.source: Lumian had promised to pay a certain price for this knowledge…
unit.target: Lumian promisit pretium aliquod pro hac scientia solvendum esse…

unit.source: It seemed the Church of Knowledge then dispatched high-ranking individuals to gather the two remaining body parts of the Abscessed Hand and hide them away in the City of Exiles, Morora.
unit.target: Videtur Ecclesia Cognitionis deinde homines praestantes misisse, ut duas reliquas partes corporis Manus Abscessae collexerent et in Urbe Exilium, Morora, absconderent.

unit.source: What does this mean?
unit.target: Quid hoc significat?

unit.source: It is clearly forcing me to journey to Morora, unless I choose to abandon my hopes of advancing to Sequence 4 and achieving the state of demi-godhood.
unit.target: Manifestum est me iter facere ad Mororam coactum esse, nisi optio relinquendi spes meas ad Sequenciam IV progrediendi ac ad statum semidei adipiscendi surgerit.

unit.source: Heh heh, my agreement with the Abscessed Hand stated that until I found its full body, I would never be able to obtain true godhood.
unit.target: Heh heh, pactum meum cum Manus Abscessae dicebat, quod nisi totum eius corpus invenirem, numquam veram deitatem adipiscerer.

unit.source: This blocks any idea of trying to become a demigod without consuming potions by relying on boons instead…
unit.target: Hoc impediat ullam ideam de semideo fieri sine potionibus sumptis, sed potius bonis inniti…

unit.source: Thankfully, Lumian wasn’t resistant to the idea of visiting the City of Exiles, Morora, before becoming a demigod.
unit.target: Fortunate, Lumian notioni visitandi Urbem Exilium, Mororam, antequam semideus fieret, non opponebat.

unit.source: At that moment, he didn’t feel stifled or vexed by this necessity.
unit.target: Illo momento, non sensit se suffocari aut vexari hac necessitate.

unit.source: Instead, he felt it would actually save him a lot of trouble.
unit.target: Proinde sensit eum revera multum incommoda servaturum esse.

unit.source: After some thought, he continued reading the rest of the letter:
unit.target: Postquam aliquantum meditatus est, reliquam epistolae partem legit.

unit.source: “My astromancy results also tell me that once the Abscessed Hand’s full body is gathered and reunited, something extremely dangerous will happen.
unit.target: “Resultata etiam astromantiae meae mihi narrant, quod, cum corpus integrum Manus Abscessae congregatum atque reunitum erit, aliquid periculosum eveniet.

unit.source: It’s best to complete this reunion step while you’re in the City of Exiles, and use the existence of 0-01 to try to counteract this incoming risk.
unit.target: Optime est hunc gradum reunionis conficere dum in Urbe Exilium es, et existentiam 0-01 adhibere ut hanc imminentem periculum compenses.

unit.source: In other words, you need to find and retrieve the body part located in the Underworld first.
unit.target: Aliter dicendum, oportet primum partem corporis in Inferis sitam invenire et recuperare.

unit.source: “Yes, you should have an opportunity to enter the Underworld itself within the next three months.
unit.target: “Etiam, habebis occasionem ipse in Inferos intrandi intra proximos tres menses.

unit.source: Remember to seize this opportunity when it arises.
unit.target: Memento hanc occasionem cape cum oritur.

unit.source: Don’t ask me what opportunity it is exactly—I don’t know the specifics either.”
unit.target: Noli me rogare quae illa occasio exacte sit—nec ego particularia sciam.

unit.source: Opportunity to enter the Underworld within the next three months… Lumian repeated this crucial piece of information to himself.
unit.target: Occasio ad intrandum in Inferos intra tres menses… Lumian hanc notabilem informationem sibi repetivit.

unit.source: Amidst his elation, the words struck Lumian as peculiar.
unit.target: Inter laetitiam suam, verba Lumian quasi insolita apparuerunt.

unit.source: “Entering the Underworld” and “going to hell” were two distinct phrases that conveyed the same meaning.
unit.target: “Intrare in Inferos” et “ire ad inferos” erant duo distincta verba, quae eandem significationem tradebant.

unit.source: In this world, barring a small number of individuals, no one could readily accept the phrase “you have a chance to go to hell within three months.”
unit.target: In hoc mundo, nisi pauci, nemo facile locutionem “habes occasionem ad inferos iturus intra tres menses” accipere poterat.

unit.source: It was worth noting that many people would curse at each other, saying, “I wish you a swift descent into hell.”
unit.target: Notandum est multos inter se maledicere, dicentes: “Velim tibi rapidum descensum ad inferos.”

unit.source: For the moment, Lumian didn’t have time to ponder the opportunity to enter the Underworld.
unit.target: Nunc, Lumian temporis non habebat sufficiens ut rem occasionis intrandi in Inferos meditaret.

unit.source: He burned Madam Magician’s reply and jotted down his gains for the night and his guesses about the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Dominae Magicae responsum combussit et utilitates nocturnas ac coniecturas de Festo Somniorum scribens notavit.

unit.source: He planned to send it to the Major Arcana card holder at noon the following day.
unit.target: Cogitavit id mittere possessori cartarum Major Arcana ad meridiem crastinae diei.

unit.source: Although he couldn’t shake the feeling that Madam Magician’s “schedule” bore a resemblance to Franca’s, he wasn’t sure if it was convenient to send a letter at that time.
unit.target: Quamquam sensum non potuit excludere, quod "tempus" Dominae Magicae ad Francam simile videbatur, non certo sciebat an illo tempore epistola mittere opportunum esset.

unit.source: Northern Continent, Trier.
unit.target: Continens Septentrionalis, Trier.

unit.source: Winter sunlight poured through the glass, filling the living room with warmth that chased away the chill.
unit.target: Luminum hyemalis per vitrum effudit, conclave calore replens, quod frigus expulit.

unit.source: Franca lounged in the recliner, basking in the cozy glow with half-lidded eyes.
unit.target: Franca in lectulo se recubuit, lumine amoeno fruens cum oculis semiobliquis.

unit.source: Suddenly, she sensed something and sat upright, pulling her legs in.
unit.target: Subito aliquid sensit et subito se erexit, crura comprimens.

unit.source: In the shadowy corner, a human skull made of pure glowing silver emerged.
unit.target: In angulo umbrato, calvaria humana ex puro argento lucente emersit.

unit.source: Pale white flames flickered in its vacant sockets.
unit.target: Flammae pallidae albae in subtilibus orbitis eius vacuis micabant.

unit.source: Madame Hela’s messenger… Why is she contacting me?
unit.target: Nuntia Dominae Helae… Cur me contingit?

unit.source: Franca watched, puzzled, as the skull’s jaws unhinged, releasing a single page that drifted towards her.
unit.target: Franca spectabat, perplexa, dum mandibulae calvariae disiectae erant, dimittens unam paginam quae ad eam undulabat.

unit.source: She snatched the letter and scanned it quickly.
unit.target: Epistolam rapuit et celeriter perlegit.

unit.source: “007 hasn’t heard from you in four days. He wants to confirm you’re okay.”
unit.target: “007 te per quattuor dies non audivit. Vult certiorem fieri te esse incolumem.”

unit.source: Four days without checking the group… A dry chuckle escaped her lips.
unit.target: Quattuor dies sine coetu inspiciendo… Risu arido ex labiis eius effugit.

unit.source: What does this mean?
unit.target: Quid hoc significat?

unit.source: Early to bed and late to rise keeps the king fit to rule his realm! No more morning courts!
unit.target: Mane ad lectum et tarde surgere regit regi aptum, ut suum regnum imperet! Non amplius curiae matutinae!

unit.source: In the early morning hours, Franca manned the radio transceiver while Jenna roamed outside, seizing her opportunity to act as a Witch.
unit.target: In horis matutinis, Franca radiophonicam stationem tenebat, dum Jenna foris vagabatur, suam occasionem strigae esse capiens.

unit.source: Tap tap tap! Her first telegram in days.
unit.target: Toc, toc, toc! Prima telegraphia eius post multos dies.

unit.source: “Shurima! Your emperor has returned!”
unit.target: “Shurima! Imperator tuus rediit!”

unit.source: Before long, 007’s telegram was tapped out by the analyzer-powered mechanical typewriter.
unit.target: Mox telegraphia 007 ab typographeia mechanica, potestate analisatori imbuenta, confecta est.

unit.source: “Hidden Blade, where have you been?”
unit.target: “Lamina Occulta, ubi fuisti?”

unit.source: Ahem. Franca cleared her throat.
unit.target: Ahem. Franca guttur suum expurgavit.
