unit.source: “Late nights breed ill health. Have you no loved ones?”
unit.target: “Noctes serae salutem male afferunt. Nonne carissimos habes?”

unit.source: “Don’t bring up such sad topics…”
unit.target: “Noli talia tristia argumenta evocare…”

unit.source: “Hidden Blade, have you mastered the assassination arts—
unit.target: “Lamina Occulta, num artem occultam caedendi didicisti—

unit.source: sundering heart and soul?”
unit.target: rumpere cor et animam?”

unit.source: Protests arose from the other members.
unit.target: Protestationes a ceteris membris oruerunt.

unit.source: At length, 007’s message arrived.
unit.target: Denique, nuntius 007 pervenit.

unit.source: “I have the intel on the last incident. Let’s meet to discuss.
unit.target: “Cognitionem habeo de ultimo casu. Conveniamus ut disseramus.

unit.source: The higher-ups also approved the item swap for the story you proposed.”
unit.target: Superiores quoque permutationem rerum pro fabula quam proposuisti approbaverunt.

unit.source: Franca blinked, startled.
unit.target: Franca palpebravit, obstupescens.

unit.source: “How long did that take? I’d forgotten all about it…”
unit.target: “Quantum temporis id cepit? Omnia de eo obliviscitus eram…”

unit.source: After all, understanding that humanoid Sealed Artifact’s tale was Lumian’s curiosity, not hers.
unit.target: Postremo, intellegere fabulam de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo erat curiositas Lumiani, non eius.

unit.source: 007’s resigned telegram:
unit.target: Telegraphium resignatum 007:

unit.source: “Bureaucracy inertia. Unavoidable for any large, established organization.”
unit.target: “Inertiam bureaucratiae. Ineluctabile pro qualibet magna, constituta organizatione.”

unit.source: “Tell me about it!” Another member, Moon King’s amused agreement clattered out.
unit.target: “Narra mihi!” Exclamavit alius membrum, rege Lunae, ridens consensu.

unit.source: “Whether public or secret, they’re all bound by red tape.”
unit.target: “Sive publicae sive secretæ, omnes vincuntur vinculis rubris.”

unit.source: After arranging to meet 007 that night with the Moran Avigny intel and initial assassination plan, Franca rose with a stretch.
unit.target: Postquam conventum cum 007 illa nocte, cum intellegentia de Moran Avigny et consilio initio caedis dispositum, Franca surrexit cum elongatione.

unit.source: She jotted down the two tasks before performing a ritual to summon Lumian’s messenger, Penitent Baynfel.
unit.target: Duas munera annotavit antequam ritum ad evocandum nuntium Lumiani, Penitentem Baynfel, perficeret.

unit.source: Southern Continent, Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Continens Australis, Oppidum Tizamo.

unit.source: Lumian was just about to head to Hisoka’s house for a nap when his messenger materialized from the shadows, delivering a letter.
unit.target: Lumian iam se ad domum Hisokae ad quiescendum petere parabat, cum nuntius eius e umbris apparuit atque epistolam tradidit.

unit.source: After taking the note, Lumian noticed Penitent Baynfel didn’t immediately depart back to the spirit world as usual.
unit.target: Postquam notam accepit, Lumian animadvertit Penitentem Baynfel non statim, ut solito, in mundum spirituum discessurum.

unit.source: Instead, he lingered, surveying their surroundings with a measured gaze.
unit.target: Proinde manebat, circumstantias cum oculo temperato perscrutans.

unit.source: 666 New Information
unit.target: 666 Nova Notitia

unit.source: Lumian had rarely seen Penitent Baynfel act so abnormally.
unit.target: Lumian Penitentem Baynfel rarissime vidit tam insolenter se gerere.

unit.source: He asked with anticipation and curiosity, “What have you discovered?”
unit.target: Interrogavit cum exspectatione et curiositate: “Quid invenisti?”

unit.source: Baynfel, clad in a clergyman’s black robe, his charred body partially tainted by black flames, averted his gaze and replied in a deep voice, “The night conceals the flowing sin.”
unit.target: Baynfel, indutus veste sacerdotali nigra, cuius corpus partim atris flammis combustum esset, oculos avertit et voce profunda respondit: “Nox fluitantem peccatum celat.”

unit.source: With that, the Penitent stepped into the void and vanished from the room.
unit.target: His verbis, Penitens in vacuum processit et ex conclavi evanuit.

unit.source: The night conceals the flowing sin…
unit.target: Nox fluitantem peccatum celat…

unit.source: It’s emphasizing the night because that allows entry into the special dream?
unit.target: Extollit noctem, quoniam id ingressum in somnium speciale concedit?

unit.source: What does the ‘flowing sin’ refer to?
unit.target: Ad quid refert “peccatum fluitans”?

unit.source: Can’t you mysterious types speak plainly?
unit.target: Num potestis, o vos mysteriosi, apertē loqui?

unit.source: Lumian criticized, then opened Franca’s letter and quickly read it.
unit.target: Lumian reprehendit, deinde epistolam Francae aperuit et celeriter legit.

unit.source: To be honest, after such a long time, his desire to understand the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s past had significantly diminished.
unit.target: Sinceriter, post tam longum tempus, cupiditas eius ad intellegendum praeteritum Artifacti Humanoidi Sigillati valde decrevit.

unit.source: After all, he had mainly felt the other party’s state was similar to his own, triggering his emotions back then.
unit.target: Nam plerumque sensit statum alterius similem suo esse, quod tum affectus eius excitavit.

unit.source: That was why he had suggested it.
unit.target: Idcirco id proposuerat.

unit.source: Now, those emotions had long settled.
unit.target: Nunc illi affectus iam diu sedaverant.

unit.source: Of course, they had only settled, not disappeared.
unit.target: Scilicet solum sedaverant, non evanuerant.

unit.source: Lumian tore open the letter and jotted down the entire incident, planning to send it to Madam Magician at noon the next day.
unit.target: Lumian epistolam laceravit et totum incidentem consignavit, disponens eam cras meridie ad Dominam Magicam mittere.

unit.source: As for whether the Major Arcana card holder would agree to such an unequal trade, Lumian wasn’t too confident.
unit.target: Quoad utrum possessor cartae Arcanae Maioris talem inaequabilem permutationem acciperet, Lumian non satis confidit.

unit.source: However, he intuitively felt that the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana holders wouldn’t simply take possession of important artifacts from the orthodox Churches.
unit.target: Tamen intuitim sensit quod possessorēs cartārum Arcanae Maioris Club Tarot non simpliciter res maximi momenti ex Ecclesiis orthodoxis acciperent.

unit.source: Using this opportunity to make a deal was more likely.
unit.target: Hoc opportunitate ad commercium faciendum uti, verisimilius videbatur.

unit.source: After leaving the Brieu Motel, Lumian calmly observed Camus, donned in a yellow vest, emerge from a dimly lit street corner.
unit.target: Postquam Brieu Motel discessit, Lumian tranquille observavit Camum, indutum in vestem flavam, ex obscuro angulo plateae emergentem.

unit.source: Beside him was Rhea, a member of the local patrol wearing leather armor and carrying a hunting bow.
unit.target: Iuxta eum erat Rhea, membrum vigiliarum localium, induta armatura coriacea et arcum venaticum gerens.

unit.source: “Why two people today?” Lumian chuckled and strode towards Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: “Cur duo homines hodie?” Lumian subridens dixit et ad domum Hisoka procedens accessit.

unit.source: Camus took a deep breath to calm his sudden surge of emotions.
unit.target: Camus altum spiritum traxit ad sedandum repentinum motum affectuum.

unit.source: As he followed Louis Berry’s left hand, he replied in a deep voice, “There are only a few days left until the 17th.
unit.target: Dum sequebatur manum sinistram Ludovici Berry, respondit voce profunda: “Paucis tantum diebus ad diem septendecimum restant.”

unit.source: An accident might happen at any moment.
unit.target: Casus quovis momento evenire potest.

unit.source: We can’t act alone anymore.
unit.target: Non iam soli agere possumus.

unit.source: Having consciously gathered various information, the patrol team had already noticed some abnormalities.
unit.target: Variis notitiis collectis, turma vigiliarum iam aliquas irregularitates animadvertit.

unit.source: This made Camus feel that staying in Tizamo was unwise.
unit.target: Id faciens Camum fecit sentire manere in Tizamo esse imprudentem.

unit.source: He was constantly on edge.
unit.target: Semper in tensione erat.

unit.source: He felt a growing sense of being a middle-aged man burdened with heavy responsibilities.
unit.target: Sensi crescere sensum se esse virum mediocris aetatis, gravibus oneri responsabilitatibus oneratum.

unit.source: Raising an eyebrow, Lumian queried, “Hey, you figuring out the 17th is a key date was pretty fast.”
unit.target: Supercilium levans, Lumian quaesivit: “Heus, celeriter animadvertisti diem septendecimum esse diem maximi momenti?”

unit.source: “We’re not fools,” Camus finally couldn’t help but reply.
unit.target: “Non sumus stulti,” Camus denique respondit.

unit.source: “It’s an obvious issue.
unit.target: “Manifestum est.”

unit.source: Last year, Tizamo was attacked on December 17th, and in previous years…
unit.target: Anno praeterito, Tizamo die XVII Decembris aggressum est, et in annis praeteritis…

unit.source: At this point, he fell silent.
unit.target: In hoc puncto siluit.

unit.source: He realized that when around Louis Berry, he constantly switched between his heavy middle-aged state and uncontrollable teenage emotions.
unit.target: Intellegebat, cum apud Ludovicum Berry esset, se constanter inter gravem statum medii aetatis et impetuosos affectus iuventutis alternare.

unit.source: Lumian asked with interest, “What happened in previous years?”
unit.target: Lumian studiose rogavit: “Quid accidit in annis praeteritis?”

unit.source: Camus fell silent for a few seconds before saying, “We obtained the funeral registrations for nearly three decades in Tizamo from the Saint-Sien Cathedral and discovered a peculiar phenomenon.
unit.target: Camus paucis momentis siluit antequam dixerit: “Funeris inscriptiones pro fere tribus decenniis in Tizamo ex cathedrali Sancti-Sien obtinuimus et phaenomenon singulare deteximus.”

unit.source: 80% of the annual deaths are recorded within the first three months starting mid-December.
unit.target: LXXX% mortuorum annuarum in tribus primis mensibus, incipiens a media Decembri, registrantur.

unit.source: “This place isn’t like many Northern Continent places.
unit.target: “Hic locus non est sicut multa loca in Continenti Septentrionali.”

unit.source: “Winters are bitterly cold there.
unit.target: Hiems ibi acerbum est.

unit.source: It’s difficult for the elderly and weak to survive.
unit.target: Senibus atque infirmis superesse difficile est.

unit.source: Even if they do, it’s summer from late December to late March.
unit.target: Etiam, si superesse afferant, aestus viget a fine Decembris ad finem Martii.

unit.source: This phenomenon is abnormal.
unit.target: Hoc phaenomenon insolitum est.

unit.source: Lumian advanced slowly and nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian lente processit et leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Is the mortality rate in Tizamo higher than elsewhere?”
unit.target: “Num in Tizamo mortalitas altior est quam alibi?”

unit.source: “Significantly higher, but that’s mainly due to attacks from the primitive forest tribe.
unit.target: “Significanter altior, sed hoc praecipue propter impetus a tribu silvestri primitivae est.”

unit.source: Also, we discovered the tribe’s attacks concentrated in the three months beginning mid-December.
unit.target: Etiam deteximus impetus tribus in tribus mensibus, incipiens a media Decembri, concentratos esse.

unit.source: There have been two to three attacks annually, and since the one on December 17th last year, not a single one has occurred.
unit.target: Duo vel tria impetus quotannis fuerunt, et post eum die XVII Decembris anni praeteriti, nullus evenit.

unit.source: The situation doesn’t seem right.
unit.target: Res non recte videtur.

unit.source: Camus was a little worried a major attack would occur in the next few days.
unit.target: Camus paululum sollicitus erat ne impetus major in proximis diebus eveniret.

unit.source: “Heh heh, it’s understandable the tribe’s attacks concentrated in those first three months.
unit.target: “Heh heh, intellegibile est impetus tribus in illis primis tribus mensibus concentrari.

unit.source: Any other abnormalities?” Lumian asked casually.
unit.target: “Aliae irregularitates sunt?” Lumian leviter interrogavit.

unit.source: Rhea, who had been silently following, responded.
unit.target: Rhea, quae silentio secuta erat, respondit.

unit.source: The brown-skinned, brown-haired woman, exuding a wild beauty, spoke in a raspy voice,
unit.target: Mulier fusca cute et capillis fusco, feram pulchritudinem effundens, voce rauca locuta est,

unit.source: “In the first half of this year, many women in town and the plantations experienced symptoms of nausea, soreness, bloating—pregnancy symptoms.
unit.target: “In prima dimidia huius anni, multae feminae in urbe et in plantis nausea, dolorem, tumorem—signa graviditatis—passae sunt.

unit.source: They believed they’d been victimized by a ghost and might birth evil fetuses, but they weren’t actually pregnant.
unit.target: Credebant se a phantasma laesos esse et malos fetos pariturum esse, sed re vera non gravidabantur.

unit.source: Just illusions.
unit.target: Illusiones tantum erant.

unit.source: After Padre Cali held Mass and briefly purified them, they received psychological comfort and quickly returned to normal.
unit.target: Postquam Padre Cali Missam egit et breviter eos purgavit, solacium animi acceperunt et celeriter ad statum pristinum redierunt.

unit.source: “We’ve also noticed similar incidents of perceived possession and attacks by evil spirits in Tizamo over the years, concentrated in that first half.
unit.target: “Etiam animadvertimus similes casus possessionis perceptae et impetus ab spiritibus malis in Tizamo per annos, in illa prima dimidia concentratos.

unit.source: “It’s not just pregnancy symptoms,” Camus added.
unit.target: “Non tantum signa graviditatis,” Camus addidit.

unit.source: Lumian halted in his tracks.
unit.target: Lumian in cursu suo cessavit.

unit.source: “Don’t the townsfolk and the people in the surrounding plantations find it strange that mass hysteria occurs every year?”
unit.target: “Num incolae urbis et homines in agris circumstantibus non mirantur quod massa tumultus quotannis eveniat?”

unit.source: As a member of the local patrol team, Rhea explained simply, “Everyone believes it’s caused by the primitive tribe in the forest.”
unit.target: Ut membrum cohortis vigiliarum localium, Rhea simpliciter explicavit: “Omnes credunt id tribu silvestri primitivae regionis causari.”

unit.source: “Why?” Lumian resumed his nocturnal “stroll.”
unit.target: “Cur?” Lumian, nocturnam ambulandi viam iterum suscipiens, rogavit.

unit.source: Rhea’s vocal cords seemed damaged, and her voice was always a little hoarse.
unit.target: Rheae chordae vocales laesi videbantur, et vox eius paulum semper rauca erat.

unit.source: “In the repeated attacks and conflicts, the primitive tribe displayed the ability to control corpses, ghosts, and shadows.
unit.target: “In impetus et conflictibus repetitis, tribus primitiva ostendit facultatem cadavera, phantasma, et umbras regere.

unit.source: Furthermore, some warriors seemed to continue protecting their tribe in their spirit form after their deaths.
unit.target: Praeterea, quidam bellatores videbantur tribum suam, post mortem, in forma spiritus protegere.

unit.source: Death domain… Heh, the entire matter seems logical on the surface.
unit.target: Regio mortis… Heh, tota quaestio in superficie logica videtur.

unit.source: No wonder the Tizamons who left town didn’t find anything amiss and didn’t raise the issue…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod Tizamones, qui urbem reliquerunt, nihil amissum reperirent nec de re loquerentur.

unit.source: Lumian had seen records of the primitive tribe, but they weren’t as specific as Rhea’s description.
unit.target: Lumian documenta de tribu primitiva viderat, sed non erant tam specifica quam Rheae descriptio.

unit.source: After inquiring about the recent information the patrol team had gathered, Lumian stopped in front of Hisoka’s house and turned to glance at Rhea, who was carrying a hunting bow and arrows.
unit.target: Postquam de novis notitiis quas turma vigiliarum collegerat inquisivit, Lumian coram domo Hisoka cessit et adspicere conversus est ad Rhea, quae arcum venaticum et sagittas gerebat.

unit.source: “You’re from the Southern Continent, but not from Tizamo?”
unit.target: “Ex Continente Meridionali es, sed non ex Tizamo?”

unit.source: Rhea nodded and calmly said, “I’m from the forest.
unit.target: Rhea annuens tranquillime respondit: “Ex silva sum.”

unit.source: I’m from one of the primitive tribes called Paca.
unit.target: Ex una tribu primitiva, quae Paca vocatur, sum.

unit.source: We mainly live near the Paz Valley.
unit.target: Praesertim prope Vallis Paz habitamus.

unit.source: The rainforest of the Southern Continent spanned a vast expanse, encompassing numerous territories.
unit.target: Foresta pluvialis Continenti Meridionalis immensa extensio est, compluribus terris includens.

unit.source: From the area near the Paz Valley to the vicinity of Matani, the distance might be even greater than that between Cordu and Trier.
unit.target: A regione prope Vallis Paz ad prope Matani, distantia fortasse maior est quam inter Cordu et Trier.

unit.source: “Paca” meant “wind” in Dutanese.
unit.target: “Paca” significabat “ventum” in lingua Dutana.

unit.source: “How did you come to Matani?” Lumian asked curiously.
unit.target: “Quomodo ad Matani pervenisti?” Lumian curiosus rogavit.

unit.source: Rhea let out a chuckle.
unit.target: Rhea subridens eduxit risum.

unit.source: “I was sold here.”
unit.target: “Hic vendita sum.”

unit.source: She paused for a moment before continuing, “Ten years ago, my tribe was attacked by the Loen Kingdom’s army.
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit antequam pergeret: “Decem abhinc annos, tribus mea a exercitu Regni Loen aggressa est.

unit.source: I was captured and sold repeatedly before arriving in the Northern state.
unit.target: Capta fui et pluries vendita, antequam ad statum Septentrionalem pervenirem.

unit.source: Later, I found a chance to escape and fled to Port Pylos.
unit.target: Postea, occasionem evadendi inveni et ad Portum Pylos confugi.

unit.source: I received help from the Church and found work.
unit.target: Auxilium a Ecclesia accepi et laborem inveni.

unit.source: Eventually, I was lucky enough to become a Beyonder.
unit.target: Denique, fortunata, Beyonder facta sum.

unit.source: The patrol team member calmly recounted her past, not dwelling on any pain or torture from those experiences, nor deliberately avoiding details.
unit.target: Membrum turmae vigiliarum tranquille praeterita sua enarrare coepit, neque dolorem aut cruciatum ex illis experimentis detinuit nec singularia omisit.

unit.source: No wonder you believe so devoutly in the Eternal Blazing Sun…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod tam devote Solem Aeternum Flammantem credas…

unit.source: Lumian ascended the stairs to the second floor and said in an even tone, “Did you keep using a bow instead of firearms out of habit?”
unit.target: Lumian scalam in secundarium gradum ascendit et aequo toni dixit: “Num ex consuetudine arcum usus es potius quam arma ignifera?”

unit.source: “Yes. Tribes named for the wind excel at archery.” Rhea’s light-brown face softened.
unit.target: “Ita est. Tribus, quae vento nominatae sunt, in arcubus excellunt.” Facies Rhea, levis et castanea, leniter mollita est.

unit.source: Lumian glanced back at her.
unit.target: Lumian ad eam iterum respexit.

unit.source: “Did you ever go back to take a look?”
unit.target: “Num umquam rediit ut rem inspiceret?”

unit.source: Rhea fell silent for a few seconds.
unit.target: Rhea paucis momentis siluit.

unit.source: “They’re all dead…”
unit.target: “Omnes mortui sunt…”

unit.source: Lumian and Camus retreated their gazes in silence as they climbed the final stairs and entered the second floor of the house.
unit.target: Lumian et Camus silentio oculos retraxerunt, dum ultimas scalas ascendebant et in secundarium domus gradum intraverunt.

unit.source: Lumian surveyed the spacious yet rudimentary surroundings, listening to the wild roars from the primitive forest.
unit.target: Lumian spatia ampla sed rudia perspexit, auscultans feroces clamores ex silva primitiva.

unit.source: He sat cross-legged.
unit.target: Sedit cruribus transpositis.

unit.source: He had intended to tell Rhea, “It’s impossible for your entire tribe to be wiped out.
unit.target: Voluerat Rhea dicere: “Impossibile est totam tuam tribum exterminari.”

unit.source: Some must have been captured and sold like you.
unit.target: Nonnulli certē capti et venditi sunt sicut tu.

unit.source: They could still be alive on plantations, in mines, or seedy bars.
unit.target: Fortasse adhuc vivunt in plantis, in fodinis, aut in popinis spurcissimis.

unit.source: But he held back.
unit.target: Sed retinuit.

unit.source: He could tell Rhea had accepted her current life and gained the ability to live better.
unit.target: Intellegebat Rhea vitam suam praesentem accepisse et facultatem melius vivendi adeptam esse.

unit.source: It seemed inappropriate to encourage her to risk traversing both continents seeking potential remaining clansmen.
unit.target: Videbatur inopportunum eam incitare ut per utramque continentem iter faceret ad quaerendos, qui fortasse adhuc superessent de genere suo.

unit.source: Just the thought of such an endeavor was daunting.
unit.target: Mere cogitatio talis conatus formidolosus videbatur.

unit.source: With so few clues and them likely scattered far, it could prove quite dangerous.
unit.target: Cum tam paucis signis et verisimiliter longe disseminatis, id se valde periculosum ostendere poterat.

unit.source: Even spending a lifetime, one might never complete it.
unit.target: Etiam, totam vitam impendens, id fortasse numquam conficietur.

unit.source: Not everyone with a similar experience would sacrifice a normal life for vengeance or seeking others.
unit.target: Non omnes, similem experientiam habentes, vitam normam pro ultione aut alios quaerendo sacrificant.

unit.source: Rhea likely realized some clansmen survived, but perhaps those most important to her had perished.
unit.target: Rhea probabiliter intellexit aliquos membra gentis superesse, sed fortasse illos, qui maxime ei erant, perisse.

unit.source: She chose to stay in Port Pylos.
unit.target: Optavit manere in Portu Pylos.

unit.source: Everyone makes their own choices.
unit.target: Omnes suas electiones faciunt.

unit.source: I can’t ask the same of others just because of my own obsessions…
unit.target: Non possum aliis eundem postulari, propter meas solas obsessiones.

unit.source: Lumian composed himself and smiled at Camus and Rhea, who were still standing.
unit.target: Lumian se composuit et Camum ac Rheam subridens respexit, qui adhuc stabant.

unit.source: “Would you like to explore the potential venue for the Dream Festival?”
unit.target: “Visne explorare locum potentialem pro Festivitate Somniorum?”

unit.source: “Where?” Rhea blurted out.
unit.target: “Ubi?” exclamavit Rhea.

unit.source: Camus furrowed his brow.
unit.target: Camus supercilia contraxit.

unit.source: “Here?”
unit.target: “Hic?”

unit.source: Quickly making a guess, he asked, “Do you come here every night to sleep and access the Dream Festival’s location? Is it in a special dream?”
unit.target: Celeriter coniectans, quaesivit: “Venisne hic omni nocte ut dormias et ad locum Festi Somniorum pervenias? Estne in somnio speciali?”

unit.source: Quite smart… Lumian praised Camus inwardly for his quick thinking, but his smile remained unwavering.
unit.target: Callide… Lumian Camum interno animo laudavit propter celerrimam cogitationem, sed risus eius immotus permanebat.

unit.source: “Care to experience it?”
unit.target: “Visne id experiri?”

unit.source: Camus and Rhea exchanged glances and agreed, “I’ll experience it. Rhea, keep an eye on the surroundings.”
unit.target: Camus et Rhea oculos commutaverunt et consenserunt: “Experiar. Rhea, circumiecta vigila.”

unit.source: “I can set some traps,” Lumian offered.
unit.target: “Laqueos imponere possum,” Lumian obtulit.

unit.source: He stood up and spent a few minutes setting up warning traps nearby.
unit.target: Surgens, paucis minutis laqueos admonitores prope instituere conatus est.

unit.source: Afterward, he lit a mosquito repellent candle, placing it in the middle of the spacious second floor.
unit.target: Postea, candelam culicos repellentem accendit, eam in medio secundi pavimenti spatiosi posuit.

unit.source: Mosquitoes that hadn’t flown away landed on the ground, emitting flames and smoke amidst crackling sounds.
unit.target: Culices, qui nondum volaverant, in terram se deposuerunt, flammas et fumum emittens inter sonos crepitantes.

unit.source: “Sleep here,” Lumian instructed Camus and Rhea as he sat cross-legged again.
unit.target: “Hic dormite,” Lumian Camum et Rheam iussit, dum iterum cruribus transpositis sedit.

unit.source: He had confirmed that sleeping anywhere in Hisoka’s house at night allowed him to enter the special dream.
unit.target: Confirmavit se quod ubique in domo Hisoka nocte dormire licebat, ita ut in somnium speciale perveniret.

unit.source: Sleeping outside or sleeping two hours earlier didn’t have the same effect.
unit.target: Extra domum dormire aut duas horas ante non eundem effectum habebat.

unit.source: Perplexed, Camus and Rhea found seats and leaned against different wooden pillars, attempting to enter a deep slumber.
unit.target: Perturbati, Camus et Rhea sedes quaesierunt et contra diversas columnas ligneas se reclinaverunt, conantes in profundum soporem pervenire.

unit.source: After an unknown period of time, Camus suddenly woke up.
unit.target: Post aliquod ignotum tempus, Camus subito evigilavit.

unit.source: Before him was the night and the crimson moonlight outside the window.
unit.target: Ante eum nox erat et rufum lunam lumen extra fenestram fulgebat.

unit.source: Louis Berry stood behind the flickering mosquito repellent candle, wearing a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Ludovicus Berry stabat post candelam culicos repellentem micantem, pileum stramineum aureum gerens.

unit.source: The adventurer playfully remarked, “Welcome to the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Aventurator ludenter dixit: “Salve ad Festum Somniorum!”

unit.source: 667 Approaching Gentleness
unit.target: 667 Mansuetudinem Accedens

unit.source: Camus’s nerves tensed as he propped himself up on his left hand, surveying his surroundings warily.
unit.target: Nervi Camusi contracti sunt dum manu sinistra se sustentans circumiecta caute intuēbatur.

unit.source: He realized he was still on the second floor of Twanaku’s house.
unit.target: Animadvertit se adhuc in secundo tabulato domus Twanaku esse.

unit.source: Rhea, who had been leaning against a wooden pillar, stood up in a daze.
unit.target: Rhea, quae in columna lignea recubuerat, stupefacta surrexit.

unit.source: Everything around him seemed no different from before he had fallen asleep.
unit.target: Omnia circa eum eadem videbantur, sicut antequam obdormiret.

unit.source: “Are you joking?” Camus asked Louis Berry cautiously.
unit.target: «Iocarisne?» inquit Camus ad Ludovicum Berry caute.

unit.source: What kind of Dream Festival is this?
unit.target: Quale est hoc Festum Somniorum?

unit.source: This feels like a normal awakening after a nap!
unit.target: Hoc instat ut experrectus ordinarius post somnum brevem!

unit.source: Lumian turned and pointed out the window.
unit.target: Lumian conversus est et ad fenestram demonstravit.

unit.source: “Listen to the forest sounds.”
unit.target: «Audi sonos silvae.»

unit.source: Camus and Rhea instinctively listened, realizing that the nearby forest was eerily silent, as if all its inhabitants had fallen asleep in the night.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea instanter audiverunt, animadvertentes silvam proximam insolenter silentem esse, quasi omnes incolae eius noctu obdormiti essent.

unit.source: Wh— Rhea’s eyes narrowed.
unit.target: Heu— oculi Rhea contracti sunt.

unit.source: Born and raised in the primitive forest and having lived in Tizamo Town for nearly a year, she knew the forest wouldn’t be in such absolute silence.
unit.target: Nata et educata in silva primitiva, ac paene annum in oppido Tizamo vixisse, scivit silvam non tam absolute silentem fore.

unit.source: Lumian pointed at the floor beside the mosquito repellent candle.
unit.target: Lumian ad solum iuxta candela repellens culices demonstravit.

unit.source: “Look here again.”
unit.target: «Rursus hic intuere.»

unit.source: Camus and Rhea looked over, realizing that the mosquito corpses that should have been there were gone.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea intuerebantur, animadvertentes corpora culicum, quae illic esse debuerant, evanuisse.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian risit.

unit.source: “Of course, you can also believe that I woke up early, cleaned up the environment, and secretly affected your hearing of distant voices. All of this was just a prank.”
unit.target: «Scilicet, et credere potestis me mane experrectum esse, ambitum purgatum, et clam vestram auditionem vocum remotarum mutavisse. Haec omnia nihil aliud quam iocus erant.»

unit.source: Camus pondered for a few seconds.
unit.target: Camus paucos momenta meditatus est.

unit.source: “I’m inclined to believe you, but I need to confirm something.”
unit.target: «Inclino ut te credam, sed aliquid confirmare debeo.»

unit.source: “Indeed,” Rhea chimed in, carrying a hunting bow and arrows.
unit.target: «Certe,» inquit Rhea, ferens arcum venatorium et sagittas.

unit.source: Lumian looked at them and nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian ad eos respexit et leviter annuit.

unit.source: He calmly concluded, I can now determine that the reason I remain conscious in this peculiar dream stems from a hidden power within Hisoka’s house, not any special traits of my own.
unit.target: Quiete conclusit: nunc determinare possum causam cur in hoc somnio singulari conscius maneam, ex occultā potentiā in domo Hisoka provenire, non ex aliquibus meis singularibus proprietatibus.

unit.source: He had invited Camus and Rhea to slumber in Hisoka’s house and enter the special dream not merely to share information with the patrol team and gather a few aides.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea invitaverat ut in domo Hisoka obdormirent atque in somnium speciale intrarent, non tantum ad informationem cum manipulo vigilum communicandam et aliquos adiutores colligendos.

unit.source: No, it was also an experiment to uncover key details!
unit.target: Minime, experimentum etiam erat ad detegenda elementa clavis!

unit.source: Over the past few days, Lumian had conducted numerous similar trials, grasping the dream’s nuanced patterns like a seasoned explorer mapping uncharted lands.
unit.target: Per dies praeteritos, Lumian multa experimenta similia egit, subtilia somnii ordines, sicut peritus explorator terras ignotas delineans, comprehensus.

unit.source: With hands tucked nonchalantly in his pockets, he trailed behind Camus and Rhea, who hurried downstairs.
unit.target: Manibus noncuranter in sinu reclusis, post Camum et Raeam se trahebat, quae celeriter deorsum gradus descenderunt.

unit.source: He wanted to witness how they would confirm whether this was indeed a dream.
unit.target: Volebat videre quomodo comprobarent an hoc vere somnium esset.

unit.source: After departing Twanaku’s house, the two patrol members rushed to the nearest townsperson’s abode.
unit.target: Postquam domum Twanaku reliquerunt, duo vigilum membra ad domicilium civis proximæ festinaverunt.

unit.source: Upon realizing the livestock had vanished from the ground floor, Rhea swiftly ascended to the second story and attempted to unlock the door with a simple iron-black key.
unit.target: Animadverte pecora a primo tabulato evanuisse, Rhea celeriter in secundum tabulatum ascendit et conata est ostium clāvis ferreae nigrae simplicis aperire.

unit.source: Camus opened his mouth as if to dissuade her, but in the end, remained silent.
unit.target: Camus os aperuit quasi eam detrectare velle, sed denique tacitus remansit.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian nodded thoughtfully and muttered to himself, A Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway will subconsciously maintain the current order, unwilling to disrupt its fabric. If such Beyonders also bear official identities, this tendency only intensifies…
unit.target: Observans hoc, Lumian cogitans annuit et sibi ipsi murmuravit: "Beyonder viae Arbiteris subconscie ordinem praesentem servabit, nolens eius structuram perturbare. Si tales Beyonder etiam identitates officiales ferant, haec inclinatio solum augebitur…"

unit.source: Rhea rapped upon the door and entered the dwelling.
unit.target: Rhea ostium percussit et in domicilium intravit.

unit.source: She and Camus scoured each room, but the resident family had seemingly evaporated into thin air.
unit.target: Ea et Camus quolibet conclave perquisiverunt, sed familia incola quasi in aerem tenuem evanuerat.

unit.source: Then, the pair made their way to the police station near the Saint-Sien Cathedral’s hallowed grounds.
unit.target: Deinde, par iter fecit ad stationem vigilum iuxta spatia sacra Cathedrali Sancti-Sien.

unit.source: The local patrol quarters held five rooms in total.
unit.target: Praesidia locales vigilium quinque conclavia habebant in summa.

unit.source: Kolobo, Maslow, and Loban were nowhere to be found, nor were the two officers meant to stand the night watch.
unit.target: Kolobo, Maslow, et Loban nusquam reperti sunt, nec duo officiales, qui nocturnam vigiliam tenere debuerunt, apparuerunt.

unit.source: “I now believe this is a dream,” Camus declared to Louis Berry, who leisurely trailed with hands tucked in pockets, a golden straw hat shading his features.
unit.target: «Nunc credo hoc esse somnium,» proclamavit Camus ad Ludovicum Berry, qui tarde se sequebatur, manibus in sinu reclusis, galea aurea ex stragulis vultum suum tegens.

unit.source: “Yet I’m so utterly awake that it defies the very notion of a dream.”
unit.target: «Sed tam plane vigilans sum ut ipsa notio somnii repugnet.»

unit.source: Before Lumian could respond, Rhea’s light-brown face furrowed slightly.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian responderet, facies Rhea, colore castaneo claro, leviter contraxit.

unit.source: “When I ran down the street and searched these rooms, it felt a little… familiar.”
unit.target: «Cum per viam cucurri et haec cubicula perquisivi, aliquid… familiare mihi apparuit.»

unit.source: “Familiar?” Lumian asked calmly, his brows unfurrowed.
unit.target: «Familiare?» inquit Lumian tranquille, superciliis non contractis.

unit.source: Could there be unexpected gains from this experiment?
unit.target: Num ex hoc experimento beneficia inopinata oriuntur?

unit.source: Rhea pondered for a moment.
unit.target: Rhea paulisper meditata est.

unit.source: “I think I’ve had a similar dream before.”
unit.target: «Puto me simile somnium antea habuisse.»

unit.source: “In my dream, it was just as dark and quiet. The streets were empty, and I was alone. I ran around, searching…”
unit.target: «In somnio meo, totum aeque obscurum ac quietum erat. Viae vacuae erant, et solus eram. Circumcurreram, quaerens…»

unit.source: “Was it a mere fragment or a complete dream?” Lumian pressed.
unit.target: «Fuitne id solum fragmentum an integrum somnium?» instanter quaesivit Lumian.

unit.source: Rhea thought for a few seconds.
unit.target: Rhea paucos momenta meditata est.

unit.source: “I don’t know. I only remember a few such scenes.”
unit.target: «Nescio. Tantum paucas huiusmodi scenae memini.»

unit.source: “Do you often dream of this, or only occasionally?” Lumian guided her to confirm the details.
unit.target: «Saepene hoc somnium tibi occurrit, an tantum interdum?» Lumian eam interrogavit ad singula confirmanda.

unit.source: Rhea replied with certainty, “Occasionally.”
unit.target: Rhea certo respondit: «Interdum.»

unit.source: “Occasionally…”
unit.target: «Interdum…»

unit.source: Even if the Tizamo residents don’t slumber here on a specific date, they can occasionally enter this peculiar dream, yet remain unable to stay awake.
unit.target: Etiamsi incolae Tizamo hic in certo die non obdormiant, interdum hoc somnium singulare intrare possunt, sed vigilare perseverare non possunt.

unit.source: Like a normal dream?
unit.target: Velut somnium normale?

unit.source: Perhaps it’s not true immersion, but rather an unconscious development spiritually spawned from the crimson moon and other environmental elements, allowing them to vaguely interact.
unit.target: Forsitan non vera immersio sit, sed potius inconscius progressus spiritualis ex rubra luna et aliis elementis ambientis, qui eos ad vago modum interagi sinit.

unit.source: Unfortunately, Rhea clearly doesn’t recall the moon, weather, and other situational details from those dreams.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Rhea manifeste non meminit lunam, tempestatem, atque cetera singula ex illis somniis.

unit.source: If I could employ Dream Divination, I could aid her recollection…
unit.target: Si somnii divinationem adhibere possem, eius memoriam adiuvare possem…

unit.source: The few Tizamons I queried in Port Pylos made no mention of such dreams.
unit.target: Pauci Tizamonenses, quos in Portu Pylos interrogavi, de talibus somniis nihil dixerunt.

unit.source: Firstly, dreams so ordinary often slip the mind.
unit.target: Primum, somnia tam ordinaria saepe ex mente evanescunt.

unit.source: Secondly, they’ve been away from Tizamo for years…
unit.target: Secundo, per annos a Tizamo absunt…

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he turned to Camus to see if the Interrogator had any queries.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani festinanter volitabant, ad Camum se convertit ut videret an Interrogator quaestiones haberet.

unit.source: Camus pondered for a moment before asking Rhea, “What do you think is special about the residents of Tizamo?”
unit.target: Camus paulisper meditatus est, deinde Raeam rogavit: "Quid putas de incolis Tizamo, quod eos speciales faciat?"

unit.source: Very perceptive.
unit.target: Valde perspicax.

unit.source: Since this dream seems to affect the entire town and surrounding area, it’s likely these people will display some abnormality in waking life…
unit.target: Cum hoc somnium totam urbem ac circumstantiam afficere videatur, verisimile est hos homines aliquam abnormitatem in vita vigili ostendere…

unit.source: Lumian nodded inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian interius annuit.

unit.source: Rhea thought for a moment.
unit.target: Rhea paulisper meditata est.

unit.source: “Nothing special. It’s just that they’re very… obedient.”
unit.target: «Nihil speciale. Sola res est quod sunt valde obsequiosi.»

unit.source: At this, Rhea sighed.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Rhea suspiravit.

unit.source: “They’re extremely polite to others. Gentle personalities, stable emotions, very obedient. Even when angered, they quickly calm down. When trouble arises, they tend to let the authorities handle it instead of fighting amongst themselves or causing public disturbances…”
unit.target: «Ergo erga alios valde comitati sunt. Indoles mansuetae, affectus stables, atque maximi obsequiosi. Etiam cum irati sint, celeriter sedantur. Cum difficultas oritur, praeferunt auctoritates agere, potius quam inter se pugnare aut tumultus publicos creare…»

unit.source: These were all situations Lumian had heard Camus mention and seen in the corresponding intel.
unit.target: Haec erant omnia casus quos Lumian a Camus audiverat referendos et in informatione congruenti conspectos.

unit.source: On the surface, nothing seemed amiss.
unit.target: Superficialiter, nihil aberrans videbatur.

unit.source: It was a state of being tamed.
unit.target: Erat status mansuetus.

unit.source: Rhea added, “Their only issue is a lack of enthusiasm.
unit.target: Rhea addidit: "Unicum eorum problema est defectus studii.

unit.source: It’s not that politeness masks an underlying coldness or hatred.
unit.target: Non est quod urbanitas tegat latentem frigiditatem aut odium.

unit.source: They’re simply… unenthusiastic, as if reluctant to openly display emotion.”
unit.target: Simpliciter… ignavi sunt, quasi nolle affectus aperte exprimere.

unit.source: Upon hearing this, Lumian recalled the Tizamons he’d interacted with over the past few days.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian Tizamonenses quos per dies praeteritos convenerat meminisse coepit.

unit.source: Apart from some gentlemen and ladies from the Northern Continent, the others were calm, gentle, and disinclined to argue.
unit.target: Praeter nonnullos viros et mulieres ex Continente Septentrionali, ceteri erant tranquilli, mansueti, et ad contentionem non conati.

unit.source: They always communicated politely.
unit.target: Semper urbaniter loquebantur.

unit.source: Immediately after, he recalled the Tizamons questioned in Port Pylos—fear, worry, ingratiating expressions, vivid emotions.
unit.target: Statim postea meminit Tizamonenses in Portu Pylos interrogatos—timor, sollicitudine, vultus obsequiosis, et affectus vivos.

unit.source: Clearly different from the Tizamo townspeople!
unit.target: Plane a civibus Tizamo differebant!

unit.source: Most of their emotions have been drawn away into the dream?
unit.target: Plurimi eorum affectus in somnium allati sunt?

unit.source: Lumian finally pinpointed an abnormality about the Tizamons.
unit.target: Lumian denique anomaliam de Tizamonibus determinavit.

unit.source: Their issue clearly didn’t stem solely from attacks by the primitive forest tribe!
unit.target: Quaestio eorum manifeste non solum ex impetus tribus silvarum primitivarum orta erat!

unit.source: Upon hearing Lumian’s guess, Camus couldn’t help but hiss.
unit.target: Audito coniecturam Lumiani, Camus sibilum emittere non potuit.

unit.source: “I knew it. The Tizamons feel… strange. Too docile. Even livestock occasionally grow agitated, resists… Could the reason be…”
unit.target: «Sciebam. Tizamonenses sentiuntur… insoliti. Nimis mansueti. Etiam pecora interdum excitari videntur, repugnantur… An causa sit…»

unit.source: Rhea’s heart skipped a beat as she said solemnly, voice laced with fear, “I’ve been here nearly a year, and I feel much gentler…
unit.target: Cor Rhea paulum percussum est, dum sollemniter dixit, voce metu tincta, "Paene annum hic fui, et me multo mansuorem sentio…

unit.source: “My most intense emotions haven’t dissipated. They’re still in my heart, but most of the time, it’s as if I’m… asleep…”
unit.target: Affectus mei intensissimi nondum evanuerunt. Adhuc in corde meo manent, sed plerumque quasi obdormitus sim…"

unit.source: Rhea began analyzing herself.
unit.target: Rhea coepit se examinare.

unit.source: “From the looks of it, everyone in Tizamo will gradually be affected by this peculiar dream.
unit.target: «Ex aspectu, omnes in Tizamo paulatim huic somnio singulari afficiendi erunt.

unit.source: After leaving, they can slowly escape its influence.”
unit.target: Postquam discesserint, lente eius influxum effugere poterunt.»

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Camus.
unit.target: Lumian Camum aspexit.

unit.source: “For outsiders like us, who’ve only been here a few days, there’s no issue for now.”
unit.target: «Externis ut nobis, qui hic paucis diebus tantummodo fuimus, pro tempore nihil est.»

unit.source: “Perhaps we’ll also become unnaturally gentle if we linger too long.”
unit.target: «Forsitan etiam nos nimis insolenter mansueti fiamus, si nimis diu moramur.»

unit.source: Without waiting for Camus’s response, Lumian inquired, “When will reinforcements from the patrol team and Admiral Guard arrive?”
unit.target: Nisi exspectans responsum Camus, Lumian interrogavit: "Quando subsidia ex manipulo vigilium et Custodia Admiralis pervenient?"

unit.source: At the mention of this, Camus’s expression soured.
unit.target: Ad hoc dictum, vultus Camus obnubilatus est.

unit.source: He gritted his teeth and cursed, “Those selfish bastards!”
unit.target: Dentes contraxit et maledixit: "Illi avari impii!"

unit.source: It’s very likely there won’t be much support.
unit.target: Valde verisimile est parvum subsidium fore.

unit.source: “The Admiral Guard said they already have a Beyonder team here and an army.
unit.target: «Custodes Admirales dixerunt iam hunc Beyonder coetum et exercitum habere.

unit.source: Only Captain Reaza expressed backing for the patrol team.
unit.target: Solus Dux Reaza pro manipulo vigilium suffragium expressit.

unit.source: Dammit, those dogsh*t!”
unit.target: Pro damnatione, illi spurci canes!

unit.source: Lumian was taken aback for a moment before bursting into laughter.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper obstupefactus est, deinde in risum erupit.

unit.source: The newly formed organization under the aboriginal admiral was indeed different from the official Northern Continent organizations.
unit.target: Nova constituta organizatio sub admiro aborigino re vera differebat ab officialibus organizatis Continenti Septentrionali.

unit.source: If this were the Eternal Blazing Sun Church or Church of Earth Mother, the official Beyonders would have already devised a plan and dispatched sufficient force to resolve the issue.
unit.target: Si haec esset Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Incendens aut Ecclesia Matris Terrae, Beyonder oficiales iam consilium excogitaverint et copiam satis misissent ad problemate solvendum.

unit.source: They’d be prepared to obliterate Tizamo if anything went awry.
unit.target: Parati fore dicerent Tizamo exstinguere, si quid male accideret.

unit.source: The current situation is Admiral Querarill believes that with me—a famed adventurer backed by the Church of The Fool, here—I’m able to use its power to resolve Tizamo’s troubles.
unit.target: Res praesentis condicionis est: Admiralis Querarill credit, quod mecum—famosus viator ab Ecclesia Stulti sustentatus—hic, eius potentiam ad quaestiones Tizamo solvendas uti possim.

unit.source: Is there a need to send more Beyonder subordinates to aid me?
unit.target: Num necesse sit plures subalternos Beyonder ad me adiuvandum mittere?

unit.source: That’s true. Beyonders aren’t commodities.
unit.target: Id verum est. Beyonder non sunt mercimonia.

unit.source: If too many powerful ones perish, not only will Admiral Querarill feel the strain, but he won’t be able to effectively rule Matani…
unit.target: Si nimis multi potens intereant, non solum Admiralis Querarill laborem sentiet, sed etiam Matani efficaciter regere non poterit…

unit.source: Recruitment alone can’t quickly fill such a gap, and they won’t be quick to trust newcomers.
unit.target: Solum receptio celeriter talem hiatus complere non potest, neque ad novis cito confidunt.

unit.source: Even nurturing the remaining people with the retrieved Beyonder characteristics poses huge problems.
unit.target: Etiam reliquos homines proprietatibus Beyonder receptis alere magnas difficultates attulit.

unit.source: Low-Sequence Beyonders are manageable, but Mid-Sequence advancement carries high failure risk.
unit.target: Beyonder in serie inferiori tractabiles sunt, sed in serie media progressus magnum periculum defectus fert.

unit.source: After all, most here haven’t mastered the acting method…
unit.target: Postremo, plerique hic modum agendi nondum exceperunt…

unit.source: Lumian quickly grasped Admiral Querarill’s mentality.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter mentalitatem Admiralis Querarill apprehendit.

unit.source: He said to the agitated Camus, “Let me show you around this dream realm and provide an introduction.”
unit.target: Dixit ad Camum concitatus: "Sinite me hunc somnium regnum vobis demonstrare et introductionem praebere."

unit.source: “Alright.” Camus took a deep breath.
unit.target: «Recte.» Camus altum spiritum traxit.

unit.source: He and Rhea followed Lumian through the dark, silent, vacant town.
unit.target: Ipse et Rhea Lumian per oppidum obscurum, silentem, et desertum secuti sunt.

unit.source: After a long while, Lumian led the two patrol members into the primitive forest.
unit.target: Post longum intervallum, Lumian duo vigilum membra in silvam primitivam duxit.

unit.source: He informed them he’d seen Twanaku’s image in the chaotic zone ahead, seemingly composed of dream fragments.
unit.target: Eis nuntiavit se imaginem Twanaku in zona chaotica prae se visam esse, quasi ex fragmentis somnii compositam.

unit.source: He suspected there was a Desire Apostle mark present.
unit.target: Suspicabatur ibi signum Apostoli Desiderii adesse.

unit.source: Walking amongst the trees, giants in the night, Camus felt increasingly oppressed.
unit.target: Inter arbores ambulans, ut gigantes in nocte, Camus se magis magisque opprimi sensit.

unit.source: Before he could inquire about Twanaku’s image details, he suddenly heard a bowstring drawn taut.
unit.target: Antequam de singularibus imaginis Twanaku quaereret, subito audivit chordam arcu strenue tensam.

unit.source: Pa!
unit.target: Pa!

unit.source: An arrow, entwined with lightning, flew from afar.
unit.target: Sagitta, fulmine implicata, ab longe volavit.

unit.source: Camus dodged just in time as it grazed past, piercing into a rubber tree behind him amidst crackling lightning and charred bark.
unit.target: Camus tempore sale evasit, dum sagitta paene praeter transiret, perforans in arborem caoutchouc post eum, inter fulmina crepitantia et corticem comburentem.

unit.source: Lumian, Camus, and Rhea gazed into the distance, spotting a woman standing on a huge tree branch.
unit.target: Lumian, Camus, et Rhea in longinquo conspexerunt, mulierem in ramo ingenti arboris stantem deprehendentes.

unit.source: The woman wore dark leather armor, holding a hunting bow and arrows.
unit.target: Mulier loricam ex pelle obscura gerebat, arcum venatorium et sagittas tenens.

unit.source: Her brown hair was tied in two strands draped over her shoulders.
unit.target: Capilli eius castanei in duas fascias alligati erant et super umeros recubebant.

unit.source: Her light brown skin and wild, beautiful face couldn’t hide the coldness and hatred behind her eyes.
unit.target: Cutis eius fuscopallida et facies fera ac pulchra non poterant celare frigorem et odium post oculos.

unit.source: Rhea!
unit.target: Rhea!

unit.source: It was Rhea!
unit.target: Erat Rhea!

unit.source: 668 Dream Person?
unit.target: 668 Persona Somniorum?

unit.source: Rhea gazed at the figure perched on the tree branch, a surreal scene playing out before her like a dream.
unit.target: Rhea speciem in ramo arboris sedenti contemplata est, scaenam insolitam ante eam quasi somnium evolutam videns.

unit.source: Correction: This was a dream.
unit.target: Correctio: Hoc somnium erat.

unit.source: The other Rhea’s frigid expression masked a deep-seated hatred as she drew the bowstring once more, causing the arrow to crackle with silver lightning.
unit.target: Altera Rhea vultum frigoris gerebat, qui profundum odium celabat, dum iterum funem arcus trahebat, quo sagittam fulmine argenteo crepitare fecit.

unit.source: As Lumian contemplated teleporting behind Rhea on the tree to probe her control in this eerily realistic dream and question her about her apparent “knowledge” of the situation, his surroundings quivered and fragmented into disjointed scenes.
unit.target: Cum Lumian meditaret de se teleportando post Rheam in arbore, ut eius potestatem in hoc somnio, quod insolite realistice appareret, perquireret atque eam de sua apparenti scientia rei interrogaret, circumstantia eius tremuerunt et in scaenas disiunctas dispersa sunt.

unit.source: The scenes overlapped and promptly shattered.
unit.target: Scaenae inter se coinciderunt et celeriter dissolutae sunt.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian, Rhea, and Camus opened their eyes.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian, Rhea, et Camus oculos aperuerunt.

unit.source: Crimson moonlight spilled through the window, accompanied by the primal roars of wild beasts from the nearby forest.
unit.target: Lumen lunare rubicundum per fenestram effudit, comitatus primordiali rugitu bestiarum ferarum ex silva proxima.

unit.source: They found themselves still on the second floor of Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: Se invenerunt adhuc in secundo tabulato domus Hisokae.

unit.source: Camus jolted upright, eyeing the mosquito repellent candle that had burned out, leaving behind a mere stub.
unit.target: Camus subito se extollit, intuens candelam repellens culices, quae exstincta erat et solum exiguum reliquum reliquit.

unit.source: Charred mosquito corpses littered the area.
unit.target: Cadavera culicum combusta in regione dispersa erant.

unit.source: “Are we awake? Have we returned to reality?”
unit.target: “Num evigilati sumus? An ad rem redierimus?”

unit.source: Camus questioned, uncertainty clouding his expression.
unit.target: Camus quaesivit, vultum incertitudinis obductum habens.

unit.source: Leaning against a wooden pillar, Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Subnixus columnae lignea, Lumian subridens erat.

unit.source: “That should be the case, but I won’t claim we’re 100% out of the dream.
unit.target: Id ita esse oportet, sed non affirmabo nos penitus extra somnium esse.

unit.source: “We’ll need to verify through various details in the coming period.”
unit.target: Variis rebus in tempore venturo probare oportebit.

unit.source: The simplest method involved checking Ludwig’s whereabouts and state.
unit.target: Methodus simplicissima consistebat in investiganda de loco ac condicione Ludovici.

unit.source: Although asking Termiboros could provide an accurate answer, there was no guarantee the fellow would answer or respond truthfully.
unit.target: Quamquam rogatio a Termiboro responsum accuratum afferre posset, nihil certe praestabatur quod ille veraciter responderet.

unit.source: Camus nodded, his gaze shifting to Rhea, who had remained silent since waking up.
unit.target: Camus annuit, oculos versans ad Rheam, quae post evigilationem tacita remansit.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he spoke.
unit.target: Brevi intervallo, locutus est.

unit.source: “We seem to have witnessed another version of you at the dream’s boundary.”
unit.target: Videtur nos aliam versionem tui in limine somnii vidisse.

unit.source: Another Rhea, embodying entirely different emotions and states.
unit.target: Altera Rhea, affectibus et statibus omnino diversis induta.

unit.source: Rhea stayed silent for a moment before admitting, “I saw it too.”
unit.target: Rhea paulisper tacuit antequam confessa voce daret: “Ego quoque illud vidi.”

unit.source: She appears much like the intense emotions I mentioned earlier—the ones slumbering in my heart.
unit.target: Illa videtur similis illis affectibus intensis, quos antea memoravi—illis, quae in corde meo quiescunt.

unit.source: Lumian adjusted his golden straw hat, standing up on his own legs.
unit.target: Lumian pileum aureum stramineum aptavit, se propriis cruribus erigens.

unit.source: He spoke thoughtfully, “Could that dream absorb the intense emotions in Tizamo and give rise to the corresponding Dream Person—an even more extreme and emotional entity?”
unit.target: Cogitans, locutus est: “Num illud somnium affectus intensos in Tizamo absorbere possit et personam somniorum congruentem generare, entitatem etiam extremiorem atque affectuosiorem?”

unit.source: “So, the longer one stays in Tizamo, the more subdued they become,” Camus concurred with Louis Berry’s hypothesis, and Rhea nodded in agreement.
unit.target: “Ita, quo diutius in Tizamo maneas, eo demissiores fieres,” Camus cum hypothesi Louisi Berry convenit, et Rhea consensu annuit.

unit.source: Mirror People… Dream People… How many peculiar entities lingered in the shadows of this world?
unit.target: Homines specularum… Personae somniorum… Quot entia insolita in umbris huius mundi mansere?

unit.source: Lumian massaged his temples and strode towards the stairs leading to the surface.
unit.target: Lumian tempora sua fricabat et ad scalas, quae ad superficiem ducebantur, procedebat.

unit.source: “That concludes tonight’s attempt,” he casually declared.
unit.target: “Hoc conatus nocturnus finem ponit,” inquit ille leviter.

unit.source: Camus and Rhea followed closely, confirming their escape from the dream through the return of livestock and the commotion in the house.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea propinquo secuti sunt, evasionem e somnio confirmantes per reditum pecorum et tumultum in domo.

unit.source: They waited until Lumian entered the Brieu Motel before halting, concealing themselves in the shadows diagonally opposite.
unit.target: Exspectaverunt donec Lumian in Brieu Motel intraret, deinde sistentes se in umbris diagonaliter oppositis abscondentes.

unit.source: Lumian pushed open the door to the suite, spotting Ludwig at the dining table, devouring a roasted banana with gusto.
unit.target: Lumian ostium suiteae pulsavit, Ludovicum ad mensam prandii conspectus, qui banana tosta cum ardore devorabat.

unit.source: In his other hand, he wielded a child’s fork, delving into a special salad crafted from the heart of a palm tree.
unit.target: In altera manu, furcam puerilem tenebat, in specialem salatam ex corde palmae confectam immergens.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian was certain that this wasn’t a dream.
unit.target: Hoc intuens, Lumian certus erat hoc non esse somnium.

unit.source: He cast a glance at Lugano, who was dozing off, and nonchalantly inquired of Ludwig, “Do you dream when you sleep?”
unit.target: Lugano, qui obdormiebatur, intuens, Ludovico leviter quaesivit: “Somniarisne dum dormis?”

unit.source: Despite being occupied, Ludwig replied, “Yes.”
unit.target: Quamquam occupatus esset, Ludovicus respondit: “Ita.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian cogitans annuit.

unit.source: “Have you had any dreams in the past few days?”
unit.target: “Num aliquos somnia in proximis diebus habuisti?”

unit.source: Taking a moment between bites of grilled river fish, Ludwig responded, “Yes.”
unit.target: Inter morsus piscis fluvii assi, Ludovicus respondit: “Ita.”

unit.source: “What dreams did you have?” Lumian removed his golden straw hat, stowing it back into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: “Quae somnia habuisti?” Lumian pileum aureum stramineum delevit et in sacculum Viatoris reponens reclusit.

unit.source: Ludwig replied with a muffled voice, “Eat, eat, eat…”
unit.target: Ludovicus voce obmuta respondit: “Ede, ede, ede…”

unit.source: Indeed, I shouldn’t expect much… Lumian chuckled self-deprecatingly and turned his attention to Lugano.
unit.target: Revera, parum exspectandum erat… Lumian subridens et se ipsum humiliter reprimens, animum ad Lugano vertit.

unit.source: “What dreams did you have?”
unit.target: “Quae somnia habuisti?”

unit.source: Is there something wrong with the dreams here? Lugano contemplated asking but decided to answer truthfully.
unit.target: Num quid in his somniis male sit? Lugano quaesitum meditatus est, sed statuit veraciter respondere.

unit.source: “All kinds of dreams…”
unit.target: “Omnia genera somniorum…”

unit.source: He paused before adding, “Perhaps it’s been too long since I went out alone. Haha, I didn’t have a chance to release my pent-up emotions. Occasionally, I’d dream of women and such matters, only to realize that something was amiss. Either the target transformed into a monster, or the initially alluring woman was covered in tree warts, wheat, and mushrooms… Then, I’d wake up in shock.”
unit.target: Brevi cessavit, deinde addidit: “Fortasse nimis diu est ex quo solus exii. Haha, nullam occasionem habui affectus congestos efferendi. Interdum de mulieribus atque similibus rebus somniabar, modo animadvertens aliquid esse aberrantem. Aut propositum in monstrum versa est, aut mulier, quae initio venusta videbatur, in verrucis arborum, tritico, et fungis cooperta erat… Tum in stupore evigilabam.”

unit.source: As an Intisian, he had no reservations discussing such topics.
unit.target: Ut Intisianus, nullas habebat cunctationes de talibus rebus disserendi.

unit.source: According to the psychology taught by Anthony, your pent-up desires and fear of the dangers in Tizamo are a mix of unresolved factors…
unit.target: Secundum psychologiam a Anthony traditam, desideria tua congesta atque metus periculorum in Tizamo mixtura sunt factorum non resolutorum…

unit.source: Lumian commented inwardly and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian interiora sensu subridens commentatus est.

unit.source: “You can explore the Giant Boa bar alone, find a local lady, or mingle with the ladies and maids in the plantation outside. As long as you ensure food for Ludwig, he’ll manage on his own.”
unit.target: “Potes solus explorare tabernam Gigantis Boa, mulierem localem invenire, aut in plantatione extra cum mulieribus et ancillis miscere; dummodo cibum Ludovico curabes, ipse se administrabit.”

unit.source: Initially, Lugano’s heart raced, but the potential dangers outside soon came to mind.
unit.target: Initio, cor Lugani trepidabat, sed pericula exterius celeriter in mentem venerunt.

unit.source: Lumian headed towards the master bedroom, leaving a parting sentence with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian ad cubiculum principale processit, relinquens sententiam valedictoriam cum subriso.

unit.source: “Of course, I can’t guarantee those ladies won’t turn into monsters or undergo anomalies after your little adventure.”
unit.target: Certe, non possum certiorem facere has mulieres non in monstra vertentur aut post tuam parvam expeditionem anomalias subeant.

unit.source: “…” Lugano couldn’t help but shudder at the imagined scenario.
unit.target: “…” Lugano non potuit quin ad hanc rem imaginatam se concuteret.

unit.source: He glanced at Ludwig, finding comfort in staying by the boy’s side.
unit.target: Oculos ad Ludovicum iecit, solacium inveniens in pueri comitatu.

unit.source: Until all the stored food was consumed, he considered himself safe!
unit.target: Donec omnis cibus repositus consumptus fuerit, se tutum putabat!

unit.source: In the shadows diagonally opposite the Brieu Motel, Rhea observed in silence for a while before suddenly speaking up.
unit.target: In umbris diagonaliter oppositis Brieu Motel, Rhea aliquod tempus silentio observavit, deinde repente loquebatur.

unit.source: “Since there won’t be any new reinforcements from the Admiral Guard, and only Deputy Captain Reaza will come from the patrol team, why didn’t you leave Tizamo directly? Why did you stay here and attempt to resolve the Dream Festival problem?”
unit.target: “Cum nullae novae copiae a Custodia Admirali pervenire possint, et solus Subpraefectus Reaza ex turma vigilum adveniet, cur non Tizamo directo reliquisti? Cur hic mansisti et conatus es quaestionem Festivalis Somniorum solvere?”

unit.source: As long as he escaped Matani, the Admiral Guard and patrol team wouldn’t have the resources to track and punish them. At most, they could issue a wanted poster, but they wouldn’t be able to pay a high bounty.
unit.target: Dummodo Matani effugeret, Custodia Admiralis et turma vigilum opes ad eos persequendos et punientes non haberent; ad summum, tantum tabellam suspecti edere possent, sed praemium magnum solvere non potuerunt.

unit.source: Camus scratched his disheveled brown hair, smiling wryly.
unit.target: Camus capillos fuscos et inconditos scalptans, subridens acerbe.

unit.source: “As you know, my previous Sequence was a Public Security Officer. It tied seamlessly with the patrol team’s usual work, making me yearn to maintain order in Matani and safeguard the lives of the people here.
unit.target: Ut scis, praeteritum meum tempus fuit officium Publicae Securitatis, quod perfecte cum officio turmae vigilum consueto coincidebat, quod me ad ordinem in Matani conservandum et vitas hominum hic tuendas incitabat.

unit.source: “The potion not only brings strength but also affects you in many ways.”
unit.target: Potio non solum fortitudinem affert, sed etiam te multis modis afficit.

unit.source: He exhaled and continued, “Besides, Captain Reaza is about to arrive. I have to help him. I have to repay what I owe him.”
unit.target: Exhalavit et perrexit: “Praeterea, Capitanus Reaza paulo ante adveniet. Ei auxilium ferre debeo; quod illi debeo, reddendum mihi est.”

unit.source: Camus didn’t disclose another reason: his confidence in the adventurer Louis Berry and the Church of The Fool behind him. He believed that with Louis Berry present, the situation would be threatening but not perilous.
unit.target: Camus aliam causam non revelavit: fidem suam in viatorem Ludovicum Berry et Ecclesiam Stulti post se. Credidit, cum Ludovico Berry praesentissimo, rem minacem sed non periculosam futuram esse.

unit.source: Rhea didn’t press further, continuing to gaze diagonally at the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Rhea ulterius non inquisivit, sed diagonali ratione ad Brieu Motel aspexit.

unit.source: Camus glanced at her.
unit.target: Camus eam intuens.

unit.source: “What about you? Why don’t you leave Tizamo with Loban and the others now? The three of you can form a team. Some local admirals will be willing to take you in.”
unit.target: “Quid de te? Cur nunc Tizamo non relinquis cum Loban aliisque? Vos tres turmam constituere potestis. Nonnulli admirales locales vos recipere parati erunt.”

unit.source: Rhea’s eyes remained fixed on Louis Berry’s suite as she stayed silent.
unit.target: Oculi Rheae in suite Ludovici Berry manebant, dum ipsa silentium retinebat.

unit.source: After a prolonged silence, just as Camus thought she wouldn’t answer, Rhea suddenly spoke.
unit.target: Post longam silentii periodum, justo cum Camus putabat eam non respondere, Rhea subito loquebatur.

unit.source: “When I was in the most pain and despair, it was the Church who helped me. After that, it was the patrol team who gave me a new beginning and a new life.”
unit.target: “Cum in maximo dolore et desperatione essem, Ecclesia mihi auxilium tulit. Postea, turma vigilum mihi novum initium et vitam novam dedit.”

unit.source: Recalling the cold Rhea’s face filled with hatred in the dream, Camus sighed sincerely and said, “It hasn’t been easy for you.”
unit.target: Reminiscens faciem frigidam Rheae in somnio, plena odii, Camus sincere suspiravit et inquit: “Non tibi facile fuit.”

unit.source: The moment he finished speaking, Rhea sneered.
unit.target: Mox, cum finem dicendi attigit, Rhea irridens sprevit.

unit.source: “You’re the most contradictory person I’ve ever encountered. In the past, I’ve often heard you talk about which states and islands the Feynapotter Kingdom should invade, which mines and valleys they should seize, and how they should establish more colonies in the Southern Continent. But now, you’re showing pity towards me.”
unit.target: “Tu es persona maximi contrariorum, quam umquam conveni. Olim saepe audivi te de civitatibus et insulis disserere quas Regnum Feynapotter invadere deberet, de fodinis et vallibus quas occupare oporteret, et quomodo plures colonias in Continente Australi constituendae essent. Sed nunc, in me miserationem ostendis.”

unit.source: “I can sense your sincerity. You genuinely feel pain for me, but that’s why I can’t help but want to say something.”
unit.target: “Sinceritatem tuam sentire possum. Vere dolorem in me sentis, et idcirco non possum quin aliquid dicere velim.”

unit.source: Camus found himself at a loss for words.
unit.target: Camus verbis deficiens se invenit.

unit.source: Indeed, it was a contradiction.
unit.target: Re vera, contradicatio erat.

unit.source: He also realized that Rhea’s emotions had become even more turbulent after encountering herself in the dream. She seemed more willing to open up.
unit.target: Etiam intellexit affectus Rheae postquam se ipsa in somnio convenit, magis turbatos esse; videbatur parata ad se aperiendum.

unit.source: Could this be the result of encountering extreme emotions? Or perhaps those who hadn’t spent more than a year in Tizamo might resist the dream’s influence to some extent if they grasped the truth of “obedience”? Camus quickly thought of the plantations outside the town and individuals like Sir Petit, Miss Amandina, Monsieur Robert, and the others.
unit.target: Num hoc ex extrema affectus experientia oriri possit? An fortasse illi, qui plus quam annum in Tizamo non egere, ad vim somnii in aliquo modum resistere possint, si veritatem “obedientiae” comprenderent? Camus celeriter cogitavit de plantationibus extra oppidum atque de individuis ut Dominus Petit, Domina Amandina, Dominus Robert, et cetera.

unit.source: These gentlemen and ladies weren’t easily subdued.
unit.target: Hi domini et dominae non facile coacti sunt.

unit.source: The special dream had evidently encompassed both the out-of-town plantation and the garrison barracks.
unit.target: Specialis somnium manifeste et plantationem extraneam et castra praesidialia complectebatur.

unit.source: Camus figured out the reason: These gentlemen and ladies spent at least half their time in Port Pylos each year.
unit.target: Camus causam deprehendit: hi domini et dominae saltem dimidiam partem temporis cuiusque anni in Portu Pylos degere solebant.

unit.source: This also explained why he was familiar with them.
unit.target: Hoc etiam explicavit cur eos noverit.

unit.source: At noon the next day, shortly after Lumian dispatched the letter, he received a prompt reply from Madam Magician:
unit.target: Meridie diei sequentis, paulo postquam Lumian epistulam misit, celerem responsionem a Domina Magica accepit:

unit.source: “Did the Eternal Blazing Sun Church present this price, or was it your offer?
unit.target: “Num Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis hunc precium proposuit, an tua oblatio fuit?

unit.source: “Can a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact be exchanged for such trifles?
unit.target: “Num Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus I pro talibus parvis rebus comerciari possit?

unit.source: “If I didn’t know the kind of person you are, I would suspect that you concealed more than half of the offer from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
unit.target: “Si non noverem qualis persona sis, suspicabar te plus quam dimidiam oblationis partem a Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis celavisse.

unit.source: “In addition to the information related to this Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, ensure the Eternal Blazing Sun Church provides an additional 50,000 pounds worth of gold at the highest exchange rate in the past three months.
unit.target: “Praeter informationem de hoc Artefacto Sigillato Gradus I, cura ut Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis additas 50,000 libras aurei, ad summam emptionis rationem in tribus proximis mensibus, praebeat.

unit.source: “Don’t worry, gold is the last thing they need.”
unit.target: “Noli sollicitari, aurum est ultimum quod eis opus sit.”

unit.source: Gold worth 50,000 pounds… That’s approximately 1.2 million verl d’or worth of gold. Why would Madam Magician require such a substantial amount of gold? Recalling the importance of gold in mysticism, the Armored Shadow’s need to reconstruct its golden body, and the widespread use of gold in Death-related domains, he swiftly arrived at a realization.
unit.target: Aurum pro 50,000 libris… id est circiter 1.2 million verl d’or in valore auri. Cur Domina Magica talem quantitatem auri exigere vellet? Memor momenti auri in mysteriis, necessitatem Umbrae Armatae corpus aureum restituendi, et late diffusae usus auri in rebus mortis pertinentibus, celeriter ad revelationem pervenit.

unit.source: A subtle detail caught his attention.
unit.target: Subtilis notitia attentionem eius cepit.

unit.source: Madam Magician used the Loen Kingdom’s gold pound to express the value of gold.
unit.target: Domina Magica libram auri Regni Loen usus est ad exprimendum valorem auri.

unit.source: Does this imply her recent activity in the Loen Kingdom? Lumian nodded thoughtfully, considering whether to summon Jenna’s messenger, Rabbit Chasel, to convey Madam Magician’s request, or to return to Trier personally for discussions on the Dream Festival with Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
unit.target: Indicatne haec nuperrime actu eius in Regno Loen? Lumian cogitans annuit, meditans utrum nuntium Iennæ, Leporem Chasel convocare debeat ut petitionem Dominae Magicae tradat, aut ipse ad Trier reverti personaliter ad colloquia de Festivalis Somniorum cum Franca, Ienna, et Anthony suscipiendum.

unit.source: Chapter 669: Connivance
unit.target: Capitulum 669: Connivantia

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Recalling Franca’s meeting with 007 tonight to discuss dealing with Moran Avigny, Lumian decided to summon Jenna’s messenger, Rabbit Chasel, as he had to return to Trier tomorrow to discuss the division of labor and specific details.
unit.target: Meminens conventum Francae cum 007 hac nocte ad negotiandum de Moran Avigny, Lumian decrevit evocare nuntium Iennae, Lepum Chasel, cum cras ad Trier redire oporteret ut de divisione laboris et rebus specificis dissereret.

unit.source: After jotting down Madam Magician’s request and folding it, Lumian set up a ritual, allowing the special Rabbit of Knowledge to emerge from the candle’s flames.
unit.target: Postquam petitionem Dominae Magicae conscripsit et involvit, Lumian caerimoniam instituit, ut peculiaris Lepus Cognitionis ex flammis candelae emergeret.

unit.source: The first thing Lumian noticed was the miniature half top hat snugly perched between the rabbit’s ears.
unit.target: Prima re quam Lumian animadvertit fuit parvus pileus, quasi “top hat” in forma dimidiata, commodē insidens inter auricula leporis.

unit.source: Next, he saw gold-rimmed glasses and a black trench coat that matched the vaguely rabbit-shaped creature’s size.
unit.target: Deinde vidit oculos vitricos margine aureo ornatos et vestem nigrum in stylo trench, quae ad magnitudinem creaturae, quae vago leporum similis videbatur, convenienter coincidebat.

unit.source: Finally, an iron-black revolver lay in the rabbit’s palm.
unit.target: Denique, revolver ex ferro nigro in palma leporis iacebat.

unit.source: The revolver gleamed with a metallic luster, its barrel unusually thick, and its cylinder unnaturally large and textured.
unit.target: Revolver nitore metallico fulgebat; canna eius insolite crassa erat, et cylindrus eius mirum in modum magnus atque texturatus videbatur.

unit.source: It stood in stark contrast to the illusory appearance of the top hat, trench coat, and gold-rimmed glasses.
unit.target: Revolver in flagrantī discrimine stabat comparatus spei fallacis pilei, vestis trench, ac oculorum vitricorum margine aureo ornatorum.

unit.source: Upon seeing Rabbit Chasel, Lumian raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: Cum Lepum Chasel vidit, Lumian supercilia eleganter elevavit.

unit.source: “Is this a real gun?”
unit.target: “Num hoc vere sclopetum est?”

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: “Did Jenna customize it for you?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: “Num Jenna id tibi ordinavit?” Lumian quaesivit.

unit.source: Rabbit Chasel replied succinctly, “It’s payment.”
unit.target: Lepus Chasel breviter respondit: “Est solutio.”

unit.source: Quite a cold demeanor… Miss Celia Bello, have you considered the consequences of what you’ve done? You haven’t! Because I don’t know the consequences either unless I consult Madam Magician… Lumian criticized inwardly before handing the folded letter to Rabbit Chasel.
unit.target: Habitus tuus frigidus valde est… Domina Celia Bello, num consequentias factorum tuorum consideravisti? Immo, non fecisti! Quia neque ego consequentias novi, nisi Magistram Magicam consulerim, Lumian interius reprehendit, antequam epistolam involutam Lepori Chasel tradidit.

unit.source: Seeing the human-like, rabbit-shaped creature preparing to turn and walk into the candle flame, Lumian, the Prankster King of Cordu, asked with interest, “Can you shoot?”
unit.target: Animadvertere creaturam, quae humano similis et leporum figura praeparabat ut converteret atque in flammam candelae ambulareret, Lumian, Rex Lusor Cordi, cum studio interrogavit: “Potesne iaculari?”

unit.source: Rabbit Chasel fell silent for a moment, as if embarrassed.
unit.target: Lepus Chasel paulisper tacuit, quasi vereberetur.

unit.source: “Not yet.”
unit.target: “Non adhuc.”

unit.source: Oh, you’re not as cold as Gehrman Sparrow anymore… Lumian chuckled and said, “Jenna and I are friends. I’ll help her pay the postage fee this time.”
unit.target: “O, non iam es tam frigidus quam Gehrman Sparrow… ” Lumian cachinnavit et dixit: “Jenna et ego amici sumus; hac vice illi vectigal epistularum solvendum adiuvabo.”

unit.source: “Do you want to learn shooting? It involves knowledge and guidance.”
unit.target: “Visne discere iaculari? Id implicat scientiam et consilium.”

unit.source: Rabbit Chasel, taller than an ordinary rabbit, replied without hesitation, “Sure thing.”
unit.target: Lepus Chasel, altior quam lepus vulgaris, respondit sine mora: “Certe!”

unit.source: Lumian’s smile broadened.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani latius factus est.

unit.source: After finding a secluded spot at the edge of the primitive forest and earnestly teaching Rabbit Chasel how to shoot for a considerable time, Lumian strolled back to Tizamo with his hands in his pockets, planning to visit the only cafe for afternoon tea.
unit.target: Postquam locum secretum in margine silvae rudis invenit et Lepum Chasel diu artem iaculandi diligenter docuit, Lumian cum manibus in sinibus ad Tizamo rediit, consiliis habens solam cauponam ad theam meridianam visitandam.

unit.source: The cafe bore the name “Bunia” after its owner, a man named Bunia.
unit.target: Cafeteria nomen “Bunia” habebat ex proprietario, viro nominato Bunia.

unit.source: He was under the age of 30.
unit.target: Habebat aetatem infra triginta annos.

unit.source: Having once served as a waiter and apprentice at a cafe in Port Pylos, Bunia, recalling the lack of a proper cafe in Tizamo Town, transformed the ground floor of his house into a semi-open cafe.
unit.target: Olim tamquam ministrum et discipulum in caupona Porti Pylos laboravit; Bunia, meminens defectum cauponae idoneae in oppido Tizamo, imum domus suae in semi-apertam cauponam convertit.

unit.source: Lumian, weaving through the tables and chairs on the street, arrived at the kitchen counter, offering a smile to the proprietor and waiter, Bunia.
unit.target: Lumian, inter mensas et sellas in via ambulans, ad mensam coquinae pervenit, proprietati atque ministri, Bunia, risum offerens.

unit.source: “Do you have Fermo coffee?”
unit.target: “Habesne Fermo caffeum?”

unit.source: Bunia’s brown skin, not too dark, and his features resembling those of mixed blood, showcased his Tizamon heritage.
unit.target: Cutis brunnea Buniae, non nimis obscura, et vultus eius, qui sanguinis mixti similitudinem habebat, ostenderunt patrimonium Tizamon.

unit.source: The man in his late twenties responded with an honest smile in fluent Intisian.
unit.target: Vir, cui proxime viginti annos complebantur, respondit risu sincero in lingua Intisiana fluente.

unit.source: “Monsieur, there’s no Fermo coffee.”
unit.target: “Domine, Fermo caffeum non invenitur.”

unit.source: Lumian, intending to playfully inquire, casually switched to a cup of Corsa coffee from Matani.
