unit.target: Lumian, intendens facetari, leviter ad poculum Corsa caffeae ex Matani transiit.

unit.source: Sipping the bitter and sweet liquid at a table, he noticed Camus, adorned in a vest, and Rhea, clad in leather armor, entering the cafe.
unit.target: Hauriens liquidum amarum et dulcem ad mensam, animadvertit Camum, ornamentaliter indutum in veste, et Rheam, lorica ex corio induta, cauponam ingredientes.

unit.source: Each ordered an Intis coffee and a corn nutcake imbued with Tizamo flair.
unit.target: Singuli imperaverunt caffeum Intisianum et placenta ex grano, Tizamo ingenio infusam.

unit.source: Upon spotting Rhea, the single Bunia became even more bashful and busier, avoiding eye contact.
unit.target: Rhea conspecta, Bunia solitarius magis verecundus atque occupatus factus est, oculos avertens.

unit.source: As Camus and Rhea, equipped with their coffee and corn nutcakes, sought a spot, Lumian raised his arm in greeting.
unit.target: Cum Camus ac Rhea, cum caffeo et placentis instructi, locum quaerebant, Lumian brachium suum ad salutandum elevavit.

unit.source: As Camus and Rhea reluctantly settled into their seats across from him, Lumian inquired with a smile, “Why do you look so tired?”
unit.target: Dum Camus ac Rhea vix consentientes in sellas prae se consederunt, Lumian risu quaesivit: “Cur tam fessi videmini?”

unit.source: Glancing at the energetic adventurer, Camus took a deep breath and slowly exhaled.
unit.target: Aspiciens ad adventatorem animosum, Camus spiritum altum cepit et lente exhalavit.

unit.source: “We just finished work. We can finally rest.”
unit.target: “Modo opus finivimus. Nunc demum quiescere possumus.”

unit.source: Yesterday, he had monitored the Brieu Motel late into the night!
unit.target: Heri, Brieu Motel usque ad nocturnam horam observaverat!

unit.source: “All I want now is a good night’s sleep.”
unit.target: “Nunc tantum volo bonum nocturnum somnum.”

unit.source: After exploring the dream together last night, Rhea wasn’t as reticent as before when facing Lumian.
unit.target: Postquam heri nocte somnium simul exploraverunt, Rhea non iam tam tacita erat coram Lumiano.

unit.source: “Then why are you still drinking coffee?” Lumian replied with amusement.
unit.target: “Ergo, cur adhuc caffeum potas?” Lumian, ridens, respondit.

unit.source: It was evident that Rhea and Camus lacked the energy of a Sleepless.
unit.target: Manifestum erat Rhea et Camus vim insomnium deficere.

unit.source: “I want to endure until dinner before sleeping,” Camus said with a sigh.
unit.target: “Volo usque ad cenam sustinere antequam dormiam,” Camus suspirans dixit.

unit.source: Rhea shook her head.
unit.target: Rhea caput movit.

unit.source: “Coffee is useless to me.”
unit.target: “Caffeum mihi inutilis est.”

unit.source: After a brief chat, Rhea finished her corn nutcake and coffee, then headed back to the nearby police headquarters to rest.
unit.target: Post brevem colloquium, Rhea crustulum ex grano et caffeum confecit, deinde ad praetorium vicinum rediit ut se quiesceret.

unit.source: Camus continued to recline in the armchair, occasionally taking a sip of coffee.
unit.target: Camus in lecto bracchiali recumbens manebat, interdum poculum caffeae sorbens.

unit.source: “Has Reaza arrived?” Lumian inquired with a smile.
unit.target: “Num Reaza advenit?” Lumian risu quaesivit.

unit.source: Camus fell silent for a moment.
unit.target: Camus paulisper tacuit.

unit.source: “He’s here. Tonight, one of the two—Maslow and Loban—will be following you with him.”
unit.target: “Hic adest. Hac nocte, unus ex duobus—Maslow et Loban—tecum ipse sequetur.”

unit.source: As for Kolobo, there was no need for him to be on duty. If he didn’t even dare to look, how could he do any monitoring?
unit.target: Quoad Kolobo, non opus erat eum in officio esse. Si ne spectare quidem ausus est, quomodo vigilare posset?

unit.source: While they conversed, Lumian noticed Miss Amandina from Palm Manor leading a short unicorn outside the Bunia cafe, exuding high spirits.
unit.target: Dum colloquebantur, Lumian animadvertit Dominam Amandinam ex Palmis Manerio brevem unicornem extra cauponam Bunia ducere, lumine animi laeto effundente.

unit.source: The blue-eyed girl was clad in off-white hunting attire today, her black hair fashioned into a half‑height bun.
unit.target: Puella oculis caeruleis, hodie induta erat vestimenta venatoria pallida, et capillos nigros in parvo nodo collectos habebat.

unit.source: After entrusting the whip and reins to the brown‑skinned valet, she strolled to the kitchen counter with her lady’s maid, who also bore an Intisian appearance.
unit.target: Postquam flagellum et retia servi cutis brunnea tradidit, illa cum ancilla sua, quae quoque indolem Intisianam gerebat, ad mensam coquinae ambulavit.

unit.source: Along the way, she cheerfully greeted the patrons in the cafe and exchanged pleasantries with the locals sipping on inexpensive coffee.
unit.target: Per viam laete clientes in caupona salutavit et cum indigenis, qui caffeum vilis sorbebant, amoena verba commutavit.

unit.source: Observing Camus’s gaze fixed on the girl, Lumian teased, “Do you wish to engage in a duel with her fiance?”
unit.target: Animadvertus oculos Camus in puellam directos, Lumian illam provocavit: “Visne certamen habere cum sponsulo tuo?”

unit.source: “No, I’m not that kind of person,” Camus replied with a serious expression.
unit.target: “Non, non sum talis persona,” Camus serio respondit.

unit.source: “I admit that she’s indeed very attractive to me, but she’s already engaged to Monsieur Robert. This is a sign that she’s starting a family. I can’t allow myself to destroy someone else’s family.”
unit.target: “Agno eam mihi vere amabilem esse, sed iam sponsa Domini Roberti est. Hoc signum est eam familiam condere incipere; non possum meipsum sinere alicuius familiae nocere.”

unit.source: “You Feynapotterians…” Lumian didn’t mock him but sighed with emotion.
unit.target: “Vos Feynapotteriani…” Lumian eum non irridit sed affectu suspiravit.

unit.source: Such values appealed to Feynapotter.
unit.target: Talia virtutes Feynapotteri complacuerunt.

unit.source: Of course, not every Feynapotterian possessed such values.
unit.target: Certe, non omnes Feynapotteriani talia valores possidebant.

unit.source: Seeing Lumian’s lack of response, Camus said seriously, "Don’t have any ideas about her."
unit.target: Videns quiescentiam Lumiani, Camus serio dixit: "Nihil de ea cogita."

unit.source: Lumian regarded the young man surnamed Castiya with amusement, awaiting further “explanation.”
unit.target: Lumian iuvenculum, cognomento Castiya, ridens contemplatus est, ulteriores explicationes exspectans.

unit.source: Camus furrowed his brow slightly.
unit.target: Camus leviter supercilia contraxit.

unit.source: “I know you Intisians won’t back down just because the other party has a fiance or a husband. You might find it even more exciting, but you always pursue momentary pleasure. Very few are willing to take responsibility. You always satisfy yourself. When you’re happy, you turn around and leave, leaving a lady to face everything that’s been destroyed.”
unit.target: "Scio vos Intisianos non recedere solum quia altera pars sponsum aut maritum habet; forsitan hoc vobis magis excitandi videatur, sed semper voluptatem momentaneam persequimini. Valde pauci sunt qui responsabilitatem suscipere volunt, et vos ipsi semper vobis satisfacitis: cum laeti estis, vertimini et disceditis, relinquentes feminam quae omnia deleta subire debeat."

unit.source: “Not every Intisian is like this,” Lumian shook his head with a smile.
unit.target: “Non omnes Intisiani sunt tales,” Lumian caput movens, risu dixit.

unit.source: But most Trieriens are like that… However, neither party is innocent in such matters… he added inwardly.
unit.target: Sed plerique Trierenses ita sunt… et tamen neutra pars in talibus rebus innocens est, inquit interius.

unit.source: The energetic and playful Amandina led the lady’s maid past Camus and Lumian’s table.
unit.target: Amandina, animosa et ludicra, ancillam praeter mensam Camus et Lumiani duxit.

unit.source: First, she greeted Camus, then sized up Lumian and said candidly, “I'm Amandina. What about you?”
unit.target: Primum Camum salutavit, deinde Lumian observavit et aperte dixit: “Ego sum Amandina. Quid de te?”

unit.source: “Louis Berry,” Lumian replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Louis Berry,” Lumian risu respondit.

unit.source: Amandina nodded and suddenly laughed.
unit.target: Amandina caput inclinavit et subito risit.

unit.source: “You must have just arrived from Trier. You’re different from the people here.”
unit.target: “Certe recens ex Trier advenisti; tu aliter te geris quam homines hic.”

unit.source: “No, I’m from a village in the south,” Lumian switched to Intisian with a Dariege accent.
unit.target: “Non, ex vico meridionali sum,” Lumian in lingua Intisiana cum accentu Dariege mutavit.

unit.source: Amandina wasn’t disappointed. She happily inquired about the folklore of the southern provinces of the Intis Republic before leading the lady’s maid to a table in the corner.
unit.target: Amandina non fuit contrita; laeta de fabulis provinciarum meridionalium Reipublicae Intis interrogavit, antequam ancillam ad mensam anguli duxit.

unit.source: Camus watched as the two of them conversed. He opened his mouth but closed it again.
unit.target: Camus eos duos colloquentes inspexit; os aperivit sed cito recluserat.

unit.source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathedrale Commemorative.
unit.target: Trier, regio Cathedralis Commemorativa.

unit.source: Jenna was curled up on the sofa, engrossed in the novels she had just bought, all with elements of Witches.
unit.target: Jenna in sofa convoluta erat, novellis, quos nuper emit, ardenter legens, quorum omnia elementa magarum continebantur.

unit.source: Suddenly, Rabbit Chasel appeared in front of her and handed her a letter.
unit.target: Subito, Lepus Chasel coram ea apparuit et ei epistolam tradidit.

unit.source: Observing the bizarre yet adorable rabbit-shaped creature, Jenna opened the letter and scanned its contents before asking earnestly, “Do you wish to select your payment, or shall I choose a random book for you?”
unit.target: Observans creaturam miram sed venustam, forma leporum similem, Jenna epistolam aperuit atque eius contenta perscrutata est, antequam sincere interrogaret: “Velisne mercedem tuam eligere, aut an ego tibi librum fortuito eligo?”

unit.source: “Lumian Lee has already settled the payment on your behalf,” Rabbit Chasel said in a deep yet sincere voice.
unit.target: “Lumian Lee pro te iam solutionem fecerat,” Lepus Chasel voce profunda sed sincera dixerat.

unit.source: Witch Jenna suddenly felt a sense of foreboding.
unit.target: Maga Jenna subito maleficum augurium sensit.

unit.source: “What has he paid?”
unit.target: “Quid solvit?”

unit.source: “He imparted shooting-related knowledge to me and guided me through the initial stage of my practice,” Rabbit Chasel raised the special revolver in his hand, briefly aimed it at the door behind Jenna, and then swiftly lowered it.
unit.target: “Ipse mihi scientiam de iaculandi artem tradidit atque per initium exercitationis meae me duxit,” Lepus Chasel revolverum speciale in manu attulit, breviter ad ianuam post Jennam intendit, deinde celeriter deiecit.

unit.source: W&— Monsieur Lumian Lee, have you considered the consequences of what you’ve done? Jenna chided, feeling a mix of irritation and amusement.
unit.target: “Domine Lumian Lee, num consequentias factorum tuorum consideraveris?” Jenna increpavit, iracundia et hilaritate mixta sensit.

unit.source: However, the deed was done, and she was powerless to reverse it.
unit.target: Attamen, factum est, et illa id revocare non potuit.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Jenna’s lips curved into a sweet smile.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, labra Jenna in dulci risu incurvata sunt.

unit.source: “The next payment will be for a genuine underarm holster. And after that, custom-made bullets with special effects. How does that sound?”
unit.target: “Proxima solutio erit pro vero receptaculo subbrachiali; et postea, globuli conscripti ad modum peculiarem cum effectibus specialibus. Quid hoc tibi videtur?”

unit.source: Behind his glass glasses, Rabbit Chasel’s eyes sparkled.
unit.target: Sub vitreis speculis, oculi Leporis Chasel micabant.

unit.source: “Alright!”
unit.target: “Bene!”

unit.source: In Tizamo Town, night had already fallen, and darkness shrouded the area.
unit.target: In oppido Tizamo, nox iam ceciderat, et tenebrae totam regionem tegebant.

unit.source: Lumian stood in Hisoka’s house, glancing at the stern vice‑captain of the Port Pylos patrol team, Reaza, and the local patrol team leader, Maslow, whose face was adorned with white paint.
unit.target: Lumian in domo Hisoka stabat, intuitus ad severum vice‑ducem turmae vigili Porti Pylos, Reaza, atque ad ducem vigiliarum localium, Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat.

unit.source: As though instructing Lugano, he said, “Watch out for any accidents.”
unit.target: Velut monens Lugano, dixit: “Cave ne quid infortunium eveniat.”

unit.source: This time, he spoke in Dutanese.
unit.target: Hoc tempore in lingua Dutanica locutus est.

unit.source: “Alright.”
unit.target: “Recte.”

unit.source: It wasn’t the first time Maslow had accompanied Louis Berry, the great adventurer, and he was already accustomed to his style.
unit.target: Non primum Maslow comitabatur Louis Berry, magno adventatore, et iam eius consuetudine erat.

unit.source: Dressed in a sleek formal suit, Reaza remained silent, signaling that there was no issue.
unit.target: Indutus in habitum formalis nitidum, Reaza silens mansit, signum ferens nullam quaestionem exsistere.

unit.source: Lumian retrieved the brown Mystery Prying Glasses from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian ex sacco viatoris specula inquisitiva et mystica brunnea extraxit.

unit.source: Tonight, his first task was to use this magical item to observe Hisoka’s house from various angles, hoping to unveil the source of its abnormality.
unit.target: Hac nocte, primum opus eius fuit hoc instrumento magico uti, ut domum Hisoka ex variis angulis observaret, sperans fontem eius anomaliae detegere.

unit.source: After confirming his condition and preparations, Lumian placed the brown gold‑rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose.
unit.target: Postquam condicionem suam et praeparationes confirmavit, Lumian specula brunnea, margine aureo ornata, in ponte nasi sui posuit.

unit.source: A familiar wave of dizziness washed over Lumian, as if his surroundings had been disrupted and reassembled.
unit.target: Fluctus notus vertiginis Lumian oppresserat, quasi circumiecta eius turbata atque redeversa essent.

unit.source: He witnessed poisonous insects crawling in the “sky,” two walls that seemed to dance in circles, and an underground water puddle deep in the soil that appeared to absorb all light..
unit.target: Vidit insecta venenosa in “caelo” reptantia, duas parietes quae in circulis saltare videbantur, atque lacunam subterraneam aquosam in profundo solo, quae omnem lucem absorbere videbatur.

unit.source: Chapter 670: Sudden Arrival
unit.target: Capitulum 670: Subitus Adventus

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Amidst the dizzying sensation that threatened to separate his spirit from his body, Lumian saw trees that seemed to slumber in the darkness and a pitch‑black boulder…
unit.target: Inter sensum vertiginosum, qui animam eius a corpore separare minabatur, Lumian vidit arbores, quae in tenebris dormire videbantur, et lapidem atrum…

unit.source: Finally, he removed the brown glasses from his nose and arched his back slightly to alleviate the discomfort.
unit.target: Denique, oculos fuscos a naso abstulit et paulo dorsum arcuit ad levandum molestiam.

unit.source: Even an Ascetic wouldn’t be able to use the Mystery Prying Glasses for long.
unit.target: Etiam asceticus non poterat diu uti Speculis Inquirendis Mysterii.

unit.source: Of course, this ensured his safety to a certain degree.
unit.target: Certe, hoc ad certum modum salutem eius confirmavit.

unit.source: Through this “prying,” Lumian confirmed two things.
unit.target: Per hanc indagationem, Lumian duas res comprobavit.

unit.source: First, the area beneath Hisoka’s house was indeed unusual, but it seemed more like an illusory symbol than an actual entity.
unit.target: Primum, spatium sub domo Hisoka vere inusitatum erat, sed videbatur magis ut symbolum illusorium quam verae entitatis.

unit.source: It indicated that this place had once been corrupted or influenced, with the most severe occurrence taking place underground.
unit.target: Indicabat hunc locum olim corruptum aut affictum fuisse, cum gravissima evenisset sub terra.

unit.source: Second, this influence was connected to the black boulder deep within the primitive forest.
unit.target: Secundo, haec influentia ad lapidem atrum, profundo in silva primitiva, pertinere videbatur.

unit.source: "How did it go?" Maslow, his face painted white, asked.
unit.target: "Quomodo processit?" inquit Maslow, cuius facies albo picta erat.

unit.source: Lumian stored the Mystery Prying Glasses back into his Traveler’s Bag and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian Specula Perscrutanda Mysterii in sacculo Viatoris recondidit et subridens fiebat.

unit.source: “The abnormality I ‘saw’ here originates from a black boulder deep in the primitive forest. Have you ever seen or heard of that black boulder?”
unit.target: "Anomalia, quam hic 'vidi,' orta est ex lapide atro, profunde in silva primitiva. Numquamne vidistis aut audistis de eo lapide atro?"

unit.source: The pale‑white Reaza and Maslow, his black hair falling over his shoulders, shook their heads in unison, indicating a negative answer.
unit.target: Reaza pallido‑albo et Maslow, cujus capilli nigri super humeros cadebant, capita simul concussere, responsum negativum indicantes.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t in a rush to do the second thing he had planned for the night.
unit.target: Lumian non festinabat secunda re, quam pro nocte destinaverat, exsequi.

unit.source: He glanced at Reaza, who was wearing a thin formal suit and appeared to be a mix of Intisian and West Balam heritage.
unit.target: Ad Reaza intuebatur, qui vestimenta formalia tenuia gerebat et ex mixtione gentium Intisianae et Occidentalis Balam appareret.

unit.source: He casually said, “I thought that with your arrival, some people in Tizamo would gradually leave and stay in Port Pylos for a while.
unit.target: Levis mente inquit: "Putabam adventu vestro, aliquos in Tizamo homines paulatim discedere et in Portu Pylos aliquantulum manere."

unit.source: “As you know, the Dream Festival should start within three days.”
unit.target: "Ut scitis, Festival Somniorum intra tres dies incipere debet."

unit.source: Reaza calmly replied, “Based on my experience, except for those who have only arrived in Tizamo in the past two weeks, it’s best not to leave this place and go elsewhere to prevent any abnormalities from spreading.
unit.target: Reaza tranquillime respondit: "Ex mea experientia, nisi pro iis qui intra duas hebdomadas solum in Tizamo advenerunt, optime est hunc locum non relinquere et alibi se non conferre, ne qua anomalia diffundatur.

unit.source: It should only be considered after the Dream Festival ends and the primitive tribe launches another attack.”
unit.target: Illud solum considerandum est post Festival Somniorum finitum esse et tribus primitiva iterum impetum facere.

unit.source: Very standardized process… I thought you would consider the opinions of Intis, Feynapotter, and other Northern Continent countries, allowing people with corresponding nationalities to evacuate in advance and protect them.
unit.target: Processus haec valde ordinatus est… putabam te opiniones Intis, Feynapotter, et aliarum nationum Continenti Septentrionalis consideraturum esse, ut homines nationalitatibus congruentes praevius evacuari possint atque protegerentur.

unit.source: For example, the owners of the plantations outside the city and their families…
unit.target: Exempli gratia, domini plantarum extra urbem et eorum familiae…

unit.source: Yes, this is likely because the Dream Festival has never shown direct harm.
unit.target: Ita, verisimiliter id, quia Festival Somniorum umquam damnum directe non ostendit.

unit.source: It only caused some townsfolk to suffer from hysteria and attracted an attack from the forests primitive tribe.
unit.target: Solum fecit ut quidam incolae urbis perturbatione laborarent et impetum a tribu silvarum primitivarum adduceret.

unit.source: The first situation could be resolved by a simple Mass.
unit.target: Prima res simplici Missa solvi poterat.

unit.source: The second problem could be guarded against and fended off…
unit.target: Secunda quaestio repellenda et defendenda poterat.

unit.source: Lumian roughly understood the mentality of Admiral Querarill and the patrol team’s leaders.
unit.target: Lumian paene intellexit mentem Admiralis Querarill et duces turmae praesidiariae.

unit.source: Since there wouldn’t be any major issues, they would act as if the Dream Festival didn’t exist, merely advising the local official Beyonders to be vigilant and guard against any mishaps while hoping that the Church of The Fool could resolve the hidden dangers!
unit.target: Cum nullae sentiri videbantur quaestiones graves, agerent ut Festival Somniorum non existeret; solum officiali locali Beyonders consilium dabant ut vigiles essent et casus adversos praevenirent, sperantes Ecclesiam Stulti pericula occulta solvere!

unit.source: If they were to do more, they might trigger something and worsen the situation.
unit.target: Si plura facerent, aliquid excitaretur atque res deterioraretur.

unit.source: After discussing the matter, Lumian recovered from the discomfort caused by the Mystery Prying Glasses.
unit.target: Postquam rem disseruit, Lumian molestiam, quae Specula Perscrutanda Mysterii causa erat, superare coepit.

unit.source: He took out the unique Eye of Truth and placed it in front of his face.
unit.target: Eduxit Unicum Oculum Veritatis et ante faciem suam posuit.

unit.source: The relatively handsome Southern Continent native’s eyelids twitched at the sight of the pale‑white flesh, dark blood vessel‑like earmuff and spectacle temple, as well as the blood‑colored lens intertwined with transparent purple tubes.
unit.target: Palpebrae indigenī Continentis Meridionalis, relativè formosi, micabant ad conspectum carnis pallide albae, auriculorum quasi vasorum sanguineorum obscurorum, templa speculi, necnon lentis sanguineae, cum tubis purpureis transparentibus implicatis.

unit.source: How many glasses does Louis Berry own?
unit.target: Quot oculos habet Louis Berry?

unit.source: Moreover, each one is a mystical item!
unit.target: Praeterea, quisque eorum item mysticum est!

unit.source: After donning the single‑lens Eye of Truth, Lumian surveyed his surroundings, seeking to uncover the truth behind reality.
unit.target: Postquam Unicum Oculum Veritatis indutus est, Lumian circumspiciebat, veritatem post realitatem detegere intendens.

unit.source: As he did so, a voice gradually sounded in his ears, growing louder and more chaotic.
unit.target: Dum id faciebat, vox paulatim in auribus eius resonare coepit, crescente strepitu et turbatione.

unit.source: Each note and word seemed to materialize, flooding into Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Quisque nota et verbum apparere videbantur, inundantes mentem Lumiani.

unit.source: It made him feel as if his head was rapidly expanding like a balloon.
unit.target: Eum faciebat sentire quasi caput eius, ut globus, celeriter expandi.

unit.source: If the balloon continued to expand, there would only be one outcome: bursting with a resounding bang!
unit.target: Si globus ultra expandi pergeret, unicum exitum esset: ruptio cum strepitu ingenti!

unit.source: Lumian reached for his ear, ready to remove the Eye of Truth at any moment.
unit.target: Lumian ad aurem se extendit, paratus ad Oculum Veritatis extrahendum quolibet momento.

unit.source: He seized the opportunity to scrutinize Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: Illud occasum cepit ut domum Hisoka perscrutaret.

unit.source: He believed that it was safer to take the risk of prying into the house’s secrets before the Dream Festival, while not inside the special dream.
unit.target: Existimabat tutius esse periculum subeundi in arcana domus perscrutanda ante Festival Somniorum, quam intra somnium speciale versari.

unit.source: It was safer than using the Eye of Truth and Mystery Prying Glasses within the dream itself.
unit.target: Tutior erat quam uti Oculo Veritatis et Speculis Perscrutandis Mysterii intra ipsum somnium.

unit.source: Through the purple lens, Lumian couldn’t discern much of the truth.
unit.target: Per lentem purpuream, Lumian multum veritatis distinguere non potuit.

unit.source: Everything appeared similar to what he could see with his naked eye, but the night seemed even darker.
unit.target: Omnia similia videbantur ad ea, quae nudo oculo videre poterat, sed nox etiam obscurior videbatur.

unit.source: Without hesitation, his eye bulged, and blood vessels appeared on his body.
unit.target: Sine mora, oculus eius protuberavit, et vasa sanguinea in corpore eius apparuerunt.

unit.source: He abruptly removed the Eye of Truth, and a slightly sharp explosion reverberated in his ears.
unit.target: Subito Oculum Veritatis abstulit, et parva acuta explosio in auribus eius reverberavit.

unit.source: Phew, phew… Panting heavily, Lumian’s mind was in disarray, overwhelmed by a barrage of strange knowledge. He couldn’t think straight.
unit.target: Pheu, pheu… Graviter anhelans, mens Lumiani in perturbatione erat, superata multitudine cognitionum mirarum. Recte cogitare non poterat.

unit.source: At that moment, even if someone were to ambush him, he wouldn’t be able to react quickly.
unit.target: In illo momento, etiam si quis eum insideret, celeriter agere non posset.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds, Lumian finally regained his ability to think clearly.
unit.target: Post plus quam decem secundas, Lumian tandem facultatem recte cogitandi recuperavit.

unit.source: He instinctively organized the knowledge that had been forcefully injected into his mind.
unit.target: Instincte disposuit scientiam, quae vi in mentem eius infusa fuerat.

unit.source: “The art of sophistry…
unit.target: Ars sophisticae…

unit.source: “How to cultivate superior wheat seeds…
unit.target: Quomodo semina tritici superiora colenda sint…

unit.source: “Canning techniques…
unit.target: Technicae conservandi…

unit.source: “How to roast pork that’s crispy on the outside and tender on the inside…
unit.target: Quomodo porcinam tostum, quae exterius croccus et intus tener est, praeparare…

unit.source: “Music to soothe a sow’s emotions…
unit.target: Musica ad molliendos affectus porcae…

unit.source: “The Revelation of Evernight…
unit.target: Revelatio Noctis Aeternae…

unit.source: “Favorite Positions of Celebrities—Memoirs of Those Mistresses”
unit.target: Positiones Praedilectae Celebritatum — Memorabilia Illarum Concubinarum

unit.source: Whats all this nonsense? Can’t there be any useful knowledge?
unit.target: Quid est haec omne ineptia?

unit.source: In the past, although Aurore had been tormented by the Hidden Sage’s instillation of knowledge, she had at least stumbled upon valuable mysticism insights.
unit.target: Olim, quamquam Aurore infusione scientiae a Sapiensi Occulti vexata erat, saltem pretiosas notiones mysticae invenit.

unit.source: Wait, had she also been corrupted by such knowledge?
unit.target: Exspecta, num etiam ipsa tali scientia corrupta fuerat?

unit.source: Is that why she always portrays a rich theoretical understanding in her books…
unit.target: An hoc est cur semper in libris suis opulentam theoreticam intellegentiam ostendat?

unit.source: Lumian rubbed his still throbbing head and said to Reaza and Maslow, “I’m going to the edge of the forest to take a look. Do you want to come with me?”
unit.target: Lumian caput suum adhuc pulsantem fregit et ad Reaza et Maslow dixit: "Ad limitem silvae spectare ibo. Visne mecum venire?"

unit.source: Reaza nodded, stingy with his words, while Maslow made his stance clear by walking towards the stairs.
unit.target: Reaza annuit paucis verbis, dum Maslow consilium suum clarum faciens ambulavit ad scalas.

unit.source: If Camus were here, he would undoubtedly smile wryly and say, “Do I have a choice?” Lumian mused to himself.
unit.target: Si Camus hic fuisset, indubitanter subridens diceret: "Habesne mihi electionem?" meditatus est Lumian sibi.

unit.source: He left Hisoka’s house and made his way towards the primitive forest near Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Domum Hisokae reliquit et iter cepit ad silvam primitivam iuxta oppidum Tizamo.

unit.source: After crossing the intersection and arriving at another street, Lumian noticed a four‑wheeled, four‑seater carriage parked at the entrance of the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Postquam angulum transivit et ad aliam viam pervenit, Lumian animadvertit carrucam quattuor rotarum, quattuor sedentarum, ad introitum Brieu Motel positam.

unit.source: An attendant and a lady’s maid stepped out of the carriage, carrying their luggage, and followed a man and a woman towards the motel.
unit.target: Unus minister et ancilla, sarcinas ferentes, e carruca exierunt et virum feminamque ad motel secuti sunt.

unit.source: The man was attired in a dark‑gray formal suit and a half top hat.
unit.target: Vir in veste formali grisea obscura indutus erat et pileum dimidiatum gerebat.

unit.source: His complexion resembled that of someone from the Northern Continent, and his side profile was well‑defined, with striking dark green eyes.
unit.target: Eius cutis similis erat illius ex Continente Septentrionali, et profilum laterale bene definitum habebat, cum oculis viridissimis obscuris eminens.

unit.source: The woman wore a light‑colored dress that allowed for ease of movement and a feathered hat adorned with pearls.
unit.target: Femina vestem levem coloris gerebat, quae motui facilitatem praebebat, et pileum pennatum, margaritis ornatum, gerebat.

unit.source: She appeared to be in her late twenties, and her skin was delicate and radiant.
unit.target: Videbatur in annis vicesimis, et cutis eius delicata atque splendida erat.

unit.source: One would easily determine that she was a beauty just from glimpsing her side profile.
unit.target: Facile cognosceretur eam pulchram esse, ex solo aspectu profili lateralis.

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze and turned to Reaza and Maslow.
unit.target: Lumian conspectum avertit et ad Reaza et Maslow se convertit.

unit.source: "Is it the weekend?”
unit.target: "Estne hoc finem hebdomadis?"

unit.source: "No,” Maslow replied, understanding the implication behind Louis Berry’s question.
unit.target: "Non," respondit Maslow, intellegens implicationem quaestionis a Louis Berry.

unit.source: "Gentlemen and ladies often find time to hunt in Tizamo, not just on weekends.”
unit.target: Domini et dominae saepe tempus ad venandum in Tizamo inveniunt, non solum in finibus hebdomadis.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Reaza and inquired, “You didn’t seal off this area?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Reaza conversus quaesivit: "Nonne hunc locum obclusisti?"

unit.source: “That would only cause unnecessary panic,” Reaza responded succinctly.
unit.target: "Hoc tantum inutilem formidinem moveret," respondit Reaza succincte.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t press the matter further.
unit.target: Lumian rem non ulterius persecutus est.

unit.source: He walked out of the town through the Brieu Motel and ventured into the primitive forest.
unit.target: Ex urbe per Brieu Motel egreditur et in silvam primitivam se immisit.

unit.source: He delved deeper along the path he had become familiar with from the dream.
unit.target: In via quam ex somnio notaverat, se ulterius immisit.

unit.source: Finally, he arrived at the chaotic zone in reality, where various dream fragments intertwined.
unit.target: Denique ad zonam tumultuosam in re pervenit, ubi varia fragmenta somniorum inter se implicata erant.

unit.source: It was an unremarkable place, indistinguishable from its surroundings.
unit.target: Locus erat mediocris, non distinctus ab circumstantibus suis.

unit.source: Lumian found a palm tree and sat down.
unit.target: Lumian palmam invenit et consedit.

unit.source: He turned to Reaza and Maslow and said, “Keep an eye on my surroundings. I’m going to sleep here.”
unit.target: Ad Reaza et Maslow conversus, dixit: "Conspicite circumstantias meas. Hic dormiturus sum."

unit.source: He wanted to see what would happen if he fell asleep closer to the source of the abnormality, if he could enter that peculiar dream, and in what state.
unit.target: Volebat videre quid accideret, si propius ad fontem anomaliae obdormiret, si in istum somnium peculiarem introire posset, et in quo statu esset.

unit.source: Receiving affirmative responses from the two patrol team members, Lumian closed his eyes and attempted Cogitation.
unit.target: Accipientes responsa affirmativa a duobus membris turmae praesidiariae, Lumian oculos clausit et cogitare conatus est.

unit.source: At some point, he drifted off to sleep.
unit.target: Aliquando obdormivit.

unit.source: After an unknown period, he awoke.
unit.target: Post tempus ignotum, experrectus est.

unit.source: Catching sight of Reaza and Maslow, Lumian rose to his feet and nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Reaza et Maslow conspectos, Lumian surrexit et cogitabunde annuit.

unit.source: This place doesn’t work either… Is Hisoka’s house the only effective location?
unit.target: Hic locus quoque non operatur… Estne domus Hisoka sola locus efficax?

unit.source: Or should I find that black boulder and sleep near it?
unit.target: An debeam illum lapidem atrum invenire et prope dormire?

unit.source: Lumian gazed into the pitch‑black forest, contemplating for a few moments before turning to Reaza and Maslow.
unit.target: Lumian in silvam atrum intuebatur, aliquot momenta meditans, deinde ad Reaza et Maslow se vertit.

unit.source: “Let’s head back.”
unit.target: "Redeamus."

unit.source: The trio swiftly returned to Tizamo.
unit.target: Trio celeriter ad Tizamo redierunt.

unit.source: The late night had settled in, and the streets were devoid of any passersby.
unit.target: Nox sero iam consedit, et plateae nullis transeuntibus erant.

unit.source: No lights or sounds emanated from the houses on either side.
unit.target: Nec luminaria neque soni ex domibus utrimque emanabant.

unit.source: Occasionally, the snorts of livestock on the ground floor of the buildings could be heard, accentuating the pervading darkness and silence.
unit.target: Interdum, sufflatus pecorum in plano primo aedificiorum audiebantur, accentuantes pervadas tenebras ac silentium.

unit.source: The dim crimson moon’s light seemed to emphasize the depths of the darkness.
unit.target: Lumen lunaris rubri tenuum videbatur profunditates tenebrarum sublineare.

unit.source: On this dark night, Lumian walked along a muddy road, heading towards the Brieu Motel situated deep within the street.
unit.target: In hac nocte obscura, Lumian per viam lutosam ambulabat, versus Brieu Motel, quod penitus in via situm erat.

unit.source: Reaza and Maslow followed quietly behind him.
unit.target: Reaza et Maslow silentiose post eum secuti sunt.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian’s mind spun, and his vision momentarily blurred before clearing.
unit.target: Subito, mens Lumiani vertiginem sensit, et visio eius momento offuscata, antequam dissoluta esset.

unit.source: This is… His pupils dilated as he instinctively scanned his surroundings but found nothing amiss.
unit.target: Hoc est… Pupillae eius dilatatae erant, dum instinctive circumspiciebat, sed nihil inusitatum reperit.

unit.source: At that moment, in a vacant house on the ground floor diagonally ahead, a dim candlelight illuminated a room on the third floor.
unit.target: In illo momento, in domo vacua in plano primo, diagonaliter ante, lumen candelae tenuum illustravit conclave in tertio plano.

unit.source: Immediately after, glass windows on this street and throughout Tizamo Town were set aglow by the light of burning candles.
unit.target: Statim postea, fenestrae vitreae in hac via et per urbem Tizamo lumine candelae ardentis fulserunt.

unit.source: Rhea awoke to find that darkness had already descended, but the candles in many houses continued to burn.
unit.target: Rhea experrecta invenit tenebras iam descendisse, sed in multis domibus candelae adhuc ardebant.

unit.source: This indicated that it wasn’t too late.
unit.target: Hoc indicabat nondum sero esse.

unit.source: Feeling lazy, Rhea had no desire to prepare her own food.
unit.target: Pigritia affecta, Rhea proprium cibum praeparare non voluit.

unit.source: Carrying her bow and arrows, she left the room and exited the police headquarters from the side, making her way towards the nearby Bunia cafe.
unit.target: Arcum et sagittas portans, conclave reliquit et ex praefectura vigilarum egreditur, versus cauponam Bunia prope contendens.

unit.source: The streets were nearly deserted, as they were every night.
unit.target: Viae fere desertae erant, sicut solum in finibus hebdomadis.

unit.source: Rhea glanced at the tables and chairs still scattered along the street and approached the kitchen counter.
unit.target: Rhea tabulas et sellas adhuc per viam dispersas intuens ad mensam culinae accessit.

unit.source: In Dutanese, she said to the busy cafe owner and waiter, Bunia, who had his head lowered, “A glass of Cosa and a beef burrito.”
unit.target: In Dutanica, dixit ad Bunia, cauponae dominum et ministrum, qui caput demissum habebat: "Vitrum Cosa et burrito bubulo."

unit.source: Bunia paused in the midst of washing cups and looked up.
unit.target: Bunia inter poculas lavandas subsistit et sursum aspicit.

unit.source: His naturally curly black hair gave him a mixed‑blood appearance.
unit.target: Capilli eius, naturaliter crispati et nigri, eum speciem sanguinis mixti praebebant.

unit.source: He looked at Rhea and revealed an obvious, strange smile that made Rhea inexplicably uneasy.
unit.target: Bunia Rhea aspiciens risum insolitum ac notabilem ostendit, quod Rhea inexplicabiliter inquietam reddidit.

unit.source: Rhea knew Bunia well and was aware that he was a shy, kind, and adult man who wasn’t particularly adept at communicating with women.
unit.target: Rhea Buniam bene noverat et intellexit eum virum esse timidum, benignum, et adultum, qui non valde callens erat in feminis communicandis.

unit.source: He had never smiled like this before.
unit.target: Numquam antea ita subriserat.

unit.source: Bunia fixed his gaze on Rhea and chuckled in a deep voice.
unit.target: Bunia oculos suos in Rhea fixavit et voce profunda subridens risit.

unit.source: “You’ve got big boobs…”
unit.target: "Magnae mammae habes…"

unit.source: Chapter 671: Beginning
unit.target: Capitulum 671: Initium

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpres: CKtalon

unit.source: Upon hearing Bunia’s words, Rhea was so surprised that she forgot her anger.
unit.target: Verbīs Buniae audītīs, Rhea tam stupuit ut iram suam oblita esset.

unit.source: It wasn’t the first time she had encountered such a situation.
unit.target: Non primum talem casum experta fuit.

unit.source: She was shocked that a man who had left a good impression on her would show such an expression and say such words.
unit.target: Stupefacta est quod vir, qui in ea bonam impressionem reliquerat, talem vultum exhiberet atque talia verba diceret.

unit.source: And this was when they weren’t even friends!
unit.target: Et hoc, cum ne amicitia quidem haberent, accidit!

unit.source: At that moment, Rhea wondered if she was still half-asleep.
unit.target: At illo tempore Rhea quaesivit an adhuc semidormiens esset.

unit.source: She also questioned whether Bunia had suffered a mental illness or succumbed to hysteria as the Dream Festival drew near.
unit.target: Et percontabatur utrum Bunia infirmitāte mentis afflixa esset aut hysteriae succumbisset, dum Festa Somniorum appropinquaret.

unit.source: Amidst Rhea’s bewilderment, Bunia’s smile intensified.
unit.target: Inter perplexitatem Rhea, risus Buniae intensificatus est.

unit.source: He extended his hands across the kitchen counter and attempted to grab Rhea’s chest.
unit.target: Manus suas super mensam coquinaria extendit et conatus est pectus Rhea rapere.

unit.source: Instinctively, Rhea leaned back, attempting to dodge.
unit.target: Instinctū, Rhea retrorsum inclinavit, conans se evadere.

unit.source: After failing to touch her, Bunia retracted his hands, propped himself up on the kitchen counter, and leaped up.
unit.target: Postquam eam tangere non potuit, Bunia manus suas retraxit, super mensam coquinaria se sublevavit, et insiluit.

unit.source: Amidst the clinking of coffee cups and glass jars, he lunged at Rhea, who was leaning back.
unit.target: Inter tintinnationem poculorum caffēae et vasōrum vitrei, in Rhea impetum fecit, quae retrorsum inclināta erat.

unit.source: This reaction, this choice, and this display of power caught Rhea off guard.
unit.target: Haec reactio, haec electio, et haec ostentātiō potentiae Rhea inopināta reliquerunt.

unit.source: She didn’t have time to remove the bow and arrow from her back.
unit.target: Non tempus habuit arcum atque sagittam a tergo removere.

unit.source: Her waist bent backward, and her right foot kicked up like the other end of a seesaw, sending the transformed Bunia cafe owner flying.
unit.target: Lumbus eius retrorsum flectus est, et pes dēxter eius, ut alter extremus lūdī alternantis, in altum impellitur, transfigurātum Buniae cauponis in aethera proiecit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, a thought flashed through Rhea’s mind.
unit.target: Simul, quaedam cogitatio per mentem Rhea fulsit.

unit.source: Has he truly lost his mind?
unit.target: Num vere mentem amisit?

unit.source: Crash. Bunia crashed to the side of the kitchen counter.
unit.target: Fragor. Bunia ad latus mensae coquinariae corruit.

unit.source: Rhea exerted strength in her back and stood up straight again.
unit.target: Rhea viribus in tergo ūsa est et iterum recta stetit.

unit.source: Then, she took off her hunting bow, nocked an arrow, and aimed at Bunia, who had just stood up.
unit.target: Tum arcum venatorium abstulit, sagittam immovit, et in Buniam, quī modo surrexit, destinavit.

unit.source: A look of fear crossed Bunia’s face.
unit.target: Vultus timōris in facie Buniae apparuit.

unit.source: He froze for a moment before pleading, “Don’t—don’t kill me!
unit.target: Statim immobilis factus est, deinde obsecrāns dīxit: “Nōli, nōli me occidere!”

unit.source: “I suddenly lost control just now!”
unit.target: “Mōdo subito imperium amīsī!”

unit.source: Looking at Bunia’s pleading and fearful face, Rhea found him both familiar and unfamiliar.
unit.target: Aspiciens vultum obsecrāntem et timōre afflictum Buniae, Rhea eum tam nōtum quam ignōtum invenit.

unit.source: The arrow on the bowstring was drawn back, but she didn’t release it.
unit.target: Sagitta in funī arcūs trahīta erat, sed eam nōn dimīsit.

unit.source: Entering the streets of Tizamo Town from the primitive forest, Lumian observed the illuminated houses on both sides and scoffed.
unit.target: Ex silva primitiva in vīs oppidi Tizamo ingrediēns, Lumian domōs utrīnque illuminātās observāvit et irridēns susurrāvit.

unit.source: “Is this supposed to be terrifying and bizarre?”
unit.target: “Num hoc esse dēbet terrībile et insōlitum?”

unit.source: This wasn’t the first time he had encountered such a scene.
unit.target: Non primum talem scenam expertus est.

unit.source: In Fourth Epoch Trier, he had witnessed a similar occurrence.
unit.target: In Trei Aetāte Quārtā, similem casum perspexit.

unit.source: Not only had the dark town regained its lights, but the entire Fourth Epoch Trier had transitioned from silence to noisiness, returning to life.
unit.target: Non sōlum oppidum obscūrum lūmina sua restituerat, sed totus Trei Aetāte Quārtā a silentiō in sonitum conversus erat, vītam referēns.

unit.source: Faced with this abnormality, Lumian was undoubtedly surprised and highly vigilant.
unit.target: Ob hanc inordinātam condītiōnem, Lumian indubitābiliter obstupuit et māxime vigilantiam habuit.

unit.source: However, he wasn’t overwhelmed by intense emotions.
unit.target: Attamen, affectibus intensīs nōn dominātus est.

unit.source: On the surface, he observed his surroundings leisurely.
unit.target: Ille circumstantiās sua trānquillē observāvit.

unit.source: He realized that Reaza and Maslow had vanished.
unit.target: Animādvērit Reaza et Maslow evanuisse.

unit.source: The two patrol team members who should have been following him were gone.
unit.target: Duo membra turmae praesidiāriā, quae eum sequi debuerant, evanuerant.

unit.source: Since it can silently make two Beyonders disappear right under my nose, it can definitely make me vanish just like that…
unit.target: Cum duo Beyonders silentiō sub meō nasō evanescere possint, certē et me ita evanescere poterit…

unit.source: In other words, 1 must have been affected.
unit.target: Aliter dīcendum est: 1 affectus esse debuit.

unit.source: There’s a high chance that the trance was an external manifestation…
unit.target: Magnā probabilitās est ut illa transe externā manifestātiō fuisset…

unit.source: From a mysticism perspective, the town, which had already fallen into a deep slumber, relighting without any significant turn of events, signifies that I’m in another scene, one that is originally related but different…
unit.target: Ex prōspectū mysticō, oppidum, quod iam in profundō somnō lapsum erat, sine aliquā notā mutātiōne rursum lūcēbat, significat mē in aliā scēnā esse, quae origināriē cognāta sed diversa est…

unit.source: Could it be that I’ve been forced into a dream?
unit.target: Num fortasse coāctus sum in somnium ingredī?

unit.source: Has the Dream Festival officially begun?
unit.target: Num Festum Somniorum officiōsē incepit?

unit.source: 1 didn’t sleep in Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: 1 in domō Hisoka nōn dormīvit.

unit.source: Why am 1 still awake?
unit.target: Cur 1 adhūc vigil sum?

unit.source: Combined with the ongoing investigation, Lumian quickly deduced the current situation.
unit.target: Cum investigātiōne in processū, Lumian celeriter rem prēsēns intellexit.

unit.source: At that moment, he spotted a figure emerging from a glass window diagonally ahead, surrounded by wooden planks and weeds.
unit.target: In illo tempore, animādvērit figuram ex fēnēstrā vitrea diagonaliter emergentem, circumdatam tabulīs līneiīs et herbīs.

unit.source: It was a local man in his early forties, with dark brown skin, brown eyes, black hair, and thick lips.
unit.target: Fuit vir loci, in prīmā quadrāgintā annōrum incipiēns, cum cute fuscā, oculīs fuscīs, capillīs nigrīs, et labrīs crassīs.

unit.source: Lumian had seen him before.
unit.target: Lumian eum anteā vīdit.

unit.source: He was a hunting guide, responsible for leading gentlemen and ladies from Port Pylos and other places into the forest for hunting.
unit.target: Erat dux venātiōnis, quī ducebat domīnōs et domināe ex Portū Pylos atque aliīs locīs in silvam ad venandum.

unit.source: Lumian’s impression of him was that he always wore a fawning smile.
unit.target: Impressiō Lumianī de eo fuit, quod semper rīsum adulatorium gerebat.

unit.source: No matter what others said, he would respond with a string of affirmatives.
unit.target: Quidquid alīī dixerunt, ille respondit seriem affirmationum.

unit.source: He never showed anger, even when punished by the gentlemen and ladies he guided.
unit.target: Numquam īram ostendit, etiam cum a domīnōs atque domināe, quōs ducebat, castigārētur.

unit.source: Upon seeing Lumian, the hunting guide’s lips curled into a cruel smile.
unit.target: Cum Lumianum vīdit, labia ducis venātiōnis in rīsū crudeliter contracta sunt.

unit.source: He pushed open the window and raised his other hand, revealing a double-barreled shotgun.
unit.target: Fēnēstram aperuit et alteram manū levāt, ostendēns sclopetum duplicem.

unit.source: “Die, you Northern Continent dog!”
unit.target: “Morere, canis Continentis Septentrionalis!”

unit.source: As the hunting guide cursed, he aimed his double-barreled shotgun at Lumian and pulled the trigger without hesitation.
unit.target: Dum dux venātiōnis maledicebat, sclopetum duplicem in Lumian intenxit et sine mora ictum dedit.

unit.source: Hang!
unit.target: Heu!

unit.source: A massive amount of lead spread out in a cone, enveloping the corresponding area.
unit.target: Magna multitūdō plumbī in conō diffusā est, circumveniēns regionem pertinēntem.

unit.source: As the hunting guide took aim, Lumian sidestepped and rolled to the other side of the street.
unit.target: Dum dux venātiōnis intenxit, Lumian sē declināvit et in alterum latus vīae volvit.

unit.source: What greeted his eyes were the previously quiet cows, sheep, and horses.
unit.target: Id quod occulī eius recipiēbantur, erant vaccae, oves, et equi, quī anteā quietī erant.

unit.source: At that moment, the eyes of these animals seemed to turn bloodshot.
unit.target: At illo tempore, oculī horum animālium rubefactī videbantur.

unit.source: Supporting himself with one hand, Lumian leaped up.
unit.target: Sustinēns sē ūnā manū, Lumian insiluit.

unit.source: Amidst the high-pitched mooing and the hunting guide’s aim, he leaped to the middle of the stairs leading to the second floor.
unit.target: Inter altum mugitum et ducis venātiōnis intentiōnem, in mediam scalae ad secundum planum insiluit.

unit.source: “Ah!” A scream suddenly pierced the air, then stopped abruptly.
unit.target: “Ah!” Clāmur subito in āerem percussit, deinde repentinō cessāvit.

unit.source: The door on the second floor swung open, and Lumian was confronted by a young man drenched in bright red blood.
unit.target: Iānuā in secundo planō aperta est, et Lumian obversātur iuvenī, nitidō rubrō sanguine perfusō.

unit.source: He held a massive axe dripping with the crimson liquid, and behind him lay the mangled corpse of an old man in his fifties, the wound carved deep into his chest.
unit.target: Tenēbat magnam securim, sanguine rubrō stillantē, et post eum iacebat lacerātum cadāver senis quinquāgenārī, cuius vulnus in pectore altē incisum erat.

unit.source: Lumian, who had been wandering Tizamo Town for days, was no stranger to these two individuals.
unit.target: Lumian, quī per diēs oppidum Tizamo vagātus erat, his duōbus hominibus nōn ignōtus erat.

unit.source: Lying on the ground, his eyes wide open, was the leathersmith of Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Iacens in terra, oculīs patefactīs, erat cuīrārius oppidī Tizamo.

unit.source: He would purchase the hides of wild beasts brought back by gentlemen, ladies, and town hunters who didn’t want to handle them themselves, processing them and selling the finished products.
unit.target: Ipse emēbat pellēs ferārum, quās domīnōs, domināe, et venātōrēs oppidī, quī eas ipsī tractare nōluerant, reportābant; ea conficiēns et operā perfecta vendēns.

unit.source: The axe-wielding figure was his eldest son, who had studied nitrification, tanning, and other leather production techniques from him.
unit.target: Figura, securim ferēns, erat prīmogenitus eius, quī ab eo nitrificātiōnem, curtitiōnem, et alias technicās coriariae producendī didicerat.

unit.source: He was known as an obedient young man, and his father wasn’t an old-fashioned leathersmith who resorted to physical or verbal violence.
unit.target: Nōtus erat ut iuvenis oboediēns, et pater eius nōn erat cuīrārius antiquus, quī ad vim corporālem aut verba flagitiāria adhiberet.

unit.source: This was a characteristic of the people of Tizamo.
unit.target: Hoc erat proprium īnde ingenium populi Tizamo.

unit.source: They were docile, calm, and devoid of intense emotions.
unit.target: Erant mītī, trānquillī, et affectibus intensīs carentēs.

unit.source: And now, it appeared that the leathersmith’s eldest son had just cleaved his father to death.
unit.target: Et nunc, apparuit fīlius prīmogenitus cuīrāriī patrem suum modo caedere fēcisse.

unit.source: Upon seeing Lumian, the lad’s eyes overflowed with a bloodthirsty smile.
unit.target: Cum Lumianum vīdit, oculī pueri sanguinis cupiditāte plēni, rīsus avidus ostendērunt.

unit.source: With a shout, he swung his axe at Lumian.
unit.target: Cum clāmōre, securim suam in Lumian iaculātus est.

unit.source: On the other side, the hunting guide began reloading his double-barreled shotgun with new lead rounds.
unit.target: In alterā parte, dux venātiōnis sclopetum duplicem novīs globīs plumbī reimplēvit.

unit.source: Lumian’s body suddenly turned ethereal, merging with his shadow and vanishing into the darkness beside the steps.
unit.target: Corpus Lumianī subito aetereum factum est, cum umbrā suā commiscēns, et in tenebrīs iuxta grādus evanuit.

unit.source: Shadow Transformation!
unit.target: Transformatio Umbrārum!

unit.source: After using this ability to sneak towards the police headquarters for a few seconds, Lumian suddenly heard someone pleading for mercy in fear.
unit.target: Postquam hanc facultātem ad prāetōrium vigilum paulīs secundīs insidiātus est, Lumian repentinē audīvīt aliquem, metuēns, misericordiam obsecrantem.

unit.source: He left the shadows and transformed back into a human.
unit.target: Ex umbrīs discessit et in hominem iterum sē transformāvit.

unit.source: He saw Rhea aiming an arrow at the cafe owner, Bunia, but she didn’t release it.
unit.target: Vīdit Rhea sagittam in dominum cauponae, Buniam, intendentem, sed eam nōn dimīsit.

unit.source: At that moment, a colossal anaconda, as thick as a barrel, emerged from the multi-layered hay at the top of the opposite house, hanging upside down.
unit.target: At illo tempore, ingens anaconda, tam crassā ut dolium, ex pluribus strātīs fāenī in summō domūs oppositae emergit, inversā pendentis.

unit.source: It widened its cold eyes and foul-smelling mouth, the patterns on its scales seeming to expand and writhe.
unit.target: Oculōs suōs frigīdōs dilatāvit et os foetidum patefecit, et formae in squāmīs eius expandī et contorquērī videbantur.

unit.source: This time, Lumian didn’t dodge.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian nōn evāsit.

unit.source: Facing the colossal boa attempting to devour him, his eyes darkened as he swung his fist upward.
unit.target: Adversus ingentem boam, quā eum devorāre conābātur, oculī eius obscurī factī sunt, dum pugnum suum sursum iactābat.

unit.source: In an instant, blazing white flames ignited from his fist, enveloping his entire forearm.
unit.target: In momento, flammae albae ardentēs ex pugnō eius exārserunt, totum bracchium eius involvēns.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s fist smashed into the colossal boa’s gaping maw, tearing through the blood-colored flesh and delivering a devastating uppercut to its upper jaw.
unit.target: Pugnō Lumianī os ingentis boae, quod late patebat, percussit, lānīāns carnem rubram, atque ictum superiōrem in maxillam eius perferēns.

unit.source: Before it could devour its human prey, the colossal boa’s cold eyes lost their luster.
unit.target: Antequam prae-dam humanam devorāretur, oculī frigīdī ingentis boae splendōrem amisērunt.

unit.source: Its massive body plummeted due to inertia, but Lumian easily sidestepped the falling serpent and retracted his fist.
unit.target: Corpus eius ingens, inertiae causā, corruit; sed Lumian facile serpentem cadentem evitāvit et pugnum suum retrāxit.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: The colossal boa crashed to the ground, its slippery scaled body engulfed in blazing white flames.
unit.target: Ingens boa in terram corruit, corpus eius squamōsum lībridum in flammīs albis ardentibus inclusum est.

unit.source: Weakness Investigation!
unit.target: Investigātiō Debilitatum!

unit.source: Lumian approached Rhea, noticing that the patrol team member was also regarding him with a vigilant and puzzled expression.
unit.target: Lumian ad Rhea accessit, animādvērēns membrum turmae praesidiāriāque eum cum vigilantia et vultū perplexō intuentem.

unit.source: He didn’t attack immediately.
unit.target: Nōn statim oppugnāvit.

unit.source: She… Lumian’s heart stirred as a smile played across his lips.
unit.target: Illa… cor Lumianī concitātus est, dum rīsus per labia eius lūderet.

unit.source: “Looks like you’re still lucid.”
unit.target: “Vidētur tē adhūc lucida esse.”

unit.source: Wary of Bunia, Rhea observed Louis Berry for a moment, hesitating before speaking.
unit.target: Cauta dē Bunia, Rhea per momentum Louis Berry observāvit, haesitāns antequam loquī coepit.

unit.source: “Lucid, you say?”
unit.target: “Lucida, dīcis?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian pointed at Bunia, who was glaring at him with undisguised hatred. “Did he attempt to attack you or even rape you?”
unit.target: “Ita.” Lumian, ad Buniam intendēns, quī eum odōre manifestō detrectābat, addidit: “Tentāvitne tē oppugnāre aut etiam violāre?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Rhea didn’t ask how he knew. Instead, she inquired, “What’s going on?”
unit.target: “Ita.” Rhea nōn rogāvit quomōde scīret, sed interrogāvit: “Quid accidit?”

unit.source: Padre Cali was already standing at the cathedral’s entrance.
unit.target: Padre Cali iam ad introitum catherdralis stabat.

unit.source: However, he was no longer clad in the Eternal Blazing Sun Church clergyman’s robe with its white and golden threads.
unit.target: Attamen, nōn iam indūtus erat veste clergōnicā Ecclesiā Solis Aeternī Flammae, filīs albīs et aurēīs ornātā.

unit.source: Instead, he had donned a dark and intricately designed robe.
unit.target: Pro eō, indūtus erat veste obscūrā et subtiliter confectā.

unit.source: The padre, with his dark-brown skin, sunken eyes, and stiff facial features, gazed out at the empty square before his eyes settled on the newly arrived Lumian and Rhea.
unit.target: Padre, cum cute fuscā, oculīs demissīs, et lineāmentīs rigīdīs, in plateam vacuām intuēns, animādvērit nuper adventōs Lumian et Rhea.

unit.source: He held the Bible aloft and shouted with a frenzied expression, “1 hereby declare the official commencement of the Dream Festival!
unit.target: Biblicam sublātam tenēns et vultū exagitātō clamāvit: “Hic dēclārō initium Festī Somniorum officiōsum!”

unit.source: “During the Dream Festival, there are no taboos or restrictions. You are free to do as you wish, including harming and killing.
unit.target: “Durante Festō Somniorum, nullae sunt prōhibitiōnēs aut restrictionēs; libērē agere potētis, etiam si nocere et occīdere id vēlitis.

unit.source: “Revel in it and unleash all your emotions and desires, everyone!”
unit.target: “Exsultāte in ēo et omnem vestram affectūs ac dēsīderia effundite, omnēs!”

unit.source: Chapter 672: Greater Trouble
unit.target: Capitulum 672: Maius Incommodum

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Upon hearing Padre Cali’s shout, Rhea raised her hunting bow and aimed an arrow wrapped in silver lightning at the clergyman in the complicated black robe.
unit.target: Cum clamor Padri Cali audivit, Rhea arcum venatorium levavit et sagittam, fulmine argenteo involutam, in sacerdotem in intricata veste nigra destinavit.

unit.source: Unlike when she had faced the cafe owner, Bunia, the anger in her eyes was even more pronounced now, and there was no hesitation.
unit.target: Diversum, cum ante cauponem, Buniam, occurrisset, ira in oculis eius nunc etiam magis manifesta erat atque mora non exstitit.

unit.source: The padre was blaspheming and apostatizing!
unit.target: Padre blasphēmia faciebat atque fidem deserere conabatur!

unit.source: At that moment, a slender and powerful palm appeared in front of Rhea’s hunting bow, blocking the arrow.
unit.target: Illo momento, palma tenuis atque fortis ante arcum venatorium Rheae apparuit, sagittam obstruens.

unit.source: “You…” Rhea turned to Louis Berry, puzzled as to why he had stopped her.
unit.target: "Tu..." Rhea ad Ludovicum Berry se vertit, mirata qua de causa eum eam prohibuisse videbat.

unit.source: Lumian replied calmly, “Let’s wait and see.”
unit.target: Lumian tranquille respondit: "Exspectemus et videamus."

unit.source: As the two of them conversed, Padre Cali revealed a wanton and flamboyant smile.
unit.target: Dum inter se colloquebantur, Padre Cali risum licentiosum et ostentatium detexit.

unit.source: He turned around and walked back to the cathedral with the Bible in his arms.
unit.target: Se vertit et ad cathedralem cum Biblia in brachiis ambulavit.

unit.source: The golden dome at the cathedral’s top and the statues and decorations on the outer walls dimmed under the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Cupola aurea in summo cathedralis, statuae autem et ornamenta in parietibus exterioribus, sub lumine lunari rubro obscurabantur.

unit.source: After Padre Cali’s figure disappeared through the cathedral’s open door, Rhea looked at Lumian with a dark expression.
unit.target: Postquam figura Padri Cali per ianuam apertam cathedralis evanuit, Rhea Lumian vultu obscuro aspexit.

unit.source: “Why?”
unit.target: "Cur?"

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “After realizing that this place is suspected to be a dream, I’ve been pondering a question.”
unit.target: "Postquam intellexi hunc locum somnium esse suspicari, quaestionem meditabar."

unit.source: As he spoke, screams and piercing cries reverberated through Tizamo and the surrounding plantations, echoing through the dark night sky.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, clamores atque acutae voces per Tizamo et circumstantia praedia resonabant, in obscuro caelo nocturno replicantes.

unit.source: “What question?” Rhea pressed.
unit.target: "Quae quaestio?" Rhea instavit.

unit.source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian said, “It’s almost certain that we’re participating in the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Nullo responsu directo dandum, Lumian dixit, "Fere certum est nos in Festum Somniorum participare."

unit.source: “Under such circumstances, if you succeed in attacking Padre Cali, what will happen when the Dream Festival concludes and everyone wakes up?”
unit.target: "Sub talibus condicionibus, si in oppugnatione Padri Cali successeris, quid fiet cum Festum Somniorum finietur et omnes evigilabunt?"

unit.source: Without waiting for Rhea’s response, Lumian smiled again.
unit.target: Ne responsum Rheae exspectans, Lumian iterum subridet.

unit.source: “If you shoot him in the arm, he’ll wake up feeling phantom pain in the corresponding location, as if he’s suffering from arthritis and his muscles are tearing.”
unit.target: "Si eum in brachium iaculaberis, expergisci sensit dolorem phantasmaticum in loco congruenti, quasi arthritidem patitur et musculi eius laniantur."

unit.source: H
unit.target: H

unit.source: “If you strike his head with a hammer and knock him out, there’s a high chance that he’ll have a headache, dizziness, and nervous twitches when he returns to reality.”
unit.target: "Si caput eius malleo percusseris et eum concutias, magna verisimilitudo est eum, ut capitis dolorem, vertiginem atque tremores nervosos patiat, cum in rem reverterit."

unit.source: “If you rape and impregnate him, he’ll likely feel nauseous, reflux, and bloated, feeling like he might have a fetus in his stomach when he wakes up.”
unit.target: "Si eum violabis atque incubeberis, verisimile est eum nauseatum, refluxum et tumescens sentire, quasi fetus in ventre suo haberet postquam expergisceretur."

unit.source: “If you tie him up, continuously electrocute him, and incinerate him with fire, will he feel those sensations in the real world, as if possessed by wraiths or shadows. He may always feel restrained, paralyzed, or in pain.”
unit.target: "Si eum alligas, continue per ictus electricos affligas, et igne cremabis, num illa sensa in mundo reali sentiet, quasi a phantasmatibus vel umbris possessus? Fortasse semper se coarctatum, paralyticum aut in dolore sentiet."

unit.source: Rhea listened calmly, not bothering to question why Padre Cali could get pregnant.
unit.target: Rhea tranquille auscultabat, non curans quaerere cur Padre Cali gravida fieri posset.

unit.source: The more she listened, the more alarmed she became.
unit.target: Quo magis auscultabat, eo magis territa facta est.

unit.source: This was because Louis Berry’s description matched the various manifestations of mass hysteria in Tizamo that the patrol team had gathered.
unit.target: Hoc erat, quia descriptio Ludovici Berry conveniebat variis signis hysteriae massivae in Tizamo, quas turma vigiliarum congregaverat.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Rhea and asked with a smile, “If you had killed Padre Cali with an arrow, what would happen when the dream recedes?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Rheam se vertit et subridente rogavit: "Si Padrem Cali sagittā interfecisses, quid accideret cum somnium recederet?"

unit.source: “He’ll die immediately? No…” Rhea denied it.
unit.target: "Mox morietur? Non..." Rhea negavit.

unit.source: Tizamo had no incidents of multiple people suddenly dying in their dreams after a night.
unit.target: In Tizamo casus non fuerunt quo plures homines simul in somniis post noctem perire possent.

unit.source: Rhea immediately thought of an abnormality.
unit.target: Rhea statim de re insolita cogitavit.

unit.source: Between mid-December and mid-March, 80% of the annual deaths in Tizamo occurred, significantly surpassing those in Port Pylos and the surrounding towns.
unit.target: Inter medium Decembrem et medium Martium, 80% mortalitatum annuarum in Tizamo evenit, valde superans eas in Port Pylos et oppidis circumjacentibus.

unit.source: She changed her words.
unit.target: Verba sua mutavit.

unit.source: “They will gradually die in an irreversible manner within the next three months?”
unit.target: "Gradatim morientur in modo irreversibili intra proximos tres menses?"

unit.source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “I even suspect that the primitive tribe in the forest launched several attacks in those three months mainly to eliminate those who had died in their dreams, allowing them to die reasonably in reality without revealing anything abnormal.
unit.target: Clauso capite, Lumian respondit, "Etiam suspicor quod tribus primitiva in silva his tribus mensibus plures impetus iniit, praecipue ad eos, qui in somniis perierant, exterminandos, ita ut in re rite morerentur sine quidquam insolitum revelando."

unit.source: “From December of last year to this year, they only completed one attack.”
unit.target: "Ab Decembri anni praeteriti usque ad hunc annum, unam tantum impetum confecerunt."

unit.source: The reason should be that the attack was very successful.
unit.target: Causa esse debet quod impetus valde feliciter successit.

unit.source: “Those who should die are dead, and some who don’t deserve to die are also dead.”
unit.target: "Qui mori debent mortui sunt, et quidam qui mori non debent, etiam mortui sunt."

unit.source: “There’s no need for them to take the risk and they also lost the motivation to come to Tizamo again.”
unit.target: "Non opus est eis periculum sumere et etiam animos ad iterum Tizamo veniendum amiserunt."

unit.source: Rhea listened attentively and pondered for a few seconds.
unit.target: Rhea attente auscultavit et paucis momentis meditata est.

unit.source: “The Dream Festival originates from that tribe?”
unit.target: "Festum Somniorum ex illa tribu oritur?"

unit.source: “It’s possible.”
unit.target: "Possibile est."

unit.source: “It’s more likely that they guard or worship the source and act according to its revelations,” Lumian replied simply.
unit.target: "Verisimiliter magis curant aut colunt fontem et secundum eius revelationes agunt," Lumian simpliciter respondit.

unit.source: Rhea nodded slightly.
unit.target: Rhea leviter annuit.

unit.source: “No wonder you stopped me from shooting Padre Cali.”
unit.target: "Non mirum est quod me a sagittatione Padrem Cali prohibuisti."

unit.source: “Everyone in Tizamo is likely a victim.”
unit.target: "Omnes in Tizamo verisimiliter victimæ sunt."

unit.source: Thats why I didn’t counterattack the two assailants and only killed the colossal boa with a single punch, Lumian thought.
unit.target: Ideo duo aggressorum non repulsi, sed solummodo magnam boam colossalem uno ictu interfeci, Lumian cogitavit.

unit.source: When awoken from the dream, will the colossal boa crawl in front of me and die?
unit.target: Cum ex somnio expergiscar, num magna boa colossalis coram me serpet et morietur?

unit.source: If thats the case, I can add more food to Ludwigs plate…
unit.target: Si ita sit, possum cibum ampliorem ad Ludwig patinam addere…

unit.source: Lumian surveyed the empty square slumbering in the night.
unit.target: Lumian forum vacuum, nocte quiescente, perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: “Let’s find Camus now and see if he’s still lucid.”
unit.target: "Nunc Camum inveniamus et videamus an adhuc lucidus sit."

unit.source: In Tizamo, on the third floor of the police headquarters, five rooms and one washroom belonged to the patrol team.
unit.target: In Tizamo, in tabulato tertio praetorii vigilantium, quinque cubicula et unum balneum turmae vigiliarum erant.

unit.source: One room was used for day-to-day work, while another was used for storing documents and items.
unit.target: Unum cubiculum pro negotiis cotidianis adhibebatur, alterum vero ad documenta et res condendas.

unit.source: The remaining three apartments belonged to the local patrol team members, one for each person.
unit.target: Reliqua tria habitacula pertenebant membris localibus turmae vigiliarum, unum pro quolibet.

unit.source: With the arrival of Camus and Kolobo, Maslow had temporarily moved to Loban’s to vacate a room for his colleagues from Port Pylos.
unit.target: Cum Camus et Kolobo adventu venerunt, Maslow ad Loban transierat ad temporarie cubiculum liberandum pro collegis ex Port Pylos.

unit.source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
unit.target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

unit.source: Amidst the reverberations of the bell, Camus jolted awake.
unit.target: Inter resonantia campanae, Camus subito evigilavit.

unit.source: He glanced out the window into the deep night, illuminated by a faint crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Per fenestram in profundam noctem, levis lumine lunari rubro illustrata, conspexit.

unit.source: Momentarily disoriented, he wondered about the hour.
unit.target: Momento confusus, de hora quaesivit.

unit.source: Just as Camus reached for his pocket watch, intending to check the time, he noticed Kolobo’s absence from the makeshift bed.
unit.target: Iam cum Camus horologium suum ex sinu capere conabatur ut tempus inspexeret, animadvertit Kolobo ab lecto improviso defuisse.

unit.source: A sense of unease washed over him, urging him into action.
unit.target: Sensatio inquietudinis eum superveniens ad agendum impulit.

unit.source: With silent determination, he rose from his bed under the eerie crimson moonlight, securing his pocket watch and weapon.
unit.target: Tacita determinatione, e lecto surrexit sub lumine lunari rubro inquieto, horologium suum atque armum ceperit.

unit.source: Stepping cautiously into the corridor, Camus found it unusually still, cloaked in shadowy silence.
unit.target: Cautius in vestibulum intravit, et invenit eum insolite quietum, in umbris silentio involutum.

unit.source: Beyond the confines of the police headquarters, eerie cries and distant wails pierced the night, emanating from various corners of Tizamo and its surrounding plantations.
unit.target: Extra limites praetorii, clamores tenebrosi atque luctus procul per noctem penetraverunt, ex variis angulis Tizamo et agris circumstantibus emanantes.

unit.source: Drawing on his keen awareness honed through experience as a Public Security Officer, Camus sensed a disturbance in his Jurisdiction.
unit.target: Ex acuta vigilantia, per experientiam ut Officier Publicae Securitatis exercitatus, Camus perturbationem in sua iurisdictione sensit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he instinctively dropped to the ground and rolled forward.
unit.target: Subito, instinctu huic, in terram cecidit et se volvit ante.

unit.source: A deafening crack echoed through the corridor as a wooden door, which Camus would have passed by, splintered and burst outward.
unit.target: Fragor insons per corridor resonavit, cum porta lignea, quam Camus transiret, dispersa atque extrusa est.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, a broadsword slashed through the air, propelled by a savage force, slicing through the empty corridor.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, gladius latus per aerem secabat, vi saeva impellitus, per corridor vacuum secans.

unit.source: As Camus swiftly evaded the attack, he turned to face his assailant.
unit.target: Dum Camus impetum celeriter evitavit, ad oppugnatorem se vertit.

unit.source: It was Loban, the towering patrol member standing at over 1.9 meters, with short light-gold hair and piercing light-blue eyes.
unit.target: Erat Loban, membrum vigiliarum excelsum, supra 1.9 metra stans, cum capillis brevi aureo-luce et oculis caeruleis penetrantibus.

unit.source: A cruel smirk adorned the Feysacian’s face, his eyes glinting with unmistakable greed.
unit.target: In facie Feysacii crudelis subrisio insita erat, oculi eius insigni avaritia micabant.

unit.source: In the dim moonlight, his features were obscured by shadows, emanating an eerie malevolence.
unit.target: Sub lumine lunari tenuimente, vultus eius umbris absconditus erat, nefandam malitiam efferens.

unit.source: Upon spotting Loban, Camus’s eyes sparked with determination.
unit.target: Loban conspecto, oculi Camus proposito ardore scintillaverunt.

unit.source: Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Percussio Mentis!

unit.source: Loban recoiled with a pained cry, instinctively shielding his head with his hands, relinquishing his grip on the broadsword.
unit.target: Loban, gemitu maerenti retorsus, instinctive caput manibus protexit, et manum in gladio lato relinquens.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Camus swiftly drew his revolver, taking aim at his teammate.
unit.target: Occasio captā, Camus celeriter revolver suum extraxit, in sodalem suum intuentem.

unit.source: In a moment of hesitation, Camus faltered, then lowered his weapon.
unit.target: Momento dubitationis, Camus titubavit, deinde armum deiecerit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: The bullet found its mark, striking Loban’s knee with brutal force, tearing through flesh and shattering bone.
unit.target: Proiectum suam metam invenit, Loban genu vi cruda percutiens, carnem lanians ac ossa confracta.

unit.source: A Doctor from the Church of Earth Mother could mend such injuries!
unit.target: Medicus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae huiusmodi vulnera sanare posset!

unit.source: Loban crumpled to the ground, writhing in agony, his attempts to curl up thwarted by the searing pain.
unit.target: Loban in terram conlapsus est, et in dolore flexus, conatus se contrahere a dolore ardenti impeditos.

unit.source: Camus lowered his revolver, rose to his feet, and pressed forward towards the end of the corridor.
unit.target: Camus revolver deiecit, surrexit, et ad finem corridoris procedere coepit.

unit.source: As he descended the stairs, Camus passed by a cluttered cubicle, its contents scattered haphazardly, and caught faint murmurs from within.
unit.target: Scala descendens, Camus cubiculum varium reconditum pertransiit, cuius contenta confusa dispersa erant, et inchoatos murmurationes ex intimo audivit.

unit.source: His heart skipped a beat as he whispered, “Kolobo, is that you?”
unit.target: Cor eius paulum titubavit, dum sibilavit: "Kolobo, esne tu?"

unit.source: A moment of tense silence followed before Kolobo’s voice, tinged with panic and fear, replied, “Stay back! Don’t come any closer! Spare me!”
unit.target: Momento silentii tensionis secutum est, antequam vox Kolobo, cum terrore et timore tincta, respondit: "Recede! Noli propius accedere! Mecum parcere!"

unit.source: Camus frowned, sensing that Kolobo’s demeanor was far from his usual composed self.
unit.target: Camus vultum contraxit, sensu quod habitus Kolobo longe ab eo solito tranquillo distaret.

unit.source: Though prone to bouts of fear and unease, Kolobo typically pushed through his anxieties to fulfill his duties.
unit.target: Quamquam ad timoris et incommodi impetus inclinatus, Kolobo plerumque anxietates superabat ad officia sua perficienda.

unit.source: This level of hysteria was unprecedented.
unit.target: Talis hysteriae gradus inauditus erat.

unit.source: What’s wrong with Kolobo? Camus wondered.
unit.target: "Quid Kolobo habet?" Camus quaesivit.

unit.source: Choosing to stay put rather than risk exacerbating the situation, Camus observed as Kolobo fell into an uneasy silence, as if attempting to fade into obscurity.
unit.target: Manere potius quam periculum augendi casum caperet, Camus aspexit Kolobo in incommodum silentium incidere, quasi in oblivionem evanescere conanti.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds, Camus contemplated assessing Kolobo’s condition.
unit.target: Post plus quam decem secundis, Camus de statu Kolobo cogitavit.

unit.source: If it proved dire, he resolved to retreat and seek out Louis Berry.
unit.target: Si pessimum inveniret, decrevit recedere et Ludovicum Berry quaerere.

unit.source: Suddenly, the sound of two sets of rapid footsteps echoed from below.
unit.target: Subito, sonus duplicatorum rapidorum graduum deorsum resonavit.

unit.source: Camus swiftly pivoted, training his revolver down the stairs.
unit.target: Camus celeriter se vertit et revolver suum ad gradus dirigebat.

unit.source: There, he beheld Louis Berry, sporting a golden straw hat, accompanied by Rhea, armed with a hunting bow and arrow.
unit.target: Ibi invenit Ludovicum Berry, galeam ex stramine auro pictam gerentem, comitante Rhea, armata arcum venatorium et sagittam.

unit.source: Gazing at the barrel aimed in their direction, Louis Berry chuckled lightly, his tone calm.
unit.target: Spectans tubum in eorum directionem intendentem, Ludovicus Berry leviter subridens loquebatur, tono tranquillo.

unit.source: “Welcome to the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: "Salve ad Festum Somniorum."

unit.source: The Dream Festival?
unit.target: Festum Somniorum?

unit.source: Its the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Estne Festum Somniorum?

unit.source: Realization dawned on Camus.
unit.target: Revelatio Camusi innotuit.

unit.source: He glanced between the smiling Louis Berry and the serious Rhea, confusion etched on his features.
unit.target: Inter risum Ludovici Berry et severam Rheam conspexit, vultus eius perplexitate notato.

unit.source: “Why are we still lucid?”
unit.target: "Cur adhuc lucidi sumus?"

unit.source: Observing their composed demeanor, Camus deduced that they hadn’t succumbed to the overwhelming emotions and desires that often engulfed dreamers.
unit.target: Eorum habitum compositum aspiciens, Camus concludit eos non subesse affectibus et cupiditatibus vehementibus, quae somniatores saepe opprimerent.

unit.source: Yet, he kept his revolver steady, wary of any sudden developments.
unit.target: Tamen revolver suum firmiter tenuit, cautus ne quid subito eveniat.
