unit.source: “Perhaps our early entry into this peculiar dream, thanks to Twanaku’s house, has granted us this lucidity,” Lumian proposed, offering his deduction.
unit.target: "Forsitan initium nostrum ante tempus in hoc somnio peculiari, propter domum Twanaku, nobis hanc luciditatem concessit," Lumian proposuit.

unit.source: Rhea seized the opportunity to suggest that encounters within the dream might hold sway over reality to some extent, sharing the conjecture with Camus.
unit.target: Rhea occasionem adhibuit ut suggereret congressus intra somnium posse partim realitatem imperare, cum Camus suam coniecturam communicans.

unit.source: Initially relieved that he hadn’t resorted to lethal force against Loban, Camus’s expression turned grave as he addressed his companions.
unit.target: Primum solatus quod contra Loban virtute letali non adhibita esset, vultus Camus serio versatus est, cum comitibus suis loquens.

unit.source: “The three of us aren’t the only Beyonders in Tizamo.
unit.target: "Nos tres non solum Beyonders in Tizamo sumus.

unit.source: “If we adhere to the notion that we can’t retaliate when attacked, it will severely hamper our ability to defend ourselves.”
unit.target: "Si instanter credamus nos, cum oppugnabimur, non posse repugnare, id vehementer impediet facultatem nostram ad se defendendum."

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens arridit.

unit.source: “Who said we can’t kill?
unit.target: "Quis dixit nos ne possimus interficere?

unit.source: “If someone poses a threat to me, they shall be killed accordingly.”
unit.target: "Si quis mihi periculum efficiat, interficietur pro tanto."

unit.source: Rhea and Camus fell silent.
unit.target: Rhea et Camus silentium ceperunt.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Camus nodded decisively, gesturing towards the sundry compartment nestled in the stairwell.
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, Camus firmiter annuit, ad compartimentum diversum in scala situm demonstrans.

unit.source: “Kolobo’s extreme reaction stems from fear.
unit.target: "Exremum Kolobo responsum ex timore provenit.

unit.source: “He won’t pose a threat to us.
unit.target: "Non nobis periculum faciet.

unit.source: “Let him seek refuge there, undisturbed.”
unit.target: "Ei ibi refugium quaerat, inturbatus."

unit.source: As Rhea concurred, Lumian’s expression suddenly shifted.
unit.target: Cum Rhea assentit, vultus Lumian subito mutatus est.

unit.source: He asked, “Is Kolobo also in this dream?”
unit.target: Rogavit: "Num Kolobo etiam in hoc somnio existit?"

unit.source: Kolobo, who has been in Tizamo for less than a week like me, has also been forced to participate in the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Kolobo, qui in Tizamo minus quam hebdomadas, sicut ego, mansit, etiam coactus est Festum Somniorum participare?

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: "Ita."

unit.source: Camus asked in confusion, “Is there a problem?”
unit.target: Camus, confusus, rogavit: "Estne quaestio?"

unit.source: A shadow crossed Lumian’s features as he responded gravely.
unit.target: Umbra per vultum Lumian transiit, dum graviter respondit.

unit.source: “This suggests there may be a larger problem at play.”
unit.target: "Hoc significat maius problema consistere posse."

unit.source: Perhaps one more terrifying than the Dream Festival itself!
unit.target: Fortasse unum adhuc terribilius quam ipsum Festum Somniorum!

unit.source: Before Camus and Rhea could inquire further, Lumian abruptly interjected.
unit.target: Antequam Camus et Rhea ulterius interrogare possent, Lumian subito interposuit.

unit.source: “Wait here for me.”
unit.target: "Hic exspecta me."

unit.source: With that, he vanished from the stairway, utilizing Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Hoc facto, ab scala evanuit, Spiritus Mundi Transitus utens.

unit.source: Lumian reappeared on the second floor of the Brieu Motel, just outside his suite.
unit.target: Lumian in secundo tabulato Brieu Motel iterum apparuit, prope conclave suum.

unit.source: In the next instant, a piercing scream echoed through the air, filled with agony and terror.
unit.target: In proximo momento, stridor acutus per aerem resonavit, dolore et terrore plenum.

unit.source: It was Lugano..
unit.target: Erat Lugano..

unit.source: Chapter 673: “Sealing” Spell
unit.target: Capitulum 673: Incantatio "Sigillandi"

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Confirming his fears, Lumian slipped his key into the lock, easing the door to the suite open without a sound.
unit.target: Timores suos confirmans, Lumian clavem suam in seram introduxit, sine sono ostium cubiculi aperiens.

unit.source: Now, he knew without a doubt that Ludwig, the terrifying sealed creature, would unleash his hunger and frenzy at the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Iam certe sciebat quod Ludwig, creatura sigillata et terribilis, famem ac furiam suam in Festum Somniorum exsolvet.

unit.source: Beneath the crimson moonlight streaming through the window, Lugano thrashed wildly, his face twisted in agony.
unit.target: Sub rubro lumine lunari, per fenestram effluentis, Lugano saeviter se convulsit, vultus eius in dolore distortus.

unit.source: Lurking at the end of his flailing arm was Ludwig, dressed in a child’s nightcap and sky-blue pajamas dotted with yellow stars.
unit.target: Insidians in extremitate brachii eius flagitantis, Ludwig apparuit, indutus in pileum puerile nocturnum et in pyjamas caeruleos, stellis flavescentibus maculatos.

unit.source: The sickening sounds of bones crunching and flesh tearing filled the air.
unit.target: Sordidi sonitus ossium crepantium et carnis laniandae aera implebant.

unit.source: Amidst the chaos, droplets of blood splattered onto the floor.
unit.target: Inter tumultum, guttae sanguinis in pavimentum sparsae sunt.

unit.source: Suddenly, Ludwig lunged forward like a frenzied animal, his jaws closing in on Lugano’s arm with a sickening crack.
unit.target: Subito, Ludwig, ut bestia furens, impetum fecit, mandibulae ejus ad brachium Lugano claudentibus, cum crepitu nauseabundo.

unit.source: “All!”
unit.target: “Omnes!”

unit.source: Lugano’s scream pierced the air once more, threatening to blow the roof.
unit.target: Clamor Lugani iterum aerem percurruit, minans tectum evellere.

unit.source: Instinctively, he tried to wrench his arm free from Ludwig’s grasp and shove the creature away with his other hand. Pain seared through him, and he felt himself teetering on the edge of unconsciousness.
unit.target: Instinctu conatus est brachium suum a Ludwig vinculis solvere et creaturam altera manu repellere. Dolor per eum ardebatur, atque se in confinio insciientiae vacillare sensit.

unit.source: Observing Ludwig closely, Lumian darted behind him, his nostrils flaring.
unit.target: Ludwig arcte observans, Lumian celeriter post eum se contulit, naribus effusis.

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot forth from his nose, enveloping Ludwig. Ludwig paused, shutting his eyes.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae e naso eius proiecerunt, Ludwig involventes. Ludwig cessavit, oculos clausit.

unit.source: But before Lumian could react, the boy’s mouth resumed its relentless assault on Lugano’s arm, pulverizing bone and flesh alike.
unit.target: Sed antequam Lumian agere posset, os pueri iterum impetum insatiabilem in brachium Lugano dedit, pulverizans ossa et carnem.

unit.source: His eyes snapped open.
unit.target: Oculi eius subito aperti sunt.

unit.source: The Spell of Harrumph can only daze Ludwig for a moment, and that’s only if he’s sealed… Lumian reminded himself, taking a deep breath to steady his nerves.
unit.target: Incantatio Harrumph Ludwig tantum per momentum obnubilare potest, et id solum si ille sigillatus est… Lumian se admonuit, spirum profundum sumens ad nervos suos temperandos.

unit.source: He glanced at Lugano, who had noticed him but was too consumed by agony to speak. Raising a hand, Lumian motioned for Lugano to remain patient.
unit.target: Ad Lugano intuitus est, qui eum animadvertit sed nimis dolore captus non poterat loqui. Manum levans, Lumian Lugano instavit ut patienter maneret.

unit.source: Though Lugano’s mind raced with curses and frustration, he remained unable to voice them.
unit.target: Quamquam mens Lugani maledicta et frustratione iterabat, ea verba exprimere non poterat.

unit.source: As thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian gave an imperceptible nod.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes in mente eius currerent, Lumian imperceptibiliter annuit.

unit.source: Changing his focus, Lumian bypassed Ludwig, who was engrossed in devouring Lugano, and seized Lugano’s shoulder.
unit.target: Focalem mutans, Lumian Ludwig praeteriit, qui Lugani vorando occupatus erat, et humerum Lugani arripuit.

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian retrieved a sharp straight sword he had acquired from Port Santa, pulling it from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: In momento, Lumian gladium acutum et rectum, quem ab Porto Santa adeptus erat, extraxit ex sacculo Viatoris.

unit.source: What is he trying to Jo? Amidst the throes of pain, Lugano’s thoughts scattered.
unit.target: Quid conatur facere? In medio doloris, cogitationes Lugani dissipatae sunt.

unit.source: With a swift motion, Lumian swung the sword, the blade bursting into white flames.
unit.target: Celeriter motu, Lumian gladium percussit, cuius lamina in flammas albas erupta est.

unit.source: The fiery sword crashed down upon Lugano’s arm, where Ludwig had been feasting, striking at the joint.
unit.target: Gladius igniatus in brachium Lugani delapsus est, ubi Ludwig epulabatur, juncturam percutiens.

unit.source: With a sharp sound, Lugano’s forearm tore away from Ludwig’s grasp, leaving behind a gory, truncated limb.
unit.target: Cum sono acuto, antebrachium Lugani a conatu Ludovigi evulsum est, relinquens membrum cruentum et truncatum.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s form began to fade, and even Lugano, whom he had grasped, vanished from sight.
unit.target: Simul, figura Lumiani evanescere coepit, et etiam Lugano, quem ceperat, ex conspectu evanuit.

unit.source: Teleport!
unit.target: Transloca!

unit.source: But Lumian hadn’t gone far. Both he and Lugano reappeared at the suite’s doorway.
unit.target: Sed Lumian non longe discesserat. Et ille atque Lugano iterum ad ostium cubiculi apparuerunt.

unit.source: The agony persisted, but Lugano’s momentary relief vanished as Ludwig’s figure once again came into view. The sight of the boy, his mouth still bloody with Lugano’s remaining forearm, sent a shiver down his spine.
unit.target: Agonia perseverabat, sed levamen momentaneum Lugani evanuit, cum figura Ludovigi iterum apparuit. Visio pueri, cuius os adhuc sanguinolentum ex antebrachio residuo Lugani manebat, tremorem per spinam eius intulit.

unit.source: The fear momentarily eclipsed the pain, and Lugano’s mind raced with frantic questions.
unit.target: Timor momento dolorem obumbravit, et mens Lugani quaestionibus ferventibus cursabat.

unit.source: Why not teleport away from Tizamo?
unit.target: Cur non translocari ex Tizamo?

unit.source: Why not teleport to Port Pylos?
unit.target: Cur non translocari ad Portum Pylos?

unit.source: Why are we still lingering in front of Ludwig?
unit.target: Cur adhuc coram Ludovigum manemus?

unit.source: Meanwhile, Ludwig had turned his attention to the doorway, his blond hair matted with blood, his brown eyes glinting with ravenous hunger.
unit.target: Interim, Ludwig animos suos ad ostium convertit, capillis flavis sanguine implicatis, oculis fuscis fame voraci micantibus.

unit.source: With the speed of a child his age, he advanced toward Lumian and Lugano,
unit.target: Celeritate pueri sui, ad Lumian et Lugano accessit,

unit.source: all the while chewing and swallowing what remained of Lugano’s arm.
unit.target: dum masticans et deglutiens quod reliquum erat ex brachio Lugani.

unit.source: Unperturbed, Lumian calmly returned the straight sword to his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Imperturbatus, Lumian tranquille gladium rectum in sacculum Viatoris repositum est.

unit.source: Under Lugano’s horrified gaze, Lumian conjured an entire almond pistachio cream thousand-layer cake and hurled it onto the floor beside Ludwig.
unit.target: Sub aspectu horrido Lugani, Lumian totam placentam mille stratis, ex crema amygdalina et pistachiis factam, in pavimentum iuxta Ludovigum iecit.

unit.source: Ludwig’s sprint slowed as he seemed to ponder which delicacy to indulge in first.
unit.target: Velocitas Ludovigi retardavit, quasi quaerebat qua dulcedine primum se deliciarent.

unit.source: Ultimately, he turned his attention back to Lugano.
unit.target: Postremo, animos suos ad Lugano redegit.

unit.source: The sight of blood, flesh, and marrow infused with spiritual essence seemed to intoxicate him even further.
unit.target: Visio sanguinis, carnis, et medullae spiritu infuso eum adhuc magis inebriabat.

unit.source: Capitalizing on Ludwig’s momentary indecision, Lumian delved into his Traveler’s Bag once more, extracting a fragment of Hisoka’s corpse and tossing it aside.
unit.target: Ex indecisione momentanea Ludovigi fructificans, Lumian iterum in sacculum Viatoris immiscuit, fragmentum corporis Hisoka extrahens et proiecit.

unit.source: Ludwig’s gaze followed the offering, his lips instinctively moistening, yet he made no move to change course.
unit.target: Aspectus Ludovigi oblationem secutus est, labia ejus instinctu humidata, sed nihil ad cursum mutandum movebat.

unit.source: It seemed he found the offering beneath his tastes, too dirty to be his top choice.
unit.target: Videbatur oblationem repulsam esse ab appetitu suo, nimis sordidam ut optio praecipua esset.

unit.source: Lumian systematically tossed out ingredients brimming with spiritual energy, one after the other, creating a barrier of tempting treats around Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian ingredientes spirituali energia plenos uno post alium systematice proiecit, murum ex delectabilibus suppellectibus circa Ludovigum condidit.

unit.source: Cream pancakes, fruit tarts, sandwiches oozing with cream, bouchee a la reine, chocolates infused with liquor, cookies, candied plums, eclairs, Charlotte desserts, and a myriad of other delicacies formed a tempting ring around Ludwig, impeding his advance toward Lugano.
unit.target: Placentae cremorosae, tartae fructuosae, panini cum cremo effluentes, bouchee à la reine, chocolatae liquore imbutae, biscottae, pruna dulcia confecta, éclairs, dolcia Charlotte, et innumerabilia alia delicia, circulum allicitium circa Ludovigum formaverunt, progressum eius ad Lugano impediendo.

unit.source: Turning to Lugano with a stern expression, Lumian’s voice took on a commanding tone.
unit.target: Ad Lugano cum vultu severo conversus, vox Lumiani tonum imperativum accepit.

unit.source: “What are you waiting for? Stem the bleeding first!”
unit.target: “Quid exspectas? Primo sanguinem sistere!”

unit.source: Startled, Lugano obeyed, his left palm emitting a faint glow as he applied pressure to the stump of his injured arm.
unit.target: Stupefactus, Lugano obtemperavit, palma sinistra leviter luce emittens, pressuram in truncum brachii laesi applicans.

unit.source: As Ludwig indulged in the feast laid out before him, his urgency waned. Though still concerned for Lugano, he no longer rushed forward.
unit.target: Dum Ludwig in epula ante se fruebatur, eius urgetio minuebatur. Quamquam pro Lugano adhuc sollicitus erat, non amplius procedebat.

unit.source: In the final stages, Lumian threw out boxes of biscuits, sweets, beef jerky, and assorted provisions, encircling Ludwig with a haphazard yet effective “wall” of food.
unit.target: In ultimis gradibus, Lumian cistulas ex biscotti, dulcibus, carne arida, et variis provisionibus proiecit, Ludwig circumcludens muro edulis, fortuito sed efficaci.

unit.source: Nearly all of Lumian’s seven days’ worth of rations for Ludwig had been deployed from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Fere omnes rationes septem dierum, quas Lumian pro Ludovigo habebat, ex sacculo Viatoris editae erant.

unit.source: “What… what’s the meaning of this?” Lugano, having successfully treated his wound and eased his pain, watched Lumian’s actions with bewilderment. He couldn’t fathom why his employer was so fixated on feeding Ludwig in the midst of their predicament.
unit.target: “Quid... quid hoc significat?” inquit Lugano, vulnera sua sanata et dolorem levatum habens, actiones Lumiani perplexus observans. Non poterat intellegere cur dominus eius tam pertinaciter in Ludovigo alendo esset in medio tribulationis.

unit.source: “Sealing that fellow,” Lumian replied calmly, his hands never ceasing their task.
unit.target: “Illum sigillandum,” respondit Lumian tranquille, manibus officium suum numquam desinentes.

unit.source: “Sealing?” Lugano nearly doubted his hearing.
unit.target: “Sigillandum?” Lugano paene auditu suo dubitavit.

unit.source: Isn’t this too absurd?
unit.target: Nonne hoc nimis absurdum est?

unit.source: Using food to seal a monster?
unit.target: Adhibere cibum ad monstrum sigillandum?

unit.source: He couldn’t recall ever encountering such a concept, not even in the most far-fetched novels on the market. No author would dream up such a peculiar method!
unit.target: Non recordabatur umquam talem notionem convenisse, ne quidem in remotissimis fabulis mercatus. Nullus auctor talem methodum insolitam fingere audiret!

unit.source: Wouldn’t a conventional seal involve the use of spiritually potent materials to inscribe mystical symbols and patterns, followed by ritualistic magic or the employment of a mystical artifact?
unit.target: Nonne sigillum ordinarium implicat usum materiis spiritualibus potentibus ad inscriptionem symbolorum et formarum mysticarum, deinde magiam ritualem aut usum artifacti mystici?

unit.source: What possible purpose could hurling food at the monster serve?
unit.target: Quid prodest cibum in monstrum iactare?

unit.source: Lumian smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Lumian subridens suspiravit.

unit.source: “Once he’s satiated, he won’t have any appetite left for you or anyone else here.
unit.target: “Postquam saturatus erit, amplius tibi aut cuiquam alii hic appetitus non erit.

unit.source: “And there’s enough food to keep him occupied until dawn, and possibly even beyond.”
unit.target: “Et satis cibi est, ut eum occupatum teneat usque ad auroram, fortasse etiam ultra.”

unit.source: Lumian had devised this plan upon realizing that Ludwig’s sole desire was to eat. Coupled with his behavior during the Dream Festival, Lumian was confident that Ludwig was now driven purely by his insatiable hunger—a unique trait exclusive to him in Tizamo.
unit.target: Lumian hanc consiliam excogitaverat, cum animadvertisset unicum desiderium Ludovigi esse edendi. His rebus coniunctis, Lumian confidens erat Ludwigum nunc solum insatiabili fame impellitum esse, proprietate unicam in Tizamo praeditum.

unit.source: In this scenario, as long as Ludwig’s appetite was sated, he could remain confined within the suite, feasting without posing a threat to others.
unit.target: In hoc casu, dummodo appetitus Ludovigi saturetur, intra cubiculum manere poterit, epulans sine aliorum periculo.

unit.source: What was the distinction between this and traditional sealing methods?
unit.target: Quid erat discrimen inter hoc et modos sigillandi tradicionales?

unit.source: Of course, the success of this makeshift seal depended on the Dream Festival concluding before Ludwig depleted the seven days’ worth of food.
unit.target: Certe, successus huius sigilli improvisi pendebat ex Festo Somniorum finem antecedente, antequam Ludwig rationes septem dierum cibi exhaureret.

unit.source: Otherwise, Lumian’s ability to hunt in the forest might not keep pace with Ludwig’s voracious appetite.
unit.target: Alioquin, facultas Lumiani in silva venandi non aequaret famem voracem Ludovigi.

unit.source: Lugano’s understanding dawned upon hearing Lumian’s explanation.
unit.target: Intellectus Lugani oriturus est, cum audivit enuntiata Lumiani.

unit.source: Indeed, this method offered a practical means of temporarily restraining Ludwig.
unit.target: Revera, haec methodus viam practicam praebuit ad Ludwigum temporarie coercendum.

unit.source: Who said it couldn’t be deemed a seal?
unit.target: Quis dixerit id non posse sigillum haberi?

unit.source: Understanding one’s target’s preferences and weaknesses allowed for the implementation of a seal without resorting to mysticism!
unit.target: Cognoscendo praeferentias et infirmitates obiecti, sigillum instituere licuit sine aditu ad mysticismos!

unit.source: Observing Ludwig still attempting to approach the door amidst his feast, Lumian realized the creature’s reluctance to part with Lugano. With a swift movement, he grasped Lugano’s shoulder and teleported them both to a corner of the second-floor stairwell in the police headquarters.
unit.target: Observans Ludwigum adhuc conari ad ostium accedere inter epulam suam, Lumian animadvertit creaturae reluctantiam a Lugano dimittendi. Celeriter motu, humerum Lugani cepit et eos ambo ad angulum scalae secundae in praesidio vigilum translocavit.

unit.source: Ludwig briefly glanced at the vacant doorway before refocusing on his culinary conquest within the suite.
unit.target: Ludwig breviter ad ostium vacuum intuebatur, deinde ad victoriam suam culinariam intra cubiculum rediit.

unit.source: “Are you certain everything’s under control?” Lugano inquired anxiously, the moment he exited the spirit world.
unit.target: “Esne certus omnia sub potestate esse?” quaesivit Lugano anxie, cum ex mundo spirituum egrediretur.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “As long as no Beyonder happens to stroll by the door, he won’t abandon his feast.”
unit.target: “Dummodo nemo Beyonder per ostium versetur, epulam suam non relinquet.”

unit.source: Relieved, Lugano exhaled deeply, casting a rueful glance at his remaining arm. Thoughts swirled in his mind as he contemplated his future.
unit.target: Levato animo, Lugano alte suspiravit, brachium reliquum suum maerens intuentem. Cogitationes per mentem eius gyrabant dum de futuro meditaret.

unit.source: At least I’m still alive. As long as I’m alive…
unit.target: Saltem adhuc vivus sum. Quamdiu vivo…

unit.source: In the future, 1’11 see if 1 can save up enough money to afford a mechanical arm from the Church of Steam. That might bolster my combat strength.
unit.target: In futuro, videam si satis pecuniae consertere possim ut brachium mechanicum ab Ecclesia Vaporis emere valeam. Id fortasse vim pugnandi meam augebit.

unit.source: The Doctor’s expertise could only do so much, as transplanting another’s limb was beyond the realm of possibility.
unit.target: Peritia Medici tantum in certa parte valebat, quia transplantatio alterius membrum extra fines possibilitatis erat.

unit.source: Camus and Rhea, observing Lugano’s bloody limb, furrowed their brows, recalling Louis Berry’s ominous warning of a greater issue.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea, membrum cruentum Lugani observantes, supercilia contraxerunt, recordantes monitionem Ludovici Berry de quaestione maiori.

unit.source: “What happened?” Camus inquired.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Camus.

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “It’s a complication caused by that big problem, but I’ve managed to seal it temporarily. Just remember, stay away from the Brieu Motel, especially the door on the second-floor suite.”
unit.target: “Complicatio est ex illa magna quaestione orta, sed eam temporarie sigillare potui. Memento: abstine a Brieu Motel, praesertim a porta cubiculi secundi.”

unit.source: Relieved to hear that Louis Berry had intervened, Camus assured Lugano,
unit.target: Levis animo, quod Louis Berry intercessisset, audito, Camus Lugano certiorem fecit,

unit.source: “Thankfully, it’s all just a dream. You’ll be fine once you wake up.”
unit.target: “Gratias Deo, omnia modo somnium sunt. Bene eris, cum expergisceris.”

unit.source: “A dream?” Lugano was perplexed.
unit.target: “Somnium?” inquit Lugano perplexus.

unit.source: Lumian offered no further explanation, simply remarking, “Indeed, it’s a dream. But remember, if you perish in the dream, you perish in reality too.”
unit.target: Lumian nullam ulteriorem explicationem attulit, sed simpliciter dixit, “Revera, somnium est. Sed memento, si in somnio peribis, in re ipsa peribis.”

unit.source: Amid Lugano’s bafflement, Lumian redirected said to Camus and Rhea, “Let’s make our way to Twanaku’s house now.”
unit.target: Inter perplexitatem Lugani, Lumian ad Camum et Rheam convertit et dixit, “Eamus nunc ad domum Twanaku.”

unit.source: His primary objective in investigating the Dream Festival was to locate Hisoka’s gold and the item acquired from the Nois family’s Demon. He intended to assess any changes in their respective locations following the festival’s commencement.
unit.target: Propositum principale eius in investigando Festo Somniorum fuit aurum Hisoka et rem ab Daemone familiae Nois adeptam invenire. Intendebat mutationes in locis eorum post initium festi aestimare.

unit.source: If nothing surfaced, Lumian planned to seek out Padre Cali at the Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Si nihil emergeret, Lumian statuit Padrem Cali in Cathedralia Sancti Sieni quaerere.

unit.source: The peculiar condition of “weakness in the depths of the Spirit Body” possessed by Padre Cali in reality set him apart from everyone else in Tizamo. This hinted at something distinctly special about the padre. Additionally, it was Padre Cali who had officially inaugurated the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Singularis condicio "infirmitatis in profundis Corporis Spirituali" qua Padre Cali re vera praedita erat, eum ab omnibus in Tizamo distinguebatur. Hoc aliquid vere singulare de patre insinuabat. Praeterea, Padrem Cali Festo Somniorum officialiter inauguravisse ostendit.

unit.source: Camus hesitated, his silence suggesting he might have pressing matters to attend to.
unit.target: Camus haesitavit, silentio suo insinuante se negotia urgetia habere.

unit.source: In that moment, Rhea regarded Lumian with confusion, gesturing towards Lugano.
unit.target: In illo momento, Rhea Lumian spectavit confusa, ad Lugano indicans.

unit.source: “Why is he still lucid?”
unit.target: “Cur adhuc lucidus est?”

unit.source: Chapter 674: Manor
unit.target: Capitulum 674: Mansio

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Upon hearing Rhea’s question, Lumian snapped to his senses and turned to Lugano.
unit.target: Audita quaestione Rheae, Lumian sensum celeriter restituit et ad Lugano conversus est.

unit.source: In his haste to save and “seal” Lugano, he had overlooked Lugano’s condition!
unit.target: In festinatione ut Lugano servaret atque "sigillaret", condicionem eius neglexerat!

unit.source: Ever since this Doctor had gotten his injuries under control, he had been responding to Lumian’s questions.
unit.target: Ex quo hic medicus vulnera sua temperaverat, quaestionibus Lumiani respondere solebat.

unit.source: He was lucid and rational, a stark contrast to the other participants in the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Erat lucidus et rationalis, contrarius prorsus aliis participantibus Festivalis Somniorum.

unit.source: It had to be known that even Ludwig, the monster himself, couldn’t effectively control his appetite and had resorted to devouring humans!
unit.target: Notum erat etiam Ludwig, ipse monstrum, appetitum suum regere non efficaciter posse et homines devorare coepisse!

unit.source: Moreover, Lugano had never slept in Hisoka’s house, nor had he entered this peculiar dream realm before!
unit.target: Porro, Lugano numquam in domo Hisoka dormivit, nec antea in hunc insolitum regnum somniorum ingressus est!

unit.source: Seeing Rhea, Camus, and his employer staring at him intently, Lugano, still grappling with the lingering pain, was utterly perplexed.
unit.target: Videns Rhea, Camus, et patronum suum eum adspicientes intentissime, Lugano—adhuc laborans sub dolore remanente—valde perplexus erat.

unit.source: “Why wouldn’t I be lucid?”
unit.target: „Cur non sim lucidus?“

unit.source: “Aren’t you all still in your right minds?”
unit.target: „Numquid non omnes adhuc in sano animo estis?“

unit.source: Everyone seems to be in the same state.
unit.target: Videtur omnes in eodem statu esse.

unit.source: Why should 1 be the only one with an issue?
unit.target: Cur solus ego problema habeam?

unit.source: Lumian carefully observed Lugano’s emotions and asked in a calm tone, “Have you ventured outside the motel recently?”
unit.target: Lumian diligenter animos Lugani observavit et leni voce interrogavit, „Num nuper extra motel profectus es?“

unit.source: “I did. I assisted Ludwig in purchasing roasted meat and pastries made from palm tree cores,” Lugano recalled.
unit.target: „Feci. Ludwig me adiuvit ad emptionem carnis assae atque placentarum ex medullis palmae,“ memoravit Lugano.

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens erat.

unit.source: “Did you sleep anywhere other than the motel?”
unit.target: „Num alibi quam in motel dormivisti?“

unit.source: No, I wouldn’t dare to engage with the women here.
unit.target: Non, non ausus sum cum his feminis hic agere.

unit.source: Lugano shook his head without hesitation.
unit.target: Lugano caput sine mora concussit.

unit.source: He was evidently a little regretful about this, as there were numerous mixed-blood girls in Tizamo who possessed a different allure compared to those in the Northern Continent.
unit.target: Manifestum erat eum aliquantulum paenitare, quod in Tizamo multae puellae mixti sanguinis erant, quarum decus ab iis in Continente Septentrionali diverso apparuerat.

unit.source: As the two men conversed, Camus and Rhea meticulously searched for any abnormalities in Lugano’s body.
unit.target: Dum duo viri colloquebantur, Camus et Rhea diligenter irregularitates in corpore Lugani quaerebant.

unit.source: However, apart from being sufficiently lucid and lacking excessive emotions and desires, Lugano appeared to be unaffected by the strange phenomenon.
unit.target: Sed, praeter id quod satis lucidus esset et nimis affectibus atque cupiditatibus careret, Lugano videbatur ab hoc insolito phaenomeno immunis esse.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Lugano with a thoughtful smile and said, “We’re being forced to participate in an event called the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Lumian super Lugano cogitantiulo subridens aspexit et dixit, „Coacti sumus ad eventum, Festivalis Somniorum, participandum.“

unit.source: Simply put, we’re dreaming.
unit.target: In summa, somniamus.

unit.source: We can do anything in this dream, but if we die here, we’ll die in reality too.
unit.target: Licet nobis quidquid in hoc somnio efficere, sed si hic pereamus, in re etiam pereamus.

unit.source: “Aside from us, everyone in Tizamo is under the influence of intense emotions and desires, just like Ludwig.
unit.target: „Praeter nos, omnes in Tizamo sub vehementibus affectibus atque cupiditatibus laborant, similiter ac Ludwig.

unit.source: They’re conscious—strictly speaking—but they’ve chosen to show their malice and express their long-suppressed desires.
unit.target: Illi conscii sunt—stricte locuto—sed malitiam suam ostendere atque desideria diu opprimenta exprimere voluerunt.

unit.source: If we can subdue them, we might be able to communicate, but they’ll instinctively try to deceive us.”
unit.target: Si eos subjicere possumus, forsitan communicare valeamus, sed instinctu nos decipere conabuntur.

unit.source: Remembering how the cafe owner, Bunia, had immediately changed his attitude after being targeted by her arrow and begged for mercy, Rhea agreed with Louis Berry’s judgment.
unit.target: Meminens quomodo cauponae dominus, Bunia, statim animum mutaverit postquam sagittam eius accepit atque veniam obsecraverit, Rhea iudicium Ludovici Berry approbavit.

unit.source: The Dream Festival participants weren’t stupid or crazy.
unit.target: Participes Festivalis Somniorum neque stulti erant neque insani.

unit.source: Their excessive desires and emotions were the main cause of their uncontrollable evil!
unit.target: Eorum cupiditates et affectus immodici erant causa principalis mali eorum incontrollabilis!

unit.source: “I see…” Lugano finally understood.
unit.target: „Intellego…“ denique intellexit Lugano.

unit.source: Realizing what Rhea’s question meant, he blurted out, “Why are we lucid and rational?”
unit.target: Cognoscens quid quaestio Rheae significaret, ille repente exclamavit, „Cur lucidi et rationales sumus?“

unit.source: After a pause, Lugano’s voice lowered as he added, “W-why can I stay lucid and rational?”
unit.target: Post paulum silentii, vox Lugani deminuta est, addens, „Cur possum me lucidum atque rationalem manere?“

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens erat.

unit.source: “We can stay lucid and rational because we entered this special dream before.
unit.target: „Lucidi atque rationales manere possumus, quia ante hunc somnium speciale ingressi sumus.

unit.source: We left marks and auras in certain places.
unit.target: In quibusdam locis vestigia atque auras reliquimus.

unit.source: “As for you, I’m not sure why.”
unit.target: „Quod ad te vero attinet, nescio cur.“

unit.source: As he spoke, he watched Lugano’s face closely, observing the change in his servant’s expression.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, vultum Lugani atente speculabatur, mutationem vultus servi observans.

unit.source: Lugano said in a daze, his voice tinged with fear, “I don’t know why this is happening either…”
unit.target: Lugano, stupefactus et voce metu tincta, dixit, „Nescio cur hoc quoque eveniat…“

unit.source: Noticing that Lugano remained calm even after his issue was brought to light, Lumian seized the chance to glimpse into his servant’s luck.
unit.target: Animadvertus quod Lugano, etiam postquam quaestio eius manifesta facta erat, tranquillum mansisset, Lumian occasionem cepit ut fortunam servi intueretur.

unit.source: Currently amidst a bloody calamity, Lugano might fall victim to an ailment in the coming days…
unit.target: Inter calamitatem sanguineam praesentem, Lugano fortasse in diebus venturis morbo victima fiet…

unit.source: The first part makes sense, considering Ludwig has just eaten half his arm.
unit.target: Pars prima intelligibilis est, cum Ludwig modo dimidium brachii eius edisset.

unit.source: But what does the second half imply?
unit.target: Sed quid secunda pars significat?

unit.source: Could the Dream Festival span several days?
unit.target: Poteritne Festum Somniorum per plures dies extendi?

unit.source: Impossible.
unit.target: Impossibile!

unit.source: If it truly lasted that long, Tizamo’s predicament would have been discovered much earlier…
unit.target: Si ita diu duraverit, casus Tizamo multo antea detectus fuisset…

unit.source: Does this suggest that Lugano would succumb to an illness during the Dream Festival itself?
unit.target: Num hoc significat Luganum in ipso Festo Somniorum morbo victum futurum esse?

unit.source: An illness similar to death in the waking world, one that wouldn’t be instantly cured even if he awakens and receives the Mass’s blessing?
unit.target: Morbus similis morti in mundo vigili, qui non statim curabitur, etiam si evigilaverit et benedictionem Missae acceperit?

unit.source: Lumian quietly pondered the meaning behind Lugano’s revealed fate.
unit.target: Lumian quiete de sensu fati Lugani revelati meditatus est.

unit.source: Shifting his gaze to Camus and Rhea, he realized that they, too, would soon face a grim and bloody ordeal.
unit.target: Converso vultu ad Camum et Rhea, animadvertit eos quoque mox ad asperum ac sanguineum periculum subire fore.

unit.source: If they failed to navigate it properly, they risked slipping further into peril.
unit.target: Si id recte non tractaverint, in periculum ulterius incidere poterant.

unit.source: As these thoughts swirled in Lumian’s mind, he turned to Camus and Rhea and declared, “I’m taking my servant with us.”
unit.target: Dum haec cogitationes in mente Lumiani volitabant, ille ad Camum atque Rhea conversus declaravit, „Servum meum nobiscum ducam.“

unit.source: It wasn’t an act of kindness or generosity.
unit.target: Non erat actus benignitatis aut liberalitatis.

unit.source: Rather, Lumian feared that leaving Lugano to his own devices, given his inexplicable lucidity and rationality, might trigger the abnormality within him and alter the course of the Dream Festival in unpredictable ways.
unit.target: Immo, Lumian timebat quod, relicto Lugano ad arbritrium suum, propter inexplicabilem eius luciditatem et rationem, an in eo non anomalia excitaret atque cursum Festivalis Somniorum in modis incertis mutaret.

unit.source: Better to keep him close at hand, where he could be monitored and any potential accidents prevented.
unit.target: Melius est eum prope tenere, ubi observari possit et casus potentiales prohiberi queant.

unit.source: If Lugano truly unleashed a dire problem, Lumian could always end his life first, eliminating any future complications.
unit.target: Si Lugano vere magnum malum efficeret, Lumian semper primo vitam eius finire posset, ut ullae complicationes futuras deleri queant.

unit.source: Camus and Rhea exchanged disgruntled glances before conceding, “It’s your call to make.”
unit.target: Camus et Rhea oculos inquinae inter se commutaverunt, deinde dixerunt, „Iudicium vestrum est.“

unit.source: “We must hurry to Twanaku’s house,” Lumian reiterated his earlier proposal.
unit.target: „Ad domum Twanaku properandum est,“ iteravit Lumian.

unit.source: Camus’s gaze drifted toward the cubicle where Kolobo lay hidden, a hint of hesitation in his voice as he asked, “Any idea where Captain Reaza and the others might be?”
unit.target: Aspectus Cami versus cellam ubi Kolobo latuit, cum leviter hesitans voce rogavit, „Quid vobis videtur, ubi Capitanus Reaza et ceteri sint?“

unit.source: “They were supposed to appear beside me when the Dream Festival began, but they were nowhere to be seen,” Lumian admitted, recounting the situation honestly.
unit.target: „Erat propositum eos mecum apparere, cum Festum Somniorum inciperet, sed nusquam apparebant,“ agnovit Lumian, rem sincere enarrantem.

unit.source: Perhaps the dream’s correspondence to reality was imperfect.
unit.target: Forsitan relatio somnii ad rem realem imperfecta erat.

unit.source: The location where each person entered this peculiar dreamscape might be influenced by factors like their understanding, the dream’s state, where they had slept, and myriad other variables.
unit.target: Locus, ubi quisque in hunc insolitum somnium ingressus est, variis factoribus—ut intellectu eorum, statu somnii, loco dormiendi, atque aliis multitudinibus—affici potest.

unit.source: Lumian mused that if he hadn’t maintained his lucidity and rationality, he might have awoken in the master bedroom of the Brieu Motel’s suite.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est, si lucidem rationem non servavisset, fortasse in cella principali suite Brieu Motel evigilavisset.

unit.source: “Should we try to locate them first?” Camus proposed, a note of uncertainty in his tone.
unit.target: „Eos primum localizare conemur?“ proposuit Camus, voce incerta.

unit.source: Lumian let out a wry chuckle.
unit.target: Lumian risum sardonice edidit.

unit.source: “Why? To engage them in combat?”
unit.target: „Cur? Ad eos in pugnam implicandos?“

unit.source: Neither Reaza nor Maslow had ever slept in Hisoka’s house before.
unit.target: Nec Reaza nec Maslow numquam ante in domo Hisoka dormiverunt.

unit.source: The likelihood of them lacking self‑control and succumbing to malice and base desires was high.
unit.target: Verisimilitudo eorum moderationem carere atque ad malitiam ac crudeles cupiditates succumbere alta erat.

unit.source: When the time came, Lumian might not possess the strength to control the pace and intensity of the battle against such formidable Beyonders as he did with ordinary folk, not without the risk of causing deaths.
unit.target: Cum tempus adveniret, Lumian fortasse vim non haberet ad regendum cursum atque ardorem pugnae contra talia formidabilia Beyonders, ut cum plebe ordinaria, nec sine periculo mortem efficiendi.

unit.source: Camus and Rhea lapsed into a simultaneous silence, neither keen on the prospect of a life‑and‑death struggle with their own teammates.
unit.target: Camus et Rhea simul silentium ceperunt, neque certamen inter vitam et mortem cum sociis suis appetentes.

unit.source: Just as Lumian was about to signal the two patrol team members to approach, Camus gritted his teeth as he declared, “There’s somewhere 1 need to go before I head to Twanaku’s house.”
unit.target: Mox, dum Lumian signum dare paratus esset ut duo milites advenirent, Camus dentes contraxit declamans, „Alibi mihi quid agendum est, antequam ad domum Twanaku ibo.“

unit.source: “And where might that be?” Lumian inquired, raising an eyebrow.
unit.target: „Et ubi hoc esse potest?“ inquisivit Lumian, supercilium leviter elevans.

unit.source: Camus replied in a deep voice, “Palm Manor.”
unit.target: Camus, voce profunda, respondit: „Mansio Palmae.“

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian risu exsolutus est.

unit.source: “You wish to rescue Miss Amandina?”
unit.target: „Visne Amandinam servare?“

unit.source: Camus nodded firmly, a hint of embarrassment tinging his features.
unit.target: Camus firmiter annuit, vultu modico pudoris tincto.

unit.source: “Yes, that’s right.”
unit.target: „Ita, recte.“

unit.source: “You needn’t worry.
unit.target: „Noli timere.

unit.source: This is merely a dream.
unit.target: Hoc solum somnium est.

unit.source: If one is violated within the dream, they’ll only experience a touch of hysteria upon waking.
unit.target: Si quis in somnio violatur, solum levem hysteriam post evigilandum experietur.

unit.source: No substantial harm will befall them,” Lumian stated matter‑of‑factly, his intention not to provoke Camus.
unit.target: „Nullum grave damnum illis continget,“ inquit Lumian, non Camum provocare volens.

unit.source: Camus’s expression remained unwavering.
unit.target: Vultus Camus constanter mansit.

unit.source: “I’m aware.
unit.target: „Scio.

unit.source: But I fear she may not be able to cope with it in her dream state and might resort to drastic measures.
unit.target: Sed timeo ne illa in statu somniorum id tolerare non possit et ad remedia extremas recurrat.

unit.source: It could lead to her demise.”
unit.target: Hoc ad exitium eius ducere posset.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Camus spoke gravely, “You can proceed to Twanaku’s house first.
unit.target: Non exspectans responsum Lumiani, Camus graviter dixit, „Primum ad domum Twanaku progredere potes.

unit.source: I’ll make my way to Palm Manor and rendezvous with you later.”
unit.target: Ego ad Mansionem Palmariam pergrediar et postea te conveniam.”

unit.source: “By the time you’re done, we might not be at Twanaku’s house anymore,” Rhea cautioned him.
unit.target: „Tempore quo finieris, fortasse iam non erimus in domo Twanaku,“ monuit Rhea.

unit.source: Camus nodded gently.
unit.target: Camus leniter annuit.

unit.source: “I’ve made this decision of my own accord.
unit.target: „Hanc iudicium ex voluntate mea cepi.

unit.source: I’m prepared to bear any consequences that may follow.”
unit.target: Paratus sum omnia consequentia ferre quae sequentur.

unit.source: Lumian locked eyes with Camus, remaining silent for a stretch.
unit.target: Lumian oculos cum Camus coniunxit et per aliquam temporis spatium siluit.

unit.source: Camus felt an indescribable pressure weighing upon him, his mind conjuring the tragic outcomes he might face, but he pursed his lips and refused to retract his suggestion.
unit.target: Camus sensit pressuram ineffabilem super se gravare, dum mens eius tragicis eventibus futuri in mentem evocabat; sed labra contraxit et suam propositionem revocare recusavit.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds of silence, his expression unchanged, Lumian finally spoke.
unit.target: Post plusquam decem secundis silentii, vultu immutato, Lumian denique locutus est.

unit.source: “Let us head to Palm Manor now.”
unit.target: „Eamus nunc ad Mansionem Palmariam.“

unit.source: “Huh? Before Camus could react, Lumian’s hand firmly grasped his shoulder.
unit.target: „Heu? Priusquam Camus reagere posset, manus Lumiani firmiter humerum eius occupavit.“

unit.source: “Simultaneously, Lumian’s other hand darted out, reaching for Rhea’s arm.”
unit.target: „Simul altera manus Lumiani subito se protulit, ad brachium Rhea tendens.“

unit.source: “Rhea’s instinctive reaction was to dodge, but the memory of how Lugano had been transported flashed through her mind.”
unit.target: Responsio instinctiva Rhea fuit ut evitare conaretur, sed memoria quomodo Lugano translatus esset per mentem eius subitaneum lucebat.

unit.source: Her tense shoulders relaxed a fraction.
unit.target: Umeri eius rigidi aliquanto levi facti sunt.

unit.source: “With Camus and Rhea securely in his grasp, Lumian shot Lugano a meaningful look.”
unit.target: „Cum Camus et Rhea secure in manu haberet, Lumian Lugano aspectum significantem dedit.“

unit.source: “Lugano, displaying a practiced ease, approached and latched onto a corner of Lumian’s vest.”
unit.target: „Lugano, solertia exercitata ostendens, accessit et ad angulum vestis Lumiani adheruit.“

unit.source: “In the next second, Lumian’s figure blurred, the haziness rapidly spreading to engulf Camus, Rhea, and Lugano.”
unit.target: „In secundo proximo, figura Lumiani confusa est, et nebulositas celeriter se disseminavit ad comprehendendos Camum, Rhea, et Lugano.“

unit.source: “As Rhea and Camus found themselves surrounded by layers of indescribable colors and formless objects, intense emotions surged within their hearts.”
unit.target: „Cum Rhea et Camus se circumdati reperirent ab stratis colorum ineffabilium atque rerum sine forma, affectus intensi in cordibus eorum eruperunt.“

unit.source: “Could this be the spirit world?”
unit.target: „Num hic mundus spirituum sit?“

unit.source: “Is this what teleportation feels like?”
unit.target: „Num hoc est teleportationis sensus?“

unit.source: “Was this how the great adventurer, Gehrman Sparrow, managed to appear before any pirate at a moment’s notice?”
unit.target: „Num hoc est, ut magnus explorator Gehrman Sparrow, ante quemlibet piratam in uno momento apparuerit?“

unit.source: “Having witnessed Louis Berry’s abrupt disappearance and subsequent return with his servant in tow, Camus and Rhea had speculated that this might be the famed teleportation ability that had become the stuff of legend across the Five Seas, thanks to Gehrman Sparrow’s extraordinary exploits.”
unit.target: Testes habentes disparitionem subitam Louis Berry atque eius reditum cum servo, Camus et Rhea coniectati sunt hanc esse famosam facultatem teleportationis, quae legendaria facta est per Quinque Marias, propter extraordinaria Gehrman Sparrow facta.

unit.source: “It seemed their suspicions had been right on the mark!”
unit.target: Videbatur eorum suspiciones recte perfixae esse!

unit.source: “Matani’s patrol team boasted numerous adventurers among its ranks, and Camus and Rhea were well‑versed in the myriad rumors that circulated the Five Seas.
unit.target: Manipulus praesidiarius Matani inter se multos viatores habebat, et Camus atque Rhea in innumeris rumoribus per Quinque Marias bene erant instructi.

unit.source: “The instant they experienced teleportation firsthand, their bodies departed the dream’s spirit world, rematerializing before a four‑story beige edifice.”
unit.target: Statim, teleportationem experirentur, corpora eorum e mundo spirituum somnii discesserunt, et ante aedificium quattuor tabulare coloris beige rematerializata sunt.

unit.source: “This was none other than the main building of Palm Manor.”
unit.target: Hoc fuit nihil aliud quam aedificium principale Mansionis Palmariae.

unit.source: “In the blink of an eye, Lumian, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano had reached their destination.”
unit.target: In ictu oculi, Lumian, Camus, Rhea, et Lugano ad finem suum pervenerunt.

unit.source: “The manor was awash with cries, screams, sinister laughter, and high‑pitched singing.”
unit.target: Mansio repleta erat clamoribus, stridoribus, risu sinistro, et cantu acuto.

unit.source: “Just over ten meters from the main building, near a garden shrubbery, a mixed‑blood lady’s maid lay pinned to the ground by a group of slaves, her clothes half‑stripped as she cried out in desperation.”
unit.target: Iamdudum, paulo ultra decem metra ab aedificio principali, prope fruticosam arborem horti, ancilla mixta sanguinis a coetu servorum in terram pressa iacebat, vestimenta eius dimidia eruta, dum desperatione clamabat.

unit.source: “She struggled with all her might, but how could she hope to resist the adult men?
unit.target: Omnibus viribus conata est, sed cur potuisset viris adultis obsistere?

unit.source: “She was utterly helpless, pinned down and at their mercy.”
unit.target: Illa omnino erat impotens, compressa atque in eorum misericordia relicta.

unit.source: “Witnessing this scene, the former Public Security Officer, Camus, instinctively yearned to intervene, but he quickly reminded himself that this was a dream.
unit.target: Testis hac scena, pristinus Officialis Securitatis Publicae, Camus instinctive intercedere cupivit, sed celeriter recordatus est hoc somnium esse.

unit.source: Such events wouldn’t truly impact reality.
unit.target: Talia eventa re vera realitatem non afficere possunt.

unit.source: At most, they would result in a certain degree of curable hysteria.
unit.target: Maxime, ad aliquam gradum hysteriae curabilis ducebantur.

unit.source: It would be a waste of time to stop it, audit would only serve to delay my search for Amandina.
unit.target: Tempus teritur, si id sistere conemur, quod tantum moram in inquisitione mea pro Amandina afferet.

unit.source: Moreover, it would be pointless…
unit.target: Porro, id erat vanum.

unit.source: Camus warned himself, forcibly averting his gaze as he ascended the steps into the main building.
unit.target: Camus se admonuit, oculos vehementer avertens, dum gradus ad aedificium principale ascendebat.

unit.source: “At that moment, Rhea, who had been silent for a couple of seconds, turned from facing the manor’s main building.”
unit.target: „Ad hoc tempus, Rhea, quae paucos secundos silentium tenebat, a parte aedificii principali manerii versa est.“

unit.source: “You guys head in first.”
unit.target: „Vos primum intrate.“

unit.source: With her back to Lumian, Camus, and Lugano, she spoke in a nonchalant tone.
unit.target: Dorso versus Lumian, Camus, atque Lugano, leni tono locuta est.

unit.source: Leaning forward slightly, she strode purposefully towards the bushes at the garden’s edge, making her way to the mixed‑blood lady’s maid who was being violated by the slaves.
unit.target: Levis paulo inclinata, iter certe profecta est ad fruticosas limites horti, ad ancillam mixta sanguinis, quae a servis violabatur.

unit.source: 675 Evil
unit.target: 675 Malum

unit.source: In a few swift strides, Rhea positioned herself behind the slaves, raised her right foot, and delivered a powerful kick.
unit.target: Paucis rapidis gradibus, Rhea se post servos constituit, pedem dextrum levavit, et validum calcitrum dedit.

unit.source: With a resounding bang, the slave pressing down on the mixed‐blood lady’s maid was sent flying, landing unceremoniously in the bushes at the garden’s edge.
unit.target: Fragore sonoro, servus qui ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti premebat, proiectus est et sine caerimoniis in fruticibus ad limitem horti cecidit.

unit.source: The other three abruptly turned to face Rhea.
unit.target: Tres reliqui subito se converterunt ad Rhea.

unit.source: Before they could get a clear look at their assailant, Rhea followed up with a fluid roundhouse kick, knocking another one to the ground.
unit.target: Antequam hostem suum clare conspexissent, Rhea calcitro circumacto fluido secundo ictu alterum in terram deiecit.

unit.source: The remaining two, torn between greed, desire, and fear, took one look at Rhea and turned tail, fleeing to another part of the manor.
unit.target: Reliqui duo, inter avaritiam, cupiditatem, et timorem divisi, unum intuitum in Rhea dederunt et celeriter confugerunt ad aliam partem villae.

unit.source: Rhea retracted her left foot and fixed a cold stare upon the two servants struggling to their feet.
unit.target: Rhea pedem sinistrum retrotraxit et frigidum aspectum duobus servis, qui ad surrectum conabantur, impositum habuit.

unit.source: She raised her hunting bow, nocking an arrow with a smooth, practiced motion.
unit.target: Arcum venatorium attollit et, motu leni atque exercitato, sagittam in funem inseruit.

unit.source: The two servants licked their lips in unison.
unit.target: Duo servi labia simul lambuerunt.

unit.source: Unwilling but fearful, they swiftly clambered over the bushes and vanished into the garden.
unit.target: Inviti sed timidi, celeriter super fruticos scandiderunt et in hortum evanuerunt.

unit.source: Only then did Rhea lower her gaze to the mixed‐blood lady’s maid, whose face was still streaked with tears and confusion.
unit.target: Tunc tantum Rhea oculos suos deiecit in ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti, cuius facies adhuc lacrimis et confusione tincta erat.

unit.source: “Are you all right?”
unit.target: “Esne bene?”

unit.source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid shook her head repeatedly.
unit.target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti caput iterum atque iterum concutiebat.

unit.source: With trembling hands, she hastily tidied her half‐torn dress and retrieved a dagger that had fallen beside her.
unit.target: Manibus tremulis, vestem dimidium laceratam festinanter retexuit et pugionem, qui ad eam caderat, arripuit.

unit.source: Seeing this, Rhea wasted no time.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Rhea nullum tempus perdidit.

unit.source: “Find a secluded corner and hide until dawn.”
unit.target: “Inveni angulum solitarium et absconde te usque ad auroram.”

unit.source: With that, Rhea pivoted on her heel and prepared to dash back to where Louis Berry, Camus, and the others stood waiting at the door of the manor’s main building.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Rhea in calcaneo vertit et se comparavit ad reditum celerem ad locum ubi Louis Berry, Camus, et ceteri ad ostium domus praecipuae villae exspectabant.

unit.source: As the mixed‐blood lady’s maid stood up, her expression darkened, and she raised the dagger clutched in her hand, plunging it towards Rhea’s back.
unit.target: Dum ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti surrexit, vultus eius obscuratus est, et pugionem, quam manu tenebat, in tergum Rheae immisit.

unit.source: Catching sight of the impending danger, Camus shouted, “Watch out!”
unit.target: Periculum imminentem conspecto, Camus exclamat: “Cave!”

unit.source: Though Rhea hadn’t sensed the approaching threat, she instinctively heeded Camus’s warning and reacted.
unit.target: Rhea, quamquam minam non sensit, instinctu Camus monitionem secuta est et actuata est.

unit.source: Surrendering to inertia, she fell forward and rolled to the side, narrowly evading the dagger’s deadly path.
unit.target: Sub imperio inertiae, prorsus cecidit et ad latus convoluta est, angustissime iter letale pugionis vitans.

unit.source: As she rolled, Rhea pivoted to face her attacker, eyes narrowing as she instinctively raised her bow, aiming at the mixed‐blood lady’s maid.
unit.target: Dum volvit, Rhea se convertere ad oppugnantem suum, oculis contrahentibus, instinctu arcum suum attoluit, ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti in scopum habens.

unit.source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid brandished her dagger, shouting in Intisian, her words laced with hatred, “Why can you join the patrol team, while I’m stuck as a mere lady’s maid? Don’t we both hail from the Southern Continent?”
unit.target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti pugionem extollens, Intisiano loquens, verbis odii infusis ait: “Cur tibi licet in cohortem speculatorum se coniungere, cum ego solum ancilla maneam? Nonne et uterque e Continente Australi orimur?”

unit.source: “Why? I even have Intisian blood coursing through my veins!”
unit.target: “Cur? Etiam sanguis Intisianus in venis meis fluit!”

unit.source: Before she could complete her tirade, a crimson Fire Raven, its hue bordering on white, swooped in from nowhere, colliding with the steel dagger.
unit.target: Antequam suam disceptationem complere posset, Corvus igniferus ruber, cuius color ad album quasi perveniebat, ex nusquam volavit et pugionem ex ferro concursans percussit.

unit.source: With a resounding clang, the dagger heated up, an explosive force wrenching it from the mixed‐blood lady’s maid’s grasp, sending it flying several meters before clattering to the ground.
unit.target: Fragore sonoro, pugio calefactus est; vis explosiva eum ex manu ancillae mulieris sanguine mixti eripuit, et per nonnullos metra volitantem ad terram cecidit.

unit.source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid faltered, fear supplanting the hatred in her eyes.
unit.target: Ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti vacillavit, metus odium in oculis eius subvertens.

unit.source: Lumian, his black hair and green eyes striking, stood on the steps of the manor’s main house, one hand casually tucked in his pocket.
unit.target: Lumian, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus eminenter fulgentibus, in gradibus domus principalis villae stetit, manum unam leviter in marsupio posuit.

unit.source: He called out, his voice carrying, “Where is Miss Amandina?”
unit.target: Clamavit, vocem suam proferens: “Ubi est Domina Amandina?”

unit.source: Uh… A pang of embarrassment struck Camus.
unit.target: Heu… Camus rubore affectus est.

unit.source: In his haste to rescue Miss Amandina, he had acted with a distinct lack of professionalism!
unit.target: In festinatione ut Domina Amandina servaret, egit cum manifesta carentia professionalitatis!

unit.source: He had been a guest at Palm Manor, but he had never been invited to visit Amandina’s room upstairs.
unit.target: Fuit hospes in Palm Manerio, sed numquam invitatus est ut conclave Amandinae in superiore videret.

unit.source: Consequently, he found himself unsure of which floor and room to search for her later.
unit.target: Consequenter, incertus fuit quo pavimento et conclave eam postea quaerendum esse eligeret.

unit.source: If he were to search floor by floor, he would undoubtedly encounter countless obstacles amidst the current chaos.
unit.target: Si pavimento per pavimentum quaereret, certe innumerabilia impedimenta in medio huius chaos occurrent.

unit.source: The mixed‐blood lady’s maid’s expression shifted, revealing a blatant desire and anticipation.
unit.target: Vultus ancillae mulieris sanguine mixti mutatus est, ostendens clarum desiderium ac exspectationem.

unit.source: “She’s sleeping in her room. Third floor, second room facing the rubber forest.”
unit.target: “Dormit in suo conclavi. Tertius tabulatum, secundus conclave ad silvam elasticam spectans.”

unit.source: “Make haste. She’s a vision of beauty, fragrant and pristine. Her figure is exquisite, her skin smooth as silk. She’s a cut above the rest of us. Many a gentleman considers her their dream lover. Go, quickly!”
unit.target: “Festina. Illa est visio pulchritudinis, fragrantia ac pristina. Figura eius exquisita est, et cutis eius lenis ut sericum. Illa prae ceteris excellit. Multi domini eam somnium amoris habere existimant. Vade, celeriter!”

unit.source: As she neared the end of her speech, the mixed‐blood lady’s maid gritted her teeth, her eyes alight with an illusory desire to witness something transpire.
unit.target: Dum ad finem orationis suae accedebat, ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti dentes strinxit, oculis ardentibus cum ficto desiderio aliquid evenire videre.

unit.source: Lugano’s hair stood on end, a chill running down his spine as he confronted the stark malevolence of human nature.
unit.target: Capilli Lugani erexerunt, et frigus per dorsum eius traiecit, dum adversam crudamque malitiam humanam opponebat.

unit.source: Plaudite! Plaudite! Plaudite! Lumian shook his head, a smile playing on his lips as he applauded.
unit.target: Plaudite! Plaudite! Plaudite! Lumian caput concussit, subrisu labris ludenti, plausum faciens.

unit.source: Rhea fell silent for a couple of seconds before rising to her feet and departing the area.
unit.target: Rhea paucos secundos silentium tulit, deinde surrexit et locum reliquum reliquit.

unit.source: After a few steps, she paused, turning to regard the mixed‐blood lady’s maid.
unit.target: Post paucos passus subsistebat et se convertit ad spectandam ancillam mulieris sanguine mixti.

unit.source: In a deep, solemn voice, she reiterated, “Find a secluded spot and hide until dawn.”
unit.target: Voce profunda et solenni iteravit: “Inveni locum solitarium et absconde te usque ad auroram.”

unit.source: With those parting words, Rhea turned away from the mixed‐blood lady’s maid and sprinted back to the steps at the main house’s entrance.
unit.target: His verbis valedictoriis, Rhea a ancilla mulieris sanguine mixti avertit se et celeriter regressa est ad gradus ad ostium domus principalis.

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze and led the way through the open brown door.
unit.target: Lumian oculos suos avertit et viam duxit per ianuam apertam fuscam.

unit.source: As he, Camus, and the others entered, they were greeted by a startling sight in the living room.
unit.target: Dum ille, Camus, et ceteri intrabant, spectaculum mirum in atrio eis apparuit.

unit.source: A middle‐aged woman in a disheveled nightgown, her half‐exposed body glistening with sweat and her black hair in disarray, sat astride a sturdy native slave.
unit.target: Mulier mediocri aetate, induta nocturnis vestimentis dissolutis, cuius corpus dimidio patefactum sudore micabat et capilli nigri in confusione erant, super firmum servum indigenam sedebat.

unit.source: Her movements were intense, and she appeared utterly immersed, alternating between shouting and cursing.
unit.target: Motus eius vehementes erant, et prorsus immersa apparuit, inter clamores et maledicta alternanter proferens.

unit.source: The native slave, clearly enjoying the experience, eagerly cooperated.
unit.target: Servus indigenus, qui experientiam manifeste fruebatur, vehementer cooperatus est.

unit.source: Near the staircase, a group of five or six servants and slaves, armed with an assortment of shotguns, rifles, and other weapons, intermittently fired bullets up the stairs.
unit.target: Prope scalas, coetus quinque vel sex ministrorum et servorum, variis armis ut sclopetis, tormentis, et aliis instructus, globos intermitte in scalas iecere.

unit.source: Occasional counterattacks emanated from the area leading to the second floor.
unit.target: Interdum impetūs adversarii ex regione quae ad secundum tabulatum ducebat procedebant.

unit.source: Camus stood frozen, his gaze fixed on the middle‐aged woman’s flushed face.
unit.target: Camus stetit immobilis, oculis in facie rubente mulieris mediocri aetate fixa.

unit.source: “You know her?” Lumian asked, a smile playing on his lips.
unit.target: «Notasne eam?» inquit Lumian, subrisu labris ludente.

unit.source: It was Rhea who replied, “She’s Sir Petit’s wife, Miss Amandina’s mother, Madam Simona.”
unit.target: Rhea respondit: “Illa est uxor Domini Petit, mater Dominae Amandinae, domina Simona.”

unit.source: “I never imagined she would be like this…” Camus said, his voice low and somber.
unit.target: «Numquam putavi eam talem esse…» inquit Camus, voce humili et lugubri.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and applauded once more.
unit.target: Lumian subrexit et iterum plausum fecit.

unit.source: “Can’t she indulge in her dreams?
unit.target: “Nonne potest illa somnia sua frui?”

unit.source: “For the Dream Festival, this is something we should encourage. No one is being forced. How delightfully harmless.”
unit.target: “Pro Festival Somniorum, hoc fovere debemus. Nemo cogitur; quam benignum et inermum est!”

unit.source: Camus found himself momentarily at a loss for words.
unit.target: Camus paulisper verba amittere sensit.

unit.source: Lumian then said to Rhea, “During the Dream Festival, there’s a high likelihood that the person you save will also be a bad person and may even attack you.”
unit.target: Lumian deinde Rhea dixit: “Per Festival Somniorum, magna probabilitas est ut persona quam servabis mala sit et fortasse te oppugnet.”

unit.source: Rhea fell silent for a few seconds before responding in a low voice, “Even if something like that happens again, I’ll still save her.”
unit.target: Rhea paulisper silentium tulit, deinde voce humili respondit: “Etiam, si simile iterum eveniat, eam servabo.”

unit.source: Lumian dropped the subject and shifted his attention to Camus.
unit.target: Lumian rem deposuit et animos suos in Camum vertit.

unit.source: “Are you prepared to see the other side of Miss Amandina? Perhaps she will…”
unit.target: «Paratusne es alteram partem Dominae Amandinae videre? Forsitan illa…»

unit.source: Lumian left the sentence unfinished, instead casting a meaningful glance at Madam Simona, who was in the throes of fierce, foul‐mouthed ecstasy.
unit.target: Lumian sententiam incomplete reliquit, et potius aspectum significativum in Domina Simonam dedit, quae in furori acerrimo et obsceno versabatur.

unit.source: Camus exhaled slowly, his voice resolute.
unit.target: Camus lente suspiravit, voce firmissima.

unit.source: “I’m here to save her. It doesn’t matter if she’s good or bad, kind, malicious, chaste, or indulgent.
unit.target: “Adsum ut eam servem. Non refert utrum bona sit an mala, benigna, maligna, casta aut indulgens.

unit.source: “After helping her find a safe hiding place and making sure she waits until dawn, we’ll head to Twanaku’s house.”
unit.target: “Postquam eam adiuvavimus ut locum securum inveniret et curavimus ut usque ad auroram remaneat, ad domum Twanaku properabimus.”

unit.source: I’m here to save her. It doesn’t matter if she’s good or bad, kind, malicious… Lumian quietly repeated the first half of the sentence, a smile playing on his lips as he regarded the servants and slaves attempting to occupy the staircase.
unit.target: “Adsum ut eam servem. Non refert utrum bona sit an mala, benigna aut maligna…”

unit.source: He raised his voice, asking, “Has anyone seen Miss Amandina? Has she come downstairs?”
unit.target: Vox suam attoluit, quaerens: “Num quis Dominae Amandinae vidit? Descenditne?”

unit.source: The servants and slaves turned their attention to Lumian and his companions, swiftly redirecting their firearms.
unit.target: Servi et ministri attentionem in Lumian et socios eius converterunt, et arma sua celeriter remutaverunt.

unit.source: Lumian calmly extended his right hand, making a grabbing motion.
unit.target: Lumian tranquillime dexteram manum extendit, eam arripiendi motu efferens.

unit.source: With this gesture, crimson flames, their hue bordering on white, ignited in the air, forming a curtain that Lumian seemed to snatch from the void.
unit.target: Hoc signo, flammas rubras, quarum color ad album quasi perveniebat, in aere accenderunt atque velut velum formaverunt, quod Lumian quasi e vacuitate rapere videbatur.

unit.source: With a deft grab and push, the fiery curtain abruptly split, transforming into Fire Birds that hurtled towards the shotguns, rifles, and revolvers before they could be properly aimed.
unit.target: Arte callida pugnomine et impetu, velum ignitum subito divisum est, in Aves Ignis convertendum, quae ad sclopetas, tormenta, et revolveros, antequam recte destinari possent, impetu incesserunt.

unit.source: Amidst a series of muffled explosions, the guns dropped from the servants’ and slaves’ hands, clattering to the ground, damaged beyond use.
unit.target: Inter seriem explosionum submurmurantium, arma ex manibus servorum ceciderunt, in terram stridentes, tam laesa ut ultra adhiberi non posset.

unit.source: The servants and slaves themselves suffered only minor burns, their grip on their weapons faltering.
unit.target: Servi et ministri soli parvas ustiones passi sunt, et tenacitas eorum in armis lapsa est.

unit.source: Since advancing to Reaper, Lumian’s mastery over flames had grown. Even without the Lie earring, he could achieve this level of control.
unit.target: Ex quo ad Reaper progressus est, dominantia Lumiani super flammas auxit; etiam sine “Lie” anulo, hunc gradum imperii assequi valerat.

unit.source: Moreover, he hadn’t unleashed his full power. He hadn’t even summoned the blazing white flames in order to minimize the damage.
unit.target: Praeterea, vim suam plenam nondum effudit; neque flammas albas ardentes evocavit, ut damnum minueret.

unit.source: “Now, can we have a civilized conversation?” Lumian smiled at the servants and slaves.
unit.target: “Nunc, possumusne colloqui more civili?” inquit Lumian, servos et ministros aspiciens, ridens.

unit.source: Behind him, crimson Fire Ravens, their color nearly white, materialized, poised to strike at a moment’s notice.
unit.target: Post eum, corvi ignifer rubri, quorum color quasi album videbatur, apparuerunt, parati ad impetum uno momento.

unit.source: An Intisian valet, who seemed to hold some influence among the group, couldn’t conceal his fear as he replied, “Amandina hasn’t come down. Otherwise…”
unit.target: Valet Intisianus, qui inter coetum aliquam auctoritatem habere videbatur, metum celare non potuit, respondens: “Amandina non descendit. Alioquin…”

unit.source: He couldn’t help but lick his lips.
unit.target: Non potuit quin labia lamberet.

unit.source: “And who were you shooting at?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: “Et ad quem iaciebas?” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: “It’s Petit, that bastard who deserves to rot in hell, and his butler, the one who’s always wielding that damn whip!”
unit.target: “Est Petit, ille scelestus, qui in inferno putredine meretur, et eius minister domesticus, qui semper flagrum istum gerit!”

unit.source: A dark‐skinned slave picked up the fallen firearm, only to discover that it was broken, just like everyone else’s.
unit.target: Servus obscura cute, telum lapsum arripuit, ut inveniret id fractum esse, sicut cetera.

unit.source: They had planned to retrieve more guns from another room on the first floor, but for now, they didn’t dare make a move.
unit.target: Plani erant plura arma ex alio conclave primi tabulati reportare, sed interim non audebant ullo motu agere.

unit.source: “Is that so?” Lumian nodded, a look of enlightenment crossing his features. “Carry on, then.”
unit.target: “Ita vero?” inquit Lumian, annuens, vultu illustrato. “Igitur pergite.”

unit.source: He turned around, leading the ten to twenty Fire Ravens that had gradually dispersed, and said to Camus and the others,
unit.target: Conversus est, ducens decem ad viginti Corvos Igniferos, qui paulatim dissersi erant, et ad Camum et ceteros dixit:

unit.source: “Let’s scale the side of the building to reach the third floor.”
unit.target: «Ascendamus latus aedificii ad tertium tabulatum pervenienda.»

unit.source: Teleportation wasn’t an optimal option at this distance, not after having used it four times already.
unit.target: Teleportatio optio optima non erat ad hanc distantiam, postquam iam quater usus erat.

unit.source: Of course, since advancing to Reaper, Lumian could now perform 11 to 12 Spirit World Traversals without relying on the spirituality accumulated through his Ascetic abilities. It was a marked improvement from his previous limitations.
unit.target: Certus est, ex quo ad Reaper progressus est, Lumian nunc undecim ad duodecim itinera per Mundi Spiritualem conficere poterat, sine fiducia in spiritu ex facultatibus asceticis acquisito; id evidens melioratio erat prae priore limitatione eius.

unit.source: Camus and the others raised no objections.
unit.target: Camus et ceteri nullas objectiones fecerunt.

unit.source: Lugano, however, trembled as he asked, “H-how am I supposed to climb?”
unit.target: Lugano, autem, tremens quaesivit: “Quomodo ascendere debeam?”

unit.source: He swung the stump that was all that remained of his right arm.
unit.target: Ille truncum, quod de brachio dextro eius solum superesset, verberavit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at him and said matter-of-factly, “Camus will assist you.”
unit.target: Lumian eum intuens inquit: “Camus tibi auxiliabitur.”

unit.source: Me? Camus was momentarily taken aback before assessing his own skills and concluding that it was indeed feasible.
unit.target: “Me?” Camus paulisper obstupefactus est, deinde facultates suas aestimans conclususque est hoc vere fieri posse.

unit.source: Before long, the four of them had ascended to the third floor, making use of the statues, decorations, metal pipes, and side balcony adorning the outer wall.
unit.target: Mox quattuor simul ad tertium tabulatum ascendere potuerunt, utens statuis, ornamentis, fistulis metallicis, et balcone laterali qui murum exterius ornabant.

unit.source: As soon as Camus pushed open the door leading to the corridor, he caught sight of a figure.
unit.target: Statim ut Camus ostium ad corridor aperuit, figuram deprehendit.

unit.source: It was Amandina’s personal maid, an Intisian lady’s maid clad in a white cloth nightgown.
unit.target: Illa erat ancilla privata Amandinae, ancilla Intisiana, in nocturnis vestimentis albis induta.

unit.source: At that moment, the young lady’s maid stood bathed in the dim moonlight, a bloody dagger clutched in her hand, her expression inscrutable.
unit.target: In illo momento, ancilla iuvenis sub obscura luce lunari stabat, pugionem sanguine tinctum in manu tenens, vultu arcano.

unit.source: Drip. Drip. The bright red blood from the dagger fell onto the corridor carpet, each drop a vivid splash of color.
unit.target: Gutta. Gutta. Sanguis ruber ex pugione in tapete corridoris cecidit, singula gutta vividum colorem effundens.

unit.source: Camus’s heart clenched.
unit.target: Cor Camus contraxum est.

unit.source: “What have you done?”
unit.target: “Quid egisti?”

unit.source: The lady’s maid’s face broke into a satisfied, carefree smile.
unit.target: Facies ancillae effusa est in risum laetum atque levem.

unit.source: “I killed it. I’ve been annoyed by it for far too long!”
unit.target: “Occidi id; nimis diu ab eo molestata sum!”

unit.source: It? In Intisian, “she” and “it” were two entirely different words.
unit.target: Id? In Intisiano, “illa” et “id” erant duo prorsus diversa verba.

unit.source: Amidst his surprise, Camus followed the trail of dripping blood, his gaze falling upon Amandina’s beloved pet dog, lying motionless at the door of the adjacent room.
unit.target: Inter stuporem suum, Camus vestigia sanguinis stillantis secutus est, et oculos suos ad canem carissimum Amandinae, qui immotus ad ostium cubiculi vicini iacebat, direxit.

unit.source: Phew… Camus breathed a sigh of relief before asking in a deep, serious voice, “Where’s Miss Amandina?”
unit.target: Phew… Camus lento suspiro levato, voce profunda et seria quaesivit: “Ubi est Domina Amandina?”

unit.source: The lady’s maid’s expression turned resentful.
unit.target: Vultus ancillae iracunditatem ostendit.

unit.source: “I’m looking for her too! She left an hour ago!”
unit.target: “Etiam quaero eam! Abiit abhinc horam!”

unit.source: An hour ago… Before the Dream Festival began?
unit.target: Abhinc horam… Ante incipiendum Festival Somniorum?

unit.source: Camus pressed further, “Where did she go?”
unit.target: Camus ulterius quaesivit: “Quo abiit?”

unit.source: The lady’s maid, still holding the blood‐stained dagger, replied with a contorted expression, “She went on a date with my Robert!”
unit.target: Ancilla, adhuc pugione sanguine maculato tenens, vultu contorto respondit: “Illam cum Roberto meo in colloquium ivisse!”

unit.source: Camus fell silent.
unit.target: Camus silentium ceperat.

unit.source: Lumian shook his head.
unit.target: Lumian caput concussit.

unit.source: Under the watchful eyes of the lady’s maid, who yearned to kill but felt outnumbered, he swiftly searched the entire third floor with Rhea and the others, but found no trace of Amandina.
unit.target: Sub oculis vigilibus ancillae, quae occidere cupiebat sed se minore numero sentiebat, celeriter totum tertium tabulatum cum Rhea et ceteris perquisivit, sed nullum vestigium Amandinae invenit.

unit.source: “Let’s go.” Lumian turned to Camus, his voice firm.
unit.target: “Eamus.” inquit Lumian ad Camum, voce firma.

unit.source: Camus had no choice but to concede defeat.
unit.target: Camus nullam aliam optionem habuit nisi cladem agnoscere.

unit.source: The four of them immediately teleported outside Hisoka’s house.
unit.target: Quattuor simul statim extra domum Hisoka teleportaverunt.

unit.source: Just as Lumian was about to proceed, he sensed something and looked up at the third floor.
unit.target: Modo dum Lumian procedere parabat, aliquid sensit et ad tertium tabulatum aspexit.

unit.source: A face appeared through the glass window of a room on the third floor.
unit.target: Vultus per fenestram vitrei conclavi in tertio tabulato apparuit.

unit.source: The face was graced with a high nose bridge, piercing blue eyes, and thick black hair tied into a simple knot atop her head. Her brows exuded a youthful, vibrant aura.
unit.target: Vultus ornatissimus habebat pontem nasi altum, oculos caeruleos acutos, et capillos nigerrimos crassos in nodo simplici in summitate capitis alligatos; supercilia ejus aerem iuvenilem et vibrantem praebebant.

unit.source: Amandina!
unit.target: Amandina!

unit.source: It was said that Amandina had gone on a date with her fiancé, Robert!
unit.target: Diceretur Amandinam cum sponsulo suo, Roberto, in colloquium ivisse!

unit.source: Chapter 676: You Intisians
unit.target: Capitulum 676: Vos, Intisiani

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpret: CKtalon

unit.source: Camus was stunned to find Amandina here.
unit.target: Camus obstupefactus est, cum Amandinam hic invenit.

unit.source: His astonishment far outweighed any joy he might have felt.
unit.target: Eius stupor longe superabat omne gaudium, quod sentire poterat.

unit.source: From the window above, Amandina noticed the four figures below.
unit.target: Ex fenestra superiori, Amandina quattuor figuras deorsum animadvertit.

unit.source: Her face twisted in alarm, and she disappeared into the house’s shadowy interior.
unit.target: Vultus eius in metu contortus est, et in obscuram interiorem domus evanuit.

unit.source: Taken aback, Camus called out, “Don’t be scared! We’re here to keep you safe!”
unit.target: Perturbatus, Camus exclamat: “Noli timere! Adsumus ut te tueamur!”

unit.source: While shouting, he raced up the stairs to the second floor of Twanaku’s residence.
unit.target: Clamans, scalas celeriter ascendit ad secundum tabulatum in domo Twanaku.

unit.source: His visit to Palm Manor had confirmed Louis Berry’s theory.
unit.target: Visitatio eius Palm Manor confirmavit theoriam Ludovici Berry.

unit.source: The Dream Festival participants had lost control of their actions, driven by hidden malevolence and desires.
unit.target: Participes Festi Somniorum, impulsī ex occultā malitiā et cupiditatibus, imperium actuum suorum amiserunt.

unit.source: Yet, their minds remained lucid, allowing for communication.
unit.target: Attamen mentes eorum lucidae manebant, permittens colloquia.
