unit.source: Camus couldn’t be sure if the possessed individuals would misinterpret others’ words.
unit.target: Camus certus esse non potuit an possessi homines verba aliorum maliter interpretarent.

unit.source: Furthermore, this wasn’t true clarity of thought.
unit.target: Praeterea, hoc non erat vera claritas cogitandi.

unit.source: They wouldn’t realize they were dreaming, and the experience would fade upon waking.
unit.target: Non noverent se somniare, et experientia cum evigilaverint evanescet.

unit.source: Thump! Thump! ‘Thump! Camus and Rhea charged into the building, taking the steps two at a time.
unit.target: Tum! Tum! Tum! Camus et Rhea in aedificium impetum fecerunt, gradus duos simul petentes.

unit.source: Behind the house, out of sight, a glass window set in wooden planks swung open.
unit.target: Post domum, extra conspectum, fenestra vitrea in tabulis ligneis posita oscillans aperiebatur.

unit.source: Amandina, clad in black hunting gear, nimbly climbed out.
unit.target: Amandina, induta vestimenta venatoria nigris, celeriter e fenestra evasit.

unit.source: She used the wall’s protrusions and crevices to swiftly descend to the ground.
unit.target: Uti murorum protuberantiis et fissuris, celeriter in terram descendit.

unit.source: As her feet touched the earth, she noticed a figure watching her from the side.
unit.target: Cum pedes eius terram tetigerent, animadvertit figuram ex latere eam spectantem.

unit.source: It was Lugano, his right arm ending in a bloody stump, his face marred with crimson stains.
unit.target: Erat Lugano, cuius dextrum brachium in truncum cruentum confectum erat, cuius facies cruentibus maculis lacerata erat.

unit.source: He looked a frightful mess.
unit.target: Videbatur terribilis.

unit.source: Amandina’s heart clenched.
unit.target: Cor Amandinae contraxit.

unit.source: She pressed her back against a pillar supporting Twanaku’s house, fists tightening as she shut her eyes.
unit.target: Dorsum suum columnae, quae domum Twanaku sustinebat, apposuit, et manibus stringens oculos clausit.

unit.source: In the same instant, Lugano’s eyelids drooped, his mind growing hazy.
unit.target: In eodem momento, palpebra Lugani deflexerunt, et mens eius obscurata est.

unit.source: He collapsed to the ground, falling into a deep sleep where he lay.
unit.target: In terram corruit, cadens in profundum somnum, in quo iacebat.

unit.source: Amandina’s eyes snapped open, no longer using her power to force the battle-worn man into slumber.
unit.target: Oculi Amandinae subito aperti sunt, neque iam vim suam ad virum certaminis laniatum in somnum coegendum adhibuit.

unit.source: Doing so would trap her in a profound sleep, able to act only in her Nightmare form, her body immobile.
unit.target: Id faciens eam in profundo somno inclusam teneret, ita ut solum in forma somniorum terribilium agere posset, dum corpus eius immobilis remaneret.

unit.source: And the man wasn’t alone!
unit.target: Et vir non solus erat!

unit.source: Before Lugano could wake naturally, Amandina turned to flee, seeking a safe haven to conceal herself.
unit.target: Antequam Lugano naturaliter evigilaret, Amandina fugere conversa est, quaerens refugium tutum ad se celandum.

unit.source: At that moment, she heard a smirking voice.
unit.target: In illo momento, vocem subridientem audivit.

unit.source: “So you’re a Beyonder too.”
unit.target: Ergo etiam tu Beyonder es.

unit.source: Amandina instinctively glanced over and saw the adventurer, Louis Berry, standing before another wooden pillar supporting Twanaku’s house, not far from her.
unit.target: Amandina instinctive suspicata, vidit Ludovicum Berry, adventatorem, stantem coram aliam columnam ligneam, quae domum Twanaku fovebat, non longe ab ea.

unit.source: The handsome Louis Berry, with his dark hair and emerald eyes, had one hand in his pocket as he leaned against the pillar.
unit.target: Pulcher Ludovicus Berry, cum capillis atris et oculis smaragdineis, manum unam in sinu habebat, dum ad columnam se inclinabat.

unit.source: His feet were crossed behind him, and his lips curled into a playful smile as he looked her way.
unit.target: Pedes eius post se transversi erant, et labia eius in risu iucundo incurvata erant, dum eam aspiceret.

unit.source: The dim crimson moonlight of the night lent him an air of enigmatic and sinister allure.
unit.target: Lunae lumen rubrum tenue noctis ei dedit aerem enigmaticum atque sinistrum.

unit.source: Amandina tightened her fists once more and closed her eyes.
unit.target: Amandina iterum pugnos contraxit atque oculos clausit.

unit.source: However, her spiritual senses told her that Louis Berry had vanished in an instant.
unit.target: Attamen sensus spirituales eius indicaverunt ei, quod Ludovicus Berry in momento evanuerat.

unit.source: She couldn’t find the target and couldn’t use her corresponding abilities.
unit.target: Non potuit destinatum invenire neque facultates congruentes adhibere.

unit.source: Moments later, Amandina, with her heightened spiritual perception, cast her gaze towards the shadows on the ground floor of the house.
unit.target: Momento post, Amandina, cum perceptione spirituali aucta, oculos suos in umbras in plano terraneo domus intendit.

unit.source: She sensed something stirring there.
unit.target: Aliquid ibi agitare sensit.

unit.source: At the same time, Amandina heard an illusory and ethereal voice.
unit.target: Eodem tempore, Amandina vocem illusoriam et aethericam audivit.

unit.source: “We mean you no harm.
unit.target: “Non tibi nocere intendimus.

unit.source: “We’re not affected by the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Festi Somniorum non nos afficit.”

unit.source: Amandina, who was about to use her spiritual perception to lock onto the formless presence in the shadow, was taken aback.
unit.target: Amandina, quae perceptionem spiritualem ad entitatem sine forma in umbra captandam uti vellebat, obstupefacta est.

unit.source: Just then, Camus and Rhea ran to the corresponding window and called out to Amandina,
unit.target: Statim Camus et Rhea ad eandem fenestram cucurrerunt et Amandinae vocaverunt,

unit.source: “We’re here to protect you!”
unit.target: “Adsumus ut te protegamus!”

unit.source: “We have enough self-control.”
unit.target: “Satis nobis est moderatio.”

unit.source: After assessing the number and strength of the two sides, Amandina asked skeptically, “Why aren’t you affected?”
unit.target: Postquam numerum et potentiam utriusque partis aestimaverat, Amandina sceptice rogavit: “Cur non afficimini?”

unit.source: As she spoke, she locked onto the formless entity in the shadow, believing it to be the strongest among the opposing group—the adventurer, Louis Berry.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, arripuit entitatem in umbra sine forma, credens eam potentissimam esse inter adversarios, id est adventatorem Ludovicum Berry.

unit.source: If she discovered anything amiss and something went awry, controlling Louis Berry first would effectively increase her chances of escape.
unit.target: Si quid inordinatum inveniret et aliquid male eveniret, primum Ludovicum Berry moderare casus eius evadendi efficaciter augeret.

unit.source: Lumian’s body emerged from the shadows.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani ex umbris emersit.

unit.source: He glanced at Lugano, who had regained consciousness and stood up, and inwardly praised Amandina’s keen spiritual perception.
unit.target: Animadvertit ad Luganon, qui conscientiam recepit et surrexit, et intime acutam Amandinae perceptionem spiritualem laudavit.

unit.source: Then, he smiled at Amandina and said, “Surely you’ve noticed that we’ve been entering and exiting this house frequently over the past few days?”
unit.target: Tum Amandinae subridens dixit: “Certe animadvertisti nos hanc domum per hos dies saepe intrasse et egressos esse?”

unit.source: “What about you? How are you able to maintain your normal self-control?”
unit.target: “Quid de te? Quomodo tuam normalem sui moderationem conservas?”

unit.source: Amandina glanced at the house beside her, no longer puzzled by Lumian and the others’ ability to remain lucid and rational.
unit.target: Amandina domum iuxta se aspexit, iam non admirata de potestate Lumiani et aliorum lucide ac rationabiliter manendi.

unit.source: She pursed her lips and said, “Robert took me on a date to Twanaku’s place. I spent half the night here.”
unit.target: Labris contrictis, dixit: “Robert me ad domum Twanaku duxit, et hic dimidiam noctem egit.”

unit.source: Camus’s heart ached as he blurted out, “Robert knows what’s special about this place?”
unit.target: Cor Camusi dolevit, dum exclamavit: “Robert novit quid hoc loco speciale sit?”

unit.source: Amandina nodded nimbly.
unit.target: Amandina celeriter annuit.

unit.source: “He knows the Dream Festival very well.”
unit.target: “Festum Somniorum eum valde bene novit.”

unit.source: “What’s his relationship with Twanaku?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
unit.target: “Quae est eius relatio cum Twanaku?” inquit Lumian, meditabunde.

unit.source: Amandina pondered for a moment.
unit.target: Amandina per momentum meditavit.

unit.source: “I don’t know. At the very least, I haven’t noticed any romantic tension between them or any interactions.”
unit.target: “Nescio. Saltem inter eos nullam tensionem romanticam aut interactiones animadverti.”

unit.source: What do you mean by romantic tension? Lumian didn’t directly inquire about Mr. Robert’s knowledge of the Dream Festival. Instead, he asked something else.
unit.target: “Quid significat ‘tensionem romanticam’?”—Lumian directe de scientia Domini Robert de Festum Somniorum non interrogavit. Proinde aliquid aliud rogavit.

unit.source: “Are you a Beyonder of the Evernight pathway?”
unit.target: “Esne Beyonder via Noctis Aeternae?”

unit.source: Amandina blinked and hesitantly said, “In a way…”
unit.target: Amandina micavit et dubiter inquit: “Quodammodo…”

unit.source: Upstairs, Camus inquired with concern, “Where did you obtain the potion formula and the corresponding ingredients?”
unit.target: In plano superiore, Camus sollicite rogavit: “Unde obtinuisti formulam potionis et ingredienta congruentia?”

unit.source: As they conversed, various movements and shouts echoed from the plantations outside the town and throughout the town.
unit.target: Dum colloquebantur, varia motus et clamores e agris extra oppidum et per totum oppidum resonabant.

unit.source: Amandina’s eyes darted around as she grinned and said, “Can I choose not to answer?”
unit.target: Amandina oculos circumspiciens, ridens dixit: “Possumne eligere non respondere?”

unit.source: “What do you think?” Lumian smiled at her.
unit.target: “Quid putas?” inquit Lumian, ad eam subridens.

unit.source: Amandina didn’t back down. She raised her head slightly and stared into Lumian’s eyes without flinching.
unit.target: Amandina non recedebat. Paululum caput elevavit et in oculos Lumiani fixiter intuens manebat.

unit.source: She noticed that his smile remained unchanged, and his emerald-green yet deep eyes remained emotionless.
unit.target: Animadvertit risus eius immutatus esse, et oculi eius virides smaragdineos, at profundi, sine affectu remansisse.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds, Amandina averted her gaze and tilted her head slightly.
unit.target: Post plus quam decem secundis, Amandina oculos avertit et paululum caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “I obtained it in this dream.”
unit.target: “Hanc in hoc somnio obtinui.”

unit.source: Camus, who was on the third floor, was taken aback. “You obtained it during the Dream Festival?”
unit.target: Camus, qui in tertio tabulato erat, obstupefactus est: “Hanc obtinuisti tempore Festi Somniorum?”

unit.source: He could understand obtaining a potion formula during the Dream Festival. While knowledge gains could be replicated in reality, could Beyonder ingredients used to concoct potions be brought from the dream to reality?
unit.target: Intelligere poterat formulam potionis tempore Festi Somniorum obtinuisse. Cum scientiae augmenta in re replicari possent, num ingredientia Beyonder, ad potiones concoquendas adhibita, ex somnio in rem transferi possent?

unit.source: Could it be that after consuming a potion during the Dream Festival, one could also remain a Beyonder upon waking?
unit.target: Num fieri posset ut, post potionem tempore Festi Somniorum consumptam, quis etiam Beyonder post evigilationem maneret?

unit.source: This subverted much of mysticism’s common sense!
unit.target: Hoc multum sensus communis mysticismi subvertit!

unit.source: Without waiting for Amandina’s confirmation, Camus thought of a possibility.
unit.target: Sine confirmationem Amandinae exspectans, Camus de possibilitate cogitavit.

unit.source: He immediately asked Amandina, “Are you a Beyonder only in this dream?”
unit.target: Statim Amandinae rogavit: “Esne Beyonder tantum in hoc somnio?”

unit.source: Amandina wanted to play dumb, but after glancing at Louis Berry, who was looking at her with a faint smile, she said gloomily, “It’s the same in reality, but I don’t have many chances to showcase it.”
unit.target: Amandina stultam se agere voluit, sed post prospectum Ludovici Berry, qui eam leviter subridente aspiciebat, tristiter dixit: “Idem est in re, sed pauca mihi sunt occasiones ut id exhibeam.”

unit.source: How is this possible? Camus gazed down at Amandina, suspecting that the mystical knowledge he had encountered since childhood was inaccurate.
unit.target: Quomodo hoc fieri potest? Camus in Amandinam deorsum intuens suspicatus est, quod scientas mystica, ab infantia percepta, esse erronea.

unit.source: He had considered the possibility that Amandina was lying, but he wasn’t willing to doubt this girl who held a special place in his heart.
unit.target: Possibilitatem consideraverat Amandinam mentiri, sed non voluit haec puella, quae locum specialem in corde eius occupabat, dubitare.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian spoke calmly to Amandina, his expression unperturbed, “You haven’t consumed a potion, have you?”
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian Amandinae tranquillime locutus est, vultu inmutato, “Non potuisti potionem consumere, nonne?”

unit.source: Amandina’s expression shifted slightly. She puffed up her cheeks and muttered, “Why are you still asking me if you already know…”
unit.target: Vultus Amandinae leviter mutatus est. Genas inflavit et submurmuravit: “Cur adhuc me interrogas, si iam scis…”

unit.source: “Haven’t consumed a potion?” Camus, Rhea, and Lugano were taken aback, but as they recalled their encounters, they gained a better understanding of Amandina’s situation.
unit.target: “Non potionem consumpsit?” Camus, Rhea, et Lugano obstupefacti erant, sed, recollectis suis congressionibus, melius de Amandinae condicione intellexerunt.

unit.source: “It’s indeed a boon, but I’m not sure how it was accomplished…” Lumian silently smiled as Camus nervously asked Amandina, “Which evil god deceived you?”
unit.target: “Vere beneficium est, sed nescio quomodo id confectum sit…” Lumian tacite subridens, dum Camus anxius Amandina interrogavit, “Qui deus malus te decipuit?”

unit.source: Amandina was bewildered. “Evil god? What evil god?”
unit.target: Amandina confusa est. “Deus malus? Quid deus malus?”

unit.source: Before Camus could explain, Lumian asked thoughtfully,
unit.target: Antequam Camus explicare posset, Lumian cogitans rogavit:

unit.source: “How did you obtain these supernatural abilities?”
unit.target: “Quomodo has facultates supernaturales obtinuisti?”

unit.source: Amandina scoffed.
unit.target: Amandina irriduit.

unit.source: “Why should I tell you?”
unit.target: “Cur tibi dicam?”

unit.source: In the next moment, she saw Louis Berry reveal a smile that inexplicably terrified her.
unit.target: In proximo momento, vidit Ludovicum Berry subridens, cuius risus inexplicabiliter eam terruit.

unit.source: “It’s—it’s Robert,” Amandina said with a shiver. “He took me into the forest outside and led me to a huge black stone. He asked me to place my hand on it.”
unit.target: “Est—est Robert,” Amandina, tremens, dixit. “Me in silvam extra duxit et ad magnam lapidem nigrum perduxit; imperavit ut manum super illud ponerem.”

unit.source: “And then you became a Beyonder?” Lugano interrupted Amandina with surprise and curiosity, failing to abide by his duty as a servant.
unit.target: “Et tum facta es Beyonder?” interpellavit Lugano Amandinam, stupore et curiositate affectus, officium servilis non observans.

unit.source: Amandina shook her head.
unit.target: Amandina caput quassavit.

unit.source: “Then I fell asleep—in the dream. When I woke up, I had superpowers.”
unit.target: “Tum obdormivi—in somnio. Cum evigilavi, facultates supernaturales habui.”

unit.source: “Is Robert also a Beyonder? Did he obtain his powers through the same method?” Camus pressed.
unit.target: “Estne etiam Robert Beyonder? Eadem via facultates suas adeptus est?” Camus percontatus est.

unit.source: Amandina let out a soft sigh and said, “He’s a Beyonder, but I don’t know if he obtained his abilities the same way. He brought me on a date here. Before entering this dream, he was already a Beyonder.”
unit.target: Amandina leniter suspiravit et dixit: “Robert Beyonder est, sed nescio utrum eadem via facultates suas adeptus sit. Me hic ad colloquium duxit; antequam in hoc somnio intraret, iam Beyonder erat.”

unit.source: Biack boulder… Lumian emerged from the ground floor of Hisoka’s house and asked Amandina with a smile, “Where’s Robert? He’s not having a date with you here?”
unit.target: “Biack boulder…” Lumian ex plano terraneo domus Hisoka emergens Amandinae subridens rogavit: “Ubi est Robert? Nonne hic tecum colloquium habet?”

unit.source: Amandina’s expression shifted between anger and amusement as she replied, “He wanted to visit his other lover before coming to me.”
unit.target: Vultus Amandinae inter iram et laetitiam mutatus est, cum respondit: “Voluit alteram amantem suam visitare, antequam ad me veniret.”

unit.source: “He has another lover? Who?” Camus asked, suddenly angry.
unit.target: “Habetne alteram amantem? Qui?” inquit Camus, subito iratus.

unit.source: Amandina’s eyes darted around, and she hesitated for a moment with a strange expression.
unit.target: Amandina oculos circumspiciens, et paulisper, vultu insolito, dubitavit.

unit.source: “Padre Cali.”
unit.target: “Padre Cali.”

unit.source: “Uh…”
unit.target: “Eh…”

unit.source: “Huh?” Camus, Rhea, and Lugano couldn’t help but exclaim in shock and confusion.
unit.target: “Heu?” Camus, Rhea, et Lugano, stupefacti et confusi, exclamaverunt.

unit.source: Even someone as well-read as Lumian couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows.
unit.target: Etiam Lumian, tam eruditus, supercilia levare non potuit.

unit.source: Amandina spread her hands and said, “He does like women, but he prefers men.”
unit.target: Amandina manus explicavit et dixit: “Mulieres amat, sed viros praeferit.”

unit.source: “He said he brought me into the dream to obtain superpowers because he felt guilty towards me. He was also grateful that I was willing to help him keep it a secret and not break off the engagement, continuing to go out with him, make out with him, protecting his image even after knowing his other side.”
unit.target: “Dixit se me in somnium duxisse ad facultates supernaturales obtinendas, quod culpa erga me eum opprimeret. Etiam gratias egit quod parata essem ei auxilium ferre, ut arcana retineret nec pactum dissolveret, sed cum eo pergere, eum osculari, eius imaginem protegere, etiam postquam alteram eius partem cognovisset.”

unit.source: At that moment, Camus and Rhea remained silent, but Lumian sensed the same meaning in their eyes.
unit.target: Eo tempore Camus et Rhea silentiam retinuere, sed Lumian in oculis eorum eundem sensum sentivit.

unit.source: You Intisians…
unit.target: Vos, Intisiani…

unit.source: Amused, Lumian asked Amandina, “And you can accept that?”
unit.target: Oblectatus, Lumian Amandinae rogavit: “Et id accipere potes?”

unit.source: Amandina pondered seriously. “Why not? As a marriage partner, Robert excels in status, wealth, strength, looks, and skills. In the Southern Continent, there aren’t many better choices. Besides, we did have a beautiful relationship. He does love me, but he also loves Padre Cali.”
unit.target: Amandina serio meditata est: “Cur non? Ut coniunx, Robert in dignitate, opibus, fortitudine, specie, et peritia praevalet. In Continente Meridionali non sunt multae optimae electiones. Praeterea, pulchram relationem habuimus. Me amat, sed etiam Padre Cali amat.”

unit.source: Amandina smiled at Lumian and said, “He also promised me more freedom.”
unit.target: Amandina Lumiani subridens dixit: “Praeterea mihi maiorem libertatem promisit.”

unit.source: Upon hearing Amandina’s response and looking at the youthful and beautiful girl, Camus, who was on the third floor, suddenly felt a pang of sorrow.
unit.target: Responsum Amandinae audito et puellam iuvenem ac pulchram observans, Camus, qui in tertio tabulato versabatur, subito dolorem sensit.

unit.source: A certain beauty in his heart shattered.
unit.target: Quidam decus in corde eius fractus est.

unit.source: Lumian glanced up at him and scoffed inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian in eum respexit et interiora risu subridens.

unit.source: Hadn’t he been mentally prepared to see the other side of Amandina? Amandina managed to express herself succinctly in a very self-controlled manner without demonstrating it.
unit.target: Num non iam praeparatus fuisset ad alteram Amandinae partem videndam? Amandina se breviter, et valde temperate, expressit, sine manifestando id.

unit.source: Perhaps Amandina had deliberately said so much in front of Camus to prevent him from loving her out of pity.
unit.target: Fortasse Amandina coram Camus deliberate tantum dixerat, ut eum, propter pietatem, eam amare prohiberet.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Amandina.
unit.target: Lumian ad Amandinam se vertit.

unit.source: “In other words, Robert is currently in Saint-Sien Cathedral?”
unit.target: “Alio modo, Robert nunc in Cathedrali Saint-Sien est?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Amandina nodded.
unit.target: “Ita.” Amandina annuit.

unit.source: Lumian tersely acknowledged her words and spoke in a commanding tone, “Then let’s pay him and Padre Cali a ‘visit..’”
unit.target: Lumian breviter verba eius agnovit et voce imperativa locutus est, “Ergo visitemus eum et Padre Cali.”

unit.source: 677 Last Year’s Dream Festival
unit.target: 677 Festum Somniorum Anni Praeteriti

unit.source: Amandina hesitated for a few seconds before saying, “You’ve already cornered me. What choice do I have?”
unit.target: Amandina paucos secundos dubitavit antequam dixerit: “Iam me in angulo reclusisti. Quid mihi restat?”

unit.source: Her eyes flickered with an inexplicable excitement and curiosity as she spoke.
unit.target: Oculi eius micaverunt inexplicabili alacritate et curiositate, dum loquebatur.

unit.source: Her words seemed to convey a different message: I didn’t want to.
unit.target: Verba eius alium nuntium exprimere videbantur: Nolui.

unit.source: I had no intention of doing so.
unit.target: Non intendebam id facere.

unit.source: You forced me to go to Saint-Sien Cathedral!
unit.target: Me ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien coegisti!

unit.source: Hurry, let’s go!
unit.target: Festina, eamus!

unit.source: Are you trying to “broaden your horizons?”
unit.target: An conaris horizontes tuos ampliare?

unit.source: Lumian criticized but didn’t expose her.
unit.target: Lumian reprehendit, sed eam non prodidit.

unit.source: He pointed at Hisoka’s house and said, “Before heading to Saint-Sien Cathedral, let’s check this place first.”
unit.target: Ille Hisokae domum indicavit et dixit: “Antequam ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien properemus, prius hunc locum inspiciamus.”

unit.source: Amandina tersely acknowledged his words.
unit.target: Amandina verbis eius breviter annuit.

unit.source: “Are you trying to find the source of its uniqueness?
unit.target: “An conaris fontem eius singularitatis invenire?

unit.source: Give up.
unit.target: Desine.

unit.source: I checked during the last Dream Festival and just now, but I found nothing.
unit.target: In ultimo Festo Somniorum Anni Praeteriti et nuper quaesivi, sed nihil inveni.

unit.source: As she spoke, she followed Lumian at a brisk pace, anticipating what this seemingly formidable adventurer would discover.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, secuta est Lumianum celeriter, exspectans quid iste videbatur formidolosus adventor detegere vellet.

unit.source: Lumian reached the second floor of Hisoka’s house, where Camus and Rhea were already waiting.
unit.target: Lumian ad secundum tabulatum domus Hisokae pervenit, ubi Camus et Rhea iam exspectabant.

unit.source: Surveying every corner, Lumian casually asked Amandina, “Are you familiar with Twanaku?”
unit.target: Omnia angulos inspiciens, Lumian leniter Amandinae quaesivit: “Num Twanaku tibi notus est?”

unit.source: Amandina wasn’t surprised by the question.
unit.target: Amandina hac quaestione non mirata est.

unit.source: Since she was searching for the source of the abnormality in Twanaku’s residence, she couldn’t avoid gaining a better understanding of his situation.
unit.target: Cum fontem anomaliae in domo Twanaku quaereret, vix impedita est melioris intelligentiae de eius re adipisci.

unit.source: She shook her head and said,
unit.target: Caput concussit et dixit,

unit.source: “I’m not familiar with him. I’ve only encountered him once or twice.
unit.target: “Non eum cognosco. Eum solum semel vel bis conveni.

unit.source: I was just a child when he lived in Tizamo.
unit.target: Parva eram, cum ille in Tizamo habitabat.

unit.source: Most of the time, I studied at the Iris Grammar School in Port Pylos.
unit.target: Plurimum tempore in Schola Iris Grammaticæ Portus Pylos studebam.

unit.source: Later, he only returned to Tizamo two or three times a year—spending a week each time.
unit.target: Postea, ille tantum bis vel ter in anno ad Tizamo redibat, et singulis occasionibus hebdomadam manebat.

unit.source: It was evident that Amandina had secretly learned about Twanaku.
unit.target: Manifestum erat Amandinam Twanaku occulte cognovisse.

unit.source: After all, she had only entered the special dream because she had slept in his house.
unit.target: Postremo, tantum somnium speciale intraverat, quia in domo eius dormiverat.

unit.source: She had even remained fully lucid during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Etiam in Festo Somniorum plene perspicua remansit.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian to ask a new question, Amandina glanced at him and added, “Twanaku returns every year for the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Sine mora ut Lumian novam quaestionem posset, Amandina eum intuita addidit: “Twanaku quotannis pro Festo Somniorum redit.”

unit.source: “Last year, during the Dream Festival, when Robert and I returned from the black stone, we noticed someone approaching.
unit.target: Anno praeterito, durante Festo Somniorum, cum Robertus et ego a lapide nigro redieremus, animadvertimus aliquem accedens.

unit.source: We hid behind giant trees on both sides of the path and saw that it was Twanaku.
unit.target: Nos post arbores gigantes in utris partibus semitae abscondimus et vidimus quod ille Twanaku esset.

unit.source: Twanaku is indeed connected to the black boulder.
unit.target: Twanaku re vera ad lapidem nigrum coniunctus est.

unit.source: There are even traces of him or marks formed by extreme emotions and desires there…
unit.target: Etiam vestigia eius aut signa ex extremis affectibus et cupiditatibus ibi formata sunt.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Camus, who was watching him and Amandina stroll around the second floor, and pondered for a moment.
unit.target: Lumian ad Camus se convertit, qui eum atque Amandinam circa secundum tabulatum ambulantes spectabat, et paulisper meditatus est.

unit.source: “Which month did Twanaku’s house burn down, killing all his family members?”
unit.target: “Quo mense domus Twanaku combusta est, interemit omnes membra familiae eius?”

unit.source: Without waiting for Camus’s response, Amandina exclaimed excitedly, “I know, I know!”
unit.target: Sine mora responsi a Camus, Amandina excitata exclamavit: “Scio, scio!”

unit.source: Yes, I’m asking you. Do you think I don’t know when Twanaku transmigrated?
unit.target: Ita, te interrogō. Pensesne me nescire, quando Twanaku transmigravit?

unit.source: Lumian smiled at Amandina, signaling her to respond.
unit.target: Lumian subridens Amandinae signavit, ut respondeat.

unit.source: He had a clear and detailed understanding of Twanaku’s matters on the surface. He had deliberately asked Camus to elicit Amandina’s answer.
unit.target: Clarissimam et accuratam notionem de rebus Twanaku habebat. Cautē Camum rogavit ut responsum Amandinae extraheretur.

unit.source: He wanted to see if she would lie and if she had any further information.
unit.target: Volebat videre num illa mentiret et num alias notitias haberet.

unit.source: Amandina said smugly, “Late December. It should be a few days after the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Amandina superbius dixit: “Decembri sero. Paucis diebus post Festo Somniorum esse debet.”

unit.source: As far as they knew, the Twanaku family likely perished during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Quam ad eorum scientiam pertinet, membra familiae Twanaku probabiliter in Festo Somniorum perierunt.

unit.source: Upon returning to reality, their fates began to unravel, and they were taken away by the fiery disaster.
unit.target: Cum ad rem realem redierunt, fata eorum explicari coeperunt, et ab calamitā ignitā rapti sunt.

unit.source: The question is, why did this house leave behind an abnormality?
unit.target: Quaestio est: cur haec domus abnormitatem reliquit?

unit.source: What happened to the Twanaku family back then, or what had they done?
unit.target: Quid acciderat familiae Twanaku tunc, aut quid fecerant?

unit.source: As the bestowed of the Inevitability domain, Lumian found a term that was very Inevitability‐like to summarize the phenomenon of those who died for various reasons in the next three months after dying in the Dream Festival and returning to reality.
unit.target: Ut electus dominii Inevitabilitatis, Lumian invenit vocabulum, vere inevitabile, ad phaenomenon eorum, qui variis causis in tribus mensibus sequentibus post mortem in Festo Somniorum ac reditionem in rem realem occiderunt, summatim describendum.

unit.source: Reining in fate!
unit.target: Fatum coerce!

unit.source: Of course, he couldn’t be certain that death in the Dream Festival would lead to death in reality.
unit.target: Scilicet, certus esse non poterat quin mors in Festo Somniorum in mortem in rem realem adduceret.

unit.source: However, judging from Amandina’s expression and tone, Lumian believed that she thought the same.
unit.target: Tamen, ex vultu et tono Amandinae iudicans, Lumian credidit eam idem putare.

unit.source: After searching the second floor and finding no differences from reality, Lumian ascended the stairs to the third floor.
unit.target: Postquam secundum tabulatum perquisivit et nullas differentias ab re reali invenit, Lumian scalas ascendit ad tertium tabulatum.

unit.source: Amandina followed closely, her excitement showing that she finally had a chance to do what a Beyonder should do.
unit.target: Amandina prope secuta est, eius excitatio demonstrans eam tandem occasionem habuisse id facere, quod Beyonder agere debet.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at her and casually asked, “What left an impression on you during last year’s Dream Festival?”
unit.target: Lumian eam intuens et leviter quaesivit: “Quid tibi in Festo Somniorum Anni Praeteriti impressionem reliquit?”

unit.source: Amandina’s excited expression darkened, as if she had been reminded of something unpleasant.
unit.target: Vultus Amandinae excitatus obscuratus est, quasi aliquid molestum recordata esset.

unit.source: She covered her mouth and nose.
unit.target: Os et nasum tegebat.

unit.source: After a few seconds, she said, “Robert and I discovered numerous cruelly murdered individuals in the town and various plantations. Their stomachs were ripped open, and their internal organs were removed. They wore pained expressions, as if they had been tortured to death…”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, dixit: “Robertus et ego deteximus multos homines crudeli caede trucidatos in oppido atque in variis plantationibus. Ventres eorum aperte lacerati sunt, et viscera eorum subtrahita sunt. Vultus eorum dolore pleni erant, quasi ad mortem tormentati essent…”

unit.source: “Serial Killer?” Camus, who had been listening intently to Louis Berry and Amandina’s conversation, blurted out.
unit.target: “Secutor serialis?” Camus, qui attente sermonem inter Louis Berry et Amandina audiebat, repente exclamavit.

unit.source: This reminded him of Twanaku.
unit.target: Hoc ei de Twanaku revocavit.

unit.source: Was this Desire Apostle venting his murderous desires during the Dream Festival to show restraint normally?
unit.target: Num hic Apostolus Desiderii in Festo Somniorum cupiditates homicidas effundebat, ut moderationem suam normalem ostenderet?

unit.source: So that’s how it is… Lumian roughly understood how Hisoka’s advancement ritual had been completed.
unit.target: Ita itur… Lumian paene intellexit quomodo ritu profectionis Hisokae peractum esset.

unit.source: Following the ritual, Hisoka had killed enough people in this realistic dream and devoured their internal organs.
unit.target: Ritu subsequente, Hisoka in hoc somnio reali satis homines interfecit atque viscera eorum devoravit.

unit.source: When he returned to reality, these people died one after another.
unit.target: Cum ad rem realem redierit, hi homines uno post alium perierunt.

unit.source: From fate’s perspective, they had indeed perished because of Hisoka’s murder.
unit.target: Ex prospectu fati, revera perierunt propter caedem Hisokae.

unit.source: This fulfilled the core requirements of the ritual.
unit.target: Hoc requisita cardinalia ritu explevit.

unit.source: Hisoka only needed to truly devour a portion of the victims’ internal organs before they were buried.
unit.target: Hisoka solum opus habebat, ut partem veram viscera victimarum, antequam sepelirentur, devoraret.

unit.source: He should be able to complete the ritual, consume the potion, and advance to Desire Apostle.
unit.target: Illo oportet posse ritum perficere, potionem consumere, et ad Apostolum Desiderii progredi.

unit.source: In reality, completing a series of murders and stealing a corpse’s internal organs were two entirely different matters!
unit.target: In re, seriem caedes perficere et viscera corporis mortui furrari duo prorsus diversa negotia erant!

unit.source: What puzzled Lumian was that according to Devilology, such an advancement ritual required a three‐day interval between killings.
unit.target: Quod Lumian mirabatur, erat quod secundum Devilologiam, talis ritus profectionis intervallum trium dierum inter caedes requirebat.

unit.source: Otherwise, it was easy to lose control.
unit.target: Alioquin, facile moderamen amittere liceret.

unit.source: The maximum interval couldn’t exceed nine days, or the ritual would reset.
unit.target: Intervallum maximum novem dies superare non poterat, alioquin ritus reinciperetur.

unit.source: Hisoka had clearly used the Dream Festival to complete all the killings in one night.
unit.target: Hisoka plane Festo Somniorum usus est, ut omnes caedes in una nocte perficeret.

unit.source: When he returned to reality and the primitive tribe attacked, all the “condemned” people died on the same day.
unit.target: Cum ad rem realem redierit et tribus primitiva aggressa est, omnes “damnati” homines eodem die perierunt.

unit.source: It didn’t drag on until the next month.
unit.target: Non protraxit usque ad mensem sequentem.

unit.source: Lumian believed that it was due to the April Fool’s prank.
unit.target: Lumian credidit hoc ob iocum Aprilis Stultorum fuisse.

unit.source: They had taken advantage of the chaos to send the deceased, whom the primitive tribe couldn’t eliminate in time, to hell.
unit.target: Ex tumultu profecti, defunctos, quos tribus primitiva tempore delere non poterat, ad inferos mittere constituerunt.

unit.source: This could be confirmed by the statements of the peripheral members of April Fool’s.
unit.target: Hoc poterat confirmari per enuntiationes membrorum exterorum Aprilis Stultorum.

unit.source: In other words, the interval of no more than nine days was satisfied, but Lumian didn’t know how Hisoka had achieved the criteria of exceeding three days.
unit.target: In aliis dictionibus, intervallum non ultra novem dies positum erat, sed Lumian nescius erat quomodo Hisoka condicionem trium dierum excedendi assequeretur.

unit.source: Had he used the dream’s uniqueness to avoid the three-day interval?
unit.target: Num somnii singularitate usus fuisset, ut intervallum trium dierum vitandum?

unit.source: When he killed someone in the dream, it hadn’t been reflected in reality, so he wouldn’t lose control so easily?
unit.target: Cum in somnio aliquem necavit, id in re reali non reflectum erat, quare non tam facile moderamen amitteret?

unit.source: As Lumian pondered Hisoka’s advancement ritual, he circled the rooms on the third floor.
unit.target: Dum Lumian de ritu profectionis Hisoka meditabat, cellas in tabulato tertio circumivit.

unit.source: After searching the room where Twanaku slept, he smiled at Amandina and said, “Apart from the serial murders, what else did you encounter?”
unit.target: Postquam cellam, in qua Twanaku dormiebat, perquisivit, et Amandinae subridens dixit: “Praeter caedes seriales, quid aliud inveneris?”

unit.source: Amandina pursed her lips and furrowed her brow.
unit.target: Amandina labra contraxit et superciliis incurvatis fuerunt.

unit.source: After a brief struggle, she grumbled, “If I cooperate, will I be awarded a medal when I return to reality?”
unit.target: Post brevissimam contentionem, murmuravit: “Si cooperaverim, mihi insigne tribuetur cum ad rem realem redierim?”

unit.source: Her father, Petit, had once received the Legion of Honor medal from Intis, so he was made a knight.
unit.target: Pater eius, Petit, olim medallionem Legionis Honoris ab Intis accepit, ideo miles factus est.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Amandina continued, “I also encountered a woman who seemed like a lunatic.”
unit.target: Nullo mora responsi Lumiani, Amandina continuavit: “Etiam mulierem occurri, quae quasi insana videbatur.”

unit.source: “Back then, I wanted to visit the Brieu Motel to see how the gentlemen and ladies hunting in Tizamo would react in such a dream. I was looking forward to seeing their other side.
unit.target: Tunc, volui Brieu Motel visitare, ut viderem quomodo domini et dominae, qui in Tizamo venabant, in tali somnio reagirent; exspectabam videre alteram partem eorum.

unit.source: “When I reached one of the rooms, I heard a few people singing a strange song.
unit.target: Cum in unam cellam perveni, paucos homines carmen insolitum canentes audivi.

unit.source: Then, the crazy woman appeared behind Robert and me. She remained lucid.
unit.target: Deinde, illa mulier insana post Robertum et me apparuit. Illa lucida manebat.

unit.source: “She was quite beautiful, but she was very crazy.
unit.target: Illa satis pulchra erat, sed valde insana.

unit.source: Back then, I was like a child with a new toy.
unit.target: Tunc, quasi puella eram cum novo ludo.

unit.source: I always wanted to test my abilities.
unit.target: Semper volui facultates meas probare.

unit.source: I felt that with Robert’s cooperation, I could easily deal with most Beyonders.
unit.target: Sensi, cum Roberti cooperatione, plerosque Beyonderes facile tractare posse.

unit.source: One controlled, and the other attacked.
unit.target: Unus moderabat, alter oppugnabatur.

unit.source: In the end… she captured the two of us.
unit.target: Denique, illa nos duos ceperat.

unit.source: Robert was knocked out, stripped naked, and hung from the bell tower with a bunch of mosquitoes released beside him.
unit.target: Robertus percussus est, nudatus, et ex turrim campanaria suspendus, cum multitudine culicum iuxta eum dimissa.

unit.source: I—I was hung in a cesspit, descending bit by bit…
unit.target: Ego in fossa suspendus sum, paulatim deorsum descendens…

unit.source: At this point, Amandina appeared on the verge of vomiting.
unit.target: Ad hoc punctum, Amandina paene vomere incipiebat.

unit.source: In Tizamo, other than the Brieu Motel, Saint-Sien Cathedral, the police headquarters, and a few other places, no one used a flush toilet.
unit.target: In Tizamo, praeter Brieu Motel, Cathedralem Sancti-Sien, praetorium vigilum, et paucis aliis locis, nemo latrinam aquam currentem utebatur.

unit.source: Camus couldn’t help but sympathize with Amandina as he imagined such a scene.
unit.target: Camus non potuit non miserari Amandinae, dum talem scaenam imaginabatur.

unit.source: Mad Lady? Were the ones singing the peripheral members of April Fool’s who participated in the Tizamo prank?
unit.target: Domina insana? Erantne illi, qui canebant, membra lateralia Aprilis Stultorum, qui in ioco Tizamo participaverunt?

unit.source: Lumian circled the third-floor rooms and smiled at Amandina.
unit.target: Lumian cellas tabulati tertii circumivit et Amandinae subridens aspexit.

unit.source: “And then?”
unit.target: “Et deinde?”

unit.source: Amandina took a deep breath and said, “She also asked me why I stayed lucid. After I told her about Robert and Padre Cali, she happily ran to Saint-Sien Cathedral and completely forgot about me. After that, I gradually escaped my predicament.”
unit.target: Amandina altum anhelitum cepit et dixit: “Etiam me quaesivit cur lucida remansissem. Postquam ei de Roberto et Padre Cali narravi, laeta ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien cucurrit et de me omnino oblita est. Postea, paulatim ex mea incommoditate evasi.”

unit.source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Let’s go to Saint-Sien Cathedral now.”
unit.target: Obsignans, Lumian respondit: “Eamus nunc ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien!”

unit.source: He planned to consider using the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth in Hisoka’s house in the dream after obtaining more information from Padre Cali and Robert.
unit.target: Cogitabat uti Speculis Insidiantibus Mysterii et Oculo Veritatis in domo Hisokae in somnio, postquam plura a Padre Cali et Roberto acceperat.

unit.source: “Alright.” Amandina tried her best to appear less eager, but she really wanted to see how Robert, her fiancé, interacted with Padre Cali.
unit.target: “Recte.” Amandina conata est se minus ardenter ostendere, sed vere cupiebat videre quomodo Robertus, sponsus eius, cum Padre Cali interagirent.

unit.source: The five of them left Hisoka’s house and hurried towards Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Quinque eorum domum Hisokae reliquerunt et festinanter versus Cathedralem Sancti-Sien accesserunt.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t use teleportation because he didn’t want to waste his spirituality.
unit.target: Lumian teleportationem non usus est, quia spiritualitatem suam non perdere volebat.

unit.source: He couldn’t carry anyone with him in his flaming spear form either.
unit.target: Nec quemquam secum portare poterat in forma hastae ignitae.

unit.source: Fortunately, Tizamo wasn’t large.
unit.target: Ex fortunā, Tizamo non ingens erat.

unit.source: They quickly followed the shadows by the roadside and returned to the intersection where the Brieu Motel stood amidst various cries.
unit.target: Velociter umbras iuxta viam secuti sunt et ad intersectionem redeuntem, ubi Brieu Motel inter varios clamores stabat, redierunt.

unit.source: Lumian pointed at the Brieu Motel and warned Amandina, "Don’t go to the second floor of the Brieu Motel. Trust me, it’ll be even more terrifying than what that crazy woman put you through."
unit.target: Lumian ad Brieu Motel indicavit et Amandina admonuit: “Noli in secundum tabulatum Brieu Motel ieris. Crede mihi, terribilius erit quam quod illa mulier insana tibi passa est.”

unit.source: Amandina’s eyes narrowed as she said, “Okay.”
unit.target: Amandina oculi adstricti sunt dum dixit: “Bene.”

unit.source: The five of them turned onto another street, passing through the Bunia café, the police headquarters, and a small square before arriving outside Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Quinque eorum in aliam viam conversi sunt, transeundo per Bunia café, praetorium vigilum, et parvum forum, antequam extra Cathedralem Sancti-Sien pervenerunt.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t in a hurry to enter. He circled to the side, pried open a stained-glass window, and peered inside.
unit.target: Lumian intrare non festinabat. Ad latus circumivit, fenestram vitream maculatam aperuit, et intus intuitus est.

unit.source: He and Amandina, who had gathered beside him, nearly went “blind.”
unit.target: Ille et Amandina, quae iuxta eum congregatae erant, paene caeci facti sunt.

unit.source: In the cathedral’s hall, a handful of naked men knelt before the Eternal Blazing Sun’s altar. They were all from the Northern Continent, including Amandina’s fiancé, Robert.
unit.target: In aula cathedralis, paucissimi viri nudi genu flexi erant coram altare Solis Aeterni Flammantis. Omnes ex Continente Septentrionali erant, inter quos Robertus, sponsus Amandinae.

unit.source: Padre Cali, also naked, paced back and forth between Robert and the others with an excited expression, reciting, “He walks in the light, He sheds warmth, He illuminates the world…”
unit.target: Padre Cali, quoque nudus, inter Robertum et ceteros forisque ambulabat, vultu excitato, recitans: “Ille in lumine ambulat, calorem diffundit, et mundum illuminat…”

unit.source: Chapter 678: Absurd Orgy
unit.target: Capitulum 678: Orgia Absurda

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpres: CKtalon

unit.source: Amandina scrutinized the naked preacher, Cali, from head to toe.
unit.target: Amandina praedicatorem nudum, Cali, a capite ad pedes perscrutavit.

unit.source: Her gaze eventually settled on Robert, her fiance, kneeling beside him.
unit.target: Aspectus eius tandem in Roberto, sponsulo suo, in genu flectente iuxta eum consedit.

unit.source: The lad with brownish-yellow hair, his skin pale-white as if he had not been exposed to the sun for a long time, had abandoned his usual cold demeanor.
unit.target: Puer, cui crines sunt flavo-brunnei, cutis pallide alba, quasi diutius solis fulgore caruisset, habitum suum frigidum consuetus reliquit.

unit.source: He was equally excited, but he controlled himself and patiently waited for the padre to complete his preaching.
unit.target: Eodem modo excitatus erat, sed se continuit et patienter exspectavit ut Padre praedicationem suam perficeret.

unit.source: The other naked men grew increasingly restless, gradually stirring.
unit.target: Alii viri nudi paulatim inquietiores fiebant et gradatim se movebant.

unit.source: However, it was evident that they held Padre Cali in high esteem.
unit.target: Sed manifeste patebat eos Padre Cali summo honore habere.

unit.source: Despite their disintegrating self-control, they refrained from directly initiating the orgy, only occasionally making small movements.
unit.target: Non obstante eorum moderatione dissoluta, directe orgiam inire abstinuerunt, tantum interdum parvos motus facientes.

unit.source: If God were watching, He would have incinerated all of them…
unit.target: Si Deus observasset, omnes illos combusisset…

unit.source: As a believer in the Eternal Blazing Sun, Amandina subconsciously wanted to kneel to the side and bow her head in repentance.
unit.target: Ut credens in Sole Aeterno Ardenti, Amandina subconscie voluit ad latus genu flectere et caput in paenitentia inclinare.

unit.source: What a blasphemous scene!
unit.target: Quam sacrilega spectaculum!

unit.source: Holding the open Sun Bible, Padre Cali continued to impart the teachings of the Eternal Blazing Sun to the naked men with an abnormally excited expression.
unit.target: Tenens Biblicam Solarem apertam, Padre Cali continuavit doctrinas Solis Aeterni Ardenti nudis viris cum expressione insolitam excitatae tradere.

unit.source: “God says, the sun shines justly upon everyone…”
unit.target: “Deus dicit: Sol aequo splendore super omnes luceat…”

unit.source: During the preaching, Padre Cali’s gaze frequently swept across Robert and the other purebreds of the Northern Continent, their faces, chests, and lower bodies.
unit.target: Durante praedicatione, oculus Padre Cali saepe transcurrit super Robertum et ceteros puri sanguinis ex Continenti Septentrionali, in vultibus, pectoribus, et inferioribus corporibus.

unit.source: His expression revealed uncontrollable satisfaction, pleasure, and enjoyment.
unit.target: Eius vultus patefecit laetitiam, voluptatem, et gaudium inexsuperabile.

unit.source: Lumian had always felt that he was well-read.
unit.target: Lumian semper existimavit se bene eruditum esse.

unit.source: In the past, he had disrupted the Church’s holy operations, but the scene before him still exceeded his imagination, leaving him momentarily dumbfounded.
unit.target: Olim sacras Ecclesiae operationes turbavit, sed scena ante eum eius imaginationem superabat, eum permomentaneam stupefactum relinquens.

unit.source: Are the padres of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church among the most “outstanding” Intisians?
unit.target: Num sacerdotes Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti inter egregios Intisianos existimantur?

unit.source: In an instant, information about Padre Cali and the observations of the past few days appeared in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: In momento, notitia de Padre Cali et observationes dierum nuperorum in mente Lumiani apparuerunt.

unit.source: He’s a native of Port Pylos, possessing pure West Balam bloodline and a lowly native of the Southern Continent.
unit.target: Ille indigena est Portus Pylosi, sanguinis West Balam purum gerens, et humilis indigena Continenti Meridionali.

unit.source: Starting as a cathedral servant, he had seized the opportunity to change his fate.
unit.target: Servus cathedralis initio factus, occasionem fatum suum mutandi arripuit.

unit.source: Subsequently, he had worked diligently and eventually became the padre of Tizamo Town.
unit.target: Postea diligenter operatus est et tandem factus est Padre oppidi Tizamo.

unit.source: He yearns for higher status and more recognition, especially from those hailing from the Northern Continent…
unit.target: Summam dignitatem et amplam recognitionem desiderat, praesertim a iis oriundis ex Continenti Septentrionali…

unit.source: Such long-standing desires have distorted the desires of Padre Cali.
unit.target: Talia diuturna desideria, desideria Padre Cali, deformaverunt.

unit.source: Is he secretly targeting men from various countries in the Northern Continent, attempting to subdue them and gain his sought‐after recognition?
unit.target: Num arcte, viris ex diversis regionibus Continenti Septentrionali, insidiatur, eos subigere atque agnitionem suam quaesitam adipisci conans?

unit.source: Robert and the others are clearly relatively young.
unit.target: Robert et ceteri plane iuvenes sunt.

unit.source: If Padre Cali had started doing such things a few years ago, they would still have been minors with immature minds.
unit.target: Si Padre Cali talia ante aliquot annos coepisset, adhuc minores cum mentibus immaturis fuissemus.

unit.source: Tsk, you padres…
unit.target: Tsk, o padres…

unit.source: As Lumian analyzed the current situation, he thought of his sister Aurore.
unit.target: Dum Lumian condicionem praesentem analyzabat, de sorore sua Aurore cogitavit.

unit.source: In Cordu, he had not liked entering the cathedral, attending Mass, or praying often.
unit.target: In Cordu, ei non placebat intrare in cathedralem, Missam adire, aut saepe precari.

unit.source: On the one hand, Aurore did not like it herself and set an example.
unit.target: Ex una parte, Aurore ipsa non hoc amabat atque exemplum praebebat.

unit.source: On the other hand, Aurore had always been worried that Lumian, who was only twelve or thirteen years old at the beginning, would be alone with the clergyman in the cathedral.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, Aurore semper sollicita erat ne Lumian, qui initio tantum duodecim vel tredecim annos natus esset, solus cum clerico in cathedralem esset.

unit.source: From time to time, she would use words like “Boys have to protect themselves” and “Many padres like boys.”
unit.target: Interdum verba utebatur ut “Pueri se ipsos protegere debent” et “Multi padres pueros amant.”

unit.source: Suppressing his sudden longing, Lumian looked at Padre Cali, who was still engrossed in his preaching.
unit.target: Subprimens repentinam desiderium, Lumian ad Padre Cali respexit, qui adhuc in sua praedicatione immeritus erat.

unit.source: The more he preached, the more excited he became.
unit.target: Quo magis praedicabat, eo magis excitabatur.

unit.source: Lumian felt that his analysis should be correct.
unit.target: Lumian sensit suam rationem esse rectam.

unit.source: A lengthy holy sermon before a male orgy was clearly not something an ordinary person could come up with and put into practice.
unit.target: Longe sermo sacer coram orgia virili plane non erat aliquid quod homo vulgaris excogitare et in praxi adhibere posset.

unit.source: It was abnormally absurd.
unit.target: Inordinanter absurdum erat.

unit.source: However, considering that Padre Cali yearned for the Northern Continent gentlemen’s recognition, especially given his identity as the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s padre, all of this became self-explanatory!
unit.target: Sed, quod Padre Cali agnitionem virorum Continenti Septentrionali, praesertim suae identitatis ut padre Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti, quaerebat, omnia haec se ipsa explanabant!

unit.source: Poor Eternal Blazing Sun and Saint Sien.
unit.target: Pauper Sol Aeternus Ardens et Sanctus Sien.

unit.source: They have become an important prop for Padre Cali’s performance art…
unit.target: Facti sunt munus grave artis scaenicae Padre Cali…

unit.source: Just as Lumian thought this, Padre Cali finally completed his “exciting” sermon.
unit.target: Iam ut Lumian hoc cogitaverat, Padre Cali demum suum sermonem “excitantem” complevit.

unit.source: He spread his arms and shouted, “Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: Bracchia extendit et exclamavit: “Laudate Solem!”

unit.source: Robert and the other lads, equally excited and naked, knelt on the ground, spread their arms, and sang in unison, “Praise the Sun! Praise His Grace!”
unit.target: Robert et ceteri iuvenes, aeque excitati et nudi, genu flecti ad terram, brachia porrigentes, uni voce cantaverunt: “Laudate Solem! Laudate Gratiam Eius!”

unit.source: The Sun does not wish to be praised by you… His Grace… Yes, it aligns with the aspirations of Padre Cali for higher status.
unit.target: Sol non vult a vobis laudari… Gratia Eius… Ita, congruens est cum cupiditatibus Padre Cali ad altiora statuta.

unit.source: In this male orgy, he made all participants view him as an archbishop and preached to them…
unit.target: In hac orgia virili omnes participes fecit eum reputari ut archiepiscopum et eis praedicavit…

unit.source: Finally, he would bestow the boon of God’s holy spirit on these people?
unit.target: Denique benedictionem Spiritus Sancti Dei his hominibus largiturus erat?

unit.source: Lumian seemed to be able to imagine the ensuing scene.
unit.target: Lumian videbatur sequentem scenam imaginari posse.

unit.source: Padre Cali turned around in satisfaction and solemnly placed the Bible back on the altar.
unit.target: Padre Cali se vertit ex satisfactione et sollemniter Bibliam ad altare reposuit.

unit.source: Then, he approached Robert, resembling an archbishop bestowing grace upon his believers.
unit.target: Deinde accessit ad Robertum, quasi archiepiscopus gratia fidelibus largiens.

unit.source: The other men tangled with each other.
unit.target: Ceteri viri inter se implicati sunt.

unit.source: Camus, Rhea, and Lugano, who were observing the cathedral through another stained-glass window, were equally stunned.
unit.target: Camus, Rhea, et Lugano, qui per aliam fenestram vitream cathedralem spectabant, aeque attoniti erant.

unit.source: In particular, Rhea felt as if her eyes, brain, and soul had been tainted despite all her tragic experiences.
unit.target: Praecipue, Rhea sensit quasi oculi, mens, et anima eius, non obstante omnibus tristicis experientiis, corrupti essent.

unit.source: Upon regaining her senses, Rhea’s anger surged.
unit.target: Cum sensus redintegratos, ira Rhea impetum sumpsit.

unit.source: Beside her, Lumian recalled a detail.
unit.target: A juxta eam, Lumian memor fuit quoddam.

unit.source: He lowered his voice and asked Amandina, “When did Robert become lovers with Padre Cali?”
unit.target: Vocem deminuit et Amandina rogavit: “Quando Robert et Padre Cali amatores facti sunt?”

unit.source: Amandina retracted her corrupted gaze and pondered for a moment.
unit.target: Amandina aspectum corruptum retractavit et paulisper meditata est.

unit.source: “More than a year after Padre Cali arrived in Tizamo, about three years ago.”
unit.target: “Plus quam annum postquam Padre Cali Tizamo pervenit, circiter tres annos abhinc.”

unit.source: Lumian frowned and asked, “Did they become lovers in reality, or during the Dream Festival?”
unit.target: Lumian corrupsit faciem et rogavit: “Facti sunt amatores re vera, an tempore Festival Somniorum?”

unit.source: “Of course in reality,” Amandina replied without hesitation.
unit.target: “Certe re vera,” respondit Amandina sine mora.

unit.source: Somethings off…
unit.target: Aliquid non est rectum…

unit.source: Padre Cali had been in Tizamo for over a year.
unit.target: Padre Cali plus quam annum in Tizamo mansit.

unit.source: He should have mellowed, turned restrained, and been devoid of excessive desires and emotions.
unit.target: Debuit remissi factus esse, moderatus, et carens cupiditatibus atque affectibus nimis intensis.

unit.source: Why was he still targeting Robert and the other lads?
unit.target: Cur tamen Robertum et ceteros iuvenes adhuc petebat?

unit.source: From the looks of it, there is something abnormal about Padre Cali, and this abnormality should have been related to the source of the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Ex specie videtur aliquid anomale de Padre Cali, et haec anomalia fonte Festival Somniorum coniuncta esse debuit.

unit.source: That is why he had declared its beginning…
unit.target: Ideo initium eius declaraverat…

unit.source: Just as Lumian thought this, he saw Rhea raise her bow angrily and aim it at the cathedral, where the scene was becoming increasingly unbearable and foul.
unit.target: Iam ut Lumian hoc cogitaverat, vidit Rhea arcum suum irata extollere et ad cathedralem destinare, ubi scena magis magisque intolerabilis et foeda fiebat.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, the energetic Padre Cali turned his body.
unit.target: Paene simul, Padre Cali, vigore repleto, corpus vertit.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian, with one hand in his pocket, saw the native padre with dark brown skin, sunken eyes, and thin black hair.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian, una manu in sinu, vidit patrem indigenum cum cute fusca, oculis depressis, et capillis tenuibus nigricantibus.

unit.source: His naked figure was reflected in Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Figura eius nuda in oculis Lumiani reflexa est.

unit.source: He felt a chilling aura emanating from Padre Cali’s body, attempting to completely freeze and replace his spirit.
unit.target: Sentivit frigidam auram e corpore Padre Cali emanare, quae conabatur totum spiritum eius congelare et substituere.

unit.source: Wraith Possession!
unit.target: Possessio Umbrae!

unit.source: So, Padre Cali possesses the ability to transform into a Wraith.
unit.target: Itaque, Padre Cali potestatem habet in umbram transformandi.

unit.source: It is no wonder that when I investigated his weaknesses, I realized that it only existed deep within the body, within the spirit…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod, cum eius infirmitates investigavi, cognovi ea solum in intimo corpore, in spiritu exsistere…

unit.source: Heh heh, a Wraith preaching in the Eternal Blazing Sun cathedral and under the sunlight…
unit.target: Hehe, umbra praedicans in cathedralem Solis Aeterni Ardenti et sub luce solari…

unit.source: Who would have thought such a thing would happen?
unit.target: Quis putaret talem rem futuram esse?

unit.source: Padre Cali’s Wraith powers definitely had not come from drinking potions.
unit.target: Certissime, vires umbrae Padre Cali non potione bibendo ortae sunt.

unit.source: They would definitely have been discovered and purified…
unit.target: Certe inventae et purgatae fuisse debuerunt…

unit.source: A boon?
unit.target: Munus?

unit.source: Lumian came to a realization.
unit.target: Lumian ad intellectionem pervenit.

unit.source: Relying on the strength of his Sequence 5 Spirit Body, Lumian struggled to wrestle control of his body from Padre Cali.
unit.target: Confidens in virtute Corporis Spiritus Ordinati V, Lumian contendit ut corpus suum a Padre Cali eriperet.

unit.source: He was not in a hurry to activate the Blood Emperor’s aura brand.
unit.target: Non festinavit ad activandum insigne aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis.

unit.source: Instead, he looked at Amandina and said with difficulty, word by word, “Let… me… and… Cali… enter a dream…”
unit.target: Pro eo, ad Amandinam respexit et vix, verba per verba, dixit: “Sinite… me… et… Cali… in somnium intrare…”

unit.source: Lumian knew that Amandina’s ability to forcefully pull people into a dream could only be used one-on-one.
unit.target: Lumian sciebat vires Amandinae ad homines in somnium trahendos tantum uno ad unum adhiberi posse.

unit.source: However, Padre Cali was currently attached to him and entangled with his Spirit Body.
unit.target: Sed, Padre Cali nunc ad eum affixus erat et cum corpore spirituali eius implicatus.

unit.source: Perhaps she could treat them as a unit.
unit.target: Fortasse illa eos tamquam unam copulam tractare posset.

unit.source: As for whether Wraiths dreamed, Lumian did not know for now.
unit.target: Quoad an umbrae somniarent, Lumian pro hac causa nesciebat.

unit.source: After all, he still had a backup plan.
unit.target: Postremo, adhuc consilium praevium habebat.

unit.source: With a resounding crash, Rhea’s arrow shattered the stained-glass window, sending shards crashing to the ground.
unit.target: Cum fragore tonitruoso, sagitta Rhea fenestram vitream confractus est, fragmenta in terram iactans.

unit.source: The arrow, entwined with silver-white lightning, crossed a distance of more than ten meters, pierced the location where Padre Cali had been, and nailed it to the wooden table with the candlestick.
unit.target: Sagitta, fulmine argenteo-albo involuta, spatium plus quam decem metrarum transiit, locum ubi Padre Cali fuisset perforavit, et in mensa lignea cum candelabro infixa est.

unit.source: Amidst crackling lightning, the long wooden table shattered and collapsed to the ground, sending burning candles tumbling in all directions.
unit.target: Inter scintillantia fulgura, longa mensa lignea confracta est et in terram corruit, candelabra ardentia in omnes partes volventa.

unit.source: Robert, clearly taken aback by the sudden departure of Padre Cali, reacted.
unit.target: Robert, plane stupefactus propter repentinam discessionem Padre Cali, respondit.

unit.source: He opened his mouth and uttered strange words in a strange language.
unit.target: Os aperuit et verba insolita in lingua ignota edixit.

unit.source: Coo!
unit.target: Coo!

unit.source: Ns if a cold wind from the Feysac Empire’s extreme north blew, a blurry, strange, and inhuman figure materialized out of thin air and burrowed into Robert’s body.
unit.target: Si ventus frigidus ex extremo septentrione Imperii Feysac flat, figura confusa, insolita et inhumana ex nihilo apparuit atque in corpus Roberti insediavit.

unit.source: A layer of armor-like ice materialized on Robert’s body, and a colossal, sharp, and crystalline frost scythe materialized in his hand.
unit.target: Stratum glacie instar armatura in corpore Roberti apparuit, et falx glaciei, ingens, acuta, et crystallina in manu eius manifesta est.

unit.source: Clutching the massive scythe, Robert sprinted toward Rhea, Camus, and the others.
unit.target: Manu falx ingenti complectens, Robert ad Rhea, Camus et ceteros celeriter accurrit.

unit.source: Wherever he passed, the ground froze, and icicles materialized on the walls.
unit.target: Ubicumque transibat, terra congelabatur, et in parietibus glaciei spicula formabantur.

unit.source: On the fourth floor of the Brieu Motel, in a room near the intersection, two figures emerged from behind the curtains as Lumian and his companions made their way to the street where Saint-Sien Cathedral stood.
unit.target: In quarto tabulato Brieu Motel, in conclavi prope angulum, duo figurae e post cortinas eminuerunt, dum Lumian et comites eius viam faciebant ad viam ubi Cathedralis Sancti Sien stabat.

unit.source: One of them was a man with distinct Northern Continent features.
unit.target: Unus ex illis vir erat, cui notas ex Continenti Septentrionali distinctas habebat.

unit.source: His dark-green eyes stood out against his dark gray formal suit and black silk top hat.
unit.target: Oculi eius virides obscuri in veste formali griseo obscuro et pileo serico nigro eminuerunt.

unit.source: The other was a woman with delicate skin, exquisite facial features, and deep blue eyes.
unit.target: Alter erat femina cum cute delicata, lineamentis vultus exquisitis, et oculis caeruleis profundis.

unit.source: She wore a light-colored dress that allowed for easy movement and a feathered hat adorned with pearls.
unit.target: Gestabat vestem pallidam, quae facilem motum permittebat, et pileum pennatum gemmis ornatum.

unit.source: They were the couple Lumian had seen moving into the Brieu Motel late at night.
unit.target: Eram par quem Lumian vidit sero nocte in Brieu Motel ingredi.

unit.source: They had arrived in Tizamo a mere ten minutes before the official Dream Festival began.
unit.target: Ad Tizamo pervenerant tantum decem minuta ante initium Festival Somniorum officialium.

unit.source: At that moment, the man and woman’s eyes were clear, devoid of any excessive emotions or actions.
unit.target: Illo momento, oculi viri et feminae claros erant, carentes omni nimia affectu aut actu.

unit.source: “The patrol team’s sudden arrival in Tizamo is indeed because they discovered the problem here,” the beautiful woman said in a deep voice, gazing out the window at the street below.
unit.target: “Repentina adventus turmae speculatorum in Tizamo re vera quia hic quaestionem invenerunt,” dixit femina formosa voce profunda, per fenestram in viam deorsum contemplans.

unit.source: “From the looks of it, they’ve also found a way to remain lucid and rational in this special dream.”
unit.target: “Ex specie videtur, etiam viam invenisse ut in hoc somnio speciali lucidi et rati maneant.”

unit.source: The man’s expression was cold as he nodded slightly and said, “But they don’t know much yet.
unit.target: Vultus viri frigidus erat dum leviter annuens dixit: “Sed adhuc parum scientes sunt.

unit.source: They’re moving in the wrong direction.”
unit.target: “In directione errata se movere vident.”

unit.source: “Let’s get moving.”
unit.target: “Eamus.”

unit.source: The woman in the feathered hat led the way to the door.
unit.target: Femina pileo pennato viam ad ostium duxit.

unit.source: The two of them descended the stairs swiftly, one after the other.
unit.target: Ambo celeriter de scalis descendere coeperunt, uno post alium.

unit.source: As they passed the second floor, the woman in the light-colored dress suddenly stopped and whispered, “Do you hear something strange?”
unit.target: Dum secundum tabulatum transirebant, femina in veste pallida subito cessavit et susurravit: “Audisne aliquid insolitum?”

unit.source: The man in the half top hat listened intently for a few seconds before hearing faint chewing sounds coming from a room deep on the second floor.
unit.target: Vir cum pileo dimidio attente auscultavit aliquot secundis antequam tenues sonos masticandi ex conclavi profunde in secundo tabulato audiret.

unit.source: The sound persisted without pause..
unit.target: Sonus sine intermissione perseveravit.

unit.source: 679 Spirit Medium
unit.target: 679 Medium Spiritus

unit.source: Seeing Robert, clad in ice armor and dragging a frost scythe, sprinting towards the stained‐glass window facing him, Rhea, and Lugano, Camus immediately drew his custom‐made revolver and aimed it ahead.
unit.target: Cum Robertum videret, indutum lorica glaciali et falcem glacialem trahebantem, festinanter currentem versus vitrum pictum, quod ad eum, Rheam, et Lugano spectabat, Camus statim revolverum suum proprium confectum extraxit atque ante se destinavit.

unit.source: At that moment, his feet turned cold, and his body froze, causing his joints to become sluggish and his wrists to tremble.
unit.target: Illo momento, pedes eius frigidi facti sunt et corpus eius congelatum est, quae effecit ut articulationes eius inertes fierent et carpi tremarent.

unit.source: From the corner of his eye, Camus observed that although Robert hadn’t truly approached, the frost on the ground and the icicles on the wall had already reached him.
unit.target: Ex angulo oculi sui, Camus animadvertit quod, quamquam Robertus re vera non accessisset, glacies in solo et spicula glaciei super parietem iam ad eum pervenerant.

unit.source: Within a radius of ten to twenty meters, the chill intensified, resembling the extreme north.
unit.target: In radio decem ad viginti metrorum, frigus intensum factum est, instar septentrionis extremi apparens.

unit.source: With a swoosh, Rhea shot another arrow entwined with silver lightning.
unit.target: Cum sonitu, Rhea aliam sagittam iaculata est, quae fulgore argenteo involuta erat.

unit.source: Robert didn’t dodge or evade.
unit.target: Robertus neque declinavit neque evasit.

unit.source: Exerting strength in his arms, he swung the frosty scythe forward.
unit.target: Fortitudinem in brachiis adhibens, falcem glacialem in antea propulit.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: The scythe knocked away the arrow, leaving behind a small amount of lightning that raced towards Robert’s body.
unit.target: Falx sagittam aberavit, relinquens parvam quantitatem fulgoris quae ad corpus Roberti properabat.

unit.source: Amidst the sizzling sounds, Robert felt numb for a moment before continuing to sprint towards Rhea and the others.
unit.target: Inter sonos crepitantes, Robertus per momentum se insensibilem sensit, antequam currere versus Rheam et reliquos perseveraret.

unit.source: Camus was taken aback.
unit.target: Camus stupefactus est.

unit.source: He wasn’t surprised that Robert could control the frost scythe so effortlessly and create a considerable frozen domain.
unit.target: Non miratus est quod Robertus falcem glacialem tam facile moderari posset atque spatium congelatum ingens creare.

unit.source: Instead, he was surprised that Robert had rushed up to him and was about to enter a five‐meter range.
unit.target: Sed potius stupuit quod Robertus ad eum festinanter accessisset et intra spatium quinque metrorum imminere pararet.

unit.source: Doesn’t he know about my Psychic Piercing ability?
unit.target: Nonne novit de facultate mea perforationis psychicae?

unit.source: Doesn’t he realize that Psychic Piercing’s effective range is five meters?
unit.target: Nonne intellegit quod radius perforationis psychicae efficax quinque metrorum sit?

unit.source: Could it be that he has never encountered or fought a Mid‐Sequence Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway?
unit.target: Numquamne obvenit aut pugnatus est cum Beyonder mediocris ex via Arbiter?

unit.source: That’s true, Camus thought.
unit.target: Ita vero, Camus cogitavit.

unit.source: No one in the patrol team or the Admiral Guard knows that Robert and Miss Amandina are Beyonders.
unit.target: Nemo in manipulo vigiliae aut in Custodia Admirali novit Robertum et Dominam Amandinam Beyonder esse.

unit.source: After obtaining Beyonder powers during the Dream Festival, they probably don’t use them much in the outside world.
unit.target: Postquam potentias Beyonder consecuti sunt durante Festa Somniorum, verisimiliter ea in mundo extra parum utuntur.

unit.source: They can only unleash their full potential during the annual Dream Festival.
unit.target: Solum in annuo Festa Somniorum suam plenam potentiam efferre possunt.

unit.source: There aren’t many Beyonder enemies to choose from…
unit.target: Non sunt multi hostes Beyonder eligendi…

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through Camus’s mind, he seized the opportunity.
unit.target: Dum haec cogitationes per mentem Camus volitabant, occasionem ceperat.

unit.source: As Robert stepped within five meters, his eyes lit up with brilliant lightning.
unit.target: Cum Robertus intra spatium quinque metrorum accessit, oculi eius fulgore praeclaro incendebantur.

unit.source: Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Perforatio Psychica!

unit.source: Two bolts of lightning shot out and pierced Robert’s head.
unit.target: Duo fulmina proiecerunt et caput Roberti transfixerunt.

unit.source: Robert let out a blood‐curdling scream and tumbled forward, writhing in pain.
unit.target: Robertus clamorem terribilem edidit et in antea labens cecidit, dolore se contorquens.

unit.source: He had tossed the frost scythe aside.
unit.target: Falcem glacialem abiecit.

unit.source: Rhea’s arrow was once again nocked to the bowstring, instinctively following Robert’s roll.
unit.target: Sagitta Rhea iterum in chorda arcu inserta erat, instinctu sequens rotam Roberti.

unit.source: Fury blazed in her eyes, erupting from within her body, and her muscles bulged with the surge of power.
unit.target: Ira in oculis eius ardebat, ex intimo corpore erumpens, et musculi eius vi potentiae influxu tumebant.

unit.source: Raging Blow.
unit.target: Ictus Furibundus.

unit.source: This was the Raging Blow Rhea had accumulated through her anger.
unit.target: Hic erat Ictus Furibundus, quem Rhea per suam iram collegit.

unit.source: It came from Sequence 8 Folk of Rage from the Sailor pathway. By releasing accumulated anger, her attack was greatly enhanced.
unit.target: Hic venit ex Sequentione VIII “Populus Irae” via nautarum; iram accumulatam dimittens, impetum eius valde augebat.

unit.source: Rhea was currently at this Sequence, but the hunting bow in her hand was a powerful Beyonder item.
unit.target: Rhea nunc ad hanc sequentiam pertinebat, sed arcus venandi in manu eius rem Beyonder potentem habebat.

unit.source: It was a formidable weapon she had spent all her savings on before arriving in Tizamo.
unit.target: Illud erat arma formidolosum, in quod totam pecuniam suam ante adventum in Tizamo impenderat.

unit.source: It was called Thunderclap Explosion and could be used for two years.
unit.target: Illud appellabatur “Explosio Tonitrui” et per biennium adhiberi poterat.

unit.source: Soon, Robert ceased his tumbling, but he couldn’t shake off the intense pain caused by Psychic Piercing.
unit.target: Mox Robertus labens desiit, sed dolorem intensum, quem Perforatio Psychica attulit, superare non potuit.

unit.source: He froze in place for a moment.
unit.target: Per momentum stetit immobilis.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Rhea watched the arrow, engulfed in dazzling lightning, and released her grip on the bowstring.
unit.target: Sine mora, Rhea sagittam, fulgore splendenti involutam, observavit et manum ab chorda arcu relaxavit.

unit.source: The arrow shot out, but the lightning on it strangely split into two. One continued to ensnare the arrow, while the other darted to the right.
unit.target: Sagitta iecit, sed fulgor in ea mirum modum in duas partes divisus est. Una part continuavit sagittam amplecti, dum altera ad dextram festinavit.

unit.source: Wh– Rhea’s pupils dilated, unable to comprehend why such a thing had occurred.
unit.target: Heu— pupillae Rhea dilatatae sunt, neque poterant comprehendere cur talis res evenisset.

unit.source: Instinctively, she turned her head and followed the separated bolt of lightning to its destination.
unit.target: Instinctu, caput vertit et fulgorem divisum ad metam suam sequens pervenit.

unit.source: Then, she saw Louis Berry leaning against the window, his eyes tightly shut as he slid down.
unit.target: Tum vidit Ludovicum Berry ad fenestram inclinatum, cum oculi eius arcte clausi essent, dum deorsum labebat.

unit.source: A few seconds ago, upon hearing Louis Berry’s words, Amandina had locked onto him with a mix of confusion and excitement.
unit.target: Paucis secundis abhinc, verbis Ludovici Berry auditis, Amandina eum complexa est cum mixtione confusionis et excitamenti.

unit.source: Since you said it, I won’t stand on ceremony!
unit.target: Cum id dixeris, non caerimoniam servabo!

unit.source: In her spiritual perception, Louis Berry’s soul was intertwined with the sinister soul, fiercely resisting while using various parts of his body as a battlefield.
unit.target: In sua perceptione spirituali, anima Ludovici Berry cum anima sinistra intricata erat, vehementer repugnans et diversas partes corporis sui ut campum pugnae adhibens.

unit.source: However, the owner of the body was clearly at a disadvantage.
unit.target: Attamen, dominus corporis manifeste in incommodo erat.

unit.source: Amandina couldn’t separate them under such circumstances.
unit.target: Amandina eos in his condicionibus separare non potuit.

unit.source: She vaguely understood why Louis Berry had instructed her to lock onto the other party’s head and entangled soul with her spirituality.
unit.target: Ea vage intellexit cur Ludovicus Berry eam instruxisset ut caput et animam intricatam adversarii cum sua spiritualitate coniungeret.

unit.source: Lumian, who had Amandina use her abilities, stammered as he struggled to move his left hand in his pocket.
unit.target: Lumian, qui Amandinam ad facultates suas adhibendas provocaverat, titubans conabatur manum sinistram in sinu movere.

unit.source: His left hand wasn’t in his trouser pocket or shirt pocket, but in his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Manus sinistra eius non in sinu braccorum aut vestis erat, sed in sacco Viatoris.

unit.source: After arriving outside Saint-Sien Cathedral and prying open the stained‐glass window, Lumian had inserted his left hand into his Traveler’s Bag, ready to retrieve a suitable mystical item at any moment.
unit.target: Postquam extra Sanctam Sien Cathedralem pervenit et fenestram vitream aperuit, Lumian manum sinistram in sacco Viatoris inseruit, paratus ad rem mysticam idoneam unoquoque momento extrahendam.

unit.source: He was preparing for the impending battle.
unit.target: Se ad proelium imminens praeparabat.

unit.source: If this wasn’t a dream, he would likely have his hand in his left shirt pocket–where Mr. K’s finger was.
unit.target: Si hoc non esset somnium, verisimiliter manum sinistram in sinu tunicae haberet, ubi digitus Domini K positus esset.

unit.source: Before being fully controlled by the Wraith, Lumian relied on the strength of a Reaper’s soul to struggle and retrieve a brooch from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Priusquam a Wraith plene dominaretur, Lumian vi animae Messoris confidebat ut pugnaretur et fibulam ex sacco Viatoris extraheret.
