unit.source: It was the grayish-white, lightning-shaped brooch known as Fury of the Sea!
unit.target: Fibula erat griseo-alba, forma fulminis similis, nota ut “Furor Maris”!

unit.source: Lumian gripped the brooch tightly and observed Amandina leaning against the wall.
unit.target: Lumian fibulam arcte apprehendit et Amandinam contra parietem inclinatum observavit.

unit.source: She clenched her fists and closed her eyes.
unit.target: Manus coniunxit et oculos clausit.

unit.source: His thoughts suddenly blurred, and his eyelids grew heavy.
unit.target: Eius cogitationes subito obscuratae sunt, et palpebra eius gravia facta sunt.

unit.source: He fell asleep and slowly slid down the wall.
unit.target: Dormivit et parietem lente labens descendit.

unit.source: Padre Cali fell silent in his body.
unit.target: Padre Cali in corpore suo tacuit.

unit.source: The Wraith appeared to be asleep as well.
unit.target: Wraith etiam dormire videbatur.

unit.source: It was unknown if he would fall asleep on his own or if he was affected by the negative effect of now possessing a body.
unit.target: Nesciebatur utrum ipse dormiret aut effectu negativo, quod ex corpore nunc possidebat, afficeretur.

unit.source: Amandina opened her eyes and was delighted to see this.
unit.target: Amandina oculos aperuit et hoc videns delectata est.

unit.source: She wanted to praise herself.
unit.target: Se laudare cupiebat.

unit.source: With a crackling sound, the bolt of lightning detached from Rhea’s arrow struck Lumian, transforming into numerous tiny electric serpents that slithered around him.
unit.target: Cum sono crepitante, ictus fulminis a sagitta Rhea separat, Lumian percussit et in innumeros parvos serpentulos electricos qui circa eum labebantur transformatus est.

unit.source: This was the downside of the Fury of the Sea brooch!
unit.target: Hoc erat incommodum fibulae “Furor Maris”!

unit.source: Even if Lumian only carried it, there was a high chance of being struck by lightning when he went out in the rain.
unit.target: Etiam si Lumian solum illud portaret, alta probabilitas erat ut fulmine percussus esset, cum in pluvia exiret.

unit.source: And if he wore it without attacking anyone else, the likelihood of encountering such a thing would significantly increase.
unit.target: Et si illud gereret sine alio aggrediente, verisimilitudo ut talis res occureret significanter augeretur.

unit.source: Lumian believed that since the Fury of the Sea brooch had a chance of attracting lightning strikes on a rainy day, it held a special allure for lightning.
unit.target: Lumian credebat quod, cum fibula “Furor Maris” occasionem haberet ad fulminis ictus in die pluvioso attrahendos, eam peculiarem allicitate fulminis habere.

unit.source: In such a situation, although it wasn’t raining, what if there was another source of lightning nearby? What would happen?
unit.target: In tali re, quamquam non pluviabat, quid, si prope esset alter fons fulminis, eveniret?

unit.source: There was a high chance that it would attract a portion of someone else’s lightning!
unit.target: Alta probabilitas erat ut partem alicuius fulminis attraheret!

unit.source: Stimulated by the pain of the electric shock, Lumian, no longer affected by the Nightmare ability, snapped out of his dream.
unit.target: Ex dolore ictus electrici stimulatus, Lumian, iam non affectus facultate Somniorum Horridorum, e somnio evigilavit.

unit.source: He regained his senses, but his body remained numb.
unit.target: Sensus suos recuperavit, sed corpus eius insensibile manebat.

unit.source: He experienced this, as did Padre Cali.
unit.target: Hoc experitus est, sicut et Padre Cali.

unit.source: As soon as the Wraith regained consciousness, he instinctively detached from Lumian’s body to distance himself from the harm of the electric current.
unit.target: Quam primum Wraith conscientiam recuperavit, instinctu se a corpore Lumiani separavit, ut a damno currentis electrici se distanseret.

unit.source: His face materialized on the nearest pane of glass, his form indistinct.
unit.target: Vultus eius in lamina vitrea proxima apparuit, forma eius indistincta.

unit.source: Seizing the moment, Lumian donned the grayish-white, lightning-shaped brooch and retrieved his revolver from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Occasionem captus, Lumian fibulam griseo-albam, fulminis similem, induit et revolverum suum e sacco Viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: He raised his right hand, aiming at Wraith Cali, who remained in a daze.
unit.target: Manum dexteram extulit, ad Wraith Cali destinans, qui in stupefacto manebat.

unit.source: The Wraith’s various colors reflected in Lumian’s determined eyes.
unit.target: Varii colores Wraith in oculis firmis Lumiani reflexerunt.

unit.source: The pallor rapidly expanded in Lumian’s line of sight.
unit.target: Pallor celeriter in conspectu Lumiani diffusus est.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: Lumian calmly pulled the trigger, firing a yellow bullet.
unit.target: Lumian tranquille trigerum premens, globulum flavum iacitavit.

unit.source: As he did so, silver-white lightning flickered on the Fury of the Sea brooch, instantly entering the bullet and wrapping around its surface.
unit.target: Dum hoc faciebat, fulgor argenteo-albus in fibula “Furor Maris” micuit, statim in globulum ingressus et superficiem eius circumvolvit.

unit.source: This was one of the brooch’s abilities. It could grant the wearer an Electric Shock effect with every strike!
unit.target: Hoc erat una ex virtutibus fibulae, quae induti ictum electricum cum omni ictu praestare poterat!

unit.source: After temporarily losing the Pride Armor, this had become one of Lumian’s most effective methods against soul-type creatures.
unit.target: Postquam armaturam Superbi temporarie amisit, hoc factum erat unum ex modis Lumiani efficacissimis contra creaturas animae generis.

unit.source: The yellow bullet, engulfed in silver-white lightning, struck the stained-glass, shattering it and sending tiny electric currents in all directions.
unit.target: Globulus flavus, fulgore argenteo-albo circumdatus, vitrum pictum percussit, confractum reddens et parvos currentes electricos in omnes partes diffudit.

unit.source: However, it missed Padre Cali.
unit.target: Attamen, Padre Cali non percussus est.

unit.source: As Lumian pulled the trigger, the Wraith vanished from the glass and instantly leaped onto the glass-like surface of the crystal chandelier high above the cathedral.
unit.target: Dum Lumian trigerum premens erat, Wraith ex vitreo evanuit et statim in superficiem vitream, quasi candelabri crystallini altae supra cathedralem, saliit.

unit.source: Mirror Blink!
unit.target: Speculum Micans!

unit.source: On the other side, Rhea’s arrow struck Robert with precision, emitting a resounding bang like a heavy object colliding.
unit.target: In altera parte, sagitta Rhea Robertum percussit cum praecisione, resonantem sonitum emittens, quasi grave obiectum collidens.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crack!

unit.source: The ice armor covering Robert’s body instantly cracked, shattering into fragments that fell to the ground.
unit.target: Armatura glacialis, quae corpus Roberti tegebat, statim fregit et in fragmenta dispersa resoluta cecidit.

unit.source: Under the assault of crackling electric serpents, the blurry shadow attached to his body broke free and vanished into the void.
unit.target: Sub impetu serpentium electricorum crepitantium, umbra confusa quae corpus eius adhaerebat, liberata est atque in nihilum evanuit.

unit.source: With the ice armor shielding him from most of the damage, Robert remained relatively unaffected. However, his chest tightened, and his body briefly went numb.
unit.target: Cum armatura glacialis eum ex plerisque damnis protegisset, Robertus relative intactus mansit; attamen, pectus eius contraxit et corpus eius per momentum insensibile factum est.

unit.source: At that moment, he regretted not wearing clothes. The various ingredients needed for his spirit channeling were hidden in his clothes, such as Full Moon Essence Oil or Corpse Incense Medication.
unit.target: Illo momento, paenitebat quod vestes non indutus esset; ingrediēntia varia, quae ad animam canali faciendam necessaria erant, in vestimentis eius celata erant, ut Oleum Essentiae Lunae Plenilunii aut Incensum Cadaveris Medicamentum.

unit.source: There were very few spirits that could allow him to communicate safely without the use of materials. The one just now was the most powerful.
unit.target: Pauci spiritus erant qui ei secure communicare sine usu materiārum sinere poterent; is qui modo apparuit potentissimus erat.

unit.source: Seeing Camus’s special revolver and Rhea’s arrows aimed at him, Robert grew anxious.
unit.target: Videns Camus revolverum specialem et sagittas Rhea ad se emissas, Robertus anxius factus est.

unit.source: He thought of a spirit channeling method that could be completed under such circumstances.
unit.target: Cogitavit de ratione ad animam canalizandam, quae talibus condicionibus perfici posset.

unit.source: Frowning and fearing the pain, he bit the tip of his tongue.
unit.target: Contristatus et dolorem metuens, apicem linguae suae mordit.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: He spat out the blood from the tip of his tongue mixed with his saliva, emitting a strange sound from his throat.
unit.target: Sanguinem ex apice linguae suae, cum salive mixta, expulsit et ex gutture suo sonum insolitum emisit.

unit.source: A pair of weathered, stone-like hands reached out from beneath the cathedral’s stone bricks, seized Robert’s body, and pulled him underground.
unit.target: Par manus lapideae vetustae, ex sub lateribus lapideis cathedralis eductae, corpus Roberti arripuerunt et eum subterraneum traxerunt.

unit.source: At some point in time, the ground had softened like a swamp, and the blood in the air abruptly vanished.
unit.target: Aliquando terra quasi paludis mollitate facta erat, et sanguis in aere subito evanuit.

unit.source: Camus’s bullets and Rhea’s arrows arrived one after another, but they only caused sparks on the stone bricks on the ground.
unit.target: Stipulae Camus et sagittae Rhea consecutim advenerunt, sed solum scintillas in lateribus lapideis terrae excitaverunt.

unit.source: Spirit Medium? Camus used this opportunity to revise his judgment of Robert’s pathway and Sequence.
unit.target: Spirit Medium? Camus hanc occasionem adhibuit ut iudicium de itinere et sequentia Roberti corrigeret.

unit.source: He’s actually not from the same pathway as Miss Amandina?
unit.target: Nonne revera non ex eadem via procedit quam Domina Amandina?

unit.source: Hadn’t he also obtained his superpowers from the black boulder?
unit.target: Nonne etiam ex saxo nigro super potestates suas consecutus est?

unit.source: Camus hastily took a few steps back, retrieved a cartridge bag, and began reloading the revolver.
unit.target: Camus celeriter paucos gradus retrorsum accessit, sacculum cartilaginum rapuit, et revolverum reficere coepit.

unit.source: As a member of Matani’s authorities, obtaining Beyonder bullets with different effects was relatively easy, even though the patrol team wasn’t wealthy or had much accumulation.
unit.target: Ut membrum auctoritatum Matani, obtinere globulos Beyonder cum diversis effectibus facile erat, quamquam manipulus vigiliae neque dives neque multa copiam habebat.

unit.source: After all, there was the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, the God of Steam and Machinery Church, the Church of Earth Mother, and numerous adventurers coming and going.
unit.target: Nam erant Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Ardoris, Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, Ecclesia Matris Terrae, ac plurimi viatores adventantes et abeuntes.

unit.source: Furthermore, the patrol team needed to be vigilant against certain branches of the Rose School of Thought and the Numinous Episcopate. They had to make targeted preparations.
unit.target: Praeterea, manipulus vigiliae contra certas factiones Scholae Rosae et Episcopatus Numinosi vigilantiam exercere oportebat, atque praeparationes destinatas facere debebat.

unit.source: Camus swiftly inserted the golden Purifying Bullets into the revolver’s cylinder and snapped it shut.
unit.target: Camus celeriter globulos aureos purificantes in cylindrum revolveri inseruit et statim illud clauserit.

unit.source: At that moment, Padre Cali, who had leaped onto another stained‐glass window, reappeared.
unit.target: Illo momento, Padre Cali, qui in aliam fenestram vitream insiluit, iterum apparuit.

unit.source: He opened his mouth and emitted a piercing shriek that harmed one’s eardrums and Spirit Body.
unit.target: Os suum aperuit et stridorem acutum exemit, qui auriculis et corpore spirituali laesit.

unit.source: “Ah!”
unit.target: “Ah!”

unit.source: Wraith Shriek!
unit.target: Stridor Wraith!

unit.source: 680 Combat Experience
unit.target: 680 Experientia Pugnandi

unit.source: Camus, who had just loaded the Purifying Bullets into his revolver cylinder, heard a sharp sound of static in his mind.
unit.target: Camus, qui modo globulos purificantes in cylindrum revolverii sui oneraverat, sonitum acutum staticum in mente audivit.

unit.source: Before his eyes, the world seemed to separate from him, a chunk of transparent glass forming a barrier between him and reality.
unit.target: Ante oculos eius, mundus videbatur se ab eo separare, cum fragmentum vitrei perspicui, quod inter eum et rem veram, ut obstaculum, constituisse videbatur.

unit.source: Under the Wraith’s Shriek, cracks appeared on the glass, extending into the Spirit Body.
unit.target: Sub ululatu umbrae, fissurae in vitreo apparuerunt, quae in corpus spirituale se extendebant.

unit.source: A faint shattering sound reverberated in the ears of Lumian, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, Robert, who had just crawled out of the ground near the altar, and the other naked men frantically dodging.
unit.target: Tenue sonitum confringentem per auribus resonabat Lumiani, Rheae, Lugani, Amandinae, Roberto, qui modo ex terra prope aram emergerant, atque aliorum virorum nudorum, qui furiose effugiabant.

unit.source: It brought sharp pain to their eardrums, blood to their noses, and agony from the depths of their souls.
unit.target: Illud intulit acutum dolorem ad tympana eorum, sanguinem ad naribus eorum, et cruciatum ex imis animorum profundis.

unit.source: Almost everyone froze in place, like fragile porcelain caught in an invisible storm.
unit.target: Fere omnes in loco steterunt immobiles, velut fragilis porcellana in tempestate invisibili capta.

unit.source: The naked men, who appeared ordinary, fainted without a sound.
unit.target: Viri nudi, qui ordinarii apparuerunt, sine sonitu conciderunt.

unit.source: Blood seeped from their eyes, nostrils, mouths, ears, and skin.
unit.target: Sanguis ex oculis, naribus, ore, auribus, et cute eorum stillavit.

unit.source: However, Lumian, who had advanced to Sequence 5 Reaper, suffered the least damage and recovered the fastest.
unit.target: Tamen, Lumian, qui ad Sequentiam 5 Messoris pervenit, minimas laesiones passa est atque celerrime restitutus est.

unit.source: Thin ice crystal arrows shot at him, their arrowheads flickering with a cold light.
unit.target: Tenues sagittae crystallinae glaciei in eum volaverunt, quarum acuminibus luce frigido micabantibus.

unit.source: In an instant, Lumian made a decision.
unit.target: Statim, Lumian consilium cepit.

unit.source: He didn’t transform into a shadow creature or enter the shadows to dodge the damage, nor did he attempt to duck.
unit.target: Non se mutavit in creaturam umbrarum nec in umbras se contulit ut laesionem evitare, neque conatus est se flectere.

unit.source: Instead, blazing white flames ignited over his body.
unit.target: Contra, flammae candidae ardentes super corpus eius incenderunt.

unit.source: He transformed into a burning-white spear and hurled himself towards the stained‑glass window closer to the door, facing the ice crystal arrows.
unit.target: Se transformavit in hastam albanter ardentem et se projecit versus fenestram vitream pictam prope ostium, adversus sagittas crystallinas glaciei.

unit.source: Padre Cali, with his dark brown skin and sinister expression, stood there.
unit.target: Padre Cali, cum cute fusca et vultu sinistro, ibi stabat.

unit.source: Amandina was the second to recover from the Wraith’s Shriek.
unit.target: Amandina secunda fuit quae ex ululatu umbrae se recuperavit.

unit.source: She witnessed the majestic blazing‑white flaming spear collide with the ice crystal arrows hurtling towards them.
unit.target: Ea conspexit hastam majesticam albanter ardentem, quae sagittas crystallinas glaciei in ipsos volitantibus concurrere videbatur.

unit.source: Silently, a portion of the ice crystal arrows facing the blazing‑white flaming spear evaporated into sizzling white gas, while the surrounding ones quickly melted and turned to steam.
unit.target: Silentio, pars sagittarum crystallinarum glaciei, quae contra hastam albanter ardentem erant, in gas album sibilans evanuit, dum reliquae celeriter liquefactae et in vaporum conversae sunt.

unit.source: White mist caused by water steam filled the air.
unit.target: Nebula alba, a vaporibus aquae orta, aerem implevit.

unit.source: Although the blazing white flaming spear had dimmed significantly and stopped burning violently, it still pierced through and headed straight for the stained‑glass that revealed Padre Cali’s figure.
unit.target: Etsi hasta albanter ardens candida significanter attenuata et violentissime non iam ardebat, tamen pervenit et recta versus vitream pictam, qua figura Padre Cali patebat, properavit.

unit.source: Similar ice crystal arrows pierced through the white mist, striking Amandina, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano.
unit.target: Sagittae crystallinae glaciei similes per nebulam albam penetraverunt, percutientes Amandinam, Camum, Rheam, et Luganon.

unit.source: However, they either melted or shrunk significantly, reducing their speed.
unit.target: Tamen vel liquefactae sunt vel signanter contractae, ita celeritatem minuentes.

unit.source: Amandina and Camus, who had just escaped the Wraith’s Shriek, easily dodged.
unit.target: Amandina et Camus, qui modo ex ululatu umbrae effugerant, facile evitaverunt.

unit.source: Although Rhea and Lugano couldn’t react in time and were hit by the ice crystal arrows, they only felt a slight pain, as if a child had hit them with a snowball.
unit.target: Quamquam Rhea et Lugano non tempestive reagere potuerunt et sagittae crystallinae glaciei illos percusserunt, tantum levem dolorem sensit, quasi puer eis pila nivis intulisset.

unit.source: It was a little painful, but mostly wet and cold.
unit.target: Parum dolorosum erat, sed praecipue madidum et frigidum.

unit.source: They seized the opportunity to snap out of their daze, almost at the same time as Robert at the altar.
unit.target: Occasionem ceperunt se evigilare ex stupore, paene simul cum Roberto ad aram.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: The blazing‑white flaming spear struck the stained‑glass, shattering it into countless pieces. However, Padre Cali had already leaped onto the window that Lumian had pried open, narrowly escaping the attack.
unit.target: Hasta albanter ardens percussit vitream pictam, eam in innumeras partes confringens. Tamen, Padre Cali iam in fenestram quam Lumian aperuerat insiluit, anguste impetum evadens.

unit.source: As the flames of the burning white spear dissipated, Lumian’s figure emerged from the fading light.
unit.target: Dum flammas hastae albanter ardentis evanuerunt, figura Lumiani ex luce evanescente apparuit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he ignited white flames once more, transforming into a majestic spear that shot towards the window where Padre Cali had appeared, determined to pursue his enemy.
unit.target: Sine mora, iterum flammas albas incendit, se transformans in hastam majesticam, qua versus fenestram, ubi Padre Cali apparuerat, volens hostem persequi, iecit.

unit.source: He deliberately refrained from teleporting and repeatedly transformed into a flaming spear, hoping to lull Padre Cali into overlooking such possibilities. Then, at a critical moment, he would unexpectedly appear beside him and use the Spell of Harrumph, catching the Wraith off guard.
unit.target: Deliberate se abstinuit teletransportare et iterum atque iterum in hastam flammans se transformabat, sperans ut Padre Cali has facultates negligere; deinde, in momento critico, inopinanter iuxta eum appareret et Incantationem “Harrumph” adhiberet, ita Wraith insidiatus capiens.

unit.source: Otherwise, it would be challenging to catch a Wraith that could constantly jump through mirrored objects, using them as portals to evade capture.
unit.target: Alioquin difficile esset comprehendere Wraith, qui constanter per specula saliret, ea uti portis ad capturam evitandam.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian knew that Wraiths could be considered spirit world creatures to a certain extent. They could also use the spirit world to complete teleportation, although they couldn’t compare to spirit world creatures specialized in this area. Nevertheless, it wasn’t an ability to be underestimated.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian sciebat Wraith esse creaturas ex mundo spirituali ad quandam partem. Possent etiam mundum spiritualem uti ad teleportationem peragendam, quamvis creaturis mundi spiritualis, in hac re specializatis, non comparari possent. Nihilominus, illa facultas non erat subestimanda.

unit.source: As the fireball spear hurtled toward the window Lumian had pried open, Robert rolled to the side of the altar where their clothes were, intending to retrieve the ingredients used for spirit channeling.
unit.target: Cum hasta globularis ignis versus fenestram, quam Lumian aperuerat, volabat, Robert ad latus arae, ubi vestimenta erant, se volvit, intendens ingrediens ad spiritum canalizandum recipere.

unit.source: Swoosh!
unit.target: Swoosh!

unit.source: An arrow pierced the stone bricks in front of him, forcing him to change the direction of his roll at the last moment, narrowly avoiding the projectile.
unit.target: Sagitta percussit latera lapidea coram eo, faciens ut directionem volutionis suae in ultimo momento mutaret, anguste proiectum vitans.

unit.source: As soon as Rhea regained her composure, she aimed at Robert and launched an attack.
unit.target: Statim postquam Rhea suam temperationem recuperavit, in Robertum destinavit et impetum iniit.

unit.source: Both she and Camus believed that Louis Berry could handle Padre Cali on his own, so their mission was to restrain Robert and capture this key figure, preventing him from interfering in the battle.
unit.target: Et illa et Camus crediderunt Louis Berry posse Padre Cali solus administrare; ergo eorum munus erat Robertum retinere et hanc personam clavem capere, ne in pugnam interveniret.

unit.source: As a gunshot rang out, Padre Cali’s figure vanished from the stained‑glass window, leaving no trace of his presence.
unit.target: Dum sclopetum acutum sonabat, figura Padre Cali ex fenestra vitrea picta evanuit, nullum vestigium praesentiae eius relinquens.

unit.source: The eyes of Amandina, who was nearby, reflected the image of the naked fallen padre.
unit.target: Oculi Amandinae, quae prope erant, imaginem Padri Cali, nudum atque lapsum, reflexerunt.

unit.source: Amandina wanted to resist, but her body quickly turned cold, gradually defying her will as an unknown force took control of her actions.
unit.target: Amandina resistere voluit, sed corpus eius celeriter frigide factum est, paulatim voluntati eius repugnans, dum vis ignota actiones eius regere coepit.

unit.source: Amidst the sloshing sounds, Lumian’s blazing‑white flaming spear pierced through the stained‑glass and landed outside the cathedral, three to four meters away from Amandina, its heat radiating in the cool night air.
unit.target: Inter sonos liquefactionis, hasta albanter ardens Lumiani per vitream pictam penetravit et extra cathedral cecidit, tres ad quattuor metra a Amandina, calor eius in aere frigido nocturno radiante.

unit.source: As the flames dissipated, Lumian appeared, clad in a golden straw hat, a white shirt, and a black vest.
unit.target: Dum flammas evanuerunt, Lumian apparuit, indutus pileum stramineum aureum, tunicam albam, et loricam nigrum.

unit.source: At that moment, Amandina’s hands had already “involuntarily” risen.
unit.target: Illo momento, manus Amandinae iam “involuntarie” surrexerant.

unit.source: The corners of her beautiful face curled into a sinister and smug smile.
unit.target: Anguli faciei eius pulchrae in risum sinistrum et superbum contraxerunt.

unit.source: Come on!
unit.target: Age!

unit.source: Attack me!
unit.target: Oppugna me!

unit.source: Amandina would be the first to be injured and die.
unit.target: Amandina fore prima vulnerata et mortua.

unit.source: If the body can’t protect me, I can still jump and shift positions in time!
unit.target: Si corpus me non defendere potest, adhuc saltare et positiones mutare in tempore possum!

unit.source: Padre Cali was wary of Amandina’s ability to forcefully pull people into dreams, a power that could easily turn the tide of battle.
unit.target: Padre Cali de facultate Amandinae, qua vi homines in somnia trahere poterat, cautus erat, potentia quae facile cursum belli mutare posset.

unit.source: This time, he chose to possess her instead of Louis Berry, an enemy at a higher Sequence, hoping to use her as a shield against Lumian’s attacks.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, elegit eam possidere pro Louis Berry, hoste in Sequentia superiori, sperans eam uti ut scutum contra impetum Lumiani.

unit.source: As Padre Cali manipulated Amandina’s body with a sinister and smug smile, he saw Louis Berry’s lips curve into a radiant smile.
unit.target: Dum Padre Cali corpus Amandinae, cum risu sinistro et superbo, moderabatur, vidit labia Louis Berry in risum radiantem incurvare.

unit.source: As a Wraith, Padre Cali had a strong spiritual premonition, and he suddenly sensed extreme danger.
unit.target: Ut Wraith, Padre Cali validam praemonitionem spiritualem habebat, et subito extremum periculum sensit.

unit.source: “Ha!”
unit.target: «Ha!»

unit.source: A pale‑yellow light burst forth from Lumian’s laughter and landed on Amandina, who stood three to four meters away, enveloping her spirit and Padre Cali, who couldn’t use Mirror Blink in time.
unit.target: Lumen pallidum flavum e risu Lumiani erupit et in Amandina cecidit, quae tres ad quattuor metra distante stabat, includens spiritum eius et Padre Cali, qui tempore “Mirror Blink” uti non poterat.

unit.source: Lumian honestly found it a pleasant surprise.
unit.target: Lumian id vere iucundum inopinatum invenit.

unit.source: You know about Nightmare’s abilities, but don’t you know how to guard against the Spell of Harrumph?
unit.target: Scis de facultatibus Nightmare, sed nesne quomodo contra Incantationem “Harrumph” te tueri possis?

unit.source: Oh, you really don’t. You don’t know this ability, nor do you know that I’m capable of it.
unit.target: O, vere non nosti. Non nosti hanc facultatem neque scis me id efficere posse.

unit.source: However, as a Wraith, you can continuously “mirror‑jump,” yet you insist on attaching yourself to one of my teammates and remain within a few meters of me. What kind of belief is this?
unit.target: Tamen, ut Wraith, constanter “saltum speculare” facere potes, sed insistis te ad unum ex sodalibus meis affigere et intra paucos metra a me manere. Quae talis opinio est?

unit.source: Don’t you have enough combat experience?
unit.target: Nonne satis experientiae pugnae tibi est?

unit.source: Even if you didn’t know the Spell of Harrumph, you have to guard against abilities like Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Etiamsi Incantationem “Harrumph” nescires, contra facultates similes “Psychic Piercing” te tueri oportet!

unit.source: Oh, you think Camus is far away, so there’s no need to worry about it. As a Sequence 5 of the Hunter pathway, how would I know this? Are you hoping to use me to quickly kill Amandina?
unit.target: O, putas Camum longe esse, itaque nihil sollicitum esse. Ut Sequentia 5 Venatoris, quomodo id scirem? Sperasne ut me ad celeriter Amandinam interficiendam adhibeas?

unit.source: Haven’t you considered the existence of mystical items?
unit.target: Numquid existentiam rerum mysticarum non consideravisti?

unit.source: My original plan was if I failed to finish you off after using teleportation to deliver the Spell of Harrumph and Cull, I would feign a strategic retreat and find a small space to set up the Bottle of Fiction. Then, when you caught up, I would fight you in a cramped and sealed space, just like how I dealt with Hisoka back then. To my surprise, you delivered yourself to me…
unit.target: Consilium meum originale erat: si te post teletransportationem ad mittere Incantationem “Harrumph” atque “Cull” interficere deficerem, simulare reditum strategicum atque parvum spatium invenirem ad “Bottle of Fiction” instituendum. Deinde, cum te assequerer, te in angusto et clauso spatio pugnarem, sicut cum Hisoka tunc egissem. Ad meum stuporem, te mihi tradidisti…

unit.source: As Lumian criticized wildly, Padre Cali and Amandina fainted and collapsed to the ground.
unit.target: Dum Lumian vehementer reprehendebat, Padre Cali et Amandina evanuerunt et in terram corruerunt.

unit.source: Had it been during his battle with Hisoka some time ago, Lumian would have hastened to follow through with the subsequent steps. This was because the Spell of Harrumph couldn’t render a Sequence 5 enemy unconscious for long. However, now that he had advanced to Sequence 5, his Spell of Harrumph had become significantly stronger. The time he could control a Wraith had increased, although it was still limited to a few seconds.
unit.target: Si hoc aliquantum ante tempore in proelio cum Hisoka factum fuisset, Lumian celerius se ad gradus subsequentes perducere festinasset. Nam Incantatio “Harrumph” hostem Sequentiae 5 non diu inanimatum facere poterat. Tamen, nunc quod ad Sequentiam 5 pervenit, incantatio eius signanter fortior facta est, et tempus quo Wraith regere posset auxit, quamvis adhuc paucis secundis limitatum esset.

unit.source: Lumian retrieved a few special bullets from his Traveler’s Bag. They had been purchased through Camus from the patrol team.
unit.target: Lumian paucos globulos especiales ex sacco Viatoris sui recepit. Illi per Camum a manipulo speculatorum empti fuerant.

unit.source: Two Exorcism and two Purification Bullets, both golden in color.
unit.target: Duo globuli Exorcismi et duo globuli Purificationis, ambo aurei colore.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly loaded the four bullets into the cylinder of his revolver and aimed at Amandina, who lay on the ground.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter quattuor globulos in cylindrum revolverii sui oneravit et in Amandinam destinavit, quae in terra iacebat.

unit.source: Catching sight of this from the corner of his eye, Camus jumped in fright and shouted, “What are you doing?”
unit.target: Hoc ex angulo oculi intuens, Camus ex timore saltavit et clamavit: “Quid agis?”

unit.source: “Saving her,” Lumian replied calmly.
unit.target: “Eam servare,” Lumian tranquille respondit.

unit.source: Then, he pulled the trigger.
unit.target: Deinde, manubrium premuit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: The golden Exorcism Bullet struck Amandina’s shoulder, causing her to bleed and emit a golden sunlight.
unit.target: Globulus aureus Exorcismi Amandinae umerum percussit, causans ut sanguis effunderet et lumen aureum emisset.

unit.source: Amandina woke up in pain, and the apparition of Padre Cali detached from her body, his face warped under the “sunlight.”
unit.target: Amandina dolore excitata est, et phantasma Padri Cali a corpore eius separatum est, cum facie sub luce aurea distorta.

unit.source: Originally, with the strength of the Exorcism Bullets, it would have been impossible to expel a Wraith from the victim’s body in an instant. However, Padre Cali was unconscious and unable to react effectively.
unit.target: Primum, cum virtute globulorum Exorcismi, impossibile fuisset in uno momento Wraith ex corpore victimae expellere. Attamen, Padre Cali inanimatus erat et efficaciter reagere non poterat.

unit.source: Lumian raised his gun, his eyes reflecting the color on the surface of Padre Cali’s Spirit Body. He locked onto the pallor that had become evident.
unit.target: Lumian sclopetum suum attulit, oculi coloris in superficie Corporis Spirituali Padri Cali reflexi; illud pallorem notum intendit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: A golden Purifying Bullet, imbued with Cull’s power, struck the Wraith’s forehead.
unit.target: Globulus aureus Purificationis, potestate Cull imbutus, frontem Wraith percussit.

unit.source: The apparition of Padre Cali froze as he “saw” the bullet shatter on its own, transforming into balls of golden holy flames that spread throughout his body, igniting dust and his soul.
unit.target: Apparitio Padri Cali immobilis fuit, dum “vidit” globulum seipso confringere, in globulos flammarum sacrarum aurearum transformari, qui per totum corpus eius se diffuserunt, pulverem atque animam eius inflammantes.

unit.source: The bright, sun‑like golden flames swiftly enveloped Padre Cali, causing him to let out a tragic scream.
unit.target: Flammae aureae, similes radiis solis, celeriter Padrem Cali involverunt, facientes eum clamorem tragicum emittens.

unit.source: This wasn’t a Wraith Shriek, but it still made everyone’s heads and ears hurt.
unit.target: Hoc non erat ululatus Wraith, sed tamen omnibus capitibus et auribus dolorem inferebat.

unit.source: Lumian endured these sensations and calmly said to Amandina,
unit.target: Lumian has sensus sustinuit et tranquille Amandinae dixit:

unit.source: “Drag him into a dream and inquire about the source of the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: «Trahe eum in somnium et interroga de fonte Festi Somniorum.»

unit.source: Padre Cali had already been subjected to Cull and was severely weakened, teetering on the brink of true death. Amandina could effectively restrain him!
unit.target: Padre Cali iam Cull subiectus erat et graviter debilitatus, in limine veri mortis versans. Amandina eum efficaciter retinere poterat!

unit.source: “But…” Amandina’s shoulder and head ached, but she didn’t dare complain when she saw Louis Berry’s cold and calm expression.
unit.target: «Sed…» umerus et caput Amandinae dolebant, sed non audebat queri cum vidit vultum frigidum et tranquillum Louis Berry.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Lugano and said, “Treat her gunshot wound.”
unit.target: Lumian ad Luganon se vertit et dixit: “Curare vulnera eius ex sclopeto!”

unit.source: “Alright.” Lugano winced from the pain in his eardrums, but he still rushed over.
unit.target: «Recte.» Lugano, ex dolore in tympanis contusus, tamen properavit.

unit.source: At that moment, Padre Cali, purified by the Cull, instinctively withdrew from his Wraith state and transformed back into a human to escape the ongoing damage.
unit.target: Illo momento, Padre Cali, per Cull purgatus, ex statu Wraith instinctive recessit et in hominem se transformavit ut damnum currentem evaderet.

unit.source: Seeing this, Amandina took a deep breath, clenched her fists, and closed her eyes.
unit.target: Videns hoc, Amandina altum inspiravit, manus contraxit et oculos clausit.

unit.source: She and Padre Cali entered the dream at the same time.
unit.target: Illa et Padre Cali simul in somnium intraverunt.

unit.source: Chapter 681 Tomb
unit.target: Capitulum 681: Sepulcrum

unit.source: Chapter 681 Tomb
unit.target: Capitulum 681: Sepulcrum

unit.source: Robert rejoiced that the two patrol team members dealing with him had also been affected by Padre Cali’s scream.
unit.target: Robert exsultavit quod duo membra turmae vigiliæ, quae cum eo operabant, etiam a clamore Padre Cali affecta erant.

unit.source: He didn’t know what had happened to his lover, nor could he confirm it.
unit.target: Nescivit quid amato suo acciderit, nec id confirmare potuit.

unit.source: Enduring the swelling in his head and the pain in his eardrums, he rushed towards the altar.
unit.target: Tolerans tumorem capitis et dolorem in auriculis, ad altare properavit.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Rhea’s arrow struck the pile of clothes, but that wasn’t Robert’s destination—it was quite a distance away.
unit.target: Sagitta Rheae in acervum vestimentorum incidit, sed non ibi Roberti destinatum erat – procul enim erat.

unit.source: After landing on the ground, he rolled and hid behind the altar.
unit.target: Postquam in terram cecidit, volutus est et post altare se abscondit.

unit.source: Rhea drew the bowstring again, but she didn’t release the arrow immediately.
unit.target: Rhea iterum chordam arcus extraxit, sed sagittam non statim emiit.

unit.source: Robert’s body was completely blocked by the altar, making it impossible for her to aim.
unit.target: Corpus Roberti ab altare omnino obtruncatum erat, ita ut Rhea destinare non posset.

unit.source: As a devout believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun, it was also impossible for her to use the hunting bow’s unique abilities together with Raging Blow to directly shatter the altar.
unit.target: Quia devota fide Solis Aeterni Flammarum erat, illi etiam impossibile erat uti singularibus facultatibus arcus venandi una cum Impetu Furioso ad altare directe confringendum.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Camus, knowing his revolver’s power was insufficient, leaped over the shattered stained‐glass window and sprinted towards the altar.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Camus, sciens vim sclopeti sui esse insufficientem, fenestram vitream fractam transiluit et ad altare cucurrit.

unit.source: After a brief moment of hesitation, Rhea raised her hunting bow and shot an arrow wrapped in lightning into the air.
unit.target: Post brevem momentum dubitationis, Rhea arcum venandi sustulit et sagittam, fulmine involutam, in aerem emisit.

unit.source: The arrow flew high into the air before swiftly descending, bypassing the altar’s obstruction and landing behind it.
unit.target: Sagitta in altum aeris volavit, deinde celeriter descendens, obstructionem altaris praeteriens, post altare consedit.

unit.source: Since she hadn’t been able to aim properly, the arrow grazed Robert’s body and struck a crevice between two stone slabs.
unit.target: Quia recte destinare non potuit, sagitta corpus Roberti leviter attigit et in fissuram inter duas lapideas laminas incidit.

unit.source: A sizzling electric current dissipated, creeping over Robert’s body and temporarily paralyzing him.
unit.target: Currens electricus sibilans evanuit, super corpus Roberti serpens, eum ad tempus immobilis reddens.

unit.source: After breaking free, Robert abandoned the idea of retrieving his spirit channeling ingredients.
unit.target: Postquam se liberavit, Robert propositum recuperandi ingredientia ad spiritum evocandum reliquit.

unit.source: He had no intention of saving his lover, Padre Cali.
unit.target: Nullum propositum habebat amatum suum servandi, Padre Cali.

unit.source: He planned to bite the tip of his tongue again and complete the spirit channeling.
unit.target: Constituit iterum apicem linguae suae mordere atque spiritus evocandi perficere.

unit.source: With the special ability of the natural spirit, he could escape back to his plantation, where he still had plenty of spirituality‐rich ingredients for backup.
unit.target: Cum singulari facultate spiritus naturae, ad praedia sua redire poterat, ubi adhuc copia ingredientorum spiritualium ad subsidium habebat.

unit.source: At that moment, from the corner of his eye, he caught sight of Camus’s light-colored pants and leather shoes with holes.
unit.target: Illo tempore, ex anguli oculi, conspexit bracas Camus coloris lucidi et calceos coriaceos cum foramina.

unit.source: He felt a whip formed by electric currents appear in his mind.
unit.target: Sentivit flagellum, e currentibus electricis constitutum, in mente sua apparare.

unit.source: The whip struck his soul,
unit.target: Flagellum animam eius percussit,

unit.source: and Robert, crouched behind the altar, felt his knees buckle, and he collapsed, trembling as extreme numbness and pain surged through him simultaneously.
unit.target: et Robert, post altare se abscondens, sensit genua labefacta esse et corruit, tremens dum maxima insensibilitas atque dolor simul eum pervadere videbantur.

unit.source: Whip of Pain!
unit.target: Flagellum Doloris!

unit.source: Interrogator’s Whip of Pain!
unit.target: Flagellum Doloris Inquisitoris!

unit.source: Camus rushed to Robert’s side, leaned down, and delivered a left hook—one that more or less bore a personal grudge.
unit.target: Camus ad Roberti partem properavit, se inclinavit, et ictum sinistrum dedit – ictum, qui paene rancorem personale gerebat.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Camus, skilled in interrogation techniques, inflicted pain on Robert without going overboard.
unit.target: Camus, artibus interrogationis peritus, Roberto dolorem intulit, sed non nimis excessit.

unit.source: Robert fainted, yet suffered no substantial harm.
unit.target: Robertus evanuit, sed nullum laesum grave attulit.

unit.source: After restraining Robert, Camus glanced at the naked man and selected nearby clothes to cover his private parts.
unit.target: Post Robertum cohibitum, Camus hominem nudum conspexit et vestimenta proxima ad membra intima tegenda elegit.

unit.source: He then picked up Robert and returned to where Lumian and the others were.
unit.target: Deinde Robertum sublevavit et rediit ad locum, ubi Lumian et ceteri erant.

unit.source: At that moment, Lugano had already retrieved the bullet that had struck Amandina’s shoulder, allowing the wound to contract and heal.
unit.target: Illo tempore, Lugano iam recuperaverat globulum, qui humeri Amandinae percussus erat, sinens vulnus contrahi et sanari.

unit.source: Padre Cali was dreaming of the interior of Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Padre Cali somniabat de intimo Sanctae Sien Cathedrali.

unit.source: Dressed in a white robe with golden threads, he knelt before the altar, muttering with a pained expression, as if repenting.
unit.target: Indutus veste alba cum filiis aureis, ante altare genu flectum, submurmurabat vultu dolenti, quasi paenitentiam ageret.

unit.source: Amandina, clad in a black hunting suit, approached Padre Cali down the aisle between the pews.
unit.target: Amandina, veste venatoria nigra induta, per ambulacrum inter sedilia ad Padre Cali accessit.

unit.source: Remembering Louis Berry’s instructions, she asked, “What’s the origin of this special dream?”
unit.target: Meminens praecepta Ludovici Berry, interrogavit: “Quid est originis huius somnii peculiarii?”

unit.source: Padre Cali looked up, his face contorted as he replied, “That… that strange tomb.”
unit.target: Padre Cali aspexit, vultu contorto, et respondit: “Illud… illud sepulcrum insolitum.”

unit.source: “Tomb?” Amandina suspected the Dream Festival she had just attended was a sham.
unit.target: “Sepulcrum?” Amandina suspicabatur Festum Somniorum, quod nuper participaverat, simulacrum esse.

unit.source: What tomb?
unit.target: Quid sepulcrum?

unit.source: Suddenly, a flash of inspiration flickered.
unit.target: Subito scintilla inspirationis micavit.

unit.source: “That colossal, black boulder?”
unit.target: “Illud ingens, nigrum lapidem?”

unit.source: It’s actually a tomb?
unit.target: Revera sepulcrum est?

unit.source: Padre Cali nodded.
unit.target: Padre Cali annuit.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Sic.”

unit.source: It’s really a tomb… Intrigued, Amandina asked proactively, “Whose tomb is that? Why is it so special?”
unit.target: Revera sepulcrum est… Intrigata, Amandina prompte rogavit: “Cuius sepulcrum est hoc? Cur tam speciale est?”

unit.source: Padre Cali remained kneeling, shaking his head.
unit.target: Padre Cali genu flectens remansit, caput movens.

unit.source: “I don’t know. Even the gravekeepers don’t know. They only know their mission is to guard that strange ancient tomb.”
unit.target: “Nescio. Ne custodes quidem sepulchri sciunt. Tantum noverunt officium suum esse, ut illud sepulcrum antiquum et mirum custodire possint.”

unit.source: “Gravekeepers? Who are they?” The more Amandina asked, the more she felt she didn’t know about the Dream Festival.
unit.target: “Custodes sepulchri? Qui sunt illi?” Quo plura Amandina interrogabat, eo magis se de Festo Somniorum nescire sentiebat.

unit.source: Padre Cali looked up at Amandina and said, “The elders of the forest tribe.”
unit.target: Padre Cali ad Amandinam aspexit et dixit: “Seniores gentis silvestris.”

unit.source: “I see…” Amandina’s mind raced with questions.
unit.target: “Intellego…” Mentem Amandinae multitudine quaestionum repleta erant.

unit.source: She picked one and asked, “Did you take Robert to Twanaku’s house to sleep and allow him to maintain his lucidity? Then, you took him to the ancient tomb where he obtained superpowers?”
unit.target: Unam ex illis elegerat et rogavit: “Num Robertum ad domum Twanaku duxisti ad dormiendum ut luciditatem retineret? Tum eum ad sepulcrum antiquum duxisti, ubi vires supernaturales adeptus est?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Padre Cali lowered his head, facing the altar, his voice laced with pain. “I’m sinful.”
unit.target: “Ita.” Padre Cali caput inclinavit, ad altare versus, voce dolore tincta: “Peccator sum.”

unit.source: Just as I thought… Amandina inquired further, “How did you know you could obtain superpowers there? And how did you maintain lucidity? You’ve only been in Tizamo for about five years, and I grew up here.”
unit.target: Sicut putavi… Amandina pergere rogavit: “Quomodo novisti te ibi vires supernaturales adipisci posse? Et quomodo luciditatem retinuisti? Quinque tantum annos in Tizamo fuisti, et ego hic crevi?”

unit.source: Blood vessels bulged from Padre Cali’s neck.
unit.target: Vasa sanguinea ex collo Padre Cali eminuerunt.

unit.source: “Twanaku, Twanaku, bewitched me.”
unit.target: “Twanaku, Twanaku, me incantavit.”

unit.source: “He used his body to tempt you?” Amandina suddenly felt a surge of excitement.
unit.target: “Corpus suum ad te alliciendum usus est?” Amandina subito alacritate affecta est.

unit.source: Padre Cali was taken aback.
unit.target: Padre Cali obstupefactus est.

unit.source: “He saw through my desire for status and recognition and gradually demonstrated his abilities. He also told me there was a way for me to quickly and easily obtain strength. And with great strength, I could do more for the Church and receive more rewards and recognition… That demon!”
unit.target: “Percepit cupiditatem meam pro statū et honōre, et gradatim virtutes suas demonstravit. Etiam mihi dixerat viam esse ut celeriter et facile robur adipisci possem. Et cum magno robore, plura pro Ecclesia efficere et maiores mercedes atque honores accipere possem… Ille daemon!”

unit.source: Amandina asked in disappointment, “You were bewitched just like that?”
unit.target: Amandina, cum contritione, rogavit: “Sic modo incantatus es?”

unit.source: Padre Cali nodded slowly.
unit.target: Padre Cali lente annuit.

unit.source: “That’s right. Twanaku needed someone to help him monitor the changes in the dream and host the Dream Festival after he left Tizamo. First, he got me to sleep at his house. Then, during the Dream Festival, he took me to that strange ancient tomb.”
unit.target: “Sic est. Twanaku aliquem requirebat ut eum mutationes somnī monitoraret et Festum Somniorum moderaret, postquam Tizamo reliquerit. Primo, me in domo sua ad dormiendum concitavit. Deinde, durante Festo Somniorum, me ad illum sepulcrum antiquum et insolitum duxit.”

unit.source: “Did you also obtain superpowers by touching that tomb?” Amandina asked casually.
unit.target: “Num et, illum sepulcrum tangendo, super vires adeptus es?” Amandina leve rogavit.

unit.source: Padre Cali shook his head again.
unit.target: Padre Cali iterum caput movit.

unit.source: “No, Twanaku opened a crack in the tomb and let me reach in…”
unit.target: “Non, Twanaku in sepulcro fissuram aperuit et me intrudere concessit…”

unit.source: “What did you touch?” Amandina couldn’t help but urge upon seeing Padre Cali’s pause.
unit.target: “Quid tetigisti?” Amandina, videns moram Padre Cali, rogare non potuit nonque quaesivit.

unit.source: “I touched a hand—a cold hand without temperature. Then, I fainted. When I woke up, I had superpowers. I did it three more times during the subsequent Dream Festivals, eventually becoming a Wraith.” Padre Cali recalled the situation, his face filled with uncontrollable fear—both of the cold hand and the ease with which he had obtained superpowers.
unit.target: “Manum tetigi—manum frigidam sine calore. Deinde evanui. Cum experrectus sum, super vires adeptus eram. Hoc ter aliae vicibus in Festis Somniorum subsequenter feci, atque tandem factus sum Wraith. ”

unit.source: “The hand of the corpse in the tomb?” Amandina quickly reviewed what Padre Cali had said and thought of a problem. “Didn’t you say there were gravekeepers? Why weren’t we stopped when Robert and I went?”
unit.target: “Manus cadaveris in sepulcro?” Amandina celeriter recensebat verba Padre Cali et quaestionem effinxit: “Nonne dixisti custodes sepulchri esse? Cur nos non prohibiti sumus, cum Robertus et ego accessimus?”

unit.source: Padre Cali’s voice deepened.
unit.target: Vox Padre Cali profundior facta est.

unit.source: “People who have lived in Tizamo for a long time often have a projection formed by suppressed emotions and desires in this special dream.”
unit.target: Qui diu in Tizamo vixerunt, saepe proiectionem ex repressis emotis et cupiditatibus in hoc somnio peculiario habent.

unit.source: “They usually hide in the chaotic area brought by the tomb, at the edge of the dream.”
unit.target: Saepe latent in regione confusa, quam sepulcrum afferebat, in margine somnii.

unit.source: “They watch over the ancient tomb with the gravekeepers to protect it from others.”
unit.target: Illi, una cum custodes sepulchri, sepulcrum antiquum observant ad id a ceteris tuendum.

unit.source: “When the Dream Festival begins, these projections will return to their true forms, forming complete Dream Festival participants who can no longer suppress their emotions and desires.”
unit.target: Cum Festum Somniorum incipiet, hae proiectiones ad formas veras redeunt, formantes integros participes Festi Somniorum qui iam passiones et cupiditates suas reprimere non possunt.

unit.source: “As for the gravekeepers, it’s unknown where they go.”
unit.target: Quam ad custodes sepulchri attinet, ignotum est quo se conferant.

unit.source: Strange… Amandina was puzzled by the gravekeepers’ whereabouts.
unit.target: Mirum… Amandina de loco custodum sepulchri perplexa erat.

unit.source: She was a little worried.
unit.target: Paulum anxia erat.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, she asked with concern, “Do I have a projection of emotions and desires in this dream?”
unit.target: Post momentum cogitationis, sollicitata quaesivit: “Habebo-ne ego proiectionem passionum et cupiditatum in hoc somnio?”

unit.source: Padre Cali shook his head.
unit.target: Padre Cali iterum caput movit.

unit.source: “No. You don’t spend enough time in Tizamo every year. Even for those who originally formed a dream projection, once they leave this place long enough and stop suppressing themselves, the corresponding projection will gradually fade until it disappears.”
unit.target: “Minime. Non satis temporis in Tizamo singulis annis paras. Etiam, qui initio proiectionem somnii condiderunt, cum hoc locum diu relinquunt et se non amplius reprimunt, proiectiones eorum paulatim evanescunt, donec omnino evanuerint.”

unit.source: “Those who can remain lucid in this dream will have their corresponding projections gradually dissipate over time. Details.”
unit.target: Qui in hoc somnio lucidi manere possunt, proiectiones eorum paulatim dissolvuntur. Minutiae.

unit.source: “However, this lucidity isn’t absolute.”
unit.target: Tamen haec luciditas non est absoluta.

unit.source: “After the Dream Festival begins, everyone will have a tendency to flaunt their emotions and desires—including those who maintain their lucidity.”
unit.target: Post Festum Somniorum initium, omnes ad ostentationem passionum et cupiditatum inclinabuntur, etiam qui lucidi manent.

unit.source: “However, they won’t completely lose control like those who have fused with their dream self.”
unit.target: Attamen non omnino moderabuntur, quales sunt qui cum ipsa sua figura somniorum coniuncti sunt.

unit.source: “They can continue restraining themselves like normal, their desires revealed in some details.”
unit.target: Possunt se perseverare in moderandis ut consuetum est, cum cupiditates eorum in aliquibus minutis patefactae sint.

unit.source: Amandina recalled her performance during the two Dream Festivals and revealed a look of enlightenment.
unit.target: Amandina memoriam revocat de sua participatione in duobus Festis Somniorum et vultum illuminationis ostendit.

unit.source: Initially, she believed that because this place was a dream, as long as no one died, it was equivalent to a game.
unit.target: Initio credebat, quia hic locus somnium esset, dummodo nemo interiret, aequivalere ludo.

unit.source: That was why she appeared more self-centered and unrestrained than in reality.
unit.target: Idcirco videbatur magis sui ipsius centricus et laxior quam in veritate.

unit.source: She didn’t expect this to come from the effect of the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Non exspectabat hoc ex effectu Festi Somniorum provenire.

unit.source: Thankfully, I’ve always had self-control… Amandina had ticked off most of the questions that Louis Berry wanted clarified, leaving only those that the Padre Cali himself wasn’t aware of.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, semper me temperare potui… Amandina pleraque quaestiones, quas Ludovicus Berry explicationem cupiebat, enumeraverat, relinquens solum eas, de quibus ipse Padre Cali ignorabat.

unit.source: Thus, she changed the subject.
unit.target: Itaque rem mutavit.

unit.source: “You’ve already become a Wraith, yet you still dare to preach and host Mass…
unit.target: “Iam factus es Wraith, sed adhuc audes praedicare et Missam exsequi…

unit.source: “Aren’t you concerned that God might notice you and unleash His wrath upon you, purifying you into ashes?”
unit.target: “Nonne sollicitus es, ne Deus te detegat et iram suam super te effundat, te in cineres purgans?”

unit.source: Being in the Southern Continent, Amandina knew the power of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church better than many gentlemen and ladies in Trier.
unit.target: In Continente Meridionali versata, Amandina potentiam Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum melius noverat quam multi viri et feminae Trevirenses.

unit.source: She had no doubts about the existence of God.
unit.target: De existentia Dei nullas dubitationes habebat.

unit.source: Moreover, over the past year, she had been diligently obtaining mysticism knowledge from Robert and the various sources she could come into contact with.
unit.target: Praeterea, per annum praeteritum, diligenter mysticam scientiam ab Roberto et variis fontibus quibus contingere poterat, adeptata est.

unit.source: She knew that the Rose School of Thought, the key characters of various terrifying rumors, was renowned for its numerous Wraiths, and Wraiths were most afraid of sunlight that came with purification.
unit.target: Sciebat Schola Rosi Cogitationis, quorum characterēs in variīs rumoribus terribilium noti erant propter multitudinem Wraith, et Wraith maxime solem, qui cum purificatione venit, timere.

unit.source: Padre Cali sighed and said, “I had such concerns, but Twanaku told me he had a way to help me hide a Wraith’s power. Unless God watches this place personally, I won’t be discovered.”
unit.target: Padre Cali suspiravit et dixit: “Talis sollicitudinem habebam, sed Twanaku mihi dixerat viam esse ut potentiam Wraith absconderem. Nisi Deus hunc locum personaliter vigilaverit, non detegar.”

unit.source: “What is it?” Amandina asked curiously.
unit.target: “Quid est hoc?” Amandina curiosa rogavit.

unit.source: Padre Cali replied truthfully, “After touching the corpse in the tomb and obtaining superpowers, don’t rush to leave. Touch the tomb itself again, the black boulder.”
unit.target: Padre Cali fideliter respondit: “Postquam cadaver in sepulcro tetigi et vires supernaturales adeptus sum, noli festinare abire. Iterum tangas ipsum sepulcrum, lapidem nigrum.”

unit.source: “This concealed all my superpowers. The effect will last for more than a year.”
unit.target: “Hoc omnes super vires meas abscondit. Effectus plus quam annum durabit.”

unit.source: That’s possible? What would happen if I touched the black boulder and then touched the corpse’s hand?
unit.target: Idne fieri potest? Quid accideret, si lapidem nigrum tetigerim et deinde manum cadaveris attigerim?

unit.source: Amandina pondered for a moment and asked a question of personal concern, “How did you entice Robert? Why did he become your lover?”
unit.target: Amandina paulisper cogitavit et quaestionem personalem rogavit: “Quomodo Robertum allicuisti? Cur factus est amator tuus?”

unit.source: Amandina sized him up but couldn’t find anything about Padre Cali that attracted Robert, other than his strength.
unit.target: Amandina eum examinavit, sed nihil invenit de Padre Cali quod Robertum alliceret, praeter eius potentiam.

unit.source: Could love truly be blind?
unit.target: Num amor vere caecus esse possit?

unit.source: Padre Cali fell silent for a moment before saying, “I ignited his desires, dismantling his self-control.”
unit.target: Padre Cali paulisper tacuit antequam dixit: “Vota eius excitavi, continentiam eius dissolvens.”

unit.source: “You’ve never displayed such abilities…” Amandina hadn’t noticed Padre Cali arousing any desires in the battle before.
unit.target: “Numquam talem potentiam ostendisti…” Amandina ante intervallum non animadvertit quod Padre Cali desideria excitaret in proelio.

unit.source: Padre Cali’s voice was once again tinged with pain.
unit.target: Vox Padre Cali rursus dolore tincta erat.

unit.source: “I’m sinful. I’m praying to the Demon Twanaku mentioned…”
unit.target: “Peccator sum. Daemonem, quem Twanaku nominavit, precor…”

unit.source: Before Padre Cali could finish, the entire dream suddenly trembled and collapsed inch by inch.
unit.target: Priusquam Padre Cali finire posset, totum somnium repente tremuit et passu per passum corruit.

unit.source: Chapter 682 Cull
unit.target: Capitulum 682 Cull

unit.source: Chapter 682 Cull
unit.target: Capitulum 682 Cull

unit.source: Unable to control the dream anymore, Amandina opened her eyes and woke up.
unit.target: Iam somnium regere non poterat, Amandina oculos aperuit et evigilavit.

unit.source: Beside her, Padre Cali snapped out of his slumber, his human form once again becoming hazy and indistinct.
unit.target: Iuxta eam, Padre Cali e somno evigilavit, forma humana eius iterum obscura et incerta facta est.

unit.source: Instinctively, he transformed into a Wraith, as if losing all restraint.
unit.target: Instinctu se in umbram transformavit, quasi omnem moderamen amisisset.

unit.source: Stiff black hair even sprouted from his body.
unit.target: Crines nigri et rigidi etiam ex corpore eius oriri coeperunt.

unit.source: Reflected in Padre Cali’s eyes was Lumian’s figure—Louis Berry, with his black hair, green eyes, and golden straw hat, holding a revolver aimed directly at the Wraith’s forehead.
unit.target: In oculis Padri Cali relucebat figura Lumiani—Louis Berry, capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, et pileo stramineo aureo indutus, revolverum tenens, qui directe in frontem umbrae intendebat.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian smiled and pulled the trigger, a golden Purifying Bullet exploding from the muzzle and instantly heading straight for the pallor in the Wraith’s forehead.
unit.target: Lumian subridens et manubrium armamenti premens, globulus aureus purgatorius e canna erumpit, qui statim versus pallorem in fronte umbrae properavit.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Cull!
unit.target: Cull!

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian waved his empty left hand at Padre Cali, as if to say, “Bye, you won’t be missed!”
unit.target: Simul, Lumian manum sinistram inanitam ad Padre Cali movit, quasi diceret: “Vale, non te desiderabimus!”

unit.source: The Purifying Bullet exploded, and golden flames instantly ignited the ethereal Padre Cali’s entire body.
unit.target: Globulus purgatorius aureus erupit, et flammae aureae totum corpus aetherium Patris Cali statim incendere coeperunt.

unit.source: Padre Cali couldn’t even scream, his agonized thoughts manifesting as an invisible gale sweeping outwards.
unit.target: Padre Cali neclamare quidem potuit, cum cogitationes eius dolentes instar aurae invisibilis se efferebant.

unit.source: Lumian endured the backlash, watching with a grim smile as the enemy was consumed by the purifying flames, reduced to scattered ashes.
unit.target: Lumian toleravit contritionem, spectans vultu tristi, dum hostis flammis purgatoriis consumebatur et in cineres dispersos redactus est.

unit.source: Lumian felt his Reaper potion digest a little more.
unit.target: Lumian sensit potionem Reaper suam paulo magis digeri.

unit.source: Using Cull to reap a powerful foe’s life was a core principle for Reapers—the higher their Sequence and strength, the more potent the acting effect.
unit.target: Uti Cull ad vitam hostis potenti evellendam praeceptum principale Reaperorum erat—quo altior eorum ordo et vis, eo potentior effectus fungebatur.

unit.source: With the addition of Cull, the relatively ordinary and common Purifying Bullet ended the life of a Wraith with just two strikes.
unit.target: Cum adiuncta esset Cull, globulus purgatorius, qui relativus et communis erat, vitam umbrae in duobus ictibus finivit.

unit.source: Lumian found it inexplicably amusing to witness the true incineration of the Padre Cali.
unit.target: Lumian id inexplicabiliter iocundum invenit, veram incinerationem Patris Cali spectans.

unit.source: Why do I always encounter fallen Eternal Blazing Sun padres and cleanse and purify them?
unit.target: Cur semper occursum habeo Padres Solis Aeterni Flagrantis lapsos, eosque purgo atque emundo?

unit.source: Is this repayment for my past faith?
unit.target: Numquid hoc est retributio fidei meae praeteritae?

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian glanced at the risen Amandina and asked with a smile, “What did he say?”
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian in Amandinam resurrexisse respexit et subridente quaesivit: “Quid dixit?”

unit.source: Amandina’s first reaction was to check the wound on her shoulder. She exclaimed, “It’s completely healed, not a trace left?”
unit.target: Prima responsio Amandinae fuit vulneris in humero suo explorare; exclamavit: “Plane sanatum est, nullum vestigium reliquum?”

unit.source: If it weren’t for her torn clothes and sore shoulder, she would have imagined herself to be uninjured.
unit.target: Nisi vestimenta eius lacerata et humerus dolens essent, putasset se non vulneratam esse.

unit.source: Miss Amandina, don’t act as if you’ve never seen the world. Although you’re a believer in the Eternal Blazing Sun and won’t seek treatment from the clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother unless you are particularly ill, there are many Feynapotterians in Matani. Haven’t you come into close contact with them?
unit.target: Domina Amandina, noli te gerere quasi numquam mundum videris. Quamquam es fidelis Solis Aeterni Flagrantis et medicinam a clerico Ecclesiae Matris Terrae non quaeres nisi valde aegra sis, multi sunt Feynapotteriani in Matani. Num illos prope contiguisti?

unit.source: Lumian criticized her and looked at Amandina coldly without responding.
unit.target: Lumian eam reprehendit et Amandinam frigide respexit, nec respondit.

unit.source: Lugano, on the other hand, saw the beautiful girl’s reaction and explained smugly,
unit.target: Lugano, autem, reactivationem puellae pulchrae vidit et superbum exposuit:

unit.source: “That’s the power of a Doctor from the Planter pathway.”
unit.target: “Haec est potentia Medici ex via Plantatoris.”

unit.source: Amandina expressed her gratitude, then recounted her conversation with Padre Cali while massaging her shoulder to relieve the lingering sourness.
unit.target: Amandina gratiam egit, deinde colloquium cum Padre Cali recitavit, dum humerum suum massabat ad dolorem manentem levandum.

unit.source: At the end, she spat at the spot where his ashes had fallen.
unit.target: Ad finem, in loco ubi cineres eius caderant, sputavit.

unit.source: “He became the Demon’s mouthpiece, using its power to violate Robert and the others.
unit.target: “Luckily, he preferred men. Otherwise…”

unit.source: Recalling how she had frequented Saint-Sien Cathedral over the years and had been a girl with limited knowledge, far from adulthood, Amandina shuddered inwardly. She sympathized with Robert and the others, but she also felt fortunate.
unit.target: Meminens quomodo Cathedralem Sancti-Sien per annos frequentaverit et puella cum parva eruditione, longe ab adultā aetāte fuisset, Amandina intus fremuit. Illa Roberto et ceteris commiseravit, sed etiam se faustam sensit.

unit.source: Lumian had another question in mind.
unit.target: Lumian aliam quaestionem in mente habebat.

unit.source: Could Hisoka’s Wraith abilities also originate from the Dream Festival and the strange black tomb, rather than a direct boon from the Mother Tree of Desire?
unit.target: Possuntne etiam facultates umbrae Hisoka e Festo Somniorum et sepulchro nigro insolito nascī, potius quam ex dono directo a Matre Arboris Desiderii?

unit.source: That would explain a few things better.
unit.target: Id plura melius explicaret.

unit.source: As far as Lumian knew, when evil god believers prayed for boons, they needed to perform a ritual and offer sacrifices. The higher the level of the boon they prayed for, the higher the requirement for the sacrifice, and the larger the ritual.
unit.target: Quantum ad Lumian notum erat, cum credentes dei mali dona precabant, oportebat ritum celebrari atque sacrificia offerre. Quo altior donum precabantur, eo altior erant requisita sacrificii et rituum magnitudo.

unit.source: As a member of Port Pylos’s patrol team, Hisoka could cover up one or two sacrifices, but it was difficult to suppress all the sacrificial incidents. It was just like how Hisoka had only completed one serial murder case in Port Pylos.
unit.target: Ut membrum turmae vigiliarum Portus Pylos, Hisoka unum aut duo sacrificia operire poterat, sed omnes casus sacrificii opprimere difficile erat. Erat enim sicut Hisoka solum unum casum caedis seriatim in Portu Pylos perfecerat.

unit.source: Previously, Lumian had believed that he had relied on Mad Lady’s help to complete the sacrificial rituals in the Southern Continent’s even more chaotic places. But now, it seemed that there was no need for such trouble. He just needed to touch the cold corpse once a year during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Prius, Lumian credidit se auxilio Mad Lady ad ritus sacrificatorios in locis Continenti Meridionali, quae adhuc magis tumultuosa erant, perficiendos innixum esse. Sed nunc videbatur talis labor non esse necessarius: solum annuum opus habebat ut corpus frigidum tetigeret, in Festo Somniorum.

unit.source: Hisoka and Padre Cali have participated in at least five Dream Festivals and have become Wraiths for some time, but they haven’t made a breakthrough since then… Is this because the cold corpse can only bestow a boon up to Sequence 5? Did Hisoka obtain the large amount of gold and something from the Nois family’s Demon to wait for this year’s Dream Festival to complete the corresponding matters and obtain a higher boon?
unit.target: Hisoka et Padre Cali saltem quinque Festos Somniorum participaverunt et aliquantulum in umbras conversi sunt, sed postea nullum progressum attigerunt… Num quia corpus frigidum solum donum usque ad Ordinem V praebet? Num Hisoka magnam copiam auri ac aliquid ex Daemone familiae Nois obtinuit, ut Festo Somniorum huius anni res pertinentes peragenda et donum maius assequatur?

unit.source: Lumian turned to Robert, who had been dragged nearby, and asked for confirmation, “He’s a Spirit Medium?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Robertum, qui prope tractus erat, se vertit et rogavit: “Estne ille medium spirituum?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Amandina replied. “Padre Cali said Robert gained powers by touching that black boulder too. But why am I a Nightmare while he’s a Spirit Medium?”
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Amandina. “Padre Cali dixit Robertum vires adeptum esse etiam eo quod illam saxum nigrum tetigerit. Sed cur ego ‘Nightmare’ sum, cum ille ‘Spirit Medium’ sit?”

unit.source: Higher-level, composite power… Just as the Great Mother can bestow three different powers, Apothecary, Planter, and Villain, respectively… Lumian wasn’t surprised by this situation at all. Camus and Rhea were as puzzled as Amandina.
unit.target: Potentia composita altiori… Sicut Magna Mater tribuere potest tres diversas potentias—Apothecary, Planter, et Villain—respective… Lumian haec nullo modo miratus est. Camus et Rhea, sicut Amandina, perplexi erant.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t be bothered to explain this complicated and high-level problem. He turned around and said to Rhea,
unit.target: Lumian non curabat hanc quaestionem implicatam et altioris gradus explanare. Se convertit et Rhea dixit:

unit.source: “Your dream projection should still exist. Be careful from now on. The question now is whether the death of your dream projection will affect your life.”
unit.target: “Proiectio somniorum tua adhuc exsistere debet. Cave ex hoc tempore. Quaestio nunc est, utrum mors proiectionis somniorum tuae vitam tuam afficiet.”

unit.source: Rhea nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Rhea cogitabunda annuit.

unit.source: Lumian shifted his gaze back to Robert, recalling the Demon that had assisted Padre Cali.
unit.target: Lumian iterum in Robertum aspexit, daemonem qui Padre Cali adfuerat recolens.

unit.source: That should be the Nois family member who established a connection with Hisoka…
unit.target: Id debet esse membrum familiae Nois, qui cum Hisoka coniunctionem instituit…

unit.source: Demons don’t do ‘good deeds’ for no reason. Whether it’s establishing a connection with Hisoka or responding to the Padre Cali’s ritual, it must have its own motives. Although witnessing a padre of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church gradually degenerate should be commendable and interesting for a Demon, this isn’t a sufficient reason for its close involvement…
unit.target: Daemonia non faciunt ‘bona opera’ sine causa. Sive coniunctionem cum Hisoka instituere sive ritui Patris Cali respondere, oportet habere proprias causas. Quamquam videndum est patrem Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flagrantis paulatim degenerare, quod pro Daemone laudabile et iucundum videatur, hoc tamen non sufficit ad eius proximam implicationem…

unit.source: What does it want during the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Quid vult in Festo Somniorum?

unit.source: The cold corpse in the black ancient tomb can bestow a Prisoner pathway boon, and Prisoners are adjacent to the Criminal pathway which Demons are part of…
unit.target: Corpus frigidum in sepulchro antiquo nigro donum viae Carcerarii praebere potest, et Carcerarii adjacent viae Criminalis, cui Daemones participant…

unit.source: Lumian roughly grasped the situation and muttered to himself, “The crucial question now is, where do the gravekeepers go during the Dream Festival? Why aren’t they protecting the black ancient tomb anymore?”
unit.target: Lumian rem vix intellexit, et submurmuravit sibi: “Quaestio nunc maximi momenti est: quo vadunt sepulturarii in Festo Somniorum? Cur sepulchrum antiquum nigrum iam non tuentur?”

unit.source: No one could answer him.
unit.target: Nemo illi respondere potuit.

unit.source: Seeing him staring at the unconscious Robert, Amandina hesitated before saying,
unit.target: Videns eum in Robertum in statu inconscio intuentem, Amandina hesitavit antequam dixit:

unit.source: “Can you let him go? He’s a victim too, don’t kill him.”
unit.target: “Potesne eum dimittere? Ipse quoque victima est, noli eum occidere.”

unit.source: Am I a homicidal maniac in your eyes? Lumian replied with amusement, “As long as Robert doesn’t seek revenge and try to kill me to avenge Padre Cali, I won’t waste my spirituality on him.”
unit.target: Num in oculis tuis homicida insanus sim? Lumian hilariter respondit: “Dummodo Robertus ultam non quaerat et me interficere conetur ut Padre Cali vindicet, spiritualitatem meam in eum non consumam.”

unit.source: Phew… Amandina sighed in relief, then muttered while rubbing her shoulder,
unit.target: Phew… Amandina leviter suspiravit, deinde submurmuravit dum humerum suum terens:

unit.source: “You’re so cold-blooded. I thought you’d kill me to deal with the padre. That shot hurt, you know!”
unit.target: “Es tam frigide sanguine. Putabam te me interficere voluisse ut de Patre ageres. Illud ictus dolet, scis!”

unit.source: Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: Lumian irridens.

unit.source: Between being possessed by a Wraith until you die and getting shot, which would you have preferred?
unit.target: Inter possessionem ab umbra usque ad mortem et ictum percussum, quod mavis?

unit.source: “I don’t care what you think or the sacrifices—I made the right choice to save you, didn’t I?”
unit.target: Non curo quid sentias aut sacrificia—rectam electionem feci ut te servarem, nonne?

unit.source: Amandina, who was just grumbling out of habit, asked with interest upon hearing Lumian’s response, “So you’re willing to make big sacrifices and make correct choices to help important people?”
unit.target: Amandina, quae solum ex consuetudine murmurebat, cum responsum Lumiani audiret, cum studio rogavit: “Itaque magnis sacrificiis ac rectis electionibus magni momenti auxilium ferre paratus es?”

unit.source: “If, and I mean if, my desires were inflamed by a Demon and I’d become a monster without venting them, would you sacrifice yourself to help me?”
unit.target: Si, et id vere dico, desideria mea a Daemone inflammata essent et monstrum fierem sine ea exprimendis, sacrificabisne te ut mihi auxilies?

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Don’t have such unrealistic expectations of me. But don’t worry, I’ll find someone else willing to make that sacrifice for you.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Noli tales exspectationes irreales de me habere. Sed noli solliciti esse: alium inveniam qui talem sacrificium pro te ferre paratus sit.”

unit.source: His gaze swept over Camus, Lugano, and the unconscious Robert.
unit.target: Conspectus eius per Camus, Lugano, et Robertum inanimatum percurrit.

unit.source: Amandina just muttered, “How lame…”
unit.target: Amandina submurmuravit: “Quam ineptum…”

unit.source: Camus inwardly sighed, feeling he’d escaped the beautiful dream world.
unit.target: Camus intus suspiravit, sentiens se pulcherrimum mundum somniorum effugisse.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Robert again and said to Amandina, “Wake him up and talk to him. I need a favor from him.”
unit.target: Lumian iterum in Robertum intuebatur et Amandinae dixit: “Expergisce eum et cum eo loquere; mihi ab eo auxilium opus est.”

unit.source: If Robert refused, Camus, the interrogation specialist, was there to persuade him.
unit.target: Si Robert recusaverit, Camus, peritus interrogationis, praesto erat ad eum persuadendum.

unit.source: “Alright,” Amandina replied crisply, jolting Robert awake and informing her fiancé of their current predicament.
unit.target: “Recte,” respondit Amandina firmiter, Robertum excitans et sponsum suum de eorum praesenti casu certiorem faciens.

unit.source: She consciously omitted mentioning Padre Cali’s death to maintain the illusion that the Wraith had fled.
unit.target: Ea conscie omisit memorare mortem Patris Cali, ut illusionem retineret Wraith effugisse.

unit.source: “Will you help if I let you go?” Robert asked warily as he struggled to his feet.
unit.target: “Auxilium feres, si te dimitto?” inquit Robert caute, dum ad pedes se conaretur.

unit.source: Lumian gestured to Camus and Rhea. “You may not trust me, but do you trust the patrol team?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Camus et Rhea gestim faciens dixit: “Forsitan in me non confidiatis, sed in turmam vigiliarum creditis?”

unit.source: Robert fell silent for a moment before saying, “What’s the favor?”
unit.target: Robert momento silentium tenuit, deinde dicens: “Quid est favor?”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “Go to Twanaku’s house and do something for me.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Vade ad domum Twanaku et aliquid pro me fac.”

unit.source: Brieu Motel, second floor.
unit.target: Brieu Motel, tabulatum secundum.

unit.source: The man in the dark gray suit and the woman in the feathered hat heard soft chewing sounds coming from the corridor—a stark contrast to the shouts, cries, and moans echoing through the motel, as if it shouldn’t be happening during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Vir in habitu griseo obscuro et femina in pileo plumato audiverunt sonos masticandi lenes ex corridorio venire, in contrarium clamorum, gemitus, et lamentorum per motel resonantium, quasi non debere fieri in Festo Somniorum.

unit.source: Suddenly, the chewing stopped.
unit.target: Subito masticatio cessavit.

unit.source: Almost instantly, the man in the gray suit jumped up as if stabbed in the waist by a red-hot iron rod.
unit.target: Paene statim, vir in habitu griseo surrexit, quasi in lumbos ferro rubro calido percutus.

unit.source: His face tense with sweat beading on his brow, he sprinted to the first floor, traversing the entire staircase in the blink of an eye.
unit.target: Vultus eius, tensus et sudore in fronte stillante, celeriter ad primum tabulatum cucurrit, totam scalas in momento transiens.

unit.source: He ran all the way out of the Brieu Motel to the intersection before stopping, his expression twisted with fear and lingering dread.
unit.target: Currens ex Brieu Motel usque ad crucem viarum pervenit, deinde cessavit, vultu metu et trepidatione permixtus.

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” the woman in the light-colored dress asked, suddenly appearing beside him with confusion and seriousness.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” inquit femina in vestitu claro, subito iuxta eum apparens, cum confusione et gravitate.

unit.source: The man in the dark gray suit panted heavily.
unit.target: Vir in habitu griseo obscuro graviter anhelabat.

unit.source: “Phew, phew, phew, didn’t you feel it? That terrifying malice!
unit.target: “Phew, phew, phew, nonne sensisti? Illam terribilium malitiam!

unit.source: “The feeling of my heart being ripped out, my tongue torn away, my brain churned into thick soup…”
unit.target: Sensus cordis mei evellendi, linguae meae laceratae, cerebri mei in crassam pultem triturati…”

unit.source: 683 Dance
unit.target: 683 Saltatio

unit.source: Hearing her companion’s words, the woman in the light-colored dress’s expression turned solemn.
unit.target: Audivit verba comitis, et vultus feminae in veste clara induta in sollemnite versa est.

unit.source: “I had a similar feeling, but it wasn’t as specific as yours.”
unit.target: “Sensivi similem affectum, sed non ita specificum quam tuum.”
