unit.source: The man in the dark-gray suit visibly calmed down and glanced back over his shoulder.
unit.target: Vir in vestitu cinereo obscuro visibiliter se tranquillavit atque retrospexit super humerum.

unit.source: “Let’s hurry to our destination. There seem to be many abnormalities beyond our grasp here.”
unit.target: “Festinemus ad metam nostram. Hic videntur esse multa insolita extra nostram comprehensionem.”

unit.source: The woman in the light-colored dress gave a single nod of acknowledgment.
unit.target: Femina in veste clara unico annuendo agnitionem manifestavit.

unit.source: After ascertaining their direction, they quickened their pace and swiftly left the intersection behind them.
unit.target: Postquam viam suam cognovissent, celeritatem auguerunt atque per crucem viarum citissime reliquerunt.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Lumian, wearing a golden straw hat, led Amandina, Robert, and the others back to the small square from the side of Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian, pileum stramineum aureum gestans, Amandinam, Robertum, et ceteros ab latere Sanctae Sien Cathedralis ad parvum forum duxit.

unit.source: At that moment, Camus spotted figures lingering in the cemetery on the other side.
unit.target: Ad illud tempus, Camus figuras in coemeterio in altera parte morantes conspexit.

unit.source: Startled, he focused his gaze and realized they were pale‑white bones hung with tattered cloths and humanoid phantoms made of fine ashes.
unit.target: Stupefactus, oculos intendit et conscivit eos esse ossa pallide alba, vestimentis laceratis suspensa, atque phantasmata humanoides ex tenuis cineribus facta.

unit.source: Many upright tombstones lay on the ground, and many graves had clearly suffered damage.
unit.target: Multae lapides sepulcrales erecti in terra iacebant, et multa sepulcra manifeste laesa erant.

unit.source: “The awakened dead?” Camus furrowed his brow and asked Amandina. “The Dream Festival can also awaken bones and ashes?”
unit.target: “Mortui excitati?” Camus supercilia contraxit et Amandinae quaesivit. “Festum Somniorum etiam ossa et cineres excitare potest?”

unit.source: Regardless of life or death, they had to celebrate the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Sive vivi sive mortui, Festum Somniorum celebrandum esse videbatur?

unit.source: Amandina nodded nimbly.
unit.target: Amandina vivaciter annuit.

unit.source: “Isn’t that normal? Robert obtained superpowers from the Corpse Collector pathway during the Dream Festival. That’s the Death domain, so the Dream Festival itself has such—uh, characteristics.”
unit.target: “Nonne id commune est? Robertus in Festo Somniorum per iter Collectoris Cadaverum potentias supernaturales adeptus est. Id est regnum Mortis, itaque Festum Somniorum ipsa talia—eh, proprietates—habet.”

unit.source: Amandina was secretly pleased that her knowledge surpassed that of a seasoned patrol team member in this area.
unit.target: Amandina tacite laetabatur quod scientia eius praestaret illius periti custodis huius regionis.

unit.source: She consoled Camus, “Don’t worry. The bones and shadows in the cemetery are very peaceful. They’re completely different from the humans at the Dream Festival. As long as you don’t approach them, they won’t attack you. They’ll only wander around their graves.”
unit.target: Amandina Camum consolata dixit: “Noli timere. Ossa et umbrae in coemeterio valde tranquillae sunt. Ab hominibus in Festo Somniorum prorsus diffluunt. Dummodo non illos appropinques, te non oppugnabunt; solum circa sepulcra sua errabunt.”

unit.source: “Of course they’re peaceful,” Lumian, who was leading the way, chuckled. “They usually don’t have emotions or desires to suppress. They won’t form an intense projection in this dream.”
unit.target: “Certe tranquilli sunt,” risit Lumian, viam ducens. “Saepe affectus nec cupiditates habent; non efficiunt potentem praesentiam in hoc somnio.”

unit.source: The dead were emotionless!
unit.target: Mortui erant sine affectu!

unit.source: Of course, excluding those who had perished with resentment and hatred, those buried in Saint-Sien Cathedral’s cemetery must have undergone purification.
unit.target: Certe, excepto illis qui cum rancore et odio perierunt, qui in coemeterio Sanctae Sien Cathedralis sepulti sunt, purgationem subisse oportuisse censetur.

unit.source: “That’s not funny.” Amandina wanted to console her silent fiancé, but she felt she didn’t have the right after witnessing his indecency and being complicit in killing his lover.
unit.target: “Hoc non iocum est.” Amandina tacitum sponsum consolari cupivit, sed sensit se ius deesse, postquam eius turpitates conspexit et in scelere amantis interfectio particeps fuit.

unit.source: Everything she said seemed hypocritical, so she had no choice but to speak to Louis Berry instead.
unit.target: Omnia quae dixerat hypocrita videbantur; ideo non potuit nisi ad Ludovicum Berry loqui.

unit.source: She muttered inwardly, Hmph, as his fiancée notarized in the cathedral, it’s my legitimate right to punish my fiancé’s lover.
unit.target: Intime submurmuravit: “Hem, cum sponsa eius in cathedral notarata sit, mihi ius legitimum est amantem sponsi mei puniendum.”

unit.source: It’s a little overboard, but in the face of the blasphemer, the demon who preyed on a minor, being a little overboard is a revelation from God!
unit.target: Parum nimis, sed coram blasphemante et daemonio, qui parvulo nocuit, hoc nimis esse revelatio Dei censetur!

unit.source: The more she thought about it, the more right she felt.
unit.target: Quo magis id meditata est, eo magis se iustum sensit.

unit.source: Lumian walked swiftly along the shadows beside the road.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter secum ambulavit per umbras iuxta viam.

unit.source: After some thought, he said, “Will those killed during the Dream Festival awaken and become undead?”
unit.target: Post aliquod meditandum, dixit: “Eritne illi qui in Festo Somniorum interfecti sunt excitati atque quasi mortui iterum vivi facti?”

unit.source: “Yes, but it takes a long time. I’ve only encountered them near the end of the Dream Festival. They’re cold and aggressive,” Amandina recalled.
unit.target: “Ita, sed multum temporis requirit.” Eos solum prope finem Festi Somniorum convenisse meminit. “Frigidi et pugnaces sunt,” inquit Amandina.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Rhea asked, “When will the Dream Festival end?”
unit.target: Occasio captus, Rhea rogavit: “Quando finietur Festum Somniorum?”

unit.source: Amandina replied with a smile, “Haven’t you noticed? The wall clocks and pocket watches are still ticking. The Dream Festival ends just before dawn.”
unit.target: Amandina subrisu respondit: “Nonne animadvertistis? Horologia muraria et horologia portabilia adhuc tictitant. Festum Somniorum paulo ante auroram finitur.”

unit.source: “Is there a way to leave the Dream Festival early?” Lugano was concerned over this question.
unit.target: “Estne via Festum Somniorum mature relinquendi?” Lugano de hac quaestione sollicitus erat.

unit.source: Amandina glanced at Robert, who remained silent.
unit.target: Amandina Roberto intuebatur, qui silent inerat.

unit.source: “There’s no way. We can usually escape by sleeping in Twanaku’s house and being stimulated at the edge of the dream. Once the Dream Festival begins, we can only wait for it to end naturally.”
unit.target: “Nulla via est. Saepe evadere possumus, dormientes in domo Twanaku et excitati in margine somnii. Quondam Festum Somniorum coeptum est, solum exspectare eum naturaliter finiri possumus.”

unit.source: Lugano shut his mouth in disappointment and unconsciously took two steps closer to Lumian.
unit.target: Lugano os in destituenda clauserunt et inconscius duos passus propius ad Luminum fecit.

unit.source: Camus observed Amandina’s brisk strides and fell silent for a few seconds before asking, “Aren’t you going back to Palm Manor to protect your parents? Aren’t you worried they’ll die during the Dream Festival?”
unit.target: Camus Amandinae celeres gressus animadvertit et paucis momentis siluit antequam rogavit: “Nonne ad Palm Manor redeas ut parentes tuos protegas? Nonne sollicita es ne parentes tui in Festo Somniorum moriantur?”

unit.source: Amandina pursed her lips and said with a complicated smile, “During last year’s Dream Festival, I rushed back to protect them. I didn’t expect them to have a ‘happy’ time and not be in any danger…”
unit.target: Amandina labra contraxit et subrisu implicato dixit: “Durante Festo Somniorum anni praeteriti, celeriter redii ut eos protegerem. Nondum exspectavi eos tempus ‘felicem’ agere nec in quacumque periculo versari…”

unit.source: “My mother prefers the lowest‑class, filthiest, yet relatively muscular slaves to do the deed while she curses them. I don’t know what mental issues that stems from or which areas that indulges, but this way, the male slaves definitely won’t kill her. Instead, her jealous lady’s maids and female slaves who get too close will be subdued and forced to join if they approach.”
unit.target: “Mater mea praeoptat ut servi ex classe infima, spurcissimi, sed aliquantulum musculosi rem efficiant, dum eos maledicit. Nescio ex quibus perturbationibus mentis hoc oritur aut quibus inclinationibus se indulgat; sed hoc modo, servi masculi certe eam non occiderunt. Immo, ancillae zelantes dominae suae atque servi feminae, qui nimis accedant, subibuntur et coacti erunt ut se coniungant.”

unit.source: “As for my father, he relied on his career in the Southern Continent to obtain the Legion of Honor medal. When awake, he’s always afraid of attacks and slave riots. He built several bunkers in the manor and stockpiled food and weapons. He constantly practices combat, shooting, and military tactics. Even during the Dream Festival, it would be very difficult for the servants and slaves to take him down. They’d have to break through layers of defenses until he retreats to a bunker.”
unit.target: “Quod ad patrem meum attinet, in curriculo suo in Continente Meridionali confisus est ut medalliam Legionis Honoris obtineret. Cum vigilat, semper impetum et seditionem servorum timebat. In manerio plura castra subterranea aedificavit et cibum armaque condidit. Cotidie in pugna, telis iaciendis, et consiliis militaribus exerceret. Etiam in Festo Somniorum, a servis et ministris eum deponere valde difficile esset. Opus esset ut per stratas defensionum rupirent, donec in castra subterranea se recipiat.”

unit.source: “Unless a Beyonder deliberately goes after them, they’ll be very safe. If I stayed to protect them, it might be more dangerous—I mean I’m more dangerous. I might not tolerate the ‘love’ of those men or the jealousy of those women. I don’t wish to kill too many people either.”
unit.target: “Nisi Beyonder eos deliberatis persequeretur, valde tuti erunt. Si manerem ut eos protegerem, forsitan periculosior fierem—scilicet, ipse periculosior sum. Fortasse non perferrem ‘amorem’ illorum virorum aut zelam illorum feminarum. Ego quoque nolo nimis multos interficere.”

unit.source: Could it be that she’s more afraid of sensing the malice hidden in her family and friends’ hearts during the unconstrained Dream Festival?
unit.target: Num ita sit, ut magis timeat malitiam in cordibus familiae atque amicorum latentem in Festo Somniorum intemerato percipiendi?

unit.source: She’d rather gallivant outside and see others’ dark sides than experience that herself?
unit.target: Malit foras vagari et obscuras aliorum facies videre, quam id ipsa experiri.

unit.source: Lumian could understand Amandina’s rationale.
unit.target: Lumian rationem Amandinae intellexit.

unit.source: He dropped the subject and turned to the silent Robert.
unit.target: Rem reliquit et ad silentem Robertum se convertit.

unit.source: “How different is your spirit channeling during the Dream Festival from usual? Will those spirits become more violent and difficult to communicate with?”
unit.target: “Quantum differt transmissio spirituum tua in Festo Somniorum ab illa solita? Eosne spiritus magis violenti atque difficiliores ad colloquendum fient?”

unit.source: Robert, now in a white shirt and black pants, was silent for a few seconds before saying, “It’s no different.”
unit.target: Robert, nunc in camisia alba et braccis nigris indutus, paucis momentis silentium tulit antequam dixit: “Non differt.”

unit.source: Could the excessive emotions and desires of the special dream exclusively target living creatures, leaving spirits unaffected by their typical lack of self‑control?
unit.target: Num affectus atque cupiditates excessivae huius specialis somnii solum creaturas vivas intingant, et spiritus, solito carentes moderationis, intacti maneant?

unit.source: Or is the spirit world and its denizens fake—part of the dream aligning with Robert’s imagination?
unit.target: An mundus spirituum et incolae eius ficti sunt—pars somnii, imaginationi Roberti conformata?

unit.source: It’s likely the latter possibility.
unit.target: Probabiliter ultima possibilitas est.

unit.source: Spirit Mediums don’t just connect with local spirits to borrow power.
unit.target: Medium spirituum non solum cum spiritibus localibus communicant ad potestatem mutuandam.

unit.source: Robert didn’t say some channeling was impossible in the dream… As Lumian’s thoughts raced, he made a speculation.
unit.target: Robert non affirmavit aliquam conductionem in somnio impossibilem esse… Dum celeriter Luminum cogitationes convergebantur, speculationem fecit.

unit.source: Lumian led Camus and the others through the intersection, quickly returning to Twanaku’s house.
unit.target: Lumian Camum et ceteros per crucem viarum duxit, celeriter ad domum Twanaku redeunte.

unit.source: He had asked about spirit channeling because it closely related to what he planned to do.
unit.target: Rogaverat de conductione spirituum, quia ad id quod facere cogitabat arcte pertinebat.

unit.source: Standing on the second floor of Hisoka’s house, Lumian said to the cold and slightly effeminate Robert, “Have you ever completed a spirit channeling here?”
unit.target: In secundo tabulato domus Hisoka stans, Lumian ad Robertum frigidum et paululum effeminatum dixit: “Numquamne hic conductionem spirituum perfecisti?”

unit.source: “I’ve tried. I can establish connections with surrounding spirits, but there’s nothing special about it,” Robert replied honestly.
unit.target: “Conatus sum. Connexiones cum spiritibus circumstantiis instituere possum, sed nihil speciale illud habet,” respondit Robert sincero animo.

unit.source: Amandina chimed in, “He tried it in reality, in the dream, and during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Amandina addidit: “Id in re, in somnio, atque in Festo Somniorum temptavit.

unit.source: “We’re all curious about this place’s uniqueness and want to figure out the reason, but those spirits don’t know anything about it.”
unit.target: Omnes nos singularitate huius loci curiosi sumus et rationem detegere volumus, sed illi spiritus nihil de eo sciunt.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded, took out his golden pocket watch, glanced at it, and said, “Come up to me in two minutes and help me with a designated spirit channeling. All of you can come up.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit, deponens aureum horologium portatile, eum intuebatur, et dixit: “Ascende ad me intra duo minuta et adiuva me in conductione spirituum designata. Omnes vos ad me ascendere potestis.”

unit.source: Robert breathed a relieved sigh, realizing he wouldn’t face this alone.
unit.target: Robert levitate suspiravit, intellegens se hoc non solum subiturum esse.

unit.source: On the third floor, in Hisoka’s bedroom, Lumian spread his arms and performed the Dancer’s Summoning Dance once more.
unit.target: In tertio tabulato, in cubiculo Hisoka, Lumian brachia patefecit et iterum Saltationem Evocatricem Saltatoris egit.

unit.source: Previously, using the Mystery Prying Glasses in the real world, he realized this place had a mysterious connection to the black boulder.
unit.target: Prius, utens speculis arcani explorandi in mundo reali, animadvertit hunc locum mysticam coniunctionem habere cum saxo nigro.

unit.source: Just now, Padre Cali had mentioned that the black boulder was actually an ancient tomb—the source of his, Robert’s, Amandina’s, and even “Hisoka” Twanaku’s superpowers, as well as the Dream Festival itself.
unit.target: Modo, Padre Cali commemoravit saxum nigrum revera sepulcrum antiquum esse—fons potentiarum mearum, Roberti, Amandinae, atque etiam “Hisoka” Twanaku, simulque ipse Festum Somniorum.

unit.source: In that case, performing the Summoning Dance in Hisoka’s house might attract special, strange items connected to the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Quoque igitur, Saltationem Evocatricem in domo Hisoka peragendo, specialia et mirabilia, quae ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pertineant, allicere potest.

unit.source: Perhaps he could obtain important information about the tomb or the corpse inside.
unit.target: Fortasse notitiam magni momenti de sepulcro aut cadavere intus obtinere poterit.

unit.source: It was much safer than using the Mystery Prying Glasses or dancing after reaching the tomb.
unit.target: Multo tutius erat quam utens speculis arcani explorandi aut saltatione post sepulcrum pertingendo.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian had no intention of directly attaching any summoned entity to himself.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian non intendebat ullam entitatem evocatam directe sibi affigere.

unit.source: He had enlisted Robert’s help to ensure safer, more effective spirit channeling.
unit.target: Ad conductionem spirituum tutiorem et efficaciorem perficiendam, auxilium Roberti obtinuit.

unit.source: A Spirit Medium could communicate with surrounding spirits or through specific directions and descriptions.
unit.target: Medium spirituum cum spiritibus circumstantiis aut per certas instructiones et descriptiones communicare poterat.

unit.source: However, they couldn’t rely on the Summoning Dance and a location’s uniqueness to attract more distant, hidden spirits like a Dancer could.
unit.target: Tamen in Saltatione Evocatoria et singularitate loci confidere non poterant, ut saltator spiritus remotiores et occultos allicere posset.

unit.source: A Spirit Medium could borrow spirits’ power to achieve supernatural effects and communicate with them in detail.
unit.target: Medium spirituum potentiam mutuo sumere poterat ad effectus supernaturales efficiendos et cum illis in singulari modo communicare.

unit.source: A Dancer could choose to obtain a trait, ability, or limited memory fragment.
unit.target: Saltator eligere poterat ut aliquam indolem, facultatem, aut memoriam finitam obtineret.

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s contorted, sonorous, bizarre dance, his spirituality combined with the environment’s unique power, spreading in all directions.
unit.target: In medio saltationis contortae, sonorae, et mirabilis Luminum, spiritualitas eius cum singulari potentia ambientis commissa est, in omnes partes diffundens.

unit.source: As the intense dance neared its climax, something finally emerged from underground and condensed on the glass‑enclosed window.
unit.target: Cum saltatio intensa ad apicem accedebat, aliquid tandem ex subterraneo emersit et in fenestra vitrea inclusa condensatum apparuit.

unit.source: A human‑like shadow wore a black robe, strikingly resembling the tomb keeper Lumian encountered at the dream’s edge, yet with differences.
unit.target: Umbra humano similis, veste nigra induta, prodigiose sepulcri custos, quem Luminum in limine somnii convenit, similis apparuit, attamen cum nonnullis differentibus.

unit.source: The hooded face seemed fixated on Lumian, eager yet sensing The Fool’s seal and the Blood Emperor’s residual aura, not daring to truly possess him.
unit.target: Vultus cucullatus in Luminum adfixus videbatur, cupidus tamen, Sigillum Stulti atque remanentem aurem Sanguinis Imperatoris sentiens, nec ausus vere eum possidere.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t force orders. He continued the Summoning Dance until Robert and the others arrived, then slowed to a halt.
unit.target: Lumian mandata non coegit. Saltationem Evocatricem persequebatur usque dum Robertus et ceteri advenissent, deinde paulatim cessavit.

unit.source: During this, he pointed at the black‑robed figure and told Robert, “Hurry up and communicate with it.”
unit.target: Interea, indicans personam veste nigra indutam, Roberto dixit: “Festina et cum ea comunica!”

unit.source: Robert nodded slightly, retrieving a bottle of Full Moon Essence Oil from his pocket.
unit.target: Robert leviter annuit, et laguncam Olei Esentiae Lunae Plenilunii ex sinu suo extraxit.

unit.source: 684 Two Answers
unit.target: 684 Duae Responsiones

unit.source: Observing Louis Berry’s peculiar sacrificial dance drawing to a close, Robert wasted no time.
unit.target: Spectans saltationem sacrificii peculiarem Ludovii Berry ad finem tendentem, Robertus nullum tempus perdidit.

unit.source: He hastily poured some Full Moon Essence Oil into his palm, utilizing his abilities to fuse it with his spirituality and rapidly dissipate it.
unit.target: Festinanter effudit aliquantum olei essentiae Lunae plenae in palmam suam, utens facultatibus suis id cum spiritualitate sua coalescere atque celeriter dissipare.

unit.source: Camus, Amandina, and the others immediately caught a refreshing, psychedelic fragrance.
unit.target: Camus, Amandina, et ceteri statim perceperunt odorem refocillantem et inebriantem.

unit.source: They felt their spirits were drunk, about to float out of their bodies.
unit.target: Sentiebant spiritus eorum inebriatos esse, ut ex corporibus emergere imminent.

unit.source: Robert’s voice echoed softly, distantly in their ears, causing their thoughts to drift farther and farther away.
unit.target: Vox Roberti resonabat molliter, procul in auribus eorum, faciens ut cogitationes eorum longe ac longe evanescerent.

unit.source: Fortunately, they weren’t channeling targets, so they managed relative control.
unit.target: Fortunato, non destinabantur ut canales spirituum, ideo moderationem relative retinuerunt.

unit.source: The black-robed figure gradually left the glass window, approaching Robert.
unit.target: Figura nigro vestita gradatim fenestram vitream reliquit, ad Robertum accedens.

unit.source: Suddenly, the shadow vanished.
unit.target: Subito, umbra evanuit.

unit.source: Robert lowered his head, then slowly looked up, his face tainted by the night sky yet with an obvious sinister aura.
unit.target: Robertus caput inclinavit, deinde lente extulit oculos, facies eius caelo nocturno tincta, sed aura sinistra manifesta eminens.

unit.source: His eyes were dark.
unit.target: Oculi eius erant obscuri.

unit.source: Observing this, Lumian ended the Summoning Dance, positioning himself three meters from Robert.
unit.target: Observans hoc, Lumian saltationem evocatoria finivit, se tribus metris ab Roberto collocans.

unit.source: Although he’d intended for Robert to channel the spirit directly while he provided questions, the peculiar shadow had instead attached itself to Robert.
unit.target: Etsi propositum habebat Robertum spiritum directe canalis retinere, dum ipse quaestiones afferret, insolita umbra tamen ad Robertum se adligavit.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: This too was a form of spirit channeling—many Spirit Mediums allowed a target’s spirit to communicate through their mouth, answering certain people’s questions.
unit.target: Hoc quoque erat forma canalizationis spiritus—multae media spirituum permittebant spiritum destinatario per os suum communicare, quaestiones quibusdam hominibus respondentibus.

unit.source: Gazing at the sinister-looking Robert, Lumian pondered briefly, then said, “Do you know what happened to the people who lived here six years ago?”
unit.target: Aspectans Robertum aspectu sinistro, Lumian brevi tempore meditatus est, deinde dixit: “Scisne quid acciderit hominibus qui hic ante sex annos vixerunt?”

unit.source: He planned to start simple, least likely to cause anomalies, constantly adjusting direction, tone, and terminology based on the actual situation.
unit.target: Consilium habebat simpliciter incipere, quod minime probabiliter anomalias excitaret, continuo directionem, tonum, et vocabula secundum rem actualem aptans.

unit.source: Robert opened his mouth, letting out a shrill voice unlike his own.
unit.target: Robertus os aperuit, efferens vocem stridulam, alienam ipsi.

unit.source: “Affected, performed a ritual, all perished.”
unit.target: Affecti, ritum exsecuti, omnes perierunt.

unit.source: This answer puzzled the others, including Camus, unsure if significant information was hidden.
unit.target: Hoc responsum ceteros perplexos reliquit, inter quos etiam Camus, incertos an notitia gravis occulta esset.

unit.source: Apart from Lugano, everyone guessed Louis asked about the fire engulfing the Twanaku family, with the spirit’s answer implying a cult or evil gods’ influence.
unit.target: Praeter Lugano, omnes putabant Louis quaesivisse de igne, qui familiam Twanaku devorabat, cum responsio spiritus insinuaretur cultui aut malis deis.

unit.source: As a Conspirer, relevant information instantly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Ut Conspirator, notitiae pertinentes statim in mente Lumiani apparuerunt.

unit.source: The suppressed emotions and desires of everyone in Tizamo would be absorbed by the dream, gradually accumulating to form corresponding dream projections.
unit.target: Emotiones repressae et desideria omnium in Tizamo somnio absorbeerentur, paulatim accumulanda ut repraesentationes somniorum correspondentes formarentur.

unit.source: Like the gravekeepers, these projections would hide in the dream’s chaotic zone, guarding the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Sicut custodes sepulchri, hae repraesentationes in zona caotica somnii latebunt, sepulcrum antiquum nigrum custodiantes.

unit.source: In previous explorations, I saw the black-robed gravekeeper and projections surrounding the ancient tomb in dream fragments.
unit.target: In explorationibus praeteritis, vidi custodem sepulchri in veste nigra et repraesentationes circum antiquum sepulcrum in fragmentis somniorum.

unit.source: One projection was the remaining figure of “Hisoka” Twanaku.
unit.target: Una repraesentatio fuit figura residua "Hisoka" Twanaku.

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku returned to Tizamo two or three times yearly for about a week.
unit.target: "Hisoka" Twanaku ad Tizamo redibat bis vel ter in anno, per circiter hebdomadam.

unit.source: After leaving, his corresponding projection would gradually fade until vanishing.
unit.target: Postquam discessit, repraesentatio eius correspondens paulatim evanescere coepit, donec prorsus evanuit.

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku had become a Devil pathway Beyonder after the fire incident.
unit.target: "Hisoka" Twanaku post incendium factus est Beyonder viae Diaboli.

unit.source: The Nois family’s Demon…
unit.target: Daemon familiae Nois…

unit.source: This information appeared simultaneously in Lumian’s mind, like disconnected nodes in a spider’s web.
unit.target: Haec notitia simul in mente Lumiani apparuit, instar nodorum disiunctorum in tela araneae.

unit.source: Soon, Lumian made a guess.
unit.target: Mox Lumian coniecturam fecit.

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku returned to Tizamo once or twice outside the Dream Festival, each visit lasting a week or more? Was this to ensure his dream projection didn’t completely disappear, allowing the dream to absorb some of his malice?
unit.target: "Hisoka" Twanaku extra Festum Somniorum Tizamo redibat semel aut bis, quarum unaquaeque visita per hebdomadam aut diutius durabat? Num hoc factum est ut repraesentationem somnii eius non omnino evaniret, sinens somnium aliquod ex malitia eius absorbere?

unit.source: Do the projections and gravekeepers stay around the ancient tomb because it has something special that unknowingly affects them, like the tomb or the cold corpse inside?
unit.target: Num repraesentationes et custodes sepulchri circa sepulcrum antiquum manent, quia illud aliquid speciale habet quod eos incognite afficit, ut sepulcrum aut corpus frigidum intus?

unit.source: If sacrificial rituals were part of the tomb’s defense, when the Dream Festival commences and the projections return to their bodies, would some deeply affected humans attempt to imitate the gravekeeper’s actions and perform a ritual?
unit.target: Si ritus sacrificiales essent pars defensionis sepulchri, cum Festum Somniorum inciperet et repraesentationes ad corpora sua redirent, num aliqui homines valde affecti conari velint custodes imitari et ritum exsequi?

unit.source: If they failed, would their entire family perish, corrupting the house and forming a subtle connection to the black ancient tomb?
unit.target: Si deficerent, num tota familia periret, domum corrumpendo atque nexum subtiliter cum sepulcro antiquo nigro formans?

unit.source: Yes, that’s a possibility, but I can’t fit the Nois family’s Demon or Hisoka becoming a Devil pathway Beyonder into this web of information…
unit.target: Ita, hoc possibile est, sed Demon familiae Nois aut "Hisoka" Twanaku, factus Beyonder viae Diaboli, in hunc reticulum informationis inserere non possum.

unit.source: What would happen if I inserted that?
unit.target: Quid accideret, si id insererem?

unit.source: Lumian’s heart stirred as he considered another possibility.
unit.target: Cor Lumiani commotum est, cum alteram possibilitatem consideravit.

unit.source: It wasn’t just the black ancient tomb or its cold corpse affecting the Twanaku family.
unit.target: Non solum sepulcrum antiquum nigrum aut corpus eius frigidum familiae Twanaku afficiebant.

unit.source: The Nois family’s Demon was also affected!
unit.target: Daemon familiae Nois quoque afficiebatur!

unit.source: Perhaps the Demon had been coveting the corpse or the source of abnormality.
unit.target: Fortasse Daemon concupierat corpus aut fons abnormitatis.

unit.source: For this reason, it secretly influenced the Twanaku family, giving them knowledge.
unit.target: Propter hoc, occulte familiam Twanaku affecit, eis scientiam tradens.

unit.source: Once the Dream Festival began, through its influence in the real world, it magnified their corresponding desires in the dream.
unit.target: Cum Festum Somniorum inciperet, per suam influentiam in mundo reali, eorum desideria correspondenta in somnio augebat.

unit.source: Coupled with the loss of self-control and wild indulgence brought by the Dream Festival, the Twanaku family took the initiative to attempt the sacrificial process from the ritual or dream projection given by the Demon, leading to subsequent abnormalities?
unit.target: Coniuncto cum amissione sui temperamenti et ferocitate indulgentiae, quae Festum Somniorum attulit, familia Twanaku inceptum cepit tentandi processum sacrificii ex ritu aut repraesentatione somnii a Daemone traditam, quod ad posteriores anomalias duxit?

unit.source: Had the Demon discovered Hisoka’s uniqueness and lured him to the Devil pathway?
unit.target: Num Daemon singularitatem "Hisoka" detexit et eum ad viam Diaboli attraxit?

unit.source: Yes, this explains why only the Twanaku family did such a thing when everyone has a dream projection and why is this house unique enough to allow lucid dreaming…
unit.target: Ita, hoc explicat cur sola familia Twanaku tale fecerit, cum omnes repraesentationes somniorum haberent, et cur haec domus tam singularis sit ut somnia lucida sinat.

unit.source: The next crucial task is guarding against the Demon.
unit.target: Proximum negotium cruciale est contra Daemonem custodire.

unit.source: It probably can’t participate personally, but its minions would definitely appear…
unit.target: Probabiliter ipse personaliter non participabit, sed ministri eius certe apparebunt.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced, Lumian gained a deeper understanding of the situation.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes festinanter percurrebant, Lumian rem melius intellexit.

unit.source: He looked at the shadow possessing Robert and changed his question.
unit.target: Aspectavit umbram, quae Robertum possidebat, et quaestionem suam mutavit.

unit.source: “Where are the gravekeepers? Where have they gone?”
unit.target: Ubi sunt custodes sepulchri? Quo abierunt?

unit.source: Robert’s shadowed face replied shrilly, “Dream Festival begins, the tomb opens. Need to hide.”
unit.target: Facies umbrata Roberti respondit stridenter: "Festum Somniorum incipit, sepulcrum aperitur. Occultandum est."

unit.source: Need to hide? After commencement, does the tomb become abnormally dangerous or pose a hidden danger to the gravekeepers?
unit.target: Occultandum est? Post initium, num sepulcrum anomale periculosum fiat aut occultum periculum custodes sepulchri immineret?

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Amandina. This lady, Robert, and Padre Cali arrived at the black ancient tomb during the Dream Festival, easily obtaining powers through contact.
unit.target: Lumian Amandinae aspexit. Haec domina, Robertus, et Padre Cali ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum per Festum Somniorum pervenerunt, vires per contactum facile adepti.

unit.source: Where is this hidden danger? How is it dangerous? And where are the gravekeepers?
unit.target: Ubi est hoc periculum absconditum? Quomodo periculosum est? Et ubi sunt custodes sepulchri?

unit.source: Something must be amiss.
unit.target: Aliquid male est.

unit.source: Amandina felt inexplicable fear under Louis Berry’s gaze.
unit.target: Amandina inexplicabilem formidinem sub aspectu Ludovii Berry sensit.

unit.source: Her voice trembled as she asked, “Is there a problem with this answer?”
unit.target: Vox eius tremuit cum rogabat: "Estne quaestio in hoc responsu?"

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “The gravekeepers need to hide. Why didn’t you two?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Custodes sepulchri se occultare debent. Cur vos duo non id fecistis?"

unit.source: Before Amandina could delve deeper, she saw Robert’s cold, dark face contort in agony.
unit.target: Antequam Amandina propius discere poterat, vidit faciem Roberti frigida et obscura, in dolore distortam.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian sighed, “End the spirit channeling.”
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian suspiravit: "Desine canalizationem spiritus."

unit.source: If it continued, something would happen to Robert.
unit.target: Si id continuaret, aliquid Roberti eveniret.

unit.source: Robert retained complete autonomy and a certain mobility level.
unit.target: Robertus plenam autonomiam et certum gradum mobilitatis retinuit.

unit.source: He immediately uttered two words in ancient Hermes to make the spirit leave his body.
unit.target: Statim duas verba in antiquo sermone Hermetico edixit, ut spiritus ex corpore suo exiret.

unit.source: The shadow attached to him remained unresponsive, and the agony on his face intensified.
unit.target: Umbra, quae ei adhaesit, nihil respondit, et dolor in facie eius intensus factus est.

unit.source: Slowly, Robert drew a dagger and stabbed his finger.
unit.target: Lente, Robertus pugionem extraxit et digitum suum confodit.

unit.source: Drops of bright red blood, mixed with his Spirit Medium spirituality, sprayed towards the window like bead chains.
unit.target: Guttae sanguinis rubri lucidi, cum spiritualitate medii spirituum eius mixta, in fenestram sparsae sunt, ut catenae perlarum.

unit.source: While doing so, Robert bellowed in ancient Hermes, “Leave!”
unit.target: Dum hoc faceret, Robertus in antiquo sermone Hermetico fremuit: "Discede!"

unit.source: The black-robed shadow detached from Robert’s body, chasing after the blood and vanishing from the glass window.
unit.target: Umbra in veste nigra a corpore Roberti se separavit, sanguinem insequens et ex fenestra vitrea evanescens.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Lumian retracted his consciousness from his right hand, no longer preparing any “snorting.”
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian suam conscientiam ex manu dextro retraxit, nec amplius ullum "sonitum sufflatorium" praeparabat.

unit.source: He breathed a relieved sigh and said to Camus, Amandina, and the others, “Wait for me on the second floor.”
unit.target: Suspiravit leviter et dixit ad Camum, Amandinam, et ceteros: "Exspectate me in secundo tabulato."

unit.source: “What now…” Amandina muttered, turning to head downstairs.
unit.target: "Quid nunc..." Amandina submurmuravit, conversans ut deorsum proficisceretur.

unit.source: In just over ten seconds, silence returned to the third floor.
unit.target: In paulo plus quam decem secundis, silentium in tertio tabulato rediit.

unit.source: Lumian retrieved ingredients from his Traveler’s Bag and set up a ritual, attempting to summon Madam Magician’s messenger.
unit.target: Lumian ex sacco viatoris sui ingredientes extraxit et ritum constituit, conans nuntium Dominae Magicae evocare.

unit.source: Unfortunately, being a dream prevented success.
unit.target: Infeliciter, somnium successum impedivit.

unit.source: Having anticipated this, Lumian wasn’t overly disappointed.
unit.target: Hoc praevidens, Lumian non nimis deiectus est.

unit.source: Though the early Dream Festival arrival prevented reporting the latest situation to Madam Magician, adding significant risks, such problems were bound to arise.
unit.target: Quamquam adventus Festi Somniorum praecoce relationem de novissima condicione Dominae Magicae prohibuit, additis periculis significantibus, talia problemata oriri debebant.

unit.source: He was mentally prepared.
unit.target: Mentibus praeparatus erat.

unit.source: Though Hunters liked to plan ahead, they weren’t afraid of battle.
unit.target: Quamquam Venatores praevidere libebant, bellum non timebant.

unit.source: Lumian was even a little excited, not just from the Dream Festival’s faint influence.
unit.target: Lumian etiam paulo excitatus erat, non solum ex tenuo influentia Festi Somniorum.

unit.source: After stowing his belongings, Lumian descended to the second floor and said directly to Robert and Amandina, “Which one of you will take me to the black boulder?”
unit.target: Postquam supellectilem suam recondidit, Lumian ad secundum tabulatum descendit atque directe ad Robertum et Amandinam dixit: "Quis ex vobis me ad saxum nigrum ducat?"

unit.source: He had analyzed their situations, realizing that Amandina, Robert, and Padre Cali had easily arrived at the black ancient tomb and obtained powers, all led by those who had touched it.
unit.target: Eum earum condiciones perspexerat, intellegens Amandinam, Robertum, et Padre Cali facile ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum perventos esse et vires adeptos habere, omnes ab iis qui illum tetigerant ductos.

unit.source: Of course, they shared more than one thing in common.
unit.target: Certe, plura in commune habebant.

unit.source: Robert fell silent, wanting to say “Didn’t you promise to let me go after helping?” but not daring.
unit.target: Robertus silentium cepit, cupiens dicere "Nonne pollebatis me dimittiturum post auxilium?" sed non ausus est.

unit.source: Amandina glanced at the silent Robert, pursed her lips and said to Lumian, “Me!”
unit.target: Amandina ad Robertum silentem aspexit, labra comprimit et Lumiani dixit: "Me!"

unit.source: Then, she added, “I want to see if I can obtain more superpowers.”
unit.target: Deinde addidit: "Volo videre, si plures potentias supernaturales adipisci possim."

unit.source: Lumian nodded and told Robert, “You may leave.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et Roberto dixit: "Abi."

unit.source: Robert glanced at Lumian, then Amandina.
unit.target: Robertus in Lumianum deinceps aspexit, deinde in Amandinam.

unit.source: Without a word, he walked out of Twanaku’s house.
unit.target: Sine verbo, domum Twanaku reliquit.

unit.source: “Gosh, he might think I brought you to the cathedral to deal with Padre Cali and embarrass him. Gosh, I was the one who brought you there,” Amandina exclaimed after Robert left.
unit.target: "Eheu, putaret se existimare me vos ad cathedralem duxisse ut cum Padre Cali agerem et eum dedicerem. Eheu, ego fui qui vos iluc duxisse," exclamavit Amandina postquam Robert discessit.

unit.source: Rhea, who had already picked up most arrows, earnestly consoled her, “But you purified the cathedral for God. Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: Rhea, quae iam plerasque sagittas collegerat, eam sincere consolata est, dicens: "Sed tu cathedralam pro Deo purgasti. Laudate Solem!"

unit.source: Amandina spread her arms as well. “Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: Amandina quoque brachia extendit. "Laudate Solem!"

unit.source: After their exchange, Lumian said to Camus and Rhea, “Next, I’m going to the black ancient tomb. It’s up to you to decide if you want to go.”
unit.target: Post eorum sermonem, Lumian ad Camum et Rhea dixit: "Deinde ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum ibo; vobis est decernere, si ire velitis."

unit.source: “I…” Lugano tried to speak, but Lumian interrupted with a smile. “You must go.”
unit.target: "I..." Lugano conari verba edicere, sed Lumian subridens intermisit: "Tibi oportet ire."

unit.source: Lugano shut his mouth.
unit.target: Lugano os clausit.

unit.source: Camus and Rhea exchanged glances and spoke in unison, “I’m coming too.”
unit.target: Camus et Rhea oculis se invicem aspexerunt et simul dixerunt: "Ego quoque venio."

unit.source: Lumian didn’t persuade them, simply nodding. “Then let’s set off now.”
unit.target: Lumian eos non convincit, sed simpliciter annuens: "Ergo nunc eamus."

unit.source: 685 Illusion
unit.target: 685 Illusio

unit.source: Outside Tizamo, near the entrance to the forest, Lumian and his companions heard gunshots and shouts echoing from the direction of the military camp.
unit.target: Extra Tizamo, prope aditum ad silvam, Lumian et comitēs eius sonitus sclopetorum acclamationumque ex regione castri militāri resonantes audiverunt.

unit.source: The population was denser here compared to the town and plantations, and more heavily armed.
unit.target: Hic incolārum densitas, comparāta cum oppidō et plantationibus, maior erat, et melius armātī erant.

unit.source: Many lives were lost each year in this area.
unit.target: Multae vitāe singulīs annīs in hac regione perierunt.

unit.source: Camus retracted his gaze and let out a sigh of resignation, like a world‐weary middle‐aged man.
unit.target: Camus oculōs retrāxit et suspirium resignationis edidit, velut vir medīae aetātis, mundo fessa.

unit.source: He knew he was powerless to stop the violence.
unit.target: Sciebat se vim violentiae prohibēre nōn posse.

unit.source: His only hope was to find a way to end the Dream Festival as quickly as possible, so that more people might survive.
unit.target: Unīca eius spes erat viam inveniendi ad Festum Somniorum quam celerrime finendum, ut plūrēs superessent.

unit.source: This was why he had chosen to follow Louis Berry to the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Idcirco elegit se sequerī Louis Berry ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

unit.source: If Camus were alone, the rational choice would be to find a secluded corner and hide until dawn, until the Dream Festival concluded—just like Kolobo planned to do.
unit.target: Sī Camus sōlus esset, optiō ratiōnābilis esset angulum remotum inveniendō et se celāre usque ad aurōram, donec Festum Somniorum finīretur—sicut Kolobo consiliāverat.

unit.source: However, after witnessing Louis Berry’s formidable strength and realizing the adventurer was willing to take the risk of approaching the black ancient tomb, Camus felt compelled to take action himself.
unit.target: Tamen, postquam vim formidābilis Louis Berry visus est et intellexit adventarium perīculum capere ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum appropinquare, Camus se īpsum ad agendum compellītus sensit.

unit.source: Lumian gazed ahead, trailing Amandina’s light footsteps as she turned onto a narrow path threading into the forest.
unit.target: Lumian ante ōculos spectābat, vestigia levia Amandinae sequerens, dum illa in angustum semitām in silvam convolūtam intrābat.

unit.source: He harbored no illusions about single-handedly putting an end to the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Nullās habebat illūsiōnēs de sē sōlō Festum Somniorum conclusūrum esse.

unit.source: His objectives for this mission had always been clear: Find the gold Hisoka had obtained, along with the item he had procured from the Nois family’s Demon.
unit.target: Scopōs eius huius missionis semper clārōs fuisse: aurum, quod Hisoka adeptus erat, atque rem quam a dāemone familiæ Nois obtinerat, reperīre.

unit.source: Uncover what the key April Fool’s member was scheming, to prevent Hisoka’s legacy from materializing.
unit.target: Detegere quid membrum Aprilis Stultōrum consilium teneret, nē legātum Hisoka materialiter exsisteret.

unit.source: This was both the duty of a Tarot Club Minor Arcana card holder, and a reflection of Lumian’s wariness towards Hisoka.
unit.target: Hoc tum erat officium tenentis chartam Minōris Arcanae in Tarot Club, tum imāgo sollicitae vigilantiae Lumiani erga Hisoka.

unit.source: After discovering the dream projection Hisoka had left behind, Lumian feared his adversary might exploit pre-arranged measures and the dream projection to resurrect himself to some degree during the Dream Festival, returning to the real world as a Wraith or evil spirit.
unit.target: Postquam proiēctiōnem somnī, quam Hisoka relīquīerat, invēnīt, Lumian timuit adversārium suum praeordināta consilia et illam proiēctiōnem ad se aliquatenus reviviscendō in Festō Somniorum adhibēri posse, redeundum in mundum rēā ut umbra aut spiritus maleficus.

unit.source: He was determined not to give Hisoka that chance.
unit.target: Statuĕre volebat nē Hisoka illam occāsiōnem tribueret.

unit.source: After hearing Padre Cali’s confession, Lumian’s suspicions only intensified.
unit.target: Post audītam confessionem Padre Cali, suspītiōnēs Lumiani sōlū intensae sunt.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Hisoka returned to Tizamo each year to participate in the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Hisoka quotanniēs ad Tizamo redibat ut in Festō Somniorum particiPARet.

unit.source: He required no other host, and this unique dream usually proceeded without any abnormalities.
unit.target: Nullum alium hospitem requīrēbat, et hoc somnium únicum plērūmque sīne anomalīs procedebat.

unit.source: It didn’t appear that anyone needed to constantly monitor it.
unit.target: Non videbātur quod quisquam id constanter observāre debueret.

unit.source: It was important to note that prior to the fire that wiped out Hisoka’s family, the special dream had existed for innumerable years.
unit.target: Notandum erat quod, ante ignem qui familiam Hisoka extinguerat, somnium speciāle per innumerōs annōs exstiverat.

unit.source: The Dream Festival had taken place countless times, yet no one had detected anything amiss.
unit.target: Festum Somniorum innumerōs vītīs factum erat, attamen nemo quidquam inusitātum deprehenderat.

unit.source: Under such conditions, the more individuals who knew the truth, the greater the danger of the information leaking out.
unit.target: Sub his condicionibus, quō plūrēs hominēs veritātem noverunt, ēō maius perīculum erat nē notiātiō effugeret.

unit.source: Nevertheless, Hisoka still enticed Padre Cali and guided him to the black ancient tomb to acquire Beyonder powers.
unit.target: Attamen Hisoka adhūc Padre Cali allicēbat et eum ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum ducebat ut vim Beyonder consequerētur.

unit.source: This anomalous conduct led Lumian to surmise that Hisoka Twanaku had enlisted Padre Cali’s aid in monitoring the dream to verify the status of his dream projection.
unit.target: Haec insolīta agendī rātiōne Lumian coniēcāre coepit Hisoka Twanaku auxilium Padre Cali ad somnium observandum, ut statum proiēctiōnis somnī confirmāret, petīvisse.

unit.source: The dream projection would gradually dissipate as Hisoka departed Tizamo, ultimately vanishing altogether.
unit.target: Proiēctiō somnī paulatim evanescere coepit, cum Hisoka Tizamo relinqueret, tandem omnīnō evanescens.

unit.source: If Hisoka desired its continued existence, he would need to return for a time after it had faded to a certain point.
unit.target: Sī Hisoka eius existentiam continuātam dēsirāvisset, necesse habuīsset ut aliquō tempore redīret postquam ad certum gradum evanuerit.

unit.source: Given that the dreams surrounding the black boulder were typically in a state of disarray, the rate at which the dream projection dissipated might be erratic.
unit.target: Cum somnia circa saepem nigrum plērūmque in statu perturbātō essent, celeritas qua proiēctiō somnī evanueret incerta esse poterat.

unit.source: This necessitated daily monitoring.
unit.target: Hoc quōtidianam vigilantiam postulābat.

unit.source: As soon as the situation was deemed to have deteriorated, an urgent telegram would be dispatched to summon Hisoka back.
unit.target: Simul ac status putātus esset in deteriorātiōnem, telegramma urgentē mittētur ut Hisoka revocareretur.

unit.source: Naturally, as a Devil, Hisoka would never divulge his true intentions to Padre Cali.
unit.target: Naturāliter, ut Diabolus, Hisoka numquam verās voluntātēs suas Padre Cali divulgāret.

unit.source: He would undoubtedly be on guard against Padre Cali exploiting the dream projection to eliminate this lurking threat.
unit.target: Cērtus erat se vigilandum esse, nē Padre Cali proiēctiōnem somnī ad hanc latentem minimam extrīpandam adhiberet.

unit.source: When instructing Padre Cali on what needed to be done, there was a high probability Hisoka was really having him monitor the shifting dynamics within the dream.
unit.target: Cum Padre Cali de agendīs instituebātur, alta probabilitās erat quō Hisoka revere eum ad mutābiles inter somnium dynamicas observandas compellāret.

unit.source: How could Padre Cali keep tabs on the evolving dream?
unit.target: Quōmodo Padre Cali somnium evolventem observāre posset?

unit.source: Through the dream projections and the condition of the gravekeepers beside the black ancient tomb!
unit.target: Per proiēctiōnēs somnī et condicionem custōdōrum iuxta sepulcrum antiquum nigrum!

unit.source: Regrettably, Lumian couldn’t enter the dream himself.
unit.target: Eheu, Lumian ipse in somnium intrāre nōn poterat.

unit.source: He could only entrust Amandina with questioning Padre Cali.
unit.target: Solum Amandinae committere poterat interrogātiōnem de Padre Cali exercendā.

unit.source: The intelligence gleaned was superficial, not delving into the crux of the matter.
unit.target: Intellēctus perceptus erat superficialis, nōn ad rem penetrālem perveniens.

unit.source: It could merely aid in analysis.
unit.target: Id tantum ad analysim auxiliārī poterat.

unit.source: If he had interrogated Padre Cali directly, he would have been able to roughly ascertain Hisoka’s objective, rather than just harboring suspicions.
unit.target: Sī Padre Cali dīrectē interrogavisset, propositum Hisoka approximatē cognoscere potuisset, potius quam sōlū suspītiōnibus insidisse.

unit.source: At present, the leads concerning the gold and the Demon’s gift both pointed to the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Praesenti tempore, indicia de aurō atque dōnō dāemōnis ūtrumque ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum referebant.

unit.source: Lumian naturally had to investigate and do what he could.
unit.target: Lumian naturaliter investigāre atque id quod potuīt facere, curāre dēbuīt.

unit.source: If the challenge truly proved insurmountable, he would decisively retreat to Tizamo and conceal himself on the third or fourth floor of the Brieu Motel, allowing the “danger” to confront Ludwig, whose appetite had grown voracious.
unit.target: Sī provocātiō vere insuperābilis evaderet, statim se ad Tizamo retulēret et in tertiō vel quartō tabulātō Brieu Motel se celāret, sinēns "perīculum" Ludwīgum congredī, cuius vorācitas increbuerat.

unit.source: Amandina guided Lumian and the others through the rainforest, drawing near to the boundary of the dream.
unit.target: Amandina Lumian et cēterōs per silvam pluvialem duxit, appropinquantēs ad līmitem somnī.

unit.source: Abruptly, Lumian raised his right hand and whispered, “Stop.”
unit.target: Subitō, Lumian manum dēstrā dextrā attollēns susurrāvit: “Siste.”

unit.source: He sniffed the air, detecting the unmistakable scent of blood.
unit.target: Aeris odōrem olfactus est, sanguinis inconfusum sentiens.

unit.source: With a Reaper’s keen sense of smell and meticulous nature, Lumian could discern that the blood didn’t originate from jungle animals hunting each other.
unit.target: Cum acūtō sensū olfactō et diligenti naturā Reaperī, Lumian discernere potuit sanguinem nōn ex animālibus silvestrīs inter sē venantibus provenīre.

unit.source: It was human blood, rich in spirituality.
unit.target: Sanguis humanus erat, spiritualitātē dīvēs.

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” Amandina asked, taken aback, as if recalling her first venture into this forest with Robert.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Amandina, perterritā, quasi prīmam incursiōnem in hanc silvam cum Robert reminiscēns.

unit.source: Camus quickly sensed the problem and pointed in the direction of the blood’s scent.
unit.target: Camus célerrime rem sensit et monstrāvit in partem odōris sanguinis.

unit.source: “Something’s not right over there.”
unit.target: “Aliquid ibi nōn recte se habet.”

unit.source: Insects were gathering in that area.
unit.target: Insecta in illa regione congregābantur.

unit.source: Although Lumian was eager to reach the black ancient tomb to thwart Hisoka’s plan, he knew that the more impatient he felt, the more cautious he needed to be.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pervenīre ad consilium Hisoka impediendum ardenter studēbat, sciebat quod quanto magis impatiēns se haberet, eo magis cautus esse ōportēbat.

unit.source: He had to remain vigilant of any abnormalities along the way to avoid walking into someone’s trap or missing crucial information and rashly starting a conflict.
unit.target: Debēbat quaelibet in viā anomaliā diligenter observāre, nē in insidiās quisquam incidat aut notitiās maximas omitteret atque imprudenter certāmen inciperet.

unit.source: Aurore had once mentioned that Emperor Roselle might have said that haste makes waste.
unit.target: Aurore olim memorāvit Imperatorem Roselle fortasse dixisse, “Festinātiō vastum ēxitum parit.”

unit.source: Lumian walked towards the source of the blood’s scent at a measured pace.
unit.target: Lumian ad fontem odōris sanguinis passū mensurātō incessit.

unit.source: As he drew closer, he caught a whiff of the pungent odor of blood mingled with decay.
unit.target: Dum propius accessit, odōrem acre sanguinis cum putredine mixtum capiebat.

unit.source: The latter originated from the tranquil essential oil used to repel mosquitoes.
unit.target: Hic alter ex oleō essentiali quietō oriebātur, quod ad culices repellendō adhibētur.

unit.source: Lumian circled a few more trees crawling with poisonous insects and saw a corpse lying face-up on the humus soil.
unit.target: Lumian aliquot arbōrēs, infestātās insectīs venenosis, circumīvit et vidit cadāver facie surrēctō iacēns super solum humicum.

unit.source: The corpse’s eyes were wide open, and its black hair was disheveled.
unit.target: Oculī cadāveris late patebant, et capillī nigrī turbātī erant.

unit.source: Its face was smeared with white paint.
unit.target: Vultus eius albo pittus erat.

unit.source: It was Maslow, the captain of the Tizamo patrol team!
unit.target: Maslow erat, dux turmae custodum Tizamo!

unit.source: At the beginning of the Dream Festival, Maslow, who had “disappeared” behind Lumian, had reappeared in the forest as a corpse!
unit.target: In initiō Festī Somniorum, Maslow, quī post Lumian “evanuerat”, in silva ut cadāver reapparuit!

unit.source: “Maslow!” Camus and Rhea exclaimed in surprise.
unit.target: “Maslow!” inclamāvērunt Camus et Rhea, stupefactī.

unit.source: Before they could fully process their grief, Lumian’s gaze shifted downward as he examined Maslow’s cause of death.
unit.target: Priusquam dolōrem plēnē compresserent, oculī Lumiani deorsum conversī erant, dum causam mortis Maslōvī examināret.

unit.source: The captain of the local patrol team had deep wounds on his chest and abdomen, as if he had been attacked by spears, triangular blades, and other weapons, but the edges showed signs of tearing.
unit.target: Dux turmae localis custodiārum vulnera profunda in pectore et abdomine gerebat, quasi telīs, lamīs triangulīs, aliīsque armīs oppressus esset, sed mārginēs lacerātiōnis indicāverunt.

unit.source: Large amounts of blood had already flowed into the ground, attracting lingering mosquitoes.
unit.target: Magnae copiae sanguinis iam in terram effluērunt, insecta culicum manentia alliciebant.

unit.source: There were obvious signs of decay on Maslow’s body, and a yellowish-green liquid seeped out, as if he had been dead for two to three days.
unit.target: In corpore Maslōvī signa putredinī manifesta erant, ac liquidum virīdēflavum exsudābat, quasi duo ad trēs diēs mortuus esset.

unit.source: After ascertaining the situation on the corpse’s surface and examining the surrounding battle traces, Camus said in a somber voice, “Attacked by the power of the Death domain…”
unit.target: Postquam statum in superficiē cadāveris atque vestigiā proelii circumiecta perspexit, Camus vocē lugubrī dīxit: “Oppressus potestāte Domini Mortis…”

unit.source: Death domain? The image of a cold, middle-aged man in a thin suit suddenly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Dominium Mortis? Imāgō vīrī frigidī, medīe aetātis in tenuē vestītō, subitō in mente Lumiani apparuit.

unit.source: Reaza, the vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol team!
unit.target: Reaza, vice ducis turmae custodum Portus Pylos!

unit.source: He was a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Death pathway!
unit.target: Erat Beyonder mediocris in vīā Mortis!

unit.source: At the beginning of the Dream Festival, Reaza had “disappeared” along with Maslow.
unit.target: In initiō Festī Somniorum, Reaza, una cum Maslōvō, “evanuerat.”

unit.source: Camus glanced at Rhea, who wore a pained expression, and hesitantly said, “They were affected by the Dream Festival and lost control of themselves. They attacked each other. One died, and the other escaped?”
unit.target: Camus Rheam aspexit, quae vultū dolore afflictā esset, et haesitāns dīxit: “Festō Somniorum affectī sunt et se regere nōn poterant. Invicem se aggressī sunt. Unus mortuus est, alter evasit?”

unit.source: This was the most plausible conjecture for the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Haec erat coniēctiō optima de Festō Somniorum.

unit.source: Lumian imagined a similar scene, but he frowned in confusion and said, “Why are they in the jungle?”
unit.target: Lumian talem scenam finxit, sed facie confūsā, dīxit: “Cur in silvā sunt?”

unit.source: Shouldn’t they appear where they were in the real world?
unit.target: Nonne apparērent ubi in mundō rēālī fuerant?

unit.source: In reality, Reaza and Maslow had already returned to Tizamo with me…
unit.target: Rēvēra, Reaza et Maslow iam mecum ad Tizamo redierant…

unit.source: Did something lure them into the forest?
unit.target: Numquid aliquid eōs in silvām attrāxit?

unit.source: As the only member of the Port Pylos patrol team supporting Tizamo, Reaza had known from the beginning that something was amiss here.
unit.target: Reaza, sōlus membrum turmae custodum Portus Pylos qui Tizamo subvenīebat, ab initīo scībat aliquid hic esse inordinātum.

unit.source: Was the true target the black ancient tomb?
unit.target: Fuitne verus finis sepulcrum antiquum nigrum?

unit.source: Lumian looked at Camus and Rhea thoughtfully and casually asked, “Were Maslow and Reaza on good terms?”
unit.target: Lumian Camum et Rheam cogitāns aspexit atque leviter rogāvit: “Erantne Maslow et Reaza in bonīs rēlātiōnibus?”

unit.source: “Excellent terms,” Camus replied with a sigh.
unit.target: “Excellentes rēlātiōnēs,” respondit Camus suspirāns.

unit.source: “Captain Reaza recruited Maslow into the patrol team and provided him with extensive guidance.”
unit.target: “Capitāneus Reaza Maslow in turmam custodum collegit et ei ampliam disciplinam praebuit.”

unit.source: Lumian fell silent for a moment before saying to Amandina and the others, “Let’s continue forward.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper silentium tenuit, deinde Amandinae et cēterīs dīxit: “Pergāmus.”

unit.source: Rhea and Camus seized the moment to gather some branches to cover Maslow’s corpse.
unit.target: Rhea et Camus occāsiōnem arripērunt ut aliquās rāmās congregarent ad cadāver Maslōvī tegendum.

unit.source: Then, they quickly followed the team.
unit.target: Deinde celeriter turmam secūtī sunt.

unit.source: After walking along the forest path for a while, Amandina suddenly slowed her pace and pressed her hand to the side of her head.
unit.target: Postquam per semitām silvae aliquod tempus ambulāvit, Amandina subitō cursum retardāvit et manum ad lātus capitis apposuit.

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian asked keenly.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Lumian acerrime.

unit.source: Amandina frowned and said, “My head feels a bit heavy, and I’m experiencing hallucinations.”
unit.target: Amandina frontem contrāxit et dīxit: “Caput meum paullō grave videtur, et hallucinātiōnēs experior.”

unit.source: “What kind of hallucinations?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: “Quāles hallucinātiōnēs?” inquit Lumian supercilia levāns.

unit.source: Amandina replied in puzzlement, “I saw the black boulder I touched previously—no, the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Amandina perplexa respondit: “Vidī lapidem nigrum, quem antea tetīgī—immo, sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

unit.source: It felt like I had returned to the past.
unit.target: Sine videbātur quasi ad praeteritum rediīssem.

unit.source: Do you understand?”
unit.target: Intellīgisne?”

unit.source: The past appeared in my mind in the form of an illusion, in front of my eyes, beside my ears.
unit.target: Praeteritum in mente mea apparuit quasi illūsiō, ante ōculos meōs, iuxta aurēs meas.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment before saying, preempting Camus, “Let’s go a little further and see what happens.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditātus, deinde, Camum praeveniēns, dīxit: “Paululō porro pergāmus et videāmus quid fiat.”

unit.source: The hallucinations didn’t incite Amandina’s desire to retreat.
unit.target: Hallucinātiōnēs nōn excitāvērunt Amandinae dēsīderium retrocedendī.

unit.source: With an experimental mindset, she followed the familiar jungle path for another few dozen meters.
unit.target: Mente experimentālī, semitām silvae nōtam per alium vīgintī metra secūtā est.

unit.source: “How is it?” Lumian, who was beside her, inquired.
unit.target: “Quōmodo est?” inquit Lumian, quī iuxta eam stabat.

unit.source: Amandina organized her thoughts and said, “The hallucinations are becoming clearer and more pronounced.”
unit.target: Amandina cogitātiōnēs suās ordināvit et dīxit: “Hallucinātiōnēs magis ac magis clārēscent et eminentius fient.”

unit.source: “The closer you get to the black ancient tomb, the stronger the hallucinations become?” Lumian suggested a possibility before asking, “Did anything similar happen to Robert when he brought you here last time?”
unit.target: “Quō propius ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum accēdis, tanto robustiōrēs hallucīnātiōnēs fient?” inquit Lumian, antequam rogāret: “Evenitne simile Robertō, cum tē hūc ultimō tempore adduxit?”

unit.source: “No,” Amandina replied with certainty. “He was quite normal the entire time.”
unit.target: “Non,” respondit Amandina certē, “Ille totum tempus prōrsus normālis fuit.”

unit.source: Camus speculated, “Perhaps he had already grown accustomed to the hallucinations after approaching more than once.”
unit.target: Camus coniēcit: “Forsitan iam assuēfactus erat hallucīnātiōnibus postquam pluriē accēderat.”

unit.source: “Who knows…” Amandina muttered and looked at Louis Berry. “What should we do now?”
unit.target: “Quis scit…” murmurāvit Amandina et respexit ad Louis Berry. “Quid nōn faciamus?”

unit.source: “It’s not a big deal if it’s just hallucinations…” Lumian pondered for a moment and said, “Let’s continue forward.”
unit.target: “Non est grāve, sī sōlū hallucīnātiōnēs sint…” paulisper meditātus, Lumian dīxit: “Pergāmus.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Amandina wasn’t sure what the hallucinations represented. She endured the discomfort and said, “We’ll reach the ancient tomb in a few minutes.”
unit.target: “Bene.” Amandina nescia erat quid hallucīnātiōnēs repraesentābant. Discommodum tolerāvit et dīxit: “Paucīs momentīs sepulcrum antiquum perveniemus.”

unit.source: She continued forward.
unit.target: Continuāvit.

unit.source: As they walked, Amandina suddenly extended her right hand and pressed it against the forest trees beside her, bending her back.
unit.target: Dum ambulabant, Amandina subitō manum dēstrā dextrā extendit et eam contra arbōrēs silvae iuxta sē apposuit, dorsum flectēns.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian to inquire, she recounted the changes in the hallucination and spoke intermittently, “I see myself… after touching the ancient tomb last time… I didn’t… I didn’t fall asleep immediately… I… I was still awake!”
unit.target: Nullo tempore expectāns ut Lumian quaereret, mutātiōnēs hallucīnātiōnis recensuit et intermittinge locūtā est: “Mē ipse video… postquam sepulcrum antiquum tetīgī ultimō tempore… nōn statim obdormīvī… mēr… adhūc vigilābam!”

unit.source: 686 Illusion and Reality
unit.target: 686 Illusio et Realitas

unit.source: “What kind of person?” Lumian perked up.
unit.target: «Qualis homo?» inquit Lumian, animadvertens.

unit.source: He hadn’t expected Amandina’s hallucination to yield unexpected insights.
unit.target: Non speraverat hallucinationem Amandinae perspicationes inopinatas exhibere.

unit.source: “I can’t see clearly, I can’t. It’s not that he isn’t clear… It’s just that I can’t make out the details.”
unit.target: «Clarie videre non valeo, vere non valeo. Non enim deficit claritas, sed singulara discernere nequeo.»

unit.source: Amandina straightened up again, as if she had recovered slightly.
unit.target: Amandina iterum se recta constitui, quasi paullo convaluisset.

unit.source: She pondered for a moment and said, “So I didn’t fall asleep immediately after touching the black boulder—no, the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Paulo meditata est et dixit: «Ita non statim obdormivi postquam lapidem nigrum—immo, sepulcrum antiquum atrum—tetigi.»

unit.source: When I woke up, I realized that I had gained superpowers.
unit.target: Cum evigilavi, intellexi me potentias supernaturales adeptam esse.

unit.source: There were still some events that transpired in between, but I don’t remember them at all.
unit.target: Eventa quaedam intercedebant, sed eos omnino memoria non habeo.

unit.source: It felt like I had fallen asleep.

unit.target: Lumian Amandinae aspexit, quae recedebat conata effugere creaturam invisibilem, sed illam figuram, quam illa describebat, percipere non potuit.

unit.source: In the brief span of more than ten seconds since Amandina’s panic attack, Lumian had used his Spirit Vision, Weakness Investigation, Luck Observation, and other abilities, but he hadn’t detected anything unusual.
unit.target: In brevi spatio, plus quam decem secundis, ex tempore Amandinae panici, Lumian visione spirituum, inquisitione infirmitatis, observatione fortunae, et aliis facultatibus usus est, sed nihil insolitum detexit.

unit.source: He was on the verge of taking out the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth.
unit.target: Fere erat ut extraheret Specula Perscrutantia Mysterii ac Oculus Veritatis.

unit.source: Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian manum in sacculum viatoris sui introduxit.

unit.source: Without a rough grasp of the situation, he didn’t know how to rescue Amandina, who had broken down from fright.
unit.target: Non habens claram comprehensionem rei, nesciebat quomodo Amandinam, quae metu defessa erat, servaret.

unit.source: Just as his fingers brushed against the Mystery Prying Glasses, Amandina was suddenly taken aback.
unit.target: Dum digiti eius Specula Perscrutantia Mysterii tetigerunt, Amandina subito consternata est.

unit.source: After a moment, she turned to Lumian and said in bewilderment, “He—he turned and left. He seems to have recognized me…”
unit.target: Post momentum, se ad Lumian vertit et in stupore dixit: “Ille—ille conversus est et discessit. Videtur me agnovisse…”

unit.source: “Recognized you?” Lumian felt compelled to confirm Amandina’s mental state.
unit.target: ‘Agnovit te?’ Lumian sensit se compellatum ad statum mentis Amandinae confirmandum.

unit.source: Amandina replied in confusion, “Yes, he nodded at me and left.”
unit.target: Amandina in confusione respondit: “Ita, mihi annuit et discessit.”

unit.source: Is this why, after the Dream Festival begins, anyone who wishes to approach the black ancient tomb must be guided by someone who has received the boon of the ancient tomb or the corpse?
unit.target: Num hoc est, post initium Festivalis Somniorum, cur quisquis nigrum sepulcrum antiquum appropinquare velit, a duce moderari debeat, qui beneficium sepulchri antiquati aut cadaveris accepit?

unit.source: Robert and Padre Cali likely played the same role in similar scenes, but they don’t belong to the Evernight pathway and lack dream-related abilities, so they didn’t notice…
unit.target: Robertus et Padre Cali verisimiliter idem munus in similibus scaenis egerunt, sed non pertinent ad viam Evernight nec facultates somniorum possident, ideo non animadvertuerunt…

unit.source: Did the people in the other dream fragments also receive the boon of the black ancient tomb or the cold corpse?
unit.target: Etne homines in aliis fragmentis somniorum etiam beneficium sepulchri antiquati aut cadaveris receperunt?

unit.source: Lumian’s heart stirred as he asked Amandina, “Where did he go? Where did that figure go?”
unit.target: Cor Lumiani movit, rogans Amandina: “Quo ivit ille? Quo abiit illa figura?”

unit.source: Amandina’s gaze shifted to the periphery of her surroundings.
unit.target: Amandinae oculi ad extremitates ambitus circumiecti versaverunt.

unit.source: Her eyes widened with lingering fear and excitement.
unit.target: Oculi eius, metu remanente et exsultatione, dilatati sunt.

unit.source: She raised her palm and pointed at the dream fragment where the man and woman were.
unit.target: Manum levavit et ad fragmentum somnii, quo vir et mulier erant, indicavit.

unit.source: He went there.
unit.target: Ille ibi ivit.

unit.source: He’s gone through! He’s gone through!
unit.target: Ille pertransiit! Ille pertransiit!

unit.source: Amandina’s explanation made Lumian and the others feel the black ancient tomb solidifying and becoming heavier.
unit.target: Explicatio Amandinae facit Lumianum et ceteros sentire nigrum sepulcrum antiquum se solidificare et gravius fieri.

unit.source: The entire area shook even more violently.
unit.target: Tota regio etiam vehementius tremebat.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian sensed a familiar burning sensation on his left chest, but he didn’t hear any ravings that seemed to come from an infinite distance.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian in sinistro pectore ignitum sensum notum sensit, sed nullas voces delirantes, quae ex infinito videbantur, audivit.

unit.source: In a daze, he saw a huge aqua-colored vortex, a dim village shrouded in gray fog, and figures within the village.
unit.target: Perturbatus, vidit ingentem vorticem colore aquae, vicum obscurum in nebula grisea velatum, et figuras intra vicum.

unit.source: Shepherd Pierre Berry, who believed in Inevitability, and Lumian’s friend, Azéma Lizier, raised their pale-white arms, as if silently shouting.
unit.target: Pastor Petrus Berry, qui in Inevitabilitate credebat, atque amicus Lumiani, Azéma Lizier, brachia pallide alba levaverunt, quasi silentio exclamantes.

unit.source: Lumian also spotted his semi-subterranean two-story house and Aurore, sitting quietly on the orange roof with her arms crossed.
unit.target: Lumian etiam domum suam semi‐subterraneam duplicem et Aurore, quae in tegmine aurantiaco, brachiis transpositis, quiete sedebat, conspexit.

unit.source: Lumian no longer resisted the illusion.
unit.target: Lumian illusioni non iam resistebat.

unit.source: He roughly understood what was happening.
unit.target: Vage intellexit quid eveniret.

unit.source: As the figure entered other dream fragments, the black ancient tomb’s abnormality intensified.
unit.target: Cum figura in alia fragmenta somniorum ingressa est, anomalitas nigri sepulchri antiquati intensior facta est.

unit.source: It contained the power of the Death domain, “awakening” the Cordu villagers within the seal.
unit.target: Haec continebat potentiam Dominii Mortis, excitans incolas Cordu in sigillo.

unit.source: These villagers were already deceased, with only soul fragments remaining.
unit.target: Hi incolae iam mortui erant, solum fragmenta animarum manentia.

unit.source: Naturally, they would be affected by the power of the Death domain.
unit.target: Naturaliter, potentia Dominii Mortis eos afficit.

unit.source: This realization made Lumian feel pain, sorrow, and bitterness that he hadn’t experienced in a long time.
unit.target: Haec cognitio Lumian dolorem, tristitiam et amaritudinem afferebat, quae diu non expertus erat.

unit.source: He “watched” Aurore, clad in a light-blue dress with thick, long blond hair and light-blue eyes.
unit.target: Lumian conspexit Aurorem, indutam veste caerulea levis, cum crinibus fulvis crassis et longis atque oculis caeruleis.

unit.source: She didn’t attempt to resist the invisible power of death.
unit.target: Ea non conata est resistere invisibili potentiae mortis.

unit.source: “He walked to that woman,” Amandina continued dutifully.
unit.target: “Ille ambulavit ad illam mulierem,” Amandina officiose dixit.

unit.source: That woman? Camus, Rhea, and Lugano turned their attention to the corresponding dream fragment.
unit.target: Illa mulier? Camus, Rhea, et Lugano animos suos ad illud fragmentum somnii converterunt.

unit.source: Having just arrived in Tizamo that night, the lady in the light-colored dress didn’t hear Amandina’s words.
unit.target: Nuper ad Tizamo advecta, hac nocte, mulier in veste leviter colorata verba Amandinae non audivit.

unit.source: She only knew that the patrol team was looking at her.
unit.target: Ea solum sciebat quod turma vigilium eam intueretur.

unit.source: Her spirituality gave her a sense of foreboding.
unit.target: Spiritualitas ei sensum praenuntiationis mali dedit.

unit.source: She hurriedly turned to her companion and asked, “Devajo, do you sense any malice?”
unit.target: Festinanter se ad socium converterit et rogavit: “Devajo, sentisne aliquam malitiam?”

unit.source: The man named Devajo, dressed in a dark gray suit, slowly shook his head and said, “Nothing.”
unit.target: Vir nomine Devajo, in veste griseo obscuro indutus, caput lente movit et dixit: “Nil.”

unit.source: In the dream fragment where Lumian and the others were, Amandina explained in high spirits, “He… The figure… extended his hand! He pressed his hand… on that woman’s head!”
unit.target: In fragmento somnii, in quo Lumian et ceteri erant, Amandina alacriter explicavit: “Ille… figura… manum extendit! Manum in caput illae mulieris premuit!”

unit.source: Just as Amandina finished speaking, Devajo saw his companion, the lady in the light-colored dress, suddenly collapse to her knees.
unit.target: Dum Amandina locutionem finivit, Devajo sociam suam, mulierem in veste leviter colorata, subito ad genua corruit.

unit.source: Her expression was stiff, and her face was abnormally pale-white.
unit.target: Vultus eius rigidus erat, et facies eius admodum pallida apparuit.

unit.source: Ooo!
unit.target: Ooo!

unit.source: In all the dream fragments, an ice-cold wind howled.
unit.target: In omnibus fragmentis somniorum, ventus glacialis ululabat.

unit.source: Lumian “saw” Aurore standing up on the orange roof, her expression dazed as she gazed into the sky, as if sensing something.
unit.target: Lumian Aurorem 'conspexit' stantem in tegmine aurantiaco, vultu stupefacto dum in caelum aspiciebat, quasi aliquid sentiens.

unit.source: She opened her mouth and spoke almost instinctively.
unit.target: Os aperuit et paene instinctu locuta est.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t know the corresponding language, but he had heard something similar before.
unit.target: Lumian linguam eam correspondens nesciebat, sed aliquid simile antea audiverat.

unit.source: It was the language used by Armored Shadow Chen Tu, a language that Franca occasionally uttered a word or two of!
unit.target: Erat lingua usitata a Chen Tu Umbra Armata, qua Franca interdum unum aut duo verbum edebat!

unit.source: Although he couldn’t understand, Lumian vaguely grasped what his sister was talking about, perhaps due to the connection between them at the soul level.
unit.target: Quamquam non potuit intellegere, Lumian vago sensu percepit quid soror eius diceret, fortasse ob nexum inter animas.

unit.source: She muttered to herself, “An immortal blessed my crown, bestowing upon me the gift of eternal life.
unit.target: Murmuravit sibi: “Immortalis mihi coronam benedixit, donans mihi donum vitae aeternae.”

unit.source: In the dream fragment where Devajo was, the light-colored lady’s hat, which had unconsciously fallen to her knees, suddenly flew off.
unit.target: In fragmento somnii, ubi Devajo erat, pileus mulieris in veste leviter colorata, qui inconscius ad genua ceciderat, subito evanuit.

unit.source: On her neck, the backs of her hands, and the surface of her face, pores opened one by one, producing white feathers tainted with faint yellow stains.
unit.target: In collo eius, in dorsis manuum, et in superficie faciei eius, pori unum post unum aperti sunt, efferentes plumas albas leviter flavis maculis tinctas.

unit.source: Devajo observed this scene with a solemn expression.
unit.target: Devajo hanc scenam vultu solemni conspexit.

unit.source: He didn’t attempt to interrupt his companion’s abnormality and instead took a few cautious steps back.
unit.target: Non conatus est intercedere in abnormitate sociae suae, sed potius paucis gradibus cautis retro se recedens.

unit.source: He couldn’t comprehend what was happening.
unit.target: Non potuit intellegere quid accideret.

unit.source: Although he hadn’t sensed any malice directed at him, he prudently distanced himself from the anomaly.
unit.target: Quamquam malitiam ad se directam non sensit, caute ab anomalia se abstulit.

unit.source: The lady in the light-colored dress’s azure eyes had lost focus, appearing abnormally vacant and lifeless.
unit.target: Oculi azurri mulieris in veste leviter colorata lumen amisere, atque insolitè vacui et sine vita apparabantur.

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, the white feathers, tainted with light-yellow oil stains, seemed to possess a consciousness and life of their own.
unit.target: In momento, plumae albae, leviter flavis olei vestigiis tinctae, videbantur propriam conscientiam et vitam habere.

unit.source: They frantically emerged from the gaps in the fabric of the dress.
unit.target: Ex rimae in textu vestis effrenanter emergere videbantur.

unit.source: Within moments, the lady in the light-colored dress was enveloped by white feathers tainted with light-yellow oil stains.
unit.target: In paucis momentis, mulier in veste leviter colorata a plumis albis, leviter flavis olei vestigiis tinctis, complectita est.

unit.source: Her body grew light and gradually floated, becoming increasingly illusory.
