unit.target: Corpus eius leve factum est et paulatim levavit, fiens magis magisque illusorium.

unit.source: Her azure eyes fixed on Devajo as she shouted in a hollow and agitated voice, “I’ve become a god! I’ve achieved immortality!”
unit.target: Oculi eius azurri in Devajo fixi erant, dum voce cava et incitata exclamabat: “Deus facta sum! Immortalitatem adeptus sum!”

unit.source: The white-feathered monster hovered above the black ancient tomb, incessantly shouting, “I’ve become a god! I’ve achieved immortality!”
unit.target: Monstrum plumis albis ornatum super nigrum sepulcrum antiquum latitabatur, continuo clamitans: “Deus facta sum! Immortalitatem adeptus sum!”

unit.source: In another dream fragment, Lumian heard Aurore change her words.
unit.target: In alio fragmento somnii, Lumian audivit Aurorem verba mutare.

unit.source: With a fearful expression, she whispered, “Immortal Ascension…”
unit.target: Cum vultu timido, sussurravit: “Ascensus immortalis…”

unit.source: In the next instant, the ethereal monster, covered in white feathers, flew towards the black ancient tomb in the dream fragment.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, monstrum aetherium, plumis albis tectum, volavit versus nigrum sepulcrum antiquum in fragmento somnii.

unit.source: She passed through the stone wall on the tomb’s surface and vanished.
unit.target: Per parietem lapideum in superficie sepulchri transiit et evanuit.

unit.source: Suddenly, the frigid wind ceased, freezing.
unit.target: Subito, ventus glacialis cessavit, congelans.

unit.source: The black ancient tomb shook visibly, and the tomb door, outlined by hair-like cracks, emitted the sound of dull rubbing, as if someone was trying to push it open from within.
unit.target: Nigrum sepulcrum antiquum manifeste tremebat, et ostium sepulchri, fissuris pilorum similes delineatum, sonum fricationis obtusae edebat, quasi aliquis ex intus illud aperire conaretur.

unit.source: Aurore, “in front” of Lumian and the “surrounding” Cordu began to fade, as if erased by an eraser.
unit.target: Aurore, coram Lumiano et circumstantibus Cordu, incipiebat evanescere, quasi ab “erasore” deletus esset.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the slowly opening tomb door and turned to “Hisoka” Twanaku, who was in another dream fragment.
unit.target: Lumian ostium sepulchri lente aperiens aspexit et ad “Hisoka” Twanaku se convertit, qui in alio fragmento somnii erat.

unit.source: The dream projection wasn’t surprised by the abnormality, nor did he show any fear.
unit.target: Proiectio somnii non mirata est ab anomalia, nec timorem ostendit.

unit.source: Instead, the silent gravekeepers around him rose to their feet.
unit.target: Immo, custodes sepulchri taciti circa eum surrexerunt.

unit.source: Amidst the illusory sound of water, the tomb door of the black ancient tomb opened completely.
unit.target: Inter sonos aquae illusorios, ostium sepulchri nigri antiquati plene aperitum est.

unit.source: Accompanied by this change, all the dream fragments that appeared in the blur seemed to be pulled by an invisible force, fusing together.
unit.target: Hoc mutato, omnia fragmenta somniorum, quae in confusione apparuerunt, videbantur vi invisibili trahentia et confluentes.

unit.source: Devajo, Reaza, Iveljsta, Hisoka Twanaku, and the gravekeepers materialized in front of the black ancient tomb, near Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Devajo, Reaza, Iveljsta, Hisoka Twanaku, et custodes sepulchri apparuerunt coram nigrum sepulcrum antiquum, prope Luminum et ceteros.

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku smiled, as if he had anticipated that one of the outsiders would transform into a “god” and that the ancient tomb’s door would open at this very moment.
unit.target: “Hisoka” Twanaku subridens apparuit, quasi praevidebat unum ex extraneis in “deum” se transformaturum esse et ostium sepulchri antiquati hoc ipso momento aperiendum esse.

unit.source: He retrieved a golden mask from his black robe.
unit.target: Ex veste nigra sua larvam auream extraxit.

unit.source: The mask appeared to be crafted from pure gold, its eyes and face smeared with white and black paint, giving it an unsettling appearance.
unit.target: Larva videbatur ex auro puro confecta esse, oculis et facie eius albis et nigris pictis, quae ei aspectum perturbantem tribuere videbantur.

unit.source: Twanaku donned the golden mask and, unlike the other gravekeepers, didn’t retreat.
unit.target: Twanaku larvam auream induit et, contrarie aliorum custodum, non recedens fuit.

unit.source: Instead, he sprinted towards the black ancient tomb and the open tomb door.
unit.target: Immo, festinanter, ad nigrum sepulcrum antiquum et ostium aperitum, cucurrit.

unit.source: Thud! Thud! Thud!
unit.target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

unit.source: Lumian heard a distinct heartbeat.
unit.target: Lumian audivit pulsationem cordis distinctam.

unit.source: It emanated from within the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Emanabat ex interioribus nigrī sepulchri antiquī.

unit.source: Chapter 688: Preparations
unit.target: Capitulum 688: Praeparationes

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: As Lumian heard his heartbeat, a palm reached out from the open door of the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Cum Lumian pulsationem cordis audivit, palma ex aperta porta sepulcri antiquati nigri se protendit.

unit.source: The palm showed no signs of decay or yellow bandages.
unit.target: Palma nulla signa putredinis nec fascias flavas ostendebat.

unit.source: Its surface was covered in gold, shimmering with a mystical hue under the dim crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Superficies eius auro suffusa erat, micans colore mystico sub tenui luce lunae rubrae.

unit.source: Upon seeing the golden palm, Lumian felt an invisible force compress his soul, instantly severing its connection to his body.
unit.target: Videns palmam auream, Lumian vim invisibilis sensit, quae animam suam comprimebat, statim eius nexum cum corpore interrumpens.

unit.source: Immediately after, he realized his body had transformed into a cold, solid wall, preventing his spirit from spreading or being controlled by his consciousness.
unit.target: Statim postea animadvertit corpus eius in murum durum et frigidum conversum esse, impediens spiritui eius se diffundere aut a conscientia regi.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian’s soul felt trapped in a cage, unable to escape.
unit.target: Illo momento, anima Lumiani in cavea inclusa se sensit, nec evadere posse.

unit.source: He could only see limited scenes through his eyes and hear relatively loud voices with his ears.
unit.target: Tantum scaenas restrictas per oculos videre et voces satis sonoras per auribus audire poterat.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Everyone present turned into statues, frozen in place.
unit.target: Omnes presenti in statuas conversi sunt, in loco immobiliter.

unit.source: Faced with this situation, Lumian suddenly recalled a saying: The body is a cage for the heart, and the world is a cage for the body.
unit.target: Hac re circumstante, Lumian subito memoriae adduxit proverbium: "Corpus est cavea cordis, et mundus est cavea corporis."

unit.source: In the stillness, the only person still moving was “Hisoka” Twanaku.
unit.target: In silentio, sola persona adhuc movens erat "Hisoka" Twanaku.

unit.source: The golden mask on his face emitted a hazy glow as he swiftly approached the black ancient tomb and the golden palm extending from it.
unit.target: Larva aurea in facie eius fulgor nebulosus emanabat, dum celeriter ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum et ab eo protrahentem palmam auream accedebat.

unit.source: Although Lumian couldn’t move or use his abilities, his soul was merely “imprisoned”—it didn’t affect his thoughts.
unit.target: Etsi Lumian movendi vel facultates suas adhibendi non poterat, anima eius modo "inclusa" erat—nec cogitationes eius afficiebat.

unit.source: Seeing that “Hisoka” Twanaku was almost unaffected by the golden palm, Lumian quickly deduced several things.
unit.target: Videns "Hisoka" Twanaku paene impassibilem palmam auream, Lumian celeriter plura concludit.

unit.source: There’s a high likelihood the gold Hisoka seized from Devise—the gold mine city—was used on the cold corpse in the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Altissima verisimilitudo est aurum, quod Hisoka ab urbe Devise, fodina aurea, rapuit, in cadavero frigido sepulcri antiquati nigri adhibitum esse.

unit.source: The item he obtained from the Nois family’s Demon is likely the golden mask he now wears.
unit.target: Res, quam a daemone familiae Nois obtinuit, probabiliter est larva aurea quam nunc gerit.

unit.source: The former was an attempt to revive the cold corpse.
unit.target: Primum conatum erat cadaver frigidi reviviscere.

unit.source: Its equivalent to Franca’s mention of creating a complete body.
unit.target: Eius aequipollentia est ad dictatum Francae de corpore completo creando.

unit.source: The latter ensures Hisoka can approach the target unaffected after the cold corpse’s "resurrection" and achieve a certain goal.
unit.target: Ultimum efficit ut Hisoka, post resurrectionem cadaveris frigidi, scopum immotus attingat et certum finem assequatur.

unit.source: Did Hisoka once plan to use this to control the cold corpse and attain demigod-level strength?
unit.target: Numquid Hisoka olim hoc consilium habuit ut cadaver frigidi regeret ac virtutem semi-dei adipiscatur?

unit.source: When I killed him in the real world, did the him in the dream attempt to "resurrect" through this?
unit.target: Cum eum in mundo reali interfecissem, numquid ille in somnio per hoc "resurrectionem" conari studuit?

unit.source: Yes, Hisoka’s Wraith power comes from the same source as the cold corpse.
unit.target: Ita, potentia umbrae Hisoka eadem fonte emanat ac cadaver frigidi.

unit.source: Perhaps there’s a way to make the corpse believe he’s its original spirit and accept his lead…
unit.target: Forsitan via sit ut cadaver credat se esse spiritum originalem suum et ducatum eius accipiat…

unit.source: Based on the information I’ve gathered and what just transpired, humans who have received the boon of the black ancient tomb and the cold corpse can open the tomb without waking the corpse.
unit.target: Ex informationibus congregatis et rebus nuper transactis, homines qui beneficium sepulcri antiquati nigri et cadaveris frigidi receperunt, sepulcrum aperire possunt sine cadaver excitando.

unit.source: To awaken it, an intruder must be bestowed with immortality by an invisible figure, ascend to godhood, and enter the ancient tomb.
unit.target: Ut illud excitetur, invasori immortalis a figura invisibili donandus est, deitatis gradus ascendere atque in sepulcrum antiquatum intrare.

unit.source: And intruders will only be attacked by invisible figures without the Dream Festival’s bestowed guides…
unit.target: Et invasores tantum figuris invisibilibus oppugnabuntur, sine ducum Festi Somniorum donatorum…

unit.source: It’s best for an intruder to remain lucid?
unit.target: Optime est ut invasor lucidus maneat?

unit.source: How did Hisoka know outsiders would participate in the Dream Festival this year and arrive at the black ancient tomb?
unit.target: Quomodo Hisoka scivit extraneos in Festo Somniorum hoc anno participaturos esse atque ad sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum pervenire?

unit.source: He didn’t have such a plan to begin with?
unit.target: Nonne talis consilium initio habuit?

unit.source: That’s because he didn’t know he was going to die.
unit.target: Quia nesciebat se moriturum esse.

unit.source: If he can’t complete his plan during this year’s Dream Festival, the dream projection will completely dissipate in the next few months, causing him to lose his last hope of revival…
unit.target: Si consilium suum in Festo Somniorum huius anni perficere non poterit, proiectio somniorum omnino in proximis mensibus evanescet, eum ultima spes reviviscendi amittens…

unit.source: The involvement of outsiders was a pleasant surprise for him?
unit.target: Num externorum interventus ei gratus erat?

unit.source: No, it's too much of a coincidence.
unit.target: Minime, nimis fortuito est.

unit.source: Reaza’s rushing over can be explained by his discovery of me investigating the Dream Festival and his worry that he wouldn’t have a chance to obtain what he wants after this year.
unit.target: Cursor Reazae explicari potest ex eius deprehensione mei, qui Festo Somniorum investigabam, et sollicitudine ne post hunc annum id, quod desiderat, adipisci posset.

unit.source: But why did Iveljsta coincidentally come to this primitive forest to investigate something?
unit.target: Sed cur Iveljsta casu ad hanc silvam primitivam venit, ut aliquid indagheret?

unit.source: Why did two Beyonders who can remain lucid in the special dream arrive just before the Dream Festival began?
unit.target: Cur duo Beyonders, qui in somnio speciali lucidi manere possunt, paene ante initium Festi Somniorum advenerunt?

unit.source: Moreover, why did the Rose School of Thought send someone to Matani in the last few months of the year to gather detailed day-to-day information?
unit.target: Praeterea, cur Schola Rosae Sententiarum aliquem ad Matani misit in paucis mensibus ultimi anni ut accuratas informationes cotidianas colligeret?

unit.source: “Hisoka” Twanaku originally planned to complete his plan during this year’s Dream Festival.
unit.target: "Hisoka" Twanaku primum consilium suum in Festo Somniorum huius anni perficere destinavit.

unit.source: He deliberately leaked some information and clues to attract different factions of interest.
unit.target: Diligenter quaedam informationes et indicia effudit, ut diversas factiones studii alliceret.

unit.source: The information these factions received wasn’t detailed enough.
unit.target: Notitia quam hae factiones acceperunt non satis accurata erat.

unit.source: They had no choice but to dispatch personnel in advance to conduct the corresponding investigations or bribe members of Matani’s patrol teams…
unit.target: Nullo alio modo nisi ut ante miscerentur operarii ad investigationes pertinentes peragendas, vel ut membra turmae Matani subornarent.

unit.source: This may very well be the truth, a truth that doesn’t rely on coincidence.
unit.target: Hoc valde verisimile veritas est, veritas quae non innititur casu.

unit.source: The only thing Hisoka didn’t anticipate was his demise before the Dream Festival began.
unit.target: Sola re quam Hisoka non praevidebat, mors eius ante initium Festi Somniorum evenit.

unit.source: Now, the Dream Festival is his last and only hope for resurrection.
unit.target: Nunc, Festum Somniorum ultima et sola spes eius ad resurrectionem est.

unit.source: If he fails to achieve his plan, he will die completely after today!
unit.target: Si consilium suum perficere non poterit, post hunc diem penitus morietur!

unit.source: No wonder he’s so secretive about Tizamo despite being honest about everything else in the dream…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod de Tizamo tam arcanus se ostendat, cum de ceteris in somnio vereus esset.

unit.source: Hisoka is truly a cunning Devil skilled at manipulating people’s hearts.
unit.target: Hisoka vere callidus Diabolus est, peritia in corda hominum regenda praedita.

unit.source: If he hadn’t been bent on killing me and his identity had given him a good opportunity to choose to stay in Port Pylos, he wouldn’t have been easy to lull.
unit.target: Si non constanter intentus ad me interficendum fuisset atque eius identitas ei bonam occasionem praebuisset ut in Port Pylos maneret, facile non mollitus fuisset.

unit.source: Yes, if I had played by the book and lacked the goodwill of a high-ranking entity, I might have died at his hands.
unit.target: Ita, si praeceptis obtemperavissem et bonam voluntatem entitatis praestantis non haberem, a manu eius moriturus fuissem.

unit.source: The Demon of the Nois family also has designs on the cold corpse in the black tomb and wants to use the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Daemon familiae Nois quoque consilia habet in cadavero frigido sepulcri nigri et Festum Somniorum adhibere vult.

unit.source: Therefore, when Hisoka mentioned the Dream Festival in his dream, he was immediately attacked by the shadow…
unit.target: Ergo, cum Hisoka in somnio suo Festum Somniorum memoravit, statim ab umbra oppressus est…

unit.source: Among those present, who is the Demon’s minion?
unit.target: Inter eos presentes, quis est famulus daemonis?

unit.source: Or could it be that the Demon from the Nois family hasn’t arrived yet and wants to wait until the end, when the situation is clear, before taking action and completing the harvest?
unit.target: An forte Daemon familiae Nois nondum advenerit et velit exspectare usque ad finem, cum res clarescant, antequam agatur et messis perficatur?

unit.source: If it’s just a dream projection, without the main body’s cooperation, there should be a huge loophole in Hisoka’s plan.
unit.target: Si solum proiectio somnii sit, sine cooperatione corporis principali, ingens hiatus in consilio Hisoka esse debet.

unit.source: Where is the loophole?
unit.target: Ubi est hiatus?

unit.source: Trapped in his body, Lumian couldn’t stop Hisoka.
unit.target: Corpori suo inclusus, Lumian Hisokam sistere non potuit.

unit.source: He watched helplessly as Hisoka ran to the open door of the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Inermis spectavit, dum Hisoka ad apertam portam sepulcri antiquati nigri cucurrit.

unit.source: Wait…
unit.target: Exspecta…

unit.source: Since the black ancient tomb reminds me of the Samaritan Women’s Spring, I can try that method…
unit.target: Cum sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum me admonet Fons Mulierum Samaritanarum, illam viam experiri possum…

unit.source: Lumian acted without hesitation, focusing his attention on his Spirit Body’s right hand.
unit.target: Lumian sine mora egit, animum suum in manum dexteram Corporis Spiritus intendens.

unit.source: Alista Tudor’s remnant aura didn’t just permeate his body!
unit.target: Aura residua Alista Tudor non solum corpus eius pervasit!

unit.source: And the Blood Emperor was closely linked to the Samaritan Women’s Spring!
unit.target: Et Imperator Sanguinis arcte cum Fonte Mulierum Samaritanarum coniunctus erat!

unit.source: Wearing a golden mask, Hisoka’s body began to etherealize uncontrollably.
unit.target: Larvam auream gerens, corpus Hisokae irrationabiliter in aetherem mutari coepit.

unit.source: Just as he was about to grasp the hand of the corpse protruding from the black ancient tomb, he suddenly sensed an extremely terrifying, frenzied, and violent aura appearing behind him.
unit.target: Iam cum manum cadaveris, quae ex sepulcro antiquato nigro protulisset, arripere pararet, subito sensit auram extremam, terribilem, et furibundam post se apparire.

unit.source: It soared into the sky explosively, sweeping through the surroundings.
unit.target: Explosione in caelum volavit, circumiecta vastans.

unit.source: The crimson moon’s glow dimmed, and “Hisoka” Twanaku’s body instinctively stiffened, trembling violently.
unit.target: Lux lunaris carminis rubri attenuata est, et corpus "Hisoka" Twanaku instinctu riguit, violentissime tremens.

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

unit.source: An illusory sound of water echoed from the black ancient tomb, and the golden palm seemed to be dragged back into the tomb by some unknown force.
unit.target: Sonus aquae illusorius ex sepulcro antiquato nigro resonavit, et palma aurea videbatur aliqua ignota vi in sepulcrum revocari.

unit.source: The feeling of their souls being imprisoned within their bodies dissipated.
unit.target: Sensatio animarum eorum intra corpora inclusarum evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian hurriedly halted the dissipation of the Blood Emperor’s aura.
unit.target: Lumian festinanter dismissionem aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis cohibuit.

unit.source: Although Amandina, Camus, Devajo, and the others instinctively felt fear, the confinement of their spirits and fixed line of sight prevented them from discovering the source of the aura that conquered everything.
unit.target: Quamvis Amandina, Camus, Devajo, et ceteri instinctu timorem sentirent, confinatio spirituum eorum et linea visus fixa eos impediunt ut fontem aurae, quae omnia superabat, detegerent.

unit.source: Ignoring the search for the origin of the terrifying aura, the fierce-eyed Iveljsta followed his instinctive desire and retrieved an item from his hidden pocket.
unit.target: Originem aurae terribilis neglexit, et Iveljsta, oculis ferocibus, instinctum sequens rem ex sinu occulto extraxit.

unit.source: It was a palm-sized rag doll, dressed in a black Gothic dress entwined with eerie vines.
unit.target: Erat pupula magnitudinis palmae, in veste Gothica nigra induta, vites insolitas circumtexta.

unit.source: It had long golden hair and blood-red eyes.
unit.target: Capillum longum aureum habebat et oculos sanguine rubros.

unit.source: The doll was sinister.
unit.target: Pupula sinistra erat.

unit.source: Just the sight of it made Lumian’s flesh crawl beneath his skin.
unit.target: Ipsius eius aspectus carnem Lumiani sub cute agitantem faciebat.

unit.source: Thud! Thud! Thud!
unit.target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

unit.source: The heartbeat in the black ancient tomb intensified, becoming resounding.
unit.target: Pulsus cordis in sepulcro antiquato nigro intensificatus est, sonorus factus.

unit.source: Beside the tomb door, “Hisoka” Twanaku felt a chill run down his spine, as if targeted by an evil being.
unit.target: Apud ianuam sepulcri, "Hisoka" Twanaku frigidum per dorsum currere sensit, quasi a mala entitate destinatus.

unit.source: Instinctively, he recalled something.
unit.target: Instincte, aliquid meminit.

unit.source: Years ago, gravekeepers had found a half-withered evil heart near the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Ante annos, custodes sepulchri cor maleficum semi-exsiccatum prope sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum invenerunt.

unit.source: The gravekeepers believed that the ancient corpse in the tomb had been lost due to some mutation.
unit.target: Custodes sepulchri crediderunt antiquatum cadaver in sepulcro ob aliquam mutationem amissum esse.

unit.source: After all, the characteristics of its power were the same, and the levels seemed similar.
unit.target: Nam proprietates potentiae eius eadem erant, et gradus similes videbantur.

unit.source: Therefore, they placed the heart back into the tomb.
unit.target: Ergo cor iterum in sepulcrum reponerunt.

unit.source: Just a moment ago, the long-dead heart had begun to beat, but now it beat stronger and faster!
unit.target: Modo abhinc, cor diu mortuum pulsare coepit, sed nunc fortius atque celerius pulsabat!

unit.source: Not far from Iveljsta, Reaza also made a move.
unit.target: Non longe ab Iveljsta, Reaza quoque motum fecit.

unit.source: He produced a mask.
unit.target: Larvam produxit.

unit.source: The mask, also made of gold, bore a striking resemblance to the one worn by Hisoka.
unit.target: Larva, etiam ex auro facta, eminenti similitudine induta erat cum ea, quam Hisoka gerebat.

unit.source: Varying shades of white and black paint adorned the eyes and face!
unit.target: Toni varii albi et nigri oculos et faciem ornabant!

unit.source: The difference between the two golden masks was that the one in Reaza’s hand was darker, as if touched by death.
unit.target: Differentia inter duas larvas aureas erat quod illa in manu Reaza obscurius videbatur, quasi morte tincta.

unit.source: Then, Reaza produced a human skull carved from crystal.
unit.target: Deinde, Reaza calvariam hominis ex crystallo sculptam produxit.

unit.source: He placed the dark golden mask on the crystal skull’s face.
unit.target: Posuit larvam auream obscuram super faciem calvariae crystallinae.

unit.source: A frigid wind gusted, engulfing the crystal skull in a massive vortex.
unit.target: Frigidus ventus impetu sufflavit, calvariam crystallinam in ingenti vortice devorans.

unit.source: The crystal skull, adorned with the golden mask, levitated, as if it had grown an invisible body made of wind.
unit.target: Calvaria crystallina, larva aurea ornata, levitabat, quasi corpus invisibile ex vento factum haberet.

unit.source: An intense coldness spread in all directions, condensing a layer of frost on the ground.
unit.target: Intensa frigiditas in omnibus partibus diffusa est, stratum pruinae in solo condensans.

unit.source: The man named Devajo reached behind his head and grasped something in his hair.
unit.target: Vir nomine Devajo post caput suum pervenit et aliquid in capillis apprehendit.

unit.source: With a sudden tug, he ripped off his skin, along with his dark gray suit.
unit.target: Subito trahente, cutem suam una cum vestimento griseo obscuro evellit.

unit.source: Devajo took on a different appearance.
unit.target: Devajo aliam speciem induit.

unit.source: He had black hair, brown eyes, a cold expression, and high cheekbones.
unit.target: Capillos nigros habebat, oculos fuscos, vultum frigidum, atque genae altas.

unit.source: He was in his thirties or forties, dressed in a white shirt and black pants.
unit.target: Inter tricesimum et quadragesimum aetas, indutus veste alba tunica et bracas negras, erat.

unit.source: He flipped the human skin in his hand, revealing dense, dizzying blood embroidery beneath.
unit.target: Cutem humanam in manu sua vertit, subdeponens densam et vertiginosam sanguinis ornamentationem.

unit.source: Devajo opened his mouth and spat out mouthfuls of blood, emitting a strong sulfuric smell.
unit.target: Devajo os aperuit et guttas sanguinis exspulit, fortem odorem sulfureum emittens.

unit.source: The blood protruded from the human skin, forming a green-eyed man in a dark gray suit.
unit.target: Sanguis ex cute humana prolapsus, virum oculis viridibus in veste grisea obscura formavit.

unit.source: With a playful smile, the “man” approached the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Cum risu ludenti, "vir" ad sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum accedebat.

unit.source: Lumian quickly scanned the area, his eyelids twitching three times.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter aream perlustrare coepit, palpebris oculorum ter concutiens.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but criticize, "Do you all possess godhood-level powers that you can utilize? Although they all seem to be one-time use… Are you bullying me for not having any?"
unit.target: Non potuit quin reprehenderetur: "Habitisne omnes potentias deitatis adhibendas? Quamquam omnes videntur solum ad usum unum destinatae… me vexatis quod nullas habeo?"

unit.source: Despite Lumian’s criticism, he quickly recited an honorific name in ancient Hermes.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumiani reprehensione, celeriter nomen honorificum in antiquo Hermete recitavit.

unit.source: It was Madam Magician’s honorific name.
unit.target: Erat nomen honorificum Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: However, it failed to penetrate this special and hidden dream.
unit.target: Attamen, illud penetrare somnium hoc speciale et occultum non potuit.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t dejected.
unit.target: Lumian non deiectus est.

unit.source: His goal wasn’t the black ancient tomb, nor was it the cold corpse or its beating heart.
unit.target: Propositum eius non erat sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum, neque cadaver frigidus aut cor eius pulsans.

unit.source: Now that he knew the whereabouts of Hisoka’s gold, there was only one thing he wanted to do.
unit.target: Iam quod locum auri Hisokae cognovisset, unum tantum agere volebat.

unit.source: Eliminate Hisoka’s dream projection, take away the golden mask, and let him perish completely!
unit.target: Elimina proiectionem somnii Hisokae, aufer larvam auream, et sinito eum penitus perire!

unit.source: 689 Precision
unit.target: 689 Praecisio

unit.source: Although Lumian’s target was clear, he didn’t immediately attack Hisoka’s dream projection.
unit.target: Quamquam scopus Lumiani clarus erat, non statim oppugnavit imaginem somnii Hisokae.

unit.source: This was because his opponent was still beside the black ancient tomb, and under the gaze of three items with godhood power, Lumian might be targeted by all of them if he teleported over.
unit.target: Hoc enim erat, quia adversarius eius adhuc iuxta antiquum tumulum nigrum stabat, et sub aspectu trium rerum divinitatis praeditarum Lumian ab omnibus incideret, si se translataret.

unit.source: The three items hadn’t reached the point where Lumian couldn’t be under their gaze simultaneously, and they appeared to last only a few minutes.
unit.target: Tres res nondum ad statum pervenerant quo Lumian eorum conspectu simul esse non posset, et videbantur tantum paucis minutis manere.

unit.source: However, they displayed certain humanoid characteristics, as if they possessed the ability to think and make decisions on their own.
unit.target: Sed tamen certas notas humanoides ostendebant, quasi propriam facultatem ad cogitandum et iudicandum haberent.

unit.source: If targeted by them, it would be no different from facing weakened Sequence 4 demigods.
unit.target: Si ab illis destinatus esset, nihil differebat ab adversitate contra debilitatos “Sequence 4” semideos.

unit.source: Under such circumstances, Lumian naturally wouldn’t take the initiative to enter the eye of the storm and help “Hisoka” Twanaku share the burden.
unit.target: Sub his condicionibus, Lumian naturaliter non caperet inceptum ingredi in oculum tempestatis atque “Hisoka” Twanaku adiuvare ut onus communicarentur.

unit.source: He even felt that if his rival was killed by an outsider whom he had personally attracted, it would be cause for celebration.
unit.target: Etiam sensit, si adversarius eius a viro externo, quem ipse attraxerat, interfectus esset, id rem celebrationi causa fore.

unit.source: It was inevitable—after all, since he had already killed Hisoka once, he wasn’t obsessed with obliterating the other party’s resurrection.
unit.target: Inevitabile erat—nam cum iam semel Hisoka interfecisset, non animum haberet ad resurrectionem alterius partis delendam.

unit.source: Having someone else “do it” for him could reduce his spirituality expenditure.
unit.target: Quod aliquis alius id pro eo faceret, expensam spiritualem eius minui posse videbatur.

unit.source: As Lumian gazed at the open tomb door, he retreated a few steps to the edge of the area.
unit.target: Dum Lumian ad ostium sepulcri apertum aspiceret, paucis gradibus recedebat ad marginem loci.

unit.source: He quickly said to Amandina, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano, “Retreat to the edge!”
unit.target: Celeriter Amandinae, Camus, Rheae, et Luganoni inquit: “Recedite ad margines!”

unit.source: Upon hearing this order, Lugano’s face lit up with happiness.
unit.target: Audito hoc imperio, vultus Luganonis laetitiae splenduit.

unit.source: He was the first to turn around and sprint away.
unit.target: Ille primus se vertit et currens fugam iniecit.

unit.source: Rhea raised her hunting bow, aiming left and right, taking slow steps back to guard against any attacks.
unit.target: Rhea arcum venatorium attoluit, ad sinistram ac ad dextram intendens, tardis gradibus recedens ut adversos impetus obsideret.

unit.source: Camus’s performance was similar to hers, but he held his custom revolver.
unit.target: Camus similiter se agebat, sed tenebat revolverum suum proprium.

unit.source: Amandina glanced at the sinister rag doll, the crystal skull adorned with a golden mask, and the green-eyed man with bulging human skin.
unit.target: Amandina intuebatur ad pupam pannosam maleficam, ad calvariam crystallinam masca aurea ornate, et ad virum oculis viridibus cum cute humana protuberante.

unit.source: She felt lightheaded, as if she was too exhausted to control her body.
unit.target: Se capite leviter afflata sensit, quasi nimis defessa esset ut corpus suum moderaretur.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: She instantly realized that these were things she shouldn’t come into contact with.
unit.target: Statim animadvertit has res esse, quarum congressum vitare deberet.

unit.source: What transpired beside the black tomb was beyond her ability to interfere.
unit.target: Quod iuxta sepulcrum nigrum evenit, extra facultatem eius ad interveniendum erat.

unit.source: She swiftly turned her back to the ancient black tomb and prepared to follow Lugano to the edge of the area.
unit.target: Celeriter vertebat dorsum ad tumulum antiquum nigrum et se praeparabat ut Luganum ad marginem loci sequeretur.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian, wearing a grayish-white lightning-shaped brooch, glanced at the gravekeepers who were also hurriedly retreating and thoughtfully asked Amandina, “Where’s that figure?”
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian, indutus fibula fulminiformis cinereo-alba, aspiciens custodes sepulchrorum (qui celeriter recedebant) Amandinae cum medita quaesivit: “Ubi est illa figura?”

unit.source: Amandina ran nimbly, synchronizing her movements with her breathing as she replied, “I don’t know! He’s gone!”
unit.target: Amandina celeriter cucurrit, motus suos cum spiritu congruentes, atque respondit: “Nescio! Abiit!”

unit.source: As soon as she finished speaking, the illusory water reverberating in the black tomb ceased.
unit.target: Statim postquam locutionem finivit, aqua illusoria, resonans in sepulcro nigro, cessavit.

unit.source: The palm-sized evil rag doll in the Gothic dress suddenly floated up, escaping Iveljsta’s grasp.
unit.target: Parva pupa pannosa mala, in veste Gothica induta, subito levavit, evadens prehensione Iveljstae.

unit.source: It hovered in midair, with “Hisoka” Twanaku’s figure reflected in its blood-red eyes.
unit.target: In medio aerei manebat, cum figura “Hisoka” Twanaku in oculis eius sanguine rubro reflexa esset.

unit.source: Twanaku, who was about to reach into the ancient black tomb, suddenly felt the golden mask on his face come to life.
unit.target: Twanaku, qui aditum ad tumulum antiquum nigrum ferre parabat, subito sensit mascam auream in facie eius animari.

unit.source: It first pressed inward, as if it wanted to crush his skull, then pulled outward, as if trying to escape.
unit.target: Primum intus premebat, tamquam cranium eius conterere vellet, deinde extra trahebat, quasi effugere conaretur.

unit.source: Hisoka instinctively raised his right hand to press the golden mask back, only to realize that his sleeve had tightly wrapped around his arm, immobilizing it, almost like it was tied up.
unit.target: Hisoka, consilio innato, dextrum manum attoluit ad mascam auream repellendam, sed animadvertit manicam suam arcte circa brachium eius involutum esse, id immobile faciens, quasi ligatum.

unit.source: Remembering the fate of a godhoodless individual losing the golden mask at the tomb’s entrance, Twanaku didn’t hesitate.
unit.target: Meminens fatum personae sine numine, quae mascam auream ad initium sepulcri amisit, Twanaku non dubitavit.

unit.source: His body became completely ethereal as he transformed into a Wraith.
unit.target: Corpus eius omnino evanuit, transmutans se in umbram.

unit.source: Then, he vanished from in front of the black tomb and reappeared in the pupil of one of the gravekeepers who had removed their golden mask.
unit.target: Tum evanuit ante sepulcrum nigrum et iterum apparuit in pupilla unius ex custodes sepulchrorum, qui mascam auream removerat.

unit.source: Due to the untimely demise of Hisoka’s physical body and his inability to get “assistance,” Hisoka had no choice but to modify his plan and wait for the three factions vying for the cold corpse in the ancient black tomb to begin fighting.
unit.target: Ob mortem intempestivam corporis Hisokae et eius incapacitatem ad “auxilium” recipiendum, Hisoka non habuit aliter quam consilium suum mutare atque exspectare, dum tres factiones pro corpore frigido in tumulo antiquo nigro certabantur.

unit.source: When the chaos reached its peak and the corresponding items were nearly depleted, he would re-enter the fray and compete for the corpse.
unit.target: Cum chaos apicem attigerit et res correspondentes paene exhauritae erunt, in pugnam redibit et pro corpore certabit.

unit.source: As Hisoka temporarily retreated, the area in front of the ancient black tomb became vacant.
unit.target: Quam Hisoka ad tempus recedens, area ante tumulum antiquum nigrum vacua facta est.

unit.source: Just as the palm-sized evil rag doll was about to float over, the crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, flew diagonally, enveloped by a vortex-shaped body formed by the cold wind.
unit.target: Ita ut parva pupa pannosa mala, in veste Gothica, pararet levare, calvaria crystallina, masca aurea ornata, diagonaliter volavit, corpus vortice formato ab vento frigido involutum.

unit.source: Pale-white flames ignited in its eyes, with a hint of darkness at the center.
unit.target: Flammae albo-pallidae in oculis eius accensa erant, cum obscuritas in medio adarsit.

unit.source: In response, illusory black water seeped out of the black tomb’s walls, forming a silent river that blocked the entrance.
unit.target: In responso, aquae illusoriae nigrae ex parietibus sepulcri nigri effluuerunt, formantes flumen silentii quod aditum obtexit.

unit.source: The river was clearly similar to a stream, but it gave Iveljsta, Devajo, Reaza, and the others a vast and expansive feeling.
unit.target: Flumen evidenter simile rivulo erat, sed Iveljsta, Devajo, Reaza, et ceteris sensum immensum et amplum praebebat.

unit.source: Their bodies gradually turned cold, and their lives drained faster, irreversibly.
unit.target: Corporibus eorum paulatim frigescere coeperunt, et vitae eorum celerius atque irrevocabiliter exhaurerentur.

unit.source: The evil rag doll, clad in a black Gothic dress, hovered in midair, not attempting to cross the silent river.
unit.target: Pupa pannosa mala, veste Gothica nigra induta, in medio aerei manebat, neque conata est flumen silentii transire.

unit.source: The crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, descended into the river.
unit.target: Calvaria crystallina, masca aurea ornata, in flumen descendit.

unit.source: The wind vortex that constituted its colossal body howled and expanded, as if transforming into an invisible ferry that floated steadily on the surface of the silent river.
unit.target: Vortex venti, qui corpus eius colossale efficiēbat, ululavit atque expandebatur, quasi in naviculam invisibilem transfiguraretur, quae constanter super superficiem fluminis silentii maneret.

unit.source: The crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, steered the ferry against the current, slowly approaching the open door of the ancient black tomb.
unit.target: Calvaria crystallina, masca aurea inducta, naviculam contra currentem gubernabat, lente appropinquantem ad ostium sepulcri antiqui nigri apertum.

unit.source: The green-eyed man, dressed in a dark gray formal suit made of human skin and blood, stood at the back, observing the scene.
unit.target: Vir oculis viridibus, indutus habitu formali griseo obscuro ex cute humana et sanguine factus, ad tergum stetit, scaenam contemplans.

unit.source: With a smile, he opened and closed his mouth, as if silently muttering to himself.
unit.target: Cum risu, os suum aperiens et claudens, quasi tacite sibi ipsi murmuraret.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, the crystal skull on the invisible ferry emitted a cracking sound.
unit.target: Fere simul, calvaria crystallina in navicula invisibili sonum crepitantem edidit.

unit.source: The pale-white flames in its eye sockets flickered violently, and tiny patterns appeared on its crystalline surface, causing invisible dust to fall.
unit.target: Flammae albo-pallidae in orbitis eius vehementer micabant, et ex superficie crystallina parvae figuras apparuerunt, quas pulveres invisibiles deicere ferebant.

unit.source: The ferry itself alternated between expansion and contraction, becoming extremely unstable as it slowed down on the River of Death.
unit.target: Ipsa navicula inter dilatationem et contrahentiam alternabat, atque extremo instabilis eveniebat, dum in Flumine Mortis tardabatur.

unit.source: Lumian paid no attention to the battle unfolding in front of the ancient black tomb.
unit.target: Lumian nullam curam habebat de proelio, quod coram tumulo antiquo nigro exercebatur.

unit.source: With a single glance, his body ignited with intense white flames.
unit.target: Uno tantum intuendo, corpus eius inflammatum est intensis flammis albis.

unit.source: Swoosh!
unit.target: Swoosh!

unit.source: He transformed into a flaming spear and crossed a distance of 20 to 30 meters, aiming at the gravekeeper whose body had been possessed by “Hisoka” Twanaku.
unit.target: Se in hastam flammantem transmutavit et spatium inter 20 et 30 metra pervenit, destinans ad custodem sepulchrorum, cuius corpus a “Hisoka” Twanaku posseditum erat.

unit.source: Hisoka raised his head, revealing a face with light-brown skin and wild beauty.
unit.target: Hisoka caput elevavit, faciem ostendens, cuius cutis levis fusca et pulchritudo fera apparuerunt.

unit.source: Rhea!
unit.target: Rhea!

unit.source: The gravekeeper whose body had been possessed by Hisoka was Rhea’s dream projection!
unit.target: Custos sepulchrorum, cuius corpus a Hisoka posseditum erat, erat imago somnii Rheae!

unit.source: Facing the rapidly expanding reflection, transforming from a speck of white light into a blazing white flaming spear with a burning tip, Hisoka didn’t dodge.
unit.target: Adspiciens reflectionem celeriter expandentem, quae a parva particula lucis albae in hastam flammam albam cum accensa punta transformabatur, Hisoka non evasit.

unit.source: He assumed a stance allowing Lumian to attack.
unit.target: Situs instituit, quo Lumian oppugnare posset.

unit.source: The blazing-white flame spear was incredibly fast.
unit.target: Hasta flammifera alba incandescens incredibiliter celer erat.

unit.source: He didn’t have time to raise his hunting bow, aim, or shoot.
unit.target: Tempus non sufficiens erat ut arcum venatorium attolleret, destinaret, aut telum iaculari posset.

unit.source: He only slightly bent his arm.
unit.target: Solum brachium leviter flectit.

unit.source: He felt a searing pain, as if his body and soul were about to be pierced.
unit.target: Sentivit dolorem flagrantem, tamquam corpus et anima eius penetrare fore parerentur.

unit.source: Hisoka showed no fear.
unit.target: Hisoka nullum metum ostendit.

unit.source: Instead, he chuckled.
unit.target: Sed potius risum edidit.

unit.source: The blazing-white flaming spear passed over his shoulder and landed behind him, failing to strike him.
unit.target: Hasta flammans alba super humerum eius transivit et post eum cecidit, ne ictu illi perveniens.

unit.source: The flames dissipated, revealing Lumian.
unit.target: Flammae evanuerunt, atque Lumian apparuit.

unit.source: The Hisoka in Rhea’s dream projection’s eyes vanished.
unit.target: Hisoka, qui in oculis imaginis somnii Rheae erat, evanuit.

unit.source: Rhea’s dream projection spun around, her expression cold and filled with hatred.
unit.target: Imago somnii Rheae circumvolvit, vultu frigido et odio pervulto.

unit.source: She raised her hunting bow, aimed at Lumian, and drew the bowstring.
unit.target: Attoluit arcum venatorium, ad Lumian destinavit, et funem arcus traxit.

unit.source: She was a dream projection formed by excessive desires and emotions, unable to control herself.
unit.target: Imago somnii, ex cupiditatibus et affectibus nimis formata, se regere non poterat.

unit.source: “Hmph!”
unit.target: “Hmph!”

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot out from Lumian’s nose.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso Lumiani emerserunt.

unit.source: Before Rhea’s dream projection could release an arrow wrapped in lightning, her eyes closed, and she fainted, collapsing to the ground.
unit.target: Priusquam imago somnii Rheae sagittam fulmine involutam emittere posset, oculi eius clauserunt, et ea lapsa in terram corruit.

unit.source: Rhea, who had just arrived at the periphery, trembled.
unit.target: Rhea, quae modo ad limitem pervenit, trepidavit.

unit.source: Her eyes reflected the black-robed “Hisoka” Twanaku.
unit.target: Oculi eius reflectere solebant imaginem “Hisoka” Twanaku, indutus vestimentis nigris.

unit.source: The strength of their souls differed significantly, and Hisoka easily possessed and seized control of Rhea’s body.
unit.target: Virtus animarum eorum notabiliter dissimilabat, et Hisoka facile corpus Rheae possedit atque imperium suscepit.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the fact that Camus, Amandina, and Lugano hadn’t noticed Rhea’s abnormality, he changed the direction of his bow and aimed it at Camus.
unit.target: Ex his, quod Camus, Amandina, et Lugano de Rheae insolita natura non animadvertissent, directionem arcus mutavit et in Camum destinavit.

unit.source: Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle.
unit.target: Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle.

unit.source: The arrowhead became engulfed in bright lightning.
unit.target: Caput sagittae in fulmine claro involutum est.

unit.source: As soon as Rhea aimed her bow and arrow at Camus, he sensed her incongruent state and noticed her abnormal behavior.
unit.target: Dum Rhea arcum et sagittam in Camum destinabat, Camus statum eius incongruum sensit atque morum insolentiam animadvertit.

unit.source: As a member of the patrol team with considerable combat experience, Camus looked at Rhea without hesitation, his eyes flashing with blinding lightning.
unit.target: Ut membrum turmae vigilarum cum nota experientia pugnandi, Camus Rheae aspexit sine haesitatione, oculis fulmine caecante micantibus.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Hisoka, who had anticipated this, detached from Rhea’s body and leaped into Amandina’s beautiful azure eyes.
unit.target: Simul, Hisoka, quod hoc praevidebat, se a corpore Rheae disiunxit et in oculis Amandinae caeruleis pulcherrimis saliit.

unit.source: Two blinding lightning bolts shot out of Camus’s eyes and drilled into Rhea’s head.
unit.target: Duo fulmina caecantia ex oculis Camusi erupere et in caput Rheae infixa sunt.

unit.source: Rhea’s eyes bulged, and her mouth gaped open.
unit.target: Oculi Rheae eminent, et os eius late patefactum est.

unit.source: She leaned back, as if she had suffered a heavy blow, but she couldn’t make a sound of pain.
unit.target: Se retraxit, quasi grave ictum perpessisset, sed sonum doloris edere non potuit.

unit.source: Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Psychic Piercing!

unit.source: Camus’s Psychic Piercing struck her before her arrow could leave the bowstring, causing her to feel pain from the depths of her soul.
unit.target: Perforatio psychica Camusi eam percussit, antequam sagitta funem arcus relinqueret, faciens ut dolorem ab intimis partibus animae sentiret.

unit.source: Her mind went blank as she stood rooted to the ground.
unit.target: Mens eius vacua facta est, dum in terra radicata staret.

unit.source: Poof. The arrow, engulfed in bright lightning, shot out unsteadily, missing Camus and flying a short distance away.
unit.target: Poof. Sagitta, in fulmine claro implicata, instabiliter exsiliit, Camum non attingens atque parvo spatio vagans.

unit.source: Amandina, with “Hisoka” Twanaku’s figure reflected in her azure eyes, felt a chill run down her spine.
unit.target: Amandina, cum imago “Hisoka” Twanaku in oculis caeruleis reflexa esset, frigus per spinam descendere sensit.

unit.source: A dense coldness enveloped her, freezing her soul and rendering her unable to control her limbs.
unit.target: Densa frigiditas eam implicavit, animam eius congelans et membra regere non sinens.

unit.source: Behind her, Lumian’s figure swiftly materialized.
unit.target: Post eam, figura Lumiani celeriter apparuit.

unit.source: “Ha!”
unit.target: “Ha!”

unit.source: Lumian opened his mouth and decisively spat out a faint yellow blob of light.
unit.target: Lumian os suum aperuit et decise exspuit globum lucis, pallidum et flavum.

unit.source: However, Hisoka had no intention of stopping.
unit.target: Attamen, Hisoka consilium intermittere non habebat.

unit.source: He shifted his position with another Mirror Jump.
unit.target: Altera saltu speculari suam positionem mutavit.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Thud!

unit.source: Amandina collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
unit.target: Amandina in terram cecidit, inconscia.

unit.source: Compared to Padre Cali, Hisoka clearly excelled in combat, possessing a wealth of experience and outstanding talent.
unit.target: Comparatus cum Padre Cali, Hisoka in pugna manifeste excelluit, abundantem experientiam et ingenium praestantem habens.

unit.source: This time, Hisoka appeared on a water droplet on the surface of a leaf more than ten meters away.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Hisoka apparuit in gutta aquae in superficie folii, situata plus quam decem metris distante.

unit.source: He leaped out and looked at Lumian and the others with a smile.
unit.target: Exsiluit et ad Lumian atque ceteros risu intuens aspexit.

unit.source: He wanted to use Wraith Shriek to attack Lumian Lee and his companions in a wide range, rendering some of them unable to fight and temporarily immobilizing the rest.
unit.target: Volebat uti “Wraith Shriek” ad oppugnandum Lumian Lee et socios eius in ampla regione, quibusdam pugnandi impotentes reddens et reliquos ad tempus immobilis faciens.

unit.source: Upon realizing this, Lumian chose not to teleport outside Wraith Shriek’s range.
unit.target: Hoc intellexit, Lumian decrevit non se teleportare extra spatium “Wraith Shriek.”

unit.source: Instead, he withdrew his palms.
unit.target: Immo, manus suas retraxit.

unit.source: A blazing white fireball condensed, the size of the black tomb.
unit.target: Globus ignis albus incandescens, magnitudine sepulcri nigri, condensatus est.

unit.source: “Ah!”
unit.target: “Ah!”

unit.source: Amidst a piercing howl of pain, the colossal white-hot fireball flew out.
unit.target: Inter acutum ululatum doloris, ingens globus ignis albus ac calidus exsiliit.

unit.source: With a smile, Hisoka vanished from the tree and leaped into Camus’s pupils, where blood flowed from his eyes, nostrils, and ears.
unit.target: Cum risu, Hisoka ex arbore evanuit et in pupillas Camusi exsiluit, ubi sanguis e oculis, naribus, et auribus fluebatur.

unit.source: At that moment, the colossal blazing white fireball split into dozens of smaller ones.
unit.target: Illo momento, ingens globus ignis albus incandescens in decurias globorum minorum divisa est.

unit.source: Accompanying this transformation, the grayish-white Fury of the Sea brooch on Lumian’s chest erupted with bright, silver‑white, and innumerable bolts of lightning after he was struck by Wraith Shriek.
unit.target: Comitante hac transformatione, fibula “Fury of the Sea” cinereo-alba in pectore Lumiani erupta est fulminibus claris, argenteo-albis et innumerabilibus, postquam ab “Wraith Shriek” percussus est.

unit.source: The lightning coiled around the incandescent white fireballs and split into dozens, enveloping the area.
unit.target: Fulmina circa globos ignis albos incandescentes se convolverunt et in decurias divisa sunt, omnem aream implicantes.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble!

unit.source: Amidst the consecutive explosions, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, and Camus were sent flying by the wind and waves.
unit.target: Inter explosionum consecutivas, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, et Camus a vento et undis volitaverunt.

unit.source: They suffered burns and were struck by a net of lightning.
unit.target: Eis ustiones afflatae sunt et rete fulminum percussi sunt.

unit.source: Camus’s entire body went numb, and his gaze lost focus.
unit.target: Totum corpus Camusi insensibile factum est, et oculi eius conspectum amiserunt.

unit.source: Hisoka, who was attached to him, also suffered an electric shock.
unit.target: Hisoka, qui ad eum adiunctus erat, etiam ictu electrico affectus est.

unit.source: Due to his Wraith state, he was severely injured and couldn’t undergo a new round of Mirror Jumps.
unit.target: Propter statum umbraticum, graviter laesus est et novum saltum speculari subire non potuit.

unit.source: Lumian recovered from the Wraith Shriek’s assault.
unit.target: Lumian ab impetu “Wraith Shriek” se restituit.

unit.source: He looked at Hisoka, who had emerged from Camus’s body, and his lips curled up.
unit.target: Lumian Hisokae, qui ex corpore Camusi apparuerat, contemplatus est, et labra eius in levitate incurvata erant.

unit.source: He was using Precision.
unit.target: Ipse “Praecisionem” adhibebat.

unit.source: The goal was to attack every target indiscriminately and ensure the damage was acceptable.
unit.target: Propositum erat omnes metas indiscriminanter oppugnare atque laedem admissibilem efficere.

unit.source: And when he launched an attack, he didn’t need to consciously control it.
unit.target: Et cum impetum iniiciebat, id regere per conscientiam non necesse habebat.

unit.source: The Fury of the Sea would automatically add an electric shock to all his offensive fireballs!
unit.target: Furor Maris automatice ictum electricum omnibus globis ignis offensivis eius addebat!

unit.source: 690 Death’s Symphony
unit.target: 690 Symphonia Mortis

unit.source: Lumian endured the pain in his soul and eardrums as he activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Lumian dolorem in anima et auriculis sustinuit, dum nigrum signum in dextro umero suo activabat.

unit.source: His figure abruptly vanished, swiftly materializing beside Camus and Hisoka.
unit.target: Figura eius subito evanuit, celeriter iuxta Camum et Hisokam apparens.

unit.source: As the residual silver-white electric currents surged into the ground, Hisoka, in Wraith form, was about to escape the paralysis’s effects.
unit.target: Dum residuae currentes electricae argenteo-albae in terram impetu transierunt, Hisoka, in forma umbræ, effectus paralysi evadere parabat.

unit.source: Lumian activated the black mark on his right chest.
unit.target: Lumian nigrum signum in dextro pectore suo activavit.

unit.source: This corresponded to the Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: Hoc incantationi "Harrumph" respondebat.

unit.source: Just as he was about to harrumph, a sudden premonition of danger struck him.
unit.target: Iam, cum "Harrumph" agere parabat, subito praemonitio insidiosa periculi eum percussit.

unit.source: He abruptly turned around and stepped back.
unit.target: Subito se vertit et retrorsum processit.

unit.source: A spear condensed from the light of dawn hurtled from afar, spanning a distance of 30 to 40 meters.
unit.target: Hasta ex luce aurorae condensata procul volavit, spatium 30 ad 40 metra transeuntem.

unit.source: It flew past Lumian and plunged into the soil behind him, leaving a deep hole as thick as an arm.
unit.target: Praeter Lumian volavit et in terram post eum incidit, relinquens fossam profundam et crassam ut brachium.

unit.source: Lumian saw his attacker–one of the gravekeepers on the verge of escaping to the periphery.
unit.target: Lumian impugnatorem suum vidit – unum ex custodibus sepulchrualibus, qui ad peripheriam effugere conabatur.

unit.source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: He was tall, and even in his black robe, his robust strength was evident.
unit.target: Altus erat, et etiam in veste nigra, robustum robur eius patebat.

unit.source: A broadsword of light had already condensed in his hand.
unit.target: Ensis lucis iam in manu ejus condensatus erat.

unit.source: A Dawn Paladin? A gravekeeper who received a boon from the Warrior pathway from the black ancient tomb?
unit.target: Paladin Aurorae? Custos sepulchrualis, qui donum ex via Bellatoris ex tumulo antiquissimo nigro accepit?

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
unit.target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

unit.source: Instead, it only confirmed his suspicions.
unit.target: Immo, illud tantum eius suspiciones confirmavit.

unit.source: What made his scalp tingle was that the other gravekeepers had also turned to face him.
unit.target: Quod caput eius formicare faciebat, erat quod ceteri custodes sepulchrualibus quoque in eum conversi erant.

unit.source: The dozen or so bestowed locked their gazes onto Lumian.
unit.target: Circiter duodecim oblati oculos suos in Lumian fixaverunt.

unit.source: Hisoka had already broken free from the paralysis caused by the electric shock.
unit.target: Hisoka iam se liberavit a paralysi, quae ictus electrici attulit.

unit.source: Worried about the Spell of Harrumph’s control, he endured the pain and leaped into the eyes of one of the gravekeepers.
unit.target: Cura incantationis "Harrumph" imperio, dolorem sustinuit et in oculos unius custodum sepulchrualium desiluit.

unit.source: Then, he broke free and transformed back into a human.
unit.target: Deinde se liberavit atque in hominem iterum versa est.

unit.source: He looked at Lumian, who was dozens of meters away, and his smile widened.
unit.target: Spectavit Lumian, qui multos metrus ab eo distante erat, et risus eius latius factus est.

unit.source: I’m also a gravekeeper now.
unit.target: Ego nunc quoque custos sepulchrualis sum.

unit.source: Harming me means harming the gravekeepers!
unit.target: Laedere me significat laedere custodibus sepulchrualibus!

unit.source: Although they won’t actively assist me and will try to escape once the tomb is opened using the current method, they will undoubtedly react if you threaten me.
unit.target: Etsi non me active adiuvabunt et conabuntur effugere, cum tumulus per hoc modum aperitur, certo reagent, si me minaberis.

unit.source: This is one of the reasons I dared to “invite” outsiders to the Dream Festival and guide them here.
unit.target: Hoc est una ex causis quae me ausum fecerunt externos ad Festum Somniorum "invitare" et hic ducere.

unit.source: Unfortunately, my main body is dead, and I can’t obtain the promised godhood item from the Celestial Worthy and Loki to resist the outsiders’ high-level powers.
unit.target: Infeliciter, corpus principale meum mortuum est, neque possum rem deitatis promissam ab Caelesti Dignitate et Loki accipere ad resistendum potentiarum externarum altarum.

unit.source: For now, I can only wait patiently.
unit.target: Ad hunc tempus, tantum patienter exspectare possum.

unit.source: According to the original plan, if something went wrong, I could choose to abandon the corpse in the tomb and help the Nois family’s Demon obtain it to aid the Rose School of Thought in exchange for other rewards.
unit.target: Secundum consilium originale, si quid male evenisset, potui cadaver in tumulo relinquere et Demonem familiae Nois adiuvare, ut id obtineret, pro aliis praemiis Scholae Rosae Mentis.

unit.source: Now, I must obtain the corpse and become its “spirit.”
unit.target: Nunc oportet me cadaver capere et eius "spiritum" fieri.

unit.source: Only then can I survive after the Dream Festival and maintain my consciousness and rationality as a demigod-level undead creature.
unit.target: Tum solum superesse possum post Festum Somniorum et conscientiam ac rationem meam servare, ut creatura "undead" ad gradum semidei existam.

unit.source: However, these matters don’t concern you, Lumian.
unit.target: Attamen haec non te, Lumian, tangunt.

unit.source: You have to face a Guardian and multiple Spirit Warlocks, Gatekeepers, Soul Assurers, Spirit Guides, and Dawn Paladins…
unit.target: Occurrere debes Custodem et plures Incantatores Spirituum, Custodes Portarum, Procuratores Animarum, Ductores Spirituum, et Paladinos Aurorae…

unit.source: No one below Sequence 4 can withstand the assault of such a Beyonder “army!”
unit.target: Nemo infra Sequentiam IV impetum huius exercitus Beyonder sustinere potest!

unit.source: Lumian watched as the gravekeepers’ gazes fell upon him.
unit.target: Lumian spectabat dum oculi custodum sepulchrualium in eum incidere videbantur.

unit.source: Some of them even condensed broadswords of light.
unit.target: Nonnulli eorum etiam enses lucis condensaverunt.

unit.source: As they charged forward, Lumian tensed up.
unit.target: Dum impetum fecerunt, Lumian se contraxit.

unit.source: He reached out, grabbed Camus’s shoulder, and teleported away from his current position.
unit.target: Manum extendit, umerum Camus cepit, et se ex loco suo translatus est.

unit.source: Not long after they vanished, the ground silently collapsed, and pale-white palms extended outward.
unit.target: Non multo postquam evanuerunt, terra silentio corruit, et palmae pallide-albae se protulerunt.

unit.source: Lumian appeared beside the severely injured Rhea with Camus and grabbed her shoulder with his other hand.
unit.target: Lumian apparuit iuxta Rhea graviter laesam cum Camus, et altera manu umerum eius cepit.

unit.source: Then, the trio swiftly vanished, reappearing beside Amandina, who had awakened from the electric shock.
unit.target: Deinde trio celeriter evanuit, et iuxta Amandinam, quae ab ictu electrico evigilaverat, iterum apparuit.

unit.source: The distance between them and the gravekeepers widened to nearly a hundred meters.
unit.target: Distantia inter eos et custodes sepulchrualibus fere ad centum metra extenta est.

unit.source: Lumian clamped his feet around Amandina’s arm, releasing the accumulated spirituality and strength in his body.
unit.target: Lumian pedibus circum brachium Amandinae premebat, spiritualitatem ac vires in corpore suo congregatas dimittens.

unit.source: His condition returned to normal, and he activated the black mark on his right shoulder once more.
unit.target: Status eius ad statum normalem rediit, et iterum signum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

unit.source: This time, the four of them teleported to Lugano, who was self-healing.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, quattuor simul se translaverunt ad Lugano, qui se ipse curabat.

unit.source: As Lumian continued to flash, some of the gravekeepers’ Beyonder powers failed to hit them.
unit.target: Dum Lumian fulgure pergebat, nonnullae potentiae Beyonder custodum sepulchrualium eos attingere non potuerunt.

unit.source: The remaining ones were forced to change directions repeatedly, preventing them from closing the distance.
unit.target: Reliqui coacti sunt directiones iteratas mutare, ne distantiam minuere possent.

unit.source: Just as Lugano was about to tell his employer, "Let’s escape quickly. Teleport us back to Tizamo," he saw Lumian toss Camus and Rhea towards him.
unit.target: Ita ut Lugano dominum suum alloqui voluit, "Festinanter evadamus. Teleporta nos ad Tizamo," vidit Lumian Camum et Rhea in suam partem iactari.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: The three of them collapsed together, followed by Amandina.
unit.target: Tres simul corruerunt, deinde Amandina secuta est.

unit.source: "Ha!"
unit.target: "Ha!"

unit.source: Lumian spat out a pale-yellow light, enveloping the four of them.
unit.target: Lumian lucem pallido-flavum exspuit, quae eos quattuor involvit.

unit.source: Lugano, Amandina, and the others lost consciousness.
unit.target: Lugano, Amandina, et ceteri conscientiam amiserunt.

unit.source: With their souls’ strength, it would take them at least a minute to regain consciousness without external stimulation.
unit.target: Virtute animarum suarum, saltem unum minutum opus erat ut, sine externis impulsionibus, conscientiam recuperarent.

unit.source: With this done, Lumian teleported away once more, preventing himself from being targeted by the gravekeepers whose abilities were effective at this distance.
unit.target: Hoc factum, Lumian iterum se translatus est, ita se prohibens a custodibus sepulchrualibus, quorum potentiae ad hanc distantiam efficaciter erant.

unit.source: His body vanished, and the gravekeepers, including Hisoka, lost sight of him.
unit.target: Corpus eius evanuit, et custodes sepulchrualibus, inter quos Hisoka erat, eum evanuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian silently materialized behind the gravekeepers, appearing in front of a palm tree.
unit.target: Lumian silentio se materializavit post custodes sepulchrualibus, apparebat coram palma.

unit.source: Leaning against the rough trees, he retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ad arboribus aspidis recubans, rem ex sacculo viatoris sui extraxit.

unit.source: It was a blackened bone flute with blood-colored holes.
unit.target: Erat fistula ossium nigra, cum foramina sanguine tincta.

unit.source: Symphony of Hatred!
unit.target: Symphonia Odii!

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curled up as he brought the sinister bone flute to his lips with a smile.
unit.target: Labia Lumiani incurvata sunt, dum sinistram fistulam ossium ad labia sua, risu, attulit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, "Hisoka" Twanaku felt a strong premonition of danger.
unit.target: Fere simul, "Hisoka" Twanaku vehementi praemonitioni periculi sensit.

unit.source: He abruptly turned around, spotted Lumian, and locked onto him.
unit.target: Subito se vertit, Lumian conspexit, et in eum oculos imposuit.

unit.source: He activated his Devil form, transforming into a pitch-black monster nearly three meters tall with curved goat horns and bat-like wings.
unit.target: Formam Diaboli suam activavit, transformans se in monstrum nigerrimum, fere trium metrorum altum, cum cornibus caprinis curvis et alis vespertilionaceis.

unit.source: Hisoka instinctively abandoned his Wraith form, forsaking the plan of possessing Lumian Lee and restraining him.
unit.target: Hisoka instinctu formam umbræ suae reliquit, consilium Lumian Lee possidendi et cohibendi deserens.

unit.source: He found it impossible to remain calm under the aura capable of conquering everything and reflexively fled from the other party.
unit.target: Invenit se non posse sub aura, quae omnia vincere potest, quiescere, atque reflexe a contra parte fugere.

unit.source: Accompanied by Hisoka’s movements, the gravekeepers also turned.
unit.target: Comitante motu Hisoka, custodes sepulchrualibus quoque se converterunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips touched the black bone flute, emitting a bloody scent, and he played the first note.
unit.target: Labia Lumiani fistulam ossium nigram tetigerunt, efferens odorem sanguineum, et primam notam canere coepit.

unit.source: The smile on his face widened.
unit.target: Risus in facie eius latius factus est.

unit.source: In the real world, facing such a large group of Sequence 7, 6, and 5 Beyonders, he could only teleport Lugano and the others back to Tizamo.
unit.target: In mundo vero, adversus tam magnam coetum Beyonderorum Sequenciarum 7, 6, et 5, solum Lugano et ceteros ad Tizamo teleporterare poterat.

unit.source: However, this was the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc erat Festum Somniorum.

unit.source: Apart from the few who had recently arrived and could remain lucid, the others were either fused with their dream projections or allowed the corresponding dream projections to move independently.
unit.target: Praeter paucos qui nuper advenerant atque lucidi manere potuerant, ceteri vel cum imaginibus somniorum suis fusae erant vel illis imaginibus moveri licebatur.

unit.source: Dream projections were formed from excessive desires and emotions, and they would lose control during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Proiecta somniorum ex cupiditatibus et affectibus excessivis formata erant, et in Festo Somniorum imperium amitterentur.

unit.source: Realizing that Hisoka’s dream projection could also become a gravekeeper and maintain a certain level of lucidity and rationality, Lumian believed that it wasn’t that the gravekeepers didn’t have dream projections, but that they had fused with them.
unit.target: Animadvertens proiectionem somniorum Hisoka quoque fieri posse custodem sepulchrualem et gradum aliquam luciditatis et rationis retinere, Lumian credidit non custodum imagines somniorum deesse, sed quod cum ipsis fusae essent.

unit.source: Using their uniqueness and their self-control in their lucid state, they barely suppressed them.
unit.target: Eorum singularitate et moderamine in statu lucido utebantur, atque vix illos reprimebant.

unit.source: Such targets were the Symphony of Hatred’s favorite prey.
unit.target: Talia proposita erant praeda dilectissima Symphoniae Odii.

unit.source: It could inflict an attack on the weakness of an enemy’s mind or body who heard the corresponding melody.
unit.target: Illud ictum inferre poterat in infirmitate animi aut corporis inimici, qui melos congruens audiret.

unit.source: Those with unstable minds might experience symptoms akin to madness.
unit.target: Qui mentes instabiles habebant, symptomata similia insaniae experiri poterant.

unit.source: Those with psychological issues might have latent problems triggered.
unit.target: Qui difficultates psychologicas habebant, latentia problemata excitari possent.

unit.source: There’s even a chance that excessive desires could cause them to explode on the spot.
unit.target: Etiam fieri potest ut cupiditates excessivae eos in loco explodere faciant.

unit.source: Individuals with illnesses or old injuries would inevitably face severe consequences.
unit.target: Individui, qui morbos aut veteres laesiones habent, inevitabiliter graves consequentias patiuntur.

unit.source: Those less fortunate might find themselves trapped in extreme misfortune.
unit.target: Qui minus fortunati erant, se in extrema miseria captos invenire possent.

unit.source: Faced with the dream projections—against the gravekeepers who might have fused with them, Lumian felt that the Symphony of Hatred could be miraculously effective, igniting 100% of the targets’ excessive desires and emotions!
unit.target: Oppositus proiectionibus somniorum — contra custodes sepulchrualibus qui cum his fusae esse poterant — Lumian sensit Symphoniam Odii miraculosam vim habere posse, igniscere centesimam partem cupiditatum et affectuum propositorum!

unit.source: Therefore, he chose to make such an attempt.
unit.target: Ergo talem conatum facere elegit.

unit.source: If it failed, he would teleport back to the unconscious Amandina and company, hold onto them, and return to Tizamo.
unit.target: Si id deficeret, se teleporteraret revertens ad Amandinam exanimatam et sociatos, eos tenens, atque ad Tizamo rediret.

unit.source: A melodious and sorrowful melody sounded, but "Hisoka" Twanaku, who was too late to stop Lumian, instinctively burned the two curved and mysterious goat horns on his head.
unit.target: Carmen melodiosum et lugubrium sonuit, sed "Hisoka" Twanaku, qui sero Lumian prohibere potuit, instinctu duo cornua caprina curva et arcana in capite suo combusit.

unit.source: Mental Shock!
unit.target: Stupor Mentis!

unit.source: Lumian’s emotions swelled, and the melody he played was filled with unmistakable pain and hatred.
unit.target: Emotiones Lumiani augebantur, et melodia quam percussit, dolore et odio inequivoco suffusa erat.

unit.source: He also saw many spirits, as well as the gravekeepers wielding broadswords of light, rushing towards him in various ways.
unit.target: Vidit quoque multos spiritus, item custodes sepulchrualibus ensibus lucis condensatis, qui variis modis ad eum accurrere videbantur.

unit.source: He continued playing the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Pergebat canere Symphoniam Odii.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Pum! Pum! Pum!

unit.source: Apart from the unconscious Rhea’s dream projection, all the gravekeepers, including Hisoka, halted with contorted expressions.
unit.target: Praeter proiectionem somniorum Rhea exanimatae et Custodem, qui retinere conabatur, custodes sepulchrualibus omnes mortui erant.

unit.source: They heard illusory explosions in their bodies and minds, and their eyes instantly turned bloodshot.
unit.target: Audierunt explosiones phantasmaticas in corporibus et mentibus, et oculi eorum statim in rubore sanguineo versati sunt.

unit.source: They lost control of their bodies, and their ears were filled with buzzing sounds.
unit.target: Imperium corporis amiserunt, et aures eorum sonis zumientibus impletae sunt.

unit.source: They couldn’t see, hear, or think.
unit.target: Non poterant videre, audire, aut cogitare.

unit.source: Their bodies and souls had been severely injured.
unit.target: Corporibus ac animis eorum graviter laesae sunt.

unit.source: The same went for "Hisoka" Twanaku.
unit.target: Idem accidit "Hisoka" Twanaku.

unit.source: In essence, he remained a dream projection formed by extreme emotions and desires.
unit.target: Essentialiter, remansit proiectione somniorum, ex affectibus ac cupiditatibus extremis formata.

unit.source: However, as he suffered the Symphony of Hatred’s weakness attack, he also ignited Lumian’s emotions and desires from the impact.
unit.target: Attamen, dum passus est ictum infirmitatis Symphoniae Odii, etiam excitavit affectus ac cupiditates Lumiani ex impetu.

unit.source: Lumian’s mind buzzed, and blood vessels bulged in his green eyes.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani zumitum habebat, et vasa sanguinea in oculis viridibus eius eminent.

unit.source: A viscous liquid reeking of blood flowed from his nose, and his internal organs seemed to suffer varying degrees of damage.
unit.target: Liquor viscosus, odores sanguinis diffundens, ex naso eius effluens, et organa interna damna variis gradibus pati videbantur.

unit.source: The Symphony of Hatred fell to the ground with a thud.
unit.target: Symphonia Odii strepitu terram percussa cecidit.

unit.source: More than a hundred meters away from Lumian, near the forest, the unconscious Amandina, Lugano, and company’s faces contorted, as if they were trapped in different nightmares.
unit.target: Plus quam centum metra a Lumiano, prope silvam, vultus Amandinae exanimatae, Lugani, et consortium contorti erant, veluti in variis incubis inclusi.

unit.source: Devajo, weakened by spitting out blood to the human skin, silently approached the edge of the forest, ready to escape at any moment.
unit.target: Devajo, sanguine ad cutem humanam expectu debilitatus, silentiose ad marginem silvae accessit, omni momento evadere paratus.

unit.source: However, he heard the Symphony of Hatred’s melody.
unit.target: Attamen, audivit melodiam Symphoniae Odii.

unit.source: He froze, vomiting copious amounts of bright red blood that reeked of sulfur.
unit.target: Stetit, vomiens copiosas quantitates sanguinis rubri nitidi, sulphuris odores diffundentes.

unit.source: His entire being weakened, and he nearly lost control.
unit.target: Totum ens eius debilitatum est, et prope imperium suum amisit.

unit.source: Iveljsta watched as the evil rag doll emitted a silent shriek, transforming the crystal skull with its golden mask and its invisible "ferry" into a pale-white goat.
unit.target: Iveljsta spectabat, dum maligna pupula pannosa silentio stridens edidit, transformans calvariam crystallinam cum facie aurea et "ferrario" invisibili in capram pallide-albam.

unit.source: Just as he was about to approach the silent river in front of the black ancient tomb in delight, his pale-white face instantly flushed red, and dark-red blood flowed from the corners of his eyes, nose, mouth, and ears.
unit.target: Iam ut, cum exsultatione flumen silentium coram tumulo antiquissimo nigro appropinquare vellet, facies eius pallide-alba repente rubescere coepit, et sanguis obscuroruber ex angulis oculorum, nasi, buae, et aurium fluere coepit.

unit.source: He had also suffered the explosion of emotions and desires, but he wasn’t a dream projection, nor had he fused with one.
unit.target: Ipse etiam explosionem affectuum et cupiditatum passi erat, sed non erat proiectionem somniorum, neque cum aliqua fusus erat.

unit.source: Therefore, he was only severely injured, unlike the gravekeepers and Devajo, who were pushed to the brink of death.
unit.target: Ergo ipse tantum graviter laesus erat, contrarium custodibus sepulchrualibus et Devajo, qui ad exitium natum impelli erant.

unit.source: Reaza, who had maintained his lucidity and rationality without a dream projection, panted heavily, as if caught in a struggle of his own.
unit.target: Reaza, qui lucidem mentem et rationem sine proiectione somniorum retinuerat, vehementer spiritavit, quasi in sua certatione capta esset.

unit.source: His cold eyes became rather lost.
unit.target: Oculi eius frigidi satis dispersi erant.

unit.source: In the area where the black tomb resided, only the evil rag doll, the human skin man, and the pale-white goat with the golden mask remained unaffected by the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: In area, ubi tumulus niger erat, solae maligna pupula pannosa, homo cutis, et capra pallide-alba cum masca aurea invariatae manebant.

unit.source: Relying on his Ascetic endurance, Lumian quickly recovered from the severe damage caused by the explosion of desire and emotions.
unit.target: Confidens in constantia ascetica, Lumian celeriter a gravibus vulneribus, quibus explosionem cupiditatum et affectuum afflixerat, se sanavit.

unit.source: Gazing at Hisoka and the others, who had yet to recover, he smiled and extended his right palm.
unit.target: Intuens Hisokam et ceteros, qui adhuc non sanati erant, risit et dextram palmam extulit.

unit.source: A colossal white-hot fireball swiftly condensed, engulfed in silver-white lightning, and launched.
unit.target: Globulus ignis colossalis candens celeriter condensatus, fulmine argenteo-albo circumvolutus, et iactus est.

unit.source: Upon reaching the gravekeepers’ area, it split into nearly 20 smaller lightning fireballs that blasted at "Hisoka" Twanaku and the gravekeepers.
unit.target: Ad locum custodum sepulchrualium perveniens, dividit se in fere viginti globulos ignis fulminis minores, qui "Hisoka" Twanaku et custodes sepulchrualibus iactabant.

unit.source: Precision!
unit.target: Praecisio!

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: Blazing white flames and silver-white lightning surged simultaneously.
unit.target: Flammae candidae ardentes atque fulmina argenteo-albae simul impetu erant.

unit.source: Lumian watched as the gravekeepers, already on the brink of death, collapsed like straw, their lives extinguished one after another.
unit.target: Lumian spectabat dum custodes sepulchrualibus, iam ad limen mortis, quasi palea corruerunt, eorum vitae alter alterum exstinguentes.

unit.source: This is what Culling means…
unit.target: Hoc est quod Culling significat…

unit.source: Lumian closed his eyes and took it in.
unit.target: Lumian oculos clausit et id percepit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rugitus!

unit.source: Apart from the unconscious Rhea’s dream projection and the Guardian struggling to hold on, the gravekeepers were all dead.
unit.target: Praeter proiectionem somniorum Rhea exanimatae et Custodem, qui retinere conabatur, custodes sepulchrualibus omnes mortui erant.

unit.source: Only "Hisoka" Twanaku, his body still emitting silver-white lightning, remained.
unit.target: Solum "Hisoka" Twanaku, cuius corpus adhuc fulmina argenteo-alba emittens, remansit.

unit.source: His eyes were bloodshot, on the verge of losing control.
unit.target: Oculi eius sanguine rubentes erant, ad limen imperii cedere.

unit.source: At that moment, he saw a flaming spear wrapped in silver-white lightning fly over and collide with the side of his nose.
unit.target: Illo momento, vidit hastam flammantem, fulmine argenteo-albo involutam, supervolitare et ad latus nasi eius collidens.

unit.source: Amidst a sizzling sound, the blazing white flaming spear pierced through his skull, igniting his brain and flying behind him, leaving behind raging silver-white electric snakes.
