unit.target: Inter sonitum sibilantem, hastam flammantem alban nitidi, fulmine argenteo-albo involutam, per calvariam eius perfodit, cerebrum incendens et post eum volitans, relinquens angues electricos argenteo-albos furibundos.

unit.source: As the flames dissipated, Lumian’s figure appeared, his back facing "Hisoka" Twanaku.
unit.target: Dum flammas evanuerunt, figura Lumiani apparuit, dorso ad "Hisoka" Twanaku converso.

unit.source: The Devil-form Hisoka’s eyes glazed over.
unit.target: Oculi Hisoka in forma Diaboli obnubilati sunt.

unit.source: He swayed a few times before collapsing to the ground.
unit.target: Paucos temporis motus fuit, deinde in terram corruit.

unit.source: Weakness Investigation!
unit.target: Investigatio Debilitatis!

unit.source: Cull!
unit.target: Extermina!

unit.source: 691 Pursuer
unit.target: 691 Sectator

unit.source: As the blazing white flames rapidly dissipated, Lumian turned his back on “Hisoka” Twanaku and fixed his gaze on the Guardian, who was swaying unsteadily more than ten meters away.
unit.target: Cum fulgentes albae flammae celeriter evanuerunt, Lumian tergum a “Hisoka” Twanaku vertit et oculos in Custodem, qui plus quam decem metris instabiliter labebatur, fixit.

unit.source: With a chuckle, he declared, “Before, I needed my team’s help to defeat you. But now, I can take you down alone.”
unit.target: Subrisu, dixit: “Prius auxilium turmae meae ad te superandum mihi opus erat; sed nunc, solus te superare possum.”

unit.source: His words were aimed squarely at Hisoka.
unit.target: Verba eius certe versus Hisoka erant.

unit.source: Collapsing to the ground, Hisoka’s consciousness gradually faded as he caught Lumian’s remark.
unit.target: In terram corruitens, conscientia Hisoka paulatim evanuit dum verba Luminum percipiebat.

unit.source: He instinctively tried to clench his fists, but lacked the strength to do so.
unit.target: Instinctu conatus est pugnos stringere, sed vires id faciendi non habuit.

unit.source: A desperate gasp escaped his throat, his pupils dilating and losing focus.
unit.target: Ex desperatione anhelitus ex gurgite eius evasit, cum pupillae eius dilatarentur et aspectum amitterent.

unit.source: Hisoka cursed himself for choosing Devil Transformation over Wraith Transformation when confronting Lumian Lee.
unit.target: Hisoka se execravit quod Transformationem Diaboli potius quam Transformationem Umbrae elegit, cum Lumian Lee opponebat.

unit.source: If only he had opted for the latter, he could have disrupted Lumian’s attempt to play the blackened bone flute with Wraith Shriek.
unit.target: Si modo alterum elegisset, conatus Lumiani tibiam ossis nigrae cum ululatu umbrae canere intercludere potuisset.

unit.source: Alas, he had no way of knowing the specifics, only able to sense the presence and source of a malicious intent.
unit.target: Heu, nullam viam habebat ad cognoscendum singularia; solum praesentiam ac originem intentionis malevolae sentire poterat.

unit.source: Given Lumian Lee’s ability to infuse bullets, fireballs, and other attacks with electric shocks and target weaknesses with precision, Devil Transformation had seemed the more versatile choice, offering protection against various contingencies.
unit.target: Cum Lumian Lee facultatem habuisset globulos, globos ignis, et alios impetus electricis ictibus infundere atque vulnerabilitates hostium subtile destinare, Transformationem Diaboli optio magis versatilis videbatur, variis casibus tutela praebens.

unit.source: As for why he hadn’t summoned a barrage of Sulfur Fireballs, even at the cost of mutual destruction—Hisoka sensed the considerable distance separating them.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad cur non convocaverit globos ignis sulfuris, etiam ad pretium mutuae interitus, Hisoka sensit longam distantiam inter eos esse.

unit.source: By the time he could conjure and launch ten to twenty fireballs, Lumian Lee would have already finished playing the flute.
unit.target: Cum decem ad viginti globos ignis evocare atque iaculari posset, Lumian Lee iam tibiam canendi perfecerat.

unit.source: With teleportation at his disposal, Lumian could effortlessly evade the clustered assault.
unit.target: Cum teleportatione in promptu esset, Lumian facile impetum congregatum evadere potuit.

unit.source: Moreover, spells like Language of Foulness had a limited range.
unit.target: Praeterea, incantationes, ut “Lingua Foeda”, spatium limitatum habebant.

unit.source: Left with no other recourse, “Hisoka” Twanaku could only resort to Emotional Shock and Desire Detonation, targeting Lumian Lee’s weakness.
unit.target: Nullo alio consilio relicto, “Hisoka” Twanaku solum ad Ictum Emotivum et Detonationem Desiderii confugere potuit, destinans in infirmitatem Lumian Lee.

unit.source: He hoped that after both of them sustained grievous injuries, their recovery rates would be comparable, granting him an opportunity to mount a different response.
unit.target: Sperabat ut, postquam uterque gravi vulnera passi essent, eorum recuperationis gradus comparabiles essent, concedens ei occasionem ad aliud respondendum.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: However, despite the pain, blood loss, and abnormal look in his eyes, Lumian Lee managed to maintain his balance.
unit.target: Attamen, non obstante dolore, sanguinis detrimento, et aspecto insolito in oculis, Lumian Lee stabilitatem retinere potuit.

unit.source: Fighting through the debilitating effects, he executed a precise area-of-effect bombardment enhanced with electric shocks.
unit.target: Pugnans adversis debilitantibus effectibus, exercuit bombadum areae effectus accuratum, electricis ictibus adiunctum.

unit.source: The effort inflicted fresh wounds upon himself and temporarily paralyzed him.
unit.target: Conatus novas vulnera sibi intulit et eum ad tempus paralysavit.

unit.source: “Gasp…”
unit.target: «Halitus…»

unit.source: Hisoka Twanaku mustered his remaining strength to drag Lumian Lee down with him in a final, desperate gambit of losing control.
unit.target: Hisoka Twanaku virtutem residuam colligens, Lumian Lee secum trahere conatus est in extremo desperato conatu moderationis amittendi.

unit.source: But his life force had reached its limit.
unit.target: Sed vis vitae eius finem attigit.

unit.source: Darkness engulfed his vision as his consciousness slipped into oblivion, a maelstrom of indignation, resentment, and agony consuming him.
unit.target: Tenebrae visionem eius oppresserunt, dum conscientia in oblivionem lapsa erat, turbine indignationis, rancoris et doloris eum consumente.

unit.source: The colossal Devil’s body spasmed a few times before falling still.
unit.target: Corpus ingens Daemoni nonnullis vicibus spasmatum est, deinde quietum cecidit.

unit.source: Hisoka’s last glimmer of hope for revival was extinguished.
unit.target: Ultima spes reviviscendi Hisoka exstincta est.

unit.source: He was well and truly dead.
unit.target: Plene atque vere mortuus erat.

unit.source: As Lumian spoke, he drew his revolver and trained it on the nearby Guardian.
unit.target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, revolverem suum extraxit et in Custodem proximum intentionem dedit.

unit.source: Disoriented and reeling, the Guardian instinctively condensed a broadsword of light.
unit.target: Confusus et attonitus, Custos instinctu gladium latum lucis condidit.

unit.source: Dropping to one knee, he plunged it into the ground before him.
unit.target: Ad genua cecidens, gladium in terram ante se immisit.

unit.source: The sword merged with the earth, erecting an impenetrable invisible wall.
unit.target: Gladius cum terra coniunctus, murum invisibilem et impenetrabilem erexit.

unit.source: As a gravekeeper merged with a dream projection, this Guardian had no effective defense against the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Sicut custos sepulchri cum proiectione somnii se miscuit, hic Custos nullam defensionem efficacem contra Symphoniam Odii habebat.

unit.source: His companions, the Spirit Warlocks and Soul Assurers, caught off guard by the attack, couldn’t pull him into a dream in time to avoid the melody’s direct impact.
unit.target: Socii eius, Spiritus Warlocks et Animarum Assecuratores, capti repentino impetu, eum in somnium trahere non potuerunt ut ictum directum melodiae evitare possent.

unit.source: He could only rely on his own physical and spiritual fortitude to withstand the detonation of desire and emotion.
unit.target: Ipse solum in sua vi corporali et spirituali innitebatur ut eruptionem desiderii et affectus toleraret.

unit.source: For Beyonders with dream projections, this assault posed a mortal threat.
unit.target: Pro Beyonders, quibus proiectiones somniorum praesto sunt, ista oppugnatio minationem mortiferam ferebat.

unit.source: Before the gravekeeper could regain his bearings, another incandescent white fireball wreathed in lightning struck him, triggering a violent explosion.
unit.target: Antequam custos sepulchri sensum suum recuperare potuisset, alius globus ignis albus incandescens, fulmine circumvolutus, eum percussit, violentam explosionem excitans.

unit.source: Fortunately, his boon as a Guardian spared him the fate of his companions, who were culled like stalks of wheat.
unit.target: Fortunate, beneficium eius ut Custos eum servavit a sorte sociis suis, qui quasi caules tritici interscindebantur.

unit.source: Without it, he would have been unable to mount even a token defense on pure instinct.
unit.target: Sine eo, neque defensionem minimam ex solo instinctu exhibere potuisset.

unit.source: Lumian’s green eyes took on an iron-black cast as he stood tall and squeezed the trigger.
unit.target: Oculi virides Luminum in castum ferreum nigros mutaverunt, dum stetit altus et trigerem stringens.

unit.source: Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Bang! Bang!

unit.source: Twin yellow bullets, trailing blazing white flames and silver lightning, slammed into a single point on the invisible wall.
unit.target: Geminae bullae flavae, secum gerentes fulgentes albas flammas et fulgorem argenteum, in unum punctum murum invisibilem percutiebant.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The already destabilized wall shattered.
unit.target: Murus iam destabilis confractus est.

unit.source: The Guardian could only watch helplessly as a searing white spear enveloped in lightning hurtled towards him, piercing his chest and sending him flying.
unit.target: Custos solum impotens spectare potuit, dum hasta alba, fulmine circumdata, ad eum volitabat, pectus eius pertransfixit et eum iactavit.

unit.source: Another Cull, another bout of digestion.
unit.target: Alia caedes, alia digestio.

unit.source: Clinging to the last shreds of consciousness, the Guardian scattered the broadsword of light into countless minuscule fragments.
unit.target: Ad ultima vestigia conscientiae adhaerens, Custos gladium latum lucis in innumerabilia minima fragmenta dispersit.

unit.source: These luminous shards coalesced into a hurricane that raged in all directions.
unit.target: Haec fulgida fragmenta in turbinem coalescebant, qui in omnibus directionibus saeviebat.

unit.source: Hounded by the storm of light, the blazing white flaming spear soared twenty to thirty meters before finally coming to rest.
unit.target: Persecutus a tempestate lucis, hasta alba flammea ardens viginti ad triginta metra volavit, antequam tandem quiescere coepit.

unit.source: As the flames ebbed away, Lumian straightened his posture, clad in a white shirt, black vest, dark trousers, and a golden straw hat.
unit.target: Cum flammae recederent, Lumian statum rectum sumpsit, indutus tunica alba, lorica nigra, bracas obscuras, et pileum stramentum aureum.

unit.source: Behind him, the bright and terrifying Hurricane of Light gradually petered out, thinning the ground.
unit.target: Post eum, Tempestas Lucis, clara et terribilis, paulatim peteret, terram tenuem faciens.

unit.source: The corpses of the fallen gravekeepers and “Hisoka” Twanaku lay broken and strewn about.
unit.target: Cadavera custodum sepulchri defunctorum et “Hisoka” Twanaku fracta et dispersa iacebant.

unit.source: Reeling from the Symphony of Hatred’s influence, his injuries abnormally severe, Devajo’s gaze flicked from the bodies littering the ground to Lumian, who stood facing him from afar.
unit.target: Perturbatus a Symphoniae Odii influxu et vulneribus insolitè gravibus, Devajo oculos a cadaveribus, quae terram inundabant, ad Luminum convertit, qui a longe ad eum stetit.

unit.source: His already pallid complexion turned even more ashen.
unit.target: Cutis eius, iam pallida, facta est etiam magis cinerosa.

unit.source: What in the world is happening?
unit.target: Quid in mundo accidit?

unit.source: Is he even human?
unit.target: Estne ipse etiam homo?

unit.source: Devajo, in whom thoughts of vengeance had fleetingly stirred following the blow, swiftly abandoned any such notions.
unit.target: Devajo, in quo cogitationes ultionis post ictum breviter excitatae erant, celeriter eas deseruit.

unit.source: Igniting the sulfurous blood he had spat out with azure flames, he hastily retreated into the forest.
unit.target: Ignivens sanguinem sulphureum, quem exspuisset, flammis caeruleis, celeriter in silvas recedebat.

unit.source: He wanted to escape!
unit.target: Volebat effugere!

unit.source: In any case, he could offer no aid to the human skin the archduke had crafted through ritual.
unit.target: Quocumque modo, nullam opem praebere poterat ad cutem humanam, quam archidux per ritum effecit.

unit.source: Lingering in the vicinity of the black ancient tomb would only expose him to greater peril.
unit.target: Morari in vicinitate sepulchri antiqui nigri eum tantum ad maiorem periculum incideret.

unit.source: Lumian paid no heed to Devajo’s flight.
unit.target: Lumian ad evasionem Devajo non curam dedit.

unit.source: Though weakened, his spirituality remained abundant.
unit.target: Quamquam debilitatus, spiritualitas eius adhuc abundabat.

unit.source: Transforming once more into a blazing white flaming spear, he traversed dozens, nearly a hundred meters in a blink, coming to rest beside Lugano, Amandina, and his companions.
unit.target: Iterum se in hastam ignis albi flammarum convertens, per plures, fere centum metra in momento transivit, iuxta Lugano, Amandina, et socios suos quievit.

unit.source: The four Beyonders lay unconscious, spared the Symphony of Hatred’s melody—the effects were minimal, a mere nightmare, but still wracked them with pain.
unit.target: Quattuor Beyonders in inconscientia iacebant, servati a melodia Symphoniae Odii—effectus minimi erant, quasi simplex somnium malum, sed tamen dolore eos vexabant.

unit.source: Their contorted expressions gradually eased as they roused from their comatose state.
unit.target: Eorum vultus contorti paulatim amollirunt, dum ex statu comatoso evigilabantur.

unit.source: Seeing them open their eyes and regain their faculties, Lumian instructed, “Leave this place at once and return to Tizamo. Find somewhere to lay low.”
unit.target: Videns eos oculos aperire et facultates suas recipere, Lumian praecepit: “Relinquite hoc locum statim et revertimini ad Tizamo. Invenite alicubi locum ubi te tegamini.”

unit.source: The conflict unfolding before the black ancient tomb was not something Lugano and the others could influence.
unit.target: Conflictus, qui coram sepulchro antiquo nigro evolvebat, non erat res quam Lugano et ceteri influere poterant.

unit.source: Lumian himself dared not approach, so he intended to send his four temporary allies to safety.
unit.target: Lumian ipse non ausus est appropinquare, itaque consilium cepit quatuor socios temporaneos in securitatem mittere.

unit.source: He had previously consented to Camus and Rhea accompanying him, believing the former’s Psychic Piercing and the latter’s Lightning Arrows could synergize effectively with his own abilities to counter Hisoka’s dream projection, Reaza, and the others.
unit.target: Prius consentiverat ut Camus et Rhea eum comitari, credens “Psychic Piercing” Cami et “Lightning Arrows” Rheae efficaciter cum suis facultatibus convenire posse ad repugnandum proiectionem somnii Hisokae, Reazae, et aliorum.

unit.source: Amandina’s power to compel others into dreams was also quite useful.
unit.target: Potestas Amandinae ut alios in somnia compelleret, etiam valde utilis erat.

unit.source: Moreover, following her was the only way to approach the black ancient tomb without falling prey to the invisible figure’s attacks.
unit.target: Praeterea, eam sequeri sola via erat ad sepulchrum antiqua nigrum accedendum, ne adversus impetus figurae invisibilis incideret.

unit.source: To his surprise, Hisoka had displayed combat prowess far exceeding Padre Cali’s.
unit.target: Ad mirum, Hisoka virtutem pugnandi ostendit, longe superiorem quam illam Padre Cali.

unit.source: With the area unsealed and devoid of preset traps, not only had Camus, Amandina, and the rest failed to render aid, they had ended up hindering each other and becoming a liability.
unit.target: Cum area aperta esset et carens insidiis praeordinatis, Camus, Amandina, et ceteri non solum auxilium praebere non potuerunt, sed etiam invicem se impedientes evaserunt et onus facti sunt.

unit.source: Reflecting on his two prior battles—the attempt to capture Hisoka alive and the confrontation with Padre Cali—Lumian grasped a fundamental principle.
unit.target: Meditatus de duobus prioribus proeliis—conatu Hisoka vivum capiendi et congressu cum Padre Cali—Lumian principium fundamentale intellexit.

unit.source: At times, there was strength in numbers.
unit.target: Interdum in multitudine robur est.

unit.source: But in other situations, solitude was preferable.
unit.target: Sed in aliis condicionibus solitudo praeferenda erat.

unit.source: Facing different foes under varied circumstances demanded adaptability, lest one court disaster by adhering to a fixed approach.
unit.target: Adversus diversos hostes sub variis condicionibus aggredi necessitabat flexibilitatem, ne quis rigidam viam sequendo in calamitatem incidat.

unit.source: Lumian recalled a maxim Emperor Roselle had once shared, as explained by his sister Aurore:
unit.target: Lumian meminit maximam quam Imperator Roselle olim communicaverat, ut a sorore eius Aurore explanatum est:

unit.source: In warfare, as in the flow of water, there are no constant conditions.
unit.target: In bello, sicut in flumine aquae, constantes condiciones non sunt.

unit.source: “We can return to Tizamo? Even me?”
unit.target: “Possumusne ad Tizamo redire? Etiam me?”

unit.source: Lugano couldn’t contain his pleasant surprise.
unit.target: Lugano suam laetam admirationem continere non potuit.

unit.source: Instinctively, he extended his remaining hand, pressing the flickering light against Lumian’s wounds.
unit.target: Instinctu, reliquam manum protendit, lucem micantem super vulnera Luminum pressens.

unit.source: As a Doctor, Lugano was unable to treat a patient’s internal organs directly.
unit.target: Ut medicus, Lugano non poterat directa curare viscera interna aegroti.

unit.source: He needed to open the cavity and make contact with the injured site.
unit.target: Debebat cavitatem aperire et locum vulneratum attingere.

unit.source: It was akin to performing surgery.
unit.target: Hoc erat quasi chirurgiam exercendi simile.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Indeed, but you’ll need to remain under Camus and Rhea’s supervision.”
unit.target: Lumian annuens respondit: “Certe, sed necesse erit ut sub custodia Camus et Rhea permaneas.”

unit.source: He planned to linger a while longer, to see if he could aid Iveljsta Eggers, a member of the Church of The Fool’s temperance faction.
unit.target: Consilium cepit paulisper morari, ut videret an auxiliari posset Iveljsta Eggers, membrum Ecclesiae Folli Temperantiae.

unit.source: It was the duty of a Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana card holder.
unit.target: Hoc officium fuit possidenti cartae Minor Arcana in Tarot Club.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian had no intention of venturing into the area immediately fronting the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian nullam intensionem habebat in aream statim ante sepulchrum antiqua nigrum ingredi.

unit.source: He might well perish before even realizing what had struck him.
unit.target: Forsitan periret antequam etiam intellexerit quid eum percussisset.

unit.source: His aim was to ascertain whether he could sway Reaza and the others to interact with the corresponding godhood items, or utilize the golden mask upon Hisoka’s corpse to some end.
unit.target: Scopus eius erat investigare num Reaza et ceteros ad res deitatis pertinentes agere moverentur, aut larvam auream super cadaver Hisoka ad aliquod finem uti posset.

unit.source: At that moment, Devajo, who had only just arrived in Tizamo that very night, had already vanished back into the forest, retracing his steps.
unit.target: Illo momento, Devajo, qui modo illa nocte in Tizamo advenisset, iam in silvas recedebat, vestigia sua retrahens.

unit.source: Mustering his dwindling strength, he started sprinting.
unit.target: Virtutem decrescens colligens, celeriter currere coepit.

unit.source: As he ran, Devajo abruptly halted, casting a perplexed gaze towards the path’s bend, obscured by the trees.
unit.target: Dum currebat, Devajo subito sistit et vultum perplexum versus flexum itineris, arboribus tegitum intuebatur.

unit.source: Beneath the dim, crimson moonlight, a short figure approached.
unit.target: Sub obscura et rubra luce lunari, figura brevis accedebat.

unit.source: It was a boy of seven or eight years, garbed in blue pajamas speckled with yellow stars and a matching nightcap.
unit.target: Puer erat annorum septem vel octo, indutus in pyjamas caeruleos, ornatos stellis flavescentibus, et pileum nocturnum assortum.

unit.source: His plump face and the short blond hair peeking out from under the cap were smeared with cream, blood, biscuit crumbs, cake fragments, and sundry other substances.
unit.target: Facies eius rotunda et capilli flavi breves, sub pileo eminentes, erant maculati creta, sanguine, fragmentis crustularum, particulis placentorum, et aliis variis substantiis.

unit.source: His brown eyes blazed with intense hunger and desire.
unit.target: Oculi eius fusci, eximia fame et desiderio ardescens, fulgebant.

unit.source: In his mouth, a vibrant, cold, and slick viper’s tail writhed and shook as he gulped it down, segment by segment.
unit.target: In ore eius, cauda viperae vibrans, frigida et lubricata, se contorquens et tremens, eam guttatim devorabat.

unit.source: The boy’s cheeks bulged as he chomped vigorously.
unit.target: Buccae pueri tumefactae erant, dum vehementer mandebat.

unit.source: In the next instant, he caught sight of Devajo.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, eum Devajo animadvertit.

unit.source: A wave of intense, terrifying malice flooded Devajo’s mind.
unit.target: Unda intensae et terribilis malitiae mentem Devajo replevit.

unit.source: Lugano, having secured permission, was on the verge of informing Camus, Rhea, and Amandina of their impending return to Tizamo when a petrified scream rang out from the forest.
unit.target: Lugano, licentiam obtinens, paene Camus, Rheam, et Amandinam de imminentis reditus ad Tizamo certiorem faceret, cum ex silva strepitus petrificus sonavit.

unit.source: They froze in their tracks.
unit.target: Steterunt immobiles.

unit.source: Mere seconds later, a pitch‑black monstrosity, towering nearly three meters tall with curved goat horns, came barreling out of the forest.
unit.target: Mere paucis secundis post, monstrum piceum ingens, paene tribus metris altum, cum cornibus caprinis curvis, ex silva egressum est.

unit.source: It charged from the direction of Tizamo, making a beeline for the black ancient tomb, panic etched in its every movement.
unit.target: Ex parte Tizamo impetum fecit, viam directam ad sepulchrum antiqua nigrum petens, panico in omni motu insculpta.

unit.source: That man just now? He’s a Devil too… A minion of the Nois family’s Demon, perhaps?
unit.target: Iste vir nunc? Etiam ille Diabolus est… Fortasse minister Daemoni familiae Nois?

unit.source: Could the green‑eyed figure fashioned from human skin be a manifestation of the Nois family’s Demon, projected into the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Num figura viridocula, ex cute humana facta, manifestationem Daemoni familiae Nois esse posset, in Festival Somniorum proiecta?

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze shifted to the shadowed forest at the Devil’s back, an ominous feeling washing over him.
unit.target: Lumian oculos convertit ad silvam umbratam post Diabolum, ubi ominosa sensatio eum invasit.

unit.source: He made a snap decision and addressed Lugano, Amandina, and the others.
unit.target: Subito decrevit et Lugano, Amandina, et reliquis allocutus est.

unit.source: “Grab hold of me!”
unit.target: “Prehendite me!”

unit.source: Lugano swiftly returned to Lumian’s side, seizing his arm.
unit.target: Lugano celeriter ad Luminum rediit, brachium eius arripiens.

unit.source: Camus, Rhea, and Amandina followed suit, startled but mimicking Lugano’s action.
unit.target: Camus, Rhea, et Amandina se contulerunt, perterriti sed actum Lugani imitantes.

unit.source: The five of them winked out of existence, reappearing in close proximity to Hisoka’s corpse.
unit.target: Quinque eorum exsistentia evanuerunt, et mox prope Hisokae cadaver iterum apparuerunt.

unit.source: The instant Amandina’s form finished coalescing, her eyes flew wide.
unit.target: In instante quo forma Amandinae coalescere perfecit, oculi eius late patefacti sunt.

unit.source: Voice quavering, she turned to Lumian and said in a deep voice, “T‑that figure… it’s appeared once more…”
unit.target: Voce quassante, se convertit ad Luminum et voce profunda dixit: “I‑Illa figura… iterum apparuit…”

unit.source: 692 Death before Rebirth
unit.target: 692 Mors ante Renascentiam

unit.source: Appeared once more?
unit.target: Iterum apparuit?

unit.source: Lumian motioned for Lugano and the others to loosen their hold and inquired of Amandina, “Where is he?”
unit.target: Lumian signa dedit Lugano aliisque ut tenentia solverent et Amandina interrogavit: “Ubi est ille?”

unit.source: Amandina’s sky-blue eyes locked onto the entrance of the black ancient tomb situated at the terminus of the motionless river.
unit.target: Amandinae oculi caerulei in limen sepulcri antiquati atri, quod in extremo fluminis immoti situm erat, fixi sunt.

unit.source: He’s sitting cross-legged over there.
unit.target: Ille ibi sedet, crura inter se complexa.

unit.source: As the words left her lips, Amandina shut her eyes and turned away.
unit.target: Dum verba ex labris eius effluabant, Amandina oculos clausit et se avertit.

unit.source: Minuscule protrusions emerged from her previously flawless and supple skin, each on the cusp of rupturing and giving rise to something unknown.
unit.target: Ex cute eius, quondam immaculata et mollis, minuta protuberantia emerserunt, quarum unaquaeque prope rupturam esset et aliquid ignotum gignere pararet.

unit.source: This reaction stemmed from her glimpse of the phantasmal, stagnant river and the ashen-white goat adorned with a golden mask, grappling to traverse the shallow waters.
unit.target: Haec reactio ortum habuit ex eius aspectu fluminis phantasmatici stagnantis et caprae cineris pallidae, aurea masca ornatae, quae tentabat per undas tenues transire.

unit.source: The pallid goat’s limbs, devoid of all fur, were extensively decomposed, exuding a nauseating yellow pus that swiftly encroached upon the remainder of its body.
unit.target: Membra caprae pallidae, omnibus pilis carentia, late corrupta erant, et nauseabunde flavo pus celeriter reliquam partem corporis eius infestabat.

unit.source: Under the sway of the Symphony of Hatred, Reaza’s wan and frigid countenance surrendered its final vestige of color.
unit.target: Sub imperio Symphoniae Odii, vultus Reaza languidus et frigidus ultimum vestigium coloris tradidit.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: The decay gradually consumed the back of his hand, neck, and cheeks, lending him the appearance of a long-deceased cadaver.
unit.target: Corruptio paulatim consumpsit dorsum manuum, collum, et genae eius, efficiens ut speciem cadaveri longo mortuo imitarit.

unit.source: This decelerated the deterioration afflicting the pale goat’s body.
unit.target: Hoc retardavit progressionem putredinis in corpore caprae pallidae.

unit.source: Concurrently, the still river conjured by the black ancient tomb grew ever more illusory, its breadth and depth visibly diminishing.
unit.target: Simul, flumen immotum, per sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum evocatum, magis magisque in illusoriam formam veniebat, eius latitudo et profunditas manifeste minuuntur.

unit.source: The rag doll, shrouded in a sinister Gothic gown, drifted onward once more, shadowing the retreating river of quietude.
unit.target: Pupa pannosa, in vestitu Gothicum sinistro induta, iterum perrexit, flumen silentii recedentem sequens.

unit.source: Abruptly, it pivoted to regard the green-eyed man composed of human flesh and blood, who, coincidentally, reciprocated its gaze.
unit.target: Subito, illa versum fecit ut virum, qui oculis viridibus instructus erat et ex carne et sanguine humano constitutus, inspiceret, qui fortuito eius aspectum rediit.

unit.source: Loathing, enmity, and lunacy erupted from the sinister cloth doll’s crimson eyes.
unit.target: Odium, inimicitia, atque insanitas ex oculis rubrīs pupae sinistrae erupit.

unit.source: Its black Gothic attire, ensnared by baleful vines, ruptured into myriad holes, scattering fabric shreds and leaving it in tatters.
unit.target: Vestimenta Gothicum nigra, a vitibus maleficis capta, in innumerabilia foramina divisa sunt, panni particulas spargens et rem in laniis relinquens.

unit.source: The green-eyed man in the dark gray suit seemed unscathed, yet as he advanced, he imprinted two footsteps saturated with vivid red blood, the aroma of sulfur swiftly dissipating.
unit.target: Vir viridoculatus in habitu obscuro cinereo intemeratus videbatur, sed dum procedebat, duo vestigia graduum, vividis rubro sanguine saturata, imprimivit, et odor sulphuris celeriter evanuit.

unit.source: One stride, two strides, three strides. Each step emblazoned bright red footprints, while dark fluid seeped from his human skin.
unit.target: Unum gressum, duo gressus, tres gressus. Quisque passus vestigia rubra nitida signabat, simulque obscurum liquidum ex cute humana eius effluens apparuit.

unit.source: Iveljsta Eggers at last recovered from the onslaught of emotions and cravings unleashed by the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Iveljsta Eggers tandem se recuperavit ex impetu passionum et desideriorum, quae per Symphoniam Odii revoluta erant.

unit.source: He cast a glance at the tattered evil cloth doll and retrieved an object from his concealed pocket–a palm-sized puppet.
unit.target: Aspectum iecit in laniatam pupam maleficam pannosam et ex sinu suo occulto rem extraxit—pupulum magnitudine palmae.

unit.source: The puppet appeared to have been stitched together by a young child’s hand. Its limbs were askew, its legs reaching its posterior, and its visage daubed with red, yellow, and white pigments, evoking the image of a circus clown.
unit.target: Pupulum videbatur manu pueri parvuli consitum esse. Membra eius inordinata erant, crura ad natim suum pertingebant, et vultus rubro, flavo, atque albo tinctus erat, efficiens imaginem scurrilis circensis.

unit.source: Iveljsta infused the misshapen puppet with his spirituality.
unit.target: Iveljsta spiritum suum infudit in pupulum deformem.

unit.source: It shimmered into intangibility and vanished from his grasp, materializing within the dark brown eyes of the Eggers family scion before vaulting into the green orbs of the man clad in human skin.
unit.target: Illud in inmaterialitatem micavit et ex manibus eius evanuit, manifestatum in oculis fusco-brunneis nepotis familiae Eggers, antequam in orbibus viridibus viri, ex carne constituti, delapsum est.

unit.source: This caused the figure in the dark gray suit to stiffen and decelerate.
unit.target: Hoc fecit ut figura in habitu obscuro cinereo rigidaretur et tardaretur.

unit.source: Lumian dared not prolong his gaze and hastily averted his eyes.
unit.target: Lumian non ausus est aspectum suum procrastinare et celeriter oculos avertit.

unit.source: As Amandina closed her eyes and turned away, the minute protuberances adorning her skin receded.
unit.target: Cum Amandina oculos clausit et se avertit, minuta protuberantia cutem eius ornantia recederunt.

unit.source: Intrigued, she stole a glance at the monstrosity, suspected to be a Devil, hurtling towards the green-eyed man, seemingly on the precipice of succumbing to terror.
unit.target: Intrigata, furtim oculus ad monstrum, suspicatum Diaboli esse, qui ad virum viridoculatum properabat, iecit.

unit.source: She swiftly surveyed her environment.
unit.target: Celeriter ambitum suum perspiciens.

unit.source: Her eyes then fell upon the colossal Devil’s incomplete carcass sprawled on the ground and a charred bone flute that had tumbled beneath a palm tree.
unit.target: Oculi eius deinde incidērunt in cadaver incompletum ingentis Diaboli, quod in terra iacebat, atque in flautam ossium combustam, quae sub palma cecidisset.

unit.source: “There, there’s something over there,” she whispered, tugging at Lumian’s sleeve.
unit.target: “Ecce, ecce aliquid illic,” susurravit, trahens manicam Lumiani.

unit.source: Could it be a potent artifact discarded by a gravekeeper?
unit.target: An nonne sit potentissimum artificium, ab sepulturario deiectum?

unit.source: Lumian peered over and murmured to Amandina and the others, “Feign ignorance. Refrain from touching or even nearing it.”
unit.target: Lumian aspiciebat super et murmuravit ad Amandina aliisque: “Simula ignorantiam. Nolite tangere aut appropinquare.”

unit.source: He had purposely abandoned the Symphony of Hatred there, deferring its retrieval.
unit.target: Ille Symphoniam Odii ibi proposito relicerat, recuperationem eius differens.

unit.source: In such circumstances, wielding it anew was far more prone to endangering his allies than exploiting an adversary’s vulnerability. As a Reaper, he had no need to employ the Symphony of Hatred to pierce the target.
unit.target: His condicionibus, eam iterum adhibere multo verius socios suos in discrimen adduceret quam hostis infirmitatem exploiteret; ut Messor, non opus habebat Symphoniam Odii ad hostem perforandum.

unit.source: Thus, he feigned a lack of opportunity to reclaim it, hoping an enemy would attempt to turn it against him.
unit.target: Ita simulavit carentiam opportunitatis id recuperandi, sperans hostem eam in se convertere conari.

unit.source: If a similar scenario unfolded, Lumian and the three godhood items would be the sole survivors capable of weathering the ensuing cataclysm unleashed by the Symphony of Hatred. At that juncture, he would whisk Amandina and her companions away via teleportation. Upon later return, he anticipated discovering the enemies’ lifeless husks and acquiring fresh spoils of war.
unit.target: Si similis casus eveniret, Lumian et tres res divinitatis soli superstes essent, capaces tolerare cataclysmum subsequens, quem Symphoniam Odii emitteret. Illo tempore Amandina atque comites eius per teleportationem abrepto abduceret; et postea hostium cadavera sine vita et nova praeda belli adipisci sperabat.

unit.source: It was a trap he had laid in passing.
unit.target: Erat insidiarum consilium, quod per transitum posuerat.

unit.source: As Devajo, transformed into a colossal Devil, retreated to the proximity of the human-skinned man and drew near the ebbing river of silence, a short silhouette walked out from the forest trail–a boy of seven or eight years old, clad in endearing sleepwear and a nightcap. His yellow hair and countenance were begrimed, besmirched with grease, dregs, and blood.
unit.target: Cum Devajo, in ingentem Diabolum conversus, ad proximam partem viri ex carne constituti recederet et ad flumen silentii decrescentem appropinquaret, ex semita silvestri brevis figura egreditur – puer annorum septem aut octo, in amoenis vestimentis somni ornatus et pileo nocturno indutus. Capilli eius flavi et vultus sordidi, uncto, limo atque sanguine tincti erant.

unit.source: Catching sight of the boy, Lugano experienced a piercing agony in his absent right hand.
unit.target: Puerum videns, Lugano acutum dolorem in deesse manu dextro sensit.

unit.source: “Man… Man… Man….” He gnashed his teeth in dread.
unit.target: “Homō… Homō… Homō…” dentes in metu contraxit.

unit.source: Observing his abnormal reaction, Camus and the others inquired in astonishment, “What’s wrong?”
unit.target: Observantibus reactionem eius insolitam, Camus aliisque mirati interrogaverunt: “Quid accidit?”

unit.source: Tracing Lugano’s line of sight, Amandina, Camus, and Rhea spotted the boy.
unit.target: Sequentes aspectum Luganoi, Amandina, Camus, et Rhea puerum animadvertērunt.

unit.source: The former swiveled to Lumian in bewilderment, “Isn’t, isn’t that your godson? Why is he here? It’s very dangerous!”
unit.target: Prima autem se ad Lumian vertit, attonita, “Nonne ille est filius spiritualis tui? Cur hic adest? Maxime periculosum est!”

unit.source: “No, he’s not in danger.” Camus recollected Kolobo’s exaggerated reaction upon encountering Louis Berry and his godson. He recalled some of the words of his companion from the Fate pathway and said with a solemn expression, “We should be the ones in danger.”
unit.target: “Non, non est in periculo.” Camus, meminens reactionem exagitaram Kolobo, cum Ludovico Berry atque filio spirituali eius occurrerent, verba aliqua socii sui ex via Fati recolens, graviter dixit: “Nos ipsi in periculo esse debemus.”

unit.source: Without waiting for Amandina and Rhea’s misgivings, Camus regarded Lumian and knitted his brow.
unit.target: Non exspectans dubitationes Amandinae et Rhea, Camus ad Lumian aspiciens, supercilium congregavit.

unit.source: “What do we do?”
unit.target: “Quid facimus?”

unit.source: As a godfather, you should have a way to control your godson, right?
unit.target: Ut padrinus, debet esse modus quo filium padrini tuum regas, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze flitted to Ludwig pursuing the Devil, then to the corpses and Hisoka’s Devil form strewn on the ground. He replied with a grin, “It’s not a big problem.”
unit.target: Lumian oculos convertit ad Ludovicum, qui Diabolum insequebatur, deinde ad cadavera atque formam Diaboli Hisoka in terra dispersam; respondens cum risu, “Non est res magna.”

unit.source: There was ample food here to form an effective seal!
unit.target: Cibus hic satis abundabat ad sigillum efficax formandum!

unit.source: As to why Ludwig had trekked to the black ancient tomb, Lumian roughly had an idea.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad cur Ludwig ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum perveniret, Lumian aliquam ideam haberet.

unit.source: The man and woman who had freshly arrived in Tizamo tonight and taken lodging at the Brieu Motel were likely minions of the Nois family’s Demon. By some means, they maintained lucidity in this special dream. Once the Dream Festival commenced, they left the motel and hastened towards the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Vir et femina, qui hac nocte nuper in Tizamo advenerant et in Brieu Motel hospitium ceperant, probabiliter ministri Daemoni familiae Nois erant. Aliqua ratione in hoc somnio speciali lucidi manebant. Postquam Festum Somniorum inceperunt, motel reliquerunt et festinanter ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pervenerunt.

unit.source: During this process, they passed the second floor, inducing Ludwig to catch wind of delicacies. He forsook the insipid fare and shadowed them closely, matching the pace of a seven- or eight-year-old child.
unit.target: Durante hoc processu, secum per tabulatum secundum transierunt, inducens Ludwig ut de deliciis suspiceret; cibum insipidum deseruit et eos arcte secutus est, aequales gressus pueri septem aut octo annorum habens.

unit.source: At that moment, Ludwig’s brown eyes were fixed solely on Devajo, the Devil.
unit.target: Illo momento, Ludovici oculi castanei solummodo in Devajo, Diabolo, intenti erant.

unit.source: “Why isn’t it a big problem?” Amandina wore a look of skepticism.
unit.target: “Cur non est res magna?” Amandina vultum dubitationis gerebat.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and indicated the massive Devil who had fled in proximity to the green-eyed man.
unit.target: Lumian subridet et monstrum ingentem Diaboli, quod prope virum viridoculatum fugit, significavit.

unit.source: “He’s here to hunt down that monster.”
unit.target: “Ille hic est ut illum monstrum venaretur.”

unit.source: “Hunt? Him?” Amandina glanced left and right in confusion.
unit.target: “Venari? Eum?” Amandina, sinistra ac dextra intuens, perplexa est.

unit.source: A seven- or eight-year-old boy in azure star-spangled sleepwear, pursuing a pitch-black Devil almost three meters in height, with curved goat horns and bat wings sprouting from his back? This is indeed a dream, right?
unit.target: Puer septem aut octo annorum in indumento somni caeruleo, stellis ornato, qui Diabolum atrum paene trium metrorum altitudinis, cum cornibus caprinae incurvis et alis vespertilionis e dorso emergentibus, insequitur? Hic certe somnium est, nonne?

unit.source: As he neared the green-eyed man formed of human flesh and blood and the black ancient tomb, Devajo sensed a tinge of respite. Yet, his mind remained haunted by visions of his tongue roasting, his brain scooped out by a soup spoon, and his arms and legs gnawed by the boy.
unit.target: Dum ad virum viridoculatum, ex carne et sanguine humano formatum, et ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum accedebat, Devajo paululum quietis sensum adeptus est. Attamen, mens eius manebat vexata visionibus linguae eius ardescens, cerebri eius cochleari suppae excavati, atque brachiorum et crurum eius a puero masticatorum.

unit.source: What kind of monster is this? Devajo watched in abnormal fear as the boy strode towards him.
unit.target: Qualis monstrum hoc est? Devajo, in metu insolito, puerum ad se pergentem observabat.

unit.source: At that juncture, Amandina, who had stolen a glance their way, exclaimed, “That figure is looking at the man in the black robe.”
unit.target: In illo momento, Amandina, quae furtim oculos in eorum partem iecisset, exclamavit: “Illa figura ad virum in veste nigra spectat.”

unit.source: Iveljsta? Lumian peered over but discerned nothing amiss with Iveljsta Eggers.
unit.target: Iveljsta? Lumian intueri conatus est, sed nihil in Iveljsta Eggers incommode observavit.

unit.source: Amandina averted her gaze, taking a moment to regain her composure before looking again.
unit.target: Amandina oculos avertit, aliquantum temporis recipiens ut se redintegraret, deinde iterum spectare incipiebat.

unit.source: She quickly explained, “He’s not looking at the man in the black robe. He’s looking at the Devil!”
unit.target: Celeriter enarravit: “Ille non aspicit virum in veste nigra; Diabolo aspicit!”

unit.source: Amandina abruptly halted, withdrawing her gaze and furrowing her brow.
unit.target: Amandina subito cessavit, oculos revocans et supercilium congregans.

unit.source: “That figure seems to utter something… I don’t know the language, but I understand the meaning.”
unit.target: “Illa figura aliquid verbi efferre videtur… linguam nescio, sed sensum intellego.”

unit.source: “What did he say?” Lumian pressed.
unit.target: “Quid dixit?” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Amandina dared not look towards the black tomb. She organized her thoughts and said,
unit.target: Amandina non ausa est ad sepulcrum nigrum spectare. Cogitationes suas ordinavit et dixit:

unit.source: **“Basically, it means:
unit.target: “Praecipue, hoc significat:

unit.source: “Everyone in the world knows that crawling insects can spin cocoons. After the cocoon fractures, butterflies take wing.
unit.target: ‘Omnes in orbe terrarum sciunt insecta reptantia capsulas sericas texere posse. Postquam capsula dirimitur, papiliones evadunt.

unit.source: A common insect can transform into a fluttering butterfly and alter its form of life. Why?””**
unit.target: Insectum commune in papilionem volitantem se transformare potest atque formam vitae mutare. Cur?’”

unit.source: Unknowingly, Amandina’s voice shifted, as if swayed by some influence.
unit.target: Nesciente, vox Amandinae mutata est, quasi aliquo impetu commota.

unit.source: She paused for a moment before answering the question in a low, cold voice, “Death before rebirth. Ascension into godhood…”
unit.target: Aliquamdiu sistit, deinde quaestioni, voce humilis et frigida, respondit: “Mors ante renascentiam. Ascensus in deitatem…”

unit.source: Before Amandina could finish her sentence, Devajo, in his Devil state, stiffened.
unit.target: Antequam Amandina sententiam finire potuit, Devajo, in statu Diaboli, rigidatus est.

unit.source: He beheld his flesh swiftly decaying, fragments sloughing off to bare ghastly white bones.
unit.target: Vidit carnem suam celeriter putrescere, et fragmenta abscindebantur, revelantes ossa albissima et formidanda.

unit.source: Within seconds, the Devil lost consciousness and crumbled into a mound of putrefying flesh and bones.
unit.target: In paucis secundis, Diabolus sensum amisit atque in aggerem carnis putrescentis et ossium dissolutorum cecidit.

unit.source: The remains fused as if alive, intertwining to form a human‑sized cocoon.
unit.target: Reliquiae coalescebant, quasi vivae, implicantes se ad formandum capsulam hominis aequipollentem.

unit.source: It rapidly shattered, and a human-headed avian monster draped in white plumage emerged.
unit.target: Celeriter confracta est, et monstrum avium capite humano ornamentatum, alis albis indutum, emersit.

unit.source: After absorbing all the flesh and blood, the monster expanded significantly, its form undergoing a transformation.
unit.target: Postquam omnem carnem et sanguinem confudit, monstrum signanter expansum est, eius formaque mutationem passa est.

unit.source: The lower portion of its head rapidly elongated and expanded, as if possessing a body of its own. The flesh at its “waist” melded with the avian body, mantled in pale‑yellow feathers.
unit.target: Pars inferior capitis eius celeriter elongata est et expandit, quasi corpus proprium haberet. Carnis in zona lumborum eius cum corpore avium coalescebant, operta plumis pallido‑flavis.

unit.source: “Hahaha!” Devajo, with innumerable white feathers sprouting from his eyes, nostrils, visage, and fingertips, erupted into laughter.
unit.target: “Hahaha!” Devajo, cum innumerabilibus albis plumis ex oculis, naribus, vultu, et digitorum apicis emergentibus, in risum conflavit.

unit.source: He slapped the white‑feathered bird body below and soared skyward, as if riding it.
unit.target: Ipse corpus avis, plumis albis opertum, percussit et in caelum ascendit, quasi illud equitaret.

unit.source: Devajo ascended higher and higher, gradually turning ethereal. Then he spiraled downward and entered the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Devajo altiora ascendit et paulatim in aethera se vertens; deinde, in gyrum decedens, intravit sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Lumian glanced once more at the entrance of the black ancient tomb but still could not perceive the unseen figure Amandina had mentioned.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian iterum ad introitum sepulcri antiquati nigri aspiciebat, sed figuram invisam, quam Amandina commemoraverat, non possit percipi.

unit.source: His heart stirred as he took two steps forward and retrieved the peculiar golden mask from Hisoka’s corpse.
unit.target: Cor eius commotus, cum duo gressus progredieretur, larvam auream insolitam ex cadavro Hisoka extraxit.

unit.source: 693 Golden Corpse
unit.target: 693 Aureum Cadaver

unit.source: Lumian looked at the gold mask in his hand, white and black paint covering the eyes and face.
unit.target: Lumian aspexit larvam auream in manu sua, quae oculos et faciem albo atque nigro pigmento tegebat.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he put it on.
unit.target: Sine mora, eam induit.

unit.source: A cold sensation quickly seeped into his skin, and the weight of the gold felt unusually real.
unit.target: Sensatio frigida celeriter in cutem eius diffusa est, et pondus auri inusitate reale videbatur.

unit.source: His mind spun as he gazed through the mask at the entrance of the black ancient tomb and the end of the still river, which had mostly receded.
unit.target: Mens eius vertiebatur dum per larvam ad introitum sepulcri antiqui nigri atque ad finem fluminis quieti, qui paene recederat, intuebatur.

unit.source: This time, he finally saw a slightly indistinct figure.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, tandem vidit figuram paulum indistinctam.

unit.source: The figure wore a strange rusted iron crown and a dark robe with peculiar patterns.
unit.target: Figura gerebat coronam ferri rubiginosi insoliti et pallium atrum cum figuris peculiariis.

unit.source: Its skin was milky-white, and its eyes were so dark they seemed to hold the entire night.
unit.target: Cutis eius erat lactea, et oculi tam obscuri ut totam noctem continerent.

unit.source: A pale-white beard fluttered around its mouth and chin.
unit.target: Barba alba pallida circa os et mentum oscillabat.

unit.source: The old man sat cross-legged, hands tucked into his sleeves.
unit.target: Senex in cruribus sessus erat, manus in manicae inclusae.

unit.source: He leaned against the open door of the black ancient tomb, his expression cold and impassive, like a statue.
unit.target: Se inclinavit ad ianuam apertam sepulcri antiqui nigri, vultu frigido et imperturbabili, instar statuae.

unit.source: As Lumian looked over, the old man met his gaze.
unit.target: Dum Lumian aspexit, senex oculos eius obviam tenuit.

unit.source: His dark eyes seemed to reflect Lumian, as if numerous phantoms had appeared.
unit.target: Oculi obscuri eius videbantur Lumianum reflectere, tamquam multa phantasmata apparuisset.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Splash!
unit.target: Splash!

unit.source: Behind the old man, an even more illusory, nearly lightless water wave rippled in the void.
unit.target: Post senex, fluctus aquae adhuc magis illusorius, paene lucis carens, in vacuo ondulavit.

unit.source: The colossal figure in blood-stained armor roared angrily, attempting to approach.
unit.target: Figura colossalis in armatura sanguine maculata irate fremuit, appropinquare conans.

unit.source: Lumian’s right palm instantly burned.
unit.target: Palma dextra Lumiani statim arsit.

unit.source: The old man in the rusted iron crown and strange robe withdrew his hands from his sleeves.
unit.target: Senex, in corona ferri rubiginosi et pallio insolito indutus, manus ex manica retraxit.

unit.source: His hands had pale, dark skin that was still smooth.
unit.target: Manus eius habebant cutem pallidam atque obscuram, sed lenem.

unit.source: The backs were cracked, each crack either covered in white feathers stained with pale yellow oil or dripping with decaying yellow pus.
unit.target: Dorsae erant fissae; singula fissura vel operta erat alis albis, pallide oleo luteo tinctis, vel stillabat pus flavo putrescente.

unit.source: Upon seeing this, Lumian’s thoughts vanished, and he felt as if he were descending into endless cold darkness.
unit.target: Videns haec, cogitationes Lumiani evanuerunt, atque sensit se in infinitas frigidas tenebras descendere.

unit.source: A familiar burning sensation emanated from his left chest.
unit.target: Sensatio ardens nota emanabat ex pecto sinistro eius.

unit.source: Combined with the burning, frenzied, violent sensation in his right palm, it awakened Lumian’s consciousness, allowing him to find a lifeline in the darkness.
unit.target: Cum sensu ardente, furioso, et violento in palma dextro coniuncto, conscientiam Lumiani excitavit, permittens ei viam salutis in tenebris invenire.

unit.source: Using this opportunity, Lumian regained the ability to think.
unit.target: Hac occasione utens, Lumian facultatem cogitandi recuperavit.

unit.source: He saw nearly black blood vessels protruding from the dark eyes that seemed to hide the entire night.
unit.target: Vidit vasa sanguinea paene nigra ex oculis obscuris eminentia, quae totam noctem celare videbantur.

unit.source: They were tainted with madness that threatened to bury and end everything.
unit.target: Ea vasa insanitate tincta erant, quae minabantur omnia sepelire et finem imponere.

unit.source: The eyes closed, and the illusory ripples and colossal figure behind the old man vanished.
unit.target: Oculi claudebantur, et undae illusoriae atque figura colossalis post senex evanuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s vision began to clear, and his perception of the outside world fully returned.
unit.target: Visio Lumiani coepit clarificari, et perceptio eius de mundo exterio plene rediit.

unit.source: A sharp pain coursed through him.
unit.target: Dolor acutus eum pervasit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced down at his right hand and realized disgusting bumps bulged from his wrist to the back of his hand.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum intuebatur et animadvertit ab carpo usque ad dorsum eius tumores horrendos eminere.

unit.source: His hair seemed to have thickened and turned whiter.
unit.target: Capilli eius densiores et albi facti videbantur.

unit.source: He flipped his palm over and saw that the mark left by Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s remnant aura had completely surfaced.
unit.target: Palmam suam vertit et vidit signum, quod aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor relicta erat, omnino emersum esse.

unit.source: It was a vivid red.
unit.target: Erat ruber vividus.

unit.source: Surrounding these marks was decaying flesh, seeping pus, and pale-white skin.
unit.target: Circa haec signa erant caro putrescens, pus exsudans, et cutis pallide alba.

unit.source: Lumian frowned.
unit.target: Lumian frontem contraxit.

unit.source: Despite the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura being fully activated, Amandina, Lugano, and the others around him didn’t show any signs of panic or fear.
unit.target: Etsi aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis prorsus activa erat, Amandina, Lugano, et ceteri circa eum nullas signa panici aut timoris ostenderunt.

unit.source: He didn’t sense any extremely frenzied or violent thoughts either!
unit.target: Neque sensit ullam cogitationem nimis furibundam aut violentam.

unit.source: Wait…
unit.target: Exspecta…

unit.source: The figure in the blood-stained armor seems to be Blood Emperor Alista Tudor…
unit.target: Figura in armatura sanguine maculata videtur esse Imperator Sanguinis Alista Tudor…

unit.source: This place feels similar to the Samaritan Women’s Spring…
unit.target: Hic locus videtur similis esse Fons Mulierum Samaritarum…

unit.source: Could the figure sitting at the tomb’s entrance be the Underworld Daoist mentioned by the Armored Shadow?
unit.target: Num figura, sedens ad introitum sepulcri, sit ille Daoista Inferorum, quem Umbrā Armata commemoratum est?

unit.source: Why are he and the Blood Emperor appearing here again?
unit.target: Cur ille et Imperator Sanguinis iterum hic apparent?

unit.source: Shouldn’t they be at the source of the Samaritan Women’s Spring?
unit.target: Nonne illi ad fontem Mulierum Samaritarum esse debent?

unit.source: Are the two connected?
unit.target: Num inter se conexae sint?

unit.source: Did the Underworld Daoist discover the Blood Emperor’s residual aura on me and conveniently seal it?
unit.target: Num Daoista Inferorum invenit auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis in me et eam commodē obsignavit?

unit.source: Even if I fully activate it, I won’t be able to unleash the crazy Red Priest’s aura?
unit.target: Etiamsi eam plene activavero, non potero efferre auram sacerdotis Rubri insani.

unit.source: Uh, I don’t know if it’s because of Mr. Fool’s seal or because I’m wearing Hisoka’s golden mask, but the Underworld Daoist didn’t directly allow me to undergo immortal ascension, nor did he force me to lose control…
unit.target: Heu, nescio utrum propter sigillum Domini Stulti aut quia larvam auream Hisoka geram, sed Daoista Inferorum mihi ascensionem immortalem directe subire non permisit, nec me coegerit ut imperium perderem.

unit.source: Lumian quickly grasped his predicament.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter suam condicionem intellexit.

unit.source: As the immortalized Devil entered the black ancient tomb, the situation inside changed once more.
unit.target: Cum Diabolus immortalizatus in sepulcrum antiquum nigrum intravit, res intus iterum mutatae sunt.

unit.source: The tomb, which had fallen silent, emitted a rustling sound, accompanied by the clang of metal colliding with stone.
unit.target: Sepulcrum, quod in silentium ceciderat, edidit sonum susurrantem, cum clangore metalli in lapidem collidens.

unit.source: The next instant, a golden figure materialized beside the Underworld Daoist at the tomb’s entrance.
unit.target: Subsequenti momento, figura aurea iuxta Daoistam Inferorum ad introitum sepulcri apparuit.

unit.source: The figure was covered in gold, with long limbs and a golden mask streaked with white and black paint.
unit.target: Figura erat auro operta, membris longis et larva aurea albo et nigro picta.

unit.source: It belonged to the same type as the one on Lumian’s face and the pale-white goat’s head!
unit.target: Pertinebat ad eundem genus, ac ea quae in facie Lumiani et in capite cabrae pallide albae apparuerat!

unit.source: The golden-masked figure stiffened, as if its limbs were dead.
unit.target: Figura larva aurea induta riguit, quasi membra eius mortua essent.

unit.source: Relying solely on the strength of its waist, it sat up from lying flat like a corpse.
unit.target: Solum innixus robore lumbi, ex recumbentia ut cadaver surrexit.

unit.source: Eyes closed, it turned its head towards the pale-white goat closest to it.
unit.target: Oculis clausis, caput suum converterit ad cabram pallide albam prope illam.

unit.source: The pale-white goat’s aura instantly turned ordinary, making it unable to walk on the still river.
unit.target: Aura cabrae pallide albæ statim ordinaria facta est, ita ut illa in flumine quieto ambulare non posset.

unit.source: It rapidly decayed, sank, and quickly vanished.
unit.target: Celeriter putrescens, delapsa, et cito evanuit.

unit.source: The golden figure, eyes still closed, turned its head to the tattered, sinister cloth doll.
unit.target: Figura aurea, oculis adhuc clausis, caput suum converterit ad pupam pannosam et sinistram.

unit.source: The eerie vines on the cloth doll’s Gothic dress suddenly came alive, coiling around the doll, rendering it powerless and immobile.
unit.target: Vinea inspissatae in veste Gothica pupae pannosae repente animatae sunt, circum pupam involutae, eam impotentem et immobilis reddentes.

unit.source: The corpse’s head turned to the slowly walking green-eyed man.
unit.target: Caput cadaveris convertit ad virum oculis viridibus, qui lente ambulabat.

unit.source: The green-eyed man, his eyes reflecting the ugly puppet, suddenly halted.
unit.target: Vir oculis viridibus, quibus pupam foedam speculabatur, subito sistit.

unit.source: With a bang, his body transformed into a bloody piglet.
unit.target: Cum strepitu, corpus eius in porcellum sanguinolentum mutatum est.

unit.source: The ugly puppet landed beside the piglet, motionless, as if it had turned into the most ordinary and common puppet.
unit.target: Pupa foeda iuxta porcellum appulit, immota, quasi in puppam vulgariam et communem versa esset.

unit.source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up as he jogged over.
unit.target: Oculi Ludovigi fulserunt, dum advenit currendo.

unit.source: He leaped up like a massive frog and pounced on the bloody piglet.
unit.target: Saltavit ut rana ingens et in porcellum sanguinolentum insiluit.

unit.source: He grabbed its head and bit down.
unit.target: Caput eius arripuit et mordere coepit.

unit.source: Amandina closed her eyes in shock.
unit.target: Amandina oculos clausit, stupefacta.

unit.source: Louis Berry’s godson turned out to be such a monster?
unit.target: Filiolus sponsi Ludovici Berry tam monstrum esse apparuit?

unit.source: The pig wailed fiercely.
unit.target: Porcellus vehementer ululavit.

unit.source: The golden-masked corpse closed its eyes, turned its head, and faced Iveljsta Eggers.
unit.target: Cadaver, larva aurea induta, oculos clausit, caput converterit, et Iveljsta Eggers opposuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s forehead throbbed.
unit.target: Frons Lumiani pulsabat.

unit.source: He wanted to break through the sudden paralyzing pressure and teleport over to rescue Iveljsta, but he hesitated.
unit.target: Voluit vim subitam, quae paralysabat, effringere et se translocare ut Iveljsta servaret, sed dubitavit.

unit.source: Previously, he had restricted himself from approaching the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Primum se prohibuerat ne ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum appropinquaret.

unit.source: At most, he would take a glance or two.
unit.target: Maxime, semel aut bis solum intuebatur.

unit.source: Now, he didn’t want to break this self-imposed “rule.” Violating it meant immense risk.
unit.target: Nunc hanc sibi ipsi impositam regulam violare nollebat; violatio autem magnum periculum significabat.

unit.source: However, Iveljsta was from the Church of The Fool.
unit.target: Attamen Iveljsta ex Ecclesia Stulti erat.

unit.source: Just as Lumian made his decision, the golden corpse turned its head again, but Iveljsta remained unchanged.
unit.target: Simul ac Lumian consilium cepit, aureum cadaver iterum caput convertere coepit, sed Iveljsta immutatus mansit.

unit.source: He was still severely injured, his aura weak.
unit.target: Adhuc graviter laesus erat, et aura eius debilis.

unit.source: What’s going on? Why did the cold corpse in the ancient tomb spare Iveljsta?
unit.target: Quid agitur? Cur cadaver gelidum in sepulcro antiquo Iveljsta parcit?

unit.source: The Underworld Daoist didn’t do anything to him when he looked at him…
unit.target: Daoista Inferorum nihil ei fecit, cum eum intuebatur…

unit.source: Lumian was puzzled as the corpse’s golden mask faced Reaza.
unit.target: Lumian perplexus erat, cum larva aurea cadaveris versus Reaza versa esset.

unit.source: After the pale-white goat vanished, Reaza summoned an undead creature to envelop him and blinked to the edge of the ancient tomb area.
unit.target: Postquam cabra pallide alba evanuit, Reaza creaturam ex mortuis evocavit, ut eum circumamplexaret, et celeriter ad limitem areae sepulcri antiqui transiit.

unit.source: He was about to escape into the forest, but before he could do anything else, his body froze.
unit.target: Paratus erat in silvas effugere, sed antequam quidquam aliud ageret, corpus eius congelatum est.

unit.source: Pop, pop, pop.
unit.target: Pop, pop, pop.

unit.source: Huge, wet warts erupted from Reaza’s face, neck, and the backs of his hands, accompanied by disgusting mucus.
unit.target: Ingens, umidae verrucae de facie, colo, et dorso manuum Reazae eruperunt, comitatae ab immundo moco.

unit.source: The vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol collapsed, rapidly disintegrating into countless bloody warts that squirmed in the gaps of his thin suit.
unit.target: Vice-captain Portus Pylos vigilum collapsus est, celeriter disintegratus in innumerabiles verrucas sanguineas, quae in fissuris tenuis vestis eius se contorquebant.

unit.source: The undead creature summoned by Reaza transformed into thin human skin and gently landed.
unit.target: Creatura ex mortuis a Reaza evocata in cutem humanam tenuem transformata est et leniter ad terram descendit.

unit.source: Lumian’s scalp tingled as he watched.
unit.target: Scalpum Lumiani formicarum sensu palpitabat dum spectabat.

unit.source: Finally, he broke free from the paralysis caused by the corpse sitting up.
unit.target: Denique a paralysi, quam cadaver surrectus attulit, evasit.

unit.source: He said to Lugano, Amandina, and the others, “Grab hold of me!”
unit.target: Dixit ad Lugano, Amandinam, et ceteros: “Prehendite me!”

unit.source: He was about to teleport back to Tizamo!
unit.target: Paratus erat se translocare ad Tizamo!

unit.source: At that moment, the corpse’s golden-masked face turned towards him.
unit.target: Ad hoc momentum, facies cadaveris, larva aurea induta, versus eum convertit.

unit.source: Lumian’s body turned cold.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani frigide factum est.

unit.source: Ignoring Camus and company, he immediately activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Neglexit Camus et ceteros, et statim signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activavit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he saw the cold corpse’s face, its eyes peeking out from under the golden mask with white and black paint, open.
unit.target: Subito, vidit faciem cadaveris frigidi, oculos eius, sub larva aurea cum albo et nigro pigmento, eminentes et apertos.

unit.source: It was a pair of cold, icy-blue eyes.
unit.target: Erat par oculorum frigidorum, glacialiter caeruleorum.

unit.source: Icy-blue eyes? Lumian was taken aback, finding them familiar.
unit.target: Oculi glaciales caerulei? Lumian obstupefactus erat, eos notos inveniens.

unit.source: These are…
unit.target: Hi sunt…

unit.source: These are Naboredisley’s eyes!
unit.target: Hi sunt oculi Naboredisley!

unit.source: Dammit, why is Naboredisley here? Why is he a cold corpse in the black ancient tomb?
unit.target: Eheu, cur Naboredisley hic est? Cur is cadaver gelidum in sepulcro antiquo nigro est?

unit.source: What right does He have to bestow the Beyonder powers of the Prisoner pathway?
unit.target: Quod ius habet ille ut largiatur potentates Beyonder viae Captivi?

unit.source: It can’t be real. It’s not Naboredisley, but its eyes resemble…
unit.target: Non potest esse verum. Non est Naboredisley, sed oculi eius similes sunt…

unit.source: Amidst Lumian’s thoughts, he saw a smile in the icy-blue eyes, a smile of playfulness, understanding, and certainty.
unit.target: Inter cogitationes Lumiani, vidit risum in oculis glaciales caeruleis, risum ludicrum, intellegentiae atque certitudinis.

unit.source: This was a stark contrast to the pained expressions in the icy-blue eyes on Hanth Island.
unit.target: Hoc erat acutum contrarium vultuum dolentium in oculis glaciales caeruleis in Insula Hanth.

unit.source: Suddenly, a half-withered, violently beating dark-red heart soared from the golden corpse’s hand and flew out of the completely disintegrated still river.
unit.target: Subito, cor dimidium exsiccatus, vehementer pulsans, rubri obscuri, ex manu cadaveris aurei surrexit et e flumine quieto omnino disintegrato evanuit.

unit.source: A short figure pounced on the heart like a frog and grabbed it.
unit.target: Figura brevis ut rana in cor insiluit et eum arripuit.

unit.source: It was Ludwig, his mouth filled with blood.
unit.target: Erat Ludwig, cuius os sanguine repletum erat.

unit.source: The smile in the golden corpse’s icy-blue eyes grew more relaxed.
unit.target: Risus in oculis glaciales caeruleis cadaveris aurei paulatim lenior factus est.

unit.source: He nodded at Lumian and willingly fell back to His original position.
unit.target: Annuit ad Lumian et libenter ad suam originariam positionem recidit.

unit.source: He had no intention of seizing the opportunity to leave the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Noluit occasionem capere ut sepulcrum antiquum nigrum relinqueret.

unit.source: With a splash of illusory water, the tomb’s open door gradually closed.
unit.target: Cum aqua illusoria spumante, ianua aperta sepulcri paulatim clausa est.

unit.source: Seated by the door, the figure suspected to be the Underworld Daoist vanished.
unit.target: Sedens iuxta ianuam, figura, quae ut Daoista Inferorum suspicata erat, evanuit.

unit.source: Wh— Naboredisley’s corpse doesn’t seem willing to leave the tomb…
unit.target: Heu— Cadaver Naboredisley non videtur sepulcrum relinquare velle…

unit.source: How did He end up lying in there?
unit.target: Quomodo in eo iaceret?

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t figure out the reason, so he looked at Ludwig and realized the boy was holding a half-withered dark-red heart to his mouth.
unit.target: Lumian causam non intellexit, ergo ad Ludovicum aspexit et animadvertit puerum cor dimidium exsiccatum rubri obscuri ad os tenere.

unit.source: Lumian wanted to stop him but lacked the ability.
unit.target: Lumian eum sistere vellebat, sed facultatem non habebat.

unit.source: The surrounding corpses didn’t seem to attract Ludwig as much as the half-withered heart.
unit.target: Cadavera circumstantia Ludwig non tam alliciebant quam cor dimidium exsiccatum.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: The tomb door slammed shut, causing the entire area to tremble.
unit.target: Ianua sepulcri subito clauserunt, totam aream tremere facientes.

unit.source: Lumian and the others witnessed dream fragments one after another, and their surroundings blurred.
unit.target: Lumian et ceteri fragmenta somniorum uno post alium conspecta sunt, et circumiecta eorum obscura erant.

unit.source: After a brief daze, Lumian realized he was lying in the middle of an unlit street.
unit.target: Post brevem stupefactum, Lumian intellexit se in medio viae non illuminatae iacere.

unit.source: The crimson moon was bright in the sky, casting its light.
unit.target: Luna coccinea in caelo praeclara lucebat, sua luce effundens.

unit.source: This was inside Tizamo.
unit.target: Hoc erat intra Tizamo.

unit.source: 694 A “Deal”
unit.target: 694: Pactum

unit.source: The Dream Festival came to an abrupt end?
unit.target: Festa Somniorum subito finem habuit?

unit.source: Lumian jolted upright, realizing he was holding the strange golden mask he had received from Hisoka.
unit.target: Lumian subito exsurrexit, animadvertens se tenere larvam auream insolitam a Hisoka receptam.

unit.source: For a moment, he couldn’t tell if he was still dreaming or if the mask had somehow followed him from the dream into the waking world.
unit.target: Per momentum, nesciebat utrum adhuc in somnio esset aut num larva, quaedam ratione, eum ex somnio in mundum vigilum secuta esset.

unit.source: Lumian turned to look behind him.
unit.target: Lumian se vertit ut post se aspiceret.

unit.source: Reaza and Maslow, who had died during the Dream Festival, were lying in the middle of the street, just starting to regain consciousness.
unit.target: Reaza et Maslow, qui in Festa Somniorum mortui fuerant, in media via iacebant, modo conscientiam recipientes.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the moment while they gathered their wits and slowly got to their feet, Lumian focused his attention on their luck.
unit.target: Ut tempore, dum mens suas redintegrabant et paulatim surrexerunt, Lumian in eorum fortunam se concentravit.

unit.source: He could see clear signs of death on both of them.
unit.target: Clara signa mortis in utrisque videre poterat.

unit.source: Their fates were about to undergo a rapid transformation, irreversibly tainted by darkness.
unit.target: Fata eorum celeriter se mutura erant, tenebris irreversibiliter contaminata.

unit.source: Reaza’s luck, in particular, was changing even more swiftly and dramatically, like a river suddenly plunging over a cliff to form a waterfall.
unit.target: Fortuna Reazae, praecipue, celerius et fulminanter mutabatur, sicut flumen repente super rupem in cataractam decidens.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: At that instant, Reaza remembered what had happened to him during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Illo momento, Reaza recordatus est quid ei in Festa Somniorum evenisset.

unit.source: Uncontrollable fear washed over his pale, cold face.
unit.target: Metus incontrollabilis super faciem eius pallidam et frigida diffusus est.

unit.source: Pop, pop, pop. Huge, mucus-oozing warts erupted all over his body, just as Lumian had witnessed in the dream.
unit.target: Pop, pop, pop. Ingens verrucae, mucum effluentes, per totum corpus eius erupere coeperunt, sicut Lumian in somnio vidit.

unit.source: Seeing Reaza’s eyes turn frenzied and his body start to disintegrate, Lumian raised his free right hand, pointing it at Reaza’s mouth as if it were a gun.
unit.target: Videns oculos Reazae in insaniam versa et corpus eius dissolvi coepisse, Lumian dextram manum liberam levavit, eam in os Reazae, quasi telum, dirigens.

unit.source: A condensed bullet of blazing white flame shot from Lumian’s fingertip, shattering Reaza’s teeth as it entered his mouth.
unit.target: Globus condensatus flammae albae ardentis, a digito Lumiani emissus, dentes Reazae confrinxit, dum in os eius intravit.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: Reaza’s head split apart inch by inch, engulfed in roaring flames.
unit.target: Caput Reazae gradatim dissectum est, flammis rugientibus involutum.

unit.source: The vice-captain of Port Pylos’s patrol team collapsed heavily, his body covered in a thin black suit made up of countless slimy warts.
unit.target: Subpraefectus turmae circuitus Portus Pylos graviter cecidit, corpus eius tenuo nigro vestimento constitutum ex innumeris verrucis mucosis.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Maslow, who was shocked by Reaza’s grotesque transformation and terrified by the death he had experienced in the dream. Calmly, Lumian asked, “Who was he working for?”
unit.target: Lumian se convertit ad Maslow, qui ab transformatione repulsiva Reazae et morte in somnio experta territus erat. Tranquillime, Lumian rogavit: “Pro quo ille operabatur?”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian tucked the golden mask into his Traveler’s Bag and checked to make sure the Symphony of Hatred and his other belongings were still there.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian larvam auream in sacco Viatoris recondidit et comprobat ut “Symphonia Odii” atque cetera supellectilia eius adhuc essent.

unit.source: Everything was accounted for, including the food he had thrown at Ludwig.
unit.target: Omnia enumerata erant, etiam cibus quem in Ludwig coniecerat.

unit.source: Maslow paused for a few seconds before answering, “We’re all part of the Numinous Episcopate.”
unit.target: Maslow paucos secundos cessavit antequam respondit: “Omnes sumus pars Episcopatus Numinosi.”

unit.source: Numinous Episcopate… Lumian chuckled. “Do you still believe in Death?”
unit.target: Episcopatus Numinosus… Lumian subridens dixit: “Num adhuc credis in Mortem?”

unit.source: Wasn’t Death already dead?
unit.target: Nonne Mors iam mortua erat?

unit.source: Maslow considered the question for a moment before saying, “Reaza told me that Death is on the verge of returning. There have been signs recently that prayers are being answered again.”
unit.target: Maslow quaestionem per momentum meditatus, dixerat: “Reaza mihi narravit Mortem rediturum esse. Nuper signa apparuerunt, ut orationes iterum responderentur.”

unit.source: Hearing Maslow’s words, Lumian nodded pensively.
unit.target: Audito Maslovi sermone, Lumian pensuose annuit.

unit.source: “Which faction of the Numinous Episcopate do you belong to?”
unit.target: “Ad quam factionem Episcopatus Numinosi pertines?”

unit.source: As far as he knew, the Numinous Episcopate was divided into numerous factions. There were the Royals, led by the descendants of the Eggers family, who sought to restore the Balam Empire’s rule; the Artificial Death faction, which had somehow recreated Death itself; and the less influential Repose and Underworld factions.
unit.target: Quoad notitiam eius, Episcopatus Numinosus in plurimas factiones divisus erat. Erant regales, ab posteris familiae Eggers ducti, qui imperium Balam restaurare studebant; factio Mortis Artificiali, quae Mortem ipsum aliquo modo recreaverat; atque factio Requies et Inferorum, minus influae.

unit.source: “We’re from the Royal faction,” Maslow admitted.
unit.target: “Nos ex factione Regali sumus,” Maslow agnovit.

unit.source: “Did you infiltrate the patrol team on purpose?” Lumian asked nonchalantly.
unit.target: “Num penitus in turmam circuitus insidiis intravisti?” Lumian nonchalanter interrogavit.

unit.source: Maslow shook his head.
unit.target: Maslow caput negavit.

unit.source: “No, Admiral Querarill has been secretly working with us.”
unit.target: “Non, Admiral Querarill occulte nobiscum operatus est.”

unit.source: Admiral Querarill, the de facto ruler of Matani, is closely tied to the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction… Combined with the Church of Earth Mother and the remaining Intis faction, this must be what Franca meant by dancing on three eggs. Judging by the situation, Reaza wasn’t a traitor after all… It’s no wonder Admiral Querarill didn’t send backup. If the Numinous Episcopate and the Church of The Fool can’t handle the problem, it won’t matter how many people he sends…
unit.target: Admiral Querarill, qui re vera Matani rector est, arcte coniunctus est cum factione Regali Episcopatus Numinosi… Cum Ecclesia Mater Terrae et reliqua factione Intis coniunctus, id oportet fuisse quod Franca de tribus ovellis saltando significavit. Ex conditione iudicata, Reaza non fuit proditor. Non mirum est quod Admiral Querarill subsidia non misit. Si Episcopatus Numinosus et Ecclesia Stulti problema superare non possunt, non refert quot homines mittat.

unit.source: His mind now clear, Lumian asked, “Was participating in this Dream Festival a direct order from the Royal faction’s upper ranks?”
unit.target: Mens eius iam clarus, Lumian rogavit: “Num participatio in hoc Festa Somniorum iussu directo ab superiores factionis Regalis facta est?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Maslow glanced at Reaza’s body, now unrecognizable as human, and said, “Apparently the order came straight from the Empress.”
unit.target: “Ita,” Maslow, oculos in corpus Reazae detorsos, quae iam humanum agnoscere non poterant, dixit: “Apparet quod ius directe a Imperatrice ortus sit.”

unit.source: Empress… The Pale Empress of the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction? Lumian instinctively scanned his surroundings.
unit.target: Imperatrix… Imperatrix Pallida factionis Regalis Episcopatus Numinosi? Lumian instinctive circumspiciebat.

unit.source: A sudden thought struck him. He drew the straight sword he had bought in Port Santa, picked up Reaza’s clothes, and quickly searched through the items he had left behind.
unit.target: Subita cogitatio eum percusit. Extraxit gladium rectum, quem in Porto Santa emi, vestimenta Reazae colligens, celeriter per reliquas res quae relicta erant quaesivit.

unit.source: There was no sign of the death-corroded golden mask or the crystal-like skull.
unit.target: Nullum signum larvae aureae, mortis corrumpentis, aut cranii sicut crystallum apparuit.

unit.source: Even though the skull had turned into a goat in the dream and the golden mask had sunk into the tranquil river, Lumian reasoned that it had still been a dream, after all. No matter how unusual it was, it was ultimately just a dream. When someone died, they died in reality, but the same might not hold true for objects.
unit.target: Etiamsi cranium in somnio in capram conversum fuerat et larva aurea in flumen tranquillum demergita, Lumian putavit tamen id somnium esse; quamquam mirum, tandem solum somnium erat. Cum quis moritur, vere perit; sed talia obiectis fortasse non conveniunt.

unit.source: It was similar to how some of the food Ludwig had eaten in the dream had reappeared in the Traveler’s Bag.
