unit.target: Simile erat quo cibus, quem Ludwig in somnio comederat, in sacco Viatoris iterum apparuerit.

unit.source: Even if the items were going to disappear, it would have to happen later. For now, they should definitely return to the real world!
unit.target: Etiamsi illa evanescere destinata erant, hoc postea fieri oportebat; nunc certe ad mundum reale redeuntem esse debebant!

unit.source: However, Reaza had nothing on him.
unit.target: Tamen, Reaza nihil ei adversum habebat.

unit.source: A chill ran down Lumian’s spine. Lowering his voice, he asked, “Termiboros, did you notice anything?”
unit.target: Gelidus tremor per dorsum Lumiani transiit. Vocem deminuens, rogavit: “Termiboros, quidquam animadvertisti?”

unit.source: Termiboros’s majestic voice echoed in Lumian’s ears. “Do you only now know fear?”
unit.target: Voce regia Termibori in auribus Lumiani resonabat: “Num tantum nunc timorem cognoscis?”

unit.source: “Tch.” Lumian felt a lingering sense of dread, but he didn’t let it show. “Was the Pale Empress watching?”
unit.target: “Tch.” Lumian, sensu metuoso manente, sed non ostendens, dixit: “Num Imperatrix Pallida spectabat?”

unit.source: Termiboros replied in a deep tone, “It’s not just Her.”
unit.target: Termiboros, voce profunda, respondit: “Non sola illa est.”

unit.source: Her? The Pale Empress is an Angel? Lumian composed himself and turned his attention back to Maslow.
unit.target: “Illa? Num Imperatrix Pallida angelus sit?” Lumian se composuit et ad Maslow rediit.

unit.source: Just as Maslow was wondering why Louis Berry was talking to himself, the other party suddenly asked, “Why did Reaza kill you?”
unit.target: Dum Maslow mirabatur cur Louis Berry sese solum loqueretur, adversarius repente rogavit: “Cur Reaza te occidit?”

unit.source: Maslow stayed quiet, offering no response.
unit.target: Maslow silentium servavit, nullam responsionem dabat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “Did you betray him?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Illum prodidistine?”

unit.source: Maslow’s lips trembled, but he didn’t say a word.
unit.target: Labia Maslovi tremuerunt, sed nihil dixit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled casually and said, “It doesn’t matter. If you don’t want to answer, don’t. You won’t be alive much longer anyway.”
unit.target: Lumian leniter risit et dixit: “Non refert. Si respondere nolo, ne respondeas. Nihil diu vita tibi manebit.”

unit.source: Maslow’s face turned ashen as he considered the ramifications of his death during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Facies Maslovi cinerea facta est, dum de consequentiis mortis in Festa Somniorum meditaret.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, then added, “Go on and do whatever you want. Just don’t do anything bad. It’ll make you die sooner.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit, deinde addidit: “Procede atque fac quaecumque velis. Tantum ne agas quid malum; id te velocius interficiet.”

unit.source: With that, Lumian glanced at Reaza’s corpse, which was starting to produce the Beyonder characteristic. Greed welled up inside him, but he suppressed it with an Ascetic’s self-control.
unit.target: His verbis, Lumian respectus est ad cadaver Reazae, quod notam Beyonder exhibere coepit. Avaritia intus eum surgebat, sed eam moderatione ascetica reprimi curavit.

unit.source: He decided that regardless of whether Reaza had been a traitor or not, his Beyonder characteristics should be left for Camus and the Matani patrol team.
unit.target: Statuit quod, sive Reaza proditor fuerit sive non, proprietates eius Beyonder Camus et turmae Matani relinquendae essent.

unit.source: To stop himself from giving in to greed and with a grave matter coming to mind, Lumian’s expression shifted subtly. He activated the black mark on his right shoulder and teleported away.
unit.target: Ut se a cupiditate non deduceret et cum res gravi mente oriri inciperet, vultus Lumiani leviter mutatus est. Maculam nigram in umero dextro activavit atque se teleportavit.

unit.source: Maslow stared at the street that had been empty a moment before and the lights that had been stirred by the explosion, looking as though his soul had left his body. With a dazed and despondent expression, he turned and walked toward the forest outside Tizamo.
unit.target: Maslow spectabat viam, quae paulo ante vacua erat, et lumina, quae explosione excitata erant, quasi anima eius ex corpore discessisset. Stupefactus et maerens, se convertit et in silvam extra Tizamo processit.

unit.source: In the second-floor suite of the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: In conclavi secundae plantae Brieu Motel.

unit.source: The instant Lugano woke up, he noticed he couldn’t move his right forearm.
unit.target: Statim quo Lugano evigilavit, animadvertit se antebrachium dextro movere non posse.

unit.source: It’s okay, it’s okay. I’ll be fine after a psychiatric treatment or two. The people in Tizamo can be healed by Mass without needing Beyonder effects… Lugano tried to console himself as he endured the pain in his right forearm.
unit.target: Est in ordine, est in ordine. Post unam vel duas therapias psychiatrics, bene ero. Homines in Tizamo per Missam sanari possunt, sine auxilio effectuum Beyonder. Lugano se consolari conatus est, dolorem in antebrachio dextro ferens.

unit.source: Just then, he heard hurried footsteps coming from the living room outside his door.
unit.target: Tum, audivit vestigia pedum festinantia e conclavi extra ianuam eius venire.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: The door to Lugano’s bedroom flew open. In the crimson moonlight pouring through the window, Ludwig appeared, dressed in blue pajamas with yellow stars and a matching nightcap. He was clutching a half-withered, blood-stained, dark red heart.
unit.target: Ianuam cubiculi Lugani celeriter patefecit. In lumine lunari coccineo per fenestram effluente, Ludwig apparuit, indutus in caeruleis pyjama cum stellis flavescentibus et pileo congruenti. Manus tenebat cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum, sanguine maculatum.

unit.source: Badump! Badump!
unit.target: Badump! Badump!

unit.source: Lugano could hear his own heart pounding, and he felt like his soul was about to abandon his body out of sheer terror.
unit.target: Lugano audire poterat proprium cor pulsantem, et sentiebat quasi anima eius ex corpore timore puro discedere velle.

unit.source: Had Ludwig come back for seconds because he had woken up early and hadn’t gotten his fill during the dream?
unit.target: An Ludwig redierat pro secunda, quia mane evigilaverat et in somnio non se satiaverat?

unit.source: A moment later, Lugano saw a figure float in through the doorway.
unit.target: Paululum post, Lugano vidit figuram per ianuam leviter fluitantem.

unit.source: The figure was semi-transparent, wearing an elaborate, opulent, black dress. There was no head on its neck, just a clean cut. In its hand, it held four identical blonde heads with red eyes and beautiful features.
unit.target: Figura semitransparens erat, induta veste nigra intricata et opulenta. In collo non erat caput, sed solum excisio purus. In manu, quattuor capita flavida, identica, cum oculis rubris et lineamentis venustis, tenebat.

unit.source: “Return…” “It”… “To”… “Me”…
unit.target: “Rede…” “Id…” “Ad…” “Me…”

unit.source: The four heads uttered different words in ancient Feysac, forming a complete sentence.
unit.target: Quattuor capita verba diversa in antiqua Feysac efferuerunt, formantes sententiam completam.

unit.source: Ludwig’s image was reflected in their eight crimson eyes.
unit.target: Imago Ludvigi in eorum octo oculis coccineis reflexa est.

unit.source: “Mine!” Ludwig ran to Lugano’s bed and spun around, looking like he wanted to bring the heart to his mouth, but he seemed to hesitate.
unit.target: “Meum!” Ludwig ad lectum Lugani cucurrit et gyravit, videns quasi cor ad os ferre velle, sed haesitabat.

unit.source: The four heads held by the translucent figure spoke one by one, “Idiot”… “Eating”… “Your”… “Own”… “Brain”…
unit.target: Quattuor capita a figura translucida tenuta singillatim dixerunt: “Stulte”… “Manducans”… “Tuum”… “Proprium”… “Cerebrum”…

unit.source: “That” “Is” “My” “Heart”
unit.target: “Id” “Est” “Meum” “Cor”

unit.source: “If” “You” “Don’t” “Return”
unit.target: “Si” “Tu” “Non” “Redieris”

unit.source: “I” “Will” “Turn” “You” “Into” “Pig”
unit.target: “Ego” “Te” “Vertebo” “In” “Porcum”

unit.source: Almost at the same moment, Lumian materialized next to Ludwig, taking in the scene and hearing the corresponding words.
unit.target: Paululum simul, Lumian iuxta Ludwig apparuit, scaenam contemplans et verba congruenta audiens.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the strange-looking lady, then at Ludwig, who wore a resolute expression as if he would defend his food to the death. After a moment’s consideration, Lumian said,
unit.target: Lumian aspiciens ad mulierem insolitae species, deinde ad Ludvigum, qui vultum constanter gerebat, quasi cibum suum ad mortem defendere velle, parvo tempore meditatus, Lumian dixit:

unit.source: “Madam, perhaps you could try trading him other spiritually rich materials for it.”
unit.target: “Domina, forsitan conari potestis eum aliis materiis spiritualiter dives pro eo commutare.”

unit.source: In Ludwig’s current state, Lumian didn’t dare try to take the item from him by force.
unit.target: In statu Ludvigi hodierno, Lumian non ausus est cor vi eripere.

unit.source: The lady in the intricate black dress, holding four blonde, red-eyed heads, went silent.
unit.target: Mulier in intricata veste nigra, quae quattuor capita flavida cum oculis rubris tenebat, silentium cepit.

unit.source: After a short while, one of her heads spat out a gleaming gold coin and held it between its teeth.
unit.target: Paulo post, una ex capitibus eius nummum aureum nitentem exspuat et inter dentes retinuit.

unit.source: A gold coin? You want to buy it with a gold coin? Ludwig doesn’t care about money… Lumian was about to point this out to the lady when he suddenly realized the gold coin looked familiar.
unit.target: Nummus aureus? Visne id emere nummo aureo? Ludwig pecuniae non curat… Lumian id mulieri indicare paratus erat, cum subito animadvertit nummum aureum familiarem esse videbatur.

unit.source: It was a Loen gold coin, worth 1 pound.
unit.target: Erat nummus aureus Loenensis, unius librae valoris.

unit.source: Uh… Lumian glanced over at Ludwig.
unit.target: Uh… Lumian ad Ludwig aspexit.

unit.source: Ludwig wavered.
unit.target: Ludwig titubavit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, he finally held out his hands and gave the half-withered dark red heart to the woman’s head.
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, tandem manus protulit et cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum, capiti mulieris tradidit.

unit.source: The blonde, red-eyed head let go, dropping the gold coin into Ludwig’s hand. Quickly, it sank its teeth into the half-withered dark red heart.
unit.target: Caput flavum, cum oculis rubris, dimisit, nummum aureum in manum Ludvigi deiecit; celeriter dentes in cor dimidiatum, rubrum obscurum infodit.

unit.source: The translucent lady stepped back and vanished from Lugano’s bedroom.
unit.target: Mulier translucida retrorsum processit atque ex cubiculi Lugani evanuit.

unit.source: Ludwig hastily popped the Loen gold coin into his mouth, as if trying to hide it in his stomach. But then he seemed to think better of it and fished it back out. He wiped it off on his pajamas and carefully put it in his pocket.
unit.target: Ludwig festinanter nummum aureum Loenensem in os suum coniecit, quasi eum in ventre celare conaretur; sed deinde melius sentire videbatur et eum iterum extraxit. Illud in pyjama lavit et caute in sinum suum recondidit.

unit.source: Just as I thought, it’s the same as Jenna’s lucky gold coin… A Loen gold coin closely connected to Mr. Fool? Lumian nodded to himself, comprehension dawning.
unit.target: Ut putavi, id est idem ac nummus aureus felix Jennae… Nummus aureus Loenensis, ad Dominum Stultum arcte coniunctus? Lumian sibi annuit, intellectus emergens.

unit.source: A twinge of disappointment ran through him.
unit.target: Modicus tristitiae impetus per eum pervenit.

unit.source: Two people close to me have gotten lucky gold coins. Why don’t I have one?
unit.target: Duo homines mihi proximos nummos aureos fortunatos acceperunt. Cur ego unum non habeo?

unit.source: 695 Kolobo’s Worry
unit.target: 695 Sollicitudo Kolobo

unit.source: Lumian snapped out of his daze and glanced at Ludwig, who had regained his composure.
unit.target: Lumian ex stupore evigilavit et Ludovicum intuebatur, qui sibi constantiam redemit.

unit.source: Turning to Lugano, who was shrinking into a corner of the bed, he said, “We’ll head back to Trier tomorrow and find a psychiatrist for you—a real, genuine one.”
unit.target: Conversus ad Lugano, qui in angulum lecti contrahere videbatur, dixit: “Cras ad Trier redibimus et tibi medicum mentis reperiemus—verum atque genuinum!”

unit.source: This decision wasn’t made out of concern for Lugano, but rather something that had long been on Lumian’s agenda.
unit.target: Haec decisio non ex cura erga Lugano facta est, sed ex re, quae diu in consilio Lumiani iam manebat.

unit.source: 007 should have already provided feedback in the early morning hours.
unit.target: 007 iam debuerat responsum ferre in primis horis matutinis.

unit.source: Lumian, Franca, and the others would discuss how to handle the Mirror Person, Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Lumian, Franca et ceteri disputabunt quomodo tractanda sit Persona Specularis, Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Moreover, Lumian intended to seize this opportunity to extract Termiboros’s power and obtain a Fate Appropriator boon.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian intendebat hanc opportunitatem capere ad extrahendam vim Termibori et obtinendum donum Fati Appropriatoris.

unit.source: His most significant gain from the Dream Festival was the substantial digestion of the Reaper potion.
unit.target: Maximus eius fructus ex Festival Somniorum fuit ingens digestio potionis Messoris.

unit.source: He knew the Southern Continent was filled with conflicts and combat opportunities, which would help him digest the Reaper potion.
unit.target: Sciebat Continentem Meridionalem esse repletam certaminibus et occasionibus belli, quae ei in digestione potionis Messoris favere poterant.

unit.source: However, he never anticipated that less than two weeks after advancing, the potion’s digestion progress would skyrocket, much like a mercury thermometer’s column shooting up when touching a living person’s armpit.
unit.target: Tamen numquam existimavit, post minus quam duas hebdomadas profectionis, progressum digestionis potionis in caelum proferi, instar columnae thermometri mercurialis quae, minimo incitamento in axillam hominis vivi contingens, subito ascendit.

unit.source: Culling Padre Cali, Hisoka’s dream projection, and nearly 20 others bestowed with strength equivalent to Sequence 6 or Sequence 5 made Lumian acutely aware of life’s fragility.
unit.target: Exstirpatio Patris Cali, proiectionis somniorum Hisoka, atque circiter viginti aliorum, quorum vires erant aequales Sequentiae VI vel V, Lumiani acutissime de fragilitate vitae animadvertitionem effecit.

unit.source: It was like straw under a scythe, constantly collapsing with a simple cull and scattered by the wind.
unit.target: Erat quasi palea sub falce, quae simplici caede constanter corruens ventis dispersa esset.

unit.source: Furthermore, after experiencing the acting of the first four Sequences, Lumian felt the Hunter pathway had a distinct characteristic of bringing calamity.
unit.target: Praeterea, postquam actus primarum quattuor Sequentiarum perceptus est, Lumian sensit iter Venatoris notum esse calamitatem afferendi.

unit.source: Reapers were no exception.
unit.target: Messori exceptionem non habebant.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: With this acting, he believed the Reaper’s destructive characteristics that brought calamity were more apparent.
unit.target: Hoc actu, credidit lineamenta destructiva Messoris, quae calamitatem afferent, magis apparere.

unit.source: At the same time, Lumian greatly benefited from an enemy’s destruction.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian ex interitu hostis valde profuit.

unit.source: As his mind raced, he summarized his first Reaper acting principle: “Culling is about destroying the target and reaping a harvest for yourself.”
unit.target: Mentem celeriter currentem, primum praeceptum actus Messoris summatim exposuit: “Exstirpatio consistit in destinatum delendo et messem sibi metendo.”

unit.source: If I had three or four more similar culls, I wouldn’t need to comprehend other acting principles and put them into practice to digest the Reaper potion.
unit.target: Si tres vel quattuor similes exstirpatio haberem, non necesse esset alias rationes actuum intellegere atque ad potionem Messoris digerendam exercere.

unit.source: However, such good fortune is rare… Lumian sighed silently.
unit.target: Tamen, talis fortuna rara est… Lumian tacite suspiravit.

unit.source: This required gathering more than ten Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 Beyonders with obvious flaws he could exploit without interference.
unit.target: Hoc requirebat congregare plus quam decem Beyonderum Sequentiae VI et V, quorum vitia manifesta erant, quibus ipse sine impedimento uti posset.

unit.source: Meeting each of these conditions was challenging, let alone all of them simultaneously:
unit.target: Singulas has condiciones exsequenda arduum erat, quanto magis omnes simul.

unit.source: First and foremost, whether humans consumed potions or gained superpowers through boons, their pathways and Sequences differed in their flaws.
unit.target: Primum et maxime, sive homines potiones consumebant sive per dona virtutes supernas adipiscebantur, vias et Sequentias in vitiosis differenti habebant.

unit.source: They couldn’t all be burdened by dream projections like the gravekeepers in the Dream Festival, where emotions and desires exploded at the slightest trigger.
unit.target: Non omnes possent oneri proiectionum somniorum esse onerati, sicut custodes sepulcri in Festival Somniorum, ubi affectus et desideria parvo incitamento erupta sunt.

unit.source: Even if the bestowed were deeply influenced by evil gods and had mental issues to some degree, exploding emotions and desires weren’t inevitable.
unit.target: Etiam, si donati a diis malignis profunde afficerentur et in aliquo modo perturbationes mentales haberent, eruptio affectuum et cupiditatum inevitabilis non erat.

unit.source: Some might simply have mutated personalities.
unit.target: Aliqui fortasse personalitates mutatas habeant.

unit.source: Secondly, Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 Beyonders were uncommon, especially the latter, who formed the backbone of various factions.
unit.target: Secundo, Beyonder de Sequentia VI et V rarae erant, praesertim illi de Sequentia V, qui columen variarum factionum constituebant.

unit.source: Even without factions, they could create their own teams and dominate a region like the Pirate Admirals.
unit.target: Etiam sine factionibus, turmas suas constituere poterant et regionem dominari, ut admirales piratarum.

unit.source: Gathering more than ten to twenty such Beyonders was no easy task.
unit.target: Congregare plus quam decem ad viginti talium Beyonderum non erat munus facile.

unit.source: Moreover, if a major incident caused the first two conditions to be met, the Beyonders’ common flaws might not be countered by Lumian and his mystical items.
unit.target: Praeterea, si magnum casus efficeret ut prima duo requisita implerentur, vitia communia Beyonderum a Lumiano et ornamentis mysticis non repellerentur.

unit.source: Finally, during the battle, a Sequence 5 Beyonder, a key member of the various factions, might draw the attention of the corresponding demigod.
unit.target: Denique, in proelio, Beyonder Sequentiae V, membrum praecipuum variarum factionum, fortasse attentionem semi-dei congruentes attraheret.

unit.source: A mysticism event like the Dream Festival, with its inherent limitations and natural problems, was unusually suitable for Lumian.
unit.target: Eventus mysticus ut Festival Somniorum, cum limitationibus immanentibus atque quaestionibus naturalibus, inusitate Lumiano conveniebat.

unit.source: Perhaps there had only been one such event in the Northern and Southern Continents in nearly a millennium.
unit.target: Forsitan solus unus talis eventus per paene mille annos in Continento Septentrionali et Meridionali fuisset.

unit.source: Sigh… Lumian couldn’t help but sigh again.
unit.target: Suspiro… Lumian iterum suspiravit.

unit.source: At that moment, Lugano was thrilled to hear he could return to Trier at dawn.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lugano exsultabat ex auditu quod ad Trier, in aurora, redire posset.

unit.source: He quickly replied, “Alright, alright!”
unit.target: Celeriter respondit: “Ita, ita!”

unit.source: Back in Trier, his boss had more trusted companions.
unit.target: Reversus in Trier, patronus eius plures fideles comites habebat.

unit.source: He probably wouldn’t need to take care of Ludwig anymore!
unit.target: Forte Ludovicum curare non iam oportebit!

unit.source: Lumian thought for a moment and glanced at the curtains emanating the crimson moonlight.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et cortinas, quae lunam rubram efferebant, intuebatur.

unit.source: Casually, he asked Lugano, “Have you saved enough for the Harvest Priest potion formula and the corresponding ingredients?”
unit.target: Leve rogavit Lugano: “Num satis seruisti ad formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis et ingredienta necessariis?”

unit.source: Lugano was taken aback.
unit.target: Lugano obstupefactus est.

unit.source: “No, I’m still a bit short of the potion formula’s price.”
unit.target: “Non, adhuc paulo deest pretium formulae potionis.”

unit.source: Most of his current “savings” came from Lumian, amounting to around 15,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Plerumque pecuniae “savings” eius ex Lumiano orta erant, circiter 15,000 verl d’or pendentes.

unit.source: Based on his knowledge, a Sequence 7 potion formula usually cost between 16,000 to 20,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Ex scientia eius, formula potionis Sequentiae VII usitate inter 16,000 et 20,000 verl d’or constabat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded pensively.
unit.target: Lumian pensiter annuit.

unit.source: “I’ll keep an eye out for the Harvest Priest potion formula and the necessary ingredients for you.
unit.target: “Tibi formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis et ingredienta necessaria observabo.

unit.source: If you’re short on funds, I’ll help cover the difference.
unit.target: Si pecunia deficit, differentiam subveniam tibi.

unit.source: Consider it a share of the spoils from this adventure.”
unit.target: Existima id partem praedae huius incepti.

unit.source: Lugano was stunned momentarily before tears welled up in his eyes, blurring his vision.
unit.target: Lugano per momentum attonitus fuit, et postea lacrimae in oculis eius eruperunt, visionem confundentes.

unit.source: I made the right choice!
unit.target: Rectam electionem feci!

unit.source: My future truly lies with the boss!
unit.target: Futurum meum vere cum patrono meo iacet!

unit.source: With a hint of unease, he asked, “But that was a dream adventure.
unit.target: Cum levissima inquietudine, rogavit: “Sed illa erat adventura somniorum.

unit.source: Can the gains be brought back to the real world?”
unit.target: Num haec beneficia ad rem veram revocari possint?”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t elaborate.
unit.target: Lumian non ampliavit.

unit.source: He retrieved Hisoka’s golden mask from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Larvam auream Hisokae ex sacco viatoris sustulit.

unit.source: It’s possible… Some special items are possible?
unit.target: Fieri potest… Quaedam res speciales fieri possunt?

unit.source: Lugano felt a sense of relief.
unit.target: Lugano solacium sensit.

unit.source: Lumian turned to Ludwig, who seemed to have acquired a cherished toy, and nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian ad Ludovicum convertebat, qui ludum carum adeptus videbatur, et leviter annuit.

unit.source: “You may go back to sleep.”
unit.target: “Redi ad somnum.”

unit.source: Ludwig, wearing a blue nightcap, blinked and reached out to touch his stomach.
unit.target: Ludovicus, galeam nocturnam caeruleam indutus, palpebravit atque manum extendit ad ventrem suum tangendum.

unit.source: Groan.
unit.target: Gemitus.

unit.source: Groan.
unit.target: Gemitus.

unit.source: His stomach churned violently.
unit.target: Venter eius vehementer agitabatur.

unit.source: Lumian laughed self-deprecatingly and took out the portion of food Ludwig had eaten in the dream, including almond pistachio cream cake, liquor‐infused chocolate, éclairs, and more.
unit.target: Lumian se ipsius contemnens risit et portionem cibi, quam Ludovicus in somnio consumpsit, extraxit—inter quae erant placenta cum crema amygdalina et pistachio, socolata liquoribus infusa, éclairs et cetera.

unit.source: After Ludwig began his “quiet” meal, Lumian returned to his room and conjured a blazing white fireball.
unit.target: Postquam Ludovicus suum “quietum” convivium inceperat, Lumian ad conclave suum rediit et globum ignis albi ardentis conjuravit.

unit.source: He unfolded the letter, picked up a fountain pen, and penned a letter to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Epistulam explicavit, calamus arripuit, et ad Dominam Magicianam scripsit.

unit.source: This took precedence over dealing with other matters.
unit.target: Hoc praecipuum fuit super aliis rebus agendis.

unit.source: As he wrote, Lumian pondered something.
unit.target: Dum scribebat, Lumian aliquid meditabatur.

unit.source: If I killed all the elders of the gravekeepers, would the primitive tribe still possess the ability to attack and eliminate the dead?
unit.target: Si omnes seniores custodum sepulchri interfecerim, num tribus primitiva adhuc poterit mortuos oppugnare et extinguere?

unit.source: Or are they still alive in the real world, waiting to drag those already dead down with them when they attack Tizamo?
unit.target: An in mundo vero adhuc vivunt, exspectantes ut mortuos, qui iam sunt, trahant cum Tizamo oppugnatione?

unit.source: Or would the deceased find another way out, like the fire that had engulfed the Twanaku family?
unit.target: Aut defuncti aliam exitum invenirent, sicut ignis qui familiam Twanaku consumpsit?

unit.source: On the third floor of the police headquarters in Tizamo Town.
unit.target: In plano tertio praetorii vigilum in oppido Tizamo.

unit.source: Camus snapped out of his reverie and instinctively glanced at the temporary bed opposite him.
unit.target: Camus ex meditatione evexit et instinctive ad lectum temporarium oppositum oculos intulit.

unit.source: He noticed the blanket had been lifted, and Kolobo was nowhere to be found.
unit.target: Animadvertit stragulum sublatum esse, et Kolobo nusquam inveniri.

unit.source: Am I still dreaming, still in the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Num adhuc somnio, num in Festival Somniorum versor?

unit.source: Camus sat up cautiously and heard a sound near the door in the corner.
unit.target: Camus caute surrexit et sonum iuxta ostium in angulo audivit.

unit.source: In the darkness, under the crimson moonlight seeping through the curtains, he saw Kolobo crouched there, curled up and trembling.
unit.target: In tenebris, sub rubro lumine lunari per cortinas effuso, vidit Kolobo ibi se congregare, contrahitum et tremulum.

unit.source: Camus lowered his voice and gently asked, “What’s wrong?”
unit.target: Camus vocem demisit et leniter rogavit: “Quid accidit?”

unit.source: Kolobo’s voice quivered as he replied, “The sky is falling! The sky is falling!”
unit.target: Voce tremula, Kolobo respondit: “Caelum cadit! Caelum cadit!”

unit.source: The sky is falling?
unit.target: Caelum cadit?

unit.source: Camus found it amusing and looked at Kolobo.
unit.target: Camus id ridiculum putavit et ad Kolobo aspexit.

unit.source: “Did you misinterpret your premonition?”
unit.target: “Praemonitionem tuam male interpretatus es?”

unit.source: How could the sky possibly fall?
unit.target: Quomodo potest caelum cadere?

unit.source: Outside Tizamo, at the edge of the primitive forest.
unit.target: Extra Tizamo, in margine silvae primitivae.

unit.source: Maslow, his face adorned with white paint, slowly advanced into the forest.
unit.target: Maslow, cuius facies albo pigmento ornata erat, lente in silvam procedit.

unit.source: It was a terrible feeling to know about his impending yet unavoidable death.
unit.target: Horrendum erat scire de morte imminente et inevitabili sua.

unit.source: He regretted betraying the Numinous Episcopate, but there had been no choice.
unit.target: De proditione Episcopatus Numinosi paenitebat, sed alia via non erat.

unit.source: Shortly after arriving in Tizamo, he had been secretly controlled by Twanaku, who had returned for a “vacation.”
unit.target: Mox post adventum in Tizamo, secretim a Twanaku imperatus erat, qui ad “vacationem” redierat.

unit.source: He had become a fallen one monitoring the situation of Padre Cali and Tizamo.
unit.target: Factus est lapsus, qui statum Patris Cali et Tizamo vigilabat.

unit.source: Subsequently, although he knew Twanaku had been killed, the other party’s dream projection appeared in his dream, telling him the matter wasn’t over.
unit.target: Subsequentia, quamquam sciebat Twanaku interfectum esse, proiection somniorum alterius partis in somnio ei apparuit, dicens rem nondum finitam esse.

unit.source: Maslow advanced step by step, yearning to return to the forest and become nourishment for a tree, just like his ancestors.
unit.target: Maslow gradatim processit, desiderans in silvam redire atque arbori nutrimentum esse, sicut maiores eius.

unit.source: As he walked, he spotted nearly 20 people emerging from the nearby barracks.
unit.target: Dum ambulabat, vidit fere viginti homines ex castris proximis emergentes.

unit.source: The men seemed to sense something amiss and prepared to inspect their surroundings.
unit.target: Homines videbantur aliquid iniurium sentire et ad circumiecta perscrutanda parati erant.

unit.source: At that moment, Maslow felt the night suddenly brighten.
unit.target: In illo momento, Maslow sentit noctem subitam fulgere.

unit.source: Subconsciously, he looked up at the sky and saw a burning boulder descending with a crimson flame tail.
unit.target: Subconscie, oculos in caelum levavit et vidit lapidem ardentem descendere cum cauda flammae rubrae.

unit.source: In an instant, the burning boulder filled Maslow’s vision.
unit.target: In momento, lapis ardens totam visionem Maslow obsedit.

unit.source: It crashed into the area between the forest’s edge and the barracks.
unit.target: Percussit aream inter limitem silvae et castra.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: The wind and dust stirred by the meteorite swiftly filled the area, rising into the air and dissipating, obscuring the crimson moon and the starlight.
unit.target: Ventus et pulvis, a meteoro excitati, celeriter aream compleverunt, sursum in aethera ascendentes et evanidi, lunam rubram et lucem stellarum obfuscantes.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: The entirety of Tizamo seemed to experience a violent earthquake.
unit.target: Totum Tizamo videtur violentum terrae motum passum esse.

unit.source: Buildings shook violently, and glass shattered.
unit.target: Aedificia vehementer concutebantur, et vitrum confractum est.

unit.source: Several houses with weak foundations quickly collapsed, burying their occupants.
unit.target: Nonnullae domus cum fundamentis debilibus celeriter corruerunt, suis incolis intermergentes.

unit.source: With great difficulty, Camus regained his balance.
unit.target: Magno labore, Camus balanciam suam restituit.

unit.source: Once the building stabilized, he rushed to the shattered window and looked out.
unit.target: Postquam aedificium stabilitum est, festinavit ad fenestram fractam et extrinsecus conspexit.

unit.source: He saw the “sky” was gray and murky, so close he could touch it if he jumped up.
unit.target: Vidit caelum esse cinereum et turbido, tam prope ut tangere posset, si saliret.

unit.source: The “sky” has really fallen…
unit.target: Caelum vere cecidit…

unit.source: For some inexplicable reason, this thought flashed through Camus’s mind.
unit.target: Ob causam inexplicabilem, haec cogitatio per mentem Camus fulsit.

unit.source: In the second-floor suite of the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: In conclavi secundo Brieu Motel.

unit.source: Clutching the letter and fountain pen, Lumian watched the smoke and dust outside with amusement, sensing the “heavy blow” not far away.
unit.target: Epistulam et calam tenens, Lumian extra fume et pulverem oblectabatur, sentiens ictum grave non longe venturum esse.

unit.source: “How direct…” he sighed sincerely.
unit.target: “Quam directe…” suspiravit sincere.

unit.source: A meteorite had descended from the sky!
unit.target: Meteorus de caelo descenderat!

unit.source: From the looks of it, the catastrophe had likely eliminated most of the deceased.
unit.target: Ex imagine, catastropha verisimiliter plerosque defunctos deleverat.

unit.source: Lumian turned to look at the door, which had swung open due to the building’s shaking, and saw Ludwig still focused on eating.
unit.target: Lumian ad ostium conversus est, quod motu aedificii aperitum erat, et vidit Ludovicum adhuc cibum edere incumbens.

unit.source: Nothing from the pile of food had fallen to the ground.
unit.target: Nihil e acervi cibi ad terram cecidit.

unit.source: After sending Lugano out to assist the injured, Lumian returned to his room and continued writing.
unit.target: Postquam Lugano ad vulneratos adiuvandos mittebat, Lumian ad conclave suum rediit et scribere perrexit.

unit.source: Upon completion, he immediately set up a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Post completionem, statim ritum instituit et nuntium “pupae” convocavit.

unit.source: Just as the “doll” messenger emerged from the expanding candle flame, it suddenly shrank.
unit.target: Ita, cum nuntius “pupae” e flamma candelae dilatante emergeret, subito contraxit.

unit.source: Slowly, she glanced to her left and then to her right.
unit.target: Lente, ad sinistram spectavit, deinde ad dexteram.

unit.source: After confirming there was no problem, she tiptoed and cautiously approached Lumian’s letter.
unit.target: Postquam confirmavit nullum esse impedimentum, super digitos ambulavit et, caute, ad epistulam Lumiani accessit.

unit.source: Lumian had never seen the “doll” messenger act like this before.
unit.target: Lumian numquam antea nuntium “pupae” talem se habere vidit.

unit.source: He watched in confusion and amusement as she picked up the folded letter like a thief.
unit.target: Contemplatus est, confundens atque delectatus, dum illa epistulam involutam quasi fur evassit.

unit.source: She waved at him and quickly retreated into the candle flame.
unit.target: Illa ei salutavit et celeriter in flammam candelae rediit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and shook his head, no longer pondering the “doll” messenger’s actions.
unit.target: Lumian risit et caput concussit, nec amplius de actis nuntii “pupae” meditabatur.

unit.source: At the very least, it seemed harmless, and he had several things to do.
unit.target: Saltem, videbatur id esse innocuum, atque multa habebat agenda.

unit.source: Lumian left the bedroom, entered the corridor, and went to the first floor.
unit.target: Lumian conclave reliquit, in corridorum ingressus est et ad primum planum processit.

unit.source: He grabbed the motel owner, who had come out to check on the situation after waking up, and asked, “Which room are the lady and her companion who arrived tonight staying in?”
unit.target: Lumian dominum motel, qui post excitandum ad rem perscrutandam exiit, apprehendit et rogavit: “In qua cella manent domina et comitissa eius, quae hac nocte advenerunt?”

unit.source: Chapter 696: Feathers
unit.target: Capitulum 696: Pennæ

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretationem paravit: CKtalon

unit.source: In Twanaku’s house in Tizamo Town, Amandina woke up amidst the violent shaking of the building.
unit.target: In domo Twanaku in oppido Tizamo, Amandina inter violenta aedificii tremores evigilavit.

unit.source: She stood up groggily and looked out the window.
unit.target: Illa torpida surrexit et per fenestram aspexit.

unit.source: The sky had turned gray and was pressing down, completely obscuring the crimson moon and stars.
unit.target: Caelum griseum factum erat et premebat, prorsus lunam coccineam et stellas obscurans.

unit.source: In the near-absolute darkness, Amandina turned and cast her gaze not far away.
unit.target: In tenebris paene absolutis, Amandina se vertit et oculos in proximo loco fixes habuit.

unit.source: Dressed neatly, Robert rose slowly, his sluggish movements suggesting he was struggling to adapt to the lightless environment.
unit.target: Indutus eleganter, Robert lente surrexit, et motus eius tardissimi indicabant eum in ambitu sine lumine aptare luctari.

unit.source: When the tremors in the ground and buildings finally ceased, Robert used his Spirit Vision to spot Amandina.
unit.target: Cum tremores in terra et aedificiis tandem cessaverunt, Robert visionem spiritualem ad Amandinam deprehendendam usus est.

unit.source: After a moment’s hesitation, he asked, “Are we awake?”
unit.target: Post momentum dubitationis, rogavit: “Evigilavimusne?”

unit.source: He recalled that before entering the Dream Festival, he and Amandina had used a date as an excuse to rendezvous.
unit.target: Recordatus est quod ante Festival Somniorum intrandum, ille et Amandina diem praetextum habuerant ad conveniendum.

unit.source: When they ended up in the special dream, they temporarily parted ways—one stayed put while the other went to Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: Cum in somnio speciali versarentur, ad tempus se divisere: unus mansit, dum alter ad Cathédralem Sancti-Sien processit.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: Glancing at the suddenly noisy street outside, Amandina thought for a few seconds before replying, “Probably… but I don’t know what’s going on.”
unit.target: Spectans viam extra subito strepitosam, Amandina paucis momentis meditata respondit: “Fortasse... sed nescio quid agatur.”

unit.source: As Robert recalled the dream encounters, both fell silent.
unit.target: Dum Robert congressus somniorum recordabatur, ambo silentium ceperunt.

unit.source: Eventually, he asked in a deep voice, “What happened to you in the end?”
unit.target: Denique, voce profunda rogavit: “Quid tibi tandem evenit?”

unit.source: Amandina suddenly chuckled.
unit.target: Amandina subito levis risum effecit.

unit.source: “Nothing much.”
unit.target: «Nihil nimis.»

unit.source: Robert closed his mouth again.
unit.target: Robert iterum os clausit.

unit.source: With her night vision, Amandina looked at him, smiling with mixed emotions.
unit.target: Per visionem nocturnam, Amandina eum intuebatur, subridente et affectibus mixtis.

unit.source: “Is there anything else you want to ask?”
unit.target: «Numquid aliud rogare vis?»

unit.source: After a long pause, Robert said, “What did you experience afterward?”
unit.target: Post longam mora, Robert dixit: “Quid postea tibi evenit?”

unit.source: Taking in the silence of the house, Amandina finally whispered, “1 saw the one who granted me powers.”
unit.target: In silentio domus, Amandina denique susurravit: “Ego vidi illum qui mihi potentias dedit.”

unit.source: “The one who granted you powers?” Robert asked, surprised.
unit.target: «Illum qui tibi potentias dedit?» rogavit Robert, miratus.

unit.source: Amandina laughed.
unit.target: Amandina risit.

unit.source: “We didn’t actually fall asleep after touching the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: «Non revera obdormivimus postquam sepulcrum antiquum nigrum tetigimus,

unit.source: We only truly fainted after receiving the powers.”
unit.target: verum solum exanimavimus postquam potentias accepimus.»

unit.source: “How is that possible…” Robert looked incredulous.
unit.target: «Quomodo id fieri potest...» inquit Robert, incredulus.

unit.source: Amandina didn’t try to convince him.
unit.target: Amandina eum persuadere non conata est.

unit.source: Instead, she muttered, “Upon acquiring superpowers, one immediately falls into a coma or slumber.
unit.target: At potius, illa submurmuravit: “Superpotentias adeptus, statim in torpor aut soporem inciditur,

unit.source: When they wake up, they completely grasp that power.
unit.target: cum evigilabunt, illam potentiam omnino percipient.

unit.source: Their spirit and flesh undergo a certain transformation…”
unit.target: Spiritus eorum atque caro mutationem aliquam subeunt…

unit.source: “Is this considered a low-level death before rebirth?”
unit.target: «Num hoc mortem gradus inferioris ante renascentiam existimatur?»

unit.source: “What are you talking about?” Robert’s confusion grew.
unit.target: «Quid dicis?» inquit Robert, confusio eius crescens.

unit.source: It was completely incomprehensible!
unit.target: Erat prorsus incomprehensibile!

unit.source: Amandina’s eyes darted around as she smiled.
unit.target: Oculi Amandinae circum volitaverunt, dum illa subridebat.

unit.source: “That person told me.
unit.target: «Ille mihi dixerat.

unit.source: Perhaps it’s a form of guidance.”
unit.target: Fortasse est forma admonitionis.»

unit.source: “Guidance…”
unit.target: «Admonitio…»

unit.source: Using his Spirit Vision, the only way to ascertain her condition in the darkness, Robert gazed at Amandina.
unit.target: Usus visionem spiritualem, qua sola in tenebris eius condicio cognoscere poterat, Robert in Amandinam aspexit.

unit.source: He felt his fiancee was different, as if she had grown up overnight.
unit.target: Sensit sponsam suam esse diversa, quasi illa per unam noctem adultior fieret.

unit.source: Amandina wanted to recount the encounter in detail as usual, but swallowed her words.
unit.target: Amandina conventum minutatim narrare cuperat, sed verba sua retinuit.

unit.source: Sighing, she said, “Aren’t you going to check on Padre Cali?
unit.target: Suspirans, illa dixit: “Nonne vis inspicere de Padre Cali?

unit.source: He might not have long to live.”
unit.target: Fortasse non diu vixerit.”

unit.source: Snapping out of his reverie, Robert blurted out, “He fled to the ancient tomb and was killed?”
unit.target: Ex meditatione evasit, Robert exclamavit: “Fugit ad sepulcrum antiquum et interfectus est?”

unit.source: “He’s indeed dead,” Amandina confirmed.
unit.target: «Vere mortuus est,» Amandina confirmavit.

unit.source: Robert’s expression shifted, but he didn’t inquire about the murderer’s identity.
unit.target: Vultus Roberti mutatus est, sed de identitate caedis interrogare non audivit.

unit.source: After a moment’s thought, Amandina said, “Before you go to Padre Cali, I need to tell you something.
unit.target: Post aliquod momentum cogitandi, Amandina dixit: “Antequam ad Padre Cali perres, tibi aliquid dicendum habeo.

unit.source: “The desire you felt when you first faced him didn’t come from your heart.
unit.target: «Desiderium, quod primo eum occurrens sensit, non ex corde tuo orta est;

unit.source: He prayed to a Demon through a ritual and obtained the power to influence you.”
unit.target: oravit ad Daemonem per ritum et potestatem te influendi adeptus est.»

unit.source: Robert’s eyes widened, his mouth gaped, but no sound came out.
unit.target: Oculi Roberti dilatati sunt, osque eius aperitum erat, sed nihil sonitum edidit.

unit.source: Without further ado, Amandina strode past him towards the staircase.
unit.target: Sine mora, Amandina praeter eum ad scalas processit.

unit.source: Pressing down on the railing, she paused and tersely acknowledged, “Let’s find an excuse to annul the engagement.
unit.target: Railing prementi, subsedit et breviter agnovit: “Inveniamus praetextum ut sponsalitatem dissolvamus;

unit.source: I can accept other things about you, but 1 can’t accept how my fiance allowed me to follow Louis Berry alone to find the black ancient tomb under those circumstances.
unit.target: alia de te accipere possum, sed non ferre possum quomodo sponsus meus mihi permisit solam sequi Louis Berry ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum sub talibus condicionibus.”

unit.source: “Don’t worry, 1 won’t tell anyone about your matters.
unit.target: «Noli timere, nihil de rebus tuis narrabo;

unit.source: Those who knew in my dream won’t tell either.”
unit.target: qui in somnio meo noverunt, neque ipsi narrabunt.»

unit.source: Robert spun around, his gaze fixed on the staircase as Amandina descended step by step, the darkness engulfing her spirituality’s light.
unit.target: Robert circumversus est, oculos in scalas fixos habens, dum Amandina gradatim descendebat, tenebrae lumen spirituale eius opprimebant.

unit.source: Leaving Twanaku’s house, Amandina stepped onto the street.
unit.target: Ex domo Twanaku discedens, Amandina in viam processit.

unit.source: She glanced at the dark, low sky, the sporadic lights on both sides, and caught a whiff of the dusty air.
unit.target: Illa aspiciebat caelum obscurum et humile, lumina sporadica utrinque, et odor pulveris aëris percipiebatur.

unit.source: With her hand covering her nose, Amandina made her way towards the manor, her steps gradually quickening.
unit.target: Manu nasum obtegente, Amandina ad villa processit, gressibus paulatim acceleratis.

unit.source: On the third floor of the police headquarters in Tizamo Town, just as Camus felt Kolobo’s trembling subside, as if he had composed himself, painful curses echoed from the next room.
unit.target: In tertio tabulato praefectorii vigilum in oppido Tizamo, simulquam Camus tremorem Kolobo quietari sensit, acerba maledicta ex proximo conclavi resonaverunt.

unit.source: His heart stirred as he lit a candle and pushed open the slightly deformed wooden door.
unit.target: Cor eius excitatum est dum candelam accendit et ostium ligneum leviter deformatum aperuit.

unit.source: Inside, he saw the Feysacian, Loban, lying on the ground, clutching his knee and screaming in agony.
unit.target: Intus vidit Feysacianum Loban, qui in terra iacebat, genu strinxens et dolore clamorans.

unit.source: The member of the Tizamo patrol team had woken from the earthquake-like commotion and tried to get out of bed to find cover, but one leg strangely lost strength, accompanied by intense pain, causing him to collapse.
unit.target: Membrum turmae vigilum Tizamo ex motu quasi terraemotu evigilavit et conatus est ex lecto surgere ad tutelam quaerendam, sed unus crus mirabiliter robur amisit, cum dolore intenso comitante, qui eum ad casum impulit.

unit.source: Before Camus could organize his thoughts, Rhea’s voice echoed beside him.
unit.target: Antequam Camus cogitationes suas componere poterat, vox Rhea iuxta eum resonavit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry.
unit.target: «Noli timere.

unit.source: It’s the mass hysteria mentioned in the investigations.
unit.target: Est perturbatio massiva, quam in inquisitionibus commemoratur.

unit.source: You’ll recover after going to the corresponding Mass.”
unit.target: Postquam ad Massam pervenies, convalesces.»

unit.source: Having cooperated with Camus to investigate the abnormalities in Tizamo, Loban quickly understood Rhea.
unit.target: Cum Camus ad in Tizamo anomalias investigandas cooperaret, Loban celeriter Rhea intellexit.

unit.source: Cursing, he struggled to his feet, retrieved a military flask from under his pillow, and downed a few gulps of liquor.
unit.target: Maledicens, ad pedes conatus est et ex sub pulvillo suo ampullam militarem repetivit, deinde aliquot sorbos liquoris deglutivit.

unit.source: After drinking until color returned to his face, Loban sighed with relief.
unit.target: Postquam bibit, et vultus eius color restitutus est, Loban leviter suspiravit in solatio.

unit.source: “I feel my knee has recovered a little.
unit.target: «Sento genu meum paulo reparatum esse.

unit.source: Sometimes, alcohol is more useful than Mass!”
unit.target: Aliquando, liquor utilior est quam Missa!»

unit.source: Breathing a sigh of relief, Camus turned to Rhea, realizing his teammate’s expression had turned colder.
unit.target: Suspirans leviter, Camus ad Rhea se convertit, animadvertens vultum socii sui frigidiorem factum esse.

unit.source: After what just happened, her dream projection has completely vanished.
unit.target: Post ea quae nuper acciderunt, imago somniorum eius prorsus evanuit.

unit.source: Have the emotions and desires returned to her body?
unit.target: An affectus et desideria ad corpus eius redierunt?

unit.source: Will the special dreamscape still exist, and will there be a Dream Festival next year?
unit.target: Num locus specialis somniorum adhuc exsistet, et eritne Festival Somniorum anno proximo?

unit.source: Camus instantly made many connections.
unit.target: Camus statim multas coniunctiones fecit.

unit.source: At that moment, Rhea said to him, “Let’s go out and see if we can save some people.
unit.target: Illo momento, Rhea ei dixit: “Eamus extra et videamus num aliquos servare possimus.

unit.source: Those who died during the Dream Festival shouldn’t be the only ones injured.”
unit.target: Qui in Festival Somniorum mortui sunt, non solum laesi esse debent.”

unit.source: Taken aback, Camus replied, “Okay.”
unit.target: Attonitus, Camus respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Joy welled up in his heart, sensing Rhea hadn’t undergone any fundamental changes due to the return of her emotions and desires.
unit.target: Gaudium in corde eius oriebatur, sentiens Rhea nullas mutationes fundamentales passa esse ex affectuum et desideriorum reditu.

unit.source: Following the Brieu Motel owner’s instructions, Lumian arrived on the fourth floor and opened the corresponding room’s wooden door.
unit.target: Sectus praeceptis domini Brieu Motel, Lumian in quarto tabulato pervenit et ostium ligneum camerae correspondentis aperuit.

unit.source: The near pitch-black darkness receded under a blazing white fireball’s illumination, revealing everything to Lumian.
unit.target: Tenebrae paene absolutae recedebant sub lume globuli ignis candidi fulgenti, omnia Lumiano patefaciens.

unit.source: Some items had fallen due to the tremors, tables and chairs had shifted, and a small amount of dust had sprinkled from the ceiling.
unit.target: Nonnulla obiecta propter tremores ceciderant, mensae et cathedrae commotae erant, et parva quantitas pulveris ex laqueari sparsa erat.

unit.source: The window was tightly shut, but the glass had shattered.
unit.target: Fenestra arcte clausa erat, sed vitrum confractum erat.

unit.source: Apart from this, there was nothing noteworthy, and no sign of humans.
unit.target: Praeter hoc, nihil notabile erat, nec ulla vestigia hominum.

unit.source: Scanning the area, Lumian found no trace of the man or woman.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, Lumian nullum vestigium viri vel feminae invenit.

unit.source: Frowning, he muttered to himself, According to the original Dream Festival’s rules, death in a dream doesn’t equate to immediate death.
unit.target: Fringens, sibi ipsi murmurat: “Secundum regulas originalis Festival Somniorum, mors in somnio non aequatur morte immediata.”

unit.source: Did they leave Tizamo after waking up?
unit.target: Discesseruntne ex Tizamo postquam evigilaverunt?

unit.source: 1 planned to take care of their corpses and inherit their Beyonder characteristics…
unit.target: Ego consilium ceperam ut cadavera eorum curarem et notiones Beyonder eorum hereditarem…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t believe the man and woman couldn’t leave just because the door and window were tightly shut.
unit.target: Lumian non credidit virum et feminam discedere posse solum quod ianua et fenestra arcte clausae essent.

unit.source: After all, they were two Mid-Sequence Beyonders, and one was even a Devil.
unit.target: Nam erant duo Mid-Sequence Beyonders, et unus etiam Diabolus.

unit.source: Perhaps they had special abilities to resolve that problem.
unit.target: Fortasse speciales potentias ad illud problema solvendum haberent.

unit.source: As Lumian contemplated searching for traces and chasing after them to eliminate the deceased on behalf of the Dream Festival, he casually examined the room’s various details.
unit.target: Dum Lumian cogitabat vestigia quaerere et eos insequi, ut pro Festival Somniorum decessos tolleret, leviter singula conclavi pervestigavit.

unit.source: Suddenly, his pupils dilated, and his eyes froze.
unit.target: Subito, pupillae eius dilatatae sunt, et oculi eius immobiliter fixi sunt.

unit.source: He saw a feather lying quietly under the recliner by the window—a white feather stained with light‐yellow oil!
unit.target: Vidit pennam quiete iacentem sub solio iuxta fenestram—pennam albam, oleo leviter flavido tinctam!

unit.source: Lumian’s scalp tingled as he silently took two steps back into the corridor.
unit.target: Caput Lumiani formicatione pervassum sensit, dum silentiose duos gradus in corridorium recedebat.

unit.source: Like Reaza, were the man and woman already dead and had undergone an abnormality?
unit.target: Sicut Reaza, an vir et femina iam mortui essent et mutationem aliquam abnormem passi essent?

unit.source: What about their corpses?
unit.target: Quid de cadaveribus eorum?

unit.source: Disappeared?
unit.target: Evanuerunt?

unit.source: Would humans who had ascended to godhood exhibit different behaviors after leaving the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Num homines, qui ad deitatem ascendesserunt, diversa mores post Festival Somniorum ostenderent?

unit.source: With a blazing white fireball floating behind him, Lumian scrutinized the room, filled with questions.
unit.target: Globulo ignis candidi fulgenti post eum volitante, Lumian conclave percontatus est, plurimis quaestionibus imbutus.

unit.source: Perhaps the man and woman’s “corpses” were still here, but he couldn’t see them.
unit.target: Fortasse cadavera viri et feminae hic adhuc mansere, sed ea videre non potuit.

unit.source: Cautiously entering, he approached the recliner, sensing nothing unusual and discovering no signs of the formless object.
unit.target: Cautius intravit atque ad lectum reclinabilem accessit, nihil insolitum sentiens neque signa rei informis reperiens.

unit.source: Lumian retrieved the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth from his Traveler’s Bag, donning them one by one.
unit.target: Lumian specula Mysterii et Oculum Veritatis ex sacco viatoris extraxit, ea singillatim induens.

unit.source: He still couldn’t see the man and woman.
unit.target: Adhuc virum et feminam videre non potuit.

unit.source: His vision was filled with chaotic darkness, a dark river, oily feathers, and imprisoning darkness.
unit.target: Visio eius repleta erat tenebris caoticis, flumine obscuro, pennis oleosis, et tenebris captivantis.

unit.source: Upon returning to reality, did they immediately undergo immortal ascension and leave this place?
unit.target: Redierunt ad realitatem, an statim immortales ascenderunt et hunc locum reliquerunt?

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds before activating the black mark on his right shoulder, teleporting to a spot in the forest at the special dream’s periphery.
unit.target: Lumian paucis secundis meditatus est, deinde notam nigram in umero dextro suo activavit et se ad locum in silva, in extremitate somnii specialis, teleportavit.

unit.source: As a Hunter, Lumian had memorized the correct route and environmental characteristics after Amandina led him to the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Ut Venator, Lumian iter rectum et condiciones ambientis notas postquam Amandina eum ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum duxit, meminisse poterat.

unit.source: After nearly fifteen minutes, he arrived at an area where numerous tree roots protruded from the ground, resembling blood vessels.
unit.target: Post fere quindecim minuta, ad locum pervenit ubi multae radices arborum ex terra eminere videbantur, sanguineis vasculis similes.

unit.source: However, the place where the black stone-like ancient tomb should have stood was empty.
unit.target: At locus, ubi sepulcrum antiquum quasi lapideo nigrum steterit, vacuum erat.

unit.source: Does that black ancient tomb only exist in dreams and can’t be encountered in reality?
unit.target: Num illud sepulcrum antiquum nigrum tantum in somnis existat et in re inveniri non possit?

unit.source: Lumian speculated seriously.
unit.target: Lumian serio speculatus est.

unit.source: So the Pale Empress and the other Angels can’t descend personally and can only send people to participate in the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Ergo Imperatrix Pallida et ceteri Angeli personaliter descendere non possunt; solum homines mittere ad Festival Somniorum possunt?

unit.source: As his thoughts raced, Lumian’s gaze darted back and forth across the land corresponding to the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes eius festinabant, oculi Lumiani per terram, quae ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pertinebat, circum volitabant.

unit.source: It was indeed a little different from its surroundings—no intertwined tree roots protruded from the ground, and it was flat and stoneless.
unit.target: Revera paulo a circumstantibus differebat—radices arborum implicatae non protuberabant, et solum planum atque sine lapidibus erat.

unit.source: Approaching thoughtfully, Lumian took out his straight sword and used it as a shovel, attempting to dig into the soil.
unit.target: Accedens mente meditans, Lumian gladium rectum extraxit et ut scapus usus est, terram fodire conans.

unit.source: Just as he dug a small pit, his eyelids twitched.
unit.target: Modo ut parvam foveam fodisset, palpebra eius concussae sunt.

unit.source: Buried in the dark brown soil were two white feathers stained with light‑yellow oil!
unit.target: In terra fusca obscura erant duo pennæ albae, oleo leviter flavido tinctae!

unit.source: Taking a slow breath, Lumian dug deeper.
unit.target: Leniter spiritum accipiens, Lumian terram profundius fodit.

unit.source: Before long, a palm‑sized, dark, slightly moist, and sticky soil lump came into view..
unit.target: Mox in conspectu apparuit glomerulus terrae, magnitudine palmae, obscurus, paulo humidus et adhaerens.

unit.source: 697 Madam Magician’s Explanation
unit.target: 697 Explicatio Dominae Magicae

unit.source: As Lumian gazed at the peculiar soil, he couldn’t help but recall the scene of Hela retrieving the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
unit.target: Dum Lumian solum insolitum contemplabatur, recordari non potuit scaenam Helae, quae fontem Samaritarum Feminarum recuperabat.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, he retrieved gold bars and coins from his Traveler’s Bag and ignited a blazing white fireball in his palm.
unit.target: Post aliquod momentum meditationis, ex sacco viatoris auratae laminae et nummos extraxit et in palma sua globum ignis candidi flagrans accendit.

unit.source: As the flames surged, the gold gradually melted under the control of his spirituality, forming a small golden box.
unit.target: Dum flammas impetu crescere videbantur, aurum paulatim sub imperio eius spiritualis liquefactum est, constituitque parvam arcam auream.

unit.source: Lumian then used the flames as a blade to fashion a cover for the box.
unit.target: Tum Lumian flammas quasi lamina ad tegmen arcae conficiendum adhibuit.

unit.source: Once the gold had cooled and solidified, he used the straight sword as a shovel to transfer the palm‑sized clump of soil into the box before closing the lid.
unit.target: Cum aurum refrigeratum atque solidatum esset, gladium rectum uti trulla ad transferendum agglomeratum soli, cuius magnitudo palmae similis erat, in arcam usus est antequam operculum clauderet.

unit.source: After stowing away the golden box, Lumian noticed that the straight sword in his hand had become rusty and decayed.
unit.target: Arcam auream recondito, Lumian animadvertit gladium rectum in manu eius oxidatum atque corrumpi.

unit.source: Rather than being alarmed, Lumian was delighted. He muttered to himself, “That soil is indeed magical…”
unit.target: Pro timore, Lumian potius laetatus est. Ipse sibi submurmuravit: “Iste solum vere magicum est…”

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: This was one of his gains from the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Hoc erat unum ex lucris eius ex Festival Somniorum.

unit.source: Despite not obtaining the Beyonder characteristics of Reaza and Maslow, and the mysterious disappearance of the man and woman who served the Demon, Lumian had finally acquired something of value.
unit.target: Quamquam proprietates Beyonder Reazae et Maslow non adeptus est, atque disparitio arcana viri et feminae qui Daemoni ministrabant evenisse apparuit, Lumian tandem aliquid pretiosum adeptus erat.

unit.source: He continued searching the area but found no other traces.
unit.target: Continuavit regionem perquirere, sed nullas alias vestigia invenit.

unit.source: Left with no other option, he teleported back to the second floor of the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Nullo alio consilio relicto, se per viam magicam ad secundum tabulatum Brieu Motel revocavit.

unit.source: By then, much of the smoke and dust caused by the meteorite had dissipated.
unit.target: Ad illud tempus, multus fumus et pulvis, qui a meteoro orti erant, evanuerant.

unit.source: The crimson moon’s light cast an eerie glow over Tizamo.
unit.target: Lux lunaris rubrae super Tizamo lumen horribilem effudit.

unit.source: Lumian noticed a folded letter on the master bedroom’s desk, with a thin brass‑like metal sheet on top.
unit.target: Lumian epistulam plicatam in mensa cubiculi principalis animadvertit, cui superpositum erat laminam tenuem, similem aerei.

unit.source: Madam Magician’s response is swift tonight…
unit.target: Responsum Dominae Magicae hac nocte celeriter accidit…

unit.source: Lumian picked up the brass plate and examined the mysterious patterns and words etched upon it, but he couldn’t discern their meaning or purpose.
unit.target: Lumian laminam aereum levavit et arcana figurae verbaque in ea inscripta perspexit, sed significationem aut propositum eorum discerere non potuit.

unit.source: He couldn’t even sense the corresponding spirituality glow.
unit.target: Neque quidem spiritualem effulgentiam corresponentem sensisse potuit.

unit.source: Shaking his head, Lumian temporarily set aside the brass sheet.
unit.target: Caput iactans, Lumian pro tempore laminam aeream deiecit.

unit.source: With a gentle grab of his right hand, he conjured a floating incandescent white fireball.
unit.target: Dextera mansuete apprehensa, globum ignis candidi, fulgenti et leviter volitantem evocavit.

unit.source: Under its glow, he sat down and began reading Madam Magician’s reply.
unit.target: Sub eius lumine sedebat et responsum Dominae Magicae legere inchoavit.

unit.source: “There’s no doubt about it.”
unit.target: “Nullum dubium de ea re est.”

unit.source: “From what you’ve described, the corpse in the dream tomb belongs to Naboredisley.”
unit.target: “Ex his quae narravisti, cadaver in sepulcro somniorum Naboredisley est.”

unit.source: “As for Naboredisley, there’s a high likelihood that it’s an alias of Devil Monarch Farbauti or a real name that can be used under certain circumstances.”
unit.target: “Quoad Naboredisley, magna verisimilitudo est eum esse pseudonymum Monarchae Diaboli Farbauti aut nomen verum, quod sub quibusdam condicionibus adhiberi possit.”

unit.source: “Don’t you find it strange that Naboredisley, as a Devil Monarch and one of the eight ancient gods who once ruled the world, can bestow superpowers from the Prisoner pathway?”
unit.target: “Nonne mirum censes quod Naboredisley, ut Monarcha Diaboli et unus ex octo deis antiquis, qui olim orbem terrarum regebant, vires supernaturales ex via Captivi conferre possit?”

unit.source: “This abnormality is quite normal for the ancient gods.”
unit.target: “Haec anomalia diis antiquis plane naturalis est.”

unit.source: “They didn’t advance according to the paths of the divine, but were born directly for some unknown reason.”
unit.target: “Non in semitis divinis progresērunt, sed directe nati sunt propter aliquam incognitam causam.”

unit.source: “Their characteristics were a mix of Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics from other pathways, or even more than one.”
unit.target: “Eorum lineamenta erant mixtura proprietatum Beyonder ex sequentia prima aliorum semitum, vel etiam plurium.”

unit.source: “Considering Demon Warlock Burman’s situation, you can see how unhinged and violent the ancient gods were.”
unit.target: “Considerata re Daemoni Warlock Burman, videre potes quam insaniti et violenti dii antiqui fuerint.”

unit.source: “There’s a significant difference between ancient gods and subsequent true gods, but this doesn’t mean that They are weak. They might even be stronger.”
unit.target: “Inter deos antiquos et deos veros posteriores discrimen notabilem est, sed hoc non significat eos infirmos esse; fortiores etiam esse possunt.”

unit.source: “Among them, although Farbauti is the Devil Monarch, He blends in Sequence 1 Abomination from a neighboring pathway.”
unit.target: “Inter eos, quamquam Farbauti Monarcha Diaboli est, tamen proprietates Abominationis Sequentionis 1 ex via vicina in se miscit.”

unit.source: “Therefore, His state is one of the best among the eight ancient gods.”
unit.target: “Itaque status eius inter optimos deorum antiquorum numeratur.”

unit.source: “He has also become the only ancient god alive in Their original form.”
unit.target: “Immo, factus est solus deus antiquus, in forma sua originali manens.”

unit.source: “In fact, if Farbauti were to gather the ingredients of the Devil pathway as a Sequence 1 Abomination and complete the deity‑ascension ritual to advance, He would be equivalent to a true god now—a stronger true god.”
unit.target: “Revera, si Farbauti ingredientia viae Diaboli ut Abominationem Sequentionis 1 congregaret et ritum deitatis ascensionis ad progrediendum perficeret, nunc aequivaleret deo vero—deo vero fortiori.”

unit.source: “He wouldn’t be an ancient god described by words like madness, cruelty, violence, and bloodlust.”
unit.target: “Non esset deus antiquus, ut verbis insaniae, crudelitatis, violentiae, et sanguinis cupiditatis describeretur.”

unit.source: “Of course, as the Devil Monarch, even if He had done so, He will inevitably exhibit the characteristics of I am the Abyss, the Abyss is Me, experiencing strong influence from this pathway.”
unit.target: “Certe, ut Monarcha Diaboli, etiamsi id fecisset, necessario ostendet proprietates, quae dicunt: ‘Abyssum sum, et abyssus est ego’, sub vehementi influentia huius viae.”

unit.source: “As for the state of a Devil, you should be well aware.”
unit.target: “Quoad statum Diaboli, id tibi perspicuum esse debet.”

unit.source: “Therefore, Farbauti is also one of the two or three most unhinged ancient gods. This doesn’t contradict His better state.”
unit.target: “Itaque Farbauti est etiam unus ex duobus aut tribus diis antiquis, maxime insanis; hoc autem non adversatur meliore statu eius.”

unit.source: “That’s all for the ancient gods. That’s not my primary purpose in writing.”
unit.target: “Hoc est totum quod ad deos antiquos attinet. Non hoc est propositum principale meum scriptionis.”

unit.source: “In short, the one in the dream tomb is indeed Naboredisley, the other Naboredisley in the form of an Abomination.”
unit.target: “In summa, qui in sepulcro somniorum residet, revera est Naboredisley, alterque Naboredisley in forma Abominationis est.”

unit.source: “Is that so…”
unit.target: “Ita vero…”

unit.source: “Ancient gods possess Beyonder characteristics of neighboring or non‑neighboring pathways, and Naboredisley has already displayed the ability to separate different desires and emotions…”
unit.target: “Dii antiqui possident proprietates Beyonder ex semitis vicinis atque remotis, et Naboredisley iam facultatem demonstravit diversas cupiditates et affectus separandi.”

unit.source: “Lumian no longer harbored any doubts about the cold corpse’s ability to bestow Wraith powers.”
unit.target: “Lumian iam de facultate cadaveris frigidi ad largitionem virium umbratium non dubitabat.”

unit.source: “After some thought, he reread Madam Magician’s letter.”
unit.target: “Post aliquam cogitationem, epistulam Dominae Magicae iterum legit.”

unit.source: “You mentioned that Naboredisley took the initiative to lie back in the dream tomb and continue in a dead state.”
unit.target: “Dixisti Naboredisley initium cepisse, ut in sepulcro somniorum recubaret et in statu mortuo perseveraret.”

unit.source: “This is a very rational choice for Him.”
unit.target: “Hoc est electio prorsus rationalis pro eo.”

unit.source: “Furthermore, I must say it’s a good death.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, fateor mortem bonam esse.”

unit.source: “Continue in this dead state until after the apocalypse!”
unit.target: “Persevera in hoc statu mortuo usque ad post apocalypsim!”

unit.source: “You don’t need to know the exact reason.”
unit.target: “Non opus est tibi causam exactam noscere.”

unit.source: “To put it simply, you can see that Naboredisley, or the Devil Monarch Farbauti, is in a terrible state.”
unit.target: “Dicendum simpliciter, videre potes Naboredisley, vel Monarcham Diaboli Farbauti, in terribili statu esse.”

unit.source: “As an Abomination, His demise is more suitable than Him living.”
unit.target: “Ut Abominatione, mors eius potius quam vita eius idonea est.”

unit.source: “It’s better for both Him and this world.”
unit.target: “Utrumque ei atque huic mundo melius est.”

unit.source: “Of course, this can’t be a simple death.”
unit.target: “Certe, hoc non potest esse mors simplex.”

unit.source: “He chose a good place to die.”
unit.target: “Locum bonum ad mortem eliguit.”

unit.source: “This will allow His corpse to enjoy peace and tranquility, safe from the Mother Tree of Desire’s harassment.”
unit.target: “Hoc sinet cadaver eius pacem ac tranquillitatem frui, ab vexatione Arboris Matris Desiderii immuniter.”

unit.source: “Now, you should understand.”
unit.target: “Nunc debes intellegere.”

unit.source: “That entity had written a story and created a coincidence, allowing you to come into contact with Naboredisley in the Feynapotter Kingdom.”
unit.target: “Ea entitas fabulam scripserat et casum creaverat, ita ut tibi in Regno Feynapotter cum Naboredisley convenire liceat.”

unit.source: “Then, you went to Hanth Island and the New City of Silver.”
unit.target: “Deinde ad Insulam Hanth et Novam Urbem Argenteam ivisti.”

unit.source: “His goal was to send information to Naboredisley in the dream ancient tomb, allowing Him to continue sleeping and be a corpse instead of being resurrected.”
unit.target: “Propositum eius erat nuntium ad Naboredisley in sepulcro antiquo somniorum mittendi, ut ei liceat pergere dormire et cadaver manere potius quam resurgere.”

unit.source: “Simultaneously, this also prevents various factions from trying to obtain the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic.”
unit.target: “Simul, hoc etiam impediat varias factiones proprietatem Beyonder Sequentionis 1 exquirere.”

unit.source: “Tsk, as expected of a remnant from ancient times.”
unit.target: “Tsk, ut ex reliquis antiquitatis exspectabatur.”

unit.source: “He’s the protagonist who personally ended the rule of the ancient gods.”
unit.target: “Ipse est protagonista, qui ipse finem imposuit regni deorum antiquorum.”

unit.source: “The secrets and various key matters He knows perhaps exceed all of us combined.”
unit.target: “Arcana et varia puncta clavis, quae scit, fortasse omnium nostrum numerum superant.”

unit.source: “Apart from Him and the Evernight Goddess, who else would know about mysticism festivals like the Dream Festival, which you forget when you wake up?”
unit.target: “Praeter illum et Deam Sempernocturnam, quis alibi sciret de festivitatibus mysticis, ut Festum Somniorum, quas cum evigilabis oblivisceris?”

unit.source: “Who would have thought that the corpse was part of the Devil Monarch?”
unit.target: “Quis putasset cadaver esse partem Monarchae Diaboli?”

unit.source: “The substantial digestion of the Reaper potion, the acquisition of the golden mask, and the formation of the corroded soil should be the rewards He promised.”
unit.target: “Substantialis digestio potionis Messoris, acquisitio larvæ aureæ, et formatio soli corrosi debent esse praemia quae promisit.”

unit.source: “Remember to give me that corroded soil.”
unit.target: “Memento mihi illud solum corrosum tradere.”

unit.source: “It’s useless to you, but I can help you exchange it for something.”
unit.target: “Tibi inutilis est, sed possum te adiuvare ut illud in aliquid commutas.”

unit.source: “It might also present an opportunity, but I can’t discern what it is for now.”
unit.target: “Fortasse etiam opportunitatem praebere potest, sed nunc quidnam id propositum sit, discerere non possum.”

unit.source: “And with that golden mask, you can boldly venture into the Underworld when the opportunity arises in the future.”
unit.target: “Et cum illa larva aurea, audacter in Inferos progredere potes, cum occasio futura apparuerit.”

unit.source: “Otherwise, the living won’t be able to stay in the Underworld for even a second.”
unit.target: “Alioquin, vivi ne quidem per momentum in Inferos manere poterunt.”

unit.source: “Those golden masks come from the fallen Death, the ancestor of the Eggers family.”
unit.target: “Illae larvæ aureae proveniunt ex morte lapsa, maiori familiae Eggers.”

unit.source: “They were originally created to assist Death’s direct descendants in entering and exiting the Underworld and Death’s kingdom.”
unit.target: “Primitivē creatae sunt ut directi posteri Mortis in ingressu atque egressu Inferorum et regni Mortis adiuvare queant.”

unit.source: “Their purpose is twofold.”
unit.target: “Propositum eorum dupliciter se habet.”

unit.source: “Firstly, to protect the wearer from the corrosion of the aura of death.”
unit.target: “Primum, ut indutorem a corrosione aurae mortis protegat.”

unit.source: “Secondly, to transform the wearer into an undead creature.”
unit.target: “Secundo, ut indutorem in creaturam mortuorum convertat.”

unit.source: “Their bodies no longer have vital points, while their minds and consciousness can maintain their living state.”
unit.target: “Corporibus eorum puncta vitalia iam non sunt, dum mentes atque conscientia statum vivantem retinere possunt.”

unit.source: “Do you understand why Naboredisley’s corpse wore the Death mask?”
unit.target: “Intelligisne cur cadaver Naboredisley larvam Mortis indutus sit?”

unit.source: “If it didn’t, it would have died completely in the dream tomb, with no possibility of revival.”
unit.target: “Si id non fuisset, omnino in sepulcro somniorum mortuus esset, nec ulla spes reviviscendi existeret.”

unit.source: “Similarly, knowing the golden mask’s functions and the state of the corpse, you should understand why Hisoka put on the golden mask.”
unit.target: “Similiter, cum scias munus larvæ aureæ et statum cadaveris, debes intelligere cur Hisoka larvam auream indutus sit.”

unit.source: “It allows a corpse to mistake Hisoka for one of its kind without affecting him.”
unit.target: “Hoc cadaveri sinit ut Hisokam pro suo simile confundat, sine quo illud afficere valeat.”

unit.source: “It also protects Hisoka from the corrosion of the tomb’s aura of death.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, Hisokam ab corrosione aurae Mortis sepulcri protegit.”

unit.source: “The first phantom that experienced an Ascension activated the corpse’s sleeping spirit under the golden mask’s protection, but without awakening His consciousness.”
unit.target: “Primum phantasma, quae ascensionem passa est, sub tutela larvæ aureæ spiritum dormientem cadaveris excitavit, sed non conscientiam eius evigilavit.”

unit.source: “In this state, Hisoka can use his resemblance to the corpse to make the corpse mistake him for its spirit and accept his dominance.”
unit.target: “In hoc statu, Hisoka similitudinem suam ad cadaver referre potest, ut cadaver eum pro spiritu eius existimet atque dominationem accipiat.”

unit.source: “Isn’t this style familiar?”
unit.target: “Nonne hic modus tibi notus est?”

unit.source: “That Celestial Worthy is indeed the strongest god who seeks out errors and exploits loopholes.”
unit.target: “Ille Caelestis Dignus est vere fortissimus deus, qui errores quaerit et ambages perlustrare vult.”

unit.source: “By the time the second phantom that underwent Ascension entered the dream ancient tomb, the corpse’s consciousness would have been basically awakened.”
unit.target: “Cum secundum phantasma, qui ascensionem passa est, in sepulcrum antiquam somniorum intrasset, conscientia cadaveris fere evigilata esset.”

unit.source: “Even if Hisoka were still alive, he wouldn’t be able to complete his grand plan.”
unit.target: “Etiam si Hisoka adhuc vivesse, magnum consilium suum perficere non posset.”

unit.source: “That’s the gist of the matter.”
unit.target: “Hoc est res summatim.”

unit.source: “The Numinous Episcopate’s purpose is the ancient tomb itself, the golden mask that has endured the corresponding corrosion in the tomb for over a millennium.”
unit.target: “Propositum Episcopatus Numinous est ipsum sepulcrum antiquum, larva aurea, quae corrosionem insepulta per ultra mille annos pertulit.”

unit.source: “The Nois family’s archduke, a collaborator of the Rose School of Thought, desires Naboredisley’s corpse, while the temperance faction seeks to retrieve Miss Messenger’s heart.”
unit.target: “Archidux familiae Nois, collaborans cum Schola Rosae Rationis, cadaver Naboredisley desiderat, dum factio temperantiae cor Dominae Messenger restituere conatur.”

unit.source: “Their goals were actually different, yet they fought to the death.”
unit.target: “Proposita eorum revera diversa erant, sed ad mortem pugnaverunt.”

unit.source: “I have to say, it’s quite humorous and ironic.”
unit.target: “Fateor, hoc valde iocundum et ironicum est.”

unit.source: “Of course, this is mainly because they can’t trust each other, and there’s indeed a possibility that it’s a situation where the winner takes all.”
unit.target: “Certe, hoc maxime est propter quod inter se confidere non possunt, et revera possit esse res in qua victor omnia decernit.”

unit.source: “Does Miss Messenger want to consume Naboredisley’s Abomination body?”
unit.target: “Num Domina Messenger vult consumere corpus Abominationis Naboredisley?”

unit.source: “Of course She does!”
unit.target: “Certe, illa vult!”

unit.source: “Miss Messenger… The lady who used the lucky gold coin to buy the heart from Ludwig?”
unit.target: “Domina Messenger… ea femina, quae fortunato auro nummo cor a Ludovico comparavit?”

unit.source: “Why is she called Miss Messenger?”
unit.target: “Cur illa Domina Messenger vocatur?”

unit.source: “It’s impossible for Her to be someone’s messenger, right?”
unit.target: “Non potest fieri ut illa nuntia alicuius sit, nonne?”

unit.source: “She’s an Angel!”
unit.target: “Ea est angelica!”

unit.source: “Uh… Mr. Fool’s messenger?”
unit.target: “Heu... nuntia Domini Stulti?”

unit.source: “So that’s why there’s a lucky gold coin closely related to Mr. Fool…”
unit.target: “Itaque ideo nummus aureus fortunatus, qui arcte Domino Stulto coniungitur, existit...”

unit.source: “Lumian was sharp, and he quickly made a guess.”
unit.target: “Lumian acutus erat, et celeriter coniecturam fecit.”
