unit.source: “He continued reading the last part of the letter.”
unit.target: “Continuavit ultimam partem epistolae legere.”

unit.source: “I forgot to mention that wearing that golden mask also poses problems.”
unit.target: “Oblitus sum mentionem facere quod indutio illae larvæ aureæ etiam problemata afferat.”

unit.source: “As you can imagine, once you transform into an undead creature and don’t have any vital points on your body, the purification of sunlight and lightning will be fatal to you.”
unit.target: “Ut te ipsum possis imaginari, cum in creaturam mortuorum convertearis et puncta vitalia in corpore tuo deessent, purificatio solis ac fulminis tibi fatale erit.”

unit.source: “Moreover, if a living person wears that golden mask for too long, they will truly become deceased.”
unit.target: “Porro, si persona viva illam larvam auream per longum tempus gerit, vere mortuus erit.”

unit.source: “When that time comes, once the mask is removed, their mind and consciousness will be unprotected and they will die immediately.”
unit.target: “Cum tempus illud adveniet, et larva sublata erit, mens ac conscientia eorum non erunt protegenda, atque statim morientur.”

unit.source: “Let me see what else I haven’t mentioned…”
unit.target: “Videamus quid alia non memoravi…”

unit.source: “Yes, you said that the Underworld Daoist and Naboredisley’s corpse had looked at Iveljsta Eggers without doing anything to him.”
unit.target: “Ita, dixisti Taoista Inferorum et cadaver Naboredisley in Iveljsta Eggers aspexisse, nihil ei factum esse.”

unit.source: “That gave me some ideas.”
unit.target: “Id mihi nonnullas cogitationes excitavit.”

unit.source: “It’s highly likely that the one who helped bury Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse and construct the dream grave was the ancestor of the Eggers family, the deceased Death.”
unit.target: “Verisimile est eum, qui adiuvit cadaver Abominationis Naboredisley sepelire et sepulcrum somniorum construere, fuisse maiora familiae Eggers, Mortem defunctum.”

unit.source: “After He went mad, perhaps He interacted with the Underworld Daoist, who guarded the river and the Blood Emperor’s afterimage.”
unit.target: “Postquam insanivit, fortasse commutavit cum Taoista Inferorum, qui flumen et vestigia Imperatoris Sanguinis custodiebat.”

unit.source: “And for some reason, He agreed to Naboredisley’s request for help, causing His Abomination corpse to slumber in a special dream.”
unit.target: “Et, quacumque ratione, consensit auxilium petendum a Naboredisley, quo cadaver eius Abominationis in somnio peculiare obdormiret.”

unit.source: “Therefore, be it the Underworld Daoist or Naboredisley’s corpse, even if they only have their instincts left, they will still treat the Eggers family’s bloodline specially.”
unit.target: “Unde, sive Taoista Inferorum sive cadaver Naboredisley sit, etiam si solum vestigia instinctuum remanent, tamen peculiari modo tractabunt sanguineam genealogiam familiae Eggers.”

unit.source: 698 Aftermath
unit.target: 698 Postea

unit.source: Considering Madam Magician’s conjecture, Lumian suddenly felt that the deceased Death, the ancestor of the Eggers family, was indeed legendary.
unit.target: Ex coniectura Dominae Magicae considerata, Lumian subito sensit Mortem defunctum, progenitorem familiae Eggers, vere legendariam esse.

unit.source: After becoming a true god, He seemed to have gone mad.
unit.target: Postquam verus deus factus est, videbatur insanire.

unit.source: He incited the Pale Disaster.
unit.target: Instigavit pallidam cladem.

unit.source: His demise created the Berserk Sea, isolating the Northern and Southern Continents for more than a millennium.
unit.target: Eius exitus creavit Mare Furens, quod Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales per plus quam mille annos segregavit.

unit.source: He had a connection to the mysterious Underworld Daoist.
unit.target: Habuit vinculum cum obscuro Daoista Submundi.

unit.source: He buried the Abomination corpse of the Devil Monarch.
unit.target: Sepulcravit cadaver abominationis Monarchae Diaboli.

unit.source: He left behind the massive Balam Empire with numerous descendants.
unit.target: Reliquit ingentem Imperium Balam cum plurimis successoribus.

unit.source: The golden mask He created for His descendants to enter and exit the Underworld is still being fought over to this day…
unit.target: Larva aurea quam creavit successoribus suis ad ingressum et exitum submundi, adhuc luctatur hodie…

unit.source: Lumian retrieved the golden mask he had obtained from Hisoka from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian extraxit larvam auream, quam a Hisoka ex sacco Viatoris adeptus erat.

unit.source: He caressed its cold surface and sighed silently.
unit.target: Tangens superficiem eius frigidi, tacite suspiravit.

unit.source: This is a true deity’s creation…
unit.target: Haec est creatio verae deitatis…

unit.source: With a sigh, Lumian read the last two pages of the lengthy letter.
unit.target: Cum suspiri, Lumian duas ultimas paginas epistulae longae legit.

unit.source: “Back to yourself.
unit.target: “Redi ad teipsum.

unit.source: The Underworld Daoist mark on you only seals the influence of the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura on the outside world.
unit.target: “Signum Daoista Submundi in te tantum serat influentiam aurae reliquiarum Imperatoris Sanguinis in mundo extero.

unit.source: It doesn’t eliminate its existence.
unit.target: “Non tollit eius existentiam.

unit.source: “In other words, you can no longer use Alista Tudor’s remnant aura to scare others.
unit.target: “Id est, iam non potes uti aura reliqua Alistae Tudor ad alios intimidandos.

unit.source: However, it can still be useful when you need to verify your corresponding ‘identity.’
unit.target: “Tamen adhuc utilis esse potest, cum necesse sit identitatem tuam verificare.

unit.source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
unit.target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

unit.source: “There are pros and cons to this situation.
unit.target: “Ad hanc rem sunt commoda et incommoda.

unit.source: Although you’ve lost your potent means of intimidating others, you don’t have to worry about attracting the attention of certain high-ranking individuals by using the Blood Emperor’s remnant aura.
unit.target: “Quamquam potentem modum aliorum intimidandi amisisti, non curandum est ne attentionem quorundam altiorum per usum aurae reliquiae Imperatoris Sanguinis allicias.

unit.source: Furthermore, the Underworld Daoist mark might have a special effect in the future.
unit.target: “Praeterea, signum Daoista Submundi in futurum effectum peculiare habere potest.

unit.source: “Emperor Roselle once said that since you can’t resist, try to enjoy yourself.”
unit.target: “Imperator Roselle olim dixit: cum resisti non possis, conare te frui.

unit.source: Lumian turned his right hand over and looked at his palm.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum verteret et palmam intuebatur.

unit.source: Compared to the decay in his dream, only a small pale-white mark remained.
unit.target: Comparata corruptione in somnio suo, solum parva macula pallido-alba remansit.

unit.source: Beneath the pale-whiteness, a faint red scarred mark could be seen.
unit.target: Sub pallido albedo, apparuit tenuis rubra macula cicatricis.

unit.source: What special use can it have?
unit.target: Quid usus specialis esse possit?

unit.source: To intimidate the undead?
unit.target: Ad intimidandum mortuos?

unit.source: Lumian muttered to himself in puzzlement, momentarily at a loss.
unit.target: Lumian sibi murmurat perplexus, paulisper inopia captus.

unit.source: At the end of the letter, Madam Magician wrote:
unit.target: Ad finem epistulae, Domina Magica scripsit:

unit.source: “This year’s Dream Festival may have ended, but the special dream and ancient tomb haven’t disappeared.
unit.target: “Festival Somniorum huius anni finitum esse potest, sed somnium speciale et sepulcrum antiquum non evanuerunt.

unit.source: The Dream Festival will still happen next year.
unit.target: “Festival Somniorum adhuc fiet anno proximo.

unit.source: “When the time comes, the Demon from the Nois family and His Rose School of Thought allies, who confirmed the ancient tomb’s situation this year, might continue their attempts.
unit.target: “Quando tempus advenerit, Daemon ex familia Nois et socii eius Scholae Rosi, qui hanc annum condicionem sepulcri antiquae confirmaverunt, fortasse conatus suos continuabunt.

unit.source: “They might even bring more targeted and powerful items, Beyonders, or projections.
unit.target: “Fortasse etiam afferent instrumenta intendentiora et potentiora, Beyonders, aut projectiones.

unit.source: “Not only do we have to stop them when the time comes, but we also have to make preparations in advance.
unit.target: “Non solum eos prohibere debemus cum tempus advenerit, sed etiam praeparationes antea efficere.

unit.source: “Furthermore, for the special dream to still have dream projections as guardians, we can’t relocate the entirety of Tizamo.
unit.target: “Praeterea, ut somnium speciale adhuc proiectiones somniorum ut custodes habeat, totum Tizamo transferre non possumus.

unit.source: “Therefore, we have to do something for the people here.
unit.target: “Ergo aliquid pro hominibus hic agendum est.

unit.source: “Of course, after completing the last task, the subsequent problems of the Dream Festival will have nothing to do with you unless you become an Angel by then.
unit.target: “Scilicet, postquam ultimam munus perfeceris, quaestiones posteriores Festival Somniorum tibi nihil attinebunt, nisi tunc Angelus fias.

unit.source: “But isn’t that too far-fetched?
unit.target: “Sed nonne id nimis incredibile videtur?

unit.source: “The last thing you need to do is enter that special dream with the half-finished brass charm I sent with the letter and perform the following ritual before the black ancient tomb.
unit.target: “Ultimum quod tibi faciendum est est intrare in illum somnium speciale cum amuleto aeneo semi-perfecto quem epistula missa est et perficere sequentem ritum coram sepulcro antiquum nigro.

unit.source: “The complete process of the ritual is:
unit.target: “Processus ritus completus est:

unit.source: After carefully reading the ritual’s description, Lumian assessed his spirituality and stowed away the half-finished brass charm.
unit.target: Postquam descriptionem rituum diligenter perlegit, Lumian spiritualitatem suam aestimavit atque amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum reponit.

unit.source: Then, he retrieved the golden box containing the peculiar soil, unfolded the letter, and penned a reply:
unit.target: Deinde, extraxit cistam auream quae solum peculiare contineret, epistulam evolvit ac responsum scripsit:

unit.source: “Honorable Madam Magician,
unit.target: “Domina Magica Honorabilis,

unit.source: “I will follow your instructions and complete the ritual.
unit.target: “Mandata tua sequar et ritum perficiam.

unit.source: “This is that strange soil…
unit.target: “Hic est solum ille insólitum…

unit.source: Lumian paused and added:
unit.target: Lumian pausavit et addidit:

unit.source: “Remember to send back the box containing it.
unit.target: “Memento cistam, quae id continet, remittere.

unit.source: It was made of gold!
unit.target: Ex auro facta erat!

unit.source: Recalling Lugano’s promise of compensation and Ludwig’s growing appetite, Lumian, who was quite wealthy, felt the need to be frugal.
unit.target: Reminiscens Luganoeae promissionem compensationis et Ludovigi appetitum crescentem, Lumian, qui dives erat, sensit necessitatem parsimoniae.

unit.source: He didn’t need to worry about the potion formula, Beyonder ingredients, or mystical items for the time being, but he needed to provide for two people now!
unit.target: Non oportebat eum solliciti esse formulae potionis, ingredientium Beyonder, aut rerum mysticarum interim, sed nunc pro duabus personis curare debebat!

unit.source: Furthermore, gold played an important role in mysticism.
unit.target: Praeterea, aurum magni momenti partes in mystica habebat.

unit.source: Franca had been accumulating gold in recent months, hoping to forge a golden body for “Armored Shadow” Chen Tu.
unit.target: Franca proximis mensibus aurum congregabat, sperans corpus aureum conficere pro “Armored Shadow” Chen Tu.

unit.source: After writing the reply, Lumian set up a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
unit.target: Postquam responsum scripsit, Lumian ritum instituit et nuntium “pupae” convocavit.

unit.source: The messenger remained cautious and furtive, not uttering a word.
unit.target: Nuntius cautus et furtivus mansit, neque verbum edidit.

unit.source: What did it sense?
unit.target: Quid sensit?

unit.source: Lumian was about to inquire when he suddenly thought of a possibility.
unit.target: Lumian quaerere vellebat, cum subito de aliqua possibilitate cogitavit.

unit.source: Could it be because Miss Messenger, whom Madam Magician mentioned, had been here?
unit.target: Num quia Miss Messenger, quam Domina Magica commemoravit, hic adfuit?

unit.source: They are both messengers, so they might know each other and be related.
unit.target: Illi ambo nuntii sunt, itaque fortasse se inter se noverunt atque connexus esse possunt.

unit.source: And that person is an Angel…
unit.target: Et ille Angelus est…

unit.source: Lumian shut his mouth and watched as the “doll” messenger retreated into the candlelight with the golden box.
unit.target: Lumian os clauserunt et observavit, dum nuntius “pupae” cum cista aurea in lucem candelarum recedebat.

unit.source: He extinguished the candle, stowed away the ritual-related items, and returned to the living room.
unit.target: Candellam exstinxit, res ritui pertinentes reponit, et in atrium rediit.

unit.source: He sat across from Ludwig, who still had half his food left untouched.
unit.target: Contra Ludovicum sedebat, qui adhuc dimidium cibi sui intactus retinebat.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Ludwig, who wore a blue pajama hat with yellow stars, and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian Ludovicum aspexit, qui pileum caeruleum cum stellis luteis gerebat, et subridit.

unit.source: “Lend me something.
unit.target: “Da mihi aliquid.

unit.source: Ludwig raised his head, his mouth moving as he inquired with his eyes.
unit.target: Ludwig caput levavit, et os movebat, dum per oculos quaerebat.

unit.source: Lumian maintained a friendly smile.
unit.target: Lumian amabilem subridionem retinuit.

unit.source: “The gold coin from earlier.
unit.target: “Moneta aurea ex priore.

unit.source: Ludwig lowered his head and focused on eating a piece of beef jerky, as if he hadn’t heard Lumian.
unit.target: Ludwig caput inclinavit et se intulit edendi partem carnei siccatae, quasi verba Lumiani non audiret.

unit.source: “It’ll only take half an hour.
unit.target: “Solum dimidiam horam requiriet.

unit.source: “Yes, half an hour.
unit.target: “Ita, dimidiam horam.

unit.source: “I won’t cause any harm.
unit.target: “Non faciam ullum damnum.

unit.source: “I’ll definitely return it to you as it was,
unit.target: “Certissime illud tibi reddam ut fuit,

unit.source: Lumian said with a sigh.
unit.target: Lumian suspirans inquit.

unit.source: “I’ve been providing for you for a long time, giving you food and drink…
unit.target: “Diu pro te curavi, cibum et potum tibi praebens…

unit.source: At this point, Lumian suddenly stopped.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Lumian subito sistit.

unit.source: “Isn’t that worth lending me your lucky gold coin for half an hour?
unit.target: “Nonne id dignum est ut mihi fortunatam monetam auream dimidiā horā mutuari?

unit.source: “When have I ever lied to you?
unit.target: “Quando tibi umquam mendacium feci?

unit.source: “Often,” Ludwig mumbled.
unit.target: “Saepe,” Ludwig murmurat.

unit.source: He looked up at Lumian for a few seconds before retrieving the Loen gold coin from his pocket.
unit.target: Aliquot secundis ad Lumian aspexit, antequam nummum aureum Loen ex sinu extraxit.

unit.source: “Twenty minutes, tops.”
unit.target: “Viginti minuta, non ultra.

unit.source: “Deal!” Lumian swiftly accepted the lucky gold coin with a radiant smile.
unit.target: “Pactum!” Lumian celeriter accepit fortunatam monetam auream, subridens radianti.

unit.source: To conserve his spirituality, he refrained from teleporting.
unit.target: Ut spiritualitatem suam conservaret, teleportandi consuetudinem abstinuit.

unit.source: Instead, he moved swiftly through the shadows and arrived at “Hisoka” Twanaku’s house.
unit.target: Pro eo, celeriter per umbras processit et ad domum “Hisoka” Twanaku pervenit.

unit.source: Robert and Amandina had already left.
unit.target: Robertus et Amandina iam discesserant.

unit.source: Lumian found a spot and leaned against the wall.
unit.target: Lumian locum invenit et ad murum se inclinavit.

unit.source: Using Cogitation, he quickly drifted off to sleep.
unit.target: Utendo Cogitatione, celeriter obdormivit.

unit.source: In the special dream, in the primitive forest.
unit.target: In somnio speciali, in silva primitiva.

unit.source: Using the shadows in the darkness, Lumian reached the edge of the dream and found himself in the chaotic zone.
unit.target: Utendo umbris in tenebris, Lumian finem somnii attigit et se invenit in regione tumultuosa.

unit.source: After some thought, he left the shadow and donned the golden mask crafted by Death.
unit.target: Post aliquantum cogitandi, umbram reliquit et larvam auream a Morte confectam induit.

unit.source: Amidst the cold corrosion and heavy pressure, Lumian saw a dream fragment of a black ancient tomb and the path leading to it.
unit.target: Inter corrosionem frigoremque et grave pressuram, Lumian particulam somnii sepulcri antiqui nigri et viam ad eum ducens vidit.

unit.source: He quickly reached his destination.
unit.target: Celeriter ad metam pervenit.

unit.source: The corpses had vanished, leaving only the ancient tomb, resembling a black boulder, standing silently.
unit.target: Cadavera evanuerant, relinquentes solum sepulcrum antiquum, quasi lapis niger, silentiter stantem.

unit.source: Lumian removed the mask and observed for a moment.
unit.target: Lumian larvam removit et per momentum observavit.

unit.source: Using a raised tree root as an altar, he placed candles, essential oil, herbal powder, a cauldron, and the half-finished brass charm on it.
unit.target: Utens radicem arboris sublata uti altare, candelas, oleum essentiale, pulverem herbarum, ollam, atque amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum super eam posuit.

unit.source: He followed the instructions in Madam Magician’s letter and dealt with them one by one.
unit.target: Mandata in epistula Dominae Magicae sequens, singula tractavit.

unit.source: Finally, Lumian placed the lucky gold coin between the two candles corresponding to Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Denique, Lumian fortunatam monetam auream inter duas candelas, quae Domino Stulto respondent, posuit.

unit.source: Instead of creating a wall of spirituality, he lit the candles in the order from god to person, from left to right, and took two steps back.
unit.target: Pro murum spiritualitatis creandi, candelas ordine a deo ad hominem, a sinistra ad dextram, accendit et duo gradus retrorsum fecit.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the burning candle flame and recited in ancient Hermes,
unit.target: Lumian flammam candelae ardentem contemplatus est et in antiquo Hermes recitavit,

unit.source: “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…
unit.target: “Stultus, qui hujus aetatis non competit, gubernator arcanus super nebulam cineream; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam bene regit…

unit.source: Silently, a thin gray fog emanated from the void, enveloping the area around the black ancient tomb and the entire special dream.
unit.target: Silentio, tenuis nebula cinerea ex vacuo emanavit, circumcludens aream circa sepulcrum antiquum nigrum et totum somnium speciale.

unit.source: Lumian’s left chest heated up slightly, preventing his thoughts from slowing down, and his body showed no signs of disintegrating.
unit.target: Pectus sinistrum Lumiani leviter calefactum est, impediens cogitationes eius retardari, et corpus eius nullos vestigia dissolutionis ostendit.

unit.source: He quickly took two steps forward and ignited the corresponding essential oil extract and herbal powder.
unit.target: Celeriter duo gradus incedit et accendit extractum olei essentialis et pulverem herbarum correspondentes.

unit.source: He placed the half-finished brass charm in the center of the altar.
unit.target: Amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum in medio altaris posuit.

unit.source: Then, Lumian straightened up and said in Hermes, “I implore you,
unit.target: Tum, Lumian se recte constituit et in lingua Hermes inquit: “Obsecro te,

unit.source: “I implore you to grant this charm power.
unit.target: “Obsecro te ut huic amuleto vim tribuas.

unit.source: “I implore you to allow this power to control this dream…
unit.target: “Obsecro te ut hanc vim sinas hunc somnium regere…

unit.source: After reciting all the remaining incantations and completing the remaining steps of the ritual, Lumian saw the lucky gold coin emit a hazy glow.
unit.target: Omnes reliquas incantationes recitatas et gradus rituum perfectos, Lumian vidit fortunatam monetam auream lucem nebulosam emittentem.

unit.source: One of the candles representing Mr. Fool darkened, and the other took on a brass hue.
unit.target: Una ex candelis, quae Domino Stulto repraesentabat, obscurata est, altera vero colorem aeneum assecuta est.

unit.source: Immediately after, the darkness and brass candlelight entangled with the half-finished brass charm.
unit.target: Statim postea, obscuritas et lumen aeneum candelarum cum amuleto aeneo semi-perfecto se implicaverunt.

unit.source: The brass charm emitted a blinding light, and Lumian couldn’t help but close his eyes.
unit.target: Amuletum aeneum lucem caecam emittens erat, et Lumian oculos claudere non potuit.

unit.source: By the time he adjusted and opened his eyes, the brass charm had vanished.
unit.target: Tempore quo se composuisset et oculos aperuisset, amuletum aeneum evanuerat.

unit.source: The soil, rocks, and tree roots in front of the black ancient tomb surged, forming a tombstone-like object.
unit.target: Solum, saxa, et radices arborum coram sepulcro antiquum nigrum effluxerunt, formantes rem similem lapide sepulcrali.

unit.source: Ancient Feysac words appeared on the tombstone one after another:
unit.target: Verba antiqua Feysac in lapide sepulcrali unum post alium apparuerunt:

unit.source: “All living beings are equal before the law.
unit.target: “Omnia entia viva ante legem aequalia sunt.

unit.source: Even Angels can be killed by ordinary people.
unit.target: “Etiam Angeli ab hominibus communibus necari possunt.

unit.source: Lost items are regarded as abandonment.
unit.target: “Res amissae ut relicta habentur.

unit.source: Anything can be done during the Dream Festival, but not killing or rape.
unit.target: “Quidquid fieri potest in Festival Somniorum, sed nec caedere nec violari.

unit.source: Murderers shall die.
unit.target: “Interfectores morientur.

unit.source: Rapists shall die.
unit.target: “Violatores morientur.

unit.source: What… What pathway’s power is this?
unit.target: Quae potentia viae hoc est?

unit.source: It resembles the Arbiter pathway…
unit.target: Similis est via Arbiter.

unit.source: Killing isn’t allowed for the next Dream Festival?
unit.target: Proximo Festival Somniorum interficere non licet?

unit.source: Even an Angel can be harmed by me?
unit.target: Etiam Angelus ab me laedi potest?

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t expected Madam Magician’s preparations.
unit.target: Lumian praeparationes Dominae Magicae non exspectaverat.

unit.source: He swiftly packed his belongings and planned to leave the area.
unit.target: Celeriter supellectilem condidit et decrevit locum relinquere.

unit.source: Finally, Lumian had an idea when he saw the “tombstone.”
unit.target: Denique, Lumian ideam cepit cum “lapidem sepulcrale” vidit.

unit.source: With a smile, he retrieved a card from his Traveler’s Bag, bent down, and placed it on the ground beneath the tombstone.
unit.target: Subridens, chartam ex sacco Viatoris extraxit, se inclinavit, et eam in terra sub lapide sepulcrali posuit.

unit.source: It was a tarot card depicting a man in green holding a wand against attacking wands at the foot of a mountain.
unit.target: Erat charta tarot repraesentans virum in veste viridi, qui baculum tenet contra baculos oppugnantes ad radicem montis.

unit.source: Minor Arcana card, Seven of Wands!
unit.target: Charta Minor Arcana, Septem Bacula!

unit.source: Lumian didn’t know if the tarot cards representing him could remain in the dream or in front of the tombstone.
unit.target: Lumian nesciebat num chartae tarot, quae eum repraesentabant, in somnio aut ante lapide sepulcrali manere possent.

unit.source: He simply wanted to give it a try.
unit.target: Simplicitate conari voluit.

unit.source: After all, he hadn’t done so since becoming a member of the Tarot Club.
unit.target: Postremo, id non fecerat ex quo membrum Tarot Club factus esset.

unit.source: Upon returning to the real world, Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag and examined it.
unit.target: Rediens ad mundum reale, Lumian in sacco Viatoris introit et examinavit.

unit.source: As expected, the half-finished brass charm had vanished, as had the Minor Arcana card, the Seven of Wands.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur, amuletum aeneum semi-perfectum evanuerat, ac etiam charta Minor Arcana, Septem Bacula, evanuerat.

unit.source: The rules of the special dream are indeed a little different… Lumian nodded thoughtfully and returned the lucky gold coin to Ludwig at the Brieu Motel.
unit.target: Regulae somnii specialis re vera paulum differunt… Lumian cogitabunde annuit et fortunatam monetam auream Ludovico apud Brieu Motel reddidit.

unit.source: Then, Lumian stepped onto the street.
unit.target: Deinde, Lumian in viam processit.

unit.source: In the darkness, he passed Camus, Rhea, Lugano, and the others, who were busy rescuing and treating people, and arrived at Saint-Sien Cathedral.
unit.target: In tenebris, transiit Camus, Rhea, Lugano, et alios, qui homines servabant et curabant, et ad Cathedralem Sancti-Sien pervenit.

unit.source: All the candles in the cathedral had been lit, but only Padre Cali was present.
unit.target: Omnes candelas in cathedral accensae erant, sed solus Padre Cali aderat.

unit.source: Dressed in a white robe adorned with golden threads, he knelt before the altar and the Sacred Emblem, his head bowed in anguish.
unit.target: Indutus veste alba, filiis aureis ornata, ante altare et Emblema Sacrum genu flexit, caput in dolore inclinavit.

unit.source: Lumian walked in step by step and took a seat in the front row.
unit.target: Lumian gradatim processit et in prima ordinis sede consedit.

unit.source: He watched Padre Cali quietly without disturbing him.
unit.target: Padre Cali quiete observavit, neque eum perturbavit.

unit.source: 699 Who is to Blame?
unit.target: 699. Cui culpa?

unit.source: The smoke and dust caused by the meteorite had mostly dissipated, and the commotion on the street had gradually subsided.
unit.target: Fumus et pulvis, a meteoro causati, plerumque dissipaverant, et tumultus in platea paulatim cessaverat.

unit.source: The injured had largely escaped danger thanks to swift treatment, but some still perished, eliciting occasional cries of anguish.
unit.target: Vulnerati periculum fere evaserunt celeris medicinae auxilio, sed quidam adhuc perierunt, suscitantes interdum clamores angoris.

unit.source: Inside Saint-Sien Cathedral, Padre Cali completed his penance.
unit.target: In Cathedrali Sancti Sien, Padre Cali poenitentiam perfecit.

unit.source: He stood and turned to face Lumian, who sat silently in the front pew, observing him.
unit.target: Stetit et se vertit ad spectandum Lumianum, qui in primo subsellio tacite sedebat eum observans.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and asked casually, “Is repentance still of any use?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens atque leviter rogavit: “Num poenitentia adhuc ad aliquid prodest?”

unit.source: Without waiting for a response, he added habitually, “You must know your fate is sealed. You won’t survive more than a few days.”
unit.target: Sine responsum exspectans, more solito addidit: “Scito fatum tuum sigillatum esse. Non superabis plus quam paucos dies.”

unit.source: Paleness showed through Padre Cali’s dark-brown complexion as he calmly replied, “If repentance worked, it wouldn’t be true repentance.”
unit.target: Complexio fusca et obscura Padre Cali pallore illustrata, tranquille respondit: “Si poenitentia operaretur, non vera poenitentia esset.”

unit.source: This statement seemed to bring him a measure of peace.
unit.target: Haec sententia ei modicum pacis attulit.

unit.source: “I repented because I wanted to, not to bargain for understanding or redemption.”
unit.target: “Poenitui quia volui, non ut ad intellegendum aut redimendum mercarer.”

unit.source: “Looking back, I have indeed made many mistakes.”
unit.target: Retrospiciens, revera multa erravi.

unit.source: “I yearned for higher status and the approval of you Northerners.”
unit.target: Superiorem statum et vestra approbationem, Septentrionales, exoptavi.

unit.source: “That desire blinded me, and I succumbed to the Demon’s temptations.”
unit.target: Istud desiderium me caecavit, et daemonis tentationibus succumbi.

unit.source: Lumian scoffed upon hearing this.
unit.target: Lumian hoc audito irridens.

unit.source: “Is that truly the case? Did desire actually cloud your judgment?”
unit.target: “Num vere ita est? Num desiderium iudicium tuum vere obnubilavit?”

unit.source: Noting the padre’s bewildered expression, Lumian leaned back and gazed up at the Sun Sacred Emblem.
unit.target: Animadvertens vultum perplexum Patris, Lumian retrorsum inclinatus sursum ad Solis Sacrum Emblema spectavit.

unit.source: “Did your ambition for prestige and recognition from Northerners force you to collaborate with Twanaku, compel you to become a Wraith as an Eternal Blazing Sun padre, make you receptive to the Demon’s allure, or drive you to exploit those boys? No, you chose this path of your own volition.”
unit.target: “Num ambitio tua de praestantia et agnitione a Septentrionalibus te coegit ut cum Twanaku collaborares, ut Wraith fieres ut Padre Solis Aeterni Flagrantis, ut daemonis allicitati accederes, aut te impulit ut illos iuvenes exploitaris? Non, hoc iter ex tua voluntate elegisti.”

unit.source: Padre Cali’s lips quivered as if to object, but he couldn’t find the words.
unit.target: Labia Padre Cali tremuerunt quasi obiecerent, sed verba invenire non potuit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and continued, “Many in this world still crave elevated status and the recognition of certain groups.
unit.target: Lumian subridens continuavit: “Multi in hoc mundo adhuc statum elevatum ac agnitionem quibusdam coetuum appetunt.

unit.source: Most of them simply work hard to contribute and combat evil with all their strength.
unit.target: Plurimi strenue laborant ut conferant atque in omni vi malum oppugnent.

unit.source: They never consort with Demons, hoping to attain their goals through righteous means.
unit.target: Numquam cum daemonibus consociantur, sperantes ad metas suas per vias iustas pervenire.

unit.source: Even in the face of repeated failure, they don’t descend into the abyss.
unit.target: Etiam in conspectu cladis iteratae non in abyssum decedunt.

unit.source: They share the same desires, yet they maintain self-control while you could not.
unit.target: Eadem desideria habent, sed se moderant, dum tu non potuisti.

unit.source: Desire didn’t cloud your mind—your mind chose depravity.
unit.target: Desiderium mentem tuam non obnubilos fecit—mens tua pravitatem elegit.

unit.source: Padre Cali fell silent, at a loss for words.
unit.target: Padre Cali tacuit, verbis caret.

unit.source: Lumian sighed with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian cum risu suspiravit.

unit.source: “A relative once told me, ‘Intense desire fuels human progress, but it’s also the demon that drags humans into the abyss. Good or bad, light or darkness—it all hinges on us, on that single thought in a pivotal moment.’”
unit.target: “Quondam cognatus mihi dixit: ‘Intensa cupiditas progressionem humanam alit, sed etiam daemon homines in abyssi trahit. Bene aut male, lux aut tenebrae—omnia in nobis pendent, in illo uno cogitatione, momento decisivo.’”

unit.source: His face growing ever paler, Padre Cali lowered his head and rasped, “I have sinned…”
unit.target: Facies eius magis pallida facta, Padre Cali caput inclinavit et rauco voce exclamat: “Peccavi…”

unit.source: Lumian pressed a hand to his chest, his expression settling.
unit.target: Lumian manum ad pectus apposuit, vultum placide compositum.

unit.source: He looked at Padre Cali and laughed self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Ad Padre Cali aspexit et seipsum cum modesta humilitate risit.

unit.source: “I too have strong desires.
unit.target: “Etiam ego vehementa desideria habeo.

unit.source: Everyone does.
unit.target: Omnes habent.

unit.source: If harboring intense desire is a sin, then you are a sinner, and so am I.
unit.target: Si vehementum desiderium colere peccatum est, tunc tu peccator es, et ego quoque.

unit.source: We are all guilty.
unit.target: Omnes culpabiles sumus.

unit.source: Padre Cali’s expression froze momentarily before he slowly turned around.
unit.target: Vultus Padre Cali momento congelatus est, antequam lente se converteret.

unit.source: Kneeling once more before the altar, he gazed up at the immense Sun Sacred Emblem and spoke in a deep voice, “You are innocent. Desire itself is not sinful, but I am a true sinner.”
unit.target: Iterum ad altare genu flectens, sursum intuebatur ingentem Emblema Sacrum Solis, et voce profunda dixit, “Innocens es. Ipse desiderium non est peccatum, sed ego vere peccator sum.”

unit.source: He bowed his head as his body gradually became ethereal and transparent.
unit.target: Caput inclinavit, dum corpus eius paulatim aethereum et perspicuum fieret.

unit.source: Thus, Padre Cali manifested as a Wraith before the Sacred Emblem.
unit.target: Ita, Padre Cali se manifestavit ut umbra ante Emblema Sacrum.

unit.source: An icy, sinister aura emanated from him, triggering a reaction from the emblem and altar.
unit.target: Gelida et sinistra aura ex eo emanabat, provocans reactionem ab emblema et altare.

unit.source: The entire cathedral trembled slightly.
unit.target: Tota cathedrale leviter tremuit.

unit.source: A brilliant, sunlight-like radiance seeped from the altar, emblem, stained glass, and religious murals, rapidly converging at the domed ceiling.
unit.target: Splendida radiatio, instar solis fulgoris, ex altare, emblema, vitreis pictis, et muralibus sacris effulgebat, celeriter in tecto cupola conveniens.

unit.source: A dazzling golden pillar of light, accompanied by a hymnal voice, descended upon Padre Cali.
unit.target: Columna aurea lucis stupenda, comitata voce hymnica, in Padre Cali descendit.

unit.source: The Wraith-form padre trembled faintly but did not evade.
unit.target: Padre in forma umbrae parum tremuit, sed non evasit.

unit.source: Under the searing holy light, his body disintegrated into ashes.
unit.target: Sub luce sacra ardenti, corpus eius in cinerem disintegratum est.

unit.source: Lumian observed this scene expressionlessly, feeling neither joy nor sorrow.
unit.target: Lumian hanc scenam, nec gaudium nec dolorem sentiens, impassibiliter contemplatus est.

unit.source: As the dome’s holy glow dissipated, leaving only candlelight illuminating the cathedral, Lumian remained seated in the front pew, quietly contemplating the spot where Padre Cali had been purified.
unit.target: Dum splendor sacer cupolae evanuit, relinquens solum lumen candelarum quae cathedralem illuminabat, Lumian in primo subsellio sedebat, quiete meditans locum quo Padre Cali purgatus erat.

unit.source: After an indeterminate span, Camus and Rhea entered the cathedral, having finished their disaster relief efforts.
unit.target: Post tempore incertum, Camus et Rhea in cathedrale intraverunt, opus subsidii calamitatum confecitantes.

unit.source: Camus sighed in relief upon seeing Louis Berry in the front row.
unit.target: Camus leviter suspiravit ex solacio, cum Louis Berry in prima ordine appareret.

unit.source: He smiled and said, “We still lack composure, prone to panic when calamity strikes.”
unit.target: Subridens dixit: “Nondum compositi sumus, ad pavorem in calamitatibus inclini soletis.”

unit.source: We were so focused on aiding the injured and trapped that we never anticipated a detestable man like Padre Cali suddenly going mad and trying to drag others down with him.
unit.target: Tam occupati ad vulneratos et captivos adiuvandos fuimus, ut numquam exspectaremus virum abominabilem, ut Padre Cali, subitamente insanire et alios secum in ruinas trahere conari.

unit.source: It’s fortunate you were here.
unit.target: Felix est quod hic adfuisti.

unit.source: Rhea surveyed the surroundings and asked, “Where is Padre Cali?”
unit.target: Rhea circumstantia aspexit atque quaesivit: “Ubi est Padre Cali?”

unit.source: Lumian stared ahead at the altar and replied plainly, “After repenting, he utilized the cathedral’s accumulated spirituality and the Sacred Emblem’s unique properties to purify himself.”
unit.target: Lumian ad altare aspexit et perspicue respondit: “Post poenitentiam, spiritualitatem cathedralis congregatam et proprietates unicas Emblema Sacrum ad se purgandum usus est.”

unit.source: Rhea fell silent. After a few seconds, she spread her arms and proclaimed, “Praise the Sun!”
unit.target: Rhea silentium obtinuit. Pauculis secundis, brachia extendens proclamavit: “Laudate Solem!”

unit.source: She then took a seat in the front pew on the opposite side, clasped her hands, bowed her head, and prayed fervently.
unit.target: Deinde in primo subsellio latere opposito consedit, manus conplectens, caput inclinavit, et ferventer oravit.

unit.source: For a moment, Camus was unsure whether to sit or remain standing.
unit.target: Per momentum, Camus dubitavit utrum sedere an stans manere debeat.

unit.source: Lumian turned to him. “Have you recovered Reaza’s Beyonder characteristic?”
unit.target: Lumian ad eum conversus dixit: “Recuperavistine indolem Beyonder de Reaza?”

unit.source: Camus paused before responding, “Yes.”
unit.target: Camus ante responsum pausavit: “Ita.”

unit.source: “And Maslow’s?” Lumian shifted his gaze back to the Sacred Emblem.
unit.target: “Et Maslow?” Lumian oculos iterum ad Emblema Sacrum convertebat.

unit.source: “Its whereabouts are unknown,” Camus replied.
unit.target: “Ubi sit, ignotum est,” respondit Camus.

unit.source: Lumian stated calmly, “It should be in the meteorite impact zone.”
unit.target: Lumian tranquille dixit: “Existimatur eo esse in regione impactionis meteoriti.”

unit.source: Camus was taken aback.
unit.target: Camus obstupuit.

unit.source: “Was the meteorite meant to claim most of the deceased? Is the Dream Festival’s power truly that immense?”
unit.target: “Num meteorītum destinatum erat ut plerosque defunctos interficeret? Num vis Festivali Somniorum vere tam ingens est?”

unit.source: “More potent than you realize,” Lumian replied, as if discussing the next day’s weather.
unit.target: “Potentior quam putatis,” respondit Lumian, quasi de caelo crastino dicens.

unit.source: “Reaza and Maslow belong to the Numinous Episcopate’s Royal faction. Admiral Querarill is aware of their identities and that Reaza came to Tizamo to fulfill a mission assigned by the Royal faction’s superiors.”
unit.target: “Reaza et Maslow factioni regiae Episcopatus Numinous pertinent. Admiral Querarill identitates eorum novit atque quod Reaza ad Tizamo venit ad missionem ex factionis regiae superioribus mandatam explendam.”

unit.source: Camus’s expression shifted as he exhaled slowly.
unit.target: Vultus Camus mutatus est, dum lente exhalabat.

unit.source: “Even without you mentioning this, I wouldn’t have harbored any ill will towards Captain Reaza.”
unit.target: “Etiam, nisi hoc diceres, adversus Capitanum Reaza nullo animo malum tenerem.”

unit.source: He did save me on multiple occasions, and this time, he didn’t overtly betray me but rather the patrol team.
unit.target: Me pluries servavit, et hoc tempore non me palam prodidit, sed manipulum speculatorum.

unit.source: My sense of belonging to the team isn’t that strong.
unit.target: Sensus meus pertinendi ad manipulum non tam fortis est.

unit.source: Now, I’m just relieved he’s not a traitor.
unit.target: Nunc solum me levatum existimo quod non sit proditor.

unit.source: Lumian smiled provocatively and said, “It benefits you as well. Port Pylos’s patrol team now has a vacant vice-captain position, and your rival is already dead.”
unit.target: Lumian provocanter subridens dixit: “Hoc tibi quoque prodest. Manipulus praesidii Port Pylos nunc locum vice-capitanei vacuum habet, et adversarius tuus iam mortuus est.”

unit.source: Camus didn’t rise to the bait, smiling wryly instead.
unit.target: Camus ad instigationem non accessit, sed potius sardonice subridens manebat.

unit.source: “I plan to leave Matani.”
unit.target: “Cogito Matani relinquere.”

unit.source: “Thanks to your generosity, I’ve nearly saved enough to advance to Sequence 6. It’s safer and simpler to return to my family and contact the main branch than to search the outside world.
unit.target: “Propter tuam largitatem, fere satis servavi ut ad Sequenciam VI progrediar. Tutior et facilior est familiam redire et ramum principale contingere, quam extra orbem quaerere.”

unit.source: “The patrol team is a small organization, after all. Sequence 6 is the limit. To reach Sequence 5, I’d need to forge close ties with the Numinous Episcopate, Rose School of Thought, Intis Bureau 8, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, or the Church of Earth Mother, or become Admiral Querarill’s trusted aide. Given my Castiya surname, the choice is clear.”
unit.target: “Manipulus praesidii, denique, parvus est. Sequencia VI est finis. Ad Sequenciam V pervenire, necesse est mihi vincula intima constituere cum Episcopato Numinous, Schola Rosae Cogitationis, Bureau Intis VIII, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flagrantis, aut Ecclesia Matris Terrae, aut firi adiutor fidus Admiralium Querarill. Cum cognomine Castiya meo, electio manifesta est.”

unit.source: If the Castiya royal family truly accepts you, your potential would be far greater…
unit.target: Si familia regia Castiya te vere accipit, potentia tua longe maior foret…

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “I thought you were leaving this place of sorrow due to a failed romance.”
unit.target: Lumian subridentem dixit: “Putabam te hunc lugubrem locum relinquere ob relationem fallacem.”

unit.source: Camus abruptly choked on his saliva and coughed several times.
unit.target: Camus subito saliva suae obstrictus est et pluries tussivit.

unit.source: After Rhea concluded her prayers, she departed the cathedral with Camus.
unit.target: Postquam Rhea preces finivit, cathedrale cum Camus discessit.

unit.source: Lumian lingered in the front pew, savoring the solitude.
unit.target: Lumian in primo subsellio manebat, solitudinem fruens.

unit.source: After a while, Amandina appeared at the entrance, clad in black hunting attire.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Amandina ad ostium apparuit, vestimenta venatoria atra induta.

unit.source: “Why are you alone here?” the girl muttered, her gaze darting about as if searching for something.
unit.target: “Quare sola hic ades?” puella submurmuravit, oculos circumfugientes quasi aliquid quaereret.

unit.source: “Why have you come?” Lumian asked nonchalantly.
unit.target: “Cur venisti?” Lumian leviter rogavit.

unit.source: Amandina sat beside him and chuckled.
unit.target: Amandina iuxta eum consedit et subridens.

unit.source: “I wanted to see if Robert would come looking for the dying Padre Cali, but surprisingly, you’re the only one here.”
unit.target: “Volebam videre num Robertus ad moribundum Padre Cali quaerendum veniret, sed mirum, solus hic es.”

unit.source: “Padre Cali purified himself. I doubt Robert has been here,” Lumian answered truthfully.
unit.target: “Padre Cali se purgavit. Dubito Robertum hic fuisse,” Lumian veraciter respondit.

unit.source: “Is that so…” Amandina felt a pang of disappointment. “If he had really come to confront Padre Cali, it would mean he still is a man…”
unit.target: “Sic est…” Amandina levem tristitiam sensit. “Si revera ad Padre Cali opponendum venisset, id significaret eum adhuc virum esse…”

unit.source: Lumian remained silent.
unit.target: Lumian tacuit.

unit.source: Amandina faced the altar and Sacred Emblem, offering a brief prayer.
unit.target: Amandina ad altare et Emblema Sacrum se convertit, brevem precem offerens.

unit.source: Her task complete, she glanced around eagerly and asked, “Will there be another Dream Festival next year?”
unit.target: Res completa, circumspiciens aviditer, quaesivit: “Num alius Festival Somniorum anno proximo fiet?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian didn’t hide anything.
unit.target: “Ita.” Lumian nihil celavit.

unit.source: Joy instantly lit up Amandina’s features.
unit.target: Gaudium statim vultum Amandinae illustravit.

unit.source: “Is that black ancient tomb still there? Can I gain superpowers by touching it again?”
unit.target: “Num illud sepulcrum antiquum atrum adhuc ibi est? Possumne iterum eo tangendo potentias supernas adipisci?”

unit.source: “Of course,” Lumian turned to her, smiling. “But the outsiders participating in next year’s Dream Festival will be even stronger and more terrifying, surpassing the evil cloth doll, crystal skull, and human skin man you encountered.”
unit.target: “Certe,” Lumian ad eam se convertit, subridens, “sed externos qui in Festivalo Somniorum anni proximo participant, robustiores ac terribiles erunt, superantes malam pupam pannosam, cranium crystallinum, et hominem cutis humanae quem occurristi.”

unit.source: Amandina’s expression fell.
unit.target: Vultus Amandinae deiectus est.

unit.source: “Really? In that case, I’ll find an excuse to stay in Port Pylos during next year’s festival and bring my parents along.”
unit.target: “Vere? Ergo, in Festivalo anni proximo in Portu Pylos manere mihi excusationem inveniam et parentes meos secum ducabo.”

unit.source: “Have you returned to Palm Manor?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: “Num rediisti ad Palmam Maneriam?” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Amandina sighed and smiled.
unit.target: Amandina suspiravit et subridit.

unit.source: “I went back briefly. Not wanting to disrupt their facade of love, I left again.”
unit.target: “Breviter redii. Nolens eorum speciem amoris perturbare, iterum discessi.”

unit.source: She paused, eyes sparkling with curiosity.
unit.target: Stetit, oculis cum curiositate fulgentibus.

unit.source: “Besides touching the black tomb, are there other ways for me to advance my Sequence?”
unit.target: “Praeter tangendum sepulcrum atrum, num aliae viae sunt quo meam Sequenciam progredi possim?”

unit.source: “You can buy formulas and drink potions to progress along one of three paths—Sleepless, Corpse Collector, or Warrior,” Lumian divulged the relevant mystical knowledge without reservation.
unit.target: “Formulae emere potes et potionibus bibere ut in unam trium semitarum iter progrediaris—Insomnes, Collectorem Cadaverum, aut Bellatorem,” Lumian sine mora scientiam mysticam revelavit.

unit.source: After some thought, he added, “Also, it wasn’t the black tomb that granted you superpowers. It was that figure…”
unit.target: Postquam paulum cogitavit, addidit: “Praeterea, non sepulcrum atrum tibi potentias supernas concessit; illa figura fuit…”

unit.source: Lumian was suddenly perplexed.
unit.target: Lumian subito perplexus est.

unit.source: What was the connection between Amandina, Robert, and the Underworld Daoist?
unit.target: Quae erat relatio inter Amandinam, Robertum, et Daoistam Inferorum?

unit.source: Typically, boons were bestowed upon believers by deities or angels, but Amandina and Robert had no faith in the Underworld Daoist. They weren’t even aware of His existence.
unit.target: Saepe dona a deis vel angelis credentibus largiebantur, sed Amandina et Robertus in Daoista Inferorum nullam fidem habebant. Ne eius quidem existentiam agnoverant.

unit.source: Considering the conventions of various secret organizations and the customs Franca occasionally mentioned, Amandina should have addressed the Underworld Daoist as “Teacher”!
unit.target: Consideratis regulis variorum consociationum secretarum et moribus quos Franca interdum commemoravit, Amandina Daoistam Inferorum “Magistro” appellare debuit!

unit.source: 700 Return
unit.target: 700 Reditus

unit.source: In the special dream, Amandina mentioned that the figure, known as the Underworld Daoist, had nodded at her…
unit.target: In somnio speciali, Amandina memoravit figuram, nota ut "Daoista Inferorum", quae ei nutaverat…

unit.source: "Armored Shadow" Chen Tu is suspected to be related to the Underworld Daoist…
unit.target: Chen Tu, "Umbra Armata", suspicatur esse cognatus Daoista Inferorum…

unit.source: Franca is accumulating gold to create a golden body for Chen Tu to obtain more information…
unit.target: Franca aurum colligit ut corpus aureum pro Chen Tu efficiat, quo plura discat…

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced with these thoughts.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani his cogitationibus volitabat.

unit.source: He turned to Amandina with a smile.
unit.target: Subrisu se ad Amandinam convertit.

unit.source: “You won’t only encounter that figure during the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Non solum, in Festival Somniorum, illam figuram occursurus eris.

unit.source: “It’s possible normally?” Amandina asked, surprised.
unit.target: “Num etiam more solito fit?” inquit Amandina, stupens.

unit.source: What kind of smarts do you have… Lumian inwardly criticized, shaking his head and smiling.
unit.target: "Quae ingenia geris..." internaliter reprehendit Lumian, caput concutens et subridens.

unit.source: “What I mean is, it’s not just in Tizamo where you can encounter that figure on a specific date.”
unit.target: "Quod scilicet dico, non solum in Tizamo, certo die, illam figuram occursurum esse potes."

unit.source: Amandina pondered for a few moments before grasping the underlying meaning behind Louis Berry’s words.
unit.target: Amandina paulisper meditavit, deinde latentem significationem verborum Ludovici Berry intellexit.

unit.source: “Have you seen that figure elsewhere?
unit.target: "Illam figuram alibi vidistine?

unit.source: “I thought you couldn’t see him and could only observe through me?”
unit.target: “Putabam te eum videre non posse et solum per me conspicere?”

unit.source: Thankfully, you’re not that dense… Lumian retrieved the golden mask from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Gratias autem, non es tam obtusus… Lumian larvam auream ex sacculo viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: “I could see after putting this on.”
unit.target: “Hoc indutum, videre potui.”

unit.source: Without waiting for Amandina’s response, Lumian added with a smile, “I did encounter that figure elsewhere.”
unit.target: Nisi responsum Amandinae exspectans, Lumian subridens addidit: "Illam figuram alibi occurrivi."

unit.source: He used “encounter” instead of “meeting” to ensure his statement couldn’t be more truthful.
unit.target: Verbum "occurrere" pro "conventu" usus est, ut sententia eius non posset verius esse.

unit.source: He wanted to say, “I even know His name,” but didn’t feel like explaining to Amandina why he used the pronoun “He” to address the Underworld Daoist respectfully.
unit.target: Volebat dicere: "Etiam nomen Eius novi," sed non voluit Amandinae explicare cur pronomen "Is" ad reverenter referendum ad Daoista Inferorum adhiberet.

unit.source: Amandina’s expression turned excited.
unit.target: Vultus Amandinae excitatus factus est.

unit.source: “Where?”
unit.target: "Ubi?"

unit.source: “In Trier,” Lumian replied honestly.
unit.target: "In Trier," respondit Lumian sincere.

unit.source: This was the information he wanted the other party to know.
unit.target: Haec erant notitiae, quas alteri tradere volebat.

unit.source: “Trier…” Amandina felt a mix of captivation and fear.
unit.target: "Trier..." Amandina mixturam captivationis et timoris sensit.

unit.source: As an Intisian born and raised on the Southern Continent, she had heard countless rumors about the Capital of Joy and understood its vibrancy and prosperity.
unit.target: Sicut Intisiana in Continentis Australis nata et educata, innumeros rumores de Capite Laetitiae audiverat et eius vibrantiam ac prosperitatem intellexerat.

unit.source: Trier had nearly become her dream paradise, but the furthest she had ventured was Port Pylos, never leaving Matani.
unit.target: Trier fere paradisus somniorum eius factus erat, sed remotissimum pervenit ad Portum Pylos, numquam Matani relinquit.

unit.source: If given the chance to visit Trier, fear was her initial reaction.
unit.target: Si occasio Trier visitandi ei daretur, timor primarius erat.

unit.source: After all, she was still a girl under 18.
unit.target: Postremo, adhuc puella sub duodeviginti annis erat.

unit.source: Lumian continued candidly, “In the future, I know someone who might interact with that figure.
unit.target: Lumian candide persequebatur: "In futuro, scio aliquem qui cum illa figura agere possit.

unit.source: I hope you can provide her with some assistance—the non-combat kind.
unit.target: Spero te ei auxilium ferre posse—non bellicum.

unit.source: To that end, I can take you to Trier and help you enter the area where the figure might appear.
unit.target: Ad hoc, te ad Trier ducam et tibi adiuvabo ad locum ingredi, ubi figura apparere possit.

unit.source: I can also provide some protection.
unit.target: Praeterea, aliquam tutelam praebere possum.

unit.source: How about it? Do you want to strike such a deal?
unit.target: Quid censes? Visne talem pactum facere?

unit.source: “I-I…” Amandina hesitated, instinctively seeking an excuse.
unit.target: "I-I..." titubavit Amandina, instinctive excusationem quaerens.

unit.source: “My parents won’t allow me to leave Matani for Trier now.
unit.target: "Parentes mei non sinunt me nunc ex Matani ad Trier discedere.

unit.source: At the very least, I have to wait until I get a chance to attend university there.”
unit.target: "Saltem, oportet me exspectare donec occasio ad universitatem ibi accedat."

unit.source: Lumian found it amusing and remarked, “I’m not asking you to permanently relocate to Trier.
unit.target: Lumian hoc risu accepit et dixit: "Non te peto ut in Trier perpetuo resideas.

unit.source: You can go on Saturday and return on Sunday.”
unit.target: Potes sabbato discedere et die dominico redire.

unit.source: “Huh?” Amandina was taken aback.
unit.target: "Eh?" Amandina stupefacta est.

unit.source: She had imagined a long-distance voyage, hiking through mountains and wading across rivers, forever bidding farewell to her home.
unit.target: Iter longum imaginaverat, per montes ambulans et flumina calcans, domum suam in perpetuum vale dicens.

unit.source: Lumian arched an eyebrow.
unit.target: Lumian unius supercilium levavit.

unit.source: “It’s not like I haven’t teleported you in the dream before.”
unit.target: "Non enim est quod te ante in somnio non translocaverim."

unit.source: “B-but isn’t that just a small area?” Amandina’s eyes lit up.
unit.target: "Sed—num non est illud parva regio?" oculi Amandinae fulserunt.

unit.source: “Can you really teleport directly from Matani to Trier?”
unit.target: "Num vere directe ab Matani ad Trier te translocare potes?"

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, I might need to make a transit once or twice along the way, but it will still allow you to reach Trier quickly.”
unit.target: "Ita, semel vel bis transeundum iter facere mihi opus esse potest, sed celeriter ad Trier pervenies."

unit.source: “Quickly…” Amandina’s interest was piqued.
unit.target: "Celeriter..." studium Amandinae excitatum est.

unit.source: She yearned to experience such wonders.
unit.target: Talia miracula experiri cupiebat.

unit.source: However, she didn’t make a decision immediately.
unit.target: Tamen statim non decrevit.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t rush her.
unit.target: Lumian eam non festinavit.

unit.source: “No need to decide right away.
unit.target: "Non necesse est statim decernere.

unit.source: Meeting that figure again is actually quite dangerous.
unit.target: Iterum illam figuram convenire vere periculosum est.

unit.source: You should first truly come into contact with Matani’s mysticism circle and learn the basics about Beyonders from Rhea.
unit.target: Primum vere oportet te cum circulo mystico Matani contiguum esse et a Rhea elementa de Beyonders discere.

unit.source: Only then should you consider accepting this deal.
unit.target: Tum solum deberes hunc pactum accipere considerare.

unit.source: It might take three months, half a year, or even a year.”
unit.target: Tribus mensibus, dimidio anno, vel etiam uno anno tempus capere potest.

unit.source: Amandina breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Amandina leviter suspiravit.

unit.source: “Understood.”
unit.target: "Intelligo."

unit.source: Curious, she asked, “Is your friend a woman?”
unit.target: Curiosa inquit: "Num amica tua sit femina?"

unit.source: He had used the pronoun “she.”
unit.target: Pronomen "ea" usus erat.

unit.source: In our hearts and minds, she has always been one.
unit.target: In cordibus et mentibus nostris, semper una fuit.

unit.source: As for how she identifies, sometimes yes, sometimes no…
unit.target: Quoad modum quo se agnoscit, aliquando sic, aliquando non…

unit.source: Lumian inwardly criticized Franca and nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian Francam internis rationibus reprehendens leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: "Ita."

unit.source: Amandina asked excitedly, “Your lover?”
unit.target: Amandina exsultans inquit: "Amator tuus?"

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens erat.

unit.source: “Of course not.
unit.target: "Certe non.

unit.source: Why do you always fixate on such matters?”
unit.target: Cur semper talibus rebus insisteris?”

unit.source: As Lumian spoke, he retrieved a post-it note and fountain pen from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, notam post-it et calamo plumbeo ex sacculo viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: He scribbled a few lines and handed them to Amandina.
unit.target: Paucas lineas scripsit et Amandinae tradidit.

unit.source: Amandina took it and carefully read it under the cathedral’s candlelight:
unit.target: Amandina id suscepit et sub lumine candelarum cathedralium diligenter legit:

unit.source: “A creature wandering above the world, the penitent who awakens from the flames of pain, a messenger that belongs solely to Lumian Lee.”
unit.target: "Creatura per orbem errans, paenitens qui ex flammarum dolore evigilat, nuntius cui soli Lumian Lee pertinet."

unit.source: “What’s this?” Amandina was bewildered.
unit.target: "Quid hoc est?" inquit Amandina, stupefacta.

unit.source: “My messenger.
unit.target: "Nuntius meus.

unit.source: Set up a ritual once you’ve made up your mind.
unit.target: Constitue ritum, simul ac mente definita es.

unit.source: Use this incantation to summon my messenger and inform me of your decision,” Lumian explained simply.
unit.target: Hoc incantationem utere ad nuntium meum evocandum, et me de tua decisione certiorem fac, explicavit Lumian simpliciter.

unit.source: Amandina grew increasingly perplexed.
unit.target: Amandina magis magisque perplexa facta est.

unit.source: “What ritual?
unit.target: "Quid ritus?

unit.source: What summoning?
unit.target: "Quam evocationem?

unit.source: This isn’t a conventional messenger?”
unit.target: "Nonne hic nuntius solitus est?"

unit.source: Lumian raised his eyebrows again.
unit.target: Lumian iterum supercilia levavit.

unit.source: “Have you never heard of a messenger in the mysticism domain?
unit.target: "Num nunquam nuntium in dominio mystico audivisti?

unit.source: Don’t you know about summoning rituals?”
unit.target: "Nonne de ritibus evocationis nosti?"

unit.source: Amandina smiled sheepishly and said, “I came into contact with superpowers last year and gathered some information about the pathways of the divine through Robert and a few mysticism enthusiasts.
unit.target: Amandina submissa risu surridens inquit: "Anno praeterito cum potentia supernaturali occurui et per Robertum atque paucos studiosos mysticae viarum informationes collegi.

unit.source: I know about rituals, but I’m not sure about the details.”
unit.target: De ritibus scio, sed de singulis non plenissime certus sum.

unit.source: Then, her eyes lit up.
unit.target: Tum oculi eius fulserunt.

unit.source: “You’ll teach me, won’t you?
unit.target: "Mihi docebis, nonne?"

unit.source: Otherwise, I wouldn’t be able to summon your messenger.
unit.target: Aliter nuntium tuum evocare non possem.

unit.source: Also, is your real name not Louis Berry, but Lumian Lee?
unit.target: Etiam, num verum nomen tuum non est Louis Berry, sed Lumian Lee?

unit.source: “Y-you took a pen and paper from that coin bag.
unit.target: "Tu... tu penna et chartam ex illo sacculo nummorum abstulisti.

unit.source: You also took your previous items from there.
unit.target: Etiam veteres res tuas ex eo abstulisti.

unit.source: What kind of mystical item is this?
unit.target: Quidnam huiusmodi res mystica est?

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but glance up at the golden spherical dome.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit non intueri ad auream sphaericam cupulam.

unit.source: The following morning, Lumian left the Brieu Motel with Ludwig and Lugano.
unit.target: Postero mane, Lumian cum Ludovico et Lugano Brieu Motel reliquit.

unit.source: They passed through streets still strewn with ruins and arrived at Bunia’s café.
unit.target: Per vias quae adhuc ruinibus sparsae erant, perrexerunt et ad cauponam Buniae pervenerunt.

unit.source: The owner, Bunia, maintained his usual shyness and politely inquired about their needs.
unit.target: Dominus, Bunia, consuetam timiditatem servavit et comiter de eorum necessitatibus interrogavit.

unit.source: Lumian ordered three cups of Cosa coffee and three servings of Matani’s specialty breakfast, Ocapa.
unit.target: Lumian tres pocula coffeae Cosae et tres portiones ientaculi specialis Matani, Ocapa, iussit.

unit.source: Ocapa was made from rice, chicken, eggs, potatoes, and common local spices wrapped in leaves from the Ocapa trees.
unit.target: Ocapa facta erat ex oryza, gallina, ova, patatae, et condimentis localibus in foliis arborum Ocapa involutis.

unit.source: It was filling and fragrant, and one couldn’t stop eating once they started.
unit.target: Saturabat et fragrans erat, nec quisquam desinere comedere poterat, cum coepisset.

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the spread of Ocapa, picked up his cutlery, and scooped a spoonful into his mouth.
unit.target: Lumian praeparationem Ocapa contemplatus, utensilia sua sustulit, et cochlearem in os suum admisit.

unit.source: The fragrance of the leaves, the salted egg yolk, the weightiness of the rice, the tenderness of the chicken, the softness of the potatoes, and the strange rich aroma combined to create a unique texture.
unit.target: Fragrantia foliorum, vitellus salatus, gravitas oryzae, teneritas gallinae, mollitia patatarum, et insolitus dives odor simul confluunt ut texturam unicam creent.

unit.source: As Lumian ate, he casually surveyed the pedestrians and café patrons on the street.
unit.target: Dum Lumian edebat, pedestres et convivas cauponae in platea leviter observabat.

unit.source: After the sorrow and fear of the previous night, they had become gentle again, no longer revealing excessive emotions.
unit.target: Post dolorem et timorem noctis praeteritae, iterum miti facti erant, neque nimias affectus ostendebant.

unit.source: When they spoke to others, they always had a faint smile on their faces.
unit.target: Cum aliis loquebantur, in vultibus semper tenui risu lucebat.

unit.source: After Ludwig finished his second meal of the morning, Lumian found a secluded corner, changed into winter clothes, and disappeared from Tizamo with him and Lugano.
unit.target: Postquam Ludovicus secundae mensae matutinae consummavit, Lumian angulum solitarium invenit, in vestimenta hiemalia se mutavit, et cum eo atque Lugano ex Tizamo evanuit.

unit.source: This time, Lumian refrained from teleporting directly to Franca, as Lugano, Ludwig, and the two Demonesses were unfamiliar with each other.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian directam translocationem ad Francam fugere constituit, quoniam Lugano, Ludovicus, et duae Daemones inter se ignotae erant.

unit.source: Lumian chose the rarely used entrance to Underground Trier in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
unit.target: Lumian ingressum raro adhibitum in Trier subterraneum, in Quartiere de la Cathédrale Commémorative, elegit.

unit.source: The trio swiftly outlined themselves on the steel steps.
unit.target: Trio celeriter se in gradibus ferreis compaginaverunt.

unit.source: Upon returning to the surface, Lumian spotted a few college students carrying carbide lamps and lanterns.
unit.target: Cum in superficiem rediit, Lumian paucos studiosos collegii lucernas carbide et lanternas ferentes conspexit.

unit.source: They jested as they passed by the trio and entered Underground Trier.
unit.target: Iocabantur dum trio praeterierunt et ad Trier subterraneum intraverunt.

unit.source: As he turned onto the nearest main street, the first thing Lumian saw was a scantily clad man in chains.
unit.target: Cum ad viam principalem propinquissimam vertit, primum quod Lumian vidit, vir tenuis vestitus in catenis erat.

unit.source: He crawled slowly along the street in a dog-like manner.
unit.target: Lente per viam reperebat, more canino.

unit.source: If anyone dared to glance at him, he would glare back and bark twice.
unit.target: Si quis ausus esset eum intuendi, ille rigide respexit et bis latravit.

unit.source: In the next moment, the street artists on the corner played a rhythmic melody.
unit.target: In proximo momento, artifices plateae in angulo melodiam rhythmicam canebant.

unit.source: Passersby more or less danced with relaxed and satisfied smiles on their faces.
unit.target: Transiens viatores fere saltabant, vultibus leniter ac laete subridens.

unit.source: The man acting as a dog and trembling in the cold wind also raised his hind leg.
unit.target: Vir, canis imitando et in frigidis ventis trepidans, etiam crus posterius levavit.

unit.source: This was very different from the streets in the market district.
unit.target: Hoc valde differebat ab viis in regione mercaturae.

unit.source: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative was renowned for its numerous universities.
unit.target: Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative notus erat plurimis universitatibus.

unit.source: Lumian averted his gaze from the pedestrians’ smiles and led Lugano and Ludwig to Anthony’s nearby rented house.
unit.target: Lumian oculos a risibus pedestrianorum avertit et Lugano atque Ludovicum ad domum locatam prope Anthony duxit.

unit.source: It was on the fourth floor, near the end of the corridor.
unit.target: Ea erat in quarto tabulato, prope finem corridorii.

unit.source: Knock! Knock! Knock! Lumian knocked on the door without hesitation.
unit.target: Trepida! Trepida! Trepida! Lumian ianuam sine mora pulsavit.

unit.source: Soon, he saw Anthony, who was dressed differently from before.
unit.target: Mox Anthony vidit, qui aliter quam antea indutus erat.

unit.source: In a white shirt, light gray cashmere sweater, black tweed coat, dark-red bow tie, gold-rimmed glasses, and a light-yellow wig, his beard was cleanly shaven, and his face was no longer greasy.
unit.target: Indutus camisia alba, subucula leviter cinerea, palton nigro ex tweedo, nodo rubro obscuro, oculis marginatis aureis, et parva capillo flavido, barba eius mundate abscissa erat, et facies eius non iam unguentata videbatur.

unit.source: The black grime in his pores was gone.
unit.target: Nigra immunditia in poris eius evanuerat.

unit.source: He had the air of a successful member of high society.
unit.target: Eius habitus significabat eum esse felicem membrum ordinis altissimi.

unit.source: “Are you in a relationship?” Lumian jested.
unit.target: "Esne in aliqua relatione amorosa?" iocatus est Lumian.

unit.source: Anthony replied with a smile, “I’m attending a banquet hosted by the Trier Psychiatrist Guild today.”
unit.target: Anthony subridens respondit: "Hodie ad convivium a Gilda Medicae Mentis Trieris hospitato adsum."

unit.source: This was a necessary prerequisite for completing Madam Justice’s mission.
unit.target: Hoc erat necessaria praevia condicio ad perficiendam missionem Dominae Iustitiae.

unit.source: Lumian entered the room and asked casually, “Have you obtained a psychiatrist license?”
unit.target: Lumian in conclave intravit et comiter quaesivit: "Licentiam psychiatricae acceperis?"

unit.source: Anthony nodded.
unit.target: Anthony annuit.

unit.source: “I acquired a genuine identity and educational background.
unit.target: "Veram identitatem et fundamenta educationis accepi.

unit.source: During the interview, I successfully ‘convinced’ the examiner.”
unit.target: Inter colloquium, examinatorum feliciter persuasi sum.

unit.source: “A genuine identity?
unit.target: "Vera identitas?

unit.source: Where’s its original owner?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
unit.target: "Ubi est eius auctor originarius?" inquit Lumian cogitans.

unit.source: Anthony glanced at Lugano and Ludwig but didn’t directly answer Lumian’s question.
unit.target: Anthony Lugano et Ludovicum intuebatur, sed non directe quaestioni Lumiani respondit.

unit.source: “What can I do for you?”
unit.target: "Quid pro te facere possum?"

unit.source: Lumian understood Anthony’s meaning and temporarily abandoned the question.
unit.target: Lumian sensum Antonii intellexit et quaestionem per tempus reliquit.

unit.source: He briefly mentioned the Dream Festival’s situation and the aftereffects of Lugano losing his arm in the dream.
unit.target: Brevi memoravit rem Festivalis Somniorum et post effecta quod Lugano in somnio brachium amiserat.

unit.source: He didn’t mention how Lugano had lost his arm.
unit.target: Non memoravit quo modo Lugano brachium amisset.

unit.source: Anthony listened attentively and looked at Lugano.
unit.target: Anthony attente audivit et ad Lugano conspexit.

unit.source: “Such hysteria is easily resolved.
unit.target: "Talis hysteria facile solvitur.

unit.source: Do you need a faster solution, or do you want it to be slower and gentler?”
unit.target: "Vel solutionem rapidorem desideras, an mavis ut tardius et lenius fiat?"

unit.source: Lugano replied without hesitation, “The faster one.”
unit.target: Lugano sine mora respondit: "Celerior."

unit.source: He had lost control of his right forearm!
unit.target: Brachium dextrum suum imperii amisit!

unit.source: Anthony’s gaze shifted to Lugano’s left side, furrowing his brow.
unit.target: Aspectus Antonii ad partem sinistram Luganorum vertit, fronte corrugata.

unit.source: Lugano subconsciously turned to his left and followed suit.
unit.target: Lugano subconscie ad sinistram conversus, eius vestigium secutus est.

unit.source: At that moment, Anthony produced a dagger from nowhere and thrust it at Lugano’s right forearm.
unit.target: Illo momento, Anthony dagam ex nihilo extraxit et in brachium dextro Luganorum impulit.

unit.source: Lugano swiftly retracted his hand and blurted out, “What are you doing!?”
unit.target: Lugano celeriter manum retraxit et exclamavit: "Quid agis!?"

unit.source: Anthony sheathed his dagger and replied calmly, “The treatment is over.”
unit.target: Anthony dagam recubuit et tranquille respondit: "Cura finita est."

unit.source: “Huh?” Lugano looked at his right hand in confusion and realized that it had “retracted” to his chest without being impeded.
unit.target: "Quid?" Lugano manum dextram, confusus, aspexit et intellexit eam ad pectus retractam esse sine obstaculo.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said to Lugano, “Keep an eye on Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian subridens ad Lugano dixit: "Circumspice Ludovicum.

unit.source: Remember to prepare food for him.”
unit.target: Memento ei cibum parare.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lugano’s response, Lumian turned to Anthony.
unit.target: Nisi responsum Luganorum exspectans, Lumian ad Anthoniam conversus est.

unit.source: “Let’s go find Franca and Jenna now.”
unit.target: "Eamus nunc Francam et Jennam invenire."

unit.source: Anthony glanced at Lumian and adjusted the gold‐rimmed glasses he was unaccustomed to.
unit.target: Anthony ad Lumian intuebatur et oculos auratis liminatis, quos non assuefactus erat, corrigebat.

unit.source: “Alright.”
unit.target: "Bene."

unit.source: 701 The Cheerful Franca
unit.target: 701 Franca Laeta

unit.source: In Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: In Quartiere Cathédralae Commemorativae, Habitaculum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

unit.source: Franca, dressed in a camel-colored cashmere coat, shivered and said to Lumian, “As soon as I have the money, I’m definitely renting a villa with underfloor heating!”
unit.target: Franca, induta pallio cashmere coloris camelus habente, tremuit et ad Lumian dixit: “Quo mox pecuniam habeam, certe vilam cum calefactione sub pavimento conducam!”

unit.source: The concept of underfloor heating was proposed by Emperor Roselle.
unit.target: Conceptus calefactionis sub pavimento a Imperatore Roselle propositus est.

unit.source: By laying metal pipes in the house during construction, boiling water could flow through them, providing summer-like warmth in confined spaces and keeping out the cold weather.
unit.target: Perponendo fistulas metallicas in domo tempore constructionis, aqua fervens per eas fluere poterat, praebens aestate similem calorem in spatiis arctis atque frigora repellens.

unit.source: This was a must-have amenity for Trier’s current upscale residences.
unit.target: Hoc erat munus necessarium pro residentibus opulentibus Trier.

unit.source: “Why would a Demoness like you be afraid of the cold?” Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: “Cur daemonissa ut tu frigore timere velis?” inquit Lumian irridens.

unit.source: He glanced at Jenna and noticed she was wearing a black cotton dress and dark makeup, as if portraying a Witch or Vampire in the little details of her daily life.
unit.target: Illum intuefactus ad Jennam, animadvertitque eam gerere vestem ex cotone nigro et ornata lineamentis obscuris, quasi in minutis vitae suae partibus magam aut vampyram depingere velle.

unit.source: “I’m not a Pyromaniac. A Demoness’s black flames have no temperature!” Franca retorted with a smile.
unit.target: “Non sum pyromaniaca. Flammae nigrae daemonissae nullam habent temperiem!” inquit Franca subridente.

unit.source: Lumian casually settled onto the divan.
unit.target: Lumian leviter in divano consedit.

unit.source: “Aren’t Demonesses skilled with ice? Don’t they have resistance to frost and cold?”
unit.target: Nonne daemonissae in glacie peritissimae sint? Nonne ad rigorem et frigorem resistent?

unit.source: Franca reclined in her recliner, pulled up a cashmere blanket, and chuckled.
unit.target: Franca in suo lecto reclinato, stragulum cashmere sublatum, atque risu excussit.

unit.source: “I admit my performance just now was a little exaggerated, but Trier’s winters really are cold. It’s mainly because it’s so humid. It’s like being soaked in a semi-frozen lake.”
unit.target: Admitto meum actuam nuper paulum exagitatum fuisse, sed hiemes Trier vere frigidae sunt.

unit.source: After the small talk, Franca sighed and said, “I’ve already obtained more information about Moran Avigny and the corresponding security detail. We can put the capture plan on the agenda. And you, my friend, are about to participate in the Dream Festival. Talk about a scheduling conflict.”
unit.target: Post sermones leves, Franca suspiravit et dixit: “Iam plura de Moran Avigny et de securitatis apparato cognovi. Consilium de captura in agenda ponere possumus. Et tu, amice, mox in Festival Somniorum participabis. Quam conflictum horarium!”

unit.source: Lumian’s expression remained unchanged as he replied, “The Dream Festival is over.”
unit.target: Figura Lumiani immota mansit, cum respondit: “Festival Somniorum peractum est.”

unit.source: “Huh?” Franca and Jenna were taken aback.
unit.target: “Heu?” Franca et Jenna obstupefactae erant.

unit.source: Already?
unit.target: Iam?

unit.source: Lumian recounted everything that had transpired during the Dream Festival, including Madam Magician’s subsequent explanation.
unit.target: Lumian omnia quae in Festival Somniorum facta erant recitavit, necnon explanationem subsequens a Domina Magica.

unit.source: Of course, as the name Farbauti couldn’t be pronounced in any language, Lumian referred to it as the Devil Monarch and replaced Naboredisley with “the Demon with a long name.”
unit.target: Certe, cum nomen Farbauti in quacumque lingua pronuntiari non posset, Lumian illud appellavit “Monarcha Diaboli” et Naboredisley substituit cum “daemonem nomine longo.”

unit.source: Franca’s breathing quickened upon hearing that Lumian had donned a golden mask and spotted the suspected Underworld Daoist.
unit.target: Francae respiratio celeravit, audito nuntio quod Lumian larvam auream induisset et suspectum Taoista Inferni conspexisset.

unit.source: Lumian’s description of the Underworld Daoist’s attire made her eyes light up like sunlight dancing on a lake.
unit.target: Descriptio Lumiani de habitu Taoista Inferni oculos eius fulgere fecit, velut radios solis in lacu saltantes.

unit.source: Thankfully, her self-control was impressive.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, eius continentia praeclara erat.

unit.source: She endured until Lumian finished explaining the entire situation before asking anxiously, “Will there be another Dream Festival next year?”
unit.target: Patienter sustinuit donec Lumian totam rem enarravit, et deinde sollicite rogavit: “Eruntne iterum Festival Somniorum proximo anno?”

unit.source: “You want to participate in next year’s Dream Festival and come into direct contact with the Underworld Daoist?” Lumian could guess Franca’s thoughts.
unit.target: “Visne proximo anno in Festival Somniorum participare atque directe cum Taoista Inferni contactum habere?” Lumian putavit Francae cogitationes.

unit.source: Franca nodded emphatically.
unit.target: Franca vehementer annuit.

unit.source: “I believe that if the Underworld Daoist can bestow the Evernight pathway’s power on Amandina, I, uh, a Demoness, shouldn’t have any issues either. I wouldn’t mind taking Him as my master!”
unit.target: “Credo, si Taoista Inferni potest viam Noctis Aeternae potentiam Amandinae tribuere, ego daemonissa quoque non difficultate laborabo; non mihi molestum erit eum magistro meo accipere!”

unit.source: “Don’t worry. As long as I remain lucid, I won’t unleash my bestial instincts during the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: “Noli solliciti esse. Dummodo mens mea lucida maneat, instinctus bestiales meos in Festival Somniorum non eruam.”

unit.source: She teased herself.
unit.target: Se iocose vexavit.

unit.source: Originally, you wanted to say that you’re from the same homeland and not a Demoness, right?
