unit.target: Initio, volebāsne dicere te eadem patria esse et non daemonissa esse, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “It’s not impossible, but you have to become an Angel first.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Non est impossibile, sed necesse est ut primo angelus fias.”

unit.source: “…” Franca fell silent.
unit.target: “...” Franca tacuit.

unit.source: Jenna pondered and said, “There’s something I don’t understand. Isn’t it the case that after obtaining the ability to stay lucid in the special dream, the corresponding dream projection will gradually dissipate? Why didn’t Hisoka’s?”
unit.target: Jenna meditata est et dixit: “Aliquid mihi incertum est. Nonne, postquam facultatem lucidi somnii specialis obtinetur, eius proiectio somnii paulatim evanescit? Cur Hisoka non fecit hoc?”

unit.source: Lumian had already considered this question.
unit.target: Lumian hanc quaestionem iam cogitaverat.

unit.source: “Perhaps this is one of the reasons Hisoka had to leave Tizamo.
unit.target: “Forsitan haec est una ex causis quae Hisoka Tizamo relinquere coegit.

unit.source: “The ability to stay lucid in the special dream shouldn’t be permanent. Once you leave Tizamo, it will gradually fade. Therefore, Hisoka not only had to leave Tizamo, but also had to return two to three times a year for at least a week each time to maintain the existence of the dream projection.”
unit.target: “Facultas ut in somnio speciali lucida maneas non debet permanere. Quoniam Tizamo relinqueris, ea paulatim evanescet. Ita Hisoka non solum Tizamo relinquere debuit, sed etiam bis ad ter in anno, saltem per hebdomadam singulis vice, redire oportuit ut proiectionis somnii existentia servaretur.”

unit.source: After discussing the Dream Festival, Franca briefly recounted the information she had obtained from 007 the previous night.
unit.target: Postquam de Festival Somniorum dissererunt, Franca breviter recitavit informationes quas a 007 nocte praeterita adeptus erat.

unit.source: “Moran Avigny’s family has a long history.
unit.target: Familia Moran Avigny historiam longam habet.

unit.source: Members span the military, political, artistic, and business worlds.
unit.target: Membra eius in rebus militaribus, politicis, artisticis, et negotiis versantur.

unit.source: Combined with the information Madam Judgment gave us, I suspect this is a branch of the Tamara family.
unit.target: Coniuncta cum informationibus quas Domina Iudicium dedit, suspicor hanc esse ramum familiae Tamarae.

unit.source: Their dark-gray eyes are one of the defining characteristics of the Tamara bloodline!
unit.target: Oculi eorum fuscis et cinereis sunt, quae notae sunt definitoriae stirpis Tamarae!

unit.source: Of course, not everyone with dark-gray eyes belongs to the Tamara family.
unit.target: Certe, non omnes cum oculis fuscis et cinereis familiae Tamarae pertinent.

unit.source: It’s more that members of the family are likely to have dark-gray eyes.
unit.target: Potissimum, membris familiae verisimile est oculos fuscos et cinereos habere.

unit.source: Based on the close connection between a large branch of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect, it’s very likely that Demoness of Black Clarice also shares the Tamara family’s bloodline.
unit.target: Ex intima nexu inter amplam partem familiae Tamarae et Sectam Daemonissarum, verisimile est Demonissam Nigram Claricem etiam stirpis Tamarae sanguinem communicare.

unit.source: Following my hypothesis, the Demoness of Black might be a mixed-blood descendant of the Sauron family who pledged allegiance to the Demoness Sect and the Tamara family.”
unit.target: Secundum hypothesim meam, Demonissa Nigrum fortasse sit descendentia mixti sanguinis ex familia Sauron, quae fidem Sectae Daemonissarum et familiae Tamarae dedit.

unit.source: This was the only explanation for Demoness of Black Clarice’s reaction when she heard about the Sauron family.
unit.target: Haec sola erat explanatio reactionis Demonissae Nigrae Clarice, cum de familia Sauron audiret.

unit.source: It was also the only explanation for her indulging Browns Sauron!
unit.target: Haec etiam sola erat explanatio indulgentiae eius erga “Browns Sauron”!

unit.source: Lumian didn’t interrupt as Franca continued, “We need to face not only Moran Avigny but also the hidden Tamara family and the Mirror People faction.
unit.target: Lumian non intermisit, dum Franca continuabat: “Non solum Moran Avigny, sed etiam familiam Tamara latentem atque factionem Hominum Specularum oppugnare debemus.

unit.source: Moran Avigny might possess powerful Beyonder powers himself.
unit.target: Moran Avigny ipse fortasse potentiam Beyonder praeclaram possidet.

unit.source: Furthermore, Bureau 8, Purifiers, and Machinery Hivemind rotate daily, with a regular Beyonder team providing protection.
unit.target: Praeterea, Bureau 8, Purificatores, et Machinae Hivemind quotidie variari solent, turma Beyonder ordinaria tutela praebens.

unit.source: What my friend means is that if we’re unafraid of sacrifice, there’s still a chance of assassinating Moran Avigny. However, capturing him alive or channeling his spirit is very difficult and dangerous.”
unit.target: Quod amicus meus significat est, si nullus timor sacrificii nos impedit, adhuc occasio existit ut Moran Avigny occidamus. Attamen, eum vivum capere aut spiritum eius canalizare valde difficile et periculosum est.

unit.source: What 007 truly meant was that the Purifiers wouldn’t go easy on us or provide overt assistance.
unit.target: Quod 007 vere intendebat, fuit quod Purificatores nobis non leniter se gerent nec auxilium apertum praebeant.

unit.source: However, if Moran Avigny’s true nature as a Mirror Person is exposed after his death, 007 would find a way to allow us—the captured assassins—an opportunity to escape, just like when Jenna killed Hugues Artois.
unit.target: Attamen, si vera natura Moran Avigny ut Homo Specularis post mortem revelatur, 007 viam inveniret ut nobis—captis sicariis—occasionem ad effugiendum daret, sicut cum Jenna Hugues Artois interemit.

unit.source: However, if we didn’t want to obtain more information about the Mirror People through Moran Avigny, wouldn’t it be better to inform the authorities and let them handle the arrest?
unit.target: Attamen, si plura de Hominibus Specularibus per Moran Avigny non cupimus adipisci, nonne melius esset auctoritatibus referre et eos de captu agere sinere?

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and said to Franca, “Let’s not rush into a plan. We’ll discuss it tomorrow.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper cogitavit et Francae dixit: “Nolimus consilium festinanter capere. Cras de eo disputabimus.”

unit.source: “Why wait until tomorrow?” Franca asked, holding the stack of papers 007 had given her.
unit.target: “Cur cras exspectare?” rogavit Franca, tenens fasciculum chartarum quas 007 ei dederat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “After I find a safe place to complete my advancement and become a Fate Appropriator, perhaps a special, mixed ability related to fate will appear. That might help us obtain new ideas and come up with more effective solutions.”
unit.target: “Postquam locum tutum inveni ad progressionem meam complendam et Fatum Appropriator fieri, fortasse specialis et mixtae naturae facultas, de fato pertinens, apparebit. Quod nos adiuvabit ad novas ideas obtinendas et solutiones efficaciores excogitandas.”

unit.source: In the current four-person team, it was no secret that Lumian possessed the power of the Inevitability pathway.
unit.target: In turma quatuor personarum, non erat ignotum quod Lumian potentiam itineris Inevitabilitatis haberet.

unit.source: Franca blurted out in surprise, “You can obtain a new boon so quickly?”
unit.target: Franca obstupita exclamavit: “Tam celeriter novum donum adipisci potes?”

unit.source: “Didn’t I just mention it?” Lumian smiled. “I culled nearly 20 Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 bestowed in one go, significantly digesting the potion.”
unit.target: “Non numquamne id dixeram?” subridens Lumian respondit: “Aggregavi fere viginti ‘Sequence 6’ atque ‘Sequence 5’ simul, potionem valde bene digerens.”

unit.source: Franca pursed her lips and signaled to Lumian with her eyes: Look, look into my eyes! They’re filled with jealousy!
unit.target: Franca labra contraxit et oculis Lumiano signavit: “Ecce, ecce intuere oculos meos! Iis plenis invidiae sunt!”

unit.source: Lumian turned to Anthony and asked, “What did you mean by genuine identity?”
unit.target: Lumian ad Anthonium conversus rogavit: “Quid per genuinam identitatem intellexisti?”

unit.source: Anthony, who had been listening quietly and was on the verge of being forgotten, explained simply, “Actually, it was a hint from Madam Justice. That identity is very strange. His background, education, and experiences are all real, but there’s actually no such person. And the people who might expose this are either long dead or out of town, the kind who won’t return for years.”
unit.target: Anthony, qui quiete auscultabat et iam fere oblivioni tradebatur, simpliciter explicavit: “Revera, id fuit insigne a Domina Iudicium. Illa identitas valde mirabilis est: eius originis, eruditionis, et experientiarum omnes verae sunt, sed re vera talis persona non existit. Et homines qui hoc revelare poterunt, vel iam diu mortui sunt vel extra urbem manent, neque per annos redire volunt.”

unit.source: Franca made a judgment based on her experience. “It seems it was meticulously crafted years in advance as a disguise.”
unit.target: Franca, ex experientia sua, iudicavit: “Videtur annos praevisa esse subtiliter compositum ut larva.”

unit.source: Since they weren’t discussing a plan to deal with Moran Avigny today, Anthony didn’t stay long. He had to prepare for tonight’s banquet.
unit.target: Cum hodie de consilio ad Moran Avigny agendum non disseretur, Anthonius non diutius mansit; praeparare cenam huius noctis debebat.

unit.source: “Where do you plan to advance to Fate Appropriator?” Jenna asked Lumian. “The sacrificial square in the catacombs?”
unit.target: “Quo locum intendis ad Fatum Appropriator ascendere?” rogavit Jenna Lumian. “Platea sacrificii in catacumbis?”

unit.source: It belonged to two orthodox gods and could protect advancers from additional interference.
unit.target: Illud duobus deorum orthodoxis pertinuit et progressores a perturbationibus ulterioribus tutari poterat.

unit.source: “I’m afraid I’ll trigger a taboo and be purified by sunlight,” Lumian dismissed the suggestion with amusement.
unit.target: “Timeo ne tabum incitet et luce solari purgabor,” inquit Lumian subridens.

unit.source: “Advancing to Conspirer is different from advancing to Fate Appropriator.”
unit.target: Ascendere ad Conspiratorem aliter est quam ad Fatum Appropriator progredi.

unit.source: One belonged to the pathways of the divine, while the other belonged to an evil god’s domain!
unit.target: Unus pertinebat ad semitas divinas, alter vero ad dominium dei mali!

unit.source: Lumian had already decided on a location to advance.
unit.target: Lumian iam locum progrediendi statuit.

unit.source: It was the Nation of the Evernight!
unit.target: Erat Natio Noctis Aeternae!

unit.source: Termiboros’s well-behaved nature kept Lumian concerned that He was waiting for an opportunity to stir up trouble.
unit.target: Comportatio modesta Termiboros Lumian curavit, ne ille occasionem tumultum excitandi exspectaret.

unit.source: And as a Fate Appropriator began to involve core abilities in the Inevitability domain, it was very likely that Termiboros would tamper at this Sequence.
unit.target: Et cum Fatum Appropriator virtutes nucleares in campo Inevitabilitatis implicare inciperet, verisimile erat Termiboros in hoc ordine immiscere.

unit.source: Therefore, Lumian had to be cautious. He planned to advance in a safe place that could eliminate many external influences.
unit.target: Itaque, Lumian cautus esse debebat. Cogitavit se in loco tuto progredi, qui multas influentias externas extruere posset.

unit.source: Among them, the Nation of the Evernight was the best choice.
unit.target: Inter ea, Natio Noctis Aeternae optima electio erat.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian had planned to contact Hela in the next two days to share information about the Underworld Daoist and the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian conciliaverat ut Hela per proximos duas dies contactaret ad informationes de Taoista Inferni et Festival Somniorum communicandas.

unit.source: Franca looked at Lumian in enlightenment. “You want to advance at our mysticism gathering?”
unit.target: Franca, lumine in vultu, intuens Lumian, dixit: “Visne apud conventum mysticum nostrum progredi?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit; Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: Franca, who was in a good mood, took the initiative to help. “I’ll help you write the letter!”
unit.target: Franca, bona mente afficta, inceptum tulit: “Adiuvabo te epistulam scribere!”

unit.source: After she entered the bedroom and closed the door, Lumian looked at Jenna and said, “You’re very quiet today.”
unit.target: Postquam in cubiculum ingressa et ianuam clausit, Lumian Jennam respexit et dixit: “Hodie valde tacita es.”

unit.source: Jenna smiled. “An excellent theater actress must know how to act like a lady.”
unit.target: Jenna subridens inquit: “Elegans actrix scaenica sciat ut quasi domina agat.”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Franca’s door.
unit.target: Lumian Francae ianuam intuens.

unit.source: “Madame Red Boots seems to be in high spirits today. She’s cracking jokes left and right.”
unit.target: “Domina Red Boots hodie animose se habet; iocos huc atque illuc iacit.”

unit.source: “It’s true she’s been in a good mood recently,” Jenna replied truthfully.
unit.target: “Certe, nuper bonam animum habuit,” respondit Jenna veraciter.

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully and didn’t probe further.
unit.target: Lumian cogitans annuit et amplius non quaesivit.

unit.source: Jenna’s lips curled into a smile. “Why don’t you keep asking?”
unit.target: Labia Jenna in risu subacta sunt. “Cur non pergas quaerere?”

unit.source: Lumian leaned back on the sofa and laughed self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Lumian in sofa recubuit et se ipsum humiliter subridens cachinnavit.

unit.source: “My sister once taught me that there’s no need to inquire too deeply about certain matters. If I know too much, I might regret it. I might even have to face problems I’m unwilling to face.”
unit.target: “Soror mea olim me docuit: non opus est nimis percontari de rebus, nam si nimis sciam, paenitem, atque fortasse difficultates subire debeam quas nolo subire.”

unit.source: Jenna listened attentively, placed her hand on her cheek, and asked with a smile, “What are you afraid of?”
unit.target: Jenna attente auscultavit, manum in maxillam posuit, et subridens rogavit: “Quid times?”

unit.source: Lumian strategically took a sip of black tea and said, “It’s not fear; it’s respect.”
unit.target: Lumian callide sorbetum theae nigrae bibit, et dixit: “Non timor est; reverentia est.”

unit.source: Jenna gazed at him and suddenly laughed.
unit.target: Jenna eum intuens subito risit.

unit.source: She didn’t press further and chatted with Lumian about the details of Tizamo.
unit.target: Ea non pergere insitit et cum Lumiano de singularibus Tizamo disseruit.

unit.source: Before long, Franca opened the door and exclaimed with a smile, “It’s on for tonight!”
unit.target: Mox Franca ianuam aperuit et subridens exclamavit: “Hodie nocte incipit!”

unit.source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian and Franca swiftly materialized, and Hela was already waiting.
unit.target: Ad horam decimam post meridiem, in antiquo et ruinoso palatio Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian et Franca celeriter apparuerunt, et Hela iam exspectabat.

unit.source: 702 Fate Appropriator
unit.target: 702 Fatum Appropriator

unit.source: Before Lumian had a chance to say anything, Franca eagerly recounted the events involving the Underworld Daoist during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian aliquid dicere poterat, Franca alacriter narravit eventus de Daoista Infernali in Festo Somniorum.

unit.source: She said excitedly, “The interaction between our two worlds is even more intricate than I had imagined!”
unit.target: Ea alacriter dixit: “Conexio inter nostros orbes etiam subtilior est quam putaveram!”

unit.source: “Who would have thought there was another point of interaction beyond the Samaritan Women’s Spring, and it’s all tied to that mysterious illusory river.”
unit.target: Quis putavit alium punctum communicationis ultra Fons Samaritarum Feminarum exsistere, atque omnia ad illum mysteriosum fluvium illusorium conexa esse?

unit.source: Silently, Franca mused, It’s a shame we still haven’t located the man believed to be from our world who was seen on the fourth level of the catacombs…
unit.target: Tacite, Franca meditabatur: “Paenitet quod nondum invenimus virum, qui ex nostro orbe esse creditur et qui in quarto gradu catacumbarum apparuit...”

unit.source: Seriously, what’s taking 007, no—the Eternal Blazing Sun Church so long?
unit.target: Serio, quid cunctatur 007, immo—Ecclesia Aeterni Solis Ardens ita diu?

unit.source: They haven’t even tracked down the traitor who worked with April Fool’s…
unit.target: Neque traditorem quidem, qui cum “Aprilis Insulso” operatus est, detexerunt…

unit.source: Once Franca had finished speaking, Lumian provided a concise explanation of the origins of the black ancient tomb and the ancient corpse.
unit.target: Postquam Franca finivit loqui, Lumian explicationem succinctam de origine sepulcri antiqui nigri et cadaveris antiqui praebuit.

unit.source: Hela, still in her black widow attire, listened intently, gently nodding her head.
unit.target: Hela, adhuc induta in habitu viduae nigrae, attente auscultabat et caput leniter annuens movebat.

unit.source: “It’s now evident that the illusory river isn’t a reference to the River Styx.
unit.target: Nunc perspicuum est flumen illusorium non referre ad flumen Styx.

unit.source: It must be something far more significant than that.”
unit.target: Id quidem esse debet aliquid multo grave.

unit.source: “Absolutely.”
unit.target: Certe.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t caught off guard by Hela’s statement.
unit.target: Lumian verba Helae non obstupefactus fuit.

unit.source: “The black ancient tomb doesn’t just embody the power of the Death pathway; it also represents the Evernight and Warrior pathways.”
unit.target: Non solum sepulcrum antiquum nigrum vim viae Mortis complectitur, sed etiam iter Perpetuae Noctis et Bellatorum repraesentat.

unit.source: In the current world, all the legends surrounding the River Styx were connected to death.
unit.target: In mundo hodierno, omnes fabulae circa flumen Styx ad mortem coniunctae erant.

unit.source: Lumian speculated that this might involve beings such as the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Mother Tree of Desire, and the Great Mother, who held multiple thrones linked to various pathways.
unit.target: Lumian coniecerat hoc fortasse implicare entia, ut Dignus Caelestis de Caelo et Terra pro Benedictionibus, Mater Arbor Desiderii, et Magna Mater, quae plura thronos ad varias viarum relationes nectos tenet.

unit.source: Hela glanced at Franca, falling silent for a moment before speaking.
unit.target: Hela Francae aspexit, paulisper tacita manens antequam loqui coepit.

unit.source: “If the Armored Shadow is right, the Underworld Daoist is in a precarious state.
unit.target: Si Umbra Armata recte censet, Daoista Infernalis in statu incerto versatur.

unit.source: If you intend to interact with Him, you must exercise extreme caution and ensure you have an escape route from the corresponding area.”
unit.target: Si cum eo colloqui vis, summa cautela utenda est, atque exitus via ex illa regione tibi praeparandus sit.

unit.source: The Armored Shadow had described the Underworld Daoist as having “sacrificed himself to enter the river,” implying the sacrifice of one’s physical form or life.
unit.target: Umbra Armata Daoistam Infernalis ita descripserat: “se ipsum sacrificavit ad flumen intrandum,” insinuans sacrificium corporis aut vitae.

unit.source: “I understand.”
unit.target: Intellego.

unit.source: Franca let out a sigh.
unit.target: Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: “I’ll give this matter more thought once I reach Sequence 5.”
unit.target: Hanc rem plenius meditabor, cum ad Sequenciam 5 perveniam.

unit.source: As she sighed, a smug thought crossed her mind, The Pleasure potion has been largely digested lately.
unit.target: Dum suspirabat, superbia cogitatio pervenit: “Potio Voluptatis nuper valde digesta est.”

unit.source: Even without additional opportunities, I can start preparing for the Demoness of Affliction’s advancement ritual within two to three months…
unit.target: Etiam sine ulterioribus occasionibus, intra duos ad tres menses ritum progressionis Daemones Afflictionis praeparare possum.

unit.source: I need to begin gathering the necessary potion ingredients now…
unit.target: Nunc incipere debeo necessaria potionis ingredientia colligere.

unit.source: I can’t mention it, I mustn’t mention it—I can’t let Lumian know.
unit.target: Id non dicere possum, non debeo dicere—non sinam Lumianum scire.

unit.source: Bragging would make me seem crass and disrespectful to Jenna…
unit.target: Iactantia me reddet ineptum ac contemptuosum in conspectu Jennæ.

unit.source: Lumian’s curious gaze alternated between Hela and Franca a couple of times.
unit.target: Oculus curiosus Lumiani inter Helam et Francam aliquoties alternavit.

unit.source: He sensed that Madame Hela had something crucial to tell Franca but refrained from doing so.
unit.target: Animadvertit Madama Helam aliquid grave Francæ habere dicendum, sed haec non narrare voluit.

unit.source: It was rare for Lumian to perceive Madame Hela as having something on her mind.
unit.target: Raro erat Lumiano Madama Helam aliquid in mente habere percipere.

unit.source: Her glance at Franca and a few seconds of silence gave him the impression of hesitancy.
unit.target: Aspectus eius ad Francam et paucis secundis silentii illi impressionem dubitationis dederunt.

unit.source: Regrettably, Franca often has a carefree nature and doesn’t pay much attention to details.
unit.target: Dolendum est quod Franca saepe naturæ levitas inest et parum ad minutias attendit.

unit.source: Otherwise, she might be able to extract some information from her through direct questioning…
unit.target: Alioquin, per quaestionem directam, fortasse aliqua indicia ab ea extrahere posset.

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced, and he concluded that if Madame Hela chose not to say anything at this point, she must have her reasons.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani celeriter currit, atque concludit, si Madama Hela hisce verbis non loqui velit, rationes suas habere oportere.

unit.source: Thus, he suppressed his curiosity and gestured towards the front of the dilapidated palace.
unit.target: Itaque curiositatem suam repressit et ad frontem palatii ruentis signavit.

unit.source: “I’ll get the ritual ready.”
unit.target: “Ritum praeparabo.”

unit.source: “Sounds good,” Franca responded with enthusiasm.
unit.target: “Optime, sonat,” Franca cum fervore respondit.

unit.source: While she had witnessed Lumian acquire Ascetic powers, that had taken place in Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Dum ipsa testata fuit Lumiani, qui potestates asceticas adeptus est, id in Aetate Quarta Trier evenit.

unit.source: A myriad of dangers had intertwined, causing her to shudder with fear.
unit.target: Mira pericula inter se contexerant, quae eam metu concutere fecerunt.

unit.source: She had to maintain constant vigilance of her surroundings, unable to “appreciate” the situation with the same level of ease as she could now.
unit.target: Oportebat illi circumiecta constanter observare, neque rem tam facili modo frui, ut nunc possset.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian retrieved a metal canister from a hidden pocket and tossed it to Franca.
unit.target: Post paulum meditationis, Lumian vas metallum ex sinu abscondito extraxit et Francæ jecit.

unit.source: “If things start going poorly for me later on, forcefully break through the wall of spirituality and throw this in front of me or on me.”
unit.target: “Si res posthac mihi male eveniant, per vim parietem spiritualitatis rumpito et hoc coram me aut in me proice.”

unit.source: “Should I unscrew the cap for you?” Franca asked, a smile playing on her lips.
unit.target: “Num tibi operculum aperire debeam?” Franca, subrisu labris, quaesivit.

unit.source: “What do you think?” Lumian arched an eyebrow.
unit.target: “Quid censes?” Lumian unam supercilium levavit.

unit.source: “Naturally,” Franca replied, her smile unwavering.
unit.target: “Certe,” Franca respondit, risu immotum.

unit.source: “I’m just trying to lighten the mood.”
unit.target: Modo conor animum levare.

unit.source: “I want you to feel at ease.”
unit.target: Volo ut te in tranquillitate sentias.

unit.source: “I appreciate it!” Lumian turned and made his way to the massive stone chair in the depths of the ancient palace.
unit.target: “Gratias ago!” Lumian versa est atque iter fecit ad magnam cathedram lapideam in profundis antiqui palatii.

unit.source: His intuition suggested that the huge, mottled stone chair might have a connection to Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Intuitus eius praebebat magnam cathedram lapideam maculatam fortasse nexum habere cum Domine Stulto.

unit.source: This would enable him to draw Mr. Fool’s attention during the impending ritual.
unit.target: Hoc ei licebit ut attentionem Domini Stulti in ritu imminente attrahere possit.

unit.source: As Franca and Hela watched Lumian arrange the corresponding items on the stone chair, setting it up as an altar and placing a Loen gold pound reverently in front of the grayish-white candle symbolizing the deity,
unit.target: Dum Franca et Hela spectabant Lumian res pertinentes in cathedra lapidea disponere, eam ut aram constituens et librum aureum Loen in honore ante candelae cinereo-alba deum repraesentantem collocans,

unit.source: Hela calmly remarked, “Don’t be concerned about not receiving a response. The secrets will remain secret, while the rest will be revealed.”
unit.target: Hela tranquille inquit: “Noli solliciti esse de responsione carente; secreta secreta manebunt, cetera vero revelabuntur.”

unit.source: Lumian felt himself relax as he consecrated the ritual silver dagger, erecting a wall of spirituality.
unit.target: Lumian se relaxare sensit, dum hasta argentea ritu sacrata consecrabat et murum spiritualitatis erigebat.

unit.source: The voices of Franca and Hela faded into the background, as if emanating from a great distance.
unit.target: Voces Francæ et Helae in obscuritate evanuerunt, quasi ex longe provenire videbantur.

unit.source: Rather than rushing into the ritual, Lumian lowered his voice and proactively provoked Termiboros.
unit.target: Potius quam in ritu festinare, Lumian vocem deminuit et Termiboronem provocavit.

unit.source: “I’m about to extract your power once more. Any thoughts on the matter?”
unit.target: “Iam iterum potentiam tuam extrahere vado. Habesne quid de hac re?”

unit.source: He aimed to enrage Termiboros to a certain degree.
unit.target: Ad Termiboronem ad certum gradum irascendum contendebat.

unit.source: Only then might Termiboros inadvertently expose any concealed issues in His response, allowing Lumian to discern whether this Inevitability Angel was secretly plotting something.
unit.target: Tum tantum Termiboros fortuito quaedam occultata in responso suo revelare posset, sinens Lumiano discernere num hic Angelus Inevitabilitatis insidiis quidpiam pararet.

unit.source: The sooner he uncovered it, the sooner he could address it and find a resolution!
unit.target: Quo citius id detegit, eo citius id solvere et consilium invenire poterit!

unit.source: Termiboros’s imposing voice resonated.
unit.target: Vox immanis Termiboronis resonabat.

unit.source: “The further you venture, the closer you draw to the end.
unit.target: Quo longius progreditur, eo propius ad finem accedis.

unit.source: This is an inevitability—irreversible.”
unit.target: Hoc fatum est—irreversibile.

unit.source: “Is that how you console yourself?” Lumian scoffed at Termiboros’s enigmatic behavior.
unit.target: “Sic te consolari?” Lumian, Termiboronis enigmatico more despectans, irridit.

unit.source: Termiboros’s voice reverberated within Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Vox Termiboronis per corpus Lumiani resonabat.

unit.source: “Boons bring the recipient closer to the bestower.”
unit.target: Beneficia accipientem propius faciunt ad largientem.

unit.source: “You may believe you’re extracting my power, but in truth, you’re steadily aligning your fate with mine, becoming more and more like me.”
unit.target: Fortasse putas te potentiam meam extrahere, sed re vera fatum tuum meum constanter alligere, te magis et magis me simile reddere.

unit.source: “This grants me glimpses through your eyes and your fate.”
unit.target: Hoc mihi sinit per oculos tuos atque fatum tuum intuenda.

unit.source: “You and I are merely bugs ensnared by fate.”
unit.target: Tu et ego non nisi insecta sumus, fata nos alligantia.

unit.source: "Apart from the greatest of existences, all living beings share this commonality."
unit.target: Praeter maxima existentia, omnia entia viventia hanc similitudinem habent.

unit.source: “In the near future, you will come to understand: “Death is the end of all things, and madness is an eternal melody.”
unit.target: Mox intelleges: “Mors finis est omnium rerum, et insania aeternum carmen est.”

unit.source: That’s essentially the same as saying nothing…
unit.target: Id fere nihil dicere significat.

unit.source: Is Termiboros implying that I will face a setback in the near future?
unit.target: An Termiboros insinuit me in proximo tempore casum adversum passurum esse?

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Are you deliberately saying this to make me obtain the power of a Fate Appropriator while burdened with worry and fear, hoping I’ll die here?”
unit.target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Num propositum dicis hoc ut mihi potentiam Fati Appropriatoris largiaris, sollicitus et timens, sperans me hic moriturum esse?”

unit.source: “Don’t concern yourself.”
unit.target: “Noli te sollicitare.”

unit.source: “Death and madness won’t deter me.”
unit.target: “Mors et insania me non detinent.”

unit.source: Without awaiting Termiboros’s reply, Lumian fixed his gaze upon the candle flame and recited in a deep, resonant voice, “Power of Inevitability!”
unit.target: Nisi responsum Termiboronis exspectans, Lumian oculum ad flammam candelae fixit et voce profunda resonante recitavit: “Potentia Inevitabilitatis!”

unit.source: “You are the past, the present, and the future;”
unit.target: “Tu es praeteritum, praesens, et futurum;”

unit.source: “You are the cause, the effect, and the process;”
unit.target: “Tu es causa, effectus, et processus;”

unit.source: As the ritual progressed, Franca and Hela bore witness to the transformation of all the items on the altar.
unit.target: Dum ritu procedebat, Franca et Hela transformationem omnium rerum in ara conspectae sunt.

unit.source: Stones softened, candles expanded, and the ground decayed into a swamp.
unit.target: Lapis mollivit, candelae expansae sunt, et terra in paludem corrupta est.

unit.source: Countless strange insects loomed in the void.
unit.target: Innumerabiles insecta mirabilia in inania eminuerunt.

unit.source: The darkness outside the dilapidated palace intensified.
unit.target: Tenebrae extra palatium lapsum intensiores factae sunt.

unit.source: A silver‑black liquid flowed from Lumian’s chest, enveloping him like corrupted mercury.
unit.target: Liquidum argentum‑nigrum ex pectore Lumiani fluxit, eum quasi mercurii corrupti involvens.

unit.source: Lumian writhed in agony.
unit.target: Lumian in dolore contortus est.

unit.source: Throughout this process, his body alternated between contortion and normalcy, occasionally assuming postures that defied human anatomy.
unit.target: Per hoc processum, corpus eius inter contorsionem et statum ordinarium alternabat, interdum habitus capiens qui anatomia humanam repugnant.

unit.source: It was as though he were boneless, his skin and flesh infused with mercury.
unit.target: Sicut sine ossibus esset, cutis et caro eius mercurio infusae erant.

unit.source: Franca was startled and experienced an inexplicable, illusory pain.
unit.target: Franca territa est et dolorem inenarrabilem, illusorium, sensit.

unit.source: Amidst the excruciating and familiar pain, Lumian caught sight of Aurore.
unit.target: Inter dolorem acerbum et notum, Lumian Aurorem animadvertit.

unit.source: Aurore, with her thick, long blond hair, was attempting the Soul Summoning Spell!
unit.target: Aurore, cum capillis fulvis crassis et longis, incantationem animarum evocandi conabatur!

unit.source: Lumian stepped forward and intervened, stopping Aurore.
unit.target: Lumian procedit et intervenit, Aurorem sistens.

unit.source: Just as he rejoiced in the belief that the problem had been nipped in the bud and Aurore wouldn’t fracture into the evil personality of Roche Louise Sanson, he was horrified to discover that Aurore’s body had undergone a drastic transformation.
unit.target: Mox, cum gaudebat credens problema in initio compositum esse et Aurore non in malam indolem Roche Louise Sanson degeneraturum esse, horridus invenit corpus eius transformationem radicalem subisse.

unit.source: In a bloody state, she had expanded into a monster with three heads and six arms, sitting cross‑legged.
unit.target: In statu sanguineo, expandit in monstrum tribus capitibus et sexque brachiis, sedens in cruce crurium.

unit.source: Lumian witnessed Aurore seeking assistance from Hela.
unit.target: Lumian conspexit Aurorem auxilium a Hela petentem.

unit.source: Reluctantly, he offered his help, preventing his sister from forgetting this matter.
unit.target: Reticentia, auxilium suum obtulit, ne sororem de hac re oblivisci sineret.

unit.source: However, when Hela arrived, Aurore had already transformed into a colossal three‑headed, six‑armed monster, despite the final ritual not having been performed.
unit.target: Sed, cum Hela advenisset, Aurore iam in monstrum colossale, tribus capitibus sexque brachiis, transmutata erat, quamquam ritu finali non peracto fuisse.

unit.source: Aurore, at various stages of life, appeared before Lumian.
unit.target: Aurore, variis vitae gradibus, ante Lumian apparuit.

unit.source: They were on the verge of making pivotal choices.
unit.target: Illi in limine decisionum gravium erant.

unit.source: Lumian desperately tried to alter the Aurores’ fates and prevent them from descending into the abyss.
unit.target: Lumian vehementer temptavit fata Auroræ mutare et impediere ne in abyssum demergerent.

unit.source: However, each time, although he managed to redirect fate to another tributary, Aurore’s spirit and flesh ultimately crumbled, transforming her into a three‑headed, six‑armed monster.
unit.target: Sed quovis tempore, licet fatum ad alium fluminis affluentem converteret, spiritus atque caro Aurore denique corruerunt, eam in monstrum tribus capitibus sexque brachiis transformantes.

unit.source: Is this inevitability?
unit.target: Hocne fatum est?

unit.source: Is this an irreversible outcome?
unit.target: Hocne exitus irreversibilis est?

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes turned bloodshot as he made increasingly futile efforts.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani in rubore sanguineo versuti sunt, dum conatus eius magis magisque frustra erant.

unit.source: At that instant, he caught a whiff of an elegant and sweet scent, and a soothing chant echoed in his ears.
unit.target: Illo momento, fragrans odor elegans et dulcis pervagatus est, atque cantus mollis in auribus eius resonabat.

unit.source: Lumian quickly regained his senses and clarity of mind.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter sensus suos et luciditatem mentis recuperavit.

unit.source: The Aurores before him abruptly vanished, leaving only the quietly burning candle flames.
unit.target: Aurores ante eum repente evanuerunt, relinquentes tantum flammas candelae tranquille ardentes.

unit.source: Instinctively, Lumian glanced behind him and realized that Franca and Hela were nearby.
unit.target: Instinctu, Lumian retrospiciens animadvertit Francam et Helam prope esse.

unit.source: The wall of spirituality had been shattered.
unit.target: Murus spiritualitatis dirutus erat.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Franca observed the flickering silver and iron‑black colors in Lumian’s eyes before they merged and settled into a silvery‑black hue.
unit.target: Simul, Franca animadvertit micantia colores argenteo et ferro nigri in oculis Lumiani, qui ante confluentes in unam umbram argenteo‑nigrum consederunt.

unit.source: Lumian exhaled, recognizing that he had evaded danger and successfully acquired the power of a Fate Appropriator.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, agnovens se periculum evaserit et potentiam Fati Appropriatoris feliciter adeptum esse.

unit.source: Yet, a profound sense of frustration and disappointment lingered within him.
unit.target: Attamen, profunda frustratio et desperatio in eo manebant.

unit.source: What he had just experienced in the illusion seemed to foretell the ultimate outcome of his desire to resurrect Aurore.
unit.target: Id quod modo in illusione expertus erat, videtur praenuntiare exitum ultimum eius desiderii Aurorem resurrectionis.

unit.source: After ten to twenty seconds, Lumian finally broke free from those emotions and regained his determination.
unit.target: Post decem ad viginti secundas, Lumian tandem his affectibus evasit et propositum suum recuperavit.

unit.source: How could anyone give up without even trying!
unit.target: Quomodo quisquam sine conatu deficere potest!

unit.source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief, screwed the cap back on, and asked with a smile, “How did it go? Any new abilities?”
unit.target: Franca suspiravit leviter, operculum redegit, et cum risu quaesivit: “Quomodo fuit? Novae virtutes suntne?”

unit.source: You really don’t consider yourself an outsider.
unit.target: Revera te extraneum non censes.

unit.source: How can you nonchalantly inquire about someone’s new Beyonder powers?
unit.target: Quomodo licet tibi tranquille interrogare de novis viribus Beyonder alicuius?

unit.source: Lumian silently criticized Franca as he meticulously observed his transformation.
unit.target: Lumian Francam silentio reprehendit, dum diligenter transformationem suam observabat.

unit.source: His eyes, which had just returned to normal, once again turned silvery‑black, reflecting the images of Franca and Hela.
unit.target: Oculi eius, qui modo ad statum normalem redierant, iterum in umbram argenteo‑nigrum conversa sunt, imagines Francæ et Helae reflectentes.

unit.source: Then, he perceived the mercury‑colored illusory river that corresponded to the two ladies.
unit.target: Deinde percipuit flumen illusorium colore mercurii, quod illis duabus congruens erat.

unit.source: He saw the sparkling light representing their past and present river trunks and the numerous tributaries that had branched off from the present.
unit.target: Vidit lumen effulgens, quod repraesentabat radices fluminum pristinarum et praesentium, atque innumerabiles affluentes, qui ex praesenti divergebant.

unit.source: The illusory river slowly advanced, devouring all the tributaries, leaving only one behind, transforming it into the main bulk.
unit.target: Flumen illusorium lente procedebat, omnes affluentes devorans, unum tantum relinquens, illud in corpus principale convertens.

unit.source: The main bulk continued to split into new tributaries…
unit.target: Corpus principale in novas affluentes dividere pergebat…

unit.source: Lumian noticed that one of the tributaries, regardless of whether it belonged to Franca or Hela, emitted a faint black hue.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit unum ex affluentibus, quod sive Francæ sive Helae pertineret, levem nigram colorem emittentem.

unit.source: Chapter 703: Fused Ability
unit.target: Capitulum 703: Facultas Coniuncta

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: Black… When it comes to luck, this color signifies they’ll face a deadly calamity…
unit.target: Niger… Quod ad fortunam attinet, hic color significat eos calamitate letali subiturum esse…

unit.source: If the hue isn’t dense, could it mean the calamity is potentially fatal but avoidable—that there’s a chance of overcoming it?
unit.target: Si color non est densus, an hoc significet calamitatem esse, potentialiter mortiferam sed vitabilem, et occasionem superandi praebere?

unit.source: Yes, I watch others going forward.
unit.target: Ita, ego alios procedentes observo.

unit.source: I might spot dense black.
unit.target: Fortasse ego densum nigrum percipere possum.

unit.source: Maybe that implies if the corresponding tributary is selected, a deadly fate is sealed…
unit.target: Forsitan hoc indicat, si tributaria electa fuerit, fatum letale signatum esse…

unit.source: Lumian continued observing Franca and Hela’s fates, forming a related hypothesis.
unit.target: Lumian fata Francae et Helae perseveranter observabat, hypothesim ad rem cognatam formans.

unit.source: Since the tributaries constantly shifted, Lumian couldn’t fully grasp a target’s future fate.
unit.target: Cum tributaria constanter mutarentur, Lumian fatum futuri obiecti non plene capere potuit.

unit.source: He could only catch glimpses of a few possibilities.
unit.target: Ipse solummodo paucae possibilitates adspicere potuit.

unit.source: The black “mark” let him pinpoint the critical junctures.
unit.target: Notam nigrum ei permisit momenta critica perspicere.

unit.source: This wasn’t covered in the mystical knowledge accompanying a Fate Appropriator’s power.
unit.target: Hoc non comprehensum erat in scientia mystica quae cum potentia Fati Appropriatoris coniuncta erat.

unit.source: Lumian strongly suspected that once Luck Observation evolved into Fate Observation, it could merge with a Reaper’s Weakness Investigation to create this unique ability.
unit.target: Lumian vehementer suspicabatur, cum Observatio Fortunae in Observatiōnem Fati evaserit, eam coniungi posse cum Investigatione Debilitatum Messoris ad hanc unicam facultatem creandam.

unit.source: It was like exposing a target’s physical and spiritual weak points—the tributary leading to their demise!
unit.target: Erant quasi revelatio vulnerabilium physicarum atque spiritualium obiecti—tributarium quod ad eorum exitium ducit!

unit.source: As I suspected, the Hunter and Inevitability pathways’ visual abilities have combined…
unit.target: Ut suspicabar, artes visivae viae Venatoris et Inevitabilitatis coniunctae sunt…

unit.source: Lumian used the chance to examine Hela and Franca’s fate rivers, realizing he could perceive fragments of their past and present destinies, similar to when he used Fallen Mercury to discern others’ fates.
unit.target: Lumian occasione usus est ad exquirenda flumina fatum Helae et Francae, animadvertens se posse percipere fragmenta eorum praeteritorum et praesentium fatum, similiter ac cum Mercurium Cadentem ad aliorum fata discernenda utebatur.

unit.source: The difference now was that he could see it directly, without extending his spirituality.
unit.target: Differentia nunc erat quod id directe videre poterat, sine extensione spirituali.

unit.source: With the right abilities, he could touch the ethereal river that shimmered with mercury-like ripples, woven from intricate symbols.
unit.target: Cum rectis facultatibus, poterat tangere flumen aetherium, quod undis mercurii similes micare videbatur, ex subtilibus symbolis contextum.

unit.source: Put another way, he could “see” part of a target’s fate without their awareness.
unit.target: Alio modo, partem fatae obiecti videre poterat, sine eorum conscientia.

unit.source: Naturally, compared to touching the corresponding fate river through abilities, there were clear limits to relying on eyesight.
unit.target: Naturaliter, comparatus ad tactum fluminis fatum per facultates, limites erant, si solum visu innitor.

unit.source: Most life scenes in the mercury river were quite hazy in such cases.
unit.target: Plurimae scaenae vitae in flumine mercurii in his casibus satis nebulosae erant.

unit.source: The nearer to the present, the sharper they became.
unit.target: Quo propius ad praesentem accedebant, tanto acutius apparebant.

unit.source: Likewise, the less they involved high-level matters, the clearer they appeared.
unit.target: Similiter, quo minus res altioris momenti implicatae erant, tanto clarius apparuerunt.

unit.source: Franca and Hela’s life scenes presented a vivid, striking contrast in this regard.
unit.target: Scaenae vitae Francae et Helae in hoc sensu contrarium vividum atque mirabile ostenderunt.

unit.source: Past and present fragments manifesting in Hela’s fate river’s mercury ripples seemed veiled in fog, while others appeared cloaked in night, making them indiscernible.
unit.target: Fragmenta praeterita et praesentia, quae in undis mercurii fluminis fatum Helae manifesta erant, quasi in nebula latent, videbantur, dum aliae in nocte opertae apparuerunt, unde discerpti esse non poterant.

unit.source: Only a handful could be perceived.
unit.target: Solum pauci percipi poterant.

unit.source: Franca’s was far clearer.
unit.target: Scaenae vitae Francae multo clarior apparuerunt.

unit.source: Especially in the last week or two, Lumian could see everything except scenes with high-level entities like the Evernight Nation, Madam Judgment, and the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Praesertim in hebdomada vel duabus hebdomadibus ultimis, Lumian omnia videre poterat, exceptis scaenis cum entibus altiorum qualis Natione Perpetuae Noctis, Domina Iudicii, atque Daemone Nigrae.

unit.source: During his exploratory observation, Lumian was abruptly startled.
unit.target: Durante exploratione, Lumian subito perterritus est.

unit.source: After a few seconds, he looked away, unsettled.
unit.target: Post paucas secundas, se avertit, perturbatus.

unit.source: “What’s the matter?” Franca inquired, curious and concerned.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” Franca inquisivit, curiosa et sollicita.

unit.source: “If you prefer not to disclose your specific abilities, that’s fine.”
unit.target: “Si mavis non divulgare facultates tuas singulares, nihil est.”

unit.source: Only then did she realize she had been too eager to ask about the Fate Appropriator’s situation and potential abilities in front of Madame Hela.
unit.target: Tum sola animadvertit se nimis festinasse quaerere de condicione et facultatibus Fati Appropriatoris coram Domina Hela.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help swallowing hard.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit non vehementer deglutire.

unit.source: Composing himself, he met Hela’s gaze.
unit.target: Se composuit et Helae oculos respexit.

unit.source: “There’s nothing I can’t share.”
unit.target: “Nihil est quod non possim communicare.”

unit.source: “I can no longer just observe luck.”
unit.target: “Nunc non possum solum fortunam observare.”

unit.source: “I can directly perceive the fate river corresponding to each of you.”
unit.target: “Possum directe percipere flumen fatum cuiusque vestri.”

unit.source: “It ranges from the main course to the tributaries, but most is indistinct.”
unit.target: “Ab principali usque ad tributaria se extendit, sed plerumque indistinctum est.”

unit.source: “I can only clearly detect it when actively using my fate‐hunting ability, and there’s a time constraint.”
unit.target: “Illud clare tantum detego, cum facultatem fatum venandi active utor, et tempus constrictum est.”

unit.source: “Indeed, among the fate river tributaries I saw, one likely leads to death…”
unit.target: “Revera, inter tributaria fluminis fatum quae vidi, unum verisimiliter ad mortem ducitur…”

unit.source: Lumian succinctly recounted his initial theory, the hue of his eyes gradually normalizing.
unit.target: Lumian succincte primam theoriam suam exposuit, dum color oculorum eius paulatim normalis fieri videbatur.

unit.source: “If death isn’t inevitable, it should be termed a death calamity,” Franca remarked, focusing on the symbolic import of “black.”
unit.target: “Si mors non inevitabilis est, calamitatem mortis esse debet,” Franca dixit, symbolica significatio vocabuli “niger” attendens.

unit.source: Death calamity? Lumian and Hela turned to Franca, awaiting clarification.
unit.target: Calamitas mortis? Lumian et Hela ad Francam converterunt, claritatem exspectantes.

unit.source: Franca laughed self‐consciously.
unit.target: Franca verecunde risit.

unit.source: “Simply put, if you navigate a catastrophe, crisis, or incident that could cause death, you might emerge alive.”
unit.target: “Simpliciter, si calamitatem, discrimen aut rem quae mortem inferre potest transeas, fortasse vivus evaderis.”

unit.source: I see… Lumian considered briefly before saying, “Then I’ll dub this ability the Eye of Calamity—eyes that can perceive death calamities.”
unit.target: “Intellego…” Lumian brevi temporis cogitavit, deinde dixit: “Ergo hanc facultatem Oculum Calamitatis nuncupabo—oculi qui calamitates mortis percipere possunt.”

unit.source: The name mattered little to him. Its utility was paramount.
unit.target: Nomen pauca ei cura fuit. Utilitas eius maxime praevalebat.

unit.source: Lumian then absorbed the mystical knowledge that had entered his body along with a Fate Appropriator’s power.
unit.target: Lumian deinde scientiam mysticam, quae cum potentia Fati Appropriatoris in corpus eius intraverat, absoruit.

unit.source: A Fate Appropriator’s core actually lay in fate appropriation, split into three abilities.
unit.target: Nucleus Fati Appropriatoris re vera in appropriatione fatum consistit, quae in tres facultates divisa est.

unit.source: The first was Fate Appropriation. By touching the target’s fate river, he could appropriate and extract the desired fate.
unit.target: Prima erat appropriatio fatum. Tacto flumine fatum obiecti, fatum desideratum sibi appropriari et extrahere poterat.

unit.source: This differed somewhat from Fallen Mercury’s abilities.
unit.target: Hoc aliquantum differebat a facultatibus Mercurii Cadentis.

unit.source: One needn’t kill the target to appropriate their fate, but it required time.
unit.target: Non necesse est obiectum occidere ad fatum eorum appropriandum, sed tempus requiritur.

unit.source: The less weighty the corresponding fate, the quicker the process, and vice‑versa.
unit.target: Quo minus grave fatum conveniens, eo celerius processus est; et vicissim.

unit.source: A fate fragment’s weightiness denoted its significance to the target’s overall fate.
unit.target: Gravitas fragmenti fatum significabat momentum eius in universo fatum obiecti.

unit.source: Naturally, Lumian could also appropriate a fragment of the target’s fate by slaying them.
unit.target: Naturaliter, Lumian etiam fragmentum fatum obiecti appropriari poterat, eum occidendo.

unit.source: Moreover, the target’s overall fate would be locked without further changes.
unit.target: Praeterea, fatum universum obiecti sine ulterioribus mutationibus claudetur.

unit.source: The time to complete the Appropriation was very brief.
unit.target: Tempus ad appropriationem perficiendam valde breve erat.

unit.source: As a Fate Appropriator, Lumian could compress two fate fragments within himself, surpassing Fallen Mercury’s single one.
unit.target: Ut Fatum Appropriator, Lumian intra se duo fragmenta fatum comprimere poterat, unam Mercurii Cadentis solitariam superans.

unit.source: Usually, there could be three, but Lumian hadn’t been a Dancer or acted as an Alms Monk.
unit.target: Fere tres esse poterant, sed Lumian nec saltator nec monachus eleemosynarius fuit.

unit.source: He hadn’t even signed a full set of special contracts.
unit.target: Ne etiam plenum corpus contractuum specialium subscripserat.

unit.source: Meaning, during the Inevitability domain’s initial trio of stages, he had seldom neared the power bestower in daily life.
unit.target: Id significat, in primis tribus gradibus dominii Inevitabilitatis, vix cotidie ad dator potentiae accesserat.

unit.source: The fusion with the powers was comparatively weak.
unit.target: Hac de re, ei commoditas et flexibilitas Mercurii Cadentis defuerunt.

unit.source: Had he not cultivated an Ascetic’s core spirit, perhaps he could have stored merely one fate fragment.
unit.target: Si non nucleum spiritus ascetici coluisset, forsitan solum unum fragmentum fatum reservare potuisset.

unit.source: The second ability was Fate Exchange, where one’s accrued fate was traded for a specific fate of the target.
unit.target: Secunda facultas erat Fatum Commutatio, ubi fatum concessum pro certo objeto fatum commutabatur.

unit.source: Ideally, the fate fragments’ weightiness should match. Light for light, heavy for heavy.
unit.target: Optime, gravitas fragmentorum fatum congruere debet: leve pro levi, grave pro gravi.

unit.source: If not, the exchange would be quite slow, maybe taking five to six minutes.
unit.target: Aliter, commutatio lente esset, fortasse quinque ad sex minuta occupans.

unit.source: The fate fragment’s importance was one facet, while its importance to the individual was another.
unit.target: Momentum fragmenti fatum unum facies erat, dum eius momentum ad individuum alterum.

unit.source: Together, they would influence the exchange speed.
unit.target: Simul, has res commutationis celeritatem afficere possunt.

unit.source: Still, generally, it was swifter than directly appropriating the corresponding fate—barring appropriating from a slain target.
unit.target: Tamen, in genere, celerius erat quam fatum conveniens directe appropriandum, excepto quod ex caeso obiecto fatum accipiendum esset.

unit.source: Be it Fate Appropriation or Fate Exchange, there were limits barring him from attacking targets until he finished them.
unit.target: Sive Fatum Appropriatio sive Fatum Commutatio, limites erant, quae eum ab aggressu obiectis retinebant, donec eos absolueret.

unit.source: In this respect, it lacked Fallen Mercury’s convenience and flexibility.
unit.target: Hac de re, ei commoditas et flexibilitas Mercurii Cadentis defuerunt.

unit.source: The third ability was Compelling Fate. It entailed expending an enormous amount of spirituality to directly compel the target’s future toward a tributary.
unit.target: Tertia facultas erat Fatum Coercitio. Ea requirebat ingentem quantitatem spiritualitatis, ut fatum futura obiecti directe in tributariam partem coegeretur.

unit.source: Originally, this ability didn’t function this way.
unit.target: Prorsus, haec facultas non ita functa erat.

unit.source: It primarily swayed the target’s future fate via rituals, curses, and other means.
unit.target: Primum, per ritus, maledicta, aliisque modis, fatum futurum obiecti ferebatur.

unit.source: Yet, after fusing with the Reaper trait, it could directly compel fates.
unit.target: Attamen, postquam cum indole Messoris fusum est, fata directe compellere poterat.

unit.source: This combination with the Eye of Calamity allowed Lumian to discern certain possibilities.
unit.target: Haec coniunctio cum Oculo Calamitatis Lumiano permisit ut quasdam possibilitates discerneret.

unit.source: Naturally, after careful assessment, he deduced his dual spirituality as a Reaper and Fate Appropriator could only permit two compulsions.
unit.target: Naturaliter, post diligentem aestimationem, deduxit dualem spiritualitatem suam, in qualitate Messoris atque Fati Appropriatoris, solum duos compulsionis modos concedere posse.

unit.source: A Fate Appropriator’s core abilities are the deepening and streamlining of the Luck Transference Spell… Lumian gave an overall appraisal.
unit.target: Capacitates nucleares Fati Appropriatoris sunt profunditas atque efficacitas Incantationis Fortunae Translativae… Lumian universam aestimationem proposuit.

unit.source: Upon becoming a Fate Appropriator, the ceiling of contracts he could withstand as a Contractee had hit twelve.
unit.target: Cum Fatum Appropriator factus est, numerus contractuum, quibus ut contractus subiectus resistens praevalere poterat, duodecim attingebat.

unit.source: The endurance stemming from being an Ascetic had also risen markedly.
unit.target: Patientia ex hoc quod Asceticus erat, signanter augebatur.

unit.source: This spurred Lumian to mull signing two to three more contractual abilities down the line to diversify his combat style and bolster his related trump cards.
unit.target: Hoc impulit Lumian cogitare de subscriptione duorum ad trium ulterius facultatum contractualium, ad stilum pugnandi diversificandum et chordas auxiliares confirmandos.

unit.source: However, he wouldn’t truly sign all twelve, not even ten.
unit.target: Attamen, revera non omnes duodecim, ne decem quidem, subscriperet.

unit.source: That would surpass an Ascetic’s endurance.
unit.target: Id asceticorum patientiam superaret.

unit.source: Lumian had no wish to become a pseudo‑inferior Beyonder like Padre Guillaume Benet, whose weaknesses could be readily grasped and actions predicted.
unit.target: Lumian nollebat fieri pseudo‑inferiore Beyonder, ut Padre Guillelmo Benet, cuius infirmitates facile agnoscantur atque acta praevidere valeant.

unit.source: Another notable shift in an Ascetic was the accumulation of external fate fragments.
unit.target: Alterum notabile in ascetico fuit fragmentorum fatum externorum congeries.

unit.source: It had genuinely become a vital component of a Fate Appropriator.
unit.target: Re vera, factum erat pars essentialis Fati Appropriatoris.

unit.source: As for rituals such as the Animal Creation Spell, they could be streamlined.
unit.target: Quod ad ritus, ut Incantatio de Animalium Creatione, attinet, facilius fieri poterat.

unit.source: For instance, Lumian previously had to drape the target with a ritual sheepskin to transform them into sheep by chanting the incantation.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, Lumian olim oportuit obiectum induere in pelle ovina rituali, ut in oves transformaretur incantationem recitans.

unit.source: Now, he could use a more symbolic sheepskin to cover the other party to meet the prerequisite.
unit.target: Nunc, poterat uti pelle ovina magis symbolica ad tegendum alteram partem, ita ut praerequisitum expleatur.

unit.source: His flexibility as a Dancer had also grown.
unit.target: Eius flexibilitas ut saltator etiam aucta est.

unit.source: Lumian could now perform horrific and incredible actions.
unit.target: Lumian nunc poterat gesta horrenda et incredibilia perficere.

unit.source: If ordinary folk merely glimpsed the corresponding shadows he cast, they would deem him a monster.
unit.target: Si plebe ordinaria tantum umbras correspondentes quas iaciebat intuebatur, eum monstrum existimabant.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian’s spirituality had climbed substantially.
unit.target: Praeterea, spiritualitas Luminum admodum surrexerat.

unit.source: The most basic yardstick was that he could employ up to 17 Spirit World Traversals.
unit.target: Fundamentum maximi momenti erat quod usque ad decem et septem Transitus Mundi Spirituum exercere poterat.

unit.source: Nonetheless, both a Fate Appropriator and a Reaper had scant impact on his physical prowess.
unit.target: Tamen, nec Fatum Appropriator nec Messor in virtute corporali eius validiter contingebant.

unit.source: After verifying his transformation, Lumian thanked Madame Hela and asked when the next Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society meeting would be before returning to the real world with Franca.
unit.target: Postquam transformationem suam verificavit, Lumian Dominae Helae gratias egit et rogavit quando venturus esset proximus conventus Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispatae, antequam ad verum orbem cum Franca rediret.

unit.source: Having returned The Fool’s gold coin to Jenna, Lumian briefly outlined a Fate Appropriator’s abilities and stated,
unit.target: Postquam nummum aureum "Fool’s Gold Coin" ad Jennam reddidit, Lumian breviter facultates Fati Appropriatoris delineavit et dixit:

unit.source: “Given my ability to directly perceive some fate fragments, I’ll settle on the concrete plan after observing Moran Avigny up close.”
unit.target: “Cum mea facultas sit quaedam fragmenta fatum directe percipere, deinde consilium concretum statuam postquam Moran Avigny intime observaverim.”

unit.source: “Okay.” Franca thoroughly endorsed any step that could lessen the risk.
unit.target: “Bene.” Franca omnem actionem, quae periculum minueret, plenissime approbavit.

unit.source: Lumian rose and said to Franca and Jenna,
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et ad Francam et Jennam dixit:

unit.source: “I’ll head out first then. Don’t forget to help me inquire at your mysticism gatherings if there’s the Harvest Priest potion formula and the matching Beyonder ingredients.”
unit.target: “Ego igitur primus exibo. Nolite oblivisci mihi in vestris conventibus mysticis auxilium ferre, si formula poculi Sacerdotis Messis et congrua ingredientia Beyonder inveniuntur.”

unit.source: “Got it.” Seeing Lumian off, Franca turned to Jenna, puzzled.
unit.target: “Intellectum.” Videns Lumian discedere, Franca ad Jennam conversa, perplexa.

unit.source: “Why is he acting a bit odd? Doesn’t he usually rile people up and quip before leaving?”
unit.target: “Cur aliquantulum insolite se gerit? Nonne solet homines excitare et argutias facere antequam discedat?”

unit.source: Jenna also found this atypical and sank into deep thought.
unit.target: Jenna quoque hoc atipicum putavit et in profunda cogitatione se recepit.

unit.source: Abruptly, her expression changed.
unit.target: Subito, vultus eius mutatus est.

unit.source: Jenna glanced down at the book in her hand, saying pensively, “Perhaps he just received the boon’s power and isn’t in a stable state. He needs to hurry back and rest.”
unit.target: Jenna librum in manu sua intuebatur, cogitans, “Forsitan modo vim beneficii accepit et non in statu stabilito est. Festinanter redeundum et quiescendum est.”

unit.source: Franca nodded, understanding. “Fair point.”
unit.target: Franca annuit, intellegens. “Recte dicis.”

unit.source: She didn’t linger on it or bother to. The night was lovely, and she couldn’t squander it on such trivial matters.
unit.target: Non diutius de ea versata est neque curavit. Nox amoena erat, et eam in talibus res levibus perdere non poterat.

unit.source: Avenue du Boulevard, outside the Champs‑Elysees’ Rose Conference Room.
unit.target: Avenida du Boulevard, extra conclave Rosarum Champs‑Elysees.

unit.source: Numerous reporters stood before the hotel’s signature indoor golden fountain, awaiting the arrival of Minister of Industry Moran Avigny, who had finished negotiations with the Loen Kingdom’s delegation.
unit.target: Multi diurnarii ante fontem aureum interior deversorii signatum steterunt, adventum Ministri Industria Moran Avigny exspectantes, qui negotia cum legatione Regni Loen confecerat.

unit.source: Lumian had switched into a pre‑prepared black tweed coat and half top hat.
unit.target: Lumian in veste praeparata nigri tweedi et semi pileo transtulit.

unit.source: He held a rented, new black‑and‑white camera without a tripod.
unit.target: Tenebat cameram novam nigro et albo, conducatam, sine tripedio.

unit.source: With his unremarkable, passerby‑like appearance, he mingled with these individuals as a fake reporter.
unit.target: Cum aspectu suo mediocri, quasi viator, cum his hominibus miscuit se ut diurnarius mendax.

unit.source: 704 Fragment of Fate
unit.target: Fragmentum Fati 704

unit.source: The reporters waiting outside the conference hall displayed no signs of impatience or dissatisfaction, despite the passing time.
unit.target: Diarii extra atrium conventus exspectantes nullas species impacientiae aut incontenti ostenderunt, quamquam tempus labebat.

unit.source: They were well accustomed to such situations.
unit.target: Itaque huic condicioni bene consueverant.

unit.source: At last, the heavy doors of the Rose Conference Hall opened, revealing the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Denique, graves ostia Aulae Conventus Rosae aperta sunt, ostendentes Ministerium Industria, Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Dressed in a sharp formal suit, his dark-gray eyes and chiseled features stood out as he emerged alongside the leader of the Loen Kingdom’s delegation.
unit.target: Indutus veste solente et formali, oculi eius obscuri-cinerei et lineamenta sculpta eminuerunt cum apparuit iuxta ducem legationis Regni Loen.

unit.source: Snap! Snap! A flurry of loud camera flashes illuminated the scene, and Moran Avigny responded with a graceful wave to the reporters.
unit.target: Snap! Snap! Turbidus fulgorium clamoribus camerae scenam illustravit, et Moran Avigny diariis gratiosa fluctuatione respondit.

unit.source: Lumian refrained from pushing his way to the front, choosing instead to observe Moran Avigny from a distance, hidden among the crowd.
unit.target: Lumian impetum ad limitem non adiit, sed potius a longe, inter turbam absconditus, Moran Avigny intueri maluit.

unit.source: Shielded by the camera, his azure eyes rapidly shifted to a silver-black hue.
unit.target: Armatus a camera, oculi eius caerulei celeriter mutaverunt colorem in nigrum-argenteum.

unit.source: Eye of Calamity!
unit.target: Oculus Calamitatum!

unit.source: In Lumian’s enhanced vision, a river of mercury materialized on Moran Avigny’s body, composed of ethereal water droplets.
unit.target: In visu Luminiani amplificata flumen mercurii in corpore Moran Avigny apparuit, ex guttulis aquae aetheriae constantibus.

unit.source: Each droplet was adorned with intricate, interconnected symbols.
unit.target: Quisque gutta insignibus intricatis et conexis ornata erat.

unit.source: As Moran Avigny delivered a concise speech announcing various industrial cooperation agreements between the Intis Republic and the Loen Kingdom, Lumian meticulously analyzed the Minister of Industry’s past, present, and future, uncovering the fragments of fate concealed within each mercurial droplet.
unit.target: Dum Moran Avigny brevem orationem habili sermonis de variis foedus industrialis cooperationis inter Rempublicam Intis et Regnum Loen enuntiavit, Lumian praeteritum, praesens atque futurum Ministerii Industria diligenter perscrutatus est, fragmenta fati in qualibet gutta mercuriali latenta detegens.

unit.source: The more distant the past, the greater the ambiguity.
unit.target: Quo longius praeteritum, eo maiorem incertitudinem.

unit.source: Lumian concentrated on the events of the preceding two weeks.
unit.target: Lumian eventus duarum septimanarum superiorum summo studio consideravit.

unit.source: He witnessed Moran Avigny residing in a government-provided villa, attending weekly gatherings at cafés to discuss matters of state, exemplifying Trier’s café politics.
unit.target: Testis fuit Moran Avigny in villa a gubernatione provisa habitare, conventus hebdomadae in cauponis ad res publicas disserendas frequentare, exemplar praebens politiae cauponarum Trevirensium.

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian observed Moran Avigny’s attendance at salons, balls, banquets, operas, concerts, theaters, and art exhibitions.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian animadvertit Moran Avigny adesse in salones, ballets, cenis, operis, concentibus, theatris atque exhibitionibus artium.

unit.source: The Minister indulged in polo, poker, hunting in the suburbs, and flirtations with courtesans.
unit.target: Minister se dedidit ludo polo, ludo poker, venatione in periurbibus, et amatoria cum cortesanis.

unit.source: He leveraged his position to secure favors, such as appointing the husband of one of his lovers as the deputy general manager of the Intis Industrial Credit Bank’s Southern Continent branch—a coveted role known for its prestige, generous compensation, and influence.
unit.target: Officio suo utebatur ut favores obtineret, ut exempli gratia, maritum unae amatarum suae designans ut vicarius generalis procuratoris ramus Meridianae Continenti Intis Industrial Credit Bank, munere exoptato ob gloriam, largam compensationem, atque auctoritatem notum.

unit.source: The sole drawback was the necessity of leaving Trier for the Southern Continent for two to three years, initially without the companionship of spouse and children.
unit.target: Unicum incommodum erat necessitatem Trier relinquendi ad Continentem Meridionalem per duo vel tres annos, initio sine coniugis atque liberorum comitate.

unit.source: These observations aligned perfectly with Lumian’s preconceived notions of Trier’s elite society.
unit.target: Observationes hae perfecte conveniebant cum praeconceptis Luminiani de societate electa Trevirensium.

unit.source: Amidst the hazy fragments, two particular instances captured Lumian’s attention.
unit.target: Inter fragmenta nebulosa duo casus peculiares attentionem Luminiani cepere.

unit.source: In one, Moran Avigny sat alone in his study, perusing a document.
unit.target: In uno, Moran Avigny solus in studiis sedebat, documentum perlegens.

unit.source: Abruptly, he jotted down a note and reached into a nearby mirror.
unit.target: Subito, notam annotavit et ad speculum prope appropinquans tendit.

unit.source: His hand, seemingly incorporeal, passed through the glass surface, depositing the note within.
unit.target: Manus eius, quasi incorporea, per superficiem vitri transiit, notam intus deponens.

unit.source: The other featured Moran Avigny’s fleeting encounter with an unfamiliar individual during a hunting excursion in the West Lognes Forest.
unit.target: Alter casus brevissimum congressum Moran Avigny cum individuo ignoto in expeditione venatoria in Silva Lognes Occidentali exhibuit.

unit.source: What piqued Lumian’s interest was the thin, white fog enveloping this fragment, rendering it indistinct.
unit.target: Quod studio Luminiani excitavit, tenuis alba nebula huius fragmenti involvens, ut fere indistinctum esset.

unit.source: This peculiar obscurity differed from the typical vagueness of most fate fragments.
unit.target: Haec obscuritas insolita differebat ab vagitate typica plurimorum fragmentorum fati.

unit.source: The first fragment confirmed Moran Avigny’s identity as a Mirror Person.
unit.target: Primum fragmentum identitatem Moran Avigny ut Personam Speculi confirmavit.

unit.source: Among the 22 paths of the divine, Demonesses proficient in mirror magic could not transmit information or objects through mirrors until attaining the rank of Sequence 4 demigods.
unit.target: Inter viginti duos semitas divinitatis, daemoniae in arte magica speculi peritae informationes aut res per specula transmittere non poterant, nisi ad gradum Sequenciae IV semideorum pervenerunt.

unit.source: If Moran Avigny were a demigod-level Demoness, his existence as a man would be impossible.
unit.target: Si Moran Avigny daemonia semidei gradu fuisset, exsistentia eius ut vir impossibilis fuisset.

unit.source: Lumian could only surmise two possibilities:
unit.target: Lumian solum duas possibilitates coniectare potuit:

unit.source: First, Mirror People possessed an innate mastery over mirrors, surpassing even Demonesses in the realm of mirror magic.
unit.target: Primum, Personae Speculi ingenio innato speculos dominabantur, etiam daemonias in regno magiae speculi superantes.

unit.source: Second, Moran Avigny had originally been a Demoness at the demigod level who later consumed a higher Sequence Hunter potion, successfully transforming into a man.
unit.target: Secundo, Moran Avigny initio daemonia semidei gradus fuit, quae postea potionem Venatoris Sequenciae superioris consumpsit, ut vir feliciter convertus esset.

unit.source: This implied that the Minister of Industry was at least a Sequence 3 Saint, if not an Angel.
unit.target: Hoc implicabat Ministerium Industria saltem Sanctum Sequenciae III, nisi Angelum, esse.

unit.source: Considering the intelligence gathered by Franca and the others, the information provided by 007, and the clearer fate fragments, Lumian concluded that Moran Avigny had never exhibited any Hunter-related traits.
unit.target: Intelligentiā a Franca aliisque collecta, informatione a 007 data, et fragmentis fati clarioribus, Lumian concludit Moran Avigny numquam ullas notas Venatoris ostentasse.

unit.source: He was undoubtedly a Mirror Person, albeit an extraordinary one.
unit.target: Indubitanter Personam Speculi fuisse constat, quamquam extraordinariam.

unit.source: The second fate fragment intrigued Lumian due to its relative uniqueness.
unit.target: Secundum fragmentum fati Luminiani, ob singularem naturam, animum excitavit.

unit.source: It might contain crucial information, but deciphering it eluded him for the moment.
unit.target: Forsitan informationes maximas contineat, sed eius enodatio momento ei eluderet.

unit.source: Shifting his focus to Moran Avigny’s future, Lumian examined the myriad potential fate tributaries.
unit.target: Ad futurum Moran Avigny se convertere, Lumian multitudinem fluminum fati potentialium inspiciebat.

unit.source: As anticipated, one tributary bore a faint black tinge.
unit.target: Ut praevisum erat, unus flumen fati levem nigram notam portabat.

unit.source: This mercurial offshoot, like many others, “rehearsed” Moran Avigny’s interview and subsequent return to the Ministry of Industry in a private carriage.
unit.target: Haec derivatio mercurialis, ut pleraeque aliae, “repraesentavit” colloquium Moran Avigny et reditum postea ad Ministerium Industria in curru privato.

unit.source: However, it diverged when, upon entering his office and sitting for a while, Moran Avigny willingly stepped into the full-body mirror near the coat rack and vanished.
unit.target: Attamen, divertebat, cum in officium suum ingressus et per aliquod tempus sedens, Moran Avigny libenter in speculum totum prope armarium vestimentorum intravit et evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s foresight extended no further.
unit.target: Praevisio Luminiani ultra non extendebatur.

unit.source: Based on his observations, Lumian deduced that if Moran Avigny ventured into the mirror world before noon, he would face a life-threatening calamity.
unit.target: Ex observationibus suis Lumian concludere audivit: si Moran Avigny ante meridiem in mundum speculi se immergisset, discrimen vitae immineret.

unit.source: Yet, the probability of Moran Avigny taking such an action was minimal.
unit.target: Attamen, verisimilitudo ut Moran Avigny talem rem ageret, exiguum erat.

unit.source: Among the numerous fate tributaries, only one represented this possibility.
unit.target: Inter multas flumina fati, sola una hanc facultatem repraesentabat.

unit.source: Certainly, if Lumian disregarded the risk of exposure, he could harness nearly half of his spirituality to manipulate Moran Avigny’s future, steering it towards that specific tributary.
unit.target: Certe, si Lumian periculum manifestationis neglexisset, fere dimidiam spiritualitatis suae vim ad futurum Moran Avigny formandum et in illum flumen specificum dirigens adhibere posset.

unit.source: However, such an act would be futile.
unit.target: Attamen, talis actus vanus esset.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s demise in the mirror world would merely prevent them from accessing his corpse and conducting the spirit channeling ritual.
unit.target: Interitus Moran Avigny in mundo speculi solum eos prohiberet ut corpus eius attingeretur atque rituum spirituum canalizationem peragirent.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black likely possesses the ability to enter the mirror world as well.
unit.target: Daemonia Nigra probabiliter etiam facultatem habet ut in mundum speculi ingrediatur.

unit.source: However, with her as the spirit channeler, obtaining the relevant information would prove impossible.
unit.target: Attamen, cum ea spirituum canalizatrix esset, necessaria informationes colligere impossibilis fuisset.

unit.source: Even if Franca has fully earned her trust, certain knowledge would remain undisclosed until she attains a specific Sequence…
unit.target: Etiam si Franca plenam eius fiduciam adeptus fuerit, quaedam scientia non revelabatur, donec ad certam Sequenciam perveniret…

unit.source: Lumian noticed Moran Avigny’s posture signaling the conclusion of the interview, and his bodyguards began navigating through the reporters.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit morum statum Moran Avigny, qui finis colloquii significabat, et custodes eius inter diarii perambulare coeperunt.

unit.source: Consequently, Lumian ceased using the Eye of Calamity and captured a black-and-white photograph, maintaining his façade.
unit.target: Consecuto, Lumian usum Oculi Calamitatum desiit et photographiam nigro-albam ceperat, simulacrum suum servans.

unit.source: Subsequently, he gradually retreated from the throng of reporters and made his way to the public washroom.
unit.target: Postea paulatim a turbam diariorum recedens via publicam latrinam intravit.

unit.source: He stashed the camera within his Traveler’s Bag, donned Lie, and transformed back into Ciel Dubois.
unit.target: Cameram in sacco Viatoris suo recondidit, veste “Lie” indutus est, et ad statum Ciel Dubois revertit.

unit.source: As a guest, he entered the annex restaurant of Champs-Élysées.
unit.target: Hospite, restaurant annexum in Champs-Élysées ingressus est.

unit.source: Franca awaited him there.
unit.target: Franca ibi eum exspectabat.

unit.source: Following the waiter to his designated spot, Lumian noticed a man and a woman engaged in coffee.
unit.target: Ministrum sequens ad locum designatum, Lumian virum ac feminam in colloquio cafei versantes animadvertit.

unit.source: The woman possessed black hair, brown eyes, and an alluring beauty.
unit.target: Femina capillos nigros, oculos fuscos, atque venustatem allicientem habebat.

unit.source: Her attire accentuated her slightly exaggerated aura.
unit.target: Vestis eius modum paululum exaggeratum aurae ejus exprimebat.

unit.source: The man, by contrast, appeared ordinary, clad in a double-breasted flannel coat, wrinkled pants, buckled leather boots, and a top hat adorned with soft fur—the favored ensemble of Trier’s bankers and financiers in recent times.
unit.target: Vir autem, contra, simplex videbatur, indutus in lorica flannel duplici pectori, braccis rugosis, calceamentis coriaceis fibulis allatis, et pileo ornato molli peli—habitus praestantissimus bankerorum et nummularum Trevirensium nuper.

unit.source: Lumian noticed that the man and woman weren’t attracted by any aura of wealth.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit virum ac feminam non allici a quacumque aura divitiarum.

unit.source: Instead, he recognized the beautiful woman with foreign features.
unit.target: Immo, agnovit pulchram feminam cum externis lineamentis.

unit.source: She, of course, had no knowledge of him.
unit.target: Ipsa, scilicet, de eo nihil noverat.

unit.source: He had only glimpsed her photograph in Ghost Face.
unit.target: Eum solum imaginem eius in “Ghost Face” intuens aspiciebat.

unit.source: She was Perle, a theater actress from Loen and a courtesan in Trier.
unit.target: Ea Perle erat, actrix theatralis ex Loen et cortisana Trevirensis.

unit.source: DuVar, the inventor of DuVar’s broth and proprietor of the esteemed restaurant, had once lavished a substantial sum on her.
