unit.target: DuVar, inventor brodi DuVar et possessor clarissimi restaurantis, olim magnam pecuniae summam super eam effudit.

unit.source: He had even attempted suicide because of her, albeit unsuccessfully.
unit.target: Etiam propter eam ad se ipsos perditionem conatus est, quamquam non prospere.

unit.source: At present, Perle and the middle-aged man, presumed to be a banker, had not yet begun their meal.
unit.target: Nunc, Perle et vir mediocris aetatis, qui banker esse credebatur, adhuc cibum suum non inceperant.

unit.source: They were simply savoring their coffee.
unit.target: Solebant simpliciter saporem cafei degustare.

unit.source: The middle-aged man picked up Perle’s empty coffee cup and gestured to the grounds, explaining something unknown to Lumian.
unit.target: Vir mediocris aetatis poculum cafeae vacuum Perle arripuit et ad residua monstrare gesticulatus est, aliquid Luminiano ignotum explanans.

unit.source: The courtesan listened intently.
unit.target: Cortisana attente audivit.

unit.source: As he passed by, Lumian’s keen senses allowed him to briefly eavesdrop.
unit.target: Dum praeteribat, sensus acuti Luminiani breviter auscultare sinere.

unit.source: He swiftly grasped that the middle-aged man, believed to be a banker, was immersed in the art of coffee ground divination.
unit.target: Celeriter intellexit virum mediocris aetatis, banker existimatum, in arte divinationis residuorum cafeae versari.

unit.source: This popular divination method in high society was more akin to a game.
unit.target: Haec methodus divinatoria in societate alta popularis maxime quasi ludus erat.

unit.source: “If the remaining coffee grounds after drinking form a circle, it signifies recent signs of love…”
unit.target: «Si residuae particulae cafeae post potum circulum efficiunt, signa recentis amoris indicant…»

unit.source: Upon hearing the middle-aged man’s words, Lumian couldn’t help but silently critique: Are you going to suggest that you’ll be the love she’s about to encounter?
unit.target: Auditis verbis viri mediocris aetatis, Lumian tacite censere non potuit: Num proponere intendis te futurum amorem, quem ipsa mox experietur?

unit.source: Any other woman, even aware of the man’s true intentions, would be secretly alarmed by divination results indicating traces of love.
unit.target: Quaevis alia femina, etiamsi de veris propositis viri conscius esset, arcano perterrita fuisset ex resultatibus divinatoriis quae vestigia amoris ostenderent.

unit.source: They might believe it to be fate’s guidance.
unit.target: Fortasse putarent hoc esse ducatum fati.

unit.source: The various patterns naturally formed by the residual coffee grounds were thought to hold corresponding revelations about one’s destiny, a notion widely accepted and impossible to manipulate.
unit.target: Figurae varias a residuīs cafeae naturaliter formatae, opinabantur revelationes congruentes de fato contineant, sententia late recepta et nequissima ad manipulationem.

unit.source: However, given Perle’s experience as a seasoned courtesan and her bold demeanor, Lumian had cause to suspect that she had deliberately manipulated the coffee grounds into a circular formation through her drinking technique.
unit.target: Attamen, ratione Perle peritiae ut cortisana callida et habitu audaci, Lumian suspicari coepit eam residua cafeae per artem suae potionis consuetudinis ad formam circularem deliberatam composuisse.

unit.source: After walking a short distance, Lumian spotted Franca.
unit.target: Postquam spatium breve ambulavit, Lumian Francam animadvertit.

unit.source: The Demoness of Pleasure was dressed as a lady today, perfectly suited for the occasion.
unit.target: Daemonia Voluptatis hodie ut domina ornata erat, ad occasionem perfecte conveniens.

unit.source: Lumian almost failed to recognize her.
unit.target: Lumian paene eam agnoscere non potuit.

unit.source: Naturally, Franca still refrained from wearing a dress, opting instead for a pantsuit.
unit.target: Naturale, Franca adhuc a vestimentis longis abstinebat, potius vestem braccatim eligens.

unit.source: Observing Franca’s elegantly styled hair, no longer in a ponytail, Lumian chuckled and remarked, “Jenna did your hair for you?”
unit.target: Observans elegantissime dispositos capillos Francae, nondum in cauda colligatos, Lumian subsannavit atque dixit: “Jenna tibi capillos compaginavit?”

unit.source: “Indeed!” Franca responded, not with humiliated rage, but with a sense of smugness.
unit.target: “Revera!” respondit Franca, non cum ira confusa sed cum modica superbia.

unit.source: Before they could delve into their observations, a nearby waiter approached, presenting them with two identical menus.
unit.target: Priusquam observationibus penitus inciperent, ministrus proximus accessit, duos menus eandem speciem offerens.

unit.source: Lowering her voice, Franca addressed Lumian in ancient Feysac, “The lunch set costs 7 verl d’or. If we order individually and indulge in some decent red wine, the bill for the two of us will amount to at least 50 verl d’or. That sum could easily feed your godson in the market district.”
unit.target: Vox demitte, Franca Luminiano in antiqua Feysac loquebatur: “Set prandiarii constat ex 7 verl d’or. Si singillatim ordinaverimus et bonum vinum rubrum degustaverimus, computus nostrum saltem 50 verl d’or attinget. Illa summa facile nepotem tuum in regione mercatus pascere posset.”

unit.source: Franca found the restaurant at Grand Champs-Élysées not only expensive but also intriguing.
unit.target: Franca invenit restaurant in Grand Champs-Élysées non solum pretiosum sed etiam mirabile.

unit.source: Switching to Intisian, Franca inquired of the waiter, “Any recommendations?”
unit.target: Transiens ad linguam Intisian, Franca ministrum interrogavit: “Quid suades?”

unit.source: The waiter, who had been sneaking glances at Franca, responded eagerly, “Would you like to try the Fürth fish?
unit.target: Ministrus, qui Francam furtim intuens erat, studiose respondit: “Velisne piscem Fürth experiri?

unit.source: “In Trier, apart from certain private banquets, we are the sole establishment that serves Fürth fish.”
unit.target: “In Treviris, praeter nonnulla privata convivia, sola instituta sumus quae piscem Fürth praebet.”

unit.source: “What makes it so special?” Lumian asked, curiosity piqued.
unit.target: “Quid id tam speciale facit?” inquit Lumian, curiositate excitato.

unit.source: Addressing Franca, the waiter explained, “Fürth fish appear semi-charred and can only be found in a specific section of Trier’s underground river. Legend has it that long ago, they were ordinary fish. One day, an individual named Fürth caught one and set up a frying pan by the underground river, intending to cook it. Midway through the process, the fish managed to escape the frying pan and return to the river. It survived and spawned numerous descendants, all bearing the semi-charred appearance.
unit.target: Ad Francam loquens, ministrus explicavit: “Piscēs Fürth videntur semi-combusti et solummodo in certa parte fluminis subterranei Trevirensium inveniri possunt. Mito narratur olim fuisse pisces comunes. Quadam die, quispiam nomine Fürth unum cepit et sartaginem iuxta flumen subterraneum posuit cum proposito ei coquendum. Medio processu piscis ex sartagine effugere et in flumen redire potuit; supervixit atque multos posteros genuit, omnes aspectu semi-combusto induti.

unit.source: “The skin of this fish is fragrantly browned and oily, yet the flesh within is exceptionally tender…”
unit.target: “Cutis huius piscis fragrante fusca et oleosa est, sed caro intima eximie tenera…”

unit.source: Trier’s underground river… Half-burnt… Alive… Lumian extracted the keywords and suddenly speculated that this might be a consequence of the leakage of Fourth Epoch Trier’s Hunter powers.
unit.target: Flumen subterraneum Trevirense… Semicombustum… Vivum… Luminian verba clavis extraxit et subito coniectavit hoc forsitan consequentiam effusionis potestatum Venatorum Temporis Quarti Trevirensis esse.

unit.source: Smiling at Franca, he proposed, “Shall we each have one?”
unit.target: Subridens Francae, proposuit: “Num uterque nostrum unum habeamus?”

unit.source: “Very well.” Franca had already been contemplating giving it a try.
unit.target: “Optime.” Franca iam id experiri cogitaverat.

unit.source: 705 Past
unit.target: 705 Praeteritum

unit.source: After the waiter left their secluded table with the order, Lumian picked up his tri‑colored liqueur—a vibrant mix of red, white, and blue—and clinked glasses with Franca before taking a sip.
unit.target: Postquam caupo mensam reconditam cum iussu reliquit, Lumian potum tribicolor suum — mixturam vibranti rubri, albi, et caerulei — arripuit et vitreis calices cum Franca tintillavit, antequam sorbere coepit.

unit.source: Glancing around to ensure no one could overhear, he quietly recounted the detailed fate fragments of Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, ne quis auscultare possit, tacite enarravit accurata fragmenta fati de Moran Avigny.

unit.source: As Franca listened, her expression gradually morphed, a frown creasing her lovely brow.
unit.target: Dum Franca auscultabat, vultus eius paulatim mutatus est, rugam in fronte decora effingens.

unit.source: “That white, thin fog you described… it reminds me of something,” she said.
unit.target: “Illam album tenuemque nebulam quam describuisti… aliquid mihi recordari facit,” inquit.

unit.source: “Does it have a mercurial, ever‑shifting nature?”
unit.target: “Num habet naturam mercurialem et semper mutablem?”

unit.source: Lumian considered briefly before nodding.
unit.target: Lumian brevi cogitavit antequam caput annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, it does.”
unit.target: “Ita, habet.”

unit.source: Franca let out a soft sigh.
unit.target: Franca leniter suspiravit.

unit.source: “It must be the same phenomenon then. You know how I told you about Jenna and I getting tailed by that entrustee of the vanished Deep Valley Cloister gatekeeper at the mysticism gathering? The one we ended up fighting?”
unit.target: “Ergo idem phaenomenon esse debet. Scisne quomodo tibi narraverim de Jenna et me a illo procuratore, qui closter Deep Valley evanuerat, secuti esse? Illum, quem tandem pugnavimus?”

unit.source: “Well, when I channeled the guy’s spirit and asked about his organizational ties, his physical form and spirit abruptly detonated.
unit.target: “Bene, cum spiritum illius evocavi et de nexibus eius quaesivi, forma eius corporalis et animus subito detonaverunt.

unit.source: My mirror cracked from the blast, but right before shattering, it filled with that same thin, mercurial white mist.”
unit.target: Speculum meum impetu fractum est, sed iusto antequam ruina esset, impletum est eadem tenue, mercuriali alba nebula.

unit.source: Franca paused, collecting her thoughts.
unit.target: Franca pausavit, cogitationes suas colligens.

unit.source: “According to the intel I passed along, 007 ran into a similar fog during their investigation of Deep Valley Town.
unit.target: Secundum nuntium quem transmissem, 007 in nebulam similem incidit, dum oppidum Deep Valley investigaretur.

unit.source: Albert Goncourt, the Carbonari’s leader, was spotted there too.
unit.target: Albert Goncourt, dux Carbonari, ibi quoque deprehensus est.

unit.source: As you’re aware, the Carbonari played a role in stoking the riots during the Hostel plan.
unit.target: Ut scis, Carbonarii partem egere in incitatione tumultuum sub consilio Hostel.

unit.source: Their other leader, operating under the alias General Philip, spearheaded that particular scheme.”
unit.target: Alter dux, sub nomine Generalis Philip, illud consilium praeivit.

unit.source: Lumian swiftly connected the dots Franca was laying out.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter notiones quas Franca proponebat coniunxit.

unit.source: “So you suspect the Carbonari is in league with multiple evil god cults, this peculiar white fog being tied to one of them—and that Moran Avigny is also entangled with this group. Meaning our supposedly chance encounter with him in the West Lognes Forest was anything but.”
unit.target: “Ita suspicis Carbonarios cum plurimis cultibus deorum malignorum consociatos esse, hoc singulare album nebula ad unum ex illis pertinere, et quod Moran Avigny quoque in hanc societatem implicatus sit; id igitur significat conventum nostrum cum eo in Silva Lognes Occidentali, putatum fortuito fuisse non.”

unit.source: “Precisely.”
unit.target: “Prorsum.”

unit.source: Franca took another sip of her liqueur.
unit.target: Franca alium sorbetionem potus sui cepit.

unit.source: “And what’s the ultimate endgame for these Mirror People? Surely not mere replacement of their originals.”
unit.target: “Et quid est ultimus finis horum Hominum Specularum? Pro certo non est solum substitutio originalium.”

unit.source: The mirror version of Gardner Martin had failed to succeed the real one, understandably using the Hostel plan to deal with his counterpart.
unit.target: Specularis imago Gardner Martin veram non supplere potuit, ideo consilium Hostel ad contrarium tractandum intelligenter adhibitum est.

unit.source: But Moran Avigny, also a Mirror Person, had quietly replaced the original for decades, even fathering an illegitimate daughter and living a cushy life.
unit.target: Sed Moran Avigny, quoque Hominum Specularum, originalem per decennia tacite substituit, filiam illegitimam genens et vitam commodam agens.

unit.source: Why collaborate with cults?
unit.target: Cur cum cultibus cooperari?

unit.source: Smiling, Lumian replied, “The goals of Mirror People as a whole versus as individuals are bound to differ.
unit.target: Subridente, Lumian respondit: “Proposita Hominum Specularum, tamquam unum genus aut ut singula, certe differre debent.

unit.source: Investigating should reveal the former.
unit.target: Investigatio primum propositum ostendere debet.

unit.source: Back in Fourth Epoch Trier, Mirror Gardner Martin mentioned their loyalty and service to someone who holds all the answers.
unit.target: In Trier, quarto aevo, Gardner Martin Specularis de sua fide et ministerio erga aliquem, qui omnia responsa tenet, locutus est.

unit.source: Learning that person’s identity should tell us the Mirror People’s endgame.”
unit.target: Cognitio identitatis illius personae nobis finem propositi Hominum Specularum revelabit.

unit.source: Franca concurred succinctly, “We can plan our next moves around this strange fog.
unit.target: Franca succincte accessit: “Movimenta nostra futura circa hanc nebulam insolitam disponere possumus.

unit.source: Deal with Moran Avigny to get more info on the Mirror People, which is already a lead.
unit.target: Negotia fac cum Moran Avigny ut plura de Hominibus Specularibus cognoscamus, quod iam indicium est.

unit.source: And capturing him or channeling his spirit could present other opportunities.”
unit.target: Et eum capere aut spiritum eius evocare alias occasiones afferre potest.

unit.source: Franca smiled.
unit.target: Franca subridens.

unit.source: “Looks like 007 will be busy again.”
unit.target: “Videtur 007 iterum occupatus fore.”

unit.source: Their discussion of Moran Avigny complete, Lumian picked up some roasted pre‑meal bread, chewing as he recounted his encounter with Courtesan Perle and the coffee ground divination he’d witnessed.
unit.target: Eorum de Moran Avigny sermo confectus, Lumian panem prae‑cenam torrefactum arripuit, masticans, dum narrabat de congressu suo cum Courtesana Perle et de divinatione ex pulveri caffeae, quam testatus fuerat.

unit.source: “She’s unlikely to be a Demoness,” Franca concluded, a hint of disappointment in her voice.
unit.target: “Illam vix daemonissa fore puto,” Franca concludit, leviter tristitia in voce insinuans.

unit.source: Based on Lumian’s description and reaction to Perle’s appearance, she could tell the courtesan wasn’t a Demoness.
unit.target: Ex enarratione Lumiani et responsione ad speciem Perle, illa intellexit Courtesanam daemonissam non esse.

unit.source: Unless deliberately feigning ugliness, a Demoness’s charms were impossible to conceal.
unit.target: Nisi dolo foeditiam fingat, amoenitates daemonissae celari non possunt.

unit.source: Even gay men couldn’t resist sneaking a few extra glances.
unit.target: Etiam viri homosexuales non potuerunt non furtim pauca aspectus additos intueri.

unit.source: “Definitely not…” Lumian suddenly paused, remembering something.
unit.target: “Certe minime…” Lumian subito cessavit, aliquid recordans.

unit.source: Shifting to casual conversation, he asked, “Does coffee ground divination actually hold mystical significance? Can it truly provide revelation?”
unit.target: Conversus ad sermonem levem, rogavit: “Num divinatio ex pulveri caffeae vere significationem mysticam habeat? Num vere revelationem praebet?”

unit.source: Franca finished her bread, took another sip of the colorful liqueur, and smiled.
unit.target: Franca panem suum consumpsit, alium sorbetionem potus colorati cepit, et subridens arridit.

unit.source: “Of course mysticism is involved.”
unit.target: “Certe, mysteria implicantur.”

unit.source: Noting Lumian’s lack of divination knowledge compared to his skill in reading fate, Franca explained with a smug grin.
unit.target: Animadvertens defectum scientiae divinandi Lumiani comparatum ad artem fatum legendi, Franca facie superba explicavit.

unit.source: “You don’t need to put divination on some holy, unattainable pedestal.
unit.target: “Non opus est divinationem in aliquem sanctum, inaccessibilem statuam ponere.

unit.source: “Our Astral Projections constantly interact with the spirit world, obtaining information and receiving revelations.
unit.target: “Nostrae Proiectiones Astrales constanter cum mundo spirituum interagunt, notitias obtinent et revelationes accipiunt.

unit.source: These get reflected in reality through various forms.
unit.target: Hae in re variis modis reflectuntur.

unit.source: It’s true for both Beyonders and ordinary people.
unit.target: Hoc verum est tam pro Beyonders quam pro hominibus ordinariis.

unit.source: But those unskilled in divination struggle to proactively obtain revelations or effectively interpret them.
unit.target: Sed eos, qui in divinatione inexperti sunt, difficulter revelationes proactivas obtinere aut efficaciter interpretari possunt.

unit.source: For example, if a Beyonder chokes on a fishbone while eating, they’ll quickly realize it’s a warning from their spirit, containing a revelation needing interpretation.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, si Beyonder ossa piscium in edendo suffocatur, celeriter intellexerit hoc esse monitionem spiritus sui, revelationem interpretandam continens.

unit.source: But if regular folks have the same experience, they’ll just think they were unlucky or careless.
unit.target: Sed, si communes homines eandem experientiam habent, putabunt se tantum infortunatos aut neglegentes fuisse.

unit.source: It won’t stand out enough to warrant deeper consideration or deciphering.
unit.target: Non satis eminent ut altiori considerationi aut interpretationi subiciatur.

unit.source: Of course, getting a stuck fishbone doesn’t always indicate a spiritual warning.
unit.target: Certe, ossa piscis haerentia accipiendi non semper indicat admonitionem spiritualem.

unit.source: Usually it’s just lack of care.
unit.target: Saepe id tantum neglegentia curae est.

unit.source: Skilled diviners can tell the difference between a true revelation and a random occurrence.
unit.target: Periti divinatores differentiam inter veram revelationem et casum fortuitum discernere possunt.

unit.source: The unskilled tend to overthink, scaring themselves while ignoring what’s truly concerning.
unit.target: Inepti tendunt nimis cogitare, se terrosos facientes, dum id quod vere solliciti esse debet neglegunt.

unit.source: Given their upcoming fish course, Franca had used a relatable example.
unit.target: Propter imminens prandium piscale, Franca exemplo idoneo usus erat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, gaining a clearer understanding of divination.
unit.target: Lumian caput annuit, divinandi melius notitiam adipiscens.

unit.source: He asked thoughtfully, “So without deliberate control over the drinking method, coffee ground patterns can reveal something—but ordinary people’s interpretations may be inaccurate?”
unit.target: Rogavit cogitans: “Itaque, sine deliberato potandi regimine, figurae pulveris caffeae aliquid revelare possunt—sed interpretationes hominum ordinariorum fortasse inexactae erunt?”

unit.source: “Precisely!” Franca said excitedly.
unit.target: “Prorsum!” Franca dixit ferventer.

unit.source: “In the most rational environment, the decades‑popular coffee ground divination can come extremely close to reality.
unit.target: “In ambitu maxime rationali, divinatio ex pulveri caffeae, quae per decennia nota est, ad veritatem prope accedere potest.

unit.source: Each divination session can refine the standard interpretations until the meaning of every ground formation is definitively established.
unit.target: Quisque sessio divinatoria interpretationes communes emendare potest, donec significatio cuiusque formationis pulveris certo constituta sit.

unit.source: Then even regular people could interpret with reasonable accuracy.
unit.target: Tum etiam homines ordinarii interpretationem cum ratione accurata praestare possent.

unit.source: Sadly, reality is no bastion of pure rationality.
unit.target: Sed, realitas non est munimentum rationis purae.

unit.source: Believers in coffee divination subconsciously work to make even mistaken interpretations come true.
unit.target: Credentes in divinatione ex pulveri caffeae subconscie operantur, ut etiam interpretationes erratae verae fieri possint.

unit.source: Non‑believers plainly see the interpretations don’t match up.
unit.target: Non credentes manifeste vident interpretationes non congruere.

unit.source: These conflicting approaches get all tangled together, preventing the codification of standard, reliable answers.
unit.target: Hae rationes discordantes inter se implicantur, quod codificationem responsorum standardorum et certorum impediat.

unit.source: In the end, it’s just a game.
unit.target: Denique, solum ludus est.

unit.source: As they conversed, the waiter served the various dishes, clearing used plates as part of the set procedure.
unit.target: Dum colloquebantur, caupo varia fercula ministrabat, patinas usitatas purgans, secundum consuetudinem.

unit.source: The fried Fürth fish arrived as a later main course.
unit.target: Piscis Fürth fritus advenit ut posterius ferculum principale.

unit.source: Lumian cut a piece and tasted it—tender flesh with an intriguing blend of charred and oily notes, the pepper and salt seasoning just right.
unit.target: Lumian partem secavit et gustavit—caro tener cum mixtura ex ustis et oleosis notarum, condimentis piperis et salis temperatis admodum apta.

unit.source: “Delicious,” Franca praised.
unit.target: “Deliciosum,” Franca laudavit.

unit.source: “And warming too.”
unit.target: “Et quoque calefaciens.”

unit.source: Lumian also felt a current of warmth spread through him as the Fürth fish reached his stomach.
unit.target: Lumian etiam sensit caliditatis flumen per se diffundi, cum piscis Fürth in ventrem eius pervenit.

unit.source: “Some special ingredients indeed,” he concluded, teasing Franca.
unit.target: “Vere, specialia ingredientia sunt,” inquit, Franca iocose provocans.

unit.source: “Just don’t eat too fast—wouldn’t want you choking on a bone.”
unit.target: “Modo ne nimis celeriter edas—nolo ut ossa te suffocent.”

unit.source: Franca laughed.
unit.target: Franca risit.

unit.source: “You think a few bones can choke me?”
unit.target: “Putone pauca ossa me suffocare posse?”

unit.source: Glancing around to confirm the waiter’s departure, she asked,
unit.target: Circumspiciens ut discessum cauponis confirmaret, rogavit:

unit.source: “I’ve been pondering something the last couple days.
unit.target: “His proximis diebus aliquid meditatus sum.

unit.source: I still can’t grasp the difference between using rituals and curses to influence a target’s future fate versus directly compelling a fate change.
unit.target: Nondum intellego discrimen inter usum ritus et maledictionum ad fatum futuri destinatum afficiendum, et directam mutationem fatum coegerendam.

unit.source: Lumian organized his thoughts before explaining.
unit.target: Lumian cogitationes suas ordinavit antequam explicare coepit.

unit.source: “In the mysticism knowledge of Fate Appropriators, a curse is a curse of fate.
unit.target: “In scientia mystica Fatorum Appropriatorum, maledictio est maledictio fatum.

unit.source: “Compared to rituals, curses are simpler, with fewer required conditions.
unit.target: “Comparatis ritibus, maledictio simplicior est, cum pauciores conditiones necessariae sint.

unit.source: But that significantly limits the ultimate effect.
unit.target: Sed hoc effectum ultimum significanter limitat.

unit.source: Nothing too outlandish can be achieved.
unit.target: Nihil nimis insolitum effici potest.

unit.source: Many bestowed of Inevitability like to call this type of curse Magnified Fate.
unit.target: Multi, qui Inevitabilitate donati sunt, hunc genus maledictionis “Fatum Magnificatum” appellare malunt.

unit.source: It can only target fate tributaries within the next ten seconds, and must align with the current environment and circumstances.
unit.target: Illud solum potest intendere ad fatum tributaria intra proximos decem secundos, et debet convenire cum ambitu et circumstantiis praesentibus.

unit.source: Meeting those prerequisites enables the fate curse to succeed.
unit.target: Cum illa praerequisita impleta sunt, maledictio fatum succedere sinit.

unit.source: And the targeted fate tributary needs a certain probability of manifesting in the first place, or the success rate plummets.
unit.target: Et fatum tributarium destinatum certa probabilitate manifestandi opus habet, alioquin ratio successus labitur.

unit.source: Simply put, one first uses or alters the environment to enable certain possibilities, then magnifies those possibilities—assuming they weren’t extremely unlikely to begin with.
unit.target: Simpliciter, primo ambitum utitur aut mutat, ut certas possibilitates fieri possint, deinde has possibilitates amplificat—supponendo eas non ab initio nimis improbabiles fuisse.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Franca, raising his right palm to gesture as he mischievously provided an example.
unit.target: Lumian Francam aspexit, dextram manum levans ad gestum faciendum, dum ludibriose exemplo praebebat.

unit.source: “For instance, while you’re eating fish, I could use a curse to magnify the chance of you choking on a bone.
unit.target: “Exempli gratia, dum piscem edis, maledictione uti possem ad augendam facultatem ut ossa te suffocare incitarent.

unit.source: “But I couldn’t magnify the chance of your chair suddenly collapsing, impaling you with wood splinters.”
unit.target: “Sed non possem augere facultatem ut sella tua subito corrueret, te lignorum fragmentis aculeis impingeret.”

unit.source: The moment he finished speaking, Franca froze, gasping twice as her throat worked.
unit.target: Mox postquam locutus est, Franca immobilis facta est, bis suspirans, dum guttur eius operabatur.

unit.source: Within seconds, she spat out a bloody fishbone.
unit.target: In paucis secundis, exspuit ossa piscis sanguinolenta.

unit.source: “You actually did it?” Franca grumbled.
unit.target: “Revera id fecisti?” Franca murmuravit.

unit.source: “Luckily my Sequence grants strong throat control.
unit.target: “Fortunate, mea Sequence validam moderationem gutturis concedit.

unit.source: I handled it myself.
unit.target: Ego ipse id curavi.

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca suddenly paused.
unit.target: “Uh…” Franca subito cessavit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, she said, “Otherwise we’d be seeking a doctor’s aid.
unit.target: Post paucas secundas, inquit: “Alioquin medicum quaressemus.

unit.source: How embarrassing would that be!”
unit.target: “Quam vere pudendum id esset!”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian cachinnavit.

unit.source: “I could’ve helped pull it out, magnifying the fate tributary of successful extraction.”
unit.target: “Possem id extrahere adiuvare, fatum tributarium extractionis felicis augeando.”

unit.source: Franca was briefly speechless.
unit.target: Franca breviter muta fuit.

unit.source: After eating another bite of Fürth fish, she nodded.
unit.target: Postquam alium morsum piscis Fürth edidit, caput annuit.

unit.source: “I understand the differences now.
unit.target: “Nunc differentias intellego.

unit.source: “Curses, or Magnify, suit combat.
unit.target: “Maledictiones, aut Fatum Magnificatum, certaminibus conveniunt.

unit.source: They’re mainly for interfering with and influencing enemies, not accomplishing anything too exaggerated.
unit.target: Praecipue ad hostes impediendos et influendos sunt, non ad res nimis exaggeratas perficiendas.

unit.source: Rituals are done in advance.
unit.target: Ritus antea peraguntur.

unit.source: With the right items, they can largely steer a target’s fate as desired.
unit.target: Cum rebus idoneis, fatum obiectum prorsus, ut optatur, dirigere possunt.

unit.source: “But only in a general direction,” Lumian added.
unit.target: “Sed solum in directione generali,” Lumian addidit.

unit.source: “No real precision.
unit.target: “Nulla vera praecisio.

unit.source: I could make someone have a bad day, but not dictate the exact flavor of misfortune.”
unit.target: Ego alicui diem malum efficere possum, sed non exacte gustum infortunii determinare.

unit.source: Franca nodded.
unit.target: Franca caput annuit.

unit.source: “So compelling fate is like a streamlined ritual for live combat that still packs a punch?”
unit.target: “Ergo fatum compellere est quasi ritualis compendiosa pro certamine vivente, quae tamen vim affert?”

unit.source: “Perhaps even stronger and more precise effects,” Lumian mused.
unit.target: “Forsitan etiam effectus fortiores et magis precisos,” Lumian meditatus est.

unit.source: “Plus, many abilities transformed in unique ways when Fate Appropriator and Reaper fused, bringing with them the relevant mystical knowledge.
unit.target: “Praeterea, multae facultates in modis singulares transformatae sunt, cum Fatorum Appropriator et Reaper se contulerunt, simul pertinentem scientiam mysticam afferentes.

unit.source: “I can’t fully distinguish the inherent from the individualized—I only know the Eye of Calamity and Compelling Fate came from Reaper.”
unit.target: “Non possum plene distinguere quod sit inherens ab individuato—solum scio Oculum Calamitatis et Fatum Compellens ex Reaper provenisse.”

unit.source: They enjoyed the rest of their lunch.
unit.target: Reliquam prandii partem fruebantur.

unit.source: “As the meal concluded, Lumian pointed to the half‑eaten Fürth fish, instructing the waiter, ‘I’d like this wrapped up to go.’”
unit.target: “Cum prandium confectum esset, Lumian ad piscem Fürth dimidium editum ostendit et cauponi praecipiens dedit: ‘Hoc involutum mihi tolli velim.’

unit.source: The waiter complied respectfully without question.
unit.target: Caupo oboedivit reverenter, sine quaestionibus.

unit.source: Franca smiled teasingly.
unit.target: Franca subridens iocose arridit.

unit.source: “How frugal of you.”
unit.target: “Quam parcus es.”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian cachinnavit.

unit.source: “This is expected of a godfather.
unit.target: “Hoc a padrino exspectatur.

unit.source: “Besides, I’m curious what makes this fish so special.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, curiosus sum quid hunc piscem tam speciale faciat.”

unit.source: Chapter 706: The Utility of Delicacies
unit.target: Capitulum 706: Utilitas Deliciarum

unit.source: In another apartment on Rue Orosay in the Quartier de la Cathedrale Commemorative, Lumian placed the cold Furth fish in front of Ludwig.
unit.target: In alia habitatione in via Orosay in Quartiere Cathedrale Commemorative, Lumian piscem Furth frigidum coram Ludovico posuit.

unit.source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up when he saw the pan‐fried fish in the exquisite wooden box.
unit.target: Oculi Ludovici fulserunt cum piscem sartum in arca lignea exquisita conspexit.

unit.source: He quickly turned to Lugano, who understood his meaning and handed over a child’s knife and fork he had found in the newly rented room.
unit.target: Celeriter se vertit ad Lugano, qui sensum eius intellexit et tradidit puerilem cultrum atque furcam, quas in nuper conducto conclavi inveniret.

unit.source: Lumian leaned back in his chair and watched as Ludwig sliced the remaining half of the fish into pieces, chewing and swallowing the meat along with the bones.
unit.target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit et spectavit, dum Ludovicus dimidium piscis reliquum in frusta secabat, carnem ossibus simul masticans et deglutens.

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian to inquire, Ludwig narrowed his eyes, seemingly enjoying himself, and said, “The Forth Firefish is a mutated fish resulting from the corruption leaking from Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Sine exspectatione, ut Lumian interrogaret, Ludovicus oculos contraxit, quasi sibi ipsi delectaretur, et dixit: “Piscis Ignifer Forthus est piscis mutatus, ortus ex corruptione effusae ex Aetate Quarta Trier.

unit.source: Its breed stabilized 769 years ago and mainly resides in the Danro section of the underground Madar River.
unit.target: Species eius ante 769 annos stabilita est et praesertim in regione Danro fluminis subterranei Madar habitat.

unit.source: Its meat and blood can be concocted into a “warm cocktail” with various sunflowers.
unit.target: Caro eius et sanguis in mixturam calidam cum variis helianthorum componi possunt.

unit.source: After drinking it, one can resist the effects of the cold to a certain extent for half an hour.
unit.target: Postquam id biberit, quisdam effectibus frigoris ad aliquam modum per dimidiam horam resistere potest.

unit.source: “A Furth Firefish that has lived for over a decade is an ingredient rich in spirituality.
unit.target: Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, est elementum spiritualitate dives.

unit.source: Using its meat, blood from a Mid-Sequence Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, ice, and lemon juice, one can cook Ice Lemon Fish fillets.
unit.target: Uti carne eius, sanguine a Beyonder Medio-Sequenti viae Venatoris, glacie, et succo citri, fileta Piscis Ice Lemon coqui possunt.

unit.source: After anyone eats them for the first time, they permanently enjoy reduced damage from flames.
unit.target: Postquam ea quisquam primum edit, damna ignis in perpetuum minuantur.

unit.source: Eating them later will enhance the effect, but it only lasts for half an hour.
unit.target: Postea edendo effectus augebitur, sed tantum per dimidiam horam permanet.

unit.source: Lumian nodded in enlightenment.
unit.target: Lumian in sapientia caput annuit.

unit.source: In Franca’s words, the first time its eaten, it adds some permanent fire resistance.
unit.target: Secundum verba Francae, ea primum edenda, addit aliquam permanentem ignis repugnantiam.

unit.source: The subsequent enhancements are temporary…
unit.target: Subsequentes emendationes sunt temporariae…

unit.source: Lugano was taken aback.
unit.target: Lugano obstupefactus est.

unit.source: Ludwig actually knows cooking?
unit.target: Revera Ludovicus artem coquinariae novit?

unit.source: Moreover, it involves cooking with superpowers!
unit.target: Praeterea, hoc implicat coquinam utens virtutibus supernaturales.

unit.source: Can 1 help him get ingredients rich in spirituality and have him make similar delicacies for me?
unit.target: Potesne mihi adiuvare, ut ei ingredimenta spiritualitate dives comparare possit et pro me similes delicatias praeparare?

unit.source: It seems capable of permanently enhancing some of my abilities!
unit.target: Videtur posse aliquas facultates meas permanentiter auget.

unit.source: After Ludwig finished his meal, Lumian suddenly thought of something.
unit.target: Postquam Ludovicus cenam finivit, Lumian subito aliquid cogitavit.

unit.source: Franca’s ritual for advancing to the Demoness of Affliction involved being burned at the stake—without using a substitute—for fifteen minutes and surviving without going mad.
unit.target: Ritualis Francae ad Demoness Afflictionis ascendentem consistit in comburendo ad supplicium per quindecim minuta, sine substituto, et superstes manere sine insanire.

unit.source: If Franca eats Furth Firefish’s Ice Lemon Fish fillet to increase her fire resistance, although the pain won’t abate, her chances of surviving the incineration will greatly increase.
unit.target: Si Franca filetan Piscis Ice Lemon Furth edit, ad augendam ignis repugnantiam, quamquam dolor non remittetur, probabilitas eius incinerationem superandi multum augescet.

unit.source: When the time comes, she can eat some more temporarily before the ritual.
unit.target: Cum tempus adveniet, paulo amplius ante ritum edere potest.

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he quickly made up his mind.
unit.target: Lumiani cogitationes celeriter volaverunt, dum mox mentem suam constanter firmavit.

unit.source: Today, he would head to Underground Trier to search for Fiirth Firefish that had lived for over a decade!
unit.target: Hodie, ad Trier subterraneum se diriget ut piscem Furth Ignifer, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, quaerat!

unit.source: From his Traveler’s Bag, Lumian retrieved a map of Underground Trier reconstructed from his memories, derived from the one Gardner Martin had once displayed.
unit.target: Ex sacculo Viatoris suo, Lumian mappam Trier subterraneum ex memoriis suis reconstructam evexit, quae a Gardner Martin olim ostensa erat.

unit.source: He searched for the location of the Danro section of the Madar underground river.
unit.target: Locum partis Danro fluminis subterranei Madar investigavit.

unit.source: As Lumian scrutinized the map, he asked Ludwig with a smile, “How do you know the precise name of the source? Do Furth Firefish have knowledge of the rivers they inhabit?”
unit.target: Dum Lumian mappam diligenter examinabat, Ludovico risu quaesivit: “Quomodo scis praecisum nomen fontis? Habentne Piscēs Furth Ignifer scientiam de fluminibus quibus habitant?”

unit.source: Ludwig licked his lips, unsatisfied.
unit.target: Ludovicus labra lambit, non contentus.

unit.source: “Indeed, they do. From years of fishing, humans inevitably mention the names of rivers and specific sections. Even if Furth Firefish don’t comprehend the meaning, they instinctively retain this information in their corresponding cells when repeatedly exposed to it.”
unit.target: “Revera, ita est. Ex annis piscandi, homines necessario nomina fluminum et specificas partes memorant. Etiam si Piscēs Furth Ignifer significatum non capiunt, instinctive hanc notitiam in cellulis suis retinent.”

unit.source: “Interesting.” Lumian had posed the question in jest, not anticipating such a serious response.
unit.target: “Interes.” Lumian quaestionem iocose proposuerat, non praevidens talem responsionem gravem.

unit.source: Pointing to himself, he inquired curiously, “Will consuming the Ice Lemon Fish fillet reduce the burn damage I sustain?”
unit.target: Indicans se, curiosus quaesivit: “Num edendo filetum Piscis Ice Lemon damna combustionis, quae mihi inferuntur, minuantur?”

unit.source: As a Reaper, flames inflict relatively minimal damage to him.
unit.target: Ut Messor, flammae damna parva ei infligunt.

unit.source: Ludwig picked up a minuscule remnant of the fish, no larger than a grain of rice, from the exquisite wooden box and presented it to Lumian.
unit.target: Ludovicus ex arca lignea exquisita remnantem minutum piscis, non majus quam granum oryzae, sustulit et Lumiano tradidit.

unit.source: “Only this much.”
unit.target: “Tantum hoc.”

unit.source: Without hesitation, the boy promptly popped the morsel into his mouth.
unit.target: Sine mora, puer statim rem in os suum introduxit.

unit.source: “Well, that’s better than nothing,” Lumian remarked with a smile and a sigh.
unit.target: “Atque hoc melius est quam nihil,” Lumian cum risu et suspirio dixit.

unit.source: He intended to secure a special serving of Ice Lemon Fish fillet for himself, with additional portions for Jenna, Anthony, Lugano, and Ludwig!
unit.target: Intendebat sibi propriam portionem fileti Piscis Ice Lemon obtinere, itemque partes additas pro Jenna, Anthony, Lugano, atque Ludovico!

unit.source: To accomplish this task, Lumian proactively inquired, “How does a Furth Firefish that has lived for over a decade differ from its ordinary counterparts?”
unit.target: Ad hoc perficiendum, Lumian proactivus quaesivit: “Quomodo differat Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui plus quam decem annos vixerit, ab ordinariis suis?”

unit.source: Ludwig’s response sounded as if he were reciting from a textbook, “A Furth Firefish that has survived for more than a decade can grow to nearly a meter in length and tends to reside in caves at the riverbed. They rarely approach the surface but exhibit a keen sensitivity to blood and spiritually rich food. These fish are highly aggressive and willing to take significant risks driven by their instincts.”
unit.target: Ludovicus respondit quasi ex testo: “Piscis Ignifer Furth, qui ultra decem annos superfuit, ad fere metrum crescere potest et in speluncis iuxta ripas fluminis habitare solet. Raro enim ad superficiem accedunt, sed acutam sensibilitatem erga sanguinem atque cibos spiritualiter dives ostendunt. Hi piscēs sunt vehementer aggressivi et pericula significantia, instinctibus impellentia, subire volunt.”

unit.source: “Their skin has hardened, rendering them impervious to fishing spears.
unit.target: Pellis eorum durata est, ita ut telis piscandi invulnerabiles sint.

unit.source: Sharp teeth fill their mouths, enabling them to devour any humans who happen to fall into the river.
unit.target: Dentes acuti ora eorum implet, quae eos facit ut homines, qui in flumen cadant, devorare possint.

unit.source: Additionally, their blood possesses a distinct burning characteristic.
unit.target: Praeterea, sanguis eorum proprietatem ignis distinctam exhibet.

unit.source: After attentively listening, Lumian calmly assessed the information.
unit.target: Postquam attente audivit, Lumian informationem tranquillē perpendit.

unit.source: Despite their longevity of over a decade, Furth Firefish did not possess Beyonder characteristics or acquire supernatural abilities through boons.
unit.target: Quamquam ultra decem annos vixerunt, Piscēs Furth Ignifer proprietates Beyonder non habebant nec facultates supernaturales per dona acceperunt.

unit.source: They belonged to a species that had undergone corruption but had since stabilized.
unit.target: Ad speciem pertinebant quae corruptionem passa erat, sed postea stabilita est.

unit.source: If they were to continue living in such an environment for tens of thousands of years, they might evolve into creatures with their own intricate society, akin to the Batings Black Insect.
unit.target: Si in tali ambitu per decem milia annorum vixerent, evolvere possent in creaturas cum propria intricata societate, similes “Batings Black Insect.”

unit.source: As he put away the map and stood up, Lumian turned to Ludwig and asked thoughtfully before leaving,
unit.target: Cum mappam recondidisset et surrexisset, Lumian ad Ludovicum conversus, antequam discessit, cogitato quaesivit:

unit.source: “Apart from the permanent enhancements, does this special cooking method involve any adverse effects, such as corruption?”
unit.target: “Praeter augmentationes permanentes, num haec methodus specialis coquendi aliquos effectus adversos, sicut corruptionem, includit?”

unit.source: Ludwig scrutinized Lumian and remained silent. Lumian suspected that Ludwig was internally mocking him.
unit.target: Ludovicus Lumian percontatus tacuit; Lumian suspicabatur Ludovicum intus eum deridere.

unit.source: For someone already deeply corrupted, the concern over a minuscule amount of additional corruption seemed trivial.
unit.target: Nam, cum aliquis iam alte corruptus esset, sollicitudo de parva quantitate corruptionis addita trivialis videbatur.

unit.source: After a brief pause, Ludwig replied, “As a child, I lack understanding of such matters. What I do know is that if one desires to indulge in finer and more delectable cuisine, they must be willing to accept the associated risks. Those unwilling to take the risk can simply choose not to partake…”
unit.target: Post breve silentium, Ludovicus respondit: “Ut puer, huiusmodi rebus intellectum mihi defuit. Quod autem scio est, si quis exquisitiorem et sapidoriorem escam petat, pericula consociata suscipere debet. Qui periculum non capere volunt, simpliciter recusare possunt…”

unit.source: Ludwig instinctively added, “If you don’t wish to eat, you can always leave the food for me.”
unit.target: Ludovicus instinctu addidit: “Si non vis edere, cibum mihi relinquere potes.”

unit.source: With a slight nod, Lumian opened the door and exited the apartment.
unit.target: Levis annuit, Lumian ianuam aperuit et ex habitatione discessit.

unit.source: In the depths of Underground Trier, the Madar River flowed through a tranquil, deserted, and dimly lit cave, its gentle splashing echoing in the distance.
unit.target: In profunda Trier subterraneum, flumen Madar per speluncam quietam, desertam, et parve luminatam fluebat, eius lenis strepitus in longinquo resonans.

unit.source: Emerging from the shadows, Lumian, Franca, and Jenna made their way to the riverbank.
unit.target: Emergentes ex umbris, Lumian, Franca, et Jenna ad ripam fluminis accesserunt.

unit.source: One carried a carbide lamp, while the other two traveled empty-handed.
unit.target: Unus lampadem carbidae gerebat, dum duo ceteri sine muneribus iter faciebant.

unit.source: Although ingredient suppliers seeking to monopolize Furth Firefish guarded this section of the subterranean river, it posed no significant challenge for a Hunter and two Demonesses.
unit.target: Quamquam venditores ingredientorum, cupientes Piscem Furth Ignifer monopolizare, hanc partem fluminis subterranei custodiabant, id nihil momenti pro Venatore et duabus Demonessibus repraesentabat.

unit.source: Utilizing the shadows, they deftly navigated through the patrolled area and successfully reached the water’s edge.
unit.target: Utendo umbris, arte per regionem custoditam navigaverunt et feliciter ripam aquae attigerunt.

unit.source: Raising his carbide lamp, Lumian discovered that the underground river was not only expansive but also incredibly deep.
unit.target: Levans lampadem carbidae, Lumian invenit flumen subterraneum non solum spatiosum esse, sed etiam incredibiliter profundum.

unit.source: Submerged caves lined the riverbed, inhabited by peculiar fish.
unit.target: Speluncae submersae fluminis fundo erant, et in eis piscēs peculiares habitabant.

unit.source: After a quick survey, Lumian set the carbide lamp down, rolled up his sleeves, and crouched beside the river.
unit.target: Post rapidam inspectionem, Lumian lampadem carbidae deponit, manicas revolvit, et iuxta flumen se procubuit.

unit.source: Without hesitation, he plunged his right arm into the frigid water.
unit.target: Sine mora, dextrum brachium in aquam frigidam immergit.

unit.source: “Is this your preferred method of fishing?” Franca inquired, well aware of Lumian’s penchant for “fishing.” However, she hadn’t anticipated him employing the same technique when his prey was, quite literally, fish.
unit.target: “Estne hoc modus tuus praelatus piscandi?” Franca quaesivit, bene consciens Lumiani amoris piscandi. Attamen, non praevidit eum eandem rationem adhibere, cum praeda eius vere piscis esset.

unit.source: “What alternative do I have?” Lumian chuckled. “Would you prefer I strip down, dive into the underwater caves, and catch them with my bare hands?”
unit.target: “Quid aliud mihi restat?” Lumian subridens quaesivit: “Vel mavis ut me exueam, in speluncas subaquaneas descendeam, et eas manibus nudis caperem?”

unit.source: “That’s not an impossibility,” Franca replied with a playful smile. “It would provide an excellent opportunity to admire your physique.”
unit.target: “Non est impossibile,” Franca respondit cum risu ludico. “Occasio optimus esset ad tuam figuram admirandam.”

unit.source: Ignoring her comment, Lumian focused his spirituality, causing a thin layer of white flames to emanate from his thumb.
unit.target: Neglegens eius commentarium, Lumian spiritualitati suae intendit, et tenuis lamina albae flammae ex pollice eius emanavit.

unit.source: The flames, resistant to the water’s extinguishing effect, took the form of a small knife and carefully sliced his index finger.
unit.target: Flammae, aquae exstinctioni repugnantes, in parvum cultrum vertuntur et diligenter digiti indicis sectionem secaverunt.

unit.source: A single drop of blood seeped out, rapidly dispersing into the surrounding water.
unit.target: Una gutta sanguinis efflata, celeriter in aquam circumstantem dispersa est.

unit.source: The Forth Firefish swimming in the shallows seemed to detect an ominous presence and swiftly retreated from the area where the blood had spread.
unit.target: Piscis Ignifer Forthus, in aquis tenuibus natans, videbatur praesentiam funestam deprehendere et celeriter ab eo loco, ubi sanguis diffusus erat, recedere.

unit.source: Moments later, enormous Furth Firefish, their skin charred and hardened, emerged from the caves along the riverbed.
unit.target: Post paululum, ingentes Piscēs Furth Ignifer, quorum cutis exarserat et durata erat, ex speluncis iuxta ripas fluminis emerguerunt.

unit.source: One particularly swift specimen reached Lumian’s right hand in a flash, its mouth wide open to reveal sharp, gleaming teeth.
unit.target: Unum speciem praecipue celerem in momento ad manum dextram Lumiani pervenit, ore late aperto, qui dentes acutos et nitidos ostendebat.

unit.source: Before it could sink its teeth into his flesh, Lumian’s palm abruptly clenched into a fist.
unit.target: Priusquam dentes in carnem eius infirent, palma Lumiani subito in pugnum concrepuit.

unit.source: Instead of withdrawing, he thrust his hand forward, punching directly into the fish’s gaping maw.
unit.target: Non recedens, manum suam protulit, et directe in os pisci, quod late patebat, pulsavit.

unit.source: With a resounding bang, Lumian grasped the creature’s skull and hauled the colossal Furth fish out of the river.
unit.target: Cum resonans ictu, Lumian calvariam creaturae apprehendit et colossalem piscem Furth e flumine extraxit.

unit.source: Silently, cold and sinister black flames ignited in the river, incinerating Lumian’s blood that had merged with the water.
unit.target: Sine strepitu, frigidae atque nefariae nigrae flammae in flumine accensa sunt, sanguinem Lumiani, qui cum aqua coniunctus erat, incinerantes.

unit.source: It was Jenna.
unit.target: Illa erat Jenna.

unit.source: “We can return now,” Lumian declared, tossing the massive Furth fish to Franca.
unit.target: “Nunc redire possumus,” Lumian dixit, colossalem piscem Furth Francae iactans.

unit.source: As Franca caught the ingredient, freezing it and storing it in her Traveler’s Bag, she appeared lost in thought.
unit.target: Cum Franca ingrediens cepit, eam congelans et in sacculo Viatoris suo reponens, videbatur mente profunda absorpta.

unit.source: Keenly observing her demeanor, Lumian asked, “What’s on your mind?”
unit.target: Eius habitum acute observans, Lumian quaesivit: “Quid tibi in mente est?”

unit.source: Pointing in a specific direction, Franca responded, “I remember that nearby, we entered a unique mirror world and acquired the classic silver mirror that granted Anthony and me access to Fourth Epoch Trier.”
unit.target: Indicans in certum directionem, Franca respondit: “Memini quod prope ingressi sumus in mundum specularum unicum et acceperamus speculum argenteum classicum, quod Antoni et mihi ad Trier Aetatem Quartam accessum dedit.”

unit.source: “Indeed,” Lumian acknowledged, gesturing for Franca to continue.
unit.target: “Revera,” Lumian agnovit, gesticulans Francae ut prosequeretur.

unit.source: Averting her gaze, Franca expressed her thoughts, “I’m contemplating whether we could utilize the mirror world to stage an ambush against Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Abiecto aspectu, Franca cogitationes suas exponens dixit: “Cogito num possimus mundum specularum uti ad insidias contra Moran Avigny componendas.

unit.source: Specifically, I’m referring to the conventional mirror world that interconnects all the mirrors in this world.”
unit.target: Speciatim, refero ad mundum specularum conventionalem, qui omnia specula huius mundi internectit.

unit.source: In the conventional sense, the mirror world functioned more akin to a conceptual amalgamation of doors rather than a tangible realm.
unit.target: In sensu conventionali, mundus specularum potius operabatur ut congeries conceptuum ostiarum quam ut regnum tangibile.

unit.source: It served as an intricate network of passageways linking various mirrors and enigmatic lands.
unit.target: Fungebatur ut rete intricatum itinerum, quod diversa specula et terras arcana coniungit.

unit.source: In essence, if Franca could harness the mirror world and pinpoint the precise location, she could conceal herself behind the mirror frequently used by Moran Avigny and launch an attack the moment her target entered.
unit.target: In essentia, si Franca mundum specularum capere et locum exactum determinare posset, se post speculum, quod a Moran Avigny frequenter adhibetur, celare atque oppugnationem in momento quo meta eius intraret, incipere poterat.

unit.source: “What is it that you truly wish to convey?” Lumian raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: “Quid igitur vere vis exprimere?” Lumian supercilia eleverat.

unit.source: Franca eagerly elaborated, “Considering that a portion of the corruption from Fourth Epoch Trier has seeped into this area, giving rise to unique creatures like Furth Firefish and the extraordinary mirror world we previously explored, is it plausible that within this vast underground expanse, there exists a secluded corner influenced by the corruption of a select few high-level Demoness powers over an extended period?
unit.target: Franca studiosissime elaboravit: “Considerans partem corruptionis ex Aetate Quarta Trier in hanc regionem pervenisse, quae creaturas singulares, ut Piscēs Furth Ignifer, et mundum specularum extraordinarium, quem ante exploravimus, gignit, num in hac vasta subterranea regione angulus reclusus exsistat, a corruptione paucarum potentium Demoness altiorum per longum tempus affectus?

unit.source: Could it be possible for one to traverse through the mirror and enter the mirror world without attaining the status of a demigod Demoness?
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut quis per speculum transgrediatur et in mundum specularum ingrediatur, sine statum semidei Demoness assequendo?

unit.source: After a moment of serious contemplation, Lumian replied, “It’s a possibility.”
unit.target: Post brevissimam meditationem, Lumian respondit: “Possibilis est.”

unit.source: Jenna’s eyes darted around as she suggested, “Could it be the location where you discovered the special mirror? That area must have been corrupted by the power emanating from Fourth Epoch Trier’s mirror world.”
unit.target: Oculi Jenna circum volvens, Franca proposuit: “Num id sit locus quo speculum speciale invenisti? Illa regio certe corrupta est potentia, quae ex mundo specularum Aetate Quarta Trier emanat.”

unit.source: “We can investigate,” Lumian said with a smile. “There’s no need to rush. If it proves unsuccessful, we can bide our time. Once Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristic is transformed into a Sealed Artifact, perhaps we can assume the form of Wraiths and conceal ourselves within the mirror. However, I’m uncertain whether Wraiths possess the ability to navigate the mirror world.”
unit.target: “Investigare possumus,” Lumian cum risu dixit. “Non est opus festinare. Si res infelix erit, tempus exspectare possumus. Cum indolem Beyonder de Hisoka in Artefactum Sigillatum transformatum erit, fortasse formam Wraithum assumere possimus et intra speculum nos celare. Tamen, incertus sum an Wraithes facultatem habeant mundum specularum navigandi.”

unit.source: “Let’s prioritize the search!” Franca declared, retrieving her Mirror World Fragment. She hoped that this item might provide some unique means of detection.
unit.target: “Investigatio praevaleat!” Franca declaravit, fragmentum Mundi Specularum suum recuperans. Sperabat hoc rem aliquam viam detectionis unicam praebiturum esse.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the fragment and, after a brief contemplation, advised seriously, “Holding the Mirror World Fragment is unlikely to yield any benefit. Instead, take out the Primordial Demoness figurine…”
unit.target: Lumian fragmentum aspexit, et post breve cogitationem serio monuit: “Fragmentum Mundi Specularum tenere vix ullum beneficium afferet; proinde, tolle figurinam Demonissae Primordialis.”

unit.source: 707 Compulsion
unit.target: 707 Compulsio

unit.source: In the dark, silent tunnel, Franca advanced slowly, holding the Primordial Demoness figurine made of bone.
unit.target: In obscuro et silente cuniculo, Franca lente procedebat, tenens effigiem Demonissae Primordialis ex os factam.

unit.source: Her footsteps were so soft they were nearly inaudible.
unit.target: Vestigia eius tam levia erant ut fere inaudibilia essent.

unit.source: Lumian, clutching his carbide lamp, and Jenna trailed silently behind her.
unit.target: Lumian, lampadem carbidae tenens, et Jenna silentio eam sequerentur.

unit.source: With a Hunter’s keen understanding of the terrain and memories, the three had finished exploring the area where they had obtained the classic silver mirror.
unit.target: Cum venatoris acuta intellegentia de regione et memoriis, tres finiverant explorare locum in quo speculum argenteum classicum adepti erant.

unit.source: They had even expanded their search to include the nearby underground tunnels and connected quarry caves.
unit.target: Etiam indagationem suam dilataverunt ut includerent cuniculos subterraneos proximos et speluncas fodinarum conexas.

unit.source: However, the Primordial Demoness figurine showed no abnormal reactions, and neither Franca nor Jenna sensed anything out of the ordinary.
unit.target: Tamen, effigies Demonissae Primordialis nullas reactiones anormales ostendit, neque Franca neque Jenna aliquid insolitum sensit.

unit.source: Franca sighed.
unit.target: Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: “Well, this is disappointing.”
unit.target: “Heu, hoc vere deludens est.”

unit.source: “Bold assumptions leading to a shameful failure!”
unit.target: “Audaces coniecturae ad ignobilem cladem ducunt!”

unit.source: She had no intention of giving up, but wanted to return to the surface first and contact 007.
unit.target: Non habebat propositum cedere, sed primum ad superficiem redire voluit et 007 contingere.

unit.source: She hoped to use the authorities’ detailed records of underground abnormalities to search for any areas where a high-level Demoness’s power might be seeping out.
unit.target: Sperabat uti accuratis tabulis ab auctoritatibus de anomaliis subterraneis ad quaerendas regiones, in quibus potentia Demonissae altissimae exfluere posset.

unit.source: Having experienced numerous mystical incidents, Lumian surveyed the area, pondering for a few seconds.
unit.target: Multa mystica experientia habens, Lumian regionem perspexit et paulisper meditatus est.

unit.source: “Let’s investigate again.”
unit.target: “Iterum investigemus.”

unit.source: “This time, I’ll extinguish the carbide lamp.”
unit.target: “Hoc tempore, lampadem carbidem exstinguam.”

unit.source: “In mysticism, Demonesses and the mirror world are always associated with darkness, evil, and quiet depth.”
unit.target: “In mystica, Demonissae et mundus specularis semper cum tenebris, malitia, et quieta profunditate coniunguntur.”

unit.source: “Perhaps subtle reactions can occur in the absence of light.”
unit.target: “Forsitan reactiones subtiles in absentia lucis fieri possint.”

unit.source: “Subtle reactions… What is this, a chemistry experiment?”
unit.target: “Reactiones subtiles… Quid hoc est, experimentum chemicum?”

unit.source: Franca scoffed, but chose to comply.
unit.target: Franca irridens dixit, sed obtemperare statuit.

unit.source: She turned to Jenna.
unit.target: Ad Jennam se vertit.

unit.source: “Hold your Mirror World Fragment in your hand.”
unit.target: “Tene fragmentum Mundi Specularis in manu tua.”

unit.source: “If we’re giving this a shot, we should try everything.”
unit.target: “Si hoc experiemur, omnia conari debemus.”

unit.source: Jenna took out the Mirror World Fragment she had obtained from the Tamara family tomb, and Lumian turned the switch to extinguish the carbide lamp.
unit.target: Jenna extraxit fragmentum Mundi Specularis, quod ex sepulcro familiae Tamara adeptus erat, et Lumian rotam vertit ad lampadem carbidem exstinguendam.

unit.source: The silent tunnel plunged into absolute darkness.
unit.target: Cuniculus silentiosus in tenebras absolutas cecidit.

unit.source: As a Hunter, Lumian couldn’t see a thing.
unit.target: Ut venator, Lumian nihil videre poterat.

unit.source: “You can hold onto my sleeve,” Jenna suggested calmly.
unit.target: «Manicam meam tene,» Jenna tranquille proposuit.

unit.source: “Or activate your Spirit Vision and follow our spiritual light.”
unit.target: «Aut spiritum visionem tuam activa et lucem nostram spiritualem sequere.»

unit.source: Lumian replied with a smile, “That would make me look weak. I suspect you’re deliberately showing off. Have you forgotten? I can gain night vision by changing my life form.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit, "Id me debilem apparere faceret. Suspicio te deliberanter ostentare. Oblitus es? Mutando formam meae vitae, nocturnam visionem adipisci possum."

unit.source: Jenna was silent for a moment before retorting,
unit.target: Jenna paulisper silentium tenuit antequam replicavit,

unit.source: “Dammit! Would it kill you to be a bit nicer about it?”
unit.target: “Heu! Num te occidat, si paulo amabilius ageres?”

unit.source: “She’s right,” Franca agreed.
unit.target: «Illa recte dicit,» Franca assentivit.

unit.source: “Jenna was just trying to help.”
unit.target: «Jenna solum auxilium ferre conabatur.»

unit.source: “It’s fine if you don’t want her assistance, but there’s no need to mock her.”
unit.target: «Licet auxilium eius non desideres, sed non necesse est eam deridere.»

unit.source: “That’s a Hunter for you.” Lumian chuckled as he activated the black mark on his body, transforming into a shadow creature.
unit.target: «Ita sunt venatores.» Lumian subridens activavit notam nigram in corpore suo, transformatus in creaturam umbratam.

unit.source: He blended into the shadows and followed Franca and Jenna as they explored the area for the second time.
unit.target: Se in umbras misit et Francam atque Jennam secutus est dum locum secundum iterum explorabant.

unit.source: As Franca passed a corner of a quarry cave, she suddenly felt the bone figurine in her hand tremble slightly.
unit.target: Dum Franca angulum speluncae fodinarum transibat, subito sensit effigiam ossis in manu eius paulum trepidare.

unit.source: “There’s a reaction! There’s a reaction!” she exclaimed joyfully.
unit.target: «Est reactio! Est reactio!» exclamavit laete.

unit.source: Lumian immediately left the shadows, transforming back into human form, his blue eyes tinged with silver-black.
unit.target: Lumian statim umbras reliquit, iterum in formam humanam transformatus, oculis caeruleis argento-nigros tinctis.

unit.source: In the absolute darkness, he saw the mercury rivers of fate belonging to Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: In tenebris absolutis vidit flumina mercurii fati, quae Francae et Jennae erant.

unit.source: As his spirituality rapidly depleted from the brief observation, Lumian found a possibility among the tributaries symbolizing Franca’s future fate.
unit.target: Dum spiritualitas eius ex brevi observatione celeriter exhauebatur, Lumian inter affluentes, qui futurum fati Francae symbolizabant, opportunitatem invenit.

unit.source: This was something that might happen in ten seconds or more.
unit.target: Hoc erat aliquid quod in decem secundis aut ultra fieri posset.

unit.source: Furthermore, the probability of it occurring was extremely low—something Curse, or rather, Magnify, couldn’t influence.
unit.target: Praeterea, probabilitas evenendi eius valde exigua erat—aliquid quod Curse, aut potius Magnify, non poterat influere.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian extended his right palm toward Franca.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian dextram manum in Francam protulit.

unit.source: Franca, with her night vision, witnessed his actions and noticed his silver-black eyes.
unit.target: Franca, cum nocturna visione, eius acta conspexit et oculos eius argento-nigros animadvertit.

unit.source: She jumped in fright.
unit.target: Ex metu exsiluit.

unit.source: “W-what are you doing?”
unit.target: «Quid facis?»

unit.source: She didn’t dodge, fully trusting Lumian.
unit.target: Non evasit, pleno fidens in Lumiano.

unit.source: Lumian roused his spirituality, transforming it into a violent illusory river that surged out of his palm.
unit.target: Lumian spiritualitatem excitavit, eam in flumen violentum et fallacem transformans, quod ex palma eius profluebat.

unit.source: Franca’s fate was instantly thrust into a future by the mighty torrent.
unit.target: Fatum Francae statim in futurum per imponentem torrentem immissum est.

unit.source: Compelling Fate!
unit.target: Fatum Impellens!

unit.source: Franca suddenly had an idea.
unit.target: Franca repente ideam cepit.

unit.source: “Are you influencing my future, allowing me to successfully utilize the corrupted fate fragments here to make it a reality?”
unit.target: “An fatum meum influas, et me sinas fragmenta fati corrupta hic efficaciter uti ad eam re veram efficiendam?”

unit.source: “Dammit, I really do have an idea. Maybe I should give it a try!”
unit.target: “Heu, vere ideam habeo. Forsitan conari debeam!”

unit.source: Lumian, his spirituality greatly depleted, chuckled. “Life is short, why not give it a try?”
unit.target: Lumian, spiritualitate multum exhausa, subridens respondit, "Vita brevis est; cur id non conemur?"

unit.source: ƈοm
unit.target: ƈοm

unit.source: “…” Franca could clearly detect the mockery in his tone.
She gritted her teeth.
unit.target: Dentes contraxit.

unit.source: “I’ll deal with you later!”
unit.target: “Te postea curabo!”

unit.source: As she spoke, Franca placed the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine on a protruding rock in a corner of the mine.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Franca effigiam ossis Demonissae Primordialis in saxo protuso in angulo fodinae posuit.

unit.source: Then she took out a mirror and placed it in front of the figurine.
unit.target: Deinde speculum extraxit et ante effigiam collocavit.

unit.source: Lumian conjured a blazing white fireball and observed as Franca retrieved essential oils, extracts, perfume, and herbal powder from her Traveler’s Bag, preparing for the ritual.
unit.target: Lumian globum ignis albi fulgentis evocavit et observavit Francam, quae ex sacculo viatoris olea essentialia, extracta, unguentum, et pulverem herbarum extraxit ad ritum praeparandum.

unit.source: Uh… Lumian turned to Jenna, who happened to look back at him.
unit.target: Eh... Lumian ad Jennam se convertit, quae ad eum respiciebat.

unit.source: Franca simultaneously turned to face them.
unit.target: Franca simul ad eos se vertit.

unit.source: The three were taken aback for a moment before bursting into laughter.
unit.target: Tres paulisper obstupefacti sunt, deinde risu erumpere coeperunt.

unit.source: “You two thought of it too?” Franca said happily.
unit.target: «Et vos duo id cogitastis?» Franca laete dixit.

unit.source: “Jenna shouldn’t stay here. The Primordial Demoness might cast Her gaze here later.”
unit.target: «Jenna hic non manere debet. Demonissa Primordialis fortasse hunc locum postea intuetur.»

unit.source: As a pure female Demoness, it would definitely not bode well for Jenna to be noticed by the Primordial Demoness. It could even mean death.
unit.target: Ut pura Demonissa feminina, certe non deceret Jennam ab Demonissa Primordiali notari; etiam mortem significare posset.

unit.source: Lumian replied with a smile, “I’ll send Jenna back first and come back after the ritual.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: "Primum Jennam remittam et post ritum revertar."

unit.source: With that, he reached out and grabbed Jenna’s shoulder.
unit.target: Hoc facto, extendit manum et umerum Jennae arripuit.

unit.source: Jenna said to Franca, “Be careful.”
unit.target: Jenna Francae dixit: "Cave."

unit.source: “Don’t worry, I’m a skilled worker,” Franca replied, waving her hand cheerfully.
unit.target: «Noli timere, artifex peritus sum,» Franca respondit, manum laete movens.

unit.source: As a member of the Demoness Sect, she regularly prayed to the Primordial Demoness through the bone figurine, following the Demoness of Black’s instructions.
unit.target: Ut membrum Sectae Demonissae, regulariter orabat ad Demonissam Primordialis per effigiam ossis, praecepta Demonissae Nigrae sequens.

unit.source: Occasionally, she even held a solo Mass.
unit.target: Interdum etiam solam Missam celebrabat.

unit.source: Of course, this was the first time she would be praying to the Primordial Demoness through a ritual.
unit.target: Certe, hoc primum tempus erat quo per ritum ad Demonissam Primordialis oraretur.

unit.source: After Lumian teleported away with Jenna, the quarry cave returned to darkness.
unit.target: Postquam Lumian cum Jennā evanuit, spelunca fodinarum in tenebras rediit.

unit.source: With the bone figurine, Franca decided to use a dualistic ritual.
unit.target: Effigiam ossis habens, Franca decrevit rituum dualisticum uti.

unit.source: After lighting the candle representing herself, she drew her needs on a faux goatskin with the corresponding symbols and patterns, drawing upon her extensive mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Postquam candelam sibi repraesentantem accendit, in pelle caprina ficta requisita sua cum symbolis et figuris congruentibus depinxit, ex vasta scientia mystica confisi.

unit.source: Following that, she sanctified the ritual silver dagger and created a wall of spirituality.
unit.target: Deinde, cultrum argenteum rituale sanctificavit et murum spiritualitatis creavit.

unit.source: She dripped rose essential oil, musk, and perfume into the candle flame.
unit.target: Oleum essentiale rosarum, muscus, et unguentum in flammam candelae stillavit.

unit.source: Franca’s heart skipped a beat as the alluring, complex scent quickly entered her nostrils.
unit.target: Cor Francae paulisper titubavit, cum venustus et multiplex odor celeriter in naribus eius intravit.

unit.source: She couldn’t help but inhale deeply.
unit.target: Non potuit quin alte inspiraret.

unit.source: After completing all the preparations, Franca took two steps back and recited the Primordial Demoness’s honorific name in Hermes.
unit.target: Postquam omnia praeparationes confecta sunt, Franca duos gradus retro se recepit et nomen honorificum Demonissae Primordialis in Hermes recitavit.

unit.source: “The source of all catastrophes, the symbol of destruction and the apocalypse, the Demoness who controls Chaos.”
unit.target: «Fons omnium catastropharum, symbolum destructionis et apocalypsis, Demonissa quae Chaos regit.»

unit.source: In the altar, a small amount of moss suddenly grew, entangling into vines that rose high, as if staring at Franca.
unit.target: In altare, parva quantitas muschi subito crevit, implicata in vitis quae alte surrexerunt, quasi Francam intuentes.

unit.source: The ground softened, and a frigid wind blew, causing Franca to tremble.
unit.target: Solum mollivit, et ventus frigidus flat, faciens Francam trepidare.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Franca sensed the fragrance in the area grow sweeter, carrying a warm charm that made her blush.
unit.target: Simul, Franca sensit odorem in regione dulciorem fieri, ferentem calidam venustatem quae eam rubescere faciebat.

unit.source: This invigorated her specific desires, and charming scenes surfaced in her mind.
unit.target: Hoc excitavit specifica desideria eius, et in mente eius scaenae amoenae apparuerunt.

unit.source: Suppressing the heat in her body and shaking off her discomfort, Franca briefly recounted how Moran Avigny was a Mirror Person and how she wanted to capture him.
unit.target: Calorem in corpore suo reprimens atque molestias abigendam, Franca breviter recitavit quomodo Moran Avigny Persona Specularis esset et quomodo eum capere vellet.

unit.source: Then, following the ritual’s standard procedure, she said,
unit.target: Deinde, rituum consuetudinem sequens, dixit:

unit.source: “I pray for the power of the mirror."
unit.target: "Precō potentiam speculi."

unit.source: “I pray for the power of chaos."
unit.target: "Precō potentiam caosi."

unit.source: “I pray for God’s protection."
unit.target: "Precō pro tutela Dei."

unit.source: “I pray for a fixed entrance to the mirror world to appear here."
unit.target: "Precō ut hic introitus fixus ad mundum specularis appareat."

unit.source: “Roses, a herb that belongs to the Demoness, please pass your power to my incantation."
unit.target: "Rosae, herba quae Demonissae competit, quaeso, potentiam vestram incantationi meae tradite."

unit.source: “Musk, a herb that belongs to the Demoness, please pass your power to my incantation…”
unit.target: "Muscus, herba quae Demonissae competit, quaeso, potentiam vestram incantationi meae tradite…"

unit.source: After reciting the incantation, Franca ignited the faux goatskin and placed it on the mirror in front of the bone figurine.
unit.target: Incantationem recitata, Franca pellem caprinam fictam accendit et in speculo ante effigiam ossis posuit.

unit.source: As the faux goatskin burned away, Franca felt the candle flame dim, as if a layer of translucent mullioned glass had materialized around it.
unit.target: Dum pella caprina ficta ardebat, Franca sensit flammam candelae attenuari, quasi stratum vitreae translucidae circa eam apparuerit.

unit.source: A strange power was activated, gathering in the mirror.
unit.target: Vis insolita activata est, in speculo congregata.

unit.source: The human-head-sized mirror suddenly darkened, turning shadowy and illusory.
unit.target: Speculum, quod mensura capitis humani erat, subito obscuratum est, umbratile et fallace illusum.

unit.source: It melded with the protruding rock where the figurine was placed and vanished.
unit.target: Illud cum saxo protuso in quo effigies posita erat, confluit et evanuit.

unit.source: In the next moment, the candle flame returned to normal, and the fragrance lingering in the air still unsettled Franca.
unit.target: In proximo momento, flamma candelae ad statum normalem rediit, et odor in aere residens adhuc Francam perturbavit.

unit.source: Her thoughts raced, requiring immense strength to control herself.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius celeriter errabant, requirentes ingentem vim ad se coercendum.

unit.source: After tidying up the bone figurine and other items, Franca took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
unit.target: Postquam effigiam ossis et alias res ordinavit, Franca alium spiritum profundum traxit et lente exhalavit.

unit.source: Dammit, just the charm and pleasure emanating from the ritual nearly made me lose myself.
unit.target: Heu, sola venustas et voluptas ex ritu effluentes paene me perdere fecerunt.

unit.source: All I wanted was to approach the source of the charm and enjoy the pleasures bestowed by Her.
unit.target: Omne quod volui fuit accedere ad fontem venustatis et frui voluptatibus ab Ea donatis.

unit.source: As expected of the Primordial Demoness who controls pleasure and feminine charm…
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur a Demonissa Primordialis quae voluptatem et venustatem feminam regit…

unit.source: Dammit! I’m an idiot.
unit.target: Heu! Idiota sum.

unit.source: Why did I take a deep breath?
unit.target: Cur spiritum profundum sustuli?

unit.source: The smell here hasn’t dissipated!
unit.target: Odor hic nondum evanuit!

unit.source: I need to quickly confirm if there’s an entrance to the mirror world before heading back to Jenna…
unit.target: Celeriter comprobare debeo an introitus ad mundum specularis adsit, antequam ad Jennam redeam.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through Franca’s mind, she saw Lumian’s figure swiftly materialize at the edge of the quarry cave.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem Francae transibant, vidit figuram Lumiani celeriter in margine speluncae fodinarum apparere.

unit.source: Franca jumped in fright.
unit.target: Franca ex metu exsiluit.

unit.source: “Why are you back already?”
unit.target: «Cur iam rediisti?»

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “You’re in pretty good shape. Didn’t I say I’d return after your ritual…?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Recte valeas; nonne dixi me post ritum tuum redire?"

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian noticed Franca’s lake-blue eyes rippling under the dim candlelight, as if they could captivate one’s soul.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian animadvertit oculos Francae, caeruleos ut lacus, sub tenui lumine candelae undulantes, quasi animam alicui capere possent.

unit.source: Lumian’s words faltered.
unit.target: Verba Lumiani vacillaverunt.

unit.source: After a brief pause, he added, “Besides, Jenna was worried about you and asked me to come check on you.”
unit.target: Post brevem pausam, addidit: "Praeterea, Jenna de te sollicitabat et me rogavit ut te inspicerem."

unit.source: I believe the Primordial Demoness can understand that a Demoness of Pleasure has a friend who cares about her.
unit.target: Credo Demonissam Primordialis intellegere posse quod Demonissa Voluptatis amicum habeat qui de ea curare possit.

unit.source: “Yeah.” Franca nodded gently, bit her lip, and pointed at the protruding rock.
unit.target: «Ita.» Franca leniter annuit, labrum contraxit, et ad saxim protusum indicavit.

unit.source: “That spot seems to have become a fixed entrance to the mirror world. Let’s see if we can enter.”
unit.target: «Illud loco videtur introitus fixus ad mundum specularis factus esse. Videamus num intrare possimus.»

unit.source: Lumian didn’t inquire further.
unit.target: Lumian non amplius quaesivit.

unit.source: He approached the protruding rock and, together with Franca, extended his right palm, pressing it against the cold stone.
unit.target: Accedens ad saxim protusum, et una cum Franca, dextram manum protulit atque eam in lapidem frigidum prementem.

unit.source: A faint light flickered, and the two vanished on the spot.
unit.target: Lumen tenuis micans apparuit, et duo in loco evanuerunt.

unit.source: After a brief moment of vertigo, a dark, illusory path appeared before Lumian and Franca’s eyes.
unit.target: Post brevem momentum vertiginis, via obscura et illusoria ante oculos Lumiani et Francae apparuit.

unit.source: Surrounding them were numerous similar “tunnels,” intertwining to form a complicated and mysterious colossal spiderweb.
unit.target: Circum eos erant multa similia cunicula, quae inter se implicabantur, formantes reticulum araneum ingens, multiplex et arcana.

unit.source: 708 Remnant Influence
unit.target: 708 Influentia Reliquiarum
