unit.source: Is this an ordinary mirror world?
unit.target: An hic est mundus specularum vulgaris?

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the dark, illusory paths around him that resembled a mosquito landing on a complicated spiderweb.
unit.target: Lumian intuebatur vias obscuras et illusorias circa se, quae instar culicibus in telam araneam intricatam descendentibus videbantur.

unit.source: For some reason, he felt a surge of fear, as if a colossal, warped, pitch‐black spider could crawl out from the depths of this strange land at any moment and drag him and Franca into the darkness that symbolized destruction.
unit.target: Nam quadam ratione sensit impetum timoris, velut si aranea ingens, deformatum, et nigerrima ex profundis huius terrae insolitae quolibet momento emergere posset et eum cum Franca in obscuritatem quae exitium symbolizabat traheret.

unit.source: “Is every illusory path connected to a mirror?” Franca’s voice suddenly echoed in Lumian’s ears, so close he could hear her breathing.
unit.target: „Num omnis via illusoria ad speculum coniungitur?“ Vox Francae subito in auribus Lumiani resonavit, tam prope ut eius halitus audire posset.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Lumian caught a whiff of a warm, sweet fragrance.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian odorem calidum atque dulcem fragrantiæ percipuit.

unit.source: His blood vessels inexplicably pulsed, and his body and mind relaxed slightly.
unit.target: Vasa sanguinea eius inexplicabiliter pulsaverunt, et corpus atque mens ejus leviter relaxata erant.

unit.source: At some point, Franca had moved to his side, her eyes flickering as she surveyed their surroundings.
unit.target: Aliquando Franca ad latus eius accessit, oculis micantibus dum circumspiciebat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: “In theory, yes.”
unit.target: „In theoria, ita.“

unit.source: “No!” Franca rejected her speculation. “They might also be connected to some mysterious alternate space.”
unit.target: „Non!“ Franca coniecturam suam reiecit. „Forsitan etiam ad spatium alternativum mysteriosum coniungi possint.“

unit.source: “That’s right…” Lumian recalled his understanding of the mirror world.
unit.target: „Recte…“ Lumian recordatus est suam notionem de mundo specularum.

unit.source: He exhaled and took a step forward.
unit.target: Exhalavit et gradum in antecessum tulit.

unit.source: “I believe those situations should also be connected to mirrors, mirrors that belong to those mysterious alternate spaces.”
unit.target: „Credo has casus etiam ad specula coniungi debere, specula quae ad illa spatia alternativa mysteriosa pertinent.“

unit.source: Without waiting for Franca’s response, he pointed at the dark illusory path ahead and said,
unit.target: Sine responsum Francae exspectans, viam obscuram et illusoriam ante se indicavit et dixit:

unit.source: “Before understanding the mirror world’s coordinates and location, recklessly traversing this place is likely very dangerous.
unit.target: „Priusquam coordinatas et locum mundi specularum intellegamus, temere hunc locum transire videtur valde periculosum.

unit.source: If we’re lucky, we might only end up at the wrong mirror and have no choice but to return to the real world.
unit.target: Si fortuna favet, fortasse solum ad speculum erratum perveniemus et nullum aliud erit nisi revertamur ad verum mundum.

unit.source: If we’re unlucky, we’ll reach a mirror representing a dangerous place.
unit.target: Si misere evenit, speculum perveniemus quod locum periculosum repraesentat.

unit.source: When we leave, we’ll have to face terrifying enemies.
unit.target: Cum discedemus, hostes terribiles obviam ire oportebit.

unit.source: If we’re super unlucky…”
unit.target: Si valde misere evenit…

unit.source: At this point, Lumian paused.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Lumian subsistit.

unit.source: Franca squeezed to his side and asked in a soft voice, “What happens if we’re super unlucky?”
unit.target: Franca se ad latus eius apposuit et leni voce rogavit: „Quid eveniet, si valde misere evenit?“

unit.source: “W—we’ll vanish from this mirror world forever.
unit.target: „Nos ex hoc mundo specularum in aeternum evanescemus.

unit.source: We won’t be seen alive, and if we’re dead, our corpses will go missing.”
unit.target: Non videbimur vivos; et, si mortui fuerimus, cadavera nostra abscondentur.”

unit.source: Lumian composed himself and took another step forward.
unit.target: Lumian se composuit et alium gradum in antecessum tulit.

unit.source: All of a sudden, he sensed the dark, illusory path morph into a massive vortex, tugging him into its depths.
unit.target: Subito sensit viam obscuram et illusoriam in ingentem vortex transformari, qui eum in profundum suum trahibat.

unit.source: Franca experienced a comparable sensation, her spirituality sending her a powerful warning.
unit.target: Franca sensum simile passus est, et spiritualitas eius validam admonitionem ei misit.

unit.source: They both stepped back in unison, evading the absorption of the fearsome vortex.
unit.target: Ambo simul retraxerunt, vitantes absorptionem vorticis terribilis.

unit.source: “How treacherous,” Franca sighed.
unit.target: „Quam insidiosa,“ suspiravit Franca.

unit.source: “Just getting close to these illusory paths without going further can make you plummet into an unknown mirror.
unit.target: „Solum accedere ad has vias illusorias, sine ulteriore progressu, te in speculum ignotum deicere potest.

unit.source: Maybe we can only count on the luck of Winners in a situation like this.
unit.target: Forsitan tantum in fortunam victorum in tali casu inniti possimus.

unit.source: Let’s hope our destination isn’t too terrible.
unit.target: Speremus ne meta nostra nimis terribilis sit.

unit.source: Uh, your Magnify or Compelling Fate abilities should come in handy.”
unit.target: Heu, facultates tuae “Magnify” aut “Compelling Fate” utilia erunt.

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “I initially thought the mirror world was closely tied to the spirit world, and teleportation would work here too.
unit.target: „Primum putavi mundum specularum arcte connexum esse cum mundo spirituum, et teleportationem hic quoque fieri posse.

unit.source: But from what I can see, while there is a connection, it’s not strong enough to enable my teleportation.
unit.target: Sed ex eo quod video, quamquam nexus existit, non satis validus est ut teleportationem meam permittat.

unit.source: It’s not that I can’t teleport, but it’s way too risky.
unit.target: Non enim quia teleportare nequim, sed quia nimis periculosum est.

unit.source: There’s nearly a 100% chance of getting lost.
unit.target: Fere plene certum est ut erremus.

unit.source: “Without comprehending the abilities associated with the mirror world, I don’t suggest using this place to ambush Moran Avigny, unless we’re aided by a high-level Demoness or a high-level Apprentice.”
unit.target: „Nisi facultates quae cum mundo specularum conexae sunt intellexerim, non suadeo hunc locum ad insidias contra Moran Avigny uti, nisi auxilio Demonessae vel discipuli gradus altissimi simus.“

unit.source: Noticing Franca nod pensively, Lumian sighed in relief and intentionally taunted, “Have you recovered?”
unit.target: Notans Francam pensanter annuere, Lumian leviter suspiravit et provocavit: „Recuperata esne?“

unit.source: “Huh?”
unit.target: „Heu?“

unit.source: Franca was startled momentarily before her embarrassment morphed into anger.
unit.target: Franca paulisper stupefacta est, antequam eius pudor in iram versa est.

unit.source: “What other option do I have?”
unit.target: „Quam aliam optionem habeo?“

unit.source: “When I use a ritual to seek aid from the Primordial One, I’m inevitably impacted.
unit.target: „Cum ritum ad auxilium ab Primo peto, inevitabiliter afficior.

unit.source: Sometimes I’m lured, sometimes I’m in pain, and sometimes I’m dejected, as if I’ve temporarily developed a mental disorder.
unit.target: Aliquando allicior, aliquando dolore experior, et aliquando deprimor, quasi morbum mentis temporarium evolverim.

unit.source: Sometimes I go rigid for a while, as if I’ve been petrified…”
unit.target: Aliquando per aliquod tempus rigidior fio, quasi lapide fixus sim.

unit.source: Since officially joining the Demoness Sect, the Demoness of Black had shared extensive mysticism knowledge with Franca, particularly concerning prayers to the Primordial Demoness.
unit.target: Ex quo sectam Demonessarum officialiter adiit, Demonessa Nigra amplam scientiam mysticam cum Franca communicavit, praesertim de precibus ad Demonessam Primordiale.

unit.source: On such topics, the Demoness of Black explained:
unit.target: De his rebus, Demonessa Nigra exponit:

unit.source: As the ritual’s host, the ritual itself granted a degree of protection.
unit.target: Ut hospes rituum, ipse ritus gradum tutelae praebebat.

unit.source: The extent to which she was influenced by the Primordial One’s overflowing presence was quite minimal.
unit.target: Gradus quo a praefulgente praesentia Primordialis afficiebatur, satis minimus erat.

unit.source: Once the ritual concluded, she would recover after withstanding it for ten to twenty seconds.
unit.target: Postquam ritus consummatus est, illa, decem ad viginti secundis tolerantibus, se reconvalescere solebat.

unit.source: The only thing to watch out for was the desires arising from their typical reaction to being entranced by the Primordial One.
unit.target: Unum tantum observandum erat: desideria oriunda ex consueta reactione ad fascinationem a Primo.

unit.source: Their fading would be comparatively gradual, but what Demoness didn’t have numerous lovers?
unit.target: Eorum evanescere, comparativē lente, eveniebat, sed qua Demonessa non multos amatores haberet?

unit.source: There was no need to be overly concerned about this.
unit.target: Non erat opus de hac re nimis solliciti esse.

unit.source: The longer Franca talked, the more forceful she became, even a tad aggrieved.
unit.target: Quo diutius Franca loquebat, eo vehementior facta est, etiam parum indignata.

unit.source: “That’s a genuine deity. How can I possibly resist a genuine deity’s overflowing influence?
unit.target: „Ille est verus deus. Quomodo possum resistere effusae potentiae dei veri?“

unit.source: If I weren’t the ritual’s host, I would’ve been unable to restrain myself and would’ve unleashed my primal instincts.”
unit.target: „Si non essem hospes rituum, me continere non potuissem et instinctus primordiales meos effuderem.“

unit.source: Franca couldn’t suppress a chuckle at the reference to her primal nature.
unit.target: Franca non potuit risum reprimere ob mentionem naturae suae primordialis.

unit.source: Within the mirror world, she had consistently called the Primordial Demoness the Primordial One to prevent blasphemy.
unit.target: In mundo specularum, illa constanter Demonessam Primordiale „Primordialis Unus“ appellabat, ne blasphemia vitaretur.

unit.source: After pondering for a moment, Lumian replied, “Praying to a different genuine deity won’t lead to anything comparable unless someone present is blasphemous.”
unit.target: Postquam per momentum meditatus est, Lumian respondit: „Preces ad alium deum verum orare nihil simile pariet, nisi quis inter praesentissimos sit blasphemus.“

unit.source: “It’s the Primordial One’s fault for being in such a terrible state.” Franca had already come up with the justification.
unit.target: „Culpa est Primi Unius quod in tam terribili statu versatur.“ Franca iam hanc explicationem excogitaverat.

unit.source: “Don’t assume you can withstand it simply because you’re an Ascetic. If you had been there and not the ritual’s host, I would’ve witnessed your primal nature erupt.”
unit.target: „Noli putare te id tolerare posse solum quia asceticus es. Si ibi fuisses, et non hospes rituum, tuam naturam primariam erupturam viderem.“

unit.source: At this juncture, she appraised Lumian and grinned.
unit.target: Ad hoc, illa Lumian aestimavit et subridens arridebat.

unit.source: “It’s not like you didn’t react. Were you worried you couldn’t restrain yourself, so you purposely exposed me and created an awkward situation?”
unit.target: „Non est quod non reageres. Erasne sollicitus te non posse te continere, ita me proposito exponens et rem incommodam creavisti?“

unit.source: Subconsciously, Franca’s breathing turned labored again.
unit.target: Subconscie, respiratio Francae rursus difficile facta est.

unit.source: Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: Lumian irrise deridit.

unit.source: “When I got there, the scene’s lingering effects hadn’t fully dissipated, and a peculiar fragrance permeated the air.
unit.target: „Cum advenissem, effectus residui scaenae nondum pleno evanuerant, et odor peculiaris per aerem diffundebatur.

unit.source: That was a genuine deity. How could I withstand even the tiniest bit of a genuine deity’s overflowing influence?”
unit.target: Ille erat verus deus. Quomodo possem et parvam partem effusae potentiae dei veri ferre?

unit.source: He echoed Franca’s words.
unit.target: Verba Francae repetivit.

unit.source: “Really? Is it merely due to the lingering aroma?” Franca’s lake-blue eyes narrowed menacingly, as if challenged.
unit.target: „Revera? Num solum ob odor remanens est?“ Oculi Francae, caerulei ut lacus, minaciter angustati sunt, quasi provocati.

unit.source: The aqueous light in her eyes resurfaced, glittering like shards of sunlight.
unit.target: Lumen aquosum in oculis eius iterum refulsit, micans ut fragmenta solis.

unit.source: Lumian exhaled and stepped to the side, grasping Franca’s upper arm.
unit.target: Lumian exhalavit et ad latus accessit, bracchium superiorem Francae prehendens.

unit.source: “I’ll send you back first. Jenna is waiting for you.”
unit.target: „Te primum remittam. Jenna te exspectat.“

unit.source: “We’re heading back already?” Franca asked, surprised. “Won’t you explore the mirror world further and consider how to utilize this place?”
unit.target: „Iam redeimus?“ rogavit Franca mirata. „Num mundum specularum ulterius non explorabis et considerabis quomodo hoc locum uti possis?“

unit.source: “I have a plan.” Lumian tugged Franca away from the illusory tunnel’s spiderweb-like darkness.
unit.target: „Consilium habeo.“ Lumian Francam a tenebris tunelis illusoriae, quae similes erant telae araneae, abstulit.

unit.source: As they returned to the quarry cave, Franca, her focus diverted, inquired, “What plan?”
unit.target: Dum ad speluncam fodinarum redibant, Franca, mente distracta, rogavit: „Quid consilium?“

unit.source: While Lumian tried to activate the black mark on his right shoulder, he responded impassively, “Contract ability.”
unit.target: Dum Lumian conabatur signum nigrum in dextro humero suo activare, respondit impassibiliter: „Contract ability.”

unit.source: He intended to establish a contract with a Beyonder creature possessing a mirror world traversal ability to acquire the corresponding characteristics!
unit.target: Conceperat contractum instituere cum creatura Beyonder, quae facultatem iter faciendi in mundo specularum possidet, ut proprietates correspondentes acquereret!

unit.source: Regardless, he hadn’t determined which three abilities to contract this time. This could be one of them.
unit.target: Attamen non decreverat quas tres facultates hoc tempore contracturus esset; una ex his esse poterat.

unit.source: “You’re right, a contract ability…” Franca was thrilled.
unit.target: „Recte dicis, contract ability…“ Franca laeta erat.

unit.source: She then noticed Lumian was still motionless.
unit.target: Tum animadvertit Lumian adhuc immotus esse.

unit.source: Comprehending, she murmured into his ear, “Didn’t you want to teleport? Why haven’t we departed? Does your Spirit World Traversal activation always take this long, or are you enduring something?”
unit.target: Intelligens, in aure eius susurravit: „Num teleporter ire non volebas? Cur nondum discessimus? Num activatio Spirit World Traversal semper tam diu durat, aut aliquid sustines?“

unit.source: As Franca completed her sentence, the pair vanished from the gloomy quarry cave.
unit.target: Dum Franca sententiam complevit, duo ex spelunca fodinarum lugubri evanuerunt.

unit.source: That evening, in Lumian’s rented apartment, the nearly one‑meter‑long Fürth Firefish was set on the dining table.
unit.target: Illo vespere, in apartamento Lumiani conducto, piscis Ignifer Fürth, fere unius metrorum longus, in mensa prandii positus est.

unit.source: Ludwig used a child’s table knife to break through the charred and tough fish skin, cutting the fair fish meat into pieces.
unit.target: Ludwig culter mensae puerilis usus est ut corium piscis, quod ustulatum et durum erat, frangeret, et carnem eius in partes secaret.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Franca, who had donned a light-colored hunting suit, and noticed the Demoness of Pleasure’s gaze was elusive, brimming with embarrassment.
unit.target: Lumian aspiciebat Francam, quae vestem venatoriam leviter coloratam induta erat, et animadvertit aspectum Demonessae Voluptatis evasivum esse, pudore plenum.

unit.source: She appeared to be lamenting: Kill me! This is too mortifying. I don’t want to live anymore!
unit.target: Videtur lamentari: „Interfice me! Hoc nimis verecundum est. Non amplius vivere volo!“

unit.source: Lumian, who had been feeling slightly embarrassed himself, smiled.
unit.target: Lumian, qui ipse paulum erubuit, subridens arridebat.

unit.source: He mouthed to Franca,
unit.target: Labris verba ad Francam edidit,

unit.source: “Post‑nut clarity is truly remarkable.”
unit.target: „Claritās post ejaculatio vere praeclara est.“

unit.source: Despite Franca’s inability to lip‑read, she still sensed Lumian’s ridicule.
unit.target: Quamquam Francae labra legere non poterat, tamen Lumiani derisum sensit.

unit.source: Pleasure is detrimental! Pleasure is detrimental! Irrespective of gender, when thoughts of pleasure dominate one’s mind, one will invariably engage in various actions that result in their own ruin!
unit.target: Voluptas noxia est! Voluptas noxia est! Sine respectu generis, cum cogitationes voluptatis mentem dominent, certe quisque in variis actibus se ipsam ruinam afferre faciet!

unit.source: How humiliating!
unit.target: Quam humilium!

unit.source: I don’t want to live!
unit.target: Non vivere volo!

unit.source: In that instant, Franca longed for a crevice in the ground to conceal herself.
unit.target: In illo momento, Franca desideravit foveam in terra, qua se celaret.

unit.source: Anthony, sitting silently at the dining table, glanced at Lumian, then at Franca, before looking away.
unit.target: Antonius, silentim ad mensam prandii sedens, Lumian intuens, deinde Francam considerans, postea oculos avertit.

unit.source: At last, Ludwig removed the inedible parts and sliced the fish fillets into three soup pots.
unit.target: Denique, Ludwig partes inedibiles abstulit et fileta piscis in tres ollas secavit.

unit.source: Franca sealed one of the pots with ice and stored it in her Traveler’s Bag for later use.
unit.target: Franca unam ex ollis glacie obsignavit et in sacculo viatoris suo ad usum futurum reponit.

unit.source: Ludwig slid the other one to Lugano and spoke in a childish tone, “Can we have fish fillet and clam cream broth tonight?”
unit.target: Ludwig alterum in Lugano transtulit et voce puerili dixit: „Possumusne hac nocte ius filetae piscis cum cremore conchyliorum habere?“

unit.source: “Sure,” Lugano promptly agreed.
unit.target: „Certe,“ Lugano celeriter consentivit.

unit.source: He made an effort to avert his gaze from Franca and Jenna, the two Demonesses, believing it was disrespectful to his boss.
unit.target: Conatus est oculos avertire ab Franca et Jenna, duabus Demonessis, putans hoc esse inhonestum erga dominum suum.

unit.source: From his viewpoint, these two Demonesses were probably the boss’s lovers.
unit.target: Ex eius prospectu, hae duae Demonesses probabiliter amatrices domini erant.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but marvel inwardly.
unit.target: Non potuit non intus mirari.

unit.source: As expected of the boss. He really has Demonesses as his lovers, and there are two of them!
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur a domino. Vere Demonesses ut amatrices habet, et duae sunt!

unit.source: Back then, Emperor Roselle only had one.
unit.target: Tunc, Imperator Roselle tantum unam habebat.

unit.source: After adding a generous amount of lemon juice to the pot of fish fillets, Ludwig slid them toward Lumian.
unit.target: Postquam succum citri copiosum in ollam filetarum piscis adiecit, Ludwig ea ad Lumian transtulit.

unit.source: His intention was evident. He required the blood of a Mid‑Sequence Beyonder of the Hunter pathway.
unit.target: Propositum eius patens erat: sanguinem Beyonder de via "Mid‑Sequence" Venatoris requirebat.

unit.source: “How much do you need?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: „Quantum tibi opus est?“ Lumian quaesivit.

unit.source: “Enough to stir it up,” Ludwig replied, acting as if this was the bare minimum.
unit.target: „Satis ad miscendum,“ Ludwig respondit, se gerens quasi hoc minimum esset.

unit.source: Jenna frowned and asked, “How much does each person need to eat to gain that permanent effect?”
unit.target: Jenna frontem contraxit et rogavit: „Quantum cuique edendum est, ut effectum illud permanentem adipiscatur?“

unit.source: Ludwig answered innocently, “Different physiques and Sequences need different quantities. You’ll only find out when you actually eat it.”
unit.target: Ludwig innocentissime respondit: „Diversae corporum formae et ordines varias quantitates postulant. Id solum cognosces cum id vere comedis.“

unit.source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and poured the rest of Gardner Martin’s blood into the soup pot.
unit.target: Lumian supercilia attollens reliquum sanguinem Gardner Martin in ollam effudit.

unit.source: Noticing it was still insufficient, he used a ritual silver dagger to slice his hand and dripped 20 to 30 milliliters of blood into it.
unit.target: Animadvertens id adhuc insufficere, utens rituali argenteo pugio ad manum suam incidendam, viginti ad triginta millilitras sanguinis in ollam stillavit.

unit.source: Ludwig observed with anticipation.
unit.target: Ludwig cum anticipatione observavit.

unit.source: “Aren’t you concerned about corruption?” Lumian asked with a smirk.
unit.target: „Nonne de corruptione sollicitus es?“ Lumian subridens quaesivit.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head. “The quantity here isn’t substantial.”
unit.target: Ludwig caput movit: „Quantitas hic non est substantialis.“

unit.source: Franca tried her best to act normally and remarked with amusement, “Discussing toxicity without considering dosage is just playing the rogue.”
unit.target: Franca conata est agere morem ordinarium et, cum ioco, dixit: „De toxicitate sine consideratione dosarum disserere tantum quasi latronem agere est.“

unit.source: “Indeed.” Ludwig concurred with Franca and stirred the fish slices in the soup with a spoon.
unit.target: „Immo vero.“ Ludwig cum Franca consentivit et segmenta piscis in ius cochleario miscuit.

unit.source: Gradually, the tender‑white fish soaked up the seemingly searing blood, and the fish slowly started to brown.
unit.target: Gradatim, piscis tener et albus sanguinem, quod quasi ardens videbatur, absorbet, et piscis paulatim brunneus fieri incipit.

unit.source: “Add some ice,” Ludwig instructed Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: „Adde aliquid glaciei,“ Ludwig Francae et Jennae imperavit.

unit.source: The two Demonesses rose in unison and extended their hands toward the soup pot.
unit.target: Duae Demonessae simul surrexerunt et manus suas ad ollam ius protraxerunt.

unit.source: Drops of white frost condensed and descended like rain, noticeably slowing the browning of the fish until it ceased.
unit.target: Guttae nivis albae condensatae sunt et, ut pluvia descendentium, fuscationem piscium retardaverunt, donec cessaverunt.

unit.source: Ludwig leaped off his chair and dashed into the kitchen, returning with a few silver plates. He distributed seven to eight Ice Lemon Fish fillets to each of them.
unit.target: Ludwig de sella sua exilavit et in culinam celeriter cucurrit, rediens cum paucis lamellis argenteis. Singulis distribuit septem ad octo fileta “Ice Lemon Fish.”

unit.source: “Is that all?” Jenna asked with a surprised smile.
unit.target: „Estne id totum?“ Jenna risu mirato rogavit.

unit.source: “If it’s not enough, you can have two or three more,” Ludwig replied earnestly.
unit.target: „Si non sufficit, potestis habere duas vel tres plures,“ Ludwig sincere respondit.

unit.source: Jenna instinctively wanted to say something, but she refrained when she saw Ludwig’s childlike demeanor.
unit.target: Jenna instinctive aliquid dicere voluit, sed detinuit, cum Ludwig puerilem habitum videret.

unit.source: She pointed at their plates and said, “Did you request so much of Lumian’s blood just to eat such a small portion of the fish?
unit.target: Illis patinis indicavit et dixit: „Num tantum sanguinem Lumiani petivisti, ut tam parvam partem piscis ederes?

unit.source: “Why not prepare less and save the remaining half of the pot for tomorrow?”
unit.target: „Cur non parum praeparas et reliquam dimidiam partem ollae cras servas?“

unit.source: Ludwig hugged the soup pot in front of him and shouted, “Mine!”
unit.target: Ludwig ollam prandi coram se amplectens clamavit: „Mea est!“

unit.source: “…” Jenna suddenly felt like a witch stealing candy from a child.
unit.target: “…“ Jenna statim se sensit ut maga, quae dulcia a puero rapit.

unit.source: He’s definitely abusing his power… Lumian glanced at Ludwig and shook his head in amusement.
unit.target: Certe potestatem suam abutitur… Lumian ad Ludwig aspiciens subridens caput concussit.

unit.source: “At least you have some sense when it comes to food.”
unit.target: „Saltem aliquam rationem in cibis habes.“

unit.source: With that, Lumian polished off all the Ice Lemon Fish fillets on his plate.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Lumian omnia fileta “Ice Lemon Fish” in sua patina consumpsit.

unit.source: 709 “Chef”
unit.target: 709 “Coquus”

unit.source: The sour lemon flavor, tender fish texture, scorching aroma, and subtle sweetness with hints of fish and oil burst forth in Lumian’s mouth.
unit.target: Saporem citri acidi, texturam piscium teneram, aromam flagrantem, et dulcedinem subtilim cum vestigiis piscium et olei in ore Lumiani erupit.

unit.source: The taste exceeded his expectations.
unit.target: Sapor exspectationes eius superavit.

unit.source: He had anticipated dishes like this would be unpalatable and jarring, similar to a potion, but he never thought they would be considered delicious.
unit.target: Praevidit se huiusmodi fercula fore insipida et discordantia, instar potionis; sed numquam existimavit ea delectabilia esse.

unit.source: When given a choice, Ludwig has a genuine preference for delicacies and doesn’t fool himself… Lumian chewed and swallowed the seven or eight fish slices.
unit.target: Cum optione data, Ludovicus veram praeferentiam ad delicatias habet et se ipsum non fallit… Lumian septem vel octo piscium segmenta masticavit et devoravit.

unit.source: A mild burning sensation spread from his throat to his stomach, reminiscent of drinking a glass of liquor.
unit.target: Sensatio lenis ardoris a gutture ad ventrem diffusa est, reminiscens bibendi poculi liquoris.

unit.source: The sensation quickly faded, and nothing unusual happened.
unit.target: Sensatio celeriter evanuit, nec quidquam insolitum accidit.

unit.source: “That’s it? It worked?” Lumian glanced at Ludwig.
unit.target: “Hocne est? Operatum est?” Lumian Ludovicum intuebat.

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludovicus caput concussit.

unit.source: “Give it another two to three minutes for your stomach to absorb it.”
unit.target: Da illud alio duobus ad tribus minutis, ut venter id absorbeat.

unit.source: “So fast?” Franca asked, surprised.
unit.target: «Tam celeriter?» Franca, mirata, quaesivit.

unit.source: She respected mysticism, but having taken potions before, she knew they worked instantaneously.
unit.target: Ea mysticismum observabat, sed, cum ante potionibus usus esset, scivit illae statim operari.

unit.source: Ludwig’s delicacies, however, seemed to require digestion and absorption by the stomach, contradicting how the organ typically functioned.
unit.target: Delicatiae Ludovici, tamen, videbantur digestionem et absorptionem a ventre postulare, contrariam morem functionis organi exhibentes.

unit.source: Plus, the stomach didn’t absorb everything!
unit.target: Praeterea, venter non omnia absorpsit!

unit.source: Ludwig responded seriously, “A Chef’s creations can be rapidly absorbed by the stomach.”
unit.target: Ludovicus serio respondit, “Opera coqui celeriter a ventre absorberi possunt.”

unit.source: Chef… Lumian nodded, deep in thought.
unit.target: Coquus… Lumian annuit, profundo cogitatione immersus.

unit.source: He remembered Ludwig frequently commenting on various things like a food connoisseur.
unit.target: Meminit Ludovicum saepe de variis rebus, quasi peritus culinarius, commentatum esse.

unit.source: Without further explanation, Ludwig buried his face in the soup pot before him and polished off the remaining Ice Lemon Fish fillets.
unit.target: Sine ulteriore explicatione, Ludovicus faciem suam in olla ius ante se coniciebat et reliquos filletos Piscis Limonis Glacialis consumpsit.

unit.source: Jenna and the others promptly finished the fish slices on their own plates.
unit.target: Jenna et ceteri statim piscium segmenta in suis patinis consumpsērunt.

unit.source: Two minutes later, Lumian felt his body growing warm, with a tingling sensation in his skin and flesh.
unit.target: Duo minuta post, Lumian sensit corpus suum calefactum fieri, cum subtili formicatione in cute et carne.

unit.source: The effect on him was minimal.
unit.target: Effectus in eo minimus fuit.

unit.source: It paled in comparison to drinking a potion, let alone the pain of burning himself with flames.
unit.target: Illud, comparatum ad potionem bibendi, paulum videbatur, nedum ad dolorem se in flammis urentis.

unit.source: Soon, Lumian returned to normal, his expression unaltered.
unit.target: Mox Lumian ad statum suum normalem rediit, vultus eius immutatus.

unit.source: He glanced playfully at Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, waiting to see how the Ice Lemon Fish fillet would affect them.
unit.target: Lumian iocose Francam, Jenna, et Anthonym intuebat, exspectans videre quo modo filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis eos afficeret.

unit.source: A minute later, Jenna and the others suddenly flushed, as if they had eaten incredibly spicy food from the Feynapotter Kingdom highlands.
unit.target: Una minuta post, Jenna et ceteri subito rubore suffusi sunt, quasi cibum vehementer piperatum ex altis regni Feynapotter edisissent.

unit.source: “Hiss…” Lugano let out a pained gasp, feeling a searing sensation in his breath.
unit.target: «Sss…» Lugano gemitus dolens edidit, sentiens in spiramine suo sensum flagrantem.

unit.source: Originating from within his body, he couldn’t have treated it even if he wanted to.
unit.target: Ex intimo corporis sui oriens, id non curare potuisset, etiamsi voluisset.

unit.source: Frost enveloped Franca’s body, seemingly trying to soothe the pain in her skin and flesh.
unit.target: Glacies corpus Francae circumplexit, quasi dolorem in cute et carne lenire conaretur.

unit.source: It was futile.
unit.target: Frustra erat.

unit.source: Jenna and Anthony grimaced but made no unnecessary movements.
unit.target: Jenna et Anthony contritos vultus habuerunt, sed nullos motus superfluos fecerunt.

unit.source: They bore the discomfort, waiting for the Ice Lemon Fish fillet to finish transforming their bodies.
unit.target: Dolorem subierunt, exspectantes ut filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis corpora eorum transformare perficeret.

unit.source: This lasted for ten to twenty seconds before the quartet’s expressions relaxed.
unit.target: Hoc per decem ad viginti secunda duravit, antequam vultus quattuor hominum relaxati sunt.

unit.source: “How does it feel?” Lumian asked with a smile.
unit.target: «Quomodo hoc sentit?» Lumian subrisus rogavit.

unit.source: Franca instinctively recalled the sensation and said, “It was like every inch of my skin and flesh had been burned. Hmm, not quite that intense—relatively mild…”
unit.target: Franca instincte sensum revocavit et dixit, “Ut si omnis pars cutis et carnis meae ustata esset. Hem, non tam intensa—proportionate lenis…”

unit.source: While speaking, she took a matchbox from her Traveler’s Bag and experimentally lit two matches.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, ex sacculo viatoris sui cistam parvam lignorum accendentium extraxit et duos ex iis experimentali modo accendit.

unit.source: She held them to the back of her left hand for a bit.
unit.target: Illos paululum ad dorsum manus sinistrae suae retinuit.

unit.source: Franca’s expression gradually contorted.
unit.target: Vultus Francae paulatim contortus est.

unit.source: She endured the pain in her left hand momentarily before pulling it back and shaking it.
unit.target: Dolorem in manu sinistra per momentum toleravit, deinde eam retrahens et concussit.

unit.source: The matchbox fell to the ground.
unit.target: Cista parva in terram cecidit.

unit.source: “It still hurts!” Franca reported the experiment results to Lumian and Jenna through gritted teeth.
unit.target: «Adhuc dolet!» Franca inter dentes contritos Lumiano et Jennae nuntiavit.

unit.source: Ludwig hastily replied, “It doesn’t reduce pain.”
unit.target: Ludovicus festinanter respondit, “Dolorem non minuit.”

unit.source: “How’s the wound?” Jenna asked, concerned.
unit.target: «Quid de vulnere?», Jenna sollicite rogavit.

unit.source: Franca immediately checked the back of her left hand, seeing only slight burn marks on her pale skin with minimal physical damage.
unit.target: Franca statim dorsum manus sinistrae suae inspexit, et tantum leves vestigia ustionis in cute pallida cum minimo damno corporeo vidit.

unit.source: “It works, even though the flame temperature wasn’t that high, to begin with…” Franca’s expression eased.
unit.target: «Operatur, etiamsi initio temperatura flammae non alta fuit…» Vultus Francae remissus est.

unit.source: Across the dining table, Anthony carefully considered his words before saying, “I think I’m a bit more irritable than usual, but within reasonable limits.”
unit.target: Trans mensam coenam, Anthony verba sua caute consideravit, deinde dedit, “Puto me aliquantulum magis irritabilem esse quam consueta, sed intra fines rationabiles.”

unit.source: Jenna added, “I’m grumpy too, but not drastically.”
unit.target: Jenna addidit, “Ego quoque iratus sum, sed non nimis.”

unit.source: Franca and Lugano confirmed experiencing the same thing.
unit.target: Franca et Lugano idem experiri confirmaverunt.

unit.source: Swallowing the Ice Lemon Fish fillet, Ludwig explained, “That’s to be expected. Effectiveness comes with corruption.”
unit.target: Ludovicus filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis deglutiente explicavit, “Hoc exspectandum est. Efficacia venit cum corruptione.”

unit.source: Jenna and Franca turned to Lumian.
unit.target: Jenna et Franca ad Lumian converterunt.

unit.source: Lumian spread his hands, smiling. “I don’t feel any different.”
unit.target: Lumian manus sparsit, subrisus, et ait, “Non sentio me mutatum esse.”

unit.source: For him, the Ice Lemon Fish fillet’s corruption was negligible.
unit.target: Ei corruptio filleti Piscis Limonis Glacialis parva erat.

unit.source: Franca wasn’t sure whether to feel envious or sympathetic.
unit.target: Franca nesciebat utrum invidere an misericorditer agere deberet.

unit.source: This is like a milder version of being a Contractee—tolerating certain negative effects in exchange for corresponding Beyonder traits.
unit.target: Hoc est quasi versio miti contracti, in qua certos effectus negativos tolerantur in commutatione pro propriis indolis Beyonder.

unit.source: Sure, the effects are noticeably weaker, but the upside is it’s passive.
unit.target: Certe, effectus notabilius infimi sunt, sed commodum est quod passivi sint.

unit.source: Plus, the negative effects are minimal.
unit.target: Praeterea, effectus negativi minimi sunt.

unit.source: Going forward, when you get similar ingredients, you need to clarify the permanent and negative effects.
unit.target: In futurum, cum similia ingredientia accipias, necesse est effectūs permanentes et negativos explicare.

unit.source: You can’t just eat everything.
unit.target: Non omnia edere licet.

unit.source: Choices have to be made.
unit.target: Optiones faciendae sunt.

unit.source: Otherwise, things can easily go wrong.
unit.target: Alioquin res facile male evenire possunt.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Ludwig and said, “That depends on the individual.”
unit.target: Lumian Ludovicum intuebat et dixit, “Id pendet ab individuo.”

unit.source: Maybe a Chef, or the Gourmet pathway, had Sequences that mitigated the corresponding impact, akin to Alms Monks and Ascetics who were Contractees.
unit.target: Fortasse coquus, aut iter Gourmet, habebat sequentias quae impactionem correspondentem levabant, similes ad monachos eleemosinarios et ascetas contractos.

unit.source: Franca grasped Lumian’s implication and continued excitedly,
unit.target: Franca implicationem Lumiani cepit et excitata continuavit,

unit.source: “Dishes and concoctions without permanent effects are like various Apothecary pathway agents.
unit.target: Fercula et concoctiones sine effectibus permanentibus sunt similes variis agentibus viae apothecariae.

unit.source: “I’ve always envied Contractees.
unit.target: Semper contractos invidi sum.

unit.source: I wanted the freedom to mix and match abilities, creating a unique character build.
unit.target: Volebam libertatem facultates miscendi et componendi, ut personam unicam constituam.

unit.source: Now, without accepting an evil god’s boon, I finally have a chance, albeit a diluted one.”
unit.target: Nunc, sine accepto beneficio dei mali, tandem occasionem habeo, quamquam dilutam.

unit.source: Jenna’s heart raced, and the two Demonesses gazed at Ludwig, eyes shining.
unit.target: Cor Iennae trepitabat, et duae daemonissae Ludovicum spectabant, oculi illarum fulgentibus.

unit.source: To them, he was no longer the gluttonous monster child Lumian had described, but a Beyonder chef deserving of their care and attention.
unit.target: A eis, non iam fuit ille insatiabilis monstrum puer, quem Lumian descripserat, sed coquus Beyonder, qui eorum curae et attentioni dignus erat.

unit.source: Ludwig concentrated on eating the leftover Ice Lemon Fish fillet, not reacting further.
unit.target: Ludovicus reliquum filletum Piscis Limonis Glacialis edendo se concentravit, nec ulterius reaguit.

unit.source: In a quarry cave in Underground Trier.
unit.target: In spelunca lapicida in subterraneo Trevirensi.

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony stood beyond the spirituality wall, observing Lumian conduct the ritual to acquire new contract abilities.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony ultra parietem spiritualem steterunt, observantes Lumianem ritualem agere ad novas facultates contractuum adipiscendas.

unit.source: Having thoroughly reviewed Madam Magician’s information on spirit world entities and possessing the strange creature knowledge granted by the boon, Lumian swiftly identified two potential contract targets with mirror travel abilities.
unit.target: Postquam diligenter informationes de entibus mundi spirituum a Domina Magica recensuerat et scientiam de creaturis miris donata habebat, Lumian celeriter duas metas contractuum potentiales, cum facultate speculi itinerandi, designavit.

unit.source: The first was a spirit world being called Bloody Jack.
unit.target: Primum erat ens mundi spirituum, Bloody Jack appellatum.

unit.source: According to the information, in the Loen Kingdom’s south, some mysticism enthusiasts and folklore academics were playing a divination game when they spotted a blurry figure in the mirror wielding a large axe, drenched in blood.
unit.target: Ex informationibus, in parte australi regni Loen, quidam mysticismi studiosi et eruditi fabularum ludum divinationis agebant, cum figuram in speculo obfuscatam conspexerunt, magnam securim gerentem et sanguine madentem.

unit.source: This figure would emerge from the mirror, assaulting and slaughtering everyone present.
unit.target: Haec figura e speculo emergere solebat, omnes ibi presentes oppugnans et trucidans.

unit.source: The second was the Daratra Diamond Maggots, mentioned in the Contractee’s mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Secundum erant Daratra Diamond Maggots, in scientia mystica contractuum commemorati.

unit.source: They could grant Mirror Traversal in exchange for sacrificing a crystallized meteorite.
unit.target: Possent concedere transitum per speculum, in commutatione pro sacrificio meteoriti crystallizati.

unit.source: The drawback was that one’s body would become denser and shorter.
unit.target: Incommodum erat, quod corpus alicuius densius et brevius fieret.

unit.source: Lumian undeniably wanted to summon Bloody Jack but wasn’t certain if it possessed an ability akin to Mirror Traversal.
unit.target: Indubitate Lumian Bloody Jack evocare volebat, sed non certus erat an facultatem similem speculi transitus haberet.

unit.source: Gazing at the three lit candles, Lumian stepped back twice and chanted in ancient Hermes, “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era;
unit.target: Tria candela accensa contemplans, Lumian bis retrocedit et in antiqua lingua Hermetica incantavit, “Stultus, qui huic ævo non competit;

unit.source: “You are the ruler above the gray fog;
unit.target: “Tu es princeps super nebula cinerea;

unit.source: “You are the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.
unit.target: “Tu es rex flavi et atri, qui bonam fortunam gerit.”

unit.source: “I beseech your shelter.
unit.target: “Obsecro, da mihi asylum tuum.”

unit.source: “I pray for your attention.
unit.target: “Obsecro, intende mihi.”
“Ego!”

unit.source: “In the name of the great Fool, I summon:
unit.target: “In nomine magni Stulti, evocō:

unit.source: “The peculiar creature that wanders about the unfounded, the slaughterer hidden in the mirror, Jack from the bloody world…”
unit.target: “Singularis creatura, quae sine fundamento vagatur, trucidator in speculo latens, Jack e mundo sanguineo…”

unit.source: The bluish-black candle flame instantly swelled, forming an illusory door adorned with enigmatic patterns amidst the pervasive, eerie gray mist.
unit.target: Flamma candelae caeruleo-nigra statim crevit, formans ianuam illusoriam figuris aenigmaticis ornatam inter nebulam cineream pervastem.

unit.source: The door gradually opened, and darkness poured out, engulfing the mirror Lumian had placed on the altar.
unit.target: Iana paulatim aperuit, et obscuritas effusa est, absorpta speculum, quod Lumian in altare posuerat.

unit.source: The mirror abruptly levitated, pointing directly at Lumian.
unit.target: Speculum subito levavit, directe in Lumian intendens.

unit.source: Within, an indistinct figure in a blood-stained old jacket dragged a massive axe.
unit.target: Intus apparuit figura indistincta, in veteri veste sanguine tincta, magnam securim trahens.

unit.source: Opening his mouth, Lumian made his throat and chest resonate as he spoke the Mystical Language of Fate.
unit.target: Os aperiens, Lumian fauces et pectus resonare fecit, dum linguam mysticam fati loquebatur.

unit.source: Silver-black words akin to symbols materialized in midair, descending onto the faux goatskin at the altar’s edge, forming a concise and ominous contract.
unit.target: Verba argentum-nigra, similia symbolis, in medio aëris apparuerunt, descendentes in fictam cutem caprae ad altaris limen, et contractum succinctum et ominosum formabant.

unit.source: Upon the contract’s formation, Lumian connected with Bloody Jack, comprehending its abilities and traits. He “listened” to its demands.
unit.target: Contractus formatus, Lumian cum Bloody Jack coniunxit, eius facultates et notas cognoscens; postulata eius auscultavit.

unit.source: Bloody Jack possessed three mirror-related abilities and traits, which Lumian named Mirror Mark, Mirror Concealment, and Mirror Traversal.
unit.target: Bloody Jack tres facultates ac indoles speculo pertinentes habebat, quas Lumian nominavit: Speculi Notam, Speculi Occultationem, et Speculi Transitum.

unit.source: Mirror Marks could invisibly mark a mirror, inverted from reality, to pinpoint a target.
unit.target: Notae Speculi speculum invisibiliter signare poterant, in modum realitatis inversae, ad scopos designandos.

unit.source: Mirror Concealment allowed the user to hide within the dark tunnels, avoiding being pulled into another mirror.
unit.target: Occultatio Speculi utebatur ut usor intra tenebros tunellos se celaret, ne in alium speculum traheretur.

unit.source: Mirror Traversal enabled swift passage through the illusory tunnels.
unit.target: Transitus Speculi celerem pergressum per tunellos illusorios permittebat.

unit.source: Bloody Jack’s demand was the sacrifice of 99 living humans.
unit.target: Exigentia Bloody Jack erat sacrificium nonaginta novem hominum viventium.

unit.source: Lumian pondered briefly, concluding that Mirror Mark was the optimal choice.
unit.target: Lumian brevi cogitavit, concludens Notam Speculi optima electionem esse.

unit.source: Locating targets was paramount, and Mirror Traversal could be substituted with Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Invenire scopos maximum momenti habebat, et Transitus Speculi substitui posset per Transitum Mundi Spirituum.

unit.source: Rapid travel wasn’t essential when he could arrive directly.
unit.target: Iter celer non necessarium erat, cum directe pervenire posset.

unit.source: His eyes suddenly glinted silvery-black, mirroring Bloody Jack’s river of fate.
unit.target: Oculi eius subito micaverunt, argentum-nigri, imitantes flumen fati Bloody Jack.

unit.source: He wasn’t seeking information about Bloody Jack. Instead, under the ritual’s protection, he aimed to verify something.
unit.target: Non quaerebat informationes de Bloody Jack; sed potius, sub protectione ritualis, aliquid probare intendebat.

unit.source: After a quick observation, Lumian switched to ancient Hermes and asked Bloody Jack, “Can I alter the request?”
unit.target: Post observationem celerem, Lumian ad antiquam linguam Hermetica convertit et a Bloody Jack rogavit, “Possumne postulatum mutare?”

unit.source: He was unsure if Bloody Jack would comprehend or respond, but asking was harmless. If not, he would have to write to Madam Magician, inquiring about other suitable mirror entities.
unit.target: Nesciebat an Bloody Jack intellexisset aut responderet, sed rogare innocuum erat. Alioquin ad Dominam Magicam scribere debebit, de aliis entibus speculi idoneis interrogans.

unit.source: Having asked, Lumian immediately employed Magnified Fate, gaining a sharper view of Bloody Jack’s fate for the next ten seconds.
unit.target: Postquam rogavit, Lumian statim Fatum Magnificat adhibuit, et prospectum acutiorem fati Bloody Jack per decem secunda adeptus est.

unit.source: Feigning nervousness, he moved his right hand as if to touch his face.
unit.target: Nervositatem simulans, dextram manum movebat, quasi vultum eius contingere vellet.

unit.source: He Magnified a fate tributary!
unit.target: Fatum tributarium amplificavit!

unit.source: Two to three seconds later, Bloody Jack’s thoughts reached Lumian through the connection forged by the Mystical Language of Fate.
unit.target: Duo ad tria secunda post, cogitationes Bloody Jack per nexum, a lingua mystica fati conditum, Lumiano pervenerunt.

unit.source: “Pull me out of the mirror!”
unit.target: “Extrude me ex speculo!”

unit.source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and stepped forward twice, extending his right hand toward the mirror hovering above the altar.
unit.target: Lumian supercilia attollens bis processit, extendens dextram manum versus speculum, quod super altare volitabat.

unit.source: The moment his finger touched the glass mirror, he felt it dissolve into nothingness.
unit.target: Momento quo digitus eius speculum vitreum tetigit, sensit id in nihilum dissolvi.

unit.source: As Lumian fully inserted his palm into the mirror, a cold, damp, and distinctly sticky hand abruptly grasped his wrist.
unit.target: Dum Lumian palmam totam in speculum inserit, manus frigida, humida et clare viscida repente eius carpus apprehendit.

unit.source: 710 “Communication”
unit.target: 710 “Communicatio”

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised when his wrist was grabbed by the wet hand.
unit.target: Lumian non mirabatur, cum manus umida carpus eius rapiebatur.

unit.source: He even chuckled.
unit.target: Etiam subridit.

unit.source: “Not bad. You only stained my wrist, not corrupt my entire arm.”
unit.target: “Non male. Solum carpus meum maculasti, non totum brachium meum corrumpis.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he pulled back with all his might, feeling the abnormally heavy force opposing him.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, vi tota se retraxit, sentiens vim insolite gravem ei adversantem.

unit.source: Lumian’s muscles swelled, and his body appeared to grow slightly larger.
unit.target: Musculi Luminiani tumefierunt, et corpus eius paulum majus videbatur.

unit.source: At last, he saw the bloody figure in the jacket being dragged out of the empty mirror.
unit.target: Denique vidit sanguinolentam figuram in veste ex speculo vacuo trahebam.

unit.source: A bluish-black mist materialized, permeating the faux goatskin containing the ominous contract.
unit.target: Nebula caeruleo-nigra apparuit, diffundens in ficta cute caprina contractum ominosum inclusum.

unit.source: The contract burst into flames on its own, morphing into silver-black symbols and words.
unit.target: Contractum per se in flammas exarsit, transformans se in symbola et verba argentea nigra.

unit.source: They linked together from end to end, creating an intricate and illusory pattern that abruptly passed through his clothes and settled between Lumian’s chest and abdomen.
unit.target: Haec inter se connexa sunt ab extremo ad extremum, creantes consilium intricatum et illusorium quod subito per vestimenta eius transiit et inter pectus et venter Luminiani consedit.

unit.source: Having pulled Bloody Jack out of the mirror, Lumian had fulfilled the other party’s request, and the contract was automatically fulfilled!
unit.target: Bloody Jack ex speculo extracto, Lumian petitionem alterius partis explevit, et contractum per se adimpletum est!

unit.source: At that instant, Bloody Jack, who had regained his footing in front of the altar, raised his head.
unit.target: Illo momento, Bloody Jack, qui ante aram iterum stetit, caput attollit.

unit.source: His mutilated face turned towards Lumian as he lifted the blood‐dripping axe with both hands.
unit.target: Facies eius mutilata ad Lumian versa est, dum securim, sanguine stillantem, ambabus manibus levavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes, tinged with an iron-black hue, mirrored a two-toned figure of Bloody Jack.
unit.target: Oculi Luminiani, ferro nigro tincti, imaginem bicolorem Bloody Jack repraesentaverunt.

unit.source: One was a vivid red, enveloping every crevice of Bloody Jack’s body, permeating every inch of space.
unit.target: Una erat rubra viva, quae omnes rimae corporis Bloody Jack involvit et omne spatium pervagans erat.

unit.source: The other was a pale white, no larger than a thumb.
unit.target: Altera erat pallida alba, non amplius quam pollex.

unit.source: It was located at Bloody Jack’s abdomen, enveloped by layers of bright red.
unit.target: Ea in venter Bloody Jack sita erat, circumdata stratis rubri nitidi.

unit.source: Much like Padre Cali in his untransformed Wraith state, he has only one vulnerability from head to toe, but it’s not in his Spirit Body; it’s concealed within his physical form…
unit.target: Sicut Padre Cali in suo statu Wraith non transformato, habet unam solam infirmitatem ab capite usque ad pedes, sed non in Corpori Spirituali; ea autem in forma physica abscondita est.

unit.source: This seems to be composed of viscous blood.
unit.target: Id videtur ex sanguine viscoso compositum esse.

unit.source: Regardless of the extent of damage or blood loss it endures, as long as the core remains unharmed, it will be unaffected…
unit.target: Quamvis quantum damni aut sanguinis amissione patiatur, dummodo nucleus intactus maneat, id immutatum erit.

unit.source: It bears some resemblance to the Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway, but it possesses mirror-related capabilities…
unit.target: Aliquantum similitudo recolitur ad Episcopum Rosae viae Secretorum Supplicantium, sed facultates speculo pertinentes posidet.

unit.source: As Lumian observed, a succession of thoughts calmly raced through his mind.
unit.target: Ut Lumian observavit, seriem cogitationum tranquille per mentem eius peragrabantur.

unit.source: Bloody Jack’s red spiderweb-like eyes displayed a ruthless and bloodthirsty expression.
unit.target: Oculi rubri, instar retis araneae, Bloody Jack vultum implacabilem et sanguinem appetentem ostenderunt.

unit.source: He raised his axe and swung it at Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Securim attollit et in corpus Luminiani percussit.

unit.source: The deal is done. Now, I’m going to kill you!
unit.target: Pactum consummatum est. Nunc te occidam!

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: The axe missed Lumian and hit the ground of the quarry cave, creating a deep fissure and sending gravel and dirt flying.
unit.target: Securis Luminiani non contigit eum et terram speluncae fodinae percussit, fissuram profundam creans et lapillos atque terram proiciebans.

unit.source: With a twisted flexibility that exceeded human limits, Lumian maneuvered behind Bloody Jack.
unit.target: Cum flexibilitate tortuosa, quae limites humanis superabat, Lumian post Bloody Jack versabatur.

unit.source: With a swift motion of his arm, Lumian punched out with his right fist.
unit.target: Celeri bracchii motu, Lumian dextro pugno percussit.

unit.source: Blazing white flames surged forth, a bright tail enveloping his fist and wrapping around his forearm.
unit.target: Flammae albae ardentes exortae sunt, caudam nitidam pugnum eius involvens et antebrachium circumvolvens.

unit.source: Pfft! Lumian’s fist felt as if it had plunged into a swamp. The deeper he went, the more muddy and sticky it became.
unit.target: Pfft! Pugnus Luminiani videbatur quasi in paludem mergi; quoad altitudinem, eo limosior et adhaerentior fiebat.

unit.source: Rumble! He detonated the blazing white flames surrounding his fist, blasting open a passageway.
unit.target: Rumble! Flammae albae ardentes, quae pugnum eius circumdebant, displosae sunt, viam patefecerunt.

unit.source: His fist and forearm sank into Bloody Jack’s cavity, halting at the pale-white spot.
unit.target: Pugnus eius et antebrachium in cavitatem Bloody Jack ceciderunt, sistentes in loco pallide albo.

unit.source: Just as Bloody Jack was about to turn around and swing his axe, he froze. His body rapidly disintegrated, turning into congealed blood that fell to the ground.
unit.target: Ita, cum Bloody Jack conversurus esset et securim percussurus, immobilis factus est. Corpus eius celeriter dissolutum est, in sanguinem coagulum conversum, qui in terram cecidit.

unit.source: The blood clots writhed and reassembled into Bloody Jack, but there was still a gap in his abdomen that couldn’t be filled.
unit.target: Coagula sanguinis se contorquebantur et in Bloody Jack redintegrabantur, sed adhuc hiatus in ventre eius exstabat, quod impleri non poterat.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian’s body ignited with a blazing white flame, ready to attack with all his might.
unit.target: Videns hoc, corpus Luminiani ignem albidum ardentem accendit, paratum ad impetum maximae virium.

unit.source: Bloody Jack instantly turned ethereal and retreated into the mirror on the altar.
unit.target: Bloody Jack statim evanuit et in speculo ad aram recessit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and abandoned the pursuit, ending the summoning ritual at a moderate pace.
unit.target: Lumian subridens persecutionem deseruit et ritum evocandi ad modum finivit.

unit.source: His objective had been achieved. He had acquired the contracted ability—Mirror Mark!
unit.target: Propositum eius perfectum est. Contractam facultatem—Signum Speculi—acquivit!

unit.source: Previously, he had observed Bloody Jack’s river of fate not to gather information about it, but to verify if this strange creature from the bloody world possessed godhood!
unit.target: Prius observaverat flumen fati Bloody Jack non ad notitiae colligendas, sed ut comprobares num haec insolita creatura ex mundo sanguinoso deitatem haberet!

unit.source: If Bloody Jack didn’t have godhood, Lumian could complete some risky transactions with him to circumvent the requirement of 99 living sacrifices. If Bloody Jack had godhood, he would undoubtedly suffer a backlash. However, he was protected by the ritual and under Mr. Fool’s gray fog’s supervision, so he wouldn’t be significantly affected.
unit.target: Si Bloody Jack deitatem non haberet, Lumian cum eo negotia periculosa conficere posset, ut exigentiam XCIX sacrificiorum viventium circumveniret. Si autem deitatem haberet, certo iniuriam subiret. Attamen, rituale eum protegebat et sub vigilantia nebulae griseae Domini Folli erat, itaque non graviter affectus esset.

unit.source: It was precisely because he was aware of this that Lumian dared to agree to drag Bloody Jack out of the mirror, allowing him to no longer be restricted by the ritual.
unit.target: Idcirco, cum hoc conscius esset, Lumian ausus est consentire ut Bloody Jack ex speculo traheretur, ita ut amplius a rituali coercebarentur.

unit.source: It turned out that as long as the contracted party could communicate normally, the price to pay when signing the contract would be significantly lower.
unit.target: Evenit, dummodo pars contracta normaliter communicare valeat, pretium in contractum subscribendo signanter minorem futurum esse.

unit.source: Of course, there was no way to avoid the negative effects entirely. Although Lumian obtained the Mirror Mark, it would also make him more susceptible to attracting abnormal events and strange dangers related to mirrors.
unit.target: Certe, nullus modus erat effectus negativos omnino vitare. Etsi Lumian Signum Speculi obtinuit, id eum etiam proclivum faceret ad attrahendos eventus abnormes et pericula insolita speculis conexa.

unit.source: As the crack created by Bloody Jack spread to the wall of spirituality, causing it to gradually disintegrate, Franca took the opportunity to curiously inquire about what had just transpired.
unit.target: Cum fissura a Bloody Jack in parietem spiritualitatis diffundebatur, paulatim dissolvens eum, Franca occasionem cepit ad curiose interrogandum quid modo evenisset.

unit.source: Lumian gave a brief account of his “negotiation” with Bloody Jack and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian breviter exposuit de sua “negotiatione” cum Bloody Jack et subridens arriduit.

unit.source: “I worked hard to reach Sequence 5 so that these evil creatures would be able to communicate with me calmly.”
unit.target: “Laboravi ut ad Sequenciam 5 pervenirem, ut hae creaturae maleficae mecum tranquille communicare possent.”

unit.source: Franca couldn’t resist laughing. “You call that calm?”
unit.target: Franca se a ridendo continere non potuit. “Hoc tranquillum vocas?”

unit.source: With a sigh, she said, “If it weren’t for dealing with Moran Avigny, the Mirror Mark wouldn’t be a wise choice. You wouldn’t have much use for it normally. It’s like wasting a contract slot.”
unit.target: Suspirans, dixit, “Nisi negotia cum Moran Avigny, Signum Speculi non esset electio sapientissima. Normaliter parum utilitatis tibi afferet; quasi locum contractus terere.”

unit.source: This was due to Lumian’s lack of mirror-related abilities. Without a fixed mirror world entrance, he couldn’t pass through mirrors, let alone use the Mirror Mark to locate his target.
unit.target: Hoc propter defectum facultatum ad specula pertinentium Luminiani erat. Sine introitus fijo in mundo speculari, specula transire non poterat, nec Signum Speculi ad scopum detegendum adhibere.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t bothered by it.
unit.target: Lumian id non curabat.

unit.source: “The Sealed Artifact corresponding to the Hisoka Beyonder characteristic might have the ability to transform into a Wraith. The Mirror Mark could be used to complement it.”
unit.target: “Artifactum Sigillatum, quod Hisoka Beyonder proprietati correspondet, fortasse facultatem habet in Wraith transformandi. Signum Speculi ad id complendum adhiberi posset.”

unit.source: “Let’s hope that’s the case,” Franca said, sighing. “This is why Contractees can’t compare to Shepherds. Once you sign a contract and gain an ability, you’re stuck with it. Even if that ability becomes useless, it still takes up a slot and brings the associated negative effects.”
unit.target: “Speremus ita esse,” inquit Franca, suspirans, “propterea Contracti cum Pastoribus comparari non possunt. Quoties contractum subscribis et facultatem acquiris, illud tibi constat; et, etsi illa facultas inutilis evadat, tamen locum occupat atque effectus negativos adfert.”

unit.source: Many contracted abilities were acquired to fulfill specific needs for a limited time. After that period, they often became useless. For instance, Lumian’s Niese Face could only be used occasionally as an illusion during combat after he obtained the Lie earring.
unit.target: Multae facultates contractae empta erant ad specificas necessitates in tempore finito explendas. Post illo tempus saepe inutiles fiebant. Exempli gratia, Vultus Niese Luminiani tantum aliquando uti poterat ut simulatio in proelio, postquam auriculam Mendacii acceperat.

unit.source: Lumian smiled. “Who says I can’t get rid of it?”
unit.target: Lumian subridet, “Quis dicit me id removere non posse?”

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca was caught off guard.
unit.target: “Heu…” Franca obstupefacta est.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curved into a bright smile.
unit.target: Labia Luminiani in risu claro incurvata sunt.

unit.source: “Kill the contract target, and the contract will automatically be nullified.”
unit.target: “Occide scopus contracti, et contractus automatice rescindetur.”

unit.source: Franca and Jenna gasped inwardly.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna interne exclamaverunt.

unit.source: After a moment, Franca joked, “Very good. Keep that smile. That’s the smile of a homicidal maniac—no, a Reaper.”
unit.target: Post instantes, Franca iocose dixit, “Optime. Illud risum conserva. Est risus homicidarum insanus—immo, Messor.”

unit.source: Jenna nodded thoughtfully. “No wonder you didn’t kill Bloody Jack just now and only scared it away. You were worried that the newly acquired abilities would vanish instantly. Didn’t you mention you were planning to contract three abilities this time? Have you thought about the other two?”
unit.target: Jenna, mente cogitans, annuit: “Non mirum est quod nuper Bloody Jack non occidisti, sed solum territus recepisti. Timuisti enim ne nuper adeptae facultates instante evanescerent. Nonne dixisti te hoc tempore tres facultates contracturum esse? De reliquis duabus cogitaveris?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian wasn’t in a rush to complete the second ritual. He casually chatted, “One is to boost my defense or substitution abilities, while the other is to handle undead creatures. However, I’ll need to think about the latter later.”
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Lumian leniter, non festinans ad secundum ritum perficendum. “Una est ad defensionem meam vel substitutionis facultates augendas, altera est ad gerendas creaturas mortuas. Tamen de altera postea cogitare mihi erit.”

unit.source: The former addressed his lack of physical defense, while the latter made up for his insufficient means to deal with Wraiths and undead creatures.
unit.target: Primum defectum defensionis corporalis solvit, altera vero insufficientiam modorum ad tractandos Wraiths et creaturas mortuas compensat.

unit.source: “Substitution abilities…” Franca said, smiling. “Just sign a contract with a Wraith or specter formed by a Demoness or a Mid-Sequence Seer Beyonder after their death.”
unit.target: “Facultates substitutionis…” inquit Franca, subridens, “contractum subscribe cum Wraith aut speculato a Demonissa aut Medio-Sequentiae Seer Beyonder post mortem eorum formatus.”

unit.source: Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: Lumian irridens respondit.

unit.source: “Do you think I haven’t considered that? However, apart from the Demoness evil spirit suspected to be a Saint, there’s nothing related to Demonesses or Seers. I definitely can’t handle the negative effects of a demigod contractor at my current level.”
unit.target: “Putasne me id non considerasse? Attamen, nisi spiritus malignus Demonissa, qui Sanctus esse suspicatur, nihil aliud pertinet ad Demonissas aut Videntes. Certe effectus negativos contractoris semidei ad gradu meo non ferre possum.”

unit.source: “Maybe it’s manageable,” Franca’s eyes sparkled. “Maybe the adverse effects will only change your gender.”
unit.target: “Forsitan moderabitur,” oculi Francae scintillaverunt. “Forsitan effectus adversi tantum sexum tuum mutabunt.”

unit.source: “What do you mean ‘only’?” Lumian wanted to tease Franca for her “life is short, why not give it a shot” mindset, but he restrained himself in front of Jenna.
unit.target: “Quid significas ‘tantum’?” inquit Lumian, desiderans Francam provocare propter mentem “vita brevis est, cur non temptes?”, sed coram Jenna se continuit.

unit.source: Franca suddenly had a thought. “Can you only sign contracts with spirit world creatures or strange creatures? Can you sign one with a human? I can share the Mirror Substitution ability with you.”
unit.target: Franca repente cogitavit: “Num solum cum creaturis mundi spiritualis aut insolitis contracta scribere potes? An cum homine contractum facere licet? Tibi facultatem substitutionis speculi communicare possum.”

unit.source: This was the first time Lumian had considered this question. After thinking for a moment, he said, “The relevant mysticism knowledge doesn’t forbid it… But never mind. The Inevitability contract might have some hidden corruption or influence.”
unit.target: Hoc primum fuit quod Lumian hanc quaestionem consideravit. Post breve meditationem, inquit, “Scientia mystica ad rem pertinentia id non vetat… Sed nihil refert. Contractus Inevitabilitatis fortasse aliquam latentem corruptionem vel influentiam habeat.”

unit.source: “That’s true.” Franca was still rational.
unit.target: “Verum est,” inquit Franca, adhuc rationem servans.

unit.source: As she responded, another question popped into her mind.
unit.target: Dum respondebat, altera quaestio in mentem eius subito venit.

unit.source: If I actually sign a contract with him, what kind of negative effects will I inflict on Lumian?
unit.target: Si vere cum eo contractum subscribam, quos effectus negativos Lumiani infligam?

unit.source: “Why does the ability to deal with the undead have to wait?” Jenna wasn’t as quick-witted as Franca, so she could only focus on more practical matters.
unit.target: “Cur facultas ad tractandum cum mortuis exspectare debet?” inquit Jenna, quae non tam vivax erat quam Franca, atque solum rebus practicis inspicere potuit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “Because spirit world creatures and strange creatures fear sunlight’s purification and don’t have similar abilities, I can only consider obtaining it from the death domain. There’s a good contract target there.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit, “Quia creaturae mundi spiritualis et insolitae purificationem solis timent nec facultates similes habent, solum e dominio mortis id obtinere considerare possum. Ibi optimus scopus contractus invenitur.”

unit.source: “Armored Shadow?” Franca realized. “Are you worried that giving him too much gold will make future communication uncontrollable?”
unit.target: «Umbra Armata?» inquit Franca; «num tibi sollicitus es quod nimis aurum donando, futura communicatio incondita fiat?»

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Additionally, I’m also waiting for the Sealed Artifact made from the Hisoka Beyonder characteristic. If it’s related to a Wraith, I won’t need the corresponding contract ability.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et respondit, “Praeterea, exspecto Artifactum Sigillatum, quod Hisoka Beyonder proprietati correspondit. Si ad Wraith referatur, non mihi opus erit facultiæ contractæ respondente.”

unit.source: After chatting for a while, Lumian reconstructed the wall of spirituality and began his second summoning.
unit.target: Post aliquod sermone, Lumian parietem spiritualitatis refecit et secundam evocationem incepit.

unit.source: This time, he summoned: “A peculiar creature wandering above the world, an unimaginably sturdy being, a colossal creature that never rests.”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, evocavit: “Creaturam pecularem, per orbem errantem, ens incredibiliter robustum, ingentem creaturam quae numquam quiescit.”

unit.source: After reciting the incantation, a “peak” made of layers of flesh appeared at the mysterious door.
unit.target: Post incantationem recitandam, culmen ex stratis carnis apparuit ad ianuam mysticam.

unit.source: Its height was unknown, but it couldn’t fully emerge, causing the illusory and mysterious door to shake.
unit.target: Altitudo eius incerta erat, sed omnino emergere non potuit, quod ianuam illusoriam et mysticam concutiebat.

unit.source: After speaking the Mystical Language of Fate, Lumian obtained the corresponding information.
unit.target: Postquam Linguam Mysticam Fati enuntiavit, Lumian informationem ad eam pertinentem obtinuit.

unit.source: This “mountain of flesh” indeed possessed the ability to enhance one’s defense. It could toughen one’s body to be like steel or rock, but the corresponding downside was having a movement speed as slow as that of an ordinary turtle.
unit.target: Hic “mons carnis” vere facultatem defensionis augendi habebat. Corpus in modum ferri vel saxi durari poterat, sed incommodum quidem erat motus tam tardus quam testudinis communis.

unit.source: Lumian had no choice but to give up.
unit.target: Lumian nihil aliud potuit facere quam cedere.

unit.source: His alternative target was his messenger, Penitent Baynfel.
unit.target: Scopus alternus eius erat nuntius, Penitent Baynfel.

unit.source: According to the messenger information provided by Madam Magician, Baynfel had the ability to bring his shadow to life and switch positions with his body at critical moments.
unit.target: Secundum informationes nuntii a Domina Magica traditas, Baynfel facultatem habebat umbram suam ad vitam revocandi et cum corpore suo in temporibus criticis locos permutandi.

unit.source: 711 Choice
unit.target: 711 Electio

unit.source: Since he was summoning his messenger, Lumian didn’t perform the ritual in Mr. Fool’s name.
unit.target: Cum nuntium suum evocaret, Lumian ritum in nomine Domini Stulti non egit.

unit.source: He simply called forth Penitent Baynfel, who was garbed in a black clergyman’s robe, resembling a charred corpse with black flames clinging to his body.
unit.target: Ipse simpliciter vocavit Penitentem Baynfel, qui in veste sacerdotali nigra indutus erat, quasi cadaver exurens cum flammas nigras ad corpus haerentes.

unit.source: “I wish to enter into another contract with you,” Lumian requested with a smile.
unit.target: «Tecum alio pacto coniungi cupio,» Lumian cum risu rogavit.

unit.source: He briefly recounted the power of Inevitability, the special contract, the sharing of abilities, the potential price, and the negative effects, awaiting Baynfel’s decision.
unit.target: Breviter narravit potentiam Inevitabilitatis, pactum speciale, divisionem facultatum, pretium potentiale, atque effectus negativos, exspectans decisionem Baynfelis.

unit.source: Baynfel stayed silent for a few moments before responding in a deep voice, “If you’re not worried about the downsides, I have no objections.”
unit.target: Baynfel paucis momentis silentium tenuit antequam voce profunda respondit: «Si incommoda non cures, nihil contra habeo.»

unit.source: “What might the negative effects be?” Lumian inquired cautiously.
unit.target: «Quae effecta negativa sint?» Lumian caute interrogavit.

unit.source: In Baynfel’s empty, dark eye sockets, the dark flames that served as his eyes flickered twice.
unit.target: In orbibus oculorum Baynfel, vacuis et obscuris, flammas obscuras, quae ut oculi eius erant, bis micabantur.

unit.source: “That hinges on your choice. I can let you finalize the contract. Once you know the specific negative effects, you can decide if you want to seal the deal.”
unit.target: «Id ex electione tua pendet. Te sinire possum pactum concludere. Cum effectus negativos certos cognosceris, decernere poteris utrum pactum confirmare velis.»

unit.source: Different choices lead to different negative effects? What choices?
unit.target: Diversae electiones ad diversa effecta negativa ducunt? Quae electiones?

unit.source: Lumian spoke the Mystical Language of Fate, filled with curiosity and puzzlement, allowing the silver-black symbols, words, and patterns to land on the faux goatskin, forming a short, powerful, mysterious, and sinister contract document.
unit.target: Lumian linguam Mysticam Fati locutus est, plenum curiositatis et perplexitatis, sinens symbola argenteo-nigra, verba, et formas in fictam cute caprina delabi, formantes brevem, potentem, mysteriosum atque sinistrum documentum pacti.

unit.source: Through the connection forged by the Mystical Language of Fate, Lumian sensed Baynfel’s traits and abilities.
unit.target: Per nexum a Lingua Mystica Fati confectum, Lumian sensit proprietates et facultates Baynfelis.

unit.source: The Penitent’s powers were intimately tied to shadows and darkness, but most of them seemed to be submerged in murky depths. Lumian could sense their presence, but he couldn’t discern their nature.
unit.target: Potestates Penitentis intime coniunctae erant cum umbris et tenebris, sed pleraeque in obscuris abyssis demersa videbantur. Lumian eorum praesentiam sentire potuit, sed naturam discerneri non potuit.

unit.source: The two abilities floating above the surface were Shadow Animation and Spirit World Traversal. Their characteristics were Ancient Corpse.
unit.target: Duae facultates super superficiem fluitantes erant “Animatio Umbrarum” et “Transitus Mundi Spiritus”. Eorum indoles erat “Corpus Antiquum.”

unit.source: Perfect, Shadow Animation is just what I need… Baynfel probably showcased it specifically for me… He’s quite unique, completely different from spirit world entities like Headless Bride, Abscessed Hand, and Human-Faced Mantis… It’s much more straightforward to truly communicate with him… As Lumian mused, he gained a deeper understanding of Shadow Animation.
unit.target: Perfectum, Animatio Umbrarum est id quod mihi necessarium est… Baynfel verisimiliter eam mihi specialiter ostendit… Ipse singularis est, prorsus differt ab entitatibus mundi spiritualis ut Nupta Sine Capite, Manus Abscessa, et Mantidea Vultu Humano; multo facilius enim cum eo vere communicare licet… Quamquam meditatus est Lumian, profundius de Animatione Umbrarum intellexit.

unit.source: This was an active ability that could animate the shadows of oneself and others. The former could be used to swap places with the body and evade fatal damage when dodging was impossible. The latter would ensnare the corresponding target, hindering their movements, but it couldn’t inflict much harm or completely restrain the opponent.
unit.target: Haec erat facultas activa quae umbras ipsius ac aliorum animare valebat. Prima adhiberi poterat ad corpus commutandum et damnum fatale vitandum, cum evadere non posset; secunda vero destinatum implicabat, motus eius inhibens, sed parum laedere aut hostem penitus reprimere non poterat.

unit.source: Activating it swiftly to produce instantaneous effects was its greatest strength. Otherwise, it couldn’t shield from death or injury. Its drawback was that it could only maintain the activation of one shadow at a time.
unit.target: Celeriter eam activare ad effectus instantaneos producendos, eius vis maxima erat. Alio modo a morte aut laesione se defendere non poterat. Incommodum autem eius erat quod solum unam umbram simul activam tenere poterat.

unit.source: As a substitute, if the animated shadow perished, Lumian would have to wait for the sun to rise or set before the shadow would reappear. Shadowless individuals would be deathly afraid of sunlight and instinctively dread it.
unit.target: Ut substitutum, si umbra animata periret, Lumian exspectare debebit usque ad ortum aut occasum solis, antequam umbra rursus appareret. Qui umbram non habent, solem mortifero metu terrentur atque instinctive illud fugiunt.

unit.source: In the past, my emotions and desires were volatile, and now I’m piling on a fear of sunlight? If I really run into Mid-Sequence Beyonders of the Sun pathway in the future, won’t I be too terrified to even open my eyes? Thankfully, this is a downside that only kicks in after losing the shadow substitute. It’s not permanent… Lumian looked at Baynfel and asked sincerely, “What sacrifice do you require? Or rather, what price must I pay?”
unit.target: In praeterito, affectus et desideria meae erant volatilia, et nunc metum solis addo? Si vere in viam Beyonderum Solis Mediis in futurum incidero, nonne nimis territus ero ut etiam oculos aperire possim? Gratiam habeo quod hoc incommodum post umbrae substituti amissionem solum incipit; non est permanens… Lumian Baynfel intuens, sincere quaesivit: «Quam sacrificium requiris? Vel potius, quid pretium solvere debeam?»

unit.source: So far, he still hadn’t figured out the negative repercussions of signing a contract with Baynfel.
unit.target: Ad hunc modum, adhuc nesciebat repercussiones negativas contractus cum Baynfel signandi.

unit.source: Penitent Baynfel, with only a thin layer of charred skin clinging to his bones, replied, “Any mystical item in your possession.”
unit.target: Penitentus Baynfel, cum tenuo strato cutis exusta ad ossa eius haerentem, respondit: «Quodlibet rem mysticam in tua possessione habes.»

unit.source: Any one… Is this the so-called choice? Picking a mystical item to offer directly shapes the ultimate negative effects? Lumian had an epiphany as he took stock of the mystical items he carried.
unit.target: Quidlibet… Estne hoc vocatum “electio”? Eligendo rem mysticam ad offerendum, directe effectus negativos ultimatos formantur? Lumian epiphania cepit dum res mysticas quas portabat enumerabat.

unit.source: His knee-jerk thought was the Pride Armor. After all, he couldn’t effectively use the Sealed Artifact at present. However, looking at Baynfel’s charred corpse, he felt that he wasn’t just sacrificing an item but attempting to off his messenger. Furthermore, while he couldn’t use the Pride Armor for now, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony could. Lumian had already taught them the corresponding usage techniques.
unit.target: Prima cogitatio eius fuit Armatura Superbiae. Postremo, Artefactum Sigillatum nunc efficaciter uti non poterat. Attamen, cum cadaver exustum Baynfel contemplaret, sensit se non solum rem sacrificasse sed etiam nuntium suum interficere temptare.
