Insuper, dum ipse Armaturam Superbiae interim uti non posset, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony id efficaciter uti poterant. Lumian iam eis modos usus congruentes docuerat.

unit.source: At the crux of it all was a single mantra: Don’t wear it yourself. Only utilize the negative effects by letting the target trigger them!
unit.target: In summa quaestionis erat una sententia: «Noli id te ipse gerere.» Utere tantum effectibus negativis, sinendo destinatum illos excitare!

unit.source: As for proactively triggering higher-level negative effects in exchange for indiscriminate area-of-effect damage, there was no way to teach that. It had to be improvised based on the environment and the enemy’s traits. After all, Demonesses likely relished this method. It was brutally effective in bullying targets without substitute-type abilities!
unit.target: Quod ad proactiva excitanda effecta negativa gradus superiores in commutatione pro damno areae indiscriminatae attinet, nullus modus docendi erat. Id improvisandum erat ex ambitu et indolis hostium; postremo, Demonides hanc rationem probabiliter delectabantur. Crudelis efficacitas autem erat in intimidando scopos sine facultatibus substitutivis.

unit.source: Mystery Prying Glasses, Flog boxing gloves, Eye of Truth, Lie earring, Mr. K’s finger, Symphony of Hatred bone flute, Fury of the Sea brooch, Traveler’s Bag, Omebella’s umbilical cord remains, expired misfortune gold coins and unlucky banknotes, Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic… Lumian went through these items one by one.
unit.target: Specula Inquisitiva Mysterii, chirothecae pugilisticae Flog, Oculus Veritatis, auriculum fallax, digitus Domini K, fistula ossium symphonia odii, fibula Furoris Maris, saccus viatoris, reliquiae funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae, nummi aurei exfortunii exspirati et chartae pecuniariae infaustae, characteristica “Serial Killer Beyonder”… Lumian his rebus singillatim peragravit.

unit.source: Excluding non-mystical items and ones that were very handy to him at the moment, Lumian ultimately decided to choose between the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth.
unit.target: Excludens res non mysticas et eas, quae illi ad tempus utilissimae erant, Lumian denique statuit eligere inter Specula Inquisitiva Mysterii et Oculus Veritatis.

unit.source: Their abilities overlapped to a degree. Keeping one sufficed.
unit.target: Eorum facultates ad aliquem gradum concurrerunt. Retinere unum satis erat.

unit.source: After a brief moment of contemplation, Lumian opted to offer the Eye of Truth to Baynfel.
unit.target: Post breve momentum meditationis, Lumian statuit Oculus Veritatis Baynfel proponere.

unit.source: He believed that the Mystery Prying Glasses had fewer negative effects than the Eye of Truth when usage time was limited. Furthermore, the Eye of Truth could only see the truth. The Mystery Prying Glasses could at least be used to paint supernatural works and disguise himself. After Lumian became an Ascetic, he could effectively rein in the urge to paint while donning the Mystery Prying Glasses. He could paint as needed or abstain.
unit.target: Existimavit Specula Inquisitiva Mysterii minus effectus negativos habere quam Oculus Veritatis, cum tempus usus limitatum esset. Praeterea, Oculus Veritatis solum veritatem videre poterat. Specula Inquisitiva Mysterii saltem ad opera supernaturalia pingenda et ad se occultandum adhiberi poterant. Postquam Lumian in Asceticum factus est, efficaciter impetum pingendi continere potuit, dum Specula Inquisitiva Mysterii gereret; sive pingeret, sive abstinere valeret.

unit.source: Lumian produced the peculiar Eye of Truth and handed it to Baynfel.
unit.target: Lumian, Oculus Veritatis peculiare producens, illud Baynfel tradidit.

unit.source: Just as Baynfel grasped the eyewear, which appeared entwined with flesh and blood vessels, Lumian suddenly sensed the downside of signing the contract.
unit.target: Cum Baynfel illud instrumentum oculare comprehenderet, quod cum carne et vasis sanguine implicatum videbatur, Lumian subito incommodum contractum signandi sensit.

unit.source: In scenes closely tied to Baynfel’s past, he would witness truths better left unseen.
unit.target: In scaenis arcte connexis cum praeterito Baynfel, veritates spectare debebat, quae melius non videantur.

unit.source: However, it’s fine if such effects only happen when it involves this messenger’s enigmatic background. Otherwise, I would have cut today’s ritual short and made a new choice after finding a suitable contract partner… In Aurore and Franca’s words, seeing what shouldn’t be seen is a death sentence… Lumian pondered for a moment and replied to Baynfel in a deep voice, “The contract stands.”
unit.target: Tamen, licet talia effecta solum eveniant cum rem ad hunc nuntii enigmaticae originis pertineat. Alioquin, hodiernum ritum breviter finivissem et novam electionem post contracti socio idoneum fecissem… Secundum verba Aurore et Franca, id quod non videndum est videntes mors est; Lumian per aliquod momentum meditatus est et, voce profunda, Baynfel respondit: «Contractus stabit.»

unit.source: As he finished speaking, the short and sinister contract spontaneously ignited without fire, transforming into silver-black symbols, words, and patterns that seared onto Lumian’s arm.
unit.target: Dum loqui finem faciens, brevis et sinistrum contractus sine igne subito incenditus est, in symbola argenteo-nigra, verba, et formas versa, quae in brachio Lumiani inscripta sunt.

unit.source: Lumian glanced down at his shadow and saw it warp on its own, as if performing a powerful dance.
unit.target: Lumian deorsum ad umbram suam respexit et vidit eam se ipsa mutari, quasi saltationem potentem ageret.

unit.source: A smile spread across Lumian’s face.
unit.target: Risus per faciem Lumiani diffusus est.

unit.source: After about ten seconds, his shadow settled.
unit.target: Post circiter decem secundas, umbra eius consedit.

unit.source: Lumian expressed his gratitude to Baynfel and ended the summoning, stowing away all the items on the altar.
unit.target: Lumian Baynfel gratias egit et evocationem finivit, omnes res in altare reponens.

unit.source: “It’s done?” Franca asked eagerly.
unit.target: «Factum est?» Franca avidē rogavit.

unit.source: It wasn’t that she doubted Lumian couldn’t even handle his messenger, but she worried the nature of his abilities might not meet the requirements or come with too many strings attached.
unit.target: Non enim dubitabat quod Lumian nuntium suum non posset administrare, sed sollicita erat quia eius facultates requisita sufficerent aut nimis vinculis implicari videbantur.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and briefly recounted the situation with Shadow Animation.
unit.target: Lumian annuit et brevi tempore rerum de Animatione Umbrarum enarravit.

unit.source: As he walked towards the quarry cave’s exit, he said to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, “Now, we can hatch a plan to deal with Moran Avigny.”
unit.target: Dum ad exitum specus lapidei pergebat, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony audire constituit: «Nunc consilium excogitare possumus ad tractandum Moran Avigny.»

unit.source: “Franca, contact the Demoness of Black and let her know we’re about to make our move. However, to avoid spooking the family and hidden forces behind Moran Avigny, she doesn’t need to observe nearby for now. Just request an emergency help charm from her that can contact her through a mirror if the Mirror People have hidden allies. Yes, it’s a golden opportunity to test the Demoness of Black’s stance towards the Tamara family and the Mirror People. Also, inform the Eternal Blazing Sun Church that they can get ready to cut us some slack.”
unit.target: «Franca, contacta Demonessam Nigrae et fac eam scire nos motum nostrum iam praeparare. Attamen, ut ne familia et vires occultae post Moran Avigny terriantur, non necesse est eam prope observare nunc. Solum ex ea charm auxilii subitus petas, qui per speculum eam contingere possit, si Populus Specularum socios occulte habeat. Ita, aurea occasio est ut probetur habitus Demonissae Nigrae erga familiam Tamarae et Populum Specularum. Etiam informa Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flaminis ut parata sint nos levare.»

unit.source: “Jenna, write to Madam Judgment and clue her in on our plan in the event the Demoness of Black is in bed with the Mirror People.”
unit.target: «Jenna, scribe ad Domnam Iudicii et instrue eam de nostro consilio, in casu Demonessa Nigra cum Populo Specularum coniungatur.»

unit.source: “Anthony…”
unit.target: «Anthony…»

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced as he considered various details and doled out missions to his companions.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani celeriter cursitare coepit, dum varia singula considerabat et munera sociis suis delegabat.

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony didn’t just passively accept their tasks. They actively chimed in with ideas and helped Lumian fill in gaps and polish his brainstorming.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony non tantum passim munera acceperunt; sed active cum ideis contendebant et Lumian adiuvabant ut lacunas explerent atque cogitationes subtiliter perficerent.

unit.source: Upon returning to Apartment 702 at 9 Rue Orosai, Anthony ducked out early to keep up appearances at the Trier Psychiatrist Guild.
unit.target: Postquam ad Apartmentum 702 in 9 Rue Orosai rediit, Anthony mature discessit ut imaginem servaret apud Collegium Psychiatrarum Treverensium.

unit.source: Jenna, meanwhile, changed into a dark black cloaked dress and seized the chance to play the part of a Witch.
unit.target: Jenna, interea, in vestem nigram, tunicam quasi clausa, se induit et occasionem rapuit ut magam ageret.

unit.source: Soon, only Lumian and Franca remained in the apartment’s living room.
unit.target: Mox soli Lumian et Franca in area communi apartmenti remanserunt.

unit.source: The atmosphere grew awkward, and a prolonged silence hung in the air.
unit.target: Ambitus incommodus factus est, et diuturnum silentium in aere pendebat.

unit.source: Lumian broke the ice as if nothing had happened.
unit.target: Lumian glaciem fregit, quasi nihil evenisset.

unit.source: “How’s Jenna coming along with digesting the Witch potion?”
unit.target: «Quomodo Jenna procedit cum potionem Magae digerendo?»

unit.source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief and said, “Not bad. She’s found her groove acting as a Witch. Ask around the market district and you’ll hear whispers of Witches appearing in the dead of night to punish rowdy drunkards. Some claim to have fallen into an icy river. Some wake up the next day aching all over, while others get splitting headaches come evening and don’t dare drink anymore. What they have in common is they all ran into someone dressed as a Witch. Yes, some drunkards even vanished into thin air…”
unit.target: Franca leviter suspiravit et dixit: «Non male. Illa viam suam in munere Magae invenit. Quaere in regione mercatoria, et audies susurros de Magis nocte apparentes ad poenas ebrios castigandos. Quidam dicunt se in flumine glaciali lapsos esse; alii cruce dolore totum pervagantes expergiscuntur, dum alii vesperi capitis dolores vehementes sentire nec ultra bibere audent. Quod omnibus commune est, est quod omnes aliquem in veste Magae convenerunt. Ita, quidam ebrii etiam in aere evanuerunt…»

unit.source: Franca’s voice trailed off, replaced by a tone fit for telling ghost stories.
unit.target: Vox Francae evanuit, substituta toni apto ad fabulas phantasmata narrandas.

unit.source: “The missing ones committed serious offenses? The others are guilty of beating their families, harassing passersby, and groping women?” Lumian guessed with a smile, based on his read of Jenna.
unit.target: «Num absentes scelera gravia commiserunt? Alii vero familias verberandi, transeuntes molestandi, et feminas palpandi reos sunt?» Lumian subrisu coniectavit, ex intuendo de Jenna.

unit.source: “Bingo.” Franca nodded with a bright smile.
unit.target: «Bingo.» Franca annuit subrisu fulgente.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked, “Aren’t you worried the Demoness of Black will catch wind of this rumor and send someone to investigate?”
unit.target: Lumian, momentaneo meditatus, quaesivit: «Nonne timetis Demonessam Nigrae hunc rumorem capituram esse et aliquem ad investigandum mittere?»

unit.source: Franca felt smug and pointed at herself.
unit.target: Franca se superbiaque sensit et ad se ipsam digito indicavit.

unit.source: “You’re looking at her! Me! In the Demoness Sect, I’m the one handling matters tied to the market district!”
unit.target: «Ad eam aspicis! Me! In Secta Demonissae, ego sum qui negotia cum regione mercatoria administrat!»

unit.source: She then sighed and said, “Jenna is a natural. She whipped up a solid acting plan in under a month. Maybe she can digest the Witch potion before I advance to Affliction.”
unit.target: Deinde Franca suspiravit et dixit: «Jenna natura praeclara est. Consilium actandi firmum intra mensem paravit. Fortasse potionem Magae digerere potest, antequam ad Afflictionem procedam.»

unit.source: “If those incidents hadn’t happened, she would’ve been a star actress. Acting is second nature to her,” Lumian agreed.
unit.target: «Si illa incidentia non occuissent, stella actrix fuisset. Agere scaenice secundum naturam eius est,» Lumian consentivit.

unit.source: The two fell silent again.
unit.target: Ambi iterum silentium obtinuerunt.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Franca put on a brave face and said, “Um, um, you can’t breathe a word to Jenna or anyone else about what I said or did near the altar in the mirror world!”
unit.target: Post paucas secundas, Franca vultum fortem induxit et dixit: «Heu, heu, non potes ullum verbum Jenna aut cuiquam aliud dicere de eo quod iuxta altare in mundo speculi dixi aut feci!»

unit.source: Lumian asked in confusion, “Did you say or do anything out of the ordinary back there?”
unit.target: Lumian, confusione affectus, quaesivit: «Dixistine aut fecistine aliquid insolitum ibi retro?»

unit.source: “I don’t recall…”
unit.target: «Non memini…»

unit.source: Franca was taken aback for a moment before flashing an understanding smile.
unit.target: Franca, momento stupefacta, deinde risum intellegentem effecit.

unit.source: She stood up with a breezy grin and walked to Lumian’s side. She patted his shoulder gratefully and said, “What a bro!”
unit.target: Franca surrexit, risu leni affixa, et ad latus Lumiani accessit; deinde, gratissima animo humerum eius percussa, dixit: «Quam frater es!»

unit.source: She felt all the awkwardness had evaporated.
unit.target: Sensi omne incommodum evanuisse.

unit.source: A few days later, as Moran Avigny attended an interministerial meeting, Lumian appeared near the government-provided villa.
unit.target: Paucis diebus post, cum Moran Avigny conventum interministerialem adesset, Lumian iuxta villam a gubernatione provisam apparuit.

unit.source: 712 “Accusation”
unit.target: 712 “Accusatio”

unit.source: Lumian stood beside Moran Avigny’s villa, wearing a wide-brimmed round hat and a black tweed coat.
unit.target: Lumian iuxta villam Moran Avigny stetit, indutus pileo rotundo lato atque cappa nigra tweedi.

unit.source: He gazed at the garden, its few withered leaves rustling in the breeze, and said to Franca, “Keep your distance later.”
unit.target: Hortum contemplatus est, quo pauca folia exsiccata in aura susurrabant, et Francae dixerat: “Custodi distantiam tuam postea!”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian’s eyes turned silver-black once more, allowing him to observe the fate tributaries corresponding to Franca’s future.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, oculi Lumiani iterum in argentum–nigrum converterunt, permittens eum videre rivulos fati qui ad futurum Francae pertinebant.

unit.source: The tributary tainted with a faint black color was unrelated to their upcoming infiltration.
unit.target: Rivulus fati, leviter nigro tinctus, ad eorum venturam incursationem non pertinuit.

unit.source: Given the current circumstances, sneaking into Moran Avigny’s villa and leaving a Mirror Mark on the full-body mirror in his study didn’t seem to pose a high risk of death.
unit.target: Ex condicionibus praesentibus, furtim in villam Moran Avigny intrare et signum speculi in speculo totius corporis in studiō relinquere non videbatur altum periculum mortis afferre.

unit.source: However, Lumian knew better than to let his guard down.
unit.target: At Lumian melius sciebat neque custodiam suam demittere.

unit.source: After using the Eye of Calamity several times, he understood that a single black fate tributary didn’t necessarily mean there was only one hidden death calamity lurking.
unit.target: Postquam Oculum Calamitatis aliquoties usus est, intellexit unum solum rivulum fati nigro tinctum non necessario significare unam tantum occultam calamitatem mortis latere.

unit.source: According to Franca, numerous death calamities were concealed further along the fate tributary, too blurry for Lumian to discern or differentiate.
unit.target: Secundum Francam, multas calamitates mortis in ulteriori cursu fati absconditae erant, nimis obscurae ut Lumian eas discerneret aut distingueret.

unit.source: In other words, even though there was presently just one faintly black-tainted fate tributary connected to their infiltration of Moran Avigny’s villa, when Franca made her decision and tried to enter, transforming the harmless fate tributary into the main path, a black tributary symbolizing a deadly calamity might still emerge.
unit.target: Aliter dicendum est: quamquam nunc solum unus rivulus fati, leviter nigro tinctus, cum incursione in villam Moran Avigny coniunctus erat, cum Franca consilium ceperit et intrare conata sit, transformans illud innocuum rivulum fati in viam principalem, rivulus niger calamitatem mortiferam significare potuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s profound realization about this was: The fate of the future was variable and ever-evolving.
unit.target: Profunda huius rei intellēctio Lumiani fuit: fatum futuri variabile et semper mutabile erat.

unit.source: Of course, certain aspects were destined to remain constant.
unit.target: Certe, quaedam elementa constantia manere destinata erant.

unit.source: For instance, death was the inevitable fate awaiting most humans.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, mors erat fatum inevitabile plerisque hominibus exspectans.

unit.source: “No need to worry, I’m not new to this,” Franca assured him, confident in her infiltration skills.
unit.target: “Noli solliciti esse, haec mihi nota sunt,” Franca eum asseruit, fidens in artibus ingressūs suis.

unit.source: Assassin 101: Infiltration!
unit.target: Sicarius 101: Ingressus!

unit.source: Without another word, Lumian activated the mark and morphed into a shadow creature, melding into the shadows cast by the garden’s plants.
unit.target: Nullo alio verbo, Lumian signum activavit et in creaturam umbrarum se mutavit, miscendo cum umbris a plantis horti proiectorum.

unit.source: Franca stepped forward and disappeared into the wind-stirred shadows.
unit.target: Franca processit et in umbras ventō concitatas evanuit.

unit.source: The pair swiftly and stealthily made their way to the side of the villa.
unit.target: Par duo celeriter et furtim ad latus villae pervenerunt.

unit.source: At the same time, Moran Avigny was attending a ministerial meeting.
unit.target: Eodem tempore, Moran Avigny conventum ministralem frequentabat.

unit.source: His wife had gone to an art salon with her lady’s maid, leaving only a handful of valets, maids, gardeners, and chefs in the villa.
unit.target: Uxor eius cum ancilla artis salone ivit, relinquens in villa paucos tantum servos, ancillas, hortulanos, et coquos.

unit.source: The Avigny family didn’t live there.
unit.target: Familia Avigny ibi non habitabat.

unit.source: Only the immediate family of the Minister of Industry was permitted to reside in the government-provided villa long-term.
unit.target: Solum familia inmediata Ministri Industria in villa a re publica provisa diuturno tempore manere licuit.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s three children had either already married and moved out or were attending university in the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
unit.target: Tres liberi Moran Avigny vel iam coniugati exierant, vel in universitate in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativae studebant.

unit.source: They only returned home on weekends.
unit.target: Solum in diebus finium hebdomadis domum redibant.

unit.source: For Lumian and Franca, this was when the target location’s security was at its most vulnerable.
unit.target: Pro Lumiano et Franca, hoc tempus erat quo securitas loci petiti maxime vulnerabilis videbatur.

unit.source: After all, Moran Avigny was the VIP.
unit.target: Nam Moran Avigny erat persona praecipua.

unit.source: The covert protection detail would undoubtedly stick close to him.
unit.target: Praesidium occultum sine dubio ei adhaerebit.

unit.source: Lumian emerged from the shadows in the corner and instructed Franca,
unit.target: Lumian ex umbris in angulo emersit et Francae imperavit:

unit.source: “Wait here and keep an eye out for any trouble.”
unit.target: “Hic mane et intuere, ne aliqua perturbatio eveniat.”

unit.source: “Got it!” Franca agreed without protest.
unit.target: “Intellectum!” Franca sine mora assensuit.

unit.source: Lumian concentrated on the Demoness of Pleasure’s fate tributary for a few moments before shifting back into a shadow creature and silently slipping into Moran Avigny’s villa.
unit.target: Lumian paucis momentis in rivulo fati Daemonissae Voluptatis intentavit, deinde in formam umbrarum iterum se convertit et silentio in villam Moran Avigny se infiltravit.

unit.source: He couldn’t view his own future fate, even with the aid of a mirror.
unit.target: Suam futuram fatum, etiam auxilio speculi, videre non poterat.

unit.source: His only option was to infer his fate by watching his companions.
unit.target: Unica eius consilium erat fatum suum ex sociis intuendis conicere.

unit.source: Franca concealed herself in the shadows and patiently waited.
unit.target: Franca se in umbris celavit et patienter exspectavit.

unit.source: It wasn’t long before Lumian reached Moran Avigny’s study, navigating it as if it were his own home.
unit.target: Non multum temporis elapsum est, cum Lumian ad studiō Moran Avigny perveniret, eum quasi domum suam percurrens.

unit.source: He had witnessed Moran Avigny use the full-body mirror there to access the mirror world on multiple occasions.
unit.target: Vidit quotiens Moran Avigny speculum totius corporis ibi aditum in mundum specularum obtinuisse.

unit.source: As for his familiarity with the layout, that was thanks to the detailed security map provided by 007.
unit.target: Ad notitiam dispositionis suae, hoc debitum erat ad mappam securitatis subtiliter explicatam a 007 datam.

unit.source: The winter sunlight around 4 p.m. was dim.
unit.target: Lumen hyemale circa horam quartam post meridiem tenue fulgebat.

unit.source: The study was a mix of light and darkness, evoking a strong sense of dusk.
unit.target: Studium erat mixtura lucis et obscuritatis, crepusculum vehementer evocans.

unit.source: The silence had long been a constant melody in this space.
unit.target: Silentium diu in hoc loco constans melos fuit.

unit.source: Lumian meticulously searched the study from within the shadows but found no traps or hidden individuals.
unit.target: Lumian diligenter in studiō ex umbris perquisivit, sed neque insidias neque homines occultos invenit.

unit.source: Only then did he revert to his human form, breaking free from the shadows and reappearing in front of the full-body mirror.
unit.target: Tunc ad formam humanam rediit, ex umbris evadens atque coram speculo totius corporis iterum apparuit.

unit.source: As the black mark activated, Lumian reached out his right palm and pressed it against the cold, hard glass.
unit.target: Cum notam nigrum activatum esset, Lumian dextrum manum extulit et contra vitrum frigidum et durum appulit.

unit.source: A blood-colored handprint instantly materialized, reversed from Lumian’s right palm as if it belonged to someone else.
unit.target: Immediāte impressio manuum sanguine colorata exstiterunt, reflexa ex manu dextro Lumiani, quasi alicuius alterius esse videbatur.

unit.source: The inverted, sinister blood-colored palm print quickly faded, blending into the mirror and vanishing.
unit.target: Impressio palmae inversa, sinistra sanguine colorata, celeriter evanuit, in speculo conflata atque dissipata.

unit.source: Just as Lumian was about to pull his right palm back and leave, a hand abruptly extended from the full-body mirror and seized his wrist.
unit.target: Iam, cum Lumian dextram manum revocare atque discedere pararet, manus subito ex speculo totius corporis protensa eius carpus apprehendit.

unit.source: The hand was a healthy white, with long, powerful fingers.
unit.target: Manus alba et sana erat, digitis longis atque validis.

unit.source: It yanked with tremendous force, catching Lumian off guard and sending him crashing into the glass mirror.
unit.target: Illā vehementer attrahente, Lumian inopinate cepit atque in vitrum speculum impellit.

unit.source: At some point, the mirror had turned ethereal, shedding its corporeal form.
unit.target: Aliquando, speculum in aetherinum factum est, formam corporis abiciens.

unit.source: Lumian’s vision went dark before illuminating to reveal numerous dark passageways resembling a spiderweb.
unit.target: Visio Lumiani obscurata est, deinde lucem cepit ut multas viae tenebrosae, telam araneam similes, revelaret.

unit.source: In the area corresponding to the current mirror, an ordinary-looking man stood at the edge.
unit.target: In regione speculo hodierno pertinenti, vir simplex in margine stabat.

unit.source: He raised his brass revolver, aimed it at Lumian, and pulled the trigger.
unit.target: Ille revolver aereum extulit, in Lumian intendens, et ictum misit.

unit.source: Clad in a dark tweed suit and a half top hat, with a glass-like cufflink fastened to his sleeve, he wore a faint smile, as if mocking Lumian for not anticipating the possibility of Moran Avigny’s bodyguard hiding in the mirror.
unit.target: Indutus habitu nigro-tweedi et semi pileo, cum fibula vitrea ad manica ligata, levem risum gerebat, quasi irridebat Lumian quod non praevidisset custodem Moran Avigny in speculo latitantem.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: A bullet gleaming with ghostly green light shot towards Lumian.
unit.target: Globulus, luce viridi quasi phantasmatico splendens, in Lumian volavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s figure abruptly vanished.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani subito evanuit.

unit.source: The bullet struck the afterimage he left behind and flew into one of the dark, empty tunnels.
unit.target: Globulus postumbram quam reliquerat percussit et in unum ex cuniculis tenebrosis et desertis volavit.

unit.source: In the next instant, Lumian swiftly materialized behind the ambusher and, without hesitation, harrumphed.
unit.target: In proximo momento, Lumian celeriter post impostorem apparuit et, sine mora, fremivit.

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot out from his nose and struck the ambusher.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso eius emiserunt et impostorem percusserunt.

unit.source: The ambusher’s eyes snapped shut, and he crumpled to the ground.
unit.target: Oculi impostoris subito claudebantur, et ille in terram corruit.

unit.source: Midway through, his eyes darted around and he snapped out of his daze.
unit.target: Interea, oculi eius circumspicuerunt, et ille ex stupore evasit.

unit.source: Thud! He crashed to the ground, transforming his body into a shadow.
unit.target: Thud! Terram percussus est, corpus suum in umbram transformans.

unit.source: The shadows disintegrated and spread in all directions, entering various dark tunnels.
unit.target: Umbrae dissolutae sunt et in omnes partes disseminatae, ingredientes diversos cuniculos tenebrosos.

unit.source: Immediately after, the ambusher stealthily materialized in an empty passageway, his form shrouded in faint white fog.
unit.target: Statim post, impostor furtim in via vacua apparuit, forma eius in nebula alba tenue involuta.

unit.source: Lumian’s figure was reflected in his misty eyes.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani in oculis eius nebulosis reflexa est.

unit.source: Before Lumian could sense it and turn to look, the ambusher spoke in a strange language that could stir the forces of nature, “You’re guilty!”
unit.target: Antequam Lumian id percipere et se convertere potuisset, impostor in lingua insolita, quae vires naturae excitare posset, locutus est: “Tu es reus!”

unit.source: Lumian had never encountered this language, but he clearly understood its meaning.
unit.target: Numquam hanc linguam audiverat, sed sensum eius plane intellexit.

unit.source: His body suddenly froze, as if under an invisible restriction.
unit.target: Corpus eius subito immobilis factum est, quasi sub vinculo invisibili.

unit.source: The ambusher opened his mouth again.
unit.target: Impostor iterum os aperuit.

unit.source: “You blasphemer!”
unit.target: “Tu sacrilegus es!”

unit.source: Suddenly, the entire mirror world froze, and the dark, ethereal passageways transformed into tiny amber insects.
unit.target: Subito, totus mundus specularis immobilis factus est, et viae tenebrosae ac aetheriae in parvos insectos, colore ambri, transformatae sunt.

unit.source: Once again, Lumian heard a terrifying voice that seemed to come from an infinite distance.
unit.target: Iterum, Lumian vocem terribilem audivit, quae ex infiniti distantia venire videbatur.

unit.source: Vaguely, he “saw” three figures.
unit.target: Vagiter tres figuras conspexit.

unit.source: The three figures sat cross-legged, one facing left, one looking straight ahead, and the other looking right.
unit.target: Tres figurae in genu sessae erant: una ad sinistram versa, una recta in ante, et altera ad dexteram spectans.

unit.source: Their hands were in different postures.
unit.target: Manus eorum in diversis positionibus erant.

unit.source: One was heavy, one real, and one ethereal.
unit.target: Una grave erat, una realis, et una aetheria.

unit.source: They were in three different states, constantly moving, changing, and interchanging around a silver circle.
unit.target: In tribus diversis statibus versabantur, constanter moventes, mutantes et inter se circa circulum argenteum intermutantes.

unit.source: A majestic and resounding voice reverberated, causing Lumian’s mind to buzz as he lost consciousness.
unit.target: Vox magnificā et resonāns reverberavit, faciens ut mens Lumiani fremitare inciperet, donec conscientiam amisit.

unit.source: Amidst the blurry, vivid pain, the dazed Lumian felt a familiar burning sensation on his left chest.
unit.target: Inter dolorem nebulosum et vividum, Lumian attonitus sensum ardoris notum in pecto sinistro sensit.

unit.source: His right palm alternated between burning and freezing.
unit.target: Palma dextra eius inter ardorem et frigorem alternabat.

unit.source: Gradually, he regained consciousness.
unit.target: Gradatim conscientiam recuperavit.

unit.source: In a dark tunnel that had solidified, the ambusher witnessed silver-black warts erupting from Lumian’s body, emitting sinister patterns that resembled viscous liquid.
unit.target: In cuniculo tenebroso, solidato, impostor vidit verrucas argentum–nigrae ex corpore Lumiani erumpere, figuras sinistras exhibentes quae liquorem viscosum repraesentabant.

unit.source: At some point, a strange, cold wind swept through the surroundings.
unit.target: Aliquando, ventus mirus ac frigidus per loca circumstantia disseminatus est.

unit.source: Darkness squirmed in the depths of the different tunnels, as if a monster was about to crawl out.
unit.target: Tenebrae in profundis diversorum cuniculorum contorquebantur, quasi monstrum emergere pararetur.

unit.source: The ambusher’s body stiffened, becoming increasingly sluggish, with a faint white fog barely discernible within.
unit.target: Corpus impostoris rigidum factum est, magis magisque inertum, cum nebula alba tenue intra se fere percepta.

unit.source: After an unknown period of time, the man finally survived the most dangerous moment.
unit.target: Post spatium ignotum, vir tandem ex momento periculo maximo superfuit.

unit.source: He felt his body again and regained his vision and hearing.
unit.target: Corpus suum iterum sensit atque visionem ac auditum recuperavit.

unit.source: As Lumian’s warts and patterns faded, the ambusher instinctively felt a lingering fear.
unit.target: Dum verrucae et figurae Lumiani evanuebant, impostor instanter metu residuali affectus est.

unit.source: How did he commit blasphemy?
unit.target: Quomodo sacrilegium commisit?

unit.source: Which deity did he blaspheme against?
unit.target: Contra quam deitatem sacrilegium commisit?

unit.source: Why didn’t he lose control?
unit.target: Cur imperium sui non amisit?

unit.source: I’ve never encountered such a situation before!
unit.target: Numquam antea talem rem expertus sum!

unit.source: The Beyonder powers possessed by the ambusher allowed him to discern the target’s crimes and “accuse” him of various charges.
unit.target: Potentiae Beyonder, quas impostor habebat, ei permisērunt crimina obiecta discerere et eum variis delictis accusare.

unit.source: The damage and effects of different crimes were completely different, and the accuser couldn’t predict them beforehand.
unit.target: Damna et effectus variorum delictorum omnino diversi erant, et accusator ea praevidere non poterat.

unit.source: They could only make a guess based on their experience from previous “cases.”
unit.target: Soli coniecturam facere poterant, ex experientiis priorum casuum innixi.

unit.source: This was the first time the ambusher had encountered a situation where he nearly succumbed to the overflowing influence of the deity after the sinner was punished by a deity for blasphemy!
unit.target: Hoc primum fuit, quo impostor experiebatur rem in qua fere cecidisset sub effusa deitatis influentia, postquam peccator a deitate pro sacrilegio poenam accepisset!

unit.source: Fortunately, he recovered before the target.
unit.target: Fortunate, se ante obiectum recuperavit.

unit.source: The ambusher raised the brass revolver once more and aimed it at Lumian, who was hunched over in pain.
unit.target: Impostor revolver aereum iterum extulit et in Lumian destinavit, qui dolore incurvatus stabat.

unit.source: Just as he pulled the trigger, Lumian’s head snapped up, his expression contorted with ferocity.
unit.target: Iam dum iaculabat, caput Lumiani subito erexit et vultus ferocitate contorsus est.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: A bullet shimmering with starlight shot out from the muzzle, locked onto the target’s body.
unit.target: Globulus, luce stellae micans, e rostro exiit, corpus obiectum destinans.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian’s shadow came to life and flipped upward.
unit.target: Paene simul, umbra Lumiani vivificata est et surrexit.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crack!

unit.source: The black shadow shattered like a mirror. Along with the starlight, it caved in and was obliterated.
unit.target: Umbra nigra quasi speculum confracta est; una cum luce stellari cecidit et evanuit.

unit.source: After briefly disappearing, Lumian materialized behind the ambusher and harrumphed once more.
unit.target: Postquam breviter evanuit, Lumian post impostorem emersit et iterum fremivit.

unit.source: He had used Shadow Animation in time, and the shadow had triggered Franca’s Mirror Substitution!
unit.target: Tempestive, umbrae animatio usus erat, et umbra substitutionem speculi Francae excitaverat!

unit.source: This was why Lumian had Franca infiltrate the villa and stay outside. Relying on Mirror Substitution required maintaining a certain distance.
unit.target: Hinc cur Lumian Francam ad villam incursare et extra manere decreverit; fidere in substitutione speculi postulabat ut certa distantia servaretur.

unit.source: It turned out his shadow could also share Mirror Substitution!
unit.target: Invenitur quod umbra eius etiam substitutionem speculi participare possit!

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot out, causing the ambusher to close his eyes again.
unit.target: Duo radii lucis albae exierunt, facientes ut impostor oculos iterum claudere coegeretur.

unit.source: This time, Lumian didn’t give the enemy a chance to quickly wake up. He extended his right foot and blocked the enemy, preventing him from falling.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian hosti occasionem celeriter evigilandi non dedit. Dextrum pedem extendit et hostem obstruxit, ne caderet.

unit.source: Simultaneously, he drew his revolver and pressed it against the target’s forehead.
unit.target: Simul, revolver suum extraxit et in fronte obiecti appoinevit.

unit.source: The ambusher’s eyes darted around, and he awoke to the terrifying pressure emanating from the muzzle.
unit.target: Oculi impostoris circumspiciebantur, et ille ad terribilem pressionem a rostro provenientem evigilavit.

unit.source: He forced a smile, handed over his revolver, and whispered, “I’ll give this to you. Can you let me go?”
unit.target: Risum compellens, revolver suum tradidit, et sussurravit: “Hoc tibi dabo. Potesne me dimittere?”

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he took the revolver and nodded. “Okay.”
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani adcurrerunt, dum revolver accipiebat atque annuit: “Bene.”

unit.source: He then holstered his revolver.
unit.target: Deinde revolver suum recondidit.

unit.source: The ambusher maintained a humble and ingratiating smile as he turned around and walked deeper into the dark tunnel.
unit.target: Impostor risum humilem et complacentem retinuit, dum se vertit et in cuniculum tenebrosum profundius ambulabat.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian heard Termiboros’s magnificent voice.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian vocem magnificentam Termiboros audivit.

unit.source: “It’s best not to let him go.”
unit.target: “Optime est ne eum dimitteris.”

unit.source: Uh… Lumian’s eyes narrowed as he instantly sensed something was off.
unit.target: Uh… Oculi Lumiani contrarii facti sunt, cum statim sensissent aliquid non esse rectum.

unit.source: Why did I agree to that deal just now?
unit.target: Cur hanc conventionem modo consensus sum?

unit.source: Why would I let him go?
unit.target: Cur eum dimitterem?

unit.source: Chapter 713: Between White and Black
unit.target: Capitulum 713: Inter album et nigrum

unit.source: Warned by Termiboros, Lumian sensed something was off.
unit.target: Monitus a Termiboro, Lumian sensit aliquid non esse rectum.

unit.source: The ambusher was slowly making his exit, as if concerned that moving too fast would prematurely alert Lumian to the abnormality.
unit.target: Insidiator lente exibat, quasi sollicitus esset ne nimis celeriter moveretur ut Lumian de inopinata anomalia praepropere certiorem fieret.

unit.source: Strangely, no massive vortex emerged from the dark, empty tunnel’s depths, stopping the ambusher, who had already gone in, from getting pulled into another mirror.
unit.target: Mira re, nullus ingens vortice ex obscuris et vacua cuniculorum profundis emergit, ita impediens insidiatorem – qui iam intraverat – ne in alium speculum traheret.

unit.source: As he watched him go, Lumian glanced at his restored shadow, put away the brass revolver taken from the enemy, and pulled out the Flog boxing gloves from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Spectans eum abire, Lumian umbram restitutam aspexit, revolverum aeneum ab hoste captum deposuit, et manicas pugilisticas Flog e sacculo viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: He put them on at a measured pace.
unit.target: Manicas induit gradatim.

unit.source: A moment later, blazing white flames engulfed Lumian’s body as he transformed into a fiery spear that hurtled towards the ambusher’s back.
unit.target: Momento post, candidae flammae fulgentes corpus Lumiani voraverunt, dum se in hastam ignifera vertit, quae versus dorsum insidiatoris celeriter volabat.

unit.source: The ambusher’s fears came to pass.
unit.target: Timores insidiatoris evenere.

unit.source: He quickly evaded, ready to turn into a shadow and escape into the dark tunnel’s depths with five decoys.
unit.target: Celeriter effugit, paratus ut in umbram se converteret atque cum quinque simulacris in tenebrosas cuniculorum profunditates confugeretur.

unit.source: Then he would trigger Mirror Traversal and get away entirely, returning to a pre‐selected mirror.
unit.target: Tum excitabit Transitus Speculi et omnino evadere poterit, revertens ad speculum praeordinatum.

unit.source: Just then, as the flames making up the burning white spear dissipated, Lumian appeared.
unit.target: Ipsum momento, dum flammae, quae hastam ignis albae efficiebant, dissipatae erant, Lumian apparuit.

unit.source: The ambusher’s shadow came alive, ensnaring the body that hadn’t fully transformed into a shadow, briefly keeping it from dividing into six separate forms.
unit.target: Umbra insidiatoris animata est, involvens corpus quod non plene in umbram conversum erat, tempore brevi impediens ut in sex formas separatas divideretur.

unit.source: It was forced to remain in place.
unit.target: Id coactus est manere in loco.

unit.source: Lumian advanced and dashed in front of the terrified ambusher.
unit.target: Lumian processit et subito ante insidiatorem territum se contulit.

unit.source: He alternated punches, starting the Flogging.
unit.target: Ictus alternavit, incipiens pugnam Flog.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s initial punch heightened the ambusher’s fear, and the target narrowly freed himself from his shadow’s entanglement.
unit.target: Primus ictus Lumiani auxit timorem insidiatoris, et ille vix se ex vinculis umbrae suae liberavit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s next punch instantly set off the enemy’s already tense fear.
unit.target: Proximus ictus Lumiani statim excitavit iam tensum timorem hostis.

unit.source: This wasn’t chance; the ambusher’s fear clearly exceeded normal levels in this situation.
unit.target: Hoc non erat fortuitum; timor insidiatoris clare excedebat limites normales in hoc casu.

unit.source: Lumian, his eyes silver-black, foresaw the corresponding future and exploited this vulnerability.
unit.target: Lumian, oculis argenteo-nigris, praevidebat futurum congruum et hanc infirmitatem opportunitate adhibuit.

unit.source: Fear played out in his mind as he punched.
unit.target: Timor in mente eius manifesta erat, dum percutiebat.

unit.source: Thus, the first punch worsened the situation, and the second significantly raised the odds, successfully triggering the fear.
unit.target: Ita primus ictus rem peioravit, et secundus probabilitates significanter augebat, timorem feliciter provocans.

unit.source: The ambusher went rigid, heart briefly ceasing from the detonating fear.
unit.target: Insidiator rigide evasit; cor eius paulisper ex detonante timore cessavit.

unit.source: His mind blanked, and blood poured from his nose.
unit.target: Mens eius vacuit, et sanguis ex naso effusus est.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian took out the ritual sheepskin from his Traveler’s Bag and threw it over the ambusher’s head.
unit.target: Videns haec, Lumian ex sacculo viatoris pelle ovina rituali extraxit et super caput insidiatoris iecit.

unit.source: Right after, he spoke the activation incantation in Hermes: “Sheep!”
unit.target: Deinde verba incantationis activationis in sermone Hermetico pronuntiavit: “Ovis!”

unit.source: Amid a dark flash, the ambusher turned into a sheep with light white and gray wool.
unit.target: Inter obscurum fulgor, insidiator in ovem versa est, quae lana levis, alba et cana habebat.

unit.source: Lumian stared at the fearful sheep with bloodshot eyes.
unit.target: Lumian oculis sanguineis infusis ad ovem territam intuerebat.

unit.source: Removing the Flog boxing gloves and returning them to his Traveler’s Bag, he grinned and said, “So, you think I’ll release you for a measly gun?”
unit.target: Manicas pugilisticas Flog deponens et eas ad sacculus viatoris redigens, subridens dixit: “Itane putas me te liberaturum esse ob vilissimum tormentum?”

unit.source: Lumian then stooped down, scooped up the limp sheep, and went back to the mirror in Moran Avigny’s study, trying to exit.
unit.target: Lumian deinde se inclinavit, ovem mollem arripuit, et ad speculum in studiis Moran Avigny rediit, exitum quaerens.

unit.source: Unable to enter or leave mirrors, he wasn’t certain he could depart so simply.
unit.target: Non potiens specula intrare aut exire, non certo habebat se tam facile discedere posse.

unit.source: If not, he would utilize the pre-prepared Mirror Mark and Spirit World Traversal to go directly to the unique, permanent mirror world exit in Underground Trier.
unit.target: Si non, adhiberet Notam Speculi praeparatam et Transitum Mundi Spiritus ut directe perveniret ad exitum unicum et permanentem mundi speculi in Trier subterraneo.

unit.source: Then he would teleport to locate Franca.
unit.target: Tum se translocabit ad Francam inveniendam.

unit.source: This would avert any issues behind the mirror.
unit.target: Hoc vitaret quaestiones, quae post speculum oriri possent.

unit.source: Lumian’s vision faded and brightened as he emerged in Moran Avigny’s study with the frightened sheep.
unit.target: Visio Lumiani obscurata atque iterum illustrata est, dum in studiis Moran Avigny cum ovibus territis apparuit.

unit.source: He rushed to the window and warily opened it.
unit.target: Festinans ad fenestram accessit et caute eam aperuit.

unit.source: Sure enough, Franca had exited the shadows and waited by the small windowsill.
unit.target: Certe, Franca umbras exierat et iuxta parvum limen fenestrae exspectabat.

unit.source: Realizing Lumian’s Mirror Substitution had shattered, Franca quickly chose to investigate and check if her partner required aid.
unit.target: Intellegens substitutionem speculi Lumiani fractam esse, Franca celeriter decrevit investigare atque perscrutari num socius eius auxilio egisset.

unit.source: "You okay?” Franca whispered.
unit.target: "Esne bene?" Franca susurravit.

unit.source: “We’ll discuss it later.” Lumian threw her the sheep.
unit.target: "Postea de hoc loquemur," Lumian ovem ei iecit.

unit.source: Franca promptly caught the sheep and vanished into the shadows with it.
unit.target: Franca statim ovem arripuit et cum ea in umbras evanuit.

unit.source: In no rush to go, Lumian donned gloves and took care of the various traces he had left behind.
unit.target: Non festinans, Lumian manicas induit et de variis vestigiis, quae reliquerat, curam tulit.

unit.source: Soon, Franca returned, using the Primordial Demoness figurine, her mirror, and Demoness black magic to handle the anti-divination and anti-prophecy part.
unit.target: Mox Franca rediit, utens statuetta daemonissae primordialis, speculo suo, et magica nigra daemonissae ad tractandum partem adversam divinationis et prophetiae.

unit.source: In an abandoned tunnel close to the permanent mirror world entrance in Underground Trier,
unit.target: In cuniculo deserto prope aditum permanentem mundi speculi in Trier subterraneo,

unit.source: Franca, now fully briefed by Lumian, eyed the quivering sheep and said eagerly, “How should we question it? Should I ready a mechanical typewriter like last time?
unit.target: Franca, nunc a Lumiano plene instructa, ovem trementem intuerebat et avidē dixit: "Quomodo eam interrogabimus? Parare ne typographum mechanicum, sicut prius?"

unit.source: “But we’ve run out of truth serum.”
unit.target: "Sed serum veritatis exhaustum est."

unit.source: Anthony, sans gold-rimmed glasses and back in veteran garb, gazed at the sheep for a couple seconds before responding, “I’ll talk with him.”
unit.target: Anthony, sine speculis aureis et in habitu veterano, ovem per paucos momentos intuebatur antequam respondit: "Cum eo loquar."

unit.source: “Should we step out first?” Jenna asked out of caution.
unit.target: "Exire primum debemus?" Jenna propter cautelam interrogavit.

unit.source: Anthony agreed with a nod.
unit.target: Anthony capite annuit.

unit.source: “I don’t mind you observing, but he’ll feel more at ease with less people, facilitating communication.”
unit.target: "Non mihi molestum est te observare, sed ille magis quietus erit cum paucioribus, quod communicationem faciliorem reddet."

unit.source: Concerned our attendance will scare him and impact the Hypnotism?
unit.target: "Curasne, ne praesentia nostra illum terret et processus hypnosi afficiat?"

unit.source: Lumian spun around pensively and exited the sealed dark tunnel alongside Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Lumian, meditabundus circumvagans, exiit e cuniculo obscuro clauso cum Franca et Jenna.

unit.source: Soon, the sheep appeared with Anthony, no longer as scared and nervous.
unit.target: Mox, ovis cum Anthony apparuit, non iam tam territus et anxius.

unit.source: “You may cancel the Animal Creation Spell,” Anthony told Lumian, smiling. “He realizes we’re acting in his best interest and wishes to assist. Provided we avoid topics that will impact his faith in a deity and directly affect his life, he’ll speak honestly and amiably.”
unit.target: "Licet incantationem creationis animalium revocare," Anthony Lumiano dixit subridens, "intellegit nos in eius utilitatem agere atque ei auxiliari velle. Dummodo argumenta, quae fidem eius in deum afficiant et vitam ejus directe intingant, vitemus, ille sincere et amabiliter loquetur."

unit.source: The sheep nodded gravely, confirming Anthony’s words.
unit.target: Ovis graviter annuit, verba Antonii confirmans.

unit.source: Lumian faced Franca and Jenna, seeing matching emotions in their eyes.
unit.target: Lumian ad Francam et Jennam conversus, eorum oculis similes passiones intuemurens.

unit.source: A Hypnotist is truly terrifying!
unit.target: Hypnotista vere terribilis est!

unit.source: A Spectator is truly terrifying!
unit.target: Spectator vere terribilis est!

unit.source: Indeed… Lumian reflected inwardly.
unit.target: Revera… Lumian introspexit.

unit.source: Looking at the sheep, he uttered the Hermes incantation: “His Grace.”
unit.target: Ovum intuens, verba incantationis in lingua Hermetica edixit: "Eius Gratia!"

unit.source: With a dark flicker, the sheepskin automatically vanished, and the ambusher materialized before Lumian and the others, half-crouched.
unit.target: Ob obscurum micare, pelle ovina automatice evanuit, et insidiator ante Luminum atque ceteros dimidio flexus apparuit.

unit.source: Putting away the sheepskin, Lumian inquired with a smile, “What’s your name?”
unit.target: Pelle ovinam deponens, Lumian subridens rogavit: "Quod nomen tibi est?"

unit.source: “Jebus Lata,” the ambusher answered nonchalantly, like talking to a buddy.
unit.target: "Jebus Lata," insidiator nonchalo respondit, quasi cum amico loqueretur.

unit.source: Holding the carbide lamp, Lumian warmly asked, “Were you guarding Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: Lampadem carbidam tenens, Lumian calide quaesivit: "Moran Avigny custodiebasne?"

unit.source: “Yes,” Jebus Lata replied frankly. “Mainly to conceal myself behind the mirror and watch the outside. Also to prevent mirror world mishaps and ensure Moran Avigny isn’t found out and ambushed when he uses it to do specific things in various locations.”
unit.target: "Ita," aperte respondit Jebus Lata, "praesertim ut me post speculum celarem et extra observarem; item ut casus in mundo speculi prohiberentur et ut Moran Avigny non detegatur atque insidiatus sit, cum ea ad opera specifica in diversis locis utatur."

unit.source: Security is fairly tight. No clear weak points…
unit.target: Securitas satis stricta est. Nulla vulnera perspicua sunt…

unit.source: Franca muttered, taking the lead in displaying her Demoness of Pleasure charm.
unit.target: Franca submurmuravit, praebeens fascinum daemonissae Voluptatis.

unit.source: Grinning, she asked, “Which organization do you belong to?”
unit.target: Subridens, interrogavit: "Ad quam societatem pertines?"

unit.source: Jebus’s eyes were drawn to Franca as he reflexively answered,
unit.target: Ipsi oculi Jebus ad Francam attraxi sunt, et reflexe respondit:

unit.source: “The School of Truth.”
unit.target: "Schola Veritatis."

unit.source: “Truth?” Lumian arched an eyebrow.
unit.target: "Veritas?" Lumian supercilium sublevavit.

unit.source: Jebus didn’t face him, gaze flitting between the two Demonesses.
unit.target: Jebus ad eum non conversus est, oculis inter duas daemonissas volitans.

unit.source: “Yes, Truth.”
unit.target: "Ita, Veritas."

unit.source: Growing serious, he addressed Franca and Jenna in a proselytizing tone, “What do you believe this world’s backdrop is?
unit.target: Gravius consequens, ad Francam et Jennam in tono conversionis dixit: "Quid creditis esse fundamentum huius mundi?

unit.source: Without waiting for the Demonesses’ response, he continued, “It’s not white or black. Not light or darkness.
unit.target: Sine daemonissarum responsione exspectare, continuavit: "Non est album aut nigrum. Non est lux aut tenebra.

unit.source: “It’s the gray between white and black, the mist between light and darkness.
unit.target: Est griseum inter album et nigrum, nebula inter lucem et tenebras.

unit.source: It’s shadows, flux, and chaos!”
unit.target: Est umbra, fluxus, et chaos!

unit.source: Traits of the corresponding pathway? Well-versed in mysticism, Lumian thoughtfully switched gears.
unit.target: Qualia sint lineamenta itineris correspondentis? Peritus in mysteriis, Lumian meditabundus cursum mutavit.

unit.source: “Are you aware of Moran Avigny’s identity?”
unit.target: "Novistine identitatem Moran Avigny?"

unit.source: This was their top priority now.
unit.target: Hoc nunc erat eorum praecipuum propositum.

unit.source: Jebus nodded casually, as if conversing with a friend.
unit.target: Jebus leviter annuit, quasi cum amico colloqueretur.

unit.source: “I am. He’s part of the Tamara family but was swapped with a Mirror Person from Underground Trier.”
unit.target: "Ego sum. Pars est familiae Tamarae, sed commutatus est cum Persona Specularis ex Trier subterraneo."

unit.source: “Then why collaborate with him still?” Franca probed.
unit.target: "Cur ergo adhuc cum eo cooperaris?" Franca interrogavit.

unit.source: Jebus chuckled.
unit.target: Jebus subridens iocose respondit:

unit.source: “Didn't I just say?
unit.target: "Nonne modo dixi?

unit.source: This world’s backdrop isn’t white or black, but gray. If cooperating with Mirror People lets me reach my aim, why not?”
unit.target: "Scaena huius mundi non est album aut nigrum, sed cinerea. Si cooperatio cum Personis Specularibus mihi finem attingere sinit, cur non?"

unit.source: “What’s the School of Truth after?” Lumian swiftly queried.
unit.target: "Quid quaerit Schola Veritatis?" Lumian celeriter interrogavit.

unit.source: Jebus peered at Franca’s face and lake-blue eyes, stating, “We seek to leverage Moran Avigny and other elites to slowly seize control of Intis’s government, letting this nation have order yet shadows, plus a conduit for ordered communication and shadows.
unit.target: Jebus vultum Francae et oculos eius lacustres intuerebat, dicens: "Propositum nostrum est, ut per Moran Avigny et alios electos, paulatim gubernationem Intis occupemus, concedendo huic nationi ordinem sed simul umbras, atque etiam canalem communicationis ordinatae et umbrarum."

unit.source: “We honor the law, but that won’t stop us from uncovering legal loopholes and employing select methods to settle matters pre-litigation.
unit.target: "Legem colimus, sed id nos non prohibebit ut hiatus legales detegamus et modos selectos ad res ante iudicium componendas adhibeamur.

unit.source: “That’s our ideology.”
unit.target: "Haec est nostra ideologia."

unit.source: Jebus seemed to preach to the Demonesses.
unit.target: Jebus videbatur daemonissis praedicare.

unit.source: How ambitious… Jenna sighed inwardly.
unit.target: Quam ambitiosa… Jenna intime suspiravit.

unit.source: Smiling, Lumian asked, “Why control the government?”
unit.target: Subridens, Lumian rogavit: "Cur gubernationem moderari?"

unit.source: “To practice and near the truth, a rite to please it,” Jebus responded fanatically.
unit.target: "Ad veritatem exerciendam et ad eam appropinquantem, ritus ad eam placandam," inquit Jebus fanaticus.

unit.source: “Plus, we must use Intis’s government and others to locate three things.”
unit.target: "Praeterea, debemus gubernationem Intis et cetera adhibere ut tres res inveniamus."

unit.source: “What three?” Franca inquired curiously.
unit.target: "Quae tres?" Franca curiose quaesivit.

unit.source: Jebus gladly obliged her.
unit.target: Jebus libenter respondit.

unit.source: “One, clues to fallen heaven. It’s in the underground ancient sealed city. Only by controlling Intis’s government can we fully unseal it.”
unit.target: "Unum, indicia caeli lapsi. Ea in antiqua urbe subterranea clausa est. Tantum gubernatione Intis eam plene aperire possumus."

unit.source: Fallen heaven… What’s that? Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony shared looks, realizing none had heard the term.
unit.target: "Caelum lapsum… Quid hoc significat? Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony oculos inter se commutaverunt, intellegentes neminem hanc vocem audivisse."

unit.source: Jebus went on, “Two, Roselle’s final mausoleum.”
unit.target: Jebus deinde dixit: "Duo, mausoleum ultimum Roselle."

unit.source: Emperor Roselle’s mausoleum? Lumian’s pupils widened.
unit.target: "Mausoleum imperatoris Roselle?" Pupillae Lumiani dilatatae sunt.

unit.source: Franca asked eagerly, “Got any clues?”
unit.target: Franca avidē interrogavit: "Habesne indicia?"

unit.source: “I don’t know.” Jebus shook his head honestly. “At minimum, I’ve got zero leads on Roselle’s tomb. No idea if the Overseers have found anything.”
unit.target: "‘Nescio,’ Jebus sincero animo caput movebat, 'ad minus nihil indicum de sepulcro Roselle habeo. Nescio num Inspectores quid invenerint.'"

unit.source: Overseer… Lumian and the rest committed the title to memory.
unit.target: "Inspectores…," Lumian et ceteri titulum in memoria retinuerunt.

unit.source: Jebus glanced from Franca to Jenna, then back to Franca.
unit.target: Jebus a Franca ad Jennam deinde iterum ad Francam respexit.

unit.source: “Three, a lamp. The Magic Wishing Lamp.”
unit.target: "Tria, lampas. Lampas Votaria Magica."

unit.source: Magic Wishing Lamp? Lumian checked Franca, seeing the Demoness of Pleasure also looked blank.
unit.target: "Lampas Votaria Magica?" Lumian Francam aspexit, et notavit Demonissam Voluptatis quoque videri vacuam.

unit.source: Smiling, Jebus added with a showy air, “The Magic Wishing Lamp is a Sealed Artifact.. Its number is: 0-05!”
unit.target: Subridens, Jebus pomposo animo addidit: "Lampas Votaria Magica est artefactum clausum. Numerus eius est: 0-05!"

unit.source: Chapter 714: The Fractured Tamara Family
unit.target: Capitulum 714: Familia Tamara Confracta

unit.source: Jebus eagerly observed Franca and Jenna after mentioning 0-05, hoping to witness expressions of shock and terror on their faces.
unit.target: Jebus Francam et Jennam aviditer observavit postquam 0-05 commemoravit, sperans videre vultus eorum stupefactos et territos.

unit.source: Considering the immense power demonstrated by this Beyonder team, they surely grasped the gravity of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact!
unit.target: Considerata ingenti potentia quam hic manipulus Beyonder ostendit, certe intellexerunt gravitatem Artefacti Sigillati Gradus 0.

unit.source: It was a horrifying object capable of obliterating not just Trier, but potentially the whole world!
unit.target: Erat obiectum horrendum, quod non solum Trier, sed etiam totum orbem delere poterat.

unit.source: The higher the serial number of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, the more dangerous it would be.
unit.target: Quanto altior numerus serialis Artefacti Sigillati Gradus 0, tanto periculosior esset.

unit.source: And now, they were talking about 0-05!
unit.target: Et nunc, de 0-05 loquebantur!

unit.source: While Franca and Jenna were intrigued and surprised, their reaction didn’t match Jebus’s expectations.
unit.target: Dum Franca et Jenna miratae atque obstupuerunt, eorum reactio non conveniebat cum exspectationibus Jebusi.

unit.source: Instead of responding to Jebus, they turned their attention to Lumian.
unit.target: Pro responso ad Jebum, illi animos ad Luminum converterunt.

unit.source: Despite not having seen or dared to read the details, they had learned from Lumian that Ludwig, the monstrous child, had “stolen” Sealed Artifact information from the Church of Knowledge and given it to Lumian as payment for a deal.
unit.target: Quamquam singula nec vidissent nec ausi essent legere, ex Luminum didicerunt Ludovicum, puer monstrum, notitias de Artefacto Sigillato ab Ecclesia Scientiae “subripuisse” atque illas Lumiano pro solutione tradidisse.

unit.source: The information pertained to 0-01!
unit.target: Notitia ad 0-01 attinebat!

unit.source: 0-05? Lumian raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: “0-05?” Luminum unam supercilium elevavit.

unit.source: To his knowledge, Sealed Artifacts probably didn’t have serial numbers in ancient times.
unit.target: Secundum scientiam eius, artefacta sigillata fortasse in temporibus antiquis numeros seriales non habebant.

unit.source: Even if they did, they were individual actions of different Churches.
unit.target: Etiam si habuerunt, haec erant casus singulares diversarum Ecclesiarum.

unit.source: It wasn’t until the end of the Fourth Epoch or the beginning of the Fifth Epoch that the seven ruling Churches established the current Sealed Artifact classification rules and numbered the ones under their control.
unit.target: Non ante finem Quartae Epochae aut initium Quintae Epochae septem Ecclesiae regantes regulas classificationis Artefacti Sigillati currentis constituerunt et ea, quae sub eorum potestate erant, numeraverunt.

unit.source: Among them, due to the immense danger posed by Grade 0 and Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, the orthodox Churches had agreed to share general information with each other and unify their serial numbers without duplicates.
unit.target: Inter illas, propter ingentem periculum ab Artefactis Sigillatis Gradus 0 et Gradus 1, Ecclesiae orthodoxae concesserunt ut informationes generales inter se communiquerent atque numeros seriales sine duplicatis unificarent.

unit.source: In other words, it was impossible for both the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the Evernight Goddess Church to possess a 0-05 Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Id est, impossibile erat ut et Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammae et Ecclesia Deae Perpetuae Noctis artefactum sigillatam 0-05 haberent.

unit.source: In the entire world, only the Magic Wishing Lamp could be called 0-05!
unit.target: In toto orbe, sola Lampada Magica Votiva appellari poterat 0-05!

unit.source: When the seven Churches first numbered their Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, they undoubtedly ranked them according to the level of danger, time of appearance, and intrinsic uniqueness.
unit.target: Cum septem Ecclesiae primum Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0 numeraverunt, sine dubio ea ordinaverunt secundum gradum periculi, tempus apparentiae, et propriam unicitatem.

unit.source: Subsequent acquisitions would be named in the order they were sealed.
unit.target: Acquisita subsequentia nominabantur ordine quo sigillata erant.

unit.source: This way, there was a high likelihood that the dozens of Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts at the top of the list would adhere to posing greater danger and having greater uniqueness the lower the serial number.
unit.target: Hoc modo, alta probabilitas erat ut plura Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0 in summa indice, quo numerus serialis minor esset, maiora pericula et singularitatem exhiberent.

unit.source: For 0-05 to be ranked fifth among the countless Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts spoke volumes about its terrifying power and significance!
unit.target: Quod 0-05 quinta ordo esset inter innumerabilia Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0, multa de eius terribili potentia atque significatione narrabat!

unit.source: Of course, based on these rules, the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts with the lowest serial numbers might not necessarily be weaker than those with higher serial numbers.
unit.target: Certe, secundum has regulas, artefacta sigillata Gradus 0 cum numeris serialibus minimis non necessario minoris potentiae erant quam ea cum numeris serialibus altioribus.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Jebus and said in a relatively calm tone, “0-05? A terrifying item ranked fifth among all Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts?”
unit.target: Lumian Jebum aspexit et, voce relative tranquilla, dixit: “0-05? Res terribilis, quinta ordinata inter omnia Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0?”

unit.source: “Indeed,” Jebus replied, his desire to show off finally satisfied.
unit.target: “Certe,” respondit Jebus, desiderio ostentationis demum satisfacto.

unit.source: Lumian inquired curiously, “Does its name, Magic Wishing Lamp, imply that you can make wishes with it?”
unit.target: Lumian curiose interrogavit: “Num nomen eius, Lampada Magica Votiva, significat te posse vota facere?”

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian’s heart swelled with anticipation that surpassed his outward expression.
unit.target: Illo momento, cor Lumiani exspectatione effusum est, quae eius externam expressionem superabat.

unit.source: Jebus nodded solemnly.
unit.target: Jebus solemniter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, it can grant the holder any ten wishes.”
unit.target: “Ita, possessori quascumque decem vota concedere potest.”

unit.source: Before Lumian could probe further, Jebus added, “However, as far as I know, the fulfillment of those wishes often takes a distorted form or comes with horrifying consequences.
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian ulterius indagare potuit, Jebus addidit: “Attamen, quantum mihi nota est, effectio istorum votorum saepe formam distortam capit aut secum consequitur horribilibus eventibus.

unit.source: Moreover, none of those who once possessed the divine lamp met a good end.
unit.target: Praeterea, nemo qui olim lampadam divinam habebat, bene finem accepit.

unit.source: Perhaps Roselle Gustav met his demise because of this.
unit.target: Fortasse Roselle Gustav propter hoc mortem subiit.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent upon hearing this revelation.
unit.target: Lumian, hanc revelationem audita, tacuit.

unit.source: Franca glanced at Lumian and asked, “Did 0-05 once belong to Emperor Roselle?”
unit.target: Franca ad Luminum respexit et rogavit: “Num 0-05 olim Imperatori Roselle pertinebat?”

unit.source: Jebus responded without hesitation, “Yes.”
unit.target: Jebus sine dubitatione respondit: “Ita.”

unit.source: Franca inquired with interest, “What about now? Do you have any leads on 0-05’s whereabouts?”
unit.target: Franca, studio affecta, interrogavit: “Quid de nunc? Habesne ullam indiciam de loco ubi 0-05 sit?”

unit.source: Jebus was eager to share what he knew.
unit.target: Jebus cupidus erat ea, quae noverat, communicare.

unit.source: “Yes, it should be with the leader of the secret organization, Element Dawn.
unit.target: “Ita, id debet esse cum duce organisationis secretæ, Element Dawn.

unit.source: “That leader is believed to be Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette.”
unit.target: Iste dux creditur esse filia primogenita Roselle, Bernadetta.

unit.source: “Wow!” Franca exclaimed in admiration and relief, as if the child of an old friend was thriving after the latter’s passing.
unit.target: “O mirum!” exclamavit Franca cum admiratione et solacio, quasi filia antiqui amici post obitum eius floreret.

unit.source: Although she and Lumian had learned after the sea prayer ritual that Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette, was alive and had invented fairytale magic, closely linked to the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card, The Hermit, they were unaware of her precise circumstances.
unit.target: Quamquam illa et Lumian post ritum maritimum orationis didicerunt filiam primogenitam Imperatoris Roselle, Bernadettam, viventem esse et magiam ex fabulis invenerat, arcte coniunctam cum charta Maior Arcana Taroti, “Eremita”, de condicionibus eius exactis nescire.

unit.source: Now, she was pleasantly surprised to discover that Bernadette had become the leader of a secret organization.
unit.target: Nunc laeta est, cum invenit Bernadettam ducem organisationis secretæ factam esse.

unit.source: Franca had long been familiar with Element Dawn.
unit.target: Franca diu Element Dawn cognita erat.

unit.source: She knew they focused on studying mysticism and Beyonder alchemy, opposing another knowledge-seeking secret organization, the Moses Ascetic Order.
unit.target: Sciebat eos studere mystica et alchimia Beyonder, oppositos alteri organisationi secretæ quaesitae scientiae, Ordo Asceticus Moyses.

unit.source: They were primarily active in the Intis region, the south-central zone, and the sea.
unit.target: Praecipue in regione Intis, in zona meridionali centrali, atque in mari actuabant.

unit.source: “It’s only natural for the Emperor’s belongings to be with his eldest daughter,” Lumian remarked, feeling somewhat pleased for Emperor Roselle.
unit.target: “Naturale est ut bona Imperatoris cum filia eius primogenita sint,” Lumian remarkavit, paulo pro Imperatore Roselle laetus.

unit.source: Franca asked Jebus excitedly, “Are you planning to confront Bernadette?”
unit.target: Franca, Jebum excitata, rogavit: “Num Bernadettam oppugnare intendis?”

unit.source: Jebus slowly shook his head.
unit.target: Jebus caput leniter nutavit.

unit.source: “We don’t have the necessary strength yet.
unit.target: Non adhuc vim necessariam habemus.

unit.source: That’s one of the reasons we collaborate with the Mirror People.
unit.target: Hoc est una ex causis cur cum Hominibus Specularibus conlaboramus.

unit.source: “Only by embracing and pleasing the truth can the Overseers obtain more boons to resist Bernadette and her subordinates.”
unit.target: Solum veritatem amplectendo et placendo, Praefecti plura beneficia obtinere possunt ad resistendum Bernadettae et subditis eius.

unit.source: Controlling the government and embracing the truth to varying degrees is a boon-seeking ritual?
unit.target: Regere imperium et veritatem in variis gradibus amplecti, num talis ritus quaerendi beneficiorum est?

unit.source: Yes, Jebus himself mentioned that this is a ritual to please the truth… Their boon‐receiving ritual differs from that of other evil god cults.
unit.target: Ita, ipse Jebus dixit hoc esse ritum ad veritatem placandam… Ritus eorum ad beneficia accipienda differt ab aliis cultibus deorum malignorum.

unit.source: Rather than primarily focusing on blood sacrifices, it emphasizes the influence, utilization, and transformation of order… Lumian summarized a key characteristic of the School of Truth based on Jebus’s words.
unit.target: Potius quam sanguineis sacrificiis praesertim incumbere, extollit vim, usum atque transformationem ordinis… Lumian summatim enuntiavit proprietatem claram Scholae Veritatis ex verbis Jebus.

unit.source: After a moment of contemplation, he asked, “Overseer is both a position and a name? What’s the Sequence equivalent in the potion pathway?”
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, interrogavit: “Praefectus est et officium et nomen? Quid est aequipollens Sequenciae in via potionis?”

unit.source: “Sequence 4, having just attained godhood,” Jebus replied concisely.
unit.target: “Sequencia 4, modo deitatem adeptus,” respondit Jebus concisē.

unit.source: It was unclear whether he was reluctant to disclose such matters or if he simply didn’t know much.
unit.target: Incertum erat utrum haec detegere velle recuserit an simpliciter parum sciret.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “We’ve already grasped your school’s philosophy and objectives.
unit.target: Lumian continuavit: “Iam intelleximus philosophiam et metas scholae tuae.

unit.source: What’s the purpose of the Mirror People?
unit.target: Quid est propositum Hominum Specularium?

unit.source: Jebus pondered for a moment before responding, “They also want to break the seal of the ancient underground city.
unit.target: Jebus paulisper meditatus est antequam respondit: “Volunt etiam sigillum urbis subterraneae antiquae frangere.

unit.source: Only by breaking the seal can they enter the depths of the special mirror world where they originally resided and find something of great importance, but it has nothing to do with us.
unit.target: Non nisi sigillum frangendo possunt inire in profundum specialis mundi specularis, in quo initio habitabant, et aliquid magni momenti invenire, sed ad nos nihil attinet.

unit.source: They’ve been allowing more Mirror People to sneak out and replace the originals.
unit.target: Sinunt plures Hominibus Specularibus clandestine evadere et originales substituere.

unit.source: I’m not sure if they have any other motives.
unit.target: Nescio an alias causas habeant.

unit.source: “Apart from Moran Avigny, which other Mirror People do you know?” Franca didn’t conceal her desire to know the answer.
unit.target: “Praeter Moran Avigny, quos alios Hominos Speculares nosti?” Franca desiderium scire responsum non celavit.

unit.source: Jebus shook his head.
unit.target: Jebus caput iterum nutavit.

unit.source: “Ever since we reached a collaborative agreement with Moran Avigny, he’s had the other Mirror People change their positions and identities.
unit.target: Ex quo cum Moran Avigny pactum fecimus, ille reliquos Hominibus Specularibus suas positiones et identitates mutare fecit.

unit.source: He’s the only one who can contact them.
unit.target: Ille solus est qui eos contingere potest.

unit.source: “How did you discover that Moran Avigny is a Mirror Person?” Lumian sought additional clues.
unit.target: “Quomodo detexisti Moran Avigny esse Hominum Specularium?” Lumian quaestiones additas quaerebat.

unit.source: Jebus chuckled.
unit.target: Jebus subridit.

unit.source: “Our School of Truth was founded with some members of the Tamara family as its core.
unit.target: Schola Veritatis nostra condita est cum quibusdam membris familiae Tamara, nucleum eius constituentes.

unit.source: Several of them had long suspected that something was off with Moran Avigny and other clansmen.
unit.target: Plurimi eorum diu suspicaverunt aliquid esse inordinatum de Moran Avigny et aliis membris clanii.

unit.source: After receiving the truth’s revelation, they confirmed this suspicion.
unit.target: Postquam revelationem veritatis acceperunt, hanc suspicionem confirmaverunt.

unit.source: “Which pathway does Moran Avigny’s original body belong to?” Lumian frowned.
unit.target: “Ad quam viam pertinet corpus originale Moran Avigny?” Lumian frontem contraxit.

unit.source: Jebus didn’t conceal anything for Moran Avigny’s sake.
unit.target: Jebus nihil pro Moran Avigny celavit.

unit.source: “The Judgment pathway. Not only does he possess the power of the Judgment pathway, but he can also wield mirror-related powers.”
unit.target: “Via Iudicii. Non solum vim viae Iudicii possidet, sed etiam potentias speculis conexas exercere potest.”

unit.source: “Are there any members of the Tamara family’s Judgment lineage who don’t follow the truth and aren’t replaced by Mirror People?” Lumian inquired further.
unit.target: “Num sunt membra stirpis Iudicii familiae Tamara, quae veritati non adhaereant nec ab Hominibus Specularibus substituantur?” Lumian ulterius interrogavit.

unit.source: “Yes, they’ve cut ties with our School of Truth and have been trying to deal with us,” Jebus replied truthfully.
unit.target: “Ita, víncula cum Schola Veritatis nostra secserunt et conantur nobiscum agere,” respondit Jebus sincere.

unit.source: Wh— The Tamara family first split into two branches, Judgment and Apprentice.
unit.target: Hem— Familia Tamara primum in duas partes divisit: Iudicii et Discipulorum.

unit.source: Then, the Judgment branch splintered into three parts: those who believe in the truth, those replaced by the Mirror People, and those who adhered to their original traditions…
unit.target: Deinde ramus Iudicii in tres partes divisus est: illi qui veritati credunt, illi qui ab Hominibus Specularibus substituti sunt, et illi qui traditionibus originariis adhaerebant…

unit.source: However, the ones with the connection between the Apprentice branch of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect are more likely to be replaced by the Mirror People.
unit.target: Attamen, illi qui inter ramum Discipulorum familiae Tamara et Sectam Demonissae coniuncti sunt, verisimiliter ab Hominibus Specularibus substituti erunt.

unit.source: Has that branch also fractured?
unit.target: Etiamne ille ramus scissus est?

unit.source: Why is the Tamara family constantly splintering…
unit.target: Cur familia Tamara constanter in partes dividitur…?

unit.source: Even if the Tamara family doesn’t fracture, there’s still the risk of being replaced by the Mirror People?
unit.target: Etiamsi familia Tamara non scindatur, tamen periculum existit ut ab Hominibus Specularibus substituatur?

unit.source: Could this stem from some unresolved mysteries of the Fourth Epoc/i?
unit.target: Potestne hoc ex non resolutis mysteriosis Quartae Epochae provenire?

unit.source: Lumian analyzed and speculated based on the available information.
unit.target: Lumian informationibus praesto datum analysavit atque speculatus est.

unit.source: “What’s Moran Avigny’s approximate Sequence?” Jenna asked, noticing Lumian’s silence.
unit.target: “Quae est Sequencia approximata Moran Avigny?” Jenna interrogavit, silentium Lumiani animadvertens.

unit.source: “Sequence 5,” Jebus answered Jenna’s question with a smile.
unit.target: “Sequencia 5,” respondit Jebus quaestioni Jennae cum risu.

unit.source: Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladin… Franca, under the guidance of Madam Judgment, a Major Arcana card holder, was well-versed in the Arbiter pathway.
unit.target: Sequencia 5: Paladinus Disciplinarius… Franca, sub ductu Dominae Iudicii, possessoris chartae Maior Arcana, in via Arbiter perita erat.

unit.source: Sequence 9 was Arbiter, Sequence 8 was Sheriff, Sequence 7 was Interrogator, and Sequence 6 was Judge.
unit.target: Sequencia 9 erat Arbiter, Sequencia 8 erat Praefectus, Sequencia 7 erat Interrogator, et Sequencia 6 erat Iudex.

unit.source: Disciplinary Paladin with mirror magic and mirror world-related abilities… Lumian looked at Jebus and asked with a smile,
unit.target: Paladinus Disciplinarius, qui magiam specularum atque facultates ad mundum specularum pertinentis habet… Lumian ad Jebum aspexit et, risu, rogavit:

unit.source: “You’re not a Mirror Person or a Demoness.
unit.target: “Non es Hominus Specularis neque Demonissa.

unit.source: Why can you freely enter and exit the mirror world without being affected by the dangers there?
unit.target: Cur libere in mundum specularum ingredi et exire potes, sine periculis ibi affici?

unit.source: Jebus pointed at the glass cufflink on his sleeve.
unit.target: Jebus ad fibulam vitream in manica sua monstravit.

unit.source: “This is an item given to us by Moran Avigny.
unit.target: “Hoc est obiectum nobis a Moran Avigny datum.

unit.source: It allows us to enter and exit the mirror world and use the connections between mirrors to traverse without being absorbed into other mirrors.
unit.target: Id nobis sinit in mundum specularum ingredi et exire, atque nexus inter specula ad iter peragenda uti, sine in alia specula absorbendi.

unit.source: “I can still use it five times.”
