unit.target: “Eam adhuc quinque vicibus uti possum.”

unit.source: Very good.
unit.target: Valde bene.

unit.source: It will be ours in the future… Yes, lets call them Mirror Cufflink..
unit.target: In futuro nostra erunt… Ita, eas “Fibula Specularis” appellabimus.

unit.source: At that moment, Franca had already thought of a name for the cufflink.
unit.target: Illo momento, Franca iam nomen pro fibula cogitaverat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “If your abilities correspond to a potion pathway, what would Sequence 9 be called?”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et respondit: “Si facultates tuae ad viam potionis respondent, quid Sequencia 9 appellabitur?”

unit.source: Given the looming potential conflict with the School of Truth, Lumian didn’t let the opportunity to understand the other party’s Beyonder powers slip away.
unit.target: Ob imminentem conflictum cum Schola Veritatis, Lumian occasionem ad intellegendas potentias Beyonder alterius partis non amittere permisit.

unit.source: A proud smile graced Jebus’s face.
unit.target: Superbus risus vultum Jebus ornabat.

unit.source: “It’s Broker.
unit.target: “Broker est.

unit.source: We are the gray between white and black, the fog between light and darkness.
unit.target: Nos sumus cinerei inter album et nigrum, nebula inter lucem et tenebras.

unit.source: We are the bridge between order and shadows!”
unit.target: Nos sumus pons inter ordinem et umbras!

unit.source: “Could you say something more comprehensible…” Franca muttered under her breath.
unit.target: “Potesne aliquid clarius dicere…” Franca submurmuravit.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and asked without hesitation, “What abilities does Broker possess?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens sine mora interrogavit: “Quae facultates Broker possidet?”

unit.source: 715 Shadow Merchant
unit.target: 715 Mercator Umbrae

unit.source: Jebus reorganized his thoughts and said, “We can become more attuned to certain needs and find suitable candidates to fulfill them.
unit.target: Jebus cogitationes suas disposuit et dixit: “Possumus ad certas necessitates magis accommodari et reperire candidatos idoneos ad eas implendas.

unit.source: We can also facilitate the corresponding transactions through our words and connections.”
unit.target: Praeterea, per verba nostra et nexus, transactiones pertinentes efficere possumus.”

unit.source: With his Conspirer’s mind, Lumian pondered seriously for two seconds before fully grasping Jebus’s true meaning.
unit.target: Mentem Conspiratoris gerens, Lumian serio per duo secundos meditatus est antequam plene sensum verum Jebus intellexit.

unit.source: Amused, he said, “Put it in simpler terms that are closer to mysticism.”
unit.target: Iocose, dixit: “Explica hoc in verbis simplicioribus quae mysticismum propius attingunt.”

unit.source: Jebus glanced at Franca and Jenna and eagerly explained, “I have two primary abilities.
unit.target: Jebus Francam et Jennam intuens et alacriter explicavit: “Duo facultates principales habeo.

unit.source: One is called Gray Perception.
unit.target: Una vocatur Perceptio Cinerea.

unit.source: I can more acutely sense the gray areas between white and black, including my desire and need to enter that gray domain.
unit.target: Possum acutius percipere spatia cinerea inter album et nigrum, incluso desiderio atque necessitate in illud cinereum regnum intrandi.

unit.source: The other is exceptional eloquence.
unit.target: Alterum est eloquentia eximia.

unit.source: This includes mastery of language and the ability to observe others’ expressions and decipher their words.”
unit.target: Haec includit dominatum linguae et facultatem aliorum vultuum expressiones contemplandi atque eorum verba interpretandi.”

unit.source: “That’s it?” Lumian asked, raising his eyebrows.
unit.target: “Sic est?” quaesivit Lumian, supercilia levans.

unit.source: “That’s it,” Jebus replied candidly with a shake of his head.
unit.target: “Sic est,” respondit Jebus candiditer, capite nutante.

unit.source: “Don’t Brokers charge fees for their services?” Lumian inquired with a smile.
unit.target: “Nonne Intermediarii pro officiis suis mercedes exigunt?” inquirivit Lumian cum subrisu.

unit.source: “Before reaching a deal, we will agree on a price with both parties.
unit.target: “Antequam pactum efficiatur, cum utrisque partibus de pretio conveniemus.

unit.source: Sometimes, we don’t even ask for one.
unit.target: Aliquando, ne pretium quidem petimus.

unit.source: It’s mainly to establish and maintain relationships,” Jebus answered seriously.
unit.target: Praecipue ad relationes instaurandas et conservandas pertinet,” respondit Jebus serio.

unit.source: “None of this involves any superpowers.”
unit.target: “Haec omnia non involvunt ullas potentias supernaturales.”

unit.source: I had thought a Broker’s Beyonder powers could derive corresponding benefits from every transaction they facilitate, including Beyonder enhancements.
unit.target: Existimabam potentias Beyonder Intermediarii ex omni transactione, quam facilitamus, utilitates correspondentis adipisci posse, inter quas etiam Beyonder meliorationes contineantur.

unit.source: However, this is clearly an exaggeration.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc plane exaggeratio est.

unit.source: It doesn’t seem to belong to Sequence 9…
unit.target: Non videtur pertinere ad Sequentiam IX…

unit.source: The two abilities Jebus mentioned are very fitting for those at Sequence 9.
unit.target: Duae facultates, quas Jebus enumeravit, valde respondent illis in Sequentia IX.

unit.source: From the looks of it, Brokers and Spectators are quite similar.
unit.target: Ex aspectu, Intermediarii et Spectatores satis similes videntur.

unit.source: They can hardly participate directly in Beyonder battles and are considered more supplementary support…
unit.target: Vix directe in pugnis Beyonder participare possunt, atque ut subsidia complementaria censentur…

unit.source: Lumian nodded in enlightenment.
unit.target: Lumian caput annuit, illustratus.

unit.source: Franca asked with interest, “What’s Sequence 8?”
unit.target: Franca cum studio quaesivit: “Quae est Sequentia VIII?”

unit.source: “It’s Shadow Merchant,” Jebus replied with a smile as he gazed at the Demoness of Pleasure’s face.
unit.target: “Est Mercator Umbrae,” respondit Jebus subrisu, vultum Demonissae Voluptatis contemplans.

unit.source: Without waiting for Franca to inquire further, he took the initiative to explain, “We can detect mysterious creatures and dangerous entities hidden in darkness and shadow while remaining safe from their attacks, thereby allowing us to reach certain deals with them.”
unit.target: Sine expectare ut Franca ulterius quaereret, ipse inchoavit explicare: “Possumus detegere creaturas arcanae et entia periculosa, quae in tenebris et umbra latent, dum a suis ictibus secure remaneamus, quo nobis pacta quaedam cum illis pertingere liceat.”

unit.source: Jenna couldn’t help but ask, “Invulnerable to hidden mysterious creatures and dangerous entities?”
unit.target: Jenna non potuit non quaerere: “Invulnerabilis an es creaturis arcanae et entia periculosa, quae latent?”

unit.source: Isn’t this ability too powerful?
unit.target: Nonne haec facultas nimis potens esse videtur?

unit.source: Jebus replied with a smile, “That’s usually the case, but you can’t attack the other party first or secretly exert any influence that’s disadvantageous to them.
unit.target: Jebus subrisu respondit: “Saepe ita est, sed alteram partem primum oppugnare neque potes nec occulto ullam vim in eorum detrimentum afferre.

unit.source: You can’t harbor malice when striking a deal, lest the other party discovers it.
unit.target: Non licet tibi malitiam fovere dum pactum conficias, ne altera pars eam detegat.

unit.source: Furthermore, you’ll suffer indiscriminate damage if embroiled in a battlefield.
unit.target: Praeterea, si in acie commiscearis, damna indiscriminata tibi incursa erunt.

unit.source: You can’t make creatures engaged in combat stand down.”
unit.target: Creaturas in pugna certantes non potes cohibere ut cessent.”

unit.source: “What if you see something you shouldn’t?” Lumian asked after some thought.
unit.target: “Quid si aliquid vides, quod videre non decet?” quaesivit Lumian post paulum cogitandum.

unit.source: “I will endure the corresponding corruption,” Jebus answered without attempting to boast.
unit.target: “Corrumpitionem correspondentem patiar,” respondit Jebus, sine gloriari conatu.

unit.source: “So it seems a Shadow Merchant possesses an aura that prevents nearby creatures from harboring malice towards them?” Franca realized.
unit.target: “Ita videtur Mercatorem Umbrae auram possidere, quae creaturas proximas a malitia erga eum prohibet?” intellexit Franca.

unit.source: Jebus praised, “Madame, your summary is better than mine.
unit.target: Jebus laudavit: “Domina, tua compendiosa relatio meliore est quam mea.

unit.source: However, it’s not that you don’t generate malice at all, but that you reduce their malice to a certain extent.
unit.target: Sed non est, quod omnino malitiam non generes, sed eam ad aliquem gradum minuas.

unit.source: The higher the other party’s level, the weaker the effect.
unit.target: Quo altior est status alterius partis, eo minuitur effectus.

unit.source: In other words, interacting with those mysterious creatures and dangerous entities to reach a deal is still risky and requires courage.”
unit.target: In aliis verbis, commercia cum creaturis arcanae et entibus periculosis ad pactum efficiendum adhuc sunt periculosa et constantiam requirunt.”

unit.source: At this point, Jebus chuckled.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Jebus subridens cachinnavit.

unit.source: “Taking risks is a necessary quality for successful merchants.”
unit.target: “Pericula suscipere virtus necessaria est mercatoribus prosperis.”

unit.source: “From the looks of it, you embody that?” Lumian deliberately provoked.
unit.target: “Ex speciem, hoc te exprimere videtur?” provocavit Lumian deliberato.

unit.source: “Of course,” Jebus replied proudly.
unit.target: “Certe,” respondit Jebus cum superbia.

unit.source: “I’ve made deals with many dangerous creatures and obtained valuable items.
unit.target: “Pacta cum multis creaturis periculosissimis confeci et res pretiosas adeptus sum.

unit.source: Then, through new deals, I used them to exchange for more useful items from believers of the Great Mother, the Mother Tree of Desire, and other Beyonders.
unit.target: Tum, per nova pacta, ea ab credentibus Magnae Matris, Arboris Desiderii, et aliis Beyonderibus ad res utiliores commutavi.

unit.source: These include bullets that can absorb life, bullets that cause a target’s implosion, and bullets that can impregnate a human, among other things.”
unit.target: Haec includunt globulos, qui vitam absorbere possunt; globulos, qui implosionem obiecti efficiunt; et globulos, qui hominem fecundare possunt, inter alia.”

unit.source: Bullets that can impregnate a human… Lumian was suddenly traumatized.
unit.target: Globuli qui hominem fecundare possunt… Lumian subito turbatus est.

unit.source: He was grateful he hadn’t given Jebus a chance to fire that bullet.
unit.target: Gratus erat quod Jebus occasionem illud globulum emittere non dederat.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna felt an inexplicable fear, their bodies turning cold.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna metum inexplicabilem sentirent, et corpora eorum frigida facta sunt.

unit.source: Even Anthony’s expression shifted slightly.
unit.target: Etiam vultus Anthoni paulum mutatus est.

unit.source: Jebus’s gaze swept across Franca, Jenna, Lumian, and his friend Anthony.
unit.target: Jebus oculos suos percurrit in Francam, Jennam, Luminum, et amicum suum Anthoni.

unit.source: He said solemnly,
unit.target: Dixit sollemniter:

unit.source: “Using our connections with various creatures, we Shadow Merchants can assist you in obtaining anything you desire, as long as you pay a sufficient price.
unit.target: “Per coniunctiones nostras cum variis creaturis, nos Mercatores Umbrae possumus tibi auxilio esse ad omnia optata obtinenda, dummodo pretium idoneum solvas.

unit.source: Of course, we can’t guarantee success in every transaction.”
unit.target: “Certe, non possumus in omni transactione certitudinem successus praestare.”

unit.source: “I want the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway,” Lumian said with a smile.
unit.target: “Formula potionis Sequentiae IV viae Venatoris mihi cupio,” inquit Lumian subrisu.

unit.source: Jebus fell silent for a moment before saying, “It will take an extremely long time to find someone who can provide the corresponding formula through multiple intermediaries.
unit.target: Jebus momentaneum silentium tulit antequam diceret: “Diuturnum erit tempus ad aliquem inveniendum qui per multifarios intermedios formulam correspondentem praebere valeat.

unit.source: “The one who ultimately makes the deal with you might even pose a danger to you.”
unit.target: “Qui denique cum te pacto conficiet, fortasse tibi periculum quidem constituet.”

unit.source: Lumian had only been joking.
unit.target: Lumian solum iocabatur.

unit.source: He deliberately sighed and said, “Then let’s put that aside for now.
unit.target: Ille deliberato suspiravit et dixit: “Ergo hoc pro nunc relinquamus.

unit.source: “What other abilities does a Shadow Merchant possess?
unit.target: “Quae alias facultates Mercator Umbrae possidet?

unit.source: Your abilities can’t be limited to just reducing the malice of surrounding creatures and detecting hidden entities.”
unit.target: Facultates tuae non possunt solum constare in malitiam creaturarum circumstantium minuentibus atque in entia abscondita detegendis.

unit.source: Jebus finally met Lumian’s gaze.
unit.target: Jebus tandem in oculos Luminum conspexit.

unit.source: “I’ve used some of them in my battles with you, including concealing myself in shadows, transforming into a shadow, and creating fake shadows.
unit.target: “Aliquas ex his in certaminibus cum te usus sum, inter quas me in umbris celare, in umbram transformari, et umbras falsas creare.

unit.source: They’re more protective abilities.
unit.target: Haec sunt facultates protectivae.

unit.source: I collectively call them ‘Shadow Utilization.’”
unit.target: Eos universim “Usus Umbrae” appellavi.

unit.source: Franca sighed with emotion.
unit.target: Franca affectu suspiravit.

unit.source: “Shadow Merchants can utilize not only symbolic shadows, but also shadows in reality.”
unit.target: “Mercatores Umbrae non solum umbras symbolicas, sed etiam umbras reales adhibere possunt.”

unit.source: Encouraged, Jebus continued, “We can also sign contracts with the shadows of both parties as witnesses, directly connected to each other’s souls.
unit.target: Fovendus, Jebus perrexit: “Possumus etiam contractus cum umbris utriusque partis signare, ut testes sint, qui animas inter se directe coniungant.

unit.source: If we violate the contract, the shadows will harm our spirits.
unit.target: Si contractum violaverimus, umbrae animos nostros laedebunt.

unit.source: It’s like a powerful curse.”
unit.target: Est quasi maledictum potentem.”

unit.source: “I see…” Franca recalled the fellow she had encountered earlier.
unit.target: “Intelligo…” meminit Franca de viro quem antea convenerat.

unit.source: The man, who also appeared to be a member of the School of Truth, had mentioned that he had a way to ensure the binding power of contracts on both parties.
unit.target: Vir, qui etiam in Schola Veritatis adesse videbatur, dixit se modum habere ut vim obligatam contractuum utrisque partibus assecuraret.

unit.source: “And then?” Jenna pressed.
unit.target: “Et deinde?” quaesivit Jenna.

unit.source: Jebus suddenly felt a little embarrassed.
unit.target: Jebus repente modicum erubuit.

unit.source: He coughed twice and said, “We can also rely on symbolic shadow power to secretly modify key terms the moment the contract is signed, making the other party offer more or less.”
unit.target: Bis tussivit et dixit: “Possumus etiam potestate umbrae symbolicae confidere, qua occulte clausulas fundamentales in momento contracti subsignationis mutare possimus, ut altera pars plus aut minus proferat.”

unit.source: “No wonder…” Franca finally understood how the man suspected of being a member of the School of Truth had deceived her and Jenna.
unit.target: “Non mirum…” tandem intellexit Franca quomodo vir, qui membrum Scholae Veritatis esse suspicabatur, eam et Jennam deciperet.

unit.source: No wonder he had revealed an abnormality once she mentioned divining the contract in advance!
unit.target: Non mirum quod ille anomaliam revelaverit, cum illa praevia divinationem contracti commemoret!

unit.source: Shadow Merchants are well-suited for dealing with Beyonders of the Marauder pathway.
unit.target: Mercatores Umbrae aptissimi sunt in rebus agendis cum Beyonderibus viae Praedatoris.

unit.source: I wonder which side will ultimately suffer…
unit.target: Miror qua pars denique patietur…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t give Franca a chance to criticize the Shadow Merchant.
unit.target: Lumian Francae occasionem non dedit ut Mercatorem Umbrae reprehenderet.

unit.source: He chuckled and questioned, “What about Sequence 7?”
unit.target: Subridens quaesivit: “Quid de Sequentia VII?”

unit.source: “Sequence 7 is Prosecutor,” Jebus introduced, as if trying to compensate for the Shadow Merchant’s dark image.
unit.target: “Sequentia VII est Prosecutor,” inquit Jebus, quasi imaginem obscuram Mercatoris Umbrae compensare conaretur.

unit.source: “A Prosecutor has two abilities.
unit.target: “Prosecutor duas facultates possidet.

unit.source: One allows them to discern a target’s crimes, but they can’t witness the process.
unit.target: Una eos sinit crimina obiecti discernere, sed processum videre non possunt.

unit.source: The other is based on the first ability.
unit.target: Alterum primā facultate innititur.

unit.source: First, declare the other party guilty, then point out the specific crime…”
unit.target: Primum, alteram partem reum declara, deinde crimen specificum designa…

unit.source: Franca turned puzzled.
unit.target: Franca vultum perplexum constituit.

unit.source: “How can this crime be determined?
unit.target: “Quomodo hoc crimen determinari potest?

unit.source: “It can’t be based on Intis law, can it?
unit.target: “Nonne id in legibus Intis fundari non potest?

unit.source: If we meet in the Loen Kingdom, won’t your abilities be useless?
unit.target: Si in Regno Loen conveniamus, num facultates tuae inutiles erunt?

unit.source: “Do they automatically adapt to local laws?”
unit.target: “Num ipsa statim legibus localibus se accommodant?”

unit.source: This seemed to be the first time Jebus had been asked this question.
unit.target: Hoc primum videbatur, cum Jebus hanc quaestionem audivisset.

unit.source: After more than ten seconds of thought, he replied,
unit.target: Post plus quam decem secundis cogitationis, respondit:

unit.source: “It’s likely an act recognized as a crime by most humans.
unit.target: “Verisimiliter actus est, quem plerique homines crimen agnoscunt.

unit.source: It includes blasphemy, murder, rape, fraud, theft, and so on.
unit.target: Includit blasphemia, caedem, stuprum, dolum, furtum, et cetera.

unit.source: Nothing more detailed or categorized.”
unit.target: Nihil magis definitum aut categorice dispositum.

unit.source: Franca remained unconvinced.
unit.target: Franca non convincitur.

unit.source: “That’s not right either.
unit.target: “Id quoque non est rectum.

unit.source: Suppose we enter a ridiculous world where we can do whatever we want, including murder and blasphemy.
unit.target: Supponamus nos in mundum ineptum ingredi, ubi quidquid volumus facere possimus, inter caedem et blasphemia.

unit.source: Wouldn’t that prevent you from declaring the target guilty?”
unit.target: Num id non impediat te alteram partem reum declarare?

unit.source: She was thinking of the recently concluded Dream Festival.
unit.target: Ea de nuper concluso Festo Somniorum cogitabatur.

unit.source: Jebus fell silent for a moment before responding, “I don’t know…”
unit.target: Jebus momentaneum silentium tulit antequam responderet: “Nescio…”

unit.source: “Perhaps the charges stem from something more fundamental,” Lumian speculated.
unit.target: “Fortasse accusationes ex aliquo fundamento oriuntur,” speculavit Lumian.

unit.source: Jebus couldn’t be certain.
unit.target: Jebus certus esse non potuit.

unit.source: Franca could only look at him and say, “Continue.”
unit.target: Franca solum in eum aspicere potuit et dicere: “Perge.”

unit.source: Jebus took a moment to recall where he had left off.
unit.target: Jebus paulisper recordatus est ubi desierat.

unit.source: “After pointing out the crime, the target will receive the corresponding punishment from the world itself or some entity.
unit.target: “Postquam crimen designatum est, obiectum poenam correspondentem a mundo ipso aut aliqua entitate accipiet.

unit.source: The exact punishment depends on the severity of the target’s crime.
unit.target: Poena certa pendet ex severitate crimini obiecti.

unit.source: We can’t know in advance.
unit.target: Non possumus praeviam scire.

unit.source: In short, from my experience, the most terrifying punishments are immediate death and loss of control on the spot.
unit.target: In summa, ex mea experientia, poenae terribilimae sunt mors statim et in loco imperii amissio.

unit.source: “In addition, for ongoing crimes, we can directly declare the target guilty.
unit.target: “Praeterea, pro crimine permanente, obiectum directe reum declarare possumus.

unit.source: There’s no need to specify the charges, effectively saving time.”
unit.target: Non est necesse accusationes enuntiandi, quo tempus efficaciter servetur.”

unit.source: Franca nodded slightly, gaining a new understanding of the battle.
unit.target: Franca parum annuit, novam de proelio intellegentiam capiens.

unit.source: “What language did you use when you announced the charge?” Lumian recalled the corresponding details.
unit.target: “Quae lingua usus es, cum accusationem pronuntiavisti?” meminit Lumian singularia.

unit.source: “It’s the Words of Order.
unit.target: “Sunt Verba Ordinis.

unit.source: I automatically learned it when I received the Prosecutor’s boon,” Jebus confessed.
unit.target: Eam statim didici, cum beneficium Prosecutoris acceperim,” confitebatur Jebus.

unit.source: Lumian offered a curt acknowledgment.
unit.target: Lumian compendiose assentivit.

unit.source: “What about Sequence 6?”
unit.target: “Quid de Sequentia VI?”

unit.source: “It’s the Ambitionist,” Jebus said, his eyes seeming to blaze with flames.
unit.target: “Est Ambitionist,” inquit Jebus, oculis quasi flammas ardentes ostendentibus.

unit.source: “An inexhaustible ambition brings about a powerful physique, keen perception, and outstanding spirituality, driving us to constantly pursue improvements in our combat abilities.
unit.target: “Ambitio inexhausta efficit corpus potentem, sensum acutum, atque spiritualitatem praeclaram, quae nos impellit ut constantiter in facultatibus pugnae nostræ meliorationes quaeramus.

unit.source: And our burning ambitions make us unwilling to rest for a moment.
unit.target: Et ardentes ambitiones nostrae nos impellunt ut neque momentum quietis petamus.

unit.source: Unless we’re prepared to sleep, no one can force us to sleep or faint…”
unit.target: Nisi parati simus ad dormiendum, nemo nos dormire aut evanescere coercebit…

unit.source: “In other words, it can effectively resist being forced into dreams, comas, and other debilitating states?
unit.target: “In aliis verbis, an id efficaciter resit coercitioni in somnia, comas, et alias debilitantes status?

unit.source: Or is it outright immunity?” Lumian immediately understood why Jebus could wake up so quickly when facing the Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: An potius prorsus immunis sit?” statim intellexit Lumian, cur Jebus tam celeriter expergisci posset, cum incantationem “Harrumph” opposerit.

unit.source: “It’s resistance,” Jebus admitted candidly.
unit.target: “Est resistentia,” confitebatur Jebus candiditer.

unit.source: Lumian inquired further about Ambitionists before asking, “You should be at Sequence 5, right?”
unit.target: Lumian de Ambitionistis ulterius interrogavit, deinde quaesivit: “Sequentia V esse debet, nonne?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Jebus puffed out his chest in front of the two Demonesses.
unit.target: “Ita.” Jebus pectus extulit coram duabus Demonissis.

unit.source: Franca asked curiously, “What’s Sequence 5?”
unit.target: Franca curiosa quaesivit: “Quid est Sequentia V?”

unit.source: Jebus replied with a smile, “It’s Under the Table.”
unit.target: Jebus subrisu respondit: “Est Sub Mensa.”

unit.source: Under the Table? Franca, Lumian, and the others simultaneously thought of the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑Table Transaction they had obtained from General Philip.
unit.target: “Sub Mensa?” Franca, Lumian, et ceteri simul meminerunt transactionem “Sub Mensa” a Possessore Auctoritatis, quam ab Generali Philippo obtinerant.

unit.source: Could it be formed by the power of a Sequence 5 boon of the Broker pathway?
unit.target: Possitne ea formari ex potestate beneficii Sequentiae V viae Intermediarii?

unit.source: Lumian gazed at Jebus, in no hurry to comprehend the hidden box’s abilities.
unit.target: Lumian Jebum intuebatur, non festinatus ad facultates arcae absconditae intellegendas.

unit.source: He asked thoughtfully, “What’s your connection to the Carbonari?”
unit.target: Quaesivit meditans: “Quae est tua connexio ad Carbonarios?”

unit.source: 716 Bullets
unit.target: 716 Globuli

unit.source: Jebus, who had been about to explain the meaning of “Under the Table,” was caught off guard.
unit.target: Jebus, qui iam intendebat significationem "Sub Mensa" explicare, insperatus comprehensus est.

unit.source: “We’re putting in a lot of effort to keep the Carbonari in check and have made considerable headway.”
unit.target: "Multum laboramus ut Carbonarios temperemus et ingentem profectum adepti sumus."

unit.source: The School of Truth member chuckled at that.
unit.target: Sodalis Scholae Veritatis huic risu effusus est.

unit.source: “They’re attempting to topple the government and create their own system. That’s precisely the outcome we hope to see.”
unit.target: "Governatio deleatur atque sui systema creetur conantur. Id ipsum est exitus quem speramus videre."

unit.source: Jenna thought Jebus’s words didn’t add up.
unit.target: Jenna censuit verba Jebus non congruere.

unit.source: “But don’t you aim to slowly seize control of the government through high society individuals like Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: "Nonne statuendum agis gubernationem lente capere per homines ex alta societate, ut Moran Avigny?"

unit.source: Jebus laughed and adopted an instructive tone.
unit.target: Jebus risit atque tonum eruditionis assumpsit.

unit.source: “A wise merchant wouldn’t risk everything on a single venture. The same principle applies to exceptional Ambitionists.”
unit.target: "Mercator prudens non totum in unam rem periclitaret. Eiusdem principium Ambitionistis praeclaris valet."

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian abruptly shifted the topic.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian repente rem mutavit.

unit.source: “From what you’ve described, Ambitionists primarily enhance their bodies, perception, and spirituality. It doesn’t appear to involve their intellect?”
unit.target: "Ex his quae dixeris, Ambitionistae praecipue corpora, sensum, et spiritualitatem augent; non videtur tamen intellectum tangere?"

unit.source: Before Jebus could reply, Franca responded with a grin.
unit.target: Priusquam Jebus responderet, Franca subridente respondit.

unit.source: “Who says Ambitionists require intelligence? It’s not the same as being a Conspirer. Ambitionists prioritize ambition over the capability to actually achieve it. Exceptional intelligence isn’t a prerequisite for them. We’ve encountered many foolish ambitionists throughout history.”
unit.target: "Quis ait Ambitionistas intelligentiam requirere? Non idem est ac conspirator esse. Ambitionistae ambitionem potius quam facultatem ad ea perficienda praeferri credunt. Intelligentia praeclara eis non necessaria est. Multos per historiam ineptos Ambitionistas convenerimus."

unit.source: The pair’s back-and-forth left Jebus speechless.
unit.target: Seriatim eorum disputatio Jebum sine verbis reliquit.

unit.source: Fortunately, Lumian didn’t dwell on the subject.
unit.target: Felix, Lumian de re non multum meditatus est.

unit.source: He turned the conversation back to the Carbonari.
unit.target: Colloquium ad Carbonarios redire constituit.

unit.source: “Has Albert Goncourt already sided with you?”
unit.target: "Num Albertus Goncourt iam tibi fautus sit?"

unit.source: “Most likely,” Jebus answered uncertainly.
unit.target: "Maxime verisimile," inquit Jebus incertus.

unit.source: “I don’t handle the Carbonari.”
unit.target: "Carbonarios non administrō."

unit.source: “Was it because of you Brokers that the Dreamseekers charity group formed ties with the Carbonari?” Lumian thought of General Philip.
unit.target: "Num propter vos, Negotiatores, coetus caritatis Dreamseekers cum Carbonari vincula instituit?" cogitavit Lumian de Generali Philippo.

unit.source: Jebus grinned again.
unit.target: Jebus iterum subridens respondit.

unit.source: “Philip was a man with grand aspirations who had long aimed to bring various secret organizations together. As Brokers, Shadow Merchants, and Ambitionists, we definitely had to help him. Regrettably, while his scheme was successful, others took advantage of him. He also disappeared in the ancient underground city. Incidentally, I’m not sure if you know, but it’s actually Fourth Epoch Trier.”
unit.target: "Philip vir magnarum aspirationum erat, qui diu diversa arcana collegiare contendebat. Ut Negotiatores, Mercatores Umbrae, et Ambitionistae, certe eum adiuvare debuimus. Infeliciter, dum consilium eius feliciter perrexit, alii eum exsueverunt. Etiam in antiqua urbe subterranea evanuit. Atqui, nescio num scias, sed revera est Trier, Quartum Aevum."

unit.source: “You guys…”
unit.target: "Vos, amici…"

unit.source: Franca had a thought but kept it to herself. She merely sighed.
unit.target: Franca quid cogitavit sed tacita remansit. Solem suspiravit.

unit.source: Only then did Lumian inquire about Under the Table.
unit.target: Tunc demum Lumian de "Sub Mensa" quaesivit.

unit.source: “What extra capabilities do you gain at Sequence 5?”
unit.target: "Quae facultates additas obtines in Sequentia V?"

unit.source: Jebus kept his eyes fixed on the two Demonesses.
unit.target: Jebus oculos in duabus Daemonessibus ferefixit.

unit.source: “Under the Table is the sole ability, but there are two ways to utilize it:
unit.target: "Sub Mensa sola facultas est, sed duo modi ad eam utendum sunt:

unit.source: The first is to establish an unseen and tranquil Under the Table atmosphere in combat and emergency scenarios.
unit.target: Primum, constituere oportet ambitum "Sub Mensa" invisibilem et quietum in pugna et in casibus emergentibus.

unit.source: You can forcibly meet your demands by offering the enemy valuable items, but you can’t injure them or impact their state in any other way.
unit.target: Exigere potes necessitates tuas vi, hosti pretiosa dona offerendo, sed neque eum laedere neque statum eius aliter afficere potes.

unit.source: Additionally, you must behave normally.
unit.target: Praeterea, se gerere debes more solito.

unit.source: If not, the enemy who ‘agreed’ to the under‐the‐table deal can easily detect that something is amiss and snap out of it.
unit.target: Alioquin, hostis qui pacto "Sub Mensa" consenserit, facile detegere potest aliquid esse non rectum et statim se extrahere.

unit.source: Such Under the Table transactions aren’t guaranteed to work.
unit.target: Talia commercia "Sub Mensa" non semper efficaciter funguntur.

unit.source: The target’s inclination and experience in the gray domain determine the success rate.
unit.target: Inclination et experientia destinatī in regione cinerea gradum successus determinant.

unit.source: The Broker Sequence’s Gray Perception ability can assess this.
unit.target: Facultas "Perceptio Cinerea" in sequentia Negotiatorum hoc aestimare potest.

unit.source: If you’re up against an Unshadowed of the Sun pathway, success is nearly impossible even without the suppression of godhood.
unit.target: Si adversus iter "Solis Nonumbratum" laborabis, successus paene impossibilis est, etiam sine deitatis suppressione.

unit.source: Unshadowed referred to the Sun pathway’s Sequence 4.
unit.target: "Nonumbratum" refertur ad viam Solis in sua quarta sequentia.

unit.source: Lumian had a realization.
unit.target: Lumian repente intellexit.

unit.source: “You previously made me release you through such an Under the Table transaction?”
unit.target: "Num olim me per talem transactionem 'Sub Mensa' te dimittere fecisti?"

unit.source: “Correct,” Jebus said frankly. “You have extensive experience with the gray domain and a strong inclination in that respect.”
unit.target: "Recte," dixerat Jebus aperte. "Amplam experientiam cum regione cinerea atque validam inclinationem in hoc habes."

unit.source: On Lumian’s behalf, Franca complimented Jebus, saying, “You have a talent for reading people!”
unit.target: Pro Luminiano, Franca Jebum laudavit, dicens: "Ingenium ad homines intellegendos tibi est!"

unit.source: “Gray Perception may be an ability acquired as a Sequence 9 Broker, but it’s incredibly useful,” Jebus bragged, seeming objective.
unit.target: "Perceptio Cinerea fortasse facultas est acquisita ut Negotiator in Sequentia IX, sed valde utilis est," iactavit Jebus, videns se obiectivum.

unit.source: Jenna pressed, “And the other Under the Table transaction?”
unit.target: Jenna instavit, "Et altera transactio 'Sub Mensa'?"

unit.source: Jebus answered with a smile, “That requires a certain amount of time. It’s not suitable for combat or emergency situations.”
unit.target: Jebus risu respondit, "Id aliquam temporis quantitatem postulat. Non est aptum ad pugnam aut casus emergentes."

unit.source: In simple terms, we’ll utilize a barely sealed space as the operating target to create a genuine Under the Table scenario.
unit.target: Simpliciter, spatium vix sigillatum ut propositum operandi ad verum casum "Sub Mensa" creandum adhibebimus.

unit.source: We’ll be on one side of the transaction under this table.
unit.target: Nos in una parte transactionis sub hac mensa erimus.

unit.source: The mysterious creature or dangerous entity concealed in the shadows and darkness will be on the other side, but we won’t know their identity beforehand.
unit.target: Mysteriosa creatura aut periculosa entitas in umbris et tenebris abscondita in altera parte erunt, sed eorum identitatem praevius nesciremus.

unit.source: We also won’t be able to sense who the other party is during the transaction.
unit.target: Etiam sentire non poterimus qua altera pars sit per transactionem.

unit.source: It could be an entity we’ve previously dealt with or one from the unknown.
unit.target: Potest esse entitas cum qua antea negociavimus aut ex incognito.

unit.source: Essentially, in this Under the Table state, where you don’t know the counter‐party or how your needs will be fulfilled through the transaction, you can achieve the desired result by stating your request and offering the item the other party desires.
unit.target: Revera, in hoc statu "Sub Mensa", ubi nec contrapartem nosti nec quomodo necessitates tuae per transactionem implebuntur, effectum desideratum assequi potes petitionem tuam enuntiando ac rem quam altera pars cupit offerendo.

unit.source: How this is accomplished isn’t relevant.
unit.target: Modus quo hoc efficiatur non refert.

unit.source: “Can the transaction only involve two parties?”
unit.target: "Possitne transactionem solum duas partes implicare?"

unit.source: “No, it can be a three‐way deal, a four‐way deal, or even more. Just follow the Under the Table transaction rules.”
unit.target: "Non, commercium esse potest triplex, quadruplex, vel etiam pluris. Modo regulas transactionis 'Sub Mensa' sequere."

unit.source: Jebus didn’t hold back on sharing his mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Jebus nulla cunctatione scientiam mysticam communicare retinuit.

unit.source: “The transaction may not succeed either.
unit.target: "Transactio fortasse quoque non succedet.

unit.source: It depends on the task’s difficulty and the limitations of the provided traded items.
unit.target: Dependet ex difficultate muneris atque limitationibus rerum mercandarum praebitarum.

unit.source: Also, don’t assume those mysterious creatures and dangerous entities will honor their promises.
unit.target: Neque putes has mysteriosas creaturas et periculosas entitates suas promissiones observaturas esse.

unit.source: There’s no lack of con artists among them who can find ways to circumvent Under the Table’s restrictions.”
unit.target: Non carent inter eos fallaces qui vias invenire possunt ut restrictiones "Sub Mensa" circumveniant.

unit.source: “Are there additional risks after using Under the Table to complete a particularly challenging task?”
unit.target: "Suntne pericula addita postquam 'Sub Mensa' ad operandum munus praecipue arduum adhibetur?"

unit.source: Jenna thought of her Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
unit.target: Jenna cogitavit de transactione "Sub Mensa" a suo Titulari Auctoritate.

unit.source: Jebus nodded gravely.
unit.target: Jebus graviter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, it depends on which mysterious creature or dangerous entity helped you and if it has malicious intentions.
unit.target: "Ita, dependet ex qua creatura mysteriis aut entitas periculosa te adiuvit, et utrum animo maligno sit.

unit.source: I once had a week of misfortune and was almost caught by the Purifiers.”
unit.target: Olim hebdomadem infelicitatis passa sum, et paene a Purificatoribus comprehensus sum.

unit.source: Jenna nodded pensively and pondered inwardly: It seems the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction is a variant of the standard Under the Table ability.
unit.target: Jenna pensim annuit et interius meditata est: Videtur transactionem "Sub Mensa" a Titulari Auctoritate esse variantem facultatis "Sub Mensa" ordinariae.

unit.source: Instead of the counter‐party making the requests, it’s us offering something valuable.
unit.target: Pro parte qua altera pars petitiones non facit, nos res pretiosas offerimus.

unit.source: However, it can only simplify complex issues and ease difficult ones.
unit.target: Attamen illa solum potest res complexas simplicari et arduas levare.

unit.source: It can’t directly complete tasks.
unit.target: Non poterit munera directe complere.

unit.source: There are significant limitations…
unit.target: Sunt limitationes notabiles…

unit.source: The cost of using it is encountering a transaction involving Demons and other sinister beings…
unit.target: Pretium huius usus est commercium cum Daemoniis aliisque entibus sinistris experiri…

unit.source: “What information do you have about Overseers?”
unit.target: "Quae notitia de Supervisoribus tibi nota est?"

unit.source: Lumian posed a new question when he noticed the Under the Table discussion was nearly over.
unit.target: Lumian quaestionem novam proposuit, cum animadvertit sermonem de "Sub Mensa" prope finem habere.

unit.source: Jebus appeared troubled and didn’t answer.
unit.target: Jebus sollicitus apparuit nec respondit.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian switched topics.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian rem mutavit.

unit.source: “What items are you carrying?”
unit.target: "Quae res geris?"

unit.source: Jebus glanced at Franca and took out a few assorted items from his concealed pocket.
unit.target: Jebus Francam respexit et ex sinu absconso paucas res varias eduxit.

unit.source: “This is a healing agent obtained from the Great Mother’s believers. These are the Coma Gas, Awakening Gas, and Confession Concoction acquired from the Mother Tree of Desire’s followers…”
unit.target: "Hoc est medicamentum sanandum ex fidelibus Magnae Matris adeptum. Hi sunt Gas Comae, Gas Excitandi, et Concoctio Confessionis ab sectatoribus Arboris Matris Desiderii adepti…"

unit.source: Healing agents, sedatives, mysticism smelling salts, and truth serum. These are all precious items…
unit.target: Medicamenta sanantia, sedativa, salis odorati mystici, et serum veritatis. Haec omnia sunt res pretiosae…

unit.source: Lumian gave a small nod at the four metal canisters with various labels.
unit.target: Lumian parvum annuit ad quattuor vasculis metallicis cum variis inscriptionibus.

unit.source: His gaze then moved to Jebus’s other palm, where six bullets rested.
unit.target: Aspectus eius deinde ad alteram manum Jebus convertit, ubi sex globuli reposita erant.

unit.source: The six bullets were brass, but their surface patterns and colors differed.
unit.target: Sex globuli aerei erant, sed figurae superficiales et colores diversae erant.

unit.source: One looked normal, one had a luminous tip, and one appeared to be corroded by potent acid.
unit.target: Unus consuetus videbatur, unus apicem lucentem habebat, et unus potenti acido corrusum videbatur.

unit.source: One flickered with a dark green light, one radiated a brilliant starlight, and another had a faint luster as if it had been matted many times.
unit.target: Unus lumine viridi obscuro micabat, unus splendida luce stellarum fulgebat, et alter tenui nitorem ostendebat, quasi multis vicibus opacatus esset.

unit.source: Jebus introduced them with enthusiasm, “These are the Impregnating Bullet, Poison Bullet, Putrid Bullet, Weakening Bullet, Implosion Bullet, and Deprivation Bullet. I traded for them from various deity believers.”
unit.target: Jebus eos cum ardore introduxit, dicens: "Hi sunt Globulus Impregnans, Globulus Venenosus, Globulus Putridius, Globulus Debilitans, Globulus Implosivus, et Globulus Deprivans. Eos a variis cultoribus deorum per commercium adeptus sum."

unit.source: Intrigued, Franca pointed at the ordinary bullet from a distance. “Is this the Impregnating Bullet?”
unit.target: Curiosa, Franca ab longinquo globulum ordinum indicavit. "Estne hic Globulus Impregnans?"

unit.source: “Indeed. People and animals shot by it will inevitably become pregnant, and the corresponding symptoms will swiftly manifest,” Jebus said, a tinge of fear in his voice.
unit.target: "Certe. Homines et animalia eo icta necessario gravidabuntur, et symptomata consequens celeriter manifesta erunt," inquit Jebus, leviter timore in voce.

unit.source: “It affects both males and females indiscriminately?” Franca inquired.
unit.target: "Num et viros et feminas indiscriminanter afficit?" rogavit Franca.

unit.source: “Yes,” Jebus said with certainty.
unit.target: "Ita," respondit Jebus certo.

unit.source: Huh… Franca made a sound conveying a mix of contempt, fear, and fascination.
unit.target: Heu… Franca sonum edidit, qui contemptum, timorem, et admirationem simul exprimebat.

unit.source: Jenna asked worriedly, “It looks like a regular bullet. What if there’s a mix-up?”
unit.target: Jenna sollicite interrogavit, "Videor esse globulus ordinarius. Quid si confusio oritur?"

unit.source: Jebus shook his head.
unit.target: Jebus caput concussit.

unit.source: “You won’t make that mistake. It’s lightweight, as if made of wood or soil.”
unit.target: "Non errare hoc potes. Levis est, quasi ex ligno aut terra factus fuerit."

unit.source: Phew… Lumian and Anthony let out a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Heu... Lumian et Anthony suspirum levem edierunt.

unit.source: Lumian pointed at the matte bullet.
unit.target: Lumian globulum opacum indicavit.

unit.source: “Is this the Deprivation Bullet? What does it do?”
unit.target: "Estne hic Globulus Deprivans? Quid facit?"

unit.source: The effects of the other bullets seemed straightforward, but Lumian wasn’t sure about the Deprivation Bullet’s purpose.
unit.target: Effectus ceterorum globulorum simplices apparuerunt, sed Lumian de proposito Globuli Deprivantis incertus erat.

unit.source: “Those struck or grazed by it will lose one Beyonder power within fifteen minutes. As for which one, it’s unpredictable,” Jebus answered honestly.
unit.target: "Qui per illud icti vel adlatae erunt, unam potentiam Beyonder intra quindecim minuta amittent. Quod autem, incertum est," respondit Jebus sincero.

unit.source: This can complement a Fate Appropriator’s abilities of designating the Deprivation…
unit.target: Hoc complere potest facultates Fati Appropriatoris in designatione Deprivationis…

unit.source: Lumian appraised Jebus and asked, “Do you have any other items? As a Shadow Merchant, don’t you possess any mystical objects?”
unit.target: Lumian Jebum aestimavit et rogavit, "Habesne alias res? Ut Mercator Umbrae, nonne rerum mysticarum aliquas possides?"

unit.source: Jebus explained embarrassedly, “I recently received the Under the Table boon. To complete the corresponding ritual and please truth, I traded all the items I had acquired, leaving only these.
unit.target: Jebus verecunde explicavit, "Nuper beneficium 'Sub Mensa' accepi. Ad ritum correspondentem perficiendum et veritati placandam, omnes res quas adeptus eram commutavi, relinquens sola haec."

unit.source: “A merchant’s rule is that you can buy and sell anything!”
unit.target: "Regula mercatoris est: quidquid emere et vendere licet!"

unit.source: Poor slob… Franca mocked disappointedly.
unit.target: Pauper stulte... Franca deiecta irriduit.

unit.source: She then said to Jebus, “Give us all these items. They’re the very reason you’ve been repeatedly caught up in danger and deity‐level conflicts. Hand them over, and you’ll be free. Once you’re safe, you can start anew.”
unit.target: Tum Jebum adloquebatur, "Da nobis omnes has res. Ipsae sunt causa cur iterum atque iterum in periculum et ad deorum contentiones incidisti. Tradito eas, et liber eris. Postquam tibi securum fiet, iterum incipere poteris."

unit.source: Similar to Anthony’s hypnotic words, Jebus chose to believe it and gave everything to Franca.
unit.target: Sicut verba hypnotica Antonii, Jebus credere decrevit et omnia Francae tradidit.

unit.source: After Franca stowed away the items, Lumian surveyed the area and asked, “Where is the School of Truth’s headquarters? Which Overseer do you report to?”
unit.target: Postquam Franca res recondidit, Lumian locum perlustrare conatus est et rogavit, "Ubi est praetorium Scholae Veritatis? Cui Supervisori referis?"

unit.source: Hearing these two questions, Jenna, Franca, and Anthony quietly moved to Lumian’s side.
unit.target: His duabus quaestionibus auditis, Jenna, Franca, et Anthony silentio ad Luminianum accesserunt.

unit.source: Jebus hesitated for a few seconds and was about to respond when his expression suddenly twisted.
unit.target: Jebus paucis secundis dubitavit et iam responderet paratus erat, cum vultus eius subito contortus esset.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian immediately said to Franca, “Toss the figurine over!”
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian immediate Francae dixit, "Iace figuram trans!"

unit.source: Franca followed suit.
unit.target: Franca secuta est.

unit.source: She took out the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine from her Traveler’s Bag and threw it to Jebus.
unit.target: Figurinam ossis Daemonissae Primordialis ex sacculo viatoris extraxit et Jebuso iecit.

unit.source: At the same time, she, Anthony, and Jenna grabbed Lumian’s shoulders, arms, and other positions.
unit.target: Simul, illa, Anthony, et Jenna humeros, brachia, et alia Lumiani loca apprehenderunt.

unit.source: In the next instant, the four of them disappeared.
unit.target: In momento secundo, quattuor eorum evanuerunt.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Jebus exploded from the inside out, his shattered flesh merging with the pale‐white fog, transforming into a peculiar blood mist.
unit.target: Jebus ex intus ad foras explosus est, caro eius fracta cum nebula pallide alba miscens, in insolitam sanguinis nebulam transmutata.

unit.source: The blood fog slowly descended, circling the Primordial Demoness’s bone figurine before seeping into the soil.
unit.target: Nebula sanguinea lente descendebat, figuram ossis Daemonissae Primordialis circuitans, antequam in terram infunderetur.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lumian and the others teleported back.
unit.target: Post paucas secundos, Lumian et ceteri iterum apparuerunt.

unit.source: 717 Supervision?
unit.target: 717 Supervisio?

unit.source: 717 Supervision?
unit.target: 717 Supervisio?

unit.source: “Why did he just blow up like that?” Lumian muttered, frowning as he watched the blood slowly soaking into the soil.
unit.target: “Cur ille ita subito erupit?” Lumian submurmuravit, frontem contritum habens dum vidit sanguinem lente in terram imbuiri.

unit.source: He gripped the carbide lamp tightly.
unit.target: Lucernam carbidicam firmiter arripuit.

unit.source: His two questions hadn’t been intended to end Jebus’s life.
unit.target: Duae quaestiones non erant destinatae ad vitam Iebus interficiendam.

unit.source: He had simply wanted to carefully test the limits, one step at a time.
unit.target: Ipse voluit limites caute experiri, unum post unum.

unit.source: Anthony calmly explained, “The fundamental rule of hypnosis is to never directly threaten the subject’s life. So when Jebus was asked something that would seriously endanger him, he either would refuse to answer or the shock would jolt him awake, breaking the hypnotic hold.”
unit.target: Anthony tranquille explicavit: “Regula fundamentalis hypnosi est ut numquam directe vitam subiecti minetur. Ita, cum Iebus aliquis quaesitus esset quo grave periculum ei inferret, aut responsum negare oportebat aut ictus eum excitare ad evigilandum moveret, vinculum hypnosi dissolvens.”

unit.source: “I was ready for the possibility of him breaking free from the hypnosis,” Lumian said, having anticipated this outcome.
unit.target: “Paratus eram ad facultatem ut ex hypnosi vinculis effugeret,” inquit Lumian, hoc eventum praevidens.

unit.source: Jebus couldn’t dodge the Spell of Harrumph at that range.
unit.target: Iebus incantationem “Harrumph” in hoc spatio evadere non potuit.

unit.source: Lumian also had three ritualistic dog skins and a cow hide in his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian etiam tres pelles caninae rituales et unam corium vaccae in sacculo viatoris habebat.

unit.source: Since becoming an Ascetic, he could now craft the mystical animal hides required for the Animal Creation Spell himself.
unit.target: Ex quo asceticus factus est, iam ipse pelles animales mysticas, quae incantationi ad creandum animalia requiruntur, conficere poterat.

unit.source: So he had imbued extra powers into the ones he already possessed.
unit.target: Ita extra potentias in eas, quas iam habebat, infusserat.

unit.source: Thinking back on what had transpired, Jenna mused, “Jebus was going to answer at first… Meaning he didn’t think those two questions would put his life at risk. Heh, guess things didn’t play out like he expected.”
unit.target: Retrospiciens quae acciderant, Jenna meditata dixit: “Primum Iebus respondi velle videbatur… Quod significat eum non credidisse has duas quaestiones vitam eius in periculum adducere. Heh, videtur res non se evenisse ut speraverat.”

unit.source: Franca nodded.
unit.target: Franca annuit.

unit.source: “Exactly. If it was truly dangerous, he could’ve just stayed quiet.”
unit.target: “Certe. Si vere periculosum fuisset, potuisset tacere.”

unit.source: “I assumed he was under some contract where revealing the School of Truth’s headquarters or his direct Overseer’s name would cause his shadow to attack his soul.
unit.target: Existimabam eum sub aliquo pacto esse, in quo revelatio sedis Scholae Veritatis aut nominis directi Supervisoris eius umbram ad animam oppugnandam provocare posset.

unit.source: “Damn, what if his Overseer sneaked in extra terms when the contract was signed? Could that be why Jebus had no clue answering would be risky? Heavens, how tragic is that? Nothing but lies and trickery through and through—are we dealing with Swindlers or Brokers here?”
unit.target: Heu, quid si Supervisor extra conditiones, cum pactum signaretur, subdole inseruisset? Num id est causae quod Iebus nesciret responsum dare periculosum futurum esse? Heu, quam tristis res! Nihil nisi mendacia et dolus in omnibus—num fraudatores an mercatores hic versamur?

unit.source: After Franca’s lament, Lumian considered for a few moments.
unit.target: Post lamentationem Francae, Lumian paucis momentis meditatus est.

unit.source: “Overseer.”
unit.target: “Supervisor.”

unit.source: “Overseer?” Franca caught on immediately.
unit.target: “Supervisor?” Franca statim intellexit.

unit.source: “Overseeing subordinates is an Overseer ability, but Jebus didn’t know that.
unit.target: Superintendere subditos est munus Supervisoris, sed Iebus id nesciebat.

unit.source: Did he set off some forbidden conditions by answering key questions?”
unit.target: Num quaestionibus clavis respondendo conditiones vetitas provocavit?

unit.source: Jenna snapped to attention.
unit.target: Jenna subito animadvertit.

unit.source: “You think the Overseer spotted us already? Could they be on their way?”
unit.target: Existimasne Supervisor iam nos conspexisse? Num in via veniendi sint?

unit.source: “Unlikely. I had Franca leave the Primordial Demoness figurine here after noticing Jebus’s strange reaction,” Lumian said, smiling.
unit.target: “Improbabile. Francam reliquisse figuram Demonissae Primordialis hic, postquam reactionem insolitam Iebus animadverti,” inquit Lumian subridentes.

unit.source: “Even if we’re right, the Overseer probably just detected an issue with Jebus, not our precise location. The real problem is we may need to change our plans going forward.”
unit.target: “Etiam, si recte sentimus, Supervisor verisimiliter solum rem in Iebus deprehendit, non nostrum locum exactum. Vera quaestio est: fortasse consilia nostra in futurum mutanda erunt.”

unit.source: Jenna and Anthony understood what Lumian meant.
unit.target: Jenna et Anthony intellexerunt quid Lumian significaret.

unit.source: They weren’t under imminent threat or at risk of the Overseer tracking them down.
unit.target: Non erant in periculo proximo nec minati erant ut Supervisor eos sequeretur.

unit.source: But something had happened to Jebus, who was guarding Moran Avigny in the mirror world.
unit.target: Sed aliquid factum erat cum Iebus, qui Moran Avigny in mundo speculi custodiebat.

unit.source: Once the Overseer realized, they would easily deduce that someone was after Moran Avigny and undoubtedly take action.
unit.target: Quam ob rem, cum Supervisor id cognovisset, facile concluderet aliquem post Moran Avigny esse et sine dubio rem capere.

unit.source: The scheme they had so carefully devised probably no longer fit the new circumstances.
unit.target: Consilium, quod tam diligenter paraverant, verisimiliter novis condicionibus iam non conveniebat.

unit.source: Franca sighed heavily, eyeing the bone figurine on the ground with genuine regret.
unit.target: Franca graviter suspiravit, figuram ossis in terra positam cum sincera paenitentia intuens.

unit.source: “I resisted when the Demoness of Black first gave me this figurine. Now I’m wishing she’d given me a dozen!”
unit.target: “Recusavi, cum Demonissa Nigra primum hanc figuram mihi dederit. Nunc opto ut mihi duodecim dederit!”

unit.source: Poking fun at herself, she stooped down to retrieve the Primordial Demoness figurine.
unit.target: Ludens de se, inclinavit ut figuram Demonissae Primordialis reciperet.

unit.source: She delicately cleaned it off and murmured appreciatively.
unit.target: Illam leniter purgavit et suaviter murmuratudine aestimativa submurmuravit.

unit.source: Lumian took stock of his own actions.
unit.target: Lumian suas actiones contemplatus est.

unit.source: “I should’ve been watching how Jebus’s fate tributary shifted using the Eye of Calamity. Maybe then I could’ve intervened in time to stop him from responding.”
unit.target: “Debuī observare quomodo fatum Iebus per usum Oculi Calamitas mutatum esset; fortasse tum in tempore intercedere potuissem, ut eum responsione prohibuerem.”

unit.source: He hadn’t anticipated Jebus being oblivious to which questions would violate a taboo.
unit.target: Non praedixit Iebus nesciens esse quaestiones quas omnino vetitas esse oporteret.

unit.source: This wasn’t about religious devotion or advanced mystical knowledge.
unit.target: Hoc non pertinebat ad devotionem religiosam neque ad scientiam mysticam provectam.

unit.source: Jebus ought to have known what he could and couldn’t say.
unit.target: Iebus debuisset scire quae verba dicere liceret et quae non.

unit.source: If not, his daily life would’ve been cut short many times over.
unit.target: Alioquin, vita eius cotidiana pluries celeriter interclusa fuisset.

unit.source: Franca remembered, “The School of Truth member Jenna and I ran into before had the same thing happen when we asked his organizational affiliation and why he was capitalizing on the gatekeeper vanishing.
unit.target: Franca recordavit: “Meminimus, cum Jenna, membrum Scholae Veritatis, et ego eum ante convenisse, idem evenisse, cum rogavimus de eius coniunctione et cur absentia custodiae portae ad lucrum converteretur.

unit.source: Based on Jebus’s answer, stating ‘the School of Truth’ itself isn’t forbidden.
unit.target: Ex responsione Iebus, in qua declarabat ‘Schola Veritatis’ ipsa non esse vetitum,

unit.source: And I bet the guy who wasn’t even an Ambitionist yet had no idea why he was exploiting the gatekeeper’s absence.
unit.target: et credo eum, qui ne Ambitionista quidem erat, nescire cur absentia custodiae portae ad lucrum converteretur.”

unit.source: “Seems it really is an Overseer ability after all. No wonder the taboos are fluid, with the context, mental state, and overall situation determining what crosses the line each time. The rules adapt to the circumstances. Heh, just like the ideology Jebus described.”
unit.target: “Videtur re vera facultas Supervisoris esse. Non mirum tabuae sint mutabiles, cum contextu, statu mentis, et universa condicione decernatur quid limitem transgrediantur. Heh, sicut ipsa ideologia quam Iebus enarravit.”

unit.source: Lumian gave a small nod and laughed.
unit.target: Lumian parvum annuit et risit.

unit.source: “Well, at least we secured the spoils early on. Would’ve been a huge waste otherwise.”
unit.target: “Bene, saltem praeda initio obtinuimus. Alioquin ingens perditum fuisset.”

unit.source: He thought for a bit.
unit.target: Pauca meditatus est.

unit.source: “Franca, contact the Demoness of Black with the charm later. Inform her about the fixed mirror world entrance we made, what occurred, and how Jebus reacted. See what she thinks and advises."
unit.target: “Franca, postea hoc amuleto utens, Demonissam Nigram continge. Nuntiā ei de fixo ingressu in mundum speculi, quem fecimus, de rebus evenientibus, et de modo quo Iebus respondit. Vide quid sentiat et suadeat.”

unit.source: “Right, she’s likely a Tamara from the Apprentice branch. No love lost between her and Moran Avigny, who defected from the Judgement branch.”
unit.target: “Recte, verisimiliter ea est Tamara ex ramo Discipulorum. Nullum amorem inter eam et Moran Avigny, qui ex ramo Iudicii discesserat, intersit.”

unit.source: Franca concurred, and Lumian turned to Jenna next.
unit.target: Franca assentivit, et Lumian deinde ad Jenna se convertit.

unit.source: “Head to the safehouse and send word to Madam Judgment. The Judgement pathway stands for order, so I feel we must alert her to the School of Truth situation at once. I’ll take you there.”
unit.target: “Vade ad refugium et mitte nuntium ad Madam Judgment. Via Iudicii ordinem significat, ergo mihi videtur nos eam statim de re Scholae Veritatis certiorem facere debere. Te illic ducam.”

unit.source: “Got it.” Jenna was accustomed to Lumian delegating tasks in moments like these.
unit.target: “Intellectum.” Jenna consuebat Lumian huiusmodi munera delegare.

unit.source: Finally, Lumian addressed Anthony.
unit.target: Denique, Lumian ad Anthony locutus est.

unit.source: “Join me at the Pleasure Pavilion to await Moran Avigny’s arrival. Watch him closely for any unusual behavior.”
unit.target: “Mecum ad Pavillionem Voluptatis adiunge ut adventum Moran Avigny exspectemus. Eum diligenter observa, si quid insolitum morum occurrat.”

unit.source: Situated on Avenue du Boulevard, the opulent Pavilion of Pleasure functioned as the Intis Republic’s presidential estate.
unit.target: In Avenue du Boulevard sito, opulentus Pavillionem Voluptatis functus est ut praesidentialis residens Reipublicae Intis.

unit.source: Moran Avigny was due to attend a ministerial meeting convened by the president there.
unit.target: Moran Avigny ad conventum ministrorum, a praeside ibi convocatum, compareturus erat.

unit.source: Anthony inclined his head slightly to convey his assent.
unit.target: Anthony caput leviter inclinavit, ut suam assentientiam exprimere posset.

unit.source: Observation was a Spectator’s forte, after all.
unit.target: Observatio erat ars Spectatoris, post omnia.

unit.source: Inside the quarry cave housing the mirror world’s fixed entryway,
unit.target: Intra speluncam lapidariam, quae ingressum fixum in mundum speculi continet,

unit.source: Franca leaned against the wall, her night vision active.
unit.target: Franca ad murum inclinata est, cum visio nocturna eius activa esset.

unit.source: She produced a compact and a charm fashioned from ashen stone.
unit.target: Parvum compactum et amuletum ex lapide cinereo factum extraxit.

unit.source: Clasping the charm, Franca infused it with her spirituality.
unit.target: Amuletum stringens, Franca illud cum sua spiritualitate infudit.

unit.source: Reciting the Hermes activation phrase, she intoned,
unit.target: Recitans verba activationis Hermetis, inquit,

unit.source: “Eyes!”
unit.target: “Oculi!”

unit.source: Wreathed in obsidian flames, the rock-like grayish charm flared to life.
unit.target: Circumdatus flammis obsidianis, amuletum, quasi lapide cinereo, in vitam exarsit.

unit.source: Franca touched it to the compact’s glass,
unit.target: Franca illud ad vitrum compacti tetigit,

unit.source: causing the mirror to lose solidity and turn incorporeal.
unit.target: causans ut speculum soliditatem amitteret et incorporeum fieret.

unit.source: The burning charm sank through without resistance, vanishing from sight.
unit.target: Amuletum ardens sine repugnatione delapsum est, conspectum amittens.

unit.source: Moments later, Franca sensed a presence surround her.
unit.target: Paucis momentis post, Franca sensit praesentiam eam circumvenire.

unit.source: A mass of dark locks then rose from the makeup mirror’s surface.
unit.target: Massa capillorum obscurorum ex superficie speculi apparuit.

unit.source: The rippling black tresses obscured her view.
unit.target: Undantes crines nigrae eius conspectum obtexuerunt.

unit.source: As the hair fully emerged, Franca tightened her grasp, and Clarice took form before her.
unit.target: Cum crines plene apparuissent, Franca manum contraxit, et Clarice coram ea formam accepit.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black’s own hair remained immaculately tied up, with no trace of the ominous raven strands.
unit.target: Crines ipsius Demonissae Nigrae immaculate alligati manebant, sine ullo vestigio crinitum corvinorum.

unit.source: Even having met her prior, Franca couldn’t suppress a rush of awe at Clarice’s allure.
unit.target: Etiam cum eam ante convenisset, Franca flumen admirationis ob Claricee formositatem reprimere non potuit.

unit.source: The woman possessed a breathtaking beauty that effortlessly ensnared any who beheld her.
unit.target: Femina pulchritudine eximia praedita erat, quae facile omnem qui eam conspexit captivabat.

unit.source: Clarice regarded Franca, her melodic voice gentle as she inquired, “You have an update?”
unit.target: Clarice Francam respexit, voce dulci et leni, quaerens: “Habesne nuntium novum?”

unit.source: Composing herself, Franca detailed her suspicion of corruption seeping out of Underground Trier.
unit.target: Se componens, Franca enarravit suspicioni de corruptione ex Underground Trier effluentis.

unit.source: She had ventured to a particular sector bearing the Primordial Demoness figurine, ultimately pinpointing the target site.
unit.target: Ad aliquem sectorem pervenit, figuram Demonissae Primordialis ferens, et denique locum propositum designavit.

unit.source: She elaborated on beseeching the Primordial One via the figurine, obtaining a reply, and securing a permanent gateway to the mirror plane.
unit.target: Explicavit quomodo per figuram Primordiae orationem fecerit, responsum obtinuerit, atque ianuam permanentem ad planum speculi assecuraverit.

unit.source: A rare glimmer of approval showed on Clarice’s face.
unit.target: Rara scintilla approbationis in facie Clarice apparuit.

unit.source: “Your instincts are sharp and your mind keen.
unit.target: “Instincta tua acuta sunt et mens tua perspicax.

unit.source: Impressive that you conceived of and accomplished this.
unit.target: Mirabile est quod id concepisti atque perfecisti.

unit.source: Perhaps you too shall rise to be a colored Demoness one day.
unit.target: Forsitan etiam tu aliquando ad demonissam coloratam exsurges.

unit.source: Demoness of Yellow? Franca grumbled to herself.
unit.target: “Demonissa Flava?” Franca ad se murmurat.

unit.source: She went on to outline the scheme she had hatched with Lumian’s crew, withholding specifics about the Tarot Club and portraying the Mirror Mark power as an item.
unit.target: Deinde continuit consilium, quod cum manipulo Lumiani excogitaverat, detrahens specifica de Tarot Club et vim Signi Speculi tamquam rem exhibens.

unit.source: Clarice listened attentively without comment.
unit.target: Clarice attentive auscultavit, nihil addidens.

unit.source: Franca recounted the offensive against Lumian amid his probe, his triumph over Jebus, and the bounty of intel gleaned through a Spectator.
unit.target: Franca narravit de impetu adversus Lumian dum eum investigaret, de victoria eius super Iebus, atque de copia notitiarum per Spectatorem collectarum.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black nodded.
unit.target: Demonissa Nigra annuit.

unit.source: “Your lovers are quite capable, the Hunter in particular.
unit.target: “Amatores vestri valde capaces sunt, praesertim Venator.

unit.source: Here Clarice smirked.
unit.target: Hic Clarice subridens risit.

unit.source: “The taste of a Hunter isn’t bad either.
unit.target: “Gustus Venatoris quoque non male est.

unit.source: The higher their Sequence, the more intense and brave they grow.”
unit.target: Quo altior eorum series, eo magis intensi et audaces fiunt.

unit.source: Wh— Emperor, even an elite Demoness has perused your clandestine annals… Every Demoness probably owns an edition!
unit.target: Heu— Imperator, etiam una Demonissa electa arcana tua annales perscrutata est… Omnis Demonissa fortasse suam editionem habet!

unit.source: Franca wavered between finding Emperor Roselle’s plight humorous or pitiable.
unit.target: Franca inter iocosum et miserabile casus Imperatoris Roselle vacillabat.

unit.source: “It certainly has its perks,” Franca played along, smiling and trying to mask her chagrin.
unit.target: “Certe, illa commoditates suas habet,” Franca ludens respondit, subridente et conante dolorem suum celare.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black proceeded, “However, both you and he erred.
unit.target: Demonissa Nigra perrexit: “Sed tamen, et tu et ille erraverunt.

unit.source: “Upon amassing adequate knowledge, you should have ceased questioning without delay. The wiser course was to first ambush Moran Avigny, seize him, then interrogate further.”
unit.target: “Postquam scientiam sufficientem conquisivisses, quaestiones sine mora desinere debuisses; melius erat primum insidiari Moran Avigny, eum capere, deinde ulteriora interrogare.”

unit.source: “Agreed.” Franca accepted the Demoness of Black’s reproach.
unit.target: “Agreed.” Franca assensit reprehensioni demonissae Nigrae.

unit.source: In hindsight, the location of the School of Truth’s headquarters and the presiding Overseer’s identity were not essential facts for their immediate needs.
unit.target: In retrospecto, locus praesidi Scholae Veritatis et identitas praesidis Supervisoris non erant essentiales notitiae ad necessitates eorum praesentes.

unit.source: They could have morphed Jebus into a dog and set Lugano and Ludwig to guard him.
unit.target: Iebum in canem convertere potuissent, et Lugano atque Ludwig ad eum custodiendum statuere potuissent.

unit.source: While the Overseer remained unaware, she and the rest could have lurked within the mirror, poised for Moran Avigny to unwittingly enter of his own accord.
unit.target: Dum Supervisor manebat nescius, illa et ceteri intra speculum latuere potuissent, parati ut Moran Avigny inscius sua sponte accederet.

unit.source: Ample chances to take a second captive would have presented themselves down the line.
unit.target: Multae occasiones ad secundum captivum capiendum se ostenderent deinceps.

unit.source: However, this was Lumian’s style.
unit.target: Attamen, hoc erat via Lumiani.

unit.source: It had long been apparent to Franca that Lumian was predisposed to extracting intelligence on the spot.
unit.target: Iamdudum Francae patebat Lumianum esse promptum notitias in loco extrahere.

unit.source: Only extraordinary reasons would induce him to postpone.
unit.target: Solum causae extraordinariae eum ad differendum coegerunt.

unit.source: As if he feared the slightest delay might thwart him from procuring otherwise obtainable insight.
unit.target: Velut si minima mora eum impediret ut notitiam aliter obtineret.

unit.source: Demoness of Black Clarice refrained from belaboring the point.
unit.target: Demonissa Nigra Clarice abstinuit rem nimis disserere.

unit.source: Nodding, she declared, “Abide here for my return. I’ll look into these developments, but it may require some time.”
unit.target: Caput inclinans, inquit: “Manete hic usque ad reditum meum. Has res explorabo, sed aliquod tempus id requisitum esse potest.”

unit.source: “As you wish, Madame Clarice.” Franca made no effort to conceal her gratified smile.
unit.target: “Ut velis, Domina Clarice.” Franca nihil fecit ut risum suum laetum celaret.

unit.source: Outside the dazzling Pavilion of Pleasure on Avenue du Boulevard, Lumian and Anthony seamlessly rejoined the throng of journalists.
unit.target: Extra fulgentem Pavillionem Voluptatis in Avenue du Boulevard, Lumian et Anthony celeriter turmam diurnariorum reiunxerunt.

unit.source: 718 Another Warning
unit.target: 718 Altera Monitio

unit.source: Lumian and Anthony only had to wait briefly before the ministers began exiting the Pavilion of Pleasure one by one.
unit.target: Lumian et Anthony breviter exspectare debebant, priusquam ministros singillatim ex Atrio Voluptatis exire coeperunt.

unit.source: They quickly approached Moran Avigny, the Minister of Industry.
unit.target: Celeriter accesserunt ad Moran Avigny, Minister Industriae.

unit.source: While listening to the other reporters’ questions, they employed their unique abilities to observe him closely.
unit.target: Dum quaestiones aliorum relatorum audiebant, singulares facultates ad eum diligenter observandum adhibuerunt.

unit.source: After just over ten seconds, Lumian turned to Anthony and gave a small shake of his head,
unit.target: Post paulo plus quam decem secundae, Lumian ad Anthony conversus est et caput leviter submovit.

unit.source: indicating that, for now, there was nothing unusual about Moran’s river of fate.
unit.target: Id indicans quod, pro tempore, nihil insolitum de flumine fati Moran erat.

unit.source: He trusted that Anthony, being a Spectator, would understand his unspoken message.
unit.target: Fidit Antonium, Spectatorem esse, tacitum nuntium eius intellegaturum.

unit.source: Anthony responded with a slight head shake of his own, confirming to Lumian that Moran Avigny’s expression and behavior appeared normal.
unit.target: Anthony respondit caput leviter submovens, Lumiano confirmans expressionem atque mores Moran Avigny esse normales.

unit.source: Has the Overseer directly responsible for Jebus not reached out to Moran Avigny?
unit.target: Num Praefectus, qui Jebus directe curabat, non accessit ad Moran Avigny?

unit.source: Or could our assumption be incorrect?
unit.target: An nostra coniectura fortasse errata sit?

unit.source: Is it possible that Jebus’s death wasn’t detected by the Overseer’s monitoring?
unit.target: Possibile est, ut mors Jebus vigilantia Praefecti non deprehensa sit?

unit.source: Have they not fully grasped the situation with Jebus?
unit.target: Num non plene intellexerunt rem de Jebus?

unit.source: These thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind as he continued his observation.
unit.target: Hae cogitationes per mentem Lumiani festinanter transierunt, dum observationem continuabat.

unit.source: This was precisely why he had come in person to the Pavilion of Pleasure to await Moran Avigny’s appearance.
unit.target: Hac quidem causa ipse ad Atrium Voluptatis venit ut apparitionem Moran Avigny exspectaret.

unit.source: Only by acquiring the most current and reliable information could he assess whether to move forward with the original plan, adjust it, or temporarily set it aside!
unit.target: Nimirum, per recentissimas atque fideles notitias acquisitas, potuisset aestimare utrum consilium originale prosequi, id accommodare, aut temporarie deponere valeat!

unit.source: Indeed, within Moran Avigny’s river of fate, a tributary of him entering the full-body mirror in the study still exists, shrouded in an intense black hue…
unit.target: Revera, in flumine fati Moran Avigny, ramus eius, qui in speculum totius corporis in studio ingreditur, adhuc existit, in nigro intensissimo involutus…

unit.source: Lumian, unconcerned about the drain on his spirituality, maintained his focus on any potential shifts in Moran Avigny’s destiny.
unit.target: Lumian, detrimento spiritualitatis suae non sollicitus, intentionem suam ad qualibet mutatione in fato Moran Avigny retinuit.

unit.source: Following a short interview, the debonair Minister of Industry, flanked by his bodyguards, descended the steps of the Pavilion of Pleasure and headed towards his stylish four-wheeled, four-seater carriage.
unit.target: Post breve colloquium, elegans Minister Industriae, cum custodibus suis, gradus Atrii Voluptatis descendit et ad raedam suam elegantem, quaterna rotis et quattuor sedibus dispositam, se contulit.

unit.source: As the valet opened the carriage door, Moran Avigny pulled out a small hand mirror from his pocket, seemingly checking his appearance.
unit.target: Dum servus ianuam raedae aperiebat, Moran Avigny speculum parvum ad manum pertinens de sinu suo extraxit, quasi aspectum suum inspiciens.

unit.source: In Trier’s high society, this was a typical occurrence.
unit.target: In societate alta Treverorum, hoc eventus solitus erat.

unit.source: Men’s cosmetics and grooming had long been in vogue.
unit.target: Cosmetica virorum et cultus corporis diu in more erant.

unit.source: Moran Avigny peered into the hand mirror, his dark-gray pupils abruptly widening as his expression subtly changed.
unit.target: Moran Avigny in speculum parvum aspexit, pupillae eius fuscogriseae subito dilatantes, dum vultus eius subtiliter mutabatur.

unit.source: Nearly simultaneously, Lumian, with his silver-black eyes, detected a notable alteration in the Minister of Industry’s fate tributary.
unit.target: Paene simul, Lumian, oculis argenteo-nigris, mutationem notabilem in ramo fati Ministri Industriae animadvertit.

unit.source: None of the tributaries suggested Moran Avigny’s entry into the study’s full-body mirror!
unit.target: Nullus ex ramis indicabat ingressum Moran Avigny in speculum totius corporis studii!

unit.source: All relevant “choices” had vanished!
unit.target: Omnes optiones pertinentes evanuerunt!

unit.source: As a result, even if Lumian depleted nearly half of his spirituality and employed Compelling Fate, he would be unable to force Moran Avigny to “willingly” enter the study’s full-body mirror.
unit.target: Consequenter, etiamsi Lumian paene dimidium spiritualitatis suae consumpsisset et Fatum Coercendum adhibuisset, non potuisset cogere Moran Avigny ut "volenter" in speculum totius corporis in studio ingrediatur.

unit.source: Compelling Fate wasn’t about creating destiny; choices had to exist before they could be compelled!
unit.target: Fatum Coercendum non significabat fatum creare; optiones prius exsistere debebant, ut compelli possent!

unit.source: Taking advantage of the moment when the reporters had shifted their focus and the two of them were slowly trailing behind, Anthony quietly said to Lumian, “When Moran Avigny looked at himself in the hand mirror, he experienced a palpable sense of fear.”
unit.target: Uti momenti quo relatores attentionem mutaverant et duo eorum lente se sequerantur, Anthony silentio Lumiano inquit: "Cum Moran Avigny in speculum parvum se aspexit, sensum timoris perceptum habuit."

unit.source: As Lumian followed the other reporters, he continued to assess Moran Avigny and formed a related hypothesis.
unit.target: Dum Lumian alios relatores sequebatur, Moran Avigny percontari continuavit et hypothesim affinitatem formavit.

unit.source: Someone was utilizing the mirror world and the hand mirror to convey a message to Moran Avigny!
unit.target: Aliquis mundum specularum et speculum parvum ad manum utebatur, ut nuntium ad Moran Avigny mitteret!

unit.source: The transmitted information likely pertained to the mysterious demise of Jebus Lata, who was tasked with guarding the study’s full-body mirror, and the disappearance of his body.
unit.target: Notitia transmissae probabiliter attinebat ad obscuram interitum Jebus Lata, qui speculum totius corporis in studio custodire curabatur, et ad eius corporis evanitionem.

unit.source: For Moran Avigny, this implied that someone was conspiring against him. The shadow was already looming over him, its source and circumstances unknown.
unit.target: Pro Moran Avigny, hoc significabat aliquem adversum se conspirare; umbra iam super eum imminebat, origo atque circumstantiae ignotae.

unit.source: Under such conditions, fear was inevitable. For the majority of people, emotions would inevitably manifest to some degree in their facial expressions and physical movements, making them readily apparent to Spectators.
unit.target: Sub his condicionibus, timor inevitabilis erat. Plurimis hominibus, affectus in vultibus et motibus corporis manifestabantur, facientes eos ab Spectatoribus manifeste agnoscibiles.

unit.source: Yes, given that Jebus possessed a Mirror Cufflink, it’s reasonable to assume that the Overseer above him would have comparable items.
unit.target: Ita, cum Jebus fibulam specularis possidebat, rationabile est putare Praefectum super eum similia habere.

unit.source: They might even possess the additional capability to communicate via the mirror world… Lumian recalled, thinking of the glass cufflink now in Franca’s possession.
unit.target: Forsitan etiam additam facultatem ad per mundum specularum communicandum possiderint… Lumian recordatus est, cogitans de fibula vitrea nunc in Francae possessione.
