unit.source: Moreover, Jebus had disclosed that Moran Avigny had instructed the other Mirror People from the Tamara family to assume new identities and relocate, leaving him as the sole contact with the School of Truth.
unit.target: Praeterea, Jebus enuntiaverat Moran Avigny reliquos Speculares ex familia Tamara hortatum esse ut novas identitates acciperent et migrarent, relinquens se solum vinculum cum Schola Veritatis.

unit.source: Consequently, when the Overseer discovered Jebus’s unexplained disappearance and ultimate death, they would be unable to reach the other Mirror People.
unit.target: Consequenter, cum Praefectus Jebus inexplicatam evanitionem atque ultimam mortem detegisset, reliquos Speculares attingere non potuit.

unit.source: They could only await the conclusion of Moran Avigny’s ministerial meeting to send him a warning.
unit.target: Illi tantum exspectare poterant finem conventus ministeriali Moran Avigny, ut ei monitum mitterent.

unit.source: Our prior conjectures have been validated. The Overseer did indeed detect Jebus’s death.
unit.target: Conjecturae nostrae priores confirmatae sunt. Praefectus vere mortem Jebus detexit.

unit.source: Whether the Overseer was limited by his abilities or hindered by the Primordial Demoness figurine is uncertain, but he was unable to immediately locate us and launch a counterattack…
unit.target: Utrum Praefectus facultatibus suis limitatus sit an figura Daemonae Primordialis eum impeditis sit incertum est; sed nos statim invenire et contra impetum iniicere non potuit…

unit.source: We must abandon the original plan. Getting Moran Avigny to ‘willingly’ enter the study’s full-body mirror is no longer feasible…
unit.target: Consilium originale deserendum est. Neque iam fieri potest ut Moran Avigny "volenter" in speculum totius corporis in studio ingrediatur…

unit.source: Lost in thought, Lumian watched as Moran Avigny tucked away the hand mirror, boarded the carriage, and headed home.
unit.target: Cogitatione absorptus, Lumian spectavit dum Moran Avigny speculum parvum ad manum recondidit, raedam conscendit et domum profectus est.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the still somewhat chaotic scene, he and Anthony discreetly left the Pavilion of Pleasure.
unit.target: Ex scena adhuc aliquantisper mixta, ille et Anthony caute Atrium Voluptatis reliquerunt.

unit.source: At the periphery of a square adorned with statues and obelisks, Lumian scanned his surroundings.
unit.target: In margine plateae ornatae statuis et obeliscis, Lumian ambitum suum circumspiciebat.

unit.source: Confirming that no one was nearby, he murmured to Anthony, “What do you think frightened Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: Confirmans neminem prope esse, ad Anthony murmuravit: "Quid putas quod Moran Avigny territus sit?"

unit.source: He had already shared his theory with Anthony.
unit.target: Iam theoriam suam cum Anthony communicaverat.

unit.source: Drawing on his Spectator perspective, Anthony endeavored to analyze the psychological states of the School of Truth and Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Ex sua Spectatoris prospectu, Anthony conatus est condiciones psychologicas Scholae Veritatis atque Moran Avigny perpendere.

unit.source: “Without intel on the enemy, it’s improbable that the School of Truth, a secret organization worshiping an evil deity, would dispatch additional demigod-level operatives to Moran Avigny’s proximity to enhance protection for the Mirror People.
unit.target: Sine indagatione de hoste, improbabile est Schola Veritatis, societas arcana deum malum colens, operarios ad gradum semi-deorum ad propinquitatem Moran Avigny mittere posse, ut speculares tueatur.

unit.source: Unlike an orthodox Church, they can’t afford to act rashly and perpetually escalate their involvement.
unit.target: Contra Ecclesiam orthodoxam, non desunt eis opes ut imprudenter agant et in sua implicatione continuo augeantur.

unit.source: They must consider the possibility that the group that apprehended Jebus is equally formidable, potentially including a demigod in their ranks.
unit.target: Rationem habere debent possibilitatis, quod coetus qui Jebus apprehendit, aeque formidabilis sit, fortasse etiam semideus in ordinibus suis continens.

unit.source: They might even suspect that this could be a covert mission orchestrated by the Purifier, Machinery Hivemind, or an elite unit from Bureau 8.
unit.target: Forsitan etiam suspicari possint hanc esse missionem occultam a Purificatore, Machinae Communis, aut unitate electa ex Bureau VIII.

unit.source: In essence, the Overseer will convey to Moran Avigny that he’s now on his own. They’ll offer indirect support but can’t intervene directly.
unit.target: Praeterea, Praefectus ipse ad Moran Avigny indicabit eum nunc solum esse; subsidium indirectum offerent, sed directe intervenire non possunt.

unit.source: Other cults might react with insanity, extremism, and irrationality while still defending Moran Avigny. However, based on Jebus’s ideology, the School of Truth will refrain from such actions.
unit.target: Aliae sectae insanitate, extremismo, et irratione agere possent, dum Moran Avigny defendunt; tamen, ex ideologia Jebus, Schola Veritatis talia agere abstinebit.

unit.source: That explains why Moran Avigny couldn’t conceal his fear. It’s tantamount to being forsaken.” Lumian gently nodded.
unit.target: Id explicat cur Moran Avigny timorem celare non potuerit. Hoc quasi desertio est. Lumian leniter annuit.

unit.source: Anthony continued his analysis.
unit.target: Anthony analysin suam continuavit.

unit.source: “We must also take into account Moran Avigny’s unique characteristic as a Mirror Person.
unit.target: Praeterea, considerare debemus singularitatem Moran Avigny ut Specularis Hominis.

unit.source: The Mirror People we’ve previously encountered not only pursued their own ambitions but also exhibited a certain zealotry towards their leader and overarching objectives.
unit.target: Speculares, quos antea convenimus, non solum suas ambitiones persequebantur, sed etiam certam fervorem erga ducem suum et metas universales exhibebant.

unit.source: Based on my observations, while Moran Avigny is undeniably terrified, he managed to exercise some restraint. Upon entering the carriage, he appeared resolute and determined.
unit.target: Ex observationibus meis, quamquam Moran Avigny indubitanter territus est, aliquam continentiam servare potuit. In raedam conscendens, constans ac determinatus apparuit.

unit.source: Lumian comprehended and remarked, “Is he contemplating self-sacrifice? He’ll promptly alert the other Mirror People and urge them to swiftly conceal themselves. As for himself, he’s under the strict protection of officials, rendering escape impossible. His only option is to remain in place, visible to the enemy faction, hoping that his fortune is sufficient and the official protection proves effective."
unit.target: Lumian intellexit et inquit: "Num se ipsum immolare cogitat? Celeriter reliquos Speculares certiorem faciet et impellere eos ut celeriter se celent. Quod ad se ipsos attinet, sub stricta tutela officialium est, unde effugere impossibile est. Unica eius optio est in loco manere, hostium factioni conspicuus, sperans fortunam suam satis esse atque tutelam officialem efficacem."

unit.source: Heh heh, in times like these, protection becomes another form of confinement.
unit.target: Heh heh, temporibus talibus, tutela alia forma coercitionis fit.

unit.source: Anthony shifted the topic.
unit.target: Anthony rem mutavit.

unit.source: “Which tributary turned black following the change in Moran Avigny’s fate?”
unit.target: Quis ramus post mutationem fati Moran Avigny in nigrum versa est?

unit.source: Lumian shook his head.
unit.target: Lumian caput negavit.

unit.source: Nothing at present.
unit.target: Nihil ad praesens.

unit.source: This is an exceptionally unique situation. It signifies that it will manifest only when Moran Avigny makes a new choice, branching into a new fate tributary.
unit.target: Hoc est condicionis eximie singularis. Significat manifestari solum, cum Moran Avigny novam electionem faciet, in novum ramum fati convertatur.

unit.source: At this juncture, Lumian exhaled slowly and stated, “I don’t perceive any other opportunities at the moment. It would have been good if the Overseer had acted rashly and protected Moran Avigny. The Demoness of Black should be awaiting him. Hmm, let’s locate Jenna and Franca first.”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian lente suspiravit et dixit: "Nullas alias opportunitates nunc video. Bene fuisset, si Praefectus impetuose egisset et Moran Avigny protegeret. Daemona Nigra eum exspectare debebat. Hmm, primum Jenna et Francam inveniamus."

unit.source: In the quarry cave housing a permanent entrance to the mirror world, Franca, who had been patiently waiting, witnessed black hair reemerge from the mirror, descending strand by strand.
unit.target: In spelunca fodina, quae ingressum permanentem in mundum specularum continebat, Franca, quae patienter exspectaverat, vidit capillos negros ex speculo iterum emergere, filamenta per filamentum descendentes.

unit.source: Demoness of Black Clarice materialized and spoke softly, “Currently, no Beyonders are concealed behind the relevant mirror. They must have abandoned Moran Avigny."
unit.target: Daemona Nigra Clarice apparuit et leniter locuta est: "Nunc, nulli Beyonders post speculum pertinente absconduntur; forsitan abierunt a Moran Avigny."

unit.source: “I’m unable to provide assistance at this time. You must reevaluate your strategy and devise a means to capture Moran Avigny, who is under the robust protection of official Beyonders, without entering the mirror world.”
unit.target: Non possum auxilium in hoc tempore praebere. Consilium tuum iterum perpendas et viam invenias ad Moran Avigny capiendum, qui sub valida tutela Beyonders officialium est, sine in mundum specularum ingrediendo.

unit.source: Do you have a solution in mind? Franca wished to inquire but refrained out of concern for offending the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Habesne solutionem in mente? Franca interrogare volebat, sed abstinuit metu ne Daemona Nigra offenderetur.

unit.source: Instead, she simply replied, “Understood.”
unit.target: Pro eo, simpliciter respondit: "Intellectum."

unit.source: In a secure safe house within the administrative district, Jenna informed Lumian and Anthony, “Madame Judgment has instructed us to halt further action for now. She needs to confer with the other Major Arcana card holders regarding the information obtained from Jebus.”
unit.target: In domo securā in regione administrativā, Jenna Lumiano et Anthony nuntiavit: "Domina Iudicium nos iussit ut hactenus actiones ulteriora desinamus. Ea oportet consuetudinem habere cum aliis possessoribus chartarum Major Arcana de notitiis a Jebus receptis."

unit.source: With Ma’am Hermit? Lumian pondered silently, immersed in thought.
unit.target: "Cum Domina Hermit?" Lumian tacite meditatus est.

unit.source: He gave a small nod and said, “Let’s go find Franca.”
unit.target: Parvum annuum dedit et inquit: "Eamus Francam quaerere!"

unit.source: After rendezvousing with Franca in the subterranean quarry cave and sharing their discoveries, Lumian sighed and declared, “For the time being, we have no choice but to abandon our efforts.”
unit.target: Postquam cum Franca in spelunca fodina subterranea conveniissent et inventa sua inter se communicaverunt, Lumian suspiravit et dixit: "Ad tempus, non aliud habemus quam conatus nostros deserere."

unit.source: As Franca and the others nodded in agreement, Lumian suddenly heard a resounding voice.
unit.target: Cum Franca et ceteri consensu annuissent, Lumian subito vocem resonantem audivit.

unit.source: “Don’t you believe you’re capitulating prematurely?
unit.target: Nonne putas te nimis prae-tempore cedere?

unit.source: “Did you fail to notice any issues?”
unit.target: Nonne quaedam difficultates non animadvertisti?

unit.source: Termiboros… Why is He offering me guidance? And it’s not an urgent matter that threatens Him? Lumian couldn’t help but furrow his brow.
unit.target: Termiboros… Cur ille mihi consilium praebet? Et num res urgente eum minatur? Lumian non potuit quin fronte contraxisset.

unit.source: Termiboros’s profound voice persisted, “Consider this. If you were an Overseer, what actions would you take in such a scenario?”
unit.target: Vox profunda Termiboros perseveravit: "Considera hoc. Si praefectus esses, quae actiones in tali casu caperes?"

unit.source: “Naturally, they would reduce personnel and conceal themselves to prevent the enemy from discovering clues and pursuing them…” Lumian muttered under his breath. “Beyond this, what else can they do? How can they indirectly aid Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: "Certe, operarios minuere et se celare conarerentur, ne hostis indicia detegeret et eos persequeretur…" Lumian submurmuravit: "Quid praeter hoc agere possunt? Quomodo indirecte Moran Avigny adiuvare possent?"

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony observed Lumian as he mumbled to himself, awaiting his ultimate explanation.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony Lumian conspexerunt, dum sibi ipsi submurmurabat, ultimum suum explanare expectans.

unit.source: Abruptly, a possibility occurred to Lumian.
unit.target: Subito, aliqua possibilitas Lumiano in mentem venit.

unit.source: He gazed at his three companions and said in a low, serious tone, “Under the Table Transaction!”
unit.target: Ad tres comites suos aspexit et voce levi ac seria dixit: "Sub Mensa Transactio!"

unit.source: “Safeguard Moran Avigny through a high-level Under the Table transaction!”
unit.target: "Moran Avigny per transactionem sub mensa altissimi gradus protegendus sit!"

unit.source: “That’s why we each abandoned the plan for distinct reasons. Even the river of fate currently shows no death calamity for Moran Avigny!”
unit.target: "Idcirco singuli consilium nostrum propter causas diversas deseruimus. Etiam flumen fati nunc nullam mortis calamitatem pro Moran Avigny exhibet!"

unit.source: 719 Advancing
unit.target: 719 Progrediens

unit.source: “We were under the influence of an Under the Table transaction?” Franca carefully reviewed the entire situation but couldn’t find anything out of the ordinary.
unit.target: “Eramusne sub imperio transactionis ‘sub mensa’?” Franca totam rem diligenter perquisivit, sed nihil prorsus extra solitum reperit.

unit.source: The only thing that stood out was that the Demoness of Black probably had a way to quickly extract Moran Avigny while he was under the protection of an official Beyonder team.
unit.target: Unum solum quod eminuit erat, quod Demonissa Nigra, verisimiliter, viam habebat celeriter Moran Avigny extrahere, dum sub tutela turmae officialis Beyonder esset.

unit.source: She clearly knew how to exploit the mirror world, yet she burdened everything upon her.
unit.target: Clare scivit quomodo mundum specularum ad usum suum converteret, attamen omnia sibi onere imposuit.

unit.source: Of course, her actions made sense when put into context.
unit.target: Profecto, eius actus sensum habebant, cum in contextu considerabantur.

unit.source: Even though Moran Avigny’s security detail consisted of Mid-Sequence Beyonders, this was Trier, the capital of the Intis Republic.
unit.target: Quamquam custodia Moran Avigny ex Beyonder Medi‐sequentibus constabat, hoc erat Trier, caput Reipublicae Intis.

unit.source: It was a diocese of great importance to both the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the God of Steam and Machinery Church.
unit.target: Illud erat dioecesis maximi momenti tam Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Ardentis quam Ecclesiae Dei Vaporis et Machinarum.

unit.source: Numerous demigods were posted there, ready to intervene at a moment’s notice.
unit.target: Multi semidei ibi constituti erant, parati ut instante intervenirent.

unit.source: If the Demoness of Black couldn’t end the fight quickly and eliminate all witnesses, she would face severe repercussions.
unit.target: Si Demonissa Nigra pugnam celeriter finire atque omnes testes tollere non valuisset, poenas graves patiretur.

unit.source: Official Beyonders might even track her using specialized Sealed Artifacts.
unit.target: Beyonder officiales eam etiam vestigia explorare poterunt, utens artefactis sigillis distinctis.

unit.source: If something happened to her, the Demoness Sect’s Trier branch would be dealt a crippling blow.
unit.target: Si quid illi evenisset, ramus Trierensis Sectae Demonissarum ictu gravissimo percussus esset.

unit.source: In a situation like this, it would be wiser for her to assign a capable member of middling rank to handle the matter while she focused on damage control.
unit.target: In tali re, melius erat ut membrum idoneum ex ordine mediocris ad rem gerendam delegaret, dum ipsa damnum coercere contendebat.

unit.source: If things went south, she could easily cut ties with Franca and her lovers.
unit.target: Si res male evenissent, facile nexus cum Franca et eius amatoribus dissolvere posset.

unit.source: This assumed, of course, that Moran Avigny wasn’t valuable enough for the Demoness Sect to go to great lengths to eliminate him.
unit.target: Hoc praesupponebat, scilicet, quod Moran Avigny non esset satis pretiosus, ut Sectae Demonissarum ad eum exstirpare longas conatibus adirent.

unit.source: If he were, the sect would have evacuated non‐essential personnel beforehand and assembled high‐ranking, color‐named Demonesses in Trier.
unit.target: Si ille praetiosus esset, secta prius personam non essentialem removeret atque Demonissas summi gradus, nomine colorato, in Trier congregavisset.

unit.source: “I think there’s an issue here. It’s not that we shouldn’t or can’t abandon the mission, but rather that we gave up far too readily and hastily,” Anthony remarked, analyzing the situation from a human behavioral standpoint.
unit.target: «Putō hic rem esse gravem. Non id est quod negotium relinquere non debeāmus aut non possimus, sed potius quod nimis cito et festinanter cederemus,» Anthony inquit, rem ex prospectu morum humanorum examinans.

unit.source: Franca nodded pensively and added, “Indeed.”
unit.target: Franca meditabunda caput inclinavit et addidit: «Vere.»

unit.source: The Demoness of Black only briefly verified the absence of hidden Beyonders behind the mirror in question before concluding that Moran Avigny had been abandoned and would receive no further assistance.
unit.target: Demonissa Nigra modo brevemente absentiam Beyonder occultorum post speculum commemoratum comprobavit, antequam conclusit Moran Avigny desertum esse et nullo ulteriore auxilio futurum.

unit.source: “That’s way too rushed and convenient,” Jenna commented.
unit.target: «Id nimis festinatum et opportunum est,» Jenna dixerat.

unit.source: After a moment’s hesitation, she asked, “Was Madam Judgment affected as well?”
unit.target: Post paulum dubitationis, illa quaesivit: «An etiam Domina Iudicium affecta sit?»

unit.source: “It’s possible.” Lumian glanced down at his chest.
unit.target: «Verisimile est,» Lumian in pectus suum deiecto aspexit.

unit.source: Lowering his voice, he asked, “Termiboros, why weren’t you impacted? Is it because you’re an Angel?”
unit.target: Vocem demittens quaesivit: «Termiboros, cur non affectus es? Num quia angelus es?»

unit.source: Termiboros’s imposing voice echoed within Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Voce imponente Termiboris intra corpus Lumiani resonabat.

unit.source: “It’s hard to say for certain.”
unit.target: Difficile est certo dicere.

unit.source: It could also be due to The Fool’s seal.
unit.target: Fortasse etiam propter sigillum Stulti est.

unit.source: While the seal does limit me, it can also serve as a safeguard under certain circumstances.
unit.target: Quamquam sigillum me limitat, sub quibusdam condicionibus praesidium quoque praebere potest.

unit.source: Similar to Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse?
unit.target: Simile cadavro Abominationis Naboredisley?

unit.source: The Overseer’s Under the Table transaction couldn’t breach Mr. Fool’s seal, so it had no effect on Termiboros?
unit.target: Transactio “sub mensa” Overseoris non potuit sigillum Domini Stulti frangere, itaque in Termiboro nullum effectum habuit?

unit.source: Lumian nodded in understanding and said to Jenna, “We need to inform Madam Judgment of our suspicions.
unit.target: Lumian intellegens caput inclinavit et ad Jennam dixerat: «Nobis oportet Dominam Iudicium de nostris suspicionibus certiorem facere.»

unit.source: If an Under the Table transaction is indeed at play, she’ll undoubtedly break free of its influence and offer new guidance once alerted.
unit.target: Si revera transactio “sub mensa” agitur, illa certe eius influentiam franget et, monita, nova praecepta offeret.

unit.source: If she’s unaffected, the messenger will just have to put in a bit of extra effort.
unit.target: Si illa non afficitur, nuntius solum modicum conatus addere oportet.

unit.source: “Got it.” Jenna grasped Lumian’s point.
unit.target: «Intelligo,» Jenna sensum Lumiani comprehendi curavit.

unit.source: “Even though we suspect an Under the Table transaction, we can’t act recklessly right now.
unit.target: «Quamquam suspicimur transactionem “sub mensa”, nunc temere agere non possumus.

unit.source: We still require fresh directives from the Major Arcana cardholders.”
unit.target: Nihilominus adhuc nova praecepta a tenentibus cartarum Major Arcana exspectamus.»

unit.source: As Franca waited for Madam Judgment’s reply, she let out a sigh.
unit.target: Dum Franca responsum Dominae Iudicium exspectabat, suspirum edidit.

unit.source: “Is something wrong?” Jenna inquired, her worry apparent.
unit.target: «Numquid aliquid male est?» Jenna inquit, sollicita eius manifeste apparens.

unit.source: Franca responded with a mix of sorrow and outrage, “This Under the Table transaction was exceptionally lavish.
unit.target: Franca, misce luctum et indignationem, respondit: «Haec transactio “sub mensa” eximie luxuriosa fuit.

unit.source: It impacted no fewer than two demigods.
unit.target: Non minus quam duos semideos percussit.

unit.source: The Overseer of the School of Truth must have paid a steep price and offered up a considerable number of precious items.”
unit.target: Overseer Scholae Veritatis certe pretio ingenti solvisset atque multas res pretiosas offerre debuisset.

unit.source: Sure, that’s all true, but what’s it got to do with you?
unit.target: Certe, haec omnia vera sunt, sed quid ad te pertinet?

unit.source: Why are you so worked up about it?
unit.target: Cur de ea tam vehementer commota es?

unit.source: Jenna blinked, struggling to grasp Franca’s train of thought.
unit.target: Jenna palpebravit, conata Francae cogitationem comprehendere.

unit.source: Franca elaborated, “Once Madam Judgment apprehends or eliminates him with our assistance, there won’t be much left in terms of spoils of war for us to divvy up.
unit.target: Franca enarravit: «Quondam Domina Iudicium, cum auxilio nostro eum caperet aut exstirparet, parum reliquum erit ex praediis belli ad dividendum nobis.

unit.source: We might end up with another penniless target like Jebus!”
unit.target: Fortasse alterum sine pecunia destinatum, sicut Jebus, habebimus!

unit.source: Lumian, Jenna, and Anthony were momentarily at a loss for words.
unit.target: Lumian, Jenna, et Anthony per momentum verbis destituti erant.

unit.source: You’re already worrying about hypothetical future spoils?
unit.target: Iam de praediis belli futuris hypotheticis sollicita es?

unit.source: Lumian shifted the topic and turned to Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Lumian sermonem mutavit et ad Francam atque Jennam se vertit.

unit.source: “When I posed those final two questions to Jebus, why did you two lean in closer to me? Did you sense that something was about to go awry?”
unit.target: «Cum ultimas duas quaestiones Jebum posuissem, cur vos duo propius ad me inclinastis? Sensistisne aliquid imminere male?»

unit.source: “Naturally, it was a Demoness’s intuitive premonition,” Franca declared smugly.
unit.target: «Certe, erat intuitiva praemonitio Demonissae,» Franca superbius dixerat.

unit.source: While I couldn’t pinpoint what exactly would happen, being nearer to you provided me with more options for dealing with potential threats.
unit.target: Quamquam quid exacte eveniret definire non potui, propius ad vos esse mihi plures optiones ad pericula tractanda praebebat.

unit.source: Jenna gave a subtle nod, indicating that she felt the same way.
unit.target: Jenna subdole caput inclinavit, indicans se idem sentire.

unit.source: Lumian faced Anthony. “What about you?”
unit.target: Lumian Antonium respexit. «Et tu quid?»

unit.source: Anthony answered honestly, “I suspected that the last two questions would snap Jebus out of his hypnotic state.
unit.target: Anthony honestē respondit: «Suspicabar ultimas duas quaestiones Jebum e statu suo hypnotico evellere.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna’s reactions indirectly validated my concerns.
unit.target: Responsiones Francae et Jennæ indirecte meas curas confirmaverunt.»

unit.source: “Given that, it seemed prudent to take cover behind you two.”
unit.target: «Quamobrem, videbatur prudentissimum esse, ut me sub vobis duos texerem.»

unit.source: “So you’re using us as human shields?” Franca remarked with a wry smile.
unit.target: «Ita nos ut scuta humana uteris?» Franca cum risu aspero inquit.

unit.source: Anthony nodded earnestly. “You two have Mirror Substitution at your disposal.”
unit.target: Anthony sincē caput inclinavit. «Vobis duobus substitutio speculi ad usum praesto est.»

unit.source: “Fair point,” Franca conceded.
unit.target: «Recte,» Franca concedit.

unit.source: After a short while, Madam Judgment’s messenger delivered a response.
unit.target: Post parvum tempus, nuntius Dominae Iudicium responsum attulit.

unit.source: The message was succinct: “Proceed with your course of action.”
unit.target: Nuntius concisus erat: «Procedite in cursum vestrum agendi.»

unit.source: Does this imply that the Major Arcana cardholders will monitor the situation?
unit.target: Num hoc significat tenentes cartarum Major Arcana rem observaturos esse?

unit.source: Have they consulted with Ma’am Hermit?
unit.target: Num consulerunt cum Domina Eremita?

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully and grinned at Franca and the others.
unit.target: Lumian, cogitans, caput inclinavit et ad Francam atque ceteros subridens respexit.

unit.source: “Let’s stick to our initial plan.”
unit.target: «Maneamus ad consilium nostrum initium.»

unit.source: “The initial plan?” Franca started, taken aback.
unit.target: «Consilium initium?» Franca incepit, stupefacta.

unit.source: “Precisely,” Lumian confirmed, still smiling.
unit.target: «Prorsus,» Lumian confirmavit, adhuc subridente.

unit.source: “Over the next several hours, potentially even a full day, the Overseer and the other Mirror People certainly won’t be guarding Moran Avigny from behind the full‐length mirror in his study.
unit.target: «Per proximas horas, fortasse etiam totam diem, Overseor et ceteri Homines Specularum certe Moran Avigny non custodiabunt ab speculo pleno in studio suo.»

unit.source: That should be a necessary condition for the Under the Table transaction to succeed.
unit.target: Id debet esse conditionis necessariae ad transactionem “sub mensa” perficiendam.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black has already inspected those locations, and the Overseer is unaware of when she might do so again.
unit.target: Demonissa Nigra iam illos locos inspicuit, et Overseor nescit quando illa iterum id facere possit.

unit.source: He needs to allow sufficient time.
unit.target: Ei sufficiens tempus concedendus est.

unit.source: “Put another way, if we conceal ourselves within that mirror, we’ll be safe from disruption and harm.”
unit.target: «Alio modo dictum, si nos intra illum speculum celamus, a perturbatione et laesione salvi erimus.»

unit.source: Jenna’s brow furrowed slightly.
unit.target: Frons Jennæ leviter corrugata est.

unit.source: “But doesn’t the heart of the issue lie in the fact that Moran Avigny won’t be entering the full‐length mirror anytime soon?
unit.target: «Num non in ipsa re cordis consistit quod Moran Avigny cito in speculum plenum non intrabit?

unit.source: How can we ambush him…”
unit.target: Quomodo eum insidiari possumus…»

unit.source: Jenna abruptly trailed off, as if a thought had just occurred to her.
unit.target: Jenna subito cessavit loqui, quasi mox cogitatio illi advenisset.

unit.source: Lumian’s grin widened. “The Overseer may resort to an Under the Table transaction, but so can we!”
unit.target: Risus Lumiani latius expansus est. «Overseer ad transactionem “sub mensa” recursus esse potest, sed et nos id efficere possumus!»

unit.source: “Indeed, the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction!” Franca immediately grasped Lumian’s implication.
unit.target: «Certe, transactio “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis!» Franca statim sensum Lumiani captavit.

unit.source: Lumian planned to harness the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction to plant the idea in Moran Avigny’s mind to re‐enter the full‐length mirror!
unit.target: Lumian consilium ceperat ut transactionem “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis adhiberet, ut ideam in mente Moran Avigny insideret, de reintroitu in speculum plenum instauranda.

unit.source: As for how an Under the Table transaction would enable such an arrangement to work, that wasn’t their concern.
unit.target: Quoad quomodo transactio “sub mensa” talem ordinationem efficere posset, id non eorum cura erat.

unit.source: Even the Overseer probably didn’t know the inner workings of the Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Etiam Overseor probabiliter interna transactionis “sub mensa” non novit.

unit.source: Under the Table dealings were, in a sense, a black box!
unit.target: Negotia “sub mensa”, quatenus quidem, erant quasi arca nigra!

unit.source: With Magic Mirror Divination verifying the level of risk, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony ventured into the enigmatic and shadowy realm via the mirror world entrance affixed to the jutting rock.
unit.target: Magica Speculi Divinatio periculum gradu probans, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony in regnum arcānum et umbraticum per ingressum mundi specularis in saxo protuberante adfixum se contulerunt.

unit.source: Surveying the spiderweb-like void passageways stretching to unknown destinations, Lumian activated the Mirror Mark contract imprinted on him.
unit.target: Percontans vias vacuas retis araneae similes, quae ad ignotas destinationes extendebantur, Lumian contractum Sigilli Speculi in se impressum activavit.

unit.source: He then addressed Franca and the others, “I can detect the full‐length mirror and determine its precise whereabouts.”
unit.target: Deinde Francae et ceteris dedit verba: «Speculum plenum detegere atque eius locum exacte determinare possum.»

unit.source: “In that case, let’s make our way there immediately.”
unit.target: «Ergo, statim, pergemus ad illuc.»

unit.source: Franca pulled up her Assassin suit’s hood once more and latched onto Lumian’s arm.
unit.target: Franca iterum cucullam vestis assassinorum sustulit et ad brachium Lumiani se alligavit.

unit.source: She had already donned the Mirror Cufflink, but why squander one of its uses when other means were available?
unit.target: Iamdudum fibulam specularis induta erat, sed cur unum ex eius usibus perdere, cum alia media praesto essent?

unit.source: As soon as Jenna and Anthony grabbed hold of him again, Lumian triggered the Spirit World Traversal mark and teleported through one of the dark, vacant passageways to a deep, black aqueous light.
unit.target: Statim ut Jenna et Anthony eum iterum prehendere coeptis sunt, Lumian signum Transitus Spiritus Mundi activavit et per unum ex viis obscuris et vacuis in lucem aquaticam profundam nigram se teleportavit.

unit.source: The aqueous light signified a mirror with a corresponding hazy zone linked to myriad illusory tunnels akin to spiderwebs.
unit.target: Lux aquosa speculum significabat, cuius regio nebulosa correspondebat ad innumerabiles tunellos fallacibus, similes retibus araneis.

unit.source: Lumian peered into the dark aqueous light and observed the scene through the glass mirror. It was undoubtedly Moran Avigny’s study.
unit.target: Lumian in lucem aquaticam obscuram intuebatur et scaenam per speculum vitri observavit. Indubitate, erat studium Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Franca likewise recognized the target’s position and breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Franca quoque locum destinatæ agnovit et suspirum levationis exhalavit.

unit.source: “I’ll handle the Under the Table transaction.”
unit.target: «Ego transactionem “sub mensa” curabo.»

unit.source: “Allow me.” Lumian smiled. “Given what transpired earlier, I might encounter Demons even without the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction. In that case, I might as well use it freely.”
unit.target: «Permitte mihi,» Lumian subridens inquit. «Quod ante evenit, fortasse daemonibus occurram etiam sine transactione “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis; in illo casu, libere id adhibere possum.»

unit.source: He was alluding to the events surrounding Naboredisley.
unit.target: Ad res circa Naboredisley versatos alludebat.

unit.source: “Very well.” Franca yielded to Lumian’s reasoning. “Then I’ll cover the cost!”
unit.target: «Valde bene.» Franca ratione Lumiani cessit. «Ergo sumptus solvam!»

unit.source: She produced 5,000 verl d’or worth of gold from her Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ex sacco viatoris, aurum prodidit cum valore 5,000 verl d’or.

unit.source: Lumian accepted without protest and said to Jenna and the others, “The transaction I aim to complete is to instill in Moran Avigny the notion of entering the full‐length mirror in his study. Then, I’ll employ Compelling Fate to transform that notion into reality.”
unit.target: Lumian sine dissentire accepit et ad Jennam atque ceteros dixerat: «Transactio quam perficere opto est, ut in mente Moran Avigny notionem inseram ut in speculum plenum in studio suo ingrediatur; deinde Fatum Coactum adhibebo, ut illam notionem in rem veram transformem.»

unit.source: “This is far simpler than directly compelling Moran Avigny to enter the mirror. The price will undoubtedly be lower.”
unit.target: «Hoc longe simplicius est quam directe cogere Moran Avigny ut speculum intraret; pretium indubitanter minorem erit.»

unit.source: “Understood.” Jenna retrieved the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction from her backpack.
unit.target: «Intelligo.» Jenna ex sacculo suo extraxit transactionem “sub mensa” Auctoris Potestatis.

unit.source: The small, dark wooden box still had eight uses remaining.
unit.target: Parva, atra arca lignea adhuc octo usus reliquos habebat.

unit.source: Lumian grasped Franca’s pouch of gold coins in his right hand and reached through the membrane-like “curtain.”
unit.target: Lumian marsupium aureorum nummorum Francae in manu dextra apprehendit et per velum simile membranae tendit.

unit.source: He then felt five damp, wrinkled fingers. They swiftly closed around the pouch containing the gold coins.
unit.target: Deinde quinque digiti humidi et rugosi sensit; celeriter circum marsupium, quod nummos aureos continebat, complectebantur.

unit.source: Lumian’s expression remained neutral as he articulated his request in Hermes.
unit.target: Vultus Lumiani manebat aequus, dum petitionem suam in lingua “Hermes” enarrabat.

unit.source: After a brief pause, the wrinkled, moist palm returned the pouch of gold coins.
unit.target: Post breve intervallum, palma rugosa et humida marsupium aureorum nummorum reddidit.

unit.source: Wh— Lumian glanced up and apprised Franca and the others of the development.
unit.target: Quid— Lumian sursum aspexit et Francam atque ceteros de progressu certiorem fecit.

unit.source: Franca promptly understood. “It’s demanding more money!”
unit.target: Franca statim intellexit. «Plus pecuniae postulat!»

unit.source: Her heart sank as she produced additional banknotes and gold, but the slightly cold, wrinkled palm kept rejecting the payment.
unit.target: Cor eius deiectum est, dum alias chartas monetarias et aurum prodidit, sed palma modice frigida et rugosa iterum pretium reiecit.

unit.source: Lumian contributed tens of thousands of verl d’or, yet the transaction still wouldn’t go through.
unit.target: Lumian decies milia verl d’or attulit, tamen transactio adhuc non procedebat.

unit.source: “Could it be that Under the Table doesn’t desire money or gold?” Jenna recalled Jebus’s insights regarding the Broker pathway.
unit.target: «Num fieri potest ut “sub mensa” non desideret pecuniam aut aurum?» Jenna recordata est intuitionem Jebus de semita Broker.

unit.source: “Perhaps it requires a mystical item?” Lumian pondered, considering what he could offer.
unit.target: «Fortasse rem mysticam requiritur?» Lumian meditatus est, quid offerre posset.

unit.source: Franca deliberated for a moment before suggesting, “What about the Blood Gold ring? It has considerable drawbacks, and we’ve hardly used it.”
unit.target: Franca paulisper deliberavit, deinde suadens: «Quid de anulo Aurosanguineo? Habet incommoditates considerabiles, atque vix id usi sumus.»

unit.source: The Blood Gold ring had come from Mad Lady and corresponded to some of the capabilities of a Sequence 6 Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway.
unit.target: Anulus Aurosanguineus ex “Mad Lady” ortus erat et cum quibusdam facultatibus “Sequence 6 Rose Bishop” itineris Secretorum Supplicantium conveniebat.

unit.source: The four of them conferred for a while before deciding to attempt the transaction with the Blood Gold ring.
unit.target: Quattuor aliquantulum consultaverunt antequam decreverunt transactionem cum anulo Aurosanguineo tentare.

unit.source: The moment the Blood Gold ring touched Under the Table, the five fingers of the palm clenched firmly and withdrew, taking the ring with them.
unit.target: Mox, cum anulus Aurosanguineus “sub mensa” contigisset, quinque digiti palmae firmiter contracti sunt et recedentes anulum secum allotaverunt.

unit.source: This indicated that the deal had been finalized.
unit.target: Hoc indicabat pactum finaliter conclusum esse.

unit.source: Phew… Lumian exhaled in relief and remarked, “I’m curious to see how the Under the Table transaction will unfold…”
unit.target: Fuf… Lumian leviter suspiravit et inquit: «Curiosus sum videre quomodo transactio “sub mensa” evolvetur…»

unit.source: Franca pressed a hand to her chest and prayed to Mr. Fool, “Please don’t let us run into any swindlers. Praise The Fool!”
unit.target: Franca manum ad pectus premens ad Dominum Stultum oravit: «Quaeso, ne in fallacibus incidamus. Laudate Stultum!»

unit.source: 720 Unexpected “Helper”
unit.target: 720 Inopinatus “Adiutor”

unit.source: The word “swindler” hung in the air, leaving Lumian and the others in stunned silence as similar thoughts raced through their minds.
unit.target: Verbum “fraudator” in aere pendebat, relinquens Lumian et ceteros in stupefacto silentio, dum similes cogitationes per mentes eorum cucurrerent.

unit.source: Surely they couldn’t be that unlucky, right?
unit.target: Certe non poterant esse tam infausti, nonne?

unit.source: Jebus had warned them about the possibility of running into swindlers during an Under the Table deal, but Franca’s previous experiences with Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction had always been reliable.
unit.target: Jebus eos monuerat de possibilitate fraudatoribus incidendi in pacto sub mensa, sed experimenta praeterita Francae cum Transactio sub mensa a Titulari Auctoritatum semper fiebant certa.

unit.source: Plus, the Blood Gold ring had been accepted this time around.
unit.target: Praeterea, annulus “Blood Gold” hoc tempore acceptus erat.

unit.source: If Lumian hadn’t been personally overseeing the transaction, he would’ve used the Eye of Calamity to assess the likelihood of it being finalized and look for ways to interfere.
unit.target: Si Lumian transactionem non personaliter curaverat, Oculum Calamitatis ad aestimandum verisimilitudinem eius consummationis atque vias intercedendi quaerendos adhibuisset.

unit.source: But for now, the four of them had no choice but to wait patiently.
unit.target: Sed nunc, quattuor eorum nihil aliud facere potuerant quam patienter exspectare.

unit.source: Hidden behind the dark, watery light, they watched the scene unfolding in the study through the glass mirror.
unit.target: Sub obscuro et aquoso lumine absconditi, spectabant scaenam in studiō evolventem per speculum vitrum.

unit.source: As the night wore on, Lumian and his companions nibbled on the rations he’d packed for Ludwig in his Traveler’s Bag to keep their hunger at bay.
unit.target: Dum nox progrediebatur, Lumian et comites eius victus parvos, quos pro Ludovico in sacco Itineris paraverat, deglutiebant ut famem temperarent.

unit.source: Close to 10 p.m., Moran Avigny strode into the study, leaving the wooden door wide open.
unit.target: Circiter ad horam decimam vespertinam, Moran Avigny in studiō processit, relinquens ostium ligneum late apertum.

unit.source: He sank into an armchair beneath the gas wall lamp, grabbed a book from a nearby pile, and began casually flipping through it.
unit.target: Sub lampade gasi parietali, in sellam armachiem consedit, librum ex pila proxima arripuit, et leniter per paginas illius transire coepit.

unit.source: The Purifier team tasked with his protection remained stationed at the door as usual, never setting foot inside.
unit.target: Turma Purificatorum, quae eum protegere debebat, ut solitum erat, ad ostium mansit, numquam intus ingrediens.

unit.source: Moran Avigny had always insisted on this arrangement.
unit.target: Moran Avigny semper hanc dispositionem instabat.

unit.source: He’d even signed contracts with the Purifiers, Machinery Hivemind members, and Bureau 8 team, acknowledging that he was willing to take on the associated risks.
unit.target: Etiam cum Purificatoribus, membris Machinery Hivemind, et turmis Bureau 8 contractus subscripsit, agnoscens se pericula huiusmodi subire paratum esse.

unit.source: The security detail understood.
unit.target: Custodes intellexerunt.

unit.source: A politician’s study likely concealed all sorts of shady secrets.
unit.target: Studium politicum probabiliter celabat omnia genera obscurarum arcanorum.

unit.source: Keeping people with Beyonder powers from entering was a way for Moran Avigny to protect himself.
unit.target: Impediendo homines cum facultatibus Beyonder intrare, Moran Avigny se protegebat.

unit.source: As was his custom, Moran Avigny left the study door open instead of shutting it, making it simpler for the Purifiers to keep an eye out for any potential trouble.
unit.target: Ut morebatur, Moran Avigny ostium studii aperitum relinquebat, potius quam claudebat, ut Purificatores facilem speciem cuiuslibet futurae perturbationis inspicere possent.

unit.source: While perusing the books, Moran Avigny would occasionally glance up at the full‐length mirror positioned just out of the Purifiers’ line of sight, his thoughts seemingly far away.
unit.target: Dum libros perlegit, interdum Moran Avigny sursum speculum totum positum, extra lineam visus Purificatorum intuebatur, cum eius cogitationes remotas videbantur.

unit.source: At the same time, Lumian’s eyes, hidden within the mirror, glinted a silvery‐black.
unit.target: Simul, oculi Luminum, in speculo occulti, micabant in luce nigro–argentea.

unit.source: Peering through the glass, he studied Moran Avigny’s river of fate.
unit.target: Per vitrum intuebatur, et flumen fatum Moran Avigny diligenter contemplatus est.

unit.source: Looking closer, he confirmed that the Minister of Industry had indeed gained several new fate tributaries involving stepping into the full‐length mirror.
unit.target: Propius intuebatur, confirmavit Minister Industriae revera plures novas fatum tributarias adeptus esse, quae implicabant ingressum in speculum totum.

unit.source: One of them was even cloaked in a thick, black hue.
unit.target: Unus eorum etiam crasso et nigro tegmine velatus erat.

unit.source: Seizing the moment when Moran Avigny ducked his head to resume reading, Lumian slowly reached his right palm out from the mirror, pressing it firmly against the glass as if it were merely a reflection.
unit.target: Aprehendens momentum, cum Moran Avigny caput inclinavit ut legendum resumere, Lumian paulatim dextram manum ex speculo protulit, eam contra vitrum firmiter prementem, quasi solum reflexus esset.

unit.source: Then, he unleashed his remaining spirituality, transforming it into a raging, phantom river that surged toward the mercury stream symbolizing Moran Avigny’s fate from a few meters away.
unit.target: Tum reliquam spiritualitatem suam efferre coepit, eam in flumen phantasmatum et furibundum vertens, quod ad flumen mercurii, fati Moran Avigny repraesentans, paucos metra propinquo impetum habebat.

unit.source: The main trunk of Moran Avigny’s fate swallowed up the other tributaries and rushed into the dense, black one.
unit.target: Truncus principalis fati Moran Avigny reliquas tributarias absorpsit atque in densum, nigrum cursum properavit.

unit.source: Compelling Fate!
unit.target: Fatum compellens!

unit.source: Channeling the spirituality he’d accumulated using his Ascetic abilities, Lumian quickly withdrew his palm to avoid tipping off Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Spiritualitatem, quam per virtutes asceticās collegerat, canalizans, Lumian celeriter retractavit dextram manum, ne Moran Avigny id admoneretur.

unit.source: He gave Franca and the others a nod, signaling that both the Under the Table deal and his Compelling of Fate had been successful.
unit.target: Francae et ceteris annuens, significavit quod et pactum sub mensa et fatum compellens feliciter evenissent.

unit.source: As for the exact way Moran Avigny would embark on this fated path, Lumian couldn’t say.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad modum exactum quo Moran Avigny hunc fatum iter inciperet, Lumian dicere non potuit.

unit.source: The details were beyond his sight.
unit.target: Singula extra conspectum eius erant.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna let out sighs of relief.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna suspiria levationis emiserunt.

unit.source: Not daring to speak lest they alert Moran Avigny, who possessed mirror‐related abilities, they shared their understanding with Lumian through gratified smiles and relaxed nods.
unit.target: Non ausi loqui ne Moran Avigny, qui facultates speculi habebat, avertirentur, intellegentiam suam cum Lumiano communicaverunt per risus gratos et annos lenes.

unit.source: They retreated to their positions, preparing for the upcoming ambush.
unit.target: Se recedebant ad sua loca, praeparantes ad insidias venturas.

unit.source: Just as fate was being compelled, Moran Avigny’s spirituality abruptly sensed a warning, filling him with a feeling of impending danger.
unit.target: Iam, cum fatum compellendum esset, spiritualitas Moran Avigny subito signum monitionis sensit, eum per sensum imminentis periculi replevit.

unit.source: The mirror message he’d received at dusk sprang to mind, and he started to suspect that the unknown enemy the Overseer had mentioned was plotting something that could put his life at risk.
unit.target: Nuntius speculi, quem ad vesperum accepit, mente revocatus est, et coepit suspicari hostem ignotum, quem Overseor mentionaverat, aliquid machinari quod vitam eius in discrimen adduceret.

unit.source: Unable to resist, Moran Avigny glanced at the full‐length mirror once more, debating whether to flee into it and abandon this place before the Purifiers had a chance to react.
unit.target: Non posse resistere, Moran Avigny iterum in speculum totum intuebatur, deliberans utrum in illud fugiendum esset et hunc locum relinquendum antequam Purificatores agere possent.

unit.source: He yearned to shed his current identity and vanish completely from the hidden enemy’s radar.
unit.target: Desiderabat identitatem suam praesentem abicere et omnino evanescere ex radario hostis occulti.

unit.source: Fighting back his impulses, he turned his head to look at the Purifiers standing guard at the door.
unit.target: Pugnans impulsus suos reprimebat, caput vertens ad Purificatores stantes ad ostium spectare.

unit.source: There could be a trap lurking behind the mirror.
unit.target: Forsitan insidiae lateant post speculum.

unit.source: His best bet was to pray that the official Beyonders would be able to shield him!
unit.target: Optimum consilium eius erat orare ut Beyonderi officiales eum tueri possent!

unit.source: This is Trier, and I’m a minister of the country!
unit.target: Hic est Trier, et ego minister patriae sum!

unit.source: Right then, his valet appeared at the door, carrying a glass of warm milk.
unit.target: Statim tunc, valet eius ad ostium apparuit, poculum vitreo lactis calidi ferens.

unit.source: Drinking warm milk before showering and brushing his teeth was part of Moran Avigny’s nightly routine to help him sleep.
unit.target: Bibere lac calidum ante se lavandum et dentes purgandos pars erat consuetudinis vespertinae Moran Avigny, ad dormitum eum adiuvandum.

unit.source: The Purifiers carried out their standard checks before permitting the valet to enter the study.
unit.target: Purificatores regulas proprias perfecerunt antequam valetum in studiō ingredi licuisset.

unit.source: “Your milk, Sir,” the valet said deferentially, extending a white porcelain cup brimming with the liquid.
unit.target: “Lac tuum, Domine,” valet deferenter dixit, calicem album porcellaneum liquidum plenum extendens.

unit.source: Moran Avigny had made immense contributions to Intis’s industrial growth and had been awarded the Legion of Honor medal, earning him the rank of Knight.
unit.target: Moran Avigny ingentes contributiones ad incrementum industriale Intis fecerat et medallium Legionis Honor adeptus erat, gradum Equitis comparans.

unit.source: Nodding his head slightly, Moran Avigny reached out his right hand to accept the glass.
unit.target: Paululum caput annuens, Moran Avigny dextram manum protulit ad poculum accipiendum.

unit.source: All of a sudden, he noticed his valet’s eyes cloud over, an indescribable agony lurking in their depths.
unit.target: Subito animadvertit oculos valeti sui nubilos fieri, cum in imis eorum dolor ineffabilis latuit.

unit.source: A heartbeat later, the valet’s mouth flew open and he vomited.
unit.target: Post unum ictum cordis, os valeti patefactum est et vomuit.

unit.source: What he spat out was a solid, writhing chunk of blood-colored flesh, hurled directly at Moran Avigny!
unit.target: Quod vomuit, frustum solidum et contortum carnis sanguinei colore, directe in Moran Avigny iactum est!

unit.source: The flesh swiftly ballooned, morphing into a cloak of flesh and blood that wrapped around Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Caro celeriter inflavit, formans pallium ex carne et sanguine, quod circa Moran Avigny involutum est.

unit.source: It wriggled inward, seemingly trying to force its way into the Minister of Industry’s body.
unit.target: Intus contorquebatur, quasi viam suam in corpus Ministri Industriae intromitti conaretur.

unit.source: In the mirror, Lumian was stunned.
unit.target: In speculo, Lumian stupefactus erat.

unit.source: This aura…
unit.target: Haec aura…

unit.source: It’s Mr. K!
unit.target: Est Dominus K!

unit.source: Why had he shown up out of nowhere to try to assassinate Moran Avigny?
unit.target: Cur ex nusquam apparuit ut Moran Avigny interficeret?

unit.source: With a sharp crack, Moran Avigny, cocooned in the flesh‐and‐blood cloak, transformed into a mirror and shattered.
unit.target: Cum acuto crepitu, Moran Avigny, in pallio carne et sanguine involutus, in speculum conversus est et confractus est.

unit.source: Nearly simultaneously, the Purifiers at the door sprang into action.
unit.target: Paene simul, Purificatores ad ostium in actionem subitam accesserunt.

unit.source: A column of pure light wreathed in flames plummeted from the sky, bathing the cloak and causing it to visibly start melting.
unit.target: Columna luminis puri, flammis circumdata, de caelo labens descendit, pallium operiens et evidenter liquefieri coepisse faciens.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Moran Avigny spun around without hesitation and lunged at the mirror nearest to him.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Moran Avigny sine mora circumvertit et in speculum proximum sibi impetum fecit.

unit.source: He had already revealed Mirror Substitution to the Purifiers.
unit.target: Iam speculi substitutionem Purificatoribus revelaverat.

unit.source: Short of eliminating every witness without a trace, he would undoubtedly face intense scrutiny later on and lose the protection of the contract.
unit.target: Nisi omnes testes sine vestigio tolleretur, certo postea severam inspectionem subiret et tutelam contractus amitteret.

unit.source: His only option was to take advantage of this chance to escape through the mirror world while the Purifiers tangled with the assassin!
unit.target: Sola eius optio erat ut occasionem hujus caperet, per mundum speculi effugiendi, dum Purificatores cum sicario certabant!

unit.source: As he watched Moran Avigny’s figure loom larger and nearer to the full‐length mirror, a thought abruptly struck Lumian.
unit.target: Dum figuram Moran Avigny, quae in speculo toto magis et propius appropinquabat, intuebatur, subito Lumian cogitationem accepit.

unit.source: Could this be fate?
unit.target: Num hoc fatum sit?

unit.source: He instantly retreated and disappeared.
unit.target: Statim se recepit atque evanuit.

unit.source: A moment later, Moran Avigny’s figure passed through the mirror, emerging behind the hazy, shadowy, and nearly vacant looking glass.
unit.target: Momento post, figura Moran Avigny per speculum transiit, emergens post vitrum nebulosum, umbratile, et paene vacuum aspectum habens.

unit.source: The Purifiers outside were shocked to see this.
unit.target: Purificatores foris stupefacti sunt, hoc videndo.

unit.source: At the same time, they grasped that something was seriously wrong with the target under their protection.
unit.target: Simul intellexerunt aliquid grave de scopo, quem protegebant, esse.

unit.source: Their attention wavered briefly.
unit.target: Eorum attentio paulisper vacillavit.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the distraction, Mr. K changed Grazing targets and teleported away from Moran Avigny’s residence.
unit.target: Utefacta distractione, Mr. K metas pascendi mutavit et ab domicilio Moran Avigny celeriter discessit.

unit.source: In the space behind the mirror, Moran Avigny didn’t linger.
unit.target: In spatio post speculum, Moran Avigny non remansit.

unit.source: He promptly activated Mirror Traversal, rapidly changing positions to throw off any would-be pursuers.
unit.target: Celeriter “Mirror Traversal” activavit, ac statuas celeriter mutans ut quoslibet insequentis confunderet.

unit.source: Just then, he felt his body grow inexplicably heavier, his movements oddly constricted, stopping him from successfully slipping into an empty, dark tunnel.
unit.target: Tunc sensit corpus suum inexplicabiliter gravius fieri atque motus eius insolite contrahendi, quod eum prohibebat ne feliciter in tuniculum vacuum et obscurum incidere posset.

unit.source: It was as though someone had seized him.
unit.target: Quasi aliquis eum apprehenderat.

unit.source: Right after that, Moran Avigny sensed invisible threads coiling around his limbs and torso, layer upon layer.
unit.target: Mox postea, Moran Avigny sensit fila invisibilia circa membra et corpus suum circumvoluta, stratum super stratum.

unit.source: With his Sheriff powers, he pinpointed the source of the sinister threads.
unit.target: Cum viribus praefectoriis, radicem horum filorum sinistrorum innotuit.

unit.source: They were close by.
unit.target: Erant prope.

unit.source: Moran Avigny angled his head marginally and peered at an empty corner.
unit.target: Modice caput inclinavit et in angulum vacuum intuebatur.

unit.source: His eyes flashed with two blinding “lightning bolts.”
unit.target: Oculi eius duos fulmina caecantia micaverunt.

unit.source: Psychic Piercing!
unit.target: Perforatio psychica!

unit.source: The “lightning” lanced out, hitting the empty spot.
unit.target: Fulmen exsulavit, locum vacuum percutiens.

unit.source: A sharp cracking rang out, scattering shards of shattered mirrors.
unit.target: Acuto crepitu auditus est, dispersans fragmenta speculorum confractarum.

unit.source: At the same instant, Jenna, dressed in a black gown and veiled bonnet, materialized behind Moran Avigny, gripping a small, elegant revolver.
unit.target: Idem tempore, Jenna, induta veste nigra et pileo velato, post Moran Avigny apparuit, revolverum parvum atque elegantem tenens.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: She squeezed the trigger, targeting Moran Avigny’s vest.
unit.target: Illa trigerum premuit, destinans ictum in vestem Moran Avigny.

unit.source: The yellow bullet, wreathed in silent black flames, struck the target’s body with precision at close range.
unit.target: Bala flava, in tacitas flammas nigras involuta, corpus destinatum prope cum praecisione percussit.

unit.source: Crack! Moran Avigny deployed Mirror Substitution yet again.
unit.target: Crepitus! Moran Avigny speculi substitutionem iterum diffudit.

unit.source: As broken mirrors rained down, his figure rematerialized in a different corner of the hazy space.
unit.target: Dum specula confracta pluvia cadebant, figura eius in angulo diverso spatii nebulosi rursum apparuit.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna vanished without a trace.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna sine ullo vestigio evanuerunt.

unit.source: Feeling the intangible threads enveloping him, Moran Avigny thrust out his right palm and intoned in ancient Hermes, “Invisibility is prohibited here!”
unit.target: Sensu filorum intangibilium eum circumvolventium, Moran Avigny dextram manum protulit et in antiqua lingua Hermetica intonavit: “Invisibilitas hic prohibetur!”

unit.source: The instant he uttered the final word, innumerable transparent spider silks undulated throughout the area, resembling seaweed blanketing a section of ocean.
unit.target: Statim quo verbum extremum edixit, innumerabiles filum transparentium araneorum per totam aream undulabant, similes algis marinis partem oceani tegens.

unit.source: Franca, garbed as an Assassin, and Jenna, clad in dark attire, circled or advanced, respectively, poised to strike again.
unit.target: Franca, ut Sicaria induta, et Jenna, veste obscura induta, circulabant vel progrediebantur, respective, paratae ad iterum feriendum.

unit.source: Realizing that the two foes couldn’t touch him for the moment and that the invisible spider silk hadn’t constricted, Moran Avigny had no time for a counterattack.
unit.target: Animadvertens hostes duo eum pro tempore tangere non posse et filum araneum invisibile non constrictum esse, Moran Avigny nullum tempus ad repugnationem habuit.

unit.source: He immediately sought to use Mirror Traversal to flee the area.
unit.target: Statim quaesivit uti “Mirror Traversal” ut aream effugeret.

unit.source: Out of nowhere, Moran Avigny’s eyes bulged, his expression contorting with viciousness.
unit.target: Ex nihilo, oculi Moran Avigny protulere, et vultus eius crudeli deformatus est.

unit.source: His body shattered once more, assuming the shape of a mirror.
unit.target: Corpus eius iterum confractum est, speculi formam assumens.

unit.source: Not far off, Anthony Reid, dressed like a veteran, “appeared.”
unit.target: Non longe, Anthony Reid, indutus ut veteranus, apparuit.

unit.source: He had just cast Frenzy on Moran Avigny!
unit.target: Nuper Frenzy in Moran Avigny immisit!

unit.source: The Prohibition of Invisibility rule didn’t constrain him since he wasn’t invisible.
unit.target: Regula invisibilitatis eum non coercebat, quoniam ipse invisibilis non erat.

unit.source: However, Moran Avigny himself hadn’t been looking in Anthony’s direction!
unit.target: Attamen, Moran Avigny ipse non ad Anthonyum spectabat!

unit.source: After employing Mirror Substitution multiple times, Moran Avigny rematerialized on the far side of the space, putting distance between himself and Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
unit.target: Post pluries speculi substitutionem usum, Moran Avigny in parte extrema spatii rematerializatus est, distantiam inter se et Francam, Jennam, atque Anthonyum imponens.

unit.source: Grasping that yet another enemy had entered the fray, he fled with intensified urgency.
unit.target: Animadvertens quod iterum hostis in certamen intraverat, celeriter evasit cum intensa urgentia.

unit.source: Right as Moran Avigny was poised to activate Mirror Traversal, Franca lowered her hood, unveiling her radiant, refined features.
unit.target: Statim, cum Moran Avigny paratus esset “Mirror Traversal” activare, Franca cappa sua deiecit, lineamenta sua radiosa ac exquisita revelans.

unit.source: As she did, the diamond necklace adorning her neck emitted a subtle glow.
unit.target: Dum id feceret, monile adamantinum, quod collum eius ornabat, levem fulgor emisit.

unit.source: Beatrice’s Necklace!
unit.target: Monile Beatricis!

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s body flushed with heat, his gaze magnetized to Franca’s lake-blue eyes, her high, delicate nose bridge, her fair, flawless skin, and her lush, crimson lips.
unit.target: Corpus Moran Avigny calore rubescens, oculi eius ad oculos Francae, caeruleos ut lacus, nasus altus et delicatus, cutis nitida et sine macula, labraque opima, coccinea, traxerunt.

unit.source: For an instant, his desire to escape slipped his mind.
unit.target: Instanti, desiderium eius effugiendi mente evanuit.

unit.source: The activation of Beatrice’s Necklace didn’t pose a direct threat to Moran Avigny’s life, so it failed to trigger Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Activatio Monili Beatricis non afferebat minas directas ad vitam Moran Avigny, itaque non excitavit “Mirror Substitution.”

unit.source: Moran Avigny lacked the time to deploy it himself.
unit.target: Moran Avigny tempus ad id ipsi exsequi non habebat.

unit.source: His cravings had already swelled beyond his control!
unit.target: Eius desideria iam ultra sui imperium extollerant!

unit.source: 721 Exhausting the Substitutes
unit.target: 721 Substitutiones Exhaurientes

unit.source: A Demoness of Pleasure didn’t possess an innately proactive charm, but she could maximize her allure to irresistible levels.
unit.target: Demonissa Voluptatis indolem proactivam naturalem non habebat, sed suam venustatem ad gradus irresistibiles extollere poterat.

unit.source: Even under normal circumstances, her magnetism could make most men unable to shift their gazes away, their breathing growing labored as their minds raced with desire.
unit.target: Etiam sub ordinariis condicionibus, eius magnetismus plerosque viros efficiebat ut oculos ab illa avertire non possent, cum respiratio eorum difficilis fieret et mentes desiderio ferventi incitabantur.

unit.source: Moran Avigny had certainly never been an Ascetic, and his lust was already inflamed by Beatrice’s Necklace.
unit.target: Moran Avigny certe numquam asceticus fuit, et eius concupiscentia a Collāre Beatricis iam inflammata erat.

unit.source: His focus was solely locked on Franca now, imagination running wild with tantalizing possibilities of what might happen next.
unit.target: Nunc sola eius intentio in Francā fixa erat, dum imaginātio ferociter per tentantes eventūs futūrōs vagabatur.

unit.source: Heart pounding, blood surging, his movements were affected—swift but erratic.
unit.target: Cor pulsans, sanguis effluens, et motūs eius celerēs sed incertae erant.

unit.source: A dawn-like glow emanated from Moran’s body, marking Franca as the target of his righteous punishment.
unit.target: Fulgor quasi aurōrae ex corpore Morānī emanavit, Francam designāns ut scopum poenāe iustae eius.

unit.source: This enhanced his influence and offensive power against the tempting demoness.
unit.target: Hoc ejus auctoritatem et vim offensivam adversus demonissam voluptātis incitantem augebat.

unit.source: As he selected her for punishment, Moran seemed to grow taller in Franca’s eyes, striking fear into her heart.
unit.target: Eligendo eam ad supplicium, Morānus in oculīs Francae altior apparēre videbātur, incūtens timorem in cordā eius.

unit.source: She sensed he was a formidable figure who could end her existence with a mere thought.
unit.target: Sentīvit eum esse formidābilem, qui sola cogitātiōne eius vitam termināre posset.

unit.source: She broke invisibility and tried to quickly shift positions.
unit.target: Invisibilitātem fregit et celeriter locum mutāre conātā est.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Moran thrust out his right hand, breathing hot and heavy, and spoke an ancient Hermes incantation: “Imprison!”
unit.target: Occasiōnem capiens, Morānus dextram manum protulit, calide et grave spirāns, et antiquam incantātiōnem Hermetis edixit: “Constringe!”

unit.source: Viscous amber liquid surged forth, enveloping Franca and freezing the demoness in place within a colossal transparent prison.
unit.target: Liquum ambra viscosum erupit, Francam amplectēns et demonissam in loco ingenti carcere translūcēnte immobilizāns.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: Franca’s form shattered, transforming into a palm-sized makeup mirror.
unit.target: Forma Francae confracta est, atque in speculum palmae mensūra conversum est.

unit.source: This allowed her to escape the Disciplinary Paladin’s Imprison.
unit.target: Hoc illi concessit ut evaderet clausa Palātī Disciplināri.

unit.source: Suddenly, powerful danger premonition gripped Moran.
unit.target: Subito, praemonitio periculi potentis Morānum obsēdit.

unit.source: Straining his enhanced physique, he broke free of the intangible spider silk ensnaring him and dove to the side.
unit.target: Corpus suum auctum exercentem, a telīs arāneae intangibilī, quae eum prehendebant, liberātus est et ad lātus desiluit.

unit.source: Jenna’s ice spike wreathed in unholy black flames narrowly missed its mark as she struck with all her might from the diagonal flank.
unit.target: Spīcula glaciei Jennāe, nigrīs flammīs impiīs involuta, vix destinātum attingebat, dum ex lātere diagonālī omni vi percutiebat.

unit.source: Moran’s eyes flicked to the Witch in her dark dress and bonnet.
unit.target: Oculī Morānī ad magam in vestī obscūrā et pileō conversī sunt.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but think she was quite appealing too.
unit.target: Non potuit quin existimāret eam quoque valde allicientem esse.

unit.source: Why not have both?
unit.target: Cur nōn utrumque habēre?

unit.source: Dropping to one knee, Moran reached out towards Jenna and bellowed another Hermes invocation: “Confinement!”
unit.target: Ad genu dēcidēns, Morānus ad Jennam protulit et aliam incantātiōnem Hermetis edīxit: “Contine!”

unit.source: Wordlessly, an immaterial wall materialized around Jenna, impenetrable even to her Spirit Body.
unit.target: Sine verbīs, mūrus immaterialis circa Jennam apparuit, quī nōn etiam ad corpus spirituale eius penetrare poterat.

unit.source: Rather than adhering directly to her, it generated a transparent cell with her at its center, thwarting any attempt at Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Pro eo quod directe eam complectere nōn poterat, cellam translūcēntem creāvit, in quā illa in mediō constitui erat, omni conātū substitutionis speculī obsistens.

unit.source: Taking note of this, Jenna opted not to strike the unseen barrier.
unit.target: Hoc observāns, Jennā decernit nōn percutere obstāculum invisibile.

unit.source: Instead, she enveloped herself in a layer of frost.
unit.target: Potius, se in strātō glaciæ cingit.

unit.source: Beyond the frost was another layer of frost—a delicate vacuum formed, transforming Jenna into a frozen statue.
unit.target: Ultrā glaciem erat aliud strātum glaciæ, vacuum delicatum formāns, quod Jennam in statuam congelatam convertit.

unit.source: “Confinement!”
unit.target: “Contine!”

unit.source: Moran Avigny didn’t immediately press his advantage against Jenna.
unit.target: Morānus Avigny nōn statim suam utilitātem adversus Jennam extulit.

unit.source: His bloodshot eyes fixed on Franca as he confined the space surrounding the Demoness of Pleasure.
unit.target: Oculī eius, ruborē affectī, in Francam fixī erant, dum spatium circa demonissam voluptātis continebat.

unit.source: Franca remained unresponsive as black flames surged forth from her form.
unit.target: Francā immota remansit, dum ex eius forma flammae nigræ erumpere coeperunt.

unit.source: Outside the black blaze, strata of frost coalesced, fashioning a translucent, sturdy sarcophagus.
unit.target: Extra ignem nigrum, strāta glaciei conglutinabantur, formantes sarcophāgum rōbustum et translūcentem.

unit.source: Transparent spider silk wound around her, cocooning the frost in spirals.
unit.target: Translūcentēs telā arāneā circa eam circumvolvit, glaciem in spirīs convolvens.

unit.source: Wh— Moran Avigny, though perplexed by the Demoness of Pleasure’s peculiar behavior, took satisfaction in the success of his Confinement, circumventing the effects of Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Heu— Morānus Avigny, quamvis de mōribus peculiāribus demonissae voluptātis perplexus, in successū continentiae suā delectābātur, effectūs substitutionis speculī circumfugēns.

unit.source: His movements somewhat warped, he lunged at Franca.
unit.target: Motūs eius aliquantulum deformātī erant; impetum ad Francam fecit.

unit.source: His mind raced with the powers he would unleash next and the consequences of bringing her under his control.
unit.target: Mensa eius celeriter currit de viribus quās sequenti emittens atque de consequentiīs eam sub potestate redigendi.

unit.source: He had almost forgotten the presence of the Spectator, but Anthony had slipped into a blind spot.
unit.target: Fere oblītus erat praesentiae Speculatoris, sed Anthony in angulō caeco lapsus est.

unit.source: No matter, I’ll subdue the two Demonesses first!
unit.target: Nihil refert, duās demonissās primum subīgam!

unit.source: The instant this notion crossed Moran Avigny’s mind, a faintly piercing melody abruptly resounded in his ears.
unit.target: Cum ista cogitātiō mentem Morānī Avigny attingeret, tenuis et acūtus melos subito in auribus eius resonavit.

unit.source: Lumian stepped out from the corner shadows, the black Symphony of Hatred bone flute at his lips.
unit.target: Lumian ex angulō umbrārum processit, flautā ossium nigrā Symphoniā Odīī ad labiīs habēns.

unit.source: Prohibition of Invisibility hadn’t compelled him to reveal himself, as he wasn’t invisible to begin with.
unit.target: Interdictiō invisibilitātis eum nōn coegit se ostendere, nam ab initio invisibilis nōn erat.

unit.source: He had merely shape-shifted into a shadow being, blending with the shadows!
unit.target: Modo se in ens umbrārum versūtum mutāvit, cum umbrīs coniungēns!

unit.source: Lumian studied Moran Avigny’s face, twisted by desire.
unit.target: Lumian faciem Morānī Avigny, desideriō distortam, perspexit.

unit.source: Approaching with a grin, he played the melody with intensified vigor.
unit.target: Accedēns cum risū, melodiam cum augetō vigōre canēns.

unit.source: Given Moran Avigny’s state, he was certain the Symphony of Hatred’s exploitation of vulnerabilities would undeniably inflame the other’s cravings.
unit.target: Considerātō statu Morānī Avigny, certus erat quod usus vulnerābilitātum per Symphoniam Odīī alīus cupiditās indubitanter inflammāret.

unit.source: Employing his Fate Appropriator’s abilities in tandem was unnecessary.
unit.target: Facultātēs Fātī Appropriatoris simul adhibēre supervacuum esse videbātur.

unit.source: Amid the lively, cutting music, Moran Avigny’s body abruptly went rigid.
unit.target: Inter musicam vivacem et acutam, corpus Morānī Avigny subito rigescit.

unit.source: With a cracking noise, he invoked Mirror Substitution to endure the nearly lethal assault on his behalf.
unit.target: Cum crepitu, Substitutionem Speculī invocāvēt, ut impetum fere letālem sibi tolerāret.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s silhouette manifested behind Lumian, but Lumian’s performance persisted, and the nigh-explosive lust gripping Moran Avigny remained unabated.
unit.target: Silhouetta Morānī Avigny post Luminum apparuit, sed actiō Luminum perseverābat, et luxuria paene explosīva, quā Morānus Avigny teneātur, nōn cessābat.

unit.source: Crack! Crack! Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus! Crepitus! Crepitus!

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s form repeatedly fractured like a mirror, rematerializing in the ever-quickening melody.
unit.target: Forma Morānī Avigny iterum quasi speculum confracta est, et in melodiā semper accelerantī rematerializāta est.

unit.source: He couldn’t flee the vicinity, nor could he spare a moment to obstruct his hearing.
unit.target: Nōn potuit exīre vicinitātem, neque tempus habuit ut auditum suum impedīret.

unit.source: The captivating strains of the Symphony of Hatred permeated every nook of the space behind the mirror.
unit.target: Notae captivānēs Symphoniae Odīī omnem angulum spatii post speculum impregnāverunt.

unit.source: Anthony crouched in a corner, employing a prop he had readied beforehand to shield his ears.
unit.target: Anthony in angulō incumbēns, utens instrumentō iam praeparātō ad aurēs suas tuendās.

unit.source: He was set to bank on the mirror to induce a trance and plunge into deep sleep, thus evading Lumian’s lethal melody that spared neither friend nor foe.
unit.target: Ipse constituit speculum ut ūtiliter ad transe inducendum et in profundum somnum se immergeret, ita melos letālem Luminum, quī neque amicos neque hostēs parcit, evitāns.

unit.source: Despite his preparations, grayish-white dragon scales involuntarily surfaced on his skin.
unit.target: Nōn obstānte praeparātiōne, squamārum dracōrum cinereo-albārum in cute eius involuntāriē apparuērunt.

unit.source: Crack! Crack! Moran Avigny’s Mirror Substitution had at last been exhausted.
unit.target: Crepitus! Crepitus! Substitutio Speculī Morānī Avigny tandem exhausta fuit.

unit.source: His mind reeled, and he experienced overwhelming pleasure, a surge of euphoria.
unit.target: Mens eius vertiginem sensit, atque voluptatem ingentem ac euphoriā impetu percipiēbat.

unit.source: His frame shuddered with pain and rapture.
unit.target: Corpus eius dolore et extāsī concussum tremebat.

unit.source: Blood seeped from his nostrils, eyes, ears, and mouth.
unit.target: Sanguis ex nāribus, oculīs, auribus, et ore eius effluxit.

unit.source: His saliva, mucus, and tears streamed all at once, as though he teetered on the brink of collapse.
unit.target: Salīva, mucus, et lacrimae eius simul effluērunt, quasi in mārgine ruinae versāretur.

unit.source: Lumian appeared behind him, lowered the Symphony of Hatred, and snorted.
unit.target: Lumian post eum apparuit, Symphoniam Odīī deiecit, et sibilāvit.

unit.source: Twin beams of white light struck Moran Avigny, plunging the Disciplinary Paladin into unconsciousness.
unit.target: Geminae radiī lucis albae Morānum Avigny percussērunt, immergentes Palātum Disciplinārium in inōscientiam.

unit.source: Lumian afforded Moran Avigny no opportunity to harness his unique powers to rouse himself.
unit.target: Lumian Moranum Avigny nullam occāsiōnem praebuit ut singulārēs vires ad se excitandum adhiberet.

unit.source: He produced a ritualistic dog skin from his Traveler’s Bag and draped it over the gradually crumpling foe’s head.
unit.target: Ex sacco Viātōris suō pellem canem ritualem eduxit et super caput hostis paulatim corruentis appōsuīt.

unit.source: “Dog!” Lumian declared in Hermes.
unit.target: “Canis!” Lumian in Hermetis edixit.

unit.source: With a shadowy flash, Moran Avigny vanished, supplanted by an enormous dog with tawny fur.
unit.target: Cum umbrātā micātiōne, Morānus Avigny evanuit, substitūtus ab canī ingenti cum pilīs fulvīs.

unit.source: Amid the intangible thud of the dog collapsing to the ground, it lay insensible on its flank.
unit.target: Inter impalpābilēs tonitruum canis in terram corruentis, ille in lātere suō insensibilis iacebat.

unit.source: Lumian smiled, stooped down, and scooped up the dog.
unit.target: Lumian subrīdēns se inclinavit et canem in brachiō suscepit.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Anthony dislodged the gag that had wholly covered his ears, and Jenna shed the dual layers of frost encasing her.
unit.target: Hoc vidēns, Anthony impedimēntum quod aurēs eius omnīnō tegebat tollere conātus est, et Jennā duplicēs strātās glaciæ quae eam involvērant removit.

unit.source: Franca lagged slightly.
unit.target: Franca paululō morāta est.

unit.source: After a handful of seconds, the cocoon ruptured, and the ice coffin noiselessly dissipated, prompting the black flames to disperse.
unit.target: Post paucos secundōs, involucrum ruptum est, et sarcophagus glaciæ sine sonō evanuit, quā flammae nigræ dissipārī coeperunt.

unit.source: She regarded Lumian and Jenna with astonishment and delight, stating, “My Pleasure potion underwent substantial digestion!”
unit.target: Illōs Lumian et Jennam stupōre et laetiā aspexit, dīcēns: “Potio mea Voluptātis ingentem digestionem passā est!”

unit.source: No sooner had she concluded her statement than she pinched her nose and surveyed the spot where Moran Avigny had stood and the massive dog cradled in Lumian’s arms.
unit.target: Nōn proculquam postquam loquāta est, nāsum sibi premit, et locum contemplāta est ubi Morānus Avigny steterat et ingens canis in brachiīs Luminum tenerētur.

unit.source: “I know what’s going on… He must have just savored genuine pleasure—utmost pleasure. Moreover, this ‘pleasure’ stemmed from me.”
unit.target: «Scio quid agatur… Eum modo veram, maximam voluptatem experīrī debuisse; praeterea, haec “voluptās” ex me orta est.»

unit.source: Lumian deliberated momentarily before replying, “He even staked his life to remain in pursuit of the pleasure you bestowed upon him, weathering the same excruciating agony. Ultimately, he attained the pleasure he coveted, albeit not in the manner he desired. He paid the steepest price for it.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper deliberāvit, deinde respondentēs dīxit: “Etiam vitam suam ponit ut in persequenda voluptate, quam tibi tribuistī, perseveret, eidem atrocem dolorem ferēns; denique voluptatem quam concupīvit adeptus est, etiamsi nōn eo mōdō quo desiderābat; pretium summum pro ea solvit.”

unit.source: “He’s also a Beyonder on par with Sequence 5,” Franca remarked with a wistful smile.
unit.target: “Is etiam Beyonder aequus Sequentiā V,” Franca sub risū desiderōso inquit.

unit.source: “Regrettably, I wasn’t the one wielding the Symphony of Hatred; otherwise, my Pleasure potion might have been fully digested. Pleasure begets pain, and pleasure lures people into depravity. Pleasure is akin to a candle flame to a moth…”
unit.target: “Infeliciter, nōn ego eram quī Symphoniam Odīī gerebam; alioquin, potio mea Voluptātis plene digestus esse potuissēt. Voluptās dolorem gignit, et voluptas hominēs in pravitātem allicit. Voluptās similis est flammae candelæ ad papilionem…”

unit.source: At this juncture, she lowered her voice and mumbled in an unfamiliar tongue, “Lust is a dangerous game…”
unit.target: Hac hōra, vocem attenuat et in lingua ignota murmurāvīt: “Libīdō lusus periculōsus est…”

unit.source: Franca harbored no excessive regrets. Among them, only Lumian could shoulder the adverse cost of the Symphony of Hatred.
