unit.target: Francā nimias dolōrēs nōn habēbat; inter omniōrum, sōlus Lumian onus adversum Symphoniae Odīī portāre poterat.

unit.source: Anthony scanned the environs and serenely prompted Franca, “Since we’ve succeeded, let’s leave quickly.”
unit.target: Anthony ambi­tum perlustrāvit et Francam tranquillitāte provocāvīt: “Cum successimus, cito eāmus.”

unit.source: Jenna had already drawn near to Lumian, who had likewise stowed away the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Jennā iam prope Luminum accesserat, quī simīliter Symphoniam Odīī in receptāculō condiderat.

unit.source: “Okay.” Franca nodded and took several paces to Lumian’s side, grasping his upper arm.
unit.target: “Okay.” Franca annuit et aliquot passūs ad Luminum accessit, bracchium eius superiōrem arripiēns.

unit.source: Concurrently, black flames ignited behind the mirror.
unit.target: Simul, flammae nigræ post speculum accensae sunt.

unit.source: Within seconds, the quartet emerged from the fixed portal to the mirror world in the quarry cave. Franca finalized the anti-divination and anti-prophecy measures.
unit.target: Post paucōs secundōs, quaternio ex portāle fīxo ad mundum speculī in spelunca lapicidā emersit. Franca mensūrās antidivinationis et antiprophetiārum dēfīnīvit.

unit.source: Subsequently, they teleported back to the secured residence in the administrative district.
unit.target: Deinde, teletransportātī ad dōmicilium securum in districtū administratīvo redierunt.

unit.source: Franca sighed. “Beatrice’s Necklace can no longer trigger Lust…”
unit.target: Francā suspirāvīt: “Collāre Beatricis libidinem excitāre nōn iam potest…”

unit.source: Beatrice’s Necklace could only trigger such desires twice. The inaugural target of Lust was Gardner Martin.
unit.target: Collāre Beatricis talem dēsīderium bis tantum excitāre poterat. Prīmum propositum libidinis erat Gardner Martin.

unit.source: For Demoness Franca, this signified the loss of a potent auxiliary means.
unit.target: Pro Demonissā Francā, hoc instrumentī auxiliī validī amissiōnem significābat.

unit.source: Jenna nodded slightly. “How unfortunate. It appears the Demoness of Pleasure and the Sex Addict of the Mother Tree of Desire pathway can forge an ideal and efficacious partnership.”
unit.target: Jennā paulum annuit: “Quam infausta rēs. Vidētur demonissa voluptātis atque addicta sexualis, per viam arboris maternī dēsīderī, societātem optimum et efficacem condere posse.”

unit.source: “Indeed. Unfortunately, I cannot obtain the Mother Tree of Desire’s boon. Otherwise…” Franca abruptly fell silent, and an identical phrase flitted through the minds of Lumian and the others: Sex Addict Demoness!
unit.target: “Revera. Infeliciter, beneficium arboris maternī dēsīderī acquirere nōn possum. Alioquin…” Franca subito tacevit, et eadem sententia per mentes Luminum et cēterōrum volitavit: “Demonissa addicta sexualis!”

unit.source: Clearing her throat twice, Franca said, “I can only hope that the bestowed of the Mother Tree of Desire will bestow comparable props.”
unit.target: Bis guttur purgāns, Franca inquit: “Spero tantum ut beneficium arboris maternī dēsīderī subsidia similia referat.”

unit.source: She turned to the enfeebled dog, who had yet to stir, and contemplated briefly before proposing, “Administer truth serum to him first, then have Anthony befriend him as a two-pronged approach? Yes, employ the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell as a precautionary step…”
unit.target: Ad canem debilitātum, quī nōn dē movit, conversus est et paulisper meditātus, deinde proponēns: “Prīmō illī serum veritātis impōnitē, deinde Anthony eum amīcitiam inīre cūret, ut modus duplex efficiātur? Itaque incantātiōnem Mirābilī Speculī Spiritūs Canalizātiōnis ut gradus cautiōnis adhibeāmus…”

unit.source: Lumian nodded, recollecting the “criticism” the Demoness of Black had leveled at Franca. Quelling his avarice, he said, “No need to rush. I’ll question him after visiting Mr. K. Mr. K must have his motives for abruptly targeting Moran Avigny for assassination. Only by consulting him can we extract more pertinent intelligence later.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit, recordāns “criticismum” quod Demonissa Nigra Francae intulisset. Avaritiam reprimēns, dīxit: “Nullum festinandum est; postquam dominum K. visitāverō, eum interrogābō. Dominus K. certe causam habet cur subitātem pro Morānī Avigny caedem petat. Solum eum consulendō plūra intellegentia extrahere possumus.”

unit.source: Franca and the others nodded in concurrence. “Agreed.”
unit.target: Franca et cēterī unanimiter annuērunt: “Consentimus.”

unit.source: Lumian alighted from the carriage, attired in a light-blue cotton shirt following a change of clothing, and entered the six-story white luxurious residence.
unit.target: Lumian e currū descendit, indūtus camisā alba caeruleā ex cotōne post mutātiōnem vestimentōrum, et intrāvit domum sex strātīs albae et opulentae.

unit.source: 722 He Knows
unit.target: 722 Ipse Novit

unit.source: In the basement of 19 Rue Scheer, Lumian encountered Mr. K.
unit.target: In subterrania viae Scheer 19, Lumian domino K occurrit.

unit.source: If he hadn’t witnessed Mr. K transform into flesh and blood to envelop Moran Avigny and subsequently suffer holy light damage from the Purifiers, Lumian wouldn’t have believed that the energetic, black-hooded man before him had recently infiltrated the Intis Republic’s Minister of Industry’s residence and carried out an assassination.
unit.target: Nisi videret Domini K in carne et sanguine transformari, ut Moran Avigny complecteretur et deinde damnum luminis sancti a Purificatoribus passum esset, Lumian non credidisset illum virum energeticum, cum nigro cucullo vestito, ante se nuper in residenciam Ministri Industriae Reipublicae Intis subrepere atque caedem exsecutum fuisse.

unit.source: “You’re back from the Southern Continent?” Mr. K’s voice was as deep and raspy as ever.
unit.target: “Rediitne ex Continente Australi?” vox Domini K tam profunda atque asperrima, ut semper fuit, resonabat.

unit.source: Instead of sitting in the red armchair, he stood directly in front of Lumian, in the shadows projected by the crystal chandelier.
unit.target: Pro eo ut in sellā rubra sedens remaneret, statim ante Luminum stetit, in umbris a crystallo candelabro proiectis.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t hide anything and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian nihil celavit et subridens erat.

unit.source: “I’m back to do a favor for a friend. I’ll be leaving again in the future. As you know, I can teleport.”
unit.target: “Redii ut amico benefaciam praestem; mox iterum discedam. Sicut scis, teleportare possum.”

unit.source: Mr. K’s expansive hood swayed gently, as if nodding.
unit.target: Cucullus vastus Domini K leniter fluctuat, quasi annuens.

unit.source: He said with relief, “The fact that you still remember to come here and praise the Lord’s glory after returning to Trier proves I didn’t misjudge you.”
unit.target: Ille cum solacio dixit: “Quod adhuc meministi huc venire et laudem gloriae Domini post reditionem ad Trier, demonstrat me non te male aestimavisse.”

unit.source: Lumian, having just completed the prayer process with Mr. K, felt guilty and ashamed.
unit.target: Lumian, modo cum Domino K orationem perfecisse, se culpam et erubescere sensit.

unit.source: He cut to the chase.
unit.target: Ad rem pervenit.

unit.source: “I saw you assassinate Moran Avigny.”
unit.target: “Te vidi Moran Avigny interficere.”

unit.source: Under his hood, Mr. K’s gaze suddenly took on a tangible quality, and the shadows around him flickered.
unit.target: Sub cucullo eius, aspectus Domini K subito efficiebatur substantiam tangibilem, et umbrae circa eum micare coeperunt.

unit.source: After a few seconds, the Aurora Order Oracle asked in a hoarse voice, “You were there?”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, Oraculus Ordinis Aurorae voce rauca rogavit: “Adfuisti?”

unit.source: Lumian maintained a relaxed demeanor as he replied.
unit.target: Lumian habitu placido servatus respondit:

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: “Your assassination method bore the hallmarks of a Rose Bishop and was suspected of using Grazing to teleport.”
unit.target: “Methodus interficendi tua insignia Episcopi Rosae portabat et suspicabatur te 'Grazing' ad teleportandum usurum esse.”

unit.source: “Even with just the Purifiers’ information, it wouldn’t be hard for me to guess it was you.”
unit.target: “Etiam ex sola notitia Purificatorum mihi non esset difficile coniectare te id fuisse.”

unit.source: “But I admit, I was indeed present.”
unit.target: “Sed fateor, re vera adfuisse me.”

unit.source: “Where were you hiding?”
unit.target: “Ubi te latebas?”

unit.source: Lumian replied with a smile, “In the mirror Moran Avigny fled into.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: “In speculo quo Moran Avigny effugit.”

unit.source: At this, Mr. K’s black robe fluttered despite the still air, as if countless flesh and blood were cheering beneath.
unit.target: Ad hoc, toga nigra Domini K, non obstante quiescenti aere, volitabat, quasi innumerabiles carnes et sanguis subter exsultationem fecerint.

unit.source: Unable to hide his excitement, he asked, “And now? Have you captured Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: Excitationem celare non valens, rogavit: “Et nunc? Ceperisne Moran Avigny?”

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded solemnly.
unit.target: Lumian solemniter annuit.

unit.source: “Hahaha! Hahaha!” Mr. K half-raised his body, revealing his thin chin, and erupted into maniacal laughter.
unit.target: “Hahaha! Hahaha!” Domini K, dimidium corporis attollens et tenuem mentum patefaciens, insanam risum effudit.

unit.source: His laughter made Lumian’s ears ring.
unit.target: Risus eius auribus Luminum resonare fecit.

unit.source: Light and shadows danced in the basement, the stench of blood permeating the air.
unit.target: Lux et umbrae in subsolo saltaverunt, dum odor sanguinis aerem pervasit.

unit.source: Finally, Mr. K stopped laughing and spoke with unnerving fanaticism,
unit.target: Denique, Domini K risus cessavit et cum fanatico fervore locutus est:

unit.source: “Just as the Lord arranged. Piousness is indeed the only way out!”
unit.target: “Sicut Dominus ordinavit. Pietas certe sola via effugiendi est!”

unit.source: He began tracing a cross on his chest.
unit.target: Crucem in pectore suo delineare coepit.

unit.source: “Praise you for creating all. Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
unit.target: “Laudo te pro omnibus creatis. Laudo te pro mundi peccata ferendis!”

unit.source: Lumian also praised the Aurora Order’s True Creator.
unit.target: Lumian etiam Verum Creatorem Ordinis Aurorae laudavit.

unit.source: Mr. K smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Domini K subridit et suspiravit.

unit.source: “I had planned to assassinate Moran Avigny in the coming days, but hadn’t set a date. However, when I saw him at the window this evening, gazing at the distant scenery, I sensed something off about his emotional state.
unit.target: “Planiaveram interficere Moran Avigny in diebus venturis, sed diem non constitueram. Sed cum eum hac vespera ad fenestram vidi, longinqua conspectu intuens, aliquid perturbatum in affectibus eius mihi apparuit.”

unit.source: “Fearing something might go wrong, I hastily launched the operation and failed.
unit.target: “Ne quid malum eveniret metuens, festinanter operationem initiavi et defeci.”

unit.source: “I was about to repent to the Lord and shoulder my sins when you arrived and told me you had captured Moran Avigny.
unit.target: “Paene me Dominum paenitire ac peccata mea subire paratus eram, cum advenisti et dixeris te Moran Avigny ceperisse.”

unit.source: “What does this signify?
unit.target: “Quid hoc significat?”

unit.source: “It means the Lord has prearranged everything. We need only pray, act, and do things with devotion. Nothing else matters.
unit.target: “Hoc significat Dominus omnia praeordinasse; solum orare, agere atque cum devotione omnia facienda sunt; nihil aliud refert.”

unit.source: “With piousness, failure is a stepping stone to success. Without it, even success leads to failure.”
unit.target: “Pietate, defectus gradus ad prosperitatem est; sine ea etiam prosperitas in defectum ducit.”

unit.source: In previous conversations with Mr. K, Lumian had always felt a language barrier.
unit.target: In colloquiis prioribus cum Domino K, Lumian semper sensum obstaculi linguae perceptus erat.

unit.source: He understood the words but couldn’t truly grasp the fanatical state.
unit.target: Verba intellexit, sed statum fanaticum vere comprehendere non potuit.

unit.source: But this time, his heart raced and a chill ran down his spine.
unit.target: Sed hoc tempore, cor eius vehementer pulsavit et frigus per spinam eius decurrit.

unit.source: Could the Under the Table transaction I initiated through the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction be connected to the Aurora Order’s Lord?
unit.target: Possitne transactio sub mensa, quam per transactionem sub mensa tenentis auctoritatem incepit, ad Dominum Ordinis Aurorae coniungi?

unit.source: Is that why Moran Avigny suddenly risked leaving through the study mirror?
unit.target: Numquid ideo Moran Avigny subito per speculum studii discedere ausus est?

unit.source: Why he came to the study to assess the environment, weighing the risks as he feigned reading…
unit.target: Cur ad studium accessit ut ambitum perscruteret, pericula ponderans dum legere simulabat…

unit.source: So, after I compelled Moran Avigny’s fate, Mr. K hurried to the study to assassinate him, forcing him to flee to the nearest mirror—the full-body one we hid in…
unit.target: Itaque, postquam fatum Moran Avigny compellui, Domini K ad studium festinavit ut eum interficeret, coegens eum ut ad proximum speculum—illum totum corporis speculum in quo abscondimus—fugeret.

unit.source: During the transaction, we paid with the Blood Gold ring, derived from the Beyonder characteristic of a Sequence 6 Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway…
unit.target: Durante transactione, solvimus cum anulo Aureo Sanguinis, qui ex proprietate Beyonder Sequenciae VI Episcopi Rosae viae Secretorum Supplicantium deductus erat.

unit.source: Lumian chose to share his feelings with Mr. K but concealed his fear and the power of Compelling Fate.
unit.target: Lumian statuit affectus suos cum Domino K communicare, sed metum ac potentiam Fati Coercentis celavit.

unit.source: He attributed all the developments to the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
unit.target: Omnia eventa transactioni sub mensa a tenente auctoritate imputavit.

unit.source: Despite his frenzied laughter, Mr. K remained composed.
unit.target: Quamquam risus eius insanus erat, Domini K tranquillitatem servavit.

unit.source: Solemnly and fanatically, he said, “The Lord watches, the Lord listens, and the Lord knows.”
unit.target: Solemniter et fanatice, dixit: “Dominus videt, Dominus audit, et Dominus novit.”

unit.source: Lumian had heard Madam Magician say similar words before but hadn’t felt their weight.
unit.target: Lumian antea verba similia a Domina Maga audiverat, sed pondus illorum non sensit.

unit.source: He hadn’t even been troubled, knowing it was futile.
unit.target: Ne quidem perturbatus est, cum noverit id esse vanum.

unit.source: But now, every hair on his body stood on end, a chill running down his spine.
unit.target: At nunc, omnis capillus in corpore eius erectus est, et frigus per spinam eius decurrit.

unit.source: He sensed eyes watching him from every shadow.
unit.target: Animadvertit oculos ex singulis umbris eum intuentibus.

unit.source: The more he experienced and learned, the more acutely he felt the terror and oppression of those three short sentences.
unit.target: Quo plura experiebatur atque cognoscebat, eo acutius terrorem atque oppressionem trium brevium sententiarum sentiebat.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lumian praised the True Creator again and asked,
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, Lumian iterum Verum Creatorem laudavit et quaesivit:

unit.source: “Mr. K, why did you assassinate Moran Avigny? My friends and I dealt with him because the real Moran Avigny is dead. The active one is a Mirror Person. What about you?”
unit.target: “Domine K, cur Moran Avigny interficisti? Amici mei et ego eum tractavimus, quoniam verus Moran Avigny mortuus est. At ille, qui nunc agit, est persona speculi. Et tu?”

unit.source: “Mirror Person? No wonder he has Mirror Substitution. That’s precisely what I didn’t anticipate—causing the assassination to fail,” Mr. K sighed with realization.
unit.target: “Persona speculi? Non mirum est quod substitutionem speculi habeat. Id ipsum prorsus quod non praevidi—causans ut interfectio deficeret,” Domini K cum intellectione suspiravit.

unit.source: Pacing back and forth, he told Lumian,
unit.target: Circumambulatione, Lumian inquit:

unit.source: “Recent cases in Intis have led to an organization called the School of Truth.
unit.target: “Casu recentibus in Intis duxerunt ad institutionem, quae Schola Veritatis appellatur.

unit.source: They used degenerates from cults and official organizations to achieve certain goals.
unit.target: Degeneratos ex cultibus et officiis organizationibus ad certos fines assequendos adhibuerunt.

unit.source: For example, a descendant of Poli vanished mysteriously, and closely monitored pages from Roselle’s diary disappeared.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, progenies Poli arcano modo evanuit, et paginae ex diario Rosella diligenter observatae evanuerunt.

unit.source: Poli? One of Emperor Roselle’s Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse? A descendant of his has vanished?
unit.target: Poli? Unus ex quattuor equitibus Apocalyptici Imperatoris Rosellae? Progenies eius evanuit?

unit.source: Lumian’s eyelids twitched at the thought.
unit.target: Palpebrae Luminum in cogitatione trepidaverunt.

unit.source: Jebus Lata had mentioned the School of Truth’s three goals: finding clues about the fallen heaven, Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum, and 0-05, the Magic Wishing Lamp.
unit.target: Jebus Lata tria proposita Scholae Veritatis enumeraverat: signa de caelo lapso invenienda, mausoleum finale Imperatoris Rosellae, et 0-05, Lampada Magica Optandi.

unit.source: The Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal had just been breached.
unit.target: Sigillum Quartae Epochae Trieris modo violatum erat.

unit.source: For now, Intis’s official organizations were unlikely to overlook anything.
unit.target: Ad hoc, organizationes officiales Intis, pro praesenti, nihil praetermittere arbitrabantur.

unit.source: As for 0-05, Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter Bernadette held it.
unit.target: Quod ad 0-05 attinet, Bernadetta, filia maior Imperatoris Rosellae, eam habebat.

unit.source: The School of Truth admitted they couldn’t handle the Element Dawn leader yet.
unit.target: Schola Veritatis agnovit se ducem Elementi Aurorae nondum posse regere.

unit.source: They wanted more boons before trying.
unit.target: Plura dona voluerunt, priusquam conarentur.

unit.source: In other words, two of the three targets required long-term planning from the School of Truth.
unit.target: In aliis verbis, duo ex tribus propositis diuturnum consilium Scholae Veritatis requirebant.

unit.source: That left clues about Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum.
unit.target: Quae reliquae erant, indicia de mausoleo finali Imperatoris Rosellae relinquebantur.

unit.source: Jebus mentioned having no relevant clues himself.
unit.target: Jebus memoravit se nullas indicias pertinentes habuisse.

unit.source: Whether the Overseer did was uncertain.
unit.target: Utrum Praefectus id habuerit, incertum erat.

unit.source: Combined with Mr. K’s account, Lumian had a bad feeling.
unit.target: Cum narratione Domini K, Lumian pessimum premonitionem habebat.

unit.source: Could the School of Truth already possess crucial clues about Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum?
unit.target: Possitne Schola Veritatis iam indicia crucialia de mausoleo finali Imperatoris Rosellae possidere?

unit.source: Mr. K continued, “We’re investigating these matters, as is Element Dawn.
unit.target: Domini K perrexit: “Has res investigamus, sicut Elementum Aurorae.

unit.source: “We recently discovered Moran Avigny’s involvement in some cases.
unit.target: “Nuper deprehendimus participationem Moran Avigny in nonnullis casibus.

unit.source: He seemed to be a key figure in the School of Truth.”
unit.target: Videbatur eum esse figuram clavem in Schola Veritatis.

unit.source: “Then why assassinate him instead of capturing him?” Lumian felt Mr. K’s previous actions aimed to kill Moran Avigny.
unit.target: “Cur ergo interficis eum potius quam capis?” Lumian sensit priores actiones Domini K ad caedem Moran Avigny intendisse.

unit.source: Mr. K chuckled raspily.
unit.target: Domini K rauce risit.

unit.source: “Killing him is simpler than capture.
unit.target: Eum interficere simplex est quam capere.

unit.source: And after his death, an abnormality will undoubtedly occur.
unit.target: Et post mortem eius, anomalia certissime occurret.

unit.source: The official Beyonders will find a way to communicate with his spirit.
unit.target: Beyonderi officiales viam reperient ad spiritum eius communicandum.

unit.source: Then, the authorities will investigate the School of Truth to thwart their plan.
unit.target: Deinde auctoritates Scholae Veritatis investigabunt ad consilium illorum impediendum.

unit.source: Isn’t that our goal?
unit.target: Nonne hoc nostrum propositum est?

unit.source: Plus, we can shadow the authorities to track down School of Truth members.
unit.target: Praeterea, auctoritates speculando, membra Scholae Veritatis detegere possumus.

unit.source: You, an Aurora Order Oracle, have also learned to “report” and exploit the authorities?
unit.target: Tu, Oraculus Ordinis Aurorae, etiam didicisti auctoritates referre et ex illis uti?

unit.source: Lumian found it amusing.
unit.target: Lumian id iocose invenit.

unit.source: If not for needing more information about the Mirror People, he, Franca, and the others could have simply forced Moran Avigny to show signs of abnormality, avoiding so much trouble.
unit.target: Nisi plura de Personis Speculi discenda essent, ille, Franca, et ceteri, facile Moran Avigny coacturi fuisset ut signa anomaliae ostenderet, ita multum incommodi vitantes.

unit.source: Lumian delved into more details with Mr. K, increasingly sensing the School of Truth was close to locating Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum.
unit.target: Lumian cum Domino K in plura ingeniis delapsus est, magis magisque sensit Scholae Veritatis prope ad mausoleum finale Imperatoris Rosellae pervenire.

unit.source: Without delay, he expressed his urgency to return and interrogate Moran Avigny to prevent mishaps.
unit.target: Sine mora, urgentiam suam declaravit redire atque Moran Avigny interrobandum, ut casus vitaretur.

unit.source: “Do you need my help?” Mr. K inquired.
unit.target: “Opusne est tibi auxilio meo?” Dominus K rogavit.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Not for now. We have a Hypnotist, the Bliss Society’s truth serum, and a Demoness skilled in spirit channeling.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Non nunc. Habemus hypnoticum, serum veritatis Societatis Beatitudinis, et daemonissam peritam in ducendis spiritibus.”

unit.source: He didn’t mention also having Fate Appropriator abilities.
unit.target: Non memoravit etiam facultates Fati Appropriatoris habere.

unit.source: During Fate Appropriation, Lumian could “see” all of Moran Avigny’s past and present fates, and most fate tributaries.
unit.target: Durante Fati Appropriatione, Lumian videre poterat totum fatum Moran Avigny, tam praeteritum quam praesens, atque pleraque fata tributaria.

unit.source: But the duration was limited, only allowing extraction of the most pertinent information.
unit.target: Sed duratio restricta erat, sola extrahendi maxime pertinentes informationes permittens.

unit.source: “Alright, let me know if you need anything.” Mr. K sized up Lumian with admiration.
unit.target: “Bene, indica mihi si quid tibi opus est.” Dominus K Luminum cum admiratione aestimavit.

unit.source: Finding a secluded spot to teleport back to the safe house, Lumian surveyed the area and said to Franca, “Use Mirror Cufflink’s ability to take us back to the underground quarry cave.”
unit.target: Inveniens locum remotum ad teletransportandum ad domum tutam, Lumian regionem perlustrarem et Francae dedit: “Utere facultate ‘Mirror Cufflink’ ut nos ad speluncam subterraneam lapidariam redeas.”

unit.source: This would prevent accidents from affecting the neighborhood.
unit.target: Hoc praeveniret ne casus in vicinitatem afficerent.

unit.source: Lumian had already teleported multiple times that day and even altered Moran Avigny’s fate.
unit.target: Lumian iam plurimas volte illo die teletransportatus erat et fatum Moran Avigny etiam mutavit.

unit.source: Previously, he had played the Symphony of Hatred and triggered a series of weakness assaults.
unit.target: Priore tempore, symphoniam odii egit et seriem impetus infirmitatis provocavit.

unit.source: The immense expenditure left him with spirituality for only seven to eight more teleports and no further accumulation.
unit.target: Ingentes expensae eum reliquerunt cum solis septem vel octo teletransportationibus spiritualibus et nulla ulterius accumulatione.

unit.source: In this situation, using Beyonder items when possible was only natural.
unit.target: In hac condicione, uti rebus Beyonder, quot possunt, naturaliter eveniebat.

unit.source: Understanding Lumian’s state, Franca didn’t hold back on the Mirror Cufflink’s charges.
unit.target: Intellecta Luminum condicione, Franca de vectigalibus ‘Mirror Cufflink’ nihil remisit.

unit.source: She only asked Lumian to carry the colossal dog and keep it from touching her.
unit.target: Sola petivit a Luminum ut canem ingentem portaret et ne eum attingeret.

unit.source: She then made the glass cufflink on her blouse glow, leading Lumian and the others into the room’s mirror.
unit.target: Deinde efficivit ut vitreus cufflink in veste sua fulgeret, ducens Luminum et ceteros in speculum cubiculi.

unit.source: Through the dark, empty tunnel, they appeared in the quarry cave with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
unit.target: Per tenebrosum et vacuum cuniculum apparuerunt in spelunca lapidea, cui ingressus ad mundum speculi fixus erat.

unit.source: Franca took out the truth serum and tossed it to Anthony Reid with a friendly smile.
unit.target: Franca serum veritatis extraxit et, subridens amabiliter, ad Anthoniam Reid coniecit.

unit.source: “Feed some to Moran Avigny and have a good chat with him.”
unit.target: “Trado aliquod ad Moran Avigny et bene cum eo colloquere.”

unit.source: 723 Secret of Immortality
unit.target: 723 Secretum Immortalitatis

unit.source: After some time had passed, Anthony Reid guided the shriveled brownish-yellow dog back to the quarry cave that housed a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus transactum, Anthony Reid canem exsiccatum flavobrunnum ad speluncam lapideam, quae ostium stabile ad mundum specularum continebat, duxit.

unit.source: Turning to Lumian, he said, “You can dispel the Animal Creation Spell now.”
unit.target: Ad Lumianum conversus, dixit: “Iam potes incantationem creationis animalis expellere.”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the enormous dog, which had lost its ferocious and ruthless demeanor.
unit.target: Lumian intuitus est in magnum canem, qui mores feroces et implacabiles amisit.

unit.source: With a smile, he recited the dispelling incantation in Hermes: “Monk!”
unit.target: Cum risu, incantationem expellendi in lingua Hermetica recitavit: “Monk!”

unit.source: Lumian had personally crafted the ritualistic dog skin.
unit.target: Lumian ipse pelle canina rituali confecit.

unit.source: While he had used Padre Guillaume Bénet’s activation incantation, he had modified the dispelling incantation.
unit.target: Cum incantationem activationis a Patre Guillaume Bénet usus esset, incantationem expellendi mutaverat.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian wanted to use the name of Gehrman Sparrow, one of his two idols, as the dispelling incantation.
unit.target: Initio, Lumian voluit nomine Gehrman Sparrow, uno ex duobus idolis suis, uti incantatione expellendi.

unit.source: However, since Gehrman was Mr. Fool’s Angel of Redemption, uttering his name in Hermes might have unusual consequences and seem blasphemous.
unit.target: Tamen, cum Gehrman esset Angelus Redemptionis Domini Stulti, eius nomen in lingua Hermetica pronuntiare fortasse consequentias insolitas haberet atque blasphemia appareret.

unit.source: Consequently, Lumian discarded that idea.
unit.target: Itaque, Lumian illam ideam abiecit.

unit.source: Since the first ritualistic hide he made was dog skin, Lumian drew inspiration from the phrase “Monks Chasing Dogs” and chose the word “Monk” for the dispelling incantation.
unit.target: Cum prima pellis ritualis quam fecisset esset pelle canina, Lumian inspirationem traxit ex dictione “Monachi Canes Persecutores” et verbum “Monk” tamquam incantationem expellendi elegit.

unit.source: As a dark light flared, it revealed a pitiful-looking Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Cum lux obscura micavit, revelavit speciem miserabilem Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Instinctively, Moran reached for a handkerchief in his chest pocket and wiped away the dried blood, tears, saliva, and mucus from his face.
unit.target: Instinctu impulsus, Moran sudarium in sinu suo arripuit et ex facie sua sanguinem siccatum, lacrimas, salivam, atque mucum abstergit.

unit.source: Rather than getting directly to the point, Lumian decided to begin with trivial questions to bolster his credibility and optimize the hypnotic effect.
unit.target: Potius quam directe ad rem pervenire, Lumian decrevit quaestiones leues incipere, ut auctoritatem suam corroboraret et vim hypnoticam optimaret.

unit.source: With a blend of derision and a sigh, he said, “I can’t grasp why you Mirror People loathe your real world equivalents.”
unit.target: Cum mixtione derisionis et suspirio, dixit: “Nescio cur vos, homines specularum, veros mundi aequales oderitis.”

unit.source: Moran Avigny sneered in response.
unit.target: Moran Avigny in responsum deridens irrise respondit.

unit.source: “If you were perpetually confined to the cold, gloomy, sealed mirror, you’d also despise your counterpart who basks in the sun, savors fine food and drink, and revels in leisure and pleasure.”
unit.target: “Si perpetuo in speculo frigido, tristi, et clauso recluderetur, etiam oderetis alterum vestrum, qui in sole nititur, cibum et potum exquisitum degustat, atque in otio et voluptate delectatur.”

unit.source: “But your existence wasn’t a natural occurrence. It was an accident,” Jenna pointed out, narrowly avoiding mentioning that they were monstrosities inhabiting a unique mirror world.
unit.target: “Sed vestra existentia non fuit naturalis ortus; casus erat,” inquit Jenna, vix referens eos monstros in mundo speculari unico habitantes.

unit.source: Chuckling, Moran Avigny retorted, “What bearing does that have on our envy and hatred?”
unit.target: Subridens, Moran Avigny derisit: “Quid ad nostram invidiam et odium pertinet?”

unit.source: “We didn’t trigger the accident. As we were born and have been perpetuating our kind, we possess the right to seek a superior life.”
unit.target: “Accidentem non excitavimus. Cum nati simus et genus nostrum perpetuo propagaverimus, ius habemus vitam superiorem quaerere.”

unit.source: Momentarily at a loss for words, Franca and Jenna fell silent.
unit.target: Paululum verbis carentes, Franca et Jenna silentium ceperunt.

unit.source: Speaking in a friendly tone, Lumian said, “You indeed have that right. However, it cannot involve murder or injuring the original body. Why not collaborate with official organizations, such as the Church of The Fool? After fleeing Fourth Epoch Trier, you could depart this city and commence a new life elsewhere.”
unit.target: Dulciter loquens, Lumian dixit: “Ius hoc vestrum vere tenetis. Attamen id non potest implicare homicidium vel laesionem corporis originarii. Cur non collaboratis cum societatibus officialibus, ut Ecclesia Stulti? Postquam a Trier Epochae Quartae effugistis, hanc urbem relinquere atque vitam novam alibi incipere potestis.”

unit.source: Moran Avigny scoffed.
unit.target: Moran Avigny derisit.

unit.source: “You believe we can trust and cooperate with these sun-dwelling organizations?”
unit.target: “Credisne nos posse confidere atque cooperari cum his organisationibus, quae in sole degunt?”

unit.source: “Are you not already collaborating with the School of Truth?” Lumian exposed Moran Avigny’s deception.
unit.target: “Nonne iam cum Schola Veritatis collaboratis?” inquit Lumian, fraudem Moran Avigny detegens.

unit.source: After a brief pause, Moran Avigny stated, “We have a mission. We desire the authentic restoration of this world.”
unit.target: Post brevem moram, Moran Avigny dixit: “Missionem habemus. Veram restitutionem huius mundi desideramus.”

unit.source: “Authentic?” Lumian intentionally provoked. “How can authenticity exist in a mirror? You Mirror People merely resemble the genuine ones. Upon death, you will revert to mirror shards.”
unit.target: “Authenticum?” provocavit Lumian; “Quomodo authenticitas in speculo existere potest? Vos, homines specularum, tantum genuinos simillimini. Post mortem, in frusta speculi redibitis.”

unit.source: Following the provocation, Lumian’s eyes turned silver-black as he examined Moran Avigny’s fate tributary, aiming to deter him from providing a response that could endanger his life.
unit.target: Post provocationem, oculi Lumiani in argenteo nigro versa sunt, dum fata Moran Avigny explorabat, intentus eum deterrere ne responsum praebeat quod vitam eius in discrimen adduceret.

unit.source: After a quick observation confirming that his question wouldn’t pose a significant risk, Lumian deactivated the Eye of Calamity to preserve his spirituality.
unit.target: Postquam celeriter observaverit quaestionem suam minorem periculum non afferre, Lumian Oculum Calamitatis deactivavit ad spiritualitatem suam conservandam.

unit.source: With a meaningful smile, Moran Avigny said, “No, in a certain sense, what resides in the mirror is real.
unit.target: Cum risu significativo, Moran Avigny dixit: “Non, quadā ratione, quod in speculo habitat, verum est.

unit.source: “Upon completing our mission, we will fully return to reality!”
unit.target: “Missionem peracta, penitus ad realitatem revertamur!”

unit.source: Intrigued by Moran Avigny’s confidence, Franca asked, “Why do you say that?”
unit.target: Intrigata fiducia Moran Avigny, Franca quaesivit: “Cur id dicis?”

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s gaze swept over the two Demonesses.
unit.target: Oculi Moran Avigny super duas daemonissas migraverunt.

unit.source: Now in his refractory period, he chuckled and said, “Even I cannot comprehend the most basic reason. All I can disclose is that it relates to the Chaos Demoness we revere deep within the mirror world. She is the true Primordial Demoness!”
unit.target: Iam in suo tempore refractory, subridens dixit: “Etiam ego rationem simplicissimam comprehendere non possum. Tantum possum dicere quod refert ad Daemonissam Chaoticam, quam intime in mundo specularum colimus; ea est vera Daemonissa Primordialis!”

unit.source: “Moreover, I can offer an example: After transforming into a Witch and interacting with mirror magic, every Demoness’s true self dwells within the mirror.”
unit.target: Praeterea, exemplum proferre possum: postquam in magam conversus et cum magia speculari operatus, veram ipsam cuiusque daemonissae in speculo habitat.

unit.source: Observing Franca and Jenna’s skepticism, Moran Avigny, eager to express his thoughts, inquired with a smile,
unit.target: Observantes Franca et Jennae scepticismum, Moran Avigny, cogitationes suas exprimere cupiens, subridens interrogavit:

unit.source: “Are you aware of the Demoness pathway’s Sequence 3 name?”
unit.target: “Scitisne nomen Sequentiae Tertiae viæ daemonissae?”

unit.source: In unison, Franca and Jenna shook their heads. “No.”
unit.target: Simul, Franca et Jenna capita neglexerunt, dicentes: “Non.”

unit.source: With a slight nod, Moran Avigny explained, “It’s known as the Demoness of Unaging. Eternal youth, skilled in resurrection and rebirth.”
unit.target: Levis annuens, Moran Avigny explanavit: “Notum est ut Daemonissa Sine Senectute. Iuventus aeterna, perita in resurrectione atque renascentia.”

unit.source: “Why are they so challenging to kill, capable of resurrection and rebirth? It’s because what they destroy is merely their external form. Their authentic selves have always been imprisoned and sealed within the mirror!”
unit.target: “Cur sunt tam difficiles ad interficiendos, et quare facultatem resurrectionis et renascentiae habent? Nam quod deleant, sola forma externa eorum est; vera ipsa semper in speculo reclusae atque sigillatae fuerunt!”

unit.source: “If the false ones perish, they can swiftly be resurrected through the projection of their true selves in the mirror!”
unit.target: “Si falsi periant, celeriter resurrecti esse possunt per proiectionem verarum suarum in speculo!”

unit.source: “Consider this: how can one’s true self, imprisoned, sealed, and utilized as a source of resurrection, not despise the false one in reality? Why wouldn’t they yearn to escape the mirror and reclaim what is rightfully theirs?”
unit.target: “Considera hoc: quomodo quis suam veram, inclusam et sigillatam atque uti fonte resurrectionis, false in re oderit? Cur non desiderarent ex speculo evadere atque recuperare id quod iure ipsorum est?”

unit.source: Franca abruptly recalled the moment she first entered the unique mirror world.
unit.target: Franca subito meminit momenti quo primum in singularem mundum specularum ingressa est.

unit.source: At that time, she had encountered her body’s original self, the one with thick brown eyebrows and short flaxen-colored hair before ingesting the Witch potion.
unit.target: Eo tempore, occurrit formae originali corporis sui, quae crassis superciliis fusco-brunneis et brevibus capillis flavis praedita erat, antequam potionem magae ingereret.

unit.source: His face was drenched in blood, and his eyes brimmed with malice and hatred.
unit.target: Facies eius sanguine imbutus erat, et oculi eius malitia et odio repleti erant.

unit.source: Could it be that after drinking the Witch potion and transforming into a woman, her male self didn’t disappear but was exiled to the mirror, unable to escape? Franca was both alarmed and suspicious.
unit.target: Numquid ita est ut, post potionem magae bibendo et in feminam conversam, eius masculinum se non evanuerit sed in speculum exsilium relegatum sit, ne effugere possit? Franca simul perturbata atque suspicata erat.

unit.source: Jenna also remembered something from her past.
unit.target: Jenna etiam aliquid ex praeterito suo meminit.

unit.source: During the process of becoming a Witch, she saw her other self in an illusion—her malevolent, mirror-like self.
unit.target: Per processum quo magam fiebat, in illusionem alteram se vidit—eam malevolam, speculo similem ipsam.

unit.source: Both of them plummeted into the black flames, and she struggled to crawl out, returning to the ice above the black flames to complete her advancement.
unit.target: Utraque in flammas nigras ruperunt, et illa conata est evadere, reptando rediens ad glaciem super flammas nigras ut progressionem suam compleret.

unit.source: The malevolent self was dragged into the bottomless Abyss by the python-like black shadow.
unit.target: Ea natura malevola in abyssum sine fundo traxit umbra nigra, simili pythona.

unit.source: Could it symbolize self-division?
unit.target: Num hoc divisionem sui ipsius significat?

unit.source: Is a part of me truly suffering in the mirror?
unit.target: Num pars mei vere in speculo patitur?

unit.source: Noticing his two Demoness companions’ perplexed state, Lumian smiled at Moran Avigny and said, “It doesn’t necessarily involve self-imprisonment. It’s conceivable that during the Witch transformation process, they formed a profound connection with their mirror selves, enabling them to master mirror magic. To a degree, this also allows for their resurrection.”
unit.target: Animadvertere de statu perplexo duarum daemonissarum sociarum, Lumian subridens ad Moran Avigny intulit et dixit: “Hoc necessario non ad ipsos incarcerationem pertinet. Possibile est ut, per processum transformationis magae, relationem profundam cum suis specularibus formis coniuncti sint, quo magiam speculari dominari possint; quatenus hoc etiam resurrectioni eorum favet.”

unit.source: “The mirror self is tainted with blood, malice, hatred, and malevolence because they are perpetually in this state. They constantly envy their real selves, just like you Mirror People from a unique world.”
unit.target: “Specularis imago sanguine, malitia, odio atque malevolentia polluta est, quoniam in hoc statu perpetuo manent; semper vero veris ipsis oderunt, sicut vos, homines specularum ex mundo unico.”

unit.source: Unable to uncover the truth at the moment, Lumian preferred not to linger on the subject and attempted to shift the blame to others.
unit.target: Ne veritatem detegere posset, Lumian maluit in hac re non diutius manere atque culpam in alios transferre conari.

unit.source: Furthermore, as a Mirror Person, Moran Avigny had an innate inclination to take sides. His words needed to be cautiously accepted and analyzed from a different perspective.
unit.target: Praeterea, ut homo specularis, Moran Avigny naturale habebat inclinat ad partes assumendas; verba eius caute accipienda et ex altera perspectiva perpendenda erant.

unit.source: Upon hearing Lumian’s explanation, Franca and Jenna’s expressions softened.
unit.target: Audita explanatio Lumiani, vultus Francae et Jennae leniti sunt.

unit.source: Moran Avigny mocked, “Self-deception cannot conceal the truth.”
unit.target: Moran Avigny derisit: “Autocellatio veritatem celare non potest.”

unit.source: Recognizing that the initial preparations were nearly complete, Lumian decided to redirect the conversation back to the main topic.
unit.target: Ratus praeparationes inititiales paene completas esse, Lumian decrevit sermonem ad rem principalem redire.

unit.source: Originally, their objective was related to Mirror People, but now Lumian sensed that the matter involving the School of Truth was more relevant and pressing. He needed to inquire about it first.
unit.target: Primum, propositum eorum ad homines speculares pertinebat, sed nunc Lumian sensit rem, quae ad Scholae Veritatis pertinebat, propius et urgentius esse; de ea re primum rogare oportuit.

unit.source: His eyes turned silver-black once more as he gazed at Moran Avigny and asked, “Did you enter into a contract with the School of Truth’s Overseer?”
unit.target: Oculi eius iterum in argenteo nigro versa sunt, dum in Moran Avigny intuebatur atque rogavit: “Contractum cum Praefecto Scholae Veritatis contraxistine?”

unit.source: “Of course we did. How else could we collaborate? We all value contracts,” Moran Avigny replied with pride.
unit.target: “Certe fecerimus. Quo alio modo cooperari possemus? Omnes contractus aestimamus,” respondit Moran Avigny cum superbia.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “He didn’t surreptitiously modify the terms the instant you signed the contract, did he?”
unit.target: “Nonne, statim postquam contractum signer, condiciones non occulte mutavit?”

unit.source: “No, I am highly attentive to such matters. As you know, I am a Judge in the mystical sense,” Moran Avigny responded confidently.
unit.target: “Non, tali rebus valde attendam. Ut scis, iudex sum ad modum mysticum,” respondit Moran Avigny confidente.

unit.source: Lumian probed further, “Have you met the Overseer?”
unit.target: Lumian ulterius quaesivit: “Num Praefectum convenisti?”

unit.source: Moran Avigny shook his head.
unit.target: Moran Avigny caput neglexerit.

unit.source: “He signed the contract first and then dispatched his subordinate to deliver it. We never actually met.”
unit.target: “Primum ipsi contractum signer, deinde subordinate suo illud tradidit. Nos autem vere numquam convenimus.”

unit.source: “What has the Overseer been up to lately?” Lumian inquired cautiously.
unit.target: “Quid nuper Praefectus egit?” quaesivit Lumian caute.

unit.source: Moran Avigny chuckled.
unit.target: Moran Avigny subridens risit.

unit.source: “I am merely a cog of his immense Under the Table black net. I assist in completing specific matters through transactions. I am unaware of what those matters allude to or the motivations behind them.”
unit.target: “Ego tantum sum rota in ingenti reticulo nigro sub mensa eius. Ad complenda quaedam negotia per transactiones ago. Nescio quid illa negotia referant aut quae sint eorum causae.”

unit.source: “Yes, he once mentioned that he intended to use individuals like me to weave an invisible and massive vortex. He could infuse his strongest desires into it and achieve results.
unit.target: “Ita, aliquando dixit se velle uti hominibus sicut me ad texendum vortex invisibilis et ingentis. Potuit in eo desideria sua vehementissima infundere ac effectus adipisci.”

unit.source: “A few days ago, he casually remarked that the vortex is on the verge of taking shape.”
unit.target: “Aliquot diebus abhinc, leniter inquit vortex formam capere imminere.”

unit.source: The vortex is about to take shape… Lumian continued to monitor the changes in Moran Avigny’s fate tributary and, after some contemplation, asked, “How do you and the Overseer typically communicate? Is there a special contingency plan in case of an emergency?”
unit.target: “Vortex mox formare se incipit… Lumian mutationes in fata Moran Avigny perspexit, et post aliquam cogitationem rogavit: ‘Quomodo vos et Praefecto solitum communicatis? Estne consilium speciale pro casu necessitatis?’”

unit.source: This was something he needed to ascertain as quickly as possible. The abrupt attack on Intis’s Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny, and his enigmatic disappearance was breaking news. It wouldn’t take long for the news to spread. When that happened, the Overseer would undoubtedly learn about it and promptly sever his original communication channel.
unit.target: Hoc erat aliquid quod celeriter determinare debebat. Impetus abruptus in Ministrum Industriae Intis, Moran Avigny, atque eius enigmata evanatione novas edebat nuntios. Non multum tempore requireret ut nuntii disseminarent. Quum id factum esset, Praefectus certo id cognosceret atque statim canalem communicationis originalis disjungeret.

unit.source: In Moran Avigny’s villa.
unit.target: In villa Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Angoulême de François, the captain of the Purifier mobile team directly under Trier’s diocese, had been prepared and swiftly arrived at the scene.
unit.target: Angoulême de François, capitaneus turmae mobilis Purificatorum directe sub dioecesi Trieri, paratus fuit et celeriter ad locum pervenit.

unit.source: After listening to the on‐scene Purifiers’ report and assessing the scene, Angoulême frowned.
unit.target: Postquam relationem Purificatorum in situ audivit atque locum percontatus est, Angoulême frontem contraxit.

unit.source: “A member of the Aurora Order?”
unit.target: “Membrum Ordinis Aurorae?”

unit.source: Not Hidden Blade and the others?
unit.target: Non Culter Occultus et ceteri?

unit.source: What are they up to!
unit.target: Quid agunt!

unit.source: Following a moment of reflection, Angoulême issued an order,
unit.target: Post momentum meditationis, Angoulême iussum edidit:

unit.source: “Let’s first suppress the news of Moran Avigny’s incident to avoid alerting the individuals and factions behind this abnormality. We may still have an opportunity to uncover clues and proceed with our investigation.”
unit.target: “Primum nuntios de casu Moran Avigny opprimamus, ne eos et factiones quae hanc abnormitatem regunt excitare possimus. Fortasse adhuc habebimus occasionem vestigia detegendi atque inquisitionem prosequendi.”

unit.source: This was his experience and a process the Purifiers were already familiar with.
unit.target: Hoc erat eius experientia et processus quem Purificatores iam cognovissent.

unit.source: 724 Leader
unit.target: 724 Dux

unit.source: The Purifier team from Saint Viève Cathedral soon arrived at Moran Avigny’s study, carrying a nearly sealed wooden box.
unit.target: Turma Purificatorum ex Cathedrali Sanctae Viève mox ad studio Moran Avigny pervenit, ferens arcam ligneam paene clausam.

unit.source: They each wore white robes adorned with waxed golden threads, thin rubber gloves, and leather hoods.
unit.target: Singuli induebantur vestibus albis ornatis filis aureis ceratis, manicis tenuibus ex caucho, et cucullis ex corio.

unit.source: Their masks curved downward, forming a bird’s beak in front of their mouths and noses.
unit.target: Larvae eorum deorsum curvabantur, formantes rostrum avis ante ora et nares.

unit.source: Angoulême signaled the other Purifiers to withdraw from this floor and clear the adjacent ones.
unit.target: Angoulême aliis Purificatoribus signum dedit ut a hoc tabulato discederent et tabulata vicina expellerent.

unit.source: Donning a bird-beak mask and similar attire himself, he tightly bandaged his wrists and ankles.
unit.target: Se ipse, larvam cum rostri avis similem atque vestimenta similia induens, carpus et tarsos arcte ligavit.

unit.source: Peering through the red glass lenses of his mask, Angoulême watched his colleagues open the wooden box.
unit.target: Intuentem per vitrea rubra lentibus larvae suae, Angoulême spectavit collegas suos arcam ligneam aperire.

unit.source: Mirrors of the perfect size lined the inner layer of the box on all sides—top, bottom, left, right, front, and back.
unit.target: Specula perfectae mensurae interiorem arcae ex omnibus partibus repleverunt—superius, inferius, sinistrum, dextrum, anterius, et posterius.

unit.source: In the center, surrounded by the mirrors, stood a milky-white stone statue half the height of a person.
unit.target: In medio, speculis circumdata, stabat statua lapidea albo lactea dimidia altitudinis hominis.

unit.source: It portrayed a beautiful half-naked woman, her dress torn away to the waist.
unit.target: Illud repraesentabat formosam mulierem semi-nudam, cuius vestis usque ad lumbos disrupta erat.

unit.source: Despite the female figurine’s broken arm, her other hand alluringly covered her navel.
unit.target: Quamquam brachium fractum figurae feminae erat, altera manus eius venuste umbilicum tegebat.

unit.source: Her captivating figure and exquisite facial features stirred an inexplicable heat within Angoulême.
unit.target: Figura eius captiva et lineamenta vultuum exquisita ignem inexplicabilem in Angoulême excitaverunt.

unit.source: A sudden urge to kiss “her” flooded his mind, a desire for an intimate encounter with the stone statue.
unit.target: Subito impulsus eam osculari mentem eius inundavit, desiderium congressus intimi cum statua lapidea.

unit.source: Not daring to breathe deeply, he forced himself to maintain control.
unit.target: Non ausus alte spirare, se coegit ut temperantiam retineret.

unit.source: He recognized this as a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact under the Trier diocese, serial number 82, known as the Ullamos Statue.
unit.target: Agnovit hoc esse Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 1 sub dioecesi Trevirensi, numero serii 82, quod Statua Ullamos nominatur.

unit.source: This Grade 1 Sealed Artifact could gradually entice nearby creatures to obsess over it, spreading various illnesses, some common and others mystical in nature.
unit.target: Hoc Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 1 paulatim poterat attrahere creaturas proximas ad eius obsessionem, diffundens varias morbos, quosdam vulgares, alias mysticos.

unit.source: Left unchecked, the statue’s influence would transform its surroundings into a nightmarish landscape of agony—living beings wailing, writhing, and perishing in horrifying ways.
unit.target: Sine coercitione, potentia statuae circumiecta in regionem somniorum dolori transformaret, ubi entia viva gemebant, contorti erant atque in horribili modo peribant.

unit.source: The relentless plague would expand, unleashing a widening catastrophe.
unit.target: Plaga implacabilis se dilatabitur, erupiens calamitatem crescente.

unit.source: Angoulême had requested 1-82 for its ability to guide other creatures into the mirror world.
unit.target: Angoulême petiverat 1-82, cuius potentia erat alias creaturas in mundum specularum ducere.

unit.source: Strictly controlling exposure time was crucial to prevent the spread of illness and obsession.
unit.target: Temporis expositionis stricta moderatio necessaria erat ad diffusionem morborum et obsessionis impediendam.

unit.source: The two Purifiers gently lifted the Ullamos Statue and carried it to the full-body mirror in the study.
unit.target: Duo Purificatores statuam Ullamos leniter sustulerunt et eam ad speculum totius corporis in studio portaverunt.

unit.source: Angoulême and his two other teammates approached, placing their palms on 1-82’s shoulders.
unit.target: Angoulême et duo ceteri sodales accesserunt, pandentes manus suas super umeros 1-82.

unit.source: In perfect synchronicity, they magically phased through the glass mirror, vanishing from Moran Avigny’s study.
unit.target: In perfecta synchronia, per speculum vitreum magice transluxerunt, evanescentes e studio Moran Avigny.

unit.source: As soon as Angoulême laid eyes on the dark, hazy, almost illusory space behind the mirror, a tickle in his throat urged him to cough.
unit.target: Statim ut Angoulême intuens spatium obscurum, nebulosum, fere illusorium post speculum cepit, titillatio in gutture eum ad tussim incitavit.

unit.source: “Sigh…” A soft exhalation escaped his lips.
unit.target: «Suspirum…» exhalatio levis ex labris eius effugit.

unit.source: Their attire couldn’t isolate the disease spread by the Ullamos Statue…
unit.target: Indumenta eorum morbum, quem Statua Ullamos diffundebat, isolare non poterant…

unit.source: Its sole purpose was to minimize the rate at which they succumbed to genuine infection!
unit.target: Unicum propositum eius erat minuere celeritatem qua verae infectioni succumbebant!

unit.source: Weakened yet inexplicably excited, Angoulême and his teammates investigated the area behind the mirror.
unit.target: Debiles sed inexplicabiliter excitati, Angoulême et sodales eius exploraverunt regionem post speculum.

unit.source: They quickly discovered numerous dim mirror fragments scattered about.
unit.target: Celeriter invenērunt plura fragmenta speculi tenebrosa dispersa.

unit.source: “A battle took place here. Moran Avigny had to use Mirror Substitution multiple times, but there’s no sign of blood, bodily fluids, hair, or any other traces,” one of the Purifiers concluded.
unit.target: «Pugna hic orta est. Moran Avigny substitutionem speculi pluries adhibere debitum habuit, sed signum sanguinis, fluidorum corporis, capillorum aut aliorum vestigiis non apparuit,» unus ex Purificatoribus conclusit.

unit.source: Angoulême’s heart raced as he speculated.
unit.target: Cor Angoulême celeriter pulsabat, dum speculabatur.

unit.source: A battle? Someone ambushed Moran Avigny in the mirror?
unit.target: Pugna? Aliquis Moran Avigny in speculo insidiatus est?

unit.source: Impressive, Hidden Blade!
unit.target: Impressionans, Lamina Occulta!

unit.source: “I see. The Aurora Order never expected the assassination to succeed. The assassin’s only objective was to drive Moran Avigny into this mirror, where the rest of the Aurora Order awaited him!”
unit.target: «Intelligo. Ordo Aurorae numquam exspectavit ut caedes succederet. Solum propositum sicarii fuit impellere Moran Avigny in hunc speculum, ubi reliqui Ordine Aurorae eum exspectabant!»

unit.source: The other Purifiers concurred with this theory, nodding in agreement.
unit.target: Reliqui Purificatores huic theoriae consenserunt, annuentes.

unit.source: “Definitely the Aurora Order.”
unit.target: «Profecto, Ordo Aurorae.»

unit.source: “They even utilized a potent item capable of accessing the mirror world to confront Moran Avigny.”
unit.target: «Etiam rem potentem, quae aditum in mundum specularum praebere posset, ad Moran Avigny oppugnandum usi sunt.»

unit.source: “The absence of gruesome scenes suggests the Aurora Order aimed to capture Moran Avigny alive and extract vital information.”
unit.target: «Inopia scaenarum horrendorum significat Ordinem Aurorae conatum esse Moran Avigny vivum capere atque informationes vitales extrahere.»

unit.source: “Over the past five to six years, the Aurora Order has grown more intelligent…”
unit.target: «Per annos quinque ad sex, Ordo Aurorae magis callidus factus est…»

unit.source: Following a short discussion, one of the Purifiers glanced back at the Ullamos Statue at the entrance and gulped.
unit.target: Post brevem disputationem, unus ex Purificatoribus retrospexit ad Statua Ullamos ad introitum et deglutivit.

unit.source: “We need to leave now. Return 1-82 to the mirror box. I can’t endure it any longer.”
unit.target: «Nunc discedere debemus. Redi 1-82 ad arcam specularum. Diutius id sustinere non possum.»

unit.source: Angoulême agreed.
unit.target: Angoulême consentivit.

unit.source: Back in the real world, they sealed 1-82 once more and removed their cumbersome attire.
unit.target: In mundo vero, 1-82 iterum sigillarunt et indumenta onerosa removerunt.

unit.source: At last, he sighed with relief, feeling utterly exhausted in both body and mind.
unit.target: Denique levitatione suspiravit, se corpore et mente plane exhaustum sentiens.

unit.source: Inside the quarry cave with a stable mirror world entrance, illuminated by the carbide lamp under the Eye of Calamity’s gaze, Moran Avigny smiled as he answered Lumian’s question,
unit.target: Intra speluncam fodinae cum stabilis ingresso in mundum specularum, luce lampadis carbidicae sub aspectu Oculi Calamitatis, Moran Avigny subridet dum quaestioni Luminiani respondebat.

unit.source: “Also through a mirror.”
unit.target: «Etiam per speculum.»

unit.source: While speaking, he retrieved a makeup mirror from his pocket and elaborated, “Every mirror in the mirror world is unique, each with its own corresponding coordinates.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, speculum pulchrum ex sinu extraxit et enarrauit: “Omne speculum in mundo specularum singulare est, et cuique propriae coordinatae tribuantur.

unit.source: I provided him with my mirror’s coordinates, and he reciprocated with the coordinates of a mirror on his side.
unit.target: Ei dedi coordinatas speculi mei, et ille reddidit coordinatas speculi ipsius.

unit.source: With this arrangement, I can harness my abilities and the mirror world to transmit information to his mirror for a set duration.
unit.target: His conditionibus, facultates meas et mundum specularum adhibere possum ut informationes in speculum eius per tempus statutum transmittam.

unit.source: He contacts me in the same manner but relies on the Beyonder item I gave him.
unit.target: Eodem modo me contingit, sed innititur re “Beyonder” quam ei dedi.

unit.source: “An IP address, I suppose…” Franca muttered in a language unfamiliar to anyone present.
unit.target: «Forsitan indicem IP,» Franca murmuravit in lingua omnibus praesentibus ignota.

unit.source: Lumian smiled warmly and inquired, “Would you be willing to share the Overseer’s mirror coordinates with us?”
unit.target: Lumian calide subridens inquit, “Velisne coordinatas speculi Overseeris nobiscum communicare?”

unit.source: Moran Avigny shook his head.
unit.target: Moran Avigny caput negavit.

unit.source: “It’s indescribable and impossible to write down. Only those like us from the mirror world can perceive it. Or Demonesses with godhood—Demonesses of Despair.”
unit.target: «Indescribibile est atque scribere impossibile. Soli similes nobis ex mundo specularum id percipere possunt. Vel Demonissae cum deitate—Demonissae Desperationis.»

unit.source: Sequence 4 Demoness of Despair? And Sequence 5 is Demoness of Affliction… These two Sequences sound unpleasant. Uncomfortable to act, but the subsequent Demoness of Unaging is quite impressive… Franca gleaned information about the Demoness pathway from Moran Avigny’s words.
unit.target: «Series IV: Demonissa Desperationis? Et Series V: Demonissa Afflictionis… Hae duae series inhoneste sonant. Incommodum sunt ad agendum, sed sequens Demonissa Sine Senectute valde mirabilis est…» Franca ex verbis Moran Avigny notitiam de via Demonissarum colliguit.

unit.source: “How can the Overseer perceive it then?” Jenna asked.
unit.target: «Quomodo ergo Overseer id percipere potest?» Jenna rogavit.

unit.source: Moran Avigny smiled.
unit.target: Moran Avigny subridit.

unit.source: “He can’t perceive it either, but his Beyonder item can record and use it.”
unit.target: «Nec ipse id percipere potest, sed eius res “Beyonder” potest id recordari et adhiberi.»

unit.source: Franca smiled and raised her sleeve, revealing the glass-like Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Franca subridens, manica sua extulit, ostendens fibulam speculi quasi vitrei.

unit.source: Taken aback, Moran Avigny’s expression shifted to one of relief.
unit.target: Moran Avigny, obstupefactus, vultum suum in expressionem levationis mutavit.

unit.source: “You’re the ones who killed Jebus.”
unit.target: «Vos estis qui Jebus occidistis.»

unit.source: “The Overseer killed him,” Lumian clarified sincerely. “We had no intention of killing him. We even wanted to befriend him, but the Overseer used a mysterious power from afar to end his life. I fear you may suffer the same fate.”
unit.target: «Overseer illum occidit,» Lumian sincere declaravit. «Nolumus eum interficere; etiam amicitiam cum eo petivimus, sed Overseer vi arcana ex longinquo ad finem vitae eius usus est. Timeo ne eandem sortem subeatis.»

unit.source: Moran Avigny fell silent for a few moments before stating, “It can record it.”
unit.target: Moran Avigny paululum tacebat, deinde dixit: “Id recordare potest.”

unit.source: He referred to the Mirror Cufflink’s ability to record the Overseer mirror’s coordinates.
unit.target: Ad facultatem fibulae speculi recordandi coordinatas speculi Overseeris refert.

unit.source: Franca wasn’t surprised at all. “I knew it would work.”
unit.target: Franca minime mirata est. «Sciebam id operaturum esse.»

unit.source: When she had used the Mirror Cufflink earlier, she realized the mirrors in the mirror world gave her a crystal-clear sense of the mirror world’s entrances in the vicinity.
unit.target: Cum antea Mirror Cufflink usus esset, intellexit specula in mundo specularum ei perspicuam notionem de ingressibus in vicinitate praebere.

unit.source: There was the full-body mirror in Moran Avigny’s study and a few other unknown mirrors.
unit.target: Erat speculum totius corporis in studio Moran Avigny et quaedam alia specula ignota.

unit.source: Franca suspected the Mirror Cufflink would instinctively record the corresponding coordinates of each mirror.
unit.target: Franca suspicabatur Mirror Cufflink instinctive recordaturum esse coordinatas correspondentis cuiusque speculi.

unit.source: Moran Avigny continued, “You won’t be able to find the Overseer directly through that mirror.
unit.target: Moran Avigny continuavit: “Non potestis directe per illum speculum Overseeris invenire.

unit.source: I’ve long suspected the mirror is actually with one of the Overseer’s subordinates.
unit.target: Diu suspicatus sum speculum revera cum uno subordinatorum Overseeris esse.

unit.source: Naturally, that subordinate must be very close to the Overseer. Otherwise, it would hinder the transmission of information.
unit.target: Naturaliter, ille subordinator valde prope Overseer esse debet; alioquin transmissionem informationum impediat.

unit.source: Just like many members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, the contact points reserved for Madame Hela’s messenger are isolated from their real lives…
unit.target: Sicut multi membra Societatis Investigationis Simiae Crispis, loca contactus pro nuntio Madame Hela reserata sunt, ab vita reali segregata…

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly and said, “That’s not an issue. We can visit them one by one, as long as they’re truly close.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuavit et dixit, “Non est quaestio; eos visitare possumus singulatim, dummodo vere prope sint.

unit.source: Can you provide us with those coordinates?”
unit.target: Potestisne nobis praebere has coordinatas?”

unit.source: Moran Avigny fell silent.
unit.target: Moran Avigny tacebat.

unit.source: The effects of hypnosis and truth serum battled fiercely against his resolve.
unit.target: Effectus hypnosi et serei veritatis vehementer contra eius voluntatem pugnabant.

unit.source: This was a Disciplinary Paladin’s principle and corresponding restrictions.
unit.target: Haec erant praecepta Paladini Disciplinarii et restrictiones correspondentes.

unit.source: Observing the shifts in his fate tributary, Lumian smiled and said, “You can think it over. Let’s discuss something else first.”
unit.target: Observans conversiones in cursu fatali eius, Lumian subridens dixit: “Hoc considerare potes. Prius aliquid aliud disseramus.”

unit.source: Having witnessed Moran Avigny’s potential loss of control, he intended to inquire about other information.
unit.target: Cum testimonium ceperit de potestate Moran Avigny amittendae, aliis informationibus rogare intendebat.

unit.source: If the other party refused to divulge it later, he would kill him before channeling his spirit!
unit.target: Si altera pars postea recusaverit ea enarrare, eum occideret antequam spiritum eius dirigeret!

unit.source: “Very well.” Moran Avigny let out a lengthy sigh.
unit.target: «Ita,» Moran Avigny subridit. «Numquam coniectabis quis sit.»

unit.source: Lumian pondered briefly and asked,
unit.target: Lumian breviter meditatus rogavit:

unit.source: “What deals did the Overseer make with you?”
unit.target: «Quae commercia tibi fecit Overseer?»

unit.source: Moran Avigny responded nonchalantly, “Primarily providing assistance to certain individuals.
unit.target: Moran Avigny nonchalance respondit: “Præsertim quibusdam hominibus auxilium praebens,

unit.source: In turn, I received help through the Overseer.
unit.target: converso, auxilium per Overseer accepi.

unit.source: Consequently, we elevated our political status and acquired more resources.
unit.target: Consequenter, statum politicum nostrum extollimus et plura subsidia consecuti sumus.

unit.source: “This is a common practice among politicians, but with the Overseer, it’s even more covert, less detectable, and effective.
unit.target: «Hoc consuetudo est inter políticos, sed cum Overseer, multo latior, minus detegibilis, et efficax,

unit.source: Additionally, protecting specific individuals or indirectly granting benefits to non-high society members to fulfill the requirements on the other side of the Overseer’s Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: praeterea, ut singulos certos protegere vel indirecte membris ex parte humiliori beneficia tribuere possimus ad exigentias altera parte transactionis “sub mensa” Overseeris implendas.

unit.source: Lumian considered for a moment and asked, “Didn’t that Overseer communicate with the leader of your Mirror People?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus rogavit: “Num ille Overseer non communicavit cum duce Populi Specularum vestri?”

unit.source: Unsure if the Mirror People had a de facto leader, he said this to deceive Moran Avigny, implying they already possessed important information.
unit.target: Nescio num Populus Specularum ducem de facto haberet, dixit hoc ut Moran Avigny falleret, insinuans eos iam informationes importantes habere.

unit.source: If the Mirror People truly lacked a de facto leader, Moran Avigny would see through the deception. With the truth serum and hypnosis, this wouldn’t affect his subsequent answers.
unit.target: Si revera Populus Specularum ducem de facto carebat, Moran Avigny deciperet. Cum sereo veritatis et hypnosi, id responsa eius posteriora non afficiet.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s expression shifted slightly. “He did communicate with our leader.”
unit.target: Vultus Moran Avigny leviter mutatus est. “Ille cum duce nostro communicavit.”

unit.source: “How did they communicate?” Lumian asked calmly.
unit.target: “Quomodo communicaverunt?” Lumian tranquillo modo rogavit.

unit.source: “Through a provided ritual. I don’t know what was exchanged as I wasn’t present,” Moran Avigny replied honestly.
unit.target: “Per ritum praebitum; nescio quid commutatum fuisset, quoniam non adfui,” Moran Avigny honestiter respondit.

unit.source: Franca asked curiously, “Is your leader in the real world or the mirror world of Fourth Epoch Trier?”
unit.target: Franca curiose rogavit: “Num dux tuus est in mundo reali aut in mundo specularum Aevi Quarti Trevirensis?”

unit.source: “In Fourth Epoch Trier,” Moran Avigny said with a sigh. “Mirror People with powerful godhood can’t escape through certain catastrophes via the leakage point.”
unit.target: “In Aevo Quarti Trevirensis,” Moran Avigny suspirans dixit. “Populi Specularum cum deitate potenti non possunt per quaedam calamitates, per punctum effusionis, evadere.”

unit.source: Franca pondered for a moment and asked, “Does your leader have a corresponding self in reality?”
unit.target: Franca paulisper meditata rogavit: “Habesne dux tuus seipsum correspondantem in mundo reali?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Moran Avigny smiled. “You’ll never guess who it is.”
unit.target: “Ita,” Moran Avigny subridit. “Numquam coniectabis quis sit.”

unit.source: 725 The Mirror World’s Third Level
unit.target: 725 Tertius Gradus Mundi Specularis

unit.source: “We’ll never guess who it is?” Lumian and Franca scoffed simultaneously, pretending to be eager to speculate.
unit.target: "Numquam coniectabimus quis id sit?" Lumian et Franca simul deriserunt, simulantes se cupidum esse ad coniecturam faciendam.

unit.source: Of course, they didn’t make any direct guesses immediately.
unit.target: Certe, non statim ullam coniecturam directam fecerunt.

unit.source: They planned to gather some information indirectly first before making a targeted guess.
unit.target: Consilium habebant ut primum informationes indirecte colligerent, deinde coniecturam destinatam facerent.

unit.source: Lumian noticed the change in Moran Avigny’s fate tributary and realized that as a Disciplinary Paladin, the man had his own principles and mystical limitations.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit mutationem in tributario fato Moran Avigny, et intellexit, ut Paladin Disciplinaris, vir suos praecepta et mysticas limitationes habere.

unit.source: He wouldn’t willingly reveal details about the Mirror People’s leader, yet he couldn’t completely suppress a desire to share–unable to resist the hypnotic influence.
unit.target: Non libenter patefaceret singula de duce Populi Specularis, sed tamen cupiditatem communicandi omnino reprimere non potuit, vim hypnoticam vincere non valens.

unit.source: So, he taunted them in a boastful way.
unit.target: Itaque eos superbo animo deridebat.

unit.source: “You mentioned Mirror People with powerful godhood can’t escape through catastrophes via leakage points, not just any Mirror People with godhood,” Lumian pointed out with a smile, interpreting Moran Avigny’s words.
unit.target: "Meministi Populos Speculares cum divina potentia, qui per calamitates per puncta effusio non evadunt, non solum quoslibet Populos Speculares cum deitate," inquit Lumian subridente, verba Moran Avigny interpretans.

unit.source: “So in other words, a Mirror Person corresponding to Sequence 4 has escaped, and your leader is a Mirror Person of at least Sequence 3 demigod level?”
unit.target: "Ita aliter, persona specularis quae Sequenciae IV respondet effugit, et dux vester persona specularis saltem ad gradum semidei Sequenciae III est?"

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s face instantly showed annoyance as he regretted being too detailed, realizing he had inadvertently revealed critical information.
unit.target: Vultus Moran Avigny statim iracundiam ostendit, paenitentem quod nimis perspicue narravisset, intellegens se informationes maximas inopinato detegisse.

unit.source: Encouraged by Lumian’s astute observation, Franca smiled and asked, “Where are the escaped Sequence 4 Mirror People now? What are they doing?”
unit.target: Lumiani acuta observatione stimulata, Franca subridente rogavit: "Ubi nunc sunt effugientes Populos Speculares Sequenciae IV? Quid agunt?"

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s lips trembled with clear effort, but he stayed quiet.
unit.target: Labia Moran Avigny conspicuo labore tremuerunt, sed tacitus mansit.

unit.source: Just as expected from a Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladin.
unit.target: Sicut exspectabatur a Paladino Disciplinario Sequenciae V.

unit.source: They’re experts at resisting interrogation and prying… I wonder if destroying his frontal lobe would make him lose that last bit of self-control… Lumian wondered to himself and switched to a less sensitive subject.
unit.target: Periti sunt interrogationi et inquisitio reprimendae… Miror an, lobum frontale eius destruendo, ultimum modum sui temperandi amitterit… Lumian intus cogitavit et ad rem minus delicatam transtulit.

unit.source: “What are the requirements for Mirror People to appear?
unit.target: "Quae sunt requisita ad appariendum Populos Speculares?

unit.source: "Does everyone who has lived in the real Trier for a long time automatically have a corresponding Mirror Person?
unit.target: "Numquid omnis qui diu in re vera Trier habitavit, automatice correspondentem Personam Specularis habet?

unit.source: Or do they need exposure to certain underground corruption first?"
unit.target: "An necesse est ut prius corruptio subterranea quaedam eos contingat?"

unit.source: This question was based on inferences from the Dream Festival incident.
unit.target: Haec quaestio ex coniecturis incidentis Festival Somniorum orta erat.

unit.source: Phew… Moran Avigny let out a relieved sigh, having almost lost control and spilled the most critical secrets moments earlier.
unit.target: Phew… Moran Avigny suspiravit leviter, vix temperiem amisisse et paulo ante secreta maximi momenti effuderat.

unit.source: The current question let him relax a little.
unit.target: Quaestio praesentis eum paululum relaxavit.

unit.source: He answered smoothly, “If not for the seal specifically targeting Fourth Epoch Trier, the mirror world there would contain a complete reflection of the real Trier, including every resident.
unit.target: Leniter respondit: "Nisi sigillo specialiter ad Trier Quartum Aevum destinato, mundus specularis ibi plenam imaginem verae Trier, omnes incolas, haberet.

unit.source: But under this seal, only those who frequently go into the underground areas and come into contact with specific corruption will leave an imprint in our mirror realm.
unit.target: Sed hoc sigillo instructo, solum illi qui saepissime in regiones subterraneas accedunt et corruptioni speciae obviam eunt, vestigium in regno nostro speculari relinquent.

unit.source: "Other than that, our kind has other origins too:
unit.target: "Praeter hoc, genus nostrum alias originem quoque habet:

unit.source: "The first type are descendants of a false deity.
unit.target: "Prima species sunt posteri falsae deitatis.

unit.source: "The corresponding Mirror People manifest from the moment of their birth, regardless of location or whether they’ve ever been to Trier.
unit.target: "Populi Speculares respectivos ex momento nativitatis suae apparere incipiunt, loco autum non curans, nec utrum ad Trier umquam accesserint.

unit.source: "The second category comes from the bloodlines of certain noble families in Fourth Epoch Trier, like descendants of the Tamara family.
unit.target: "Secunda categoria ex sanguine quaedam familiis nobilibus Trier Quarti Aevum provenit, ut posteri familiae Tamara.

unit.source: "That’s how I came to be. This isn’t limited by location or environment.
unit.target: "Ita factus sum. Hoc loco aut ambitu non constrictum est.

unit.source: Lumian and the others understood that the false deity he was talking about was Primordial Demoness Cheek.
unit.target: Lumian et ceteri intellexerunt falsam deitatem de qua loquebatur esse Demonissam Primordialem Cheek.

unit.source: As an evil deity overseeing the mirror world, it made sense that Her descendants would have close ties to that unique realm.
unit.target: Ut deitas mala mundum specularis regens, conveniebat quod eius posteri nexūs proximos cum illo regno singulari haberent.

unit.source: "Why do descendants of the Tamara family have a special connection to your mirror world?" Lumian asked curiously.
unit.target: "Cur posteri familiae Tamara nexus peculiaris cum mundo tuo speculari habeant?" inquit Lumian curiosus.

unit.source: "Did your ancestors suffer the relevant corruption during the War of the Four Emperors, or even earlier?"
unit.target: "Num patribus tuis corruptionem pertinentem passi sunt in Bello Quattuor Imperatorum, an etiam prius?"

unit.source: Moran Avigny paused for a few moments before replying, “Earlier."
unit.target: Moran Avigny paucos momenta pausinguit antequam respondit: "Prius."

unit.source: "I'm not sure of the specifics of the corruption or how it occurred, as it was too long ago. Maybe those Tamaras who follow the Judgment pathway without being Mirror People themselves, or those of the Door pathway, have records of it."
unit.target: "Details corruptionis nec modum eius accideri apte novi, cum pridem evenit. Forsitan Tamarae, qui semitam Iudicii sequuntur sine ipsis Populis Specularibus, aut qui semitam Portae (nam haec alius appellatio est semitae discipulorum) secuti sunt, documenta retinuerunt."

unit.source: The Door pathway was another name for the Apprentice pathway.
unit.target: Semita Porta erat aliud nomen semitae discipulorum.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and asked on behalf of Franca and Jenna, “Does your kind exclude Mirror People of other Demonesses?”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et pro Franca ac Jenna interrogavit: "Nonne genus vestrum excludit Populos Speculares aliarum Demonissarum?"

unit.source: "They are Mirror People, but not from our world," Moran Avigny answered with a smile.
unit.target: "Populi Speculares sunt, sed non ex mundo nostro," respondit Moran Avigny subridente.

unit.source: "Of course, if the conditions I mentioned earlier are met, a Mirror Person corresponding to a Demoness could be born in our realm too."
unit.target: "Scilicet, si condiciones quas antea dixi implentur, persona specularis quae Demonissae respondet etiam in nostro regno oriri potest."

unit.source: I see… Franca and Jenna nodded slightly as Lumian changed the topic.
unit.target: Intelligo… Franca et Jenna leviter annuerunt, dum Lumian rem mutabat.

unit.source: "What are the Mirror People who left the underground doing?"
unit.target: "Quid agunt Populi Speculares qui subterraneum reliquerunt?"

unit.source: His question was broad, not specifically referring to the godhood-level Mirror People.
unit.target: Quaestio eius late patens erat, non specialiter ad Populos Speculares cum divina potentia spectans.

unit.source: Moran Avigny struggled for a moment before responding, “Most of them stay in Trier.
unit.target: Moran Avigny paulisper certavit antequam respondit: "Plurimi in Trier manent.
