unit.source: They either use the original’s identity to advance their status in various industries and organizations, or they hide in the shadows, secretly developing their factions.
unit.target: Vel identitatem originis adhibent ut statum in variis industriis et organizandis promovendo, vel in umbris latitant, factiones suas occulte evolvens.

unit.source: The goal is to eventually fully unseal Fourth Epoch Trier and access the third, deepest level of the mirror world.
unit.target: Propositum est ut tandem Trier Quartum Aevum omnino reveletur et tertium, profundissimum gradum mundi specularis attingatur.

unit.source: "As for the rest…"
unit.target: "Quoad reliqua…"

unit.source: Moran Avigny paused and grinned at Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Moran Avigny pausavit et Francae ac Jennae subridet.

unit.source: "Some infiltrated the Demoness Sect to locate the fake deity’s real-world hiding place.
unit.target: "Quidam sectam Demonissae se infixerunt ut locum absconditum deitatis falsae in mundo reali detegerent.

unit.source: "Others went to Lenburg to search for an item, as instructed by the leader.
unit.target: "Alii ad Lenburgiam accesserunt quaerere rem, ut dux iussisset.

unit.source: "Don't ask me about the progress of those in the Demoness Sect or what exactly the ones in Lenburg are looking for. That’s not my area of responsibility. No one told me the details.
unit.target: "Noli me rogare de progressu eorum in sectione Demonissae aut quid precise in Lenburg quaerantur. Hoc non est meum munus. Nemo mihi singularia dixerit.

unit.source: "I also want to find the Primordial Demoness’s real-world hiding spot. Why not tell me about the infiltrators in the Demoness Sect? Maybe we could work together," Franca suggested with a lovely smile.
unit.target: "Etiam locum absconditum Demonissae Primordialis in mundo reali invenire volo. Cur non mihi narras de intrusis in sectionem Demonissae? Forsitan simul operari possimus," Franca suaviter subridente proposuit.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s expression said it all: The more beautiful the woman, the more deceptive. I won’t fall for it.
unit.target: Vultus Moran Avigny omnia significabat: quanto pulchrior femina, tanto dolosior. Illi non succumbam.

unit.source: "I don't know their identities either. Only the leader has all the information.
unit.target: "Neque eorum identitatem mihi nota est. Solus dux omnia habet.

unit.source: "Alright then."
unit.target: "Age igitur."

unit.source: Franca’s eyes darted around as she continued, "What did you mean by the third level of the mirror world?
unit.target: Oculi Francae circum volitabant, dum pergebat: "Quid significabas per tertium gradum mundi specularis?

unit.source: We’ve all gone into Fourth Epoch Trier and entered your special mirror realm.
unit.target: Omnes in Trier Quartum Aevum ivimus et in regnum speculare tuum speciale intravimus.

unit.source: But what we encountered there were Mirror People of the deceased citizens from that ancient era.
unit.target: Sed quod ibi invenimus, Populi Speculares civium defunctorum ex illa antiqua aetate erant.

unit.source: They were reflections of that bygone city.
unit.target: Erat imago illius urbis praeteritae.

unit.source: Where does your kind live?
unit.target: Ubi habitat genus vestrum?

unit.source: Moran Avigny explained, “Back then, you must have accessed the second level of our mirror world. It only appears under specific conditions and preserves the scene of Fourth Epoch Trier’s destruction. It’s quite dangerous and holds many unknown secrets. As for our daily life, we live on the first level of the mirror world–a reflection of the present-day Trier."
unit.target: Moran Avigny explicavit: "Tunc certe ad secundum gradum mundi specularis nostrum accessistis. Hic solum sub conditionibus specificis apparet et scaenam destructionis Trier Quarti Aevum conservat. Periculosus valde est et multa arcana ignota continet. Quoad vitam cotidianam, in primo gradu mundi specularis vivimus – imago Trier hodierni."

unit.source: "The first level mirrors the current Trier?"
unit.target: "Num primus gradus reflectit Trier praesentem?"

unit.source: Jenna keenly noticed a discrepancy.
unit.target: Jenna discrepantiam acerrime animadvertit.

unit.source: "Didn't you say you Mirror People live in a dark, cold, confined environment?"
unit.target: "Nonne dixisti Populos Speculares in obscuro, frigido, angusto ambitu vivere?"

unit.source: Trier was now a metropolis!
unit.target: Trier nunc metropolis erat!

unit.source: Moran Avigny sneered and said, “We may seem to live in a metropolis, but in reality, we are all restricted.
unit.target: Moran Avigny sprevit et dixit: "Licet videamur in metropolis vivere, sed re vera omnes restricti sumus.

unit.source: We can only walk fixed paths, endlessly wandering between a handful of rooms and one or two streets.
unit.target: Solum vias fixas ambulare possumus, inter paucas conclavia et unam vel duas vias perpetuo errantes.

unit.source: Without the help of godhood-level powerhouses, we can’t even talk to each other.
unit.target: Sine auxilio virium divinitatis, inter nos ne quidem colloqui possumus.

unit.source: We can only observe what our counterparts are doing in the real world through mirrors.
unit.target: Solum per specula observare possumus quid aequipollentes nostri in mundo reali agant.

unit.source: Plus, our realm has no reflection of the sun, moon, or stars.
unit.target: Praeterea, regnum nostrum nullam solis, lunae aut stellarum imaginem continet.

unit.source: Imagine living in such an environment.
unit.target: Finge te in tali ambitu vivere.

unit.source: It’s similar to the living conditions of the painting world’s individuals, except the Mirror People have self-awareness and a clear understanding… No wonder they are in agony…
unit.target: Simile est condicionibus viventium in mundo picturae, nisi quod Populi Speculares conscientiam sui ipsorum et perspicuitatem habeant… Non mirum in angore laborent…

unit.source: Lumian thought of a question when he realized the mirror world’s first level lacked the sun, moon, and stars.
unit.target: Lumian quaestionem meditatus est, cum animadvertit primum gradum mundi specularis solem, lunam, et stellas deesse.

unit.source: “If a Sequence 4 Unshadowed of the Sun pathway comes into contact with the specific underground corruption, will a corresponding Mirror Person be born?”
unit.target: "Si Sequenciae IV viae Solis sine umbra corruptione subterranea specifica contingat, nasceturne persona specularis respondens?"

unit.source: “No,” Moran Avigny stated firmly.
unit.target: "Non," affirmavit firmiter Moran Avigny.

unit.source: Lumian used this chance to eliminate several more possibilities regarding the real identity of the Mirror People’s leader.
unit.target: Lumian hanc opportunitatem adhibuit ut plures alias facultates ad veram identitatem ducis Populi Specularis tolleret.

unit.source: Franca sighed deeply.
unit.target: Franca graviter suspiravit.

unit.source: "The Sun pathway is truly exceptional. Befitting of the pathway that governs Purification."
unit.target: "Via Solis vere eximia est. Idonea est via quae purificationem regit."

unit.source: She then remembered her earlier unanswered question and pressed, "What exists on the third level of the mirror world?"
unit.target: Tum meminit quaestionis antea non responsae et instanter rogavit: "Quid in tertio gradu mundi specularis existit?"

unit.source: Once again, Moran Avigny shook his head.
unit.target: Iterum, Moran Avigny caput movit.

unit.source: "No one has entered it. We only know it exists. We know our origins, traits, and the source of our power all point to that level."
unit.target: "Nemini intravit. Solum scimus eum exsistere. Originem nostram, proprietates, atque fons potentiae nostrae omnes ad illum gradum referuntur."

unit.source: "As for the Chaos Demoness we revere and follow, who is also the Primordial Demoness, She is trapped there for some reason, guarding the truth."
unit.target: "Quod ad Demonissam Chaoticam, quam colimus et sequimur, quae etiam Demonissa Primordialis est, attinet, illa aliqua ratione ibi clausa est, veritatem custodiente."

unit.source: Trapped there? More like sealed there… ‘Protecting reality’—a nice way to spin it…
unit.target: Ibi sigillatus? Immo magis sigillatus ibi… "Realitatem protegens"—modus pulcher ad hoc fingendum…

unit.source: Lumian pondered briefly before asking, "What truth are you referring to?"
unit.target: Lumian paulo meditatus est antequam rogavit, "De qua veritate loqueris?"

unit.source: "Truth is truth." Moran Avigny seemed confused, as if he had never seriously considered the matter.
unit.target: "Veritas est veritas." Moran Avigny confusus videbatur, quasi numquam rem serio consideravisset.

unit.source: Seeing that he lacked an answer, Jenna brought the conversation back to the Mirror People’s connection to reality.
unit.target: Animadversa quod responsum ei deesset, Jenna colloquium ad nexum Populi Speculares cum re restituit.

unit.source: Puzzled, she asked, "If the original person in reality dies, what happens to the Mirror Person?
unit.target: Attonita, rogavit, "Si homo originalis in re moritur, quid fit persona specularis?

unit.source: "And the other way around?"
unit.target: "Et vicissim?"

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s lips twisted into a warped smile.
unit.target: Labia Moran Avigny in risum deformem contorti sunt.

unit.source: "Normally, if the me in reality dies, I’ll die along with him. But if I send my real self into the mirror world beforehand, the impact of his death on me will be minimal."
unit.target: "Ordinarie, si ego in re moriar, simul cum eo moriar. Sed si meum verum praevenire in mundum specularis mitto, ictus eius mortis in me parvus erit."

unit.source: "The reverse holds true too. When I was still in the mirror world, if an invader killed me, the me in reality would merely get sick and be weakened for a time. Going forward, if he didn’t come into contact with the specific underground corruption again, no corresponding Mirror Person would exist."
unit.target: "Res contraria quoque veridica est. Cum adhuc in mundo speculari esse videbar, si invasor me occideret, ego in re tantum aegrotare et debilitari per tempus fuissem. In futurum, si rursus specifica corruptio subterranea eum non contingat, persona specularis respondens non exsisteret."

unit.source: "If I escape to the real world and am killed there, the real me won’t be affected at all."
unit.target: "Si ad mundum realem effugiam et ibi occider, verus ego omnino non afficiar."

unit.source: Franca hissed and said, "So instead of killing Moran Avigny directly, you found a way to drag him into the mirror world?"
unit.target: Franca sibilavit et dixit: "Ergo, potius quam Moran Avigny directe occidere, viam invenisti ut eum in mundum specularis traheretur?"

unit.source: "Exactly. I waited for him to ‘savor’ the darkness, coldness, isolation, and loneliness before ending him," Moran Avigny confirmed with a smile.
unit.target: "Prorsus. Exspectavi ut tenebras, frigorem, solitudinem, et solitudo degustaret antequam eum interficerem," confirmavit Moran Avigny subridente.

unit.source: In short, the one in the mirror loses significance and won’t impact the other’s survival, regardless of whether they are a Mirror Person or a real individual…
unit.target: In summa, ille in speculo momentum perdit nec superviventiam alterius afficiet, sive persona specularis sive homo verus sit…

unit.source: If both are in the real world, the Mirror Person is naturally at a disadvantage…
unit.target: Si ambo in mundo reali sunt, persona specularis ex natura in incommodo manet…

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly as he started to deduce the identity of the Mirror People’s leader mentioned by Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit dum identitatem ducis Populi Specularis a Moran Avigny dicta detegere inciperet.

unit.source: Someone who ventures into Trier’s underground often, exposed to specific corruptions.
unit.target: Aliquis qui saepe in subterraneum Trier incurrit et corruptionibus specificis subiectus est.

unit.source: Formidable godhood, at least Sequence 3.
unit.target: Divinitas formidabilis, saltem Sequenciae III.

unit.source: He must still be alive…
unit.target: Oportet eum adhuc vivere...

unit.source: With this in mind, Lumian couldn’t narrow it down further.
unit.target: Hoc mente habens, Lumian ulteriora restringere non potuit.

unit.source: He had no choice but to use his Conspirer abilities to upload all relevant information onto his mental network.
unit.target: Nullo alio modo potuit quam facultatibus conspiratoris ut omnia informationes pertinentes in rete mentis suae oneraret.

unit.source: The Overseer of the School of Truth had performed a ritual and interacted with the Mirror People’s leader.
unit.target: Praepositus Scholae Veritatis ritum perfecit et cum duce Populi Specularis communicavit.

unit.source: The School of Truth was searching for Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum.
unit.target: Schola Veritatis mausoleum finalem Imperatoris Roselle quaerebat.

unit.source: They had obtained something significant.
unit.target: Aliquid grave adepti erant.

unit.source: The vortex was on the verge of taking shape…
unit.target: Vortex forma capiendi imminebat…

unit.source: Suddenly, a flash of insight hit Lumian, and an incredible guess raced through his mind.
unit.target: Subito, fulgor perspicacitatis Lumian percussit, et incredibilis coniectura per mentem eius fremebat.

unit.source: He couldn’t be certain, as one premise seemed questionable.
unit.target: Certus esse non potuit, cum una praemissa dubia videbatur.

unit.source: He took two steps forward and whispered a name into Moran Avigny’s ear.
unit.target: Duo passus progreditus est et nomen in aure Moran Avigny susurravit.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s expression changed drastically, a mixture of shock and panic.
unit.target: Vultus Moran Avigny radicitus mutatus est, mixtura stuporis et terrorem ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew and exhaled solemnly.
unit.target: Lumian recessit et sollemniter suspiravit.

unit.source: "Have you figured out who the Mirror People’s leader is?" Franca asked.
unit.target: "Num cognovisti quis sit dux Populi Specularis?" inquit Franca.

unit.source: Lumian nodded gently and surveyed the surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian leniter annuit et circumstantia contemplatus est.

unit.source: In a deep voice, he declared, "Yes, I know who He is. He’s Roselle Gustav in the mirror!"
unit.target: Profunda voce declaravit: "Ita, scio quis ille sit. Roselle Gustav in speculo est!"

unit.source: 726 Fragment of Fate
unit.target: 726 Fragmentum Fati

unit.source: Roselle Gustav in the mirror?
unit.target: Roselle Gustav in speculo?

unit.source: When Franca, Jenna, and Anthony heard that the name of this dazzling figure, revered by every Intisian, was connected to the Mirror People, their minds went completely blank.
unit.target: Cum Franca, Jenna, et Anthony audirent nomen huius fulgidæ figurae, ab omni Intisiano veneratæ, ad Populum Speculi pertinere, mentes eorum omnino vacuae factæ sunt.

unit.source: They instinctively wanted to question him further, but Moran Avigny’s reaction and change in expression appeared to validate Lumian’s conjecture.
unit.target: Instinctu veluti eum amplius interrogare velle conabantur, sed responsio et mutatio vultus Moran Avigny coniecturam Lumiani videbantur confirmare.

unit.source: “But the Emperor has been dead for over a century. How can there still be a corresponding Mirror Person?” Franca asked, finally composing herself.
unit.target: "Sed imperator iam centum annos et ultra mortuus est. Quomodo adhuc persona speculi correspondens esse possit?" inquit Franca, tandem se componens.

unit.source: It made sense that Emperor Roselle would have encountered Trier’s underground corruption.
unit.target: Rationabile erat quod imperator Roselle corruptionem subterraneam Trieris occurrisset.

unit.source: He had, after all, lived in Trier for an extended period after reaching adulthood, and he was not one to easily settle down.
unit.target: Postquam ad aetatem adultam pervenit, in Trier per longum tempus vixit, et non erat is qui facile se constituere solebat.

unit.source: Lumian’s serious expression softened a bit.
unit.target: Vultus severus Lumiani paulum mollitus est.

unit.source: “Initially, I hesitated to make that guess, but then I recalled something. For someone of Emperor Roselle’s stature, even if they perish, they might not be completely gone. There could even be a possibility of resurrection.”
unit.target: "Initio coniecturam facere dubitabam, sed deinde aliquid recordatus sum.

unit.source: It was just like Naboredisley’s Abomination corpse resting in the ancient tomb of the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Id erat, sicut corpus abominationis Naboredisley quiescens in sepulcro antiquo Festi Somniorum.

unit.source: Franca made an odd remark.
unit.target: Franca rem insolitam enuntiavit.

unit.source: “Old institutions are hard to get rid of…”
unit.target: "Vetera instituta aboli difficilia sunt…"

unit.source: With their experience dealing with the Devil Monarch’s Abomination corpse, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony quickly accepted Lumian’s explanation.
unit.target: Experientia habita cum corpore abominationis Diaboli Monarchi versantes, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony celeriter expositionem Lumiani acceperunt.

unit.source: Lumian looked at Moran Avigny, whose face had turned ashen, and smiled.
unit.target: Lumian ad Moran Avigny aspiciens, cuius vultus in cinerem conversus erat, subridit.

unit.source: “I made a bold hypothesis and meticulously verified it. When I shared my guess with him, he willingly confirmed it.”
unit.target: "Audacem hypothesim proposui et diligenter confirmavi.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s lips trembled, wanting to defend himself, but he held back.
unit.target: Labia Moran Avigny tremebant, se defendere velle, sed abstinuit.

unit.source: He believed that the more he tried to explain, the more he would end up helping these people.
unit.target: Credidit quod, quo magis explicare conaretur, eo magis eos adiuvaret.

unit.source: His urge to confide led him to add, “Now, do you understand that our Mirror People are also incredibly powerful?
unit.target: Eius impetus confidendi duxit eum ad addendum dicens, "Nuncne intellegitis quod homines speculi nostri etiam incredibiliter potentes sint?"

unit.source: “If we can fully break the seal of Fourth Epoch Trier, we will be as strong as any orthodox Church!”
unit.target: "Si sigillum Triorum Quarti Æpoci penitus perrumpere poterimus, tam validi erimus quam quaelibet Ecclesia orthodoxa!"

unit.source: Franca disregarded Moran Avigny’s showy remark and muttered to herself, “No wonder the Church’s demigods refuse to personally go underground and resolve the various abnormalities here unless the seal of Fourth Epoch Trier is badly damaged.
unit.target: Franca rem ostentatam Moran Avigny neglexit et sibi submurmuravit: "Non mirum est quod demigodi Ecclesiae recusant personaliter in subterraneum ire et hic varias anomalias solvere, nisi sigillum Triorum Quarti Æpoci grave laesum sit."

unit.source: “This isn’t about fixing abnormalities. It’s about making more of them!”
unit.target: "Hoc non ad corrigendas anomalias pertinet, sed ad eas multiplicandas!"

unit.source: Even though the demigods of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church didn’t have to fear the birth of their corresponding Mirror People, Trier’s underground corruption extended beyond just the mirror world!
unit.target: Etsi demigodi Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardoris non timere debuerunt ortum suorum specularum, corruptiones subterraneae Trieris ultra mundum speculi patebant!

unit.source: Isn’t the underground of Trier excessively vile and horrifying?
unit.target: Nonne subterraneum Trieris nimis foedum et terribile est?

unit.source: This was assuming that Fourth Epoch Trier was relatively well-sealed.
unit.target: Assumendum est quod Trier Quarti Æpoci relative bene sigillatum esset.

unit.source: What had the four Emperors, particularly Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, done during the War of the Four Emperors?
unit.target: Quid quattuor Imperatores, praesertim Imperator Sanguineus Alista Tudor, in Bello Quattuor Imperatorum egerunt?

unit.source: The issues they left behind more than a thousand years ago were still incredibly terrifying!
unit.target: Quaestiones, quas ante plus quam mille annos reliquerunt, adhuc incredibiliter terribiles erant!

unit.source: We often venture into Trier’s underground and have even entered Fourth Epoch Trier and the unique mirror world.
unit.target: Saepe in subterranea Trieris iter facimus et etiam in Trier Quarti Æpoci atque in singularem mundum speculi intravimus.

unit.source: Could there be a corresponding special Mirror Person?
unit.target: Poteratne exsistere persona speculi specialis correspondens?

unit.source: No, it’s not a matter of whether there is one, but rather that there definitely was one. They had encountered it before!
unit.target: Non, non quaestio est utrum sit, sed certe fuit; iam ante eam convenerant!

unit.source: Lumian ignored Moran Avigny’s boasting and turned to Jenna.
unit.target: Lumian ostentationem Moran Avigny neglexit et ad Jenna se vertit.

unit.source: “Our investigation into the Mirror People has yielded significant progress. Combined with the Overseer, who evidently possesses godhood, what unfolds next is beyond our ability to intervene. As soon as we acquire the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror, promptly report the entire situation.”
unit.target: "Investigatio nostra de Populo Speculi progressum significativum attulit.

unit.source: Jenna curtly acknowledged his words and laughed self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Jenna verba eius brevi modo agnovit et sibi ipsi, cum humilitate, risit.

unit.source: “Actually, I’m dying to report it now.”
unit.target: "Revera, nunc morior ex desiderio ut id referam."

unit.source: From her viewpoint, although she was unsure why the School of Truth was searching for Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum or what their intentions were, given the strong probability that they had already obtained vital information and collaborated with the mirror Roselle, the situation had obviously become very urgent, and it was certainly not a positive development.
unit.target: Ex eius prospectu, quamquam nescia erat cur Schola Veritatis mausoleum finalem Imperatoris Roselle quaereret aut quid consilia haberet, cum magna probabilitate iam informationes vitales adepti essent et cum speculo Roselle collaboraverint, res manifeste valde urgentissimae factae erant, nec certe progressus favorabilis erat.

unit.source: “You can begin writing now.” Lumian gave a slight nod and shifted his gaze to Moran Avigny.
unit.target: "Nun scribere potes," inquit Lumian, leviter annuens et oculos ad Moran Avigny convertens.

unit.source: He planned to appropriate the other party’s fate.
unit.target: Consilium ceperat fatum partis adversæ sibi appropriandi.

unit.source: Fate Appropriation was not his objective. By seizing the chance to interact with fate, his aim was to seek essential information from past fate fragments.
unit.target: Fatum appropriationem non erat propositum eius. Occasione cum fato interagendi captâ, propositum eius fuit informationes esenciales ex fragmentis fati praeteritorum quaerere.

unit.source: This was the penultimate segment of the “interrogation.”
unit.target: Hoc fuit penultima pars "interrogationis".

unit.source: The final segment involved spirit channeling to forcibly obtain the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror!
unit.target: Ultima pars ad canalizationem spiritus pertinebat, qua vi coordinatas speculi Supervisoris obtinere conabatur!

unit.source: Furthermore, Lumian wanted to take this opportunity to observe what would happen to the target if he seized one of their fate fragments without exchanging fates or directly causing their death.
unit.target: Praeterea, Lumian hanc occasionem adhibere voluit ut observarit quid subiecto eveniret, si unum eorum fragmentorum fati arriperet sine fata commutando aut mortem directe inferendo.

unit.source: This was not mentioned in the mystical knowledge possessed by a Fate Appropriator. The only thing Lumian knew for certain was that the past would not change, and what had already transpired would remain unchanged.
unit.target: Hoc non memoratum fuit in scientia mystica, quam Fato Appropiantore haberet, opusque unum quod Lumian certo scivit erat: praeteritum non mutaretur, et quae iam gesta erant, immutata manerent.

unit.source: Initially, Lumian had wanted to inquire further about the Mirror People who maintained contact with Moran Avigny and their positions. However, the urgency of the situation led him to postpone this matter to the spirit channeling part. In any case, it wasn’t particularly crucial.
unit.target: Initio, Lumian ulteriora indagare voluerat de Populo Speculi, qui cum Moran Avigny contactum habebat, et de locis eorum. Tamen, urgentes rei causae eum ad hanc rem in partem canalizationis spiritus differendam detulerunt. Quocumque modo, non valde necessarium erat.

unit.source: From Lumian’s perspective, it was more important to know the identities of the Mirror People who had infiltrated the Demoness Sect and who had gone to Lenburg in search of an item. However, Moran Avigny clearly had no knowledge of this.
unit.target: Ex prospectu Lumiani, magis grave erat cognoscere identitates Hominum Speculi qui Sectam Demonissæ infiltraverunt et ad Lenburg item quaerendum perrexerunt. Sed Moran Avigny hujus rei plane ignarus erat.

unit.source: Lumian suspected that the Mirror People who had gone to Lenburg were looking for clues about 0-01. After all, based on the information, this item likely had a close connection to Blood Emperor Alista Tudor. The method of sealing it was quite similar to sealing Fourth Epoch Trier. It might be of great significance to the Mirror People from the special mirror world in Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Lumian suspicabatur Homines Speculi, qui ad Lenburg ierant, quaerere indicia de 0-01. Nam ex informationibus evenit hoc artefactum fortasse arcte coniunctum esse cum Imperatore Sanguineo Alista Tudor; et modus sigillandi eius valde similis erat modo sigillandi Trier Quarti Æpoci. Id fortasse magni momenti fuit pro Hominibus Speculi ex mundo speculi specialis Trier Quarti Æpoci.

unit.source: Lumian extended his right palm and pressed it against Moran Avigny from a distance.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum protulit et, a longe, eam contra Moran Avigny premuit.

unit.source: His blue eyes rapidly turned silver-black.
unit.target: Oculi eius caerulei celeriter in nigrum argenteum conversi sunt.

unit.source: Moran Avigny was perplexed by Lumian’s strange behavior.
unit.target: Moran Avigny mores insolitos Lumiani perplexus erat.

unit.source: Although he possessed the strength of a Sequence 5, he had been actively involved in politics for the past decade or so.
unit.target: Quamquam vires Sequentiae V possidebat, iam per decem annos in rebus politicis active versatus erat.

unit.source: He maintained a certain distance from the mysticism domain and the emerging cults.
unit.target: Ab regno mysticarum scientiarum et cultibus emergentibus aliquam distantiam servabat.

unit.source: This was particularly true after becoming the Minister of Industry.
unit.target: Hoc praecipue verum erat postquam factus est Minister Industriae.

unit.source: He relied entirely on the connections within the Mirror People and the Brokers of the School of Truth to acquire the knowledge, information, and items he desired.
unit.target: Confidebat omnino in nexibus intra Populum Speculi et negotiatores Scholae Veritatis ad scientiam, informationem, et res quas cupiebat adquirendas.

unit.source: Direct contact with wild Beyonders was uncommon, so he naturally couldn’t discern Lumian’s intentions.
unit.target: Contactus directus cum feris Beyonders rarus erat; ideo naturaliter Lumian consilia eius discernere non poterat.

unit.source: He only instinctively believed that Lumian had ulterior motives and wasn’t simply acting.
unit.target: Ipse solum instinctu credidit Lumian ulteriora propositum habere et non rem simpliciter agere.

unit.source: Lumian’s right palm “touched” the mercury illusory river corresponding to Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Palma dextra Lumiani attigit flumen mercurii illusorii, quod ad Moran Avigny correspondebat.

unit.source: The life of the Mirror Person flashed before his eyes, and various fate fragments surged along the river.
unit.target: Vita Personae Speculi coram oculis eius fulguravit, et varia fragmenta fati per flumen celeriter fluxerunt.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t discern them in detail. Seizing the brief span of two to three seconds, he focused on observing two fate fragments.
unit.target: Lumian ea subtiliter distinguere non potuit; duobus ad trium secundorum brevi spatio captis, duo fragmenta fati observare intendit.

unit.source: One fate fragment depicted how Moran Avigny remotely instructed the School of Truth’s Overseer to perform a ritual through the mirror, establishing a connection with the Mirror Roselle Gustav.
unit.target: Unum fragmentum fati depinxit quomodo Moran Avigny a longe Supervisorem Scholae Veritatis iuberet ut per speculum ritum celebreretur, nexum efficiens cum Roselle Gustav Speculi.

unit.source: The other aspect was how this Mirror Person came into being.
unit.target: Alia vero pars erat quomodo haec Persona Speculi exsistere coepisset.

unit.source: In the previous fate segment, Lumian witnessed Moran Avigny stuffing a classic silver mirror into his makeup mirror and lending it to the Overseer.
unit.target: In segmento fati praeterito, Lumian conspectus est Moran Avigny speculum classicum argenteum in speculum faciei suae inserere et illud Supervisori tradidisse.

unit.source: At the source of the mercury river of fate, the 17- or 18-year-old Mirror Moran Avigny swiftly materialized in the dark and cold room, his expression naturally sinister.
unit.target: Apud fontem fluminis mercurii fati, Moran Avigny Speculi, annos XVII vel XVIII natus, celeriter in conclavi obscuro et frigido apparuit, vultu naturaliter malevolenti.

unit.source: The classic silver mirror bears a striking resemblance to the one Franca found at the overflow of corruption in the mirror world. She had relied on the latter to enter Fourth Epoch Trier during Operation Hostel… Could such a mirror be closely tied to the Mirror People?
unit.target: Speculum classicum argenteum notabiliter simile est illi, quod Franca in inundatione corruptionis in mundo speculi invenit. Illo confugerat ut in Trier Quarti Æpoci, per Operationem Hostel, intraret… Num tale speculum arcte coniungi possit cum Populo Speculi?

unit.source: Didn’t Moran Avigny say that the descendants of the Tamara family naturally have a corresponding Mirror Person?
unit.target: Nonne dixit Moran Avigny quod posteritas familiae Tamarae naturaliter habeat personam speculi correspondentem?

unit.source: Why wasn’t he a baby when he was born as a Mirror Person?
unit.target: Cur non infans erat, cum ut Persona Speculi natus esset?

unit.source: The descendants of the Tamara family must reach a certain age or have done something specific to produce the corresponding Mirror People?
unit.target: Nonne posteritas familiae Tamarae certam aetatis finem attingere debet aut aliquid specificum facienda est, ut personae speculi correspondentis producantur?

unit.source: He doesn’t seem to understand what’s going on either…
unit.target: Ille parum videtur intellegere quid agatur…

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian didn’t allow the Fate Appropriation attempt to end naturally and result in failure.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian non permisit experimentum appropriationis fati naturaliter finiri et in defectum degere.

unit.source: He seized the moment and grasped a fate fragment in his right hand.
unit.target: Ille momentum arripuit et fatum fragmentum in manu dextra apprehendit.

unit.source: Through the spew of his spirituality, he slowly extracted the abnormally heavy target from the mercury-colored illusory river.
unit.target: Per effusum spiritualitatis suae, lente extraxit obiectum insolitè grave ex flumine mercurii illusorii.

unit.source: The fate fragment corresponded to the scene of Moran Avigny’s lust exploding under the Symphony of Hatred.
unit.target: Fragmentum fati correspondebat scaenae in qua libidine Moran Avigny sub Symphonia Odii erupta erat.

unit.source: As time passed, Franca and Jenna asked about the other Mirror People to divert Moran Avigny’s attention, and the fate fragment finally left the mercury river.
unit.target: Cum tempus transibat, Franca et Jenna de reliquis Hominibus Speculi quaesiverunt ut attentionem Moran Avigny avertirent, et fragmentum fati denique flumen mercurii reliquit.

unit.source: Consequently, the hole that had appeared was neither filled nor rewoven. Empty chaos occupied it, emitting a thin fog.
unit.target: Consequenter, foramen quod apparuit neque repletum neque restitutum est; chaos vacuum eum occupabat, tenuam nebam efferens.

unit.source: After storing the obtained fate fragments into his Spirit Body, Lumian carefully observed Moran Avigny’s transformation.
unit.target: Postquam fatum fragmenta adeptata in corpus spiritale suum condidit, Lumian diligenter mutationem Moran Avigny inspicuit.

unit.source: As he waited, he muttered inwardly, The fact that we caught Moran Avigny remains unchanged…
unit.target: Dum exspectabat, intus submurmuravit: "Res quod Moran Avigny cepimus immutata manet…"

unit.source: Him drinking the truth serum and being hypnotized remain unchanged…
unit.target: "Eius serum veritatis bibere et hypnotizari immutata manent…"

unit.source: We haven’t forgotten what he just said…
unit.target: Id, quod modo dixerat, non obliti sumus…

unit.source: “Yes, this Fate Appropriation took a total of three minutes. The fate fragment depicting his eruption of lust weighs heavily in Moran Avigny’s entire life. After all, it caused his fate to take a sharp turn for the worse…”
unit.target: "Ita, haec appropriatio fati totum tres minuta tulit.

unit.source: Appropriation requires a distance of 15 meters. Obtaining the target’s blood is unnecessary…
unit.target: Appropriatio spatium quindecim metrorum requirit. Sanguinem obiecti acquirere non necessarium est…

unit.source: While stirring fate and waiting for completion, I can’t attack the target, but I can stay away…
unit.target: Dum fatum agitans et completionem exspectans, obiectum oppugnare non possum, sed ab eo distantiam servare valeo…

unit.source: It’s more convenient to kill him directly. The Appropriation can be completed in a matter of seconds…
unit.target: Commodius est eum directe interficere; Appropriatio paucis secundis perfici potest…

unit.source: As Lumian reviewed, Moran Avigny’s weakened aura gradually filled up, and his face flushed.
unit.target: Dum Lumian recensit, aura Moran Avigny debilitata paulatim repleta est, et vultus eius rubore effusus est.

unit.source: The bloodstains and tears on his face vanished.
unit.target: Sanguinei maculae et lacrimae in facie eius evanuerunt.

unit.source: Yes, there was no eruption of lust, so no severe injuries… Lumian harrumphed as Moran Avigny’s face lit up with pleasant surprise.
unit.target: Ita, eruptio libidinis non evenit, ergo graves laesiones non passa sunt… Lumian sibilavit, cum vultus Moran Avigny iucunda admiratione fulserat.

unit.source: Two beams of white light struck Moran Avigny, knocking him unconscious.
unit.target: Duae radii lucis albae Moran Avigny percuterunt, eum in inscienciam deiecērunt.

unit.source: Simultaneously, Jenna and Franca, who had been closely monitoring Lumian’s movements, aimed their revolvers at the yet-to-collapse Moran Avigny’s head.
unit.target: Simul, Jenna et Franca, quae motus Lumiani arcte observaverant, revolveris in caput Moran Avigny, nondum collapsum, destinaverunt.

unit.source: Amidst the gunshots, the Disciplinary Paladin’s head exploded like blood-colored fireworks.
unit.target: Inter clangores sclopetorum, caput Paladini Disciplinarii quasi ignis artificialis sanguine coloratus explosum est.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t complain about Franca and Jenna not giving him a chance to cull.
unit.target: Lumian non querelavit de Franca et Jenna quod ei occasionem ad caedem non dederunt.

unit.source: He didn’t want to waste his spirituality on Culling.
unit.target: Non voluit spiritualitatem suam in caedem terere.

unit.source: When he appeared at the last moment and used the Symphony of Hatred to shatter Moran Avigny’s remaining Mirror Substitution and capture him, he felt as if the potion had digested somewhat due to the successful cull.
unit.target: Cum ad ultimum momentum apparuisset et Symphonia Odii uti coepisset ad stridentem reliquam speculi substitutionem Moran Avigny frangendam atque eum capiendum, sensit quasi potionem propter felicem caedem aliquantulum digerisse.

unit.source: Thud!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s lifeless body crumpled to the ground, and Franca prepared to channel the spirit.
unit.target: Corpus sine vita Moran Avigny in terram corruit, et Franca ad spiritum evocandum se praeparavit.

unit.source: 727 Arrival
unit.target: 727 Adventus

unit.source: As Franca prepared the ritual, she considered her options and said to Lumian, “The Overseer’s mirror coordinates are indescribable and can only be procured through mystical means.
unit.target: Dum Franca ritum parabat, optiones suas consideravit et Lumiano dixit: “Coordinates speculi praefectoris indescribibiles sunt et solum per vias mysticas comparari possunt.

unit.source: The Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell isn’t capable of that.
unit.target: Incantatio Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici non id efficit.

unit.source: I intend to use standard spirit channeling instead.”
unit.target: Intendo spiritum canalizationem ordinariam potius uti.”

unit.source: While the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell she had developed greatly extended the duration of the channeling and the number of questions the spirit would respond to, it was constrained by relying on the mirror as a medium, forfeiting the chance for other types of interaction.
unit.target: Dum incantatio Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici, quam evolverat, diuturnitatem canalizationis atque numerum quaestionum quibus spiritus responderet multum extendit, restricta est eo quod speculum tam medium adhiberet, ita facultatem aliorum modorum interactionis amittens.

unit.source: “Regular spirit channeling drastically restricts the intel we can gather…”
unit.target: “Canalizatio spiritus ordinaria valde restringit notitiam quam colligere possumus…”

unit.source: Lumian thought briefly and said, “For the first question, we should have him provide the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror.
unit.target: Lumian brevi cogitavit et dixit: “Pro prima quaestione, eum oportet ut coordinates speculi praefectoris praebeat.

unit.source: Second, ask about the whereabouts of the classic silver mirror utilized for the ritual and leader communication.
unit.target: Secundo, quaere unde sit speculum argenteum classicum, quod ad ritum et ad communicationem cum duce adhibetur.

unit.source: Third, inquire about the identities and locations of the Mirror People in contact with him, ranked by importance.”
unit.target: Tertio, interroga de identitatibus et locis Populi Speculorum, qui cum eo sunt in contactu, secundum momentum ordinatos.”

unit.source: Once the third question was answered, the spirit channeling ritual would come to its natural conclusion.
unit.target: Cum tertia quaestio respondita fuerit, ritus canalizationis spiritus ad finem suum naturalem perveniet.

unit.source: Lumian suspected Moran Avigny might not have time to “introduce” every Mirror Person under his command.
unit.target: Lumian suspicabatur Moran Avigny tempus non habere ut omnes Populos Speculorum sub imperio suo introducere valeat.

unit.source: Hence, he asked for them to be prioritized based on the criticality of their role and responsibilities.
unit.target: Ergo posuit ut hi secundum momentum muneris et officiorum suorum praeferantur.

unit.source: “A classic silver mirror?”
unit.target: “Speculum argenteum classicum?”

unit.source: Franca asked, puzzled.
unit.target: Franca quaesivit, perplexa.

unit.source: “Yes, Moran Avigny has a mirror akin to the classic silver one you used to own.
unit.target: “Ita, Moran Avigny speculum habet simile speculo argenteo classico, quod olim possidebas.

unit.source: It’s vital for communicating with Mirror Roselle,”
unit.target: Id est vitale ad communicationem cum Speculo Rosella,”

unit.source: Lumian explained succinctly.
unit.target: Lumian breviter explanavit.

unit.source: While speaking, he crouched and rummaged through Moran Avigny’s pockets.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, se inclinavit et in sinibus Moran Avigny quaesivit.

unit.source: Unfortunately, the Minister of Industry carried only a handful of large bills and some loose change totaling 3,212 verl d’or.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Minister Industria solum paucas notas magnas et aliquam pecuniam levem, summa 3,212 verl d’or, gerebat.

unit.source: Besides the money, there was an elegant golden mechanical pocket watch, a meticulously embroidered handkerchief, and a wallet crafted by a private designer and artisan.
unit.target: Praeter pecuniam, erat horologium mechanicum aureum elegans, sudarium diligentissime ex contextum, et marsupium a privato designatore et artifici confectum.

unit.source: But not a single item imbued with Beyonder powers!
unit.target: Sed nullum quidem obiectum viribus Beyonder imbuitum erat!

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t resist mimicking Franca’s inner thought: “Poor slob!”
unit.target: Lumian non potuit resistite imitare interiorem Francae cogitationem: “Pauper spurcus!”

unit.source: He realized that as the sitting Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny was under the watchful eye of official Beyonders.
unit.target: Animadvertit, ut minister industriae sedens, Moran Avigny sub vigilanti oculo Beyonder officialium esset.

unit.source: He was unlikely to carry mystical items, Beyonder weapons, or anything that might reveal his abnormality.
unit.target: Minime verisimile erat eum portare res mysticas, arma Beyonder, aut quidquid eius anomaliam revelare posset.

unit.source: As a Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladin of the Judgment pathway, disclosing this to the two Churches would raise difficult questions about how he obtained the potion formula and Beyonder characteristics at that level.
unit.target: Ut Paladinus Disciplinarius Sequenciae 5 viae Iudicii, hoc divulgare ad duas Ecclesias quaestiones arduas excitaret de modis quibus potionis formula et proprietates Beyonder in illo gradu obtinerentur.

unit.source: When signing the contract, he would at most acknowledge being a Beyonder of a related pathway without specifying the Sequence.
unit.target: Contractum subsignando, maxime confitebatur se Beyonder esse ad viam cognatam, nec Sequenciam designare.

unit.source: This cost him the chance to procure items openly, forcing him to rely on Brokers—something official Beyonders couldn’t be privy to.
unit.target: Hoc ei impedivit occasionem item aperte comparandi, cogens eum in Brokeris confidere—rem, quam Beyonder officiales nescire poterant.

unit.source: Moran Avigny didn’t require the Overseer’s assistance with the Under the Table deal to access mystical items, as Mirror People could transfer objects through mirrors.
unit.target: Moran Avigny auxilia Praefectoris in pacto “Sub Mensa” ad res mysticas accedendas non requirebat, quoniam Populi Speculorum res per specula transferre poterant.

unit.source: If he genuinely needed an item for a specific purpose, he could reach out to his mirror world associates and have them “send” it over, returning it promptly after use.
unit.target: Si ad aliquam rem specialem vere indigeret, possit ad socios sui ex mundo speculari recurrere et eos iubere ut eam “mitterent”, eam celeriter post usum reddens.

unit.source: Lumian sighed, pocketed the cash, watch, and other belongings, and rose to his feet.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, pecuniam, horologium et cetera in sacculis recondidit, atque surrexit.

unit.source: With Franca’s spirit channeling preparations complete, Lumian turned to Jenna, still composing her letter, and asked, “You shot without hesitation earlier.
unit.target: Cum praeparationes canalizationis spiritus Francae confecta essent, Lumian ad Jennam, quae epistolam scribere continuabat, se convertebat atque rogavit: “Prius sine dubitatione iaculata es.

unit.source: Did it weigh on you at all?
unit.target: Numquid tibi gravuit?

unit.source: This wasn’t a battle.
unit.target: Hoc non erat proelium.

unit.source: We’d been engaged in friendly conversation with Moran Avigny for a while now.
unit.target: Iam diuturno tempore colloquium amicale cum Moran Avigny habuimus.

unit.source: I even started to feel like we were becoming friends.”
unit.target: Etiam coepi sentire quasi amicos fiamus.”

unit.source: Jenna glanced up at Lumian while writing on a protruding rock of the cave wall.
unit.target: Jenna ad Lumian intuita est dum in saxo eminenti parietis speluncae scribebat.

unit.source: She laughed softly.
unit.target: Submissa risit.

unit.source: “Worried I’ll bottle up my emotional turmoil and cause issues down the line?
unit.target: “Pertimesne ne tumultus affectuum meorum coartus maneat et difficultates in posterum oriantur?

unit.source: Planning to play psychiatrist and offer me counseling?”
unit.target: Cogitans te quasi psychiatrem agere atque mihi consilium offerre?”

unit.source: Anthony Reid, who had been observing silently, living up to his role as a Spectator, scratched his nose self-consciously.
unit.target: Anthony Reid, qui silentio observabat et muneri Spectatoris incumbebat, nasum suum cum timore conscientiae arrupit.

unit.source: That seemed to be his job.
unit.target: Id videtur esse officium eius.

unit.source: However, he could discern that Jenna and Franca were not in need of counseling.
unit.target: Attamen animadvertit Jennam et Francam consilio non egere.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t tackle Jenna’s question head-on.
unit.target: Lumian quaestionem Jennae directe non responsit.

unit.source: With a smile, he remarked, “You haven’t taken many lives yourself.”
unit.target: Sub risu, ille dixit: “Non tot vitas abstulisti.”

unit.source: “Had we not pulled the trigger, would you have taken action?
unit.target: “An, nisi ictum deesset, ageresne?

unit.source: Despite feeling you had befriended Moran Avigny, I think you wouldn’t have flinched at blowing his head off,”
unit.target: Quamquam existimabas te cum Moran Avigny amicam esse relationem, puto te non titubavisse ad eius caput explodendum,”

unit.source: Jenna retorted, a smile playing on her lips.
unit.target: Jenna respondit, subrisu labiis ornata.

unit.source: Lumian let out a derisive snort.
unit.target: Lumian irridens sputum edidit.

unit.source: “I’m not like you.
unit.target: “Non similis sum tibi.

unit.source: I’ve killed more people than I can count.”
unit.target: Multos homines interfeci, quos numerare non possum.”

unit.source: Jenna met his gaze again.
unit.target: Jenna iterum eius aspectum convenit.

unit.source: “Moran Avigny admitted to his crimes.
unit.target: “Moran Avigny crimina sua agnovit.

unit.source: He lured the real Moran Avigny into the mirror, holding him captive before ruthlessly ending his life.
unit.target: Eum, verum Moran Avigny, in speculum allicit, eum captivum retinens antequam vitam eius crudelis modo finiret.

unit.source: I felt no qualms about carrying out the execution of a guilty man.”
unit.target: Nullas remoras sensitus sum in supplicio viri reum.

unit.source: “You’ve changed…”
unit.target: “Mutata es…”

unit.source: Lumian let out an exaggerated sigh and quipped, “Once upon a time, you depended on the police and authorities to punish the bad guys.”
unit.target: Lumian exsaggeratum suspirium edidit atque iocose inquit: “Olim in vigilum et auctoritatum fidem innixus es ad peccatores punire.”

unit.source: Jenna didn’t have a chance to respond, as Franca had finished her spirit channeling.
unit.target: Jenna occasionem respondendi non habuit, cum Franca canalizationem spiritus perfecisset.

unit.source: In the wavering dark-green candlelight, Moran Avigny’s spirit took shape above his corpse, perceptible to those who had activated their Spirit Vision.
unit.target: In luce viridique obscurae candelarum vacillantis, spiritus Moran Avigny super cadaver eius formam suscepit, ab illis qui Visionem Spiritus excitaverant, perceptibilis.

unit.source: Franca acted swiftly.
unit.target: Franca celeriter egit.

unit.source: Withdrawing the glass-like Mirror Cufflink from her sleeve, she addressed Moran Avigny’s spirit, “Give me the coordinates of the Overseer’s mirror.”
unit.target: Ex manica cufflink speculi vitrei extrahens, ad spiritum Moran Avigny locuta est: “Da mihi coordinates speculi praefectoris.”

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s indistinct, menacing face twisted in anguish.
unit.target: Vultus indeterminus et minax Moran Avigny angore contractus est.

unit.source: But stripped of life, he no longer had the ironclad self-control to resist the commanding pull of the spirit channeling.
unit.target: Sed, vita destituens, non iam habebat rigidae moderationis vires ad vim imperii canalizationis spiritus resistere.

unit.source: He stretched out his right hand, motioning for Franca to hand over the Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Manum dexteram protendit, Francae signum dedit ut cufflink speculi tradiret.

unit.source: Anticipating this, Franca passed him the Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Prævidens hoc, Franca illi cufflink speculi tradidit.

unit.source: As Moran Avigny’s spirit clutched the cufflink, a shadowy light shimmered across its form, drawn into the glass-like accessory.
unit.target: Dum spiritus Moran Avigny cufflink concepit, lumen umbratile per eius formam micavit, in ornamentum vitreum trahens.

unit.source: Franca exhaled in relief upon the Mirror Cufflink’s return.
unit.target: Franca leviter suspiravit de reditu cufflink speculi.

unit.source: Having achieved the primary objective, it was time to reap further rewards!
unit.target: Prima meta confecta, tempus erat ulteriora praemia colligere!

unit.source: Her mood buoyed, Franca inquired of Moran Avigny with piqued interest, “Is there a functional classic silver mirror in your possession…
unit.target: Animata animo, Franca cum acuto studio a Moran Avigny quesivit: “Habesne speculum argenteum classicum functionalem in tua possessione…

unit.source: Hold on…”
unit.target: Exspecta…”

unit.source: Abruptly realizing this constituted a question, she hastily rephrased.”Where is the classic silver mirror the Overseer used to facilitate communication with your leader?”
unit.target: Subito intellegens hoc quaestionem esse, festinanter redixerat: “Ubi est speculum argenteum classicum, quod praefector ad communicationem cum duce tuo adhibebat?”

unit.source: Lumian had already ascertained Moran Avigny didn’t have it on him.
unit.target: Lumian iam perspexerat Moran Avigny id in se non habere.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s spirit responded with cold rigidity, “Griffith has it.
unit.target: Spiritus Moran Avigny cum frigida rigiditate respondit: “Griffith id habet.

unit.source: When I require it, I have him deliver it to me through the mirror.”
unit.target: Quando id require, eum iubeo ut per speculum mihi tradat.”

unit.source: Franca’s initial elation quickly gave way to an exasperated curse.
unit.target: Gaudium primum Francae celeriter in exasperatum maledictum conversa est.

unit.source: “Dammit!”
unit.target: “Damnatum!”

unit.source: It dawned on her that she couldn’t extract Griffith’s mirror coordinates from Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Illuc eam pervenit quod coordinates speculi Griffith a Moran Avigny extrahere non posset.

unit.source: The spirit channeling had but one question remaining.
unit.target: Canalizatio spiritus solam quaestionem reliquam habebat.

unit.source: She needed to ask Moran Avigny about the Mirror People serving as their contacts and their true identities.
unit.target: Eam oportebat a Moran Avigny quaerere de Populis Speculorum, qui ut contactus funguntur, et de eorum veris identitatibus.

unit.source: Requesting mirror coordinates was out of the question!
unit.target: Petere coordinates speculi impossibile erat!

unit.source: Lumian and Anthony immediately grasped the reason for Franca’s self-directed frustration, but they were powerless to intervene.
unit.target: Lumian et Anthony statim causam frustrationis a Franca sui intellexerunt, sed intervenire non poterant.

unit.source: Certain questions hinged on preceding answers, and mirror coordinates couldn’t be conveyed through the Magic Mirror Spirit Channeling Spell.
unit.target: Quaedam quaestiones ex praecedentibus responsionibus pendebant, et coordinates speculi per incantationem Spiritus Canalizationis Speculi Magici tradi non poterant.

unit.source: Collecting herself, Franca fixed her gaze on Moran Avigny’s spirit.
unit.target: Se contuliens, Franca oculos suos in spiritum Moran Avigny fixavit.

unit.source: Marshaling her thoughts, she articulated, “Name the Mirror People in contact with you.
unit.target: Cogitationes suas ordinans, dixit: “Nomina Populos Speculorum, qui tecum sunt in contactu.

unit.source: What roles do they play in the real world?
unit.target: Quae munera in mundo reali agunt?

unit.source: Begin with those of the highest rank and responsibility.”
unit.target: Incipe ab iis summi ordinis et officii.

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s ghostly, blurred visage contorted once more.
unit.target: Vultus phantasma et nebulosus Moran Avigny iterum contorquebatur.

unit.source: Despite his resistance, he responded in a clipped tone, “First, there’s Griffith, who serves as my second-in-command.
unit.target: Quamquam repugnans, respondebat concisus: “Primum, Griffith est, qui mihi secundarius imperator fungitur.

unit.source: Originally, he was a key figure in the Moses Ascetic Order.
unit.target: Olim figura praecipua in Ordine Ascetico Mosiensi fuit.

unit.source: With our assistance, he’s steadily elevating his position within the Order.
unit.target: Auxilio nostro, constanter locum suum in Ordine augere conatur.

unit.source: His aspiration is for the secret organization to eventually join the alliance to open Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal…”
unit.target: Eius aspiratio est ut societas arcana tandem ad coniunctionem accedat ad sigillum Quartae Epoch Trier aperiendum…”

unit.source: The Moses Ascetic Order…
unit.target: Ordo Asceticus Mosiensis…

unit.source: The very group that clashed with Element Dawn, headed by the Emperor’s firstborn, Bernadette?
unit.target: Coetus ille, qui cum Elemento Aurora certabat, ducitur a primogenita imperatoris, Bernadette?

unit.source: If memory serves, they primarily consist of Mystery Pryer pathway Beyonders…
unit.target: Si memoria servat, praecipue ex Beyonder in via Mystery Pryer constare vident…

unit.source: I can’t help but wonder if the Research Society has members from either faction.
unit.target: Nescio quin cogitare possim num Societas Investigationis membra ex utraque factione habeat.

unit.source: There must be others like myself with multiple secret society affiliations…
unit.target: Certe alii, sicut ego, cum pluribus nexibus in societatibus arcanis, esse debent…

unit.source: Franca listened intently, not daring to disrupt Moran Avigny’s account.
unit.target: Franca attente auscultavit, non audens narrationem Moran Avigny interrumpere.

unit.source: Moran Avigny proceeded to the second Mirror Person.
unit.target: Moran Avigny ad secundum Populum Speculorum procedit.

unit.source: “Caratanza Tamara, part of our branch’s Tamara family.
unit.target: “Caratanza Tamara, pars familiae Tamara rami nostri.

unit.source: He enlisted in the military and now holds the rank of colonel.
unit.target: Militiae se adiunxit et nunc gradum colonelis obtinet.

unit.source: He legitimized his Beyonder powers by slaying a Loen Kingdom spy, seizing their potion formula and Judgment pathway characteristics…
unit.target: Eius vires Beyonder legitimas fecit, dum speculator Regni Loen interfecit, eorum potionis formulam et proprietates viae Iudicii rapiens…

unit.source: “Palia, a ore scholar originally.
unit.target: “Palia, olim erudita in metallo.

unit.source: She infiltrated the Trier Cave Association to mask our attempts at uncovering a vulnerability in the seal…
unit.target: Infiltravit Societatem Speluncarum Trier, ut conatus nostros ad infirmitatem sigilli detegendam celare posset…

unit.source: “Sport, Trier’s Deputy Commissioner of Police and a member of the police commission.
unit.target: “Sport, vice commissarius vigilum Trier et membrum commissionis vigilum.

unit.source: His original self was purposely corrupted during an operation.
unit.target: Eius forma originalis proposito in operatione corrupta est.

unit.source: Subsequently, Griffith and Caratanza orchestrated an ambush, dragging him into the mirror and allowing the mirror world’s Sport to emerge and assume his place…
unit.target: Postea, Griffith et Caratanza insidias composuerunt, eum in speculum trahebant et Sport, ex mundo speculari, emergere ac locum eius obtinere sinerunt…

unit.source: By this point, Moran Avigny’s spirit had become increasingly insubstantial, on the brink of dissipation.
unit.target: Hac in hora, spiritus Moran Avigny magis magisque insubstantialis factus erat, evanescendi limine.

unit.source: At that instant, Jenna concluded her letter and pivoted to face Lumian.
unit.target: Illo momento, Jenna epistolam finivit et se ad Lumian convertit.

unit.source: “I’ll now summon Madam Judgment’s messenger.”
unit.target: “Nunc advocabo nuntium Dominae Iudicii.”

unit.source: The words had scarcely left her mouth when an ethereal voice, seemingly originating from a great distance, reverberated in the ears of Jenna, Lumian, and the others.
unit.target: Vix verba e ore eius exierant, cum vox aetherea, paene ex longinquo orta, in auribus Jennae, Lumiani, et ceterorum resonabat.

unit.source: “Summoning won’t be necessary.”
unit.target: “Vocatio non erit necessaria.”

unit.source: A shared premonition compelled Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony to direct their attention to the side of the quarry cave.
unit.target: Communis praemonitio Lumian, Francam, Jennam, et Anthoni coegit ut intentionem suam ad latus fodinarum speluncae converterent.

unit.source: In the chamber’s dim illumination, supplied only by carbide lamps and candles, dazzling starlight coalesced in the void, rapidly tracing the outline of an enchanting door.
unit.target: In obscura camerae luce, solum lumine lampadarum carbidentium et candelarum provisa, stellae fulgida in vacuo coalescebant, celeriter figuram ianuae incantatae delineantes.

unit.source: Noiselessly, the door swung open, revealing an enormous pumpkin carriage drawn by a multitude of gray rats.
unit.target: Sine strepitu, ianua aperiebatur, demonstrans currum cucurbitaceum ingentem a multitudine murum cinereorum tractatum.

unit.source: Three women occupied the carriage’s interior.
unit.target: Tres feminae currus interiori occupant.

unit.source: One was Magician, resplendent in a beige gown with a high collar adorned with golden embroidery.
unit.target: Una erat Maga, in vestimenta beige splendida, cum colla alto aureis ornamentis innixis.

unit.source: Another was Judgment, her shoulder-length flaxen hair complementing her grayish‑white knight’s attire, accented by brown leather armor.
unit.target: Altera erat Iudicium, capillis flavis ad humeros usque, qui vestimentum equitis cinereo-album complementabant, lorica coriacea fusca accentuata.

unit.source: The third woman was clad in a purple dress bearing a cryptic pattern.
unit.target: Tertia femina induta erat vestitu purpureo, cum exemplo arcaico inscripto.

unit.source: A celestial globe and sundry items dangled from her waist, and refined spectacles perched upon her nose.
unit.target: Globus caelestis et varia ex inguine eius pendent, et oculi speculares elegantes in naso eius insident.

unit.source: Clasped in her left hand was a peculiar lamp, its surface golden like a kettle and adorned with enigmatic designs.
unit.target: In manu sinistra tenebatur lampas peculiaris, cuius superficies aurea quasi ollae similis erat et designis enigmaticis ornata.

unit.source: 728 Tracking
unit.target: 728 Vestigatio

unit.source: Lumian, Franca, and Jenna’s eyes widened as they caught sight of the strange golden lamp, making a bold conjecture.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani, Francae, et Jennae dilatati sunt, cum speciem lampadis aureae insolitae conspexissent, audacem coniecturam facientes.

unit.source: Could it be 0-05, the Magic Wishing Lamp?
unit.target: Num sit 0‑05, Lampas Magica Votiva?

unit.source: Yes, the pumpkin carriage is one of Major Arcana Ma’am Hermit’s trademark symbols.
unit.target: Ita, carruca cucurbitae est una ex insignibus typicis Dominae Eremitae Majorum Arcanae.

unit.source: She has close ties to Element Dawn’s leader—Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter—and the current owner of 0-05, Bernadette.
unit.target: Ea arctos nexus habet cum duce Elementi Aurorae—filia maioris imperatoris Roselle—et hodierna possessor 0‑05, Bernadetta.

unit.source: It isn’t outside the realm of possibility that she might have borrowed the Magic Wishing Lamp…
unit.target: Neque est impossibile ut illa Lampam Magicam Votivam mutuaverit…

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through their minds, they heard Anthony’s respectful greeting, “Good evening, Madam Magician, Madam Judgment.”
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentes eorum festinabant, audiverunt salutem reverentem a Antonio: “Bona vespera, Domina Magica, Domina Iudicium.”

unit.source: Snapping out of their momentary trance, Lumian and the others quickly followed suit with their own greetings.
unit.target: Ex eorum brevi extasi evasis, Lumian et ceteri celeriter se salutaverunt.

unit.source: “And this is Ma’am Hermit,” Magician added briefly.
unit.target: “Et ecce, haec est Domina Eremita,” addidit Domina Magica breviter.

unit.source: Once the introductions were complete, the woman in the beige dress with a gold-embroidered high collar retrieved a bottle of dark‑red wine from the void and said to Franca, “Hand over that cufflink. Once you do, you can all head home and get some rest.”
unit.target: Cum introductiones completae fuerunt, femina in veste cana cum colla altissima auro inscripta lagena vini obscuri rubri e inane extraxit et Francae dixit: “Tradite illam fibulam. Cum id feceritis, omnes domum redire potestis et quiescere.”

unit.source: Confronting the School of Truth’s Overseer was clearly a battle at the demigod level.
unit.target: Opponere Moderatori Scholae Veritatis plane erat certamen ad gradum semideorum.

unit.source: It wasn’t something Lumian and company could get involved in.
unit.target: Non erat res in quam Lumian et ceteri implicari possent.

unit.source: Franca had no intention of forcing the issue.
unit.target: Franca non intendebat rem impellere.

unit.source: She handed the glass‑like cufflink to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Illam fibulam quasi vitream tradidit Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: In exchange, Madam Magician gave her the wine bottle containing a faint dark‑red liquid.
unit.target: Pro hoc, Domina Magica ei tradidit lagena vini, quae tenuem liquorem rubri obscuri continebat.

unit.source: “This is a mystical item that restores stamina and spirituality after drinking it.
unit.target: Hoc est obiectum mysticum, quod robur et spiritualitatem reficit postquam bibitur.

unit.source: But remember, you can only have it once a day. Don’t go turning into a drunkard.”
unit.target: Sed memento, id solum semel die capere potes. Noli id inebriatum fieri.

unit.source: Just one more sip and you’ll become a drunkard?
unit.target: Unum tantum sorbum et inebriatus fies?

unit.source: Franca and the others instantly understood the deeper meaning behind Madam Magician’s final warning.
unit.target: Franca et ceteri statim intellexerunt sensum profundum post ultimam admonitionem Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: Seeing only a single sip of dark‑red wine in the bottle, Franca turned to pass the old glass bottle to Lumian.
unit.target: Cum videbat in lagena solum unum sorbum vini obscuri rubri, Franca se convertit ut vetustam lagena vitrea Lumiano traderet.

unit.source: He had expended the most spirituality, after all.
unit.target: Ille enim plurimam spiritualitatem consumaverat.

unit.source: Madam Magician rubbed the Mirror Cufflink between her fingers, a smile playing on her lips.
unit.target: Domina Magica fibulam specularis inter digitos suos fregit, dum risus labris eius luderet.

unit.source: “Don’t worry. You won’t be able to finish it. It’s called Bottomless Wine.”
unit.target: Noli solliciti esse. Non poteris id finire. Id vocatur “Vinum Sine Fondo.”

unit.source: I see… Franca still wanted to give it a shot.
unit.target: Video… Franca tamen id conari volebat.

unit.source: She unscrewed the thin metal cap and downed the light dark‑red wine.
unit.target: Illa detorquevit tenue operculum metallicum et deglutit levis vini obscuri rubri.

unit.source: As the slightly astringent and sweet alcohol slid down her throat, she felt refreshed, as if she’d just had a good night’s sleep and hadn’t been in a fierce battle with Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Dum alcohol paulo astringens et dulcis per guttur eius labebatur, se recreatam sensit, quasi modo optima nocte quiesceret et non esset in acerba pugna cum Moran Avigny.

unit.source: At the same time, she noticed dark‑red liquid seeping from the bottom of the old glass bottle, forming a thin layer of wine.
unit.target: Simul animadvertit liquorem rubri obscuri e fundo veteris lagenae vitreae effluere, tenuem stratum vini formans.

unit.source: It really is bottomless… Franca sighed, handing the old glass bottle to Lumian.
unit.target: Revera sine fundo est… Franca suspiravit, veterem lagena vitrea Lumiano tradens.

unit.source: But just as she reached out, a sudden sense of unease struck her.
unit.target: Sed modo ut extendit manum, subito sensus incommoditatis eam percussit.

unit.source: Acting on instinct, she changed course, intending to let Jenna drink first.
unit.target: Instinctu agens, iter mutavit, intendens ut Jenna primo bibat.

unit.source: Yet upon further reflection, she realized something was even more off!
unit.target: Sed post ulteriores cogitationes, intellexit aliquid etiam magis esse prorsus aberrans!

unit.source: Because she still had to pass it to Lumian afterward!
unit.target: Quia postea eam Lumiano tradere oportebat!

unit.source: Never mind, never mind. No point getting caught up in trivial matters… Franca muttered in her native tongue.
unit.target: Noli, noli. Nullum est momentum in rebus levibus versari… Franca in lingua sua murmurat.

unit.source: Instead, she circled her finger around the bottle and managed to form a thin layer of frost.
unit.target: Pro eo, digitum circa lagena circumduxit et tenuam pelliculam gelidam formare potuit.

unit.source: As the frost naturally fell away, Franca passed the Bottomless Wine to Jenna.
unit.target: Dum pellicula gelida naturaliter lapsa est, Franca “Vinum Sine Fondo” ad Jennam tradidit.

unit.source: Jenna drank the dark‑red wine, mimicked Franca’s actions, and then handed it to Lumian.
unit.target: Jenna vinum obscuri rubri bibit, actiones Francae imitata, deinde illud Lumiano tradidit.

unit.source: Franca breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Franca leviter suspiravit.

unit.source: Lumian paid no mind to the Demonesses’ odd behavior.
unit.target: Lumian non curavit de insolito more daemonarum.

unit.source: He was more concerned about the strange actions of Ma’am Hermit and Madam Magician.
unit.target: Ipse magis sollicitus erat de insolitis actionibus Dominae Eremitae et Dominae Magicae.

unit.source: Ma’am Hermit’s eyes, obscured by lenses, grew dark but remained unfocused, as if staring into a vast expanse.
unit.target: Oculi Dominae Eremitae, ab linteis obtecti, obscuri facti sunt, sed non intendentes, quasi in immensum spatium intuebantur.

unit.source: Countless brilliant specks of light appeared around her, as if she had shrunk the universe and brought it down to the ground.
unit.target: Innumerabilia puncta lucis radiantis circa eam apparuerunt, quasi universum contrahuisset et in terram adduxisset.

unit.source: Performing divination or prophecy before tackling important matters?
unit.target: Num divinare aut prophetare priusquam res maximi momenti aggrediantur?

unit.source: Lumian took the old glass bottle and drank the dark‑red wine.
unit.target: Lumian veterem lagena vitrea arripuit et vinum obscuri rubri bibit.

unit.source: His spirituality rapidly recovered, as if he’d experienced six in the morning.
unit.target: Spiritualitas eius celeriter restituta est, quasi sex horas matutinas haberet.

unit.source: Of course, the portion of accumulated spirituality he had used didn’t “return.”
unit.target: Certe, portio spiritualitatis accumulatae quam usus erat non redibat.

unit.source: Phew, Lumian’s anxiety over his spirituality deficiency had been alleviated.
unit.target: Phew, sollicitudo Lumiani de suo defectu spiritualitatis amota erat.

unit.source: After Anthony drank the Bottomless Wine and returned the mystical item to Madam Magician, the Mirror Cufflink’s dark glow, mixed with starlight, flew out and landed on the Major Arcana card holder’s eye.
unit.target: Postquam Antonius “Vinum Sine Fondo” bibit et obiectum mysticum Dominae Magicae reddidit, fulgor obscurus Fibulae Specularis, cum luce stellarum mixta, evolavit et in oculo tenentis chartae Major Arcana incidit.

unit.source: Madam Magician sent Mirror Cufflink flying toward Franca while extending her hands, grasping the void, and pulling it apart on either side.
unit.target: Domina Magica, extendens manus, vacuum arripiens et utrumque latus tollens, misit Fibulam Specularis volitare ad Francam.

unit.source: Without a sound, the void ripped open like a transparent membrane, revealing passageways formed by spiderwebs of emptiness and darkness.
unit.target: Sine sono, vacuum discidit ut membrana translucida, transitus revelans contextos ex rete vacuitatis et tenebris.

unit.source: This was a standard mirror world.
unit.target: Hoc erat mundus specularis ordinarius.

unit.source: Magician had opened an illusory door to the mirror world without using a mirror!
unit.target: Domina Magica aperuit ianuam illusoriam ad mundum specularis, sine speculum utens!

unit.source: Is this the advanced power of the Apprentice pathway? Lumian and company inwardly marveled.
unit.target: Num haec est potestas provecta viae discipuli? Lumian et ceteri intime mirabantur.

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced at Ma’am Hermit beside her.
unit.target: Domina Magica intuita est ad Dominam Eremitam iuxta se.

unit.source: The Hermit, wearing a purple robe, held a vibrant, unreal ball of yarn in her right hand.
unit.target: Domina Eremita, induta toga purpurea, tenebat globulum filorum vividum et irreale in manu dextra.

unit.source: She wound its thread around the peculiar golden lamp.
unit.target: Ipsa filum convolvit circa lampam auream insolitam.

unit.source: Then, the Major Arcana card holder tossed the vivid and illusory ball of yarn through the illusory door Magician had opened, into the mirror world’s dark and ethereal tunnels.
unit.target: Tum, possessor chartae Major Arcana, globulum filorum vividum atque illusorium per ianuam illusoriam quam Domina Magica aperuerat, in tuniculos obscuros et aetheros mundi specularis coniecit.

unit.source: The ball of yarn rolled into one of the passageways and quickly vanished into the depths, leaving only the thread connected to the golden lamp to mark its path.
unit.target: Globulus filorum in unum ex viis decurrit et celeriter in profundum evanuit, relinquens solum filum ad lampam auream conexum, ut iter eius signaret.

unit.source: Magician immediately led The Hermit and Judgment into the mirror world, chasing the ball of yarn.
unit.target: Domina Magica statim duxit Dominam Eremitam et Dominam Iudicium in mundum specularis, globulum filorum insequens.

unit.source: After their figures disappeared from the mirror world, the forcibly torn void rapidly closed.
unit.target: Postquam figurae eorum ex mundo speculari evanuerunt, vacuum, vi laniatum, celeriter se clausit.

unit.source: Franca muttered again, “I think I’ve heard the story about a yarn ball before, but I can’t recall its name…”
unit.target: Franca iterum murmurat: “Puto me prius fabulam de globulo filorum audivisse, sed nomen eius recolere nequeo…”

unit.source: Lumian turned his attention back to Moran Avigny’s corpse.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit ad cadaver Moran Avigny.

unit.source: “You want to bring him back for your godson to eat?” Franca said with contempt.
unit.target: “Visne eum reducere ut filius dei tui eum edat?” inquit Franca cum contemnione.

unit.source: “Let’s not even discuss whether Ludwig should be eating humans in the first place.
unit.target: “Ne quidem de hoc agamus, an Ludwig homines edere debeat ex initio.

unit.source: A Mirror Person’s flesh will gradually turn back into mirror fragments. Do you really want Ludwig to be eating glass shards?”
unit.target: Caro personae specularis gradatim in fragmenta specularia redibit. Num vere vis ut Ludwig vitri frusta edat?”

unit.source: Lumian shook his head.
unit.target: Lumian caput concussit.

unit.source: “I’m considering whether I should take Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror.”
unit.target: “Cogito num speculum ornamentale Moran Avigny tollere debeam.”

unit.source: After tracking the vibrant yarn for a while, the three Major Arcana card holders reached a country villa matching the mirror’s coordinates and spotted the target mirror on a desk.
unit.target: Postquam per aliquod tempus globulum filorum vibrantem secuti sunt, tres possessor chartarum Majorum Arcana in villam rusticanam, quarum coordinationes speculi conveniebant, pervenerunt et speculum destinatum in scrinio conspexerunt.

unit.source: It was also a makeup mirror.
unit.target: Etiam erat speculum ornamentale.

unit.source: They didn’t pause.
unit.target: Non morati sunt.

unit.source: They followed the ball of yarn and walked through the spirit world.
unit.target: Illi globulum filorum secuti sunt et per mundum spiritale ambulaverunt.

unit.source: In a mere two to three seconds, they returned to reality and saw the vivid and illusory ball of yarn come to a halt in a dark cathedral lacking a deity’s statue.
unit.target: In duobus ad tribus secundis, ad realitatem redierunt et conspexerunt globulum filorum vividum atque illusorium in obscura cathedralia, cuius statua deitatis defuit, consistere.

unit.source: Beneath the cathedral’s dome, humans hung in the air, gently swaying in the wind.
unit.target: Sub cupola cathedralis, homines in aere suspendebantur, leniter in vento oscillantes.

unit.source: Some were old, some were young, and some were gentlemen wearing half top hats.
unit.target: Alii senes erant, alii iuvenes, et alii domini, qui pileos dimidiatos gerebant.

unit.source: Some were beautiful ladies in vintage dresses, some were tall and muscular like giants, and some were covered in wet, sticky scales resembling fish…
unit.target: Aliae erant pulchrae feminae in vestimentis veteranorum modorum, alii alti et musculosi velut gigantes, et alii in squamis madidis et adhaerentibus, quae piscibus similes erant, operti erant…

unit.source: What they all had in common was their firmly closed eyes, suspended by invisible ropes, looking like hanged corpses.
unit.target: Quod omnes habebant commune, oculi eorum firmiter clausi erant, funibus invisibilibus suspendentes, et similes cadaveribus adpositis videbantur.

unit.source: In the cathedral’s depths, a man in his thirties with average facial features and dark hair sat in a wooden black armchair.
unit.target: In profundis cathedralis, vir annos triginta fere habens, vultu mediocri et capillis obscuris, in solio ligneo nigro sedebat.

unit.source: His aura and soul felt both familiar and unfamiliar to Magician.
unit.target: Eius aura et anima Dominae Magicae tam nota quam ignota videbantur.

unit.source: It was familiar because she recognized Loki, the head of April Fool’s, who had been compelled to exhaust his resurrection times.
unit.target: Erat familiaris, quia agnovit Lokum, caput Aprilis Stultorum, qui ad exhaurendas resurrectionis tempora coactus fuerat.

unit.source: It was unfamiliar because the other party had been stained with an odd sensation.
unit.target: Erat ignotum, nam altera pars inusitato sensu tincta erat.

unit.source: At that instant, a blurry female figure stood next to Loki, resembling a sketch.
unit.target: Illo momento, figura feminea nebulosa iuxta Lokum stabat, quasi delineata.

unit.source: Her eyes were pitch‑black, like a lake in the dim night.
unit.target: Oculi eius erant atri, ut lacus in obscura nocte.

unit.source: He looked at Magician, The Hermit, and Judgment, a smile playing on his lips.
unit.target: Ille spectavit Dominam Magicam, Dominam Eremitam, et Dominam Iudicium, cum risus in labiis eius luderet.

unit.source: “It’s all thanks to you that I found some hope of returning.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago, per te spem redire inveni.”

unit.source: Before Loki could finish his sentence, the suspended corpses’ eyes snapped open simultaneously.
unit.target: Antequam Loki sermonem conficere potuisset, oculi cadaverum suspendendorum simul aperti sunt.

unit.source: Those eyes were pitch‑black.
unit.target: Illi oculi erant atri.

unit.source: In the quarry cave with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
unit.target: In spelunca lapidea cum fixo ingressu ad mundum specularis.

unit.source: “Taking away Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror?” Jenna echoed Lumian’s words before a realization struck her.
unit.target: “Speculum ornamentale Moran Avigny auferre?” Jenna verba Lumiani repetivit, antequam ei intellexit aliquid.

unit.source: “Do you want to see if any other Mirror People will try to contact Moran Avigny before news of his mysterious disappearance spreads?”
unit.target: “Visne videre an alii Homines Speculares conentur Moran Avigny contingere, antequam nuntius de eius mysteriosa evanitione diffundatur?”

unit.source: “Patience is a virtue,” Lumian replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Patientia est virtus,” respondit Lumian cum risu.

unit.source: For a Hunter, this was an essential quality.
unit.target: Pro Venatore, haec erat qualitas necessaria.

unit.source: He stooped down and retrieved the makeup mirror from Moran Avigny’s corpse’s pocket.
unit.target: Ille se inclinavit et speculum ornamentale ex sinu cadaveris Moran Avigny extraxit.

unit.source: At that moment, the makeup mirror snapped open.
unit.target: In illo momento, speculum ornamentale subito aperitum est.

unit.source: It opened on its own!
unit.target: Ipse per se aperuit!

unit.source: Dark light surged from the palm‑sized glass mirror, instantly filling the dimly lit quarry cave.
unit.target: Lux obscura ex speculo vitreo, cuius magnitudo similis palmae erat, effluit, statim speluncam lapideam parum illuminatam replens.
