unit.source: In the next instant, Lumian, Franca, and the others saw a figure quickly take shape beside the fixed entrance to the mirror world on the protruding rock.
unit.target: In sequenti momento, Lumian, Franca, et ceteri vidērunt figuram celeriter formari iuxta ingressum fixum ad mundum specularis in saxo eminente.

unit.source: It was a stunning woman with black hair and brown eyes.
unit.target: Erat femina stupenda, capillis nigris et oculis fuscis.

unit.source: She wore a bright red dress with layers of embroidery and lace, revealing a large expanse of snow‑white skin on her chest despite the cold winter.
unit.target: Induta erat veste rubra splendida, cum stratis insculptis et laciniatis, quae magnam partem cutis niveae in pectore patefaciabat, non obstante frigore hiemali.

unit.source: A friendly smile graced her face.
unit.target: Subridens, risus amicus faciem eius ornabat.

unit.source: Perle?
unit.target: Perle?

unit.source: The renowned courtesan in Trier, Perle, the theater actress from the Loen Kingdom?
unit.target: Notissima cortigiana Trevirensis, Perle, actrix theatri ex Regno Loen?

unit.source: Lumian was shocked and at a loss. He hadn’t expected to encounter this flamboyant courtesan in such a setting.
unit.target: Lumian obstupefactus et perplectus erat; non speraverat talem cortigianam pomposam in tali ambitu occurrem.

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony also found the situation surreal and hard to believe.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna, et Antonius quoque rem insolitam atque incredibilem esse putabant.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian recalled two key facts related to Perle.
unit.target: Fere simul, Lumian duas res claves de Perle recordatus est.

unit.source: The first time he had observed Moran Avigny, Perle had been on a date with her new lover in the hotel’s annex restaurant.
unit.target: Primum, cum Moran Avigny conspexisset, Perle cum novo amatore suo in restaurante annexo deversorii cenaverat.

unit.source: All courtesans were standard, textbook brokers—political brokers!
unit.target: Omnes cortigianae erant prorsus standard, instar exemplorum librorum—mediatrices politicas!

unit.source: Combining these two points, a guess formed in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: His duobus rebus coniunctis, coniectura in mente Lumiani orta est.

unit.source: Could Perle also be a member of the School of Truth?
unit.target: Num Perle etiam membrum Scholae Veritatis sit?

unit.source: Could she be the Overseer that Jebus directly reported to, the bestowed of an evil god at the demigod level?
unit.target: Num illa esset Moderator cui Jebus directe referret, donata a deo malo ad gradum semidei?

unit.source: If that’s the case, where did Madam Magician and the others end up? Who were they tracking?
unit.target: Si ita sit, quo Domina Magica et ceteri pervenerunt? Quem insequebantur?

unit.source: Flee! We must flee immediately!
unit.target: Fuge! Statim fugere debemus!

unit.source: At that moment, Perle looked at Lumian and the others, a smile forming on her lips as she uttered the Words of Order.
unit.target: Illo momento, Perle spectavit ad Lumian et ceteros, cum risus in labiis eius efflorescentes, verba Ordinis proferens.

unit.source: “Your crimes remain unpunished!”
unit.target: “Crimina vestra impune manent!”

unit.source: 729 Purpose
unit.target: 729 Propositum

unit.source: Franca had already concealed herself by the time she recognized Perle.
unit.target: Franca se iam celaverat, cum Perlem agnovit.

unit.source: Her plan was to circle around and use the mirror to reflect Perle’s figure, hoping to curse her.
unit.target: Eius consilium erat circumire et speculum ad imaginem Perlei referendam adhibere, sperans eam maledicere.

unit.source: If the curse failed, it would at least create an opening for Jenna to sneak up from the shadows and assassinate the target.
unit.target: Si maledictio deficeret, saltem ostium pareret ut Jenna a tenebris furtim accesseret et propositum occideret.

unit.source: Though not as cunning as Lumian the Conspirer, both Jenna and Franca instinctively sensed that the sudden assaulting Perle was incredibly dangerous, even more so than Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Quamquam non tam callidi ut Lumian Coniurator, et Jenna et Franca intuitu sentiverunt Perlem repentinam, quae oppugnatione imminuebatur, incredibiliter periculosam esse, etiam magis quam Moran Avigny.

unit.source: However, they didn’t go so far as to suspect her of being an Overseer or demigod.
unit.target: Tamen non egerunt ad id ut eam ut Inspectorem aut semideum suspicerent.

unit.source: As Perle uttered the Words of Order, Franca felt slender, snake‐like entities emerge from the surrounding shadows, enveloping her despite her invisibility.
unit.target: Cum Perle verba Ordinis effuderet, Franca sensit entia gracilia, serpentium similia, ex circumstantibus umbris emergere, eam compleverant, non obstante eius invisibilitate.

unit.source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Razor‐sharp icicles burst from the ground like soldiers thrusting their spears.
unit.target: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Glacies acutissimae e terra eruperunt, velut milites hastae suas immittens.

unit.source: Franca quickly leaped up, pressing one hand against an icicle to tumble out of the area.
unit.target: Franca celeriter insiluit, unam manum in glaciem prementem, ut ex area labaret.

unit.source: She narrowly avoided impalement, hanging precariously from the icicle’s tip.
unit.target: Vix impalationem evitavit, instabili modo ex acro glaciei suspendens.

unit.source: Before Franca could regain her footing, black flames shot out from the shadows, hurtling directly towards her.
unit.target: Antequam Franca pedes recuperaret, flammae nigrae ex umbris erupere, directae in eam impetum fecerunt.

unit.source: The serpentine creatures around her constricted, binding her in layers.
unit.target: Creaturae serpentiformes circa eam coarctabantur, eam in stratis circumligantes.

unit.source: Wh– With no time to react, Franca could only watch helplessly as the black flames consumed her.
unit.target: Heu – nullum tempus ad respondendum habens, Franca nihil nisi impotens spectare potuit, dum flammae nigrae eam consumebant.

unit.source: At the same moment, a figure stepped out from the shadows–Clarice, wearing an elegant black court dress with her hair in a sophisticated bun.
unit.target: Eodem tempore figura ex umbris emersit–Clarice, induta veste nigra curiae eleganti, et capillis in coleo subtili compositis.

unit.source: However, the Demoness of Black’s face was blurry and dark, unlike a living person.
unit.target: Attamen, vultus Daemonissae Nigrae obscurus atque confusus erat, dissimilis persona viva.

unit.source: My crime is cheating, deceit, and exploiting others, mainly in reference to the Demoness Sect.
unit.target: Crimen meum est fraus, dolus atque abusus aliorum, praesertim respectu Secta Daemonissae.

unit.source: Is this punishment from a manifestation of the Demoness of Black?
unit.target: Num haec poena ex manifestatione Daemonissae Nigrae provenit?

unit.source: Franca’s thoughts raced.
unit.target: Cogitationes Francae festinanter currebant.

unit.source: Her body shattered like glass.
unit.target: Corpus eius quasi vitrum confractum est.

unit.source: Mirror Substitution!
unit.target: Substitutio Speculi!

unit.source: Jenna, while stealthily hidden, also encountered a strange foe.
unit.target: Jenna, dum caute abscondita erat, hostem insolitum quoque invenit.

unit.source: It was a clergyman from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, dressed in a white robe adorned with golden threads.
unit.target: Erat clericus e Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis, indutus veste alba, aureis filis ornata.

unit.source: Not only were his facial features hazy and unrecognizable, but his physique was also constantly shifting in subtle ways.
unit.target: Non solum facies eius obscurae et incognoscibiles erant, sed etiam corpus eius subtimis modis constanter mutabatur.

unit.source: A blaze of sunlight descended, banishing the shadows in the area and exposing Jenna’s body.
unit.target: Flamma solis deorsum descendit, umbras regionis expellens et corpus Jennæ revelans.

unit.source: Realization dawned on Jenna.
unit.target: Jennæ mox intellexit.

unit.source: My crime is believing in multiple deities and betraying the Eternal Blazing Sun…
unit.target: Crimen meum est pluribus deis credere et Aeternum Solem Flammantem prodere…

unit.source: So, an abstract embodiment of the Church’s clergyman is punishing me…
unit.target: Ita, incarnatio abstracta clerici Ecclesiae mihi poenam facit…

unit.source: Jenna quickly rolled to the other side of the quarry cave, dodging the clergyman’s attack.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter ad alteram partem speluncae lapidariae volvit, impetum clerici eludens.

unit.source: Anthony was not forgotten.
unit.target: Antonius non oblitus est.

unit.source: Just as he prepared to use Psychological Invisibility to approach Perle and send her into a Frenzy, a whip wreathed in silver lightning lashed out at him.
unit.target: Ita ut invisibilitatem psychologicam adhibere pararet, ut Perlem accedat et eam in furor induceret, flagrum, fulmine argenteo involutum, in eum percusit.

unit.source: A crackling sound echoed in Anthony’s mind, both illusory and real, sending a sharp pain through his soul.
unit.target: Sonus crepitans in mente Antonii resonavit, simul illusorius et verus, acutam dolorem per animam eius inferens.

unit.source: Every hair on his body stood on end.
unit.target: Omnes pili corporis eius erexerunt.

unit.source: If not for his incredible self‑control, he would have screamed.
unit.target: Nisi incredibile sua moderatione, clamavisset.

unit.source: Before him stood a middle‑aged man in a black uniform and white shirt, dressed as a Trier police officer.
unit.target: Ante eum stabat vir mediā aetāte, in uniforme nigro et camisia alba indutus, ut vigil Trevirensis.

unit.source: My crime stems from my transgressions as an information broker, so I’m up against Trier’s police?
unit.target: Crimen meum ex delictis ut mercator notitiarum provenit; ergo adversus vigilos Trevirenses sto?

unit.source: Most Trier police officers lack Beyonder powers, yet this Punisher directly wields abilities in the Arbiter domain?
unit.target: Plurimi vigilēs Trevirenses vim Beyonder non habent; attamen hic Puniōr in dominio Arbiter facultates directe utitur?

unit.source: As Anthony conjured grayish‑white dragon scales on his body, he deftly ran and rolled, seeking a chance to use Psychological Invisibility.
unit.target: Dum Antonius squamas draconum niveo‑griseas in corpore evocabat, callide cucurrit et volvit, occasionem invisibilitatis psychologicae adhibendae quaerens.

unit.source: The already dim surroundings around Lumian suddenly darkened further, as if something was about to take shape, filling him with a profound sense of dread.
unit.target: Circumiecta iam obscura Lumiani repente adhuc obscuriora facta sunt, quasi aliquid formari pararetur, eum profundo timoris sensu compleverunt.

unit.source: Just as the terrifying entity was about to emerge, it abruptly disintegrated.
unit.target: Ita ut terribilis entitas emergere pararetur, subito dissoluta est.

unit.source: Even the surrounding gloom and fear dissipated like melting snow.
unit.target: Etiam circumjacentia obscuritas et metus, velut nix liquescente, evanuerunt.

unit.source: Uh… Is my crime too severe for a Punisher to manifest directly?
unit.target: Eheu… Num crimen meum nimis grave est, ut Puniōr directe manifestari possit?

unit.source: Lumian guessed, considering Franca and the others’ situations.
unit.target: Lumian coniectavit, condicionem Francae et ceterorum considerans.

unit.source: Behind him, spears of blazing white flame materialized and shot towards the flamboyantly dressed Perle like a volley of arrows.
unit.target: Post eum, hastae flammae albae incandentes apparuerunt et versus Perlem, qui vestitu pomposo induta erat, quasi telis sagittabantur.

unit.source: The flaming spears formed a majestic and fierce forest, providing cover for Lumian’s true attack.
unit.target: Hastae flammantes silvam magnificam et ferocem formaverunt, tegmen praebentes verae impetūs Lumiani.

unit.source: He had already drawn his revolver, gently flicking the cylinder with his finger.
unit.target: Iam revolverum suum extraxerat, cylindrum leviter pollice commovebat.

unit.source: Three of the six bullets he had obtained from Jebus were loaded.
unit.target: Tria ex sex globulis, quos a Jebus obtinuerat, oneratae erant.

unit.source: Lumian needed to use Implosion Bullets now.
unit.target: Lumian nunc globulos implosivos adhibere oportebat.

unit.source: Only by employing these special bullets in combination with his Cull ability did he have a sliver of hope of injuring Perle, whom he suspected to be the Overseer!
unit.target: Solum his globulis specialibus, coniunctis cum facultate sua 'Cull', parva spes erat ut Perlem laederet, quam suspicabatur esse Inspectorem!

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes blazed with an iron‑black intensity as the starlight‑shimmering bullets wove between the blazing white flame spears, speeding towards Perle’s neck.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani, ferro‑nigro fulgenti splendore, erant, dum globuli, ut astra scintillantes, inter hastae flammae albae incandentes texti celeriter versus collum Perlei properabant.

unit.source: Perle stood beside the fixed entrance to the mirror world, her amiable smile unwavering.
unit.target: Perle stabat iuxta ianuam fixam in mundo speculi, risus eius amabilis constans.

unit.source: The corners of her mouth curled up.
unit.target: Anguli oris eius incurvabantur.

unit.source: “How dare you attack an Overseer?”
unit.target: «Quomodo audes Inspectorem oppugnare?»

unit.source: As the self‑proclaimed Overseer uttered her first word, Lumian’s starlight bullet abruptly changed course, hurtling towards his own neck.
unit.target: Cum ipsa, se declarata Inspectrix, primum verbum edidit, globulus stellae fulgoris Lumiani subito cursum mutavit, versus suum collum properans.

unit.source: Likewise, the blazing white flame spears strangely returned to Lumian’s side, engulfing him.
unit.target: Similiter, hastae flammae albae incandescentes insolenter ad latus Lumiani redierunt, eum involventes.

unit.source: Before Lumian could teleport, an Implosion Bullet struck him, causing his body to collapse bit by bit.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian teleportare posset, globus implosivus eum percussit, quo corpus eius paulatim corruperet.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitum!

unit.source: He transformed into a mirror, shattering into countless fragments that vanished without a trace as they gathered uncontrollably.
unit.target: Se in speculum transformavit, innumeris fragmentis confractus, quae sine vestigio evanuerunt dum inordinate se congregabant.

unit.source: After the battle with Jebus, Franca had provided Lumian with another Mirror Substitution!
unit.target: Post proelium cum Jebus, Franca Lumiano aliam Substitutionem Speculi praebuerat!

unit.source: Perle showed no surprise.
unit.target: Perle nullum stuporem exhibuit.

unit.source: She sighed and smiled.
unit.target: Ea suspiravit et subridens.

unit.source: “Personally, I’d prefer you die now and release that Angel. It would greatly benefit our common cause.
unit.target: «Personaliter, potius velim te nunc mori et illum Angelum liberare; id causae nostrae communi magno prodesset.

unit.source: Unfortunately, the one who made the Under the Table transaction with me insisted on capturing you alive.”
unit.target: Infeliciter, is qui mecum sub mensa transactionem fecit, instanter te vivum capturum esse postulavit.»

unit.source: Lumian materialized in a corner of the quarry cave, catching Perle’s words.
unit.target: Lumian in angulo speluncae lapidariae se materializavit, verba Perlei capiens.

unit.source: Instantly, numerous guesses flooded his mind.
unit.target: Statim, multitudines coniecturarum mente eius inundaverunt.

unit.source: Under the Table transaction?
unit.target: Transactionem sub mensa?

unit.source: Perle is the Overseer directly above Jebus.
unit.target: Perle est Inspectrix directe super Jebus.

unit.source: She evaded pursuit from the Major Arcana card holders by completing another high‑level Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Ea persecutionem a possessoribus chartarum Majoris Arcani evasit compleendo aliam transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus.

unit.source: And for this, she must capture me and take me somewhere?
unit.target: Et propter hoc, debet me captare atque me alibi ferre?

unit.source: When did she find out about Moran Avigny’s situation?
unit.target: Quando de condicione Moran Avigny cognovit?

unit.source: Was she monitoring his residence?
unit.target: Num eius domicilium observabat?

unit.source: Or did she receive information from other sources?
unit.target: An ex aliis fontibus notitiam accepit?

unit.source: Surely the Purifiers are professional enough to keep the news under wraps, right?
unit.target: Certe purgatores satis periti sunt ut nuntium celent, nonne?

unit.source: Why capture me alive?
unit.target: Cur me vivum capere?

unit.source: Who wants me alive?
unit.target: Quis me vivum vult?

unit.source: To use me as a sacrifice, like Susanna Mattise?
unit.target: Ut me, sicut Susanna Mattise, ut sacrificium adhibeat?

unit.source: Or could the person engaging in Perle’s Under the Table transaction be a Sufferer from the Sinners organization?
unit.target: Aut num persona, quae in transactione sub mensa cum Perle versatur, sit Patiens ex organizatione Peccatorum?

unit.source: Someone who doesn’t want Termiboros to break free from the seal, but instead wants to control this Angel and use Him as an ingredient for advancement?
unit.target: Aliquis qui non vult Termiboros e sigillo liberari, sed potius hunc Angelum regere ac ut rem ad progressionem adhiberet?

unit.source: No, that’s not right.
unit.target: Non, id non rectum est.

unit.source: If he were just a Sufferer, even if he could mislead Madam Magician and the others temporarily, he couldn’t prevent them from returning to help.
unit.target: Si solum esset Patiens, etiamsi Dominam Magicam et ceteros temporarie fallere posset, eos ad auxilium redire non prohiberet.

unit.source: Yet, Perle remains calm and collected…
unit.target: Attamen, Perle manet tranquilla et composita…

unit.source: Could the other party in the Under the Table transaction be a faction of the Mother Tree of Desire or the Great Mother?
unit.target: Num altera pars transactionis sub mensa esset pars Arboris Matris Desiderii aut Magna Mater?

unit.source: Only they could organize a lineup in this world to deal with the Major Arcana card holders…
unit.target: Soli illi possent congregare ordinem in hoc mundo ad tractandum possessoribus chartarum Magni Arcani…

unit.source: With his keen Conspirer’s intuition, Lumian connected two problems.
unit.target: Cum acuto sensu coniuratoris suo, Lumian duas quaestiones coniunxit.

unit.source: First, the counter‐party of Overseer Perle’s Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Primum, contraria pars transactionis sub mensa Inspectricis Perlei.

unit.source: Second, how she discovered Moran Avigny’s mishap so quickly and promptly convened a high‑level Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Secundum, quomodo celeriter casum Moran Avigny detexit et statim transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus convocavit.

unit.source: As these questions intertwined, a thought struck Lumian.
unit.target: Dum hae quaestiones inter se conexae erant, cogitatio Lumiani percusit.

unit.source: In the Purifier team, a key member of April Fool’s wasn’t a transmigrator.
unit.target: In turma Purgatorum, membrum principale Aprilis Stultorum non erat transmigrator.

unit.source: Together with Loki, he single‑handily orchestrated the loss of the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Una cum Loki, solus orchestravit amissionem Artifacti Sigillati, qui humanoide erat.

unit.source: To this day, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church hasn’t discovered the perpetrator!
unit.target: Ad hanc diem, Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis perpetratorem nondum detexit!

unit.source: Could a Broker also be involved?
unit.target: Potestne etiam intermedius interesse?

unit.source: Indeed, only if a key April Fool’s member lurking within the Church appears unrelated to the Purifier who lost the humanoid Sealed Artifact, and they don’t even know each other, can the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, with its numerous Sealed Artifacts and demigods, investigate for so long without finding anything!
unit.target: Certe, solum si membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum intra Ecclesiam latentis, qui non sit coniunctus cum Purgatore qui Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem amisit, et si invicem ne cognoscant quidem, Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis, cum multis Artifactis Sigillatis et semideis, tam diu investigare possit sine quidquam inveniendo!

unit.source: From the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s perspective, the Purifier who lost the humanoid Sealed Artifact truly committed a momentary “mistake.”
unit.target: Ex prospectu Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Flammantis, Purgator qui Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem amisit, vere errorem momentaneum commisit.

unit.source: He had no motive for the crime and no links to April Fool’s…
unit.target: Nihil habebat causae criminis neque nexum cum Aprilis Stultorum…

unit.source: Has the School of Truth expanded the Broker business into the Eternal Blazing Sun Church?
unit.target: Num Schola Veritatis negotium intermedii in Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Flammantis propagavit?

unit.source: It’s true; only Unshadowed won’t be embroiled in gray transactions, and most Purifiers can’t reach Sequence 4.
unit.target: Verum est; solum Unshadowed non implicabuntur in transactionibus griseis, et plerique Purgatores Sequenciam Quartam attingere non possunt.

unit.source: Similarly, not all Cardinals are from the Sun pathway…
unit.target: Similiter, non omnes Cardinales e via Solis proveniunt…

unit.source: It seems the School of Truth has long been connected to April Fool’s and is collaborating…
unit.target: Videtur Schola Veritatis diu ad Aprilis Stultorum coniuncta esse et cooperari…

unit.source: Damn it, it really is a broker organization.
unit.target: Maledictum, vere est societas intermedii.

unit.source: It can be associated with any faction!
unit.target: Ad quamlibet factionem pertinere potest!

unit.source: Could it be that the School of Truth’s collaborator within the Eternal Blazing Sun Church urgently transmitted information about Moran Avigny’s mishap to Overseer Perle?
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut collaborans Scholae Veritatis intra Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Flammantis de casu Moran Avigny notitiam ad Inspectricem Perlem celerrime transmittat?

unit.source: Upon receiving the news, Perle immediately convened a high‑level Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Notitiam receptam, Perle statim transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus convocavit.

unit.source: Was the transaction with April Fool’s?
unit.target: Fuitne transactio cum Aprilis Stultorum?

unit.source: No, April Fool’s doesn’t have that power.
unit.target: Non, Aprilis Stultorum hanc potentiam non habet.

unit.source: Could it be the Celestial Worthy backing them or other high‑ranking subordinates of the Celestial Worthy?
unit.target: Num fortasse Cœlestis Dignus eos adiuvat, aut alii subditi altioris gradus Cœlestis Digni existimantur?

unit.source: No wonder they want to capture me alive…
unit.target: Non mirum est eos me vivum capturum esse velle…

unit.source: Perle might have intended to offer an item in exchange for severing her connection with Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Fortasse Perle volebat rem offerre in commutatione ut vinculum suum cum Moran Avigny solveret.

unit.source: However, the counter‑party in the Under the Table transaction proposed a new plan, allowing her to switch from passive to active, seizing the opportunity to deceive and set a trap.
unit.target: Attamen, oppositio in transactione sub mensa novum consilium proposuit, quod ei permittebat ut a passiva ad activam mutaretur, occasionem capiens ad decipiendum et laqueum constituendum.

unit.source: How far it can go depends on her improvisation…
unit.target: Quousque procedere possit, in eius improvisatione dependet…

unit.source: If it is indeed April Fool’s and the Celestial Worthy’s will is faintly discernible, it would explain why Madam Magician didn’t sense anything amiss and walked right into the trap.
unit.target: Si vere Aprilis Stultorum est et voluntas Cœlestis Digni leviter perceptibilis, id explicaret cur Domina Magica nihil insolitum sentiret et directo in laqueum incidisset.

unit.source: Realizing this, Lumian was alarmed.
unit.target: Hoc intellegens, Lumian consternatus est.

unit.source: Termiboros warned me twice about the School of Truth.
unit.target: Termiboros me bis de Schola Veritatis monuit.

unit.source: Could it be that He foresaw the corresponding fate unfold and a chance for Him to break free from the seal?
unit.target: Num ille fatum correspondens praevidit et occasionem habuit se a sigillo liberari?

unit.source: Is that why He was so eager, hoping to compel it into fruition?
unit.target: Num idcirco tam ardens fuit, sperans ut id ad effectum perduceret?

unit.source: 730 Struggle
unit.target: 730 Certamen

unit.source: Lumian’s mind raced, unable to fully process the myriad details, but in the heat of battle, he couldn’t afford to waste a single moment overthinking.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani celeriter cursabat, innumerabilia singula plene intelligere non posse, sed in ardore pugnae momentum quidem supervacue deliberandi perdere non poterat.

unit.source: Only a Conspirer could deduce a possible scenario within two seconds of Mirror Substitution taking effect.
unit.target: Solum Conspirator intra duos secundos, postquam Substitutio Speculi effecta est, possibilis eventus deduci poterat.

unit.source: Based on Perle’s words, Franca and the others would have concluded that she was the Overseer directly above Jebus.
unit.target: Ex verbis Perle, Franca et ceteri concluderent eam praepositam esse directe super Jebus.

unit.source: She had sidestepped danger through the Under the Table transaction but now had no choice but to confront them head-on.
unit.target: Per transactionem “Sub Mensa” periculum effugerat, sed nunc nihil aliud ei aderat nisi eos directe oppugnare.

unit.source: They couldn’t let their focus waver, not even for a second.
unit.target: Neque quidem per unam secundam permitterent ut eorum intentio vacillaret.

unit.source: Lumian cursed inwardly, frustrated that the Blood Emperor’s residual aura had been sealed by Underworld Daoist’s death mark.
unit.target: Lumian interius exsecravit, furens quod aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis signo mortis Daoshi Inferorum clauseretur.

unit.source: If not for that, his best bet would have been to activate the mark on his right palm with everything he had, allowing Alista Tudor to “descend” upon Trier once again.
unit.target: Nisi id accidisset, optimum consilium illi fuit signum in palma dextro omni vi activare, ut Alista Tudor in Trier iterum descendere posset.

unit.source: It would have drawn the attention of Angels from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, the God of Steam and Machinery Church, and other powerhouses hiding in the city, pressuring Perle to retreat.
unit.target: Id attraheret attentionem Angelorum ex Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardentis, ex Ecclesia Deorum Vaporis et Machinarum, atque aliorum potentium in urbe latenter absconditorum, Perle ad recessum impellendo.

unit.source: Without a second thought, Lumian triggered the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Sine secunda cogitatione, Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro activavit.

unit.source: His plan was to teleport out of there and into Saint Viève Cathedral.
unit.target: Propositum eius erat inde teleportare et in Cathedralem Sanctae Viève ingredi.

unit.source: Since Perle’s goal was to capture him alive, he obtained a conclusion through simple deduction.
unit.target: Quoniam propositum Perle eum vivum capere fuit, per deductionem simplicem conclusionem adeptus est.

unit.source: She would undoubtedly chase after him with all her might.
unit.target: Ea indubitanter totis viribus eum persequeretur.

unit.source: There’s no way she would stay put and risk failing the Under the Table transaction!
unit.target: Nequaquam poterat manere et periclitari ut transactio “Sub Mensa” deficeret!

unit.source: If that happened, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony would still have to deal with the conjured Punisher, but at least they wouldn’t be facing a demigod.
unit.target: Si id eveniret, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony adhuc cum coniurato Punitore agere oporteret, sed saltem non demigodum oppugnabant.

unit.source: Their odds of survival would be significantly better.
unit.target: Sors eorum superesse multo melior foret.

unit.source: For any Mid-Sequence Beyonder, even a single Sequence 4 demigod–bestowed or not–was enough to make their hearts sink with despair.
unit.target: Nam cuique Mid-Sequence Beyonder, etiam unicum demigodum Sequenciae IV—datum sive non—satis erat ut corda eorum in desperatione deprimerent.

unit.source: Moreover, the two Demonesses and Anthony all possessed Mirror Substitution, as well as items like the Seven-Stone Bracelet.
unit.target: Praeterea, duo Demonessae et Anthony omnes possidebant Substitutionem Speculi, necnon res quales Armilla Septem Lapidum.

unit.source: As long as they didn’t become a demigod’s target, they had a real shot at using the substitutes to escape to the Church of The Fool’s cathedral at Lavigny Docks.
unit.target: Dummodo non fiissent meta demigodi, habebant veram facultatem substituta uti ad effugium in ecclesiam cathedralem “Stulti” ad portus Lavigny.

unit.source: As Lumian’s form swiftly dissipated, he reached into his pocket with his left hand, his mind crystal clear, and grasped Mr. K’s finger.
unit.target: Dum forma Lumiani celeriter evanuit, manu sinistra in tasca sua extendit, mens eius nitida, atque digitum Domini K apprehendit.

unit.source: He couldn’t be sure if Perle was telling the truth about capturing him alive or if it was a lie.
unit.target: Non poterat certi esse utrum Perle veritatem diceret de eum vivum capiendo aut mendacium esset.

unit.source: Was it just a demigod’s nonchalance when dealing with a Mid-Sequence Beyonder, or a habit formed from a Broker’s constant deception?
unit.target: Num id esset tantum levitas demigodi in rebus Mid-Sequence Beyonder tractandis, aut morum consuetudo ex perpetua fallacia Negotiatoris?

unit.source: He had to be prepared for the possibility that Perle might not follow him and instead stay behind to take on Franca and the others.
unit.target: Oportebat eum paratum esse ad occasionem, quod Perle eum sequi non curaret, sed potius manere ut Francam et ceteros oppugnaret.

unit.source: His contingency plan was: Summon Mr. K!
unit.target: Consilium secundarium eius fuit: Invoca Dominum K!

unit.source: While Mr. K, as a Shepherd, couldn’t directly fight a demigod, he was the Aurora Order’s Oracle.
unit.target: Dum Dominus K, ut Pastor, demigodum directe pugnare non poterat, fuit Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae.

unit.source: He could hear the True Creator’s guidance at any time.
unit.target: Potest audire ductum Veritatis Conditoris quovis tempore.

unit.source: His presence meant that the deity he believed in would surely cast His gaze upon them.
unit.target: Eius praesentia significabat deum in quem credebat, certo oculos suos super eos iacturum.

unit.source: There was a good chance it would trigger some miraculous turn of events in their favor.
unit.target: Erant magnae spei ut hoc rem miraculosum eventum in eorum favorem moveret.

unit.source: And even without divine intervention, the Beyonder of the Apprentice pathway under Mr. K’s Grazing appeared to have records of demigod abilities.
unit.target: Et etiam sine interventu divino, Beyonder itineris Apprenti sub cura Domini K videbatur documenta facultatum demigodarum habere.

unit.source: It should be able to hold off Perle for a few seconds, giving Franca and the others a window to escape.
unit.target: Id posse Perle paucos secundos conterere debebit, ita ut Francae et ceteris occasio ad effugium praebeatur.

unit.source: As Lumian activated his teleportation, Franca, who had been compelled to use Mirror Substitution, materialized in a corner of the quarry cave.
unit.target: Dum Lumian teleportationem suam activabat, Franca, quae ad Substitutionem Speculi cogenda erat, in angulo speluncae fodinae apparuit.

unit.source: Clutching a makeup mirror, she decisively activated the Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Tenens speculum ornamentale, firmiter Fibulam Speculi activavit.

unit.source: She already knew Perle was the Overseer and intended to escape via the mirror world.
unit.target: Iam sciebat Perle praeposita esse et per mundum speculi effugere velle.

unit.source: Once concealed within the mirror world, she could jump to the mirrors on Jenna, Lumian, and Anthony.
unit.target: Cum intra mundum speculi abscondita esset, poterat ad specula in Jenna, Lumiano, et Anthony salire.

unit.source: She could extend her hand and pull her companions into the mirror world, and they could all flee together!
unit.target: Manum extendere poterat et comites suos in mundum speculi trahere, atque omnes simul effugi posse!

unit.source: The glass-like Mirror Cufflink emitted a dark light, but Franca didn’t budge, unable to enter the makeup mirror in her grasp.
unit.target: Fibula Speculi, quasi vitrea, lucem obscuram emittens, sed Franca non movebatur, intrare enim speculum ornamentale quod tenebat non poterat.

unit.source: Wh– Franca was stunned for a moment before a realization hit her.
unit.target: Heu—Franca per momento stupefacta est, antequam realitas eam percuteret.

unit.source: Failing to enter the mirror world without any interference could only mean one thing:
unit.target: Deficio intrandi mundum speculi sine alio impedimento unum solum significare poterat:

unit.source: This was a mirror world!
unit.target: Hic erat mundus speculi!

unit.source: Except for certain unique mirror worlds, one couldn’t enter the mirror world from within the mirror world itself.
unit.target: Nisi pro quibusdam unice constitutis mundis speculi, non liceret ex interiore ipsius mundi speculi in eum intrare.

unit.source: The only option was to use the mirror to jump!
unit.target: Unica optio erat speculum ad transilendum adhibere!

unit.source: Mirror worlds came in two varieties.
unit.target: Mundi speculi duas varietates habebant.

unit.source: The first was conventional and universal, not a true world.
unit.target: Prima erat consueta et universalis, non verus orbis.

unit.source: It was a concept of “doors” amalgamated into a dark void passageway linking all mirrors.
unit.target: Erat notio “ianuarum” compositarum in obscurum vacuum transeundum, quae omnes specula coniungebat.

unit.source: Wherever mirrors and their surfaces existed, such mirror worlds with no discernible boundaries could be found.
unit.target: Quocumque specula et superficies eorum fuerunt, tales mundi speculi sine finibus perceptibilibus inveniri poterant.

unit.source: The second type was special mirror worlds.
unit.target: Secunda generis erant mundi speculi speciales.

unit.source: They relied on the conventional mirror world and leveraged specific corruption or corresponding abilities to take shape.
unit.target: Existimabant in mundo speculi consueto uti atque corruptione specifica aut facultatibus aequivalentiis ad formam capiendam recurrere.

unit.source: Some were permanent, others temporary.
unit.target: Nonnulli permanentes erant, alii temporarii.

unit.source: Their characteristics closely mirrored the real world, projections of one facet of reality, but each had its own unique limitations and rules.
unit.target: Eorum indoles arcte verum mundum imitabatur, ut specula unius aspectus realitatis, sed unusquisque limitationes et regulas singulares habebat.

unit.source: The mirror world in Fourth Epoch Trier belonged to the latter category.
unit.target: Mundus speculi in Trier, Aetatis Quartae, illius generis adstabat.

unit.source: It contained only a projection of Trier, a sprawling metropolis, and excluded other regions.
unit.target: Continebat solum effigiem Triers, metropolitanum spatiosum, et alias regiones excludebat.

unit.source: Moreover, it was split into three distinct levels.
unit.target: Praeterea in tres gradus distinctos divisus erat.

unit.source: This mirror world was also special, but on a smaller scale.
unit.target: Hic mundus speculi etiam specialis erat, sed magnitudine inferior.

unit.source: It was merely a projection of the quarry cave, likely generated by some ability.
unit.target: Hoc erat solum effigies speluncae fodinae, probabiliter aliqua facultate generata.

unit.source: As a veteran Shadow Merchant, Perle had a long-established partnership with the Mirror People.
unit.target: Ut veterana Mercatrix Umbrae, Perle diuturnam societatem cum Populo Speculorum habebat.

unit.source: It was perfectly normal for her to trade items capable of creating temporary special mirror worlds!
unit.target: Plane erat ut illa negotium faceret cum rebus quae temporarios mundos speculi speciales creare valeant!

unit.source: Recalling the dark light emanating from Moran Avigny’s mirror just before Perle’s arrival, Franca’s suspicion was confirmed.
unit.target: Recordans lucem obscuram quae ex speculo Moran Avigny emansit paulo ante adventum Perle, suspicio Francae confirmata est.

unit.source: Just as she was about to warn Lumian and the others, she saw the Demoness of Black’s Punishment projection seize the moment to reflect herself in a mirror.
unit.target: Ita ut Lumian et ceteros monere velle parata esset, vidit projectionem Demonessae Nigrae Poenae momentum capere, ut se in speculo reflecteret.

unit.source: Franca’s pupils dilated as she activated Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, dum Substitutionem Speculi activavit.

unit.source: In an instant, she transformed into a mirror, engulfed by pitch-black flames from within.
unit.target: In momento, ipsa in speculum se convertit, ab interioribus nigris flammis absorpta.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Strepitus!

unit.source: The mirror slammed into the ground, shattering into countless fragments.
unit.target: Speculum in terram collidit, innumeris fragmentis confractum.

unit.source: At the same time, Lumian’s figure rematerialized in place.
unit.target: Simul figura Lumiani in loco iterum apparuit.

unit.source: His teleportation had failed.
unit.target: Teleportatio eius defecerat.

unit.source: This was indeed a special mirror world.
unit.target: Hoc re vera erat mundus speculi specialis.

unit.source: Finding an exit was the only way out.
unit.target: Exitum inveniendi sola via egressus erat.

unit.source: Mr. K’s finger had already expanded, morphing into a mass of flesh and blood that enveloped Lumian’s body, forming a vibrant red cloak that covered him from head to toe.
unit.target: Digitus Domini K iam expansus erat, in massam carnis et sanguinis mutatus, quae corpus Lumiani totum involvit, pallium rubrum viventem a capite ad pedes formans.

unit.source: With a sickening sound, Lumian’s body was pierced by grotesque wounds, as if struck by invisible arrows.
unit.target: Cum sonitu fastidioso, corpus Lumiani ab vulneribus monstruosis perforatum est, velut sagittis invisibilibus feriendum.

unit.source: It was only thanks to the protection of the flesh-and-blood cloak, transformed from Mr. K’s finger, that he managed to survive.
unit.target: Solummodo propter tutelam pallii carnis et sanguinis, ex digito Domini K constitutum, superare potuit.

unit.source: Otherwise, he would have been forced to animate his shadow to absorb those fatal injuries on his behalf.
unit.target: Aliter, coactus fuisset umbram suam animare, ut illa fata vulnera pro se absorberet.

unit.source: Of course, he still had one more Mirror Substitution up his sleeve—courtesy of Jenna.
unit.target: Certe, adhuc unum Substitutionis Speculi in manibus habebat, gratia Jennae.

unit.source: Overseer Perle stood firm beside the jutting rock deep within the quarry cave.
unit.target: Praeposita Perle firmiter stabat iuxta saxum eminens in profundo speluncae fodinae.

unit.source: She flashed Lumian a smile and said, “Those who defy supervision and try to flee shall face punishment.”
unit.target: Illa Lumian subridens aspexit et dixit: “Qui supervisionem contemnunt et effugere conantur, poenam pati debent.”

unit.source: As Franca and Lumian’s attempts failed in quick succession, Jenna tossed out a handful of fluorescent dust, whispered an incantation, and promptly vanished from the Punisher dressed as a clergyman of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
unit.target: Dum conatus Francae et Lumiani celeriter deficerent, Jenna manum pulveris lucentis iactavit, incantationem murmuravit, atque celeriter evanuit a Punitore, qui ut clericus Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammantis vestitus erat.

unit.source: A golden light surged around the Punisher, clad in a white robe adorned with golden threads, spreading outward in layers.
unit.target: Lumen aureum circum Punitorum proliferavit, qui veste alba cum filis aureis ornatus erat, et stratis extendens diffundebatur.

unit.source: As the golden light reached an empty space, it abruptly encountered an obstacle, staining it a faint golden hue.
unit.target: Dum lumen aureum spatium vacuum pervenit, subito in obstaculum incidit, eum leviter aureum tingens.

unit.source: Jenna felt a surge of warmth and courage, but her eyes reflected a pure and magnificent blazing pillar of light.
unit.target: Jenna ardorem et virtutem resensivit, sed oculi eius pilam lucis puram ac magnificentem ardentem repraesentabant.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: The pillar of light struck her, transforming her into a mirror and shattering her into pieces.
unit.target: Columna lucis eam percussit, transformans eam in speculum et confrangens in partes.

unit.source: Anthony seized the chance to activate Psychological Invisibility once more.
unit.target: Anthony occasionem arripuit ad invisibilitatem psychologicam iterum activandam.

unit.source: However, the Trier police incarnation didn’t overlook him, as if it could detect the scent of sin on him.
unit.target: Tamen incarnatio vigilum Triers eum non neglexit, quasi odores peccati in eo detegere posset.

unit.source: Two bolts of lightning shot forth from the Punisher’s eyes, piercing Anthony’s soul.
unit.target: Duo fulgura e oculis Punitoris effulserunt, animam Anthoni penetrantia.

unit.source: Anthony’s eyes bulged, his mouth agape, but he couldn’t even muster a scream.
unit.target: Oculi Anthoni eminuerunt, os eius apertum, sed clamorem edere quidem non potuit.

unit.source: He stood paralyzed, rooted to the spot.
unit.target: Stabat immobilis, in loco haerens.

unit.source: “Death!” Trier’s police incarnation uttered a single ancient Hermes word.
unit.target: “Mors!” incedebat incarnatio vigilum Triers, unum vetus verbum Hermes proferens.

unit.source: Clenching his right hand into a fist, he lunged at Anthony, leaving an afterimage in his wake.
unit.target: Dextram manum in pugnum constringens, impetum ad Anthoni fecit, post se vestigia relinquens.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Imbued with a peculiar force, the fist collided with Anthony’s head in an inescapable blow.
unit.target: Virtute singulari imbuus, pugnum caput Anthoni in ictu inexorabili percussit.

unit.source: Crack! Anthony shattered into countless glimmering mirror fragments.
unit.target: Crepitus! Anthony in innumeros micantes fragmenta speculi confractus est.

unit.source: Franca, dressed in an assassin suit, reappeared.
unit.target: Franca, in habitu sicarii induta, iterum apparuit.

unit.source: Confronted by a demigod’s overwhelming power, the ethereal, non‑godhood‑possessing Demoness of Black, and the sealed special mirror world, she decisively retrieved an item from her Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Confrontata potentia demigodi ingenti, etherea Demonessa Nigrae, deitatis carentis, et mundo speculi speciali clauso, illa certissime obiectum ex sacculo Viatoris sui extraxit.

unit.source: It was a silver‑white full‑body armor, taller than Franca herself.
unit.target: Erat armatura totius corporis albo‑argentea, altior quam ipsa Franca.

unit.source: Pride Armor!
unit.target: Armatura Superbiæ!

unit.source: Franca positioned the Pride Armor in front of her, its back facing Overseer Perle.
unit.target: Franca Armaturam Superbiæ ante se posuit, dorsu versus Praepositae Perle.

unit.source: She was convinced that the demigod was the crux of the problem, not the Punisher taking the form of the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Illa certissima erat demigodum esse radicem quaestionis, non Punitoris in forma Demonessae Nigrae.

unit.source: If Perle remained unscathed, another Punisher would emerge to eliminate even after dispatching the first.
unit.target: Si Perle impune maneret, alius Punitor emergeret ad interemendos etiam post primum exterminandos.

unit.source: She might even face a direct “accusation.”
unit.target: Forsitan etiam directe “accusationem” subiret.

unit.source: Franca noticed Perle standing beside a protruding rock with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
unit.target: Franca animadvertit Perle iuxta saxum emergentem, cuius aditus ad mundum speculi fixus erat.

unit.source: It led her to believe that Perle could harness the Fourth Epoch Trier’s abundant corruption to request a fixed entrance to the mirror world created by the Primordial Demoness.
unit.target: Hoc illam adduxit ad credendum Perle abundantem corruptionem Triers Aetatis Quartae adhibere posse ad ianuam fixam ad mundum speculi, ab Demonessa Primordiali creatum, petendum.

unit.source: Not only would it allow them to enter and exit the conventional mirror world without relying on their inherent characteristics and abilities, but it would also serve as the gateway to this special mirror world.
unit.target: Non solum eis permittet in mundum speculi consuetum ingressum et exitum sine innatis qualitatibus et facultatibus, sed etiam ut ostium huic speculi speciali fungatur.

unit.source: After all, it could be considered a gift from a true god!
unit.target: Postremo, id donum a vero deo esse putari poterat!

unit.source: The instant the Pride Armor’s feet touched the ground, it suddenly spun around, fixing an invisible gaze upon Overseer Perle.
unit.target: Statim ut pedes Armaturae Superbiæ terram tetigerunt, illa subito se convertit, et oculum invisibilem versus Praepositae Perle infixit.

unit.source: Franca swiftly leaped to the side and rolled, avoiding facing the Pride Armor’s back.
unit.target: Franca celeriter ad latus progressa et voluta est, ne dorsum Armaturae Superbiæ contemplaret.

unit.source: Thud thud thud!
unit.target: Tum, tum, tum!

unit.source: The silver‑white full‑body armor charged towards Overseer Perle, condensing a broadsword of light in its hand.
unit.target: Armatura totius corporis albo‑argentea versus Praepositae Perle impetum fecit, gladium lucis latum in manu condensum.

unit.source: In the dark cathedral bereft of a deity’s Sacred Emblem, a pea rapidly grew, transforming into a multitude of thick turquoise vines that converted the area into a lush paradise of plants and an otherworldly forest.
unit.target: In obscura cathedralis, deitatis sacri emblēma carente, pisum celeriter crevit, transformans in multitudinem densarum vitis caeruleo‑viridum, quae regionem in luxuriantem paradisum plantarum atque silvam aliam extraneam converterent.

unit.source: They separated the suspended corpses, preventing them from approaching The Hermit.
unit.target: Separaverunt corpora suspendita, impediendo ut ad Eremitam accederent.

unit.source: Judgment, who had remained silent, extended her right palm, her eyes glowing with a copper‑gold luster.
unit.target: Iudicium, quod silens mansit, palmam dextram extendit, oculis eius fulgentibus cum nitore cupreo‑auro.

unit.source: She spoke gravely in ancient Hermes, “Marionettes are prohibited here!”
unit.target: Loquuta est graviter in antiquo sermone Hermes: “Marionettæ hic vetantur!”

unit.source: The animated corpses abruptly ceased their movements, and Magician tore open the void before her, tainting it with resplendent starlight, forming an enchanting door.
unit.target: Corpora animata subito motus cessaverunt, et Magus vacuum ante se distraxit, eum stella luce splendidissima pollens, formans ianuam incantatam.

unit.source: Beyond the door was the portrait of a woman—Loki, who had undergone a bizarre transformation.
unit.target: Ultra ianuam erat imago mulieris—Loki, quae transformationem miram passa est.

unit.source: Loki reached into the air and pulled out a figure.
unit.target: Loki in aether extendit manum et figuram extraxit.

unit.source: The figure was a woman with a voluptuous build, dressed in a black gown.
unit.target: Figura erat mulier voluptuosa, nigro vestita.

unit.source: A golden crown encrusted with jewels adorned her head.
unit.target: Corona aurea gemmis insculpta caput eius decorabat.

unit.source: She had curly chestnut hair, blue eyes, a high nose bridge, and slightly thin lips.
unit.target: Habebat capillos castaneos crispatos, oculos caeruleos, altum nasum et labia leviter tenue.

unit.source: She exuded a Demoness‑like allure from the inside out.
unit.target: Externo et interno, allicitio qualis Demonessa emanabat.

unit.source: 731 Another Good Job
unit.target: 731 Aliud Bonum Opus

unit.source: In the depths of the shadowy cathedral, Loki conjured a figure out of thin air.
unit.target: In intimis umbris templi, Loki figuram ex nihilo evocavit.

unit.source: The scene unfolding beside him was vividly reflected in the eyes of the Major Arcana card holders: Magician, Judgment, and Hermit.
unit.target: In oculis tenentium Chartarum Arcana Maiora — Magus, Iudicium, et Eremita — scaena iuxta eum evoluta vive reflexa erat.

unit.source: On the wall of aqueous‑black stone bricks, a painting depicted a woman in a bright red dress adorned with intricate embroidery and lace.
unit.target: In pariete ex lateribus lapideis nigro‑aquosis, pictura repraesentabat mulierem in veste rubra nitida, ornatam intricata contextura et reticulis delicatis.

unit.source: Her black hair was styled in an elegant high bun, and her face bore a mysterious, frozen smile.
unit.target: Capilli eius nigri in eleganti et alta conglobatione dispositi erant, et facies eius, quasi in glacie congelata, subridens apparuit.

unit.source: Her brown eyes seemed transfixed on the vivid, illusory ball of yarn before the Hermit and the peculiar golden lamp connected to its other end.
unit.target: Oculi eius fusci videbantur fixi in globum vivum et illusorium filamenti, quod coram Eremita et lampade aurea insolita, ad alterum finem conexa, positum erat.

unit.source: The woman remained within the mural, silently observing the scene.
unit.target: Mulier in pictura mansit, tacite scaenam observans.

unit.source: At the same time, the mature lady with a golden crown, exuding the allure of a Demoness, was pulled from the air by Loki.
unit.target: Simul, domina provecta cum corona aurea, quae daemonis allicitatem diffundens erat, ex aere a Loki rapta est.

unit.source: She turned her piercing blue eyes towards the Hermit, who had just entered the cathedral’s depths through the starlight door.
unit.target: Oculos suos acutos caeruleos versus Eremitam vertit, qui modo per ianuam lucis stellaris in intimas templi partes intraverat.

unit.source: As her long, chestnut hair billowed, each strand thickening, she too seemed fixated on the Hermit.
unit.target: Dum capilli eius longi, castanei, undulabant atque singuli crassiores fieri videbantur, ipsa quoque in Eremitam fixa videbatur.

unit.source: Prophesying a grim future, the Hermit quickly shielded herself with the Magic Wishing Lamp.
unit.target: Futurum funestum praedicens, Eremita celeriter se protexit cum Lampada Magica Votiva.

unit.source: Then, arching her back slightly, she sprouted pure white, illusory feathers reminiscent of a swan’s.
unit.target: Deinde, leviter dorsum arcens, ex ea plumæ candidæ et illusoriae, cygno similes, emerserunt.

unit.source: Fairytale magic, Ugly Duckling!
unit.target: Magia fabulosa, Anas Deformis!

unit.source: Even an ugly duckling could transform into a swan!
unit.target: Etiam anas deformis in cygnum transformari poterat!

unit.source: This power allowed Saints who had not yet reached the Angel level to reveal their incomplete Mythical Creature forms.
unit.target: Haec potentia Sanctis, qui nondum ad gradum Angelicum pervenerant, permisit formas eorum creaturarum mythicarum imperfectas revelare.

unit.source: The pristine swan feathers abruptly turned a grayish‑white and hardened into falling rocks.
unit.target: Plumæ cygni pristinae subito in album cinereum conversæ sunt et in saxa cadentia solidatæ sunt.

unit.source: The Hermit’s exposed skin split open, revealing grotesque, sinister crevices.
unit.target: Cutis Eremitae exposta resoluta est, et fissuras grotescas atque sinistras revelavit.

unit.source: Within the crevices, flesh and blood writhed, giving rise to black and white eyeballs.
unit.target: In fissuris, caro et sanguis torquebantur, generantes oculos nigros et albos.

unit.source: The eyeballs petrified and fell away, only to be replaced by new ones.
unit.target: Oculi lapidei facti ceciderunt, sed deinde novi eis substituti sunt.

unit.source: Yet, the Magic Wishing Lamp before the Hermit remained untouched.
unit.target: Attamen, Lampada Magica Votiva coram Eremita manens intacta permanuit.

unit.source: The black‑clad empress’s body suddenly became ethereal, her form dissipating into a torrent of knowledge that surged towards Magician, dressed in white with golden embroidery.
unit.target: Corpus imperatricis nigro indutae subito aetherium factum est, forma eius in torrentem scientiae evanidum dissipata, qui versus Magum — albo vestitum cum contextura aurea — fluebat.

unit.source: Magician appeared beside Loki in an instant, but a deluge of information immediately emerged from the void behind her.
unit.target: Magus in momento iuxta Lokim apparuit, sed diluvium informationum ex vacuo post eam statim emersit.

unit.source: Vanishing, the Magician reappeared “simultaneously” in nine different locations throughout the cathedral, her form flickering incessantly.
unit.target: Evanescens, Magus simul in novem diversis locis per templum reapparuit, forma eius incessanter micans.

unit.source: Upon realizing that their target was the woman in the wall painting, she attempted to escape the shadowy cathedral by force, but each effort led her back to where she began.
unit.target: Cum intellexisset scopum suum esse mulierem in pictura parietali, illa vi effugere templum umbratile conata est, sed omnis conatus eam ad locum unde initium fecerat redduxit.

unit.source: The black‑clad empress’s incarnation continued to pour forth information from behind the Magician’s nine figures, seeking to infiltrate the target’s mind and denying her the time to tear through the void.
unit.target: Incarnatio imperatricis nigro indutae informationes ex novem figuris Magi continue effundebat, quaerens in mentem scopum infiltrare atque ei tempus negare ut vacuum perrumpat.

unit.source: Smiling, Loki rose from the black wooden armchair and reached into the void with his right hand, as if grasping someone’s arm once more.
unit.target: Subridens, Loki ex sella lignea nigra surrexit et dextro manu in vacuum protendit, quasi bracchium alicuius iterum arripiens.

unit.source: Seizing the moment, Judgment reached the cathedral’s dome and pressed down with her right palm, like chaos descending from the heavens to the earth.
unit.target: Momentum arripens, Iudicium ad cupolam templi pervenit et dextro palma premens, sicut chaos de caelo in terram descendens.

unit.source: In ancient Hermes, she solemnly declared, “Mystery weakens here, while reality grows stronger!”
unit.target: In antiquo Hermete, sollemniter declaravit: "Hic mysterium infirmatur, dum realitas roboratur!"

unit.source: As the silver Pride Armor raced towards Overseer Perle, Franca activated the Seven‑Stone Bracelet on her left wrist.
unit.target: Dum argenteum Indumentum Superbiæ ad Administratricem Perle properabat, Franca Bracciale Septem Lapidum in sinistro polso excitavit.

unit.source: The crimson, blood‑like gem on the bracelet, adorned with three diamonds and four uniquely colored gems, burned with a fierce light.
unit.target: Gemma coccinea, quasi sanguinea, in bracciale, tribus adamantibus et quattuor gemmis singulari colore ornata, luce ferocia ardebat.

unit.source: In a flash, Franca appeared behind the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: In momento fulgente, Franca post Demonissam Nigram apparuit.

unit.source: She refrained from joining the Pride Armor in confronting Overseer Perle, having learned from Lumian’s encounter that their attacks would have no effect on the Overseer and only invite proportional punishment.
unit.target: Abire conata est participare Indumento Superbiæ in oppugnatione Administratricis Perle, postquam ex congressu Lumiani didicerat impetūs eorum in Administratricem nullum effectum habere, sed tantum poenam proportionalem invitare.

unit.source: Instead, she resolved to eliminate the Demoness of Black, a Punisher lacking godhood and exhibiting rigidity. The Demoness was merely equivalent to a stronger Sequence 5 Beyonder, making it possible for Franca to deal with her.
unit.target: Pro eo, decrevit exterminare Demonissam Nigram, Punitricem deorum absentem et rigiditatem exhibentem. Demonissa tantum aequivalebat Beyonder Series V robustiori, ita ut Francae eam oppugnare posset.

unit.source: As for Overseer Perle, the outcome depended on the changes and effects brought about by the Pride Armor, a Sealed Artifact devoid of “sin” and pragmatic intelligence.
unit.target: Quoad Administratricem Perle, exitus pendebat ex mutationibus et effectibus a Indumento Superbiæ, Artefacto Sigillato, carente "peccato" et intelligentia practica.

unit.source: Materializing, Franca raised her left hand, already adorned with the Ring of Punishment.
unit.target: Apparens, Franca manum sinistram sustulit, iam ornata Anulo Poenae.

unit.source: In her lake‑blue eyes, two bolts of lightning suddenly ignited and shot forth.
unit.target: In oculis eius caeruleo‑lacustris, duo fulminis ictus subito accensi sunt et proiecerunt.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitum!

unit.source: The Demoness of Black’s figure shattered into countless fragments.
unit.target: Figura Demonissae Nigrae in innumerabiles fragmenta confracta est.

unit.source: Dammit! Mirror Substitution is such a nuisance! Franca couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
unit.target: Di immortales! Substitutio speculi tam molestia est! Franca non potuit quin interius malediceret.

unit.source: At that instant, Lumian had just endured the punishment for attempting to escape, the flesh cloak transformed from Mr. K’s finger shattering and splattering on the ground.
unit.target: In illo momento, Lumian modo poenam passus erat ob conatum effugiendi, cum pallium carnis, quod ex digito Domini K dissolutum et in terram sparsum erat, evenitus esset.

unit.source: He watched as the silver‑white Pride Armor rushed to Overseer Perle’s side, raising a broadsword forged from pure light.
unit.target: Observavit dum album argenteum Indumentum Superbiæ ad latus Administratricis Perle contendebat, gladium latum ex lumine puro fabricatum elevans.

unit.source: Perle maintained her friendly smile, undaunted by the imposing presence of the massive, heavy armor.
unit.target: Perle subrisum suum amicum servavit, non perturbata ingenti et gravi armaturae praesente.

unit.source: An Overseer was impervious to attacks from those lacking godhood!
unit.target: Administratrix impassibilis erat impetu ab iis, qui deitate caruerunt!

unit.source: This was the sacred significance of overseeing.
unit.target: Haec erat sacra significatio vigilantiae.

unit.source: As for daring to strike an Overseer lifeform, the consequences would be dire!
unit.target: Quod attinet ausum feriendi formam Administratricem, consequentia gravissima erunt!

unit.source: Perle could already envision the armor‑like Sealed Artifact turning on the Demoness who had summoned it in the next moment.
unit.target: Perle iam praevidere poterat Indumentum Superbiæ, Artefactum Sigillatum quasi armatura, in Demonissam, quae illud invocaverat, in momento se convertere.

unit.source: As the Overseer contemplated this, the silver‑white Pride Armor swung the Sword of Dawn in its grasp.
unit.target: Dum Administratrix hoc contemplabat, argentum‑album Indumentum Superbiæ Gladium Auroris in manu sua circumagerat.

unit.source: It remained unaffected!
unit.target: Id immotum manebat!

unit.source: Perle’s pupils dilated as her figure in the bright red dress transformed into a pitch‑black shadow.
unit.target: Pupillae Perle dilatarunt, dum figura eius in veste rubra nitida in umbram atra transformabatur.

unit.source: The broadsword of light descended, cleaving the shadow in two.
unit.target: Gladius latus ex lumine descendit, umbram in duas partes secans.

unit.source: The divided shadows took form, replicating multiple similar shadows that scattered in all directions.
unit.target: Umbrae divisæ formam acceperunt, replicantes plurimas umbras similes, quae in omnes partes dispersae erant.

unit.source: The Pride Armor genuflected and drove the Sword of Dawn into the ground.
unit.target: Indumentum Superbiæ genu flectens Gladium Auroris in terram impulit.

unit.source: The broadsword shattered, unleashing countless sharp fragments of light that swept across the area.
unit.target: Gladius latus confractus est, innumerabiles acutos fragmenta luminis efferens, quae per totam regionem diffusa sunt.

unit.source: The entire quarry cave was bathed in illumination. To Franca’s surprise, the Demoness of Black, whose outline had been visible nearby, rapidly faded and vanished.
unit.target: Totum spelunca lapicola lumine inundata est. Ad Francae stuporem, Demonissa Nigra, cuius figura prope visibilis erat, celeriter evanuit et disparuit.

unit.source: Likewise, Jenna and Anthony, who had been cornered by the clergyman of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the Trier police incarnations, found themselves no longer under attack or pursuit.
unit.target: Similiter, Jenna et Anthony, qui a sacerdote Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum et incarnationibus vigilum Trevirensium in angustum coacti erant, se iam non sub impetu aut insequentia reperere poterunt.

unit.source: Bewildered, they observed as the Punishers, who had exerted immense pressure upon them, melted away like frost under the sun’s rays.
unit.target: Perplexi, observaverunt, cum Punitrices, quae in eos ingentem pressionem exercuerant, quasi gelu sub radiis solis dissolutae essent.

unit.source: Lumian was astonished by the Pride Armor’s performance.
unit.target: Lumian de actu Indumenti Superbiæ obstupefactus est.

unit.source: He had harbored little faith in the Sealed Artifact’s ability to challenge Overseer Perle. Yet, to his pleasant surprise, it had exceeded his expectations!
unit.target: Parvam fidem habebat in facultate Artefacti Sigillati Administratricem Perle provocandi. Attamen, ad eius iucundam admirationem, exspectationes suas superavit!

unit.source: Furthermore, he had noticed several peculiar details since Perle’s arrival.
unit.target: Praeterea, complura insueta ex adventu Perle animadvertit.

unit.source: The Overseer’s feet had not shifted an inch!
unit.target: Pedes Administratricis ne saltem quidem unciam mutaverunt!

unit.source: She stood beside a protruding rock with a fixed entrance to the mirror world, never pursuing or approaching. Instead, she exerted her influence upon them from a distance.
unit.target: Stabat iuxta saxum eminens, cuius fixus introitus in mundum speculi erat, numquam insequens nec appropinquabat; potius, a longe in eos influentiam exercebat.

unit.source: Could this be an inherent trait of an Overseer? Might the Pride Armor’s capacity to strike her stem from the abhorrence and hatred imbued within it by a deity before His demise? Were only attacks infused with godhood or a corresponding level of corruption capable of harming an Overseer? Lumian frowned, pondering these possibilities.
unit.target: Numquid hoc esset attributum insitum Administratricis? Potuitne capacitas Indumenti Superbiæ eam feriendi oriri ex repugnatione et odio, in ea a deo ante interitum inserto, provenire? Erantne solum impetūs, deitate infusi aut corruptelae aequivalenti gradus, potentes Administratricem laedere? Lumian fronem contraxit, his possibilitatibus meditatus.

unit.source: Snapping out of her daze, Franca shouted to him, “Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror!”
unit.target: Ex stupore evadens, Franca ad eum exclamavit: "Speculum decori Moran Avigny!"

unit.source: She knew that the Pride Armor could not so easily vanquish Overseer Perle. They had to seize this fleeting, uninterrupted window to escape the extraordinary mirror world.
unit.target: Sciebat Indumentum Superbiæ Administratricem Perle non tam facile vincere posse. Illud momentaneum, sine intermissione fenestram occupare debebant, ut ex extraordinario mundo speculi effugerent.

unit.source: Before Overseer Perle’s appearance, the dark light emanating from Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror had led Franca to suspect it might be the exit!
unit.target: Antequam Administratrix Perle appareret, lux obscura, quae ex speculo decori Moran Avigny emanabat, Francam ad suspicandum duxit: forsitan exitum esset!

unit.source: Franca trusted that Lumian grasped the full import of her concise words and refrained from elaborating further. The blue gem on her Seven‑Stone Bracelet emitted a sea‑like glow.
unit.target: Franca confidebat Lumian plenam significationem verborum eius compendiosis intellexisse et ulterius non enarrasse. Gemma caerulea in Bracciale Septem Lapidum eius luce simili maris effulgebat.

unit.source: In an instant, she materialized beside Jenna, grasping her arm.
unit.target: In momento, apparuit juxta Jennam, bracchium eius arripiens.

unit.source: A diamond on the Seven‑Stone Bracelet illuminated.
unit.target: Adamans in Bracciale Septem Lapidum illuminatus est.

unit.source: Teleport!
unit.target: Teleporta!

unit.source: Franca and Jenna teleported to Moran Avigny’s corpse and the nearby makeup mirror.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna se teleportaverunt ad cadaver Moran Avigny et speculum decori prope.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Lumian readily understood Franca’s message.
unit.target: Interim, Lumian facile intellexit nuntium Francae.

unit.source: He activated the black mark on his right shoulder and teleported to Anthony’s side. Without hesitation, he grabbed his teammate’s arm and teleported once more.
unit.target: Marcum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit et ad latus Anthoni teleportavit; sine mora, bracchium sodalis sui arripuit et iterum teleportavit.

unit.source: Their destination: Moran Avigny’s already open makeup mirror!
unit.target: Destinatio eorum: speculum decori Moran Avigny, iam apertum!

unit.source: However, upon appearing near Moran Avigny’s corpse, Franca and Lumian were stunned to discover that the makeup mirror had become illusory and unreal, as if it were a mere projection of the original item.
unit.target: Sed, cum prope cadaver Moran Avigny apparuerunt, Franca et Lumian stupefacti sunt, cum invenerunt speculum decori illusorium et irréale factum esse, quasi tantum proiectio rei originalis.

unit.source: At that moment, they heard Overseer Perle’s voice once again.
unit.target: In illo momento, vocem Administratricis Perle iterum audiverunt.

unit.source: “You stand guilty! You have harmed an Overseer!”
unit.target: «Culpabiles estis! Administratricem laesistis!»

unit.source: As her voice echoed, the silver‑white full‑body armor ascended, and the void behind it ruptured into darkness.
unit.target: Dum vox eius resonabat, armatura integra, album argenteum, ascendit, et vacuum post eam in tenebras ruptum est.

unit.source: Propelled by an unseen force, the Pride Armor plummeted into a centipede‑like crack resembling a void scar, falling into a pitch‑black abyss that extended as far as the eye could see. It vanished entirely from Lumian and his companions’ sight.
unit.target: Vi invisibili impulsum, Indumentum Superbiæ in fissuram centipedem similem, quae vestigium vacui alludebat, demersum est in abyssum atrum, quod usque ad oculum se extendebat; omnino a conspectu Lumiani et sociorum eius evanuit.

unit.source: Judgment: Exile!
unit.target: Iudicium: Exsilium!

unit.source: Fragmented shadows swiftly converged beside the protruding rock with the fixed entrance to the mirror world. Overseer Perle, garbed in her red dress, reappeared.
unit.target: Umbrae confractae celeriter iuxta saxum eminens, cuius fixus introitus in mundum speculi erat, convenere. Administratrix Perle, in veste rubra induta, reapparuit.

unit.source: Holding a makeup mirror in her hand, she smiled and said, “Did you believe I would leave the exit intact? I replaced it with a counterfeit long ago!”
unit.target: Tenens speculum decori in manu, subridens dixit: "Credidistisne me exitum intactum relinquere? Illud olim falsum substitui!"

unit.source: Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony’s expressions shifted slightly.
unit.target: Expressiones Lumiani, Francae, Jennae, et Anthoni leviter mutatae sunt.

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian, already grasping Anthony’s arm, swiftly activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Dum haec cogitationes per mentem eius cursu agerent, Lumian, iam bracchium Anthoni arripiens, celeriter marcum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

unit.source: He and Anthony vanished in an instant beside Moran Avigny’s corpse.
unit.target: Ipse et Anthony in uno momento iuxta cadaver Moran Avigny evanuerunt.

unit.source: Franca made a similar effort, causing the emerald in her Seven‑Stone Bracelet to emit a transparent green light.
unit.target: Franca similem conatum fecit, ita ut smaragdus in Bracciale Septem Lapidum eius lucem viridem transparens emiit.

unit.source: However, just as she Blinked with Jenna to a corner of the quarry cave, Perle’s Words of Order resounded in her ears.
unit.target: Attamen, mox cum ipsa et Jenna ad angulum speluncae lapicola teleporterentur, verba ordinationis Perle in auribus eius resonaverunt.

unit.source: “You stand guilty! You attacked an Overseer!”
unit.target: «Culpabiles estis! Administratricem oppugnastis!»

unit.source: Franca was the one who had unleashed the Pride Armor!
unit.target: Franca ipsa erat quae Indumentum Superbiæ liberaverat!

unit.source: As Franca prepared to use the Seven‑Stone Bracelet to depart her current location, she suddenly witnessed the surrounding void freeze and transform into layers of amber, encasing her and Jenna within.
unit.target: Dum Franca parabat Bracciale Septem Lapidum ad locum suum currentem relinquendum uti, subito vidit vacuum circumstantem congelari ac in stratis ambra mutari, quae eam et Jennam inclusit.

unit.source: This was a “cage” from which even teleportation could not provide escape.
unit.target: Hoc erat "cavea", ex qua etiam teleportatio effugere non poterat.

unit.source: It encompassed the entire area, and even if Franca and Jenna attempted to employ Mirror Substitution, they would remain confined within its boundaries.
unit.target: Totum spatium complectebat, et etiam si Franca et Jenna speculum substitutionis uti conarentur, intra eius limites manere deberent.

unit.source: Judgment: Confinement!
unit.target: Iudicium: Confinatio!

unit.source: Overseer Perle averted her gaze, searching for Lumian and Anthony.
unit.target: Administratrix Perle oculos avertit, Lumian et Anthoni quaerens.

unit.source: She surveyed the surroundings but found no trace of the two.
unit.target: Circumiecta inspexit, sed nullum vestigium duorum invenit.

unit.source: Perle swiftly focused and took her Overseer position, carefully observing the different sections of the quarry cave.
unit.target: Perle celeriter se concentravit et munus praefectae suscepit, diversas speluncae fodinae partes diligenter observans.

unit.source: The area was shrouded in darkness, with only a carbide lamp lying on its side providing a faint bluish‑yellow light.
unit.target: Regio tenebris involuta erat, et sola lampada carbidica, in latere iacens, levem lucem caeruleo‑flavam parumque efferebat.

unit.source: As she looked around, Perle spotted Lumian and Anthony.
unit.target: Dum circumspiciebat, Perle Lumian et Anthony conspexit.

unit.source: They were both located at the quarry cave’s exit, which marked the isolated boundary of this unique mirror world.
unit.target: Utrumque ad exitum speluncae fodinae erant, quod fines solitarios huius unici speculi mundi designabat.

unit.source: It wasn’t a viable escape route, leaving them trapped.
unit.target: Non erat via apta ad evadendum, quae eos captivos reliquit.

unit.source: Lumian stood facing Perle, wearing the Flog boxing gloves with iron‑black spikes.
unit.target: Lumian, ad Perlem conversus, stetit, gerens manubria pugilistica Flog quae spinis ferri nigri ornata erant.

unit.source: He gripped a brass revolver in his hand.
unit.target: Manu sua revolver ex aere tenuit.

unit.source: Anthony took cover behind him, their backs almost touching.
unit.target: Anthony se post eum abscondit, quorum dorsa paene inter se contigebant.

unit.source: The Hypnotist, however, wasn’t standing.
unit.target: Hypnotista, autem, non stabat.

unit.source: He was down on one knee, using a blank sketchbook propped on his right thigh as a surface to quickly draw something with a short pencil.
unit.target: In uno genu iacebat, librum delineationum inanis, in dextro femore appositum, ut substratum celeriter aliquid delineare per calamum breve uteretur.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Vas Fictum!

unit.source: Lumian and Anthony found themselves inside a Bottle of Fiction, formed from the quarry cave’s exit.
unit.target: Lumian et Anthony se invenerunt in Vas Fictum, quod exitus speluncae fodinae efformatus erat.

unit.source: But this was pointless against Perle, who had a complete overview of the current mirror world.
unit.target: Sed hoc contrarium Perlei frustra erat, quae plenam perspicientiam de mundo speculi hodierno habebat.

unit.source: She could easily see where Lumian and Anthony were hiding.
unit.target: Ea facile videre poterat ubi Lumian et Anthony se celaverant.

unit.source: As she watched the scene unfold, Overseer Perle felt a strange, unsettling aura, as if it involved a gray domain.
unit.target: Dum scaenam evolventem spectabat, praefecta Perle auram insolitam et perturbantem sensit, quasi regnum cinereum implicaretur.

unit.source: Lumian, as the team’s leader and most powerful member, appeared to be buying the Spectator more time.
unit.target: Lumian, ut dux turmae et potentissimus membrum, videbatur Spectatori tempus emere.

unit.source: Whether he was gambling on her unwillingness to kill him, hoping to capture him alive, so he could be used as a shield, it was evident that the Spectator’s actions were critical.
unit.target: Utrum aleam faceret ex eius voluntate non eum interficendi, sperans eum vivum captum iri ut scutum adhiberetur, patebat Spectatoris actus esse cruciales.

unit.source: Lumian believed it could either harm her—an Overseer—or help them evade an Overseer!
unit.target: Lumian credebat id aut eam laedere posse—praefectam—aut eos a praefecta evadere adiuvare!

unit.source: Without hesitation, Perle fixed her gaze on Lumian and Anthony within the Bottle of Fiction and declared in the Words of Order, “An Overseer sees all secrets!”
unit.target: Sine dubitatione, Perle oculos suos in Lumian et Anthony intra Vas Fictum dirigens, verbis ordinis declaravit: “Praefecta omnia arcana videt!”

unit.source: The moment she uttered those words, the Bottle of Fiction at the quarry cave’s exit quietly disintegrated.
unit.target: Momeno quo illa verba edixit, Vas Fictum ad exitum speluncae fodinae leniter dissolutus est.

unit.source: However, Perle noticed that while Lumian was no longer shielded by the Bottle of Fiction, Anthony still remained inside one.
unit.target: Tamen Perle animadvertit quod, dum Lumian non iam vas fictum servabat, Anthony adhuc intra illud remanebat.

unit.source: The Overseer’s words had failed to dispel it!
unit.target: Verba praefectae eam dissolvere non potuerunt!

unit.source: Confirming this detail, Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Hoc confirmans, Lumian subridit.

unit.source: The Bottle of Fiction surrounding Anthony was created using him as a base.
unit.target: Vas Fictum, quod Anthony circumdabat, eum ut fundamentum adhibitum creatum erat.

unit.source: His spread legs and the ground created a symbolic doorway.
unit.target: Crura diffusa et terra ianuam symbolicam creaverunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s body arched slightly as he faced Overseer Perle.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani paulum arcuatum est, dum praefecta Perlem spectabat.

unit.source: His smile twisted as he muttered under his breath, “Yes, Anthony is carrying out a crucial task under my guidance.
unit.target: Risus eius contorti sunt, dum submurmurans dixit: “Ita, Anthony munus cruciale sub mea ductu peragit.

unit.source: But to break the Bottle of Fiction made from a living person like me, you must defeat me first.
unit.target: Sed ut vas fictum, ex persona viva simili me factum, frangeris, me primum superare debes.

unit.source: Anyone trying to harm Anthony will have to go through me!
unit.target: Quicumque conabitur Anthony laedere, per me transire necesse erit!

unit.source: I am now Anthony’s shield.
unit.target: Nunc ego scutum Anthoni sum.

unit.source: I am the wall that protects him!”
unit.target: Murus sum qui eum tuetur!”

unit.source: Perle’s smile diminished slightly as she regarded Lumian with a grave expression.
unit.target: Subrisus Perlae leviter deminutus est, dum Lumian vultu gravi intuebatur.

unit.source: “You stand guilty!
unit.target: Tu es reus es!

unit.source: You murdered someone!”
unit.target: Aliquem interfecisti!”

unit.source: Murder… Lumian’s heart skipped a beat.
unit.target: Homicidium… cor Lumiani titubavit.

unit.source: He wasn’t surprised by the fact that he had killed someone, but he didn’t expect Overseer Perle to charge him with such a crime.
unit.target: Non miratus est quod aliquem interficeret, sed non exspectavit praefectam Perlem eum tali scelere accusare.

unit.source: No matter the form of the ensuing punishment, the ultimate outcome was set in stone.
unit.target: Quamvis forma poenae secutae, exitus finalis in lapide inscriptus erat.

unit.source: A murderer met his end!
unit.target: Homicida suum finem obiit!

unit.source: Doesn’t she want to take me alive? Lumian had voluntarily become Anthony’s shield, believing that Perle wouldn’t risk killing him.
unit.target: Non vultne illa me vivum capere? Lumian voluntarie scutum Anthoni factus erat, credens Perlem eum necandum non auditurum esse.

unit.source: This would limit many of her abilities.
unit.target: Hoc multas eius facultates restringeret.

unit.source: He hoped to buy time until Anthony finished the sketch on the Beyonder painting album he had gotten from Bard.
