unit.target: Spem habebat tempus emere, donec Anthony delineationem in albume picturae Beyonder, quod a Bardo adeptus erat, finiret.

unit.source: The album’s purpose was to bring drawings to life or manifest special effects for a period.
unit.target: Propositum albumi erat delineationes ad vitam revocandas aut effectus especiales pro certo intervallo manifestandos.

unit.source: Unexpectedly, this plan fell apart from the start.
unit.target: Inopinanter, hoc consilium ex initio dissolutum est.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian didn’t bet everything on the possibility of the Overseer only wishing to capture him alive.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian non cuncta in spe posuit, ut praefecta eum solum vivo capturum cupiret.

unit.source: It was impossible for him to defeat a demigod, but he had some hope at buying time.
unit.target: Ei impossibile erat semideum superare, sed aliquam spem temporis emendi habebat.

unit.source: A muffled thunderclap resounded in the low ceiling of the quarry cave.
unit.target: Tonitrua opaca resonaverunt in humili laquearia speluncae fodinae.

unit.source: Silver‑white lightning serpents sprang forth, intertwining into a tree of lightning as wide as a barrel, aimed at Lumian.
unit.target: Angues fulminis argenteo‑albi exsiluerunt, in arborem fulminis latissimam ut dolium implicantes atque ad Lumian intendentes.

unit.source: Before the thunder echoed and the lightning struck, Lumian had already lifted his hand, pointing the brass revolver at the world’s punishment.
unit.target: Antequam tonitrua resonarent et fulmen percuteret, Lumian iam manum extulit, revolver ex aere ad poenam mundi intendens.

unit.source: His blue eyes turned iron‑black, but he couldn’t perceive any weakness in the terrifying lightning.
unit.target: Oculi eius caerulei in ferreo nigro versi sunt, sed nullam infirmitatem in terribili fulmine deprehendere potuit.

unit.source: His only option was to channel blazing white flames into the revolver and the bullet about to be fired.
unit.target: Unica optio eius erat flammam albae fulgentis in revolver atque in pilam iam emittendam infundere.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: As the threatening silver‑white tree of lightning hurtled down, a bullet glowing with dark green flames shot from the muzzle, colliding with the immense lightning bolt.
unit.target: Dum arbor fulminis argenteo‑albi minax deorsum ruat, pila obscuro‑viridibus flammis fulgens ex canna emissa est, collidens cum ingenti fulminis ictu.

unit.source: Weakening Bullet!
unit.target: Pila Debilis!

unit.source: This was the Weakening Bullet he had obtained from Jebus!
unit.target: Haec fuit Pila Debilis quam a Jebus adeptus erat!

unit.source: Instantly, the barrel‑thick lightning bolt shattered the dark‑green bullet and the blazing white flames encasing it.
unit.target: Statim, fulmen crassum, quasi tuba, pilam viride obscuram et flammas albas ardentes, quae eam cinxerant, confringit.

unit.source: A blinding silver‑white light engulfed Lumian.
unit.target: Lux argenteo‑alba caeca Lumian obvolvit.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Tum!

unit.source: A horrifying roar assaulted Anthony’s ears, causing his body to shudder involuntarily, nearly deafening him.
unit.target: Clamor terribilis auribus Anthoni irruit, corpus eius involuntarie concutens, paene eum surdum faciens.

unit.source: He remembered the night the cultists attacked the army camp.
unit.target: Meminit noctis in qua cultores castra exercitus oppugnaverunt.

unit.source: Gunfire, cannon blasts, screams, and shouts came from every direction, overwhelming him with panic and fear.
unit.target: Telis igniferis, tormentis cannonum, clamores ac exclamationes ex omni parte pervenerunt, eum terrore et timore opprimentes.

unit.source: It had left a profound psychological scar that took years to heal.
unit.target: Reliquit cicatricem psychologicam profundam, quae multos annos ad sanandum requiruit.

unit.source: Now, he felt as if he had been transported back to that moment.
unit.target: Nunc sensit quasi ad illum tempus rediisset.

unit.source: Anthony gathered himself and looked at the blank sketchbook before resuming his sketch.
unit.target: Anthony se componit et librum delineationum inanimem observavit, deinde delineationem resumere coepit.

unit.source: The pencil in his hand rustled as it moved.
unit.target: Calamus in manu eius susurravit dum movebatur.

unit.source: He could still vividly recall Lumian’s body language: “Unless I die and someone steps over my corpse, no one can harm you!”
unit.target: Adhuc vividissime recordabatur motus corporis Lumiani: “Nisi moriar et quis super cadaver meum calcet, nemo tibi nocere potest!”

unit.source: Compared to the helplessness and terror of that night at the military camp, where everyone was in peril, Anthony felt the current situation wasn’t as dire.
unit.target: Comparata cum inopia ac terrore illius noctis in castris militaribus, ubi omnes in periculo erant, Anthony sensit rem prae se non tam gravem esse.

unit.source: At the very least, I have a dependable companion!
unit.target: Saltem, comitem fidum habeo!

unit.source: At the very least, someone is willing to risk their life to protect me!
unit.target: Saltem, aliquis paratus est vitam suam periclitare ut me protegat!

unit.source: Amidst the innumerable silver lightning serpents, Lumian’s body first fractured into mirror shards, then charred and crumbled into dust—the Mirror Substitution Jenna had provided him!
unit.target: Inter innumeros angues fulminis argentei, corpus Lumiani primo in fragmenta speculi divisum est, deinde comburatum atque in pulverem dissolutum est — substitutio speculi quam Jenna ei praebuerat!

unit.source: Lumian’s figure reappeared, standing firm in his spot with his legs slightly parted.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani iterum apparuit, stans firmiter in loco suo cum cruribus leviter divisis.

unit.source: Rumble.
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: The thunder in the sky didn’t fade with the previous punishment.
unit.target: Tonitrua in caelo non defecerunt cum poena priore.

unit.source: A new round of execution was brewing.
unit.target: Nova series supplicii imminebat.

unit.source: Since the Overseer had prosecuted, the punishment would persist until the target was well and truly dead!
unit.target: Cum praefecta prosecutus fuerit, poena perseveraret usque ad finem, donec scopus vere mortuus esset!

unit.source: Lumian’s scalp prickled, and his black hair stood on end from the lingering electricity in the air.
unit.target: Capillitium Lumiani formidine excitatum est, et capilli nigri eius, propter electricitatem manentem in aere, erecti erant.

unit.source: Seconds later, an even more magnificent and terrifying colossal lightning bolt silently descended.
unit.target: Post paucis secundis, fulmen colossale, adhuc magnificum et terribile, silentio descendit.

unit.source: Already clenching his teeth, Lumian tossed aside his revolver and raised his hands, allowing the Flog boxing gloves with iron‑black thorns to precisely meet the lightning’s tip.
unit.target: Iam dentes stringens, Lumian revolver suum deiecit et manus elevavit, permittens ut chirothecas pugilisticas Flog, cum spinis ferri nigri, apicem fulminis accurate convenirent.

unit.source: Blazing white fireballs materialized above him.
unit.target: Globuli ignis albi ardentes super eum apparuerunt.

unit.source: The Flog boxing gloves could withstand an attack imbued with godhood at the cost of shattering or cracking!
unit.target: Chirotheca Flog pugilistica oppugnationem divinitate imbutam sustinere poterat, etsi fractura vel fissura occurreret!

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Amidst the abrupt, devastating explosion, the silver‑white tree of death, composed of lightning, stopped at Lumian’s fist and the Flog boxing gloves.
unit.target: Inter subito, vasto et devastante impetu, arbor mortis argenteo‑alba, ex fulmine composita, ad pugnus Lumiani et chirothecas Flog sistit.

unit.source: Rumble.
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: Blazing white flames burst forth, driving the tiny lightning serpents back.
unit.target: Flammae albae ardentes eruperunt, angues fulminis parvos repulsantes.

unit.source: The lightning punishment quickly subsided, but the muffled rumble in the air lingered.
unit.target: Poena fulminis celeriter cessavit, sed murmure opaco in aere manebat.

unit.source: With multiple resounding cracks, Lumian’s Flog boxing gloves turned charred and cracked, shattering into countless pieces that rained down.
unit.target: Multiplicibus sonorum fissuris, chirotheca Flog pugilistica Lumiani in carbonem et fracta dispersa sunt, in innumerabilia fragmenta quae quasi pluvia ceciderunt.

unit.source: Seeing a fresh round of lightning about to form, Lumian knew he shouldn’t, but he couldn’t resist urging Anthony inwardly, “Why isn’t it done yet? I can only hold on a little longer!”
unit.target: Videns novum circulum fulminis fore, Lumian scivit se non agendum esse, sed tamen interne Anthony impellere non potuit, dicens: “Cur nondum confectum est? Paululum tantum adhuc sustinere possum!”

unit.source: After a brief, suffocating silence, a silver‑white giant lightning serpent abruptly struck from midair, illuminating the entire quarry cave and the smile on Overseer Perle’s face.
unit.target: Post brevissimam atque suffocantem silentium, gigas anguis fulminis argenteo‑albus subito ex medio aëris impetum fecit, totam speluncam fodinae et risum in facie praefectae Perle illustrans.

unit.source: Lumian only had time for one thing.
unit.target: Lumian tantum unam rem tempori habebat.

unit.source: He animated his shadow and switched places with it.
unit.target: Umbram suam animavit et cum ea locum commutavit.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Amid the sharp and urgent thunderstorm, the giant lightning serpent consumed the shadow, instantly vaporizing it without a trace.
unit.target: Inter acute et ardenter tonantem tempestatem, gigas anguis fulminis umbram consumpsit, eam statim sine ulla vestigio vaporavit.

unit.source: At last, this round of punishment concluded, and Lumian reappeared in front of Anthony.
unit.target: Denique haec series poenae finem attigit, et Lumian coram Anthoni iterum apparuit.

unit.source: His legs were slightly apart, and his back was somewhat hunched, but no shadow remained under his feet.
unit.target: Crura eius parum divisa erant, et dorsum aliquantum incurvum, sed nulla umbra sub pedibus eius remansit.

unit.source: Why isn’t it finished yet? Lumian thought anxiously.
unit.target: Cur nondum confectum est? Lumian anxie cogitavit.

unit.source: He considered dismantling the Bottle of Fiction and teleporting Anthony around.
unit.target: Cogitavit de dissolvendo Vas Fictum et de Anthoni circum transferendo.

unit.source: However, he could tell that the Overseer’s prosecuted punishment wouldn’t end simply because he changed positions.
unit.target: Tamen intellexit poenam, quae a praefecta prosecutus erat, non finiri solum quia locum mutaverit.

unit.source: With the speed of lightning, he couldn’t depend on teleportation to evade it.
unit.target: Cum velocitate fulminis, in teleportatione ad illud evadendum non poterat confidere.

unit.source: It wasn’t a matter of teleportation being too slow, but rather the time he needed to activate the black mark on his right shoulder.
unit.target: Non quaerat quod teleportatio nimis tarda sit, sed temporis ad notam nigram in humero dextro activandam opus esset.

unit.source: Rumbling thunder resonated in Lumian’s ears, heralding the impending punishment.
unit.target: Tonitrua rugientia in auribus Lumiani resonabant, poenam imminentem praenuntiantes.

unit.source: Behind Lumian, sweat the size of soybeans formed on Anthony’s forehead as he crouched on one knee, drawing on his right thigh, which served as a table.
unit.target: Post Lumian, sudor, fabarum sojarum magnitudine, in fronte Anthoni constitit, dum ille in uno genu fovebat et in dextro femore, qui quasi mensa fungebatur, delineabat.

unit.source: The sketch’s first half was successful and completed quickly, but for some reason, the final stroke suddenly became challenging.
unit.target: Media pars delineationis feliciter confecta atque celeriter perfecta est, sed aliqua causa, ultima linea subito ardua facta est.

unit.source: The painting album influenced the pencil, causing it to greedily absorb Anthony’s spirituality.
unit.target: Album picturae calamum influere fecit, quo ille aviditer spiritualitatem Anthoni absorbere coepit.

unit.source: However, even this substantial amount of spirituality could only inch the black lines forward slowly.
unit.target: Tamen, etiam hac substantiali spiritualitatis quantitate, solum nigros lineas lente progredi facere poterat.

unit.source: At the same time, the edges of the blank drawing page gradually curled, igniting with transparent flames, as if struggling to contain what Anthony was about to draw.
unit.target: Simul, margines paginae delineationis inania paulatim convoluti sunt, ignibus transparentibus accensi, quasi contendentes continere id quod Anthony delineare pararet.

unit.source: Anthony was well aware that this painting album was not meant to display such a thing, but he had complete faith in Lumian’s judgment and persevered.
unit.target: Anthony bene sciebat album picturae non destinatum esse ad huiusmodi rem monstrandam, sed plenam fidem in iudicium Lumiani habebat et perseveravit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: The muffled thunder intensified, and Anthony, within the Bottle of Fiction, could hear it clearly.
unit.target: Tonitrua opaca intensiora facta sunt, et Anthony intra Vas Fictum ea clare audire poterat.

unit.source: Despite being a Psychiatrist, he found himself unable to control his emotions.
unit.target: Quamquam psychiater erat, se invenit quia affectus suos regere non posset.

unit.source: Nervousness, impatience, anxiety, and panic surged within him.
unit.target: Nervositas, impatientia, anxietas et pavor in eo erupere.

unit.source: He composed himself and continued the final stroke.
unit.target: Se composuit et ultimam lineam continuavit.

unit.source: Seeing the terrifying silver‑white lightning on the brink of taking shape and Anthony still silent behind him, Lumian felt a wave of despair.
unit.target: Cum vidisset terribile fulmen argenteum formari in limite et Anthony post eum adhuc silentem, Lumian desperationis fluctum sensit.

unit.source: Am I about to die?
unit.target: Moriarne?

unit.source: Very well, I’d like to see what Termiboros looks like!
unit.target: Bene, vellem videre qualis Termiboros esset!

unit.source: Death… Suddenly, a flash of inspiration illuminated Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Mors… Subito, scintilla inspirationis mentem Lumiani illustravit.

unit.source: He retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ex sacco viatoris rem extraxit.

unit.source: It was a golden mask adorned with several dashes of oil paint.
unit.target: Erat larva aurea, paucis spicis picturae oleatae ornata.

unit.source: He had obtained this golden mask from Hisoka, and it originated from Death!
unit.target: Larvam hanc auream a Hisoka adeptus erat, et a Morte orta erat!

unit.source: Lumian swiftly put on the golden mask, his body rapidly growing cold as his aura gradually dissipated.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter larvam auream induit, corpus eius celeriter frigescens, dum aura eius paulatim evanuit.

unit.source: The terrifying lightning punishment brewing in midair abruptly came to a standstill.
unit.target: Terribilis poena fulminis, quae in medio aëris fervebat, subito cessavit.

unit.source: Lumian gazed up at the silver‑white electric serpents that no longer converged, his lips curling beneath the golden mask.
unit.target: Lumian sursum aspexit ad angues electricae argenteo‑albae, qui non iam conveniebant, labris eius sub larva aurea incurvatis.

unit.source: He had become an undead creature!
unit.target: Factus erat creatura ex morte restituta!

unit.source: One of the golden mask’s purposes was to transform the wearer into an undead being while preserving their intelligence!
unit.target: Unus ex finibus larvae aureae erat ut indutum in creaturam ex morte restitutam converteret, dum intelligentiam eius servaret.

unit.source: Since Lumian was now “dead,” the punishment had fulfilled its purpose.
unit.target: Cum Lumian nunc “mortuus” esset, poena propositum suum impleverat.

unit.source: It naturally came to an end!
unit.target: Naturaliter finem habuit!

unit.source: Witnessing this, the Overseer was momentarily taken aback before grasping the situation.
unit.target: Haec videns, praefecta breve obstupuit antequam rem intellexit.

unit.source: She chuckled, but her composure remained intact.
unit.target: Risu emicuit, sed constantia eius intacta mansit.

unit.source: While the punishments descended, she had not sat idle and had prepared for any unforeseen circumstances.
unit.target: Dum poenae descendebant, illa non sedebat inops, sed omnia casus inopinatos praeparaverat.

unit.source: She used a coin bag to execute an Under the Table transaction.
unit.target: Saccum nummorum ad transactionem sub mensa exsequendam usus est.

unit.source: Her right hand was about to withdraw.
unit.target: Manus dextra eius iam recedebat.

unit.source: Behind Lumian, Anthony watched as the curled‑up edge and invisible flames rapidly spread to the center of the painting page, intensifying his despair.
unit.target: Post Lumian, Anthony spectabat, dum margines convoluti et flammae invisibiles celeriter ad medium paginae delineationis diffuserentur, desperationem eius intensificantes.

unit.source: Even if he managed to complete the final stroke, the drawing paper would be rendered useless—nothing effective would come out of it.
unit.target: Etiamsi ultimum ictum perfici posset, charta delineationis inutilis facta esset—nihil efficax ex ea proveniret.

unit.source: Anthony gritted his teeth, choosing to trust his companion and Lumian.
unit.target: Anthony dentes conpressos tenuit, socium suum et Lumian confidere elegit.

unit.source: He recalled Lumian’s instructions: “Draw Monette first before drawing Madam Magician!”
unit.target: Meminit praecepta Lumiani: “Depinge Monette primo, deinde Madam Magician!”

unit.source: Monette, the Islander swindler Monette…
unit.target: Monette, fraudatrix insulana…

unit.source: The instant this thought crossed Anthony’s mind, he was astonished to see the painting paper’s edge halt and the invisible flames temporarily freeze.
unit.target: Instante hoc in mente Anthoni apparuit, stupuit videre marginem charta delineationis sistentem et flammas invisibiles pro tempore congelatas.

unit.source: His pencil movements became smoother.
unit.target: Motus calamī eius leviores facti sunt.

unit.source: Mustering his spirituality, he finished drawing a monocle outlined by simple lines on the right eye of the thin‑faced Islander with sunken eyes, thick lips, and slightly curly black hair.
unit.target: Spiritualitatem colligens, finivit depingere monoculum, simplicibus lineis circumscriptum, in oculo dextro insulanae vultu tenui, oculis infuscatis, labris crassis et capillis nigris paulo crispatis.

unit.source: 733 Praise You
unit.target: 733, Te laudamus

unit.source: Finishing the last stroke, Anthony sighed in relief, confirming he still lived.
unit.target: Ultimum ictum perficiens, Antonius ex solacio suspiravit, confirmans se adhuc in vita esse.

unit.source: Though unsure if Amon’s incarnation–Monette’s drawn form–could help turn the tables and find a way out of the mirror world, he had obeyed his partner’s orders and done his part.
unit.target: Quamquam incertus an incarnatio Amonis — forma delineata Monette — casus convertere et viam e mundo speculi invenire posset, iussa socio obtemperaverat et suum munus egit.

unit.source: Almost at once, Anthony saw the corners of Monette’s sketched mouth turn up, eyes appearing to come to life.
unit.target: Paene statim, Antonius vidit angulos ore delineato Monette sublevatos, oculosque quasi in vitam redire apparentissimos.

unit.source: But the curling paper and translucent flames stirred once more.
unit.target: Sed charta volvens ac flammae translucidæ iterum se moverunt.

unit.source: In an instant, the drawing of Monette condensed into a ball, devoured by clear flames and absorbed into the dim Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: In momento, delineatio Monette in globum condensata est, flammis perspicuis devorata et in obscura Ampulla Ficticia absorpta.

unit.source: Wh– Had it failed? Anthony’s heart squeezed tight again.
unit.target: Heu—defecitne? Cor Antonii iterum arcte comprimitur.

unit.source: Even a disciplined Hypnotist found it hard to stay calm in the face of this.
unit.target: Etiam disciplinatus Hypnotista difficile invenit se ante hoc quietum manere.

unit.source: Right then, Overseer Perle, still next to the jutting rock, pulled her right hand from the Under the Table bag of coins.
unit.target: Iam statim, Praefecta Perle, adhuc iuxta rupem protuberantem, dextram manum ex sacculo monetae "Sub Mensa" extraxit.

unit.source: The transaction was made; Lumian’s group would teeter on the edge of sleep!
unit.target: Negotium peractum est; cohors Lumiani in limine somni trepidabit!

unit.source: Perle looked back at her target.
unit.target: Perle ad metam suam respexit.

unit.source: Lumian stood firm, wearing a gold mask painted black and white.
unit.target: Lumian firmiter stetit, larvam auream nigro atque albo pictam gerens.

unit.source: His aura was gone, body radiating an icy breath of death.
unit.target: Aura eius evanuit, corpus autem spiritum mortis glacialem effundebat.

unit.source: But Lumian’s now blue eyes stayed open.
unit.target: Sed oculi Lumiani, nunc caerulei, manebant aperti.

unit.source: As an Overseer, Perle knew something was wrong.
unit.target: Ut praefecta, Perle intellexit aliquid male esse.

unit.source: About to act, a thick darkness swallowed her, snuffing out the carbide lamp.
unit.target: Acturum, densae tenebrae eam voraverunt, exstinguentes lampam carbidicam.

unit.source: Perle’s eyes shut as she swayed unsteadily.
unit.target: Oculi Perle se claudebant, dum instabiliter vacillabat.

unit.source: She fell asleep.
unit.target: Dormivit.

unit.source: Somehow, the sleep effect meant for Lumian’s team had hit her instead, leaving them untouched.
unit.target: Quidam modo, effectus somni ad turmam Lumiani destinatus eam percussit, eos tamen intactos relinquens.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian felt shock, then immense joy.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian stupefactus est, deinde immensam laetitiam sensit.

unit.source: He sensed a strange power pulsing from the Bottle of Fiction he had made with his body.
unit.target: Sensit vim insolitam ex Ampulla Ficticia, quam corpore suo confecerat, palpitare.

unit.source: Did it work?
unit.target: Operatumne est?

unit.source: Had Anthony done it?
unit.target: Num Antonius id fecerat?

unit.source: As expected, the entity’s prior actions sought to help His father.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur, praecedentes actiones entitatis patrem suum adiuvare conabantur.

unit.source: And His father is on our side against heretics!
unit.target: Et pater eius est in nostra parte contra haereticos!

unit.source: Lumian quickly deactivated the Bottle of Fiction, ready to teleport to the sleeping Perle.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter Ampullam Ficticiam deactivavit, paratus ad Perle dormientem translocari.

unit.source: He would get Moran Avigny’s mirror and try to escape through the mirror world’s set entrance.
unit.target: Accipiet speculum Moran Avigny et conabitur per ianuam statutam mundi speculi effugere.

unit.source: If he could just get out, he could find help to make Perle leave.
unit.target: Si tantum extrahere posset, auxilium invenire posset ut Perle discederet.

unit.source: Just then, Perle’s coin bag and Moran Avigny’s mirror fell to the ground.
unit.target: Tunc, sacculus monetae Perle et speculum Moran Avigny in terram caderunt.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Ictus!

unit.source: Moran Avigny’s mirror broke, cracking the entire mirror world barrier.
unit.target: Speculum Moran Avigny confractum est, totum obstaculum mundi speculi scindens.

unit.source: Perle, driven by flaming ambition, woke up with a start.
unit.target: Perle, studio flammeo incitata, repente evigilavit.

unit.source: As Lumian’s hopes sank, a shadow raced out of the shattered mirror.
unit.target: Dum spes Lumiani labefactabant, umbra ex speculo confracto celeriter effugit.

unit.source: It combined with strewn bits of flesh and blood, instantly reforming into Mr. K in his black robe.
unit.target: Ea miscuitur cum sparsis particulis carnis et sanguinis, statim in Mr. K in nigra toga reformata.

unit.source: When the mirror world took damage, the Aurora Order Oracle felt his finger and teleported on instinct, turning to shadow to slip through the cracks.
unit.target: Cum mundus speculi laesionem passus est, Oraculum Ordine Aurorae digitum suum sensit et instinctu translocationem sumpsit, in umbram convertens ut per fissuras se insinuaret.

unit.source: In the dark cathedral in an unknown location, Magician Blinked over and over, unable to shake off the flood of random information.
unit.target: In obscura cathedrali in loco ignoto, Magus iterum atque iterum oculos micavit, neque potuit inundationem informationum fortuitarum abstinere.

unit.source: As she Blinked, starlight filled her eyes, solidifying into a weird, ancient stone wall clock.
unit.target: Dum illa oculos micabat, lumen stellarum oculos eius replebat, solidificans in insolitum et antiquum horologium lapideum murale.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: Grand, majestic chimes echoed in every nook of the cathedral.
unit.target: Magnae et magnificae campanae in omni angulo cathedralis resonaverunt.

unit.source: An old, mottled phantom appeared in the air–a stone wall clock split into twelve sections, each crossing grayish-white or bluish-black symbols.
unit.target: Phantasma vetus et maculatum in aere apparuit — horologium lapideum murale in duodecim partes divisum, quarum singulae symbola albo-cinerea vel nigro-caerulea ostendebant.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: The chimes carried an unspeakable, invisible torrent through long ages past, freezing all present.
unit.target: Campanae torrentem ineffabilem et invisibilem per longas aetates praeteritas ferebant, omnia praesentes congelantes.

unit.source: The horrifying torrent of information froze.
unit.target: Terrorificus torrentis informationum stetit congelatus.

unit.source: Hermit, changed into an incomplete Mythical Creature, stopped cold.
unit.target: Eremita, in creaturam mythicam imperfectam conversus, subito sistit.

unit.source: Judgment, floating over the cathedral, turned to a statue.
unit.target: Judicium, super cathedral levitans, in statuam conversum est.

unit.source: Loki’s hand, reaching into the void, also paused, failing to pull out a silhouette.
unit.target: Manus Loki, in vacuum extendens, quoque cessavit, neque silhouetum extrahere potuit.

unit.source: In this frozen state, the starlight in Magician’s eyes changed again.
unit.target: In hoc statu congelato, lumen stellarum in oculis Magi iterum mutatum est.

unit.source: Countless complex mercury symbols appeared, quickly joining into a huge, unreal, scaleless serpent.
unit.target: Innumerabilia symbola mercurii, intricata, apparuerunt, celeriter iungentes se in magnam serpentem, incredibilem et sine squamis.

unit.source: The silver-white giant snake, layered with dense patterns and symbols, made connected cylinders with different markings.
unit.target: Serpens giganteus argenteo-albus, stratis densus et symbolis ornatus, cylindros connexos cum insigniis diversis formavit.

unit.source: The next second, the mercury serpent bent to bite its tail before it began slowly turning.
unit.target: Secundo proximo, serpens mercurii se inclinavit ad caudam suam mordendum, antequam lente converteretur.

unit.source: The massive torrent of information started to reverse, going back the way it came until it turned back into the woman in the black dress with the gold crown.
unit.target: Magnus torrentis informationum revocari incipiebat, rediens per viam unde venit, donec iterum in feminam in veste nigra coronata corona aurea versa est.

unit.source: The black-dressed woman faded, becoming a ghost and a floating, oddly captivating tarot card. In the end, both went back to the void and disappeared.
unit.target: Femina veste nigra induta evanuit, facta umbra et charta taroti volitans, insolitè captivans. Denique, ambae ad vacuum redierunt et evanuerunt.

unit.source: Fallen rocks flew back to Hermit’s body, turning back to eyes or pure white. Hermit quickly lost her terrifying look that would make anyone go mad.
unit.target: Saxa lapsa ad corpus Eremitae revenerunt, in oculos aut purum album iterum convertentes. Eremita celeriter amisit aspectum terribilem, qui quemquam insanum facere posset.

unit.source: Judgment returned to the surface, going back past the “door” as the mystery-weakening limit faded.
unit.target: Judicium ad superficiem rediit, transeundo portam, dum terminus ad mysteria debilitanda evanuit.

unit.source: Loki drew back his hand, settling into the pitch‑black wooden chair.
unit.target: Loki manum retraxit, et in sellam lignea nigerrimam consediit.

unit.source: In the fractured special mirror world, Overseer Perle saw the hooded, black‑robed Mr. K and his many sins upon waking up.
unit.target: In mundo speculi speciali fracto, Praefecta Perle, evigilans, vidit Mr. K, cucullo indutus et veste nigra, atque multa peccata eius.

unit.source: Oddly, the criminal who had done worse things than Lumian only had a small gray spot.
unit.target: Insuete, sceleratus, qui peiora quam Lumian perfecerat, tantum parvam maculam cineream habebat.

unit.source: This suggested that finishing an Under the Table transaction with Mr. K would be hard, as if it needed certain conditions.
unit.target: Hoc suggerit finem transactionis "Sub Mensa" cum Mr. K difficultatem esse, quasi certis condicionibus egentem.

unit.source: It seems to come from extreme devotion.
unit.target: Videtur ex extrema devotione provenire.

unit.source: All Under the Table transactions can only keep going with the permission of the one he has faith in…
unit.target: Omnes transactiones "Sub Mensa" perseverare possunt solum cum licentia eius, in quem fidem habet…

unit.source: As Perle’s mind raced, she glared at Mr. K and said with the Words of Order, “You stand guilty! You murdered someone!”
unit.target: Dum mens Perle celerrime versabatur, illa Mr. K aspiciens, verbis ordinationis affirmavit: "Culpam geris! Aliquem interfecisti!"

unit.source: The space over Mr. K went dark at once as something awful took shape.
unit.target: Spatium super Mr. K simul obscuratum est, cum aliquid horribile formam summittere coepit.

unit.source: Having heard Lumian talk about Jebus’s powers, he knew a deadly punishment was coming. He quickly changed his Grazing target, using Devil Transformation and Rose Bishop’s flesh and blood magic to endure the unknown attack.
unit.target: Audito Lumiano de potentia Jebus, scivit mortalem poenam venturam esse. Celeriter metam suam "Grazing" mutavit, utens Transformatione Diaboli et magia carnis et sanguinis Rosae Episcopi, ut ignotum impetum ferre posset.

unit.source: But in a flash, the growing penalties vanished, as if going to an unknown place.
unit.target: Sed in momento, poenae crescentes evanuerunt, quasi ad locum ignotum se transferentes.

unit.source: The scary pressure, like thick smoke, blew away in fierce winds.
unit.target: Pressura terribilis, sicut fumus densus, in ventis ferocibus evanuit.

unit.source: Mr. K was stunned for a moment before exploding in crazed laughter.
unit.target: Mr. K per momentum stupefactus fuit, deinde in risu insaniente erupit.

unit.source: “Haha! Hahaha!
unit.target: "Haha! Hahaha!

unit.source: “I’m guilty, but the Lord carries my sins!”
unit.target: "Ego culpam habeo, sed Dominus peccata mea portat!"

unit.source: “I’m innocent. I’m innocent to this world!”
unit.target: "Innocens sum. In hoc mundo innocens permaneo!"

unit.source: Amid the laughter, Mr. K changed Grazing targets.
unit.target: Inter risum, Mr. K metam "Grazing" mutavit.

unit.source: Layers of unreal doors showed up in his eyes.
unit.target: Strata ianuarum irrealium in oculis eius apparuerunt.

unit.source: Many doors to different places came together, turning into ghostly books.
unit.target: Multae ianuae ad loca diversa confluere coeperunt, in libros spectra transformantes.

unit.source: The book materialized in front of Mr. K, pages flipping fast.
unit.target: Liber coram Mr. K apparuit, paginas celeriter volventes.

unit.source: “I came, I saw, I recorded.”
unit.target: "Veni, vidi, conscripsi."

unit.source: As the ethereal voice rang out, the illusory book stopped on a page.
unit.target: Dum vox aetheria resonabat, liber illusorius in una pagina sistit.

unit.source: In an instant, Mr. K turned into a two‑ to three‑meter‑tall half‑giant in cold black armor, holding a pitch‑black sword.
unit.target: In instante, Mr. K in semigitaneum, duorum ad trium metrorum altitudinem, in frigida armatura nigra versus est, gladium nigerrimum tenens.

unit.source: He sprinted towards the Overseer.
unit.target: Ad Praefectam impetu cucurrit.

unit.source: “Praise you!” Mr. K roared, slicing down with the Sword of Darkness.
unit.target: «Laudo te!» clamitavit Mr. K, gladium tenebris stridens deorsum feriens.

unit.source: Perle’s face went grim, seeing the prosecution had no effect on Mr. K.
unit.target: Vultus Perle adstrictus factus est, cum animadverteret persecutionem nullum in Mr. K operari.

unit.source: Of course, as a demigod, though caught off guard, she knew what to do.
unit.target: Scilicet, ut semideus, quamvis inopinata, scivit quid faciendum esset.

unit.source: Amid Mr. K’s wild laughter, she stressed with the Words of Order, “An Overseer is protected!”
unit.target: Inter risum insanum Mr. K, illa verbis ordinationis affirmavit: "Praefecta protegetur!"

unit.source: The black‑armored half‑giant used all his might, slashing at Perle’s head with the dark broadsword, but an unseen barrier blocked it.
unit.target: Semigitaneus in armatura nigra omni vi utebatur, caput Perle latum gladium obscurum caedens, sed barriera invisibilia illud impediverunt.

unit.source: The barrier cracked.
unit.target: Barriera fracta est.

unit.source: Mr. K’s body quietly fell apart.
unit.target: Corpus Mr. K silentio dissortium est.

unit.source: A clean cut took off his right arm and shoulder, dropping them to the ground.
unit.target: Incisio nitida dextrum brachium et humerum eius abstulit, eos in terram deiecit.

unit.source: Though Mr. K used recorded demigod powers and had a bit of godhood, he still faced punishment for attacking a “clearly” protected Overseer.
unit.target: Quamquam Mr. K potestates semidei memoratas adhibuit et aliquantum divinitatis possidebat, tamen poenam subire debuit propter impetum in praefectam manifestè protegitam.

unit.source: This was a freshly done crime, not yet borne!
unit.target: Hoc erat crimen recens commissum, nondum pertulit!

unit.source: The flesh on Mr. K’s shoulder writhed, as if a new arm would grow. But he ignored it.
unit.target: Caro in humero Mr. K contorquebatur, quasi novum brachium crescere velletur; sed id non curavit.

unit.source: His left hand grabbed the falling dark sword, yelling again, “Praise you for creating everything!”
unit.target: Manus sinistra gladium obscurum cadentem apprehendit, iterum clamans: "Laudo te quod omnia creasti!"

unit.source: As the rough voice echoed, the dark broadsword slashed at Overseer Perle.
unit.target: Dum vox aspera resonabat, gladius latus obscurus in Praefectam Perle incidens caedebat.

unit.source: With Perle’s former protection, the dropped coin bag floated back to her hand.
unit.target: Cum pristina protectione Perle, sacculus monetae lapsus ad manum eius revolavit.

unit.source: She quickly made an Under the Table deal aimed at everyone there.
unit.target: Celeriter commercium "Sub Mensa" omnibus illic destinatum instituit.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: As the dark broadsword swung, the unseen barrier guarding the Overseer fully shattered.
unit.target: Dum gladius latus obscurus osculabatur, barriera invisibilis, quae Praefectam protegēbat, plene confracta est.

unit.source: Mr. K’s left arm came off his body, showing a huge cut.
unit.target: Brachium sinistrum Mr. K e corpore eius abscissum est, demonstrans magnum laesum.

unit.source: In the cut, blood‑colored flesh tendrils grew fast, as if alive, as if a new Mr. K would emerge.
unit.target: In laesione, filiculae carnis, sanguine coloratae, celeriter creverunt, quasi vivae essent, quasi novus Mr. K oriri posset.

unit.source: Overseer Perle wasn’t happy. Based on the Under the Table deal, Mr. K, Lumian, and the rest should have gotten much weaker.
unit.target: Praefecta Perle non laeta erat. Secundum commercium "Sub Mensa", Mr. K, Lumian, et ceteri multo debiliores fieri debuerunt.

unit.source: But in truth, nothing changed!
unit.target: Sed re vere, nihil mutatus est!

unit.source: Could it be that I’m unlucky?
unit.target: Fortasse infortunata sum?

unit.source: The person who made the deal was a fraud who never meant to keep their end?
unit.target: Is qui commercium fecit, impostor erat qui numquam partem suam servare voluit?

unit.source: Perle’s heart sank as she couldn’t move for some reason.
unit.target: Cor Perle demissum fuit, quoniam, qua causa, movere non poterat.

unit.source: Then she saw the armless Mr. K bow in an exaggerated way.
unit.target: Tum vidit Mr. K, sine armis, in modum exaggeratum se inclinare.

unit.source: The Aurora Order Oracle’s mouth opened as wide as it could, corners going to his ears. Blood churned where it tore, flesh tendrils thickly covering the spot.
unit.target: Os Oraculi Ordine Aurorae quam late aperuit, angulos ad aures eius tendentes. Sanguis cum turbatione fluxit ubi lacerationem fecit, et filiae carnis spissae locum tegentes.

unit.source: Using his stretched mouth, the black‑armored Mr. K bit the dark sword’s handle.
unit.target: Utendo ore suo extenso, Mr. K, in armatura nigra indutus, manubrium gladii obscuri mordebat.

unit.source: He jumped high, voice ringing from his chest.
unit.target: Altum saltavit, voce ex pectore resonante.

unit.source: “Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
unit.target: "Laudo te quod peccata mundi tulisti!"

unit.source: Amid hoarse yells, Mr. K fell, a straight dark sword using himself as the grip, slashing at Overseer Perle.
unit.target: Inter voces rauces, Mr. K cecidit, gladium obscurum rectum se ipse quasi manubrium habens, in Praefectam Perle incidens.

unit.source: 734 My Weapon
unit.target: 734 Telum Meum

unit.source: Lumian stood at the quarry cave’s exit, wanting to work with Mr. K to take on Perle, but unsure of how to proceed.
unit.target: Lumian ad exitum speluncae fodinarum stetit, cupiens cum Domino K laborare ut Perlem oppugnaret, sed nesciebat quo modo procedendum esset.

unit.source: Past experience had shown him that without godhood, any action against an Overseer would only come back to haunt him, without affecting the demigod at all.
unit.target: Experientia praeterita eum docuit quod, sine divinitate, omnis actio contra Supervisorem tantum ad eum rediret ut eum vexaret, nec quidem semideum attineret.

unit.source: With his golden mask removed, Lumian could only remain in place, considering what items he possessed that might be useful and effective.
unit.target: Cum larva aurea exlata esset, Lumian solum in loco manere potuit, considerans quae instrumenta haberet quae utilis atque efficax esse possent.

unit.source: He was left with no option but to watch the fight between Mr. K and Perle unfold as a mere spectator.
unit.target: Nulla alia ei remansit nisi pugnam inter Dominum K et Perlem tamquam spectator videre.

unit.source: At the same time, he scanned the area, looking for a way to utterly destroy the existing mirror world.
unit.target: Simul circumspiciens, regionem perlustrare conabatur, qua viam inveniendi mundum speculi iam existentem omnino delere posset.

unit.source: Anthony kept his posture and continued drawing on the blank painting album, which was missing a page.
unit.target: Antonius statum suum retinuit et in album picturae vacuo, cui pagina defesset, delineare pergebat.

unit.source: His current subject was to be Madam Magician.
unit.target: Subiectum eius hodiernum erat Domina Maga.

unit.source: As he observed Mr. K’s movements and listened to each slash, Lumian sensed a slight corruption creeping into his mind.
unit.target: Dum motus Domini K contemplabat et singulos ictus auscultabat, Lumian levem corruptionem in animum suum subire sensit.

unit.source: It surprised him that Mr. K could hold the Overseer at bay to some degree, unafraid of her accusations and armed with a means to harm her.
unit.target: Eum mirum fuit quod Dominus K, sine timore accusationum eius et armatus instrumento nocendi, aliquam vim contra Supervisorem retinere potuisset.

unit.source: Lumian silently hoped that even if Mr. K couldn’t defeat Perle, he would at least be able to drive her off.
unit.target: Lumian tacite sperabat, etiam si Dominus K Perlem vincere non posset, saltem eam repellere valere.

unit.source: Mustering strength from his waist and core, Mr. K swung his upper body as he descended, bringing the dark broadsword down on Overseer Perle’s head for the third time.
unit.target: Virtutem ex lumbis et corde colligens, Dominus K, corpus superius movens et descendens, gladio nigro super caput Supervisori Perle tertiam ictum intulit.

unit.source: Perle remained motionless, not using any Mirror Traversal-like ability to evade, nor rolling to the side.
unit.target: Perle immota manebat, neque ullo ingenio speculi itineris utens ad effugiendum, neque se ad latus volvens.

unit.source: She stood firm beside the jutting rock, her body turning pitch‑black and dissolving into a constantly dissipating shadow.
unit.target: Firmiter iuxta saxum prominens stabat, corpusque eius in atrum nitidum vertens atque in umbram constanter evanescentem dissolvitur.

unit.source: The dark, enigmatic broadsword plunged down abruptly, silently cleaving the shadows in two.
unit.target: Gladius obscurus, arcanus, subito deorsum labens, tacite umbras in duas dividens.

unit.source: The shadows rapidly encircled the protruding rock, perpetually moving and merging once again.
unit.target: Umbræ celeriter saxum eminens circumcircuere, perpetuo movebantur et rursus confluentes erant.

unit.source: They writhed, striving to reassemble Overseer Perle’s form.
unit.target: Illae contorquebantur, conantes formam Supervisōris Perle recomponere.

unit.source: Where the Sword of Darkness had cut through, the shadows struggled to form proper connections, barely managing to stack together into a humanoid shape riddled with cracks and misaligned parts.
unit.target: Ubi Gladius Obscuritatis incidit, umbræ nexus idoneos formare studebant, vix convenientes in formam humanam aggregari, fissuris atque partibus disordinatis infestatam.

unit.source: Mr. K sprang up, ready to swing the dark broadsword gripped in the gaping crack of his mouth.
unit.target: Dominus K subsiluit, paratus gladium obscurum, quod in fovea oris eius latebat, agitare.

unit.source: Suddenly, his body shrank rapidly, the cold black armor encasing him vanishing.
unit.target: Subito, corpus eius celeriter contraxit, et lorica nigra frigida, quae eum circumferebat, evanuit.

unit.source: He reverted to his original form, dressed in a black hood and matching robe.
unit.target: Rediit ad formam suam primigeniam, indutus cucullo nigro et veste congruente.

unit.source: The precariously assembled shadow gradually shed its black color, revealing human skin and a vivid red dress inch by inch.
unit.target: Umbra, instabili modo composita, paulatim colorem nigrum dimittere coepit, patefacens cutem humanam atque vestem rubram vivam singulis graduibus.

unit.source: In the shadowy cathedral at an undisclosed location, the mercury giant serpent phantom hanging in midair slowly faded away.
unit.target: In cathedrale umbratā, loco ignoto, phantasma serpentis gigantis mercurialis, in aere pendens, lente evanuit.

unit.source: The Reboot was finished.
unit.target: Renovatio peracta est.

unit.source: Perched on a black wooden armchair, Loki abruptly thinned and shrank, transforming into a paper figurine.
unit.target: Situs in sellā ligneā nigra, Loki subito tenuatus et contractus est, in effigiam chartaceam transformatus.

unit.source: The paper figurine and chair then crumbled, disintegrating into dust.
unit.target: Effigia chartacea et sella deinde corruerunt, in pulverem dissoluta.

unit.source: Loki materialized in a far corner of the cathedral.
unit.target: Loki in angulo remoto cathedralis apparuit.

unit.source: Magician, appearing to still be airborne, quickly conjured an alternate self behind him.
unit.target: Magus, adhuc in aere suspensus videbatur, celeriter alterum se post eum evocat.

unit.source: As Loki reached into the void to pull out an assistant, his jet‑black eyes suddenly shifted to blue.
unit.target: Dum Loki in vacuum se extendebat ut adiutorem extraheretur, oculi eius, nigri impiger, repente in caeruleum mutaverunt.

unit.source: The blue rapidly stained black, then reverted to blue, the two colors continually alternating.
unit.target: Caeruleum celeriter in nigrum conversum, deinde iterum in caeruleum revertit, et hi duo colores continue alternabantur.

unit.source: Loki was paralyzed, unable to summon an aide, allowing Magician to stretch out her right hand and grasp with all her might.
unit.target: Loki paralyticus erat, adiutorem evocare non valens, sinens Magae dextram manum extendere atque omni viribus prehendere.

unit.source: The dark void warped, swallowing Loki.
unit.target: Vacuum obscurum deformatum est, et Loki devoratus est.

unit.source: Then, the two shattered into fragments, ultimately buried in a bottomless abyss.
unit.target: Deinde ambo in fragmenta discrassata sunt, postremo in abyssum sine fundo sepeliti.

unit.source: Throughout this, Loki’s body instantly became ethereal, unreal, as if he were a projection or puppet that had been swapped at some moment.
unit.target: Per hoc, corpus Loki statim factum est aethereum et irreale, quasi esset proiectionem aut marionettam, quae aliquando commutata fuerit.

unit.source: Hermit, Judgment, and Magician simultaneously heard a regretful sigh and witnessed the shadowy cathedral itself turn ethereal and slowly disintegrate.
unit.target: Eremita, Iudicium, et Maga simul suspirium maerorem audiverunt atque ipsam cathedral umbratam in aethereum vertere et lente dissolvi conspexerunt.

unit.source: It, too, seemed to be a projection.
unit.target: Ea quoque videbatur esse proiectionis.

unit.source: An aged, ethereal voice then echoed from the distance.
unit.target: Vox antiqua, aetherea, ex longinquo resonavit.

unit.source: “My wish is for all the demigods present to be lost for three minutes.”
unit.target: “Desiderium meum est, ut omnes semidei praesentes per tres minuta amittantur.”

unit.source: The shadowy cathedral fully collapsed, and darkness engulfed the surroundings, devoid of starlight or boundaries.
unit.target: Cathedral umbrata prorsus corruit, et tenebrae circumiecta obvolutae sunt, carentes luce stellari aut finibus.

unit.source: In the special mirror world, realizing Mr. K could no longer maintain his godhood‑enhanced half‑giant state and Overseer Perle was close to returning to her human form, Lumian’s first instinct was to shape‑shift into a shadow being and flee through the growing rift in the mirror world to find other allies.
unit.target: In mundo speculi speciali, animadvertens Dominum K statum semi‑gigantis divinitate auctum amplius tenere non posse et Supervisorem Perle paene ad formam humanam rediens esse, primus instinctus Lumiani fuit se in ens umbratile converti et per fissuram crescentem mundi speculi fugere, ut alios socios inveniendos haberet.

unit.source: However, he was unsure if Mr. K had employed any mystical items upon entry, and whether Shadow Transformation alone would allow passage through the mirror world’s fissure.
unit.target: Tamen incertus erat an Dominus K ullam rem mysticam ad initium usus fuerit, et an sola umbratilis transformatiō transitum per fissuram mundi speculi permitteret.

unit.source: As Lumian watched Overseer Perle’s face gradually come into view, her eyes and nostrils both vertically misaligned, a sudden realization struck him.
unit.target: Dum Lumian faciem Supervisōris Perle paulatim in conspectum veniens aspiciebat, oculi et nares eius verticaliter disiuncti, subito intellexit.

unit.source: I, too, can wound an Overseer…
unit.target: Ego quoque possum Supervisorem vulnerare…

unit.source: If Mr. K can do it, so can I!
unit.target: Si Dominus K id efficere potest, ita et ego possum!

unit.source: My fate is intertwined with Termiboros.
unit.target: Fatum meum cum Termiboros implicatum est.

unit.source: To a degree, we can be considered one.
unit.target: Ad aliquod modum unum haberi possumus.

unit.source: I’ve long known I possess a fake angelic level!
unit.target: Diu scivi me gradum angelicum falsum possidēre!

unit.source: The powers and items I wield won’t hold godhood and can’t touch an Overseer, but I should be able to do it myself.
unit.target: Virtutes et res quas gero, deitatem non retinebunt neque Supervisorem tangere poterunt; sed credo me ipse id efficere posse.

unit.source: I will become my own weapon!
unit.target: Meum telum ipse fiam!

unit.source: These thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind as a slightly manic grin spread across his face.
unit.target: Haec cogitationes per mentem Lumiani celeriter percurrērunt, dum levis risus manic diffunderetur per faciem eius.

unit.source: His blood seemed to boil, as if set aflame.
unit.target: Sanguis eius quasi ebullīret, velut igni accensus esset.

unit.source: In a flash, he disappeared and reappeared before Overseer Perle.
unit.target: In momento fulgenti, evanuit atque ante Supervisorem Perle iterum apparuit.

unit.source: His eyes had already taken on an iron‑black tint, revealing a few pale spots that marked Perle’s vulnerabilities.
unit.target: Oculi eius iam coloris ferrei nigri ceperant, ostendentes pauca macula pallida, quae vulnerabilitates Perle designabant.

unit.source: One such spot was just below the left side of her face!
unit.target: Una talis macula erat prope sub latere sinistro faciei eius!

unit.source: Before Perle’s shadows could fully reconstruct the Overseer, a multitude of incandescent white flames burst forth from Lumian’s body.
unit.target: Priusquam umbræ Perle plene Supervisorem recomponerent, multitūdo flammarum albarum incandentium ex corpore Lumiani erupit.

unit.source: Like a rushing current, they poured out from Lumian’s eyes, ears, nostrils, mouth, skin, and pores, completely enveloping him, transforming him into a raging inferno.
unit.target: Velut unda impetuosa, ex oculis, auribus, naribus, ore, cute, et poris Lumiani effluentes, eum totum involverunt, transformantes in furibundum ignem.

unit.source: Let’s do this!
unit.target: Agāmus hoc!

unit.source: Let us burn as one!
unit.target: Nos una incendeāmus!

unit.source: Let us explode together!
unit.target: Nos simul erumpāmus!

unit.source: Lumian, now one with the blazing white flames, swung his right fist at Perle’s left cheek.
unit.target: Lumian, iam unum cum flammis albis flagrantibus factus, dextro pugno suo in gena sinistra Perle percussit.

unit.source: Perle’s vertically‑misaligned eyes betrayed a flicker of confusion before understanding dawned.
unit.target: Oculi Perle, verticaliter disiuncti, parvam scintillam confusionis prodiderunt, antequam intellegentia apparuerit.

unit.source: But it was too late for her to protest or react.
unit.target: Sed iam sero erat ut neque protestaret neque responderet.

unit.source: She had not even fully returned.
unit.target: Redierat enim non omnino.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: Lumian’s right fist collided with Perle’s left cheek, caving it in.
unit.target: Pugnum dextro Lumiani cum gena sinistra Perle collidens, eam concavato effingens, percussit.

unit.source: As he struck, a ghastly wound appeared on his own chest and abdomen, but it was quickly consumed by the blazing white flames.
unit.target: Dum percutiebat, vulnus terribile in pectore atque abdomine eius apparuit, sed celeriter a flammis albis ardentibus devoratum est.

unit.source: Perle felt the pain, but it was not a mortal blow.
unit.target: Perle dolorem sensit, sed non fuit ictus mortiferus.

unit.source: At that instant, Lumian’s face, wreathed in blazing white flames, displayed a sinister and frenzied smile.
unit.target: Illo instante, facies Lumiani in flammis albis ardentibus involuta, risum sinistrum et insanum ostendit.

unit.source: It actually works!
unit.target: Revera operatur!

unit.source: I can truly use myself as a weapon to strike an Overseer!
unit.target: Vere me uti possum ut telum ad Supervisorem percutiendum!

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: He detonated his right arm, using the incandescent white flames he had pre‑injected to make it explode.
unit.target: Dextrum brachium suum detonavit, utens flammis albis incandescens, quas antea imposuerat ad id explodendum.

unit.source: His right fist, propelled by a fierce, blazing white wave of flames, pierced Perle’s left cheek and penetrated her skull.
unit.target: Pugnus dextro eius, ab fluctū albis ignis ferociter impulsus, gena sinistra Perle transfixit et cranium eius penetravit.

unit.source: Cull!
unit.target: Cull!

unit.source: Crack! The special mirror world, with its dark barrier and numerous cracks, let out a shattering sound.
unit.target: Crepitus! Mundus speculi specialis, cum obscura barriera et plurimis fissuris, sonum percussivum edidit.

unit.source: It rapidly disintegrated and fell apart.
unit.target: Celeriter dissolutus est et corruit.

unit.source: Lumian’s head took an invisible blow, his skull caving in and teeth falling out.
unit.target: Caput Lumiani per ictum invisibilem affectum est, calvaria eius inruens et dentes eius ceciderunt.

unit.source: Deprived of his right arm, he was hurled through the air, his entire body wreathed in blazing white flames.
unit.target: Dextro brachio carens, per aerem iactatus est, totum corpus eius in flammis albis ardentibus involutum.

unit.source: His face twisted in agony, yet his eyes shone with elation.
unit.target: Facies eius in dolore contorta erat, sed oculi eius exsultatione fulgebant.

unit.source: Success!
unit.target: Successus!

unit.source: He beheld a horrific, blood‑red wound on the left side of Overseer Perle’s face.
unit.target: Vidit vulnus horribile, rubro‑sanguineum, in latere sinistro faciei Supervisōris Perle.

unit.source: Within the wound, a pale‑white fog intermingled with the grayish‑white brain.
unit.target: In vulnere, nebula alba pallida cum cerebro cinereo‑albo intermixta erat.

unit.source: The shattered fist had ripped it asunder and set it ablaze.
unit.target: Pugnus fractus illud discerpsit et incendit.

unit.source: As the blazing white flames faded, Overseer Perle’s remaining right eye dulled, and her body slowly crumpled.
unit.target: Dum flammae albae ardentes evanuerunt, oculus dextro residuus Supervisōris Perle opacus factus est, et corpus eius lente corruit.

unit.source: The cage imprisoning Franca and Jenna quickly disintegrated.
unit.target: Cavea, qua Franca et Jenna inclusae erant, celeriter dissoluta est.

unit.source: Mr. K, observing this, nodded approvingly.
unit.target: Dominus K, hoc observans, laetus annuit.

unit.source: Lumian is like me!
unit.target: Lumian similis mihi est!

unit.source: The fighting style is quite alike!
unit.target: Modus pugnae eius valde similis mihi est!

unit.source: The only shortcoming is that he did not loudly praise the Lord during the final blow.
unit.target: Unum defectum est quod in ictu finali Domini clamore non laudavit.

unit.source: At the same time, Lumian’s head buzzed, and he nearly blacked out.
unit.target: Simul, caput Lumiani fremitavit, et paene sensum amisit.

unit.source: He collapsed to the ground, on the verge of losing consciousness.
unit.target: In terram corruit, prope conscientiam amittens.

unit.source: He managed to stay awake only because he had undergone significant digestion of the Reaper potion.
unit.target: Vigilare potuit solum, quoniam ingentem digestionem potionis Reaper passus est.

unit.source: It felt as if he had completed another massive cull by the ancient tomb during the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Videbatur quasi alteram magnam caedem per antiquam sepulcrum in Festa Somniorum perfecisset.

unit.source: Wh— Lumian was initially thrilled, but then he forced himself to stand, shocked and suspicious.
unit.target: Hem— Lumian initio exhilaratus erat, sed deinde se ad statum coegit, attonitus et suspicāns.

unit.source: He knew the digestion must have resulted from his Culling of Overseer Perle, but shouldn’t a demigod suffice for him to fully digest the Reaper potion?
unit.target: Scivit digestionem ex caede Supervisōris Perle orta esse, sed num non sufficeret semideus ut potionem Reaper plene digereret?

unit.source: Lumian extinguished the incandescent white flames burning within and without.
unit.target: Lumian flammas albas incandescentes, interiores et exteriores, exstinxit.

unit.source: With his left hand, he retrieved the healing agent and Lie earring obtained from Jebus from his Traveler’s Bag, all while examining Overseer Perle’s corpse.
unit.target: Manu sinistra, agentem curativum atque monile “Lie” ab Jebus ex sacco Viatoris adeptum extraxit, dum corpus Supervisōris Perle inspiciebat.

unit.source: Just then, the special mirror world completely collapsed, and they found themselves back in reality, inside the quarry cave with a fixed mirror world entrance.
unit.target: Tandem, mundus speculi specialis prorsus corruit, atque iterum se in re invenērunt, intra speluncam fodinarum, cuius ingressus ad mundum speculi reparatus erat.

unit.source: Next to the protruding rock where Perle had stood, there was no corpse or white fog to be seen.
unit.target: Prope saxum eminentem, ubi Perle steterat, nec corpus nec nebula alba videbatur.

unit.source: Lumian spotted an oil painting hanging on the corresponding rock wall.
unit.target: Lumian deprehendit picturam oleosam suspensam in pariete saxorum conveniens.

unit.source: The painting looked torn and ruined, but one could faintly discern that it had once portrayed a woman in a red dress.
unit.target: Pictura lacerata et devastata videbatur, sed vix intueri poterat quod olim mulierem in veste rubra depinguisset.

unit.source: Perle?
unit.target: Perle?

unit.source: We weren’t facing the true Overseer, but a painted figure she created using a Pixie pathway item?
unit.target: Non verum Supervisorem oppugnabamus, sed figuram pictam, quam ipsa instrumento viae “Pixie Pathway” creaverat?

unit.source: This oil painting grants the depicted demigod a short lifespan, but no freedom of movement?
unit.target: Haec pictura oleosa demideo depingto brevem vitam tribuit, sed nullam libertatem motus concedit?

unit.source: Is that why Perle never budged and always took the attacks head‑on?
unit.target: Numquid ideo Perle numquam se movit et semper impetus directe sustinuit?

unit.source: Amid his bewilderment, Lumian drank the healing agent Jebus had procured from the Great Mother’s followers to ensure he would survive past 6 a.m.
unit.target: Inter sua stupefacta, Lumian agentem curativum a sectatoribus Magnae Matris a Jebus adeptum potavit, ut ultra horam sextam ante meridiem superesset.

unit.source: At that moment, Perle’s smiling voice resonated from the depths of the shattered oil painting.
unit.target: Illo momento, vox subridens Perle ex profundis picturae oleosae fractae resonavit.

unit.source: “I didn’t anticipate my painting person failing.
unit.target: “Non praevidi personam meam pictam deficere.

unit.source: But no matter.
unit.target: Sed nihil refert.

unit.source: What’s important is that the vortex is about to manifest.
unit.target: Id quod maximum est, est quod vortex mox manifestabitur.

unit.source: It won’t be long before you’re officially consumed.
unit.target: Non longum erit, antequam vere consumberis.”

unit.source: “Everyone will be caught up in it…”
unit.target: “Omnes in eo inclusi erunt…"

unit.source: Perle’s voice gradually faded into the depths of the oil painting, thwarting Mr. K’s attempt to track her through teleportation.
unit.target: Vox Perle paulatim in profundum picturae oleosae evanuit, frustrans conatum Domini K eam per teleportationem deprehendere.

unit.source: 735 I Have Sinned
unit.target: 735 Peccavi

unit.source: The healing agent’s effects and the incineration of the original flames had largely stemmed the bleeding from Lumian’s wounds.
unit.target: Effectus medicamenti curativi et incineratio flammarum originariarum sanguinem ex vulneribus Lumiani paene cohibuerunt.

unit.source: Flesh and blood had even started to regrow and form scabs over his skin.
unit.target: Caro et sanguis etiam denuo crescere et crustas super cutem eius formarent.

unit.source: Putting on the Lie earring, Lumian tried to shift the gruesome hole in his chest and abdomen to a less vital location.
unit.target: Auriculam mendacem induens, Lumian conatus est transferre horrendum foramen in pectore et abdomine ad locum minus vitalem.

unit.source: As he did so, he stared intently at the oil painting hanging on the rocky wall, his thoughts racing.
unit.target: Dum hoc faciebat, intente aspexit picturam oleariam in pariete saxo pendentem, dum cogitationes eius festinanter currerent.

unit.source: As an Overseer, Perle is unlikely to directly engage in combat herself?
unit.target: Ut Praefecta, num Perle vere se in pugnam directe immittet?

unit.source: Has her true form been lurking in the shadows this whole time to avoid any potential mishaps?
unit.target: Num vera forma eius per totum hoc tempus in umbris latebat, ne quid eveniret?

unit.source: But if she had personally intervened, perhaps we would have been defeated long ago, with no chance for any slip-ups…
unit.target: Sed si ipsa personaliter intervenisset, forsitan iam pridem superati fuissemus, sine ullis occasionibus erroris.

unit.source: Furthermore, Perle doesn’t appear overly concerned about capturing me alive.
unit.target: Praeterea, Perle non videtur nimis sollicitus de me in vita capiundo.

unit.source: Doesn’t the failure of her painting version indicate that the Under the Table deal she initiated didn’t meet the requirements?
unit.target: Num defectus eius versionis pictae non indicat quod foedus "sub mensa", quod ipsa incepit, requisitis non satisfecerit?

unit.source: She’s bound to face severe consequences for that in the future.
unit.target: Illa certissime severas consequentias in futurum pati debebit.

unit.source: It’s not as if she’s a fraud…
unit.target: Non enim quasi mendax sit…

unit.source: Coming to this realization, Lumian suddenly came up with a guess:
unit.target: Hoc intellegens, Lumian subito coniecturam fecit:

unit.source: Perle was the sole person to mention capturing me alive.
unit.target: Perle sola fuit quae de me in vita capiendum meminit.

unit.source: There’s no other evidence to support it…
unit.target: Nulla alia testimonia id comprobare possunt…

unit.source: While this may indeed be a request from the other party in the Under the Table transaction, it’s probably not the only one.
unit.target: Etsi hoc quidem posset esse petitio ex parte altera negotii "sub mensa", probabiliter non est sola.

unit.source: It’s likely one of multiple requests and the least critical.
unit.target: Videtur inter multas petitiones esse et momentum eius minimum esse.

unit.source: That’s why, after creating the special mirror world, Perle immediately left this painting behind, allowing her painting version to handle us while she went off elsewhere.
unit.target: Ideo, postquam mundum speculi specialem creavit, Perle statim hanc picturam reliquit, sinens ut eius versio picta de nobis curaret, dum ipsa alibi pergebat.

unit.source: Was she going to carry out the most vital and important requirement?
unit.target: Num illa intendebat exsequi exigentiam maxime vitalem et gravissimam?

unit.source: I can’t fully trust a Broker’s words either…
unit.target: Ego etiam verbis Brokeris non penitus confido…

unit.source: Based on her tone, she seems to have succeeded.
unit.target: Ex tono eius videtur se feliciter obtinuisse.

unit.source: This strongly suggests she’s confident the vortex is on the brink of taking shape.
unit.target: Hoc firmiter indicat eam confidere quod vortex iam in limine formationis sit.

unit.source: It won’t be long before it entraps everyone…
unit.target: Non diutius erit, ut omnes implicet…

unit.source: Apparently, she wasn’t in the vicinity at all.
unit.target: Apparet illa omnino in vicinitate non adfuisse.

unit.source: She merely used the link to her painting self to briefly speak remotely before vanishing completely.
unit.target: Ipsa tantum nexum ad imaginem suam pictam usus est ut brevi sermonem remoto faceret antequam penitus evanuerit.

unit.source: We have no way to track her.
unit.target: Nobis nullus modus est eam detegere.

unit.source: Lumian felt his theory could account for Perle’s actions and certain details from the prior battle.
unit.target: Lumian sensit theoriam suam posse explicare facta Perlei et aliqua notabilia proelio pristino.

unit.source: This realization made his heart sink.
unit.target: Haec revelatio cor eius deprimere fecit.

unit.source: If his suspicions were correct, the School of Truth’s vortex hadn’t been successfully halted and was about to manifest!
unit.target: Si suspiones eius recte fuerint, vortex Scholae Veritatis non reposita est sed manifestari iam parabat!

unit.source: What would transpire after some time had passed?
unit.target: Quid eveniretur post aliquod tempus lapsum?

unit.source: Right then, Mr. K approached Lumian, his gaze locked on the tattered oil painting.
unit.target: Tum statim, Dominus K ad Lumian accessit, oculos in picturam oleariam laceratam fixos habens.

unit.source: In a hoarse voice, he spoke, “I have sinned. I failed to discover the School of Truth’s scheme beforehand, letting the issue escalate until it was on the verge of erupting.”
unit.target: Voce rauca dixit: "Peccavi. Defui consilium Scholae Veritatis prius deprehendere, sinens rem crescere usque ad limen erumpendi pervenire."

unit.source: As he talked, the flesh on Mr. K’s shoulders writhed, and two pale, slender, damp arms gradually grew out.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, caro super humeros Domini K contorquebatur, et duo pallida, gracilia, umida brachia paulatim creverunt.

unit.source: The black robe, its sleeves severed, was beyond repair.
unit.target: Habitus niger, cui manicae discerpta erant, ultra reparari non poterat.

unit.source: Not waiting for Lumian to respond, Mr. K turned his head and said, “The disturbance here will soon be noticed. We shouldn’t stay. Meet me tomorrow morning.”
unit.target: Nondum exspectans responsionem Lumiani, Mr. K vertit caput et dixit: "Hic tumultus mox notabitur. Non manere debemus. Cras mane mecum convenite."

unit.source: “Got it.” Lumian glanced at his companions, who had concealed themselves in the shadows or used Psychological Invisibility, and nodded subtly.
unit.target: “Intelligo.” Lumian conspexit socios suos, qui in umbris se celaverant aut invisibilitate psychologica utebantur, et leniter caput nutavit.

unit.source: He also intended to head to the safe house as quickly as possible to avoid any accidental attacks by official Beyonders.
unit.target: Etiam destinavit quam celerrime ad domum tutam pervenire, ne quid inopinatum a officialibus Beyonders incideret.

unit.source: Once Mr. K teleported away, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony came out of hiding.
unit.target: Postquam Mr. K teleporteravit, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony ex latebris exierunt.

unit.source: “We should get back to the safe house now,” Lumian said decisively.
unit.target: “Ad domum tutam nunc redire debemus,” Lumian firmiter dixit.

unit.source: Franca nodded and said with regret and sorrow, “I wonder where Pride Armor was sent. It would be such a shame if we truly lost it.”
unit.target: Franca capite nutavit et cum maerore dixit: "Miror quo misit Armaturam Superbiae. Dolendum esset, si vere eam amisimus."

unit.source: If Pride Armor hadn’t hit Overseer Perle’s painted self, compelling her to alter her life form and indirectly making the transformed Punishers disappear, even if Lumian could have still found a way to lure out the Islander swindler, Monette, they wouldn’t have survived the following stages.
unit.target: Si Armatura Superbiae non percussisset imaginem pictam Perlei, quae eam coegit formam vitae mutare et indirecte efficit ut Poenatores transformati evanuerent, et etiamsi Lumian viam invenisset ad decipiendum fraudatorem insularum, Monette, non supervissent gradus sequentis.

unit.source: In that case, he would face not only Perle’s punishment but also Anthony’s Punisher.
unit.target: In hoc casu, non solum poena Perlei, sed etiam Punitorem Anthoni, ei immineret.

unit.source: For Lumian and the others, Pride Armor had performed exceptionally; it was a Sealed Artifact of tremendous value.
unit.target: Pro Lumiano et ceteris, Armatura Superbiae eximie perfuncta erat; erat artefactum sigillatum ingentis pretii.

unit.source: Nobody wanted it to be lost.
unit.target: Nemo voluit ut illud perderetur.

unit.source: “If it were human and smart, it could find its way back. But now…” Lumian sighed, grasping Anthony’s shoulder with his left hand.
unit.target: “Si esset humanum et sapientem, viam reverteri posset. Sed nunc…” Lumian suspiravit, apprehendens humerum Anthoni sinistra manu.

unit.source: Suddenly, dazzling starlight emerged from the void, rapidly forming a dreamlike door.
unit.target: Subito, lux siderea fulgida ex vacuo emersit, celeriter formans ianuam somniorum similem.

unit.source: The door opened, and out came Magician, Judgment, and Hermit.
unit.target: Ianuam aperta, et ex ea egressi sunt Magus, Iudicium, et Eremita.

unit.source: Surveying the scene, Magician noticed Lumian’s dire condition, one arm missing.
unit.target: Contemplans scenam, Magus animadvertit conditionem direm Lumiani, cui unum brachium defuerat.

unit.source: With an odd expression, she asked, “You were attacked?”
unit.target: Cum vultu insolito, illa quaesivit: "Oppugnatus es?"

unit.source: As she spoke, the quarry cave, lit solely by the carbide lamp’s glow, darkened, as if an unseen curtain had been pulled around it.
unit.target: Dum illa loquebatur, spelunca, sola luce lampadis carbidici illustrata, obscurata est, quasi velum invisibile circa eam traheretur.

unit.source: “Yes,” Franca replied on behalf of Lumian, who had only gained enough reprieve from his injuries to avoid imminent death.
unit.target: “Ita,” Franca respondit pro Lumiano, qui modo satis remissionem vulnerum suorum adeptus erat, ne mortem imminentem afficeret.

unit.source: She concisely recounted the whole situation.
unit.target: Enarravit breviter totam rem.

unit.source: “The one who attacked you came from Perle’s painted self. Her true form departed to do something else?” Magician sought confirmation.
unit.target: “Qui te oppugnaverat, ex imagine picta Perlei venit; vera forma eius discessit ad aliquid faciendum?” Magus confirmationem petivit.

unit.source: “That appears to be the case,” Lumian responded.
unit.target: “Ita videtur,” Lumian respondit.

unit.source: Magician exchanged glances with Judgment and Hermit, their eyes meeting without hiding their bewilderment.
unit.target: Magus oculos cum Iudicio et Eremita commutavit, quorum oculi conveniebant, nec celabant stupefactionem.

unit.source: After a short pause, Magician offered no explanation.
unit.target: Post breve silentium, Magus nullam explicationem dedit.

unit.source: Starlight gathered in her eyes, as if tracing a pattern.
unit.target: Lux siderum in oculis eius congregata est, quasi figuram describeret.

unit.source: A gentle rain fell, soaking Lumian’s body and fully healing his wounds.
unit.target: Pluvia lenis cecidit, corpus Lumiani impregnans et vulnera eius plene sanavit.

unit.source: Nourished by the rain, Franca and the others felt their weariness melt away.
unit.target: Alimentati pluvia, Franca et ceteri sensit lassitudinem suam evanescere.

unit.source: It closely resembles the power Madame Night used in the dream… Lumian drew a connection.
unit.target: Similitudinem habet virtutis, quam Domina Nox in somnio usus est… Lumian coniunctionem traxit.

unit.source: Magician nodded and instructed, “Provide me the details in writing tomorrow.”
unit.target: Magus nutavit capite et inquit: "Crastino die mihi in scriptis singula reddas."

unit.source: With that, she disappeared along with Judgment and Hermit.
unit.target: Hoc facto, illa simul cum Iudicio et Eremita evanuit.

unit.source: As the darkness around them lifted, Lumian realized they had returned to the safe house in the administrative district, where Jenna had summoned Judgment’s messenger.
unit.target: Cum tenebrae circa eos sublevatae essent, Lumian intellexit eos ad domum tutam in regione administrativa rediisse, ubi Jenna nuntium Iudicii vocaverat.

unit.source: “Madam Magician and the others are perplexed that we were attacked by Perle’s painting self,” Anthony remarked while putting away the blank painting collection, voicing his thoughts.
unit.target: “Domina Magus et ceteri perplexi sunt quod a imagine picta Perlei aggressi simus,” Anthony dixit, dum collectionem picturarum inanarum reponeret.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “What’s perplexing shouldn’t be Perle attacking us. It’s not unusual for an Overseer with an Under the Table transaction at the heart of it all to do something like that.”
unit.target: Lumian nutavit capite et respondit: "Id quod perplexum facit non debet esse per se, ut Perle nos oppugnet. Non est insolitum ut Praefecta, cum foedo 'sub mensa' contracto, talem rem agat."

unit.source: “So what were they perplexed about?” Jenna and Franca couldn’t figure out an answer.
unit.target: “De quo ergo erant perplexi?” Jenna et Franca responsum invenire non potuerunt.

unit.source: Anthony tried to analyze the situation.
unit.target: Anthony conatus est rem analysare.

unit.source: “They’re not perplexed by Perle’s attack itself, but why we were targeted by her painted self specifically.
unit.target: “Non ipsa Perle oppugnatione sunt perplexi, sed cur speciatim a imagine picta eius nos petierit.

unit.source: “They seem to think we wouldn’t be attacked by Perle directly. Whether she had such intentions or acted on them is irrelevant.”
unit.target: Videtur illis esse cogitandum nos non a Perle directe oppugnatos futuros esse. Sive illa talia propositum habuerit, sive egerit, nihil refert.”

unit.source: Lumian and the others became lost in thought.
unit.target: Lumian et ceteri in cogitatione amersi sunt.

unit.source: Abruptly, Franca exclaimed.
unit.target: Subito, Franca exclamavit.

unit.source: Looking at Lumian and the others, she slowly withdrew her hand from her Traveler’s Bag in astonishment.
unit.target: Intuens in Lumian et ceteros, manus sua ex sacculo Viatoris lente se recepit, stupens.

unit.source: “Pride Armor is in here. It’s returned!”
unit.target: “Armatura Superbiae hic est. Rediit!”

unit.source: “Did Madam Magician help locate it?” As this thought crossed Lumian’s mind, he noticed Franca’s actions.
unit.target: “Num Domina Magus adiuvit ut eam inveniret?” Hac cogitatione Luminum, Francae actiones animadvertit.

unit.source: He instantly shouted, “Stop!”
unit.target: Statim exclamavit: "Siste!"

unit.source: He couldn’t allow Franca to retrieve the Pride Armor!
unit.target: Non poterat Francam sinere ut Armaturam Superbiae recuperaret!

unit.source: This is a confined room, and I’m present!
unit.target: Hoc conclave est restrictum, et ego adsum!

unit.source: Franca’s expression froze, and she immediately stopped moving her elbow.
unit.target: Vultus Francae congelatus est, et statim motum cubiti eius cessavit.

unit.source: In the mirror world created by dark void tunnels, Overseer Perle continuously moved from mirror to mirror, searching for her final destination.
unit.target: In mundo speculi, creato per tenebrosos tunelos vacui, Praefecta Perle continue se movebat ab speculo ad speculum, ultimam destinationem quaerens.

unit.source: Her expression stayed calm, thrilled that the calamity had instead accelerated the vortex’s formation.
unit.target: Vultus eius manebat placidus, exsultans quod calamitas formationem vortex acceleraverit.

unit.source: On the other side of the dark, vacant tunnel, a vibrant ball of yarn quietly trailed her, leaving a concealed path.
unit.target: In altera parte tuneli obscuri et vacui, globus vivax lanae eam silentio secutus est, viam occultam relinquit.

unit.source: The next morning, having sent the letter to Magician, Lumian reached Psychic’s headquarters and met Mr. K in the basement.
unit.target: Die sequenti mane, epistolam ad Magum missam, Lumian sedem Psychici attigit et in hypogaeo cum Mr. K convenit.

unit.source: Both their limbs had been restored.
unit.target: Utrorumque membrorum restituta erant.

unit.source: Clad in an enormous hood and black robe, Mr. K disregarded this.
unit.target: Indutus ingenti cuculla et toga nigra, Mr. K hoc neglexit.

unit.source: In a grating voice, he told Lumian, “Come with me somewhere.”
unit.target: Voce aspera, Mr. K dixit: "Veni mecum alicubi."

unit.source: “For what purpose?” Lumian’s demeanor toward Mr. K had become more at ease after their collaboration the previous night.
unit.target: “Ad quid hoc?” Lumian inquit, quoniam eius habitus erga Mr. K post praeteritam nocturnam cooperationem mitigatus esset.

unit.source: Mr. K nodded and explained, “First, I wish to atone for this incident. Second, through the idol, I want to notify the Lord that you’ve grown and can serve as His envoy. He will make preparations when the moment is right. Have faith in the Lord, and trust Him completely.”
unit.target: Mr. K nutavit et explicavit: "Primum, pro hoc casu veniam expiare volo. Secundo, per idolum, Dominum certiorem facere volo te crevisse et pro eius legato fungi posse. Ipse praeparabit, cum tempus id aptum erit. In Domino crede et Eum penitus confide."

unit.source: Just going to a location with the True Creator’s idol? That’s okay… It would be problematic if I actually had to encounter a god… Lumian bowed his head humbly and said, “It would be my honor.”
unit.target: Ad locum cum idolum Veri Creatoris pergere? Bene est… Incommodum esset, si vere deum obviam ire debeam… Lumian humiliter inclinavit caput et dixit: "Mihi honos esset."

unit.source: Mr. K came up to him, grasped his arm, and transported him into the spirit world via teleportation.
unit.target: Mr. K ad eum accessit, brachium eius arripuit, et eum per viam teleportationis in mundum spirituum transtulit.

unit.source: Traversing dense layers of colors and innumerable indescribable transparent beings, the pair arrived at a cathedral.
