unit.target: Transiens densas stratas colorum et innumerabilia entia translucida inenarrabilia, par tandem ad catedralem pervenerunt.

unit.source: The cathedral seemed to be located in a deep valley.
unit.target: Cathedrale videbatur in valle profunda situm esse.

unit.source: Its surface was a watery black, decorated with many human bones.
unit.target: Superficies eius erat aquosus niger, multis ossibus humanis ornata.

unit.source: The top resembled the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s cathedral, forming a hemispherical shape.
unit.target: Summum eius simile erat catedrali Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum, figuram hemisphaericam formans.

unit.source: Mr. K silently entered through the open door, his back slightly hunched.
unit.target: Mr. K silentio per ianuam apertam intravit, tergo paulo incurvato.

unit.source: Lumian followed closely behind.
unit.target: Lumian proxime secutus est.

unit.source: Then, he saw the vast but dimly lit prayer hall and an enormous, pitch‑black cross standing in the cathedral’s depths.
unit.target: Tum vidit amplum sed vix lucentem conclave orationis et immensum crucem nigerrimum in profundis cathedralis stantem.

unit.source: A naked male idol hung upside down from the cross.
unit.target: Idolum masculinum nudum a cruci versa pendebat.

unit.source: Rust-colored iron nails jutted out from various parts of its body, each nail stained with vivid red blood.
unit.target: Clavi ferrei rubiginosi ex variis partibus corporis eius protruebantur, singuli sanguine rubeo vividis tincti.

unit.source: Is this the True Creator’s idol? Lumian’s heart raced as he quickly averted his gaze.
unit.target: Num hoc est idolum Veri Creatoris? Cor Lumiani palpitabat, et celeriter oculos avertit.

unit.source: What he had seen in the Church of The Fool, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and the God of Steam and Machinery Church were merely Sacred Emblems.
unit.target: Quae viderat in Ecclesia Stulti, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammarum, et Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, nihil aliud erant quam Emblema Sacra.

unit.source: There were no idols.
unit.target: Nulla idola erant.

unit.source: He had assumed Mr. K was referring to the Sacred Emblem as an idol.
unit.target: Existimaverat Mr. K referre ad Emblema Sacrum tamquam idolum.

unit.source: Mr. K walked until he was four to five meters from the idol and halted.
unit.target: Mr. K processit usque ad quattuor vel quinque metra ab idolo, deinde cessavit.

unit.source: Lumian trailed slightly behind and stopped.
unit.target: Lumian paulo post eum sequebatur et subsedit.

unit.source: As he made his way from the entrance, he got a clear look at the hanging idol’s face.
unit.target: Dum ex introitu procedebat, lucide vultum idoli pendentis conspexit.

unit.source: Its nose, mouth, and ears were quite blurry, with only a rough outline.
unit.target: Nasus, os, et aures eius plane obscuri erant, tantum lineamenta rudia exhibebant.

unit.source: However, its eyes were very distinct and tightly closed, as if enduring all the pain and guilt.
unit.target: Tamen oculi eius valde distincti erant et strictissime clausi, quasi totum dolorem et culpam ferre deberent.

unit.source: Mr. K drew a cross on his chest and cried out in a raspy voice, “Praise you! Praise you for creating everything! Praise you for shouldering the world’s sins!”
unit.target: Mr. K in pectore suo crucem delineavit et voce rauca exclamavit: "Laudare te! Laudare te pro omni creatione tua! Laudare te quod mundi peccata suscepisti!"

unit.source: Lumian followed suit in offering praise.
unit.target: Lumian similiter laudem obtulit.

unit.source: Abruptly, his head spun, and his eyes burned with a sense of familiarity.
unit.target: Subito, caput eius vertit, et oculi eius ardere coeperunt cum sensu familiaritatis.

unit.source: Wh— Lumian’s spiritual intuition alerted him that the negative effects of the Baynfel contract had been triggered.
unit.target: Quid— Intuitio spiritualis Lumiani eum monuit effectus negativos contractus Baynfel excitatos esse.

unit.source: The effect was: In scenes intimately connected to Baynfel’s past, he would witness truths better left unknown.
unit.target: Effectus fuit: in scaenae, quae intime ad praeterita Baynfel pertinent, veritates perspiceret, quae melius ignota manerent.

unit.source: This place is closely tied to Baynfel’s past? Was he once a clergyman of the True Creator?
unit.target: Hic locus intime ad praeteritum Baynfel connexus est? Num olim clericus Veri Creatoris fuerit?

unit.source: Lumian suppressed his curiosity as he continued to focus on the ground.
unit.target: Lumian curiositatem suam repressit, dum in terram intuebatur.

unit.source: Suddenly, his eyes froze.
unit.target: Subito, oculi eius congelaverunt.

unit.source: He spotted a blurry, lizard‑like creature.
unit.target: Animadvertit creaturam confusam, lacertae similem.

unit.source: It was the lizard‑like elf that had appeared in his dream about Cordu.
unit.target: Erat ille elfus, lacertae similis, qui in somnio de Cordu apparuerat.

unit.source: The same one that had crawled out of Aurore’s mouth!
unit.target: Idem qui ex ore Aurorae evasit!

unit.source: It might have influenced Aurore, stopping her from seeking Hela’s help in time!
unit.target: Fortasse Aurorem influerit, eam prohibens ut auxilium Helae tempore quaereret!

unit.source: At the conclusion of the Tree of Shadow incident, the lizard‑like elf had also made an appearance.
unit.target: Ad finem incidentis Arboris Umbrae, ille elfus, lacertae similis quoque apparuit.

unit.source: Why was it present now, in the True Creator’s cathedral?
unit.target: Cur nunc aderat in catedrali Veri Creatoris?

unit.source: As Mr. K sprawled on the ground, pressing his face firmly against the watery black stone bricks, Lumian instinctively looked up.
unit.target: Dum Mr. K in terra iacebat, faciem suam firmiter contra lateres lapideos nigros aquosos prementem, Lumian instinctu surrexit.

unit.source: He witnessed the huge pitch‑black cross transform into an illusory shape, as if it loomed over a mountain range’s peak.
unit.target: Vidit magnum crucem nigerrimum in formam illusoriam mutari, quasi super culmen montanum eminentem.

unit.source: On the indistinct figure hanging upside down, lizard‑like elves crawled in and out, circling and dancing…
unit.target: In figura indistincta versa, elfi lacertae similes in et ex subambulabant, circulantes atque saltantes…

unit.source: Lumian watched the scene in a daze as Mr. K’s slightly muffled voice resounded in his ears.
unit.target: Lumian scenam in attonitione contemplabatur, dum vox modice submissa Mr. K in auribus eius resonabat.

unit.source: “Oh, merciful Father, I implore your mercy for the transgressions I’ve made.”
unit.target: “O, misericors Pater, veniam tuam pro delictis meis imploro.”

unit.source: End of Volume—Sinner
unit.target: Finis Voluminis—Peccator

unit.source: 736 Night
unit.target: 736 Noctis

unit.source: Can you accept such an outcome?
unit.target: Potesne talem exitum accipere?

unit.source: Inside an empty house in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Angoulême de François, wearing a lion headdress, stood by the window, gazing down at the gas streetlamps below, patiently waiting.
unit.target: Intra domum vacuam in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Angoulême de François, in capite leonino ornatus, ad fenestram stetit, lumina gasica in via deorsum inspiciens, patienter exspectans.

unit.source: After losing contact, he and Hidden Blade had switched emergency communication methods. They aimed to quickly re-establish contact, even without Madame Hela’s messenger.
unit.target: Postquam communicationem amiserat, ipse et Hidden Blade modos communicationis subitanei mutaverant. Celeriter contactum restituere intendebant, etiam sine nuntio Dominae Helae.

unit.source: Early the previous morning, as soon as he had wrapped up the Moran Avigny case, he immediately tried to locate Hidden Blade.
unit.target: Mane dīē prīmō, simul ac negotium de Moran Avigny confecerat, statim conatus est Hidden Blade invenire.

unit.source: Finally, Hidden Blade Franca, dressed in her assassin outfit, emerged from the shadows.
unit.target: Denique Hidden Blade Franca, vestita habitu sicario, ex umbris apparuit.

unit.source: Angoulême cut right to it and asked, “Did you take down Moran Avigny?”
unit.target: Angoulême ad rem pervenit et rogavit: “Moran Avigny interfectus es?”

unit.source: “Otherwise?” Franca replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Alioquin?” Franca subrisu respondit.

unit.source: Although Overseer Perle’s vortex warning hung over Franca’s head like a sharp blade, preventing her from relaxing just because Moran Avigny was dead and she had the intel, Franca wouldn’t let it ruin her mood or make her solemn or anxious.
unit.target: Quamquam monitum vortex Perlae super caput Francae pendebat, velut aculeus acutus, qui eam non sineret solum quia Moran Avigny mortuus esset et notitiam obtineret, Franca non sineret animum suum deprimere aut eam gravem atque anxiam reddere.

unit.source: The Major Arcana card holders would naturally worry about something so serious, and she and the others just needed to follow orders and complete the missions. No point fretting.
unit.target: Possessores chartarum Major Arcana naturaliter de rebus tam gravibus solliciti erant, atque illa cum ceteris modo mandata sequi et missiones perficere debebant. Nulla est causa sollicitandi.

unit.source: Plus, the intel they obtained was crucial and valuable. Either the Eternal Blazing Sun Church or the Demoness Sect would definitely be grateful!
unit.target: Praeterea, notitia quam obtinerunt erat crucialis atque pretiosa. Aut Ecclesia Solis Aeternae Incandens aut Secta Daemonum certe grata erit!

unit.source: Franca was filled with anticipation over this.
unit.target: Franca ex illa ratione exspectatione plena erat.

unit.source: “It really was you guys…” Angoulême couldn’t help but sigh.
unit.target: “Revera vos fuistis…” inquit Angoulême, nec potuit non suspirare.

unit.source: Hidden Blade and her team really acted fast. They had mentioned dealing with a government minister, and not long after, they actually attacked and succeeded.
unit.target: Hidden Blade et turma eius vere celeriter agnoverant. Ministerium regiminis tractandum memoraverant, et non multo postea oppugnaverunt et successerunt.

unit.source: Franca covered for Lumian, saying, “We were waiting for Moran Avigny to walk into the mirror himself. Surprisingly, the Aurora Order suddenly assassinated him, forcing him into our trap early.”
unit.target: Franca pro Lumiano excusavit, dicens: “Exspectabamus ut Moran Avigny ipse in speculum intraret. Mirum in modum, Ordo Aurorae eum subito interemit, coegens eum in insidias nostras mane incidere.”

unit.source: Combined with the scene details, Angoulême slightly nodded and said, “So it was just a coincidence…”
unit.target: Coniunctis rebus scaeniciis, Angoulême leviter annuit et dixit: “Ita, hoc solum fortuitum fuit…”

unit.source: This aligned with what the Purifiers had confirmed.
unit.target: Hoc congruebat cum quod Purificatores confirmaverant.

unit.source: Angoulême then asked, “So where’s Moran Avigny now?”
unit.target: Deinde Angoulême rogavit: “Ergo, ubi nunc est Moran Avigny?”

unit.source: “Dead,” Franca said with a tongue click. “He was definitely a Mirror Person, and gave us lots of important intel.”
unit.target: “Mortuus,” inquit Franca, simul et lingua percussa; “Certe homo specularis fuit, atque nobis multam notitiam pretiosam dedit.”

unit.source: “What intel?” Angoulême quickly asked.
unit.target: “Quam notitiam?” statim Angoulême rogavit.

unit.source: Franca chuckled and raised her right hand, gently rubbing her thumb and index finger together. “Where’s my informant fee?”
unit.target: Franca subridens manum dexteram levavit, leniter pollicem et indicem inter se frotans, et inquit: “Ubi est praemium meum?”

unit.source: Angoulême said in exasperated amusement, “Don’t forget I contributed a lot to the Moran Avigny operation. Even if I don’t get spoils, it’s no problem to hear the intel, right?”
unit.target: Angoulême, vexato sed laeto, dixit: “Ne obliviscaris me ad rem Moran Avigny multum contulisse. Etiamsi praeda mihi non tradita sit, audire notitiam nihil impedit, nonne?”

unit.source: Franca, who always prided herself on fairly “splitting loot,” awkwardly cleared her throat.
unit.target: Franca, quae semper in aequa praedarum divisione se gloriabat, infauste guttur purgavit.

unit.source: “Just kidding. Just kidding. But that intel is super important. Your superior will definitely reward you. Don’t forget to help me collect my fee!”
unit.target: “Modo iocus erat. Modo iocus erat. Sed notitia illa est valde momenti. Superior tuus certe te remunerabit. Ne obliviscaris me adiuvare ut praemium meum colligam!”

unit.source: “Get to the point,” Angoulême replied in a deep voice.
unit.target: Angoulême respondit voce profunda: “Ad rem veni.”

unit.source: It wasn’t that he was stingy about the fee, but Hidden Blade had twice emphasized how crucial the intel was, making him eager.
unit.target: Non enim id erat quod de praemio parsimonia ageret, sed Hidden Blade bis extolliverat quantum notitia esset praecipua, id quod eum excitavit.

unit.source: Franca omitted Tarot Club and Aurora Order details, but started from capturing Jebus to Overseer Perle’s painted self appearing and Lumian’s theory about the whole situation.
unit.target: Franca de notis de Tarot Club et Ordo Aurorae omisit, sed narrationem ab apprehensione Jebus usque ad apparitionem pictam Overseer Perlae atque ad theoriam Lumiani de tota re incipere coepit.

unit.source: Initially, Angoulême stayed relatively composed. Mirror People problems barely factored into Purifier expectations. But when Moran Avigny was tricked into revealing Roselle Gustav led the Mirror People, Angoulême’s head started buzzing louder and louder.
unit.target: Initio, Angoulême paulo compositus mansit. Quaestiones de hominibus specularibus vix in exspectationibus Purificatorum habebantur. Sed cum Moran Avigny decipiebatur ut revelaret Roselle Gustav, ducem hominum specularum, caput eius magis ac magis vibrari coepit.

unit.source: Why do Hidden Blade and the others always get mixed up in such major situations?
unit.target: Cur Hidden Blade et ceteri semper in talibus rebus gravibus implicantur?

unit.source: How long has it been since the Hostel incident? Why is there another “vortex”?
unit.target: Quamdiu ab incidente Hostel praeteriit? Cur alius “vortex” apparuit?

unit.source: After Franca finished, Angoulême couldn’t help but raise his right hand and pinch his throbbing, headdress-concealed forehead. His emotions were so scrambled he was speechless.
unit.target: Postquam Franca finivit, Angoulême manum dexteram levavit et frontem, sub ornatu celatam atque pulsante, premeo; animi eius motus tam confusi erant ut nihil diceret.

unit.source: Franca smugly asked, “How’s that? Project Vortex, the Mirror People, and intel about a hidden traitor—pretty important stuff, right?”
unit.target: Franca superba rogavit: “Quid agitur? Projectum Vortex, homines speculares, atque notitia de latente proditore—res potissimum momenti, nonne?”

unit.source: Noticing Angoulême’s grave gaze and slightly moving, teeth-grinding mouth, Franca instinctively added, “Don’t blame me! We’re not causing these problems, Trier’s just uniquely prone to all kinds of chaos. We’re victims too!”
unit.target: Animadvertens Angoulême vultum grave et os paulum mobile, dentes stridentes, Franca instinctive addidit: “Noli me culpare! Non nos has difficultates inferimus; Trier solum ad omnia tumulta destinata est. Et nos victimae sumus!”

unit.source: Angoulême slowly exhaled and said, “I’ll… submit this intel… tonight. I won’t forget to pass along my informant’s reward request. What do you want?”
unit.target: Angoulême paulatim suspiravit et dixit: “Hanc notitiam hac nocte tradam. Non obliviscar adferre petitionem praemii informatorii meae. Quid vis?”

unit.source: At the mention of “tonight,” Angoulême’s emotions surged and he paused a moment.
unit.target: Ad dictum “hac nocte”, animi Angoulême impetu surrexerunt et paulisper subsistens fuit.

unit.source: He had just finished his workday an hour ago and left Saint Viève Cathedral. Now he had to return!
unit.target: Iam operam diei finivit et a Cathedralia Sanctae Viève discessit. Nunc redire debet!

unit.source: I’m Agent 007, not some societal slave working from midnight to midnight every damn day! Angoulême inwardly cursed, but still appeared calm, reliable, and emotionally stable.
unit.target: Ego sum Agens 007, non aliquis servus socialis qui ab media nocte ad mediam noctem omni die laborat! Angoulême interno maledixit, sed tamen apparuit placidus, fidēlis, atque animi constanti.

unit.source: Franca deeply pondered and said, “All the Pleasure potion ingredients.”
unit.target: Franca alte meditata est et dixit: “Omnia ingredientia potionis Voluptatis.”

unit.source: She had considered her Affliction potion could be rewarded by the Demoness Sect, but not Jenna’s. She could only rely on the authorities.
unit.target: Putaeā potionem Affliction suam a Secta Daemonum remunerari posse – sed non Jennae – solum in auctoritatibus confidere poterat.

unit.source: “Aren’t you already at Pleasure?” Angoulême muttered, giving up asking. He nodded, “I’ll help get it.”
unit.target: “Nonne iam in Voluptate es?” Angoulême submurmuravit, quaestionem relinquens. Deinde annuit: “Adiuvabo ut eam obtineam.”

unit.source: He didn’t ask about Hidden Blade’s Pleasure potion preparations, just as he didn’t ask how she and her crew survived facing a demigod’s painted self.
unit.target: Non quaesivit de praeparationibus potionis Voluptatis Hidden Blade, sicut nec interrogavit quomodo illa et turma eius superaverint se adversus demigodum se pictum.

unit.source: Franca was overjoyed at 007’s promise.
unit.target: Franca exsultabat ob promissum Agentis 007.

unit.source: Getting Pleasure from the Church and Affliction from the Demoness Sect, surely Madam Judgment would reward me too. I sold this one intel three times… I can now understand Lumian’s glee at triple-dipping mission rewards!
unit.target: Ex Ecclesia Voluptatem ac ex Secta Daemonum Afflictionem obtinendo, certissime Domina Judgment quoque mihi remunerabit. Notitiam hanc ter vendidi… nunc intelligere possum laetitiam Lumiani propter missionum triplicem praemiationem!

unit.source: Angoulême rubbed his temples and muttered, “There are Cardinals not from the Sun pathway, and way more diocese bishops. I really don’t know what we’ll uncover next. I just hope the impact isn’t too massive.”
unit.target: Angoulême tecta sua fricavit et submurmuravit: “Sunt cardinales extra iter Solis, ac multo plures episcopi dioecesani. Vere nescio quid deinceps detegamus; spero tantum effectum non nimis ingentem futurum esse.”

unit.source: He meant the April Fool’s insider in the Eternal Church. With a clear lead, it wouldn’t be hard for that party to be discovered, even if they worked through a Broker.
unit.target: Id significabat societatem Aprilis Insularum inter Ecclesiam Aeternam. Claro duce, non difficile erit illam partem inveniri, etsi per intermediarium operentur.

unit.source: Without waiting for Franca’s reply, Angoulême pondered a moment and said, “The humanoid Sealed Artifact transaction is approved. Let me know the transaction details anytime.”
unit.target: Sine responsione Francae exspectando, Angoulême paulisper cogitavit et dixit: “Transactio Artefacti Signati Humanoidis approbata est. Notitia negotiationis quovis tempore mihi tradita sit.”

unit.source: “It’s finally approved…” Franca criticized the bureaucracy and curiously asked, “What’s the story with that humanoid Artifact?”
unit.target: “Denique approbatum est…” inquit Franca, bureaucratiam condemnans, et curiosa rogavit: “Quid est fabula de illo Artefacto Humanoideo?”

unit.source: She had encountered the humanoid Sealed Artifact during the sea prayer ritual and knew its abnormal power.
unit.target: Illa artefactum Humanoide Signatum in ritu orationis maritimae occurrerat et eius vim insolitam noverat.

unit.source: Angoulême shook his head. “I’m not cleared for that intel. All I know is she used to be a Sequence 4 Spectator demigod. Later she suddenly went insane, but I don’t know if she went mad before an evil god corrupted her, or because of the corruption.”
unit.target: Angoulême caput vertit et dixit: “Non sum concessus ad hanc notitiam. Scio tantum eam olim fuisse demigodum Spectatorem Ordine IV. Postea subito insanivit, sed nescio an insanivit antequam deus malus eam corrumpisset, an propter ipsam corruptionem.”

unit.source: “It was probably the latter,” Franca said thoughtfully. “Aren’t Spectator Beyonders usually emotionally stable and hard to lose control?”
unit.target: “Forsitan alterum fuit,” inquit Franca cogitans. “Nonne Spectatores Beyonders plerumque animi constanti sunt et difficile est eis moderationem perdere?”

unit.source: Angoulême rejected Franca’s statement. “From what I know, Spectators normally don’t have issues. But when they do, it gets really messy.”
unit.target: Angoulême proclamationem Francae reiecit: “Ex iis quae scio, Spectatores plerumque problemata non habent; sed cum occurrunt, res vere confunduntur.”

unit.source: “True,” Franca thought of I Know Someone.
unit.target: “Vere,” Franca cogitavit, meminens I Know Someone.

unit.source: After chatting a while, Angoulême bid Hidden Blade farewell and left the empty room.
unit.target: Postquam aliquantulum colloquebantur, Angoulême Hidden Blade valedixit et ex illa camera inhāna discessit.

unit.source: Before leaving, he quickly reviewed the intel, then inwardly sighed with a heavy heart.
unit.target: Antequam discessit, celeriter notitiam recensuit, deinde corde gravi intus suspiravit.

unit.source: Aren’t there way too many mystical incidents in Trier?
unit.target: Nonne nimis sunt casus mystici in Trier?

unit.source: In the market district, Jenna seized a chance to act as a Witch again.
unit.target: In regione mercatoria, Jenna occasionem arripuit ut iterum magā agirent.

unit.source: Wearing a black cloak and dark dress, she walked the shadowed street, pondering new acting directions as she looked for an opportunity.
unit.target: Nigro pallio et veste obscura indūta, viam umbratam ambulavit, novas rationes agendi meditans dum occasionem quaerebat.

unit.source: I can’t just equate Witches with bad deeds. Sinister, dark acts aren’t necessarily bad…
unit.target: Non possum magās cum malis factīs aequare. Acta sinistra et obscura non necessario mala sunt…

unit.source: Among the Witch legends I’ve gathered so far, many focused on Witches using mystical and sinister dark powers to help others fulfill desires, tempting them to stumble…
unit.target: Inter fabulas de magā quae adhuc collegi, multae spectabant magās uti potentiis mysticis et sinistris obscuris ad alios adiuvandos, ut desideria perficerent, eos ad lapsum incitantes…

unit.source: These legends likely contain remnants of acts by Demonesses posing as Witches. I could try imitating them. Plus, tempting others into depravity is a deeper way for an Instigator. Pleasure’s acting also corrupts the target…
unit.target: Hae fabulae probabiliter reliquias continent actuum daemonissārum, quae ut magā se praebuerunt. Possum conari eas imitari. Praeterea, alios in pravitatem inducere via profunda est ad instigationem; actus Voluptātis quoque scopus corrumpit…

unit.source: Yes, the mystical powers of sinisterness and darkness, tempting depravity and depravity brings calamity…
unit.target: Ita, potentiae mysticae sinistritātis et tenebrarum, pravitatem incitantes, calamitatem afferunt…

unit.source: Jenna’s thoughts gradually became more clear.
unit.target: Cogitationes Jennae paulatim evidentiores factae sunt.

unit.source: With these in mind, she turned onto Rue Anarchie, intending to find a chance to act as a Witch on this chaotic street.
unit.target: His in mente habitīs, illa in viam “Rue Anarchie” versa est, intentā ut occasionem in hac via confusa ut magā agiret inveniret.

unit.source: After a few steps, Jenna suddenly heard someone singing hysterically, “Trier, a city dressed in gold,
unit.target: Post paucos passūs, Jenna subito aliquem audivit histrionicē cantantem: “Trier, urbs auro indūtā,

unit.source: “A ball that endures ’til dawn unfolds;
unit.target: Saltātiō quae usque ad auroram extenditur;

unit.source: “Chicken roasted, dripping with oil’s grace,
unit.target: Pullus assus, oleī grātiā stillans,

unit.source: “A castle cake to fill each eager embrace.
unit.target: Placenta castrōrum, quae singulōs amplexūs avidos implet.

unit.source: “A bow-tied attendant glides ‘mongst the guests,
unit.target: Minister, nodo papilionī ligātus, inter hospitēs labitur,

unit.source: “Merrily dancing with joy and delight.
unit.target: Hilariter saltat cum gaudio et delectātiōne.

unit.source: “My beloved, hidden ‘midst the crowd,
unit.target: Carus meus, inter turbam abscondītus,

unit.source: “Among them, my love resides,
unit.target: Inter eōs, habitat amor meus,

unit.source: “In the Capital of Joy, forever Trier!”
unit.target: In capite laetitiāe, in aeternum Trier!”

unit.source: This voice… Jenna peered from the shadows at Auberge du Coq Doré and saw Lumian, in a thick brown jacket, sitting on the third floor windowsill, holding a green liquid-filled bottle.
unit.target: Haec vox… Jenna ex umbrīs conspexit ad Auberge du Coq Doré et vidit Lumian, veste crassa fusca indūtus, sedens in limine fenestrae tertī tabulātī, tenens lagēnam virēdam plena liquoris.

unit.source: Hadn’t he gone to the Aurora Order and never returned? Jenna frowned and stepped out of the shadow.
unit.target: Numquid non ivit Ordo Aurorae et numquam rediit? Jenna fronte contrīta ex umbrā processit.

unit.source: Lumian noticed her and smiled. He leaped down from the third floor, landing steadily before her.
unit.target: Lumian eam animadvertit et risit. E fenestra tertiā, deiecit, et ante eam firmē consedit.

unit.source: “Why are you here?” Jenna asked with concern.
unit.target: “Cur hic es?” inquit Jenna sollicite.

unit.source: Lumian smiled casually. “I suddenly missed this place. Came back for a drink.”
unit.target: Lumian libenter risit. “Subitō hunc locum desideravi. Redīī ad potum.”

unit.source: Sensing Lumian’s strange excitement, Jenna pondered a moment then asked, “Did something happen?”
unit.target: Sentientī Lumiani excitātōrem mirum, Jenna paulisper meditāta est deinde rogavit: “Acciditne aliquid?”

unit.source: “No,” Lumian denied quickly. He emphasized, “I’m fine.”
unit.target: “Non,” celeriter negavit Lumian. Insisterat: “Ego valeō.”

unit.source: With an absinthe bottle in hand, he headed towards Rue Anarchie’s exit. Jenna trailed closely behind, not inquiring further.
unit.target: Absynthī lagēnam in manu habens, ad exitum Rūe Anarchie properavit. Jenna prope secuta est, ulterius non interrogāns.

unit.source: Under the crimson moonlight and scattered gas lamps, the silent Lumian suddenly smiled and announced, “I’m about to start blaspheming. No, it’s already begun.”
unit.target: Sub luce lunāri coccineā et lampadibus gasicis dispersīs, silentiosus Lumian subito risit et annuntiāvit: “Mox blasphemāre incipiam. Minime, iam coepit.”

unit.source: He didn’t turn around and kept walking.
unit.target: Non se vertit et ambulāre continuit.

unit.source: “Haven’t you been blaspheming all this while?” Jenna cautiously probed with Lumian’s usual self-deprecation.
unit.target: “Numquid totum hunc tempus blasphemāstī?” inquit Jenna cautius, consuētā sui deprecatione ad Lumian.

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze stayed fixed ahead as he smiled. “It’s different this time.”
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani ante se fixus remansit dum risit: “Hoc tempore aliud est.”

unit.source: He quickened his pace and didn’t mention it again.
unit.target: Celeritātem acceleravit nec rē iterum dīxit.

unit.source: Jenna glanced at Lumian’s muddy leather boots and the dirty but dry surroundings. She pursed her lips and didn’t press further.
unit.target: Jenna conspexit calceamenta ex corio luto Lumiani et circumstantia sordida sed arida; labra comprimens, ulterius non quaesivit.

unit.source: Lumian continued walking, occasionally humming a tune, occasionally chatting with Jenna and joking with a smile.
unit.target: Lumian ambulāre continuit, interdum carmen hummandō, interdum cum Jenna colloquēns et subrīdēns iocāns.

unit.source: He made his way back to his rented apartment and entered his room.
unit.target: Ad locum conductum rediit et in conclāve intrāvit.

unit.source: Jenna stood quietly in the living room, watching Lumian close the bedroom’s wooden door.
unit.target: Jenna tranquille in conclāve vivendi stābat, spectāns Lumian lignārem iānam cubiculi claudere.

unit.source: In the dark room, lit only by crimson moonlight, Lumian sat at his desk, unfolded a piece of paper, and picked up a fountain pen.
unit.target: In conclāve obscūro, solum sub luce lunāri coccineō, Lumian ad mensam suam sedebat, chartam explicāvit, et stilum calamosum sustulit.

unit.source: He didn’t light the gas wall lamp, nor create a blazing fireball. In the pitch‑black, he positioned the pen under the faint light.
unit.target: Non accendit lampādum parietālem gasicum neque globum ignis ardentem creāvit. In tenebrīs impenetrābilibus, stilo sub tenuō lumine posuit.

unit.source: Amidst paper rustling, Lumian’s smile faded, and his wrist slowed.
unit.target: Inter crepūs chartārum, subrīsus Lumiani evanuit et carpus eius retardātus est.

unit.source: Finally, he penned the unusually brief letter: “Honorable Madam Magician, I’d like to meet you.”
unit.target: Denique scripsit epistolam insolitam brevissimam: “Honoranda Domina Magistra, te convenīre velim.”

unit.source: 737 Opinion
unit.target: 737 Opinio

unit.source: After having the messenger dispatched to deliver the letter, Lumian sat at his desk, gazing at the dark curtains that seeped in the crimson moonlight, patiently awaiting Madam Magician’s arrival.
unit.target: Postquam nuntius ad epistulam tradendam missus erat, Lumian ad scrinium suum sedebat, intuens obscuras cortinas, in quas rubro lunari lumine permeabatur, adventum Magistrae Magicae patiens exspectans.

unit.source: After an indeterminate period of time, a resplendent starlight emerged from the dark room, coalescing into the figure of Magician.
unit.target: Post aliquod indefinitum tempus, lux stellaris splendida ex conclavi obscuro apparuit, in figuram Magistrae Magicae coalescens.

unit.source: She had changed into a brownish‐yellow cotton dress with white trimmings.
unit.target: Mutaverat se in tunicam ex cotone flavidentem cum albis ornamentis.

unit.source: “Good evening, Madam Magician,” Lumian said with a glance around. “I have something important to discuss.”
unit.target: “Bonum vesperum, Magistra Magica,” inquit Lumian, circumiaculis intuens. “Aliquid magni momenti habeo ad disserendum.”

unit.source: Magician grasped his meaning and immediately condensed the surrounding darkness into an illusory glass barrier, curling up to block out the infiltration of the crimson moonlight and the sounds from outside.
unit.target: Magistra Magica eius sensum intellexit atque statim circumstantias tenebras in fictum obstaculum vitrei coaravit, se convolvens ut penetrationem rubri lunaris luminis atque sonorum ex foris impediret.

unit.source: “What’s so important?” Madam Magician inquired once secrecy was ensured.
unit.target: “Quid est tam magni momenti?” quaesivit Magistra Magica, cum secretum confirmatum esset.

unit.source: Lumian conjured a blazing white flame to use as a chandelier.
unit.target: Lumian flammam albidam ardentem evocavit ut lampadario uteretur.

unit.source: After a few moments of silence, he said, “I’ve confirmed the origins of the lizard‐like elf.”
unit.target: Post aliquot momenta silentii, inquit, “Origines elfi lacertiformis comprobavi.”

unit.source: “It’s not an evil god from outside the barrier?” Madam Magician wore a thoughtful expression.
unit.target: “Num non est deus malus ex extra claustra?” inquit Magistra Magica, vultu cogitativo.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curled into a slight smile. “An evil god in a way, but one not from outside the barrier.”
unit.target: Labia Lumiani in levem risum convoluta erant. “Deus malus aliquatenus, sed non ille ex extra claustra.”

unit.source: Magician frowned and said, “Give me the details.”
unit.target: Magistra Magica frontem contraxit et dixit, “Da mihi singula.”

unit.source: Lumian recounted in his deep voice his pact with Penitent Baynfel and the corresponding negative effects.
unit.target: Lumian, voce profunda, narravit pactum suum cum Penitente Baynfel et effectus adversos consequentes.

unit.source: He described seeing the True Creator idol and a lizard‐like elf in the secret cathedral of the Aurora Order, as well as the illusory scene suspected to be a divine kingdom.
unit.target: Descripsit quod vidisset idolum veri creatoris et elfum lacertiformem in cathedrali secreto Ordine Aurorae, necnon scenam illusoriam, quae regnum divinum fore suspicabatur.

unit.source: Madam Magician didn’t interrupt him, listening attentively.
unit.target: Magistra Magica eum non interpellavit, attente auscultans.

unit.source: Then, she let out a long sigh and said, “In fact, I had suspected that the lizard‐like elf was related to Him, but whether it was the Spectator pathway’s Mythical Creature form or the Hanged Man pathway’s Mythical Creature form, they were clearly different from that elf.”
unit.target: Tum illa longum suspirium exhalavit et dixit, “Revera suspicabar elfum lacertiformem ad Eum pertinere, sed sive in forma creaturae mythicae per viam Speculatorum sive in forma creaturae mythicae per viam Pendenti Viri, plane diversa erant ab illo elfo.”

unit.source: Nothing similar had manifested in the past five to six years.
unit.target: Nulla similia apparuerant per annos quinque ad sex praeteritos.

unit.source: Additionally, the two experts at decrypting and deciphering dreams were more inclined to believe that the elf came from an evil god outside the barrier.
unit.target: Praeterea, duo periti in somniorum interpretandis magis inclinabantur credere elfum ex deo malefico extra claustra venisse.

unit.source: This led me to abandon that guess.
unit.target: Id me ad eam coniecturam deserendam adduxit.

unit.source: From the looks of it, that entity had been involved in Cordu’s catastrophe for a long time.
unit.target: Ex aspectu, illa entitas diu in calamitate Cordi implicata fuit.

unit.source: That’s the only explanation that’s complete.
unit.target: Haec sola explicatione plena est.

unit.source: How could He, who’s been listening and watching, not notice such a major incident that has been unfolding for so long and involves members of the Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society?
unit.target: Quomodo potuit ille, qui auscultavit et observavit, talem rem gravissimam, quae diu evoluta est et membra Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispatorum implicat, non animadvertere?

unit.source: How could He not take advantage of the situation?
unit.target: Quomodo non potuit ex huius rei opportunitate uti?

unit.source: “What does He want?” Lumian’s expression subtly contorted.
unit.target: “Quid vult ille?” inquit Lumian, vultu subtiliter contracto.

unit.source: Magician stared at Lumian for a few seconds before sighing again.
unit.target: Magistra Magica Lumianum per paucos momenta aspiciens deinde iterum suspiravit.

unit.source: “I can only confirm one goal. That is to create a Beyonder capable of rapid digestion and rapid advancement along the Hunter pathway.
unit.target: “Unum solum propositum confirmare possum. Id est, Beyonder creare, qui celeriter digerendi atque celeriter in via Venatoris progredi possit.

unit.source: “Think about it. It’s been just over half a year since you became a Hunter.
unit.target: Cogita de hoc. Iam paulo plusquam dimidium anni est ex quo Venator factus es.

unit.source: You’re already a Sequence 5 Beyonder, and your Reaper potion has been greatly digested.
unit.target: Iam es Beyonder ordinis quinto, et potio tua Reaper magno modo digesta est.

unit.source: Perhaps in two to three months, you can consider breaking through to godhood and advancing to Sequence 4, becoming a demigod.
unit.target: Fortasse in duobus ad tribus mensibus, te in divinitatem transgredi atque ad Ordinem Quartum progredi, factus semideus, considerare poteris.

unit.source: “On this ‘journey,’ whether it was the fake Angel status brought about by sealing Termiboros, the obtained boons of the Inevitability pathway, or some tempering and digestion opportunities filled with calculated arrangements, they all contributed significantly to your growth.
unit.target: In hoc itinere, sive falsus status Angeli per sigillum Termiboros obtentus, sive dona obtenta per viam Inevitabilitatis, sive occasiones temperationis et digestionis cum consiliis computatis, omnes ad incrementum tuum significanter contulerunt.

unit.source: “He wants a Red Priest and is pushing for a decisive battle between the Red Priest and the Primordial Demoness.
unit.target: Ille Sacerdotem Rubrum desiderat et pugnam decisivam inter Sacerdotem Rubrum et Daemonissam Primordialem impellit.

unit.source: “I was worried that your advancement might be going too smoothly, but now it seems that a price has already been exacted for what fate bestowed, and a deposit has been paid.”
unit.target: “Timebam ne progressio tua nimis leniter eveniret, sed nunc videtur pretium iam solutum esse quod fata imposuerunt, atque depositum datum esse.”

unit.source: Under the blazing white flames, Lumian spoke in a deep, raspy voice, “I’d rather remain an ordinary person.”
unit.target: Sub flammis albidis ardentibus, Lumian, voce profunda et rauca, dixit, “Malim manere hominem ordinarium.”

unit.source: Madam Magician shook her head with a complex smile.
unit.target: Magistra Magica caput concussit cum risu composito.

unit.source: “As the apocalypse approaches, with Aurore’s background and condition, even if no catastrophe had occurred in Cordu, it’s inevitable that you’ll encounter one eventually.
unit.target: “Cum apocalypsis appropinquet, et cum Aurore condicione atque originibus, etiamsi in Cordo nulla calamitas evenisset, inevitabile est ut tandem tibi occurrat.

unit.source: Have you forgotten the helplessness and pain of being an ordinary person in that catastrophe?
unit.target: Nonne oblitus es inopiam ac dolorem, qui hominem ordinarium in illa calamitate affligit?

unit.source: Lumian clenched his fists involuntarily and lowered his head.
unit.target: Lumian pugnos involuntarie stringens et caput deiecit.

unit.source: “I-I just don’t want to obtain power this way.”
unit.target: “N-nolo potentiam hoc modo adipisci.”

unit.source: Madam Magician didn’t dwell on the topic and said, “He definitely has ulterior motives.
unit.target: Magistra Magica de re non multum versata est et dixit, “Profecto, ille ulteriora consilia habet.

unit.source: For example, a humanoid Sealed Artifact like you can effectively gather evil god influences around you wherever you go, exposing their schemes in advance and giving us more time to deal with them.”
unit.target: Exempli gratia, artificium sigillatum humanoide ut tu efficaciter colligere potest influxus deorum malorum circa te, ubicumque eris, consilia eorum ante ostendendo et nobis tempus amplius tribuendo ad eos tractandos.

unit.source: Lumian remained silent and didn’t respond.
unit.target: Lumian tacitus remansit et non respondit.

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced at him and asked with an obvious sigh, “What’s your next move?”
unit.target: Magistra Magica eum aspexit et, cum suspirio manifesto, quaesivit, “Quid deinceps agas?”

unit.source: Lumian’s body trembled slightly, as if he couldn’t suppress his emotions.
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani paulo trepidavit, quasi affectus suos reprimere non posset.

unit.source: Gritting his teeth, he said, “I want to punch Him!”
unit.target: Dentes stringens, dixit, “Illum percutire volo!”

unit.source: Upon saying this, Lumian’s eyes turned bloodshot.
unit.target: His dictis, oculi Lumiani sanguine rubefacti sunt.

unit.source: To be honest, he had never harbored a firm desire to seek revenge on a deity.
unit.target: Ad veritatem, numquam firmum desiderium habuerat deum vindicare.

unit.source: His original plan was to eliminate the key members of April Fool’s and the Sanson family of the Sinners organization.
unit.target: Primum consilium eius erat principales membra April Fool’s atque familiam Sanson de organizatione Peccatorum exstirpare.

unit.source: Then, he would work hard to become an Angel and extract most of Termiboros’s strength.
unit.target: Deinde laboraret constanter ut Angelus fieret et maximum Termiboros robur extraheretur.

unit.source: Then, he would release the weak Angel of Inevitability and kill Him.
unit.target: Deinde dimitteret Angelum infirmum Inevitabilitatis et Eum interficeret.

unit.source: He knew that the source of Cordu’s catastrophe was actually the entity known as Inevitability.
unit.target: Sciebat fons calamitatis Cordi revera esse entitatem quae Inevitabilitas appellatur.

unit.source: However, due to the vast disparity between them and his natural fear of deities, he had only occasionally cursed and spoken harsh words.
unit.target: Attamen, ob ingentem discrepantiam inter eos ac eius naturalem deorum timorem, tantum aliquando maledictus et verba aspera dixit.

unit.source: He hadn’t truly put the other party on his revenge list.
unit.target: Non vere alterum in indicem ultionis suae posuerat.

unit.source: And now, he wanted those damned deities to fall from heaven, like meteors streaking through the night sky!
unit.target: Et nunc, volebat ut illi deorum maledictorum de caelo caderent, sicut meteora per caelum nocturnum fulgentia.

unit.source: Madam Magician looked at Lumian with a serious expression and asked, “Do you know what you mean by that?”
unit.target: Magistra Magica, vultu serio Lumianum intuentem, inquit, “Scis quid hoc significet?”

unit.source: “I know,” Lumian nodded slowly. “I’ve been waiting all day before requesting to meet you because I’ve been questioning myself seriously.”
unit.target: “Scio,” inquit Lumian, lente annuens. “Totum diem exspectavi antequam te convenire petissem, quia me ipse serio interrogaveram.

unit.source: He had questioned himself again and again, sometimes in anger, sometimes in sorrow.
unit.target: Se iterum atque iterum interrogaverat, aliquando in ira, aliquando in dolore.

unit.source: When he calmed down a little, he questioned himself again.
unit.target: Cum paulo sedatus esset, se iterum interrogavit.

unit.source: Madam Magician regarded him with a familiar pity in her eyes.
unit.target: Magistra Magica eum intuens, oculis pietatis nota, aspiciebat.

unit.source: This time, Lumian knew clearly what she was pitying.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian clare intellexit quid illa misere teneret.

unit.source: A human yearning to punch a deity.
unit.target: Homo desiderans deum percutere.

unit.source: Lumian gazed back at the Major Arcana card holder, his gaze unwavering.
unit.target: Lumian aspiciebat tenentem chartarum Maioris Arcanae, oculis immotis.

unit.source: After a while, Magician nodded slightly and said, “You’re telling me the target because you want me to provide effective advice on your idea and make it a little more feasible?”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit, “Narras mihi scopum, quia vis ut consilium efficax de tua idea praebeam et eam paulo magis efficacem reddam?”

unit.source: “Yes, my suggestion is that before Mr. Fool awakens to some extent, endure your impulses and work hard to improve yourself.
unit.target: “Ita, suadeo ut, priusquam Dominus Fool aliquatenus evigilaverit, impulsus tuos sustineas et constanter te meliorem facias.

unit.source: Only by becoming a demigod can you have a chance to sit at that table of cards—of course, that depends on whether you appear there in the form of cards or chips.
unit.target: Solum semideus factus, occasio tibi dabitur ut ad mensam chartarum sedeas—scilicet, id pendet ex forma tua, sive chartarum sive tessarum.

unit.source: Don’t be disheartened. It’s the same for you, me, and the other demigods.
unit.target: Noli contristari. Idem est pro te, me, et ceteris semideis.

unit.source: Our will and choices can also play an important role at critical moments.
unit.target: Voluntas nostra et electiones etiam partes maximas in momentis decisivis agere possunt.

unit.source: We can also exploit the card players.
unit.target: Luditores chartarum quoque ad nostram utilitatem adhibere possumus.

unit.source: Lumian asked in a deep voice, “Will Mr. Fool—will he help me?”
unit.target: Lumian voce profunda quaesivit, “Num Dominus Fool mihi adiuvabit?”

unit.source: Madam Magician nodded solemnly. “Yes.”
unit.target: Magistra Magica sollemniter annuit. “Ita.”

unit.source: Unknowingly, her eyes grew brighter. “Mr. Fool will protect us. All of us are willing to make sacrifices for this world, but we can’t be sacrificed.”
unit.target: Nescite, oculi eius clarior facti sunt. “Dominus Fool nos proteget. Omnes parati sumus pro hoc mundo sacrificia ferre, sed sacrificari non possumus.”

unit.source: Lumian suddenly let out a sigh of relief, as if he had lost all strength.
unit.target: Lumian subito suspirium levationis emisit, quasi omnem fortitudinem amisisset.

unit.source: He couldn’t stand steadily, and his body swayed slightly.
unit.target: Non potuit stabile stare, et corpus eius paululum vacillabat.

unit.source: He had been suppressing his emotions with all his might until now.
unit.target: Affectus suos omni vi usque ad hunc tempus reprimebat.

unit.source: Madam Magician looked at him and pondered for a moment before saying, “I must remind you that that entity should already be aware of your thoughts.
unit.target: Magistra Magica eum aspiciens paulisper meditata deinde dixit, “Moneo te, nam illa entitas iam de tuis cogitationibus conscius esse debet.

unit.source: This is because you displayed an abnormality in front of His idol.
unit.target: Nam coram eius idolo anomaliam ostendisti.

unit.source: I’m not criticizing you; I’m just stating a fact.
unit.target: Non te critico; tantum rem dico.

unit.source: In that situation, even Clowns and Spectators would find it difficult to control their emotions and expressions, let alone an Ascetic like you.
unit.target: In illa condicione, etiam scurrae et spectatores vix possent affectus et vultum suum moderari, cujus modi te, ascetam, moderare non possis.

unit.source: “I know…” Lumian replied with difficulty.
unit.target: “Scio…” inquit Lumian, lente annuens.

unit.source: Before Madam Magician exposed him, he had harbored a glimmer of hope.
unit.target: Antequam Magistra Magica eum detegeret, parvam spem in corde suo fovebat.

unit.source: Magician chuckled and said, “That’s also a positive thing. The fact that you’re still alive suggests that you’re still useful to Him and can be used.
unit.target: Magistra Magica subridens dixit, “Id quoque res positiva est; quod adhuc vivus es, significat te Eius usui esse posse.”

unit.source: You haven’t repaid the full price that fate has exacted of you.
unit.target: Non solvesti pretium integrum, quod fata ex te exiguerunt.

unit.source: As long as you don’t give up on yourself or participate in actions that can disrupt His important plans, He will ignore your hatred.
unit.target: Dum te ipsum non deseruis aut in rebus, quae consilia Eius turbabunt, non participes, Eius odium negleget.

unit.source: He might even continue to allow you to encounter opportunities and obtain things until you step onto the stage He has decided for you.
unit.target: Forsitan etiam te permittet ut occasiones capias et res obtineas, donec in scaenam, quam Eius pro te designavit, ascendas.

unit.source: It’s frustrating, but that’s the reality.
unit.target: Molestum est, sed hoc est veritas.

unit.source: In the eyes of an existence like Him, you are currently just a speck of dust.
unit.target: In oculis entitatis similis Eius, nunc es tantum particula pulveris.

unit.source: He can reduce you to dust at any time without worrying about your thoughts.
unit.target: Ille te in pulverem quovis tempore redigere potest, sine cura de cogitationibus tuis.

unit.source: After a long silence, Lumian asked in a slightly hoarse voice, “You mean, before Mr. Fool awakens, I’m to make full use of that entity’s arrangements?”
unit.target: Post longum silentium, Lumian voce paulo rauca quaesivit, “Id igitur significas, antequam Dominus Fool evigilaverit, ut totis entitatis praeparatis uti deberem?”

unit.source: Magician nodded slightly and said, “Using an enemy’s resources to strengthen yourself is also a way of seeking revenge.
unit.target: Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit, “Ad te corroborandum hostis opibus uti quoque est modus ultionis quaerendi.

unit.source: Of course, this requires greater caution and restraint.
unit.target: Scilicet, hoc maiorem cautionem et temperantiam requirit.

unit.source: As I mentioned earlier, a price is always exacted for what fate has bestowed.
unit.target: Ut antea dixi, pretium semper exigitur pro eo quod fata tribuunt.

unit.source: You have to weigh whether you’re willing to pay the corresponding price in the future.
unit.target: Oportet ponderare num paratus sis pretium futurum solvere.

unit.source: Lumian looked down at the floor illuminated by the incandescent white light and said, “Okay.”
unit.target: Lumian aspexit ad solum, quod luce albidis incandescentibus illustratum erat, et dixit, “Bene.”

unit.source: He then asked, “When will Mr. Fool begin awakening?”
unit.target: Deinde quaesivit, “Quando Dominus Fool evigilabit?”

unit.source: “No one knows,” Madam Magician replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Nemo scit,” inquit Magistra Magica cum risu.

unit.source: “But there’s no need to be disheartened by this answer.
unit.target: “Sed nihil est te contristare ex hoc responsu.

unit.source: I foresee that we tarot card holders will play an important role in this matter.
unit.target: Praedico nos, tenentes chartas Taroticas, partes maximas in hac re agere.

unit.source: Let’s work hard together.
unit.target: Conemur simul operari.

unit.source: “How do we?” Lumian pressed.
unit.target: “Quomodo faciemus?” inquit Lumian instanter.

unit.source: Madam Magician pondered for a moment and said, “First, focus on yourself. Then, wait patiently for the right opportunity.”
unit.target: Magistra Magica paulisper meditata et dixit: “Primum, cura te ipsum; deinde patienter opportunitatem rectam exspecta.”

unit.source: The right opportunity? Lumian couldn’t fathom how they, the Minor Arcana card holders, were involved in awakening Mr. Fool.
unit.target: “Opportunitas recta?” Lumian non potuit intellegere quomodo illi, tenentes chartas Minoris Arcanae, ad Dominum Fool evigilandum implicarentur.

unit.source: All he could do was cautiously ask, “Madam, did you deliberately place Penitent on the messenger list?”
unit.target: Omnia quae facere poterat, tantum cautus quaesivit, “Magistra, num Penitent voluntarie in indice nuntiatorum posuisti?”

unit.source: Without Baynfel’s negative influence, he wouldn’t have had a chance to see the lizard‐like elf in the True Creator’s hidden cathedral.
unit.target: Sine influxu negativo Baynfel, non haberet occasionem elfum lacertiformem in cathedrali secreto veri creatoris videre.

unit.source: “Yes and no,” Madam Magician replied.
unit.target: “Et sic et non,” respondit Magistra Magica.

unit.source: “I know he has a certain connection to that entity.
unit.target: “Scio eum certum nexum ad illam entitatem habere.

unit.source: I believe our collaboration with the Aurora Order is fragile.
unit.target: Credo nostram collaborationem cum Ordine Aurorae esse fragili.

unit.source: You were sent as an undercover agent, not a true member.
unit.target: Misitus es ut speculator occultus, non ut verus membrum.

unit.source: You might encounter certain problems in the future, and there’s a chance that he will bring about new possibilities.
unit.target: Fortasse aliquas difficultates in futurum occursuras, et facultas est ut novas possibilitates afferat.

unit.source: That’s why I placed him on the messenger list to see if fate will allow you to choose him.
unit.target: Ideo eum in indice nuntiatorum posui, ut videam an fata tibi sinant eum eligere.

unit.source: I never expected this to unveil a very important mystery.
unit.target: Numquam exspectavi hoc revelare mysterium valde momenti.

unit.source: Lumian had long grown accustomed to Madam Magician’s cryptic responses.
unit.target: Lumian iam diu consueverat responsionibus crypticis Magistrae Magicae.

unit.source: He swiftly filtered through her thoughts.
unit.target: Celeriter per eius cogitationes perscrutatus est.

unit.source: He spoke in a deep voice, “Madam, I wish to explore Mr. Hanged Man’s Blue Avenger soon.”
unit.target: Voce profunda dixit, “Magistra, mox Mr. Hanged Man’s Blue Avenger explorare volo.”

unit.source: 738 Original Arrangement
unit.target: 738 Dispositio Originalis

unit.source: Magician concurred tersely.
unit.target: Magus breviter assentivit.

unit.source: “No problem.
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio.

unit.source: I understand the urgency.
unit.target: Intellego urgentiam.

unit.source: I’ll bring you there once Mr. Hanged Man and I confirm the time.”
unit.target: Te illuc ducam, cum Dominus Suspenditus et ego tempus confirmaverimus.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent for a moment before saying, “Thank you.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper tacuit, deinde dixit: “Gratias.”

unit.source: Madam Magician pondered for a moment and reminded him, “But don’t be too hasty.
unit.target: Magistra Magica paulisper meditata est et eum admonuit: “Sed noli nimis festinare.

unit.source: Emperor Roselle once said, ‘More haste, less speed.’
unit.target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: ‘Plus festinatio, minus velocitas.’

unit.source: “It’s not just because impatience blinds you and affects your judgment, causing you to make wrong choices in many matters.
unit.target: “Non solum quod impatiens te caecat et iudicium tuum afficit, faciens ut in multis rebus decisiones falsas capias.

unit.source: It’s also because consuming the potion to advance has a requirement on your mental state.
unit.target: Etiam quod potionem ad progressum sumere statum animi tui exigit.

unit.source: You should be well aware of this.”
unit.target: Hoc bene scire debes.”

unit.source: “I understand,” Lumian said with a sigh.
unit.target: “Intellego,” inquit Lumian cum suspirio.

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced around and joked, “You were really tense just now.
unit.target: Magistra Magica circumspiciens iocata est: “Nuper vere anxius eras.

unit.source: We’ve been talking this whole time, but you didn’t even remember to invite me to sit down.
unit.target: Totum hoc tempore locuti sumus, sed ne mihi quidem meministi ut me ad sedendum invitarem.

unit.source: “Yes, the School of Truth’s vortex clearly involves higher-level forces.
unit.target: “Ita, vortex Scholae Veritatis clare vires superiores implicat.

unit.source: We’ll take over the subsequent investigations.
unit.target: Inquisitiones posteriores nos suscipiemus.

unit.source: Your primary mission is to locate the relatively important Mirror People according to what Moran Avigny had shared.
unit.target: Missio primaria tua est reperire Populum Specularum, qui relative magni momenti sunt, secundum ea quae Moran Avigny narraverat.

unit.source: I suspect that something in the special mirror world is an important part of the vortex.
unit.target: Suspicor aliquid in mundo speculari speciali esse partem praecipue momenti vorticis.

unit.source: “This time, you’ve obtained crucial information.
unit.target: “Hoc tempore, notitiae maximi momenti adeptus es.

unit.source: We Major Arcana card holders won’t be stingy with the rewards.
unit.target: Nos, qui cartas Major Arcana habemus, non erimus parcitrici cum praemiis.

unit.source: Of course, it’s for your team, not just you.
unit.target: Scilicet, pro turma tua est, non solum tibi.

unit.source: The exact distribution is up to you.”
unit.target: Distributio exacta tibi delegatur.”

unit.source: Upon hearing the last sentence, Lumian suddenly fell into a daze.
unit.target: Audito ultimo verbo, Lumian subito in torporis statum incidit.

unit.source: He muttered to himself, “Again…
unit.target: Sibi murmurat: “Iterum…

unit.source: “Is this also what fate has bestowed?”
unit.target: Numquid hoc etiam est quod fata largita sint?

unit.source: “I can’t say for sure that’s not the case,” Madam Magician replied with a self-deprecating smile.
unit.target: “Non possum certo dicere id non esse,” inquit Magistra Magica cum risu modesto.

unit.source: “Your psychological and mental state are better than I expected.
unit.target: Status mentis et animi tui melius sunt quam exspectavi.

unit.source: You haven’t reached the point where you need treatment again, but you seem to have suffered from the aftereffects of the trauma known as Fate’s Bestowment.
unit.target: Non attigisti gradum, ubi denuo curationem requiras, sed videtur te passum esse ab effectibus post traumaticos, qui Fati Largitio vocatur.

unit.source: Everything you see seems arranged as if by fate’s hand.”
unit.target: Omnia quae vides ita ordinantur quasi manu fati.”

unit.source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, she added, “Actually, there’s no problem with that.
unit.target: Non exspectans responsum Lumiani, addidit: “Revera, in hoc nullum est problema.

unit.source: It’s good to be vigilant, but don’t put too much pressure on yourself.
unit.target: Bonum est vigilare, sed noli te nimis oneri subicere.

unit.source: Your mind is like an eraser.
unit.target: Mens tua est instar cancellatoris, qui notis tollit.

unit.source: If you’re too tense, it’ll snap.
unit.target: Si nimis tensus eris, rumpetur.

unit.source: You can be vigilant about details, but you have to relax.
unit.target: Potes in rebus subtilibus vigilare, sed oportet te relaxare.

unit.source: Think about it.
unit.target: Cogita de hoc.

unit.source: You can’t resist a real arrangement anyway.
unit.target: In veram dispositionem resistere non potes.

unit.source: Why make yourself unable to sleep well, eat well, and become more and more neurotic?”
unit.target: Cur te ipsum efficis ut bene dormias, bene edas, atque magis ac magis anxius fies?

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian had to admit that Madam Magician had a point.
unit.target: “Ita,” Lumian agnoscere debuit quod Magistra Magica recte dixit.

unit.source: Magician expressed satisfaction at Lumian’s ability to self-regulate.
unit.target: Magistra Magica satisfactionem expressit de facultate Lumiani ad sui ipsius temperandum.

unit.source: “Of course, once you discover any arrangements that are clearly problematic, remember to inform me immediately by reciting the honorific name.
unit.target: “Scilicet, cum quasquam dispositiones, quae manifeste problematicae videntur, reperies, memento me statim certiorem facere recitando nomen honorificum.

unit.source: “For the reward this time, I’ll include the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway, facilitating your quest for items on the Blue Avenger.
unit.target: “Pro praemio hoc tempore includam formulam poculi Sequenciae 4 viae Venatoris, quae tuam inquisitionem rerum in Blue Avenger faciliorem reddet.

unit.source: As for the rewards for the Two of Cups, Seven of Cups, and Four of Swords, I don’t know either.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad praemia pro Duobus Poculis, Septem Poculis, et Quattuor Gladiis, neque scio.

unit.source: It mainly depends on what Judgment, The Hermit, and the others will offer.”
unit.target: Praecipue pendet a iis quae Iudicium, Eremita, aliique offerent.

unit.source: Lumian had no objections to this arrangement.
unit.target: Lumian huic dispositioni nullas objectiones habuit.

unit.source: Even if Madam Magician didn’t mention it or believed that the information about the vortex and the Mirror People wasn’t worth the demigod-level potion formula, he would take the initiative to request that the other party provide it first before making up for the missing contributions.
unit.target: Etiam si Magistra Magica id non memoravisset aut credidisset notitiam de vortice atque Populo Specularum formulae poculi demidei deo dignae non esse, ille inceptivus esset rogandi ut pars altera id prius praebeat, antequam contributiones defuntas compensaret.

unit.source: As Lumian regained his composure, a question crossed his mind.
unit.target: Dum Lumian compositum animi recuperabat, quaestio illi occurrit.

unit.source: “Madam, Mr. K of the Aurora Order has already divulged my contributions in front of the True Creator’s idol, requesting Him to put me up as a candidate Oracle.
unit.target: “Domina, Dominus K Ordinis Aurorae iam meas contributiones coram idolum Vero Creatoris divulgavit, petens ut me pro candidato Oraculo proponat.

unit.source: When an official Oracle falls into danger, I will become the prime candidate to replace them.
unit.target: Cum Oraculus officialis in periculum incidat, primus candidatus supplere eos ero.

unit.source: When the time comes, will I truly become a certain Mr. of the Aurora Order?
unit.target: Quando tempus adveniet, vere num fiet ut aliquis Dominus Ordinis Aurorae sim?

unit.source: “In addition, Mr. K also promised material rewards in the next few days.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, Dominus K etiam praemia materialia in diebus proximis promisit.”

unit.source: Magician nodded slightly and said, “The Aurora Order’s organizational structure is quite peculiar.
unit.target: Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit: “Structura Ordinis Aurorae valde peculiaris est.

unit.source: Although Oracles have a Saint directly above them, most Oracles can directly hear the ravings of that entity and His instructions, giving them strong autonomy.
unit.target: Quamquam Oraculi Sanctum directe super se habent, plerique Oraculi verba illius atque praecepta eius directe audire possunt, quod eis magnam autonomiam tribuit.

unit.source: Yes, they still follow the orders of their Saint superiors and report to them on most matters, but there are a few matters that completely bypass their superiors.
unit.target: Ita, praecepta Sancti superiorum eorum sequuntur et de plurimis rebus ad eos referunt, sed quaedam sunt quae penitus superiores praetereunt.

unit.source: Recommending a candidate Oracle is one of them.
unit.target: Candidatum Oraculum commendare unum ex his est.

unit.source: “An oracle of God can only come from God’s revelation.”
unit.target: “Oraculus Dei solum ex revelatione Dei provenire potest.”

unit.source: After a brief sigh, Magician chuckled and said, “As long as there’s no major problem with the screening, feel free to accept the material rewards.
unit.target: Post brevem suspirum, Magistra Magica risit et dixit: “Dum in probatione nulla maior difficultas sit, libenter accipe praemia materialia.

unit.source: You’ve already received enough of fate’s bestowments.
unit.target: Iamdudum satis largitionum fatrae accepisti.

unit.source: Any more and there won’t be any substantial changes.
unit.target: Quidquid amplius, nullae substantiales mutationes erunt.

unit.source: “I don’t think being an Oracle will happen.
unit.target: “Non puto futurum esse ut Oraculus fias.

unit.source: The Aurora Order’s Oracles have a fixed preaching area.
unit.target: Oraculi Ordinis Aurorae aream praedicandi fixam habent.

unit.source: It can’t beat letting you run around and trigger various hidden dangers of evil gods.
unit.target: Non potest competere cum te sinere circum vagari et varia occultata pericula diorum malorum excitare.

unit.source: It will help you digest the potion.
unit.target: Adiuvabit te potionem digere.

unit.source: Uh…”
unit.target: Heu…

unit.source: At this point, Magician’s expression gradually turned odd.
unit.target: Ad hoc puncto, vultus Magistrae Magicae paulatim insolutus factus est.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t in a hurry to inquire.
unit.target: Lumian non festinabat interrogare.

unit.source: He waited for the Major Arcana card holder to take the initiative to explain.
unit.target: Exspectabat ut possessor cartarum Major Arcana inceptum caperet ad explanandum.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Magician maintained her expression and hesitantly said, “Perhaps, that person’s original arrangement was for you to be a certain Mr. for a while.
unit.target: Post paucis secundis, Magistra Magica vultum suum retinuit et titubanter dixit: “Forsitan, dispositio originalis illius fuit ut aliquantisper esses aliquis Dominus.

unit.source: “The Hunter pathway’s Sequence 4 is known as Iron-blooded Knight.
unit.target: “Sequencia 4 viae Venatoris nota est ut Eques Sanguineo Ferreo.

unit.source: It makes all consumers transform into men.
unit.target: Omnes consumptores in viros transformare facit.

unit.source: Its ritual requires the formation of a team of at least 30 people.
unit.target: Ritual eius formationem turmae ex saltem triginta hominibus requirit.

unit.source: They should be able to comprehend your intentions based on your gaze and actions after long periods of nurturing—as though all of you are nearly one.
unit.target: Illi tua consilia ex aspectu et actionibus post longam institutionem intellegere debent, quasi omnes vobis fere unum essetis.

unit.source: The higher the team’s strength and tacit understanding, the better the effect of the ritual.”
unit.target: Quo altius vis turmae et tacita intellectio, eo melius effectus ritualis.

unit.source: Think about it.
unit.target: Cogita de hoc.

unit.source: What’s the most striking characteristic of the Aurora Order?
unit.target: Quae est notabilissima proprietas Ordinis Aurorae?

unit.source: It’s fanaticism.
unit.target: Est fanaticismus.

unit.source: “After becoming a certain Mr., you will undoubtedly have your own jurisdiction and a large number of subordinates.
unit.target: “Postquam aliquis Dominus fies, indubitanter suam iurisdictionem et multos subditos habebis.

unit.source: They are fanatical and will completely follow the orders of a deity’s oracle like you.
unit.target: Illi fanatici sunt et prorsus praecepta oraculi dei, sicut tui, sequerentur.

unit.source: With some training, they can fulfill the requirements of the ritual.
unit.target: Aliqua disciplina, requisita ritualis explere possunt.

unit.source: What you need to worry about is how to increase their strength and tacit understanding to make the ritual more effective.”
unit.target: Quod tibi sollicitudinem efficit, est quomodo vires eorum et tacitam intelligentiam augere possis, ut ritualis effectus efficacior fiat.

unit.source: Wh— The original plan was for me to become an Oracle after digesting the Reaper potion, allowing me to establish a team to complete the ritual as quickly as possible.
unit.target: Heu— Ordinatio originalis erat ut Oraculus post digestionem potionis Reaper fiam, quae mihi licebat turmam constituere ad ritualem quam celerrime peragendam.

unit.source: How can I carry out this ritual now?
unit.target: Quomodo nunc hoc rituale peragere possum?

unit.source: Franca and the others are without a problem, but there are too few of them…
unit.target: Franca et ceteri non sunt problema, sed eorum numerus nimis paucus est…

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but frown.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit quin fronem contraherere.

unit.source: Upon seeing this, Madam Magician chuckled and said, “The Church of Knowledge, well-versed in the Hunter path, offered an alternative.”
unit.target: Videns hoc, Magistra Magica risit et dixit: “Ecclesia Scientiae, in via Venatoris bene perita, alternativam oblationem proposuit.

unit.source: “Of course, the prerequisite is that you can tame Ludwig.
unit.target: “Scilicet, praerequisitum est ut Ludwig domare possis.

unit.source: Angels can offset most quantity requirements.”
unit.target: Angeli plurima requisita quantitatis compensare possunt.

unit.source: “Angel level?” Lumian finally obtained information about Ludwig’s power from Madam Magician.
unit.target: “Gradus Angelorum?” Tandem Lumian de potentia Ludwig a Magistra Magica notitiam accepit.

unit.source: “Yes.” Madam Magician didn’t elaborate further.
unit.target: “Ita.” Magistra Magica ulterius non explicavit.

unit.source: Taming Ludwig? All I can do now is “bribe” him and give simple commands…
unit.target: Ludwig domare? Nihil aliud nunc possum nisi eum “corrumpere” et simplicia mandata dare…

unit.source: Lumian fell deep into thought.
unit.target: Lumian in altum cogitationem incidit.

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced at him and said, “You can wait until you digest the Reaper potion and visit the City of Exiles, Morora, before deciding which method to use to meet the ritual’s requirements.”
unit.target: Magistra Magica eum aspexit et dixit: “Potes exspectare donec potionem Reaper digesturus sis et urbem Exulorum, Mororam, viseres, antequam decernas quo modo requisitis ritualis satisfaciaris.”

unit.source: “Right, let’s discuss the vortex details through letters.”
unit.target: “Recte, per litteras de subtilitatibus vorticis colloquamur.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded and watched as Madam Magician vanished into thin air.
unit.target: Lumian annuit et spectavit, dum Magistra Magica in aether evanuit.

unit.source: Gazing at the gradually expanding dark border, he closed his eyes and recalled everything he had seen and heard that day.
unit.target: Intuens limen obscurum paulatim dilatantem, oculos clausit et omnia illa die visa et audita recordatus est.

unit.source: Unbeknownst to him, he clenched his fists tightly, and blazing white flames surged from his fists, burning fiercely.
unit.target: Nescientes illi, manus arcte coarctavit, et flammas albas ardentes ex manibus eius effulserunt, vehementer urentes.

unit.source: Jenna sat in an armchair in the living room, quietly waiting for Lumian to open the door and leave.
unit.target: Jenna in sella bracchiali in conclavi sedeat, quiete exspectans ut Lumian ianuam aperiret et discederet.

unit.source: The sound of gnawing and chewing echoed from the dining room.
unit.target: Sonus manducandi et masticandi ex triclinio resonabat.

unit.source: Lumian carried the unfinished bottle of absinthe to the balcony, settled into a chair, and took a sip.
unit.target: Lumian vas absinthii imperfectum ad balconem portavit, in sella consedit, et sorbuit.

unit.source: Jenna approached him with light footsteps and observed him for a few seconds.
unit.target: Jenna levibus passibus ad eum accessit et eum per paucos secundos observavit.

unit.source: “You’re in better shape.”
unit.target: “Melius habitus es.”

unit.source: “You can tell that too?” Lumian asked nonchalantly without turning his head.
unit.target: “Id quoque potes dicere?” inquit Lumian leviter, caput non vertens.

unit.source: Jenna pulled up a chair and sat down, sneering.
unit.target: Jenna sellam arripuit et consedit, irridens.

unit.source: “Your silent and reserved demeanor makes me feel more at ease than your previously excited and talkative demeanor.”
unit.target: “Tua silentiosa et reticens indoles me facit magis tranquille sentire quam tua antea excitata et loquax indoles.”

unit.source: Lumian gazed at the night outside the balcony and remained silent for a long time.
unit.target: Lumian noctem extra balconem intuens diu tacitus mansit.

unit.source: Jenna didn’t ask any questions either.
unit.target: Jenna quoque nullas quaestiones fecit.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian spoke in a deep voice, “I saw that lizard-like elf.”
unit.target: Subito, Lumian voce profunda dixit: “Vidi illum elfum, quasi lacertam similem.

unit.source: Jenna had heard him talk about Cordu and understood what it meant.
unit.target: Jenna eum de Cordu loqui audiverat et intellexit quid id significaret.

unit.source: She said in surprise, “Didn’t you go to the Aurora Order to meet Mr. K?
unit.target: In admiratione dixit: “Nonne ad Ordinem Aurorae ivisti ut Dominum K convenires?

unit.source: Why… Is that lizard-like elf related to the Aurora Order?”
unit.target: Cur… Num ille elfus, qui ad lacertam similis est, ad Ordinem Aurorae pertinet?

unit.source: “It stems from the one they believe in,” Lumian’s voice seemed to emerge from the depths of darkness.
unit.target: “Ex illo procedit, in quem credunt,” videbatur vox Lumiani emergere ex profundis tenebris.

unit.source: “No wonder…” Jenna suddenly understood Lumian’s previous state.
unit.target: “Non mirum…” Jenna subito intellexit praecedens statum Lumiani.

unit.source: “Madam Judgment mentioned that the one the Aurora Order believes in is close to Mr. Fool in power…”
unit.target: “Magistra Iudicium commemoravit quod ille, in quem Ordinis Aurorae credunt, potentia prope Dominum Stultum sit…

unit.source: It wasn’t something mortals could face directly, let alone exact revenge on!
unit.target: Hoc non erat quod mortales directe oppugnare possent, nedum ulciscendi causa!

unit.source: After a brief silence, Jenna understood and said, “Did you just meet Madam Magician?”
unit.target: Post brevem silentium, Jenna intellexit et dixit: “Num modo Magistram Magicam convenisti?”

unit.source: “You’ve grown quite smart after drinking the Witch potion,” Lumian turned to Jenna.
unit.target: “Postquam potionem Veneficae bibi, valde callidus factus es,” Lumian ad Jenna convertit.

unit.source: Jenna couldn’t help but ask, “Can’t Hunters speak nicely?”
unit.target: Jenna non potuit quin quaereret: “Num Venatores non possunt bene loqui?”

unit.source: She paused for a moment before adding, “What did Madam Magician say?”
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit, deinde addens: “Quid dixit Magistra Magica?”

unit.source: “She said to endure it for now and wait for Mr. Fool to wake up before considering what to do next,” Lumian replied simply.
unit.target: “Dixit quod id pro tempore sustineres et Dominum Stultum evigilare exspectares, antequam consilium pro sequentibus cepisses,” Lumian simpliciter respondit.

unit.source: Jenna tersely acknowledged, momentarily at a loss for words.
unit.target: Jenna breviter annuit, momentum verbis caret.

unit.source: After a moment, she stood up and went to Ludwig’s side in the dining room to retrieve a glass from the balcony.
unit.target: Post momentum, surrexit et ad latus Ludwig in triclinio ivit ut calicem ex balcone tuleret.

unit.source: She snatched the bottle of absinthe from Lumian’s hand and poured a third of it for herself.
unit.target: Absinthii lagena e manu Lumiani rapuit et tertiam eius partem sibi effudit.

unit.source: Jenna had just taken a sip of the dreamy green liquid when her face instinctively furrowed.
unit.target: Mox, postquam Jenna sorbetum de liquore viridi somniorum simile biberat, vultus eius statim rugosus factus est.

unit.source: “Heck, why do you people like to drink absinthe?
unit.target: “Heu, cur vos absinthium bibere amatis?

unit.source: It tastes awful!”
unit.target: Sapidum horrendum est!

unit.source: As a former Showy Diva, Jenna had drunk plenty of alcohol, but she still couldn’t accept the taste of absinthe.
unit.target: Ut olim Diva ostentatrix, Jenna multum alcoholis bibeerat, sed saporem absinthii adhuc accipere non potuit.

unit.source: Lumian scoffed but didn’t offer an explanation.
unit.target: Lumian irridens respondit sed explanationem non tulit.

unit.source: Jenna casually chatted, “I once read a book about a writer whose name I can’t remember.
unit.target: Jenna leve colloquebatur: “Olim librum legi de scriptore cuius nomen mihi recordari non potest.

unit.source: He said that those who enjoy absinthe either use it to pretend they are experienced or use it to reminisce about their experiences…”
unit.target: Dixit eos qui absinthium amant, aut id ut se peritos simularent, aut id ad memoriam suarum experientiarum adhibere.

unit.source: Lumian listened quietly, picked up the bottle, and took another mouthful.
unit.target: Lumian quiete auscultavit, lagena rapuit, et alium sorbetum sumpsit.

unit.source: The slightly burning alcohol slid down his throat, leaving behind a familiar bitterness.
unit.target: Alcohol leviter ardens per fauces eius labebat, relinquens post se amaritudinem notam.

unit.source: 739 Reminder
unit.target: 739 Recordatio

unit.source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: In quartiere Cathédralis Memorativae, Habitaculum 702 in via Orosai IX.

unit.source: Franca waited a while for Jenna to return.
unit.target: Franca aliquantulum exspectavit ut Jenna rediret.

unit.source: She sniffed and asked in confusion, “Have you been drinking?”
unit.target: Franca olfactans et, confusa, rogavit: “Bibistine?”

unit.source: Didn’t Jenna say she was going to the market district to find an opportunity to act as a Witch?
unit.target: Nonne Jenna dixit se in districtum mercatus proficisci ut occasionem inveniret ad munus strigae exercendum?

unit.source: Could it be that she had been deliberately drinking and engaging in sting operations to carry out law enforcement?
unit.target: Num potest esse ut illa deliberato bibisset et in operationibus insidiis se implicaverit ad iustitiam exsequendam?

unit.source: Jenna removed her black cloak and said to Franca with a solemn expression, “I ran into Lumian.”
unit.target: Jenna pallium nigrum detraxit et, cum vultu soleno ad Francam, dixit: “Lumian mihi obviam fuit!”

unit.source: “Huh?”
unit.target: «Heu?»

unit.source: Franca was taken aback.
unit.target: Franca obstupuit.

unit.source: “He’s in the market district? Didn’t he go to the Aurora Order to meet Mr. K? I thought he hadn’t returned because he was being tested and preparing to choose a reward…”
unit.target: «In districtum mercatus est? Nonne ad Ordinem Aurorae ivit ut dominum K conveniret? Putabam eum non redisse, quia probaretur et praemium eligere pararetur…»

unit.source: Jenna didn’t hold back and recounted Lumian’s condition and words in almost complete detail.
unit.target: Jenna non cessavit et statum Lumiani ac verba eius fere plene enarravit.

unit.source: “Is that so…”
unit.target: «Ita vero…»

unit.source: Franca’s emotions became complicated.
unit.target: Affectus Francae intricati erant.

unit.source: She understood Lumian’s current feelings and sympathized with the plight of Muggle Aurore.
unit.target: Illa intellexit affectus recentes Lumiani atque ad condicionem Aurore Muggle compatita est.

unit.source: She still remembered that the Ancient Sun God, suspected to be from the Third Epoch and whom the Aurora Order believed in, had returned in some form.
unit.target: Attamen meminisse poterat Deum Solis Antiquum, ex Tertia Aetate oriundum, in quem Ordo Aurorae fidem habebat, aliquo modo rediit.

unit.source: There was a high chance that the Ancient Sun God was an earlier transmigrator, a transmigrator like them!
unit.target: Alta erat probabilitas ut Deus Solis Antiquus priorem transmigratorem fuisset, transmigratorem similem illis!

unit.source: Transmigrators harming transmigrators…
unit.target: Transmigratores inter se nocentes…

unit.source: It’s the way of the April Fool’s group; likewise for the Ancient Sun God…
unit.target: Est modus coetus Aprilis Stultorum; similiter pro Deo Solis Antiquo…

unit.source: Franca sighed silently and decided to summon Madame Hela’s messenger later.
unit.target: Franca silenter suspiravit et deinceps nuntium Dominae Helae evocare decrevit.
