unit.source: She would inform the vice president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society about the School of Truth’s vortex operation and the True Creator’s role in the catastrophe at Cordu, and request a gathering of all members soon.
unit.target: Illa vice praesidem Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis de operatione vorticosa Scholae Veritatis et de munere Veritatis Conditoris in clade Cordu certiorem faciet, atque celeriter congregationem omnium membrorum postulabit.

unit.source: It wasn’t that she wanted to publicly warn all members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society at the gathering about the True Creator and the Ancient Sun God.
unit.target: Non enim voluit omnes membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis in congressu de Veritate Conditore et de Deo Solis Antiquo publice monere.

unit.source: Certain matters could become catastrophic if people below a certain level knew about them.
unit.target: Res quaedam catastrophicae fieri possunt, si homines infra certum gradum de illis scirent.

unit.source: After all, that entity possessed the ability to know whenever He was mentioned.
unit.target: Denique, illa entitas facultatem habebat scire quoties de eo diceretur.

unit.source: Franca hoped to raise the vigilance of Hela and the other organizers of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society before indirectly alerting the other members through them.
unit.target: Franca sperabat Helae et reliquorum organizatorum Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis vigilantiam augere, antequam per eos alii membra indirecte certiores fierent.

unit.source: Furthermore, Franca found the Overseer of the School of Truth formidable, but that wasn’t the most terrifying aspect about her and her accomplices.
unit.target: Praeterea, Franca superintendantem Scholae Veritatis formidolosum invenit, sed non id erat maxime terribile de ea et sociis eius.

unit.source: Franca’s greatest unease stemmed from the Broker’s ability and willingness to unite the evil god sects, which had been in disarray, fighting independently and even attacking each other.
unit.target: Maxima Francae perturbatio ex facultate ac voluntate Brokeris orta est, qui congregare poterat sectas maleficarum deorum, quae in confusione erant, singillatim pugnantes atque inter se etiam oppugnantes.

unit.source: The Hostel plan was the embryonic form of such a change, and perhaps the vortex incident represented the outcome in a stepped sequence.
unit.target: Consilium Hospitii forma embryonica huiusmodi mutationis erat, et fortasse incidentia vortex gradatim exitum repraesentabant.

unit.source: Facing the evil god cults that had begun to collaborate, Franca wanted the factions she associated herself with to take action and collaborate as well.
unit.target: Opposita cultuum maleficarum deorum, quae collaborare inceperant, Franca voluit ut factiones quibus se associaverat agerent et cooperarent.

unit.source: To this end, she was willing to share information about the vortex and the Mirror People with Madame Hela, a demigod likely backed by the Evernight Church, free of charge.
unit.target: Ad hoc, parata erat informationes de vortex et de Hominibus Specularibus cum Domina Hela, semideo probabiliter Ecclesiae Noctis Perpetuae innixae, libere communicare.

unit.source: She had already written and sought Madam Judgment’s opinion on this matter, and her response was affirmative.
unit.target: Iamdudum scripserat et Domina Iudicii sententiam de hac re petiverat, cui responsum erat affirmatum.

unit.source: “How is he now?”
unit.target: «Quomodo nunc se habet?»

unit.source: Franca asked with concern, contemplating whether to drink with Lumian until dawn to express her support and comfort him.
unit.target: Franca sollicite interrogavit, meditando an cum Lumiano usque ad auroram bibere vellet, ut suum favorem exprimat atque eum consolaret.

unit.source: “He’s fine for now,”
unit.target: «Nunc bene est,»

unit.source: Jenna replied after a few seconds of contemplation.
unit.target: Jenna post paucas momenta considerationis respondit.

unit.source: “Perhaps it’s also because the one the Aurora Order believes in is far superior to him.
unit.target: «Fortasse etiam quia ille, in quem Ordo Aurorae credit, longe praestantior ei est,

unit.source: Although the hatred is real, it’s very intangible and can’t be acted upon for a long time.”
unit.target: Etsi odium verum est, tamen intangibile est et per longum tempus in actum non veniat.»

unit.source: She had authority to speak on such matters.
unit.target: Ipsius auctoritas erat de talibus rebus loquendi.

unit.source: Franca tersely acknowledged her words and contemplated her next move.
unit.target: Franca verba eius breviter agnovit et de sequenti actu cogitavit.

unit.source: At dawn, Franca visited Clarice immediately and reported her encounter to the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Aurora orto, Franca statim Claricem visitavit et congressum suum cum Daemona Nigra referuit.

unit.source: The latter expressed her approval and inquired about Franca’s recent needs.
unit.target: Illa approbationem suam demonstravit et de necessitatibus Francae recentes quaesivit.

unit.source: Franca didn’t stand on ceremony and mentioned her desire for the ingredients for the Affliction potion.
unit.target: Franca non ritus sequebatur et desiderium suum de ingredientibus potionis “Affliction” enuntiavit.

unit.source: Back then, the Demoness of Black didn’t agree or reject her request.
unit.target: Tunc, Daemona Nigra nec petitioni eius assensit nec recusavit.

unit.source: She only instructed Franca to visit in two days and to find the Mirror People that Moran Avigny had mentioned as soon as possible.
unit.target: Illa solum imperavit Francam ut intra duas dies adveniret et ut Hominibus Specularibus, quos Moran Avigny commemoraverat, quam primum inveniret.

unit.source: She could provide any assistance Franca needed.
unit.target: Illa omnem auxilium quod Francae opus esset praebere poterat.

unit.source: As for the Mirror People that Moran Avigny had mentioned—Griffith, Palia, and Caratanza Tamara—none of them used their real names in reality.
unit.target: Quoad Homines Speculares, quos Moran Avigny commemoraverat – Griffith, Palia, et Caratanza Tamara – nullus eorum nomina vera utebatur.

unit.source: They could only rely on their unclear identities to investigate.
unit.target: Tantum in identitatibus obscuris inniti poterant ad indagandum.

unit.source: Franca hoped to obtain official “assistance” through 007, and she also wanted to see if there were any members of the Moses Ascetic Order in the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
unit.target: Franca sperabat auxilii officialis per 007 obtinere, et etiam videre si quid membra Ordinis Asceticici Moysi in Societate Inquisitionis Papionum Capilatis Crispatis exstiterent.

unit.source: This was one of the reasons why she had requested a full-scale gathering soon.
unit.target: Hoc unum ex causis erat cur mox plenam congregationem petiverat.

unit.source: The only Mirror Person who could be identified was Trier’s Deputy Commissioner of Police, Sport.
unit.target: Unicus Hominum Specularis agnoscibilis fuit, Trevirensis vicarius praefectus vigilantiae, Sport.

unit.source: Franca had investigated the situation before dawn and realized that the Mirror Person had vanished.
unit.target: Franca ante auroram rem exploravit et animadvertit Hominem Specularum evanuisse.

unit.source: It appeared that the fleeing Overseer had used some method to alert the Mirror People.
unit.target: Apparuit fugitivum superintendantem aliquo modo utefuisse ut Homines Speculares certiores facerent.

unit.source: For example, news of Moran Avigny’s accident had quickly spread.
unit.target: Exempli causa, nuntius de casu Moran Avigny celeriter diffusus est.

unit.source: After downing the last of the absinthe and saying goodbye to Jenna, Lumian rubbed his temples and headed back to his bedroom.
unit.target: Postquam ultimam absynthiam deglutivit et Jennae valedixit, Lumian tempora sua sustulit et ad cubiculum suum rediit.

unit.source: Under the crimson moonlight pouring through the curtains, he noticed a folded letter on the table.
unit.target: Sub lumine lunari rubeo per cortinas effluente, animadvertit epistulam plicatam super mensam.

unit.source: Madam Magician?
unit.target: Domina Magica?

unit.source: Didn’t she just leave not too long ago?
unit.target: Nonne nuper discesserat?

unit.source: Lumian frowned and picked up the letter.
unit.target: Lumian frontem contraxit et epistulam sustulit.

unit.source: It was indeed from Madam Magician, with a few short paragraphs:
unit.target: Id certe erat a Domina Magica, cum paucis parvis paragraphis:

unit.source: “I forgot to mention we ran into Loki while tracking the School of Truth’s Overseer.
unit.target: «Oblitus sum dicere nos Lokim occurrisse, dum Superintendantem Scholae Veritatis sequeremur.

unit.source: “His condition has changed significantly.
unit.target: «Status eius notabiliter mutatus est.

unit.source: It seems something went wrong during his resurrection after the sea prayer ritual.
unit.target: Videtur aliquid in resurrectione eius post ritum orationis maritimae male evenisse.

unit.source: This led to the owner of Castle Dylan, the former Secret Order leader, being resurrected inside him somehow.
unit.target: Hoc effecit ut dominus Castelli Dylan, pristinus dux Ordinis Secretorum, quacumque ratione intra eum ressurrectus esset.

unit.source: “Zaratul has come back from the dead and become the Celestial Worthy’s attendant.
unit.target: «Zaratul ex mortuis rediit atque factus est adiutor Caelestis Digni.

unit.source: Right, but He hasn’t fully taken over Loki’s body, and Loki hasn’t died completely.
unit.target: Recte, sed ille corpus Loki non penitus occupavit, et Loki non omnino mortuus est.

unit.source: This has turned them into an unstable, stitched-together monster in mind and soul.
unit.target: Hoc eos in monstrum instabilem, diversis partibus consitum, mente et anima vertit.

unit.source: “For now, don’t try finding Castle Dylan and expending Loki’s remaining resurrection.
unit.target: «Nunc, noli quaerere Castellum Dylan neque resurrectionem residualem Loki consumere.

unit.source: It’s best to avoid any situations where he could track you down.”
unit.target: Optimum est vitare quaelibet casus in quibus ille te deprehendere possit.»

unit.source: Zaratul…
unit.target: Zaratul…

unit.source: Franca had said the former Secret Order leader played a major role in Emperor Roselle’s rise, but ultimately betrayed the Emperor…
unit.target: Franca dixit pristinum ducem Ordinis Secretorum maximum momentum egisse in ortu Imperatoris Roselle, sed demum Imperatorem prodidisse…

unit.source: The Sauron family’s Vermonda Sauron seemed to have gone insane from His and the Emperor’s schemes, prompting Him to enter Fourth Epoch Trier alone…
unit.target: Vermonda Sauron, ex familia Sauron, ut videtur, insanivit propter consilia Eius et Imperatoris, quod eum impulit ut solus in Aetas Quartam Trevirensis intraret…

unit.source: Is Loki considered half-dead now?
unit.target: Nuncne Loki semimortuus censetur?

unit.source: When Zaratul fully controls his body, he should be completely dead.
unit.target: Cum Zaratul corpus eius plene regnet, omnino mortuus esse debet.

unit.source: What a shame…
unit.target: Heu, quam miserrimum!

unit.source: Lumian regretted not finishing off Loki’s final life himself, but didn’t feel too disappointed or indignant.
unit.target: Lumian paenitebat se non ultimam vitam Loki finivisse, sed neque valde contrariatus neque indignatus est.

unit.source: He had already caused Loki’s demise twice, after all!
unit.target: Iam bis mortem Loki effecit, postremo!

unit.source: After burning the letter, Lumian pondered for a moment, then left the bedroom.
unit.target: Post epistulam combusam, Lumian paulisper cogitavit, tum cubiculum reliquit.

unit.source: He sat across from Ludwig, who wore yellow cotton pajamas and a matching nightcap, watching the boy quickly nibble on a cold bone-in steak.
unit.target: Ille consedit adversus Ludovicum, qui indutus erat in pajamas ex flavo cotone et pileo nocturno convenienti, et spectabat puerum celeriter in carnem frigidam cum osse mordere.

unit.source: Ludwig stayed unfazed by Lumian’s gaze, continuing his feast.
unit.target: Ludwig immotus a conspectu Lumiani mansit, et festum suum continuavit.

unit.source: After nearly a minute, Lumian probed, “Are you willing to call me Godfather?”
unit.target: Post paulo, circa minutam, Lumian interrogavit: “Visne me padrinum appellare?”

unit.source: Ludwig glanced up at him, then lowered his head, scooped up some banana puree, and spooned it into his mouth.
unit.target: Ludwig eum aspiciens, deinde caput inclinavit, aliquantum pulpae bananae sumpsit et cochlearium in os introduxit.

unit.source: Lumian changed the question.
unit.target: Lumian quaestionem mutavit.

unit.source: “Are you willing to follow my orders, accept my commands, and build a tacit understanding here?”
unit.target: «Visne mea mandata sequi, iussa mea accipere atque hic tacitam intelligentiam condere?»

unit.source: This time, Ludwig didn’t even look up, his mouth constantly moving.
unit.target: Hoc tempore Ludwig neque oculos sustulit, cum os eius constanter moveretur.

unit.source: Lumian silently watched as he slowly took something out of his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian silentiose spectabat dum lente aliquid ex sacco Viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: It was a mercury eyeball in a glass jar—a Sequence 7 Lucky One Beyonder characteristic of the Monster pathway.
unit.target: Erat oculus mercurii in vaso vitreo—characteristica “Sequens 7 Lucky One Beyonder” viae Monstrorum.

unit.source: It had re-condensed after the Flog boxing gloves shattered.
unit.target: Erat re-condensata, postquam guantiae pugilisticae Flog confractae erant.

unit.source: Ludwig immediately looked up.
unit.target: Ludwig statim aspicuit.

unit.source: Ignoring Ludwig’s gaze, Lumian leisurely pulled out the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic and a few other items, placing them on the dining table in front of him.
unit.target: Neglegens aspectum Ludovici, Lumian tranquille extraxit characteristicam “Serial Killer Beyonder” et alias paucas res, eas in mensa ante se collocavit.

unit.source: Then, he smiled at Ludwig, who wore the yellow cotton nightcap, and said, “Are you willing to call me Godfather?”
unit.target: Deinde illi subridet Ludovico, qui indutus erat in pileo nocturno ex flavo cotone, et dixit: “Visne me padrinum appellare?”

unit.source: Ludwig fell silent for a few seconds before saying in a low voice, “Godfather.”
unit.target: Ludwig per paucos momenta tacebat, deinde voce humiliter dixit: “Padrinus.”

unit.source: Lumian probed further, “Are you willing to follow my orders, accept my commands, and build a tacit understanding here?”
unit.target: Lumian ulterius interrogavit: “Visne mea mandata sequi, iussa mea accipere atque hic tacitam intelligentiam condere?”

unit.source: Without hesitation, Ludwig replied, “I am.”
unit.target: Sine mora, Ludwig respondit: “Ego sum.”

unit.source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
unit.target: Auctores in WebNovel directe sustinete!

unit.source: As he spoke, his eyes were fixed on the pile of items before Lumian.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, oculi eius in acervum rerum ante Luminam constituti erant.

unit.source: Sigh…
unit.target: Suspirum…

unit.source: Lumian sighed silently.
unit.target: Lumian tacite suspiravit.

unit.source: He could rely on “food” to control someone, but couldn’t rely solely on “food.”
unit.target: Potuit ex “cibo” inniti ad aliquem regendum, sed non potuit solummodo in “cibo” inniti.

unit.source: Otherwise, it’d be so easy for Ludwig to ignore him when there was no “food” around.
unit.target: Alio modo, facile esset ut Ludwig eum ignoraret, cum “cibus” nullus adesset.

unit.source: This likely didn’t meet an Iron-blooded Knight’s ritual requirements.
unit.target: Hoc verisimiliter non convenit requisitis ritualibus equitis ferro-sanguinei.

unit.source: Deep in thought, Lumian pointed at the pile and smiled.
unit.target: Profunde cogitans, Lumian ad acervum intendit et subridet.

unit.source: “Since you’ve admitted to being my godson, you can choose one item.
unit.target: «Quoniam agnovisti te meum padrinum esse, unam rem eligere potes;

unit.source: “But there’s a condition.
unit.target: sed condicio est:

unit.source: You have to answer two or three of my questions.”
unit.target: quod oportet ut duo vel tria ex meis quaestionibus respondeas.»

unit.source: Ludwig hesitated a moment, then spoke with a stern look, “Okay.”
unit.target: Ludwig parvo tempore hesitavit, deinde vultu severo dixit: “Bene.”

unit.source: “Which one do you want?”
unit.target: «Quod vis eligere?»

unit.source: Lumian asked kindly.
unit.target: Lumian benigne rogavit.

unit.source: Looking around, Ludwig yearned for every item, but was reluctant to abandon any.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, Ludwig omnem rem desideravit, sed ullam relinquere non voluit.

unit.source: Finally overcoming himself, he pointed at the Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic and said, “That one!”
unit.target: Denique se superans, illam characteristicam “Serial Killer Beyonder” indicavit et dixit: “Illa!”

unit.source: You really want that Beyonder characteristic…
unit.target: Revera illam characteristicam Beyonder tibi desideras…

unit.source: Can it be turned into some magical dish or cocktail?
unit.target: Possitne illa in aliquam magnam potionem aut ferculum magicum converti?

unit.source: Lumian put away the other items and smiled at Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian reliquas res removit et Ludovicum adspiciens subridet.

unit.source: “First question:
unit.target: «Prima quaestio:

unit.source: “What pathway does your Beyonder power belong to? What are its characteristics? What’s your rough Sequence level?”
unit.target: «Ad quam viam pertinet potentia tua Beyonder? Quae sunt eius proprietates? Quid est gradus tuus in Sequentia approximatus?»

unit.source: He hoped to gain inspiration for taming the sealed Angel based on Ludwig’s Beyonder pathway information.
unit.target: Sperabat ut ex informatione de via Beyonder Ludovici inspirationem caperet ad Angelum sigillatum domandum.

unit.source: Ludwig muttered under his breath, “That’s three questions.”
unit.target: Ludwig submurmuravit: “Tres quaestiones sunt.”

unit.source: Lumian pretended not to hear.
unit.target: Lumian simulavit non audire.

unit.source: Seeing his protests were futile, Ludwig could only pick up some beef and mutton to munch on.
unit.target: Videns protestationes eius inutiles esse, Ludwig solum carnem bovinam et ovinam sumere potuit ad edendum.

unit.source: He mumbled, “Yes, yes…”
unit.target: Murmuravit: “Ita, ita…”

unit.source: It seemed he couldn’t recall the original name, so he had to find another term for it.
unit.target: Videbatur non posse nomen originale meminisse, ita alterum vocabulum invenire debuit.

unit.source: “It’s the Gourmet pathway.”
unit.target: «Est via gastronomica.»

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
unit.target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

unit.source: “No wonder you’re always acting like you’re savoring delicacies and ingredients.”
unit.target: «Non mirum quod semper te geris quasi delicatias et ingredientes degustares.»

unit.source: Ludwig added earnestly, “To put it simply, it’s a way to get superpowers by being hungry and eating.
unit.target: Ludwig addidit ardenter: “Ut dicam simpliciter, est via ad vires supernas adipisci fame et edendo.

unit.source: “What corresponds to your Sequence 9 is Tramp. You lose everything and are always searching for food, barely surviving.”
unit.target: Quod pertinet ad Sequentiam Nonam, est vagabundus; omnia perdis et semper cibum quaeris, vix vivis.”

unit.source: Could you be the ultimate Tramp embodiment?
unit.target: Potesne esse summa incarnatio vagabundi?

unit.source: You’d even lost your mind, only never forgetting to eat…
unit.target: Etiam mentem amisisses, sed edendi consuetudinem numquam oblitus es.

unit.source: From that description, I can’t tell what abilities a Tramp has…
unit.target: Ex hac descriptione non possum discernere quae virtutes vagabundi sint…

unit.source: But Lumian didn’t mock him.
unit.target: Sed Lumian eum non deridebat.

unit.source: Rather than detail the Tramp Sequence, Ludwig said, “Sequence 8 is Glutton.”
unit.target: Pro minutissime enarranda Sequentia Vagabundi, Ludwig dixit: “Sequentia Octava est Gulosus.”

unit.source: Chapter 740: Depriver
unit.target: Capitulum 740: Depriver

unit.source: Translator: CKtalon
unit.target: Interpretator: CKtalon

unit.source: “Glutton?” Lumian said approvingly, “Quite the image.”
unit.target: «Gulosus?» inquit Lumian approbans, «Imago praeclara.»

unit.source: Ludwig ignored Lumian’s mockery and continued with the brief introduction, “At this Sequence, hunger truly becomes ingrained in our bodies, allowing us to evolve around it.”
unit.target: Ludwig derisionem Lumiani neglexit et cum brevi introductione pergit: «In hac Sequence, fames vere in corporibus nostris insita fit, quae nos circa eam evolvere sinit.»

unit.source: “What kinds of evolutions are there?” Lumian was concerned that Ludwig would only mention this about Gluttons, just as he had described the Tramp Sequence. Therefore, he took the initiative to inquire.
unit.target: «Quales evolutiones sunt?» Lumian anxius erat ne Ludwig hanc rem solum de Gulosis referret, sicut de Sequence Vagabundi exposuerat. Ergo initium sumens interrogare coepit.

unit.source: Ludwig paused for a few seconds to swallow his food.
unit.target: Ludwig pauca secunda subsistebat ut cibum suum deglutiret.

unit.source: Then, he stuffed a small piece of lemon cake into his mouth and replied in a muffled manner,
unit.target: Tum parvum frustum placentae citreae in os replevit et modo submurmurato respondit:

unit.source: “Internal organs that are better suited for digesting food and absorbing energy. Stronger, more powerful teeth, a bite force and appetite that exceed normal limits…
unit.target: Organa interna, quae melius sunt ad cibum digerendum ac energiam absorbendam; dentes fortiores et potentiores, vis mordendi et appetitus qui limites normales superant…

unit.source: “This will help us obtain different abilities from food more efficiently. We won’t have to worry about being affected by the toxins, viruses, and bacteria that food brings.”
unit.target: Hoc adiuvabit nos ad diversas facultates ex cibo efficacius adipiscendas. Non erimus solliciti ne toxinibus, virus, et bacteriis quae cibus affert, afficiamur.

unit.source: “In other words, even if it’s highly toxic, as long as you consume it with your mouth and treat it as food, you won’t die from the poison?” Lumian suddenly felt that Ludwig would make a suitable assistant for Apothecaries.
unit.target: «Aliis verbis, etsi summopere toxicum sit, dummodo ore utaris et id tamquam cibum habeas, non morieris ex veneno?» Lumian subito sensit Ludovicum fore aptum adiutorem Apothecarum.

unit.source: Ludwig took a sip of milk and shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig lac suscepit et caput concussit.

unit.source: “We can’t exceed a certain limit. Many Gluttons die from eating random stuff.”
unit.target: «Non possumus certum terminum superare. Multi Gulosi ex fortuito edendo moriuntur.»

unit.source: And you’re not eating random stuff? Lumian scoffed inwardly.
unit.target: «Et tu non edis res fortuitas?» Lumian intus subridens.

unit.source: At the same time, he inwardly sighed.
unit.target: Simul autem intus suspiravit.

unit.source: This guy is quite honest. He’s indeed like a child most of the time. He actually forgot to protest that I had asked additional questions.
unit.target: Hic vir satis honestus est. Vere plerumque puero similis est. Revera oblitus est protestari quod plura quaesiveram.

unit.source: Ludwig set down the milk bottle and picked up a box of cookies.
unit.target: Ludwig deposuit vas lactis et cistam crustularum elexit.

unit.source: Amidst the munching sounds, he continued, “The corresponding Sequence 7 is Gourmet.
unit.target: Inter sonos masticandi, pergit: «Sequencia 7 correspondens est Gourmet.»

unit.source: “At this level, our digestion and eating abilities will improve further. We can discern which ingredients are edible, which are inedible, which ingredients can bring about special effects, and which ingredients need to be combined with others.”
unit.target: «Ad hoc gradu, facultates nostrae digestionis et edendi ulterius meliorabuntur. Possumus discernere quae sint edibilia, quae inedibilia, quae ingredientes effectus speciales efficiant, et quae cum aliis componenda sint.»

unit.source: Lumian thought seriously before asking, “Is extracting the corresponding information from the consumed food one of a Gourmet’s abilities?”
unit.target: Lumian serio meditatus est, antequam rogavit: «Num ex cibo consumpto informationem congruentem extrahere una ex facultatibus Gourmet sit?»

unit.source: This ability had helped Lumian a great deal.
unit.target: Haec facultas Lumiani multum adiuvit.

unit.source: Ludwig, donning a thick yellow cotton nightcap, nodded obediently. “Yes.”
unit.target: Ludwig, indutus crasso pileo nocturni flavi ex lina, oboedienter annuit: «Ita.»

unit.source: He didn’t elaborate on the corresponding abilities.
unit.target: Non de facultatibus correspondentibus amplius disseruit.

unit.source: “Although a Gourmet is useful, I can sense that at this Sequence, you lack sufficient combat strength. Yes, perhaps Tramp will grant you a certain level of street fighting abilities,” Lumian commented from his own perspective.
unit.target: «Etsi Gourmet utilis est, sentio te in hac Sequence vim pugnandi non satis habere. Ita, fortasse Tramp tibi aliquod gradum artes pugnae viaticae conferet,» commentatus est Lumian ex sua sententia.

unit.source: Ludwig didn’t argue, nor did he bother to. How could delicacies already in his mouth or subsequent delicacies be less important than what he was talking about?
unit.target: Ludwig non disputavit, nec curavit. Quomodo deliciae iam in ore ejus aut quae postea venturi essent minus momenti quam ea de quibus loquebatur?

unit.source: He peeled a lollipop and placed it in his mouth, a hint of enjoyment on his face.
unit.target: Ludwig lollipopum exscindit et in os posuit, vultu paulo gaudio tincto.

unit.source: “Beyond that is what you call Sequence 6—Chef.”
unit.target: «Ultra hoc est quod vocatur Sequencia VI—Chef.»

unit.source: “I thought it was Bartender,” Lumian teased.
unit.target: «Putabam eum esse Bartender,» arridebat Lumian.

unit.source: Ludwig pondered seriously and said, “Chefs cover a wider range. It’s not like they can only make cocktails.”
unit.target: Ludwig serio meditatus est et dixit: «Chefi latam varietatem complectuntur; non est, ut solum cocktailas praeparare possint.»

unit.source: Lumian nodded pensively.
unit.target: Lumian pensative annuit.

unit.source: “Is a Chef’s ability to use special ingredients to create mystical dishes, pastries, drinks, and cocktails?”
unit.target: «Num facultas Chef ingrediens speciales ad creandas mysticas cenationes, pastillas, potiones, et cocktailas sit?»

unit.source: Ludwig had displayed this ability numerous times.
unit.target: Ludwig hanc facultatem saepius ostendit.

unit.source: Ludwig couldn’t help but reveal a smug expression.
unit.target: Ludwig vultum superbum revelare non potuit.

unit.source: “That’s right. Every Chef has different characteristics and abilities due to the ingredients they’ve obtained and the food they’ve prepared.
unit.target: «Recte dicis. Unusquisque Chef diversas proprietates et facultates habet ex ingredientibus adeptis et cibis praeparatis.»

unit.source: “Chefs have one thing in common: they have excellent skills in processing ingredients. This includes finding weaknesses and techniques like cutting, chopping, and slicing.”
unit.target: «Chefi unum commune habent: artes praeclarae in tractando ingredientia. Hoc includit reperiendi infirmitates et technicas, ut secandi, concindendi, atque laniandi.»

unit.source: Only at this Sequence would one from the Gourmet pathway truly possess combat strength… However, a Chef is similar to a Contractee. Their actual combat strength depends on their synergy of abilities. The upper limit is very high, and the lower limit is very low… Lumian, thinking of a Contractee, asked curiously, “Is there a limit to the number of permanent effects a Chef can obtain through various mystical foods?”
unit.target: Solum in hac Sequence veram vim pugnandi obtinet aliquis ex via Gourmet… Attamen, Chef similis est Contractee. Vires verae in proelio pendent ex synergia facultatum eorum. Terminus superior valde altus, et inferior valde humilis est… Lumian, de Contractee cogitans, curiose rogavit: «Num terminus sit ad numerum effectuum permanentium quos Chef per varias mysticas cibos adipiscere possit?»

unit.source: As for the negative effects, Lumian, who had eaten Ice Lemon Fish fillet before, had a deep understanding.
unit.target: Quoad effectus negativos, Lumian, qui antea filettum piscium citrei glacialis edisset, profundam intellegentiam habebat.

unit.source: Depending on the ingredients and finished products, mystical dishes or cocktails brought different negative effects, but they were significantly weaker than those a Contractee experienced.
unit.target: Secundum ingredientes et producta perfecta, fercula mystica aut cocktailae effectus negativos diversos afferebant, sed significanter debiliores erant quam illi, quos Contractee expertus est.

unit.source: “No.” Ludwig quickly shook his head. “As long as you fully embrace hunger and greed, there won’t be an upper limit.”
unit.target: «Minime.» Ludwig celeriter caput concussit. «Dummodo fames et avaritiam plene amplectaris, terminus superior non erit.»

unit.source: This upper limit is a little crazy… However, this also means that there’s no limit to the number of negative effects. Even if each one is far inferior to the ones brought about by a Contractee, they will undergo a qualitative change after stacking… Lumian pondered for a moment and looked at Ludwig, who had roughly finished his meal.
unit.target: Hic terminus superior aliquantum insanus est… Attamen hoc etiam significat nullum finem esse ad numerum effectuum negativorum. Etiamsi unusquisque longe inferior erit illis quos Contractee afferre potest, post aggregationem mutationem qualitatem subibit… Lumian paulisper meditatus est et in Ludovicum aspexit, qui fere suum cibum consumpsisset.

unit.source: “That first time we met, when I saw you chowing down on rats, were you just a Glutton or a Gourmet?”
unit.target: «Prima vice cum te vidissem mures vorantes, num solum Gulosus fuisti aut Gourmet?»

unit.source: Ludwig didn’t try to hide anything.
unit.target: Ludwig nihil occultare conatus est.

unit.source: “Gourmet.”
unit.target: «Gourmet.»

unit.source: Indeed, he’d been critiquing the dishes I served him… Lumian pondered for a moment, then said, “Did you recover to Chef status during that Batings Black Insect incident?”
unit.target: Revera, fercula quae ei servivi criticarat… Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde dixit: «Recuperavistine statum Chef tempore illius incidentis Insecti Nigri Batings?»

unit.source: Ludwig curtly confirmed it.
unit.target: Ludwig breviter id confirmavit.

unit.source: “I was just short to begin with. Eating a Batings Black Insect was all it took to advance.”
unit.target: «Initio modo caret eram. Manducare Insectum Niger Batings tantum erat ad progrediendum.»

unit.source: “What’s the next Sequence?” Lumian steered the conversation back on track.
unit.target: «Quae est sequens Sequence?» Lumian sermonem iterum in ordinem redigebat.

unit.source: Ludwig dredged up the memories.
unit.target: Ludwig memorias revocavit.

unit.source: “It’s Depriver.”
unit.target: «Est Depriver.»

unit.source: “Depriver?” Lumian immediately thought of the Deprivation Bullet he’d gotten from Jebus.
unit.target: «Depriver?» Lumian statim meminit Teli Deprivationis, quod a Jebus acceperat.

unit.source: Could this be a transaction from the cult of the Gourmet pathway?
unit.target: Num hoc fieri potest commercium ex cultu viae Gourmet?

unit.source: Ludwig thought Lumian wanted him to explain the Depriver’s abilities.
unit.target: Ludwig putavit Lumian eum velle facultates Depriver explicare.

unit.source: He recounted, “A Depriver can strip one to three abilities from a target for a period of time. If they then consume part of the target’s flesh, they permanently gain one of those abilities, and the target permanently loses it unless they drink a potion again or kill me—no, the corresponding Depriver.
unit.target: Narravit: «Depriver potest e obiecto unam ad tres facultates pro certo tempore auferri. Si deinde partem carnis obiecti consumat, permanenter unam ex his facultatibus adipiscitur, et obiectum eam permanentiter amittit, nisi potionem iterum bibat aut Depriver congruus occidatur.»

unit.source: “At Depriver, our recipes get way more range. A ton of formerly inedible things become food. We can consume things we previously couldn’t.”
unit.target: «Ad Depriver, recetas nostras longe ampliamus. Multa, quae olim inedibilia erant, in cibum vertuntur. Possumus edere res quas antea edere non poderamus.»

unit.source: “Give me an example?” Lumian wasn’t sure his interpretation matched Ludwig’s intentions.
unit.target: «Exemplum, quaeso?» Lumian non certo erat an interpretatio eius cum propositis Ludovici concurreret.

unit.source: Ludwig looked at him and offered two examples.
unit.target: Ludwig eum aspexit et duo exempla proposuit.

unit.source: “Corruption to a certain degree, as well as fireballs, lightning, and other energy forms.”
unit.target: «Corruptio ad certum gradum, necnon globuli ignis, fulmina, et aliae formae energiae.»

unit.source: They can eat way more dangerous stuff and consume things that shouldn’t even be considered food… Lumian thought of an enemy he’d faced at the Hostel and something Ludwig just mentioned. He asked for confirmation, “So that ability to process ingredients includes those ingredients too?”
unit.target: Possunt edere res multo periculosa et consumere quidquid cibus esse non debet… Lumian de inimico, quem apud Hostel occurrerat, et de re nuper a Ludovico dicta cogitavit. Confirmare quaesivit: «Itaque illa facultas tractandi ingredientes etiam eos ingredientes includit?»

unit.source: “Yes,” Ludwig admitted candidly.
unit.target: «Ita,» Ludovico pro certo confitebatur.

unit.source: Lumian pulled the matte Deprivation Bullet from his Traveler’s Bag and set it on the dining table.
unit.target: Lumian telum Deprivationis mateum e sacco viatoris extraxit et in mensa posuit.

unit.source: “This is from a Depriver?”
unit.target: «Hoc a Depriver provenit?»

unit.source: Ludwig’s eyes lit up.
unit.target: Oculi Ludovici fulserunt.

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: «Ita.»

unit.source: He said anxiously, “Can I… can I use it as a prize? I don’t want that Beyonder characteristic anymore!”
unit.target: Anxie dixit: «Possumne eam uti tamquam praemium? Illam qualitatem Beyonder amplius nolo!»

unit.source: “I think Beyonder characteristics are way more valuable,” Lumian deliberately provoked him.
unit.target: «Putō enim qualitates Beyonder longe pretiosiores esse,» provocavit Lumian.

unit.source: Ludwig looked sad and said reluctantly, “But I can only choose one.
unit.target: Ludwig tristis aspiciens, haesitans, dixit: «Sed una tantum eligere possum.»

unit.source: “I can’t actually consume Beyonder characteristics yet. I can only use them as ingredients for now.”
unit.target: «Nondum vere qualitates Beyonder consumere possum; solum ut ingredientes adhibere ea possum.»

unit.source: Is that right… Lumian eyed Ludwig and organized his thoughts.
unit.target: Num ita sit… Lumian Ludovicum intuebatur et cogitationes suas ordinabat.

unit.source: “How much more do you need to eat to recover to Depriver?”
unit.target: «Quantum adhuc edendum est, ut ad Depriver recupere possis?»

unit.source: “The further along I go, the harder it gets. I can’t just eat a ton. I need higher quality, higher energy foods.” Ludwig pointed at the Deprivation Bullet. “I’d need at least 200 of these bullets to reach Depriver.”
unit.target: «Quo longius proficio, eo difficilius fit. Non possum tantum in multitudinem edere; mihi opus sunt ciborum altioris qualitatis et energiae.» Ludovigo ad Telum Deprivationis demonstravit. «Saltem ducentos ex his telis ad Depriver pervenire oporteret.»

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and whispered devilishly, “What if you ate the Depriver who made this bullet?”
unit.target: Lumian risu molli et subdolum susurrans dixit: «Quid si Depriver, qui hoc telum fecit, ederes?»

unit.source: “I could recover immediately!” Ludwig’s eyes lit up.
unit.target: «Statim recuperei possem!» Oculi Ludovici fulserunt.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile widened.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani latius factus est.

unit.source: “You don’t seem to have strong offensive abilities. I can help you get the stuff to capture the corresponding Beyonders, but you gotta listen to me and do what I say before I become a demigod. We need to be totally in sync.
unit.target: «Non vides te artes offensivas validas habere. Te adiuvare possum ut res ad capiendum respectivos Beyonder tibi adipiscaris, sed oportet me audire et quod dicturus sim facere, antequam ego semideus fiam. Omnino coniungamur.»

unit.source: “That’s my promise. You gonna hold up your end of the deal?”
unit.target: «Hoc meum promissum est. Tu partem tuam pacti sustinebis?»

unit.source: Ludwig hesitated a moment before reluctantly nodding.
unit.target: Ludwig paulisper dubitavit antequam reluctanter annuit.

unit.source: “Deal.”
unit.target: «Pactum.»

unit.source: Phew, stay calm… This is just the start of the “taming,” not the end. Long process ahead… Lumian suppressed his smile and asked curiously, “Who were you following back then?”
unit.target: Eheu, mane tranquillus… Hoc solum initium est "domandi", non finis. Longum iter ante nos est… Lumian risum suum cohibuit et curiose rogavit: «Quem tunc secutus es?»

unit.source: “No need for the full title. Just call them something like ‘the Great Mother.’”
unit.target: «Non opus est pleno titulo. Illos tantum appellas, ut "Magna Mater."»

unit.source: Ludwig was caught off guard.
unit.target: Ludwig inopinanter comprehensus est.

unit.source: His expression shifted a few times before tears streamed down his face. He wailed like a child.
unit.target: Vultus eius aliquoties mutatus est, antequam lacrimae per faciem eius effluere coeperunt. Velut puer clamavit.

unit.source: “I-I don’t remember!
unit.target: «N–non memini!»

unit.source: “I’ve forgotten. I’ve forgotten everything!”
unit.target: «Oblitus sum. Omnia oblitus sum!»

unit.source: Hearing his cries, Lugano emerged from the guest room in a thick coat.
unit.target: Auditis clamoribus eius, Lugano ex conclavi hospitum in crasso pallio emersit.

unit.source: The Doctor immediately noticed Lumian and asked in confusion, “Why is he crying?”
unit.target: Medicus statim Lumian animadvertit et, confusus, quaesivit: «Cur plorat?»

unit.source: Is this really the terrifying cannibal from the Dream Festival?
unit.target: Num vere hic est terribilis anthropophagus ex Festivitate Somniorum?

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian risu respondit.

unit.source: “I showed him delicacies but didn’t give him any.”
unit.target: «Illi fercula exquisita ostendi, sed nihil dedi.»

unit.source: “Alright…” Lugano looked between them in confusion before retreating back to his room.
unit.target: «Bene...» Lugano inter eos confusus aspexit, deinde ad conclavium suum rediit.

unit.source: Lugano’s brief appearance made Lumian remember an item, and he had a dangerous thought.
unit.target: Brevis apparitio Luganoi Lumiani rem memoriam fecerat, et periculosam cogitationem habuit.

unit.source: He pulled the remains of Omebella’s umbilical cord from his Traveler’s Bag and “consulted” Ludwig, who’d gradually stopped sobbing.
unit.target: Reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae e sacco viatoris extraxit et Ludwig consultavit, qui paulatim fletum desierat.

unit.source: “What dishes and cocktails could you make with this?”
unit.target: «Quae fercula et cocktailas ex hoc facere potes?»

unit.source: That umbilical cord left behind by the Great Mother’s Child of God was thought to be just an ingredient for charms, mystical items, and Beyonder weapons.
unit.target: Iste funiculus umbilicalis, relicta a Filio Dei Magnae Matris, existimabatur solum esse elementum pro talibus amuletis, rebus mysticis, et armis Beyonder.

unit.source: But now Lumian figured a Gourmet might see it differently.
unit.target: Sed nunc Lumian existimavit Gourmet eam aliter videre posse.

unit.source: Looking at Omebella’s umbilical cord remains, Ludwig licked his lips.
unit.target: Aspiciens reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae, Ludwig labra sua lambit.

unit.source: “It could make three types of food with different mystical effects.
unit.target: «Ex eo fieri possunt tres genera ciborum cum diversis effectibus mysticis.

unit.source: “One food would completely cure infertility.”
unit.target: «Unum cibus infertilitatis omnino curare posset.»

unit.source: “Don’t need that,” Lumian said in amusement. “What about the other two foods?”
unit.target: «Non opus est hoc,» inquit Lumian hilare, «quid de reliquis duobus cibis?»

unit.source: Ludwig said professionally, “One grants potent self-healing abilities, though inferior to a Vampire’s.
unit.target: Ludwig technicaliter dixit: «Unus facultates potentissimas auto-sanationis praebet, quamquam in potentia inferior ad vampiri.»

unit.source: “And another…”
unit.target: «Et alterum…»

unit.source: 741 “Appraisal”
unit.target: 741 “Aestimatio”

unit.source: 741 “Appraisal”
unit.target: 741 “Aestimatio”

unit.source: “What else does it do?”
unit.target: «Quid aliud facit?»

unit.source: Lumian, seeing Ludwig pause as if he had concerns, pressed for an answer.
unit.target: Lumian, Ludwicum morari quasi sollicito animo videns, instavit ut responsum daret.

unit.source: Ludwig stared at the piece of umbilical cord in front of Lumian and hesitated before replying, “It could somewhat alter your aura and lineage, making certain creatures without the necessary wisdom perceive you as a divine child of the ‘Great Mother.”
unit.target: Ludwig in particulam funiculi umbilicalis coram Lumiano aspexit et haesitavit antequam respondit: «Hoc aliquatenus tuam auram atque stirpem mutare potest, ita ut quaedam ingenia, carentia sapientia necessaria, te ut divinam prolem Magnae Matris percipiant.»

unit.source: Lumian’s expression grew more solemn.
unit.target: Vultus Lumiani gravior factus est.

unit.source: “So, you’re saying it could actually integrate the Child of God’s lineage into mine, even if it’s almost negligible?”
unit.target: «Ita ergo dicis posse vere stirpem Filii Dei in meam inserere, etiamsi ea fere exiguum videantur?»

unit.source: And this would fool creatures of low intelligence or those acting purely on instinct?
unit.target: Et hoc falleret creaturas parvae intelligentiae vel quae tantum instinctu agunt?

unit.source: “Yes.” Ludwig nodded earnestly. “That bit of lineage won’t change anything for you, and only creatures directly created by the ‘Great Mother’ or those who have received Her boons could sense it.”
unit.target: «Ita.» Ludwig sincere annuit. «Ea stirps nihil tibi mutabit; solum enim creaturae, quae directe a Magnae Matris creatae sunt aut quae beneficia Eius acceperunt, id percipere possunt.»

unit.source: This doesn’t sound very useful, but in special circumstances, it could be incredibly crucial.
unit.target: Hoc non valde utile videtur, sed in certis casibus incredibiliter momenti esse potest.

unit.source: Compared to curing infertility or enhancing self-healing, it has more room for imagination…
unit.target: Comparatum ad infertilitatis curandam aut ad auto-sanationem augendam, amplius locus imaginationi adest…

unit.source: Lumian weighed his words and asked, “What are the side effects?”
unit.target: Lumian verba sua deliberavit atque rogavit: «Quae sunt effectus laterales?»

unit.source: Could it change my gender? After all, the Great Mother’s’ Child of God, Omebella, seems to have been female.
unit.target: Poteritne genus meum mutare? Denique, proles Dei Magnae Matris, Omebella, videtur fuisse femina.

unit.source: Ludwig’s greedy gaze shifted from the umbilical cord back to Lumian, and he said regretfully, “For someone else, it might cause the ‘Great Mother’s’ Child of God to start developing inside them, but not for you. You just have to worry about the ‘Great Mother’ setting Her sights on you, really watching you.”
unit.target: Ludwig, aspectu avaro a funiculo umbilicali ad Lumianum reverto, paenitenter dixit: «Alio forsitan hoc efficiet ut proles Dei Magnae Matris in eo evolvatur, sed tibi non; solum cavendum est ne Magna Mater in te intendat, te vere observans.»

unit.source: Lumian was silent for a good twenty seconds before slowly stowing Omebella’s umbilical cord remains back into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian viginti secundos silentium tenuit, deinde lente reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae in sacculum Viatoris recondidit.

unit.source: He wasn’t in a hurry to have Ludwig use the remains to create food with special effects, planning instead to consult Madam Magician’s opinion before deciding.
unit.target: Non festinavit ut Ludwig reliquias ad cibum cum effectibus specialibus creandum adhibeat; potius consilium Dominae Magicarum quaerere constitui priusquam decerneret.

unit.source: He was willing to take risks, but he wasn’t reckless.
unit.target: Paratus erat pericula subire, sed non temerarius fuit.

unit.source: “Can I have it now?” Ludwig looked eagerly at the matte Deprivation Bullet.
unit.target: «Num nunc illam habeam?» Ludwig avidē ad pilam opacam “Deprivationis” respexit.

unit.source: “One last question.” Lumian smiled again, pulling out another item from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: «Una ultima quaestio.» Lumian iterum subridet, extrahens alterum rem ex sacculo Viatoris.

unit.source: It was a small glass vial containing ancient bloodstain powder.
unit.target: Erat parva ampulla vitrea, quae pulverem antiqui sanguinis maculae continebat.

unit.source: This came from Demon Warlock Burman, who was guided by a visitor from Resurrection Island named Harrison.
unit.target: Hoc provenit a Daemone Magico Burman, qui a viatore ex Insula Resurrectionis, nomine Harrison, ductus erat.

unit.source: He summoned a spirit named Arden from the depths of death and easily killed it, collecting its blood for a future ritual.
unit.target: Spiritum nomine Arden e profundis mortis evocavit et facile occidit, eiusque sanguinem ad futurum ritum colligens.

unit.source: Lumian got some of this bloodstain powder from his room.
unit.target: Lumian ex camera sua aliquod ex hoc pulvere antiqui sanguinis maculae obtinuit.

unit.source: Previously, Lumian had Franca conduct an investigation using Magic Mirror Divination, confirming that it truly came from the depths of the spirit world but yielded no further insights. Now, he wanted the Gourmet to taste it, to see if he could glean more important information.
unit.target: Antehac, Lumian Francam per Divinationem Speculi Magici inquisitionem gerere curavit, confirmans id vere ex profundis mundi spirituum provenire, sed nullas ulteriores notitias praestitisse; nunc autem volebat ut Gourmet id gustaret, ut videat an notitias magni momenti exhaurire possit.

unit.source: He remembered clearly; the people of Resurrection Island claimed they could die and revive repeatedly, never aging, and the secret was in their control over the markings from the depths of death.
unit.target: Clare meminit; populi Insulae Resurrectionis dicebant se posse mori et reviviscere saepius, numquam senescere, et secretum in sua potestate super signa e profundis mortis iacere.

unit.source: This might truly be a way to revive the dead.
unit.target: Forsitan vere via sit ad mortuos reviviscendos.

unit.source: “Is it edible?” Lumian maintained his smile as he pushed the glass vial with the ancient bloodstain powder towards Ludwig.
unit.target: «Num edule sit?» Lumian risum retinuit, dum ampullam vitream cum antiquo pulvere sanguinis maculae ad Ludwicum protraxit.

unit.source: Ludwig carefully examined the powder for a while and then opened the bottle cap, touching it a few times with his fingers.
unit.target: Ludwig pulverem aliquantisper diligenter examinavit deinde operculum ampullae aperuit, et paucis temporibus digitis in eam tetigit.

unit.source: “Yes,” he replied, not too eagerly.
unit.target: «Ita,» respondit, non nimis avidē.

unit.source: “Then eat half of it.” Lumian watched expectantly as Ludwig sprinkled a small amount of the ancient bloodstain powder into his mouth, leaving just a bit behind.
unit.target: «Tunc medietatem eius edas.» Lumian exspectans animadvertit, dum Ludwig parvam portionem pulveris antiqui sanguinis maculae in os suum aspergebat, reliquum parvum relinquens.

unit.source: Ludwig chewed and tasted it for a while before starting his “gourmet review”: “It has a rich aroma of death and eternal rest, originating from the depths of the spirit world.
unit.target: Ludwig aliquantisper masticavit et gustavit, deinde recensionem suam gourmandilicam inchoavit: «Habet divitem odorem mortis atque quietis aeternae, proveniens ex profundis mundi spirituum.»

unit.source: “It comes from a man in his thirties, with traits of both the Mystery Pryer and Death pathways, in poor mental state, highly prone to emotional instability…”
unit.target: «Ex viro in tricesima aetate orto est, qui notis et moribus tam viae Mysterii inquisitoris quam Mortis pollentem sit, mente debili et ad perturbationes affectuum valde inclinato…»

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian supercilium attollit.

unit.source: This sounds like it’s describing Demon Warlock Burman himself!
unit.target: Hoc videtur ipsum Daemoni Magi Burman describere!

unit.source: But this bloodstain powder is from the evil spirit Arden killed by Burman, right?
unit.target: Sed hic pulver sanguinis maculae ex malo spiritu provenit, quem Arden a Burman occidit, nonne?

unit.source: “From Intis’s Winter Province?” Lumian confirmed his guess.
unit.target: «Ex Provincia Hiemali Intis?» Lumian coniecturam suam confirmavit.

unit.source: “Yes.” Ludwig smacked his lips.
unit.target: «Ita.» Ludwig labia crepuit.

unit.source: He shared other insights drawn from the bloodstain powder, each aligning with the Demon Warlock’s situation.
unit.target: Alias indagationes ex hoc pulvere extractas communicavit, singulas cum casu Daemoni Magi congruentes.

unit.source: This couldn’t possibly mean that Burman summoned himself, killed himself, and then collected his own blood, could it?
unit.target: Hoc nequaquam potest significare quod Burman se ipse evocaverit, se interemit, ac suum sanguinem collexerit, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian felt an eerie thrill.
unit.target: Lumian excitationem insolitam sensit.

unit.source: The ancient bloodstain powder surely wasn’t left by Burman due to some other issues, as both Franca and Ludwig had confirmed the blood was closely linked to death and the spirit world. Lumian had fought the Demon Warlock twice, believing him to still be alive at those times.
unit.target: Antiquus pulver sanguinis maculae certe non a Burman relicuus fuit, quoniam et Franca et Ludwig confirmaverunt sanguinem arcte ad mortem et mundum spirituum pertinere; Lumian bis cum Daemone Mago pugnaverat, eum tempore adhuc vivum esse crederet.

unit.source: Using the method taught by Resurrection Island’s Harrison, Burman summoned an evil spirit from the depths of death that was himself, er, his own marking?
unit.target: Usu methodi a Harrison Insulae Resurrectionis tradita, Burman spiritum malum e profundis mortis evocavit, qui erat ipse—heu—suum proprium signum?

unit.source: He killed his own marking in the depths of death and found it very weak?
unit.target: Ipse signum suum in profundis mortis occidit et constitui id valde debile esse?

unit.source: This is hard to believe…
unit.target: Hoc crederi difficile est…

unit.source: What exactly does Harrison from Resurrection Island want, and what hidden truths lie behind the islanders’ resurrections?
unit.target: Quid prorsus vult Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis, et quae arcana veritates resurrectionum insularum tegunt?

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced, feeling that the mysteries of Resurrection Island were no less profound than the high-level events he had experienced before.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani cursabant, existimans mysteria Insulae Resurrectionis non esse minus profunda quam eventa summi gradus, quae antea experitur.

unit.source: “Can you give it to me now?” Ludwig looked again at the Deprivation Bullet, very eagerly.
unit.target: «Potesne nunc illam mihi dare?» Ludwig iterum ad pilam Deprivationis, valde avidus, aspiciens.

unit.source: He handed back the small glass vial with the remaining bit of ancient bloodstain powder to Lumian.
unit.target: Illam parvam ampullam vitream cum reliquo pulveris antiqui sanguinis maculae munere Lumiano reddidit.

unit.source: “Yes.” Lumian tossed the Deprivation Bullet to Ludwig.
unit.target: «Ita.» Lumian pilam Deprivationis ad Ludwicum iecit.

unit.source: Ludwig caught it, and stuffed the matte bullet into his mouth.
unit.target: Ludwig eam cepit et pilam opacam in os suum intulit.

unit.source: “Eating it directly?” Lumian asked with a chuckle, “Aren’t you going to cook it first? Maybe mix a cocktail?”
unit.target: «Illud directe edes?» Lumian subridebat: «Nonne prius coquere vel mixturam potionis parare vis?»

unit.source: Ludwig replied with a muffled voice, “No need for that, I can absorb it directly.”
unit.target: Ludwig voce submissa respondit: «Non opus est; illud directe absorbere possum.»

unit.source: As he spoke, he sucked on the Deprivation Bullet like it was an ice pop, pulling it from his mouth again.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, pilam Deprivationis quasi sorbetum glacialem sugere coepit, eam ex ore iterum extrahens.

unit.source: Compared to before, the bullet’s matte metal casing had noticeably thinned, the intricate symbols etched into its surface now pitted and marked with teeth impressions.
unit.target: Comparata priore, involucro metallico opaco pilulae evidenter tenuatum erat, et insignia intricata in eius superficie nunc cavata et dentibus impressa erant.

unit.source: Ludwig sucked on it three times, then finally, when the inside gunpowder was vaguely visible, he put the bullet in his mouth, chewed it with a crackling sound, and swallowed.
unit.target: Ludwig eam ter sugivit, deinde denique, cum intus pulvis ignitus vage apparebat, pilam in os suum intulit, crepitans masticavit et deglutivit.

unit.source: Lumian watched with a grimace, gaining a deeper understanding of the various changes hunger could bring.
unit.target: Lumian facie contrita observabat, profundiorem intellegentiam variarum mutationum, quas fames adferre posset, adipisciens.

unit.source: After eating the Deprivation Bullet, Ludwig closed his eyes, savoring the taste and longing for more.
unit.target: Postquam pilam Deprivationis comedit, Ludwig oculos clausit, saporem degustans et amplius desiderans.

unit.source: Lumian felt a pang of regret for the extraordinary bullet he had obtained from Jebus.
unit.target: Lumian dolorem paenitentiae sensit propter illam pilam extraordinariam, quam a Jebus acquirerat.

unit.source: The Weakening Bullet, Deprivation Bullet, and Implosion Bullet had not served their intended purposes, while the Poison Bullet, Putrid Bullet, and Impregnating Bullet had been given to Franca.
unit.target: Pila debilitans, pila Deprivationis, et pila Implosionis munera proposita non perfuncta habuerunt, at pila venenata, pila putrida, et pila impregnante Francae traditae sunt.

unit.source: “How do you feel?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: «Quomodo te sentis?» Lumian quaesivit.

unit.source: “Delicious, a familiar taste,” Ludwig responded, half-closing his eyes.
unit.target: «Deliciosum, gustus familiaris,» Ludwig respondit, dimidio oculis clausis.

unit.source: After reflecting for a moment, he snapped his eyes open, their gaze sharp and alert.
unit.target: Postquam paulisper meditatus est, subito oculos aperuit, quorum aspectus acutus et vigilantissimus erat.

unit.source: “G-Godfather, can you quickly find out who made that bullet?”
unit.target: «G-Godfather, potesne celeriter detegere qui illam pilam fecit?»

unit.source: You little rascal, that’s the cult following your deity… But I can’t blame you, you’re brainless now.. And for an evil god, sacrificing any number of bestowed is worthwhile if it frees an angel from its bonds, returning to an Angel’s belly is like returning to the deity’s heaven…
unit.target: «Parve pravule, hic est cultus sectarius deitatis tuae… Sed te non reprehendo, nam nunc sine mente es… Et pro deo malo, sacrificare quolibet numerum donorum pretium habet, si angelum a vinculis solverit; reditus in ventrem angeli similis est reditui in caelum deitatis…»

unit.source: Lumian muttered silently to himself, nodded slightly in agreement, and slowly stood up, heading back to his bedroom.
unit.target: Lumian tacite sibi murmuravit, leviter annuit consentiente, et lente surrexit, ad cameram suam tendens.

unit.source: Lying in bed, he stared at the dark ceiling adorned with a chandelier, feeling no trace of sleepiness despite the lingering scent of absinthe.
unit.target: Cubans in lecto, aspiciens ad obscurum laquearium ornatum candelabro, non sensit ullum vestigium somnolentiae, quamquam odor absinthii permansit.

unit.source: After staring silently for who knows how long, Lumian chuckled self-deprecatingly, trying to use Cogitation to help himself fall asleep.
unit.target: Postquam silentio diu aspexit, Lumian seipsum irridebat, conans Cogitationem ad somnum se inducendum uti.

unit.source: He slowly visualized a crossed-out sphere that grew an eye in his mind.
unit.target: Leniter imaginatus est sphaeram deletam, quae in animo eius oculum genuit.

unit.source: His state settled, and drowsiness began to creep up.
unit.target: Status eius se stabilivit, et somnolentia paulatim insidiari coepit.

unit.source: Just then, Lumian was taken aback.
unit.target: Modo, Lumian obstupefactus est.

unit.source: Cogitation was taught by his sister, and the Cogitation pattern was also casually drawn by her…
unit.target: Cogitatio a sorore eius tradita est, et eius exemplum quoque leviter ab ea delineatum fuit…

unit.source: Lumian laughed softly to himself, his laughter shaking.
unit.target: Lumian molliter se ipsi risit, risus eius trementes.

unit.source: Minutes later, he indulged in reminiscing about his life in Cordu, including those interactions in the dream.
unit.target: Minutis post, indulgebat recordatione vitae suae in Cordu, inter quas etiam illae interactiones in somniis memoratae erant.

unit.source: Even those, now looking back, carried a certain indescribable warmth.
unit.target: Etiam illa, nunc respicientes, aliquam caliditatem ineffabilem afferebant.

unit.source: As his thoughts wandered, Lumian remembered his sister’s contracted creature, White Paper.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes eius errabant, Lumian recordatus est creaturae contractae sororis suae, “Charta Alba.”

unit.source: I wonder what state White Paper is in…
unit.target: Miror in quo statu “Charta Alba” sit…

unit.source: Strictly speaking, Aurore isn’t completely dead, so her contract with White Paper should still exist…
unit.target: Stricte loquendo, Aurore non omnino mortua est, ideo pactum eius cum “Charta Alba” adhuc existere debet…

unit.source: Pity, contract creatures aren’t messengers, only the contractee can summon them, otherwise, I’d summon White Paper to see its condition…
unit.target: Eheu, creaturae contractae nuntii non sunt; solum contractus possessorem eas evocare potest, alioquin “Charta Alba” evocarem ut condicionem eius intuerer…

unit.source: Using Aurore’s words, seeing something left behind makes you think of that person? Or, liking someone so much you even like their pets?
unit.target: Ut verbis Aurore utendo, videns quod relictum est, te facit illum hominem reminiscere? Aut, aliquem tam diligis ut etiam eius amica animalia placeant?

unit.source: Eh, it’s not that I can’t summon, since the Termiboros sealed inside me and I are one, Aurore’s soul shard must be too, my summoning is as if Aurore is doing it… Thinking this, Lumian abruptly sat up.
unit.target: Heu, non est quod evocare non possim, cum Termiboros, qui in me clausus est, et ego unum simus, ita frustum animae Aurore debet esse; evocatio mea quasi ab Aurore fiat… Cogitans hoc, Lumian repente surrexit.

unit.source: In the darkness, he set up an altar and chanted the spell in the appropriate language: “I!
unit.target: In tenebris, altare posuit et incantationem in lingua apta recitavit: «Ego!»

unit.source: “I summon in my name: “The spirit that wanders about the unfounded, a friendly creature that can be subordinated, the weak ball that can telepathically connect with me…”
unit.target: «Ego in nomine meo evoceo: spiritum qui errat per incognitum, creaturam amicam quae subici possit, et pilam debilem quae mecum telepathice communicare valeat…»

unit.source: As the incantation echoed, the candlelight flickered gently, but nothing happened.
unit.target: Dum incantatio resonabat, lumen candelarum leniter micuit, sed nihil evenit.

unit.source: With Spirit Vision active, Lumian didn’t see White Paper that had appeared in his dreams.
unit.target: Cum Visio Spirituum activa esset, Lumian “Charta Alba” non vidit, quae in somniis eius apparuerat.

unit.source: Sigh… He lay back down, disappointed.
unit.target: Suspirans… Rursus se in lecto recubavit, destitus.

unit.source: As time ticked by, the sleepless Lumian suddenly became alert, feeling not the slightest fatigue.
unit.target: Dum tempus transibat, Lumian, insomnis, repente vigilantiam acceperat, nullam quidem lassitudinem sentiens.

unit.source: It was six in the morning.
unit.target: Era hora sexta mane.

unit.source: Lumian got up silently and began to clean up the altar.
unit.target: Lumian silentio surrexit et altare purgare inceperat.

unit.source: Just then, a “doll” messenger in a light-gold dress emerged from the void, dropping a dark coin pouch and a folded square letter onto the table.
unit.target: Modo, ex vacuum, nuntia “pupula” in veste aurea levi apparuit, deicens in mensa sacculum nummorum obscurum atque epistulam quadrangulam convolutam.

unit.source: Is this the reward from Miss Magician? One of them is a Traveler’s Bag?
unit.target: Num hoc praemium a Domina Magica est? Una inter ea num sacculus Viatoris sit?

unit.source: Lumian perked up, grabbing the dark coin pouch.
unit.target: Lumian subito excitatus, sacculum nummorum obscurum rapuit.

unit.source: The “doll” messenger glanced at him, pinched her nose and said, “Drunkard! Your clothes stink!”
unit.target: Nuntia “pupula” eum intuens, nasum suum comprimens, dixit: «Ebrio! Vestimenta tua foetida sunt!»

unit.source: Uh… Lumian, who hadn’t bathed or changed clothes last night, cleared his throat awkwardly in embarrassment and thanked her.
unit.target: Heu… Lumian, qui heri nocte neque se lavaverat neque vestimenta mutaverat, guttur difficultate purgans, erubescens, ei gratias egit.

unit.source: After the “doll” messenger left, he continued to check the rewards.
unit.target: Postquam nuntia “pupula” discessit, Lumian praemia perscrutari continuavit.

unit.source: 742 Rewards
unit.target: 742 Praemia

unit.source: 742 Rewards
unit.target: 742 Praemia

unit.source: That dark coin pouch was indeed a Traveler’s Bag, containing three items: One was a sheepskin parchment of a brownish hue, another was a nearly invisible triangular spike, and the last was a mechanically intricate black revolver.
unit.target: Illud obscurum marsupium monetarium revera erat Sacculus Viatoris, tribus rebus instructum: una erat charta membrata ex pelle ovinā fusca; altera erat spiculum triangulare fere invisibile; et ultima erat revolver niger mechanice intricatus.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t rush to take out the rewards but instead unfolded the folded square letter.
unit.target: Lumian non festinavit praemia extrahere, sed potius epistolam quadratam plicatam explicavit.

unit.source: “Prize Descriptions: “Ironblood Knight potion formula: See for yourself.
unit.target: “Praemiorum Descriptiones: Formula potionis ‘Eques Ferro‐sanguinei’: Vide tu ipse.

unit.source: “Traveler’s Bag: No need for further introduction, right?
unit.target: “Sacculus Viatoris: Non est opus ulterius explanare, nonne?

unit.source: ‘Wintry Blade: A mystical item crafted from the dust of ancient vengeful spirits and residual spirituality.
unit.target: ‘Gladius Hiemalis: Res arcana confecta ex pulvere veterum spirituum ultionis et residuae spiritualitatis.

unit.source: Any creature pierced by it, even without a visible wound, will fall into an icy rigidity and uncontrollable thoughts, as if possessed by a Wraith.
unit.target: Quaecumque creatura percursa eo, etiam sine vulnero conspicuo, in rigiditatem glaciei et cogitationes incontrollatas cadet, quasi umbra possessa.

unit.source: Moreover, as the battle persists, the targets of the Wintry Blade, even without direct contact, will gradually find their thoughts slowing and movements becoming stiff and awkward.
unit.target: Praeterea, dum pugna perseverat, victimis Gladii Hiemalis, etiam sine directo contactu, paulatim invenientur cogitationes retardari et motus rigidi atque inepti fieri.

unit.source: The downside is that the bearer gradually loses body heat, turning toward a necrotic state.
unit.target: Incommodum est quod portator paulatim calorem corporis amittit, se convertens in statum necroticum.

unit.source: If this exceeds the necessary time limit, the process becomes irreversible.
unit.target: Si hoc tempus necessario excedit, processus irreversibilis efficitur.

unit.source: “Placing it in the Traveler’s Bag effectively avoids the negative effects of carrying it.
unit.target: “In Sacculo Viatoris ponendo, effectus negativos vehendi efficaciter vitantur.

unit.source: You only need to ensure the battle doesn’t exceed three hours.
unit.target: Te solum necesse est providere ne pugna tres horas excedat.

unit.source: Of course, as a Sequence 5 of the Hunter pathway, a burning Reaper, you could endure the negative effects for at least four hours without other countermeasures.”
unit.target: Certe, ut Sequens V in via Venatoris, ardens Messor, effectus negativos saltem per quattuor horas absque aliis remediis tolerare possis.

unit.source: Reading this, Lumian immediately thought of the Eggers family’s golden mask.
unit.target: Hoc legens, Lumian statim larvam auream familiae Eggers meminisse sensit.

unit.source: That mask could also turn the wearer into a dead being, providing protection for the spirit and consciousness to remain alive until the mask was removed, allowing the wearer to easily revert to their original state.
unit.target: Illa larva etiam gerentem in entitatem mortuam convertere poterat, praebens tutela spiritui et conscientiae ut maneant in vita, donec larva sublata fuerit, permittens gerenti facile in statum suum initialem reverti.

unit.source: While wearing Death’s golden mask, could I use the Wintry Blade completely unaffected?
unit.target: Dum larvam auream Mortis gerens, num possum Gladium Hiemalem omnino sine perturbatione uti?

unit.source: I’m already an undead, so the gradual necrosis doesn’t apply… No, wearing that golden mask for too long means real death once removed, resulting in instant death… Lumian found no exploitable loophole and sighed in disappointment.
unit.target: Iam in statu mortuorum sum, igitur necrosis gradualis non valet… At vero, illam larvam auream nimis diu gerendo veram mortem, postquam sublata est, efficit mortem instantaneam… Lumian ullam viam expediendi invenit et dejectione suspiravit.

unit.source: He continued reading the last part of the letter: “Winter is Coming: This revolver was found at the site of a secret but failed ritual while investigating the Order of All Extinction cult. It was meant to be a collectible firearm, but it became a formidable weapon with a limited number of uses due to corruption during the ritual.
unit.target: Pergit ultimam partem epistolae legens: “Hiems Adventura: Hic revolver invenitus est in situ rituum secretorum sed fallitorum, cum cultum Ordinis Omnium Exstinctionis investigabant; destinatus erat esse arma collectaria, sed ob corruptionem in ritu limitato, factus est arma formidabilis.

unit.source: “The bullets it fires carry that corruption, producing two effects: “One ensures the bullet hits its target; even Saints, unless they use special abilities to dodge, will be hit. For beings below demigods, unless they switch with a substitute or the shooter is under an illusion and unable to aim, the shot will hit its intended target, and any substitutes will fail.
unit.target: “Globuli quos iacit hanc corruptionem portant, duo effectus efficiunt: Unum efficit ut globulus metam percutiat; etiam Sancti, nisi facultates speciales ad effugiendum utantur, percutientur. Pro entibus infra semideos, nisi substitutio fiat aut iaculans sub illusione intendere non valeat, ictus metam destinatum percutiet, et vicarii deficiunt.

unit.source: “Two, ensures death; even Saints, lacking certain traits and abilities, once hit, will suffer great trauma and gradually die. For beings below demigods, a hit means certain death.
unit.target: “Secundum efficit mortem; etiam Sancti, quibus quidam ingenia et facultates deficiunt, semel percussi magnum trauma patiuntur et paulatim moriantur. Pro entibus infra semideos, ictus mortem certam significat.

unit.source: “These two effects cannot coexist; a choice is made for each shot.
unit.target: Hi duo effectus simul esse non possunt; electio fit pro quolibet ictu.

unit.source: “The number of times it can still carry these effects is four. Once used up, Winter is Coming will revert to a normal revolver and begin rusting and deteriorating. However, until then, its normal shots will also spread ailments with each wound, with the type of disease being unpredictable.
unit.target: Numerus temporum quo adhuc hos effectus ferre potest, quattuor est. Postquam exhaustus erit, Hiems Adventura ad revolverum normale revertetur et rubigo corrumpi atque deteriorari incipiet. Tamen, usque ad hoc tempus, ictus eius normales etiam morbos disseminabunt, cuius generis morbus incertus erit.

unit.source: “After each use of Winter is Coming, you must seek treatment from an Apothecary or Doctor within the following week, even if no symptoms appear.
unit.target: Post singulos usus Hiems Adventura, medicinam quaerere debes ab Apothecario vel Medico intra hebdomadam sequentem, etiam si nullae signa apparent.

unit.source: “If not treated in time, you will inevitably contract a terminal illness that lower-sequence Apothecaries and Doctors cannot cure due to mystical factors.”
unit.target: Si non in tempore curatione succideris, inevitabiliter morbum terminalem contrahes, quod Apothecarii et Medici inferioris ordinis propter mysticos factores curare non possunt.

unit.source: This is a weapon that can harm demigods…? After the Overseer Perle’s painted self incident, are Miss Magician and her peers consciously providing us with items that can affect demigods, with bearable side effects? Doctor… Lumian half-turned his body, casting his gaze toward the door.
unit.target: Haec arma sunt quae semideos laedere possunt…? Post incidentem sui ipsius picti a Vigili Perle, num Domina Magica et socii eius conscie nobis praebent res quae semideos afficere possint cum effectibus tolerabilibus? Medice… Lumian dimidio corpore convertit et oculum ad ostium iecit.

unit.source: Lugano had already woken up and was preparing Ludwig’s first breakfast.
unit.target: Lugano iam excitatus erat et primum ientaculum Ludovici parabat.

unit.source: After confirming the rewards, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and pulled out the brownish sheepskin parchment, written on in dark red ink:
unit.target: Postquam praemia confirmavit, Lumian in Sacculo Viatoris profectus est et extraxit chartam membratam ex pelle ovina fusca, atramento rubro obscuro scripta:

unit.source: “Potion name: Iron-blooded Knight; “Sequence: 4;
unit.target: “Nomen potionis: Eques Ferro‐sanguinei; Sequentia: 4;

unit.source: “Main ingredient: Magma Giant’s core, Stone of Catastrophe;
unit.target: “Ingrediens principalis: Cor Magmae Gigantis, Lapis Catastrophae;

unit.source: “Supplementary ingredients: 80 milliliters of boiling magma, 20 grams of flora powder corrupted by a Stone of Catastrophe, 20 grams of soil soaked in soldier’s blood from a large battlefield, one acorn;
unit.target: “Ingrediens supplementarii: 80 millilitra magmae ferventis, 20 grammae pulveris floralis corrupti a Lapide Catastrophae, 20 grammae soli in sanguine militis infuso ex magno campo belli, unam glandem;

unit.source: “Ritual: Form a team of at least 30 people, cultivate deep comradeship with them, allowing them to grow stronger together with perfect synergy, understanding the leader’s intent through eye contact and gestures, nearly as one entity, then have them perform the ritual (the stronger and more cohesive the team, the better the ritual’s effect).
unit.target: “Ritual: Conforma coetum ex saltem triginta hominibus; colite arcanam foedus amicitiam cum illis, sinentes eos simul crescere fortiores in perfecta synergia, ducis propositum per oculos et gestus intueri, quasi unum entitatem; deinde eos fac ut ritualem peragant (quod coetus fortior et magis cohaerens, eo melius effectus ritus erit).

unit.source: While reading, Lumian felt a strong burning sensation from the dark red inked words and thought he could smell rust and blood.
unit.target: Dum legebat, Lumian vehementem ardorem ex verbis atramento rubro obscuro scriptis sensit et putavit se rubiginem et sanguinem odorare posse.

unit.source: Phew… Lumian had just finished reading the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula and quickly set it down on the table, feeling as if he was sinking into a hell of flames and blood.
unit.target: Phew… Lumian modo finem legendi formulae potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei attigit et celeriter eam in mensa deponit, sentiens quasi in infernum flammarum et sanguinis delabi.

unit.source: Such a strong mental impact…
unit.target: Tanta est vis impactus mentis…

unit.source: Is it because the Sequence 4 potion formula inherently possesses such traits, or because it was written by an Angel, or perhaps a combination of both?
unit.target: Num quia formula potionis Sequens IV insita haec possidet, aut quia ab Angelo redacta est, aut fortasse utrorumque mixtio?

unit.source: Boiling magma… Does this mean drinking magma directly, and if you don’t advance, you die?
unit.target: Magma fervens… Num hoc significat ut magma directe bibatur, et si non progredieris, morieris?

unit.source: Lumian memorized the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula in his mind, occasionally opening the parchment to ensure there were no mistakes.
unit.target: Lumian menti retinuit formulam potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei, interdum chartam aperiens ut nullae errores inessent.

unit.source: In the morning, at 702 Apartment, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Mane, in Appertamento 702, 9 via Orosai.

unit.source: Lumian placed the new Traveler’s Bag and the two weapons on the coffee table and went into detail about the latter two.
unit.target: Lumian novum Sacculum Viatoris et duas armas super mensa collocavit et de his duabus armis plenius narravit.

unit.source: “Only three items?” Franca asked, puzzled.
unit.target: “Nonne solum tres res sunt?” Franca quaesivit, perplexa.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: “There’s also the Iron-blooded Knight Sequence 4 potion formula for the Hunter pathway, but that’s meaningless for you.”
unit.target: Item etiam formula potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei Sequens IV pro via Venatoris existit, sed tibi nihil significat.

unit.source: “Who says so? At Sequence 4, a Demoness can switch to the Hunter pathway!” Franca retorted, her eyes sparkling.
unit.target: “Quis hoc dicit? Ad Sequens IV, Demonissa ad viam Venatoris transire potest!” Franca respondit, oculis fulgentibus.

unit.source: She almost said that before joining the Demoness Sect, her dream was to obtain the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula to turn herself back into a male.
unit.target: Haec paene dixit; antequam Sectam Demonissarum adiunxisset, somnium eius erat recipere formulam potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei ut se rursus in virum converteret.

unit.source: Before Lumian could respond, Franca eagerly pleaded, “May I see it? It’s not like you’ll lose anything” This way, if I become a Demoness of Affliction and something forces me out of the Demoness Sect, I could consider advancing to Iron-blooded Knight!
unit.target: Antequam Lumian responderet, Franca aviditer obsecravit: “Licetne mihi id videre? Non putas te aliquid amissurum esse?” Hoc modo, si Demonissa Afflictionis fiam et aliquid me ex Secta Demonissarum expellat, considerare possim in Eques Ferro‐sanguineo procedere!

unit.source: “Sure.” Lumian replied nonchalantly.
unit.target: “Certe.” Lumian respondit non sollicitus.

unit.source: He knew what Franca truly desired.
unit.target: Sciebat quid Franca vere desideraret.

unit.source: He then took the brownish parchment out of his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Tum chartam fuscam e Sacculo Viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: Seeing this, Jenna asked, curious yet hopeful, “May I have a look too?”
unit.target: Hoc videns, Jenna quaesivit, curiosa sed spe plena: “Licetne mihi quoque videndi?”

unit.source: This was a potion formula that could unlock the gates of godhood!
unit.target: Haec erat formula potionis quae portas deitatis recludere posset!

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca turned to Jenna, wanting to stop her but finding no suitable excuse.
unit.target: “Eheu…” Franca ad Jennam conversa est, eam prohibere volens sed causam idoneam non inveniens.

unit.source: Is it really appropriate for a female Demoness to look at the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula?
unit.target: Num vere decet Demonissam feminam ut formulae potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei intueatur?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t help Franca dissuade Jenna, and freely unfolded the brown parchment, placing it on the coffee table surface, and casually cautioned, “For every paragraph, take a look then close your eyes and rest for a few seconds—it has a strong mental impact.”
unit.target: Lumian Francae non prodidit, ut Jennam dissuaderetur, sed chartam fuscam libere plicavit, eam super mensam posuit, et leviter monuit: “Pro quolibet paragraph, inspice deinde oculos claude atque pauca secunda quiesce; nam validum impulsum mentis habet.”

unit.source: After a while, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony felt as though they had been roasted by a fire all night long, their sweat long since dried.
unit.target: Post nonnullum tempus, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony sensit se quasi tota nocte igni torridi fuisse, sudor eorum iam olim exustus.

unit.source: “It requires at least thirty people… That’s a bit difficult,” Franca said, empathizing with Lumian’s challenge.
