unit.target: “Saltem triginta homines requirit… id paulum difficile est,” Franca, Lumianis inceptis compatiens, dixit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: The stronger the team members, the better the effect. And if you have members with godhood in the team, the number required can be significantly reduced.
unit.target: Quo fortiora membra coetus sunt, eo melius effectus erit. Et cum membra deitatis in coetu sint, numerus requisitus significanter minuitur.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna thought of a name simultaneously and said in unison, “Ludwig?”
unit.target: Franca et Jenna simul nomen excogitaverunt et in unisono dixerunt, “Ludwig?”

unit.source: “I’m trying to teach him.” Lumian gave a godfatherly smile.
unit.target: “Eum docere conor.” Lumian subridens quasi patruelis risum dedit.

unit.source: Franca said no more and turned her attention to the three items: the Wintry Blade, Winter is Coming, and the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Franca nihil amplius addidit et animadvertit ad tres res: Gladius Hiemalis, Hiems Adventura, et Sacculus Viatoris.

unit.source: She generously smiled and said, “Jenna, Anthony, you pick first. Just don’t leave the Traveler’s Bag for me—I already have one.”
unit.target: Benigne subridens dixit: “Jenna, Anthony, vos primum eligite; tantummodo Sacculum Viatoris mihi non relinquam—iam unum habeo.”

unit.source: She was worried about lacking a powerful or special effect item. Both the Wintry Blade and Winter is Coming perfectly met her needs—any would do. As an Assassin, her hidden blade was a normal weapon that could rely on Witch powers to attach black flames, while the Cannon Gun was akin to a portable mini-cannon, nothing special.
unit.target: Timuit ne careat re potentia aut effectu speciali. Utrumque—Gladius Hiemalis et Hiems Adventura—prorsus opem eius fecerunt, et unumquodque sufficere posset. Ut sicatrix, culter eius occultus arma communia erant, quae virtutibus Maleficarum ad flammas nigras adligandas inniti poterant, dum Cannon Gun simile erat ad portabile parvum cannone, nihil speciale.

unit.source: Anthony immediately looked at Jenna, signaling her to choose first.
unit.target: Anthony statim in Jennam respexit, signum ei faciens ut primum eligat.

unit.source: This was not out of courtesy—he wanted the Traveler’s Bag, and he wanted the other two items as well.
unit.target: Hoc non ex urbanitate erat—ipse Sacculum Viatoris optabat, ac reliquas duas res quoque desiderabat.

unit.source: Jenna looked at the Hypnotist, lacking direct attack capability, then at Franca, whose gaze moved back and forth between the Wintry Blade and Winter is Coming. She picked up the ark coin pouch and said with a smile, “I’ve always wanted a Traveler’s Bag.”
unit.target: Jenna hypnosi aspiciens, directe oppugnandi facultate caret, deinde in Francam, cuius oculi inter Gladium Hiemalem et Hiems Adventuram vagabantur, intuefacta, saccum nummarium sustulit et subridens dixit: “Semper volui Sacculum Viatoris habere.”

unit.source: This wasn’t a lie—many Witch spells required casting materials, and some items, even just by carrying them, could have negative effects, which could be barely avoided by placing them in the Traveler’s Bag, such as the Beyonder characteristic of the Dream Stealer.
unit.target: Hoc non faba mendacium erat—multae incantationes Maleficarum materiis ad operandum exigerunt, et quaedam res, et solum eas portando, effectus negativos afferre poterant, qui vix evitari possent, ea in Sacculo Viatoris ponendo, sicut proprietas Beyonder Somniorum Furtoris.

unit.source: Once Jenna took the Traveler’s Bag, Anthony quickly made his decision.
unit.target: Postquam Jenna Sacculum Viatoris accepit, Anthony celeriter decrevit.

unit.source: “I’ll take Winter is Coming.”
unit.target: “Hiems Adventuram accipiam.”

unit.source: Without a Traveler’s Bag, carrying the Wintry Blade would be a significant burden.
unit.target: Sine Sacculo Viatoris, Gladium Hiemalem vehere gravissimum onus esset.

unit.source: Franca looked at the nearly transparent triangular spike and smiled broadly.
unit.target: Franca spiculum triangulare prope invisibilem aspexit et latissime subridit.

unit.source: “I’ll see if I can have it made into a hidden blade.”
unit.target: “Videbo an id in cultrum occultum fieri possit.”

unit.source: These are all suitable rewards for us. Madam Judgment and company are so thoughtful…
unit.target: Haec omnia praemia nobis apta sunt. Domina Iudicium et socii eius tam solliciti sunt…

unit.source: Lumian watched his companions distribute the rewards, nodding thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian comitum suorum praemia distribuere contemplatus est, capite cogitante annuens.

unit.source: That evening, back in the rented apartment, he met Madam Magician again.
unit.target: Illo vesperi, in apartamento conducto, iterum cum Domina Magica occurrit.

unit.source: This Major Arcana card holder spoke bluntly, “Head to the Blue Avenger now.”
unit.target: Hic tenens chartam Arcanae Maioris locutus est asperte: “Ad Caeruleum Vindex nunc propera.”

unit.source: 743 Exploration
unit.target: 743 Exploratio

unit.source: 743 Exploration
unit.target: 743 Exploratio

unit.source: On the dark expanse of the sea, the antiquated Blue Avenger bobbed gently with the undulations of the waves, enveloped by an unending mist.
unit.target: In obscura maris vastitate, vetustus Caeruleus Vindex leniter fluctuum undationibus labebatur, perpetua nebula involutus.

unit.source: Lumian once again came face to face with Alger, the Stormbringer.
unit.target: Lumian iterum occurrit facie ad faciem cum Alger, Tempestatum Afferens.

unit.source: The bearer of The Hanged Man card stood on deck, his deep blue hair a wild mess, seemingly under constant assault from the sea winds.
unit.target: Tabulam “Vir Suspendus” gerens in ponte stetit, capillis eius caeruleis profundis inordinatis, quasi constanti impetu ventorum maris oppugnatis.

unit.source: His attire had changed from his previous sailor’s garb to a captain’s coat adorned with golden embroidery on a blue background.
unit.target: Indumentum eius mutatum est a veteri veste nautarum ad tunicam praefectoriam, quae in caeruleo fundo aurifera insculpta erat.

unit.source: “Explore it yourself,” Alger said to Lumian, who was standing beside Magician, nodding firmly.
unit.target: «Ipse explore,» inquit Alger ad Lumian, qui iuxta Magam statuebatur, firmiter annuens.

unit.source: “I don’t have any wisdom to impart that would help; if I did, I’d have already uncovered all the secrets of this ghost ship.”
unit.target: Nihil sapientiae habeo tribuendae, quae prosit; sin autem haberem, iam omnia arcana huius navis phantasmatis detexissem.

unit.source: These matters had been confirmed by Madam Magician, leaving Lumian without doubts.
unit.target: Haec negotia a Domina Maga confirmata erant, relinquens Lumian sine dubiis.

unit.source: He thanked Alger and began walking forward, his steps echoing on the wooden deck.
unit.target: Alger gratias egit et incedere coepit, passus eius in ponte ligneo resonantes.

unit.source: He triggered the residual aura of the Blood Emperor in his right palm without hesitation, but felt no ominous sensation spill forth.
unit.target: In dextra palma sua, auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis activavit, sed nullam sensationem ominosam emanarentem sensit.

unit.source: Instead, his palm felt ice‐cold, while deep within was a pain like fire scorching his flesh.
unit.target: Praeterea, palma eius frigida ut glacies apparebat, et interius dolorem, quasi ignis carnem urens, sentiebat.

unit.source: Lumian lifted his right hand and noticed that the faint red scar had brightened slightly, but the skin covering it had turned paler, more deathlike.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et animadvertit cicatricem tenuem rubram leviter fulguisse, sed cutis eam tegens pallidior et mortifera facta esse.

unit.source: I wonder whether the Underworld Daoist’s seal would prevent activating the key special characteristics of this ghost ship… Lumian circled the Blue Avenger’s cabin with a mix of anxiety and trepidation.
unit.target: Me miror num sigillum Daoista Submundi activationem clavorum proprietatum huius navis phantasmatis prohiberet… Lumian cellam Caerulei Vindictoris circumeavit, anxietate et timore mixtis.

unit.source: During his exploration, he encountered no attacks from ropes or any other disturbances.
unit.target: Durante sua exploratione, nullos impetus funium nec alias perturbationes obiit.

unit.source: It seems the residual aura of the Blood Emperor still serves some purpose, or else it wouldn’t be this tranquil… Lumian muttered to himself as he stepped into the cabin, exploring each room in turn.
unit.target: Videtur aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis aliquod finem servare, alioquin non tam tranquilla esset… Lumian se ipsum sussurravit, dum in cellam intrabat et singulas partes explorabat.

unit.source: The Hanged Man, Alger, did not follow but stayed at the front of the deck, watching from afar.
unit.target: Vir Suspendus, Alger, se non secutus est sed in fronte pontis remansit, a longe spectans.

unit.source: As Lumian’s figure disappeared deeper into the ship, Magician raised her right hand and drew a circle in mid‐air with her index finger.
unit.target: Dum figura Lumiani in nave profunde evanuit, Maga dextram manum attollit et indice in aere circulum delineavit.

unit.source: A sprinkle of brilliant starlight emerged, initially forming a transparent crystal orb, then expanding into a circular, dreamlike veil.
unit.target: Exsiluit sparsa splendidae stellae lucis, initio globum crystallinum translucidum formans, deinde in velum circulari, quasi somniculosum, expandens.

unit.source: On the veil, Lumian’s figure appeared, wandering around the captain’s cabin, occasionally extending his right palm to touch various objects.
unit.target: In velamine, figura Lumiani apparuit, circa cellam capitanei vagans, interdum dextram palmam extendens ad varia tangenda.

unit.source: “There should be some findings,” Magician stated with a charlatan‐like tone.
unit.target: «Inventa nonnulla esse debent,» inquit Maga, tono charlatanico.

unit.source: The Hanged Man nodded slightly, not asking what might be found or what changes it could bring, since even Magician could not divine a certain future, and Ma’am Hermit could only see vague images.
unit.target: Vir Suspendus leviter annuit, nec quaesivit quid reperiri posset aut quae mutationes afferre, cum etiam Maga futurum certum divinare non posset, atque Domina Eremita tantum imagines vagas videre valeat.

unit.source: After Mr. Fool’s slumber, the Major Arcana card holders had explored the Blue Avenger multiple times but had not unraveled the ghost ship’s core secrets or located the treasures left by the Tudor dynasty.
unit.target: Post somnum Domini Stulti, habentes cartas Maioris Arcanae, multoties Caeruleum Vindictorem exploraverant, sed nec arcana nuclei huius navis phantasmatis detexere nec thesauros a dynastia Tudor relictos invenire potuerant.

unit.source: With the Apprentice pathway’s speciality, Magician only managed to help The Hanged Man uncover other secrets, unable to reach the deepest level.
unit.target: Per specialitatem viae discipulorum, Maga tantum valuit Viro Suspenduto alia arcana detegere, neque ad gradum maximum pervenire potuisse.

unit.source: Mr. Star’s explanation was:
unit.target: Explicatio Domini Star erat:

unit.source: “The Blue Avenger is not only influenced by the Lawyer pathway’s Distortion authority but also possesses notable traits of errors, spatial transposition, and grafting.
unit.target: Caeruleus Vindex non solum ab auctoritate distortionis viae Advocati afficitur, sed etiam insignia errorum, transpositionis spatialis, et insertionis notabilia possidet.

unit.source: And this aligned with the actual circumstances of the Tudor dynasty: Under Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, among the five great nobles, Amon was the Marauder, the King of Angels of the Error pathway, later becoming a true god; the ancestor of the Abraham family, Mr. Door, was the King of Angels of the Apprentice pathway; and the ancestor of the Antigonus family was the King of Angels of the Seer pathway. The Jacob and Tamara families had one Angel from the Error pathway and one who had been an Angel of the Apprentice pathway.
unit.target: Et hoc conveniebat cum circumstantiis veris dynastiae Tudor: sub Imperatore Sanguinis Alista Tudor, inter quinque magnos nobilissimos, Amon erat Praedator, Angelorum Rex viae Erroris, postea verus deus factus; maior familiae Abraham, Dominus Door, erat Angelorum Rex viae Discipulorum; et maior familiae Antigoni erat Angelorum Rex viae Videntis. Familiae Iacob et Tamara unum Angelum ex via Erroris et unum, qui Angelus viae Discipulorum fuisset, habebant.

unit.source: They clearly possessed strong abilities to utilize errors, alter positions, and graft spaces.
unit.target: Illi manifeste validas facultates habebant ad errores utendi, positiones mutandi, et spatia inserendi.

unit.source: If not ensuring the preservation of the Blue Avenger and its treasures unharmed and intact, Magician felt she could unravel the ghost ship’s deepest secrets, but doing so would reduce the Blue Avenger to irreparable fragments.
unit.target: Nisi Caeruleus Vindex et thesauri eius intacti et integri servarentur, Maga arbitrabatur se posse arcana profunda huius navis phantasmatis detegere, sed hoc faciendo Caeruleus Vindex in fragmenta irreparabilia redigeretur.

unit.source: Under the watchful eyes of two Major Arcana card holders, Lumian searched every room on the upper deck without triggering any anomalies.
unit.target: Sub oculis vigilantibus duorum tenentium cartarum Maioris Arcanae, Lumian omnem cellam in ponte superiore perlustrare coepit, sine ullis anomalis provocatis.

unit.source: He intermittently came across seven or eight sailors, all instructed by the captain not to interfere with his exploration.
unit.target: Intervallis invenit septem aut octo nautas, omnes a capitan instructos ne eius explorationi immiscere.

unit.source: Approaching the stairs leading up to the lower decks, Lumian glanced down into the pitch‐black abyss below, maintaining the stimulated aura of the Blood Emperor as he descended the creaking stairs.
unit.target: Accedens ad scalas inferiores pontis, Lumian in abyssum totum atrum sub se conspexit, servans excitatam auram Imperatoris Sanguinis, dum scalas crepitantes descendebat.

unit.source: As he walked, he suddenly detected an unusual scent.
unit.target: Dum ambulabat, subito odor insolitum sensit.

unit.source: He had been descending for thirty to forty seconds, which under normal circumstances should have brought him to the lower deck’s floor.
unit.target: Iam per triginta ad quadraginta secundas descendebat, quod sub ordinariis circumstantiis eum ad solum pontis inferioris attulisset.

unit.source: The distance between the Blue Avenger’s upper and lower decks couldn’t possibly be so vast that a Reaper couldn’t traverse it in dozens of seconds!
unit.target: Inter stratum superius et inferius Caerulei Vindictoris spatium nequaquam tam ingens esse potuit, ut Messor in paucis secundis transire non posset!

unit.source: To this, Lumian responded not with alarm, but with elation.
unit.target: Ad hoc, Lumian nec cum metu sed cum laetitia respondit.

unit.source: An anomaly was exactly what he needed!
unit.target: Vere, anomalia erat ea quae ei opus erat!

unit.source: Had there been no anomaly, it would have meant the sealed residual aura of the Blood Emperor could no longer function properly!
unit.target: Si anomalia non esset, id significaret auram residuam clausam Imperatoris Sanguinis iam non recte functionare posse!

unit.source: Lumian exhaled, calming his nerves while maintaining a steady but unhurried pace, continuing the creaking descent into the darkness.
unit.target: Lumian exhalavit, nervos suos leniens, dum gradu constanti sed non festinante servabat, descensum crepitantem in tenebras continuans.

unit.source: After an indeterminate amount of time, he saw no more wooden steps ahead; his feet now touched cold, black stone slabs radiating a metallic chill.
unit.target: Post indefinitum tempus, non apparuerunt ulteriores gradus lignei; pedes eius iam continebant laminae lapideae frigidae, nigrae, metallo splendentes.

unit.source: Have I arrived? Just as this thought flickered through Lumian’s mind, his vision was flooded with blazing white light.
unit.target: Advenione? Juste cum haec cogitatio in mentem Lumiani intravit, visio eius luce alba ardenti inundata est.

unit.source: He saw a barrage of white‐hot flame spears flying densely toward him, obscuring everything above.
unit.target: Vidit impetum hastarum flammarum candentium, densissime in se volitantium, quae omnia super obscurabant.

unit.source: It was like facing an army, each soldier hurling a flame spear from their hands.
unit.target: Erant quasi contra exercitum, cum quisque miles hastam ignis ex manibus iactaret.

unit.source: There was nowhere to hide, no way to dodge.
unit.target: Nusquam celari possis, nec viam evadendi inveniretur.

unit.source: Instinctively, Lumian was about to swap places with his shadow, hoping to use this rapid ability to survive the initial volley and then seek a chance to teleport away.
unit.target: Instinctive, Lumian paene se cum umbra sua commutare volebat, sperans hanc celerem facultatem ad primam iactationem superandam atque deinde ad occasionem se translocandi quaerendam.

unit.source: But just then, he had an idea—an extremely daring idea.
unit.target: Sed eo tempore, ideam habuit—ideam egregie audacem.

unit.source: Lumian’s expression took on a tinge of madness as he faced the overwhelming barrage of flame spears, not using any abilities and not even attempting to dodge.
unit.target: Vultus Lumiani ad modum insaniae vertus mutatus est, dum adversus vastum impetum hastarum flammarum se contendebat, sine ulla facultate aut conatu evadendi.

unit.source: He straightened his back and thrust forward his right palm.
unit.target: Dorsum recte sustulit et palmam dextram in ante protulit.

unit.source: The right palm, sealed by the Underworld Daoist and carrying the residual aura of the Blood Emperor—both were fully activated.
unit.target: Palma dextra, ab Daoista Submundi sigillata et auram residuam Imperatoris Sanguinis ferens, ambo plene activata erant.

unit.source: The dense, rain‐like barrage of white‐hot flame spears instantly froze in mid‐air.
unit.target: Densa, quasi pluvia, impetu hastarum flammarum candentium statim in aere congelata est.

unit.source: They stopped, neither advancing nor falling.
unit.target: Statuerunt, neque procedentes neque cadentes.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian let out an uncontrollable sigh of relief.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian suspirum ineluctabilem levationis emittere coepit.

unit.source: He had made the right bet!
unit.target: Bene iudicaverat!

unit.source: Gradually, the white‐hot flame spears began to extinguish, slowly fading until they completely disappeared.
unit.target: Paulatim, impetu hastarum flammarum candentium exstinguere coepit, lente evanescentes, donec omnino evanuerunt.

unit.source: Before Lumian could take a closer look, clusters of bright flames lit up on both sides.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian propius inspicere posset, congeries flammarum nitidarum utrinque accensae sunt.

unit.source: They resembled wall‐mounted lamps, piercing the dense darkness and revealing the surroundings.
unit.target: Instar lampadarum in parietes fixarum apparuerunt, tenebras densas perforantes et cuncta circumstantia revelantes.

unit.source: He found himself in a deep, wide hall that was smaller than he had imagined.
unit.target: Inveni se in aula profunda et lata, quae parva videbatur comparata cum eius expectatione.

unit.source: When the white‐hot flame spears were hurled at him like a flock of endless crows, it felt as though he stood on an ancient battlefield, vast enough to be measured in kilometers. However, the hall before him was merely the size of the grand prayer hall of the Saint Vive Cathedral.
unit.target: Cum hastae flammarum candentes in eum iactabantur instar turbae incessabilium corvorum, sensus erat quasi in antiquo campo proelii steteret, vasto ut chiliometris metiri posset; attamen aula ante eum solum erat magnitudinis aulae magnae orationis Ecclesiae Sancti Vive.

unit.source: At a glance, Lumian’s gaze froze, and his heart seemed to stop beating.
unit.target: In uno intuitu, conspectus Lumiani congelatus est, et cor eius quasi cessare pulsare videbatur.

unit.source: At the far end of the hall, there stood a colossal throne made of black iron.
unit.target: In extremo aulae, stabat thronus colossalis ex ferro nigro confectus.

unit.source: The surface of the throne bore patches of red, either from the corrosion of ages or from old bloodstains.
unit.target: Superficies throni maculas rubras gerebat, sive ex corrosionis temporum sive ex veteribus sanguinis vestigiis.

unit.source: There was a figure on the throne!
unit.target: In trono erat figura!

unit.source: This figure was giant‐like, draped in a deep red ceremonial robe and wearing an iron‐black crown, with its right elbow resting on the armrest, supporting its bowed head.
unit.target: Haec figura similis gigante erat, in profunda rubra vestimenta caerimonia induta et coronam ex ferro nigro gerens, cum cubito dextro in subsidio reposito, caput inclinatum sustinens.

unit.source: The flickering blood‐red long hair draped down, hiding the figure’s face.
unit.target: Longi capilli rubro‐sanguinei, micantes, deferebantur, figuram occultantes.

unit.source: Lumian was familiar with this figure; he had seen it at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, though the attire was somewhat different now.
unit.target: Lumian huic figurae nota erat; eam vidit ad Fons Feminarum Samaritanarum, quamquam indumentum nunc aliquantum differebat.

unit.source: It was the figure of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor!
unit.target: Haec erat figura Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor!

unit.source: However, this figure lacked the terror, violence, and madness seen at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, devoid of the aura of war and destruction, and the tangible oppressiveness and sense of conquest; if it weren’t visible, Lumian would have believed there was nothing on the iron throne.
unit.target: Tamen, haec figura caret timore, violentia, et insania, qualia ad Fons Feminarum Samaritanarum visa erant, nec auram belli et exitii, neque veram oppressivitatem ac sensum subjugationis; si non apparuisset, Lumian credidisset in trono ferreo nihil esse.

unit.source: A phantom? Lumian closed his eyes, relying solely on his other senses and intuition to feel.
unit.target: Phantasma? Lumian oculos clauserat, solum aliis sensibus et intuitu innixus ad percipiendum.

unit.source: In this perception, there was nothing above the iron throne marked with red stains.
unit.target: In hac perceptione, nihil super trono ferreo, rubris maculis signatum, apparebat.

unit.source: Lumian’s heartbeat gradually normalized, and he reopened his eyes to look at the iron throne.
unit.target: Pulsus cordis Lumiani paulatim se normalizavit, atque oculos rediens thronum ferreum contemplari coepit.

unit.source: The figure remained motionless.
unit.target: Figura immota permanebat.

unit.source: Lumian resisted the urge to observe any weaknesses in the figure or to activate the Eye of Calamity. Instead, he shifted his gaze and surveyed the rest of the hall.
unit.target: Lumian repugnare conatus est desiderium observandi infirmitates figurae aut Oculus Calamitatis activandi; pro eo, oculos suos verteret et reliquam aulae partem perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: Below the nine steps leading up to the iron throne were five mottled stone chairs—two on the left and three on the right.
unit.target: Sub novem gradibus ad thronum ferreum ducientibus, erant quinque cathedrae lapideae maculatae – duae ad sinistram et tres ad dextram.

unit.source: Why couldn’t there be one more, for symmetry? Lumian couldn’t help but criticize to himself.
unit.target: Cur non esset una adhuc ad symmetriam? Lumian se ipse non potuit non reprehendere.

unit.source: He knew these five stone chairs likely represented the five great nobles of the Tudor dynasty.
unit.target: Sciebat has quinque cathedras lapideas probabiliter repraesentare quinque magnos nobilissimos dynastiae Tudor.

unit.source: These ancient, mottled chairs appeared smashed by someone; some were completely split by cracks, some shattered into countless pieces yet barely holding their original shape, some had broken backrests, some were missing their seats, and others seemed melted by intense flames as if burnt for a long time.
unit.target: Hae antiqui, maculatae cathedrae videbantur ab aliquo percussae esse; quaedam fissis, quaedam in innumerabilia fragmenta dissipata, vix formam originariam retinentes, quaedam tergo fracto habentes, quaedam sellas carentes, et aliae intensis flammarum liquefactae quasi diu ustulatae apparuerunt.

unit.source: Had there been a battle here? Lumian tried to find corresponding marks on the black stone floor, the giant supporting columns, and the surrounding walls, but found nothing.
unit.target: Pugna hic orta fuit? Lumian conatus est vestigia correspondens invenire in pavimento lapideo nigro, columnis ingentibus sustentantibus, et parietibus circumstantiis, sed nihil repertum est.

unit.source: No objects either… Weren’t there supposed to be treasures from the Tudor dynasty hidden here? Had they been stolen? Hmm, Termiboros had said earlier that if I’m not of high enough level, forcibly exploring the Blue Avenger could lead to the resurrection of Alista Tudor within me… This suggests there should be something here, or some arrangement… Lumian started walking forward again.
unit.target: Nec obiecta quoque… Nonne thesauri dynastiae Tudor hic celandi erant? Furti illi fuerunt? Hmm, Termiboros antea dixit, quod, nisi gradus meus satis altus esset, exploratio vi Caerulei Vindictoris ad resurrectionem Alista Tudor in me ducere posset… Id indicat aliquid hic esse, aut aliquam dispositionem; Lumian iterum incedere coepit.

unit.source: All the while, he kept his eyes on the figure on the iron throne, observing every detail.
unit.target: Omni tempore, oculos suos in figura in trono ferreo retinuit, singula diligenter observans.

unit.source: Suddenly, he saw a pair of eyes, iron‐black and cold.
unit.target: Subito, vidit par oculorum, nigra et frigida.

unit.source: The figure on the iron throne slowly raised its head.
unit.target: Figura in trono ferreo caput paulatim attollit.

unit.source: 744 Approach
unit.target: 744 Accessus

unit.source: 744 Approach
unit.target: 744 Accessus

unit.source: The moment Lumian saw those iron‑black eyes, his mind went completely blank.
unit.target: Momento quo Lumian illos oculos, nigros ut ferro, vidit, mens eius prorsus vacua facta est.

unit.source: When he came to, he was shocked to find himself walking step by step toward the massive iron throne without any intention to do so.
unit.target: Cum se evigilavit, stupens invenit se passu post passum procedere ad magnum thronum ferreum, neque ulla voluntate ad hoc agendum in animo habens.

unit.source: He could feel his body trembling uncontrollably, yet he was powerless to stop his legs from moving.
unit.target: Senti corpus suum inordinatim tremulare, sed non poterat crura sua detinere ne moverentur.

unit.source: It seemed as though his body was no longer his own, obeying unknown commands and directed by someone else!
unit.target: Apparuit quasi corpus eius non esset iam suum, ignotas praecepta obtemperans et ab alio rectus ducendus!

unit.source: This scene, coupled with the figure on the iron throne possibly being Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, instantly reminded Lumian of two past incidents: One was at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, where both he and Hela lost consciousness due to the violent reactions of the Blood Emperor’s apparition, walking back to the edge of the spring as if they were puppets being manipulated or soldiers absolutely obeying orders.
unit.target: Haec scaena, coniuncta cum figura in throno ferreo – quae fortasse esset Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor – statim Lumian duos casus praeteritos commemoravit: unum ad Fontem Samaritarum Feminarum, ubi et ipse et Hela sensum amiserunt propter vehementes reactiones apparitionis Imperatoris Sanguinis, redeuntes ad limen fontis tamquam pupae manipulatae aut milites prorsus oboediens mandatis.

unit.source: The other was in the depths of the Red Swan Castle’s underground labyrinth, where he, Albus, and Elros lost consciousness after hearing a phantom roar from Vermonda Sauron in Fourth Epoch Trier, and they all wandered away from the core area, each towards a different wax sculptor.
unit.target: Alterum fuit in profundis labyrinthi subterranei Castelli Cygni Rubri, ubi ipse, Albus, et Elros sensum amiserunt postquam rugitum phantasmaticum a Vermonda Sauron in Aetate Quarta Trier audierunt, et omnes a regione centrali erraverunt, unusquisque versus alium sculptorem cerae.

unit.source: Could this be a similar situation now?
unit.target: Numquid haec condicio nunc similis sit?

unit.source: Is this a capability at the Hunter’s angelic level?
unit.target: Estne haec facultas ad gradus angelicos Venatoris?

unit.source: Lumian forced himself to calm down to find a way out of his current predicament.
unit.target: Lumian se compulit ad se tranquillandum, ut viam e praesenti difficultate inveniret.

unit.source: Compared to those two times, at least his consciousness recovered quickly this time!
unit.target: Comparatis illis duobus temporibus, saltem mens eius hoc tempore celeriter restituta est!

unit.source: Right, why did my consciousness awaken first this time, while my body still accepts control?
unit.target: Recte, cur mens mea hoc tempore prima evigilavit, cum corpus meum adhuc imperio subiectum maneret?

unit.source: Is the figure of Alista Tudor here weaker and less powerful, or is there another reason?
unit.target: Num figura Alista Tudor hic infirmior et minor potentia sit, an aliud quidem causa existat?

unit.source: Perhaps this anomaly holds the key to overcoming the control.
unit.target: Fortasse haec anomalia clavem continet ad imperium superandum.

unit.source: Lumian strained to extend his will towards his limbs, trying to regain control over them.
unit.target: Lumian studuit voluntatem suam ad membra extenderet, conatus eas iterum dominari reddere.

unit.source: This had some effect; his steps toward the iron throne began to slow.
unit.target: Hoc efficaciter operatus est; gradus eius versus thronum ferreum incipiebant tardare.

unit.source: He also took the opportunity to get a clearer look at the figure of Alista Tudor on the throne: The Blood Emperor had a stern face with sharp, chiseled features, resolute lips, a prominent nose, and long hair gleaming with a faint blood‑light, his iron‑black eyes cold yet filled with ultimate madness.
unit.target: Praeterea, occasione uteatus est ut figuram Alista Tudor in throno melius intueretur: Sanguinis Imperator vultum severum habebat, lineamenta acuta et sculpta, labia obstinata, nasum eminentem, ac capillos longos leviter sanguine luce fulgentis, cum oculis ferrei nigri, frigidis sed plenos extremae insaniae.

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian felt an urge to submit, to give up resistance.
unit.target: Subito, Lumian desiderium sensit ut se submitteret, ut repugnationem deserere inciperet.

unit.source: This impulse did not fade quickly but instead swelled rapidly, filling his mind.
unit.target: Hic impetus celeriter non evanuit, sed potius rapido crescebat, mentem eius replens.

unit.source: No, I can’t resist…
unit.target: Non, non possum resistere…

unit.source: There’s no way to resist…
unit.target: Nulla via est resistendi…

unit.source: Submit, submission will grant everything…
unit.target: Cede, nam submissio omnia praestabit…

unit.source: If He becomes angry, I will be destroyed, and Franca and Jenna will also be destroyed…
unit.target: Si ille irascitur, delebor, et Franca atque Jenna quoque delebuntur…

unit.source: Give up, give up, kneel down and beg for forgiveness, accept the command…
unit.target: Cede, cede, genu flecte et veniam obsequia, imperium accipe…

unit.source: Such thoughts surged in Lumian’s mind, turning into violent waves that battered his clarity, rationality, and will.
unit.target: Talia cogitationes in mente Lumiani eruperunt, in fluctus violentos transformantes, qui claritatem, rationem, atque voluntatem eius percutiebant.

unit.source: He clenched his teeth, as if any relaxation would break the final dam, and the flood would completely drown his will and soul.
unit.target: Dentes contraxit, quasi quaelibet relaxatio ultimum claustrum rumpere posset, et diluvium omnino voluntatem ac animam eius submergere vellet.

unit.source: His previously slowed steps quickened again.
unit.target: Gradus eius, antea retardati, iterum festinaverunt.

unit.source: On the deck of the Blue Avenger.
unit.target: In ponte Vindex Caerulei.

unit.source: Magician and The Hanged Man were both staring at the dreamlike veil suspended in midair.
unit.target: Magus et Vir Appensus uterque ad velum quasi somniculosum in aere suspenditum spectabant.

unit.source: Against a backdrop of starlight, Lumian’s figure on the translucent curtain had already become blurred, the surrounding darkness rendering everything else invisible.
unit.target: Sub lumine stellarum, figura Lumiani in velamento translucido iam offuscata erat, et tenebra circumiecta omnia reliqua invisibilia reddebant.

unit.source: This obscurity compared to the previous clarity indicated that something unusual was happening.
unit.target: Haec obscuritas, comparata ad pristinam claritatem, significabat aliquid insolitum evenire.

unit.source: The eyes of Magician and The Hanged Man saw Lumian’s body growing increasingly rigid, yet his pace quickening.
unit.target: Oculi Magi et Viri Appensi viderunt corpus Lumiani gradatim rigidari, sed simul celeritatem augeri.

unit.source: They also noticed his black hair slowly lengthening, tinted with a blood‑like glow.
unit.target: Etiam animadvertebant capillos eius nigros lente crescere, et rubore quasi sanguine simili tinctos.

unit.source: “Something’s off,” The Hanged Man Alger, said, turning to Madam Magician beside him.
unit.target: “Aliquid non rectum est,” inquit Vir Appensus Alger, convertens ad Dominam Magam iuxta se.

unit.source: Magician nodded slightly, preparing to pull out a Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Magus leviter annuit, se praeparans ad extrahendum Artefactum Sigillatum.

unit.source: This would help her precisely locate Lumian and allow her direct entry into the hidden extradimensional space.
unit.target: Hoc ei adiuverit ut Lumian exacte detegeret atque ei directum ingressum in spatium extradimensionale celatum concederet.

unit.source: In the dim surroundings, Lumian walked forward with a blank, rigid expression.
unit.target: In tenebris circumiectis, Lumian procedebat vultu immutato et rigido.

unit.source: Yet his soul was struggling, crying out in pain:
unit.target: Attamen anima eius luctabatur, clamans in dolore:

unit.source: I can’t give up…
unit.target: Non possum desistere…

unit.source: J mustn’t give up…
unit.target: Non debeo cedere…

unit.source: If I lose my resolve, I will no longer be myself…
unit.target: Si fidem meam amittam, non amplius ipse ero…

unit.source: Dogsh*t…
unit.target: Stercus caninum…

unit.source: Son of a sow…
unit.target: Filius scrofae…

unit.source: Lumian exerted all his strength, but felt an increasing desire to submit.
unit.target: Lumian omnem virtutem suam adhibuit, sed crescentem desiderium subiendi sensit.

unit.source: Suddenly, the dam holding his will collapsed, and surrender and submission completely overtook him.
unit.target: Subito, impedimentum voluntatis eius corruit, et submissio eum penitus comprehendorum coepit.

unit.source: Lumian’s mind went blank again.
unit.target: Mens Lumiani iterum vacua facta est.

unit.source: In this state, he had no concept of how much time had passed, until a deathly cold and rot‑like pain shot through his right palm.
unit.target: In hoc statu, neque tempus aestimare poterat, donec frigidus letalis atque putrida dolor per palam dextram eius transiit.

unit.source: Death… cold…
unit.target: Mors… frigida…

unit.source: Rot… pain…
unit.target: Putredo… dolor…

unit.source: Pain…
unit.target: Dolor…

unit.source: Lumian was jolted awake, suddenly regaining his thoughts and a measure of control over his body.
unit.target: Lumian subito permotus evigilavit, mox cogitationes suas atque aliquam dominationem corporis sui recuperans.

unit.source: Before him was not the nine‑stepped dais or the huge iron throne marked with red, but a mirror.
unit.target: Ante eum non erat podium novem gradibus nec magnus thronus ferreus rubro signatus, sed speculum.

unit.source: An antique full‑length mirror, framed with elaborate silver designs!
unit.target: Speculum priscum totius longitudinis, operibus argenteis elaboratissimis ornatum!

unit.source: The mirror reflected Lumian’s figure.
unit.target: Speculum figuram Lumiani repraesentabat.

unit.source: In the mirror, Lumian saw his face contorted with pain, looking like he might give up at any moment, while his facial contours slowly sharpened and his nose became unnaturally prominent.
unit.target: In speculo, Lumian vidit faciem suam dolore contortam, quae suggerebat se statim cedere posse, dum lineamenta faciei eius lente affiliebantur et nasus inusitate eminentior factus est.

unit.source: At the same time, his black hair grew inch by inch, dyed with a bloody glow, and his blue eyes turned colder, edging toward iron‑black.
unit.target: Simul, capilli eius nigri pollice per pollice crescebat, colore sanguine simili tincti, et oculi eius caerulei frigidi facti sunt, quasi ad ferreos nigros inclinantes.

unit.source: Jam turning into Alista Tudor…
unit.target: Iam se in Alista Tudor transformari coepit…

unit.source: This realization dawned on Lumian.
unit.target: Haec intuitio in Lumiano ortum est.

unit.source: Without thinking further, while his body still somewhat obeyed his commands, he immediately lunged to the side, trying to escape the reflection of the silver mirror.
unit.target: Sine plura cogitando, dum corpus eius adhuc partim mandatis oboediens remanebat, statim ad latus impetum fecit, ut a reflexione speculi argentati effugeret.

unit.source: A dive followed by a roll quickly took him out of the mirror’s reflective range.
unit.target: Submissa deinde gyratio celeriter eum extra ambitum speculi repraesentationis evellit.

unit.source: The next second, he heard a phantom roar, a mad scream.
unit.target: Secundo proximo, audivit rugitum phantasmaticum, insani clamorem.

unit.source: His mind blanked out again.
unit.target: Mens eius iterum vacua facta est.

unit.source: As his thoughts gradually returned, he found himself still crouched on the ground, the endpoint of his roll.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes eius paulatim redierunt, se invenit adhuc in terra collapso statu, ad extremum gyrationis.

unit.source: His body hadn’t moved toward the mirror on its own, but it couldn’t stop shaking, as if his blood had frozen.
unit.target: Corpus eius non ipso se movit ad speculum, sed tremulationem prohibere non poterat, quasi sanguis eius congelatus esset.

unit.source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
unit.target: Bang! Bang! Bang!

unit.source: It seemed as if something inside the mirror was madly pounding, making the mirror clatter as if it were about to shatter and release a monster.
unit.target: Videbatur quasi aliquid intra speculum insaniter pulsaret, faciens ut speculum stridore resonaret, quasi paene dissolveretur atque monstrum effugeret.

unit.source: And with each bang against the mirror, Lumian’s mind felt the impact, over and over.
unit.target: Et singulis ictibus contra speculum, mens Lumiani impactionem iterum atque iterum sentiebat.

unit.source: This gripped him with fear, nearly solidifying his thoughts.
unit.target: Hoc eum metu comprehendit, fere cogitationes eius rigidans.

unit.source: After a while, the pounding inside the mirror gradually subsided, and the surroundings became eerily quiet.
unit.target: Post aliquot tempora, pulsus intra speculum gradualiter cessavit, et ambitus mirabiliter quietus factus est.

unit.source: Lumian’s body stopped shaking, and he began to understand and reflect on his current situation and recent ordeal: If I had really approached that full‑length mirror, and the reflection had completed the transformation, would that mean that Blood Emperor Alista Tudor would be resurrected within me?
unit.target: Corpus Lumiani non amplius tremuit, et ille coepit intellegere atque meditari de sua praesenti condicione et nuper experienti: si revera ad illud speculum totius longitudinis accederet, et reflectio transformationem compleverit, an id significaret Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor intra me resuscitaturum esse?

unit.source: But as long as I’m not reflected in that mirror, and my image isn’t cast upon it, the impact will be minimal, and neither my will nor my body will lose command…
unit.target: Sed dummodo in illo speculo non repraesentarer, neque imago mea in eo projiceretur, ictus minimus erit, nec voluntas nec corpus meum imperium amittentur…

unit.source: Is the trigger for this transformation entering the range of the full‑length mirror’s reflection?
unit.target: Num incitamentum huius transformationis in ambitum speculi totius repraesentationis intrat?

unit.source: It seems calm now…
unit.target: Nunc tranquillus videtur…

unit.source: Lumian slowly supported himself up, cautiously observing his surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian lente se sublevavit, caventer circumiecta observans.

unit.source: He realized he was not in a somber hall, but in a bizarre starlight‑formed space where the floor appeared semi‑transparent, revealing endless darkness below, and no dome above, only twinkling yet ethereal stars.
unit.target: Animadvertit se non in aula tristi versari, sed in spatio mirabili a luce stellarum constituto, ubi pavimentum semitransparens videbatur, ostendens tenebras sine fine subtus, neque tecta super, sed tantum astra micantia ac aetherea.

unit.source: On either side were doors of starlight, erect in the darkness, forming a wide, somber corridor that ended with the silver full‑body mirror.
unit.target: In utrisque lateribus erant ianuae luminis stellarum, in tenebris erectae, quae latum atque solemniter triste corridor formabant, qui finem habebat in speculo argenteo totius corporis.

unit.source: At this moment, Lumian had reached deep into this corridor, only about fifteen meters from the mirror.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian alte in hoc corridor pervenit, soli circiter quindecim metris a speculo.

unit.source: Was the hall I saw earlier, the stone chair, the iron throne, and the figure of the Blood Emperor all illusions?
unit.target: Num aula quam ante vidi, cathedra lapidea, thronus ferreus, et figura Sanguinis Imperatoris omnia erant illusiones?

unit.source: Was their purpose to make me submit?
unit.target: Eratne propositum eorum ut me subicere?

unit.source: No, if I had been reflected in the mirror, the one emitting the roar I just heard would have achieved their goal…
unit.target: Non, si in speculo repraesentar, ille qui rugitum phantasmaticum emittens audiveram, propositum suum assecutus fuisset…

unit.source: In a flash of insight, Lumian guessed: Perhaps, the illusions I saw earlier—the iron throne, the figure of Tudor, the broken stone chair— were resonances caused by the residual aura of the Blood Emperor within me and that silver full‑length mirror, which also triggered a response from the Underworld Daoist’s brand, helping me briefly escape the controlled state and the mirror’s reflective range.
unit.target: In momento intuitus, Lumian coniectavit: fortasse illae illusiones quas ante vidi – thronum ferreum, figuram Tudor, cathedram lapideam fractam – erant resonantiae a residua aura Sanguinis Imperatoris in me atque in illo speculo argenteo totius longitudinis, quae etiam responsum excitaverunt ab insigni signo Daoista Inferorum, quod mihi ad tempus ex statu coercito et extra ambitum speculi repraesentationis effugiendum auxilium tulit.

unit.source: Thinking this, Lumian raised his right hand, looking at his palm.
unit.target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian dextram manum levavit, palmam suam intuens.

unit.source: There, the pale red scar was vibrant as if just entered into his body, while the pale skin around it showed clear signs of decay, leaking a pale yellow fluid, and revealing the bones beneath.
unit.target: Ibi, cicatrix pallide rubra vivebat, quasi modo in corpus intravisset, dum cutis pallida circa eam claras significationes corruptionis ostendebat, effundens liquorem luteum pallidum, et ossa subjacentes revelans.

unit.source: This preliminary confirmed Lumian’s suspicion.
unit.target: Hoc praevius suspicionem Lumiani confirmavit.

unit.source: He once again turned his gaze toward the silver full‑length mirror facing him.
unit.target: Iterum oculos suos convertebat ad speculum argenteum totius corporis, quod ei occurreret.

unit.source: Having dealt with the Mirror People multiple times, he slightly furrowed his brows: Does the Blood Emperor want to use that mirror and His residual aura within me for resurrection?
unit.target: Cum Populo Specularum plurimas lites egisset, leviter supercilia contraxit: num Sanguinis Imperator illud speculum atque residuam auram in me ad resurrectionem uti velit?

unit.source: There must be something hidden inside that mirror.
unit.target: Necesse est aliquid in illo speculo latere.

unit.source: The Blood Emperor’s resurrection setup actually involves the mirror world…
unit.target: Constitutio resurrectionis Sanguinis Imperatoris re vera in mundo speculi includitur…

unit.source: Yeah, that’s not unusual, whether it’s the special mirror world itself or the Mirror People from that world, they are all related to this Blood Emperor’s Fourth Epoch Trier…
unit.target: Ita, hoc non est insolitum, sive ipse mundus speculi specialis sive Populus Specularum ex eo mundo, omnia ad hunc Sanguinis Imperatoris Aetatem Quartam Trier pertinere.

unit.source: I had thought the special mirror world was a relic of the War of the Four Emperors, but Moran Avigny from the Tamara family said their connection to the special mirror world was established before the War of the Four Emperors…
unit.target: Putabam mundum speculi specialis reliquiam esse Belli Quattuor Imperatorum, sed Moran Avigny ex familia Tamara dixit nexum eorum ad mundum speculi specialem ante Bellum Quattuor Imperatorum constitutum esse.

unit.source: Dammit, that special mirror world couldn’t have been created by the Blood Emperor, could it?
unit.target: Heu, ille mundus speculi specialis a Sanguinis Imperatore creari non potuit, an ita sit?

unit.source: How many problems has He left for this world?
unit.target: Quot difficultates ille huic mundo reliquit?

unit.source: As expected of the Blood Emperor known for His madness…
unit.target: Ut exspectatum erat ab Imperatore Sanguinis, cui nota est insania eius…

unit.source: But clearly, the special mirror world can’t avoid the Primordial Demoness…
unit.target: Sed plane, mundus speculi specialis Demonissa Primigenia vitare non potest…

unit.source: Could it be that the Demoness Sect secretly lured the Tamara family, trying to subtly influence the Blood Emperor through the special mirror world?
unit.target: Num forte secta Demonissae occulto modo familiam Tamara allexit, conata subtiliter Sanguinem Imperatorem per mundum speculi specialem influere?

unit.source: In the end, it was used by the Blood Emperor?
unit.target: Denique, id ab Imperatore Sanguinis usum est?

unit.source: Fourth Epoch Trier is indeed full of mysteries…
unit.target: Aetas Quarta Trier re vera plurima mysteria continet…

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, he suddenly understood why Termiboros had initially prevented him from exploring the Blue Avenger.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabat, subito intellexit cur Termiboros initio eum explorare Vindex Caeruleum prohibuisset.

unit.source: To explore here, one would need either the Underworld Daoist’s brand to seal the Blood Emperor’s residual essence or some corresponding artifact or authority to counteract that domination; otherwise, one would become a puppet of Alista Tudor, allowing Him to resurrect within.
unit.target: Ad hoc explorandum, aut signum Daoista Inferorum ad essentiam residuam Sanguinis Imperatoris sigillandam necessarium esset, aut aliquod artifactum vel auctoritas conveniens ad dominatum repugnandum; alioquin quispiam puppa Alista Tudor fient, quod Illi resurrectionem intra efferre patitur.

unit.source: For Termiboros, this was definitely not a good thing.
unit.target: Pro Termiboro, hoc certe non bonum erat.

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze shifted, focusing on the doors of starlight.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani mutatus est, et ianuas luminis stellarum intuebatur.

unit.source: Did they represent different treasures?
unit.target: Num diversa thesauros repraesentabant?

unit.source: 745 Three Items
unit.target: 745 Tres Res

unit.source: 745 Three Items
unit.target: 745 Tres Res

unit.source: Having checked his physical condition, Lumian slowly moved along the wall of the spacious corridor.
unit.target: Corpus suum inspectum habens, Lumian lente iuxta parietem porticæ spatiosæ ambulavit.

unit.source: During this, he almost cleared his mind, not thinking or analyzing, focusing solely on whether he would be caught by the silver full‐length mirror at the end of the deep corridor.
unit.target: Interea, fere mentem evacuavit, nihil cogitans nec ratiocinans, solum intendens utrum a speculo argenteo integerrimo, in extremo porticæ profundae, caperetur.

unit.source: Finally, following his instincts, Lumian stopped.
unit.target: Denique, instinctu ductus, Lumian sistit.

unit.source: He hoped to use the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence and a Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate to find the most “suitable” room among the doors of starlight.
unit.target: Sperabat legem Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder ac sensum Fati Appropriatoris ad fatum adhibere, ut cameram maxime aptam inter portas stellarum inveniret.

unit.source: There might be high-level items from the Hunter’s path there, even the main ingredient for the Iron‐blooded Knight potion!
unit.target: Illic fortasse erunt res excelsae ex itinere Venatoris, etiam elementum principale potioni Eques Sanguine Ferreo.

unit.source: Looking at the translucent door formed by brilliant starlight beside him, Lumian, in a hushed tone, asked, “Termiboros, do you think there’s great danger inside?”
unit.target: Intuens ad ianuam translucidam, a splendore stellarum praeclaro formatam iuxta se, Lumian submisse rogavit: “Termiboros, putasne magnum periculum intus esse?”

unit.source: After the ordeal with the School of Truth, Lumian grew more cautious and vigilant towards the Angel of Inevitability, but that didn’t mean he wouldn’t seek His opinion under the right circumstances and conditions, as Termiboros could still offer valuable advice.
unit.target: Post perniciem cum Schola Veritatis, Lumian cautior et vigilantius erga Angelum Inevitabilitatis factus est, sed id non significabat eum opinionem Eius non quaesiturum; nam Termiboros adhuc praeclaram consilium offerre poterat.

unit.source: As it was now, with Madam Magician outside, Termiboros had little hope of breaking His seal; his death or mutation would only worsen His situation, likely prompting Him to warn of any danger.
unit.target: Nunc, cum Magistra Magica foris esset, Termiboros paullo spem habebat sigillum Eius rumpendi; mors eius aut mutatio tantum rem Eius inpeioraret, verisimiliter eum ad pericula monenda incitans.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t see changes in his own fate, but Termiboros could!
unit.target: Lumian eiusdem fati mutationes videre non potuit, sed Termiboros poterat!

unit.source: Termiboros remained silent, not answering Lumian’s question.
unit.target: Termiboros silentium retinuit, nec rogationi Lumiani respondit.

unit.source: Unfazed, Lumian placed his right hand, still pulsing with the Blood Emperor’s residual essence, on the handle of the starlight door before him.
unit.target: Imperturbatus, Lumian dextram manum, adhuc vibrare reliqua essentia Imperatoris Sanguinis sentiens, in manubrio ianuae stellarum ante se collocavit.

unit.source: He slowly turned the handle, poised to push the door open, waiting for any reaction from Termiboros.
unit.target: Manubrium lente vertere coepit, paratus ianuam aperire, exspectans cuiuslibet reactionis ab Termiboro.

unit.source: The door of starlight gradually opened, and Termiboros gave no warning.
unit.target: Ianua stellarum gradatim patefacta est, nec Termiboros ullam monitionem attulit.

unit.source: No response is also a response! It means the danger inside is bearable, or likely manageable…
unit.target: Nulla responsio quoque responsum est! Id significat periculum intus tolerabile esse, aut verisimiliter regendum…

unit.source: Lumian calmly pushed the door wide open and walked into the room dominated by shadows.
unit.target: Lumian placide ianuam late patefecit et in cameram, umbris dominantem, ingressus est.

unit.source: Suddenly, a bluish‐white blaze lit up, and an iron‐black sword engulfed in terrifying flames struck down towards his head.
unit.target: Subito, ignis caeruleo‐albus refulsit, ac gladius nigro‐ferreus, ignibus terribilibus circumdatus, in caput eius impetum fecit.

unit.source: Prepared for such surprises, Lumian quickly activated the black mark on his shoulder and teleported to the side of the room.
unit.target: Paratus talibus inopinatis eventibus, Lumian celeriter signum nigrum in umero suo activavit et ad latus camerae se teleportavit.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Pum!

unit.source: The black sword, covered in bluish‐white flames, struck the translucent starlight floor, leaving a deep crack.
unit.target: Gladius niger, flammis caeruleo‐albis indutus, pavimentum stellarum translucidum percussit, relinquens fissuram profundam.

unit.source: Inside the crack, some of the starlight melted, appearing like flowing magma.
unit.target: In fissura, aliqua lumen stellarum liquefactum est, quasi magma effluens apparens.

unit.source: Using the sparks, Lumian saw who his assailant was.
unit.target: Scintillis utens, Lumian vidit quis esset aggressor eius.

unit.source: It was a nearly 2.5‑meter tall suit of iron‐black armor, the interior of its visor a swath of darkness, as if uninhabited, with no fiery glow of an undead’s eyes.
unit.target: Erat armatura nigrum‐ferrea, prope 2.5 metra alta, cuius interior visori latum atri tenebras patefecit, quasi desertum, sine ullo igneo fulgore oculorum inferorum.

unit.source: With a swift motion, the iron‐black armor turned and faced Lumian, raising the large sword covered in bluish‐white flames once more.
unit.target: Celeriter motu, armatura nigro‐ferrea se vertit et Lumian obviam profectus est, iterum elevans magnum gladium, flammis caeruleo‐albis indutum.

unit.source: Before it could strike, Lumian’s blue eyes had turned iron‐black.
unit.target: Ante ictum, oculi caerulei Lumiani in nigrum‐ferreos conversi erant.

unit.source: He spotted the weak points in the half‑giant armor, the pale‑white spots at its joints.
unit.target: Animadvertit puncta debilia in armatura semi‑gigantis, et maculas pallide‑albas in juncturis eius.

unit.source: As the black sword struck with its fiery blade, Lumian teleported away again.
unit.target: Dum gladium niger ictu igneo percutit, Lumian iterum se teleportavit.

unit.source: With a bang, the bluish‑white flames scattered, and Lumian’s figure outlined behind the iron‑black armor.
unit.target: Cum “Pum!” resonavit, flammae caeruleo‑albae dispersae sunt, et figura Lumiani post armaturam nigro‑ferream delineata est.

unit.source: He leaped up, his right fist igniting with white flames.
unit.target: Saltavit, dextera pugna eius igni albo inflammata.

unit.source: A resounding clang echoed as Lumian punched the joint between the helmet and body armor of the iron‑black armor.
unit.target: Resonans clangor auditus est, dum Lumian juncturam inter galeam et loricam armaturae nigro‑ferrea percussit.

unit.source: Cull!
unit.target: Cull!

unit.source: After landing the punch, Lumian immediately teleported away, dodging a waist‑high slash from the half‑turned iron‑black armor.
unit.target: Post ictum traditum, Lumian statim se teleportavit, vitans ictum ad altitudinem lumbi a semi‑versa armatura nigro‑ferrea.

unit.source: In this manner, using the high mobility of teleport, he continuously appeared behind his target, striking the same spot with Cull, never overreaching, completing a single hit with each teleport.
unit.target: Hac re, alta mobilitate teleportationis usus, continue post scopum suum apparuit, eundem punctum cum “Cull” percutiens, numquam ultra procedens, unum ictum per singulam teleportationem conficiens.

unit.source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
unit.target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

unit.source: After five consecutive Culls, the iron‑black armor stood frozen in place.
unit.target: Post quinque consecutivos “Cull”, armatura nigro‑ferrea in loco immota stetit.

unit.source: Gnarly cracks spread rapidly from the joint between its helmet and body armor, soon covering its entire body.
unit.target: Fissurae sinistrae celeriter e junctura inter galeam et loricam se pervagabant, mox totum corpus tegentes.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: The iron‑black armor completely shattered, its metal fragments falling like rain onto the starlight‑condensed floor, making a pattering sound.
unit.target: Armatura nigro‑ferrea omnino dissipata est, fragmenta eius metallorum, quasi pluvia, in solum stellarum condensatum cadentes, strepitum facientes.

unit.source: Clang. The large sword covered in bluish‑white flames followed, hitting the ground.
unit.target: Clang. Magnum gladium, flammis caeruleo‑albis indutum, subsecutus est, terram percutiens.

unit.source: It has no intelligence, moves stiffly, and is stronger than a Sequence 6 but weaker than a Sequence 5.
unit.target: Non habet intelligentiam, agit rigidum, et est fortius quam Series VI sed infirmius quam Series V.

unit.source: However, that sword hits incredibly hard.
unit.target: Attamen hic gladium perquam vehemens ictum dat.

unit.source: If it struck me, unless I substituted with an animated shadow, I would’ve been killed instantly or lost limbs.
unit.target: Si mihi illud percuteret, nisi umbram animatam substituissem, statim interfectus essem aut membra amitterem.

unit.source: That’s only because it didn’t hit my torso.
unit.target: Hoc tantum, quod non me percussit in pecto.

unit.source: And yes, it’s very durable, even more so than the Guardians I encountered at the Dream Festival, Lumian mused, glancing at the shattered armor while using the remaining light from the black sword to scan the room for other dangers.
unit.target: Et quidem, valde durabile est, etiam super custodes quos in Festival Somniorum conveneram; Lumian meditabatur, aspexit armaturam confractam, dum reliquam lucem ex gladio nigro ad pericula in camera exploranda adhibebat.

unit.source: The room was quite empty, featuring only an altar‑like stone platform with a small, transparent glass bottle on it, containing a semi‑solid yellowish‑red substance, topped with a thick black wick.
unit.target: Camera erat satis vacua, habens solum suggestum lapideum altaris simile, in quo parva, perspicua vitrea lagena sita erat, quae substantiam semi‑solidam luteo‑rubram continens, coronatam crassa nigra mebula.

unit.source: A mystical candle? Lumian speculated roughly.
unit.target: Candela mystica? Lumian ruditer coniecerat.

unit.source: I wonder what it’s used for…
unit.target: Miror ad quid hoc adhiberi possit…

unit.source: By now, he was fairly certain there were no other surprises, and he turned his attention back to the pile of fragments from the shattered iron‑black armor.
unit.target: Iam satis certus erat nullas alias miracula exspectanda esse, atque animos redeunxit ad congeriem fragmentorum armaturae nigro‑ferreae confractae.

unit.source: Among the debris, he found a peculiar piece of leather.
unit.target: Inter ruinas, invenit fragmentum cori insolitum.

unit.source: The leather was about the size of half a towel, creamy white, and finely textured, appearing so enticing that even from a distance, Lumian felt it must have belonged to a beautiful woman.
unit.target: Corium, circa dimidiam linteae quantitatem, cremosum et subtili textura, tam venustum apparens ut etiam a longinquo Lumian sensit id pulchrae feminae pertinuisse. skin? he muttered, frowning as he approached.

unit.source: He didn’t immediately pick up the black sword, whose flames had mostly died down, or the alluring piece of leather.
unit.target: Non statim sustulit gladium nigrum, cuius flammae paene exstinxerant, neque particulam cori amoenam.

unit.source: Instead, he drew a dagger from his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Proinde, ex sacculo Viatoris, pugionem extraxit.

unit.source: Using the dagger, Lumian picked out the leather, holding it up before him.
unit.target: Pugione utendo, Lumian corium elegit et ante se sustulit.

unit.source: The first thing he saw was a few words in ancient Hermes script:
unit.target: Primum quod vidit, pauca verba in antiqua scriptura Hermes notata:

unit.source: “Despair…
unit.target: “Desperatio…

unit.source: “Sequence 4…”
unit.target: “Series IV…”

unit.source: Suddenly, Lumian’s breathing grew belabored, his head spun, and his physical condition visibly worsened.
unit.target: Subito, respiratio Lumiani laboriosa facta est, caput eius vertit, et eius conditio corporalis palam peior facta est.

unit.source: He quickly looked away and used the dagger to lift the delicate white leather, stuffing it into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Celeriter oculos avertit et, pugione utendo, delicatum album corium elevavit atque in sacculo Viatoris suo reponit.

unit.source: His discomfort gradually subsided.
unit.target: Molestia eius paulatim cessavit.

unit.source: A potion formula for the Demoness of Despair? Lumian mused over what he had just seen.
unit.target: Formula poculi pro Daemona Desperationis? Lumian de ea re, quae modo visa fuerat, meditatus est.

unit.source: And the leather it’s written on was peeled right off a Demoness of Despair, hence its special and dangerous nature? Truly a relic from the Tudor dynasty, harboring such items…
unit.target: Et corium, in quo scriptum erat, ex Daemona Desperationis depulsum erat, ideo naturam peculiarem et periculosam habens? Vere relicta est ex dynastia Tudor, talia continens…

unit.source: Lost in thought, Lumian’s gaze shifted to the black sword, whose bluish‑white flame was dimming, no longer as brilliant as before.
unit.target: Absorptus cogitatione, oculus Lumiani ad gladium nigrum convertebat, cuius flamma caeruleo‑alba paulatim extinguebatur, non iam tam nitens quam prius.

unit.source: He pondered for a moment, deciding not to risk determining the item’s abilities, effects, and negative impacts just yet.
unit.target: Aliquem momenti suspensus, decrevit non periculum capere ad determinandas proprietates, effectus, et detrimenta rei modo.

unit.source: Instead, he placed it into the Traveler’s Bag, setting it aside in a corner clear of other items.
unit.target: Proinde, illud in sacculo Viatoris reponit, in angulo extra alias res separatum.

unit.source: Using the same method, Lumian also packed the strange candle in the glass bottle into the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Eodem modo, Lumian candela mirabilis in lagena vitrea posita quoque in sacculo Viatoris reponit.

unit.source: He planned to consult Madam Magician about these items once outside, rather than experimenting on his own!
unit.target: Consilium habebat ut, semel extra, cum Magistra Magica de his rebus consuleret, potius quam solus experimenta faceret!

unit.source: After ensuring the room had nothing else of interest, Lumian returned through the door of starlight to the deep, spacious corridor.
unit.target: Postquam certus fuit camera nihil aliud praestare, Lumian per ianuam stellarum in profundum et spatiosum porticum rediit.

unit.source: Just as he was about to continue using the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence and a Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate to choose the next room to explore, a faint, distant voice suddenly echoed in his ears: “For you, the other rooms are too dangerous…”
unit.target: Iam ut legem Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder et sensum Fati Appropriatoris ad fatum eligendum uteretur, ut proximam cameram explorandam eligeret, vox tenue procul atque subito in auribus eius resonavit: “Tibi, ceterae camerae nimis periculosae sunt…”

unit.source: This was the voice of Madam Magician.
unit.target: Haec vox Magistrae Magicae fuit.

unit.source: Mr. Hanged Man and her are indeed watching… Did her words mean that the exploration is to pause here? This confirmation steadied Lumian considerably.
unit.target: Dominus Hanged Man et ipsa revera observabant… Num verba eius indicabant explorationem hic sistere? Haec confirmatio Lumian admodum stabilivit.

unit.source: He thought for a few seconds, deciding to do one more thing before leaving this extradimensional space.
unit.target: Paucos secundos cogitavit, decidens unum adhuc facere antequam hanc spatiam extradimensionalem relinqueret.

unit.source: Slowly, bit by bit, he circled towards the silver full‐length mirror at the end of the corridor, his focus intense, ready to turn and leave at the first word of discouragement from Madam Magician.
unit.target: Lente, paulatim, circumstetit ad speculum argenteum totum in longitudine, in fine corridoris, cum studio intenso, paratus ut verteret et discederet ad primum verbum demotivationis a Magistra Magica.

unit.source: Until he reached the side of the silver full‑length mirror, Madam Magician had not spoken out to stop him.
unit.target: Donec ad latus speculi argentei totius longitudinis pervenisset, Magistra Magica nondum locuta erat ut eum sisteret.

unit.source: Lumian took a deep breath and carefully moved his right palm towards the front of the silver full‑length mirror.
unit.target: Lumian alium spiritum traxit et curanter dextram palmam suam versus frontem speculi argentei plenae longitudinis movit.

unit.source: He didn’t know whether the mirror would react again when reflecting only a palm.
unit.target: Nescivit utrum speculum iterum reagere vellet, si tantum palmam reflecteret.

unit.source: As his palm moved slowly, Lumian’s nerves were taut.
unit.target: Dum palmas eius lente moveret, nervi Lumiani stricti erant.

unit.source: Finally, he touched the surface of the mirror, feeling its brittle yet firm coldness.
unit.target: Denique superficiem speculi attigit, frigiditatem eius, quamquam fragili sed firma, sentiens.

unit.source: Immediately after, Lumian activated a power from his contract with Bloody Jack—Mirror Markl He wanted to test whether he could still sense the mark left in this hidden space once he returned to the outside world.
unit.target: Statim postea, Lumian potentiam ex pacto suo cum Bloody Jack—Markl Speculi activavit. Volebat experiri utrum adhuc signum, quod in hoc spatio occulto relicum erat, postquam in mundum externum rediisset, sentire posset.

unit.source: Blood seeped from his palm into the mirror, forming an inverted image.
unit.target: Sanguis ex palma eius in speculum percola, imaginem invertam formans.

unit.source: While waiting, Lumian suddenly had a thought: Did my recent encounters stack on negative effects from the Mirror Mark contract? This does indeed pertain to mirror‑related anomalies and bizarre dangers…
unit.target: Dum exspectabat, Lumian subito cogitavit: Num nuper congressiones meae effectus negativos ex pacto Markl Speculi accumulaverint? Id certe spectat ad anomalias speculo pertinentes et ad pericula insólita…

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian had set the Mirror Mark.
unit.target: In ictu oculi, Lumian Markl Speculi instituit.

unit.source: Having done this, he began to retrace his steps, avoiding areas where the silver full‑length mirror could reflect him, and walked up the wooden stairs.
unit.target: Hoc factum, se revertere coepit, vitans loca ubi speculum argenteum totum eum reflectere posset, et scalas ligneas ascendit.

unit.source: Before long, Lumian’s path brightened as he saw the wall lamps on either side of the ship’s cabin and the dim firelight.
unit.target: Mox iter Lumiani illustratum est, cum vidisset lampades parietales utrinque cubiculorum navis atque lucem ignis tenui.

unit.source: He had returned to the Blue Avenger.
unit.target: Rediit ad Vindictorem Caeruleum.

unit.source: Upon reaching the front deck, before Lumian could ask Madam Magician to retrieve the three items from his Traveler’s Bag and perform their appraisal, he heard the Major Arcana card holder chuckle and say, “As expected of a Hunter with the status of a fake Angel and Tudor’s remnant aura. You obtained three items closely related to Hunters and Demonesses in an instant.
unit.target: Ad perveniens ad tabulatum prae navis, antequam Lumian Magistram Magicam rogarentem ut tres res ex sacculo Viatoris extraheret et earum aestimationem faceret, audivit tenentem cartam Major Arcana subridens atque dicentem: “Ut exspectabatur a Venatore cum statu Angelus ficti et aurae Tudoricae relictae. Tres res, arcte conexae Venatoribus et Daemonissis, statim obtinuisti.”

unit.source: “That sword is what you were hoping for—it’s made from the Iron‑blooded Knight Beyonder characteristic.”
unit.target: “Ille gladium est quod sperabas—ex charactere Beyonder Eques Sanguine Ferreo confectum.”

unit.source: 746 Corpse Wax Candle
unit.target: 746 Candela Cerae Cadaveris

unit.source: 746 Corpse Wax Candle
unit.target: 746 Candela Cerae Cadaveris

unit.source: A mystical item made from an Iron-blooded Knight Beyonder characteristic?
unit.target: Res arcana ex attributo Beyonder equitis sanguine ferrei confecta?

unit.source: The Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence sure is handy…
unit.target: Lex coniunctionis proprietatum Beyonder certe utilis est…

unit.source: A Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate must have contributed a bit…
unit.target: Sensitivitas Fatoris Appropriatoris ad fatum paulum contulit…

unit.source: Or, could it be the result of some arrangement?
unit.target: An id ex aliqua ordinatione evenit?

unit.source: Lumian was first surprised, then felt the aftereffects of a traumatic bestowment.
unit.target: Lumian primum obstupuit, deinde vestigia effectuum traumatici doni sensit.

unit.source: Madam Magician seemed to sense his thoughts and chuckled, saying, “I don’t know if this is a bestowment from fate, but even if it is, it’s the kind we were hoping for and can certainly accept.”
unit.target: Domina Magica cogitationes eius quasi sentiebat et subridens dixit: “Nescio utrum hoc sit donum a fato, sed etsi ita sit, genus est quod sperabamus et certe accipere possumus.”

unit.source: Lumian silently nodded.
unit.target: Lumian silentio annuit.

unit.source: Mr. Hanged Man, speaking calmly, said, “Don’t overcomplicate your thoughts, just consider two things:”
unit.target: Vir suspenditus, tranquille loquens, dixit: “Nolite cogitationes vestras nimis complicare, sed duo tantum considera:”

unit.source: First, you now have no ability to escape this arrangement.
unit.target: Primum, nunc nullam habes facultatem hujus ordinationis effugiendi.

unit.source: Sometimes, what you think of as resistance or rebellion might actually be a predetermined part of the process, and Mr. Fool’s Angels aren’t always available to protect you.
unit.target: Interdum, id quod existimas esse resistentiam vel seditionem, re vera pars praedestinata processus esse potest, et Angeli Domini Stulti non sunt semper praesto ut te protegeant.

unit.source: Remember, accepting reality isn’t a sign of weakness; finding opportunities within such realities is a true act of courage.
unit.target: Memento, realitatem accipere non est signum infirmitatis; sed in talibus realitatibus occasiones invenire verum est actus fortitudinis.

unit.source: Second, maximize the benefits that this bestowment of fate brings.
unit.target: Secundo, beneficia huius fati doni ad maximum auge.

unit.source: Work hard to improve yourself.
unit.target: Strenue labora ut te meliorem facias.

unit.source: This doesn’t mean giving up but rather tests your wisdom and determination.
unit.target: Hoc non significat renuntiationem, sed potius probat sapientiam et constantiam tuam.

unit.source: When you sense danger or anything unusual, remember, we will always stand by you.
unit.target: Cum periculum aut aliquid insolitum sentis, memento, nos semper ad te erimus.

unit.source: Remember, Mr. Fool can interfere with those plans, but as you know, He isn’t fully awake and can’t frequently provide protection—only at critical moments.
unit.target: Memento, Dominus Stultus illis consiliis immixere potest, sed ut scis, non est omnino vigil et non plerumque tutelam praebet—tantum in momentis criticis.

unit.source: After listening intently, Lumian slowly nodded, finding a different kind of resonance and persuasiveness in hearing these ideas voiced by someone else.
unit.target: Postquam attente auscultavit, Lumian lente annuit, inveniens aliam speculationem resonantiae et persuasivitatis ex his ideis a alio proferendis.

unit.source: Mr. Hanged Man thought for a moment, then added, “What you need to be most wary of is the attempt to resurrect the Blood Emperor through you.
unit.target: Vir suspenditus paulisper cogitavit, deinde addidit: “Quod maxime cavendum est, est conatus per te resurrectionis Imperatoris Sanguinis.

unit.source: You must be extra cautious in similar situations going forward.
unit.target: Extra cautus esse debes in futuris similibus condicionibus.

unit.source: “I’ll remember that, thank you, Mr. Hanged Man,” Lumian replied sincerely.
unit.target: “Illud meminero, gratias tibi, Domine Suspenditus,” respondit Lumian sincere.

unit.source: Madam Magician then steered the conversation back on track.
unit.target: Domina Magica deinde sermonem ad rectam viam rediit.

unit.source: “You can take out the items you’ve gathered, and I’ll help you evaluate their powers and any negative effects.”
unit.target: “Potes res quas congregavisti extrahere, et ego te adiuvabo ut earum virtutes et incommoda effectus aestimes.”

unit.source: With the promise of support, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and grasped the hilt of the dark, iron-black broadsword.
unit.target: Cum promissione sustinendi, Lumian in sacculum Viatoris incursavit et manubrium gladii latis, nigri ferri apprehendit.

unit.source: Suddenly, his inner worries, like clouds in the sky, were scattered by a terrifying wind, vanishing in an instant.
unit.target: Subito, internae sollicitudines eius, ut nubes in caelo, vento terribili disperguntur atque in momento evanescunt.

unit.source: Why fear a bestowment from fate?
unit.target: Cur donum a fato timendum est?

unit.source: Why fear the arrangements of the gods?
unit.target: Cur deorum ordinationes timere?

unit.source: To hell with them all!
unit.target: Ad inferos omnes!

unit.source: May they all go to hell!
unit.target: Ut omnes in inferos descendant!

unit.source: In that moment, Lumian was filled with courage, feeling as though he could swing his broadsword at the True Creator Himself if He appeared before him right then.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian virtute repletus est, sentiens se posse gladium latus in ipso Verissimo Creatore impellere, si ille statim appareret.

unit.source: He drew the black broadsword, its flames extinguished yet still radiating intense heat, and handed it to Madam Magician.
unit.target: Gladium nigrum extraxit, cujus flammae exstinctae, sed adhuc ardorem singularem efferentes, illud Dominae Magicae tradidit.

unit.source: Madam Magician looked at him, took the sword, and joked, “How about we call it the ‘Sword of Courage’?”
unit.target: Domina Magica eum conspexit, gladium accepit, et iocose dixit: “Quomodo id vocemus Gladium Fortitudinis?”

unit.source: “The Sword of Courage…” Lumian paused for a moment.
unit.target: “Gladium Fortitudinis…” Lumian paulisper haesitavit.

unit.source: As the black broadsword left his grasp and was taken by Madam Magician, he shivered violently.
unit.target: Cum gladium nigrum e manu eius deflueret et Domina Magica reportaret, vehementer trepidavit.

unit.source: What was I thinking?
unit.target: Quid putabam?

unit.source: I nearly blasphemed His sacred name…
unit.target: Paene nomen sacrum eius blasphemai…

unit.source: How could I believe I was capable of deicide?
unit.target: Quomodo credere poteram me deicidem esse posse?

unit.source: In a moment of fright, Lumian’s eyes returned to the black broadsword in Madam Magician’s hands.
unit.target: In momento terroris, oculi Lumiani ad gladium nigrum in manibus Dominae Magicae redeunti sunt.

unit.source: Could it be its negative influence?
unit.target: Num eius influentia negativa sit?

unit.source: Could it really inspire the courage to commit deicide?
unit.target: Num vere fortitudinem ad deicidium committendum inspirare possit?

unit.source: Stars sparkled in Madam Magician’s eyes as she gazed at the sword and explained,
unit.target: Stellae in oculis Dominae Magicae fulgebant, dum gladium intuēbatur et explicabat,

unit.source: “This sword fills its bearer with courage, ensuring they are not knocked down by fear or paralyzed by fright.”
unit.target: “Hic gladius portatorem suum fortitudine replet, curans ut non metu deiectus aut terrore immobilis fiat.”

unit.source: If you had held this sword earlier, even if you were ultimately ‘conquered, you could have endured a bit longer.
unit.target: Si hoc gladium antea tenuisses, etsi tandem superatus esses, aliquantulum diutius tolerare potuisses.

unit.source: “It’s extremely durable and sharp, capable of blocking direct attacks from demigods and significantly impacting their defenses.
unit.target: “Hic gladius valde durabilis ac acutus est, et aptus est ictus directos a semideis obstruere et defensionibus eorum graviter impingere.”

unit.source: It can also enable you to perform Cull at the level of an Iron-blooded Knight, but this will consume a great deal of your spirituality, roughly two-thirds of it in one go.
unit.target: “Quod etiam te facit ‘Cull’ peragere in gradu equitis sanguinis ferrei, sed hoc ingentem tuam spiritualitatem consumet, circiter duas partes trium simul.”

unit.source: The sword can also absorb half of the damage for you.
unit.target: Gladius etiam dimidium damni pro te absorbere potest.

unit.source: That is, even if you fail to block an attack and suffer a fatal wound, it can reduce the severity of that wound from fatal to grave.
unit.target: Id est, etiam si ictum impediere non potes et vulneri letali subis, potest severitatem vulneris, ab letali ad grave, minuere.

unit.source: Each strike carries high-temperature flames, and depending on your will, these flames can spread from your weapon to your enemy’s body upon contact, and each strike can cause massive explosion.
