unit.target: Unusquisque ictus flammas altae temperiae fert, et secundum voluntatem tuam, hae flammas ab armamento tuo ad corpus hostis in contactu diffundi possunt, et quisque ictus magnam explosionem causare potest.

unit.source: If the sword is coated with your target’s blood or if they’ve been scorched by its flames, you can throw it up to five kilometers into the sky.
unit.target: Si gladius sanguine propositi tinctus est aut si eius flammae eos combussere, eum ad quinque chiliometra in caelum iaculari potes.

unit.source: It will wrap itself in flames, fly toward the target like a live artillery shell, lock on, and then crash down, creating a violent explosion that can destroy everything in a typical public square.
unit.target: Ipse se in flammas involvet, ad propositum instar globuli tormentarii vivorum volabit, se figet, deinde ruet, creans violentam explosionem quae omnia in foro publico destruere potest.

unit.source: The maximum range is five kilometers, and it won’t return to you on its own; you’ll need to retrieve it.
unit.target: Distantia maxima est quinque chiliometra, et non se ipso ad te retribuet; te ipsi eum recuperare oportet.

unit.source: There are two drawbacks.
unit.target: Duae sunt incommoditates.

unit.source: First, excessive courage is a lethal poison.
unit.target: Primum, nimia fortitudo est venenum letale. fear and apprehension are among the key reasons humans have survived to this era.

unit.source: A person who only knows courage and not fear will likely lose their ability to judge and analyze, leading to a swift demise.
unit.target: Qui solam fortitudinem novit et timorem ignorat, probabiliter facultatem iudicandi et analyzandi amittet, quod celerem exitium adducet.

unit.source: Second, it needs companions.
unit.target: Secundo, adiutores necesse sunt.

unit.source: You’ll need to prepare at least thirty ordinary broadswords to place around it to complete the sealing process.
unit.target: Tibi necesse erit saltem triginta gladios ordinaris parare, quos circa eum disponere debes ad sigillum perficiendum.

unit.source: Otherwise, within about fifteen minutes, it will start attacking everyone nearby indiscriminately, including you.
unit.target: Alioquin, intra circiter quindecim minuta, omnes in vicinitate sine discrimine, te etiam includens, oppugnare incipiet.

unit.source: Don’t think about using the residual aura of the Blood Emperor to avoid or deter this, as this sword doesn’t have living characteristics; it’s a manifestation of its destructive godhood.
unit.target: Noli cogitare de usu aurae residualis Imperatoris Sanguinis ad hoc vitandum aut deterrendum, quoniam hic gladius proprietates viventis non habet; manifestatio enim est eius destructivae deitatis.

unit.source: It also constantly emits high temperatures, causing ordinary broadswords around it to gradually melt.
unit.target: Insuper constanter altam temperiem emittit, quae gladios ordinarios circa eum paulatim liquescere faciunt.

unit.source: So, you’ll need to regularly replace its companions.
unit.target: Ita necesse est ut adiutores eius regulariter reponas.

unit.source: Similarly, for you as the Reaper, it means enduring a progressively intensifying burn injury.
unit.target: Similiter, tibi ut Messor, hoc significat tolerare vulnera ustionis paulatim intensificanda.

unit.source: That’s about it.
unit.target: Hoc est.

unit.source: If you don’t mind, we can call it the ‘Sword of Courage’.
unit.target: Si non molestum est, id “Gladium Fortitudinis” appellare possumus.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Can the negative effects of being filled with courage be avoided if it’s carried in the Traveler’s Bag?”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et respondit: “Num effectus negativos virtute repleti vitari possunt, si in Sacculo Viatoris feruntur?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Madam Magician nodded gently.
unit.target: “Ita,” leniter annuit Domina Magica.

unit.source: Lumian pondered further and asked, “In the room where I found this sword, there was only one piece of armor, an altar, and two other items.
unit.target: Lumian ulterius cogitavit et rogavit: “In camera qua hunc gladium inveni, sola fuit una armatura, altare, et duo alia supellectiles.

unit.source: Why didn’t it destroy those things?”
unit.target: Cur ea non deleverit?

unit.source: “That suit of armor is its companion,” Madam Magician replied promptly.
unit.target: “Illa armatura comes eius est,” respondit Domina Magica statim.

unit.source: Lumian did not inquire further and began to consider how to use the Sword of Courage: / must fully assess the situation and make the right judgment before drawing the sword…
unit.target: Lumian ulterius non quaesivit et cogitare coepit quomodo Gladium Fortitudinis uti debeat: rem plenissime aestimare atque iudicium rectum ferre ante gladium trahendum…

unit.source: This isn’t a commander’s scepter; it’s a bugle for the charge…
unit.target: Hoc non est sceptrum imperatoris; est buccina ad impetum…

unit.source: /ts use must not exceed fifteen minutes…
unit.target: “/ts” usus non debet quindecim minuta excedere…

unit.source: While thinking, Lumian reached out and took hold of the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Dum cogitabat, Lumian manum extendit et Gladium Fortitudinis apprehendit.

unit.source: In the next second, he felt he didn’t need to overthink: Fear of this, fear of that—all of that only leads to failure!
unit.target: In secundo proximo sensit se non opus esse nimis cogitare: timor huius, timor illius—haec omnia ad defectum tantum ducunt!

unit.source: One should not be overly cautious or indecisive, just do it!
unit.target: Non nimis cautus aut irresolutus esse debet, solum age!

unit.source: What is there to fear?
unit.target: Quid est timendum?

unit.source: Madam Magician reached into the void and, from nowhere, produced dozens of broadswords with slight variations in design, letting them fly towards Lumian.
unit.target: Domina Magica in vacuum manum porriguit et, ex nihilo, complura gladios laterales cum levibus variationibus in forma protulit, eosque ad Lumian volitare permisit.

unit.source: After placing the Sword of Courage among these broadswords and stuffing it back into the Traveler’s Bag, Lumian snapped back to his senses.
unit.target: Postquam Gladium Fortitudinis inter hos gladios posuit et in Sacculum Viatoris recludit, Lumian ad sui sensus rediit.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but silently scoff at himself.
unit.target: Non potuit quin se tacite irridens reprehenderet.

unit.source: An Ascetic’s abilities don’t work in this case…
unit.target: Virtutes asceticorum in hoc casu non operandum esse videntur…

unit.source: Then, he took out a piece of pristine, fine leather and a half-solid, pale yellowish-red candle housed in a transparent glass vial.
unit.target: Deinde, extraxit partem corii pristini et candelam semi-solidam, pallide luteo‐rubram, in vitro vitreo perspicuo receptam.

unit.source: Stars again twinkled in Madam Magician’s eyes as she took the two items and examined them for several seconds.
unit.target: Stellae iterum in oculis Dominae Magicae micabant, dum has duas res arripiebat et per aliquot secundos examinabat.

unit.source: “This is indeed the potion formula of the Demoness of Despair, but the human skin carrying it comes from an ancient Demoness of Despair and contains strong, mystically powerful viruses, bacteria, and fungi.
unit.target: “Haec vere est formula poculi Demonissae Desperationis, sed corium humanum quod eam gerit ex antiqua Demonissa Desperationis provenit et potentissimis, mystice validis virus, bacterias, et fungi continet.

unit.source: It causes those who touch or gaze upon it to gradually contract various diseases.
unit.target: Facit ut qui illud tangunt aut intuentur, paulatim varias morbos concipiant.

unit.source: If contact and observation don’t exceed ten seconds, recovery will occur on its own,” Madam Magician briefly explained about the pristine leather.
unit.target: “Si contactus et contemplatio decem secundis non excedunt, sanatio ipsa eveniet,” Domina Magica de corio pristino breviter exponit.

unit.source: Her gaze then shifted to the peculiar candle.
unit.target: Eius aspectus deinde ad pecularem candelam versa est.

unit.source: “This is a corpse wax candle, made from the corpse oils of an Iron-blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair mixed with other substances.”
unit.target: “Haec est candela cerae cadaveris, confecta ex oleis cadaverum equitis sanguine ferrei et Demonissae Desperationis, cum aliis substantiis mixta.”

unit.source: Corpse wax candle…
unit.target: Candela cerae cadaveris…

unit.source: And from two demigods’ corpse oils…
unit.target: Et ex oleis cadaverum duorum semideorum…

unit.source: Although Lumian had seen much of the world, he still found the candle somewhat eerie and terrifying when he looked at it again.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian multum orbis terrarum viderat, candelam tamen aliquantulum mira et terrifica invenit cum eam iterum aspexit.

unit.source: “What is its use?” he asked, more concerned with this issue while feeling strangely uneasy.
unit.target: “Quid est eius usus?” rogavit, de hoc magis sollicitus et insuete inquietus.

unit.source: Madam Magician deliberated before responding, “Once lit and used in pacts and Cogitation, it should probably be paired with a ritual, but the specific details and ultimate effect are unclear.
unit.target: Domina Magica antequam responderet deliberavit, “Semel accensa et in pactis et cogitatione adhibita, fortasse cum ritu coniungenda est, sed specifica et effectus ultimus incerti sunt.

unit.source: Hmm, you have the residual aura of the Blood Emperor, maybe you can try it directly without a ritual.”
unit.target: “Hmm, residuam auram Imperatoris Sanguinis habes; fortasse id directe sine ritu conari potes.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t hesitate.
unit.target: Lumian non dubitavit.

unit.source: “Alright, I’ll try it now.”
unit.target: “Recte, nunc id conabor.”

unit.source: With an Angel and Saint watching over him, if anything went wrong, they could save him.
unit.target: Cum Angelus et Sanctus eum vigilarent, si quid male eveniret, eum servare poterant.

unit.source: Why wait to try it alone when he got back?
unit.target: Cur solus id temptare exspectare, cum rediisset?

unit.source: Neither Magician nor The Hanged Man stopped him.
unit.target: Nec Domina Magica nec vir suspenditus eum prohibuerunt.

unit.source: Lumian took the corpse wax candle from the glass jar and sat cross-legged on the deck.
unit.target: Lumian candelam cerae cadaveris e vitro extraxit et in genu flexis in tabulato consedit.

unit.source: Snap—his fingers produced a blazing white flame, and he immediately lit the black wick of the corpse wax candle.
unit.target: Crispatione digitorum flamma alba ardens oriebatur, et statim atram meinge candelam cerae cadaveris accendit.

unit.source: Then, he closed his eyes, visualized a pattern, and began to Cogitate.
unit.target: Deinde oculos clausit, figuram concipivit, et cogitare incipiebat.

unit.source: In the tranquil state of dispersion, a hint of dark fragrance entered his nostrils, causing his marrow to itch as if it were about to ignite.
unit.target: In tranquillo statu dissipationis, indicium fragrantiæ obscuræ in naribus eius intravit, faciens ut medulla eius prurire videbatur quasi inflammari velletur.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t try to endure this sensation; he simply concentrated on maintaining his cogitative state.
unit.target: Lumian hanc sensationem non tolerare conatus est; sed simpliciter in statu cogitativo permanere contigit.

unit.source: After some time, a dark mist suddenly appeared “before” his eyes.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, nebula obscura subito ante oculos eius apparuit.

unit.source: He seemed to be standing in this mist, on the edge of a barely visible street.
unit.target: Videbatur in hac nebula stadi, in margine plateae vix visibilis.

unit.source: Across the street, various not-too-tall buildings appeared as if they were mere shadows.
unit.target: Trans plateam, varia aedificia, non nimis alta, apparuerunt, quasi solum umbrae essent.

unit.source: Ding-ding—a vehicle resembling a steam train came from the other end of the street.
unit.target: Ding-ding — vehiculum, quod tramine vaporario simile videbatur, ex altero extremo plateae venit.

unit.source: It had few segments, just two, with no distinctive chimney but a strangely shaped bracket extending from the top, connecting to something in midair.
unit.target: Paucis segmentis constabat, tantum duobus, sine camini insigni, sed cum angulo insolito ex summo extendente, quod ad aliquid in aere intermedium coniungitur.

unit.source: Wh—Lumian’s memory was instantly triggered.
unit.target: Wh—memoria Lumiani statim excitata est.

unit.source: He had seen a similar scene in Fourth Epoch Trier!
unit.target: Similem scaenam in quarto aetate Trierensi vidit!

unit.source: It heralded the appearance of the second level in that special mirror world.
unit.target: Ea praenuntiavit adventum secundi gradus in illo mundo speculi peculiare.

unit.source: 747 Pact Experience
unit.target: Experientia Pacti 747

unit.source: 747 Pact Experience
unit.target: Experientia Pacti 747

unit.source: Ding-ding.
unit.target: Ding-ding.

unit.source: The object resembling a steam train whizzed past Lumian, its presence nearly obscured by the thick, dark mist.
unit.target: Objectum, quod tramen vaporis simile apparuit, celeriter Luminum praeteriit, eius praesentia paene obtecta a spessa et atra nebula.

unit.source: Yet, Lumian managed to discern some details: both carriages were blue and seemed to be crammed with passengers standing and facing the street, their expressions blurred and their forms lacking clear outlines.
unit.target: Tamen, Luminum aliqua perspicere potuit: utraque carraria caerulea erant et videbantur plene onerata vectore stantibus atque viam intuentes, quorum vultus confusi erant et formae liminibus definitis carentes.

unit.source: This is more than what I had witnessed in Fourth Epoch Trier—it isn’t powered by steam.
unit.target: Hoc est plus quam id quod in Trier Aetate Quarta conspexi—non enim vaporis vi operatur.

unit.source: As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Lumian noticed someone at the other end of the street, hunched over, pulling a black, two-wheeled cart with a canopy.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius fulserunt, Luminum animadvertit aliquem in extremo viae, incurvatum, trahentem carrum nigrum duarum rotarum cum tegmine.

unit.source: A lady sitting in the cart, holding a round fan and dressed in a long skirt, was hidden by the thick mist, which obscured the finer details of her and the puller’s attire.
unit.target: Femina in carro sedeens, ventilatrum rotundum tenens et in longa pallio induta, ab spessa nebula abscondita erat, quae subtiliora vestimenta eius atque trahentis occultebat.

unit.source: Lumian found himself staring as the black cart approached.
unit.target: Luminum se fixedo aspectu reperit dum carrus niger appropinquabat.

unit.source: At that moment, the lady in the cart lifted her fan to her face, turned slowly, and looked back at Lumian.
unit.target: Eo momento, femina in carro ventilatrum ad faciem suam levavit, lente se vertit, et ad Luminum respexit.

unit.source: As if the mist had thinned, Lumian could see the back of the lady’s hand holding the fan: swollen and shiny with dark, bluish patches.
unit.target: Velut nebula tenuata esset, Luminum videre potuit dorsum manus feminae, quae ventilatrum tenebat, tumida et nitida maculis obscuris et caeruleis ornamentata.

unit.source: The puller, with a towel around his neck, stopped, and the lady, who seemed about to step down from the peculiar cart, looked towards Lumian.
unit.target: Tractor, cum linteo circa collum induto, sistit, et femina, quae ex carru peculiario descensurum videbatur, ad Luminum respexit.

unit.source: A wave of fear washed over him, instinctively repelling any contact with the lady.
unit.target: Unda timoris eum pervasit, instinctu omne commercium cum ea evitans.

unit.source: Then, he heard a panicked whisper—it was his own voice, although he harbored no such thoughts!
unit.target: Tum audivit susurrum perterratus—erat vox eius ipsa, quamquam talia cogitationes non fovebat!

unit.source: Standing on the edge of the street, enveloped in the dark mist, Lumian felt a sharp tension as if his true self wasn’t entirely present.
unit.target: Stans in margine viae, in atra nebula involutus, Luminum acutam tensionem sensit, quasi verus ipse non omnino adesset.

unit.source: Lumian’s heart tightened as he attempted to step back.
unit.target: Cor Luminum contraxit, cum conabatur recedere.

unit.source: He suddenly found himself floating up, soaring into midair.
unit.target: Subito se invenit levitare sursum, in medium aërem volitans.

unit.source: He saw the core of the dense mist, a vast city with a bizarre, shadowy high tower beneath which lay unspeakable horrors and gloom.
unit.target: Vidit mediam densae nebulae partem: magnam urbem cum turri altae et insolitae, sub qua inaudita horrores et lugenda tristitia iacebant.

unit.source: Unwillingly, he flew towards it.
unit.target: Invitus ad eam volavit.

unit.source: Almost at the same time, he saw specks of starlight appear.
unit.target: Paene simul, vidit puncta lucis stellarum emergere.

unit.source: Lumian abruptly exited his Cogitative state; the city and tower wrapped in the dark mist, the segmented train, and the lady with the floral fan vanished from his “vision.”
unit.target: Luminum subitaneus ex statu cogitativo exiit; urbs et turris, in atra nebula involutae, tramen segmentatum, et femina cum ventilatro florido, ex visione eius evanuerunt.

unit.source: He opened his eyes to see Madam Magician and Mr. Hanged Man.
unit.target: Oculos aperuit, ut Dominam Magicam atque Dominum Suspenditum videret.

unit.source: “You were a bit off just now, showing signs of losing control, so I had to wake you,” Madam Magician briefly explained.
unit.target: «Modo aliquantulum aberas, signa moderationis amittendi ostendens, itaque te excitare necesse habui,» Domina Magica breviter explicavit.

unit.source: Lumian thanked her, extinguished the enticingly fragrant corpse wax candle, and detailed the scenes and characters he had witnessed during his meditation.
unit.target: Luminum eam gratias egit, candela cerae cadaveris, olentissima et alliciens, exstinxit, atque scaenas et characteres, quos in meditatione perspexerat, enarravit.

unit.source: Madam Magician nodded thoughtfully and remarked, “It’s similar to a pact-making ritual."
unit.target: Domina Magica cogitato animo caput annuit et inquit, «Simile est ritu pacti faciendi.»

unit.source: “This has established a connection between you and some unknown entity, progressively aligning with it.
unit.target: «Hoc coniunxit te cum aliqua entitate ignota, quae paulatim tecum se conciliat.»

unit.source: However, unlike a true pact ritual that is directed towards deities, angels, demons, or evil spirits, your pact seems to be with a city.
unit.target: Tamen, contra vero, non ut verus ritus pacti, qui ad deos, angelos, daemones aut malos spiritus pertinet, pactum tuum cum urbe esse videtur.

unit.source: “If I hadn’t interrupted the process earlier, you might have accessed some higher knowledge or power through this pact experience, though it likely wouldn’t have been something positive.”
unit.target: «Si non processum prius interrumpererim, aliquod altiora scientiam aut potentiam per hanc experientiam pacti adeptus esses, etiamsi probabiliter non aliquid beneficum fuisset.»

unit.source: Lumian, no novice in mysticism, understood the nature and implications of such rituals.
unit.target: Luminum, non novitius in mysteriis, naturam atque implicationes talium rituum intellexit.

unit.source: He pondered and then countered, “So, you’re saying that the city in the fog, closely related to Fourth Epoch Trier and very special, has formed a connection with me through this corpse wax candle, despite the vast distances and the layers of seals between us?”
unit.target: Cogitavit deinde et respondit: «Ergo dicis urbem in nebula, quae Trier Aetate Quarta arcte coniuncta atque valde specialis est, per hanc candela cerae cadaveris mecum coniunctionem instituisse, non obstante ingentibus distantibus et stratis sigillis inter nos?»

unit.source: “Yes, it’s not an illusion,” Madam Magician replied, looking towards the candle encased in a small glass vial with a light yellow and red hue.
unit.target: «Ita, non est illusio,» respondit Domina Magica, intuens candelam in parva ampulla vitrea inclusam, leviter flavescentem et rubescentem.

unit.source: “Besides the corpse oils of the Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair, this candle likely contains some special materials to which its origins I’m not aware of.
unit.target: «Praeter olea cadaveris Equitis Sanguinis Ferrei et Demonissae Desperationis, haec candela verisimiliter aliquam materiam specialem continet, cujus originem nescio.

unit.source: There are two other locations where it could be more effective, allowing you to see and experience more.
unit.target: Sunt duo alii loci in quibus efficacior esse possit, quae tibi plura videre et experiri sinunt.

unit.source: But those are far too dangerous; you already showed signs of losing control, so I wouldn’t recommend trying it now.”
unit.target: Sed illi nimis periculosi sunt; iam signa moderationis amittendi ostendisti, ideo nunc id experiri non commendo.

unit.source: “The other two locations…” Lumian’s curiosity piqued.
unit.target: «Ceteri duo loci…» Luminum curiositas excitata est.

unit.source: “Is one of them Fourth Epoch Trier?”
unit.target: «Estne unus ex illis Trier Aetate Quarta?»

unit.source: In Fourth Epoch Trier, he could already partially see that misty city.
unit.target: In Trier Aetate Quarta iam partim illam urbem nebulosam videre poterat.

unit.source: Lighting the candle and entering a Cogitative state would surely reveal much more sights and experiences!
unit.target: Candela accensa et in statum cogitativum ingrediens certo plura visa et experientiae patefientur!

unit.source: “Yes,” Madam Magician affirmed Lumian’s guess.
unit.target: «Ita,» Domina Magica coniecturam Luminum affirmavit.

unit.source: “And where is the other place?” Lumian inquired further.
unit.target: «Et ubi est alter locus?» Luminum ulterius inquisivit.

unit.source: Unless the School of Truth’s vortex project could unlock Fourth Epoch Trier’s seals, it would be a long time before he could re-enter that version of Trier.
unit.target: Nisi projectum vortex Scholae Veritatis sigilla Trier Aetate Quarta reserare posset, multum temporis ante reingressionem eius versionis futurum erat.

unit.source: Madam Magician eyed Lumian for a few seconds before simply stating, “Bansy.”
unit.target: Domina Magica Luminum per aliquot momenta intuens, deinde simpliciter dixit: «Bansy.»

unit.source: Bansy… Bansy Harbor?
unit.target: Bansy… Portus Bansy?

unit.source: The harbor that had been destroyed by the Church of Storms due to some corruption, where no one had escaped?
unit.target: Portus, qui a Ecclesia Tempestatum propter corruptionem deleta est, in quo nemo effugit?

unit.source: That was also the former home of Red Angel Medici…
unit.target: Id quoque olim erat domus Redi Angeli Medici…

unit.source: Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly.
unit.target: Luminum paene imperceptibiliter annuit.

unit.source: Considering the Red Angel’s gains in Fourth Epoch Trier and the pathways He took, Lumian had no doubts about the special nature of Bansy Harbor being akin to that of Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Consideratis lucris Redi Angeli in Trier Aetate Quarta et itineribus quibus egit, Luminum non dubitabat de natura speciali Portus Bansy, quae Trier Aetate Quarta similis esset.

unit.source: “Of course, it must be a specific place in Bansy Harbor, not just anywhere,” Madam Magician added.
unit.target: «Certe, debet esse locus peculiaris in Portu Bansy, non omnino ubicumque,» Domina Magica addidit.

unit.source: Then she continued, “There’s another place I’m not sure about for the candle’s efficacy.”
unit.target: Deinde perrexit: «Alius locus est, de quo quantopere candela efficax sit, certus non sum.»

unit.source: “Which place?” Lumian asked, then had a sudden insight, “City of Exiles, Morora?”
unit.target: «Qui locus?» Luminum rogavit, deinde subito intellexit: «Urbs Exilium, Morora?»

unit.source: “Correct, you’re now clearly seeing the connections between things,” Madam Magician praised him, sternly advising, “If you do decide to venture to those places and use the corpse wax candle to aid your Cogitation and complete the pact, make sure someone is with you at all times to monitor your condition and wake you immediately if anything unusual occurs.”
unit.target: «Recte, nunc manifesta coniunctiones rerum vides,» Domina Magica eum laudavit et severiter admonuit, «si statuas iter illis locis agere et candela cerae cadaveris ad tuam cogitationem adiuvandam atque pactum perficere adhibere, cura ut semper aliquis te comitari possit, ut condicionem tuam perscrutetur atque te statim excitet, si quid insolitum eveniat.»

unit.source: “I’ll remember that,” Lumian promised earnestly.
unit.target: «Id meminero,» Luminum ex animo promisit.

unit.source: As Madam Magician gestured for Lumian to pack away the candle, she thought for a moment and said, “Use the Sword of Courage as a Sealed Artifact for now.
unit.target: Dum Domina Magica Luminum ad candelam recondendam hortabatur, paulisper meditata, dixit: «Utere gladio fortitudinis ut rem sigillatam pro tempore.»

unit.source: “When it’s time to concoct the Iron-blooded Knight potion, I’ll revert it into a Beyonder characteristic.”
unit.target: «Cum tempus ad potionem Equitis Sanguinis Ferreae conficiendam venerit, eam in proprietatem Beyonder revertere curabo.»

unit.source: “By the way, the Sealed Artifact crafted by Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristics should be completed in a few days.”
unit.target: «Praeterea, Artifactum Sigillatum, a proprietatibus Beyonder Hisoka confectum, paucis diebus perficietur.»

unit.source: “Thank you, Madam Magician,” Lumian expressed his gratitude sincerely.
unit.target: «Gratias tibi ago, Domina Magica,» inquit Luminum sincere.

unit.source: Although obtaining the Iron-blooded Knight main ingredient so easily felt somewhat unreal, when he thought about how the Blood Emperor’s residual aura came to be, which played a key role in it, and the issue of the Underworld Daoist’s seal, he realized it wasn’t that “easy” after all.
unit.target: Licet adeptio ingredienti principali Equitis Sanguinis Ferreae tam facile videbatur ut quasi irrealia, cum cogitaret quomodo aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, quae partes maximas obtinuerat, exsisteret, atque quaestione sigilli Taoistae Inferni, intellexit tamen id non ita facile esse.

unit.source: Lumian then discussed the remains of Omebella’s umbilical cord and Ludwig’s three processing methods, finally asking, “Can I consume that piece of umbilical cord to gain some of the Great Mother’s Child of God’s bloodline?”
unit.target: Deinde Luminum de reliquiis funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae et tribus methodis Ludwigii tractandas disseruit, denique rogans: «Num illud fragmentum funiculi ombilicalis sumere possum ut aliquam partem stirpis sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre adipiscar?»

unit.source: Madam Magician’s expression turned slightly strange as she looked towards The Hanged Man Alger, seemingly seeking his opinion on the matter.
unit.target: Vultus Dominae Magicae paulo insolitus factus est, dum ad Dominum Suspenditum Alger spectabat, quasi eius sententiam de re quaereret.

unit.source: The Hanged Man looked at Lumian and asked seriously, “This will indeed bring you some opportunities, but with them, corresponding risks as well.
unit.target: Dominus Suspenditus Luminum intuebatur et serio quaesivit: «Hoc certe tibi aliquas opportunitates afferet, sed simul pericula congruentes quoque.

unit.source: We can help you, but we can’t be there every moment.
unit.target: Te adiuvare possumus, sed non possumus omni momento adesse.

unit.source: You need to consider whether you’re willing to take this risk and if it’s worth it.”
unit.target: Oportet te deliberare an hoc periculum subire velis et an id pretium habeat.

unit.source: Madam Magician added, “While the Great Mother’s attention might sound nebulous and not tangible enough to have a real effect—after all, you’re already under the scrutiny of the being known as Inevitability—having one more such entity’s attention might not seem like a big deal.
unit.target: Domina Magica addidit, «Etsi attentio Magnae Matris nebulosa videri potest et non satis concreta ad effectum verum facienda, cum iam sub inspectione entitatis, quae “Inevitabilitas” appellatur, sis, alterius huiusmodi attentio non videatur rem magni momenti esse.

unit.source: However, remember, the Great Mother’s interference and permeation in our world far exceed those of the Inevitability entity.
unit.target: Tamen memento, interventio et permeatio Magnae Matris in nostro mundo longe superant illa entitatis Inevitabilitatis.

unit.source: If you do consume Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants, you might face unknown influences or attract special enemies without even realizing it.
unit.target: Si reliquias funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae consumes, fortasse incognitas influentias subire aut hostes speciales attrahere poteris, quin id sentias.

unit.source: “Of course, there’s only a potential risk, not a certainty.”
unit.target: «Certe, solum periculum potentiale est, non certitudo.»

unit.source: What concerned Lumian more was another point.
unit.target: Quod Luminum magis sollicitavit, alterum erat.

unit.source: “Madam Magician, Mr. Hanged Man, it seems you’ve already confirmed that consuming Omebella’s umbilical cord will bring some opportunities?”
unit.target: «Domina Magica, Domine Suspendite, videtur iam confirmavisse vos quod reliquias funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae sumere nonnullas opportunitates afferre possint?»

unit.source: This must be a significantly useful opportunity; otherwise, Madam Magician’s expression wouldn’t have become strange, nor would she have consulted Mr. Hanged Man.
unit.target: Hoc certe occasionem utilissimam esse debet; alioquin vultus Dominae Magicae non fuisset insolitus neque Dominum Suspenditum consuluisset.

unit.source: There’s no need to hesitate on matters with only downsides; it’s the presence of significant potential benefits that causes Madam Magician to pause!
unit.target: Non est opus haesitare de rebus quae solum incommoda habent; sed praesentia commodorum potentialium maximi efficit ut Domina Magica pauseat!

unit.source: Madam Magician weighed her words carefully before responding, “The vortex project might involve a location tainted by the Great Mother’s power, teeming with monsters spawned from this corruption.
unit.target: Domina Magica verba sua caute ponderavit antequam respondit: «Projectum vortex includere potest locum, ab potentia Magnae Matris contaminatum, monstris ex hac corruptione generatis plenum.

unit.source: If you possess the bloodline of the Great Mother’s Child of God, theoretically, you wouldn’t need to worry about attacks from them, and you might even be able to command them simply.
unit.target: Si stirpem sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre possides, theoretice de eorum impetibus non solliciti eris, atque fortasse eos simpliciter imperare poteris.

unit.source: That’s one aspect.
unit.target: Hoc est unum aspectus.

unit.source: Another is that once you meet two other prerequisite conditions, you should be able to touch and briefly use a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.”
unit.target: Alterum est quod, cum duas alias conditiones praerequiras impleveris, tangeri atque breviter uti Artifacto Sigillato Gradus 0 poteris.

unit.source: Grade 0 Sealed Artifact… Extremely Dangerous.
unit.target: Artifactum Sigillatum Gradus 0… valde periculosum.

unit.source: Not to be inquired, disseminated, described, or spied; capable of destroying a country or even the whole world… Lumian’s spirit lifted at the mention.
unit.target: Non ad quaerendum, divulgandum, describendum, neque inspiciendum destinatum; id habet potentiam terram aut totum orbem delere… Spiritus Luminum in hac mentione elevatus est.

unit.source: So far, he had indirectly encountered two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts: 0-01 and 0-05.
unit.target: Usque ad hoc, duos Artifactos Sigillatos Gradus 0 — 0-01 et 0-05 — indirecte occurrerat.

unit.source: “What’s the number of that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact?” Lumian curiously asked.
unit.target: «Quod est numerus illius Artifacti Sigillati Gradus 0?» inquit Luminum curiosus.

unit.source: “Why would having the Great Mother’s Child of God bloodline allow me to touch and briefly use it?”
unit.target: «Cur possessio stirpis sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre mihi permittit eam tangere atque brevi tempore uti?»

unit.source: Madam Magician glanced at Lumian and said, “I can’t tell you the details yet.
unit.target: Domina Magica Luminum aspiciens inquit: «Nondum tibi singularia exponere possum.

unit.source: All I can say is, it’s not the Child of God bloodline of the Great Mother that allows you to touch it, but rather the integration of Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants with you that helps you access it without facing severe danger, because it originated from Omebella’s remains.”
unit.target: Singillatim dicere possum: non stirpes sanguinis Proles Dei a Magna Matre te facit eam tangere, sed potius integratio reliquiarum funiculi ombilicalis Omebellae cum te adiuvat, ut eam intueri possis sine magno periculo, quoniam ex reliquiis Omebellae orta est.

unit.source: Omebella’s remains… Omebella had remains before being born?
unit.target: Reliquiae Omebellae… Omebella ante ortum reliquias habebat?

unit.source: No, that’s normal, as there are already remnants of the umbilical cord before She was born…
unit.target: Non, hoc normale est, quia iam ante nativitatem eius reliquiae funiculi ombilicalis exstiterunt…

unit.source: Ah, the one that shares the same name?
unit.target: Ah, ille qui eundem nomen habet?

unit.source: No, obviously, it’s more than just sharing names…
unit.target: Non, manifesta quidem, plus est quam solum nomen communicare.

unit.source: Lumian pondered and then asked, “Are you referring to the remnants of the Goddess of Harvest from ancient times?”
unit.target: Lumian meditatus deinde rogavit: «Referisne ad reliquias Deae Messis ex temporibus antiquis?»

unit.source: times?
unit.target: Tempora?

unit.source: 748 Despair Ritual
unit.target: 748 Rituale Desperationis

unit.source: 748 Despair Ritual
unit.target: 748 Rituale Desperationis

unit.source: Madam Magician confirmed Lumian’s guess, “Yes, the remains of Omebella, the Goddess of Harvest.”
unit.target: Magistra Magica coniecturam Lumiani confirmavit: “Ita, reliquiae Omebellae, Deae Messis.”

unit.source: The remains of the Goddess of Harvest… a Grade O Sealed Artifact… contact should be possible and briefly usable… Lumian asked eagerly, “What are the other two prerequisites, besides merging with the remnants of Omebella’s umbilical cord?”
unit.target: Reliquiae Deae Messis… artifactum sigillatum gradus O… contactus fieri debet et brevi tempore usui praesto… Lumian avidissime rogavit: “Quae sunt altera duo praerequisita, praeter fusionem cum reliquiis funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae?”

unit.source: Magician laughed self-deprecatingly and said, “I really shouldn’t have told you this; it’s spurred you to truly consider taking risks.
unit.target: Magica subridente seipsam vituperans dixit: “Revera non debui tibi hoc dicere; id te ad pericula subeunda vere impulsit.”

unit.source: “Of course, as a high-ranking Astromancer, I can’t say I didn’t foresee this. Telling you everything and letting you decide is my choice.
unit.target: “Certe, ut summus Astromancer, non possum dicere me hoc non praevidisse. Omnia tibi narrare et tibi decernendi facultatem relinquere mihi arbitrium est.”

unit.source: “The two prerequisites are: “First, you must have been betrayed by a direct relative; second, you must be female.”
unit.target: “Dua praerequisita sunt: Primo, proditus a cognato recto esse debes; Secundo, oportet te esse feminam.”

unit.source: Wh-—This clearly disappointed Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc plane Lumian displicuit.

unit.source: He felt he met the betrayal requirement, as his biological father had abandoned him and his mother, leading to his grandfather’s bankruptcy.
unit.target: Sensi me praerequisitum proditionis adimplevisse, cum pater meus biologicus eum et matrem reliquerit, quod ad ruinam avi duxit.

unit.source: But why did he have to be a woman?
unit.target: Sed cur oportuit eum feminam esse?

unit.source: Madam Magician seemed to guess his thoughts.
unit.target: Magistra Magica videbatur eius cogitationes coniectare.

unit.source: “You barely meet the betrayal criterion. As for being female, in the world of mysticism, there are ways to temporarily transform you into a woman, such as a special mystical item from the Demoness pathway, which doesn’t necessarily require a high Sequence.
unit.target: “Vix ad praerequisitum proditionis convenis. Quoad feminam, in mundo mystico sunt modi temporarii quibus te in feminam convertere possis, ut exempli gratia per rem mysticam specialem ex via Demonessa, quae non necessario altam Sequentiam requirit.”

unit.source: “That’s true…” Lumian thought of the Lie earring.
unit.target: “Ita vero…” Lumian de “Auriculis Mendacibus” cogitavit.

unit.source: Although it couldn’t change his gender, its ability to alter appearances or adjust height was equally magical.
unit.target: Quamquam generum eius mutare non potuit, facultas eius ad speciem mutandam aut altitudinem accommodandam aeque magica erat.

unit.source: If such items existed, then surely there must be artifacts that could change one’s gender, which, given Lumian’s understanding of the Demoness path, he believed to be almost certainly existent, albeit rare and special.
unit.target: Si talia essent, certe debent esse artifacta quae generum transformare possint, quae – ratione cognitionis Lumiani de via Demonessa – quasi certo exsistere existimavit, etiamsi rara et specialia.

unit.source: Lumian’s hope was rekindled about accessing Omebella’s remains.
unit.target: Spes Lumiani, ad reliquias Omebellae accedendi, iterum renata est.

unit.source: That was a Grade O Sealed Artifact!
unit.target: Id erat artifactum sigillatum gradus O!

unit.source: Madam Magician, with a quirky expression, gave another reminder. “If you truly consume Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants and possess the bloodline of the Great Mother, you will forever be unable to approach Pride Armor.
unit.target: Magistra Magica, vultu insolito, aliam admonitionem edidit: “Si vere reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae consumas et sanguinem Magnæ Matris habeas, in aeternum ad Armaturam Superbiæ accedere non poteris.”

unit.source: “Your backstabbing of it would fade over time, but once you become a false Omebella, it will target you first and always, unless there’s someone more special present who’s worth targeting.”
unit.target: “Tua proditione tergi tempore evanescet; sed cum falsam Omebellam fias, illa te primum et semper adpetet, nisi aliquis specialis, qui id meritum sit, adsit.”

unit.source: Is this a manifestation of Pride Armor’s hatred for the Earth pathway?
unit.target: Num hoc est manifestatio odii Armaturæ Superbiæ erga viam Terræ?

unit.source: In future battles, if I’m nearby, Franca and the others won’t be able to use Pride Armor…
unit.target: In proeliis futuris, si prope sim, Franca et ceteri Armaturam Superbiæ uti non poterint…

unit.source: However, between Pride Armor and a Grade O Sealed Artifact, any sane person knows which to choose, even if the latter is only for temporary use…
unit.target: Tamen, inter Armaturam Superbiæ et artifactum sigillatum gradus O, quisquam mens sana scit quam eligere oporteat, etiamsi ultimum solum ad tempus sit.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, indicating he understood.
unit.target: Lumian capite annuit, significans se intellexisse.

unit.source: Madam Magician didn’t continue the topic.
unit.target: Magistra Magica rem non prosequebat.

unit.source: “The deal with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church can move forward. Let me know the agreed time and place for the transaction.
unit.target: “Pactum cum Ecclesia Solis Æterni Flammei procedere potest. Mihi indica tempus et locum consensum pro transactione.”

unit.source: “That Sealed Artifact can’t be transferred by you; it’s too dangerous. Have the Purifiers prepare to seal it on-site; she will appear herself.”
unit.target: “Illud artifactum sigillatum a te transferi nequit; nimis periculosum est. Purificatores praeparent ut in loco id sigillent; ipsa se ostendet.”

unit.source: “Alright.” Lumian took this opportunity to relay other information he had gathered in the past few days.
unit.target: “Recte.” Lumian hoc tempore usus est ut alias notitias quas paucis diebus collegisset referret.

unit.source: Hearing that the Demon Warlock Burman was influenced by Harrison from Resurrection Island, wanting to touch the mark of deep death, and the evil spirit he summoned and killed was suspected to be himself, Madam Magician turned her head towards Mr. Hanged Man.
unit.target: Audivit quod Demonum Warlock Burman a Harrison de Insula Resurrectione influentia affectus esset, cum cupiret signum mortis profundi attingere, et quod spiritus malus quem evocavit necavisset suspiceretur; itaque Magistra Magica caput convertit ad Dominum “Hanged Man.”

unit.source: Lumian had previously heard from Madam Magician that the Tarot Club was already investigating Resurrection Island, specifically Mr. Hanged Man and Ma‘am Hermit.
unit.target: Lumian antea a Magistra Magica audiverat Club Taroticum iam Insulam Resurrectionem investigare, in specie Mr. Hanged Man et Domina Hermit.

unit.source: The one known as the ‘Stormbringer’ among the Major Arcana cards thoughtfully said, “This is related to something I’m investigating.
unit.target: Ille, notus inter chartas Major Arcana ut “Tempestam Fertorem”, cogitans dixit: “Hoc pertinet ad rem quam investigo.”

unit.source: “I can’t reveal the specifics yet, but you should know Harrison is likely to appear in places closely linked to death, darkness, dusk, and decay. If you encounter someone of unknown origin in such scenarios, remember to tell me.”
unit.target: “Non possum adhuc particularia revelare, sed scito quod Harrison probabiliter in locis arcte connexis cum morte, tenebris, crepusculo, et corruptione appariturus sit. Si aliquem ignotum in talibus occasionibus occursurus fueris, memento mihi indicare.”

unit.source: Death, darkness, dusk, decay.. Truly someone from Resurrection Island… Lumian wasn’t surprised by Mr. Hanged Man’s hint.
unit.target: Mors, tenebrae, crepusculum, corruptio… Vere aliquis ex Insula Resurrectionis… Lumian implicationem Domini “Hanged Man” non miratus est.

unit.source: He was more concerned about whether Resurrection Island’s ‘resurrection’ was indeed a true resurrection.
unit.target: Magis autem curabat utrum “resurrectio” Insulae Resurrectionis revera esset.

unit.source: Madam Magician could read what he was pondering.
unit.target: Magistra Magica videre poterat quid ille meditaret.

unit.source: “I’ve said before, we aren’t Beyonders of the Death pathway, so we don’t fundamentally understand the situation on Resurrection Island, and it’s difficult to have a precise view of their so-called ‘resurrection.’ Maybe a direct encounter with Harrison or another islander will provide the insights you’re seeking.
unit.target: “Iam dixi, non sumus Beyonders viæ Mortis, itaque casum Insulae Resurrectionis non radicitus intellegimus, nec facile accuratam visionem de eorum ‘resurrectione’ habere possumus. Forsitan conventus directus cum Harrison aut alio insulana perspicacitatem, quam quaeris, afferet.”

unit.source: “The only thing I can say now is, think about Demon Warlock Burman. His condition had clearly worsened since Harrison led him to kill what seemed to be his own evil spirit. The inhabitants of Resurrection Island likely have issues.
unit.target: “Unum nunc dicere possum: cogita de Demon Warlock Burman. Eius condicio manifeste peior facta est ex quo Harrison eum ad occidendum, quod videbatur esse proprium spiritum malum, duxit. Incolae Insulae Resurrectionis verisimiliter quaestiones habent.”

unit.source: “Heh, I was right last time when I said the Arden evil spirit might still be alive after the related ritual.”
unit.target: “Heh, recte prius dixi spiritum malum Arden fortasse post ritum pertinens adhuc vivere.”

unit.source: Lumian fell silent.
unit.target: Lumian siluit.

unit.source: Upon returning to Trier, Lumian promptly made his way to 9 Rue Orosai and knocked on the door of Room 702.
unit.target: Revertens ad Trier, Lumian celeriter ad 9 Rue Orosai pervenit et ianuam Cubiculi 702 pulsavit.

unit.source: “Why are you here again?” Franca opened the door with a look of disdain.
unit.target: “Cur iterum hic es?” Franca ianuam aperuit vultu contemptus.

unit.source: He had left less than an hour ago!
unit.target: Abiit ante minus quam horam!

unit.source: Fortunately, it was daytime.
unit.target: Fortunate, tempus diurnum erat.

unit.source: She hadn’t been planning anything yet—what if she had been scared out of her wits?
unit.target: Nihil praeparaverat—quid si metu extremo oppressa esset?

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Jenna, who was curled up on the living room sofa with a book, propping herself up to look at him.
unit.target: Lumian Jennam intuebatur, quae in sofa conclavi cum libro relaxata erat, ut eum aspiceret.

unit.source: He smiled at the two Demonesses and said, “I’ve managed to obtain the potion formula of the Demoness of Despair.”
unit.target: Subridens duabus Demonessibus dixit: “Formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis adeptus sum.”

unit.source: “Ah?” Franca looked puzzled.
unit.target: “Ah?” Franca, vultu perplexo, aspexit.

unit.source: Hadn’t he just acquired the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula?
unit.target: Num non modo formula potionis “Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei” modo adeptus eras?

unit.source: Or had he accomplished something significant in the few minutes since he left?
unit.target: An aliquid magnum in paucis minutis postquam discessit perfecit?

unit.source: Jenna was equally baffled, thinking Lumian was joking at first.
unit.target: Jenna similiter perplexa erat, putans Lumian initio iocari.

unit.source: Despair was a Sequence 4 potion formula that contained the method humans used to pry open the gates to godhood.
unit.target: Desperatio erat formula potionis Sequenciae IV, quae modum continens patefaciendi portas ad deitatem ab hominibus adhibitus erat.

unit.source: How could it be obtained so easily?
unit.target: Quomodo ita facile obtiniri potuit?

unit.source: In a flash of thought, Franca and Jenna asked in unison: “Did you go to the Blue Avenger?”
unit.target: In momento cogitationis, Franca et Jenna simul rogaverunt: “Accessisti ad Blue Avenger?”

unit.source: “Have you finished exploring the Blue Avenger?”
unit.target: “Num Blue Avenger exploravisti?”

unit.source: “Just a preliminary exploration,” Lumian squeezed past Franca, smiling as he spoke.
unit.target: “Modo exploratio praevia,” Lumian praeter Francam transiit, subridente loquens.

unit.source: “You got the Demoness of Despair potion formula from just a preliminary exploration?”
unit.target: “Ex solâ exploratione praevia tantum formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis adeptus es?”

unit.source: Jenna asked, somewhat incredulously.
unit.target: Jenna quaesivit, aliquantulum incrédula.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “That’s one of the Blood Emperor’s legacies. A Sequence 4 potion formula should be considered pretty normal among the treasures.”
unit.target: “Hoc est unum ex legato Imperatoris Sanguinis. Formula potionis Sequenciae IV inter thesauros prorsus ordinaria esse debet.”

unit.source: “What else did you find?” Franca asked curiously after closing the door.
unit.target: “Quid aliud invenisti?” Franca post ianuam claudendam curiosa rogavit.

unit.source: Lumian casually took a seat on an armchair and recounted his adventure aboard the Blue Avenger, including his interactions with Madam Magician and Mr. Hanged Man from start to finish.
unit.target: Lumian in sellam bracchatam consedit et narravit suum adventum in Blue Avenger, inter quos interactiones cum Magistra Magica et Mr. Hanged Man a principio ad finem comprehensae erant.

unit.source: “That corpse wax candle sounds rather sinister,” Franca genuinely exclaimed.
unit.target: “Illum candela cera ex cadavere valde sinistrum sonat,” Franca vere exclamavit.

unit.source: Jenna nodded in agreement, feeling like she had just heard a horror story.
unit.target: Jenna capite annuit, consensu effuso, sensa quasi nuper fabulam horroris audivisset.

unit.source: As a Beyonder of the Demoness pathway, friend of a Hunter, hearing that the candle was made from the corpse oils of an Iron-blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair always made her inadvertently think of herself, Franca, and Lumian.
unit.target: Ut Beyonder viæ Demonessae, et amica venatoris, audivit candela ex oleis cadaverum Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei et Demonessae Desperationis factam esse, semper inopinato ad se, Francam, et Lumianum reminiscens.

unit.source: Just as Jenna felt Franca had voiced her own thoughts, she heard her female companion eagerly propose, “Last time in Fourth Epoch Trier, I barely saw what that misty city looked like.
unit.target: Iam, cum Jenna sensit Francam suas cogitationes exprimere, audivit comitem feminam suam ferventer proponere: “Ultima vice in Trier Quarta Aetate vix vidi qualis illa urbs nebulosa appareret.”

unit.source: You didn’t describe it clearly enough.
unit.target: Non satis clare eam enarrasti.

unit.source: Can I use that candle to make a pact and see the misty city from inside or from the air?
unit.target: Licetne mihi illa candelam ad pactum faciendum et ad urbum nebulosum intus aut ex aere intuendum uti?

unit.source: “You guys be my guardians!”
unit.target: “Vos sitis mei custodes!”

unit.source: “That candle burns very quickly. I only tried it once, and it used up a fifth of it,” Lumian thought aloud, “Let’s wait for a chance to visit Bansy Harbor or enter Fourth Epoch Trier, then you can try it.
unit.target: “Illa candela celeriter ardet. Semel tantum experior, et quinta eius consumitur,” Lumian alta voce cogitavit: “Exspectemus occasionem ut Bansy Portum visitare aut in Trier Quarta Aetate intrare possimus, et deinde eam temptare potestis.”

unit.source: Besides, Madam Magician said that without the Blood Emperor’s residual aura, a specific ritual is needed to assist, and no one knows yet what that ritual is like.
unit.target: Praeterea, Magistra Magica dixit sine aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, ritualem singularem auxilium requiri, nec quisquam adhuc novit quo modo hic rituus sit.

unit.source: Maybe once we’re in Bansy or Fourth Epoch Trier, influenced by the environment, we won’t need the ritual anymore.”
unit.target: Forsitan, cum in Bansy aut Trier Quarta Aetate erimus, ambiente affecti, ritualem amplius non indigebimus.

unit.source: “That’ll do,” Franca relented.
unit.target: “Ita satis,” Franca concessit.

unit.source: A corpse wax candle that could only be used four more times obviously needed to be reserved for the best occasions.
unit.target: Candela cera ex cadavere, quae solum quater iteribus usui adhiberi posset, manifeste ad optimas occasiones reservanda erat.

unit.source: Franca turned to Lumian.
unit.target: Franca ad Lumian se convertit.

unit.source: Franca, brimming with enthusiasm, said to Lumian, “Let’s see the Demoness of Despair’s potion formula.”
unit.target: Franca, studio pleno, ad Lumian dixit: “Videamus formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis.”

unit.source: “What’s my reward?” Lumian joked.
unit.target: “Quid mihi praemium est?” Lumian iocose dixit.

unit.source: Franca clicked her tongue.
unit.target: Franca lingua strinxit.

unit.source: “I’ll keep an eye out at the Demoness Sect for any mystical items that can change gender and give it to you for free.”
unit.target: “In Secta Demonessa observabo, si qua res mystica ad genus mutandum inveniatur, et tibi libere tradam.”

unit.source: With that, Franca’s smile grew even brighter, her eyes sparkling.
unit.target: Hoc facto, risus Francae lucidius effulsit, et oculi eius fulgentes erant.

unit.source: “I really look forward to that day.”
unit.target: “Illum diem vere exspecto.”

unit.source: Jenna imagined it for a moment and found herself also a bit excited.
unit.target: Jenna per momentum id imaginavit et se aliquantulum excitatam invenit.

unit.source: Considering the potential consequences of debating over this topic, Lumian pretended to be at a loss for words and quickly took out a sheet of delicate human skin from his Traveler’s Bag and laid it on the coffee table.
unit.target: Consideratis consequentiis potentialibus huius argumenti, Lumian se verbis carere simulavit et celeriter paginam cutis humanae delicatae ex sacco Viatoris extraxit atque in mensa posuit.

unit.source: The three only glanced at the potion formula before swiftly moving away, taking a moment before returning to continue.
unit.target: Tres tantum formulae potionis intuerunt, deinde celeriter se avulsere, paulisper morantes antequam redeunt ad continuandum.

unit.source: After a few repeats, the contents of the Sequence 4 potion formula fully emerged in their minds: “Name: Despair; “Sequence: 4; “Main ingredients: Plague Mother Serpent’s venom sac; Silver Hunter’s crystal; “Supplementary ingredients: 10 milliliters of Plague Mother Serpent’s bile, three fragments of the Silver Hunter, a fresh branch of mistletoe, and 10 milliliters of blood from seven victims who died from different plagues.
unit.target: Post paucas repetitiones, contenta formulae potionis Sequenciae IV plane in eorum animis emergere coeperunt: “Nomen: Desperatio; Sequencia: IV; Ingredientes principales: vesica venenata Serpentis Matris Pestis; crystallum Argenti Venatoris; Ingredientes supplementarii: 10 millilitra bilis Serpentis Matris Pestis, tres fracta Argenti Venatoris, ramus recens visci, et 10 millilitra sanguinis ex septem victimis, qui variis pestibus mortui sunt.”

unit.source: “Ritual: Involve over thirty thousand people in a severe plague.
unit.target: “Ritus: Involvere plus quam triginta milia hominum in pesti gravis.

unit.source: The more who die, the stronger the despair and suffering, the better the ritual effect.”
unit.target: Quo magis moriantur, eo fortior desperatio et miseria, eo melior effectus rituus.

unit.source: In a brief silence, Franca hissed, “Isn’t this ritual too evil?
unit.target: In brevi silentio, Franca sibilavit: “Nonne hic rituus nimis malus est?”

unit.source: I can’t do such a thing!”
unit.target: “Non possum talem rem facere!”

unit.source: She felt that if she succumbed to the urge to advance, to become a demigod, and caused such a plague, she would truly fall and truly become a Demoness!
unit.target: Sensi se, si impulsu ad progressum cedisset ut semidea fieret, et talem pestem attulisset, vere corrueret atque vere Demonessa fieret!

unit.source: Jenna shook her head, her face full of fear.
unit.target: Jenna capite concussit, vultu metu pleno.

unit.source: She couldn’t imagine becoming that kind of person.
unit.target: Non se poterat fingere talem fieri.

unit.source: She would rather stay forever at the Demoness of Affliction Sequence!
unit.target: Malim in Sequencia Demonessae Afflictionis in aeternum manere!

unit.source: “It’s not just about being evil, it’s obviously more difficult than the Iron-blooded Knight’s ascension ritual,” Lumian said from another angle.
unit.target: “Non solum maleficium concernit, sed prorsus difficilius est quam rituus ascensionis Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei,” Lumian ex alia parte dixit.

unit.source: Using the capabilities of the Demoness of Affliction along with auxiliary media and items, turning a contagion into a plague that swept through thirty thousand people wasn’t too challenging.
unit.target: Usus facultatum Demonessae Afflictionis una cum mediis et rebus auxiliariis, contagionem in pestem vertens quae triginta milia hominum pervasit, non nimis arduum fuit.

unit.source: However, in any city with such a large population, official organizations existed, and they would likely notice the outbreak soon after it began.
unit.target: Attamen, in quacumque urbe cum tanta populatione, institutiones oficiales exsistant, et cito post initium pestis eam animadverterent.

unit.source: That would lead to targeted interventions and possibly even identification of the disease’s source—the Demoness of Affliction herself—leading to her elimination.
unit.target: Id ad interventiones destinatas et fortasse etiam ad fons morbi (Demonessae Afflictionis ipsius) cognoscendum ducet, quae ad eius exterminationem perveniat.

unit.source: If she avoided cities and spread the disease from one small town or village to another, it would take an exceedingly long time.
unit.target: Si urbēs vitaret et morbum ex uno parvo oppido in alium disseminaret, longum nimis tempus requereret.

unit.source: The longer the process dragged on, the greater the chance of various mishaps that could cause the ritual to fail.
unit.target: Quo diutius processus perdurabit, eo maior occasio variarum infortunior, quae rituum infaustum reddere possint.

unit.source: For example, discovery by the official Beyonders, natural containment of the disease, or other unforeseen events.
unit.target: Exempli causa, inventio ab Beyonders officialibus, continentia naturalis morbi, aut aliae casus inopinati.

unit.source: Compared to this, the Southern Continent might be more suitable for the Demoness of Affliction to advance.
unit.target: Comparata hoc, Continentia Meridionalis fortasse magis idonea esset ut Demonessa Afflictionis progrediatur.

unit.source: “Yes,” Franca said with a pained expression, “Is there no way to bypass this ritual?
unit.target: “Ita,” Franca vultu dolenti dixit, “Nonne via est hunc rituum praeterire?”

unit.source: Or is there an equivalent, less evil ritual?”
unit.target: Aut an equivalens rituus est, minus maleficus?

unit.source: Jenna racked her brain but couldn’t think of any shortcuts that didn’t involve killing innocents.
unit.target: Jenna mentem percontavit sed nullas vias breves invenire potuit, quae non implicarent interficere innocentes.

unit.source: Lumian, with a carefree smile, said, “It’s simple.
unit.target: Lumian, subridens leviter, dixit: “Simplex est.

unit.source: After you reach Sequence 5, you could switch to Iron-blooded Knight.
unit.target: Postquam Sequenciam V pertinges, poteris in Equitem Ferro-Sanguinei convertere.

unit.source: If you care—or rather, prefer to remain a Demoness—you can then check whether the ritual of the Demoness of Unaging is evil.
unit.target: Si cuperis—vel potius, manere Demonessa mavis—deinde perscrutari potes an rituus Demonessae Non Senescendi malus sit.

unit.source: If it isn’t, you could switch back.”
unit.target: Si non est, poteris revertere.

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca and Jenna were stunned.
unit.target: “Uh…” Franca et Jenna obstupefactae erant.

unit.source: 749 Conjugate Captain and Members
unit.target: 749 Capitāneus Coniunctus et Sociī

unit.source: 749 Conjugate Captain and Members
unit.target: 749 Capitāneus Coniunctus et Sociī

unit.source: After her initial shock, Franca pondered thoughtfully, Maybe this idea isn’t so bad after all…
unit.target: Post prīmum stupefactum, Franca dīligenter meditātā est: “Forsitan haec cogitātiō denique nōn tam mala sit…”

unit.source: Wasn’t I originally aiming to become an Iron-blooded Knight? But then there’s Jenna…
unit.target: Nonne initio intendēbam fīeri ēques sanguīne ferreō? Sed ecce, Jenna…

unit.source: Seeing Franca silent, Lumian said with a meaningful smile, “There’s no need to take some things too seriously.
unit.target: Franca silentem reperta, Lumian subrīdē subnuntiāns dīxit: “Nōn est nōbīs necesse quāedam nimis grave tractāre.

unit.source: We’ve all used Lie before and changed our appearances, adapting quite well, haven’t we?
unit.target: Omnēs iam “Lie” ūstāmus et īmāgines nostrās mutāvimus, satis bene accommodātī—nonne?

unit.source: I once even turned into a dog without any lingering trauma.
unit.target: Olim etiam in canem conversus sum, sine ūllo vestigiō trāumatis.

unit.source: As long as it’s not permanent and you can change back, occasionally switching things up can actually be quite fun.
unit.target: Dummōdō non sit perpeūtus et revertī possīs, interdum res mutārī vere delectābilis esse potest.

unit.source: Remember, you’re just acting.”
unit.target: Mementō: tantum fingi nōs.

unit.source: Lumian knew Jenna was already aware that the Demoness pathway led to changes from male to female, whereas the Hunter’s pathway did the opposite, occurring at Sequence 7 Witch and Sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight.
unit.target: Lumian scīvit Iennam iam nostrānosse viam Demonissae, quā mutātiōs a virō ad fēminam ducēbat, dum via Venatoris contrāriam effēctūs habēbat—in Sequentia VII Maga et Sequentia IV ēques sanguīne ferreō.

unit.source: He also knew Franca suspected Jenna was aware of this.
unit.target: Eum etiam scībat Francam suspicārī Iennam hoc nostrāre.

unit.source: But since the Demoness of Pleasure wanted to continue deceiving herself, he didn’t mind helping a bit by keeping his words vague.
unit.target: At quoniam Demonissa Voluptātis sē fallere perseverāre vellebat, ei nōn molestum erat paulum auxiliārī, verba vagā servāns.

unit.source: “Temporarily… If the ritual of the Demoness of Unaging isn’t evil, I can switch back… A Demoness of Unaging doesn’t sound so evil…”
unit.target: “Temporāriē… Sī rītus Demonissae Immortālīs nōn fuerit malus, revertī possum… Demonissa Immortālīs nōn ita malī vidētur…”

unit.source: Jenna muttered to herself before saying, “! think Lumian’s suggestion is worth considering.”
unit.target: Ienna sibi submurmurāvit antequam dīxit: “Putō cōnsilium Lumiani dīgnum esse cōnsiderandī.”

unit.source: Franca nodded in agreement, on the verge of saying more but stopping herself.
unit.target: Franca annūvit consentientiē, paene plūra dīcere velle sed sē continēbat.

unit.source: Jenna chuckled self-deprecatingly, “I’m only at Sequence 7, just a Witch.
unit.target: Ienna subrīdē dīxit: “Solum in Sequentia VII sum, mera maga.

unit.source: Why am I even considering becoming a demigod and switching back and forth?
unit.target: Cur quidem cogitō semideus fīeri atque vicissim mutārī?

unit.source: “Dammit, it feels like when I first became Showy Diva. Though I was always saving money to pay off debts, it didn’t stop me from dreaming of becoming a famous actress, earning thousands of verl d’or a year, and wondering how I’d spend all that money…”
unit.target: Di immortālēs, quasi tamquam cum prīmō facta essem Diva ostentātrix! Quamquam semper pecuniam servābam ad dēbitō solvendum, nōn impedīt mē somniare fīre actrīcem celeberrimam, annuātim mihi milia “verl d’or” lucrārī, et qua ratiōne totam illam pecuniam expendere?

unit.source: “Me too, me too,” Franca echoed, attempting to explore the feasibility, “If we switch, how do we complete the ritual for a thirty-person Iron-blooded Knight team?”
unit.target: “Et ego quoque, et ego quoque,” Franca replicāvit, conāns possibilitātem explorāre: “Sī mutābimur, quōmodo rītum pro turbā trigintā ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreō perficimus?”

unit.source: Lumian clicked his tongue and continued, “You’d better pray that by then I’ve become an Iron-blooded Knight. Having an Iron-blooded Knight as a team member can significantly reduce the number of people required. Besides, we already work well together.”
unit.target: Lumian linguam concussit et continuāvit: “Oportet orāre, ut eo tempore factus sim ēques sanguīne ferreō. Eques sanguīne ferreō habēns ut membrum turbae, numerum requisītōrum hominum multō attenuāre potest. Praeterea, iam optime simul operāmur.”

unit.source: “Is that possible?” Franca first instinctively felt there was a problem, then muttered to herself, “A ritual is just a ritual. After it’s done, there’s really no need to maintain the previous state, meaning the captain and team members could swap places and form anew team again. What do you call that? That’s called recycling, sustainable development!”
unit.target: “Num hoc possibile est?” Franca primō instinctī sensit quaestiōnem, deinde sibi submurmurāvit: “Rītus modo rītus est. Postquam peractus, nōn est vere necesse pristinum statum servāre, quī significat capitānum et sociōs locīs commūtāre atque turbam novam condere posse. Quid id appellās? Id vocātur re-cyclātiō, progressiō sustenibilis!”

unit.source: The more Franca thought about it, the more excited she became.
unit.target: Quō magis de hoc cōgitābat, eō magis excitāta facta est.

unit.source: “Once I also become an Iron-blooded Knight, Jenna will have two demigod teammates, plus Anthony and Lugano. She shouldn’t need to look for anyone else.
unit.target: “Cum et ego fiam ēques sanguīne ferreō, Ienna duo semideī sodālēs habēbit, praetereā Anthōnius et Lugānus; nōn necesse erit ei aliōs quaerere.

unit.source: “If Ludwig is still with us by then, not having broken his seal, things will be even simpler; we could be his godmothers!”
unit.target: “Sī Ludovīgus tunc adhūc nobiscum fuerit, nec sigillum suum fregit, res etiam simplicīōrēs erunt; possumus eius nutrices esse!”

unit.source: We’d be Ludwig’s godmothers, and Lumian would be his godfather…
unit.target: Nōs Ludovīgī nutrices erimus, et Lumian pater spiritualis eius fīēt…

unit.source: Although this isn’t anything amazing, there are many similar examples, but still.. Jenna glanced at Franca, wanting to remind her of something, but ultimately decided against it.
unit.target: Etsi hoc nōn est quidquam stupendum, multa similia exempla sunt; tamen Ienna Francam aspicuit, aliquid eam admonēre cupiēns, sed tandem id nōn fecit.

unit.source: The more they discussed the details, the more awkward it got, so it was best to leave them be.
unit.target: Quō magis de minutīs disseruērunt, eō magis ineptum factum est, itaque melius erat ea relinquere.

unit.source: With a new strategy to avoid the Demoness of Despair’s ritual, Franca and Jenna felt much better.
unit.target: Nova consilia habentēs ad vitandum rītum Demonissae Desperatiōnis, Franca et Ienna melius se sentsērunt.

unit.source: The former said to Lumian, “There’s a mysticism gathering in a few days.
unit.target: Prīmā Lumian dīxit: “Conventus mysticus intra paucōs diēs fiet.

unit.source: Touch base with the Professor and others to probe whether any members of the Moses Ascetic Order are among them.
unit.target: Contingās cum Professore et aliīs ut investigent, an quid membrī Ordinis Ascēticōrum Mōysis inter eōs sint.

unit.source: It’s not too urgent since Madam Judgement told me that the Tarot Club has informants inside the Moses Ascetic Order who can provide the necessary information.
unit.target: Nōn est nimis urgentis, quoniam Domina Judiciō mihi dīxit Clubum Tarōticum habēre informātōrēs intra Ordinem Ascēticōrum Mōysis, quī necesāriās notitiās praebere possunt.

unit.source: But I’m not sure if that informant belongs to the Trier region and knows the local circumstances, while the Mirror Person, Griffith, is definitely in Trier.”
unit.target: Sed nescio num ille informātōr regiōnī Trēvirensi pertineat et casūs lōcālēs sciat, dum Persona Speculī, Griffith, certē in Trēverī sit.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and replied, “I also need to ask about the Harvest Priest potion formula and corresponding materials.
unit.target: Lumian annūvit et respondentēs dīxit: “Ego etiam quaerere debeō de formula poculī Sacerdōtīs Mēssis et materiīs correspondēntibus.

unit.source: Boosting the team’s strength will help us complete the ritual later.
unit.target: Robōrem turmæ augēre nōs adiuvābit ut rītum postea perficāmus.

unit.source: Jenna listened quietly for a while before interjecting, “Can you help sell that Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic for me?
unit.target: Ienna quietē aliquandō auscultāvit antequam interponeret: “Potesne mihi auxilium ferre ut illam proprietātem ‘Dream Stealer Beyonder’ vendam?

unit.source: The level of the mysticism gatherings I attend aren’t high enough; nobody can afford an item of that Sequence.”
unit.target: Gradus conventuum mysticōrum quibus adsum nōn satis altus est; nemo rem illius sequentiae comparāre potest.

unit.source: She was thinking about the Demoness of Pleasure potion materials she was about to receive from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
unit.target: Rēā cogitābat de materiīs poculī Demonissae Voluptātis, quās ex Ecclesiā Solis Aeternī Flammarum recipere videbātur.

unit.source: Franca’s Pleasure was almost digested, and it wasn’t too good to still owe her companion money.
unit.target: Potio Voluptātis Francae paene completa erat, sed nōn fuit optima rēs quoniam adhūc sociae pecuniam debēbat.

unit.source: After all, she couldn’t use the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic herself.
unit.target: Post omnia, ipsa proprietātem “Dream Stealer Beyonder” uti nōn poterat.

unit.source: Lumian could probably guess Jenna’s thoughts, subtly gesturing towards his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian probabiliter intuere potuit Iennās cogitātiōnēs, subtiliter ad sacculum viātōrium suum gesticulāns.

unit.source: His implication was clear: you’ve seen my Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair potion formulas; how come you haven’t thought about owing me a substantial debt?
unit.target: Intellectus eius manifesto erat: vidistīs formulās poculī meī ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et Demonissae Desperatiōnis; quare nōnne cōnsēnsistis tē mihi ingentem dēbitum debere?

unit.source: Lumian hoped this approach would make Jenna worry less about owing money, suggesting she borrow more and hire an Artisan to turn the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic into a mystical item for use.
unit.target: Lumian sperābat hanc ratiōnem Iennam de pecuniā debendā mīni āctūram, suādens ut amplius fecerit et artificem contratarit, ut proprietātem “Dream Stealer Beyonder” in rem mysticam ad usum converteret.

unit.source: The stronger you are, the easier it is to repay debts!
unit.target: Quō fortiōr es, tanto facilius dēbīta solvere licet!

unit.source: Sitting on the sofa, Jenna scoffed at Franca, gesturing towards Lumian.
unit.target: Sedit in sōfā, Ienna Francam irrīdēns et ad Lumian indicāvit.

unit.source: Her message was clear: when I need to use those two potion formulas to advance, I’ll pay you back!
unit.target: Nuntiō eius manifesto erat: cum illās duās formulās poculī ad progressum adhibere oportēverit, tibi solvam!

unit.source: “I’ll keep an eye out,” Franca said, unaware of the silent conversation between Lumian and Jenna.
unit.target: “Ego cautus ero,” Franca dīxit, nesciēns tacitām conversātiōnem inter Lumian et Ienna.

unit.source: She then said, “We can start gathering some supplementary ingredients for Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair now, like the mud soaked with soldiers’ blood from a major battlefield and the blood of seven victims of the plague, just to be prepared in case we’re short on time later. Who knows, by then, we might find another way to bypass the plague ritual. Let’s get ready now.”
unit.target: Deinde dīxit: “Nunc possumus colligere supplementāria ingrediēnta pro ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et Demonissae Desperatiōnis, ut, exempli grātiā, lutum, quod sānge mīlitum ex magnā campō belli saturātum est, atque sānge septem victimārum pestilentiae, ad praeparandum, sī postea tempus deficiat. Quis scit? Forsitan tunc aliam viam inveniēmus ad rītum pestilentiae evādendum. Pariāmus nunc!”

unit.source: Hearing about the preparations for the potion, Lumian nodded and then remembered something.
unit.target: Audītō de praeparātiōnibus poculī, Lumian annūvit atque aliquid meminītus est.

unit.source: He stood up and walked over to the full-length mirror in the room, pressing his right hand against it.
unit.target: Surgēns accessit ad speculum totā longitūdine in camerā, dextram manū illī premēns.

unit.source: He then activated the contract ability from Bloody Jack, sensing the mirror imprints he had left behind.
unit.target: Tum activāvit virtūtem contractūs ex “Bloody Jack”, sentīns imprōntās speculī quās reliquerat.

unit.source: Soon, Lumian used the mirror and its otherworldly connection to detect two imprints from afar—one clear and one blurry.
unit.target: Mox, Lumian speculō et eius nōxum ultra-mundānum nexum adhibuit ut duās imprōntās ab longīnquo detegeret—unam perspicuā et unam obscūrā.

unit.source: The clear one belonged to the full-length mirror in Moran Avigny’s study, while the blurry one changed on its own, shifting positions and making it hard to track.
unit.target: Illa perspicuā pertinēbat ad speculum totum in studio Moran Avigny, dum autem imprōnta obscūra sponte loca mutābat, quā rēs insequi difficilis fēcītur.

unit.source: I can sense it… That must be the imprint on the mirror inside the Blue Avenger’s vault…
unit.target: Id sentīre possum… Illud certe est imprōnta in speculō intra arcā “Blue Avenger.”

unit.source: Using the link between the imprint and myself, no matter how it blurs or shifts, I can teleport directly to it, as long as I can step through the mirror, Lumian pondered for a while but decided not to borrow Franca’s Mirror Cufflink for an experiment.
unit.target: Uti nexū inter imprōntam et mē, quacumque modō illa obscūrētur aut mutētur, directe ad eam transīre possum, dummō cum per speculum ingredī possim; Lumian aliquantulum meditātus est, sed decrevit nōn Francae fibulam speculī ad experimentum mutandam sumere.

unit.source: This was because his spiritual intuition and a warning from fate told him that if he teleported to that imprint now, he might never return, or he might return as Alista Tudor.
unit.target: Hoc erat, quoniam sensus spiritualis eius atque admonitiō vātī fatālēs illi dixerunt, sī nunc ad eam imprōntam translocārētur, fortasse numquam redīret, aut ut Alista Tudor redeātur.

unit.source: Withdrawing his hand, Lumian shared the results of his attempt with Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Manum revocāns, Lumian eventūs conātī sui cum Franca et Ienna communicāvit.

unit.source: Afterward, Jenna left to visit various hospital morgues.
unit.target: Postea, Ienna discessit ut varia mortuāria hospitāliā visitare dēscīret.

unit.source: This was both to look for opportunities to act as a Witch and to see if there were any bodies that had died from severe contagious diseases.
unit.target: Hoc factum est ut tum occasiones inquīreret ad agendum ut maga, tum ut vidēret an aliqua corpora ex morbis contagiosis gravissimīs mortuāca fuisset.

unit.source: With the Order of All Extinction and the Sick Church not yet eradicated in Trier, there definitely were deaths from the plague, just not many that could cause a widespread outbreak.
unit.target: Cum Ordo Omnium Exstinctionis et Ecclesia Infirmōrum in Trēverīs nōn dēlepta essent, certe mortēs ex pestilentia occurrērunt, sed nōn tantā quātīs ut vasta epidemia efferri possent.

unit.source: Standing by the window, Lumian saw Jenna appear on the street and turned to Franca, saying, “You might have to become a Demoness of Despair, so it would be good to think about how to find an alternative to that ritual.”
unit.target: Stāns ad fēnestram, Lumian Iennam in vīa apparere vidit et ad Francam conversus dīxit: “Forsit necesse erit ut fias Demonissa Desperatiōnis; itaque bene esset cōngitāre quōmodo alteram viam ad istum rītum reperīre possīs.”

unit.source: “Why must I?” Franca responded, clearly astonished.
unit.target: “Cur mihi hoc faciendum sit?” Franca respondit, manifeste obstupefacta.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “Have you noticed that all the high-ranking members of the Demoness Sect are Demonesses?
unit.target: Lumian subrīdē dīxit: “Animadvertīstī omnes summōs gradūs membrōrum Sēctae Demonissārum esse Demonissās?

unit.source: Do you think it’s because they can’t get their hands on the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula and Beyonder characteristics?”
unit.target: Putāsne id esse, quoniam manibus illīs formulam poculī ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et proprietātēs “Beyonder” adipisci nōn licet?

unit.source: “But the Demoness Sect doesn’t prohibit Demonesses from switching to the Hunter pathway…”
unit.target: “Sed Sēctio Demonissārum Demonissās nōn prohibet ut ad viam Venatoris mutentur…”

unit.source: “That’s indeed a contradiction,” Lumian speculated.
unit.target: “Id certe est contrārietās,” Lumian coniectāvit.

unit.source: “I suspect that those angelic-tier Demonesses can’t find higher Sequence Hunter pathway Beyonder characteristics to change back into men, so they’re not keen on seeing their subordinates regain themselves.
unit.target: “Suspiciō has Demonissās, quae in ordinum angelicō collocantur, proprietātēs “Beyonder” viae Venatoris superiōrēs ad rēs in vīrōs retransmutandō reperīre nōn posse, ideo nōn appetītās videntēs subditōs suōs iterum se recipere.”

unit.source: It has become an unspoken rule. You know, most of the high-ranking Demonesses are twisted in spirit, psychopathic, and enjoy seeing others in pain while hating to see them happy.”
unit.target: Iam factum est regula tacīta. Scīs, plērīque ex summīs Demonissārum gradibus animīs corruptīs, psychopāticīs sunt et delectantur videndī alios in dolōre, simulque nolunt vidēre eos laetōs.

unit.source: According to the intelligence Lumian and Franca received from Madam Magician and Madam Judgement, starting from Sequence 4, Hunters and Demonesses could switch pathways, with gender determined by the highest Sequence attained, and consuming potions of the same Sequence but from neighboring pathways to enhance one’s strength could cause significant problems.
unit.target: Secundum notitiās quas Lumian et Franca a Domina Magica et Domina Judiciō recepērunt, ab Sequentia IV Venatōrēs et Demonissae viās mutāre poterant, cum genus determināretur ex summā Sequentiā attingentī, et potiōnēs eiusdem Sequentiae ex viis vicīnīs ad robōrem augendum sumendī gravia problemāta afferre possent.

unit.source: Franca was silent for a long moment before saying, “If I digest the Affliction potion and still haven’t found an alternative to the Despair ritual, I’ll request to end my mission with the Demoness Sect from Madam Judgement. She should understand and wouldn’t allow me to carry out something like spreading a horrific plague.”
unit.target: Franca diu siluit, antequam dīxit: “Sī poculum Afflictionis consumam et adhūc alternāviam viam ad rītum Desperatiōnis invenīre nōn possim, petam ut mīsae meae cum Sēctā Demonissārum ab Domina Judiciō finem imponam. Ea intellegere dēbet et nōn sinet mihi aliquid simile pestilentiam horribilem dissemināre.”

unit.source: After saying this, Franca relaxed and muttered, “Besides, wouldn’t it be odd if Jenna becomes an Iron-blooded Knight and I remain a Demoness by then?”
unit.target: Post hōc dictō, Franca se relaxāvit et submurmurāvit: “Praetereā, nonne mirum esset, sī Jenna fīeret ēques sanguīne ferreōrum et ego tunc manerem Demonissa?”

unit.source: “Life is short, why not give it a try?” Lumian jested.
unit.target: “Vīta brevis est, cur nōn conārī?” Lumian iocātus est.

unit.source: Before Franca could react, Lumian leaped over the sofa with a stride and headed out the door.
