unit.target: Priusquam Franca potuīsset reagere, Lumian sōfā super saltāvit et per iānua exiēvit.

unit.source: Bursts of black flames shot through the wooden door, chasing after Lumian’s back but gradually veering off target and dissipating into the air.
unit.target: Flammae nigrāntēs per iānua līneā eruptae sunt, sequentes Lumianī tergum, sed paulatim a scōpō devīantes et in aere dissipantes.

unit.source: Franca’s curse still rang clear in Lumian’s ears, “If you have what it takes, try it yourself!”
unit.target: Maledictiō Francae adhūc clarē in auribus Lumianī resonābat: “Sī has facultātēs possīdās, conāre ipse!”

unit.source: With a grin, Lumian stepped out into the street.
unit.target: Subrīdē, Lumian in vīam exiēvit.

unit.source: Watching Ludwig eat, he pulled up a chair opposite him and casually asked, “What ingredients or spices are needed for the third method of cooking those umbilical remains?”
unit.target: Vidēns Ludovicum mandūcāre, sedem contrā eum arripuit et leviter quaesīvit: “Quae ingrediēnta aut species condimentōrum necessāriā sunt ad tertiam viam coquendī illās reliquiās umbilicālēs?”

unit.source: By the side, Lugano was taken aback. “What umbilical remains?”
unit.target: Ad lātus, Lugano stupēfactus exclamāvit: “Quae reliquiās umbilicālēs?”

unit.source: Lumian smiled. “The umbilical remnant of the Child of God that Father Montserrat was carrying.”
unit.target: Lumian subrīdē respondit: “Reliquiae umbilicāles Puerī Dei, quarum Pater Montserrat portābat.”

unit.source: Lugano’s expression froze.
unit.target: Vultus Lugānī congelātus est.

unit.source: 750 Source of Life
unit.target: 750 Fons Vitae

unit.source: 750 Source of Life
unit.target: 750 Fons Vitae

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lugano stuttered, “Can you actually eat that?”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, Lugano balbutivit: “Num hoc vere edere potes?”

unit.source: What happens if you do eat it? What are the changes?
unit.target: Quid evenit, si id edis? Quae mutationes fiunt?

unit.source: Does it cause the Child of God to be born?
unit.target: Num hoc facit ut Filium Dei nascatur?

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Lugano’s arm and said, “What can’t be eaten?”
unit.target: Lumian brachium Luganonis aspexit et dixit: “Quid ederi non potest?”

unit.source: Lugano suddenly felt a sharp phantom pain and shook his head vigorously.
unit.target: Lugano subito acutum dolorem phantasmaticum sensit et caput vehementer concussit.

unit.source: “No, never mind!”
unit.target: “Non, nihil refert!”

unit.source: He wanted to get away from Ludwig and Lumian but couldn’t think of an excuse on the spot.
unit.target: Volebat Ludwig et Lumian recedere, sed causam statim excogitare non potuit.

unit.source: After Ludwig swallowed a mouthful of cheese bread, he spoke slowly, “Top-tier ingredients don’t need much accompaniment or seasoning.
unit.target: Postquam Ludwig morsum panis casei deglutivit, lente dixit: “Ingredientia optima non indigent magno comitatu aut condimento.

unit.source: We just need to give it a symbol.
unit.target: Nobis solum illi signum dare necesse est.

unit.source: That includes nine main staple ingredients: wheat, oats, rye, rice, potatoes, sweet potatoes, corn, cassava, and any other kind of bean.
unit.target: Hoc comprehendit novem materias praecipuas: triticum, avena, secale, oryza, poma terrae, batatas dulces, maizem, cassavam, atque omne aliud genus fabarum.

unit.source: Cook them with the umbilical remains in cow’s or sheep’s milk for half an hour, and it’s ready to eat.
unit.target: Coque eas cum reliquiis umbilicalibus in lacte vaccino aut ovino per dimidium horae, et parata est ad edendum.

unit.source: This dish is called ‘Source of Life.”
unit.target: Hoc ferculum vocatur “Fons Vitae.”

unit.source: “Are you cooking or performing a mystical rite?” Lumian muttered under his breath.
unit.target: “Num coquis aut ritu mystico fungaris?” Lumian submurmuravit.

unit.source: Of course, a Gourmet pathway’s Chef, who concocted alcoholic beverages and cooked various dishes, was essentially conducting corresponding mystical rites.
unit.target: Certe, coquus viae Gourmet, qui potiones alcoholicas conficiebat et varia fercula coquebat, re vera ritus mysticos pertinentes agebat.

unit.source: Thoughtfully, Lumian asked, “Actually, it doesn’t have to be these nine ingredients, right?
unit.target: Cogitans, Lumian quaesivit: “Revera, non oportet ut haec novem sint, nonne?

unit.source: As long as the concept of main ingredients and their quantity is satisfied? Likewise, other kinds of milk would work too?”
unit.target: Dummodo notio ingredientium principalium et eorum quantitas satisfaciatur? Similiter, alias lactis species quoque valent?

unit.source: Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: Ludwig caput nutavit.

unit.source: “No, this way tastes the best.”
unit.target: “Non, hoc modo optimum sapit.”

unit.source: So, what you’re saying is, the method I mentioned would work but won’t taste as good?
unit.target: Ita, quid dicis igitur? Methodus quam dixi operabitur, sed non tam sapida erit?

unit.source: No wonder it’s the Gourmet pathway, always chasing culinary perfection…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod haec sit via Gourmet, semper perfectionem culinariam persequens…

unit.source: Lumian stood up and instructed Lugano to buy some of the ingredients.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit et Luganone iubet ut aliqua ingredientia emerent.

unit.source: Lumian’s Traveler’s Bag only contained dry rations that could be eaten right out of the package.
unit.target: Saccus viatorius Lumiani tantum rationes siccas habebat, quae ex sarcina edi poterant.

unit.source: For Trier, a leading global metropolis, the ingredients Ludwig needed were easily collected, and by noon, Lumian and Lugano had returned to see Ludwig placing the main ingredients along with the umbilical remnant into a stew pot filled with several hundred milliliters of milk.
unit.target: Pro Trier, urbe insigne orbis terrarum, ingredientia quae Ludwig desiderabat facile collecta erant, et meridie redierunt Lumian et Lugano ut viderent Ludovicum materias principales atque reliquiem umbilicalem in ollam decoctionis, repletam pluribus centum mililitris lactis, inferre.

unit.source: These steps had to be completed by a Chef himself, to endow them with mysticism, to coax out the designated uniqueness of the ingredients and maintain them to a degree conducive to absorption.
unit.target: Hi gradus a coquo ipso perficiendi erant, ut eis mysticum infunderetur, ut unicitatem designatam ingredientium evelleret atque servaret ad modum assimilationis aptum.

unit.source: Done by anyone else, the dish might have no effect or turn into poison.
unit.target: Si ab alio quis factum esset, ferculum aut sine effectu esset aut in venenum converteretur.

unit.source: After simmering for a while, Lumian smelled the starchy aroma mixed with the milk and saw dense milky white steam rising above the pot.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempore coctum, Lumian odor amidonaceus mixta cum lacte sensit et vidit vaporem densum, album lacteum, super ollam emergentem.

unit.source: The steam did not disperse but condensed in midair and slowly settled back into the pot, carrying a tantalizing scent tinged with blood.
unit.target: Vapor non dispersus est, sed in aere condensatus lenteque in ollam rediit, ferens odorem leporem sanguine tinctum.

unit.source: At that moment, Ludwig turned to Lumian and licked his lips, asking, “Do you want to add sugar or salt?”
unit.target: Illo momento, Ludwig ad Lumian conversus, labia lambens, rogavit: “Visne addere saccharum an sal?”

unit.source: “What differences do they bring?” Lumian asked cautiously.
unit.target: “Quae differentiae afferunt?” quaesivit cautim Lumian.

unit.source: Ludwig responded seriously, “The taste, one is sweet, the other is salty.
unit.target: Ludwig respondit serio: “Gustus: unus dulcis, alter salsus.

unit.source: Which do you prefer?”
unit.target: Quod mavis?

unit.source: Lumian, sensing the choice, relaxed and asked with a smile, “Which do you prefer?”
unit.target: Lumian, electionem sentiens, laxatus et sub risu rogavit: “Quod mavis?”

unit.source: “I can’t eat it…” Ludwig said regretfully, mumbling, “Sweet is tasty, salty is good too.
unit.target: “Id edere non possum…” Ludwig paeniter submurmurans dixit: “Dulce sapit, salsum quoque optime.”

unit.source: If only it could be split into two parts, one sweet, one salty…”
unit.target: Utinam in duas partes dividi posset, unam dulcem, alteram salsam…

unit.source: As he spoke, the young boy, seemingly agitated, sprinkled some salt and then tossed in some sugar.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, puer iunior, viso excitatus, paululum salis sparsit et deinde saccharum adiecit.

unit.source: Lumian watched amusedly, not stopping him.
unit.target: Lumian ridens observavit eum, neque eum prohibens.

unit.source: For him, the taste of the Source of Life was not important; its effect was.
unit.target: Ei autem non gustus Fons Vitae gravis erat, sed effectus eius.

unit.source: Finally, Ludwig instructed Lugano to extinguish the flame and removed the contents of the pot.
unit.target: Denique Ludwig Luganone imperavit ut flammam exstingueret et contentum ollae removeret.

unit.source: It was a palm‑sized piece of starchy congealment, white and soft, sticky and gooey.
unit.target: Erat pars coacta amidonacea, mensura palmae, alba et mollis, viscosa et glutinosa.

unit.source: The surface of the food was covered with red spots, as if blood had seeped out from within.
unit.target: Superficies ferculi maculis rubris tectus erat, quasi sanguis ex intus effusus esset.

unit.source: “It’s ready to eat.” Ludwig tried hard not to drool.
unit.target: “Paratum est ad edendum.” Ludwig strenue conatus est ne saliva effunderetur.

unit.source: “Will it be effective with just one bite, or do I need to eat it all?” Lumian asked, his curiosity reminiscent of his days learning various experiments, which often frustrated Aurore with his questions.
unit.target: “Unico morsu efficax erit, an totum edendum sit?” quaesivit Lumian, cuius curiositas diem experimentorum discendorum meminisse faciebat, quae saepe Aurorem per quaestiones vexabant.

unit.source: “All of it,” Ludwig said with a look of disappointment.
unit.target: “Totum,” inquit Ludwig vultu languido.

unit.source: Lumian picked up the steaming, slightly scalding food, brought it to his mouth, and took a bite.
unit.target: Lumian victum vaporosum, paulo scaldidum, levavit, ad os tulit, et morsum cepit.

unit.source: The sweet and salty flavors melded together, offsetting each other’s intensity in a unique way that relieved Lumian of any mental burden.
unit.target: Sapores dulces et salsi se miscuerunt, alterorum intensitatem in modo unico mitigantes, quo Lumian onus animi levatus est.

unit.source: He quickly devoured the Source of Life.
unit.target: Celeriter Fons Vitae devoravit.

unit.source: “Will it work right away?” an eager Lumian asked, already resolute in his intentions.
unit.target: “Statim fungiet?” quaesivit Lumian alacer, iam consiliis certus.

unit.source: Ludwig pointed to the master bedroom.
unit.target: Ludwig ad cellam principalem designavit.

unit.source: “You’ll need to sleep first.”
unit.target: “Primum dormire debebis.”

unit.source: Sleep? With a slight sigh, Lumian left the dining table, returned to his room, and lay down on his bed.
unit.target: “Dormire?” Paululum suspirans, Lumian mensam edendi reliquit, ad cubiculum rediit, et in lecto se iacuit.

unit.source: Closing his eyes, he felt his body gradually warm up, his consciousness becoming heavier and heavier…
unit.target: Oculos clausos habens, sensit corpus suum paulatim calefieri, atque conscientia magis magisque grave fieri…

unit.source: In the darkness, Lumian heard soft sobs.
unit.target: In tenebris, Lumian levia fletus audivit.

unit.source: He turned his head, carefully discerning the sound.
unit.target: Caput vertit, sonum caute discernens.

unit.source: It was of a little girl whispering, “Mommy… Mommy…”
unit.target: Fuit puellae parvulae, susurrans: “Māter… Māter…”

unit.source: The voice grew louder, more mature, and more piercing.
unit.target: Vox augebatur, magis madura, et acutius reddita.

unit.source: “Mommy! Mommy!”
unit.target: “Māter! Māter!”

unit.source: The cries drew closer, as if they were right beside Lumian, resonating within him.
unit.target: Clamores propius accedebant, quasi iuxta Lumian essent, resonantes intra eum.

unit.source: “Mommy! Mommy!”
unit.target: “Māter! Māter!”

unit.source: Inside my body… Lumian suddenly jolted awake, regaining his senses.
unit.target: Intra corpus meum… Lumian subito excitatus evigilavit, sensus suos recipiens.

unit.source: The darkness shattered, and sunlight pierced his eyes.
unit.target: Tenebrae dissipatae sunt, et lumen solis oculos eius percussit.

unit.source: He sat up abruptly, freeing himself from the dream.
unit.target: Repente surrexit, somnio se liberans.

unit.source: The cries of “mommy, mommy” still echoed faintly in his mind.
unit.target: Clamores “māter, māter” adhuc vage in mente eius resonabant.

unit.source: Did I hear the Child of God crying? Lumian looked down at himself.
unit.target: Audivine Filium Dei fletum? Lumian se introspexit.

unit.source: He undressed and found nothing unusual, but he knew something about him was different now, an indescribable change.
unit.target: Se exuit et nihil insolitum invenit, sed intellexit aliquid in se nunc differre – mutationem ineffabilem.

unit.source: He didn’t feel the Great Mother’s gaze, which made him even more cautious.
unit.target: Non sensit conspectum Magnae Matris, quod eum magis cautum reddidit.

unit.source: Dressed again, he left his room to find Lugano sneaking glances his way.
unit.target: Iterum vestitus, ex cubiculo processit ut Luganum, clam aspiciens, inveniret.

unit.source: “Are—are you alright?” Lugano, who had been caught red-handed, asked instinctively.
unit.target: “Esne bene?” quaesivit Lugano, qui in flagrante deprehensus erat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian risit.

unit.source: “It’s okay, I won’t become the Child of God of the Great Mother.”
unit.target: “Omnia bene, non fiam Filium Dei Magnae Matris.”

unit.source: Seeing Lugano eyeing his stomach, Lumian added, “Nor have I conceived Her.”
unit.target: Videntes Lugano ventrem suum intuentem, Lumian addidit: “Nec Eam concepi.”

unit.source: After speaking, he left the still‑concerned Lugano behind and walked out of the apartment.
unit.target: Postquam locutus est, reliquit Lugano adhuc sollicium et ex conclavi processit.

unit.source: The afternoon sun was perfect, and with nothing much to do in the next couple of days, Lumian decided to stake out a particular spot.
unit.target: Sol meridianus perfecte fulgebat, et cum paucis in proximis diebus agendi essent, Lumian constituit statuere certum locum.

unit.source: That place was the Trier catacombs.
unit.target: Ille locus erat catacumbae Treverenses.

unit.source: Knowing that Harrison from Resurrection Island might appear at places associated with death, darkness, dusk, and decay, Lumian’s first thoughts were of the Dream Festival and the Trier catacombs—locations rife with death and dark mysticism.
unit.target: Sciens Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis posse apparere in locis morti, tenebris, crepusculo, et corruptione pertinentibus, primum Lumiani mente venit de Festo Somniorum et catacumbis Treverensibus – loca abundantia in morte et mysteriis obscuris.

unit.source: In the first level of the catacombs, by the “Entrance to the Old Ossuary” leading deeper below, Lumian sat next to a withered, scattered skeleton with a lit white candle, quietly observing each visitor descending into or returning from the depths.
unit.target: In primo gradibus catacumbarum, prope “Ingressum ad Vetus Ossuarium” quod profundiora ducit, Lumian sedebat iuxta scheletrum marcescens et dispersum, cum candela alba accensa, quiete observans singulos visitatores, qui in profundum descendebant aut redibant.

unit.source: Soon, a group of students passed by, spotting Lumian sitting alongside the catacombs bones.
unit.target: Mox coetus studentium transivit, et Lumian sedens iuxta ossa catacumbarum animadvertus est.

unit.source: The leader, a tall, thin man with glasses, asked Lumian curiously, “Why are you sitting here?”
unit.target: Dux, vir altus et tenuus cum oculis speculatoribus, quaesivit a Lumiano: “Cur hic sedes?”

unit.source: Lumian casually responded, “I’ve been down to the lower levels many times and lost interest.
unit.target: Lumian leviter respondit: “Iam pluries in gradus inferiores descendi et studium amisi.

unit.source: Now, I just want to sit here quietly and watch everyone and everybody that comes and goes, to see who never leaves.”
unit.target: Iam sola huc quies sedere volo et omnes, qui veniunt ac abeunt, observare, ut videam quem numquam relinquant.

unit.source: “That sounds interesting,” the students said, holding their white candles.
unit.target: “Hoc interest,” dixerunt studenti, candela alba tenentes.

unit.source: They decided to sit down too and observe if any of those returning from the depths showed signs of fear.
unit.target: Constituerunt quoque sedere et observare an quis e iis, qui e profundis redibant, signa timoris ostenderet.

unit.source: The tall, bespectacled man chose to sit beside Lumian and struck up a conversation.
unit.target: Vir altus, oculis speculatoribus, secum Luminum congregatus, sermonem inchoavit.

unit.source: “Do you really think not lighting a white candle here could lead to mishaps?”
unit.target: “Vere putasne, si hanc candelae albam lucem non accenderis, infausta evenire possint?”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at him and chuckled, “You could try it, and we’d all see what happens.”
unit.target: Lumian eum aspexit et subridens dixit: “Potes id experiri, et omnes quid eveniat videbimus.”

unit.source: Before the students could respond, Lumian spoke in a relaxed tone, “I didn’t believe in these things before, but then…”
unit.target: Priusquam studenti responderent, Lumian leniter locutus est: “Priore his rebus non credebam, sed tum…”

unit.source: He suddenly lowered his voice.
unit.target: Subito vocem demisit.

unit.source: Two of the female students blurted out, “What happened?”
unit.target: Duae discipulae feminae repente exclamaverunt: “Quid accidit?”

unit.source: “Then…” Lumian wore a reminiscent expression, “I met someone who had encountered the Montsouris ghost. You know the legend of the Montsouris ghost, right?”
unit.target: “Tum…” inquit Lumian, vultu rememorante, “Convenī aliquem qui spiritum Montsouris passa esset. Fabulam de spiritu Montsouris nostis, nonne?”

unit.source: The students nodded together.
unit.target: Discipuli simul nutuerunt.

unit.source: You really know Trier’s spooky tales well… Typical of Underground Trier creatures—students…
unit.target: Revera bene nosti fabulas terribiles Trieris… Typicae sunt creaturae subterraneae Trier – scilicet studenti…

unit.source: Lumian sighed, “His immediate family all died, and he thought he could escape it.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit: “Universa familia eius proxima perivit, et putavit se id evitare posse.

unit.source: But one day, when I went to see him, I found him hanged from a window frame.
unit.target: Sed quadam die, cum ad eum accessi, eum reperi suspenditum a structura fenestrarum.

unit.source: “Since then, I’ve been strictly following every rule of Underground Trier.”
unit.target: “Ex illo tempore, omnes regulas subterraneae Trier stricte sequor.”

unit.source: The students looked at each other, a bit frightened by the tale told by a peer.
unit.target: Studentes inter se spectaverunt, paulo territi fabulae a pari narratae.

unit.source: “It seems we really shouldn’t extinguish this candle,” the tall student with glasses said regretfully.
unit.target: “Videtur, quidem, hanc candelam non oportere exstinguere,” inquit tristiter altus student cum oculis speculatoribus.

unit.source: Lumian lowered his voice again, “Have you ever encountered such a thing?
unit.target: Lumian iterum vocem demisit: “Numquamne talem rem experitus es?

unit.source: There are extra books, blankets, and clothes in your dorm—none which belong to you—but the administrator tells you that no one else lives there.”
unit.target: Extra libros, stragula, et vestimenta in dormitorio tuo sunt—nulla tibi pertinent—sed administrator tibi affirmat neminem aliud ibi habitare.

unit.source: Two students turned pale, as if hearing the most terrifying ghost story.
unit.target: Duo discipuli pallidi facti sunt, quasi audientes fabulam phantasmatis terribilissimam.

unit.source: As if they were seeking a lifeline, they asked, “Yes, that happens, do you know why?”
unit.target: Veluti auxilium quaerentes, rogaverunt: “Ita fit, scisne cur?”

unit.source: Lumian shook his head and sighed, “I heard those are the people who extinguished their candles here.
unit.target: Lumian caput negavit et suspiravit: “Audivi eos esse qui candelae suas hic exstingerunt.

unit.source: They completely vanished, with no one remembering them.”
unit.target: Penitus evanuerunt, nec quisquam eos meminisse potuit.

unit.source: Hearing this, the tall student shivered instinctively.
unit.target: Hoc auditu, altus student instinctim tremuit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he felt something tap his shoulder.
unit.target: Subito sensit aliquid in umero eius contingere.

unit.source: He turned to look and saw a ghastly pale skeletal hand.
unit.target: Conversus est ut aspiceret et vidit manum scheletricam pallidam et terribilem.

unit.source: “Ah!” He screamed, jumping up.
unit.target: “Heu!” exclamavit, saltans.

unit.source: Lumian pulled back the bone hand he had picked up somewhere, his smile mocking.
unit.target: Lumian retractavit manum ossatam quam alibi acceperat, risu irridente.

unit.source: “You’re really scaredy‐cats! Scared already?”
unit.target: “Vere, estis pusillanimi! Iam timetis?”

unit.source: The students were stunned, and after a while, they forcefully said, “No! That was just a reflex!”
unit.target: Discipuli stupuerunt, et post breve intervallum voce firmiter dixerunt: “Non! Id solum reflexus erat!”

unit.source: As they seriously considered whether to beat up the prankster, someone came up the stone steps to the second level.
unit.target: Dum serio cogitabant utrum lusorem percutere deberent, aliquis scala lapidea ad gradum secundum ascendit.

unit.source: He wore a blue top and yellow pants, his face deeply wrinkled and his white hair sparse and dry, holding a short lit white candle.
unit.target: Indutus erat tunica caerulea et bracas flavas, facie profunde rugosa, capillis albis raris et siccis, tenens parvam candelae albam accensam.

unit.source: It was an elderly catacombs administrator.
unit.target: Erat senex curator catacumbarum.

unit.source: Lumian slightly frowned.
unit.target: Lumian leviter frontem contraxit.

unit.source: He had seen this catacombs administrator before in the giant tomb chamber housing the Samaritan Women’s Spring, but the administrator hadn’t used a white candle then.
unit.target: Hunc curator catacumbarum antea viderat in magna camera sepulcrali, quae Fons Samaritarum Feminarum continebat, sed tunc candela alba non adhibebatur.

unit.source: 751 “Help”
unit.target: 751 “Auxilium”

unit.source: 751 “Help”
unit.target: 751 “Auxilium”

unit.source: Lumian had always assumed that the catacombs administrator, marked with light brown age spots, had been assimilated by the catacombs themselves, becoming part of this peculiar place, and would over time become more corpse-like, losing all semblance of life and forever sleeping within an upright, decaying coffin.
unit.target: Lumian semper credebat administrator catacumbarum, qui maculis aetatis leviter fusco inscriptus erat, ab ipsis catacumbis absorptus esse, partem huius loci insueti factus, et tempore longiore cadaveri similis futurus, omnem speciem vitae amittens atque in sarcophago erecto putrescente in aeternum quiescendum.

unit.source: Yet, here he was, able to leave the massive tomb chamber that housed the Samaritan Women’s Spring, still carrying a burning white candle.
unit.target: Attamen hic aderat, capax exeundi a magno conclavi sepulcrali, in quo Fontem Samaritanarum Feminarum collocatum habebat, atque adhuc portans candelae albae ardentes.

unit.source: Taking turns guarding the entrance to the Samaritan Women’s Spring, the longer you stay, the deeper the catacombs’ peculiar erosion takes hold, making you less and less like the living until finally, you no longer need a lit white candle to prevent being consumed by the catacombs?
unit.target: Vicissim custodiendo ostium Fontis Samaritanarum Feminarum, quo diutius maneas, eo altior fit insueta erosio catacumbarum, quae te paene ex viventibus depauperat, donec tandem candela alba accensa non amplius opus sit, ne catacumbis absorberis?

unit.source: Can one slowly recover once they rotate out?
unit.target: Num aliquis paulatim se recuperare potest, postquam officia sua relinquitur?

unit.source: Lumian speculated as he watched the elderly catacombs administrator ascend the steps.
unit.target: Lumian speculabatur, dum senex administrator catacumbarum gradibus ascendebat.

unit.source: As he drew closer and the candlelight illuminated his features, the group of students also got a clearer look at the newcomer.
unit.target: Dum propius accessit et candela luce lineamenta eius illustrata erant, coetus studentium quoque novum advenientem clarius aspexit.

unit.source: They recognized the uniform of the catacombs administrator but had never met one so aged he seemed nearly decomposed.
unit.target: Illi uniformem administratoris catacumbarum agnovērunt, sed numquam convenierunt aliquem tam senem ut paene dissolutus videretur.

unit.source: His face, speckled with light brown age spots and his eyes black and icy, coupled with his faint, almost non-existent breath, instilled an involuntary fear in them, prompting them to huddle together for warmth and courage.
unit.target: Facies eius, in qua maculae aetatis leviter fusci sparsae erant, et oculi nigri atque glaciales, una cum spiritu vix perceptibili, in eos instinctivum timorem excitaverunt, impellentes ut ad calorem et fortitudinem se congregarent.

unit.source: With each soft step echoing, the elderly caretaker stopped at the Entrance to the Old Ossuary.
unit.target: Unusquisque lenis passus resonans, senex curator ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii stetit.

unit.source: He then turned, casting his chilling gaze upon Lumian.
unit.target: Tum se vertit atque oculos frigore pervadentes in Lumian immisit.

unit.source: “I need to speak with you,” the catacombs administrator said in a hoarse, matter-of-fact tone.
unit.target: “Tecum loqui mihi necesse est,” inquit administrator catacumbarum, voce rauca et sincera.

unit.source: Me?
unit.target: Me?

unit.source: Do we know each other?
unit.target: Nos num nos cognovimus?

unit.source: Plus, I came here on a whim, driven by impulse and didn’t inform anyone of my plans.
unit.target: Praeterea, casu huc veni, impulsu motus, nec cuiquam consilia mea nuntiavi.

unit.source: Why would you need to see me?
unit.target: Cur ergo me videre velis?

unit.source: Lumian was taken aback, as were the university students.
unit.target: Lumian, sicut discipuli universitatis, attonitus fuit.

unit.source: They hadn’t expected this intriguing, skilled prankster to be acquainted with such a frightening catacombs administrator.
unit.target: Illi non exspectaverunt hunc intrigantem et peritum ioculator, talem terribilem administrator catacumbarum iam cognitum esse.

unit.source: Had he really explored the catacombs so often that he had befriended the administrators?
unit.target: Num vere toties catacumbas perlustraret, ut administratoribus amicitia coniunxisset?

unit.source: Perplexed, Lumian stood up and followed the elderly administrator to the side of the Entrance to the Old Ossuary.
unit.target: Confusus, Lumian surrexit et senem administrator ad latus Introitus Veteris Ossuarii secutus est.

unit.source: He wanted to hear what this was all about and why he was being sought out.
unit.target: Volebat audire quid de hac re ageretur et cur ille peteretur.

unit.source: In the dense darkness, with just a stub of a white candle making his face appear more ghastly, the emotionless caretaker said, “There’s been an anomaly with a corpse on the fourth level’s southwest corner. Handle it.”
unit.target: In tenebris densis, cum solum truncus candelae albae faciem eius magis horribilem reddideret, curator, indifferens, dixit: “Anomalia accidit cum cadavero in angulo australi occidentali quarti gradus. Cura id.”

unit.source: “Me?” Lumian pointed to himself with his empty right hand.
unit.target: “Me?” inquit Lumian, se indicans manu dextro vacua.

unit.source: Why are you asking me to deal with this? There are other catacombs administrators, official Beyonders for this sort of thing. Why me?
unit.target: Cur rogas ut hoc curem? Sunt alii administratores catacumbarum, officiales “Beyonders” huiusmodi; cur me?

unit.source: And you’re ordering me around as if I’m a mercenary paid to handle such matters, without even discussing compensation…
unit.target: Et imperas mihi quasi mercenario, ad talia negotia solvendum mercede remunerato, sine de compensatione quidquam tractato…

unit.source: “Correct.” The elderly administrator nodded gently. “My body and spirit are nearing decay, and I can no longer engage in combat.”
unit.target: “Recte.” Senex administrator leniter annuit. “Corpus et animus mihi putrescentiae appropinquant, nec amplius in pugnam ingredi posse puto.”

unit.source: Lumian eyed the administrator with curiosity, probing, “Do you know me?”
unit.target: Lumian administratoris oculos cum curiositate intuebatur et interrogavit: “Me nosti?”

unit.source: The deep wrinkles on the administrator’s face unfolded into a strange smile. “You are one of our kind.”
unit.target: Profunda rugae in facie administratoris in risum mirabilem evolutae sunt. “Tu es unus ex nostris.”

unit.source: One of our kind… Lumian mused, a guess forming in his mind.
unit.target: “Unus ex nostris…” cogitavit Lumian, coniectura in mente formans.

unit.source: “Deal with it now. The longer you wait, the more troublesome it becomes.” The administrator turned and headed back towards the “Entrance to the Old Ossuary.”
unit.target: “Cura id nunc; quo diutius moraris, eo magis molestum fit.” Administrator se vertit et ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii rediit.

unit.source: ! came to stake out Harrison from Resurrection Island, not to work for you… Lumian muttered silently, his curiosity piqued as he followed the more corpse-like than living administrator down the stone steps.
unit.target: Non ad te laborandum, sed ad Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis inspiciendum veni—murmuravit Lumian silentio, curiositate excitatus, dum senex administrator, magis cadaverosus quam vivus, sub lapideis gradibus secutus est.

unit.source: During this, he flashed a smile and waved at the students, frightening them into silence; none dared to respond.
unit.target: Hoc interea, risum ostendit et discipulis manum ferebat, eos in silentium terrens; nemo audebat respondere.

unit.source: Once Lumian and the elderly administrator’s figures had disappeared deep into the stone stairway, with only a flicker of candlelight remaining, the students finally relaxed and exhaled in relief.
unit.target: Cum figurae Lumiani et senis administratoris in profunda scala lapidea evanuerant, et solum scintilla candelae remansisset, discipuli tandem relaxaverunt et leviter suspiraverunt.

unit.source: That guy really knew the catacombs administrator well!
unit.target: Ille vere bene administratorem catacumbarum noverat!

unit.source: He must be extremely familiar with this place!
unit.target: Oportet eum hunc locum eximie noverisse!

unit.source: Were the rumors he shared actually true?
unit.target: Num famae, quas divulgaverat, vere res fuerunt?

unit.source: Recalling Lumian’s description of the dorm anomalies and the consequences of extinguishing a candle, the students shivered in unison, pulling their candles closer to their bodies.
unit.target: Meminentes descriptionem Lumiani de anomaliis dormitoriis et consequentias candelae exstinguendi, discipuli una contremuerunt, suas candelas propius ad corpora trahentes.

unit.source: Descending layer by layer, past François’ Tomb and the Blood Order Hall, Lumian followed the old administrator, quickly reaching the southwest corner of the catacombs’ fourth level.
unit.target: Descendens stratum per stratum, praeter Sepulcrum Francois et Aulam Ordinis Sanguinis, Lumian veterem administrator sequebatur, celeriter ad angulum australi occidentalem quarti gradus catacumbarum perveniens.

unit.source: Using the remaining third of his white candle, Lumian saw a giant skeleton, about three to four meters tall, composed of bones from different corpses and shaped like a human with seven or eight heads, all eye sockets dark, void of any colored flame.
unit.target: Utendo reliquā tertiā parte candelae albae, Lumian ingentem sceleton vidit, circiter trium ad quattuor metrarum altitudinem, ex ossibus variarum cadaverum compositum, et in formam hominis cum septem vel octo capitibus versa, quorum omnes orbitae obscurae erant, sine aliqua flammā coloratā.

unit.source: At that moment, the giant skeleton was opening tomb doors, extracting sharp bones, and adding them to its massive bone sword.
unit.target: In illo momento, sceleton ingens portas sepulcrorum aperiebat, ossa acuta extrahens eaque ad suum ingentem gladium ossium addens.

unit.source: The candlelight spread only slightly, illuminating the area minimally as darkness flowed like water, bringing an indescribable chill and horror.
unit.target: Lumen candelae tantum parum diffundebatur, regionem vix illustrans, dum tenebrae, quasi aqua, fluere videbantur, afferentes frigorem et terror ineffabile.

unit.source: Even without getting close, Lumian involuntarily felt fear and resistance, as if he were walking towards death.
unit.target: Etiam abs non accessu proximo, Lumian involuntarie timorem et repugnantiam sensit, quasi ad mortem ambularet.

unit.source: His blue eyes darkened to iron-black, reflecting the ghastly pallor of the aberrant skeleton.
unit.target: Oculi eius caerulei in ferruginem obscurum mutaverunt, pallorem horrendum sceletonis aberrantis reflectentes.

unit.source: Deep within its chest, it felt as if he had to cleave through layers of white bones to reach it.
unit.target: In pectore eius profundo videbatur quasi necesse esset per stratas ossium alborum penetrare ut ad illum perveniret.

unit.source: “You see it? Take care of it,” the old caretaker commanded again, as if ordering a subordinate.
unit.target: “Videsne id? Cura id,” iterum praecepit senex curator, quasi subordinatum imperans.

unit.source: “What abilities does it have?” Lumian wasn’t averse to lending a hand—he had just acquired a powerful item and was eager to use it, but he couldn’t just rush into battle without understanding the monster’s capabilities and planning his strategy.
unit.target: “Quae facultates ei insunt?” inquit Lumian; auxilium ferre non recusabat—modo validam rem adeptus erat atque eam uti cupidus, sed in proelium impetu accurrere non poterat, nisi monstri facultates intellexerit et consilium paraverit.

unit.source: The candle in the administrator’s hand was now just a stub, its dim flame stubbornly clinging on.
unit.target: Candela in manu administratoris iam solum truncus erat, eius flamma obscura pertinaciter manens.

unit.source: He shook his head and said, “I’m not sure, but it’s being suppressed by the catacombs, unable to show much of its potential. Once it gets dark outside, we might not have that advantage. We must clear it out now.”
unit.target: Caput movit et dixit: “Nescio, sed catacumbae eam comprimunt, neque multum ex eius potentia ostendere possunt. Cum extra tenebra fient, fortasse hanc commoditatem non habebimus. Nunc id expurgandum est.”

unit.source: The catacombs are suppressing it… Lumian mused aloud, “How often have these anomalies occurred recently? Is it frequent?”
unit.target: Catacumbae id comprimunt… Lumian alte meditatus inquit: “Quoties hae anomaliae nuper evenere? Frequentesne sunt?”

unit.source: “It’s normal, once or twice a month,” the elderly catacombs administrator replied in a raspy voice.
unit.target: “Normaliter, semel vel bis in mense,” respondit senex administrator catacumbarum voce rauca.

unit.source: Even if it’s broadly sealed, some abnormalities still occur? That’s similar to other areas of the Underground Trier…
unit.target: Etiamsi late obsignata sit, quaedam anomalia tamen eveniunt? Id simile est aliis partibus Subterranei Trier.

unit.source: As Lumian was about to ask more questions, the giant, mud-and-mold‑covered skeletal aberration seemed to notice them, suddenly turning around and raising its massive bone sword.
unit.target: Dum Lumian plura quaerere parabat, ingens aberratio sceletonica, luto et fungo induta, eos animadvertit, subito se vertens et suum ingentem gladium ossium extollens.

unit.source: The surface of the giant sword burst into pale‑white flames.
unit.target: Superficies ingentis gladii in flammas pallido‑albas erupit.

unit.source: Thud, thud, thud, the skeleton with several heads moved stiffly but quickly charged toward Lumian and the catacombs administrator.
unit.target: Thud, thud, thud, sceleton cum pluribus capitibus rigide sed celeriter ad Lumian et administrator catacumbarum impetum fecit.

unit.source: The surrounding darkness surged over, bringing with it a bone‑chilling cold and a terror that seemed to reach into their souls.
unit.target: Tenebrae circumstantes impetu insurgentes, afferentes frigoris ossium perfrigidum atque terrorem, qui animis eorum penetrare videbatur.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and grasped the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian in sacculum Viatoris inseruit et Gladium Fortitudinis arripuit.

unit.source: A warm rush quickly spread through his body.
unit.target: Calidus impetus celeriter per corpus eius diffusus est.

unit.source: What’s there to fear?
unit.target: Quid timendum est?

unit.source: Fight, fight, fight!
unit.target: Pugna, pugna, pugna!

unit.source: Lumian drew the iron‑black greatsword and charged toward the giant skeleton and its terrifying bone sword.
unit.target: Lumian gladium magnum ferri‑nigerrimum extraxit et ad ingentem sceleton ac eius terribilem gladium ossium impetum fecit.

unit.source: Then, he swung the Sword of Courage upwards.
unit.target: Tum Gladium Fortitudinis sursum intorquebat.

unit.source: A bright white flame with a hint of blue burst forth from the blade.
unit.target: Clara flamma alba, leviter caerulea insinuante, ex gladio erupta est.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: The iron‑black greatsword collided with the bone sword, made of numerous sharp bones, in midair.
unit.target: Gladius magnum ferri‑nigerrimus cum gladio ossium, ex multis ossibus acutis composito, in medio aere concurrit.

unit.source: Lumian’s knees bent as his feet sank into the mud.
unit.target: Lumiani genua flecta sunt, dum pedes eius in lutum ceciderunt.

unit.source: The skeleton’s force was immense, and the bright white‑blue flames tangled with the pale‑white flames, mutually extinguishing each other.
unit.target: Vis sceletonis immensa erat, et flammae albae‑caeruleae clarae cum flammas pallido‑albas implicatae inter se extinguebantur.

unit.source: Lumian was not afraid.
unit.target: Lumian non timebat.

unit.source: His eyes excited, he tightened his thighs, straightened his knees, and advanced rather than retreated, slashing with his iron‑black greatsword toward the colossal creature.
unit.target: Oculi eius excitati erant; femora contraxit, genua recta tenuit, et progredi potius quam recedere incipiebat, gladium suum magnum ferri‑nigerrimum contra ingentem creaturam secans.

unit.source: The bone sword responded with the force of a falling boulder.
unit.target: Gladius ossium respondit cum vi lapidis cadentis.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: The collision triggered a violent explosion, and the fierce shockwave, carrying the bright white‑blue flames, struck the giant skeleton’s surface, pushing it back two steps.
unit.target: Confluentia violentam explosionem excitavit, et impetu acerbo, flammis albae‑caeruleae illustrato, superficiem ingentis sceletonis percussit, duo gradus retro impellens.

unit.source: Lumian pursued, slashing again with the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Lumian persequebatur, iterum Gladium Fortitudinis secans.

unit.source: Rumble! Rumble! Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble! Rumble! Rumble!

unit.source: With each clash of the huge swords and in every massive explosion, a large number of bones fell from the skeleton, charred, and even the bone sword itself thinned significantly.
unit.target: Cum omni concursu ingentium gladiorum et omni explosione maxima, magna multitudo ossium ex sceleton cecidit, combusta, atque etiam gladium ossium ipse significanter tenuatum est.

unit.source: Finally, Lumian broke through its defense, cleaving into its chest with one strike.
unit.target: Denique, Lumian eius defensionem fregit, in pectore uno ictu secans.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: The bright white‑blue fireball expanded there, penetrating its entire body.
unit.target: Orbis ignis clarus, alba‑caeruleus, ibi expandit, totum corpus eius penetralia perveniens.

unit.source: The giant skeleton froze instantly.
unit.target: Sceleton ingens statim congelatus est.

unit.source: Crash! t collapsed entirely, like a stacked block castle knocked over.
unit.target: Crash! Totum corruit, sicut castellum ex lapidibus conpositum everruit.

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his iron‑black greatsword, turned halfway to the elderly catacombs administrator, and smiled, saying, “Neutralized.”
unit.target: Lumian gladium suum magnum ferri‑nigerrimum recepit, partim vertens ad senem administrator catacumbarum, et subridens dixit: “Neutralizatum.”

unit.source: As he spoke, he returned the Sword of Courage to the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Gladium Fortitudinis ad sacculum Viatoris reddidit.

unit.source: Just after this action, Lumian suddenly sobered up.
unit.target: Mox post hanc actionem, Lumian repente sobrius factus est.

unit.source: Was that it?
unit.target: Hocne fuit?

unit.source: Although I had planned to engage in direct combat before drawing the sword, I hadn’t considered just a head-on attack…
unit.target: Quamquam pugnare directe ante gladium sumendum consiliaveram, non meditatus eram tantum impetum frontale subire…

unit.source: Truly the Sword of Courage…
unit.target: Vere, Gladium Fortitudinis…

unit.source: Hearing Lumian’s words, the elderly catacombs administrator, holding the nearly extinguished white candle, slowly approached.
unit.target: Audiens verba Lumiani, senex administrator catacumbarum, candelae albae paene exstinctae tenens, lente accedebat.

unit.source: Lumian, taking advantage of having just provided help, casually asked, “Has anyone visited the Samaritan Women’s Spring in the past few months?”
unit.target: Lumian, modo auxilium praestito, leviter rogavit: “Num aliquis Fontem Samaritanarum Feminarum paucis mensibus praeteritis visitavit?”

unit.source: That was supposedly the strongest point of death energy in the entire catacombs, and Harrison might be drawn there.
unit.target: Illa dicebatur esse potentissima energiae mortis in totis catacumbis, et Harrison ibi fortasse attrahetur.

unit.source: The elderly catacombs administrator looked at Lumian in slow motion, his voice hoarse as he said, “Extinguish the candle.”
unit.target: Senex administrator catacumbarum, Luminum lente aspiciens, voce rauca dixit: “Extingue candela!”

unit.source: What? Extinguish the candle? Are you trying to kill me? Lumian’s first reaction was that the catacombs administrator in front of him meant him harm.
unit.target: Quid? Extingue candela! Mihi necares? Prima reactio Lumiani fuit, existimans administrator catacumbarum coram eo malum intendere.

unit.source: Without a lit white candle here, one would be eerily erased and forgotten by all!
unit.target: Sine candela alba accensa hic, quisque mirabiliter deleatur et ab omnibus obliviscatur!

unit.source: At that moment, the candle in the administrator’s hand burned down to the end, flickered once, and was completely extinguished.
unit.target: In illo momento, candela in manu administratoris usque ad finem combusta est, semel micavit, et penitus exstincta est.

unit.source: Darkness surged toward the old man, seemingly engulfing him in deathly silence.
unit.target: Tenebrae versus senem insurgent, eum in silentio mortifero quasi complectentes.

unit.source: He did not disappear.
unit.target: Non evanuit.

unit.source: In that instant, Lumian recalled many things, including the catacombs administrator considering him one of their own and his own guess about it.
unit.target: In illo instante, Lumian multa recordatus est, inter quae quod administrator catacumbarum eum unum ex suis habebat et suam ipsius coniecturam.

unit.source: He hadn’t made his final, crazy decision when the darkness around the administrator viciously spread, enveloping him.
unit.target: Non fecerat decisionem ultimam insanam, cum tenebrae circa administrator saevissime diffunderent se eum complectentes.

unit.source: His white candle suddenly went out.
unit.target: Candela alba eius subito exstincta est.

unit.source: 752 In the Darkness
unit.target: 752 In Tenebris

unit.source: 752 In the Darkness
unit.target: 752 In Tenebris

unit.source: Dammit!
unit.target: Heu!

unit.source: Though Lumian had toyed with the idea of taking risks, he hadn’t truly made up his mind.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian de consilio pericula capiendi luserat, veram autem sententiam nondum decreverat.

unit.source: The sudden extinguishing of his white candle prompted him to swear under his breath, instinctively preparing to activate the black mark on his shoulder and teleport out of the catacombs.
unit.target: Subitus exstinguens candelae albae suae eum impulit ut sub ore iuraret, instinctive parans ut in umero suo atrum sigillum activaret et e catacumbis evaderet.

unit.source: At that moment, a bone-chilling cold tinged with slight pain surged through the palm of his right hand.
unit.target: Illo momento, frigore ossa terrente, cum parvo dolore tincto, per palmam dextrae eius inruit.

unit.source: This snap of pain brought him to his senses, thankfully without any further unpleasant changes to his body.
unit.target: Hic ictus doloris eum ad sensum revocavit, gratias Deo quod nulla ulterius incommoda mutationes corporis factae sunt.

unit.source: Indeed… Lumian instantly calmed down, abandoning the idea of using his Spirit World Traversal ability.
unit.target: Revera… Lumian statim se tranquillavit, consilium uti facultate transitus in Mundi Spirituum desinens.

unit.source: His suspicions were confirmed!
unit.target: Suspicionēs eius confirmatae sunt!

unit.source: He clenched his right hand discreetly, ensuring the prominently-marked Underworld Daoist seal wasn’t visible to anything lurking in the darkness.
unit.target: Manum dextram caute comprimentem curavit, ut sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum insigniter notatum a quolibet in tenebris latentibus non videaretur.

unit.source: After the elderly, decaying, and clearly unwell catacombs administrator mistook him for a kindred spirit, Lumian suspected it was due to the Underworld Daoist seal.
unit.target: Postquam senex, putrescens, atque manifeste infirmus administrator catacumbarum eum pro cognato spiritu equivocavit, Lumian suspicatus est id ob sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum esse.

unit.source: Given that the Samaritan Women’s Spring was closely related to the Underworld Daoist and the catacombs of Trier were likely built to contain its overflowing influence, the administrators took turns guarding the massive tomb chamber leading to the spring.
unit.target: Cum Fons Mulierum Samaritarum arcte coniungeretur cum Daoisticis Inferorum, et catacumbae Treverenses verisimiliter ad eius effusam potentiam continendam aedificatae essent, administratores vicissim in magna cella sepulcrali, quae ad fontem ducebat, custodiendum munere se tradiderunt.

unit.source: Since catacombs administrators affected by anomalies could navigate the dark catacombs without a lit white candle and not disappear, theoretically, he should be able to as well, given his Underworld Daoist seal!
unit.target: Cum administratores catacumbarum, anomaliebus affecti, per tenebrosas catacumbas sine candela alba accensa navigare et non evanescere poterant, theoretice et ipse id efficere debet, propter sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum suum!

unit.source: Of course, this was extremely risky. A wrong guess could mean dying without leaving a trace, causing Lumian to hesitate despite his wild impulse.
unit.target: Certe, hoc erat summopere periculosum. Errata coniectura mortem sine vestigio relinquere poterat, quod Lumian, non obstante impetu ferocio, ad dubitationem adducebat.

unit.source: In the pure darkness, where his eyes saw nothing, Lumian felt as if he were in Trier’s subterranean river, immersed in cold, damp, heavy, and silent waters.
unit.target: In pura tenebris, ubi oculi eius nihil videbant, Lumian se sensit quasi in flumine subterraneo Treverensi esset, in aquis frigidis, humidis, gravibus et tacitis immersus.

unit.source: Yet, he breathed easily; his body and soul strangely drawing air from the dense, dark “waters,” sustaining his existence.
unit.target: At tamen facile spirabat; corpus et anima eius mirabiliter aerem ex aquis densis et obscuris trahentes, vitam suam sustentabant.

unit.source: He seemed like a fish in the deep sea.
unit.target: Velut piscis in profundo mari videbatur.

unit.source: The darkness, like flowing water, layered and pressed down, isolating this space from the surrounding areas and the outside world.
unit.target: Tenebrae, vel aquae fluentes, se stratis disposuerunt et premebant, spatium hoc a circumstantiis et mundo externo segregantes.

unit.source: The next moment, Lumian heard the old administrator’s raspy, indifferent voice.
unit.target: Proximo momento, Lumian vocem asperam et indifferenter sonantem senis administratoris audivit.

unit.source: “Recently, three people tried to approach the spring, but I stopped them.”
unit.target: “Nuper tres homines fontem appropinquare conati sunt, sed ego eos prohibui.”

unit.source: Three people… Lumian’s spirit lifted as he asked, “Who were they?”
unit.target: Tres homines… Animus Lumiani surrexit, dum quaerebat: “Qui erant illi?”

unit.source: “One time it was a Blessed of darkness and death with a Hunter,” the old administrator described in his own way.
unit.target: “Olim fuit Beatus tenebrarum et mortis cum Venatore,” senex administrator suo modo descripsit.

unit.source: A Blessed of darkness and death with a Hunter.. Isn’t that Madame Hela and me? You still remember us… Lumian realized, followed by muttered criticisms.
unit.target: Beatus tenebrarum et mortis cum Venatore… Nonne illa est Domina Hela atque ego? Nos adhuc meministis… Lumian intellexit, et secuta sunt murmurationes leviter reprehensivae.

unit.source: He had thought this elderly administrator, unlike the more active ones like Kendall and nearing a corpse-like state, didn’t recognize people by sight but by sensing their presence— Lumian had encountered two catacombs administrators guiding visitors when he arrived at the Entrance to the Old Ossuary, and they didn’t see him as one of their own. Instead, they advised him not to wander alone and always keep a white candle burning for light.
unit.target: Existimaverat senem administratoris, dissimilem activioribus ut Kendall, qui ad mortuosam similitudinem accedere videbatur, homines non per aspectum sed per praesentiam eorum agnoscere; Lumian enim duos administratores catacumbarum, qui visitores ducebant, convenisse meminit, cum ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii pervenisset, et illi eum non inter suos agnoverunt. Immo, moniti sunt ne solus errarent atque ut semper candela alba pro lumine arderet.

unit.source: “Who was the third?” Lumian pressed on.
unit.target: “Quis tertius erat?” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Was it Harrison, or Monette, the incarnation of Amon active in these subterranean catacombs?
unit.target: Fuitne Harrison, an Monette, incarnatio Amonis, quae in his catacumbis subterraneis operatur?

unit.source: The old catacombs administrator responded in a monotone, husky voice, “An outsider, he felt similar to us but also different, so I stopped him.”
unit.target: Senex administrator catacumbarum respondit voce monotona et rauca: “Alienus est; similis nobis se videbat, sed etiam diversus, ideo eum prohibui.”

unit.source: Similar yet different… an outsider… Lumian pondered these key descriptions and surmised it was probably Harrison from Resurrection Island!
unit.target: Similis sed diversus… alienus… Lumian his descriptionibus meditatus est et coniectus, fortasse, esse Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis!

unit.source: “What did he look like?” Lumian asked, controlling his emotions, seemingly calm.
unit.target: “Quomodo ille videbatur?” inquit Lumian, affectus suos temperans et tranquillum apparens.

unit.source: He couldn’t see through the darkness, not even the outline of the old administrator, but he sensed the other was right in front of him, no more than two meters away.
unit.target: Per tenebras videre non potuit, ne formam quidem senis administratoris, sed sensit illum statim ante se esse, non longius quam duo metra distantem.

unit.source: He then heard the old administrator reply: “I’ve been an administrator for so long, I’ve forgotten many things. Even death itself vanishes here, let alone our memories. I can’t remember what he looked like, only that he didn’t resemble an Intisian, nor a Loenese or Feysacian.”
unit.target: Tum senex administrator respondit: “Tamdiu administravi ut multa oblitus sim; etiam mors ipsa hic evanescit, nedum memoriae nostrae. Non memini quomodo ille videbatur, nisi quod neque Intisianus, neque Loenensis, neque Feysacianus ei similis fuit.”

unit.source: After a brief pause, the catacombs administrator continued in his flat tone, “I should go back to rest now…”
unit.target: Post brevem moram, administrator catacumbarum in tono aequo continuavit: “Nunc ad quiescendum redire debeo…”

unit.source: Lumian did not try to stop him, nor did he ask further questions.
unit.target: Lumian neque eum prohibere conatus est neque ulteriores quaestiones posuit.

unit.source: Although he hadn’t heard any footsteps, nor sensed any movement ahead, a very clear thought suddenly struck him: The person has already left.
unit.target: Quamquam vestigia graduum non audivit nec motus aliquos ante sensit, repente clarum ei pervenit: persona iam discessit.

unit.source: He didn’t look like an Intisian, a Loenese, or a Feysacian… An outsider… Someone who had been to the fourth level of the catacombs in recent months… Lumian replayed the catacombs administrator’s responses in his mind over and over.
unit.target: Non videbatur ut Intisianus, aut Loenensis, aut Feysacianus… alienus… aliquis qui ad quartum gradum catacumbarum nuper pervenerat… Lumian responsa administratoris catacumbarum in mente sua iteravit rursus atque rursus.

unit.source: Suddenly, he remembered something: Franca had mentioned that she encountered a man in the catacombs who she suspected came from the world of the Celestial Master—the world they had transmigrated from. Her judgment was based on the man’s appearance, which closely resembled the people from that world and was distinctly different from those of the Intisians, Loenese, Feynapotterians, and Feysacians!
unit.target: Subito, aliquid memoravit: Franca dixit se virum in catacumbis convenisse, quem suspicabatur ex mundo Magistri Caelestis esse – eo mundo unde translati fuerant. Iudicium eius in specie viri fundabatur, quae populum illius mundi arcte resemblabat et a Intisianis, Loenensibus, Feynapotterianis, atque Feysacianis distincte differebat.

unit.source: So, the person Franca met was the one the elderly administrator persuaded to leave? And that person could very well be Harrison from Resurrection Island…
unit.target: Ergo, persona quam Franca convenit, fuitne ea qua senex administrator ad discedendum persuaserat? Et iste fortasse Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis esse potuit…

unit.source: /s Resurrection Island actually a node where two worlds converge?
unit.target: /s Insula Resurrectionis re vera est nodus ubi duo mundi conveniunt?

unit.source: The reason the nautical chart leading to Resurrection Island is incorrect is because it lacks mystical details; even if one reaches the designated sea area, only danger is encountered, with no sight of the goal?
unit.target: Causa cur charta nautica quae ad Insulam Resurrectionis ducit erronea sit, est quod notis mysticis carens est; etsi quis ad aream maritimam designatam perveniat, solum periculum occurrit, nec finis in conspectu apparet?

unit.source: This would nicely explain Franca’s divination result that the “chart is genuine” and why adventurers have failed to locate Resurrection Island. The charts are indeed accurate, but they don’t record the method to open the “Island’s Door”!
unit.target: Hoc bene explicaret eventum divinationis Francae, quae affirmavit “charta vera est,” et cur viatores Insulam Resurrectionis invenire non valuerint. Chartae vere sunt accuratae, sed modum ad aperiendum “Ianuam Insulae” non inscribunt!

unit.source: If this is the case, there should be a deeper explanation for why Franca and the others were transmigrated, and for the purpose of the Resurrection Islanders appearing on the North and South Continents…
unit.target: Si hoc ita sit, explanatio profundior debet esse de causa cur Franca et ceteri translati sint, atque de proposito ut Insulares Resurrectionis in Continenti Septentrionali et Meridionali apparerent…

unit.source: The good thing now is, Franca has seen someone who might be Harrison and has drawn a corresponding portrait through a ritual, which will help us in our future search.
unit.target: Bonum nunc est quod Franca quemque vidit qui fortasse Harrison sit, et per ritum eius imaginem delineavit, quae nobis in futura inquisitione prodesse poterit.

unit.source: Heh heh, Franca and Jenna’s exploration yielded quite a lot of crucial information about many important matters, filled with a sense of being arranged.
unit.target: Heh heh, exploratio Francae et Jennae plurimas informationes cruciales de multis rebus gravibus attulit, sensu apparendi ordinatae.

unit.source: This might not have been that entity’s doing, but it’s highly likely related to Monette, who often haunts this place…
unit.target: Forsitan non huius entitatis munus fuit, sed verisimiliter pertinet ad Monette, quae hunc locum saepe infestat…

unit.source: Lumian was particularly puzzled about why the True Creator or Amon valued this matter so much. Their previous “help” was mainly about combating the evil gods beyond the barrier and didn’t involve issues from another world.
unit.target: Lumian maxime miratus est cur Verus Creator aut Amon hanc rem tam magno pretio aestimarent. Praevius eorum “auxilium” praecipue ad deos malos ultra limen pugnandum pertinebat neque ad quaestiones ex alio mundo attinebat.

unit.source: Hmm, would that Celestial Worthy be counted as one of the evil gods beyond the barrier?
unit.target: Hmm, num ille Caelestis Dignus inter malos deos ultra limen numerandus sit?

unit.source: Does He come from the Celestial Master’s world?
unit.target: Venitne ille ex mundo Magistri Caelestis?

unit.source: /s this also considered a part of the evil gods’ invasion?
unit.target: /s num hoc etiam pars invasionis malos deorum habetur?

unit.source: Lumian speculated briefly before pondering another question: Whether to inform Franca, 007, Madame Hela, and other members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society about this.
unit.target: Lumian breve speculatus est antequam aliam quaestionem meditaret: num Francae, 007, Domina Hela, et ceteris membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum haec nuntiare deberent.

unit.source: Lumian could already picture what would happen: Including Franca, some members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society would desperately set out to sea, searching for Resurrection Island marked on the sea chart, failing to find the island, but finding it being even more dangerous!
unit.target: Lumian iam imaginari poterat quid futurum esset: cum Franca, nonnulli membri Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum ad mare desperanter navigare inciperent, Insulam Resurrectionis in charta nautica notatam quaerentes; insulam invenire non valentes, sed eam magis periculosam reperientes!

unit.source: But Lumian preferred to see Franca remain as she was: conflicted about her gender but generally happy.
unit.target: Sed Lumian mavult videre Francam esse qualis fuit: de genere suo dubiam, sed plerumque laetam.

unit.source: After a moment of silence, Lumian laughed a bit out of character, whispering self-mockingly in the environment like the dark depths of the sea, “Would you avoid seeking a way to resurrect Aurore because of danger and others’ expectations?
unit.target: Post momentum silentii, Lumian aliquantulum extra personam ridebat, sibi ipsi submurmurans in ambitu velut obscuris abyssis maris: “Num viam quaerere ad Aurore resuscitandam ob periculum et exspectationes aliorum vitabis?”

unit.source: “Would you give up resisting because of danger and others’ expectations?
unit.target: “Num propter periculum et exspectationes aliorum resistentiam desereres?”

unit.source: “Would you refuse to merge with the bloodline of Omebella because of danger and others’ expectations?
unit.target: “Num ob periculum et aliorum exspectationes coniunctionem cum sanguine Omebellae recusares?”

unit.source: “No!”
unit.target: “Minime!”

unit.source: Lumian made up his mind and began to focus on his surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian animum constituit et coepit ad circumstantia attendere.

unit.source: He couldn’t see anything but faintly sensed figures wandering in the darkness, felt hands reaching out to him, grabbing his arms, ankles, neck, and body, yet not having any tangible effect.
unit.target: Nulla videri poterat, sed subtiliter figuras in tenebris errantes intuitus est, manus quae ad eum tendebant, brachia, talos, collum, et corpus eius arripiebant, sed nullum palpabilem effectum habebant.

unit.source: No, there was one thing—Lumian felt distinctly colder, to the point where, with the physical traits of a Reaper, he almost couldn’t help but constrict his pores and shiver lightly.
unit.target: Minime, una tamen re: Lumian clare sensit se frigidiorem esse, ita ut, cum proprietatibus Messoris, paene non possent quin poros contraheret et leviter tremorem faceret.

unit.source: He also heard faint, painful, despairing cries but couldn’t discern their specific directions.
unit.target: Etiam audivit voces infimas, dolentes et desperatas, sed earum certas directiones discernere non potuit.

unit.source: Are these the people who vanished in the catacombs before? Lumian tried to listen closely, to find one or two of the missing, to understand their current state, but it was to no avail.
unit.target: Num hi sunt homines qui ante in catacumbis evanuerunt? Lumian diligenter auscultare conatus est, ut unum aut duo ex eis qui aberant reperirent et statum eorum intellexerent, sed frustra.

unit.source: Suddenly, he shivered.
unit.target: Subito, tremuit.

unit.source: The cold and the dead silence seeped into his mind.
unit.target: Frigus et mortua silentia in mentem eius penetraverunt.

unit.source: His thoughts became slightly sluggish, and his memories of certain things grew a bit fuzzy.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius paulo tardiores fiere coeperunt, et memoriae quarundam rerum aliquantulum opacae factae sunt.

unit.source: The Underworld Daoists seal just prevents me from disappearing on the spot, from even dying without a trace, but it can’t stop me from being slowly eroded by the abnormalities here, like those catacombs administrators? And, my erosion is clearly faster than theirs…
unit.target: Sigillum Daoistarum Inferorum mihi tantum impediat ut in loco evanescam, ne mortuus quidem sine vestigio fiam, sed non potest me impediere ut paulatim ab anomaliebus hic corrodear, sicut illi administratores catacumbarum? Et erosio mea certe celerior est quam eorum…

unit.source: Lumian snapped a flame into existence, lighting the white candle in his hand.
unit.target: Lumian flammam creavit, candelae albae in manu sua accendens.

unit.source: The darkness, cold, weight, silence, and dampness retreated as the light spread.
unit.target: Tenebrae, frigus, pondus, silentium et humiditas recederunt dum lux diffundebatur.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the candle in his hand, nodding and muttering to himself, “I just interpreted the Underworld Daoist’s seal as a kind of alternative white candlelight, but now it seems, they’re not the same, fundamentally different. One stems from an anomaly being sealed, the other leverages the power sealing this place?”
unit.target: Lumian ad candelae in manu sua intuebatur, caput annuens et sibi submurmurans: “Modo sigillum Daoistarum Inferorum tamquam speciem alternativae candelae albae interpretatus sum; sed nunc videtur non eadem esse, sed fundamentaliter diversa. Una ex anomalie sigillata oritur, altera vim ad hoc locum signandum adhibet?”

unit.source: As thoughts swirled, Lumian, holding the burning white candle, made his way back along the original route.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes circumvolabant, Lumian, candela alba ardens tenens, iter originalem retrorsum secutus est.

unit.source: Upon returning to the Entrance of the Old Ossuary, he saw that the few university students who had been there were gone.
unit.target: Revertus ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii, animadvertit paucos iuvenes universitarios, qui ibi fuerant, discessisse.

unit.source: “Scared off, just like that?” Lumian scoffed softly, leisurely leaving the catacombs and returning to Place du Purgatoire.
unit.target: “Territi, ita?” inquit Lumian leniter subsannans, catacumbas paulatim relinquens et ad Place du Purgatoire rediens.

unit.source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: In Quartière Cathédralis Commemorativae, Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numero IX.

unit.source: Franca, who was about to go out to gather information on the Mirror People, saw Lumian again.
unit.target: Franca, quae exire ad de Populo Specularum informationem colligendam parata erat, iterum Lumian vidit.

unit.source: “You’re here again? It’s the third time today!” the Demoness of Pleasure asked, her lips twitching slightly.
unit.target: “Iterum ades? Tertium iam tempore hodie!” inquit Demonissa Voluptatis, labris leviter concitatis.

unit.source: 753 Rational Franca
unit.target: 753 Rationabilis Franca

unit.source: 753 Rational Franca
unit.target: 753 Rationabilis Franca

unit.source: Facing Franca’s probing, Lumian raised an eyebrow and said, “I’ve again come across something important that I need to tell you.”
unit.target: Ad indagationem Francae obstante, Lumian supercilium levatum fecerat et dixit: “Iterum aliquid maximi momenti reperivi, quod tibi narrare debeo.”

unit.source: Franca eyed Lumian suspiciously, unsure whether he was playing a prank or had actually discovered something new.
unit.target: Franca Lumian suspicie intuens, nesciens utrum iocus faceretur aut vere aliquid novi invenerit.

unit.source: Given the frequency of his discoveries, it seemed a bit much, didn’t it?
unit.target: Ex frequentia inventionum eius, videbatur paulum nimis esse, nonne?

unit.source: Just this morning, he had returned from the Blue Avenger, having completed an initial exploration that yielded the formula for the Demoness of Despair potion, a Sword of Courage equivalent to a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, and a specially significant corpse wax candle—all important findings. And now he had more gains in the afternoon?
unit.target: Modo mane redierat ab Caeruleo Vindex, explorationem primam perfecerat quae attulit formulam poculi daemonissae desperationis, gladium virtutis, quod gradus primus sigillatum artificium aequipollens esset, atque candelam ceratam cadaveris peculiaris momenti—omnia res magni momenti repertae. Et nunc post meridiem plura adeptus est?

unit.source: Ultimately, Franca chose to believe Lumian; after all, he had proven himself a harbinger of chaos on multiple occasions.
unit.target: Denique Franca decrevit Lumiano credere, quippe se pluries praenuntiatorem tumultus ostendisse.

unit.source: She stepped aside to let him into the living room.
unit.target: Ea se recessit ut eum in conclave introiret.

unit.source: “What’s it about this time?” Franca asked gravely as she closed the door.
unit.target: “Quid hoc tempore est?” quaesivit Franca graviter, dum ostium clauderat.

unit.source: Lumian stood by the window, back to the outside, and said seriously, “Do you remember Mr.
unit.target: Hanged Man’s description of Harrison?”

unit.source: “I remember—he might appear in places closely linked to darkness, death, dusk, and decay,” Franca replied, the oppressive atmosphere stifling her usual retort of not having forgotten what was discussed just that morning.
unit.target: “Memini—ille forsitan apparere potest in locis arcte coniunctis cum tenebris, morte, crepusculo et corruptione,” respondit Franca, dum opprimens atmosphaera eius solitam replicationem de mane dicta non oblivisse prohibebat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and continued, “I had some free time, so I went to the catacombs. I met with the administrator guarding the Samaritan Women’s Spring area. He told me that recently, an outsider tried to approach the spring but was stopped by him. This outsider’s features are quite different from anyone from the Northern Continent…”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et perrexit: “Aliquam temporis liberi mihi contigit, itaque ad catacumbas accessi. Conveni cum administrador, qui regionem Fontis Samaritarum Mulierum custodivit. Narravit mihi nuper externum fuisse, qui fontem appropinquare conatus est, sed a me prohibitus est. Eius externa lineamenta plane differunt ab iis, qui in Continente Septentrionali oriuntur…”

unit.source: Franca, initially confused, shivered instinctively and blurted out, “Harrison? Was the man with the Eastern features that Jenna and I met actually Harrison?”
unit.target: Franca, prima rursus confusa, tremore instinctivo commota, subito exclamavit: “Harrison? Num vir, cuius lineamenta orientalibus insignes sunt, quem Jenna et ego convenimus, vere Harrison fuit?”

unit.source: She immediately recalled her and Jenna’s adventure at the Krismona Night Pillar.
unit.target: Statim meminit adventurae suae et Jennae ad Columnam Nocturnam Krismonae.

unit.source: In her urgency, she replaced the more complex description of non–North-Continent-bearing features with “Eastern features.”
unit.target: In festinatione sua, descriptionem magis intricata lineamentorum non continentium septentrionalium substituit in “lineamenta orientalia.”

unit.source: “It’s very likely.” Lumian nodded slowly.
unit.target: “Id verisimile est,” Lumian lente annuit.

unit.source: Franca was taken aback. “Resurrection Island… Resurrection Island!”
unit.target: Franca obstupefacta est. “Insula Resurrectionis… Insula Resurrectionis!”

unit.source: Her lake-blue eyes sparkled with excitement and anticipation.
unit.target: Oculi eius, caerulei ut lacus, scintillabant ex laetitia et spe.

unit.source: She asked for confirmation, “Could Resurrection Island be a node where the two worlds converge?”
unit.target: Ea quaesivit confirmationem: “Num Insula Resurrectionis sit nodus quo duae mundi confluant?”

unit.source: “Even if it’s not, it’s probably closely related to your world,” Lumian said, not wanting to dampen her spirits.
unit.target: “Etiamsi non sit, verisimiliter ad mundum tuum arcte pertineat,” inquit Lumian, ne animum eius deprimeret.

unit.source: Franca paced back and forth excitedly, then wailed, “Why didn’t I recognize him then? Why didn’t I capture him? Now he’s gone and we don’t even have a starting point! The Eternal Blazing Sun Church is too slow, not a single piece of feedback!”
unit.target: Franca alacer per spatiolum circumegrebatur, deinde ululavit: “Cur tunc eum non agnovi? Cur eum non ceperam? Nunc evanuit, nec initium quidem habemus! Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Incendii nimis tarda est, ne una quidem responsione!”

unit.source: After Franca vented her frustration, Lumian calmly said, “You can’t blame 007 and the others for being slow; Harrison might no longer be in Trier.”
unit.target: Postquam Franca frustrationem suam effudit, Lumian tranquille dixit: “Non potes 007 et reliquos in tarditate culpare; Harrison fortasse iam non in Trier adest.”

unit.source: “Mmm,” Franca pondered aloud. “I’ll announce this at the research society meeting so members in different areas can watch out for anyone resembling Harrison.”
unit.target: “Mmm,” Franca voce meditabunda exclamavit: “Hoc in conventu societatis investigationis enuntiam, ut membra diversarum regionum vigilent, si quis Harrison similis appareat.”

unit.source: Before Lumian could caution her, Franca muttered to herself, “I’ll tell them not to seek the island until we find Harrison and obtain detailed information about Resurrection Island. It’s too dangerous. If they spot Harrison, they shouldn’t rush to recognize him or approach him; pretend they haven’t seen him and notify President Gandalf, the chairman, Madame Hela, and us…”
unit.target: Antequam Lumian eam monere posset, Franca sibi murmurat: “Eis dicam ne insulam quærant, donec Harrison inveniamus et accuratas notitias de Insula Resurrectionis colligamus. Nimis periculosum est. Si Harrison conspecti erunt, non festinanter eum agnoscant neque ad eum accedant; simulent se eum non vidisse et nuntent Praesidem Gandalf, praefectum, Dominam Hela, et nos…”

unit.source: Lumian listened intently and then playfully complimented her, “I thought you’d be too excited to think straight. But surprisingly, you, who usually seem carefree and not too thoughtful, have considered everything quite thoroughly.”
unit.target: Lumian attente auscultavit, deinde ludenter eam elogio complectus dicens: “Putabam te nimis excitatam fore ut recte cogitaris; sed, ad mirum, tu, quae plerumque leviter videaris et parum sollicita, omnia diligenter perspexisti.”

unit.source: Franca wasn’t provoked; she replied with a smug grin, “What do you call that? Lü Duan is never muddled in major matters! If I have to think hard all the time, wouldn’t that negate the point of relaxing?”
unit.target: Franca, non stimulata, respondit cum risu superbo: “Quid hoc vocas? Lü Duan numquam in rebus gravibus confunditur! Si omni tempore vehementer cogitare debeam, num id non revocat finem quietis?”

unit.source: That made some sense… Lumian asked, puzzled, “Who’s Lü Duan?”
unit.target: Quod aliquatenus sensum habet… Lumian, perplectus, interrogavit: “Quis est Lü Duan?”

unit.source: “No need to know!” Franca answered decisively.
unit.target: “Nihil scire opus est!” respondit Franca ferme.

unit.source: Lumian guessed the reason and didn’t press further, simply nodding. “We’ll share this at the gathering in two days.”
unit.target: Lumian causam coniunxit neque ultra insistere volens, simpliciter annuens: “Hoc in conventu post duos dies communicabimus.”

unit.source: Franca hummed in agreement, then her excitement and joy vanished, her body trembling slightly.
unit.target: Franca submurmuravit in assentimento, deinde laetitia et exsultatio eius evanuerunt, et corpus paulum trepidans factum est.

unit.source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian asked with concern.
unit.target: “Quid accidit?” rogavit Lumian sollicite.

unit.source: Franca pressed her lips together, speaking softly, “I’m excited about the truth and what the future might hold, but I’m also afraid it won’t meet my expectations. I’m scared of facing an answer I can’t handle.”
unit.target: Franca labris conpressis leniter loquens dixit: “Ex veritate et de futuris rebus excito, sed etiam timeo ne ea exspectationibus meis non respondeant. Metuo responsum, quod sustinere non valeam.”

unit.source: After speaking, Franca leaned on the windowsill as if drained of strength.
unit.target: Postquam locuta est, Franca in margine fenestrae inclinavit, quasi vi tota exhaurita.

unit.source: Lumian offered no comfort, his look one and the same as that Madam Magician had when she looked at him: pity.
unit.target: Lumian nihil solatium attulit; vultus eius idem erat ac illius Magistrae Magicae, quae eum intuens misericordiam ostendebat.

unit.source: He too feared that the hope for resurrection he so desperately pursued might just be an unattainable illusion.
unit.target: Et ipse timebat spem resurrectionis, quam tam vehementer petebat, esse tantum inaccessibilem illusionem.

unit.source: After a moment, Lumian asked, “Want to have a drink?”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Lumian interrogavit: “Visne potum habere?”

unit.source: “Sure,” Franca responded with a complex smile. “Getting drunk might help me forget these worries. Ah, typical brotherly comfort—offering a drink.”
unit.target: “Certe,” respondit Franca cum risu multiplex: “In ebrietate forsitan has curas obliviscar. Ah, solatium fraternum typicum, potum offerens!”

unit.source: Two days later.
unit.target: Post duos dies.

unit.source: Franca met with Demoness of Black Clarice, at a hunting ground on the edge of the East Lognes Forest, as agreed.
unit.target: Franca convenit cum Daemonissa Nigra Clarice in campo venationis ad marginem Silvae Orientalis Lognes, ut fecerat conventum.

unit.source: The demigod-level Demoness had swapped her usual black court gown for dark hunting attire and a black hat that covered her long hair, giving her an air of dashing elegance and freshness.
unit.target: Daemonissa, dignitate semidea, solitam vestem curiam nigram mutaverat in vestem venatorem obscuram atque galeram nigram, quae capillos longos operiebatur, efficiens ut indoles eius esset audax elegantia et recenti fulgore.

unit.source: Compared to her previously melancholic beauty, Madame Clarice now radiated a different kind of allure, equally captivating and splendid. Franca eyed the Demoness of Black with appreciation, suppressing the desires that instinctively arose, and relayed the intelligence on the Mirror People that 007 had provided in detail.
unit.target: Comparata pulchritudine tristissima priore, Domina Clarice nunc aliam speciem amoenitatis exsudabat, aeque captivam atque splendidam. Franca Daemonissam Nigram cum admiratione intuens, instinctu orta desideria cohibens, notitiam de Speculorum Populo, quam 007 minutatim tradiderat, narravit.

unit.source: Clarice nodded gently, her smile bright as she took a wooden, burgundy-colored briefcase from her horse.
unit.target: Clarice leniter annuit, ridente praeclaro, dum a suo equo capsam ligneam coloris burgundii arripiebat.

unit.source: “This is your reward,” said the Demoness of Black as she handed the case to Franca.
unit.target: “Hoc est praemium tuum,” inquit Daemonissa Nigra, dum cistam Francae tradidit.

unit.source: Franca did not hesitate, thanking her as she unlatched the metal fasteners and opened the modest-sized wooden briefcase.
