unit.target: Franca non dubitavit; gratias egit, dum vincula metallica soluta et cistam ligneam modestam aperuit.

unit.source: Inside, the case was divided by pristine ice blocks showing no signs of melting, each compartment containing a bat’s head with colorful markings, a gallbladder oozing blood and green bile, a bifurcated tail covered with sleek, sinister scales, and two types of dark red blood in glass vials.
unit.target: Intus, cista subdivisa erat in compartimenta glacie purissima constituta, quae liquefactionis ullum signum non ostenderat; singula compartimenta continebat: caput vespertilionis variis notis coloratis, vesicam felleam sanguine et bile viridi stillantem, caudam bifurcatam lamellis nitidis et sinistris opertam, atque duo genera sanguinis rubri obscuri in vitreis.

unit.source: “Affliction’s main ingredient and most of the supplementary ingredients are here. If you’re not ready to advance, don’t try to break the ice I’ve crafted. That would only infect the bearer with various diseases and lead to a slow death,” warned the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: “Ingrediens praecipua afflictionis et pleraque supplementaria hic sunt. Si ad progressum nondum parata es, noli conari glaciem quam ego condidi rumpere; id tantum ferentem variis morbis inficiat et ad mortem tardam ducat,” admonuit Daemonissa Nigra.

unit.source: “Thank you, Madame,” Franca quickly counted what supplementary ingredients were still needed.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi, Domina,” celeriter enumeravit Franca quae supplementaria adhuc necessaria essent.

unit.source: All that was missing was the fairly common Enfinitas Eucalyptus.
unit.target: Omne quod defuit erat Enfinitas Eucalyptus, satis communis.

unit.source: Demoness of Black Clarice commented, “You’re very efficient and effective in your tasks.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice inquit: “Es valde efficax et diligens in officiis tuis.

unit.source: Perhaps in another year or two, you’ll be ready to attempt opening the gate to godhood. But then, we won’t reward you with the formula and ingredients for Despair. Instead, we’ll inform you of the advancement ritual in advance. Once you’re nearly ready, we’ll simply give you the Despair potion.”
unit.target: Forsitan in alio anno vel biennio, paratus eris portam deitatis aperiendi conari. Tunc autem non tibi dabimus formulam atque ingredienta desperationis; immo, caerimoniam progressionis praeveniemus. Cum paene paratus eris, tibi simpliciter poculum desperationis praestitabimus.

unit.source: “Is this to prevent High-Sequence potion formulas from being leaked?” Franca asked, understanding dawning on her.
unit.target: “Num hoc est ad impediendum ut formulae poculi Ordinis Altissimi effundantur?” rogavit Franca, dum paulatim intellectus eam complectebatur.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black nodded.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra annuit.

unit.source: “Once you earn the right to have a color precede your title, you’ll truly access the High-Sequence potion formulas and some of the sect’s secrets.”
unit.target: “Cum ius tibi comparaveris ut color titulum tuum praeveniat, vere formulae poculi Ordinis Altissimi atque quaedam secreta sectae tibi patefientur.”

unit.source: I also want to obtain the Demoness of Unaging potion formula from you all, but without becoming a Demoness of Unaging, I probably can’t have a color precede my name… No matter, having prior knowledge of the ritual to see if it’s wicked or not is sufficient… Franca didn’t hide the anticipation in her expression.
unit.target: Etiam cupio a vobis formulam poculi Daemonissae Immortalitatis obtinere, sed sine Daemonissa Immortalitatis fieri probabiliter colorem nomini meo praeferre non possum… Nihil refert; scientia praevia caerimoniae nos certiores facit utrum nefaria sit. Franca expectationem in vultu suo non celavit.

unit.source: She then steered the conversation back to the investigation of the Mirror People.
unit.target: Deinde sermonem ad indagationem Speculorum Populi redegit.

unit.source: “Madame, to what extent should we pursue the Mirror People? Is it enough to thwart their plans and eliminate those who have escaped from the special mirror world?
unit.target: “Domina, usque quo Speculorum Populum persequendum sit? Estne satis consilia eorum impediere atque eos, qui ex mundo speculari speciali effugerunt, delere?”

unit.source: “We couldn’t possibly enter that special mirror world and eradicate their leaders and their foundation while Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal remains intact, could we?”
unit.target: “Nonne possumus in illud speculare mundum specialem intrare et duces atque fundamenta eorum exterminare, dum sigillum Quartae Aetatis Trier intactus manet?”

unit.source: Franca was probing the Demoness Sect’s ultimate goal regarding the Mirror People, trying to gauge the state and thoughts of the Primordial Demoness.
unit.target: Franca de ultimo proposito Sectae Daemonissarum circa Speculorum Populum percontabatur, quaerens statum atque cogitationes Daemonissae Primordialis intellegere.

unit.source: Clarice looked at her and said with a refreshing smile, “Let’s do what we can for now. When you’ve advanced to Affliction, we’ll tell you more.”
unit.target: Clarice eam contemplata, risu recenter nitido afferente, dixit: “Quod nunc possumus ageamus; cum ad Afflictionem pervenieris, tibi plura dicemus.”

unit.source: Becoming a Demoness of Affliction means entering the core circle of the Demoness Sect, eligible to learn some secrets? Franca was both excited to be drawing closer to the secrets of the Demoness Sect and completing tasks, and somewhat anxious.
unit.target: Fieri Daemonissa Afflictionis significat intrare in nucleum Sectae Daemonissarum, unde quaedam arcana disci possunt; Franca tum excitata, prope arcana sectae attingens et opera peragenda conficiens, et aliquantum anxia fuit.

unit.source: Late at night, in a quarry cave in Underground Trier.
unit.target: Sero nocte, in spelunca fodina in subterraneo Trier.

unit.source: Angoulême de François, dressed in a brown woolen coat and wearing a gold brooch, entered this dormant area carrying a carbide lamp.
unit.target: Angoulême de François, veste lana fusca indutus et fibula aurea gerens, hanc quietam aream intravit, lampam carbidicam ferens.

unit.source: His right sleeve was rolled up, revealing a glass syringe tied around his elbow filled with a cloudy white liquid.
unit.target: Manica dextra evoluta erat, ostendens syringeam vitrei circa cubitum alligatam, quae liquorem album turbido implebat.

unit.source: Behind him followed four or five Purifiers, each with a similar syringe on their arms.
unit.target: Post eum quattuor vel quinque Purificatores sequebantur, unusquisque brachio simili syringea habens.

unit.source: Surrounded by the Purifiers were four tall iron-gray steam robots, responsible for carrying an item over two meters long and about six feet wide.
unit.target: Circumdati a Purificatoribus erant quattuor automata vaporis ferro-grisea alta, quae munus habebant portandi rem quae plus quam duo metra longitudo et circiter sex pedes latitudo habebat.

unit.source: The item was covered with a red flannel cloth, hiding any details.
unit.target: Res tegebatur pannus flannel ruber, quo omnia singularia abscondebantur.

unit.source: Angoulême stopped in the middle of the quarry, gesturing for his teammates to halt as well.
unit.target: Angoulême in medio fodinae subsedit, gesticulans ut socios suos quoque sisterent.

unit.source: The iron-gray steam robots then set the item on the ground.
unit.target: Automata vaporis ferro-grisea deinde rem in terram posuerunt.

unit.source: As the flannel cover was lifted, a beautifully crafted, classical-looking bed was revealed, making Angoulême and his team feel tired and drawn to its inviting comfort, wanting to lie down for a good sleep.
unit.target: Cum pannus flannel sublevatus esset, lectus elegans et more classico apparens revelatus est, faciens Angoulême et turma eius fesses et ad solacium eius invitantem trahi, ut ad bonum somnum iacere concilirent.

unit.source: Angoulême quickly looked away and, using the hand holding the carbide lamp, pushed the plunger of the syringe, injecting more of the liquid into his body.
unit.target: Angoulême celeriter oculos avertit et, manu lampam carbidicam tenente, pistonem syringeae impulsit, plura liquoris in corpus suum iniectens.

unit.source: Following similar actions from the other Purifiers, a figure in a black nun’s outfit suddenly emerged from the other side of the quarry.
unit.target: Post similiora acta a ceteris Purificatoribus, figura in habitu monialis nigrae subito ex altera parte fodinae apparuit.

unit.source: 754 Two Spirits
unit.target: 754 Duo Spiritūs

unit.source: When the feminine silhouette emerged from the darkness, Angoulême and his companions instantly tensed up.
unit.target: Cum figura feminina ex tenebris emersit, Angoulême et comites eius statim commoti sunt.

unit.source: They were still unsure how to make the humanoid Sealed Artifact move towards the bed on its own; they could only hope that the bed, also a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, would exert its allure to entice beings to lie upon it.
unit.target: Adhuc nesciebant quomodo artificium sigillatum humanoide, a se ipso agendum, ad lectum moveretur; tantum sperabant ut lectum, qui etiam artificium sigillatum gradus I esset, suam allicitatem ostenderet ad entia ad iacendum.

unit.source: Of course, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church wouldn’t send merely a team of highest-ranking Purifiers for a transaction involving a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Certe, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Incandescentis non mittebat solum turmam purificatorum summae classei ad negotium quod cum artificio sigillato gradus I attinebat.

unit.source: Undoubtedly, a demigod was overseeing from the shadows, but in the event of an incident, how many could be saved from the clash of two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts was an uncertainty.
unit.target: Indubitanter, semideus ex umbris vigilabat, sed, casu eventus, quot ex concursu duorum artificiorum sigillatorum gradus I servari possent, incertum erat.

unit.source: As soon as the somber yet serene-looking woman appeared, she moved toward the elegant, classical bed as if summoned or commanded.
unit.target: Quam primum mulier, tristis sed serena specie, apparuit, illa se contulit ad lectum elegantem et classicum, quasi invocata vel imperata.

unit.source: Angoulême and the others remained perfectly still, almost like statues, fearing any sudden movement might startle their target and hinder the positive development of the situation.
unit.target: Angoulême et ceteri perfecte immobiles mansere, quasi statuae, metuentes ne repentinus motus eorum scopum perturbaret atque progressionem bonam impediret.

unit.source: Finally, the figure in the black nun’s attire lay down on the bed.
unit.target: Denique, figura in veste monialis nigrae, in lecto cubuit.

unit.source: She yawned slightly, then closed her eyes, her whole being radiating profound exhaustion, as if she had spent her life’s energy.
unit.target: Paulum suspiravit, deinde oculos clausit, totum esse eius languore profundo refulgebat, quasi vim vitae suae consumpsisset.

unit.source: She fell asleep.
unit.target: Dormivit.

unit.source: Several Purifiers stepped forward, placing their differently colored leather cases on the ground.
unit.target: Plures Purificatores processerunt et arcas coriaceas diversis coloribus in terram posuerunt.

unit.source: They then pulled up the red flannel cloth to cover both the humanoid Sealed Artifact and the classical bed together.
unit.target: Tum attulerunt pannum rubrum flannelum ut simul artificium sigillatum humanoidem et lectum classicum tegerent.

unit.source: The iron-gray steam robots also set down another leather case they were carrying.
unit.target: Automata vaporis ferri-cinereae etiam aliam arcam coriaceam, quam portabant, deiecerunt.

unit.source: They lifted the bed and, along with the Purifiers, left the quarry at a measured pace.
unit.target: Lectum levaverunt et, cum purificatoribus, lapicinium gradu mensurato reliquerunt.

unit.source: Soon, only Angoulême and the nine cases on the ground behind him remained.
unit.target: Mox tantum Angoulême et novem arcae, in terra post eum, remanserunt.

unit.source: At the edge of the quarry, enveloped in deep darkness, a figure dressed in assassin’s garb emerged.
unit.target: In margine lapicinii, in profunda tenebris involuta, figura induta vestimentis sicariis emersit.

unit.source: She did not speak to Angoulême but moved past the Purifier deacon to inspect the cases one by one.
unit.target: Non Angoulême locuta est; sed praeter diaconum purificatorum processit ut unaquaeque arcam inspiceret.

unit.source: Eight of the cases were either filled with shimmering gold bars or packed with numerous gold coins, all quite heavy, making Franca’s gaze seem disrupted by the gleam of gold.
unit.target: Octo arcae aut aureis laminis fulgentibus replebantur aut multiplicibus nummis aureis congestae erant; omnes gravia, ita ut aspectus Francae a splendore auri perturbatus videbatur.

unit.source: I’ve never seen so much gold in my two lifetimes combined… shame it’s not mine, Franca thought regretfully as she stowed the gold, valued at 1.2 million verl d’or, along with the cases into her Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Numquam tam multum auri in duabus vitae meis ambit numquam vidi… pudet quod non mihi pertineat, Franca, cum aurum – quod valorque 1.2 milliona “verl d’or” existimabatur – una cum arcae in sacculo Viatoris reponeret, paenite cogitavit.

unit.source: Another case contained the main and supplementary ingredients for the Pleasure potion and two folded scrolls.
unit.target: Alia arca continebat ingredientia principalia et supplementaria potionis Voluptatis atque duo volumina plicata.

unit.source: After verifying everything was correct, Franca nodded to Angoulême in a cold, businesslike tone befitting their professional relationship.
unit.target: Postquam cuncta recta esse comprobata sunt, Franca Angoulême annuit, tono frigido et negotioso, qui relationi eorum professionali convenit.

unit.source: “You keep your promises well.”
unit.target: “Promissa tua bene servas.”

unit.source: “I will continue to provide you with intel.”
unit.target: “Continuabo tibi indicia praebere.”

unit.source: “Praise the Sun, you are the God of Deeds!” Angoulême exclaimed, spreading his arms slightly in homage, attributing all glory and success to the deity.
unit.target: “Lauda Solem, deus operum es!” Angoulême exclamavit, bracchia leviter diffundens in honorem, omnem gloriam atque prosperitatem deo tribuens.

unit.source: Franca then left the quarry, continuously circling around and using her Demoness powers to erase any traces, countering any potential divination or prophecy.
unit.target: Deinde Franca lapicinium reliquit, continuo circumvolvens atque potentiam daemonissae suae ad vestigia delenda adhibens, divinationem vel vaticinium quemlibet contraria.

unit.source: After about seven or eight minutes, she met with Lumian in a secret tunnel in Underground Trier and was transported away by teleportation.
unit.target: Post circiter septem vel octo minuta, illa convenit cum Lumiano in tunnel secreto sub Treveris et per teleportationem translata est.

unit.source: Inside Apartment 702 at 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Intra Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numéro IX.

unit.source: Franca handed over the ingredients related to the Pleasure potion along with the leather case to Jenna, while Lumian was already seated on the armchair, engrossed in a reorganized dossier of the Sealed Artifact which wasn’t written in a fixed format.
unit.target: Franca tradidit ingredientia ad potionem Voluptatis pertinentia una cum arca coriacea Jennae, dum Lumian iam in solio bracchiali sedebat et in fasciculo reorganizato artificii sigillati, qui forma fixa non scriptus erat, occupatus erat.

unit.source: “Number: 1-147 “Original Name: Clémence Athana.
unit.target: “Numerus: 1-147 “Nomen Originale: Clémence Athana.

unit.source: “This Sealed Artifact was born in a magistrate’s family in Spahm Village, Zamet region of Upper Hornacis.
unit.target: “Haec Artificium Sigillatum in familia magistratus in vico Spahm, regione Zamet, in Hornaci Superiori nata est.

unit.source: “She was sent to the Zamet Cloister upon reaching adulthood and, two years later, entered Suhit University to study paleobiology.
unit.target: “Illa, cum adulescentiam attingisset, ad Zamet Cloister missa est et post biennium in Universitatem Suhit ingressa est ad paleobiologiam studendam.

unit.source: “After graduation, she stayed on as a faculty member.
unit.target: “Post lauream, illa ut membrum facultatis mansit.

unit.source: “Her research in paleobiology primarily focused on tracing the remnants of mythical creatures to prove their existence.
unit.target: “Investigatio eius in paleobiologia primario operatu versata est in vestigiis creaturarum mythicarum sequendis, ad earum existentiam demonstrandam.

unit.source: “At the age of twenty-nine, she abruptly resigned from her academic post and returned to her native village, where she secluded herself in her room.
unit.target: “Aetate viginti novem, illa subito munus academicum reliquit et ad vicum natale rediit, ubi se in conclavi suo reclusit.

unit.source: “Over the next two years, her family suffered a series of misfortunes:
unit.target: “Per duos annos sequentes, familia eius seriem calamitatum passa est:

unit.source: “Her father, intoxicated, fell into a cesspit at night and drowned; her mother, overcome with grief, hanged herself; her siblings killed each other over inheritance disputes; and her sister, who had gone home to intervene, went missing and was never found…
unit.target: “Pater eius, ebrius, noctu in cloacam cecidit et submersus est; mater eius, luctus oppressa, se suspinxit; fratres et sorores inter se in hereditatis contentione occiderunt; et soror, quae domum ad interveniendum redierat, evanuit et numquam reperta est…

unit.source: “The villagers of Spahm blamed her for bringing misfortune and sought to expel her.
unit.target: “Vicani Spahm eam culpaverunt pro calamitatibus attulitisque et eam expellere quaesiverunt.

unit.source: “Not long after, a strange mental plague broke out in the village.
unit.target: “Non longe post, insolitum pestis mentis in vico orta est.

unit.source: “By the time the Purifiers realized the issue, it was beyond redemption, and they had to purify all the infected…
unit.target: “Cum purificatores rem comprehenderunt, iam ultra redemptionem erat, et omnes infectos purgare debuerunt…

unit.source: “Further research indicated that Clémence Athana harbored two spirits within her, with her soul appearing stitched together.
unit.target: “Investigatio ulterius indicavit Clémence Athana duas spiritūs in se habere, cum anima eius quasi consutura appareret.

unit.source: “It is believed that one spirit orchestrated the tragedies of her family and the village’s infection, while the other, unable to cope, became muddleheaded yet fought back instinctively, eventually going mad…
unit.target: “Creditur unum spiritum cladem familiae eius et pestem vicani moderasse, dum alter, insufficiens ad sustinendum, in statu turbato versus sed instinctive repugnavit, denique insanivit…

unit.source: “Additionally, she carried another kind of corruption, distinct from her abilities to manipulate minds and spirits.
unit.target: “Praeterea, illa aliam speciem corruptionis tulerat, quae a facultatibus eius ad mentes et spiritūs regendos distincta erat.

unit.source: “It remains unclear when this corruption first appeared, whether before her return to her hometown or after the death of her parents…
unit.target: “Nondum clarum est, an haec corruptio primum apparuerit ante reditum ad oppidum natale eius vel post mortem parentum eius…

unit.source: “Sealed two years and four months ago.”
unit.target: “Sigillata abhinc biennium et quattuor menses.”

unit.source: “She was sealed not long ago. Among all Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, her number must be one of the latest,” Franca remarked, having appeared behind Lumian at some point, her elbows resting on the back of the armchair as she finished reading the dossier.
unit.target: “Non multo abhinc sigillata est. Inter omnia Artificia Sigillata Gradus I, numerus eius inter novissimos esse debet,” Franca dixit, apparens post Lumian aliquando, cum cubitis in dorso solii repositis, dum dossier perlegeret.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled softly after a pause.
unit.target: Lumian post pauco intervallo leniter subridens risit.

unit.source: “Perhaps one day, this will be my fate.”
unit.target: “Fortasse aliquando hoc fatum meum erit.”

unit.source: He could faintly sense Clémence Athana’s struggle and resistance, but she ultimately failed and became a monster.
unit.target: Subtiliter animadverti poterat certamen et resistentiam Clémence Athanae, sed illa tandem defecit atque in monstrum versa est.

unit.source: Franca opened her mouth, unsure of what to say.
unit.target: Franca os aperuit, nescia quid diceret.

unit.source: After a few seconds, she patted Lumian on the shoulder and said, “Look on the bright side, in the grand scheme of things, we’re all going to die. What matters is what we do on the path to death.”
unit.target: Post paucas secundas, illa Lumian in humero pulsavit et dixit: “Aspice latus serenum; in universa re omnes moriemur. Quod refert, id est quid in via ad mortem faciamus.”

unit.source: Lumian folded up the dossier, nodded solemnly, and responded, “Until death!”
unit.target: Lumian dossier conplectit, solenniter annuit, et respondit: “Usque ad mortem!”

unit.source: At 10 p.m., in the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight, members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society materialized in various locations.
unit.target: Hora decima post meridiem, in antiquo et ruentem palatio Nationis Semper Noctis, membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum in diversis locis apparuerunt.

unit.source: Franca immediately spotted 007, who was wearing the lion headgear.
unit.target: Franca statim repperit 007, qui galeam leonis gerebat.

unit.source: She adjusted her hood and approached, asking curiously, “We’ve received our reward. What’s yours?”
unit.target: Cucullum suum aptavit et accessit, curiosa rogans: “Praemium nostrum accepimus. Quid tuum est?”

unit.source: “007” Angoulême replied with mixed emotions, “I can now wield a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact with less severe adverse effects.”
unit.target: “007,” Angoulême respondit cum affectibus mixtis: “Nunc possum artificium sigillatum gradus I uti cum effectibus adversis minus gravibus.”

unit.source: “Wow, you’re basically on reserve for demigod status!” Franca exclaimed enviously.
unit.target: “O mirum, es re vera in reposito ad statum semidei!” Franca exclamavit invidens.

unit.source: Her thoughts then turned to Lumian, who also possessed a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact with minor negative effects, essentially putting him in the same reserve category.
unit.target: Deinde cogitavit de Lumiano, qui quoque artificium sigillatum gradus I cum effectibus adversis levibus posidebat, quod eum in eadem reposito categoria collocabat.

unit.source: Before Lumian embarked on the paths of the divine, 007 had already been a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian itinera divina inciperet, 007 iam Sequens 5 Beyonder fuit.

unit.source: He was just too busy to serve as vice president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, so he had never shared this with others.
unit.target: Tantopere occupatus erat ut vice praesidens Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum operaretur, ideo numquam hoc aliis enuntiavit.

unit.source: Thinking about it, 007 wasn’t really that enviable after all.
unit.target: Ruminans, 007 non vere tam invidendus erat.

unit.source: 007 glanced at Franca and said, “I used to dream of advancing to Sequence 4 and becoming a demigod, but as I handled more and more Beyonder events, I started to think that it might not be such a good thing. Sigh, fate has pushed me to this point; I can only keep moving forward.”
unit.target: 007 Francam intueri et dixit: “Olim somniabam me ad Sequentiam 4 progredi et semidei fieri, sed cum plura eventa Beyonder gesserim, incipiebam credere id non tam optimum esse. Heu, fatum me ad hunc locum impulit; solum pergere possum.”

unit.source: “Right,” Franca replied, feeling a sense of kinship. “I have a very important announcement to make soon.”
unit.target: “Recte,” Franca respondit, affecta sensu cognationis, “mox nuntium valde grave tradere habeo.”

unit.source: “What is it?” 007 couldn’t help but ask impulsively.
unit.target: “Quid est?” 007 impulsive rogavit.

unit.source: Why is Hidden Blade involved in an important matter again?
unit.target: Cur Hidden Blade iterum in re gravissima implicatus sit?

unit.source: What is it this time?
unit.target: Quid est hoc tempore?

unit.source: So far, the news she brought was crazier and more shocking one after the other!
unit.target: Hactenus, nuntii quae attulerat, alter post alterum insaniores ac mirabiliores erant!

unit.source: “You’ll find out soon enough.” Franca sighed.
unit.target: “Cito satis cognosces,” Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: She then looked towards Lumian, who was now disguised as Aurore, donning a warlock robe and a black hood, heading towards the Academy group’s gathering place.
unit.target: Deinde aspexit ad Lumian, qui nunc sub persona Aurore, toga magica et cucullo nigro indutus, ad locum conventus Academiae dirigebat.

unit.source: Lumian, in disguise, nodded gently at Franca.
unit.target: Lumian, sub specie mutata, leniter Francae annuit.

unit.source: Seeing that the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society had nearly all arrived, Franca walked directly to the massive stone chair.
unit.target: Cum vidisset membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum paene omnes advenisse, Franca recta ad magnam sellam lapideam processit.

unit.source: Dressed in a plain white robe and resembling a half-giant, Gandalf was nearby.
unit.target: Vestitus in simplice veste alba et semigianti similis, Gandalf prope adfuit.

unit.source: He whispered, “Are you going to warn everyone about the Mirror People?”
unit.target: Submurmuravit: “Num omnes de Hominibus Speculorum moneas?”

unit.source: “No,” Franca looked at Madame Hela standing on the other side and conjured a simple megaphone from the cold air.
unit.target: “Non,” Franca vidit Madame Hela in altera parte stantem et ex frigida aere megaphonum simplicem conjuravit.

unit.source: “Ladies and gentlemen, I have an announcement to make,” Franca’s voice echoed through the ancient and dilapidated palace.
unit.target: “Dominae et domini, nuntium habere habeo,” vox Francae per palatium antiqua et dilapidata resonabat.

unit.source: Members like Isotope, Bear, and Cerberus of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society turned their attention towards the depth of the palace to see who was speaking.
unit.target: Membra, ut Isotope, Ursus, et Cerberus Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum, attentionem converterunt ad interiora palatii ut perspexerent quis loqueretur.

unit.source: They suddenly felt uneasy.
unit.target: Subito male se sentiunt.

unit.source: The news Hidden Blade had brought before was never good!
unit.target: Nuntii quos Hidden Blade attulerat numquam bonos erant!

unit.source: Although she helped the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society clean up its internal saboteurs and established more reliable rules, avoiding foreseeable harm, the surging tide still left every participant unnerved.
unit.target: Quamquam illa Societati Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum internos sabotorēs purgare et regulas firmiores constituere adiuvit, ne damna praevidenda evenirent, fluctus tamen impetuosus omnes participes perturbavit.

unit.source: As everyone ceased their discussions and looked towards her, Franca cleared her throat and started from the rumors about Resurrection Island, recounting her encounter in the catacombs of Trier with a man bearing Eastern looks in their original world.
unit.target: Cum omnes sermones deseruerint et ad eam spectarent, Franca guttur purgavit et ab rumoribus de Insula Resurrectionis incipiens narravit conventum suum in catacumbis Treverorum cum viro vultum orientalem in mundo suo originali gerente.

unit.source: So, it’s about this… There’s a continuation of that incident? 007 relaxed slightly.
unit.target: Ita, de hoc est… Continuatio illius rei est? 007 leviter relaxatus est.

unit.source: A humming sound arose in different parts of the old palace, and members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society couldn’t help whispering among themselves.
unit.target: Sonus mugitus in diversis partibus veteris palatii orsus est, et membra Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispinorum inter se susurrare non potuerunt.

unit.source: For most of them, they had already accepted reality, adapted to their current lives, and even had different pursuits.
unit.target: Plerorum iam veritatem susceperant, ad vitam praesentem se accommodaverant, atque etiam varia studia habebant.

unit.source: But now, someone was telling them that the matter of transmigration still had secrets; maybe they could even go home!
unit.target: Sed nunc, aliquis eis narrabat rem transmigrationis adhuc arcana habere; fortasse etiam domum redire possent!

unit.source: Franca then spoke about Harrison of Resurrection Island, involved with death and dark forces, searching for something across the Northern and Southern Continents, but she didn’t mention Demon Warlock Burman—it was too easy to link that to the great adventurer Louis Berry.
unit.target: Deinde Franca de Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis locuta est, morte et tenebris implicato, quaerens aliquid per Continenta Septentrionalia et Australia, sed Demon Warlock Burman non commemoravit—nimis facile hoc ad magnum adventorem Louis Berry coniungere.

unit.source: In the sudden silence inside the palace, Franca shared her and Lumian’s speculation, “Resurrection Island might be a nexus where the two worlds converge.
unit.target: In subito silentio intra palatium, Franca speculatio sua et Lumiani communicavit: “Insula Resurrectionis fortasse nexus erit ubi duo mundi conveniant.

unit.source: “We must find Harrison and get information about Resurrection Island from him!”
unit.target: “Harrison invenire debemus et a eo de Insula Resurrectionis notitiam adipisci!”

unit.source: After speaking in one breath, Franca’s gaze slowly moved from the somewhat dazed faces of the audience to Madame Hela nearby.
unit.target: Post unum suspiri sermonem, oculi Francae lente ab faciebus paulo obnubilatis audientium ad Madame Hela prope stantem migraverunt.

unit.source: She noticed an indescribable emotion in the dark pupils visible behind Madame Hela’s black latticed veil.
unit.target: Animadvertit in obscuris pupillis, sub velamine nigro reticulato Madame Hela, affectum inenarrabilem.

unit.source: 755 Different Attitudes
unit.target: 755 Diversae Attitudines

unit.source: 755 Different Attitudes
unit.target: 755 Diversae Attitudines

unit.source: Despite Madame Hela’s usual restraint and calm, there are clear emotional ripples this time…
unit.target: Quamquam domina Hela solitam moderationem et tranquillitatem exerceat, hoc tempore evidentes tamen fluctus affectuum apparent…

unit.source: Franca thoughtfully withdrew her gaze.
unit.target: Franca, ratiocinandis, oculos suos avertit.

unit.source: By then, many members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society had regained their composure from the shock, voicing their opinions with both excitement and urgency.
unit.target: Iam multi ex membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis post stuporem suam aequabilitatem restituerunt, opinionesque suas simul cum excitamento et urgenza proferentes ediderunt.

unit.source: Someone shouted, “Hidden Blade, you can’t make such assumptions so lightly!”
unit.target: Quidam exclamavit: “Lamina Occulta, tales coniecturas tam leviter facere non potes!”

unit.source: Franca roared back immediately, “Whether or not Resurrection Island is a nexus between two worlds, we still need to find Harrison! This isn’t a conclusion; it’s a direction for our investigation!”
unit.target: Franca statim replicavit rugiens: “Sive Insula Resurrectionis nexus sit inter duos mundos sive non, adhuc Harrison reperire necesse est! Hoc non est conclusio; sed directio inquisitionis nostrae!”

unit.source: Another person yelled, “How can we find someone just based on a name?”
unit.target: Alia persona exclamavit: “Quomodo aliquem tantum ex nomine invenire possumus?”

unit.source: “I have his portrait!” Franca responded instantly.
unit.target: “Eum imaginem habeo!” Franca statim respondit.

unit.source: As members expressed their expectations, posed questions, and sought answers, a voice, slightly out of control, shouted, “Why can’t you just live peacefully in the present?”
unit.target: Dum membra suas exspectationes exprimebant, quaestiones proponebant, responsa quaerebant, vox, paulo perturbata, exclamavit: “Cur in praesenti tranquilliter vivere non potestis?”

unit.source: Franca looked towards the source of the sound and saw a male member known as Mole.
unit.target: Franca ad fontem soni respexit et virum membrum, qui Mole nominabatur, vidit.

unit.source: After Mole spoke up, several members loudly said, “I don’t want to risk everything for a slim hope.”
unit.target: Postquam Mole locutus est, plures membra alta voce dixerunt: “Nolo omnia pro tenuissima spe periclitari.”

unit.source: “Why can’t you give up these fantasies?”
unit.target: “Cur has phantasiās relinquere non potestis?”

unit.source: “I have no interest in returning to our previous world!”
unit.target: “Non cupio redire ad mundum nostrum priorem!”

unit.source: In response to the dissenting voices, Franca wasn’t surprised but internally sighed, People vary so much when you gather a hundred of them…
unit.target: Ad voces dissentientes Franca non mirata est, sed interius suspiravit: “Homines tam varii sunt, cum centum congregentur…”

unit.source: She sincerely responded, “Searching for Harrison and verifying the situation on Resurrection Island are both entirely voluntary. Those who want to uncover the truth about our transmigration can decide if it’s worth the risk. Those who aren’t interested can continue as before, but please don’t stop others from participating.”
unit.target: Sincere respondit: “Inquisitio ad Harrison quaerendum et status in Insula Resurrectionis perscrutatio omnino voluntaria sunt. Qui veritatem de nostra transmigratione detegere volunt, possunt decernere an periculum id referat. Qui non student, ut antea pergere possunt—sed quaeso, alios a participatione non prohibeatis.”

unit.source: Mole and others were clearly still worried that investigating Resurrection Island might disrupt their current lives, but with Franca offering the choice of “free will,” they could only mutter and retreat to the fringes.
unit.target: Mole et ceteri manifeste solliciti erant ne investigatio Insulae Resurrectionis vitam eorum praesentem perturbaret, sed cum Franca optionem “liberae voluntatis” offerret, solum murmure reticere ac ad latera recedere poterant.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, Franca added, “For now, our investigation into Resurrection Island is limited to gathering information. Do not go looking for it—it’s very dangerous. Once we obtain key information from Harrison, we’ll discuss whether or not to go to the island and how to approach it. Right now, let me show you Harrison’s portrait.”
unit.target: Occasione capta, Franca addidit: “Ad hoc tempus, nostra investigatio in Insulam Resurrectionis ad informationes colligendas tantum restringitur. Nolite eam quaerere—periculosissima enim est. Quam informationem clavis a Harrison obtineamus, de insula eundum atque de modo accessus rem disputabimus. Nunc, sinite me imaginem Harrisonis vobis ostendere.”

unit.source: Cheers erupted from some of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society members who had grasped the situation: “Hidden Blade is awesome!”
unit.target: Alii ex membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis, qui rem intellexerant, exclamaverunt: “Lamina Occulta praeclara est!”

unit.source: “Hidden Blade, I love you!”
unit.target: “Lamina Occulta, te amo!”

unit.source: “Praise be to Hidden Blade!”
unit.target: “Laudetur Lamina Occulta!”

unit.source: Franca chuckled and tilted her head, her worries and fears somewhat alleviated by the emotions of the crowd.
unit.target: Franca subridentem risit et caput inclinavit; sollicitationes et timores eius paulo levati erant per affectus turbae.

unit.source: She knew that these members were not without fear of the unknown results of the investigation and the potentially disappointing truths it might reveal, but they had waited too long and desired too much. Even a small glimmer of hope could temporarily relieve their pain and sorrow, releasing their excitement and joy.
unit.target: Sciebat hos membra non carere timore eventuum ignotorum inquisitionis atque veritatum fortasse deludentium, sed nimis diu exspectaverant atque nimis desideraverant. Etiam parva scintilla spei levare posset transitori dolore atque tristitia, excitamentum et gaudium eorum fovere.

unit.source: Franca then took a deep breath, pulled out Harrison’s portrait, and affixed it to the back of the massive stone chair.
unit.target: Franca deinde alte anhelavit, picturam Harrisonis extraxit, eamque ad tergum magnae sellae lapideae adfixit.

unit.source: “Everyone, take turns to come and take a look!” Franca called out, stepping back from the area around the speckled stone chair.
unit.target: “Omnes, vicissim venite et intuite!” Franca exclamavit, recedens a zona circa sellae lapideae maculatae.

unit.source: “Do you really think that’s a nexus between two worlds?” Gandalf stopped Franca, asking fervently.
unit.target: “Putatisne vere hoc esse nexum inter duos mundos?” Gandalf Francam sistens fervide rogavit.

unit.source: Franca smiled awkwardly. “It’s just a theory, still.”
unit.target: Franca ineleganter subridens respondit: “Modo theoria est, adhuc.”

unit.source: Gandalf nodded with satisfaction.
unit.target: Gandalf cum satisfactione caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “That’s no problem. Make bold assumptions, but verify them carefully.”
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio est. Coniecturas audaces facite, sed ea diligenter comprobate.”

unit.source: “What, in your opinion, is the relationship between Resurrection Island and our world?”
unit.target: “Quid, in tua sententia, est relatio inter Insulam Resurrectionis et mundum nostrum?”

unit.source: Franca asked Gandalf, both hopeful and nervous.
unit.target: Franca Gandalfum rogavit, spe et timore simul affecta.

unit.source: Gandalf chuckled. “I don’t have any predetermined conclusions yet; I need more information to study.”
unit.target: Gandalf ridente dixit: “Nullas conclusiones praefixas adhuc habeo; mihi plura ad studendum necessaria sunt.”

unit.source: Franca glanced around and lowered her voice.
unit.target: Franca circumspexit et vocem deiecit.

unit.source: She shared the existence of the Samaritan Women’s Spring, Underworld Daoist, and Celestial Master with President Gandalf, whom she and Lumian had decided to inform before attending this meeting—previously, they had only shared this with Hela. After all, they had worked together in the real world before.
unit.target: Ea de existentia Fontis Mulierum Samaritarum, Daoista Inferorum, et Magistri Caelestis cum Praeside Gandalf, quem illa et Lumian ante hanc conventum certiorem facere statuerant (ordinario modo hoc tum modo tantum cum Hela communicaverant), communicavit; quippe, olim in mundo reali una laboraverant.

unit.source: Gandalf listened attentively and made a judgment.
unit.target: Gandalf attente auscultavit et iudicium dedit.

unit.source: “The relationship between the two worlds might be closer than we anticipated.
unit.target: “Relatio inter hos duos mundos fortasse propius est quam putaveramus.

unit.source: “The phenomenon of transmigration may have started even earlier.”
unit.target: Phænomenon transmigrationis fortasse etiam prius inchoatum fuit.”

unit.source: Before Hidden Blade Franca could respond, the president of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society mused to himself, “With so many signs and traces, it’s incredible we haven’t encountered them, while you frequently do.”
unit.target: Antequam Franca, quae Lamina Occulta appellatur, responderet, Praeses Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis sibi meditatus est: “Cum tot signa et vestigia adsint, incredibile est quod eos non occurramus, dum vos eos frequenter invenitis.”

unit.source: This probably requires your praise for the True Creator.. Franca barely held back a sarcastic remark.
unit.target: Fortasse hoc exigit tuam laudem pro Vero Creatore… Franca vix retinuit rem sarcasticam.

unit.source: After parting from the half-giant Gandalf, she was cornered by the tall 007.
unit.target: Postquam ab semi-gigante Gandalf discessit, 007 altus eam in angulum conduxit.

unit.source: “We’ve yet to find the person who might be Harrison,” 007 simply reported on the previous “person-finding” efforts.
unit.target: “Nondum invenimus personam quae Harrison esse posset,” 007 de praeteritis conatibus inveniendi simpliciter nuntiavit.

unit.source: “Maybe he’s no longer in Trier.” Franca refrained from complaining about the Purifiers’ inefficiency.
unit.target: “Forsitan iam non in Trier sit.” Franca querelas de inefficientia Purificatorum abstinuit.

unit.source: She glanced at “007” in lion headgear and cautiously asked, “Would you want to return to our original world?”
unit.target: Aspicit “007” galeam leonis gerentem, et caute rogavit: “Visne ad mundum nostrum originarium redire?”

unit.source: 007 paused for a few seconds before replying, “Of course, but I’m afraid everything has changed.”
unit.target: 007 paucos secundos stetit antequam respondit: “Certe, sed timeo omnia mutata esse.”

unit.source: “Although the era from which Emperor Roselle transmigrated isn’t far from ours—if we returned now, we’d only miss a few days of life—no one has gone back yet, so we can’t be certain. Maybe the rules for coming and going are fundamentally different.”
unit.target: “Quamquam aetas ex qua Imperator Roselle transmigravit non longe a nostra est—si nunc redire mussemus, tantum paucos dies vitae amitteremus—nemo adhuc rediit, itaque certi esse non possumus. Forsitan regulæ ad ingressum et ad exitum fundamentaliter diversa sint.”

unit.source: Franca fell silent.
unit.target: Franca siluit.

unit.source: 007 glanced at Gandalf sitting on the steps, scribbling in a notebook, and asked Franca, “What did you discuss with the president? He seemed quite stirred.”
unit.target: 007 respexit ad Gandalf sedente in scalis, notis scribentem in schedula, et Francam rogavit: “Quid cum praeside disputavisti? Videbatur enim valde commotus esse.”

unit.source: Franca, managing her emotions, took the opportunity to share with 007 what she had told Gandalf.
unit.target: Franca, sensus suos moderans, occasionem cepit ut 007 narrarent ea quae ad Gandalf dixerat.

unit.source: “‘007’ Angoulême was stunned for a moment, then clenched his teeth and said, ‘Why didn’t you share this information sooner? What else haven’t you told us?’”
unit.target: “‘007’ Angoulême per momentum obstupefactus est, deinde dentes contraxit et dixit: ‘Cur has informationes non antea divulgavisti? Quid aliud nobis nondum narravisti?’”

unit.source: “I was just afraid you would really go all 007?” Franca joked, only to be met by a stern look from 007, which made her chuckle awkwardly. “Sometimes, it’s not that I don’t want to share; it’s either not the right time or I don’t have the permission.”
unit.target: “’Timui modo ne vere vos totum 007 ageretis?’ Franca iocata est, sed 007 vultum severum ostendens eam ineleganter subridere provocavit. ‘Non est quod nolo communicare; interdum tempus non idoneum est aut licentiam non habeo.’”

unit.source: I’m not Lumian, who has to squeeze out information like toothpaste—if I could tell, I would share everything… Franca added in her mind.
unit.target: “Non sum Lumian, qui notitias quasi pastae dentifrici exprimere debeat; si possem, omnia communicarem…” Franca in mente sua addidit.

unit.source: 007 knew that Hidden Blade might have joined a secret organization and understood her predicament. He took a couple of deep breaths to calm himself.
unit.target: 007 sciit Lamina Occulta fortasse societati secretae se adiunxisse atque eius condicionem intellexisse. Paucos graves spiritus cepit ad se tranquillandum.

unit.source: He mumbled to himself, “You all have found so many traces of another world beneath Trier; I can’t believe the two major churches that have watched over Trier for over a thousand years haven’t discovered anything.
unit.target: Murmuravit sibi: “Vos omnes tot vestigia alterius mundi sub Trier invenistis; incredibile est quod duo ecclesiae maximi momenti, quae Trier per plus quam mille annos custodiunt, nihil detexerint.

unit.source: “When I become a demigod, a senior deacon, maybe I’ll be allowed to look at those dossiers, right?”
unit.target: “Cum demideus fiam, senior diaconus, fortasse mihi documenta illa inspicienda licebit, nonne?”

unit.source: “Mmm, mmm,” Franca agreed repeatedly.
unit.target: “Mmm, mmm,” Franca iterumque assensit.

unit.source: In the corner where the Academy group gathered, Professor, Associate Professor, Principal, Isotope and others had all viewed Franca’s portrait of Harrison posted on the stone chair and were eagerly discussing related matters.
unit.target: In angulo, ubi coetus Academiae congregatus est, Professor, Professor Associatus, Principal, Isotope et alii omnes picturam Harrisonis a Franca in sella lapideae positam viderunt et ardenter de rebus pertinentibus disputabant.

unit.source: A woman with the periodic table painted on her face in washable paints asked those around her, “If we really find a way and a path back to our world, would you want to return?”
unit.target: Femina, cui facies tabula periodica in pigmentis lavabilibus picta erat, ab iis circum ea quaesivit: “Si vere viam atque iter ad mundum nostrum reperiamus, redire velitisne?”

unit.source: Professor and Associate Professor looked at each other and said, “If we can bring our children without having to leave anyone behind, we definitely hope to go back.”
unit.target: Professor et Professor Associatus se invicem respexerunt et dixerunt: “Si liberos nostros, sine aliquem relinquendo, adducere possimus, certissime redire speramus.”

unit.source: Principal, suspected of being a Sanguine, laughed.
unit.target: Principal, qui sanguine suspicabatur, risit.

unit.source: “If I could keep my Beyonder abilities, then I’d be willing to go back.”
unit.target: “Si facultates Beyonder meas retinere possem, redire paratus essem.”

unit.source: Isotope, with fake heads on each shoulder and wearing a mannequin headgear, chuckled.
unit.target: Isotope, cum ficta capita in singulis umeris atque galea manichina induta, subridens risit.

unit.source: “I have no attachments or affairs that a mere modern life could replace with the sense of accomplishment I’ve gained in this world; I don’t want to go back.”
unit.target: “Nihil mihi sunt vincula aut negotia, quae sola vita moderna, cum sensu perficiendi quem in hoc mundo adeptus sum, reponere possit; redire non volo.”

unit.source: “What about you, Muggle?” asked Periodic Table, turning to the quietly listening Lumian.
unit.target: “Quid de te, Muggle?” quaesivit Tabula Periodica, ad Luminum quiete auscultantem convertens.

unit.source: Lumian paused for a moment and said in the voice of Aurore, “That’s the place I long for day and night.
unit.target: Lumian paucos momentos stetit et, voce Aurore, dixit: “Illic est locus, quem die ac nocte vehementer desidero.

unit.source: “But I’d also like to take some people who are close to me with me.”
unit.target: “Sed etiam velim aliquos, qui mihi cari sint, mecum ducere.”

unit.source: After much discussion, the topics of “going home” and “Resurrection Island” finally cooled down, and as everyone naturally fell silent, Lumian lifted his beautifully curved chin and looked around, asking, “Does anyone know someone from the Moses Ascetic Order?”
unit.target: Post longam disputationem, argumenta “domum redire” et “Insula Resurrectionis” demum quieta sunt, et cum omnes naturaliter sileverunt, Lumian pulchre incurvato maxillo levavit atque circumspiciens rogavit: “Scit aliquis quemdam ex Ordine Asceticorum Moysium?”

unit.source: Suddenly, most members of the Academy group turned their gaze toward Muggle, observing her rosy lips and pale skin exposed outside her hoodie.
unit.target: Subito, plerique ex membris coetus Academiae oculos converterunt ad Muggle, animadvertentes labra eius rosea et cutem pallidam extra indumentum capuccinum.

unit.source: “Why are you asking this all of a sudden?” asked Professor wearing a butterfly bow tie.
unit.target: “Cur hoc subito interrogas?” rogavit Professor, ligamen papilionis gerens.

unit.source: The Academy group had many Warlocks and had exchanged information about the Moses Ascetic Order, so it wasn’t surprising that “Muggle” knew about this secret organization.
unit.target: Coetus Academiae multos warlockos habebat et informationes de Ordine Asceticorum Moysium commutaverat, itaque non mirum erat quod “Muggle” de hac societate secreta notum haberet.

unit.source: Lumian responded with a smile, “I want to pass a message to the Moses Ascetic Order that there’s a traitor among them.”
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Volo nuntium ad Ordinem Asceticorum Moysium transmittere: inter eos proditor est.”

unit.source: “A traitor?” Isotope and company listened, somewhat bewildered.
unit.target: “Proditor?” Isotope et ceteri audiverunt, aliquantulum attoniti.

unit.source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian said, “Have you heard of ‘Mirror People’?”
unit.target: Sine responsu directo, Lumian dixit: “Audivistisne de Populo Specularum?”

unit.source: According to Madame Hela’s latest statement, the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society who could enter the Nation of the Evernight through the spell were at most mentally disrupted or harbored corruption inside; it was unlikely that their life forms had changed without detection, so it could preliminarily be ruled out that there were any Mirror People lurking here.
unit.target: Secundum novissimam declarationem Dominae Helae, membra Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Capillis Crispis, quae per incantationem in Nationem Perpetuae Noctis ingredi poterant, aut perturbata mente maximi gradus erant aut corruptione interna affecta; minus verisimile erat ut formae vitae eorum sine detectione mutatae essent, itaque initialiter excludi posset ut ulli Populi Specularum hic latearent.

unit.source: “I’ve heard of it,” said Professor in a black half-face mask, nodding solemnly. “There have been occasional incidents of original hosts being replaced by their Mirror People, but why these Mirror People appear is still unknown, and perhaps the official Beyonders have the relevant information.”
unit.target: “Eum audivi,” inquit Professor, in masca nigra semi-faciali indutus, caput solemni animo inclinans. “Occasionalia casus sunt, in quibus hospes originalis a Populo Specularum substituitur; sed cur hi Populi Specularum apparere possint adhuc ignotum est, fortasseque Beyonderi officiales informationem pertinentem habent.”

unit.source: You seem to know quite a bit about the mystical world… Lumian’s lips curled up with a smile.
unit.target: Videtur te multa de mundo mystico scire… Labia Lumiani subridens convoluta erant.

unit.source: “I know a Mirror Person named Griffith who has replaced his original host, and his host was a member of the Moses Ascetic Order; of course, Griffith certainly isn’t the name he used in the Moses Ascetic Order.”
unit.target: “Scio personam specularum, Griffith nomine, qui hospitem suum originalem substituit, et cuius hospes membrum Ordine Asceticorum Moysium fuit; scilicet, Griffith certe non est nomen quod ille in Ordine Asceticorum Moysium usus est.”

unit.source: Members of the “Academy” group remained silent, simply nodding their heads.
unit.target: Membra coetus “Academiae” silentia retinuerunt, capita simpliciter inclinantes.

unit.source: Lumian did not continue the topic.
unit.target: Lumian rem non prosecutus est.

unit.source: Professor looked at her and ventured to ask, “Muggle, are you still in Trier?”
unit.target: Professor eam respexit et audenter rogavit: “Muggle, adhuc in Trier es?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Lumian responded with a smile.
unit.target: “Ita,” Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: Professor looked around and said, “I'm planning to organize a real‐world gathering for members in Trier soon; do you want to join? It will primarily involve our Academy group.”
unit.target: Professor circumspiciens dixerit: “Mox conventus realis pro membris in Trier constituendus mihi existimat; velisne te adiungere? Principiter coetum nostram Academiae involvet.”

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes flickered, and he smiled coyly. “Okay.”
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani micaverunt, et ille subridens respondit: “Okay.”

unit.source: 756 “Farm” Team
unit.target: 756 “Turma ‘Farm’”

unit.source: After finalizing the details of the real-world gathering through Madame Hela’s messenger, including the time, place, password, and method of the meeting, Lumian quietly listened to the members of the Academy group exchanging ideas, occasionally joining in the discussion.
unit.target: Postquam per nuntium Dominae Helae omnia singularia conventus–tempus, locum, tessera etiamque modum convocandi–confecit, Lumian tranquille auscultabat membra coetus Academiae, quorundam inter se ideas permutantium, interdum ipsius concipiens in disputationem.

unit.source: With his current mastery of mysticism, he no longer needed to hide his ignorance.
unit.target: Cum praesenti mysticismo dominio, amplius non opus erat suam ignorantiam celare.

unit.source: After a while, Lumian asked if anyone had the potion formula and related ingredients for the Harvest Priest, but the answer was no.
unit.target: Post aliquod temporis, Lumian rogavit utrum quisquam formam potionis atque ingredientia correlata Sacerdoti Messis haberet, sed responsum fuit “non.”

unit.source: He then walked over to another group near the ancient palace’s gate.
unit.target: Deinde ad alium coetum iuxta ianuam antiqui palatii ambulavit.

unit.source: Called the “Farm,” it was a group of Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society members who enjoyed planting and accumulating wealth.
unit.target: Vocatum “Farm,” erat coetus membrorum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispatorum, qui gaudebant in planta faciendis et divitias congregandis.

unit.source: Lumian had once overheard their everyday conversations about how many hectares they had purchased, their plans to save for a ranch, their forest harvests, the effectiveness of their compost, the Church of Earth Mother’s batch of modified wheat seeds suitable for arid regions, their growing savings, and how work brought them joy.
unit.target: Lumian olim auscultaverat cotidiana colloquia eorum de quantis hectaris emptionem fecerint, de consiliis pecuniam ad fundum conservandi, de messe silvestri, de efficacitate compostionis, de copia seminum tritici modificatorum a Ecclesia Matris Terrae aptorum ad regiones aridas, de pecuniis crescentibus atque de gaudio quod opus eis afferebat.

unit.source: After that, Lumian never eavesdropped again.
unit.target: Postea, Lumian numquam iterum furtim auscultavit.

unit.source: As he approached the Farm members, he smelled the earthy scents of soil, fertilizer, grass, grains, and livestock—a familiar and comforting aroma that transported him back to Cordu Village, back to his sister’s side.
unit.target: Dum ad membra “Farm” appropinquabat, olfactus terrae, fertilis, herbae, granorum, et pecorum eum movit ad Vicum Cordu, ad sororis eius latum—aroma notum atque solatorem.

unit.source: The experienced Lumian instantly became alert.
unit.target: Lumian peritus statim alertus factus est.

unit.source: This… reminds me of life in Cordu for one thing, but on another level, the acts of farming, herding, and harvesting resonate with the Omebella bloodline within me.
unit.target: Hoc … mihi memoriam revocat vitae in Cordu ex una parte, sed alio modo opera agriculturae, pecuandi, et messei cum sanguine Omebella in me resonant.

unit.source: The Goddess of Harvest is indeed living up to Her name; as expected of the Great Mother’s Child of God…
unit.target: Dea Messis vere nomini suo congruit; ut exspectatur a prole Magnae Matris Dei…

unit.source: Lumian quickly figured out the reason.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter causam cognovit.

unit.source: Although consuming the remnants of Omebella’s umbilical cord hadn’t enhanced his powers or abilities, it had attracted the Great Mother’s gaze, allowing creatures She had created or blessed to sense his bloodline, though it hadn’t been without effect.
unit.target: Licet edendi reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae eius potentias nec facultates auxisset, tamen oculum Magnae Matris attraxit, sinens creaturas quas illa creaverat aut benedixerat sanguinem eius percipere, etiamsi hoc non effectu vacuus fuit.

unit.source: Omebella’s residual bloodline subtly altered his perceptions of certain things, indirectly affecting his psyche.
unit.target: Residua stirps sanguinis Omebellae subtiliter mutavit eius perceptiones quorundam rerum, indirecte afficiens animum eius.

unit.source: As Lumian listened to the Farm group members discussing, he keenly observed each person’s reactions.
unit.target: Dum Lumian membra coetus “Farm” disputantia audiebat, perspicue singulorum responsa observavit.

unit.source: Although only creatures lacking necessary intellect would mistake him for a child of the Great Mother, those who had received the Great Mother’s boons or were directly created by Her could sense the Omebella bloodline in him, though they wouldn’t misidentify him.
unit.target: Licet tantum creaturae intellectu carentes eum pro prole Magnae Matris confundere possent, illi vero qui beneficia Magnae Matris acceperant aut a Ea directe creati erant, sanguinem Omebellae in eo percipere poterant, nec eum errone cognoscentes.

unit.source: This would help Lumian determine through any unusual reactions among the Farm group members whether they covertly worshiped the Great Mother.
unit.target: Hoc Lumiano auxilium praebebit ut, ex reactionibus insolitis inter membra “Farm”, intellegat num occulte Magnam Matrem colerent.

unit.source: After a few minutes, Lumian tentatively confirmed that none of the Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society members in this area were problematic.
unit.target: Post pauca minuta, Lumian tentative confirmavit nullum ex membris Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispatorum in hac regione esse problematicum.

unit.source: He then mimicked Aurore’s voice when she pressed her voice down, looked around, and asked, “Does anyone have the Harvest Priest’s potion formula or related ingredients? If you’re unwilling to disclose the formula, you could sell me a ready-made Harvest Priest potion.”
unit.target: Deinde, vocem Aurore imitans—cum illa vocem deprimebat et circumiensque aspiciens—rogavit: “Habesne quisquam formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis aut ingredientia correlata? Si formam non revelare velitis, potesne mihi vendere potionem paratam Sacerdotis Messis?”

unit.source: “Muggle, I thought you were a ‘Warlock,’” a Farm group member called “Breeder Master” asked, puzzled.
unit.target: “Muggle, putabam te esse ‘Warlock’,” inquit membrum coetus “Farm”, qui nominabatur “Magister Fecundator”, perplexus.

unit.source: He was tall with a rugged, wild demeanor and wore a primitive tribal mask made from animal fur.
unit.target: Erat altus, habitu rudo et ferocio, et indutus larva tribalis primitiva ex pelibus animalium facta.

unit.source: “I know someone who needs it,” Lumian laughed, “and I thought I might make a small profit while helping out.”
unit.target: «Scio aliquem cui hoc necessarium sit,» risit Lumian, «et putavi me posse parvum lucrum adipisci simul cum auxilio dando.»

unit.source: Breeder Master further inquired, “You should know that a ready-made potion needs to be consumed quickly before it is absorbed by the container and becomes a Sealed Artifact with strong negative effects. Moreover, trading through Madame Hela’s messenger would delay things. You have to drink it immediately upon receipt. Will there be no issues?”
unit.target: Magister Fecundator interrogavit: “Scire debes potionem paratam celeriter consumi, antequam vas eam absorbeat et fiat Artifactum Signatum cum effectibus negativis validis. Insuper, negotiatio per nuntium Dominae Helae res morabitur; statim eam bibendum est cum recipis. Nonne omnia bene erunt?”

unit.source: Madame Hela’s messenger sure is busy… Lumian teased inwardly. “No problem.”
unit.target: Nuntius Dominae Helae certe valde occupatus est… Lumian intimo iocose dixit: “Nulla quaestio.”

unit.source: After questioning and observing, he was sure that the Doctor potion from Lugano had been fully digested.
unit.target: Postquam quaesivit et observavit, certus fuit potionem “Doctor” ex Lugano plene digestam esse.

unit.source: This was a Doctor who had treated an Angel and fake Angel!
unit.target: Hic erat Doctor, qui Angelum atque Angelum simulatum curaverat!

unit.source: After Ludwig was brutally beaten by Loki, it was Lugano who had treated and healed his wounds.
unit.target: Postquam Ludwig a Loki saevissime verberatus est, Lugano vulnera eius curavit et sanavit.

unit.source: Lumian himself had received Lugano’s treatments on multiple occasions.
unit.target: Lumian ipse pluribus occasionibus curationes Lugani accepit.

unit.source: After contemplating for a moment, Breeder Master said, “20,000 gold risot for a ready-made Harvest Priest potion.”
unit.target: Post brevem meditationem, Magister Fecundator dixit: “20,000 risot aurei pro potione parata Sacerdotis Messis.”

unit.source: “It’s pricier than just buying the ingredients separately, but we have to respect intellectual property rights. Normally, I’d charge between 30,000 and 35,000, but since we’re all members of the society…”
unit.target: “Hoc pretiosius est quam singillatim ingrediens emere, sed oportet iura intellectualis proprietatis observare. Plerumque inter 30,000 et 35,000 exigere possem, sed cum omnes sodales sumus societatis…”

unit.source: About 40,000 verl d’or, Lumian nodded slightly in agreement.
unit.target: Circa 40,000 verl d’or, Lumian leviter annuit consentiens.

unit.source: “No problem.”
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio.”

unit.source: He already had 19,000 gold risot in bills and coins on him, so he made an upfront payment of 10,000, agreeing to pay the balance upon receipt of the potion.
unit.target: Iam 19,000 risot aurei in schedulis et nummis habebat, itaque 10,000 praeposuit, pollicitus reliquum solvere ad recipiendam potionem.

unit.source: They brought in 007 from the Sanctuary group to notarize the agreement.
unit.target: Invocaverunt 007 ex coetu Sanctuarii ad pactum notarizandum.

unit.source: “Pleasure doing business,” said Breeder Master with a smile to Muggle as he pocketed the deposit.
unit.target: “Voluptas negotii,” inquit Magister Fecundator cum risu ad Muggle, dum depositum in sinu suo reponit.

unit.source: He then turned to other members of the Farm group and exclaimed, “Now I have the funds for more experiments! I’ve been studying those mushrooms created by the legendary Druid Frank Lee. I find his philosophy intriguing and worth following.
unit.target: Deinde ad ceteros membra coetus “Farm” conversus exclamavit: “Nunc facultatem habeo ad ulteriora experimenta agendum! Illos fungos, quos creavit druid legendarius Frank Lee, studui; philosophiam eius iucundam atque sequendam puto.

unit.source: “Given the myriad supernatural beings in this world, including Beyonders, why not merge the blood, flesh, milk of these beings with ordinary plants? Whether through hybridization or genetic modification, with the aid of mystical powers, it can be done relatively easily, and after several generations, the traits stabilize, resulting in plants with magical effects but no Beyonder characteristics…”
unit.target: “Propter multitudinem entium supernaturalis in hoc mundo, inter quos Beyonders, cur non sanguinem, carnem, et lac horum cum plantis ordinariis coniungere possimus? Sive per hybridationem sive modificationem geneticam, cum auxilio potestatum mysticarum id facile perferri potest, et post aliquot generationes proprietates stabilis fiunt, efficiendo plantas effectibus magicis sed sine notis Beyonder…”

unit.source: As Lumian listened, a strange unease began to form within him.
unit.target: Dum Lumian audiebat, in eo inchoavit inexplicabilis inquietudo.

unit.source: He never felt this way even when discussing death-related topics with the Purgatory group!
unit.target: Numquam talem sensum habuit, etiam cum de rebus mortis pertinentibus cum coetu Purgatorii dissereret!

unit.source: The first time he heard the name Frank Lee was in the Cordu Village dream, where an official Beyonder named Ryan mentioned a saying that circulated at sea: “I’d rather come face to face with Pirate Admirals or even Kings than run into a bloke named Frank Lee.”
unit.target: Prima vice nomen Frank Lee audivit in somnio Vici Cordu, ubi officialis Beyonder, Ryan, locutus est: “Mallem me conspectu habere cum Admiralis Piratarum aut etiam Regibus, quam incidere cum viro qui ‘Frank Lee’ appellatur.”

unit.source: Later, when Lumian was at sea, he heard no rumors about Frank Lee, nor did he know if Ryan was exaggerating in the dream or if those who knew of Frank Lee’s deeds dared not or chose not to mention him again.
unit.target: Postea, cum Lumian in mari esset, rumores de Frank Lee non audivit, neque scivit an Ryan in somnio exaggeraverit aut an qui de gestis Frank Lee noverant, non ausi aut noluerint eum iterum commemorare.

unit.source: Sanctuary team.
unit.target: Coetus Sanctuarii.

unit.source: Franca looked towards a member nicknamed “Someone” and asked with a smile, “Weren’t you looking for the Marauder pathway Sequence 5 Dream Stealer’s Beyonder characteristic? Still need it? I just got one from a friend.”
unit.target: Franca respexit ad membrum, cui vulgo “Someone” dictus erat, et cum risu rogavit: “Nonne quaerebas proprietatem Beyonder viae Marauder, Sequenciae 5 Dream Stealer? An tamen opus est? Modo ab amico unum accepi.”

unit.source: “If you don’t want it, I’ll go to an Artisan to craft a mystical item with that Beyonder characteristic.”
unit.target: “Si id non vis, ad Artificem ibo ut rem mysticam cum illa proprietate Beyonder conficiam.”

unit.source: Someone, wearing an eyepatch-style black half-face mask, sized up Franca and replied, “It seems your friend isn’t you.”
unit.target: “Someone,” indutus larva nigrae semi–faciei, Francam aestimavit et respondit: “Videtur amicus tuus non esse tu.”

unit.source: “I don’t need it anymore, but wouldn’t mind another.”
unit.target: “Iam non mihi opus est, sed alterum bene acciperem.”

unit.source: “One flat rate, 5000 pounds.”
unit.target: “Unum pretium fixum, 5000 librarum.”

unit.source: That’s about 120,000 verl d’or… Franca laughed and said, “200,000 verl d’or, not a coin less.”
unit.target: Id fere est 120,000 verl d’or… Franca risit et inquit: “200,000 verl d’or, nec nummus minus.”

unit.source: Someone calculated for a moment and countered, “150,000 verl d’or at best, or forget it.”
unit.target: “Someone” paulisper computavit et dixit: “Optime 150,000 verl d’or, aut omitte.”

unit.source: Franca thought for a few seconds and said, “You can pay in two installments, the first right now of 120,000 verl d’or, and the second of 60,000 within three months of receiving the Beyonder characteristic, secured by 007’s notarization to enforce the contract.”
unit.target: Franca paulisper meditata, dixit: “Potes solvere in duas stipulationes: primam nunc 120,000 verl d’or, et secundam 60,000 intra tres menses ab obtinendo proprietate Beyonder, sub notarizatio 007 ad pactum confirmandum.”

unit.source: Someone paused to think, then asked with a smile, “Aren’t you worried I’ll default after getting the Beyonder characteristic? A Notary’s notarization isn’t foolproof, remember, I was once a renowned Swindler.”
unit.target: “Someone” paulisper suspensa cogitavit et, cum risu, rogavit: “Nonne timebis me deficere postquam proprietatem Beyonder accepero? Notarii notarizatio non est infallibilis, memento, olim fama fraudatoris mihi aderat.”

unit.source: Franca smiled. “Who’s better, you or Bard?”
unit.target: Franca subridet: “Quis melior est, tu an Bard?”

unit.source: Someone fell silent.
unit.target: “Someone” tacuit.

unit.source: “Bard has already been dealt with by me and my comrades. Unless you’re willing to give up a very useful trading platform over 60,000 verl d’or, I’m not worried about you defaulting, your Beyonder characteristics are also quite valuable.” Franca, who had mafia ties, made her intimidating remark as casually as discussing what’s for dinner.
unit.target: “Bard iam a me et sociis meis tractatus est. Nisi paratus es tradere suggestum commercii valde utilem pro 60,000 verl d’or, non timeo te deficere; proprietates Beyonder tuae quoque sunt pretiosissimae.”

unit.source: “It won’t be long before I surpass him,” replied Someone after a few seconds, “Deal!”
unit.target: “Non multum erit antequam eum superem,” respondit “Someone” post paucos secundos, “Pactum!”

unit.source: “No rush,” Franca said with a smile, “The final payment must be in gold.”
unit.target: “Nulla festinatio,” inquit Franca cum risu, “ultima solutio in auro esse debet.”

unit.source: In the following days, Lumian had no particular business and wandered around Trier, tracking several Mirror People and looking for Harrison’s whereabouts based on intelligence provided by 007.
unit.target: In diebus posthac, Lumian negotium singulare non habebat et per Trier errabat, persequens nonnullos Homines Speculares atque quaerens locum Harrison ex informationibus a 007 datis.

unit.source: He was supposed to collect a reward from Mr. K, but his heart resisted, and he kept delaying.
unit.target: Eum exspectabat ut mercedem a Domine K colligeret, sed cor eius repugnavit atque moraturus permanevit.

unit.source: Franca completed her transaction with Someone from the Sanctuary group, receiving a down payment composed of bills and coins totaling 5000 pounds.
unit.target: Franca mercaturam suam cum “Someone” ex coetu Sanctuarii perfecit, accipiens solutionem initialem ex schedulis et nummis quae totaliter 5000 librarum constabant.

unit.source: She also gave Jenna 15,000 verl d’or in bills, stipulating that the remaining payment of 60,000 verl d’or in gold belonged entirely to her.
unit.target: Ea etiam Jennae 15,000 verl d’or in schedulis dedit, statuens quod reliqua solutio de 60,000 verl d’or in auro ad eam omnino pertineret.

unit.source: Jenna lost the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic but also paid off the 45,000 verl d’or she owed Franca, now possessing 16,000 verl d’or and gold Loen pound worth 120,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Jenna proprietatem Beyonder Dream Stealer amisit, sed simul 45,000 verl d’or, quos Francae debebat, solvit, atque nunc possidet 16,000 verl d’or et libram auri Loen valoris 120,000 verl d’or.

unit.source: She had never been so wealthy before.
unit.target: Numquam antea tam dives fuisset.

unit.source: She always knew that potion formulas and Beyonder characteristics were valuable and even knew their approximate price range, but she had never paid in full in one go nor truly sold any until now.
unit.target: Semper sciebat formulas potionum et proprietates Beyonder pretiosas esse atque etiam earum pretium circiter cognovisset, sed numquam totum solutum nec vere venditum fecerat usque ad hunc diem.

unit.source: Now she was experiencing what it felt like to earn money like the Pirate Hunter Gehrman Sparrow.
unit.target: Nunc experiebatur quomodo esset argentum mereri sicut Piratarum Venator Gehrman Sparrow.

unit.source: That evening, just as Lumian returned to his rented apartment planning to change his clothes and muster the courage to see Mr. K, the wall lamp in his room suddenly tinged with eerie green and pale colors.
unit.target: Illo vespera, cum Lumian ad conductum suum rediret, consilium habens vestimenta mutare et animos colligere ut Dominum K videat, lucerna parietalis in cella eius subito viridi obscuro atque pallidis coloribus tincta est.

unit.source: They blended bizarrely together.
unit.target: Inusitate simul miscebantur.

unit.source: Then, Lumian saw his messenger, the mummified Penitent in a black clergy robe, emerge from the void.
unit.target: Tum Lumian vidit nuntium suum, Penitentem mummificatum in veste clericali nigra, ex nihilo emergere.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Madame Hela’s messenger, a skull made of pure silver, appeared shrouded in darkness.
unit.target: Fere simul, nuntius Dominae Helae—calvaria ex argento puro facta—apparuit in tenebris involuta.

unit.source: Shortly after, the silhouette of a doll messenger rapidly took shape.
unit.target: Post breve intervallum, umbra nuntii pupae celeriter formam cepit.

unit.source: Lumian was somewhat stunned.
unit.target: Lumian paulo stupefactus fuit.

unit.source: Would the messengers fight each other?
unit.target: Num nuntii inter se pugnabunt?

unit.source: Do! have three letters?
unit.target: “Do!” tres litteras habet?

unit.source: One should be for the Harvest Priest potion, another likely a Sealed Artifact made from the Beyonder characteristics of Hisoka, but what about the third?
unit.target: Unum ad potionem Sacerdotis Messis pertineat, alter probabiliter ad Artifactum Signatum ex proprietatibus Beyonder Hisokae, sed quid de tertio?

unit.source: 757 Harvest Priest
unit.target: 757 Sacerdos Messis

unit.source: As Penitent Baynfel and the pure silver skull appeared, the doll messenger, dressed in a pale gold mini dress, instantly floated beside Lumian as if confronting the other two messengers.
unit.target: Cum Penitent Baynfel et cranium argenti puri apparuerunt, nuntia pupula, induta parva veste aurea pallida, statim iuxta Lumian volavit, quasi ceteros duos nuntios opponens.

unit.source: The pure silver skull set down a burlap bag on the desk from its mouth amidst the surrounding darkness, then fixed its burning pale eyes on Lumian.
unit.target: Cranium argenti puri, ex ore suo, sacculum linteum in mensa inter circumiectas tenebras posuit et deinde oculos ardentes pallidos in Lumian fixit.

unit.source: Penitent Baynfel dropped a folded letter and silently returned to the spirit world, vanishing from the room.
unit.target: Penitent Baynfel epistolam plicatam deiecit et tacite ad mundum spirituum rediit, e conclavi evanescens.

unit.source: Lumian wanted to take this opportunity to chat with his messenger about his past and ask about his relationship with the True Creator, but given the circumstances, he had to suppress his curiosity and focus on the pure silver skull instead.
unit.target: Lumian hanc occasionem capere volebat, ut cum nuntio suo de praeteritis colloqueretur et de sua relatione cum Verace Creatore rogaret; sed ob circumstantias curiositatem suam reprimere oportuit et in cranium argenti puri impendere.

unit.source: Lumian picked up the burlap bag, which resembled a book bag, and pulled out an aluminum flask.
unit.target: Lumian sacculum linteum, quod saccum librorum simile apparebat, levavit et amphoram aluminii extraxit.

unit.source: Behind him, the doll messenger floated closer, curiously looking on.
unit.target: Post eum, nuntia pupula propius volavit, curiosa spectans.

unit.source: Lumian unscrewed the grayish‐white flask to find a golden liquid inside, brimming with white foam.
unit.target: Lumian amphoram cinereo–albida aperuit ut liquidum aureum intus inveniret, spumante albo abundans.

unit.source: If it weren’t for the lack of a malty scent, he would have thought it was beer.
unit.target: Nisi malti odor aberat, putavisset eam cerevisiam esse.

unit.source: He took out a piece of paper from the burlap bag, written in ancient Feysac by Madame Hela: “It is indeed the Harvest Priest potion.
unit.target: E sacculo linteo chartam extraxit, in antiqua Feysac a Madame Hela scriptam: “Vere est potio Sacerdotis Messis.

unit.source: “It needs to be drunk within 15 minutes, or you will end up with a alcohol flask that could bring harvests.”
unit.target: In quindecim minutis bibenda est, alioquin eris cum amphora alcoholica, quae messes afferre possit.

unit.source: Seeing that Madame Hela had helped with the identification and there was a notarized contract in place, Lumian immediately took out the remaining 9000 gold risot from his Traveler’s Bag and the 1000 gold risot notes he had exchanged in the last two days.
unit.target: Videns quod Madame Hela identificationi adfuerat et pactum notariatum exstabat, Lumian statim reliquos 9000 risotos aureos ex Sacculo Viatoris sui ac notae de 1000 risotos aureos, quas per proximos duos dies permutaverat, extraxit.

unit.source: “This is the final payment.”
unit.target: "Hoc est solutio finalis."

unit.source: Lumian put the gold risot into the burlap bag and handed it to the skull made of pure silver.
unit.target: Lumian risotos aureos in sacculum linteum posuit et illos cranio argenti puri tradidit.

unit.source: The pure silver skull bit down on the burlap bag, merged with the surrounding darkness, and disappeared in an instant.
unit.target: Cranium argenti puri in sacculo linteo mordens, cum circumiectis tenebris commiscutum, momento evanuit.

unit.source: Lumian then turned his head and said with a smile to the doll messenger, “What’s your take?”
unit.target: Tum Lumian caput convertit et, cum risu, nuntiā pupulā dīxit: “Quid censes?”

unit.source: The doll messenger snorted.
unit.target: Nuntia pupula sputavit.

unit.source: “I will surpass them eventually!
unit.target: “Eos tandem superabo!”

unit.source: “I will become the first, no, the second most powerful messenger in this world!”
unit.target: “Ego primus, immo secundus, nuntius potentissimus in hoc orbe fiam!”

unit.source: “Quite ambitious,” Lumian replied, half-seriously, half in jest.
unit.target: “Valde ambitiosum,” respondit Lumian, semiserio atque semiludente.

unit.source: He wasn’t surprised by the doll messenger’s response; he already knew about the special nature of Penitent Baynfel and the pure silver skull.
unit.target: Non miratus est responsum nuntiāe pupulae; iam noverat de natura speciali Penitent Baynfel et cranii argenti puri.

unit.source: The doll messenger then hurled a dark, translucent orb, resembling a crystal ball but more ethereal, towards Lumian, who easily caught it.
unit.target: Deinde nuntia pupula globum obscurum et translucidum, globum crystallinum similem sed magis aetherium, in Lumian iaculatus est, qui facile apprehendit.

unit.source: Inside the bent, transparent barrier, a glossy black bone ring floated, its surface carved with the twisted, agonizing face of a demon, whose eyes contained two vague shadows.
unit.target: Intra flexum, transparentem vallum, anulus ossis nigri lucidi fluitabat, cuius superficiem facies daemonis contorta et laboriosa incisa erat, cuos oculi duo umbrae vagi complebantur.
