unit.source: After letting the folded letter fall to the surface of the desk, the doll messenger also left Lumian’s room.
unit.target: Postquam epistola plicata in superficiem mensae cecidit, nuntia pupula etiam conclave Lumiani reliquit.

unit.source: It is indeed a Sealed Artifact made from Hisoka’s Beyonder characteristics… Lumian couldn’t afford to check the artifact’s effects and impacts right away, so he stored the dark transparent orb and the folded letter first, and then began to read the letter brought by his messenger.
unit.target: Revera, hoc est artefactum sigillatum ex qualitatibus Beyonder Hisoka factum… Lumian effectus et ictus artefacti statim inspicere non potuit, itaque globum obscurum translucidum et epistolam plicatam primum condidit, deinde incipiebat legendum epistolam a nuntio suo adlatam.

unit.source: The letter was very brief: “Seven of Wands: “Do you still remember your promise? We now need your help.
unit.target: Epistola brevissima erat: “Septem Baculi: Num adhuc promissionem tuam meministi? Nunc auxilio tuo indigemus?

unit.source: “If you don’t have other important matters recently, please meet us at the following coordinates, where I will tell you the details.”
unit.target: “Si alias res magni momenti nuper non habes, quaeso, conveni nobiscum in locum consignatum, ubi tibi singula exponam.”

unit.source: “Knight of Swords.”
unit.target: “Eques Gladii.”

unit.source: Knight of Swords needs help… Lumian came to a realization.
unit.target: Eques Gladii auxilio indiget… Lumian hoc intellexit.

unit.source: In the incident of the sea prayer ritual, he had asked this Minor Arcana card holder, working under Ma‘am Hermit, for help.
unit.target: In casu rituum orationis maritimae, hunc tenorem chartae Minor Arcanae, sub Domina Hermit operantem, auxilium petivit.

unit.source: At the time, he did not ask for a payment but mentioned that he might need a bit of help if he went to the Southern Continent, to which he readily agreed.
unit.target: Tunc pecuniam non petivit, sed indicavit se parum auxilio indigens fore, si ad Continens Meridionalis perveniret, ad quod facile consensit.

unit.source: Fortunately, I’m relatively free lately. Lumian put away the letter from the Knight of Swords, screwed the cap back on the grayish-white flask, and walked out of the room with it in hand.
unit.target: Fortunate, nuper satis liber erat. Lumian epistolam a Eques Gladii receptam deponit, operculum super amphoram cinereo–albidem iterum adfixit, et e conclavi eam manu tenens egrediebatur.

unit.source: Lugano was cleaning up the plates and cutlery that Ludwig had left behind.
unit.target: Lugano patinas et instrumenta, quae Ludwig reliquit, purgabat.

unit.source: “Your Harvest Priest potion has arrived,” Lumian stated calmly.
unit.target: “Potio Sacerdotis Messis tua advenit,” inquit Lumian tranquille.

unit.source: Lugano froze, a look of confusion washing over his face.
unit.target: Lugano stetit, vultu confusione afflato.

unit.source: After a few seconds, he pointed to the flask in his employer’s hand and asked, “This?”
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, ad amphoram in manu domini sui indicavit et rogavit: “Hoc?”

unit.source: “Yes, it looks more drinkable than the potions from the Hunter pathway,” Lumian chuckled as he shook the flask. “You have ten minutes to decide whether you want to drink it.”
unit.target: “Ita, potabilius videtur quam potiones viae Venatoris,” inquit Lumian subridens, dum amphoram concutiebat. “Decem minuta habes ut decernas num eam bibas.”

unit.source: “Ten minutes?” Lugano exclaimed, startled.
unit.target: “Decem minuta?” exclamavit Lugano, perterritus.

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “No, eight minutes.
unit.target: “Non, octo minuta.

unit.source: “If you haven’t made up your mind in eight minutes, I’ll find a stray dog downstairs or catch a rat and feed it this potion.”
unit.target: “Si in octo minutis animum non constitueris, canem vagum deorsum inveniam aut rattum capiam et illi potionem impingam.”

unit.source: “Don’t I need to prepare mentally and physically?” Fear was written all over Lugano’s face.
unit.target: “Nonne opus est mihi praeparatio mentis atque corporis?” Timor in vultu Lugani apparuit.

unit.source: This seems too casual, doesn’t it?
unit.target: Hoc nimis leviter videtur, nonne?

unit.source: This is a potion, after all!
unit.target: Potio est, postremo!

unit.source: If his mental and physical state weren’t right, he could either turn into a monster or die on the spot!
unit.target: Si status mentis atque corporis eius non rectus esset, vel in monstrum verti posset vel statim morire.

unit.source: “Only seven minutes left now,” Lumian reminded with a smile. “Your condition is fine; you just need to relax and remember that you are Ludwig’s nanny and family doctor.”
unit.target: “Nunc tantum septem minuta restant,” inquit Lumian cum risu. “Status tuus rectus est; solum oportet te relaxare et meminisse te esse nutrice Ludwig et medicum familiaris.”

unit.source: “Is that really okay?” Lugano still couldn’t believe it.
unit.target: “Num ita revera licet?” Lugano adhuc id credere non potuit.

unit.source: “Six minutes,” Lumian said coldly.
unit.target: “Sex minuta,” inquit Lumian frigide.

unit.source: “..” Lugano was stunned.
unit.target: “…” Lugano attonitus erat.

unit.source: How could time pass so quickly?
unit.target: Quomodo tempus tam celeriter transire potuit?

unit.source: Gritting his teeth, he replied, “Alright! But I need to drink it in Underground Trier.”
unit.target: Dentes strinxit et respondit: “Recte! Sed id in Trier Subterraneo bibere mihi oportet.”

unit.source: “Hmm?” Lumian raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: “Hmm?” Lumian supercilium elevavit.

unit.source: Lugano quickly explained, “I feel that standing on the earth helps me maintain my state while drinking the potion.”
unit.target: Lugano celeriter explicavit: “Sento quod in terra stans mihi auxilium ferre permittit ut statum meum teneam dum potionem bibo.”

unit.source: “The Earth pathway, huh…” Carrying the grayish-white flask, Lumian turned and walked out of the room.
unit.target: “Iter Terrae, hm…” portans amphoram cinereo–albidem, Lumian se vertit et e conclavi abiit.

unit.source: Lugano followed, pulling out a bunch of banknotes from his pocket.
unit.target: Lugano secutus est, et ex sinu copiam chartarum argentariarum extraxit.

unit.source: “This is all my savings, 15,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: “Haec sunt omnia pecuniae meae, 15,000 verl d’or.

unit.source: “You said before, the rest would be covered by you.”
unit.target: “Tu ante dixisti reliqua a te soluta fore.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded nonchalantly and accepted the 15,000 verl d’or without hesitation.
unit.target: Lumian non curans annuit et 15,000 verl d’or sine mora accepit.

unit.source: He still had 86,000 verl d’or, including a few coins and gold bars.
unit.target: Adhuc 86,000 verl d’or habebat, inter quos nonnulli nummi et laminae aureae erant.

unit.source: Once on the street, Lumian headed directly to the nearest entrance to Underground Trier.
unit.target: Cum in platea esset, Lumian statim ad proximam introitum Trier Subterranei profectus est.

unit.source: A stray dog passed by, barking as if to threaten them.
unit.target: Canis vagus transibat, latrans quasi eos minaretur.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and “tested” Lugano, “Can you understand what it’s saying?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens et Lugano “probavit” dicens: “Potesne intellegere quid dicat?”

unit.source: With his mind full of thoughts about the Harvest Priest potion, Lugano asked in astonishment, “Y-you can understand? Do you have a mystical item from a Beast Tamer?”
unit.target: Mentem plenam rerum de potione Sacerdotis Messis habens, Lugano stupens rogavit: “P–potesne intellegere? Habesne rem mysticam a Domitore Bestiarum?”

unit.source: Lumian laughed to himself. “It says, ‘I heard you’re going to feed me a portion of the Harvest Priest potion; why haven’t you given it to me yet?’”
unit.target: Lumian sibi interius risit: “Dicit: ‘Audivi te portionem potionis Sacerdotis Messis mihi adferre; cur eam mihi nondum tradidisti?’”

unit.source: “..” Lugano then realized his employer was joking.
unit.target: “…” Tum Lugano intellexit dominum suum iocari.

unit.source: On second thought, Lugano felt like he was being mocked by his employer.
unit.target: Postera cogitans, Lugano sensit se a domino suo derisum esse.

unit.source: He’s implying that I’m a stray dog!
unit.target: Implicat me esse canem vagum!

unit.source: I was indeed wondering why he hasn’t given me the Harvest Priest potion yet…
unit.target: Vere mirababar cur adhuc potionem Sacerdotis Messis mihi non dederit…

unit.source: Once in Underground Trier, Lumian expertly navigated to a deserted tunnel and tossed the grayish-white flask at Lugano.
unit.target: Cum in Trier Subterraneo esset, Lumian peritus ad tuniculum desertum profectus est et amphoram cinereo–albidem ad Lugano iecit.

unit.source: As Lugano fumbled to catch the flask, Lumian coldly reminded, “Two minutes left.”
unit.target: Dum Lugano amphoram apprehendere conabatur, Lumian frigide admonuit: “Duo minuta restant.”

unit.source: Lugano took a deep breath, unscrewed the cap, and saw the potion inside that looked like beer.
unit.target: Lugano altum spiritum traxit, operculum deprimens, et potionem intus vidit, quae cerevisiam similis erat.

unit.source: He began to recall how he had cared for and treated Ludwig, using this memory to slightly relax his tense spirit.
unit.target: Coepit recordari quomodo Ludwig curaverat, hanc memoriam ad levandam animum suum tensum adhibens.

unit.source: After a few seconds and two deep breaths, Lugano raised the grayish-white flask and gulped down the potion.
unit.target: Post paucos secundos et duas profundae spiratus, Lugano amphoram cinereo–albidem elevavit et potionem ingurgitavit.

unit.source: Lumian, who made a ball of bright white flame as a light source, silently watched, observing the various changes in Lugano’s body.
unit.target: Lumian, qui globum flammae albae nitidae ut lucis fons confecit, silentiose spectabat, varias mutationes in corpore Lugani observans.

unit.source: He had not forgotten that his “servant” was quite unusual; he could stay conscious during the Dream Festival!
unit.target: Non oblitus erat quod “servus” eius valde insolitus esset; poterat in Festa Somniorum conscire manere!

unit.source: Lugano’s face quickly twisted in agony, as if experiencing the pain of Ludwig biting off his arm again.
unit.target: Facies Lugani celeriter in dolore contorta est, quasi iterum dolorem, quem Ludwig in brachio suo mordendo afferebat, experiri posset.

unit.source: Lumian saw his feet slowly sinking into the soil, the hairs on his exposed skin visibly thickening and lengthening, and his brown hair doing the same, his brown eyes losing focus.
unit.target: Lumian vidit pedes eius lente in terram mergi, pilos in cute patefacta manifeste densari et longari, et capillos fuscos idem agere, oculosque fuscos sensu confusione amittere.

unit.source: After a while, the transformations stopped, and Lugano’s expression gradually eased.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, transformationes cessaverunt, et vultus Lugani paulatim lenitus est.

unit.source: It went smoothly… He fits the Planter pathway well… I’m not sure if this is due to his own anomalies… Lumian muttered silently, watching as Lugano’s eyes slowly regained clarity and reason.
unit.target: Leniter procedebat… Iter Plantatoris eum optime convenit… Nescio utrum his ipsius singularitatibus sit… Lumian tacite submurmuravit, dum oculi Lugani lente claritatem atque rationem recipere videbantur.

unit.source: He asked in a relaxed posture, “What abilities have you gained?”
unit.target: In statu relaxato rogavit: “Quas facultates acquisivisti?”

unit.source: Although it was frowned upon in the mystical world to inquire about the details of someone’s Beyonder abilities, who could be blamed because the person across from him was his “servant”?
unit.target: Quamquam in mundo mystico fastidiebatur de subtilitatibus facultatum Beyonder alicuius inquisire, quis enim reicere posset, cum persona adversa esset eius “servus”?

unit.source: Lugano saw no problem with this, checking his condition while savoring the acquired mystical knowledge.
unit.target: Lugano in hoc nullum problema invenit, statum suum perscrutans et sapientiam mysticam adeptam degustans.

unit.source: “My healing capabilities have expanded. I can now cure diseases in plants and fields…
unit.target: “Facultates curandi meae ampliatae sunt. Nunc morbos in plantis et agris sanare possum…

unit.source: I can also catalyze seeds, making them grow or reproduce faster.
unit.target: Etiam semina accelerare possum, ita ut celerius crescant vel reproduci queant.

unit.source: This divides into two scenarios: the first is placing both hands on the earth, which allows seeds and plants within a thirty‐meter radius to grow or reproduce much faster than normal, though not instantaneously complete their lifecycle from gestation to returning to the land in a few seconds or minutes. The second is directly holding some seeds or plants and fully catalyzing the life contained within them.
unit.target: Hoc in duas casus dividitur: prima, utras manus in terram ponendo, quae sinit semina et plantas intra spatium triginta metrorum celerius quam solito crescere vel reproducere (non tamen statim totum eorum vitae cyclum a genesis ad terram reditionem perficere); secunda, semina vel plantas directe tenendo et vitam intus plenarie accelerando.

unit.source: “The latter scenario allows me, in a very short time, to create a large amount of vines, which can be used to entangle and control enemies.”
unit.target: “Secunda casus mihi sinit, brevissimo tempore, multas vitis creare, quae hostes implicare et regere adhiberi possint.”

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian thoughtfully asked, “So you can only fully catalyze the life contained within plants, and it can’t be used on humans?”
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian cogitans rogavit: “Ita solum vitam in plantis contentam plene accelerare potes, et non in hominibus adhiberi potest?”

unit.source: “No.” Lugano shook his head.
unit.target: “Non,” inquit Lugano, caput concussit.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “If you encounter a creature that is essentially a plant but has intelligence, could you, by direct contact, cause all of its life to burst forth in seconds or tens of seconds, completing its entire life cycle?”
unit.target: Lumian continua: “Si invenias creaturam, quae maxime planta sit sed intelligentiam habeat, potesne, per contactum directum, totam eius vitam in paucis aut decem secundis erumpere, totumque vitae cyclum perficere?”

unit.source: “First, I’d need to be able to touch it…” Lugano indicated that this was dangerous and not something he, not specialized in combat, could manage.
unit.target: “Primum, attingi illud mihi posse necesse est…” Lugano significavit hoc periculosum esse atque rem, quam ipse, non pugnandi artibus instructus, tractare non possentem.

unit.source: He added, “Plus, I’m not sure it would have the effect you’re imagining.”
unit.target: Adiecit: “Praeterea, non certo scio se effectum tibi concipiendum habere.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly, signaling Lugano to continue.
unit.target: Lumian fere imperceptibiliter annuit, indicans Lugano ut prosequeretur.

unit.source: Lugano gathered his thoughts and said, “If I could obtain seeds of different mutant plants, my catalytic abilities could play a significant role in combat.
unit.target: Lugano cogitationes suas colligens dixerit: “Si semina plantarum mutantarum diversarum adipisci possem, facultates accelerationis meae partes maximas in pugna agere possent.

unit.source: “I can also command plants and insects within a thirty‐meter radius to provide me with appropriate support, as long as it does not exceed their species limitations. However, intelligent ones won’t work.
unit.target: “Etiam plantas et insecta intra spatium triginta metrorum imperare possum, ut mihi subsidium idoneum praebeant, dummodo fines speciei eorum non excedantur; sed quae intelligentiam habent non sufficiunt.

unit.source: “I’ve also gained a few ritual spells, mainly for summoning rain or clearing the skies.”
unit.target: “Etiam nonnullas incantationes rituales accepi, praecipue ad pluviam evocandam aut caeli purgationem.”

unit.source: 758 Devil’s Whispers
unit.target: 758 Susurri Diaboli

unit.source: 758 Devil’s Whispers
unit.target: 758 Susurri Diaboli

unit.source: This really leans towards the concept of harvest…
unit.target: Hoc vere ad notionem messis inclinatur…

unit.source: If I could obtain seeds from magical plants or be in an environment dominated by magical plants and special insects, the Harvest Priest’s combative abilities using mystical means wouldn’t be too bad; they might even be impressively effective…
unit.target: Si semina ex plantis magicis adipisci possem aut in ambitu, quo plantae magicae et insecta specialia dominantur, versari, facultates pugnantium Sacerdotis Messis per modos mysticos non essent pessimae; fortasse etiam mirabiliter efficaces fiebant…

unit.source: The Beyonder ability to directly catalyze plants to unleash their full life force has vast imaginative possibilities.
unit.target: Facultas extramundana, quae plantas directe impellit ad plenam vim vitae eorum liberandam, vastas possibilitates phantasiae praebet.

unit.source: Unfortunately, a Harvest Priest’s direct combat ability is limited.
unit.target: Infeliciter, facultas directa pugnae Sacerdotis Messis limitata est.

unit.source: If Lugano were a Sealed Artifact and I were to use it, things would be completely different…
unit.target: Si Lugano artifactum sigillatum esset et id uterer, res omnino aliter se gerebunt…

unit.source: Amid these thoughts, Lumian looked at Lugano and asked, “Have there been any enhancements to your body?”
unit.target: Inter has cogitationes, Lumian ad Lugano respexit et rogavit: "Num in corpore tuo aliqua melioramenta fuerunt?"

unit.source: "There are some, but not many," Lugano replied honestly.
unit.target: "Nonnulla sunt, sed non multa," respondit Lugano honestē.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and pulled out a letter from his pocket sent along with Hisoka’s Sealed Artifact from Madam Magician, reading it with the aid of the bright white light orb floating above his head.
unit.target: Lumian annuit et epistulam ex sinu suo extraxit, quae cum artifacto sigillato Hisoka a Domina Magician missa erat, auxilio orbis lucentis albae, qui supra caput eius fluitabat, legens.

unit.source: "Temporarily named: Devil’s Whisper.
unit.target: "Ad tempus nominatum: Susurro Diaboli.

unit.source: Positive effects:
unit.target: Beneficia:

unit.source: 1. Devil’s Arm:
unit.target: 1. Bracchium Diaboli:

unit.source: To minimize the negative effects and make it easy to use, the Beyonder ability of this bone ring is reduced.
unit.target: Ut effectus negativos minuantur et usus facilius fiat, facultas extramundana huius anuli ossei diminuitur.

unit.source: Originally Devil Transformation targets the entire body, it now only affects the arm wearing Devil’s Whisper.
unit.target: Initio Transformātiō Diaboli totum corpus inficiebat, nunc solum bracchium, quod Susurro Diaboli gerit, afficit.

unit.source: It causes the arm to swell, darken, and sprout sinister patterns, as if covered with a thick layer of armor.
unit.target: Illud facit ut bracchium tumescat, obscuretur, atque exempla sinistra emergant, quasi crassa lorica tegeret.

unit.source: The flesh becomes highly elastic and resistant, minimizing damage.
unit.target: Caro vehementer elastica et resistentia fit, ita damna minuens.

unit.source: The arm in question becomes immune to most poisons, resistant to curses and fire to a certain degree, and significantly stronger.
unit.target: Id bracchium plurimis venenis immunis fit, maledictis et igne ad certum gradum resistente, ac valde fortius efficitur.

unit.source: 2. Malice Perception:
unit.target: 2. Perceptio Malitiae:

unit.source: For the same reason, Malice Perception granted by this ring only helps you sense whether people around you bear ill will towards you, not to detect looming dangers.
unit.target: Propter eundem rationem, perceptio malitiae a hoc anulo concessa solummodo tibi prodest intuendi an homines circa te malevolentiam gerant, non imminentia pericula detegendi.

unit.source: Make do with it.
unit.target: Suscipe illud.

unit.source: 3. Desire Incarnation:
unit.target: 3. Incarnatio Desiderii:

unit.source: This is a power I specifically requested the Artisan to emphasize, sacrificing the chance to obtain other powerful effects.
unit.target: Haec est vis quam ab Artifice specialiter petivi ut eminere faceretur, renuntians occasione ad alias potentias effectus consequendos.

unit.source: Moreover, to ensure its full manifestation, I agreed to slightly increase the ring's negative effects.
unit.target: Insuper, ad plenam eius manifestationem efficendam, consentivi paulo augere effectus negativos anuli.

unit.source: It can transform your body into a shadowy black liquid composed of various emotions and desires, helping you avoid damage, conceal your movements, and affect your enemies.
unit.target: Potest corpus tuum in liquidum atrum umbratile, ex variis affectibus et cupiditatibus compositum convertere, quod tibi damna vitare, motus celare, et inimicos afficere adiuvat.

unit.source: This sounds quite useful, but is it worth my special request to the Artisan?
unit.target: Hoc videtur satis utile, sed num valet speciali petitioni meae ad Artificem?

unit.source: You’ll understand why once you use it.
unit.target: Intellies cur, simul ut id uteris.

unit.source: Upon reading this, Lumian muttered to himself, ‘So, by suppressing the reduced negative impacts of the first two positive effects, some of the impact has returned in the Desire Incarnation ability? What makes it so special for Madam Magician to do this?’
unit.target: Hoc lectum, Lumian sibi submurmuravit: "Ita, minuendo effectus negativos parvos duorum primorum effectuum positivorum, aliquantum ictus in incantatione Desiderii restitutus est? Quid hoc facit ita speciale ut Domina Magician id efficat?"

unit.source: Lumian didn’t rush to experiment and continued reading.
unit.target: Lumian ad experimenta non festinavit et lectionem continuavit.

unit.source: 4. Wraith Shriek
unit.target: 4. Clamor Umbrae

unit.source: By rubbing the demon relief on the ring’s face and emitting a loud sound, you can create an effect similar to Wraith Shriek that can rupture the eardrums of living beings and harm their spirits.
unit.target: Levando imaginem daemonis in facie anuli et sonum acutum emittens, effectum simile Clamori Umbrae creare potes, quod membrana auralis viventium frangere et animas laedere potest.

unit.source: The closer they are to you, the better the effect.
unit.target: Quo propius tibi adsunt, eo melius effectus est.

unit.source: Negative effects:
unit.target: Effectus negativos:

unit.source: After wearing it, your malice will become more pronounced.
unit.target: Post id gestum, malitia tua magis manifesta fiet.

unit.source: If you can’t control yourself and indulge in malice, you’ll gradually slip into the Abyss and eventually be controlled by the malice of this ring, meaning, if you indulge in malice while wearing it, you will become its puppet, and it will be the driver, you the driven.
unit.target: Si te ipsum regere non potes et in malitiam indulgeas, paulatim in Abyssum lapsurus eris et tandem a malitia huius anuli dominaberis, id est, si dum id geris in malitiam indulgeas, eius mancipulum fies, et ipse moderator erit, tu subiectus eris.

unit.source: While it’s not that a single indulgence in malice will result in being controlled, it’s hard for humans who have tasted the sweet lure of malice not to continue.
unit.target: Cum non sit quod una indulgentia in malitiam statim dominari incipiat, difficile tamen est hominibus, qui dulcedine malitiae gustaverunt, non perseverare.

unit.source: According to my estimates, the conspicuous malice combined with the existing negative effects of the contract ability will negate all your endurance from Ascetic and your own willpower, making you unable to withstand further emotional and desire stimuli.
unit.target: Secundum aestimationem meam, malitia manifesta cum effectibus negativis facultatis contractae totam tolerantiam ex Ascetismo et tuam ipsius voluntatem delebit, efficiendo ut impulsus affectuum et cupiditatum ulteriores ferre non possis.

unit.source: Moreover, whether worn or not, just carrying it will cause your body to suffer burns from sulfur flames, both internally and externally.
unit.target: Praeterea, sive id geris sive non, solum illum portans corpus tuum ex flammis sulfuris, tam internis quam externis, conflagrabit.

unit.source: Placing it in the Traveler’s Bag can effectively mitigate this effect.
unit.target: Illud in sacco viatoris ponere hunc effectum efficaciter mitigare potest.

unit.source: As a Pyromaniac who has reached Sequence 5, you can withstand these burns for a longer period, but be mindful of the sulfur’s toxic effects and treat it promptly.
unit.target: Ut pyromaniacus, qui Sequenciam Quintam attigit, has comburitiones diuturnius ferre potes, sed memento effectuum toxicorum sulfuris et celeriter curare.

unit.source: Furthermore, including yourself, people within a hundred meters radius will be subtly influenced by the Devil’s Whisper, more prone to ill thoughts and impulsive actions.
unit.target: Praeterea, te ipsum includens, homines intra centum metrorum radii subtiliter a Susurro Diaboli influentur, inclinati ad cogitationes malévolas et actus impulsivos.

unit.source: This can also be mitigated by placing it in the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Hoc quoque mitigari potest, si in sacco viatoris reponatur.

unit.source: The rest is okay, but after wearing Devil’s Whisper, my emotions and desires will become my greatest weaknesses…
unit.target: Res cetera bene sunt, sed postquam Susurro Diaboli geretur, affectus et desideria mea maximae infirmitates erunt…

unit.source: Lumian assessed this Sealed Artifact from Hisoka.
unit.target: Lumian hoc artifactum sigillatum a Hisoka aestimavit.

unit.source: Its sealing is relatively simple, requiring only spatial isolation.
unit.target: Eius sigillatio relativam simplicem habet naturam, qua solummodo separatio spatii requiritur.

unit.source: Combined with Lumian’s strong endurance, he could totally use it as a mystical item.
unit.target: Cum robusta tolerantia Lumiani conjuncta, illud omnino uti poterat ut rem mysticam.

unit.source: Lumian then pulled out the pitch-black bone ring, wrapped in a dark transparent barrier, from another pocket.
unit.target: Lumian de altera coscina extraxit anulum osseum nigrum, in obscuro vehiculo translucido involutum.

unit.source: He pressed his hand against the sphere and slowly reached inside.
unit.target: Manum contra sphaeram premens, lente intus pervenit.

unit.source: His right hand felt like it was moving through a dense swamp, struggling to touch the ring.
unit.target: Manus dextra eius videbatur quasi per densam paludem moveretur, luctans anulum attingere.

unit.source: At the same time, the dark sphere silently crumbled, unfolded on its own, and merged with the surrounding void.
unit.target: Simul, sphaera obscura silentio corruens, se ipsa dissipavit, et cum vacuum circumiectum commiscuit.

unit.source: Lumian then slipped Devil’s Whisper onto his left index finger.
unit.target: Lumian deinde Susurro Diaboli in digito indice sinistro induit.

unit.source: His body suddenly liquefied and became ethereal.
unit.target: Corpus eius subito liquefactum est et quasi aethericum evanescens factum est.

unit.source: He turned into a pool of thick black liquid.
unit.target: In stagnum liquoris densi nigri convertebatur.

unit.source: Lugano, who only glanced at him, shivered uncontrollably, chilled to the bone as if he had seen the most sinister and hidden desires and emotions deep within the human heart.
unit.target: Lugano, qui eum tantum inspexit, vehementer tremuit, frigidus ad ossa, quasi vidisset obscurissima et abscondita desideria ac affectus, in profundo corde humano latentia.

unit.source: The newly-advanced Harvest Priest impulsively asked Lumian, who had just returned to human form from a black liquid state, “When can we return to the surface?”
unit.target: Novus et progressus Sacerdos Messis impetuoso animo Lumiano interrogavit, qui modo ex statu liquoris nigri in formam humanam rediit: "Quando ad superficiem redire possumus?"

unit.source: Lumian gave him an icy glance, his blue eyes seemingly harboring a darkness that no light could penetrate.
unit.target: Lumian ei gelidum intuitum dedit, oculis caeruleis quasi tenebras latentibus, quas nullum lumen penetrare posset.

unit.source: Lugano shuddered violently, a familiar fear creeping back as he stuttered, “J-just asking.”
unit.target: Lugano vehementer tremuit, timore noto reveniente, dum balbutiens dixit: "M-Modo quaero."

unit.source: Lumian cracked a slightly mad smile and slowly removed the Devil’s Whisper, placing it back into the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian leviter insanus subridens, Susurro Diaboli lente removebat et in sacco viatoris reponit.

unit.source: He now understood why Madam Magician had specifically requested this ability.
unit.target: Nunc intellexit cur Domina Magician specialiter hanc facultatem postulavisset.

unit.source: His desires and emotions were not entirely his own!
unit.target: Desideria et affectus eius non omnino proprii erant!

unit.source: A smaller part of his emotions and desires stemmed from his fate linked to Termiboros, from the residual aura of the Blood Emperor, and from the bloodline of Omebella.
unit.target: Pars minor affectuum et desideriorum eius orta est ex sorte sua coniuncta cum Termiboros, ex aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, et ex stirpe Omebellae.

unit.source: Normally, these would only affect him, but using Desire Incarnation, these emotions and desires could be materialized and thus exert some influence on the outside world and his enemies.
unit.target: Normaliter haec solum eum afficerent, sed per Incarnationem Desiderii, affectus et desideria illa materiali fieri possent ac ita extra mundum et adversarios suos influere.

unit.source: If I were to envelop a Sequence 4 Saint in the Desire Incarnation form, that demigod would likely suffer from the corresponding emotional and desire corruption…
unit.target: Si Sainctum Sequenciam Quartam in forma Incarnationis Desiderii complexerero, ille semideus verisimiliter corruptionem affectuum ac cupiditatum correspondens pati fore videbatur…

unit.source: But this method of attack means I’m forgoing evasion to face the backlash head-on, Lumian mused briefly, fairly satisfied with this Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Sed hoc modus oppugnationis significat me evasionem relinquere ut ictum retributivum directe oppugnem, Lumian breviter meditatus est, satis de hoc artifacto sigillato contentus.

unit.source: Facing a demigod, evasion was sometimes futile—better to fight it out!
unit.target: Oppugnans semideum, evasio interdum frustra fuit—melius est pugnare!

unit.source: And both the Sword of Courage and Devil’s Whisper gave him that chance.
unit.target: Et Gladius Fortitudinis atque Susurro Diaboli illi hanc occasionem dederunt.

unit.source: When night fully descended, Lumian arrived at the headquarters of the Psychic magazine, located at 19 Rue Scheer in Avenue du Boulevard, and met Mr. K in the basement.
unit.target: Cum nox plene descendit, Lumian ad praeses ephemeris Psychicae, sita in 19 Rue Scheer in Avenue du Boulevard, pervenit et Dominum K in subterraneo convenit.

unit.source: Mr. K, wearing a wide hood, warmly said, “Let us pray to the Lord first.”
unit.target: Dominus K, pallio lati indutus, calide dixit: "Primum ad Dominum oramus."

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly and closed his eyes.
unit.target: Lumian leniter annuit et oculos clausit.

unit.source: His thoughts tightly wrapped, not drifting outward.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius strictissime contentae erant, neque extra se disfluebant.

unit.source: After a while, he and Mr. K opened their eyes simultaneously.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, ipse atque Dominus K simul oculos aperuerunt.

unit.source: Mr. K, with a hoarse but fervent voice, said, “Congratulations, you are now a candidate Oracle.”
unit.target: Dominus K, voce rauca sed fervida, dixit: "Gratulamur, nunc candidatus Oraculi es."

unit.source: “This is the greatest reward, being closer to the Lord is the greatest reward for us!”
unit.target: "Id est maximum praemium; propinquitas ad Dominum nobis summum est praemium!"

unit.source: “Afterwards, wherever you go, you can contact the local Oracles or members of the Aurora Order, followers of the Lord, to request their help.”
unit.target: "Postea, ubicumque pergis, poteris contactum habere cum Oraculis localibus aut membris Ordinis Aurorae, Domini fautoribus, ad auxilium petendum."

unit.source: “If there are no Saints or Oracles locally, you have the authority to call upon all resources there, including personnel, money, intelligence, and materials.”
unit.target: "Si Sancti aut Oracula locali non adsunt, auctoritatem habes omnes opes, inter quas sunt homines, pecunia, intelligentia, et materia, evocandi."

unit.source: Is this the Aurora Order’s reward, elevating my authority and status?
unit.target: Num hoc praemium Ordinis Aurorae est, quod auctoritatem ac dignitatem meam extollit?

unit.source: Lumian made the sign of the cross over his chest and said in a hoarse voice, “Praise you for creating all. Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
unit.target: Lumian crucem super pectus suum signavit et voce rauca dixit: "Laudo te quod omnia creasti. Laudo te quod peccata mundi sustinuisti!"

unit.source: Mr. K nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Dominus K contentus annuit.

unit.source: “There are no other rewards for now, let’s continue to investigate the matter of the vortex.”
unit.target: "Non sunt alia praemia pro tempore; pergamus rem vorticis investigare."

unit.source: "Okay," Lumian quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
unit.target: "Bene," Lumian leniter suspiravit levationis causa.

unit.source: If Mr. K had offered material rewards, he would have hesitated to accept them.
unit.target: Si Dominus K praemia materialia obtulisset, dubitaverit ea accipere.

unit.source: It’s not that he was worried about the items themselves being marked by that entity; after all, he was already under surveillance, so a little more wouldn’t make a difference.
unit.target: Non quidem de ipsis rebus sollicitus erat, ut ab illa entitate notarentur; iam enim sub vigilantia erat, ideo parva amplius non differebant.

unit.source: His reluctance was more psychological.
unit.target: Eius haesitatio magis psychologica fuit.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and then informed Mr. K, “I might be heading to the Southern Continent again soon to wrap up some previous matters, not sure how long I’ll need.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus deinde Dominum K certiorem fecit: "Fortasse mox iter faciam ad Continens Meridionalem, ut aliqua negotia praeterita conficiam; nescio quamdiu opus erit."

unit.source: "Alright," Mr. K nodded gently, "Which area specifically?"
unit.target: "Optime," Dominus K leniter annuit, "Quae regio praecipue?"

unit.source: "Not sure yet," Lumian answered truthfully.
unit.target: "Nondum certus," Lumian veraciter respondit.

unit.source: He really didn’t know.
unit.target: Vero nesciebat.

unit.source: Mr. K didn’t inquire further.
unit.target: Dominus K ultra non interrogavit.

unit.source: "We have Saints and Oracles on the Southern Continent, and many followers of the Lord operating secretly there. Once you determine the specific location, I can help you contact the person responsible for that area."
unit.target: "Sanctos et Oracula in Continens Meridionali habemus, atque multos Domini fautores ibi occulte operari. Quoties locum precisum statuas, possum te iuvare, ut contactum habeas cum eo, qui illius regionis curae praefuit."

unit.source: "Thank you, Mr. K," Lumian said, expressing his gratitude.
unit.target: "Gratias tibi, Domine K," Lumian dixit, gratiam suam exprimens.

unit.source: Mr. K corrected him, "No need for thanks; we are all Oracles now, not being equals is disrespectful to the Lord."
unit.target: Dominus K eum corrigens dixit: "Nulla gratia opus est; omnes nunc Oracula sumus, et inaequales esse Dominum contumeliant."

unit.source: Lumian was momentarily speechless.
unit.target: Lumian per momentum mute erat.

unit.source: He casually asked, "Mr. K, that cathedral you took me to last time, does it have any significant meaning within our Aurora Order?"
unit.target: Levis animo interrogavit: "Domine K, illa cathédralis, quam me adduxisti tempore ultimo, num aliquam significationem in Ordine Aurora habet?"

unit.source: Mr. K replied fervently, "That was the first cathedral established by our Aurora Order."
unit.target: Dominus K fervide respondit: "Illa prima cathédralis a nostro Ordine Aurora instituta est."

unit.source: Is it related to Baynfel?
unit.target: Num ad Baynfel pertinet?

unit.source: Lumian asked a few more indirect questions from different angles, then took his leave.
unit.target: Lumian alias quaestiones indirectas ex diversis angulis rogavit, deinde discessit.

unit.source: Returning to Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, he informed Franca and Jenna about the Knight of Swords’ request and then activated the black mark on his right shoulder, beginning the teleportation.
unit.target: Rediens ad Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Francae et Jenna de petitione Equitis Gladii nuntiavit, deinde signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activavit, teleportationem incipiens.

unit.source: He moved between layers of pure color blocks and indescribable bizarre creatures, not knowing how long it took, but he finally arrived at the location indicated in the Knight of Swords’s letter.
unit.target: Inter stratos purorum colorum iugorum et ineffabilia monstrosa animalia migravit, nescientem quantum temporis transierit, sed tandem ad locum indicatum in epistula Equitis Gladii pervenit.

unit.source: The first thing that caught Lumian’s eyes were several pale-faced men and women, like bodyguards, surrounding the Knight of Swords with somewhat disheveled brown hair, a suppressed look in his eyes, dressed in a white shirt and black vest.
unit.target: Primum quod oculi Lumiani incipuerunt erant complura viri et feminae pallide vultu, quasi custodes, qui Equitem Gladii circumfovebantur, comis brunneis aliquantulum laxe, vultu repressa, induti in tunica alba et vestis nigra.

unit.source: 759 Spiritual Intuition
unit.target: 759 Intuitio Spiritualis

unit.source: 759 Spiritual Intuition
unit.target: 759 Intuitio Spiritualis

unit.source: Beside the Knight of Swords lay a boundless lake, its quiet crimson waters shimmering under the moonlight of the night, occasionally stirred by a breeze.
unit.target: Iuxta Eques Gladii iacebat lacus infinitus, cujus aquae purpureae lenes sub lumine lunari nocturno micabantur, interdum a tenue aura excitatae.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but lift his head to gaze upward, feeling the night sky, hung with a crimson moon, seemed closer and much clearer than usual.
unit.target: Lumian non potuit non levare caput ut in caelum aspiceret, sentiens nocturnum caelum, in quo luna rubra appensa videbatur, propius atque clarius quam solito esse.

unit.source: Even the stars, obscured by the moonlight, were faintly visible, dense as if forming a brilliant, vast river.
unit.target: Etiam stellae, lumine lunae obtectae, vix conspicuae erant, tam spissae quasi flumen praeclarum ac immensum formantes.

unit.source: A chilly wind blew past, and Lumian, dressed in a thick jacket, turned his attention back to the Knight of Swords and asked, “Aren’t you cold?”
unit.target: Ventus frigidus praeteriecit, et Lumian, veste crassa indutus, animadvertit Eques Gladii et rogavit: “Nonne te frigore afficit?”

unit.source: Although it was summer in the Southern Continent, their high altitude and thin air made it feel significantly colder, especially at night, with temperatures likely below 15 degrees Celsius.
unit.target: Quamquam erat aestas in Continente Meridionali, altitudo eorum ac tenuus aer efficiebant ut sentiretur multo frigidior, praesertim nocte, cum temperatūra fere sub quindecim gradibus Celsius esset.

unit.source: Originally gazing at the highland lake, the Knight of Swords turned to Lumian and said, “For me, temperature has lost its meaning, and besides, the cold suits me better.”
unit.target: Primum ad lacum montanum aspiciens, Eques Gladii ad Lumian conversus dixit: “Mihi, temperatura significationem amisit, et praeterea frigus mihi magis convenit.”

unit.source: “Is that so? Then, extreme temperatures over 100 degrees Celsius or close to absolute zero don’t affect you?” Lumian replied, his tone relaxed.
unit.target: “Ita vero? Ergo temperaturas extremas, supra centum gradus Celsius aut prope ad nihilum absolutum, non te afficiunt?” respondit Lumian, tono quieto.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords fell silent, his gaze dark, seemingly suppressing something, before Lumian steered the conversation back on track.
unit.target: Eques Gladii silentium imposuit, vultu obscuro, quasi aliquid inhibens, antequam Lumian sermonem iterum ad rem redire curavit.

unit.source: “What exactly is the matter?”
unit.target: “Quid prorsus est quaestio?”

unit.source: Without asking the pale-faced, simply dressed men and women around him to leave, the Knight of Swords spoke in a low voice, “This is the Raklev area of the former Highlands Kingdom. I would like you to help find someone here.”
unit.target: Sine rogatu ut pallide vultos et simpliciter vestitos viros ac feminas circa eum discedere iuberet, Eques Gladii voce humili locutus est: “Hic est regio Raklev regni montanis pristini. Velim ut aliquem hic invenias.”

unit.source: The Highlands Kingdom, known for its mummies across the Northern and Southern Continents? Lumian did not hide his confusion.
unit.target: Regnum Montanum, notum propter mummias in Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales? Lumian confusionem suam non celavit.

unit.source: “What can you not find that I can?”
unit.target: “Quid tu invenire non potes, quod ego invenire possim?”

unit.source: Having worked together before, Lumian knew that the Knight of Swords, a holder of a Minor Arcana card and a Sequence 5 Wraith of the Prisoner pathway—mainly controlled by the Rose School of Thought with its splinter group, the temperance faction, joining the Church of The Fool—must have his reasons.
unit.target: Collaboraverant iam ante, Lumian sciebat Eques Gladii, chartam Arcanae Minoris tenentem et umbram Sequenciae V in viā Captīvī—maxime ab Schola Rosae Cogitationis, cum factione temperantiae quae Ecclesiam Stulti adiungit—rationes suas habere debere.

unit.source: Combining this information, Lumian guessed that the Knight of Swords was a member of the temperance faction, representing his faction within the Tarot Club, also serving Mr. Fool.
unit.target: Coniunctis his notitiis, Lumian coniectatus est Eques Gladii membrum esse factionis temperantiae, quae suam partem intra Societatem Taroti repraesentabat et etiam Domino Stulti inserviebat.

unit.source: Moreover, having seen a temperance faction Angel suspected of being a messenger of Mr. Fool, Lumian knew this organization was not weak, but rather strong, especially in divination, endowed with potent spiritual intuition.
unit.target: Praeterea, cum Angelum factionis temperantiae, quem nuntium Domini Stulti esse suspicatus esset, videret, Lumian intellexit hanc ordinationem non esse infirmam sed potius validam, praesertim in divinatione, intuitu spirituali vehementi praedita.

unit.source: Considering these, if the Knight of Swords truly needed to find a person, it would be simpler to request assistance directly from the temperance faction.
unit.target: His rebus consideratis, si Eques Gladii vere aliquem invenire postularet, facilius esset auxilium directe ab hac factione temperantiae petere.

unit.source: Is he thinking that it’s a waste of my promise if it’s not used?
unit.target: Num putat promissum meum inutiliter esse, nisi id adhibetur?

unit.source: Or, like me, do you prefer to rely on your own abilities and the goodwill you’ve accumulated to complete tasks, as a way to hone yourself?
unit.target: An, sicut ego, mavis inniti propriis virtutibus atque colligta bona voluntate ad opera perficienda, quo te exerceas?

unit.source: Ah, it’s more likely you’re relying on my mystical ability to attract evil god bestowed to locate the target…
unit.target: Ah, verisimiliter inniti es facultati mysticae meae, quae deum maleficum allicere confert, ut metam invenias…

unit.source: While Lumian made these guesses, the Knight of Swords, his voice suppressing his emotions and desires, said, “Someone’s spiritual intuition tells her that you can solve our current problem and provide the most effective help.”
unit.target: Dum Lumian has coniecturas faciebat, Eques Gladii, cuius vox affectus atque desideria inhibebat, locutus est: “Intuitio spiritualis cuiusdam indicat illi te posse quaestionem nostram solvere atque auxilium efficacissimum praebere.”

unit.source: A Wraith becomes a charlatan after becoming skilled at divination? Lumian thought sarcastically but didn’t inquire further.
unit.target: Num umbra, postquam in arte divinatoria peritissima facta, charlatanum fit? Lumian sardonice cogitavit, sed ulterius non interrogavit.

unit.source: “What do you need me to do?”
unit.target: “Quid vis ut faciam?”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords took a few steps forward.
unit.target: Eques Gladii aliquot passus profectus est.

unit.source: “Please allow me to introduce myself.
unit.target: “Quaeso, permitte mihi me ipsum introducere.

unit.source: My name is Maric, the ‘Knight of Swords’ of the Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana, and also a member of the temperance faction of the Church of The Fool.
unit.target: Nomen mihi est Maric, “Eques Gladii” chartae Arcanae Minoris Societatis Taroti, atque etiam membrum factionis temperantiae Ecclesiae Stulti.

unit.source: You’re aware of the origin of the temperance faction aren’t you?”
unit.target: Novistine originem factionis temperantiae, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian nodded and pointed at himself. “Lumian Lee.”
unit.target: Lumian annuit et in se digito indicavit: “Lumian Lee.”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords continued, “We are looking for an important member of the Primordial Moon faction within the indulgence faction.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii continuavit: “Quaerimus membrum maximi momenti factionis Lunae Primordialis intra factionem indulgentiae.”

unit.source: We… Lumian’s first reaction was to look around for any companions the Knight of Swords, Maric, might have.
unit.target: Lumian, primo instinctu, circumspiciebat quaerens utrum quid comitum Eques Gladii, Maric, haberet.

unit.source: But he found no one.
unit.target: Sed neminem invenit.

unit.source: As for the pale-faced men and women, he didn’t use his Eye of Calamity, simply observing their weaknesses and confirming they were all zombies.
unit.target: Quoad viros et feminas faciei pallidae, Oculum Calamitatis non adhibuit, sed eorum infirmitates perscrutatus confirmavitque omnes esse zombos.

unit.source: Lumian retracted his gaze and frowned.
unit.target: Lumian oculos retraxit et frontem contraxit.

unit.source: “The Primordial Moon faction?”
unit.target: “Factionem Lunae Primordialis?”

unit.source: Wasn’t the Rose School of Thought only known for the split between the indulgence and temperance factions? Where did the Primordial Moon faction come from?
unit.target: Num Schola Rosae Cogitationis non tantum nota erat propter dissensionem inter factionem indulgentiae et temperantiae? Unde orta est Factionem Lunae Primordialis?

unit.source: Hmm, from the series of events involving Hisoka and the Dream Festival, perhaps there was also a Devil faction within the Rose School of Thought…
unit.target: Hmm, ex serie eventuum quae Hisoka et Festum Somniorum complectebantur, fortasse etiam intra Schola Rosae Cogitationis Factionem Diaboli exstabat…

unit.source: Is this something learned from the Tamara family? Infinitely divisible…
unit.target: Hocne ex familia Tamara didicisti? Divisibilitas infinita!

unit.source: The Knight of Swords earnestly explained, “The Primordial Moon faction joined the indulgence faction later, originally a branch of the Life School of Thought; they grasp the Apothecary, which is also the Moon pathway. Later, guided by the Primordial Moon, they defected from the Life School of Thought and joined the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: Eques Gladii studiose explicavit: “Factionem Lunae Primordialis postea ad factionem indulgentiae se contulit, olim ramus Scholae Vitae; illi ‘Apothecarium’, quod etiam est via Lunae, apprehendunt. Postea, ducti a Luna Primordiali, a Schola Vitae defecerunt et Scholae Rosae se adiunxerunt.

unit.source: Life School of Thought… Lumian’s head throbbed.
unit.target: Schola Vitae… caput Lumiani pulsabat.

unit.source: Why does this keep getting more complicated?
unit.target: Cur haec semper magis complicantur?

unit.source: And which secret organization is this now?
unit.target: Et quaenam nunc societas secreta haec est?

unit.source: Seemingly sensing his thoughts, the Knight of Swords, Maric, spoke succinctly, “The Life School of Thought primarily follows the Fate pathway and is now an ally of the Tarot Club. This matter has nothing to do with our current search.”
unit.target: Quasi cogitata eius intuentem, Eques Gladii Maric succinte dixit: “Schola Vitae primarie per viam Fati se sequitur et nunc socia est Societati Taroti. Haec res ad quaesitum nostrum praesentem non attinet.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded, signaling the Knight of Swords to stick to the main issue.
unit.target: Lumian annuit, indicans Eques Gladii ut re principali perseveraret.

unit.source: Aurore once said, “Do not add unnecessarily entities; if irrelevant, best leave it be to save energy.”
unit.target: Aurore olim dixit: “Nolite entia supervacua addere; si sunt irrelevantia, melius est ea relinquere, ut energiam servetis.”

unit.source: Glancing at the pristine, boundless lake, the Knight of Swords, Maric, said, “The member of the ‘Primordial Moon’ faction we’re looking for possesses a very important item—that is our target.”
unit.target: Aspiciens lacum immaculatum et infinitum, Eques Gladii Maric dixit: “Membrum factionis ‘Lunae Primordialis’ quem quaerimus rem valde momenti possidet—id est propositum nostrum.”

unit.source: “How are you so sure they are in, uh, the Raklev area?” Lumian engaged more seriously now.
unit.target: “Quomodo ita certus es eos in area Raklev esse?” inquisivit Lumian iam serio.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords paused for a few seconds before responding, “Two incidents here and some residual traces point to him, but we haven’t found him yet. Meanwhile, another event occurred that proves he’s still here, possibly right in Raklev City.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii paucis secundis moratus est antequam responderet: “Duae hic res et nonnulla vestigia residua ad eum indicant, sed eum nondum invenimus. Interea, aliud factum evenit quod probat eum adhuc hic esse, fortasse in Urbe Raklev ipsa.”

unit.source: “Is he from the Apothecary pathway?” Lumian asked cautiously.
unit.target: “Num ex viā Apothecaria es?” inquisivit Lumian cautus.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords gave a slight nod. “Yes.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii leviter annuit: “Ita.”

unit.source: “Which evil god is their Primordial Moon?” Lumian didn’t rush to ask about the incidents and the traces left behind.
unit.target: “Quis deus malus est eorum Lunae Primordialis?” non festinavit Lumian de incidentibus atque vestigiis relictis quaerere.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords’ expression turned grave for a moment.
unit.target: Vultus Eques Gladii ad momentum gravis factus est.

unit.source: “It’s likely an incarnation of the Great Mother, sometimes also known as the Mother Tree of Desire.”
unit.target: “Verisimiliter incarnatio Magnae Matris est, quae etiam Mater Arboris Desiderii vocatur.”

unit.source: “The Great Mother…” Lumian’s eyelids twitched, “Has the Primordial Moon’s important follower received a boon from the Primordial Moon, or should I say, the Great Mother?”
unit.target: “Magna Mater…” palpebrae Lumiani tremuerunt, “Num sequens gravis Lunae Primordialis beneficium ab ea accepit, sive magis dicam, ab Magna Matre?”

unit.source: “Possibly.” The Knight of Swords wasn’t too certain.
unit.target: “Fortasse,” inquit Eques Gladii, non omnino certus.

unit.source: A follower of the Great Mother receiving Her blessing would mean they could sense my Child of God lineage within a certain distance… The Knight of Swords hadn’t thought of asking for my help before; I had only recently received the lineage of Omebella, and his companion then had a strong spiritual intuition… Are they trying to lure out the target using my Child of God lineage? Lumian’s understanding of the situation became instantly clear.
unit.target: Sequens Magnae Matris, benedictionem Eius accipiens, significaret se posse progeniem meam Filii Dei intra certam distantiam sentire; prius Eques Gladii auxilium meum petere non cogitaverat—nuper tantum progeniem Omebellae acceperam, et comes eius tum validam intuitionem spiritualem habebat. Num conantur metam edocere utens progenie meae Filii Dei? Intellectus Lumiani de re statim clarus factus est.

unit.source: That person’s spiritual intuition is spot on!
unit.target: Intuitio spiritualis illius personae penitus apta est!

unit.source: The Knight of Swords regained his composure.
unit.target: Eques Gladii iterum compositus fuit.

unit.source: “That person is named Oxyto, a Sequence 4 Shaman King of the Apothecary pathway, a demigod. Don’t worry, we will discreetly provide you with protection.”
unit.target: “Iste appellatur Oxyto, Sequenciae IV Rex Shaman viā Apothecariae, demideus. Noli solliciti esse; nos te secreto protegemus.”

unit.source: While speaking, the Minor Arcana card holder bent down to pick up an oil painting from the ground, depicting a handsome young man in his twenties, his skin pale as if he hadn’t been exposed to sunlight for a long time, with deep features and slightly curly black hair cascading to his shoulders.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, tenens chartam Arcanae Minoris, se inclinavit ut tolleret picturam oleam ex terra, quae repraesentabat iuvenem virum formosum in annis viginti, cuius cutis pallida videbatur quasi diu sole non expositus, cum lineamentis profundis et capillis nigris paulo crispis ad humeros decurrentibus.

unit.source: “This is a portrait of Oxyto,” the Knight of Swords briefly introduced.
unit.target: “Hic est effigies Oxytoni,” breviter introduxit Eques Gladii.

unit.source: “If there’s a boon, the target’s current appearance and gender might be uncertain…” Lumian pondered aloud, “Tell me about the incidents that occurred in the Raklev area and the significant traces left behind.”
unit.target: “Si beneficium evenit, forma et sexus propositi fortasse incerti esse possunt…” meditatus inquit Lumian, “Narra mihi de incidentibus, qui in regione Raklev occurrerunt, atque de vestigiis gravibus relictis.”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords pulled out a stack of papers from under his vest and handed them to Lumian, saying, “We first heard from some merchants about several occurrences of a full moon in Raklev City at times it shouldn’t appear…”
unit.target: Eques Gladii fasciculum papyrorum de subia veste extraxit et Lumiano tradidit, dicens: “Primum a quibusdam mercatoribus audivimus de pluribus occurrenceibus lunae plenae in Urbe Raklev temporibus, quibus apparere non debet…”

unit.source: “At the edge of Lake Dalsh, we discovered a buried ritual site where dozens of humans had become nourishment for the earth. Their abdomens had been torn open, and it seemed something had crawled out, but no related traces were found at the scene…”
unit.target: “Ad marginem Lacus Dalsh invenimus locum ritualem sub terra positum, in quo plures homines cibus terrae facti erant. Abdomena eorum lacerata erant, et videbatur aliquid exinde exsurgere, sed nullae vestigia ad rem pertinentia in loco reperta sunt…”

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian suddenly recalled several scenes he had seen in Madame Pualis’s castle.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian statim recoluit varias scaenas quas in castello Dominae Pualis viderat.

unit.source: He grimaced as he asked, “Were these humans both men and women?”
unit.target: Vultu contrito rogavit: “Eramne hi homines tam viri quam feminae?”

unit.source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords seemed to anticipate his question and added proactively, “The males’ abdomens were also torn open.”
unit.target: “Ita,” inquit Eques Gladii, quasi quaestionem praedicturus, addens: “Abdomena virorum quoque lacerata erant.”

unit.source: He then pointed to the stack of papers in Lumian’s hands.
unit.target: Tum ad fasciculum papyrorum in manibus Lumiani indicavit.

unit.source: “More detailed information is in the documents.”
unit.target: “Plura in documentis continentur.”

unit.source: Lumian hummed in acknowledgment, pondering for a moment.
unit.target: Lumian submisse hummavit, paulisper meditans.

unit.source: “I might need my companions to assist me, can you protect them too?”
unit.target: “Forsitan comites meos ad me adiuvandos mihi opus sit; potesne eos quoque protegere?”

unit.source: “No problem, as long as you all stay within five kilometers of each other,” the Knight of Swords assured.
unit.target: “Nulla difficultas, dummodo intra quinque chiliometra inter vos maneatis,” asseveravit Eques Gladii.

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian risit.

unit.source: “Then I’ll go back first to study the materials and make some preparations.”
unit.target: “Tum primum redeam ut materiās studiose perlegam atque praeparationes faciam.”

unit.source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: In Quartiere Cathédralis Commémorativae, Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numero 9.

unit.source: After listening to the Knight of Swords’ request, Franca scratched her head, puzzled.
unit.target: Postquam petitionem Eques Gladii audivit, Franca caput scrobavit, perplexa.

unit.source: “Forget the risk of searching for a demigod for a moment; I think you alone should be able to handle it. There’s limited help we can provide, as we don’t have the lineage of Omebella.”
unit.target: “Oblita periculum quaerendi deo-semideum paulisper; puto te solum id curare posse. Auxilium nobis limitatum est, quoniam progeniem Omebellae non possidemus.”

unit.source: Anthony, who had been called over, thought for a moment and said, “I could help cover up traces of the investigation, making those questioned forget they were ever asked.”
unit.target: Anthony, qui vocatus erat, paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Possem auxilium ferre ad tegenda vestigia inquisitionis, ita ut interrogati obliviscantur se unquam interrogatos fuisse.”

unit.source: Jenna glanced at Lumian and said, “I think your real purpose isn’t to get our help.”
unit.target: Jenna Lumian intuens dixit: “Cogito verum propositum tuum non esse nostram auxilium petere.”

unit.source: Hearing this, Franca realized.
unit.target: Audito hoc, Franca intellexit.

unit.source: “You want to use this opportunity to train the team? You want to prepare this early?”
unit.target: “Visne hoc uti ut turmam instituas? Velisne id antea praeparare?”

unit.source: “Not too shabby.” Lumian chuckled, “The earlier you prepare for these things, the better, in case I’m forced to advance earlier than planned.”
unit.target: “Non male.” subridens inquit Lumian, “Quo primum haec praeparas, eo melius, ne me coerceat ad antea procedendum quam destinatum.”

unit.source: Franca thoughtfully said, “Then I’ll pass Jenna’s messenger summoning method to 007. When there are Mirror People clues, we’ll go back to Trier to follow up. And don’t forget the most important team member.”
unit.target: Franca mente meditabunda dixit: “Tunc tradam methodum nuntiandi a Jenna ad 007. Cum indicia de Speculis Hominum apparebunt, redibimus ad Treveros ut sequamur, et ne obliviscaris membrum maximi momenti.”

unit.source: “How could I forget?” Lumian laughed.
unit.target: “Quomodo oblivisci possum?” risit Lumian.

unit.source: Ludwig, who was enjoying a late‑night snack, saw his godfather enter the room and sit down across the dining table, flashing a smile at him.
unit.target: Ludwig, qui cenam serotinam degustabat, vidit patrinum suum in conclave intrare et trans mensam convivii sedere, ei risum praebens.

unit.source: Suddenly, the bread in his hands didn’t taste as good anymore.
unit.target: Subito, panis in manibus eius non iam tam delectabilis gustu apparuit.

unit.source: 760 Second Day
unit.target: 760 Dies Secunda

unit.source: 760 Second Day
unit.target: 760 Dies Secunda

unit.source: In the Southern Continent, Raklev region, the day revealed Lake Dalsh in all its clarity, the serene waters reflecting the azure sky and distant snow-capped mountains in a scene almost dreamlike in its beauty.
unit.target: In Continente Australi, in regione Raklev, dies patefecit Lacum Dalsh omni sua claritate, cum aquis serenis caelum azureum atque montibus nive coronatis remotis speciem repraesentantibus in scaena paene quasi somnifera ob eius decorem.

unit.source: Lumian, devoid of any mood to appreciate the scenery, was strolling around a pit at the forest’s edge with Ludwig, who was smartly dressed in a tweed blazer, and Lugano, who wore a light cotton coat.
unit.target: Lumian, animō carēns ad scaenam admirandam, circa fovem ad margō silvā ambulabat, cum Ludovico, quī veste tweedi eleganter indūtus erat, et Lugano, quī in tunica levissima ex cottonīs indūtus apparēbat.

unit.source: The pit contained highly decayed bodies, half-melted into the surrounding soil as if merging with it, decomposing in a unique way that returned nutrients to the earth.
unit.target: Fossa continēbat corpora valde corrupta, semiliquata in terram circumiectam quasi eam connēscēns, in modo unico putrescēns, quī nutrimenta ad terram reddebāt.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian understood why Oxyto, a Shaman King, didn’t destroy the bodies after his rituals, leaving behind evidence and traces: burying the bodies and allowing them to return to the land was likely part of the ritual!
unit.target: Hoc vidēns, Lumian intellexit cur Oxyto, Rex Shamanōrum, corpora post rituōs suōs nōn deleverit et vestigia relinquī: sepelīre corpora et sinere ea ad terram redīre verisimiliter partem rituōs fuisset!

unit.source: Last night, after reviewing the documents provided by the Knight of Swords, Lumian had a clearer idea of how to find Oxyto, a fervent disciple of the Primordial Moon.
unit.target: Heri nocte, postquam documenta a Equeste Gladii provisa examināvit, Lumian clārius intellexit quōmodo Oxyto, fervidus discipulus Lunae Primordialis, reperīretur.

unit.source: Clearly, conventional methods like Magic Mirror Divination wouldn’t work; otherwise, the Knight of Swords’ companion, a member of the temperance faction with sharp spiritual intuition, would have already located Oxyto.
unit.target: Plane, methodi usitatae ut Divinātiō per Speculum Magicum nōn funcionarent; aliter, comes Eques Gladii, membrum factionis temperantis cum perspicuā intūitiōne spiritualī, iam Oxyto reperīretur.

unit.source: Lumian had three plans:
unit.target: Lumian trēs consilia habēbat:

unit.source: First, since Oxyto was a member of the Rose School of Thought and often mingled with the indulgence faction, he started by sending Franca and Jenna, both Demonesses, to casually stroll through Raklev City in full regalia, hoping to encounter Oxyto.
unit.target: Prīmō, quoniam Oxyto membrum Scholae Rōsā Ideārum erat et saepe cum factione indulgentiā miscēbātur, incepit mittendō Francam et Jennam, ambae daemonissae, ut per urbem Raklev in plena pompa casualiter ambularent, sperāns Oxyto occurrēmus.

unit.source: This Shaman King, who never resisted his desires, might approach them, all under the watchful protection of the temperance faction.
unit.target: Hic Rex Shamanōrum, quī numquam desideriis suīs resistit, fortasse ad eōs accedere posset, omnia sub vigilantia factionis temperantis.

unit.source: Additionally, Anthony would use Psychological Invisibility or disguise himself as a commoner to follow them and observe the reactions of those around the Demonesses to discern any malice before Oxyto made a move.
unit.target: Praeterea, Antonius aut Invisibilitātem Psychologicam adhiberet aut se ut vulgaris transfigurāret, eos secūtus et reactionēs circa daemonissās observāret, ut ullam malitiam ante quam Oxyto moverētur discerneret.

unit.source: Whether or not Oxyto had received the Great Mother’s boons and transformed into a woman was a detail that didn’t affect the Demonesses’ ability to seduce him.
unit.target: Utrum Oxyto beneficiora Magnae Mātris accepisset et in feminam se transformavisset, ērant res quae virtutem daemonissārum ad eum sedūcendum nōn afficiebat.

unit.source: Lumian deduced from Madame Pualis’s and Franca’s experiences that Oxyto would still be attracted to women, and might as well have an interest in men.
unit.target: Lumian ex experientiīs Dominae Pualis et Francae concludit Oxyto ad mūlēs adhūc attrahī, atque fortasse etiam ad vīrōs interit.

unit.source: Second, using his own lineage from Omebella, and the unique ability of the Great Mother’s blessed to sense others within a certain distance, he planned to roam the Raklev area in hopes of drawing out Oxyto.
unit.target: Secundō, utens sēva stirpē ex Omebella ac singularī facultāte benedictōrum Magnae Mātris cēteros intra certam distantiam sentī, consilium cepit per regionem Raklev vagārī, sperāns Oxyto evocārī.

unit.source: Similarly, Lugano, who also bore an anomaly possibly linked to the Great Mother, would serve as excellent bait.
unit.target: Similiter, Lugano, quī etiam anomaliam, fortasse cum Magnā Mātre connexam, ferēbat, optima esca fungī nāturus erat.

unit.source: Third, he considered revisiting the sites Oxyto had been before to see what could be eaten.
unit.target: Tertium, meditātus est loca quō Oxyto anteā frequentāverat iterum visitāre, ut vidēret quid edendum esset.

unit.source: Pinching his nose, Lumian carefully inspected the traces around and inside the pit along with the numerous bodies for a while, then turned his head to ask Ludwig, “Is it dirty?”
unit.target: Nasum compremēns, Lumian diligenter vestigia circa et intrā fovem, simul cum numerōs corporum, per aliquod tempus inspexit, deinde caput vertēns Ludovico rogāvit: “Squalida estne?”

unit.source: “Very dirty,” Ludwig nodded emphatically.
unit.target: “Valde squalida,” Ludovicus emphaticē inclināvit caput.

unit.source: “Dirty from the Great Mother?” Lumian pressed further.
unit.target: “Squalida ob Magnam Mātrem?” Lumian ulterius interrogāvit.

unit.source: Ludwig hummed affirmatively, his expression filled with conflict.
unit.target: Ludovicus sonum assentientem edidit, vultū conflictu plēnō.

unit.source: Unsurprisingly, he heard his godfather ask, “Is it edible?”
unit.target: Non mirum, audivit patrinum suum rogāre: “Edibilis estne?”

unit.source: At this question, Lugano couldn’t help but gag, while the usually stoic Knight of Swords, Maric, slightly raised his eyebrows.
unit.target: Ad hanc quaestiōnem, Lugano, quasi vomitus imminēns, se non potuit absterner, dum Miles Gladii, Maric, solitus stoicus, leviter superciliā attollēbat.

unit.source: Ludwig replied reluctantly, “Yes.”
unit.target: Ludovicus dubitāns respondit: “Ita.”

unit.source: “Can you sense the child born from these corpses after eating?” Lumian further inquired.
unit.target: “Potesne sentī puerum, quī ex his corporibus post escam natus est?” Lumian ulterius rogāvit.

unit.source: Based on his experience, these bodies had likely been impregnated during the ritual, carrying rapidly growing clawed bird-like creatures in their wombs, which then tore through their parents’ abdomens, absorbing the remnants and emerging on their own.
unit.target: Ex suā experientiā, haec corpora verisimiliter in ritu impregnata erant, portātā in utero creatūrās, similes avibus ungulātīs celeriter crescentēs, quæ deinde per abdomina parentum lacerābant, reliquiās devorantes et sē ipsās emergentēs.

unit.source: From a mysticism standpoint, whether voluntarily or forcibly, the clawed bird-like creatures and the corpses shared a deep blood connection, making it easy to trace one from the other, or even cast curses across distances.
unit.target: Ex prospectū mysticō—sive voluntāriē sive vi—creatūrae avium ungulātārum et corpora profunde sanguinis vinculō conexa erant, quod facile uno ex alterō inquirere aut etiam maledicta trans distantias iacere sinēbat.

unit.source: However, according to the Knight of Swords’ documents, divinations utilizing this blood connection had been fruitless, as if the creatures that had emerged from these corpses had vanished from this world.
unit.target: Attamen, secundum documenta Eques Gladii, divinātiōnēs hanc sanguinis coniunctionem utentēs infructuosae fuerunt, quasi creatūrae quæ ex his corporibus emergērunt ex hoc mōndō evanuerint.

unit.source: This could be due to a high-ranking individual casting a counter-divination or a change in the creatures’ state.
unit.target: Hoc fierī potuit ob aliquem summī gradūs individuō, quī divinātiōnem contrā intulisset, aut ob mutātiōnem statūs creatūrārum.

unit.source: Lumian’s only hope was that Ludwig might glean different information by consuming the flesh.
unit.target: Unica spes Luminiana erat ut Ludovicus, carnem comedendō, diversa indicia haurīret.

unit.source: Ludwig, with a sullen face, said, “You can extract a bit of the bloodline from the corpses through a certain cooking method.
unit.target: Ludovicus, vultū maestō, dīxit: “Ex his corporibus, per quandam coctionis rationem, parvam sanguinis stirpem extrahere potes.

unit.source: While this won’t allow me to sense the child’s position and condition from a great distance, I should be able to detect its presence within a thirty-meter radius.”
unit.target: Quamquam hoc nōn sinet mihi locum et condicionem puerī ex longinqua sentīre, credo tamen intra triginta metrorum radius eius praesentiam detegere posse.”

unit.source: “Okay,” Lumian felt the results were better than expected.
unit.target: “Bene,” Lumian sensit eventūs melius quam sperāverat.

unit.source: Then, he watched as Ludwig squatted down and used a child’s silver knife and fork to separate a piece of half-melted, half-rotten flesh from one of the corpses.
unit.target: Deinde vidit Ludovicum genu flectēns, cultellum et furculam argenteam puerilem utentem, ut partem carnis semiliquātā et semirotā e quōlo corporum segregāret.

unit.source: The flowing yellow pus and the grotesque state of the flesh made Lugano turn away, looking out towards Lake Dalsh and Raklev City on the other side of the water.
unit.target: Fluens pus flavus et status carnis deformis fēcērunt Lugano se avertīre, perspiciēns versus Lacum Dalsh atque urbem Raklev in altera aquae parte.

unit.source: Ludwig then had Lumian retrieve a cast-iron skillet, a stand, wheat flour, liqueur, various spices, and a chunk of solidified lard from the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ludovicus deinde iussit Luminian adferrere sartāgionem ex ferro fundītō, statīvum, farinā triticī, liquorem, varīās specias aromāticās et partem lardi solidificātī ex sacculo Viātōris.

unit.source: Lumian took on the role of the Chef’s assistant, mainly responsible for starting the fire.
unit.target: Lumian munus adiūtoris coquōrum suscepit, prācīpe responsābilis ad ignem accendendō.

unit.source: Ludwig first melted the lard, then added a bit of liqueur and some spices, frying them until the mixture was richly aromatic.
unit.target: Ludovicus primō lardum liquefēcit, deinde paulum liquorem atque aliquās species addidit, fricēns, donec mixtūra opulente aromātica fīeret.

unit.source: Next, he wrapped the rotten flesh in wheat flour and tossed it into the skillet, frying it in the deeply colored, fragrant lard.
unit.target: Deinde carnem putridam in farinā triticī involvit et in sartāginem iacuit, fricēns eam in lardo opime colorātō atque odorātō.

unit.source: The odors of fragrance and foul mingled together, gradually spreading.
unit.target: Odōra suāvē et foeda simul mixtā erant, paulatim diffundentēs.

unit.source: Finally, Ludwig finished cooking and forked up the fried, golden-brown flour-coated meatball, stuffing it into his mouth.
unit.target: Denique Ludovicus coquendi finem attigit et globum carnis fritum, farina aureo-brunne inductum, cum furculā cepit et in os suum intulit.

unit.source: He chewed, tears seemingly welling up in his eyes, looking pitiful as if wronged.
unit.target: Mandūcāvit, lacrimae in oculīs quasi orīrī videbantur, miserābilis aspiciens quasi iniuriā affectus.

unit.source: “You didn’t complain when you ate Loki raw,” Lumian joked.
unit.target: “Non quereris cum Loki crudelem edistī,” iocātus est Lumian.

unit.source: Ludwig muttered as he spoke, “Rotten doesn’t taste good, and there’s no spirituality in it.”
unit.target: Ludovicus, murmurāns, dīxit: “Putridum nōn sapit bene, nec in eo aliqua spiritualitās inveniuntur.”

unit.source: After swallowing the fried meatball that looked rather appealing, Ludwig continued thoughtfully as he savored it, “The deceased’s birthday is on the second day of every year.”
unit.target: Postquam globum carnis fritum, satis delectābilem, deglūtīvit, Ludovicus meditabundō perrexit dīcēns: “Dies nātālis defunctī in secunda die uniuscuiusque annī est.”

unit.source: “Is there something special about that?” Lumian asked.
unit.target: “Estne aliquid speciale in hoc?” rogāvit Lumian.

unit.source: Stuffing candy into his mouth, Ludwig responded offhandedly, “In myths, on the first day, the Oldest One created the world; on the second, the Great Mother was born.”
unit.target: Dulcia in os suum intulēns, Ludovicus leviter respondit: “In fabulis, in prima die, Vetustissimus mundum creāvit; in secunda, Magna Mātres nata est.”

unit.source: “I’ve never heard of such a myth…” Lugano murmured to himself, puzzled, with his back to Ludwig.
unit.target: “Numquam talem fabulam audīvī…” Lugano sibi murmūrābat, perplexus, dorsi ad Ludovicum.

unit.source: Lumian, deep in thought, shifted his gaze to another body.
unit.target: Lumian, altē cogitāns, oculōs suōs in alterum corpus vertit.

unit.source: “Their birthdays couldn’t all be on the second day of each year, could they?
unit.target: “Nativitātēs eōrum omnēs nōn possunt in secunda die uniuscuiusque annī esse, nonne?”

unit.source: “I remember that the new year for many tribes on the Southern Continent isn’t the same as on the Northern Continent; it’s not necessarily January 1st.
unit.target: “Meminī novum annum multārum tribuum in Continente Australi nōn eōdem esse ac in Continente Septentrionālī; nōn necessario ut sit Kalenda Ianuaria prima.

unit.source: So, which day is the second day, and which calendar are we using?”
unit.target: Ergō, quae dēs sit dies secunda, et quō calendāriō utimur?”

unit.source: Ludwig, with candy in his mouth, said, “Any would do, as long as it’s the second day of the new year according to the calendar one believes in.”
unit.target: Ludovicus, dulcia in ore gerēns, dīxit: “Quicumque sufficit, dummodo sit dies secunda novi annī secundum calendārium cui credātur.”

unit.source: Purely symbolic, then… Lumian turned towards the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Sola symbolice, igitur… Lumian versus Eques Gladii se vertit.

unit.source: “Have you confirmed the identities and birthdays of these bodies?”
unit.target: “Confirmāvistine identitātēs et diēs nātalēs harum corporum?”

unit.source: Raklev in the Star Highlands was a relatively prosperous area with a significant population, similar to the City of White Rapus, where Lumian had been before.
unit.target: Raklev in Montibus Stellātīs fuit regio relative prospēra cum magna populātiōne, similis Urbi Albae Rapus, quam Lumian ante visitāverat.

unit.source: It was one of the ancient Highlands Kingdom’s support points ruling over the entire Star Highlands.
unit.target: Erat una ex antiquīs stationibus sustentātiōnis Regni Montānī, quī totōs Montēs Stellātōs dominābat.

unit.source: This area was known for its rich mines, but interestingly, all mining sites were far from Lake Dalsh, preserving the sanctity of this highland lake in the hearts of its people.
unit.target: Haec regio nota erat ob opulentās fodināriās; sed mirum, omnes loci fodināriī longe ab Lacum Dalsh erant, sacralitātem huius lacus altomontānī in cordibus populī servātōs.

unit.source: In the past, the Star Highlands were primarily a battleground between the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire.
unit.target: Olim, Montes Stellātī fere erant ager pugnandī inter Rempublicam Intis et Imperium Feysac.

unit.source: After the war a few years ago, the Feysac Empire’s influence waned, and the Loen Kingdom began to extend its reach.
unit.target: Post bellum aliquot annōs praeterītōs, potentia Imperiī Feysac decrescit, et Regnum Loen diffusionem suam augere coepit.

unit.source: Even the Evernight Goddess Church of Loen Kingdom seemed to be spreading its teachings in this area—a fact Lumian had heard about while in Rapus.
unit.target: Etiam Ecclesia Deae Perpetuae Noctis Regni Loen videbātur sua praecepta in hac regione dissemināre—a rem, quam Lumian in Rapus audīverat.

unit.source: And throughout the Star Highlands, the city atop the mines, Raklev, had the largest Loenese population.
unit.target: Et per Montes Stellātōs, urbs super fodināriās—Raklev—maximam populātiōnem Loenensium habēbat.

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric nodded slowly and said, “We’ve confirmed 90% of the bodies; their birthdays, according to the Northern Continent’s calendar, are mostly on January 2nd.
unit.target: Miles Gladii Maric lente annuivit et dīxit: “Nonaginta percentum corporum confirmāvimus; diēs nātālēs eōrum, secundum calendārium Continenti Septentrionālī, plerumque in secunda die Ianuariī cadunt.

unit.source: For the rest, using local calendars, their birthdays also fall on the second day of the new year.
unit.target: Ad cetera, ex calendāriīs regionalibus utentibus, diēs nātālēs eōrum quoque in secunda die novi annī cadunt.

unit.source: “For those whose identities remain uncertain, they seem to be foreigners, who may have come here either voluntarily or involuntarily.
unit.target: “Illōrum, quarum identitātēs incertae manent, videntur esse peregrinī, qui huc vel voluntāriē vel invitō advenerunt.

unit.source: Give us a bit more time, and we’ll surely determine who they are.”
unit.target: Da nōbīs paulum temporis, et certe cognoscēmus quī sint.

unit.source: With a sufficiently large sample, the findings mostly align with Ludwig’s explanation that the ritual required a strong symbol of the Great Mother…
unit.target: Cum exemplum satis ample, inventa plerumque congruunt cum Ludovicī explicatione quō ritu signum validum Magnae Mātris necessarium erat…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t stop the more temperance faction members from wasting energy verifying the remaining deceased’s identities—what if there was something else peculiar?
