unit.target: Lumian nōn impedīvit membrīs factionis temperantis ne energiam terēre in reliquārum defunctorum identitātibus verificandīs—quid, sī aliquid aliud peculīārem esset?

unit.source: Looking across the lake at Raklev City, Lumian said, “Let’s head back to the city now and walk around.”
unit.target: Trans Lacum ad Urbem Raklev aspiciēns, Lumian dīxit: “Nunc ad urbem redeāmus et circūm ambulemus.”

unit.source: Let’s see which of the three are more effective—Omebella’s bloodline, the anomaly of the Earth pathway, or the blood connection with the bird-clawed babies!
unit.target: Videāmus quae trium efficacius sit—stirps Omebellae, anomalia itineris terrānae, aut nexus sanguineus cum infāntibus avium ungulātīs!

unit.source: Walking towards the city, made of numerous gray and white stone houses, along the shimmering lake as blue as the sky, Lumian suddenly had a thought.
unit.target: Ambulāns ad urbem, ex plurimīs cinereīs et albīs lapideīs domīs confectā, iuxta lacum scintillantem tam caerūleum quam caelum, Lumian subito rem cogitāvit.

unit.source: He asked the quiet Knight of Swords walking beside him, “In the Rose School of Thought, was Oxyto in charge of the Raklev area?”
unit.target: Rogāvit quietum Equestem Gladii, quī iuxta eum ambulābat: “In Schola Rōsā Ideārum, num Oxyto curam regionis Raklev gerebat?”

unit.source: “Not previously, and now it’s uncertain,” replied the Knight of Swords succinctly.
unit.target: “Non anteā; nunc autem incertum est,” respondit Eques Gladii succinctē.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, musing to himself, “If he isn’t in charge of Raklev and merely initiated a ritual here on a whim, he should have left after it ended.
unit.target: Lumian annuivit, meditandō sibi: “Sī nōn de Raklev curam gerat et tantum hinc rituōrum impulsus fuerit capriciōnibus, post finem īllum discessurus esse debuīt.”

unit.source: Why is he still here?
unit.target: Cur adhuc hic manet?

unit.source: “Does he have a deeper purpose in the Raklev area?
unit.target: “Num habet propositum profundius in regione Raklev?

unit.source: Or perhaps, the Rose School of Thought is planning something for this place?”
unit.target: Aut fortasse Schola Rōsā Ideārum aliquid huic loco parat?”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords paused for a few seconds before responding, “We suspect there might be a deeper purpose.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii paulum cessāvit antequam responderet: “Suspicimur quī propositum profundius esse possit.”

unit.source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “Before the Highlands Kingdom was established, many areas of the Star Highlands worshiped Death, and Raklev was one of the places most influenced by this belief.
unit.target: Intermissū paulo, addidit: “Antequam Regnum Montānum institūtum esset, pleraeque partes Montium Stellātōrum Mortem colere solebant, et Raklev erat una ex locīs maxime huic fide affīnata.”

unit.source: Even today, some local customs still carry remnants of this death worship.
unit.target: Etiam hōdie, quaedam consuetūdines localēs reliquiās huius cultūs mortis portābant.

unit.source: As they spoke, the three adults and one child arrived outside Raklev City.
unit.target: Dum loquēbantur, trēs adultī et ūnum puer extra urbem Raklev advenerunt.

unit.source: Raklev, compared to the refined City of White Rapus, the architecture here was much more rugged.
unit.target: Raklev, comparāta ad urbem exquisītam Albām Rapus, architectūra hīc multō asperior erat.

unit.source: Although there were people in dark red robes and bright dresses, most wore more durable canvas work clothes.
unit.target: Quamquam erant hominēs indūtī in tunicīs rubeīs obscūrīs et vestimentīs nitīdīs, plērīque indūmenta robustiora ex tela gestābant.

unit.source: Before even reaching the city gates, Lumian could already sense the hustle and bustle.
unit.target: Antequam ipsam portam urbīs attingeret, Lumian iam sentīre poterat tumultum et festinātiōnem.

unit.source: 761 The Blessings Festival
unit.target: 761 Festum Benedictionum

unit.source: 761 The Blessings Festival
unit.target: 761 Festum Benedictionum

unit.source: Beside a segment of the old city wall, now merely a relic for admiration, Lumian’s gaze passed between the tall and short gray‑white stone buildings and landed on a majestic temple standing near the mountain range.
unit.target: Apud segmentum veteris muri urbis, nunc solum reliquiae ad admirationem, visus Lumiani inter alta et parva aedificia lapidea cinereo‑alba pertransiit et incidit in magnificum templum iuxta catena montium.

unit.source: It towered thirty meters high, made up of several turrets, reminiscent of an ancient war fortress left over from bygone eras.
unit.target: Triginta metra alta stabat, ex pluribus turribus compositum, quod antiquam arcem belli ex temporibus praeteritis relicta evocabat.

unit.source: At this moment, influenced by both the mountains and the clouds, the near‑noon sunlight cast a dim hue, cloaking the grand temple in a dusk‑like veil.
unit.target: Hoc ipso momento, montibus et nubibus simul afflatus, sol prope mediam diem pallidam umbram iaciebat, magnum templum in velamine crepusculari operiens.

unit.source: “Is that a temple of the God of Combat?” Lumian didn’t turn his head as he asked the Knight of Swords beside him.
unit.target: “Estne id templum Dei Pugnandi?” non vertit caput Lumian, dum equitem gladii iuxta se rogabat.

unit.source: The God of Combat Church was the only state religion of the Feysac Empire, but following their defeat in the war a few years ago, the Evernight Goddess Church had gained a certain right to preach within the empire, although they seemed unenthusiastic about this role.
unit.target: Ecclesia Dei Pugnandi erat sola religio publica Imperii Feysac, sed post cladem in bello paucis annis abhinc, Ecclesia Deae Noctis Aeternae certum ius intra imperium praedicandi adeptus est, quamquam huic muneri non videbantur ardenter incumbere.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords replied succinctly, “It’s a cathedral.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii breviter respondit: “Cathedrāla est.”

unit.source: Not a temple, but a cathedral?
unit.target: Non templum, sed cathedrāla?

unit.source: True to the Feysacians, who suffer from a fascination with enormity, and their taste is not bad…
unit.target: Feysaciani, qui admiratione ingentiae versantur, et cuius gustus non est male…

unit.source: For some reason, Lumian suddenly recalled a phrase he had heard at the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society: More is beautiful, bigger is better.
unit.target: Quamquam quaedam ratione, Lumian subito recordatus est locutionis quam audiverat apud Societatem Papionum Crispinorum: “Plus est pulchrum, majus est melius.”

unit.source: He then asked, “Is this a Feysac colony?”
unit.target: Tum rogavit: “Estne haec colonia Feysaciana?”

unit.source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords replied in a deep voice, “but now, the Loenese have the right to trade here.”
unit.target: “Ita,” eques gladii voce profunda respondit, “sed nunc Loenenses ius habent hic mercandi.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly, saying nothing further as he followed the road into Raklev City.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit, nihil amplius addens, dum viam in urbem Raklev sequebatur.

unit.source: Along the way, it was easy for him to distinguish people from different countries among the crowd:
unit.target: Per iter, facile ei erat homines ex diversis nationibus inter turbam distinguere:

unit.source: • The Feysacians, tall in stature—men typically over six feet three inches, women nearly six feet—matched Lumian’s stereotype of them: descendants of giants, even including many half‑giants.
unit.target: Feysaciani, qui altitudine egregia praediti erant—viri plerumque ultra sex pedes, quarum tres uncias ferent, et feminae paene sex pedum—stereotypum Lumiani de eis confirmabant: progenies gigantum, etiam multos semigiantes includentes.

unit.source: • Their dressing tended to be casual, with either unbuttoned jackets or no jackets at all.
unit.target: Indutiae eorum levis erant, sive vestimenta soluta gerentes vel omnino nulla induti.

unit.source: • The Loenese, predominantly with black hair, cared much about their appearance, always impeccably dressed. The ladies favored round‑brimmed bonnets and carried sun‑blocking parasols, while the gentlemen were decked out in top hats and carried canes.
unit.target: Loenenses, praesertim capillis nigris ornati, de specie sua multum curabant, semper impecstus vestiti. Feminae bonnetos rotundos cum latus amplo praeditos predilexerunt et parasolas solis repellentis portabant, dum viri in pileis altis ornatos et baculos ferentes erant.

unit.source: • The locals of Raklev were darker‑skinned and wiry. The men often wore durable canvas work clothes, and the women dressed for labor, with only a few in brightly colored dresses, herding cattle, sheep, and horses.
unit.target: Incolae Raklevenses cutis obscurae et graciles erant. Viri saepe induti erant vestimentis fortibus ex tela fabricatis, et feminae ad laborem aptae vestimenta gerebant, pauci tantum in vestibus vividis, pecora, oves, et equos gregantes.

unit.source: Lumian watched a dwarf horse and several long‑haired cattle pass by, spotting a local man in a dark red robe with a stark white skull topped with a wool‑knit gray and white hat on his head.
unit.target: Lumian aspexit equum nanum et plura pecora longis pilis transeunta, detegens hominem localem in veste rubeo obscura, cui calvaria alba, nitida, super caput, sub pileo ex lana cinerea et alba contextō, erat.

unit.source: “Is this the remnant of Death worship you mentioned in the local customs?” Lumian didn’t choose his path deliberately but followed his instincts.
unit.target: “Haecne remanentia cultus mortis, quem in consuetudinibus localibus memorasti?” Lumian iter non deliberatum eligebat, sed instinctibus se deduxit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords nodded slightly and said, “Yes, the people of Raklev keep the skulls of their deceased relatives at home, believing they protect them, bring good luck, and help fend off dangers lurking in the night.
unit.target: Eques Gladii leviter annuit et dixit: “Ita, incolae Raklevenses domi calvariās cognatorum defunctorum servant, credentes eas eos protegere, fortunam bonam afferre, atque pericula nocturnis latentia repellere.”

unit.source: The more skulls a family has, the more prosperous and developed it is considered.”
unit.target: Quo plures calvariae familiae habentur, eo magis prospere et evoluta censentur.

unit.source: This is similar to the practice in Cordu where relatives’ hair and nails are kept… but here, the Death worship is much stronger, hence the choice of skulls, making it more extreme…
unit.target: Hoc simile est more in Cordu, ubi capilli et ungues cognatorum servantur… sed hic cultus mortis multo fortior est, ideo electio calvariarum id magis extremum reddit.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly felt a pang of melancholy.
unit.target: Lumian subito dolorem tristitiae sensit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords continued, “Some even make amulets from the skulls of their deceased kin to carry with them at all times.
unit.target: Eques Gladii perrexit: “Quidam etiam amuleta ex calvariis cognatorum defunctorum faciunt, quae semper secum ferre solebant.”

unit.source: What you saw earlier was just such a case.
unit.target: Id quod antea vidisti, tale erat exemplum.

unit.source: During the annual Blessing Festival, all the locals in Raklev take the skulls from their homes into the streets, dress them solemnly, and join in the revelry and prayers together.”
unit.target: Durante festo annuo Benedictionum, omnes incolae Raklev calvariās ex domibus suis in vias ferunt, eas solemniter induunt, et in laetitia atque precibus congregantur.

unit.source: “Blessing Festival?” Lumian perked up, asking with gravity.
unit.target: “Festo Benedictionum?” Lumian excitatus graviter rogavit.

unit.source: Having experienced Lent, Sea Prayer Festival, and Dream Festival, he felt like he had developed a sort of festival‑induced PTSD, with a headache starting whenever he heard of another special day.
unit.target: Experiens Quadragesimam, Festum Precum Maris, et Festum Somniorum, sensit quasi ex festivitatibus PTSD ortum esse, cum capitis dolor incipere solebat quoties de alio die speciali audiret.

unit.source: Oxyto, a Shaman King of the Rose School of Thought and a key follower of the Primordial Moon, couldn’t be staying in Raklev just for the Blessing Festival, could he?
unit.target: Oxyto, Rex Schamanorum Scholae Rosae atque sectator praecipuus Lunae Primordialis, non potuit in Raklev manere tantum ob Festo Benedictionum, nonne?

unit.source: The Knight of Swords responded somberly, “The Blessing Festival has long since passed; it was in November last year, more than a month before the Dream Festival.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii graviter respondit: “Festo Benedictionum iam pridem transierit; fuit Novembri proximo anno, plus quam mense ante Festum Somniorum.”

unit.source: You know about the Dream Festival… Lumian first breathed a sigh of relief, then asked anxiously, “Did Oxyto first appear in the Raklev area before or after the Blessing Festival?”
unit.target: Scis de Festum Somniorum… Lumian primum leviter suspiravit, deinde anxie quaesivit: “Oxyto prius apparuit in regione Raklev ante an post Festo Benedictionum?”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords thought for a moment before replying, “Before.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii paulisper meditatus est, deinde respondit: “Ante.”

unit.source: “So during the Blessing Festival, he was likely still in the Raklev area?” Lumian furrowed his brow slightly.
unit.target: “Ita, ergo, Festo Benedictionum, probabiliter adhuc in regione Raklev mansit?” Lumian leviter fronte contraxit.

unit.source: “That seems to be the case,” the Knight of Swords answered, very cautiously.
unit.target: “Id videtur,” respondit eques gladii, cautissime.

unit.source: Franca’s gaze drifted away from a local woman with colorful skulls sewn onto her shoulder, and she turned to a tall, blond, blue‑eyed woman from Feysac with a smile.
unit.target: Francae oculus a muliere locali, cui in humero variī calvariae coloratī consuti erant, avertit, et illa ad mulierem altam, flavam, caeruleosque oculos ex Feysac, subrisu, se convertit.

unit.source: “Sorry, I already have a lady companion!”
unit.target: “Ignosce, iam comitissa habeo!”

unit.source: Isn’t this Feysacian a bit too forthright?
unit.target: Nonne hic Feysacianus paulo nimis aperte se exprimit?

unit.source: Flirting with me and Jenna, and to think, aside from men, there were also beautiful women inviting us over!
unit.target: Ludens mecum et cum Jenna, et cogitandum est, praeter viros etiam pulchrae feminae nos invitabant!

unit.source: The Feysacian chuckled.
unit.target: Feysacianus subridens risit.

unit.source: “I don’t mind if you both come over to my place.”
unit.target: “Mihi non molestum est, si uterque ad domum meam veniatis.”

unit.source: “I mind,” Jenna spoke up for Franca.
unit.target: “Mihi molestum est,” locuta est Jenna pro Franca.

unit.source: They had been wandering around Raklev City for nearly two hours.
unit.target: Per urbem Raklev fere per duas horas vagabantur.

unit.source: Although Franca hadn’t actively unleashed the Demoness of Pleasure’s charm—to avoid suspicion of fishing purposefully—their carefully styled Demoness appearance alone, in terms of looks, demeanor, and figure, was enough to draw plenty of attention.
unit.target: Quamquam Franca non actu Demonissam Voluptatis venustatem efferuerat – ut suspicio de piscatione deliberata evaderetur – tamen ipsa eleganter disposita species Demonissae, in specie, habitu, atque figura, satis erat ad multam attentionem alliciendam.

unit.source: Here, the Feysacians were bold and direct, both men and women, while the Loenese were conservative and reserved, only daring to approach after finding a good reason.
unit.target: Hic Feysaciani audaces et directi (viri et feminae) erant, dum Loenenses cauti et reticentes erant, tantum appropinquare audebant cum rationem bonam inveniissent.

unit.source: The locals mostly just watched from a distance, quietly following, with a few gathering the courage to speak up, but only in the guise of offering guidance.
unit.target: Incolae Raklevenses plerumque a longinquitate spectabant, tranquille sequi solebant, pauci audaciam conquisivērunt loquendi, sed tantum sub specie consilii praebendi.

unit.source: “Alright then.”
unit.target: Bene igitur.

unit.source: The female Feysacian, a bit taller than Franca, waved her hand in disappointment and turned to enter a nearby café.
unit.target: Femina Feysaciana, paululum Francae altior, manu languida taedio vibrante salutavit et ad cauponam prope positam se convertit.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna were now in the heart of Raklev City, on a street that boasted the grand and elegant architectural style typical of Feysac.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna nunc in corde urbis Raklev erant, in platea qua praevalebat magnus et elegans styla architectonica Feysaciana.

unit.source: “It’s almost noon, how about trying some Feysac cuisine?”
unit.target: Prope meridiem est; quid de cibis Feysacianis temptandis censes?

unit.source: Franca looked up at the sun, bright but not warm.
unit.target: Franca solem extulit, lucide sed non fervide.

unit.source: She was referring to the St. Millom Restaurant diagonally across from them.
unit.target: Ea referret ad St. Millom Restaurant, quod diagonaliter trans eos positum erat.

unit.source: St. Millom was the capital of the Feysac Empire, and naming a restaurant after it seemed an attempt to offer an “authentic” experience.
unit.target: St. Millom erat caput Imperii Feysac, et restaurantium eum nominare videbatur conari experientiam “authenticam” praebere.

unit.source: “Sure.” Jenna nodded gently.
unit.target: “Certe,” Jenna leniter annuit.

unit.source: As the two Demonesses stepped into the grand and intricately decorated restaurant, Anthony sat down on a bench across the street and quietly started on his lunch—a corn tortilla wrapped around beef and lamb, seasoned with various spices.
unit.target: Dum duae Demonissae in magnum et subtiliter ornatum restaurantum intraverunt, Anthony in subsello trans viam sedebat et silentio prandium suum inire coepit—tortilla maiziana involuta in carne bubula et agnellina, variis condimentis sapientibus.

unit.source: Lumian walked with Ludwig and Lugano until they reached the temple‑like Holy Lake Cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian cum Ludovico et Lugano ambulavit, donec ad Cathedralem Sacri Lacus, quasi templo similem, pervenerunt.

unit.source: But once they truly entered the city, the Knight of Swords, Maric, disappeared.
unit.target: Sed cum veram urbem intrarentur, Eques Gladii, Maric, evanuit.

unit.source: However, Lumian’s instincts told him that this Minor Arcana card holder was still nearby.
unit.target: Attamen, instinctus Lumiani ei indicaverunt hunc tenentem chartae Minoris Arcanae adhuc prope esse.

unit.source: “Feeling anything unusual?” Lumian inquired of Ludwig.
unit.target: “Sentisne aliquid inusitatum?” Lumian a Ludovico interrogavit.

unit.source: “No,” Ludwig shook his head.
unit.target: “Non,” Ludovicus caput concutiens respondit.

unit.source: Lumian then turned to Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian deinde ad Lugano se vertit.

unit.source: “What about you?”
unit.target: “Quid de te?”

unit.source: “Me?” Lugano looked baffled.
unit.target: “Mihi?” Lugano obstupuit.

unit.source: Isn’t it Ludwig’s job to locate people?
unit.target: Nonne officium Ludovico est homines quaerere?

unit.source: What does this have to do with me?
unit.target: Quid hoc ad me pertinet?

unit.source: “Do you sense anything unusual?” Lumian calmly repeated the question.
unit.target: “Sentisne aliquid inusitatum?” Lumian placide quaestionem repetivit.

unit.source: For some reason, Lugano felt that his employer had become more approachable lately, so he honestly replied, “No.”
unit.target: Aliqua ratione, Lugano sensit dominum suum nuper magis accesibilem factum esse, itaque sincere respondit: “Non.”

unit.source: Gurgle, gurgle, a strange noise sounded next to both him and Lumian.
unit.target: Gurgle, gurgle, sonus mirus prope eum et Lumian audiebatur.

unit.source: Both turned their gaze to Ludwig.
unit.target: Ambo ad Ludovicum oculos converterunt.

unit.source: Touching his stomach, Ludwig looked eager and said, “It’s time for lunch.”
unit.target: Tangentem ventrem, Ludovicus ardens videbatur et dixit: “Tempus prandi est.”

unit.source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed readily.
unit.target: “Optime,” Lumian pariter convenit.

unit.source: His philosophy was to never let a child go hungry, especially since the starving child might resort to cannibalism.
unit.target: Philosophia eius erat ne umquam puer famem pati haberet, praesertim quod puer esuriens ad anthropophagiam degredi posset.

unit.source: He looked around and pointed towards a bustling street to the northwest of Holy Lake Square.
unit.target: Circumspiciens et digito monstrans, versus viam ferventem ad septentrionalem occidentem Sacri Lacus Plateam indicavit.

unit.source: “There seem to be quite a few restaurants there.”
unit.target: Videtur ibi esse plures cauponae.

unit.source: This time, Ludwig didn’t need Lugano’s hand‑holding; he scampered ahead with short strides, while Lumian followed at a leisurely pace, and Lugano trailed close behind.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Ludovicus manibus Luganoi non indigebat; celeriter per breves passus praecurrit, dum Lumian tarde sequebatur, et Lugano prope post se pergebat.

unit.source: The street bore a very typical Feysac characteristic, complete with trees and benches, resembling a streetscape in the Northern Continent countries.
unit.target: Via notam Feysacianam propriam habebat, cum arboribus et subselliis, similis scaenae viarum in regionibus Continenti Septentrionalis.

unit.source: Lumian glanced around briefly and pointed with his chin to St. Millom Restaurant not far away.
unit.target: Lumian breve circumspiciens et mento ad St. Millom Restaurant, non longe truatus, digitum extulit.

unit.source: “Let’s try some Feysac cuisine.”
unit.target: Conemur fercula Feysaciana.

unit.source: “Okay.” Ludwig wiped his mouth.
unit.target: “Optime,” Ludovicus os suum exlustrans respondit.

unit.source: Suddenly, his eager expression turned to confusion, and his head moved left and right as if searching for something.
unit.target: Subito, vultus eius ardens in confusionem versa est, et caput ad sinistram et dextram movebatur, quasi aliquid quaereret.

unit.source: Lumian noticed this unusual behavior.
unit.target: Lumian hanc insolitam ambulationem animadvertit.

unit.source: “Why? Want an ice cream too?” he teased Ludwig.
unit.target: “Cur? Et visne gelatum etiam?” ludibrio incisus, ad Ludovicum dixit.

unit.source: Imitating Lugano’s usual demeanor, Ludwig pressed his voice down and said, “I think I sensed that child from the body, but it’s vague.”
unit.target: Ludovicus, morem solitum Luganoi imitans, vocem demittens dixit: “Puto me illud puerum ex corpore sensitisse, sed incertum est.”

unit.source: Sensed the bird‑clawed baby? Lumian looked around; there were no other children in sight, just Feysacians and locals, with a few from Loen scattered among them.
unit.target: Sensisti puerum ungulis avium similem? Lumian circumspiciens animadvertit: nulli alii pueri apparuerunt, solum Feysaciani et incolae, cum paucis ex Loen inter eos dispersis.

unit.source: There weren’t even any pregnant women around.
unit.target: Ne quidem ulla femina gravida aderat.

unit.source: Then, Ludwig added, “I can’t sense it anymore.”
unit.target: Deinde Ludovicus addidit: “Hoc amplius sentire non possum.”

unit.source: Had it moved beyond a thirty‑meter range?
unit.target: Num ultra triginta metra migraverit?

unit.source: Lumian thoughtfully withdrew his gaze.
unit.target: Lumian cogitabunde oculos avertit.

unit.source: If what we had just encountered was related to the bird‑clawed baby, then my own Omebella bloodline might have been sensed by the other…
unit.target: Si id quod modo incidimus puero ungulis avium simili attinet, tunc stirps mea Omebella ab altero percepta fuisset.

unit.source: Lumian nodded and smiled at Ludwig.
unit.target: Lumian annuit et Ludovico subrisit.

unit.source: “Let’s eat first, nothing’s more important than filling our bellies.”
unit.target: “Primum edamus, nihil est magis momenti quam ventres nostros replemus.”

unit.source: “Right!” For the first time, Ludwig felt that the godfather’s words resonated deeply with him.
unit.target: “Recte!” Primo tempore, Ludovicus sensit verba patroni ei penitus resonare.

unit.source: Upon entering St. Millom Restaurant, Lumian immediately noticed Franca and Jenna sitting in a conspicuous spot.
unit.target: Intravit in St. Millom Restaurant, et statim animadvertit Francam et Jennam in loco conspicuo sedentes.

unit.source: The carefully dressed Demonesses caught Lumian’s attention for an extra second.
unit.target: Daemonissae diligenter indutae proximum momentum attentionis Lumiani ceperunt.

unit.source: Meanwhile, he wondered to himself, Is this the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence?
unit.target: Interim, cogitabat: “Estne haec lex de ‘Beyonder Characteristics Convergence’?”

unit.source: How coincidental for us to choose the same restaurant…
unit.target: Quam fortuito nobis idem restaurantum eligere convenit…

unit.source: (Reader note: A reasonable development)
unit.target: (Nota lectoris: Evolutio rationabilis.)

unit.source: Franca and Jenna, noticing his gaze, looked back at him—one with a mouth agape in surprise, the other stifling a laugh.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna, eius oculos animadvertere, in eum redeuntes vidērunt—una ore stupore aperto, altera risu suffocans.

unit.source: They quickly composed themselves and turned their attention back to the beet soup in front of them.
unit.target: Celeriter se componere coeperunt et animos ad ius betae coram eos redegerunt.

unit.source: With the waiter’s guidance, Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano took a seat in the corner.
unit.target: Ministri auxilio, Lumian, Ludovicus, et Lugano in angulo consederunt.

unit.source: “Sir, what would you like to order?”
unit.target: “Domine, quid vis ordinare?”

unit.source: The waiter offered a menu designed like a book.
unit.target: Serviens menùum, qui quasi liber formatus erat, obtulit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at it, chose not to browse through, and simply said, “One set of everything but the drinks.”
unit.target: Lumian illud aspexit, non perlegens, et simpliciter dixit: “Unum exemplar omnium, excepto potionibus.”

unit.source: 762 The Flirting Showcase
unit.target: 762 Expositio Amatoria

unit.source: 762 The Flirting Showcase
unit.target: 762 Expositio Amatoria

unit.source: Although limited by the variety of local ingredients, St. Millom Restaurant’s menu appeared thick, yet it didn’t offer an extensive variety of dishes.
unit.target: Quamquam varietate ingredientorum localium limitata, tabula ferculorum cauponae Sancti Millom spissa videbatur, sed non praebebat amplam varietatem ferculorum.

unit.source: However, relatively speaking, a whole book’s worth of menu items couldn’t possibly be too few—it was enough to make a dozen adults feel stuffed.
unit.target: Ceterum, relative loquendo, totus liber ferculorum non posset esse nimis parvus; satis enim erat ut duodecim adultis satietatem afferret.

unit.source: The restaurant’s waiter was a local, but he spoke fluent Feysacian, Loenese, and Intisian, completely understanding Lumian’s order without any confusion.
unit.target: Minister cauponae, qui locale erat, sed clare loquebatur Feysacianam, Loenensem atque Intisianam, iussum Lumiani prorsus intellegens.

unit.source: He was about to double-check when he saw the customer from Intis bring out a thick stack of gold hoorn.
unit.target: Dubiendum parabat, cum vidit emptorem ex Intis extrahere crassum fasciculum aurorum hoornu.

unit.source: This was the currency of the Feysac Empire, commonly used in the Raklev area—before teleporting to the Southern Continent that morning, Lumian had specifically gone to a nearby bank to exchange some cash at a higher rate of 4.4 verl d’or for one gold hoorn, but the cash he now produced wasn’t his own; it was activity funds provided by the Knight of Swords, Maric.
unit.target: Haec erat moneta Imperii Feysac, in regione Raklev vulgo adhibita—antequam illo mane ad Continens Meridionalem teletransportaretur, Lumian profecto ad argentariam vicinam ivit ut aliquot nummos ad ratem superioris 4.4 verl d’or pro uno auro hoornu converteret; sed argentum quod nunc exhibebat, suum non erat, sed pecunia activitatis a Eque Gladii, Maric, praebita.

unit.source: "All of it?" The waiter, diligent and thorough, made one last inquiry.
unit.target: "Omne?" inquit minister cauponae, diligentissime et accuratissime, ultimum quaesitum fecit.

unit.source: "All of it," Lumian confirmed, earning Ludwig’s approval.
unit.target: "Omne," confirmavit Lumian, ac consensum Ludwig adeptus est.

unit.source: After a while, dishes like beet soup, red wine beef stew, cream‑fried cod, caviar, grilled meat skewers, appetizer salad, thick‑cut steaks, and Feysac pies were served one by one.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, fercula ut puls betarum, bubulum in vino rubro coctum, gadum in cremo frigitum, caviar, spicula carnium assarum, insalāta ad gustum initium, bifecta crassa, et placentae Feysacianae uno post alium ministrabantur.

unit.source: Ludwig was utterly immersed in a sea of flavors, and Lumian, too, let himself indulge.
unit.target: Ludwig in mari saporum omnino immersus erat, et Lumian quoque se in voluptatibus immergebat.

unit.source: As a Sequence 5 Reaper, his appetite was already not small, and similarly, Harvest Priest Lugano, starting as a Planter, was eating more and more.
unit.target: Ut Sequencia V Messor, eius appetitus iam non parvus erat, et similiter Sacerdos Messis Lugano, qui ut Plantator coeperat, amplius edebat.

unit.source: After nearly filling their stomachs, as Lumian savored the salty, fishy burst of the caviar in his mouth and awaited the arrival of dessert, he pondered over the recent events.
unit.target: Paene ventres suos implevissent, dum Lumian saborebat salsam et piscosam eruptionem caviar in ore suo atque adventum deserti exspectabat, recentia eventa meditatus est.

unit.source: Why did Ludwig just vaguely sense the presence of the bird‑clawed baby, and then in the blink of an eye, it vanished?
unit.target: Cur Ludwig modo vago sensu praesentiam infantis ungulis avium percipiebat, et in ictu oculi illa evanuit?

unit.source: Could it be that we were exactly thirty meters apart, and just one step further would break the range of perception?
unit.target: Num ita esset ut inter nos exacte triginta metra essent, et solum unus passus ultra finem perceptionis attigeret?

unit.source: This is too coincidental… If it were arranged, they would have let Ludwig keep sensing it…
unit.target: Hoc nimis fortuito accidit… Si praeordinatum fuisset, Ludwig ut id sentiret permissum fuisset.

unit.source: If Ludwig could sense the bird‑clawed baby, could the baby also sense its ‘mother’ approaching? Did it detect the deceased ‘mother’ appearing in an unnatural way and immediately leave the area or hide, severing the connection between them?
unit.target: Si Ludwig infanti ungulis avium sentire poterat, num et infans matrem suam appropinquare percipere poterat? Num sensit matrem defunctam, in modo innaturali apparentem, et statim regionem reliquisse aut se celasse, vinculum inter eos dissolvens?

unit.source: This explanation is more reasonable, not reliant on coincidence…
unit.target: Haec explicatio magis rationabilis videtur, non casu innixa.

unit.source: Now the question arises, if it wasn’t a coincidence, why did the bird‑clawed baby appear on this street?
unit.target: Nunc quaestio oritur: si non ex casu fuit, cur infans ungulis avium in hac platea apparuit?

unit.source: It couldn’t possibly just be passing by and happened to bump into us, right?
unit.target: Non potuit tamen esse, ut mero transiret et casu nobis incidisset, nonne?

unit.source: If it truly is the law of convergence, it’s still unclear whether it’s due to a bloodline connection or a law of repulsion…
unit.target: Si vere lex convergence est, adhuc non constat utrum ex nexu sanguinis sive ex lege repulsionis oritur.

unit.source: Lumian picked up the napkin that was on his lap, folded it neatly, and stood up, pushing the stack of gold hoorn to Lugano.
unit.target: Lumian linteum, qui in gremio suo iacebat, arripuit, diligenter plicavit, et surrexit, fasciculum aurorum hoornu ad Lugano impellens.

unit.source: "I’ll take a walk nearby to see if there’s anything worth buying; you take care of Ludwig and remember to pay for the meal."
unit.target: "Ambulabo prope ut videam, si quid emendi fuerit dignum; tu cura Ludwig et memento solvere pretium ferculi."

unit.source: "Sure," Lugano was happy to remain seated without moving.
unit.target: "Sane," inquit Lugano, laetus sedere immotus.

unit.source: Lumian left St. Millom Restaurant with a leisurely gait, taking in all the shops and pedestrians along the street.
unit.target: Lumian cauponam Sancti Millom lento ambulando reliquit, omnes tabernas atque viatores per plateam observans.

unit.source: There were banks, candy stores, cafés, and shops selling Feysacian imported goods, with no suspicious individuals in sight.
unit.target: Erant argentariae, dulciaria, cauponae, et tabernae quae bona ex Feysac importata venderentur, nec quisquam suspectus in conspectu apparuit.

unit.source: The passersby were mostly Feysacians and Raklev locals, the latter often carrying talismans made from their relatives’ skulls—some wore them as hats, others strung them into necklaces, and some sewed them onto their clothing at the shoulder.
unit.target: Transientes plerumque Feysaciani et indigeni Raklevenses erant; illi saepe talismata ex calvariis cognatorum suorum portabant—quidam eos ut petasos gerebant, alii in monilia stringebant, et quidam in vestimentis ad humeros conserebant.

unit.source: It is not apparent who might attract the bird‑clawed baby and its associates here, nor which building might harbor something unusual… Lumian pondered as he walked along the street, hoping for a “chance encounter.”
unit.target: Non patet quis hic infans ungulis avium et socios eius attrahere possit, nec quaedam aedificia aliquid insolitum celare; Lumian dum per plateam ambulabat, fortunatam congressum sperabat.

unit.source: Unfortunately, this did not happen.
unit.target: Infeliciter, hoc non accidit.

unit.source: Finally, he finished his stroll along the street and returned to St. Millom Restaurant.
unit.target: Denique iter per plateam conficiens, ad cauponam Sancti Millom rediit.

unit.source: The two Demonesses leisurely enjoyed a lavish Feysacian meal, their prominent position and striking looks drawing the gaze of everyone who came and went.
unit.target: Duae Demonessae opulentum convivium Feysacianum tranquille degustabant, eorum eminens positio ac speciosa vultus oculos omnium venientium et abeundorum attrahentes.

unit.source: Some even made a point of passing by their table repeatedly.
unit.target: Nonnulli etiam certo se praecipue constituerunt, mensam eorum iterum atque iterum adire.

unit.source: Lumian took the opportunity to admire the Demonesses’ beauty.
unit.target: Lumian occasionem cepit ad pulchritudinem Demonessarum admirandam.

unit.source: Suddenly, a thought struck him:
unit.target: Subito, cogitatio eum percussit:

unit.source: Ludwig only sensed the bird‑clawed baby near St. Millom Restaurant…
unit.target: Ludwig tantum sensisse infantis ungulis avium iuxta cauponam Sancti Millom percipiebat…

unit.source: Franca and Jenna were right here in the restaurant…
unit.target: Franca et Jenna hic ipsae in caupona erant…

unit.source: Could it be that they truly attracted the attention of Oxyto, the Shaman King, who personally brought or sent the bird‑clawed baby to track them, looking for an opportunity to strike?
unit.target: Num vere ita fuerunt, ut attraxissent attentionem Oxyto, Regis Shaman, qui ipse infans ungulis avium misit ut eos sequeretur, occasionem feriendi quaerens?

unit.source: Upon discovering the scent of a deceased “mother” on Ludwig and sensing my Child of God bloodline, did Oxyto abandon his original plan, temporarily leaving this area or completely hiding?
unit.target: Cum odor matris defunctae in Ludwig detexit et sanguinis mei "Fili Dei" lineam perciperet, num Oxyto consilium suum originale deseruit, pro tempore hanc regionem reliquit, aut omnino se abscondit?

unit.source: This logic flows smoothly; there’s no issue, but how could the guardian demigod of the temperance faction completely miss Oxyto’s presence?
unit.target: Haec ratio leniter procedit; nihil quaestionis est, sed quomodo custos demideus factionis temperantiae omnino absentem Oxyto deprehenderet?

unit.source: A Shaman King is adept at concocting various magical agents and conducting rituals, perhaps using one to evade normal premonitions and intuitions?
unit.target: Rex Shaman peritus est in diversis agentibus magicis conficiendis et ritibus celebrandis, forsitan unum ad praenotiones et intuitus naturales evitandos adhibens?

unit.source: Or could it be some other method?
unit.target: An est aliquod aliud modus?

unit.source: Lumian quickly reviewed the intelligence provided by the temperance faction about the Shaman King.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter enuntiata a factione temperantiae de Rege Shaman proposita perlegit.

unit.source: His steps slowed, seemingly captivated by the beauty and charm of the two Demonesses, reluctant to look away.
unit.target: Eius passus tardaverunt, quasi ab amoenitate et decore duarum Demonessarum captus, oculos avertere minime volens.

unit.source: After analyzing the information on the Apothecary pathway up to Sequence 4 Shaman King, Lumian considered that Oxyto might have also received a boon, transitioning to female, and he recalled the information he knew about the Heretic Spellmaster pathway.
unit.target: Postquam notitias de via Apothecarii usque ad Sequenciam IV Regem Shaman examinavit, Lumian censuit Oxyto etiam beneficium recepturum fuisse, in feminam transmutatum, et memoriam revocat de via Haereticae Magiae Magistri.

unit.source: In a flash of thought, a term came to mind: Paramita!
unit.target: Subito, in mentem venit terminus: Paramita!

unit.source: (Reader’s Note: Sequence 4 of the Villain Pathway (boon) allows you to establish a new small world called “Paramita”. In this world, when humans die, their souls return to the earth and roam the wilderness. On special occasions, they can return home, be reborn and emerge from the Mother’s womb as human foetuses. Also, this sequence turns you into a woman.)
unit.target: (Nota lectoris: Sequencia IV Iter Malefici (beneficium) sinit novum mundum parvum condere, qui "Paramita" appellatur. In hoc mundo, cum homines moriuntur, animae eorum ad terram redeunt et in solitudine vagantur. Occasione speciali possunt domum redire, renati fieri, et ex utero Matris emergere ut foetūs humani apparere. Praeterea, haec sequens te in feminam vertit.)

unit.source: Paramita exists in its own right, dependent on the land, and its activities cannot be detected from the outside…
unit.target: Paramita ipsa exsistit, terrae dependentis, et eius activa exterius detegi non possunt…

unit.source: Did Oxyto use some application of Paramita to evade the gaze of the temperance faction’s demigod and follow Franca and Jenna undetected?
unit.target: Num Oxyto usum aliquo Paramitae adhibuit ut oculos demidei factionis temperantiae vitaret et Francam atque Jennam inopinato sequeretur?

unit.source: Hmm, were those bird‑clawed babies taken into Paramita after they crawled out of their “mothers”?
unit.target: Hmm, num illi infantes ungulis avium in Paramita recepti sunt postquam ex “matre” extraxerunt?

unit.source: With Paramita clearly involving the domain of death, were these “mothers” dead before the bird‑clawed babies tore out?
unit.target: Cum Paramita manifeste regnum mortis amplectitur, num hae “matres” iam mortuae erant antequam infantes ungulis avium evellerent?

unit.source: In that case, from birth, they bear a strong taint of death, seamlessly blending into Paramita…
unit.target: Ergo, ex ortu, fortem maculam mortis ferunt et in Paramita perfecte miscentur…

unit.source: Just now, Paramita was unfolding, watching Franca and Jenna, waiting to make a move, and upon sensing the presence of the deceased “mother” and the bloodline of a Child of God, Paramita immediately retracted, cutting off this close connection?
unit.target: Modo Paramita se explicabat, Francam et Jennam spectans, agendi occasionem exspectans, et praesentiam defunctae “matris” atque sanguinis Filii Dei percipiens, statim recessit, hunc nexum intimam interrumpens?

unit.source: No wonder Ludwig’s sensing of the bird‑clawed baby was so vague… it was because it was inside Paramita!
unit.target: Non mirum quod sensus Ludwig de infante ungulis avium tam vago fuit… id enim quod illud intra Paramita erat!

unit.source: Moreover, the local Skull Blessing Festival clearly reveres death, which can be linked to Paramita… Could Oxyto’s deep‑seated purpose for coming to the Raklev region be hidden in this?
unit.target: Praeterea, festival localis Benedictionis Crani manifeste mortem colit, quae ad Paramita referi potest… Num profundum propositum Oxyto ad regionem Raklev veniendi in hoc latet?

unit.source: With his speculation, Lumian approached Franca and Jenna’s table with a genuine smile and politely asked in Intisian—like any real Intisian would do—
unit.target: Cum his cogitationibus, Lumian ad mensam Francae et Jennae accessit, genuino risu, et comiter rogavit, more Intisiano, quem quis verus Intisian faceret:

unit.source: "May I have the honor of sitting here for a few minutes, beautiful ladies?"
unit.target: "Licetne mihi honorem sit hic sedendi aliquot minuta obtinere, pulcherrimae dominae?"

unit.source: Franca replied in amusement, "Are you also from Intis?"
unit.target: Franca, amans risu, respondit: "Num et tu ex Intis es?"

unit.source: She knew Lumian’s approach wasn’t simply to chat her up; he must have another purpose, so she played along very cooperatively.
unit.target: Scivit Lumiani accessum non esse solum ad colloquendum, sed etiam alterum propositum habere, et ideo valde cooperative consentiens agens luserat.

unit.source: "Yes, which is why I felt a connection as soon as I saw you," Lumian fully utilized the pickup lines he’d learned from everyday life in Trier.
unit.target: "Ita, proinde te videns statim nexum senserim," inquit Lumian, verba captandi cotidiana in Trier didicisse plene adhibens.

unit.source: At a nearby table, several men who were covertly listening in thought simultaneously:
unit.target: Apud mensam vicinam, plures viri caute auscultantes simul cogitabant:

unit.source: Damn Intisians!
unit.target: Maledicti Intisiani!

unit.source: Curse those Intisian playboys!
unit.target: Maledicti illi Intisiani frivoli pueruli!

unit.source: Jenna’s response was natural, tinged with a hint of wariness and surprise.
unit.target: Responsum Jennae naturale erat, leviter cautela et admiratione tinctum.

unit.source: "Are you here in Raklev for travel or business?"
unit.target: "Esne hic in Raklev ad iter faciendum aut negotia exercenda?"

unit.source: As she spoke, Jenna signaled the waiter, who brought over a chair for Lumian beside their table.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Jenna ministrum indicavit, qui sellam pro Lumiano iuxta mensam attulit.

unit.source: Lumian sat down and said to the two Demonesses, "Your beauty is like something out of a dream. No, even in my dreams, I haven’t seen anyone as beautiful as you. You must have caught many an eye along the way?"
unit.target: Lumian consedit et duabus Demonessis dixit: "Vestra pulchritudo quasi ex somnio est. Immo, etiam in somniis meis neminem tam pulchrum vidi quam vos. Certe multos oculos cepistis, nonne?"

unit.source: Dammit, these sweet nothings are giving me goosebumps! At this moment, Franca would have preferred if Lumian mocked her.
unit.target: Heu, haec dulcia inania me excitant! Hoc tempore, Franca maluisset, si Lumian eam irriduisset.

unit.source: Of course, she was still secretly pleased; after all, she had heard from Browns Sauron that every Demoness who had transitioned from male would have a bit of narcissism—fond of and proud of her feminine self.
unit.target: Certe, tamen, ea arcane delectabatur; nam a Saurone Brunis audiverat quod omnis Demonessa, quae a masculo transmutata esset, modicum de sua feminitate amoris ac superbiae haberet.

unit.source: Jenna felt both discomfort and amusement, much like encountering a pretentious drunkard while playing a Witch.
unit.target: Jenna et incommodum et oblectationem sensit, quasi invenerit ebrium praetentiosum dum magam luderet.

unit.source: Her acting was good; she showed no oddity and smiled mockingly.
unit.target: Ars eius optima erat; nihil insolitum ostendit et subridente irridens se gessit.

unit.source: "Really? Would you dare to look into my eyes and say that again?"
unit.target: "Revera? Audeasne in oculos meos intuitus id iterum dicere?"

unit.source: Seeing the handsome young man genuinely sit beside the beautiful ladies and engage in pleasant conversation, seemingly stirring emotions, the surrounding men lamented, "How can they be so superficial, only considering looks? That’s how you get deceived!"
unit.target: Videns iuvenem formosum sincere iuxta pulchras mulieres sedere et amoenam conversationem agere, motus animos excitare videt, viri circumstantium lamentabant: "Quomodo tantopere superficiales esse possunt, solum speciem attendentes? Hoc modo decipis!"

unit.source: Lumian laughed, looking into Jenna’s eyes and said, "The moment I saw you, I knew what true beauty was."
unit.target: Lumian risit, in oculos Jennae intuentem, et dixit: "Momentum te vidi, cognovi quid vera pulchritudo esset."

unit.source: "..." How can this guy say such things without feeling nauseous? Jenna avoided Lumian’s gaze, answering his earlier question, "You know, some gazes make one feel uncomfortable."
unit.target: "..." Quomodo hic vir talia dicere potest sine nausea? Jenna oculos Lumiani evasit, quaestioni antehac eius respondens: "Scis, quaedam aspectus incommoda faciunt."

unit.source: "Any gaze more peculiar than others?" Lumian asked with a smile.
unit.target: "Estne ullus aspectus magis singularis quam cetera?" inquit Lumian subridente.

unit.source: Franca, understanding what he was probing for, shook her head. "No."
unit.target: Franca, intellegens quid quaereret, caput movit. "Non."

unit.source: Lumian nodded pensively.
unit.target: Lumian penside annuit.

unit.source: "The weather here is rather cold; did you feel something similar earlier?"
unit.target: "Tempestas hic satis frigida est; num ante aliquid simile sensisti?"

unit.source: Franca recalled for a moment, pursed her lips, and said, "It started a bit on Chapin Street and lasted until just before the beet soup was served; the soup was warm and made us no longer feel cold."
unit.target: Franca paulisper meminit, labia contraxit, et dixit: "Paululum in via Chapin coepit et duravit usque paulo antequam puls betarum ministrari inciperet; pulmentum calidum erat et nos frigore destitit."

unit.source: Paramita that involves the realm of death made the surroundings feel a bit colder? Lumian said with a smile to Franca, "Perhaps that’s the lack of a reliable man’s warmth."
unit.target: Num Paramita, quae regnum mortis involvit, circumstantia paululum frigida efficit? Inquit Lumian Francae subridente: "Forsitan hoc defectus caloris virilis fideli est."

unit.source: Franca’s face twitched, and she communicated with Lumian using her eyes and lips.
unit.target: Vultus Francae contorsus est, et oculis atque labris cum Lumiano communicavit.

unit.source: Please, no more playing the playboy!
unit.target: Quaeso, non amplius age puerilem ludibrio!

unit.source: As the three conversed, the image of a woman wearing a petite black cap and a light golden bun appeared faintly on the surface of a gold‑leaf mirror embedded in the wall.
unit.target: Dum tres colloquebantur, imago feminae, quae parvum pileum nigrum et leviter aureum nodum in capillis gerebat, in speculo folio auri in pariete inseto tenuiter apparuit.

unit.source: She rested her chin in her hand, her gaze occasionally focused on Lumian and Jenna, then shifting between Lumian and Franca, and assessing Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Mentum suum in manu requievit, oculos interdum in Lumiano et Jennā incumbentes, deinde inter eos alternos transferens atque Francam et Jennam aestimans.

unit.source: 763 Folklore Origins
unit.target: 763 Origines Fabularum

unit.source: 763 Folklore Origins
unit.target: 763 Origines Fabularum

unit.source: Lumian “kept his promise” and sat at the table with the two Demonesses for only a few minutes before politely taking his leave, leaving the nearby men somewhat perplexed and puzzled.
unit.target: Lumian promissum suum servavit et ad mensam cum duabus daemonissis tantum paucis minutis consedit, deinde comiter discessit, relinquens viros proximos aliquantulum perplexos et stupefactos.

unit.source: Shouldn’t he have seized the opportunity to pursue further?
unit.target: Num occasionem ulterius persequendi non cepisset?

unit.source: Could this be the advanced technique of an Intisian playboy and Dandyist?
unit.target: Num hoc ars provecta ludentis Intisiani et dandisti esse possit?

unit.source: Walking back to his own table, Lumian saw waiters carrying a towering stack of plates, their faces a mix of confusion, shock, and fear as they walked away.
unit.target: Ambulans ad suam mensam, Lumian vidit ministris portantibus altam seriem patinarum, quorum vultus confusione, stupore, et timore mixti erant dum abeunt.

unit.source: All the dishes on the menu had really been devoured!
unit.target: Omnia fercula in menu vere devorata erant!

unit.source: The look in their eyes towards Ludwig and Lugano was as if they were staring at monsters who had crawled out of the abyss.
unit.target: Aspectus in oculis eorum versus Ludovicum et Lugano erat quasi intuerentur monstra, quae e abyssis reperegerunt.

unit.source: If you knew that two-thirds of those dishes and mains were consumed by Ludwig, and Lugano and I only shared the remaining third, you’d be even more scared, worried you might be eaten too.
unit.target: Si scires duas partes trium illorum ferculorum a Ludovico devoratas esse, et Lugano et ego solum reliquam tertiam partem communicavisse, adhuc fortius terrebres, sollicitus ne etiam tu devorarer.

unit.source: Well, that worry would be justified… Lumian muttered silently as he sat down.
unit.target: Ita enim, illa sollicitudo esset iusta… Lumian tacite murmurebat dum sedebat.

unit.source: Before him, Ludwig, and Lugano, there was now a slice of apple cake and a cup of richly flavored ice cream.
unit.target: Ante eum, Ludovicum, et Lugano, iam erat frustum placentae pomorum et poculum gelati lactis opulentissime sapidi.

unit.source: Ludwig’s face was unmasked in satisfaction, the most fulfilled he had felt in a long time.
unit.target: Vultus Ludovici in laetitia patefactus erat, maxime impletus quam diu sensit.

unit.source: This was not only because the Feysacian meals were generous in portion and tasty but also because it didn’t hurt Lumian to spend someone else’s money.
unit.target: Hoc non solum quod fercula Feysaciana porcionibus largis et sapidis parata erant, sed etiam quod Lumiano non molestum erat alicuius pecuniam consumere.

unit.source: Lumian pushed his slice of apple cake towards Ludwig and appeared to concentrate as he scooped up the milky ice cream with a spoon and placed it in his mouth.
unit.target: Lumian suum frustum placentae pomorum versus Ludovicum impulsavit et videtur intendere, dum cochleare adhibens gelatum lacteum subleverat atque in os suum posuit.

unit.source: As he savored the melting frost and the spreading taste of milk, he whispered to himself, “Have any of you noticed anything unusual around Two of Cups and Seven of Cups?”
unit.target: Dum frigus liquescentem et gustum lactis diffundentem degustabat, sibi sussurravit: “Num quis vestrum aliquid insolitum circa Duo Calices et Septem Calices animadvertit?”

unit.source: After a brief silence, a faint, ethereal voice echoed in Lumian’s ear.
unit.target: Post brevissimum silentium, vox tenue et aetheria in aure Lumiani resonavit.

unit.source: It was from the Knight of Swords Maric.
unit.target: Ea venit a Milite Gladii Maric.

unit.source: “We did notice something, from Chaban Street until you approached St. Millom Restaurant, but only a slight abnormality was detected, and we couldn’t pinpoint its origin.”
unit.target: “Notavimus aliquid, a via Chaban usque ad te appropinquans ad Popinam Sancti Millom, sed tantum levem anomaliam detegimus, nec eius originem determinare potuimus.”

unit.source: This matches Franca’s description and my speculation, confirming each other…
unit.target: Hoc correspondet cum descriptione Francae et speculatione meā, invicem confirmantes…

unit.source: The temperance faction’s demigod is unable to catch Oxyto even though they have started tracking Franca and Jenna…
unit.target: Semideus factionis temperantiae Oxyton capere non potest, quamquam Francam et Jennam vestigiari coeperunt…

unit.source: Can we only wait for Oxyto to make a move?
unit.target: Possumusne tantum exspectare ut Oxyto quid agere incipiat?

unit.source: Lumian thought for a few seconds and pulled out a pair of non‐prescription, plain gold‐rimmed glasses for disguise from his Traveler’s Bag, placing them on his nose.
unit.target: Lumian aliquot momenta meditatus est et duo oculi, specula non praescripta et simplicia sed aureo margine ornata, ex sacculo viatoris sui extraxit, ea in naso suo collocans.

unit.source: He immediately saw the image of the Knight of Swords dressed in a shirt and vest highlighted in the lenses, then disappearing.
unit.target: Statim imaginem Militis Gladii, induti camisam et vestem, in speculis illustratam, deinde evanescere, vidit.

unit.source: The voice of Maric became clearer.
unit.target: Vox Marici clarior facta est.

unit.source: “We occasionally find such slight abnormalities and corresponding traces too, and that is also one of the main reasons we are sure that Oxyto is still in the Raklev area.”
unit.target: “Interdum invenimus et talia levia anomaliae et vestigia correspondenta, quod etiam una ex causis praecipuis est, qua certi sumus Oxyton adhuc in regione Raklev esse.”

unit.source: Can Paramita alone achieve this, managing to move undetected under the nose of a demigod with strong spiritual intuition?
unit.target: Num Paramita sola hoc efficere potest, sinit movendi sine detegentia sub naso semidei cum valida intuitu spirituali?

unit.source: Lumian, lacking a deep understanding of Paramita, could only speculate based on his past experiences.
unit.target: Lumian, profundae Paramitae cognitione carens, tantum ex experimentis praeteritis coniectare poterat.

unit.source: He had entered Paramita more than once!
unit.target: Plusquam semel in Paramita ingressus est!

unit.source: In Cordu, whether in reality or in dreams, he had entered Paramita several times, but at that time, without high‐level forces involved, he couldn’t judge the normal state of Paramita and whether it could deceive a demigod’s senses and intuition when it unfolded;
unit.target: In Cordu, sive in re sive in somniis, pluries in Paramita intravit, sed eo tempore, sine viribus altioribus praesentibus, non potuit aestimare statum normalem Paramitae nec utrum sensus atque intuitus semidei decipi possent cum ipsa evolvebatur;

unit.source: In Trier, during the Tree of Shadow catastrophe, he was involuntarily drawn into Lady Moon’s Paramita, which effectively isolated the inside from the outside, preventing Trier’s demigods from detecting the growth of the Tree of Shadow and the fighting in that area.
unit.target: In Trieri, durante catastropha Arbores Umbrae, invitus in Paramita Dominae Lunae trahendus fuit, quae efficaciter interiora ab exterioribus segregavit, impediens semideos Trieri arboris umbrae incrementum ac pugnam in illa regione detegere.

unit.source: It was only through Franca’s use of the Judgment card and the unique properties of Madam Judgment that they managed to establish a connection with the outside world, allowing the Tarot Club’s demigods to pinpoint and descend into Paramita.
unit.target: Sola per usum chartae Iudicii a Franca et proprietates unicas Dominae Iudicii comparaverunt connexionem cum orbe externo, quod permisit semideis Taroc Club ad exacte determinandum et descensum in Paramita.

unit.source: At that time, the demigods of Trier were far from Rue Anarchie, unaware of anything hidden there, which could be understood and accepted…
unit.target: Illo tempore, semidei Trieri longe ab Rue Anarchie erant, nescii quidquid ibi celatum esset, quod intellegi atque accipi posset…

unit.source: Memories flashed through Lumian’s mind, and he always felt that Paramita could not reach the current extent.
unit.target: Memoriae in mente Lumiani fulserunt, et semper sensit Paramitam ad huiusmodi amplitudinem non pervenire posse.

unit.source: When Paramita closed, it was normal that the temperance faction’s demigod couldn’t sense it even if nearby, but how could it remain undetected after unfolding right under the nose of the temperance faction’s demigod?
unit.target: Cum Paramita clauserit, naturale erat quod semideus factionis temperantiae eam, etiam prope, non deprehenderet; sed quomodo potuit manere latens postquam ipsa sub naso semidei evoluta est?

unit.source: Is it that powerful?
unit.target: Estne ita potens?

unit.source: I think even Lady Moon’s Paramita couldn’t achieve that, only capable of masking activities and protecting itself through distance from being detected…
unit.target: Puto etiam Paramita Dominae Lunae id efficere non posse; sola idonea est ad operas occultandas atque se per distantiam ab detectione protegendam…

unit.source: Lumian turned his gaze to the window, seeing two locals among the passersby; one had a human skull painted purple hanging on his chest, and the other tied a bleached white human skull on top of his head.
unit.target: Lumian ad fenestram respexit, duos inter transeuntes locales videns; unus calvariam humanam purpuream in pectore pendentem habebat, alterque calvariam albidam in summitate capitis sui alligavit.

unit.source: Death worship…
unit.target: Cultus mortis…

unit.source: Paramita…
unit.target: Paramita…

unit.source: Perhaps, Shaman King Oxyto has developed a special aspect of his Paramita in the Raklev area, which allows him to unfold it in front of a demigod without being detected, at least until there’s substantial interaction…
unit.target: Forsitan, Rex Shaman Oxyto specialem partem Paramitae suae in regione Raklev evolverit, quae ei permittit eam in conspectu semidei sine detegentia evolvere, saltem donec notabilis interactio fiat…

unit.source: Lumian speculated, piecing together Madame Pualis’s plan to use the folklore of Cordu to enhance her own Paramita.
unit.target: Lumian speculavit, consilium Dominae Pualis colligens, ut fabulas Cordi ad suam Paramitam augendam adhiberet.

unit.source: Lumian took another spoonful of milky ice cream and lowered his voice again.
unit.target: Lumian alterum cochlearium gelati lactei cepit et vocem suam iterum demisit.

unit.source: “Tell me more about the origins and circumstances of the Skull Blessing Festival.”
unit.target: “Dic mihi plura de originibus ac circumstantiis Festi Benedictionis Calvariae.”

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric replied clearly in his ear, “It dates back to the fall of Death, when the situation on the Southern Continent fundamentally changed.
unit.target: Miles Ensis Maric clare in aure respondit: “Ad lapsum Mortis revocatur, cum res in Continente Meridionali fundanter mutatae erant.

unit.source: “The fall of Death caused disturbances in the Underworld, leaving most spirits unable to sense or enter it, forced instead to wander its periphery, between the spirit world and the real world.
unit.target: “Lapsus Mortis perturbationes in Orcum attulit, multos spiritus sensu aut ingresso impeditos relinquens, qui potius per eius limitem vagari coacti sunt, inter mundum spiritualem et reale.

unit.source: “As a result, when sentient beings die, they are very likely to become undead, wraiths, or evil spirits—a grave threat to the living, leading to one disaster after another.
unit.target: “Ergo, cum entia animata moriuntur, verisimile est ut in non mortuos, umbras, aut spiritus malignos transformentur—periculum grave viventibus praebentes, quod in catenam calamitatum ducit.

unit.source: “The response of the Northern Continent nations has been Church-sanctioned purification combined with compulsory cremation.
unit.target: “Responsum nationum Continenti Septentrionali fuit purgatio Ecclesia-sancta combinata cum crematione compulsoria.

unit.source: Here, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the God of Combat Church have had notable success with purification, making cremation unnecessary for those who have been purified.
unit.target: Hic, Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardoris et Ecclesia Dei Pugnae purificatione insignem successum adeptae sunt, ita ut crematio iis, qui purgati sunt, non necessaria sit.

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian truly understood and appreciated the various measures taken before and after death, including consoling the dying, purifying the dead, encouraging cremation, and rewarding the discovery of deceased vagrants.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian vere intellexit et aestimavit varias rationes ante et post mortem captas, inter quas consolatio morientium, purgatio mortuorum, cremationis hortatio, et inventio vagantium defunctorum praemia habens.

unit.source: The origins of all these practices was the fall of Death and the subsequent anomalies in the Underworld!
unit.target: Origines harum omnium praxium erant lapsus Mortis atque subsequentiae anomaliae in Orcu!

unit.source: No wonder the old bones in the lower layers of the underground tombs are still bones, not ashes…
unit.target: Non mirum est ossa vetera in inferioribus stratis sepulchrorum subterraneorum adhuc ossa esse, non cineres…

unit.source: During the Fourth Epoch, the Underworld hadn’t yet been disturbed, and the spirits had a place to return to…
unit.target: Durante Aetate Quarta, Orcus nondum perturbatus erat, et spiritibus locus ad rediendum exstitit…

unit.source: Some mysticism knowledge suggests that bodies are prone to transform at the end of the Fourth Epoch during the Pale Disaster, caused by Death’s invasion of the Northern Continent.
unit.target: Nonnulla arcana doctrinalia suggerunt corpora ad mutationem inclinari in fine Aetatis Quartae, in tempore Caliginis Palae, ex invasione Mortis in Continentem Septentrionalem causam habentia.

unit.source: Indeed, it is the legacy of the Pale Disaster; Death perished during that disaster, leading to the anomaly in the Underworld… Lumian suddenly realized, gaining a deeper understanding of certain mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Revera, hoc est legatum Caliginis Palae; Mors periit eo casu, quod ad anomaliam in Orcu duxit… Lumian subito intellexit, profundius cognitionem quarundam doctrinarum mysticarum adeptus.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords continued, “The same issues arose on the Southern Continent, but the Balam Empire, home to many Beyonders following the Death pathway, swiftly devised several solutions that quelled the undead outbreaks in certain areas without resorting to mandatory cremation, thus restoring normalcy.
unit.target: Miles Ensis continuavit: “Eadem problemata in Continente Meridionali evenere, sed Imperium Balam, cuius domus est plurimorum Beyonders viam Mortis sequendi, celeriter plura consilia excogitavit quae insurrectiones defunctorum in quibusdam regionibus reprimebant, ita ordinem restituentes.

unit.source: “In other regions, however, due to ongoing independence efforts from countries like Haagenti, Paz, and the Highlands, faith in Death began to wane, leading to a period of rampant undead plagues and a power vacuum. The people in these areas had no choice but to fend for themselves.”
unit.target: “In aliis regionibus, tamen, ob conatus independentiae perpetuos ex nationibus ut Haagenti, Paz, et Montes Altos, fides in Mortem minuere coepit, ducens ad tempus pestilentiae non mortuorum expansae et vacuitatis potentiae; in his regionibus populus nullam aliud optionem habebat nisi se ipsos tueri.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Is the Skull Blessing Festival a solution for the Raklev area?”
unit.target: “Festum Benedictionis Calvariae solutio est pro regione Raklev?”

unit.source: “The Skull Blessing Festival is just one manifestation,” explained the Knight of Swords simply.
unit.target: “Festum Benedictionis Calvariae tantum una manifestatio est,” explicavit Miles Ensis simpliciter.

unit.source: “According to records left by the Highlands Kingdom, it appears that the people of Raklev, with the help of a former official from the Balam Empire, established a mini‐state for the spirits, allowing the dead to enter and rest there without emerging again.
unit.target: “Secundum tabulas relictas a Regno Montes Altos, videtur populus Raklev, auxilio pristini officii ex Imperio Balam, parvam civitatem pro spiritibus condidisse, ut mortui intrare possent et ibi quiescerent sine iterum emergendo.

unit.source: “However, this isn’t the Underworld; it cannot truly offer rest, nor can it completely bind the spirits. They just have to gradually fade away.
unit.target: “Attamen, hoc non est Orcus; neque vere quietem praebet neque spiritus omnino ligare potest. Illi solum paulatim evanescere debent.

unit.source: “The annual Skull Blessing Festival is a day for the spirits to emerge, revel, and be liberated.
unit.target: “Festa annua Benedictionis Calvariae dies est quo spiritus emergere, delectari et liberari possint.

unit.source: Keeping the skulls of loved ones at home helps to protect the family from any spirits that might stray from this mini‐state, preventing them from causing harm.
unit.target: Calvarias carorum domi retinere adiuvat familiam a spiritibus, qui ab hac parva civitate egrederentur, impediens ne damnum inferant.

unit.source: In essence, they created a rudimentary, localized version of the Underworld for spirits to return to…
unit.target: In essentia, parvam et rudimentariam versionem Orci locali condiderunt, ad quam spiritus redire possint…

unit.source: A place to return to… The concept of Paramita is similar, where souls return to the earth and wander the wilderness…
unit.target: Locus ad reditionem… Conceptus Paramitae similis est, ubi animae ad terram revertere et in vasta solitudine vagari possunt…

unit.source: Moreover, in Paramita, spirits can return home on special days to enjoy the joy of reunion, much like the Raklev area’s Skull Blessing Festival…
unit.target: Praeterea, in Paramita, spiritus domum redire possunt in diebus specialibus ut gaudium reitionis fruantur, sicut in Festa Benedictionis Calvariae regionis Raklev…

unit.source: The only difference is that here, the spirits have no path to rebirth; they can only slowly fade away…
unit.target: Unica differentia est quod hic spiritibus via ad renascentiam non praebetur; solum paulatim evanescere possunt…

unit.source: Lumian compared the local state for the deceased to Paramita and grasped something subtle.
unit.target: Lumian statum localem pro defunctis cum Paramita comparavit et aliquid subtiliter intelligo percepit.

unit.source: He recalled something Louis Lund once relayed from Madame Pualis: What’s been established is merely a small, caricature Paramita, a part of the complete Paramita…
unit.target: Meminit aliquid a Ludovico Lund olim a Madame Pualis relatum: id quod constitutum est solum parva, caricaturalis Paramita, pars Paramitae completae…

unit.source: Hmm… Lumian inhaled sharply, muttering under his breath, “Could Oxyto be planning to merge this local spirit realm into his own Paramita, to make it more complete?
unit.target: Hmm… Lumian acerrime inspiravit, submurmurans sub ore suo: “Num Oxyto cogitaret hanc localem rem spirituum in suam Paramitam coniungere ut eam completiorem faceretur?

unit.source: “Has he, no, she already partially succeeded, which is why you haven’t detected her?”
unit.target: “Num illa—non, ea iam partim successerat, qua de causa eam non detegistis?”

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric paused for a moment before responding, “It’s a possibility.”
unit.target: Miles Ensis Maric paulisper sesit antequam respondit, “Possibilitas est.”

unit.source: After a brief pause, he added proactively, “We also haven’t seen that spirit realm.”
unit.target: Post brevem pausam, addidit prompte, “Illam rem spirituum quoque non vidimus.”

unit.source: Seen… Lumian was initially startled but then understood what the Knight of Swords meant.
unit.target: Visum est… Lumian initio obstupuit, sed deinde intellexit quid Miles Ensis intendisset.

unit.source: The Prisoner pathway could directly turn into wraiths, and they should have been able to see the spirit realm, but they found nothing in Raklev this time.
unit.target: Iter Carceris directe in umbras verterī poterat, et rem spirituum videre debuerunt, sed hoc tempore in Raklev nihil invenerunt.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t respond but considered another issue.
unit.target: Lumian non respondit sed aliam quaestionem consideravit.

unit.source: If Oxyto has indeed begun to merge with that mini‐spirit realm, she essentially becomes a local version of Death, and she must have sensed the Omebella bloodline in me…
unit.target: Si Oxyto revera coepit illam parvam rem spirituum coniungere, ipsa de facto versio localis Mortis efficietur, et debet in me sanguinem Omebellae sensit…

unit.source: What would her reaction be?
unit.target: Quae esset eius reactio?

unit.source: Instant anger, or seeing it as something to be exploited?
unit.target: Irae instantanea, an id ut rem ad exploitatum visum intueri?

unit.source: Why didn’t she act directly? Right, she also used the bird‐clawed monster baby to discover that Ludwig nearby had the aura of a corpse ‘mother,’ adding up to what clearly looked like bait, obviously a trap!
unit.target: Cur ea directe non egit? Recte, etiam adhibuit monstrum infans ungulis avis appendicatis, ut detegeret quod Ludwig prope habebat auram mortuae ‘matris,’ idque addens quod manifeste videbatur quasi munus, manifeste insidiae!

unit.source: That’s why she, accustomed to indulgence, held back. What she needs to do now is, seek assistance?
unit.target: Ideo ea, indulgentiae assueta, cesserit. Quid nunc facienda sit? Auxilium quaerere.

unit.source: With that thought, Lumian removed his glasses and abruptly stood up.
unit.target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian specula sua auro margine ornata sustulit et subito surrexit.

unit.source: 764 There’s Always a Corruption That Can Be Used
unit.target: 764: Semper est corruptio, quae adhiberi potest.

unit.source: 764 There’s Always a Corruption That Can Be Used
unit.target: 764: Semper est corruptio, quae adhiberi potest.

unit.source: Lumian took off his glasses and whispered, “The target should have noticed something unusual about me, but Ludwig is right beside me, giving off the ‘mother’ aura from that corpse.
unit.target: Lumian oculos vitreos sustulit et susurravit: “Scopus debuit aliquid insolitum de me animadvertere, sed Ludwig stat iuxta me, ex illo cadavere ‘mater’ auram emittens.

unit.source: With both of these factors together, the target will surely be highly suspicious and may seek assistance.
unit.target: Cum his duobus factoribus simul, scopus certe erit suspiciosus et auxilium quaerere possit.

unit.source: Be prepared.
unit.target: Estote parati.

unit.source: If it were just the Omebella bloodline alone, Oxyto might think it was merely the law of convergence at work, bringing the blasphemer of the Child of God into her presence.
unit.target: Si sola stirps Omebellae esset, Oxyto forsitan putaret id solum esse legem convergenceis in actu, quae blasphemetorem Filii Dei in praesentiam eius adduceret.

unit.source: Similarly, if it were just the ‘mother’ aura from the corpse, she might become wary or suspect that the corpse’s return to the earth had contaminated the local water, leading to the corruption of certain individuals.
unit.target: Similiter, si sola aura “mater” ex cadavere esset, illa fortasse cauta esset aut suspicaret reditum cadaveris in terram aquas locales contaminavisse, quod corruptionem quarundam inferret.

unit.source: But put together, anyone who could sense these would immediately see there was a big problem.
unit.target: Sed simul, quisquis haec sentire posset, statim agnosceret magnum esse problema.

unit.source: This couldn’t just be a coincidence; there was clearly a dangerous trap!
unit.target: Hoc non esset solum fortuita coincidentia; perspicue erat insidia periculosa!

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric’s voice seemed to come from farther away.
unit.target: Vox Equitis Gladii Maric videbatur ex longinquo provenire.

unit.source: “We’re already ready.”
unit.target: “Iam parati sumus.”

unit.source: Sensing the hidden danger and preparing even before I thought through everything and issued a reminder? They have strong spiritual intuition and rich experience… Lumian mused as he noticed Lugano, startled by his movements and deep voice, also standing up.
unit.target: Percipiens periculum occultum et praeparans iam, antequam omnia meditarem et admonitionem edicerem? Habent validam spiritualem intuitionem atque copiam experientiae… meditatus Lumian animadvertit Lugano, motibus suis atque voce profunda commotum, qui quoque surrexit.

unit.source: Ludwig wasted no time in pulling the ice cream they had abandoned closer to him and happily ate away, completely unconcerned about what might happen next.
unit.target: Ludwig nihil moratus est: gelatum, quod reliquerant, ad se traxit et laete comedebat, omnino de futuris eventibus non sollicitus.

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze swept over Lugano and Ludwig before moving to Franca and Jenna, who were enjoying their dessert.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani percurrit Lugano et Ludwig, deinde ad Francam et Jennam, quae dulcia edebant.

unit.source: He was now considering a critical question:
unit.target: Iam quaestionem gravem considerabat:

unit.source: Should they act together, or separate like they did in the morning?
unit.target: Num simul agere debeant, an ut mane seorsim agerent?

unit.source: If the earlier speculations were broadly accurate, then the bait phase to lure out Oxyto should already be over.
unit.target: Si praecedentes coniecturae late verae fuerunt, tempus allicii ad Oxyto extrahendum iam peractum debebat.

unit.source: What lay ahead would likely be probing attacks from the Shaman King and her companions.
unit.target: Quod sequentia erant, probabiliter, essent impetus inquirendi a Regina Scamanorum et comitibus eius.

unit.source: In that case, moving together would allow them to better receive protection from the temperance faction, without worrying that Oxyto might strike at a less guarded spot and capture one or two as hostages.
unit.target: In hoc casu, simul moveri illis sineret melius tutelam a factione temperantiae recipere, sine sollicitudine ne Oxyto in loco minus munito feriret ictum et unum vel duo captivis haberet.

unit.source: But if the attack was fierce enough to force the temperance faction’s hidden forces into a defensive position, staying together could lead to total annihilation.
unit.target: Sed si impetus satis ferox esset ut copias occultas factionis temperantiae in positionem defensionis cogerent, simul manere ad exitium totum ducere posset.

unit.source: Which choice was safer and more reasonable in this environment was a decision the team leader needed to make.
unit.target: Quae optio tutior et magis rationabilis in hoc ambitu esset, id decernere duce turmae incumbebat.

unit.source: Lumian walked slowly toward the restaurant’s entrance, mentally filtering through the questions and speculations he’d considered earlier.
unit.target: Lumian lente ad ostium cauponae processit, quaestiones et speculationes antea in mente meditatas revidens.

unit.source: He thought of his own description of the spirit realm in Raklev:
unit.target: Meminit propriam descriptionem regni spirituum in Raklev:

unit.source: A rudimentary, localized Underworld.
unit.target: Orbis inferni rudimentarius et in loco limitatus.

unit.source: Underworld… Lumian’s eyelids twitched, and he quietly asked again, “Can any of you see or sense the Underworld?”
unit.target: Infernum… Palpebra Lumiani concitata sunt, atque ille tacite iterum rogavit: “Num quis vestrum infernum videre aut sentire potest?”

unit.source: He was asking whether Zombies and Wraiths could detect the Underworld.
unit.target: Rogabat an mortui ambulantes et umbrae infernum deprehendere possent.

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric quickly answered, “No, unless someone directly opens the door to the Underworld or is already from there. Otherwise, it can only be sensed through certain traces.
unit.target: Eques Gladii Maric celeriter respondit, “Non, nisi aliquis ianuam directe ad infernum aperiat aut ex eo iam proveniat. Aliter, tantum per quaedam vestigia deprehendi potest.

unit.source: “Before the Underworld anomaly, it was possible.”
unit.target: “Ante anomaliam inferni, id fieri poterat.”

unit.source: It was possible before the Underworld anomaly? Is this inferred from ancient records?
unit.target: Potestne hoc fuisse ante anomaliam inferni? Num hoc ex antiquis documentis deducitur?

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t particularly concerned about this; instead, he was more interested in something else:
unit.target: Lumian hoc non valde curabat; potius aliud eum magis occupabat:

unit.source: If Oxyto has indeed begun integrating the local spirit realm into her Paramita, does that mean her Paramita qualifies as a small-scale Underworld?
unit.target: Si Oxyto vere coepit regnum spirituum localem in Paramita sua integrare, num illa Paramita ut parvus orbis inferni consideranda sit?

unit.source: Moreover, it had to be a small-scale Underworld that was still bound to this region.
unit.target: Praeterea, debebat esse infernum parvum, quod adhuc huic regione alligatus esset.

unit.source: Otherwise, based on Lumian’s understanding of Paramita, Oxyto could have easily taken her Paramita away and left the area.
unit.target: Alioquin, secundum intellectum Lumiani de Paramita, Oxyto facile illam Paramita abducere potuisset et regionem relinquere.

unit.source: Of course, it’s also possible that she hadn’t achieved another goal yet.
unit.target: Certe, etiam possibile est quod alia propositum nondum perficeret.

unit.source: A small-scale Underworld… Lumian muttered to himself and then walked toward Franca and Jenna, smiling as he said, “I heard Chaban Street is unique to this area. Would you two lovely ladies like to be my guides?”
unit.target: Infernum parvum… Lumian sibi submurmuravit et deinde ad Francam et Jennam ambulavit, subridente dicens: “Audivi viam Chaban huic regione unicam esse. Velitisne, o pulcherrimae mulieres, mihi duces esse?”

unit.source: Chaban Street was where Franca and Jenna had first noticed the temperature drop slightly, indicating that they might have encountered Oxyto there.
