unit.target: Via Chaban erat locus in quo Franca et Jenna primum animadvertēbant levem lapsum temperiei, quod indicabat fortasse ibi Oxyto occurrisse.

unit.source: In the eyes of the nearby customers, Lumian’s invitation was a blatant attempt to arrange a date. However, Franca and Jenna exchanged a glance and understood that Lumian was suggesting they should act together, with Chaban Street as their destination.
unit.target: In oculis clientium proximorum, invitatio Lumiani manifesta erat conatus ad conventum amoris ordinandum. Attamen, Franca et Jenna oculos inter se commutaverunt et intellexerunt Lumian eos simul agere, Via Chaban destinata servare.

unit.source: “Sure.” Franca and Jenna smiled in unison and stood up.
unit.target: “Certe.” Franca et Jenna simul subriserunt et surrexerunt.

unit.source: This left those around them somewhat stunned:
unit.target: Hoc reliquit eos circumstantes paulo attonitos:

unit.source: Are they that easy to invite?
unit.target: Suntne illae tam facile invitandae?

unit.source: If I’d known, I would have plucked up the courage to ask!
unit.target: Si id scivissem, animum ad rogandum colligerem!

unit.source: Together, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and the others strolled toward Chaban Street, exchanging relaxed remarks about their impressions of the city.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian, Franca, Jenna, et alii ad Via Chaban ambulaverunt, inter se leviter de impressionibus urbis sermones commutantes.

unit.source: About fifteen minutes later, they reached the street predominantly occupied by locals.
unit.target: Circiter quindecim minutis post, viam attigerunt, quae praecipue incolis frequentabatur.

unit.source: Gray-white stone houses stood in rows, appearing rugged yet solid.
unit.target: Domus lapideae cinereo-albae in ordines steterunt, aspicientes asperae sed robustae.

unit.source: Outside each house, strips of wool hung, adding a vibrant, exotic touch that distinguished it from the Star Highlands.
unit.target: Extra singulas domos, fascias lanae pendent, addentes notam vibrantem atque exoticam, quae eam ab Alpibus Stellatis distinguebatur.

unit.source: Compared to other streets in Raklev City, the locals here were more likely to wear traditional clothing: dark red woolen robes for men and brightly colored skirts for women.
unit.target: Comparato aliis viis in Urbe Raklev, incolae hic verisimiliori modo vestimenta traditionalia gerere solebant: viris tunicas ex lana obscuro rubras et mulieribus stolas vividissimas.

unit.source: Similarly, many of them carried skull amulets of various designs, some mottled and brown with wool wigs, some painted purple, green, and red, and some holding caramel-colored tobacco from East Balam between their teeth.
unit.target: Similiter, multi ex eis amuleta calvaria variorum specierum gerebant: quaedam maculatae et fuscae cum capillis ex lana, quaedam purpurea, viridis, et rubra picta, et quaedam tabacum colore caramello ex Oriens Balam inter dentes tenentes.

unit.source: Others appeared as white as jade, with dark eye sockets and insects crawling in and out.
unit.target: Alii apparuerunt candidi ut iaspes, cum orbiculis oculorum obscuris et insectis, quae intus et ex se serpentibus movebantur.

unit.source: Standing at the entrance to Chaban Street, Lumian paused instead of moving forward, signaling Franca and Jenna to stay slightly behind him.
unit.target: Stans ad introitum Viae Chaban, Lumian subsistebat potius quam procedere, indicans Francam et Jennam ut paulo post se manerent.

unit.source: He then took something out of his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Deinde, aliquid e sacculo viatoris sui extraxit.

unit.source: It was a golden mask, with the area around the eyes and the face painted in either black or white.
unit.target: Erat larva aurea, cum zona circum oculos et faciem sive nigro sive albo picta.

unit.source: It was an Eggers family mask crafted by Death Himself!
unit.target: Erat larva familiae Eggers, a Morte ipso facta!

unit.source: Since this pure gold mask was initially designed to help the living sense and enter the Underworld and was directly created by the deity who ruled over death and the Underworld, wearing it might reveal something related to the Underworld within a certain range.
unit.target: Cum haec larva pura auri initio destinata esset ad vivos infernum sentire et ingrediendum, et directe a deo, qui mortem et infernum regnabat, creata esset, eam gerere aliquid revelare posset quod inferno attineret intra certum spatium.

unit.source: In the Raklev region, the local spirit realm was akin to a small, rudimentary Underworld.
unit.target: In regione Raklev, regnum spirituum localis simile erat parvo, rudimentario inferno.

unit.source: If the local spirit realm had really been integrated into Oxyto’s Paramita, seeing it would be equivalent to seeing that Paramita, revealing Shaman King Oxyto!
unit.target: Si regnum spirituum localis vere in Paramita Oxyto integratum fuisset, id videre aequivaleret illae Paramitae, revelans Regina Scamanorum Oxyto!

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian donned the golden Eggers family mask.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian larvam auream familiae Eggers indutus est.

unit.source: His breath rapidly cooled, becoming increasingly still.
unit.target: Spiritus eius celeriter refrigit, atque paulatim magis quietus fit.

unit.source: His body went cold in an instant, losing the sensation of life, and his blood ceased to flow.
unit.target: Corpus eius statim frigescere coepit, sensum vitae amittens, et sanguis eius fluere desiit.

unit.source: Through the golden mask, Lumian noticed the surroundings dimming slightly, with the colors fading and the temperature dropping a little.
unit.target: Per larvam auream, Lumian animadvertit circumstantia paulum obscurari, cum coloribus deficiendo et temperie paululum decrescente.

unit.source: Apart from that, everything appeared normal.
unit.target: Praeter hoc, omnia normaliter apparuerunt.

unit.source: So, this is the world through the eyes of the undead?
unit.target: Ergo, hic orbis est per oculos mortuorum ambulantium?

unit.source: I can’t see any trace of that spirit realm…
unit.target: Nullam vestigium illius regni spirituum videre possum…

unit.source: Is it hidden deeper due to being integrated into Paramita?
unit.target: Num altius absconditum sit propter integrationem in Paramita?

unit.source: Hmm, I can sense the spirit world directly but can’t detect the Underworld…
unit.target: Hmm, regnum spirituum directe sentire possum, sed infernum deprehendere non valeo…

unit.source: No wonder one has to wait for an opportunity to enter the Underworld instead of simply locating it and teleporting there after wearing the Eggers family mask…
unit.target: Non mirum est, ut aliquis occasionem exspectet ad infernum ingrediendum, pro eo quod simpliciter eum detegere et inde transire non possit, post larvam familiae Eggers gerandam.

unit.source: Lumian muttered silently, not giving up on his original theory, and tried to stimulate the lingering aura of the Blood Emperor.
unit.target: Lumian tacite submurmuravit, non relinquens primam theoriam, atque conatus est excitare remanentem auram Imperatoris Sanguinis.

unit.source: Along the entire Chaban Street, the fabric strips hanging from the walls lost their color and turned gray, while the people walking there became inexplicably blurry, as if shrouded in thick fog.
unit.target: Per totam viam Chaban, striae ex tela pendentia a parietibus colorem amiserunt atque cinerea factae sunt, dum homines ibi ambulantes inexplicabiliter, quasi in denso nebula involuti, videbantur.

unit.source: However, the skull amulets they wore remained unusually clear, their colors even more vivid by contrast.
unit.target: Attamen, amuleta calvaria, quae gerebantur, insolite perspicua manebant, eorumque colores, ob contrapositiam, magis vividique fulgebant.

unit.source: Lumian also saw pale or dark red flames ignite in the hollow sockets of those human skulls, flickering and exuding an eerie chill of death.
unit.target: Lumian etiam vidit pallidas aut obscuras rubras flammae in cavis orbitis illorum craniorum humanorum accendere, micantes et frigorem mortis terribilem effundentes.

unit.source: In that instant, Lumian realized he was “seeing” the spirit realm of Raklev.
unit.target: In illo momento, Lumian animadvertit se regnum spirituum Raklev percipere.

unit.source: It overlapped with the entire Raklev area, where spirits wandered in the shadows while humans lived openly.
unit.target: Illud totam aream Raklev cooperebat, ubi spiritus in umbris vagabantur, dum homines aperte vivebant.

unit.source: Standing on the edge of the spirit realm, Lumian didn’t attempt to step inside but instead searched from a distance for any signs of Paramita’s presence.
unit.target: Stans in margine regni spirituum, Lumian non conatus est intus ingredi, sed pro longe quaerebat vestigia praesentiae Paramitae.

unit.source: He saw a vast black cloud hanging over the sky in the direction of Lake Dalsh, saw some skulls floating mid‑air on the streets with ghostly child‑like figures flickering within their burning sockets, and saw how the wilderness below the mountains seemed to have encroached directly, blending into the city seamlessly.
unit.target: Vidit magnam nubem nigrum super caelum pendentem in directione Lacus Dalsh, vidit crania quae in aere per viarum spatia natabant, in quibus figuras infantiles phantasticae in orbitis ardentibus micabant, et vidit quomodo solitudo, infra montes, directe in urbem confluere videbatur.

unit.source: As expected… Lumian immediately had a clear realization:
unit.target: Ut expectabatur… Lumian statim claram revelationem habuit:

unit.source: Oxyto is inside this Paramita, which has merged with the spirit realm!
unit.target: Oxyto intra hanc Paramitam est, quae cum regno spirituum coniuncta est!

unit.source: With this understanding, the first thought that flashed through Lumian’s mind was: My mission ends here.
unit.target: Hoc intellegente, prima cogitatio quae per mentem Lumiani apparuit fuit: Mea missio hic finitur.

unit.source: Next, I’ll lend the Eggers family’s golden mask to the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction, leaving them to organize their forces to enter Paramita and fight Oxyto, while we return to Trier to avoid the potential danger.
unit.target: Deinde larvam auream familiae Eggers tradam Equesti Gladii et factioni temperantiae, relinquens eos ut copias suas ordinent ad Paramitam ingrediendam et cum Oxyto pugnant, dum nos ad Trier revertimur ne pericula eveniant.

unit.source: But on second thought, Lumian realized that wouldn’t work.
unit.target: Sed secundo cogitato, Lumian intellexit id non operaturum esse.

unit.source: Because if they only had the Eggers family’s golden mask and not the Underworld Daoist’s seal, even a Wraith wearing it wouldn’t be able to directly “see” Oxyto’s mutated Paramita!
unit.target: Quia, si tantum larvam auream familiae Eggers haberent et non sigillum Daoista Inferni, ne umbra eam induta quidem directe Oxytoe mutatam Paramitam videre possit!

unit.source: A possibility vaguely came to Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Aliqua possibilitas vage in mente Lumiani apparuit.

unit.source: He said in a low voice to the hidden Knight of Swords Maric, “I’ve found Oxyto’s Paramita. First, take the Two of Cups and the others to safety. Then, as Wraiths, attach yourselves to me, and I’ll lead all of you into Paramita!”
unit.target: Voce demissa ad occultum Equestem Gladii Maric dixit: “Inveni Paramitam Oxyto. Primo, cape Duos Poculorum et ceteros in securitatem; deinde, ut umbrae, coniungimini ad me, et vos omnes in Paramitam ducam!”

unit.source: “Alright.” The Knight of Swords’ somewhat ethereal voice couldn’t conceal his joy and malice. It was directed at Oxyto.
unit.target: “Bene.” Vox Equestis Gladii, aliquantum aetheria, gaudium et malitiam eius celare non potuit. Ea in Oxyto versa erat.

unit.source: 765 Howl
unit.target: 765 Ululatus

unit.source: 765 Howl
unit.target: 765 Ululatus

unit.source: Lumian thought for a moment and then specifically reminded, “Don’t forget the Four of Swords.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde specialiter admonuit: “Ne obliviscaris Quattuor Gladii!”

unit.source: To be honest, he almost overlooked Anthony’s presence, but because he was constantly thinking about what his teammates were doing and how to coordinate with them, he didn’t forget entirely.
unit.target: Ad veritatem, paene praeterspiciebat praesentiam Antonii, sed quoniam constanter de eo cogitabat quid sodales sequerentur et quomodo cum illis se coordineret, non plane obliviscebatur.

unit.source: When he invited the two Demonesses to Chaban Street at St. Millom Restaurant, Lumian didn’t think of Anthony right away.
unit.target: Cum duas Demonassas ad viam Chaban, apud Popinam Sancti Millom invitavit, Lumian non statim de Antonio cogitavit.

unit.source: It was only when he reached the street that he remembered their teammate.
unit.target: Tandem, cum viam attigit, sodalem eorum recordatus est.

unit.source: But he couldn’t find the Hypnotist, who had used Psychological Invisibility.
unit.target: Sed Hypnotistam, qui occultationem psychologicam adhibuerat, invenire non potuit.

unit.source: He could only trust that Anthony, with his rich experience, would realize that once the rest of the team had gathered together, it was clear the next actions weren’t suited to splitting up, and he would follow.
unit.target: Tantummodo confidebat quod Antonius, opulenta experientia praeditus, intellexerit postquam reliqui sodales congregati essent, manifestum fore ut sequentia consilia non ad dissociationem convenirent, atque ille sequi debetur.

unit.source: Anthony’s habits as an information broker combined well with Psychological Invisibility.
unit.target: Consuetudines Antonii, ut mercator notitiarum agirent, optime cum occultatione psychologica conveniebant.

unit.source: After a two-second pause following Lumian’s reminder, the Knight of Swords said, “We won’t forget.”
unit.target: Post duas secundas moram post admonitionem Lumiani, Eques Gladii dixit: “Non obliviscemur.”

unit.source: It seems like you already did… but the temperance faction’s demigod shouldn’t be affected much by Anthony’s Psychological Invisibility, so when sending Franca and Jenna away, they shouldn’t really forget about Anthony…
unit.target: Videtur quasi iam fecistis… sed semideus factionis temperantiae non debet nimis affici ab occultatione psychologica Antonii, itaque, cum Francam et Jennam dimitterent, vere Antonium non obliviscantur.

unit.source: If that’s the case, one major cause of death for a Hypnotist would definitely be that Psychological Invisibility works too well, causing teammates to forget or overlook them…
unit.target: Si ita sit, una ex maximis mortis causis Hypnotistae certe esset quod occultatio psychologica nimis optime operetur, efficiente ut sodales eos obliviscantur aut praetermitterent.

unit.source: As Lumian mused to himself, the special Paramita before him suddenly changed.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditaret, specialis Paramita ante eum subito mutata est.

unit.source: A deafening crash sounded from Lake Dalsh as gray-white water surged upward like a tsunami, reaching into the air.
unit.target: Ex Lago Dalsh sonuit fragor ingens, dum aquae cinereo-albae quasi tsunami in aethera surrexerunt.

unit.source: The wilderness, already intertwined with the city of Raklev, began to dominate.
unit.target: Vastitas agrestis, iam cum urbe Raklev intertexta, dominari incipiebat.

unit.source: In an instant, it crossed squares and streets, swallowing Lumian, who had not yet reached Chaban Street, while avoiding Franca and the others.
unit.target: In uno momento, per fora et vias transiit, Lumian, qui viam Chaban nondum attigerat, devorans, dum Francam et ceteros vitabat.

unit.source: Oxyto, blessed by the Great Mother, seemed to realize she had been exposed.
unit.target: Oxyto, Magna Matre benedicta, videbatur intellexisse se patefactam esse.

unit.source: Her choice was to use the nature of Paramita to temporarily separate the blasphemer of the Child of God from the temperance faction’s demigods, then exploit the brief time difference to achieve her desired goal regarding Lumian.
unit.target: Optio eius fuit ut natura Paramitae adhiberetur ad paulisper separandum blasphemerum Filii Dei a semideis factionis temperantiae, deinde brevissimo intervallo tempore ad propositum suum de Lumiano assequendum.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask and transformed into an undead, felt his body grow “heavier,” as if cold masses had taken residence inside him.
unit.target: Fere simul, Lumian, larvam auream familiae Eggers gerens et in mortuos conversus, sensit corpus suum gravius fieri, quasi massae frigidae in eo sedes dederint.

unit.source: In the next second, he saw the indistinct human figures on Chaban Street vanish, along with Franca, Jenna, Ludwig, Lugano, and possibly Anthony behind him.
unit.target: In secundo proximo, vidit figuras humanas in via Chaban indistinctas evanescere, una cum Franca, Jenna, Ludwig, Lugano, et fortasse Antonio post se.

unit.source: It was as if they were in two separate worlds.
unit.target: Ut si in duobus mundis distinctis essent.

unit.source: The human skulls in various states became increasingly distinct, their eye sockets burning with pale or dark red flames as they all turned to face Lumian.
unit.target: Crania humana variis modis magis distincta apparebant, orbitae eorum ignibus pallidisque aut obscurorum rubrorum ardentes, dum omnes ad Lumian converterentur.

unit.source: At the end of Chaban Street, at the city’s edge where it blended more deeply with the wilderness, swaying figures crawled out from unknown places and began walking toward Lumian.
unit.target: In fine viae Chaban, in oram urbis ubi cum vastitate agrestis mixtum erat, figurae vacillantes ex locis ignotis emergere coepere et in Lumian ambulare incipiebant.

unit.source: There were rotting long-haired oxen with only a few pieces of pus-oozing flesh left, giant birds with exposed bones flying low, pythons dragging half-melted threads of flesh between their decaying tissues, and monstrous hills made of multiple headless skeletons.
unit.target: Erant boves longipilos putridi, quorum tantum paucae particulae carnis suppurantis relictae erant, aves ingentes cum ossibus patentibus parvo volantes, pythones quae dimidia filum carnis liquefactae inter putrescentes telas trahentes, et colles monstruosos ex multis scheletis sine capitibus constitutos. skulls from all corners of the city were also swiftly converging on Chaban Street, floating in the air and covering the sky, blocking out the pale, dim, and heatless “sunlight.”

unit.source: Lumian appeared stunned, as if he had encountered something terrifying, or was like an undead creature facing a higher-ranked and more terrifying kindred spirit.
unit.target: Lumian stupefactus apparuit, quasi aliquid terribile convenisset, aut ut creatura mortua adversus spiritum cognatum, altiori et terribili, obviam egeret.

unit.source: For a brief moment, he stood frozen, unable to move.
unit.target: Per brevem momentum stetit immobilis, neque se movere poterat.

unit.source: Just then, a wretched howl, filled with pain, echoed from Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: Tum, miserrimus ululatus, dolore repletus, ex Lago Dalsh resonavit.

unit.source: The terrifying and piercing sound was like a high-speed spinning drill that bored directly into Lumian’s soul.
unit.target: Sonus terribilis et acutus erat, velut terebra celeriter gyrans, quae in animam Lumiani directe pervenit.

unit.source: His vision went dark, and he lost consciousness.
unit.target: Visus eius obscuratus est, et conscientiam amisit.

unit.source: When Lumian regained his thoughts and awareness of his body, he found himself midway along Chaban Street, accompanied by the Knight of Swords Maric, who had appeared at some point, dressed in a black vest and white shirt.
unit.target: Cum Lumian cogitationes et sensum corporis sui recipere coepisset, invenit se in media viae Chaban, comitatus a Equestre Gladii Maric, qui aliquando apparuerat, veste nigra et camisia alba indutus.

unit.source: All around him, crystalline cold had frozen human skulls of varying states in mid-air, on the ground, and on the surfaces of gray-white stone buildings.
unit.target: Omnibis circa eum, glacies crystallina, craneos humanos variis modis in aere, in terra, et super superficies aedificiorum lapideorum cinereo-alborum congelaverat.

unit.source: The surreal frozen scene stretched all the way to the wilderness on the outskirts of the city.
unit.target: Scaena surrealistica congelata usque ad solitudinem in extremis urbis extendebatur.

unit.source: In the staggering army of undead creatures, the rotting monsters shed flesh onto the ground, leaving only bones-yellowed, brown, or bleached white.
unit.target: In ingenti exercitu creaturarum mortuorum, monstra putrida carnem in terram effuderunt, relinquentes tantum ossa quae flavae, fuscae aut candidae erant.

unit.source: The skeletal remains sank into the soil, and droplets of crimson blood, not their own, oozed from the surface.
unit.target: Reliquiae scheletrales in terram ceciderunt, et guttas sanguinis coccinei, non propriorum, ex superficie exsudaverunt.

unit.source: Meanwhile, the wraiths and evil spirits swelled like balloons and burst silently, turning into strange dust.
unit.target: Interim, umbrae et spiritus mali quasi globi inflati erant, et silentio eruperunt, in pulverem insolitum vertentes.

unit.source: Although Lumian didn’t fully understand what was happening, two thoughts sprang to mind: Have they all been cursed?
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian non plene intellexit quid ageretur, duo cogitationes in mentem eius immediate venerunt: num omnes maledicti sint?

unit.source: Even the fleshless bones were cursed to bleed?
unit.target: Etiam ossa sine carne maledicta sunt ut sanguinem effundantur?

unit.source: With that thought, Lumian couldn’t help but raise his right hand and wipe his nose.
unit.target: Hac cogitatione, Lumian non potuit prohibere ut dextram manum tolleret et nasum suum abstergeret.

unit.source: He immediately noticed some blackened bloodstains on the back of his hand.
unit.target: Statim animadvertit nonnullas maculas sanguinis nigras in dorso manūs eius.

unit.source: This came from within his body, blood that had long since stopped flowing.
unit.target: Hoc ex interno corpore eius oriebatur, sanguis qui iam diutius fluere desierat.

unit.source: In the banshee’s wail just now, not only was his soul wounded, but his undead body seemed to have suffered physical damage too.
unit.target: In recenti lamentatione Bansheei, non solum anima eius vulnerata est, sed et corpus eius mortuum, ut videbatur, damna physica passa est.

unit.source: Some capillaries had ruptured, causing the blackened blood to seep out.
unit.target: Quaedam capillaria rupta erant, quae sanguinem nigrum effundere fecerunt.

unit.source: Terrifying… Lumian had roughly figured out what had just happened.
unit.target: Terribile… Lumian paene intellexit quid modo accideret.

unit.source: Oxyto screamed from a distance, using the Banshee’s Howl enhanced by Paramita, and!
unit.target: Oxyto ex longinquo clamavit, utens ululatu Bansheei per Paramita amplificato, et!

unit.source: instantly lost consciousness.
unit.target: Statim conscientiam amisit.

unit.source: Did the temperance faction’s demigods attach themselves to me as wraiths before Paramita expanded, pulling me into Paramita right away?
unit.target: Num semidei factionis temperantiae, antequam Paramita expandebatur, se ut umbrae ad me applicaverunt, me statim in Paramitam trahentes?

unit.source: Then, they took over my body and used their abilities to deal with the swarming army of human skulls and undead?
unit.target: Tum corpus meum occupaverunt et facultates suas ad pugnandum contra exercitum humanorum craniorum et mortuorum usi sunt?

unit.source: The Knight of Swords also attached himself to me, which is why he’s now in Paramita?
unit.target: Et Eques Gladii se ad me applicavit, qua de causa nunc in Paramita versatur?

unit.source: After grasping the recent encounter, Lumian had a clearer and more accurate understanding of the terror of demigods: Oxyto isn’t even a full Angel but just a Banshee’s Howl knocked me unconscious, robbing me of my ability to fight.
unit.target: Postquam recentem eventum comprehenderat, Lumian claram et accuratam notionem terroris semideorum consecutus est: Oxyto quidem non est angelus integer, sed solum ululatus Bansheei, qui me in inopiam redegit, vim pugnandi mihi subtrahens.

unit.source: It took me over ten seconds to wake up… Without the presence of temperance faction demigods, those ten seconds would have been more than enough for Oxyto to kill me ten times over…
unit.target: Mihi plus quam decem secundis opus fuit ut evigilarer… Sine praesentia semideorum factionis temperantiae, illa decem secunda satis haberent ut Oxyto me decies occideret…

unit.source: This isn’t something a drawn demigod can compare to.
unit.target: Hoc non est res ad quam semideus evocatus comparari possit.

unit.source: Facing a real demigod, if I don’t seize the initiative, I won’t even have the chance to draw the Sword of Courage or use Desire Incarnation!
unit.target: Adversus verum semideum, nisi initium capiam, ne occasionem quidem habebo ut Gladium Fortitudinis traheam aut Incarnationem Desiderii adhibeam!

unit.source: There’s no time for the animated shadow to take the damage for me unless I anticipate it in advance…
unit.target: Nullum tempus est ut umbra animata pro me damnum subeam, nisi id ante praevideam.

unit.source: With these thoughts swirling, Lumian regained control of his body.
unit.target: His cogitationibus circulantibus, Lumian iterum dominari corpore suo coepit.

unit.source: Then, he heard the Knight of Swords, Maric, mutter softly, “Oxyto has retreated. She should be near Lake Dalsh.”
unit.target: Tum audivit Eques Gladii, Maric, leniter sussurrare: “Oxyto recessit. Prope Lacum Dalsh esse debet.”

unit.source: “We still don’t know what kind of help she’s seeking.”
unit.target: “Nondum scimus quid genere auxilii quaerat.”

unit.source: “Lake Dalsh?” Lumian asked in mild surprise.
unit.target: “Lacus Dalsh?” interrogavit Lumian, leniter admiratus.

unit.source: That serene, beautiful, sacred lake?
unit.target: Iste lacus serenus, pulcher, sacer?

unit.source: On second thought, it makes sense. All mining operations in the Raklev region have avoided Lake Dalsh, leaving it entirely unpolluted…
unit.target: Secunda cogitatione, rationem habet. Omnes operationes fodinarias in regione Raklev Lacum Dalsh vitaverunt, eum prorsus incontaminatum relinquentes…

unit.source: The Knight of Swords surveyed the surroundings but didn’t immediately dash off into the wilderness toward Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: Eques Gladii ambitum inspexit, sed non statim in solitudinem versus Lacum Dalsh festinavit.

unit.source: He nodded slightly and said, “Lake Dalsh itself is special, connected to the fallen Death. The establishment of this small spirit realm in the Raklev region was made possible due to Lake Dalsh.”
unit.target: Levis annuens ait: “Lacus Dalsh ipse specialis est, Morti lapsae conexus; constitutio huius parvi regni spirituum in regione Raklev facta est propter Lacum Dalsh.”

unit.source: “That former Balam Empire official even used an Undying’s skull from the Church of Death and, using his Gatekeeper powers, opened a door to the Underworld and fixed it onto the Undying’s skull. This prevented it from completely closing too quickly, allowing a bit of the Underworld’s aura to leak out.”
unit.target: Ille pristinus officialis Imperii Balam etiam calvarium Immortui ex Ecclesia Mortis usus est, et, utens viribus Custodis aditus, ianuam ad Orcum aperuit atque eam in calvarium Immortui fixavit. Hoc impedivit ne claudendi processus nimis celeriter completus esset, relinquens parvam partem aurae Orci effluere.

unit.source: “The skull of an Undying? Undying can die too?” Lumian instinctively asked.
unit.target: «Calvarium Immortui? Immortui etiam mori possunt?» rogavit Lumian instinctive.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords started walking towards the edge of the frozen world.
unit.target: Eques Gladii iter ad oram mundi congelati inchoavit ambulare.

unit.source: He glanced at Lumian and said, “An Undying is only Sequence 4 in the Death pathway. They can still die if killed.”
unit.target: Intuentem Lumian, dixit: “Immortui sunt tantum in Sequentia IV in via Mortis; adhuc mori possunt, si interfecti fuerint.”

unit.source: I see… Lumian nodded almost imperceptibly.
unit.target: Intellego… Lumian paene imperceptibiliter annuit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords continued, “The aura leaking from the Underworld, the unique traits of the Undying’s skull, and the special nature of Lake Dalsh all worked together to sustain this spirit realm, drawing the souls of dead creatures in the region and letting them gradually wither away.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii continuavit: “Aura e Orco effluente, proprietates singulares calvari Immortui, et natura specialis Lacus Dalsh omnia simul coniuncta sunt ut hoc regnum spirituum sustentaret, animas creaturarum mortuorum in regione attrahendo et eas paulatim exaridire sinendo.”

unit.source: After listening, Lumian froze for a moment.
unit.target: Postquam audivit, Lumian per breve momentum immobilis stetit.

unit.source: “You seem to know a lot about the local spirit realm…”
unit.target: “Videtur te multa de regno spirituum locali scire…”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords replied, “The Rose School of Thought ruled here for over a thousand years. Apart from the uniqueness of Lake Dalsh, everything else was long understood.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii respondit: “Schola Rosacea cogitationis hic per ultra mille annos dominavit. Praeter singularitatem Lacus Dalsh, omnia alia diu nota erant.”

unit.source: “Then why didn’t you say so earlier?” Lumian blurted out.
unit.target: “Cur, igitur, non ante dixisti?” exclamavit Lumian.

unit.source: If you’d told me sooner, I might have guessed Oxyto’s intentions earlier!
unit.target: Si prius mihi dixeris, fortasse antea conicere potuissem quid Oxyto intendisset!

unit.source: “We didn’t initially connect Oxyto to the spirit realm, so that intelligence wasn’t included in the information,” explained the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: “Initio Oxyto non associabatur regno spirituum, ideo illa cognitio in notitia non inclusa erat,” explicavit Eques Gladii.

unit.source: “After that, I answered whenever you asked, but didn’t elaborate. Speaking is also a desire that requires temperance.”
unit.target: “Postea, quoties rogavisti, respondi sed non explicavi. Loqui quoque est desiderium quod temperantiam requirit.”

unit.source: “…” Lumian suddenly understood how Franca felt every time she heard him say, “I’ll have to start with the events at the Samaritan Women’s Spring, where Madame Hela and 1…”
unit.target: “…” Lumian subito intellexit quomodo Franca se haberet, quoties eum audiret dicentem, “Incipient a rebus ad Fons Samaritarum Feminarum, ubi Domina Hela et 1…”

unit.source: While talking, he and Maric reached the edge of the city, where the frozen world met the desolate wilderness.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, ille et Maric ad limen urbis pervenerunt, ubi mundus congelatus cum vastitate desolata congressus est.

unit.source: Lumian instinctively glanced at the thick layer of ice encasing the gray-white buildings.
unit.target: Lumian instinctu aspexit spissum stratum glaciei quod aedificia cinereo-alba circumdabat.

unit.source: Using the reflective surface, he was astonished to see a blurry figure in each of his eyes.
unit.target: Reflectivam superficiem utens, stupuit videns figuram nebulosam in unoquoque oculo suo.

unit.source: One wore a small black bonnet and a court dress of the same color; the other had no head and was dressed in a dark, intricately patterned, sinister gown.
unit.target: Unus portabat parvulum bonnet nigrum et vestem curiæ eodem colore; alter caput non habebat et veste obscura, subtiliter designata, sinistra induta erat.

unit.source: Lumian then noticed translucent-ringed insects crawling in and out of his mouth, yet he felt nothing.
unit.target: Tum Lumian animadvertit insecta, anulis translucidis ornata, quae in ore eius serpentes intrabant et exeuntia erant; attamen nihil sensit.

unit.source: At the entrance to Chaban Street, Franca, Jenna, and the others felt a sudden chill engulf them and saw Lumian vanish before their eyes.
unit.target: Ad initium viae Chaban, Franca, Jenna et ceteri subito frigore invasos sensit et Lumian coram oculis eorum evanescere viderunt.

unit.source: Before they could communicate or react, a voice, slightly magnetic and ethereal like a dream, echoed in their ears: “I’ll send you back to Trier first.”
unit.target: Priusquam communicare vel agere possent, vox, paulum magnetica et aetheria ut somnium, in auribus eorum resonavit: “Primum vos ad Trier remittam.”

unit.source: Franca, Jenna, and Lugano instinctively turned their bodies and discovered that a young-looking man had appeared next to them at some point.
unit.target: Franca, Jenna et Lugano instinctive corpora sua converterunt et compererunt virum iuvenem ad eos apparuisse aliquando.

unit.source: He wore a white shirt, draped in a thin black trench coat. With black hair and green eyes, he had a night-like, handsome quality, and wore a pair of red gloves on both hands.
unit.target: Indutus erat camisia alba, pallio nigro tenue involutus; capillis nigris et oculis viridibus ornatus, indole nocturna et formosa, atque par chirothecarum rubrarum in utrisque manibus gerebat.

unit.source: 766 Early Labor
unit.target: 766 Labor Primum

unit.source: 766 Early Labor
unit.target: 766 Labor Primum

unit.source: Gazing at the young man wearing red gloves, Franca cautiously asked, “Who might you be?”
unit.target: Observans iuvenem indutum in chirothecis rubris, Franca cauta rogavit: “Quis es tu?”

unit.source: She wasn’t about to trust a stranger just because of what he said unless influenced by some Beyonder power.
unit.target: Non erat parata fidere ignoto solum ex verbis eius, nisi aliqua potentia Beyonder eam inspirasset.

unit.source: “Two of Cups, Seven of Cups. You don’t need to be involved in what’s coming next,” said the young man in red gloves directly, calling Franca and Jenna by their Minor Arcana names.
unit.target: “Duo Poculorum, Septem Poculorum. Non opus est tibi in re ventura implicari,” inquit iuvenis in chirothecis rubris directe, Francam et Jennam vocans nomina eorum ex Arcana Minoribus.

unit.source: His voice carried the natural authority of someone used to leading many people, instilling a faint sense of fear in Franca and the others.
unit.target: Vox eius naturalem auctoritatem, solitis multitudinem ducendi, intulit, modicum timoris in Franca et aliis infundens.

unit.source: He knows our Tarot Club codenames…
unit.target: Novit codenomina nostri Circuli Taroti…

unit.source: A member of the Tarot Club?
unit.target: Socius Circuli Taroti?

unit.source: One of the Knight of Swords’ helpers?
unit.target: Unus ex adiutoribus Eques Gladii?

unit.source: His outfit looks like those “Red Gloves” from the Church of Evernight Goddess…
unit.target: Indumentum eius illis “Chirothecis Rubris” ex Ecclesia Deae Semper Noctis simile videtur…

unit.source: As Franca pondered, she didn’t sense any warning from her spiritual intuition.
unit.target: Dum Franca meditabat, nullam admonitionem a spirituali intuitione sua sensit.

unit.source: Before she could respond, the young man in red gloves pulled out a tarot card.
unit.target: Antequam illa responderet, iuvenis in chirothecis rubris extraxit cartam Taroticam.

unit.source: The card’s front depicted a goddess pouring holy water under a sky full of stars.
unit.target: Frons chartae deam depingebat, quae aquam sacram sub caelo stellato effundebat.

unit.source: Major Arcana, The Star!
unit.target: Arcana Maiora, Stella!

unit.source: So, it’s Mr. Star… Franca and Jenna hesitated no longer and nodded in unison, saying, “Okay.”
unit.target: Ita, Dominus Stella est… Franca et Jenna non amplius dubitaverunt et unanimiter annuerunt, dicentes: “Bene.”

unit.source: Lugano stood there, a bit dazed.
unit.target: Lugano ibi stetit, paulo attonitus.

unit.source: Why did he take out a card?
unit.target: Cur cartam extraxit?

unit.source: I think I’ve heard of something like this, but I can’t remember…
unit.target: Puto me aliquid huiusmodi audivisse, sed non memini…

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Anthony appeared out of nowhere and squeezed in beside Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Prope simul, Antonius ex nihilo apparuit et iuxta Francam et Jennam accessit.

unit.source: Franca was startled for a moment, muttering to herself, “I really did forget about you…”
unit.target: Franca paulisper attonita fuit, sibi ipsi murmurans: “Te vere oblitus sum…”

unit.source: Mr. Star didn’t say much more.
unit.target: Dominus Stella non multum locutus est.

unit.source: He opened his mouth slightly.
unit.target: Leviserum os aperuit.

unit.source: In an instant, Franca and the others were enveloped by a vast, invisible spirit, and then they ascended into the layered, colorful spirit world, like they were traveling in a hot air balloon.
unit.target: In momento, Franca et ceteri ingenti spiritu invisibili involuti sunt, deinde in mundum spirituum stratis et coloratis ascendentes, quasi in globulo aerato calido peragrarentur.

unit.source: Along the city’s periphery, covered in crystalline ice, Lumian, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, withdrew his gaze.
unit.target: In lateribus urbis, glacie crystallina operitis, Lumian, indutus larva aurea familiae Eggers, oculos avertit.

unit.source: He could roughly guess that the blurry figures in his eyes were the temperance faction’s demigods responsible for this operation.
unit.target: Conjecturi poterat, figuras obscuras in oculis suis esse semideos factionis temperantiae, huic operationi incumbentes.

unit.source: One of them, headless, seemed to resemble the temperance faction’s Angel he had seen before.
unit.target: Unus eorum, caput carens, videbatur Angeli factionis temperantiae similis, quem antea viderat.

unit.source: The translucent insects crawling in and out of his mouth were likely helpers invited by the temperance faction.
unit.target: Insecta translucida, quae in ore eius intro et exire videbantur, probabiliter adiutores factionis temperantiae invitati erant.

unit.source: How many people have taken residence in my body just now?
unit.target: Quot homines modo in corpore meo insederunt?

unit.source: Lumian grumbled internally as he followed the Knight of Swords, Maric, in a mad dash.
unit.target: Lumian, interiora murmure, secutus est Eques Gladii, Maric, in impetu insanum.

unit.source: They entered the wilderness outside Raklev under the pale, cold “sunlight,” heading swiftly toward Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: In solitudinem extra Raklev ingressi sunt, sub pallida et frigida luce solari, celeriter versus Lacum Dalsh properantes.

unit.source: Due to the unique influence of Paramita, Lumian couldn’t teleport anywhere beyond his line of sight.
unit.target: Propter unicam vim Paramitae, Lumian ultra lineam visionis suae se transferre non potuit.

unit.source: He had to use a visual lock to establish a position, which made it challenging to appear instantly at the edge of Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: Oportuit ei uti vinculo visivo ad statum constituendum, quod apparere statim in margine Lacus Dalsh difficile faciebat.

unit.source: After running some distance, he reached out and grabbed the Knight of Swords’ shoulder.
unit.target: Post aliquod spatium cursu, manum protendit et humerum Eques Gladii arripuit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, blazing white flames surged from within him, instantly covering his entire body.
unit.target: Prope simul, flammae albae fulgentes ex ipso eruperunt, totum corpus eius statim tegentes.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords understood his intent without asking and promptly dematerialized into a wraith, attaching himself to Lumian.
unit.target: Eques Gladii consilium eius sine quaestionibus intellexit et statim in umbram evanuit, se Lumiano adnixus.

unit.source: Lumian transformed into a white-hot spear and shot off into the distance in a brilliant display.
unit.target: Lumian in hastam candentem se transformavit et, in splendidum spectaculum, in distantia volavit.

unit.source: The flaming spear streaked through the sky, crossing vast distances to arrive at the edge of Lake Dalsh in no time.
unit.target: Hasta ardens per caelum transvolavit, ingentes distantias superans atque in oram Lacus Dalsh celeriter perveniens.

unit.source: As Lumian detached from the blazing white spear, he noticed that even in Paramita, intertwined with the spirit realm, this lake remained tranquil, clear, sacred, and beautiful.
unit.target: Cum Lumian a hasta candenti albi se distulit, animadvertit quod etiam in Paramita, coniuncta cum regno spirituum, hic lacus tranquillus, clarus, sacer atque pulcher permaneat.

unit.source: In the dim surroundings, the gray-white water seemed weightless, stretching upwards like a giant curtain, perhaps drawn to some high-altitude entity.
unit.target: In obscuritate circumiectis, aqua cinereo-alba levitate carens videbatur, sursum extendens ut velum ingens, fortasse ad aliquam altitudinem attrectatam.

unit.source: In front of the water curtain, countless human skulls formed a mountainous head.
unit.target: Ante velum aquae, innumerabilia crania humana, ut caput montuosum, formabant.

unit.source: Among the skulls of various colors, one stood out the most.
unit.target: Inter crania diversorum colorum, unum maxime eminuit.

unit.source: It was at the very top, crystal clear as if carved from crystal, and significantly larger than a normal human skull.
unit.target: Illud in vertice erat, crystallinum quasi ex crystallo sculptum, et notabiliter maius quam cranium humanum solitum.

unit.source: Instead of pale or dark red flames, the eye sockets of this crystal skull reflected a mysterious, intricately patterned, ancient bronze door.
unit.target: Pro flammis pallidis aut rubris obscuris, fossae oculorum huius cranii crystallini repraebant ianuam aeneam antiquam, mysteriosa et subtiliter ornatam.

unit.source: The door was slightly ajar, revealing endless darkness within.
unit.target: Ianuam paulum aperta erat, infinitam obscuritatem intus patefaciens.

unit.source: In that darkness were countless indescribable eyes, staring out yet unable to emerge.
unit.target: In illa obscuritate innumerabiles oculi ineffabili erant, spectantes sed emergere non poterant.

unit.source: Along the edges of the bronze door, strange, grotesque, and sometimes revolting hands grasped the frame as if trying to squeeze through but unable to. They only managed to scratch out piercing noises that seemed to tear at the human eardrum.
unit.target: Ad margines ianuae aenea, manus insolitae, grotescae atque interdum repulsivas, limen prehendebant, quasi per transitus exprimere conantes sed non potentes; solum sonos acutos stridentes ediderunt, qui quasi tympana humana lacerabant.

unit.source: Many spirits and human skulls were drawn to this place, gradually becoming part of the massive head.
unit.target: Multae animae et crania humana ad hunc locum trahebantur, paulatim in partem ingentis capitis versa.

unit.source: Is that crystal skull the Undying’s skull used back then?
unit.target: Estne hoc cranium crystallinum, cranium Immortalis, illo tempore usitatum?

unit.source: Is the bronze door in its eye sockets the Death Sequence 5’s Gatekeeper’s door to the Underworld?
unit.target: Estne ianua aenea in orbitis eius porta Custodis Sequenciae Mortis V ad Orcos inferos?

unit.source: Hmm, a Sequence 5 can’t keep the Underworld door open for long, so they used the Undying’s skull and the unique properties of Lake Dalsh to fix it…
unit.target: Hmm, Sequencia V ianuam Orcorum non diu patefacere potest, itaque cranium Immortalis et proprietates unicas Lacus Dalsh ad id reparandum adhibuerunt…

unit.source: But where has Oxyto, the Shaman King, gone?
unit.target: Sed quo abiit Oxyto, Rex Scamanorum?

unit.source: As this thought crossed Lumian’s mind, he saw the countless human skulls forming the massive head in the air open and close their bony teeth, speaking in unison in various voices: “Why couldn’t you give me a little more time?”
unit.target: Dum haec cogitatio per mentem Lumiani transibat, vidit innumerabilia crania humana, ingens caput in aere formantia, dentes ossa aperientes et claudentes, una voce variis modis loquentia: “Cur non mihi paululum temporis tribuistis?”

unit.source: “If I can’t have it, I’ll destroy this place and see how many of you can survive the calamity of this collapsing Paramita!”
unit.target: “Si id mihi non obtineri potest, hunc locum delam et videbo quot ex vobis calamitatem huius Paramita corruentis superesse possint!”

unit.source: “And I have already abandoned this place and left the Raklev region using my prior preparations!”
unit.target: “Et iam hunc locum deserui atque regionem Raklev, praeparationibus meis usus sum!”

unit.source: “Hahaha, hahaha!”
unit.target: “Hahaha, hahaha!”

unit.source: Amid the sharp, hoarse, old, and deep laughter of the human skulls, Lumian felt the massive shadow in the sky descend toward his head.
unit.target: Inter acutum, raucem, vetustum et profundum risum craniorum humanorum, Lumian sensit ingentem umbram in caelo versus caput suum descendere.

unit.source: Cracks appeared in the ground below, growing deeper and revealing a dark void.
unit.target: Fissurae in terra inferiore apparuerunt, crescentes in profundum et tenebrosum abyssum revelantes.

unit.source: All the skulls, including the crystal one, developed tiny cracks, seemingly ready to shatter completely in no time.
unit.target: Omnia crania, etiam cranium crystallinum, parvas fissuras formaverunt, quasi mox omnino dirumpenda erent.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian felt a chill leave his body, and all the skulls stopped cracking as if temporarily held back by an invisible external force.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian sensit frigidum ex corpore suo fugere, et omnia crania fissuras facere cessare, quasi a vis invisibili externa temporarie continerentur.

unit.source: This also halted the process of Paramita’s collapse and destruction.
unit.target: Hoc quoque processum ruinae et destructionis Paramitae sistit.

unit.source: Although it didn’t reverse, it wasn’t going to happen immediately.
unit.target: Quamquam non restitutum est, non statim evenire paratum erat.

unit.source: Is this the temperance faction’s demigod or their invited helper using their ability? It seems Oxyto really escaped.
unit.target: Num hic est semideus factionis temperantiae aut adiutor eorum invitatus, facultate utendo? Videtur Oxyto revera effugiisse.

unit.source: After testing the waters with the Banshee’s Howl, she decisively abandoned this Paramita, clearly stronger than other Madames, and used her prior arrangements and the unique properties of this place to escape before the temperance faction could act…
unit.target: Postquam aquas per ululatum Banshee temptavit, illa constanter hanc Paramitam deseruit, manifeste fortior quam alia dominae, et priores dispositiones atque proprietates unicas huius loci ad effugiendum, antequam factio temperantiae agere posset, adhibuit.

unit.source: A series of thoughts flashed through Lumian’s mind as he took in the scene before him.
unit.target: Seriae cogitationum per mentem Lumiani fulserunt, dum scaenam ante se intuebatur.

unit.source: An ancient voice suddenly echoed in his ears: “Don’t just listen to what Oxyto says.
unit.target: Vox antiqua subito in auribus eius resonavit: “Noli solum audire quod Oxyto dicat.”

unit.source: In my experience, anyone who leaves behind so many words before running away is either already insane or trying to cover up something.
unit.target: Experientia mea docet: quisquam qui tot verba relinquit antequam fugiatur, aut iam insanus est aut rem aliquid tegere conatur.

unit.source: Oxyto did indeed flee here decisively before we locked onto her and planned to destroy this Paramita, but why would she tell us her objectives? Purely to vent her emotions?
unit.target: Oxyto quidem hic effugit, antequam eam apprehenderemus et hanc Paramitam delere consiliaveremus, sed cur nobis sua proposita narrare vellet? Numquid solum ad affectus suos efferendos?

unit.source: That may be one reason, but there should be a more important one: she wants us to focus on the collapse and destruction of this Paramita and overlook something else.
unit.target: Id fortasse una causa sit, sed aliter gravius: illa vult ut nos ruinae et destructioni huius Paramitae incumbamus, aliam rem autem neglegamus.

unit.source: Lumian hadn’t entirely dismissed his doubts after Oxyto’s proclamations through those human skulls, but such behavior wasn’t unusual for the indulgence faction of the Rose School of Thought.
unit.target: Lumian dubitationes suas post pronuntiata Oxyto per illa crania humana non omnino deiecit, sed talis mos non erat insolitus pro factione indulgentiae Scholae Rosarum.

unit.source: Those accustomed to indulgence were always eager to express their emotions.
unit.target: Qui indulgentiae assuefacti erant, semper affectus suos exprimere studebant.

unit.source: The ancient voice finally said, “Time will provide us the answer.”
unit.target: Vox antiqua tandem inquit: “Tempus nobis responsum dabit.”

unit.source: As soon as these words fell, Lumian saw the insects with translucent rings flying out.
unit.target: Simul cum verba illa ceciderunt, Lumian vidit insecta annulis translucidis volitantia.

unit.source: Suddenly, everything around him slowed down.
unit.target: Subito, omnia circa eum tardaverunt.

unit.source: A grayish-white fog settled over everything Lumian saw, making it all look surreal.
unit.target: Caligo cinereo-alba super omnia, quae Lumian vidit, consedit, efficens ut omnia quasi insueta apparerent.

unit.source: Soon after, everything projected on the foggy “curtain” started to rewind.
unit.target: Statim postea, omnia in velo caliginoso proiecta retrogradari incipiebant.

unit.source: The human skulls were no longer cracked in countless places, the ground returned to smoothness, and the thick shadows receded into the sky.
unit.target: Crania humana non iam in innumeris locis fissata erant, terra laevis restituta, et umbrae denses in caelum recedebant.

unit.source: Time wasn’t moving backward; rather, recent history and events were being displayed.
unit.target: Tempus non retrorsum currebat; potius, recentia historia et eventus ostendebantur.

unit.source: Lumian then saw a pair of brown wings that could blot out the sky, leaving the current shadow behind.
unit.target: Tum Lumian par alarum fuscatarum vidit, quae caelum obruere poterant, umbram praesentem relinquentia.

unit.source: Between the wings, each feather as large as a human head, stood a female figure with an exposed abdomen.
unit.target: Inter alas, quarum singulae plumae tam magnae erant quam caput humanum, stabat figura feminea cum ventre patefacto.

unit.source: The woman was as beautiful as the moon at night, her face radiating maternal brilliance, but her hands and feet were arched, with sharp nails that gleamed coldly.
unit.target: Femina erat tam pulchra quam luna nocturna, vultu materno radiante, sed manus et pedes eius incurvati erant, cum unguibus acutis frigide micantibus.

unit.source: This was the Shaman King, Oxyto.
unit.target: Hic erat Rex Scamanorum, Oxyto.

unit.source: Having seen her male form, Lumian recognized her instantly.
unit.target: Cum formam eius masculinam viderit, Lumian eam statim agnovit.

unit.source: Her features were softer now, and her facial details were more delicate.
unit.target: Lineamenta eius nunc leniora erant, atque singula vultus teneriora.

unit.source: Her belly was swollen, stretched taut with black veins visible on the surface.
unit.target: Venter eius tumidus erat, expansus nervis nigris in superficie conspicuis.

unit.source: The skin was so thin that it was almost transparent, revealing the merging forms of numerous bird‐clawed monster infants inside.
unit.target: Cutis tam tenuis erat ut paene perspicua videbatur, ostendens formas miscendas multitudinis infantium monstrorum ungulatorum avium intus.

unit.source: She… stuffed all those corpse‐born bird‐clawed infants into her belly…
unit.target: Illa omnes illos infantes, ex cadaveribus oriundos cum ungulis avium, in ventrem suum impluit…

unit.source: What kind of monster is she nurturing?
unit.target: Quale monstrum illa alit?

unit.source: No wonder the bloodline connection didn’t work directly, only indirectly within a certain range…
unit.target: Non mirum nexus sanguinis non directe operatus est, sed solum indirecte intra certum spatium…

unit.source: As Lumian came to this realization, Oxyto reached for her belly in the scene from the past.
unit.target: Cum Lumian hoc intellexit, Oxyto manum ad ventrem suum protulit in scaena praeterita.

unit.source: With a tearing sound, she ripped her abdomen open, blood pouring out.
unit.target: Cum sono stridente, ventrem suum laceravit, et sanguis effudit.

unit.source: Oxyto forcefully pulled out an infant slightly smaller than Ludwig.
unit.target: Oxyto vi abrupte extraxit infantem paululum minorem quam Ludwig.

unit.source: Its skin was pale, its flesh decayed, and remnants of four or five heads and seven or eight bird claws remained on its surface.
unit.target: Cutis eius pallida erat, caro corrupta, et reliquiae quattuor vel quinque capitum atque septem vel octo ungulorum avium in superficie eius manebant.

unit.source: A pure, clear membrane, seemingly from Lake Dalsh, covered the baby’s body.
unit.target: Membrana pura et clara, quasi ex Lacu Dalsh orta, corpus infantis tegebat.

unit.source: Oxyto let out a cry of agony as she threw the infant into the eye socket of the crystal skull.
unit.target: Oxyto gemitum doloris edidit, dum infantem in orbitam oculorum huius cranii crystallini iecit.

unit.source: The rotten, multi‐headed infant was clearly much larger than the eye socket and the bronze door within it, yet it mysteriously shrank smaller and smaller until it squeezed through a gap barely wide enough for a hand, disappearing into the boundless darkness behind the door.
unit.target: Infans putridus et pluricapitatus manifeste multo maius erat quam orbis oculorum et ianua aenea intus, attamen mysteriose paulatim minuebatur, donec per angulum vix latum manu transire potuit, in immensam obscuritatem post ianuam evanescens.

unit.source: Is Oxyto’s ultimate goal to send that monster infant into the Underworld, making some terrifying thing a reality?
unit.target: Estne propositum ultimum Oxyto, illum infantem monstrum in Orcum inferos mittere, quoddam terribile factum efficere?

unit.source: And now she’s been forced into early labor?
unit.target: Et nunc illa in partum praecoce coacta est?

unit.source: As Lumian had this thought, he realized the coldness inside him had vanished.
unit.target: Cum Lumian hanc cogitationem habuit, animadvertit frigiditatem interioris se evanuisse.

unit.source: The figure in the small black bonnet and the Knight of Swords in the vest and shirt simultaneously appeared in front of the crystal skull.
unit.target: Figura in parvo nigro pileo et Eques Gladii in veste et camisia simul apparuerunt ante cranium crystallinum.

unit.source: But they seemed unable to pass through the crack in the bronze door and were trying to open it a little more.
unit.target: Sed videbantur non posse per fissuram ianuae aeneae transire, et eam paulo amplius aperire conabantur.

unit.source: The Underworld… Wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, Lumian felt a stirring inside.
unit.target: Infernum… Indutus larva aurea familiae Eggers, Lumian sensit motum intimum.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity provided by the temperance faction demigods stalling Paramita’s collapse, he activated the black mark on his right shoulder, teleporting to the front of the crystal skull.
unit.target: Occasione capta a semideis factionis temperantiae, qui ruinae Paramitae moram ferebant, activavit notam nigrum in humero dextro suo et se in fronte cranii crystallini translocavit.

unit.source: In his eyes, the bronze door loomed abnormally large.
unit.target: In oculis eius, ianua aenea insolitē ingens videbatur.

unit.source: He stretched out both hands and pressed them on either side of the bronze door.
unit.target: Manus utramque protendit et in utrisque lateribus ianuae aeneae apposuit.

unit.source: A hollow, muffled buzzing filled the air as the bronze door opened a little wider.
unit.target: In aere sonitus vacuus et submurmurans replebat, dum ianua aenea paulum latius aperiebatur.

unit.source: Lumian immediately felt a terrifying suction, and with a swish, he was pulled through the crack, flung deep into the darkness.
unit.target: Lumian statim sensit terribilem vim attrahentem, et cum sibilo, per fissuram trahendus, alte in obscuritatem iactus est.

unit.source: Inside him, two more cold masses joined him.
unit.target: Intra eum duo alia corpora frigida ei se adiunxerunt.

unit.source: 767 Underworld
unit.target: 767 Orcus

unit.source: With Lumian vanishing before the crystal skull, the human skulls, already covered in countless cracks, lost their support.
unit.target: Cum Lumian coram cranio crystallino evanuerit, crania humana, iam innumeris fissuris tecta, subsidium suum amisissent.

unit.source: They shattered with a thunderous crash, bringing down the shadows from above and splitting the grassy wilderness into fragments.
unit.target: Illi cum fragore tonitruoso confracta sunt, umbras ex alto detrahendo et solitudinem virentem in frusta dividendo.

unit.source: Oxyto’s Paramita crumbled toward the cracked crystal skull, and everything there silently turned to dust.
unit.target: Paramita Oxytoni corruit ad cranio crystallino fissum, et omnia ibi silentio in pulverem conversa sunt.

unit.source: The spirits dissipated, the light vanished, and the void of darkness swallowed everything.
unit.target: Spiritus dissipati sunt, lux evanuit, et vacuitas tenebrarum omnia absorpsit.

unit.source: No one knew how much time had passed before a gentle light began to glow in the absolute blackness, revealing a barren, dim, pale, and almost frozen wilderness.
unit.target: Nemo scivit quantum temporis elapsum esset, donec lenis lumen in absoluta tenebris inciperet scintillare, revelans solitudinem sterilem, obscuram, pallidam, et paene gelidam.

unit.source: In the center of the wasteland lay the tranquil and sacred Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: In medio vastitatis iacebat lacus Dalsh, tranquillus et sacer.

unit.source: The headless lady, draped in a dark‐black dress and carrying four heads, swiftly appeared beside the lake, quietly gazing at its serene, transparent surface.
unit.target: Mulier capite carens, induta veste nigro atra et quattuor capita gerens, celeriter apparuit iuxta lacum, leniter intuens eius serenum et perspicuum superficiem.

unit.source: As soon as Lumian was pulled through the bronze door, he felt countless eyes upon him, chilling his body further and numbing him.
unit.target: Quam primum Lumian per ianuam aeneam trahitus est, sensit innumeros oculos in se versantes, qui corpus eius ulterius refrigerabant atque imbecillabant.

unit.source: Meanwhile, arms of unknown origin reached out, grabbing at his head, neck, torso, and legs.
unit.target: Interim, bracchia originis ignotae extendebantur, caput, collum, pectus, et crura eius rapientes.

unit.source: Some had dull skin with white, bony teeth; others were so decayed that their flesh was falling off, slowly wriggling with equally decayed worms; some lacked skin altogether; others were merely illusory Spirit Bodies…
unit.target: Aliqui habebant cute opacam cum dentibus albis et ossibus; alii tam corrupti erant ut caro eorum cadebat, lente se contorcendo cum vermibus similiter corruptis; quidam cutis omnino caret; alii tantum erant corpora spirituum illusoria.

unit.source: What they all shared was a bone‐chilling cold that could freeze the soul.
unit.target: Quod omnes communicabant, erat frigus ex ossibus, quod animam congelare posset.

unit.source: On Lumian’s face, the golden mask painted with black and white oil sparkled with a faint yet pure light.
unit.target: In facie Lumiani, persona aurea, nigro et albo oleo picta, luce tenuissima sed pura micabat.

unit.source: The reaching arms halted momentarily before retracting.
unit.target: Bracchia extendentia paulisper cessaverunt antequam retracta erant.

unit.source: The eyes watching him from the darkness also withdrew their gaze.
unit.target: Oculi, qui eum ex tenebris observabant, quoque suum intuitum retraxerunt.

unit.source: Lumian regained his thoughts and his sense of his body.
unit.target: Lumian cogitationes suas atque sensum corporis sui recuperavit.

unit.source: Below him, he discovered a deep pit with no visible bottom or boundaries.
unit.target: Sub eum invenit foveam profundam sine fundo vel limitibus visibilibus.

unit.source: The edge of the pit was made up of layers of blurry worlds, spiraling downward to the limits of his vision.
unit.target: Limen fossae constabat ex stratis orbium nebulosorum, spiraliter descendens ad terminos visionis eius.

unit.source: These jumbled worlds layered atop each other, and Lumian couldn’t make out what lay within them, only knowing that each was vaster than the Star Highlands, with all previous watching eyes stemming from the pit’s bottomless dark.
unit.target: Hi mundos confusos uno super alium involutos erant, et Lumian non poterat perspicere quid in illis iaceret, nisi quod sciebat unusquisque vastior esse quam Montes Stellarum, cum omnibus antea observantibus oculis ex fundo foveae insondabilis provenientibus.

unit.source: Lumian plummeted suddenly, falling into one of these blurry worlds in the blink of an eye.
unit.target: Subito Lumian praecipitatus est, in unum ex his orbibus nebulosis in ictu oculi cadens.

unit.source: Miraculously, he stood on a barren wilderness exposed with gray‐white rocks, surrounded by heaps of bleached bones, densely packed and stretching toward various distant places.
unit.target: Miracose stetit in desolata terra, patefacta lapidibus cinereo‐albis, circumdata congeries ossium candidorum, densissime compacta atque in varias regiones longinquas extendens.

unit.source: At this moment, these bones lay still, as if slumbering through time.
unit.target: Hoc ipso momento, ossa illa quieta iacebant, quasi per tempus dormientes.

unit.source: Is this the Underworld?
unit.target: Hicne est Orcus?

unit.source: I wonder where the Abscessed Hand’s body part might be.
unit.target: Miror ubi pars corporis Manus Abscessae sit.

unit.source: Lumian looked around, muttering to himself in silence.
unit.target: Lumian circumspiciebat, silentio sibi submurmurans.

unit.source: (Amonoculus’ note: It is the contracted creature that gave him the traverse the Spirit World. Lumian must find its body parts or else he cannot achieve godhood. According to Fors, one of the body parts is located in the Underworld.)
unit.target: (Nota Amonoculi: Creatura contracta est, quae ei viam per Mundi Spirituum dedit. Lumian eius partes corporis invenire debet, alioquin deitatem adipisci non poterit. Secundum Fors, una ex partibus corporis in Orco sita est.)

unit.source: It was the chance to enter the Underworld that had prompted him to help voluntarily, using the Eggers family’s golden mask and the Underworld Daoist’s seal to push open the bronze door inside the crystal skull.
unit.target: Haec occasio intrandi Orcum eum impulit ut voluntarie adiuvareret, utens persona aurea familiae Eggers et sigillo Daoista Orci ad aperiendum ianuam aeneam intra cranio crystallino.

unit.source: Now, the problem was that the Underworld was much more vast than he had anticipated, and he had no idea where to start looking.
unit.target: Iam quaestio erat quod Orcus multo vasta esset quam praevidisset, atque nesciebat quo inciperet quaerere.

unit.source: Similarly, the whereabouts and intentions of the decaying infant that Oxyto had sent were unknown.
unit.target: Similiter, loca et intentiones infantis corrupti, quem Oxyto miserat, ignota erant.

unit.source: Perhaps I could rely on the contract I had signed with the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Fortasse in pacto, quem cum Manu Abscessae signeram, confiderem.

unit.source: Essentially being part of the same body, they are mystically connected.
unit.target: Essentialiter, eo quod pars eiusdem corporis sunt, mystice inter se connexi sunt.

unit.source: The contract I had signed is, to some extent, also with the rest of its body…
unit.target: Pactum, quod signeram, est, ad aliquod modum, etiam cum reliqua eius corpore.

unit.source: Lumian quickly formulated a plan and spoke in a cold, hoarse voice, “Knight of Swords, have all of you entered as well?”
unit.target: Lumian celeriter consilium suum composuit ac frigida, rauca voce dixit: “Eques Gladii, vos omnes quoque intrastisne?”

unit.source: “Yes,” came the faint voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit vox tenue Eques Gladii, Maric.

unit.source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “A companion of mine has also entered.”
unit.target: Paulisper cessato, addidit: “Socius meus quoque intravit.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “Why aren’t both of you coming out? You are now in a wraith state, so there’s no need to worry about dying instantly in the Underworld.”
unit.target: “Cur non egressi estis ambo? Nunc in statu umbrarum estis, itaque non opus est timere mortem instantem in Orco.”

unit.source: “You’re essentially undead beings now; what’s there to fear about the Underworld’s unique conditions?”
unit.target: “Vos enim nunc quasi mortui estis; quid timendum est de singularibus condicionibus Orci?”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords responded, “But we are fundamentally still living beings. If we stay in the Underworld as wraiths for too long, we won’t be able to revert to human form and will forever exist as wraiths or evil spirits. By using your body, we can temporarily avoid the influence of the Underworld, emerging only when it’s crucial.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii respondit: “Sed tamen nos fundamentatim sumus entia viventia. Si in Orco nimis diu in statu umbrarum maneamus, non poterimus ad formam humanam redire et in perpetuum ut umbrae aut spiritus mali exsistere. Corpus tuum utendo, incursionem Orci temporarie vitare possumus, emergentes solum cum necessarium est.”

unit.source: “I see…” Lumian looked up at the pale, dim sky, “I also can’t wear this Eggers family’s mask for too long. We have about three hours.”
unit.target: “Intelligo…” Lumian ad caelum pallidum et obscurum aspiciebat, “ego quoque hanc personam auream familiae Eggers nimis diu portare non possum. Habemus circiter tres horas.”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian tried to activate without using the black mark on his right shoulder, which was the Abscessed Hand’s Spirit World Traversal ability.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian conatus est activare sine utendo signo nigro in umero dextro, qui erat facultas transitus Mundi Spirituum a Manu Abscessae.

unit.source: With this mark, he faintly sensed something at the end of the wilderness on his right calling to him.
unit.target: Hac nota, leviter sensit aliquid in fine solitudinis dextro, quod ei vocabat.

unit.source: Is that the body part of the Abscessed Hand in the Underworld?
unit.target: Num haec pars corporis Manu Abscessae in Orco est?

unit.source: Just as Lumian had this thought, a figure appeared ahead.
unit.target: Justo cum hoc Lumian cogitaverat, figura ante eum apparuit.

unit.source: It was an extremely delicate‐looking young woman with an unnaturally pale complexion.
unit.target: Erat iuvenis mulier, nimis delicata, quae cutem insolitam pallidam habebat.

unit.source: Her deep blue eyes were profound and devoid of any emotional fluctuation; her light golden hair was tied in an astern bun adorned with a small black bonnet with a fine black veil, and she wore a complicated, exquisite black Gothic court dress.
unit.target: Oculi eius caerulei profundissimi erant, carentes ullam motum animi; capilli eius aurei levi toni in coque retro congregati erant, ornati parvo nigro bonnet cum subtili nigro velamine, et gerebat vestem Gothicam nigram intricatam atque exquisitam.

unit.source: Is this the temperance faction demigod that was attached to me earlier?
unit.target: Hacne est semideus factionis temperantiae, qui ante mihi aderat?

unit.source: Lumian recalled the two blurry figures he saw through the crystalline ice.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est duarum figurarum nebulosarum, quas per glaciem crystallinam vidit.

unit.source: One of them matched the lady before him perfectly!
unit.target: Una eorum perfecte conveniebat cum muliere coram eo!

unit.source: The temperance faction demigod floated in mid‐air, slowly turned around, and then pointed in a direction, nodding at Lumian.
unit.target: Semidea factionis temperantiae in aere fluitavit, lente se circumvertit, deinde in quandam partem indicavit, Lumiano annuens.

unit.source: She was pointing toward the end of the wilderness on the right.
unit.target: Ea indicabat versus finem solitudinis in dextro.

unit.source: “Do you mean that Oxyto’s prematurely born, decayed child might be over there?” Lumian asked for confirmation.
unit.target: “Num significas quod filius Oxytoni, ante tempus natus et corruptus, illic sit?” quaesivit Lumian ad confirmationem.

unit.source: The lady in the black bonnet nodded gently in affirmation.
unit.target: Mulier in nigro bonnet leniter annuit in affirmatione.

unit.source: She then vanished into thin air, and Lumian felt another chill inside him.
unit.target: Deinde illa in aere evanuit, et Lumian in se alium frigus sensit.

unit.source: It’s all in that direction, huh… A coincidence? No, not a coincidence, it’s more likely that something in that direction is drawing them there…
unit.target: Omnia in illa parte sunt… Casusne? Non, minime; verisimiliter aliquid illā parte eos allicit.

unit.source: Lumian turned his body, ready to teleport to the edge of his vision.
unit.target: Lumian corpus vertit, paratus ad teletransportandum ad limen visionis suae.

unit.source: As soon as Lumian started to become transparent, his body was suddenly grabbed by pale hands that appeared out of nowhere, seizing his arms.
unit.target: Quam primum Lumian transparentem fieri coepit, corpus eius subito ab manibus pallidis, ex nihilo apparente, arripiebatur, quae brachia eius ceperunt.

unit.source: Lumian felt a paralyzing sensation throughout his body, as if his soul was being torn apart by an invisible force.
unit.target: Lumian sensit per totum corpus eius sensum paralyticum, quasi anima eius a vi invisibili discerperetur.

unit.source: This time, the faint glow from the golden mask had no effect.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, tenuis fulgor ex persona aurea nullum effectum habuit.

unit.source: Lumian attempted to ignite a blazing white flame to ward off the cold, stiffness, and numbness, but he was overwhelmed by an invisible terror, trembling uncontrollably, unable to respond effectively.
unit.target: Lumian conatus est ignem albidum flammans accendere ut frigus, rigorem ac insensibilitatem expelleret, sed invisibili terrore superatus, incontenabiliter tremens, non potuit efficaciter responde.

unit.source: When he regained his clarity and composure, he found himself still standing in the same spot, but surrounding layers of bleached bones had all risen up, encircling him as if to protect him.
unit.target: Cum claritatem et temperantiam recuperavit, se in eodem loco adhuc stantem invenit, sed omnia circumjacentia strata ossium candidorum surrexerant, eum circumdantes quasi ad protegendum.

unit.source: At the same time, Lumian heard the voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric: “Once you put on the Eggers family’s mask and become a pure undead being, you will also possess all the traits of an undead, one of which is being suppressed by higher beings of the Death pathway, making it difficult to resist and your body and mind willing to accept enslavement.
unit.target: Simul, Lumian vocem Eques Gladii, Maric audivit dicentem: “Cum indueris personam auream familiae Eggers et fies purum entia mortuorum, omnes proprietates entis mortuorum habebis, quarum una est subiectio a superioribus entibus viae Mortis, quae difficultatem praebet resistendi et corpus ac mentem ad servitutem subeundam paratam reddit.

unit.source: In contrast, we wraiths, who aren’t pure and can switch states freely, are less affected.”
unit.target: ’Contra, nos umbrae, qui non sumus purae et statum libere mutare possumus, minus afficimur.’

unit.source: Was this why I couldn’t resist just now? I wonder if the Sword of Courage can counteract this effect. It theoretically should… Lumian realized with a start. “Did both of you save me just now?”
unit.target: Hocne est cur nunc non potui resistere? Miror num Gladius Fortitudinis hunc effectum compensare possit. Theoretice id agere debet… Lumian subito intellexit: “Num uterque me modo servavit?”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords didn’t continue on this topic but instead reminded Lumian, “It seems that in the Underworld, you can teleport but not teleport freely, as that is considered a desecration of Death and attracts the punishment of the Underworld”
unit.target: Eques Gladii non prosequebatur de hac re sed Lumian admonuit: “Videtur in Orco te posse teletransportari, sed non libere, quoniam id putatur profanatio Mortis et supplicium Orci attrahit.”

unit.source: According to the mystic knowledge mentioned by Madam Magician, teleporting should be normal in the Underworld since it stems from the spirit world, but considering it as desecration of Death seems a bit too strict, typical of the oppression by higher-ranking beings of the Death pathway…
unit.target: Secundum mysticam scientiam a Domina Magica enuntiata, teletransportatio in Orco esse debet ordinaria, cum ex mundo spirituum proveniat, sed id tamquam profanatio Mortis existimari videtur, nimis stricte, quod typicum est oppressionis a superioribus entibus viae Mortis.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds, slightly bending his back.
unit.target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, leviter dorsum suum flectens.

unit.source: A blazing white, radiant spear of flame immediately shot forth, illuminating the pale, dim half‐sky, casting towards the far reaches of the wilderness.
unit.target: Hasta ignis albae fulgida statim emissus est, caelum pallidum et obscurum semi-illuminans, versus longinquos fines solitudinis iaculans.

unit.source: As the white and red trail of the flame spear disappeared inch by inch, Lumian, transformed into the spear, hurled himself forward at the fastest speed he could achieve.
unit.target: Dum vestigia alba et rubra hastae flammae per passus paulatim evanuerunt, Lumian, in hastam conversus, se in maximam celeritatem propulit.

unit.source: During this process, he noticed the wilderness sloped downwards, and the destination he, the Knight of Swords, and the temperance faction demigod aimed for was at the bottom of this ‘hillside’.
unit.target: In hoc processu animadvertit solitudinem declivem esse, et destinatio qua quaerebant ille, Eques Gladii, et semidea factionis temperantiae, in imo huius “collis” mansit.

unit.source: After a while, the blazing white light scattered in all directions, and Lumian, now clad in a thick jacket, descended toward the ground.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, lux flammea albae in omnia se dispersit, et Lumian, nunc indutus veste spessa, ad terram descendit.

unit.source: Ahead of him lay a wide, surreal black river, so vast he couldn’t see the other side.
unit.target: Ante eum iacebat flumen nigrum, latum et quasi irreale, tam vastum ut alterum latus videre non posset.

unit.source: The river flowed silently from the edge of the sky to its limits, exceptionally quiet.
unit.target: Flumen silentio fluebat ab orsa caeli usque ad fines eius, eximie quietum.

unit.source: “Is this the River Styx?” Lumian inquired of the temperance faction demigod within him.
unit.target: “Hicne est flumen Styx?” inquit Lumian semideae factionis temperantiae intra se.

unit.source: Responding to Lumian was still the Knight of Swords, Maric: “It should be. It spans every layer of the Underworld. Crossing it is like entering the depths of the Underworld. If you hadn’t stopped earlier and ended up flying above it, you would have fallen straight into the river, and no one would have been able to pull you out.”
unit.target: Respondens ad Lumian, Eques Gladii, Maric dixit: “Id esse debet; omnes stratos Orci complectitur. Illud transire quasi in interiores Orci intrare est. Si non antea destiteris et super illud volaveris, recte in flumen caderes, neque quis te extrahere potuisset.”

unit.source: Good thing the issue with teleporting just now gave me a warning: it’s best to pause in uncertain environments…
unit.target: Bene quod quaestio teletransportationis modo mihi monitum dedit: optimum est in ambitu incerto paulisper morari…

unit.source: Lumian glanced left and right, noticing the wilderness was dotted with withered blood flowers, each concealing a multitude of corpses, bones, and shadows.
unit.target: Lumian ad sinistram et dexteram respexit, animadvertens solitudinem punctatam esse floribus sanguine exaridorum, quorum unusquisque multitudinem cadaverum, ossium, et umbrarum celabat.

unit.source: “How do I cross?” Lumian sensed that the missing part of the Abscessed Hand’s body was on the other side of the River Styx.
unit.target: “Quomodo transibo?” sensit Lumian quod pars corporis Manu Abscessae deest, in altera parte fluminis Styx.

unit.source: No sooner had he asked, and before the Knight of Swords could respond, a dilapidated, gloomy black boat suddenly appeared on the shadowy river.
unit.target: Nisi mox postquam quaesivit, et antequam Eques Gladii respondebat, navis nigra, labefacta et lugubris, subito in flumine umbrato apparuit.

unit.source: A figure draped in fragments stood on the boat, rowing with a long oar, guiding the vessel to Lumian’s side before stopping at the river’s edge.
unit.target: Figura in fragmentis vestita in nave stabat, longa remo remigans, navem ad latus Lumiani gubernans, antequam ad limen fluminis sisteret.

unit.source: Peering closely, Lumian saw that the ferryman was a severely decayed male corpse.
unit.target: Intuens attente, Lumian vidit nautarum esse cadaver virum graviter corruptum.

unit.source: Large portions of his body were exposed, and his eyes appeared gouged out, leaving hollow sockets entwined with thick blood vessels oozing yellow pus.
unit.target: Magnae partes corporis eius patefactae erant, et oculi eius quasi expulsi videbantur, relinquentes orbitas cavatas, intricatas cum crassis vasculis sanguine luteo suppurante.

unit.source: “Take this boat across?” Lumian asked, lowering his voice to consult the temperance faction member inside him.
unit.target: “Hoc navigium transi?” quaesivit Lumian, vocem deminuens ut consuleret cum membro semideae factionis temperantiae interiori.
