unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric replied in an ethereal but slightly grave tone, “It’s the only way… But be careful of the boatman. The Underworld has mutated, and it could be affected too.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii Maric respondit voce aetherea sed paulo gravis: “Hoc solum est iter… Sed cave nautae; Orcus mutatus est, et ipse affici potest.”

unit.source: 768 Ferryman
unit.target: 768 Ferryman

unit.source: 768 Ferryman
unit.target: 768 Ferryman

unit.source: Lumian nodded, his right hand naturally falling on the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian nutivit caput, et dextera manus eius naturaliter in sacco viatoris cecidit.

unit.source: He then walked over to the dilapidated, gloomy boat, noticing the severely decayed boatman turning aside to make way, as if signaling for him to hurry aboard.
unit.target: Tum accessit ad barcam decrepitae et lugubris, animadvertens nautam valde corruptum ad latus se vertere ut viam liberarent, quasi eum instanter conscendere hortaret.

unit.source: “Can you ferry me across the Styx?” Lumian asked politely in Dutanese.
unit.target: „Potesne me per Styx transferri?“ in Dutanensi sermone comiter rogavit Lumian.

unit.source: Given that the former Death hailed from the Southern Continent, Lumian figured that speaking Dutanese might be more readily accepted by “all parties” in the Underworld.
unit.target: Cum prior Mors ex Continente Meridionali proveniret, Lumian ratus est loqui Dutanensem, quod ab omnibus in Inferis partibus facilius recipi posset.

unit.source: After all, in an environment so rich with the stench of death that a living person couldn’t last a second, using mystical languages like ancient Hermes, which could manipulate natural forces, might have unexpected effects.
unit.target: Nam in ambitu odore mortis tam saturato ut nullus homo vivus ne momentum quidem maneret, usus linguarum mysticarum, ut veteris Hermetis, quae vires naturales regere poterant, effectus inopinatos ferre poterat.

unit.source: For instance, merely uttering the words “River Styx” could forge a strong connection with the dark, ethereal river before him, possibly causing it to whip up a massive wave and sweep him away.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, sola verba “Flumen Styx” pronuntiata firmum vinculum cum flumine obscuro et aethereo ante eum constituere posset, fortasse ita ut ingens unda excitata eum rapiret.

unit.source: The boatman, its eye sockets filled with thick blood vessels and oozing yellow pus, faced the river, wide enough that the opposite bank was out of sight, and remained motionless.
unit.target: Nauta, cuius orbitae oculorum crassis vasculis sanguine et fluxu flavo exorrebant, flumen respexit, latius satis ut altera ripa extra conspectum esset, et immotus mansit.

unit.source: It seemed it was answering Lumian with his actions:
unit.target: Videbatur se actis suis Lumiano respondere:

unit.source: “Why would you try to communicate with a corpse?”
unit.target: „Cur conaris cum cadavero colloqui?“

unit.source: “I can’t hear you, nor can I make a sound.”
unit.target: „Non te audīre possum, neque ullam vocem efficere.“

unit.source: “It seems ordinary language won’t do… I’ve heard that the Death pathway includes a Language of the Dead, but unfortunately, I don’t speak it…” Lumian muttered to himself quietly as he let his eyes take on a silver-black hue and slowly stepped onto the rickety, gloomy boat.
unit.target: „Videtur sermo vulgaris non sufficere… Audivi iter Mortis comprehendere Linguam Mortuorum, sed, pro dolor, eam non loquor…“ submurmuravit Lumian sibi ipsi quiete, dum oculos in nitore argenteo-nigro induit et lente in barcam labefactam lugubrem conscenderet.

unit.source: In his Eye of Calamity, the boatman’s destiny was pure black, dead and void, showing no signs of change.
unit.target: Sub aspectu Calamitatis, fatum nautae erat purum nigrum, mortuum et inane, nihil mutationis ostendens.

unit.source: “Does this mean no matter how much the boatman struggles, it can’t change its status as a corpse, and its only fate is to wither away with time until even its existence vanishes?”
unit.target: Num hoc significat quod, quamquam nauta quantumcumque laboret, statum cadaveris mutare non possit, nec aliud fatum eius sit nisi tempore evanescere, donec ipsa existentia dissolvatur?

unit.source: “But that doesn’t mean the boatman can’t do anything during this time before its demise.”
unit.target: Sed id non significat nautam in hoc tempore ante finem nihil agere posse.

unit.source: “Its actions can still affect the fates of others, including mine and other undead beings.”
unit.target: Eius actus tamen fata aliorum, inter mea et cetera corpora non viventium, afficere possunt.

unit.source: “From this perspective, the boatman, or rather the summoned undead, should still have a destiny, only that the outcome cannot be changed…”
unit.target: Ex hoc prospectu, nauta—vel potius evocatus non viventium—adhuc fatum habere debet, sed exitus immutabilis manet…

unit.source: “Indeed, they have destinies, but my current rank isn’t high enough to see them, is it? After all, objects have destinies too, but I can’t see them now…”
unit.target: Revera, fata habent; sed gradus meus nunc non satis altus est ad ea perspicienda, an non? Nam et res fata habent, sed nunc ea videre non possum…

unit.source: “It might also be that the destinies of the dead need to interact with others to manifest in the destinies of those others…”
unit.target: Forsitan etiam fata mortuorum cum aliis agere necesse habeant ut in fatibus illorum manifesta fiant…

unit.source: “Perhaps because he had temporarily become an undead himself, Lumian couldn’t help but ponder the destinies of these “residents” of the Underworld.”
unit.target: Forsitan quia ipse ad tempus in statum non viventium versa esset, Lumian cogitare de fatibus horum “incolarum” Inferorum non potuit non meditari.

unit.source: “With the mystical knowledge he currently possessed, he couldn’t define destiny precisely, nor did he know how much the mercury river of fate encompassed, or whether there were unseen aspects or hidden parts he wasn’t aware of yet.”
unit.target: Cum scientia mystica quam nunc haberet, fatum exacte definire non potuit, nec scivit quantum flumen mercuriale fatum complectat aut num partes invisibiles vel absconditas exsisterent de quibus nondum noscere valeat.

unit.source: “He felt there must be, which stemmed from a few simple questions:”
unit.target: Sentiebat tales esse necesse, a paucis quaestionibus simplicibus orta:

unit.source: “Could it be that by donning the Eggers family’s golden mask and becoming an undead, the river of fate that still existed for me simply disappears, turning utterly black and void?”
unit.target: Num fieri potest ut, induendo larvam auream familiae Eggers et factus in non viventem, flumen fatum, quod mihi adhuc subsistebat, omnino evanescat, se vertens in nigrellum et inane?

unit.source: “And when I take off the mask, does the river of fate instantly return?”
unit.target: Et cum larvam auferam, num flumen fatum statim revertitur?

unit.source: “What then is the river of fate? A plaything at our disposal?”
unit.target: Quid igitur est flumen fatum? An quasi ludibrium nobis tribuendum sit?

unit.source: “Although the golden mask of the Eggers family was made by Death, it didn’t contain Beyonder characteristics and was only of a higher rank.”
unit.target: Etsi larva aurea familiae Eggers a Morte confecta erat, proprietates Beyonder non continens, solum gradus superioris exhibebatur.

unit.source: “It surely wasn’t simple enough to manipulate the river of fate so easily!”
unit.target: Certe non erat satis simplex ut flumen fatum ita facile regere posset!

unit.source: “Later on, if there’s a chance, I should have a Monster pathway Beyonder observe my fate to see the changes before and after donning the golden mask…”
unit.target: Postea, si occasio obveniret, debebo Monstrum semitae Beyonder fatum meum observare ut mutationes ante larvam auream induendam et postea notentur…

unit.source: “Uh… never mind, unless I find a demigod-level Monster pathway Beyonder, otherwise it would only harm them.
unit.target: Heu… noli quaerere, nisi inveniam Beyonder ad gradum demidei in semita Monstrorum; alioquin tantum illis noceret.

unit.source: “Even when I had only Mr. Fool’s seal, the false angelic rank, and the residual aura of the Blood Emperor, the patrol team’s ‘machine’ Kolobo from Port Pylos was already too afraid to look at me, thinking it would bring him great danger.”
unit.target: Etiam cum solum sigillo Domini Stulti, falso ordine angelico, atque reliqua aura Imperatoris Sanguinis haberem, machina „Kolobo“ turmae speculatoriae ex Portu Pylos iam nimis timebat me inspicere, existimans magnum periculum illi afferre.

unit.source: “Now, I have also added the Underworld Daoist’s seal and Omebella’s bloodline…”
unit.target: Nunc quoque sigillum Taoistae Inferorum atque sanguinis Omebellae adieci…

unit.source: “Lumian positioned himself at the center of the battered boat, allowing the golden mask to turn his eyes iron-black.”
unit.target: Lumian se in media parte barcae laesa collocavit, permittens larvam auream oculos eius in ferreo nigros verti.

unit.source: “He wanted to preemptively spot the boatman’s weaknesses to prepare for any potential mishaps.”
unit.target: Volebat praevenire infirmitates nautae, ut ad quamlibet casus incertos se praepararet.

unit.source: “At that moment, the highly decayed boatman began to row, slowly steering the dark boat towards the other side of the surreal, shadowy river.”
unit.target: Illo momento, nauta, valde corruptus, remigare coepit, lente barcam obscuram versus alteram ripam fluminis surreali et umbrato gubernans.

unit.source: “His body was entirely cloaked in dark colors, and Lumian struggled to find any sign of a vulnerable pale spot amid the black.”
unit.target: Corpus eius totum in tenebrosis coloribus vestebatur, et Lumian differebat aliquem indicium vulnerabilis pallidae maculae intra nigredinem invenire.

unit.source: “Of course, these dark colors also meant that the boatman was completely vulnerable to sunlight and lightning.”
unit.target: Certe, hi colores obscuri etiam significabant nautam omnino subiectum radiis solis et fulminibus esse.

unit.source: “The next second, Knight of Swords Maric’s voice rang in Lumian’s ears: ‘Its weaknesses might not be here.’”
unit.target: Secundo postremo, vox equitis gladii Maric in auribus Lumiani sonuit: „Infirmitates eius hic fortasse non adsunt.“

unit.source: “Not here? What do you mean they’re not here? Can weaknesses be separated from the person?”
unit.target: Non hic? Quid hoc significas? Possunt infirmitates a persona separari?

unit.source: “Just as Lumian was filled with intense curiosity, he remembered several stories his sister had once told him.”
unit.target: Sicut Lumian vehementer curiositate repletus esset, meminit multarum fabularum quas soror eius olim narraverat.

unit.source: “In those stories, a type of monster called a lich would create phylacteries and hide them in heavily protected, secret places.”
unit.target: In illis fabulis, genus monstri, lich appellatus, phylactera creabat et ea in locis arcte custodiendis atque occultis recondebat.

unit.source: “As long as the phylacteries were not found and destroyed, the lich would not truly die, effectively separating its fatal weakness from itself.”
unit.target: Dum phylactera non deprehendantur nec deleri possint, lich vere non moriebatur, efficaciter fatalem infirmitatem a se separans.

unit.source: (Amonoculus’ note: phylactery ⌜ either of two small square leather boxes containing slips inscribed with scriptural passages and traditionally worn on the left arm and on the head by observant Jewish men and especially adherents of Orthodox Judaism during morning weekday prayers.)
unit.target: (Nota Amonoculi: “phylactery” – unum ex duobus parvis capsulis quadratis coriaceis, in quibus schedulae cum inscriptionibus sacris continentur, et quae more solito a viris Iudaeis observantibus—praesertim ab orthodoxis cultoribus—in brachio sinistro atque in capite geruntur, praesertim in precibus matutinis dierum hebdomadicorum.)

unit.source: “And in the twenty-two paths of the divine, such things were hardly surprising.”
unit.target: Et in viginti duobus itineribus divinis, talia vix mirabilia erant.

unit.source: “The Knight of Swords continued, ‘Were you trying to discern its fate earlier?’”
unit.target: Eques Gladii perrexit: „Num prius fatum eius quaerebas?“

unit.source: “It holds a considerable rank; this is a dangerous endeavor.”
unit.target: „Magnum gradum tenet; hoc res periculosa est.“

unit.source: “A considerable rank? Lumian glanced at the boatman, draped in tattered clothes and highly decayed flesh, unable to see anything particularly formidable about it.”
unit.target: „Magnus gradus?“ Lumian aspexit nautam, vestimentis lacerrimis et carne graviter corrupta indutum, nihil vere formidolosum in eo perspicuum esse censens.

unit.source: “However, the fact that it could ferry across the River Styx without sinking into it certainly suggested something extraordinary.”
unit.target: Attamen, quod Styx flumen transferre poterat sine se mergendo, certam aliquam rem extraordinariam significabat.

unit.source: “Lumian diverted his gaze, closely watching the boatman’s every move, patiently waiting as the dilapidated boat made its way across the River Styx to the opposite shore.”
unit.target: Lumian oculos avertit, omnes motus nautae diligenter inspiciens, patienter exspectans dum barca laesa per Styx flumen ad ripam alteram navigaret.

unit.source: “The battered boat rocked slowly, as if it might fall apart at any moment, taking what felt like an eternity to reach the middle of the river.”
unit.target: Barca laesa lente fremuit, quasi quovis momento dissolveri posset, atque quasi aeternitatem caperet ad medium fluminis perveniendum.

unit.source: “Suddenly, the highly decayed boatman raised its long oar and turned toward Lumian.”
unit.target: Subito, nauta valde corruptus longum remum elevavit et versus Lumian se vertit.

unit.source: “As the gloomy boat came to a halt, the boatman’s mouth abruptly opened, splitting down to its decayed chest, its hollowed-out navel, and further down to its groin.”
unit.target: Dum barca lugubris consederet, os nautae subito aperitum est, extendens se usque ad pectus corruptum, per umbilicum excavatum, et usque ad inguen.

unit.source: “Its body unfolded like a coat unbuttoning, stretching out to the sides, revealing no darkened organs or bones of its own, but rather a heap of half-melted, decayed limbs.”
unit.target: Corpus eius evolutum est quasi vestis soluta, latera pandens, non ostendens ulla obscurata viscera aut ossa sua, sed potius acervum membrorum dimidium liquefactorum et corruptorum.

unit.source: “Once again, Lumian felt a chill that made him shudder, daring not to harbor any thoughts of resistance.”
unit.target: Rursus, Lumian frigoris sensu pervultus est, qui eum trepidare fecit, ne auderet ullas cogitationes repugnationis fovere.

unit.source: “He clenched his right hand, which had been ready.”
unit.target: Dextram manum, quae praeparata iam erat, concluxit.

unit.source: “He grasped the Sword of Courage from the Traveler’s Bag, holding the hilt of the iron-black broadsword.”
unit.target: Gladium Fortitudinis ex sacco viatoris arripuit, manubrium gladii ferrei nigri tenens.

unit.source: “Courage swiftly filled Lumian’s body, prompting a manic smile on his face.”
unit.target: Fortitudo celeriter corpus Lumiani replevit, provocans risum insanum in facie eius.

unit.source: “What is there to fear from a mere boatman?”
unit.target: Quid est metuendum ab mero nauta?

unit.source: “Even if Death Himself stood before me, I would strike Him down with my sword!”
unit.target: Etiam si Mors ipse coram me steteret, eum gladio meo ferirem!

unit.source: “Lumian drew his broadsword, now ablaze with white-blue flames, and slashed fiercely at the boatman, who was lunging at him with its skin peeled open.”
unit.target: Lumian gladium suum extraxit, nunc flammis albo-caeruleis incensum, et ferociter nautam oppugnavit, qui ad eum impetum faciebat, cute expolita.

unit.source: “With a thud, the Sword of Courage cut through the pile of melting limbs in the boatman’s stomach and struck the layer of rotting skin riddled with holes behind its chest.”
unit.target: Cum strepitu, Gladius Fortitudinis per agger membrorum liquefactorum in stomacho nautae transectus est et ictum givit strata cutis putridae, foraminibus infixa, post pectus eius.

unit.source: “But the broadsword failed to split the seemingly fragile, decayed skin.”
unit.target: At gladium ferreum cutem, quae parum firma et corrupta videbatur, dividere non potuit.

unit.source: “As Lumian readied a second strike, one accompanied by a massive explosion, the boatman swiftly recoiled, slowly closing its opened chest and abdomen.”
unit.target: Dum Lumian secundum ictum parabat, cui magna explosio comitabat, nauta celeriter recedens, lente pectus et abdomina aperta claudebat.

unit.source: “At the same time, the voice of the Knight of Swords rang in Lumian’s ears: ‘Stop. We’ve got it under control’”
unit.target: Simul vox equitis gladii in auribus Lumiani sonuit: „Siste. Illud sub nostra potestate est.“

unit.source: “This is our chance to finish it off!” Lumian responded without hesitation.
unit.target: „Hoc est occasio nostra ut illud conficiamus!“ respondit Lumian sine cunctatione.

unit.source: “He and the Knight of Swords were communicating in Intis.”
unit.target: Ipse et Eques Gladii in lingua Intis colloquebantur.

unit.source: “The Knight of Swords paused for a second and said, ‘I know, you’re not afraid of it, and you could kill it, but if it dies, we can’t cross the River Styx.’”
unit.target: Eques Gladii paulisper cessavit et dixit: „Scio te id non timere nec non potuisse occidere; sed si moritur, Styx flumen transire non possumus.“

unit.source: “Seeing Lumian calm down a bit, the Knight of Swords added, ‘Besides, killing it won’t grant you any Beyonder characteristics. It’s merely the skin of the true Ferryman. It seems to have been consuming other corpses, trying to regain a body but never succeeding.’”
unit.target: Videns Lumian paululum se quietum reddi, Eques Gladii addidit: „Praeterea, eius interficere tibi nullas proprietates Beyonder conferet; solum cutis veri Ferryman est. Videtur alios cadavera vorasse, corpus restituere conans sed numquam succedere.“

unit.source: “Lumian accepted the Knight of Swords’ explanation.”
unit.target: Lumian explicationem Equitis Gladii accepit.

unit.source: “Having courage didn’t mean being deaf to others’ words, it’s just selectively ignoring dangerous warnings.”
unit.target: Fortitudo habita non significat aliorum verba non audire; sed potius monitiones periculosas selective ignorare.

unit.source: “He then placed the Sword of Courage back among the ordinary straight swords in the Traveler’s Bag.”
unit.target: Tum gladium Fortitudinis inter gladios ordinarios et rectos in sacco viatoris reponit.

unit.source: “This time, he didn’t feel the post-event fear because this was the purpose of using the Sword of Courage. The only thing he feared was:”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, metu post eventum non affectus est, nam hoc propositum usus Gladii Fortitudinis erat. Solum quod eum terruit fuit:

unit.source: “A demigod’s skin has been peeled off? What in hell happened in the Underworld back then?”
unit.target: Cutis demidei expolita est? Quid in Inferis tunc evenit?

unit.source: “Lumian watched as the boatman slowly and struggle-fully pinched together the split skin and rotting flesh on its chest, like buttoning up a coat.”
unit.target: Lumian observabat nauta, lente et strenue, cute scissa et carne putrescente in pectore congregare, quasi vestem fibulari conaretur.

unit.source: “Following this, the boatman plunged its long, dark, decayed oar into the surreal shadowy River Styx, moving it at an even slower pace as if resisting something.”
unit.target: Post hoc, nauta longum, obscurum et corruptum remum in flumen Styx surreale et umbratum immergit, eo multo tardius movere videtur quasi aliquid oppresseret.

unit.source: “Has the demigod of the temperance faction possessed the boatman, forcefully taking control and making it continue to row? It looks like this control is met with strong resistance… Lumian remained ready to draw the Sword of Courage again in case of any unforeseen incidents.”
unit.target: Num demideus factionis temperantiae nautam possiderit, vehementer imperium sumens atque remigare perpetuare coercens? Videor hoc imperium cum valida oppositione occurri… Lumian paratus remansit gladium Fortitudinis iterum extrahere, si quid inopinatum accideret.

unit.source: “As the gloomy boat rocked its way towards the opposite shore of the Styx, Lumian, having nothing better to do, started a conversation with the Knight of Swords.”
unit.target: Dum barca lugubris viam suam ad ripam oppositam Styx navigabat, Lumian, nihil melius agens, colloquium cum Equite Gladii inire coepit.

unit.source: “I saw the entire Underworld as a series of descending layers earlier. Crossing the Styx should just get us to the other side of this layer, so why did you say it’s like entering deep into the Underworld?”
unit.target: „Totum Infernum vidi ut seriem stratorum decrescentium antea. Transire Styx nos solummodo ad ripam huius strata deducere debet; cur ergo dixisti hoc simile esse ingressui in profunda Inferna?“

unit.source: “The Knight of Swords simply replied, ‘The geography of the Underworld doesn’t completely align with the real world. According to the many notes of the Eggers family, there are two ways to enter the depths of the Underworld. The first is to descend layer by layer through the worlds encircling the Styx, which are used to punish sinners, ultimately arriving at the realm where the Blessed of Death reside. The second is to cross the Styx directly.’”
unit.target: Eques Gladii simpliciter respondit: „Geographia Inferni non perfecte congruit cum mundo reali. Secundum multas notas familiae Eggers, duo modi sunt ad intrandum profunditates Inferni. Primo stratum post stratum per mundos circa Styx qui ad peccatores puniendos adhibentur descendi debet, tandem ad regnum ubi beati Mortis resident; secundo vero Styx directe transiri oportet.“

unit.source: “Is that so…” Lumian mused aloud, “So, our destination is the realm once inhabited by the Blessed of Death?”
unit.target: „Sic ergo…” meditatus audibiliter est Lumian, „Ergo, propositum nostrum est regnum, quod olim a Beatis Mortis incolatum erat?“

unit.source: “The Knight of Swords paused for a second and said, ‘Death’s palace should be there as well.’”
unit.target: Eques Gladii paulisper cessavit et dixit: „Palatium Mortis ibi quoque esse debet.“

unit.source: “The palace of the former Death? Lumian’s eyelids twitched at the thought.”
unit.target: „Palatium prioris Mortis?“ Palpebra Lumiani ad hanc rem subitam contrahere coeperunt.

unit.source: “As he and the Knight of Swords alternated between silence and conversation, the boundary on the other side of the Styx finally came into view.”
unit.target: Dum ille et Eques Gladii inter silentia atque sermonem alternabantur, limen contra Styx tandem in conspectum venit.

unit.source: 769 Incomplete Corpse
unit.target: 769 Corpus Incompletum

unit.source: 769 Incomplete Corpse
unit.target: 769 Corpus Incompletum

unit.source: Unlike the wilderness Lumian and company had passed through earlier, strewn with grayish‐white rocks, the soil on this side of the River Styx was pitch black.
unit.target: Contra silvas per quas ante Lumian cum comitatu iter fecerat – in quibus lapides cinere–albi sparsi erant – terra hujus parti fluminis Styx plane atra erat.

unit.source: There were no withered blood‐colored flowers, no ghostly skeletons, and no decaying corpses to be seen.
unit.target: Nec flores defessi, sanguineo colore tincti; nec scheletra umbratica; nec corpora putrida videbantur.

unit.source: The sky above was no longer lit by pale, dim, cold “sunlight.”
unit.target: Caelum superne iam non illustrabatur a luce solis – pallida, exigua, frigida.

unit.source: Instead, a rich darkness dominated this boundless world.
unit.target: Proinde dives tenebrae in hoc mundo immenso dominantur.

unit.source: Deep within the darkness, clusters of pale‐white, greenish–hued flames hung quietly in mid–air, spaced far apart as if serving as street lamps.
unit.target: In profundo tenebrarum, coetus flammarum pallido–albae, viridi tinctarum, silentio in aere suspendebantur, longe separati quasi lampades viarias fungentes.

unit.source: Using the illumination from the nearest pale flame, Lumian quickly leaped from the gloomy boat to the shore.
unit.target: Luce flammae pallidae proximae utens, Lumian celeriter ex navicula lugubri ad litus salivit.

unit.source: Once his feet hit solid ground, his heart steadied considerably.
unit.target: Cum pedes in terram solidam incidissent, cor eius notabiliter se tranquillavit.

unit.source: As he crossed the River Styx, the scent of death in his undead body became more intense and evident, while his spirit and consciousness, tightly protected by the Eggers family’s golden mask, felt a slight chill.
unit.target: Dum flumen Styx transibat, odor mortis in corpore eius – iam quasi mortuo – intensior atque clarius factus est; at mens et animus, strictissime a larva aurea familiae Eggers custodi, levem frigoris titubationem sensere.

unit.source: Following that, a sinister coldness pervaded his body, but the highly decayed boatman, with its hollow eyes, simply reinserted its long oar back into the river’s current.
unit.target: Postea frigida malignitas totum corpus eius pervadit, sed nauta putrescens, oculis cavis, simpliciter longum remum in cursum fluminis reintroduxit.

unit.source: It made no new move to attack Lumian.
unit.target: Nullam novam agitatum ad Lumian impugnandum suscepit.

unit.source: It seemed incapable of attacking targets on the shore.
unit.target: Videbatur id non posse hostes in litore oppugnare.

unit.source: Watching the gloomy boat and the boatman, now facing away from him, slowly drift away, Lumian mused, “Not going to finish it off? With its rank, that decayed human skin would match your messenger quite well”
unit.target: Spectans naviculam lugubrem et nautam, nunc se a eum avertentem, lente aberrare, Lumian meditatus est: “Nonne id exstinguere vis? Eius foetentia – illa putrescens cutis humana – optime nunti tuo congruere videtur.”

unit.source: This referred to the Knight of Swords’ messenger, the Half–Fairy, a spirit being missing the outer half of her body, meaning she was precisely lacking human skin, while the boatman was just the peeled skin of a demigod from the Death pathway.
unit.target: Id referebat nuntio equitis gladii, “Semifae”, entitati spiritali cui dimidia pars exteriorem corporis deesset – id quod significabat eam prorsus caret cute humana – dum nauta solum erat cutis expolita semidiei ex via Mortis.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords was silent for a few seconds, letting his voice echo in Lumian’s ears: “She only lacks her own skin.”
unit.target: Eques gladii paucos momenta silentium tenuit, sinens vocem suam in auribus Luminiani resonare: “Ea sola cuti suae caret.”

unit.source: This reply was curt and restrained, yet Lumian almost heard the Knight of Swords roar: Don’t just find any skin for my messenger to wear!
unit.target: Responsio illa brevis et contenta fuit, tamen Lumian paene audivit equitem gladii rugire: “Noli quaerere quamlibet cutem pro nunti meae induendam!”

unit.source: Pausing for a second, the Knight of Swords continued, “We might need to return across the River Styx, and we don’t know how many Ferryman are left there.”
unit.target: Postremo paulo moratus, Eques gladii continevit: “Forsitan necesse sit nos per flumen Styx redire; neque scimus quot ferrymanni ibi reliqui sint.”

unit.source: A need to return across the Styx? Lumian then pondered a very serious and important question.
unit.target: Nonne necesse est per Styx redire? Tum Lumian quaestionem valde seriem et momentariam meditatus est.

unit.source: After dealing with Oxyto’s child, how do we leave the Underworld?
unit.target: Postquam de filio Oxyto agendum fuit, quo modo ex Inferis discedere possimus?

unit.source: Clearly, this was not something that could be solved by teleportation.
unit.target: Manifestum erat hoc rem non posse solvi per translationem instantaneam.

unit.source: Our allies in the outside world should be seeking help from the Death pathway’s Sequence 5 Gatekeeper or a corresponding demigod, which might necessitate our return to the peripheral areas of the Underworld we were in before, to access the bronze doors of the Underworld.
unit.target: Socii nostri in mundo externo auxilium quaerere debent a Custode Sequenciae V viae Mortis aut a semideo congruente, quod fortasse nos redire ad regiones laterales Inferorum – in quibus antea fuimus – aditum ad ianuas aeneas obtinendi requiret.

unit.source: Lumian nodded, following a vague sensation brought on by the black mark on his right shoulder, and took a step forward.
unit.target: Lumian annuit, secutus sensum vagum a nigro signo in dextro humero ortum, et passum in antefecit.

unit.source: He didn’t ask the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction demigod if he was veering off the path to find Oxyto’s child.
unit.target: Non rogavit Equitem gladii neque semideum factionis temperantiae, num a via ad Oxyto filium inveniendum aberrare inciperet.

unit.source: If he were wrong, they would inform him.
unit.target: Si errasset, illi eum certiorem facerent.

unit.source: Reaching the nearest pale flame, Lumian realized it truly served as a street lamp.
unit.target: Adveniens ad flammam pallidam proximam, Lumian animadvertit eam vere lampada viaria fungere.

unit.source: It was crafted from gold, shaped like a kneeling figure with hands bound behind its back, its head tilted back and torso bent outward.
unit.target: Auro factum erat, effigiæ genuflexae similis, manibus post tergum alligatis, capite retrorsum inclinato et pectore protracto.

unit.source: A dark, sinister wick protruded from the statue’s mouth, coated in a layer of pale yellow translucent grease.
unit.target: Ex ore statuae protrudebat funiculus obscurus et sinistrus, opertus strato unctus pallide flavus translucidi.

unit.source: The pale–white flame burned quietly, seemingly for thousands of years without a hint of extinguishing.
unit.target: Flamma pallido–alba tranquille ardebat, quasi per milia annorum sine ullo signo exstinguendi permaneret.

unit.source: From this human–shaped lamp onward, the ground was covered with dark, cracked stone slabs.
unit.target: Ex hac lampada humaniformi, terra coperiebatur lapidibus obscuris, fissis.

unit.source: Lumian could imagine just how solemn and solemn the path to Death’s palace must have been.
unit.target: Lumian imaginari poterat quam solemnis atque solemnis via ad palatium Mortis esse deberet.

unit.source: (Amonoculus’ note: Not sure why the official translation has used the word solemn twice here.)
unit.target: (Notatio Amonoculi: Nescio cur translatio officialis verbum “solemnus” bis usurpare videatur.)

unit.source: He walked along the path, which was inexplicably cracked and shattered, quickly but cautiously heading deeper into the darkness, towards the place suspected to hold the Abscessed Hand’s body part.
unit.target: Per viam ambulavit, quae inexplicabiliter fissae et dissipatae erant, celeriter sed caute in tenebras profundiores procedens, ad locum suspectum partem corporis “Manus Abcessae” continere.

unit.source: The path also presented a slightly downward trajectory.
unit.target: Iter quoque paulum deorsum inclinatum apparuit.

unit.source: This reminded Lumian of Hotel Orella he had once stayed in, recalling the words spoken by Iveljsta, a descendant of Death – many believed that the true hell and the origin of death lay deep underground, so one had to continually descend, delving deeper and deeper.
unit.target: Hoc Lumian de Hotel Orella, in quo olim mansit, recordari faciebat verba Iveljsta, descendantis Mortis, quorum multi credebant verum infernum atque originem mortis in profundo subterraneo iacere, ita ut continue descendendum esset, semper magis et magis penetriens.

unit.source: This is reflected in the Underworld too… After walking for a while, Lumian suddenly conjured a large, blazing white flame in his hand.
unit.target: Hoc in Inferis quoque evidentiam habebat… Post aliquod ambulatum, Lumian subito in manu sua magnam flammam albae ardentis evocavit.

unit.source: The bright light quickly dispelled the darkness further away, allowing Lumian to clearly see the surroundings: Mausoleum–style buildings were either completely collapsed or half fallen, deathly quiet, with no bones or bodies.
unit.target: Lumen splendens celeriter tenebras procul dissolvit, concedens Lumiano ut circumstantia clare videret: aedificia, similia mausoleis, aut penitus collapsa aut partim conlapsa, mortifera silentia, nec ossa nec corpora habentia.

unit.source: These buildings varied in color, not just black, but also pale–white, golden, dark red, and sinister green.
unit.target: Haec aedificia variis coloribus fulgebant – non solum nigra, sed etiam pallido–alba, aurea, rubra obscura et viridi sinistra.

unit.source: “Did the Blessed of Death once live in these houses?” Lumian asked the Knight of Swords, who was well–versed in the history of the Southern Continent and the legends of the Underworld.
unit.target: “Num benedictus Mortis olim in his domibus habitaverit?” quaesivit Lumian ab Equite gladii, qui bene versatus erat in historia Continentis Meridionalis atque fabulis Inferorum.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords replied succinctly, “I don’t know”
unit.target: Eques gladii breviter respondit: “Nescio.”

unit.source: He then added, “Only by finding a creature that entered and exited the Underworld before the fall of Death can we be sure.”
unit.target: Deinde addidit: “Solum inventione creaturae, quae Inferos ante lapsum Mortis ingressa et egressa est, certi esse possumus.”

unit.source: “Alright…” Lumian didn’t press further and quickened his pace.
unit.target: “Bene…” inquit Lumian, nec ulterius quaerens, celerius procedens.

unit.source: This was because he felt that the body part of the Abscessed Hand was not far ahead!
unit.target: Id erat, quod sensit partem corporis “Manus Abcessae” non esse longe praeesse!

unit.source: His right hand went back into the Traveler’s Bag, ready to draw the Sword of Courage at any moment.
unit.target: Manus dextra in Sacculum Viatoris reoccupavit, parata ad gladium Fortitudinis quovis momento extrahendum.

unit.source: As for the Devil’s Whispers ring, he didn’t plan to wear it yet; he didn’t think becoming undead would immunize him against the malevolent effects unleashed by that Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Quod ad annulum “Daemonum Susurri” attinet, nondum eum induere intendebat; non putabat se, postquam undead factus esset, immunem fore adversus malignos effectus ab illo artefacto sigillato effulgatos.

unit.source: Undead beings could harbor malice too!
unit.target: Entia mortua etiam malitiam in se colere poterant!

unit.source: After all, undead beings such as wraiths and evil spirits were formed around the core of their own obsessions and residual malice.
unit.target: Postremo, entia mortua ut umbrae et spiritus mali circa nucleum propriarum obsessionum et residuae malitiae formabantur.

unit.source: Moreover, Lumian’s spirit and consciousness were still protected by the golden mask of the Eggers family, remaining in a living state.
unit.target: Praeterea, spiritus ac mens Luminiani adhuc a larva aurea familiae Eggers proteguntur, permanentes in statu vivi.

unit.source: After a quick jog, guided by the pale–white flame of the human–shaped street lamps and the blazing white orb above, Lumian discovered a grand structure along the side of the cracked stone slabs.
unit.target: Post celerem cursum, ductus flammae pallido–albae lampadarum humaniformium atque orbis albi ardentis superne, Lumian magnam structuram iuxta lapidum fissarum tabulas invenit.

unit.source: It appeared to be a cathedral, entirely black and about fifty to sixty meters tall, but its upper half had already collapsed into the lower part.
unit.target: Videtur esse cathēdrā, omnino nigra atque circiter quinquaginta ad sexaginta metra alta, sed pars superior iam in partem inferiorem ceciderat.

unit.source: Lumian concentrated, listening intently, and heard faint, strange sounds emanating from the grand but ruined cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian intentione fusus, diligenter auscultavit, atque sonos leves et mirabiles, ex illa magna sed ruina cathēdrā emanantes, audivit.

unit.source: It was as if someone was using a blunt sword to slice through flesh and saw through bones, causing a headache to the listener.
unit.target: Sicut si quis gladio obtuso carnem secaret et ossa concideret, capitis dolorem audienti inferens.

unit.source: “I have another matter to resolve inside this cathedral,” Lumian finally disclosed his intent to the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction demigod.
unit.target: “Altera quaestio mihi intra hanc cathēdrām solvenda est,” tandem Lumian propositum suum Equiti gladii atque semideo factionis temperantiae enuntiavit.

unit.source: He then firmly added, “It should be quick.”
unit.target: Deinde firmiter addidit: “Celeriter peragenda est.”

unit.source: He remembered what Madam Magician had said: the true danger of the Abscessed Hand would only manifest once all its parts were assembled, and currently, two parts were still in the City of Exiles Morora, so there was no need to worry about that.
unit.target: Meminit verba Dominae Magicae: verum periculum “Manus Abcessae” manifestandum esset tantum cum omnes eius partes congeriescerentur, et nunc duo partes adhuc in Urbe Exilium Morora manere – ergo non erat causa sollicitudinis.

unit.source: The enemy he might face next could be the undead being creating the sound just heard.
unit.target: Inimicus quem sequenti oppugnare posset, fortasse esset entitas mortua, quae sonum nuper auditum creabat.

unit.source: “Alright,” the Knight of Swords did not inquire about the specifics.
unit.target: “Optime,” respondit Eques gladii, nec ulterius in subtilitates percontans.

unit.source: “Thank you,” Lumian responded sincerely.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago,” sincere Lumian respondit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords and the temperance faction demigod neither objected nor disengaged from Lumian’s body, indicating their tacit approval to provide the necessary assistance when needed.
unit.target: Eques gladii atque semideus factionis temperantiae nec obiecerunt nec a corpore Luminiani se separataverunt, tacitam voluntatem suam ad subsidium necessarium, si opus esset, praebendum declarantes.

unit.source: Lumian extinguished the blazing white orb hovering above his head to avoid provoking the undead within the dilapidated cathedral.
unit.target: Lumian orbem albi ardentis, qui super caput eius volitabat, exstinxit, ne entia mortua intra cathēdram dilapidatam provocaret.

unit.source: He transformed into a shadow, blending into the areas not illuminated by the pale–white flames, and silently infiltrated the building whose upper half had entirely collapsed inward.
unit.target: Se in umbram vertit, miscens se in locis non illustratis a flammis pallido–albis, et tacite in aedificium se infiltavit, cuius pars superiora penitus intus ceciderat.

unit.source: From the shadows, Lumian saw columns thrust into the ground, a dome shattered into pieces, and a bird statue broken in half.
unit.target: Ex umbris Lumian columnas in terram coniunctas, cupolam in frusta confractam, atque statuam avis dimidiatam animadvertit.

unit.source: After winding through the ruins for a while, Lumian’s path brightened suddenly.
unit.target: Postquam per ruinas aliquatenus erravit, iter Luminiani subito clarum factum est.

unit.source: Ten meters ahead on a crumbling wall, several bone torches burning with pale green flames were inserted, the dense darkness above streaming through a large hole created by the collapsed dome, blocked outside by this dim light.
unit.target: Decem metris ante in pariete corrodente, insertae erant plures luminaria ex ossibus, cum flammis viridulis pallidis ardentibus; et tenebrae denses supra per magnum foramen, quod cupola collapsa creaverat, extra hanc lucem exigua obstrictae videbantur.

unit.source: Beneath the bone torches, a long table made of grayish–white stone was set up, upon which lay a half–corpse, head severed and vertically split open.
unit.target: Sub luminariis ossium, mensa longa ex lapide cinereo–albo posita erat, in qua iacebat dimidium cadaver – capite abscisso et verticaliter diviso.

unit.source: The corpse wore no clothes, its body bluish–black and swollen with decay, oozing yellowish–red pus everywhere.
unit.target: Cadaver nullas vestes gerebat; corpus eius, caesi nigroque, putre tumens, ubique exundabat pus flavido–ruber.

unit.source: It appeared significantly larger than a normal human, unclear whether it was a half–giant in life or merely bloated by post–mortem gasses.
unit.target: Videtur notabiliter maius quam homo ordinarius, nec certum an semigigas in vita fuisset aut solum post mortem gasorum inflatum esset.

unit.source: Lumian recognized it instantly—this was the body of the Abscessed Hand!
unit.target: Lumian statim id agnovit – hoc erat corpus “Manus Abcessae”!

unit.source: It comprised the left half, including one hand and one foot.
unit.target: Illud complebatur ex dimidio sinistro, una manu et uno pede inclusis.

unit.source: In front of the Abscessed Hand’s corpse stood a towering figure, about four meters tall.
unit.target: Ante corpus “Manus Abcessae” stabat figura excelsa, circiter quattuor metra alta.

unit.source: The figure’s skin was pitch–black, etched with numerous sinister patterns, most of which had decayed, exposing bare, ghostly white bones or appearing as half–melted, viscous tissue.
unit.target: Cutis figurae erat plane nigra, multis formis sinistris incisa; quarum pleraeque putrescere coeperant, ostendentque ossa nuda et spectra alba aut quasi dimidio liquefacta, viscosa substantia apparentes.

unit.source: At that moment, this figure, bent over, was slowly cutting into the half–corpse of the Abscessed Hand with an even larger pale–white leg bone, likely from another unknown source.
unit.target: In illo momento, illa figura, incurvata, lente in dimidium cadaver “Manus Abcessae” incidebat, utens ossa cruris maiore, pallido–alba, fortasse ex alio ignoto fonte orta.

unit.source: Lumian noticed two curved, tattered black goat horns growing from the figure’s head, its profile resembling a fusion of human and goat features, becoming increasingly terrifying the longer he looked.
unit.target: Lumian animadvertit duas cornua caprina, curvata et lacerata, ex capite illius figurae oriunda; cuius vultus, mixtura formarum humanarum atque caprinarum, magis ac magis terribilis apparebat quanto diutius ea contemplaretur.

unit.source: An undead being transformed from a Beyonder of the Devil pathway after death? Just as Lumian had this thought, he saw the goat–faced giant slice off a chunk of bluish–black decaying flesh and stuff it into its mouth, chewing vigorously, causing pale yellow pus to splatter.
unit.target: Num entitas mortua, ex Beyonder viae Diaboli post mortem transformata, existimanda sit? Quamquam Lumian hoc cogitaverat, vidit gigantem, vultu caprino ornatum, partem carnis caesi nigro putrescens excidere et in os suum infundere, vehementer masticans, quo pus pallidum flavus spargere coepit.

unit.source: On the half–corpse of the Abscessed Hand, the decaying flesh writhed and grew, filling in the cuts made.
unit.target: In dimidio cadaver “Manus Abcessae”, caro putrescentis contorquebatur atque crescebat, vulnera facta reficiens.

unit.source: A cycle of one eating, the other growing? Lumian was pondering a plan to take the Abscessed Hand’s corpse when the Devil–like undead suddenly turned around, looked towards the shadows where he was hiding, and spoke in an unintelligible language using a hollow, decayed voice.
unit.target: Cyclum edendi alteriusque crescendi? Lumian consilium de capiendi cadavere “Manus Abcessae” meditabatur, cum repente entitas mortua, similis Diaboli, se converteret, versus umbras, ubi latebat, aspiciens atque in lingua inculta, voce cava et putrescente locutus esset.

unit.source: Though he couldn’t understand the words, Lumian felt a strange pulsation in his flesh, compelling him to leave his shadow form and revert to his undead appearance with the golden mask.
unit.target: Quamquam verba intellegere non poterat, Lumian in carne sua pulsationem miram sensit, quae eum compellite reliqui formam umbramque relinquere atque ad speciem mortuam cum larva aurea redeundi causa fuit.

unit.source: However, the decaying, goat–faced Devil did not take the opportunity to attack.
unit.target: Attamen, diabolus decrescentis, vultu caprino, non usus est occasionem ad impetum faciendum.

unit.source: After two seconds, the voice of the Knight of Swords reached Lumian’s ears: “It’s asking: ‘Do you need flesh?’”
unit.target: Post duas secunda, vox Equitis gladii in auribus Luminiani pervenit: “Rogat: ‘Opusne tibi est carne?’”

unit.source: Do you need flesh? Lumian was first stunned, then relieved that he had a translator.
unit.target: “Opusne tibi est carne?” Primo Lumian stupefactus est, deinde solatus, quod interpretorem haberet.

unit.source: Looking at the hunched–over, Devil–like giant undead, Lumian suddenly had a strange thought: Is this considered making a deal with a Demon?
unit.target: Aspiciens in ingentem entitatem mortuam, concavam atque Diaboli similem, Lumian repente cogitavit: “Num hoc pactum cum Daemone esse existimandum sit?”

unit.source: Has the aftereffects from using the Authority Holder’s Under–the–table Transaction finally caught up with me?
unit.target: Num effectus ex usu “transactionis sub mensa” Auctoritatis Tenentis tandem me persecuti sint?

unit.source: 770 Egg
unit.target: 770 Ovum

unit.source: 710 Egg
unit.target: 710 Ovum

unit.source: For a moment, Lumian was unsure whether the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction, a Beyonder item from the Broker pathway, actually had negative effects.
unit.target: Pro momento, Lumian dubitabat num Transactio sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis, res transmundana ex via Negotiatoris, re vera effectus negativos haberet.

unit.source: On the one hand, encountering a deal with Demons and other evil beings surprisingly prevented a potential battle.
unit.target: Ex una parte, congressus cum daemonibus et aliis maleficis entibus, mirum in modum, certamen potentiale impediit.

unit.source: Without this “negative effect,” Lumian suspected he would have been attacked the instant he was spotted by the goat‐faced Demon, instead of being asked if he needed flesh.
unit.target: Sine hoc “effectu negativo,” Lumian suspicabatur se statim oppugnatum fore, quatenus a Daemone vultu caprino deprehenso, pro eo ut interrogaretur an caro desideraret.

unit.source: This seemed like a manifestation of how a Shadow Merchant could reduce the malice from dangerous creatures and mysterious entities.
unit.target: Hoc videbatur esse manifestatio quomodo Mercator Umbrae malitiam creaturarum periculosarum et entium mysteriosorum minuere posset.

unit.source: However, it was definitely wrong if this wasn’t considered a negative effect.
unit.target: Attamen, certe erratum erat, si hoc non habebatur ut effectus negativus.

unit.source: Dealing with a Demon wouldn’t be simple or easy.
unit.target: Negotium cum Daemone non esset simplex neque facilis.

unit.source: It might even be very dangerous, even if the Demon was already dead.
unit.target: Fortasse etiam valde periculosum, etiamsi daemon iam mortuus esset.

unit.source: After a few seconds of deliberation, Lumian, pointing to the half‐body of the Abscessed Hand on the grayish‐white stone table, asked, “I want it all.
unit.target: Post paucas secundas deliberationis, Lumian, ad dimidiatum corpus Manus Abscessae in mensa lapidea cinereo–alba demonstrans, quaesivit: “Omnia volo.

unit.source: What must I give in return?”
unit.target: Quid in vicem dare debeam?

unit.source: He planned to gauge the difficulty of the transaction first.
unit.target: Primum consilium habebat difficultatem transactionis aestimandi.

unit.source: If it proved too challenging, he would ask for help from the temperance faction demigod to confront and collectively eliminate this decaying goat‐faced Demon!
unit.target: Si nimis arduum appareret, auxilium a semideo factionis temperantiae peteret, ut hunc daemonem vultu caprino putrescens oppugnaret et communiter exstirpareret!

unit.source: Having a deal offered by a Demon didn’t mean you had to accept it!
unit.target: Negotium a Daemone oblato non significabat quod id accipere oporteret!

unit.source: As soon as Lumian spoke, he felt his body stiffen and a coldness spread within him.
unit.target: Cum Lumian statim locutus esset, sensit corpus suum rigidum fieri et frigoris sensum intrinsecus diffundi.

unit.source: He understood what was happening and didn’t resist or struggle, then found himself involuntarily speaking in a gravelly, metallic voice, as if using dead vocal cords.
unit.target: Intellexit quid ageretur et nec remisit nec certavit; deinde se invito invenit loquendum voce rauca et metallina, quasi chordas vocales mortuas adhiberet.

unit.source: His words were repeated in an unknown language by the goat‐faced giant, and every word struck a chill into Lumian’s spirit, feeling as though they were piercing his Spirit Body.
unit.target: Verba eius in lingua ignota a giganto vultu caprino repetebantur, et unumquodque verbum frigidum in spiritum Lumiani percutiebat, quasi corpus spirituale eius perforarent.

unit.source: Bent over and goat‐faced, the black‐skinned decaying Demon responded in the same hollow language, its voice echoing ominously.
unit.target: Inclinatus et vultu caprino, daemon putrescens, cum cuti nigrae, respondit in eadem lingua vacua, voce lugubri resonante.

unit.source: One of the words seemed to grasp Lumian’s Spirit Body and body as if by a giant hand.
unit.target: Unum verbum videbatur corpus spiritale Lumiani et corpus eius quasi manu gigantea complecti.

unit.source: If it weren’t for his “dead” state and the protection of the Eggers family’s golden mask, just this interaction alone could have severely harmed him.
unit.target: Nisi ex statu “mortuo” suo et tutela larminae aureae familiae Eggers, sola haec interactio eum graviter laedere potuisset.

unit.source: Soon, the ethereal voice of the Knight of Swords resonated in his mind: “I want Farbauti dead!”
unit.target: Mox, vox aetherica Equis Ensium in mente eius resonabat: “Farbautium mortuum volo!”

unit.source: Farbauti?
unit.target: Farbauti?

unit.source: The Devil Monarch, Farbauti, the true form of Naboredisley?
unit.target: Diabolus Monarchus, Farbauti, veram formam Naboredisley?

unit.source: The terms of the deal require me to kill an ancient god?
unit.target: Pacti condiciones mihi mandant ut deum antiquum occiderem?

unit.source: Lumian narrowed his eyes at the towering goat‐faced devil, regaining control of his voice to say, “That’s an ancient god.
unit.target: Lumian oculos contraxit ad diabolum altum vultu caprino, moderationem vocis recuperans, ut diceret: “Id est deus antiquus.

unit.source: I can’t do it.
unit.target: Non possum.

unit.source: Change the terms.”
unit.target: Muta condiciones.

unit.source: If the goat‐faced devil refused to change the terms, then there was no need for negotiation!
unit.target: Si diabolus vultu caprino condiciones mutare recusaverit, nihil ad contrahendum necessarium erit!

unit.source: Facing an ancient god might be beyond me, but taking you down certainly wasn’t!
unit.target: Oppugnare deum antiquum mihi fortasse impossibile videbatur, sed te superare certe non videbatur!

unit.source: It was just a matter of owing a favor to a demigod!
unit.target: Hoc tantum erat: favorem semidei debere!

unit.source: That debt could be repaid slowly over time!
unit.target: Illud debitum paulatim, tempore solvi poterat!

unit.source: It was unclear whether it was the Knight of Swords or the temperance faction demigod who then took control of Lumian’s body, translating his words into a language the goat‐faced Demon could understand.
unit.target: Non clare patebat utrum Eques Ensium aut semideus factionis temperantiae corpus Lumiani ceperit, verba eius in linguam daemonis vultu caprino intellegibilem converteret.

unit.source: This also brought Lumian a strange sensation.
unit.target: Hoc etiam Lumian sensum mirum attulit.

unit.source: The goat‐faced Demon, capable of standing four to five meters tall but appearing only a bit over three meters due to its bent back, fell silent for a moment before speaking in a deep, hollow tone, “I want that egg.”
unit.target: Daemon vultu caprino, quattuor ad quinque metra altus stare posse, sed propter dorsum incurvum vix paulo plus quam tria metra apparens, paulisper siluit, antequam voce profunda et vacua diceret: “Illud ovum volo.”

unit.source: Egg?
unit.target: Ovum?

unit.source: Lumian muttered to himself in confusion.
unit.target: Lumian sibi, in confusione, submurmuravit.

unit.source: He understood directly because the Knight of Swords had already translated it synchronously.
unit.target: Statim intellexit, nam Eques Ensium id iam simul interpretatus erat.

unit.source: “Where is this egg?” Lumian inquired.
unit.target: “Ubi est hoc ovum?” quaesivit Lumian.

unit.source: As a member of the temperance faction took control of his mouth to relay the question, the decaying goat‐faced Demon let the massive thigh bone in its hand drop to the ground with a loud thud.
unit.target: Dum membrum factionis temperantiae os eius ceperat ad quaestionem referendam, daemon vultu caprino putrescens ossa femorale ingens in manu sua in terram cum magno strepitu deiecit.

unit.source: “In the palace,” the goat‐faced Demon answered simply, making the Knight of Swords’ job of translating much easier.
unit.target: “In palatio,” respondit daemon vultu caprino simpliciter, faciens laborem interpretationis Equis Ensium multo faciliorem.

unit.source: This also made the Knight of Swords’ translation job much easier.
unit.target: Hoc etiam laborem interpretationis Equis Ensium multo faciliorem reddidit.

unit.source: Lumian asked, seeking confirmation, “The palace of Death?”
unit.target: Lumian confirmationem petens quaesivit: “Palatium Mortis?”

unit.source: Could a former divine residence be extremely dangerous?
unit.target: An olim divina residentia valde periculosa esse posset?

unit.source: The goat‐faced Demon’s eyes, oozing blood and pus, shifted slightly.
unit.target: Oculi daemonis vultu caprino, sanguine et suppa fluentes, leviter mutaverunt.

unit.source: Yes.
unit.target: Ita.

unit.source: An egg within Death’s palace…
unit.target: Ovum in palatio Mortis…

unit.source: Lumian hesitated between agreeing to the deal or just seizing it.
unit.target: Lumian inter pactum admittere aut eam tantum arripere haesitavit.

unit.source: As he surveyed his surroundings, he further inquired, “What does this egg look like?”
unit.target: Dum circumiecta contemplabatur, ulterius interrogavit: “Qualis hoc ovum est?”

unit.source: While waiting for the member of the temperance faction to translate, Lumian noticed a broken statue by a half‐buried stone pillar, with only parts of its body remaining.
unit.target: Dum membrum factionis temperantiae interpretationem exspectabat, Lumian statuam fractam iuxta columnam lapideam semi‐sepelitam animadvertit, cui solum partes corporis remaneant.

unit.source: It was vaguely recognizable as an avian statue, its feathers seemingly woven from mystical patterns, pale‐white and dim.
unit.target: Illa vage recognoscibilis erat ut statua avium, quorum plumae quasi ex figuris mysticis contextae, pallide albae et obscurae.

unit.source: An avian statue…
unit.target: Statua avium…

unit.source: Lumian thought, connecting this with the egg the goat‐faced Demon wanted.
unit.target: Lumian cogitavit, hoc cum ovo quod daemon vultu caprino desiderabat coniungens.

unit.source: Once the translation was finished and control of his mouth returned, he added, “A bird’s egg?”
unit.target: Postquam interpretatio confecta est et potestas oris redepta, addidit: “Ovum avium?”

unit.source: After about ten seconds, the goat‐faced Demon dragged its pale thigh bone forward a few steps, which scraped against the ground, producing a grating sound.
unit.target: Post circiter decem secundas, daemon vultu caprino ossa femorale pallida paucis passibus trahebat, quae super terram repediendo sonum stridulentem afferebant.

unit.source: The goat‐faced Demon spoke slowly and intermittently, “Yes.
unit.target: Daemon vultu caprino lente et intermittenter loquebatur, “Ita.

unit.source: It’s large.
unit.target: Illud magnum est.

unit.source: Black, within flames.
unit.target: Nigrum, in flammis.

unit.source: It really is a bird’s egg, and obviously from an abnormal mother…
unit.target: Revera ovum avium est, et manifeste ex matre anormali provenit…

unit.source: Birds…
unit.target: Aves…

unit.source: Lumian suddenly remembered the prematurely born child they were tracking, associated with the Banshees in their full might.
unit.target: Lumian subito recordatus est infanti praecoetu nato, quem insequebantur, qui cum Banshees totius vi coniunctus erat.

unit.source: They resembled birds, with claws and wings!
unit.target: Aves similes erant, cum unguibus et alis!

unit.source: Although there are clear differences from this bird statue, they are at least all birds…
unit.target: Quamquam ab hac statua avium differentiae manifestae sunt, tamen omnes aves sunt…

unit.source: Moreover, since there is an abnormal bird’s egg inside Death’s palace, it implies the existence of a mother, a mother in the mystical sense…
unit.target: Praeterea, cum ovum avium anormalis intra palatium Mortis sit, id existentiam matris, matris mysticae, implicat…

unit.source: Lumian vaguely grasped the reason Oxyto had conceived such a stillborn and cast it into the Underworld.
unit.target: Lumian vage intellexit causam cur Oxyto talem natum mortuum conciperet et in Orcum proiceret.

unit.source: Was her goal also this egg, to use it to do something to the Underworld?
unit.target: Num etiam eius propositum esset hoc ovum ad aliquid in Orco faciendum adhibere?

unit.source: Whether integrating the realm of the dead in the Raklev region into her own Paramita or conducting a ritual to impregnate corpses and bear children, was it all for this purpose?
unit.target: Sive regnum defunctorum in regione Raklev in suam Paramita integrare sive ritum celebrari ad cadavera fecondanda et liberos parendos, omnia ad hoc propositum pertinere videbantur?

unit.source: Sheesh, does she intend to merge the Underworld with her own Paramita?
unit.target: Heu, num illa vult Orcum cum sua Paramita commiscere?

unit.source: That’s quite ambitious, isn’t it?
unit.target: Id certe audax est, nonne?

unit.source: This is a legacy of a true god, a former divine kingdom!
unit.target: Hoc est legatum veri dei, pristinum regnum divinum!

unit.source: But if Oxyto really succeeds, wouldn’t the Great Mother be able to descend directly?
unit.target: Sed si Oxyto vere succedat, nonne Magna Mater directe descendere poterit?

unit.source: Even if she can’t fully merge the Underworld just yet, just planting a seed is still a very dangerous thing for our world!
unit.target: Etiamsi illa Orcum plene coniungere nondum possit, sola semina serere rem valde periculosam pro nostro mundo efficit!

unit.source: Lumian immediately asked the goat‐faced Demon, “Have you seen a giant baby with bird claws?”
unit.target: Lumian statim rogavit daemon vultu caprino: “Num vidistine infantem ingentem cum unguibus avium?”

unit.source: The decaying goat‐faced Demon looked at Lumian but did not respond.
unit.target: Daemon vultu caprino putrescens Lumian spectavit sed non respondit.

unit.source: It was unclear whether it hadn’t seen such a thing, or if the influence of the Broker pathway was limited to the transaction itself.
unit.target: Non clare patebat utrum tale non perspexisset, an influentia viae Negotiatoris solum ad transactionem ipsam restringeretur.

unit.source: Lumian fell silent for a few seconds before stating, “Deal!”
unit.target: Lumian paucis secundis siluit antequam dixerit: “Pactum!”

unit.source: The goat‐faced Demon’s head moved almost imperceptibly.
unit.target: Caput daemonis vultu caprino paene imperceptibiliter movebat.

unit.source: It turned and began dragging its pale thigh bone, step by step, back to the grayish‐white stone table where the half‐body of the Abscessed Hand lay.
unit.target: Se convertere et paulatim ossa femorale pallida, gradatim, retrorsum ad mensam lapideam cinereo–albam, in qua dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae iacebat, trahebat.

unit.source: Lumian, lowering his voice, shared his recent thoughts with the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction demigod.
unit.target: Lumian, vocem deprimens, cogitationes recentes suas cum Eques Ensium et semideo factionis temperantiae communicavit.

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric quickly responded, “Let’s head to Death’s palace right now.”
unit.target: Eques Ensium Maric celeriter respondit: “Nunc ad palatium Mortis eamus!”

unit.source: Seemingly to reassure Lumian, the Knight of Swords added, “You’re wearing the Eggers family’s mask.
unit.target: Quasi Lumian tranquillandum, Eques Ensium addidit: “Geris larvam auream familiae Eggers.”

unit.source: Many dangers in the Underworld will naturally avoid you.
unit.target: Multa pericula in Orco te naturaliter evitabunt.

unit.source: We only need to worry about anomalies like the boatman.
unit.target: Nobis solum curandum est de anomaliis ut de nauta.

unit.source: And if Oxyto’s monstrous child can get close to Death’s palace, close to that bird’s egg, then we should be able to as well.
unit.target: Et si infans monstruosus Oxyto ad palatium Mortis, iuxta ovum avium, accedat, tunc nos quoque id efficere poterimus.

unit.source: Even with the premature birth and the powers inherited from Oxyto, it’s at most equivalent to a Sequence 4.
unit.target: Etiam cum praecoetu nativitate et viribus ex Oxyto receptis, id tantum est aequipollens Sequentiae IV.

unit.source: Upon hearing the Knight of Swords say so much in one breath, Lumian pondered and said, “Its state of existence and birth ritual are quite unique.
unit.target: Audito a Eques Ensium tantum in uno anhelitu dicere, Lumian meditatus est et inquit: “Status eius existentiae et ritus nativitatis admodum singulares sunt.

unit.source: It might be able to harness some of the Underworld’s power.
unit.target: Forsitan potentiam Orci quandam capere possit.

unit.source: Even if it hasn’t reached the Angelic level due to being premature, we must treat it as a Sequence 3 demigod in the corresponding environment.
unit.target: Etiamsi praecoetu gradum angelicum nondum attigerit, eum in ambitu congruenti ut semideum Sequentiae III considerare debemus.

unit.source: After all, this was a baby born through the integration of Paramita and the spirit realm, facilitated by Lake Dalsh.
unit.target: Postremo, hic erat infans natus per integrationem Paramitae et regni spirituum, quo Lacus Dalsh adiuvabat.

unit.source: And this baby had undergone gestation within a corpse, birth post‐mortem, and then returned to its original form through a process of mutation and integration.
unit.target: Et hic infans gestationem in cadavere subiit, partum post mortem habuit, atque deinde per mutationem et integrationem ad formam originariam rediit.

unit.source: It absolutely couldn’t be considered a living creature, for living beings would instantly die in the Underworld.
unit.target: Certe non poterat censiri creatura viva, nam entia viva in Orco statim interire deberent.

unit.source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords answered succinctly.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Eques Ensium.

unit.source: Under the pale glow of a few bone torches mounted on the broken wall, Lumian asked the two members of the temperance faction within him, “If we continue along the path we were on, into the depths of the darkness, will we reach Death’s palace?”
unit.target: Sub pallido lumine paucarum ossium torcharum in pariete fracto, Lumian duo membrum factionis temperantiae intra se rogavit: “Si iter nostrum in obscuritatem continuaverimus, perveniemusne ad palatium Mortis?”

unit.source: Lumian remembered that the Knight of Swords had mentioned reading many notes from the descendants of Death.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est Eques Ensium multas annotationes ab descendantibus Mortis legisse.

unit.source: Before the Knight of Swords could reply, the goat‐faced Demon standing at the gray stone table suddenly lifted the large pale thigh bone.
unit.target: Priusquam Eques Ensium responderet, daemon vultu caprino ad mensam lapideam cinereo–albam stans subito levavit magnum ossa femorale pallidum.

unit.source: It used the bone to point toward a dark, deep hole that had been smashed open by a dome‐shaped stone block near the broken statue.
unit.target: Is ossa adhibuit ut monstrasset ad cavum obscurum et profundum, quod lapide globoso prope statuam fractam abruptim apertum erat.

unit.source: That seemed to lead to the dark cathedral’s basement.
unit.target: Id videbatur ducere ad hypogaeum obscurae cathedralis.

unit.source: Lumian paused, then blurted out, “You mean, this leads directly to Death’s palace?”
unit.target: Lumian pausavit, deinde subito exclamat: “Intellegesne hoc iter directe ad palatium Mortis ducere?”

unit.source: Based on the Knight of Swords’ explanations and what he had seen earlier, Lumian believed Death’s palace was situated at the bottom of the dark Underworld.
unit.target: Ex explanationibus Eques Ensium et id quod antea viderat, Lumian credidit palatium Mortis in imo obscuri Orci situm esse.

unit.source: One would have to keep heading downward, deep into the ground, to reach it.
unit.target: Oportet incessanter deorsum procedere, in terram profunda, ut ad eum perveniret.

unit.source: But since it was a descent, jumping directly into the seemingly bottomless “basement” might also be feasible.
unit.target: Sed cum descensus esset, directe in hypogaeum, quod quasi inexhaustum videbatur, salire etiam fieri posset.

unit.source: Emperor Roselle once said, “All roads lead to Trier!”
unit.target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: “Omnes viae ad Trier ducunt!”

unit.source: The decaying goat‐faced Demon nodded slowly.
unit.target: Daemon vultu caprino putrescens lente annuit.

unit.source: It was only then that Lumian realized: This fellow understands my Intis language!
unit.target: Tunc tantum Lumian intellexit: hic vir linguam meam Intis intellegit!

unit.source: Why did I even bother getting a translator?
unit.target: Cur quidem translator comparare studui?

unit.source: Is a Demon still a Demon even after death?
unit.target: Num daemon etiam post mortem daemon permaneat?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t waste any time confronting the decaying goat‐faced Demon.
unit.target: Lumian tempus non perdidit daemon vultu caprino putrescens oppugnando.

unit.source: He ran a few steps to the edge of the dark, vast hole.
unit.target: Currit paucos gradus ad limitem cavum obscuri et vasti.

unit.source: He formed a clump of blazing white flame and placed it at the edge of the hole, illuminating some of the interior: massive stone pillars, blackened wood racks, collapsed stone slabs, and a winding staircase extending downward, disappearing into the darkness.
unit.target: Constituit conglobatum flammae albae fulgidissimae et posuit ea ad marginem cavum, quae interiora illustrabat: columnas lapideas ingentes, armaria lignea atrata, laminas lapideas collapsas, et scalas tortuosam deorsum porrigentes, quae in tenebras evanuebant.

unit.source: “No problem,” the Knight of Swords conveyed the judgment on behalf of the temperance faction demigod.
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio,” tradidit Eques Ensium iudicium pro semideo factionis temperantiae.

unit.source: It leads to Death’s palace.
unit.target: Illud ducit ad palatium Mortis.

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian jumped onto the partially collapsed staircase.
unit.target: Sine mora, Lumian in scalas partim collapsas salivit.

unit.source: Instead of running down the stairs in the usual way, he jumped back and forth between stone pillars, wood racks, staircases, and walls in a linear free‐fall.
unit.target: Pro eo quod ex scalibus more solito descenderet, inter columnas lapideas, armaria lignea, scalas, et muros in libero, lineario lapsu saliebat.

unit.source: During this process, Lumian occasionally transformed into a blazing white flame spear to leap over completely collapsed parts without footholds and at other times turned into a shadow creature to navigate around special areas.
unit.target: Per hoc processum, Lumian interdum in hastam flammae albae fulgidae se transformabat, ut partes omnino collapsas sine sustentatione superare posset, et alias in creaturam umbratam convertibat ad spatia specialia circumvaganda.

unit.source: The surrounding darkness seemed to hide something, something even the blazing white light couldn’t illuminate, but Lumian ignored it, pretending not to notice.
unit.target: Tenebrae circumiectae aliquid celare videbantur, aliquid, quod etiam fulgens alba lux lucrare non potuit, sed Lumian id neglexit, simulans se non animadvertere.

unit.source: After descending for an indeterminate amount of time, Lumian’s feet finally touched the ground.
unit.target: Postquam per spatium temporis indefiniti descenderat, pedes Lumiani tandem terram tetigerunt.

unit.source: In the light of the blazing white flame, he saw that the area was littered with broken bones, some white, some yellow‐brown, and some dark brown.
unit.target: Sub luce flammae albae fulgidissimae, vidit regionem ossibus fractis sparsa esse, quaedam alba, quaedam flavo–brunnea, et quaedam fuscobrunea.

unit.source: Not too far from Lumian, a deep black stone wall stood, set with a heavy wooden door large enough for a giant to pass through.
unit.target: Non longe a Lumiano stabat paries lapideus nigerrimus, ornatus ostio ligneo ingenti, sufficiente ut gigantem transire permitteret.

unit.source: Lumian walked up to the door, bent over, and extended his palms, beginning to push outward with all his strength.
unit.target: Lumian ad ostium accessit, inclinatus, et palmas extendens coepit omni vi propellere.

unit.source: His instincts told him that beyond this door lay Death’s palace.
unit.target: Instinctus eius indicaverunt ei quod ultra hoc ostium palatium Mortis iaceret.

unit.source: 771 Pale-White Nation
unit.target: 771 Natio Pallide-Alba

unit.source: 771 Pale-White Nation
unit.target: 771 Natio Pallide-Alba

unit.source: Amidst the heavy tearing sound of a long-unmoved wooden board, the chestnut-brown door slowly opened outward.
unit.target: Inter gravem stridorem lacerantis tabulae lignae diu immobilis, porta castanea lente foras se aperiebat.

unit.source: The first thing Lumian noticed was the dim light, unlike the darkness typical of the deeper parts of the Underworld, emanating not from golden humanoid streetlamps but from all objects ahead.
unit.target: Primum quod Lumian animadvertit fuit lumen obfuscum, non simile tenebris partium profundarum Inferi, quod non ex lampadibus aureis humanoidibus sed ex omnibus rebus ante se emanabat.

unit.source: He then got a clear view of the exterior.
unit.target: Deinde perspicuum aspectum exterioris habuit.

unit.source: There lay a cluster of palaces half-sunken into the void, with a majestic main hall, several high towers, and aerial corridors connecting them.
unit.target: Ibi iacebat congeries palatiorum paene submersorum in vacuum, cum aula principali magno, pluribus turribus altis et porticulis aereis eas coniungentibus.

unit.source: Deeper into the palace complex, the structures seemed to sink further into the void, while those on the periphery stood solidly on a barren wilderness.
unit.target: In intimo complexu palatii, structurae ulterius in vacuum mergi videbantur, dum illae in extremitate firmiter super desertum stabant.

unit.source: Even so, the main hall in the core area towered much higher than the rest of the buildings.
unit.target: Attamen, aula principalis in regione cordis multo altior erat quam cetera aedificia.

unit.source: Now, most of the structures were completely collapsed, leaving only ruins and broken walls.
unit.target: Nunc, pleraque structurae omnino corruperant, relinquentes solum ruinas et muros fractos.

unit.source: The relatively intact palaces and towers were concentrated on the periphery, with the only visibly towering structure in the core area being the main hall and its four attached spires.
unit.target: Palatia et turris relative integrae in extremitate congregatae erant, cum sola structura visibiliter eminens in regione cordis esset aula princeps et quattuor apices eius adnexae.

unit.source: At this moment, whether it was the broken palace complex or the surrounding wilderness and the sky above, all had faded to a dim, pale white, enveloping and infusing the entire world with pallor.
unit.target: Hoc ipso tempore, sive complexus palatii ruptus sive desertum circumjacens et caelum superius, omnia in lumen pallidum et obfuscum evanuerant, totum orbem pallore infundentes.

unit.source: They brought light.
unit.target: Illi lucem afferebant.

unit.source: This pale-white world still retained a few other colors—gold embedded on the surfaces of buildings and the black at the bottom of the palace complex representing the void.
unit.target: Hic mundus pallide-albus adhuc paucas alias colores retinebat—aurum in superficiis aedificiorum insitum atque nigrum in imo complexus palatii, quod vacuum repraesentabat.

unit.source: The latter had two other sources: one was the silently falling illusory dark River Styx from above, cascading behind the main hall, and the other was a creature long enough to be described in hundreds of meters, nestled among the four spires atop the grand main hall.
unit.target: Huius ultimi duo alia fons erant: alterum, Styx obscurum et illusorium, silentio cadens ex alto, post aulae principis labente; et alterum, creatura tam longa, ut in centenis metris describi posset, inter quattuor apices super magnam aulam principem collocata.

unit.source: It was an exaggeratedly large bird, its wings woven from pale-white flames and mystical patterns, quietly sprawling on the roof of the main hall.
unit.target: Erat avis nimis ingens, cujus alae ex flammis pallide-albis et figuris mysticis contextae erant, tranquille in tecto aulae princeps expansae.

unit.source: Many of its pale-white fiery feathers had shed, revealing the black, decaying skin underneath.
unit.target: Multae pennatae eius flammarum pallide-albarum deciduerant, ostendentes nigrum, putrescens cutem subiacens.

unit.source: Despite the considerable distance, and even with just a few fleeting glances, Lumian couldn’t help but feel his “death” accelerating.
unit.target: Quamquam distantia magna erat, et etiam paucis momentaneis intuitibus, Lumian sentiendi non potuit non accelerare suam "mors".

unit.source: He lowered his head to look at his hands and found his already pale, dull, and withered undead skin now marked with spreading patches of blue-black decay.
unit.target: Caput inclinavit ad manus suas intueendas et invenit cutem suam iam pallidam, opacam et marceam mortuam, nunc signata maculis expansis putris caeruleo-nigris.

unit.source: These marks moved slowly, deepening continuously.
unit.target: Haec signa lente moverentur, continuo in profunditatem augentes.

unit.source: Moreover, his clothes were also beginning to be “infected” by the pallor of this world, all colors turning dim.
unit.target: Praeterea, vestimenta eius quoque incipiebant a pallore huius mundi "infecta" esse, omnes colores obscurari.

unit.source: "What kind of monster is that?" Lumian dared not gaze at the distant giant bird anymore and could only look directly at the palace complex itself.
unit.target: "Quale monstrum est hoc?" Lumian non ausus est ulterius speciem distanti avi ingentis contemplari, sed solum directe complexum palatii intuiri potuit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, the increasingly ethereal voice of the Knight of Swords, Maric, rang out: "It might be the corpse of Gregrace."
unit.target: Post aliquot secundos, vox magis ac magis aetheria Militis Gladii, Maric, resonavit: "Forsitan corpus Gregrace est."

unit.source: Gregrace? The Phoenix Ancestor, the ancient Death among the eight ancient gods of the Second Epoch? Lumian blurted out in astonishment, "Why would Her body be here?"
unit.target: Gregrace? Progenitrix Phoenixi, Antiqua Mors inter octo deos antiquos Secundi Aetatis? Lumian stupore exclamavit: "Cur corpus eius hic esse possit?"

unit.source: After posing the question, Lumian felt it was somewhat meaningless.
unit.target: Postquam quaestionem posuit, Lumian sensit eam paulo vacuam esse.

unit.source: This was the Underworld, and it was not strange for any deceased’s body to appear here.
unit.target: Hoc erat Inferum, et non mirum erat quod cuiuslibet defuncti corpus hic appareret.

unit.source: The Phoenix Ancestor—ancient Death—had perished before the Underworld anomaly.
unit.target: Progenitrix Phoenixi—Antiqua Mors—ante anomaliam Inferi peregerat.

unit.source: On the other hand, the absence of the Eggers family’s Death’s corpse, hidden somewhere, was an anomaly.
unit.target: Contra, absentia corporis Mortis familiae Eggers, alicubi occulti, erat anomalia.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t expect the Knight of Swords to actually answer his question.
unit.target: Lumian non exspectabat Militem Gladii reapse responsurum ad quaestionem suam.

unit.source: "It might be that the ancestor of the Eggers family, the former Death, placed it here."
unit.target: "Forsitan progenitor familiae Eggers, quondam Mors, id hic posuerit."

unit.source: Uh… Does that mean the Eggers family’s Death not only acquired the Beyonder characteristics of the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace but also brought Her body back to the Underworld, hiding it somewhere in the palace complex?
unit.target: Eh... An hoc significat Mortem familiae Eggers non solum proprietates Beyonder Progenitricis Phoenixi Gregrace adeptum esse, sed etiam corpus eius ad Inferum reducere, alicubi in complexu palatii occultum?

unit.source: How did She, no—it end up on top of the palace? Is it just a corpse? Was it placed there initially? Or did the anomaly in the Underworld come from this ancient god’s corpse? With the reigning Death dead, has the ancient god’s corpse reanimated?
unit.target: Quomodo illa, immo, in summo palatii delapsa est? Estne hoc solum corpus? An initio ibi positum fuit? An anomalia in Infero ex hoc corpore dei antiquorum orta est? Cum regnantis Mors mortua sit, an corpus dei antiquorum reanimatum sit?

unit.source: Lumian suddenly had some thoughts.
unit.target: Lumian subito quaedam cogitationes habuit.

unit.source: At that moment, he heard the Knight of Swords add, "Sharron just saw the egg."
unit.target: Illo momento, audivit Militem Gladii addere: "Sharron modo ovum vidit."

unit.source: The egg? The one the goat-faced Demon wants? Is Sharron referring to the temperance faction demigod within me?
