unit.target: Ovum? Illud quod daemon caprino vult? Num Sharron refert ad semideum deorum factionis temperantiae in me?

unit.source: Lumian’s heart leaped with joy before he quickly asked, "Where is the egg?"
unit.target: Cor Lumiani exsultavit laetitia, et celeriter rogavit: "Ubi est ovum?"

unit.source: "Below the belly of what seems to be the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor. It has a pitch-black shell and is engulfed in pale-white flames, about a meter in diameter," the Knight of Swords briefly described the egg.
unit.target: "Sub ventre id quod videtur corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi. Illud habet testam ateram et involutum est flammis pallide-albis, circiter unius metrorum in diametro," Milites Gladii breviter ovum describebat.

unit.source: Protected by the corpse of the ancient Death? Lumian’s scalp tingled at the thought.
unit.target: A corpore Mortis antiqui protegto? Lumiani caput formidine pulsatum est.

unit.source: How am I supposed to retrieve it?
unit.target: Quomodo id recipere debeam?

unit.source: This might as well be no different from slaying the Devil Monarch, Farbauti!
unit.target: Hoc fortasse nihil differt a interficere Monarcham Diaboli, Farbauti!

unit.source: Of course, for those of high stature, a living ancient god and a Beyonder-characteristic–lacking one reduced to a decaying corpse were not on the same level; the difficulty of these tasks was as different as heaven and the abyss.
unit.target: Scilicet, pro illis eminenti statura, deus antiquus vivens et ille, quae proprietatibus Beyonder carens, ad corpus putrescens redactus, non erant eodem gradu; difficultas harum negotiorum tam diversa erat quam caelum et abyssus.

unit.source: But for Lumian, they were equally insuperable, both falling under the category of “impossible even with self-sacrifice.”
unit.target: Sed Lumiano, ea aeque insuperabilia videbantur, utrumque sub categoria "impossibilis etiam cum seipso sacrificio" incurrendum.

unit.source: Son of a sow, that goat-faced fellow really is a Demon turned undead!
unit.target: Filius scrofae, ille caprino facie vir vere est Daemon conversus in mortuum!

unit.source: Fine, if it can’t be completed, then so be it.
unit.target: Bene, si confici non potest, fiat ita.

unit.source: Just finish off the contractor as if there was no task at all!
unit.target: Solum perime conductorem, quasi nullus labor exstiterit!

unit.source: As malicious thoughts spread throughout his body, the Knight of Swords added, "It’s not entirely impossible to retrieve the egg.
unit.target: Dum malae cogitationes per corpus eius diffunderent, Miles Gladii addidit: "Non prorsus impossibile est ovum recipere.

unit.source: The state of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse is somewhat strange."
unit.target: Status corporis Progenitricis Phoenixi aliquantum mirus est."

unit.source: Strange state of the corpse? Aren’t there only two states for a corpse, eternal rest and reanimation?
unit.target: Status mirabilis corporis? Nonne solae duae sunt status corporis: requies aeterna et reanimatio?

unit.source: Lumian dared not use his own eyes to inspect the decaying corpse of the ancient Death, Gregrace, and could only inquire of Sharron, the only one present who could withstand looking at the body of an ancient god to some extent, "What’s strange about it?"
unit.target: Lumian non ausus est oculos suos ad inspiciendum putrescens corpus Mortis antiqui, Gregrace, sed tantum ab Sharron, quae sola ad modum diuturno spectare corpus dei antiquorum ferre poterat, interrogare: "Quid in eo mirum est?"

unit.source: The one responding was still the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Qui respondit adhuc erat Miles Gladii.

unit.source: "It’s asleep, the kind of deep sleep that’s hard to awaken from.
unit.target: "Dormit, somno profundo, ex quo difficile excitari potest.

unit.source: This doesn’t align with the current state of this Pale-White Nation."
unit.target: Hoc non convenit cum statu hodierno huius Nationis Pallide-Albae."

unit.source: Asleep? Dead and transformed, yet still needing sleep? Lumian frowned slightly and asked, "Why does that not align with the current state here?"
unit.target: Dormit? Mortuus et transfiguratus, sed adhuc somnum quaeret? Lumian leviter fronit et rogavit: "Cur hoc non convenit cum statu hodierno hic?"

unit.source: The Knight of Swords paused a few seconds before explaining, "From what we’ve seen, one of the reasons for the original anomaly in the Underworld was the reanimation of the Phoenix Ancestor.
unit.target: Miles Gladii paucos secundos cessavit antequam explicaret: "Ex his quae vidimus, una ex causis originalis anomaliae in Infero fuit reanimatio Progenitricis Phoenixi.

unit.source: It destroyed Death’s palace, killed all of Death’s Blessed present, and turned this place into a pale-white nation.
unit.target: Delevit palatium Mortis, occidens omnes Sanctos Mortis praesentis, et hunc locum in nationem pallide-albam vertit.

unit.source: We’ve encountered a few demigods from the Death domain.
unit.target: Occurrimus paucis semideis ex domino Mortis.

unit.source: Since the Underworld anomaly, they could still manage some affairs in the Underworld, even enter directly, but none dared to venture deep into the Underworld to search for the treasures within Death’s palace.
unit.target: Ex quo anomalia in Infero ortum est, adhuc negotia aliqua in Infero administrare poterant, etiam directe ingredi, sed nemo ausus est alte in Inferum penetrare ad thesauros intra palatium Mortis quaerendos.

unit.source: Their instincts told them it was too dangerous, absolutely not to be approached.
unit.target: Instinctus eorum indicabant illud nimis periculosum esse, omnino non adpropinandum.

unit.source: But Sharron didn’t have such a premonition for danger, so she agreed to come here.
unit.target: At Sharron talem praescientiam periculi non habebat, itaque ad hunc locum venire consensit.

unit.source: That means, for a long time after the Underworld anomaly, the body of the Phoenix Ancestor still roamed this pale-white nation, keeping the high-ranked beings of the Death domain at bay, but now, it lies asleep…
unit.target: Id significat, per longum tempus post anomaliam Inferi, corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi adhuc hanc nationem pallide-albam peragratum esse, altos entitates domini Mortis arcens, sed nunc, dormit…

unit.source: Lumian found the oddity from Maric’s description.
unit.target: Lumian ex descriptione Maric mirabilem rem invenit.

unit.source: "When was the last time a high-ranking Beyonder of the Death pathway felt danger approaching deep into the Underworld?" Lumian tried to determine the approximate timeframe.
unit.target: "Quando novissimum fuit tempus quo supremus Beyonder viae Mortis periculum altum in Inferum appropinquare sensit?" Lumian conatus est tempus approximatum determinare.

unit.source: "I don’t know," the Knight of Swords answered promptly.
unit.target: "Nescio," respondit Miles Gladii celeriter.

unit.source: Don’t know… It seems then, that the Phoenix Ancestor’s body has only fallen asleep in recent years.
unit.target: Nescio… Videtur ergo corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi nuper tantum in somno lapsum esse.

unit.source: Otherwise, the high-ranked Beyonders of the Death pathway entering the Underworld would have discovered that it’s not so dangerous here anymore, and might have attempted exploration, not leaving without a trace nor without any news spreading…
unit.target: Aliter, altiores Beyonder viae Mortis, qui in Inferum intrabant, repperissent hunc locum iam non tam periculosum esse, fortasse explorationem conati essent, sine vestigio aut nuntio disseminato redeuntes…

unit.source: What happened in recent years? Lumian thought, unable to suppress his complaint.
unit.target: Quid accidit annis recentioribus? Lumian cogitavit, querelam reprimere deficiens.

unit.source: "Why did the Eggers family’s Death bring back the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse, leaving such a huge risk? As a true god, He could have directly destroyed this corpse!"
unit.target: "Cur Mors familiae Eggers revocavit corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi, tantum periculum relinquens? Ut verus deus, poterat hunc corpus directe delere!"

unit.source: The Knight of Swords responded to Lumian’s complaint, "The Underworld was established by the ancient Death in the spirit world, and as an ancient god, She wasn’t limited to the powers of the Death pathway when She created the Underworld.
unit.target: Miles Gladii respondit querelae Lumiani: "Inferum constitutum est a Mortis antiquo in mundo spirituum, et ut deus antiquus, illa non erat limitata potestatibus viae Mortis cum inferum creavit.

unit.source: It might not have been easy for the Eggers family’s Death to initially take control of the Underworld; He might have needed to use the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor.
unit.target: Forsitan non facile fuit Morti familiae Eggers initio subigere imperium Inferi; fortasse opus erat ei ut corpus Progenitricis Phoenixi uteretur.

unit.source: By the time He truly took control, His state might have changed, no longer concerned with such trivial matters.
unit.target: Tempore quo vere imperium adeptus est, status eius fortasse mutatus erat, et de rebus talibus levibus amplius non curabat.

unit.source: Does this mean the Eggers family’s Death went mad later?
unit.target: Num hoc significat Mortem familiae Eggers postea insanivit?

unit.source: The Underworld wasn’t naturally formed, it was created by the ancient Death, Gregrace…
unit.target: Inferum non naturaliter ornatum erat, sed a Mortis antiquo, Gregrace, creatum est…

unit.source: Such a powerful ancient god, no wonder She could have undergone reanimation…
unit.target: Talis potens deus antiquus, non mirum illam reanimationem peragere potuisse…

unit.source: Lumian reflected inwardly.
unit.target: Lumian introspexit.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords, sensing his sigh, simply said, "It’s said that even among those mad ancient gods, the Phoenix Ancestor, Gregrace, was particularly fond of stirring things up, much like the Blood Emperor Alista Tudor of the Fourth Epoch."
unit.target: Miles Gladii, eius suspirum sentiens, simplex dixit: "Dicitur etiam inter illos deos antiquos insanientes, Progenitrix Phoenixi, Gregrace, valde diligere res excitare, sicut Sanguinis Imperator Alista Tudor Quartae Aetatis."

unit.source: Now that you put it that way, I can understand perfectly…
unit.target: Nunc, quomodo hoc exposuisti, plane intellegere possum…

unit.source: Lumian’s gaze continuously shifted among the pale sky, the wilderness, and the collapsed palace complex, pondering whether to seize the opportunity of the ancient god’s corpse being asleep to steal the enormous black egg burning with pale-white flames.
unit.target: Aspectus Lumiani continue inter caelum pallidum, desertum et complexum palatii ruentem versabatur, meditans num occasio capienda esset ad corpus dei antiquorum dormientis, ut enormem ovum nigrum flammis pallide-albis ardentem furari possit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he spotted a figure still capable of movement.
unit.target: Subito, animadvertit figuram adhuc motu valentem.

unit.source: It was a creature with a human head but the body of a giant bird.
unit.target: Erat creatura capite humano sed corpore avis ingentis.

unit.source: The creature’s limbs were bent, with nails that flickered with a cold light; its back sported wings covered in half pale-white, half chestnut-brown feathers.
unit.target: Membra creaturae flectebantur, unguibus micantibus lumine frigido; dorso alas gerebat, quarum pennas dimidio pallide-albas et dimidio castaneo fusces erant.

unit.source: The development of its head seemed incomplete, resembling several infant heads slowly merging together.
unit.target: Eius progressus capitis imperfectus videbatur, similis plurium capitum infantium paulatim se miscentes.

unit.source: "Oxyto’s premature child? It’s indeed here!" Lumian recognized the creature’s identity.
unit.target: "Puer prae‑maturus Oxyto? Revera hic est!" Lumian identitatem creaturae agnovit.

unit.source: That was the target he and the members of the temperance faction had been tracking!
unit.target: Id erat propositum quod ille et membra factionis temperantiae persequebantur!

unit.source: At that moment, Oxyto’s monstrous child was flapping its wings, continuously circling and stealthily drawing closer to the sleeping ancient god’s corpse.
unit.target: Illo momento, puer monstrosus Oxyto alis vibrabat, continue circumvolans atque furtim appropinquans ad corpus dei antiquorum dormientis.

unit.source: Its target appeared to be the enormous black egg pressed beneath the corpse!
unit.target: Propositum eius videbatur esse enormem ovum nigrum sub corpore pressum!

unit.source: "We must stop it! Sharron will handle cursing and controlling it, and we’ll take care of the attack!"
unit.target: "Debemus id sistere! Sharron maledicta et imperio tractabit, et nos impetum subeamus!"

unit.source: The voice of the Knight of Swords echoed in Lumian’s mind.
unit.target: Vox Militis Gladii in mente Lumiani resonabat.

unit.source: "Okay."
unit.target: "Recte."

unit.source: This time, Lumian didn’t hesitate and sprinted out from the base of the pitch‑black cathedral.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian non dubitavit et e basi cathedrali atri festinanter ejectus est.

unit.source: As soon as he stepped into that pale‑white nation, his entire being was dyed pale‑white, devoid of any additional colors.
unit.target: Statim, cum in illam nationem pallide‑albam ingressus est, totum ens eius pallide‑album factum est, reliquis coloribus carens.

unit.source: This caused him to shiver both body and soul, wanting nothing more than to kneel down on the ground, lying prostrate and motionless.
unit.target: Hoc eum concutiebat corpore et anima, nihil aliud volens nisi in terra genu flectere, prostratus ac immobilis iacere.

unit.source: Silently, Lumian drew the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Tacite, Lumian Ensis Fortitudinis extraxit.

unit.source: The blade, now color‑eroded by the pale‑whiteness, suddenly ignited with a bright white flame tinged with blue.
unit.target: Lamina, iam palliditate deleuta, subito accensa est cum flamma albo nitida, caeruleo tincta.

unit.source: 772 Curse
unit.target: 772 Maledictio

unit.source: 772 Curse
unit.target: 772 Maledictio

unit.source: Filled with the courage to battle against the heavens and to strike at true gods, Lumian stood straight and tall, unflinchingly facing the ruined palaces within the Pale-White Nation.
unit.target: Virtute ad certandum contra caelos et deos veros percutiendos imbutus, Lumian rectus et altus stetit, impavidus ruinas palatiorum intra Nationem Pallide-Albam spectans.

unit.source: Just then, his eyelids dropped uncontrollably, shielding his eyes.
unit.target: Tandem, palpebrae eius sine moderamine ceciderunt, oculos eius tegentes.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, the voice of the Knight of Swords resonated once more in his ear: “Our target is Oxyto’s child, not the ancient god’s corpse.”
unit.target: Fere simul, vox Eques Gladii iterum in aurem eius resonavit: “Meta nostra est proles Oxyto, non corpus dei antiqui.”

unit.source: This was to prevent Lumian from looking directly across the pale‐white wilderness at the corpse of the ancient death god.
unit.target: Hoc adhibitum est ut Lumian non directe per desertum pallide album corpus dei mortis antiqui intueretur.

unit.source: “There’s nothing to fear!” Lumian quickly responded.
unit.target: “Nihil metuendum est!” Lumian celeriter respondit.

unit.source: His voice, once it left his mouth, was also “infected” by the pallor governing this world, becoming weak, hollow, and devoid of emotion.
unit.target: Vox eius, semel e ore prolata, a pallore huius mundi imperante infecta est, infirmis, inanis, et affectibus carentibus.

unit.source: The Knight of Swords earnestly advised, “But this will affect our battle with Oxyto’s child; we must resolve it quickly. Once that’s done, you can do whatever you want.”
unit.target: Eques Gladii sincere monuit: “Sed hoc nostram pugnam cum prole Oxyto afficiet; celeriter id solvere oportet. Postea, quidquid vis facere poteris.”

unit.source: Lumian fell momentarily quiet before responding, “Okay.”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper tacuit antequam respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: Honestly, wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask and in his undead state, Lumian felt a bloodline‐based fear and an awe towards the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse atop Death’s palace, which the courage did not dispel and even somewhat weakened, creating a balance.
unit.target: Vere, larvam auream familiae Eggers gerens et in statu inter vivos et mortuos versans, Lumian timorem ex stirpe et reverentiam erga corpus progenitoris Phoenicis, super palatium Mortis, sensit, quod virtus non expulit sed etiam paulo attenuat, aequilibrium creando.

unit.source: Otherwise, Lumian, wielding the Sword of Courage, would not have been so agreeable!
unit.target: Alioquin, Lumian, Gladium Virtutis gerens, non tam obsequiosus fuisset!

unit.source: Immediately, Lumian ignited into a bright white flame, transforming into a long spear of light, hurling towards the still‐intact buildings at the edge of the palace complex.
unit.target: Statim, Lumian in splendida flamma alba accensus est, in longam hastam lucis mutatus, ad aedificia adhuc integra in margine complexus palatii iactatus est.

unit.source: As the fiery spear cut through the sky, it too was eroded by the pallor, dissipating and dimming even faster, which meant Lumian only managed half the intended distance.
unit.target: Dum hasta ignita per caelum secabat, ea quoque a pallore erodebatur, celerius dissipata et obscurata, quod significabat Lumian solam dimidiam partem itineris destinati assecutum esse.

unit.source: Finally, as the pale‐white light extinguished, Lumian appeared mid‐air, plummeting straight towards the ground.
unit.target: Denique, cum lux pallide alba exstinxit, Lumian in medio aëris apparuit, directe ad terram labens.

unit.source: He landed softly on the wilderness, making only a slight sound, and all around was deadly silence.
unit.target: Suavi modo in deserto terram contigit, leviter sonum edens, et undique silentium mortiferum regnabat.

unit.source: The bright, blazing spear of flame took to the air once again.
unit.target: Hasta flammae candida et fulgida iterum in aethera advolavit.

unit.source: After repeating this five times, Lumian finally reached a high tower adorned with numerous golden patterns and stood at its top, with the figure of Oxyto’s monstrous child becoming clearer in his sight.
unit.target: Quinque vice id repetens, Lumian denique turrim altam, multis figuris aureis ornatam, attingit et in summo stetit, cum imago proles monstruosae Oxyto in conspectu eius clare appareret.

unit.source: Although the other did not display the potentially incomplete Mythical Creature form, merely seeing the bent human limbs, a head formed from several merged infant heads, and wings stretching from the torso with half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown feathers, Lumian felt dizzy, accompanied by spasmodic pain.
unit.target: Quamquam ille formam creaturae mythicae, fortasse imperfectam, non ostendebat, cum solum videret membra humana flecta, caput ex pluribus capitibus infantum coniunctum, et alas a torace protractas, quarum plumae dimidio pallide albae et dimidio castaneo‐brunnea erant, Lumian vertiginem sensit, comitatus dolore spasmodico.

unit.source: Additionally, something inside him seemed to be calling, slowly gathering towards his abdomen.
unit.target: Praeterea, aliquid intus in eo videbatur vocare, lente in directionem abdominis eius congregans.

unit.source: It was the bloodline of Omebella!
unit.target: Erat stirps Omebellae!

unit.source: Lumian felt no fear from this.
unit.target: Lumian ex hoc nullum timorem sensit.

unit.source: Wasn’t this inevitable?
unit.target: Nonne hoc ineluctabile erat?

unit.source: In the next instant, two figures materialized before him.
unit.target: In proximo momento duo figurae ante eum apparuerunt.

unit.source: One figure wore a black Gothic‐style court dress, complete with a matching petite bonnet and her light golden hair neatly bundled up; the other, slightly disheveled, donned a traditional black vest over a white shirt.
unit.target: Una figura induta erat vestimento curiae Gothicum nigrum, cum parva bonnet congruente et capillis aureis levibus diligenter compositis; altera, paulo incondita, loricam nigrum traditam super camisiam albam induit.

unit.source: Temperance faction demigod Sharron and a member of the temperance faction, the holder of the Knight of Swords Minor Arcana tarot card, Maric!
unit.target: Semideus factionis temperantiae, Sharron, et membrum eadem factionis, tenens chartam tarot “Eques Gladii Arcana Minor”, Maric!

unit.source: As they approached their primary target, they finally detached from Lumian’s body, ready to battle.
unit.target: Dum ad metam principalem accedebant, tandem ex corpore Lumiani se separaverunt, ad pugnam paratos.

unit.source: Indeed, both Sharron and Maric bore colors derived from the impressions left by Lumian, not truly manifested, appearing pale‐white and dim.
unit.target: Revera, et Sharron et Maric colores gerebant ex vestigiis a Lumiano relictis, qui vere non manifesta erant, apparentes pallide albos et exiguo lumine.

unit.source: Moreover, their bodies were transparent and ghostly, in a state of Wraiths.
unit.target: Praeterea, corpora eorum erant translucida et quasi phantasmatica, in statu umbrarum.

unit.source: If not so, they would have instantly died, becoming real undead creatures devoid of consciousness.
unit.target: Nisi ita fuisset, statim interfecti essent, facti essent creaturae mortuorum verae, conscientia carentes.

unit.source: The monstrous child of Oxyto, hovering close to the belly of the ancient death god’s corpse, sensed the proximity of Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Proles monstruosa Oxyto, prope ventrem corporis dei mortis antiqui volitans, propinquitatem Lumiani et ceterorum sensit.

unit.source: From a distance of two or three kilometers, it half‐turned its body and looked over with its twelve clustered eyes.
unit.target: Ex distantia duorum vel trium chiliometrorum, corpus eius semi‐vertit et per duodecim oculos congregatos intuebatur.

unit.source: Lumian immediately felt the protective essence of his mind and consciousness, shielded by the Eggers family’s golden mask, along with the life force deep within, showing signs of disintegration.
unit.target: Lumian statim sensit essentiam protectivam mentis et conscientiae suae, ab aurea larva familiae Eggers tegente, una cum vi vitae intima quae signa disintegrationis exhibebat.

unit.source: In his eyes, the temperance faction demigod named Sharron, using the reflective mirror effect of the pure gold surface, flickered twice between the crumbling palace and the high tower, coming within three to four hundred meters of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse.
unit.target: In oculis eius, semideus factionis temperantiae nomine Sharron, utens speculi reflexo effectu ex superficie puro auri, bis inter palatium ruentem et turrim altam micavit, ad corpus progenitoris Phoenicis intra trecentos ad quadringentos metra accessit.

unit.source: She opened her mouth towards Oxyto’s child and emitted a piercing scream.
unit.target: Os suum ad prolem Oxyto direxit et clamorem acutum edidit.

unit.source: This was Lumian’s first time hearing Sharron’s voice.
unit.target: Hoc fuit primum tempus quo Lumian vocem Sharronis audivit.

unit.source: Eroded by the pallor during its journey of over two thousand meters, the sound reached Lumian’s ears as a faint echo, almost like an illusion.
unit.target: Pallore in itinere plus quam duorum milia metrorum eroditus, sonus ad aures Lumiani pervenit ut tenuus echo, fere quasi illusio.

unit.source: Oxyto’s child didn’t see it that way.
unit.target: Proles Oxyto id non ita videbat.

unit.source: The feathers on its wings—half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown—rapidly fell off.
unit.target: Plumæ in alis eius—dimidio pallide albae, dimidio castaneo‐brunnea—celeriter delapsae sunt.

unit.source: One by one, the eyes on its face burst open, the flesh on its uncovered body festering down to the bone, as if struck by a potent curse!
unit.target: Uno post alium, oculi in facie eius erupti sunt, et caro in corpore nudato putrida usque ad ossa, quasi potenti maledictō icta esset!

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian, fearless, transformed once again into the fiery spear of flame and hurled himself at the creature.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian, impavidus, iterum in hastam flammae ardentis se transformavit et in creaturam iactavit.

unit.source: Meanwhile, the Knight of Swords flickered forward on various reflective surfaces.
unit.target: Interim, Eques Gladii per varias superficies reflectas micavit.

unit.source: Oxyto’s child let out a mournful howl.
unit.target: Proles Oxyto ululatum maeroris edidit.

unit.source: Though distant and further muted by the dense pallor within Death’s palace, the sound was soft when it reached Lumian, yet it still made him dizzy for a moment, a bloody stench of decay filling his nostrils, involuntarily causing him to revert from his fiery spear form.
unit.target: Quamquam procul et a denso pallore in palatio Mortis attenuatus, sonus ad Lumian perveniens lenis erat, sed tamen eum paulisper vertiginem afflixit, fetore cruenti putredinis naribus eius impleto, quod inviti eum ex forma hastae flammae recedere coegit.

unit.source: With this howl, Oxyto’s monstrous child morphed into a writhing, twisted, huge pale‐white bud.
unit.target: Hoc ululatu, proles monstruosa Oxyto in germen immane, tortuosum, pallide album se transformavit.

unit.source: The exploded eyeballs, festering flesh, and fallen feathers were all absorbed into the bud.
unit.target: Oculi, quae eruptae sunt, caro putrescens, et plumæ lapsae omnes in gemen absorpti sunt.

unit.source: In a blink, the bud blossomed, sopping wet, and produced two children.
unit.target: In momento, germen floruit, madidum, et duo proles peperit.

unit.source: One was intertwined in pitch‐black and dark red, its sores festering rapidly until it stilled, turned pale, and fell to the ground; the other was an unscathed, massive bird‐clawed monstrosity.
unit.target: Unus intricatus erat in atris nigro et rubro obscuro, cuius ulcera celeriter putrescere coeperunt, donec quietus factus, pallide redditus, et in terram cecidit; alter erat intactus, ingens monstrum cum unguibus avium.

unit.source: Through this transformation, Oxyto’s monstrous child shed the curse and was reborn.
unit.target: Per hanc transformationem, proles monstruosa Oxyto maledictionem abiecit et renata est.

unit.source: But Sharron seized the moment, her figure reflected within its clustered twelve eyes.
unit.target: Sed Sharron momentum arripuit, cum figura eius in oculis duodecim conglobatis repraesentata esset.

unit.source: Oxyto’s monstrous child froze mid‐air, just a few dozen meters from the Death’s main hall where the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse lay.
unit.target: Proles monstruosa Oxyto in aere immota stetit, paulo decem metris ab aula principali Mortis, ubi corpus progenitoris Phoenicis iacebat.

unit.source: In its twelve gleaming beautiful eyes, the figure of Sharron, wearing her petite bonnet, flickered in and out of view, soon illuminated by intense, bright white light.
unit.target: In duodecim oculis nitidis eius, figura Sharronis, parva bonnet gerens, inter praesentiam et evanitionem micavit, mox luce intensa, candida et alba illustrata.

unit.source: A flamboyant spear of flame shot forth, striking an ancient, partially collapsed tower nearby.
unit.target: Hasta flammae fulgida exsurgit, proximam turrim antiquam, partim collabentem, percutiens.

unit.source: As the light dispersed, Lumian, single‐handedly wielding the Sword of Courage, appeared.
unit.target: Dum lux dispersa est, Lumian, solus gladium Virtutis gerens, apparuit.

unit.source: He did not hesitate or feel fear.
unit.target: Non cunctatus est neque timorem sensit.

unit.source: Despite the dizziness and pain in his head, his eyes turned an iron‐black.
unit.target: Non obstante vertigine et dolore in capite, oculi eius in nigro ferreo versaverunt.

unit.source: This iron‐black shade emerged only to be eroded by the pallor, harmonizing completely with this nation.
unit.target: Haec umbra nigro ferrea emersit solum ut pallore eroderetur, perfecte huic nationi congruens.

unit.source: This did not impede Lumian’s observation of his target’s weaknesses, though all he saw was pallor.
unit.target: Hoc non impedit Lumian ut infirmitates scopī eius observeret, nam nihil nisi pallorem vidit.

unit.source: Compelled, Lumian relied on his Hunter kin senses to detect weaknesses, picking the most appealing and battle‐raging spot among those pale hues.
unit.target: Coactus, Lumian sensibus cognationis venatorum innitens ad infirmitates detegendas, eligebat locum maxime amoenum et certaminis fervorem exhibentem inter illa pallida signa.

unit.source: Once again, he became the increasingly pale and dimming fiery spear of flame, positioning himself above Oxyto’s monstrous child.
unit.target: Iterum, factus est hasta flammae ardens, crescente palliditate et obscuritate, se posito super prolem monstruosam Oxyto.

unit.source: His figure outlined; he grasped the Sword of Courage, blazing with bright white and blue flames, and plummeted like a boulder towards the body of Oxyto’s monstrous child.
unit.target: Figura eius delineata; gladium Virtutis arripuit, fulgens cum flammis candidae et caeruleae, atque ut lapis ingens versus corpus proles monstruosae Oxyto labens ruavit.

unit.source: As they drew close, Lumian struck at the monstrous bird‐clawed infant’s abdomen with his broadsword, now tainted with pallor.
unit.target: Dum propius accederent, Lumian ad abdominum infantis monstrosi, cui unguibus avium attributus erat, gladio lato, iam pallore contaminato, percussit.

unit.source: He was using his Cull.
unit.target: Hunc modum, “Cull”, adhibuit.

unit.source: Before this, the Knight of Swords, Maric, appeared atop the half‐collapsed tower, slipping on a ring carved in the shape of the sun god’s bird.
unit.target: Ante hoc, Eques Gladii Maric in summo turrim semidemolitam apparuit, induens annulum, sculptum in forma avis dei solis.

unit.source: In his hands, he quickly formed a lance as clear as pure sunlight.
unit.target: In manibus eius, celeriter hastam paravit, tam perspicuam quam solis purae lumen.

unit.source: This caused the nearby pallor to fade slightly, erasing shadows and causing the Wraith‐like state of the Knight of Swords to melt inch by inch. Droplets of dim liquid fell like wax in a fire.
unit.target: Hoc effecit ut pallor proximus paullo evanuerit, umbras tollens et statum umbralem Eques Gladii passu passu dissoluens. Guttae liquidae obscurae, similes cerae in igne, cadebant.

unit.source: The droplets evaporated quickly, leaving behind a bit of dust that slowly dispersed.
unit.target: Guttae celeriter evanuerunt, relinquentes paulum pulveris quod lente dispersum est.

unit.source: Enduring the melting of his right side, Maric’s expression twisted into one of madness as he hurled the lance of sunlight towards Oxyto’s monstrous child.
unit.target: Dextro latus fusum sustinens, vultus Marici in insanitate contortus est, dum hastam solis in prolem monstruosam Oxyto iactabat.

unit.source: Considering that Oxyto was a Shaman King of the Moon pathway, the temperance faction had prepared a Sun pathway Sealed Artifact in advance, which unexpectedly proved useful at this time!
unit.target: Cum Oxyto esset Shamanus Rex viae Lunae, factionis temperantiae praeparaverat sigillatum artifactum viae Solis, quod in hoc tempore inopinato utile fuit!

unit.source: This Sealed Artifact, both in effect and trait, would bring significant harm to the Wraiths.
unit.target: Hoc Artifactum Sigillatum, et in effectu et in indole, nocentiam notabilem umbris afferet.

unit.source: The clean and bright spear of flame became an anomaly in this pale world.
unit.target: Hasta flammae pura et candida facta est insolita in hoc mundo pallido.

unit.source: It too was being eroded, but it was also dispersing the pallor, appearing to be able to strike the body of the monster child before Lumian’s Sword of Courage could.
unit.target: Ea quoque erodebatur, sed simul pallorem dispergebat, apparens se posse corpus proles monstrosae percutere antequam gladium Virtutis Lumiani feriret.

unit.source: Although the monstrous child of Oxyto was possessed by the demigod Sharron and forcibly controlled, it wasn’t completely turned into a statue to be slaughtered at will.
unit.target: Quamquam proles monstruosa Oxyto a semideo Sharron possessa et vim adhibitam subiecta erat, non plane in statuam versam erat, ut ad caedem ad arbitrium parata esset.

unit.source: It struggled against the influence of the Wraith, as its “reborn” body slowly contracted, seemingly returning to an embryonic state, seeking the comfort of its mother’s embrace, while unleashing its own Paramita.
unit.target: Contra vim umbrarum certabat, dum corpus eius “renatum” lente contractum est, quasi ad statum embryonicum rediens, consolationem amplexus matris quaerens, dum propriam suam Paramitam efferebat.

unit.source: The pale‐white wilderness quickly engulfed the surrounding ruined palaces and the half‐collapsed tower, also drawing the bodies of a few Blessed of Death who had died in this area into its scope.
unit.target: Deserta pallide alba celeriter absorpsit palatia ruinas circumstantia et turrim semidemolitam, trahens etiam corpora paucorum Beatorum Mortis qui hic perierant.

unit.source: In the deathly silence, a horrific giant snake, bearing only bones and some rotting flesh with exaggerated wings, sprung from the collapsed palace into the air, blocking the path of the Knight of Swords’ spear of sunlight.
unit.target: In silentio mortifero, horrendus serpens gigas, qui tantum ossa et carnem putrescens cum alis amplis portabat, ex palatio collapso in aethera exsiluit, iter hastae solis Eques Gladii impediens.

unit.source: The blinding sunlight burst forth, filling Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Sol obcaecans erupit, oculos Lumiani implevit.

unit.source: His strike with the Sword of Courage did not slow down; he firmly slashed downwards.
unit.target: Ictus eius cum Gladio Virtutis non tardavit; firmiter deorsum secavit.

unit.source: The sunlight blackened his pale, dim skin, sparking a burning smoke.
unit.target: Lux solis cutem pallidam et opacam eius nigravit, producens fumum ardentem.

unit.source: A soft “clang” sounded as Lumian’s Sword of Courage struck the head of the winged giant snake, splitting the target, which had become exceptionally fragile after absorbing most of the sunlight damage.
unit.target: Mollis “clang” resonavit cum gladium Virtutis Lumiani caput serpens gigantis alatae percutit, scissum obiectum, quod post absorptionem plerisque damni solis maxime fragili factum erat.

unit.source: In a barely audible silence, the snake’s bones either evaporated or shattered, completely losing their support and falling like rain to the ground.
unit.target: In silentio vix audibili, ossa serpens vel evanescebant vel confracta sunt, omnino subsidium amittens et quasi pluvia in terram cadentes.

unit.source: With the help of the giant bone snake blocking a strike for him, Oxyto’s monstrous child controlled by Sharron contracted even more fiercely.
unit.target: Auxilio ossium serpentis gigantis, qui ictum eius impediebat, proles monstruosa Oxyto, ab Sharron regita, etiam vehementius contracta est.

unit.source: Its half pale‐white, half chestnut‐brown wings and bent limbs had merged with its body, forming a sphere, with only its head, formed from several merged infant heads, still visible.
unit.target: Alæ dimidio pallide albae et dimidio castaneo‐brunnea atque membra flecta cum corpore eius coalescebant, sphaeram formantes, cum capite solum, ex pluribus capitibus infantum coniuncto, adhuc visibili.

unit.source: Its Paramita then encompassed the entire main hall of Death and the corpse of the Phoenix Ancestor.
unit.target: Deinde eius Paramita totum atrium principale Mortis et corpus progenitoris Phoenicis complexi amplectebatur.

unit.source: 773 Cries
unit.target: 773 Clamores

unit.source: 773 Cries
unit.target: 773 Clamores

unit.source: The pale-white light quickly engulfed the bird-clawed infant’s Paramita, rendering the spread-out wilderness dull and indistinguishable from the surrounding ruined palaces, towers, and corridors.
unit.target: Lux pallide alba celeriter absorpsit Paramitam infanti ungulis avium, reddens desertum latum opacum atque a ruinarum palatiis, turribus, et porticibus circumiectum indistinguibilem.

unit.source: This Paramita lost the features distinguishing the interior from the exterior, effectively withering and dying.
unit.target: Haec Paramita lineamenta, quae inter intus et exterum distinguebant, amisit, deficiens ac moriens.

unit.source: As the bone serpent collapsed, Lumian fell straight down, landing amidst the broken walls and debris scattered across the wilderness.
unit.target: Dum serpens ossium corruit, Lumian recta cecidit, inter murorum fractos et in desertum disseminatas ruinas cadens.

unit.source: With a forceful bend of his waist and a forward flip, he landed firmly, not relying on his burning‐white spear form to avoid the damage from such a fall.
unit.target: Per vehementem flexionem lumbi et saltum praevium, firmiter terram contigit, non innitens formae hastae alba ardentis ad vabanda damna lapsus.

unit.source: In this pale-white nation, even the rules of the world seemed corrupted; falling from fifty meters felt no different than jumping from a five-meter building.
unit.target: In hac natione pallide alba, etiam leges orbis videntur corruptae; lapsus ab quinquaginta metris non aliter sentiebatur quam saltus ex aedificio quinque metris altitudinis.

unit.source: At this moment, the monstrous child of Oxyto retracted its head into the pale-white flesh sphere, forcing the temperance faction demigod Sharron to detach and hover in mid-air.
unit.target: Hoc ipso momento, filius monstrum Oxyto caput suum in sphaeram carnis pallide albae retraxit, cogens demigodam factionis temperantiae, Sharron, ut se detacheret et in aere suspendi.

unit.source: In the area near the main hall of Death, five or six terrifying undead creatures, influenced by Paramita, shakily rose to their feet.
unit.target: In regione iuxta atrium Mortis, quinque vel sex terribiles creaturae mortuorum redivivarum, Paramita incitatae, vacillanter surrexerunt ad pedes.

unit.source: Among them were two giant serpents with feathered wings and hairy corpses, a bloated, rotten giant, a humanoid mountain of white bones, and a woman with hair like thick snakes and a face two-thirds decayed.
unit.target: Inter eos erant duo serpentes gigantes cum alis pennatis et cadaveribus pilosis, gigas inflatus et putrescens, mons humanoides ex ossibus albis, et femina, cui capilli instar anguilarum crassarum erant, atque cuius facies dimidio corrupta videbatur.

unit.source: Each of these risen dead, summoned by the bird-clawed infant, exerted immense pressure on Knight of Swords Maric.
unit.target: Unusquisque ex his resurrectis, a infante ungulis avium evocatis, pressuram ingentem in Militem Gladii Maric imposuit.

unit.source: As a Sequence 5 of the Prisoner pathway, he knew he couldn’t control these corpses; attempting to wake them would only result in his own immediate dismemberment.
unit.target: Ut Series V viæ Captivi, scivit se harum cadavarum regere non posse; conatus eos excitandi tantum ad propriam promptam dissecationem duceret.

unit.source: The undead, immense and horrifying, locked onto the temperance faction demigod, Sharron, but their movements were sluggish, as if hindered by an unseen force, unable to attack immediately.
unit.target: Mortui, ingentes et formidabiles, in demigodam factionis temperantiae Sharron se coniunxerunt, sed motus eorum lenti erant, quasi vi invisibili obstructi, necnon statim oppugnare nequibant.

unit.source: Sharron, too, could control corpses and command the dead, and she was a true demigod with a higher rank than the premature bird-clawed infant!
unit.target: Sharron quoque cadavera regere atque mortuos imperare poterat, et vera demigoda erat, dignitate superna quam infans ungulis avium praematurus!

unit.source: Sharron’s divided focus to influence the former Blessed of Death gave Oxyto’s monstrous child a chance for rebirth.
unit.target: Intensio divisa Sharronis, ad influendum pristinum “Benedictum Mortis”, filio monstrum Oxyto occasionem renascentiae obtulit.

unit.source: The pale-white flesh sphere bloomed like a flower, revealing a giant baby cleansed by pure water, while the sphere itself withered rapidly, turning pale and decaying as it fell to the ground.
unit.target: Sphaera carnis pallide albae ut flos efflorescebat, revelans magnum infans aqua pura emundatum, dum ipsa sphaera celeriter deficiebat, pallens et putrescens cadens ad terram.

unit.source: Just as the giant baby spread its half-pale, half-chestnut wings, Sharron abandoned her control over the corpses.
unit.target: Justo cum magnum infans alas dimidiis pallidīs et dimidiis castaneīs patefecisset, Sharron imperium suum super cadavera deseruit.

unit.source: In her pale-white eyes, the floating bird-clawed infant was reflected.
unit.target: In oculis eius pallide albis, infans ungulis avium volitans reflectus erat.

unit.source: She opened her mouth and let out a scream that seemed to come from the depths of her soul.
unit.target: Os suum aperuit et clamorem edidit, qui ex intimis animae eius profundis provenire videbatur.

unit.source: The giant baby froze, instantly transforming into a lamb covered in pale fur. Unable to fly or use any Beyonder abilities, it plummeted towards the ground, towards Lumian, who stood with the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Magnus infans statim congelatus est, in agnum pallide pilis operatum transformatus. Non potens volare aut ullas virtutes Beyonder uti, praeceps cecidit ad terram, ad Lumian, qui Gladium Fortitudinis tenebat.

unit.source: Transfiguration Curse!
unit.target: Maledictio Transfigurationis!

unit.source: Without the monstrous child’s support, Paramita began to collapse.
unit.target: Sine auxilio filii monstri, Paramita corruere coepit.

unit.source: The risen dead lost the foundation of their existence, gradually halting their movements and toppling over in the ruins.
unit.target: Mortui surrecti fundamentum existentiae suae amiserunt, motus gradatim sistentes et in ruinis corruentes.

unit.source: The lamb covered in pale-white fur seemed corrupted from within; as it fell, its skin split, sprouting half-pale, half-chestnut feathers, and its belly swelled, as if nurturing new life.
unit.target: Agnus, pallide albis pilis opertus, intus corruptus videbatur; dum cecidit, cutis eius scissurat, pennas dimidiīs pallidīs et dimidiīs castaneīs oriundas effodens, et venter eius inflabatur, quasi novam vitam nutrit.

unit.source: No creature could escape the fate of being corrupted and nurturing new life, not even an ordinary lamb!
unit.target: Nulla creatura fati corrupti et novam vitam nutrituri evadere poterat, ne quidem agnus vulgaris!

unit.source: This was a trait of the Madame pathway, and the Transfiguration Curse could not strip corresponding Beyonders of these traits!
unit.target: Hoc erat habitus viae Madame, nec Maledictio Transfigurationis talia ingenia correspondentibus Beyonder auferre poterat!

unit.source: Sharron never expected to resolve Oxyto’s premature child with just the Transfiguration Curse.
unit.target: Sharron numquam exspectavit Oxyto puerum praematurum solum Maledictione Transfigurationis resolvi posse.

unit.source: Seizing the opportunity, she let her pale-white figure reflect in the mutated lamb’s eyes.
unit.target: Occasionem capiens, figuram suam pallide albae in oculis agni mutati reflecti permisit.

unit.source: The lamb’s swelling belly began to slow, and the mutation caused by the corruption became less rapid.
unit.target: Venter agni inflatus incipiebat tardari, et mutatio corruptione causata celeritatem amittere coepit.

unit.source: It continued to plummet towards the ground.
unit.target: Continuabat praeceps ad terram cadere.

unit.source: Lumian, standing on the ground, looked up with a smile, raising the blue-hued blazing white Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Lumian, in terra stans, surrexit subridens, gladium Fortitudinis candidum, caeruleo fulgore ignitum, levans.

unit.source: As the lamb entered his attack range, a spear of pure, intense sunlight shot from the half-collapsed tower.
unit.target: Cum agnus in ambitum impugnationis eius intravit, hasta solis purae et intensae e turrim dimidium collapsa proiciebatur.

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric, enduring significant pain and damage, once again projected the spear that illuminated the pale-white world.
unit.target: Miles Gladii Maric, dolorem et laesiones gravissimas subiens, iterum hastam proiecit, quae mundum pallide album illuminavit.

unit.source: This time, the bird-clawed infant, still in lamb form, could not evade or find a helper to block the spear. It could only watch as the golden spear of sunlight pierced its abdomen and exploded.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, infans ungulis avium, adhuc in forma agni, neque fugiendi vi neque auxilium reperire potuit ad hastam obsistendam; solum intuiri potuit, quomodo hasta aurea solis abdominum eius percussit atque explosus est.

unit.source: At this moment, as the scorching white sunlight engulfed the target, Sharron used Lumian’s eyes and the pure gold in the nearby ruins to Mirror Jump away from the bright, sunlit, and fading pale area.
unit.target: Hoc ipso momento, dum candens lux alba solis scopulum complevit, Sharron oculos Lumiani et aurum purum in ruinis proximis ad saltum specularis adhibuit, se a regione clara, solis illustrata, et pallide evanescente avolvens.

unit.source: Although the lamb’s body shielded her from the direct harm of the sunlight explosion, she, as a spirit-like Beyonder, still suffered significant impact.
unit.target: Quamquam corpus agni eam a directo nocere explosionis solis protegebat, illa, ut spiritus similis Beyonder, tamen ictum gravem toleravit.

unit.source: When she reappeared in a golden pattern embedded in a wall hundreds of meters away, her figure had thinned noticeably, dripping waxy liquid like sweat.
unit.target: Cum in figura aurea, in pariete centum metrorum distante inscripta, reaparuit, figura eius notabiliter tenuata erat, et guttas liquoris cerosi, instar sudoris, stillantes extraxit.

unit.source: Lumian stood close to the pale-white lamb, filled with courage, not dodging, but standing firmly, welcoming the spreading sunlight.
unit.target: Lumian prope agnum pallide album stetit, fortitudine repletus, non evasiens sed firmiter stans, lucem solis expandentem excipiens.

unit.source: Wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, his entire body ignited, blackening and melting like a candle, bringing extreme pain.
unit.target: Gerens larvam auream familiae Eggers, totum corpus eius incendit, nigrescens et liquescens ut candela, dolorem acerrimum afferens.

unit.source: Fortunately, he was not at the explosion’s core, most of the damage falling on the bird-clawed infant, with Sharron taking some as well.
unit.target: Fortunate, non in centrum explosionis erat, cum pleraque damna infanti ungulis avium inciderent, et Sharron quoque aliqua sustinuerit.

unit.source: Otherwise, the sunlight spear might have purified him in one blow.
unit.target: Alioquin, hasta solis eum uno ictu purificavisset.

unit.source: The Sword of Courage also absorbed half the damage, making his injuries not as severe as they appeared.
unit.target: Gladius Fortitudinis etiam dimidium damnae absorbuit, ita ut vulnera eius non tam gravia videbantur quam apparuerunt.

unit.source: Clenching his teeth, Lumian advanced instead of retreating, running towards the falling bird-clawed infant with the eroded white broadsword in hand.
unit.target: Dentes contrahens, Lumian processit pro non recedendo, currens ad infans ungulis avium lapsum, manu tenens eroditum albidum gladium latiorem.

unit.source: With a faint thud, the half-melted, ghastly pale lamb crashed onto the shattered stones.
unit.target: Cum tenue strepitu, agnus semi-liquescens, horrendum pallidus, in lapides fractos corruit.

unit.source: Lumian arrived a second later, his eyes turning from iron-black to pale-white.
unit.target: Lumian secundo advenit, oculi eius a nigro ferri ad pallide album vertentes.

unit.source: He swung the Sword of Courage with both hands.
unit.target: Gladium Fortitudinis utrisque manibus concussit.

unit.source: Bright white and blue flames flared, the sharp sword striking the lamb’s chest and abdomen.
unit.target: Flammae candidae et caeruleae fulserunt, acutus gladius pectum atque abdominum agni percussit.

unit.source: The explosion was not loud, but the flames and the violent shockwave lifted the surrounding rubble, tearing a jagged hole in the lamb’s chest and abdomen.
unit.target: Explosio non fuit strepitus magnus, sed flammae atque unda violenta ruinas circumjacentes levaverunt, scindentes rupem aspera in pectore atque abdomine agni.

unit.source: Boom! Boom!
unit.target: Tum! Tum!

unit.source: Lumian swung the sword twice more, splitting the bird-clawed infant’s lamb form into charred fragments.
unit.target: Lumian gladium bis iterum volvit, dividens formam agni infanti ungulis avium in frusta combusta.

unit.source: The charred pieces were immediately eroded by the pale-white color, bringing a sense of dark, dead silence.
unit.target: Fragmenta combusta statim ab colore pallide albedo consumpta erant, sensum obscurum et mortuum silentium inferentes.

unit.source: Just as Lumian was about to strike again, the pale lamb’s abdomen exploded, scattering rotten flesh and liquid with a strange aura.
unit.target: Eodem modo, cum Lumian iterum ferire pararetur, abdominum agni pallide eruptum est, carnem putrescens et liquorem cum aura insolita spargens.

unit.source: Instinctively, Lumian slashed the void ahead with the Sword of Courage, cutting through everything there.
unit.target: Instinctu impulso, Lumian gladio Fortitudinis prae se secavit, omnia illuc secans.

unit.source: Boom! Bright white flames and a violent shockwave formed a solid wall, blocking the rotten flesh and evil liquid.
unit.target: Tum! Flammae candidae et unda ictus violenta murum solidum condiderunt, blocantes carnem putrescens atque liquorem malignum.

unit.source: As the pale lamb’s abdomen exploded, a small, phantom figure with bird claws and wings, covered in a layer of pure water, flew out, heading straight for the black bird egg beneath the ancient Death’s corpse.
unit.target: Cum abdominum agni pallide eruptum est, parva figura phantasma, cum ungulis avium et alis ornata, strato aquae purae operta, evanuit, recta versus ovum avium nigrum, pallide albis flammis ardentem, sub antiquo cadavere Mortis volans.

unit.source: This time, the bird-clawed infant, reduced to a phantom, was no longer cautious, no longer circling.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, infans ungulis avium, ad phantasmam redactus, non iam cautus erat neque circumvolabat.

unit.source: Knight of Swords Maric could not throw the spear of sunlight again, as it would cause his severely injured body to dissolve in the light.
unit.target: Miles Gladii Maric iterum hastam solis proicere non potuit, quoniam eo corpus eius graviter laesum in lumine dissolveretur.

unit.source: Instead, he opened his arms, summoning a divine pillar of clean flame from the sky, aiming at the phantom heading for the main hall of Death.
unit.target: Pro eo, bracchia aperuit, columnam divinam ignis puri ex caelo evocans, destinans eam in phantasmam ad atrium principale Mortis tendentem.

unit.source: The bird-clawed infant’s figure first disappeared, then reappeared, evading the divine pillar’s attack, but was immediately locked by Sharron’s pale-white eyes.
unit.target: Figura infanti ungulis avium primum evanuit, deinde re-apparuit, impetum columnae divinae eludens, sed statim ab oculis pallide albis Sharronis inclusa est.

unit.source: Sharron transformed into a dim, stiff doll, encasing herself in layers of ice.
unit.target: Sharron in pupam obscuram ac rigidam transformata, se in stratis glaciei involvit.

unit.source: Simultaneously, layers of crystalline ice emerged around the bird-clawed infant, briefly fixing it in place, preventing its disappearance or progress.
unit.target: Simul, strata glaciei crystallinae circa infans ungulis avium ortae sunt, eo ad tempus firmiter fixum, eius evanitionem vel progressum prohibentes.

unit.source: The bird-clawed infant raised its head, letting out a howling wail within the ice cage.
unit.target: Infans ungulis avium caput sublevavit, in cavea glaciei ululans lamentum edens.

unit.source: The ice cage silently shattered.
unit.target: Cavea glaciei silentio confracta est.

unit.source: The bird-clawed infant’s body, covered in clear, pure water, splashed towards the ancient Death’s corpse, forming droplets of faint golden liquid.
unit.target: Corpus infans ungulis avium, opertum aqua pura et clara, versus anticum cadaver Mortis pluvit, formans guttae liquoris aurei pallidae.

unit.source: These droplets, drawn by an unseen force, converged into a river, carrying the bird-clawed infant towards the black bird egg burning with pale-white flames.
unit.target: Hae guttae, vi invisibili trahitae, confluunt in flumen, infans ungulis avium vehentes versus ovum avium nigrum, pallide albis flammis ardentem, portant.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian instinctively wanted to avoid the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse. He leaned back, raised his arm, and hurled the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian instinctu cupivit cadaver Phoenix Antecessoris vitare; se recedens inclinavit, brachium sublevavit, et gladium Fortitudinis iaculatus est.

unit.source: The broadsword, eroded to pale but blazing with white and blue flames, flew like a conscious missile, covering hundreds of meters, leaving a trail of flames in the air, and striking the bird-clawed infant.
unit.target: Gladius latius, ad pallidum eroditus sed flammis albis et caeruleis ardentibus, quasi telum conscientem volavit, centena metrorum percurrens, vestigia flammarum in aere relinquit, et infans ungulis avium percussit.

unit.source: Locked on!
unit.target: Ad scopum intentus!

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Fragor!

unit.source: The sky near the black bird egg erupted with expanding white flames, forming a mushroom cloud.
unit.target: Caelum iuxta ovum avium nigrum flammis albis expansis eruptum est, nubem fungosam formans.

unit.source: Silently, charred shadowy fragments fell from the expanding flames and cloud, like a rain of dust.
unit.target: Silentio, fragmenta umbraculosa et combusta ex flammis expansis et nube ceciderunt, quasi pluvia pulveris.

unit.source: The dust turned pale before touching the ground, some blown by the wind onto the black bird egg.
unit.target: Pulvis, ante terram attingere, pallidum factus est; quidam, vento impulsis, super ovum avium nigrum delabuntur.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian heard an illusory shattering sound and felt his Reaper potion fully digest.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian sonitum fractum et illusorium audivit, atque potionem Reaper suam totam digeri sensit.

unit.source: He had no time to rejoice as his mind and consciousness, protected by the Eggers family’s golden mask, were overwhelmed by fear and dread.
unit.target: Non habuit tempus gaudendi, nam mens eius atque conscientia, a larva aurea familiae Eggers protegente, metu et formido opprimuntur.

unit.source: He lowered his head, knelt to the ground, and hugged himself, trembling.
unit.target: Caput inclinavit, ad terram genu flexit, et se complevit, tremens.

unit.source: He only wanted to obey the orders of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse.
unit.target: Solum cupiebat iussa cadaveris Phoenix Antecessoris obsequi.

unit.source: As an undead, he lost his courage, his vision darkening.
unit.target: Ut mortuus iterum ambulans (undead), virtutem amisit, et visus eius obscuratus est.

unit.source: Thump, splash… In extreme fear, Lumian heard the sound of a heartbeat and flowing blood.
unit.target: Tum, splash… In extremo metu, Lumian sonitum cordis pulsationis et sanguinis effluentis audivit.

unit.source: It came from nearby, within this Pale-White Nation.
unit.target: Venit ex proximo, intra hanc Nationem Pallide Albam.

unit.source: It resonated strangely with Lumian.
unit.target: Resonabat insolenter cum Lumiano.

unit.source: Faintly, Lumian heard a mournful cry: “Child!
unit.target: Leniter, Lumian lugubrem clamor audivit: “Puer!

unit.source: “My child!”
unit.target: “Fili mi!”

unit.source: Who is your child? Who are you? Lumian instinctively wondered.
unit.target: Quis puer tuus est? Quis es tu? Lumian instinctu quaerebat.

unit.source: The mournful cry continued:
unit.target: Clamor lugubris pergebat:

unit.source: “My child, where are you?”
unit.target: “Fili mi, ubi es?”

unit.source: The voice paused and then rose slightly:
unit.target: Vox cessavit et deinde leviter surrexit:

unit.source: “Omebella, where are you?”
unit.target: “Omebella, ubi es?”

unit.source: 774 Resonance
unit.target: 774 Resonantia

unit.source: 774 Resonance
unit.target: 774 Resonantia

unit.source: The mournful cry seemed to draw closer: “My child, Omebella, where are you?”
unit.target: Clamor lugubris videbatur appropinquare: “Fili mi, Omebella, ubi es?”

unit.source: Hearing the name “Omebella,” Lumian shuddered violently, snapping out of his fear-induced daze.
unit.target: Audito nomine “Omebella,” Lumian vehementer contremuit, evadens ex stupore, quem timor excitaverat.

unit.source: Who? Who is looking for Omebella? Why are they looking for Omebella?
unit.target: Quis? Quis Omebellam quaerit? Cur eam quaerunt?

unit.source: As he wondered, Lumian noticed the surrounding area growing darker, with a sense of confinement and imprisonment.
unit.target: Dum cogitabat, Lumian animadvertit loca circumstantia obscuriora fieri, cum sensu coarctationis et captivitatis.

unit.source: He reached out, his hands brushing against a cold, hard “wall.”
unit.target: Protulit manum, et manus eius ad parietem frigido atque duro perveniebant.

unit.source: He pressed himself against it, trying to peer through its cracks.
unit.target: Se apposuit super illud, conans per fissuras eius intueri.

unit.source: The “wall” was pitch black but semi-transparent, and Lumian could faintly see the pale-white sky, the collapsed towers, and the shattered palaces.
unit.target: Paries erat penitus atratus sed semi-transparens, et Lumian tenuiter videre poterat caelum pallido-album, turris lapsas, et palatia dilaniata.

unit.source: He also saw Sharron, the temperance faction demigod dressed in a small bonnet and a Gothic dress, floating nearby.
unit.target: Etiam vidit Sharron, semideum factionis temperantiae, parvo pileolo et veste Gothica indutum, prope fluitantem.

unit.source: She extended her hand, summoning the Sword of Courage, now pale from erosion.
unit.target: Manum extendit, evocans Gladium Fortitudinis, nunc pallide ex erosione factum.

unit.source: Beyond Sharron, he looked down at the rubble-strewn ruins.
unit.target: Ultra Sharron, deorsum intuebatur ruinas lapidibus sparsas.

unit.source: A pale figure in tattered clothes was kneeling, bent over as if to crawl.
unit.target: Figura pallida in vestimentis laceratis genu flectens, incurvata quasi repere conari.

unit.source: The figure was trembling all over, struggling to raise its head and straighten up.
unit.target: Figura totum tremens, conans caput levare et se erigere.

unit.source: It was a face wearing a golden mask—his own face!
unit.target: Facies erat, quae larvam auream gerebat—ipsa eius facies!

unit.source: Me?
unit.target: Ego?

unit.source: If I’m outside, then who is here?
unit.target: Si extra sum, quis igitur hic est?

unit.source: Already half-conscious, Lumian felt even more bewildered.
unit.target: Iam semiconscius, Lumian etiam magis perplectus se sensit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, he saw his outside self, with charred skin peeling off, sprouting half-pale, half-chestnut feathers.
unit.target: Fere simul, vidit se forensem, cuius cutis arsa, exfoliens, erat, et pennae dimidio pallidae, dimidio castaneae emergentes.

unit.source: His belly writhed visibly, while wheat, mushrooms, and flowers grew from the sunlit wounds.
unit.target: Venter eius manifeste convolabatur, dum triticum, fungi, et flores ex vulneribus sub sole illustratis crescebat.

unit.source: Silently, Sharron leaped onto the golden mask and appeared before Lumian, placing the Sword of Courage into his hands.
unit.target: Tacite, Sharron in larvam auream subsilavit et ante Lumian apparuit, Gladium Fortitudinis in manibus eius ponens.

unit.source: The surge of courage instantly dispelled the fear suppressing his mind and consciousness, making his vision pale-white and no longer pitch black.
unit.target: Impulsus fortitudinis statim sopivit metum, qui mentem ac conscientiam eius subjugabat, efficens ut visio eius pallido-alba, non iam penitus atra videretur.

unit.source: The sense of confinement and entrapment around him also dissipated.
unit.target: Sensus coarctationis et captivitatis circum eum quoque evanuit.

unit.source: He raised his head higher, no longer seeing himself or using a top-down perspective.
unit.target: Caput suum attulit altius, neque se iam ex prospectu superiori intuens.

unit.source: His gaze fell on the black egg under the ancient Death’s corpse at the top of the main hall.
unit.target: Aspectus eius incidit in ovum nigrum sub antiquo cadavere Mortis in summitate aulae principalis.

unit.source: He instinctively believed he had just been inside the egg, observing the outside through its shell!
unit.target: Instinctu credebat se modo intra ovum fuisse, externa per testam eius intueri!

unit.source: No, it wasn’t me inside the black egg, but the part of me that lost courage and was subdued by the ancient god’s aura resonating with the creature inside the egg, sharing its senses.
unit.target: Minime, non ego in ovo nigrum ferebam, sed pars mei quae fortitudinem amisit atque aura antiqui dei, resonans cum creatura intra ovum et eius sensus communicans, subacta est.

unit.source: So, I “saw” the scene outside the shell, “heard” the mournful cry for Omebella, and showed signs of corruption!
unit.target: Itaque scinam extra testam “vidi”, clamor lugubris pro Omebella “audivi”, et signa corruptionis ostendi!

unit.source: Thinking this, Lumian quickly looked down at his body, seeing the feathers falling off, mixed with wheat, mushrooms, and flowers.
unit.target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian celeriter intuebatur suum corpus, videns pennas decidentes, misceatas cum tritico, fungis, et floribus.

unit.source: They had all lost their color, turning pale and dim.
unit.target: Omnia colorem suum amisere, fiens pallida et obscura.

unit.source: Lumian also saw his belly flattening, feeling his blood, meant to be solid as a deceased, flowing throughout his body.
unit.target: Lumian etiam vidit ventrem suum achatam, et sensit sanguinem suum, quod ut cadaver solidum esse debebat, per totum corpus fluere.

unit.source: Suddenly, he understood why Oxyto risked so much to nurture a fetus with undead traits and an aura of the Underworld.
unit.target: Subito intellexit cur Oxyto tantum periculum cepisset ad fovendum fetus cum indiciis mortuorum et aura Inferorum.

unit.source: Even with just a bit of Omebella’s bloodline, suppressed by the ancient god’s corpse, he could resonate and interact with the creature inside the black egg.
unit.target: Etiam cum parva parte sanguinis Omebellae, a cadavro antiqui dei repressa, resonare et cum creatura intra ovum nigrum interagere poterat.

unit.source: How much more could the bird-clawed infant, with more of the Great Mother’s gifts, fused with Paramita and the Underworld, and perhaps also with Omebella’s bloodline!
unit.target: Quam multo amplius infans ungulis avis praeditus, cum plurimis donis Magnae Matris, cum Paramita et Inferis fusus, et fortasse etiam cum sanguine Omebellae, efficere posset!

unit.source: If we hadn’t taken out Oxyto’s premature child in time, it might have used the resonance and interaction to merge with the creature inside the black egg, controlling it from the source, or completing its catalysis!
unit.target: Si non extraxerimus puerum prae-maturum Oxytoni in tempore, ille resonantiam et interactionem adhibuisse potuisset ut cum creatura intra ovum nigrum confluere posset, eam ex ipso fonte regens aut catalysin suam perficiens.

unit.source: Hmm, the premature birth meant the bird-clawed infant lacked the rank and traits, requiring extreme caution.
unit.target: Hmm, nativitas prae-matura significabat infans ungulis avis deficere dignitate et proprietatibus, idque eximia cautela requirente.

unit.source: Even if it reached the final step, there was a high chance of failure…
unit.target: Etiam si ad ultimum gradum pervenisset, alta probabilitas defectus erat…

unit.source: Now, the question is, why could the creature inside the black egg hear the ‘Mother’s’ call for Omebella…
unit.target: Nunc quaestio est: cur creatura intra ovum nigrum vocem “Matris” pro Omebella audire posset…

unit.source: Who exactly is Omebella’s ‘Mother’? It can’t really be the Great Mother, can it? Isn’t She always outside the barrier?
unit.target: Quis igitur est “Mater” Omebellae? Nonne illa Magna Mater esse non potest? Num illa non semper extra claustra manet?

unit.source: What is the relationship between the creature inside the black egg and Omebella?
unit.target: Quae est relatio inter creaturam intra ovum nigrum et Omebellam?

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian suddenly heard a faint cracking sound.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius percurrebant, Lumian subito audivit sonum tenuem crepantem.

unit.source: He looked up in astonishment, seeing the pale-white flames burning on the black egg dim significantly and peel away.
unit.target: Stupefactus aspexit, et vidit flammas pallido-albas super ovum nigrum ardere, signanter attenuatas atque evellentes.

unit.source: The black egg itself developed a noticeable fissure.
unit.target: Ipsum ovum nigrum notabilem fissuram evolvit.

unit.source: It seemed to be disintegrating to some extent.
unit.target: Videbatur in aliquo gradu dissolvi.

unit.source: The next second, the entire Pale-White Nation began to tremble.
unit.target: Secundo sequente, tota Natio Pallido-Alba tremere coepit.

unit.source: A deathly aura from the black egg, where the ancient Death’s corpse lay, started to emerge.
unit.target: Aura mortifera ex ovo nigrum, in quo iacebat cadaver antiqui Mortis, incipiebat emergere.

unit.source: Even with the Sword of Courage in hand, Lumian couldn’t help but freeze, trembling.
unit.target: Etiam cum Gladio Fortitudinis in manu haberet, Lumian non potuit nisi congelari, tremens.

unit.source: The surrounding palaces and towers, whether in ruins or half-collapsed, began to shake violently as if struck by an earthquake.
unit.target: Palatia et turres circumstantes, sive in ruinis sive semi-collapsae, vehementer concuti coepere, quasi terrae motu percussae.

unit.source: A thought flashed through Lumian’s mind: The Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace’s corpse is awakening… Run! Escape!
unit.target: Cogitatio per mentem Lumiani fulsit: Cadaver progenitoris Phoenicis Gregrace excitatur… Fuge! Effuge!

unit.source: He shouted this in his mind but couldn’t turn his body or take a single step.
unit.target: Hoc in mente exclamavit, sed corpus verti nec unum quidem passum facere potuit.

unit.source: The temperance faction demigod Sharron grabbed him, and in his eyes reflected the dim figure of the Knight of Swords, who looked much fainter than before.
unit.target: Deum minor factionis temperantiae Sharron eum arripuit, et in oculis eius figura opaca equitis gladii reflexa est, quae multo pallidior quam ante videbatur.

unit.source: Cracks appeared in the pale-white sky, extending towards the trembling ground.
unit.target: Fissurae apparuerunt in caelo pallido-albo, extendentes versus terram tremens.

unit.source: An overwhelming sense of dread was rapidly accumulating at the top of the main hall of Death.
unit.target: Immensus sensus timoris celeriter in summitate aulae principalis Mortis accumulabatur.

unit.source: Sharron, holding Lumian, initiated Spirit World Traversal.
unit.target: Sharron, Lumian tenens, iter per Regnum Spirituum incepit.

unit.source: This could be used in the Underworld but would trigger retribution.
unit.target: Hoc in Inferis adhiberi poterat, sed ultionem excitare debebat.

unit.source: Countless indescribable limbs reached out from the void, grabbing at the swiftly moving Sharron.
unit.target: Innumerabiles membra ineffabilia e vacuo protraxerunt se, rapientes Sharron celeriter moventem.

unit.source: Sharron endured the damage from these limbs, continuing to head towards the pitch-black cathedral at the edge of the Pale-white Nation.
unit.target: Sharron toleravit damna harum membrorum, pergens versus cathedral penitus atrum in margine Nationis Pallido-Albae.

unit.source: Her body ignited with pale-white flames, directly burning her spirit, causing clumps of powder to fall continuously.
unit.target: Corpus eius inflammatum est in flammas pallido-albas, spiritum directe comburens, unde conglomerata pulveris continue cadere coeperunt.

unit.source: Sharron could no longer sustain it any more than three seconds, interrupting the Spirit World Traversal and falling onto the pale-white wilderness outside the palace of Death, nearly a kilometer from the pitch-black cathedral.
unit.target: Sharron id amplius quam tribus secundis sustinere non potuit, iter per Regnum Spirituum interrumpens et in solitudinem pallido-albam extra palatium Mortis cadens, paene uno chiliometro a cathedral penitus atro.

unit.source: Holding the Sword of Courage, Lumian, now outside Death’s palace complex, no longer felt as afraid.
unit.target: Gladio Fortitudinis tenens, Lumian, nunc extra complexum palatii Mortis, timorem non amplius sensit.

unit.source: He immediately pointed at himself, indicating for Sharron to possess him.
unit.target: Statim se ipsum indicavit, ostendens ut Sharron eum possideret.

unit.source: At the same time, he saw numerous jagged cracks rapidly spreading from behind, revealing a bottomless darkness, spheres wrapped in blood-red substance, and mountains filled with tombs…
unit.target: Eodem tempore, vidit numerosas fissuras acutatas celeriter se extendere ab tergo, ostendentes abyssum sine fundo, sphaeras in sanguine rubro involutas, et montes sepulcris repletos…

unit.source: Feeling achill within him, Lumian quickly ignited in blazing white flames, transforming into a magnificent spear, and launched towards the edge of the Pale-White Nation.
unit.target: Sentiens aciem intus, Lumian celeriter inflammatus est in flammas albas ardentes, se in hastam magnificam transformans, et ad marginem Nationis Pallido-Albae iecit.

unit.source: Above, below, and on all sides, countless cracks chased after him like shattered glass.
unit.target: Supra, infra, et omni parte, innumerabiles fissurae eum insequebantur, quasi vitrum confractum.

unit.source: Behind him, from the direction of the palace, a heavy sound emerged.
unit.target: Post eum, ex directione palatii, sonus gravis emersit.

unit.source: Amid the pale erosion, the flaming spear disappeared and reappeared twice.
unit.target: In medio erosionis pallidae, hasta flammans evanuit et bis re apparuit.

unit.source: Finally, Lumian escaped the Pale-White Nation, landing in front of the towering pitch-black cathedral.
unit.target: Postremo, Lumian Nationem Pallido-Albam effugit, incidens in conspectu ingentis cathedral penitus atri.

unit.source: Here, only the underground portion of the cathedral was visible, resembling a massive mountain.
unit.target: Hic, sola pars subterranea cathedral, ingenti monte similis, apparebat.

unit.source: Lumian passed through the heavy wooden doors, once again transforming into a flaming spear and launched upwards.
unit.target: Lumian per portas ligneas graves transivit, iterum se in hastam flammeam transformans et sursum iecit.

unit.source: When the flames dispersed, he sheathed the Sword of Courage, climbing upwards using the collapsed stairs, peeling walls, and broken pillars, repeatedly jumping between them, sometimes leaping across support-less areas as a flaming spear.
unit.target: Cum flammas evanuerunt, involvit Gladium Fortitudinis, ascendens sursum per scalas collapsas, parietes descidentes et columnas fractas, iterumque inter eos saliens, interdum regiones sine sustentatione transiliens, ut hasta flammea.

unit.source: Before long, the pitch-black cathedral began to shake violently.
unit.target: Mox, cathedral penitus atra vehementer concuti coepit.

unit.source: The already precarious corridors, stairs, walls, and pillars started to crack and fall.
unit.target: Illa iam instabiles, scalae, parietes, et columnae incipiebant fissuras formare et cadere.

unit.source: Seeing himself about to be crushed and buried by the collapsing building, Lumian prepared to draw the Sword of Courage to carve out an escape route.
unit.target: Cum vidisset se imminere constringi et sub ruentibus aedificiis sepulti futurum, Lumian praeparavit Gladium Fortitudinis extrahere ad viam evasionis sculpendam.

unit.source: At this moment, he was surprised to find the stones and pillars above him seemed to have a life of their own, avoiding him and continuing to fall past his sides.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, admiratus est quod lapides et columnae super eum quasi vitam propriam haberent, evitantes eum et per latera eius cadentes.

unit.source: In such a dangerous situation, Lumian remained unharmed.
unit.target: In tali periculo, Lumian intactus remansit.

unit.source: He guessed Sharron provided some help, not wasting any time, and continued his ascent, repeating the process.
unit.target: Coniectus est Sharron quandam auxilium praebuisse, nullum tempus perdit, atque ascensum suum continuavit, processum iterans.

unit.source: After an unknown amount of time, the violent shaking abruptly stopped.
unit.target: Post ignotum spatium temporis, concutio violenta subito cessavit.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t relax, maintaining his pace and rhythm until he saw a pale green light above.
unit.target: Lumian non quievit, cursum et rhythmum suum servans, donec lucem viridem pallidam supra videret.

unit.source: A blazing white spear shot out from the dark hole within the half-collapsed church.
unit.target: Hasta alba flammans ex foro obscuro intra ecclesiam semi-collapsam erupit.

unit.source: With the flames dispersing, Lumian’s figure appeared, standing firmly on the cracked stone slab.
unit.target: Cum flammas evanuerant, corpus Lumiani apparuit, firmiter stans super lapide fisso.

unit.source: Next to a broken wall embedded with several bone torches, a tall Demon with a human-goat hybrid face slowly turned, dragging a white bone leg.
unit.target: Iuxta parietem fractum, in quo plura luminaria ex ossibus insita erant, altus Daemon, facie humano-caprina mixta, lente se vertit, crus ossis albi trahens.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian realized he hadn’t retrieved the black egg, failing the Demon’s commission.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian animadvertit se ovum nigrum non recuperavisse, mandatum Daemonis deficiens.

unit.source: Instantly, anger surged within him: Was this a task I could complete?
unit.target: Statim, ira in eo surrexit: Num hoc opus perficere possem?

unit.source: You were sending me to my death! Truly a Demon’s commission! Fine, since completing the task is no longer an option, I have only one choice: destroy the commissioner!
unit.target: Me ad mortem mittebas! Vere mandatum Daemonis! Bene, cum opus perficere iam non possit, unum solum mihi relinquit: commissarium perimere!

unit.source: Despite these thoughts, Lumian only reached into the Traveler’s Bag, preparing to draw the Sword of Courage, without intending to fight immediately.
unit.target: Non obstante his cogitationibus, Lumian solum in sacculum Viatoris extendit manum, Gladium Fortitudinis extrahere praeparans, neque statim pugnare intentus.

unit.source: He was concerned that the ancient Death’s corpse’s awakening would cause mutations to spread here, preferring to leave the depths of the Underworld as soon as possible, especially given the unknown strength of the goat-faced Demon.
unit.target: Curabat ne excitatio antiqui cadaveris Mortis mutationes hic diffunderet, et optabat quam primum relinquere profunda Inferorum, praesertim propter ignotam potentiam Daemonis faciei caprinae.

unit.source: Hunched over, the goat-faced Demon staggered in front of Lumian.
unit.target: Procumbens, Daemon faciei caprinae ante Lumian titubavit.

unit.source: It stared at Lumian silently before speaking in a hollow, decayed voice.
unit.target: Silentiose adspiciebat Lumian, deinde in vocem cavum et corruptam loqui coepit.

unit.source: This time, it used Dutanese: “You’ve taken that egg for yourself!”
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Dutanice dixit: “Tu tibi ipsi ovum abstulisti!”

unit.source: Before it finished speaking, the goat-faced Demon straightened its four or five-meter-tall body and swung the white bone leg at Lumian.
unit.target: Priusquam finiret loqui, Daemon faciei caprinae corpus suum, quod quattuor aut quinque metrorum altum erat, rectificavit et crus ossis albi in Lumian iactavit.

unit.source: 775 Cunning
unit.target: 775 Calliditas

unit.source: 775 Cunning
unit.target: 775 Calliditas

unit.source: As the goat-faced Devil approached and stared at him, Lumian’s hand was already gripping the hilt of the Sword of Courage.
unit.target: Cum diabolus, vultu caprino, accedebat et eum intuebatur, manus Lumiani iam manubrium Gladii Fortitudinis tenebat.

unit.source: When the white bone leg came crashing down, he swiftly drew the iron-black sword, burning with a bright white and blue flame, and met the attack head-on.
unit.target: Cum crus ossis album in terram ruina cecidit, celeriter traxit gladium ferri–nigerum, qui flammis albis et caeruleis nitidissimis ardebant, et impetum directe oppugnavit.

unit.source: Clang!
unit.target: Clang!

unit.source: The clash echoed loudly, and Lumian’s palm split open, spilling blackened, coagulated blood.
unit.target: Conflagra–tio sonum magnopere edidit, et palma Lumiani rupta est, effundens sanguinem atratum et coagulatum.

unit.source: The immense force from the goat-faced Demon’s strike made him lose his grip on the Sword of Courage, sending him flying and crashing into a pile of rubble.
unit.target: Immensus vis ictus daemonis, vultu caprino, fecit ut manus illum de Gladio Fortitudinis amitteret, eumque volitare atque in acervum ruinarum corruere faceret.

unit.source: The goat-faced Demon stepped over the fallen sword in two strides, standing before Lumian and raising the bone leg again.
unit.target: Daemon, vultu caprino, in duobus passibus gladium lapsum transgressus est, coram Lumiano stans et crus ossis denuo attollens.

unit.source: Suddenly, in its blood- and pus-filled eyes, the figure of Sharron, the temperance faction demigod, appeared. Its raised hands froze in midair.
