unit.target: Subito, in oculis eius sanguine et purulento plenis, figura Sharronis, semidei factionis temperantiae, apparuit. Manus eius attollitae in aere congelatae erant.

unit.source: Seeing the goat-faced Demon’s movements slow down as if struggling against something, Lumian ignited with white flames, transforming into a spear and darting past the high-ranking undead to where the Sword of Courage had fallen.
unit.target: Videns daemonis, vultu caprino, motus tardari quasi aliquid oppugnari, Lumian ignibus albis exarduit, in hastam se transformans atque praeter praestantes redivivos evolans ad locum, ubi Gladius Fortitudinis cecidit.

unit.source: Perhaps because the goat-faced Demon wasn’t an undead created by the Death pathway, its intimidating effect on Lumian was weak.
unit.target: Forsitan quod daemon, vultu caprino, non esset redivivus per viam Mortis creatus, effectus eius intimidans in Lumiano debilis fuit.

unit.source: It lacked the ability to enslave his body and mind, allowing Lumian to muster the courage to fight back.
unit.target: Non habebat facultatem subigere corpus eius et mentem, ita Lumiano concessum est virtutem colligere ad repugnandum.

unit.source: While retrieving the iron-black broadsword, Lumian released the spirituality he had accumulated using his Ascetic ability.
unit.target: Dum gladius ferri–niger reciperetur, Lumian spiritualitatem, quam per potentiam asceticam suam congregaverat, dimisit.

unit.source: At the same time, his eyes turned iron-black, reflecting the many colors on the goat-faced Demon.
unit.target: Simul, oculi eius in ferrum nigrum versati sunt, multa colora in daemon, vultu caprino, reflectentes.

unit.source: He quickly found a patch of pallor, took two steps towards the goat-faced Demon, and leaped high.
unit.target: Celeriter locum palloris invenit, duos gradus in directionem daemonis, vultu caprino, fecit, et alte salivit.

unit.source: In midair, Lumian adjusted his posture, gripping the Sword of Courage with both hands and descending towards the slow-moving Demon, still battling Sharron.
unit.target: In aere, Lumian statum corporis sui componebat, Gladium Fortitudinis utrisque manibus tenens et ad daemonem tarditer movens descendebat, Sharron adhuc pugnans.

unit.source: This time, he used the Sword of Courage’s Cull ability!
unit.target: Hoc tempore, usus est facultate “Cull” Gladii Fortitudinis!

unit.source: His spirituality surged into the iron-black broadsword, causing the bright white and blue flames to flare up and then condense inward.
unit.target: Spiritualitas eius in gladium ferri–nigerum impetum fecit, ut flammae albae et caeruleae nitidae exarduerent atque deinde in se congregarentur.

unit.source: With a heavy thud, Lumian landed on the Demon’s back, stabbing the Sword of Courage into the junction of its neck and body. The blade sliced into the decayed flesh like butter.
unit.target: Gravi iactu, Lumian in tergo daemonis decessit, Gladium Fortitudinis in iuncturam colli et corporis infigens. Lamina in carne putida ut butyrum incidit.

unit.source: As pus splattered, the flames on the broadsword poured into the goat-faced Demon’s body.
unit.target: Dum pus spargebatur, flammae in gladio ferri–niger in corpus daemonis, vultu caprino, effundebantur.

unit.source: Boom! A muffled explosion echoed, and Sharron quickly withdrew from the Demon’s body.
unit.target: Boom! Explosio submissa resonavit, et Sharron celeriter a corpore daemonis recedebat.

unit.source: The Demon disintegrated into a puddle of sticky black liquid, condensed from evil thoughts.
unit.target: Daemon in guttam liquoris nigri viscosi, ex malis cogitationibus condensati, disgregatus est.

unit.source: The liquid, scattered by the expanding flames and shockwaves, swiftly flowed into the dark hole leading to the Pale-white Nation, seemingly to reassemble itself.
unit.target: Liquidum, a flammis expansis et undis concussis dispersum, celeriter in cavum obscurum, quod ad Nationem Pallidam Albam duxit, fluebat, quasi se iterum coalescere vellet.

unit.source: Holding the Sword of Courage, Lumian felt his released spirituality deplete by two-thirds.
unit.target: Gladium Fortitudinis tenens, Lumian sensit spiritualitatem suam dimissam esse per duas partes ex tribus.

unit.source: He wanted to chase and fight the Demon again but felt his body stiffen and his soul trapped in an invisible cage.
unit.target: Daemonem iterum persequi et pugnare vellebat, sed sensit corpus rigide fieri et animam in invisibili cavea inclusam.

unit.source: “Retrieve your target item first,” the faint voice of the Knight of Swords echoed in his ears.
unit.target: “Recupera primum rem propositam tuam,” vox tenue Eques Gladii in auribus eius resonabat.

unit.source: Right… Lumian agreed with the Knight of Swords’ reasoning.
unit.target: Recte… Lumian ratione Eques Gladii assensit.

unit.source: I don’t fear the goat-faced Demon. I can totally grab the Abscessed Hand’s body before it reassembles!
unit.target: Daemonem, vultu caprino, non timeo. Possum plane corpus Manus Abscessae arripere antequam se iterum congreget.

unit.source: He transformed into a burning-white spear, darting to the bone torches.
unit.target: Se in hastam albe ardentem transformavit, festinans ad faces ossium.

unit.source: To better move the Abscessed Hand’s body, he temporarily stashed the Sword of Courage in the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Ut corpus Manus Abscessae melius moveret, Gladium Fortitudinis pro tempore in sacculo Viatoris recondidit.

unit.source: Moments later, Lumian felt a pang of fear: I only have a third of my spirituality left, yet I was thinking of a life-or-death fight with the Demon?
unit.target: Paulis post, Lumian angorem timoris sensit: solam tertiam partem spiritualitatis suae remanere; et tamen de pugna inter vitam et mortem cum daemon cogitabatur?

unit.source: And Sharron is clearly in poor condition!
unit.target: Et Sharron plane in paupera condicione versatur!

unit.source: Now isn’t the time for that. Shouldn’t I grab the target item and leave the collapsing cathedral before the Demon reassembles?
unit.target: Nunc non est tempus ad hoc. Num oportet me rem propositam arripere et cathedralem corruentem relinquere antequam daemon se iterum congreget?

unit.source: Thankfully, the Knight of Swords acted as a valve for my courage and found a convincing reason!
unit.target: Gratias Deo, Eques Gladii instar moderatoris virtutis meae egit et rationem persuasivam invenit!

unit.source: Without hesitation, Lumian grasped the Abscessed Hand’s half-body, trying to lift it.
unit.target: Sine dubitatione, Lumian dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae arripuit, conans illud sublevare.

unit.source: It was extremely heavy, like metal. Fortunately, Lumian was now a Sequence 5 Beyonder, from a pathway known for their strength.
unit.target: Valde grave erat, sicut metallum. Fortunate, Lumian nunc erat Sequence V Beyonder, ex via notissima propter virtutem.

unit.source: During this process, Lumian worried the body might suddenly reanimate and deliver a fatal blow.
unit.target: Durante hoc processu, Lumian sollicite cogitabat ne corpus repente reanimi fieret et ictum letalem daret.

unit.source: However, the Abscessed Hand’s half-body, after enduring years of cutting by the goat-faced Demon, seemed lifeless with no abnormal reaction.
unit.target: Tamen, dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae, post annos vulnerum a daemon, vultu caprino inflictorum, iners apparuit, sine ullo motu anomalo.

unit.source: Lumian placed the half–corpse into the Traveler’s Bag, relieved to see it “sink” inside.
unit.target: Lumian dimidium cadaveris in sacculo Viatoris posuit, levatus quod illud intus submergeretur.

unit.source: Living flesh couldn’t be stored in the Traveler’s Bag, and the Abscessed Hand’s body had shown self–healing traits earlier.
unit.target: Carne viva in sacculo Viatoris condiri non potuit, et corpus Manus Abscessae antehac qualitates auto–sanationis ostendit.

unit.source: Lumian had thought if he couldn’t store it, he’d carry it or have the Knight of Swords or Sharron possess it to make it move.
unit.target: Lumian putavit, si id condere non posset, vel portaturum esse, vel Eques Gladii aut Sharron illud possiderent ad eius movendum.

unit.source: With the body stored, Lumian heard creaking sounds from the dark hole.
unit.target: Corpus repositum, Lumian sonos crepitantes ex cavum obscurum audivit.

unit.source: He immediately transformed into a blazing spear, darting out of the half–collapsed pitch–black cathedral.
unit.target: Statim se in hastam flagrans transformavit, ex cathedral dimidio corruente et prorsus nigro expellens.

unit.source: With a swoosh, the white flames left a burning trail in the dark, spreading quickly into the distance.
unit.target: Cum sibilo, flammae albae vestigium ardentem in tenebris reliquerunt, celeriter in longinquitatem diffundentes.

unit.source: Without the Pale–White Nation’s erosion, Lumian flew far in one breath.
unit.target: Absque erosionem Nationis Pallidae Albam, Lumian uno spiritu longe volavit.

unit.source: Under the golden humanoid lamplights, he repeatedly transformed into a blazing spear, finally reaching the shadowy River Styx.
unit.target: Sub aureis lampadis humanoidibus, iterum atque iterum se in hastam flagrans transformabat, denique flumen Styx umbratile attingens.

unit.source: He saw the gloomy, tattered boat reappear, slowly approaching as the boatman rowed.
unit.target: Vidit navem tristem, laceratam iterum apparire, paulatim accedens dum nauta remigabat.

unit.source: Lumian waited anxiously, not daring to fly onto the boat as a spear.
unit.target: Lumian anxie exspectabat, non ausus ut se in navem, ut hasta similis, volitaret.

unit.source: According to the Knight of Swords Maric, doing so would make him sink into the river’s depths, never to be saved.
unit.target: Secundum Equem Gladii Maric, hoc faciens eum in profundum fluminis submergere faceret, nunquamque servatum esse.

unit.source: Behind him, pale green flames burned quietly, sometimes swaying with the ground’s tremors, sometimes shaking with some vibrations.
unit.target: Post eum, flammae virides pallidae quiete ardebant, interdum tremore terrae oscillantes, interdum vibrationibus aliquantulis commoventes.

unit.source: Lumian tensed, feeling an increasing danger, unsure if it was from the ancient Death’s corpse awakening or the goat-faced Demon’s pursuit.
unit.target: Lumian tensus est, percipiens periculum augmentum, nescio utrum ex evigilatione cadaveris Mortis antiquae vel ex insequentia daemonis, vultu caprino proveniret.

unit.source: He looked at the slow–moving boat, using a Hunter’s method to calm his emotions.
unit.target: Contemplatus est navem tarditer moventem, utens more venatoris ad animi sui sedandum.

unit.source: He chuckled and spoke to the Knight of Swords Maric within him, “I thought the goat–faced Demon was powerful, just below the ancient gods, holding a grudge against the Devil Monarch and desiring the egg beneath the ancient Death’s corpse. But now, it seems it’s just at the Saint level, with only a corpse left, lacking Beyonder characteristics.”
unit.target: Subridens locutus est ad Equem Gladii Maric, qui intra eum habitat, “Putabam daemonem, vultu caprino, esse potentem, paene deorum antiquorum infra, rancorem gerens adversus Monarcham Diaboli et ovum sub cadavere Mortis antiquae desiderare. Sed nunc videtur solum ad gradum Sancti esse, solo cadavro relicto, carens proprietatibus Beyonder.”

unit.source: The Knight of Swords didn’t respond.
unit.target: Eques Gladii non respondit.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “The goat–faced Demon’s initial request to kill the Devil Monarch was likely a bluff, making us more likely to accept the second condition, thinking it reasonable. If Oxyto’s premature child hadn’t interfered, we might have stolen the egg, only to face the ancient Death’s wrath, unrelated to the goat–faced Demon.
unit.target: Lumian continuavit: “Petitum initium daemonis, vultu caprino, ad occidendum Monarcham Diaboli probabiliter erat fictio, quae nos ad aliam condicionem accipiendam inclinavit, id rationabile existimantes. Si filius prae–maturus Oxyto non intercessisset, fortasse ovum surripivissemus, ut contra iram Mortis antiquae pugnaremus, quae daemoni, vultu caprino, non pertinebat.

unit.source: It also used the request to kill the Devil Monarch to build its image, making us think it was formidable, of high rank, preventing us from attacking it or abandoning the egg task.
unit.target: Etiam postulatum ad occidendum Monarcham Diaboli ad imaginem suam constituendam utebatur, nos efficere faciens ut putaremus eum formidolosum et excelsum, ne ab illo oppugnarent aut officium ovum neglegerent.

unit.source: What a cunning Demon…
unit.target: O quam callidum daemonem…

unit.source: Lumian then remembered the demon’s accusation: “You’ve taken that egg for yourself!”
unit.target: Tum Lumian daemonis accusationem retulit: “Ipsum ovum tibi ceperis!”

unit.source: When did I take the egg? It’s still under the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse. I only resonated with the creature inside, hearing and seeing what it did… Did the Demon mistake this resonance for me taking and breaking the egg? As an undead, even if it was a Saint–level Demon in life, it might have little brain left, acting on its cunning Demonic instinct…
unit.target: Quando ovum ceperim? Illud adhuc sub cadavere Phoenix Avus manet. Ego solum cum creatura intima resonavi, audiens et videns quid faceret… Num daemon hanc resonantiam pro eo confudit, ut ovum ceperim et confractum fecerim? Ut redivivus, etiamsi in vita daemon gradus Sancti fuerit, parvum cerebrum reliquum habere poterat, agens ex suo callido instinctu daemonico…

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, the tattered boat finally reached the shore.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, navis lacerata denique litus attingebat.

unit.source: He jumped aboard, standing behind the boatman.
unit.target: In navem insilivit, stans post nauta.

unit.source: Though the boatman might attack later, compared to the goat–faced Demon’s pursuit and the ancient Death’s corpse’s awakening, it was “friendly.”
unit.target: Quamquam nauta postea oppugnare posset, comparato insequentia daemonis, vultu caprino, et evigilatione cadaveris Mortis antiquae, amicus videbatur.

unit.source: This was manageable.
unit.target: Hoc tolerabile erat.

unit.source: The rickety boat shook as it left the dark shore, slowly heading towards the middle of the shadowy river.
unit.target: Navis labile concutiebatur dum litus obscurum relinquebat, lente versus medium fluminis umbratilis se vertens.

unit.source: Lumian looked back at the depths of the Underworld, seeing the intense darkness calm down, no more tremors or heavy sounds.
unit.target: Lumian ad profunda Inferorum respexit, qua intensae tenebrae sedaverunt, nec iam tremores aut sonitus graves resonabant.

unit.source: Everything was serene again.
unit.target: Omnia iterum tranquilla erant.

unit.source: Lumian relaxed a bit, instinctively sighing.
unit.target: Lumian paululum relaxatus est, instinctu suspirans.

unit.source: This Underworld trip was indeed “intense”…
unit.target: Haec iter Inferorum vere “intensa” fuit…

unit.source: Only now did he ponder the huge black egg issue: The creature inside seemed related to Omebella!
unit.target: Modo nunc de ingenti ovo nigro quaestionem meditatus est: creatura intima ad Omebella pertinere videbatur!

unit.source: From this, Lumian felt the Great Mother naming Her Child of God after the ancient god, Omebella, wasn’t just for symbolic reasons to erode the Earth Mother’s authority. The fallen Goddess of Harvest held significant secrets.
unit.target: Ex hoc, Lumian sensit Magnum Matrem, Filium Dei in honorem dei antiquae, Omebella, nominare non solum propter rationes symbolicas ad auctoritatem Matris Terrae subruendam esse. Dea Messis decidua secreta gravia tenebat.

unit.source: But Omebella wasn’t one of the eight ancient gods ruling the sky and land, just the Giant King’s queen, akin to an Angel. How can Her secrets affect the current era?
unit.target: Sed Omebella non erat una ex octo deis antiquorum, qui caelum et terram regebant, sed sola regina Regis Gigantis, quasi Angelus. Quomodo eius secreta aetatem hodiernam afficere possunt?

unit.source: Ah, many key pieces of information are obscured by history’s fog. Only a few high–ranking beings from the Second Epoch know a bit…
unit.target: Ah, multae res clavis ab historiae nebula obscuratae sunt. Pauci tantum entia summa dignitatis ex Secunda Aetate parum scire videntur…

unit.source: Lumian mused as he watched the dark land of the Underworld recede, until only the shadowy River Styx water filled his view.
unit.target: Lumian meditatus est dum terram obscuram Inferorum recedere videbat, donec solum umbratile flumen Styx totam visionem eius implevit.

unit.source: He suddenly felt the matter had finally come to an end.
unit.target: Subito sensit rem denique finem attigerit.

unit.source: 776 Secrets
unit.target: 776 Arcana

unit.source: 776 Secrets
unit.target: 776 Arcana

unit.source: This time, the boatman didn’t attack Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, nauta Lumian non oppugnavit.

unit.source: Instead, he rowed the gloomy boat to the opposite shore.
unit.target: Contrae, navem lugubrem ad alteram ripam remigavit.

unit.source: Jumping onto the wasteland covered in withered blood flowers, Lumian, whose spirituality was nearly exhausted, ran towards the pile of bones and corpses on higher ground.
unit.target: Saltans in solitudinem desolata, opertam floribus sanguineis appassitis, Lumian, cuius spiritualitas paene exhausta erat, cucurrit versus molem ossium et cadaverum in loco superiore.

unit.source: After running for a few minutes, he saw faint starlight piercing through the dim sky.
unit.target: Paucis momentis currendo, tenui lucem stellarum per obscurum caelum penetrare vidit.

unit.source: Next, the void tore open like transparent paper.
unit.target: Deinde, vacuum scinditur sicut charta translucida.

unit.source: The tear blended with the starlight, forming a door of shimmering light.
unit.target: Scissio cum luce stellarum miscetur, ostium lucis micantis formando.

unit.source: Standing beyond the door was Madam Magician, dressed in a loose orange dress.
unit.target: Extra ostium stabat Domina Magica, induta vestimento aurantiaco laxe.

unit.source: Madam Magician did not enter the Underworld but floated in the void outside the door, smiling at Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Domina Magica non intravit Infernum, sed in vacuo extra ostium levitabat, subridens Lumiano et ceteris.

unit.source: Madam Magician… Lumian had expected another demigod from the temperance faction, bringing a Beyonder of the Death pathway to open the door to the Underworld to fetch him, Sharron, and Maric.
unit.target: Domina Magica… Lumian alterum semideum de factione temperantiae exspectaverat, qui Beyonder viae Mortis ad ostium Inferni aperiendum et ad eum, Sharron, atque Maric evocandum afferret.

unit.source: But it was the Major Arcana card holder, Madam Magician.
unit.target: Sed erat tenens chartam Major Arcana, Domina Magica.

unit.source: She can find the Underworld?
unit.target: Potestne Infernum invenire?

unit.source: She can tear through its barrier and create a door?
unit.target: Potestne obstaculum eius scindere et ostium creare?

unit.source: Suppressing his curiosity, Lumian took a running start and jumped through the starlit door.
unit.target: Curiositatem reprimens, Lumian impetum cepit et per ostium lucis stellarum saltavit.

unit.source: He felt a wave of dizziness and his vision darkened before he saw the clear, pure Lake Dalsh and felt the thin air of the highlands.
unit.target: Undam vertiginis sensit et visus obscuratus est, priusquam Lacum Dalsh clarum et purum videret et aerem tenuem altorum sentiret.

unit.source: He reflexively removed the golden mask of the Eggers family from his face to avoid becoming a true undead from wearing it too long.
unit.target: Instinctive, larvam auream familiae Eggers ab facie sua removebat, ne nimis diu eam gerens vere mortuos evaderet.

unit.source: During this, the figures of Sharron and the Knight of Swords Maric appeared beside him.
unit.target: Interim, figurae Sharron atque equitis gladii Maric iuxta eum apparuerunt.

unit.source: “Thank you,” the Knight of Swords politely addressed Madam Magician.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi,” inquit comiter Eques Gladii ad Dominam Magicam.

unit.source: Wearing a small black and Gothic dress, Sharron nodded silently.
unit.target: Induta parvo vestimento nigro et Gothico, Sharron silentio annuit capite.

unit.source: “It’s only right,” Madam Magician replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Recte est,” respondit Domina Magica cum risu.

unit.source: “It’s a pity we couldn’t catch Oxyto.
unit.target: Lamentabile est quod Oxyto non cepimus.

unit.source: The Great Mother’s Bestowed are very vigilant and skilled at rebirth, making them extremely hard to catch.
unit.target: Donati a Magna Mater valde vigilantes et rebus renascentibus peritissimi sunt, quae eos ad prehendendum valde difficiles reddit.

unit.source: After a few pleasantries, the Knight of Swords said goodbye.
unit.target: Post paucas amabilitates, Eques Gladii valedixit.

unit.source: Before leaving, he and Sharron both nodded to Lumian, showing their approval.
unit.target: Ante discessum, ille et Sharron utrumque capite annuerunt Lumiano, suam approbationem ostendentes.

unit.source: Although the Knight of Swords’ request was only to help find Oxyto, Lumian had far exceeded that by chasing Oxyto’s premature child into the Underworld and eliminating it.
unit.target: Quamquam petitio Equis Gladii soli ad auxilium inveniendi Oxyto erat, Lumian prolem praematuram Oxyto in Infernum insequendo et exterminando multum hanc exsuperavit.

unit.source: In return, Sharron, despite being injured, helped Lumian control the goat-faced Demon, giving him a chance to defeat it and take the Abscessed Hand’s half-body.
unit.target: Pro compensatione, Sharron, quamvis laesa, Lumiano adiuvit ut daemonem faciei caprinae moderaret, ei occasionem praebens ut illud vinceret et dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae caperet.

unit.source: Thus, neither owed the other, and no additional payment was necessary.
unit.target: Itaque, nec unus alteri debebat, neque aliqua additamenta solutio necessaria fuit.

unit.source: Of course, establishing a friendship and deepening his connection with the Knight of Swords was an added bonus.
unit.target: Certe, amicitia instituenda et nexus cum Eques Gladii confirmandus praemium additum erat.

unit.source: After Sharron and the Knight of Swords left, Madam Magician looked at Lumian with a teasing smile.
unit.target: Postquam Sharron et Eques Gladii discesserunt, Domina Magica Lumianum intuens subrisu iocoso.

unit.source: “Wondering how I found the Underworld?
unit.target: Cur miraris quomodo Infernum inveni?

unit.source: “For a high-ranking member of the Apprentice pathway, the Underworld is just there.
unit.target: Nam, pro membro eminenti viae discipulatus, Infernum ipse illic stat.

unit.source: There’s no question of finding it.
unit.target: Non est quaestio eius inveniendi.

unit.source: Even if hidden, we can easily locate it by observing the Gatekeepers and master the ability to summon a door to the Underworld.
unit.target: Etiamsi absconditum, facile eum reperire possumus, custodum portarum observando atque facultatem ad evocandum ostium Inferni assecuti.

unit.source: But I didn’t summon it; I just opened a door.
unit.target: Sed non eum evocavi; solum ostium aperui.

unit.source: “Then why did you say I had to wait for an opportunity to enter the Underworld?” Lumian asked reflexively.
unit.target: “Cur ergo dixisti me opportunitatem exspectare ad ingressum Inferni?” inquit Lumian reflexe.

unit.source: As Mr. Fool’s Angel of Stars, couldn’t you just open a door to the Underworld for me?
unit.target: Sicut Domini Stultorum Angelus Stellarum, num non potuisses mihi simpliciter ostium Infernum aperire?

unit.source: What opportunity was there to wait for?
unit.target: Quae opportunitas ad exspectandum erat?

unit.source: Madam Magician chuckled.
unit.target: Domina Magica subridens ridebat.

unit.source: “Could you have retrieved part of the Abscessed Hand’s body if I had sent you to the Underworld back then?”
unit.target: Potuissesne partem corporis Manus Abscessae recuperare, si te tunc ad Infernum misissem?

unit.source: “No…” Lumian answered softly.
unit.target: “Non…” respondit Lumian molliter.

unit.source: Not only would he fail, but he might also die instantly from illegal teleportation.
unit.target: Non solum deficeret, sed etiam statim ab teleportatione illicita mori posset.

unit.source: This time, with guidance from the temperance faction and the help of a demigod, he had a chance to take the Abscessed Hand’s body from the goat-faced Demon.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, ductu factionis temperantiae et auxilio semidei, occasionem habuit corpus Manus Abscessae ex daemonem faciei caprinae capiendi.

unit.source: Of course, the risks had also increased significantly.
unit.target: Certe, pericula etiam valde augmenta erant.

unit.source: “I sensed an opportunity and advised you to wait,” Madam Magician said sincerely.
unit.target: “Occasionem sensi et tibi suadet ut exspectares,” Domina Magica sincere dixit.

unit.source: “Not all abilities can be repeated; not using them and using them to change one’s state directly is very difficult.”
unit.target: “Non omnes facultates replicari possunt; eas non adhibere ac ad statum mutandum directe uti valde difficile est.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t dwell on it, recounting his experiences in the Underworld with Sharron and the Knight of Swords.
unit.target: Lumian non diuturnē rem contemplatus, sed cum Sharron et Eques Gladii suas in Inferno experientias enarravit.

unit.source: Madam Magician listened attentively without interrupting, sometimes showing a thoughtful expression.
unit.target: Domina Magica attentius auscultavit sine interpellatione, interdum vultum cogitativum ostendens.

unit.source: “What secrets are hidden in the body of the Second Epoch’s Goddess of Harvest?” Lumian asked at the end.
unit.target: “Quae arcana in corpore Deae Messis Secundae Aevi celantur?” inquit Lumian in fine.

unit.source: Madam Magician replied, shaking her head, “I don’t know.”
unit.target: Domina Magica, caput movens, respondit: “Nescio.”

unit.source: She paused for a moment before adding, “There are things I hadn’t planned to tell you so early because it’s not good for you.
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit, deinde addens: “Sunt res quas non praevidi tibi tam mature nuntiandas, quoniam tibi non prosunt.

unit.source: But since you’ve merged with Omebella’s bloodline and experienced the Underworld, I can share a bit.
unit.target: Sed, cum sanguinis Omebellae stirpe coniunxeris et Infernum experieris, parum nunc communicare possum.

unit.source: Do you remember the relic of Omebella I mentioned?”
unit.target: Meministine reliquiam Omebellae de qua dixi?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Lumian said, one of his reasons for merging with Omebella’s bloodline being the hope of briefly using the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact formed from the relic.
unit.target: “Ita,” inquit Lumian, quarum una ex causis coniungendi cum sanguine Omebellae erat spes breviter uti Artefacto Sigillato Gradus 0 ex reliquia orto.

unit.source: Madam Magician continued, “Do you know where it is?”
unit.target: Domina Magica continuavit: “Scisne ubi sit?”

unit.source: Before Lumian could shake his head, she answered herself, “It’s in the New City of Silver.”
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian caput moveret, ipsa respondit: “In Nova Urbe Argentea est.”

unit.source: New City of Silver? The Church of The Fool’s headquarters? Lumian thought of the giant-like beings that made him feel like a dwarf.
unit.target: Nova Urbs Argentea? Caput Ecclesiae Stultorum? Lumian de ingentibus entibus, qui eum quasi nanum facere sentire faciebant, cogitavit.

unit.source: Omebella’s relic is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Church of The Fool’s in New City of Silver?
unit.target: Reliquia Omebellae est Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 0 Ecclesiae Stultorum in Nova Urbe Argentea?

unit.source: Madam Magician pondered for a few seconds before saying, “First, you need to understand a piece of mystical knowledge.
unit.target: Domina Magica paucos secundos cogitavit antequam dixerit: “Primum, tibi opus est unam partem scientiae mysticae intellegere.

unit.source: Marauders, the Angels of the Error pathway, can steal others’ identities and destinies.
unit.target: Praedatores, Angeli viae Erroris, aliorum identitates et fata subripere possunt.

unit.source: In other words, someone whose identity and destiny are stolen will no longer be recognized by their parents, spouse, or children, gradually becoming rejected by fate.
unit.target: Hoc est, aliquis cuius identitas et fatum sublata sunt, a parentibus, coniuge, aut liberis non amplius agnoscetur, et paulatim a fato abiectus erit.

unit.source: Lumian recalled the Substitution Spell in the Inevitability domain, which also involved one’s identity and fate.
unit.target: Lumian incantationem substitutionis in dominio Inevitabilitatis revocavit, quae etiam identitatem et fatum complectebatur.

unit.source: Though different from Madam Magician’s description and on a much lower level, it helped Lumian understand her words.
unit.target: Quamquam ab descriptione Dominae Magicae differebat et in multo inferiori ratione agebat, id Lumiano ad verba eius intellegenda adiuvit.

unit.source: Seeing he had no questions, Madam Magician continued, “According to what we know, I suspect the Goddess of Harvest Omebella had Her identity and destiny stolen by a high-ranking member of the Error pathway and was killed by Her direct relatives.
unit.target: Cum videret eum quaestiones non habere, Domina Magica pergebat: “Secundum quae scimus, suspicor Deam Messis Omebellae identitatem et fatum suum ab membro praestanti viae Erroris sublata fuisse et a cognatis suis occisam.

unit.source: “Up to this point, it sounds like nothing more than a horrific consOriginal, but think about it.
unit.target: Ad hunc punctum, nihil aliud quam horrendum consOriginal videtur, sed considera.

unit.source: Why would the body of the Goddess of Harvest, killed by Her direct relatives and robbed of Her identity and destiny, end up in the former City of Silver, not silently in a battlefield corner?
unit.target: Cur corpus Deae Messis, a cognatis suis occisum et identitate atque fato expers, in pristina Urbe Argentea finire debet, non silentiose in angulo proelii?

unit.source: And more strangely, the ancestors of the City of Silver knew it was Omebella’s body and Her true identity.
unit.target: Et etiam mirabilius, maiores Urbis Argenteae sciebant hoc esse corpus Omebellae et veram eius identitatem.

unit.source: At the time, the Steal effect was still present!
unit.target: Illo tempore effectus furti adhuc vigebat!

unit.source: Lumian sensed something amiss and frowned, “What’s the City of Silver’s records or speculations on this?
unit.target: Lumian aliquid suspectum sensit et frontem contraxit, “Quid dicunt tabulae Urbis Argenteae vel coniecturae de hoc?

unit.source: Does Omebella’s body contain Beyonder characteristics?”
unit.target: Num corpus Omebellae proprietates Beyonder continet?

unit.source: “None,” Madam Magician answered firmly.
unit.target: “Nulla,” respondit Domina Magica ferme.

unit.source: “The City of Silver’s records are sparse due to the Ancient Sun God’s rule in the Third Epoch.
unit.target: Tabulae Urbis Argenteae exiguas sunt ob regnum Dei Solis Antiqui in Tertia Aevo.

unit.source: But their ancestors mentioned that the Goddess of Harvest walked to the City of Silver on Her own.
unit.target: Sed maiores eorum meminerunt Deam Messis ipsam ad Urbem Argenteam ambulavisse.

unit.source: Heh heh. Strange, right?
unit.target: Heh heh. Mirum, nonne?

unit.source: You’ll understand more when you can temporarily use that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
unit.target: Plura cognosces cum illud Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus 0 ad tempus uti poteris.

unit.source: Now is not the time.”
unit.target: Nunc non est tempus.

unit.source: This confirms that Omebella held significant mysteries…
unit.target: Hoc confirmat Omebella res arcana magni ponderis habuisse…

unit.source: Lumian asked cautiously, “What did the goat-faced Demon mean when it said I had taken the egg for myself?”

unit.target: “Ita,” Plessy respondit, consentiens indicium pro semideo esse inutile et imaginem Ecclesiae inter populum laedere posse.

unit.source: A few days later, Franca, Anthony, and the others used different channels to gather the latest sightings and rumored whereabouts of the Pirate Admirals.
unit.target: Paucis diebus post, Franca, Antonius et ceteri per varias vias recentes appariciones et fama loca Admiralis Piratarum colligebant.

unit.source: Looking at the information, Franca patted the top sheet and said to Lumian, “How about this one?”
unit.target: Revidens informationes, Franca lamina suprema pulsavit et Lumiano dixit: “Quid de hoc?”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the name and read it silently: Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine.
unit.target: Lumian nomen conspexit et tacite legit: “Admiralis Profundi Maris, Ululatus Constantinus.”

unit.source: 778 Method of Arrival
unit.target: 778 Methodus Adventus

unit.source: Lumian had already looked through the information Franca had gathered and could guess her reasoning for this choice: Howl Constantine-Admiral Deep Sea-with rumored sea monster blood, often went to an island called “Banamo” west of the Fog Sea for supplies.
unit.target: Lumian iam perlegit informationes quas Franca colegerat et rationem eius electionis coniectare potuit: Howl Constantine, Admiralis Profundi Maris – cui fama sanguinis monstrosi marini fertur – saepe navigabat ad insulam, quae "Banamo" appellatur et in parte occidentali Marem Nebulae sita est, ad supplementa acquirenda.

unit.source: A few days ago, someone spotted Howl Constantine’s flagship, the Newins, surfacing on a route to Banamo, allowing the crew to breathe fresh air and enjoy their precious freedom.
unit.target: Paucis diebus abhinc aliquis conspexit navem praecipitem Howl Constantine, cui nomen est Newins, in itinere ad Banamo emergere, quo manipulo aerem recens spirare et pretiosam libertatem frui licebat.

unit.source: Based on the distance, speed, route conditions, and weather in the Fog Sea, it was estimated that the Newins would reach Banamo in about two to three days.
unit.target: Ex distantia, velocitate, condicionibus itineris et tempestate in Marem Nebulae, aestimatum erat Newins ad Banamo pervenire intra duos ad tres dies.

unit.source: Among all the Pirate Admirals, he was the only one with a predictable trajectory in the near future!
unit.target: Inter omnes admirales piratarum, ille solus erat cui iter, in proximo futuro, praedicibile videbatur!

unit.source: “We can give it a try,” Lumian responded nonchalantly to Franca’s suggestion.
unit.target: «Experiri possumus,» inquit Lumian leviter ad suggestionem Francae.

unit.source: Having participated in battles at the demigod level and played a significant role, he felt that which Pirate Admiral they targeted didn’t matter much as long as they could locate him.
unit.target: Certaminibus ad gradum semideorum participans et momentum praebens, sensit quod, qua quis admiral piraticus eligendus esset, parum referri, dummodo eum reperire possent.

unit.source: Franca glanced at Lumian and mumbled, “I think there’s something wrong with your attitude.
unit.target: Franca Lumianum intuens submurmuravit: "Puto aliquid esse pravum in tua indole."

unit.source: You can’t underestimate the best of the Sequence 5s.
unit.target: Optimos Sequenciae 5 non potes subestimare.

unit.source: You’re not a demigod yet, and your body is still fragile.
unit.target: Adhuc non es semideus, et corpus tuum adhuc fragilis est.

unit.source: Underestimating Admiral Deep Sea could cost you dearly.
unit.target: Subestimare Admiralem Profundi Maris tibi grave pretia afferre potest.

unit.source: There’s a saying from my homeland: Strategically, you can underestimate your enemy, but tactically, you must respect them.”
unit.target: Ex patria mea dicitur: "Stratēgice hostem tuum minus aestimare licet, sed tacticē eum honorare debes."

unit.source: “I know.
unit.target: "Scio."

unit.source: Aurore used to remind me of that, telling me not to underestimate the villagers’ intelligence and think my pranks would always succeed without problems.
unit.target: Aurore me id meminisse solebat, monens ne ingenium vicanorum subestimes et putes meus iocus semper sine difficultate evenisse.

unit.source: After being chased by them a few times, I understood it well.
unit.target: Postquam aliquoties ab illis persecutus sum, id plane intellexi.

unit.source: Lumian said earnestly, “Your homeland also has another saying: Weakness and ignorance aren’t barriers to survival, but arrogance is.”
unit.target: Lumian sincere inquit: "Patria tua etiam alterum dictum habet: Infirmitas et ignorantia non sunt impedimenta ad superviventiam, sed superbia est."

unit.source: “Stop!” Franca grumbled.
unit.target: "Desine!" murmurat Franca.

unit.source: “As long as you know it; don’t turn this into an exchange of famous sayings.”
unit.target: Quamdiu id nosti, noli hoc in commercium proverbiorum celebriorum vertere.

unit.source: Seeing they had decided on the target, Jenna spoke up, “The problem now is, how do we get to Banamo Island?”
unit.target: Cum destinatum propositum elegerent, Jenna inquit: "Nunc quaestio est: quomodo ad insulam Banamo perveniemus?"

unit.source: Banamo, located in the northwest of the Fog Sea, was once a Feysac Empire colony.
unit.target: Banamo, in parte septentrionali-occidentali Marem Nebulae sito, olim colonia Feysac Imperii fuit.

unit.source: Later, as the Feysac Empire declined and the natives of Banamo resisted actively, the island gained independence.
unit.target: Postea, cum Feysac Imperium declinaret et incolae Banamo vehementer resistent, insula independentiam adeptus est.

unit.source: It helped that Banamo lacked valuable resources and was only a base for exploring the Fog Sea’s end.
unit.target: Adiuvabat quod Banamo opes pretiosas caret et solum fundamentum esset ad finem Marem Nebulae explorandum.

unit.source: Giving it up wasn’t a big loss.
unit.target: Abdicare id non magnum detrimentum erat.

unit.source: After gaining independence, Banamo developed into a pirate haven, offering a place for pirates to trade and resupply.
unit.target: Postquam independentiam adeptus est, Banamo in asylum piraticum evoluta est, locum praebens ad piratas ad mercandi et supplementandi causa.

unit.source: Jenna’s point was clear: Even with clear routes and good weather, it would take two to three weeks to sail from Trier to Banamo.
unit.target: Punctum Jennarum clare patebat: etiam cum itineribus perspicuis et tempestate optima, navigatio ab Trier ad Banamo duabus ad tribus septimanis constare debebat.

unit.source: Any issues requiring detours or delays could stretch the journey to a month.
unit.target: Quaecumque difficultates, quae accessus vel morae exigerentur, iter ad mensem extendi possent.

unit.source: By then, Admiral Deep Sea would likely have left Banamo, and finding a Pirate Admiral on the open sea would be almost impossible without a stroke of fate.
unit.target: Ille tempore, Admiralis Profundi Maris verisimiliter Banamo reliquisset, et in aperto mari admiralem piraticum invenire fere impossibile esset, nisi casu fortuito.

unit.source: Given the circumstances, only teleportation could ensure the team reached Banamo in time to wait for Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine.
unit.target: Hisce condicionibus datis, sola teleportatio efficere poterat ut manipulus ad Banamo perveniret in tempore ad Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine exspectandum.

unit.source: However, neither Lumian nor Franca had the spirit world coordinates for Banamo Island, making long-distance teleportation impossible without getting lost in the spirit world.
unit.target: Tamen nec Lumian nec Franca habebant coordinata mundi spiritalis pro insula Banamo, quae teleportationem longinquam efficere posset, sed sine perditione in mundo spiritali impossibile redderet.

unit.source: Lumian thought for a moment and asked Franca, “Can we contact anyone on Banamo Island?”
unit.target: Lumian paulisper meditatus Francam rogavit: "Num aliquem in insula Banamo contingere possumus?"

unit.source: “We should be able to.
unit.target: Ita fieri debet.

unit.source: There’s a telegraph office on Banamo Island.
unit.target: In insula Banamo officina telegraphica est.

unit.source: We can ask adventurers who’ve been to Banamo to send a telegram to their friends on the island.
unit.target: Adventores, qui Banamo venerunt, rogare possumus ut telegraphem amicis suis in insula mittant.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridit.

unit.source: “Good. If everything goes well, we can arrive at Banamo Island tonight.”
unit.target: "Bene. Si omnia rite procedunt, hac nocte ad insulam Banamo pervenire possumus."

unit.source: Banamo Island in the Fog Sea, shrouded in perennial fog and gloomy weather.
unit.target: Insula Banamo in Marem Nebulae, perpetua nebula et tristi tempestate obducta est.

unit.source: In the island’s only port, Mason, carrying a bundle of items, navigated through the bustling pirates and entered an abandoned warehouse.
unit.target: In unico portu insulae, Mason, fasciculum rerum ferens, per tumultum piratarum navigavit atque in horreum desertum ingressus est.

unit.source: The warehouse had been destroyed in a pirate skirmish and never repaired, becoming a desolate spot.
unit.target: Horreum in certamine piratico deletum erat nec umquam reparatum, unde locum desertum redditum est.

unit.source: Mason was an adventurer who despised the brutal and ruthless pirates but couldn’t leave Banamo because the pirate haven was full of opportunities.
unit.target: Mason adventor erat, qui piratas crudeles atque inhumanos detestabatur, sed Banamo relinquere non poterat, quod asylum piraticum opportunitatibus plenum erat.

unit.source: Even if he didn’t hunt down solitary, bounty-carrying pirates, he could wait for pirate feuds to end and take the remaining goods from the losers.
unit.target: Etiam si piratas solitarios, praemiis oneratos, non venaret, poterat exspectare dum lites piratici finirent et reliquas merces ex victis caperet.

unit.source: This was how he became a Beyonder, now a Sequence 8 Pugilist.
unit.target: Hac ratione Beyonder factus est, nunc pugil Sequenciae VIII.

unit.source: (Amonoculus’ note: From the Twilight Giant Pathway)
unit.target: (Nota Amonoculi: Ex Vía Gigantis Crepuscularis)

unit.source: Today, Mason took on a task supposedly very simple but with a reward of 1,000 verl d’or, seeking a secluded place to complete it.
unit.target: Hodie, Mason officium suscepit, quod videtur esse valde simplex, sed praemium mille verl d’or praebebat, quaerens locum remotum ad exsequendum.

unit.source: He quickly cleared the pile of broken wooden crates, stacking them to form an altar.
unit.target: Celeriter congeriem pulvinarum lignearum fractarum purgavit, eas congregans ut altare efficiat.

unit.source: Following the task description, he placed candles, incense, and essential oils on the altar.
unit.target: Secundum officii descriptionem, in altare posuit candelas, incensum, et olea essentialia.

unit.source: After the preparations, Mason took out the neatly folded task description and read the next steps, “The most challenging part of this task is the necessary knowledge, including basic ancient Hermes and proficient Hermes. If you don’t meet these conditions, don’t take the commission…”
unit.target: Post praeparationibus, Mason descriptionem officii diligenter plicatam extraxit et sequentia legit: "Pars arduissima huius muneris est cognitio necessaria, quae includit fundamenta antiqui Hermetis et scientiam peritissimam Hermetis. Si has condiciones non impleres, commissionem ne suscipe..."

unit.source: Fortunately, I learned some ancient Hermes and enough Hermes from other adventurers… Mason felt lucky for his past decision when taking this task.
unit.target: Fortunate, aliquantum antiqui Hermetis et satis Hermetis ab aliis adventoribus didici... Mason propter praeteritam decisionem huius muneris suscipiendi se felix sensit.

unit.source: It wasn’t that he was more studious than other adventurers, but the items he had previously acquired involved Hermes. To understand their true value, he had paid an adventurer proficient in Hermes to teach him for a while.
unit.target: Non enim studiosior quam ceteri adventores erat, sed res quas antea adeptus erat ad Hermem attinebant; ut earum verum pretium intellexeret, adventorem in Hermete peritum aliquantulum remuneraverat ut eum doceret.

unit.source: After quickly reading the second half of the task description, Mason assessed the potential dangers and felt confident it wouldn’t be a big problem.
unit.target: Postquam celeriter dimidium descriptionis officii legit, Mason pericula possibilia aestimavit et confidit rem non magnam futuram esse.

unit.source: He then arduously created a wall of spirituality, lit the candles, dripped the incense, and took two steps back, chanting in ancient Hermes, “I!”
unit.target: Deinde labore arduo murum spiritualitatis condidit, candelas accendit, incensum stillare sinxit, et duo passus retro fecit, in antiquo Hermete canens: "Ego!"

unit.source: This was one of the few words he knew in ancient Hermes.
unit.target: Hoc fuit unum ex paucis verbis quas in antiquo Hermete noverat.

unit.source: He then switched to Hermes:
unit.target: Deinde ad linguam Hermete conversus est:

unit.source: “I summon in my name:
unit.target: "Ego in nomine meo invoco:

unit.source: “A creature wandering above the world, the penitent who awakens from the flames of pain, a messenger that belongs solely to Lumian Lee…”
unit.target: "Creaturam errantem super mundum, paenitentem, qui ex flammas doloris expergisci videtur, nuntium, qui solum Lumiani Lee competit..."

unit.source: As Mason finished, the candle flames surged, turning a deep green, almost black.
unit.target: Cum Mason finem fecisset, flammas candelarum proliferaverunt, in viridem profundum, paene nigrum redigere.

unit.source: In the firelight, a tall figure in a black clergyman’s robe emerged.
unit.target: In lumine ignis, figura alta in veste nigra clericorum apparuit.

unit.source: Mason took a step back in fear at the sight.
unit.target: Mason, metu affectus, unum gradum retro fecit.

unit.source: The figure’s exposed parts seemed long scorched by flames, with blackened flesh and skin clinging to the bones.
unit.target: Partes figurae patentia diu ab igne combusta videbantur, cum carne nigrita et cute ad ossa aderente.

unit.source: Its eye sockets were dark, burning with deep-colored flames, and its body was oozing a viscous black fluid like water.
unit.target: Orbitae oculorum obscurae erant, flammarum profundo colore ardentes, atque corpus viscosum fluidum nigrum quasi aquam stillabat.

unit.source: It looked like an undead creature!
unit.target: Ut creatura mortuorum apparuit!

unit.source: Mason had seen similar beings in Banamo Port, as some pirates were adept at communicating with corpses.
unit.target: Mason similia entia in Portu Banamo vidisset, cum quidam piratae cum cadaveribus communicare periti essent.

unit.source: However, the summoned Penitent made Mason instinctively fearful, sensing it was fundamentally different from ordinary undead.
unit.target: Tamen, Penitent evocatus, Mason instinctive territus est, sentiens eum fundamentatim dissimulare ab ordinariis mortuis.

unit.source: Even the Pirate Admirals who had visited Banamo Port hadn’t given Mason this feeling!
unit.target: Etiam admirales piratici, qui Portum Banamo visiterunt, talem sensum Mason non attulerunt!

unit.source: Seeing the dried corpse in a black clergyman’s robe looking at him, Mason shakily handed over the letter.
unit.target: Videns cadaverum aridum in veste nigra clericorum ad se spectantem, Mason tremens epistulam tradidit.

unit.source: His task was to deliver a letter to someone named Lumian Lee!
unit.target: Munus eius erat epistulam tradere cui nomen Lumian Lee esset!

unit.source: The blackened, burning corpse messenger took the letter and disappeared into the dark-green candlelight.
unit.target: Nuntius cadaveris nigrescens et ardens epistulam attulit et in lucem candelae viridis obscurae evanuit.

unit.source: The abandoned warehouse returned to normal.
unit.target: Horreum desertum ad statum normalem rediit.

unit.source: Mason wiped his cold sweat and muttered to himself, “This seems more complicated than I thought… I’ve heard of people being lured into special rituals, summoning evil gods or devils, destroying themselves and their towns… Was that what just happened? Is a catastrophe coming to Banamo Port? Is Lumian Lee the true name of an evil god or demon?”
unit.target: Mason sudorem frigidum exstinxit et sibi submurmuravit: "Hoc videtur complicatius quam putabam... Audivi homines in ritus especiales decipi, malos deos aut daemonia evocare, se ipsos et urbes suas delere... An hoc modo res acciderunt? An calamitas ad Portum Banamo ventura est? An Lumian Lee verum nomen mali dei aut daemonis est?"

unit.source: won Mason had previously seen that the ritual only summoned a messenger, unrelated to evil gods or demons. As a Sequence 8 Beyonder, he had taken the risk, but the messenger made him uneasy.
unit.target: Mason antea vidit quod ritus solum nuntium evocaret, qui non pertinere ad malos deos aut daemonia; ut Beyonder Sequenciae VIII, periculum susceperat, sed nuntius eum perturbavit.

unit.source: Muttering to himself, Mason cleaned up the items on the altar.
unit.target: Submurmurans, Mason res in altare purgavit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he stopped and frowned.
unit.target: Subito sistit et vultum contraxit.

unit.source: “I think I’ve heard the name Lumian Lee somewhere before…”
unit.target: "Credo nomen Lumian Lee aliquando antea audivisse."

unit.source: He tried to recall but couldn’t remember.
unit.target: Conatus est reminiscere, sed meminisse non potuit.

unit.source: Before leaving the abandoned warehouse, Mason glanced back at the makeshift altar, seeing shadows shifting within the broken crates.
unit.target: Antequam horreum desertum relinqueret, Mason ad altare improvisum retrospectavit, umbras inter cistas fractas commoventes videns.

unit.source: His heart tightened.
unit.target: Cor eius contraxit.

unit.source: Pretending he hadn’t seen anything, Mason quickly left the warehouse.
unit.target: Simulans se nihil vidisse, Mason celeriter horreum reliquit.

unit.source: In Trier, within Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, in the apartment rented by Franca and Jenna.
unit.target: Trier, intra Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, in apartamento a Franca et Jenna locato.

unit.source: Lumian saw Penitent Baynfel step out of the void and hand him a letter.
unit.target: Lumian vidit Penitentem Baynfel ex vacuitate exeundi et ei epistulam tradentem.

unit.source: He didn’t even open it, knowing it contained only blank paper.
unit.target: Ne aperuit quidem, sciens eam tantum chartam inane continere.

unit.source: He asked his messenger, “Can you deliver a reply to the sender?”
unit.target: Nuntio suo rogavit: "Potesne mittenti responsum tradere?"

unit.source: “I can,” Penitent Baynfel answered in a low voice.
unit.target: "Possum," respondit Penitent Baynfel voce humilis.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and pointed to himself.
unit.target: Lumian subridens sibi ipsi demonstravit.

unit.source: “Lam the reply.”
unit.target: "Mitte responsum."

unit.source: In the foggy Banamo Port, Lumian leaned against the outer wall of the abandoned warehouse, watching the sender walk out with a fearful expression and quickly leave.
unit.target: In Portu Banamo nebuloso, Lumian contra parietem exterior horrei deserti innixus, mittentem spectabat, qui vultu timido egressus celeriter discessit.

unit.source: He smiled, took a golden straw hat from the Traveler’s Backpack, looked at it for a moment, and put it back.
unit.target: Subridens, pileum straminis aureum e saccis Viatoris extraxit, breviter aspiciens, et iterum recondidit.

unit.source: Having the famous adventurer Louis Berry appear here would arouse unnecessary suspicion and might cause Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine to change his destination and avoid Banamo Port.
unit.target: Fama adventoris celebri Louis Berry hic appareat, suspicionem inutilem excitaret, et Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine facere posset ut destinationem mutaret atque Portum Banamo vitaret.

unit.source: Lumian straightened up, tightened his thick jacket, and walked slowly along the streets of Banamo Port, his hands in his pockets.
unit.target: Lumian se rectificavit, tunicam crassam arcte flexit et lente per vias Portus Banamo ambulavit, manibus in sinibus.

unit.source: He planned to take a look around before returning to fetch Franca and the others.
unit.target: Constituit ut circumplicaret antequam Francam et ceteros colligeret.

unit.source: Trier, late at night.
unit.target: Trier, sero nocte.

unit.source: Angoulême arrived at the agreed-upon empty house to retrieve emergency contact information from Hidden Blade.
unit.target: Angoulême ad domum vacuam convenitam pervenit ut informationes subitas a Hidden Blade extraherent.

unit.source: He quickly found the note and read its contents: “In case of emergency, summon my friend’s messenger: “Rabbit-shaped spirit that wanders about the unfounded, a runner who pursues knowledge, a messenger that belongs solely to the Seven of Cups.”
unit.target: Celeriter notam invenit et eius contenta legit: "In casu emergentiae, evoca nuntium amici mei: 'Spiritum leporiformem, qui sine fundamento vagatur, cursor qui scientiam insequitur, nuntium qui solum Septem Poculorum competit.'"

unit.source: Seven of Cups… From the Tarot Club? Hidden Blade, your friend is you, right? Angoulême muttered to himself.
unit.target: "Septem Pocula... Ex Tarot Clubo? Hidden Blade, amicus tuus es, nonne?" Angoulême sibi submurmuravit.

unit.source: He felt he understood why Hidden Blade always had so many troublesome matters.
unit.target: Sensit se intellexisse cur Hidden Blade semper tot quaestiones molestissimas haberet.

unit.source: 779 Pirate Haven
unit.target: 779 Piratarum Portus

unit.source: 779 Pirate Haven
unit.target: 779 Piratarum Portus

unit.source: Banamo Port.
unit.target: Portus Banamo.

unit.source: As Lumian strolled along the streets, he couldn’t shake the feeling that he had arrived in Backlund, the capital of the Loen Kingdom.
unit.target: Dum Lumian per vias vagabatur, sensum vix removit se advenisse in Backlund, caput regni Loen.

unit.source: Although he had never been there, the foggy sky and damp, cold environment mirrored Trier’s newspapers and magazines’ mockery of Backlund.
unit.target: Quamquam numquam ibi fuerat, caelum nebulosum atque ambitus humidus ac frigidus repraesentabant derisionem Backlund, qualem diurnaria et ephemerides Trierenses ostenderunt.

unit.source: Of course, the architectural style here was distinctly different from Backlund’s.
unit.target: Scilicet, stilus architectonicus hic clare differens erat ab illo Backlund.

unit.source: There were two main types: one was large yet not crude, with typical Feysac characteristics, and the other was a mix of stone and wood, simple and rough, often crowded together without any clear planning.
unit.target: Duo genera praecipua erant: unum, magnum sed non rudis, notis propriis Feysac, et alterum, mixtio lapidis atque ligni, simplex ac asper, quæ saepe sine apparente consilio coniungebatur.

unit.source: Most of the people on the streets were dressed like typical pirates, with short knives strapped to their waists and guns tucked into their belts, not bothering to conceal their weapons.
unit.target: Plurimi homines in viis, ut piratae consueti, induti erant, cum cultrellis brevis ad lumbos alligatis atque tormentis in cingulis reconditis, qui arma celare non curabant.

unit.source: In contrast, the locals with dark-brown skin always wore smiles, their faces full of deference.
unit.target: Contra, incolae cum cute fusca constanter subridens erant, vultus reverentia impleti.

unit.source: Lumian fully understood the mindset of the natives.
unit.target: Lumian rationem incolarum plene intellexit.

unit.source: After all, angering a pirate could result in being dragged into a corner and killed, or having someone sneak into their home at night to murder them.
unit.target: Nam, si aliquem piratam irasceres, id efficere poterat ut in angulum traheretur atque interficeretur, aut ut quis in nocte in domum eorum insidiareretur ad caedem.

unit.source: The killer would then sail away on their pirate ship without a care.
unit.target: Interfector postea in sua nave piratica navigabat, nec curas habens.

unit.source: The current rulers of Banamo Island were trying to recruit pirates and adventurers to maintain order and hoped the great pirates would agree on a pirate code to regulate behavior in the port.
unit.target: Rectores actuales insulae Banamo conabantur piratas et viatores ad ordinem conservandum congregare, atque sperabant magnos piratas consensuros esse in codice piratico qui mores in portu regeret.

unit.source: However, these measures had limited effectiveness.
unit.target: Attamen hae mensurae efficacitatem limitatam habebant.

unit.source: This was because seasoned pirates couldn’t suddenly start obeying laws and strict rules, even if they became sheriffs or police officers.
unit.target: Id est, piratae periti repente legibus et normis severis obtemperare non poterant, etiam si praefecti vel custodes facti essent.

unit.source: Moreover, there wasn’t a strong enough force on the island to keep them in check.
unit.target: Porro, non exstabat vis satis valida in insula ad eos continendos.

unit.source: As a result, it was common for sheriffs to break the law and accept bribes to shield criminals.
unit.target: Ex hoc erat commune ut praefecti leges transgrederentur et munera acciperent ad scelestes defendendos.

unit.source: The pirate code, agreed upon by the great pirates, wasn’t mandatory.
unit.target: Codex piraticus, ab ingentibus piratis conveniens, non obligatorius erat.

unit.source: Even if someone broke it, they would only face minor punishment within their own crew.
unit.target: Etiam si quis codicem fregisset, tantum minimum poenam intra propriam turmam affligeret.

unit.source: No one would hand over their own men to be dealt with by others.
unit.target: Nemo proprios suos tradiret ut ab aliis punirentur.

unit.source: These measures’ greatest effect was making Banamo Port appear somewhat orderly.
unit.target: Earum mensurarum potentissimum effectus erat ut Portus Banamo aliquatenus ordinatus videbatur.

unit.source: As Lumian admired the bustling street scenes, he occasionally heard screams or gunshots from the alleys.
unit.target: Dum Lumian plateas animatas admirabatur, interdum clamores aut ictus sclopetorum ex angustiis audiebat.

unit.source: This place is perfect for a Hunter, he thought, genuinely appreciating it.
unit.target: Hic locus perfectus est pro Venatore, existimavit, vere eum laudans.

unit.source: When two groups of pirates started a brawl in the middle of the street, Lumian had a sudden idea: A large-scale plague for a Demoness of Despair advancement ritual could work here…
unit.target: Duo coetus piratorum in media platea pugnam incipientes, Lumian subito ideam cepit: pestilentia in scala magna ad ritum progressionis Demonissae Desperationis hic efficax esse posset…

unit.source: But I would need to develop medicine to prevent infection or severe illness and secretly distribute it to the locals…
unit.target: Sed medicinam conficiendam mihi erit, ut infectionem vel grave morbum prohibeas, atque eam incolis occulto modo distribuam…

unit.source: The only problem is that there aren’t 30,000 pirates here.
unit.target: Solum problema est, hic non esse triginta milia piratorum.

unit.source: However, there are quite a few Beyonders among them.
unit.target: Attamen inter eos nonnulli Beyonders sunt.

unit.source: Infecting them and causing them suffering and despair should significantly reduce the number needed for the ritual…
unit.target: Eos inficiendo atque cruciando cum desperatione, numerum ad ritum requisitum significativo modo minuere debet…

unit.source: As Lumian watched the pirate brawl with interest, he pondered the feasibility of holding the Demoness of Despair ritual in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Dum Lumian pugnam piraticam cum curiositate spectabat, de possibilitate ritus Demonissae Desperationis in Portu Banamo celebrandi meditabatur.

unit.source: When the fight was almost over, the sheriffs finally arrived, dispersing the two groups and symbolically arresting a few people.
unit.target: Cum pugna paene finita esset, praefecti tandem advenerunt, duo coetus dissipantes et paucos homines symbolice arripientes.

unit.source: They were just waiting for the respective pirate crews to pay the fines!
unit.target: Tantum exspectabant ut singuli coetus piratorum multa solverent!

unit.source: As for the grievances between the two groups, the sheriffs didn’t care.
unit.target: Quod attinet ad querimonias inter hos duo coetus, custodes nihil curabant.

unit.source: If they wanted revenge, they would have to settle it out at sea.
unit.target: Si vindictam optabant, eam in mari componere necesse habebant.

unit.source: Meanwhile, adventurers and locals quietly dragged away some of the pirate corpses left on the street.
unit.target: Interim, viatores et incolae tacite aliquot cadavera piratorum via relicta abstulerunt.

unit.source: Lumian felt like applauding this kind of order.
unit.target: Lumian huic ordini plausum dare vellet.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the remaining daylight and the sun filtering through the fog, he continued his leisurely stroll through Banamo Port.
unit.target: Ut luce residua et sole per nebulam transfigurante uti posset, iter leviter per Portum Banamo continuavit.

unit.source: Passing a stone house with a small square, he saw a dozen or so people gathered, mostly locals.
unit.target: Transiens domum lapideam cum parvo atrio, vidit circiter duodecim homines congregatos, plerumque incolas.

unit.source: A pirate wearing a bicorne hat and blue woolen clothes stood on a stone platform in front of them.
unit.target: Pirata, galea bicornata gerens et vestimenta lanae caeruleae indutus, in suggestu lapideo coram illis stetit.

unit.source: The pirate was shouting in Feysac, “You’re just a bunch of pups fresh from your mother’s embrace.
unit.target: Pirata Feysace clamabat: “Vos estis tantum catuli recens ex amplexu matris.

unit.source: If you want to become proper pirates, you need training.
unit.target: Si vultis piratae veraces fieri, exercitatione opus est vobis.

unit.source: Today, I’ll give you your first lesson: who you can and can’t mess with at sea…
unit.target: Hodie, primam lectionem vobis dabo: de his, quibus in mari agere licet et quibus non…

unit.source: Feysac was the language with the least difference from ancient Feysac.
unit.target: Lingua Feysac erat, quae parum ab antiquo Feysac differre videbatur.

unit.source: Lumian, skilled in ancient Feysac, barely understood what the pirate was saying.
unit.target: Lumian, in antiquo Feysac peritus, vix intellexit quid pirata dicebat.

unit.source: He realized that the pirate crew was recruiting newcomers and providing basic training.
unit.target: Animadvertit coetum piratarum novos recrutarentur atque disciplinam primariam praebere.

unit.source: Why does this feel like a big company in Trier hiring new employees…
unit.target: Cur hoc videtur quasi magna societas Trierensis novas operarias conducere…

unit.source: Lumian grumbled to himself as he watched the pirate display wanted posters and portraits, introducing the six kings, nine admirals, and notable adventurers.
unit.target: Lumian sibi murmuravit dum spectabat piratas tabulas quaesitas et imagines ostendentes, inter quos sex reges, novem admirales atque notos viatores introducere videbantur.

unit.source: This was exactly the information Lumian needed.
unit.target: Hoc erat prorsus informatio quam Lumian desiderabat.

unit.source: He stopped and listened from a distance.
unit.target: Consedit et a longe audivit.

unit.source: As expected, he saw a portrait and detailed introduction of Louis Berry.
unit.target: Ut expectabatur, imaginem atque enarrationem de Ludovico Berry perspexit.

unit.source: At the end, the pirate with the bicorne hat pointed to a portrait and said, “His bounty isn’t high, but you must never underestimate him, or even have any contact with him.”
unit.target: Ad finem, pirata galea bicornata gerens ad imaginem monstravit et dixit: “Praemium eius non magnum est, sed numquam debetis eum subestimare, neque ullam transactionem cum eo habere.”

unit.source: No contact at all?
unit.target: Nullum commercium omnino?

unit.source: Lumian focused on the portrait, seeing a burly man in his thirties with thick brown body hair, wearing suspenders and a white shirt.
unit.target: Lumian imaginem contemplatus est, videns virum robustum, circa tricesimum annos natus, densis pilis fuscae corporis, sustentamenta gerens atque tunicam albanam indutum.

unit.source: The pirate’s tone became serious as he introduced the man to the new pirates, “His name is Frank Lee, the first mate of the Queen of Stars.
unit.target: Tonus piratae serio factus est, dum virum novis piratis introducere inceperet, “Nomen eius est Frank Lee, primus minister navis Reginae Stellarum.

unit.source: He's a Druid.
unit.target: Druidus est.

unit.source: What is a Druid?
unit.target: Quid est druida?

unit.source: I’ll explain when we cover Beyonder knowledge.
unit.target: Explicabo, cum de cognitione Beyonder agemus.

unit.source: For now, just know that a Druid is Sequence 5, on par with the Pirate Admirals.
unit.target: Modo scito, druida est Series V, pariter cum Admiralibus Piraticis.

unit.source: So, understand how terrifying Frank Lee is?
unit.target: Ergo, intellegite quam terribilis sit Frank Lee?

unit.source: But that's not the main reason adventurers and pirates fear him.
unit.target: Sed hoc non est principale quod viatores et piratae eum timent.

unit.source: I don't know the exact reason either.
unit.target: Nec ego certam causam scio.

unit.source: I only know that every pirate and adventurer who’s encountered Frank Lee acts like they’ve gone mad.
unit.target: Scio tantum quod omnis pirata atque viator, qui Frank Lee occurrit, agitur quasi insaniti affectus sit.

unit.source: They jump out of their chairs and sometimes vomit when his name is mentioned.
unit.target: Ex sellis desilire et interdum vomere incipiunt, cum nomen eius dicitur.

unit.source: They always warn me to stay away from Frank Lee and not to leave any blood near him or eat anything found around him…
unit.target: Semper me admonent ut a Frank Lee recedam, neque sanguinem prope eum relinquam aut quidquid circa eum reperitur edam…

unit.source: So, the legendary Druid Frank Lee is the first mate of the Pirate King…
unit.target: Ita, legendarius druida Frank Lee est primus minister regis piratarum…

unit.source: But why are so many pirates and adventurers so terrified of him?
unit.target: At cur tot piratae et viatores eum ita territi sint?

unit.source: Even if he has the strength of a Pirate Admiral and is ruthless, it shouldn’t cause this reaction…
unit.target: Etiamsi roboris Admiralis Piratici et crudelitatis ei haberet, haec responsio non oriri debet…

unit.source: Lumian silently mused as he listened to the pirate’s introduction.
unit.target: Lumian tacite cogitabat, dum piratae introductionem audiebat.

unit.source: He was curious about what made Frank Lee so special.
unit.target: Curiosus erat quid specialem faceret Frank Lee.

unit.source: After watching the pirate crew’s recruitment, Lumian headed to the nearby Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Postquam coetum piratarum novos recrutarentur vidit, Lumian ad tabernam “Carnival Bar” proximam se contulit.

unit.source: He pushed through the unapologetically pirate crowd and sat on a high stool at the bar, ordering a Lanti Proof.
unit.target: Per turbas piratarum impune institorum propulsus, in subsello alto ad tabernam sedit et iussit “Lanti Proof.”

unit.source: The common language in Banamo Port was Feysac, but pirates spoke various languages, and few were multilingual.
unit.target: Lingua communis in Portu Banamo erat Feysac, sed piratae varias linguas loquebantur, et parvi erant qui plures linguis utebantur.

unit.source: Those who spoke Feysac formed one circle, those who spoke Intisian another, and so on.
unit.target: Qui Feysac loquebantur, circulum unum formabant; qui Intisian, alium; et cetera.

unit.source: Lumian chose the Carnival Bar because all its signage was in Intisian.
unit.target: Lumian “Carnival Bar” eligere curavit, quod omnia insignia eius in Intisian posita erant.

unit.source: In the noisy, lively environment, Lumian took two sips of his drink, put down his glass, and asked the bartender loudly in Intisian, “Do you have detailed information on the nine Pirate Admirals?”
unit.target: In tumultuoso et vivo ambitu, Lumian duo sorbos poculi suae cepit, vitrum deponens, et tabernario voce alta in Intisian rogavit: “Habesne informationem accuratam de novem Admiralibus Piraticis?”

unit.source: Something beyond the wanted posters.
unit.target: Aliquid ultra tabulas quaesitas.

unit.source: Suddenly, the entire bar went silent.
unit.target: Subito, tota taberna silentio cecidit.

unit.source: Every pirate turned to look at Lumian at the bar.
unit.target: Omnis pirata in taberna ad Lumian se convertere coepit.

unit.source: It became so quiet that the sound of someone swallowing could be heard.
unit.target: Ita silentium fuit ut sonus aliquis deglutitionis audiri posset.

unit.source: The bartender’s expression turned awkward and amused.
unit.target: Vultus tabernarii incommodus ac hilaris factus est.

unit.source: He asked Lumian, “Are you an adventurer?”
unit.target: Rogavit Lumian: “Esne viator?”

unit.source: An adventurer coming to a pirate bar to ask for detailed information on the Pirate Admirals!
unit.target: Viator ad tabernam piraticam accessurus est ut informationem accuratam de Admiralibus Piraticis peteret!

unit.source: Lumian didn’t answer the bartender.
unit.target: Lumian tabernario nihil respondit.

unit.source: He half-turned to look at the staring pirates.
unit.target: Lumian semiconversus ad piratas qui eum intuebantur aspiciebat.

unit.source: Around him, one by one, crimson-white fireballs began to form and float in the air.
unit.target: Circa eum, uno post alium, globuli ignis rubro-albo formari atque in aere fluitare coeperunt.

unit.source: Lumian smiled, raising his chin slightly.
unit.target: Lumian subridens leviter mentum suum extulit.

unit.source: “Even though your bounties are low and I don’t want to bother, if anyone wants to give me money voluntarily, I won’t mind accepting it.”
unit.target: “Etiamsi praemia vestra parva sunt et nolo vos sollicitare, si quis mihi libere pecuniam dare velit, eam accipere non negabo.”

unit.source: The pirates’ expressions changed, but Lumian’s gaze remained steady.
unit.target: Vultus piratorum mutati sunt, sed aspectus Lumiani stabilis manebat.

unit.source: He scanned their faces and sneered.
unit.target: Eorum vultus perlegens, irridere constituit.

unit.source: “Anyone want to try?”
unit.target: “Num quis conari velit?”

unit.source: Silence.
unit.target: Silentium.

unit.source: The entire Carnival Bar remained silent.
unit.target: Tota “Carnival Bar” silentium retinuit.

unit.source: Everyone could feel the danger in those crimson-white fireballs.
unit.target: Omnes periculum in illis globulis ignis rubro-albo sentire poterant.

unit.source: Lumian stopped provoking them, pointing to a chair a few meters behind him.
unit.target: Lumian eos provocare desiit, et ad sellam paucos passus post se indicavit.

unit.source: “Don’t appear behind me.
unit.target: “Noli apparere post me.

unit.source: “Don’t think about using the crowd to get close and assassinate me.
unit.target: Ne cogites turmam ad propinquandum et ad me caedendum adhibere.

unit.source: “If anyone crosses that chair, I’ll kill them.”
unit.target: Si quis illam sellam transgressus fuerit, eos occidam.

unit.source: After speaking, Lumian turned back, smiling at the bartender amid the fireballs.
unit.target: Post locutum, Lumian se convertit retrorsum, inter globulos ignis tabernario subridente.

unit.source: “Now, you can answer my question.”
unit.target: “Nunc, quaestionem meam responde.”

unit.source: Seeing this adventurer not introduce himself or boast about his exploits, but show absolute confidence and a nonchalant attitude toward killing, the bartender forced a smile.
unit.target: Videns hunc viatorem, qui neque se introducere neque de suis factis gloriari conabatur, sed absolutam confidentiam ac indifferens modum ad caedem ostendere videbatur, tabernarius subridente respondit.

unit.source: “We know about the same as the wanted posters.
unit.target: “Scimus idem, quod tabulae quaesitae ostendunt.

unit.source: If you want more hidden details, ask the enemies of the Pirate Admirals.
unit.target: Si plura occulta velis, hostes Admiralium Piraticorum interroga.

unit.source: Emperor Roselle once said the person who knows you best is your enemy.”
unit.target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: “Qui te optime novit, hostis tuus est.”

unit.source: “Tell me about each Pirate Admiral’s enemies,” Lumian said, taking another sip of his Lanti Proof.
unit.target: “Dic mihi de inimicis singulorum Admiralium Piraticorum,” inquit Lumian, iterum ex Lanti Proof sorbos cepens.

unit.source: In the bar, the pirates resumed their conversations, while some quietly left, seemingly to find help upon seeing the adventurer easily maintain the fireballs.
unit.target: In taberna piratae colloquia sua renovaverunt, dum nonnulli tacite abiissent, quasi auxilium petere inciti, cum viatorem globulos ignis facile retinere videbantur.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t stop them or even look their way.
unit.target: Lumian eos non prohibuit nec ad eos spectare attendit.

unit.source: When the bartender finished, Lumian had a general understanding of who Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine’s enemies were.
unit.target: Cum tabernarius finem pervenisset, Lumian generalem intelligentiam de inimicis Admiralis Deep Sea Howl Constantine habebat.

unit.source: This Pirate Admiral with sea monster blood was usually low-key and mysterious.
unit.target: Hic Admiralis Piraticus, qui sanguinem monstri marini haberet, solet esse humilis et arcanus.

unit.source: Besides doing pirate work in a bloody and brutal manner, he rarely clashed with other Pirate Admirals or major forces.
unit.target: Praeterquam operam piraticam cruento et crudeli modo peragendo, raro cum aliis Admiralibus Piraticis vel viribus maximis pugnavit.

unit.source: However, the former Vice Admiral Dusk, now the King of Dusk, Bulatov Ivan, suspected Howl Constantine’s two "submarine ships" came from a legendary sea treasure, the Lost Newins.
unit.target: Attamen, pristinus Vice-Admiralis Dusk, nunc Rex Dusk, Bulatov Ivan, suspicabatur duas “naves subaquaneas” Howl Constantine ex thesauro marino legendaro, “Newins Perditis,” ortas esse.

unit.source: He targeted Admiral Deep Sea, seeking information on the Newins, leading to multiple conflicts.
unit.target: Ipse Admiralem Deep Sea petivit, quaerens de Newins notitiam, quod multos conflictus attulit.

unit.source: When Bulatov became a king over the seas, Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine had no choice but to avoid this powerhouse and his fleet.
unit.target: Cum Bulatov rex super maria factus esset, Admiralis Deep Sea Howl Constantine nullo alio modo nisi hanc potentiam ac classem eius vitare oportuit.

unit.source: 780 Primary Job
unit.target: 780 Munus Principale

unit.source: 780 Primary Job
unit.target: 780 Munus Principale

unit.source: Lumian listened to the bartender recount the rivalries and grudges of the Pirate Admirals while the pirates behind him grew increasingly restless.
unit.target: Lumian auscultavit tabernarium, qui certamina atque rancores Admiralium Piratarum enarrabat, dum piratae post eum paulatim inquietiores fiebant.

unit.source: They were all hoping someone would make the first move, either by shooting or stabbing the arrogant adventurer, so they could all rush him at once.
unit.target: Omnes sperabant aliquem primum agere, sive telum iaciendo sive cultrum inferendo superbum adventorem, ut omnes simul in eum impetum facerent.

unit.source: But the threat of those crimson‐white fireballs deterred them.
unit.target: At minas illorum globorum ignium rubro‐alborum eos deterruerunt.

unit.source: They looked at each other, but no one dared cross the chair Lumian had designated.
unit.target: Invicem spectabant, sed nemo ausus est transire sellam quam Lumian destinaverat.

unit.source: They figured anyone this brazen had to be pretty strong, and the Carnival Bar was low‐tier, with no high‐profile pirates around.
unit.target: Rati erant quemquam tam audacem esse debere validum, et taberna Carnivalis erat humilis, sine piratis claris circumstantibus.

unit.source: They could only hope those who had left would return with someone more formidable.
unit.target: Sperabant tantum eos qui discesserant redire cum aliquo formidabiliore.

unit.source: After about ten minutes, one of the pirates who had left pushed open the heavy wooden door.
unit.target: Post circiter decem minutas, unus e piratis qui discesserant, ostium grave ligneum aperuit.

unit.source: Behind him was a middle‐aged man wearing a tricorne hat and dressed in dark blue.
unit.target: Post eum erat vir aetate mediocris, galeam tricorna indutus et in veste caerulea obscura gerens.

unit.source: The pirates in the bar immediately straightened up, holding their breath.
unit.target: Piratae in taberna statim se recti sunt, spiritum retinentes.

unit.source: The noisy, lively atmosphere quickly returned to silence.
unit.target: Strepitus atque animus vivus celeriter in silentium redierunt.

unit.source: Some of them recognized the man, knowing him as Captain Flying Hadmagk of the Rosemary, a well‐known pirate just below the Pirate Admirals, active on the Five Seas for over a decade.
unit.target: Alii virum agnoverunt, scientes eum esse Capitaneum Flying Hadmagk de Rosemary, piratam notum paulo infra Admirales Piratarum, qui per quinque maria per plus quam decem annos active operabatur.

unit.source: The pirate who opened the door flashed a flattering smile and pointed at Lumian’s back.
unit.target: Pirata, qui ostium aperuit, risum adflatum praebuit et digitum in dorsum Lumiani demonstravit.

unit.source: “Captain, that’s the adventurer I mentioned!
unit.target: “Capitane, hic est adventor quem memoravi!

unit.source: He dared to provoke all the pirates in Banamo Port!”
unit.target: Auso est omnes piratas Portus Banamo provocare!

unit.source: Hadmagk, with his thick, dark hair and imposing presence, stared at Lumian’s back for a few seconds.
unit.target: Hadmagk, cum capillis densis atque obscuris et praesentiā imponente, per paucos secundos in dorsum Lumiani aspexit.
