unit.source: He paused before asking, “How long has he been maintaining those fireballs?”
unit.target: Intermissit antequam rogaverit: “Quamdiu illa globula ignium servat?”

unit.source: “I don’t know.
unit.target: “Nescio.

unit.source: They were there when I left the bar, but he might not have kept them up the whole time,” the pirate replied.
unit.target: Illa erant ibi, cum tabernam relicissem, sed fortasse totum tempus non servavit, respondit pirata.

unit.source: He grabbed a young pirate sitting by the door, pointing at Lumian and growling, “How long has he been keeping those fireballs up?”
unit.target: Rapuit iuvenem piratam, qui prope ostium sedebat, et digitum in Lumianum demonstrans rugiens, “Quamdiu illa globula ignium servat?”

unit.source: The young pirate, a bit flustered, glanced at the old clock on the wall and stammered, “Almost… almost fifteen minutes.”
unit.target: Iuvenis pirata, paulum turbatus, ad vetus horologium in pariete aspexit et titubans dixit: “Fere… fere quindecim minuta.”

unit.source: Fifteen minutes?
unit.target: Quindecim minuta?

unit.source: Flying Hadmagk’s eyelid twitched, and he suddenly looked like he remembered something important.
unit.target: Palpebra eius convulsit, et subito videbatur aliquid magni momenti meminisse.

unit.source: He immediately cursed at his sailor, “Did you forget about our important deal at the docks?
unit.target: Statim nautam maledixit: “Oblitus es nostri magni momenti pacti ad molas?

unit.source: Bastard, is your brain filled with nothing but booze, women, and pride?”
unit.target: Bastarde, an cerebrum tuum nihil nisi potione, mulieribus atque superbia impletum sit?

unit.source: Cursing, Flying Haddock turned and walked out of the Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Maledicens, Flying Haddock conversus est et ex Taberna Carnivalis egrediebatur.

unit.source: His sailor, though dumbfounded, instinctively followed him.
unit.target: Nauta eius, quamquam attonitus, instanter eum secutus est.

unit.source: The captain is always right!
unit.target: Capitane semper rectus est!

unit.source: The Carnival Bar remained quiet as Lumian finished his Lanti Proof and stood up.
unit.target: Taberna Carnivalis silentium servavit, dum Lumian Lanti Proof perfecit et surrexit.

unit.source: With those crimson‐white fireballs still floating around him, he swept his gaze over the pirates once more.
unit.target: Cum illis globulis ignium rubro‐albis adhuc circa eum volitantibus, circumspexit piratas.

unit.source: Then he smiled, raised his right hand, brought his index and middle fingers to his lips, and blew softly.
unit.target: Deinde risit, manum dexteram levavit, digitos index et medios ad labia sua adduxit, atque leniter sufflavit.

unit.source: It was like he was blowing away the smoke from a gun after shooting everyone in the bar.
unit.target: Erat quasi, fumo sclopeti, post omnes in taberna iaculatos evellere conaretur.

unit.source: As the pirates’ eyes and expressions shifted, Lumian leisurely walked towards the door with his hands in his pockets.
unit.target: Dum oculi et vultus piratarum mutabantur, Lumian lente ad ostium ambulavit, manibus in sinu suis positis.

unit.source: One by one, the pirates instinctively moved out of his way.
unit.target: Uno post alium, piratae instinctive se a via eius removerunt.

unit.source: Some felt aggrieved, some ground their teeth, and others consoled themselves with thoughts like, It’s not fear; those fireballs are just too blinding!
unit.target: Alii se offensos sentirent, alii dentes stringebant, et alii cogitationibus consolabantur: “Non timor; illa globula ignium nimis caecantia sunt!”

unit.source: Lumian seemed utterly unafraid of being ambushed as he walked out of the Carnival Bar, almost like he was receiving their admiration and welcome.
unit.target: Lumian videbatur omnino non timuisse insidiari, dum ex Taberna Carnivalis egrederetur, quasi eorum admirationem et beneficentiam acciperet.

unit.source: Late at night, in an inconspicuous hotel room in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Sero nocte, in cubiculo parvo in hospitio Portus Banamo.

unit.source: Leaning back in his chair, Lumian said to Franca, “Disguise yourself and spread the word that an unknown adventurer has been provoking all the pirates, claiming they’re cowards with no real strength, and that he could crush any pirate’s head under his boot.”
unit.target: Recumbens in sella sua, Lumian Francae dixit: “Te tege et nuntiā, quod adventor ignotus omnes piratas provocaverit, dicens eos ignavos esse sine vera virtute, et quod caput cuiusque piratae sub calce conterere possit.”

unit.source: Franca’s mouth twitched slightly.
unit.target: Os Francae leviter tremuit.

unit.source: “Fishing again?
unit.target: “Iterum piscare?

unit.source: You’re quite the expert at this…
unit.target: Es vere peritus in hoc…

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “According to the information we’ve gathered, Admiral Deep Sea prefers to stay out of the public eye because of his sea monster bloodline.
unit.target: Secundum informationes quas collegimus, Admiralis Deep Sea mavult extra oculos publicos remanere propter stirpem monstrorum maris.

unit.source: Even if he comes to Banamo Port, he’ll likely stay on his flagship, the Newins.
unit.target: Etiam si ad Portum Banamo venerit, verisimiliter in nave sua praecipua, Newins, permaneat.

unit.source: If he wants women or food, someone will bring it to him.
unit.target: Si mulieres aut cibum velit, aliquis id ei afferet.

unit.source: “In this situation, we’ll have to risk sneaking onto the Newins.
unit.target: “In hac re, oportet nobis in Newins silentio se introducere.”

unit.source: It’s an alchemical ship from some ancient ruins, and we have no idea what traps or mechanisms it might have.
unit.target: Navis alchemica est ex quibusdam antiquis ruinis, nec scimus quae insidias aut machinationes habeat.

unit.source: Plus, there are bound to be many Beyonder pirates on board.
unit.target: Praeterea, multi piratae Beyonder in nave esse certi sunt.

unit.source: As a Hunter, we should avoid fighting on someone else’s turf.
unit.target: Ut Venatores, pugnam in territorio alieno vitare debemus.

unit.source: “I deliberately provoked the pirates in Banamo Port because I know no Pirate Admirals are here right now.
unit.target: “Consulto piratas Portus Banamo provocavi, quia scio nullos Admirales Piratarum hic esse.

unit.source: I have enough confidence to handle the other notable pirates.
unit.target: Satis fiduciae habeo ad tractandum ceteros piratas notabiles.

unit.source: They should soon figure this out too.
unit.target: Mox id quoque perspici debent.

unit.source: Expecting pirate crews to work together against me overestimates their trust in each other.
unit.target: Exspectatio ut turmae piratarum adversus me simul operentur, fidem inter se nimis auget.

unit.source: Who would they rather rob?
unit.target: Quem potius rapinare malunt?

unit.source: Jenna suddenly understood.
unit.target: Jenna subito intellexit.

unit.source: “If Admiral Deep Sea leaves the Newins and takes action himself, that would be the best outcome.
unit.target: “Si Admiralis Deep Sea Newins discedat et ipse agere incipiat, optimum erit.

unit.source: We would be fighting on our terms.
unit.target: Nos in nostro more pugnabimus.

unit.source: Even if he isn’t interested, his top men won’t miss the chance.
unit.target: Etiam si non velit, milites eius superiores occasionem non amittent.

unit.source: With Admiral Deep Sea as their backup, they won’t fear failure and will be more willing to challenge you.
unit.target: Cum Admirali Deep Sea pro subsidio, non timebunt cladem, et libenter te provocabunt.

unit.source: This will reduce the number of Beyonders on the Newins, giving us our chance.
unit.target: Hoc numerum piratorum Beyonder in Newins diminuet, nobis occasionem praebens.

unit.source: “Good psychological analysis,” Lumian teased.
unit.target: “Bona psychologica analysis,” iocatus est Lumian.

unit.source: Jenna shot him a look.
unit.target: Jenna eum aspexit.

unit.source: “A good actor needs to understand people’s minds.”
unit.target: “Bonus actor mentes hominum intellegere debet.”

unit.source: “And then perform for the ‘spectators’?” Lumian joked.
unit.target: “Et deinde pro spectatoribus agere?” inquit Lumian iocose.

unit.source: Anthony didn’t react.
unit.target: Antonius non respondit.

unit.source: Franca scoffed.
unit.target: Franca irriduit.

unit.source: “What if a Pirate King’s fleet arrives before the Newins?”
unit.target: “Quid si classem Regis Piratarum ante Newins adveniat?”

unit.source: Lumian spread his hands and said, “That’s why the adventurer is ‘unknown.
unit.target: Lumian manibus expansis dixit: “Quare adventor ignotus est.

unit.source: The benefit is that he can disappear without a trace.
unit.target: Beneficium est quod sine vestigio evanescere possit.

unit.source: Change his face and appearance, and we can execute another plan.”
unit.target: Faciem et habitu mutato, alium consilium efficere possumus.

unit.source: “A Conspirer is really an outright schemer…” Franca muttered.
unit.target: “Coniurator vere est dolosus,” murmurat Franca.

unit.source: “Alright, let’s do it.”
unit.target: “Bene, faciamus.”

unit.source: Lumian then discussed the possibility of using a large‐scale plague in Banamo Port, emphasizing the need to secretly distribute preventive medicine to the locals beforehand.
unit.target: Lumian de possibilitate magnae plagae in Portu Banamo utendi disseruit, necessitatem celate medicamenta praeventionis in indigenis distribuendi extollens.

unit.source: Franca was stunned.
unit.target: Franca attonita fuit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, she said, “You even thought of that…
unit.target: Post paucis secundis, dixit: “Etiam id cogitasti…

unit.source: How about we start a plague company?
unit.target: “Quid, si societatem pestifera condamus?

unit.source: Just kidding, there’s some plausibility in this, but in this day and age, there are no vaccines—uh, preventive medicine?”
unit.target: “Modo iocor, aliqua probabilitas in hoc est, sed in his temporibus nullae sunt vaccina—immo, medicamenta praeventionis?”

unit.source: “Normally, we wouldn’t have it, but we can turn to mysticism,” Lumian replied.
unit.target: “Normaliter, id non habemus, sed ad mysticitatem confugere possumus,” respondit Lumian.

unit.source: “The Apothecary path specializes in this.
unit.target: “Via apothecaria hoc specialiter incumbit.

unit.source: We just need to provide them with a number of infected individuals for observation, research, and experimentation.
unit.target: Nobis solum opus est eos cum aliquot infectis hominibus ad observationem, inquisitionem, et experimentum praebere.

unit.source: They should be able to create effective preventive or curative medicine.
unit.target: Illi medicamenta praeventionis vel curativa efficax efficere debent.

unit.source: We won’t have trouble finding an Apothecary.
unit.target: Non habebimus difficultatem apothecarium invenire.

unit.source: The Fool Pharmaceutical Company has plenty of them.
unit.target: The Fool Pharmaceutical Company eos in copia habet.

unit.source: Lumian knew from Miss Magician that The Fool Pharmaceutical Company had many ties to the Tarot Club.
unit.target: Lumian ex Domina Magica scivit The Fool Pharmaceutical Company multas coniunctiones cum Tarot Club habere.

unit.source: Jenna began to calculate.
unit.target: Jenna coepit computare.

unit.source: “A medicine with mystical effects would cost at least 100 verl d’or per bottle.
unit.target: “Medicamentum cum effectibus mysticis saltem centum verl d’or pro lagena constabit.

unit.source: There are probably over ten thousand non‐pirate residents in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Verisimiliter plus quam decem milia incolarum non piratarum in Portu Banamo sunt.

unit.source: We’d need to prepare at least a million verl d’or.
unit.target: Saltem unum milionem verl d’or praeparare oportet.

unit.source: We can’t expect the Apothecaries from The Fool Pharmaceutical Company to work for free or cover the material costs.
unit.target: Exspectare non possumus Apothecarios The Fool Pharmaceutical Company gratis operari aut expensas materiales solvere.

unit.source: One million verl d’or wasn’t a small sum.
unit.target: Unum milionem verl d’or non erat parva summa.

unit.source: Even a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic only cost around 200,000 verl d’or.
unit.target: Etiam proprietas Sequence 5 Beyonder circiter ducenta milia verl d’or tantum constabat.

unit.source: “A million verl d’or to become a demigod is a good deal,” Lumian suddenly laughed.
unit.target: “Unum milionem verl d’or ad semideum fieri bonum pretium est,” subitamente risit Lumian.

unit.source: “A million verl d’or is just an Admiral Deep Sea.
unit.target: “Unum milionem verl d’or tantum est ut Admiralis Deep Sea.

unit.source: Even if we can’t kill him, his top men are valuable too.”
unit.target: Etiam si eum occidere non possimus, milites eius superiores quoque pretiosi sunt.

unit.source: Franca sighed and replied, “You’re starting to sound a bit like Gehrman Sparrow.
unit.target: Franca suspiravit et respondit: “Tu paulo similis Gehrman Sparrow sonare incipis.

unit.source: But while Gehrman Sparrow treated pirates as his piggy bank, only targeting high‐bounty ones, you’re aiming to eradicate them completely!”
unit.target: At dum Gehrman Sparrow piratas tamquam arcam pecuniae suas tractabat, petens solum eos qui magna praemia haberent, tu eos omnino exterminare intendis!

unit.source: A plague like that would likely affect thousands, if not tens of thousands, of pirates.
unit.target: Plaga talis verisimiliter milia, si non decem milia, piratarum afficiet.

unit.source: Before Lumian could respond, Franca self‐mockingly laughed.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian responderet, Franca se ipsam irridens risit.

unit.source: “Poor Admiral Deep Sea. Just sitting on his flagship, doing nothing, and suddenly he’s our target.”
unit.target: “Pauper Admiralis Deep Sea, iusto in nave sua praecipua sedens, nihil faciens, et subito meta nostra factus est!”

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, and said with some realization, “Nothing to pity. A Hunter’s job is to create chaos and strife.
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Nil est miserandum; munus Venatoris est chaos et discordiam creare.

unit.source: And your primary job as a Demoness is to bring catastrophe and affliction.
unit.target: Et tuum munus principale ut Demonissa est calamitatem et afflictionem adferre.

unit.source: It’s better to inflict these on pirates than innocent people.”
unit.target: Melius est haec piratis quam in innocentes inferre.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna fell silent for a moment.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna paulisper silent.

unit.source: Achoo!
unit.target: Eruco!

unit.source: Banamo Port, Mason, sitting at the docks with a bottle of rye beer, suddenly sneezed.
unit.target: Mason, in Portu Banamo, sedens ad molas cum lagena cervisiae secalis, subito sternutavit.

unit.source: He immediately thought of the messenger summoning ritual he had completed that afternoon and the unsettling messenger it had summoned, muttering to himself, “Could that sneeze be some kind of spirituality warning?
unit.target: Statim recordatus est ritu nuntiandi, quem illo postmeridiano perfecerat, et de incommodo nuntio, quem evocatam habuerat, murmurans sibi: “Num haec sternutatio aliqua spiritualis monitione sit?

unit.source: “Am I really going to be the protagonist of some occult event, the fool who makes a mistake and attracts an evil god or devil?
unit.target: “Num vere ego futurus sim protagonistā alicuius occultī eventus, stultus qui errorem facit et deum malum aut daemonem attrahit?

unit.source: “Did the ritual I performed bring some kind of catastrophe to Banamo Port?
unit.target: “Num ritus quem perfeci aliquam calamitatem in Portum Banamo attulit?

unit.source: “Have hidden dangers and problems started quietly spreading in the shadows?”
unit.target: “Num pericula abscondita et quaestiones latentia in umbris quiete diffunduntur?”

unit.source: Gulping down a large swig of beer, Mason tried to reassure himself that he was just scaring himself.
unit.target: Magno sorbendo cervisiam, Mason se consolari conatus est, existimans se solum se ipsum terruisse.

unit.source: From afternoon until now, there had been no signs of calamity or reports of strange phenomena!
unit.target: A postmeridie usque ad nunc nullae erant notas calamitatis nec relationes de phaenomenis insolitis!

unit.source: It was just a messenger summoning. It should be fine!
unit.target: Erant tantum nuntii evocatio. Bene erit!

unit.source: 781 Individual Missions
unit.target: 781 Missiones Individuae

unit.source: 781 Individual Missions
unit.target: 781 Missiones Individuae

unit.source: Two days later, at a quiet spot on the docks of Banamo Port.
unit.target: Post duas dies, in loco quieto in ripa Portus Banamo.

unit.source: Jenna, dressed in a black outfit that looked like a cross between a dress and a robe, gazed out over the blue ocean shrouded in a thin fog.
unit.target: Jenna, induta habitu nigro, qui quasi inter vestem et togam appareret, intuita est super oceanum caeruleum, tenuā nebulā circumfusum.

unit.source: Her task was to monitor the docks and be the first to spot Admiral Deep Sea’s flagship, the Newins.
unit.target: Eius munus erat vigilare ripam Portus Banamo et primum deprehendere navem praecipuam Admiralium Profundi Maris, Newins.

unit.source: Of course, this was just one of her responsibilities.
unit.target: Scilicet, hoc solum erat unum ex oneribus eius.

unit.source: The most critical part was to ensure no Pirate King’s fleet arrived at Banamo Port before the Newins.
unit.target: Pars maximi momenti erat cavere ne classis regis piratorum ad Portum Banamo ante Newins perveniret.

unit.source: If that happened, she had to quickly inform Lumian so the unknown adventurer could disappear.
unit.target: Si hoc eveniret, celeriter Lumiano certiorem facere debebat ut ignotus adventor evanescere posset.

unit.source: Jenna paced back and forth or found a spot to sit, patiently waiting for her target.
unit.target: Jenna circumambulabat aut locum sedendi inveniebat, patienter scopus suus exspectans.

unit.source: Suddenly, she saw a colossal shape break the surface of the water, emerging from the depths.
unit.target: Subito, vidit ingentem formam superficiem aquae rumpentem, ex profundis emergentem.

unit.source: The massive object was jet black and metallic, with seawater cascading off its surface.
unit.target: Res ingens erat nigerrima et metallina, cum undae maris ex eius superficie labentes.

unit.source: It resembled an elongated, inflated spindle with a thin, curved metal tube extending from its top like a snail’s eye stalk.
unit.target: Illud simile erat fusiformi, inflato, cum tenuo tubo metallico curvato, quod ex sua parte superiore protrahitur, velut pedunculus oculi cochleae.

unit.source: In the next moment, the metal tube retracted, and the upper half of the behemoth split open, unfolding outward to reveal a broad deck, numerous cannons, and hundreds of pirates.
unit.target: In momento sequenti, tubus metallicus retractus est, et dimidium superius ingentis rei disiunctum est, expandens se exterius ut patefieret latam platam, multas tormentas, et centena piratarum.

unit.source: Masts and sails were raised.
unit.target: Masta et vela sublevata erant.

unit.source: Jenna was momentarily mesmerized.
unit.target: Jenna paulisper stupuit.

unit.source: Though Lumian had described how Bone Splitter Basil’s Black Octopus submerged, surfaced, and unfolded, seeing it in person was stunning.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian exposuerat quomodo Octopus Nigra Bone Splitter Basil se submergeret, appareret, et evolveretur, videre hoc in persona stupendum erat.

unit.source: There was a strong sense of mechanical beauty!
unit.target: Exsistebat vehementer sensus pulchritudinis machinalis!

unit.source: Moreover, the behemoth was no smaller than the latest steam-powered ocean liners, vastly superior to traditional sailing pirate ships.
unit.target: Praeterea, ingens non erat minor quam novissimae vecturae oceani, vaporibus impelluntur, longe praevalens navibus piraticis traditis.

unit.source: Jenna didn’t need further confirmation to know this was Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine’s flagship, the Newins.
unit.target: Jenna ulteriores confirmationes non requirere debuit ad cognoscendum hanc esse navem praecipuam Admiralium Profundi Maris Howl Constantine, Newins.

unit.source: She quickly deduced that the Newins had arrived alone, without the Black Octopus.
unit.target: Celeriter intellexit Newins solum adventum esse, sine Octopus Nigro.

unit.source: Since Vice Admiral Dusk Bulatov Ivan became the King of Dusk, other ships in Admiral Deep Sea’s fleet rarely traveled with the flagship.
unit.target: Cum Vice-Admiralis Dusk Bulatov Ivan Rex Crepusculi factus esset, ceterae naves in classe Admiralium Profundi Maris raro secum cum navibus praecipuis navigabant.

unit.source: The Newins and the Black Octopus could submerge and travel secretly, which other ships couldn’t do.
unit.target: Newins et Octopus Niger se mergere et clamiter iter facere poterant, quod ceterae naves non poterant.

unit.source: Forcing them to follow would only expose Howl Constantine’s movements.
unit.target: Eorum coactio ut sequerentur tantum revelaret motus Howl Constantine.

unit.source: This was one reason Franca had targeted Admiral Deep Sea.
unit.target: Hoc erat una ex causis cur Franca destinaverat Admiralium Profundi Maris.

unit.source: What a beautiful piece of alchemical machinery… Jenna thought, staring at the Newins.
unit.target: Quam pulcherrimum opus machinae alchemicae… cogitavit Jenna, Newins intuens.

unit.source: Her father had been a worker, and his appreciation for machinery had deeply influenced her and her brother Julien.
unit.target: Pater eius operarius fuerat, et eius aestimatio machinarum altissime eam et fratrem Julien afflixit.

unit.source: With Trier full of all sorts of useful and odd machines, Julien had almost given up his faith in the Eternal Blazing Sun in his youth to join the God of Steam and Machinery’s Church.
unit.target: Cum Trier pleno esset variis machinis utilibus et insolitis, Julien paene fidem suam iuvenili in Sol Aeterno Ardentis relinquere decrevit, ut Ecclesiam Dei Vaporis et Machinarum adiret.

unit.source: Jenna withdrew her gaze and walked away from the dock, somewhat worried about something else.
unit.target: Jenna oculos avertit et a ripa discessit, paulo de alio sollicita.

unit.source: Her brother Julien would return to Trier in just over a month after his exchange studies.
unit.target: Frater eius Julien ad Trier rediturus erat paululum post studia commutativa.

unit.source: She didn’t want him to continue living in this dangerous city built on a “caldera.”
unit.target: Noluit ut permaneret in hac urbe periculosa, super calderam constructa.

unit.source: She wanted Julien to settle in a place with strong official forces but not as dangerous as Trier.
unit.target: Volebat Julien collocari in loco ubi vires officiales robustae essent, sed non tam periculosa quam Trier.

unit.source: Port LeSeur, where he was currently staying, or another similar town would be ideal.
unit.target: Portus LeSeur, ubi nunc mansurabat, aut aliud simile oppidum idoneum foret.

unit.source: Jenna knew she couldn’t persuade Julien.
unit.target: Jenna scivit se Julien persuadere non posse.

unit.source: He would worry about her unless she found a reliable person to marry.
unit.target: Ipse de ea sollicite esset, nisi aliquem fidum ad nuptias inveniret.

unit.source: Besides, Julien had grown up in Trier, and it offered him more opportunities.
unit.target: Praeterea, Julien in Trier creverat, et ei plures opportunitates obtulit.

unit.source: How could he leave his hometown?
unit.target: Quomodo domum suam relinquere posset?

unit.source: I need to find a way, something temporary to convince him.
unit.target: Mihi viam invenire oportet, aliquid temporarium ut eum convincam.

unit.source: Permanent relocation is something Julien would never accept.
unit.target: Migratio perpetua est res quam Julien numquam acciperet.

unit.source: As Franca said, maybe try for three years, then another three… Jenna didn’t consider having Anthony directly “hypnotize” Julian.
unit.target: Ut Franca dixit, fortasse tribus annis conari, deinde aliis tribus; Jenna non consideravit Anthony directe "hypnotizaret" Julianum.

unit.source: Just then, two drunken pirates stumbled onto the dock and spotted Jenna in her hooded, dress-like outfit.
unit.target: Mox duo piratae ebrii in ripam inciderunt et Jennam in habitu cucullato, simili vesti, conspexerunt.

unit.source: They looked her up and down for a few seconds, exchanged glances, and blocked her path.
unit.target: Illi eam desuper et deorsum per paucos secundos intuentes, oculos inter se commutaverunt, atque iter eius obstruxerunt.

unit.source: “Hey lady, name your price.”
unit.target: “Heus, domina, profer pretium tuum.”

unit.source: “If you don’t want to, we’ll just decide for ourselves!”
unit.target: “Si non vis, nos ipsi decernemus!”

unit.source: As they spoke, the pirates reached out to grab Jenna.
unit.target: Dum loquebantur, piratae manum extendere ad Jennam apprehendendam conati sunt.

unit.source: In Banamo Port, this wasn’t uncommon.
unit.target: In Portu Banamo, hoc non erat insolitum.

unit.source: Local women either worked as streetwalkers in protected places like bars or stayed home to avoid attracting pirates.
unit.target: Feminae locales aut ut meretrices in locis tutis, ut tabernis, laborabant aut domi manebant, ne piratae illas allicerent.

unit.source: The best outcome would be the arrival of the sheriff and receive compensation, and the worst would be being killed on the spot by pirates unwilling to pay, their bodies thrown into the sea or taken aboard a ship and sold elsewhere.
unit.target: Optimum evenire esset adventus praefecti cum compensatione, et pessimum, ut statim a piratis, solvere recusantibus, occideretur, corpora eorum in mare iacta aut in navem capta et alibi vendita.

unit.source: Before the pirates could touch her, they suddenly found themselves engulfed in silent, evil black flames.
unit.target: Priusquam piratae eam contingere possent, subito se invenerunt implicatos in flammis silentibus, maleficis, nigerrimis.

unit.source: They felt a surge of fear and pain, sobering up instantly, and turned to flee in terror.
unit.target: Impulsum timoris et doloris sensissent, statim sobrii facti, et in terrore fugere conversi sunt.

unit.source: As they ran, they screamed, “Witch!”
unit.target: Dum currerent, clamaverunt, “Striga!”

unit.source: “Witch!”
unit.target: “Striga!”

unit.source: Jenna felt a bit of her Witch potion digest from their fear and pain.
unit.target: Jenna sensit aliquantulum potionis suae Strigae, ex eorum timore et dolore digesta.

unit.source: She watched them weaken under the black flames, collapsing and dying as they ran.
unit.target: Illos aspexit sub flammis nigris debilari, corruentes atque morientes dum fugerunt.

unit.source: Jenna then faced a dilemma.
unit.target: Jenna deinde dilemma occurritabat.

unit.source: Should I maintain the mysterious and evil image of a Witch or follow my instincts and take the money from their corpses…
unit.target: Num servare debeam imaginem arcanae et mali Strigae, aut instinctus meos sequi atque pecuniam ex cadaveribus eorum sumere?

unit.source: In a bar in Banamo Port.
unit.target: In taberna in Portu Banamo.

unit.source: Anthony sat on a barstool with a mug of beer, listening to a pirate across from him boast.
unit.target: Anthony in subsellio tabernae sedebat, poculum cervisiae tenens, et audiebat piratam adversus se gloriantem.

unit.source: His task for the past two days had been to blend in with the pirates, monitor, and guide the “public opinion.”
unit.target: Munus eius per duas dies praeteritas fuit se miscere cum piratis, observare et ducere "opinionem publicam."

unit.source: Although Lumian had analyzed a lot, he wasn’t entirely sure how the pirate community would react.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian multa perspexerat, non plane certus erat quomodo communitas piratica agirentur.

unit.source: Human nature was unpredictable, and among so many pirates, it was normal for some to act in ways that defied logic.
unit.target: Natura humana erat incerta, et inter tot piratas, normale erat ut quidam agerentur modis rationi repugnandis.

unit.source: A Conspirer couldn’t predict events with certainty like a high-ranked Seer, Prophet, or Spectator.
unit.target: Conspirator eventus certe praedicere non poterat, sicut summi vates, prophetae aut spectatores.

unit.source: They needed to prepare extra measures to ensure things went as planned and not fall apart at the first deviation.
unit.target: Extra mensuras parare oportebat, ut res prout destinatae evenirent nec in prima aberratione corruerent.

unit.source: So, Anthony frequented the pirates’ favorite bars, making as many friends as possible to understand their reactions to the unknown adventurer’s provocations.
unit.target: Itaque Anthony popinas piraticas carissimas frequentavit, complurimos amicos faciens, ut eorum responsiones ad incognitum adventorem provocantem intellegeret.

unit.source: He identified voices that could significantly influence the outcome and used his Hypnotist abilities to quietly guide and change the attitudes of a few influential pirates, ensuring the public opinion matched Lumian’s goals.
unit.target: Voces agnovit quae exitum significanter afficere poterant, et facultatibus hypnoticis utendo tacite dirigere atque morum aliquot piratarum influentium mutandas curavit, ut opinio publica Lumian propositis congrueret.

unit.source: This large-scale, covert guidance helped Anthony digest a good portion of his Hypnotist potion.
unit.target: Haec directa latiore atque occulta Anthony adiuvit ut bonam partem potionis hypnoticae suae digereret.

unit.source: It involved actual hypnosis and seemed to indirectly guide the collective psyche of the pirates in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Hoc implicabat hypnosim veram atque videbatur indirecte dirigere animum collectivum piratarum in Portu Banamo.

unit.source: Gulping down golden beer, the pirate beside Anthony admired his new friend.
unit.target: Cervisiam auream degustans, pirata iuxta Anthony novum amicum suum admirabatur.

unit.source: To him, this new friend was not only amiable but also a good listener among pirates, not interrupting to show off during others’ stories.
unit.target: Ei, hic novus amicus non solum amabilis erat, sed etiam bonus auditor inter piratas, qui non intercipiebat ut se ostenderet in fabulis aliorum.

unit.source: “Holy Lord of Storms, it’s rare to meet a pirate like this. I finally got to finish my story!”
unit.target: “Sancte Domine Tempestatum, raro est talem piratam convenire. Denique fabulam meam conficere potui!”

unit.source: The pirate Stilwell praised the god in his heart and asked Anthony, “Interested in joining our crew?”
unit.target: Pirata Stilwell deum in corde suo laudavit et Anthony rogavit: “Visne nostram classem iungere?”

unit.source: Anthony smiled and replied, “I don’t think I’m skilled enough to be one of you.”
unit.target: Anthony subridens respondit: “Non puto me satis peritum esse ut unus ex vobis sim.”

unit.source: “Haha.” Stilwell laughed proudly.
unit.target: “Haha.” Stilwell superbe risit.

unit.source: Anthony glanced around and lowered his voice, “Have you heard about the unknown adventurer?”
unit.target: Anthony circumspiciens et vocem deminuens dixit: “Audivistine de ignoto adventore?”

unit.source: Stilwell’s smile vanished instantly.
unit.target: Risus Stilwell subito evanuit.

unit.source: “Yeah, I heard. There’s so many pirate captains here, but none have taught that adventurer a lesson!”
unit.target: “Ita, audivi. Hic tot capitanei piratorum sunt, sed nemo huic adventori rem monitionis instituit!”

unit.source: “What are they waiting for? This is their chance to gain more fame. They might even become the tenth Pirate Admiral!”
unit.target: “Quid ergo exspectant? Haec eorum occasio ad ampliandam famam est. Forsitan etiam decimus Admiralis Piraticus fieri possint!”

unit.source: In his rant, Stilwell never mentioned challenging the arrogant adventurer himself.
unit.target: In sua oratione, Stilwell numquam memor fuit provocandi ipsius arroganti adventori.

unit.source: Suddenly, a commotion erupted in the bar.
unit.target: Subito, tumultus in taberna exarsit.

unit.source: “What’s happening?” Stilwell picked up his beer and mumbled, heading towards the table.
unit.target: “Quid fit?” Stilwell cerevisiam suam tollens mormoravit, ad mensam properans.

unit.source: After a while, he returned to the bar, excitedly telling Anthony, “Admiral Deep Sea is in Banamo!”
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, ad tabernam rediit et excitatus Anthony dixit: “Admiralium Profundi Maris in Portu Banamo est!”

unit.source: “Admiral Deep Sea is here?” Anthony looked delighted.
unit.target: “Admiralium Profundi Maris hic est?” Anthony laetus videbatur.

unit.source: “Yes, someone will teach that bastard a lesson!” Stilwell sat back on his stool, enthusiastically, “That’s a Pirate Admiral! Every Pirate Admiral earned their title through real battles, not just boasting. They could kill all the adventurers here if they wanted to!”
unit.target: “Ita, aliquis huic nefando rem monitionis dabit!” Stilwell in sellā recubuit, alacriter dicens: “Hic est Admiralis Piraticus! Omnis Admiralis Piraticus titulum suum per vera proelia meritus est, non solum per gloriationem. Omnes adventores hic interficere posse poterant, si velissent!”

unit.source: When Stilwell finished, Anthony echoed, “I’m already looking forward to it.”
unit.target: Cum Stilwell finem fecit, Anthony respondit: “Iam id exspecto.”

unit.source: Gulp. Stilwell picked up his beer mug again and took a sip.
unit.target: Gulp. Stilwell iterum poculum cerevisiae levavit et sorciens.

unit.source: He boasted, “I thought Admiral Deep Sea would come to end the humiliation caused by those so-called notable pirates.”
unit.target: Ille gloriatus est, “Putabam Admiralem Profundi Maris venturum esse ut finem imponeret humiliationi a piratis dictis notabilibus.”

unit.source: “Why do you say that?” Anthony asked curiously.
unit.target: “Cur id dicis?” Anthony curiose interrogavit.

unit.source: Stilwell glanced at him. “You don’t know?”
unit.target: Stilwell eum aspexit: “Nescis?”

unit.source: Anthony smiled and explained, “Although I’m from Intis, our boss often intercepts ships in the Berserk Sea and rarely comes to the Fog Sea.”
unit.target: Anthony subridens explicavit: “Etsi ex Intis sum, dominus noster saepe naves in Mari Furenti intercipit et raro ad Mari Nebulosi venit.”

unit.source: “That explains it.” Stilwell nodded understandingly. He lowered his voice, “We suspect Admiral Deep Sea comes to Banamo Port every year to find that legendary treasure.”
unit.target: “Illud rationem dat.” Stilwell caput intellegenter annuit. Vocem deminuens dixit: “Suspicimus Admiralem Profundi Maris quotannis ad Portum Banamo venire ut illud thesaurum legendarium inveniat.”

unit.source: “Treasure? The Lost Newins?” Anthony acted like a genuine pirate.
unit.target: “Thesaurus? Novins Perditus?” Anthony se quasi verus pirata gessit.

unit.source: The Lost Newins was one of the most famous treasure legends on the Five Seas, rumored to be at the bottom of a certain part of the Fog Sea.
unit.target: Novins Perditus erat una ex clarissimis fabulis thesaurorum in Quinque Mariis, diciturque in imo alicuius partis Maris Nebulosi esse.

unit.source: It was said to be the site of an ancient civilization of intelligent beings, long destroyed.
unit.target: Dicitur fuisse situs antiqui civilizationis ingeniarum, iam diu deleta.

unit.source: Strange items often appeared in the area, all pointing to the ancient Newins.
unit.target: Res insolitae saepe in regione apparuerunt, omnes ad antiquam Novins referentes.

unit.source: “Yes.” Stilwell nodded emphatically. “Think about it. Admiral Deep Sea’s flagship was found in some ruins and named the Newins. Anyone would suspect those ruins are the Lost Newins! Besides, the area where the Newins supposedly sank isn’t far from here.”
unit.target: “Ita.” Stilwell emphaticē annuit. “Cogita illud: navis praecipua Admiralis Profundi Maris in nonnullis ruinis inventa est et ‘Newins’ nominata; quisquis suspicaret has ruinas Novins Perditas esse. Praeterea, regio in qua putatur Newins submersa esse, non longe ab hoc sit.”

unit.source: Banamo Port, Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Banamo Port, Carnival Bar.

unit.source: Adventurer Mason had donned the loose pants and thick jacket favored by pirates.
unit.target: Peragrator Mason bracas laxas et cassidum crassum, a piratis gratissimum, induerat.

unit.source: He looked toward the unknown adventurer drinking strong liquor with his back to him, feeling a constant tension.
unit.target: Ad peragratorem ignotum, qui potum fortem lugubri saepe bibebat et tergum ad se habebat, intuebatur, dum constanti angore affectus esset.

unit.source: He wasn’t worried about being hurt but was anxious about when this kind of life would end.
unit.target: Non de laesione sollicitus erat sed de tempore quo talis vita finem haberet anxius versabatur.

unit.source: Pirates were never reasonable; they would always vent their anger on others.
unit.target: Piratae numquam rationem habebant; iram suam in alios semper effuderent.

unit.source: After no one stepped up to respond to the arrogant unknown adventurer, many pirates tried to take their anger out on other adventurers in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Quod nemo ad peragratorem arroganti ignotum conversum contendere animadvertit, multi piratae in ceteros peragratores in Banamo Port iram suam dirigere conati sunt.

unit.source: Frequent adventurers in Banamo Port were used to a life of hiding.
unit.target: Peragratores cotidiani in Banamo Port vitam abscondendi soliti erant.

unit.source: They would never openly identify as adventurers, disguising themselves as other professions instead.
unit.target: Numquam manifeste se peragratores agnoscerent, sed se aliis officiis celare solebant.

unit.source: Otherwise, bodies would be found in alleys or floating near the docks.
unit.target: Alioquin corpora in angulis aut prope pontificia fluctuantia reperirentur.

unit.source: In this pirate-dominated port, being an adventurer was clearly a dangerous and elusive profession.
unit.target: In hoc portu, a piratis dominato, esse peragratorem manifeste officium periculosum et elusivum videbatur.

unit.source: People like Mason had regular identities to disguise themselves, sometimes even joining pirate crews to help gather supplies while stationed in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Homines ut Mason identitates communes habebant ad se celandum, interdum etiam classibus piratarum iungendo ad opes colligendas dum in Banamo Port manebant.

unit.source: Taking on commissions wouldn’t expose an adventurer’s identity because many pirates also took jobs for rewards.
unit.target: Mandata accipere identitatem peragratoris detegere non poterat, quoniam multi piratae negotia pro praemiis susceperunt.

unit.source: For example, if they killed a rival pirate, they could collect a bounty through connections.
unit.target: Exempli causa, si piratam adversarium occiderent, per coniunctiones praemium colligere poterant.

unit.source: Who wouldn’t want that?
unit.target: Quis id non velle posset?

unit.source: Pirates approached tasks differently from adventurers.
unit.target: Piratae negotia aliter aggrediebantur quam peragratores.

unit.source: They would first identify the mission issuer and decide if they could kill the client directly.
unit.target: Primo emissarium missionis agnoscebant atque statuere conabantur num cliente directe interfici posse.

unit.source: Some adventurers would naturally turn into bandits in lawless areas.
unit.target: Nonnulli peragratores in regionibus iniquis naturaliter ad latrones redire solebant.

unit.source: Mason had recently lost his job at a trading company.
unit.target: Mason nuper officium suum in societate mercatoria amiserat.

unit.source: With his distinct, non-native features, he had to dress as a pirate to avoid trouble.
unit.target: Cum lineis distinctis et extraneis, ut pirata se indueret, ne in commotionem incidens necesse habebat.

unit.source: His thoughts drifted to a corner of the Carnival Bar near the window.
unit.target: Cogitationes eius ad angulum Carnival Bar iuxta fenestram vagabantur.

unit.source: The walls were charred, the glass cracked, and overturned tables and chairs lay amidst two charred bodies that had been burning for a long time.
unit.target: Muri decocti erant, vitrum fractum, et mensae ac cathedrae revolutae inter duas corpora exustas, diu ardentia, iacebant.

unit.source: These were two pirates.
unit.target: Hi erant duo piratae.

unit.source: Earlier that afternoon, they had recognized an adventurer they had encountered before and decided to vent their malice on him.
unit.target: Ante meridiem illa, peragratorem quem olim occurrerant agnoverunt atque decreverunt in eum malitiam suam effundere.

unit.source: The unknown adventurer at the bar counter didn’t even turn his head, summoning one fiery raven after another, blasting the pirates apart and burning them.
unit.target: Peragrator ignotus ad mensam tabernarii quidem quidem caput vertit, sed non sufficiens; unus post alium corvi igniti evocati sunt, qui piratas dissipaverunt atque combusserunt.

unit.source: This convinced the watching pirates that the unknown adventurer was a man of his word.
unit.target: Hoc piratis spectantibus convincit peragratorem ignotum virum veri dicti esse.

unit.source: If he said he would kill, he would kill.
unit.target: Si dixerit interficere se, interficeret.

unit.source: If he promised punishment for crossing the line, there would be punishment, even in a pirate port watched by thousands of pirates and many Beyonders.
unit.target: Si poenam pro transgressione promissit, poena dabitur, etiam in portu piratarum ab milibus et multis Beyonder inspexum.

unit.source: And the pirates’ captain didn’t dare retaliate.
unit.target: Et dux piratarum non ausus est refellere.

unit.source: Mason had witnessed the entire scene.
unit.target: Mason totum spectaculum conspectum habebat.

unit.source: He noticed that the two pirates were familiar with the Pyromaniac’s abilities and were quite skilled, with one being a Low-Sequence Beyonder.
unit.target: Animadvertit duo piratas potentiam Pyromaniaci bene novisse et peritissimos esse, quorum unus Beyonder ordinis humilis erat.

unit.source: Despite their precautions, they couldn’t escape the ravens.
unit.target: Quamquam cautiones ceperant, corvis effugere non poterant.

unit.source: They were covered in flames by the window before they could escape from the center of the bar.
unit.target: Flammis iuxta fenestram tegeri eos antequam e media taberna evaderent.

unit.source: This filled Mason with admiration and longing.
unit.target: Hoc Mason admiratione ac desiderio implevit.

unit.source: When will I have such power?
unit.target: Quando talis vis mihi futura erit?

unit.source: When can I become an adventurer who can intimidate so many pirates?
unit.target: Quando peragrator fieri possum qui tantos piratas terret?

unit.source: Mason had intended to “kindly” help the pirates deal with the bodies, but to his regret, their captain and first mate quickly arrived and collected their “inheritance.”
unit.target: Mason commerte auxilium ferre intendebat piratis ad corpora tractanda, sed ad illum dolorem, dux piratarum primusque nauta celeriter accesserunt et suam “portionem” collegissent.

unit.source: I should stick close to this adventurer.
unit.target: Adhaerebo huic peragratore.

unit.source: If I’m recognized, I’m done for…
unit.target: Si agnoscarer, perditionem patiibo…

unit.source: Mason muttered, gulping down his dark beer.
unit.target: Mason murmuravit dum obscuram cerevisiam vorax edebat.

unit.source: How did my life change so drastically?
unit.target: Quomodo vita mea tam drastice mutata est?

unit.source: Though he hadn’t been harmed, he felt implicated.
unit.target: Quamquam non laesus erat, se implicatum sentiebat.

unit.source: This heightened his fear that he might have brought disaster to Banamo Port, though it didn’t seem like a disaster yet.
unit.target: Hoc metum eius auxit, ne Banamo Port cladem intulisset, quamquam clades nondum videbatur.

unit.source: He hoped it would end when the unknown adventurer left or a Pirate Admiral or King arrived.
unit.target: Spem habebat finem futurum esse cum peragrator ignotus discessisset aut Admiralis Piratarum vel Rex advenerit.

unit.source: Never perform rituals you don’t fully understand… Mason warned himself.
unit.target: Numquam ritus quos non penitus intellegis exsequere… Mason sibi ipsi monuit.

unit.source: He then raised his glass to his reflection on the wall, toasting to his resolution.
unit.target: Deinde poculum ad imaginem in pariete tollens, pro sua resolutione convivium fecit.

unit.source: In the shadow, Franca was intently observing the Carnival Bar inside and out.
unit.target: In umbra, Franca diligenter Carnival Bar ex interioribus et exterioribus partibus observabat.

unit.source: This was her task.
unit.target: Hoc erat munus illius.

unit.source: Even though Lumian was vigilant and prepared, he could still be ambushed.
unit.target: Quamquam Lumian vigilans et paratus erat, tamen insidiari poterat.

unit.source: The Beyonder world had many strange, unpredictable, and hard-to-defend abilities, rituals, and spells.
unit.target: Mundus Beyonder multae habebat insolitae, incognitae atque difficillime defendendae virtutes, ritus, et incantationes.

unit.source: Thus, Franca stayed hidden, monitoring the surroundings from another angle, ready to intervene or provide a Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Ita Franca latuit, ex alio angulo circumiecta perscrutans, parata intervenire aut substitutionem speculi praebere.

unit.source: In the past few days of wandering around Banamo Port with Lumian, Franca had seen pirates drinking, chatting, joking, eating, gambling, venting, and sleeping, making them seem no different from ordinary people.
unit.target: His paucis diebus in Banamo Port cum Lumian errans, Franca piratas bibentes, colloquentes, iocantes, edentes, aleam ludentes, iram effundentes et dormientes vidit, ita ut ab vulgari hominibus non distinguerentur.

unit.source: She felt a bit guilty about the possible plague plan.
unit.target: Aliquantum se culpam habere sensit de consilio pestilentiae possibile.

unit.source: But after witnessing pirate battles and hearing about killings, kidnappings, bullying, robbery, and rape, she genuinely felt that letting these scum die from the plague would purify the world and be a good deed.
unit.target: Sed postquam pugnas piratarum viderat atque de caedibus, rapinis, vexationibus, furtis, et stupri audiverat, vere sensit ut hos spurcissimos pestilentia interfectos mundum purificaret et bonum factum foret.

unit.source: Ignoring her hunger, Franca grumbled about Lumian, “This guy, doesn’t he know it’s been an hour past lunch?”
unit.target: Fame neglegens, Franca de Lumiano murmurat: “Hic homo, num non novit iam unam horam post prandium transisse?”

unit.source: You get to eat, but I don’t!
unit.target: “Tu cibum accipis, ego vero non!”

unit.source: Based on our previous understanding, shouldn’t we shake off potential trackers, hide back at the inn, and let me rest and eat something?
unit.target: “Ex nostro consensu nonne debemus vestigia potentialium vestigiatorum abicere, reverti ad deversorium, atque mihi concedere tempus ad requiem et ad cibandum?”

unit.source: Despite her complaints, Franca continued to dutifully monitor the surroundings.
unit.target: Non obstante querelis, Franca diligenter circumiecta perscrutari continuavit.

unit.source: At that moment, a few pirates entered, bringing a lively, joyful, and excited atmosphere to different tables.
unit.target: Illo momento, pauci piratae intraverunt, diversis mensis animosam, laetam et excitatam atmosphaeram afferentes.

unit.source: Hmm… Franca melded into the shadows, sticking to the wall, and stealthily approached a group of pirates to listen in.
unit.target: Hmm… Franca in umbras se contulit, ad parietem adhaerens, et caute ad coetum piratarum accessit ut auscultaret.

unit.source: “Admiral Deep Sea is really here?”
unit.target: “Admiralis Profundae Maris vere hic est?”

unit.source: “The Newins has already docked!”
unit.target: “Newins iam in portu positus est!”

unit.source: “Do they know about the adventurer?”
unit.target: “Num de peragratore sciunt?”

unit.source: Oh, Admiral Deep Sea is finally here… Franca silently confirmed with a guess.
unit.target: O, Admiralis Profundae Maris demum hic est… Franca tacite coniectura confirmavit.

unit.source: Since Jenna hadn’t issued a warning, it meant no Pirate King had arrived in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Quia Jenna monitionem non emisisset, id significabat nullum Regem Piratarum in Banamo Port accessisse.

unit.source: Franca began to anticipate Admiral Deep Sea’s reaction and actions.
unit.target: Franca coepit exspectare responsionem atque actiones Admiralis Profundae Maris.

unit.source: She was sure Admiral Deep Sea and his key subordinates were aware of the unknown adventurer’s provocation.
unit.target: Certa erat Admiralem Profundae Maris et eius principales subordinatos de provo catio peragratoris ignoti instructos esse.

unit.source: It was a simple deduction.
unit.target: Erat simplex coniectura.

unit.source: Since Admiral Deep Sea was avoiding the King of Dusk, he would first confirm the situation in Banamo Port before coming to resupply.
unit.target: Quia Admiralis Profundae Maris Regem Crepusculi vitabat, primum condicionem in Banamo Port confirmaret antequam supplementa petere veniret.

unit.source: The common practice was to send lesser-known pirates from the fleet on other ships to scout Banamo Port.
unit.target: Consuetudo communis erat piratas minus notos ex classe in aliis navibus mittere ut Banamo Port explorerent.

unit.source: If Banamo Port was a regular stop, trusted subordinates might be stationed there long-term, reporting back promptly.
unit.target: Si Banamo Port statio regularis esset, fideles subordinati ibi diuturno tempore colloci poterant et celeriter referre.

unit.source: Of course, local forces could also provide warnings.
unit.target: Scilicet copiae locales etiam monitiones praebere poterant.

unit.source: In any case, Admiral Deep Sea would be well aware of recent events in Banamo Port; otherwise, he wouldn’t surface the Newins.
unit.target: Quacumque causa, Admiralis Profundae Maris recentes res in Banamo Port bene sciret; alioquin, Newins non appareret.

unit.source: Franca calmed herself, no longer distracted by hunger.
unit.target: Franca se tranquillavit, fame non amplius perturbata.

unit.source: But like the pirates, she waited half an hour without seeing Admiral Deep Sea or his key subordinates, growing puzzled.
unit.target: Sed sicut piratae, dimidiam horam exspectavit, neque Admiralem Profundae Maris neque eius duchos videns, consternata.

unit.source: Why haven’t they shown up?
unit.target: Cur non apparuerunt?

unit.source: Could it be that Admiral Deep Sea is also a cautious person?
unit.target: Num Admiralis Profundae Maris etiam cautus sit?

unit.source: But Lumian is only showing the strength of a strong Sequence 6.
unit.target: Sed Lumian tantum vim validi Ordinis VI ostendit.

unit.source: This crafty guy is using crimson-white flames, not the Reaper’s white flames…
unit.target: Hic callidus vir utitur flammis rubro–albis, non flammas albas Messoris…

unit.source: Franca thought carefully and understood the reason.
unit.target: Franca diligenter cogitavit et causam intellexit.

unit.source: If she were in his shoes, targeted by the King of Dusk, she wouldn’t cause trouble right after arriving at a port.
unit.target: Si in eius loco esset, a Rege Crepusculi subiecta, non statim tumultum efferreret postquam portum advenisset.

unit.source: She would complete the resupply first and prepare for another dive.
unit.target: Primum supplementa absolveret et ad aliam inmersionem praepararet.

unit.source: That way, even if something unexpected happened, they could leave Banamo Port immediately and not complete their primary objective here.
unit.target: Ita, si quid inopinatum eveniret, statim Banamo Port relinquere poterent neque hic proprium propositum perficerent.

unit.source: Also, Lumian, the unknown adventurer, had been in Banamo Port for two or three days.
unit.target: Etiam Lumian, peragrator ignotus, duos vel tres dies in Banamo Port versatus erat.

unit.source: He didn’t seem to be hunting bounties of lesser known pirates, as if he were waiting for something.
unit.target: Non videbatur praedas piratarum minus notarum insequi, quasi aliquid exspectaret.

unit.source: This could make people suspicious of his true intentions.
unit.target: Hoc efficit ut homines de eius veris propositis suspicionem habeant.

unit.source: Admiral Deep Sea would naturally be cautious.
unit.target: Naturali modo, Admiralis Profundae Maris cautus esset.

unit.source: Phew… Franca sighed silently.
unit.target: Fuf… Franca tacite suspiravit.

unit.source: Her gaze continued to sweep across the Carnival Bar, wary of any surprises.
unit.target: Aspectus eius per Carnival Bar percurrit, cautus ulla miracula vitans.

unit.source: In the process, her eyes inevitably swept over Lumian, noticing her companion’s slight smile and good mood, holding a cup of amber-colored Lanti Proof mixed with something unknown.
unit.target: Interea oculi eius inevitabiliter super Lumian percurrerunt, animadvertentes levem risum et bonum animum comitis, qui poculum Lanti Proof coloris ambrae cum aliquo incognito mixtum tenebat.

unit.source: Lumian played with his glass, using his Hunter’s exceptional hearing to roughly understand why the pirates were suddenly excited and anxious.
unit.target: Lumian poculo luderat, eximio auditu venatoris utens, ut approximanter intelligeret cur piratae subito excitati et anxii essent.

unit.source: His target had arrived!
unit.target: Meta eius advenit!

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised since he already knew—Jenna had come by earlier and left a note under his hand, concealed by shadows.
unit.target: Lumian non stupefactus erat, nam iam sciebat—Jenna prius accessisse et sub manu eius notam relinqueret, umbris occultatam.

unit.source: Knowing Admiral Deep Sea wouldn’t come looking for him immediately, Lumian remained calm, acting unaware of the commotion behind him.
unit.target: Sciens Admiralem Profundae Maris non statim eum quaeriturum esse, Lumian quies servabat, se inscius tumultus post eum agens.

unit.source: He glanced at the bartender trying to control his expression and smiled.
unit.target: Ille ad tabernarium, qui vultum suum temperare conabatur, brevem intuerebat, et subridens effexit.

unit.source: “The wind is quite noisy today,” Lumian said.
unit.target: “Vento hodie satis strepituoso est,” inquit Lumian.

unit.source: The bartender didn’t know how to respond, forcing a stiff smile.
unit.target: Tabernarius nescivit quomodo respondeat, coactus tamen subridere firmum.

unit.source: “True.”
unit.target: “Vere.”

unit.source: Lumian said nothing more, feeling his emotions and state change.
unit.target: Lumian nihil amplius dixit, sentiens motus atque statum suum mutari.

unit.source: To be honest, he felt a bit nervous about facing a Pirate Admiral with his fleet.
unit.target: Ad veritatem, paulum anxius se sensit ob congressum cum Admirali Piratarum cum classe sua.

unit.source: But it also made his blood boil slightly.
unit.target: Sed etiam sanguinem suum leviter ebullire fecit.

unit.source: He had never been one to shy away from challenges.
unit.target: Numquam fuit qui a provocationibus recederet.

unit.source: Since becoming a Hunter, he had tasted the allure of challenges even more.
unit.target: Ex quo Venator factus est, allicitatem provocationum etiam magis gustaverat.

unit.source: With that thought, Lumian raised his cup of Lumian to his lips, tilted his head back, and drank it all in one go.
unit.target: Hoc cogitans, Lumian poculum suum ad labra attulit, caput retrorsum inclinavit, et totum in uno hausto biberat.

unit.target: 783 In Navem Conscendens

unit.source: 783 Boarding the Ship
