unit.source: Banamo Port, near the docks.
unit.target: Portus Banamo, iuxta navalia.

unit.source: Jenna hid in the shadows, watching Anthony mingle with the crowd, blending in with the pirates.
unit.target: Jenna in umbris se abscondit, spectans Anthonium cum turba miscere et inter piratas se assimilare.

unit.source: She didn’t deliberately track the famous pirates who arrived on the Newins when it docked.
unit.target: Non diligenter vestigia piratorum famosos sequeretur qui in Newins advenerunt cum navis ad portum accessit.

unit.source: On the one hand, she feared being discovered, which would alert Admiral Deep Sea to a grand consOriginal awaiting him at Banamo Port.
unit.target: Ex una parte, timebat ne detegeretur, quod Admiralem Profundum Mare de magno consOriginal, qui eum in Portu Banamo exspectabat, admoneret.

unit.source: On the other hand, she didn’t need to follow them to know the whereabouts of the Newins’ first mate, second mate, and boatswain.
unit.target: Ex altera parte, non opus erat eos sequi ut locum primi ministri, secundi ministri, et navarchi Newins cognosceret.

unit.source: The pirates in Banamo Port were eagerly anticipating Admiral Deep Sea or his capable subordinates to teach the unknown adventurer a lesson.
unit.target: Piratae in Portu Banamo ardenter exspectabant Admiralem Profundum Mare aut eius capaces subditos ad disciplinam ignoti viatoris tradendam.

unit.source: Naturally, they kept an eye on these individuals and shared information with their companions and friends!
unit.target: Naturaliter, illos vigilabant et notitias cum sociis ac amicis communicabant!

unit.source: In other words, with so much attention on the situation, most of the pirates in Banamo Port had become unofficial reporters.
unit.target: Aliis verbis, cum tanta attentione ad rem, plerique piratae in Portu Banamo facti erant nuntiatores extra officiales.

unit.source: Admiral Deep Sea’s key subordinates couldn’t go anywhere without being noticed and widely discussed.
unit.target: Principales ministri Admiralis Profundi Maris nusquam abire poterant, quippe si eorum motus animadvertere et late disseri non posset.

unit.source: If they used stealth abilities or invisibility, they might avoid the curious eyes spread throughout Banamo Port.
unit.target: Si facultates furtivas aut invisibilitatem adhiberent, oculi curiosi per Portum Banamo diffusi eis evitare poterant.

unit.source: However, they were currently gathering supplies, which meant they couldn’t hide the large quantities of goods.
unit.target: Attamen, nunc suppellectilem colligebant, quod significabat se magnas copias bonorum celare non posse.

unit.source: Thus, information flowed swiftly into Anthony’s ears: “Great Shark is at Firth Trading Company.”
unit.target: Itaque notitia celeriter in aures Anthoni inflavit: “Magnus Squalus apud Firth Trading Company adest.”

unit.source: “Ship Destroyer is heading towards the Carnival Bar!”
unit.target: “Nāvem Destructor ad Tabernam Carnivales se dirigit!”

unit.source: “Holy Lord of Storms, those guys are meeting at Blackstone Square!”
unit.target: “Sancte Domine Tempestatum, illi in Platea Nigrī Lapidis conveniunt!”

unit.source: “They’re one street away from the Carnival Bar!”
unit.target: “Ab Taberna Carnivales una via distant!”

unit.source: “They’ve stopped for now, discussing something!”
unit.target: “Iam subsiderunt, aliquid disserentes!”

unit.source: “They seem to be heading to Old Dante’s for large barrels of pale ale!”
unit.target: “Videtur eos ire ad Antiquum Dante pro magnis dolis cervisiae pallidae!”

unit.source: Anthony sensed the commotion among the pirates, watching them leave the current street and head towards the Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Anthony tumultum inter piratas sensit, eos spectans eā via recedere et ad Tabernam Carnivales contendere.

unit.source: He stood up as well to avoid standing out.
unit.target: Et ipse surrexit, ne eminens appareret.

unit.source: During this, he gave Jenna’s hidden shadow a look.
unit.target: In hoc, oculos in umbram Jennæ latentem contulit.

unit.source: Jenna understood immediately, using the shadows along the street to slip through the growing crowd towards the Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Jenna statim intellexit, umbras per viam adhibens ut per turbam crescente ad Tabernam Carnivales se furtim moveret.

unit.source: Lumian sipped the freshly poured amber-colored Lanti Proof, nodding to himself.
unit.target: Lumian Lanti Proof, recentissime effusum et colore amberei inditum, sorbuit, sibi annuens.

unit.source: He then looked at the bartender behind the counter, smiling as he said, “You might want to move the valuable liquor and items out of here for now. It’s probably best if no one stays inside.”
unit.target: Deinde ad cauponem post tabulatum spectavit, subridens, dicens: “Forsitan velis liquorem pretiosum et res hinc interim transferre; optimum erit si nemo intus maneat.”

unit.source: The bartender froze for a few seconds before responding hastily, “Alright!”
unit.target: Caupo paucis momentis stetit, deinde celerrime respondit: “Ita!”

unit.source: No one wanted to alert Lumian by passing on messages that might affect the plan, but he guessed something was brewing from the pirates gathering outside the bar.
unit.target: Nemo voluit Lumian admonere per nuntios tradendos, qui consilium afficere possent, sed ipse suspicatus est aliquid e piratis extra tabernam congregatis fieri.

unit.source: He was both excited and nervous, knowing the impending conflict would take place in the Carnival Bar, where he was.
unit.target: Et exsultans et anxius erat, sciens proelium imminens in Tabernam Carnivales futurum esse, ubi ipse se inveniebat.

unit.source: Watching the bartender instruct the waiters to move valuable items out the back door, Lumian pulled out a blank sketchbook and an ink pen, casually sketching as he asked, “How much is your bar worth, including this two-story building?”
unit.target: Cauponem spectans qui ministris imperabat ut res pretiosas per ostium posticum moverent, Lumian librum delineandi vacuum et calamus extraxit, leviter depingens ac rogans: “Quantum valet taberna tua, hoc aedificio duorum stratorum includendo?”

unit.source: “Uh…” The bartender was stunned again.
unit.target: “Eheu…” Caupo iterum attonitus fuit.

unit.source: What does this mean?
unit.target: Quid hoc significat?

unit.source: Is he implying the bar might get destroyed in the upcoming conflict, collapsing the whole building?
unit.target: Num insinuat tabernam in proximo proelio delebitur, totum aedificium corruens?

unit.source: Recalling the powerful crimson-white fireballs, the bartender grew even more anxious, forcing a smile as he said, “Are you offering compensation? You decide, or let the loser pay…”
unit.target: Memor potentium globulorum ignis rubro-albore, caupo magis anxius factus est, subridens cogens et dicens: “An compensatio tua est? Tu decernas, aut sinas ut qui perit solvat...”

unit.source: “This building is a simple structure built by locals. It’s definitely cheap. Your bar caters to low-level pirates, so the furniture and décor are all the cheapest kind…” Lumian continued his assessment without looking up, still sketching in the blank book.
unit.target: “Hoc aedificium est structura simplex ab incolis aedificata. Certe vilis est. Tua taberna ad piratas humilis gradus destinata est, ideo supellex et ornamenta omne genere vilissima sunt…” Lumian aestimationem suam continuavit sine sursum aspiciens, adhuc in libro vacuo depingens.

unit.source: “Yes, that’s right.” The bartender nodded quickly, agreeing.
unit.target: “Ita, recte est.” Caupo celeriter annuit.

unit.source: Lumian looked up, shaking his head with a smile. “Whatever I say, you agree. It’s making things difficult for me.”
unit.target: Lumian surrexit, caput agitando ac subridens: “Quaecumque dicam, tu assentiris. Ea mihi difficultates afferunt.”

unit.source: “…” The bartender closed his mouth, unsure how to respond.
unit.target: “…” Caupo os clausit, nescius quo respondeat.

unit.source: Lumian lowered his head again. “How about 2,000 verl d’or?”
unit.target: Lumian caput iterum inclinavit: “Quid de 2,000 verl d’or?”

unit.source: “Okay.” The bartender used a different word, not even trying to bargain.
unit.target: “Bene.” Caupo alterum verbum usus est, neque quidem de negotiatione conatus.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t pause his sketching, his tone calm.
unit.target: Lumian delineationem suam non intermittebat, tono tranquillo.

unit.source: “Payment will be after assessing the damage. If the big pirates coming later want to help compensate, that works too.”
unit.target: “Solutio erit post aestimationem damni. Si magni piratae, qui postea venerint, compensare auxilio studuerint, id quoque valet.”

unit.source: “Alright.” The bartender responded quickly.
unit.target: “Ita.” Caupo celeriter respondit.

unit.source: He looked around, wishing he could sprout wings and fly out of the Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, optabat se alae gerere posse atque ex Tabernā Carnivālēs evadere.

unit.source: From their conversation, he feared staying could lead to him becoming a mangled corpse.
unit.target: Ex eorum colloquio timebat manere posse eum in cadaver laceratum convertere.

unit.source: A few minutes later, the waiters had moved the few valuable items out, leaving only the cheap goods in the bar.
unit.target: Paucis minutis post, ministri paucas res pretiosas extra moverant, relinquentes in taberna solum mercimonia vilia.

unit.source: The bartender left through the back door, and the other patrons, including Mason, exited to wait and watch outside.
unit.target: Caupo per ostium posticum exiit, et ceteri clientes, inter quos Mason etiam, foris exierunt ut exspectarent et spectarent.

unit.source: They didn’t dare stay in this anticipated battlefield.
unit.target: Non ausi sunt manere in hoc proelio exspectato.

unit.source: This was the lesson of experience.
unit.target: Hoc erat praeceptum experientiae.

unit.source: Lumian sketched for a while, then put down his pen and slowly sipped the remaining Lanti Proof.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper delineavit, deinde calamus deiecit et lente reliquum Lanti Proof sorbuit.

unit.source: A few minutes later, Franca sneaked into the shadows near the bar and whispered, “Admiral Deep Sea didn’t come, but his first mate, Great Shark, and others are almost here. They’ll be here in about two minutes.”
unit.target: Paucis minutis post, Franca ad umbras prope tabernam se furtim inserebat et susurravit: “Admiralis Profundus Mare non venit, sed primus socius eius, Magnus Squalus, et alii paene adsunt. Ibi erunt circa duos minutos.”

unit.source: Lumian picked up the ink pen again and continued sketching in the book.
unit.target: Lumian iterum calamus sumpsit et in libro delineare continuavit.

unit.source: He chuckled and said, “Remember to prepare the 2,000 verl d’or compensation, and when we get back, return the 1,000 verl d’or bounty for summoning the messenger.”
unit.target: Risus emisit et dixit: “Memento compensationem 2,000 verl d’or praeparare, et cum redeamus, redde 1,000 verl d’or praemium pro nuntio evocando.”

unit.source: “Ah?” Franca was a bit surprised.
unit.target: “Ah?” Franca paulo mirata est.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “All of this is to help you digest Pleasure. You should cover all expenses, including consumed Beyonder items.”
unit.target: Lumian risit et dixit: “Hoc omnia est ut tibi auxilii sit ad Voluptatem digerendam. Oportet omnes expensas sustinere, inclusis rebus Beyonder consumptis.”

unit.source: “No problem.” Franca wasn’t resisting; she was just surprised Lumian brought it up suddenly.
unit.target: “Nulla quaestio.” Franca non resistebat; modo mirabatur quod Lumian subito id attulerit.

unit.source: She watched Lumian finish his sketch on the blank page, curious as she asked, “Why not just take out the Pride Armor, disguise it as a person with a robe, and have it sit in this chair facing away from the incoming pirates?”
unit.target: Illa spectavit Lumian delineare finem sui in pagina vacua, curiosa rogans: “Cur non tollis Armaturam Superbiæ, eam ut hominem cum togā simulare, et in hac sella sedere disponas, ita ut facies eius a piratis venturis avertatur?”

unit.source: With Lumian present, the Pride Armor couldn’t be used, so it might as well serve some purpose by being placed here.
unit.target: Cum Lumian praesens esset, Armatura Superbiæ uti non poterat; igitur melius aliqua utilitas esset, si hic collocaretur.

unit.source: “Do you really want this building destroyed?” Lumian chuckled. “Besides, the Pride Armor can’t use Lie and can’t disguise itself as me. The subordinates of Admiral Deep Sea would notice something’s wrong before even entering.”
unit.target: “Num vere vis hunc aedificium deletum esse?” Lumian risit. “Praeterea, Armatura Superbiæ mendacium uti nequeat neque se in me transformare. Subditi Admiralis Profundi Maris aliquid iniuriosum animadverterent antequam intrarent.”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian finished the last stroke on the blank page.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian ultimam lineam in pagina vacua perficit.

unit.source: It was a sketch outlined in deep blue ink, depicting Lumian himself.
unit.target: Erat delineatio delineata atri caerulei tincta, quae Lumian ipsum repraesentabat.

unit.source: The paper gradually turned translucent, and the sketch of Lumian suddenly came to life, thickening and expanding like a balloon.
unit.target: Charta paulatim translucens facta est, atque delineatio Lumiani subito in vitam evasit, crassior et dilatans velut globus.

unit.source: In an instant, a stoic-faced Lumian appeared before the bar counter, blocked by Lumian’s body.
unit.target: In momento, Lumian vultu stoico ante mensam tabernae apparuit, corpore Lumiani obstructus.

unit.source: It had the instinct to complete a few minutes of combat and possessed some of Lumian’s abilities, obeying the sketcher’s commands.
unit.target: Illi ingenium erat ut paucos momenta proelii peragret et nonnullas virtutes Lumiani haberet, praeceptoris delineatoris obsequens.

unit.source: As the sketched Lumian sat in a chair facing away from the bar door, Lumian transformed into a shadow creature, disappearing from the bar.
unit.target: Dum delineatus Lumian in sella sedebat, a porta tabernae se avertens, Lumian in creaturam umbræ transformatus est, ex taberna evanescens.

unit.source: Soon, Great Shark, the first mate of the Newins, arrived at the Carnival Bar with a few companions of similar strength, surrounded by a crowd of pirates.
unit.target: Mox Magnus Squalus, primus socius Newins, cum paucis comitibus simillimis viribus ad Tabernam Carnivales pervenit, a turba piratarum circumdatus.

unit.source: The tall, muscular, bald Great Shark glanced at the unknown adventurer calmly sitting at the bar and gestured, leading the way through the door.
unit.target: Magnus Squalus, altus, musculus, calvus, viatorem ignotum quiescentem ad tabernam intuerebat et gesticulans iter per ostium monstravit.

unit.source: As the Beyonders from the Newins entered the bar, Lumian, disguised and watching from the window, placed his right hand on the glass.
unit.target: Dum Beyonders e Newins tabernam intrabant, Lumian, celatus et ex fenestra spectans, dextram manum in vitrum imposuit.

unit.source: A black mark hidden under his clothes glowed.
unit.target: Nigrum signum sub vestimentis absconditum lucide fulgebat.

unit.source: Bottle of Fiction!
unit.target: Vas Fictionis!

unit.source: He trapped the Carnival Bar inside the Bottle of Fiction, setting the condition for exit to be non-Beyonders.
unit.target: Tabernam Carnivales in Vas Fictionis recludit, condicionem exitus constituens ut non ex Beyonders esset.

unit.source: Lumian turned, and in the chaos of the pirates losing sight of the bar’s interior, he squeezed through the crowd and headed to a nearby alley, teleporting to the docks with Franca.
unit.target: Lumian conversus est, et in confusione piratarum interiora tabernae obliviscientium, per turbam se comprimit atque ad proximam angustum viam contendit, cum Franca ad navalia teleportans.

unit.source: They met Jenna and Anthony at the designated spot, using shadows and Psychological Invisibility to remain hidden as they boarded the alchemical ship Newins.
unit.target: Ipsi convenere cum Jennā et Anthoni in loco designato, umbras atque invisibilitatem psychologicam adhibentes ut absconditi remanserent, dum navem alchemicam Newins conscenderent.

unit.source: Compared to when they arrived, there were fewer pirates on the ship, just enough to maintain basic vigilance.
unit.target: Comparatis temporibus adventus, pauciores piratae in navi erant, satis tantum ad vigilantiam rudimentariam conservandam.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t worried their actions would alert Admiral Deep Sea.
unit.target: Lumian non sollicitus erat ne eorum acta Admiralem Profundum Mare admonerent.

unit.source: According to gathered intel, Howl Constantine wasn’t a Beyonder of the Devil pathway and couldn’t sense malice.
unit.target: Secundum notitias collectas, Howl Constantine non fuit Beyonder viae Diaboli et malitiam sentire non potuit.

unit.source: His abilities resembled a Sequence 5 Ocean Songster of the Storm pathway, and according to the Tarot Club, Admiral Deep Sea had no ties to the Church of Storms.
unit.target: Eius potentiae similes erant Sequenciae 5 Ocean Songster (via Tempestatum), et secundum Tarot Club, Admiralis Profundus Mare nullos nexūs ad Ecclesiam Tempestatum habebat.

unit.source: Thus, Lumian had Jenna confirm if the Black Octopus had followed the Newins to Banamo Port—the Black Octopus’s captain, Bone Splitter Basil, was a Devil.
unit.target: Ita, Lumian iussit Jennam verificare, si Octopus Niger Newins sequeretur ad Portum Banamo—capitaneus Octopi Nigri, Bone Splitter Basil, Diabolus erat.

unit.source: Considering the changing situation at the Carnival Bar might alert Admiral Deep Sea, Lumian and his team didn’t waste time, swiftly sneaking into the ship’s hold.
unit.target: Quoniam mutatio rei in Tabernā Carnivālēs Admiralem Profundum Mare admonere posset, Lumian et turma eius tempus non perdiderunt, celeriter in cellam navis se insidiantes.

unit.source: Within a minute, they found a lone pirate in a corridor room.
unit.target: Intra minuto, in conclavi corridori invenerunt unicum piratam.

unit.source: Franca checked the surrounding mechanical devices for alarms, then whispered to shadow-form Lumian, “It’s show time.”
unit.target: Franca machinas mechanicas circumstantium pro sonis periculum examinavit, deinde Lumiano, in forma umbrā, susurravit: “Tempus spectaculi est.”

unit.source: Lumian immediately slipped into the room, moving behind the lone pirate and emerging, giving a harrumph.
unit.target: Lumian statim in conclave se introduxit, post unicum piratam movens et emergens, gutturim exclamans “harrumph.”

unit.source: Two flashes of white light, and the pirate fell unconscious.
unit.target: Duae micationes luminis albi, et pirata in insensibilitatem cecidit.

unit.source: Anthony entered the room quickly, beginning hypnosis.
unit.target: Anthony celeriter in conclave intravit, hypnosi initium faciens.

unit.source: Jenna and Franca guarded the door from the shadows, soon hearing friendly conversation inside, “Where’s the Admiral?”
unit.target: Jenna et Franca ostium ex umbris custodiēbant, mox audientes amicam sermonem intus: “Ubi est Admiralis?”

unit.source: “In the captain’s cabin.”
unit.target: “In cubiculo capitani.”

unit.source: “The Admiral must have a powerful backer to be one of the most famous pirates, right?”
unit.target: “Admiralis certe validum patronum habere debet, ut unus ex piratis celebrioribus sit, nonne?”

unit.source: “I don’t know, but the Admiral is indeed mysterious.”
unit.target: “Nescio, sed Admiralis vere mysteriosus est.”

unit.source: After a brief inquiry, Anthony made the pirate forget he had such a friend on board.
unit.target: Post breve quaestionem, Anthony fecit ut pirata oblivisceretur se talem amicum in nave habere.

unit.source: They then sneaked to the upper deck, stopping outside the captain’s cabin.
unit.target: Tum furtim ad terram superiorem se contulerunt, foris cubiculi capitani subsistentes.

unit.source: Lumian’s eyes twitched as he gazed at the silver‑white metal door.
unit.target: Oculi Lumiani micabant, dum portas metallarum argenteo-albas intuebatur.

unit.source: He realized Admiral Deep Sea’s possible pathway and sequence.
unit.target: Animadvertit viam et ordinem Admiralis Profundi Maris.

unit.source: On an alchemical ship like this, an Ocean Songster’s power might not be inferior to being in the deep sea or the air!
unit.target: In navis alchemica huiusmodi, potentia Ocean Songster non minor esse potest quam in profundo mari aut in aere!

unit.source: While Lumian pondered, two pirates pushed a food cart to the captain’s cabin using a mechanical lift.
unit.target: Dum Lumian cogitabat, duo piratae plaustrum cum cibo ad cubiculum capitani impulerunt, utens machina levatoria.

unit.source: 784 Mask
unit.target: 784 Larva

unit.source: 784 Mask
unit.target: 784 Larva

unit.source: Lumian immediately retreated into the nearby shadows, closely watching the slowly opening metal door of the captain’s cabin.
unit.target: Lumian statim in umbras vicinas se recepit, oculis diligenter spectans ianuam metallicam cubiculi capitani paulatim aperientem.

unit.source: As the cart filled with various foods was pushed in, he finally saw their target, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine.
unit.target: Cum plaustrum variis cibis repletum in cubiculum impellum esset, tandem metam eorum, Admiralem Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, perspici vidit.

unit.source: Though he had heard many rumors and seen the wanted posters, nothing compared to witnessing the reality of his sea monster lineage firsthand.
unit.target: Quamquam multas rumores audiverat et tabulas quaesitas vidisset, nihil comparabat ad testimonium verae stirpis monstrorum maris, quod ipse intuendus erat.

unit.source: Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine’s face looked as if a translucent, palm-sized octopus clung to it, with numerous slimy tentacles hanging down to his chest.
unit.target: Vultus Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, videbatur quasi octopus translucens, magnitudine palmae, adhaerens, cum multis lubricis tentaculis usque ad pectus pendentibus.

unit.source: His deep blue, almost black hair was thick and coarse, falling to his shoulders, and his body was entirely wrapped in a black cloak, even his hands hidden within.
unit.target: Capilli eius, caerulei intensi et fere nigri, densi et aspri erant, ad humeros cadentes, et corpus totum in nigro pallio involutum, etiam manus intus absconditae.

unit.source: He was nothing like a normal human.
unit.target: Nullus similis erat homini ordinario.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but feel this was unusual.
unit.target: Lumian certe sentire non potuit quin hoc esse inusitatum.

unit.source: His face, fused with an octopus, was exposed, so what was there to hide about his body?
unit.target: Facies eius, cum octopodo coniuncta, patebat; ergo quid in corpore eius celandum esset?

unit.source: Even if he was truly an octopus beneath the cloak, no one around would be surprised!
unit.target: Etiam si vere sub pallio octopus esset, nemo circum eum miratus esset!

unit.source: The only reason to cover his body so tightly was if there was something even more unpresentable there.
unit.target: Unica causa cur corpus eius tam arcte tegatur, erat, si aliquid adhuc indecorum ibi exstaret.

unit.source: Puzzled, Lumian carefully observed Howl Constantine’s fate.
unit.target: Perplexus, Lumian fatum Howl Constantine attente observavit.

unit.source: Being in shadow form didn’t prevent him from doing this since shadow beings could still “see” the real world, though the perspective was slightly different.
unit.target: Forma umbratilis eum non prohibuit, quoniam entia umbra adhuc mundum verum videre poterant, etsi prospectus paulo diversus videbatur.

unit.source: As the two pirates arranged the food on the long table in the captain’s cabin, Lumian’s eyes reflected the illusory river of fate composed of complex mercury symbols.
unit.target: Dum duo piratae cibos in longa mensa cubiculi capitani disponebant, oculi Lumiani efferebant flumen fatum illusorium, ex symbolis mercurii intricatis compositum.

unit.source: Given that they were less than fifteen meters apart, Lumian extended his right palm, letting it stay at the edge of the shadow, and remotely touched Howl Constantine’s river of fate.
unit.target: Cum inter se minus quam quindecim metra distant, Lumian dextram manum protulit, eam ad limitem umbrae relinquit, et tactu remoto flumen fatum Howl Constantine attigit.

unit.source: Most of Admiral Deep Sea’s fate fragments instantly materialized, flowing turbulently.
unit.target: Plurima fragmina fatum Admiralis Profundi Maris statim apparuerunt, turbulenter fluentes.

unit.source: Knowing time was limited, Lumian could only browse briefly.
unit.target: Scientes tempus limitatum esse, Lumian breviter tantum perlustrare potuit.

unit.source: He saw Howl Constantine diving in the dark, lightless ocean depths, fighting a half-giant over two and a half meters tall wielding a huge sword.
unit.target: Vidit Howl Constantine in obscuris, luce carentibus profunditatibus oceanicis submergi, et cum semigiante, plus quam duo et dimidium metra altus, magnam gladium gerente pugnare.

unit.source: He watched as Admiral Deep Sea passed through ruins filled with bizarre buildings and saw his future self removing the translucent octopus from his face…
unit.target: Observavit dum Admiralis Profundi Maris per ruinas aedificiis insolitis completas transiret, et se futurum, octopodium translucens de facie tollentem, vidit.

unit.source: Removing the octopus clinging to his face?
unit.target: Evertensne octopodium, quod faciem eius adhaeret?

unit.source: It isn’t Howl Constantine’s face; it’s a mask?
unit.target: Non est facies Howl Constantine; larva est?

unit.source: He isn’t a descendant of sea monsters?
unit.target: Nonne ex monstris maris descendit?

unit.source: Lumian was stunned.
unit.target: Lumian attonitus erat.

unit.source: Reflexively, he decided on the fate fragment he would exchange.
unit.target: Instinctu reflexo, decrevit fragmentum fatum commutare.

unit.source: It was a fragment of Howl Constantine being injured on the seabed.
unit.target: Erat fragmentum fatum in quo Howl Constantine in fundo maris laesus esset.

unit.source: In this fate fragment, back when he was only Sequence 7 or 6, Howl Constantine failed to return to the surface in time, suffering the crushing pressure of deep water and the suffocating sensation of liquid flooding his lungs.
unit.target: In hoc fragmento fato, cum solum esset Sequenciae VII vel VI, Howl Constantine non potuit in superficiem redire in tempore, patiens grave pressuram aquae profundae et suffocantem sensum liquoris pulmonibus inundantis.

unit.source: This was different in severity from Moran Admiral Deep Sea’s fate fragment of lust outburst, which had irrevocably changed Moran’s fate, forcing him to an early death.
unit.target: Hoc differebat a fragmento fatum Morani, Admiralis Profundi Maris, de impetu libidinis, quod fatum eius irrevocabiliter mutaverat, cogens eum ad mortem praecoce.

unit.source: In contrast, this fragment merely influenced Howl Constantine’s subsequent exploration style, making him more cautious.
unit.target: Contra, hic fragmentum modum expeditionis ulterioris Howl Constantine affecit, eum cautiorem reddens.

unit.source: However, Lumian couldn’t find a more suitable fragment in such a short time.
unit.target: Attamen, Lumian non potuit invenire fragmentum magis idoneum in tam brevi tempore.

unit.source: As fate began to swap, Howl Constantine, who was seeing off the two pirates, suddenly turned his gaze towards Lumian’s hiding spot.
unit.target: Dum fatum commutari coepit, Howl Constantine, qui duo piratas dimittere videbat, subito oculos suos in latibulum Lumiani vertit.

unit.source: His spirituality had warned him!
unit.target: Spiritualitas eius eum monebat!

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Admiral Deep Sea’s eyes lit up with intense lightning.
unit.target: Paene simul, oculi Admiralis Profundi Maris fulmine intenso micaverunt.

unit.source: With a crackling sound, thick lightning struck Lumian’s hiding spot, hitting the wall and shattering into countless tiny electric serpents, which spread out, covering the area with their fierce and erratic energy, using the properties of the metal door, walls, and floor to launch indiscriminate attacks inside and outside the captain’s cabin.
unit.target: Cum sono crepitanti, fulmen crassum latibulum Lumiani percussit, parietem afficiens, et in innumeras parvas electricas serpentes disrupit, qui diffuderunt, totum spatium acerrima et erratica energia tegens, proprietatibus ianuae metallicae, parietum et pavimenti utentibus ad impetus indiscriminatos intra et extra cubiculi capitani incutiendos.

unit.source: The two food-delivering pirates were hit first, their bodies trembling and convulsing as if performing a grotesque dance.
unit.target: Duo piratae, qui cibos ferentes erant, primo percussi sunt, corpora eorum tremula et convulsa quasi saltationem deformem exhibentes.

unit.source: Their skin quickly charred.
unit.target: Cutis eorum celeriter combusta est.

unit.source: Amid the cracking sound, mirrors hidden in the shadows where Franca and Jenna were hiding shattered, but the Demonesses’ figures did not appear.
unit.target: Inter sonos crepitantes, specula in umbris, ubi Franca et Jenna latebant, confracta sunt, sed figurae Demonessarum non apparuerunt.

unit.source: At the Carnival Bar, Great Shark Jorg and his companions, including Ship Destroyer, had just entered the hall and were staring at the unknown adventurer’s back.
unit.target: Apud Tabernam Carnavalem, Magnus Squalus Jorg et comites eius, inter quos Ship Destroyer inclusus erat, modo in aulam intraverunt et tergum ignoti viatoris intuentes erant.

unit.source: Before they could speak, the noisy surroundings abruptly fell silent.
unit.target: Priusquam loqui poterant, strepitus circumstantium subito silentium ceperunt.

unit.source: The pirates’ chatter and conversations seemed muffled, vanishing instantly.
unit.target: Orationes piratarum et colloquia illorum quasi opacata videbantur, et statim evanuerunt.

unit.source: Wh- Great Shark Jorg instinctively looked towards the window, seeing the dim sunlight through the fog replaced by deep darkness.
unit.target: Magnus Squalus Jorg instinctive ad fenestram respexit, et vidit solem pallidum per nebulam, quod obscuritate profunda substituebatur.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian, sitting at the bar, turned on his stool.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian, sedens ad bar, in sellam ligneam consedit.

unit.source: His expression was indifferent, his gaze calm, looking at the few big pirates as if they were dead men.
unit.target: Vultus eius indifferens erat, oculi tranquilli, et paucos piratas magnos quasi mortuos spectabat.

unit.source: A huge crimson-white fireball shot out.
unit.target: Inlatus est ingens globus ignis coccineo-albus.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: Amidst the flames and wind from the explosion, the pirates either used their agility or abilities to dodge in different directions.
unit.target: Inter flammas et ventos explosionis, piratae aut agilitate aut facultatibus suis utebantur ad diversas partes se evitare.

unit.source: Behind Ship Destroyer, Lumian’s figure swiftly emerged in the chaos, letting out a hum.
unit.target: Post Ship Destroyer, figura Lumiani celeriter in caos apparuit, mormorans.

unit.source: Two beams of white light shot from his nose, causing Ship Destroyer to faint instantly.
unit.target: Duae radii lucis albae ex naso eius emissae sunt, facientes ut Ship Destroyer statim exanimi fieret.

unit.source: Witnessing this, Great Shark Jorg felt a chill down his spine, instinctively muttering to himself, “Formidable…”
unit.target: Hoc testante, Magnus Squalus Jorg frigus per dorsum sentit, instinctive sibi murmurans: “Formidolosum…”

unit.source: Aboard the Newins.
unit.target: In nave Newins.

unit.source: Having used the Lightning Strike ability and created an area attack effect utilizing the current environment, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, had a figure suddenly appear behind him.
unit.target: Postquam facultatem Fulgoris Ictus usus et effectum impulsionis areae ex ambitu currente creaverat, Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, figuram subito post se apparere vidit.

unit.source: It was Franca, dressed in an assassin’s suit.
unit.target: Illa erat Franca, in vestitu sicarii induta.

unit.source: Franca gripped an almost invisible triangular spike in her right hand while raising her left palm, with an iron-black spiked ring targeting Howl Constantine.
unit.target: Franca in manu dextra spiculum triangularis fere invisibilem tenuit, dum manum sinistram extollens, anulo ferro nigro aculeato ad Howl Constantine destinato intendebat.

unit.source: Lightning flickered in her eyes.
unit.target: Fulmen in oculis eius micabat.

unit.source: As Franca used Psychic Piercing on Howl Constantine, Jenna appeared by the door, throwing a Louis d’or at Admiral Deep Sea, seemingly to distract him and make him momentarily ignore Franca’s assassination attempt.
unit.target: Dum Franca “Percussione Psychica” in Howl Constantine adhibebat, Jenna ad ostium apparuit et moneta Louis d’or in Admiralem Profundi Maris iecit, quasi eum distraheret atque conatum sicarii Francae paulisper neglegeret.

unit.source: A golden brooch carved into a gorse flower was pinned to her chest.
unit.target: Fibula aurea, in florem ulex sculpta, ad pectus eius affixa erat.

unit.source: Covered in gray-white scales, Anthony appeared in the corridor, with tiny electric serpents still crawling over his body, paralyzing him and preventing rapid movement.
unit.target: Anthony, squamis cinereo-albis opertus, in corrido apparuit, cum parvis electricis serpentibus super corpus eius reperebus, eum paralysantes et motum rapidum prohibentes.

unit.source: But this didn’t stop Anthony from using his ability.
unit.target: Sed hoc Anthony non prohibuit ut facultatem suam adhiberet.

unit.source: Staring at Admiral Deep Sea, with a translucent octopus clinging to his face, his pupils turned vertical, glowing golden.
unit.target: Intuens Admiralem Profundi Maris, cui faciei eius octopodus translucens adhaerebat, pupillae verticaliter conversae sunt, aureo lumine fulgentibus.

unit.source: Awe!
unit.target: Stupor!

unit.source: This ability made the target feel as if they encountered a true dragon, panicking instantly.
unit.target: Haec facultas destinatum faciebat se sentire quasi verum draconem occurrere, ita ut statim in panico versaretur.

unit.source: As fate began to swap and Howl Constantine noticed the anomaly, he struck out lightning.
unit.target: Dum fatum commutari coepit et Howl Constantine anomaliam animadvertit, fulmen percussit.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian teleported into the captain’s cabin, landing on a wooden chair by the window.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian se teleportavit in cubiculum capitani, consedens in sella lignea iuxta fenestram.

unit.source: Soon, tiny electric serpents covered the area, but they didn’t last long due to the wooden chair’s material.
unit.target: Mox parvi electrici serpentes totam aream tegerunt, sed propter materiam sellae lignae breve manserunt.

unit.source: This caused Lumian’s body to show signs of paralysis.
unit.target: Hoc efficit ut corpus Lumiani signa paralysi exhiberet.

unit.source: However, he didn’t reveal himself because he was now a true shadow creature, and no shadow being would leave the shadows due to a mild electric shock.
unit.target: Attamen, se non patefecit, quia nunc vere umbratica creatura erat, nec ullum ens umbratile umbras relinqueret propter levem ictum electricum.

unit.source: Lumian chose to stay in the shadow provided by the wooden chair, quietly watching the upcoming battle.
unit.target: Lumian decrevit in umbra, quam sella lignea praebebat, manere, silentiose proelium futurum intuens.

unit.source: During the fate exchange, he couldn’t attack Howl Constantine, which would interrupt the process.
unit.target: Inter commutationem fati, Howl Constantine oppugnare non potuit, quod processum interrumperet.

unit.source: So, the next step was to see if Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, three Beyonders below Sequence 5, could hold off Admiral Deep Sea for at least two minutes!
unit.target: Itaque, gradus proximus erat videre si Franca, Jenna, et Anthony, tres Beyonders infra Sequenciam V, Admiralem Profundi Maris saltem per duas minuta detinere posset!

unit.source: Of course, if they really needed to kill Howl Constantine, Anthony could do it quickly with the Winter is Coming revolver, but that was impractical and went against their original goal.
unit.target: Certe, si vere Howl Constantine occidere oporteret, Anthony id celeriter per revolver “Winter is Coming” conficere potuisset, sed hoc inopportunum atque contra propositum eorum erat.

unit.source: Awe and Psychic Piercing hit Howl Constantine, but the Admiral’s face, fused with the translucent octopus, glowed faintly, protecting his soul and spirit, causing only minor effects.
unit.target: Awe et Percussio Psychica Howl Constantine percuterunt, sed facies Admiralis, cum octopodo translucido coniuncta, leniter lucebat, animam ac spiritum eius protegens, effectus minores producens.

unit.source: As his octopus-like face dimmed slightly, Howl Constantine, puzzled by the unfamiliar assassins, suspected some adventurer group wanted to make a name for themselves and earn a huge bounty.
unit.target: Dum facies eius, similis octopodi, paullo obscurata est, Howl Constantine, ab ignotis sicariis perplexus, suspicatus est quod aliquis coetus viatorum se glorificare atque ingentem praemium adipisci velle.

unit.source: Enduring the dizziness, he grabbed an obsidian trident from the nearby weapon rack and thrust it at Franca.
unit.target: Vertiginem tolerans, tridentem obsidianum ex armario proximo arripuit et Francam impulit.

unit.source: The trident immediately surged with violently flickering silver-white lightning, its heavy tip seemingly trying to pull Franca onto itself.
unit.target: Tridens statim, fulmine argenteo-albo violenter micante, pervultus est, cuius grave apex quasi Francam ad se trahere conabatur.

unit.source: Crack!
unit.target: Crepitus!

unit.source: Franca’s body, clad in the assassin’s suit, shattered into numerous mirror fragments, while Jenna threw a silent black flame at Howl Constantine before hiding in the shadows again.
unit.target: Corpus Francae, in vestitu sicarii indutum, in innumeras fragmenta specularum confractus est, dum Jenna flammam nigram tacitam in Howl Constantine iecit, antequam iterum in umbras se occultavit.

unit.source: Anthony also pulled out the exquisite Winter is Coming revolver, aiming at Admiral Deep Sea for a standard shot.
unit.target: Anthony quoque revolver “Winter is Coming” exquisitus eduxit, in Admiralem Profundi Maris ictum ordinarium intendens.

unit.source: The gunshot had just sounded when a sharp wind pierced everyone’s ears.
unit.target: Ictus sclopeti modo auditus erat, cum ventus acutus auribus omnium percussus est.

unit.source: Howl Constantine, wrapped in a whirlwind, flew into the air, avoiding the yellow bullet and eerie black flame.
unit.target: Howl Constantine, in turbine involutus, in aether volavit, bullam flavam et flammam nigram terribiles vitans.

unit.source: He then pointed the obsidian trident at Anthony.
unit.target: Tum tridentem obsidianum ad Anthony intendit.

unit.source: The silver-white currents on the trident converged into thick lightning, shooting out.
unit.target: Rivi fulminis argenteo-albae in tridente in densum fulmen confluere coeperunt, quod eiecit.

unit.source: Anthony, experienced as ever, immediately dove away from the door, changing his position and avoiding the direct hit from the lightning, though the resulting tiny electric serpents still affected him, causing his body to tremble and paralyze.
unit.target: Anthony, semper peritus, statim a porta se abstraxit, locum mutans et ictum directum fulminis vitans, licet parvi electrici serpentes ex consequentibus eum adhuc afficerent, corpus eius tremens et paralyticum facientes.

unit.source: The two pirates, just recovering from the previous shock, were struck by the new wave, falling unconscious and twitching on the ground.
unit.target: Duo piratae, modo ex praecedente ictu reviviscentes, novo fluctus percussi sunt, incoscientes cadentes et in terra convulsi.

unit.source: Franca and Jenna were also affected by the indiscriminate attack, revealing themselves from their hidden states.
unit.target: Franca et Jenna etiam impetu indiscriminato affectae sunt, se ex latenti condicione revelantes.

unit.source: Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, showed no joy or bloodthirsty emotion but grew more vigilant, his octopus-like face showing doubt.
unit.target: Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, nullam laetitiam aut cupiditatem sanguinolentam ostendit, sed vigilantior factus est, facies eius, similis octopodi, dubitationem patefecit.

unit.source: There should be one more assassin!
unit.target: Debetur esse adhuc unus sicarius!

unit.source: Why hasn’t he appeared?
unit.target: Cur non apparuit?

unit.source: What is he preparing?
unit.target: Quid parat?

unit.source: At that moment, out of the corner of his eye, Howl Constantine saw a figure leisurely sitting on the wooden chair near the window.
unit.target: Illo momento, ex angulo oculi, Howl Constantine vidit figuram leniter in sella lignea iuxta fenestram sedere.

unit.source: The figure had black hair, blue eyes, a handsome face, and wore a thick dark jacket, reclining against the chair with his right foot resting on his left knee, a mocking smile on his face.
unit.target: Figura capillos nigrantes, oculos caeruleos, vultum formosum habebat, et veste crassa obscura induta erat, recubans contra sellam, cum pede dextro in genu sinistro reposito, risu irrisorio in facie.

unit.source: 785 Performance
unit.target: 785 Praestatio

unit.source: 785 Performance
unit.target: 785 Praestatio

unit.source: Seeing the assassin who had been hiding suddenly sit openly on a chair by the window, calmly watching him as if he didn’t care about the ongoing battle, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, felt a sudden heavy weight in his heart.
unit.target: Videntes sicarium, qui antea latens versabatur, repente aperte in sella iuxta fenestram sedere et eum tranquille spectare, quasi de proelio continuo nihil curaret, admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, subitaneum grave pondus in corde sensit.

unit.source: Such a posture and expression suggested that the opponent didn’t consider him a threat and was absolutely confident in dealing with him.
unit.target: Talibus habitibus et vultu insigne ostendebat hostem eum non minacem putare atque omnino fidere se posse adversus eum agere.

unit.source: That’s why he didn’t attack immediately to support his companions but instead sat there, arrogantly smiling and observing.
unit.target: Ideo non statim impetum tulit ut socios adiuvaret, sed potius illuc sedebat, superbe subridens et attentus omnibus rebus.

unit.source: Without any hesitation, Howl Constantine instinctively aimed his obsidian trident at Lumian.
unit.target: Sine ulla mora, Howl Constantine instinctu tridentem suum obsidianum in Lumian direxit.

unit.source: A bolt of silver-white lightning formed in his hand, amplified by the trident’s tip, and shot out like a raging thunder serpent towards Lumian.
unit.target: Fulmen argenteo-album in manu eius formatum, in vertice tridenti confirmatum, velut furiantis tonitrui serpens ad Lumian iaculatum est.

unit.source: Lumian kept his right foot on his left knee, his face bearing a mocking smile as if Howl Constantine’s desperate counterattack was just child’s play, incapable of changing the outcome at all.
unit.target: Lumian pedem dextrum in genu sinistro reposuit, facie subridens, quasi confutatio desperata Howl Constantine esset solum ludus puerilis, qui omnino eventum mutare non posset.

unit.source: Of course, this was just a front he put on.
unit.target: Certe, hoc solum simulacrum fuit quod ostentavit.

unit.source: In reality, he couldn’t attack Howl Constantine or leave the hundred‐meter range, or else the Fate Exchange would be interrupted.
unit.target: Revera, non poterat Howl Constantine oppugnare nec spatium centum metrorum relinquere, alioquin Fatum Commutatio interrumpi velle videbatur.

unit.source: But not being able to attack didn’t mean he couldn’t influence the current battle.
unit.target: Sed quod oppugnare non poterat, non significabat se in proelio praesenti influere non posse.

unit.source: Lumian left his shadow form and deliberately revealed his presence to Howl Constantine, using himself as bait to attract most of Admiral Deep Sea’s attention and create a sense of pressure and fear, forcing him to react hastily and increase the chance of making mistakes.
unit.target: Lumian umbraticam formam reliquit et conscio animo praesentiam suam palam Howl Constantine revelavit, se ipsam uti praeda ad maiorem attentionem Admiralis Profundi Maris alliciendam atque sensum pressurae et timoris creando, eum impellens ut festinanter responderet et occasionem errorum augeret.

unit.source: Even a Hunter who couldn’t strike, speak, or communicate could still provoke, scheme, and set traps!
unit.target: Etiam Venator, qui non poterat ferire, loqui aut communicare, adhuc provocare, machinari et laquearia insidiari poterat!

unit.source: The thick silver-white thunder serpent struck Lumian.
unit.target: Serpens tonitrui crassus argenteo-albus Lumian percussit.

unit.source: With a crack, Lumian’s figure shattered like a mirror, leaving only the quickly charred wooden chair behind in the ravaging lightning.
unit.target: Cum crepitu, figura Lumiani quasi speculum fracta est, solam celeriter combustam sellam ligneam in fulmine vastante relinquens.

unit.source: He disappeared again, and the thunder serpent, constrained by the chair’s material, didn’t dissipate much.
unit.target: Iterum evanuit, et serpens tonitrui, materiae sellae coartatus, non multum evanuit.

unit.source: This made Howl Constantine anxious, considering whether to break through the window and dive into the sea.
unit.target: Hoc Howl Constantine anxium fecit, dum meditatus est utrum fenestram frangeret et in mare mergi vellet.

unit.source: Underwater, he feared no Beyonder below demigod level!
unit.target: Sub aqua, nullum Beyonder infra gradum semideus timebat!

unit.source: Even many Saints couldn’t dive into the depths to fight him!
unit.target: Etiam multi Sancti in profundum mergi ad eum pugnandum non poterant!

unit.source: Just then, he felt his limbs and body being bound layer by layer, making it difficult to move or turn the obsidian trident quickly.
unit.target: Mox sensit membra et corpus suum strato post stratum vincta esse, quod movere aut celeriter tridentem obsidianum convertere difficile faciebat.

unit.source: The bindings tightened rapidly.
unit.target: Vincula celeriter stringebantur.

unit.source: Taking advantage of Lumian drawing away most of Howl Constantine’s attention and caution, Franca had set up the spider silk of a Demoness of Pleasure, entangling Admiral Deep Sea layer by layer.
unit.target: Ex commoditate quod Lumian magnam partem attentionis et cautelae Howl Constantini abstulit, Franca filum araneum daemonissae Voluptatis posuit, quo Admiralis Profundi Maris strato post stratum implicabatur.

unit.source: Faced with this restricted situation, Howl Constantine stopped and let the translucent octopus on his face glow with dawn-like brilliance.
unit.target: Ob hanc condicionem restrictam, Howl Constantine sistit et permisit polypode translucenti in facie sua quasi aurorae splendore fulgere.

unit.source: The light suddenly exploded into countless fragments, sweeping through the captain’s cabin like a storm.
unit.target: Lumen repente in innumerabilia fragmenta dispersum est, per cellam capitanei quasi tempestas transvolans.

unit.source: The long table with food shattered into pieces, the metal walls were marked with deep scratches, and Franca and Jenna’s figures shattered into countless mirror fragments again, while the invisible spider silk broke inch by inch, unable to restrain Howl Constantine any longer.
unit.target: Mensa longa cum cibo in partes dirupta est, parietes metallici scalpitibus profundis notabantur, et figurae Francae atque Jennae iterum in innumerabilia fragmenta speculi dirutae sunt, dum filum araneum invisibile ex unius unci passu frangebatur, iam Howl Constantinem tenere non posse.

unit.source: In the corridor, away from the captain’s cabin door, Anthony was unaffected by the light storm, as was Lumian outlined beside him.
unit.target: In corridorio, procul a porta cellae capitanei, Antonius a luce tempestatis non affectus erat, sicut et Lumian, qui iuxta eum delineatus apparuit.

unit.source: Lumian placed his hand on the metal sliding door of the staircase, using his contractual ability.
unit.target: Lumian manum posuit super ianuam metallicam labilem scalae, facultate sua contractuali utendo.

unit.source: He enclosed the area within the Bottle of Fiction, with the entry and exit condition being female.
unit.target: Inclusit aream intra “Bottle of Fiction”, cum conditione introitu et egressus esse femina.

unit.source: This effectively blocked any rescue attempts by the pirates, preventing interference in their battle.
unit.target: Hoc efficaciter conatus salutis a piratis interclusit, interpositionem in eorum proelio prohibens.

unit.source: Except for teams with female captains, most pirate ships had very few female Beyonders, if any at all.
unit.target: Nisi turmas cum gubernatricibus feminis, plerae naves piraticae valde paucas feminas Beyonder habebant, si quidem habebant.

unit.source: The non-Beyonder women on board were merely ship prostitutes, incapable of becoming regular pirates.
unit.target: Feminae, quae non erant Beyonder, in nave tantum meretrices navales erant, neque possunt ordinarii piratae fieri.

unit.source: Outside the Carnival Bar.
unit.target: Extra Taberna Carnivalis.

unit.source: The real pirates, the disguised Mason, and the rest simultaneously noticed that the glass windows no longer reflected the scene of Great Shark Jörg and the others fighting the unknown adventurer.
unit.target: Piratae veri, Mason dissimulatus, et reliqui simul animadverterunt fenestras vitreas iam non repraesentare scaenam Magni Squalo Jörg et aliorum cum ignoto adventore pugnantium.

unit.source: The glass appeared dim, showing the bar’s interior with no bartender or customers.
unit.target: Vitrum obscurum videbatur, ostendens interiora tabernae sine poculatoribus aut clientibus.

unit.source: “What happened?” a pirate asked loudly, uncertainly.
unit.target: «Quid accidit?» inquit pirata alte et incertus.

unit.source: “What ability was used?” Similar questions echoed.
unit.target: «Quae facultas adhibita est?» quaestiones similiter resonabant.

unit.source: They all suspected the unknown adventurer was behind the changes, as Great Shark and his crew wouldn’t hide their fight; they would want to showcase their strength to more pirates.
unit.target: Omnes suspicabant ignotum adventorem mutationum auctor esse, quia Magni Squalo et turma eius pugnam suam non ocultabant, sed virtutem suam pluribus piratis ostendere vellent.

unit.source: Within the Bottle of Fiction.
unit.target: Intra Vas Ficti.

unit.source: Great Shark Jörg, wearing black gloves, was surrounded by signs of explosions and charred marks.
unit.target: Magnus Squalo Jörg, manicas nigras gerens, erat circumdatus signis explosionum et vestigiis combustis.

unit.source: He had timely distorted the unknown adventurer’s attack intent, avoiding injury in the recent bombardment.
unit.target: Tempestive impetum ignoti adventoris consilium distorsit, ita ut in recente bombardamento laesus non esset.

unit.source: However, his companion, Ship Destroyer, another Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, had long been unconscious from a combination of Beyonder powers and explosion damage.
unit.target: Attamen comes eius, Navis Exstinctor, alius Beyonder per semitam Venatoris, diu ex mixtura virium Beyonder et damnis explosionis in statu inconscientiae versabatur.

unit.source: The other pirates were also scattered, none unscathed.
unit.target: Ceteri piratae quoque dispersi erant, nemo intactus.

unit.source: Gazing at the unknown black-haired, blue-eyed adventurer several meters away, Great Shark Jörg cursed the teleportation ability.
unit.target: Intuens ignotum adventorem, qui capillis nigris et oculis caeruleis, nonnullis metris distante esset, Magnus Squalo Jörg virtutem teleportationis maledixit.

unit.source: Just as he was about to shift positions and attempt a Bribe, the handsome adventurer’s figure rapidly faded like a projection and disappeared.
unit.target: Modo cum locum mutare et “Bribe” conari pararet, figura venustissimi adventoris quasi imago celeriter evanuit et evanita est.

unit.source: Worried it was another teleportation, Great Shark Jörg dove to the side, turning to look behind him.
unit.target: Timens ne altera teleportatio esset, Magnus Squalo Jörg ad latus delapsus est, et se convertens ut post se spectaret.

unit.source: Nothing happened.
unit.target: Nihil evenit.

unit.source: Jörg and the remaining pirates, suspicious and tense, maneuvered cautiously multiple times, but the adventurer never reappeared.
unit.target: Jörg et ceteri piratae, suspicaces et anxii, pluries caute moverunt, sed adventor numquam redivit.

unit.source: Finally, the bald Great Shark began to grasp the situation.
unit.target: Denique, calvus Magnus Squalo, rem comprehendere coepit.

unit.source: That was just an illusion?
unit.target: Numquid hoc solum illusio fuit?

unit.source: We fought an illusion and nearly lost?
unit.target: Illusionem pugnavimus et prope perdidimus?

unit.source: Where did the real one go?
unit.target: Quo abiit verus?

unit.source: Realizing this, Great Shark Jörg blurted out, “Sh*t! The Newins!”
unit.target: Hoc intellegens, Magnus Squalo Jörg subito exclamavit: “Stercus! Newini!”

unit.source: The unknown adventurer’s real target was the Newins and the Admiral!
unit.target: Verus destinatus ignoti adventoris Newini et Admiralis erat!

unit.source: Jörg and the others grew anxious but were trapped in the Bottle of Fiction, unable to get out.
unit.target: Jörg et ceteri anxii facti sunt, sed in Vas Ficti inclusi, exire non poterant.

unit.source: After trying several methods and abilities without success, they resorted to violent disassembly.
unit.target: Postquam varias rationes et virtutes sine successu temptaverunt, ad dissectionem violentam confugere decreverunt.

unit.source: Aboard the Newins.
unit.target: In nave Newins.

unit.source: As the light storm began to subside, Jenna quickly appeared behind Admiral Deep Sea, in a blind spot created by his own body.
unit.target: Dum tempestas lucis coepit subsidere, Jenna celeriter apparuit post Admiralem Profundi Maris, in angulo caeco a corpore ipsius creato.

unit.source: Then, using all her strength, she stabbed a dagger covered in silent black flames into Howl Constantine’s back.
unit.target: Tum, omni vi utendo, pugionem silentibus nigris flammis opertum in tergo Howl Constantini confodit.

unit.source: Although he couldn’t turn or redirect the trident in time, Howl Constantine remained unfazed.
unit.target: Etsi tridentem convertere aut tempore opportuno dirigere non potuit, Howl Constantine impassibilis mansit.

unit.source: From his cloak emerged a silver-white lightning bolt that struck Jenna at a speed too fast to dodge.
unit.target: Ex pallio eius emersit fulmen argenteo-album, quod Jenna ictu adeo celeri percussit ut evadere nequeat.

unit.source: Countless tiny electric serpents coursed over Jenna’s body, but she seemed largely unharmed and only slightly slowed.
unit.target: Innumerabiles parvuli serpentuli electricae per corpora Jennae percurrebant, sed illa vix laesa et parum retardata videbatur.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: The dagger covered in black flames pierced Howl Constantine’s black cloak.
unit.target: Pugio, nigris flammis opertus, pallium nigrum Howl Constantini perforavit.

unit.source: At the beginning of the fight, Jenna had thrown a Louis d’or at Howl Constantine, not to seek luck but to activate the Decency brooch, completing a Bribe that significantly weakened his attacks, defenses, and controls against her for a while!
unit.target: In initio pugnae, Jenna “Louis d’or” in Howl Constantinem iecit, non qua fortunam peteret sed fibulam “Decency” activandam, complens Bribe, quae impetum, defensionem et moderationem eius contra eam per aliquod tempus signanter debilitavit!

unit.source: Since then, neither the rampaging lightning nor the light storm had affected her as much as she let on.
unit.target: Ex tunc, nec tonitrus saevitus nec tempestas lucis eam quantum affecerat, ut ipsa patefecit.

unit.source: Her frantic dodging and use of the Mirror Substitution were meant to psychologically deceive Admiral Deep Sea!
unit.target: Fugam impetuosam et usum speculi substitutionis ad fallendum psychologice Admiralem Profundi Maris destinabantur!

unit.source: She didn’t expect Howl Constantine to be unaware of the Bribe ability, given that his deputy was likely a Briber.
unit.target: Non exspectabat Howl Constantinem se facultate “Bribe” nescire, cum eius vicarius probabiliter “Briber” esset.

unit.source: Instead, she performed as if the Bribe had failed, leading him to attribute the Louis d’or toss to another ability.
unit.target: Contra, se gessit quasi “Bribe” defecerit, inducens eum ut iactum “Louis d’or” ad aliam facultatem attribueret.

unit.source: At the start, Howl Constantine might still have guarded against the Bribe, but in the heat of battle, and with time running short, he instinctively responded without caution.
unit.target: In initio, Howl Constantine fortasse contra “Bribe” vigiliam habuit, sed in ardore pugnae et cum tempus deficeret, instinctu sine cautela respondit.

unit.source: Thus, he ignored the Bribe from before and didn’t stop Jenna’s assassination!
unit.target: Itaque, Bribe priorem neglexit et caedem Jennae non sistere permisit!

unit.source: With a pfft, the black-flamed dagger pierced Howl Constantine’s cloak and flesh.
unit.target: Cum “pfft”, pugio, nigris flammis opertus, pallium et carnem Howl Constantini perforavit.

unit.source: Acting was for a better assassination!
unit.target: Agere erat ad meliorem caedem obtinendam!

unit.source: After the successful strike, Jenna felt a strong resistance and wriggling flesh as if alive, preventing further progress with the dagger despite her full strength.
unit.target: Post ictum felicem, Jenna sensit validam repulsionem atque carnem contorquens quasi animata, quae ulteriorem pugionis progressum impediebat, quamquam omni vi sua utebatur.

unit.source: She abandoned force, instead channeling the black flames into Howl Constantine’s body.
unit.target: Virtutem reliquit, potius flammis nigris in corpus Howl Constantini infundens.

unit.source: As the black flames surged, Admiral Deep Sea howled in pain.
unit.target: Dum flammae nigrae increabant, Admiralis Profundi Maris dolore ululavit.

unit.source: Franca seized the opportunity to reach Howl Constantine’s side, stabbing the transparent Wintry Blade into Admiral Deep Sea.
unit.target: Franca occasionem arripuit ut ad latus Howl Constantini perveniret, et “Wintry Blade” transparentem in Admiralem Profundi Maris confodens.

unit.source: The Wintry Blade pierced the skin and flesh but couldn’t go deeper into Howl Constantine’s body.
unit.target: “Wintry Blade” cutem atque carnem penetravit, sed in corpus Howl Constantini profundius penetrare non potuit.

unit.source: But it was enough.
unit.target: Sed id sufficiebat.

unit.source: Howl Constantine’s body stiffened as if frozen, and his thoughts became sluggish.
unit.target: Corpus Howl Constantini riguit quasi congelatum, et cogitationes eius tardari coeperunt.

unit.source: Franca slid to Jenna’s side, retracting the Wintry Blade.
unit.target: Franca ad latus Jennae labitur, retrahens “Wintry Blade.”

unit.source: Simultaneously, she flipped out a compact mirror with her left hand, reflecting Howl Constantine’s body.
unit.target: Simul, manu sinistra speculum compactum extulit, quod corpus Howl Constantini reflexit.

unit.source: Then, with her right hand, she smeared black flames on the mirror’s surface.
