unit.source: In this world, many have died from pleasure without being attacked.
unit.target: In hoc mundo, multi ex voluptate mortui sunt, sine aggressione.

unit.source: Reflecting on this, Howl Constantine noticed a shiny gold Louis d’or at the cabin door.
unit.target: Cogitans de hoc, Howl Constantine aureum nummum “Louis d’or” nitidum ad ianuam cubiculorum animadvertit.

unit.source: It was left by the two Demonesses.
unit.target: Ab duabus daemonissis relinquitus erat.

unit.source: Staring at the water at the doorstep and the gold coin, which had clearly been treated to prevent tracking, Howl Constantine suddenly had a ridiculous thought and fell into an indescribable silence.
unit.target: Intuens aquam ad limen et nummum aureum, qui manifeste tractatus erat ut vestigia prohiberet, Howl Constantine subito cogitationem ridiculam habuit et in silentium ineffabile cecidit.

unit.source: In the motel room rented by Lumian and company in Banamo Port.
unit.target: In cubiculo deversorii a Lumiano et collegis in Portu Banamo conducto.

unit.source: Jenna quickly removed the Scotch Broom-like Decency brooch and submerged it in the aluminum military flask Lumian had given her.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter extraxit fibulam “Decency”, quae similem “Scotch Broom” erat, et eam in lagenula militari ex aluminio, quam Lumian ei dederat, immergit.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, Jenna felt the eyes of Lumian, Franca, and Anthony change significantly.
unit.target: Paene simul, Jenna sensit oculos Lumiani, Francae, et Anthonii signanter mutatos esse.

unit.source: Their gazes now held undisguised disgust, aversion, and malice.
unit.target: Aspectus eorum nunc aperte fastidium, aversionem, et malitiam ostenderunt.

unit.source: Jenna had felt malice from some people in the bars and dance halls of Trier’s Rue Pasteur, but it was often mixed with desire and longing, unlike the pure hatred and loathing now directed at her.
unit.target: Jenna sensit malitiam ab quibusdam in popinis ac in aulis saltationis Trierensis in via Pasteur, sed ea saepe cum cupiditate et desiderio miscebatur, contraria vero purae odii et fastigii nunc in eam directae.

unit.source: Of course, Jenna also noticed a certain amount of desire in Franca’s disgust and aversion, as if she wanted to satisfy herself by domineering over Jenna.
unit.target: Certe, Jenna etiam animadvertit aliquod desiderii quanti in Francae repulsione et aversione, quasi illa per dominationem super Jenna se ipsam satiari velle.

unit.source: Lumian, though his expression remained relatively normal, had a change in his eyes, reflecting an Ascetic’s endurance.
unit.target: Lumian, quamquam vultus eius relative ordinaris mansit, in oculis autem eius mutatio facta est, quae tolerantiam asceticam repraesentabat.

unit.source: He nodded at Jenna and said, “The Decency brooch’s negative effect has taken hold. Go to the next room for an hour.”
unit.target: Ille Jennae annuit et dixit: “Effectus negativus fibulae Decency dominatus est; i ad proximum cubiculum per horam.”

unit.source: “I know.” Jenna glanced at Lumian, recalling past events.
unit.target: “Scio.” inquit Jenna, ad Lumian aspiciens, praeterita recolens.

unit.source: Back then, she had been tasked with protecting Lumian under the negative effect of the Decency brooch, and she had felt the urge to beat him up.
unit.target: Tunc munus eius erat Luminum sub effectu negativo fibulae Decency tueri, atque impetum eum verberandi sensisse.

unit.source: She regretted not taking the chance to draw piles of dogsh*t on his face.
unit.target: Paenitebat quod non cepisset occasionem ut in facie eius acervos stercoris canum depingeret.

unit.source: Recalling these memories, Jenna smiled slightly, left the room, and went to wait for the negative effect to wear off in the next room.
unit.target: Reminiscens haec, Jenna leviter subridens cubiculum reliquit et processit ad exspectandum effectu negativo in proximo cubiculo evanescendo.

unit.source: “Phew, the Decency brooch’s negative effect is really strong…” Franca commented sincerely.
unit.target: “Heu, effectus negativus fibulae Decency vere validus est…” inquit Franca sincere.

unit.source: Lumian gave her a sidelong glance and laughed.
unit.target: Lumian ei aspectum obliquum dedit et risit.

unit.source: “I think your hatred and disgust weren’t pure enough.”
unit.target: “Puto odium et fastidium vestrum non satis purum fuisse.”

unit.source: Franca immediately felt embarrassed, awkwardly smiling as she said, “Sometimes, hatred and disgust can also spark desire. Just ask Anthony!”
unit.target: Franca statim erubuit, leviter risu ornata, dicens: “Interdum, odium et fastidium etiam desiderium excitare possunt. Tantum interroga Anthony!”

unit.source: Before Lumian could turn to him, Anthony spoke up, “It’s true.
unit.target: Antequam Lumian ad eum converteret, Anthony dixit: “Verum est.

unit.source: The human brain and soul are complex.
unit.target: Cerebrum et anima hominis sunt complexa.

unit.source: Different people might develop the same desire from different stimuli.
unit.target: Diversi homines eundem desiderium ex diversis stimulis evolvere possunt.

unit.source: “Some get pleasure from pain, others from jealousy, breaking taboos, being scolded or tortured, or sharing with others, gaining their affection.
unit.target: Quidam voluptatem ex dolore capiunt, alii ex invidia, alii ex violatione praeceptorum, alii ex reprehensione aut tormento, aut ex communicando cum aliis atque eorum affectionem adipiscendo.

unit.source: The possibilities are endless.”
unit.target: Possibilitates sunt infinitæ.

unit.source: “In simple terms, the world is full of perverts?” Lumian mocked Franca.
unit.target: “In terminis simplicibus, mundus est plenus depravatorum?” inquit Lumian, Francam irridens.

unit.source: Franca didn’t take the bait, her expression growing serious as she frowned slightly.
unit.target: Franca non incidit in insidias; vultus eius serio factus est, leviter fronens.

unit.source: Once free from the Decency brooch’s negative effect, she recalled the scene she had witnessed earlier.
unit.target: Postquam liberata est ab effectu negativo fibulae Decency, scaenam priorem, quam antea conspexerat, recoluit.

unit.source: After some thought, she said, “Do you think Admiral Deep Sea’s real appearance resembles Harrison from Resurrection Island?”
unit.target: Postquam paulum cogitavit, inquit: “Putasne veram speciem Admiralis Profundi Maris Harrisonem ex Insula Resurrectionis similem esse?”

unit.source: Lumian recalled and said, “You mean they both have noticeable Eastern features?”
unit.target: Lumian recoluit et dixit: “Scilicet uterque notabilia elementa orientalia habet?”

unit.source: He had seen Franca’s drawing of Harrison.
unit.target: Picturam de Harrison, quam Franca effinxerat, vidit.

unit.source: “Yes, but more like a mix of someone like Harrison and an Intisian or person from the North Continent,” Franca said thoughtfully.
unit.target: “Ita, sed magis ut compositum ex aliquo simili Harrison et Intisiano aut homine ex Continente Septentrionali,” Franca cogitabunda inquit.

unit.source: Because Anthony was present, she didn’t mention the transmigration matter, instead steering towards Resurrection Island.
unit.target: Quia Anthony praesens erat, rem de transmigratione non attinuit, sed potius versus Insulam Resurrectionis inclinavit.

unit.source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Draw Howl Constantine’s portrait, and we’ll write to the Tarot Club Major Arcana card holders.”
unit.target: Cum annuens, Lumian respondit: “Pinge imaginem Howl Constantine, et scribemus ad possessoribus chartarum Tarot Club Major Arcana.”

unit.source: “No need to ask Madam Judgment or Madam Magican yet; I’ll try with Magic Mirror Divination first,” Franca responded immediately.
unit.target: “Non est opus adhuc petere Dominam Iudicium aut Dominam Magicanam; primum conabor Divinationem Speculi Magici,” Franca statim respondit.

unit.source: She began preparing the ritual in the room, sketching Howl Constantine’s features from memory.
unit.target: Ritum in cubiculo parare coepit, lineamenta Howl Constantine ex memoria delineans.

unit.source: This included an appearance similar to Resurrection Island residents, slightly pointed ears, dark blue near-black thick hair, and the tentacle-like dark veins on his hands when holding the obsidian trident.
unit.target: Hoc includebat aspectum similem incolis Insulae Resurrectionis, aures paulo acutatas, capillos densos coloris caerulei fuscati, et venae obscurae, quasi tentacula, in manibus eius, dum tridente obsidiano tenebat.

unit.source: Some details Franca hadn’t noticed during the fight were now retrieved from her memory through the ritual.
unit.target: Nonnulla singularia, quae Franca in certamine non animadvertit, nunc per ritum ex memoria restituta sunt.

unit.source: Lumian examined the portrait for a moment and said, “It does have an Eastern style.”
unit.target: Lumian picturam per momentum consideravit et dixit: “Habent quidem stilum orientalem.”

unit.source: Franca nodded, then busied herself with the Magic Mirror Divination.
unit.target: Franca annuit, tum se occupavit Divinatione Speculi Magici.

unit.source: Soon, the mirror on the desk turned dark, with faint sounds of water echoing within.
unit.target: Mox speculum in mensa obscurum factum est, cum sonis aquae leviter resonantibus intus.

unit.source: Franca picked up the portrait of Admiral Deep Sea and asked the target of the Magic Mirror Divination, “What does this appearance signify?”
unit.target: Franca picturam Admiralis Profundi Maris arripuit et ab obiecto Divinationis Speculi Magici interrogavit: “Quid hanc speciem significat?”

unit.source: She didn’t directly ask about Howl Constantine’s origins, fearing it was beyond the Magic Mirror Divination’s knowledge.
unit.target: Non directe de originibus Howl Constantine quaesivit, metuens id extra scientiam Divinationis Speculi Magici esse.

unit.source: A hoarse, elderly voice emerged from the mirror: “This is an elf.”
unit.target: Vox rauca et senilis ex speculo exortus est: “Hic est elfus.”

unit.source: An elf?
unit.target: Elfus?

unit.source: Lumian’s temples throbbed.
unit.target: Tempora Lumiani pulsabant.

unit.source: This was a legendary Beyonder race!
unit.target: Haec erat gens Beyonder legendaris!

unit.source: Previously, Lumian had only known of elves as a mythical race from ancient times, living on the Sonia Sea’s Sonia Island.
unit.target: Priore tempore, Lumian tantum de elfis novit ut gens mythica ex temporibus antiquis, in Insula Soniae Maris Soniae degentibus.

unit.source: He learned they were powerful, with their queen, Soniathrym, being one of the eight ancient gods, ruling the sky and sea.
unit.target: Didicit eos potentissimos esse, cum regina eorum, Soniathrym, una ex octo diis antiquis, caelum et mare regens.

unit.source: In the real world, encountering a true elf since the Fifth Epoch was rare, only seeing occasional descendants with diluted bloodlines.
unit.target: In mundo reali, verum elfum ab Aetate Quinta convenire raro erat, cum vix aliquando descendentibus cum sanguine diluito conspiciendis.

unit.source: Franca was equally shocked, blurting out, “An elf, or a half-elf mixed with humans?”
unit.target: Franca aeque stupefacta exclamavit: “Elfus, an semielfus cum hominibus mixtus?”

unit.source: “Half-elf,” the hoarse voice responded.
unit.target: “Semielfus,” respondit vox rauca.

unit.source: Though a half-elf, Howl Constantine’s features show a strong elven bloodline…
unit.target: Quamquam semielfus, lineamenta Howl Constantine validam sanguinis elficum demonstrant.

unit.source: In theory, the Sequence 5 Ocean Songster shouldn’t cause such changes…
unit.target: In the theoria, Sequence 5 Ocean Songster talia mutationes non debet provocare.

unit.source: A half-elf?
unit.target: Semielfus?

unit.source: Could the elves be descendants of transmigrators, living and thriving in this world?
unit.target: Possuntne elfi esse posteri transmigratorum, in hoc mundo viventes et florentes?

unit.source: Elf legends date back to the Second Epoch…
unit.target: Legendae elforum ad Secundam Aetatem redeunt.

unit.source: Franca thought deeply, almost forgetting to ask the third question.
unit.target: Franca alte cogitavit, paene tertiam quaestionem obliviscens.

unit.source: Gathering her thoughts, she pondered for a few seconds and asked, “Is the Lost Newins an ancient elven relic?”
unit.target: Cogitationes colligens, paucis secundis meditata, quaesivit: “Num Lost Newins reliquia antiqua elfica sit?”

unit.source: Though elves supposedly lived on Sonia Island in ancient times, they once ruled the seas, so leaving relics in other seas was plausible.
unit.target: Quamquam elfi, ut fertur, in Insula Soniae temporibus antiquis habitaverunt, olim maria regebant; ergo reliquias in aliis maribus relinquere plausibile erat.

unit.source: Yes, if Howl Constantine is a pure-blooded half-elf, it makes sense he wore a mask to disguise as a sea monster.
unit.target: Ita, si Howl Constantine est semielfus sanguine puro, rationabile est eum larvam gerere ad monstrum marinum celandum.

unit.source: The Church of the Lord of Storms supposedly hates pure-blooded elves…
unit.target: Ecclesia Domini Tempestatum, ut fertur, elfos sanguine puro oderit.

unit.source: The elderly voice in the mirror answered Franca’s third question, “I don’t know.”
unit.target: Vox senilis in speculo tertiam quaestionem Francae respondit: “Nescio.”

unit.source: “Alright…” Franca ended the Magic Mirror Divination and fell into a long silence.
unit.target: “Bene…” Franca Divinationem Speculi Magici finivit et in longum silentium cecidit.

unit.source: She suddenly regretted using Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine merely to digest the Pleasure potion this time.
unit.target: Subito paenitebat se quod Admiralem Profundi Maris Howl Constantine solum ad potionem Voluptatis digerendam hoc tempore usus fuisset.

unit.source: Instead of training the team and exchanging fate, they should have gotten Lumian to strike fully with their support to see if they could capture the elf alive.
unit.target: Pro turmam instruenda et fatum commutandum, debuerunt Lumian, plenis suis adiutoriis, totum impetum facere, ut videant an elfum vivum capere possent.

unit.source: 788 Realizations
unit.target: 788 Realizationes

unit.source: 788 Realizations
unit.target: 788 Realizationes

unit.source: Seeing the Magic Mirror Divination come to an end, Lumian turned his gaze to Anthony.
unit.target: Cum Divinatio Speculi Magici finem attigerit, Lumian oculos suos ad Anthony convertit.

unit.source: “The Newins has definitely fled.
unit.target: “Newins certe fugerunt.

unit.source: Go out and gather information from the pirates.
unit.target: Exi et a piratis notitias colligas.

unit.source: Find out if Great Shark Jörg and the key crew members managed to board the ship.
unit.target: Inquire num Magnus Squalus Jörg et nautae praecipui navem conscenderint.

unit.source: If they didn’t, find out where they are now.”
unit.target: Si non, inquere ubi nunc sint.

unit.source: “Understood.”
unit.target: “Intellectum.”

unit.source: Anthony knew Lumian wanted to quickly determine the whereabouts of Great Shark Jörg and his men to see if they could use them to “visit” the Newins again and learn about the elves and the true nature of the Lost Newins.
unit.target: Anthony scivit Lumian celeriter videre velle ubi esset Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites, ut comprobet num eos ad Newins iterum “visitandum” adhibere possent atque de elfis ac de vera natura Newins Perditorum discere.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t go himself; the pirates would avoid him, and even if he forced the information out of them, it would alert Great Shark Jörg and his men if they were still in Banamo Port, making them hide deeper.
unit.target: Lumian ipse ire non potuit; piratae eum vitabant, et etiam si eorum notitias colligere coegisset, hoc Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites, si in Portu Banamo adhuc erant, certiorem fecisset, eosque in altiora latebras ageret.

unit.source: Disguising himself wouldn’t work either; the pirates wouldn’t be friendly or forthcoming.
unit.target: Se celare non sufficeret; piratae neque comiter se gererent neque aperte responderent.

unit.source: The same applied to Franca.
unit.target: Idem de Franca agebat.

unit.source: Only Anthony, who had befriended many pirates, could naturally obtain the needed intel.
unit.target: Solus Anthony, qui multis piratis amicus fuisset, notitias necessarias naturaliter acquirere poterat.

unit.source: After watching Anthony leave the room, Franca sat down at the desk with a sigh.
unit.target: Postquam Anthonym ex conclavi discessisse vidit, Franca cum suspirio ad mensam consedit.

unit.source: “This whole transmigration thing keeps getting more complicated.”
unit.target: “Haec omnis transmigratio semper magis intricata videtur.”

unit.source: “You used to treat it too simply,” Lumian scoffed.
unit.target: “Olim id nimis simpliciter tractabaris,” derisit Lumian.

unit.source: Franca didn’t argue, staying silent for a moment before changing the subject.
unit.target: Franca non contradixit, paulisper tacita mansit antequam rem mutare coepit.

unit.source: “I’ve fully digested the Pleasure potion.
unit.target: “Potionem Voluptatis penitus digestam habeo.

unit.source: After a few days of rest, I’ll be ready to attempt the Demoness of Affliction ritual.”
unit.target: Post paucos dies quietis, paratus ero tentare ritum Demonissae Afflictionis.”

unit.source: “Honestly, it feels like a dream.
unit.target: “Revera, tamquam somnium videtur.

unit.source: Have I really digested it?”
unit.target: Num id vere penitus digestum habeo?

unit.source: She still seemed somewhat incredulous.
unit.target: Illa tamen aliquantulum incredula videbatur.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “What else were you expecting?”
unit.target: “Quid aliud exspectabas?

unit.source: If Admiral Deep Sea knew our main goal was to help you digest the Pleasure potion, he’d think the world was absurd.
unit.target: Si Admiral Profundi Maris sciret finem nostrum principalem esse tibi in potionem Voluptatis digestione auxilium ferre, mundum absurdum putaret.

unit.source: He’d wonder if it was necessary and suggest that with a Demoness of Pleasure’s conditions, we could have just asked for his help with a notarized agreement to prevent harm, and he’d happily assist.”
unit.target: Mirabatur num id necessarium esset et suadebat ut, cum condicionibus Demonissae Voluptatis, auxilium eius per pactum legitimum ad damna vitanda petivissemus, quod libenter adiuvaret.

unit.source: “It’s just hard for me to accept…” Franca muttered.
unit.target: “Mihi hoc accipere vere difficile est…”

unit.source: “And I know what you mean.”
unit.target: “Et scio quid dicas.”

unit.source: In our world, plenty would say, “Helping a Demoness of Pleasure digest a potion is too wicked—please let me help,” but that’s superficial pleasure and low‐quality digestion.
unit.target: In nostro orbe multi dixerunt: “Auxilium ferre Demonissae Voluptatis potionem digerere nimis improbat—quaeso, sinite me auxiliari,” sed id est voluptas superficialis et digestio mediocris.

unit.source: Real pleasure comes from experiencing it in pain and sinking into it.
unit.target: Vera voluptas ex dolore experiendo et in eo se immergendo nascitur.

unit.source: Targeting people like Moran Avigny and Howl Constantine aligns more with the essence of the Demoness path.
unit.target: Eligio hominum similium Moran Avigny et Howl Constantine magis cum essentia viae Demonissae convenit.

unit.source: Lumian was just joking and didn’t continue the topic.
unit.target: Lumian solum iocabatur et rem non prosequi voluit.

unit.source: Franca was silent for a while.
unit.target: Franca paulisper tacita mansit.

unit.source: Then she looked at Lumian and carefully said, “About your plan to spread a plague among the pirates in Banamo Port—I don’t think it’s viable.”
unit.target: Tum Lumian spectavit et caute inquit: “De consilio tuo pestem inter piratas in Portu Banamo diffundendi—non puto id esse viabile.”

unit.source: “Why?” Lumian raised an eyebrow, amused.
unit.target: “Cur?” inquit Lumian, supercilum levans et delectatus.

unit.source: Franca straightened, her gaze unwavering.
unit.target: Franca se rectam posuit, oculis constanter fixis.

unit.source: “I don’t think we can completely separate the guilty pirates from innocent bystanders.
unit.target: “Non puto nos posse piratas reos omnino a innocentiis spectatoribus separare.

unit.source: The plague would inevitably affect the latter, causing them to die in despair.”
unit.target: Peste certo illos afficiet, eos in desperatione mori faciendos.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “It was just a concept, a direction.
unit.target: “Id tantum erat conceptus, directio.

unit.source: We can refine the plan to address those concerns, and if it’s not feasible, we can abandon it.
unit.target: Consilium emendare possumus ad has curas solvendas; et, si non idoneum erit, deserere possumus.

unit.source: We can’t limit our thinking right from the start.”
unit.target: Cogitationem a principio cohibere non possumus.

unit.source: For example, by then, I might be a demigod and find a high-level replacement for the Bottle of Fiction, capable of containing all of Banamo Port with conditions allowing only pirates to enter or exit.
unit.target: Exempli gratia, tum fortasse semideus sim et inveniam substitutum altum pro Ampulla Fictionis, quod totum Portum Banamo condere valeat sub condicionibus ut solum piratae ingressu aut egressu permittantur.

unit.source: “No,” Franca shook her head.
unit.target: “Non,” inquit Franca, caput movens.

unit.source: “There are adventurers who moonlight as pirates, and many of them haven’t committed crimes deserving death.”
unit.target: “Sunt viatores qui simul piratis fiunt, et plerique eorum crimina non fecerunt quae mortem mereantur.”

unit.source: Lumian smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Lumian subridet et suspirat.

unit.source: “Then we’ll collaborate with the Aurora Order or find a Sequence 5 artifact from the Broker path to identify guilty targets.”
unit.target: “Tum aut cum Ordine Aurora collaborabimus aut inveniemus artifactum Sequentionis V ex via Negotiatoris ad reos identificandos.”

unit.source: Franca seriously thought for a moment.
unit.target: Franca per momentum serio cogitavit.

unit.source: “That won’t work either.
unit.target: “Id quoque non operabitur.

unit.source: We have our own crimes.
unit.target: Nostra crimina habemus.

unit.source: Many adventurers have killed pirates.
unit.target: Multi viatores piratas interfecerunt.

unit.source: Does that count as guilty?”
unit.target: Num id inter reos iudicabitur?

unit.source: Lumian was momentarily speechless, then laughed.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper mutus fuit, deinde risit.

unit.source: “You really are suited for switching to Provoker.
unit.target: “Vere es aptus ad Provoker mutandum.

unit.source: “I was just raising examples; my point being that a plan shouldn’t be dismissed outright.
unit.target: “Exempla tantum proposui; mea idea est consilium non statim reiectum esse.

unit.source: We need to analyze its feasibility and consider future changes.”
unit.target: Eius efficaciam perscrutari et mutationes futuras considerare oportet.

unit.source: “Okay.”
unit.target: “Bene.”

unit.source: Franca expressed her opinion and sighed quietly.
unit.target: Franca sententiam suam exposuit et leniter suspiravit.

unit.source: After some thought, she decided to speak frankly to Lumian, “Since discovering the vortex plan, you’ve become more aggressive, like when you first came to Trier.
unit.target: Post aliquam meditationem, decernit sincera verba ad Lumian proferre: “Ex quo consilium vorticis detexisti, magis aggressivus factus es, sicut cum primum ad Trier venisti.

unit.source: Or is it the Devil’s Whispers from Hisoka that’s constantly stirring your malice?
unit.target: An sunt illi Diaboli Susurri a Hisoka, qui constantiter tuam malitiam excitant?

unit.source: The Traveler’s Bag only mitigates its influence; it doesn’t completely eliminate the negative effects.
unit.target: Saccus Viatoris tantum eius vim attenuat; non tamen omnino effectus adversos eliminat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, somewhat self-deprecatingly.
unit.target: Lumian subridens, aliquantulum se ipsum contemnens, risit.

unit.source: “It’s a bit of both.”
unit.target: “Est ex utroque.”

unit.source: He then grew serious.
unit.target: Tum grave factus est.

unit.source: “But more importantly, I’ve come to some realizations.”
unit.target: “Sed potissimum, ad nonnullas realizationes perveni.”

unit.source: “What realizations?” Franca asked, puzzled.
unit.target: “Quae realizationes?” quaesivit Franca, perplexa.

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuit.

unit.source: “I was going to remind you anyway.
unit.target: “Te iam monebar.

unit.source: You’ve been a Demoness for a long time.
unit.target: Diu Demonissa fuisti.

unit.source: Haven’t you noticed the inherent nature of this pathway?”
unit.target: Nonne animadvertisti naturam inherentem huius viae?

unit.source: Franca fell silent.
unit.target: Franca tacita fuit.

unit.source: Lumian continued in a low voice.
unit.target: Lumian voce humili pergebat.

unit.source: “Like the Hunter pathway, it inevitably brings catastrophe and calamity.
unit.target: “Sicut via Venatoris, inevitabiliter calamitatem et cladem affert.

unit.source: We are destined to belong to darkness and represent destruction.”
unit.target: Fatum nobis est tenebris pertinere et exitium repraesentare.

unit.source: “Think about it.
unit.target: “Cogita de hoc.

unit.source: What’s the general perception of Hunters and Demonesses among Beyonders?
unit.target: Quae opinio generalis de Venatoribus et Demonissis apud Beyonders est?

unit.source: Danger.
unit.target: Periculum.

unit.source: Hunters are seen as bloody dangers, and Demonesses as evil dangers.
unit.target: Venatores ut pericula sanguinolenta, et Demonissae ut pericula mala existimantur.

unit.source: We can’t escape this impression, nor can we deny it.
unit.target: Non possumus hanc impressionem effugere, nec eam negare.

unit.source: The subsequent potion digestion and advancement rituals will push us deeper into darkness unless you choose to stop advancing and remain where you are.
unit.target: Ritūs digestionis potionis et progressus nos in tenebras plenius impellent, nisi decernas non ultra progredi et manere quo es.

unit.source: Otherwise, we’ll face challenges that test our very souls.
unit.target: Alioquin difficultatibus obveniemus, quae animas nostras ipsas probabunt.

unit.source: “You could consider switching paths, but your only option would be the Hunter pathway.”
unit.target: “Potes viam mutare cogitare, sed sola optio tua erit via Venatorum.”

unit.source: Seeing Franca’s expression change but still remaining silent, Lumian suddenly laughed.
unit.target: Videns expressionem Francae mutatam sed adhuc tacitam, Lumian subito risit.

unit.source: “What I’m trying to say is, give up on purity; don’t shy away from darkness and evil.
unit.target: “Id quod dicere conor est: abice puritatem; noli recedere a tenebris et malo.

unit.source: We need to confront these things.
unit.target: His rebus occurrere debemus.

unit.source: Only then can we find ways to avoid evil and discover the light within the darkness.
unit.target: Tunc tantum viās invenire possumus ad malum vitandum atque lucem in tenebris detegendam.

unit.source: We will all be tainted by darkness.”
unit.target: Omnes tenebris contaminabimur.

unit.source: “We are stained black; we must strive not to fall, not to betray our inner principles.”
unit.target: “Manemus nigri; contendere debemus ne cademus neque interiora nostra principia prodamus.”

unit.source: Franca was silent for a while before sighing deeply.
unit.target: Franca paulisper tacita fuit, deinde alte suspiravit.

unit.source: “Affliction and Despair give me bad premonitions.
unit.target: “Afflictio et Desperatio mihi mala praenotiones dant.

unit.source: But walking in darkness, seeking light within it—won’t we be corrupted bit by bit and eventually fall completely?”
unit.target: Sed ambulando in tenebris, quaerendo lucem in ea—nonne paulatim corrumpemur et tandem omnino cadamus?

unit.source: Lumian chuckled. “Do we have any other choice?
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit. “Habemusne aliam optionem?

unit.source: We can only keep fighting our own darkness and evil until we die.”
unit.target: Solum contra nostras tenebras et mala pugnare possumus usque ad mortem.”

unit.source: Franca tersely acknowledged his words and expressed her thoughts, “Actually, all Beyonders are like this.
unit.target: Franca breviter verba eius accepit et cogitationes suas exprimit: “Revera, omnes Beyonders ita sunt.

unit.source: The paths of gods are inherently dangerous and inevitably lead to madness.
unit.target: Viae deorum naturae periculosae sunt et necessario ad insaniam ducunt.

unit.source: Hunters and Demonesses just make it more obvious and direct.”
unit.target: Venatores et Demonissae hoc magis evidenter et directe efficiunt.”

unit.source: She couldn’t imagine the struggles and pain if she had chosen the Devil pathway.
unit.target: Non poterat fingere labores et dolores, si semitam Diaboli eligisset.

unit.source: When the negative effects of Jenna’s Decency brooch wore off, Anthony returned and briefed Lumian and the others on the current situation in Banamo Port.
unit.target: Cum effectus negativi fibulae Decentiae Jennae evanescebant, Anthony rediit et Lumiano aliisque de statu hodierno in Portu Banamo enarravit.

unit.source: The Newins had indeed fled, and Great Shark Jörg and his men hadn’t boarded and were now missing.
unit.target: Newins certe fugerunt, et Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites navem conscendere non potuerunt et nunc ignoti sunt.

unit.source: In the following two days, Lumian and his team disguised themselves and searched Banamo Port for the first mate, second mate, and boatswain of the Newins.
unit.target: In duos dies subsequentes, Lumian et turma eius se in alias vestes induti sunt et Portum Banamo quaesiverunt ad reperiendum primum, secundum, et nautae praepositum Newins.

unit.source: However, they found no significant leads, whether through social investigation or mystical tracking.
unit.target: Sed nullas notabiles vestigia invenerunt, sive per inquisitionem socialem sive per indagationem mysticam.

unit.source: Instead, they discovered some suspected associates of Admiral Deep Sea had also disappeared.
unit.target: Proinde invenerunt aliquot socios suspectos Admiralis Profundi Maris quoque evanutos esse.

unit.source: Lumian suspected Great Shark Jörg and his men had left Banamo Port through some secret means.
unit.target: Lumian suspicabatur Magnum Squalus Jörg eiusque milites Portum Banamo per vias arcana discessisse.

unit.source: Whether they returned to the Newins remained unknown.
unit.target: Num ad Newins redeunt, ignotum manet.

unit.source: In Trier, in an apartment in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
unit.target: In Trier, in habitatione in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativae.

unit.source: Angoulême de Francois set up a ritual and summoned the messenger of the Seven of Cups.
unit.target: Angoulême de Francois ritum instituit et nuntium Septem Poculorum evocavit.

unit.source: He saw a rabbit-shaped Spirit Body emerge from the flames, dressed in an odd manner: a miniature silk top hat between its ears, tiny gold-rimmed glasses on its nose, a black trench coat clearly not meant for a rabbit, and holding an iron-black revolver sized for a large rabbit.
unit.target: Vidit corpus spirituale forma cuniculi ex flammis emergere, insolite indutum: parvum pileum sericum inter aures, parvas speculas aureas in naso, atram tunicam trench quae pro cuniculo manifeste non apta erat, et revolverum ferrum nigrum, magnitudine cuniculo ingenti, tenentem.

unit.source: The messenger of Hidden Blade is quite cute, with a unique style… Who knew she would dress her messenger like this…
unit.target: Nuntius Falcis Occultae valde decorus est, cum singulari stilo… Quis putavit eam nuntium taliter vestire…

unit.source: Angoulême picked up the prewritten letter and handed it to the adorably dressed rabbit messenger.
unit.target: Angoulême epistulam prae-scripta collegit et tradidit nunti cuniculo venuste induto.

unit.source: The rabbit gave him a cold, sharp glance.
unit.target: Cuniculus ei intuentem frigidum atque acutum dedit.

unit.source: Um… Angoulême retracted his previous thoughts.
unit.target: Hem… Angoulême prius suas cogitationes retraxit.

unit.source: In one of the motel rooms rented by Lumian and company in Banamo Harbor, Franca read Angoulême’s letter and said with some difficulty, “007 has a lead on the Mirror People and wants us to follow up, but we still haven’t found Great Shark Jörg.”
unit.target: In uno ex conclavibus motel in Portu Banamo a Lumiano et sociis locatis, Franca epistolam Angoulême legendi dixit difficulter: “007 vestigium habet de Populis Specularibus et vult nos persequi; sed Magnum Squalum Jörg nondum invenimus.”

unit.source: She was more interested in the secrets of the elves than the Mirror People.
unit.target: Ea magis de arcana elforum quam de Populis Specularibus curabat.

unit.source: Lumian leaned back, relaxed, and said, “The worst-case scenario is that Great Shark Jörg and his men have already returned to the Newins through secret means. We won’t get any results staying here.
unit.target: Lumian relaxatus se recubuit et dixerat: “Pessimus eventus est quod Magnus Squalus Jörg eiusque milites iam per vias arcana ad Newins redeunt; hic manentes nullum fructum consequemur.

unit.source: “So, let’s leave. Once the alert is lifted, those people might come out.
unit.target: “Itaque eamus. Statim postquam monitum levabitur, illi homines fortasse emergent.

unit.source: Meanwhile, we can make long-term plans to keep an eye on Banamo Port. Maybe the Newins will return for supplies.
unit.target: Interim consilia diuturna facere possumus ut Portum Banamo vigilaverimus. Forsitan Newins redierint ad suppeditanda.

unit.source: “Agreed,” Franca accepted reality.
unit.target: “Consentit,” Franca rem accipiebat.

unit.source: At that moment, Jenna noticed a problem: Rabbit Chasel was still in the room.
unit.target: Illo momento, Jenna rem animadvertit: Rabbit Chasel adhuc in conclavi manebat.

unit.source: 789 At the Stake
unit.target: 789 Ad Stipam

unit.source: 789 At the Stake
unit.target: 789 Ad Stipam

unit.source: Jenna observed Rabbit Chasel, who increasingly resembled Gehrman Sparrow, and carefully asked, “What do you need this time?”
unit.target: Jenna observavit Rabbit Chasel, qui magis magisque Gehrman Sparrow similis fieri incipit, et caute rogavit: “Quid hoc tempore tibi opus est?”

unit.source: One of the later volumes of The Great Adventurer? Or something else?
unit.target: Unum ex volumina posterioribus Magni Adventuratoris? An alia?

unit.source: Luckily, few people knew about her messenger, and Rabbit Chasel didn’t deliver messages frequently.
unit.target: Felix, pauci de eius nuntio sciebant, et Rabbit Chasel nuntia non frequenter tradebat.

unit.source: Otherwise, Jenna would have to consider providing different knowledge.
unit.target: Alioquin, Jenna diversa scientia praebere cogitavisset.

unit.source: Rabbit Chasel lowered its paw holding the revolver and said in a thoughtful tone, “Get me a pair of boxing gloves that a rabbit can wear.”
unit.target: Rabbit Chasel pedem, qui revolver tenebat, deiecit et cogitans in tono dixit: “Adfer mihi pariam manicarum pugilatoriārum, quas lepus gerere possit.”

unit.source: What kind of request is that?
unit.target: Qualis petitio ista est?

unit.source: Lumian said with a chuckle, “I don’t remember Gehrman Sparrow ever wearing boxing gloves.”
unit.target: Lumian subrisus dixit: “Non memini Gehrman Sparrow umquam manicas pugilatorias indutum fuisse.”

unit.source: This imitation doesn’t quite fit the persona!
unit.target: Haec imitatio non perfecte personae convenit!

unit.source: “True, but Gehrman Sparrow has Blazing Danitz.
unit.target: “Vere, sed Gehrman Sparrow Danitz Igneus habet.

unit.source: I need my own Danitz.
unit.target: Ego meam Danitz propriam requiro.

unit.source: I want to develop one in our community,” Rabbit Chasel explained earnestly.
unit.target: Unam in nostra communitate evolvere volo, sincere explanavit Rabbit Chasel.

unit.source: “Danitz uses boxing gloves.”
unit.target: “Danitz manicas pugilatorias utitur.”

unit.source: For a moment, Franca, Jenna, and Lumian didn’t know how to respond.
unit.target: Per momentum, Franca, Jenna, et Lumian nesciverunt quomodo respondeant.

unit.source: After several seconds, Jenna nodded and said, “I’ll have a pair custom-made for you. Mm, normal Rabbit of Knowledge size, not your size?”
unit.target: Post aliquot secundos, Jenna annuit et dixit: “Paria tibi ex consilio fabricata parabo. Mm, magnitudine normali Leporis Scientiae, non tua?”

unit.source: “That’s right.” Rabbit Chasel raised its right hand, blew on the small revolver’s muzzle, satisfied.
unit.target: “Recte.” Rabbit Chasel dextram manum elevavit et super parvum tubum revolveris flatus dedit, contentus.

unit.source: But… this gesture isn’t fitting for the current scene… Franca noticed that Rabbit Chasel was still an immature Rabbit of Knowledge, mimicking and repeating much without truly mastering it.
unit.target: Sed… hic gestus scaenam praesentem non convenit… Franca animadvertit quod Rabbit Chasel adhuc immaturus Lepus Scientiae esset, multum imitans et repetens, sed vere non dominatus.

unit.source: In the darkness of Banamo Port, only a few street lamps with candles flickered.
unit.target: In obscuritate Portus Banamo, tantum paucae lampades viarias cum candelis micabant.

unit.source: Pirates gathered in bars, drinking heavily or going upstairs with women, enjoying pleasures unavailable at sea.
unit.target: Piratae in tabernis congregabantur, graviter bibentes aut cum mulieribus in superiores conclavia ascendentes, voluptatibus fruentes, quae in mari inaccessae erant.

unit.source: With the Newins gone and the unknown adventurer disappeared, the pirates gradually put the incident behind them.
unit.target: Cum Newins discessissent et adventurator ignotus evanuerit, piratae rem illam paulatim relegaverunt.

unit.source: After all, everyone felt embarrassed; no one would ridicule another.
unit.target: Post omnia, omnes erubuerunt; nemo alterum deridebat.

unit.source: As pirates, they knew they might die in a storm, during a robbery, or in a mutiny on their next voyage.
unit.target: Ut piratae, noverunt se in tempestate, rapina, aut seditione in proximis itineribus interiri posse.

unit.source: Dwelling on past problems was meaningless; indulging in the present was the only option.
unit.target: De quaestionibus praeteritis versari nihil prodest; in praesenti solum fruendum optimum erat.

unit.source: Of course, they also talked about the unknown adventurer’s strength and what had happened inside the Newins, wondering why Admiral Deep Sea fled in such a hurry.
unit.target: Certe etiam de virtute adventurantis ignoti et de rebus quae in Newins acciderant loquebantur, mirantes cur Admiralis Profundi Maris tam festinanter fugeret.

unit.source: “I think that adventurer was waiting for Admiral Deep Sea!”
unit.target: “Credo illum adventurarem Admiralem Profundi Maris exspectavisse!”

unit.source: “Does he want to recreate Gehrman Sparrow’s great feats?”
unit.target: “Num vult res gestas Gehrman Sparrow recreare?”

unit.source: “Pui! Son of a bitch. What great feats? We’re pirates!”
unit.target: “Vah! Filius canis. Quae res gestae magnæ? Piratae sumus!”

unit.source: “He succeeded but didn’t completely succeed? He defeated Admiral Deep Sea but let him escape?”
unit.target: “Vicit, sed non omnino? Admiralem Profundi Maris vicit, sed eum effugere permisit?”

unit.source: “Is he close to the power of the Kings?”
unit.target: “Num prope potentiam regum sit?”

unit.source: “What’s happening on the sea? Every so often, a powerful adventurer appears! There was that Louis Berry before, too.”
unit.target: “Quid agitur in mari? Quoties aliquando adventurator potens apparet! Erat etiam ille Louis Berry antea.”

unit.source: Disguised as a non-pirate, Mason mingled in several bars, listening to the pirates discuss recent events, hoping they’d start a fight.
unit.target: Se non pirata simulans, Mason in pluribus tabernis miscuit, auscultans piratas de recentibus rebus disputantes, sperans eos pugnam inchoare.

unit.source: On his way to the next bar, Mason turned into a quieter alley and saw a figure standing ahead, seemingly waiting for him.
unit.target: In itinere ad proximam tabernam, Mason in vico angusto se contulit et figuram ante se stantem vidit, quasi eum exspectans.

unit.source: The figure had black hair and blue eyes, with sharp features and a handsome face.
unit.target: Figura capillos nigros, oculos caeruleos, lineamenta acuta, et vultum formosum habebat.

unit.source: It was the same unknown adventurer who had challenged all the pirates in Banamo Port and forced Admiral Deep Sea to flee.
unit.target: Erat eadem adventurator ignotus, qui omnes piratas Portus Banamo provocaverat et Admiralem Profundi Maris ad fugam compulit.

unit.source: Mason suddenly heard his heart pounding and blurted out, “I’m not a pirate!”
unit.target: Mason subito cor suum pulsantem audivit et exclamavit: “Non sum pirata!”

unit.source: Lumian strolled forward and smiled. “I have a task for you.”
unit.target: Lumian procedebat et subridebat. “Tibi munus habeo.”

unit.source: Hearing this, Mason relaxed a bit and carefully said, “What can I do for you? I’m not sure if my abilities can meet your needs.”
unit.target: Hoc audito, Mason paulo relaxavit et caute dixit: “Quid tibi facere possum? Non certus sum an facultates meae necessitatibus tuis satisfacere possint.”

unit.source: He feared that while completing the task might be easy, the aftermath could be problematic—pirates might hack him to pieces once the adventurer left.
unit.target: Timebat, dum munus absolvendum facile esse posset, postea res arduae fieri, nam piratae eum in frusta caedere possent, simul adventurator discessisset.

unit.source: Lumian said bluntly, “It’s a simple and secret task. Keep an eye on Banamo Port. As soon as the Newins returns or you spot Great Shark Jörg and his men, summon my messenger immediately.”
unit.target: Lumian aperte dixit: “Munus simplex et secretum est. Intuere Portum Banamo. Quotiens Newins redierit aut Magnum Squalum Jörg cum viris eius agnoscas, statim nuntium meum invoca.”

unit.source: Hearing “messenger,” Mason was suddenly struck by a thought.
unit.target: Audito “nuntio,” Mason subito cogitatione percussus est.

unit.source: He remembered his last task: summoning a terrifying messenger through a ritual!
unit.target: Meminit sui ultimi muneris: nuntium terribilem per ritum evocare!

unit.source: Unable to control his expression, Mason asked in slight terror, “Are you Lumian Lee, sir?”
unit.target: Nondum velle vultum suum regere, Mason leviter territus rogavit: “Esne Lumian Lee, domine?”

unit.source: The master of that terrifying messenger?
unit.target: Dominus illius nuntii terribilis?

unit.source: “Perceptive,” Lumian replied, not too sincerely.
unit.target: “Perspicax,” Lumian respondit, non nimis ex animo.

unit.source: Mason connected the recent events in his mind: Was the real purpose of that task to bring Lumian Lee to Banamo Port?
unit.target: Mason nupera eventa in mente coniunxit: Num verum propositum illius muneris esset Lumian Lee ad Portum Banamo adducere?

unit.source: And Lumian Lee’s goal was to deal with Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, for the Lost Newins?
unit.target: Et propositum Lumian Lee erat agere contra Admiralem Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, pro Newins perditis?

unit.source: My spiritual intuition was partly correct; the ritual indeed brought something bad to Banamo Port, though it didn’t turn into a catastrophe…
unit.target: Intuitio spiritua mea partim recte fuit; ritus re vera aliquid mali ad Portum Banamo attulit, licet in calamitatem non versa sit.

unit.source: Lumian continued, “The payment is 5000 verl d’or.”
unit.target: Lumian continuavit: “Solutio est 5000 verl d’or.”

unit.source: The task is indeed simple, and I likely wouldn’t be discovered by the pirates.
unit.target: Munus quidem simplex est, et verisimiliter piratae me non deprehenderent.

unit.source: The reward is generous…
unit.target: Praemium est largum…

unit.source: If I refused, knowing the task details might bring trouble…
unit.target: Si recusarem, cognoscere minuta muneris fortasse incommodum afferrem…

unit.source: After weighing it for over ten seconds, Mason said, “No problem, I think I can handle this task.”
unit.target: Postquam per plus quam decem secundos deliberavit, Mason inquit: “Nulla quaestio, puto me hoc munus perficere posse.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly, paid a 1000-verl d’or deposit, and turned to leave the quiet alley.
unit.target: Lumian parum annuit, cautionem depositi 1000 verl d’or solvit, et vicum quietum reliquens discessit.

unit.source: Watching Lumian’s figure disappear into the darkness, Mason silently repeated his name, “Lumian Lee, Lumian Lee…”
unit.target: Videns figuram Lumiani in tenebras evanescere, Mason tacite nomen suum repetivit: “Lumian Lee, Lumian Lee…”

unit.source: Mason finally remembered where he had heard the name: on a wanted poster aboard a ship!
unit.target: Denique Mason meminit ubi nomen audisset: in tabella desideratorum in nave!

unit.source: The poster described Lumian Lee as a survivor of a sacrificial ritual to an evil god that destroyed a village, severely corrupted by the evil god.
unit.target: Tabella describebat Lumian Lee ut superstitium ritus sacrificii deo malo, qui vicum deleverat, graviter corruptum ab eo deo.

unit.source: In Trier, in the prison district, at the Rois Comprehensive Execution Ground.
unit.target: In Trier, in regione carceraria, ad Campum Exsecutionis Rois.

unit.source: Returning to Trier for two days, Franca, feeling ready for the Demoness of Affliction advancement ritual, decided to proceed.
unit.target: Rediens ad Trier per duas dies, Franca, se ad ritum progressionis Demonissae Afflictionis paratam sentiens, destinavit procedere.

unit.source: 007’s lead on the Mirror People came from an ore scholar of the Trier Cave Association.
unit.target: Indictum 007 de Populo Specularium provenit ab erudito Associationis Speluncarum Treiensium.

unit.source: The Purifiers had planned to investigate all the association’s ore scholars, but one had mysteriously disappeared before they could visit.
unit.target: Purificatores consilium tenuerant omnes eruditos associationis Speculorum minerali investigare, sed unus, mysterio, evanuerat antequam visitari possent.

unit.source: Recently, someone had seen her in Underground Trier, suspected to be Palia, a Mirror Person.
unit.target: Nuper, aliquis eam in Trier Subterraneo vidit, suspiciens eam esse Palia, Personam Specularis.

unit.source: Franca looked at the stake and sighed sincerely, “When I became a witch, I wondered if I’d end up burned at the stake. Who knew, I have to tie myself up here?”
unit.target: Franca stipam aspexit et sincere suspiravit: “Cum striga facta essem, mirabar num in stipam cremata finirem. Quis scivit me hic me ipsum alligare oportere?”

unit.source: As she spoke, she took out the brown-red wooden suitcase given by Demoness of Black Clarice from the Traveler’s Bag and unlocked the metal clasp.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, capsam ligneam fusco-rubram ab Demonissa Nigrae Clarice ex Sacculo Viatoris data extraxit et cingulum metallicum aperuit.

unit.source: Next, she retrieved a red wine glass, crushed the crystalline ice containing potion ingredients, and poured in Flower-Faced Bat blood and human blood from a seriously ill person.
unit.target: Deinde vitrum vini rubri obtinuit, glaciem crystallinam, quae potionis ingredientes contineret, conterit, et effudit sanguinem vespertilionis faciei floridae et sanguinem humanum ex aegroto graviter affecto.

unit.source: Both were dark red, and when combined, they turned almost black.
unit.target: Utraque obscuro rubra erant, et cum coniuncta sunt, fere in nigritudinem versa sunt.

unit.source: She then added the Flower-Faced Bat’s head, a Two-Tailed Black Snake’s gallbladder and tail tip, and ten drops of Enfinitas Eucalyptus essential oil.
unit.target: Deinde addidit caput vespertilionis faciei floridae, vesicam bilii anguis nigri duplici caudatu et apicem caudae, atque decem guttas olei essentialis Enfinitas Eucalyptus.

unit.source: As the ingredients were added, the dark red blood in the glass turned pitch black, with occasional nauseating green bubbles.
unit.target: Cum ingredientia addebantur, sanguis obscuro ruber in vitreo in nigritudinem totam versa est, cum interdum bullis viridibus nauseabundis.

unit.source: “It’s like a cup of untreated sewage,” Lumian commented honestly.
unit.target: “Instar poculi limi non purgati est,” Lumian honeste commentatus est.

unit.source: “Dammit! Shut up!” Franca grew more disgusted as she looked at the Demoness of Affliction potion.
unit.target: “Heu! Tace!” Franca, potionem Demonissae Afflictionis aspiciens, magis turbata facta est.

unit.source: She handed the potion to Lumian and lightly jumped onto the stake, tying herself up with Jenna’s help.
unit.target: Potiionem illam Lumiani tradidit et leviter in stipam insiluit, se cum auxilio Jennae alligans.

unit.source: During this, Franca muttered, “Damn, this feels so weird…”
unit.target: Interea, Franca submurmuravit: “Maledictum, hoc tam insolitum videtur…”

unit.source: She adjusted her mindset for several seconds and nodded to Lumian, “I’m ready.”
unit.target: Postquam per aliquos secundos animum temperavit, Lumiani annuit et dixit: “Parata sum.”

unit.source: Lumian handed the potion to Jenna and extended his right palm.
unit.target: Lumian potionem ad Jenna tradidit et dextram manum protulit.

unit.source: A ball of crimson-white flames flew out, landing on Franca, who immediately felt pain.
unit.target: Globulus flammarum rubro-albae eiecit et in Francam incidit, quae statim dolorem sensit.

unit.source: Her body instinctively wanted to dodge and contract, but the ropes held her firmly.
unit.target: Corpus eius instinctu vitare et contrahere conari volebat, sed funes eam firmiter teneabant.

unit.source: Jenna quickly jumped to her side, one hand holding the ropes and the other bringing the potion to her mouth.
unit.target: Jenna celeriter ad eam accessit, una manu funes tenens et altera potionem ad os suum afferens.

unit.source: Franca forced herself to gulp down the pathogen-like dark-green potion.
unit.target: Franca se coegit ut potionem obscuro-viridem, quasi pathogeno similem, deglutiret.

unit.source: Whether from the flames or the potion, her head quickly grew hot, and her mind became fuzzy from the heat.
unit.target: Sive ex flammarum sive ex potioni, caput eius celeriter calefactus est, et mens eius calore confusa facta est.

unit.source: She involuntarily recalled past pleasures, including her own experiences and the feedback from her partners.
unit.target: Involuntarie recordata sunt ei voluptates praeteritae, inter quas propriae experientiae et responsiones sociorum.

unit.source: At that moment, Franca was both the giver and receiver of pleasure, drowning in it from body to soul, almost dissolving like spring water.
unit.target: Illo momento, Franca et deditrix et receptrix voluptatis erat, ea inundata ab corpore ad animam, paene quasi aqua verni liquefacta.

unit.source: Her thoughts drifted, her will sank, and her self was lost in various intense pleasures.
unit.target: Eius cogitationes vagabantur, eius voluntas deficit, atque ipsa in variis voluptatibus intensis amissa est.

unit.source: However, the pain accompanying those pleasures kept her slightly conscious.
unit.target: Attamen, dolor illos voluptatibus comitans eam parum consciam retinuit.

unit.source: It was the mental resistance and spiritual conflict with Gardner Martin, the emotional gap with Jenna, as if they could never truly unite body and soul…
unit.target: Erat resistentia mentis atque conflictu spirituali cum Gardner Martin, intervallum affectivum cum Jenna, quasi numquam vere corpus et animam coniungere possent…

unit.source: The extreme pain from the burning flames on her body was like invisible threads pulling her self and consciousness, making her sway like a kite in a storm, not completely out of control.
unit.target: Extremus dolor ex flammarum ardor in corpore eius erat velut fila invisibilia, quae ipsam et conscientiam trahent, faciens ut quasi papilio in tempestate vacillaret, non omnino imperio soluto.

unit.source: Swaying, Franca instinctively cursed in her mind:
unit.target: Vacillans, Franca instinctu in mente maledixit:

unit.source: Damn, it hurts so much!
unit.target: Heu, tam multum dolet!

unit.source: This ritual is trying to kill me, isn’t it?
unit.target: Hoc ritus me interficere conatur, nonne?

unit.source: Cough, cough, hot smoke in my throat and lungs, so uncomfortable. Am I dying…
unit.target: Tussis, tussis, fumus calidus in fauce et pulmonibus meis, tam incommodus. Moriensne sum…

unit.source: “Dammit, my clothes almost got burned up!
unit.target: “Eheu, vestimenta mea paene combusta sunt!

unit.target: “Modo uno passu ab te ut nuda perambulare possis!

unit.source: Franca then disappeared from sight, took out a set of clothes from the Traveler’s Bag, and changed in a nearby secluded corner.
unit.target: Deinde Franca ex conspectu evanuit, vestimentorum seriem ex sacco viatoris extraxit, et in angulo proximo abdito se mutavit.

unit.source: She then deactivated her invisibility, tied up her ponytail, and walked back to Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Deinde vim invisibilitatis suæ exstinxit, crines in caudam alligavit, et ad Lumian atque ceteros rediit.

unit.source: “The beautifying effect is really impressive…”
unit.target: “Effectus ad ornandum vere praeclarus est…”

unit.source: Franca took out a mirror, examined herself, and poked her cheek as if testing her skin’s elasticity and smoothness.
unit.target: Franca speculum extraxit, se examinavit, et buccam tetigit, quasi cutis elasticitatem ac lenitatem probaret.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Is that the only change the Affliction potion brought?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Numquid hoc solum mutatio est quam potio Afflictionis attulit?”

unit.source: Franca was about to speak when she suddenly remembered something and glanced at Lugano.
unit.target: Franca paene loqui parabat, cum subito aliquid meminisse recordata et ad Lugano respexit.

unit.source: Lugano immediately said, “I need to go back and prepare dinner for Ludwig.”
unit.target: Lugano statim dixit: “Redire et cenam pro Ludovico parare mihi necesse est.”

unit.source: “Okay.”
unit.target: “Bene.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded.
unit.target: Lumian annuuit.

unit.source: After Lugano left, Franca felt the changes in her body and spoke slowly,
unit.target: Postquam Lugano discessit, Franca mutationes in corpore suo sensit et lente dixit:

unit.source: “Enhancing appearance, figure, and charm is just one aspect, and it’s the least important.
unit.target: “Speciem, figuram, et fascinum augere una tantum pars est, et haec pars minime momenti est.

unit.source: No, it’s not unimportant, but it has little to do with becoming stronger.
unit.target: Immo, non est inanis, sed parum attinet ad vires augendas.

unit.source: No, I remember someone saying beauty is part of a woman’s power, just like handsomeness is part of a man’s.
unit.target: Non, memini aliquem dixisse pulchritudinem esse partem potentiae feminae, sicut formositas est partem virili potentiae.

unit.source: Anyway, you get the idea.
unit.target: Denique, intellege.

unit.source: The other changes include Charm becoming an active ability instead of a passive state.”
unit.target: Aliae mutationes comprehendunt quod fascinum in facultatem activam, non in statum passivum, verteretur.

unit.source: As a Beyonder in the Demoness pathway, Jenna easily understood Franca’s meaning.
unit.target: Ut Beyonder in via daemonissae, Jenna facile intellexit quid Franca diceret.

unit.source: “Before, you showcased your appearance, figure, and aura, naturally enchanting anyone who saw you.
unit.target: “Priore tempore, speciem, figuram, atque auram ostendebas, naturaliter omnes qui te viderent incantarentur.

unit.source: Now, a glance, a gesture, a word can completely charm someone?”
unit.target: Nunc autem, uno intuitu, uno gestu, uno verbo, aliquem prorsus fascinabit?

unit.source: “Yes,” Franca said with a smile, “But combined with showcasing my appearance, figure, and aura, the active Charm ability will be more effective.
unit.target: “Ita,” subridens dixit Franca, “sed cum specie, figura, atque aura ostendendis, facultas activa Fascini magis efficax erit.

unit.source: Charmed enemies will hesitate to harm us, unable to use their full strength.
unit.target: Inimici fascinati cunctabuntur ne nobis laedant, neque vires suas plene adhibere poterint.

unit.source: Some might even give up resisting just to get closer to us.
unit.target: Aliqui fortasse desinent resistere, ut propius ad nos accedant.

unit.source: In daily interactions, if Charm is used repeatedly on someone, they will truly fall in love with us over time.”
unit.target: In quotidianis colloquiis, si fascinum aliqui pluries adhibetur, vere in nobis amorem capiet.

unit.source: Franca glanced at Lumian, her eyes twinkling.
unit.target: Franca ad Lumian intuita est, oculis micantibus.

unit.source: She wanted to test the effect of Charm and see how it compared to the endurance of an Ascetic.
unit.target: Volebat effectum Fascini experiri et videre quomodo ad tolerantiam asceticam comparetur.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly felt Franca’s lake-blue eyes deepen, as if hiding countless words, and her fair, smooth skin seemed delicate enough to break with a touch.
unit.target: Lumian subito sensit oculos Francae, ut lacus caerulei, profundiores fiebant, quasi innumerabilia verba celarent, atque cutem eius albanam ac lenem, tam teneram, ut uno tactu discerperetur.

unit.source: An indescribable feeling surged within Lumian, causing him to curse aloud, “Dammit! Stop experimenting with your abilities here!”
unit.target: Sensus ineffabilis in Lumiano exarsit, qui clare maledixit: “Eheu! Desine hic cum facultatibus tuis experimenta facere!”

unit.source: Charm works well if it can make an Ascetic curse… Franca thought to herself, then said seriously, “It’s just that I’ve just advanced, and the potion’s power is leaking out, making it hard to control.”
unit.target: Fascinum bene operatur, si potest ascetam maledicere… Franca interna cogitavit, deinde serio dixit: “Modo processi sum, et potio vim suam diffundit, ita ut regere difficulter possim.”

unit.source: “Do you think I’ll believe that?” Lumian retorted, realizing he felt unusually agitated.
unit.target: “Num putas me hoc credere?” retorquens dixit Lumian, animadvertens se insolenter perturbatum esse.

unit.source: For a Provoker, staying calm while provoking others was crucial.
unit.target: Pro provocatore, manere tranquillus dum alios provocat, maximi momenti erat.

unit.source: Franca withdrew her gaze and continued explaining the Affliction potion’s abilities, “The core ability is Plague.
unit.target: Franca oculos avertit et perrexit explanare facultates potionis Afflictionis, “Nuclei potentia est Pestilentia.

unit.source: It can create various pathogens within a 30-meter range.
unit.target: Varii pathogeni intra spatium 30 metrorum creare potest.

unit.source: Once I get used to the Affliction potion and truly master its power, this range can expand beyond 40 meters and eventually to 50 meters as the potion is digested.
unit.target: Postquam potioni Afflictionis consueverim et vim eius vere perficerim, hic radius ultra quadraginta metra et denique ad quinquaginta metra extendi poterit, quam potio digeritur.

unit.source: A Demoness of Affliction can create multiple pathogens, accelerating their infection and the onset of diseases.
unit.target: Daemonissa Afflictionis plures pathogeni creare potest, contagionem eorum et initium morborum accelerans.

unit.source: The initial ten seconds are the incubation period, followed by mild symptoms like allergies, fever, cough, and sneezing.
unit.target: Primi decem secundi sunt periodus incubationis, deinde sequuntur symptomata mitia, ut allergiae, febris, tussis, et sternutatio.

unit.source: The symptoms quickly worsen, leading to severe illnesses like pneumonia.
unit.target: Symptomata celeriter exacerbantur, ducens ad morbos graves, sicut pneumonia.

unit.source: In two to three minutes, the disease will become critical, potentially causing sudden death or incapacitation.”
unit.target: In duobus ad tribus minutis, morbus critice fiet, potenter mortem subitam aut incapacitationem efficens.

unit.source: Done with explaining Plague, Franca excitedly envisioned, “This pairs well with an Assassin.
unit.target: Exposita Pestilentia, Franca exsultans proposuit: “Hoc bene convenit cum Sicario.

unit.source: “Stealthily get within a few dozen meters of the target, silently spread pathogens to cover the area.
unit.target: “Subdoliter accede intra paucos triginta metra ad scopum, et tacite pathogena dissemina ad aream tegendam.

unit.source: When the target shows mild symptoms and realizes something is wrong, strike as their strength decreases, their state affected, and many abilities disrupted.
unit.target: Cum obiectum levia symptomata ostendat et animadvertat aliquid esse inordinatum, percutito, dum vires eius minuuntur, status mutatur, atque multa facultates turbantur.

unit.source: If the first strike fails, reposition and keep trying, dragging the target into severe illness.
unit.target: Si primus ictus defecerit, reposita te et persevera, trahendo obiectum in morbum grave.

unit.source: “Plague should be something a Guardian’s abilities can’t defend against.
unit.target: “Pestilentia illa esse debet, quam facultates Custodis defendere non possunt.

unit.source: Their invisible barriers don’t seem to block air.
unit.target: Invisibilia munimenta eorum aërem videntur non obstruere.

unit.source: The people they protect can still breathe normally.
unit.target: Populi quos custodiunt adhuc normaliter spirare possunt.

unit.source: I’m not sure if the barriers have a sterilizing function…”
unit.target: Nescio an ea claustra functionem sterilizantem habeant…

unit.source: “Heh heh, next time I face Admiral Deep Sea, I won’t worry about his octopus mask.
unit.target: “Heh heh, proxima vice cum Admiro Profundi Maris occurram, non curabo de larva polypidis eius.

unit.source: It seems to only protect the spirit and mind, maybe also making the body tougher and more resilient.”
unit.target: Videtur solum spiritum et mentem protegere, fortasse etiam corpus duriorem ac magis robustum reddere.”

unit.source: “It’s indeed well-suited for assassination and prolonged fights,” Lumian evaluated from a Hunter’s perspective.
unit.target: “Revera id aptum est ad sicariam et pugnas diuturnas,” aestimavit Lumian ex prospectu Venatoris.

unit.source: He pondered and asked, “Does the infection and onset time of Plague vary based on the target’s constitution? Can the pathogens you create be burned by a Hunter’s flames?”
unit.target: Cogitavit et rogavit, “Num tempus infectionis et initii Pestilentiae variantur secundum constitutionem obiecti? Possuntne pathogeni quos creas ab igne Venatoris comburri?”

unit.source: He was recalling his battle with a bestowed from the Order of All Extinction.
unit.target: Meminiebatur proelii sui cum dono datum ab Ordine Omnium Exstinctionis.

unit.source: “Of course, there’s a difference.
unit.target: “Certe, discrimen est.

unit.source: Undead creatures won’t be infected unless I become a Demoness of Despair,” Franca said introspectively.
unit.target: “Creaturae mortuorum non contagientur nisi ego daemonissa Desperationis fiam,” dixit Franca introspecte.

unit.source: “I’m not sure if the pathogens can be burned by a Hunter’s flames.
unit.target: “Nescio an pathogeni quos creas ab igne Venatoris comburri possint.

unit.source: Want to test it?”
unit.target: Visne id experiri?”

unit.source: “Sure.”
unit.target: “Certe.”

unit.source: Lumian also wanted to confirm.
unit.target: Lumian quoque id confirmare voluit.

unit.source: This could be useful if he ever faced a Demoness of Affliction.
unit.target: Hoc utile esse poterit, si umquam daemonissae Afflictionis occurrat.

unit.source: Jenna and Anthony immediately distanced themselves, moving to the edge of the Rois Comprehensive Execution Ground.
unit.target: Jenna et Anthony statim se abstulerunt, et ad marginem Campi Exsecutionis Comprehensivae Rois processerunt.

unit.source: In the early winter night, Lumian’s body suddenly ignited with brilliant white flames, spreading around and burning the air within a seven-to-eight-meter radius.
unit.target: In prima nocte hiemali, corpus Lumiani subito albis flammis fulgentibus inflammatum est, circum disseminans et aerem intra radium septem ad octo metrorum comburens.

unit.source: Franca stood over ten meters away, her lake-blue eyes deepening.
unit.target: Franca stabat ultra decem metra, oculis lacu caeruleis profundis factis.

unit.source: As the flames crackled, time passed, and Lumian gradually felt a discomfort in his throat, as if swallowing a foreign object, making him want to cough it out.
unit.target: Dum flammas crepitabant, tempus transibat, et Lumian paulatim dolorem in fauce sensit, quasi extraneum obiectum degluturum, quod eum ad tussim compellebat.

unit.source: His nose also felt sore and itchy.
unit.target: Naris eius quoque laborabat et pruriebat.

unit.source: Franca stopped the experiment and concluded, “Hunter’s flames can indeed kill many pathogens created by a Demoness of Affliction, reducing the disease’s impact.

unit.target: Mihi circiter una minuta fuit ut tibi symptomata levia darem.”

unit.target: Lumian sternuit, bis tussivit, et flammae albae celeriter evanuerunt.

unit.source: When Jenna and Anthony returned, Franca continued, “A Demoness’s webs have also been significantly enhanced.

unit.target: Ut daemonissa Voluptatis, solum ruditer eas regere poteram ad obiecta implicanda et liganda.

unit.source: Now, they’re like extensions of my arms, capable of more precise actions, like…”
unit.target: Nunc, velut extensiones brachiorum meorum, sunt, ad operationes subtiliores faciendas aptae, ut…

unit.target: Franca subito subridit.

unit.source: “Tickling you!”
unit.target: “Te titillabo!”

unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian et Jenna aliquid molle et invisibile in zona lumborum eorum titillari sentiebant, excitantes sensum pruriginis.

unit.source: “Immature, haven’t you grown up?” Lumian mocked, then added, “But it’s useful in combat.”
unit.target: “Imaturi, nonne iam adultus es?” deridebat Lumian, deinde addens: “Sed in pugna utilis est.”

unit.target: Franca tela invisibilia subtraxit, caudam crinium solvit, et capillos cadere permisit.

unit.source: Her flaxen-colored hair didn’t drop but floated, each strand distinct and lively.
unit.target: Crines eius, flavo colore, non ceciderunt sed volitabant, singula distincta et vivida.

unit.source: “Now, my hair is also a weapon,” Franca proudly announced, “It can pierce skin, inject black flames, and cause stiffness in the contacted area, effective in close combat.”
unit.target: “Nunc, crines mei quoque arma sunt,” Franca superba nuntiavit, “quae cutem perforare, flammis nigris infundere, et in regione contacta rigiditatem efficere possunt, ad proximum certamen apta.”

unit.source: She let her hair down, tied it again, and took out a mirror.
unit.target: Crines libera, iterum alligavit, et speculum extraxit.

unit.source: “My curses are also stronger and more targeted.
unit.target: “Maledictiones meae quoque fortiores et magis intentione destinatae sunt.

unit.source: Before, I had to reflect the target’s full image in a mirror to curse them with black flames.
unit.target: Olim totam imaginem obiecti in speculo reflectere deberam, ut eos maledicerem flammis nigris.

unit.source: Now, I can reflect just a part of the body, affecting the corresponding area.
unit.target: Nunc possum tantum partem corporis reflectere, regionem eius respondentem afficiens.

unit.source: My other abilities have also been enhanced, including black magic and mirror magic.”
unit.target: Ceterae quoque facultates meae auctae sunt, inter quas magica nigra et magica specularis.

unit.source: Jenna listened quietly and sincerely remarked, “Compared to a Demoness of Pleasure, this is a significant improvement.”
unit.target: Jenna quiete auscultavit atque sincere dixit: “Comparata daemonissa Voluptatis, hoc emendatio notabilis est.”

unit.source: “After all, it’s Sequence 5,” Franca said, feeling extremely pleased.
unit.target: “Postremo, Sequens V est,” dixit Franca, se extremo laeta sentiens.

unit.source: Seeing this, Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Hoc videns, Lumian leviter annuuit.

unit.source: “I won’t be participating in the Mirror People investigation for now.
unit.target: “«Nunc inquisitione Specularium non participabo,

unit.target: Cras ad Lenburg discedere cogito.”

unit.source: To find the City of Exiles, Morora!
unit.target: Ut urbem Exilium, Morora, reperias!

unit.target: Linguam Lenburgicam studuerat et invenit eam esse fundamentaliter eandem ac Linguam Highlander Regni Feynapotter, cum aliquibus differentiationibus dialectalibus — Lenburg a Feynapotter secessit post Proelium Iuratis Violati in Quinta Aetate.

unit.source: So, having learned Highlander, Lumian quickly mastered the Lenburg language in a few days.

unit.source: “So soon? Well, you’ve digested the Reaper potion and need to consider advancing to demigod.”
unit.target: “«Tam cito? Bene, potione Messoris digestus es et considerare oportet ut ad semideum progrediaris.»

unit.target: Franca subito desiderio affecta est.

unit.target: Lumian extra Campum Exsecutionis Comprehensivae Rois intuitus est, et ad Francam, Jennae atque Anthoni dixit: “Cura pro Ludovico mihi et vigila super Lugano.”

unit.source: Based on the information from 0-01 and Madam Magician’s hints, it was best for Lumian to go to Morora alone.
unit.target: Ex informationibus 0-01 et a Domina Magica indicatis, optimum Lumiano erat solus ad Mororam proficisci.

unit.source: Initially, he considered taking Ludwig, his godson, but given his angelic nature and divinity, he might cause unnecessary changes in Morora.
unit.target: Initio, cogitavit Ludovicum, filium dei, accipere, sed propter eius angelicam naturam et divinitatem, mutationes superfluas in Morora afferre posset.

unit.source: So, he abandoned the idea.
unit.target: Ergo, ideam reiecit.

unit.source: In comparison, Termiboros, sealed by Mr. Fool, could be temporarily ignored.
unit.target: Comparato, Termiboros, a Domine Stulto sigillatus, ad tempus neglegi poterat.

unit.source: Theoretically, He wouldn’t trigger 0-01.
unit.target: Theoretice, 0-01 non moveret.

unit.source: “Okay,” Franca and the others responded to Lumian.
unit.target: “Bene,” dixerunt Franca et ceteri ad Lumian.

unit.target: Post cenam, Franca et Jenna redierunt ad Apartamentum 702, numero IX, in via Orosai.

unit.source: “Finally, it worked.”
unit.target: “Denique, successit.”

unit.source: Franca raised her hands and stretched lazily.
unit.target: Franca manus elevavit et languide se extendit.

unit.source: “Next, should we find Palia the Mirror Person first, report to the Demoness of Black, or tell her tomorrow morning that I’ve become a Demoness of Affliction?
unit.target: “Deinde, an primum inveniamus Palia, Personam Speculi, aut referamus Daemonessem Atram, aut cras mane illi dicamus me factam esse Daemonessem Afflictionis?

unit.source: She said that once I advanced to Affliction, she would share some secrets of the Demoness Sect with me.
unit.target: Dixit, quod, simul ac ad statum Afflictionis pervenissem, illa mihi aliquot arcana Sectae Daemonesae communicaturum esset.

unit.source: Franca was curious but also a bit fearful about knowing these secrets.
unit.target: Franca erat curiosa sed etiam paullo timida de his arcana cognoscendis.

unit.source: Additionally, she felt that her progress in digesting the Pleasure potion was much faster than expected, which might arouse the Demoness of Pleasure’s suspicion.
unit.target: Praeterea, sensit progressum suum in digestione potionis Voluptatis multo celerius esse quam expectabatur, quod suspicionem Daemonessei Voluptatis excitare posset.

unit.source: She didn’t want to report anything related to Admiral Deep Sea yet.
unit.target: Noluit adhuc referre quidquam de Admiro Deep Sea.

unit.source: This involved the secret of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s transmigration!
unit.target: Hoc implicabat secretum transmigrationis Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crisparum!

unit.source: So far, Franca and Lumian had only mentioned Admiral Deep Sea’s suspected connection to elves to their respective Arcana cards and had yet to receive any response.
unit.target: Hactenus, Franca et Lumian tantum memoraverant nexus suspectum Admirol Deep Sea cum elphis ad suas tabulas Arcana, nec ullum responsum adhuc receperunt.

unit.source: Jenna thought for a moment and then said, “Even if you don’t go to the Demoness of Black tomorrow, you should do it soon.
unit.target: Jenna paulisper meditata, deinde dixit: "Etiamsi cras ad Daemonessem Atram non proficiscaris, cito id agendum est."

unit.source: The sooner we understand the Demoness Sect’s secrets, the better we can plan our actions and avoid potential pitfalls.
unit.target: Quo citius arcana Sectae Daemonesae intellexerimus, eo melius nostra consilia statuere possumus atque casus perniciosos vitare.

unit.source: Understanding Franca’s concerns, she added with a smile, “Just tell the Demoness of Black that Lumian has become a Reaper and he helped you digest the Pleasure potion.”
unit.target: Intellegens Francae curas, illa cum risu addidit: "Modo Daemonessei Atram dic, Lumian factus esse Messor, et eum adiuvisse tibi ad potionem Voluptatis digerendam."

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca was taken aback.
unit.target: “Heu…” Franca obstupuit.

unit.source: “That's true, but the way you put it doesn’t feel right…”
unit.target: "Vere, sed modus quo id dicis non videtur rectus…"

unit.source: “That’s exactly the kind of misunderstanding we need,” Jenna replied with a soft smile.
unit.target: "Id est prorsus genus erroris quo nobis opus est," Jenna leniter respondit.

unit.source: She glanced out at the night sky and said, “Finding Palia should be enough with just you and Anthony.
unit.target: Caelum nocturnum intuens, illa dixit: "Palia inveniendi solum tibi et Anthonym satis esse debet."

unit.source: I want to visit Julien in Port LeSeur in the next few days.
unit.target: Volo Julien in Port LeSeur proximis diebus visitare.

unit.source: We haven’t seen each other for almost two months, and I want to gauge his intentions, see if he really plans to return to Trier.
unit.target: Iam fere per duas menses invicem non convenerimus, atque volo consilia eius perscrutari, videre an vere ad Trier redire cogitet.

unit.source: “Sure.” Franca understood Jenna’s concerns.
unit.target: “Certe.” Franca curas Jennae intellexit.

unit.source: Jenna nodded.
unit.target: Jenna annuit.

unit.source: “I’ll go home tonight, pack some things for him, and try to leave tomorrow morning.
unit.target: "Hac nocte domum ibo, ei aliqua condenam, et cras mane proficisci conabor.

unit.source: The sooner I go, the sooner I can come back.”
unit.target: Quo citius exeo, eo citius redeo possum.

unit.source: There were plenty of steam locomotives and riverboats heading to Port LeSeur, so she didn’t worry about not getting a ticket on the spot.
unit.target: Multa erant tramina vaporalia et navigia fluviales ad Port LeSeur profectantia, qua de causa non sollicita erat ne tessera in loco careret.

unit.source: After a brief conversation, Jenna packed her luggage, took her suitcase, and left the apartment.
unit.target: Post brevem conversationem, Jenna sarcinas suas conplevit, dolium tulit, et apartamentum reliquit.

unit.source: She hadn’t followed Julien’s instructions to cancel the lease on the Rue Pasteur apartment while he was away for his exchange program in Port LeSeur, saving money.
unit.target: Illa non secuta est iussa Julieni de locatione apartamenti in via Pasteur revocanda, dum ille, pro programmate commutationis in Port LeSeur, discessisset, pecuniam servabat.

unit.source: She still occasionally stayed there, as if she had never left.
unit.target: Adhuc interdum ibi remaneat, quasi numquam abierat.

unit.source: Watching Jenna leave, Franca felt a pang of disappointment and muttered, “I was hoping we could celebrate tonight…”
unit.target: Jenna discedentem spectans, Franca dolorem deceptionis sensit et submurmuravit: "Sperabam ut hac nocte celebraremus..."

unit.source: She walked slowly back to her bedroom and saw that some of Jenna’s clothes and belongings had been taken away.
unit.target: Lente rediit ad cubiculum suum et vidit aliquas vestes atque res Jennae ablatas esse.

unit.source: As she looked at the now tidier and cleaner bedroom, Franca seemed to understand something.
unit.target: Dum cubiculum iam melius dispositum ac purificatum aspiceret, Franca quidam sensum comprehendere videbatur.

unit.source: She fell silent.
unit.target: Tacuit.

unit.source: She felt that the Affliction potion had been somewhat digested.
unit.target: Sentiebat potionem Afflictionis aliquantum digesta esse.

unit.source: Chug, chug, chug.
unit.target: Tum, tum, tum.

unit.source: A cream-colored steam train with brass patterns sped along the tracks, heading towards the capital of Lenburg, Azshara, nestled among the mountains.
unit.target: Tramen vaporale coloris cremæ cum ornamentis aereis per semitas festinanter currebat, versus caput Lenburg, Azshara, in montibus collocatum.

unit.source: Lumian sat in a second-class carriage, looking around leisurely.
unit.target: Lumian in plaustro secundae classis sedebat, lente circumspiciens.

unit.source: Without coordinates for Azshara and unwilling to go through the messenger hassle again, he chose to teleport back to the Riston Province, take a steam train to the border, and then smuggle himself across the mountains.
unit.target: Sine coordinatis pro Azshara et nolens iterum incommoda nuntiorum pati, elegit se in Provinciam Riston dislocare, tramen vaporale sumere ad finem, atque postea per montes se clandestine transire.

unit.source: With pre-exchanged Lenburg currency, knowledge of black market traders, and intermediaries, Lumian easily obtained new identification and bought a ticket to Azshara.
unit.target: Cum moneta Lenburgensi prae-mutata, scientia mercatorum clandestinorum et intercessorum, Lumian facile novam identificationem adeptus est atque tessera ad Azshara emi.

unit.source: Lenburg was a small country, so he would reach his destination by the evening.
unit.target: Lenburg parva patria erat, itaque ad metam suam intra vesperam perveniet.
