unit.source: As Lumian observed, he noticed that Lenburg residents favored light-colored clothes and brass accessories, each carrying a book to read quietly during the journey.
unit.target: Dum Lumian observabat, animadvertit cives Lenburgenses vestimenta levium colorum et ornamenta aenea praeferre, singuli librum quiete in itinere legere.

unit.source: Even those who conversed did so in hushed tones.
unit.target: Etiam qui colloquebantur, hoc submurmurantes faciebant.

unit.source: At stops, passengers were eager to help elderly people or those dressed as scholars, showing heartfelt respect.
unit.target: Ad stationes, viatores sperabant senes aut doctos, auxilio praestare, reverentiam sincere exhibentes.

unit.source: No wonder this is the land of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Lumian silently mused.
unit.target: Non mirum est hanc terram esse deum Cognitionis et Sapientiae, sed tacite meditatus Lumian.

unit.source: Lenburg was a nation of single faith without a royal family, where the Church of Knowledge exerted strong control and influence over the country.
unit.target: Lenburg erat natio unius fidei sine familia regia, ubi Ecclesia Cognitionis potestatem firmam et auctoritatem super patriam exercebat.

unit.source: Perhaps sensing his gaze, the young man next to him, holding a book, glanced at Lumian’s “Lenburg Travel Guide” and asked with a low laugh, “Are you a foreigner?”
unit.target: Forsitan sensum eius aspectus, iuvenis iuxta eum, librum tenens, in "Lenburg Iter Dux" Lumiani oculos intenxit, et risu levi rogavit: "Esne peregrinus?"

unit.source: He spoke in Lenburg, then switched to Highlander, Loenese, Intisian, and Feysac.
unit.target: Linguam Lenburgensem locutus est, deinde ad Highlander, Loenensem, Intisian, atque Feysac versus se vertit.

unit.source: Lumian was a bit surprised.
unit.target: Lumian paulum obstupefactus est.

unit.source: A typical Lenburg second-class passenger knew so many languages?
unit.target: An typicus viator Lenburgensis classe secunda tot linguas scivisset?

unit.source: Moreover, it felt like the man was showing off.
unit.target: Praeterea, videbatur vir se ostendere.

unit.source: “Yes, I’m from Intis, and I speak Lenburg,” Lumian replied cooperatively.
unit.target: "Etiam, ex Intis sum, et linguam Lenburgensem loquor," respondit Lumian cooperanter.

unit.source: “What’s your name? It’s impressive you know all the North Continent languages.”
unit.target: "Quod est tibi nomen? Mirum est, quod omnes linguas Continenti Septentrionalis nosti."

unit.source: The young man adjusted his light-framed glasses and smiled.
unit.target: Iuvenis oculos cum limine levi correxit et subrisit.

unit.source: “My name is Sallent, and I’m just a small company employee.
unit.target: "Nomen meum est Sallent, et solum parvus operarius societatis sum.

unit.source: “Actually, once you learn one language from the North Continent, the others are easy.
unit.target: "Revera, quoniam semel unam linguam ex Continenti Septentrionali didiceris, cetera facile sunt.

unit.source: If you start with ancient Feysac, it’s even simpler.
unit.target: Si incipias a antiqua Feysac, ea etiam simpliciora fiunt.

unit.source: We Lenburgers begin learning ancient Feysac in our compulsory education.”
unit.target: Nos Lenburgenses antiquam Feysac in nostra educatione obligatoria discere incipimus.

unit.source: Sallent’s tone carried a hint of pride, almost looking down on other countries still plagued by illiteracy and people who didn’t know foreign languages.
unit.target: Tonus Sallent insinuabat superbiam, paene despicens alias terras adhuc a litterarum ignorantia oppressas et homines linguas alienas nescentes.

unit.source: In theory, yes, otherwise, I wouldn’t have mastered Highlander so quickly.
unit.target: In ratione, ita; alioquin linguam Highlander non tam celeriter pervenerim.

unit.source: My Dutanese is just barely passable…
unit.target: Lingua Dutana mea vix tolerabilis est…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t mind Sallent’s slight arrogance.
unit.target: Lumian parvam Sallent arrogantiam non curabat.

unit.source: The Lenburgers he met this morning all had a similar attitude.
unit.target: Lenburgenses quos hoc mane convenit omnes talem rationem habebant.

unit.source: Keeping his voice low, Lumian said with a smile, “You’re quite civilized, showing great respect for the elderly and scholars, and reading on the train instead of chatting or playing.”
unit.target: Voce humili servata, Lumian cum risu dixit: "Es valde urbanus, senibus atque eruditis magna reverentia tribuens, et in tramine legens potius quam loquens aut ludens."

unit.source: Sallent replied with restrained pride, “In Lenburg, knowledge is the most precious, and scholars have more knowledge.
unit.target: Sallent cum temperata superbia respondit: "In Lenburg, scientia pretiosissima est, et eruditi plurimam scientiam habent.

unit.source: Elders, throughout their lives, accumulate a lot of experiential knowledge.”
unit.target: Senes per totam vitam suam abundantem scientiam ex experientia colligunt.

unit.source: Sallent let out a self-deprecating laugh.
unit.target: Sallent risum auto-deprecativum edidit.

unit.source: “Reading is a habit from childhood and a necessity.
unit.target: "Lectio est consuetudo ex pueritia et necessitas.

unit.source: You wouldn’t know that our lives are filled with exams and evaluations—in school, in companies, and even in church, where we take theological tests during grand masses to show our piety and respect for the God of Knowledge.
unit.target: Nescies quin vita nostra plena sit examinationibus et aestimationibus—in scholis, in societatibus, atque etiam in ecclesia, ubi per magnas Missas probationes theologicas capimus ut pietatem ac reverentiam erga Deum Cognitionis ostendamus.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly felt this wasn’t necessarily a good thing.
unit.target: Lumian subito sensit hoc non necessario esse bonum.

unit.source: No wonder Ludwig is reluctant to return to the Church of Knowledge…
unit.target: Non mirum est Ludwig ad Ecclesiam Cognitionis redire nolle…

unit.source: But Aurore would love it here.
unit.target: Sed Aurore hic id amabit.

unit.source: She wouldn’t want to live here herself, but she’d certainly want to send me here to study…
unit.target: Ipsa hic vivere nollet, sed certe me ad studendum hic mittere vellet…

unit.source: Seeing the foreigner beside him fall silent, Sallent sighed and said, “That’s why I didn’t stay in Azshara after graduating.
unit.target: Videntes peregrinum iuxta se tacuisse, Sallent suspiravit et dixit: "Ideo post lauream in Azshara non remansi."

unit.source: The pressure is overwhelming—qualification exams, annual competency reviews, monthly company evaluations, job training exams, and so on.
unit.target: Pressura est opprimitrix: examina ad qualificationem, recognitiones annuas competentiae, aestimationes mensuales societatis, probationes ad disciplinae munus, et cetera.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t help but hiss internally.
unit.target: Lumian intus susurrare non potuit nisi.

unit.source: So this is the daily life of Lenburgers, especially those in Azshara?
unit.target: Itaque haec est vita cotidiana Lenburgensium, praesertim eorum in Azshara?

unit.source: Ludwig’s vague descriptions didn’t prepare me for this.
unit.target: Descriptiones indubiae Ludovici me ad hoc non praeparaverunt.

unit.source: I thought only students had it hard…
unit.target: Putabam solum discipulos esse qui difficultatibus laborarent…

unit.source: Thank goodness Aurore took me in and not some Lenburger…
unit.target: Gratias sit Deo quod Aurore me accepit, non aliquem Lenburgensem…

unit.source: Talking about this made Sallent feel melancholic, prompting him to lower his head and return to his book.
unit.target: Hac re loquendo, Sallent se melancolicum sensit, inde caput inclinare et ad librum reverti.

unit.source: Judging by the time, Lumian realized they were close to Azshara, so he started pondering the issue of the City of Exiles, Morora.
unit.target: Tempore iudicato, Lumian conspexit eos prope Azshara esse, et itaque de Urbe Exilorum, Morora meditari coepisse.

unit.source: He hesitated and then asked Sallent, “Have you heard of a city called Morora?”
unit.target: Haesitavit, deinde Sallent interrogavit: "Audivistine urbem, quae Morora vocatur?"

unit.source: Sallent thought carefully and then replied, “No, neither in reality nor in any legends.”
unit.target: Sallent diligenter cogitavit, deinde respondit: "Minime, nec in realitate nec in ulla fabula."

unit.source: Lumian gave a noncommittal grunt and turned his gaze back to the quickly receding mountain scenery outside, as if their conversation was just casual small talk.
unit.target: Lumian gruntionem indifferens edidit et oculos ad celeriter recedentem montium scaenam extra vertit, quasi eorum colloquium esset solum leviter inter se conversatum.

unit.source: If Madam Magician couldn’t find it, I probably can’t either, unless I kidnap a demigod of the Church of Knowledge…
unit.target: Si Domina Magica id invenire non potuit, fortasse ne ego quidem possum, nisi demideum deum Ecclesiae Cognitionis rapere conar…

unit.source: Since the Church of Knowledge placed parts of the Abscessed Hand in Morora, can I use the connection between the body parts to find the city?
unit.target: Cum Ecclesia Cognitionis partes Manus Abscessae in Morora collocaverit, an nexum inter corpora ad urbem detegendam uti possim?

unit.source: The Church of Knowledge expects and allows me to go to Morora, perhaps even hoping for it. Will they give me a hint?
unit.target: Ecclesia Cognitionis exspectat et sinit me ad Morora ire, fortasse etiam id sperans; dabuntne mihi aliquod indicium?

unit.source: With these thoughts, Lumian grew more determined.
unit.target: His cogitationibus, Lumian firmior factus est.

unit.source: As dusk fell, the steam locomotive stopped at a platform paved with gray and white stone slabs.
unit.target: Dum crepusculum adveniebat, tramen vaporale in platforma lapidibus cinereis et albis pavimentata consedit.

unit.source: Lumian, carrying a small suitcase, walked with Sallent through the station decorated with book sculptures and brass patterns.
unit.target: Lumian, parvam capsam ferens, cum Sallent per stationem ambulavit, quae sculpturis librorum et ornamentalibus aereis ornata erat.

unit.source: The wind howled through the mountains, bringing cold but refreshing air.
unit.target: Ventus per montes ululabat, aerem frigidum sed refrigerantem afferens.

unit.source: As they approached the entrance of Azshara Steam Train Station, Lumian saw several clergy members from the Church of Knowledge in white robes trimmed with brass blocking the way, checking the documents of passengers.
unit.target: Accedentes ad introitum Stationis Traminis Vaporalis Azsharae, Lumian cerno plures clercos Ecclesiae Cognitionis in tunicis albis cum ornamento aeneo viam obstruentes, documenta vectorum examinantes.

unit.source: “What’s going on?” Lumian asked.
unit.target: "Quid agitur?" inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Sallent glanced over and casually replied, “Routine exit checks, done alternately by the Church and the government.”
unit.target: Sallent intuebatur et leviter respondit: "Inspectiones exitiariae, vicissim ab Ecclesia et gubernatione exsequuntur."

unit.source: “I thought they might randomly stop people to test their knowledge,” Lumian joked.
unit.target: "Putabam fortasse eos casu homines sistere posse ad scientiam probandam," iocatus est Lumian.

unit.source: Sallent turned his head sharply, eyes filled with fear, as if to say: “Are you a devil? Even the Church bishops wouldn’t think of that!”
unit.target: Sallent caput subito vertit, oculis timore repletis, quasi diceret: "Esne diabolus?" Neque episcopi Ecclesiae id in mente habebunt!

unit.source: Lumian shrugged and stepped forward to have his documents checked by the clergy.
unit.target: Lumian umeros levavit et procedere coepit ut documenta eius a clericis examinaretur.

unit.source: The elder leading the group scrutinized Lumian, glanced at his documents, then signaled to the others.
unit.target: Senior, qui coetum ducebat, Lumianum diligenter examinavit, documenta eius conspectus, deinde aliis signum dedit.

unit.source: Lumian was quickly surrounded by the clergy, all poised for action.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter a clericis circumdatus est, omnes ad agendum parati.

unit.source: The elder stared at him and said sternly, “We’ve found a wanted criminal.
unit.target: Senior eum fixo intuenti et severo tono dixit: "Criminalem quaesitum invenimus.

unit.source: Take him away!”
unit.target: Auferte eum!

unit.source: Uh… Lumian raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: “Heu… Lumian supercilium sublevavit.

unit.source: In a split second, he decided not to resist, extending his hands to let the clergy cuff him with silver handcuffs.
unit.target: In momento, statuit non resistendum esse, manus extendens, ut clerici eum cingulis argenteis vincirent.

unit.source: 792 Judgment
unit.target: 792 Iudicium

unit.source: 792 Judgment
unit.target: 792 Iudicium

unit.source: Inside the slow-moving carriage, Lumian, handcuffed and shackled, stared at the window with iron bars welded and covered with thick cloth.
unit.target: In curru lento moventi, Lumian, manubus cingulis vinctus et catenis obligatus, in fenestram aspicabat, quarum trabes ferreae coniunctae et crasso panno tectae erant.

unit.source: His belief in his own judgment grew stronger.
unit.target: Fides eius in proprio iudicio firmior facta est.

unit.source: When the clergy from the Church of Knowledge accused him of being a wanted criminal, his first reaction wasn’t to be on guard but to feel a wave of confusion.
unit.target: Cum clerici Ecclesiae Scientiae eum criminalem quaesitum accusaverunt, prima eius reactio non fuit vigilare sed undam confusionis sentire.

unit.source: He sensed that those performing the routine exit check were there specifically for him.
unit.target: Sensus est ei, eos qui inspectionem ordinariam exitus peragere solebant, specialiter ad eum conversos esse.

unit.source: But apart from Ludwig and the 0-01 incident, he had no interaction with the Church of Knowledge and hadn’t harmed their interests.
unit.target: Sed praeter Ludwigum et casum 0-01, nullam relationem cum Ecclesia Scientiae habebat neque eorum utilitates laesit.

unit.source: Why are you Lenburgers so enthusiastic about catching an Intisian criminal?
unit.target: Cur, o Lenburgenses, tam vehementer existitis scelestum Intisianum capere?

unit.source: Did you even verify the details and the target’s current abilities?
unit.target: Num diligenter perspexistis singula ac facultates praesentis rei?

unit.source: As thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian, noticing Sallent’s surprised, fearful yet relieved gaze, thought of a possibility: Is this the hint from the Church of Knowledge?
unit.target: Dum cogitationes per mentem eius rapiditer transibant, Lumian, Sallent oculos admiratos, timidos sed etiam solatos intuentem, contemplavit: "Num haec sit monita Ecclesiae Scientiae?"

unit.source: No, this isn’t just a hint.
unit.target: Non, hoc non solum est indicium.

unit.source: They’re directly escorting me to the destination!
unit.target: Me directe ad destinatum locum comitantur!

unit.source: The City of Exiles, as the name suggests, is a place for exiling criminals.
unit.target: Civitas Exilorum, ut nomen indicat, est locus ad scelestos exiliandos.

unit.source: When I’m arrested as a wanted criminal and sentenced to exile, I’ll naturally be sent to Morora…
unit.target: Cum, ut scelestus quaesitus, comprehensus sim et exilio damnatus, naturaliter ad Mororam mittar…

unit.source: Isn’t this method a bit too straightforward?
unit.target: Nonne haec methodus paulo nimis directa est?

unit.source: How did they know I was coming?
unit.target: Quomodo sciverunt me venturum esse?

unit.source: Although I didn’t disguise myself, I kept a low profile the entire way…
unit.target: Etsi me non dissimulavi, totum iter humilem tenui.

unit.source: Are High-Sequence Beyonders of the Reader pathway adept at prophecy or divination?
unit.target: Num Beyonders in via Lectoris Altissimae Series in vaticinatione aut divinatione periti sunt?

unit.source: Lumian glanced at his waist, looking at the Traveler’s Bag that hadn’t been confiscated.
unit.target: Lumian ad latus suum intueri, inspectans sacculum viatoris, quod non confiscatum erat.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but silently grumble, “They didn’t confiscate a wanted criminal’s belongings or take measures against potential dangerous criminals to restrict the use of Beyonder powers…”
unit.target: Silentio murmurat: “Non confiscaverunt bona scelesti quaesiti neque instituerunt cautiones contra scelestos potentialiter periculosos ad restringendum usum virium Beyonder.”

unit.source: This performance is too unconvincing.
unit.target: Haec repraesentatio nimis inconvincens est.

unit.source: Are they afraid I won’t notice and might resist, causing losses?
unit.target: An timent ut non animadvertere possim et oppugnare incipiam, damna efficiendo?

unit.source: Lumian silently took the Traveler’s Bag from his belt and tucked it into the inner pocket of his thick jacket.
unit.target: Lumian silentio sacculum viatoris de balte suo sustulit et in sinum internum veste crassa commisit.

unit.source: He didn’t want to make things difficult for the clergy of the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Noluit res difficile reddere pro clericis Ecclesiae Scientiae.

unit.source: Their poor acting doesn’t matter, but I can’t be equally patronizing.
unit.target: Agendi eorum modus miserabilis non refert; sed ego aeque indulgere non possum.

unit.source: What if other serious offenders, nearby Azshara citizens, or assisting police officers see the Traveler’s Bag?
unit.target: Quid si alii scelesti graviores, cives Azshara prope, vel custodes auxiliantes sacculum viatoris videant?

unit.source: They’d think the clergy of the Church of Knowledge are unprofessional!
unit.target: Putarent clericos Ecclesiae Scientiae esse imperitos!

unit.source: After driving for a while, the vehicle finally stopped.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, vehiculus tandem sistit.

unit.source: Under the strict guard of several clergy members in white robes trimmed with brass, Lumian was escorted to a massive white tower.
unit.target: Sub stricta custodia plurium clericorum, induti albis vestibus cum ornamento auri, Lumian ad magnam turrim albonem comitati est.

unit.source: Before he could take a good look at the tower’s full appearance or even see its spire to confirm its grandeur, he was “pushed” through a side door, down a stone staircase, through a dim corridor lit by several gas wall lamps, and into a cell made of black iron.
unit.target: Antequam plenam speciem turrim intuens aut etiam culmen eius pro magnificentia videret, per ianuam lateralem impulsum est, de scala lapidea descendens, per obscurum corridorium illuminatum pluribus lucernis gasi, et in cellam ex ferro nigro constitutam impositus est.

unit.source: Lumian glanced around and saw about eight people already inside, all handcuffed and shackled.
unit.target: Lumian circumspiciens vidit fere octo homines intra, omnes manubus vinctos et catenis obligatos.

unit.source: Some were even chained through their collarbones, fixed in place.
unit.target: Nonnulli etiam per claviculas catenati erant, firmiter in loco positi.

unit.source: Such restraints would be effective even against Beyonders, but they couldn’t suppress those with more mystical abilities…
unit.target: Talia vincula etiam contra Beyonderos efficacia esse poterant, sed eos cum facultatibus magis mysticis opprimere non poterant.

unit.source: If it were me, being locked up like this would render my Hunter combat skills useless, but it wouldn’t stop me from starting fires, provoking, scouting for weaknesses, swapping fates, or teleporting to escape.
unit.target: Si ego essem, taliter inclusus artes meas Venatoris pugnandi inutiles fuisset, sed non prohiberet me incendia accendere, provocare, infirmitates explorare, fata mutare, aut celeriter transire ad evadendum.

unit.source: Come on, can’t you be more professional? This performance is too fake…
unit.target: Age, non potesne esse magis peritus? Haec repraesentatio nimis ficta est…

unit.source: Lumian thought as he watched the elder who had arrested him open the iron cell door.
unit.target: Lumian cogitavit, spectans senex eum apprehendens ostium cellae ferrea aperire.

unit.source: The slightly aged clergyman stepped aside and said to Lumian, “Stay here and await your judgment.”
unit.target: Clericus paulo senescens se abdexit et Lumiano dixit: “Mane hic et iudicium tuum exspecta.”

unit.source: Judgment? You haven’t even done the judgment yet? Have you given up on pretending?
unit.target: Iudicium? Iudicium nondum egisti? An simulandi conatum iam reliquisti?

unit.source: Lumian cooperatively shuffled into the cell.
unit.target: Lumian comiter in cellam se contulit.

unit.source: Clang! The iron cell door was closed and locked.
unit.target: Clang! Ostium cellae ferrea clausa et reclusum erat.

unit.source: Lumian looked around, found a metal chair fixed to the ground, and sat down, casting his gaze at the serious offenders who were sizing him up.
unit.target: Lumian circumspiciens sedem ex metallo ad terram fixam invenit, et consedit, oculos suos in scelestos graves qui eum examinabant intendens.

unit.source: A young man with glasses, sitting opposite him, raised his chin and said, “Didn’t expect someone younger than me to arrive. Brother, what crime did you commit?”
unit.target: Iuvenis cum speculis, adversus eum sedens, mentum erexit et dixit: “Non exspectavi aliquem mihi iunorem adventurum esse. Frater, quid scelus commissus es?”

unit.source: Without answering, Lumian asked in return, “What about you?”
unit.target: Sine respondere, Lumian rogavit vicissim: “Et tu?”

unit.source: The young man with glasses smiled and said, “Murder. Most people here are murderers.”
unit.target: Iuvenis cum speculis subridens dixit: “Homicidium. Plerique hic homicidae sunt.”

unit.source: “How many did you kill?” a middle-aged man with a sturdy build and chains through his collarbones asked curiously.
unit.target: “Quot occidisti?” inquit vir medius, robusto corpore et claviculis catenatis, curiosus.

unit.source: “Seven or eight. I’m not sure if one of them died in the end,” the young man replied with a reminiscent look.
unit.target: “Septem vel octo. Nescio an quis eorum tandem mortuus sit,” respondit iuvenis cum aspectu reminiscente.

unit.source: “Ending a human life with my own hands, feeling their pain, struggle, and despair, having their warm blood splatter on my face, is intoxicating.
unit.target: Vitam hominis propriis manibus finire, dolorem, certamen atque desperationem eorum experiri, et sanguinem calidum in facie meā effundum sentire, mihi inebrians est.

unit.source: At that moment, I felt like their god, their lord.”
unit.target: Tunc instanti, me quasi deum eorum, dominum eorum, sentiebam.

unit.source: A Serial Killer? Lumian silently watched, not interrupting the exchange among these serious offenders.
unit.target: Homicida seriatim? Lumian silentio spectabat, neque sermonem inter hos scelestos graves interpellans.

unit.source: The young man sighed in the end.
unit.target: Iuvenis tandem suspiravit.

unit.source: “Unfortunately, Azshara has too many detectives. They eventually found me. What about you? How many did you kill, and why?” he asked the middle-aged man with chained collarbones.
unit.target: “Heu, Azshara nimis multas inquisitores habet. Tandem me invenerunt. Et tu? Quot occidisti, et cur?” inquit vir medius, claviculis catenatis.

unit.source: The man replied indifferently, as if describing his breakfast, “Don’t know. Too many. Do you keep count of how many slices of bread you eat in a month?”
unit.target: Vir indifferenter respondit, quasi de ientaculo suo narrans: “Nescio. Multa sunt. Numeras-ne quot frusta panis in mense edas?”

unit.source: “That’s a quote from Emperor Roselle of Intis, right? I read it in a biography,” the young man replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Ista est sententia a Imperatore Roselle de Intis, nonne? Legebam eam in biographia,” respondit iuvenis subridente.

unit.source: “I remember eating 123 slices last month.”
unit.target: Memini me mense priore CXLIII (123) frusta panis comedisse.

unit.source: The middle-aged man was silent for a few seconds and then said, “I kill because they deserve to die. And the more deserving they are, the tastier their flesh.”
unit.target: Vir medius paucis momentis tacuit deinde dixit: “Occido, quia mori debent; et quanto magis id merent, tanto sapidior caro eorum est.”

unit.source: “You eat the people you kill?” the young man’s expression changed slightly.
unit.target: “Edisne homines quos occidis?” inquit iuvenis, vultu leviter mutato.

unit.source: “Depending on how much they deserve it, there are different cooking methods,” the middle-aged man replied seriously.
unit.target: “Secundum quantum id meruerint, varia sunt modi coquendi,” respondit vir medius serio.

unit.source: “You two are both freaks,” a sullen man in his thirties snorted.
unit.target: “Vos duo estis vere aberrantes,” inquit vir tristis in annis tricesimis.

unit.source: The young man didn’t get angry and asked curiously, “Why did you kill?”
unit.target: Iuvenis, non iratus sed curiosus, rogavit: “Cur occidisti?”

unit.source: “I didn’t kill for the sake of killing. I just wanted to rape them. Blame them on resisting too much,” the sullen man answered with a look of disdain, as if saying he was different from these perverts.
unit.target: “Non occidi pro caede sola; volui tantum eos violare. In ipsorum nimia repugnatione culpam invenio,” respondit vir tristis vultu contemptus, quasi se ab his perversis distingueret.

unit.source: The young man laughed and pointed to a woman with disheveled brown hair and collarbone chains, “She also rapes and kills, but that’s incidental.”
unit.target: Iuvenis risit et ad mulierem, cui crines brunnei soluti erant et claviculae in catenis erant, demonstravit, dicens: “Illam quoque violat et occidit, sed id est incidentale.”

unit.source: Her main purpose is collecting reproductive organs.
unit.target: Eius praecipuum propositum est organa generativa colligere.

unit.source: Sitting quietly on a metal chair, slightly leaning forward, Lumian couldn’t help but shake his head.
unit.target: Sedens quiete in sella metallina, paulum inclinatus, Lumian caput concutere non potuit.

unit.source: Does Lenburg have too many murderers? On average, each has a few body counts…
unit.target: Num Lenburg habet nimis plures homicidas? In mediis, quisque paucos caedes numerat.

unit.source: The gentlemanly young man looked at Lumian again.
unit.target: Iuvenis urbanus iterum ad Lumian respexit.

unit.source: “What about you? What major crime did you commit?”
unit.target: “Et tu? Quod scelus grave commissus es?”

unit.source: Lumian thought seriously for a moment and said, “Murder, blasphemy, arson, kidnapping, extortion, intimidation, deceit, causing explosions, inducing miscarriages, worshiping evil gods, attacking government officials, blackmailing the orthodox Churches…”
unit.target: Lumian serio per momentum meditatus et dixit: “Homicidium, blasphemia, incendium, raptus, extortio, intimidatio, dolus, explosionum faciendorum, abortus inducens, deos malos colens, officiales regiminis oppugnantem, et Ecclesias orthodoxas minatione opprimens…”

unit.source: The young man was stunned for a few seconds and then laughed.
unit.target: Iuvenis per aliquot secundos stupefactus est deinde risit.

unit.source: “Brother, haven’t you committed too many crimes?”
unit.target: “Frater, num non nimis multa scelera commissus es?”

unit.source: “Why else would I be here?” Lumian replied casually.
unit.target: “Cur aliter hic sim?” respondit Lumian leniter.

unit.source: “True.” The young man and the other serious offenders looked at Lumian with more respect.
unit.target: “Vero.” Iuvenis et ceteri scelesti graves in Lumiano maiore reverentia conspexerunt.

unit.source: “How many did you kill exactly?” the young man asked, as if he could immerse himself in the details.
unit.target: “Quot occidisti exacte?” inquit iuvenis, quasi in minutia se immiscere posset.

unit.source: Lumian shook his head and said in a low voice, “I didn’t count and don’t want to answer. It’s not something to boast about. It’s like a farmer culling wheat—I’m just doing my job. Would you be happy doing your daily job well?”
unit.target: Lumian caput concussit et voce humili dixit: “Non numeravi neque vellem responsum dare; haec res non est ad gloriandum. Sicut agricola triticum selecens, officium meum tantum ago. Esne felix si cotidie officium tuum bene peragas?”

unit.source: The young man was silent for a moment and then said, “What’s your name? I’m Guei. Maybe we’ll meet again in the land of Death.”
unit.target: Iuvenis paululum tacuit deinde dixit: “Quod nomen tibi est? Ego sum Guei. Forsitan in terra Mortis iterum conveniamus.”

unit.source: Lumian simply replied, “Louis.”
unit.target: Lumian simpliciter respondit: “Louis.”

unit.source: He didn’t want to use his real name among these people or in the City of Exiles. In mysticism, knowing someone’s real name could lead to curses.
unit.target: Non voluit nomen suum verum apud hos aut in Urbe Exilorum uti. In mystica, nomen verum aliquis scire maledicta afferre poterat.

unit.source: The Inevitability pathway had similar contract abilities.
unit.target: Iter Inevitabilitatis facultates contractuales similes habebat.

unit.source: “What about you guys?” Guei asked the others.
unit.target: “Et vos?” inquit Guei ad ceteros.

unit.source: “Lez,” the middle-aged man replied.
unit.target: “Lez,” respondit vir medius.

unit.source: The sullen man hesitated but answered, “Vijepan.”
unit.target: Vir tristis dubitavit sed respondit: “Vijepan.”

unit.source: “Julie,” said the woman with disheveled brown hair, her gaze lingering greedily on Guei and the others’ crotches.
unit.target: “Julie,” inquit mulier cum capillis brunneis solutis et claviculis in catenis, oculos avide in regionem inguinalem Guei et ceterorum intendens.

unit.source: After the serious offenders introduced themselves, Lumian smiled and said, “I didn’t expect Lenburg’s security to be so bad, with so many serial killers. Right, I’m from Intis. I haven’t been in Lenburg long.”
unit.target: Postquam scelesti graves se invicem declaraverunt, Lumian subridet et ait: “Non exspectabam securitatem Lenburg tam pravam esse, cum tot homicidas seriatim sint. Recte, ego sum ex Intis. Non diu in Lenburg fui.”

unit.source: Guei, the most talkative, raised his handcuffed hands, adjusted his glasses, and said with a smile, “Actually, it’s not bad, even quite good, because Lenburg has the most and best detectives in the world.”
unit.target: Guei, qui loquacissimus erat, manus cingulis vinctas elevavit, speculas suas corrigens, et subridente dixit: “Revera, non est malum, sed etiam satis bonum, nam Lenburg maximum ac optimum numerum inspectorum in mundo habet.”

unit.source: “But there are still many people like us—twisted personalities combined with a lot of knowledge easily create a batch of formidable criminals.
unit.target: Sed adhuc multi sunt similes nobis—personalitates tortuosas cum magna scientia facile efficiunt coetum formidabilium scelestorum.

unit.source: And criminals from other countries come here, wanting to challenge Lenburg’s detectives.”
unit.target: Et scelesti ex aliis nationibus hic veniunt, volentes inspectoribus Lenburgensibus provocationem inferre.

unit.source: Detectives are Sequence 7 of the Reader pathway, which belongs to the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Inspectores sunt Series VII viae Lectoris, quae Ecclesiae Scientiae pertinent.

unit.source: There are indeed many here…
unit.target: Multi quidem hic adsunt…

unit.source: Could there be real Criminals and Serial Killers among these criminals, using the Detectives for their own role‐play?
unit.target: Num inter hos scelestos veri scelesti et homicidae seriatim esse possint, qui inspectores ad ludos suos adhibent?

unit.source: But then again, if the detectives catch the Devil pathway criminals, they can better and faster digest their own potions…
unit.target: Sed, si inspectores scelestos viae Diaboli prehendunt, potiones suas melius ac celerius digerre possunt.

unit.source: Lumian thought, nodding slightly and replying with a smile, “Am I one of them?”
unit.target: Lumian cogitavit, leviter caput adnuit et subridente dixit: “Num ego unus eorum sim?”

unit.source: “You have a clear understanding of your own personality. The more knowledge you have, the more dangerous you become.”
unit.target: Tuae personalitatis clarum intellectum habes. Quo plura scientiae habeas, eo periculosior fies.

unit.source: Guei coughed and said, “Yes, I now regret not having more knowledge.”
unit.target: Guei tussivit et dixit: “Ita, nunc paenitet me quod non plus scientiae acquisivi.”

unit.source: As the serious offenders alternated between silence and idle chatter, time seemed to pass without notice.
unit.target: Dum scelesti graves inter silentium et inanem sermocinando alternabant, tempus quasi inobservatum praeteribat.

unit.source: Finally, the clergy from before escorted a woman to the cell.
unit.target: Denique clerici pristini mulierem ad cellam duxerunt.

unit.source: She wore a shirt with white lace flowers at the collar, a beige coat with brass trim, a dark knee-length skirt, and brown boots.
unit.target: Ea induta erat tunica qua flores ligati albi ad collem erant, pallio beige cum ornamentis auri, lacerna obscura usque ad genua, et calceamentis fuscis.

unit.source: Her face was oval, her light blue eyes like spring water, her nose high and straight, and her brown hair simply tied back with a bun—a very beautiful woman.
unit.target: Facies eius ovoidis erat, oculi caerulei ut aquae vernales, nasus altus et rectus, ac crines fusci simpliciter in nodum coacti erant—mulier valde pulchra.

unit.source: Seeing her, Vijepan’s eyes lit up.
unit.target: Cum eam vidit, oculi Vijepan fulgore refulserunt.

unit.source: “You have been judged, and I will announce the verdict.”
unit.target: “Iudicatus es, et sententiam pronuntiabo.”

unit.source: The beautiful woman said this before turning and walking toward the end of the dim corridor.
unit.target: Inquit mulier pulchra, antequam se converteret et ad finem obscuri corridorii ambularet.

unit.source: The other clergy opened the cell and escorted Lumian, Guei, and the others behind her.
unit.target: Ceteri clerici cellam aperuerunt et Lumian, Guei, et ceteros post eam duxerunt.

unit.source: They descended stone stairs, going deeper and deeper underground, until they reached a large, double brass door.
unit.target: Descendentes scalae lapideae, semper profunda sub terra, donec ad magnam ianuam duplicem auri pervenerunt.

unit.source: The beautiful woman with the oval face stopped and turned to face Lumian and the others, her expression serious.
unit.target: Mulier pulchra, cuius facies ovoidis erat, sistit et ad Lumian et ceteros conversam aspicientem vultu serio constituit.

unit.source: “Your verdict is: ‘Exile, never to return!’”
unit.target: “Sententia vestra est: Exilium, nec umquam revertimini!”

unit.source: “Exile to where?” Guei asked, both surprised and confused.
unit.target: “Exilium quo?” inquit Guei, simul miratus atque confusus.

unit.source: Not a death sentence?
unit.target: Nonne hoc non est sententia mortis?

unit.source: The woman pointed to the brass double doors behind her.
unit.target: Mulier demonstravit ad ianuas duplices auri, quae post eam erant.

unit.source: “Exile beyond these doors.”
unit.target: “Exilium ultra has ianuas.”

unit.source: As soon as she finished speaking, a chilling, indistinct sound came from behind the doors.
unit.target: Statim postquam locuta est, sonus frigidus et indistinctus ex post ianuas emersit.

unit.source: 793 Morora
unit.target: 793 Morora

unit.source: 793 Morora
unit.target: 793 Morora

unit.source: Hearing the sounds from behind the door, the faces of all the serious offenders changed, except for Lumian.
unit.target: Sonos ex posteriori parte ostii audientes, vultus omnium reorum gravium mutati sunt, excepto Luminiano.

unit.source: Guei blurted out, “What’s behind the door?”
unit.target: Guei subito exclamat, “Quid est post ostium?”

unit.source: Could exile actually mean being sent to some monster to be its food?
unit.target: Num exilium revera significat te ad monstrum aliquod mittere, ut eius escam fias?

unit.source: “Behind the door is a path leading to your place of exile,” the beautiful woman with the oval face answered simply.
unit.target: «Post ostium est via quae ad locum exilii tui ducit,» respondit pulchra femina, facie ovali, simpliciter.

unit.source: “There are no monsters waiting to eat you, but it is indeed dangerous.
unit.target: Non sunt monstra quae te edere exspectant, sed re vera periculosum est.

unit.source: I don’t know the specifics, but there’s definitely a chance for you to survive.
unit.target: Nescio singularia, sed certe occasio est ut superes.

unit.source: It’s much better than being hanged or shot.”
unit.target: Plurimum melius est quam suspendi aut sagittis percussi.

unit.source: Guei, Lez, and the others exchanged glances, then looked at the clergy in white robes trimmed with brass.
unit.target: Guei, Lez, et ceteri oculos inter se commutaverunt, deinde ad clericos in albis vestibus cum latonia ornamentis intuiti sunt.

unit.source: They were tempted but eventually suppressed their urge.
unit.target: Temptati erant, sed tandem impetum suum reprimere conati sunt.

unit.source: They believed they were no match for the clergy of the Church of Knowledge, especially the beautiful woman who clearly held a higher status.
unit.target: Crediderunt se non esse paria clericorum Ecclesiae Scientiae, praesertim pulchrae feminae quae claram dignitatem superabat.

unit.source: Guei glanced at Lumian and saw that the wanted criminal, who claimed to have committed various serious crimes, looked calm and unafraid.
unit.target: Guei in Luminiano intuitus est et animadvertit reum fugitivum, qui multas graves scelera committere confitebatur, tranquillus et timore carens.

unit.source: “I will open the door in a moment.
unit.target: “Mox ostium aperiam.

unit.source: You will enter on your own.
unit.target: Tu solus ingredieris.

unit.source: Anyone who stays behind will have an additional charge tagged on, and be sentenced to death on the spot,” the beautiful woman said, raising her hands.
unit.target: Quicumque remanet, onus additum super eum imponetur et statim ad mortem damnabitur, inquit pulchra femina, manus levans.

unit.source: In her light blue eyes, countless illusory lights seemed to float.
unit.target: In eius oculis caeruleis levibus, innumerabiles luxes illusoriae videbantur fluitare.

unit.source: Dark, dim rain fell silently from a height of about four meters, drenching Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Imber obscurus et tenuis silentio de altitudine circiter quattuor metrorum cadebat, Luminiano et ceteros madens.

unit.source: Lumian immediately felt irritated, a wave of violent emotions surging within him.
unit.target: Lumian statim irritari sensit, fluctuum violentarum passionum intus insurgentium experitur.

unit.source: It seemed like the blood of Omebella was stirring.
unit.target: Videbatur sanguis Omebellae excitari.

unit.source: “What did you do to us?” Guei asked, unsure and alarmed.
unit.target: «Quid nobis fecistis?» inquit Guei, incertus et turbatus.

unit.source: The beautiful woman in the beige coat with brass trim explained in a teaching tone,
unit.target: Pulchra femina, induta veste beige cum latonia marginata, in tono praeceptorio explicavit:

unit.source: “This is a mystic technique called ‘Harps’ Rain of Sterility.’
unit.target: «Haec est ars mystica, quae “Pluvia Harpārum Sterilitatis” appellatur.

unit.source: It renders you infertile but can be reversed with the corresponding mystic technique or by a professional doctor.
unit.target: Te infertilem reddit, sed arte mystica congruente aut per medicum peritum revocari potest.

unit.source: We don’t want babies born in the place of exile.
unit.target: Non volumus ut infantes in loco exilii nascantur.

unit.source: They are innocent.”
unit.target: Sunt innocentes.»

unit.source: Rain of Sterility…
unit.target: Pluvia Sterilitatis…

unit.source: No wonder Omebella’s blood reacted so strongly…
unit.target: Non mirum est sanguis Omebellae ita vehementer reaguisse…

unit.source: I wonder if this secret technique will affect me or if the special properties of Omebella’s bloodline will neutralize it…
unit.target: Miror utrum haec ars secreta me afficiat aut proprietates peculiares stirpis Omebellae eam neutralizabunt…

unit.source: If it works, would it prevent embryos from implanting if I were influenced by the Great Mother in the future?
unit.target: Si id operatur, num impediat embryones in se inseri, si in futurum a Magna Matre me afficeret?

unit.source: It probably depends on the rank of the influence…
unit.target: Certe pendet ex gradu influentiae…

unit.source: Lumian thought that the Rain of Sterility might not be a bad thing.
unit.target: Lumian existimavit Pluvia Sterilitatis fortasse non esse rem nefariam.

unit.source: The other serious offenders didn’t see it as a problem either.
unit.target: Ceteri reos graves id quoque non videbant ut problema.

unit.source: Some already had children, while others were too cold-blooded or twisted to think much about offspring.
unit.target: Quidam iam proles habebant, alii autem nimis frigidi sanguine aut perversi erant ut de posteritate multum cogitarent.

unit.source: The beautiful woman stepped back a few paces, faced the brass doors, and pressed her hands in the air.
unit.target: Pulchra femina paucis passibus retrocessit, ianuas latonia intuens, et manus in aere levavit.

unit.source: The doors emitted a heavy, metallic creaking sound and slowly opened.
unit.target: Ianuae sonum gravem et metallicum crepitum reddiderunt et lente apertae sunt.

unit.source: For some reason, Guei and the others felt an urge to go through the doors, stepping into the dim passage beyond.
unit.target: Aliqua re, Guei et ceteri impulsum habuerunt per ianuas transire, ingredientes in obscuram viam ultra.

unit.source: They didn’t notice that, except for the beautiful woman, the clergy of the Church of Knowledge had retreated to the edge of the corridor, standing on the steps when the doors opened.
unit.target: Non animadverterunt quod, nisi pulchrae feminae, clerici Ecclesiae Scientiae ad margines corridorii regressi erant, in gradibus stantes cum ianuae apertae essent.

unit.source: Lumian felt the same urge, sensing something familiar yet unknown calling to him from deep within the passage.
unit.target: Lumian idem impulsum sensit, aliquid notum sed ignotum ex profundo viae ad eum vocantem sentiens.

unit.source: He walked in the middle of the group, hearing the clang of the closing doors behind them.
unit.target: In medio coetus ambulavit, sonitum ianuarum claudentium post se audiens.

unit.source: The passage dimmed significantly, illuminated only by glowing gems embedded in the walls.
unit.target: Via multum obscurata est, solummodo gemmis fulgentibus in parietibus inclusis illustrata.

unit.source: How extravagant… Lumian instinctively thought.
unit.target: Quam extravagantia, Lumian instinctu cogitavit.

unit.source: Guei glanced around and whispered, “Should we stay here and wait until there are fewer guards outside, then find a way to escape?”
unit.target: Guei circumspiciens susurravit: “Manere hic debeamus et exspectare, donec pauciores custodes foris sint, deinde viam ad effugiendum quaeramus?”

unit.source: “Do you think the exiled people before us didn’t think of that?” Vijepan sneered.
unit.target: “Pensisne exilii ante nos hoc non cogitaverint?” arridens inquit Vijepan.

unit.source: “And we’re still shackled.
unit.target: “Et nos adhuc catenis iungimur.

unit.source: How do we escape?”
unit.target: Quomodo effugiemur?”

unit.source: Lumian watched coldly, noticing that Guei could somewhat resist the urge to flee while the other serious offenders were finding excuses to reject his suggestion.
unit.target: Lumian frigidis oculis intuebat, animadvertiens Guei quatenus impetum fugendi resistere posset, dum ceteri reos graves excusationes inveniebant ut consilium eius repellerent.

unit.source: After they argued for two or three minutes, Lumian casually asked, “Do we have any food?
unit.target: Postquam per duas vel tres minuta disseruerunt, Lumian leviter rogavit: “Habemusne aliquid cibi?

unit.source: What if the guards only have a lapse every few days?”
unit.target: Quid si custodes tantum inter paucos dies intervalla habent?”

unit.source: Without waiting for Guei to answer, Lumian continued, “Actually, there is food.
unit.target: Nullo responso Guei exspectato, Lumian continuavit: “Revera, cibus adest.

unit.source: Each one of you is food.”
unit.target: Unusquisque vestrum cibus est.”

unit.source: He turned to Lez, the human chef, and asked with a smile, “How would you prepare us?”
unit.target: Ad Lez, coquum hominem, se vertit et subrisus interrogavit: “Quomodo nos praeparabis?”

unit.source: “Suitable for stewing and pickling.
unit.target: “Aptum est ad decoctum et ad condituram,

unit.source: You need the right spices to prevent the taste from turning sour,” Lez replied, his face lighting up.
unit.target: ut sapor non acerberit – opus est condimentis rectis,” respondit Lez, facies eius fulgente.

unit.source: Guei fell silent for a few seconds, then, handcuffed and shackled, began to walk slowly down the passage.
unit.target: Guei per aliquot momenta tacuit, deinde, manibus et catenis ligatus, lente per viam ambulare coepit.

unit.source: Lumian followed at the same pace.
unit.target: Lumian eodem gradu secutus est.

unit.source: They walked for what felt like seven or eight hours, though Lumian suspected his sense of time was distorted.
unit.target: Ambulaverunt per tempus quod septem vel octo horas videbatur, quamquam Lumian suspicabatur sensum temporis eius distortum esse.

unit.source: During this time, no one chose to stop.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, nemo subsistere decrevit.

unit.source: It seemed like they were heading not for a City of Exiles but a Land of Hope.
unit.target: Videbatur eos non ad Civitatem Exiliatorum, sed ad Terram Spei se dirigere.

unit.source: They frequently heard the indescribable terrifying sounds, prompting the human chef, Lez, to comment, “It’s like we’re walking down a monster’s long esophagus, heading for its stomach.
unit.target: Frequenter audiebant inexplicabiles et terribiles sonos, quod Lez, coquus humanus, incitavit dicere: “Sicut ambulamus per longum esophageum monstri, ad ventriculum eius tendentes.

unit.source: The sounds are its digestive movements.”
unit.target: Sonitus sunt motus digestionis eius.”

unit.source: Lumian agreed, while the others felt their hair stand on end.
unit.target: Lumian assentivit, dum ceteri capillos erigere sentiebant.

unit.source: Finally, they saw stone steps leading upwards.
unit.target: Denique viderunt scalas lapideās quae sursum ducebant.

unit.source: This seemed to signify that the end was near.
unit.target: Hoc videbatur significare finem prope esse.

unit.source: Climbing the steps and pushing open a heavy wooden door, Lumian and the others were momentarily blinded by the bright sunlight, causing them to instinctively close their eyes.
unit.target: Ascendentes scalas et gravem ianuam ligneam pulsantes, Lumian et ceteri brevi momento lumine fulgenti caeci fuerunt, unde instinctu oculos claudere coegerunt.

unit.source: The indescribable, chilling sounds ceased.
unit.target: Soni inenarrabiles et frigidantes cessaverunt.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, a gentle voice said, “Welcome to the City of Exiles, Morora.”
unit.target: Fere simul, vox lenis dixit: “Salvete in Civitatem Exiliorum, Morora.”

unit.source: Just as I thought… Lumian sighed silently, opened his eyes, and looked around.
unit.target: Sicut putaveram… Lumian tacite suspiravit, oculos aperuit, et circumspiciens se aspexit.

unit.source: They were in a grand prayer hall of a cathedral.
unit.target: In magna aula orationis cathedralis erant.

unit.source: Sunlight streamed through stained glass windows, creating a sacred and radiant scene.
unit.target: Lumen solare per fenestras vitreas effundebatur, creando scaenam sacram ac radiantem.

unit.source: The walls without windows were adorned with murals depicting mythical stories, while below stood brass bookshelves filled with various books and scrolls.
unit.target: Muri, sine fenestris, ornati erant muralibus depingentibus fabulas mythicas, dum infra stabant scrinia latonia repleta libris et volumina.

unit.source: It felt more like a library than a church.
unit.target: Videbatur magis bibliotheca quam ecclesia.

unit.source: The speaker was an old man in a white robe trimmed with brass.
unit.target: Orator erat senex in albo vestitu, latonia ornamentatus.

unit.source: He was in his sixties or seventies, with graying hair, gentle and clear amber eyes, and no trace of cloudiness.
unit.target: Ille annos sexagenarios vel septuagenarios habebat, capillis canoescentibus, oculis benignis et limpidis quasi ambra, atque nullam turbationem ostendens.

unit.source: He held a thick book in his left hand, a standard scholar‐clergyman of the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Tenebat librum crassum in manu sinistra, clericum eruditum Ecclesiae Scientiae.

unit.source: Yet Lumian felt he wasn’t a real person, suspecting he was a specially crafted puppet.
unit.target: Attamen Lumian sensit eum non esse verum hominem, suspiciens eum esse specialiter fabricatum simulacrum.

unit.source: “Morora? This place is called Morora?” Guei asked curiously, opening his eyes.
unit.target: «Morora? Hic locus Morora nuncupatur?» inquit Guei curiosus, oculos aperiens.

unit.source: The old man nodded.
unit.target: Senex annuit.

unit.source: “I am Heraberg, responsible for all theological affairs in Morora.”
unit.target: «Ego sum Heraberg, qui curam omnium rerum theologicarum in Morora gero.»

unit.source: As he spoke, he extended his right hand, pointing at Lumian and the others.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, dextram manum protulit, ad Luminianum et ceteros demonstrans.

unit.source: The shackles, handcuffs, and chains through their collarbones softened instantly, as if made of mud.
unit.target: Vincula, manubria, et catenae per claviculas eorum statim mollitae sunt, quasi ex luto factae.

unit.source: With a clatter, they fell from the bodies of the serious offenders, hitting the gray and white stone floor with metallic thuds.
unit.target: Cum strepitu, ex corporibus reorum gravium ceciderunt, incidens in pavimentum lapideum cinereum et album sonis metallicis.

unit.source: The serious offenders’ hearts sank, abandoning any bad thoughts.
unit.target: Cordia reorum gravium demissa sunt, omnem malum cogitationem relinquentes.

unit.source: Heraberg handed out the thick book and a brass-cased pen.
unit.target: Heraberg dedit librum crassum et calamus, operitus in latone.

unit.source: “Register your names.
unit.target: «Inscribite nomina vestra.

unit.source: This signifies your official status as residents of Morora.”
unit.target: Hoc significat statum vestrum officialem ut incolae Mororae.»

unit.source: Lumian complied, taking the book and writing “Louis.”
unit.target: Lumian obtemperavit, librum sumens et scribens “Louis.”

unit.source: Next was Guei.
unit.target: Deinde Guei.

unit.source: He took the book and pen and tentatively asked Heraberg, “How do you know we’re writing our real names?”
unit.target: Librum et calamus sumpsit et dubius rogavit Heraberg: “Quomodo scis nos vera nomina scribere?”

unit.source: Heraberg replied calmly, “The past is not important.
unit.target: Heraberg tranquille respondit: “Praeteritum non refert.

unit.source: In Morora, the present and the future matter.”
unit.target: In Morora, praesentia et futura res momenti sunt.”

unit.source: Guei pondered for a while, unsure of the clergyman Heraberg’s meaning.
unit.target: Guei aliquantulum cogitavit, incertus quid clericus Heraberg significaret.

unit.source: Considering that the Church of Knowledge could exchange information via telegram, he didn’t use a fake name but wrote his real name honestly.
unit.target: Quia Ecclesia Scientiae per telegraphum notitias commutare posset, nomen fictum non adhibuit sed verum nomine suo sincere scripsit.

unit.source: After all the serious offenders finished registering, Heraberg looked at them and said, “You must follow the rules here.
unit.target: Postquam omnes reos graves se registraverunt, Heraberg eos aspexit et dixit: “Hic regulas observare oportet.

unit.source: Most laws are the same as in other cities in Lenburg, but dueling is legal if both parties agree.
unit.target: Plurimae leges eadem sunt ac in aliis civitatibus Lenburg, sed duellum licitum est, si ambae partes consentiant.

unit.source: Non-violent protests are also allowed.
unit.target: Protestationes non violentae quoque admittuntur.

unit.source: We have a dedicated team to maintain order in Morora.”
unit.target: Habemus turmam dedicatam ad ordinem in Morora conservandum.

unit.source: The honest-looking, middle-aged Lez asked, “Can we join the enforcement team?”
unit.target: Lez, honestus et medii aetatis, rogavit: “Possumusne turmam exsecutivam adiungere?”

unit.source: “The enforcement team is made up entirely of experimental personnel,” Heraberg replied warmly.
unit.target: «Turma exsecutiva ex integris personalibus experimentalis constat,» respondit Heraberg calide.

unit.source: Guei asked, “How do we become experimental personnel?”
unit.target: Guei rogavit: “Quomodo experimentales personae fieri possumus?”

unit.source: Vijepan asked grimly, “What happens if we break the law here?
unit.target: Vijepan severo animo rogavit: “Quid fiet, si legem hic violaverimus?

unit.source: Jail time or death penalty?”
unit.target: Tempus carceris aut poena mortis?

unit.source: Heraberg smiled.
unit.target: Heraberg subridens.

unit.source: “The worst punishment for breaking the law here is becoming experimental personnel.”
unit.target: «Pessima poena pro lege hic violanda est: fieri persona experimentalis.»

unit.source: “Wouldn’t that make us enforcers?” Guei was stunned.
unit.target: «Num hoc nos non faceret custodes?» inquit Guei attonitus.

unit.source: Isn’t that encouraging us to break the law?
unit.target: Nonne id nos ad legem violandam incitat?

unit.source: Lumian recalled the term “experimental personnel” frequently appearing in the 0-01 sealed information.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est vocabulum “personalia experimentalia” quod frequenter in informatione 0-01 sigillata apparuerat.

unit.source: Just from that, he knew becoming experimental personnel was definitely not a good thing.
unit.target: Ex hoc solum scivit fieri personalem experimentale certe non esse rem bonam.

unit.source: Heraberg’s expression remained unchanged.
unit.target: Vultus Heraberg immutatus mansit.

unit.source: “Yes, but remember, besides the church’s overseers, at least two experimental personnel are discarded daily.”
unit.target: «Ita, sed mementote, praeter inspectores ecclesiae, saltem duo personalia experimentalia quotidie abicuntur.»

unit.source: Discarded… Guei and the others found this term strangely terrifying.
unit.target: Abicuntur… Guei et ceteri hoc vocabulum mirum modum terribile invenerunt.

unit.source: “How many people are in Morora now?” Lumian asked a peculiar question.
unit.target: «Quot homines in Morora nunc sunt?» inquit Lumian quaestionem insolitam.

unit.source: Heraberg replied with a smile, “Nearly 200,000.
unit.target: Heraberg respondit subridente: “Prope ducenti milia.

unit.source: The city has farms, mines, and factories around it, all part of Morora.”
unit.target: Circum urbem sunt agri, fodinae et officinae, quae omnes pars Mororae sunt.

unit.source: “Nearly 200,000? Does Lenburg have that many serious offenders?”
unit.target: «Fere ducenti milia? Num Lenburg tot reos graves habet?»

unit.source: Lumian was slightly surprised.
unit.target: Lumian paulum miratus est.

unit.source: Heraberg professionally explained, “It’s accumulated over generations, and we also spend money to import serious offenders from abroad.”
unit.target: Heraberg professionaliter explanavit: “Per generationes accumulatum est, atque etiam pecuniam impendimus ad reos graves ex terris alienis importandos.”

unit.source: Import… makes it sound like importing talent…
unit.target: Importatio… facit ut videatur quasi ingenia importari.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds, not in a hurry to “commit a crime,” planning to apply to become experimental personnel, hoping to get close to the sealed 0-01.
unit.target: Lumian per aliquot secundos meditatus est, non festinans crimen committere, sed consiliavit se applicaturum fieri personalem experimentale, sperans se ad 0-01 sigillatum appropinquare.

unit.source: He bade farewell to Heraberg and headed for the exit of the library-like cathedral, intending to first find the two parts of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Valedixit Heraberg et ivit ad exitum cathedralis, quae bibliothecae similis erat, intendens primum invenire duas partes Manūs Abscessae.

unit.source: 794 The Price of Meddling
unit.target: 794 Pretium Immiscendi

unit.source: 794 The Price of Meddling
unit.target: 794 Pretium Immiscendi

unit.source: Behind Lumian, Vijepan continued questioning Heraberg, the clergy of the Church of Knowledge, “In a legal duel, can I do anything to the other party without facing punishment?”
unit.target: Retro Lumian, Vijepan Herabergum, clericum Ecclesiae Cognitionis, interrogare continuavit: “In certamine legali, licetne mihi adversario aliquid agere, ne poena afficiar?”

unit.source: “Yes,” Heraberg confirmed.
unit.target: “Ita,” Heraberg confirmavit.

unit.source: Vijepan’s eyes lit up, feeling as if he had found paradise.
unit.target: Oculi Vijepanis fulserunt, quasi paradisum invenisset.

unit.source: He excitedly swallowed.
unit.target: Ille alacriter deglutivit.

unit.source: Gulp… He heard a similar sound next to him.
unit.target: “Gulp…” Iuxta se similem sonum audivit.

unit.source: He turned his head and saw that the sound came from a woman with long brown hair, Julie.
unit.target: Caput vertit et vidit sonum provenire a muliere cum longis capillis fuscis, Iulia.

unit.source: The “collector” was also excited, while the human chef, Lez, licked his lips.
unit.target: “Collector” quoque excitatus erat, dum coquus humanus, Lez, labia linguit.

unit.source: He was already hungry.
unit.target: Iam esuriebat.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t bother watching the other offenders’ performances.
unit.target: Lumian non curavit spectare ostentationes reliquorum sceleratorum.

unit.source: He left the library-like cathedral and surveyed the surroundings.
unit.target: Lumian ecclesiam, quasi bibliothecam, reliquit et circumstantias perlustrare coepit.

unit.source: The buildings in this area were ancient, reminiscent of early Fifth Epoch styles with their heavy columns and arches, giving a sense of grandeur and simplicity.
unit.target: Aedificia huius regionis antiqua erant, quae stilis primis Quinti Aevi similia erant, columnis gravibus et arcubus ornata, sensum maiestatis et simplicitatis praebentia.

unit.source: Behind the cathedral was a seemingly endless graveyard.
unit.target: Post ecclesiam, coemeterium quasi infinitum erat.

unit.source: Tombstones stood amidst the trees, with many raised graves dotting the landscape.
unit.target: Lapides sepulcrales inter arbores stabant, cum multa sepulcra elevata terram punctabant.

unit.source: This reminded Lumian of a line from the 0-01 sealed information: “Place it in an underground mausoleum with a large number of soldier mannequins. Construct a cemetery with more than a million corpses above it…”
unit.target: Hoc recordatus est Lumian de linea ex notitia sigillata 0-01: “In mausoleo subterraneo, cum magna multitudine simulacrorum militum, pone id. Erige coemeterium cum plus quam uno millione cadaverum super eo…”

unit.source: Is the underground mausoleum sealing 0-01 right below?
unit.target: Num mausoleum subterraneum, quod 0-01 sigillans, infra iacet?

unit.source: Just as Lumian withdrew his gaze, the previously sunny sky darkened.
unit.target: Simul ac Lumian oculos avertit, quondam serenus caelum obscuratum est.

unit.source: Thick clouds gathered, and the sound of thunder rumbled.
unit.target: Nubes spissae congressae sunt, et sonus tonitrui fremuit.

unit.source: The weather changes so quickly…
unit.target: Tempestas tam celeriter mutatur…

unit.source: No wonder the information mentioned Morora frequently experiencing extreme weather…
unit.target: Non mirum quod notitia refert Mororam saepe tempestatibus extremis experiri.

unit.source: Lumian sighed as he looked into the distance, seeing mountain ranges resembling giant beasts lying at the horizon, blocking anyone who might want to leave secretly.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, dum in longinquum intuebatur, videns catenae montium, similes ingentibus bestiis in horizonte iacentes, qui celate discedere cuivis impediabant.

unit.source: Of course, this was just a metaphor, as the residents of Morora never thought of leaving the city.
unit.target: Certe, hoc solum erat metaphorum, quoniam incolae Mororae urbem relinquere numquam cogitabant.

unit.source: Lumian felt a slight reluctance too.
unit.target: Lumian etiam parvam repugnationem sensit.

unit.source: The underground was calling to him.
unit.target: Subterra eum vocabat.

unit.source: “We need to find a place to settle down quickly, or we’ll get soaked,” Guei’s voice came from beside Lumian.
unit.target: “Celeriter locum habitandi invenire debemus, cum aliter madidi erimus,” vox Guei prope Lumian pronuntiata est.

unit.source: He had also left the cathedral, and as a local of Azshara, his words were quite formal.
unit.target: Etiam ecclesiam reliquit, et ut vicinus Azsharae, verba eius note formalia erant.

unit.source: “Yeah,” Lumian replied with a smile as he walked into the large square in front of the cathedral.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit Lumian sub risu, dum in magnam forum coram ecclesia ambulabat.

unit.source: Guei followed, glancing back and saying in surprise, “There’s such a large graveyard here?”
unit.target: Guei secutus est, retro speculans atque obstupescens dicens: “Hic coemeterium tam magnum est?”

unit.source: “A graveyard with over a million, even tens of millions of corpses,” Lumian replied casually.
unit.target: “Coemeterium cum plus quam uno millione, etiam decies milliones cadaverum,” respondit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: Guei nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Guei cogitavit et annuit.

unit.source: “History books record a large-scale grave relocation in the early Fifth Epoch in the Lenburg region to address the aftermath of the Pale Disaster. Was it moved here?”
unit.target: “Libri historiae memorant magnam translationem sepulchrale in initio Quinti Aevi in regione Lenburg ad remediandas consequentias Disasterum Pallidum. Num hic translata est?”

unit.source: “Perhaps,” Lumian said as they crossed the square.
unit.target: “Forsitan,” inquit Lumian dum forum transibant.

unit.source: He quietly activated the black mark representing the Abscessed Hand, but did not actually use it.
unit.target: Tacite notam nigrum repraesentantem Manum Abscessam activavit, sed re vera non usus est.

unit.source: He was sensing the approximate location of the other two parts of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Sentiebat locum approximatum duarum reliquarum partium Manum Abscessae.

unit.source: To his surprise, he sensed more than two parts.
unit.target: Ad eius mirationem, plus quam duas partes sensit.

unit.source: Different directions within the City of Exiles had subtle responses.
unit.target: Diversae regiones intra Urbem Exilium responsa subtilia praebebant.

unit.source: Hand Bro’s body parts got dismembered?
unit.target: Partes corporis Hand Bro dissectae sunt?

unit.source: Lumian silently muttered.
unit.target: Lumian silentio mumuravit.

unit.source: He chose the direction with the strongest response.
unit.target: Elegit directionem cum maximo responsu.

unit.source: After walking about a street’s length, he heard the clashing of metal and saw two men fiercely fighting with sharp swords as a crowd watched.
unit.target: Postquam viae spatium perambulavit, sonitum metallorum audivit et duos viros acutis gladiis ferociter certantes vidit, dum multitudo spectabat.

unit.source: Duels with fatalities happen daily…
unit.target: Certamina mortifera quotidie fiunt…

unit.source: Lumian reviewed the 0-01 sealed information.
unit.target: Lumian notitia sigillata 0-01 recognovit.

unit.source: He didn’t hurry, deciding to watch for a while.
unit.target: Non festinavit, constitutus aliquantulum spectare.

unit.source: Guei did the same, seemingly assessing the strength of Morora’s residents.
unit.target: Guei idem fecit, fortitudinem incolarum Mororae aestimans.

unit.source: The fight lasted two or three minutes, ending with a man in a black jacket being slashed across the chest and stomach, his intestines spilling out as he convulsed and died.
unit.target: Pugna duas vel tres minutas duravit, finita cum viro in veste nigra pectore et abdomine lacerato, cui intestina effusa erant, dum convulsus mortuusque est.

unit.source: A team of men and women in black robes, their expressions indifferent, appeared, silently dragging the stripped corpse away and cleaning the blood from the street, like machines following a set procedure.
unit.target: Grex virorum et feminarum in vestibus nigris, vultu indifferente, apparuit, corpus spoliatum tacite trahebant et sanguinem e via purgabant, quasi machinae praeordinatae.

unit.source: The onlookers dispersed.
unit.target: Spectatores se dissipaverunt.

unit.source: A small man in a brown-green cap, smiling kindly, walked past Lumian and Guei, glancing at them.
unit.target: Vir parvus in pileo fusco-viridi, benigno risu, praeter Lumian et Guei ambulavit, eos circumspectans.

unit.source: “New here?” the small man asked warmly.
unit.target: “Novus hic?” inquit parvus vir calide.

unit.source: “How can you tell?” Guei asked curiously.
unit.target: “Quomodo hoc agnoscis?” inquit Guei curiosus.

unit.source: The small man laughed.
unit.target: Parvus vir risit.

unit.source: “You still have that new look, not yet fully integrated into Morora!”
unit.target: “Adhuc illam novam speciem geris, nondum plene in Morora integra es!”

unit.source: His voice suddenly turned sharp, as if possessed by something unknown.
unit.target: Vox eius subito acuta facta est, quasi ab ignoto possessa.

unit.source: Lumian watched the small man in silence, observing his changes.
unit.target: Lumian parvum virum silentio observabat, mutationes eius contemplans.

unit.source: The small man waved.
unit.target: Parvus vir manum levavit.

unit.source: “Haha, I’m Worms. Let’s have a drink sometime.”
unit.target: “Haha, ego sum Worms. Bibamus aliquando.”

unit.source: As Worms walked down another street, Guei suddenly spoke to Lumian, “Don’t you feel like you’re missing something?”
unit.target: Dum Worms per aliam viam ambulabat, Guei repente ad Lumian locutus est: “Nonne tibi videtur aliquid deficere?”

unit.source: “I noticed,” Lumian replied nonchalantly.
unit.target: “Animadverti,” respondit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: “He’s quick.”
unit.target: “Celer est.”

unit.source: He had only noticed his Traveler’s Bag was about to be taken when Worms withdrew his hand.
unit.target: Modo animadvertit sacculum Viatoris sui sublaturum esse, cum Worms manum detraxit.

unit.source: He must be a real Beyonder, a true Marauder.
unit.target: Eum verum Beyonder esse oportet, verum praedatorem.

unit.source: That sudden state change was likely a performance to distract attention.
unit.target: Illud subitum status mutatio verisimiliter actio fuit ad attentionem decipiendam.

unit.source: “Why didn’t you expose him if you noticed? Afraid of retaliation?” Guei didn’t understand Lumian’s reaction.
unit.target: “Cur eum non patefecisti, si animadvertisti? Timuisti ultioni?” Guei non intellexit reactionem Lumiani.

unit.source: “I wanted to see what he would do,” Lumian replied with a smile, hands in his pockets, slowly following the route Worms had taken.
unit.target: “Cupivi videre quid faceret,” respondit Lumian sub risu, manibus in sinu, lente sequens iter quod Worms cepit.

unit.source: Guei watched his back for a while, then decided to find a place to stay first.
unit.target: Guei post tergum eius aliquot tempora aspexit, deinde locum manendi invenire decrevit.

unit.source: Once out of Lumian and Guei’s sight, Worms quickened his pace, darting through several alleys in a circuitous route.
unit.target: Postquam a conspectu Lumiani et Guei evaserat, Worms celeritatem augebat, per varias semitas angustas circuitus.

unit.source: After confirming he had shaken off any potential pursuers, he stopped in a secluded alley and took out a dark black coin pouch from inside his clothes.
unit.target: Postquam certior fecit se insequentibus evulsum esse, in angusto viculo secluso subsedit et ex vestimentis suis sacculum nigrum extraxit.

unit.source: It was Lumian’s Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Id erat Saccus Viatoris Lumiani.

unit.source: “Haha, these new fools are so careless. Let’s see what’s inside…” Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: “Haha, hi novi stulti tam neglegentes sunt. Videamus quid intus sit…” Worms manum in Saccum Viatoris protendit.

unit.source: His expression changed slightly, filled with intense surprise.
unit.target: Vultus eius modice mutatus est, plena intensa admiratione.

unit.source: He could “see” the pouch’s value, sensing many items with spirituality inside, but he hadn’t expected it to be a rare spatial item, holding what felt like a small room.
unit.target: Poterat «videre» valorem sacci, sentiens multa instrumenta spiritualitatis intus, sed non exspectaverat id esse rarum rem spatiale, quod quasi parvam cellam contineret.

unit.source: What a pleasant surprise… Worms pulled out one of the items.
unit.target: Quam iucunda sorpresa… Worms unum ex rebus extraxit.

unit.source: What greeted his eyes was a half-decomposed, dark blue swollen corpse, dripping yellowish-red pus.
unit.target: Quod oculis eius obviam fuit, corpus semi-decompositum, caeruleum obscurum et tumescentem, ex quo pus flavus-ruber stillabat.

unit.source: Smack!
unit.target: Ictus!

unit.source: Worms recoiled, letting the half-corpse fall to the ground.
unit.target: Worms recubuit, sinens corpus semi-decompositum in terram cadere.

unit.source: Wh- His face turned horrified.
unit.target: Heu—facies eius territa facta est.

unit.source: Who carries a half-decomposed corpse around?
unit.target: Quis corpus semi-decompositum circum fert?

unit.source: And a highly decayed corpse at that!
unit.target: Atque corpus valde corruptum!

unit.source: Even in Morora, filled with countless murderers, this is the most twisted thing!
unit.target: Etiam in Morora, cum innumerabilibus homicidibus, hoc est res maxime tortuosa!

unit.source: No wonder he was exiled here!
unit.target: Non mirum, hic exsul factus est!

unit.source: Steadying himself, Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag again, pulling out a piece of smooth, white leather.
unit.target: Se confirmans, Worms iterum in Saccum Viatoris manum intulit et partem cori album, lenis, extraxit.

unit.source: He couldn’t take his eyes off it, as if staring at the skin of a dream lover.
unit.target: Oculos ab eo deferrere non potuit, quasi cutem dilecti somnorum contemplans.

unit.source: He quickly noticed some black words on the leather that he didn’t recognize.
unit.target: Celeriter animadvertit verba nigra in corio, quae ignorabat.

unit.source: Seems to be words that can trigger Beyonder powers.
unit.target: Videtur verba esse quae potestates Beyonder excitare possint.

unit.source: This leather must be very valuable.
unit.target: Hoc corium valde pretiosum esse debet.

unit.source: I should copy it and find someone to decipher it without arousing suspicion, Worms thought in delight, caressing the leather, unwilling to let go.
unit.target: Debeo id scribere et aliquem invenire qui id enodare possit sine suspicione excitanda, Worms laetus cogitavit, corium fovens, nec dimittere volens.

unit.source: Suddenly, he felt his throat itch.
unit.target: Subito fauces eius prurire coeperunt.

unit.source: Cough, cough, cough!
unit.target: Tussis, tussis, tussis!

unit.source: He started coughing, more and more violently.
unit.target: Tussire coepit, magis atque magis violenter.

unit.source: Within seconds, he coughed so hard it felt like his heart would tear apart.
unit.target: In paucis secundis, tam vehementer tussivit ut cor eius quasi discindatur.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: Worms spat out a mouthful of blood.
unit.target: Worms os plenum sanguinis exspuit.

unit.source: This isn’t right! How did I suddenly get so sick?
unit.target: Hoc non rectum est! Quomodo subito ita male aegrotare coepi?

unit.source: Worms, vaguely understanding, threw the leather to the ground.
unit.target: Worms, vix intellegens, corium in terram iecit.

unit.source: But his coughing continued, even more violently.
unit.target: Sed tussis eius continuavit, etiam magis violenter.

unit.source: While coughing, he thought of a way to save himself: That guy put such dangerous leather in his pocket, he must have prepared a cure…
unit.target: Dum tussiret, cogitavit modum se servandi: ille vir tam periculosum corium in sinu posuerat, debet curam praeparasse…

unit.source: Yes, there must be one!
unit.target: Ita, unum esse debet!

unit.source: Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag again.
unit.target: Worms iterum in Saccum Viatoris manum protendit.

unit.source: He first pulled out a gray-white lightning-shaped brooch.
unit.target: Primum extraxit fibulam in formam fulminis, cinereo-albam.

unit.source: A thick, silvery-white lightning bolt suddenly descended from the stacked clouds, striking him.
unit.target: Subito e nubibus superpositis densus, argenteo-albus fulmen descendit, eum percutiens.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: The thunder echoed, and Worms fell, his body charred and twitching.
unit.target: Tonitrua resonaverunt, et Worms cecidit, corpus eius comburatum et convulsum.

unit.source: Already gravely ill, the lightning strike left him near death.
unit.target: Iam graviter aegrotans, ictus fulminis eum prope mortem reliquit.

unit.source: How… how could I suddenly be struck… by lightning… I, I… Worms’s vision darkened, his confusion and regret lingering as he closed his eyes.
unit.target: Quomodo… quomodo repentinus fulmine percussus sim… Ego… Visio Worms obscurata est, et confusio atque paenitentia remanserunt, dum oculos clausit.

unit.source: He soon stopped breathing.
unit.target: Cito respirare desiit.

unit.source: About ten seconds later, Lumian turned into the alley, walked to Worms, looked down at his body, and shook his head with a smile.
unit.target: Circa decem secundis post, Lumian in viculum se vertit, ad Worms ambulavit, corpus eius respexit, et caput sub risu movit.

unit.source: “Rummaging through others’ belongings is very dangerous.”
unit.target: “In rebus alienis scrutari periculosum est.”

unit.source: After a pause, Lumian regrettably sighed.
unit.target: Post brevem silentium, Lumian tristis suspiravit.

unit.source: “I wanted to follow you and get in touch with Morora’s Beyonders. You let me down.
unit.target: “Te sequi et cum Beyonderibus Morora convenire volui. Me deludisti.

unit.source: “And you didn’t even get to the more dangerous items.”
unit.target: Et ne gravioribus rebus quidem attigisti.”

unit.source: As he spoke, Lumian picked up the Traveler’s Bag, placing the items back inside in their compressed form: the Fury of the Sea brooch, the Demoness of Despair human leather, and the half‐corpse of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian Saccum Viatoris sustulit, et res in eadem forma compressa reposuit: fibulam “Furor Maris”, corium humanum “Demonissa Desperationis”, et corpus semi-decompositum “Manum Abscessae”.

unit.source: “I guess being a generous soul is all you can do,” Lumian muttered, extracting 537 sassen gold from Worms.
unit.target: “Animam largam habere, id credo, est totum quod facere potes,” muspitavit Lumian, extrahens 537 sassen aurei ex Worms.

unit.source: That was about 2863 verl d’or.
unit.target: Id fere erat 2863 verl d’or.

unit.source: Pocketing the generous soul’s gift, Lumian waited for Worms’s Beyonder characteristics to manifest.
unit.target: Donum animae largae in sinu condidens, Lumian exspectavit ut proprietates Beyonder Worms manifestae essent.

unit.source: About two minutes later, a team of black-robed enforcers entered the alley.
unit.target: Circiter post duas minutas, grex exsecutorum in vestibus nigris in viculum intravit.

unit.source: The leader looked at Lumian expressionlessly and said, “Did you kill him?”
unit.target: Dux, sine vultu, Lumian intuebatur et dixit: “Num eum occidisti?”

unit.source: “No, he was struck by lightning. Maybe he did too many bad things,” Lumian replied with a smile, explaining earnestly.
unit.target: “Non, fulmine percussus est. Forsitan nimis multa mala fecerit,” respondit Lumian sub risu, sincere explicans.

unit.source: “He was a thief and stole my stuff, so I chased him here.”
unit.target: “Fur erat et res meas abstulit, itaque eum huc persecutus sum.”

unit.source: The enforcers stared at Lumian as if verifying his truthfulness.
unit.target: Exsecutores Lumian intuebantur, quasi veritatem eius comprobarent.

unit.source: After a moment, the leader nodded.
unit.target: Post momentum, dux annuit.

unit.source: “You may leave.”
unit.target: “Discedere licet.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t move, smiling as he said, “His belongings should be mine, right?”
unit.target: Lumian non movebat, subrisu dicens: “Possessiones eius mihi esse debent, nonne?”

unit.source: 795 “Old Friend”
unit.target: 795 “Amicus Vetus”

unit.source: 795 “Old Friend”
unit.target: 795 “Amicus Vetus”

unit.source: The leader of the enforcers was around forty, clean-shaven, with dark brown eyes.
unit.target: Dux coercitorum circiter quadraginta annos natus erat, glaber, ac oculis fusco‐castaneis.

unit.source: He responded to Lumian’s question without any expression, “There’s no such rule.”
unit.target: Ad quaestionem Luminiani sine ulla vultu respondit: “Nulla talis regula est.”

unit.source: He meant there was no rule stating that all items on a thief’s body should go to the victim.
unit.target: Intendebat nullam esse regulam quae praescriberet omnia in corpore furtoris reperta victimae tradenda esse.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and asked, “But there’s also no law specifically prohibiting it, right?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens rogavit: “Sed etiam lex nulla est quae id specialiter prohibeat, nonne?”

unit.source: “Right.” The leader of the enforcers nodded slowly.
unit.target: “Ita est.” Dux coercitorum lente annuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile broadened. “Coming to Morora means cutting all ties with the past, right?”
