unit.target: Risus Luminiani latius factus est. “Ad Mororam veniendi significat omnia vincula cum praeterito rumpere, nonne?”

unit.source: This was inferred from what the clergyman Heraberg had said in the cathedral.
unit.target: Hoc ex illis, quae clericus Heraberg in cathedrali dixerat, concludebatur.

unit.source: “Yes.” The enforcer did not deny it.
unit.target: “Ita.” Coercitor id non negavit.

unit.source: Lumian probed further, “And this thief doesn’t have any other heirs in Morora, does he?”
unit.target: Lumian ulterius quaesivit: “Et hic fur in Morora alias haeredes non habet, numquid?”

unit.source: Before being sent to Morora, serious criminals were sterilized.
unit.target: Antequam in Mororam mittebantur, scelesti graves sterilizati erant.

unit.source: Unless they were part of a criminal family or found a partner with similar criminal interests here, no one in Morora had legal heirs.
unit.target: Nisi fuerint pars familiae sceleratae aut socium cum similibus criminibus inclinatus hic invenierit, nemo in Morora haeredes legitimos habebat.

unit.source: The enforcer didn’t answer Lumian immediately.
unit.target: Coercitor non statim Luminiano respondit.

unit.source: He pulled a thick book from under his black robe and started searching for the relevant records.
unit.target: Sub veste nigra sua, librum crassum extraxit et documenta pertinens quaerere coepit.

unit.source: “Do you know this thief’s name?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
unit.target: Lumian quaesivit cogitans: “Scisne nomen huius furtoris?”

unit.source: The enforcer nodded. “His name is Worms.”
unit.target: Coercitor annuit: “Nomen eius est Worms.”

unit.source: Soon, the records were found.
unit.target: Mox acta reperta sunt.

unit.source: The enforcer read in a flat voice, “His parents and siblings are not in Morora, and he hasn’t married here, at least not officially registered.”
unit.target: Coercitor voce aequa legit: “Parentes eius et fratres non sunt in Morora, nec hic nupta est, saltem non officialiter registrata.”

unit.source: “So, according to the laws from where I come from, a thief’s possessions go to the person who caught them if there are no other heirs or claimants,” Lumian began to explain, “Just like in a legal duel, the victor can take the spoils.”
unit.target: “Ergo, secundum leges ex loco meo, possessiones furtoris adsunt illo qui ea apprehendit, si ceteri haeredes aut vindicatores absunt,” inchoavit Lumian explanare, “sicut in certamine legali, victor praeda capere potest.”

unit.source: The enforcer stared at Lumian for a few seconds before saying, “Okay.”
unit.target: Coercitor paulisper Luminian aspexit antequam dixit: “Bene.”

unit.source: He and his team stood patiently as Worms’s Beyonder characteristics manifested, merging with one of his fingers, which then broke off, turning semi‐transparent black.
unit.target: Ipse et turma eius patienter steterunt, dum proprietates Beyonder Worms apparuerunt, confluentes cum uno de digitis eius, qui deinde disjectus, semitransparens atque nigerrimus factus est.

unit.source: Lumian put away the Beyonder characteristics but didn’t leave immediately.
unit.target: Lumian proprietates Beyonder recondidit, sed non statim discessit.

unit.source: Instead, he stayed, watching as the enforcers dragged away the body and cleaned the blood and scorch marks from the alley.
unit.target: Sed potius manet, observans dum coercitores corpus trahebant et sanguinem atque signa comburitionis ex via angusta delebant.

unit.source: The clouds above thickened, and lightning and thunder grew more frequent.
unit.target: Nubes caeli densatae sunt, et fulgura ac tonitrua frequentiora facta sunt.

unit.source: Finally, the alley was clean and quiet, with only Lumian remaining.
unit.target: Denique via angusta pura et quieta erat, et solus Lumian remanebat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully, murmuring to himself, The enforcers seem to remember the appearance and names of every Morora resident…
unit.target: Lumian cogitans annuit, sibi submurmurans: “Videtur coercitores formam et nomina omnium incolarum Mororae meminisse…”

unit.source: After becoming enforcers, they are still human but not quite human anymore…
unit.target: Postquam coercitores facti sunt, adhuc sunt homines, sed non iam prorsus homines.

unit.source: He felt that the so‐called enforcers, who were actually experimental personnel, acted like puppets following set procedures, lacking self‐awareness and deep thinking.
unit.target: Sensit dictos coercitores, qui revera experimentales operarii erant, quasi pupae regulas sequentes agere, carentes conscientia sui atque cogitatione profunda.

unit.source: He had deliberately asked if Worms’s belongings were his, not out of greed for the Beyonder characteristics, although that played a small part, as Beyonder characteristics were valuable.
unit.target: Diligenter quaesierat utrum possessiones Worms eius essent, non ex cupiditate proprietatum Beyonder, quamvis parva pars id efficaciter moveret, nam proprietates Beyonder pretiosae erant.

unit.source: He had long figured that Worms wasn’t a Sequence 7 Marauder, as a Sequence 7 called Cryptologist would have deciphered some of the secrets of the items in the Traveler’s Bag and understood their dangers, not dying just after examining three items.
unit.target: Diu arbitratus erat Worms non esse Marauder Sequenciae VII, quoniam Cryptologus, qui Sequenciae VII vocatur, nonnulla arcana rerum in Sacculo Viatoris persolveret et earum pericula cognovisset, non moriturus esse modo tribus obiectis examinatis.

unit.source: Lumian even doubted Worms had reached Sequence 8 Swindler, because the thief didn’t seem smart enough.
unit.target: Lumian etiam dubitavit Worms ad Sequenciam VIII Swindler pervenisse, quia fur non satis ingeniosus apparuit.

unit.source: Lumian’s questions to the enforcers were not to showcase his talent in being a negotiator or exploit loopholes but to test the enforcers’ state.
unit.target: Quaestiones Luminiani ad coercitores non erant ut ingenium suum negotiatori ostenderet nec lacunas legales expleret, sed ut statum coercitorum examinarent.

unit.source: And he had his answer.
unit.target: Et responsum suum obtinuit.

unit.source: He felt that after becoming enforcers, these serious criminals became like the wax figures in the Sauron family’s Red Swan Castle or a combination of the Iron and Blood Cross Order Supervisor Olson, but without the violent madness, instead exhibiting a gentle indifference.
unit.target: Sensit postquam coercitores facti essent, hi scelesti graves vel ut figuras ceratas in Castris Rubri Cygnorum familiae Sauron, vel ut compositio inter Ordinem Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis sub vigilantia Olson, sed sine furori violento, sed cum leni indifferentia se gerere.

unit.source: Is this the combined effect of the 0-01 corruption and Morora’s sealing influence?
unit.target: Num hoc compositum est effectus corruptionis 0-01 atque influentiae sigillantis Mororae?

unit.source: Lumian was unsure if he would retain his self‐awareness if he joined the enforcers, or end up just following Morora’s rules, becoming a puppet of the City of Exiles or 0-01.
unit.target: Lumian non certo sciebat utrum, si coercitoribus iungeret, sui conscientiam retinere posset, aut tantum leges Mororae sequi, quasi marioneta Urbis Exulorum aut 0-01 fieret.

unit.source: This made him waver in his original plan to approach 0-01 as an enforcer.
unit.target: Hoc eum in consilio suo primo ad 0-01 ut coercitor accederet vacillare fecit.

unit.source: He laughed softly, asking in a low voice, “Termiboros, do you want to be Morora’s puppet?”
unit.target: Leniter risit, voce humili rogans: “Termiboros, velisne marioneta Mororae esse?”

unit.source: Termiboros ignored him.
unit.target: Termiboros eum ignoravit.

unit.source: Whoosh!
unit.target: Whoosh!

unit.source: The downpour finally arrived, shrouding Morora in a mist of rain and a doomsday-like gloom.
unit.target: Denique imber pervenit, Mororam in nebulam pluvialis et fatalis obscuritate involvens.

unit.source: Lumian followed the shelter of the huge buildings, avoiding the rain as he headed to the place where the strongest feedback from the Abscessed Hand’s missing parts came from.
unit.target: Lumian sub tegmine ingentium aedificiorum se contulit, imbrem vitans, dum ad locum properabat unde validissima responsio ex partibus Manūs Abscessae proveniebat.

unit.source: When he reached his destination, his clothes were half-soaked by the wind and rain, and the water on the street was nearly up to the steps.
unit.target: Cum ad destinatum pervenisset, vestimenta eius dimidio venti et pluviae madida erant, et aqua in via fere usque ad gradus perveniebat.

unit.source: Lumian glanced to the side, seeing a sign by the door depicting a knife, fork, and wine glass, with the words in Lenburg: “Carnivore”
unit.target: Lumian ad latus intuerebat, videns signum iuxta ostium, quod culter, furca, atque poculum vini repraesentabat, cum verbis in Lenburg: “Carnivore”.

unit.source: A bar serving food? Carnivore… Lumian pondered the bar’s name, suddenly having a strange guess, The feedback indicated that parts of Hand Bro’s body are scattered across Morora, but originally there were only two pieces…
unit.target: Taberna cibum praebens? Carnivore… Lumian de nomine tabernae meditatus est, subito insolitum coniecturam fecit: responsum indicabat partes corporis Hand Bro per Mororam dispersas esse, initio vero tantum duo fragmenta exstare.

unit.source: The demon with the goat face in the Underworld cut and ate Hand Bro’s rotten flesh daily, and it regenerated…
unit.target: Daemon capite caprino in Inferis cotidie secabat et edebat carnem putridam Hand Bro, quae deinde regenerabatur…

unit.source: This bar is called “Carnivore”…
unit.target: Haec taberna “Carnivore” nuncupatur…

unit.source: Could it be that one piece of Hand Bro’s body was obtained by the bar’s owner, saving them the cost of buying meat and using it as a substitute?
unit.target: Numquid fieri potest ut unum ex partibus corporis Hand Bro a domino tabernae adeptum sit, ei impensam emendi carnem servans et tamquam substitutionem adhibitum?

unit.source: Other bar owners in different cities might not do this, but in Morora, they likely would, since they were exiled here for serious crimes.
unit.target: Alii domini tabernarum in diversis urbibus fortasse hoc non facerent, sed in Morora verisimiliter fecerunt, cum hic ex gravibus delinquentiis exulati essent.

unit.source: The bar owner might even be a perverted butcher who killed people and sold their meat…
unit.target: Dominus tabernae etiam fortasse macellarius pervertus esset, qui homines occidit et carnem eorum vendidit…

unit.source: If that’s true, things will be troublesome. Who knows how many people have eaten and integrated Hand Bro’s rotten flesh, and what impact that might have…
unit.target: Si hoc verum est, res difficiles erunt. Quis sciat quot homines carnem putridam Hand Bro comederint et incorporaverint, atque quo modo id afficiat…

unit.source: Can I merge the remaining parts once I find the original two pieces?
unit.target: Possumne reliquas partes iungere, cum duo originaria repperer?

unit.source: Lumian muttered silently for a while, then ran through the rain and pushed open the heavy wooden door of the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Lumian paulisper tacite murmuravit, deinde per imbrem cucurrit et gravem ianuam ligneam tabernae Carnivore aperuit.

unit.source: Upon arriving in Morora, after almost reassembling the Abscessed Hand’s body, he had started referring to it as Hand Bro, half-jokingly and half to show “closeness,” hoping it wouldn’t attack him when fully restored, as there might be other dangers then.
unit.target: Adveniens in Morora, postquam paene corpus Manūs Abscessae refecisset, coepit id Hand Bro appellare, dimidio iocose et dimidio propinquitatem ostendere, sperans ne eum oppugneret cum plene restitutum esset, cum aliae pericula existimabantur.

unit.source: Just as he entered the bar, bringing in the rain, Lumian saw a familiar figure.
unit.target: Simul ac in tabernam intravit, imbrem inferens, Lumian figuram familiaris vidit.

unit.source: That figure sat on a high stool in front of the bar, their hair tinged with red, eyebrows and eyes leaning towards brown, looking handsome yet unlikable due to their overly sharp features.
unit.target: Illa figura in alto scabello ante tabernam sedebat, capillis rubro tinctis, supercilia atque oculi castanei, speciosa sed non amabilis propter nimia acuta lineamenta.

unit.source: Albus!
unit.target: Albus!

unit.source: Albus Medici!
unit.target: Albus Medici!

unit.source: Lumian tensed, though his expression remained calm as he smiled and walked towards the bar.
unit.target: Lumian contraxit, quamquam vultus eius placidus remansit, subridente et ad tabernam properans.

unit.source: He used to think Albus Medici was mysterious and possibly involved in some consOriginal.
unit.target: Olim putabat Albus Medici esse mysteriosum et fortasse in quibusdam fraudibus implicatum.

unit.source: Later, he learned about the existence of the Red Angel Medici, realizing this former King of Angels had orchestrated a massive plot and successfully obtained the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the Hunter pathway from Vermonda Sauron in Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Postea didicit de existentia Rubri Angeli Medici, intellegens hunc quondam Regem Angelorum magnam machinamentum extruxisse et feliciter proprietatem Beyonder Sequenciae I viae Venatoris a Vermonda Sauron in Aetate Quarta Trier adeptum esse.

unit.source: This made Lumian associate Albus Medici with the Red Angel, suspecting Albus was the King of Angels’ agent, sent to Morora to find a way to get close to 0-01.
unit.target: Hoc faciebat ut Lumian Albus Medici cum Rubro Angelo coniungeretur, suspicatus eum esse agentem Regis Angelorum, ad Mororam missum ut viam ad 0-01 appropinquare inveniret.

unit.source: For Lumian, this was bad news, as Medici was close to ascending to the Red Priest’s divine throne!
unit.target: Lumiano hoc mala nuntia videbantur, nam Medici prope ascendendum ad thronum divinum Sacerdotis Rubri erat!

unit.source: Albus Medici noticed Lumian’s gaze and turned, looking back at Lumian, who had made no effort to disguise himself beyond restoring his hair color.
unit.target: Albus Medici conspexit aspectum Luminiani et conversus est, revidens Luminianum, qui nihil nisi capillorum colorem restitutum se tegere conatus erat.

unit.source: “What brings you here?” Lumian smiled as if meeting an old friend.
unit.target: “Quid te hic adfert?” subridens Lumian dixit, quasi veteri amico conveniretur.

unit.source: Albus returned the smile. “What brings you here?”
unit.target: Albus similiter subridens respondit: “Quid te hic adfert?”

unit.source: “Of course, I was captured,” Lumian laughed, sitting beside Albus and tapping the bar counter, “Give me a steak, tenderloin, medium-rare,” he told the bartender, who looked as if he had lost his parents.
unit.target: “Scilicet, captus sum,” risit Lumian, sedens iuxta Albam et pulsans mensam tabernae, “Da mihi steak, lumbum tenerum, medium coctum,” inquit ad cauponem, qui videbatur quasi parentes suos amisisset.

unit.source: “Are you mimicking me? Also being randomly captured and ordering a tenderloin steak,” Albus said, one foot on the stool’s footrest, the other resting on his knee.
unit.target: “Imitasne me? Etiam captus fortuito esse et lumbum tenerum iubere?” inquit Albus, cum unus pes in subsellii sustentaculo positus esset, alterum in genu reposito.

unit.source: Before Lumian could respond, he relaxed and asked with a smile, “What crime did you commit?”
unit.target: Antequam Lumian responderet, se relaxavit et subridente quaesivit: “Quod crimine commisisti?”

unit.source: “Murder, blasphemy, arson, causing explosions, kidnapping…” Lumian repeated the crimes he had told Guei and others before, but not in the same order.
unit.target: “Homicidium, blasphemia, incendium, explosionum causatio, rapina…” repetebat Lumian scelera quae Guei et aliis antea enuntiaverat, sed non ordine eodem.

unit.source: He was relaxed as he asked, “What about you?”
unit.target: Relaxatus quaesivit: “Et tu?”

unit.source: “Me?” Albus jiggled his foot resting on his knee, “Murder, arson, inciting riots, attempting to overthrow the government.”
unit.target: “Ego?” inquit Albus, pedem in suo genu quassans, “Homicidium, incendium, seditionem incitandi, conatus ad regimen evertere.”

unit.source: “Which government?” Lumian asked in a tone of old friends reuniting.
unit.target: “Quod regimen?” inquit Lumian, in tono veterorum amicorum conveniendorum.

unit.source: “Intis.” Albus shrugged, “Don’t ask me why I tried to overthrow the Intis government and ended up in this strange city in Lenburg. I don’t know either.”
unit.target: “Intis.” Albus umeros levavit et dixit: “Noli me interrogare cur conatus sim regimen Intis evertere et in hac urbe mirabili Lenburg incidere; neque ego scio.”

unit.source: That’s such a patronizing answer… Lumian nodded in agreement. “Yeah, I didn’t commit crimes in Lenburg either.”
unit.target: Ista responsio ita superba est… Lumian annuit consentiens: “Ita, et ego in Lenburg scelera non commissus sum.”

unit.source: As the two former Iron and Blood Cross Order members “chatted,” two steaks were served.
unit.target: Dum duo pristini membri Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis confabulabant, duo steak serviebantur.

unit.source: Looking at the steaks on white porcelain plates, slightly bloody and with a good-looking texture, Lumian remained silent and didn’t pick up his knife and fork.
unit.target: Intuens steaks in patinis albis ex porcelane, leviter sanguineos et pulchrae structurae, Lumian silentium servavit et culter atque furcam non levavit.

unit.source: He sensed a connection.
unit.target: Coniunctionem sensit.

unit.source: This was indeed the Abscessed Hand’s rotten flesh, cut from the body!
unit.target: Hoc re vera erat caro putrida Manūs Abscessae, ex corpore secta!

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lumian glanced to the side and found Albus Medici also staring at the “steak” without moving.
unit.target: Post paucos segundos, Lumian ad latus intuefactus est et invenit Album Medici quoque “steak” immobile spectantem.

unit.source: Lumian smiled and asked, “Why aren’t you eating?”
unit.target: Lumian subridens rogavit: “Cur non edis?”

unit.source: Albus responded with a radiant smile. “Why aren’t you?”
unit.target: Albus respondit, radianti subridente: “Cur non edis?”

unit.source: 796 “Duel”
unit.target: 796 “Certamen”

unit.source: 796 “Duel”
unit.target: 796 “Certamen”

unit.source: In response to Albus’s question, Lumian let out a soft laugh and muttered to himself, This guy seems pretty sharp…
unit.target: Ad quaestionem Albi respondens, Lumian leniter risit et sibi murmurat: “Hic vir videtur valde acutus…”

unit.source: No idea when he was exiled to Morora, but this must be his first time eating here…
unit.target: Nescio quo tempore in Mororam exsulatus sit, sed hoc videtur primum esse quo hic cibum sumat…

unit.source: Did he come here because he noticed some people in Morora behaving strangely after eating at this bar?
unit.target: Venitne hic quia animadvertit aliquos in Morora, postquam in hac taberna cibo usi sunt, se mirum modum gerere?

unit.source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian slapped the bar counter.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius volitabant, Lumian mensam tabernae percussit.

unit.source: He jumped off the stool and coldly said to the bartender, whose expression had remained grim.
unit.target: Exsiliens e subsellio, frigidus ad cauponem dixit, cuius vultus severus manebat.

unit.source: “Serving this kind of meat as steak to me? Get your boss out here!”
unit.target: “Hancne carnem mihi ut ‘steak’ ministras? Educe dominum tuum huc!”

unit.source: The bartender was taken aback.
unit.target: Caupo stupefactus est.

unit.source: “Are you certain?”
unit.target: “Esne certus?”

unit.source: He wasn’t embarrassed or angry at Lumian’s attitude; instead, there seemed to be a slight hint of pleasant surprise.
unit.target: Non erubuit neque iratus est ob habitum Lumiani; potius, parva indicia iucundae admirationis apparebant.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t answer but conveyed with his eyes that he wanted the boss to hurry up and come out.
unit.target: Lumian non respondit; sed oculis intimavit se velle ut dominus celeriter exiret.

unit.source: The bartender immediately shouted, “Boss! Boss! Someone’s about to wreck your bar!”
unit.target: Caupo statim exclamat: “Domine! Domine! Aliquis paene tuam tabernam delebit!”

unit.source: Within seconds, a figure rushed out from the kitchen.
unit.target: Inter paucos secundos, figura ex culina festinanter exiit.

unit.source: The figure had messy, fluffy hair and a very fat face, layered with flesh that made his eyes appear small, yet his body was quite standard, showing no sign of obesity.
unit.target: Figura capillos inconditos et lanuginosos habebat, atque faciem valde obesam, carnis stratis inductam quae oculos eius parvos reddidit; sed corpus eius ordinarium, nullum adipositatis signum ostendens, erat.

unit.source: At this moment, he was wearing a white apron and holding a cleaver, glaring angrily at the two customers near the bar, shouting in Lenburg, “Who? Who’s going to wreck my bar?”
unit.target: In hoc momento, mappam albam gerebat et cultrum tenebat, iratus ad duos clientes prope tabernam aspexit, clamans in lingua Lenburg: “Quis? Quis tabernam meam delebit?”

unit.source: Lumian pointed at the steak on the white porcelain plate and sneered, “You think I can’t tell what kind of meat this is?”
unit.target: Lumian ad “steak” in albo plato porcellaneo digitum extulit et subsannavit: “Putasne me nescire qua genere carnis haec sint?”

unit.source: “If I say it’s steak, it’s steak,” the fat-faced boss retorted without backing down.
unit.target: “Si dicam id esse ‘steak’, id est ‘steak’”, respondit dominus obesus sine recedendo.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t argue further. He took out a black glove from the Traveler’s Bag and tossed it in front of him.
unit.target: Lumian amplius non contendit. Ex sacculo Viatoris manicam nigram extraxit et coram se proiecit.

unit.source: “I challenge you to a duel,” Lumian said calmly.
unit.target: «Te ad certamen provocabo», sedate inquit Lumian.

unit.source: Throwing down a glove was a customary way to issue a duel challenge in Intis.
unit.target: Manicam deponere erat more solito in Intis ad certamen provocandum.

unit.source: The boss glanced at the black glove on the ground, his layers of fat shifting to reveal a light yellow beard.
unit.target: Dominus in manicam nigrum in terra aspexit, et strata pinguedinis eius labente barbam luteam levem revelare coeperunt.

unit.source: He was laughing.
unit.target: Ridebat.

unit.source: He responded to Lumian’s challenge, “Okay.”
unit.target: Ad provocationem Lumiani respondit: “Bene.”

unit.source: As soon as he spoke, he raised the cleaver and swung it down at Lumian.
unit.target: Statim eum locuto, cultrum elevavit et contra Lumian deiecit.

unit.source: Lumian sidestepped the blow, but suddenly felt he couldn’t use his teleportation ability.
unit.target: Lumian ictum evitavit, sed repente sensit se facultatem teleportationis suae uti non posse.

unit.source: The contract ability from the Abscessed Hand seemed to be stripped away by some strange power!
unit.target: Facultas contracta ex “Abscessed Hand” videbatur ab aliqua potentia insolita sublata esse!

unit.source: Lumian recalled Ludwig’s description of the Sequence 5 Depriver of the Gourmet pathway and suspected this boss-cum-chef was a blessed one of this pathway.
unit.target: Lumian recordatus est descriptionem Ludovigi de “Sequence 5 Depriver” in via Gourmet, et suspicatus est hunc dominum cum coquus simul esse benedictum hujus itineris.

unit.source: No wonder he can make Hand Bro’s rotten flesh look and smell like real steak…
unit.target: Non mirum est quod potest effingere carnem putridam “Hand Bro” ita ut vera “steak” videatur et odor habeat…

unit.source: A bestowed not executed but exiled to Morora?
unit.target: Num concessus, non interfectus, sed in Mororam exsulatus?

unit.source: Stop dumping all the trash in Morora…
unit.target: Desine totum purgamentum in Mororam abicere…

unit.source: Is it because they fear Morora’s population decline, risking the seal on 0-01?
unit.target: Num quia timent declinationem populi Mororae, sigillum 0‑01 periclitantes?

unit.source: As these thoughts flashed through his mind, Lumian swung his shoulder, his arm swelling, and punched out with his right fist.
unit.target: Dum hae cogitationes in mente eius fulsirent, Lumian humerum suum volvens, brachiumque eius inflatum, dextro pugnus percussit.

unit.source: His fist burst into bright, blazing-white flames, like a peacock’s tail, heading straight for the bartender.
unit.target: Pugnus eius in nitidissimas flammas albas, quasi cauda pavonis, eruptus est, recta via ad cauponem tendens.

unit.source: Boom!
unit.target: Boom!

unit.source: As his fist struck the side of the heavy cleaver, a violent explosion occurred.
unit.target: Cum pugnus eius latera cultri gravis percussit, violenta explosio evenit.

unit.source: The blazing-white light lit up the entire bar, the violent blast overturning nearby stools and throwing the fat-faced boss away.
unit.target: Lux flammea albae fulgentis totam tabernam illuminavit, dum explosio violenta subsellia proxima subvertebat et dominum obesum proiciebat.

unit.source: Albus reacted quickly, jumping off his stool and perching on the bar counter far from the blast area.
unit.target: Albus celeriter reactus, subsellium exiluit et in mensa tabernae longe ab area explosionis insedit.

unit.source: He pulled one foot up, resting it on the bar, watching Lumian’s duel with interest.
unit.target: Pedem unam levavit, eam in mensa collocans, et certamen Lumiani studio observabat.

unit.source: The bartender was also caught in the blast, thrown against the liquor shelf, doused in the fragrant liquid from shattered bottles.
unit.target: Caupo quoque in explosione comprehensus est, in scrinium liquoris proiectus, et in liquore aromatico ex poculis confractis demersus est.

unit.source: He was nearly set on fire.
unit.target: Paene ignibus incensus erat.

unit.source: The bar owner, who took the brunt of the explosion, had his chest clothes torn, revealing blood, charred flesh, and white bones.
unit.target: Dominus tabernae, qui ictum explosionis passus est, vestimenta pectoralia scissa habebat, sanguinem, carnes ustulatas, et ossa alba patefacientia.

unit.source: His face had similar wounds, but the layers of fat kept it from affecting his skull.
unit.target: Vultus eius vulnera similia habebat, sed strata pinguedinis cranium eius immuniter protegērunt.

unit.source: The wounds were writhing and healing rapidly in an unnatural, inhuman way, as if they would soon be completely healed.
unit.target: Vulnera contorquebantur et celeriter, modo innaturali atque inumano, sanabantur, quasi mox omnino convalescerent.

unit.source: This isn’t a power or trait typical of a Depriver.
unit.target: Haec non est vis aut proprietas typica Depriveris.

unit.source: None of the middle or low Sequences in the Gourmet pathway have this ability.
unit.target: Nulla ex sequentiis mediis aut inferioribus in via Gourmet hanc facultatem possidet.

unit.source: Did he gain this from a special kind of food as a Chef?
unit.target: Num hoc ex genere cibi speciali ut coquus adeptus est?

unit.source: It’s similar to how Hand Bro’s rotten flesh can regenerate after being eaten…
unit.target: Simile est modum quo caro putrida “Hand Bro” post consumptionem regenerari potest…

unit.source: Lumian retreated a few steps from the bar owner, putting distance between them.
unit.target: Lumian paucos passus a domino tabernae se recepit et distantiam inter eos constituit.

unit.source: As he noticed the other party’s peculiarity, he also realized he had lost another ability—Spell of Harrumph.
unit.target: Observans peculiarity alterius partis, etiam cognovit se aliam facultatem—Incantationem “Harrumph”—amissurum esse.

unit.source: Can a Depriver sense which of my abilities and traits are most dangerous to them?
unit.target: Num Depriver sentire potest quae ex meis facultatibus et proprietatibus illis maxime periculosa sint?

unit.source: Even if they don’t know exactly what those abilities and traits are, can they still deprive me of them based on the level of danger they pose?
unit.target: Etiamsi non exacte sciant quae sint illae facultates et proprietates, possuntne tamen me ab eis privare, ratione periculi quod ipsis incumbit?

unit.source: Lumian calmly formed a massive, blazing-white fireball and shot it at the bar owner.
unit.target: Lumian sedate ingentem globum ignis albi fulgentis condidit et ad dominum tabernae proiecit.

unit.source: The bar owner didn’t dodge.
unit.target: Dominus tabernae non evitavit.

unit.source: He raised his nearly shattered cleaver and slashed at the blazing-white fireball.
unit.target: Cultrum fere fractum elevavit et globum ignis albi fulgentis secuit.

unit.source: The fireball split in two, losing its momentum and destructive aura.
unit.target: Globus ignis in duas partes divisus est, momentum eius atque auram destructivam amittens.

unit.source: The bar owner opened his mouth wide and sucked it in like a whale swallowing water, remaining unharmed.
unit.target: Dominus tabernae os latius aperuit et illud, sicut cetus aquam vorans, aspiravit, intactus manens.

unit.source: At that moment, Lumian laughed.
unit.target: Illo momento, Lumian ridebat.

unit.source: More blazing-white fireballs rapidly formed around him, whistling through the air toward the bar owner.
unit.target: Plura globi ignis albi fulgentis celeriter circa eum coalescebant, per aerem sibilantes ad dominum tabernae volitantes.

unit.source: Behind him, blazing-white Fire Ravens appeared one after another, flying in wide arcs to flank the bar owner.
unit.target: Post eum, corvi ignis albi fulgentis, qui frontem conscie vitaverant, uno post alium apparuerunt, lati curvis volitantes ut dominum tabernae circumvenirent.

unit.source: Lumian wanted to see how many fireballs the Depriver could handle and if he could eat them all without getting overwhelmed.
unit.target: Lumian videre cupiebat quot globos ignis Depriver sustinere posset et an eos omnes edere sine overpoweratione valeat.

unit.source: The bar owner’s eyes narrowed, and he immediately spewed the blazing-white flames from his stomach, transforming them into a torrent to meet the incoming fireballs.
unit.target: Oculi domini tabernae contrarietate contracti sunt, et statim flammas albas fulgentes ex ventre eructavit, eas in torrentes convertens ad globos ignis advenientes oppugnandos.

unit.source: Seeing this, Albus flipped over the bar counter.
unit.target: Videns hoc, Albus super mensam tabernae transiluit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The fireballs exploded one after another upon contact with the flames.
unit.target: Globi ignis, uno post alium cum flammas attigerunt, explosi sunt.

unit.source: The counter was flattened, the liquor shelves collapsed silently, and the mixed liquor burned in a fierce blaze.
unit.target: Mensa plana facta est, scrinia liquoris silentio corruerunt, et mixtus liquor in igne feroci combusus est.

unit.source: The bartender, who had escaped to Albus’s position, felt very fortunate he had reacted in time.
unit.target: Caupo, qui ad locum Albi effugit, se valde fortunatum sensit ob tempestivum suum reactum.

unit.source: Other patrons either shrank to the edges of the room or escaped the hall, showing a wealth of experience.
unit.target: Alii clientes aut ad limina conclavis coegerunt aut ex aula effugerunt, abundantiam experientiae ostendentes.

unit.source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! The blazing-white Fire Ravens, which had deliberately avoided the front, fell on the bar owner’s back one after another.
unit.target: “Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!”

unit.source: By then, the bar owner was covered in a semi‑transparent crimson glow, like solidified moonlight.
unit.target: Iam dominus tabernae semi‑transparente rubro splendore tegebatur, quasi lumen lunae solidatum.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: Despite the explosions and flames from the Fire Ravens, the bar owner’s crimson glow didn’t dim.
unit.target: Non obstante explosionibus et ignibus a Corvis Ignis, ruber fulgor domini tabernae non obscuratus est.

unit.source: Instead, it brightened with the fire’s reflection.
unit.target: Immo, reflexione ignis, fulgore augebarat.

unit.source: When the flames finally subsided, the bar owner returned to his normal appearance.
unit.target: Quum flammas denique cessaverunt, dominus tabernae ad aspectum suum normalem rediit.

unit.source: He lifted his cleaver and looked at where Lumian had been standing.
unit.target: Cultrum suum sublevavit et intuens locum ubi Lumian steterat, aspexit.

unit.source: No one was there.
unit.target: Nemo aderat.

unit.source: Lumian was nowhere to be seen in the hall either.
unit.target: Lumian quoque in aula nusquam apparebat.

unit.source: The bar owner was momentarily stunned.
unit.target: Dominus tabernae per momentum obstupefactus erat.

unit.source: Almost simultaneously, a figure emerged from his shadow.
unit.target: Fere simul, figura e umbra eius emersit.

unit.source: Lumian, his eyes iron‑black, struck the bar owner’s crotch with his blazing‑white flame‑covered right fist.
unit.target: Lumian, oculis nigrosis ut ferro, inguen domini tabernae cum dextro pugnus igni albo tecto percussit.

unit.source: Amid the rumbling, Lumian’s fist hit its mark, penetrating the Depriver’s intestines with blazing‑white flames.
unit.target: Inter strepitum, pugnus Lumiani scopum attingit, intestina Depriver ignibus albis fulgentibus penetralia pertransiens.

unit.source: Standing up straight, Lumian lifted the bar owner, letting the flames surge into his stomach.
unit.target: Stans rectus, Lumian dominum tabernae elevavit, flammas in ventrem eius intransire siniens.

unit.source: Then, Lumian withdrew his right fist and threw the bar owner to the ground.
unit.target: Deinde, Lumian dextro pugnus abstulit et dominum tabernae in terram deiecit.

unit.source: With a thud, the bar owner’s crotch split open, intestines spilling out, and his stomach, though intact, was scorched and oozing yellow‑green fluid.
unit.target: Cum strepitu, inguen domini tabernae ruptus est, intestina erant effusa, et ventrem eius, quamquam intactum, combustum ac liquorem flavus‑viridem stillantem exhibebat.

unit.source: Lumian looked at the bar owner’s pained, shrunken eyes and mocked, “Did you turn your brain into food too? You blocked one round of attacks, then stayed in the same spot without moving. Did you not consider that I might use your shadow?”
unit.target: Lumian oculos domini tabernae, plenos doloris et contractos, intuens deriso inquit: “Num etiam cerebrum tuum in escam convertere fecisti? Unam seriem ictuum opprimes, deinde in eodem loco sine motu manes. Nonne putasti me umbram tuam uti posse?”

unit.source: The bar owner’s face twisted as he murmured, “Turning… my own… brain into… food… Is it possible?”
unit.target: Vultus domini tabernae contortus est, dum submurmurabat: “Convertens… meum ipsum… cerebrum in… escam… Num id fieri potest?”

unit.source: His voice faded, and he died, lying motionless on the ground.
unit.target: Vox eius evanuit, et mortuus est, in terra immotus iacens.

unit.source: Lumian stared at the Depriver’s corpse, not thinking about his opponent’s response, but noting something unusual about the battle.
unit.target: Lumian cadaver Depriveris contemplatus est, nullam de responsione adversarii cogitans, sed aliquid insolitum de pugna notans.

unit.source: Deprivers sure have a variety of abilities. Though each one is basic and crude, their combat applications are quite formidable…
unit.target: Depriver scilicet varietatem facultatum habent. Etsi singula fundamentalia atque rudia sint, applicationes eorum in pugna valde formidabiles apparent…

unit.source: If this guy hadn’t reacted so sluggishly after I vanished, I wouldn’t have attacked his weak spot so easily. I might have needed to use one of the mystical items from the Traveler’s Bag…
unit.target: Si hic vir non tam lententer post evanescens meam reagisset, non tam facile locum infirmum eius oppugnavissem; forsitan unum ex rebus mysticis Sacculi Viatoris adhibere necesse habuissem.

unit.source: In comparison, Worms the Marauder didn’t have this problem…
unit.target: Comparato, Worms the Marauder hanc difficultatem non habuit…

unit.source: As he thought, Lumian shook his hand, revealing painful corrosive wounds caused by the stomach acid of the bar owner when he delivered the strike at his stomach.
unit.target: Dum hoc cogitabat, Lumian manum suam concussit, revelans vulnera corrosiva et dolosa, quae acido ventris domini tabernae, cum ictum ad ventrem perferret, causa fuerunt.

unit.source: His hand had been protected by the blazing‑white flames at the time.
unit.target: Manus eius tempore a flammis albis fulgentibus protepta erat.

unit.source: Despite knowing he couldn’t prevent the bar owner’s boons from returning to their source, Lumian squatted down, pulled a plain sword from the Traveler’s Bag, and used his flames to separate the stomach from the corpse.
unit.target: Quamvis sciret se non posse impedire beneficia domini tabernae ad suam originem redire, Lumian se genu flectens sistit, gladium simplicem ex Sacculo Viatoris extraxit, atque flammas ad ventrem a cadavere dividendum usus est.

unit.source: He planned to ask Ludwig if this could be made into a dish with special effects or if it could be used as a unique material by an Artisan.
unit.target: Cogitavit Ludovigum interrogaturum, num hoc in ferculum cum effectibus specialibus converteri possit aut ut materia singularis a Artifice adhiberi valeat.

unit.source: Finished with this task, Lumian stood and asked the bartender, who had just emerged from hiding and was severely injured, “How many years has your boss been exiled in Morora?”
unit.target: Negotio hoc confecto, Lumian se levavit et cauponem, qui modo e latentibus effugit et graviter vulneratus erat, interrogavit: “Quot annos dominus tuus in Morora exsulatus est?”

unit.source: “Five or six years, I think,” the bartender answered with an uncertain look.
unit.target: «Quinque aut sex annos, credo», respondit caupo vultu incerto.

unit.source: Five or six years… That thief looked younger, probably only exiled for a year or two… The longer one stays in Morora, the more likely they are to show symptoms of experimental personnel—symptoms of 0‑01 corruption. No, the sealing information didn’t mention this, and it doesn’t happen in Trier… Did the bar owner do something in Morora that caused him to start turning into an experimental subject?
unit.target: Quinque aut sex annos… Ille fur juvenior videbatur, verisimiliter tantum per annum aut biennium exsulatus… Quo diutius quis in Morora manet, eo verisimilius symptomata personalia experimentalia—symptomata corruptionis 0‑01—ostendit. Non, nota sigillantis hoc non commemoravit, nec hoc in Trier evenit… Fecitne dominus tabernae quid in Morora, quod eum ad subiectum experimentale mutandum impulit?

unit.source: Lumian pondered as he looked around and smiled. “Don’t take my spoils.”
unit.target: Lumian circa se perspiciens et subridens meditatus est: “Noli spolia mea auferre.”

unit.source: He referred to the bar owner’s money.
unit.target: Referebat ad pecuniam domini tabernae.

unit.source: Lumian then walked towards the corridor beside the bar.
unit.target: Lumian deinde ad corridorium iuxta tabernam ambulavit.

unit.source: Based on the origin of the “steak” and the Chef’s position, he suspected the Abscessed Hand’s body part was in the kitchen.
unit.target: Ex origine “steak” et ex positione Coqui, suspicatus est partem corporis “Abscessed Hand” in culina esse.

unit.source: Entering the kitchen, he saw a half‑decayed, swollen, blue‑black corpse openly displayed on the cooking counter.
unit.target: Culina intrans, vidit cadaver semi‑putrescens, tumidum, caeruleo‑nigrum, palam in mensa coquinaria expositum.

unit.source: 797 Determining the Situation
unit.target: 797 Statu Determinando

unit.source: 797 Determining the Situation
unit.target: 797 Statu Determinando

unit.source: Looking at the swollen, blue‐black corpse on the counter, Lumian chuckled to himself, They’re not even trying to hide it, are they?
unit.target: Spectans cadaver tumidum, caeruleo‐nigrum super mensam, Lumian sibi subridens ait: “Non etiam conantur celare, nonne?”

unit.source: Classic Morora, the City of Exiles…
unit.target: Classica Morora, Urbs Exulorum…

unit.source: Lumian did a quick inspection, confirming that the highly decayed corpse was indeed the other body part of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter inspicuit, confirmans cadaver valde corruptum revera esse aliam partem corporis Manus Abscessae.

unit.source: Besides missing the left half, the corresponding part of the head, and the Abscessed Hand’s body itself, it was fairly intact.
unit.target: Praeter absentiam dimidiae sinistrae, partem capitis correspondens, atque ipsum corpus Manus Abscessae, illa satis integra manebat.

unit.source: If it weren’t for the rotting flesh at the spine writhing and trying to regenerate, Lumian might have doubted that the two steaks served to him and Albus had come from this corpse, let alone that dozens, perhaps hundreds, of such “steaks” had been sold.
unit.target: Si non esset caro putrida in spina, quae contorquebatur et regenerari conabatur, Lumian fortasse dubitasset quin duo “steaks”, quibus ei et Albo oblata erant, eodem cadavro provenirent, nedum quin non paucos—fortasse centena—talium “steaks” vendita essent.

unit.source: This made Lumian frown slightly, a question he had pondered earlier resurfacing in his mind: Must I do a recall of all the steaks sold?
unit.target: Hoc faciens, Lumian leviter frontem corripiebat; quaestio, quam antea meditaverat, iterum in mente apparuit: “Oportetne mihi omnes venditas ‘steaks’ recolere?”

unit.source: Judging by the corpse’s completeness, it doesn’t seem necessary…
unit.target: Ex integritate cadaveris, id non videtur necesse esse…

unit.source: Moreover, the residents of Morora had been eating such steaks for some time.
unit.target: Praeterea, incolae Morora iamdiu talia “steaks” edebant.

unit.source: Who knows if they’ve actually digested and absorbed the rotten flesh…
unit.target: Quis sciat num vere carnem putridam digeruerint atque absoruerint…

unit.source: From what I sense about the subtle connections between the corpse, even if digested, the rotten flesh likely just changes form without fundamentally altering…
unit.target: Ex intuendo meo de subtilibus nexibus inter cadaver, etsi digesta sit, caro putrida verisimiliter solum formam mutat, non tamen radicaliter.

unit.source: As he pondered, Lumian quickly stuffed the half-decayed corpse into the Traveler’s Bag, using the Sword of Courage and other plain swords to separate it from the other half to prevent unwanted fusion before finding the head.
unit.target: Dum meditaret, Lumian celeriter dimidium corruptum cadaver in Saccum Viatoris coniecit, utens Gladio Virtutis et aliis gladiis simplicibus, ut ea ab altero dimidio segregaret, ne fusio inopina eveniret, priusquam caput inveniret.

unit.source: “So we were served this stuff, and it looked pretty appetizing,” Albus’s voice came from the kitchen doorway as Lumian put away the half of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: “Ita nobis hoc oblata est, et satis edule videbatur,” vox Albi ex ianuā culinae prodiit, dum Lumian dimidium Manus Abscessae recondidit.

unit.source: Albus, the former member of the Iron and Blood Cross Order and Medici family member, wore a black jacket with dark red patterns, one hand in his pocket, marveling.
unit.target: Albus, pristinus Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis atque membrum familiae Medici, indutus erat iaccā nigra cum figuris rubris obscuris, una manu in sinu, admirans.

unit.source: He didn’t seem disgusted by almost eating rotten flesh steak.
unit.target: Non videbatur abhorrescere, cum prope “steaks” carnis putridae edisset.

unit.source: Lumian turned and responded with a smile, “I was looking forward to seeing what changes you’d undergo after eating it.”
unit.target: Lumian se vertit et subrisus respondit: “Exspectabam videre quales mutationes subies postquam id comederis.”

unit.source: “Gradually gain some self-healing ability, become stronger on moonlit nights, and learn some dark spells,” Albus replied in a report-like tone.
unit.target: “Paulatim aliquam facultatem se curandi adipisces, noctibus lunatis fortior fies, et incantationes obscuras discere,” respondit Albus, tono quasi relationis.

unit.source: “But in return, self-control would significantly decrease, intelligence would regress, and nightmares would be frequent.”
unit.target: “Sed pro invicem, moderatio multum decrescet, intelligentia recedet, et incubi frequenter apparebunt.”

unit.source: “So, you came to investigate after noticing the odd behavior of those guys?” Lumian asked with a smile.
unit.target: “Itaque, venisti ad investigandum postquam insolitum illorum comportamen animadvertivisti?” quaesivit Lumian subrisus.

unit.source: He wasn’t really seeking confirmation; he had already determined it.
unit.target: Non vere confirmationem quaerebat; iam id statuerat.

unit.source: He was using this question to indicate that he was also investigating and hadn’t come specifically for the half-corpse.
unit.target: Quaestionem hanc adhibebat ut indicaret se quoque investigare nec solum ad dimidium cadaveris venerit.

unit.source: “A Hunter must conceal their true purpose to avoid traps set by others.”
unit.target: “Venator verum finem suum celare debet, ne ab aliis insidiis capiatur.”

unit.source: The red-haired Albus smiled.
unit.target: Albus, cum capillis rufis, subrisit.

unit.source: “They tried to keep this a secret, hoping only they and their collaborators could enjoy this bar’s special food.”
unit.target: “Conati sunt hoc arcani servare, sperantes quod tantum ipsi et socii eorum cibum peculiare huius tabernae frui possent.”

unit.source: “Who in Morora isn’t selfish?” Lumian asked, changing the topic.
unit.target: “Quis in Morora non est sui ipsius cupidus?” quaesivit Lumian, rem mutans.

unit.source: “How did you notice their intelligence regression?”
unit.target: “Quomodo animadvertivisti eorum recedentem intelligentiam?”

unit.source: Albus raised his right hand, palm up.
unit.target: Albus dextram manum levavit, palma sursum.

unit.source: “If their intelligence hadn’t regressed, how could they have revealed their secret to me so easily, leading me to this bar?”
unit.target: “Si intelligentia eorum non recederet, quomodo facile secreta sua mihi revelata essent, quae me ad hanc tabernam duxerint?”

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly, looking thoughtful.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit, aspectu cogitativo.

unit.source: “So, should I kill you to keep this secret from spreading?”
unit.target: “Itaque, te occidam, ne hic secretus divulgetur?”

unit.source: Albus met Lumian’s gaze calmly, smiling.
unit.target: Albus oculos Lumiani tranquille convenit, subrisus.

unit.source: “Do you think those idiots can keep a secret?”
unit.target: “Num credis illos stultos secretum retinere posse?”

unit.source: With that, the Medici family member turned and walked towards the bar hall, exposing his back to Lumian.
unit.target: Hoc facto, membrum familiae Medici se vertit et ad atrium tabernae processit, dorsum Lumiano ostendens.

unit.source: Lumian stood still, watching him leave, as if deep in thought.
unit.target: Lumian stabat immotus, eum discedentem observans, quasi penitus meditans.

unit.source: For a moment, he had the urge to kill.
unit.target: Aliquando, impulsum occidendi eum percussit.

unit.source: He considered using this chance to eliminate Albus Medici to prevent him from interfering with his approach to 0-01, or even marking it for the Red Angel before him.
unit.target: Cogitavit hanc occasionem uti ad Album Medici eliminandum, ne in accessu ad 0‑01 interveniret, aut ut ante eum pro Angelo Rubro signaretur.

unit.source: Ultimately, Lumian resisted this impulse.
unit.target: Finaliter, Lumian hunc impulsum repulit.

unit.source: For two reasons: First, he judged that becoming an experimental subject would severely impact his self-awareness.
unit.target: Duo erant causae: Primo, aestimavit fieri subiectum experimentale graviter conscientiam suam laesurum.

unit.source: Unless it was his only option, he didn’t want to try it.
unit.target: Nisi unica optio esset, id conari noluit.

unit.source: In that case, having an extra person, a “cannon fodder” to help navigate the dangers, was a viable strategy.
unit.target: In hoc casu, habere personam extra, “cannon fodder”, ad pericula superanda adiuvandum, consilium valde idoneum erat.

unit.source: Second, he wasn’t confident he could kill Albus Medici.
unit.target: Secundo, non confidit se Album Medici interficere posse.

unit.source: If Albus was still in the same state as when they explored the Red Swan Castle, he would be easily dealt with, but several months had passed.
unit.target: Si Albus in eodem statu maneret, ut cum Rubro Cygno Castello exploraverunt, facile tractabilis esset, sed menses plurimi transierant.

unit.source: He had become a Reaper and had even fully digested the corresponding potion.
unit.target: Factus erat Messor et potionem ad id pertinens plene digeriverat.

unit.source: It was unlikely the other party hadn’t made any progress.
unit.target: Improbabile erat ne altera pars ullam profectionem non fecerit.

unit.source: Moreover, if Albus was indeed representing the Red Angel in approaching 0-01, the King of Angels would likely enhance His descendant’s strength, providing powerful items to ensure he was among the apex below demigods, capable of handling Morora’s dangers.
unit.target: Praeterea, si Albus revera Angelum Rubrum in accessu ad 0‑01 repraesentaret, Rex Angelorum verisimiliter vires posteritatis eius augeret, potentes res suppeditans, ut inter apex infra semideos esse possit ad pericula Morora superanda toleranda.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t leave the kitchen immediately.
unit.target: Lumian culinam statim non reliquit.

unit.source: He checked around again.
unit.target: Circumspiciebat iterum.

unit.source: He was looking for any other special ingredients—the bar owner’s slightly sluggish behavior made him suspect it was caused by randomly eating something in Morora, a common cause of death for Beyonders of the Gourmet pathway.
unit.target: Quaerebat alias ingredientes speciales – morosa paulo tarditas tabernarii eum suspicari faciebat, quod fortuito aliquid in Morora edendi causa communi mortis Beyonderum in via Gourmet fiebat.

unit.source: Unfortunately, Lumian only found ordinary ingredients like flour, butter, and milk.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Lumian tantum ingredientes ordinaris invenit, ut farinam, butyrum, atque lac.

unit.source: He then went up to the second floor of the Carnivore bar, entering the Depriver’s bedroom.
unit.target: Deinde ascendit ad tabulatum secundum tabernae Carnivoris, et in cubiculum Depriveris ingressus est.

unit.source: He planned to stay here as the duel winner for the time being.
unit.target: Cogitavit manere hic, ut ad tempus victor duelli esset.

unit.source: The bedroom was cleaner than Lumian expected—no grease stains, no cockroaches, mice, or insects.
unit.target: Cubiculum purius erat quam Lumian speraverat—nullae maculae unctuosae, neque blattae, neque mures, neque alia insecta erant.

unit.source: Aside from being slightly messy, it was fine.
unit.target: Praeter modicum inordinatum, statim conveniebat.

unit.source: Lumian walked around the bedroom, trying to activate the black mark on his right shoulder to see if he could teleport out of Morora.
unit.target: Lumian per cubiculum ambulavit, conans signum nigrum in umero dextro suo activare, ut videret num ex Morora se teleportare posset.

unit.source: He couldn’t sense any of the places he had been to.
unit.target: Non poterat sentire ullos locos quos antea visitaverat.

unit.source: As expected, I can’t leave.
unit.target: Ut expectatum est, non possum exire.

unit.source: I can only teleport within this mountainous area… But it’s not like Morora residents want to leave… I wonder if Albus has such thoughts…
unit.target: Ego solum intra hanc montuosam regionem teleportare possum… Sed non videtur incolis Mororae exire velle… Miror an Albus talem animum habeat…

unit.source: Lumian muttered silently, taking out ritual materials from the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian submurmuravit tacite, materias rituales e Sacco Viatoris extrahens.

unit.source: He conducted his second experiment: Summoning a messenger!
unit.target: Experimentum secundum perfecit: nuntium evocans!

unit.source: But neither the doll messenger nor his own messenger responded to his call.
unit.target: Sed nec nuntius ex pupula nec nuntius proprius ad vocem eius respondit.

unit.source: Disconnected from the spirit world?
unit.target: Disiunctus a mundo spirituali?

unit.source: At least to some extent…
unit.target: Saltem ad aliquam mensuram…

unit.source: As expected from a place sealing 0-01…
unit.target: Sicut exspectabatur, ex loco quod 0‑01 sigillaret…

unit.source: Lumian stood at the window, gazing at the dim environment and the slightly less intense rain, feeling the cold dampness seeping in.
unit.target: Lumian ad fenestram stetit, aspiciens ambitum obscuratum et pluviam paulo minorem intensitatis, frigorem humiditatis se infiltrantem sentiens.

unit.source: He proceeded with the third experiment according to his plan.
unit.target: Tertium experimentum secundum consilium suum prosecutus est.

unit.source: He walked to the full-length mirror in the room, placed his right hand on it, and activated a black mark on his body.
unit.target: Ad speculum totum in conclavi stetit, dextrem manum superposuit, et signum nigrum in corpore suo activavit.

unit.source: He was using the contractual ability from Bloody Jack to sense the mirror marks he had left elsewhere!
unit.target: Utebatur facultate contractuali ex “Bloody Jack” ad signa speculi, quae alibi reliquerat, sentienda!

unit.source: In the blink of an eye, Lumian sensed three faint marks through the mirror.
unit.target: In momento oculi, Lumian per speculum tres signa tenues sensit.

unit.source: They were in Moron Avigny’s study, the Blue Avenger’s treasury, and Franca and Jenna’s rented apartment.
unit.target: Erat ea in studio Moronis Avigny, in thesauro Vindicis Caeruli, et in locato habitatione Francae et Jennae.

unit.source: This meant that if Lumian could enter the mirror, he might be able to use his teleportation ability to reach the mirrors corresponding to these marks.
unit.target: Hoc significabat: si Lumian in speculum intrare posset, fortasse facultate teleportationis ad specula correspondentia his signis pervenire posset.

unit.source: Even if not, he should be able to exchange information with the outside world through them!
unit.target: Etiam si non, per ea informationem cum orbe exterio commutare posset!

unit.source: Lumian was both pleasantly surprised and satisfied that his hypothesis was confirmed.
unit.target: Lumian et laetus et contentus erat quod hypothesim suam confirmatam esse videret.

unit.source: Having read the 0-01 data, he knew its origin and its connection to Fourth Epoch Trier.
unit.target: Postquam data 0‑01 lecta erant, originem eius et nexum ad Quartam Epocham Trier noverat.

unit.source: Given the similar sealing methods, many details should also be consistent–Trier had a special mirror world, so this place likely did too.
unit.target: Propter modos sigillandi similes, multa quoque compatenda esse videntur—Trier habebat mundum specularum specialem, itaque hoc loco idem verisimile est.

unit.source: Trier had Mirror People, so this place likely had them too!
unit.target: Trier habebat Populum Specularum, itaque hoc loco verisimiliter eos habet quoque!

unit.source: The experimental subjects’ detail, “if not blindfolded, the one who leaves the mausoleum will be a monster resembling him,” was evidence of the Mirror People and the special mirror world’s existence.
unit.target: Commentarium subiectorum experimentalis, “nisi caecati erint, qui mausoleum relinquit, monstrum eum simile erit,” testimonium erat de Populo Specularum atque exsistentia mundi specularis specialis.

unit.source: Based on these premises, Lumian thought using the mirror world’s abilities might establish some contact with the outside world.
unit.target: His praemissis innixus, Lumian putavit facultates mundi specularis ad aliquod contactum cum orbe exterio constituendum esse.

unit.source: With this hypothesis, he borrowed the Mirror Cufflink from Franca, who had become a Demoness of Affliction.
unit.target: Hoc hypothesi innixus, mutuatus est “Mirror Cufflink” ab Franca, quae Daemona Afflictionis facta erat.

unit.source: In a few days, she could use the pretext of investigating Mirror People to request charms from the Demoness Sect that would allow her to use the mirror world for teleportation.
unit.target: In paucis diebus illa poterit praetexto investigationis Populi Specularum adhibere, ut ab Secta Daemona incantamenta petat, quae ei sinerent uti mundo speculari pro teleportatione.

unit.source: Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and took out the glass-like cufflink.
unit.target: Lumian in Sacco Viatoris manum extendit et “Mirror Cufflink,” quasi vitreum, extraxit.

unit.source: He didn’t rush to confirm if it could be used to leave directly or only to transmit information, as the Mirror Cufflink had only four uses left.
unit.target: Non festinavit confirmare num ad directam exitum vel tantum ad informationem transmittendam adhiberi posset, cum “Mirror Cufflink” tantum quattuor usus reliquerat.

unit.source: He’d wait for important information or urgent matters to test it.
unit.target: Exspectaret informationem gravem aut negotia urgenta, ut id experiretur.

unit.source: Grr, grr… At that moment, Lumian’s stomach growled with hunger.
unit.target: Grr, grr… Illo momento, ventris Lumiani fame fremuit.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but gripe internally, Seriously, the Church of Knowledge is so stingy.
unit.target: Non potuit non interne queri: “Serio, Ecclesia Scientiae tam avara est!”

unit.source: Not even a meal or a sip of water before sending me into Morora.
unit.target: Nec quidem cena aut sorbitus aquae, antequam me in Morora mitterent.

unit.source: I’m not Ludwig, who can finish all the prison food…
unit.target: Non sum Ludwig, qui omnem cibum carceris consumere possit…

unit.source: Muttering, Lumian descended to the first floor, intending to cook something in the kitchen and wait for the rain to stop before looking for the Abscessed Hand’s head.
unit.target: Murmurans, Lumian ad tabulatum primum descendit, cogitans aliquid in culina coquere et pluvia cessare exspectare, antequam caput Manus Abscessae quaereret.

unit.source: By now, the bar owner’s body had been taken away by the enforcers, and the bloodstains on the floor had been cleaned, but the destroyed bar counter and the hall’s scorched remains hadn’t been dealt with.
unit.target: Interim, corpus tabernarii a vigilibus abductum erat, et maculae sanguinis in pavimento expurgatae erant, sed mensa deleta atque reliquiae aulae combustae non curatae erant.

unit.source: Glass shards and wood splinters mixed with the scents of liquor and charred wood.
unit.target: Fragmenta vitrea et scindulae lignorum cum odoribus liquoris et ligni combusti miscebantur.

unit.source: Just as Lumian picked up the bar owner’s legacy left by the enforcers- 420 sassen gold-someone walked in from the doorway.
unit.target: Ita ut Lumian hereditatem tabernarii a vigilibus relictam — 420 sassen aurum — sublevit, aliquis ex ostio intravit.

unit.source: It was the humble-looking human meat chef, Lez.
unit.target: Erat Lez, coquus humanarum carnium, aspectu humili.

unit.source: Lez was soaked, glanced around, and asked Lumian, “Are you hiring a chef here?”
unit.target: Lez madidus erat, circumspexit, ac Lumiano rogavit: “Num hic coquum conducis?”

unit.source: The Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence?
unit.target: Lex Convergence Characteristicarum Beyonder?

unit.source: Lumian suddenly laughed.
unit.target: Lumian subito risit.

unit.source: “Sure, go to the kitchen and make something. I’ll try it and see how it tastes.”
unit.target: “Certe, ad culinam vade et aliquid fac; conabor id et videbo quo modo sapiat.”

unit.source: 798 Hire
unit.target: 798 Conduce

unit.source: 798 Hire
unit.target: 798 Conduce

unit.source: Lez looked at Lumian with confusion and asked, “Can you make decisions for the owner here?”
unit.target: Lez, confuso animo Luminum contemplatus, quaesivit: “Potesne hic pro domino decernere?”

unit.source: “Yes, because I am the owner now,” Lumian replied with a smile, pointing to himself.
unit.target: “Ita, nam nunc ego dominus sum,” respondit Lumian subrisu, ad se ipsum demonstrans.

unit.source: The human meat chef, Lez, was even more perplexed.
unit.target: Lez, coquus carnium humanarum, adhuc magis perplexus erat.

unit.source: “Weren’t we just exiled to Morora together?”
unit.target: “Nonne modo una in Morora exsulati sumus?”

unit.source: It had been less than an hour since they arrived.
unit.target: Ex quo advenissent, minus quam una hora praeterierat.

unit.source: Lumian tilted his head and pointed his chin towards the destroyed bar area.
unit.target: Lumian caput inclinavit et mentum suum ad aream tabernae deleta indicavit.

unit.source: “I had a duel with the previous owner and won this bar from him.”
unit.target: “Certamen cum priore domino habueram atque hanc tabernam ab eo vici.”

unit.source: Lez’s eyes suddenly lit up.
unit.target: Oculi Lez subito fulserunt.

unit.source: “Is he dead? Where’s his body?”
unit.target: “Num mortuus est? Ubi eius corpus est?”

unit.source: “The enforcers took it away, probably to be buried in the cemetery,” Lumian said, walking to the edge of the hall and picking up a relatively intact chair, placing it next to the ruined bar.
unit.target: “Custodes id abstulerunt, verisimiliter ad sepelendum in coemeterio,” inquit Lumian, ad limitem aulae ambulans et sellam satis intactam tollens eamque iuxta tabernam ruinam ponens.

unit.source: Lez sighed regretfully but followed Lumian’s suggestion and went into the kitchen to start cooking.
unit.target: Lez tristiter suspiravit, sed consilio Lumiani se secutus in culinam ivit ad coquendum.

unit.source: Lumian wandered to the bar area, searching for the two “steaks” he and Albus hadn’t eaten.
unit.target: Lumian ad aream tabernae vagatus est, duo frusta carnis quaerens, quae ipse atque Albus non ediderant.

unit.source: They were torn to pieces in the violent explosion, scattered among the debris, completely charred and carbonized.
unit.target: Illae in violenta explosione in partes disiectae erant, inter ruinas sparsae, omnino exusta atque carbonatae.

unit.source: After examining them for a while, Lumian noticed that the steak fragments showed no signs of writhing or regeneration.
unit.target: Postquam aliquantisper ea examinavit, Lumian animadvertit fragmenta carnis nullas signa motus aut regenerationis exhibere.

unit.source: The fire had destroyed any subtle connection to the corpse, making them seem entirely dead and no longer part of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Ignis omnem levem nexum ad cadaver destruxit, ita ut videbantur omnino mortui et non amplius pars “Manus Abscessae” essent.

unit.source: These probably don’t need to be recalled…
unit.target: Haec fortasse non sunt revocanda.

unit.source: High-temperature flames can restrain the self-healing ability of the separated rotten flesh, but it’s unclear how much it affects the corpse itself…
unit.target: Flammae altae temperaturae facultatem auto-sanandi carnis putrescentis separatae reprimere possunt, sed incertum est quantum ipsa cadaver afficiat.

unit.source: Besides, the separated rotten flesh must only have a limited self-healing ability; otherwise, each piece could grow into a new Hand Bro, and there’d be no need for Hand Bro to find the whole corpse…
unit.target: Praeterea, carnis putrescentis separatae facultas auto-sanandi limitata esse debet; alioquin, quaelibet pars in novum “Manus Frater” crescere posset, et opus non esset ut “Manus Frater” totum cadaver inveniret.

unit.source: After pondering for a while, Lumian brought over a small overturned round table from the edge of the hall and placed it next to the chair.
unit.target: Postquam paulisper cogitavit, Lumian parvam mensam rotundam deorsum versa ex extremitate aulae attulit et iuxta sellam posuit.

unit.source: He sat down, patiently waiting for Lez to prepare lunch.
unit.target: Sedit, patienter exspectans ut Lez prandium praepararet.

unit.source: As time passed, Lez brought out a mixed salad, creamy mashed potatoes, and other dishes.
unit.target: Tempore transacto, Lez acetariam mixtam, cremosa puram solanorum, et alia fercula eduxit.

unit.source: Lumian took a spoonful of mashed potatoes and tasted it, finding the texture unusually smooth and the flavors of starch, cream, and fat deliciously combined.
unit.target: Lumian cochlearem puri solanorum sumpsit et gustavit, inveniens texturam insolitam lenem atque sapores amylum, cremor, et adipum sapide coniunctos.

unit.source: “Not bad,” Lumian said, raising his left hand and giving a thumbs up.
unit.target: “Non male,” inquit Lumian, manum sinistram levans et pollice probans.

unit.source: Lez stood beside him, smiling humbly.
unit.target: Lez iuxta eum stetit, humiliter subridens.

unit.source: “I used to own a restaurant.”
unit.target: “Olim cauponam possidebam.”

unit.source: “A restaurant specializing in human meat?” Lumian teased provocatively.
unit.target: “Taberna quae carnem humanam praecipue parabat?” provocavit Lumian.

unit.source: Lez shook his head.
unit.target: Lez caput agitavit.

unit.source: “Back then, I was a normal chef with excellent, but still human, cooking skills.”
unit.target: “Illo tempore, eram coquus ordinarius cum optimis, sed humanis, artibus culinariis.”

unit.source: “Then why did you start eating people?”
unit.target: “Cur ergo homines edere coepisti?”

unit.source: He didn’t know which evil god corresponded to the Gourmet pathway.
unit.target: Nesciebat cui deus malignus ad viam “Gourmet” pertineret.

unit.source: Lez’s expression gradually darkened.
unit.target: Vultus Lez paulatim obscuratus est.

unit.source: “My wife had a friend who always filled her head with the idea of a luxurious lifestyle, introducing her to so‐called high society members, even encouraging her to have affairs and squander money.
unit.target: “Uxor mea amicum habuit, qui semper eius mentem ideae vitae luxuriosae imbuere solebat, eam ad vocatos altos societatis introducens, atque etiam hortans ut amatoria se gereret et pecuniam disperderet.

unit.source: She secretly mortgaged our restaurant; her goal was our restaurant from the start.
unit.target: Ea arcane cauponam nostram hypothecavit; propositum eius ab initio caupona nostra erat.

unit.source: After losing the restaurant, that friend stopped associating with my wife.
unit.target: Post amissione caupona, ille amicus cum uxore mea consociari desiit.

unit.source: My wife finally came to her senses but was too weak.
unit.target: Uxor mea tandem ad se rediit, sed nimis debilis erat.

unit.source: She burned down the restaurant, killing herself in the process.
unit.target: Ea cauponam incendit, se in processu interficiente.

unit.source: Then a regular customer, who admired my cooking skills, approached me and asked if I wanted revenge.
unit.target: Tum comes ordinarius, qui artes meas culinarias admirabat, ad me accessit et rogavit: “Num ultionem velle?”

unit.source: He offered to help, saying someone with my high-level cooking skills should worship the God of Cuisine, the great “Devouring Whirlpool.”
unit.target: Auxilium offerre voluit, dicens aliquem cum meis altissimis artibus culinariis deum Coquinariae, magnum “Devorantem Turbinem,” adorare debere.

unit.source: After that, I received a boon and slowly grew stronger.
unit.target: Postea beneficium accepi et paulatim fortior factus sum.

unit.source: After becoming a true Chef, I found that woman and made her into the most satisfying meal of my life.
unit.target: Postquam verus coquus factus sum, illam feminam inveni et eam in prandium vitae meae maxime satisfaciens convertere feci.

unit.source: From that day on, I enjoyed eating the flesh of the damned and gained the ability to discern who deserved to die.
unit.target: Ex illa die, edendi carnem damnatorum mihi placuit et facultatem accepi ut discernerem quem mori merebat.

unit.source: “Was that woman also a follower of an evil god?”
unit.target: “Num illa femina quoque sectatrix dei maligni fuit?”

unit.source: Hearing this, Lumian strongly suspected that the first person Lez ate was a bestowed of the Broker pathway.
unit.target: Hoc audito, Lumian vehementer suspicatus est primum hominem quem Lez edisset esse concessum viae Broker.

unit.source: Perhaps Lez’s restaurant was part of a transaction.
unit.target: Forsitan caupona Lez pars negotii erat.

unit.source: “Yes,” Lez confirmed, “She worshiped the so‐called Truth. When she met my wife, she was still weak.”
unit.target: “Ita,” confirmavit Lez, “Ea quae dicitur Veritas adoravit. Cum uxorem meam convenit, adhuc debilis erat.”

unit.source: As expected… Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Ut exspectabatur… Lumian subridens fuit.

unit.source: The ability to discern who deserves to die is quite useful.
unit.target: Facultas discernendi quis mori mereatur est valde utilis.

unit.source: When I capture a Broker pathway Sequence 7 or higher, I’ll leave it to Ludwig to handle.
unit.target: Cum series viae Broker gradus VII aut superiores capiam, id Ludwig ad gerendum tradam.

unit.source: After finishing the meal Lez prepared, Lumian nodded in satisfaction.
unit.target: Postquam Lez prandium praeparaverat, Lumian satisfactione annuit.

unit.source: “I’m willing to hire you as the chef for this bar.
unit.target: “Paratus sum te conducere ut coquum huius tabernae

unit.source: Let’s discuss your compensation and responsibilities.”
unit.target: de compensatione et officiis tuis colloquamur.”

unit.source: “All right,” Lez said, assuming a listening posture.
unit.target: “Ita,” inquit Lez, se audienti animo parans.

unit.source: Lumian picked up a white napkin and wiped his mouth.
unit.target: Lumian linteolum album sustulit et os suum extergit.

unit.source: “There’s quite a bit of wine left in the cellar.
unit.target: “In cella adhuc multum vini remanet.

unit.source: Clean up the bar, rebuild it, and display the wine.
unit.target: Tabernam purga, eam refice, et vinum exhibe.

unit.source: After that, you’ll be responsible for hiring and managing bartenders and waitstaff, as well as reestablishing contact with suppliers.”
unit.target: Post hoc, tibi incumbet de conducto et administratione tabernariorum et ministrorum, necnon de relatu cum suppeditatoribus restituendo.

unit.source: “That’s the job of a manager,” Lez noted, having run a restaurant before.
unit.target: “Id est munus moderatoris,” inquit Lez, quoniam antea cauponam gerebat.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “Yes, chef and manager.
unit.target: “Ita, coquus et moderator.

unit.source: The bar’s revenue, after costs, will all be yours.”
unit.target: Omnis reditus tabernae, post expensas, tibi erit.

unit.source: “What about you?”
unit.target: “Et quid de te?”

unit.source: Lez had never seen such an owner.
unit.target: Lez talem dominum numquam viderat.

unit.source: Not even wanting the money?
unit.target: Nec pecuniam quidem quaerebat?

unit.source: Lumian stood up, stretching his body, and casually said, “You’ll be responsible for my meals, cleaning my room, and if there are special ingredients, making dishes or cocktails that give me the corresponding traits.
unit.target: Lumian surrexit, corpus extendens, et leve dixit: “Tibi incumbet de meis cibis curare, conclave meum purgare, et, si ingredientia specialia adsunt, fercula aut potiones parare quae mihi proprietates idoneas tribuant.

unit.source: Also, I don’t eat human meat.”
unit.target: Et etiam, carnem humanam non edo.

unit.source: Lez stared at Lumian for a few seconds and said in a deep voice, “You seem to know a lot about a Chef’s abilities.”
unit.target: Lez per paucos momenta Luminum aspexit et voce profunda dixit: “Videtur te multa de facultatibus coquorum scire.”

unit.source: Lumian glanced at the now-stopped rain outside and walked towards the bar’s entrance, smiling.
unit.target: Lumian pluviam, quae iam cessaverat, intuebatur et ad introitum tabernae ambulavit subridens.

unit.source: “The previous owner of this bar was a Depriver, but unfortunately, I deprived him of his life, so he can’t share his culinary skills with you.”
unit.target: “Prior dominus huius tabernae deprivator fuit, sed infeliciter, vitam eius abstuli, ideo artes culinarias suas tibi communicare non potest.”

unit.source: Moreover, my godson is an Angel of your pathway.
unit.target: Praeterea, nepos meus est Angelus viae tuae.

unit.source: Lez fell silent.
unit.target: Lez silentium tenuit.

unit.source: As Lumian was about to leave the bar, he finally spoke, “I’ll take good care of this bar.”
unit.target: Dum Lumian tabernam relinquere parabat, tandem locutus est: “Hanc tabernam bene curabo.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t look back, raising his right hand and waving lightly in acknowledgment.
unit.target: Lumian non respexit, dextram manum levans et leve salutans.

unit.source: There were still some deep pools of water on the street outside, with pedestrians mainly walking on the sidewalks.
unit.target: Extra viam adhuc erant nonnullae profundae aquarum piscinae, cum viatores praesertim in semitis incedebant.

unit.source: The sky was now bright and sunny, as if there hadn’t been a heavy rainstorm.
unit.target: Caelum nunc clarum et serenum erat, quasi imber gravis non fuisset.

unit.source: Following the subtle connection from the contract mark, Lumian walked towards the suspected location of the Abscessed Hand’s head.
unit.target: Secundum subtilissimum nexum ex signo contractus, Lumian ad suspicatum locum capitis “Manus Abscessae” ambulavit.

unit.source: Turning a corner, he saw a drenched corpse lying under a book-engraved obelisk.
unit.target: Angulum vertebat, et vidit cadaver madide permeatum iacere sub obelisco libris insculpto.

unit.source: It was Vijepan, the gloomy rapist-murderer who had been exiled to Morora with Lumian and others.
unit.target: Erat Vijepan, lugubris stuprator et caedator, qui cum Lumiano aliisque in Morora exsulatus erat.

unit.source: At this moment, his hands and feet were severed at the joints, his pants stripped off, and his groin a bloody mess with the most important part missing.
unit.target: In hoc momento, manus et pedes eius ad nodos abscissi erant, bracae eius ablatae, et inguina eius, cum parte maximo deficiente, in sanguine confusa erant.

unit.source: His eyes were wide open, frozen in pain and despair.
unit.target: Oculi eius late patefacti erant, et in dolore atque desperatione immobiliter fixi erant.

unit.source: Lost the duel, huh?
unit.target: Certamen amisisti, nonne?

unit.source: Lumian murmured with a silent laugh.
unit.target: Lumian submurmuravit tacito risu.

unit.source: He almost whistled in admiration for the duel he hadn’t witnessed.
unit.target: Fere sibilavit ex admiratione certaminis, quem non viderat.

unit.source: It must have been exciting; whoever died deserved a toast.
unit.target: Excitans fuisse debuit; qui mortuus erat, poculo honorifico celebrandus erat.

unit.source: Looks like that collector named Julie is stronger…
unit.target: Videtur illa collector, quae “Julie” appellatur, fortior esse…

unit.source: Both she and Vijepan had ulterior motives, no, open intentions to provoke a duel…
unit.target: Et illa et Vijepan ulteriora consilia habebant, immo apertas intentiones certamen provocandi…

unit.source: Lumian thought Julie was likely a Beyonder.
unit.target: Lumian putavit Julie probabiliter Beyonder esse.

unit.source: Such knife skills weren’t something an ordinary person could possess.
unit.target: Tales peritiae cultrorum non erant, quas homo vulgaris possideret.

unit.source: As for whether Vijepan was a Beyonder, Lumian couldn’t tell for now.
unit.target: Quoad utrum Vijepan Beyonder esset, Lumian hoc nunc discernere non potuit.

unit.source: Even if he was, his Beyonder characteristic should have been taken.
unit.target: Etiamsi esset, eius natura Beyonder accipienda fuisse debuit.

unit.source: “That woman is formidable,” a voice suddenly said beside Lumian.
unit.target: “Illa femina formidabilis est,” subito vox iuxta Lumian dixit.

unit.source: A gentleman had come from the side of the small square.
unit.target: Quidam vir ex latere parvae plateae accessit.

unit.source: He wore a half-high silk hat, a white shirt, a cashmere sweater, and a woolen suit jacket, with a bow tie and a cane in hand.
unit.target: Ille habebat pileum sericum semialtum, tunicam albam, pallium cashmiri, et vestimentum laniferum, cum papilione et baculo in manu.

unit.source: He looked just over thirty, with a thin face and gentle blue eyes, like a well-educated upper-class person.
unit.target: Vix triginta annos videbatur, vultu tenuo et oculis caeruleis mitibus, quasi persona nobilis et erudita.

unit.source: Of course, in Morora, there were no good people, only bad people and worse people.
unit.target: Certe, in Morora, nulli boni erant, sed tantum mali et peiores.

unit.source: “Did you see their fight?” Lumian asked casually.
unit.target: “Pugnam eorum vidistine?” inquit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: The gentleman smiled.
unit.target: Vir ille subridens fuit.

unit.source: “They initially wanted to borrow revolvers for a duel from the restaurant over there, but the waiter told them that there were too many duels today and all the guns were borrowed, leaving only two long swords.
unit.target: “Initio revolvera a caupona illa pro duello mutuo capere voluerunt, sed ministrus illis dixit hodie nimium duella esse et omnia arma mutuaria, relinquens solum duas gladios longos.”

unit.source: “That woman was very skilled.
unit.target: “Illa femina valde perita erat.

unit.source: This man blocked three strikes before being knocked down, having his hands and feet cut off, and his pants removed.”
unit.target: Hic vir tres ictus impedivit antequam deiectus esset, manus et pedes eius abscissi, et bracae eius ablatae.

unit.source: So Vijepan wasn’t likely a Beyonder…
unit.target: Itaque Vijepan verisimiliter non erat Beyonder…

unit.source: Lumian shifted his gaze from the corpse to the gentleman and asked with a smile, “What’s your name?”
unit.target: Lumian oculos a cadavero ad virum convertit, subridens, et rogavit: “Quod nomen tibi est?”

unit.source: The gentleman placed a hand on his chest and bowed.
unit.target: Vir manum in pectore posuit et inclinavit.

unit.source: “You can call me Gusain, or Count. I heard you killed Worms?”
