unit.target: “Me vocare potes Gusain, sive Comes. Audivi te Worms interfecisse?”

unit.source: “Worms, the thief?” Lumian laughed.
unit.target: “Worms, fur?” inquit Lumian ridens.

unit.source: “He was struck by lightning, nothing to do with me.
unit.target: “Fulguratus est, nihil ad me pertinet.

unit.source: If I had killed him, the enforcers would have arrested me.”
unit.target: Si eum interfecissem, custodes me arestassent.

unit.source: Gusain smiled slightly.
unit.target: Gusain leviter subridens est.

unit.source: “There are ways to deceive the enforcers.”
unit.target: “Sunt modi custodes decipiendi.”

unit.source: So you’ve noticed their rigidity and procedural nature too?
unit.target: Itaque etiam animadvertisti eorum rigiditatem et proceduralem naturam?

unit.source: Lumian thought for a few seconds before deciding to be “honest.”
unit.target: Lumian per paucos secundos meditatus est, antequam decreveret se “sincerum” esse.

unit.source: “Worms died because he wasn’t lucky enough.
unit.target: “Worms mortuus est, quia non satis fortunatus erat.

unit.source: The item he stole from me attracts lightning during rain.”
unit.target: Res, quam mihi abstulit, tempore pluviae fulgura allicit.

unit.source: “Then you can’t be blamed,” Gusain said understandingly.
unit.target: “Tum ergo te non reprehendi potest,” inquit Gusain.

unit.source: He asked warmly, “How should I address you, and where are you staying now?”
unit.target: Calide quaesivit: “Quomodo te appellare debeam, et ubi nunc residis?”

unit.source: “Louis, staying at the Carnivore bar,” Lumian replied truthfully.
unit.target: “Louis, in taberna Carnivora manens,” respondit Lumian sincere.

unit.source: Gusain nodded slightly.
unit.target: Gusain leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Be wary of Bainar, the bar’s owner and chef. He’s dangerous and cannibalistic.”
unit.target: “Cave Bainar, dominum et coquum tabernae. Is periculosus et anthropophagus est.”

unit.source: Lumian smiled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “He’s already dead.”
unit.target: “Iste iam mortuus est.”

unit.source: Gusain paused for a moment before smiling.
unit.target: Gusain momentanea pausa fecit, deinde subridens.

unit.source: “You’re more interesting than I expected.
unit.target: “Es multo iucundior quam exspectabam,

unit.source: I hope you bring long-lost vitality to Morora.”
unit.target: spero te vitalitatem diu amissam Mororae afferre.”

unit.source: Lumian didn’t continue the topic, instead taking the opportunity to gather information.
unit.target: Lumian rem non continuavit, sed potius occasionem ad notitias colligendas arripuit.

unit.source: “In Morora, apart from Heraberg from the Church of Knowledge, who else should I watch out for?”
unit.target: “In Morora, praeter Heraberg de Ecclesia Scientiae, quem alium observare debeam?”

unit.source: Without hesitation, Gusain replied, “Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company, has a monopoly on the grain supply from the surrounding farms to Morora.
unit.target: Sine mora, Gusain respondit: “Wanak, dominus Societatis Agriculturae Dades, monopolium habet in copia grana ex agris circumfacentibus ad Mororam.”

unit.source: He had become an experimental subject but suddenly escaped and now behaves like a normal person.
unit.target: Factus erat subiectus experimentalis, sed repente effugit et nunc se gerit ut homo ordinarius.

unit.source: He is the most dangerous one in Morora.”
unit.target: Ipse est periculosissimus in Morora.

unit.source: Can someone really return to normal after becoming an experimental subject?
unit.target: Num quis vere ad statum normalem redire potest, postquam subiectus experimentalis factus est?

unit.source: And the Church of Knowledge didn’t do anything about Wanak leaving the experimental group?
unit.target: Et Ecclesia Scientiae nihil fecit de Wanak, discessisse a coetu experimentali?

unit.source: This is exactly what I need…
unit.target: Hoc est exacte quod mihi opus est…

unit.source: Lumian thought to himself and nodded.
unit.target: Lumian sibi ipsi meditabatur et annuit.

unit.source: “Who is the second most dangerous person in Morora?”
unit.target: “Quis est secundus maxime periculosus in Morora?”

unit.source: Gusain’s smile remained unchanged as he answered, “They say it’s me.”
unit.target: Risus Gusain immutatus restabat, cum respondit: “Dicunt me esse.”

unit.source: 799 Provocation
unit.target: 799 Provocatio

unit.source: 799 Provocation
unit.target: 799 Provocatio

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t surprised that Gusain indirectly referred to himself as the second most dangerous person in Morora.
unit.target: Lumian non stupuit quod Gusain, per indirectam referentiam, se nominasset ut secundus inter homines in Morora, qui periculosissimi esse videantur.

unit.source: Instead, he smiled and asked, “What have you done? I mean, what have you done in Morora?”
unit.target: Immo, subridente, rogavit: “Quid fecisti? Id est, quid in Morora fecisti?”

unit.source: Gusain’s smile faded as he spoke seriously.
unit.target: Risus Gusain evanuit dum serio loquebatur.

unit.source: “Organized uprisings.
unit.target: “Insurrectiones ordinavit.

unit.source: “We’re already in the City of Exiles.
unit.target: “Iam sumus in Urbe Exulorum.

unit.source: Why should we still accept the rule of the Church of Knowledge?
unit.target: Cur adhuc regimen Ecclesiae Scientiae accipiamus?

unit.source: We should unite and drive them out of Morora.
unit.target: Uniamur et eos e Morora expellamus.

unit.source: Then, we’ll make our own rules and govern ourselves!”
unit.target: Tum normas nostras constituemus atque nosmetipsos regnabimus!

unit.source: Ignoring other factors, your words do make some sense.
unit.target: Praeter alia, verba tua aliquam rationem habent.

unit.source: But the issue is, if we overthrow the Church’s rule, why stay in Morora?
unit.target: Sed quaestio est: si imperium Ecclesiae deponamus, cur in Morora permaneamus?

unit.source: Is this the influence of 0-01?
unit.target: Numquid haec est vis 0-01?

unit.source: The residents of Morora never consider leaving the city…
unit.target: Incolae Mororae numquam cogitant urbem relinquere.

unit.source: Fortunately, I have a false Angel rank and all sorts of random items, so I’m only somewhat reluctant to leave, not entirely devoid of such thoughts…
unit.target: Fortunate, mihi falsus gradus Angelicus atque varia instrumenta fortuita adsunt, itaque non omnino contra discedendi animum habeo, sed paulum remanentia cogitationum mihi sunt.

unit.source: Lumian first confirmed the abnormalities of Morora from Gusain’s response, then understood why people considered Gusain the second most dangerous person in Morora.
unit.target: Lumian primum, ex responsione Gusain, raritates Mororae comprobavit; deinde intellexit cur homines Gusain ut secundum inter eos, qui maxime periculosi videantur, aestimarent.

unit.source: Uprisings were something the Church of Knowledge wouldn’t allow, and given the information on 0-01, Gusain must have organized multiple uprisings and still hadn’t been caught and added to the experimental subjects!
unit.target: Insurrectiones erant res quas Ecclesia Scientiae non liceret; et ex notitia de 0‑01, Gusain plures insurrectiones ordinasse debuit, neque adhuc captus neque ad subiectos experimentales additus fuit!

unit.source: This was enough to show that this gentleman-like mature man was not simple.
unit.target: Hoc satis fuit ut monstraret virum istum urbanitate indutum non esse simplex.

unit.source: Seeing that Louis wasn’t scared by his words and didn’t show obvious resistance, Gusain extended an invitation, “Would you like to join our group?”
unit.target: Cum videret Ludovicum non verbis eius territum nec repugnantiam manifestam ostendere, Gusain invitationem protulit: “Velisne te in nostrum coetum coniungere?”

unit.source: “I’ll think about it,” Lumian replied with a smile.
unit.target: “Cogitabim,” respondit Lumian subridente.

unit.source: He really intended to consider it.
unit.target: Id revera meditari intendebat.

unit.source: This might be a way to approach 0-01 without becoming an experimental subject.
unit.target: Forsitan haec via sit ad 0‑01 accedendum, ne quidem subiectus experimentalis fias.

unit.source: He believed that this ragtag group, unable to resist the influence of 0-01, couldn’t truly overthrow the Church’s rule in Morora, but he needed chaos and opportunity.
unit.target: Credidit hunc coetum parvum, qui potentiae 0‑01 opponere non posset, regnum Ecclesiae in Morora vere deponi non posse, at chaos atque occasio sibi necessaria esse.

unit.source: These exiles could die, and the Church of Knowledge personnel here seemed to be puppets.
unit.target: Hi exili possent mori, et ministros Ecclesiae Scientiae hic videbantur quasi pupae.

unit.source: Gusain smiled in satisfaction.
unit.target: Gusain pro laetitia subridet.

unit.source: “Being a prisoner in this open‐air prison or becoming its ruler, being perpetually oppressed or pursuing freedom, it indeed requires careful consideration.”
unit.target: “Captivus in hac aperta carceri esse aut eius dominus fieri, sive perpetuo oppressus sive libertatem petens, certe exigit accuratam deliberationem.”

unit.source: With that, Gusain glanced at the other side of the small square and said, “I must take my leave now.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Gusain ad alteram partem parvi fori spectavit et dixit: “Nunc discedere mihi necesse est.

unit.source: If you decide, hang a red cloth, the kind used to taunt bulls, at the door of the Carnivore bar.”
unit.target: Si decernis, ad ostium bar Carnivorum, pannum rubrum––quo tauri ludibrio insuantur––pende!

unit.source: With that, Gusain removed his hat, placed a hand on his chest, and bowed.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Gusain pileum detraxit, manum in pectore posuit, et inclinavit.

unit.source: Watching him walk into a nearby alley at a leisurely pace, Lumian saw a group of black‑robed enforcers hurrying from the opposite side of the small square.
unit.target: Observans eum leniter in vicinam angustam alleam intrantem, Lumian coetum exsecutorum in nigris togatis, ab altera parte parvi fori properantes, vidit.

unit.source: “Did you see Gusain just now?
unit.target: “Vidistine Gusain modo?

unit.source: He looks like a gentleman with a hat,” the leader asked Lumian.
unit.target: “Videtur vir nobilis cum pileo,” inquit dux ad Lumian.

unit.source: Lumian’s smile widened, and he casually pointed to the alley Gusain had entered.
unit.target: Lumian risus suus latius factus est et leviter ad alleam, quam Gusain intravit, indicavit.

unit.source: “Yes, he went that way.”
unit.target: “Ita, eo ivit.”

unit.source: The enforcers stared at Lumian for a couple of seconds before continuing to pursue Gusain.
unit.target: Exsecutores Lumianum per paucos secundos intuebantur, deinde in Gusain insequi perrexerunt.

unit.source: Lumian raised his right hand, rubbed his chin, and murmured to himself.
unit.target: Lumian dextram manum elevavit, mentum fregit, et sibi murmuratum edidit.

unit.source: Gusain sensed the enforcers’ arrival in advance, but I didn’t…
unit.target: Gusain adventum exsecutorum praevidit, sed ego non.

unit.source: Is that why he’s managed to organize multiple uprisings without being caught?
unit.target: Numquid ideo plures insurrectiones ordinare potuit sine captu iri?

unit.source: Is it his ability, an item, or the special corruption from 0-01?
unit.target: Estne id eius facultas, instrumentum, aut corruptio specialis a 0‑01?

unit.source: Lumian didn’t linger in the small square, bidding farewell to Vijepan’s corpse, and continued towards the possible location of the Abscessed Hand’s head.
unit.target: Lumian in parvo foro non moratus est, cadavero Vijepan vale dicens, et iter fecit ad locum possibilem capitis Manus Abscissae.

unit.source: After turning into another street, he suddenly had a premonition and looked towards the edge of the city of Morora.
unit.target: Postquam in aliam viam se convertit, subito praemonitionem sensit et ad limen urbis Mororae conspexit.

unit.source: The ground shook violently, earth and stones surged up, swallowing several buildings and forming a mountain about ten meters high.
unit.target: Terra vehementer tremuit; terra et saxa erupere coierunt, complura aedificia devorantes atque montem circiter decem metris altum formantes.

unit.source: At the mountain’s peak, thick dust mixed with smoke erupted, red lava flowed, emitting heat that Lumian could clearly feel even in the city center.
unit.target: In vertice montis, pulvis densus cum fumo mixtus erupit, lava rubra fluebat et calorem emittens, quem Lumian etiam in media urbe clare sentiebat.

unit.source: At the same time, the screams of humans from that direction echoed far and wide.
unit.target: Simul, ex illa parte clamor hominum longe et late resonabat.

unit.source: A volcanic eruption?
unit.target: Erupitio vulcanica?

unit.source: Lumian was stunned.
unit.target: Lumian stupefactus est.

unit.source: He had thought the volcanic eruptions described in the 0-01 information came from the surrounding mountains, not from within the city on flat ground!
unit.target: Existimaverat eruptiones vulcanicas, ut in notitia de 0‑01 enarratae, ex circumstantibus montibus provenire, non ex ipsa urbe super plano terræ!

unit.source: After a few seconds, the dust obscured the sky, plunging Morora back into darkness.
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, pulvis caelum obscuravit, Mororam iterum in tenebras mergens.

unit.source: Passersby showed no extra reaction, merely covering their noses to block the dust, treating it as just another heavy rain.
unit.target: Viatores nullam reactionem extra ostenderunt; tantum nares tegentes ut pulverem obtexerent, eum tanquam aliam immanem pluviam considerantes.

unit.source: Lumian shook his head as he watched.
unit.target: Lumian caput concussit dum spectabat.

unit.source: In such living conditions, Gusain and his people hadn’t thought of escaping, only planning to overthrow the Church’s rule and replace it.
unit.target: In talibus condicionibus, Gusain et collegae eius non de effugiendo cogitaverunt, sed tantum regnum Ecclesiae deponere atque eum subvertire statuere conspexerunt.

unit.source: No wonder this is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact…
unit.target: Non mirum est hoc esse Artificium Sigillatum Gradus 0…

unit.source: Lumian, who restored himself at six every morning, remained unafraid of the dust and resumed his steps.
unit.target: Lumian, qui omni mane hora sexta se restituebat, pulveri non timens iter suum continuavit.

unit.source: He crossed the street and arrived at a square with multiple obelisks.
unit.target: Viam transiit et ad forum cum pluribus obeliscis pervenit.

unit.source: In the dusty environment, he moved along the buildings around the square towards his destination.
unit.target: In ambitu pulvereo, iuxta aedificia forum circumjacentia versus destinatum suum movit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he felt a resonance, a connection from his special powers.
unit.target: Subito, sensus ei venit resonantia, nexus ex potentia speciali sua.

unit.source: Lumian quickly turned and looked at the classical building made of gray‑white stones beside him.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter se vertit et aspexit aedificium classicum ex lapidibus albo–griseis iuxta se positum.

unit.source: At the top hung a large sign with words written in Lenburg: Dades Agricultural Company
unit.target: In vertice pendentem magna tabula verbis in Lingua Lenburgensi scribitis pendebat: Dades Agricultural Company.

unit.source: Below the sign, two glass windows suddenly opened, revealing a figure.
unit.target: Sub tabula, duo fenestrae vitreae subito apertae sunt, figuram revelantes.

unit.source: The figure, wearing a thin white shirt with the top two buttons undone despite the cold winter, had hair like it was stained with fresh blood, iron‑black eyes, and sharp facial features, exuding a fierce aura.
unit.target: Figura, induta tenue alba tunica cum duobus nodis supremos solutis, nondum frigido hieme impediente, capillos quasi recenti sanguine tinctos, oculos ferreos nigrissimos, et lineamenta acuta habebat, aura ferocia effundens.

unit.source: No introduction was needed; Lumian identified the figure from the sign and the resonating aura.
unit.target: Nulla introductio necessaria fuit; Lumian figuram ex signo et aura resonante intellexit.

unit.source: The most dangerous criminal in Morora, former experimental subject Wanak!
unit.target: Criminalis periculosissimus in Morora, pristinus subiectus experimentalis, Wanak!

unit.source: Did the resonance just now come from the direct corruption of 0‑01?
unit.target: Num resonantia modo ex corruptione directa 0‑01 orta est?

unit.source: Did the law of convergence lead to this encounter?
unit.target: Num lex convergenceis hanc congressionem induxit?

unit.source: Did Wanak escape the status of an experimental subject because he completely submitted to 0‑01?
unit.target: Num Wanak effugere statum subiecti experimentalis potuit, quia penitus 0‑01 se subiecit?

unit.source: Is he now 0‑01’s proxy in Morora?
unit.target: Num nunc in Morora pro 0‑01 fungitur?

unit.source: This Sealed Artifact, despite lacking wisdom, instinctively seeks opportunities to break free from its seal?
unit.target: Hic Artificium Sigillatum, quamvis sapientia careat, instinctive occasiones quaerit ut sigillum suum rumpat?

unit.source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, the suspected Wanak suddenly transformed into a blazing‑white flame spear, filled with destructive energy, and flew at him.
unit.target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani conflaebant, Wanak, qui suspectus erat, subito in hastam flammae candidae refulgens, energia destructiva plena, transformatus est et in eum volavit.

unit.source: Lumian’s figure instantly disappeared without reappearing.
unit.target: Figura Lumiani statim evanuit, sine se iterum ostendendo.

unit.source: He directly teleported closer to the Abscessed Hand’s head.
unit.target: Statim se translatus est propius ad caput Manus Abscissae.

unit.source: In his ears echoed the taunting voice of the suspected Wanak, “Coward! Chicken!”
unit.target: In auribus eius resonabat vox irridea: “Ignavus! Gallina!”

unit.source: Lumian snorted, not turning back to fight the man.
unit.target: Lumian sufflavit, neque se convertere ad virum pugnandum ausus est.

unit.source: “I’ll first gather the Abscessed Hand’s body!”
unit.target: “Primum corpus Manus Abscissae colligam!”

unit.source: He feared the intense battle might lead to unforeseen events, making contact with 0‑01 before he collected all the body parts, resulting in uncontrollable consequences.
unit.target: Timebat vehementem proelium ad eventus inattenditos ducere, quia 0‑01 contingere posset antequam omnia corpora congregeret, unde consequentiae incontrollabiles oriuntur.

unit.source: Moreover, the aura and the flame spear the suspected Wanak displayed suggested he might have a trace of godhood.
unit.target: Praeterea, aura et hasta flammae quam Wanak suspectus ostendit indicabant eum deitate aliquam vestigium habere.

unit.source: Even if not truly Sequence 4, he had fundamentally differed from a Sequence 5 Beyonder.
unit.target: Etiamsi non vere esset Series IV, radicitus ab Series V Beyonder se distinguebatur.

unit.source: Demigods couldn’t approach 0‑01, but maybe pseudo‑demigod proxies created by 0‑01 weren’t subject to this rule!
unit.target: Semidei ad 0‑01 appropinquare non poterant, sed fortasse pseudo‑semidei representantes, a 0‑01 creati, huic regulae non subiecti erant!

unit.source: Lumian looked ahead, finding himself in the boundless cemetery behind the Church of Knowledge, surrounded by gravestones and trees.
unit.target: Lumian ante se aspexit et se in coemeterio immensissimo post Ecclesiam Scientiae invenit, lapidibus sepulcralibus et arboribus circumdatum.

unit.source: Uh… Lumian was momentarily stunned, then felt it made sense.
unit.target: Heu… Lumian per momentum stupefactus est, deinde sensit se id intellegere posse.

unit.source: The bar owner‑cum‑chef having half of the Abscessed Hand’s body and using it was an anomaly.
unit.target: Tabernarius atque coquus, qui dimidium corporis Manus Abscissae haberet atque illud uti solebat, anomalia erat.

unit.source: Normally, anyone, even a felon, encountering a rotting corpse split into multiple parts would first call the enforcers to clean up the scene.
unit.target: Normaliter, quisquis—even sceleratus—qui cadaver putrescens in plura partes divisum incideret, primum exsecutores vocaret ut locum purgarent.

unit.source: The enforcers would then bury the body in this cemetery as part of the seal.
unit.target: Exsecutores deinde corpus in hoc coemeterio sepelirent ut pars sigillamenti.

unit.source: Of course, this was a normal assumption, excluding those with a penchant for corpses.
unit.target: Certe, hoc erat prorsus opinio communis, exceptis illis qui cadaveribus studiosi erant.

unit.source: Lumian moved forward, approaching the source of the subtle connection.
unit.target: Lumian procedebat, ad fontem subtilis nexus appropinquare conatus.

unit.source: During this, he remembered something.
unit.target: Interea aliquid meminit.

unit.source: Madam Magician said dangerous things might happen once the Abscessed Hand’s body is gathered.
unit.target: Magistra Magician dixit res periculosas evenire posse, cum corpus Manus Abscissae congregabitur.

unit.source: It’s best to complete this step within the City of Exiles to offset the corresponding risks with the presence of 0‑01…
unit.target: Optimum est hunc gradum intra Urbem Exulorum conficere, ut pericula correspondentia cum praesentia 0‑01 compensentur.

unit.source: If I get the Hand Bro’s head later, does that count as gathering the body?
unit.target: Si postea caput Hand Bro obtineam, idne censetur corpus congregare?

unit.source: Will that cause dangerous events?
unit.target: Num id res periculosas eveniet?

unit.source: Maybe I should wait a bit longer?
unit.target: Forsitan paulo diutius exspectare debeam?

unit.source: Wait for dangerous and difficult‑to‑handle situations before teleporting back to gather Hand Bro’s body to create unknown risks and muddy the waters?
unit.target: Exspecta res periculosas atque difficillimas ad tractandum, priusquam teletransportatione redeas ad corpus Hand Bro colligendum, ut pericula ignota creentur et res confundantur.

unit.source: I can’t face the dangers of the Hand Bro alone; sharing is caring…
unit.target: Non possum solus pericula Hand Bro tolerare; communitas enim auxilium praebet.

unit.source: Also, Madam Magician implied that the Hand Bro might break the seal and enter Morora once its body is gathered?
unit.target: Item, Magistra Magician insinuabat quod Hand Bro sigillum rumpere atque in Morora introiret, cum corpus eius congregaretur.

unit.source: Otherwise, how could it be considered complete…
unit.target: Aliter, quomodo id censeri completum posset…

unit.source: Normally, not even a messenger can be summoned, nor a contract creature…
unit.target: Normaliter, neque nuntius quidem evocari potest, nec creatura contracta.

unit.source: This might help me escape Morora…
unit.target: Hoc me forsitan adiuvabit ut Morora effugiam.

unit.source: As Lumian pondered, he stopped at a recently filled pit without a tombstone.
unit.target: Dum Lumian meditabat, subsistit ad puteum nuper impletum sine lapide sepulcrali.

unit.source: His contract mark told him a part of the Abscessed Hand’s body was in this pit.
unit.target: Notatio contractus eius indicavit ei partem corporis Manus Abscissae in hoc puteo esse.

unit.source: Seeing the unusually fresh marks on the pit’s surface, Lumian felt a tightness in his chest.
unit.target: Videns vestigia insolitè recens in superficie putei, Lumian angorem in pectore sensit.

unit.source: He crouched down, extended his hands, and performed a directional blast.
unit.target: Se inclinavit, manus extendit, et impetum directum inieci.

unit.source: With the rumbling sound of explosions, he blew away a large amount of soil and unearthed a black wooden box from the bottom of the pit.
unit.target: Cum rugitu explosionum, magnam terræ copiam evellit et arcam ligneam nigram ex fundo putei extraxit.

unit.source: Opening the box, Lumian saw a highly decomposed, blue‑black, swollen ear and a folded white paper.
unit.target: Arcam aperiens, Lumian vidit auriculam valde corruptam, caeruleo‑nigrum et tumidam, atque chartam album plicatam.

unit.source: Lumian unfolded the paper, seeing words written in Intisian:
unit.target: Lumian chartam explicavit, et verba in lingua Intisiana scripta vidit:

unit.source: “As expected, you want this rotten head.
unit.target: “Ut expectatum est, hoc caput putridum vis.

unit.source: “But unfortunately, I got it before you went to the Carnivore bar and hid it.
unit.target: “Sed, pro dolor, id accepi antequam ad bar Carnivorum accederes et occulteres.

unit.source: “Maybe you can ask me for it.
unit.target: “Forsitan id a me petere possis.

unit.source: “Albus Medici.”
unit.target: “Albus Medici.”

unit.source: 800 New Waitress
unit.target: 800 Nova Opsaria

unit.source: 800 New Waitress
unit.target: 800 Nova Opsaria

unit.source: Lumian admitted that he felt a bit provoked.
unit.target: Lumian agnovit se paulum provocatum sensisse.

unit.source: However, it was still acceptable.
unit.target: Tamen id adhuc acceptum erat.

unit.source: If his guess was right, he and Albus would eventually cross paths again regarding 0-01.
unit.target: Si coniectura eius recta esset, ille et Albus tandem de 0-01 occurrerent.

unit.source: It was better for the Abscessed Hand’s head to be in Albus’s possession than lost or hidden by some unknown person.
unit.target: Melius fuit caput Manus Abscessae in possessione Albī esse quam ab aliquo ignoto amitteri aut celari.

unit.source: Lumian now regretted not acting against Albus at the Carnivore Bar.
unit.target: Lumian nunc paenitebat se contra Album in Tabernā Carnivorā non egisse.

unit.source: He had hesitated and wanted to use him.
unit.target: Dubitavit et eum uti vellebat.

unit.source: At that time, it was hard to predict that Albus had already obtained the Abscessed Hand’s head.
unit.target: Illo tempore difficillimum erat praedicere Album iam caput Manus Abscessae adeptum esse.

unit.source: Silently, Lumian activated the black mark representing Spirit World Traversal, sensing the subtle connection between himself and the Abscessed Hand’s body parts again.
unit.target: Tacite, Lumian signum nigrum, quod Transitum Mundi Spiritorum repraesentabat, activavit, denuo tenuem nexum inter se et partes corporis Manus Abscessae sentiens.

unit.source: He intended to use this to find Albus.
unit.target: Hoc uti vellebat ut Album inveniret.

unit.source: The feedback is all similar, no way to distinguish which is stronger, which might be Hand Bro’s head…
unit.target: Responsa omnia similia sunt, nec ullo modo distingui potest qui fortior sit, quem fortasse "Hand Bro" caput habeat…

unit.source: Did Albus do something to suppress the feedback?
unit.target: Num Albus quid fecit ut responsa reprimarentur?

unit.source: Or completely block it?
unit.target: An omnino ea obstrueret?

unit.source: Lumian slowly exhaled, taking the Abscessed Hand’s ear from the black wooden box and placing it in his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian lente suspiravit, auriculam Manus Abscessae e nigra lignea arca sumens et in saccum Viatoris ponens.

unit.source: He carefully examined the area around the grave, hoping to find clues to Albus’s whereabouts.
unit.target: Cautissime circum sepulcrum perspexit, sperans vestigia de loco Albī invenire.

unit.source: Unfortunately, Albus was also an experienced Hunter, very adept at covering his tracks.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Albus quoque venator peritus erat, valde callidus in vestigia sua celanda.

unit.source: Containing his emotions, Lumian turned back to the Carnivore Bar amidst the dust and clouds from the volcanic eruption.
unit.target: Affectōs suos retinēns, Lumian ad Tabernam Carnivoram rediit, inter pulverem et nubes ex eruptione volcanica.

unit.source: As he stepped through the door, Lez, the human cook, who had found some wood to repair the shelves and bar counter, stopped working, hammer in hand, and turned to him.
unit.target: Cum per ostium intraret, Lez, coquus humanus, qui lignum ad reparanda plutea et mensam tabernae invenit, operam destitit, malleum in manu tenens, et ad eum se convertit.

unit.source: “I hired a waitress.”
unit.target: «Opsariam conduxi.»

unit.source: “You can decide on that yourself,” Lumian said, uninterested in the bar’s operation.
unit.target: «Tu ipse de hoc decerne», inquit Lumian, negotium tabernae non curans.

unit.source: He only cared about getting three meals and free lodging under the guise of being the boss.
unit.target: Nihil aliud eum curabat, nisi tribus cibis et hospitio gratuito sub specie praepositi obtinere.

unit.source: Lez, ever diligent, added, “You know her.
unit.target: Lez, semper diligens, addidit: «Ipsam nosti.»

unit.source: Julie, who came in with us.”
unit.target: Illa Iulia, quae nobiscum accessit.

unit.source: The “collector”?
unit.target: «Collector?»

unit.source: Lumian almost choked on his own saliva.
unit.target: Lumian paene saliva sua obstrictus est.

unit.source: Why would a man hire such a “collector” as a waitress?
unit.target: Cur vir talem "collector" ut opsariam conducat?

unit.source: Won’t he feel a chill down there?
unit.target: Numquid non sentiet frigus intus?

unit.source: Before Lumian could ask Lez’s reasoning, Julie descended from upstairs.
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian Lez rationem quaereret, Iulia de superiore descendit.

unit.source: She had changed into a dark slit dress she found from somewhere, with her chest barely concealed under a thin veil.
unit.target: Induta erat veste obscura scissilis, quam alicubi repperat, cum pectore vix sub tenue velamine celato.

unit.source: Her previously dirty face was now clean, and her long brown hair was simply tied up, her features clear in Lumian’s eyes.
unit.target: Vultus eius, quondam sordidus, nunc mundus erat, et capilli longi fusci simpliciter coniuncti erant, cum lineamenta in oculis Lumiani perspicua esse videbantur.

unit.source: Despite having been around two Demonesses for a long time, Lumian found himself impressed.
unit.target: Quamquam diu cum duabus demonessīs fuerat, Lumian se admiratum sensit.

unit.source: This female convict didn’t look perverse or mad, with slender brown eyebrows and brown eyes that seemed to hold a gentle autumn water, her skin delicate and white, her demeanor gentle and elegant, contrasting sharply with her enticing figure.
unit.target: Haec convicta mulier neque perversa neque insanā videbatur, cum superciliis fuscīs tenuissimis et oculīs fuscīs, quae quasi aquam autumnalem lenem retinebant, cutē tenerā ac albā, habitū miti et elegantī, prorsus contrā figuram venustam ostentantī.

unit.source: She was a uniquely beautiful woman, exuding an allure beyond normal.
unit.target: Illa erat mulier singulariter pulchra, allicitāte extraordināriā evidenter ostenta.

unit.source: Like a Demoness…
unit.target: Velut demonessa…

unit.source: Lumian had to admit Julie’s previous disguise with dirt and loose hair was quite effective.
unit.target: Lumian agnoscere debuit praeviam Iuliae larvam, cum sordibus et capillis solutīs, satis efficacem fuisse.

unit.source: Another case of the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence…
unit.target: Alius casus Legis Convergence Characterum Beyonder…

unit.source: Lumian sighed, responding to Julie’s tender, affectionate gaze, “Why do you want to be a waitress at my bar?”
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, ad tenerum et amantem Iuliae conspectum respondens: «Cur vis esse opsaria in mea tabernā?»

unit.source: “I need a job to support myself,” Julie smiled gently, as if they were in some city instead of Morora.
unit.target: «Opus mihi est ad me sustentandum», inquit Iulia leniter subridens, quasi in aliqua urbe potius quam in Morora essent.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly changed the topic.
unit.target: Lumian repente rem mutavit.

unit.source: “Why do you like collecting that part of men?”
unit.target: «Cur amas colligere illam partem virōrum?»

unit.source: Julie’s gentle brown eyes suddenly showed an indescribable madness.
unit.target: Oculi fuscī miti Iuliae subito insanitatem inenarrābilem ostenderunt.

unit.source: She smiled and answered with a tone of longing, “I just want to reclaim what’s mine.”
unit.target: Subridens respondit: «Mihi solum restituere id quod meum est volo.»

unit.source: Uh… another victim of the Demoness Sect?
unit.target: Heu… alia victima Sectae Demonessārum?

unit.source: Now turned perpetrator…
unit.target: Nunc facta est perpetratrix…

unit.source: She must have transformed from a man to a woman like Franca, but unlike Franca, she had severe psychological issues, resulting in her abnormal hobby?
unit.target: Forte a viro ad feminam, sicut Franca, conversa est; sed, contrā Franca, graves perturbationes psychologicae habuit, quae in eius insolitum studium versa sunt?

unit.source: Lumian guessed while confirming that Julie was likely a Demoness, and not a low-level one, at least a Sequence 6 Demoness of Pleasure.
unit.target: Lumian coniectavit, firmans Iuliam verisimiliter esse demonessam, neque ex gradibus inferioribus sed saltem Demonessam Voluptātis Sequenciae VI.

unit.source: Lumian then murmured, Your way of digesting Pleasure is to rape men and then cut it off at the climax to make them experience the fall from heaven to hell?
unit.target: Tum Lumian murmurat: «Vestra via voluptatem percipiendi est: viros stuprare atque in culmine abscindere, ut lapsum de caelo in inferos experiantur?»

unit.source: That fits the nature of a Demoness of Pleasure, but it’s too direct and brutal, lacking the beauty of self-struggle…
unit.target: Id naturae Demonessae Voluptātis convenit, sed nimis directe atque crudelis est, carens pulchritūdine certamīnī sui ipsius.

unit.source: How did the Church of Knowledge send a Demoness here as an ordinary rapist-murderer?
unit.target: Quomodo Ecclesia Scientiā demonessam hic misit ut vulgaris raptatrix et homicida sit?

unit.source: Was it intentional?
unit.target: Num id intente factum est?

unit.source: Right, based on my current mysticism knowledge, each god’s pathway top has one to three great beings holding all the sequence powers, like Mr. Fool, The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Great Mother, and the Mother Tree of Desire…
unit.target: Recte, ex mea hodiernā mysticā scientiā, cuique deī semita summā unum ad tria ingentia entia habet, quae omnes vires sequentiae tenent, ut, exempli grātiā, Dominus Stultus, Dignus Caelestis Caeli et Terrae ad Benedictionēs, Magna Mater, et Mater Arbōr Desideriī…

unit.source: From this perspective, the Primordial Demoness-being adjacent to the Hunter pathway—trying to scheme 0-01—is understandable, perhaps inevitable.
unit.target: Ex hoc prospectū, entitas demonessae prīmordialis, ad viam venatoris proxima, quae 0-01 machinari conatur, intellectibilis est, fortasse inevitabilis.

unit.source: According to Madam Magician, 0-01 is the key to ascending to Red Priest and becoming the true god of the Hunter pathway…
unit.target: Secundum Dominae Magicae, 0-01 clavis est ad ascensum ad Sacrum Rubrum et ad verum deum viae Venatoris efficiendum.

unit.source: In this case, once the Demoness Sect discovers Morora, they will definitely send witches below the demigod level to infiltrate here…
unit.target: In hoc casu, cum Secta Demonessārum Mororam detegat, certe maleficae infra gradum semideī mittentur ut huc se infiltrent.

unit.source: Why didn’t they send anyone before, waiting until Julie and I were exiled together?
unit.target: Cur ante non misere aliquem, exspectantes usque dum Iulia et ego simul exularemur?

unit.source: Perhaps the Primordial Demoness’s revelation told them only by following me could they enter Morora, given I was specially sent by the Church of Knowledge without any checks?
unit.target: Forsitan revelātiō demonessae prīmordialis eis indicavit quod me sequi tantum poterent Mororam intrāre, quoniam a Ecclesiā Scientiā specialiter sine ullīs censūrīs missus essem.

unit.source: No, more likely, Julie isn’t the first or even the second Demoness to infiltrate Morora.
unit.target: Minime, verisimilē Iulia non est prima neque secunda demonessa Mororam infiltrāns.

unit.source: The previous ones didn’t complete their mission and gradually lost contact with the Demoness Sect…
unit.target: Priores suam missionem non confecerunt et paulatim contactum cum Secta Demonessārum amiserunt.

unit.source: If that’s true, the Demonesses controlling the mirror world have it easier than me using the Mirror Cufflink and Mirror Mark to connect with the outside.
unit.target: Si id verum est, demonessae, quæ mundum speculī regunt, facilius habent quam ego, qui fibulam speculī et signum speculī ad externam connexiōnem utor.

unit.source: Julie must have a lot of accumulated intelligence and plans…
unit.target: Iulia multam intelligentiam et consilia congregavit.

unit.source: From her, I might find opportunities and ways to approach 0-01 and leave a mark…
unit.target: Ex ea fortasse occasiones et modos inveniam ad 0-01 accedendum atque signum relinquendum.

unit.source: With these thoughts, Lumian smiled at Julie, who still had a hint of madness in her eyes, “I don’t care what you want to reclaim or why, but since you chose to be my bar’s waitress, you must follow my rules.
unit.target: His cogitātiōnibus his, Lumian Iuliae, quae adhūc levem insanitātis umbram in oculīs habebat, subridens dixit: «Non curo quid restituere velis aut cur, sed quoniam elegistī esse opsariam in mea tabernā, regulās meas sequi dēbēs.»

unit.source: First, no harassing customers during business hours.”
unit.target: Primum, nāllōs clientes in horīs negotii vexāre.

unit.source: Julie looked a bit aggrieved but her eyes shone brightly, full of anticipation.
unit.target: Iulia paulo delūsā videbātur, sed oculī eius splendide fulgebant, plēnī exspectātiōne.

unit.source: “What if they harass me?”
unit.target: «Quid, sī me vexent?»

unit.source: “Lez will throw them out.
unit.target: «Lez eōs expellat.

unit.source: If they dare fight back, Lez knows how to cook them and will leave you the parts you want,” Lumian said casually.
unit.target: Sī ausi fuerint repugnāre, Lez novit quōmode eōs coquāt et partes quās vēlīs tibi relinquet, inquit Lumian leviter.

unit.source: “Or you can wait until the bar closes and find them yourself.”
unit.target: «Aut potes exspectāre donec taberna claudātur, et ipsōs invenīre.»

unit.source: Julie licked her lips.
unit.target: Iulia labia sua lambit.

unit.source: “What’s the second rule?”
unit.target: «Quae est secunda regula?»

unit.source: “No harassing the boss.”
unit.target: «Noli dominum molestāre.»

unit.source: Lumian headed for the stairs to the second floor.
unit.target: Lumian ad scalās tabulati secundi accessit.

unit.source: “Lez will discuss your pay.”
unit.target: «Lez de mercedā tua disputābit.»

unit.source: Julie seemed slightly disappointed.
unit.target: Iulia paulo delūsā videbātur.

unit.source: “I wanted to see if what I lost is with you.”
unit.target: «Volebam vidēre utrum id, quod amīserim, apud tē sit.»

unit.source: Before Lumian could respond, she asked again, “Is it harassment if I invite you to view my collection?”
unit.target: Priusquam Lumian responderet, illa iterum rogāvit: «Num molestātiō est, sī tē invītāverim ut collectionem meam videās?»

unit.source: “Not interested,” Lumian replied curtly.
unit.target: «Non interest», respondit Lumian breviter.

unit.source: He confirmed Julie’s crimes weren’t intentional to get exiled to Morora.
unit.target: Confirmavit crīmina Iuliae non esse intentāta ut exulāretur in Mororam.

unit.source: She had a genuine hobby, looking gentle and beautiful but twisted and mad inside.
unit.target: Habebat studium verum, exterius lenis et pulchra, sed intus corrupta et insanabilis.

unit.source: After dark, Julie finished Lez’s meticulously prepared dinner and praised it, “I’ve decided to seduce you last.”
unit.target: Post vespērum, Iulia cēnam Lez diligenter paratam consummāvit et laudāvit: «Decisī tē ultīma sedūcere.»

unit.source: Her seduction was lethal.
unit.target: Sedūctiō eius letālēs erat.

unit.source: Lez seemed a bit disappointed but sincerely asked, “If you’re ever killed, can I have your body?”
unit.target: Lez paulum delūsus videbātur, sed sincēre rogāvit: «Sī umquam interficieris, possumne corpus tuum accipere?»

unit.source: “Sure,” Julie agreed nonchalantly, her movements graceful and smile reserved.
unit.target: «Certe», inquit Iulia noncuranter, cum motibus gratiīs et risū retinūtō.

unit.source: She then looked at Lumian, blinking.
unit.target: Deinde ad Lumian respexit, palpebris micantibus.

unit.source: “Boss, the bar hasn’t reopened. Can I go out tonight?”
unit.target: «Domine, taberna non iterum aperta est. Possumne hac nocte eīre?»

unit.source: “That’s your freedom.”
unit.target: «Libertās tua est.»

unit.source: Lumian drank some wheat ale to suppress the sudden restlessness inside him.
unit.target: Lumian triticeum aleum bibit ut submoveret subitānem internam inquietūdinem.

unit.source: He was now sure Julie was a Demoness of Affliction, having just used Charm on him.
unit.target: Iam certus erat Lumian Iuliam esse demonessam Afflictionis, quoniam ea modo ei fascinum usus esset.

unit.source: If she approached again, he planned to Cull her without mercy.
unit.target: Si illa iterum appropinquaret, eam sine misericordia caedere statuavit.

unit.source: Only by intimidating this Demoness of Affliction with strength and ferocity could he keep her in check.
unit.target: Solum per minas et ferocitātem huius Demonessae Afflictionis eam intimidando potuit eam coercere.

unit.source: Julie wiped her mouth with a white napkin, stood up, and left the Carnivore Bar.
unit.target: Iulia os suum mappā albā abstulit, surrexit, et Tabernam Carnivoram reliquit.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lumian vanished from the table.
unit.target: Post paucās secundās, Lumian e mensā evanuit.

unit.source: He first teleported then turned into a shadow creature, silently following Julie.
unit.target: Primum se teleportavit, deinde in creatūram umbrātam mutātus, tacite Iuliam secūtus.

unit.source: Julie walked elegantly, approaching a square where exiles gathered, feigning drunkenness.
unit.target: Iulia elegānter ambulavit, ad forum accedens, ubi exulī congregābantur, ebriētā simulāns.

unit.source: The exiles couldn’t take their eyes off this Demoness.
unit.target: Exulī oculōs ab hac demonessa non abstrahere poterant.

unit.source: A muscular man eagerly approached and chatted with Julie.
unit.target: Vir musculosus alacriter accessit et cum Iulia colloquium habuit.

unit.source: Julie drunkenly waggled her finger.
unit.target: Iulia ebrius digitum suum undulavit.

unit.source: “I want to duel you.”
unit.target: «Te ad certamen provocāre volo.»

unit.source: “Sure,” the man said joyfully, helping Julie leave for his home.
unit.target: «Certe», inquit vir laete, adiuvāns Iulia ad suam domum proficīscī.

unit.source: The other exiles didn’t react in time, losing sight of the two.
unit.target: Ceterī exulī nōn tempore responserunt, duo ex conspectū amittens.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t lose track, hiding outside the man’s window.
unit.target: Lumian cursum nōn amisit, extra fenestram viri se occultāvit.

unit.source: He heard Julie’s kitten-like moans, unlike the rough madness he imagined.
unit.target: Audivit gemitus Iuliae, velut catuli, non similes aspera insanitāte quam imagināverat.

unit.source: With an Ascetic’s endurance, Lumian showed no abnormality until the man shouted loudly, nearing climax.
unit.target: Cum tolerantiā ascēticā, Lumian nihil insolitum ostendit, donec vir magnopere clamāvit, apicem appropinquāns.

unit.source: The next second, a piercing scream of intense pain erupted from the room.
unit.target: Secundo post, stridens clamor intensī doloris ex conclāvi erupit.

unit.source: Soon, Julie emerged, face flushed, eyes bright, her beauty overwhelming.
unit.target: Mox Iulia apparuit, facie rubicundā, oculīs nitidīs, et pulchritūdine sua imponentē praevalentī.

unit.source: She held a bloody object, freezing it in crystal-clear ice, placing it in a small bag.
unit.target: Tenebat obiectum sanguinolentum, quod in glaciē crystallinā perspicuā congelāvit et in parvō sacculō posuit.

unit.source: Lumian continued following Julie, who didn’t attempt any counter-surveillance, arriving at the large square outside the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Lumian Iuliam persequi continuāvit, quae ullam speculārem repugnātiōnis temptāre nōn conāta est, ad magnam plateam extra Ecclesiam Scientiā perveniens.

unit.source: She seemed to be waiting for something.
unit.target: Videbātur aliquid exspectāre.

unit.source: After a while, a team of black-robed enforcers emerged from the church, led by a tall, fair-skinned, restrained, beautiful woman.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, cohors coercitōrum in vestībus nigrīs ex Ecclesiā processit, ducta ā muliere altā, candida, temperāta, et pulchrā.

unit.source: Julie’s eyes lit up, her face glowing with joy.
unit.target: Oculī Iuliae exstārērunt, et facies eius laetitiā fulgebat.

unit.source: She approached the enforcers excitedly, shouting at the leader, “Celeste!”
unit.target: Illa coercitōrēs exsultāns appropinquāvit, ducī clamāns: «Celeste!»

unit.source: The tall woman in the black robe glanced at Julie indifferently, asking emotionlessly, “Who are you?”
unit.target: Mulier alta in veste nigrā Iuliae indifferenter aspexit, rogāns sine affectū: «Quis es tū?»

unit.source: Julie’s expression froze.
unit.target: Vultus Iuliae immobilis factus est.

unit.source: 801 Pretending
unit.target: 801 Simulatio

unit.source: 801 Pretending
unit.target: 801 Simulatio

unit.source: Seeing Julie remain silent, the black‑robed female enforcer led her team across the square, continuing their patrol of Morora.
unit.target: Videns Julie silentem manere, custos veste nigra induta, turmam suam per forum duxit, dum Mororam peragabat.

unit.source: Julie stood there, staring at her back, as if turned to stone.
unit.target: Julie illic stetit, tergum suum intuens, quasi in lapidem conversam.

unit.source: Hidden in the shadows, Lumian watched silently, musing to himself, “An old lover?”
unit.target: In umbris celatus, Lumian silentiose observabat et sibi ipsi cogitabat: “An antiquus amator?”

unit.source: That enforcer had a certain Demoness‑like charm…
unit.target: Illa custos aliquam venustatem daemonissae similem habebat…

unit.source: Was she the last Demoness to infiltrate Morora, Julie’s lover, but ultimately became an experimental subject and forgot her past?
unit.target: Num ipsa ultima daemonissa fuerat quae Mororam infiltravit, amatrix Juliae, sed tandem facta sit subiecta experimentali et praeteritum suum oblita?

unit.source: Yes, the Knowledge Cathedral’s Heraberg mentioned that in Morora, the past isn’t important, only the present and future matter.
unit.target: Ita, Heraberg Cathedrali Cognitionis notum fecit quod in Morora praeteritum non valet, sed solum praesens ac futurum momentum habent.

unit.source: Is this implying that after becoming an experimental subject or spending enough time here, ties to the past will gradually disappear, even memories can’t be retained?
unit.target: Num hoc insinuat quod, postquam subiecta experimentali facta vel tempus hic satis transactum erit, vincula praeteriti paulatim evanescere, ne memoria quidem retineantur?

unit.source: This is somewhat like the people who disappeared in Trier’s catacombs, who were forgotten by everyone who knew them, but the effect is opposite and not as strong…
unit.target: Hoc est simile illis hominibus qui in catacumbis Trier evanuerunt, ab omnibus eos qui eos noverant obliti, sed effectus eorum est oppositus et non tam validus…

unit.source: Lumian felt he understood Julie’s emotions better now.
unit.target: Lumian sensit se nunc melius intellexisse affectus Juliae.

unit.source: She might have willingly taken on the task of infiltrating Morora, hoping to find and rescue her lover, only to discover her lover had completely forgotten her, not betraying her but simply not remembering who she is…
unit.target: Fortasse illa libenter munus suscepit Mororam infiltrandi, sperans amatricem suam invenire atque servare, tantum ut comperiret amatricem suam se omnino oblitam esse – non prodidisse, sed simpliciter non meminisse quis ipsa esset…

unit.source: Besides the two untainted Demonesses around me, there’s actually another who believes in true love…
unit.target: Praeter duas daemonissas sine macula circa me, revera altera est quae verum amorem credit…

unit.source: Julie must have another purpose in seeking Celeste, confirming her situation, obtaining untransmitted information, and perhaps items prepared for seizing 0-01…
unit.target: Illa certe aliam causam habere debet qua Celestem quaerit, condicionem suam confirmans, informationes nondum traditas adipisci, fortasse etiam res praeparatas ad capiendum 0‑01…

unit.source: Lumian seriously considered the feasibility of attacking the enforcers without facing punitive consequences.
unit.target: Lumian serio consideravit facultatem exsecutores oppugnandi sine poenalis consequentia subeundis.

unit.source: After a while, Julie trudged back towards the Carnivore bar, her face plain and her expression sorrowful, like a white Jimsonweed swaying gently in the cold night wind.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempore, Julie ad tabernam Carnivoram rediit, vultu simplex atque vultu maerente, instar alba Datura stramonium leniter in frigido noctis vento oscillante.

unit.source: Lumian stayed vigilant, following Julie until she reached the Carnivore bar before reappearing in his room using the shadows.
unit.target: Lumian vigilavit, Juliam secutus, donec ad tabernam Carnivoram pervenit, deinde per umbras in conclavi suo apparuit.

unit.source: A while later, lying in bed listening to the wind, Lumian’s thoughts wandered aimlessly.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, iacens in lecto et ventum auscultans, cogitationes Lumiani sine fine errabant.

unit.source: Suddenly, he opened his eyes, noticing a troubling detail.
unit.target: Subito oculos aperuit, rem perturbantem animadvertens.

unit.source: Having become an experimental subject, Celeste’s reaction just now was wrong!
unit.target: Postquam experimento subiecta facta est, reactio Celeste modo facta errata fuit!

unit.source: From previous tests, Lumian knew the enforcers strangely recognized every resident of Morora.
unit.target: Ex experimentis prioribus, Lumian noverat custodes omnem incolam Mororae mirum in modum agnoscere.

unit.source: Celeste should have asked “Who are you calling?” or “What do you want?” instead of “Who are you?”
unit.target: Celeste debuit interrogare: “Quem vocas?” vel “Quid vis?”, potius quam “Quis es?”

unit.source: Whether in a normal state or not, she most likely still recognized Julie but pretended not to.
unit.target: Sive in statu normali sive non, verisimiliter adhuc Juliam agnoscebat, sed simulabat non agnoscere.

unit.source: Lumian sat up, narrowing his eyes.
unit.target: Lumian surgit, oculos contrahens.

unit.source: Is Celeste not a complete experimental subject yet?
unit.target: Num Celeste nondum subiecta experimentali completa sit?

unit.source: Is she pretending not to recognize Julie to protect her or to keep her secrets safe, ensuring the plan continues?
unit.target: Simulatne illa non agnosse Juliam, ut eam protegat aut arcana eius conservet, ita ut consilium pergat?

unit.source: What is she using to maintain some clarity and self‑awareness, not becoming a complete puppet‑like experimental subject?
unit.target: Quid uteretur ad aliquam claritatem et conscientiam sui ipsius retinendam, ne omnino fiat subiecta experimentali sicut marionetta?

unit.source: Is it something the Demoness Sect prepared based on previous infiltrators’ experiences, or has Celeste had some fortuitous encounter, discovering part of the secret?
unit.target: Numquid id est quod Sectio Daemonissarum ex experimentis antecedentium infiltratorum paraverit, aut fortuito Celeste aliquam occurrit, qua secretum partem detexerit?

unit.source: Lumian decided it was necessary to “contact” Celeste.
unit.target: Lumian decrevit necessarium esse ut Celestem contingeret.

unit.source: Of course, he would first see if Celeste would secretly approach Julie.
unit.target: Scilicet, primum videbit an Celeste tacite ad Juliam appropinquaretur.

unit.source: In Trier’s arts district, Franca waited outside an art gallery, as agreed, for the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: In regione artium Treverensium, Franca foris, ut conventum erat, exspectabat Daemonissam Nigram.

unit.source: Before long, a four‑seater carriage pulled up, and Clarice, wearing a black hat and thin veil over a dark court dress, looked out from the window and nodded at her.
unit.target: Mox raeda quadrilocata accessit, et Clarice, pileo nigro et tenue velamine super veste iudiciali obscura, ex fenestra prospiciens ad eam annuit.

unit.source: Franca opened the door, stepped lightly up, and sat opposite her.
unit.target: Franca ianuam aperuit, leviter ascendit, et adversus eam consedit.

unit.source: As the carriage moved slowly through the bustling city, she smiled at the Demoness of Black.
unit.target: Dum raeda lente per urbem vibrans movebatur, illa Daemonissae Nigrae subridens respexit.

unit.source: “Madame, I’ve ascended to Affliction.”
unit.target: «Domina, ad Afflictionem ascendī.»

unit.source: “Faster than I expected,” Clarice said, her doubt evident.
unit.target: «Citius quam expectavi,» inquit Clarice, dubitatione manifesta.

unit.source: Franca smiled slyly. “Because Ciel became a Reaper.”
unit.target: Franca subridens astute dixit: «Quia Ciel factus est Messor.»

unit.source: “He’s Sequence 5 too? His advancement seems even quicker than yours…” Clarice slightly raised her head, her eyes seeming to shift.
unit.target: «Etiam ille Sequens 5 est? Profectus eius etiam citius videtur quam tuus...» leviter caput elevavit Clarice, oculis quasi transmutatis.

unit.source: “After Gardner Martin’s death, he should have left the Iron and Blood Cross Order, right?”
unit.target: «Post mortem Gardner Martin, debebat Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis relinquere, nonne?»

unit.source: Franca spoke the absolute truth.
unit.target: Franca veritatem absolutam dixit.

unit.source: “Yes, he used Gardner Martin’s Beyonder characteristics to concoct the potion, so he owes him for the quick advancement.”
unit.target: «Ita, notis Beyonder Gardner Martinis usus est ut potionem componeret, ideoque ei pro celeri progressu debitum est.»

unit.source: The Demoness of Black smiled in understanding, her demeanor much warmer than usual.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra, cum intellegentia, subridens, habitus eius multo calidius quam more solito apparebat.

unit.source: “Even in death, Gardner Martin helps you.”
unit.target: «Etiam in morte, Gardner Martin tibi auxilium dat.»

unit.source: That was a hell of a joke… Franca felt slightly awkward.
unit.target: Iste erat iocus ingens… Franca se paulum incommodam sensit.

unit.source: She quickly changed the subject.
unit.target: Celeriter rem mutavit.

unit.source: “Madame, you said you’d tell me some secrets of the sect once I became a Demoness of Affliction.”
unit.target: «Domina, dixisti te mihi aliquas sectae arcana narrare, cum Demonissa Afflictionis essem.»

unit.source: Clarice, with a slight smile behind her thin black veil, replied, “Yes, you’re now considered a core member of our sect. Hmm, where should I start…”
unit.target: Clarice, cum tenue velamine nigro et leviter subridente, respondit: «Ita, nunc membrum cardineum sectae nostrae haberis. Hmm, unde incipiam…»

unit.source: Seeing the Demoness of Black unconsciously reveal a hint of innocent girlishness, Franca couldn’t help but be momentarily moved, marveling at the high‑level Demoness’s overwhelming charm.
unit.target: Videns daemonissam Nigram inconscii modicum innocentiae puellae speciei patefacere, Franca non potuit quin momento moveretur, admirans vim incantationis daemonissae altissimi gradus.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Clarice’s expression turned serious and a bit melancholic as she began, “I’ll start with the specifics of our sect.”
unit.target: Post paucis secundis, vultus Clarice serio ac paulum maerens factus est, et incepit: «Ab de rebus specificis sectae nostrae incipiam.»

unit.source: “We originally were a family, all members descendants of the Primordial One, but since the Fifth Epoch, such an organizational structure couldn’t sustain our influence.
unit.target: «Primum familia fuimus, omnes membra ex Uno Primordiali descendentes; sed a Quinta Aevo, talis structura ordinata influentiam nostram sustinere non potuit…

unit.source: We began to incorporate Beyonders of the Assassin pathway who also believed in the Primordial One as members.”
unit.target: Incepimus includere Beyonder ex via sicarii, qui quoque in Unum Primordiale credebant, ut membra nostra fierent.»

unit.source: “Are you also a descendant of the Primordial One?” Franca, having learned this from the Tarot Club, still showed appropriate surprise and curiosity.
unit.target: «Et tu es ex Uno Primordiali descendantia?» Franca, hoc ex Tarot Club dida, admirationem et curiositatem congruam ostendit.

unit.source: This was a performance learned from Jenna, honed with a Spectator’s feedback.
unit.target: Hoc erat exercitium didacticum, a Jenna perceptum, et responsione Spectatoris emendatum.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black nodded slightly.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra leviter annuit.

unit.source: “My mother is a descendant of the Primordial One.”
unit.target: «Mater mea ex Uno Primordiali descendit.»

unit.source: Wait, according to our deductions, you should have Sauron and Tamara blood… Does this mean your mother was of Primordial One and Tamara bloodlines?
unit.target: Exspecta, secundum nostras deductiones, tibi sanguinem Sauronis et Tamaræ habere oportuisset… Num hoc significat quod mater tua ex sanguine Unius Primordiali et Tamaræ nata sit?

unit.source: Franca hesitated, then pitifully asked, “Does that mean I can never join the brass in the sect? I’m not a descendant of the Primordial One…”
unit.target: Franca haesitavit, inde miserabiliter rogavit: «Num hoc significat me numquam ad ordinem principalem sectae coniungi posse? Non enim ex Uno Primordiali descendō…»

unit.source: “It doesn’t matter. You can marry a descendant, and your spouse will count as a family member,” Clarice smiled again.
unit.target: «Non refert. Descendenti in matrimonium ducere potes, et coniugatus tuus familiae numerabitur,» iterum Clarice subridens inquit.

unit.source: “Moreover, in the future, you might truly become a child of the Primordial One. We are always getting closer to the Primordial One.”
unit.target: «Praeterea, in futurum, vere filia Unum Primordiale fieri potes. Semper ad Unum Primordiale propius accedimus.»

unit.source: “What do you mean?” Franca expressed her confusion.
unit.target: «Quid hoc significat?» Franca suam confusionem exprimens rogavit.

unit.source: She felt a sudden inexplicable fear.
unit.target: Repente inexplicabilis timor eam affecit.

unit.source: “You’ll understand in time,” the Demoness of Black did not elaborate.
unit.target: «Tempore intelleges,» daemonissa Nigra dixit, neque ulterius explicavit.

unit.source: I hate people who speak unclearly… Franca silently grumbled, waiting for the Demoness of Black to continue.
unit.target: Odi eos, qui non clare loquuntur… Franca silentio gemebat, exspectans daemonissam Nigram ut pergeret.

unit.source: Clarice returned to the previous topic.
unit.target: Clarice ad rem priorem rediit.

unit.source: “After the Pale‑White War, the Primordial One fell into slumber, occasionally waking. All sect affairs are handled by high‑ranking Demonesses titled by color.
unit.target: «Post Bellum Albopallidum, Unus Primordialis in soporem cecidit, interdum evigilans. Omnia negotia sectae a daemonissis altissimi gradus, coloribus nominatis, tractantur…

unit.source: Currently, there are thirteen, including myself, some of whom are Angels, others powerful Saints.”
unit.target: Nunc tredecim sunt, inter quas etiam ego; quarum quaedam Angeli, aliae Sancti potentes.

unit.source: “Is there a pope, a pontiff, or a matriarch?” Franca asked.
unit.target: «Num est papa, pontifex, vel matriarcha?» Franca rogavit.

unit.source: Clarice nodded.
unit.target: Clarice annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, the Primordial One’s child, our Matriarch, the Demoness of Gray. She likes to be called the Saintess of Gray.”
unit.target: «Ita, filia Unius Primordialis, nostra Matriarcha, Daemonissa Cineraria; illi placet ut Sancta Cineraria dicatur.»

unit.source: “The Primordial One’s child… What is Her relation to Krismona? Browns told me Krismona is also a child of the Primordial One,” Franca openly expressed her curiosity.
unit.target: «Filia Unius Primordialis… Quid est eius relatio ad Krismonam? Browns mihi dixerunt Krismonam quoque filiam Unius Primordialis esse,» Franca aperte curiose expressit.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black replied emotionlessly, “They are twins, but our Matriarch was born as a male Sequence 9 and later became a Demoness.”
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra, sine affectū, respondit: «Gemini sunt, sed nostra Matriarcha primo ut masculus Sequens 9 nata est, et postea Daemonissa facta est.»

unit.source: Twins… It seems the Demoness of Gray might know some secrets of the Krismona Night Pillar… Franca felt a strange sense of history merging with reality.
unit.target: Gemini… Videtur Daemonissa Cineraria quaedam arcana Columnæ Nocturnæ Krismonae scire posse… Franca sensum mirum historiae cum re confluere sensit.

unit.source: The Demoness of Gray must have witnessed the Fourth Epoch.
unit.target: Daemonissa Cineraria certe Quatram Aevo conspexit.

unit.source: Clarice continued, “Each high‑ranking Demoness titled by color handles specific affairs, directly reporting to our Matriarch.
unit.target: Clarice pergebat: «Quisque daemonissa altissimi gradus, colore nominata, res particulares curat et directe ad nostram Matriarcham referit.

unit.source: They do not have clear subordination among themselves, and we sometimes receive revelations from the Primordial One, allowing us considerable autonomy.”
unit.target: Inter se subordinationem clarissimam non habeunt, et nonnumquam revelationes a Uno Primordiali accipimus, quae nobis amplam autonomiam concedunt.»

unit.source: “I came to Trier to manage sect members here, maintain contact with local collaborators, and clean up the Mirror People.”
unit.target: «Ad Treverenses veni ut membra sectae hic regerem, contactum cum collaborantibus localibus retinerem, atque Populum Specularum purgarem.»

unit.source: Franca seized the opportunity to ask, “Is our approach to the Mirror People complete eradication? No intention to use them?”
unit.target: Franca, occasione usus est rogandi: «Num nostrum accessus ad Populum Specularum exterminationem completam intendit? Nonne nullam voluntatem habemus eos adhibere?»

unit.source: The Demoness of Black smiled sadly.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra tristis subridens arriduit.

unit.source: “How do you plan to use them?”
unit.target: «Quomodo consilias eos adhibere?»

unit.source: If I knew, why would I ask you?
unit.target: Si scirem, cur te interrogarem?

unit.source: Franca awkwardly smiled.
unit.target: Franca incommode subridens arriduit.

unit.source: “To help us control that special mirror world. I think it’s quite useful.”
unit.target: «Ad auxilium regendi illud speciale mundum specularum. Puto id valde utile esse.»

unit.source: The Demoness of Black glanced at Franca, her eyes shimmering, and laughed softly.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra Francam intuebatur, oculis micantibus, et submissa risu risit.

unit.source: “Why do you think we haven’t mastered that special mirror world?”
unit.target: «Cur putas nos illud speciale mundum specularum nondum dominari posse?»

unit.source: “Uh…” Franca was genuinely confused.
unit.target: «Eh…» Franca vere confusa erat.

unit.source: It wasn’t an act.
unit.target: Non erat simulatio.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black resumed her melancholy, elegant demeanor, smiling faintly.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra iterum suum maeroris habitum elegantem retulit, leviter subridens.

unit.source: “All mirror worlds are under our Demoness control.
unit.target: That special mirror world was originally used to fight the Primordial One, but ultimately, the Primordial One took control of it.

unit.source: “Of course, after the War of the Four Emperors, we lost partial control of that special mirror world. After the Pale‑White War, we could only exert limited influence.”
unit.target: «Certe, post Bellum Quattuor Imperatorum, imperium partile illius specialis mundi specularum amisimus. Post Bellum Albopallidum, solum influentiam limitatam exerci poteramus.»

unit.source: “Why?” Franca felt there must be a significant secret.
unit.target: «Cur?» Franca sensit esse secretum grave.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black smiled.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra subridens arriduit.

unit.source: “Perhaps the Matriarch and other high‑ranking Demonesses who survived the Fourth Epoch know, but not me.
unit.target: «Fortasse Matriarcha et aliae daemonissae altissimi gradus, quae Quartam Aevo superaverunt, sciunt, sed non ego.

unit.source: “From the Mirror People’s state and their confessions, I guess the Primordial One’s projection in the mirror experienced some changes or, the Primordial One’s projection separated part of Her characteristics, affected by the Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal, unable to return, unable to reunite with the Primordial One.”
unit.target: Ex statu Populi Specularum et eorum confessionibus, coniecturus sum projectionem Unius Primordialis in speculo nonnulla mutata esse, aut partem eius notabilium separavisse, ab sigillo Treverensi Quartae Aevi affecta, ita ut neque redire neque cum Uno Primordiali reuniri possit.»

unit.source: “But this doesn’t explain why we lost further control after the Pale‑White War. Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal hasn’t strengthened. Moreover, a true god is unique.”
unit.target: «Sed hoc non explicat cur post Bellum Albopallidum imperium nostrum ulterius amisimus. Sigillum Treverense Quartae Aevi non firmatum est. Praeterea, verus deus unicus est.»

unit.source: 802 The Most Special Point
unit.target: 802 Punctum Maxime Speciale

unit.source: 802 The Most Special Point
unit.target: 802 Punctum Maxime Speciale

unit.source: A true god is unique…
unit.target: Deus verus unicus est…

unit.source: What does that mean?
unit.target: Quid hoc significat?

unit.source: Is it impossible for another Primordial Demoness to exist, whether in a mirror or a painting?
unit.target: Num alia Daemonissa Primordialis – sive in speculo sive in pictura – exsistere possit?

unit.source: Franca pondered over the Demoness of Black’s final words, sensing they held critical mysticism knowledge.
unit.target: Franca de ultimis verbis Daemonissae Nigrae meditata est, sentiens ea scientiam mysticam cruciālem continere.

unit.source: As for Clarice’s speculation about the Primordial Demoness’s projection in the mirror undergoing some changes, Franca had thought the same before.
unit.target: De speculatione Clarice de proiectione Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo mutationibus subeundis, Franca eadem prius existimaverat.

unit.source: When the Demoness of Black obtained the black Primordial Demoness figurine, she had nonchalantly mentioned, “The Mirror People believe in the mirrored Primordial One, but it’s actually just a projection of the Primordial One in the mirror.”
unit.target: Cum Daemonissa Nigra figuram nigram Daemonissae Primordialis adeptam esset, leviter dixit: “Homines speculi credit in Daemonissam Primordialem speculatam, sed revera ea solum est proiectio Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo.”

unit.source: She didn’t explain further, and at that time, Franca had already guessed that perhaps the projection had undergone some changes.
unit.target: Non amplius explicavit, et eo tempore Franca iam coniectaverat fortasse proiectionem mutationes subisse.

unit.source: But the problem was that if one continued this line of reasoning, it could explain why the Demonesses lost further control over the special mirror world after the Pale-White War.
unit.target: Sed quaestio erat: si hanc rationem prosequeretur quisquam, id explanare potuisset cur Daemonissae post Bellum Pallide-Album de mundo speculi speciali ulterius imperium amitterent.

unit.source: According to Franca’s limited knowledge, in the Pale Disaster, Death fell, and the Primordial Demoness was heavily injured.
unit.target: Secundum scientiam Francae modicam, in Calamitate Pallida mors cecidit, et Daemonissa Primordialis graviter laesa est.

unit.source: Such a weakened Primordial Demoness couldn’t prevent the projection in the mirror from changing further, thus losing control over that special mirror world and failing to recover from the injuries for millennia.
unit.target: Talis debilitata Daemonissa Primordialis proiectionem in speculo ne ulterius mutationem prohibere potuit, ita potestatem super specialem mundum speculi amittens et vulnera per millennia non reficere.

unit.source: Franca thought that if she, with her limited understanding of the Pale Disaster, could come to such a conclusion, the Demoness of Black wouldn’t say it couldn’t be explained.
unit.target: Franca putavit, si ipsa ex modica sua intellectione Calamitatis Pallidae ad hanc conclusionem pervenire posset, Daemonissa Nigra non affirmaturum esse id inexplicabile.

unit.source: Unless she was completely unaware of the outcomes of the Pale Disaster or had already obtained other strong evidence that ruled out the possibility that the Primordial Demoness’s injuries during the divine war led to the Demonesses’ further loss of control over the special mirror world.
unit.target: Nisi quaenam omnino de eventibus Calamitatis Pallidae nesciret aut iam aliam validam probationem obtinuisset, quae excluderet possibilitatem, ut vulnera Daemonissae Primordialis in bello divino ad ulteriorem imperii amissionem in speciali mundo speculi ducerent.

unit.source: After some thought, Franca carefully asked, “Is the black figurine I handed over evidence of the Primordial One’s projection changing in the mirror?”
unit.target: Post aliquod cogitandum, Franca diligenter rogavit: “Num figura nigra, quam tradidi, sit testis proiectionis Daemonissae Primordialis in speculo mutantis?”

unit.source: The Demoness of Black neither nodded nor shook her head.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra nec annuit nec caput movit.

unit.source: Instead, she explained mysticism, “Our Assassin pathway’s most unique node is Sequence 7, Witch. This isn’t just because it changes our gender but also because it leaves a strong, distinct imprint in the mirror world. This imprint is what allows us to use mirror magic.”
unit.target: At versus, ea mysticam exponens dedit: “Nodus singularissimus itineris nostri sicarii est Series VII, Maga. Hoc non solum quia genus nostrum mutat, sed etiam quia vestigium validum et distinctum in mundo speculi relinquit. Id vestigium nobis sinit uti magiam speculi.”

unit.source: This is about the Mirror Person for each Demoness…
unit.target: Hoc ad Personam Speculi cuiusque Daemonissae attinet…

unit.source: Franca suddenly had an epiphany and took the opportunity to say, “Previously, Moran Avigny said the one in the mirror is our true self, our exiled and sealed self…”
unit.target: Franca subito epiphania affecta est atque occasionem arripuit ut diceret: “Prius Moran Avigny dixit id quod in speculo est, esse verum nostrum ipsum, exsulum et sigillatam.”

unit.source: Clarice shook her head with a hint of melancholy.
unit.target: Clarice caput demulit, leviter tristitia affecta.

unit.source: “I believe Moran Avigny didn’t lie to you. The Mirror People indeed believe they are the true selves, but can you completely trust conclusions made from their own perspective?
unit.target: “Credo Moran Avigny vobis non mentitum esse. Homines speculi vere creditunt se esse veram sui ipsos; sed potestisne penitus confidere iudiciis ex ipsorum prospectu deductis?

unit.source: “Have you ever forgotten your past self, that indelible pain?”
unit.target: Num umquam praeteritum te ipsum obliviscis, illum dolorem indelebilem?”

unit.source: “No,” Franca answered sincerely, “I often think back to my past self and life, imagining if I hadn’t chosen the Assassin potion, would things have turned out differently.”
unit.target: “Non,” respondit Franca sincere, “saepe de me praeterito ac vita cogito, fingens si potionem sicarii non elegissem, res fortasse aliter evenissent.”

unit.source: The Demoness of Black nodded sympathetically.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra cum compassione annuit.

unit.source: “We still remember, we haven’t forgotten, so it’s impossible for our true self to be exiled. If one day, we no longer feel pain from our losses, forget the past, and immerse ourselves in the present state, the strong imprint we left in the mirror might activate in a mystical sense, leading to cognitive confusion and gradual loss of control.
unit.target: “Meminimus; nondum obliti sumus; ergo verum nostrum se exsulum fieri non potest. Si aliquando dolorem ex amissionibus non sentiamus, praeteritum obliviscamur et nos in statu praesenti immergamus, validum vestigium quod in speculo reliquimus in sensu mystico excitari poterit, ducens ad confusionem cognitivam et paulatim ad imperii amissionem.”

unit.source: “In this regard, having once been male and constantly reminiscing about our male self is a major advantage in maintaining our identity and avoiding loss of control.”
unit.target: “In hac re, quoniam olim masculi fuimus et de nostro masculino se continuo reminiscimus, magnum commodum habemus ad identitatem nostram tuendam et imperium non amittendum.”

unit.source: “Then purely female Demonesses must be very dangerous?”
unit.target: “Ergo daemonissae omnino femininae fortasse valde periculosae esse debent?”

unit.source: Franca feigned sudden realization; in truth, she was worried about Jenna.
unit.target: Franca subito impressionem simulavit; re vera, de Jenna anxia erat.

unit.source: “There won’t be purely female Demonesses,” Clarice coldly replied.
unit.target: “Daemonissae omnino femininae non erunt,” frigide respondit Clarice.

unit.source: If you encountered one, you would kill her?
unit.target: Si talem occurreres, eam occideres?

unit.source: Without the sacrificial square in the catacombs, Jenna would have lost control and died when ascending to Witch…
unit.target: Sine area sacrificii in catacumbis, Jenna imperium amitteret et ascendendo ad gradum Magae periret…

unit.source: Franca didn’t delve further, fearing to arouse the Demoness of Black’s suspicion.
unit.target: Franca non ulterius indagavit, metuens ne suspicio Daemonissae Nigrae excitaret.

unit.source: Clarice continued, “Aside from the product of the special mirror world, everyone has a Mirror Person. Each time we look into a mirror, a Mirror Person is created. For non-Demoness pathway individuals, these Mirror People are temporary projections, quickly dissipating after the person leaves the mirror.
unit.target: Clarice continuavit: “Praeter rem specialem mundi speculi, quisque Personam Speculi habet. Quoties in speculum aspicimus, Persona Speculi creatur. Pro his qui non in via daemonissarum student, Personae Speculi projectiones temporariae sunt, celeriter evanentes postquam persona speculum relinquit.

unit.source: “But we Demonesses are different. The strong imprint creates a Mirror Person that always exists and grows stronger as we advance in Sequence. At the divine stage, because a true god is unique, the imprint returns to the body, merging with the self. From then on, one exists both in reality and in the mirror, embodying both states.”
unit.target: “Sed nos, daemonissae, aliter sumus. Vestigium validum Personam Speculi creat, quae semper existit et, quotiens in Serie progredimur, augetur. In gradu divino, quoniam deus verus unicus est, vestigium ad corpus redit et se cum ipso coniungit. Ex tunc quis simul in re ac in speculo existit, utrumque statum complectens.”

unit.source: There’s some similarity to what Moran Avigny said.
unit.target: Aliqua similitudo est ad ea quae Moran Avigny dixit.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black didn’t deny our strong imprint in the mirror could be called Mirror People…
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra non negavit validum vestigium nostrum in speculo vocari Personae Speculi.

unit.source: Both their words likely contain parts of the truth but not the whole truth.
unit.target: Verba eorum verisimiliter partes veritatis continent, sed non totam.

unit.source: Perhaps piecing them together could reveal some reliable facts…
unit.target: Forsitan, cum iuncta sint, quaedam certa facta revelari possint…

unit.source: Franca nodded thoughtfully.
unit.target: Franca, meditans, annuit.

unit.source: “So the appearance of the black figurine is abnormal. It should have merged with the self?”
unit.target: “Ergo species figurae nigrae anomala est. Nonne illa cum se ipsa coniuncta esse debuit?”

unit.source: “That’s why we suspect the Primordial One lost part of Her characteristics, causing changes in the mirror projection,” Clarice confirmed Franca’s statement.
unit.target: “Ita suspicamus Daemonissam Primordialis partem suarum proprietatum amisisse, mutationes in proiectione speculi efficiens,” Clarice verba Francae confirmavit.

unit.source: But according to this logic, the white figurines each sect member carries shouldn’t exist either…
unit.target: Sed secundum hanc rationem, figurinae albae quas singuli membri sectae portant nec existere debent.

unit.source: The Primordial Demoness, also known as the Chaos Demoness, shouldn’t be purely black or white.
unit.target: Daemonissa Primordialis, quae etiam Daemonissa Chaos appellatur, neque pure nigra neque pure alba esse debet.

unit.source: Unless the white and black figurines represent something other than the real and mirror selves…
unit.target: Nisi figurinae albae et nigrae aliud repraesentent quam verum et speculum seipsum…

unit.source: Franca didn’t dare voice these emerging thoughts.
unit.target: Franca has cogitationes emergentes exprimere non ausus est.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black further explained, “Black figurines are rare.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra ulterius explicavit: “Figurinae nigrae rarae sunt.

unit.source: Not every special Mirror Person has one, not even someone as significant as Moran Avigny.
unit.target: Non omnis Persona Speculi specialis talem habet, ne etiam aliquis tam insignis quam Moran Avigny.

unit.source: “Which specific ones possess it is currently unknown.”
unit.target: “Quae specifica ea possident, nunc ignotum est.”

unit.source: That’s right…
unit.target: Ita vero…

unit.source: Franca felt a pang of regret for not asking Moran Avigny about the black Primordial Demoness figurine back then.
unit.target: Franca dolorem sensit quod tum de figura nigra Daemonissae Primordialis a Moran Avigny rogare non ausus esset.

unit.source: She and Lumian had previously thought it didn’t warrant further investigation: wasn’t it just a special entity the Mirror People worshiped?
