unit.target: Illa et Lumian antea arbitraverant hoc non ulterius investigandum esse: nonne ipsa erat entitas specialis quam Homines Speculi colere solebant?

unit.source: Asking directly for the deity’s honorific name and related information seemed enough, with no need to focus on the figurine’s origin…
unit.target: Directe quaerere nomen honorificum deitatis et informationes adiunctas satis videbatur, nec oportebat originem figurae perscrutari.

unit.source: Franca showed her frustration, then tentatively asked, “Shouldn’t we be trying to destroy the Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal to lift the restrictions on that special mirror world, letting the Primordial One regain control and complete the fusion?
unit.target: Franca iram suam ostendit, deinde dubiter rogavit: “Nonne conari debemus sigillum Quarti Aevi Triensis delere, ut restrictiones super specialem mundum speculi tollantur, Daemonissa Primordialis iterum imperium adipisci possit et fusionem perficere?”

unit.source: “Why are we still cleaning up Mirror People?”
unit.target: “Cur adhuc purgamus Homines Speculi?”

unit.source: The Demoness of Black replied seriously, “Opening it ourselves and them opening it are completely different.”
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra serio respondit: “Nos ipsi aperientes et illi aperientes id esse plane diversa sunt.”

unit.source: Which one dominates the white or black figurines?
unit.target: Utra praevaleat, figurinae albae an nigrae?

unit.source: Franca, a voracious reader and imaginative transmigrator, had a vivid imagination.
unit.target: Franca, vorax lectionis et imaginativa transmigratrix, phantasiam vividam habebat.

unit.source: The Demoness of Black didn’t give her a chance to ask further.
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra ei occasionem ulteriorem quaerendi non dedit.

unit.source: “What we need to do now is clean up the Mirror People in Trier, disrupt their plans, and, if possible, collect vital information from the deepest Darts of the special mirror world.”
unit.target: “Nobis nunc faciendum est Homines Speculi in Triensi purgare, consilia eorum confundere, et, si fieri potest, informationes vitales ex partibus profundissimis specialis mundi speculi colligere.”

unit.source: “Yes, Madame,” Franca seized the moment to request, “I’m tracking a Mirror Person and need items that can traverse the mirror world and send messages through mirrors. My Mirror Cufflink is running out of uses,” Demoness of Black Clarice nodded lightly.
unit.target: “Ita, Domina,” Franca occasionem arripuit ut rogaret: “Sequor Personam Speculi et instrumenta mihi opus sunt quae per mundum speculi transire possint atque nuntios per specula mittere. Mea fibula speculi usus deficiunt.”

unit.source: “All right, I’ll prepare it for you.”
unit.target: “Bene, id tibi parabo.”

unit.source: She paused for a moment before adding, “Remember, the mirror world is both mysterious and dangerous. It is also a source of our strength as Demonesses. Don’t resist approaching it, but don’t underestimate it either.
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit antequam addidit: “Memento, mundus speculi tam arcānus quam periculosus est. Etiam fons nostri roboris est, daemonissae. Noli repugnare accessui ejus, sed ne illud subestimes.”

unit.source: “Compared to the Hunter pathway, the mirror world is our most unique feature.”
unit.target: “Comparatus ad viam venatorum, mundus speculi nostra proprietas singularissima est.”

unit.source: The most unique feature…
unit.target: Proprietas singularissima…

unit.source: Franca suddenly felt that the Demoness of Black was hinting at the mirror world’s importance far beyond what she imagined.
unit.target: Franca subito sensit Daemonissam Nigram insinuare momentum mundi speculi longe ultra, quod illa imaginaverat.

unit.source: After exchanging more mysticism knowledge about the sect and the Assassin pathway, Franca asked one last question, “Madame, can the Plague of an Affliction Witch expand the types of pathogens?”
unit.target: Postquam plura de scientia mystica de secta atque via sicarii commutata erant, Franca ultimum quaesivit: “Domina, potestne Pestis Magae Afflictionis genera pathogena dilatari?”

unit.source: “What do you mean?” The Demoness of Black frowned slightly, evoking pity.
unit.target: “Quid significas?” inquit Daemonissa Nigra leviter, fronte contrahente et misericordiam excitante.

unit.source: “I mean, can we find special pathogens and incorporate them into our Plague ability? Simple illnesses like pneumonia, strokes, and heart attacks are powerful but lack imagination. I remember some pathogens cause narcolepsy or complete muscle weakness…”
unit.target: “Intelligo; licetne specialia pathogena reperire et in nostram potestatem Pestis incorporare? Morbi simplices, ut pneumonia, ictus, et infarctus cordis, sunt potentes sed carent imaginatione. Memini quaedam pathogena narcolepsiam aut plenam musculorum infirmitatem efficere.”

unit.source: The Demoness of Black was silent for several seconds before saying, “When you become a Demoness of Despair, you can create mystical pathogens with different effects. For now, the range of Plague is fixed by the Beyonder characteristics unless…”
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra paucos secundos silentium tuuit antequam dixit: “Cum daemonissa Desperationis evaderis, poteris pathogena mystica diversis effectibus creare. Pro nunc, spatium Pestis proprietatibus Beyonder definitum est, nisi…”

unit.source: “Unless what?”
unit.target: “Nisi quid?”

unit.source: The Demoness of Black spoke with longing and admiration, “Unless the Primordial One modifies the scope of Plague as a true god of the Demoness pathway.”
unit.target: Daemonissa Nigra desiderio et admiratione locuta est: “Nisi Daemonissa Primordialis spatium Pestis mutaverit, ut vera dea viae daemonissarum.”

unit.source: So that’s possible? This is what being a deity means, influencing one’s pathway…
unit.target: Ergo id fieri potest? Hoc est quod deum esse significat: iter suum afficere…

unit.source: Franca was genuinely shocked, realizing the true meaning of the word “true god.”
unit.target: Franca vere stupuit, verum sensum verbi “deus verus” agnoscens.

unit.source: Morora, in the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Morora, in taberna Carnivora.

unit.source: Lumian lay on the bed, eyes closed, appearing asleep but actually closely monitoring Julie’s movements.
unit.target: Lumian in lecto iacebat, oculis clausis, quasi dormiens apparens sed re vera motus Juliae diligenter observans.

unit.source: He suspected that Celeste, the seemingly fully converted experimental subject, might secretly visit Julie at night to share vital information about Morora.
unit.target: Suspicionem habebat Celestem, subiectum experimentale quasi plane conversum, fortasse noctu arcane Juliam visitaturam esse ut notitias vitales de Morora compartirent.

unit.source: As the night deepened, Lumian felt a sudden restlessness, as if the air was filled with amorous energy.
unit.target: Cum nox profundiore facta esset, Lumian subito inquietudinem sensit, quasi aër energia amorosa repletus esset.

unit.source: His mind couldn’t help but recall scenes of temptation he’d witnessed before.
unit.target: Mens eius non potuit non recordari scaenas tentationis quas antea viderat.

unit.source: 803 Transmitting Information
unit.target: 803 Traditio Notitiae

unit.source: 803 Transmitting Information
unit.target: 803 Traditio Notitiae

unit.source: Similar experiences were not new to Lumian; he had felt this way before.
unit.target: Experientiae similes Lumiano non erant novae; talem sensum antea experitus erat.

unit.source: Whenever Franca prayed to the Primordial Demoness figurine made of bone, Lumian would sometimes be nearby.
unit.target: Quoties Franca ad effigiem ex ossibus factam Demonissae Primordialis orabat, aliquando Lumian prope aderat.

unit.source: Even through doors and walls, through the wall of spirituality, he couldn’t help but feel sensations.
unit.target: Etiam per ianuas et muros, per murum spiritualitatis, haud potuit quin sensus sentiret.

unit.source: Is Julie praying to the Primordial Demoness figurine?
unit.target: Num Julie ad effigiem Demonissae Primordialis orat?

unit.source: Lumian, still with his eyes closed, made a guess about the current situation.
unit.target: Lumian, adhuc oculos clausos tenens, de praesentibus rebus coniecturam fecit.

unit.source: It wasn’t necessarily due to Julie’s extreme piety; it was a daily ritual for members of the Demoness Sect.
unit.target: Id non necessario ex extrema pietate Julie proveniebat; sed erat ritu quotidiano membris Sectae Demonissae.

unit.source: Even a believer of Mr. Fool, like Franca, had to do it regularly.
unit.target: Etiam cultor Domini Stulti, ut Franca, id regulariter facere debebat.

unit.source: Before long, the amorous energy in the air dissipated, and Lumian’s state returned to normal.
unit.target: Mox, amorosa vis in aere dissipata est, et status Lumiani ad solitum rediit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he remembered something: Where did Julie get a Primordial Demoness figurine?
unit.target: Subito, aliquid meminit: ubi Julie effigiem Demonissae Primordialis obtinuit?

unit.source: During the exile to Morora, Lumian noticed that neither Lez nor Julie seemed to carry personal belongings.
unit.target: In exsilio in Morora, Lumian animadvertit neque Lez neque Julie bona sua ferre.

unit.source: This meant that, except for Lumian, who had special treatment and wasn’t searched, all other exiles were handled by the standard procedure.
unit.target: Hoc significabat, nisi Lumian, qui curam specialem habebat et non explorabatur, omnes reliquos exsules rite tractari.

unit.source: So, Julie shouldn’t have a standard-issue figurine from the Demoness sect.
unit.target: Ergo, Julie non debet habere effigiem consuetam ex Secta Demonissae.

unit.source: Even if she wanted to make one herself, she would need to buy materials and set up a ritual, and Lumian’s tracking today showed she hadn’t done any preparations.
unit.target: Etiam si ipsa eam fabricare vellet, materias emere atque ritum instituere oporteret, et indagatio hodierna Lumiani ostendit eam nullas praeparationes fecisse.

unit.source: So, where did her Primordial Demoness figurine come from?
unit.target: Ergo, unde orta est eius effigies Demonissae Primordialis?

unit.source: Or did she directly use the language that can invoke natural forces to recite the Primordial Demoness’s honorific name?
unit.target: An ipsa directe usuit linguam, quae potest vires naturales evocare, ad recitandum nomen honorificum Demonissae Primordialis?

unit.source: But if that were the case, the influence of the power overflow on me would be too weak.
unit.target: Sed, si ita esset, vis effusae potentiae in me nimis debilis foret.

unit.source: Even if it was not as strong as the residual divine power Franca experienced, it shouldn’t be just a bit of restlessness… Lumian became extremely alert.
unit.target: Etiam si non tam fortis quam potestas divina residua, quam Franca experita erat, non debebat esse tantum parva inquietudo… Lumian valde vigilans factus est.

unit.source: He quickly had a hypothesis.
unit.target: Celeriter hypothesim excogitavit.

unit.source: Celeste had visited!
unit.target: Celeste adfuit!

unit.source: It must have been this Demoness, who had become an experimental subject, who gave Julie the Primordial Demoness figurine or something similar!
unit.target: Fieri debuit hanc Demonessam, quae facta est subiecta experimentalis, Julie effigiem Demonissae Primordialis vel aliquid simile dedit!

unit.source: Why didn’t I notice?
unit.target: Cur non animadverti?

unit.source: II was monitoring the room Julie was in all along…
unit.target: Ego totum tempus conclave, in qua Julie erat, observabam.

unit.source: With that thought, Lumian suddenly sat up and looked at the full-length mirror in his bedroom.
unit.target: Hoc cogitato, Lumian subito consedit et speculum totum in cubiculo suo aspexit.

unit.source: Yes!
unit.target: Sic!

unit.source: Celeste must have come through the mirror world!
unit.target: Celeste certe per mundum specularum accessit!

unit.source: She must have communicated with Julie through the mirror, which is why I didn’t detect anything unusual until Julie started praying!
unit.target: Illam oportuit per speculum cum Julie communicavisse, ideo nihil inusitatum animadverti, donec Julie orare coepit!

unit.source: It’s normal for the Demoness Sect to have items like the Mirror Cufflink!
unit.target: Consuetum est in Secta Demonissae res tales habere, ut Fibula Specularis!

unit.source: Silently, Lumian got out of bed and walked to the full-length mirror in his room.
unit.target: Silentio, Lumian ex lecto exiit et ad speculum totum in cella sua accessit.

unit.source: He felt it was time to use the Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Sensit tempus esse ut Fibulam Specularis uteretur.

unit.source: He put on the glass-like cufflink and pressed his hand against the mirror surface.
unit.target: Indutus fibulam specularis, quae similis vitreo erat, manum contra superficiem speculi premuit.

unit.source: The button-like accessory lit up with a faint glow, and Lumian’s figure immediately penetrated the mirror’s surface, entering the deep, dark mirror world.
unit.target: Accessorium instar globuli leviter fulsit, et figura Lumiani statim superficiem speculi penetravit, ingrediens in profundum et obscurum mundum specularum.

unit.source: Before the dark, web-like tunnels spread out before him, Lumian clearly sensed the three mirror imprints he had left in the outside world and the few he had set up in Julie’s and Lez’s rooms.
unit.target: Antequam cuniculi tenebrosi, quasi retia, ante eum se pandissent, Lumian perspicue sensit tres impressiones speculi quas in mundo externo reliquerat et pauca quas in cellis Julie et Lez instituerat.

unit.source: He didn’t rush to the mirror in Julie’s room.
unit.target: Non festinavit ad speculum in cella Julie.

unit.source: Instead, he took out an unfinished letter from the Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Pro eo, litteram imperfectam e sacculo Viatoris extraxit.

unit.source: It was a letter to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
unit.target: Erat epistula ad Francam, Jennam et Anthonym.

unit.source: Lumian then activated the black mark on his right shoulder, attempting to teleport to the full-length mirror in Franca and Jenna’s apartment.
unit.target: Tum Lumian notam nigram in dextro humero excitavit, conatus transire se ad speculum totum in domo Francae et Jennae.

unit.source: It felt distant and had an invisible barrier.
unit.target: Videbatur remotum esse et habebat claustrum invisibile.

unit.source: Even if he penetrated the barrier, there was a vast, silent void of darkness that Lumian instinctively believed contained indescribable danger and terror.
unit.target: Etiam si claustrum penetravisset, illic erat immensa et silens vacuum obscuritatis, quod Lumian instinctu credebat inenarrabilem periculum et terrorem contineri.

unit.source: Does this represent that special mirror world?
unit.target: Num hoc repraesentat illum specialem mundum specularum?

unit.source: To leave Morora and return to the outside world, I must pass through it?
unit.target: Ut Mororam relinquam et ad mundum externum redeam, per ipsum transeundum mihi est?

unit.source: Even Angels would find it dangerous…
unit.target: Etiam Angeli id periculosum esse putarent…

unit.source: With these thoughts, Lumian stretched out his right hand, holding the letter, using the already activated Mirror Cufflink to give the paper a reflective, glass-like hue, and sent it out.
unit.target: His cogitationibus, Lumian dextram manum protulit, epistulam tenens, Fibulam Specularis iam activatam adhibens, ut chartae speciem vitreae reflexivae conferret, eam misit.

unit.source: The light stuck to the invisible barrier’s surface, slowly permeating it, falling into the dead silence, and heading toward the distant target mirror.
unit.target: Lux ad superficiem claustri invisibilis adhaesit, eam lente permeans, in silentium mortuum incidens, et versus speculum propositum remotum se dirigebat.

unit.source: It works… Lumian breathed a sigh of relief and used the contracted ability of Spirit World Traversal to shift to the mirror in Julie’s room.
unit.target: Operatur… Lumian suspirum levationis exhalavit et facultatem contractam Transitus Spiritus Mundi adhibuit, ut se in speculum cellae Julie moveret.

unit.source: The mirror was pitch black with no traces left.
unit.target: Speculum prorsus atrum erat, nullis vestigiis relicto.

unit.source: Lumian sniffed slightly, catching a lingering scent.
unit.target: Lumian leviter olfactus est, odorum perseverantem capiens.

unit.source: It smelled like a human hormone, coupled with the influence of mystical power, faintly sweet, amorous, and warm.
unit.target: Odores erant ut hormonum humanum, iunctum cum influxu potentiae mysticae, leniter dulces, amorosi et calidi.

unit.source: Not Julie’s scent… Lumian nodded slightly. Celeste indeed visited.
unit.target: Non odor Julie erat… Lumian leviter annuit. Revera, Celeste adfuit!

unit.source: Now the question was, did Celeste use an item to traverse the mirror world and reach Julie’s room, an item that escaped the Church of Knowledge’s search, or did she use the special connection of the mirror world to send it through a ritual?
unit.target: Nunc quaestio erat: utrum Celeste rem ad transgrediendum mundum specularum et pervenire ad cellam Julie usus sit—rem quae investigationi Ecclesiae Cognitionis evaserat—aut an nexum speciale mundi specularis per ritum adhibuerit ad eam mitterendam?

unit.source: Or, did she conduct a ritual to ask the Primordial Demoness for it?
unit.target: An potius ritum egit ut eam a Demonissa Primordiali peteret?

unit.source: Or is she no longer the original Celeste but her corresponding special Mirror Person?
unit.target: An iam non est Celeste originalis, sed persona specularis specialis ei correspondens?

unit.source: This could explain why she retained some self-awareness after becoming an experimental subject, but it’s not the only explanation…
unit.target: Hoc explicare posset cur aliquam sui conscientiam postquam subiecta experimentali facta sit retinuerit, sed non sola explanatio id est.

unit.source: Lumian, an experienced handler of mystical events with much knowledge, naturally linked it to the special Mirror People.
unit.target: Lumian, peritus in rebus mysticis et multa scientia instructus, id naturaliter ad speciales Personae Speculares coniunxit.

unit.source: He didn’t peek into Julie’s current situation through the mirror, fearing Celeste had given Julie some mirror-related items, making her more sensitive to the gaze from the mirror.
unit.target: Non perspexit in condicionem praesentem Julie per speculum, metuens Celeste Julie aliquas res speculis pertinentes dederit, quae eam sensibiliora ad aspectum speculi fecerint.

unit.source: Moreover, Julie had just finished praying, and the Primordial Demoness figurine’s residual effects lingered.
unit.target: Praeterea, Julie modo orationem finivit, et reliquae effectuum effigiei Demonissae Primordialis manebant.

unit.source: Lumian didn’t know if this would affect his spying.
unit.target: Lumian nesciebat num hoc eius speculandi laborem afficere posset.

unit.source: Of course, he could roughly guess what Julie was doing.
unit.target: Certe, paene coniectare poterat quid Julie faceret.

unit.source: Because he could hear Julie’s suppressed, soft moans through the mirror.
unit.target: Nam per speculum audire poterat voces Julie repressas et suaves gemitus.

unit.source: Lovers reunited, getting what they wanted, relaxing and celebrating.
unit.target: Amantes reïuniti, id quod desideraverunt accipiens, se relaxantes et celebrantes.

unit.source: Yes, and the sensations brought by praying to the Primordial Demoness figurine.
unit.target: Ita, et sensus, quos oratione ad effigiem Demonissae Primordialis attulit.

unit.source: She hasn’t gone out to add to her collection, which is already quite restrained.
unit.target: Non egreditur ut collectionem suam augeat, quae iam satis temperata est.

unit.source: Lumian silently chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian tacite subridens.

unit.source: He teleported back to his bedroom mirror, stepped out of the glass surface, and lay back on the bed.
unit.target: Se translocavit ad speculum in cubiculo suo, ex superficie vitrea exivit, et in lecto recubavit.

unit.source: Trier.
unit.target: Trier.

unit.source: Lonely, empty, cold… Franca, used to go early to bed and early to rise, sighed, lying in bed, unable to sleep.
unit.target: Solitaria, vacua, frigida… Franca, quae solebat mane cubitum ire et mane surgere, suspiravit, in lecto iacens, dormitum non posse.

unit.source: She felt she needed a few more days to adapt.
unit.target: Sentiabat se paucos dies amplius ad se accommodandum egere.

unit.source: At this moment, she sensed something, sat up, walked out of the room, and went to the living room.
unit.target: In hoc momento, aliquid sensit, consedit, conclave exiit, et ad atrium processit.

unit.source: She looked at the full-length mirror in the living room and saw a water-like light wave on the glass surface, reflecting a neatly folded letter.
unit.target: Aspiciebat speculum totum in atrio et vidit undam lucis instar aquae super superficie speculi, quae epistulam diligenter plicatam reflectebat.

unit.source: Is it from Lumian or the Demoness of Black?
unit.target: Num ea a Lumiano aut a Demonissa Nigra est?

unit.source: Franca walked over and pressed her hand against the mirror’s surface.
unit.target: Franca accessit et manum contra superficiem speculi premuit.

unit.source: Her right hand felt slightly cold, as if penetrating a lake mixed with ice, touching the now ethereal, intangible paper.
unit.target: Manus dextra eius leviter frigida sensa est, quasi lacum glaciei mixtum penetrare, tangens chartam nunc aetheream et intangibilem.

unit.source: The paper quickly “dispersed,” forming lines of Intisian words on the mirror surface: “I have arrived in Morora…”
unit.target: Charta celeriter “dispersa” est, lineas verborum Intisianorum in superficie speculi formans: “Ad Mororam perveni…”

unit.source: Lumian briefly described his experiences and the results of the experiment but didn’t mention the specific situation in Morora.
unit.target: Lumian breviter suas experientias et eventus experimenti narravit, sed rem specificam in Morora non contulit.

unit.source: It was a kind of corruption!
unit.target: Fuit genus corruptionis!

unit.source: A corruption Franca and the others might not withstand!
unit.target: Corruptio, quam Franca et ceteri fortasse non sustinere possent!

unit.source: At the end of the letter, Lumian reminded: “I’ve already told my messenger and Madame Hela that if anyone writes to me but can’t find me, they should send it to you to handle. Yes, I’m talking about you, Franca. Now you temporarily have a messenger.”
unit.target: In fine epistulae, Lumian recordatus est: “Iam nuntio meo et Domina Hela certiorem feci, quod, si quis mihi scribat sed me invenire nequit, id ad te transferendum sit. Ita, de te loquor, Franca. Nunc tibi nuntius ad tempus habes.”

unit.source: Dammit, he still has to mock me in the end! Franca cursed in a mix of anger and amusement, grinding her teeth.
unit.target: Di immortales, adhuc me in fine deridere debet! Franca, ira et delectatione simul, dentes stridens, maledixit!

unit.source: She thought for a moment and began writing a reply:
unit.target: Paulisper cogitavit et responsum scribere coepit:

unit.source: Nothing much to say, just a reminder: The Demoness of Black told me that Demonesses with color titles occasionally receive revelations from the Primordial One and have strong autonomy.
unit.target: Parum est quid dicere, tantum admonitio: Demonissa Nigra mihi dixit Demonissas cum titulis coloratis, interdum revelationes ab Uno Primordiali accipere et autonomiam validam habere.

unit.source: If they are like this, won’t the Demonesses of Affliction sent to Morora for important tasks also receive revelations, or even some divine power from the figurine?
unit.target: Si ita sunt, num Demonissae Afflictionis, ad Mororam pro rebus gravibus missae, non etiam revelationes accipient, aut etiam aliquam potentiam divinam ex effigie?

unit.source: You should take this issue seriously.
unit.target: Hoc negotium serio accipere debes.

unit.source: Also, it’s time to test your Ascetic endurance.
unit.target: Praeterea, tempus est tolerantiam asceticam tuam probare.

unit.source: If you get bewitched and lose your manhood, even if it grows back every morning, I’ll laugh at you for the rest of your life.
unit.target: Si incantaris et virilitatem amittas, etiam si omni mane regeneretur, totam vitam tuam ridebo.

unit.source: After finishing, Franca folded the paper and took out a rectangular amulet from the Traveler’s Bag that looked like it was made of ice.
unit.target: Postquam finivit, Franca chartam plicavit et ex sacculo Viatoris amuletum rectangulare extraxit, quod, quasi ex glacie factum, videbatur.

unit.source: The amulet was entirely transparent, with patterns and motifs like bubbles inside, flowing and gathering continuously.
unit.target: Amuletum erat omnino transparens, cum figuris et ornamentis instar bullarum interioribus, fluentibus et congregantibus continuo.

unit.source: It was the Ice Amulet given to Franca by the Demoness of Black, allowing seven traversals through the mirror world or fourteen transmissions of information.
unit.target: Hoc erat Amuletum Glaciale, a Demonissa Nigra Francae datum, quod septem transitus per mundum specularum aut quattuordecim transmissiones notitiae concedebat.

unit.source: Franca put on the amulet, held the letter, and returned to the full-length mirror.
unit.target: Franca amuletum induit, epistulam tenuit, et ad speculum totum rediit.

unit.source: With a flash of cold light, she pressed the letter into the mirror surface, letting it fall toward the place the previous message came from.
unit.target: Cum fulgore frigido, epistulam in superficiem speculi premuit, sinens eam cadere versus locum unde prior nuntius venit.

unit.source: Morora.
unit.target: Morora.

unit.source: After reading the letter on the mirror’s surface, Lumian lay back on the bed again.
unit.target: Postquam epistulam in superficie speculi legit, Lumian iterum in lecto recubavit.

unit.source: He anticipated possible surprises.
unit.target: Praevidit eventus inopinatos.

unit.source: Like Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company, coming to kill him at night.
unit.target: Sicut Wanak, dominus Societatis Agricolae Dades, qui nocte ad eum occidendum veniret.

unit.source: This most dangerous criminal in Morora should soon figure out who the exile he confronted in the afternoon was.
unit.target: Hic periculosissimus in Morora mox intellegere debet quis fuerit exsul quem postmeridie occurrisset.

unit.source: He must already know that Lumian killed the Carnivore bar owner and took over the place.
unit.target: Iamdudum scire debet quod Lumian dominum tabernae Carnivoris interfecit et locum obtinuit.

unit.source: Given his attitude, he couldn’t wait to kill Lumian on the spot.
unit.target: Propter eius indolem, non poterat exspectare ut Lumian in loco occideretur.

unit.source: Now, he hoped Wanak would come soon.
unit.target: Nunc sperabat Wanak mox venire.

unit.source: Then, he would teleport away, leaving Julie, the Demoness, for Wanak, letting them have an intense duel.
unit.target: Tum se translocaret, relinquens Julie et Demonissam ad Wanak, sinens eos vehementer certare.

unit.source: That way, he could see what cards Julie had, what items she got from Celeste, and whether Wanak could further use the power of 0-01.
unit.target: Ita videret quae chartae Julie haberet, quae res a Celeste acceperit, et num Wanak ulterius potentiam 0-01 adhibere posset.

unit.source: To Lumian’s disappointment, Wanak didn’t show up all night.
unit.target: Ad delusionem Lumiani, Wanak tota nocte non apparuit.

unit.source: Is there a need to be this cautious? Just come straight here…
unit.target: Num ita cautus esse necesse est? Nunc, directe huc venias…

unit.source: Lumian muttered, getting out of bed and heading downstairs.
unit.target: Lumian ex lecto exiens et deorsum descendens, murmuratione dixit.

unit.source: Chef Lez was already up, preparing breakfast with the kitchen ingredients.
unit.target: Cocus Lez iam surrexit, prandium cum rebus culinae praeparans.

unit.source: “We can resume operations by noon today,” Lez said, glancing at Lumian.
unit.target: “Operatiōnibus ad meridiem hodie resumere possumus,” inquit Lez, Lumian intuens.

unit.source: “But we don’t have any beef, lamb, or pork in stock.”
unit.target: “Sed nullum bubulum, agnum, aut porcinum in copia habemus.”

unit.source: “I’ll give you some startup funds,” Lumian replied, just about to leave the kitchen when he suddenly heard Julie’s footsteps coming down the stairs.
unit.target: “Initium pecuniae tibi dabo,” respondit Lumian, vix ex culina discedens, cum subito audivit vestigia pedum Julie de scalis descendere.

unit.source: An idea crossed his mind, and he casually said to Lez, "By the way, let me tell you about a few people you need to be cautious of. Whatever you do, don’t provoke them.
unit.target: Idea illi occurrit, et ad Lez leviter dixit: “Interim, sinas me narrare de paucis hominibus quibus caveas. Quidquid facias, eos ne provoces.”

unit.source: “First, there’s Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company…”
unit.target: “Primum, est Wanak, dominus Societatis Agricolae Dades…”

unit.source: Lumian relayed all of Gusain’s warnings to Lez and then added, "And another one, named Albus Medici…"
unit.target: Lumian omnes monitiones Gusain ad Lez enarravit, deinde addidit: “Et alter, nomine Albus Medici…”

unit.source: As soon as he mentioned the name, Lumian heard Julie’s footsteps pause momentarily.
unit.target: Statim, cum nomen illud dixisset, Lumian audivit vestigia pedum Julie paulisper subsistere.

unit.source: 804 Consultation
unit.target: 804 Consultatio

unit.source: 804 Consultation
unit.target: 804 Consultatio

unit.source: “He might not use that name in Morora.
unit.target: “Fortasse illum nomen in Morora non utetur.

unit.source: I knew him before and saw him again yesterday when he came to the bar to duel with the owner.
unit.target: Eum antea noveram et heri iterum vidi, cum ad tabernam venit ut cum domino certaret.

unit.source: He has red hair.
unit.target: Crines rubros habet.

unit.source: In Morora, anyone with red hair, no matter the shade, is trouble…”
unit.target: In Morora, quicumque crines rubros gerit, cuiuscumque umbrae sit, periculum est…

unit.source: Lumian described Albus Medici’s appearance in detail.
unit.target: Lumian Albus Medici aspectum minutatim descripsit.

unit.source: Chef Lez nodded.
unit.target: Chef Lez annuit.

unit.source: “I’ll keep that in mind.”
unit.target: “Id in mente tenebo.”

unit.source: “Are you sure? Do you need me to sketch them for you?” Lumian asked earnestly.
unit.target: “Esne certus? Num tibi opus est ut ea delineem?” Lumian sincere quaesivit.

unit.source: He wasn’t just asking Lez but also Julie, who was coming down the stairs slowly.
unit.target: Non solum Lez quaerebat, sed etiam Iuliam, quae lente scala descendebat.

unit.source: He wanted to give the Demoness something to focus on, hoping she’d be aware of Wanak and Albus Medici soon enough, letting trouble collide with trouble to see who was the bigger problem.
unit.target: Volebat daemonissae aliquid ad quo intendere posset, sperans ut mox de Wanak et Albus Medici notam haberet, et sinens difficultates inter se concurrere ut videatur quae maior incommoditas esset.

unit.source: Lez shook his head slowly.
unit.target: Lez caput leniter movit.

unit.source: “No need. I’ll remember them like different ingredients with distinct features.”
unit.target: “Nulla necessitas. Ea meminero tamquam diversos ingredientes cum proprietatibus distinctis.”

unit.source: “Different ingredients, like a turkey?” Lumian imagined Albus Medici looking like a turkey and laughed.
unit.target: “Diversi ingredientes, ut meleagris?” Lumian imaginatus est Albus Medici quasi meleagris aspectum habere et risit.

unit.source: He then handed Lez 200 sassen gold coins to restock the bar with meat and drinks.
unit.target: Deinde Lez tradidit ducentos nummos aureos Sassen ut taberna carnium et potuum reficeretur.

unit.source: As he turned to leave the kitchen, he saw Julie reaching the bottom of the stairs.
unit.target: Dum se ex coquina discedere vertit, Iuliam vidit ad imum gradum scalae pervenire.

unit.source: The Demoness had changed into fresh, clean clothes—an elegant white blouse paired with an ankle‐length green skirt, highlighting her gentle and graceful demeanor.
unit.target: Daemonissa se mutavit in vestimenta recens et pura – elegans tunica alba cum lorā viridā (qui usque ad talōs descendit) quae indolem eius mitissimam atque eleganter habitam ostendit.

unit.source: Lumian suddenly recalled the sounds he heard last night, which contrasted sharply with Julie’s current serene appearance.
unit.target: Lumian subito meminit sonitus, quos nocte priore audiverat, qui acerrime contrarii erant cum sereno vultu Iuliae.

unit.source: His mouth went dry.
unit.target: Os eius aridum factum est.

unit.source: Dammit, this Demoness is subtly using Charm on me!
unit.target: Heu, haec daemonissa subdole mihi incantamentum imponit!

unit.source: It was normal to react, but this strong reaction wasn’t right for an Ascetic like Lumian.
unit.target: Reagere normale erat, sed talis vehementia ascetae ut Lumian non convenit.

unit.source: He looked at Julie and raised an eyebrow.
unit.target: Iuliam aspexit et supercilium levavit.

unit.source: “Do you remember the second rule of the bar?”
unit.target: “Meministine secundam regulam tabernae?”

unit.source: Julie, looking more radiant than yesterday, seemed to glow with inner joy.
unit.target: Iulia, splendentius quam heri, ex interiore gaudio lucebat.

unit.source: Lumian felt an urge to rub his forehead.
unit.target: Lumian desideravit frontem terere.

unit.source: Hey gal, are you really not worried about exposing that Celeste visited you last night?
unit.target: Heus, puella, nonne cures ut patefatur quod Celeste te heri nocte visitaverit?

unit.source: Although you don’t know that I witnessed you sprinting to Celeste yesterday and suffered a huge blow…
unit.target: Quamquam nescis me te heri ad Celeste currere conspectum esse et ingentem ictum passi esse…

unit.source: Julie smiled gently.
unit.target: Iulia leniter subridit.

unit.source: “Don’t harass the boss.”
unit.target: “Noli vexare praefectum.”

unit.source: “You were Charming me just now,” Lumian stated flatly.
unit.target: “Modo me incantavisti,” Lumian aequabiliter dixit.

unit.source: Julie shrank back, feigning fear.
unit.target: Iulia recedebat, simulans timorem.

unit.source: “What… what are you going to do to punish me?”
unit.target: “Quid… quid facies ut me punias?”

unit.source: She acted scared but her eyes sparkled with amusement, as if she was teasing Lumian.
unit.target: Ea se timidum praestitit, sed oculi eius cum ioco micabant, quasi Lumian deriderent.

unit.source: Lumian sighed, half‐genuine, half‐deliberate.
unit.target: Lumian suspiravit, dimidio sincere, dimidio deliberato.

unit.source: “First-time offense can be forgiven. But don’t let it happen again, or else…”
unit.target: “Prima culpa ignoscitur. Sed ne id iterum fiat, alioquin…”

unit.source: He didn’t finish the sentence, leaving an ominous silence.
unit.target: Non confecit sententiam, relinquens silentium ominosum.

unit.source: “Yes, boss!” Julie beamed.
unit.target: “Ita, domine!”

unit.source: She glanced at the door.
unit.target: Ianuam aspexit.

unit.source: “The bar won’t open until noon. Can I go out for a bit?”
unit.target: “Taberna non aperietur usque ad meridiem. Possumne paululum exire?”

unit.source: “Sure,” Lumian teased. “Planning to add to your collection? Do you have a morning exercise routine?”
unit.target: “Certe,” Lumian iocose dixit. “Cogitasne addere ad collectionem tuam? Habesne exercitatio matutina?”

unit.source: “No,” Julie shook her head lightly. “Just want to explore the city more.”
unit.target: “Non,” Iulia caput leve concussit. “Modo urbem amplius explorare volo.”

unit.source: As she left the bar, Lumian immediately teleported ahead, transforming into a shadow creature to follow her.
unit.target: Dum ea tabernam relinquit, Lumian statim se in creaturam umbratam transformavit ut eam sequeretur.

unit.source: But Julie vanished.
unit.target: Sed Iulia evanuit.

unit.source: Invisibility, then wiped her tracks, and did anti-divination?
unit.target: Invisibilitas, deinde vestigia sua delevit, atque contra divinationem processit?

unit.source: Lumian emerged from the shadows, frowning slightly.
unit.target: Lumian ex umbris emersit, leviter frontem contrahens.

unit.source: This meant what Julie was doing this morning was very important.
unit.target: Hoc significabat quod id, quod Iulia hac mane faciebat, valde grave erat.

unit.source: She didn’t want anyone to know!
unit.target: Noluit ut quisquam id sciret!

unit.source: Also, having finally met her lover and found solace, she was more professional now, unlike her near‑breakdown last night.
unit.target: Etiam, postquam tandem amatum suum convenit et solacium invenit, nunc professionalior se gerebat, contra cladem paene heri nocte.

unit.source: This was the normal behavior of a Sequence 5 Demoness of Affliction.
unit.target: Hoc erat habitus normalis daemonissae afflictionis, Sequenciae V.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t too disappointed.
unit.target: Lumian non erat nimis deiectus.

unit.source: At least Julie now knew about Wanak and Albus Medici.
unit.target: Saltem nunc Iulia de Wanak et Albus Medici sciebat.

unit.source: Following the nearest path, he walked towards the cemetery but didn’t dig any graves or sneak underground.
unit.target: Viā proximam sequens, ad coemeterium ambulavit, sed nec sepulcra effodit nec sub terram furtim accessit.

unit.source: Instead, he went straight into the library‑like Knowledge Cathedral.
unit.target: Proinde directo ingressus est in cathedralem Scientiae, bibliothecam similem.

unit.source: Today, he was not merely tracking Julie.
unit.target: Hodie non tantum Iuliam sequeretur.

unit.source: His main goal was to visit Archbishop Heraberg of Morora.
unit.target: Summum propositum eius erat Archiepiscopum Heraberg de Morora visitare.

unit.source: The title of Morora’s Archbishop was Lumian’s creation.
unit.target: Titulus Archiepiscopi Mororae a Lumiano creatus erat.

unit.source: After all, this puppet‑like clergy member of the Church of Knowledge claimed to oversee all theological affairs in Morora.
unit.target: Nam hic membrum clericii, quasi marionetta Ecclesiae Scientiae, asserebat omnia negotia theologica in Morora sub sua potestate esse.

unit.source: Lumian felt that since the Church of Knowledge had ‘recommended’ him into Morora without confiscating his mystical items, direct inquiry about the underground mausoleum might be surprisingly effective rather than probing indirectly.
unit.target: Lumian sensit quod, cum Ecclesia Scientiae eum in Morora sine confiscandis rebus mysticis “commendaverit”, directa inquisitio de mausoleo subterraneo prorsus miro modo efficax foret potius quam indirecta indagatio.

unit.source: This was also a test.
unit.target: Hoc etiam probatio erat.

unit.source: Lumian wanted to see if the sealing information about 0‑01 was given only to him or distributed to all eligible individuals.
unit.target: Lumian videre cupiebat utrum notitia de sigillo circa 0‑01 soli ei data esset an omnibus idoneis distributa.

unit.source: Did the Church of Knowledge place its bet solely on him, or did it hedge its bets across multiple candidates?
unit.target: Num Ecclesia Scientiae tantum in eum sors posuerit, an in pluribus candidatis fidem deposuerit?

unit.source: Inside the radiant holy cathedral, Lumian found Heraberg, with his graying hair, kind eyes, and white robe with brass embroidery, standing by a brass bookshelf, quietly reading a thick book.
unit.target: Intra splendidam cathedralem sanctam, Lumian Heraberg invenit, cum capillis canitie factis, oculis benignis, et toga alba cum ornamentis aereis, stantem iuxta armariam auream, librum crassum tacite legens.

unit.source: “Archbishop,” Lumian called tentatively.
unit.target: “Archiepiscopus,” Lumian dubitanter vocavit.

unit.source: Heraberg looked up and asked warmly, “What puzzles you?”
unit.target: Heraberg sursum aspexit et benigne quaesivit: “Quid te perplexum facit?”

unit.source: Lumian chose his words carefully.
unit.target: Lumian verba sua caute elegit.

unit.source: “If I want to enter the cemetery’s underground section to find something, how can I avoid the dangers?”
unit.target: “Si in subterraneam coemeterii partem ingredi voluerim ad aliquid invenire, quomodo pericula vitare possim?”

unit.source: Heraberg smiled and pointed to the brass bookshelf beside him.
unit.target: Heraberg subridens ad armariam auream iuxta se stantem digitum extulit.

unit.source: “This one, this one, and this one… read them all thoroughly.”
unit.target: “Hunc, hunc, et hunc… omnes diligenter lege.”

unit.source: Lumian followed his gesture, mentally noting the book titles:
unit.target: Lumian signum eius secutus, titulos librorum mente notans:

unit.source: “Morora Residents’ Code,”
unit.target: “Codex Incolarum Mororae,”

unit.source: “Doll Crafting and Maintenance,”
unit.target: “Ars Pupae conficiendae et conservandae,”

unit.source: “Examples of Mausoleum Construction,”
unit.target: “Exempla Aedificii Mausolei,”

unit.source: “Principles of Sealing”…
unit.target: “Principia Sigillandi”…

unit.source: What use is this for a Hunter like me?
unit.target: “Quid hoc prodest venatori sicut ego?”

unit.source: I’m not a Reader who can wield knowledge directly.
unit.target: “Non sum lector qui scientiam directe adhibere possit.”

unit.source: Does this mean that by absorbing the knowledge in these books, I can grasp the layout of the underground mausoleum, understand the sealing mechanisms, and find a way to leave my mark on 0‑01?
unit.target: “Significatne hoc quod, scientiam his libris absorptam, possim dispositionem mausolei subterranei comprehendere, mechanismos sigillandi intellegere, atque viam invenire ut vestigium meum in 0‑01 relinquam?”

unit.source: Lumian thought deeply as he withdrew his gaze.
unit.target: Lumian profunde cogitavit dum oculos avertit.

unit.source: Heraberg continued, “Once you’ve read those, complete these test papers. You must score perfectly on each one.”
unit.target: Heraberg perrexit: “Postquam illa legisti, has chartas probationis confice; in quaelibet nota perfecte assequenda est.”

unit.source: Lumian looked at the stack of test papers filling a shelf.
unit.target: Lumian aspexit super catervam chartarum probationis quae armariam implebant.

unit.source: His forehead twitched, recalling some unpleasant memories.
unit.target: Frons eius convulsus est, non jucundas memorias revocans.

unit.source: He maintained a neutral expression, confirming, “So, once I finish reading and acing these tests, I can avoid the underground dangers?”
unit.target: Vultum neutrum retinuit, dicens: “Ita ergo, postquam has chartas legero atque expediam, pericula subterranea vitare possum?”

unit.source: Heraberg pointed to another brass bookshelf.
unit.target: Heraberg ad aliam armariam auream digitum extulit.

unit.source: “That one, that one, and that one. Master all the knowledge on those shelves, and you’ll be well‑prepared.”
unit.target: “Illam, illam, et illam. Omnem scientiam in istis armariis percipe, et bene praeparatus eris.”

unit.source: Three shelves? Lumian’s lips twitched slightly.
unit.target: “Tres armaria? Labra Luminiani leviter contrectabantur.”

unit.source: That’s about two or three hundred books, plus thousands of test papers, right?
unit.target: “Id est circiter ducenti aut trecenti libri, praeterea milia chartarum probationis, nonne?”

unit.source: Heraberg smiled and sighed.
unit.target: Heraberg subridens suspiravit.

unit.source: “Remember, knowledge equals power, and knowledge equals wealth. All the answers you seek lie within.”
unit.target: “Memento, scientia potentia est, et scientia divitia est; omnia responsa quae quaeris intus iacent.”

unit.source: Lumian’s expression shifted as he bit his lip and said, “I’ll start with these.”
unit.target: Vultus Luminiani mutatus est dum labium mordebat, et dixit: “His incipiam.”

unit.source: He pulled out the initial books Heraberg pointed out.
unit.target: Extraxit libros initios quos Heraberg indicaverat.

unit.source: Heraberg nodded approvingly.
unit.target: Heraberg annuit approbans.

unit.source: “A Hunter who learns and pursues knowledge is the most powerful Hunter.
unit.target: “Venator qui discit et scientiam persequitur, potentissimus venator est.

unit.source: “It’s been years since another Hunter came to me, willing to patiently read the designated books.
unit.target: “Multos annos praeterierunt ex quo alius venator ad me venit, paratus designatos libros paciente legere.

unit.source: The others, with red or thick hair, won’t even step into the Holy Temple of Knowledge, let alone approach these bookshelves.”
unit.target: “Ceteri, cum crinibus rubris aut densis, ne in Templum Sanctum Scientiae quidem intrabunt, quanto minus ad has armarias appropinquare.”

unit.source: It’s because Aurore instilled a reading habit in me from a young age…
unit.target: “Nam Aurore in me consuetudinem legendi a tenera aetate intulit…”

unit.source: Lumian thought, feeling a pang of sadness.
unit.target: Lumian cogitavit, tristitiae acerrimam sentiens.

unit.source: He placed the books into his Traveler’s Bag, bid farewell to Heraberg, and walked towards the Knowledge Cathedral’s entrance.
unit.target: Libros in sacco Viatoris posuit, Heraberg valedixit, et ad ingressum Cathedralis Scientiae ambulavit.

unit.source: Along the way, he saw a familiar figure—Guei, who had been exiled to Morora with him.
unit.target: In via, vidit figuram familiaris—Guei, qui cum eo in Morora exsulatus erat.

unit.source: The scholarly‑looking Guei, now dressed in thick, cotton clothing, stood by a brass bookshelf, engrossed in a book by the light of the stained glass window.
unit.target: Guei, erudito speciei, nunc in vestibus spessis ex contextu indutus, stetit iuxta armariam auream, in libro luce fenestrae vitreae absorptus.

unit.source: After a few seconds, Lumian walked over, smiling.
unit.target: Post paucos secundos, Lumian accessit, subridente.

unit.source: “What a coincidence. Why are you here reading?”
unit.target: “Quale casus! Cur hic legis?”

unit.source: Guei smiled faintly.
unit.target: Guei leviter subridit.

unit.source: “Didn’t I tell you yesterday? I regret not knowing enough. Now, with such a vast library, how could I pass up the chance to learn? What brings you here?”
unit.target: “Nonne heri tibi dixi? Paenitet me quod satis non scivi. Nunc, cum tam vasta bibliotheca sit, quomodo occasionem discendi praetermitterem? Quid te hic adducit?”

unit.source: “To ask if it’s too late to convert to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom,” Lumian joked, then changed the topic.
unit.target: “Ad quaestionem: num sero sit ad Deum Scientiae et Sapientiae converti,” iocavit Lumian, deinde argumentum mutavit.

unit.source: “Have you found a job yet?”
unit.target: “Num iam munus invenisti?”

unit.source: “Not yet,” Guei shook his head lightly.
unit.target: “Nondum,” Guei caput leviter concussit.

unit.source: “I don’t want to work on a farm or in a factory as some exile’s slave.
unit.target: “Nolo in agro aut in fabrica laborare ut servus cuiusdam exsulis;

unit.source: I’m planning to study for a while.
unit.target: intendo aliquantulum studere.

unit.source: Fortunately, I had some luck yesterday and earned some money, so I don’t have to worry about going hungry.”
unit.target: Fortunate, heri quidam fortuna mihi adfuit et pecuniam lucratus sum, itaque de fames non sollicitus sum.

unit.source: Lumian chatted with Guei for a bit before waving goodbye to the secretive serial killer and returning to the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Lumian cum Guei paulo sermocinatus est, antequam occulto interfectori seriali vale dixit et ad tabernam Carnivorum rediit.

unit.source: He found a spot by the window and began reading the borrowed books in a comfortable position.
unit.target: Invenit locum iuxta fenestram et libros mutuatos in loco commodo legere coepit.

unit.source: Morora’s sunlight alternated between bright and hidden by storm clouds, but it didn’t affect Lumian’s reading as he had his radiant fireball lamp.
unit.target: Sol Mororae inter claritatem atque nubibus tempestatis absconditum alterbat, sed lectio Luminiani non immutabatur, cum lampadem ignis radiante haberet.

unit.source: Near noon, Julie returned, her steps light, her face smiling, exuding a charm that even made Chef Lez steal a few glances at her.
unit.target: Prope meridiem, Iulia rediit, gradibus levis, facie subridente, venustatem effundens, quae etiam Chef Lez paucos intuitus ab ea subripuit.

unit.source: Julie gave Lumian a curious look.
unit.target: Iulia Luminiano aspectum curiosum dedit.

unit.source: “You’re reading?”
unit.target: “Legis?”

unit.source: “Not much else to do,” Lumian replied casually.
unit.target: “Non multum aliud,” Lumian respondit leve.

unit.source: Julie had no interest in the books; she withdrew her gaze and went upstairs, likely looking for waitress attire.
unit.target: Iulia de libris nihil curabat; oculos avertit et sursum ascendit, verisimiliter vestimenta ministrarum quaerens.

unit.source: Lumian clicked his tongue silently.
unit.target: Lumian linguam leviter frotavit tacite.

unit.source: Really, knowledge is power, and knowledge is wealth.
unit.target: Revera, scientia potentia est, et scientia divitia est.

unit.source: Aren’t you curious about what I’m reading?
unit.target: Nonne curiosa es quid legam?

unit.source: Lez approached and said, “Boss, lunch is ready.”
unit.target: Lez accessit et dixit: “Domine, prandium paratum est.”

unit.source: Lumian nodded, put away the books, and stood up.
unit.target: Lumian annuit, libros recondidit, et surrexit.

unit.source: He thought for a moment and said to Lez, “Find a red cloth and hang it at the door.”
unit.target: Paulisper meditatus est et Lez dixit: “Inveni pannum rubrum et ad ostium appende.”

unit.source: 805 Test
unit.target: 805 Experimentum

unit.source: 805 Test
unit.target: 805 Experimentum

unit.source: Lez didn’t ask why.
unit.target: Lez non rogavit cur.

unit.source: He went upstairs, found a piece of red cloth, and hung it at the entrance of the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Ascendit, pannum rubrum invenit, et ad ostium tabernae Carnivorae suspendit.

unit.source: Lumian then sat at the newly rebuilt bar, enjoying the spiced, marinated roast beef with soft, delicious bread.
unit.target: Lumian tunc ad tabernam nuper refectam consedit, gaudens degustare carnem bovis assam, conditam et marinatam, cum pane molli et delicato.

unit.source: As time passed, more and more customers entered the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Tempore procedente, magis ac magis clientes in tabernam Carnivorae intraverunt.

unit.source: Lez had put up a wooden stand outside with a new menu and corresponding prices.
unit.target: Lez extra posuit stativum ligneum cum novo menu et pretiis congruentibus.

unit.source: Of course, this wasn’t the main reason for the influx of customers.
unit.target: Certe, hoc non erat principalis causa influxus clientium.

unit.source: The primary reason was the incredibly low prices on the menu.
unit.target: Causa primaria erant pretia in menu incredibiliter humilia.

unit.source: After all, there was no owner to take a cut.
unit.target: Post omnia, nullus dominus erat qui partem acciperet.

unit.source: The customers came in with a sense of skepticism.
unit.target: Clientes cum sensu dubitationis intraverunt.

unit.source: They didn’t have much faith in the bar under new ownership, repeatedly checking if the prices were real, if there were any hidden costs, and if the portions and quality of the food were as advertised.
unit.target: Non multam fidem habebant in taberna sub nova potestate, iterumque atque iterum perscrutantes an pretia vera essent, an expensa occulta haberentur, et an portiones atque qualitas cibi iuxta praeconata essent.

unit.source: This skepticism stemmed from being frequently deceived by Morora’s unscrupulous merchants.
unit.target: Haec dubitatio orta est ex eo quod saepe mercatoribus Mororae sine scrupulo decepti erant.

unit.source: Those merchants had a point, though: “We’ve been exiled here for serious crimes.
unit.target: Illi mercatores tamen habebant rationem: “Exsuli sumus hic propter crimina gravia.

unit.source: You can’t expect us to run honest businesses, can you?
unit.target: Non potes exspectare ut negotia honesta curemus, nonne?

unit.source: Besides, the Morora Resident Code doesn’t prohibit false pricing or inferior goods, and the enforcers won’t check the kitchen’s hygiene.”
unit.target: Praeterea, Codex Incolarum Mororae non vetat falsam praevaluationem neque bona inferiora, et custodes hygienam culinae non inspiciunt.”

unit.source: Most customers were angry but helpless.
unit.target: Plurimi clientes irati erant sed impotentes.

unit.source: Those merchants they could deal with had already been eliminated.
unit.target: Mercatores, quibus tractare poterant, iam exstincti erant.

unit.source: The remaining ones were too powerful to confront.
unit.target: Reliqui nimis potentes erant ad eos oppugnandos.

unit.source: They often regretted not keeping a few manageable merchants around to ensure food quality and fair pricing through regular supervision.
unit.target: Saepe paenitebant quod paucos mercatores tractabiles non retinuerunt, qui curarent qualitatem cibi et pretia aequa per regularis vigilantiam.

unit.source: Sometimes, killing wasn’t the best solution.
unit.target: Aliquando, interficere non erat optima solutio.

unit.source: “If I had understood that, I wouldn’t have been exiled to Morora!”
unit.target: “Si id intellexeram, in Morora non exsul essem!”

unit.source: A man in his forties voiced his opinion while holding a beer with white foam.
unit.target: Vir in annis quadragenariis suam sententiam dixerat, tenens cervisiam cum spuma alba.

unit.source: His gaze kept shifting to Julie, temporarily acting as the bartender, hoping to catch her attention with his words and demeanor.
unit.target: Aspectus eius iterum atque iterum ad Julie vertebatur, quae pro tempore caupo agebat, sperans verba et habitum suum ad eam allicere.

unit.source: Low prices drew them in, but the pretty bartender made them stay for another drink.
unit.target: Pretia humilia eos attraxerunt, sed pulchra caupona eos ad alium potum manere fecit.

unit.source: Lumian forked a piece of perfectly roasted beef, savoring the combination of Lez’s secret spices and the tender meat.
unit.target: Lumian partem carnis bovis assae perfecte coctae arripuit, fruens coniunctionem specierum secretarum Lez et teneri carnis.

unit.source: He wondered if, after leaving Morora, he should have Ludwig become a head chef.
unit.target: Cogitavit num, postquam Mororam relinqueret, Ludwig caput coquinae fieret.

unit.source: Can’t waste a Chef’s talent!
unit.target: Ingenium coqui non spreandum est!

unit.source: After finishing lunch, Lumian took a glass of strong liquor and walked around the hall as the bar owner, piecing together the current situation in Morora from different customers.
unit.target: Postquam prandium finitum habuit, Lumian vitrem liquoris validi cepit et per atrium, tamquam dominus tabernae, ambulavit, ex diversis clientibus condicionem Mororae contexens.

unit.source: Not long after the establishment of this City of Exiles, a class division emerged, mainly based on power.
unit.target: Non longe post institutionem huius Urbis Exsulorum, divisio classium orta est, praesertim ex potentia.

unit.source: Today, the Beyonders firmly controlled all key positions in Morora, holding the resources like food, meat, vegetables, dairy products, various minerals, factory goods, sales channels, and street shops.
unit.target: Hodie, Beyonderes firmiter omnes positiones clavis in Morora imperabant, tenentes opes ut cibum, carnes, olera, producta lactea, varia mineralia, merces fabricarum, canales venditionis, et tabernas viarias.

unit.source: Ordinary criminals without supernatural powers could only serve them, working on farms, in mines, ranches, factories, etc.
unit.target: Criminales vulgares, sine viribus supernaturalis, eis solum inservire poterant, operantes in agris, in fodinis, in praediis, in officiis, etc.

unit.source: The better-off were employees; the worse-off were nearly slaves.
unit.target: Meliores erant operarii; inferiores fere servi erant.

unit.source: For these ordinary criminals, the ultimate dream was to gain the trust of a powerful Beyonder and receive unwanted Beyonder characteristics as rewards after a duel.
unit.target: Pro his criminalibus vulgariis, ultimus somnium erat fiduciam potentis Beyonderis adipisci atque proprietates indesideratas Beyonderis, ut praemia post certamen acciperent.

unit.source: This is exactly what the Iron and Blood Cross Order dreamed of, Lumian mused with a chuckle after returning to his seat at the bar.
unit.target: Hoc ipsud est quod Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis somniavit, inquit Lumian subridens postquam ad sedem suam in taberna rediit.

unit.source: As a former member of the Iron and Blood Cross Order, he often mocked the awkward “preaching” and “rituals,” but it helped him grasp the core ideology of the Iron and Blood Cross Order:
unit.target: Ut pristinus membrum Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis, saepe deridebat ineptam praedicationem et ritus, sed id eum adiuvabat ut nucleum ideologicum Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis caperet.

unit.source: They wanted to establish a world where Beyonders no longer hid but gained status through power.
unit.target: Volebant mundum instituere, in quo Beyonderes non iam latebant sed per potentiam statum adipiscebant.

unit.source: Morora seemed to embody this vision.
unit.target: Morora videbatur hanc visionem incarnare.

unit.source: Lumian was about to finish his drink and find a quiet place upstairs to study when he noticed Gusain, the gentleman, entering the bar.
unit.target: Lumian iam potionem finire parabat et quietum locum in superiore qua studeret quaerebat, cum notavit Gusain, virum urbanum, tabernam intrantem.

unit.source: You came quickly…
unit.target: Celeriter venisti…

unit.source: Someone’s been watching this place?
unit.target: Aliquisne hunc locum observavit?

unit.source: Lumian played with his glass.
unit.target: Lumian vitrem suum luserat.

unit.source: Gusain sat beside him, removed his top hat, and addressed Julie, who wore a white blouse, black vest, and a dark tie with a unique charm, “A Lanti Proof.”
unit.target: Gusain iuxta eum consedit, pileum superiorem sustraxit, et ad Julie, quae albam tunicam, atrum vestem, et obscurum nodum cum singulari venustate gerebat, locutus est: “A Lanti Proof.”

unit.source: In Morora, the most popular drinks were rye beer, Lanti Proof, and red wine.
unit.target: In Morora, potiones maxime populares erant cervisia secalis, Lanti Proof, et vinum rubrum.

unit.source: Lumian took out paper and pen from his Traveler’s Bag and started sketching on the bar counter.
unit.target: Lumian ex sacculo viatoris chartam et calamum extraxit, et in mensa tabernae delineare coepit.

unit.source: Gusain waited until Julie handed him the Lanti Proof, took a sip, and then smiled ahead.
unit.target: Gusain exspectavit donec Julie ei Lanti Proof tradidit, sorbuit, et deinde subridens prospexit.

unit.source: “You made your decision faster than I expected.”
unit.target: “Celerius decrevistī quam ego exspectābam.”

unit.source: “I don’t want to be tied down like this,” Lumian replied with a hidden meaning—his true intention was that he didn’t want to stay in Morora long, while Gusain interpreted it as him not wanting to remain under the Church of Knowledge’s rule.
unit.target: “Nolo me tali modo vincire,” respondit Lumian, subnubiliter indicans se non velle diu in Morora manere, dum Gusain id interpretavit ut non velle sub regimine Ecclesiae Cognitionis manere.

unit.source: “That’s a choice all strong people make.
unit.target: “Illa electio est quam omnes fortes faciunt.

unit.source: Eagles don’t mingle with sparrows,” Gusain praised.
unit.target: “Aquilae cum passeribus non miscuntur,” laudavit Gusain.

unit.source: Lumian, still sketching, laughed.
unit.target: Lumian, adhuc delineans, risit.

unit.source: “Now, you need to convince me that you have a promising future.
unit.target: “Nunc, oportet me convincere te futurum promissum habere.

unit.source: I won’t stand with losers.”
unit.target: Non stabo cum perditoribus.

unit.source: “I’ve incited dozens of riots and haven’t been caught by the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: “Dozenas tumultus excitavi, et a Ecclesia Cognitionis non comprehensus sum.

unit.source: Isn’t that reason enough?” Gusain sipped his Lanti Proof.
unit.target: “Nonne hoc iam satis est?” Gusain Lanti Proof sorbuit.

unit.source: Lumian shook his head.
unit.target: Lumian caput concussit.

unit.source: “In my hometown, there’s a saying, ‘One swallow doesn’t make a summer.’
unit.target: “In patria mea, dicitur: “Una hirundo non facit ver.”

unit.source: It means that a single event can’t predict a season.
unit.target: Id significat unum eventum non posse totam aetatem praedicere.

unit.source: Making hasty judgments based on isolated incidents is unwise.”
unit.target: Festinanter ex casibus isolatis iudicare imprudens est.

unit.source: “What do you need to be convinced?” Gusain tilted his head.
unit.target: “Quid tibi opus est ut convincaris?” Gusain caput inclinavit.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled in response.
unit.target: Lumian subridens respondit.

unit.source: “Pass my test.”
unit.target: “Supera probationem meam.”

unit.source: Gusain paused for a moment, then laughed.
unit.target: Gusain paulisper cessavit, deinde risit.

unit.source: “Normally, wouldn’t it be our organization testing new members to see if they’re qualified?
unit.target: Normaliter, num non solet nostra organizatione novos membra probare, ut videat an idonei sint?

unit.source: How did it become the other way around?”
unit.target: Quomodo conversum est?

unit.source: “It depends on the new member’s strength and importance, not past experiences,” Lumian said, with an expression suggesting he didn’t need them to stir up trouble—he could form his own team.
unit.target: “Hoc pendet ex viribus et momentis novi membri, non ex priscis experimentis,” inquit Lumian, vultu indicante se non eos ad tumultum excitandum require, sed suam ipsam turmam constituere posse.

unit.source: Gusain drank his Lanti Proof, then said, “What do you want us to do?”
unit.target: Gusain Lanti Proof sorbuit, deinde dixit: “Quid vis ut faciamus?”

unit.source: Lumian remained silent until he finished his sketch, then pushed the paper toward Gusain.
unit.target: Lumian silentium retinuit usque ad finem delineationis, deinde chartam ad Gusain protraxit.

unit.source: “Find this person.”
unit.target: “Invenias hunc.”

unit.source: The drawing was of Albus Medici.
unit.target: Delineatio erat de Albo Medici.

unit.source: Although Lumian’s drawing skills weren’t high, his precise control as a Hunter, his deep memory of the subject, and mental reconstruction made Albus Medici’s likeness vivid, capturing his aggressive, unpleasant aura.
unit.target: Quamquam ars delineandi Lumiani non alta erat, eius accurata disciplina venatoria, memoria profunda rei, atque reconstructio mentis effecit ut imago Albi Medici vivesceret, exprimens eius aerem aggressivum et incommodum.

unit.source: “Him?” Gusain asked, confirming as he held the drawing.
unit.target: “Eum?” inquit Gusain, confirmans, dum delineationem tenebat.

unit.source: Lumian nodded slightly.
unit.target: Lumian leviter annuit.

unit.source: “His real name is Albus Medici. I don’t know if he’s using an alias in Morora.”
unit.target: “Nomen verum eius est Albus Medici; nescio an in Morora nomine aliquo uterit.”

unit.source: “Medici…” Gusain repeated the last name softly.
unit.target: “Medici…” repetivit Gusain leniter.

unit.source: He folded the drawing, tucked it into his pocket, then picked up his drink.
unit.target: Delineationem plicavit, eam in sinum recondidit, deinde potionem assumpsit.

unit.source: “You can test us, but we need to test you too.
unit.target: “Nos probare potes, sed te quoque probare oportet.

unit.source: You must prove your capabilities.”
unit.target: Debes facultates tuas probare.

unit.source: “Killing the original owner of this bar isn’t enough?” Lumian smiled.
unit.target: “Interficere dominum originarium huius tabernae non sufficit?” subridit Lumian.

unit.source: “Or do you want to duel me?”
unit.target: “An me certare vis?”

unit.source: Gusain, maintaining his gentlemanly demeanor, shook his head.
unit.target: Gusain, urbane se gerens, caput concussit.

unit.source: “We acknowledge your strength. Now we need to test other aspects.”
unit.target: “Agnoscimus tuam potentiam. Nunc oportet nos alias res probare.”

unit.source: Lumian, holding his glass, turned to Gusain, waiting for him to elaborate.
unit.target: Lumian, vitrem tenens, ad Gusain se vertit, exspectans ut amplius explicaret.

unit.source: Gusain glanced around, his eyes resting on the irresistibly charming Julie for a moment.
unit.target: Gusain circumspiciens, oculis per momentum in Julie quievantibus, mansit.

unit.source: Lowering his voice, he said, “The Church of Knowledge’s control over Morora relies on something in the underground mausoleum of the cemetery.
unit.target: Vox suam leniorem faciens, inquit: “Dominatio Ecclesiae Cognitionis super Mororam innititur quadam re in subterraneo mausoleo coemeterii.

unit.source: Our ultimate goal is to break in and take control of it.”
unit.target: Propositum nostrum ultimum est irrumpere et imperium eius capere.”

unit.source: “It’s very dangerous.
unit.target: “Valde periculosum est.

unit.source: We found a similar place to train our members.
unit.target: Similem locum invenimus ad exercendum membra nostra.

unit.source: Your test is to enter that fog‐covered underground area, overcome the challenges, and reach the marked location.”
unit.target: Probatio tua est ingredere illam regionem subterraneam caligine obductam, provocationes superare, et ad locum signatum pervenire.

unit.source: The goal is still 0-01?
unit.target: Num finis adhuc 0-01 est?

unit.source: Lumian thought for a few seconds and said, “Alright, when do we start?”
unit.target: Lumian aliquot secundis cogitavit et dixit: “Bene, quando incipiemus?”

unit.source: “Tonight,” Gussin finished his Lanti Proof, paid, and left the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: “Hac nocte,” finivit Gussin Lanti Proof, solvit, et tabernam Carnivoram discessit.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Julie, noticing she was dealing with customers politely and reservedly, seemingly unaware of his conversation with Gusain.
unit.target: Lumian Julie aspiciebat, animadvertens eam clientes comiter et circumspecte tractare, quasi sermonem eius cum Gusain nesceret.

unit.source: Heh… Lumian smirked inwardly, set down his glass, and headed upstairs.
unit.target: Heh… Lumian interiora subridens, vitrem deponens, et ad superiores conclavia perrexit.

unit.source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai
unit.target: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartmentum 702, 9 Rue Orosai

unit.source: “Jenna should be back the day after tomorrow, right?” Franca murmured, standing by the living room window, a bit wistful and fearful.
unit.target: “Jenna postridie redibit, nonne?” submurmuravit Franca, stans iuxta fenestram atrii, paulo desiderans et timens.

unit.source: Her face alternated between light and shadow against the deep night and streetlights, like an enchanting dream.
unit.target: Vultus eius inter lucem et umbram alternabat sub nocte profunda et luminibus viarum, velut somnium incantans.

unit.source: Suddenly, she saw Penitent Baynfel, dressed in black clerical robes and looking like a charred corpse, emerge from the void, holding a letter.
unit.target: Subito, vidit Penitentem Baynfel, indutum in nigris vestimentis clericalibus et quasi cadaver ustum apparens, ex inania emergere, epistulam tenens.

unit.source: A letter?
unit.target: Epistula?

unit.source: Who’s writing to Lumian?
unit.target: Quis ad Lumian scribit?

unit.source: Hmm, Baynfel’s appearance here means messengers can’t locate Morora, even those with special contracts…
unit.target: Hmm, apparit Baynfel hic, quod significat nuntios Mororam reperire non posse, etiam eos cum contractibus specialibus.

unit.source: Franca accepted the letter with a polite smile.
unit.target: Franca epistulam comiter subridens accepit.

unit.source: “Thank you.”
unit.target: “Gratias.”

unit.source: Baynfel nodded, turned, and vanished into the night outside the window.
unit.target: Baynfel annuit, se vertit, et in noctem extra fenestram evanuit.

unit.source: Franca sighed and mumbled, “I wanted to build a relationship and ask you to introduce me to a messenger…”
unit.target: Franca suspiravit et submurmuravit: “Volebam relationem condere et te rogare ut mihi nuntium adduceres…”

unit.source: She raised her right hand, catching a mixed scent of powder, perfume, grass, flowers, and spices from the letter.
unit.target: Dexteram manum levavit, captans mixtum odorem pulveris, unguenti, graminis, florum, et specierum ex epistula.

unit.source: A letter from a woman?
unit.target: Epistula a femina?

unit.source: Franca, entrusted by Lumian, muttered as she opened the letter and read it.
unit.target: Franca, a Lumiano commissa, submurmuravit, dum epistulam aperiebat et legebat.

unit.source: “Not sure if I should call you Monsieur Louis Berry or Monsieur Lumian Lee.
unit.target: “Nescio utrum te appellare debeam “Monsieur Louis Berry” aut “Monsieur Lumian Lee.”

unit.source: “Through Rhea, I’ve delved into Matani’s mysticism circle, learning much about the mysticism and realizing I’m not weak—just inexperienced and unable to show it. For real.
unit.target: “Per Rhea, in circulum mysticismi Matani penitus immeritus sum, multa de mystica didiciens, atque animadvertens me non esse infirmum, sed solum inexperientem et id ostendere non posse. Vere.

unit.source: “Of course, I’ve also realized the gap between us and how vast the world is beyond Matani.
unit.target: “Certe, etiam animadverti spatium inter nos ac quam immensus mundus extra Matani sit.

unit.source: “I’m willing to help your friend and hope you’ll keep your promise.
unit.target: “Parata sum ad auxilium amico tuo ferendum, atque spero te promissionem tuam servare.

unit.source: “Amandina.”
unit.target: Amandina.

unit.source: 806 Expressing Goodwill
unit.target: 806: Expressio Benevolentiae

unit.source: 806 Expressing Goodwill
unit.target: 806: Expressio Benevolentiae

unit.source: Amandina? If it were anyone else, Franca might not have remembered, but she couldn’t forget this participant of the Dream Festival, a girl who called the Underworld Daoist her teacher.
unit.target: Amandina? Si quis alius esset, Franca fortasse non meminisset, sed hanc participantem Festi Somniorum oblivisci non potuit, puellam quae Daoistae Inferorum ut magistrum suum appellabat.

unit.source: Franca later summoned the Armored Shadow Chen Tu for more information, and she might even need Amandina’s help.
unit.target: Franca postea “Armored Shadow Chen Tu” ad plura cognoscenda evocavit, atque fortasse etiam Amandinae auxilium opus esse putavit.

unit.source: With this in mind, Franca reached into her Traveler’s Bag and counted her accumulated gold.
unit.target: Hoc mente servato, Franca manum in marsupio viatoris suo inseruit et aurum cumulatum numeravit.

unit.source: Including the final payment from a member of the Curly-Haired Baboon Research Society, she now had gold worth 82,000 verl d’or and nearly 20,000 verl d’or in cash.
unit.target: Incluso solutione finali a membro Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispis Capillis, nunc habebat aurum valoris 82,000 verl d’or et fere 20,000 verl d’or in nummis.

unit.source: With a little exchange, it would be enough to meet the requirements of the Armored Shadow, Chen Tu, for a conversation.
unit.target: Parvo commercio, satis erit ut requisita “Armored Shadow Chen Tu” ad colloquium obtemperanda assequantur.

unit.source: Of course, Franca didn’t plan to do this anytime soon.
unit.target: Certe, Franca non statuit haec cito agere.

unit.source: First, Lumian was in Morora.
unit.target: Primum, Lumian in Morora aderat.

unit.source: Without using his special connection with the contract target, even knowing the Armored Shadow’s name as Chen Tu, Franca wasn’t sure she could summon the spirit from the original world.
unit.target: Non utens speciali nexu suo cum proposito contractus, etiam si “Armored Shadow” sub nomine Chen Tu notum esset, Franca non certo sciebat se posse spiritum ex mundo originali evocare.

unit.source: After all, that might not be its true name, and translating it into ancient Hermes or other mystical languages might correspond to different spirit world creatures.
unit.target: Nam fortasse id verum nomen non esset, et transferre illud in antiquam linguam, ut hypocrisinam aut alias mysticas, diversis creaturis ex mundo spirituum convenire posset.

unit.source: Secondly, facing the Armored Shadow without a demigod present would likely be extremely dangerous.
unit.target: Secundo, adversari “Armored Shadow” sine semideo praesentis valde periculosum esse videbatur.

unit.source: Amandina’s presence might partially substitute for a demigod, intimidating the Armored Shadow.
unit.target: Praesentia Amandinae partim semideum substituere potuit, ita “Armored Shadow” intimire velle.

unit.source: Should we wait for Lumian to return from Morora before summoning Chen Tu again?
unit.target: Exspectamusne ut Lumian ex Morora redeat, antequam Chen Tu iterum evocarer?

unit.source: Franca felt a mix of excitement and apprehension, a state known as “near-home anxiety.”
unit.target: Franca sensit mixturam excitationis et timoris, statum notum ut “angor prope domum.”

unit.source: After a moment, she exhaled slowly, deciding to respond to Amandina on Lumian’s behalf.
unit.target: Post paulum, lente exhalavit et decrevit pro Lumian, Amandinae respondeat.

unit.source: Hmm, Lumian promised to take Amandina to the area around the Samaritan Woman’s Spring, giving her a chance to meet the Underworld Daoist outside of the Dream Festival.
unit.target: Hmm, Lumian pollicitus est Amandinam ad aream circa Fons Feminae Samaritanae ducere, ita ei occasionem praebens ut Daoistam Inferorum extra Festum Somniorum conveniret.

unit.source: This is beneficial for us, but it’s too dangerous with my current strength.
unit.target: Hoc nobis utile est, sed cum mea vi praesenti nimis periculosum videtur.

unit.source: Besides, I’m not sure if the power brought by The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings combined with the Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana identity can penetrate the fog around the Samaritan Woman’s Spring.
unit.target: Praeterea, non certo mihi videtur an potentia a “Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings” missa, cum identitate Minor Arcana “Tarot Club”, nebulae circa Fons Feminae Samaritanae penetrare valeat.

unit.source: We should wait until Lumian is out of Morora.
unit.target: Exspectandum est donec Lumian e Morora discedat.

unit.source: For now, I’ll show Amandina some goodwill to lay the groundwork for future cooperation…
unit.target: Nunc autem, Amandinae benevolentiam ostendam, ut fundamenta futurae cooperationis ponantur…

unit.source: Hmm, I’ll organize some important mysticism knowledge and give it to Amandina for free.
unit.target: Hmm, aliquam scientiam mysticam momenti disponam et Amandinae gratis tradam.

unit.source: Show some respect for the higher authority, if not for me.
unit.target: Ostende reverentiam erga maiorem auctoritatem, si non pro me.

unit.source: If the Underworld Daoist sees how well I treat His disciple, maybe His attitude will change…
unit.target: Si Daoista Inferorum perspiciet quam bene discipulum Suum tractem, fortasse eius habitus mutabitur…

unit.source: Also, I’ll ask Amandina which path of the divine she wants to take besides the power of the boons and help her get the corresponding potion formulas and materials.
unit.target: Praeterea, Amandinae rogabo qua viam divinam, praeter vim beneficiorum, sequi velit, atque adiuvabo eam ut formulæ potionum et materias congruentes recipiat.

unit.source: This won’t be free.
unit.target: Hoc non gratis erit.

unit.source: Giving everything for free would make us look too humble and lead to disrespect.
unit.target: Omnia gratis dare nos nimis humiles ostendere faceret et ad contemptum ducere posset.

unit.source: Too much kindness can turn into resentment…
unit.target: Nimis clementia in rancorem vertere potest…

unit.source: Amandina should choose between the paths of Darkness, Death, and Warrior.
unit.target: Amandina inter viās Tenebrarum, Mortis, et Bellatoris eligere debet.

unit.source: The potion formulas and characteristics for the mid-to-low Sequences of the Warrior path are relatively easy to find.
unit.target: Formulae potionum et proprietates sequentiarum mediocris in via Bellatoris relativè facile inveniuntur.

unit.source: Maybe we can ask Madam Justice to get help from Mr. Star for the Darkness path.
unit.target: Fortasse rogare possumus Domina Iustitia ut a Domino Stella auxilium pro via Tenebrarum obtineat.

unit.source: He seems to be a high-ranking member of the Evernight Goddess Church; last time, he wore red gloves…
unit.target: Videtur esse membrum altus ordinis Ecclesiae Deae Perpetuae Noctis; novissima vice chirothecas rubras gerebat…

unit.source: Perfect timing, I was about to report the secrets of the Demoness Sect taught by the Demoness of Black and mention Amandina’s situation to see what mysticism knowledge can be shared and what can’t be leaked…
unit.target: Optime situatus, iam paratus eram enarrare arcana Sectae Demonum, ab Demonessa Nigra tradita, atque de condicione Amandinae referre, ut intuerer quid scientiae mysticae communicari possit et quid divulgari non debeat…

unit.source: Having sorted her thoughts, Franca returned to her bedroom, sat at her desk, and began writing her report.
unit.target: Cogitationibus ordinatis, Franca cubiculum suum rediit, ad scrinium consedit, atque relationem scribere coepit.

unit.source: South Continent, Port Port Pylos of Matani, in a three‐story white marble villa.
unit.target: Continens Meridionalis, Port Port Pylos Matani, in villa marmorā albae tribus tabulis constituta.

unit.source: Having finally made up her mind and sent out that letter, Amandina grew more awake as the night went on, pacing back and forth in her soft, girlish bedroom, waiting for Lumian’s reply.
unit.target: Postquam tandem animum constituens et epistulam misit, Amandina, cum nox procederet, vigilantior facta est, in cubiculo suo tenero puellarum simili circuitum faciens, responsum Lumiani exspectans.
