unit.source: The more she learned about mysticism and Beyonders, the more she realized the gap between herself and Lumian and how ignorant she had been.
unit.target: Quo magis de mystica et Beyonder discere coepit, eo magis animadvertit discrimen inter se et Lumian atque quantum olim ignorasse se.

unit.source: Though she felt she could continue living as she had, maintaining the appearance of a normal high-society person with certain supernatural abilities, the events during the Dream Festival and the rumors she had heard from various mysticism circles made her feel a sense of crisis and urgency.
unit.target: Etsi putabat se posse vivere ut antea, personam honestae alti societatis cum nonnullis facultatibus supernaturalibus servans, eventus Festi Somniorum ac rumores ex variis circulis mysticarum in animo habere crisis et urgentiam facere.

unit.source: Living in the South Continent in an era of increasing disasters, her Sequence 7 Nightmare powers and current situation of facing everything alone made her truly afraid that one day her entire family would become sacrifices in a Rose School of Thought blood ritual or that the hidden problems of the Dream Festival would suddenly erupt and engulf her.
unit.target: Vivens in Continenti Meridionali in tempore calamitatum crescentium, potentia eius Sequenciae VII “Nightmare” et solitaria adversus omnia pugnandi condicio eam vere terruerunt ne aliquando omnis familia eius in sacrificia ritu sanguineo Scholae Rosi converteretur aut ne problemata occulta Festi Somniorum subito eruptura eam opprimerent.

unit.source: The more she knew, the more afraid she became.
unit.target: Quo plura scivit, eo magis timida facta est.

unit.source: Amandina felt she could never return to her previous state of ignorance and recklessness, and she had a strong desire for higher Sequences and more extraordinary power.
unit.target: Amandina sensit se numquam redire posse ad pristinam ignorantiam et imprudentiam, atque vehementer desiderabat superiores sequentias et potentiam extraordinariam.

unit.source: That would mean she could do more and see more.
unit.target: Id significaret se plura efficere atque plura videre posse.

unit.source: Suddenly, she saw the same cool-looking charred messenger from before emerge from the void, handing her a small dressing mirror.
unit.target: Subito, vidit eundem nuntium exustum, qui antea apparuerat, e vacuo emergere et ei parvum speculum ad ornandum tradere.

unit.source: A mirror? What does Lumian Lee mean by giving me a mirror?
unit.target: Speculum? Quid significat Lumian Lee mihi speculum dare?

unit.source: Amandina accepted the mirror with curiosity and confusion, feeling it was quite ordinary.
unit.target: Amandina speculum cum curiositate et perplexitate accepit, sentiens illud esse prorsus commune.

unit.source: She was about to ask the Penitent Baynfel when she noticed a dark, aqueous light spreading across the mirror’s surface.
unit.target: Iam paene Penitentem Baynfel interrogare volebat, cum animadvertit lucem obscuram atque aquosam per superficiem speculi diffundere.

unit.source: As the light flowed, the mirror gradually brightened, revealing a figure.
unit.target: Dum lux diffuse fluebat, speculum paulatim illuminatum est, figuram revelans.

unit.source: A mystic telegraph? And one where you can see and talk to the other person? How fascinating…
unit.target: Telegraphum mysticum? Et unum quo alterum videre ac loqui possis? Quam mirabile…

unit.source: Amandina didn’t notice the messenger leaving, her attention entirely captivated by the mirror.
unit.target: Amandina nuntium discedentem non animadvertit, tota sua attentio in speculo captata.

unit.source: She soon realized that the figure in the mirror wasn’t Lumian Lee but a stranger, a woman.
unit.target: Mox intellexit figuram in speculo non esse Lumian Lee, sed ignotam, feminam.

unit.source: The woman had lake-colored eyes, both bright and deep, as if hiding countless words that made one want to explore them.
unit.target: Femina oculos habebat colore lacustri, claros atque profundos, quasi innumeras verba celaret, quae explorari concupiscantur.

unit.source: Her nose was delicate and straight, her lips a tempting combination of red and tender white skin, and her eyebrows extended to her temples, with her flaxen hair tied into a ponytail, giving her an air of elegance.
unit.target: Naris eius delicata et recta erat, labia delectabilis mixtione rubro et tenera albo formata, et supercilii ad tempora se extendebant, dum capilli flavi in caudam nodati essent, quae indolem elegantiae afferebant.

unit.source: So beautiful… Amandina stared blankly, instinctively admiring the woman in her mind.
unit.target: Quam pulchra… Amandina vacuo aspectu intuebatur, instinctive feminam in animo suo admirans.

unit.source: She herself was a girl of outstanding appearance and had always been proud of it, but this time, she felt no sense of competition, entirely immersed in a beauty she had never seen before.
unit.target: Ipsa puella eminenti specie praedita fuit et semper de ea superba, sed hoc tempore nullum sensum certaminis sensit, penitus in pulchritudine immersa quam nunquam antea viderat.

unit.source: Her gaze naturally lowered, seeing the smooth, slender neck and the lace flowers around the shirt collar.
unit.target: Aspectus eius naturaliter deorsum cecidit, videns collum lenem et tenuem atque ornamenta linearia quasi flores circa margines vestis.

unit.source: For some reason, Amandina felt an urge to see the entire body of the woman in the mirror, to see how beautiful she would look naked.
unit.target: Aliqua ratione, Amandina sensit desiderium totum corpus feminae in speculo intuendi, ut perspiceret quam pulchra nuda appareret.

unit.source: She felt this wasn’t her own problem.
unit.target: Sentiit hoc non esse suum proprium problema.

unit.source: Even Padre Cali who only liked men would surely have a similar urge!
unit.target: Etiam Padre Cali, qui solum viros amabat, certe talem cupiditatem haberet!

unit.source: Using a bit of Charm to enhance goodwill for easier communication, Franca also observed Amandina.
unit.target: Ut parvulo Charme benevolentiam augeret, ad communicationem faciliorem perficiendam, Franca etiam Amandinam contemplata est.

unit.source: This girl had a waterfall of black hair and blue eyes, exuding a youthful energy of free self-expression.
unit.target: Haec puella habebat capsulas nigras quasi cataractam et oculos caeruleos, iuvenem vim liberam suam exprimens.

unit.source: All of Lumian’s female acquaintances are quite beautiful… Is this a Hunter’s talent?
unit.target: Omnes cognatae femines Lumiani pulcherrimae sunt… Num hoc ingenium Venatoris sit?

unit.source: Franca smiled sweetly through the glass mirror.
unit.target: Franca per speculum vitrei leniter subridebat.

unit.source: “Lumian is busy right now and can’t leave, so he asked me to communicate with you.”
unit.target: “Lumian nunc occupatus est nec discedere potest, itaque me rogavit ut tecum communicarem.”

unit.source: Amandina snapped out of her daze, shaking off the spell of the woman’s beauty.
unit.target: Amandina ex stupore suo evasit, incantamentum pulchritudinis feminae dimittens.

unit.source: She looked at Franca in the mirror, curiosity and a desire to explore igniting within her.
unit.target: In speculo Francam contemnit, cum curiositate et explorandi cupiditate interius accensa.

unit.source: “You’re Lumian… Eh… Monsieur Lumian Lee’s friend? The one who might need my help in the future?”
unit.target: “Tu es Lumian… Eh… amicus Domini Lumian Lee? Ille qui fortasse auxilium meum in futurum petet?”

unit.source: “Yes.” Franca smiled and nodded.
unit.target: “Ita.” Franca subridens annuit.

unit.source: Hmph, and you say you’re not lovers.
unit.target: Hemph, et dicis vos non esse amantes.

unit.source: Such a beautiful woman makes even me, who likes men, want to sleep with her.
unit.target: Talis pulchra femina efficit ut etiam ego, qui viros amo, cupiam cum ea iacere.

unit.source: How much more for a man who doesn’t like men… Amandina felt she had seen through Lumian’s lie.
unit.target: Quanto magis pro viro qui viros non amat… Amandina sensit se mentis Lumiani penitus perspexisse.

unit.source: She straightened her waterfall-like hair and asked brightly, “I’m willing to help you. Can you keep your promise?”
unit.target: Capillos quasi cataractam nigrorum ornatos ordinavit et clare rogavit: “Paratus sum te adiuvare. Potesne promissionem tuam servare?”

unit.source: “That might have to wait until Lumian finishes his current tasks, and you’re not strong enough yet,” Franca said succinctly.
unit.target: “Forsitan id exspectare debeat donec Lumian negotia sua currentia conficiat, et tu nondum satis fortis sis,” Franca succincte dixit.

unit.source: “Do you want to advance through potions besides the power of boons?
unit.target: “Visne per potionibus progredi, praeter vim beneficiorum?

unit.source: Which path do you want: Death, Darkness, or Warrior?”
unit.target: Quae viam vis eligere: Mortem, Tenebras, aut Bellatorem?”

unit.source: Franca spoke quickly because the power of the Ice Amulet was limited in time.
unit.target: Franca celeriter locuta est, quia potentia Amuletis Glacialis temporarie finita erat.

unit.source: After posing the question, she suddenly thought of something.
unit.target: Postquam quaestionem posuit, subito aliquid in mentem venit.

unit.source: It is said that the Warrior path’s potions has a significant height-enhancing effect, even turning the drinker into a giant at higher levels…
unit.target: Dicitur potiones viae Bellatoris effectum notabilem in altitudine augendi habere, et etiam potum in gradus superiores in gigantem convertere…

unit.source: Hmm, turning such a pretty girl into a three or four-meter-tall giant beauty seems odd…
unit.target: Hmm, puellam tam pulchram in gigantem trium vel quattuor metrorum altum transformare insolitum videtur…

unit.source: Franca wasn’t sure if she was worried or looking forward to it.
unit.target: Franca non certe sciebat num id timueret an exspectaret.

unit.source: Amandina had discussed with Lumian which paths she could take and had thought seriously about it, so she quickly made her decision.
unit.target: Amandina cum Lumiano de viis sequi possset disseruerat et serio de ea cogitaverat, itaque celeriter decrevit.

unit.source: “Darkness.”
unit.target: “Tenebras.”

unit.source: As a girl who had always been good at understanding her parents’ thoughts and was adored by her elders, Amandina felt that since the figure during the Dream Festival had only given her the power of Darkness and not the Death power given to Robert or the Warrior power given to some gravekeepers, it might mean that He wanted her to be pure and focus on the path of Darkness.
unit.target: Ut puella semper in cogitationibus parentum suorum bene percepta atque ab senioribus carissima, Amandina sensit, quia figura in Festo Somniorum solum vim Tenebrarum ei dederit, nec vim Mortis quae Roberto, aut vim Bellatoris quae quibusdam custodianis sepulchrorum tribuata esset, id fortasse significare voluisse, ut puram esse et in viam Tenebrarum incumbere concupieret.

unit.source: She also planned to go to the ancient tomb during the next Dream Festival to receive more gifts, naturally not wanting to disappoint that figure.
unit.target: Praeterea, consilium ceperat ad tumulum antiquum ire durante proximo Festo Somniorum, ut dona plura acciperet, naturale nolens illam figuram deludere.

unit.source: I still want to see what happens when the power of the Death or Warrior path is mixed with the Darkness boon…
unit.target: Adhuc cupio videre quid fiat, cum virtus viæ Mortis aut Bellatoris cum dono Tenebrarum misceatur…

unit.source: Franca said seriously, “I will inquire and gather the necessary things for you, but you need to pay for it or complete tasks I assign.”
unit.target: Franca serio dixit, “Quaesiam et colligam ea quae tibi necessaria sunt, sed solvere aut officia quae tibi assignabo exsequere debes.”

unit.source: Amandina was no longer the naive girl she used to be and understood the value of potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients.
unit.target: Amandina iam non erat puella ingenua quam olim fuisset et intellexit pretium formularum potionum atque ingredientorum Beyonder.

unit.source: She nodded.
unit.target: Annuit.

unit.source: “Okay.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: Franca smiled in the mirror.
unit.target: Franca in speculo subridebat.

unit.source: “Also, I appreciate you agreeing to help. No matter what Lumian promised you, I will provide you with some extra mysticism knowledge for free.”
unit.target: “Praeterea, gratum mihi est quod adiuvare consensisti; quocumque Lumian tibi promiserit, ego tibi scientiam mysticam additam gratis praestabo.”

unit.source: “Really?” Amandina was delighted.
unit.target: “Vere?” Amandina delectata est.

unit.source: This beautiful lady is truly generous!
unit.target: Haec pulchra domina vere liberalis est!

unit.source: And it’s not a trap.
unit.target: Et id non est insidiosum.

unit.source: The potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients come at a cost.
unit.target: Formulae potionum et ingredienta Beyonder certo pretio veniunt.

unit.source: Franca didn’t answer directly but smiled and said, “Remember, my name is Franca.”
unit.target: Franca non directe respondit sed subridens dixit, “Memento nomen meum esse Franca.”

unit.source: As she spoke, she raised her right hand and pushed a stack of stapled papers forward.
unit.target: Dum loquebatur, dexteram manum levavit et fasciculum chartarum confixarum protulit.

unit.source: In Amandina’s eyes, the stack grew larger, eventually penetrating the glass and falling into her hands, while Franca’s image disappeared from the mirror.
unit.target: In oculis Amandinae, fasciculus magisque crevit, denique vitrum perveniens in manus eius cecidit, dum imago Francae ex speculo evanuit.

unit.source: Franca… Lumian Lee and she make a good match…
unit.target: Franca… Lumian Lee et illa bene conveniunt…

unit.source: Amandina imagined Lumian and Franca together, suddenly having some romantic thoughts.
unit.target: Amandina Lumian et Francam simul imaginavit, subito nonnullas cogitationes amorosas excipiens.

unit.source: She whispered to herself, That must be beautiful. I’d love to see it…
unit.target: Sibi susurravit: “Pulchrum certe erit. Vellem id videre…”

unit.source: Suppressing the images in her mind, Amandina looked at the papers in her hand, glancing over a line of words: “Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence…”
unit.target: Mentis imagines reprimens, Amandina chartas in manu intuens una lineam verborum legit: “Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence…”

unit.source: Wh- Amandina was both bewildered and deeply impressed.
unit.target: Quid— Amandina perplexa erat atque vehementer admirata.

unit.source: Morora, late night.
unit.target: Morora, in nocte serotina.

unit.source: After the Carnivore bar closed, Lumian exited through the back door and saw Gusain wearing a top silk hat.
unit.target: Postquam taberna Carnivora clausum est, Lumian per ostium posticum exiit et Gusainum, galeam sericam praetendentem, conspexit.

unit.source: Gusain slowly smiled.
unit.target: Gusain lente subridit.

unit.source: “I’ll take you to the place for your test now.”
unit.target: “Te nunc ad locum probationis tuae ducam.”

unit.source: 807 Overlooked
unit.target: 807 Neglectus

unit.source: 807 Overlooked
unit.target: 807 Neglectus

unit.source: Morora’s night was devoid of streetlights, relying solely on the crimson moon high above to provide light, casting deep darkness and dense shadows everywhere.
unit.target: Nox Mororae caruit luminariis viariis, solum confisens in lunam rubram excelsam quae lucem praebebat, diffusens profundas tenebras atque densas umbras ubique.

unit.source: Gusain, dressed like a gentleman, carried a lantern as he led Lumian to a neighborhood near the edge of the city.
unit.target: Gusain, more viro urbanitatis indutus, lucernam portabat dum Luminum ad vicinitatem prope fines urbis ducebat.

unit.source: The area had been completely abandoned due to a small volcano that had erupted, swallowing several houses and leaving a charred wasteland in its wake.
unit.target: Regio tota deserta erat ob parvum vulcanum eruptum, quod complura domicilia devoravit et vastam terram incensam reliquit.

unit.source: “The place you mentioned isn’t at the base of the volcano, is it?” Lumian glanced around, adjusted his cuff, and smiled.
unit.target: «Locus quem memorasti non est ad radicem vulcani, an non?» Luminum circumspicuit, manicam rectificans, et subridens.

unit.source: Gusain nodded slightly.
unit.target: Gusain leviter annuit.

unit.source: “Yes, the volcanic eruption affected the underground part of the cemetery, allowing its power to seep out. The lava receded quickly, leaving behind an empty void.
unit.target: «Ita, eruptio vulcanica partem subterraneam cimiterii attigit, sinens potentiam eius se effundere. Lava celeriter recedebat, relinquens vacuum spatium.»

unit.source: “If you can find the right path through the void filled with the fog of war and reach the designated spot, it will prove you have the qualifications to join us in penetrating the underground part of the cemetery.”
unit.target: «Si viam rectam per vacuum, nebula belli referta, inuenies atque locum designatum attinges, id demonstrabit te habere aptitudinem ut nobiscum in partem subterraneam cimiterii penetres.»

unit.source: Fog of war…
unit.target: Nebula belli…

unit.source: Gusain had been using this term to describe the underground fog, which seemed to have leaked from the mausoleum containing 0-01, which represents the Red Priest…
unit.target: Gusain hoc verbum adhibebat ad describendam nebula subterranea, quae videtur effluisse ex mausoleo quod 0-01 continet, qui Sacerdotem Rubrum repraesentat…

unit.source: Lumian didn’t conjure a bright white fireball for illumination.
unit.target: Lumian non evocavit globum ignis albidum nitidum ad illuminationem.

unit.source: Instead, he followed Gusain, who carried the lantern, into a building on the edge of the volcanic area.
unit.target: Immo, secutus est Gusain, qui lucernam portabat, in aedificium iuxta limitem areae vulcanicae.

unit.source: Inside the house, filled with solidified volcanic rock, they descended a precarious staircase into a partially collapsed basement.
unit.target: Intra domum, plena lapide vulcanico solidato, descendebant per scalas incertas in cellam partim ruinosam.

unit.source: The basement walls had a gaping crack leading to a void filled with dense fog.
unit.target: Parietes cellae habebant fissuram ingentem quae ad vacuum repletum nebula densa ducebat.

unit.source: “You need to reach this point near the cemetery’s underground section and light the oil lamp between four stone statues. Remember, there are four statues facing each other in pairs.”
unit.target: «Ad hunc locum iuxta partem subterraneam cimiterii attingere debes et lampadem olei inter quattuor statuas lapideas accendere. Memento, quattuor statuae sunt, dispositae in duas pares inter se oppositas.»

unit.source: Gusain hung the lantern on a protruding stone brick in the wall crack and took out a simple map, pointing to the destination.
unit.target: Gusain lucernam in lapide proeminente in fissura parietis suspendit et mappam simplicem extraxit, ad metam indicans.

unit.source: Lumian studied the map for a minute, then turned his gaze to the dense fog outside the crack.
unit.target: Lumian mappam per unum minutum studuit, deinde oculos convertere in nebula densam extra fissuram.

unit.source: “What’s special about this fog?”
unit.target: «Quid in hac nebula speciale est?»

unit.source: Gusain pressed his top hat and smiled.
unit.target: Gusain pileum altum stringens et subridens.

unit.source: “It significantly reduces your visibility, affects your hearing and smell, suppresses your Astral Projection’s interaction with the spirit world, and dulls your spiritual warning and intuition.”
unit.target: «Notabiliter minuit tuam visibilitatem, auditum, et olfactum, cohibet interactionem proiectionis astralis cum mundo spirituum, atque atenuat praemonitionem spiritualem et intuitionem.»

unit.source: “And?” Lumian asked, seemingly relaxed.
unit.target: «Et?» inquit Lumian, videbatur relaxatus.

unit.source: Gusain thought for a few seconds.
unit.target: Gusain per pauca secunda meditatus est.

unit.source: “The fog of war envelops the corresponding spirit world area. Some Beyonders, even if they can enter the spirit world, can’t locate themselves or escape the fog. If they try to teleport out, they might get lost somewhere in Morora and never return to reality.”
unit.target: «Nebula belli totam regionem mundi spirituum circumcludit. Aliqui Beyonders, etiam si in mundum spirituum ingredi possunt, se determinare nec e nebula effugere valent. Si conantur teleportare, forte in Morora peribunt et numquam ad realitatem redeunt.»

unit.source: Seeing means being able to teleport there? With my Hunter’s vision, I can only see five or six meters…
unit.target: Viderene, ergo, significat teleportare posse illuc? Ex mea Venatoris visione, tantum quinque vel sex metra videre possum…

unit.source: Lumian roughly understood the fog’s effects and laughed.
unit.target: Lumian efficaciter effectus nebulae intellexit et risit.

unit.source: “If I could create a hurricane, could I blow it away?”
unit.target: «Si procellam similis turbine creare possem, an eam depellere valeam?»

unit.source: “We’ve tried. You can, but once the wind stops, the fog comes back, and the dispersal is limited to reality, not affecting the part seeping into the spirit world,” Gusain explained the previous experiment’s results.
unit.target: «Experti sumus. Possis, sed cum ventus cessaverit, nebula refertur, et diffusio ad realitatem tantum limitatur, non afficiens partem in mundum spirituum se effundentem,» explicavit Gusain eventus experimenti praeleti.

unit.source: Lumian asked a few more details, then conjured a bright white flame to hover above his head.
unit.target: Lumian plura interrogavit, deinde flammam ignis albidum nitidum super caput suum conjuravit.

unit.source: He stepped forward, through the crack, and into the dense fog.
unit.target: Procedit per fissuram in nebula densam.

unit.source: Unlike normal fog, this one felt like it had been scorched by fire.
unit.target: Haec nebula, dissimilis nebulæ ordinariae, quasi igne conflagrata videbatur.

unit.source: As Lumian inhaled, his airways stung with a fiery pain, and his mind filled with the smell of burning, blood, and rust.
unit.target: Cum Lumian inhauriret, viae respiratoriae eius igneo dolore flagitabantur, et mens ejus odoribus combustionis, sanguinis, atque ferruginei implebatur.

unit.source: The dense fog churned, and the ground trembled slightly.
unit.target: Nebula densa turbarebatur, et terra leviter tremuit.

unit.source: Lumian saw tall figures emerging from the fog five or six meters away.
unit.target: Lumian conspexit figuras altas ex nebula emergentes, quinque vel sex metris distantibus.

unit.source: These figures were made of black iron, covered in dark red rust, like neglected metal puppets.
unit.target: Hae figurae ex ferro nigro factae erant, opertae rubra obscura ferrugine, instar marionettarum metallicarum neglectarum.

unit.source: Some lacked arms, others had disjointed bodies, and some had gaping holes in their chests.
unit.target: Aliqui bracchia carebant, alii corpora disiuncta exhibebant, et quidam in pectoribus fissuras ingentes ostenderunt.

unit.source: They staggered towards Lumian, wielding giant swords that gleamed coldly.
unit.target: Ipsi ad Luminum titubaverunt, gladii ingentes ferentes qui frigide micabantur.

unit.source: Lumian chuckled.
unit.target: Lumian subridens risit.

unit.source: “Who dug you out of the trash heap? Recycling, huh?”
unit.target: «Quis te ex vasto conglutinato immunditatis effodit? Recyclatio, nonne?»

unit.source: Before he finished speaking, he disappeared from his spot, reappearing behind one of the iron puppets.
unit.target: Antequam dixerit, evanuit e loco suo, et post unam ex marionettis ferreis rediviens apparuit.

unit.source: His eyes turned iron‑black, and his right fist ignited with bright white flames, crashing down on the puppet’s waist.
unit.target: Oculi ejus in ferro nigri colore facti sunt, et dexter pugnus, accensus igni albi nitidi, in latus marionettae percussus est.

unit.source: Suddenly, a bright white flame spear shot from the crack in the wall, hurtling towards Lumian.
unit.target: Subito, hasta ignis albi nitidi ex fissura parietis emissa, ad Luminum festinanter properavit.

unit.source: Lumian couldn’t dodge or use Spirit World Traversal in time.
unit.target: Lumian tempore nec defugere nec transitus in mundum spirituum adhibere potuit.

unit.source: He could only fall to the ground, following the momentum of his right punch.
unit.target: Solum ad terram cadere potuit, impulsu dextri ictus sequerens.

unit.source: At the same time, he prepared to swap places with his shadow.
unit.target: Eodem tempore praeparatus erat ut locum cum umbra sua permuteret.

unit.source: Bang!
unit.target: Bang!

unit.source: His flaming right fist struck the puppet’s waist, creating a spiderweb of cracks.
unit.target: Dexter pugnus eius flammis ardens latus marionettae percussit, telam fissurarum instar araneae creans.

unit.source: Then, his fist brushed against the metal surface, pulling his body to the ground, narrowly avoiding the white flame spear, though a lock of his hair caught fire.
unit.target: Deinde, pugnus eius superficiem metallicam percussit, corpus suum in terram trahens, vix vitans hastae ignis albi imminenti, sed fasciculus capillorum eius ignem cepit.

unit.source: With a clatter, the white flame spear pierced the puppet and landed two meters away, revealing Gusain in his top hat.
unit.target: Cum strepitu, hasta ignis albi per marionettam penetravit et duos metra ab ipsa cecidit, ostendens Gusain sub pileo suo alto.

unit.source: The invigilator was the attacker!
unit.target: Ille inspector erat aggressor!

unit.source: The second most dangerous person in Morora!
unit.target: Secundus inter homines periculosissimos in Morora erat!

unit.source: Creak! Creak! The puppet took a step forward out of inertia, then collapsed into a heap of scrap metal.
unit.target: Stridulus! Stridulus! Marionetta ex inertia unum gressum cepit, deinde in congeriem metallorum reiectorum corruit.

unit.source: Lumian, lying on the ground, didn’t roll away. Since he hadn’t gone far from the basement, he teleported to the crack covered in dense fog, moving as far as his vision allowed to escape the fog of war.
unit.target: Lumian, iacentem in terra, non se volvit. Cum a cella subterranea non longe discessisset, ad fissuram, tegendam nebula densa, se teleportavit, quantum visio eius sineret ad nebula belli effugiendum.

unit.source: Once outside, he could either counterattack Gusain or find a chance to escape, both better options than fighting in a preset scenario.
unit.target: Postquam extra erat, vel contra Gusain repugnare poterat aut occasionem ad effugiendum quaerere, utrumque melius quam in praeconstituta scaena pugnare videbatur.

unit.source: Whenever possible, avoid fighting in someone else’s setup!
unit.target: Quoties possibile, vitanda est pugna in praeordinata configuratione alicujus!

unit.source: As Lumian’s figure appeared in the dense fog near the basement crack, he saw a bright white flaming metal spear rushing towards his heart as if waiting for him to come.
unit.target: Cum figura Luminum in nebula densa prope fissuram cellae apparuit, vidit hastam metallicam ignis albi nitidi, ad cor eius festinanter properantem, quasi eum exspectaret.

unit.source: Besides Gusain, there was another ambusher!
unit.target: Praeter Gusain, alius insidiator adfuit!

unit.source: Gusain’s attack seemed to lure Lumian to teleport towards the exit, stepping into a trap!
unit.target: Impetus Gusain videbatur Luminum ad exitum teleportare allicere, in insidias ingrediens!

unit.source: At this moment, Lumian, in Morora, far from Franca and Jenna, couldn’t use their Mirror Substitution.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Lumian in Morora, longe ab Franca et Jenna, eorum Speculi Substitutionem uti non potuit.

unit.source: He could only swap places with his shadow in a flash of light.
unit.target: Solum locum cum umbra sua in fulgore lucis commutare potuit.

unit.source: Pfft!
unit.target: Pfft!

unit.source: The bright white flaming spear pierced Lumian’s chest, setting him ablaze.
unit.target: Hasta ignis albi nitidi lucens pectus Luminum percussit, eum incendens.

unit.source: But Lumian’s figure turned thin and black, dissolving like a shadow in the firelight.
unit.target: At figura Luminum facta est tenuis et nigra, dissolvens quasi umbra in lumine ignis.

unit.source: The spear‑wielding man stepped through the crack into the fog of war.
unit.target: Vir hastam ferens per fissuram in nebula belli ingreditus est.

unit.source: His hair was tinged with blood, his features aggressive, and he wore a black and red jacket. He was Albus Medici.
unit.target: Capilli ejus sanguine tincti erant, vultus ejus aggressivi, et iaccam nigram et rubram gerebat. Erat Albus Medici.

unit.source: Albus Medici, whom Gusain was supposed to be looking for, was here!
unit.target: Albus Medici, quem Gusain quaerere debebat, hic aderat!

unit.source: Lumian’s figure reappeared in another direction, but due to the fog of war, he was still within six meters of Albus, Gusain, and the remaining iron puppets.
unit.target: Figura Luminum alio in loco redivit, sed propter nebula belli, adhuc intra sex metra ab Albo, Gusain, et reliquis marionettis ferreis manebat.

unit.source: He saw Gusain’s forehead glow red, something about to emerge. Albus’s hair was covered in red flames, lengthening as it spread.
unit.target: Vidit frontem Gusain rubescere, aliquid imminere velle; capilli Albi rubris flammarum operiebantur, dilatantes dum se diffundeabant.

unit.source: “Traitor,” Gusain whispered, sentencing him.
unit.target: «Proditor,» submurmuravit Gusain, eum damnans.

unit.source: He then created several bright white fireballs, hurling them at Lumian to cover every corner.
unit.target: Deinde creavit plura globos ignis albi nitidi, quos contra Luminum iactabat, ut omnem angulum tegerent.

unit.source: He seemed unafraid of affecting himself or Albus, though they were only five or six meters apart, and the fireballs could flatten the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Videbatur non timere se nec Album laedere, quamquam inter se tantum quinque vel sex metra erant, et globi ignis potentes tabernam Carnivorum comprimere poterant.

unit.source: Hearing Gusain’s words and seeing Albus’s stance, Lumian understood why he was attacked: He had overlooked the Iron and Blood Cross Order!
unit.target: Verba Gusain audiens et statum Albi videns, Lumian intellexit cur aggressus esset: Ordinem Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis negliguerat!

unit.source: This secret organization, primarily following the Hunter path, was also searching for 0-01. Over the years, someone had likely infiltrated Morora.
unit.target: Haec societas secreta, praesertim viam Venatoris sequens, etiam 0-01 quaerebat. Per annos, aliquis verisimiliter in Mororam infiltraverat.

unit.source: One of them was Gusain!
unit.target: Unus ex iis erat Gusain!

unit.source: With the core members of the Iron and Blood Cross Order’s strange connection to Fourth Epoch Trier, they could maintain some self‑awareness in Morora. Using 0-01 to sense the approaching enforcement team made sense, fitting Gusain’s behavior!
unit.target: Cum membris principalibus Ordinis Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis insueta nexu ad Quartam Epocham Trier, aliquam sui conscientiam in Morora tenere poterant. Usus 0-01 ut turmam coercitivam appropinquantem sentiret, rationem habuit, conveniens mores Gusain.

unit.source: Now, it seemed Albus Medici was still cooperating with the Iron and Blood Cross Order, using the secret organization.
unit.target: Nunc, videtur Albus Medici adhuc cum Ordine Crucis Ferreae et Sanguinis cooperari, societatem secretam adhibens.

unit.source: Lumian’s attempt to use Gusain’s power to find Albus had been turned into a trap.
unit.target: Conatus Luminum ut potentiam Gusain ad Album inveniendum adhiberet, in insidias versa erat.

unit.source: Seeing the incoming bright white fireballs and Albus blocking the exit, Lumian didn’t hesitate.
unit.target: Cum vidisset globos ignis albi nitidi imminentes et Album exitum obstruere, Lumian non dubitavit.

unit.source: His sleeve flashed, and he disappeared again.
unit.target: Manica ejus micavit, et iterum evanuit.

unit.source: This time, he left behind a makeup mirror.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, speculum ornamentale relinquit.

unit.source: The mirror fell through the dense fog, cracking as it hit the ground.
unit.target: Speculum per nebula densam cecidit, fractum cum terram contingens.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Rumble!

unit.source: Gusain’s fireballs exploded, only affecting a six‑meter range, unable to disperse the dense fog of war, confined to a small area.
unit.target: Globuli ignis Gusain erupti sunt, solum ambitum sex metrorum afficiens, nec nebulae belli densi diffundi potuerunt, in parvo spatio confinati.

unit.source: The mirror shattered into countless pieces, some turning to dust, others melting and reforming.
unit.target: Speculum in innumerabilia fragmenta confractum est, quaedam in pulverem versa, alia liquefacta et reformata.

unit.source: Albus, feeling the impact and heat, muttered in confusion, “Using the mirror world?”
unit.target: Albus, ictum et calorem sentiens, confusus submurmuravit: «Uti mundum speculi?»

unit.source: Behind the dark void of the mirror, Lumian used the Mirror Cufflink again, quickly looking forward and finding the fog of war hadn’t invaded the dark, web‑like tunnels.
unit.target: Post vacuum obscurum speculi, Lumian iterum Cingulum Speculi adhibuit, celeriter prospiciens et inveniens tunelas obscuras, reticulis similes, ab nebula belli non invasas esse.

unit.source: Indeed, in Morora, the mirror world is special… Lumian dared to trust Gusain and enter the fog of war for the test because he had the Mirror Cufflink.
unit.target: Revera, in Morora, mundus speculi peculiaris est… Lumian ausus est Gusain credere et in nebula belli intrare pro probatione, quia Cingulum Speculi habebat.

unit.source: Of course, with items like the Sword of Courage, he wasn’t without fighting strength, but he didn’t want to risk it in an enemy’s prepared battlefield without knowing Albus’s full capabilities.
unit.target: Certe, cum rebus ut Gladio Fortitudinis, non caret virtute pugnae, sed noluit id in campo hostis praeparato periclitari, nisi totam facultatem Albi cognovisset.

unit.source: Lumian chose a mirror mark in Morora and used Spirit World Traversal to leave.
unit.target: Lumian signum speculi in Morora elegit et Transitus Mundi Spirituum ad discessum adhibuit.

unit.source: As he vanished, the dark void behind the mirror silently collapsed with its shattering.
unit.target: Dum evanuit, vacuum obscurum post speculum silentio corruit, se frangens.

unit.source: Lumian’s destination was Julie’s room mirror.
unit.target: Meta Luminum fuit speculum cubiculi Juliae.

unit.source: Upon arrival, he looked through the glass, finding Julie, the Demoness, nowhere to be seen, not even asleep in bed.
unit.target: Adventu facto, per vitrum intuebatus invenit Juliam, daemonissam, nusquam apparere, ne etiam in lecto dormientem.

unit.source: Lumian’s lips curled into a smile.
unit.target: Labia Luminum in risum contorta sunt.

unit.source: 808 Return
unit.target: 808 Reditus

unit.source: 808 Return
unit.target: 808 Reditus

unit.source: Not far from the abandoned neighborhood, Albus Medici, who had parted ways with Gusain, walked along the shadows by the roadside toward the cemetery.
unit.target: Non procul ā regione relicta, Albus Medici, quī a Gusain sē discesserat, iuxta viam per umbrās ad coemeterium ambulāvit.

unit.source: Suddenly, he stopped, as if sensing an undercurrent in the nearby darkness.
unit.target: Subitō consēdit, quāsi latentem motum in proxiam tēnebrīs perceptūrus esset.

unit.source: Albus chuckled, and a dense fog immediately surged out, covering his figure and half the street.
unit.target: Albus subrīdit, et dēns nebula statim exorta est, figuram eius ēt dimidiem viā tegens.

unit.source: After several seconds, the fog gradually dispersed, but Albus was no longer there.
unit.target: Pōst nōnnūllōs secundōs, nebula pāulatim evanuit, sed Albus iam nōn aderat.

unit.source: He had vanished.
unit.target: Evanuerat.

unit.source: From the shadow that had just been enveloped by the fog, Julie, with her hair tied up and wearing a slit dress, emerged, staring at the spot where Albus had stood for several seconds.
unit.target: Ex umbrā, quāmodo modo nebula involverat, Julia, capillīs colligātīs et vestī scintillātā (densim “veste scissa” indūtā), emersit, locum, ūbi Albus aliquot secundīs steterat, intuēns.

unit.source: A golden ring with a blue gemstone adorned her left middle finger.
unit.target: Anulus aureus cum gemmā caeruleā digitum mēdium sinistrum eius ornābat.

unit.source: Julie looked away, her expression somewhat grim, and headed toward the few blocks where the exiles gathered.
unit.target: Julia occulōs avertit, vultū paulō tristi, et ad pauca quadra, ūbi exsulēs congregābantur, accessit.

unit.source: Some time later, in the deep darkness of the night, the sharp, painful screams of a man echoed from a room.
unit.target: Aliquando postea, in profunda noctis tēnēbrīs, acūtī et dolorōsī hominis clāmorēs ex conclāvī resonāvērunt.

unit.source: Lumian returned to the full-length mirror in his room and stepped out, lying down on the bed.
unit.target: Lumian ad speculum integrāe statūrae in cellā suā rediit et exiit, in lectō iacēns.

unit.source: After discovering that Julie had quietly left the Carnivore bar, he knew the Demoness had been secretly following him and Gusain.
unit.target: Pōstquam dētexit Juliam tacitō tabernam Carnivōrum deseruisse, intellexit daemonissam eum et Gusain furtim secūtam fuisse.

unit.source: This was one of his intended outcomes.
unit.target: Hoc ūnum ex eventibus dēstīnātīs eius erat.

unit.source: Otherwise, he wouldn’t have discussed searching for Albus Medici and accepting the corresponding test with Gusain at the bar.
unit.target: Alioquīn, de quāerendō Album Medicum et probatione cōrrēspondentī cum Gusain in tabernā non locūtus fuisset.

unit.source: He had done it to ensure that Julie, temporarily acting as a bartender, would hear it!
unit.target: Id fēcisset ut Julia, pro tempore ut tabernāria fungēns, id audīret!

unit.source: Although he and Gusain had lowered their voices, the Demoness was close enough to catch the crucial information with her enhanced hearing.
unit.target: Quamquam ille et Gusain vocēs demiserant, daemonissa tamen satis prope erat ut informationem clāvicam, auditū acerrimō praeditā, capere possēt.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian hadn’t initially considered Julie as a contingency plan because Gusain had witnessed the Demoness castrate Vijepan and had clearly noticed her beauty and charm when she became a bartender.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian initiō quī Juliam nōn ut cōnsilium subsitutīvum cōnsiderāverat, quōnam Gusain vidisset daemonissam Vijepan castrāre et palam eius pulchritūdem ac venūstātem animādvertere, quum tabernāria facta esset.

unit.source: In such a situation, Gusain would likely guess Julie’s identity as a Demoness and remain cautious, knowing she might have overheard their conversation.
unit.target: In talī condiciōne, Gusain verisimiliter identitātem Juliae ut daemonissam coniectūrus esset et cautus mansisset, sciēns eam sermonem eōrum fortasse audīvisse.

unit.source: Lumian’s primary goal was to gauge the progress of the Demoness Sect regarding 0-01 based on Julie’s reaction.
unit.target: Prīncipālem propositum Luminī erat progressum Sēctae Daemonissārum dē 0-01 ex rēactiōne Juliae aestimāre.

unit.source: If the Demoness Sect, through the long‑term investigation of Celeste and other Demonesses, had completed preparations and was only waiting for the final opportunity to act, Julie would avoid creating extra trouble and patiently maintain the status quo.
unit.target: Sī Sēcta Daemonissārum, per diuturnam indāgātiōnem Celeste et alīārum daemonissārum, praeparātiōnēs confecerat et sōlum ultimam occasionem agendī exspectābat, Julia iniuriam superflūam creare evitāret et statu quō patienter maneret.

unit.source: In that case, Lumian would have to closely monitor Julie and Celeste to prevent them from taking the lead.
unit.target: In talī cāsu, Lumian dīligenter Juliam et Celeste observāre debuisset, ne praeponderāre lācēret ībīs.

unit.source: If the Demoness Sect wasn’t confident and still lacked information, Julie would likely use this opportunity to gather more intelligence from Gusain and the rebels connected to him, making her actions more comprehensive.
unit.target: Sī Sēcta Daemonissārum nōn confīdēns esset et adhūc notītiā dēfērret, Julia verisimiliter hanc occasionem ad plūra indicia ex Gusain et rebellibus coniunctīs colligendā utebātur, atque actūs suos magis comprehensīvē efficīret.

unit.source: Lumian wouldn’t need to be as urgent and could allocate time and effort to other investigations.
unit.target: Lumian nōn tam festināns esse debuisset et tempus atque operam ad alias indāgātiōnēs tribuere potuisset.

unit.source: In this regard, he had perfectly achieved his goal.
unit.target: Hoc mōdō, propositum suum perfecte attigerat.

unit.source: Now, Lumian was more curious about Julie’s reaction after discovering Albus Medici while following him and Gusain.
unit.target: Nunc, Lumian magis curiōsus erat dē rēactiōne Juliae, pūst quum Album Medicum dētexisset, dum eum et Gusain sequerētur.

unit.source: What would she try to do?
unit.target: Quid facere conābitur?

unit.source: Will she attempt an assassination on the spot, wait patiently to challenge Albus alone after he and Gusain part ways, or go find Celeste to discuss it first?
unit.target: Num in locō statim caedem conābitur, patienter exspectābit ut postquam ille et Gusain sē diviserint, Album sōlū provocet, an prīmum Celestem quaeret ut rēm disputet?

unit.source: It’s a pity I don’t know where they’ll encounter each other, so I can’t observe the battle and see what cards they hold.
unit.target: Heu, pro dōlō, nescio ūbi invicem occurrant; itaque proelium spectāre et vīdēre quae chartae teneantur nōn possum.

unit.source: If I’m lucky, I might even eliminate them both if they end up badly injured… Lumian sighed regretfully on the bed.
unit.target: Sī fēlīx sim, fortasse utrumque perdere possim, sī graviter laesī erunt… Lumian in lectō maere suspīrat.

unit.source: After a while, he sensed some movement from Julie’s room.
unit.target: Pōst aliquod tempus, aliquid motūs ex cubiclō Juliae sensit.

unit.source: The Demoness had returned.
unit.target: Daemonissa rediit.

unit.source: Lumian sniffed the air and detected a faint smell of blood.
unit.target: Lumian āerem olfactus est et levem sanguinis odoris vestigiō deprehendit.

unit.source: He chuckled inwardly and mocked, “Albus, did you lose your prized possession? I wonder if you can regrow it as an Iron‑blooded Knight…”
unit.target: Interius subrīdens irriduit: “Albus, amisistine praetiosum bonum tuum? Miror an iterum crescere possis ut Eques Ferri‑sanguineus…”

unit.source: There wasn’t much commotion in Morora just now, not like there was a fierce battle…
unit.target: In Morora nunc nōn multum strepitus erat, neque sicut in proeliō acerbo…

unit.source: So, did Julie fail to locate Albus and vent her frustration on some random guy?
unit.target: Ergo, num Julia Album dētegere defecerat et īram suam in aliquem fortuitum hominem efferre conāta est?

unit.source: Lumian waited patiently, ensuring the City of Exiles, Morora, fell into a deep slumber, then transformed into a shadow creature and blended into the darkness of the room.
unit.target: Lumian patienter exspectāvit, curāns ut Urbs Exsulōrum, Morora, in profundum somnum caderet, dēinde in creatūram umbrātam sē converteret et in tēnēbrīs conclāvi sē celāvisset.

unit.source: He moved swiftly, returning to the abandoned neighborhood with the volcano, and arrived at the crack in the basement, once again gazing into the void filled with dense fog.
unit.target: Celeriter sē movit, vulcānō comitante, rediens ad regionem relictam, et ad fissūram in cellā subterraneā pervenit, iterum in vanitātem dēnsae nebulae intūreō.

unit.source: He felt it was necessary to investigate this area thoroughly to better understand some details in the 0-01 sealing information and gain further insight into the underground mausoleum.
unit.target: Sēnsit oportēre hanc regionem diligenter explorāre, ut singulā dē informatione sigillandī 0-01 melius intellēgeret atque ulterīōres rēs de mausoleō subterraneō cognoscere posset.

unit.source: Neither Gusain nor Albus would expect him to return here, especially after the possibility of facing Julie’s attack!
unit.target: Nec Gusain nec Albus exspectābant eum hic redīre, praesertim post opportunitātem adversus Juliae impetum!

unit.source: The fog isn’t as dense as before.
unit.target: Nebula nōn tam dēnsa est quam anteā.

unit.source: The visibility range is about thirteen or fourteen meters…
unit.target: Ambitus visibilitātis est circiter trēdecim aut quattuordecim metra…

unit.source: Was it Albus and Gusain enhancing the fog of war with their abilities or items earlier?
unit.target: Num ante Albus et Gusain facultātibus aut instrumentīs nebula bellī auxērunt?

unit.source: Lumian observed the fog for a few seconds, making a preliminary judgment.
unit.target: Lumian per aliquot secundōs nebulam contemplātus est, iudiciōnem prēliminārem faciēns.

unit.source: He then conjured a bright white fireball for illumination and slowly walked into the fog of war.
unit.target: Deinde globum ignis candidī radiante ad illuminātionem evocāvit et lente in nebulam bellī ingressus est.

unit.source: The fog felt similar to before, with no other changes.
unit.target: Nebula eādem videbātur ac anteā, sīn ūlla altera mūtātiō.

unit.source: Lumian dripped a few drops of perfume on the ground every so often to mark his path for the return journey.
unit.target: Lumian paucas guttās unguentī in terram interdum stillāvit, ut viam reditūs signāret.

unit.source: He was heading to the area marked with statues on the map Gusain had shown.
unit.target: Ad regionem in charta a Gusain ostensā, ubi statuae notae erant, sē dīrigebat.

unit.source: In the dead silence, only the faint sound of footsteps echoed in the fog as Lumian discerned the terrain, passing several iron puppets hidden in the fog.
unit.target: In mortuā silentiā, sōlum tenuis sonus vestigiōrum per nebulam resonābat, dum Lumian terram discerneret, complūrēs automāta ferrea in nebulā abscondīta trānsībat.

unit.source: Finally, relying on his Hunter abilities and the memorized map, he reached his destination.
unit.target: Denique, innīxus artibus venātiōnis et chartā memorātā, ad dēstinātum locum pervenit.

unit.source: There, against the rock wall, stood four statues made of gray‑white stone, each over two meters tall.
unit.target: Ibi, contra parietem sāxium, quattuor statuae ex lapidē cinereo‑albo, quarum ūnaquaeque plus quam duo metra alta erat, stabant.

unit.source: These statues faced each other in pairs, their faces blurred, dressed in peculiar clothing, with square scarves wrapped around their heads.
unit.target: Hae statuae in paria sē invicem collocāvērunt, vultūs eōrum obscurī, indūtæ vestīmentīs inīsitīs, cum pallīs quadrātīs circumscrips capitum.

unit.source: In the middle of the statues stood a half‑height stone platform with an unlit oil lamp on it.
unit.target: In mediō statuarum stābat tabulātum lapideum dimidiō altitudinis, super quod face olearia nōn accensa recubābat.

unit.source: Who made these statues?
unit.target: Quis has statuas fēcit?

unit.source: They weren’t originally here.
unit.target: Nōn initiō hic erant.

unit.source: According to the 0‑01 sealing information, this place isn’t part of the underground mausoleum, it’s just normal underground…
unit.target: Secūndum informationēs dē sigillo 0‑01, hic locus nōn est pars mausoleī subterraneī, sed sōlum subterranus ordinārius est…

unit.source: After the volcanic eruption, some of the mausoleum’s power leaked out, and someone built these four statues and placed the oil lamp here.
unit.target: Post eruptionem vulcanicā, quaedam potentia mausoleī effusa est, atque aliquis has quattuor statuas condidit et face olearia hic posuit.

unit.source: What’s the purpose?
unit.target: Quid est propositum?

unit.source: Lumian mused silently, staring at the bright white fireball.
unit.target: Lumian tacitē meditātus est, globum ignis candidī radiante fīxo oculīs intuitus.

unit.source: Judging by the style of the statues and the overall arrangement, he doubted the Church of Knowledge had set them up to reinforce the seal.
unit.target: Ex genere statuarum et dīspositiōne ordinātā, dubitābat Ecclesiam Scientiae ēās constituisse ad sigillum corroborandum.

unit.source: It was more likely the work of the Iron and Blood Cross Order, which explained Gusain’s familiarity with the area.
unit.target: Probabilius erat opus Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis, quod explicābat magnam familiaritātem Gusain cum regione.

unit.source: Meanwhile, Lumian felt the call from underground growing stronger.
unit.target: Interim, Lumian sensit vocem ex subterrāneo firmiōrem fīrī.

unit.source: It seemed to be just behind the rock wall, waiting for him to approach.
unit.target: Videbātur esse iūstō post parietem sāxium, eum appropinquāre exspectāns.

unit.source: Lumian took a deep breath, suppressing his inner urge.
unit.target: Lumian altē inspirāvit, internum impetum reprimēns.

unit.source: He circled the statues and the oil lamp on the stone platform several times, finding nothing unusual.
unit.target: Statuās et face oleariam in tabulātō lapideō compluriē circumvagātus est, nihil insolitum invēnīens.

unit.source: Lumian pondered for a moment and had two ideas.
unit.target: Lumian paulō meditātus est et dūās cōgitiōnēs habuit.

unit.source: One was to light the oil lamp and see what happened; the other was to take this opportunity to destroy something and trigger a possible change.
unit.target: Una erat face oleariam accendēre et vidēre quid evenīret; altera erat hanc occasionem capere ad aliquid dēstruendum et mutationem possibilis excitandam.

unit.source: Lighting the oil lamp is too risky.
unit.target: Face oleariam accendere nimis periculōsum est.

unit.source: It’s not necessary yet…
unit.target: Nondum necessārium est…

unit.source: Lumian decided on the second idea after some thought.
unit.target: Lumian, post longam meditātiōnem, secūndam idēam elegit.

unit.source: Destruction is always easier than construction!
unit.target: Dēstructiō semper facilius est quam constructiō!

unit.source: And if something went wrong, leaving a mess behind would be more meaningful than keeping the place intact.
unit.target: Et sī aliquid male evenīret, reliquās caoticas relinquere potius esset quam locum intāctum servāre.

unit.source: Lumian conjured a bright white fireball, placing it at the base of one of the statues, setting it to explode with a delay.
unit.target: Lumian globum ignis candidī radiante evocāvit, eum ad rādicem unīus statuae collocāns, itā condīxit ut post moram explōderet.

unit.source: After setting up five time bombs, Lumian moved about ten meters away, hiding in the dense fog, and snapped his fingers.
unit.target: Postquam quīnque bombāe temporālēs posuerat, Lumian circiter decem metra abiit, in nebulā dēnsa sē celāns, et digitōs strinxit.

unit.source: Rumble!
unit.target: Tumultus!

unit.source: The four statues and the stone platform simultaneously underwent a violent explosion, cracking from the base and collapsing into piles of rubble.
unit.target: Quattuor statuae et tabulātum lapideum simul violenti explosiōnī subiectī sunt, rādice fissī et in acervōs ruinārum corruērunt.

unit.source: The explosion dissipated some of the dense fog, allowing Lumian to see the statues and the platform.
unit.target: Explosiō quaedam nebula dēnsam dissipāvit, quae Lumianī permisit statuae et tabulātum vidēre.

unit.source: No anomalies or dangers appeared…
unit.target: Nolla insolīta aut pericula apparuērunt…

unit.source: Good.
unit.target: Bene.

unit.source: Now, let’s see if Gusain or Albus notice the commotion and come to check it out.
unit.target: Nunc vidēmus, utrum Gusain vel Albus tumultum animadverterint et ad rem explorandam accedant.

unit.source: I’ll be hiding here, ready to strike a fatal blow…
unit.target: Hīc latitābō, parātus ictum mortiferum inferre…

unit.source: Lumian grew more puzzled about the statues and the platform, planning to set a simple trap for Gusain that might be overlooked due to its subtlety.
unit.target: Lumian de statuae et tabulātō magis perplexus fātus est, cōnspicuum dolum simplex pro Gusain parandō prōponens, quī ob eius subtilitātem fortasse neglexisset.

unit.source: If the statues and the platform were crucial, Gusain would rush to confirm the situation, instinctively thinking the destroyer had already escaped to avoid an ambush.
unit.target: Sī statuae et tabulātum essent essentialia, Gusain festināre ad rem comprobandam accēdere dūxelit, instintīvē putāns destructorem iam effugisse ut insidiam vitāret.

unit.source: Just as Lumian was about to retreat further into the fog, he noticed the five piles of rubble starting to wriggle.
unit.target: Iā dum Lumian in nebulā ulteriōrem recēdere parāret, quīnque catervās ruinārum incipiēntēs quassārī animadvertere vīdī.

unit.source: They collided and quickly reformed, rising back into their original statue and platform shapes.
unit.target: Confligerunt et celeriter reformātae sunt, redīre in formas origināriās statuarum et tabulātī.

unit.source: Identical to before.
unit.target: Idem erant, sicut anteā.

unit.source: Wh– Lumian’s eyes froze.
unit.target: Heu— oculī Luminī congelāvērunt.

unit.source: The stone statues and the platform can restore themselves?
unit.target: Statuae lapideae et tabulātum sē restituere possunt?

unit.source: No wonder the Iron and Blood Cross Order didn’t station guards here…
unit.target: Non mirum est quōd Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguīnīs hic custōdēs nōn constituit!

unit.source: They aren’t afraid of these things being destroyed!
unit.target: Nōn timent nē haec deleantur!

unit.source: Lumian quickly recovered and tried a new approach.
unit.target: Lumian celeriter sē recorporāvit et ad novum modum accessit.

unit.source: This time, after blowing up the statues and the platform, he used his Traveler’s Bag to collect some of the rubble, waiting a few meters away.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, postquam statuae et tabulātum evellit, sacculus viātōris ad aliquot ruinās colligendās ūsus est, pauca metra distantem exspectāns.

unit.source: The stone statues and the platform restored themselves again, drawing materials from the earth, while the rubble in Lumian’s pouch became ordinary stones.
unit.target: Statuae lapideae et tabulātum iterum sē restituere coeperunt, materiās ex terrā trahentēs, dum ruināe in sacculō Luminī in lapidēs commūnēs mutātae sunt.

unit.source: Lumian temporarily gave up on destruction, emptied the pouch of rubble, and returned to the statues, picking up the oil lamp with the glass cover.
unit.target: Lumian ad dēstructiōnem temporāriē cessāvit, sacculus ruinārum exsiccāvit, et ad statuae rediit, face oleariam cum operculō vitreo sumens.

unit.source: Inside the lamp was a semi‑solid, semi‑liquid yellowish grease, with a wick seemingly woven from black hair.
unit.target: Intra facem oleariam inveniebātur substantia pallide luteo‑rubra, semi‑solida et semi‑liquida, cum stoppinō denso nigrō in summō, quasi ex capillīs confectō.

unit.source: The more Lumian looked at it, the more familiar it seemed.
unit.target: Quō magis Lumian eam contemplābat, eo magis nota apparebat.

unit.source: He began to recall the source of this familiarity.
unit.target: Coepit originem huius familiaritātis recordārī.

unit.source: After over ten seconds, he suddenly reached into his Traveler’s Bag and took out an item.
unit.target: Post plūsquam decem secundīs, subitō in sacculum viātōris manum intulit et rēm extrāxit.

unit.source: It was a pale yellowish‑red, semi‑solid substance in a transparent glass bottle, with a thick black wick on top.
unit.target: Erat substantia pallide luteo‑rubra, semi‑solida, in vitro translucīdō, cum stoppinō denso nigrō in summō.

unit.source: Corpse wax candle!
unit.target: Candēla ex cera cadāverum!

unit.source: A candle made from the corpse oils of an Iron‑blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair mixed with other substances!
unit.target: Candēla ex oleīs cadāverum Equitis Ferri‑sanguineī et daemonissae Desperātiōnis, cum aliīs substantiīs mixta!

unit.source: The oil lamp on the stone platform resembled it somewhat.
unit.target: Face olearia in tabulātō lapideō aliquantulum huic similis videbātur.

unit.source: Lumian muttered to himself, “Magician, Magician, –” said that Fourth Epoch Trier and a place in Bansy Harbor were the best scenes for the corpse wax candle…
unit.target: Lumian sībi murmurāvit, “Magus, Magus,” inquit, “Quartum Saeculum Trier et locus in Portū Bansy sunt optima loca pro candēla ex cera cadāverum.”

unit.source: What about the underground mausoleum in Morora, which is very similar to Fourth Epoch Trier?
unit.target: Quid dē mausoleō subterraneō in Morora, quod valdē simile est Quārtō Saeculō Trier?

unit.source: 809 Additive
unit.target: 809 Additio

unit.source: 809 Additive
unit.target: 809 Additio

unit.source: In the dense fog, Lumian stared at the oil lamp, feeling an urge to light it and see what would happen.
unit.target: In nebula densa, Lumian lampam olei intuebatur, desiderium illam accendere et quid eveniret videre sentiens.

unit.source: Eventually, he controlled himself and refrained from taking the risk.
unit.target: Tandem se temperavit et periculum capere abstinuit.

unit.source: With everything still in a state of chaos and uncertainty, Lumian believed that making any high‐risk decisions would be unwise.
unit.target: Cum omnia adhuc in statu chaos et incertitudinis erant, Lumian existimavit consilia altissimo periculo instituta insipientia esse.

unit.source: He also had no intention of taking the oil lamp to trade with Albus Medici for the head of the Abscessed Hand.
unit.target: Etiam non habebat consilium lampam olei ferre ad commercium cum Albus Medici pro capite Manus Abscessae.

unit.source: Since the Iron and Blood Cross Order placed the oil lamp here without guarding it, they probably weren’t worried about losing it or had many similar lamps.
unit.target: Cum Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis lampam olei hic posuerit sine custodia, forsan non sollicitabantur de eius amissione aut multas lampadas similes haberent.

unit.source: Based on his observations, Lumian deduced that the pale yellow grease in the lamp likely didn’t come from Iron‐blooded Knights and Demonesses of Despair.
unit.target: Ex observationibus suis, Lumian concludit quod unguentum pallide luteum in lampade verisimiliter non ex equitibus ferri et sanguinis nec daemonissis desperationis proveniret.

unit.source: It was different from corpse wax candles and seemed to be a mixture of mid‐sequence Hunters and Demonesses.
unit.target: Id differebat ab candelis ex cera cadaverum et videbatur fuisse mixtura venatorum ordinis mediocris atque daemonissarum.

unit.source: Though it’s less effective than a corpse wax candle, it should still work in the underground of Morora, which is similar to Fourth Epoch Trier…
unit.target: Quamquam minus efficax quam candela ex cera cadaverum, tamen in subterranis partibus Morora, quae similem habet Trier Quartae Aevi, operari debet.

unit.source: Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian manum in sacculum viatoris introduxit.

unit.source: Just because he couldn’t light it or take it didn’t mean he couldn’t do anything.
unit.target: Quod eam non incendere nec portare posset, non significabat se nihil agere posse.

unit.source: He planned to add something extra to the oil lamp, ensuring the Iron and Blood Cross Order would face unforeseen complications during their rituals!
unit.target: Consilium cepit aliquid addere lampae olei, ut Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis in ritibus suis inopinatas difficultates subirent!

unit.source: Lumian took out some old blood powder from the Demon Warlock, Ice Lemon Fish fillets, a Berserk Agent from the Nightstalkers, and another Bark Agent from the same source.
unit.target: Lumian extraxit aliquod pulverem veterem sanguinis a Daemonum Warlock, fileta piscis “Ice Lemon”, agentem ferocissimum ex Nocturnis Venatoribus, atque alium agentem ex cortice eodem fonte.

unit.source: He placed them on the half‐height stone platform, mixed a bit of each into a brown lump the size of a human finger joint.
unit.target: Illos posuit in suggestu lapideo dimidio altitudinis, miscens paulum ex unoquoque in globulum fuscum, magnitudine unius articulationis digiti humani.

unit.source: What do you call this? A cocktail!
unit.target: Quid hoc appellas? Cocktailum!

unit.source: Lumian chuckled, putting all the materials back into his Traveler’s Bag.
unit.target: Lumian subridens omnes materias in sacculum viatoris reponit.

unit.source: He then took out Mr. K’s finger, sliced off some flesh, and wrapped it around the brown lump.
unit.target: Deinde extraxit digitum Domini K, aliquam carnem secans, et circum nodule fuscum involvit.

unit.source: This was a precaution against the Iron and Blood Cross Order’s inspection – Hunters from the Order would undoubtedly check the oil lamp for any issues before use, as it wasn’t always under their strict watch.
unit.target: Hoc fuit cautio contra inspectionem Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis—venatores ordinis certo lampam olei perscrutabuntur ante usum, cum non semper sub strenua eorum custodia esset.

unit.source: In Morora, Lumian didn’t worry that using Mr. K’s finger this way would be detected.
unit.target: In Morora, Lumian non timuit ne usus digitum Domini K hoc modo detegeretur.

unit.source: Looking at the blood‐stained lump, Lumian reluctantly scooped a bit of the semi‐solid, yellowish‐red substance from his corpse wax candle and smeared it on the lump.
unit.target: Aspiciens nodule sanguine maculatum, Lumian vix nolens paululum substantiae semi-solidae, luteo-rubrae ex candela cera cadaverum sumpsit et in nodulum unxit.

unit.source: A double disguise, combined with a higher‐Sequence, godhood‐possessing item, should fool the Hunters’ noses and eyes!
unit.target: Identitas duplicata, coniuncta cum suprema sequentia atque deitate praeditum, debet nasos et oculos Venatorum fallere!

unit.source: Once the lump was coated with the yellowish‐red substance, Lumian examined the candle, reassuring himself, “Just a little bit, it shouldn’t affect the number of uses…”
unit.target: Postquam nodule substantia luteo-rubra coopertum est, Lumian candelam perspexit, seque consolans, “Paululum tantum; numerum usuum non afficiet...”

unit.source: After putting away the corpse wax candle, Lumian picked up the oil lamp, removed the wick made of woven black hair, and carefully submerged the yellowish‐red lump into the semi‐solid grease, ensuring it stayed in the desired position.
unit.target: Postquam candela ex cera cadaverum reponita est, Lumian lampam olei sustulit, plicam ex capillis nigris textis removit, et caute nodule luteo-rubrum in unguente semi-solido demersiit, curans ut in loco optato remaneret.

unit.source: Seeing the lump’s yellowish‐red color blend with the surrounding grease, leaving only faint traces hidden inside, Lumian breathed in relief and slowly inserted the wick back into the semi‐solid grease.
unit.target: Videntes colorem luteo-rubrum noduli cum unguente circumstanti miscere, solummodo levia vestigia intus latere, Lumian leviter anhelavit et paulatim plicam in unguente semi-solido reinsertit.

unit.source: After several adjustments, the wick’s position and condition finally met Lumian’s requirements.
unit.target: Post aliquot adaptationes, positio et condicio plicae tandem exigentias Lumiani occurrerunt.

unit.source: He could already imagine the scene:
unit.target: Iam scaenam imaginari poterat:

unit.source: The oil lamp would initially burn normally, with the corpse wax having perhaps a hint of godhood, enhancing the ritual’s effect and immersing the Iron and Blood Cross Order members in the sensory experience.
unit.target: Lampada olei initio normale ardebit, cum cera cadaverum fortasse aliquod deitate indicium habens, effectum rituum confirmans atque membra Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis in experientia sensoria immergens.

unit.source: This would last for twenty or thirty seconds, after which the corpse wax part would burn.
unit.target: Hoc per viginti aut triginta secundos manebit, deinde pars cerae cadaverum ardebit.

unit.source: This would bring an intense pact‐like experience, potentially fatal for some Order members with weaker wills.
unit.target: Hoc afferet experientiam vehementem, quasi pacto similem, quae fortasse fatalis erit quibusdam membris Ordinis infirmae voluntatis.

unit.source: Of course, this might also benefit some members, causing positive mutations, but the corpse wax portion was minimal, and the burn would soon reach the random materials wrapped in Mr. K’s flesh.
unit.target: Certe, hoc etiam quibusdam membris prodesset, mutationes positivas generans, sed pars cerae cadaverum minima fuit, et ignis mox perveniret ad materias fortuitas in carne Domini K involutas.

unit.source: Lumian wasn’t sure what the impact would be, but he was confident it would worsen the situation.
unit.target: Lumian non erat certus qualis effectus futuros esset, sed confidebat rem peioraturam fore.

unit.source: Just suck on this one; it hits strong.
unit.target: Accipe hoc; percutit vehementer.

unit.source: Lumian recalled how South Continent people described East Balam cigarettes, smiling as he addressed the imaginary Order members.
unit.target: Lumian meminit quomodo populi Continenti Australis cigarettas Balam orientales describerent, subridente dum ad fictos ordinis membra loquebatur.

unit.source: Then, he cleaned up the traces on the oil lamp and tidied the scattered rubble.
unit.target: Tum vestigia in lampade olei purgavit et ruinas dispersas ordinavit.

unit.source: Following the faint scent of various perfumes, Lumian found his way back to the basement crack through the dense fog, leaving the area slowly.
unit.target: Sequens tenue odor variorum unguentorum, Lumian viam suam ad fissuram subterraneam per densam nebula invenit, regionem lente relinquens.

unit.source: He transformed into a shadow creature, silently returned to the Carnivore bar, and pretended to sleep to avoid an ambush by Albus Medici, Gusain, and others.
unit.target: In creaturam umbram transformatus, tacite ad tabernam Carnivorum rediit, et dormire simulavit, ut insidiam a Albo Medici, Gusain, aliisque vitaret.

unit.source: At six in the morning, Lumian felt refreshed.
unit.target: Hora sexta matutina, Lumian se refectum sensit.

unit.source: He rolled out of bed, stretched his neck, and laughed softly.
unit.target: Ex lecto se evolvit, collum protraxit, et leniter risit.

unit.source: “Didn’t come? Albus and the others didn’t come, neither did Wanak.
unit.target: “Non venerunt? Albus et ceteri non venerunt, nec Wanak.

unit.source: Do they think I have teleportation abilities, making it hard to kill me outside a special battlefield or without special items?
unit.target: Putantne me facultates teleportationis habere, ita ut difficile sit me extra certum campum aut sine instrumentis specialibus interficere?

unit.source: “Heh heh, you’re too hesitant, too cautious.
unit.target: Heh heh, es nimis dubius, nimis cautus.

unit.source: Now I have shadows again, no longer afraid of sunlight, and can block another fatal attack…”
unit.target: Nunc umbras iterum habeo, iam non sole metuens, et aliam fatalem impetum obstruere possum...

unit.source: Lumian drew the curtains, gazing at the brightening dawn, his eyes falling on the books from the Church of Knowledge on his desk.
unit.target: Lumian cortinas trahebat, auroram fulgentem intuebatur, et oculi eius in libris Ecclesiae Scientiae super mensam eius inciderunt.

unit.source: He instinctively felt a headache, frowning.
unit.target: Instinctu sensit dolorem capitis et fronte contraxit.

unit.source: He resisted reading and learning, struggling with an indescribable inner turmoil.
unit.target: Legere et discere repugnavit, certans cum intimo inenarrabili tumultu.

unit.source: If there were only a few books, Lumian would be highly motivated, reading diligently and focusing intently, but knowing there were three whole shelves of books and thousands of scrolls left him feeling defeated, unwilling to start.
unit.target: Si paucos tantum libros haberet, Lumian valde incitaretur, diligenter legens atque intentissime intendens, sed sciebat tres totas cellas librorum et milia voluminum esse, quod eum victum sentire et incipere velle impediit.

unit.source: After several seconds, Lumian rubbed his temples, sighed, and muttered to himself,
unit.target: Post aliquot secundos, Lumian tempora sua friccavit, suspiravit, et sibi murmurat.

unit.source: Well, since 0-01 was sealed by the Church of Knowledge, I should respect knowledge.
unit.target: Bene, cum 0-01 a Ecclesia Scientiae sigillatum esset, scientiam honorare debeo.

unit.source: There’s nothing else to do now, just waiting for Albus and Julie to take further action, hoping to seize an opportunity and direction…
unit.target: Nullo alio nunc agendo, solum expectans ut Albus et Iulia ulteriora caperent, spem habens occasione et viae apprehensione...

unit.source: Lumian sat down, leaning back in his chair, placing his feet on the edge of the desk, reading the books specified by Heraberg in a comfortable but precarious position.
unit.target: Lumian consedit, in sella sua recubans, pedes in margine mensae ponens, libros a Heraberg indicatos legens in positione commoda sed periculosa.

unit.source: He had read the first two or three chapters before and found nothing noteworthy, but this time he planned to study in depth.
unit.target: Prius duas vel tres capita legebat et nihil notabile inveniit, sed hoc tempore consilium habuit diligenter studere.

unit.source: As he read, Lumian’s expression gradually changed.
unit.target: Dum legebat, vultus Lumiani paulatim mutatus est.

unit.source: He became engrossed in the reading, almost forgetting the time until Lez knocked on the door, telling him breakfast was ready.
unit.target: In lectione absorptus est, tempus paene oblitus, donec Lez ad ianuam pulsavit, nuntians eum prandium paratum esse.

unit.source: “Okay.” Lumian nodded, setting down the book without any visible changes and heading out of the room.
unit.target: “Bene.” Lumian annuit, librum deponens sine ullis signis mutationis, et ex conclavi proficiscens.

unit.source: Almost at the door, he saw Lez turning towards the stairs and half-turned back, glancing at the books on the desk with a puzzled expression.
unit.target: Fere ad ianuam, vidit Lez versus scalas convertentem et paulo retrorsum, libros super mensam intuens vultu perplexo.

unit.source: These books indeed contained important knowledge!
unit.target: Hi libri re vera notitiam magni momenti continebant!

unit.source: He was currently reading one thoroughly and had skimmed through the others, already finding similarities with the details in the 0-01 sealing information, along with more detailed explanations!
unit.target: Nunc unum penitus legebat et reliquos perlegit, iam similitudines cum rebus in notitia sigillationis 0-01 reperiens, atque etiam explicationes minutiores!

unit.source: If I read through the three bookshelves and pass the exam, I might find a way to approach 0-01 through the overall sealing operation and use the sealing principles to protect myself when touching the artifact…
unit.target: Si per tres cellas librorum perlegam et examen superemero, fortasse viam inveniam ad 0-01 per totam operationem sigillationis accessendum, atque principia sigillationis ad me protegendum, dum artefactum tingo.

unit.source: Knowledge is power, knowledge is wealth, knowledge holds all the answers…
unit.target: Scientia est potentia, scientia est divitiae, scientia omnia responsa continet...

unit.source: Lumian withdrew his gaze, his eyes flashing with thoughts as he entered the hallway and turned towards the stairs.
unit.target: Lumian oculos aversus, et cum cogitationibus micantibus, in vestibulum intransiit atque ad scalas vertit.

unit.source: The problem now was that this kind of knowledge brought noticeable corruption, just like the 0-01 sealing information.
unit.target: Quaestio nunc erat quod talis scientia corruptionem conspicuiorem afferebat, sicut notitia sigillationis 0-01.

unit.source: Lumian worried that the more he learned, the closer he got to 0-01, the more likely he would become its puppet.
unit.target: Lumian timebat, quo magis disceret, eo propius ad 0-01 accederet, et tanto magis ut quasi eius marionetta fieret.

unit.source: Also, if I focus too much on reading these books, Albus, Julie, Gusain, and Wanak might get suspicious and also borrow a few books from the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: Etiam, si nimis in his libris legendo incumbam, Albus, Iulia, Gusain, atque Wanak suspicari possint et pauca de libris Ecclesiae Scientiae mutuo capere.

unit.source: Then I would lose my advantage… I need to wander aimlessly every day, set traps for them, outsmart them, and make it seem like I’m just reading out of boredom…
unit.target: Tum commoda mea amitterem… Cotidie sine proposito vagari debeo, laqueos illis ponere, eos callide superare, et efficere ut videatur me simpliciter ex taedio legere…

unit.source: Lumian’s smile gradually widened.
unit.target: Risus Lumiani paulatim latius factus est.

unit.source: He finished the flight of stairs and glanced at Julie sitting on a bar stool at the counter.
unit.target: Ille scalas perambulavit finivit atque Iuliam, quae in scabello ad mensam sedebat, intuebatur.

unit.source: The Demoness wore a white shirt and black skirt, looking quite demure, but she swayed her waist gently, making the stool spin.
unit.target: Daemonissa induta erat camisā albā et paenulā nigra, aspectu satis modesta, sed lumbos leniter movebat, faciens scabellum vertere.

unit.source: She glanced back at Lumian and continued talking to Lez,
unit.target: Illa retro ad Lumian intuebatur et ad Lez loqui continuavit,

unit.source: “I only think about finding what I lost from other men when I’m in a terrible mood.
unit.target: “Cogito solum de inveniendis, quae a ceteris viris amiserim, cum in animo terribili versor.

unit.source: Normally, I just feel jealous and resentful, wondering why I lost it and they still have it?
unit.target: Normaliter, solum invidiam et rancorem sentio, mirans cur id amiserim et illi adhuc tenerent?

unit.source: “And you, your cooking has conquered me.
unit.target: “Et tu, tua coquina me vicit.

unit.source: I acknowledge your right to keep that thing, as long as you don’t come to me when I’m in a bad mood, I won’t do anything to you.”
unit.target: Agnovero ius tuum illud retinendi, dummodo, cum in malo animo sim, ad me non accedas, nihil tibi faciam.

unit.source: Is that why you Demonesses like turning lovers into Witches?
unit.target: Num propter hoc, daemonissae, amatores in magas convertere libet?

unit.source: Lumian sat beside Julie, smiling at Lez.
unit.target: Lumian iuxta Iuliam sedebat, Lez subridens.

unit.source: “What are you guys talking about?”
unit.target: “De quo loquimini?”

unit.source: Lez licked his lips and replied, “She asked if I was curious about the taste of Demoness meat and cut a small piece for me.
unit.target: Lez labra lambebat et respondit: “Rogavit an me curiosum esse de sapore carnis daemonissae, et mihi parvum fragmentum secavit.

unit.source: Grilled, it was delicious, rich in fat and very chewy.
unit.target: Assatum, sapidum erat, pingue et valde masticabile.

unit.source: Then we got to the topic we were discussing.
unit.target: Deinde ad rem de qua disputabamus pervenimus.

unit.source: Lumian glanced at Julie and noticed the bandage marks on her left shoulder, with some bloodstains on her shirt.
unit.target: Lumian Iuliam intuebatur et animadvertit vestigia ligaminum in humero sinistro eius, cum quaedam sanguinis maculae in veste eius erant.

unit.source: She really cut it… One daring to cut and the other daring to cook, your mental states and inner worlds are beyond me…
unit.target: Vere illam secuit… Unus audax ad secandum et alter audax ad coquendum, mentes vestras atque intima regna mihi inaccessa sunt…

unit.source: Lumian snorted and directly asked Julie, “What are you up to?”
unit.target: Lumian sufflans directe Iuliam rogavit: “Quid agis?”

unit.source: Julie smiled, showing two shallow dimples.
unit.target: Iulia subridens duas parvas concavas in vultu ostendit.

unit.source: “I want to learn cooking from Lez.”
unit.target: “Volo a Lez artem coquendi discere.”

unit.source: Her face was full of longing and expectation.
unit.target: Vultus eius desiderio atque exspectatione plenus erat.

unit.source: To cook for Celeste? You Demonesses… Lumian shook his head and focused on his breakfast.
unit.target: Coquere pro Celeste? Vos, daemonissae… Lumian caput concussit et ad prandium suum attendit.

unit.source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
unit.target: Trier, Quartiere Cathedralis Commemorativus, Apartmentum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

unit.source: Franca received a reply from Madam Judgment.
unit.target: Franca responsum a Domina Iudicio accepit.

unit.source: The letter began:
unit.target: Epistula incipiebat:

unit.source: “Mr. Star agrees to provide potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients in stages for Amandina’s matter, but he doesn’t need money or resources.
unit.target: “Dominus Star consentit potionum formulas et ingredientes Beyonder gradatim pro re Amandina tradere, sed neque pecuniam neque opes requirit.

unit.source: He only hopes you can help with some matters.”
unit.target: Sperat tantum te posse in quibusdam rebus auxilium praestare.

unit.source: 810 Learning is my Hobby
unit.target: 810 Discere est otium meum

unit.source: 810 Learning is my Hobby
unit.target: 810 Discere est otium meum

unit.source: Thinking that if it were truly dangerous and beyond her ability to help, Madam Judgment would surely protect her, Franca pulled out a sheet of pure white paper and began her reply: “Dear Madam Judgment, “If Mr. Star’s requests are within reason, I have no problem with them.”
unit.target: Cogitans, si vere periculosum esset atque ultra eius facultatem ad auxilium agendum, Domina Iudicii eam certe protegeret, Franca charta purae albae evolvit et suum responsum scribere coepit: “Cara Domina Iudicii, ‘Si petitiones Domini Star ratione congruentes sunt, nullam difficultatem habeo.’”

unit.source: After writing this, Franca read the rest of Madam Judgment’s letter:
unit.target: Post hoc scripto, Franca reliquam epistulam Dominae Iudicii legit:
