unit.source: “The Demoness of Black’s description and speculation about the Primordial Demoness are a common view within the Demoness Sect.
unit.target: “Descriptio et speculatio Daemonissae Nigrae de Daemonissa Primordiali sunt visio communis intra Sectam Daemonissarum.

unit.source: However, if it were that simple, things wouldn’t be this complicated.
unit.target: Attamen, si ita simplex esset, res non tam complicatae essent.”

unit.source: “Many high-ranking witches believe the mirror world is vital for the Demoness pathway.
unit.target: “Multae magae summi ordinis credunt mundum specularum esse vitalem ad viam daemonissae.

unit.source: This isn’t entirely inaccurate, but as a collective concept of ‘doors’, the mirror world seems incapable of bearing such importance.
unit.target: Hoc non omnino inexactum est, sed ut conceptus communis “ianuarum”, mundus specularum videtur non posse talem pondus sustinere.

unit.source: “These are things we need to understand further.
unit.target: “Haec sunt quae ulterius cognoscenda sunt.

unit.source: “Two of Cups, I know this may be harsh, but you still need to continue infiltrating the Demoness Sect for a while.
unit.target: “Duo Poculorum, scio hoc fortasse asperum esse, sed tamen necesse est ut per aliquod tempus in sectam daemonissarum infiltrare pergas.

unit.source: You are currently our highest-ranked member within the sect.
unit.target: Nunc es membrum sectae nostri summo gradu.

unit.source: “Due to the peculiarities of the Demoness pathway, we cannot actively cultivate male Assassins, and the existing Demoness Sect members are mentally twisted, longing to approach the Primordial One.
unit.target: “Propter singulares vias daemonissae, non possumus Assassinos masculos active colere, et membra sectae daemonissarum existantia mentibus corruptis sunt, ad Primordiale appropinquare desiderantes.

unit.source: We can only passively wait and find people like you who inadvertently enter the Assassin pathway…
unit.target: Nobis solum licet passive exspectare et invenire homines similes tibi, qui inattente in viam Assassinorum incidunt…

unit.source: Suddenly feeling a heavy sense of responsibility… Franca muttered to herself, sighed, and continued writing her reply.
unit.target: Subito gravem sensum responsabilitatis sentiens, Franca sibi ipsi murmurat, suspiravit, et responsum scribere continevit.

unit.source: She wasn’t too disappointed, still hoping to obtain the main ingredients for the Demoness of Despair within the sect, provided she found a way to bypass the cruel requirements of the advancement ritual.
unit.target: Non valde deiecta erat, tamen spem habens principales materias pro Daemonissa Desperationis intra sectam adipisci, dummodo viam inveniret ut crudeles exigentias ritu progressus superaret.

unit.source: After sending her reply, Franca leaned back in her chair, gazing idly out the window at the night sky.
unit.target: Postquam responsum misit, Franca in sella sua recubuit, per fenestram ad nocturnum caelum otiose contemplans.

unit.source: Suddenly, the area in front of her grew extremely dark, and a silver skull emerged from the void, holding a letter in its mouth.
unit.target: Subito, area ante eam valde obscurata est, et calvaria argentea ex vacuo apparuit, epistulam in ore tenens.

unit.source: Another letter?
unit.target: Altera epistula?

unit.source: What’s going on?
unit.target: Quid fit?

unit.source: Franca took it, thanked the messenger, and watched it leave before opening the letter, inhaling its subtle, enduring fragrance:
unit.target: Franca eam accepit, nuntio gratias egit, et eam discedentem aspexit, antequam epistulam aperiret, odor subtilis atque diuturnus ejus inspirans.

unit.source: “Dear Muggle,
unit.target: “Care Muggle,

unit.source: “Do you remember the previous invitation?
unit.target: “Meministine invitationem priorem?

unit.source: “We’re having an offline gathering in Trier this Saturday at 10 p.m. Are you still interested in attending? If so, please reply promptly, and I’ll inform you of the location and participation details.
unit.target: “Hac Saturni die in Trier conventum praesentem habebimus ad horam decimam vespertinam. Num adhuc interest tibi ut adsis? Si ita, quaeso cito responde, et locum ac singula participationis tibi indicabo.

unit.source: “Professor.”
unit.target: “Professor.”

unit.source: An offline meeting of the Academy team?
unit.target: Conventus praesentis turmae Academiae?

unit.source: Lumian’s life is so eventful!
unit.target: Vita Lumiani tam eventibus plena est!

unit.source: I’ve barely been his proxy for a few days, and I’m already swamped with tasks, one after another…
unit.target: Vix paucos dies eius procurator fuī, et iam onerata sum officiis, unum post alium…

unit.source: Should he be called 007?
unit.target: Num eum 007 vocari debet?

unit.source: Even 007 needs sleep; he doesn’t!
unit.target: Etiam 007 somnum requirit; ille autem non habet!

unit.source: Franca couldn’t help but lampoon.
unit.target: Franca non potuit non irridere.

unit.source: She had already noticed that wherever Lumian went, hidden catastrophes erupted one after another.
unit.target: Iam animadvertit quod, ubicumque Lumian iret, catastrophae occultae una post aliam erumpebant.

unit.source: But since she hadn’t been directly involved in most of them, the impact hadn’t been as apparent.
unit.target: Sed quia in plurimis non directe versata erat, effectus non tam evidens fuit.

unit.source: Now, as his liaison, she felt it keenly.
unit.target: Nunc, ut eius legata, id vehementer sensit.

unit.source: After a while, Franca sighed.
unit.target: Post aliquod tempus, Franca suspiravit.

unit.source: She’d have to use the Ice Amulet to contact Lumian again!
unit.target: Oportet ut Amuletum Glaciale ad Lumian denuo contactum adhibeat!

unit.source: Since obtaining it from the Demoness of Black, she hadn’t used it for investigating the Mirror People, spending it all on Lumian-related matters.
unit.target: Ex quo id ab Daemonissa Nigra adepta est, non usus est id ad investigandum Populum Specularum, totum negotium ad res Lumianas expendens.

unit.source: She needed to ask Lumian if he wanted to attend the offline gathering of the Academy team, which might include members of the Moses Ascetic Order.
unit.target: Debebat Lumiano rogare num conventui praesentis turmae Academiae, qui fortasse membra Ordinis Asceticorum Moysi includere possit, interesse vellet.

unit.source: If he did, he’d need to designate a substitute and try to send out the Lie earrings.
unit.target: Si ita fecerit, necesse erit ut subsitutum designes atque coneris “Lie Earrings” mittere.

unit.source: Franca quickly wrote a letter regarding the matter, wrapping a copper coin, some wraith dust, and her rarely used Beatrice’s Necklace in the paper.
unit.target: Franca celeriter epistulam de re scripsit, et in charta involvit monetam cupram, pulverem umbraticum, atque Monile Beatricis, raro usitatum.

unit.source: She had noticed that after passing through the seal of Morora, Lumian’s letters lost their physical form, leaving only pure information.
unit.target: Animadvertit postquam per sigillum Mororae transierunt, epistolae Lumiani formam physicam amisse, relinquentes solam puram notitiam.

unit.source: So, she planned to experiment, seeing if ordinary items, highly spiritual items, and Beyonder items could all pass through the seal and in what state they would exist.
unit.target: Ita consilium ceperat experimentum facere, ut perspiceret utrum res ordinariae, res valde spirituales, et res Beyonder per sigillum transire possent, atque in quo statu existerent.

unit.source: The experiment’s results would determine if the Lie earrings could be sent out.
unit.target: Eventus experimenti determinabunt num “Lie Earrings” miti possint.

unit.source: If it weren’t for the fact that each mystical item was precious and useful, Franca would have included items containing Beyonder characteristics in this experiment.
unit.target: Nisi quod quilibet res mystica pretiosa et utilis esset, Franca res cum proprietatibus Beyonder in hoc experimento includuisset.

unit.source: After preparing the small package, Franca walked to the full-length mirror in the living room, putting on the Ice Amulet.
unit.target: Postquam parvum sarcinam paravit, Franca ad speculum totum in conclavi ambulavit, Amuletum Glaciale induens.

unit.source: As it flashed with crystalline cold light, Franca pressed the package into the glass surface.
unit.target: Cum luce gelida crystallo micante, Franca sarcinam in superficiem vitrei premebat.

unit.source: Late at night in Morora, on the second floor of the Carnivore bar.
unit.target: Sero nocte in Morora, in secundo tabulato tabernae Carnivorum.

unit.source: Lumian sat under a glowing white fireball, focused on reading “Examples of Underground Mausoleum Construction.”
unit.target: Lumian sub globulo ignis albo fulgente sedebat, responsum “Exempla Constructionis Mausolei Subterranei” legere intentus.

unit.source: Suddenly, he looked up, his eyes bloodshot, and glanced at the mirror in the room.
unit.target: Subito surrexit, oculis rubentibus, et speculum in conclavi aspexit.

unit.source: The mirror’s surface had turned dark, with ripples moving within it.
unit.target: Superficies speculi obscurata erat, cum undae intra eam moverentur.

unit.source: Lumian reluctantly set down his book, approached the mirror, and placed his right hand on it.
unit.target: Lumian, vix nolens, librum deponit, ad speculum accessit, et dextram manum super eum posuit.

unit.source: He saw Intisian words appearing on the mirror’s surface, line after line, densely packed.
unit.target: Vidit verba Intisiana in superficie speculi apparire, versus post versus, densi aggregati.

unit.source: Professor’s invitation… Academy team’s offline gathering… experiment with transferring items…
unit.target: Invitatio Professoris… conventus praesentis turmae Academiae… experimentum de rebus transferendis…

unit.source: Lumian’s thoughts raced.
unit.target: Cogitationes Lumiani festinanter currentes erant.

unit.source: Taking advantage of the Ice Amulet’s active effect, he reached into the mirror and pulled out an item.
unit.target: Effectum activum Amuletī Glacialis adhibens, Lumian in speculum se intulit et rem extraxit.

unit.source: It was a diamond necklace.
unit.target: Erat monile adamanteum.

unit.source: Beatrice’s Necklace!
unit.target: Monile Beatricis!

unit.source: The copper coin and wraith dust mentioned in Franca’s letter were gone.
unit.target: Moneta cuprea et pulveris umbratici, quae in epistula Francae dicta erant, evanuerant.

unit.source: Lumian looked back at the mirror, seeing an image of the coin and wraith dust around the densely packed words, with a ghostly presence.
unit.target: Lumian speculum redegit, et imaginem monetae atque pulveris umbratici circa verba densissime congregata conspiciens, cum praesentia phantastica.

unit.source: As the Ice Amulet’s power waned, and the words faded, the items gradually disappeared.
unit.target: Dum potentia Amuletī Glacialis decrescebat, et verba evanescebant, res paulatim evanuebant.

unit.source: Only pure information and items with Beyonder power can pass through that special mirror world, through the seal, and reach here?
unit.target: Solum pura notitia et res cum potentia Beyonder praeditae per illum mundum specularum speciale, per sigillum, huc pervenire possunt?

unit.source: Hmm, items with godhood shouldn’t work either, only something made within Morora…
unit.target: Hmm, res cum deitate praeditae quoque non operari debent, solum aliquid intra Mororam confectum…

unit.source: Lumian played with Beatrice’s Necklace, using the Ice Amulet’s remaining power to send Franca two words: “Necklace, okay.”
unit.target: Lumian Monile Beatricis lusus est, reliqua potentia Amuletī Glacialis adhibens, Francae duo verba mittere: “Monile, bene.”

unit.source: The aqueous glow within the mirror quickly receded, and the dark glass returned to normal.
unit.target: Lumen aquosum intra speculum celeriter recedebat, et vitrum obscurum ad ordinem rediit.

unit.source: Soon, the mirror showed another anomaly.
unit.target: Mox, speculum aliam anomaliam ostendit.

unit.source: This time, Franca sent the Ice Amulet through.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, Franca Amuletum Glaciale per speculum misit.

unit.source: This helped Lumian conserve the use of the Mirror Cufflink—only two uses left.
unit.target: Hoc adiuvit Lumian ut usum “Mirror Cufflink”, cui modo duo usus reliquerunt, conservaret.

unit.source: Holding the icy talisman, Lumian began writing his reply.
unit.target: Tenens talisman gelidum, Lumian responsum scribere coepit.

unit.source: He detailed the experiment results and his observations on the item transfer process, then instructed Franca to attend the Academy team’s offline gathering in Trier as Muggle on his behalf.
unit.target: Eventus experimenti ac observationes de processu translationis rerum enuntiavit, deinde Franca instruxit ut conventui praesentis turmae Academiae in Trier ut “Muggle” pro eo accederet.

unit.source: After folding the letter and enclosing the Lie earrings and Ice Amulet, Lumian activated the latter, pressing the package into the glass mirror, sending it to Franca’s apartment mirror.
unit.target: Postquam epistulam plicavit et “Lie Earrings” atque Amuletum Glaciale inclusit, Lumian illud activavit, sarcinam in speculum vitreum prementem, eam ad speculum habitationis Francae mittens.

unit.source: Franca received the items, read Lumian’s letter carefully, and murmured to herself, both expectant and anxious.
unit.target: Franca res accepit, epistulam Lumiani diligenter legit, et sibi ipsi murmurat, tam exspectans quam anxia.

unit.source: Do I really have to pretend to be Muggle?
unit.target: Num vere simulare debeo me esse “Muggle”?

unit.source: Sigh, the Ice Amulet can only transmit information nine more times…
unit.target: Suspirat, Amuletum Glaciale informationem solum novem amplius transmittere potest…

unit.source: Meanwhile, Lumian returned to his desk and resumed reading “Examples of Underground Mausoleum Construction.”
unit.target: Interim, Lumian ad scrinium suum rediit et lecturam “Exempla Constructionis Mausolei Subterranei” continuavit.

unit.source: He was reluctant to rest; the more he read, the more compelling the books became.
unit.target: Non volebat quiescere; quo magis legebat, eo magis libri eum alliciebant.

unit.source: Of course, Lumian knew this was a sign of slight corruption.
unit.target: Certe, Lumian sciebat hoc esse signum parvae corruptionis.

unit.source: Just then, he heard a loud explosion.
unit.target: Subito audivit fragorem ingentem.

unit.source: It came from a few blocks away!
unit.target: Venit ex paucis regionibus remotus!

unit.source: Explosion?
unit.target: Explosio?

unit.source: Lumian used his Ascetic endurance to break free from the compulsion, extinguished the fireball, and moved to the window to observe outside.
unit.target: Lumian asceticam tolerantiam suam adhibuit, compulsionem superans, globum ignis exstinxit et ad fenestram processit ut foris observarit.

unit.source: The explosions continued, with brilliant flames illuminating the streets hundreds of meters away.
unit.target: Explosiones perseverabant, cum fulgentes flammas vias centum metrorum distante illuminantes.

unit.source: It was on the route from the Carnivore bar to the Church of Knowledge.
unit.target: In via ab taberna Carnivorum ad Ecclesiam Scientiae erat.

unit.source: Lumian saw Julie jump out of her room, landing lightly like a feather, then blending into the shadows, disappearing.
unit.target: Lumian Iuliam ex conclavi suo exsiliantem vidit, sicut plumam leve cadentem, deinde in umbras se miscere et evanescentem.

unit.source: Hunters causing explosions and fires?
unit.target: Venatores, qui explosionem et ignes efficere?

unit.source: Lumian rubbed his temples, looking reluctant.
unit.target: Lumian tempora sua fregit, haesitans spectans.

unit.source: He grumbled to himself, I really don’t want to get involved in your schemes and fights; I just want to study peacefully.
unit.target: Murmuravit ad se, “Vere nolo implicari in consiliis vestris et pugnis; solum quiete studere volo.”

unit.source: Since discovering the important knowledge in the books specified by Heraberg, he had become increasingly focused, spending all his time reading except when “acting” outside.
unit.target: Ex quo notitiam magni momenti in libris a Heraberg nominatis invenit, factus est magis concentratus, totum tempus legens, nisi cum extra “agendo”.

unit.source: If not for the risk of exposing the books’ importance, he would have used his special abilities to study all night.
unit.target: Nisi periculum patefaciendi momentum librorum esset, totam noctem facultatibus specialibus ut studeret.

unit.source: The more seriously he studied, the less he wanted to do anything else, often relying on sheer willpower and even his Ascetic abilities to break free from that mental state.
unit.target: Quo magis serio studeret, eo minus aliud agere vellet, plerumque solida voluntate atque etiam facultatibus asceticis innitens ut ex illo statu mentis evaderet.

unit.source: After a moment, Lumian’s expression calmed, and he muttered to himself, When I find the opportunity to eliminate you all, I can finally study in peace…
unit.target: Post paulum, vultus Lumiani quietus factus est, et ipse sibi susurravit: “Cum occasionem inveniam vos omnes tollendi, tandem in pace studere potero…”

unit.source: Suppressing his abnormal emotions, Lumian transformed into a shadow creature, slipping into the darkness between buildings and heading toward the explosion site.
unit.target: Suppressis perturbationibus abnormalibus, Lumian in creaturam umbratam se transformavit, inter aedificia in tenebris se infundens atque ad locum explosionis profectus est.

unit.source: Soon, he reached the destination and saw a half-collapsed building- Dades Agricultural Company.
unit.target: Mox ad destinatum pervenit et aedificium semiruptum vidit: Societatem Agriculturam Dades.

unit.source: Wanak’s Dades Agricultural Company? Someone attacked Wanak?
unit.target: Societas Agriculturalis Dades Wanak? Aliquis Wanak oppugnavit?

unit.source: Lumian snapped out of his study-induced haze, his mind suddenly alert.
unit.target: Lumian ex nebula studii evigilavit, et mens eius subito acuta facta est.

unit.source: He saw two giant figures emerge from the building.
unit.target: Vidit duas figuras gigantes de aedificio apparere.

unit.source: They were three to four meters tall, with iron-like skin and blue paint depicting clothing, each holding a giant broadsword.
unit.target: Eorum altitudo inter tres et quattuor metra erat, cum cute quasi ferrea et pictura caerulea vestimentorum repraesentante, singuli gladium ingentem tenentes.

unit.source: Iron soldiers? Giant iron soldiers?
unit.target: Milites ferrei? Milites ferrei ingentes?

unit.source: Lumian immediately recalled the iron soldiers he had seen deep in the Sauron family’s Red Swan Castle crypt.
unit.target: Lumian statim recordatus est militum ferreorum quos in profunda crypta Castelli Cygni Rubri familiae Sauron viderat.

unit.source: The next moment, one of the iron soldiers smashed through the collapsed wall and fixed its cold gaze on the shadow Lumian was hiding in.
unit.target: Proximo momento, unus ex militibus ferreis per murum ruentem perrumpens, frigido aspectu in umbram, in qua Lumian latebat, stetit.

unit.source: It charged at Lumian, raising its giant broadsword.
unit.target: In Lumian impetum fecit, gladium ingentem levans.

unit.source: Why is it so good?
unit.target: Cur tam bonum est?

unit.source: Will it be so good all the time?
unit.target: Num semper tam bonum erit?

unit.source: A note from kecskepasztor
unit.target: Notula a kecskepasztor

unit.source: Hello everybody!
unit.target: Salvete omnes!

unit.source: This is a Thursday release!
unit.target: Haec emissio die Iovis est!

unit.source: Spoiler Ah the cliché bandits, in serious need of acting classes!
unit.target: Heu, latrones stereotypos, qui ad lectiones scaenicas egent!

unit.source: If you see any grammar (or another kind) mistake, please don't hesitate to point it out in the comments!
unit.target: Si aliqua errata grammaticae (vel alicuius generis) conspicias, quaeso, ne dubita ea in commentariis indicare!

unit.source: Schedule will be Monday/Thursday at minimum, but if I write more then I will post more!
unit.target: Schedula saltem Lunae et Iovis erit, sed si plura scribam, plura publicabo!

unit.source: Have fun, and have a nice day!
unit.target: Divertimini, et habeatis diem iucundum!

unit.source: Having Lucky’s race turn from Forest Wolf to Mana Wolf was a small boon.
unit.target: Conversio generis Lucky ab Lupo Silvestri ad Lupum Mana modicum auxilium erat.

unit.source: It would increase the level limit a little.
unit.target: Hoc modicum finem gradus parum auget.

unit.source: Not much, as the maximum level of a Forest Wolf was 15, at which point Lucky would have turned into an Alpha Forest Wolf, instead his level cap would increase.
unit.target: Non nimis, nam gradus maximus Lupi Silvestri erat quindecim, quo facto Lucky in Luper Alpha Silvestris verti debuisset; proinde eius gradus capitus augere debebat.

unit.source: Though Sam didn’t exactly know by how much.
unit.target: Attamen Sam non exacte sciebat quantum.

unit.source: Based on the general knowledge he got, the increase was maybe 5 or at maximum, 10 levels.
unit.target: Ex notitia generalis, quam accepit, incrementum fortasse quinque vel ad summam decem gradus esse aestimabatur.

unit.source: Even that would make Lucky more useful in the short term, and grant him more time to prepare for proper evolution.
unit.target: Etiam id Lucky in brevi tempore utiliorem reddit atque ei plura tempora ad evolutionem rectam praeparandam concedit.

unit.source: Not that he would get rid of Lucky for any reason.
unit.target: Non enim Lucky quocumque causa amitteret.

unit.source: The excitable fluff ball was coming with him, even if the wolf would become useless in fights.
unit.target: Illa globus pilosus excitabilis secum se feret, etiam si lupus in pugnis inutilis fateri videbatur.

unit.source: Fluff was love.
unit.target: Pilositas erat amor.

unit.source: Fluff was life.
unit.target: Pilositas erat vita.

unit.source: Sam watched as the energized Lucky tore through the monsters of the forest with a small smile.
unit.target: Sam spectavit, cum Lucky energizatus per monstra silvae lacessos parvo subridente confregeret.

unit.source: While the wolf’s new capability with mana didn’t mean much, with Deep Connection he would soon learn to use it enough to strengthen his body and maybe execute a few mana-based attacks.
unit.target: Quamquam nova potentia lupi cum manā parum videbatur, cum Coniunctione Profunda mox illa uti discebisset ad corpus suum firmandum et fortasse nonnullos ictus manae exsequi.

unit.source: Sam absentmindedly deflected an attack from a stealthy fox that jumped at him from a nearby bush, his Mana Sense pinpointing the position of his attacker before it even decided to attack him, as he thought about Lucky.
unit.target: Sam, absens mente, impetum a vulpe callida, quae ex fronde proxima in eum saltavit, repulit, dum Sensus Manæ locum aggressoris antequam impetum iungere decrevisset designavit, dum de Lucky cogitabat.

unit.source: Now that he was done with that, he would only need to reach level 15, get a courier mission towards one of the nearest cities, and get out of the tutorial.
unit.target: Iam id confectum habens, solum ei opus erat ut gradus quindecim attingeret, missionem cursoriae ad unum ex urbibus proximis obtineret, atque oppidum praeceptorum relinqueret.

unit.source: While he definitely wasn’t the fastest to leave the tutorial, Sam knew that by dedicating oneself to grinding, one could reach the necessary level and leave the tutorial area within a few real-life days- And with the help of a guild or gaming studio? In mere hours, if they were good.
unit.target: Quamquam certe non celerissimus ad oppidum praeceptorum exire poterat, Sam sciebat quod, studio terens, quis gradum necessarium attingere et regionem praeceptorum intra paucos dies in re vera relinquere posset – et auxilio sodalium vel studii ludici? In paucis horis, si optimi fuerunt.

unit.source: But that was the magic of Magic Unbound.
unit.target: At illud erat miraculum Magic Unbound.

unit.source: It didn’t reward the highest leveled people.
unit.target: Non praemia dabat hominibus summis gradibus.

unit.source: The game designers were thinking long-term.
unit.target: Conditores ludi longae temporis cogitabant.

unit.source: Slow and steady exploration, building a proper foundation, and social connections were more important than the race to the top.
unit.target: Lenta et constans exploratio, bona fundamenta exstruenda, ac nexus sociales magni momenti erant quam cursor ad apicem.

unit.source: And that would cripple a lot of currently high leveled players.
unit.target: Et id multos lusores iam alti gradus habentes claudebit.

unit.source: According to his memories, not an insignificant number of them would simply restart when they realized that they essentially gimped their characters.
unit.target: Secundum memorias eius, non pauci inter eos iterum inciperent, cum intellexerunt se in sua figura re vera debilitatos esse.

unit.source: Not that they couldn’t have corrected their build and learned the required skills to be useful, but the time investment required was more than anybody was willing to invest.
unit.target: Non quod structuram corrigere neque artes necessarias ad esse utiles discere non potuissent, sed tempus impensus superabat omnem voluntatem.

unit.source: But Sam wasn’t worried about anything like that.
unit.target: Sed Sam de talibus nihil curabat.

unit.source: He gathered the skills he needed, and some he didn’t even know he could get, so he was happy.
unit.target: Artes quas opus habebat collegit, et aliquas quas ne sciebat habere quidem possent, ita laetus erat.

unit.source: And the moment Lucky took down the latest oversized hog, a notification rang out, and a window appeared in front of him.
unit.target: Et momento quo Lucky recentissimum porcum nimis magnum deiecit, nuntius sonuit, et fenestra coram eo apparuit.

unit.source: [You are now level 15!]
unit.target: [Iam gradus 15 es!]

unit.source: [Thanks to your daring handling of mana, you gained +1 WIS!]
unit.target: [Gratia audaci manipulatione manae, +1 Sapientia adeptus es!]

unit.source: [You gained 2 Unassigned status points!]
unit.target: [2 puncta status non assignata adeptus es!]

unit.source: He read the window, then simply closed it.
unit.target: Fenestrae epistolas legit, deinde eam simpliciter claudidit.

unit.source: The game didn’t tell him that he reached the level where he could leave the tutorial town.
unit.target: Ludus non narravit ei se ad gradum pervenisse quo oppidum praeceptorum relinquere posset.

unit.source: It would be handled in-game.
unit.target: Id in ludo agitaretur.

unit.source: Maybe a trainer would realize that he was strong enough to leave, or an important figure would find him to deliver something far away.
unit.target: Fortasse aliquis instructor intellexerit eum satis validum esse ut exiveret, aut figura momenti eum inveniret ad aliquid procul tradendum.

unit.source: But no matter what, the moment he returned to the town, his time was limited.
unit.target: Sed quidquid eveniret, momento quo ad oppidum rediret, tempus eius limitatum esset.

unit.source: Even if he stayed out of the town, sooner or later, the system would have had enough and would engineer some kind of event that would chase him out of the tutorial area.
unit.target: Etiam si extra oppidum mansis, celeriter aut sero, ratio sufficere potuerit et aliquod eventum concinnasset quod eum ex regione praeceptorum expelleret.

unit.source: Sam returned to Greenwood without any fanfare.
unit.target: Sam ad Greenwood rediit sine aliqua pompa.

unit.source: Granted, the area outside of the town was almost teeming with new players, while the wildlife was desperately trying to survive.
unit.target: Admitte, regio extra oppidum fere nova lusoribus referta erat, dum fauna saltem conata est superesse.

unit.source: Thankfully, the rabbits present were a hardy species and would bounce back once the locusts left.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, cuniculi ibi presentes arcta specie erant et reviviscent, cum locustae discesserint.

unit.source: He greeted the gate guard, who was actually doing their job, and not napping.
unit.target: Portam custodem salutavit, qui re vera officium suum exercebat et non dormiebat.

unit.source: Then he headed for the butcher, where he deposited his loot for processing.
unit.target: Deinde ad macellarium accessit, ubi praeda sua ad processum deposuit.

unit.source: After thanking the butcher for his help, and receiving a simple grunt, he went to the Merchant Association and sold the hides, and while he was tempted to get rid of some useless loot from the bandit hideout; he knew that would be social suicide in this town.
unit.target: Macellario gratias egeret et ex grummi simili auditum accepit, deinde ad Societatem Mercatoriam ivit et pellibus vendidit, et, quamquam temptatus est non utilem praedam ex latibulo latronum abicere, scivit hoc in hoc oppido suicidium sociale fore.

unit.source: Plus, he had collected enough gold from the criminals that he had no need for more in the short term.
unit.target: Praeterea, satis aurum a sceleratis collegerat, ut amplius non opus esset in brevi termino.

unit.source: Then he returned to the library to study a little more while the butcher worked.
unit.target: Deinde ad bibliothecam rediit ut paulo amplius studeret, dum macellarius laborabat.

unit.source: He still needed to say goodbye to Sarah at the Green Stump Inn, and Sam wanted to do it with a proper gift.
unit.target: Eamque se valedixisse ad Sarah apud Hospitium Radicis Viridis oportebat, et Sam id cum dono apto facere volebat.

unit.source: A few hours later, he was standing in front of the inn, bag heavy with prime cuts.
unit.target: Nonnullis horis post, ante hospitium stabat, sacculo grave cum optimis frustis.

unit.source: The moment the door opened, she looked up, and when she spotted him, Sarah smiled.
unit.target: Mox ianua aperta est, illa surrexit, et cum eum deprehenderet, Sarah subridet.

unit.source: “Sam!” she called out, placing the book down and standing up. “Welcome back!”
unit.target: “Sam!” inquit, librum deponens et surrecta, “Gratum te revidere!”

unit.source: The people closest to the door looked up, but when they saw him and Lucky, they simply went back to their discussions or meals. He was, after all, a regular and nothing interesting…
unit.target: Homines prope ianuam surrexerunt, sed cum eum et Lucky vidissent, redierunt ad colloquia aut cibaria sua. Erat, post omnia, solitus et nihil insigne…

unit.source: He returned the smile and stepped up to the counter.
unit.target: Ille risum reddidit et ad tabernam accessit.

unit.source: “Hello, Sarah!”
unit.target: “Salve, Sarah!”

unit.source: “What can I do for you, honey?” asked the woman, giving him a once over, while also glancing at the visibly grown Lucky, who just gave her a wolfish grin.
unit.target: “Quid faciam tibi, cara?” inquit illa, eum celeriter pervidens, dum etiam Lucky, palam crevitum, ei vulturiconem risum dabat.

unit.source: “I… came by to say goodbye,” he said haltingly. “Leaving town soon.” Then he took off the bag he was carrying on his shoulder and held it out for her. “Also, here, a little gift.”
unit.target: “Veni ut vale dicam,” inquit hesitanter, “mox oppidum relinquam.” Tum sacculum, quem in umero portabat, detraxit et ei protulit. “Praeterea, ecce, parvus donum.”

unit.source: “Thank you, honey.” Then she put down the bag behind the counter and reached down with one hand. When Sam could see the hand again, it was holding a letter.
unit.target: “Gratias tibi, cara.” Tum sacculum post tabernam deponit et manu una se inclinavit. Cum Sam manum iterum videre potuit, ea epistulam tenebat.

unit.source: “Here, I prepared something for you.”
unit.target: “Hic, tibi aliquid praeparavi.”

unit.source: “You knew?”
unit.target: “Sciebas?”

unit.source: Sarah just snorted.
unit.target: Sarah sufflavit.

unit.source: “Young man! I’ve been here for a long time. I know about the call of adventure.”
unit.target: “Iuvenis! Hic diu maneo. Scio de voco adventus.”

unit.source: Sam took in Sarah’s impish smile and took the letter with a quiet thanks.
unit.target: Sam subrisum impium Sarah intulit et epistulam tacite accepit.

unit.source: “It’s an introduction to a friend in the city of Ironwood,” she continued. “She also owns an inn, though it’s more for long-term lodging than temporary, like mine. If you give her the letter – you can find the address on it – she will give you a discount, and maybe some more…” she finished with a suggestive wink.
unit.target: “Est introductio ad amicum in urbe Ferri ligno,” illa continuavit. “Ea etiam hospitium possidet, quamquam magis ad diuturnam habitationem quam ad temporariam, sicut meum. Si ei epistulam dederis – inscriptionem in ea invenies – discountum tibi dabit, et forsitan amplius…” finivit illa cum oculo suggestivo micante.

unit.source: Sam just stared at her for a moment before pocketing the letter.
unit.target: Sam per momentum eam contemplatus, deinde epistulam in sinum recondidit.

unit.source: “Thank you for your help, Sarah. I appreciate it.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi pro auxilio, Sarah. Hoc aestimo.”

unit.source: “Don’t mention it, honey! Just go and make me proud out there!” she exclaimed, looking pumped as if she was the one going on an adventure.
unit.target: “Noli de hoc dicere, cara! Ege et me laude imple!” inquit illa, viso quasi ipsa in adventum profectura.

unit.source: Sam nodded with a smile.
unit.target: Sam annuens cum risu dixit: “Faciam. Gratias tibi!”

unit.source: And with that, he turned around and headed for the door. Lucky looked after his master, then at Sarah, and quickly darted behind the counter to rub against the owner of the inn, then ran after Sam, leaving a chuckling woman behind.
unit.target: Et eo facto, conversus ad ianuam contendit. Lucky dominum suum spectavit, deinde ad Sarah, et celeriter post tabernam confugit ut contra dominum hospitii se flecteret, deinde post Sam cucurrit, relinquens mulierem subridentem.

unit.source: “Hey, you! Stop!”
unit.target: “Heus, tu! Cesse!”

unit.source: He turned and saw two people in black clothing running at him. He blinked in surprise and was about to give Lucky the order to run, as he had a bad feeling, when an arrow whizzed past his face, coming from behind.
unit.target: Conversus vidit duo homines veste nigra in eum currentes. Obmutescente miratusque fere paratum esse ut Lucky imperium daret currere, cum mala foedera sensit, cum sagitta per faciem eius volitavit, e tergo veniens.

unit.source: For a moment, he froze, but then Sam moved.
unit.target: Momento sistit, sed deinde Sam se movit.

unit.source: Surreptitiously taking a stance that would leave him stable and ready to respond to more attacks, he slightly turned his head and glanced behind him, seeing two people approaching, one of them holding a bow, both of them grinning.
unit.target: Fallaciter statu sumens quod eum firmum et paratum ad ulteriora impetum respondendum relinqueret, modice caput vertit et surrexit ad posterius, duos homines appropinquantes videns; unus eorum arcum tenebat, amboque risu contrectantes.

unit.source: The two bandits arrived in front of him, breathing heavily yet grinning as they raised their weapons. One was holding an ax, caked with a mysterious substance, while the other held a sword. The one behind him, not holding a bow, was playing with a dagger.
unit.target: Hi duo currentes coram eum pervenerunt, et, paulo graviter spirantes, tamen risu manentes arma sua elevaverunt. Unus eorum securim tenebat, quod aliquo mysterioso materia opertum erat (quamquam Sam de origine eius suspicabatur), et alter gladium tenebat. Is qui post eum stabat, arcum non tenens, cum pugione luserat.

unit.source: Altogether, a pretty stereotypical bandit party made up of players.
unit.target: Omnino, coetus latronum stereotipicus satis erat. Ex lusoribus compositus.

unit.source: To someone new, they would be indistinguishable from NPCs, but to Sam, thanks to his inherited memories, they were quite obvious. Random fragments of their armor and their behavior were very telling, and most importantly, they didn’t know that the kingdom’s knights regularly patrolled this road and were harsh on any bandits.
unit.target: Aliquis novi eos a NPC distinguere non posset, sed Sam, gratias memoriam hereditariam, eos perspicue intellexit. Fragmenta armorum aleatoria et eorum mores satis indicabant. Et, maxime, nesciebant equites regni hanc viam regulariter inspexisse, et contra quascumque latrones repugnare satis aspera.

unit.source: No sane NPC bandit would set up shop here. And if an insane NPC had settled here, Sam would have been killed, teleported to some random location or plane, or perhaps trapped in a nightmarish illusion.
unit.target: Nullus latro NPC rationabilis hic forum condere posset. Et si quidam NPC insanus hic consederet, Sam iam interfectus aut ad locum fortuitum aut planum teletransportatus fuisset, aut fortasse in aliquo phantasmate nocturno captus.

unit.source: While his mind was racing, the bandits began speaking.
unit.target: Dum mens eius celeriter curreret, latrones verba incipiebant.

unit.source: The one holding the ax smiled at him.
unit.target: Is qui securim tenebat ei subridit.

unit.source: “Hello, friend. It seems you arrived at a place where you have to pay the new toll!”
unit.target: “Salve, amice. Videtur te pervenisse ad locum ubi novum vectigal solvere debes!”

unit.source: Sam decided to play along while he stealthily began activating his skills.
unit.target: Sam, adhuc, decrevit se ludere, dum clam incipiebat artes suas activare.

unit.source: “A toll? Nobody said anything about a toll!”
unit.target: “Vectigal? Nemo quid de vectigali dixerat!”

unit.source: The man continued to grin, while the other, believing himself stealthy, began to fan out around him.
unit.target: Ille vir tantum risu continuavit, dum alter, se callide putans, circa eum dispergebat.

unit.source: “It’s a rather new thing, my friend,” he explained, subtly raising his ax.
unit.target: “Res nova satis est, amice,” explicavit, subtiliter securim levans.

unit.source: Sam gave him a wry smile.
unit.target: Sam ei risum sardonicum reddidit.

unit.source: “I see. And may I ask what this toll would cost me?”
unit.target: “Intellego. Et licetne rogar quid hoc vectigal mihi constaret?”

unit.source: The grin on the bandits’ faces grew even bigger.
unit.target: Risus in faciebus latronum et eorum amicorum ancora amplius crevit.

unit.source: “Why everything!”
unit.target: “Quaeque res!” inquit praevidens.

unit.source: Sam sighed.
unit.target: Sam tantum suspiravit.

unit.source: “You guys are pretty bad at this bandit stuff…”
unit.target: “Vos valde male in his latronum artibus laboratis…”

unit.source: The grins vanished, and the man with the ax scowled at him.
unit.target: Risus in faciebus eorum evanuit, et vir securi ei vultum truculenter ferebat.

unit.source: “Shut up! There are four of us, and one of you. And I know that those wolves only go up to level 15. Do as I say, and you won’t die. Don’t and enjoy the timeout…”
unit.target: “Tace! Quattuor sumus et unus tu. Et scio illos lobos solum usque ad gradum 15 pervenire. Fac ut dico, et non morieris. Noli, et fruere paupertate temporaria…” inquit, paene minatione versa.

unit.source: But to Sam, it just seemed so stupid.
unit.target: Sed Sam illud tam stupidum videbatur.

unit.source: Sam sighed again and blatantly looked at each of them, noting their position, then spoke up.
unit.target: Sam iterum suspiravit et aperte singulos aspexit, ordinem eorum notans, deinde locutus est.

unit.source: “Next time, take some acting classes because this was pretty cringe!”
unit.target: “Proxima vice, classes scaenicas capite, quia hoc vere turpe fuit!”

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: “Quid?”

unit.source: Instead of answering the confused bandits, he moved.
unit.target: Pro responsione latronum incertorum, movebat.

unit.source: Sam raised a hand and blasted the bandit holding the bow with a simple Mana pulse, throwing him back, then called out to Lucky.
unit.target: Sam manum attulit et latronum qui arcum tenebat cum simplice impulso manae percussit, eum retrorsum iactans, deinde Lucky vocavit.

unit.source: “Lucky, kill!”
unit.target: “Lucky, occide!”

unit.source: He unsheathed his sword, coated it in mana, and parried a strike from the only bandit who reacted to his attack.
unit.target: Simul gladium extraxit, manā percussit, et ictum ab unico latrone qui ad acitionem eius respondit paravit.

unit.source: The other two just stared at him with slack jaws, probably in disbelief at his audacity.
unit.target: Reliqui duo eum cavatis mandibulis aspiciebant. Fortasse propter audaciam eius, non celeriter desistendi. Insoliti…

unit.source: Their ally on the ground screamed as Lucky’s jaw struck the man’s throat, and Sam had to parry several more strikes from the man with a sword while the other two finally recovered and raised their weapons.
unit.target: Amicus eorum in terra exclamavit, cum mandibula Lucky in gutture viri incidit. Et Sam plura ictus ab illo, qui gladium tenebat, parare debuit, dum reliqui duo tandem stupefactos expellerunt et arma sua elevaverunt.

unit.source: Sam grinned at them and gripped his sword tighter, while his other hand glowed with magic.
unit.target: Sam eis subridens gladium firmius tenebat, dum altera manus eius magica lucebat.

unit.source: ‘This is going to be awesome!”
unit.target: ‘Hoc mirabile futurum est!’

unit.target: [Mana Well: Gradus 1/5 (1%) – Profundum et abstractum aliquid percepisti. Mana sicut argilla in manu tua est. Corpus tuum fons manae est. Quantitatem manae a puncto statu magico tribuenda auget. Incrementum currente: Basim quadruplitat.]

unit.source: [Calm Heart: Level 3/50 (4%) You are the epitome of keeping calm and carrying on. You will have an easier time staying calm and focused. Increases resistance against mind-altering effects.]
unit.target: [Calm Heart: Gradus 3/50 (4%) – Tu es exemplum tranquillitatis et constantiae. Facilius mansurus eris tranquillus et concentratus. Resistentia adversus effectus mentis mutantes augetur.]

unit.source: [Light Ball: Level 4/10 (5%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to conjure a ball of light to illuminate your surroundings.]
unit.target: [Light Ball: Gradus 4/10 (5%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit globum lucis evocare ad circumstantia illuminanda.]

unit.source: [Firespark: Level 2/10 (14%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to conjure a spark of fire to start fires.]
unit.target: [Firespark: Gradus 2/10 (14%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit scintillam ignis evocare ad focos accendendos.]

unit.source: [Condense Water: Level 3/10 (27%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to condense water from the surrounding air.]
unit.target: [Condense Water: Gradus 3/10 (27%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit aquam ex aere circumstanti condensare.]

unit.source: [Clean: Level 6/10 (87%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to clean a selected surface.]
unit.target: [Clean: Gradus 6/10 (87%) (Active) – Incantatio simplex quae tibi concedit superficiem electam purgare.]

unit.source: [Mage Sight: Level 1/10 (69%) (Active) A spell that allows you to visually observe the currents of magic.]
unit.target: [Mage Sight: Gradus 1/10 (69%) (Active) – Incantatio quae tibi permittit fluxus magiae videre.]

unit.source: [Mana Strike: Level 2/10 (11%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your strikes be it unarmed or with weapon.]
unit.target: [Mana Strike: Gradus 2/10 (11%) (Active) – Permittit tibi damnum ictuum tuorum, sive sine armis sive cum armis, augere.]

unit.source: [Mana Slash: Level 6/10 (17%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your slashes with any weapon capable of slashing.]
unit.target: [Mana Slash: Gradus 6/10 (17%) (Active) – Permittit tibi damnum ictuum tuorum in caedibus cum quolibet armamento augere.]

unit.source: [Mana Body Enhancement: Level 11/100 (69%) (Active) During usage enhances the physical attributes by 6% (STR, AGI, DEX, END).]
unit.target: [Mana Body Enhancement: Gradus 11/100 (69%) (Active) – Usus huius incantationis omnes attributos físicos (STR, AGI, DEX, END) per 6% auget.]

unit.source: [Dwarven Language: Level 3/10 (21%) (Passive) You managed to learn the basics of the Dwarven language.]
unit.target: [Dwarven Language: Gradus 3/10 (21%) (Passive) – Fundamenta linguae Nanorum didicisti.]

unit.source: [Elven Language: Level 1/10 (8%) (Passive) You managed to learn the basics of the Elven language.]
unit.target: [Elven Language: Gradus 1/10 (8%) (Passive) – Fundamenta linguae Elfonum adeptus es.]

unit.source: A note from kecskepasztor
unit.target: Nota a kecskepasztor

unit.source: Hello everybody!
unit.target: Salvete omnes!

unit.source: This is a Monday release!
unit.target: Hoc est emissio diei Lunae!

unit.source: If you see any grammar (or another kind) mistake, please don't hesitate to point it out in the comments!
unit.target: Si quid erroris grammaticae (vel cuiusdam alii generis) videris, quaeso, noli dubitare id in commentariis indicare!

unit.source: Schedule will be Monday/Thursday at minimum, but if I write more then I will post more!
unit.target: Programma saltem erit die Lunae et die Iovis, sed si plura scribam, plura divulgabo!

unit.source: Have fun, and have a nice day!
unit.target: Gaude, et diem iucundum habeas!

unit.source: The two bandits, faces no longer filled with grins but with intense concentration, stood there glaring at him.
unit.target: Duo latrones, quorum vultus iam non risu sed acerrima cogitatione impleti erant, steterunt eum intuentes.

unit.source: Probably surprised that their victim decided to fight back.
unit.target: Fortasse mirati sunt quod victima eorum ad repugnandum constiterat.

unit.source: Not that Sam cared.
unit.target: Non tamen Sam curabat.

unit.source: Compared to the shadow spirit that had possessed the corpse of the bandit leader, they were pitifully slow.
unit.target: Comparati cum spiritu umbratili, qui cadaver ducis latronum possidebat, paeniter lente agebant.

unit.source: “No doubt their main stat is either strength or vitality, maybe endurance…” he thought, as he danced out of the way of the bandit with the daggers, warned by his Mana Sense of the impending attack.
unit.target: "Nullum dubium est: praecipua eorum virtus aut vis, vel fortasse patientia..." cogitavit, dum a latrone cultro armato se distulit, mana sensu imminenti impetu admonitus.

unit.source: At the same time, he raised his own hand, holding his sword, and attacked the one with the ax, while using his other hand to simply shoot a small ball of mana at the man with the sword.
unit.target: Simul manum suam levavit, gladium tenens, et oppugnavit eum qui ascia utebatur, dum altera manu parvam pilam manae in hominem gladio tenentem iaciit.

unit.source: Lucky, in the background, was finishing off the archer.
unit.target: Lucky, in latere, sagittarium occidebat.

unit.source: At this point in the game, mages were rather rare.
unit.target: Ad hoc in ludo, magi satis rari erant.

unit.source: While unlocking mana was an easy and simple affair, making proper use of it was a different thing altogether.
unit.target: Dum mana revelatio facile et simplicis erat, eius rectus usus omnino diversus erat.

unit.source: Plus, learning spells cost money.
unit.target: Praeterea, incantationes discere pecuniam requirebat.

unit.source: And the stronger (or rarer) the spell was, the more it cost.
unit.target: Et quanto potentior (vel rarior) incantatio, tanto magis pecuniam summabat.

unit.source: And at the beginning of the game, not everybody had the money to spend on spells that they can’t fully make use of.
unit.target: Et ad initium ludi, non omnes pecuniam habebant incantationibus impendenda, quarum completa utilitas capi non poterat.

unit.source: Granted, there were already a few gold farming guilds, as with every game, but while it was not known to the populace at large, Sam knew that the game’s system, the very same one, that would chase people out of the tutorial towns was doing its usual machinations to hinder the gold farmers and sellers.
unit.target: Certum est, iam pauca collegia auro colligendi erant, ut in quolibet ludo, sed cum populo latissime ignota erant, Sam sciebat systema ludi, ipsum quod homines ex urbibus initiationis expellebat, consueta machinamenta sua ad agricolas et venditores auri impediendos exercere.

unit.source: The developers didn’t officially ban gold farming, but they sure as hell made sure the gold farmers would suffer.
unit.target: Developatores officialiter auri colligendi negationem non fecerunt, sed tamen firmiter curaverunt ut agricolae auri cruciantur.

unit.source: The moment the mana ball hit the criminal, he cried out in pain and confusion.
unit.target: Instante quo pila manae in scelestum percussit, ille cum dolore et confusione clamitavit.

unit.source: “What the hell! He’s a mage!”
unit.target: "Quid diaboli! Magus est!"

unit.source: Sam just smirked and took a step back, his sword up in a guard position, eyeing the three bandits, while they stared at him with one eye and with the other they watched Lucky, who, after finishing with the archer, kept stalking around the group, ready to pounce.
unit.target: Sam subridens et paulum retrocessit, gladium in custodia tenens, et tribus latronibus intuens, dum illi uno oculo eum intuebantur et altero Lucky spectabant, qui, post sagittarium confectum, circa coetum insidiabatur, praeparatus ad insidendum.

unit.source: “I thought he was a ranger!” called out one of them with slight panic.
unit.target: "Putabam eum esse exploratorem!" exclamavit unus eorum cum parva perturbatione.

unit.source: “I don’t care! Just kill him!” exclaimed the one with the daggers, then tensed his body, and with a small roar, launched one of his blades at him.
unit.target: "Non curo! Interfice eum!" exclamavit ille cultro armatus, deinde corpus contraxit, et parvo rugitu unam ex lamina iaculatus est.

unit.source: “Dagger Strike!”
unit.target: "Ictus Cultro!"

unit.source: Sam just focused more mana into his Mana Shield and tanked the hit.
unit.target: Sam ampliorem manam in scutum manae intendeat et ictum sustinuit.

unit.source: At this level, it was rather easy to calculate the damage it would cause, so he was confident he would be able to take it.
unit.target: Ad hoc gradu, satis facile erat computare damnum quod afferret, itaque confidebat se id subire posse.

unit.source: The three bandits watched with sheer disbelief as the dagger hit Sam squarely in the torso, and then with a quiet clink, bounced off and landed on the ground.
unit.target: Tres latrones incredulitate spectabant, dum culter Sam in pectore exacte percuteret, et deinde cum sonitu parvo, recidit et in terram cecidit.

unit.source: For a moment, there was absolute silence.
unit.target: Per momentum silentium absolutum fuit.

unit.source: Even the forest surrounding them seemed to fall silent, the bandits looking between the dagger on the ground and Sam.
unit.target: Etiam silva, quae eos circumdata erat, silentem afferebat, dum latrones inter culter in terra positum et Sam intuentes erant.

unit.source: Sam smirked at them, raised his sword, and then charged.
unit.target: Sam eis subridens gladium levavit, atque deinde impetum tulit.

unit.source: One strike upwards removed the ax-wielding bandit's weapon hand, the strike following that as Sam turned cut the sword-wielding criminal's throat, and Sam finished the movement by impaling the gaping dagger wielder with his sword.
unit.target: Uno ictu sursum removit manum latronis, qui ascia utebatur; ictus alter, dum Sam se convertit et fauces scelesti gladium gerentis secabat; et Sam motum perfecit, gladium suo latronem cultro operandum infigens.

unit.source: Lucky, taking the opportunity, jumped on the back of the bandit with one less hand, and soon the only sound that could be heard was the chirping of the birds and the movement of the trees as the wind shook them.
unit.target: Lucky, occasionem capiens, in tergum latronis, cuius una manus deleta erat, insiluit, et mox solus sonus auditus erat: cantus avium atque arborum motus, dum ventus eas concutiebat.

unit.source: Sam cleaned his sword and took a look around to see if his attackers dropped something, but it didn’t seem so.
unit.target: Sam gladium purgavit et circumspiciens quaesivit an aggressores aliquid deposuissent, sed ita non videbatur.

unit.source: Shrugging, he motioned to Lucky, and continued his journey towards Ironwood, leaving 4 cooling corpses behind.
unit.target: Humeros levans, ad Lucky signum dedit, et iter suum versus Ironwood continuavit, quattuor corpora refrigerantia relinquens.

unit.source: “Boss, we found something awesome!”
unit.target: "Domine, aliquid praeclarum invenimus!"

unit.source: “What is it?”
unit.target: "Quid est?"

unit.source: “A guy with magic swordsman class!”
unit.target: "Vir cum classe gladii magici!"

unit.source: “There’re no classes in the game, you idiot!”
unit.target: "Nullae classes in ludo sunt, stulte!"

unit.source: “I know, but he used a sword and magic at the same time! And he had a wolf pet!”
unit.target: "Scio, sed simul gladium et magiam utebatur! Et lupum comitem habebat!"

unit.source: “And where did you meet the guy?”
unit.target: "Et ubi convenisti eum?"

unit.source: “Er… we were going to ambush him, but it seems he was higher leveled…”
unit.target: "Er... eum insidiari parati eramus, sed videtur eum gradum superiorem habere..."

unit.source: “How much higher?”
unit.target: "Quantum altius?"

unit.source: “Dunno. None of us had the skill to check.”
unit.target: "Nescio. Nemo nostrum peritiam ad hoc comprobandum habebat."

unit.source: “Damn. What’s his name?”
unit.target: "Maledictum. Quod est nomen eius?"

unit.source: By the time Sam left the forest, his inventory had a few more animal carcasses, mostly made of animals that decided that Lucky and Sam looked like a nice snack.
unit.target: Cum Sam silvam relinquit, inventarium eius pauca animalium cadavera continebat, maxime ex animalibus, quae decreverunt Lucky et Sam speciem ciborum delectabilium esse.

unit.source: They violently disagreed.
unit.target: Vehementer dissentiebant.

unit.source: And his messages were blowing up from several people who seemed to be after the secret of the ‘magical swordsman’ class.
unit.target: Et nuntia eius a pluribus hominibus perveniebant, qui arcanum classis "magici gladiatoris" quaerere videbantur.

unit.source: He received everything from offers for in-game gold to real-life money and some in between.
unit.target: Accepit omnia, ab oblationibus pro auro in ludo ad pecuniam in vita reali, atque intermedia.

unit.source: Apparently, the bandits spread his abilities far and wide.
unit.target: Apparet latrones eius facultates latissime divulgasse.

unit.source: Thankfully, he made sure to only use the basics.
unit.target: Fortunate, constituit solum elementa fundamentalia adhibere.

unit.source: Sam also received several invites to guilds that he knew wouldn’t amount to anything, based on the fact that the other Sam never heard of them.
unit.target: Sam etiam plurimas invitationes ad collegia accepit, quarum nihil futurum esse sciebat, ratione quod alter Sam de eis numquam audiverat.

unit.source: And so much spam…
unit.target: Et ita multa nuntia inania.

unit.source: Thankfully, the mail system was rather robust, so he could set up folders and filters for his mail.
unit.target: Fortunate, systema epistolarum satis robustum erat, ita ut paginas et filtros pro litteris suis constituere posset.

unit.source: For now, he didn’t block anybody, as he didn’t want to hurt anybody’s feelings, but neither did he want to answer them.
unit.target: Ad hoc tempus, neminem vetavit, quoniam nollebat affectus laedere, sed etiam eos respondere non voluit.

unit.source: For now, he had better things to do…
unit.target: Ad hoc tempus, meliora habebat agenda…

unit.source: Cresting over the last hill, finally out of the forest, the small group of man and wolf finally beheld the city of Ironwood.
unit.target: Super ultimo colle ascendens, tandem extra silvas, parva cohors hominis et lupi urbem Ironwood conspexit.

unit.source: It was much like the town of Greenwood, medieval but bigger.
unit.target: Erat similis oppido Greenwood, medii temporis, sed amplior.

unit.source: Its houses were mostly made from its namesake, ironwood.
unit.target: Domus eius praecipue ex ligno ferreo, cui nomen erat, factae erant.

unit.source: A famously hardy and durable wood that can be harvested near the city.
unit.target: Lignum celeberrimum propter firmitatem atque durabilitatem, quod prope urbem meti potest.

unit.source: Granted, they were extremely protected and under constant surveillance, as over the years, the city and people of the kingdom almost caused the extinction of the tree.
unit.target: Certe, valde protegebantur et sub constanti vigilantia manebant, quoniam per annos urbs atque populus regni paene arborem extinguere conati sunt.

unit.source: According to the lore, it was only in the last few decades that the newest leadership of the area decided to properly cultivate and protect the trees.
unit.target: Secundum traditionem, tantum in paucis decadiis nuper, novissima ducatio regionis decrevit arbores rite colere et protegere.

unit.source: Accordingly, the most important quests in the area had to do with the ironwood and the tree nursery.
unit.target: Ergo, quaestiones maximi momenti in regione attinebant ad lignum ferreum et ad hortum arborum.

unit.source: At least the public ones…
unit.target: Saltem quae publicae erant…

unit.source: As the road from the forest joined the bigger one leading to another city, and Sam walked forward to it, he could see countless people walking and riding towards and away from the city.
unit.target: Cum via ex silva ad viam maiorem, quae ad aliam urbem ducebat, se coniungere videbatur, et dum Sam in eam procedebat, innumeros homines ambulantes et equitantes ad urbem ac ab ea discedentes videre poterat.

unit.source: Sam joined the throng of people heading towards the city, keeping Lucky close, as the young wolf kept trying to get away from him and smell everything.
unit.target: Sam turbae hominum, quae ad urbem proficiebantur, se adiunxit, Lucky prope retinens, dum iuvenis lupus ab eo fugit et omnia olfacere conabatur.

unit.source: A few guards to bigger carts, either filled with merchandise or important people, gave him and Lucky an odd look here and there, but he was nowhere powerful enough for them to worry about him.
unit.target: Nonnulli custodes et maiora plaustra, sive mercibus sive personis insignibus completa, intermittentem et peculiarem aspicientiam sibi et Lucky dederunt, sed ille nusquam tam potens apparuit ut eos de eo sollicitaret.

unit.source: Sam didn’t mind, he just simply enjoyed the walk, watching people, taking note of the symbols of the merchant carts, looking through his memories to try to figure out what they might be transporting, practicing with his mana and simply enjoying the game.
unit.target: Sam non curae habebat; iter gaudebat, homines observans, symbola plaustrorum mercatorum notans, per meminisse suas quaerens quid forte transportarent, cum manam exercens et ludo simplicitate fruens.

unit.source: Almost an hour later, he was standing at the civilian entrance of the city, being greeted by a very bored guard.
unit.target: Paene una hora post, stabat ad ingressum civium urbis, ubi a custode valde taedio suffuso salutatus est.

unit.source: “ID please!”
unit.target: "ID, quaeso!"

unit.source: “Here you go, good sir!” he replied, handing over his papers.
unit.target: "Ecce, bone domine!" respondit, chartas suas tradens.

unit.source: There was no room to play nice with these guards, Sam knew very well.
unit.target: Nullum spatium erat ad bene se gerere cum his custodibus, quod Sam bene sciebat.

unit.source: In his inherited memories, there was a very special fail video compilation about the Ironwood city guards.
unit.target: In memoris suis hereditariis, compilatio video errorum peculiare de custodibus urbis Ironwood exstitit.

unit.source: The guard took the card, took a look at it, then at Sam, then finally he waved some kind of artifact that reminded Sam of the metal finders at the airport in his previous life, over the card.
unit.target: Custos chartam accepit, eam inspexit, deinde Sam intuens, atque tandem aliquod genus artificii, quod Sam ad repertores metallorum in portu aeris vitae pristinae reminiscens, super chartam agitavit.

unit.source: When the artifact let out a small, almost silent beep, the guard grunted, tossed the card back at Sam, and motioned for him to move on.
unit.target: Cum artifactus parvum, fere silentem sonum edidisset, custos murmure exclamavit, chartam retro Sam iacuit, et signum dedit ut se moveret.

unit.source: “Have a nice day!” he said, with no enthusiasm.
unit.target: "Diem iucundum habeas!" inquit, sine ulla ardore.

unit.source: As Sam stepped through the gate and beheld his first sight of the massive city, he heard the guard call out behind him.
unit.target: Cum Sam per portam ingrediebatur et primum prospectum urbis ingentis conspexit, custodem post se clamantem audivit.

unit.source: “ID please!”
unit.target: "ID, quaeso!"

unit.source: For the first half an hour, he just wandered around, taking in the sights and smells, making sure to familiarize himself with the map he had seen in his memories, then when that was finished and Lucky and Sam finished their snack that was bought at a roadside stall, he cleaned his hand with his small spell, and headed for the nearest government office.
unit.target: Per primam dimidiimam horam, vagatus est, loca et odores percipiens, et curavit ut consuefactus esset charta, quam in memoriis viderat; deinde, cum illa perfecta essent et Lucky ac Sam suum ientaculum emptionem finivissent, manum parva incantatione purgavit, et ad officium gubernii proximo se contulit.

unit.source: After all, if he wanted to go forward with his goals, he needed to register.
unit.target: Postremo, si proposita sua persequi volebat, se registrare oportuit.

unit.source: Ironwood was in the same kingdom as Greenwood, obviously, but being a bigger city there were more levels of bureaucracy than back at the tutorial town.
unit.target: Ironwood eodem regno ac Greenwood erat, plane, sed quia urbs maior erat, plura erant gradus officiorum bureaucraticorum quam in oppido introductionis.

unit.source: Then, when that was finished, he dropped by the local mage tower, which, for a change, was actually a building with a very spiffy tower built on it.
unit.target: Deinde, cum illa completa essent, in turrim magorum regionalem incidit, quae pro novitate vere erat aedificium cum turrim nitidum superstructam.

unit.source: Opening the door, he was met with a crowd of people all standing around talking, or standing in line waiting to get the attention of one of the girls standing and sitting behind the counters.
unit.target: Ianuam aperiens, convenit multitudo hominum stantium et colloquentium, aut in serie exspectantium ut attentionem alicuius puellae, quae post mensas stabat et sedebat.

unit.source: “Welcome, sonny! I’m Rick and this is mah Racket!” he exclaimed with a cackle as if laughing at his own joke.
unit.target: "Salve, puerule! Ego sum Rick et haec est mea Racket!" exclamavit, cum risu laeto quasi ioca sua ridens.

unit.source: “Tell me if ya find something interesting, young man!” And with that, he sat down on a stool and turned his attention to something that Sam couldn’t see.
unit.target: "Dic mihi, si quid iucundum reperias, iuvene!" inquit. Tum in subsellium consedit et dominum animam convertere coepit in rem, quam Sam videre non poterat.

unit.source: Instantly, his senses lit up with a multitude of items that radiated mana.
unit.target: Statim, sensus eius illustrati sunt multitudine rerum, quae manam efferebant.

unit.source: But Sam discarded all of them, as he knew that what he was looking for was almost inert.
unit.target: Sed Sam omnia abiecit, sciens quod id, quod quaerebat, paene iners esset.

unit.source: Though, to make a show of it, he started walking around and examining the items that his senses marked.
unit.target: Tamen, ut ostentaret, circum ambulare coepit et res quas sensus designaverant perscrutari.

unit.source: To his shock, and maybe a little surprise (and a lot of disgust), most of these items were sexual aids and not anything that he was currently interested in.
unit.target: Ad stuporem eius, et fortasse parva admiratione (ac multo fastidio), pleraque harum rerum erant auxilia sexualia, nec aliquid quod eum praesenti tempore attraheret.

unit.source: Though, he managed to find a box that seemed to hold something that had a similar signature to one of the skill books he had used recently.
unit.target: Attamen, reperit cistam, quae videbatur aliquid continentem, cuius signatura similis erat ad unam ex libris artium, quas nuper adhibuerat.

unit.source: He examined the box in his hands, noting that it was very well made, but there were no seams on it.
unit.target: Cistam in manibus suis examinavit, animadvertens eam optime confectam esse, sed nullas habere suturas.

unit.source: Finally, he held it up and called out to the owner.
unit.target: Tandem eam sustulit et dominum vocavit.

unit.source: “Yo, old man. Know what this is?”
unit.target: "Heus, senex. Scis quid hoc sit?"

unit.source: The old man looked up, squinted a little, then shrugged.
unit.target: Senex surrexit, paulum oculos contraxit, deinde humeros levavit.

unit.source: “Haven’t the foggiest, sonny. I told ya, this is a racket. You buy what you buy. Nothin’ more, nothin’ less.”
unit.target: "Nescio, puerule. Dixi tibi, hoc est racket. Emis quod emis; nihil amplius, nihil minius."

unit.source: Sam snorted, but he didn’t put the box back. He might as well try his luck with it.
unit.target: Sam sufflavit, sed cistam non repressit; fortasse cum ea fortunam tentare voluit.

unit.source: Then after a few minutes of browsing, and a brief argument with Lucky, who wanted to really gnaw on something unsanitary, he finally found it.
unit.target: Post pauca minuta cursu per taberna et brevem contentionem cum Lucky, qui re vera aliquid insalubre masticare vellet, tandem id invenit.

unit.source: A generic off-white mask under a pile of fur cloaks.
unit.target: Larva generica fere in albo pallida, sub congero pallium pilosorum.

unit.source: The only thing special about it was a small, stylized chameleon drawing on the bottom of it.
unit.target: Unum solum rem peculiarem de ea erat: parva imago chameleorum stylizata in eius fundo.

unit.source: Sam was careful to hide his smile, then, as if nothing happened, he continued to browse.
unit.target: Sam risum suum celavit, et deinde, quasi nihil acciderit, explorare continuavit.

unit.source: He picked up an old bag of holding that was able to hold a mountain’s worth of materials but sadly had no weight reduction on it.
unit.target: Eripuit sacculum vetus recondendi, qui materiae montis quantitatem portare posset, sed, pro dolor, nullam reductionem ponderis habebat.

unit.source: Probably why it ended up in the shop.
unit.target: Probabiliter ideo in taberna finivit.

unit.source: Then, finally, he stepped up to the counter and placed his haul down.
unit.target: Tandem ad tabulam accessit et praeda sua deponit.

unit.source: “I want these. How much?”
unit.target: "Haec volo. Quanti?"

unit.source: The old man took a look at the items, hemmed and hawed for a minute then, raised three fingers.
unit.target: Senex res inspexit, paulisper moratus, deinde tres digitos elevavit.

unit.source: “Thirty.”
unit.target: "Triginta."

unit.source: It was Sam’s turn to snort.
unit.target: Iam erat tempus Sam sufflare.

unit.source: “Don’t be ridiculous. Ten at max!”
unit.target: "Noli ridiculum esse. Decem, ad summam!"

unit.source: Rick gave him a big smile, his eyes shining with a predatory gleam.
unit.target: Rick ei magnum risum dedit, oculis praedatori splendore fulgentibus.

unit.source: “Twenty-five.”
unit.target: "Viginti quinque."

unit.source: “They are rather scuffed up. Fifteen.”
unit.target: "Illi satis labefacti sunt. Quindecim."

unit.source: “Twenty.”
unit.target: "Viginti."

unit.source: Sam thought about it, then nodded.
unit.target: Sam de eo cogitavit, deinde annuit.

unit.source: “Twenty, it is.”
unit.target: "Viginti, ita est."

unit.source: The smile on the old man’s face grew, and suddenly a hand was thrust into Sam’s face.
unit.target: Risus in facie senis augebatur, et subito manus in faciem Sam immissa est.

unit.source: “Then, mah payment, sonny!”
unit.target: "Tum, solutio mea, puerule!"

unit.source: Sam grumbled a little, but forked out the required silvers and watched as the man carefully counted them, finally nodding.
unit.target: Sam paulum murmuravit, sed argentum requisitum tradidit, et vidit virum ea diligenter numerare, et tandem annuit.

unit.source: “Alright, they’re yours, young man. No complaints and no buyback!”
unit.target: "Recte, tua sunt, iuvenis. Nulla querela nec reparationis voluntas!"

unit.source: “Understood.” Sam swept the items into his inventory and turned around, Lucky dutifully following him. “Thank you, and have a nice day!”
unit.target: "Intellectum." Sam res in inventarium suum congregavit et revertit, Lucky obsequiose secutus. "Gratias, et diem iucundum habeas!"

unit.source: Outside of the shop, he stepped aside, and in the shadows of his cloak and the alley, he took out the mask, placed a finger on the chameleon symbol, and began channeling magic, while watching with anticipation.
unit.target: Extra tabernam, se declinavit, et in umbris pallii sui et in viae angustae, larvam extraxit, digitum super symbolum chameleonis posuit, et magiam canalizare coepit, cum summa anticipatione spectans.

unit.source: Sam didn’t have to wait long, as, after a minute of channeling, the chameleon symbol flashed in a rainbow color, and the mask changed from the dirty off-white color to pure white, shining with an inner light.
unit.target: Sam non diu exspectare debuit, nam post minutum canalizationis, symbolum chameleonis in colore arcus iridis fulsere, et larva, a sordido colore quasi albissimo ad purum album, mutata est, luce interno splendens.

unit.source: [Chameleon Mask: Created by a hidden master, it allows the user to craft a new face for themselves. Can store a maximum of 3 different faces. After activating, the mask can stay active for an hour, unless charged. Creating a new face has an hour delay.]
unit.target: [Larva Chameleon: Ab magistro occulto creata, sinit usorem novam faciem sibi confingere. Maximum tres facies diversas continere potest. Post activationem, larva per unam horam manere potest activum, nisi onerata fuerit. Novam faciem creandi mora est una hora.]

unit.source: It was extremely hard not to break into evil laughter…
unit.target: Valde difficile erat non in risum malignum erumpere...

unit.source: After logging out for a hot minute, and indulging in evil laughter, Sam logged back into the game and headed for the government office dealing with real estate.
unit.target: Postquam brevi intervallo discessit et risu maligno indulgebat, Sam in ludum iterum accessit et ad officium gubernationis, quod rebus immobilibus curabat, processit.

unit.source: He planned to buy a few properties, as all isekai'd people knew, the real power was in real estate.
unit.target: Parare emere nonnullas possessiones cogitabat, nam omnes qui in alio mundo versabantur sciebant veram potentiam in rebus immobilibus esse.

unit.source: Granted, Ironwood wasn’t the capital city, it was at most a mid-tier city in the Kingdom of Emerald Crown (they really like the color green, but the name came mostly from the emerald mine it was founded on), but naturally, Sam knew more than the average person.
unit.target: Licet Ironwood caput urbis non esset, sed tantum urbs mediocris in Regno Corona Smaragdina (quod viridem colere amabant et nomen maius ex fodina smaragdi in qua condita erat orta habebat), sed scilicet, Sam plus quam homo mediocris sciebat.

unit.source: By now, most people playing the game noticed that it lacked one important thing that almost all roleplaying games had.
unit.target: Iam plerique lusores huius ludi animadvertērunt unum elementum maximi momenti, quod fere omnes ludi fabularum habebant, deficere.

unit.source: Dungeons.
unit.target: Carceres.

unit.source: Magic Unbound had no dungeons.
unit.target: Magic Unbound nullos carceres habebat.

unit.source: No instanced content, no creepy caves to delve into, and nothing to farm.
unit.target: Nec ullum contentum assignatum, nec speluncas horrendas explorandas, nec quidquam ad colligendum existimabat.

unit.source: But as the game was extraordinary in its quality, nobody complained yet.
unit.target: Quamquam ludus eximie in qualitate erat, nemo adhuc querelam efferre ausus est.

unit.source: As they expected that a game of this magnitude would probably make them work for it.
unit.target: Sicut speraverunt, ludus huius magnitudinis eos labore implicaret.

unit.source: As Sam walked through the crowded streets of Ironwood, he couldn’t help but grin when thinking about how the developers would implement the dungeon system.
unit.target: Dum Sam per vias densas Ironwoodi ambulabat, non potuit non subridere, cogitans quomodo programmatores systema carcerum instituere conarentur.

unit.source: The first event of Magic Unbound.
unit.target: Primum eventum Magic Unbound.

unit.source: The Fracture.
unit.target: Fractio.

unit.source: And the first thing it would do, after, of course, causing untold chaos everywhere, was making living around the capitals almost impossible.
unit.target: Et primum, postquam scilicet ubique inenarrabilem turbam effecisset, id erat ut vita circa capita paene impossibilis fieret.

unit.source: And not because they were destroyed or anything like that.
unit.target: Et non quia illa deleatae essent aut similia.

unit.source: No, instead the greed of players and NPCs would make living there impossible.
unit.target: Immo, avaritia lusorum et characterum non ludentium vitam ibi paene impossibile reddere faceret.

unit.source: Staying near a mid-tier city like Ironwood, for now, was much more profitable in the long term.
unit.target: Habitare prope urbem mediocris ut Ironwood, pro tempore, in longum terminum multo lucrativius erat.

unit.source: Plus, the quests were much easier to gather the required reputation to purchase a property.
unit.target: Praeterea, inquisitiones multo facilius efficiebantur ad congregandam famam necessariam ad possessionem emendam.

unit.source: Sam looked up at the building he arrived in front of, then nodded to himself, Lucky dutifully following him, while also curiously watching the people around them.
unit.target: Sam aedificium, coram quo advenit, respexit, deinde sibi annuit, Lucky eum fideliter sequens atque homines circa eos curiose observans.

unit.source: Stepping through the gate, he didn’t even take a few steps before somebody called out to him.
unit.target: Per portam ingrediens, ne paucos passi quidem fecit, antea aliquis eum vocavit.

unit.source: “Hey, you with the wolf! Stop right there!”
unit.target: “Heus, tu cum lupo! Siste hic!”

unit.source: Sam stopped and turned towards the speaker, who was one of the guards stomping toward them.
unit.target: Sam sistit et se convertit ad loquentem, qui unus ex custodibus ad eos calcans accessit.

unit.source: “Yes, sir? Is there any problem?” he asked politely.
unit.target: «Ita, domine? Estne quaestio?» inquit comiter.

unit.source: The guard, grumpy and glaring at him, stood in front of him and exclaimed.
unit.target: Custos, acerbe eum intuentis, ante eum stetit et exclamavit.

unit.source: “Indeed. Pets are not permitted in the Area Bureau! You either have to leave your animal out here or can’t enter.”
unit.target: «Revera, animalia domestica in Officio Regionis non permittuntur! Aut animal vestrum hic relinquere debetis, aut intrare non potestis.»

unit.source: Sam stared at the guard for a second, then shrugged and turned to Lucky.
unit.target: Sam custodem paulisper intuebatur, deinde umeros levavit et ad Lucky se convertit.

unit.source: “Lucky, be nice and wait for me here.”
unit.target: «Lucky, sis benignus et hic mihi exspecta.»

unit.source: Lucky instantly plopped down where he was, tongue lolling out, giving Sam a wolfish grin.
unit.target: Lucky statim locum suum occupavit, lingua erosa, Samo risum lupinum praebens.

unit.source: Sam chuckled and returned his attention to the guard with a raised eyebrow.
unit.target: Sam subridens animam suam ad custodem rediit, supercilium levatum in vultu gestans.

unit.source: “Will that suffice?”
unit.target: «Hoc satis est?»

unit.source: The guard, still grumpy but a little surprised, nodded.
unit.target: Custos, adhuc acerbus sed paulo obstupefactus, annuit.

unit.source: “Er, yes. That’ll do.” And with that, he did an about‐face, probably to return to his station.
unit.target: «Er, ita. Id sufficit.» Et ita, se vertit, fortasse ad stationem suam redire.

unit.source: Sam just shrugged, gave Lucky another look, and continued towards the building.
unit.target: Sam indifferenter umeros levavit, Lucky iterum aspexit, et ad aedificium processit.

unit.source: The Area Bureau, was a giant building, at least compared to the buildings back in Greenwood, with at least five stories above ground, and who knows how many underground.
unit.target: Officium Regionis erat ingens aedificium, saltem comparatum ad aedificia in Greenwood, cum quinque tabulatis super terram et plurimis sub terra.

unit.source: It was decorated in the same vein as all buildings in Ironwood. With iron and wood.
unit.target: Decoratum erat eodem stilo ac omnia aedificia Ironwood, ferro et ligno.

unit.source: ‘Very original…’ Sam thought as he beheld the wrought iron columns and wooden inlays everywhere.
unit.target: ‘Valde originaliter…’ cogitavit Sam, dum columnas ferreas et incrustationes ligneas ubique contemplabatur.

unit.source: Still, he had set a task for himself, and no bad interior (and exterior) design would distract him from it.
unit.target: Tamen sibi propositum statuit, nec mala structura interioris (nec exterioris) eum a proposito distraxit.

unit.source: Thankfully, the part of the building he entered wasn’t filled with people rushing around, trying to swim against the relentless tides of bureaucracy, as it was the Property Acquisition wing of the building.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, pars aedificii quam intravit non erat plena hominibus festinantibus contra fluctus inexorabiles bureaucratiae contendentibus, quoniam pars ad possessionum acquisitionem designata erat.

unit.source: More than likely several people tried their luck here, but according to Sam’s memories of watching the internet and game historians analyze the past property trends of the game, most of the players who could afford (or think they could afford) buying lands were heading for the capital.
