unit.target: Verisimiliter plures hic fortunam temptaverunt, sed secundum memorias Sam de interrete et historicos ludorum spectantes, plerique lusores qui terras emere poterant (aut putabant se posse) versus caput tendebant.

unit.source: And, of course, there were the quest requirements.
unit.target: Et, scilicet, requisita inquisitionum erant.

unit.source: He quickly stepped into the thankfully very short line, and barely a minute later, an exceptionally dressed young lady was leading him through the registration.
unit.target: Celeriter in ordinem, qui ad gratias brevissimus erat, ingressus est, et vix post unam minutas, iuvenis femina egregie vestita eum per modum inscriptionis ducebat.

unit.source: “Now that is finished, good sir,” the young woman spoke up with a polite smile after organizing the papers on her side of the counter.
unit.target: «Iam consummatum est, bone domine,» inquit iuvenis femina cum risu comiter, postquam chartas in parte sua mensae disposuit.

unit.source: “There are some issues that I must bring to your attention.”
unit.target: «Sunt quaedam res, quas tibi notitiam afferre debeo.»

unit.source: Sam just smirked at her.
unit.target: Sam eam leviter subridens aspexit.

unit.source: “I don’t have enough reputation to purchase land in the city. Right?”
unit.target: «Non mihi satis famae est ad terram in urbe emendam, nonne?»

unit.source: The woman blinked in surprise, but her training must have been great, as she immediately recovered and gave him another smile.
unit.target: Femina stupens, sed disciplina eius praeclara, statim se redemit et ei iterum risum obtulit.

unit.source: “Very good, sir. I’m glad you’ve done the research before contacting us.”
unit.target: «Optime, domine. Gaudeo quod ante nos consulevistī.»

unit.source: She took a little breath, then ran her eyes over him with Sam feeling as if the woman was looking through him.
unit.target: Parum spiritum cepit, deinde oculos super eum traiecit, ita ut Sam sentiret eam quasi per eum intueri.

unit.source: “So, if you know about that issue, then how may I help you?”
unit.target: «Ita, si illam rem nosti, quomodo tibi auxilium ferre possim?»

unit.source: Sam gave her his best smile.
unit.target: Sam ei suum optimus risus dedit.

unit.source: Though, based on the twinkle in the woman’s eyes, it really wasn’t working.
unit.target: Sed ex scintilla in oculis eius plane non efficiebat.

unit.source: “I was hoping… that you’d be able to point me in the right direction for increasing said reputation.”
unit.target: «Sperabam ut mihi viam rectam indicares ad famam augendam.»

unit.source: The administrator in front of him considered for a minute, and this time, Sam was pretty sure the pause was for the game to make a decision.
unit.target: Administrator coram eo per minutum meditatus est, et hoc tempore Sam certus erat moram esse ad decisionem ludi faciendam.

unit.source: Relationships with NPCs were tricky.
unit.target: Relationes cum personis non lusoribus difficilia erant.

unit.source: Your stats could affect it depending on the NPC, as well as your look, clothing, and such, just like in real life.
unit.target: Status tui afficere poterant id secundum personam, simul atque habitus, vestitus, et similia, sicut in vita reali.

unit.source: But the most important thing, for generic NPCs like this administrator woman, was how you treated them.
unit.target: Sed res maximi momenti, pro characteribus genericis ut haec administratrix, erat quomodo eos tractares.

unit.source: A lot of people tried but not many people could treat them like real people.
unit.target: Multos conati sunt, sed pauci eos tamquam veros homines tractare potuerunt.

unit.source: Understandably, even Sam struggled at the beginning, but thanks to Lucky (and the fluff) and the owner of the Green Stump inn, he could actually see the life in the NPCs.
unit.target: Intelligenter, etiam Sam initio laboravit, sed gratias Lucky et domino cauponae "Green Stump", veram vitam in NPCs videre potuit.

unit.source: Finally, the young woman nodded, and reached under the counter and retrieved a small pamphlet.
unit.target: Denique, iuvenis femina annuit et sub mensa parvum libellum extraxit.

unit.source: Sam carefully took it and gave the woman a thankful smile.
unit.target: Sam id caute sustulit et feminae risum gratiam dedit.

unit.source: Of course, the entire thing was a farce.
unit.target: Certe, totum illud erat simulatio.

unit.source: He knew every way he could increase his reputation, from hunting down bounties of bandits to finding metal deposits or even finding ancient seeds of the trees the city was named after.
unit.target: Sciebat omnes vias ad famam suam augendam, a venatione praemiis latronum ad inveniendas fodinas metallorum aut etiam ad inveniendas seminas antiquas arborum, quibus urbs nominata erat.

unit.source: But as always, there was no shortcut taking with Magic Unbound.
unit.target: Sed ut semper, nullum iter brevius cum Magic Unbound invenire poterat.

unit.source: At least until he could assemble a proper information network.
unit.target: Saltem donec retiacula informationis apta constituere possit.

unit.source: But that was far away… For now, he had to follow the same path as the other players…
unit.target: Sed id longe erat... Interim autem, idem iter ac ceteri lusores sequi debebat.

unit.source: ‘Isekai'd, and even got foreknowledge, and I can barely do anything about it…’ he grumbled to himself as he said goodbye to the woman, and went to find Lucky.
unit.target: “Isekai factus sum, et etiam praenotitiam adeptus, et vix aliquid facere possum…” murmurat, dum feminae vale dicit et ad Lucky se contulit.

unit.source: However, as he stepped out to the courtyard patrolled by grumpy guards, what he saw caused him to stop in surprise.
unit.target: Sed cum in atrium, quod a custodibus iratis vigilandum erat, egressus est, ea quae vidit eum in stupore sisti fecerunt.

unit.source: Out in the courtyard, surrounded by several confused guards, dressed differently than the guards of the Bureau was Lucky, who was currently at the mercy of a young noble lady based on her clothing.
unit.target: In atrio, circumdatus a pluribus confusis custodibus, diversis ab illis in Officio, erat Lucky, qui nunc sub potestate iuvenis nobilis feminae, cuius vestimenta erant, versabatur.

unit.source: “Who is a good boy? Who is?”
unit.target: «Quis est bonus puer? Quis est?»

unit.source: She exclaimed softly as she kept scratching Lucky’s belly, while the wolf rolled around on the ground, his entire body radiating happiness and satisfaction.
unit.target: Ea leniter exclamavit, dum Lucky ventrem eius leniter scabicabat, et lupus in terra revolvens totum corpus laetitia et satisfactione efferebat.

unit.source: Sam looked on, trying to identify the young woman.
unit.target: Sam spectabat, conans iuvenem feminam agnoscerere.

unit.source: She was definitely a teenager, dressed in very high-quality clothing, that screamed nobility and not even the garden variety.
unit.target: Illa certe adulescens erat, vestita vestimentis optimae qualitatis, quae nobilitatem clamabant et non vulgarem.

unit.source: She had long blonde hair, an appropriately aristocratic face, thin lips, cute button nose, and as she worked on sending Lucky into wolf heaven, Sam could see her deep brown eyes.
unit.target: Illa capillos longos flavos habebat, vultum aristocraticum, labra tenuia, nasum parvum ac venustum, et dum Lucky in caelum lupinum mittere conabatur, Sam oculos eius fuscos profundos videbat.

unit.source: Still, nowhere in his memories could he find her.
unit.target: Sed nusquam in memoria eius eam invenire potuit.

unit.source: And Sam was sure that a future beauty like her, in the later stages of the game, would have been memorable enough.
unit.target: Et Sam certus erat quod pulchritudo futura talis, in posteris ludorum gradibus, satis memorabilis futurus esset.

unit.source: ‘Lucky, you are really my lucky charm… the only thing to decide if you are a good luck or a bad luck charm…’ he grumbled, then began walking towards his pet.
unit.target: ‘Lucky, vere es meus amuletum fortunae… sola res quae determinat num sis bonus vel malus talismanus…’ murmurat, deinde ad pet suum ambulare coepit.

unit.source: The moment he started walking, the guards tensed, but he just nodded at them, then called out.
unit.target: Mox ut ambulare coepit, custodes nervosi facti sunt, sed ipse eis annuit, deinde vocavit.

unit.source: “Hey, Lucky! Have you been good?”
unit.target: «Heus, Lucky! Fuisti bonus?»

unit.source: The wolf, hearing his voice, froze for a moment, stopping his happy wriggling, while the young woman also froze.
unit.target: Lupus, vocem eius audiens, paulisper immobilis factus est, et motus eius hilaris cessavit, dum iuvenis femina similiter sistit.

unit.source: Then Lucky twisted his head so he could look up at Sam gave him a wolfish grin, then returned his attention to the still frozen young woman, batting at her hand as a small kitten would.
unit.target: Tum Lucky caput vertit ut Sam intueretur, lupinum risum ei dedit, et deinde attentionem suam ad iuvenem feminam adhuc immobilis redegit, manu eius pulsando sicut parva felis.

unit.source: Sam just snorted.
unit.target: Sam tantum sufflatus est.

unit.source: Truly, a fearsome and murderous creature. The king of the forest…
unit.target: Revera, formidabilis et caedis appetens creatura; rex silvarum…

unit.source: He turned towards the girl and gave a short bow.
unit.target: Se ad puellam convertit et brevem inclinavit.

unit.source: “I apologize, my lady. I hope Lucky wasn’t bothering you?”
unit.target: «Ignosce, domina mea; spero Lucky te non molestavisse.»

unit.source: The girl let out a small breath and, to Lucky’s devastation, stood up, patting her dress a little, then turned her gaze at Sam.
unit.target: Puella parum suspiravit, deinde surrexit, vestem leviter tangens, et oculos ad Sam convertit.

unit.source: “Not at all, good sir. I was just waiting on my father.”
unit.target: «Minime, bone domine; solum patrem meum exspectabam.»

unit.source: She glanced down at the almost silently whining wolf.
unit.target: Ea deorsum aspexit ad lupum, qui paene silentio gemebat.

unit.source: “Lucky you say? A good name.”
unit.target: «Lucky, dicis? Bonum nomen est.»

unit.source: She murmured, then continued. “Lucky was just keeping me company.”
unit.target: Ea murmuravit, deinde dixit: «Lucky mihi solum socius erat.»

unit.source: Sam gave her a smile and nodded.
unit.target: Sam ei risum obtulit et annuit.

unit.source: “He is good at that, my lady. Perhaps I could bring him around later for you to play with? After all, even fearsome wolves like Lucky need to relax…”
unit.target: «Id bene facit, domina mea. Forsitan postea eum tibi ad ludendum adferre possum? Quippe etiam lupi formidabiles ut Lucky requiescere indigent…»

unit.source: The young girl giggled at him, calling the wolf on the ground fearsome, and dipped her head a little.
unit.target: Iuvenis puella subridens eum aspexit, lupum in terra formidolosum appellans, et caput leviter inclinavit.

unit.source: She opened her mouth, probably to answer him, but they were interrupted by a boisterous yell.
unit.target: Ea os aperuit, ut forsitan illi responderet, sed clamor tumultuosus eos interpellavit.

unit.source: “Lucrecia!”
unit.target: «Lucrecia!»

unit.source: Sam watched as a man, taller than him by several heads, and shoulders wide enough to use as a billboard, the noble clothing almost stretched to its utmost limit on his muscled form.
unit.target: Sam spectabat virum, pluribus capitibus eum superantem, et umeris latioribus, cuius vestimenta nobilia fere ad summum corporis musculosum extulerunt.

unit.source: Sam’s gaming senses were practically screaming at him that this was an important NPC.
unit.target: Sensus ludendi Sam fere illi nuntiabant, "hic character non lusor magni momenti est!"

unit.source: Though, the fact there was no mention of this man in his inherited memories, as the history of Ironwood was pretty well documented, confused him.
unit.target: Sed quod de hoc viro in memoria sua non apparuerat, cum historia Ironwood bene scripta esset, eum confundebat.

unit.source: He watched as the giant man fussed over his daughter, and he simply made eye contact with the girl and mouthed ‘Lucrecia?’ at her.
unit.target: Observavit virum ingentem filiam curare, et cum puella oculos eius convenirent, labris "Lucrecia?" insinuavit.

unit.source: She just rolled her eyes back at him, while reassuring her father, that no it wasn’t torturing to wait for five minutes.
unit.target: Ea oculos reiecit ad eum, dum patrem suum rassurabat, dicens quinque minuta exspectare non esse cruciatum.

unit.source: Then the man finally deigned to notice Sam.
unit.target: Tum vir tandem dignatus est Sam animadverti.

unit.source: “You!” he yelled, apparently only knowing how to communicate at ear-shattering levels, and pointing at Sam.
unit.target: «Tu!» exclamavit, cum videnter sciret loqui voce fragoris aurium percussa, digito ad Sam monstrans.

unit.source: “My daughter told me that your pet has entertained her!”
unit.target: «Filia mea mihi narravit petum tuum eam delectavisse!»

unit.source: Sam simply bowed his head once again.
unit.target: Sam iterum caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “Yes, my lord. Lucky is good at that. Back in Greenwood, he used to run around with the local kids.”
unit.target: «Ita, domine. Lucky id bene facit; in Greenwood cum pueris localibus circumiabatur.»

unit.source: “Ah-ha! I see!” yelled the man, looking between him, the wolf, and his hopeful-looking daughter.
unit.target: «Ah-ha! Intelligo!» exclamavit, inter eum, lupum, et filiam eius, quae spe plena videbatur, intuebatur.

unit.source: “She also tells me that you have offered to visit us so that my darling daughter – “Father!” – could continue to be entertained by him!”
unit.target: «Ea etiam mihi narrat te nos visitaturum esse, ut filia mea cara – "Pater!" – ab eo delectari possit!»

unit.source: “That is correct, my lord. Lucky seems to like your daughter, and if he likes her, then he likes her. Who am I to stand in their way?” he finished with a wry grin.
unit.target: «Recte, domine. Lucky videtur tuam filiam diligere; et si eam amat, ideo eam amat. Quis ego sum, ut in via eorum stetim?» finivit cum risu ironico.

unit.source: The noble stared at him for a second, then threw his head back and began to laugh. Loudly, of course.
unit.target: Nobilis eum per momentum aspexit, tum caput retraxit et risum incoepit, clamore stridente.

unit.source: “Excellent! Then come to the Silvercrest manor in a week’s time, young adventurer, and we shall have you as a guest!”
unit.target: «Optime! Ergo veni ad manerium Silvercrest intra hebdomadam, iuvenis adventor, et te hospitem habebimus!»

unit.source: He turned around and immediately began to walk away, not even waiting for Sam to answer.
unit.target: Se vertit et statim processit, nec Sam responsum dare exspectans.

unit.source: “Come, Lucrecia! Your mother must be waiting!”
unit.target: «Veni, Lucrecia! Mater tua certe te exspectat!»

unit.source: Lucrecia looked at him with an apologetic smile, and gave Lucky a fond look, then hurried after her father, their guards quickly following them.
unit.target: Lucrecia eum aspiciens cum risu excusato, Lucky amantissime aspexit, et deinde celeriter post patrem suum processit, custodes eos celeriter sequentes.

unit.source: Sam stood there for a minute, ignoring the pitying or jealous looks from the guards of the Bureau while he searched his memories for the name Silvercrest.
unit.target: Sam ibi per unam minuta stetit, vultus miseritatis aut invidiae a custodibus Bureau neglex, dum nomen Silvercrest in memoria quaerebat.

unit.source: Finally, after a few minutes of frantic search, he found it.
unit.target: Denique, post paucos minutos fervidae quaestionis, id invenit.

unit.source: ‘Ooooh… Now it makes sense…’ he thought.
unit.target: ‘Ooooh… nunc sensum reddit…’ cogitavit.

unit.source: Then, shaking his head, Sam motioned for Lucky and left the area with great haste.
unit.target: Tum, caput concutens, Sam Lucky signavit et area celeriter reliquit.

unit.source: It was finally time to upgrade Lucky.
unit.target: Tandem tempus erat Lucky emendandi.

unit.source: And as he left the courtyard, he checked out his latest quest.
unit.target: Et dum atrium reliquit, novissimum quaestionem inspexit.

unit.source: [New quest acquired!]
unit.target: [Nova quaestio acquisita!]

unit.source: [Visit of the highest order!]
unit.target: [Visitatio ordinis altissimi!]

unit.source: [Lord Silvercrest has appreciated that your pet managed to get his only daughter to smile. He wants you to visit him in a week and do it again (and won’t take a no as an answer). Bide your time, and visit his manor at the appropriate time.]
unit.target: [Dominus Silvercrest aestimavit quod petum tuum filiam suam unicam eam delectavisse. Vult ut eum intra hebdomadam visites et id iterum facias (nec "non" ut responsum accipiet). Tempore adsiste et manerium eius tempore opportuno visita.]

unit.source: [Time limit: A week]
unit.target: [Tempus limite: Hebdomada]

unit.source: [Penalty: Failure to present yourself at the correct time will result in Lord Silvercrest hunting you down.]
unit.target: [Poena: Si te in tempore apto non praesentes, Dominus Silvercrest te insequetur.]

unit.source: ‘A curse or opportunity?’ he wondered as finished reading while rejoining the crowds tussling in the street.
unit.target: ‘Maledictio an occasio?’ meditatus est, cum lecturam finiret et se cum turbā in via congregatā reiunxit.

unit.source: As he already had access to a ritual room, he simply went by the mage tower and reserved one of the neutral ritual rooms, then began to hunt for materials.
unit.target: Cum iam ad conclave ritualis accessum haberet, per turrim magorum processit et unum ex conclavibus ritualibus neutris reservavit, deinde materias quaerere coepit.

unit.source: Truly, he could have waited until he managed to gather ultra-super rare materials, but that would fall into the shortcut territory, and the system would penalize him for it.
unit.target: Revera, exspectare potuisset donec materias ultra-super raras colligeret, sed id in viam brevius celeri pertinebat, et ratio eum poena afficere debebat.

unit.source: So for now, he was working with the highest material that somebody could have intuited based on his previous actions.
unit.target: Ita interim, laborabat cum materia altissima, quam quis ex actis eius praeteritis coniecturam habere potuisset.

unit.source: A few magically charged crystals to provide power.
unit.target: Pauca crystallina magicae impetu repleta ad vim praebendam.

unit.source: A few vials of blood from swamp shadow murks, a fang from a shadow wolf, and a tiny piece of mithril, famous for being the best at conducting magic.
unit.target: Pauca vasa sanguinis ex paludose umbris murkorum, dente ex lupo umbrato, et parva pars mithrili, nota propter optimum in magica ductura.

unit.source: Though they were just mere additions.
unit.target: Licet ea tantum additamenta erant.

unit.source: In reality, upgrading a pet at this level only needed one thing.
unit.target: In re, emendatio pet ex hoc gradu solum unum rem requirebat.

unit.source: An essence. Something related to the preferred evolution.
unit.target: Essentia. Aliquid ad evolutionem praeferendam pertinentis.

unit.source: If you wanted to evolve something that was made of metal? An Elemental core…
unit.target: Si aliquid ex metallo factum evolvere velis? Nucleus elementalis…

unit.source: You wanted your pet to fly? Air elemental core, or maybe the essence of some flying magical creature…
unit.target: Si pet tuum volare velis, nucleus aeri elementalis, aut fortasse essentia alicuius creaturae magicae volantis…

unit.source: And wouldn’t you know? He had found a shadow spirit just lying around…
unit.target: Et nonne scires? Spiritum umbrarum iacentem invenerat…

unit.source: Grinning to himself, followed by Lucky, Sam eagerly climbed the stairs of the mage tower towards his rented ritual room, while leafing through the small booklet the receptionist handed him.
unit.target: Subridens ad se ipso, Lucky sequens, Sam aviditer scalas turrim magorum ascendit ad conclave ritualis locatum, dum per parvum libellum, quod receptrix ei tradiderat, perlegebat.

unit.source: It contained the basic rules of the ritual rooms, the dos and don’ts of rituals, and a few basic rituals that everybody should know.
unit.target: Continebat regulas fundamentales conclavorum ritualium, quae qua facienda et qua non facienda sint, atque paucos ritus fundamentales quos omnes scire debent.

unit.source: He couldn’t wait…
unit.target: Non poterat exspectare…

unit.source: The room was a rather traditional affair.
unit.target: Camera erat more traditionali instituta.

unit.source: The building itself was made of stone, with wooden inlays and floors.
unit.target: Aedificium ipse ex lapide factum erat, cum inserta lignaria et pavimenta.

unit.source: The walls were adorned with simple scrolls or basic paintings.
unit.target: Parietes erant ornati volumina simplicia aut picturis rudimentariis.

unit.source: Nothing that screamed wealth, more like it whispered about an overworked interior designer who ran out of ideas after the reception hall.
unit.target: Nihil ostendebat opulentiam clamantem; potius quasi susurrabat de designatore interiore nimis laborato, qui post atrium receptionis consilia exhauriverat.

unit.source: Sam hung the small sign, that told people that a ritual was taking place on the doorknob, then after making sure that the door was locked behind him, he turned to the room, ignoring it for a moment as Lucky curiously sniffed around, and took in the ritual room.
unit.target: Sam parvum signum suspendit, quod populo indicabat ritu in manubrio ostii agi, et postquam certus fuit ostium post se clausum esse, ad cameram se vertit, eam per momentum neglegens dum Lucky curiosus circum quaerebat et spatium rituosum intuens erat.

unit.source: A simple stone surface, elevated slightly in the middle, surrounded by wooden flooring, that was found everywhere else in the building.
unit.target: Superficies lapidea simplex, in medio parum elevata, circumdata pavimento ligneo, ubique in aedificio reperta est.

unit.source: Next to the walls were several desks, empty, with only one covered with simple writing utensils and a few reams of parchments.
unit.target: Iuxta parietes erant plura mensae, vacuae; solum una erat instructa instrumentis scribendi simplicibus et paucis fasciculis chartarum.

unit.source: And next to the door, on the wall, was a small cabinet that, according to the booklet Sam was given, contained some basic ritual materials that were needed in almost every ritual.
unit.target: Et iuxta ostium, in pariete, parvus armarium apponebatur, qui, secundum libellulum quem Sam accepit, contineret quaedam materialia rituum fundamentalia quae fere in omni ritu necessaria erant.

unit.source: Chalk, salt, and a few more reagents and such.
unit.target: Creta, sal, et nonnulla alia reagentia.

unit.source: On the ceiling was a dark hole, right above the short stone plinth in the middle of the room.
unit.target: In laqueariis erat fovea obscura, recta supra brevem plinthum lapideum in medio camerae.

unit.source: ‘Probably for ventilation or maybe it opens and allows the sky to be seen…’ he wondered as he curiously gazed at it.
unit.target: «Forsitan ad aerationem aut fortasse aperitur, ut caelum videatur…» miratus est dum eo curiosus aspiciebat.

unit.source: But in the end, he just shook his head and took out the booklet.
unit.target: Sed in fine, caput dimovit et libellulum extraxit.

unit.source: Thankfully, it contained the basic ritual that the natives of the world called Evolution Ritual.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, continebat ritum fundamentalis, quem indigenae mundi Ritus Evolutionis vocabant.

unit.source: Naturally, there were better and more intricate rituals, but he was in a position where he could only use this.
unit.target: Naturaliter, meliores atque intricati ritus exstabant, sed talibus conditionibus tantum hoc uti posset.

unit.source: Opening the cabinet, he retrieved some chalk, gave Lucky some snacks to allow him to work without distraction, then began drawing the ritual circle on the stone platform.
unit.target: Armarium aperiens, cretam extraxit, Lucky esculenta dedit ut sine perturbatione laboraret, deinde circulum rituosum in superficie lapideo delineare coepit.

unit.source: One big circle to encompass the ritual, and setting a boundary for the magic.
unit.target: Unus ingens circulus ad ritum complectendum, finemque magiae statuens.

unit.source: Then a smaller circle, with even smaller circles placed on it, equidistant from each other to hold the reagents.
unit.target: Deinde parvus circulus, super quem circuli minores aequo intervallo distributi ad reagentia colligenda erant.

unit.source: Followed by a few important runes between the two concentric circles.
unit.target: Sequebantur paucae magni momenti runae inter duo circulos concentricos.

unit.source: Coincidentally, one of the runes that he drew was one he already knew.
unit.target: Casualiter, una ex runis quas delineavit, erat illa quam iam noverat.

unit.source: The rune of magic.
unit.target: Runa magiae.

unit.source: After all, this ritual was nothing more than channeling the mana of the world through certain filters, the reagents, into the pet or familiar, to evolve them.
unit.target: Postremo, hic ritus nihil aliud erat quam canalizatio mana mundi per certos filtros—reagentia—in animal domesticum, ut evolvantur.

unit.source: It took him around an hour to draw all the runes out painstakingly, ignoring how every time he perfected one, his notification chimed in that he learned a new rune.
unit.target: Ei circiter hora tulit ut omnes runas diligentissime delinearet, neglegens quotienscumque una conficiebatur, notitia eius nuntians novam runam didicisse.

unit.source: He would have turned it off, but the notification was needed to tell him when he was finished with a rune.
unit.target: Illud suppressisset, sed notitia necessaria erat ut ei indicaret cum runa confecta esset.

unit.source: Then, after the ritual circle was fully applied to the stone, Sam took a quick breather, making sure he was as ready for the ritual as he could be.
unit.target: Deinde, postquam circulus rituosus in lapide plene delineatus est, Sam brevem spiritum sumpsit, curans se tam paratum ad ritum esse quam poterat.

unit.source: Then he simply stepped up to Lucky, lifted the silly wolf into the circle, then squatted down, and looked directly into his eyes.
unit.target: Deinde ad Lucky accessit, ineptum lupum in circulum sustulit, deinde genu flectens, in oculos eius directe respexit.

unit.source: “Okay, Lucky! I need you to stay, veeery still! Alright?”
unit.target: «Bene, Lucky! Te requireo ut maneas, valde quietus! Ita?»

unit.source: The wolf looked at him for a moment, then simply licked his face.
unit.target: Lupus per momentum in eum respexit, deinde faciem eius simpliciter lambivit.

unit.source: As Sam cleaned the slobber off his face, he hoped it was the lick of agreement.
unit.target: Dum Sam saliva ex facie abstergit, sperabat illud esse lambitum consensum.

unit.source: Sam watched Lucky for a moment, and when he saw that the young wolf had no intention of leaving the ritual circle, he let out a relieved sigh and began walking around the ritual circle.
unit.target: Sam Lucky per momentum observavit, et cum vidit iuvenem lupum non propositum esse circulum rituosum relinquere, suspiravit leviter et circa circulum rituosum ambulare coepit.

unit.source: In the smaller circles, he began placing the reagents.
unit.target: In circulis minoribus, reagentia disponere coepit.

unit.source: Into the bottom two went a small shadow wolf fang and a tuft of Lucky’s own fur.
unit.target: In duo inferiores posita sunt parva canina lupae umbratilis et fasciculus pilorum Lucky ipsius.

unit.source: The next two received the blood of the swamp shadow murks, which were creatures from the swamp that blended into the shadows from where they ambushed their victims.
unit.target: Duo proximis accipiunt sanguinem paludis umbra murkorum, creaturarum ex palude quae in umbras se miscebant ad hostes insidiandos.

unit.source: And the top two received two tiny pieces of mithril.
unit.target: Et duo superiora acceperunt duas parvas partes mithrili.

unit.source: Finally, at the top, into the seventh circle, he placed the bottle of the fractured Lesser Shadow Spirit essence.
unit.target: Denique, in circulum septimum, amphoram essentiae fractae Minoris Umbrae Spiritus posuit.

unit.source: Originally, he planned to hunt down a Shadow Murk, but this was much better.
unit.target: Primum intendebat murkum umbratilem venari, sed hoc multo melius fuit.

unit.source: Now he just had to pray to the RNG gods that he chose the correct reagents, and Lucky would get the skills he wanted.
unit.target: Nunc tantum oportuit deos RNG orare, ut recta reagentia eligeret, atque Lucky artes quas optabat adeptus esset.

unit.source: Stepping around the wolf sitting still, curiously gazing at the surrounding stuff, he kneeled down behind the ritual circle and placed one hand on the shadow wolf’s fang and the tuft of fur.
unit.target: Circumstantem lupum immobile sed curiose intuens, post circulum rituosum genu flectit et unam manum super caninam lupae umbratilis atque fasciculum pilorum posuit.

unit.source: Then Sam took a deep breath and began channeling mana.
unit.target: Tum Sam profundum spiritum arripuit atque mana canalizare coepit.

unit.source: He closed his eyes and concentrated fully on the mana as it left his body, making sure to extract every last ounce of mana from his body.
unit.target: Oculos clausit et totum animum ad mana intentum habuit dum ex corpore eius effluere videbatur, curans ut omnem quantitatem manae eodem extraheret.

unit.source: With his senses he followed as the mana flowed from his hands into the items he was touching, saturating them, then following the circle drawn with chalk continued into the runes, filling them, causing them to shine strong enough that he could feel them through closed eyes, then continued into the next circle.
unit.target: Sensibus suis secutus est, dum mana ex manibus eius per ea quae tetigit fluere inciperet, ea saturans; deinde circulum creta delineatum sequens in runas versus, eas replebat, ita ut valde fulgere vellent ut per clausos oculos sentiret, atque deinde in circulum sequentem perveniebat.

unit.source: Watching through his mind’s eye, he waited as his mana infused the blood, then continued to travel further in the circle.
unit.target: Mentis oculo intuens, exspectavit dum mana in sanguinem infusa esset, deinde per circulum ulterius procedere coepit.

unit.source: The pieces of mithril barely took a second to fill with mana, proving their capability with conducting mana, and then his mana reached the most important reagent.
unit.target: Partes mithrili paulo tempore ad manae repletionem suffecerunt, ostendentes earum facultatem mana conducendi, et tunc mana eius ad reagentia maximi momenti pervenit.

unit.source: The shadow spirit, however fractured, still had its own mana, so for a moment that felt like years, Sam felt his mana straining against the spirit’s own mana, the two warring against each other.
unit.target: Spiritus umbra, quamvis fractus, attamen proprium manae retinebat, ita ut per momentum, quod quasi annos videbatur, Sam sensit mana suum adversus spiritus conari, duo inter se certantes.

unit.source: Thankfully, the mind was destroyed by its defeat, so Sam only had to dominate the instincts that were inherent in such a being.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, mens eius in clade deletus erat, ita Sam solum debuit instinctus in ea entitate innatos dominare.

unit.source: But in the end, it was just a fractured remnant of a weak spirit, so he managed to overwhelm it.
unit.target: Sed demum, illa erat tantum fracta reliquio spiritus infirmi, quapropter eum superare potuit.

unit.source: And the moment the spirit’s defenses broke, Sam felt the ritual circle complete, and the drain on his mana increased.
unit.target: Et momento quo defensionēs spiritus confractae sunt, Sam sensit circulum rituosum finitum esse, atque deiectio manae eius augeri.

unit.source: He didn’t hesitate and gave everything freely.
unit.target: Non dubitavit et omnia libere donavit.

unit.source: After all, he was investing in the future, so he couldn’t afford to be stingy.
unit.target: Nam in futurum investiebat, ergo non poterat esse avarus.

unit.source: Plus, it was just mana, it would regenerate.
unit.target: Praeterea, erat solum mana, quae regenerabitur.

unit.source: So, he dug deep, dragged up every last mote of mana, and channeled it into the circle.
unit.target: Itaque alte fodiit, omnem remanentem particulam manae eduxit, et eam in circulum canalizavit.

unit.source: Meanwhile, the circle, which previously shone with light, began to turn dark, and as he opened his eyes, he saw as if the very darkness was swallowing the light, birthing… shadows.
unit.target: Interim, circulus, qui antea lumine fulgebat, obscurari coepit, et cum oculos aperuit, vidit quasi ipsa tenebra luce devoranda esset, umbras gignens.

unit.source: Shadows danced on the wall, and even though the room had a few windows, they were obscured by the shadows that seemed to be erupting randomly from Lucky, who became a big ball of darkness that seemed to be pulsating to a weird beat.
unit.target: Umbrae in pariete saltabant, et quamquam camera paucis fenestris praedita erat, illae obscuratae erant ob umbras quae fortasse ex Lucky, qui in magnum globum tenebris versum est ac ad pulsus insolitos vibrare videbantur, erumpere videbantur.

unit.source: It took Sam a moment to recognize that it was beating to the rhythm of his own heart.
unit.target: Sam paulum temporis requisivit ut agnosceret illud ad rhythmon cordis sui pulsare.

unit.source: For a while, he just knelt there, and watched, amazed, the spectacle as mana was drained out of him as soon as it regenerated.
unit.target: Aliquamdiu, ibi genu flectens, stupens spectabat spectaculum dum mana eique inmomentaneē effluebatur simul ac regenerabatur.

unit.source: After an unknown amount of time, the pulsating dark mass began to die down in intensity, and the dark ball of nothingness in the middle of the room began to shrink.
unit.target: Post quantitatem temporis incertam, massa obscura pulsans incipiebat minuere in intensitate, atque globus tenebricosus nullitatis in medio camerae contrahere coepit.

unit.source: Soon it lost its globular shape and began to take the familiar shape of Lucky, albeit a little smaller.
unit.target: Mox formam globularis amisit et formam Lucky notam assumpsit, quamquam paulo minorem.

unit.source: Lucky’s body, instead of sinfully fluffy fur, was made of black shadows that seemed to dance a little every time Lucky twitched.
unit.target: Corpus Lucky, pro lanugine peccatori ex pilis abundanti, ex umbris nigris factum erat, quae parum saltabant quotidie cum Lucky leviter convulsus esset.

unit.source: Otherwise, it was still shaped like a wolf and had the same adorable face.
unit.target: Alioquin adhuc in forma lupi erat atque eundem vultum amoenum habebat.

unit.source: For an entire minute, they stared at each other, then at the same time a multitude of notifications popped up, and Sam felt himself being hit by exhaustion that he had never felt, and Lucky pounced on him and began licking his face.
unit.target: Per totum minutum inter se aspiciebant; deinde simul multitudo notificationum apparuit, et Sam sensit se ab extenuatione, quam numquam ante sentirat, affictum, dum Lucky in eum desiluit et faciem eius lambere coepit.

unit.source: Sam couldn’t help but laugh out loud, then bury his face into Lucky’s fur.
unit.target: Sam nesciebat non subridere voce clara, deinde faciem in lanugine Lucky sepelit.

unit.source: Thankfully, it was still as soft as previously, more like it was even softer and more delicate.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, adhuc tam mollis erat quam antea, immo etiam suavior atque tenerior.

unit.source: For a moment he let himself loose in the sensation of Lucky’s fur and played with his friend, but then, still laying on the ground, exhausted, he began going over his notifications.
unit.target: Per momentum se relaxavit in sensu lanugine Lucky et cum amico luderet, sed deinde, adhuc iacens in terra et extenuatus, notificationes suas recensere coepit.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you have correctly recorded an entire Rune scheme!]
unit.target: [Gratulor, totum schema runarum recte consignatum habes!]

unit.source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Direction!]
unit.target: [Runa Directio didicisti!]

unit.source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Health!]
unit.target: [Runa Salutis didicisti!]

unit.source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Control!]
unit.target: [Runa Dominii didicisti!]

unit.source: [You’ve learned the Rune of Assimilation!]
unit.target: [Runa Assimilationis didicisti!]

unit.source: [You’ve learned the rune scheme of the Ritual of Evolution!]
unit.target: [Schema runarum Rituum Evolutionis didicisti!]

unit.source: That little addition to his rune dictionary was a nice bonus.
unit.target: Illa parva additio ad dictionarium runarum eius bonus gratiosus erat.

unit.source: He would have to get some skill that would be able to make use of it.
unit.target: Debebat aliquam artem adipisci, qua ea uti posset.

unit.source: Though if the exhaustion meant what he suspected it did, then he would have enough time at a library to get the skill.
unit.target: Si extenuatio id significabat, quod suspicabatur, tunc satis temporis in bibliotheca habebat ad artem adipisci.

unit.source: [You attempted the Ritual of Evolution with your pet, Lucky!]
unit.target: [Ritualem Evolutionis cum tuo domestico, Lucky, conatus es!]

unit.source: [Compatibility check…]
unit.target: [Examinatio compatibilitatis…]

unit.source: [Your Ritual of Evolution was a success!]
unit.target: [Ritualem Evolutionis tuam feliciter perfecisti!]

unit.source: [Lucky, the Adult Gray Mana Wolf (Level 15) has successfully transformed into Juvenile Shadow Spirit Wolf (Level 1)!]
unit.target: [Lucky, Lupus Manae Caesi Adultus (Gradus 15) feliciter in Lupum Spiritus Umbrae Juvenilem (Gradus 1) se transformavit!]

unit.source: [Lucky lost the Strong Jaw skill!]
unit.target: [Lucky, artem Mandibulae Fortis perdit!]

unit.source: [Lucky gained the Animalistic Shadow Control skill!]
unit.target: [Lucky artem Controlli Umbrarum Animalisticam adeptus est!]

unit.source: [Animalistic Shadow Control: Level Max (Passive) The wolf controls the shadows around him just as easily as it breathes.]
unit.target: [Controllus Umbrarum Animalisticus: Gradus Maximus (Passivus) – Lupus umbras circa se regit aeque facile quam spirat.]

unit.source: [Lucky gained the Shadow Spirit Body skill!]
unit.target: [Lucky artem Corporis Spiritus Umbrae adeptus est!]

unit.source: [Shadow Spirit Body: Level Max (Passive) The body of the wolf is part shadow and part spirit, which makes it much more malleable.]
unit.target: [Corpus Spiritus Umbrae: Gradus Maximus (Passivus) – Corpus lupi est parte umbra et parte spiritus, quod id multo flexibilis reddit.]

unit.source: [Name: Lucky Race: Juvenile Shadow Spirit Wolf HP: 945/945 MP: 285/285 Level: 1 STR: 21 DEX: 25 AGI: 30 VIT: 21 END: 18 MAG: 19 PER: 31 WIS: 14 LUK: 7]
unit.target: [Nomen: Lucky Genus: Lupus Spiritus Umbrae Juvenilis HP: 945/945 MP: 285/285 Gradus: 1 Virtus: 21 Agilitas: 25 Celeritas: 30 Vigor: 21 Patientia: 18 Magia: 19 Perceptio: 31 Sapientia: 14 Fortuna: 7]

unit.source: Sam read the skills and couldn’t help but celebrate.
unit.target: Sam artes legit et non potuit non celebrare.

unit.source: He got the skill he wanted!
unit.target: Artem, quam desiderabat, adeptus est!

unit.source: Granted, he was just aiming for the Shadow Body skill, which was a well-known pet skill in his inherited memories, but the addition of the Spirit prefix couldn’t hurt.
unit.target: Certe, tantum ad artem Corporis Umbrae contendebat, quae nota erat ut ars domestica in memoria hereditata, sed additio praefixi Spiritus nullum nocuit.

unit.source: And the stats…
unit.target: Et statuta…

unit.source: They were amazing, showing clearly that without the evolution ritual, poor Lucky stood no chance.
unit.target: Ea erant miranda, evidenter ostendentes quod sine ritu evolutionis, pauper Lucky nullam spem habebat.

unit.source: Then, while scratching behind Lucky’s ears, he started reading the notifications about his own skills.
unit.target: Deinde, dum post aures Lucky scalpens, notificationes de propriis artibus legere coepit.

unit.source: [You have successfully finished the first ritual you ever tried! You gained +1 MAG and +1 WIS!]
unit.target: [Priorem ritualem quam umquam temptavisti feliciter perfecisti! +1 MAG et +1 WIS consecutus es!]

unit.source: [Thanks to keeping calm during the ritual, the Basic Breathing Technique reached Level 8!]
unit.target: [Gratias ad calmum animum in ritu manendum, Technica Basica Spiritus ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Advanced Mana Control reached Level 6!]
unit.target: [Imperium Manae Provectum ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Mana Sense reached Level 11!]
unit.target: [Sensus Manae ad Gradum 11 pervenit!]

unit.source: [You gained the Focused Sense subskill!]
unit.target: [Subdisciplina Sensus Concentrati adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Focused Sense: Level 0/5 (Passive) The more you concentrate your sense on something, the more you can sense.]
unit.target: [Sensus Concentratus: Gradus 0/5 (Passivus) – Quo arctius sensum ad aliquid intendis, eo amplius percipies.]

unit.source: [Multitasking reached Level 22!]
unit.target: [Multitasking ad Gradum 22 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Mana Synergy reached Level 4!]
unit.target: [Synergia Manae ad Gradum 4 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Thanks to drawing deep and long from your well of mana, keeping nothing back, and supporting your companion, your Mana Well skill reached Level 3!]
unit.target: [Gratias ad profunde et diuturne ex puteo manae trahendum, nihil retinendo, et comitem tuum sustinendo, ars Putei Manae ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Calm Heart reached Level 5!]
unit.target: [Cor Tranquillum ad Gradum 5 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your skill Companion Sense and its subskill, Deep Connection, transformed upon your companion’s evolution!]
unit.target: [Ars Sensus Comitis tui et eius subdisciplina, Connexio Profunda, in evolutione comitis tui transformata sunt!]

unit.source: [Companion Sense and Deep Connection transformed into the skill, Spirit Link!]
unit.target: [Sensus Comitis et Connexio Profunda in artem, Vinculum Spirituum, transformatae sunt!]

unit.source: [Spirit Link: Level 0/100 (Passive) You have a connection to a spirit, and this connection is based on the deep bond you two share. It allows you to know the location of the spirit and their feelings and gives you a general idea about their wellbeing. The spirit is capable of the same. (Still provides the bonuses of the subsumed skills.)]
unit.target: [Vinculum Spirituum: Gradus 0/100 (Passivus) – Habes nexum ad spiritum, et hic nexus fundatur in profunda vincula quae inter vos existunt. Permittit te scire locum spiritus atque affectus eius, atque notionem generalem de eius salubritate praebet. Spiritus quoque eadem efficit. (Adhuc praebet beneficia subdisciplinarum condescendatarum.)]

unit.source: Sam stared for a long minute at the notifications happily, but then his smile turned into a frown as he beheld the last notification that popped up.
unit.target: Sam diuturno momento notificationes laete intuens, deinde risus eius in rugam conversus est cum ultimam notificationem apparuisse vidit.

unit.source: [Due to overdrawing your mana, you have been struck by Mana Exhaustion!]
unit.target: [Propter nimiam extractionem manae, afflictus es Exhauritione Manae!]

unit.source: [Mana Exhaustion: Physical abilities -90%, Mana Control -90%, Mana Regeneration -90%, Using mana could result in all manner of other negative effects. Duration: 99 hours 49 minutes]
unit.target: [Exhaustio Manae: Facultates Corporales -90%, Imperium Manae -90%, Regeneratio Manae -90%, Uti manam potest ducere ad alias nocivas effectus. Duratio: 99 horae 49 minuta]

unit.source: Which neatly explained why he was feeling so exhausted.
unit.target: Quod satis explicavit cur tam extenuatus se sentirentem.

unit.source: Sam scowled a little, but then shrugged.
unit.target: Sam paulum scowlavit, sed deinde umeros levavit.

unit.source: He already suspected that it would be the case, as nothing was free.
unit.target: Iam suspicabatur hoc futurum esse, quoniam nihil gratis est.

unit.source: And Ironwood’s library was much better than the one back in Greenwood, so he had things to do while recovering, but it still felt shitty.
unit.target: Et bibliotheca Ironwood multo melior erat quam illa in Greenwood, itaque res agendas habebat dum convalescebat, sed tamen misere se sentiebat.

unit.source: But before he could do anything, he had to check something.
unit.target: Sed antequam quidquam agere posset, aliquid inspexi debuit.

unit.source: Carefully he sat up, still patting Lucky, then took a deep breath and called out to the changed wolf.
unit.target: Cautissime sedebat, Lucky adhuc palpans, deinde profundum spiritum arripuit et ad lupum mutatum clamavit.

unit.source: “Hey, Lucky!” the wolf immediately looked up, eagerly waiting for his words.
unit.target: «Heus, Lucky!» lupus statim oculos elevavit, avidus verbis eius exspectans.

unit.source: “Could you do me a favor and jump into my shadow?”
unit.target: «Potesne mihi commodum facere et in umbram meam salire?»

unit.source: The wolf cocked his head to the side, as if contemplating his request, but then barked out happily and jumped up and, with a picture-perfect dive, jumped into the shadow his sitting body was making on the wooden floor.
unit.target: Lupus caput ad latus inclinavit, quasi petitionem considerans, sed deinde laetus latravit et desiluit, et cum perfecta deiectio, in umbram quam corpus sedentem in pavimento ligneo creabat, saliit.

unit.source: For a moment the shadow was still, then two big eyes opened and began staring at him as if expecting praise.
unit.target: Per momentum umbra immobilis manebat, deinde duo magna oculi aperti sunt et eum intuentes quasi laudem exspectantes perspexerunt.

unit.source: He wasn’t one to hold back.
unit.target: Non cunctabatur.

unit.source: “Good boy!”
unit.target: «Bonus, puer!»

unit.source: After cleaning up the ritual room, one of those little things that made NPCs hate the players for if not done, he left the room, told the receptionist that he was finished, and left the mage tower.
unit.target: Postquam cameram rituosam purgavit – una ex illis parvis rebus quae NPCs lusores odisse faciebant si non pergerentur – egressus est, receptori dixit se finem attigisse, et turrim magicarum reliquit.

unit.source: If anyone noticed that he left without the wolf he entered with, then nobody mentioned it.
unit.target: Si quis animadvertisset eum sine lupo quo intraverat discessisse, de hoc nihil dictum est.

unit.source: Lucky, thankfully, managed to understand the concept of staying in his shadow to ambush people, though he expected to have to explain a lot in the future why his shadow was staring at people, or panting.
unit.target: Lucky, gratiose, intellexit notionem mansisse in sua umbra ad hostes insidiandos, quamquam exspectabat se multum de hoc in futurum explanandum esse.

unit.source: It was still much better than the person who did in the other timeline, and from whom he got the idea.
unit.target: Hoc tamen multo melior erat quam persona quae in altera linea temporis egisset, a qua idea orta est.

unit.source: That person was a fan of tentacles…
unit.target: Ea persona tentaculorum cultor erat…

unit.source: Knowing that he was exhausted mentally, and his in-game body was pretty much useless, he took out the letter he got from the owner of the Green Stump, checked the address, and began walking towards it.
unit.target: Scire se mente extenuatum et corpus in ludo fere inutiliter esse, litteras quas a domino “Green Stump” accepisset extraxit, inscriptionem comprobatam quaesivit, et in eam viam procedere coepit.

unit.source: Sam navigated through the winding streets of Ironwood for a while until he found himself standing in front of a three-story building with the same iron and wooden decorations that were present everywhere else in the city.
unit.target: Sam per vias flexuosas Ironwood aliquantum erravit, donec se coram aedificio tribus ordinibus stantem invenit, quo ornamenta ferrea et lignaria, quae ubique in urbe erant, praesente erant.

unit.source: Over the door hung a sign proclaiming the building to be the Cloudy Day inn.
unit.target: Super ostium pendebat signum, quod aedificium nominaretur “Hospitium Diei Nubili.”

unit.source: ‘Weird name…’ Sam thought, but then shrugged.
unit.target: «Nomen insuetu…» cogitavit Sam, sed deinde umeros sublevavit.

unit.source: Sarah was nice and had a rather eccentric name for her inn.
unit.target: Sarah benigna erat et hospitii sui nomen satis eccentricum habebat.

unit.source: Stepping through the door, he was immediately hit by the scent of well-made food and the sound of chatter as people enjoyed the aforementioned food.
unit.target: Per ostium ingrediens statim odor cibi bene parati et sonus sermonum eum percuterunt, dum homines cibum praedictum gaudebant.

unit.source: Dodging people as they rushed around, taking note of a few beautiful women, that seemed to delight in displaying themselves, he stepped up to the counter, manned by a bored man, dressed in slacks and a white shirt.
unit.target: Turba evitans et paucas feminas pulchras, quae se ostendere vellebant, notans, accessit ad mensam, qua vir taediosus, in braccis et alba camisia indutus, praefuit.

unit.source: “Hello, sir, and welcome to the Cloudy Day! How can we help you today?” came the bored greeting, the man barely taking the effort to look at him.
unit.target: «Salve, domine, et gratum te habemus ad “Cloudy Day”! Quomodo tibi hodie auxiliari possumus?» inquit vir taediosus, vix conatus ad eum spectans.

unit.source: Sam just gave the man a smile.
unit.target: Sam viro tantum subridens obtulit.

unit.source: “Greetings, I’m here to deliver a letter to…” he looked down at the letter and then back at the man.
unit.target: «Salve, adsum ut epistulam tradam…» inquit, epistulam intueriens deinde ad virum revertit.

unit.source: “…Andrea.”
unit.target: «…Andrea.»

unit.source: The man let out a deep and long-suffering sigh, nodded, then turned around leisurely and walked through the door behind the counter.
unit.target: Vir profundum et longum suspirium edidit, annuit, deinde lente conversus per ostium post mensam ambulavit.

unit.source: A minute later, the door slammed open, and a big woman, with black hair, put up in a delicate bun, wearing what Sam would call a stereotypical barmaid dress.
unit.target: Post unum minutum, ostium repente patefactum est, et magna femina, capillis nigris in subtili nodum convolutis, vestem gerens, quam Sam “vestimentum tabernariae ministrae” appellaret, apparuit.

unit.source: “It is, I, Andrea!” she exclaimed, standing proudly at the door, while the receptionist just sighed behind her.
unit.target: «Ego, Andrea, sum!» exclamavit, stantibus superbe ad ostium, dum receptrix post eam suspiravit.

unit.source: Sam, now, could understand a little better the man’s attitude.
unit.target: Sam nunc melius mores viri intellexit.

unit.source: “Who has the letter for me?” She continued to yell, looking around until her eyes found Sam.
unit.target: «Quis mihi epistulam dat?» perstabat clamare, circumspiciens donec oculi eius Sam invenirent.

unit.source: “That would be me, madam!” he stated humbly, then held out the letter.
unit.target: «Ego sum, domina!» humiliter dixit, deinde epistulam protulit.

unit.source: “It’s from Greenwood.”
unit.target: «Ex Greenwood est.»

unit.source: The woman’s eyes lit up and she practically teleported next to Sam, snatching the letter from his hands.
unit.target: Oculi mulieris fulserunt et statim ad Sam accessit, epistulam ex manibus eius arripiens.

unit.source: “Oh, Sarah! I haven’t heard from her for a while!” Then she fell silent as she got absorbed in reading the letter.
unit.target: «O, Sarah! Nuper ab ea nullum nuntium audivi!» Deinde siluit, dum epistulam legere occupata esset.

unit.source: A minute later, she silently folded the letter and slipped it into a pocket on her dress, and turned towards Sam with a small, mischievous smile.
unit.target: Post unum minutum, tacite epistulam plicavit et in sinum vestis suae introduxit, et ad Sam versa parvo, malitioso risu.

unit.source: “So, I heard you are looking for a room?”
unit.target: «Itaque audivi te quaerere cubiculum?»

unit.source: She looked at the message that was blinking in the browser window and took another glance at the name of the sender.
unit.target: Illud nuntium, quod in fenestra interretiali micabat, aspexit et nomen mittentis iterum contemplata est.

unit.source: She knew who they were.
unit.target: Sciebat qui essent.

unit.source: Everyone who worked in the same circles as she did knew who they were.
unit.target: Omnes qui in eandis circulis, sicut ipsa, laborabant, sciebant qui essent.

unit.source: LazyPhoenix rose to infamy just like their namesake.
unit.target: LazyPhoenix, sicut nomen ipsius indicat, ad infamiam ascendit.

unit.source: They knew things nobody should know and had access to things nobody should have.
unit.target: Sciebant res, quas nemo scire debuit, et accessum habebant ad ea, quae nemo habere debuit.

unit.source: The speculations on the forums (and in private) ran rampant, with everybody trying to figure out where they came from, and who pissed them off that they were so generous with what was, more than likely, insider information.
unit.target: Speculationes in forum (et in privato) pervagabantur, dum omnes conabantur perscrutari unde originem haberent, et quis eos iraserit quod tam largiter communicabant, quae probabiliter erant notitiae intimae.

unit.source: Personally, before today, she didn’t care much.
unit.target: Personaliter, ante hunc diem, parum curabat.

unit.source: People like LazyPhoenix popped up now and then, and then crashed and burned when their fame got into their head, and did or said something inadvisable.
unit.target: Homines similes LazyPhoenix aliquando apparuērunt, deinde ruērunt et combusti sunt, cum fama in mentem eorum intrasset, et aliquid inprudenter fecerunt aut dixerunt.

unit.source: But LazyPhoenix didn’t talk to people.
unit.target: Sed LazyPhoenix cum hominibus non loquebatur.

unit.source: They didn’t brag about their knowledge or fame on any social media.
unit.target: Non gloriabatur de sua scientia aut fama in ulla retia sociali.

unit.source: They were only active on one site, and even there, their interaction with people was businesslike.
unit.target: Solum in uno situ erant activi, et etiam ibi eorum commercium cum hominibus negotiale erat.

unit.source: They sold information and nothing more.
unit.target: Notitias vendebant et nihil ultra.

unit.source: And now she was here, staring at a message from the aforementioned person, offering her information.
unit.target: Et nunc illa aderat, intuens nuntium a praedicta persona, ei informationem offerentem.

unit.source: Three favors.
unit.target: Tres beneficia.

unit.source: From her.
unit.target: Ab ea.

unit.source: A person who was at best a small-time streamer.
unit.target: Persona, quae ad minimum, parvus emissarius ludorum esset.

unit.source: For a moment, she even thought it was some kind of scam.
unit.target: Per momentum, etiam putavit id esse aliquam fraudem.

unit.source: But she couldn’t exactly point out what kind of scam it could be.
unit.target: Sed non potuit exacte indicare quidnam fraudis genus esset.

unit.source: In the end, she couldn’t help it; her curiosity overwhelmed her and she accepted the offer.
unit.target: Demum, non potuit se repugnare; eius curiositas eam opprimebat, atque oblationem accepit.

unit.source: She expected a well-formatted document with a list of tasks or something along those lines, but apparently, the game was new enough that even LazyPhoenix couldn’t showcase their usual meticulousness.
unit.target: Exspectabat documentum bene ordinatum cum indice munerum aut similibus, sed apparuit ludus satis novus esse ut etiam LazyPhoenix consuetam accuratam diligentiam suam ostendere non posset.

unit.source: Instead, she was practically treated to a few videos, with parts highlighted, links to stories from people, and even some clips from her own stream.
unit.target: Proinde, paucis video ei praebita erant, cum partibus illustratis, nexus ad fabulas hominum, atque etiam aliqua fragmenta ex sua ipsius emissione.

unit.source: It was definitely weird, but LazyPhoenix was the guy who knew.
unit.target: Certe mirum erat, sed LazyPhoenix vir erat qui sciebat.

unit.source: So, she just shrugged and wrote down the instructions.
unit.target: Itaque illa humeros sublevavit et praecepta scripsit.

unit.source: It was worth the try…
unit.target: Conatus certe valuit…

unit.source: Sometime later, she stared down at the stone tablet in the middle of the cavern, decorated with crystals jutting out of the ground and the ceiling, all pulsing with mystical light.
unit.target: Aliquando postea, illa intuebatur lapidem tabulam in medio speluncae, ornatam crystallis eminenti ex terra et laqueario, omnibus luce mystica pulsante.

unit.source: The cavern itself was humongous, as she couldn’t actually see its end, only the twinkling of the crystals in the distance like stars on a clear night.
unit.target: Ipsa spelunca ingens erat, nam finem eius videre non potuit, sed solum micantia crystallorum in longinquo, quasi stellae in serena nocte.

unit.source: The journey to reach the place wasn’t arduous, but without the hints she was given, she would have never found it.
unit.target: Iter ad locum attingendum non erat arduum, sed sine indicibus datis, numquam illum inveniret.

unit.source: And as she saw several people near the locations while she was doing the requisite quests, she knew she only had a small window to acquire it.
unit.target: Et cum plures homines prope locos observasset, dum quaestiones necessarias perficiendis versabatur, scivit se occasionem parvam habere ad id adipiscendum.

unit.source: So, with a small trepidation, she reached out for the tablet and prayed that the quest was true, and it would really give her the thing she was promised.
unit.target: Itaque, parvo cum tremore, ad tabulam manum extendit et oravit ut quaestus verus esset, et vere ei id daret quod promissum fuerat.

unit.source: As her hand got closer, she could hear an audible hum coming from the crystals, and the pulsing sped up.
unit.target: Dum manus eius appropinquabat, sonum humile ex crystallis audire potuit, et pulsus celerius fieri coepit.

unit.source: Then her fingers touched the stone tablet, and a deluge of notifications appeared in front of her.
unit.target: Tum digiti eius lapidem tabulam tetigerunt, et inundatio notificationum coram ea apparuit.

unit.source: [Congratulations! You found one of the Tablets of Creation!]
unit.target: [Gratulatio! Unam ex Tabulis Creationis invenisti!]

unit.source: [Thanks to your luck and attention to detail you gain +1 LUK, +3 PER, and +1 WIS!]
unit.target: [Propter fortunam tuam ac diligentiam, consequeris +1 LUK, +3 PER, et +1 WIS!]

unit.source: [The Tablet of Creation reaches out to you…]
unit.target: [Tabula Creationis ad te tendit…]

unit.source: [The Tablet of Creation finds you worthy!]
unit.target: [Tabula Creationis te dignum invenit!]

unit.source: [The Tablet of Creation grants you the Knowledge of Crystal Geomancy!]
unit.target: [Tabula Creationis tibi dat scientiam Geomantiae crystallinae!]

unit.source: [Crystal Geomancy: Level MAX (Passive) You are able to summon an ethereal book that contains the knowledge of how to build artifacts, items, and most importantly, golems out of crystals.]
unit.target: [Geomantia Crystallina: Gradus MAX (Passivus) Possides facultatem evocandi librum aetherium, qui continet scientiam quomodo artificia, instrumenta, et maxime golemos ex crystallis construi possint.]

unit.source: She stared for a moment, and while she was reading the screens that appeared, the stone tablet, which so far looked like an ordinary stone tablet, began to shine with the same light as the surrounding crystals.
unit.target: Per momentum intuebatur, et dum ea quae apparuerant legebat, lapis tabula, quae usque nunc ut simplex tabula lapidea visa erat, incipiebat eadem luce, ac crystalla circumjacentia splendescere.

unit.source: Then it began to pulse, and before she could react, it flashed brightly enough that she went blind for a second, and when she managed to blink the flashes out of her eyes, the tablet was gone, and crystals were losing their own shine.
unit.target: Tum incipiebat pulsare, et antequam reagere posset, tam fulgide micuit ut per momentum caeca esset; et cum conata esset fulgura ex oculis extinguere, tabula evanuit, et crystalla suum splendorem amittere coeperunt.

unit.source: Instead, she was greeted with another notification.
unit.target: Proinde, alia notificatio eam salutavit.

unit.source: [The Tablet of Creation found your lonely journey worth a reward!]
unit.target: [Tabula Creationis iter solitarium tuum praemio dignum invenit!]

unit.source: [The Tablet of Creation granted you the Crystal Heart skill!]
unit.target: [Tabula Creationis tibi concedit artem Cordis Crystallini!]

unit.source: [Crystal Heart: Level MAX (Passive) Your heart turned to mana crystal, and while it will operate the same way your old heart did, it will also confer you several blessings. Your base mana gain from Magic will be doubled. Your base Mana Regeneration is doubled. The base number of crystal creations you can control is doubled. Grants you the Crystal Affinity skill.]
unit.target: [Cor Crystallinum: Gradus MAX (Passivum) Cor tuum in crystallum manae conversum est, et dum eodem modo operabitur, quem modo cor vetus tuum fungebatur, nonnullas benedictiones tibi conferet. Fundamentalis acquisitio manae ex Magia duplicabitur. Regeneratio manae fundamentalis duplicata erit. Numerus fundamentalium creationum crystallorum, quos regere potes, duplicatus est. Tribuit tibi artem Affinitatis Crystallinae.]

unit.source: She stared for a long moment, and the next moment the rapidly darkening cavern was echoing with curses that would make a ship’s worth of sailors blush.
unit.target: Illa diu intuebatur, et mox spelunca, rapidissime obscurata, resonabat maledictis quae tot nautae in classe navali rubescere facerent.

unit.source: “Now I can’t even show it off on the stream! Fuck!”
unit.target: “Nunc illud in emissione quidem ostendere nequeo! Merda!”

unit.source: Dave liked money.
unit.target: Dave pecuniam amabat.

unit.source: However, he didn’t like to work.
unit.target: Attamen laborare non placebat.

unit.source: That is why he found the perfect compromise.
unit.target: Hinc optimum medium invenit.

unit.source: Crime.
unit.target: Crimen.

unit.source: But Dave also liked games, and that was how he found out about gold farming groups and their associated activities.
unit.target: Sed Dave etiam ludos amabat, et ita didicit de coetibus ad aurum colligendum et operibus eorum associatis.

unit.source: It didn’t take long for him to shift his own group into a “professional” gaming group, while those who were a little behind on their rent were asked to play a game for a while.
unit.target: Non multum temporis fuit ut suum coetum in gregem ludorum professionalium convertirentur, dum illi, qui paulum in merceda sero erant, ad ludendum aliquod tempus invitabantur.

unit.source: It was a win-win for everyone.
unit.target: Id omnibus utiliter profuit.

unit.source: He made money, didn’t have to work, and got to play video games.
unit.target: Pecuniam faciebat, laborare non oportebat, atque video ludos ludere poterat.

unit.source: And then Magic Unbound came out.
unit.target: Et deinde Magic Unbound edita est.

unit.source: It was the latest in the lines of the revolutionary VR games, and while everyone waited to see if it was actually worth the hype, Dave spotted an opportunity.
unit.target: Novissimum erat in serie ludorum VR revolutionariorum, et dum omnes exspectabant videre utrum vere praestaret, Dave opportunitatem deprehendit.

unit.source: Roleplaying games always needed thugs and bandits, and he had a decent collection of them.
unit.target: Ludi partes agendi semper scelestos et latrones requirebant, et habebat satis bonam collectionem eorum.

unit.source: And while they were away doing what they did best (or at least trying not to mess up) he could take his main group and create a proper guild that would be the face of his business.
unit.target: Et dum illi optimam operam dabat in officiis suis (aut saltem conabantur ne male agerent), poterat coetum suum principale sumere et creare societatem idoneam, quae faciem negotii eius praebebit.

unit.source: And look, he was right!
unit.target: Et ecce, recte erat!

unit.source: The game was amazing, didn’t need people to race for the highest level, and there were secrets everywhere. Which meant there was money to be made everywhere.
unit.target: Ludus mirabilis erat, neque requirebat ut homines certarent in altissimo gradu, et ubique arcana erant. Quod significabat ubique pecuniam faciendam esse.

unit.source: Then, one day, he received a message.
unit.target: Tum, uno die, nuntium accepit.

unit.source: Some of his boys were killed.
unit.target: Quidam ex pueris eius interfecti sunt.

unit.source: Dave didn’t really care, as this was a game.
unit.target: Dave re vera non curabat, nam hoc erat ludus.

unit.source: He cared more about how they were defeated.
unit.target: Ei magis curabat quomodo superati essent.

unit.source: A player with amazing skills and spells that they haven’t seen yet?
unit.target: Ludens cum praeclaris artibus et incantamentis, quae nondum viderant?

unit.source: Now that was more interesting.
unit.target: Iam id magis interest.

unit.source: He looked up from his tablet at his assistant.
unit.target: Ex tabula sua aspexit adiutorem suum.

unit.source: “Get the info from the guys, and tell our people to keep an eye for the guy. I want to know where he got the skills.”
unit.target: “Accipe informationes ab illis, et dic nostris ut vigiles sint de eo; scire volo unde artes acceperit.”

unit.source: The man standing in front of him nodded, then made some notes on his own tablet.
unit.target: Vir, qui ante eum stabat, annuit, deinde in tabula sua nonnulla notavit.

unit.source: “Should they… ask, or…” he replied leadingly.
unit.target: “Num... quaerere debeant, an…” inquit prae se ferens.

unit.source: Dave thought about it a little before answering.
unit.target: Dave paulum de hoc cogitavit, antequam respondeat.

unit.source: “Nah, we are at the beginning of the game. Just follow him and see if we can steal his quests.”
unit.target: “Non, ludus solum in initio est. Sequimini eum et videatis an possimus eius quaestiones subrumpere.”

unit.source: “Yes, sir. Do you want us to offer him money for it?”
unit.target: “Ita, domine. Visne ut illi pecuniam pro ea offeramus?”

unit.source: Dave just simply waved the man away, annoyed.
unit.target: Dave virum manu repulit, irritatus.

unit.source: “What for? It’s not like he expects us. And our boys are good.”
unit.target: “Quidnam? Non enim nos exspectat. Et pueri nostri boni sunt.”

unit.source: He thought for a second, then nodded a little. “If all else fails, we can just kill him until he gives up his secrets.”
unit.target: Paulo cogitavit, deinde leviter annuit. “Si omnia aliter deficiant, eum interficere possumus, donec secreta sua tradat.”

unit.source: The other man nodded.
unit.target: Alter vir annuit.

unit.source: “Understood, sir. I’ll make the arrangements.”
unit.target: “Intelligo, domine. Dispositiones faciam.”

unit.source: Stephen, at first, was annoyed with the guy that had that adorable wolf with his short, and basically useless description of the process of acquiring a pet, but in the end, he just shrugged and put it behind him.
unit.target: Stephen, initio, de viro, qui illum amabilem lupum cum brevi et fere inutili descriptione de pet accipiendi processu haberet, irritatus erat; sed demum humeros sublevavit et illud abiecit.

unit.source: True, he was out of a few silvers, but now he knew where to go.
unit.target: Vere, paucis argentis caret, sed nunc scivit quo ire.

unit.source: In his previous quest, he talked to one of the rangers, so he naturally knew where to find the woman.
unit.target: In quaestione praeterita, cum unum ex rangeris locutus esset, naturaliter scivit ubi eam invenire posset.

unit.source: Though it was a little annoying that if he hadn’t asked that guy for it, he wouldn’t have known to talk to the ranger to get a pet.
unit.target: Quamquam paulum molestum erat, quod nisi illum virum rogavisset, nesciret se ad ranger loquendum esse ut pet adipisceretur.

unit.source: As he walked toward his destination, he couldn’t help but talk out loud.
unit.target: Dum ad destinationem iter faciebat, non potuit non voce alta loqui.

unit.source: “Man, this game is hardcore, but such fun!”
unit.target: “Heus, hic ludus est durissimus, sed tam iucundum!”

unit.source: A random guy next to him also exclaimed.
unit.target: Aliquis ignotus iuxta eum quoque exclamavit.

unit.source: “Right?!”
unit.target: “Recte?!”

unit.source: They exchanged a high-five and Stephen continued on his travel, while the guy began to extoll the game’s good points to an unfortunate bystander.
unit.target: Manum altam inter se commutaverunt, et Stephen iter suum continuavit, dum ille vir bonus ludi rationes in infortunatum transeuntem clare enarrantem incipiebat.

unit.source: Stephen approached the small building on the outskirts of the town, opened the small gate, and stepped into the courtyard of the house, surrounded by a low stone wall.
unit.target: Stephen appropinquavit parvo aedificio in proximo extraneo oppidi, parvum portam aperuit et in atrium domus ingressus est, parvo muro lapideo circadatum.

unit.source: Inside the courtyard were several people preparing to head out, maintaining their gear, or talking to each other.
unit.target: In atrio complures erant, qui se praeparabant ad exitionem, apparatum suum conservabant, aut inter se colloquebantur.

unit.source: Stephen ignored the collection of rangers and headed directly for the severe woman standing in the corner of the courtyard, observing the activities.
unit.target: Stephen coetum rangerorum neglexit et directe accessit ad severam mulierem in angulo atrii stantem, quae actiones observabat.

unit.source: He made eye contact with the woman, and when he received a small nod, he approached her.
unit.target: Oculos cum muliere contulit, et cum parvus annuit, ad eam accessit.

unit.source: “Hail, Ranger Rose!” he called out, offering a deep bow.
unit.target: “Ave, Ranger Rose!” exclamavit, profundum inclinavit.

unit.source: “Young Stephen, well met,” came the deep and husky voice of the ranger in front of him.
unit.target: “Iuvenis Stephen, bene convenisti,” exclamavit vox profunda et rauca ranger, qui ante eum stabat.

unit.source: “How can I help you today?” she asked, then smirked a little.
unit.target: “Quomodo te hodie adiuvare possum?” inquit, deinde leviter subsurridens.

unit.source: “You need more help with differentiating weed from herbs?”
unit.target: “Plusne tibi opus est auxilio in distinguendo inter herbas spurcas et herbas útiles?”

unit.source: “Not today, Ranger Rose,” he answered, his cheeks pinking a little in embarrassment.
unit.target: “Non hodie, Ranger Rose,” respondit, cum genae eius paulum roseae fierent.

unit.source: “Then what brought you to my yard, young man?” she asked with a raised eyebrow.
unit.target: “Quid ergo te ad domum meam attulit, iuvenis?” inquit, supercilio elevato.

unit.source: Stephen almost answered with ‘milk’ but in the end, he managed to control himself.
unit.target: Stephen paene respondit ‘lac’, sed denique se continere potuit.

unit.source: ‘Curse those memes…’
unit.target: ‘Maledictis memis…’

unit.source: He cleared his throat and began talking.
unit.target: Guttur suum purgavit et coepit loqui.

unit.source: “I was wondering if you could help me acquire a pet…”
unit.target: “Mirabar utrum poteris me adiuvare ad pet adipiscendum…”

unit.source: There was a moment as the ranger stared at him, then she snorted.
unit.target: Aliquid momentum fuit, dum ranger in eum intuebatur, deinde sufflavit.

unit.source: “That’s it?”
unit.target: “Idne est?”

unit.source: “Well… yeah.”
unit.target: “Ita… ita.”

unit.source: “Alright! We are preparing to head out, come with us, and I’ll show you the ropes.”
unit.target: “Bene! Nos praeparamus ad exitionem, veni nobiscum, et tibi ostendam viam.”

unit.source: “For the traps?”
unit.target: “Ad laqueos?”

unit.source: “For the traps.”
unit.target: “Ad laqueos.”

unit.source: Stephen stared at the beast in front of him. Taking it in as its eyes glinted intelligently back at him.
unit.target: Stephen bestiam, quae ante eum stabat, intueri coepit, dum oculi eius callide ad eum micabant.

unit.source: He observed as its fur rose and fell as the creature breathed.
unit.target: Animadvertit quomodo pellis eius surgere et cadere videbatur, dum creatura respirabat.

unit.source: He slowly reached out with a hand, and began to stroke the creature’s very soft and delicate fur, wondering at its dark gray color.
unit.target: Lente manum extendit et coepit mollissimam atque teneram creaturae pellem palpare, mirans de colore eius obscuro cinereo.

unit.source: As he continued to caress the beast, he took in the horn, as the tip of it looked sharp enough to get through his armor.
unit.target: Dum bestiam palpabat, cornu eius attendit, cuius apicem acutum esse videbatur, satis ut armaturam suam perforet.

unit.source: Fortunately, or unfortunately, depending on who you asked, the beast had no claws.
unit.target: Fortunate, vel infortunatim, secundum interrogationem, bestia ungues non habebat.

unit.source: Just as Stephen was about to talk to the creature when he heard a twig break behind.
unit.target: Ita ut Stephen ad loquendum cum creatura se coniungeret, frutex post eum rumpi audivit.

unit.source: Knowing who he was with, he was pretty sure that the noise was deliberate.
unit.target: Quod scivit cum quo esset, satis certus erat sonum esse deliberatum.

unit.source: The creature in front of him froze at the sight, and he simply turned around, his hand continuing to caress the soft fur.
unit.target: Creatura, quae ante eum stabat, aspectu immobilis facta est, et ille simpliciter vertit, dum manus eius mollissimam pellem palpare pergebat.

unit.source: “Yes, Ranger Rose?”
unit.target: “Ita, Ranger Rose?”

unit.source: The woman gave him and the creature behind him a long look, then looked back at him.
unit.target: Mulier ei ac creaturae, quae post eum stabat, longum conspectum dedit, deinde ad eum respexit.

unit.source: “Is this your final choice, Stephen?”
unit.target: “Estne haec electio ultima tua, Stephen?”

unit.source: “Yes,” he answered without thinking. The moment he spotted the beast, he knew it was meant to be.
unit.target: “Ita,” respondit sine cogitatione. Statim bestiam conspexit, intellexit id fatum esse.

unit.source: “All right, in the end, it is your decision. But I must warn you, your path will not be an easy one.”
unit.target: “Bene, demum, electio tua est. Sed te monere debeo: via tua non facile erit.”

unit.source: Stephen just nodded.
unit.target: Stephen iterum annuit.

unit.source: “I’ll make do.”
unit.target: “Me accommodabo.”

unit.source: The ranger gave him another long, measuring look, then nodded.
unit.target: Ranger illi alium longum aspectum examinans dedit, deinde annuit.

unit.source: “Very well. Then this is what you need to do…”
unit.target: “Optime. Ergo hoc est quod tibi faciendum est…”

unit.source: Stephen walked back into the town of Greenwood with a pep in his steps, pride in his heart. And the most adorable and fluffy bunny in his arms.
unit.target: Stephen in oppidum Greenwood rediit, cum vigore in passibus suis et superbia in corde; ac cuniculus amabilissimus et lanuginosus in bracchiis suis.

unit.source: Slathor the Younger, Destroyer of Worlds, Ending of Universes, or for short, Slathy was a big, fluffy horned rabbit, common around Greenwood.
unit.target: Slathor Iunior, Mundi Exterminator, Universorum Finitor, sive breviter Slathy, erat magnus, lanuginosus, corniger cuniculus, qui communis erat circa Greenwood.

unit.source: And the reason Stephen chose him, and not a wolf as he originally planned, was because the little bunny was able to evade all of his traps when he went out to gather food for dinner, under the orders of the head ranger.
unit.target: Causa cur Stephen eum elegit, et non lupum, ut initio destinaverat, erat quod parvus cuniculus omnes laqueos eius evadere poterat, cum pro cena cibum colligere iret sub praeceptis capitis rangeris.

unit.source: The bunny was too intelligent for wildlife.
unit.target: Cuniculus nimis callidus erat ad animalia silvestria.

unit.source: And as he approached his friends, who upon seeing Slathy, immediately gathered around him (including several girls, which included his crush) and began to pet and coo at the bunny, as he sat in his arms imperiously looking at the surrounding people, just as an emperor would look at their subjects.
unit.target: Et cum ad amicos suos accessit, qui Slathy viso statim circa eum congregati sunt (inter quos varias puellas, inter quas etiam eius cupiditas), et coepere cuniculum amplecti atque suave affari incipiebant, dum ille in brachiis suis imperiose sedebat et circumstantibus spectabat quasi imperator subditos suos.

unit.source: ‘I really need to thank that guy…’ Stephen thought, then with a smile turned to Julia and began to tell the slightly embellished tale about how he acquired his adorable rabbit.
unit.target: “Vere illi viro gratias agere mihi oportet…” cogitavit Stephen, deinde cum risu ad Juliam se convertit et parvam fabulam paulo ampliatam narrandi initiavit de eo, quomodo cuniculum amabilem adipiscitus esset.

unit.source: The first thing he did, after a rather exhausting negotiation with the woman running the show at the Cloudy Day inn, that he suspected was something more, he walked up to the second story, where his room would be for the foreseeable future (he rented for a month), inserted the key and opened the door.
unit.target: Prima res quam fecit, post negotium satis fatigans cum muliere gubernante spectaculum in hospitio Cloudy Day, quod suspicabatur aliquid amplius esse, ascendit ad secundum tabulatum, ubi cubiculum eius in futurum prospicuum (locavit per mensem) erit, clavem inseruit et ostium aperuit.

unit.source: The moment he was fully in the room, alone, and the door locked behind him, Lucky, in his shadow, jumped up, almost high enough to reach the ceiling, then landed right next to him with an unnaturally quiet thud.
unit.target: Cum plene in conclavio esset, solus, atque ostium post eum clauditum erit, Lucky, in umbra sua, saluit, prope tam alte ut tecta attingere posset, deinde iuxta eum cecidit cum silentio innaturali.
