unit.source: The now black wolf looked up at him, with an appropriately wolfish smile, then began to sniff around the room.
unit.target: Lupus iam niger eum aspexit cum risu lupino congruo et deinde per conclavium olfactare coepit.

unit.source: Curious about his future accommodations, Sam followed after his companion, while trying to parse the bursts of feelings coming from him.
unit.target: Curiosus de futuris habitationibus suis, Sam comitem secutus est dum conabatur impulsum affectuum ex eo perscrutari.

unit.source: Currently, it was mainly happiness (though he could tell that by looking at Lucky’s tail), curiosity and a little hunger.
unit.target: Praesente maximum ex laetitia (quae ex cauda Lucky perspiciebatur), curiositate, et parva famis imperabant.

unit.source: At least, that was how he interpreted the feelings.
unit.target: Saltem ita affectus interpretavit.

unit.source: It was all sorts of new feelings and experiences, and while they were incredibly confusing, Sam loved every minute of it.
unit.target: Erat omnis varietas novarum affectuum et experientiarum, et quamquam valde perplexa erant, Sam omnem momentum id amabat.

unit.source: It wasn’t a fantasy isekai, but with the technology used to create Magic Unbound, it might as well have been.
unit.target: Non erat isekai phantasia, sed cum technologia ad Magic Unbound creanda adhibita, fere idem esse poterat.

unit.source: The room he rented wasn’t anything special, though, while Andrea called it a room, it was actually a main room with a bed, dresser, and a table next to a small shelf, it had a small bathroom, and another small room that was, based on the shelves and boxes, used for storage.
unit.target: Cubiculum quod locavit nihil praeclarum erat; licet Andrea id cubiculum appellaverit, re vera erat camera principalis cum lecto, armario, atque mensa iuxta parvam scapulam, et habebat parvum lavatorium ac aliam cameram ad reponendas res, secundum scapulas et cistas destinatam.

unit.source: All in all, it wasn’t the highest quality, but it was secure, and based on what he got from Andrea’s personality, it was pretty safe.
unit.target: In summa, non erat summae qualitatis; sed tuta erat, et ex ingenio Andreae recepto, satis secure videbatur.

unit.source: Nodding happily, Sam fed Lucky with the usual meat scraps and a little vegetable added to it for the wolf’s health, then took off his dirty armor, and cleaned it with his Clean spell, though he made a note to take it to an armorer as the Clean spell did not repair it.
unit.target: Subridens laetus, Sam Lucky pascuit cum solitis reliquiis carnium et paulo oleris ad salutem lupi addito; deinde loricam sordidam deponens, eam incantatione “Mundatio” purgavit, notam tamen fecit ut eam ad fabrum armorum perduceret, quoniam incantatio “Mundatio” eam reparare non poterat.

unit.source: ‘Or I could go for the Repair spell…’ he thought, then he shook his head.
unit.target: «Vel incantationem Reparandi adhibere possem…» cogitavit, deinde caput concussit.

unit.source: “Nah, too much trouble for now.”
unit.target: «Non, id nimis laboriosum nunc est.»

unit.source: Lucky looked up from his meal hearing Sam speak, but he just smiled back.
unit.target: Lucky ex suo prandio intuitus Sam loquente audivit, sed solum risum reddidit.

unit.source: “Go on, finish it.”
unit.target: «Age, confice.»

unit.source: Lucky barked quietly, then returned to messily munch on the hog meat.
unit.target: Lucky quiete latravit, deinde rediit ad incondite edendum carnem porci.

unit.source: When Lucky was finished, Sam took out a few clothes that would suffice for sleeping and got into the bed, Lucky following him, settling down at his foot, forming a giant ball of fluffy darkness.
unit.target: Cum Lucky finem faceret, Sam pauca indumenta, quae ad dormiendum satis erant, extraxit et in lectum se recubavit; Lucky eum secutus, ad pedem eius consedit, globum ingentem ex lanugine obscuro formans.

unit.source: The last thing Sam saw as he logged out was Lucky yawning and settling in for the night.
unit.target: Ultimum quod Sam vidit cum discessit, erat Lucky, os aperiens et ad noctem se colligans.

unit.source: Removing the VR helmet, Sam laid there for a minute, as his body and mind adjusted and chased away the phantom sensation of the Mana Exhaustion debuff.
unit.target: Helmetum VR removens, Sam ibi per momentum iacebat, dum corpus et mens eius se accommodabant atque impressionem phantasmaticam “Mana Exhaustion” fugabant.

unit.source: He shuddered a little as the bone‐deep exhaustion left his body, leaving behind normal exhaustion.
unit.target: Paululum trepidavit, quoniam exhaustio profunda ossium corpus eius reliquit, relinquens exhaustionem ordinariam.

unit.source: Realizing that he had been playing for a while, Sam put the helmet onto its stand, then stood up and stretched a little and looked around the room.
unit.target: Intellexit se aliquod tempus ludisse, ergo Sam galeam in supportu reponit, deinde surrexit, modicum se extendens atque circa conclavium spectavit.

unit.source: “Right! I need a little break…” he spoke out loud, still stretching a little.
unit.target: «Recte! Parvum requiem mihi opus est…» inquit, adhuc paulum se extendens.

unit.source: Then headed for the shower.
unit.target: Deinde ad lavacrum se contulit.

unit.source: After taking a long, hot shower, he dressed up in warm clothing and left the apartment.
unit.target: Post longum et calidum lavacrum, se indutus vestimentis calidis, de habitatione discessit.

unit.source: On the way out of the building, he once again ran into the bundled-up neighbor, nodding at them, and receiving the same back.
unit.target: Per exitum ex aedificio, iterum vicinum involutum convenit, annuens illi, eandemque reciprocationem accipiens.

unit.source: Leaving the complex, Sam looked up at the sky, where for a change it wasn’t snowing, and spring was peeking through the gray clouds.
unit.target: Relinquens complexum, Sam in caelum aspexit; ubi non nivebat, et ver per nubila cinerea eminere videbatur.

unit.source: Looking around, he searched for inspiration for something to do.
unit.target: Circumspiciens, inspirationem quaerendam ad aliquid faciendum quaesivit.

unit.source: Not finding anything that sparked an idea, he was almost ready to turn back when his stomach growled.
unit.target: Nulla idea excitata reperiens, paene redire paratus erat, cum venter eius rugire coepit.

unit.source: “Food it is!”
unit.target: «Cibus est!»

unit.source: Returning to the game, after a little break in the real world, where he ate some good noodles, exercised a little, checked up on his investments and other administrative matters, and made sure that everything was heading in the same direction with the game, he woke up with Lucky snuggled up to him.
unit.target: Ad ludum rediens, post parvum intervallum in mundo reali, ubi bona lagana edebat, paulum exercitatus, negotia sua et cetera administranda curabat atque certus erat omnia in eundem ordinem in ludo ire, expergisci invenit se cum Lucky ad se composito.

unit.source: Chuckling slightly, he extricated himself from the wolf, and out of curiosity, took a shower.
unit.target: Paululum subridens, Sam se a lupo eripuit, et ex curiositate, lavacrum cepit.

unit.source: While a simple Clean spell would have been enough, Sam still wanted to know how it felt to shower in the game.
unit.target: Quamquam incantatio “Mundatio” simplicis sufficeret, Sam tamen scire volebat qualiter esset lavari in ludo.

unit.source: The water was at best lukewarm, but the feeling was the same as if in the real world.
unit.target: Aqua ad optimum casu mediocriter tepida erat, sed effectus idem videbatur quasi in mundo reali.

unit.source: After dressing up and coaxing Lucky back into his shadow, he left the room for the eating hall of the inn.
unit.target: Postquam se indutus erat et Lucky in umbram suam redidit, conclavium reliquit et ad triclinum hospitii properavit.

unit.source: Getting a meal, he sat down along the wall, observing as people around him ate, chatted and consumed their own breakfast.
unit.target: Cibum accipiens, iuxta parietem consedit, homines circa se edentes, colloquentes et suum ientaculum consumentes observans.

unit.source: Similar, to how back in Greenwood he could barely see any players at the inn, the clientele of the Cloudy Day inn was mostly made of NPCs with a few scruffy‐looking players munching on the cheapest breakfast option and staring at nothing (their status screens).
unit.target: Sicut in Greenwood vix ullos lusores in hospitio videre poterat, clientela hospitii Cloudy Day plerumque ex NPC constituta erat, cum paucis lusoribus rudibus aspectu optione ientaculi vilissimae comedentes et ad nihilum spectantes (tabulis statuum eorum).

unit.source: The ‘hidden’ satiety system was already known to the players and the community, but at this point, everybody thought that spending the least amount of money was enough.
unit.target: Systema satietatis “absconditum” iam lusoribus et communitati notum erat, sed hoc tempore omnes existimabant ut minima pecunia expensa satis esset.

unit.source: So the order of the day for most people was water, maybe some tea, and hardtack.
unit.target: Ergo ordo diei plurimorum erat: aqua, fortasse aliquantum theae, et panis durus.

unit.source: Maybe a few people who had access to fresh meat would use it to make jerky.
unit.target: Forsitan pauci, qui carnem recentem habebant, eam ad carnes siccas faciendas uterentur.

unit.source: Sam wished them the best.
unit.target: Sam illis optima desideravit.

unit.source: Magic Unbound gave only the most basic information to the players, forcing them to discover the details on their own.
unit.target: Magic Unbound solum informationem rudimentariam lusoribus dabat, eos cogens ut singula ipsa detegerent.

unit.source: That was why the status screen and skill descriptions were so vague.
unit.target: Ideo tabula status et descriptiones artium ita vagae erant.

unit.source: After all, while a person knew their body, not everybody was a doctor.
unit.target: Postremo, quamquam quis suum corpus sciat, non omnes medici erant.

unit.source: Conversely, if somebody would get training as a healer in Magic Unbound, they would get more information about their body from the status screen thanks to their skills.
unit.target: Contra, si quis in Magic Unbound artis medicae institutionem caperet, ex tabula status de corpore suo plura per suis artibus acciperet.

unit.source: As of now, it wasn’t in the focus, but later, getting information‐providing skills were considered one of the most important things.
unit.target: Ad hunc tempus, non in conspectu erat, sed postea artes informationem praebentes inter res maximi momenti existimabantur.

unit.source: People lived and died by the information they gathered.
unit.target: Homines vivebant et moriebantur ex informationibus collectis.

unit.source: That was why the other Sam was killed.
unit.target: Ideo alter Sam interfectus est.

unit.source: He was good at collecting, collating and extrapolating from data.
unit.target: Bonus erat in colligendo, ordinando et ex data extrapolando.

unit.source: Plus, access to a few niche skills, and he got a recipe for a disaster.
unit.target: Praeterea, accessu ad nonnullas artes speciales, ac consilium pro calamitate obtinuit.

unit.source: The only reason Sam didn’t go after those types of skills, was because at this level he practically knew everything that he needed.
unit.target: Singulari ratione, Sam illas artes non secutus est, quia in hoc gradu fere omnia necessaria sciebat.

unit.source: Later, of course, he would need to get those skills, but for now, he could navigate the world of Magic Unbound quite easily.
unit.target: Postea, scilicet, illas artes adipisci debebit, sed nunc mundum Magic Unbound satis facile peragrabat.

unit.source: And with his debuff in play, what better time than now?
unit.target: Et cum debuff in ludo viguerit, quid melius quam nunc esset?

unit.source: Finishing his meal, he returned his plates to the counter, thanked the serving girl, and getting a sparkling smile back, he left the inn and with slow, but deliberate steps, practicing his footwork and breathing.
unit.target: Cibum consummans, catinos ad mensam reddens, puellam ministram gratias egit, et nitidum risum recipiens, hospitium reliquit, ambulans lente sed deliberata, pedum motus atque respirantiam exercens.

unit.source: First, he headed for the armorer, leaving behind his gold and armor after a short conversation, then still leisurely walking, took a quick circuit of the market and general shops, refilling his inventory with general items, while also keeping his eye open for anything worth buying.
unit.target: Primum ad fabrum armorum se contulit, post brevem sermonem aurum et loricam reliquit; deinde, ambulans leniter, per forum et negotia generalia celerem circuitum fecit, inventarium suum rebus communibus replevit, dum oculos ad ea, quae emere digna videbantur, intendit.

unit.source: He threw a few longing glances at the Auction House, but in the end, he turned away and headed for his ultimate destination for the day, the library.
unit.target: Aliquot desideriosis aspectibus domum auctionum intuentem iecit, sed tandem se avertit et ad ultimam destinationem diei, bibliothecam, profectus est.

unit.source: Sam read enough web novels to remember that most main characters started their rebirth by monopolizing several materials and making bank when those materials inevitably become the hot topic items.
unit.target: Sam satis fabulas interretiales legens meminit plerosque characteres principales renasci incipere per complures materias monopolizandas atque pecuniam faciendam, cum illae materias inevitabiliter in res maximas convertissent.

unit.source: Sadly, maybe he could get away with one item, maybe if he was careful.
unit.target: Heu, fortasse una re satis esset, si cautus esset.

unit.source: But the moment he started to hoard items that he had no way to know would become important, the system would strike him down.
unit.target: Sed cum coepit res congregare, quarum momentum futurum ignotum erat, ratio eum deiciebat.

unit.source: Frustratingly, he would need to play the game properly.
unit.target: Frustranter, necesse erat eum ludem recte.

unit.source: The library in Ironwood was naturally bigger, and better equipped than the one in Greenwood.
unit.target: Bibliotheca in Ironwood naturaliter maior et melius instructa erat quam illa in Greenwood.

unit.source: The building itself was built in the same style as the town, though Sam could see a few repairs there were made recently.
unit.target: Aedificium ipsum eodem stilo ac oppido constructum erat, quamquam Sam nonnullas nuper factas reparationes videre poterat.

unit.source: Stepping into the library, the first thing he spotted was an elderly woman, more than likely one of the librarians, struggling with a cart, heavy with enough books that a small library wouldn’t have enough space to fit them.
unit.target: Ingrediens in bibliothecam, primum quod deprehendit erat senilis femina, verisimiliter bibliothecaria, quae cum plaustra laborabat, onerata libris satis abundantes ut parva bibliotheca eos condere non posset.

unit.source: Smiling slightly, Sam stepped close and called out to the woman.
unit.target: Subridens modice, Sam propius accessit et feminam vocavit.

unit.source: “Excuse me, miss. Do you need some help?”
unit.target: «Ignosce mihi, domina. Auxilium tibi opus est?»

unit.source: The woman jumped a little, but then turned to him, gave him a once over, then smiled back at him.
unit.target: Mulier paululum subsiluit, deinde ad eum se vertit, eum brevem intuens habens, atque deinde ei risum reddidit.

unit.source: “Ah, young man. Please be careful, my old ticker can’t take much stress!”
unit.target: «Ah, iuvenis. Quaeso, cave; cor senile meum non multa ferre potest!»

unit.source: Sam bowed his head.
unit.target: Sam caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “My apologies!”
unit.target: «Mea culpa!»

unit.source: The librarian simply waved it away.
unit.target: Bibliothecaria id manu leviter abiecit.

unit.source: “No worries, no worries! Now, you mentioned some help?”
unit.target: «Nihil curandum, nihil curandum! Nunc, dixistine te auxilium petere?»

unit.source: “Yes, ma’am.”
unit.target: «Ita, domina.»

unit.source: “Then I would respectfully accept it, young man. My body is not as it used to be, and my helpers are off today, and some inconsiderate out-of-towner left all these books here for me to return. Would you be so kind and help an old woman out?”
unit.target: «Tum, iuvenis, id ex reverentia accipiam. Corpus meum non iam est ut olim fuit, adiutoresque mei hodie defuerunt, et aliquis inconsideratus peregrinus haec omnia libros mihi reliquit ut redigerentur. Vellesne tam benigne senili muliere auxilium ferre?»

unit.source: Sam simply nodded, took another step and grabbed the handle of the cart, while thanking the nameless (and careless) player who gave him this opportunity.
unit.target: Sam simpliciter annuit, aliam passum fecit et manubrium plaustri arripuit, dum gratias agebat ignoto (et incurante) luseri qui ei hanc occasionem dedit.

unit.source: “Of course, you lead and I follow.”
unit.target: «Certe, tu ducis, et ego sequor.»

unit.source: The old librarian chuckled, then turned on the dime, showing much more spryness than was natural, then began walking forward while Sam followed after her.
unit.target: Bibliothecaria senilis subridens, deinde subito se vertens, agilitatem supernatam ostendens, incipiebat ambulare, cum Sam eam sequebatur.

unit.source: “Onward to face our adventure, young man!”
unit.target: «Adventuram nostram pergamus, iuvenis!»

unit.source: Sam continued to push the cart laden with books forward, straining ever so slightly thanks to his debuff, while taking a quick look at his new notification window.
unit.target: Sam plaustrum libris oneratum porgere continuavit, paulum laborans ob debuff, dum celeriter in novam fenestram notificationum intuebatur.

unit.source: [New quest acquired!]
unit.target: [Nova quaestio adepta!]

unit.source: [Toil, toil, toil!]
unit.target: [Labor, labor, labor!]

unit.source: [The elderly librarian of Ironwood (you should really learn her name) is in need of help after some inconsiderate and uneducated fool disrespected the books. Help her clean up her domain.]
unit.target: [Bibliothecaria senilis Ironwoodensis (nomen eius vere discendum est) auxilio egit, postquam aliquis inconsideratus et imperitus stultus libros contempsit. Adiuva eam ut dominionem suam purget.]

unit.source: [Time limit: -]
unit.target: [Terminus temporis: -]

unit.source: [Penalty: She will be disappointed in you.]
unit.target: [Poena: Illa in te delusa erit.]

unit.source: [Reward: The knowledge that you did a good deed. Maybe a cookie.]
unit.target: [Praemium: Scientia quod bonum facinus egisti. Forsitan crustulum.]

unit.source: It only took a few hours following the librarian around, whose name was Martha, to put the books back in their rightful place, help clean up the reception desk after one of her helpers left it covered with crumbs and drinks, and bring out a few new books, sort some paperwork, and fetch lunch for them from a nearby eatery that the library had a deal with.
unit.target: Nomen horarum paucarum suffecerunt, sequendo bibliothecariam, cuius nomen Martha erat, ut libros in locum suum restitueret, mensam receptionis purgaret postquam unus ex adiutoribus ejus eam craterum et potionum operto reliquerat, atque paucos libros novos afferret, chartas ordinaret, et prandium ex popina proxima, cum qua bibliotheca foedus haberet, adduceret.

unit.source: But in the end, Sam completed the quest and even got a cookie.
unit.target: Sed in fine, Sam quaestionem perfecit et etiam crustulum obtinuit.

unit.source: It was a pretty good cookie.
unit.target: Crustulum satis bonum erat.

unit.source: Librarian Martha was rather thankful, and after they were finished, left him alone with a few books to learn from.
unit.target: Bibliothecaria Martha valde grata erat, et postquam opera perfecta sunt, eum solum reliquit cum paucis libris ad discendum.

unit.source: Throwing a glance at the elderly librarian as she hummed an unfamiliar song while dusting some shelves, Sam chuckled a little and turned his attention towards the book in his hand.
unit.target: Aspectum iecit ad bibliothecariam senilem, quae carmen ignotum submurmurabat dum scapulas pulverem depurabat, Sam paululum subridens et attentionem suam ad librum in manu convertit.

unit.source: Learning new languages couldn’t happen without any effort after all…
unit.target: Novas linguas discere postremo sine labore fieri non potest…

unit.source: “What are you doing, young Sam?”
unit.target: «Quid agis, iuvenis Sam?»

unit.source: Sam looked up from his notes, a little frustrated, and eyed the librarian standing above him as she stared at him with an inquisitive look.
unit.target: Sam ex notis suis intuitus, paulum perturbatus, et bibliothecariam, quae super eum stabat, vultu inquisitivo aspiciens.

unit.source: “Trying to make sense of these runes… But I think I’m missing something!” he complained.
unit.target: «Conor has runas intellegere… Sed mihi videtur me aliquid deesse!» queritur.

unit.source: And for once, his complaint was genuine.
unit.target: Et pro una vice, querela eius vera erat.

unit.source: Runes were never something that the other Sam made use of, or researched.
unit.target: Runae numquam erant res quibus alter Sam usus aut indagaverit.

unit.source: They were too time-consuming and hard to learn.
unit.target: Erant nimis temporis sumptoriae et discendi difíciles.

unit.source: Especially for somebody who didn’t have the resources of a guild at their beck and call.
unit.target: Praesertim pro aliquo, cui opes collegii ad promptum non essent.

unit.source: But his gaming senses, enhanced by the fact he got isekaid told him that it was a useful thing to learn.
unit.target: Sed sensus ludendi eius, augetus ab facto isekaid, eum certiorem fecerunt rem discendam esse utilem.

unit.source: But without his cheat, it was rather hard, thus his frustration.
unit.target: Sed sine dolo suo, difficillimum erat, ita frustratus est.

unit.source: The woman reached out and took a quick look at his notes, which were full of the runes he had learned and a few other basic ones that he copied from the books during the last few days while he waited for his debuff to disappear.
unit.target: Mulier manum protendit et celeriter in notis eius intuebatur, quae erant plenae runarum didictarum et paucarum aliarum fundamentalium, quas ex libris per proximos dies, dum debuff eius evanescere exspectabat, collegit.

unit.source: He tried to put together a few rune schemes, but apparently, he was missing something because none of them worked, and none of the books in the library contained any working rune schemes.
unit.target: Conatus est pauca consilia runarum componere, sed videbatur aliquid deesse, quia nulla ex his operabantur, nec ulli libri in bibliotheca consilia runarum operantia continere videbantur.

unit.source: Even replicating the one he saw at the bandit’s hideout refused to work.
unit.target: Etiam replicare illum quem in latibulo latronum vidit, non operabatur.

unit.source: “Hmmm… A conundrum indeed,” murmured the woman, then turned towards him, placing his notes back on the table.
unit.target: «Hmmm… Revera aenigma est,» murmuravit mulier, deinde ad eum se vertens, notas eius in mensa reponens.

unit.source: “Your runes are excellent, but you’re missing something important.”
unit.target: «Runae tuae sunt excellentes, sed aliquid momenti tibi deest.»

unit.source: “I know! But none of the books says what!” he exclaimed, grabbing his hair.
unit.target: «Scio! Sed nihil librorum indicat quid deesset!» exclamavit, capillos suos arripiens.

unit.source: “And none of them will,” came the calm reply from the librarian.
unit.target: «Et nullum eorum indicabit,» respondit bibliothecaria tranquille.

unit.source: Sam practically froze, hand still in his hair.
unit.target: Sam fere stetit immobilis, cum manus adhuc in capillis eius maneret.

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: «Quid?»

unit.source: “Indeed. Working rune schemes are extremely valuable. Nobody would share them. Not at this kind of library,” explained the woman, aiming a disapproving glare at nothing.
unit.target: «Revera, consilia runarum operantia sunt valde pretiosa. Nemo ea communicaret; neque in tali bibliotheca,» explicavit mulier, oculos in nihilum reprobanter.

unit.source: “Creating one requires effort beyond the capabilities of most people.”
unit.target: «Unum creandi requirit laborem superans facultates plurimorum hominum.»

unit.source: “Huh…” Sam slowly lowered his hand, then looked back at Martha thoughtfully.
unit.target: «Heu…» Sam leniter manum deiecit, deinde Martha, cogitatione afflata, respexit.

unit.source: “That actually makes sense. Do you know what is actually missing, ma’am?”
unit.target: «Hoc vere sensum facit. Scisne quid deest, domina?»

unit.source: She gave him a long look, then nodded.
unit.target: Illa eum diuturno aspectu contemplata, deinde annuit.

unit.source: “Indeed, I know.”
unit.target: «Revera, scio.»

unit.source: “Would you be willing to share it?”
unit.target: «Visne id communicare?»

unit.source: There was a small silence, and then the librarian chuckled.
unit.target: Parvum silentium fuit, et deinde bibliothecaria subridens risit.

unit.source: “I like this about you, young Sam. You don’t demand, like those fools. You ask.”
unit.target: «Hoc de te mihi placet, iuvenis Sam. Non exiges ut illi stulti; petis.»

unit.source: Sam didn’t even have to ask.
unit.target: Sam non etiam rogare oportuit.

unit.source: Over the days he was banging his head against the wall that was the study of runes, he witnessed several times as players of all types came in and treated the librarian as one would treat an NPC in other games.
unit.target: Per dies, dum in studiis runarum se affligebat, pluries vidit lusores omnium generum intrantes et bibliothecariam, ut NPC in aliis ludis, tractatam.

unit.source: No courtesy, no respect.
unit.target: Nulla comitas, nulla reverentia.

unit.source: Most left without getting anything for their trouble.
unit.target: Plerique discesserunt sine praemio pro laboribus suis.

unit.source: The rest were thrown out after the librarian called the guards.
unit.target: Reliqui expulsi sunt postquam bibliothecaria custodes convocavit.

unit.source: The local forums back in the real world declared the library and the librarian a forbidden area, ‘impossible’ to enter.
unit.target: Fori locali in mundo reali bibliothecam et bibliothecariam declaraverunt regionem vetitam, “impossibilis” ad ingressum.

unit.source: Before Sam could say something, Martha stepped forward, pulled out a chair next to him, took a seat and pulled a clean paper towards her while picking up a pen.
unit.target: Antequam Sam quid diceret, Martha processit, sellam iuxta eum extraxit, sedebat atque chartam nitidam ad se traxit, dum calamus arripiebat.

unit.source: “What you need is an anchor rune, or as they call it, a Heart Rune, which is unique for everybody. Without it, you can’t connect a scheme to yourself, and can’t control it,” she explained while starting to sketch out something on the paper.
unit.target: «Quod tibi opus est, est runa ancora, sive ut appellant, runa Cordis, quae unicua omnibus est; sine ea consilium tibi coniungere non potes, nec id regere valeas,» explicavit dum aliquid in charta delineare coepit.

unit.source: “Pay attention, because I won’t explain it again.”
unit.target: «Attende, quia iterum non id explicabo.»

unit.source: Over the next several days, when the old librarian had time she gave him a few lessons on runes, while Sam toiled and tried to create his own Heart Rune.
unit.target: Per proximos dies, cum bibliothecaria senilis tempus haberet, ei pauca praecepta de runis dedit, dum Sam laborabat et suam runam Cordis creare conabatur.

unit.source: He needed to review hundreds of runes, sketch them out, and see which one ‘resonated’ with his own magic.
unit.target: Debebat centenas runas recensere, delineare, et videre quae cum sua magica ratione resonaret.

unit.source: Then he had to take those runes and merge them into one all-encompassing rune that was more than the parts it was created from.
unit.target: Deinde debebat has runas sumere et in unam universam runam coniungere, quae plus esset quam summa partium ex quibus creata erat.

unit.source: In the end, he found seven simple runes, and after some sweat and tears, he managed to put together an equally simple Heart Rune.
unit.target: In fine, septem runas simplices invenit, et post sudorem et lacrimas, composuit aequaliter simplicem runam Cordis.

unit.source: Staring at the symbol on the paper, while Martha stood behind him, he felt elation.
unit.target: Intuens symbolum in charta, dum Martha post eum stabat, gaudium sensit.

unit.source: He was finished.
unit.target: Finitus est.

unit.source: Then, as he was about to ask his newest teacher about the next step, the rune began to glow lightly, pulsing with a rhythm, that after a second Sam realized was the same as his heartbeat.
unit.target: Deinde, cum novissimae magistrae de proximo gradu rogare pararet, runa leve fulgere coepit, cum rhythmo pulsante, quod paulo post Sam intellexit id eundem esse ac ictum cordis sui.

unit.source: It flashed strong enough to cause spots to appear in his eyes, and the rune went inert.
unit.target: Illuminavit satis fortiter ut maculae in oculis eius apparerent, et runa inertem facta est.

unit.source: Instead, he was blinded by a few notification windows.
unit.target: Proinde, a paucis fenestris notificationum caecatus est.

unit.source: He ignored them for a moment and turned toward his teacher.
unit.target: Eos per momentum neglexit et ad magistram se convertit.

unit.source: “That was supposed to happen, right?”
unit.target: «Id evenire debebat, nonne?»

unit.source: “Indeed, young man. And might I say congratulations. You just became a Journeyman Runecarver.”
unit.target: «Revera, iuvenis. Et licet dico: gratulor! Nunc factus es Peritus Runarum Sculpens.»

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: «Quid?»

unit.source: “An apprentice can carve runes for the master to power, while the journeyman has their own Heart Rune constructed. A master can create and undo rune schemes whenever they want.”
unit.target: «Discipulus runas pro magistro sculpere potest ad vim, dum peritus suam runam Cordis fabricat; magister autem consilia runarum quotiens vult creare et dissolvere potest.»

unit.source: “That’s…”
unit.target: «Id est…»

unit.source: “Amazing indeed.” The woman smiled and reached into the pocket of her robe, retrieved a small scroll and placed it on the table.
unit.target: «Revera mirabile est.» Mulier subridens in sinum vestis suae extendit, parvum volumem extraxit et in mensa collocavit.

unit.source: “You impressed me with your dedication, young Sam. This is my own small reward for a task well done.”
unit.target: «Dedicatione tua me delectavisti, iuvenis Sam. Hoc est meum parvum praemium pro opere bene perfecto.»

unit.source: With that, she gave him a small pat on his head, then turned around and left, leaving Sam alone with his thoughts and flashing notifications.
unit.target: Hoc facto, illa eum leviter in capite demulcavit, deinde se vertit et discessit, relinquens Sam solum cum cogitationibus suis et notificationibus micantibus.

unit.source: [Congratulations! Thanks to the teachings of the Librarian Martha, you became a Journeyman Runecarver!]
unit.target: [Gratulatio! Ob praecepta Bibliothecariae Marthae, factus es Peritus Runarum Sculpens!]

unit.source: [Journeyman Runecarver: Level 0/50 (0%) You have constructed your Heart Rune, and are capable of carving and drawing runes without an error. The cost of activating Rune schemes cost is reduced by 25%. Increased chance of recognizing hidden runes and rune schemes.]
unit.target: [Peritus Runarum Sculpens: Gradus 0/50 (0%) Runam Cordis tuam condidisti et sine errore runas sculpere atque delineare potes. Sumptus activandi consilia runarum 25% diminutus est. Aucta est etiam probabilitas runas absconditas et consilia runarum agnoscendi.]

unit.source: [Thanks to you skipping over being an Apprentice Runecarver due to your hard work, and luck, you receive +1 LUK and +1 PER!]
unit.target: [Propter laborem arduum tuum et fortunam, gradum Apprendicis Runarum Sculpens praeteriens, accipis +1 LUK et +1 PER!]

unit.source: [You learned the following Rune Schemes: Silencing Ward, Ritual of Evolution, Basic Shielding Scheme…]
unit.target: [Sequentes consilia runarum didicisti: Custodia Silentii, Ritus Evolutionis, Consilium Scuti Basicum…]

unit.source: Closing the list of schemes that he had apparently managed to put together while he studied, he picked up the small scroll and unfurled it.
unit.target: Clauso indice consiliorum, quos apparenter in studiis suis componere poterat, parvum volumem arripuit et disvolvit.

unit.source: Upon it was a small skill, and the moment he began reading the scroll flashed, and burst into an ethereal fire that burned up the scroll, leaving him holding nothing, and once again blinking spots out of his eyes.
unit.target: In eo parva ars erat, et cum volumen legere coepit, subito fulguit atque in ignem aetherium evoluta est, quae volumen combussit, relinquens eum nihil tenentem et iterum oculis maculas provocans.

unit.source: [Congratulation! You were given a gift from Librarian Martha!]
unit.target: [Gratulatio! Donum a Bibliothecaria Martha tibi datum est!]

unit.source: [You learned the skill, Grimoire!]
unit.target: [Artem didicisti, Grimoire!]

unit.source: [Grimoire: Level MAX (MAX%) Allows you to summon your own ethereal Grimoire, which automatically records the spells, runes, rune schemes and recipes you have learned. Can summon a simple ethereal pen that allows you to record your thoughts as well in the book. Every spell, rune, rune scheme and recipe costs 10% less mana to cast and use.]
unit.target: [Grimoire: Gradus MAX (MAX%) Permittit tibi tuam propriam grimoire aetheriam evocare, quae automatice incantationes, runas, consilia runarum, et praecepta didicisti recenset. Potest evocare simplicem calamus aetherium, qui tibi etiam cogitationes in libro inscribere sinit. Omnis incantatio, runa, consilium runarum et praeceptum 10% minus manae impendet ad effectionem et usum.]

unit.source: ‘Well, that looks useful as hell… pity I can’t level it…’ he thought as he processed what happened.
unit.target: «Heu, hoc valde utile videtur… pro meo dolore, non possum hoc gradu augere…» cogitavit, dum processit quid evenisset.

unit.source: When Sam looked up, he caught the librarian’s eyes, who just winked at him.
unit.target: Quando Sam intuitus est, oculos bibliothecariae cepit, quae ei subridens oculum intermittens misit.

unit.source: [Mana Exhaustion has expired!]
unit.target: [Exhaustio Manae exspiravit!]

unit.source: Sam looked at the notification gratefully, then dismissed it.
unit.target: Sam notificationem grato animo respexit, deinde eam deiecit.

unit.source: He then spent a few minutes flexing and stretching, glad that he had the same feeling he grew to enjoy back in his body.
unit.target: Tum paucos minuta se flexendo et extendendo consumpsit, laetus quod idem sensus in corpore suo, quem olim diligere coepit, adesset.

unit.source: Being struck by that horrible debuff was worse than some of the sicknesses he had been struck with.
unit.target: Ictus ab illo horribili detrimento peius erat quam nonnullis morbis quibus affectus fuerat.

unit.source: He hadn’t been playing for very long, but the new feeling of the magic coursing through him, even though Sam knew it was not real, still managed to get him hooked.
unit.target: Non diu ludebat, sed novus sensus magiae per eum fluens, quamquam Sam sciebat id non esse verum, tamen eum allicit.

unit.source: Sam knew he had to be careful because it was exactly this feeling that was labelled as one of the newest addictions not long after the game reached its first anniversary.
unit.target: Sam sciebat se cavendum esse, nam hoc ipsum sensum, post ludum primum annum transacto, ut una ex novissimis addictionibus designatum erat.

unit.source: Still, there were techniques that would let him get a handle on the process.
unit.target: Tamen erant technicae quae ei moderamen huius rei obtinere sinerent.

unit.source: Sam expected, thanks to his inherited memories, that sooner or later he would have to deal with it, but he didn’t expect it would happen so soon.
unit.target: Sam ex memoria hereditate exspectavit, sero aut mature, cum eam tractare oportere, sed non putavit id tam cito evenire.

unit.source: Shaking his head, he gave Lucky a look, thankful that the fluffy, and now shadowy, wolf was still content to sit in his shadow.
unit.target: Caput iactans, Lucky aspexit, gratus quod lupus laniger, nunc autem umbratus, adhuc contentus in umbra eius sedere placebat.

unit.source: Only sometimes poking his nose out to smell something interesting.
unit.target: Interdum tantum nasum extollens ut aliquid curiosum olfaceret.

unit.source: Then took the book he was reading and closed it with a quiet sigh.
unit.target: Deinde librum quem legebat cepit et quiete suspirans clausit.

unit.source: After finally making progress on his runes, he briefly went over all the books that contained standalone runes, making sure to note them down into his new, nifty Grimoire then turned his attention back to his original goal.
unit.target: Postquam tandem in runis progressus est, breviter omnes libros perlustrare coepit qui runas ex autonomis continerent, eos in novo, eleganti Grimoire conscripsit, deinde ad propositum originale rediit.

unit.source: Improving his language skills and acquiring a skill that would help him get more information more easily.
unit.target: Artes linguarias emendare atque artem adipisci quae eum ad informationem facilem consequendam adiuvaret.

unit.source: Some skills were much more convenient to get, for example, Combat Eye, which allowed one to read their enemy and pinpoint weak spots or attack trajectories, but he could collect those any time.
unit.target: Nonnullae artes multo commodius adipisci poterant, exempli gratia, Oculum Pugnandi, quod hostem legere et infirmitates aut itineraria impetus deprehendere permittebat, sed illa quovis tempore colligere poterat.

unit.source: What he was after needed much more time, and a certain amount of relaxed atmosphere.
unit.target: Quod desiderabat multo plus temporis et aliqua tranquillitate requisivit.

unit.source: By the time the other Sam joined the game, the ‘secret’ of the libraries were out, as well as the fact that you needed to actually learn languages to communicate with other races (boy, were the elf fanboys mad) and the libraries were actually fought over by guilds as they would fight over farming spots.
unit.target: Cum alter Sam ludo se iunxisset, arcana bibliothecarum patefacta erant, atque factum quod linguas discere oportebat ad communicationem cum aliis gentibus (o, fanatici elfi vehementer irati erant) et bibliothecae re vera a corporibus guildarum certabantur, sicut de agrorum cultu pugnaverunt.

unit.source: Even obtaining a few books to study was a great accomplishment at that time.
unit.target: Etiam paucos libros ad studendum obtinere magnum aestimationem illis temporibus erat.

unit.source: Sam wanted to make as much of the time as he had available at the library.
unit.target: Sam cupiebat ex tempore in bibliotheca prompto quantum fieri posset efficere.

unit.source: And with the librarian predisposed to help him, he wanted to maximize his gains.
unit.target: Et cum bibliothecaria ei auxilium dare parata esset, vis erat utilitates suas ad maximum conferre.

unit.source: Opening the book somebody he didn’t much care about wrote about the language of the dwarves.
unit.target: Aperiens librum, quem aliquis, de quo non multum curabat, de lingua nanorum scripserat.

unit.source: ‘I’m in a freaking game that makes every game look like it was drawn by crayon, and I’m studying…’ he grumbled inside his mind.
unit.target: ‘In ludo insanissimo versor, qui omne ludum quasi creta delineatum ostendit, et studeo…’ murmurat in mente sua.

unit.source: Then he refocused and began to read.
unit.target: Tum se concentravit denuo et legere coepit.

unit.source: “Um, excuse me?”
unit.target: “Heu, ignosce mihi?”

unit.source: “Yes, young Sam?” the librarian replied, turning away from the shelf she was dusting.
unit.target: “Ita, iuvenis Sam?” respondit bibliothecaria, dum supellectilem librorum purgabat.

unit.source: “I was wondering if you ever heard a spell that would let me analyze things?”
unit.target: “Mirabar an umquam audivisses incantationem, quae mihi res perscrutari liceat?”

unit.source: Sam debated about trying to be circumspect, but in the end, he just shrugged and went ahead.
unit.target: Sam de esse circumspectum conari deliberavit, sed in fine simpliciter humeros eleverit et processit.

unit.source: It wasn’t like his request was such a weird one.
unit.target: Non enim petitio eius tam peculiare erat.

unit.source: Analyze or observe skill was a staple skill of every other MMO, so it was natural that players would want to get one here in Magic Unbound too.
unit.target: Ars perscrutandi vel observandi erat ars fundamentalis cuiusque alii MMO, ideo naturaliter lusores unum hic, in Magic Unbound, adipisci cupiebant.

unit.source: The librarian raised one hand and started tapping on her chin with a finger.
unit.target: Bibliothecaria manum levavit et digito ad mentum pulsare coepit.

unit.source: “Examinare? Examinare… Hem, videamus… Miror…”
unit.target: “Examinare? Examinare… Hem, videamus… Miror…”

unit.source: He watched curiously as the older woman began to mumble to herself, waiting to see if he needed to get more involved, but in the end, the woman stopped her mumbling, her eyes lit up and a big grin appeared on her face.
unit.target: Curiose aspiciebat dum mulier senior ad se ipsa submurmurare coepit, exspectans an amplius necesse foret ei intervenire, sed denique illa submurmurare cessavit, oculi accensi sunt et risus latissimus in facie apparuit.

unit.source: “I remember!” she exclaimed, then reached over and grabbed Sam’s hand.
unit.target: “Memini!” exclamavit, deinde porrigens manum Sam apprehendit.

unit.source: Then, without any word, she began to drag him towards the back of the library.
unit.target: Deinde, sine verbo, eum ad extremum bibliothecae trahere coepit.

unit.source: Sam didn’t protest, just grinned at the success and let himself be dragged.
unit.target: Sam non protestatus est, sed tantum successui risit et se trahi permisit.

unit.source: Being friends with NPCs was really worth it!
unit.target: Amicitia cum NPCs vere pretium habebat!

unit.source: A few seconds later, they were standing in a shadowy corner of the library, covered with even more dust.
unit.target: Paucis post secundis, in angulo umbrato bibliothecae stabant, adhuc magis pulvere obtecti.

unit.source: The librarian tutted disapprovingly and mumbled something about her helpers.
unit.target: Bibliothecaria disapprobatim increpavit et de auxiliis suis submurmuravit.

unit.source: “Heu, cur non paululum purgemus, antequam incantationem mihi ostendas?”
unit.target: “Heu, cur non paululum purgemus, antequam incantationem mihi ostendas?”

unit.source: He didn’t want to clean, but it was a perfect moment to raise the librarian’s evaluation of him.
unit.target: Non volebat purgare, sed id tempus perfectum erat ut aestimationem bibliothecariae de se augeretur.

unit.source: And he was proven right when the woman gave him a tender smile but shook her head.
unit.target: Et recte putavit, cum illa ei leni risu obtulit, sed caput movit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry, I’ll get to it soon.
unit.target: “Noli timere, mox ad id perveniam.

unit.source: While I appreciate the sentiment, it’s not your job, young man.
unit.target: Quamquam affectum aestimo, non est officium tuum, iuvenis.

unit.source: So, allow me to do my job, and provide you with knowledge.”
unit.target: Itaque sinas me officium meum agere, et tibi sapientiam tribuere.

unit.source: Sam simply bowed his head in understanding, then watched as Martha stepped up to one particular shelf and began to browse it.
unit.target: Sam simpliciter caput inclinavit intellegens, deinde vidit Martha ad particularem librorum repositorium accessisse et eam perlustrare inceperit.

unit.source: Then almost a minute later she removed a medium-sized book, covered in dust, but to Sam’s magical senses it sang with mana.
unit.target: Paene post minutum, illa librum mediocris, pulvere obductum, extraxit; sed ad sensus magicos Sam, librum quasi carmen manae resonantem vidit.

unit.source: Holding the book gingerly, the librarian turned to him and held it out.
unit.target: Librum diligenter tenens, bibliothecaria ad eum se convertit et pro eum librum porrigebat.

unit.source: “Here you go, young man.”
unit.target: “Ecce, iuvenis.”

unit.source: “The spell you asked about!”
unit.target: “Incantatio de qua rogavisti!”

unit.source: He reached out and just as gingerly took the book with a thankful nod.
unit.target: Manum protulit et librum, teneriter acceperit, grato capite inclinato.

unit.source: “Thank you, ma’am.”
unit.target: “Gratias tibi ago, domina.”

unit.source: The older woman just patted his head.
unit.target: Mulier maior caput eius leniter tetigit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry, young man.”
unit.target: “Noli anxius esse, iuvenis.”

unit.source: “It’s never a problem to help a splendid gentleman like you!”
unit.target: “Numquam molestum est viro praestanti ut te adiuvare!”

unit.source: After taking the received book back to the table that over the last week almost became his table, he sat down and for a moment stared at the book.
unit.target: Postquam librum receptum ad mensam, quae per hebdomadam fere sua mensa facta erat, redegit, sedet et per momentum librum contemplatus est.

unit.source: He had hopes for what was contained in the book, but Sam was sure it contained at least a rare or higher rarity skill.
unit.target: Spem habebat de id, quod in libro inclusum esset, sed Sam certo sciebat illud saltem artem rarissimam vel altiorem implere.

unit.source: With a slightly trembling hand, he reached out, and under Lucky’s shadowy gaze, opened the book.
unit.target: Manu paulo tremula extendit, et sub Lucky umbrato aspectu, librum aperuit.

unit.source: Surprisingly, there was no light show, no flashes or other mysterious lights.
unit.target: Admirabiliter, nullum lumen spectaculum, nullae fulgora aut aliae luces mysteriosae erant.

unit.source: So, with a heavy sigh, he began to read…
unit.target: Ita, gravi suspirio, legere coepit…

unit.source: An hour later, he closed the book with a heavy thud and just stared at the book and table.
unit.target: Hora post, librum claudidit repente gravi strepitu et tantum librum et mensam contemplatus est.

unit.source: ‘What the hell did I just read?’
unit.target: ‘Quid diaboli modo legi?’

unit.source: The entire book was incomprehensible mumbo-jumbo about mana, mana sight and how it interacted with the world.
unit.target: Totus liber erat inintelligibilis sermo confusus de mana, visione mana et de modis quibus cum mundo interageret.

unit.source: Some of it made sense, some went right over his head, and some he only understood because he had his inherited memories.
unit.target: Nonnulla rationem habebant, alia penitus praeter eum transegerunt, et aliora solum intellexit ob memorias hereditarias.

unit.source: Just as he was about to shake off the confusion, the notifications appeared, derailing his thoughts.
unit.target: Cum paene confusionem abigere vellet, notificationes apparuerunt, et cogitationes eius disruptae erant.

unit.source: [You have read the Book of Fluxus Vitae et Mortis!]
unit.target: [Librum Fluxus Vitae et Mortis legisti!]

unit.source: [Your Mana Sight gained the Mana Flow subskill!]
unit.target: [Visio Mana tua subartem Mana Fluctus adeptus est!]

unit.source: [Mana Flow: Level MAX (MAX%) Your Mana Sight has sharpened beyond the normal, you can discern the greater flows of the mana.]
unit.target: [Mana Fluctus: Gradus MAX (MAX%) – Tua Visio Mana ultra modum acuta est; maiores fluxus mana discernere potes.]

unit.source: [Thanks to your tireless search for knowledge and diligence in studying you gain +1 WIS!]
unit.target: [Propter indefessum studium scientiae et diligentiam in studiis, +1 SAPIENTIA adipiscitur!]

unit.source: [Thanks to your research you gained the skill, Discernment!]
unit.target: [Propter tuam inquisitionem, artem Discernment adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Discernment: Level 0/10 (0%) Your eyes are trained enough to discern the relative strength of those on who you lay your eyes. Thanks to also having the Mana Sight skill, you will also be able to gauge their relative mana level.]
unit.target: [Discernment: Gradus 0/10 (0%) – Oculi tui satis exercitati sunt ut relativam vim eorum quem aspicis discernerent. Quia etiam artem Visio Manae habes, eorum relativum gradum mana aestimare potes.]

unit.source: “Not bad…” he mumbled as he read the skill.
unit.target: “Non male…” murmurat dum artem legebat.

unit.source: It might have seemed weak and useless and was actually useless at this level, but with a few supporting skills, the synergy it would achieve would propel it among the god-like skills.
unit.target: Fortasse debilis et inutilis videbatur, et ad hoc gradum re vera inutilis erat, sed cum aliquot artibus accessorioribus, synergia quam obtinebat, eam inter artes pessimas promoveret.

unit.source: Plus, that was without leveling up the skill…
unit.target: Praeterea, hoc factum est sine ipsius artis gradu incremento…

unit.source: After getting the best skill he could, he finished his study of the languages, reaching level five in the dwarven and elven languages, while also beginning to study the dark elven language.
unit.target: Postquam optimum artem adeptus est, studium linguarum complevit, ad gradum quintum in linguis nanorum et elforum perveniens, simulque linguam elficam obscuram discere coepit.

unit.source: Sadly, he couldn’t improve beyond level five without actually using the language, but for now, that was enough.
unit.target: Infeliciter, linguam uti, gradum quinque ultra progredi non poterat, sed ad hoc tempus satis erat.

unit.source: Then, while he prepared for his meeting at the Silvercrest manor, he began to run around the town.
unit.target: Tum, dum se ad congressum in Silvercrest manerio parabat, in oppido currere coepit.

unit.source: Sam opened an account at the bank, depositing a small part of the haul he gained while robbing the bandits.
unit.target: Sam rationem in argentaria aperuit, et parvam partem praedii, quod ex latronum rapina adeptus erat, depositus est.

unit.source: It was nice to see the stuffy bankers treat him with much more respect than when he previously stepped into the bank.
unit.target: Jucundum erat videre argentarii rigidi eum multo maiore reverentia tractare quam cum ante in argentariam intrasset.

unit.source: Following that, he bought some new, more modern and, most importantly in-fashion clothes for his visit.
unit.target: Post eo, emi vestimenta nova, moderniora, et maximi momenti modis apta ad ejus visitationem.

unit.source: There was no need to commit some kind of lame social faux pas by showing up in adventuring garb.
unit.target: Non opus erat aliquam rationem ignavi erroris socialis facere, ostendendo se in vestitu expeditionis.

unit.source: That was followed by Sam going around and knocking out a few basic reputation quests.
unit.target: Postea Sam circumiecit et nonnullos missiones reputati fundamentales pervenit.

unit.source: Getting herbs for the city guard barracks from the nearby forest.
unit.target: Herbas ad castra vigiliarum urbis e silva proxima acquirere.

unit.source: Getting some fresh meat from the nearby forest.
unit.target: Carne recens a silva proxima adeptus est.

unit.source: Reducing the population of the moss snakes in the nearby forest.
unit.target: Numerum angium musalium in silva proxima reducere.

unit.source: Basically, he went out to the forest and, with Lucky’s help, decimated the local fauna and flora population.
unit.target: Essentialiter, silvam ivit et, cum Lucky auxilio, populum localem faunae et florae decimavit.

unit.source: He and Lucky got a few levels out of it, but nothing exciting happened.
unit.target: Eum et Lucky paucos gradus ex eo adepti sunt, sed nihil excitans evenit.

unit.source: Sam mostly concentrated on increasing his skills and trying to master them.
unit.target: Sam maxime artes suas augere et eas dominari conari se dedicavit.

unit.source: He got two points for Endurance, one for Dexterity and one for Agility on his level-ups, and the bonus points went into Magic and Perception.
unit.target: Duas puncta pro Constantia, unum pro Dexteritate, et unum pro Agilitate in incremento adeptus est, et puncta bonus in Magiam et Perceptionem ivit.

unit.source: The skills Basic Footwork and Basic Breathing Technique were, as their name suggested, basic, but they were absolutely crucial and were the foundation for pretty much every offensive martial art.
unit.target: Artes Basic Footwork et Basic Breathing Technique, ut nomen indicat, simplices erant, sed absolute essentiales atque fundamentum fere omni artis martialis offensivae constituebant.

unit.source: And thanks to his hard work, he managed to raise both of them to level 9, and they were only waiting for a breakthrough.
unit.target: Et ob industriam suam, utrumque ad gradum nonum elevavit, et tantum ad novum impetum exspectabant.

unit.source: Sadly, as they were combat skills, his breakthrough would have to come from a fight.
unit.target: Infeliciter, cum essent artes pugnae, eius impetum ex proelio provenire oportebat.

unit.source: Or if he took the effort to get a proper teacher, from them.
unit.target: Vel, si conatus esset ut rectum magistrum adipiscatur, ex iis quoque.

unit.source: But as of now, that would be a too big commitment.
unit.target: Sed ad praesens, id nimis magnum compromissum esset.

unit.source: Returning to the town, he unloaded the loot he gathered from the forest, earning the adoration of several green soldiers and the grudging respect of their superiors.
unit.target: Rediens ad oppidum, praedam a silva collectam deponit, accepiens admirationem plurium militum viridium et reverentiam a superioribus.

unit.source: The captain of the guard even nodded at him like he wasn’t disgusted by the very concept of adventurers.
unit.target: Dux custodiae etiam ei annuit, quasi non vomeretur ex ipso conceptu adventurorum.

unit.source: Sam counted that as a win!
unit.target: Sam hoc pro victoria censebat!

unit.source: Satisfied, he decided to take a quick trip to see if anything could catch his interest in the Auction house.
unit.target: Satisfactus, statuit brevem excursionem facere, ut videat utrum quid eius curam in auctorio excitare posset.

unit.source: Of course, only after patting Lucky on his head.
unit.target: Certe, solum post Lucky in capite percussione.

unit.source: He needed all the luck he could get!
unit.target: Omnem fortunam, quam adipisci posset, ei opus erat!

unit.source: The Auction house looked like any other building in the city of Ironwood, but interestingly the population inside of it, and around it were a much higher percentage of players than NPCs.
unit.target: Auctorium videbatur sicut aliud aedificium in urbe Ironwood, sed notabile est quod in eo atque circa eum multo maiorem partem lusorum quam NPC erant.

unit.source: Granted, the workers were NPCs, but almost all the people inside were players bidding on items, or looking for opportunities.
unit.target: Dictum est, operarii NPC erant, sed fere omnes homines intus erant lusores, vel res licitantes, vel occasionibus quaerentes.

unit.source: Sam watched as people from several well-known and not so well known guilds and workshops were lounging around, staring at the auction house screen.
unit.target: Sam aspexit homines ex pluribus claris et minus notis gildiis et officinis circumambulantes, in schermate auctorii fixos.

unit.source: He could even spot a few people wearing symbols from the ‘hidden’ guilds that were biding their time…
unit.target: Etiam paucos homines notare poterat, qui insignia gildiis ‘occultis’ gestabant et tempus suum exspectabant…

unit.source: Aside from them, the entire building was full of people yelling, cursing, laughing, and generally just lamenting the fact that nobody had much money.
unit.target: Praeter eos, totum aedificium repletum erat hominibus clamantibus, maledicentibus, ridentibus, et generaliter lamentantibus quod pauca pecunia haberent.

unit.source: He just smirked, then quickly took a seat somewhere where people weren’t jumping around and opened the screen for the Auction house.
unit.target: Simpliciter subridit, deinde celeriter sedebat in loco quo homines non saltabant, et auctorii schermi aperuit.

unit.source: As of now, one could only search for simple items, materials and artefacts.
unit.target: Ad hoc tempus, solum simplices res, materiae et artefacta quaerere licebat.

unit.source: But in the future, they would be able to auction off services, guild memberships and so much more.
unit.target: Sed in futurum, servitia, subscriptiones gildiarum et multa alia ad venditionem offerre poterunt.

unit.source: In some areas, Auction Houses even transformed into Slave Shops where guilds sold the services of their members.
unit.target: In quibusdam locis, auctoria etiam in tabernas servorum transformabantur, ubi gildi officia membrorum suorum vendebantur.

unit.source: That was another can of worms that Sam wanted nothing to do with…
unit.target: Id erat alia res in qua Sam nullo modo versari voluit.

unit.source: The solution the company behind the game came up with was good enough for him.
unit.target: Solutio a societate ludi proposita ei satis placuit.

unit.source: Quickly running his eyes over the available merchandise, Sam couldn’t help but scowl.
unit.target: Celeriter oculos per merces praesto currentes transiens, Sam non potuit quin vultum contritum haberet.

unit.source: ‘Why are they selling all this shit? Those main characters in those novels always find easy gold the moment they open the auction screen!’ he complained to himself as he continued to peruse the rather lean selection.
unit.target: ‘Cur vendunt tot hoc immundum? Illi personae principales in illis fabulis semper facile aurum statim inveniunt, cum auctoria schermi aperiuntur!’ querellavit sibi dum tenuem selectionem perlustrare continuabat.

unit.source: Eventually, getting bored with the collection of random steel weapons, and barely used armors that he could buy at any armor shop, he opened the skill book tab.
unit.target: Postremo, cum collectione armorum fortuitorum ferrariorum et armis vix usitatissimis, quas in qualibet armaria emere poterat, taedet, tabulam librorum artium aperivit.

unit.source: And as he beheld that rather expected spread of common skill book, he sighed but began to scroll down, hoping to find something at least useful.
unit.target: Et cum illud spectrum librorum artium vulgarium, praevisum, contemplatus esset, suspiravit sed incipiebat descendere, sperans aliquid saltem utile invenire.

unit.source: Or, if not useful, at least cheaper than buying it anywhere else.
unit.target: Vel, si non utile, saltem viliori pretio quam alibi emere.

unit.source: Apparently, Lady Luck was with him, because he managed to find a few basic skill books for basic spells cheaper than he knew he could buy them from the mage tower.
unit.target: Videtur, Domina Fortuna eum comitata esse, nam aliquot libros basicos artium incantationum viliori pretio invenire potuit quam scire poterat eos ex turribus magorum emere.

unit.source: Not hesitating, he quickly bought the Wind Blade, Electric Spark, Earth Wall and Water Bullet spells.
unit.target: Nullo mora, celeriter emi incantationes Ventus Ensis, Fulgur Scintilla, Muri Terrae, et Aqua Telum.

unit.source: He mostly wanted the Earth Wall and Wind Blade, as they would harmonize with his current build very well, but the other two would also become useful soon.
unit.target: Praecipue Muri Terrae et Ventus Ensis optabat, cum ad statum constructum suum bene congruerent, sed altera duo cito etiam ad usum utilia futura erant.

unit.source: Then, after a moment of hesitation, and a quick glance at Lucky, who was curiously staring at all the strange people, he decided to bite the bullet and bought the Shadow Cloak skill book.
unit.target: Tum, post momentum dubitationis et celerem aspectum ad Lucky, qui cunctis hominibus miris curiose inspiciebat, statuit audacter agere et librum artium Shadow Cloak emit.

unit.source: It was not cheap at around 100 gold coins, but it was easier than going out and doing the quest for it, or simply hoping it would drop as loot.
unit.target: Non vilius erat, circiter 100 nummis aureis, sed facilius quam exire et missionem perficere, aut sperare ut tamquam praeda caderet.

unit.source: Standing up, he was about to head for the counter to receive the goods he bought when he heard a commotion quickly spreading among the people of the Auction house.
unit.target: Stans, paratus erat ad mensam ad res emptionis recipiendas accedere, cum audivit tumultum celeriter inter homines auctorii diffusum.

unit.source: “Sancte, per deos!”
unit.target: “Sancte, per deos!”

unit.source: “Have you seen this?”
unit.target: “Vidistine hoc?”

unit.source: “How?”
unit.target: “Quomodo?”

unit.source: “How much?”
unit.target: “Quantum?”

unit.source: Sam looked up and watched as the entire populace of the Auction house stared, tense and excited at their screens.
unit.target: Sam aspexit et vidit totam populum auctorii, qui in suis schermis, nervosi et excitati, perspici debebant.

unit.source: He quickly opened the screen and went looking for the item that caused the tizzy.
unit.target: Celeriter schermi aperuit et quaesivit rem quae tumultum excitaverat.

unit.source: Sam didn’t have to look far, as his screen was still on the skill books, and on the top of the listings was one book, set for 10 000 golds.
unit.target: Sam non debuit longe quaerere, quia schermi eius adhuc ostendebat libros artium, et in summo indice unus liber, pro 10,000 nummis aureis, praeberetur.

unit.source: [Book of the Life of Blood]
unit.target: [Liber Vitae Sanguinis]

unit.source: [Life of Blood: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Grants the user of the skill incredible regenerative blood, increasing their regeneration by 1% for each level in the skill.]
unit.target: [Vitae Sanguinis: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Oculis artis, sanguis regenerationis incredibilis tribuit, augens regenerationem 1% pro quolibet gradu artis.]

unit.source: It was an amazing skill.
unit.target: Ars mira erat.

unit.source: At a maximum level, it granted a flat 10% health regeneration.
unit.target: Ad gradum maximum, constantem 10% regenerationem valetudinis concedebat.

unit.source: But Sam could only laugh at himself, then continue towards the counter to his new skill books.
unit.target: Sed Sam solum se ipsum ridere potuit, et deinde ad mensam ad novos libros artium procedere coepit.

unit.source: The skill was amazing and incredibly rare at the moment (though when people get stronger, then killing trolls would be much easier) Sam knew one thing that made it one of the shittiest skills.
unit.target: Ars erat mirabilis et incredibiliter rara illis temporibus (quamquam, cum homines fortiores fiunt, trolos interficere multo facilius fiet), Sam unum certe sciebat, quod eam inter artes pessimas interponeret.

unit.source: It was technically blood magic.
unit.target: Technice, erat magica sanguinea.

unit.source: And it tainted the person’s own magic with blood magic, and a sufficiently good Blood Mage could make use of that taint…
unit.target: Et magiam propriam cum magica sanguinea polluere solebat, et sanguineus magus satis bonus illam contaminationem exploere poterat…

unit.source: And thanks to people not knowing this itty-bitty little tidbit, they simply almost farmed trolls to extinction for the skill.
unit.target: Et propter hoc parvum secretum, quod homines nesciebant, fere trolos ad exstinctionem pro hoc arte colegerunt.

unit.source: Which was followed by the Blood Dance, when two enterprising brothers realized the significance of almost the entire player base being tainted by blood magic and only around 5% of them having any defenses against it.
unit.target: Quae subsequitur est Saltatio Sanguinea, cum duo fratres industrii intellexerunt fere totum ludens corpus sanguinea magia pollutum esse et tantum circa 5% eorum ullam defensionem habere.

unit.source: The hunt for them was (or will be) legendary…
unit.target: Venatio eorum erat (aut erit) legenda…

unit.source: Exiting the still buzzing Auction house, Sam headed directly towards the Cloudy Day inn, for a quick cleansing shower and a change of clothes.
unit.target: Exiens auctorium adhuc stridulans, Sam directe ad hospitium “Cloudy Day” accessit, ad celerem lavationem et vestimenta mutanda.

unit.source: Throwing another small glance at Lucky, he decided a quick grooming session was also in order before the visit.
unit.target: Aliud parvum aspectum ad Lucky iaculans, decernit sessionem celerem curandi se, antequam visitaret, esse oportere.

unit.source: Standing before the imposing gates of the Silvercrest manor, eyed by two guards and the city behind him, still abuzz with the news of the Life Blood skill book, Sam felt a lot of things.
unit.target: Stans ante imponentes portas manerii Silvercrest, sub aspectu duorum custodum et urbis post eum, quae adhuc nuntiis de libro ingenii “Vitae Sanguinis” fervebat, Sam multa sensit.

unit.source: He was laughing at the idiots that fought over that not‐at‐all rare book that would cause their demise in a year or two; he was annoyed that he had to dodge fights that randomly broke out in and outside of the city over the book; and most of all, he was curious what was the purpose of the lord calling him for a meeting.
unit.target: Ridebat de ineptis, qui de hoc libro—non penitus raro, sed tali quo eorum perniciem intra annum vel duo afferret—certabant; iratus erat quod pugnas fortuito in urbe et extra eam de libro exarsantes vitare debebat; et maxime, mirabatur cur dominus eum convocare voluerit.

unit.source: Because Sam was hundred percent sure that the excuse that his daughter liked Lucky was just that, an excuse.
unit.target: Nam Sam totus certus erat excusatione, quod filia eius Lucky amaret, id solum esse—simply quendam rationem ad excusandum.

unit.source: A man like Lord Silvercrest could buy hundreds of fluffy wolves for his daughter to play with.
unit.target: Vir ut Dominus Silvercrest centenas luporum mollium emere posset, ut filiae suae ludere praebeat.

unit.source: More than likely, he didn’t want anyone to know he was talking to an adventurer.
unit.target: Verisimiliter noluit quisquam scire eum cum viatore colloqui.

unit.source: Sighing quietly, throwing a glance at the rapidly counting down clock for the quest, he finally squared his shoulders and approached the gate guards.
unit.target: Tacite suspirans, oculos intuebatur ad horologium expeditionis celeriter decrescentem, demum humeros rectos fecit et ad custodes portarum accessit.

unit.source: “Halt, stranger!” called out one of them, while the other tightened their grip on their spear. “State your business!”
unit.target: «Sta, peregrine!» inquit unus eorum, dum alter firmius hastam tenebat. «Dic negotium tuum!»

unit.source: He bowed his head a little, then answered.
unit.target: Paulum inclinavit caput, deinde respondit.

unit.source: “Lord Silvercrest requested my presence,” he said simply, while the two guards exchanged a glance.
unit.target: «Dominus Silvercrest praesentiam meam postulavit,» inquit leniter, dum duo custodes oculos inter se coniunctaverunt.

unit.source: Finally, after a few seconds of silent communications, the other one shrugged and began walking towards the gate.
unit.target: Denique, post aliquos secundos tacitae communicationis, alter humeros levavit et versus portas ambulare coepit.

unit.source: “We will inform the Lord. For now, I would like to request that you wait here.”
unit.target: «Dominum certiorem faciemus. Interim, te rogare velim, ut hic maneas.»

unit.source: “Understood,” Sam answered and watched as the guard slipped in, while the remaining one was still eyeing him.
unit.target: «Intelligo,» respondit Sam et observavit custodem intrare, dum reliquus eum adhuc spectabat.

unit.source: He didn’t have to wait long, as a notification window popped up not even a minute after the second guard went inside.
unit.target: Non multum exspectare debuit, nam fenestra nuntiorum apparuit ne minuto quidem postquam secundus custos intravit.

unit.source: [The quest “Visit of the highest order!” has been completed!]
unit.target: [Expeditio “Visitatio summi ordinis!” completa est!]

unit.source: They didn’t have to wait long as the guard returned with a very stereotypical butler at their side.
unit.target: Non multum exspectandum fuit, cum custos rediit cum servo domestico prorsus more consueto ad se.

unit.source: The butler opened the gates enough for him to comfortably step through, while the guard who played the messenger returned to his post.
unit.target: Servus domesticus portas satis aperuit, ut ille commode transiret, dum custos, qui nuntius fuit, ad locum suum rediit.

unit.source: “If you would follow me, Sir?” motioned the butler, their face neutral and their voice almost devoid of emotion. Though, Sam thought he might have heard some kind of tightness in the voice.
unit.target: «Si me secuteris, domine?» inquit servus domesticus, facie aequabili et voce quasi affectu carenta. Sed Sam putabat se aliquam tensionem in voce audivisse.

unit.source: Keeping his observation to himself, he quietly thanked the butler, nodded to the guards and entered the manor grounds.
unit.target: Observationem suam retinens, tacite ministrum domesticum gratias egit, ad custodes annuit et in area manerii intravit.

unit.source: The manor looked exactly like Sam imagined a manor of a lord in a fantasy setting would look like.
unit.target: Manerium prorsus ita videbatur, qualiter Sam repraesentaverat domum domini in mundo phantastico.

unit.source: Marble, gold and weird paintings were everywhere.
unit.target: Marmor, aurum, et picturae insolitae ubique erant.

unit.source: The wooden panelling was, of course, made from ironwood, and the candle holders were made of ironworks.
unit.target: Parietes lignei, scilicet ex ligno ferreo facti, erant; etiam sustentacula candelarum ex ferro confecta erant.

unit.source: There was, of course, a lot of silver filigree and family crests around the halls, of course, also made from either silver, ironwood or simply iron.
unit.target: Circa aedes, scilicet, multa erant filigrana argentea et sigilla familiarum, quae ex argento, ligno ferreo aut ferro simpliciter facta erant.

unit.source: Sam never understood the taste of the rich…
unit.target: Sam saporem divitorum nunquam intellexit…

unit.source: Soon, they arrived in a room that looked like every other room they walked past, but Sam just shrugged.
unit.target: Cito ad conclave pervenerunt, quod quasi omnium aliorum conclavium, quae transeunt, simile videbatur; sed Sam leviter humeros excussit.

unit.source: At the polite behest of the butler, Sam took a seat and began waiting.
unit.target: Secundum benigne imperium servi domestici, Sam sedes occupavit et exspectare coepit.

unit.source: The butler bowed perfectly from the waist and left the room, closing the door.
unit.target: Servus domesticus ex imis inclinavit et conclave reliquit, ianuam claudens.

unit.source: Sam was about to wonder how long he would have to wait when the recently closed door almost exploded and he was once again face to face with the bombastic Lord Silvercrest, with the stone-faced butler standing behind him.
unit.target: Sam paene mirari coepit, quamdiu exspectaret, cum ianuam nuper clausam paene explodere videbatur et iterum facie in faciem convenit cum bombastico Domino Silvercrest, servo domestico lapideo vultu post eum stante.

unit.source: The man was dressed in fancy clothing, practically radiating wealth, though his blonde hair was not very well put together, and he could see something that suspiciously looked like shadows under the man’s eyes.
unit.target: Vir indutus vestimentis pretiosis erat, opulentiam quasi effundens, quamquam capilli flavuli non optime dispositi erant, et aliquid sub oculis eius, quasi umbrae, apparuerunt.

unit.source: Sam stood up and gave a small bow.
unit.target: Sam surrexit et modice inclinavit.

unit.source: “Greetings, Lord Silvercrest. As you have bid me, I’ve returned.”
unit.target: «Salve, Domine Silvercrest. Sicut iussisti, redii.»

unit.source: The man let out a boisterous laugh and then grinned at Sam. Then he squinted, and the smile on his face decreased a little.
unit.target: Vir risum robustum effudit et deinde Sam subridens spectavit. Tum oculos contraxit, et risus in facie eius paulum decrevit.

unit.source: “You did, my young friend! You did good! But, my new friend, it seems you’re missing somebody!”
unit.target: «Fecisti, iuvenis amice! Bene egisti! Sed, novus amice, videtur te aliquem desiderare!»

unit.source: Sam just grinned and motioned for his own shadow.
unit.target: Sam tantum subridens signum dedit umbrae suae.

unit.source: The man, followed by the butler, stared at it, and two eyes of a wolf blinked back at them.
unit.target: Vir, a servo domestico secutus, ad eam spectavit, et duo oculi lupi ad eos reciprociter micaverunt.

unit.source: The butler let out an almost silent ‘huh’ and the grin on the lord’s face grew two sizes.
unit.target: Servus domesticus paene tacitum “heu” edidit, et risus in facie domini duplicato incremento auxit.

unit.source: “Haha, what a marvellous development! Come, my friend, let us join my precious daughter!”
unit.target: «Haha, quam mirabilis progressio! Veni, amice mi, accedamus ad filiam meam pretiosam!»

unit.source: And with that the other man turned on a dime and left the room, leaving Sam blinking, at the spot where the lord stood.
unit.target: Et hoc facto, alter vir celeriter se vertit et conclave reliquit, relinquens Sam palpebrantem in loco quo dominus stabat.

unit.source: The butler simply spoke up.
unit.target: Servus domesticus simpliciter locutus est.

unit.source: “If the good Sir, would follow me once again?”
unit.target: «Si, bone Domine, me iterum secuteris?»

unit.source: Sam just sighed and began walking.
unit.target: Sam tantum suspiravit et ambulare coepit.

unit.source: The garden was rather refreshing compared to the interior of the manor.
unit.target: Hortus admodum refrigerans videbatur respectu interioris manerii.

unit.source: Sam expected sprawling hedge mazes, and precious flowers in stupendous arrangements, but what received him was everything but that.
unit.target: Sam sperabat videre labyrinthos sepalos dilatatos et flores pretiosos in praeclaris compositionibus, sed quod eum receptum est, omnino aliter erat.

unit.source: There were at least three different sparring rings, made of sand, at least a few sheds made of wood (ironwood, of course) probably holding weapons, Sam suspected, and while there was a very tastefully arranged gazebo, it was designed for comfort instead of beauty.
unit.target: Erant saltem tres diversa circuli certaminis, ex arena facti, et pauca horrea ex ligno (scilicet ex ligno ferreo) fortasse armamenta continentes, ut Sam suspicabatur, et dum erat praeclare ordinata tenda solatii, ad commoditatem potius quam ad formositatem destinata.

unit.source: And currently, it was hosting the young Lucrecia with an older woman looking exactly like the young friend of Lucky, just, well, older.
unit.target: At nunc, in hoc loco hospitabant Lucreciam iuvenem cum muliere seniore, quae prorsus similis videbatur iuveni amico Lucky, sed evidentius seniora.

unit.source: Though, now that Sam was getting closer, he could see that the older woman was moving as little as possible and looked rather faint.
unit.target: Sed, cum Sam propius accessisset, animadvertit mulierem senorem vix moveri et languidam esse.

unit.source: ‘Ahh, sick mother, boisterous father… probably enemies out of the wazoo. I bet I’ll need to retrieve a medicine…’ Sam speculated as he approached the family. ‘Or maybe remove a curse…’
unit.target: «Ah, mater aegra, pater tumultuosus… fortasse hostes innumerabiles! Puto me medicamentum quaerere debere…» speculatus est Sam, dum ad familiam accessit.

unit.source: The lord, heads taller than anyone else in the garden, was standing next to the gazebo and the moment Sam stepped close enough that the women of the family could see him, he began speaking.
unit.target: Dominus, capite altiori quam omnis alius in horto, iuxta pavilionem stabat, et simul cum Sam satis accessit ut mulieres familiae eum intuerentur, coepit loqui.

unit.source: Though for him, speaking was yelling.
unit.target: Sed pro eo, loqui erat quasi clamare.

unit.source: The young lady of the manor winced and sent him an apologetic look while the man’s wife just smiled indulgently at him.
unit.target: Domina iuvenis manerii faciem contraxit et ei vultum excusationis misit, dum uxor viri indulgenter subridens spectabat.

unit.source: “Look, my darling Lucrecia! Look who came to visit us!”
unit.target: «Ecce, mea carissima Lucrecia! Ecce quis ad nos visitandum venit!»

unit.source: “I can see, father. And could hear you from inside the house,” came the deadpan reply. The man just laughed harder. “Though I do not see the wolf.” She turned to him. “Sir adventurer, could you perhaps explain?”
unit.target: «Vidi, pater. Et ex domo te audivi,» respondit sine inflectione. Vir autem magis risit. «Sed non video lupum.»

unit.source: Sam just smiled and simply called out.
unit.target: Sam solum subridens exclamavit.

unit.source: “Lucky!”
unit.target: «Lucky!»

unit.source: There was a brief pause, then there was a quiet bark and Lucky resurfaced from the shadow beneath Sam.
unit.target: Post brevem silentii spatium, parum sonitus latratus auditus est, et Lucky ex umbra sub Sam emergit.

unit.source: The wolf jumped up, pranced a little in front of Sam, then stuck a pose and let out a howl.
unit.target: Lupus surrexit, ante Sam parumper saltavit, deinde se in figuram constat posuit et ululavit.

unit.source: “It’s soooo fluffy!”
unit.target: «Tam molle est!»

unit.source: Sam watched for a minute as the young girl and wolf played together, then looked up at the lord and lady of the manor, who were sitting in the gazebo, watching the playing duo with a smile.
unit.target: Sam per momentum spectavit ut puella iuvenis et lupus simul ludere inciperent, deinde aspexit ad dominum et dominam manerii, qui in pavilione sedebant, duo ludentis subridentes observantes.

unit.source: Lord Silvercrest motioned for him to join them, so he did so.
unit.target: Dominus Silvercrest eum ad se iungendum invitavit, et ille se iunxit.

unit.source: He calmly walked up and took a seat opposite the pair.
unit.target: Calme accessit et sedem praepositam contra paria occupavit.

unit.source: However, before he could speak up, the lord reached forward and gingerly touched the abstract decoration in the middle of the table.
