unit.target: Attamen, antequam loqui posset, dominus progressus est et commodatim ornamentum abstractum in medio mensae tetigit.

unit.source: The moment his meaty fingers touched the decoration it lit up with gentle white light and Sam felt some kind of magic activating around them.
unit.target: Cum digiti eius robusti ornamentum attigerunt, id momento luce alba leniter fulsit, et Sam sensit aliquam magiam circum se activari.

unit.source: He raised an inquisitive eyebrow.
unit.target: Supercilium inquisitivum levavit.

unit.source: “Worry not, friend, just a little magic to make sure what we say stays here!” came the loud explanation from the lord.
unit.target: «Noli metuere, amice; solum parva magia est ad curandum ut verba nostra hic manserint!» inquit dominus voce clara.

unit.source: Sam nodded in understanding, suspecting that the people in the manor must be a master of that type of magic.
unit.target: Sam annuit intellegens, suspiciens homines manerii esse peritos in illa magica.

unit.source: “I understand, my lord. Now, perchance you may share with me the reason you called me here…” he simply said, then leaned back, looking directly into the man’s eyes.
unit.target: «Intelligo, domine. Nunc, forsitan mihi rationem, qua me hic vocavisti, explices…» inquit simpliciter, deinde recubans, oculos in eius spectans.

unit.source: “Smart man!” exclaimed the lord, then his entire demeanor shifted. Gone was the boisterous and happy lord, instead Sam was sitting across from a lord of a family, with an edge to them that made Sam a little nervous. Though the voice level didn’t go down.
unit.target: «Ingeniosus vir!» exclamavit dominus, et totus habitus eius immutatus est. Abiit ille dominus festivus et sonorus, et Sam sedebat adversus dominum familiae, cuius acerbitas eum paulum movebat, quamquam vox eius non attenuata fuit.

unit.source: “I called you here, young man because I needed someone unaffiliated with anyone. And the best ones are adventurers that work for money!”
unit.target: «Te hic vocavi, iuvenis, quia opus mihi erat aliquem sine vinculis; et optimi sunt adventores, qui pro pecunia operantur!»

unit.source: “That makes sense, my lord. Then, how can I be of service to the House of Silvercrest?”
unit.target: «Hoc sensibile est, domine. Ergo, quomodo servire possum Domui Silvercrest?»

unit.source: “Good attitude! Good attitude!” the man proclaimed, slapping the table, rattling the entire gazebo while his wife continued to sip her tea as if nothing interesting was happening.
unit.target: «Bona indoles! Bona indoles!» proclamavit vir, mensam percussit, totum pavilionem concutens, dum uxor eius theam bibebat, quasi nihil insolitum ageretur.

unit.source: “I shall be direct. Enemies of my house grew jealous of our wealth. They desire our silver mines, thus they conspired and managed to place a foul curse upon my wife.”
unit.target: «Ego directe dicam. Inimici domus meae divitiam nostram invidere coeperunt. Fodinas argentarias nostras optaverunt, itaque conspiraverunt et maledictionem foedam super uxorem meam imposuerunt.»

unit.source: “And you want me to help you to lift it.”
unit.target: «Et vis ut tibi auxilior ut id tollam.»

unit.source: “Excellent deduction, young man!”
unit.target: «Excellens deductio, iuvenis!»

unit.source: “Hmm… Do you know the name of the curse?”
unit.target: «Hmm… Scisne nomen maledictionis?»

unit.source: This time, the grin was replaced by a frown on the man’s face.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, risus in facie viri evanuit, atque loco eius apparuit vultus contritus.

unit.source: “Sadly, no. We scoured libraries all over the land, but we could find no mention of the curse. All we know is that it saps my darling’s energy. Every day she grows weaker.”
unit.target: «Heu, minime. Bibliothecas per totam terram investigavimus, sed nullam mentionem maledictionis invenimus. Omne quod scimus est quod vim carissimae meae exhaurit; quotidie eam debilitari videmus.»

unit.source: By the time he finished, he was almost whispering and throwing a worried gaze at his wife.
unit.target: Cum finiret, fere susurrabat et vultum sollicitum ad uxorem suam iaciebat.

unit.source: “I see,” Sam said simply, then raised a hand at the woman. “If I could?”
unit.target: «Intelligo,» inquit Sam simpliciter, deinde manum ad mulierem levavit. «Si possem?»

unit.source: There was a tense moment as the lord eyed him, but at a gentle touch from his wife, he relented.
unit.target: Fuit momentum anxium dum dominus eum intuebatur, sed leni tactu uxoris cedere coepit.

unit.source: “Go ahead, young man. Maybe you could see something that countless wise men have not!”
unit.target: «Procede, iuvenis. Forsitan quid videas quod innumeri sapientes nondum viderunt!»

unit.source: Sam nodded and activated several skills.
unit.target: Sam annuit et varias artes activavit.

unit.source: The first one was Mana Sense, focused on the woman, then Discernment, just to be sure and finally Mana Sight.
unit.target: Prima erat “Sensus Manae”, in mulierem intendens, deinde “Discernmentum” ad certitudinem, et postremo “Visus Manae.”

unit.source: Staring at the woman with both of his senses and eyesight, he could immediately spot the ugly, pulsating and rather foul black ball of mana in her body.
unit.target: Observans mulierem omnibus sensibus et acuto visu, statim deprehendit globum nigrum, foedum, pulsantem mana in eius corpore.

unit.source: Right at the level of her stomach.
unit.target: Recte in regione ventris eius.

unit.source: The pulse of the black ball of mana was the same as the mana circulating in the woman, but every time the woman’s mana circulated, it came back less and the black mana grew in size.
unit.target: Pulsus globi nigrantis mana idem erat ac mana, quae in mulier circumfluens, sed quotiens mana eius circulabat, redibat minor atque globus niger in magnitudine crescebat.

unit.source: It was a slow process, but as Sam focused on it, the surroundings started getting out of focus, and he could only see the woman.
unit.target: Processus tardus erat, sed dum Sam in eam intendit, circumstantia evanescere coeperunt, et solum mulierem videre potuit.

unit.source: Then even the woman was lost to his sight, and he was directly staring at the blue mana, infested by what was definitely some kind of foul mana parasite.
unit.target: Tum etiam mulier ex conspectu eius evanuit, et ille directe intuebatur mana caeruleum, quod indubitanter aliquo genere foedi parasiti manae infestatum erat.

unit.source: As he tried to make sense of the mess of tangled webs of mana in the woman’s body, he also tried to sift through his inherited memories, trying to figure out if the other Sam ever came across something like that or maybe heard about it.
unit.target: Dum conabatur sensum facere in confusione reticulorum intricatorum mana in corpore mulieris, etiam hereditarias memorias suas perquirere conatus est, ut sciret utrum alius Sam aliquando huiusmodi aliquid occurrisset aut de eo audivisset.

unit.source: He was about to give up and curse the fact that the inherited memories didn’t come with a convenient search engine when he found it.
unit.target: Iam prope relinquere et maledicere quod memoriae hereditatis non venissent cum instrumento quaerendi commode, cum eam reperit.

unit.source: “Right! The Ironwood Monster Break! Somehow, a portal was opened in the city and foul monsters started pouring out.”
unit.target: «Recte! Fractio Monstrorum Ligni Ferrei! Quidam modo in urbe portae apertae sunt et monstra foeda effluere coeperunt.»

unit.source: At first, he wasn’t sure that it was connected to this parasite, but then another very faint memory resurfaced.
unit.target: Primum non certus erat an id huic parasito pertinere posset, sed deinde alia memoria valde tenue recidit.

unit.source: “If I remember correctly… there was a mention of battles for the silver mines after the Monster Break…”
unit.target: «Si bene memini… mentionem fuisse proeliis pro fodinis argentariis post Fractio Monstrorum Ligni Ferrei…»

unit.source: He closed his eyes, slowly turning his skills off, then leaned back and began to consolidate what he figured out.
unit.target: Oculos clausit, paulatim artes suas deactivans, deinde recubuit et ea quae intellexerat consolidare coepit.

unit.source: “If I’m right, then more than likely, this ball of mana is what would open the portal. Probably will use up the life force of the lady, then bamm… monsters everywhere… But how to remove it?”
unit.target: «Si recte memini, hoc globus mana verisimiliter portam aperiet. Fortasse vim vitae dominae consumet, deinde monstra ubique apparebunt… Sed quomodo id removere possum?»

unit.source: And wasn’t that the million dollar question…
unit.target: Et nonne quaestio illa, vera quaestionis summae pretii, esset…

unit.source: Sam opened his eyes, and glanced at his notifications.
unit.target: Sam oculos aperuit et ad nuntios suos aspexit.

unit.source: [You have discovered something new but horrible with your senses!]
unit.target: [Novum, sed horribile, per sensus tuos detexisti!]

unit.source: [Your skill Mana Sense became Level 15!]
unit.target: [Ars tua “Sensus Manae” gradum XV pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your subskill Focused Sense became level 3!]
unit.target: [Sub-ars “Sensum Focalizatam” gradum III pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your skill Mana Sight became level 5!]
unit.target: [Ars tua “Visus Manae” ad gradum V pervenit!]

unit.source: Dismissing them, he turned his attention to his hosts.
unit.target: Eos deiecit et animadvertit in hospites suos.

unit.source: “Well, from what I can see, you don’t have much time left. That thing is eating the lady’s life force. I can’t even fathom what it will achieve when it consumes the last drop. I assume you have a basic plan?”
unit.target: «Bene, ex eo quod video, non habetis multum temporis reliquum. Illa res vim vitae dominae devorat. Nequaquam intelligo quid fiet cum ultima gutta absorbetur. Puto vos consilium fundamentale habere!»

unit.source: The man nodded grimly, while his giant hand engulfed one of the woman’s tiny ones.
unit.target: Vir graviter annuit, dum manus eius ingens unum ex parvis manibus mulieris amplectebatur.

unit.source: “Indeed, young man. Through research and contacts, I found an artefact that is capable of housing and transferring such spirits without damaging the previous host. However…”
unit.target: «Revera, iuvenis, per investigationes et relationes inveni artificium, quod talia spiritus continere ac transferre possit sine hosti praecedenti laedendo. Sed…»

unit.source: “However, you need somebody to get it. And you can’t leave her, because then…”
unit.target: «Sed oportet te aliquem habere ad id obtinendum; neque eam relinquere potes, nam tunc…»

unit.source: “You are perceptive, young man!” burst out the man, and the woman gave him a small smile.
unit.target: «Perspicax es, iuvenis!» exclamavit vir, et mulier ei parvum risum dedit.

unit.source: “Let me tell you the details!”
unit.target: «Permitte mihi ut tibi singula enarram!»

unit.source: Before the man could start, Sam held up a hand.
unit.target: Priusquam vir incipere posset, Sam manum levavit.

unit.source: “And what makes you think that you can trust me with this? By all accounts, I could be a plant by your enemies…”
unit.target: «Et quid te facit putare te posse mihi hoc in fidem tradere? Omnibus indicibus, fortasse ego speculum aut “plant” ab hostibus tuis esse possim…»

unit.source: His only response was laughter from the man and an elegant chuckle from the lady.
unit.target: Responsum eius unicum fuit risus ab viro et lepidus subridens ex parte dominae.

unit.source: “Nobody who has a pet like that could be an evil person!” came the baffling reply. “Plus, I have this nifty thing here!”
unit.target: «Nemo, qui talem animal domesticum habeat, malus esse potest!» inquit responsum perplexum. «Praeterea, hanc rem eleganter habeo!»

unit.source: With that, the lord of the manor placed a parchment radiating magic in front of Sam.
unit.target: Hoc facto, Dominus manerii charta magiam radiante ante Sam posuit.

unit.source: He immediately recognized it. And not for good reasons.
unit.target: Id statim agnovit; neque propter causas bonas.

unit.source: The parchment was yellow, with dark red, almost black edges, and to his Mana Sight, it was almost as if it was bleeding mana.
unit.target: Charta flavissima erat, cum marginibus rubris obscuris, paene nigris, et, secundum “Visum Manae” eius, quasi mana stillabant.

unit.source: A Blood Contract…
unit.target: Pactum Sanguinis…

unit.source: Sam left the Silvercrest manor in a daze, with Lucky, exhausted, back in his shadow, staring at the window in front of him.
unit.target: Sam manerium Silvercrest in stupefactum reliquit, et Lucky, defessus, in umbra eius versatus, ad fenestram coram se intuebatur.

unit.source: [You signed a Blood Contract!]
unit.target: [Pactum Sanguinis subscripsisti!]

unit.source: [If you break the terms of the contract, your life is forfeit, along with several other punishments!]
unit.target: [Si conditiones pacti violaveris, vita tua peribit, una cum plurimis poenis!]

unit.source: [You are marked by the magic of the contract until you fulfil it!]
unit.target: [Magia pacti te signavit, donec id adimpleas!]

unit.source: [You received a new quest!]
unit.target: [Novam expeditio acceperis!]

unit.source: [A shadow in a shadow of a shadow!]
unit.target: [Umbra in umbra in umbra!]

unit.source: [Lord Silvercrest has entrusted you with retrieving the Chalice of Restraint, used for housing and transporting belligerent spirits in the olden days. However, the House of Silvercrest has enemies around every corner, so be careful! You also signed a Blood Contract with Lord Silvercrest as a sign of trust, beware of the terms, lest you suffer a fate worse than death!]
unit.target: [Dominus Silvercrest tibi commisit ut Calicem Coercitionis recuperares, ad quem spiritus bellicosi in antiquis temporibus continebantur et transportabantur. Attamen, Domus Silvercrest hostibus ubique infestata est, ergo cave! Etiam cum Domino Silvercrest Pactum Sanguinis subscripsisti ut fides demonstraretur; cave conditiones, ne tibi fatum peius quam mors eveniat!]

unit.source: [Time Limit: As long as Lady Silvercrest lives.]
unit.target: [Tempus: Quamdiu Domina Silvercrest vivit.]

unit.source: [Failure: Lady Silvercrest dies. You don’t deliver the Chalice of Restraint.]
unit.target: [Defectio: Domina Silvercrest moritur. Calicem Coercitionis non tradis.]

unit.source: [Penalty: Death. One year 90% EXP penalty and the permanent loss of one from every base stat.]
unit.target: [Poena: Mors. Unum annum poenae EXP 90% et detractio perpetua unius ex omnibus statibus principalibus.]

unit.source: [Reward: The undying gratitude of the House of Silvercrest. You can hire young Lucrecia as a follower. Additional rewards are possible.]
unit.target: [Praemium: Aeterna gratitudo Domus Silvercrest. Potes iuvenem Lucreciam conducere ut sequax. Praemia addita possibilia sunt.]

unit.source: He stared at the sentence ‘Additional rewards are possible.’ and couldn’t help but feel happy, but still want to despair.
unit.target: Ille aspexit sententiam “Praemia addita possibilia sunt” et non potuit non gaudere, sed simul desperare quoque.

unit.source: It was a rather famous sentence. It basically meant that the quest had some hidden elements that he would need to solve if he wanted to finish it.
unit.target: Sententia erat satis famosa. Fundamentum eius significabat expeditio quaedam elementa abscondita habere, quae solvere oporteret si eam finire vellent.

unit.source: Which meant complications. At least it was an early quest, so it wouldn’t take much time. And based on how developed the parasite was, he had at most one-month in-game time before the Monster Break occurred, if he was right about that.
unit.target: Quae implicabat complicationes. Saltem expeditio prima erat, ergo non multum temporis caperet. Et, secundum quam evoluta esset parasitus, ad summum unum mensem intra tempus ludi ante Fractio Monstrorum habebatur, si recte putabat.

unit.source: Sighing and lamenting his weird luck, Sam ducked into an alley, and if somebody were watching that alley, the man that came out on the other end looked nothing like Sam, be it their face or clothing.
unit.target: Suspirans et fortunam suam miram lamentans, Sam in angustum viculum se recepit, et si quis illum viculum observasset, vir qui ex altera parte apparuit omnino a Sam dissimilis videbatur, nec in facie nec in vestimentis.

unit.source: After leaving the manor, disguising himself, and losing at least two people who followed him after exiting the gate of the Silvercrest manor, Sam went around the city, periodically changing his looks, doing odd things, and walking in circles for a while.
unit.target: Postquam manerium reliquit, se celans, et saltem duos homines qui eum postquam portam manerii Silvercrest transegerunt amisit, Sam per urbem vagatus est, vultum suum interdum mutans, res insolitas faciens, atque aliquantisper circulos ambulans.

unit.source: Then, when he was sure that nobody was following him anymore, he shed his latest disguise, returned to his original look, pocketing the Chameleon Mask, Sam began to whistle gently and began walking towards one of the general shops.
unit.target: Deinde, cum certus esset neminem eum amplius sequi, novissimam subditionem abdidit, ad aspectum suum originarium revertere, et "Chameleon Mask" in sinum recondendo, Sam leniter sibilare coepit atque ad unam tabernam generalem ambulare incipiebat.

unit.source: The information provided by the Lord was somewhat vague, with the only thing being known about the Chalice, that it was hidden in one of the old ironwood forests around the city.
unit.target: Notitia a Domino data aliquantum vaga erat, cum sola res notam de Calice esset – id sciebat quod in una ex antiquis silvis ligni ferrarii circa urbem celatum esset.

unit.source: This kinda of made sense, but also made his job much harder as all ancient groves of trees were either heavily guarded or so hidden, nobody knew where they were.
unit.target: Id sensum aliquatenus habebat, sed negotium eius etiam multo arduiorem faciebat, quoniam omnia veterana nemora arborum vel valde vigilabantur vel tam occultata erant ut nemo sciret ubi essent.

unit.source: And if that wasn’t enough, Lord Silvercrest was sure that his enemies also knew that the only thing capable of saving his wife was the Chalice so they would either hinder him or search for the Chalice themselves.
unit.target: Et si id non sufficeret, Dominus Silvercrest certo credebat hostes suos etiam novisse unam tantum rem quae uxorem servare posset – id est, Calicem – itaque aut eum impedirent aut ipsi Calicem quaererent.

unit.source: Thankfully, there was a silver lining to the story.
unit.target: Felix tamen, in fabula lumen argenteum apparuit.

unit.source: Sadly, it wasn’t that he knew exactly where the artifact was.
unit.target: Infeliciter, non exacte sciebat ubi artefactum esset.

unit.source: This was a completely unknown quest to him, as the other Sam only knew about the probable after‐effects of the quest.
unit.target: Hoc iter plane ignotum ei fuit, quoniam alter Sam solum de probabilibus effectibus post expeditionem sciret.

unit.source: But the other Sam spent a lot of time in Ironwood, and by the time he arrived in the city, the guilds had already explored big parts of the area and guides were available for cheap.
unit.target: Sed alter Sam multum temporis in Ironwood egit, et tempore quo in urbem pervenit, gildae iam magnam partem regionis exploraverant et duces vili pretio praesto erant.

unit.source: And those guides were currently rattling around in his head, ready to be used.
unit.target: Et hi duces iam in mente eius vagabant, parati ad usum operandum.

unit.source: “Let us see what will happen!” he thought as he continued his preparations.
unit.target: „Videamus quid eveniat!” cogitavit, dum parationes suas pergebat.

unit.source: It was getting easier to handle, but logging out still left him a little confused and with a little uncontrollable body.
unit.target: Rem tractare facilius videbatur, sed exitus sessionis eum paulum confusum reliquebat atque corpus eius aliquantulum ingovernabile.

unit.source: Thankfully, the exercises he had been doing, and knowing about the issue and how it was handled in the future made it so that Sam just did a few stretching exercises and other movements, and the confusion was gone and his appendages were back under his control.
unit.target: Gratia exercitationum quas exerciebat atque cognitione quaestionis necnon quomodo ea postea tractata essent, Sam paucis exercitationibus distensionis et aliorum motuum uti solebat, et confusio evanuit atque membra sua rursus sub imperio eius erant.

unit.source: After going through his usual log-out routine, he sat down in front of his computer dressed in fresh clothing, hair still a little bit damp.
unit.target: Postquam solitam sessionis clausuram perrexerat, ante computatrum suum sedebat, vestimentis recentibus indutus, capillis adhuc paulum umidis.

unit.source: He checked his emails and other assorted notifications, pointedly ignoring anything related to Shadowland.
unit.target: Epistulas electronicās et alias notificationes varias inspexit, neglegens omnia quae ad Shadowland pertinere videbantur.

unit.source: He knew what it was mostly about, but first, he wanted to deal with the general stuff.
unit.target: Sciebat quid plerumque conserneret, sed primo voluit de rebus universalibus agere.

unit.source: A quick check showed him that the official stuff was doing okay.
unit.target: Celeris inspectio ei ostendit res officiales satis bene versari.

unit.source: His shares in Future Unknown were doing really well, as well as several other investments in companies that would become bigger and more profitable with the rise of the game.
unit.target: Partes eius in Future Unknown optime se gerebant, sicut et plura alia pecuniaria in societatibus quae cum ludorum ortu maiorem et lucrativam fieri promissae erant.

unit.source: Another check at the official site showed that the timeline hadn’t deviated yet, as they hadn’t posted anything that the other Sam hadn’t seen.
unit.target: Alia inspectio in situ officiali ostendit chronologiam nondum deviatam, cum nihil postatum esset quod alter Sam non viderat.

unit.source: There were the usual video compilations of the funny, sad and awesome moments, and he spent a little time watching those, trying to spot people that would be important, but sadly the company did a good job in anonymizing the player without decreasing the quality of the videos.
unit.target: Erat consueta compilatio video momentorum iocularium, maerorum, et praeclarorum, et ille parum temporis ea inspiciens consumpsit, conans agnoscere eos qui magni momenti essent, sed infeliciter societas pulchre operam dedit ad lusorem anonymum reddendum sine qualitatem videoorum minuenda.

unit.source: There were even a few scenes of Lucky in action in one of the compilations…
unit.target: Etiam paucae scaenae de Lucky in actu in una ex compilationibus adhibitae erant…

unit.source: Sam made sure to download that one.
unit.target: Sam curavit ut illud dempsisset.

unit.source: Then, he turned his attention to the forums.
unit.target: Deinde, animum ad fora convertebat.

unit.source: Aside from the local sections that were focused on the conflicts and actions of certain towns, the main page of the game’s forum was occupied with the Life of Blood skill.
unit.target: Praeter sectiones locales, quarum in contentiones et actiones certarum urbium versabantur, pagina principalis fori ludi occupabatur per artem vitae sanguinis.

unit.source: It was a good skill. Hell, it was an excellent skill. Ten percent base health regeneration for practically free, plus the subskill at the tenth level? It was basically a godly skill.
unit.target: Ars bona erat. En, ars praeclara erat. Decem centesimae regenerationis salutis ex fundamento fere gratis, atque subperitia ad decimum gradum—in summa, ars quasi divina erat.

unit.source: If it weren’t for that minuscule drawback…
unit.target: Nisi ob illum levissimum incommodum…

unit.source: As Sam scrolled through the forums, reading people overreacting or praising the skill, while several people were calling for nerfing it, if not outright banning it.
unit.target: Dum Sam per fora delabatur, legens homines aut artem nimis laudantes aut vehementer criticantes, dum plures eam attenuare, si non omnino interdicere, postulabant.

unit.source: But the developers were silent. Probably because they knew about the blood magic aspect.
unit.target: Sed programmatores silent erant. Forsitan quia de sanguinea magica notitiam habebant.

unit.source: Then, as Sam read another jealousy‐filled rant, he had a wicked idea.
unit.target: Deinde, dum Sam aliam invidiae plenum orationem legebat, malitiosam ideam concipiebat.

unit.source: Grinning, ear to ear, he switched over to the Shadowland website, ignored all the requests for more Life of Blood skill books, and began typing.
unit.target: Subridente a fronte usque ad auribus, ad situm Shadowland convertit, neglexit omnes petitiones pro libris additis artis “Vitae Sanguinis” et scribere coepit.

unit.source: It was a simple message.
unit.target: Erat nuntius simplex.

unit.source: “Trolls, you idiots.”
unit.target: “Trolli, stulti estis.”

unit.source: Under it, he added a few Wiki-like articles about the mythology of trolls, highlighting and quoting the parts about their superior regeneration and blood, then set the price of viewing the post the lowest amount possible.
unit.target: Sub eo, addidit nonnullos articulos similes Wiki de mythologia trollorum, partes de eorum praestante regeneratione et sanguine extollens et citans, deinde pretium ad legendum nuntium minimum possibile constituit.

unit.source: He added a few tags, just to make sure even more people saw it, then clicked on the upload button, leaned back in his chair, and watched as the chaos unfolded.
unit.target: Addidit nonnullas titulos (tags) ut certior fieret plures id viderent, deinde puga “upload” premens, in sella recubavit, et spectavit dum chaos evoluta esset.

unit.source: For a moment nothing happened, then as people realized that he had posted, they began to flock to his post, while happily watching as the viewer counter ticked up.
unit.target: Per momentum nihil accidit, deinde, cum homines intellexerunt eum postatum esse, ad post eius concurrere coeperunt, laeti spectantes dum numerus spectatorum augebat.

unit.source: It was just the cherry on the top that he got paid for it.
unit.target: Hoc erat quasi cerasum in summo, quod pro eo remuneratus est.

unit.source: He gleefully read the responses.
unit.target: Sam laetus responsa legebat.

unit.source: “LazyPhoenix thx as always, you r the bro!”
unit.target: “LazyPhoenix, gratias ut semper, tu es fratrem!”

unit.source: “As always, quality content. Thanks!”
unit.target: “Ut semper, contentum optimae qualitatis; gratias!”

unit.source: “Thanks, bro, this will allow us to dominate the area! MightyWolves Go!”
unit.target: “Gratias, fratrem, hoc nobis sinet regionem dominari! MightyWolves, procedite!”

unit.source: “MightyWolves suck! RagingDucks are the best!”
unit.target: “MightyWolves male sunt! RagingDucks optimi sunt!”

unit.source: And so on…
unit.target: Et cetera…

unit.source: Eventually, as with all forum threads, it devolved into name‐calling and other nice things, so the mods intervened and locked the thread, while Sam just cackled in his apartment, watching the counter tick up faster and faster.
unit.target: Denique, sicut in omnibus discussionibus fororum, sermo in iniurias nominativas ac alias leves res degeneravit, itaque moderatores intervenere et thread clauderunt, dum Sam in domo sua cachinnans numerum spectatorum celeriter ascendere spectabat.

unit.source: He made a good chunk of money and even hastened the approach of the Blood Dance… Probably.
unit.target: Magnam pecuniae portionem consecutus est atque etiam adventum Saltationis Sanguinis festinavit… Probabiliter.

unit.source: But at least most people would be concentrating on hunting down the trolls to make as much money as possible.
unit.target: Sed saltem plerique homines intendebant trollos venari, ut pecuniam quam maxime comparare possent.

unit.source: And wouldn’t you know? Ironwood had several areas around it, especially in the mountains, that contained trolls.
unit.target: Et nonne scies? Ironwood complura spatia circa se habebat, praesertim in montibus, ubi trolli inerat.

unit.source: “A perfect distraction for my mission…”
unit.target: "Perfecta distractio pro mea missione…

unit.source: Ironwood City was abuzz around him as he collected the necessary supplies for his quest.
unit.target: Urbs Ironwood circa eum alacriter vibrabat, dum necessaria subsidia pro expeditione sua collegit.

unit.source: He eyed as the proto‐guilds, mercenary bands, gaming groups and other collections of greedy players moved around him, tense, ready to pounce at the slightest provocation.
unit.target: Ille animadvertit proto‐gildas, manipulorum mercenariorum, coetus ludicros et alias aggregationes avarorum lusorum circa se versari, tensi et parati ad minima quidem provocatione impetum dare.

unit.source: While he was enjoying a nice dinner in a restaurant near his home, a guild found the trolls around Ironwood.
unit.target: Dum cenam iucundam in caupona prope domum suam fruebatur, una gilda trollos circa Ironwood detexit.

unit.source: There was a brief clash with two other guilds as the information naturally was leaked immediately.
unit.target: Erat brevis congressus cum duabus aliarum gildarum, cum notitia statim divulgata esset.

unit.source: As of now, there was an uneasy truce as the guilds geared up for a fight.
unit.target: Nunc, inter gildas, pax incommoda exstabat, cum gildae ad certamen praeparabantur.

unit.source: And Sam couldn’t be happier.
unit.target: Sam non poterat laetior esse.

unit.source: He already saw several groups of soldiers belonging to the noble families that the Lord of Silvercrest named as their enemies leave the city, heading, presumably, to support a group that earned that privilege.
unit.target: Iam vidit complura manipula militum ex familiaribus nobilibus, quos Dominus Silvercrest hostibus suis designavit, urbem exire, fortasse ut coetum sustinerent qui illud honorem adeptus esset.

unit.source: Or to take the troll hunting ground for themselves. One can never know…
unit.target: Vel ut ipsi terram venandi trollorum sibi vindicent. Quid futurum sit, nemo scit…

unit.source: And while the chaos was brewing around him, he stocked up his perishables, had his armor and weapon repaired, got some potions, and copied the local and other maps he gathered into his grimoire.
unit.target: Dum chaos circa eum bulliebat, cibaria pereuntia congregavit, armum telumque reparavit, potiones acceperat, et tabulas locales aliasque quas collegisset in grimoario suo consignavit.

unit.source: Standing in the middle of his room he looked at the collected items, making notes, trying to figure out if he missed something while Lucky lazily lay on the bed, watching him with sparkling eyes.
unit.target: Stans in media camera sua, res collectas inspiciens, notas faciens, quaerens utrum quid omitteret, dum Lucky languide in lecto iacebat et eum oculis micantibus contemplabat.

unit.source: After half an hour of internal debate, he finally decided that he had everything he needed, so he put everything away into his inventory and bags of holding.
unit.target: Post dimidium horae disputationum internarum, tandem decrevit se omnia habere necessaria, itaque ea in inventario et sacculis tenendi recondidit.

unit.source: Turning to Lucky, he spoke up softly.
unit.target: Conversus ad Lucky, leniter locutus est.

unit.source: “Are you ready, Lucky?”
unit.target: “Paratus es, Lucky?”

unit.source: His answer was an eager bark.
unit.target: Responsum eius fuit latratus alacer.

unit.source: “All right. Then hop into my shadow and we can go!”
unit.target: “Bene. Ergo, in umbram meam sali et eamus!”

unit.source: The wolf nodded, then slowly stood up and rather comically jumped into the air and dived headfirst into his shadow.
unit.target: Lupus annuit, deinde lente surrexit, et quasi comice in aethera salit atque capite primum in umbram suam immergit.

unit.source: Which was followed by a small notification window.
unit.target: Quae postea parva fenestra notificationum apparuit.

unit.source: [Thanks to the growing connection between you and your spirit companion, Spirit Link has reached Level 7!]
unit.target: [Gratias nexui crescens inter te et spiritum comitem, Spirit Link ad Gradum VII pervenit!]

unit.source: Smiling silently, Sam dismissed the window, and with determined steps left the room.
unit.target: Sam, silentio subridente, fenestram reiecit, et cum passibus firmatis conclave reliquit.

unit.source: His first step was to find an old man.
unit.target: Primum, senem invenire constituit.

unit.source: At least according to the Lord of Silvercrest, the old man he found was an old ranger that used to walk the hidden woods around the city of Ironwood.
unit.target: Saltem, secundum Dominum Silvercrest, senex quem invenit erat quondam custos silvarum, qui in silvis occultis circa urbem Ironwood ambulabat.

unit.source: The lord managed to get an approximate location at the eastern part of the town, but the remaining legwork was left to Sam.
unit.target: Dominus locum approximatum in parte orientali oppidi assecutus erat, sed reliqua opera itineris Sam relinquuntur.

unit.source: Sam could have started to canvass the area, but why work hard when there was an easy way?
unit.target: Sam regionem perlustrare poterat, sed cur laborare, cum via facilis exsisteret?

unit.source: He simply donned a dark cloak, used the Chameleon Mask to change his looks, this time into a pretty blonde and sought out one of the darker areas of the city, where crime was still the king.
unit.target: Ille simpliciter pallium obscurum induit, "Chameleon Mask" usus est ut speciem suam mutaret, hoc tempore in faciem decorae flavae, atque unam ex partibus obscurioribus urbis quaesivit, ubi crimen adhuc dominabat.

unit.source: Not as blatantly as in many seaside cities, but there was definitely a stench in the air that told him that not everything was alright in the area.
unit.target: Non tam manifeste quam in multis urbibus maritimis, sed fetor in aere certe indicabat eum non omnia in regione esse recta.

unit.source: Even the mana in the air was tainted a minuscule amount with darkness.
unit.target: Etiam mana in aere parvo quantitate obscuritate tinctum erat.

unit.source: He purposefully strode forward, not too fast, or too slow, just with enough speed to show that he knew where he was going.
unit.target: Proposito animo procedebat, neque nimis celeriter neque tardius, sed satis impetu ut ostenderet se scire quo ire.

unit.source: And when he spotted what he was looking for, he slowed down and then stopped.
unit.target: Et cum id quod quaerebat conspexit, tardavit et deinde sistit.

unit.source: Turning towards a small alley, he activated his defensive skill just in case and called out.
unit.target: Ad parvum angiportum convertens, artem defensionis suam ut cautelam activavit et exclamavit.

unit.source: “Hey kid, want to make some money?”
unit.target: “Heus, puer, vis pecuniam facere?”

unit.source: For a moment there was no reply or even movement in the alley, but then a small voice, hesitant but with a hidden spine, answered.
unit.target: Per momentum nec responsum nec motus in angiporto fuit, sed deinde parva vox, dubia sed cum animi fortitudine latente, respondit.

unit.source: “Wat’chu want?”
unit.target: “Quid vis?”

unit.source: Sam, knowing the rules, instead of answering just raised a hand that held one lone silver coin.
unit.target: Sam, regulas sciens, pro respondiendo manum attollit, quae unum solum nummum argenteum tenebat.

unit.source: Thanks to his somewhat advanced stats he managed to hear a small gasp from the shadows enveloping the alley.
unit.target: Propter statuta aliquantum provecta, parvum suspirium e umbris angiporti circumfugientibus audire potuit.

unit.source: “Looking for a man.”
unit.target: “Virum quaerens.”

unit.source: “Name?”
unit.target: “Nomen?”

unit.source: “No name. A ranger. Old.”
unit.target: “Nullum nomen. Explorator. Senex.”

unit.source: There was another silence.
unit.target: Fuit iterum silentium.

unit.source: He added another silver to his hand.
unit.target: Illi addidit alterum nummum argenteum in manum.

unit.source: “Might kno’ some-some…”
unit.target: “Fortasse scit aliquid…”

unit.source: Sam simply nodded.
unit.target: Sam simpliciter annuit.

unit.source: “Five now, ten if they are who I’m looking for.”
unit.target: “Quinque nunc, decem si sunt illi quos quaero.”

unit.source: He had no need to negotiate here. He had all the money he wanted, so why not make use of it?
unit.target: Non oportuit eum hic negoceari. Omnem pecuniam optatam habebat, ergo cur non ea adhiberet?

unit.source: There was a flurry of sounds in the alley, and then, hesitantly, a dirty-haired head belonging to a young urchin poked their head out.
unit.target: In angiporto tumultus sonorum ortus est, et deinde, dubito, caput crinite sordido iuvenis vagabundi emersit.

unit.source: Sam honestly couldn’t tell if they were a girl or a boy…
unit.target: Sam vere nesciebat utrum esset puella an puer…

unit.source: The look on the face of the kid was pretty serious.
unit.target: Vultus in facie pueri valde gravis erat.

unit.source: Sam could see the light of greed in their eyes.
unit.target: Sam lucem avaritiae in oculis eorum perspiciebat.

unit.source: He just snorted and nodded.
unit.target: Ille tantum sputavit atque annuit.

unit.source: He wasn’t feeling pity for them, as he knew from his inherited memories that kids like these dressed up as street urchins to make money from clueless people.
unit.target: Non miserebat illos, nam ex memoria hereditate sciebat pueros tales se induisse ut mendicos, ad pecuniam ab insipientibus capiendam.

unit.source: They had homes, were fed, and were surprisingly well educated.
unit.target: Habebant domos, saturabantur, et mirum in modum bene eruditi erant.

unit.source: Mostly to be able to con even more people, the little monsters.
unit.target: Praecipue ut etiam plures deciperent, parvuli monstra.

unit.source: And surprisingly, every city had one of these child organizations.
unit.target: Et mirum in modum, omnis urbs unam huiusmodi organizationem puerilem habebat.

unit.source: The prevailing theory was that the developers didn’t want to show starving kids in a game…
unit.target: Praevalens theoria fuit, quod programmatores noluerunt pueros esurientes in ludo ostendere…

unit.source: “Ya swear, mistah?”
unit.target: “Iurabis, domine?”

unit.source: “Drop the horrible accent and I will raise it to eleven,” Sam replied dryly.
unit.target: “Abice accentum foedum, et illud ad undecimum elevabo,” respondit Sam aride.

unit.source: The kid didn’t even blink.
unit.target: Puer neque palpebra commovit.

unit.source: “Of course, mister!” replying with an innocent looking smile and a glint in their eyes.
unit.target: “Certe, domine!” respondit, cum risu innocenti et fulgore in oculis.

unit.source: Sam snorted. “Show me.”
unit.target: Sam sputavit. “Ostende mihi.”

unit.source: “Yes, mister. Follow me, I’ll show the way to Old Marak!”
unit.target: “Ita, domine. Sequere me, viam ad Vetus Marak ostendam!”

unit.source: Nodding silently, he threw the five coins at the kid, who caught them, and they instantly vanished into their rags.
unit.target: Silenter annuens, quinque nummos puero iacuit, qui eos ceperat, et statim in vestimentis suis evanuerunt.

unit.source: The kid nodded, and they began walking with Sam following after the excitable kid.
unit.target: Puer annuit, et ambulare coeperunt, cum Sam puerum excitatum sequens.

unit.source: “Maybe they are not even kids, but fey…” he thought as he went over what he knew about the KidConOrg as the forums called them.
unit.target: “Forsitan illi non pueri quidem sint, sed fey…” cogitavit, dum rem de KidConOrg, sicut fora eos nominabant, recolens.

unit.source: “Making deals, tricking people, showing up everywhere and just altogether being mischievous…hmmm, should I?”
unit.target: Negotia faciendi, homines decipiendi, ubique apparendi atque omnino facinorosus esse… hmmm, debeam?

unit.source: They were in another dark part of the city, walking by dilapidated houses, old shops and generally areas that had a serious need for a facelift.
unit.target: In alia parte obscura urbis versabantur, ambulantes iuxta domos dilapidatas, tabernas antiquas et regiones quae renovationem sincere exigebant.

unit.source: While the kid excitedly led him through the streets and alleys of the darker side of Ironwood, he couldn’t help but notice that they were somewhat walking in a circle.
unit.target: Dum puer eum excitatus per vias et angiportos partis obscurioris Ironwood ducebat, non potuit non animadvertisse eum paulo in circulo ambulare.

unit.source: “Kid!”
unit.target: “Puer!”

unit.source: The little menace turned around, and he could see in their eyes that they were trying not to laugh.
unit.target: Parvus vexator se vertit, et in oculis eius videbat eos conari non ridere.

unit.source: “Yes, mister? Whatever is the issue?”
unit.target: “Ita, domine? Quid est problema?”

unit.source: Sam couldn’t help but snort again.
unit.target: Sam iterum sputavit.

unit.source: “I thought fey tended to keep to their deals…” he said, finally taking a stab in the dark.
unit.target: “Putabam fey pacta sua tueri…” inquit, postremo in obscuro conamine incipiens.

unit.source: For a moment, it was as if time froze, and then the smile on the kid’s face grew into a disproportional size.
unit.target: Ad momentum, quasi tempus congelatum esset, et deinde risus in facie pueri ad ingentem dimensionem crevit.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but shudder a little.
unit.target: Non potuit nisi paulum tremere.

unit.source: “We do,” came the reply, though instead of the squeaky voice of a child, it was an eerie and echo‑y voice.
unit.target: “Facimus,” inquit, sed non voce stridula pueri, sed voce terribiliter resonante.

unit.source: “Then why are we going in circles?”
unit.target: “Cur ergo in circulos ambulamus?”

unit.source: The fey in the kid’s body just shrugged, the freaky smile still on their face.
unit.target: Fey, in corpore pueri, tantum umeros sublatit, cum risus insolitus in vultu eius adhuc maneret.

unit.source: “You were being followed, now you aren’t.”
unit.target: “Te secuti erant, nunc autem non sunt.”

unit.source: “And you’re helping me. Why?”
unit.target: “Atque me adiuvas. Cur?”

unit.source: “I’m not helping you. I’m helping the city. This is where I store my stuff. I would like if it stayed as it is,” came the clipped reply.
unit.target: “Non te adiuvo; urbem adiuvo. Hic res meas condō. Velim ut ita maneat,” inquit breviter.

unit.source: Sam thought about it for a second, and in the end, he had to agree with the kid.
unit.target: Sam de hoc per momentum cogitavit, et denique cum puero consentire debuit.

unit.source: “That makes sense,” with that he motioned for the fey to continue towards their goal, but the kid didn’t move an inch.
unit.target: “Id sensum facit,” inquit, et fey ad propositum pergredi iussit, sed puer ne quanti quidem passus movebat.

unit.source: “Ah, ah, ah! You asked a question! And there are no freebies here!”
unit.target: “Ah, ah, ah! Quaestionem posuisti! Et hic nulla gratuita sunt!”

unit.source: He cursed internally, while also making a note to read up on the rules of the fey. But he didn’t reply, refusing to acknowledge his ‘debt’.
unit.target: Intus maledixit atque simul notam fecit ut de regulis fey perlegeret; sed non respondit, recusans agnoscere debitum suum.

unit.source: The smile, as if possible, got even wider on the kid’s face.
unit.target: Risus in facie pueri, quasi amplius fieri posset, etiam latius factus est.

unit.source: “How about a question for a question?”
unit.target: “Quid de quaestione pro quaestione?”

unit.source: Sam nodded in agreement.
unit.target: Sam annuit in consensu.

unit.source: “Excellent! My question is as follows: How did you know?”
unit.target: “Optime! Quaestio mea est: Quomodo cognovisti?”

unit.source: He almost chuckled at the question.
unit.target: Paene risit ex quaestione.

unit.source: “No street urchin behaves like you. Fey are notorious for making deals. So, I made an educated guess. You just confirmed it,” he answered with a smirk.
unit.target: “Nullus mendiculus in via se gerit ut tu. Fey noti sunt ob pacta facienda; ergo conieci, et nunc id confirmasti,” respondit cum subridente.

unit.source: The eyes on the kid went round in surprise, but then the kid flashed him a smile that contained more teeth than what was possible, and once again between two blinks, the dirty street urchin was back before him without the creepy smile.
unit.target: Oculi pueri in stupefactione circumvolaverunt, sed deinde puer ei subripuit risum, qui plura dentes continebat quam fieri poterat, et post duas contractiones palpebrarum, mendiculus sordidus viae ante eum apparuit sine risu terribili.

unit.source: “Let’s continue our journey, good sir!” they spoke up as if the previous discussion hadn’t happened.
unit.target: “Pergamus iter nostrum, bone domine!” iniecerunt, quasi prior disputatio non fuisset.

unit.source: Sam looked around, but somehow nobody walked by or showed up while they had their conversation.
unit.target: Sam circumspiciebat, sed nullo modo aliquis praeterebat aut apparebat dum sermonem agebantur.

unit.source: He shuddered again, and while walking behind the kid, he berated himself for being careless.
unit.target: Iterum tremuit, et dum puerum sequebat, se ipse reprobatum habuit propter negligentiam.

unit.source: That could have gone worse…
unit.target: Hoc peius evenire poterat…

unit.source: After a few minutes, they finally arrived at a surprisingly nice building.
unit.target: Post paucos minuta, tandem ad aedificium mirum iucundum pervenerunt.

unit.source: The kid stopped before the door, then turned towards him with a hand held out, waiting for their pay.
unit.target: Puer ante ostium sistit, deinde ad eum convertit atque manum protulit, mercedem exspectans.

unit.source: “Are you sure?”
unit.target: “Certus es?”

unit.source: “Yes, sir. The man you are looking for is inside.”
unit.target: “Ita, domine. Vir quem quaeris intus est.”

unit.source: “Good.”
unit.target: “Bene.”

unit.source: He pulled out the promised six silver and placed it gently in the kid’s hand.
unit.target: Se promissos sex nummos argenteos eduxit et leniter in manu pueri posuit.

unit.source: However, when he pulled back his hand, one coin seemed to be stuck to his skin.
unit.target: Attamen, cum manum retraxit, unus nummus quasi ad cutem eius adhaeret.

unit.source: As he stared at it curiously, the kid spoke up.
unit.target: Dum illud curiosus intuens erat, puer locutus est.

unit.source: “A little memory for our first meeting…”
unit.target: “Parva memoria pro nostra prima congressione…”

unit.source: He looked at the coin, which, instead of the seal of the kingdom, now was totally unadorned, except for a simple butterfly symbol.
unit.target: Aspiciens nummum, qui pro sigillo regni nunc omnino inornatus erat, nisi simplici symbolo papilionis.

unit.source: He looked up, but the kid was gone.
unit.target: Elevavit oculos, sed puer evanuerat.

unit.source: Instead, he was greeted by several notifications.
unit.target: Pro eo, varias notificationes eum excipiebant.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you figured out the secret identity of a Fey! You may choose to gain 1 WIS and lose 1 LUK, or gain 1 LUK and lose 1 WIS!]
unit.target: [Gratulations, secretam identitatem Fey perspexisti! Potes eligere ut 1 WIS accipias et 1 LUK amittas, aut 1 LUK accipias et 1 WIS amittas!]

unit.source: Sam stared at the screen for a moment, then spoke up.
unit.target: Sam per momentum ad scrinium intuebatur, deinde locutus est.

unit.source: “I choose neither.”
unit.target: “Utrumque non eligam.”

unit.source: There was a moment of silence, and another screen popped up.
unit.target: Fuit momentum silentii, et iterum scrinium apparuit.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you made a smart decision! You gain +1 PER!]
unit.target: [Gratulations, sapienter decrevist! Accipis +1 PER!]

unit.source: Nodding proudly, he continued to read.
unit.target: Superbus annuens, continuavit legere.

unit.source: [You received a Token of Friendship from a Fey!]
unit.target: [Accepisti Tessera Amicitiae a Fey!]

unit.source: [It is up to you to decide if it is a good thing or a bad thing!]
unit.target: [In te est decernere utrum id bonum sit aut malum!]

unit.source: [Token of Friendship (Fey): A coin bearing the mark of the fey. Can be exchanged for favors with the fey. Be warned, they are not obligated to accept it.]
unit.target: [Tessera Amicitiae (Fey): Nummus sigillum Fey gerens. Pro favoribus cum Fey commutari potest. Moneor: non obligantur eam recipere.]

unit.source: “Well, that seems supremely useless…” Sam thought, then with a shrug put the token into his inventory and turned towards the house.
unit.target: “Ita, hoc videtur summopere inutile…” cogitavit Sam; deinde tessera in inventarium suum recondidit atque ad domum se vertit.

unit.source: He had a nice lady to save…
unit.target: Habebat mulierem pulchram ad servandum…

unit.source: The house from the outside looked old but well cared for.
unit.target: Domus exterius vetusta, sed diligenter conservata videbatur.

unit.source: A few potted plants were hanging from the upstairs window; the walls were clean of the usual grime that became really familiar to Sam during his short journey with the little fey.
unit.target: Paucae plantae in vasis e fenestra superiori pendent; muri ab sordibus solitis expurgati erant, quae Sam in brevi itinere cum parva nympha valde notissima erant.

unit.source: The only thing that was really unusual about the house was the complete lack of decoration made of iron.
unit.target: Unum quidem, quod vere insolitum de domo apparuit, fuit defectus absolutus ornamentorum ex ferro factorum.

unit.source: Instead, every facet of the house was made from the famous ironwood.
unit.target: Pro eo, omnis pars domus ex ligno ferreo celeberrimo facta erat.

unit.source: Even the doorknob was made from the material.
unit.target: Etiam manubrium ianuae ex eodem ligno ferreo factum erat.

unit.source: This alone convinced Sam that he was in the right place.
unit.target: Hoc solum Sam certum habuit se in loco recto esse.

unit.source: Squaring his shoulders, taking another look around, he stepped forward and, with a hand that hesitated only a little, knocked on the door.
unit.target: Humeros aequatos constituens, aliam circumspectans, processit et, manu parum morantis, ianuam pulsavit.

unit.source: He waited for almost a minute when he finally could hear someone walking very slowly towards the door.
unit.target: Paene minutum exspectavit, cum tandem audire potuit aliquem lente ad ianuam ambulantem.

unit.source: And when the door opened, he almost expected an extremely old man, in a bathrobe and slippers.
unit.target: Et cum ianua aperta esset, paene senem expectabat, indutum vestimento balneario et calceis mollibus.

unit.source: Which was almost true.
unit.target: Quod paene verum erat.

unit.source: The man who opened the door was wearing something like a robe, though it was definitively not a bathrobe, and the shoes on his feet were more like very fluffy loafers than slippers.
unit.target: Vir, qui ianua aperuit, vestem quidam similem gerebat, quamquam certe non erat vestis balnearia, et calcei in pedibus eius magis erant similes calceorum lanigerorum quam solearum.

unit.source: He was also wearing a rather respectable beard and mustache combo, all of it in silver‑white with a few blacks, and for some reason, green strands of hair mixed in.
unit.target: Etiam se gerens barbam et mustacium mixturam dignam, totum in albo argenteo cum paucis nigrioribus, et—quaedam causa—viridibus capillis interpositis.

unit.source: The old man also had rather impressively bushy eyebrows that rose the moment he saw Sam standing at the door.
unit.target: Senex etiam supercilia valde densissima habebat, quae statim surrexere, cum Sam ad ianuam stantem videbat.

unit.source: Sam also felt a very delicate and gentle mana pulse go through him, no doubt looking for anything that could be a danger to the old man.
unit.target: Sam etiam sensit subtilis et mitis vis magicae pulsus per se transire, sine dubio quaerens quidquid senem in discrimen adducere posset.

unit.source: They spent the next dozen or so seconds staring at each other when the old man just sighed and spoke up.
unit.target: Inter se aspicientes, per circiter duodecim secunda, senex tandem suspiravit et loqui coepit.

unit.source: "Well, what do you want?” his voice was old, but the expected weakness that was ever present in every old person Sam ever talked with was not present.
unit.target: "Quid vis?" vox eius antiqua erat, sed infirmitas exspectata, quae in omnibus senibus cum quibus Sam locutus erat, absens erat.

unit.source: Instead, his voice radiated a certain power that caused a small shiver to run down Sam’s spine.
unit.target: Proinde, vox eius emittens erat certa potentia, quae parvum tremorem in spina Sam excitavit.

unit.source: "Good day, Sir!” replied Sam, followed by a respectful bow of the head.
unit.target: "Bonum diem, domine!" respondit Sam, deinde caput reverenter inclinans.

unit.source: "I’m here to ask you a few questions.”
unit.target: "Venio ut te quaedam interrogem."

unit.source: "About what?”
unit.target: "Quid de re?"

unit.source: "The ironwoods, sir.”
unit.target: "De ligno ferreo, domine."

unit.source: While Sam wanted to be circumspect, he knew that the only in with the old man was by being truthful.
unit.target: Dum Sam circumspectus esse vellet, sciebat solum per sinceritatem viro senex placere.

unit.source: And who knows, maybe he was powerful enough to see through his lies.
unit.target: Et quis scit; fortasse tam potens esset ut mendacia eius perspiceret.

unit.source: The old man’s eyes narrowed at him the moment he spoke, and Sam could feel the gentle magic settle around him, now with a slight edge to it.
unit.target: Oculi senis in eum contracti sunt, simul cum locutus esset, et Sam sensit vim magicam lenem circa se consedisse, nunc leviter acuta.

unit.source: "I know nuttin’!” The answer came out more of a growl than actual speech, while the magic around Sam turned from containing a slight edge to being a literal storm of magic, poised to destroy him.
unit.target: "Nihil scio!" Responsum plus rugitus quam sermo fuit, dum vis magica circum Sam a leviter acuta ad veram tempestatem magicam convertit, paratam eum perdere.

unit.source: So he talked. Fast.
unit.target: Itaque, celeriter locutus est.

unit.source: "The Silvercrest family sent me! To help them recover the Chalice of…”
unit.target: "Familia Silvercrest me misit! Ut eos adiuvarem Calix Coercitionis recuperare…"

unit.source: "...Restraint,” finished the old man for him, a scowl on his face.
unit.target: "...Coercitionem," finivit senex pro eo, vultu contrecto.

unit.source: And to Sam’s relief, the mana surrounding him quieted down a little.
unit.target: Et, ad solacium Sam, vis magica circa eum leviter quietata est.

unit.source: But then the older man fell silent, looking directly at him, and Sam would have sworn that he looked through him, searching for something.
unit.target: Sed deinde senex tacuit, directe in eum aspiciens, et Sam iuravit se eum pervigilare, aliquid quaerens.

unit.source: Finally, after several minutes of uncomfortable silence, the man sighed, the mana vanished, and he began to turn around while spitting out a few words.
unit.target: Denique, post paucis minutis silentii molestissimi, vir suspiravit, vis magica evanuit, et convertere coepit dum pauca verba exsputabat.

unit.source: "You better come in then…”
unit.target: "Melius ut intres…"

unit.source: Sam let out a relieved sigh, shook himself, and stepped through the doorstop while desperately ignoring the haunting laughter originating from somewhere in the street.
unit.target: Sam leviter suspiravit, se concussit, et per limen ianuae processit, desperanter ignorans risum lugubrium, ex platea provenientem.

unit.source: The interior of the house was reminiscent of the exterior.
unit.target: Interior domus exteriori similis erat.

unit.source: Simple, but well kept.
unit.target: Simplicis, sed bene conservata.

unit.source: Lots of potted plants, several comfortable chairs, a merrily roaring fireplace, and shelves full of books that were no doubt full of mysterious secrets that most mage guilds would sacrifice the firstborns of their guild masters to possess.
unit.target: Multae plantae in vasis, plurima sedilia commoda, et focus hilariter crepitans, et scrinia libris referta, quae indubitanter arcana mysteria replebant, pro quibus pleraque collegia magorum primogenitos magistrorum suorum immolabant.

unit.source: The old ranger, Marak, led him from the door through a corridor to a living room and bade Sam to sit in one of the armchairs in front of the fireplace, while he gingerly sat down in the other one.
unit.target: Senex custos silvarum, Marak, eum a ianua per corridorium ad triclinum duxit et iussit Sam ut in una sella ante focum consederet, dum ipse caute in alia sede consedit.

unit.source: He watched as the old man let out a content sigh as he eased himself into the chair with closed eyes, then turned his attention to the rest of the room, waiting for the other man to call on him.
unit.target: Observavit senem suspirare contentum, dum oculos clausos habens in sellam se commode demittebat, deinde aliam partem cubiculi attendens, exspectans alterum eum ad loquendum vocare.

unit.source: He was very aware of the fact that as far as the other man was concerned; he was practically nothing on the power scale.
unit.target: Valde animadvertit se, quatenus altero, fere nihil esse in scala potentiae.

unit.source: Even his skill Discernment was only telling him that there was no chance of a snowball in hellfire that he could defeat the old ranger.
unit.target: Etiam ars ipsius, Discernmentum, indicabat nullam esse occasionem, quo globo nivis in igne infero senem custodem superare posset.

unit.source: At least the skill leveled up.
unit.target: Saltem ars in gradum altiorem elevata est.

unit.source: After another uncomfortable silence, the older man finally opened his eyes, and Sam felt another pulse of mana sweep through him and then through the room, finally stopping at the walls.
unit.target: Post alium silentium molestum, senex senior tandem oculos aperuit, et Sam sensit aliam impulsionem vis magicae per se et per cubiculi spatiem fluere, denique ad muros consistere.

unit.source: ‘Probably for security…’ he thought as he looked apprehensively at the ranger sitting across from him, while the fire merrily burned, letting out a few sparks and odd cracks.
unit.target: ‘Fortasse ad securitatem…’ cogitavit, dum sollicitus aspiciebat custodem silvarum sedentem trans eum, dum focus iucunde ardebat, paucas scintillas et insolitas crepitus sonos emittens.

unit.source: "The artifact you seek… The Silvercrest family seeks, exists,” began the ranger, looking directly into Sam’s eyes.
unit.target: "Artifactum quod quaeris… quod Familia Silvercrest quaerit, existit," inceptavit custos, directe in oculos Sam spectans.

unit.source: "However, there is a problem…”
unit.target: "Attamen, quaestio est…"

unit.source: "Of course, there is a problem,” exclaimed Sam, rolling his eyes.
unit.target: "Certe, problema est," exclamavit Sam, oculos volvens.

unit.source: "What is it? Was it stolen? A powerful monster decided to nest at the place it was hidden? Let me guess, there was even a prophecy about it?”
unit.target: "Quid est? Furtumne factum est? An monstrum potentissimum, in loco ubi celatum erat, nidum condidit? Conjecturo: etiam vaticinium de eo fuisse?"

unit.source: The old man stared at him for a few seconds, then chuckled a little.
unit.target: Senex eum per pauca secunda aspiciens, deinde parum risit.

unit.source: "No prophecy, young man, so you don’t have to worry about that.”
unit.target: "Nullum vaticinium, iuvenis, ergo de eo non curandum est."

unit.source: "Then what do I have to worry about?”
unit.target: "Quid ergo mihi curandum est?"

unit.source: "There is indeed a powerful monster.”
unit.target: "Revera, monstrum potentissimum est."

unit.source: "Well, great… What is it? And why is it still alive if the Chalice is where I think it is?”
unit.target: "Bene, optime… Quid est? Et cur adhuc vivat, si Calix Coercitionis in loco, quem puto esse, sit?"

unit.source: Marak’s eyes narrowed at him at that, but he still answered.
unit.target: Marak oculos in eum adstrictos habuit, sed tamen respondit.

unit.source: "It is alive because we don’t know what the monster is. It is a powerful illusion user, and none of us are that good with them.”
unit.target: "Illud vivit, quia nesciamus quid monstrum sit. Illud est usor potentissimus illusionum, et nemo nostrum in his tam peritus est."

unit.source: "What do you mean us?” asked Sam, now officially curious.
unit.target: "Quid significas 'nos'?" inquit Sam, nunc vere curiosus.

unit.source: He wasn’t really worried about the illusion monster.
unit.target: De illo monstro illusionum non vere sollicitus erat.

unit.source: At this level, it could only be a few things, and the area allowed him to further narrow it down.
unit.target: In hoc gradu, id solum paucis rebus esse poterat, et regio eum ulterius circumscribere sinit.

unit.source: "The guardians of the woods,” came the simple reply.
unit.target: "Custodes silvarum," respondit simplex.

unit.source: "We walk the woods, protect them and make sure the cycle of life continues…”
unit.target: "Ambulamus per silvas, eas protegemus, et curamus ut circulus vitae permaneret…"

unit.source: "Why not call in some outside expert?”
unit.target: "Cur non advocamus aliquem peritum exterius?"

unit.source: The old ranger shook his head.
unit.target: Senex custos caput concussit.

unit.source: "Too big a chance that our secret would get out. Plus, the monster was content to stay there… Nobody needed that area.”
unit.target: "Nam nimis magna erat occasio ut nostrum secretum efferretur; insuper monstrum ibi manere contentum erat… Nemo illam regionem requirebat."

unit.source: "Until now…”
unit.target: "Usque nunc…"

unit.source: "Until now, yes.”
unit.target: "Usque nunc, quidem."

unit.source: There was another silence as the two of them stared at each other until Sam sighed.
unit.target: Aliud silentium inter eos constantem fuit, dum se inter se intuabant, donec Sam suspiravit.

unit.source: "Let me guess… You want me to go there and try to get rid of the monster?”
unit.target: "Coniecturam fac… Visne ut ibi irem et monstrum depellam?"

unit.source: "Hmm, I suppose… If you want to,” came the answer, with a slight smirk on the man’s face.
unit.target: "Hmm, opinor… Si vis," respondit, leviter subridens vultu.

unit.source: "Well, I don’t particularly want to, I need to…” replied Sam, thinking back to the Blood Contract he had signed with a slight ache in his heart.
unit.target: "Bene, non mihi maxime placet, sed necesse est..." respondit Sam, reminiscens Pactum Sanguinum quod subscripserat, cum leve dolore in corde.

unit.source: And based on how the smirk widened on the old man’s face, Sam was pretty sure the man also knew he was under the contract.
unit.target: Et ex modo quo vultus senis subridet, Sam satis certus erat eum etiam scire se sub pacto esse.

unit.source: Curse his bleeding heart…
unit.target: Maledicat cor sanguinolentum!

unit.source: "Indeed, sometimes the need for adventure is just too great! Were I a few decades younger, why, I would be joining you right out of the door, such is the call of the adventure!” spoke the man, his entire tone filled with laughter.
unit.target: "Revera, aliquando necessitas adventurae nimis magna est! Si paucis annis minus essem, ex ianua te adiunxerim, tanta est vocatio adventurae!" inquit vir, totum risu impletum.

unit.source: "Very funny,” retorted Sam, glaring.
unit.target: "Valde iocosum," refertavit Sam, aspiciens acerrime.

unit.source: "Now tell me what you want me to do, and I’ll leave you staring uselessly at the fire.”
unit.target: "Nunc dic mihi quid vis ut faciam, et te relinquam ad ignem stultum spectantem."

unit.source: The old ranger snorted, but the grin didn’t leave his face.
unit.target: Senex custos sibilavit, sed risus eius in facie manebat.

unit.source: "Very well, my young friend. I suppose an adventurous spirit like yours should be rewarded!” he exclaimed then jumped out of his chair, completely ignoring his age and stepped up to one of the shelves that was filled to the brim with books, scrolls and stray sheets of papers and parchments.
unit.target: "Optime, iuvenis amice. Opinor spiritum adventurosum tuum remunerandum esse!" exclamavit, deinde e sella subsiluit, aetate sua prorsus neglexa, et accessit ad scrinium unum, quod libris, volumina, schedis et membranis dispersis plenum erat.

unit.source: Sam watched as the man searched for a few seconds before exclaiming.
unit.target: Sam aspiciebat dum vir per pauca secunda quaerebat, deinde exclamavit.

unit.source: "Aha!”
unit.target: "Ahā!"

unit.source: Then he retrieved a scroll wedged between a book titled ‘Bounciest places in all the Kingdom” and another titled “You and your tools, how to protect them but still keep them useful!”
unit.target: Deinde evolvit scrollum inter librum titulado "Loca maxime saltabilia in toto Regno" et alium titulado "Tu et Instrumenta Tua: Quomodo Ea Protegeris Sed Utilia Servabis!"

unit.source: Sam just shook his head.
unit.target: Sam solum caput concussit.

unit.source: ‘Pervy old man…’
unit.target: "Lascivus senex…"

unit.source: The man thankfully couldn’t read his thoughts and returned with the scroll and, with a quick and decisive motion, unrolled it on the small table between the two chairs.
unit.target: Vir, gratias, cogitationes eius legere non potuit, et rediit cum scrollo, et celeriter ac certissime illud super parvam mensam inter duas sellas evolvit.

unit.source: Sam leaned forward and quickly took in the map that was revealed to him.
unit.target: Sam se inclinavit et celeriter mappam, quae ei ostensa erat, intuens accepit.

unit.source: "The city is here, and you need to go there,” pointed out the old man, his gnarled fingers moving through the map as Sam scrambled to memorize the route.
unit.target: "Haec urbs est, et ad eam ire debes," inquit senex, digitis rugosis per mappam movens, dum Sam iter meminisse conabatur.

unit.source: "And what am I doing when I get there?” He asked, not daring to look away from the map.
unit.target: "Quid agam, cum ad eam pervenerim?" inquit, non ausus mappam relinquere.

unit.source: The grin on the old ranger’s face was even bigger.
unit.target: Risus in facie senis custodi maiorem erat.

unit.source: "What else, but what do you need to do? Deal with the monster, retrieve the treasure, and save the damsel. You know, my young but foolish friend, standard adventurer stuff…”
unit.target: "Quid aliud, nisi quid facias? Pugna cum monstro, thesaurum recupera, et puellam salva; scis, iuvenis sed insipienter amice, haec sunt munera vulgares adventurarum…"

unit.source: "Any other helpful information?”
unit.target: "Alia notitia utilis?"

unit.source: "Yes.”
unit.target: "Ita."

unit.source: Sam just stayed silent.
unit.target: Sam silentium retinuit.

unit.source: "Make sure to prepare to deal with illusions.”
unit.target: "Praepara te ad illusiones superandas."

unit.source: He threw an incredulous look at the other man, who simply raised his hands defensively.
unit.target: Incredulus eum aspexit, et ille simpliciter manus suas extulit ad defensionem faciendam.

unit.source: "Just wanted to make sure. You never know with adventurers… Most of them are in the belief if they swing their swords hard enough, they would get through everything!”
unit.target: "Modo certiorem facere volui. Nescis enim de adventurīs… Plurimi putant, si gladios satis fortiter ferant, omnia superare posse!"

unit.source: Sam just sighed again.
unit.target: Sam iterum suspiravit.

unit.source: "Alright, just tell me what you know about the monster…”
unit.target: "Bene, dic mihi quid de monstro nosti…"

unit.source: A few hours later he found himself in the eating hall of the Cloudy Day inn, angrily eating his dinner while staring at his screens.
unit.target: Paucis horis post, se in aula cenandi deversorii "Cloudy Day" invenit, cenam irate edens, dum in scrinia sua spectabat.

unit.source: [You received a new quest!]
unit.target: [Novum inceptum accepisti!]

unit.source: [To peek or not to peek?]
unit.target: [Inspicere an non inspicere?]

unit.source: [Master Ranger Marak has told you of a mysterious illusion using monster plaguing the area where an artifact you seek resides. Your task is to scout out the monster and hopefully deal with it, in any way you decide.]
unit.target: [Magister custos silvarum Marak tibi narravit de monstro usore illusionum mysterioso, qui in regione, ubi residet artifactum quod quaeris, infestat. Officium tuum est monstrum explorare atque, fortasse, quacumque ratione, cum eo agere.]

unit.source: [Time Limit: As long as Lady Silvercrest lives.]
unit.target: [Terminus temporis: quoad domina Silvercrest vivit.]

unit.source: [Failure: Lady Silvercrest dies. The Chalice of Restraint gets destroyed.]
unit.target: [Defectus: Domina Silvercrest moritur. Calix Coercitionis delebitur.]

unit.source: [Penalty: Death. The Fey will be angry with you.]
unit.target: [Poena: Mors. Fae te irascent.]

unit.source: [Reward: Chance to retrieve the Chalice of Restraint. A reward from Master Ranger Marak. Additional rewards are possible.]
unit.target: [Praemium: Occasio Calix Coercitionis recuperandi. Praemium a Magistro Custode Silvarum Marak. Praemia addita possibilia sunt.]

unit.source: Because of course, the sub‑quest could be complicated!
unit.target: Nam scilicet, sub quaestio esse poterat intricata!

unit.source: At least the rewards were good.
unit.target: Saltem praemia bona erant.

unit.source: As Sam thought about it, he realized that based on the tropes that were prevailing in his last life; he wasn’t supposed to kill the monster, but rather befriend it and turn it into an additional defender of the city of Ironwood. Probably…
unit.target: Cum Sam cogitaret, intellexit ex tropis, quae in vita sua priori vigebant, non oportere monstrum interficere, sed potius illud amicitiam suscipere atque additum in defensione civitatis Ligni Ferrei convertere. Probabiliter…

unit.source: Sadly, the information he received from the old man wasn’t enough to narrow it down enough to make sure his preparations were hundred percent successful.
unit.target: Tristiter, notitiae a viro senior receptae non suffecerunt ad eam totam determinandam, ut praeparationes eius centum per centum prospere evenirent.

unit.source: Finishing his meal, he stood up and began to murmur.
unit.target: Cenam finita, surrexit et murmurare coepit.

unit.source: "Welp, time to do some research!”
unit.target: "Heu, tempus est ad inquisitionem exercendam!"

unit.source: It was mostly for the game system to know what he was thinking, as it would be rather hard to explain how he knew how to deal with dozens of different illusion‑using monsters.
unit.target: Id maxime erat, ut systema ludi sciret quid cogitaret, nam difficillimum esset explicare quomodo cum multitudine monstrorum, qui illusionibus uterentur, agere posset.

unit.source: Then bidding goodbye to the waitress, thanking her for the food, he returned to his room, played with Lucky a little, then laid down on the bed, and simply logged out.
unit.target: Deinde, ministram valedicitans et ei pro cibis gratias agens, ad cubiculum rediit, pauulum cum Lucky luserit, deinde in lecto se collocavit, et sessionem ludens simpliciter finivit.

unit.source: Sam went through his routine, then after angrily eating something to sate his hunger, he sat in his office for a few minutes and stared at his whiteboard, trying to divine some kind of information from it.
unit.target: Sam consuetudinem suam egit, et postquam irate aliquid edens famem saturavit, in officio suo per aliquot minuta sedebat et tabulam album intuens quaedam notitia divinabat.

unit.source: Sadly, the other Sam didn’t have anything on his current quest.
unit.target: Tristiter, alter Sam nihil de sua quaestione praesentis habebat.

unit.source: By the time he joined the game, the city of Ironwood was already rebuilding from the effects of the Monster Break.
unit.target: Cum in ludum se redierit, urbs Ligni Ferrei iam ex effectibus Monstri Rupturae reconstructa erat.

unit.source: Sighing, he shook his head, stood up from his thinking stool and went to his computer.
unit.target: Suspirans, caput concussit, ex sellis cogitandi surrexit et ad computatrum suum ivit.

unit.source: Might as well cheer himself up by checking on how the troll hunt was going.
unit.target: Fortasse se alacer facere posset, intuentem quomodo venatio trollorum procederet.

unit.source: Unfortunately, it wasn’t meant to be.
unit.target: Infeliciter, non evenit.

unit.source: The moment he pulled up the first news site that talked about Magic Unbound, he was instantly bombarded with headlines.
unit.target: Cum primum situm nuntiorum, qui de Magia Unbound disserebat, aperuisset, statim tituli eum oppresserunt.

unit.source: Troll hunt gets trollish
unit.target: "Venatio trollorum trollesce fit."

unit.source: Magic Unbound is the new game to troll people
unit.target: "Magia Unbound est novum ludum ad homines trollendos."

unit.source: Troll-ololo! The hunt is on!
unit.target: "Troll-ololo! Venatio incipit!"

unit.source: And so on, as far as his eyes could see.
unit.target: "Et cetera, quantum oculi eius videre poterant."

unit.source: Apparently, the game exploded.
unit.target: Apparenter, ludus explosus est.

unit.source: Sitting up straighter, he began to browse the net, checking everything out.
unit.target: Sedit rectius, et per rete omnia explorare coepit.

unit.source: Minutes later, he sat back and began to massage his temples.
unit.target: Minutis post, se iterum consedit et tempora sua leniter tractare coepit.

unit.source: Apparently, by revealing the secret of the Life of Blood skill book, he set so many guilds against each other that the fights and skirmishes between them caught the attention of a few big‑name streamers (and of course uncountable no‑name streamers) and from there it was like a runaway train.
unit.target: Apparenter, secreto libri artis "Vitae Sanguinis" revelando, tot collegia inter se adversa instituit, ut pugnae et brevissima proelia inter eas notitiam paucorum emissariorum famosorum (ac innumerorum ignotorum) attigerent, atque inde, ut tramen effugitum, omnia celeriter evenirent.

unit.source: Based on the official number on the official site of the game, the number of players already jumped by a magnitude.
unit.target: Secundum numerum in situ officiali ludi, numerus lusorum iam per magnitudinem creverat.

unit.source: He stared at the counter as it slowly but surely ticked up and couldn’t help but curse himself.
unit.target: Aspiciebat numerationem, dum lente sed certissime augeretur, et se maledicere non potuit.

unit.source: "Architect of my own demise…” he exclaimed softly while leaning back and putting his hand on his eyes. “Why couldn’t I keep my mouth shut?”
unit.target: "Architectus ipsius exitii mei..." exclamavit leniter, dum recubans et manum super oculos posuens. "Cur os meum non retinere potui?"

unit.source: "Stupid, stupid, Sam! The butterfly effect! The more you do, the more things change!” he lambasted himself.
unit.target: "Stulte, stulte, Sam! Effectus papilionis! Quo plura fecisti, eo magis res mutantur!" maledixit sibi.

unit.source: Then, with a growl, he returned his attention to the screen and began his research anew.
unit.target: Deinde, cum rugitu, mentem suam ad scrinium redegit et iterum inquisitionem coepit.

unit.source: If things changed, then his plans would also have to change.
unit.target: Si res mutantur, consilia eius quoque mutanda erunt.

unit.source: He returned to the game in a foul mood.
unit.target: In ludum se rediit in animo misero.

unit.source: Barely giving Lucky a quick pat on his head, he immediately headed out, leaving the staff perturbed, as he was usually very kind to them.
unit.target: Paene Lucky caput celeriter pulsat, et statim exiit, operarios perturbatos relinquens, cum plerumque eis benignus esset.

unit.source: Thankfully, the new people were still stuck in the beginner towns, but soon they would be let loose…
unit.target: Gratias, novi adhuc in oppidis initiatorum haerebantur, sed mox liberabuntur…

unit.source: He took a quick trip to the alchemist, buying some sparklescale powder, which allowed one to cover invisible enemies, causing them to become sparkling, which allowed people to hunt them.
unit.target: Celerem iter ad alchymistam fecit, emens pulverem squamiformem micantem, qui hostes invisibiles operire, eos micantes reddere, quo homines eos venari poterant.

unit.source: Then a few more potions, and then simply began power walking towards the gate that would allow him to begin his journey to the area where Old Marak told him the monster was.
unit.target: Postea paucae potionum, deinde simpliciter ambulare celeriter coepit ad portam, quae ei iter ad regionem incipiendam concederet, ubi senex Marak monstrum esse dixerat.

unit.source: A few people stepped away in fright as the young man stalked through the streets with a blood‑thirsty smile on his face.
unit.target: Pauci, metu captati, recedebant, dum iuvenis per vias insidians, vultu sanguine sitiente et risu ferocissimo ambulabat.

unit.source: With Lucky in his shadow, his so‑far trusty sword at his side, and his repaired armor on him, Sam stepped out of the city, dodging the crowds that seemed to have swelled another size since he posted his stupid post and began heading towards his goal.
unit.target: Cum Lucky in umbra eius, gladio fideli iuxta se, et armatura reparata induta, Sam e civitate egreditur, turbam vitans quae, postquam stultum nuntium suum edidit, quasi magis augebat, ac ad finem suum properabat.

unit.source: Thankfully, dungeons weren’t a thing yet, so he knew he would have to fight the unknown monster out in the wild.
unit.target: Gratias, speluncae nondum institutae erant, ideoque scivit se in regione agreste ignotum monstrum pugnare debere.

unit.source: Which made things easier and at the same time harder.
unit.target: Quod simul rem faciliorem et simul difficiliorem reddidit.

unit.source: Understandably, dungeons made things easier because they were instanced content that somewhat scaled in difficulty to the number of people that entered them.
unit.target: Intelligenter, speluncae rem faciliorem fecerunt, quoniam contenta erant singularia, quorum difficultas paulatim pro numero intrantium evoluta est.

unit.source: And this instanced content ensured the security of the people who entered them.
unit.target: Et haec contenta singularia securitatem intrantium confirmabant.

unit.source: But with this came the danger.
unit.target: Sed cum his periculum venit.
