unit.source: More powerful monsters, more traps and environmental hazards and so on.
unit.target: Monstra potentiora, laqueos multiplices atque pericula ambientalia ceteraque.

unit.source: While in the open world, monsters were easier to attack, ambush and defeat due to players being able to make use of the environment.
unit.target: In mundo aperto, monstra facile oppugnari, insidiari atque vincere videbantur, quia lusores circumiecta uti poterant.

unit.source: Yet, at the same time, this made it much harder to do it.
unit.target: At eodem tempore, hoc idem facere multo difficilius faciebat.

unit.source: Because if you could ambush the boss monster, other people could also ambush you.
unit.target: Nam si poteras ducem monstrorum insidiari, alii te quoque insidiari poterant.

unit.source: Or if you are very unlucky, then simply a party that was travelling by would spot you trying to fight the monster.
unit.target: Aut, si valde infortunatus esses, pars itinerans te deprehenderet, quod monstrum pugnare conaris.

unit.source: In the best‑case scenario, they would acknowledge your right to the monster and leave.
unit.target: In optimo casu, ius tuum ad monstrum agnoscerent et discesserent.

unit.source: In the worst, you would be fighting two battles at the same time.
unit.target: In pessimo casu, bis simul pugnare deberes.

unit.source: If you saw them coming…
unit.target: Si eos advenientes videris…

unit.source: As Sam walked along the road leading away from the town, once again wearing a different face thanks to his awesome mask, he couldn’t help but smirk, thinking about the chaos he caused with his post.
unit.target: Dum Sam per viam discedentem e oppido ambulabat, iterum faciem aliam gestans propter mirabile larvam suam, non potuit impediri ridere, cogitans de tumultu quod post nuntium suum intulit.

unit.source: The guilds around Ironwood and anywhere where trolls could be found were at each other’s throats, fighting tooth and nail to acquire the Life of Blood skill book.
unit.target: Gildae circa Ironwood et ubique ubi troli inveni possent, inter se in acerrima contentionem erant, digito et unguie pugnantes, ut librum artium “Vitae Sanguinis” adipiscerentur.

unit.source: It was such an amazing skill that everyone wanted it.
unit.target: Ars tam mirabilis erat ut omnes eam optarent.

unit.source: Which was a little deviation from his inherited memories.
unit.target: Quod paulo a memoria eius hereditariis discrepabat.

unit.source: In the future—that‑was the Life of Blood skill was famous, but it didn’t get such enormous fame as it did in his current timeline.
unit.target: In futuro, ars “Vitae Sanguinis” nota facta est, sed non tanta fama acceperat quam in suo tempore praesenti.

unit.source: Probably his post helped with it…
unit.target: Forsitan nuntius eius id adiuvit…

unit.source: His smirk turned into a chuckle at that thought.
unit.target: Subridens eius in cachinnum conversa est ex illa cogitatione.

unit.source: ‘Can’t wait until those two idiots figure out Blood Magic…’
unit.target: ‘Non possum exspectare donec illi duo stulti Magiam Sanguinis cognoscant…’

unit.source: While he walked, acting as if he was oblivious to the world, he was actually using all of his skills to make sure he wasn’t followed or there weren’t any random monsters or bandits hiding around.
unit.target: Dum ambulabat, quasi mundo insensibilis, re vera omnes artes suas utebatur, ut neque sequeretur neque monstra temere aut latrones latearent.

unit.source: His senses stretched as far as he could, feeling the mana in the air, in the forest and in the ground under him.
unit.target: Sensus eius procul extendebantur, sentiens manam in aere, in silva et in solo sub eo.

unit.source: His eyes were straining to see the smallest anomaly in the eccentric tapestry that the mana he saw was.
unit.target: Oculi eius minimas anomalias in insueta textura manae visum intendebant.

unit.source: His mana ticked up and down as he continuously used his skills, while the levels of Sam’s skills slowly but surely rose.
unit.target: Mana eius ascendebat et descendebat dum constanter artes suas utebatur, dum gradus artium Sam paulatim sed certim augebantur.

unit.source: After an hour on the road, whistling and seemingly traveling towards the next town over, he finally ascertained that nobody was on the road that seemed to be interested in him.
unit.target: Post horam in via, sibilans et quasi ad proximam urbem iter faciens, tandem animadvertit neminem eum curare.

unit.source: Granted the other travellers on the road, single people like him, a few merchant caravans, or lone carts drawn by all manner of beasts were there, but everybody was engrossed in their own lives.
unit.target: Certe alii viatores—solitarii ut ipse, quaedam caravae mercatorum, aut sola plaustra a variis bestiis tracta—adfuerunt, sed omnes suis rebus occupati erant.

unit.source: Even the players were more interested in talking about strategies and skill compositions or bragging about how many trolls they had already killed.
unit.target: Etiam lusores magis interestabant de consiliis et compositione artium disputare aut se iactare de numero troli iam necatorum.

unit.source: Nodding to himself, and spotting a rest station, which was basically a cleared part of the forest a few dozen yards away from the road proper, he slowly left the road and headed towards it.
unit.target: Suam annuens et stationem requiei, quae fere areae purgatae silvae paucis passibus a via principali separata erat, animadvertens, viam relicuit atque ad eam se contulit.

unit.source: He made a great show of stretching and groaning, despite not sensing anyone around there, but in case somebody was watching from the road, he wanted to make sure they only saw what he wanted them to see.
unit.target: Magnam ostentationem faciebat extendens se et gemens, quamquam neminem illic sentiret, sed, ne quis ex via aspiceret, curare volebat ut solum ea viderent quae ipse videre voluerat.

unit.source: ‘Probably wouldn’t fool a professional, but I’m not dealing with professionals… I hope…’ Sam thought as he glanced around.
unit.target: ‘Forsitan peritum non falleret, sed non cum peritoribus nego… spero…’ Sam cogitavit dum circumspiciebat.

unit.source: After all, it wasn’t paranoia if they were out to get you.
unit.target: Postremo, non erat insania, si te persequi conabantur.

unit.source: He spent a few minutes sitting on one of the logs that were in the rest station, drinking and snacking.
unit.target: Paucis momentis in uno ex lignis in stazione requiei sedens, bibens et levis edulia capiens, tempus consumpsit.

unit.source: Then, as he spotted a lull in the traffic on the road, and luckily a cloud hid the sun behind him, he stood up and softly exclaimed.
unit.target: Tum, cum inter motum vehiculorum in via quietem animadvertit, atque feliciter nubes solem post se abscondebat, surrexit et leniter exclamavit.

unit.source: “Shadow Cloak!”
unit.target: “Pallium Umbrae!”

unit.source: Instantly, his shadow shot up from under him, enveloping him and creating a sort of haze around him.
unit.target: Statim, umbra eius ex eo emergit, eum involvens atque velut nebula circa eum formans.

unit.source: At the same time, he jumped backward, then twisted in the air, and began running through the forest, away from the rest station and road.
unit.target: Eodem tempore, retrorsum saltavit, in aere se torquens, ac per silvas currere coepit, a stazione requiei et via recessus.

unit.source: He changed directions a few times, making sure to let the cooldown of Shadow Cloak go down, and restarting it every time he lost it.
unit.target: Quoties directionem mutavit, curavit ut tempus refrigescendi Pallii Umbrae sequeretur, atque quotiens eam amitteret, iterum inciperet.

unit.source: Finally, after running through the forest like a demented (but rather edgy) squirrel, he stopped in a clearing, breathing heavily, but grinning in happiness.
unit.target: Denique, postquam per silvas quasi insanus sciurus cucurrit, in aperta area constituit, graviter spirans, sed laetitia subridens.

unit.source: He always enjoyed playing ninja, and what he did was the same thing he did as a kid while playing around, but with superpowers.
unit.target: Semper gaudebat ludere ut ninja, et quae agebat idem erant, quae puer ludens agebat, sed cum superviribus.

unit.source: As Sam caught his breath, he took a quick glance at his notifications.
unit.target: Dum Sam spiritum reciperabat, celerem aspectum in notis suis iecit.

unit.source: He couldn’t help but be happy with what he saw.
unit.target: Non potuit non gaudere ex iis quae vidit.

unit.source: [Your skill, Multitasking has reached Level 25!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Multitasking, ad Gradum 25 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Thanks to reaching level 25 with the Multitasking skill you gained Efficiency subskill!]
unit.target: [Gratias ad artem Multitasking gradum 25 assecutus, subars “Efficientia” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Efficiency: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Everything you do through multitasking is much more efficient. Decreases mana consumption of spells when using them simultaneously and stamina when using physical skills simultaneously by 1%.]
unit.target: [Efficientia: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passiva) Omne quod per multitasking facis efficacius est. Consumptio manae incantationum, cum simul adhibita, et stamina in artibus corporalibus simul usitata 1% minuitur.]

unit.source: Efficiency was a rather common subskill, still, it was a rather good skill for his build, so Sam was happy with it.
unit.target: Efficientia subars satis communis erat; sed pro structura eius optima arte videbatur, ergo Sam cum ea laetabatur.

unit.source: [Your skill, Mage Sight has reached Level 6!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Mage Sight, ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your skill, Mana Sense has reached Level 16!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Mana Sense, ad Gradum 16 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your skill, Discernment has reached Level 3!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Discernment, ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your skill, Advanced Mana Control has reached Level 7!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Advanced Mana Control, ad Gradum 7 pervenit!]

unit.source: Nodding in satisfaction, he took a last, deep breath, then took out a compass and map from his inventory and took a few seconds to orient himself, then took a few seconds to close his eyes and take a few deep breaths.
unit.target: Satisfacto animo, annuens ultimum spiritum cepit, deinde ex inventario compassum et mappam extraxit, paucos secundos ad se orientandum sumens, deinde oculos clausit et aliquot profundos spiritus attulit.

unit.source: Following that, he took out a simple black cloak, pulled it on, making sure that the hood of the cloak was covering his entire head, then turned on the Mana Shield and Shadow Cloak skills, covering himself head to toe, and with a final flex of his will, he ignited the Mana Body Enhancement skill and shot off towards his destination.
unit.target: Postea, pallium nigrum simplex extraxit, induit, cavens ut caput totum operiret, deinde artes Mana Shield et Pallium Umbrae activavit, se a capite ad pedes tegens, atque ultimo studio voluntatis artem Mana Body Enhancement excitavit et in metam se coniecit.

unit.source: He left behind a small clearing and a very surprised squirrel that fell out of the tree over him, as the sound of Sam’s departure managed to shock him.
unit.target: Reliquit parvam claram aream et sciurum valde stupitum, qui e arbore super eum cecidit, quoniam sonitus discessus Sam eum perterruit.

unit.source: Because the Chalice was hidden at a place that was also hidden from the general public, the old ranger couldn’t exactly give Sam directions straight to the area.
unit.target: Quia calix in loco, qui a populo etiam abdito esset, celatus erat, senex custos silvarum Sam non potuit rectas instructiones ad locum dare.

unit.source: Instead, Sam was given several landmarks to find and follow.
unit.target: Proinde, Sam plurima signa itineraria invenire et sequi debebat.

unit.source: The first landmark was a rather simple rock, called Candle rock by the people of the area, on the account of it looking like a melted candle.
unit.target: Primum signum erat saxum simplicissimum, a incolis loci “Candle Rock” nominatum, quoniam ut candelam liquefactam videbatur.

unit.source: It was on the border of the forest around Ironwood town and one of the mountains called (quite creatively) Ironspark Mountain.
unit.target: In limine silvae circa oppidum Ironwood et in uno montium, qui ingeniose “Ironspark Mountain” vocabatur, erat.

unit.source: It mostly contained iron and coal, with a few rarer metals here and there.
unit.target: Imprimis ferrum et carbonem continebat, cum paucis metallicis rarioribus hic et illic.

unit.source: So, nobody cared about it.
unit.target: Ergo, neminem curabant id.

unit.source: Until now.
unit.target: Usque ad hoc.

unit.source: Because recently a tribe of trolls had moved in.
unit.target: Nam nuper tribus trollorum insediaverat.

unit.source: And with them came the players.
unit.target: Et cum eis lusores venerunt.

unit.source: As Sam hid behind a tree thick enough that it would need at least four people to reach around it, he beheld a group of players apparently patrolling the area.
unit.target: Dum Sam post arborem, tam crassam ut circumeundi quattuor homines opus esset, se abscondit, et coetum lusorum, qui loco peragrabantur, animadvertit.

unit.source: Further up, he could hear the sound of battle.
unit.target: Ulterius, sonitum proelii audire poterat.

unit.source: Cursing to himself, he waited until the patrol moved further away, then after making sure his skills were turned on and Lucky wasn’t about to jump out of his shadow, he darted towards the next tree.
unit.target: Se iurans, exspectavit donec custodia longius recesserat; tum, certus ne artes eius inactivae essent et Lucky e umbra eius exsilire pararet, ad arborem proxime festinavit.

unit.source: Holding his breath, he watched the players for a clue they saw him, but they continued to walk away, carelessly talking about some kind of pop star.
unit.target: Spiritum retinens, lusores intuens qua indicem haberent eum videre, sed illi ambulare pergebant, neglegenter de aliqua stella populari colloquentes.

unit.source: Releasing his breath, he steeled himself and began darting from tree to tree toward his goal.
unit.target: Spiritum dimittens, se firmavit et ab arbore una ad aliam, versus finem suum festinavit.

unit.source: Soon, he found himself watching as a large group of people battling an equally large group of trolls.
unit.target: Mox se invenit intuens coetum magnum hominum, qui aeque magnum tribum trollorum pugnabant.

unit.source: But while the trolls were wielding wooden clubs and primitive stone axes, they were bombarded by steel‑tipped arrows, swords, spears, and all manner of other weapons, while a small collection of players, guarded by a few serious knight types, were lobbing fireballs and balls of electricity at the trolls.
unit.target: Sed dum trolli baculis ligneis et rudimentariis securibus lapideis utebantur, telis ex ferro acuto, gladiis, hastis, et aliis armis oppugnabantur, et dum parvus coetus lusorum, a paucis gravibus equitibus custoditi, pilas ignis et electricitatis in trollos iaciebat.

unit.source: While the spells looked rather anemic to Sam, and he winced every time he heard one of the mages cry out ‘Fireball!’, the players facing the trolls cheered whenever one of the spells hit the monsters.
unit.target: Dum incantationes Sam paulo anemicae videbantur, et quotiens unus ex magis “Fireball!” exclamabat, lusores, qui trollos opponebant, exsultabant quoties incantatio in monstrum pertingebat.

unit.source: He spent a few minutes just observing them and the trolls wanting to gather intelligence on the current average combat capability.
unit.target: Paucis minutis eos et trollos observavit, scientiam de mediā pugnae potentia colligere cupiens.

unit.source: Sam was getting ready to move, and he just waited for the Shadow Cloak to expire, while the group he was watching was celebrating a drop of the infamous skill book.
unit.target: Sam se ad motum parabat, et exspectabat ut Pallium Umbrae exsuperaret, dum coetus quem spectabat lapsum libri artis infami celebrabat.

unit.source: The skill expired, and he was no longer cloaked in shadows, staying absolutely still behind one of the trees he immediately renewed it and launched himself towards his next hiding spot.
unit.target: Ars exspiravit, et non iam in umbris celatus erat; stans omnino quietus post arborem, eam statim renovavit et se ad proximam latebram projecit.

unit.source: Sadly, it seemed his luck ran out.
unit.target: Heu, videbatur fortuna eius exhaurita esse.

unit.source: As he was midway between the two hiding spots, one of the people fighting the trolls cried out.
unit.target: Dum inter duas latebras medium esset, unus ex hominibus qui contra trollos pugnabant exclamavit.

unit.source: “There is someone here!”
unit.target: “Hic aliquis adest!”

unit.source: Instantly, the entire guild became tense, and different yells filled the air.
unit.target: Statim, tota gilda anxia facta est, et diversas clamitates aerem repleverunt.

unit.source: What?
unit.target: Quid?

unit.source: Who dares?
unit.target: Quis audet?

unit.source: Which guild wants our spoil?
unit.target: Quae gilda spolia nostra appetit?

unit.source: Thankfully, before they could properly react, he managed to reach his newest hiding spot.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, antequam recte responderent, ad novam latebram suam pervenit.

unit.source: He crouched down, ready to launch himself away, and listened carefully.
unit.target: Se in genu flectit, paratus ad se proiciendi, et attente auscultavit.

unit.source: “Are you sure?” spoke up one of the guys.
unit.target: “Esne certus?” inquit unus ex iis.

unit.source: Sam suspected the guild leader.
unit.target: Sam ducem guildae suspicatus est.

unit.source: “Yeah, boss! My skill pinged because it sensed somebody going by!”
unit.target: “Ita, domine! Ars mea adnotavit, quia aliquem transeuntem sensit!”

unit.source: Sam listened as the first man cursed up a storm, then asked another question.
unit.target: Sam auscultavit, dum primus vir multa maledixit, deinde aliam quaestionem posuit.

unit.source: “Where are they?”
unit.target: “Ubi sunt?”

unit.source: “Sorry, boss, I lost them instantly!”
unit.target: “Ignosce, domine, eos statim amisi!”

unit.source: Another curse session.
unit.target: Alia sessio maledictorum fuit.

unit.source: Then the man began to issue orders.
unit.target: Deinde vir mandata dare coepit.

unit.source: “Alright, if those assholes want to play with us, then we will play!”
unit.target: “Ita, si illi impudentes nobiscum ludere volunt, tunc ludemus!”

unit.source: Team one will stay here and continue farming.
unit.target: Turma prima hic manebit et agros colligere pergat.

unit.source: Team two I want you to be on guard!
unit.target: Turma secunda, volo ut vigiletis!

unit.source: Team three increase the patrol radius!
unit.target: Turma tertia, augete spatium circuitus!

unit.source: “Yes!”
unit.target: “Ita!”

unit.source: Sam smiled at their actions, relieved they only sensed him momentarily, he launched himself away from the tree he was hiding behind once again heading for the Candle rock, leaving behind an agitated guild.
unit.target: Sam ob eorum facta subridens, contentus quod eum brevissime tantum perceptum esse videbantur, se iterum a arbore latebrantis proiecit et ad Candle Rock properavit, gilda turbata relicta.

unit.source: Even if by accident, if he could stoke the flames of the developing guild wars, then Sam was happy.
unit.target: Etiam, si casu, si pugnandas guildarum incursus excitare posset, Sam laetus esset.

unit.source: Thankfully, there were no more interruptions on his way to the Candle rock.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, nulla amplius interruptio in via ad Candle Rock erat.

unit.source: He weaved through the trees, ignored every monster that looked his way, and another hour after leaving behind the guild farming trolls (thanking the stars that they had no idea that proximity wards were a thing) he arrived at a small outcropping holding the rock he was after.
unit.target: Per arbores serpit, omne monstrum quod eum intueri conabatur neglexit, et post horam aliam, relicto coetu trollorum qui agriculturam exercebant (stellis gratias referens quod nesciebant munimenta proximitatis esse), ad parvum excrescentem locum, in quo saxum quaerebat, pervenit.

unit.source: It jutted toward the sky, and upon Sam’s inspection, he had to agree it did look like a melted candle.
unit.target: Saxum ad caelum protrudebat, et cum Sam inspiciebat, agnovit illud vere ut candelam liquefactam apparere.

unit.source: If one squinted.
unit.target: Si quis oculos constringeret.

unit.source: But he wasn’t there to debate the naming sense of the locals.
unit.target: Sed non adfuit ut de sensu nominandi incolarum disputaret.

unit.source: He was here to hunt a monster down and get rid of the blood contract.
unit.target: Hic adest ut monstrum venaret atque pactum sanguinis tolleret.

unit.source: And of course, get all the sweet, sweet loot.
unit.target: Et scilicet, omnem praedam dulcem ac delectabilem adipisci.

unit.source: Slowly, Sam once again took out the map and compass, though after glancing at the compass, he put it back.
unit.target: Lente, Sam iterum mappam et compassum extraxit, sed post aspectum compassi, id reponit.

unit.source: Thanks to the iron in the mountains and some subtle enchantments that the ranger told him about, compasses were useless from this point forward.
unit.target: Ob ferrum in montibus atque incantationes subtilissimas quas custos narraverat, compassi ab hoc tempore inutiles facti sunt.

unit.source: He stepped next to the candle‑shaped rock and began looking around, trying to spot the landmarks he was told about.
unit.target: Ad saxum, qui candelam formabat, accessit et circumspicere coepit, tentans signa itineraria, de quibus audiverat, deprehendere.

unit.source: Finally, after a minute of straining his eyes, he spotted the first one.
unit.target: Denique, post minutum oculis intendendo, primum signum animadvertit.

unit.source: An ancient giant ironwood that was recognizable because it had two trunks heading toward the sky.
unit.target: Antiquum ingens lignum ferreum, quod notabile erat, quoniam duo truncis ad caelum tendebant.

unit.source: Then, after a few seconds, he spotted the other one.
unit.target: Deinde, post pauca secunda, alterum animadvertit.

unit.source: A distant waterfall that almost looked like a spot of bluish‑white dirt on the side of a mountain.
unit.target: Cataracta remota, quae paene ut situs terrae caeruleo‑albae in latere montis videbatur.

unit.source: His journey would take him between the two of them.
unit.target: Iter eius inter ea duo pertransiturum erat.

unit.source: Now that he found the proper directions, instead of continuing with his journey, he quickly set up a tent hidden between some rocks, let out Lucky, fed him, and played with him for a while, then he crawled into the tent, and simply logged out.
unit.target: Iam directiones idoneas inveniens, pro itinere desinendo, celeriter tentorium inter saxa occultum posuit, Lucky dimisit, eum pascit atque aliquantum cum eo lusit, deinde in tentorium intravit et discessit.

unit.source: He had been playing for a while; he had to take care of his biological function.
unit.target: Aliquantulum lusit; necessarium fuit ut curam functionis suae biologicae ageret.

unit.source: “Hopefully, with the bigger hype, they will announce the time restrictions earlier, because this is a murder on my sleep cycle…” Sam murmured as he ambled towards the bathroom.
unit.target: “Spero, cum maiori strepitu, restrictiones temporales antea enuntiabuntur, quia hoc somnii mei interfectio est…” murmurat Sam, ambulans ad latrinam.

unit.source: Finished with taking care of his annoying biological function Sam spent a few minutes checking the internet, watching almost in real‑time as the hype of the game continued to increase, while on the forums the Troll Wars as the players started calling it continued to escalate.
unit.target: Perfecto curando functionem molestiorem biologicam, Sam paucos minutos in interrete explendo consumpsit, vix in tempore reali spectans quomodo fervor ludi augeret, dum in forum pugnae trollorum, ut lusores id nominare coeperunt, crescere perseverabant.

unit.source: He logged back to find Lucky snuggled under one of his arms, snoring almost silently but looking absolutely content.
unit.target: Rediit in ludum ut inveniret Lucky sub uno brachio eius collocatum, fere silentissime stertientem, sed omnino contentum videbatur.

unit.source: Sam smiled and spent a few minutes just cuddling his wolf companion with the sinfully soft fur.
unit.target: Sam subridens paucis minutis solum comitem lupum, cui pilus peccanter mollis erat, amplexus est.

unit.source: “Duty calls, you silly boy,” he called out softly, poking the nose of the wolf.
unit.target: “Officium vocat, puer ineptus,” inquit leniter, nasum lupī tussidens.

unit.source: Lucky blinked a few times, then simply grinned at him and barked enthusiastically.
unit.target: Lucky paucis oculis micavit, deinde simpliciter ei subridens latravit cum ardore.

unit.source: “Good boy!” He petted the wolf, then extricated himself from the tent, followed by Lucky, who upon seeing Sam dismantling the tent, yawned, stretched a little, and simply jumped into his shadow.
unit.target: “Bonus puer!” Fovit lupum, deinde se ex tentorio extraxit, secutus a Lucky, qui, cum Sam tentorium demolire videbat, oscitavit, paulo se extendit et in umbram eius saliit.

unit.source: Which was followed by a single notification.
unit.target: Quod sequitur una notificatio.

unit.source: [Your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 8!]
unit.target: [Ars tua, Spirit Link, ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

unit.source: Sam chuckled a little, then threw another “Good boy!” at his shadow, then activated his skills and shot off towards his goal, keeping the unique ironwood tree and distant waterfall in his sight.
unit.target: Sam paulo cachinnavit, deinde alium “Bonus puer!” ad umbram suam iacuit, postea artes suas activavit et in metam se coniecit, dum arborem unicam ligni ferrei et cataractam remotam in conspectu retinebat.

unit.source: He had the next landmark to find.
unit.target: Proximum signum inveniendum habebat.

After another hour of constantly rushing towards his goal, only stopping every few minutes to make sure his heading was correct, Sam finally stopped at a clearing, as even his prodigious Mana Regeneration couldn’t keep up with his use of Shadow Cloak.

unit.source: As he stood, resting a little bit, he had a decision to make.
unit.target: Dum stabat, paulo requiescens, decisionem capere debebat.

unit.source: Either he waited for his mana to regenerate and then continue, or go ahead without using it.
unit.target: Aut exspectavit ut regeneratio manae eius eveniret et deinde pergeret, aut sine ea procederet.

unit.source: It wasn’t like he was in a real rush…
unit.target: Non enim vere festinabat…

unit.source: Yes, the guilds were trying to hunt the trolls into extinction in their greed for the skill book that everybody wanted, but they were pretty far from reaching the area where he was headed.
unit.target: Ita, collegia conabantur trollos ad exstinctionem venari, insatiabili cupiditate pro libro peritiae, quem omnes desiderabant; sed longe ab eo loco, ad quem se dirigeret, erant.

unit.source: But still, currently, most players were dedicated and hardcore gamers.
unit.target: Sed tamen, nunc, plerique lusores erant devoti et ardenter ludentes.

unit.source: Gamers only like a few things: finding secrets, collecting loot, and being the first.
unit.target: Lusores solum paucis rebus delectantur: arcana detegere, praeda colligere, et primus esse.

unit.source: And nothing attracted curious and fame‐hungry gamers more than a secret area.
unit.target: Nec quidquam altius lusores curiosos atque fama avidos alliciebat quam locus arcanus.

unit.source: No matter how much something is hidden, somebody, somewhere, would find it.
unit.target: Quamvis aliquid celatum sit, aliquis, alicubi, id inveniet.

unit.source: And Sam couldn’t allow someone to overtake him.
unit.target: Et Sam non permittere potuit ut aliquis eum superaret.

unit.source: Feeling as if his breathing was coming under control, he turned to his status screen and clicked around the settings for a little while.
unit.target: Sentiens quasi spiritus eius sub moderamine esset, ad scrinium status conversus est et paulisper per optiones premebat.

unit.source: Sam would be going into a high‐stakes environment, and he didn’t want to be distracted by a wrongly timed pop‐up.
unit.target: Sam in ambitum magnum periculi ingredietur, neque volebat ab apparitione intempestiva, tempore errato, distrahi.

unit.source: So, he turned off the skill level‐up notifications and only left those that would inform him of status effects and the like.
unit.target: Itaque notificationes de incremento artis interclusit et solum eas reliquit quae eum de effectibus status et similia certiores facerent.

unit.source: Thankfully, the game had the option to set a notification profile, as well as the capability to save multiple profiles.
unit.target: Fortunatim, ludus optionem habebat ad constituendum profilium notificationum, necnon facultatem plurimorum profilorum salvandorum.

unit.source: He set the current one as Basic and the new one as High Tempo.
unit.target: Praesentem Basic et novum High Tempo constituit.

unit.source: Then he did a few stretches, checked his equipment for the last time and, without activating his Shadow Cloak, shot off again in the direction of the forest where the Chalice was said to be hidden.
unit.target: Deinde aliquot exercitationes fecit, supellectilem ultima inspecta, et, sine usu pallii umbratilis, iterum in directionem silvae properavit, ubi dicitur Calix lateare.

unit.source: Sam pivoted, slashing down with his sword, bisecting the giant grasshopper of all things, then at the same time jumped back as another launched itself at him.
unit.target: Sam circumversus est, gladio suo ictum habens, gigantem locustam in duas partes secans, simulque retro saltavit, cum alter ad eum impetum daret.

unit.source: He didn’t have to react as Lucky crashed into the grasshopper with an eager howl.
unit.target: Non oportuit eum agere, cum Lucky in locustam impetuoso ululatu irrueret.

unit.source: He didn’t even get to watch the carnage unfolding as, with an eerie sound, several more grasshoppers jumped at him from behind several bushes, and he was once again in a fight for his life.
unit.target: Neve spectare potuit effusionem caedis, cum, sonitu infausto, plures locustae ex post aliquot frondis insiliebant, atque iterum in pugna pro vita sua versaretur.

unit.source: “Why grasshoppers?” but the only answer to his question were cricket sounds in the background.
unit.target: “Cur locustae?” sed sola responsio quaestionis eius erant soni cicadarum in fundo.

unit.source: He just sighed at the stupidity and went back to massacring the giant, unnatural grasshoppers as they tried to aggressively hop at him and Lucky.
unit.target: Ob stultitiam simplex suspiravit et rediit ad trucidandas locustas gigantes, inusitatas, quatenus vehementer in eum et Lucky saltabant.

unit.source: The silly wolf looked like he was having the time of his life.
unit.target: Lupus ineptus videbatur quasi summo gaudio vitae suae frueretur.

unit.source: Half an hour later, he was standing in the middle of a field filled with corpses of giant grasshoppers, breathing heavily, but smiling triumphantly.
unit.target: Dimidio hora post, in medio agri cadaveribus locustarum gigantum repleto, stetit, grave respirans, sed triumphanter subridens.

unit.source: ‘Apparently, the first hurdle is done…’ was his first thought, and then he froze.
unit.target: ‘Apparenter, primus obstaculum peractum est…’ erat prima cogitatio eius, deinde immobilis factus est.

unit.source: Lucky watched as his master froze for a second, then walked up to the nearest tree and began to bang his head into it while yelling.
unit.target: Lucky spectavit dum magister eius per momentum immobilis factus esset, deinde ad arborem proximam accessit et incoepit caput in eam percussare dum clamitabat.

unit.source: “Stupid! Stupid! Stupid!”
unit.target: “Stultus! Stultus! Stultus!”

unit.source: Sam stopped trying to use concussion to make his idiotic brain forget the fight, and then went to the nearest corpse.
unit.target: Sam cessavit conari uti concussione ut mentem stultam pugnae oblivionem perduceret, deinde ad cadaver proximum accessit.

unit.source: He quickly infused a drop of mana into the tip of his sword, then thrust the sword into the still corpse.
unit.target: Celeriter guttulam manae in aciem gladii infudit, deinde gladium in cadaver quiescentem impulit.

unit.source: He grabbed hold of the drop of mana and, with a violent motion, had it burst inside the carcass.
unit.target: Guttulam manae arripuit et, vi motu violento, intra cadaver illam erupit.

unit.source: Instead of an explosion of gore, he was rewarded by the grasshopper corpse turning rainbow‐colored, and then, in the next instant, shattering into a million little pieces and sinking into the ground, vanishing from sight.
unit.target: Pro explosione cruentis non, compensatus est quod cadaver locustae in colores iridis vertit, deinde, in proximo momento, in innumeros frustulos dissolutum atque in terram delapsum, conspectu evanuit.

unit.source: “Of course they are illusions! You were told it is using illusions…” he grumbled under his breath as he spread his mana as thin as possible and enveloped all the corpses he could see and sense.
unit.target: “Scilicet, illae sunt illusiones! Audisti enim eam illusiones uti…” mormoravit sub ore dum manam suam tenuissime ferebat et omnia cadavera, quae videre atque sentire poterat, involvit.

unit.source: Then the next second the entire scene was filled with rainbow light, then nothing but the slightly torn‐up forest, no grasshopper, but a very confused Lucky sitting in the middle.
unit.target: Deinde, in proximo momento, tota scena luce iridis plena facta est, deinde nihil nisi silva leviter laniata, nullae locustae, sed Lucky valde confusus in medio sedens.

unit.source: Sam just sat down next to the confused Lucky with a huff and began petting the wolf.
unit.target: Sam statim iuxta Lucky confundum sedebat, cum suspirio, et lupum fovere coepit.

unit.source: After trying to ignore his blunder, Sam took a breather, and continued on his journey, while lambasting himself for forgetting that he was dealing with an illusion‐using monster.
unit.target: Postquam conatus est suum errorem neglegere, Sam paulum quiescit et iter suum continuavit, simul se ipsum reprehendens quod oblitum esset se cum monstrum ut illusionum utens versari.

unit.source: Though at least he now knew beyond a shadow of a doubt that he was in the correct place.
unit.target: At saltem iam sciebat sine minima dubitatione se in loco recto esse.

unit.source: He took hold of part of his mana and expelled it from his body, trying to spread it as thin as possible while still keeping it connected to himself.
unit.target: Partem manae suae arripuit eamque ex corpore suo expulsit, conatus eam tenuari quantum fieri potuit, simul tamen ad se ligatam servans.

unit.source: Sam knew from his inherited memories that illusions could be broken.
unit.target: Sam ex memoriis hereditariis sciebat illusiones frangi posse.

unit.source: Few and far were those that couldn’t, and most of those were either cast by legendary mages or anchored to artifacts deep in ancient ruins.
unit.target: Pauci erant qui frangi non poterant, et plerique eorum aut ab magis praeclaris magiis evocati erant aut ad artifacta profunde in antiquis ruinis coniuncti.

unit.source: When he judged that the mana was spread far enough from him, in a crude globe, he paused for a second, then began to vibrate the mana in the surrounding cloud.
unit.target: Cum iudicavit manam satis longe a se diffusa esse in globulo rudis, momento cessit, deinde manam in nube circumjacenti vibratoriam facere coepit.

unit.source: To his dismay, the scene of the forest rushing past him shattered, and he found himself back in a very familiar field, with a very confused Lucky sitting in the middle and watching him with concern.
unit.target: Ad magnam eius maerorem, scena silvae praeter eum festinanter traiciebatur dissoluta est, atque se invenit in agro valde noto, cum Lucky valde confuso in medio sedens eumque sollicitus intuentem.

unit.source: “Fuuuuuuuh…”
unit.target: “Fuuuuuuuh…”

unit.source: He sighed and began rolling up (metaphorically) his sleeves.
unit.target: Suspiravit et manicas suas (metaphorice) volvere coepit.

unit.source: ‘This is going to take a while.’
unit.target: ‘Hoc tempus aliquantum capiet.’

unit.source: Sam’s second attempt went almost the same.
unit.target: Secunda conatus Sam fere idem exsecutus est.

unit.source: He shot off towards his direction with the cloud of illusion‐disrupting mana already primed, yet the moment he activated it, he found himself back in the clearing.
unit.target: Festinavit in suam partem cum nube manae, quae ad illusiones dissolvendas iam praeparata erat, sed eodem momento quo eam activavit, se in prato invenit.

unit.source: Just to make sure he wasn’t imagining, and holding to the adage that ‘if you can’t repeat it, it ain’t science’, he did two more times, exactly the same.
unit.target: Ut certus esset se non imaginari, et ad dicendum quod ‘si iterari non potest, non est scientia’ tenens, bis iter fecit, prorsus idem.

unit.source: And his experiments were validated.
unit.target: Et experimenta eius confirmata sunt.

unit.source: It took exactly the same time to break the illusion and find himself back in the empty field.
unit.target: Eodem tempore exacto illusionem frangere atque se in agro vacuo iterum invenire potuit.

unit.source: Then he went out without the disruption field and just kept rushing ahead, pumping his Body Enhancement to the maximum.
unit.target: Deinde, campo disruptionis carente, egressus est et tantum properabat, incrementum corporis ad maximum impellens.

unit.source: However, after a few minutes, he noticed something that he overlooked the first time.
unit.target: Sed post paucis minutis, aliquid animadvertit quod primo negligere fecerat.

unit.source: Some trees were repeating themselves.
unit.target: Quaedam arbores se repetebant.

unit.source: ‘Oh, look, this is the second time I've seen that flower…’ Sam remarked to himself as he slowed down and stopped in front of a simple yellow flower resembling a marigold.
unit.target: ‘O, ecce, iterum hanc florem vidi…’ inquit Sam sibi, dum tardabat et coram simplici flori flavo, marigold simili, sistit.

unit.source: With a quiet sigh, he activated his disruption field and found himself back in the clearing, with a very confused Lucky, who watched him with a tilted head, and a tongue lolling out.
unit.target: Cum quieto suspirio, campum disruptionis activavit et se iterum in prato invenit, cum Lucky maxime confuso, qui capite inclinato eum observabat, et lingua laxe pendente.

unit.source: For the next hour, he tried several ways to escape the situation.
unit.target: Pro hora sequenti, varias vias conatus est ad exitu e statu evadendi.

unit.source: He tried going super fast, super slow, tried it backward, sideways, even zig‐zagging but nothing worked.
unit.target: Celeriter nimis, tardius, retrorsum, lateraliter, etiam in formis zigzag conatus est, sed nihil profuit.

unit.source: He tried going back towards the Candle rock, but even when he tried to leave the place, he still found himself back in the clearing where he fought the illusionary grasshoppers.
unit.target: Conatus est reverti versus Saxum Candelarum, sed etiam cum locum relinquere conaretur, se in prato, ubi cum locustis illusoriis pugnaverat, iterum invenit.

unit.source: He tried staying in the clearing and disrupting the illusion by stretching his mana even further, but the only thing that happened was that he heard a small noise, akin to a crystal globe shattering, and nothing more.
unit.target: Conatus est in prato manere et illusionem minuere manam suam ulterius distendens, sed solum evenit ut parvus sonus, similis globi crystallini confracti, audiret, et nihil aliud.

unit.source: Afterwards, the way out was still blocked by the illusion.
unit.target: Postea, via exitus adhuc ab illusionem obstructa manebat.

unit.source: Sam even tried going out, as if heading towards his goal, and then just unleashing some devastating attacks.
unit.target: Sam etiam conatus est exire, quasi ad finem suum tendens, deinde impetuosos impetus efferens.

unit.source: The only response to that was a giant army of grasshoppers swarming him and the burning forest around him.
unit.target: Solum responsum ad id fuit ingens exercitus locustarum, eum et silvam ardentem circum eum inflammans.

unit.source: While Sam appreciated the opportunity to practice and hone his sword skills, it was not the goal he was aiming for.
unit.target: Dum Sam occasionem aestimabat ad peritia gladiatoria exercenda et perficienda, id non erat propositum ad quod contendebat.

unit.source: So, feeling a little frustrated, he let out a yell and charged into the horde of grasshoppers with Lucky at his side.
unit.target: Itaque, paulo frustratus, clamitavit et in turbam locustarum impetum dedit, cum Lucky iuxta se.

unit.source: He made sure his stance was solid, but otherwise, he kept spamming his skills, trying to get a true feel for them, practicing with them, and so on.
unit.target: Curot ut habitus eius solidus esset, sed cetera, facultates suas crebro adhibebat, verum sensum iis adipisci conatus, eas exercens, et ita porro.

unit.source: Lucky was just having fun…
unit.target: Lucky tantum ludeat…

unit.source: For half an hour, after getting almost killed by a kaiju‐sized grasshopper and quickly shattering the illusions, he logged out, took a water break and tried to organize the information he acquired into something resembling a form.
unit.target: Per dimidiam horam, postquam paene a locusta magnitudine kaiju interfectus est et celeriter illusiones dissolvit, se discessit, aquae refrigerium cepit et conatus est informationes collectas in formam aliquam ordinare.

unit.source: Luckily, by the time he returned to the game, he had something approaching a game plan.
unit.target: Fortunate, cum ad ludum rediret, aliquid consilii ludendi quasi paratum habebat.

unit.source: He continued as he did before, trying different things, charging this and that way. Shooting off attacks at random things, pretending to be getting angry.
unit.target: Praeteritis modis continuavit, variis rebus conatus, hinc illuc impetum dabat, impetus casu in res misos iaciens, simul se iratum esse simulans.

unit.source: A few times, just for the fun of it, he redid the Attack of Grasshopper scenario. He found it rather therapeutic…
unit.target: Aliquot vicibus, solum ad ludicrum, scenarium Impetus Locustae iteravit. Id ei satis therapeuticum videbatur…

unit.source: But finally, after several hours of fruitless action, he felt he was ready.
unit.target: Sed tandem, post varias horas inanis actionis, sensit se paratum esse.

unit.source: It was a risky move, but based on the hints and information he gathered from his inherited memories, and his actual knowledge of mythology and somewhat dubious knowledge he gained from reading all those isekai and gaming novels.
unit.target: Consilium periculosum fuit, sed indicibus et informationibus ex memoriis hereditatis colligendis, atque ex vera mythologiae scientia et paulo dubia, quam ex libris isekai et ludorum fabulis percepit, innixus est.

unit.source: For a moment, he closed his eyes, resisted the temptation to check the skill level‐up notifications, as he knew the system took that into account when determining results and enemy strength, even the final reward sometimes, then opened them, and for the last time he rushed off, directly towards his goal, burning enough mana to make a lot of mages jealous.
unit.target: Per momentum oculos clausit, temptationi inspiciendorum notificationum de incremento artis resistit, quoniam sciebat systema id habere in rationem cum exitus et hostium vim computaret, etiam finalem praemium aliquando, deinde eos aperuit, et ad novissimum tempus, directe ad finem suum, festinavit, satis manae comburens ut multos magos invidiosos efficeret.

unit.source: Then, just as Sam did so many tries previously, he reached inside himself, grasped the mana circulating there, drew out a good chunk of it, and using the by now routine ability, and with a small twist of his mana, shattered the illusionary world around him.
unit.target: Deinde, sicut antea Sam multas conatus habuerat, intra se pervenit, manam ibi circulantem arripuit, bonam partem eius extraxit, et usu iam solito, cum parva torsione manae, orbem illusionis circa se frangit.

unit.source: Sam found himself back in the clearing, still as he left it, though with a few more craters and scars.
unit.target: Sam se invenit iterum in prato, quo reliquerat, quamquam paucis crateribus et cicatricibus additis.

unit.source: Lucky was again, back in the middle, watching him confusedly.
unit.target: Lucky iterum in medio sedebat, eum confusim spectans.

unit.source: The poor thing had no idea what was going on…
unit.target: Miserus ille nesciebat quid ageretur…

unit.source: Then Sam started on his plan.
unit.target: Deinde Sam consilium suum inchoavit.

unit.source: “What the hell? What the frick is going on?” he exclaimed, acting as angry as he could be, while stomping around, making sure that his mana was churning around him, showcasing his anger.
unit.target: “Quid diablotinum? Quid hoc vehementer agitur?” exclamavit, furibundus quantum poterat, dum circumcalcans, curans ut mana eius circa se turbinebatur, iram suam ostendens.

unit.source: He continued to do this for a few minutes, angrily jumping and stomping around the clearing without any aim.
unit.target: Hoc per paucos minutas continuavit, irate saltans et calcibus per prato calcans sine ullo proposito.

unit.source: Then, after completing a circle around the now worried Lucky, he stealthily reached inside his inventory and retrieved the sparklescale powder he purchased just in case, and began to prepare it.
unit.target: Deinde, post circulum circa nunc sollicitum Lucky perfecit, furtim in sua saccula accessit et pulvisum squamae scintillantis, quem ad casum emerat, rapuit atque praeparare coepit.

unit.source: Sparklescale powder came from grinding down scales of the Sparklescale Mollusk, which could be found in certain seas, but could be bred pretty easily anywhere, with some know‐how.
unit.target: Pulvis squamae scintillantis ex squamis mollusci Sparklescale molendis oriebatur, qui in quibusdam mari reperiri poterant, sed ubique faciliter aleri possent, si scientia esset.

unit.source: Their scaled shell was pretty good at disrupting magic, and if the Sparklescale Mollusk was allowed to mature, that disruption turned into outright magic resistance.
unit.target: Tegmen eorum squamosum efficaciter magiam perturbabat, et si molluscus Sparklescale maturari liceret, illa perturbatio in veram repugnationem magicae convertere videbatur.

unit.source: They were pretty hard enemies to defeat for mages.
unit.target: Hostes erant difficillimi superandi ab magicis.

unit.source: Slowly, under the cover of his churning mana, he separated a tiny thread of mana, and enveloped the small leather bag in his hands that contained the powder.
unit.target: Lente, sub tegmento manae ferventis, tenuem filum manae separavit, et parvum sacculum coriaceum manibus suis, quod pulverem continebat, involvit.

unit.source: Holding it as if it was a snow globe.
unit.target: Tenens eum tamquam globum nivale.

unit.source: Still continuing his angry stomp through the clearing, and when he was in the middle with Lucky jumping out of his way with a small yelp, he suddenly stopped, and with a flex of his will, shot the globe of mana containing the bag of sparklescale powder, and with another exertion of his will detonated the bag over the clearing.
unit.target: Adhuc iratus per pratum calcans, et cum in médio esset, Lucky parvo clamo extrorsum saliens, subito sistit, et cum voluntatis suae flexu globum manae, quod sacculum pulveris squamae scintillantis continebat, proiecit, ac alio impetu voluntatis sacculus super prato detonatus est.

unit.source: Instantly, sparkling powder began falling on the clearing like snow and, with his senses cranked up to eleven, he could immediately feel the illusionary construct around him waver.
unit.target: Statim, pulveris scintillantis instar nivis in pratum cadere coepit, et sensibus suis ad undecim excitatis, statim sentire potuit constructionem illusionis circa se vacillare.

unit.source: Yet, he knew it wasn’t the same as when Sam did the same with his own mana.
unit.target: Tamen sciebat id non eundem esse ac cum Sam idem cum sua mana fecisset.

unit.source: After all, he was rather amateurish with his attempts and the scale powder was permanent and one would defend against it differently than against simple mana disruptions.
unit.target: Nam conatus eius satis ineptus erant, et pulvis squamae perpetuus, quem aliter defendere oportebat quam adversus simplices disruptiones manae.

unit.source: His hope was that the monster was originally from the area and had no knowledge of the intricacies of the deep sea mollusk lives.
unit.target: Spes eius erat ut monstrum ex illa regione originem haberet et de subtilitatibus vitae molluscorum profundae maris nihil noverit.

unit.source: And as he reined in his own churning mana, while slowly petting Lucky as he sat practically on his legs, he looked around and couldn’t help but let out a satisfied smile as his eyes zeroed on an area near the edge of the clearing next to a most stereotypical tree stump that Sam had ever seen.
unit.target: Et dum manam suam ferventem moderabatur, lente Lucky fovens, qui quasi in cruribus eius sedebat, circumspiciens, non potuit non subridere satisfacta vultu, cum oculi eius in aream prope limitem prati, iuxta truncum arboreum maxime stereotipum, quem Sam umquam viderat, inciderent.

unit.source: The stump was like every stump that ever existed.
unit.target: Truncus erat sicut omne truncus, qui umquam exstiterit.

unit.source: It was so generic that it looked positively wrong in a game that strived for such perfection in graphical fidelity.
unit.target: Tam vulgare erat ut prorsus iniuste videbatur in ludo, qui ad talem perfectionem fidelitatis graphicae contendebat.

unit.source: It was as if somebody placed a stump from a game from the past into Magic Unbound.
unit.target: Velut si aliquis truncum e ludo antiquae aetatis in Magic Unbound posuisset.

unit.source: The look just didn’t fit.
unit.target: Aspectus prorsus non conveniebat.

unit.source: Despite that, and the odd thoughts it generated in his head, Sam’s attention wasn’t on the stump, but on the presence next to said stump.
unit.target: Nihilominus, et eximias cogitationes quas in eius capite excitavit, attentio Sam non in trunco, sed in praesentia iuxta illum truncum consistit.

unit.source: A presence which before now had been invisible, but now the outlines were slowly emerging thanks to the slowly falling silvery mollusc powder.
unit.target: Praesentia, quae antea invisibilis erat, nunc lineamenta paulatim apparere coepit, propter pulverem molluscorum argenteum, lente cadentem.

unit.source: It was an odd shape and thanks to it being well, invisible, Sam couldn’t make out much, but at least he could see that it had antennae.
unit.target: Forma insolita erat, et propter quod, utique, invisibilis erat, Sam non plura discernere poterat, sed saltem videre poterat quod antennae haberet.

unit.source: Or very weird hair…
unit.target: Vel etiam capilli valde insueti…

unit.source: He stood there silently, hiding his triumph, and stared at the monster just as the monster stared at him.
unit.target: Illic silentium servans, triumphum suum celans, stetit et monstrum intuerebat, sicut monstrum in eum intuebatur.

unit.source: Despite not seeing the being's eyes, he could feel their intense gaze on him.
unit.target: Etsi oculos illius entitatis non videbat, tamen intensum eorum aspectum super se sentiebat.

unit.source: Slowly, the silvery powder finished falling, settling on the ground, on him and Lucky (the wolf sneezing and setting off clouds of sparklescale explosion with it) and on the monster.
unit.target: Lente, pulvis argenteus caderet, consedens in terram, in eum, in Lucky (lupus sternutans et nubes scintillantium eruptionis excitans) atque in monstrum consederat.

unit.source: Sadly, even with that, he couldn’t even tell what kind of monster it was.
unit.target: Tristiter, etiam cum hoc, quid genus monstri esset, cognoscere non poterat.

unit.source: Slowly, he readied his magic, just let it brim under his skin, his Mana Shield almost shining with the potential of the mana he was channelling into it, and his hand was almost white from gripping the handle of his sword.
unit.target: Lente magicam vim parabat, eam sub cute sua effundens; scutum manae paene fulgebat ex potentia manae in eum canalizata, et manus eius, manubrium gladii tenens, paene alba erat.

unit.source: Sam didn’t want to fight; he didn’t need to fight, and he was pretty sure if he tried to fight it directly, he would die within a second.
unit.target: Sam non voluit pugnam; pugnandi ei non opportebat, et certus erat, si directe pugnare conaretur, intra unam secundam moriturum esse.

unit.source: This was at least a boss-level monster.
unit.target: Hoc saltem erat monstrum gradus praecipuus.

unit.source: You needed to be either overpowered beyond belief or with a group to defeat it.
unit.target: Necesse erat aut nimis potentem esse, aut cum grege eum superare.

unit.source: But that was him.
unit.target: Sed ille ipse erat.

unit.source: The monster could still decide to kill him…
unit.target: Monstrum tamen adhuc decernere poterat ut eum occideret…

unit.source: As he was ruminating about the possibility of a solo boss fight, and glancing around the clearing looking for spots to hide behind or otherwise use for the fight (and finding almost none), a quiet sound was heard.
unit.target: Dum de possibilitate pugnae solitariae cum duce meditaret et in area aperta loca quaerebat ad se celandum vel ad pugnam, (paene nihil inveniens) sonus quietus auditus est.

unit.source: A sniff.
unit.target: Inhalatio.

unit.source: Then a musical voice, gentle but with an undercurrent of steel.
unit.target: Deinde vox musicus, lenis sed subtextu ferreo, emissa est.

unit.source: It was as if a zither came to life (which Sam only recognized because one of his friends decided one year to really get into zithers) and decided that from now on it would be capable of speaking.
unit.target: Velut si cithara animam susceperit (quam Sam cognovit solum quia unus ex amicis eius aliquo anno ad citharas vere immersus est) et decrevit ex hoc tempore loqui posse.

unit.source: “So crude, child of man…”
unit.target: “Tam rudis, puer hominis…”

unit.source: Before Sam could even open his mouth to answer, the form next to the malformed stump shimmered, the sparklescale powder lifting off of it falling to the ground, and finally revealing the monster.
unit.target: Priusquam Sam os aperiret ut responderet, forma iuxta truncum deformem micavit, pulveris scintillantis levans in terram cadens, tandem monstrum revelans.

unit.source: ‘It’s a cricket,’ was Sam’s only thought.
unit.target: “Gryllus est,” solum Sam cogitavit.

unit.source: ‘A giant. fricking. cricket.’
unit.target: “Gryllus ingens. Per deos. Gryllus.”

unit.source: It stood on two legs, which looked exactly like one would expect a cricket’s legs to look like, but weirdly humanized, yet not.
unit.target: Super duos crus stabat, quae prorsus erant ut crura grylli exspectari debent, sed mirabiliter humanatae, tamen non plane.

unit.source: Its body, colored black with red accents, was covered by a weird yellow shawl, almost see-through, yet not.
unit.target: Corpus eius, nigro tinctum cum accentibus rubris, tegebatur ab insolito flavo pallio, paene translucido, sed non omnino.

unit.source: Its hands were segmented like an insect’s yet ended in weirdly segmented but human-like hands.
unit.target: Manus eius segmentatae erant ut insecti, sed evenerunt in manus eximie segmentatas, sed quasi humanas.

unit.source: On its head were antennae jutting up high in the air.
unit.target: In capite eius erant antennae, alte in aere protrudentes.

unit.source: And one of them had a cute yellow bow on it.
unit.target: Et una eorum portabat arcum flavescens, venustum.

unit.source: Its face was the weirdest.
unit.target: Vultus eius erat maxime insolitus.

unit.source: Instead of an insect’s face, it was like someone mixed human and insect together but moved the slider towards human more.
unit.target: Pro facie insecti, videbatur quasi aliquis humanum et insectum misceret, attamen maiore ratione ad humanum inclinatus.

unit.source: It had a mouth, nose, eyes and even a slight chin, yet the teeth were sharp, almost shark-like and the eyes were giant and it had no sclera instead it was all yellow.
unit.target: Habebat os, nasum, oculos atque etiam parvum mentum, sed dentes acuti erant, paene ut squalorum, oculi ingentes erant, et sclera non videbatur, cum totus flavo colore fulgentes.

unit.source: Sunshine yellow.
unit.target: Flavus ut radii solis.

unit.source: It wasn’t the weirdest monster he had seen in his inherited memories, but Sam had to say it was up there.
unit.target: Non erat id monstrum maximum insuetus, quod in memoriam hereditariam viderat, sed Sam fatebatur id esse inter se summum.

unit.source: “Oh, my… soooo forceful with your gaze, child of man,” she spoke again, turning away slightly, acting demurely.
unit.target: “O me… tam vehementer cum tuo aspectu, puer hominis,” iterum locuta est, leviter se avertens, modeste agens.

unit.source: “I think I might fear for my… innocence!”
unit.target: “Puto me fortasse timere meam innocentiam!”

unit.source: There was a silence following that, and Sam could only hear crickets in the background.
unit.target: Postea silentium sequebatur, et Sam solum gryllos in obscuro audire poterat.

unit.source: Throwing a deadpan gaze at the monster, he spoke up.
unit.target: Ad monstrum vultu imperturbato intueretur, et locutus est.

unit.source: “Really?”
unit.target: “Revera?”

unit.source: The giant cricket monster turned back, and with a slight smirk on her face (based on the voice) answered.
unit.target: Monstrum grylli ingentis revertere, et leviter subridens vultu respondit.

unit.source: “I stay true to my roots, child of man,” and then her entire demeanor shifted.
unit.target: “Fidelis sum radicibus meis, puer hominis,” et tum totus habitus eius mutatus est.

unit.source: Gone was the playful smile, or airy personality.
unit.target: Risus ludibundus et indoles levis evanuerunt.

unit.source: Instead, it was replaced by a look as hard as a diamond and a threatening aura.
unit.target: Proinde, substitutus est vultu durissimo velut adamas et aura minax.

unit.source: “Why have you come to my little slice of paradise? Why have you wrought destruction on my beautiful creations? Why should I not erase your pitiful song from this world? Answer me, child of man.”
unit.target: “Cur ad partem parvam paradisii mei veneris? Cur exitium in creationibus meis pulchris adduxisti? Cur non deleam carmen tuum miserum ex hoc mundo? Responde mihi, puer hominis.”

unit.source: Taken aback by the rapid change, Sam took a moment to consider the questions.
unit.target: Sam, celeriter mutato conspectu, parva temporis spatium ad quaestiones meditandas cepit.

unit.source: Fighting was absolutely out of the question.
unit.target: Pugnare omnino non erat in ratione.

unit.source: Now that she wasn’t hiding anymore, he could feel the monster’s monstrous mana.
unit.target: Iam, cum non se celaret, poterat sentire monstri vim manae ingentem.

unit.source: He would be squashed in seconds, just as he suspected.
unit.target: In paucis momentis conteri foret, prorsus ut suspicabatur.

unit.source: So, he did the only thing he could.
unit.target: Igitur id quod ei solum possibile erat, fecit.

unit.source: He bowed.
unit.target: Se inclinavit.

unit.source: “My apologies, er… your majesty?”
unit.target: “Ignosce mihi, er… vestra maiestas?”

unit.source: A flash of humor ran through her face, but in an instant, the cold look was back.
unit.target: Subito facetia vultus eius perlata est, sed statim aspectus frigidus redivit.

unit.source: “I’m no monarch, child of man.”
unit.target: “Non sum regina, puer hominis.”

unit.source: “Understood, ma’am,” he replied, swallowing hard.
unit.target: “Intelligo, domina,” respondit, difficulter deglutiens.

unit.source: “I’m here looking for an artifact to lift a curse most foul.”
unit.target: “Adsum quaerens artefactum ad tollendam maledictionem foedissimam.”

unit.source: “A curse most foul you say…” came the melodic words from the monster.
unit.target: “Maledictio foedissima, dicis…” inquit verba melodica ex monstro.

unit.source: “And you need my adorable self for this artifact? How curious…”
unit.target: “Et opus habes mihi, amabilem meam, ad hoc artefactum? Quam curiosum…”

unit.source: “No, ma’am,” spoke up Sam before the monster could get the wrong idea.
unit.target: “Non, domina,” inquit Sam, priusquam monstrum rem male interpretaret.

unit.source: “Oh? Do elaborate, child of man,” came the calm order.
unit.target: “Oh? Expone amplius, puer hominis,” inquit cum tranquillo ordine.

unit.source: Though Sam was relieved to hear that the threatening steel was finally absent from her voice.
unit.target: Sam solacium cepit ex auditu quod minas ferreas tandem in voce eius non erant.

unit.source: “I’m looking for something called Chalice of Restraint.”
unit.target: “Quaero aliquid, quod Calix Moderationis vocatur.”

unit.source: It can be used to safely remove the curse from the person afflicted with it.
unit.target: Adhiberi potest ut maledictionem ex persona affecta tuto removeat.

unit.source: According to my sources, it is hidden around here.
unit.target: Ex fontibus meis, circa hic latet.

unit.source: Sam hoped his honesty would allow him to continue on his journey, and as he carefully watched the monster, he knew he made the right decision.
unit.target: Sam sperabat honestate sua iter suum pergere posse, et dum monstrum caute contemplabatur, scivit se rectum decrevisse.

unit.source: “I see,” said the monster, slowly considering his words, tilting her head slightly and putting one hand up to her face with the other supporting the first hand.
unit.target: “Intellego,” inquit monstrum, lente verba eius considerans, caput leviter inclinans, unam manum ad faciem levans, altera eam opem ferens.

unit.source: A very picture of a fine lady.
unit.target: Imago praeclarae dominae erat.

unit.source: “And was I hindering in your journey, child of man?”
unit.target: “Et an iter tuum impedivi, puer hominis?”

unit.source: “Not… really, ma’am.”
unit.target: “Non… re vera, domina.”

unit.source: There was no answer, only the monster’s stare, so he hastily continued.
unit.target: Responsio nulla fuit, solum intuitus monstri; itaque festinanter continuavit.

unit.source: “My source, an old ranger, has asked me to check up on the area, as it is considered valuable – historically – to the city.
unit.target: Fons meus, senex custos silvarum, me rogavit ut regionem explorarem, quae historice urbi pretiosa habetur.

unit.source: “Your existence came up in our discussion.”
unit.target: Existentia tua in sermone nostro emersa est.

unit.source: “And what did this old ranger ask you to do with my exquisite form?”
unit.target: “Et quid hoc senex custos silvarum tibi iussit de mea forma exquisita facere?”

unit.source: “Nothing nefarious, I assure you. He simply wanted to make sure that the area with the ironwood trees is healthy and hale.
unit.target: “Nihil nefarium, tibi certo confirmo. Ille solum voluit cur regio arboribus ligni ferrei sita bene sani esset.

unit.source: No mention of extermination was made.
unit.target: Nulla de exterminatione dicta est.

unit.source: “Hmm…”
unit.target: “Hmm…”

unit.source: Sam watched as the giant cricket considered him and his words.
unit.target: Sam spectabat dum monstrum grylli ingentis eum et verba eius contemplaret.

unit.source: They stood there in silence, occasionally broken by Lucky, who was playing in the silvery powder as if it was snow.
unit.target: Illic silentium regnabat, interdum intermissum per Lucky, qui in pulveri argenteo quasi neve luderet.

unit.source: Finally, the monster nodded.
unit.target: Denique monstrum annuit.

unit.source: “I believe you, child of man.”
unit.target: “Te credo, puer hominis.”

unit.source: Sam’s shoulder might have sagged a little, hearing that.
unit.target: Scapula Sam paulum labefactata videtur, id audito.

unit.source: And based on the smirk on the monster’s face, she saw it.
unit.target: Et ex risu in facie monstri, ipsa rem intellexit.

unit.source: “Then I think we should part here, ma’am. I don’t want to trouble you with my presence any longer!”
unit.target: “Ergo puto nos hic divergere oportere, domina. Non volo te ultra mea praesentia vexare!”

unit.source: One hand moved onto her chin, and she shot him a mischievous smile, causing a shiver to go down his spine.
unit.target: Una manus ad mentum eius accessit, et illa ei risum malitiosum dimisit, quod tremorem per spinam eius provocavit.

unit.source: “I don’t think so!”
unit.target: “Non puto!”

unit.source: “Excuse me?”
unit.target: “Quid?”

unit.source: The monster just ignored his question and continued to talk.
unit.target: Monstrum quaestionem eius neglexit et ulterius loquebatur.

unit.source: “I’d like to see this mysterious artifact.”
unit.target: “Vellem videre hoc arcanum artefactum.”

unit.source: Sam could feel the dread pooling in his stomach.
unit.target: Sam poterat sentire formidinem in ventre suo confluere.

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: “Quid?”

unit.source: There wasn’t any answer, instead, the monster began glowing with eerie purple light, and before Sam could blink more than a few times, the giant cricket standing on two legs was gone from his sight, to be replaced by a normal cricket sitting on the weird stump, albeit red and black and slightly bigger than the average cricket.
unit.target: Nulla responsio fuit; sed monstrum incipiebat nitere lumine purpureo sinistro, et antequam Sam pluries oculos concluderet, monstrum grylli ingentis super duos crus stantem ex conspectu eius evanuit, substitutus a gryllo ordinario sedente super truncum insolitum, rubro et nigro, et paulo maiore quam gryllus mediocris.

unit.source: Sam could only stare at it.
unit.target: Sam solum ad eum spectare potuit.

unit.source: “It is an odd feeling, but I suppose that’s where whimsy took me today…” came the melodic sound from the cricket on the stump, accompanied by a zither-like giggle.
unit.target: “Sensatio insueta est, sed puto me hodie in levitatem duxi…” inquit vox melodica a gryllo in trunco sedente, cum risu simili citharae comitante.

unit.source: Sam just sighed.
unit.target: Sam tantum suspiravit.

unit.source: Then, with a powerful jump, the cricket vaulted on top of his head.
unit.target: Tum, saltu valido, gryllus super caput eius transiliit.

unit.source: She spent a few moments getting comfortable, with Sam feeling some kind of magic anchoring her to his head, before exclaiming.
unit.target: Illa paucis momentis se accommodavit, dum Sam aliquam vim magicam, eam in capite suo adligantem, sentiret, antequam exclamat.

unit.source: “Onward noble steed! Let us enjoy the songs of adventure!”
unit.target: “Procite, equus nobilis! Gaudeamus carmina adventura!”

unit.source: Sam stood there silently, trying to calculate how much success he would have convincing the monster that could crush him with a swipe of her finger to not come with him.
unit.target: Sam illic silentium servans stetit, conatus aestimare quantum successus esset, ad persuadendum monstrum, quod uno digiti ictu eum conterere posset, ut se non comiteret.

unit.source: He came up with zero.
unit.target: Nihil computavit.

unit.source: “However, I will not fight your fights for you, child of man. This is your adventure. I’m merely an observer.”
unit.target: “Attamen, certamina tua pro te non pugnabo, puer hominis. Hoc est iter tuum. Ego tantum spectator sum.”

unit.source: There was a slight pause, and Sam could feel the smirk on her face.
unit.target: Brevis mora fuit, et Sam subridentem vultum eius sentire poterat.

unit.source: “Do be entertaining, though. I have been somewhat bored as of late…”
unit.target: “Esto tamen iucunda; nuper aliquantulum taedebam.”

unit.source: Sam looked up at the sky, looking for some kind of divine help, but neither the gods nor the developers appeared.
unit.target: Sam in caelum aspexit, quaerens aliquam auxilium divinum, sed nec dei nec excogitatores apparuerunt.

unit.source: Though one of the clouds looked suspiciously like a smiley face.
unit.target: Quamquam una ex nubibus videbatur, quasi facies subridentis.

unit.source: Finally, he just shrugged and spoke up.
unit.target: Denique, ille umeros levavit et locutus est.

unit.source: “My name is Sam…”
unit.target: “Nomen meum est Sam…”

unit.source: After gaining an impromptu observer for the rest of his quest, Sam spent a few minutes taking stock of his equipment making sure nothing was too damaged, spent a few minutes patting Lucky’s head then squared his shoulders and once again stepped on the path that he tried so many times before.
unit.target: Postquam obsidionem improvisam ad reliquam quaestionis partem adeptus est, Sam paucos minutas consumpsit ut supellectilem suam recenseret, cavens ne quid nimis laesum esset; postea paucos minutas Lucky caput fovens, deinde humeros sternens et iterum in viam, quam toties antea conatus erat, ingressus est.

unit.source: Thankfully, this time he couldn’t feel the subtle shifts of an illusion constraining him.
unit.target: Grato animo, hoc tempore subtila illusionis motus eum non premere sentiebat.

unit.source: Although, the cricket noises were still there.
unit.target: Attamen sonitus gryllorum adhuc erant.

unit.source: Trying to ignore it, he turned his attention to something else.
unit.target: Conans id neglegere, attentionem ad aliquid aliud convertit.

unit.source: Now that his ‘battle’ was over, he could finally review his gains.
unit.target: Iam, cum "pugna" eius finita esset, tandem sua merita recensere poterat.

unit.source: And boy, were there a lot of screens.
unit.target: Et, pro certo, multa erant ostensiones visuales.

unit.source: Thankfully, the game was nice enough to consolidate the notices, and he wasn’t bombarded with every little thing.
unit.target: Grato animo, ludus erat satis benignus ut notificationes coalescerentur, et non omni parva re tormentaretur.

unit.source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
unit.target: [Congratulationes! Gradum attigisti!]

unit.source: [You’re now Level 19!]
unit.target: [Nunc es Gradus 19!]

unit.source: [Gained 4 unassigned attribute points!]
unit.target: [Quattuor puncta attributorum nondistributa adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Gained 2 MAG points for your extensive and creative use of magic!]
unit.target: [Duo puncta MAG adeptus es propter usum magiae amplum et creativum!]

unit.source: [Gained +1 AGI, DEX, END for going beyond what your body is capable of!]
unit.target: [Acceperis +1 AGI, DEX, END propter id quod ultra limites corporis tui pervenisti!]

unit.source: Before continuing, he quickly opened his status screen and added two points to vitality and two to strength, just to make sure he was balanced.
unit.target: Antequam pergere, celeriter paginam statum suum aperuit et duos punctos ad vitalitatem et duos ad fortitudinem addidit, ut se aequum esse confirmaret.

unit.source: [Name: Sam ‘Solar’  Level: 19 (37%)  Title: Magical Genius  HP: 240/240  MP: 1105/1260  STR: 12  DEX: 13  AGI: 12  VIT: 12  END: 14  PER: 15  MAG: 21  WIS: 15  LUCK: 11]
unit.target: [Nomine: Sam ‘Solar’  Gradus: 19 (37%)  Titulus: Ingenium Magicum  HP: 240/240  MP: 1105/1260  STR: 12  DEX: 13  AGI: 12  VIT: 12  END: 14  PER: 15  MAG: 21  WIS: 15  LUCK: 11]

unit.source: ‘I really need to do something about my HP’ he scowled as he carefully bounded through the forest towards his goal.
unit.target: “Revera aliquid de HP meo agendum habeo,” inquit Sam, vultu contristo, dum diligenter per silvas ad propositum suum contendebat.

unit.source: Next came the skill gains.
unit.target: Deinde adeptus est incrementum peritiarum.

unit.source: [Advanced Mana Control is now level 10!]
unit.target: [Imperium Manae provectum nunc gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to keeping the flow of your mana during a stressful time, you gained the sub-skill, Stable Mana Control!]
unit.target: [Propter servandam fluxum manae tuae in tempore arduo, adeptus es sub-peritia, Stabilis Imperium Manae!]

unit.source: [Stable Mana Control: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Decreases the chance of outside forces disrupting your control over your own mana.]
unit.target: [Stabilis Imperium Manae: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Occasio virium extranearum, quae imperium manae tuae perturbare conantur, minuit.]

unit.source: [Mana Shield is now Level 26!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae nunc gradus 26 est!]

unit.source: [Controlled Mana Shield is now Level 8!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Moderatum nunc gradus 8 est!]

unit.source: [Sustained Mana Shield is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum nunc gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Sense is now Level 20!]
unit.target: [Sensus Manae nunc gradus 20 est!]

unit.source: [Pushing your senses to the limit, you gained the sub-skill, Detailed Mana Sense!]
unit.target: [Propter sensus tuos ad ultimum protrudendo, adeptus es sub-peritia, Sensus Manae Elaboratus!]

unit.source: [Detailed Mana Sense: Level MAX (Passive) The feedback from your Mana Sense is much more detailed. It also enhances information-gathering skills.]
unit.target: [Sensus Manae Elaboratus: Gradus MAX (Passivum) Responsio ex Senso Manae tuo multo elaborata est. Etiam peritiae informationis colligendae augetur.]

unit.source: [Focused Mana Sense is Level 5!]
unit.target: [Sensus Manae Concentatus nunc gradus 5 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Synergy is now Level 6!]
unit.target: [Synergia Manae nunc gradus 6 est!]

unit.source: Sam checked the subskill with a satisfying feeling. Detailed Mana Sense was an excellent supporting skill that would pay dividends later down the line when intricate manaworks would become the norm.
unit.target: Sam sub-peritiam recognovit cum sensu satisfactoria. Sensus Manae Elaboratus erat peritia subsidialis optima, quae postea dividendos afferet, cum operae intricatae manae ut norma fient.

unit.source: Some of his spells also leveled up. Mainly Wind Blade and Earth Wall, as he made use of them generously during the fight against the horde of giant grasshoppers.
unit.target: Nonnulla incantamenta eius etiam gradum attigerunt. Praesertim "Lamina Venti" et "Murus Terrae", quas liberaliter utebatur in pugna contra catervam locustarum gigantum.

unit.source: They respectively reached Level 5 and 7 during the battle.
unit.target: In certamine respective gradus 5 et 7 attigerunt.

unit.source: There were not many gains in any of his other spells, but Mana Strike shot up to 8 and Mana Slash was maxed out, gaining him another sub-skill.
unit.target: Non multa incrementa in aliis incantamentis eius facta sunt, sed "Mana Strike" attigit gradum 8, et "Mana Slash" ad maximum pervenit, adeptus est nova sub-peritia.

unit.source: [Mana Strike is now Level 8!]
unit.target: [Mana Strike nunc gradus 8 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Slash is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Mana Slash nunc gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Using your mana efficiently and creatively, you gained the sub-skill, Efficient Mana Slash!]
unit.target: [Per efficacem et creativam usum mana tuae, adeptus es sub-peritia, Mana Slash Efficax!]

unit.source: [Efficient Mana Slash: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to your familiarity and efficiency in the use of the skill it requires much less mana to execute a Mana Slash. Decreased the cost of the spell by 10% per level.]
unit.target: [Mana Slash Efficax: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passivum) Propter familiaritatem tuam et efficientiam in usu huius peritiae, multo minus mana requiritur ad peragendum Mana Slash. Sumptus incantationis decrescit 10% pro uno gradu.]

unit.source: Aside from that, Mage Sight only gained a level as he barely used it, knowing that looking at illusions at his level would be beyond useless, while Mana Body Enhancement also shot up.
unit.target: Praeter hoc, "Vis Magi" solum gradum attigit, quod vix usus esset, scientes quod in suo gradu illusiones contemplari ultra inutile esset, dum "Mana Body Enhancement" quoque ascendit.

unit.source: [Mana Body Enhancement is now Level 17!]
unit.target: [Mana Body Enhancement nunc gradus 17 est!]

unit.source: Battling with a pet was always nice, and it increased his connection with Lucky, but sadly, no new sub-skill was created from it.
unit.target: Pugnare cum familia animalium semper iucundum erat, et coniunctionem eius cum Lucky auxit, sed, heu, nulla nova sub-peritia ex hoc creata est.

unit.source: Though Lucky managed to gain a few levels, now sitting at a respectable Level 9.
unit.target: Etsi Lucky paucos gradus adeptus est, nunc in statu respectable gradus 9 sedet.

unit.source: He stopped for a moment, took a look around, checking to see if the landmarks guiding him were still where he left them, and of course, he also checked if he was in an illusion.
unit.target: Paulisper cessavit, circumspiciens, examinans utrum signa itineris, quae eum ducebant, adhuc eodem loco, quo reliquerat, essent, et scilicet, etiam comprobavit se in illusione esse.

unit.source: Thankfully, the only thing that happened when he used his magic to disrupt any potential illusions around was that the monster sitting on his head let out a musical huff.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, sola res quae evenit, dum magiam suam ad perturbandas illusiones potentiales usus est, fuit quod monstrum super caput eius huff musicum edidit.

unit.source: Not even commenting, he began running once again.
unit.target: Ne commentus quidem faciens, iterum currere inceperat.

unit.source: He wanted to be done with the quest as fast as possible.
unit.target: Cupiebat celerissime missionem absolvere.

unit.source: While keeping an eye on the forest, though with the monster snugly on his head, there was little chance that any other monster would attack him, he turned his remaining attention to something else.
unit.target: Dum silvam intuebatur, et cum monstrum arcte in caput eius stetisset, parva erat occasio ut aliud monstrum eum oppugnaret, et reliquam attentionem ad tabulas notificationum revertebat.

unit.source: [Multitasking is now Level 28!]
unit.target: [Multitasking nunc gradus 28 est!]

unit.source: [Efficiency is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Efficientia nunc gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: [Pinpoint Accuracy is now Level 5!]
unit.target: [Exacta Praecisio nunc gradus 5 est!]

unit.source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery is now Level 9!]
