unit.target: [Peritia Ensis Intermedia nunc gradus 9 est!]

unit.source: [Stable Stance is now Level 3!]
unit.target: [Stabilis Habitudo nunc gradus 3 est!]

unit.source: [Calm Heart is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: Then came some of the most interesting ones.
unit.target: Deinde aliqua ex iis maxime iucunda apparuerunt.

unit.source: [Shadow Cloak is now level 9!]
unit.target: [Pallium Umbrarum nunc gradus 9 est!]

unit.source: [You successfully broke through with two skills!]
unit.target: [Duo peritiae feliciter penetraverunt!]

unit.source: [Basic Footwork has reached Level 10 and can be upgraded into Intermediate Footwork. However, thanks to dipping your feet into the shadows, you are capable of upgrading the skill into Shadow Footwork.]
unit.target: [Fundamentalis Gressus nunc gradus 10 attigerunt et in Gressus Intermedios elevari possunt. Attamen, propter pedes tuos in umbras immergentes, habilis es ad hanc peritiam in Gressus Umbrae elevandam.]

unit.source: [Upgrading it into Shadow Footwork will leave you with the abilities granted by Basic Footwork, but you will not be able to learn Intermediate Footwork and above, locking you into the path of Shadows.]
unit.target: [Elevatio eius in Gressus Umbrae tibi dona fundamentalia Gressuum relinquet, sed discere Gressus Intermedios et ultra non poteris, te in semita Umbrae clausurum.]

unit.source: [Upgrade into Intermediate Footwork or Shadow Footwork?]
unit.target: [Elevare in Gressus Intermedios an in Gressus Umbrae?]

unit.source: Sam didn’t even hesitate.
unit.target: Sam quidem etiam non dubitavit.

unit.source: [Basic Footwork has been upgraded into Shadow Footwork.]
unit.target: [Fundamentalis Gressus elevatus est in Gressus Umbrae.]

unit.source: [Shadow Footwork: Level 0/50 (0%) (Passive) You have mastered the basics of footwork. Your stance is stable and hidden in the shadows. Observers will have a harder time figuring out your next action based on the movement of your feet. When traveling in shadows, your speed increases. Grants the Shadow Burst skill.]
unit.target: [Gressus Umbrae: Gradus 0/50 (0%) (Passivum) Fundamenta gressuum adeptus es. Statura tua stabilis est et in umbris abscondita; observatores magis laborabunt ut sequentem actum tuum ex motu pedum tuorum intellegant. In umbris iter facientes, celeritas tua augetur. Donat peritiam “Eruptionis Umbrae”.]

unit.source: [Shadow Burst: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) Activating the skill will increase your speed by 100% for 1 second. Cooldown: 180 seconds.]
unit.target: [Eruptio Umbrae: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incitando peritiam, celeritatem tuam auges 100% per 1 secundam. Refrigeratio: 180 secundae.]

unit.source: Nodding in satisfaction, he only gave a cursory read of the other skill that broke through.
unit.target: Annuens cum satisfactione, reliquam peritiam breviter legere conatus est.

unit.source: [Basic Breathing Technique has reached Level 10 and upgraded into Intermediate Breathing Technique.]
unit.target: [Fundamentalis Technica Respirationis nunc gradus 10 attigit et in Technicam Respirationis Intermediam elevata est!]

unit.source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) You gained control over your breathing. The very air you breathe sustains you. Decreases stamina consumption during any activity and increases stamina regeneration when not in a fight.]
unit.target: [Technica Respirationis Intermedia: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Imperium super respirationem adeptus es. Ipsa aura quam spiraris te sustinet. Consumptio virium in quacumque activitate minuitur atque regeneratio virium, cum non pugnaris, augetur.]

unit.source: Sadly, none of them granted sub-skills. Not that he expected them to, they were basic skills that only the truly talented, or those under specific teachers got sub‑skills for Basic Footwork and Basic Breathing Technique. And Sam was nowhere near talented enough for that or able to approach those teachers.
unit.target: Heu, nullae ex eis sub‑peritiae dederunt. Non quod id exspectaret; erant studia fundamentalia, quarum tantum vere ingeniosi aut sub magistris certis sub‑peritiae acceperunt. Et Sam minime ingeniosus erat nec ad illos magistros accedere poterat.

unit.source: But instead of feeling sad, he was happy. After all, he had new skills to check out!
unit.target: Sed pro tristitia, laetus erat. Postremo, novas peritias habebat explorandas!

unit.source: [Thanks to your accomplishment, you gained the skill Illusion Resistance!]
unit.target: [Propter successum tuum, adeptus es peritia "Resistentiae Illusionis"!]

unit.source: [Illusion Resistance: 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to your experience, you gained resistance against illusions. Makes it easier to resist and spot illusions. Each level increases the resistance by 1%.]
unit.target: [Resistentia Illusionis: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivum) Propter experientiam tuam, resistentia contra illusiones adeptus es. Facit facilem deprehensionem illusionum, et quisque gradus resistentiam auget per 1%.]

unit.source: [Thanks to your accomplishment, you gained the skill Mana Disruption!]
unit.target: [Propter successum tuum, adeptus es peritia "Disturbationis Manae"!]

unit.source: [Mana Disruption: 0/20 (0%) (Active) Using your finely honed control over your mana you can disrupt mana constructs. Mana cost depends on the mana construct you are disrupting.]
unit.target: [Disturbatio Manae: Gradus 0/20 (0%) (Activa) Utendo subtili moderamine super manam tuam, potes structuras manae perturbare. Sumptus manae dependet ex structura manae quam perturbas.]

unit.source: Two very nice spells that will definitely come in handy. Especially the resistance skill. They were wicked hard to acquire.
unit.target: Dua incantamenta valde iucunda, quae certe utilia erunt. Praesertim peritia resistentiae. Valde difficilia erant adipisci.

unit.source: For example, the easiest way to get the Fire Resistance skill was by executing a ritual in a volcano.
unit.target: Exempli causa, facilis modus ad peritiam “Resistentiae Ignis” obtinendam fuit per exsecutionem ritu in volcāno.

unit.source: Apparently, the monster on his head (currently whistling an unknown song), whose name he still didn’t know, was a masterful enough illusion user, that Sam noticing the illusion was enough of an accomplishment to get the skill.
unit.target: Apparenter, monstrum super caput eius (nunc carmen ignotum sibilans), cuius nomen eum nondum noverat, peritus in usu illusionum erat, ut Sam ipsi notare illusionem satis esset ad peritiam adeptandam.

unit.source: Giving one last look at his status screen, Sam gave one rather satisfied nod, closed it and began pumping his legs.
unit.target: Sam, ultimam paginam status suam aspexit, capite contento annuit, eam clausit, et crura movere coepit.

unit.source: He could see the trunks of the trees slowly changing into that of ironwood trees, as well as the mountain coming closer.
unit.target: Videbat truncos arborum paulatim in truncos arborum ligni ferrei mutari, atque montem appropinquare.

unit.source: It was time for the next leg of his journey…
unit.target: Tempus erat pro parte secunda itineris eius…

unit.source: As Sam ran through the forest, surrounded by giant ironwood trees and some sparse underbrush, he couldn’t help but get a little nervous.
unit.target: Dum Sam per silvam currebat, ingentibus arboribus ligni ferrei et rara subboscitate circumdatus, paulum anxius fieri non potuit.

unit.source: The first obstacle for the quest was a monster that he had no hope of defeating.
unit.target: Primum obstaculum expeditionis erat monstrum, quod vincere nullam spem habebat.

unit.source: He imagined that if a player with a guild got it, they would be still there, trying to figure out how to win against the boss.
unit.target: Existimabat, si lusor cum collegio id adeptus esset, ibi mansurum esse, conans invenire modum quomodo contra ducem vinceretur.

unit.source: "I wonder how long it would take them to consider talking with the monster…" he mused as he tried to find that one specific tree that the old ranger told him about while ignoring the cricket on his head.
unit.target: "Quamdiu illi de colloquio cum monstro cogitare poterint, miror," meditatus est, dum illam unicam arborem quaerebat, de qua senex custos eum certiorem fecit, neglegens gryllum in capite suo.

unit.source: Who, for some reason, was humming.
unit.target: Qui, quadam ratione, murmure leni sonabat.

unit.source: He slowed down, throttling his speed back from an all‑out sprint to a leisurely jog as his head was on a swivel, trying to spot a literal tree in the forest.
unit.target: Celeritatem retraxit, recedens ex totali cursu ad lenem ambulandi modum, dum caput circumversum, arborem veram in silva quaerebat.

unit.source: Sam slowed to walk and then engaged all his sensory skills.
unit.target: Sam ambulare tardavit et deinde omnes facultates sensoriae suas adhibuit.

unit.source: According to the old man, the tree had a symbol on it, and it probably still contained some mana, which would help him find it.
unit.target: Secundum senem, arbor signum habebat, et probabiliter adhuc aliquam manam contineret, quae ei auxilium afferret ad eam inveniendam.

unit.source: Slowly, his walk stopped, and he stood at the edge of a regular clearing, with closed eyes and his senses stretched to the limits.
unit.target: Paulatim iter eius cessavit, et stetit in limine spatii aperti, oculis clausis atque sensibus ad limites extensis.

unit.source: Trying to spot a minuscule amount of a very specific concentration of mana.
unit.target: Conans perscrutari minutam quantitatem peculiarem manae concentrationis.

unit.source: With a giant cricket on his head that was still humming.
unit.target: Cum ingenti gryllo in capite, qui adhuc murmure leni sonabat.

unit.source: He felt the mana in the air, in the trees, in the vegetation and in the ground.
unit.target: Sentivit manam in aere, in arboribus, in vegeto, et in terra.

unit.source: He felt as great clumps of mana moved around – animals and monsters – mostly away from him and his impromptu passenger.
unit.target: Sensit ingentes agmina manae circumire – animalia atque monstra – plerumque ab eo et socio fortuito secedentes.

unit.source: Sam at first excluded the ground, slowly but surely twisting his senses so that the information that came back to him didn’t tell him anything about the ground he stood on.
unit.target: Sam initio terram excludebat, sensus suos lente sed certo torquens, ut notitia redeunte nihil de terra in qua staret referret.

unit.source: With that, he had more mana available to gather information about the rest of the targets.
unit.target: Ex hoc, maiorem manam habebat ad colligendam notitiam de reliquis obiectis.

unit.source: He slowly wound the mana in a pattern that somehow made sense, and in an instant, the monsters and animals vanished from his senses.
unit.target: Lente manam in ordinem versavit, qui aliquam rationem exprimebat, et in momento, monstra atque animalia ex sensibus eius evanuerunt.

unit.source: Then Sam took a little breather, waiting for his reserves to fill up, trying to find his objective but coming up short.
unit.target: Deinde Sam paulum respiravit, exspectans ut copia eius replearentur, conans propositum suum invenire, sed sufficere non potuit.

unit.source: Not at all perturbed, he continued with his manipulations of the skill.
unit.target: Non perturbatus, manipulationibus artis suae perseveravit.

unit.source: Mana moved upon his command and was twisted into shapes which were further linked together, in turn creating bigger shapes.
unit.target: Mana, mandato eius, movebatur et in figuras convolutas versa est, quae ulterius inter se coniunctae erant, creantes formas maiores.

unit.source: It was almost beyond his ability to coherently describe it to anybody else.
unit.target: Fere ultra posse eius erat, ut id alicui alii cohaerenter enarraret.

unit.source: The mana manipulation was such a unique and, most importantly, alien sense that even years into the future people would struggle to adequately define it to anybody who didn’t use it.
unit.target: Manipulatio manae erat tam singularis et, maximi momenti, aliena, ut etiam annos postea homines luctarent ut id alicui, qui id non utebatur, apte definirent.

unit.source: Not to mention those who went beyond what the skills in the game provided and tried to manipulate the very mana in the game.
unit.target: Nisi etiam eos qui extra limites artium ludi proficiebantur et ipsam manam manipulare conabantur.

unit.source: There were rumors, but it was said that more than one person went mad due to the phenomenon.
unit.target: Rumores erant, sed dicebatur non uno tantum homine ex hoc phaenomeno insanire.

unit.source: He ignored all those feelings, fully focusing on the mana and the feedback it was providing.
unit.target: Neglexit illa omnia sensa, totus in manam atque in responsionem quam praebebat intendens.

unit.source: The ground and the fauna were already excluded, so the next thing on his to‑do list was the underbrush and any other vegetation that wasn’t a tree.
unit.target: Terra et fauna iam excluduntur, itaque proximo in ordine operum eius erant subboscus et quaedam alia vegetatio, quae arbor non erant.

unit.source: Slowly, the Mana Sense skill cohered into a new shape and the only thing he could ‘see’ with his mind’s eye were the giant trees towering over them.
unit.target: Paulatim, ars “Sensus Manae” in novam formam coniuncta est, et unica quae mente videre poterat erant ingentes arbores, quae super omnes se extollere videbantur.

unit.source: Unfortunately, he was in a forest where there were a lot of trees.
unit.target: Infeliciter, in silva erat, ubi multae arbores erant.

unit.source: Thankfully, he had an answer to that.
unit.target: Bene est quod responsum illi haberet.

unit.source: Carefully extending his hand, Sam touched the nearest tree, one of the famous ironwoods, and channelled a minuscule amount of mana into it.
unit.target: Cautus, manum extendens, Sam arborem proximam tetigit, una ex claris arboribus ligni ferrei, atque minutam quantitatem manae in eam infundit.

unit.source: He delicately circulated the mana in the tree, following the veins in it, from the roots to the treetops, to every leaf, then back to his hand, getting familiar with the tree’s mana signature.
unit.target: Arcte manam in arbore circulavit, venas eius secutus, a radicibus ad summitatem, ad omne folium, deinde ad manum suam redeo, signum manae arboris cognoscens.

unit.source: Sam spent a small amount of time getting to know the signature, memorizing it (it was rather simple thanks to it being a tree) then slowly he removed his hand from the tree and returned his focus to his Mana Sense.
unit.target: Sam parvum tempus dedicavit ad signum cognoscendum, id meminens (quod satis simplex erat, ex natura arboris), deinde lente manum a arbore detrahens et in Sensus Manae suum se concentravit.

unit.source: Slowly, using his own mana, he began to construct the mana signature of the ironwood tree into his spell.
unit.target: Lente, sua manā utens, signum manae arboris ligni ferrei in incantationem suam constituere coepit.

unit.source: He failed.
unit.target: Defecit.

unit.source: The spell fizzled out and the Mana Sense with all the filters built into it came crashing down on him, causing him to stagger back cursing in a low voice, while the cricket was chortling on his head, her laughter like bells tinkling.
unit.target: Incantatio exstincta est, et Sensus Manae cum omnibus inclusis filtris super eum ruere coepit, faciens eum retro titubare et sub voce humili maledicere, dum gryllus in capite eius cachinnabat, risus eius quasi tintinnabulorum resonans.

unit.source: He ignored her, then tried it again.
unit.target: Illam neglexit, atque iterum conatus est.

unit.source: First, the exclusion of the ground.
unit.target: Primum, terrae exclusio.

unit.source: Then the animals and monsters.
unit.target: Deinde animalia et monstra.

unit.source: Then the flora.
unit.target: Deinde flora.

unit.source: And finally, he began to construct the mana signature of the ironwood again.
unit.target: Et tandem iterum signum manae arboris ligni ferrei construere coepit.

unit.source: He failed again.
unit.target: Iterum defecit.

unit.source: And again.
unit.target: Et iterum.

unit.source: And again.
unit.target: Et iterum.

unit.source: It was annoying.
unit.target: Id molestum erat.

unit.source: Especially the needling laugh of his unwanted passenger.
unit.target: Praesertim risus aculeus comitis eius inopportuni.

unit.source: So he tried, tried and tried again…
unit.target: Itaque iterum atque iterum conatus est…

unit.source: Two hours later, Sam was mentally exhausted; the cricket was still chortling, and he was on the brink of logging out and going to sleep for days before trying again.
unit.target: Duo horis post, Sam mente exhaustus erat; gryllus adhuc cachinnabat, et ipse ad exitum sistematis atque ad diem somnum capiendum paene erat, antequam iterum conaretur.

unit.source: He knew it was possible.
unit.target: Sciebat id fieri posse.

unit.source: He (or rather the other Sam) read the accounts from the high‑rated mages.
unit.target: Ipse (vel potius alter Sam) relationes a summis magorum legebat.

unit.source: Granted, their explanations at the time made no sense to the other Sam, but to him? It made some sense…
unit.target: Certo, earum explicationes alteri Sam tempore nihil sensu praebebant, sed ei? Aliquid sensum habebat…

unit.source: The shapes of the mana just moved in a way that made sense to him.
unit.target: Formae manae se moverunt modo, qui sensum ei praeberet.

unit.source: Even if his life depended on it, he couldn’t explain how it made sense to him, but it did.
unit.target: Etiamsi vita eius in hoc pendebat, non potuit explanare quomodo illud ei sensum praeberet, sed fere ita erat.

unit.source: Finally, scrounging up his last remaining concentration, he began shaping the mana.
unit.target: Tandem, ultimam quoque attentionem colligens, manam formare coepit.

unit.source: Slowly and carefully, he took hold of each grain of mana, and one after another put them into place.
unit.target: Lente et diligenter, singula grana manae tenuit, et una post aliam in locum posuit.

unit.source: And the shape of the ironwood tree, in the abstract, took shape in his Mana Sense skill.
unit.target: Et forma arboris ligni ferrei, in abstractione, in facultate Sensus Manae eius apparuit.

unit.source: There was no warning, instead, the skill clicked and one moment he could sense all trees and the next only the ironwood trees.
unit.target: Nulla praemonitio fuit; proinde, ars subito instar ictus accedebat, et uno momento omnes arbores sentire poterat, et deinde solum arbores ligni ferrei.

unit.source: Thankfully, he was at the edge of the true ironwood forest, so he wasn’t overwhelmed with choices.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, ad limen verae silvae arborum ligni ferrei erat, itaque non multitudine electionum oppressus est.

unit.source: Quickly, before the very delicate mana construct could shatter, he focused and began looking for the symbol.
unit.target: Celeriter, antequam ipsa tenuis constructio manae discerperetur, se concentravit et signum quaesivit.

unit.source: It was a hidden symbol, used by the rangers of old to denote areas of importance.
unit.target: Erat signum occultum, a veteribus custodibus ad notanda loca momenti adhibitum.

unit.source: The new generation of guardians used the same symbols to protect the areas where the true ironwood trees resided against deforestation.
unit.target: Nova generatio protectorum eadem signa adhibebat ad tuendas regiones, ubi verae arbores ligni ferrei habitabant, contra deforestationem.

unit.source: Occasionally, they ventured there to get a few samples for some important people, but people mostly had to be content with the young forests around Ironwood city.
unit.target: Occasionibus, ad illuc profecti sunt ad paucas probationes pro aliquibus personis gravibus colligendas, sed plerique contenti esse debebant iuvenibus silvis circa urbem Ironwood.

unit.source: Eyes still closed, feeling something on the periphery of his senses, Sam began to slowly walk forward, hands held out to avoid bumping into something.
unit.target: Oculi eius adhuc clausi erant, et aliquid in extremitatibus sensuum sentiens, Sam lente porrexit, manibus protensis ne in aliquam rem incidat.

unit.source: After a few minutes of bumbling, ignoring the cricket’s laughter, he finally arrived at the spot he was aiming for.
unit.target: Post paucas minutas errandi, neglegens risum grylli, tandem ad locum, quem petebat, pervenit.

unit.source: Letting go of the spell, feeling as if a giant weight had been lifted off his body, Sam sighed deeply and opened his eyes.
unit.target: Incantationem dimittens, sentiens quasi ingens pondus ex corpore eius sublatum esset, Sam alte suspiravit et oculos aperuit.

unit.source: The first thing he saw was a giant ironwood tree, covered by moss around the roots, and high up a mysterious symbol, slightly glowing to his Mage Sight.
unit.target: Primum quod vidit, ingens arbor ligni ferrei erat, circa radices musco obtecta, et in altitudine signum mysteriosum, parum lucentem ad visu Magi eius.

unit.source: The second thing was, of course, the notification screens.
unit.target: Secunda res, scilicet, erat tabula notitiarum.

unit.source: [Advanced Mana Control is now Level 15!]
unit.target: [Manae Moderatio Provecta nunc Gradus 15 est!]

unit.source: [Stable Mana Control is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Manae Moderatio Stabilia nunc Gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to your miraculous effort, Mana Sense has reached Level 25!]
unit.target: [Gratias conatu tuo mirabili, Sensus Manae Gradum 25 attingit!]

unit.source: [Thanks to pushing your senses to their absolute maximum (again), you gained the sub‑skill, Natural Sensor!]
unit.target: [Gratias sensus tuos ad summum terminum iterum impellendis, sub‑artem, Sensor Naturalis, adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Natural Sensor: Level MAX (Passive) You are a natural sensor. Your sensing range, detail and every other attribute are increased. Mana cost of sensing skills is decreased. Grants the Flow skill.]
unit.target: [Sensor Naturalis: Gradus MAX (Passivus) Tu es sensor naturalis. Ambitus sensus tui, subtilitas, et omnia alia attributa augmentantur. Sumptus manae artium sensorium decrescit. Donat artem Fluxus.]

unit.source: [Flow: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to being a natural sensor, you can read the flow of mana. Increases your stability and the bonuses any movement or martial art skill provides by 1% per level in the skill.]
unit.target: [Fluxus: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivus) Gratias quod sensor naturalis es, flumen manae legere potes. Augmentat stabilitatem tuam ac beneficia cuiusque artis motoriae aut bellica per 1% per gradu praebita.]

unit.source: Ignoring the sassy system, Sam couldn’t help the wide smile appearing on his face.
unit.target: Systema insolentem neglexit, et Sam latum risum in facie sua effecit.

unit.source: Getting the Natural Sensor skill was something he never expected.
unit.target: Artem Sensoris Naturalis adeptus esse, id numquam exspectaverat.

unit.source: In his inherited memories, the other Sam only knew one person who had that.
unit.target: In memoria hereditata, alter Sam unam tantum personam cognoscebat, quae hoc habebat.

unit.source: And that person was somebody who was raised by a guild of mages attempting to create the perfect mage years after the start of the game.
unit.target: Et illa persona erat, a societate magorum educata, quae magum perfectum creare conabatur annos post initium ludi.

unit.source: And while they bragged about the skill, they kept the details about acquiring it to themselves.
unit.target: Et dum de hac arte se laudabant, singula de eius adeptione ad se reservabant.

unit.source: However, getting the skill also meant something different to Sam.
unit.target: Attamen, artem adeptio Sam quoque aliquid alium significabat.

unit.source: The other Sam was never talented enough with mana to get even close to what Sam had achieved.
unit.target: Alter Sam numquam satis ingenio manae utebatur, ut prope id quod Sam attigit, assequeretur.

unit.source: He had the theoretical knowledge, of course, but he could have never done what Sam had just done.
unit.target: Habebat scientiam theoreticam, scilicet, sed numquam potuit id quod Sam modo perfecerat.

unit.source: This meant that Sam was different, which helped with the low‑level issue that had been simmering in the back of his mind for a long time.
unit.target: Hoc significabat Sam esse diversum, quod opem tulit ad quaestionem parvi gradus, quae diu in mente eius insidiabatur.

unit.source: He was different from the person he had inherited the body from.
unit.target: Erat diversus ab illa persona, a qua corpus habuerat.

unit.source: He wasn’t the other Sam with some memories.
unit.target: Non erat alter Sam, qui quibusdam memoriis utebatur.

unit.source: He was a new Sam. With memories from a particular timeline, but he wasn’t that person.
unit.target: Novus Sam erat. Cum memoriis ex linea temporali peculiari, sed ille persona non erat.

unit.source: It strangely helped with his sorta‑impostor syndrome that had been bubbling under the surface.
unit.target: Id mirum modo adiuvabat in suo quasi "impostor syndrome" quod sub superficie bulliebat.

unit.source: Sam would have to think further about it, but for now, he was somewhat reassured.
unit.target: Sam ulterius de hoc cogitare debebat, sed nunc aliquantulum solatium inveniebat.

unit.source: Feeling, once again, as if a slight weight had been lifted from his shoulders, he returned his attention to the rest of the screens in front of him.
unit.target: Iterum se sentiens quasi levato parvo pondo ex umeris, animadvertit reliquas tabulas ante se.

unit.source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique is now Level 1!]
unit.target: [Technica Respirationis Intermedia nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Calm Heart is now Level 15!]
unit.target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc Gradus 15 est!]

unit.source: [Multitasking is now Level 34!]
unit.target: [Multitasking nunc Gradus 34 est!]

unit.source: [Efficiency is now Level 6!]
unit.target: [Efficientia nunc Gradus 6 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Synergy is now Level 7!]
unit.target: [Manae Synergia nunc Gradus 7 est!]

unit.source: He was a little disappointed that Mana Well didn’t level up, but it probably needed a little more usage of mana.
unit.target: Paulum contristatus erat quod Manae Fons non gradum ascendisset, sed verisimiliter paulum ampliorem usum manae necessitabat.

unit.source: Thanks to his monstrous mana regeneration, he was never in danger of running out of mana.
unit.target: Gratias regenerationi manae ingentis, numquam in periculo deficiendi manae versabatur.

unit.source: Looking back up at the symbol high up on the tree, he directed his Mana Sense at it, marvelling at how detailed and easy it was to use.
unit.target: Respiciens ad signum in altum in arbore situm, sensum manae suum in illud direxit, admirans quam subtiliter et facile id adhiberetur.

unit.source: As if after looking around with bad eyes he was suddenly given prescription glasses.
unit.target: Veluti, postquam male per oculos inspiciebat, subito oculi correctivi ei dederunt.

unit.source: Concentrating on the faint mana signature in the symbol, he reached out and looked for the others that would lead him to his final destination.
unit.target: Concentrans in leve signum manae in signo, manum protendit et alios quaesivit, qui eum ad ultimam destinationem perducerent.

unit.source: Finding one, he nodded, ignored the monster’s complaint, and began calmly walking.
unit.target: Inveniens unum, capite assensit, querelas monstri neglexit, et tranquille ambulare coepit.

unit.source: Sam spent a better part of several hours hopping from tree to tree, following the symbols high up in the air like some kind of demented treasure hunt.
unit.target: Sam plurimas horas arborem ex arbore saliendo consumpsit, signa in alto aere sequens, quasi insania quaesitio thesauri.

unit.source: "I mean… it’s kinda a treasure hunt… If you squint…" he mused as he felt what was probably the last symbol.
unit.target: "Dico... quasi quaestio thesauri est... Si oculos angulose constringas..." meditatus est, dum sensit quod probabiliter ultimum signum esset.

unit.source: It was much bigger and held much more mana than the previous ones.
unit.target: Iam multo maius erat et multam manam plurimam retinebat quam ea praecedentia.

unit.source: Even the terrain was changing.
unit.target: Etiam terra ipse mutabatur.

unit.source: Mirroring his approach to the bandit hideout, the rocks and stone on the ground were multiplying, though here the trees weren’t thinning.
unit.target: Saxa et lapides in terra multiplicabantur, sed arbores ibi non minuebantur.

unit.source: Ironwood trees didn’t really care where they grew, be it plains, hills or mountainsides.
unit.target: Arbores ligni ferrei minime curabant, ubi crescerent—sive in campis, sive in collibus aut in montium latis.

unit.source: Navigating the still‑thick forest, he arrived in front of the last tree, marked with the biggest symbol.
unit.target: Per silvam adhuc densa navigans, appropinquavit ad ultimam arborem, signo maximo notatam.

unit.source: He spent a minute looking up at the symbol, raised high by the passing time, then nodded and began walking around the trunk of the tree until he stood across from a small crack in the mountainside, with an old, weathered, moss‑covered stone marked with the same symbol, though lacking the mana imbued in it.
unit.target: Per unum minutum signum aspiciens, quod tempore extulit, deinde capite assensit et circa truncum arboris ambulare coepit, donec iuxta parvam fissuram in latere montis consedit, ad lapidem vetustum, musco opertum, eodem signo notatum, quamvis manae in eo non adfinitam esse videbatur.

unit.source: Which made sense.
unit.target: Quod rationem faciebat.

unit.source: Instead of heading in immediately, he simply sought a dry spot near the crack, set up his tent, and spent a minute feeding Lucky, who spent the entire time he wandered through the forest in his shadow, patiently watching.
unit.target: Pro eo ut statim intraret, locum siccum iuxta fissuram quaesivit, tentorium constituit, et per unam minutas Lucky pascit, qui totum tempus in silva, in umbra eius, vagabatur, attente inspiciens.

unit.source: Sam thought that the loyal wolf deserved a little pampering.
unit.target: Sam putavit lupo fideli parum indulgentiam mereri.

unit.source: The cricket finally hopped off his head and began looking around the clearing curiously.
unit.target: Demum gryllus ex capite eius descendit et in area clara, curiosus, quaerebat.

unit.source: He just sat in front of his tent, playing with Lucky, who was on his back, tongue out and in pure bliss.
unit.target: Ipsum coram tentorio sedebat, ludens cum Lucky, qui in dorso eius sedebat, lingua extrorsa et in pura beatitudine.

unit.source: Finally, the cricket looking up at the giant ironwood tree with the biggest symbol spoke up.
unit.target: Denique, gryllus aspiciens ingentem arborem ligni ferrei cum maximo signo, locutus est.

unit.source: “Fascinating…”
unit.target: «Fascinans…»

unit.source: Sam just continued to pet the wolf.
unit.target: Sam lupum teneriter fovebat.

unit.source: “You’re supposed to ask what is fascinating, child of man!” came the pouting call from the cricket.
unit.target: «Debes quaerere quid sit fascinans, fili hominis!» inquit gryllus, vultu contritum.

unit.source: Sam sighed.
unit.target: Sam suspiravit.

unit.source: “What is fascinating, ma’am?”
unit.target: «Quid est fascinans, domina?»

unit.source: The cricket immediately perked up.
unit.target: Gryllus statim excitatus est.

unit.source: “I’m glad you asked, child of man! This mana! It is familiar!”
unit.target: «Gaudeo quod rogavisti, fili hominis! Haec mana est mihi nota!»

unit.source: Now that managed to raise Sam’s head.
unit.target: Hoc efficit ut caput Sam elevaretur.

unit.source: “Oh, how so?”
unit.target: «O, quomodo ita?»

unit.source: “I don’t know…” came the reply, and Sam could hear the frustration in her voice.
unit.target: «Nescio...» inquit, et Sam audire potuit frustrationem in voce eius.

unit.source: “If we go by tropes, she is probably the familiar of an ancient ranger or druid or protector. Or maybe the last owner of the Chalice…” he thought, but didn’t speak up.
unit.target: «Si secundum tropos agat, fortasse illa est familiaris antiqui custodis aut druidis aut protectoris. Aut fortasse ultimus Calicis dominus...» meditavit, sed non locutus est.

unit.source: Neither did the cricket.
unit.target: Nec gryllus quidquam dixit.

unit.source: Instead, it continued to hop around the crack, checking out things while Sam pampered the dog.
unit.target: Proinde, gryllus per fissuram salire perrexit, rerum inspectione se occupans, dum Sam Lucky indulgentiam ferebat.

unit.source: Looking up at the sky, he saw it was quickly darkening.
unit.target: Aspiciens in caelum, vidit celeriter obscurari.

unit.source: Nodding to himself, he set up a proper camp, then after making sure that the cricket wouldn’t eat him while sleeping, he crawled into his sleeping bag and logged out.
unit.target: Noddans sibi, castra propria constitui, ac deinde, curavit ut gryllus eum dum dormiret non ederet, in sacco cubili se conplexus est et se ex systemate discessit.

unit.source: The moment Sam pulled off the helmet, he rushed to the bathroom, had a quick shower then fell into his bed fast asleep, mentally and physically tired beyond belief.
unit.target: Moxquam Sam galeam abstulit, festinavit ad balneum, cito se lavavit, deinde in lecto suo obdormivit, mente et corpore incredibiliter fessus.

unit.source: The next morning he was still a little off, so he took his time to do his exercise routine, had a nice breakfast, watched the news and did a little cleaning.
unit.target: Postero mane adhuc paulum perturbatus erat, ita tempus tulit ut exercitationes suas perageret, ientaculum jucundum sumpsit, nuntios spectavit et aliquantulum purgavit.

unit.source: Then, with a heavy heart, sat down in front of his computer and began checking the news.
unit.target: Deinde, corde gravi, coram computatro suo consedit et nuntios inspicere incipiebat.

unit.source: The troll hunt was still ongoing.
unit.target: Venatio trollorum adhuc pergebat.

unit.source: The guild wars it generated dominated the news.
unit.target: Bella collegiorum, quae illud excitaverant, nuntios dominabant.

unit.source: Everyone wanted that skill book.
unit.target: Omnes illum librum artium desiderabant.

unit.source: Everyone.
unit.target: Omnes.

unit.source: "Hmm… that gives me an idea…"
unit.target: «Hmm… id mihi ideam dat…»

unit.source: Turning his attention to other news, he checked the popularity with a little trepidation, and he was rewarded by a nice statistics graphic on the game’s website that proudly proclaimed how many people are playing the game.
unit.target: Vertens animos ad alias nuntias, parva timore popularitatem inspiciens, et remuneratus est pulchra statica graphica in situ ludi, quae superbe indicabat quot homines ludum ludere.

unit.source: Scowling, he checked his bank account and smiled a little when he saw how much the shares he bought were worth.
unit.target: Furibunde, rationem argentariam inspiciens, paulum subridens animadvertit quantum partium emptionum valeat.

unit.source: "At least that’s nice…"
unit.target: «Saltem, hoc iucundum est…»

unit.source: Sam went through his list of important people, checking up on them on the internet.
unit.target: Sam per indicem personarum gravium transivit, de quibus in interreti inspiciens.

unit.source: The streamers were easy.
unit.target: Streamers erant faciles.

unit.source: SummerRose was gaining followers ever since he directed her towards the unique class, and other currently beginner streamers were gaining ground.
unit.target: SummerRose secutores inveniebat, ex quo eam ad unicam classem dirigebat, atque alii streamerii incipientes progrediebantur.

unit.source: Soon, much sooner than he expected, he would have to start networking.
unit.target: Mox, citius quam exspectaverat, retis coniunctionem inire debebat.

unit.source: Getting on the ground floor in this was vital to his plans.
unit.target: Intra primum gradum implicari essentiale erat pro consiliis eius.

unit.source: As for his enemies?
unit.target: Quoad hostes eius?

unit.source: He was making very detailed notes on them.
unit.target: De eis notas plurimas et accuratas conficiebat.

unit.source: After he was done with that, he spent a little time just spending time on the internet, still finding the new world’s internet culture fascinating.
unit.target: Postquam id confecerat, paululum temporis tantum in interreti degit, culturam interretialem novae mundi adhuc fascinantem existimans.

unit.source: Sadly, he had to stop, as he had a pseudo‑dungeon to run.
unit.target: Heu, debebat cessare, nam pseudo‑caveam regere oportebat.

unit.source: Reluctantly, he stood up from the computer and laid down and put on the helmet, ready for whatever was inside that mountain.
unit.target: Invitus, ab computatro surrexit, se iacuit et galeam induit, paratus ad quidquid intra illam montem existimet.
Immediately after logging in, she made sure to check her ensemble in the mirror of the room she was renting.

unit.source: Seeing everything was in place and wardrobe malfunction was not possible (she wasn’t one of those ‘bathtub’ streamers), her blue hair was still blue and even her limited make-up was still in one place, she nodded and turned towards the table in the middle of the room.
unit.target: Cum omnia in ordine essent atque defectus vestimentorum fieri posse videntur (non enim erat illa inter illos emissarios “balneae”), capilli eius caerulei manebant, et etiam parva ornamenta faciei in eodem loco constituta erant; annuit et ad mensam in media camera se convertit.

unit.source: The room itself was nothing special, though thanks to her connections, which themselves were the result of her completing the quest she ‘received’, she could afford to rent one of the more expensive inns, with wide rooms, quality beds and actual baths.
unit.target: Camera ipsa nihil praeclara erat, sed propter coniunctiones suas, quarum origo ex peracta missione quam acceperat orta erat, poterat conducere unam ex cauponis pretiosioribus, cum conclavibus amplis, lectis optimis, et balneis veris.

unit.source: It cost some money to rent it, but she felt it was worth it.
unit.target: Non parva pecunia expendebatur ad eam conducendam, sed videbatur id pretium valuisse.

unit.source: Nonetheless, she wasn’t shy about making use of the opportunities to make money, thus being able to stream much more interesting things than the other streamers.
unit.target: Attamen, non erat verecunda occasionibus lucrandi utendo, quo poterat res multo curiosiores quam ceteri emissarii ostendere.

unit.source: Her popularity was climbing at a steady pace, though she was realistic enough to realize some of it was because she was a girl streamer, but she couldn’t do much about that…
unit.target: Eius fama constanter crescebat, quamquam satis realistica erat ut agnosceret aliquam partem eius ex eo provenire quod puella emissaria esset, sed de hoc parum efficere posset…

unit.source: On the table were several curious objects, a small box-like object, made of blueish-silver crystalline matter with several parts made of metal, three semi-spherical objects made from the same blueish-silver matter, and a spear with the head of the spear made from the same material.
unit.target: In mensa erant varii obiecti curiosi: parvum obiectum, simile arcā, ex materia crystallina caeruleo-argentea confectum cum aliquot partibus metallicis; tres obiecta semi-spherica ex eadem materia; et sagitta, cuius caput ex eadem materia factum erat.

unit.source: She first took the small box, slipped it into an equally sized satchel that hung on her belt and instantly a notifications screen lit up in front of her.
unit.target: Primum parvum arcae sumpsit, eam in sacculum parīs magnitudinis, qui in cingulo pendentem erat, inseruit atque statim scrinium notificarum coram ea lucebat.

unit.source: [Energy Shield Activated!]
unit.target: [Scutum Energeticum Activatum!]

unit.source: [Crystalline Energy Matrix Integrity 89%!]
unit.target: [Integritas Matricis Energeticae Cristallinae 89%!]

unit.source: Nodding to herself, making a note to herself to do some maintenance on the battery, she raised her left arm and poked at her very normal-looking bracelet.
unit.target: Sui ipsam annuens et meminisse scripta faciens ut curam pilae ageret, bracchium sinistrum levavit et lorum quasi ordinariae specie tanguit.

unit.source: Instantly, she was greeted by a holographic screen showing three lines.
unit.target: Statim eam salutavit scrinium holographicum, quod tres lineas ostendebat.

unit.source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00016 – Activate?]
unit.target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00016 – Activare?]

unit.source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00027 – Activate?]
unit.target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00027 – Activare?]

unit.source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00034 – Activate?]
unit.target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00034 – Activare?]

unit.source: Without hesitating, she touched the screen three times, and the lines vanished, replaced by an hourglass.
unit.target: Sine haesitatione, scrinium ter tetigit, et lineae evanuerunt, substitutae horologio arenae.

unit.source: Moving her attention from the small screen to the table, she watched with a satisfied smile as the remaining spherical artifacts on it shivered, then a small blue light flashed through them and slowly, but surely, began to hover about the table.
unit.target: Attensionem ab parvo scrinio ad mensam transferens, spectabat cum risu contento, dum reliqua artifacta sphaerica fremuerunt, deinde parva lux caerulea per ea micuit et paulatim, sed certē, circa mensam levitāre inceperunt.

unit.source: A second later, their awkward hovering was replaced by a much more confident hovering, accompanied by a slight hum that always comforted her.
unit.target: Ante pauculum tempore, levatio inepta eorum substituta est levatione multo fideli, comitata leni murmuratione quae semper eam consolabat.

unit.source: The drones were rather cute, in her opinion.
unit.target: Droni, ad eius iudicium, satis lepidi erant.

unit.source: They were each the size of a medium medicine ball made of two bigger parts.
unit.target: Singuli erant magnitudinis pilae medianae medicaminis, ex duobus partibus maioribus constituti.

unit.source: Their brains were composed of a bluish-silver spherical crystal material that she used her power on, basically programming them.
unit.target: Cerebra eorum ex materia crystallina sphaerica, caeruleo-argentea, erant, quam ipsa viribus suis opes Loca ad programmandum adhibuit.

unit.source: And the spherical material was held in a cradle of metal that had a small but cute face designed on it while two little stubs of metal with their own tiny balls of crystal hovered next to the drone as arms.
unit.target: Materia sphaerica in cunabulo metallico tenebatur, cui parva sed lepida imago insculpta erat, dum duo parva fragmenta metalli cum globulis crystallinis minutis iuxta dronum ut brachia levitabant.

unit.source: It had taken her several iterations before she was satisfied with their cuteness and functionality.
unit.target: Multas exercitationes necessarias fuerunt, antequam de levitate et functione eorum satisfacta esset.

unit.source: And based on her fans' reactions (and the multitude of fanart) she had made a good decision.
unit.target: Et ex reactionibus fautorum suorum (ac multitudine imaginum fan) bona consilia cepit.

unit.source: One of the drones was for shooting at the enemy, another created somewhat solid shields on her prompting and the last one created chains that immobilized (at most slowed them down, but she hoped with a few level-ups it would truly immobilize) enemies.
unit.target: Unus dronum hostes iaculari destinatus erat, alter ex eius mandato scuta paulo solida creavit, atque novissimus catenas effingebat quae inimicos immobilizare conabantur (saltem eos retardabant, sed sperabat aliquot incrementis vere immobilizare).

unit.source: With the three drones hovering over her shoulder, dipping and bobbing, she took up the spear which was also her creation.
unit.target: Cum tres droni super umerum eius levitabant, oscillantes, sagittam, quae etiam eius creatio erat, tenuit.

unit.source: One part spear, one part magical foci.
unit.target: Quaedam pars sagittae, quaedam pars focus magicus.

unit.source: As of now, thanks to her obsession with getting the drones right, she could barely do more than a few Magic Missiles and such, but one of her contacts has mentioned they had a lead on a crystal-based spell book so she was pretty pumped.
unit.target: Nunc, ob obsessionem suam dronorum recte disponendorum, vix ultra paucos Missilia Magica efficere poterat, sed unus ex coniunctionibus eius indicavit se de libro incantationum ex crystallo composito indagare posse, itaque valde excitata erat.

unit.source: Doing a final check, she took a deep breath, closed her eyes for a minute, then exhaled and activated her streaming app.
unit.target: Ultimam recognitionem faciens, alium spiritum receptum habuit, oculos per minutum clausit, deinde exhalavit et applicationem emittendi activavit.

unit.source: Putting a blinding smile on her face, she exclaimed, “Hello everyone! This is SummerRose and today we are going to check out that scaaaary forest!”
unit.target: Risum fulgidum in facie habituens, exclamavit: “Salvete omnes! Ego sum SummerRose et hodie silvam illam terribilem inspiciemus!”

unit.source: As she headed towards the door, the drones following her, she began to read the comments and started answering her fans.
unit.target: Dum ad ianuam se dirigebat, droni eam secuti, commentaria legere coepit et fautores suos respondere inchoavit.

unit.source: All in all, she was feeling pretty good.
unit.target: Omnino, se satis optime sentiebat.

unit.source: “Slathy! Go for the middle one!”
unit.target: “Slathy! In medium age!”

unit.source: The giant rabbit, now the size of a big child, didn’t show any reaction that it had heard Stephen’s order, instead, the rabbit immediately opened his maw, with teeth almost the size of a child’s forearm, and jumped at the lizard monster he indicated.
unit.target: Lepus ingens, nunc magnitudinis ingentis pueri, nullam reactionem ostendit quod iussum Stephani audiret; potius, lepus statim os suum aperuit, dentes paene aequales brachii pueri habens, et ad monstrum lacertae indicatum saltavit.

unit.source: Soon, their group was standing in the middle of the cavern, all around them corpses of the lizard monsters while their pets and companions were either lazing around or curiously sniffing the corpses or the rock and detritus thrown around.
unit.target: Mox, cohors eorum in medio speluncae stabat, circumdatus cadaveribus monstrorum lacertarum, dum animalia domestica et comites aut inertia vagabantur aut curiosa cadavera atque saxa et reliquias circumiectas odorabant.

unit.source: After he became a team with Slathor, Destroyer of Worlds, all of his friends decided that pets were cute so why shouldn’t they also get one?
unit.target: Postquam cum Slathor, Destructor Mundi, coniunxit, omnes amici eius decreverunt animalia domestica esse lepida, et ideo cur ipsi non haberent unum?

unit.source: So, excited at the opportunity, he took them back to the ranger who helped him, and after completing the quest to gather enough funds to pay the rangers to help them out, all of them got their own pets.
unit.target: Ita, occasione excitatus, eos ad custodem qui eum adiuvabat reduxit, et postquam quaestionem ad satis pecuniae colligendam ad custodes solvendos perfecit, omnes proprias bestias domesticas adepti sunt.

unit.source: Kim also got a rabbit, which made him happy, as it allowed him to spend more time with her.
unit.target: Kim etiam leporem adeptus est, quod eum laetum reddidit, nam plus temporis cum ea agere poterat.

unit.source: Though based on some of the looks he was getting from his friends, he wasn’t really hiding his intentions too well.
unit.target: Quamquam ex vultibus amicorum suorum credebatur, suas vero voluntates non celabat satis.

unit.source: Oh, well… Kim wasn’t complaining, so he wouldn’t say anything.
unit.target: O, bene… Kim non querelabatur, ergo nihil dici velle videbatur.

unit.source: The others got an assortment of other pets: wolves, bears, some more rabbits, somebody got a falcon, and one guy got a snake.
unit.target: Ceteri adepti sunt variae aliae bestiolae: lupi, ursi, plures lepores, aliquis falconem, et unus vir serpentem.

unit.source: It was a very judgemental snake.
unit.target: Serpens valde censorius erat.

unit.source: Stephen felt judged every time the snake looked at him.
unit.target: Stephen se sentiebat iudicatum quoties serpens eum intuēbatur.

unit.source: Those eyes…
unit.target: Isti oculi…

unit.source: As they walked out of the cave, bringing with them the spoils of their fights, they got to talking.
unit.target: Dum speluncam exierunt, praedas certaminum suorum ferentes, colloquia incipiebant.

unit.source: “These animals are pretty great! I can’t believe Stephen had such a good idea!”
unit.target: “Haec animalia vere mirabilia sunt! Non possum credere quod Stephen tam bonam ideam habuerit!”

unit.source: “Hey! Watch the name!”
unit.target: “Heus! Attende nomini!”

unit.source: “Sorry, I mean Cactus…”
unit.target: “Ignosce, dico vero Cactus…”

unit.source: “Hell yeah! My bear is the cutest of them all! But you know what we should do?”
unit.target: “Ita, certe! Ursus meus inter omnes optime amabilis est! Sed scis quid agendum sit?”

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: “Quid?”

unit.source: “We should make a guild for people with animal companions!”
unit.target: “Societatem constituere debemus pro iis qui cum animalibus comitantur!”

unit.source: There was a moment of silence as everybody digested the proposal, and then the area was full of people talking.
unit.target: Momento silentium orta est dum omnes propositum meditabantur, deinde regio plena erat hominibus loquentibus.

unit.source: Apparently, everyone agreed.
unit.target: Apparuit omnes consentisse.

unit.source: Stephen just walked with Slathor next to him, hopping cheerfully (yet menacingly) forward, and looked at his friends happily.
unit.target: Stephen modo ambulavit cum Slathor ad latus, laete (sed minaciter) saliens, et amicis suis cum gaudio intuens.

unit.source: A guild sounded awesome!
unit.target: Societas mirabilis audiebatur!

unit.source: Dave struck down with his halberd, listened to the satisfying crunch that the troll’s head made, then looked over the ‘battlefield’.
unit.target: Dave halberdā sua percussit, auscultans sonum satisfaciens a capite trol factum, deinde “campum belli” contemplatus est.

unit.source: His elite kill team, empowered by the Life of Blood skill books, and the skill books that the Life of Blood skill books netted them, were going through the trolls like a scythe through fresh barley.
unit.target: Manipulus electus caedendi eius, potentia librorum artium “Vitae Sanguinis” impulsus, et operibus eorum libris acquisitis, trolos percurreret quasi falx per hordeum recentem.

unit.source: It was a stroke of genius to create the team.
unit.target: Fuit ictus ingenii coetum condere.

unit.source: It contained all his most loyal minions, all of them criminals for life, and he had enough dirt on them that none of them would even think about betraying him.
unit.target: In ipso continebat omnes fideles ministros eius, quos omnes in vita reos habebant, atque satis notitiarum de illis haberet, ut nemo quidem de proditione cogitare posset.

unit.source: The creation of the group was already paying dividends.
unit.target: Constitutio coetus iam merces praebebat.

unit.source: Thanks to being a small group, a lot of other guilds thought them weak and tried to muscle into their farming territory.
unit.target: Quia coetus parvus erat, multae aliae societates eos debiles arbitrabantur atque in finibus agrorum eorum irruere conabantur.

unit.source: But thanks to the power of his elite team, they were all soundly defeated, or stalled long enough for the rest of his group to arrive.
unit.target: Sed propter virtutem manipuli electi eius, omnes graviter superati sunt, aut satis morati sunt ut reliquus coetus adveniret.

unit.source: As his team finished the last trolls, he spotted his assistant in rather stupid-looking mage robes walking towards him with a frown on his face.
unit.target: Cum manipulus eius ultimos trolos terminaverit, adiutorem suum in vestibus magorum stultos spectandos ad se sequi animadvertit, facie maesta.

unit.source: ‘Probably not good news then…’ he thought, then called out to the man. “What is it?”
unit.target: ‘Forsitan nuntii non boni sint…’ cogitavit, deinde viro exclamat: “Quid est?”

unit.source: “We still can’t find him,” came the simple response.
unit.target: “Eum adhuc invenire non possumus,” inquit simplex responsus.

unit.source: For a moment Dave was confused. “Who?”
unit.target: Paulo Dave confundebatur. “Quis?”

unit.source: “Solar.”
unit.target: “Solar.”

unit.source: “I still don’t remember…”
unit.target: “Nondum memini…”

unit.source: “The guy who could use the sword and magic at the same time and killed one of our quote-unquote bandit groups,” his assistant explained patiently.
unit.target: “Vir qui simul gladium et magiam uti poterat et unum ex nostris ‘latronum’ coetibus interfecit,” adiutor eius patienter exponit.

unit.source: “Ah! Why the hell not?”
unit.target: “Ah! Cur ergo non?”

unit.source: “He simply vanished. For a little while we could follow him in Ironwood, but then…”
unit.target: “Ipse statim evanuit. Parvo tempore eum in ‘Ironwood’ secuti sumus, sed deinde…”

unit.source: “I see…” he mused, bringing up his hand to scratch his chin. ‘Should I grow a badass beard?’
unit.target: “Intelligo…” inquit, manum ad mentum tollens terere, “Crescamne barba forti?”

unit.source: “Should we continue to look for him?”
unit.target: “Numquid eum quaerere pergamus?”

unit.source: Dave thought about it a little but then shook his head.
unit.target: Dave paulum ratiunculavit, ac deinde caput iactavit.

unit.source: “Nah! Leave him be. He was a big shot then, but we are plenty strong. Especially with the money rolling in.”
unit.target: “Non! Relinquite eum. Olim potens fuit, sed nos valde fortes sumus; praesertim cum pecunia ingens fluens.”

unit.source: “Understood, sir,” his assistant replied and, based on the movement of his fingers, he was already sending messages.
unit.target: “Intellectum, domine,” respondit adiutor eius, et ex motu digitorum iam nuntios mittere videbatur.

unit.source: “How are we with the income from the skill books?” Dave asked, his mind back on the piles of gold they were raking in every day.
unit.target: “Quomodo rem gerimus cum reditu ex libris artium?” rogavit Dave, mente ad montes auri cotidie colligendi revertente.

unit.source: There was a moment of silence as his assistant checked something, then he answered. “Still holding around seven thousand gold coins. It fluctuates a little every time a bigger guild or workshop joins the game, but I think it won’t go higher.”
unit.target: Momento silentium orta est dum adiutor aliquid inspiciebat, tum respondit: “Adhuc circiter septem milia nummorum aureorum retenta habemus. Paululum fluctuat quoties maius collegium aut officina ludi se adiunxit, sed puto non ulterius ascendere!”

unit.source: “And the gold farmers?”
unit.target: “Et agricolae aurei?”

unit.source: “Real money is traded currently for ten to fifteen gold.”
unit.target: “Nunc pecunia vera pro decem ad quindecim aureis commutatur.”

unit.source: Dave worked over those statements in his head, doing a little math, then looked over the battlefield and his men as they were harvesting the trolls.
unit.target: Dave dictas res in mente recensuit, paulo arithmetica faciens, deinde campum belli et viros suos, quomodo trolos metirent, contemplatus est.

unit.source: They weren’t just valuable for their drops, but even for their bodies.
unit.target: Non solum ad eorum detrimenta, sed etiam corpora pretiosa erant.

unit.source: Sadly, they were getting fewer and fewer experience points for killing them, and they killed them too fast.
unit.target: Eheu, minora puncta experientiae per caedem earum comparabantur, et eos nimis veloci occidebant.

unit.source: Their respawn timer was just too long.
unit.target: Tempus restitutionis eorum nimis longum erat.

unit.source: They would probably need to expand their hunting grounds.
unit.target: Forsitan fines venandi eorum expandere oporteret.

unit.source: Making a decision he turned towards his assistant.
unit.target: Decidens, ad adiutorem suum se convertit.

unit.source: “Put out a call to the people we know that we are looking for players. We need more muscle.”
unit.target: “Efferte nuntium illis quos cognoscimus: luditores quaerimus; opus est nobis vi ampliore.”

unit.source: The assistant began to make notes, and he continued to issue orders. “Also, start planning a second elite team. Equipment, skill books and the contracts.”
unit.target: Adiutor notare coepit, et praecepta dare continuavit: “Accipite etiam consilium pro secundo manipulo electo: apparatu, libris artium et contractibus.”

unit.source: “Yes, Sir! Anything else?”
unit.target: “Ita, domine! Quid aliud?”

unit.source: Spotting a troll lumbering out of the forest, he shook his head and, with a roar, launched himself at the monster, his halberd raised high, ready to strike true.
unit.target: Videns trolum ex silva laniantem, caput iactavit et, cum fremitu, in monstrum se coniecit, halberda alta extollita, parata ad verum ictum.

unit.source: The studio was well lit, with all the bright lights and background items that one would expect a news program to use that was geared towards presenting news about games.
unit.target: Studio bene illuminato, cum omnibus luminibus claris et rebus scaenicis, quae a programma nuntiario ludorum proposita utendi putabatur.

unit.source: In the middle was a curved desk, all shiny and clean, and behind the desk sat an exceptionally beautiful woman.
unit.target: In medio mensa curva, nitida et pura, et post eam sedebat mulier praeclara pulchra.

unit.source: Her blond hair was carefully arranged around her head, her makeup was picture-perfect, her assets were artistically covered, and she was speaking with a smile that was worth millions.
unit.target: Capilli eius flaventes diligenter circa caput dispositi erant, ornatusque eius ad imaginem perfectam constitutus, opes autem arte tegatae, et loquebatur cum risu pretioso quasi in milionibus.

unit.source: With the advent of the VR gaming scene came the need for information gathering and sharing said information.
unit.target: Cum adventu scenei ludi VR, ortum est necessitas adnotandi et communicandi informationes.

unit.source: Thus the creation of internet channels on video sites that dealt with news about games.
unit.target: Ita factio canalium interretialium in locis video, qui de nuntiis ludorum agerentur, orta est.

unit.source: Then those, slowly over the years, grew into actual TV channels with everything that entailed.
unit.target: Postea illa, annis paulatim transibis, in canales televisificos veros cum omnibus praesentiis formam ceperunt.

unit.source: Including pretty presenter people.
unit.target: Inclusis etiam pulchris moderatoribus.

unit.source: “Welcome everyone, to tomorrow’s news today!” she spoke up, with a steady voice, looking directly into the camera.
unit.target: “Salvete omnes, ad nuntios crastinos hodie!” inquit, voce stabilis, recta in cameram intuentis.

unit.source: “This is Katie Marchik, and you are watching TGN!”
unit.target: “Est Katie Marchik, et TGN spectatis!”

unit.source: The video changed, showing the woman from a different angle, and next to her head was a small window showing a graph that had several very vibrant red lines going up high.
unit.target: Video mutatum est, mulierem ex angulo diverso ostendens, et iuxta caput eius parva fenestra apparebat, quae graphum ostendebat, in quo plures lineae rubrae vibrantes alte ascendebant.

unit.source: “Future Unknown’s recently released game, Magic Unbound, is continuing its rise in popularity.
unit.target: “Ludus nuper ab Future Unknown emissus, Magic Unbound, ascensionem in popularitate continuat.

unit.source: According to the statistics that were published by the developers themselves, and correlated by several independent watch groups, the game’s popularity has risen by two hundred percent.”
unit.target: Secundum statistica a ipsis programmatoribus edita et ab diversis coetibus speculatorum independentium correlata, popularitas huius ludi ducentas centesimas ascendit.

unit.source: A small banner appeared on the bottom of the screen and the presenter smiled.
unit.target: Parva vexillum in infimo scrinii apparuit et moderator ridens fuit.

unit.source: “If you want to know more, please visit our site for more detailed information!”
unit.target: “Si plura scire vultis, quaeso nostrum locum visitate ad informationes accuratissimas!”

unit.source: The scene changed again, and the window next to her head was showing several people standing in line in front of a shop.
unit.target: Scaena denuo mutata est, et fenestra deorsum iuxta caput eius homines in caterva ante tabernam stantes ostendebat.

unit.source: “Current research suggests that there is a steady decline in games sold, as Magic Unbound is currently dominating the gaming market.
unit.target: “Recentia studia ostendunt diminutionem constantem ludorum venditorum, nam Magic Unbound mercatum ludi nunc dominatur.

unit.source: It seems, with the high fidelity and very complicated levelling system, this new game has managed to grab everybody’s attention.
unit.target: Videtur, cum alta fidelitate et systemate levationis valde implicato, hunc novum ludum omnium attentionem cepisse.

unit.source: Both young and old.”
unit.target: Et iuvenes et senes.

unit.source: The woman smiled, shuffled the papers in front of her, and then continued speaking.
unit.target: Mulier risit, chartas ante se miscebat, tum sermonem pergere coepit.

unit.source: “Our research also suggests that many gaming workshops, including GoldenHare, BambooShoots and Silent Step, have made a decision to move their focus onto the game and leave behind their current games.
unit.target: “Studia nostra etiam indicant plurimas officinas ludorum, inter quas GoldenHare, BambooShoots et Silent Step, decreverunt se intentionem in hunc ludum translatam habere et reliquos ludos deserere.

unit.source: As you know, these workshops boast memberships in thousands and have several experts in their ranks.
unit.target: Ut scitis, hae officinae sodalitia in multitūdine habent et plures peritos in suis ordinibus possident.

unit.source: Their move will definitely boost the game’s popularity even further!”
unit.target: Motus eorum certe popularitatem ludi adhuc augebit!

unit.source: The woman paused for a moment, followed by an impish smile appearing on her face.
unit.target: Mulier momento stetit, et deinde risus impius in facie eius apparuit.

unit.source: “Of course, this fame also aroused the interest of the corporate world.
unit.target: “Certe, haec fama etiam studium mercatorum excitavit.

unit.source: “TGN has the word that several corporate research teams have been reviewing the possibilities that the game, Magic Unbound, could provide.”
unit.target: “TGN fert verba quod plures turmae investigationis corporativae de opportunitatibus, quas ludus Magic Unbound praebere posset, recensuerint.”

unit.source: The studio lights flashed a little, and when the lights died down to their previous intensity, the scene was changed back to the first one, with Katie sitting behind the desk, smiling at the camera.
unit.target: Luminaria studi bene micaverunt, et cum ad pristinam potentiam redierunt, scaena reddita est ad primam, cum Katie post mensam sedens in cameram subrisset.

unit.source: “And now, thanks to Future Unknown, we here at TGN are proud to present the latest trailer for Magic Unbound with actual footage from the game.
unit.target: “Et nunc, gratias Future Unknown, nos hic TGN gloriantes sumus novissimum trailer pro Magic Unbound, cum imaginibus authenticis ex ludo, praebere.

unit.source: Future Unknown has assured us that they used footage from real players and none of them were beta players!
unit.target: Future Unknown nobis assecuravit se imaginum ex veris lusoribus usum esse, nec ullam versionem beta adhibuisse!

unit.source: So, my dear watchers can rest assured you will be seeing real gameplay!”
unit.target: Ita, spectatores mei dilecti, certiores eritis fore vos verum ludum videre!

unit.source: The scene began to darken, and the woman spoke one last sentence.
unit.target: Scaena tenebris coepit tegari, et mulier ultimam sententiam dixit.

unit.source: “After the trailer, I’ll be here, and we’ll be talking with an expert in martial arts about them in the game Magic Unbound.
unit.target: “Post trailer, hic ero, et cum perito artium martialium de illis in ludo Magic Unbound colloquemur.

unit.source: Happy watching!”
unit.target: Felices spectantes!

unit.source: The video darkened fully, showing a fully black screen for a second, and then it was filled with all manner of colors swirling, while rhythmic music began playing.
unit.target: Video omnino obscuratum est, scrinium totum nigrum per momentum ostendens, deinde cum variis coloribus gyrantibus impletum, dum musica rhythmatica sonare inceperunt.

unit.source: On the screen, one could see a group of mages, in mismatched robes, pointing their foci at a giant tree in a middle of a swamp.
unit.target: In schermo, coetum magorum videre poteras, in vestimentis disparatis, qui suos focus ad arborem ingentem in medio paludis digitabant.

unit.source: The tree’s stump opened, and a massive maw appeared filled with nothing but darkness.
unit.target: Radix arboris aperiebatur, et os ingens apparuit, nihil nisi tenebris plenum.

unit.source: A roar could be heard, and then the mages’ foci all lit up and fireballs began bombarding the monster.
unit.target: Rugitus audiebatur, et deinde omnes focus magorum lucere coeperunt atque globuli ignis monstrum oppugnare inceperunt.

unit.source: The next scenes showed several craftsmen laboring over all manner of weapons, armors and artifacts.
unit.target: Scaenae secundae pluries artifices ostenderunt, laborantes ad omnes genera armorum, loricorum et rerum mirabilium.

unit.source: A blacksmith was feverishly hammering something with their hammer, while forge fire roared next to them.
unit.target: Faber, cum martello ferventi aliquid pulsat, dum ignis in fabrica iuxta eum rugit.

unit.source: A beautiful woman was humming, sitting next to a window and stitching a silky cloth in their hands.
unit.target: Mulier pulchra submurmurabat, iuxta fenestram sedens, atque linteum sericum in manibus conscribebat.

unit.source: A man covered in all manner of devices, both arcane and scientific, was looking through goggles at a small mysterious cube on a desk.
unit.target: Vir, omnibus generibus machinarum opertus, tam arcane quam scientificis, per oculos speciales intuerebat parvum cubum mysteriosum super mensam.

unit.source: Following that were several farmers tending to their fields, and gardens.
unit.target: Sequebantur agricolae, qui agros et hortos colere curabant.

unit.source: Alchemist harvesting and using materials.
unit.target: Alchymista materias metiebat et adhibebat.

unit.source: People venturing into forests for all manner of exotic flora and fauna.
unit.target: Homines in silvas incipiebant, quaerentes omnes species exotericas florum et bestiarum.

unit.source: The music began to speed up.
unit.target: Musica celerius audiri incipiebat.

unit.source: People fighting monsters, people fighting alongside monsters, even people riding on monsters.
unit.target: Homines monstris pugnantes, homines simul cum monstris pugnantes, etiam homines super monstris vehentes.

unit.source: A werewolf tearing apart sheep monsters.
unit.target: Homo-lupus, monstrum ovinum lanians.

unit.source: A man dancing with his sword through a veritable flood of giant grasshoppers.
unit.target: Vir gladio suo saltans per inundationem veram ingentium locustarum.

unit.source: Snake people besieging a village hastily barricaded, with the defenders looking through the gaps of the barricade.
unit.target: Homines serpentiformes oppidum celeriter obsidere coeperunt, cum defensores per hiatus strati intuentes.

unit.source: And so on…
unit.target: Et cetera…

unit.source: Finally, the scene darkened again, and the only thing that was shown was the name of the game.
unit.target: Denique, scaena iterum obscuravit, et sola res quae apparuit, nomen ludi erat.

unit.source: Magic Unbound
unit.target: Magic Unbound

unit.source: They were sitting in a pub on the shadier side of the town.
unit.target: In popina sedebant in parte obscuriore urbis.

unit.source: Everybody, even the servers were wearing cloaks that hid their features, and so did they.
unit.target: Omnes, etiam ministri, pallias induti gerebant, quae vultus eorum celabant, atque ita illi.

unit.source: Everything was covered by some kind of magical fog, which made it hard to see anything further than their table, which was its exact purpose.
unit.target: Omnia operiebantur quibusdam nebulis magicis, quae efficiebant ut ultra mensam videre haud facile possent, quod ipsarum causae erant.

unit.source: “So you managed to get something for me?” spoke up the man across from him.
unit.target: “Ita quid mihi obtinuisse potuisti?” inquit vir adversus eum.

unit.source: “Yeah, got into contact with a guy who finally could get me some proper answers.”
unit.target: “Ita, contaxi cum viro qui denique mihi responsa apta deducere potuit.”

unit.source: “And?”
unit.target: “Et?”

unit.source: “We are good.”
unit.target: “Bene sumus.”

unit.source: “Yeah?”
unit.target: “Ita?”

unit.source: “Yeah.”
unit.target: “Ita.”

unit.source: “Good. Anything else?”
unit.target: “Bene. Aliud?”

unit.source: “The situation in Ironwood is proceeding as we predicted. The guilds are still squabbling over the trolls, leaving us the bounty in the city. And this opportunity…”
unit.target: “Res in Ironwood procedit ut praediximus. Guildae adhuc de trolis certant, relinquentes nobis praemia in urbe. Et haec occasio…”

unit.source: “Yes, this calamity will allow us to properly take over.”
unit.target: “Ita, haec calamitas nos recte superare sinet.”

unit.source: “We still have a few steps in the quest, but my sources say that we are on track. There is nothing that can stop us!”
unit.target: “Adhuc paucos gradus in missione habemus, sed fontes mei nuntiunt nos in via esse. Nihil nos prohibere potest!”

unit.source: “Good!”
unit.target: “Bene!”

unit.source: The second man hesitated for a moment as he watched the other man sip his probably shitty beer.
unit.target: Secundus vir momento cunctatus est, dum alium virum spectabat, qui probabiliter ignobili cerevisia sorbebat.

unit.source: “I’m sorry to ask this boss, but was this shady darkness and cloak-and-dagger stuff necessary? Couldn’t we just talk in the offi…”
unit.target: “Ignosce, domine, sed num hoc umbratilem obscuritatem et rem pallio-culterisque necessariam habuimus? Nonne simpliciter in officio loqui potuimus…”

unit.source: He was, however, interrupted by the other man slapping the beer mug on the table, rattling it.
unit.target: Intermissus est tamen a viro altero, qui poculum cerevisiae in mensam pulsavit, illud fremens.

unit.source: “But think of the roleplaying!”
unit.target: “Sed cogitate de ludis simulandi!”

unit.source: The second man just sighed…
unit.target: Secundus vir tantum suspiravit…

unit.source: Sam stepped inside the hole in the mountain, instantly casting Mana Shield, Mana Sense, Mana Sight and conjuring a Light Ball over his head for visibility.
unit.target: Sam in puteum montis intravit, statim incantans Scutum Manae, Sensus Manae, Visum Manae atque globulum Lucis super caput suum evocans ad conspectum.

unit.source: His sword was in his hand, ready to strike and thrumming with mana barely restrained.
unit.target: Gladius eius in manu erat, paratus ad impetum et pulsans cum mana vix continuta.

unit.source: He took a few steps, then turned around and called out.
unit.target: Paucos gradus fecit, deinde se convertit et clamitavit.

unit.source: “Are you coming, ma’am?”
unit.target: «Venis, domina?»

unit.source: There was a moment of silence, and then the giant cricket, still in her smaller form, hopped in front of the cave entrance and faced Sam.
unit.target: Momenti silentii fuit, deinde grylla ingens—adhuc in forma parva—ante ostium speluncae salivit et Sam aspexit.

unit.source: Then, somehow shook her head. Without having a neck…
unit.target: Deinde, quadam ratione, caput suum concussit, cum collum non haberet…

unit.source: “No, child of man. That is your test to see through. I shall stay here and perhaps I may find out why this place seems so familiar…”
unit.target: «Non, puer hominis. Ista est probatio tua ad pervidendum. Hic manebo atque, forsitan, cognoscam cur locus hic tam familiaris appareat…»

unit.source: Sam nodded, relieved yet a little disappointed.
unit.target: Sam caput annuit, solamen inveniens sed paulo deiectus.

unit.source: “Alright! Have fun!”
unit.target: «Recte! Gaude!»

unit.source: Having a powerhouse in his pocket, or rather on top of his head, would have been great, but he didn’t mind leaving the monster behind as he couldn’t exactly control them.
unit.target: Habere virtutem potentem in sinu—vel potius super caput—optimum fuisset, sed non cura eum vexavit monstrum relinquere, quoniam ea regere non poterat.

unit.source: With that squared away, he turned back towards the empty darkness, only illuminated by his Light Ball, and took a step forward.
unit.target: Hoc compositum habens, se iterum convertit ad tenebras vacuas, solum globulo Lucis eius illustratas, et passum in antecessum fecit.

unit.source: Then another and another, until the only thing he could see was the illuminated circle around him, and only hear his own heartbeat and steps reverberating around the corridor filled with rubble and roots poking out of the ceiling.
unit.target: Deinde alterum et alterum, donec sola visio eius fuerat circulus lucidus circa eum, atque tantum audiebat pulsus cordis sui et vestigia gressuum resonantia in corridorum, plenum ruinarum atque radicum ex tecto evidentium.

unit.source: While the Blood Contract was a rather motivating force behind his haste, Sam was actually rather interested in preventing the Ironwood Monster Break.
unit.target: Dum Pactum Sanguinis vis ad festinationem eius fovebat, Sam vero magis studebat Rupturam Monstrorum Ligna Ferrei prohibere.

unit.source: Granted, his first plans were based on that break.
unit.target: Certe, prima consilia eius in eo eventu fundabantur.

unit.source: He planned to amass enough money to buy a few plots that would become valuable after the Break, but now that he had an actual front‐row seat to the event, he was pretty sure he could get something much better than a few plots of land.
unit.target: Consilium habebat argentum satis congregare ut paucas fundias emeret, quae post Rupturam pretiosae fiebant; sed nunc, cum in prima fila eventus sedisset, satis certus erat se aliquid multo melius quam paucas fundias adepturum esse.

unit.source: The quest was rather unique, so Sam didn’t actually have any idea what he would get.
unit.target: Expeditio singularis erat, itaque Sam re vera nesciabat quid consequiturum esset.

unit.source: Even his inherited memories were no help here as the other Sam wasn’t one of the pioneers that died of unique quests every day, so most of his knowledge about these things was from second or sometimes even third-hand.
unit.target: Etiam memoriae hereditatae ei non suffuerunt, quoniam alter Sam non erat unus ex innovatoribus, qui per expeditiones singulares cotidie interirem, itaque plurima notitia eius de his rebus ex testimoniis secundariis vel tertiariis orta erat.

unit.source: Thus, Sam’s gamer senses were tingling…
unit.target: Ita sensus ludi Sam titillabantur…

unit.source: As he walked through the corridors, he made sure to watch out for everything, paying special attention to the ceiling (he read enough stories about the MC hiding up there because ‘nobody looks up’) as he had no need for a surprise monster to the head.
unit.target: Dum per corridoria ambulabat, cuperat omnia observare, maxime attendens laquearia (satis fabularum legit de protagonista illic latente, quia “nemo sursum spectat”) cum monstrum subitaneum in capite ei non opus esset.

unit.source: After five minutes of uneventful walking, dodging rocks on the ground, or giant roots that, over time, managed to break through the hard stone that made up the wall, Sam arrived in a small chamber.
unit.target: Post quinque minuta ambulandi sine incommodis, lapides terreni evitans atque radices ingentes, quae tempore lapidem durum muri constituentem fregere potuerunt, Sam in cellam parvam pervenit.

unit.source: Thankfully, the entrance to the chamber was in a much better shape than the one that lead directly to the outside.
unit.target: Fortunate, ostium cellae in multo meliore statu erat quam ille, qui directe ad foras ducebat.

unit.source: Stepping carefully into the chamber, his senses cranked to the maximum, Sam looked around curiously.
unit.target: Cautissime cellam ingressus, sensus ad summum excitatos habens, Sam circumspiciebat cum curiositate.

unit.source: There wasn’t much.
unit.target: Non erat multum.

unit.source: Another arch, leading deeper inside the mountain, a few benches near the walls and a stone bowl with water dripping into it from a hole in the wall.
unit.target: Altera arcus, quae interiora montis ducebat, pauca subsellia iuxta muros atque urna lapidea, in quam aqua per foram in muro stillabat.

unit.source: Only, so much time had elapsed that the dripping water eroded the stone bowl, so much that it was standing in a small pool that was trickling towards a hole in a nearby wall, made by a root that has long since rotted off.
unit.target: Sed tantum tempus elapsum erat ut aqua stillans urnam lapideam abrasset, ita ut illa in parva piscina steteret, quae versus foram in muro proximo, a radice diu putrescente, fluebatur.

unit.source: His senses told him there was nothing behind the walls either on purpose or hidden, so Sam simply walked around the small pool of water and continued his journey through the arch.
unit.target: Sensus eius significabant nihil post muros esse, nec celatum neque consilio dispositum; itaque Sam circa parvam piscinam aquae ambulavit et iter per arcum continuavit.

unit.source: Sam barely took a few steps when he heard an ominous noise.
unit.target: Sam vix paucos gressus fecit, cum sonum infaustum audivit.

unit.source: It sounded like grinding stone mixed with someone yelling from inside a very deep well.
unit.target: Sonabat quasi lapides molebantur, mixti cum aliquo e intimo puteo vehementer clamante.
