unit.source: Tightening the shield around him and channeling a little more mana into his sword, his other ready to unleash some of his meagre amount of skills, he began walking forward cautiously, while the sound continued to come ever so closer.
unit.target: Scutum circa se stringens et paullo maiorem quantitatem mana in gladium suum infundens, cum altera manus ad paucas artes suas emittendas parata, coepit cautus progredi, dum sonus propius accedebat.

unit.source: Finally, his nerves a little frayed, and the unknown entity entered the visible patch of the corridor.
unit.target: Postremo, nervi eius paulo tensi, et ens ignotum in partem visibilem corridoris intravit.

unit.source: It was a mass of rocks, ground and moss, with short stubby legs and arms, no head, just two sinister glowing eyes half-hidden behind moss and other detritus.
unit.target: Erat multitudo lapidum, terrae et muschi, cum cruribus et brachiis brevi et paulum contortis, sine capite, solum duo oculi sinistri fulgentes, partim absconditi post muscum atque reliqua detrita.

unit.source: And to his magical senses, it oozed some kind of black miasma, that caused his stomach to turn.
unit.target: Et sensibus magicis eius apparuit miasma obscurum effluere, quod stomachum eius concitabat.

unit.source: While his attention was fully on the newly revealed monster, Sam still had enough mind to notice the similarities between the miasma coming from the small moss‑slash‑rock golem and the noble lady whose ailment he was planning to heal.
unit.target: Dum tota attentio eius in novo monstrum patefacto versabatur, Sam tamen satis animi habebat ad agnoscendas similitudines inter miasma, quod ex parvo golem musco‑lapideo emanaat, et mulierem nobilem, cuius aegritudinem sanare intendebat.

unit.source: He didn’t have more time to ponder the situation as the little monster, barely reaching his hips raised their hand, roared, filling the corridor with the sound of rocks banging together, and ‘charged’ at him.
unit.target: Non habebat tempus plura meditandi, cum parvum monstrum, vix ad coxas eius attingens, manum levavit et rugivit, corridorem sonitu lapidum inter se percussorum implet, et in eum impetum fecit.

unit.source: At the speed, one would expect a moss‑covered rock to move.
unit.target: Ad velocitatem, quam exspectaretur, saxum musco opertum se moveret.

unit.source: That is, not very fast.
unit.target: Id est, non nimis celeriter.

unit.source: Sam simply sidestepped the ‘speedy’ charge and, with one steady swing, cut the monster in half.
unit.target: Sam impetum celerem facile latius evitavit, et uno ictu constanti monstrum in duas partes secavit.

unit.source: Ignoring the experience point notification, he turned back towards the darkness.
unit.target: Notificatio de punctis experientiae neglecta, se ad tenebras redegit.

unit.source: ‘If all the monsters inside are this type, then it will be ea-‘
unit.target: «Si omnia monstra intus huiusmodi erunt, tunc ea—»

unit.source: His thoughts were however interrupted, as the darkness was suddenly illuminated by dozens of maliciously staring eyes that looked suspiciously like the little golem he killed, and sadly, not all the eyes were at hip level.
unit.target: Sed cogitationes eius interpellatae sunt, cum tenebrae subito a decenis oculis malitiose spectantibus illustratae essent, quae suspiciosae similes erant parvo golem, quem interfecit, et, pro dolore, non omnes oculi ad coxas pertingebant.

unit.source: The next second he was shaken by the roar as hundreds, maybe thousands of moss‑covered golems roared at the same time.
unit.target: Secundo, per rugitum concussus est, cum centena—fortasse milia—golem musco opertorum simul rugirent.

unit.source: Steadying himself, ignoring as the entire mountain shook with the roar, he read the notification that popped up.
unit.target: Firmans se, dum totus mons rugitu tremens appareret, legebat notificationem quae emergebat.

unit.source: “Well, fuck…”
unit.target: «Heu, futue…»

unit.source: Inside his shadow, he could feel Lucky shift, and there was no time to think as the monsters were upon him.
unit.target: In umbra sua sensit Lucky se mutare, et tempus cogitandi non erat, quoniam monstra in eum appropinquabant.

unit.source: They charged at him on the ground, hanging from the walls and even skittering on the ceiling.
unit.target: In terram in eum impetum fecerunt, a muris pendentia atque etiam in laquearibus rapiditer currentes.

unit.source: They were all made of rock and covered by ancient moss, some solid, but most of them were loose rocks and stone fallen from the old stone walls, held together by shadowy miasma.
unit.target: Omnia ex lapide facta erant atque antiquo musco operta; quaedam firma, sed pleraque erant lapides soluti et saxa ex veteribus muris lapsa, coniuncta miasma umbratali.

unit.source: He opened with a wide Mana Slash, creating a gap in the front of the charging monsters, then began a deathly dance.
unit.target: Inchoavit lato Mana Incisio, spatium in fronte monstrorum impetantium creans, et deinde saltationem mortiferam incepit.

unit.source: Striking every monster that came close, making sure that none of them got behind him, while Lucky, like some weird shark, snapped out of his shadow, and with his jaws turning every small monster that got through Sam into powder.
unit.target: Percutiens singulos monstrorum propinquos, cavens ne quis post eum incidat, dum Lucky, velut mirus squalus, ex umbra sua emersit et mandibulis suis omne parvum monstrum, quod per Sam transisset, in pulverem verteret.

unit.source: For every step, he fought, striking down several monsters, ranging in size and shape from small corgi to full‑sized humans, including some terrifying cat‑sized ones, shaped like a spider, that liked to skitter up on the ceiling.
unit.target: Pro quolibet gressu, pugnavit, complura monstra deicens, quarum forma et magnitudo variabant ab parvo cane (corgi) ad integros homines, inter quos erant etiam aliquae, magnitudine felis, quasi araneae similes, quae in laquearibus currere solebant.

unit.source: Those he shot down with simple Wind Blades, and the ones that were fast enough to evade his shots were torn apart by Lucky, who was prowling behind him.
unit.target: Illos deiciebat cum simplicibus Venti Laminis, et qui celeriter ictus eius evadere poterant, Lucky dissecabat, qui post eum se latebat.

unit.source: And thanks to his new skills, Flow and Shadow Footsteps, he was managing to evade most of the thrown rocks.
unit.target: Et novis artibus suis, Flow et Umbrae Vestigia, gratia, pleraque lapides iactatos evitare poterat.

unit.source: With Flow, he could see a sort of wake in front of the monsters with his Mana Sight and, using that, he could predict where they would strike or move.
unit.target: Cum Flow, videre poterat quasi vestigia ante monstris per Visum Manae, atque ea utens, praedicere currorem, ubi impetum facerent vel moverent.

unit.source: It was a fascinating development, but sadly he couldn’t really make use of it anywhere else, as the black miasma dripping from the monsters stood out very well in front of the generally homogenous mana of the mountain and ruin.
unit.target: Evolutio illa admodum mirabilis erat, sed tristiter aliunde uti eam non poterat, cum miasma nigrum, quod ex monstris stillabat, clare eminens appareret coram mana montis et ruinarum uniformi.

unit.source: Maybe when it leveled up…
unit.target: Forsitan, cum gradu suo augebitur…

unit.source: He moved in a circular motion, slashing his sword forward then instantly backward, creating two Mana Slashes in the same instant, then he didn’t even get to watch as two hog‑sized moss golems disintegrated, the miasma sinking into the ground as two more took their place and raised their rather rigid hands to strike Sam.
unit.target: Circuivus motu se movebat, gladium suum ante et deinde subito retro ictu feriens, duo Mana Incisiones eodem momento creans, et deinde ne spectare quidem potuit, cum duo golem musco operti, magnitudine porcorum similes, dissolverentur—miasma in terram submergens—dum alia duo eorum vicem obtinuerunt et manus rigidas ad impetum Sam elevaverunt.

unit.source: Continuing the motion with his sword, he dispatched them with Mana Strikes, then carried on with his journey towards his goal, which his still‑lit Light Ball was starting to illuminate.
unit.target: Perseverans in motu gladii, eos per Mana Incisiones deiecit, atque iter suum ad finem prosequens, quod globus Lucis eius, adhuc lucebat, incipiebat illustrari.

unit.source: As on the edge of the space, he could see thanks to the spell, Sam could see another arch, which hopefully led to a chamber where he could rest.
unit.target: In limite spatii, gratias incantationi, Sam aliam arcum videre poterat, quae—ut sperabat—ad cellam quietis ducebat.

unit.source: Though, he felt that if his luck held up, then it was probably a mini‑boss fight instead of resting…
unit.target: Attamen sensit, si fortuna eius favebat, probabiliter pugna minor ducis esset pro quiete…

unit.source: Slowly but surely, he continued to cut down the monsters that came pouring from beyond the arch, then with a last, heavy step, he crossed a threshold, stepping over slowly dissipating monster corpses and crumbling rocks only to come face to face with a giant chamber, walls crumbling leading to what was, once in the past, rooms.
unit.target: Lente sed certo, monstra quae extra arcum effluere secabat, deinde ultimo gressu gravissimo limen transiunxit, super cadavera monstrorum paulatim dissolventium atque saxa corruentia calcans, ut in facie conveniret cum cella ingenti, cuius muri, in ruina cademus, ad olim cellas ducebantur.

unit.source: And in the middle of the chamber was one giant rock, levitating in the middle. Though it wasn’t whole, as through its spherical body several cracks crisscrossed, filled with the oh‑so‑familiar black miasma.
unit.target: Et in medio cellae erat saxum ingens, levitans; quamquam non integer, cum per corpus sphaericum eius plura fissura intersecabantur et replentur miasma nigro—optime noto.

unit.source: The moment Sam stepped through the arch, there was a stillness in the air and the still‑attacking monster fell back around the giant sphere of rock and miasma while the archway was locked behind him with an opaque black curtain that felt solid under a brief touch.
unit.target: Momento quo Sam per arcum ingressus est, quietis aeris habitus apparuit et monstrum, quod adhuc in impetu erat, circa ingens sphaeram lapidis atque miasma retrocessit, dum introitus post eum clausa esset ab opacis atris velaminibus, firmis sub brevi tactu.

unit.source: Fortunately, Lucky was also fast enough to enter the room.
unit.target: Fortunate, et Lucky celeritate satis habebat ut in cellam intraret.

unit.source: The fluffy wolf stood next to him, tail down and nose pointed at the floating rock and softly growling while the shadows that partially made up his body writhed in apparent anger.
unit.target: Lupus lanuginosus iuxta eum stetit, cauda demissa et naso ad saxum levitans directe, leniter rugiens, dum umbrae, quae partim corpus eius constituebant, in manifesta ira concutarentur.

unit.source: Sam patted the wolf’s head for a few seconds as he took in the situation, absentmindedly noting that Lucky had once again grown.
unit.target: Sam caput lupi per paucos secundos palpat, dum rem contemplabatur, notans insciti quod Lucky iterum cresceret.

unit.source: Then the floating rock pulsed once again, and his Mana Shield dipped a little, and the small monsters congregating around the rock fell apart.
unit.target: Tum saxum levitans rursus pulsavit, et Scutum Manae eius paulum deiecit, atque monstra parva qua saxo circum congregata erant, dissoluta sunt.

unit.source: Sam watched, fascinated, (though he fired off a few Mana Slashes and Wind Blades at the construct, to no results) as the rock, moss, dirt, small roots, and corpses of rodents were slowly mixed together and then rose into the air.
unit.target: Sam spectabat, fascinatō, (quamquam aliquot Mana Incisiones et Venti Laminas in constructum iaciebat, sed frustra) dum saxum, muscus, terra, radicula parva et cadavera murium lente miscēbantur et deinde in aer surgebant.

unit.source: At the same time, the miasma from the rock began to leak out, mixing with the detritus on the ground, hefting it into the air to float around the rock, like asteroids around a planet.
unit.target: Simul, miasma ex saxo effluere coepit, cum detritis in terra miscebat, ea in aer elevans ut circum saxo flueret, velut asteroides circa planetam.

unit.source: Then the dirt orbiting the rock began to take shape, bolstered by the material taken from the rock.
unit.target: Tum terra, quae circum saxo orbita, formam capere coepit, confirmata materia ex saxo collecta.

unit.source: Several seconds later, Sam stood across from a rock golem standing twelve feet tall (cursing cinematic transformations), held together by black miasma, with hundreds of malicious eyes upon its body and a very visible core under all that armor in the middle of its body.
unit.target: Paucis secundis post, Sam adversus golem lapideum, duodecim pedum altitudinis stantem (maledicens transformationes cinematographicas), miasma nigro coniunctum, cum centenis oculorum malitiosorum super corpus eius et nucleo manifeste visibili sub omni armatura in medio eius, stetit.

unit.source: “Well, at least they made it easy to figure it out…” he spoke out loud, then before the enemy golem could finish its first step, he exclaimed.
unit.target: «Bene, saltem id facile inveniendum fecerunt…» in voce edixit, et tum, antequam golem hostilis primum gressum perficeret, exclamavit.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»

unit.source: Using the superior speed granted by the Shadow Burst skill, his own Mana Body Reinforcement skill, and pumping a little more mana into them than needed, Sam was fast enough to immediately launch himself behind the behemoth.
unit.target: Utendo velocitate superiori tributa per artem Eruptio Umbrarum, propria arte Mana Corpus Confirmatio, et paulo maius mana in ea impendens quam necessario fuit, Sam sufficiente celer erat ut statim se post behemothum jeceret.

unit.source: He arrived, looking up at the craggy back of the golem, which immediately began to slowly turn around.
unit.target: Advenit, intuens ad dorsum asperum golem, qui statim paulatim circumvertere inceperat.

unit.source: Sam didn’t let it. Using Mana Strike, he concentrated a lot of mana into the tip of his sword, and then he thrust with full strength.
unit.target: Sam id non permisit. Usus Mana Incisio, magnam quantitatem mana in aciem gladii sui concentravit, deinde impetu pleno confodit.

unit.source: The sword, enhanced with his mana and supported by his body enhancement, penetrated the back of the golem, the tip of the sword deeply embedded into the core of the monster.
unit.target: Gladius, mana eius auctus et corpore confirmatus, dorsum golem penetravit, acies gladii alte in nucleum monstri insita.

unit.source: Its body frozen in mid-movement, the noise previously filling the chamber vanishing and the miasma also froze as if surprised then it began leaking from the body of the golem, followed by the monster’s body falling apart, while Sam stepped back with a satisfied expression on his face.
unit.target: Corpus eius, in medio motu immobilitum, sonus, qui antea cellam replebat, evanuit, et miasma quoque, quasi obstupefactum, congelatum est, deinde ex corpore golem effluere coepit, cum corpus monstri dissolveretur, dum Sam vultu contento retrorsum gressus fecit.

unit.source: ‘Apparently, the tactics to fight golems are still valid…’ he thought while watching the ‘death throes’ of the golem.
unit.target: «Apparenter, consilia ad golems oppugnandos adhuc valent…» cogitavit, dum exitus mortis golem contemplabatur.

unit.source: Finally, the last piece of rock fell with a small thunk upon the giant pile of rock and dirt in the middle of the room, and Sam was greeted with a small collection of notification screens.
unit.target: Denique, ultima pars lapidis parvo strepitu super ingentem congeriem lapidum atque terrae in medio cellae cecidit, et Sam ex parva collectione monitorum notificationum salutatus est.

unit.source: [Your companion, Lucky, has reached Level 13!]
unit.target: [Socius tuus, Lucky, Gradum XIII attigit!]

unit.source: [Lucky has gained a new skill, Shadow Strike!]
unit.target: [Lucky novam artem adeptus est, Percussio Umbrarum!]

unit.source: [Shadow Strike: Level Max (Active/Passive) All attacks started from the shadows receive bonus damage, and the wolf can clad itself in shadows while striking at an enemy increasing its range of attack.]
unit.target: [Percussio Umbrarum: Gradus Maximus (Activa/Passiva) Omnes impetus, qui ex umbris inchoantur, damnum bonus accipiunt, et lupus se in umbris induere potest dum hosti impetum inferit, ita spatium ictus auget.]

unit.source: Taking a look at the wolf that was now visibly bigger, wagging his tail and curiously sniffing the pile that was a few seconds ago a very threatening golem, Sam shook his head with a wry smile.
unit.target: Aspectans lupum, qui nunc visibiliter maior erat, caudam movebat et curiose congregatum, quod paucis ante golem valde minax fuisset, olfactabat—Sam caput annuit cum risu sardonico.

unit.source: Then he refocused on the screens.
unit.target: Deinde in monitoria se rursus concentravit.

unit.source: [Thanks to fighting in sync with your companion, your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 12!]
unit.target: [Gratias certamine synchrono cum socio tuo, ars tua Vinculum Spirituum Gradum XII attigit!]

unit.source: [Shadow Footwork has reached Level 3!]
unit.target: [Vestigia Umbrarum Gradum III attigerunt!]

unit.source: [Shadow Burst has reached Level 1!]
unit.target: [Eruptio Umbrarum Gradum I attigit!]

unit.source: [Mana Shield has reached Level 24!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Gradus XXIV attigit!]

unit.source: [Sustained Mana Shield has reached Level 2!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum Gradus II attigit!]

unit.source: It was a pity about Mana Shield as he was looking forward to what would be the Level 25 sub‑skill, but it couldn’t be helped as the fight wasn’t really dangerous, so he didn’t really need to use it much. The most damage it suffered was when the dark miasma tried to strike at him directly.
unit.target: Dolet de Scuto Manae, cum exspectaret quid sub‑ars Gradus XXV futurum esset, sed nihil efficere poterat, quoniam pugna non vere periculosa erat; ideo non multum usui eius indigens fuit. Maxima damna passi sunt cum miasma obscurum directe in eum impetum facere conatus est.

unit.source: [Light Ball has reached Level 6!]
unit.target: [Globus Lucis Gradus VI attigit!]

unit.source: [Wind Blade has reached Level 7!]
unit.target: [Lamina Ventorum Gradus VII attigit!]

unit.source: [Mage Sight has reached Level 7!]
unit.target: [Visus Magi Gradus VII attigit!]

unit.source: [Mana Strike reached Level 9!]
unit.target: [Mana Incisio Gradus IX attigit!]

unit.source: [Efficient Mana Slash has reached level 1!]
unit.target: [Mana Incisio Efficax Gradus I attigit!]

unit.source: [Mana Body Enhancement has reached level 19!]
unit.target: [Mana Corpus Amplificatio Gradus XIX attigit!]

unit.source: [Flow has reached Level 3!]
unit.target: [Flow Gradus III attigit!]

unit.source: [Multitasking has reached level 39!]
unit.target: [Multitasking Gradus XXXIX attigit!]

unit.source: Then came his favorite notification.
unit.target: Deinde venit notificatio eius praedilecta.

unit.source: [Thanks to your dedication to your craft, you managed to perform two Mana Slashes almost at the same time, granting you the Double Mana Slash skill!]
unit.target: [Gratias dedicationi erga artem tuam, duas Mana Incisiones fere simul perficere potuisti, tibi donans artem Duo Mana Incisio!]

unit.source: [Double Mana Slash: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your slashes with any weapon capable of slashing while slashing so fast it doubles the effect. The sub‑skills of Mana Slash also affect this skill.]
unit.target: [Duo Mana Incisio: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Permittit tibi damnum incisionum tuarum augere cum quolibet armis, quod incidere potest, dum tam celeriter incidis ut effectum duplicet. Sub‑artes Mana Incisio hanc artem quoque afficiunt.]

unit.source: It was a simple concept, doing two slashes after each other fast enough that there was barely any pause between them, but it took some practice.
unit.target: Conceptus ille simplex erat: duas incisiones sequentibus tam celeriter perficere ut paulum inter eas interponeret, sed tamen exercitationem quaesivit.

unit.source: Luckily, he had some practice time with the giant grasshoppers, so he finally managed to do it against the miasma golems.
unit.target: Fortunate, tempus exercitationis cum magnis locustis habuit, ita ut tandem id contra golems miasmaticos efficere posset.

unit.source: Finally, he dealt with his lone level up.
unit.target: Denique, gradum suum unicum adeptus est.

unit.source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
unit.target: [Felicitationes! Gradum adeptus es!]

unit.source: [You’re now Level 20!]
unit.target: [Nunc es Gradus XX!]

unit.source: [Gained 2 unassigned attribute points!]
unit.target: [Acquisisti 2 puncta attributa non assignata!]

unit.source: [Gained 1 END point for enduring everything that rose against you!]
unit.target: [Acquisisti 1 punctum END pro sustinendis cunctis adversitatibus!]

unit.source: [Gained 1 AGI for demonstrating speed above the average man!]
unit.target: [Acquisisti 1 AGI pro ostendendo celeritatem supra mediocris hominem!]

unit.source: Sam added the two extra points to AGI and DEX respectively, as he had enough MAG for now.
unit.target: Sam duas puncta extra ad AGI et DEX respective adiecit, cum pro praesenti satis MAG haberet.

unit.source: He now needed to bring his body up to a satisfactory level.
unit.target: Nunc debebat corpus suum ad gradum satisfaciendum adducere.

unit.source: Then, when he was finished reviewing the changes, he made sure to check over his sword as he was fighting rock golems, but thanks to running mana through it, the sword didn’t suffer any damage.
unit.target: Deinde, cum mutationes recognovisset, certus fuit gladium suum inspicere, dum contra golem lapideos pugnabat; at, per fluxum mana per gladium, illud nullum damnum passi est.

unit.source: Following that, he began the age‑old tradition of digging for loot.
unit.target: Postea, antiquam consuetudinem praediandi fodiendi incepit.

unit.source: Sadly, the only thing he found was a small marble‑sized and shaped bright white crystal in the middle of the pile of rock left behind.
unit.target: Tristiter, solum quod invenit fuit parvus crystallus candidus, marmoreae magnitudinis et figurae, in medio congeriem lapidum relictorum.

unit.source: Sam lifted the small crystal to his eyes and fully focused all of his skill upon it.
unit.target: Sam parvum crystallum ad oculos levavit et totam artem suam in eum penitus concentravit.

unit.source: But the only thing he could sense was a very dense concentration of raw, unadulterated nature mana.
unit.target: Sed solum quod percipere poterat, erat densissima concentratio mana naturae crudae et inconditae.

unit.source: The same mana he could sense in the symbols he followed to this place.
unit.target: Eadem mana, quam per symbola, quae eum ad hunc locum duxerunt, percipiebat.

unit.source: “So, this is one of the keys right?”
unit.target: «Ita, haec una clavis est, recte?»

unit.source: Lucky just huffed in agreement, and Sam nodded, then placed the marble into his inventory, took another look around the chamber, and then stepped through the only arch that didn’t lead to a room full of fallen rocks and plants that thrived in the darkness.
unit.target: Lucky leviter suspiravit in approbatione, et Sam caput annuit, deinde marmorem in inventarium suum posuit, cellam iterum circumspexit, atque per unicam arcum, quae non ad cellam lapidum cadentium et plantarum in tenebris vigentium ducebat, ingreditus est.

unit.source: Unsurprisingly, he was once again met with hundreds of maliciously glowing eyes, all staring hungrily at him.
unit.target: Non mirum, iterum centena oculorum malitiosorum fulgentium eum occurrere videntur, omnesque ad eum famelice spectabant.

unit.source: He lifted his sword up, and his other hand shone with the light of mana.
unit.target: Gladium suum sublevavit, et altera manus eius luce mana refulgebat.

unit.source: The ground shook, the monsters roared, and the mountain also began to shake, causing dirt and dust to fall on Sam’s and Lucky’s heads.
unit.target: Terra tremuit, monstra rugiverunt, et mons quoque tremere coepit, unde terra et pulvis in capita Sam et Lucky cadebant.

unit.source: Lucky answered with his own howl, and Sam only had one thing to say.
unit.target: Lucky suo ululatu respondebat, et Sam unum tantum verbum habebat.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»

unit.source: After a rather uneventful fight, where Sam practically danced through the corridor full of moss, rock and miasma monsters, he arrived in another chamber.
unit.target: Post pugnam haud memorabilem, in qua Sam quasi saltavit per corridorum plenum monstris ex musco, saxo, et miasmate compositis, ad aliam conclavam pervenit.

unit.source: The arch opened in the middle of the room, on one of the elongated sides.
unit.target: Arcus in medio conclavis aperiebatur, in una ex lateribus elongatis.

unit.source: And before he was besieged by another mass of monsters, this time shaped like snakes, though still made of rock, moss and black dripping miasma, Sam saw several broken slabs of stone evenly spaced out in the middle of the room, surrounded by smaller slabs of stone.
unit.target: Et antequam ab alia multitudine monstrorum obsidione premeretur, hoc tempore ut angues formati—tamen ex saxo, musco et nigra miasmata stillantia facti—Sam vidit complura laminae lapideae fractae in media conclavi aequo intervallo distributae, circumdatae lamellis lapideis minoribus.

unit.source: He had a moment for a fleeting thought: “Eating Hall!” Then the monsters were on him.
unit.target: Brevi cogitatione permotus est: “Cena Aula!” Deinde monstra eum aggressi sunt.

unit.source: Though thankfully, this time there was no giant golem.
unit.target: Tamen, gratiose, hoc tempore nullus ingens golem aderat.

unit.source: Shadow Burst was still on cooldown from his entrance into the chamber, he had to do a little fancy footwork.
unit.target: Shadow Burst adhuc in refectio erat ex introitus in conclave, itaque parvum, elegantem motum pedum efficere debuit.

unit.source: Thankfully, he had the skills for it.
unit.target: Bene, peritiam ad hoc faciendum possidebat.

unit.source: With a giant sidestep, he moved aside from the archway, neatly dodging the deluge of giant rock snakes that went through the same place that he was a moment before.
unit.target: Magno latere passu, a arcui recedens, ordine vitavit inundationem anguium lapideorum ingentium, qui per locum eodem, ubi paulisper ante versatus erat, transibant.

unit.source: Continuing the movement, he spun around with mana flowing through his sword, cleaving through another group of monsters.
unit.target: Motum continuans, circum se vertit, dum mana per gladium eius fluebat, aliam multitudinem monstrorum secans.

unit.source: With his other hand, Sam unleashed a wave of mana that flung the monsters that were planning to charge at him from his “unprotected” side.
unit.target: Ex altera manu, Sam undam mana dimisit, quae monstros ab latere suo “non protegto” ad eum impetum paratos proiecerunt.

unit.source: “So they can plan…” he realized while never stopping his sword dance.
unit.target: ("Ita consilium capere possint…") animadvertit, dum saltum gladii sui numquam intermittebat.

unit.source: Sam gave his thanks to all his skills that decreased stamina consumption, otherwise he would have been long dead by now.
unit.target: Sam gratiam egit omnibus suis artibus, quae consumptionem vigoris minuere solebantur, nam alioquin iam multo temporis mortuus fuisset.

unit.source: He hacked and slashed through the throng of monsters, flinging magic every which way, cutting down the obviously corrupted rock elementals by the dozens.
unit.target: Sam per turbam monstrorum caedebat et secabat, magiam in omnes partes proiciebat, elementales lapideos, manifeste corruptos, per decenas deiciebat.

unit.source: Then, as most of the monsters in the chamber were falling apart, there was a lull in the battle.
unit.target: Tum, cum pleraque monstrorum in conclavi dispergerentur, quietudo in pugna apparuit.

unit.source: Sam stood there for a moment panting with weapon and magic ready, and Lucky pacing behind him, growling menacingly, though Sam could see that the smoky‐looking wolf was rather proud of the mounds of monsters that he had slain.
unit.target: Sam ibi paulisper stetit, anhelans, cum arma et magia parata essent, et Lucky post eum vagans, minaciter rugiens; tamen Sam videre poterat lupum, aspectu fumo similem, montes monstrorum interfectorum superbus esse.

unit.source: Then the respite was over, and another roar shook the chamber.
unit.target: Tum quies cessavit, et alius rugitus conclave concusserat.

unit.source: This time instead of giant rock snakes, he was met with hundreds, maybe even thousands of small snakes pouring out of the archway at the other end of the room like a tidal wave made of rock, stone and miasma, peppered with the dark green of moss that was slowly chewed up by the undulating mass of monsters.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, pro ingentibus anguibus lapideis, centenae—fortasse etiam milia—parvorum anguibus occurrerunt, quae ex arcui in altera parte conclavis effluent, instar undae ex saxo, lapide, et miasmate factae, punctis viridi obscuri musci sparsae, quod ab undulante multitudine monstrorum lente masticabatur.

unit.source: Sam couldn’t help but exclaim.
unit.target: Sam non potuit non exclamare.

unit.source: “Damn! Lucky, back in the shadow!”
unit.target: Maledictum! Lucky, in umbram redi!

unit.source: Lucky followed the command instantly, jumping head‐first into his shadow.
unit.target: Lucky mandato statim secutus est, capite primo in umbram suam saliens.

unit.source: Having only a split second to react, Sam poured as much mana as he safely could into his left hand and immediately unleashed it against the mass of monsters heading to devour him.
unit.target: Habens tantum momentum ad agendum, Sam quantum mana tute fieri poterat in manum sinistram infudit, et statim illud contra multitudinem monstrorum, quae ad eum devorandum contendebant, dimisit.

unit.source: The mass was flung back instantly, but their numbers were so high that it only stopped them for a few seconds.
unit.target: Multitudo statim retrorsum proiecta est, sed numerus eorum tam magnus erat ut eos paucis tantum secundis sisteret.

unit.source: But that was enough for Sam.
unit.target: Sed id suffecit Sam.

unit.source: Because when he attacked the monsters, he didn’t let the mana dissipate.
unit.target: Nam cum monstros oppugnavit, mana dissipari non sinit.

unit.source: After all, the monsters were made of rock, and he knew how to manipulate that with mana.
unit.target: Nam monstri ex saxo facti erant, et sciebat quomodo id cum mana regere posset.

unit.source: So, using that second as the tidal wave was stopped, he had his mana seep into their bodies.
unit.target: Ita, ut illo momento qua unda maris sistita erat, mana eius in corpora eorum infudit.

unit.source: There was resistance, of course, but thanks to his Mana Disruption skill, and the fact they were small, disposable minions for the controlling intelligence behind the miasma (at least according to his current theory) he managed to wrestle control over the rock that made up their bodies almost instantly.
unit.target: Oppositio quidem exstitit, sed, propter peritiam Mana Disruption et eo quod erant parvi ministri regiminis miasmata (saltem secundum theoriam eius praesentem), celeriter imperium super saxa, quae corpora eorum constituebant, subigere potuit.

unit.source: Using his control, he made them all do one thing.
unit.target: Sua potestate utendo, eos omnes unum facere iussit.

unit.source: Explode!
unit.target: Detona!

unit.source: The moment he gave the mental order, he began moving, channeling mana into his shield, raising his own Earth Wall and crouching behind a piece of stone that may or may not have been a table once upon a time.
unit.target: Momento quo iussum mentis dedit, coepit movere, mana in scutum suum canalisans, proprium murum terrae levans, atque se sub lapide, qui olim mensa fortasse fuisse potuit, reclinavit.

unit.source: He was still peppered by not insignificant chunks of rock as the front of the tidal wave exploded, taking with it the second half in a glorious explosion that itself shook the ruin just as much as the previous roar.
unit.target: Adhuc infestatus erat non parvis fragmentis saxi, dum pars frontis undae explosa est, secunda partem in explosione gloriosa, quae ruinam aeque concusserat ac prius rugitus, proiecit.

unit.source: Granted, a few stragglers remained, but as Sam stood from his already crumbling hiding place, renewing his slightly depleted Mana Shield, once again happy that he didn’t learn the limited Mage Armor spell, he could simply stomp on those monsters that remained.
unit.target: Certe pauci remanserunt, sed cum Sam ex latibulo suo iam corrumpto surrexit, scutum Mana paullo depletum renovans, atque iterum laetus quod non didicerat limitatam incantationem “Mage Armor”, simpliciter illos monstros pedibus calcitare poterat.

unit.source: Walking around the rubble that was a few seconds ago his cover, shaking loose dust from his armor, he looked around the room and took in how almost everything was covered by a fine layer of dust and miasma, though the miasma seemed to be evaporating making it seem as if the room was covered by dark fog.
unit.target: Circumambulans ruinas, quae paulo abhinc tegmen eius fuerant, pulverem ex armis evellens, circumspiciens conclavem animadvertit quomodo fere omnia tenuo strato pulveris et miasmata operirentur, quamquam miasma evanesce videbatur, quasi conclave caliginosum velaretur.

unit.source: Sam spent another minute, ready for anything, waiting for the other shoe to drop, but nothing else came through the archway opposite of him.
unit.target: Sam aliam minutam egit, paratus ad omnia, exspectans alterum calceum cadentem, sed nihil aliud per arcum oppositum ejus advenerat.

unit.source: After doing a sweep with his mana, he finally let down his sword and let out a deep, shuddering sigh.
unit.target: Postquam mana circumcurrebat, demum gladium suum deiecit et suspirum profundum, tremulantemque, edidit.

unit.source: “Fuuuuu…gh”
unit.target: “Fuuuuu…gh”

unit.source: He took a look at his sword and immediately threw it away in disgust.
unit.target: Gladium suum intuens, statim illud fastidio abiicebat.

unit.source: The steel was chipped and there was a giant hairline crack running through the entire length of the blade.
unit.target: Ferrum gladii fractum erat et ingens fissura tenuissima per totam laminae longitudinem traiciebat.

unit.source: The only thing that probably let him use it was the mana running through it, reinforcing it.
unit.target: Unum quod eum uti sinit, fere certe, erat mana per illud fluens, quod id roborabat.

unit.source: Ignoring the clanging of the sword falling on the stone floor, he fished out another mass-manufactured steel sword.
unit.target: Neglegens clangorem gladii in saxo cadentis, alium gladium ex ferro massam fabricatum extraxit.

unit.source: He swung it around, getting a feel for its balance, then did a quick loot check.
unit.target: Ille circumiecit, sensum aequilibrii eius explorans, deinde celerem inspectionem praediorum fecit.

unit.source: Sadly, nothing dropped.
unit.target: Heu, nihil cecidit.

unit.source: Cursing the RNGods, he primed his Mana Shield and the multitude of senses and began, once again, to stride forward.
unit.target: Deos RNG maledicens, scutum Mana et multitudinem sensuum praeparavit, et iterum incedere coepit.

unit.source: Sam quickly fought through several rooms following the battle in the eating hall.
unit.target: Sam celeriter per plura conclavia pugnavit, post pugnam in “Eating Hall”.

unit.source: In the first room after it, he was beset by another tidal wave of rock snakes, this time from two sides, and spitting miasma at him.
unit.target: In primo conclavio post illud, alter unda maris anguibus lapideis, hoc tempore ex duabus partibus, eum obsederunt, miasmata in eum sputantes.

unit.source: His Mana Shield got its fair share of exercise, as while the spits were fairly linear, he couldn’t dodge every droplet.
unit.target: Scutum Mana eius suam partem exercitationis accepit, quoniam, dum miasmata quasi linearia erant, non potuit omnes guttas evadere.

unit.source: He had a feeling that miasma touching him would be a bad thing…
unit.target: Sensit miasma, quod eum attingeret, rem mala futuram esse…

unit.source: Sam mainly kited the snakes around until they were all in the room, then used the same tactic as before.
unit.target: Sam praecipue angues circum lusus est, donec omnes in conclavio congregatae erant, deinde eandem rationem adhibuit.

unit.source: Throw them back and make them explode.
unit.target: Reiice eos et detona eos.

unit.source: It was glorious…
unit.target: Gloriosum erat…

unit.source: The next room after that was absent of rock snakes.
unit.target: Proximum conclave post illud nullos angues lapideos continebat.

unit.source: Instead, the golems returned with a vengeance.
unit.target: Immo, golem redierunt cum ultione.

unit.source: And weapons.
unit.target: Et arma.

unit.source: Granted, they were barely worth being called weapons.
unit.target: Certe, vix dignae erant ut arma appellarentur.

unit.source: They were mostly crude rods masquerading as spears and shorter rods that acted like swords, a few monsters even sported clubs made of rocks.
unit.target: Praecipue erant vergae rudis, speciem telorum induentes, et vergae breviores quae quasi gladios afferebant, atque pauca monstra etiam clavas ex saxo gerebant.

unit.source: Sam had to use his Wind Blade and Mana Slash generously to keep his distance because while his speed was better than the average at his level, his own reaction speed wasn’t good enough to keep track of every monster trying to transform him into minced meat and dodge their attacks.
unit.target: Sam oportuit ut Lamine Ventorum et Mana Slash liberaliter ad distantiam servandam adhiberet, quoniam, cum celeritas eius gradus suos superaret, propria reactionis celeritas non sufficiebat ut omnes monstros, qui eum in carnem minutam convertere et impetus eorum evadere conabantur, sequi posset.

unit.source: But in the end, he stood triumphantly on top of a small mountain of golem corpses with a rapidly evaporating miasma around him.
unit.target: Sed demum triumphanter stetit super parvam montem cadaverorum golem, circum eum miasma celeriter evaporans.

unit.source: This time, being ready for the phenomena, he took a small bottle, and with the help of his mana, managed to coral a small amount of the dark material into it.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, paratus ad phaenomena, parvam lagenae caput tulit, et cum auxilio mana, parvam quantitatem materiae obscurae in eam aggregare potuit.

unit.source: The moment the miasma was in the bottle, he inserted the stopper and with his knife quickly etched a very small and crude seal on it made of runes.
unit.target: Momento quo miasma in lagena erat, obturator inseruit et cultello suo celeriter parvum atque rudimentarium sigillum ex runis incidit.

unit.source: It was basically a three‐rune seal.
unit.target: Fundamentaliter, erat sigillum trium runarum.

unit.source: One was his Heart Rune, another Rune for the mana to fuel the seal and the rune for Sealing.
unit.target: Una erat runa Cordis eius, altera erat runa mana ad sigillum alendum, et tertia runa ad sigillandum.

unit.source: It wasn’t the most sophisticated seal or rune sequence, but it would work in a pinch.
unit.target: Non erat sigillum aut series runarum maxime sophisticata, sed in necessitate prodesse poterat.

unit.source: And it would also allow him enough time to bring the sample to somebody who knows about things like that…
unit.target: Et etiam tempus ei dabit ut exemplar ad aliquem, qui talia novit, afferre possit…

unit.source: Then he headed for the next archway.
unit.target: Deinde ad proximum arcum contulit.

unit.source: The next part of his journey brought him through several smaller, interconnected rooms.
unit.target: Pars sequens itineris eius eum per plura minora et inter se conexa conclavia duxit.

unit.source: To his eyes, they looked like rooms that somebody used to live in.
unit.target: Oculis eius, videbantur sicut conclavia in quibus aliquis olim habitare solebat.

unit.source: Slabs of stone took the shape of beds, and shelves were carved into the walls, though nothing organic remained that would allow him to figure out who lived in the ruins before they became a ruin.
unit.target: Laminae lapideae formam lecti obtinebant, et cellae in parietibus incisi erant, quamquam nihil organicum reliquum erat, quod ei patefaceret quis ante ruinas habitaverit.

unit.source: His current running theory was that it was a headquarters that the rangers of the old used to protect the ironwood forest that somehow got corrupted.
unit.target: Theoria eius praesentis erat quod esset sedes, qua veteres custodes (rangers) silvae “ironwood” protegere solebant, et qua ratione corrupta fuisset, nesciebatur.

unit.source: The whys and hows were currently beyond him, though he had a few suspects…
unit.target: Causae et modi nunc extra eum erant, quamquam paucos suspectos habebat…

unit.source: The fight in the rooms was basically one giant hide‐and‐seek game.
unit.target: Pugna in conclavi fere quasi magnum ludum celandi et inveniendi erat.

unit.source: Rock monsters in the shapes of spiders, both giant and small, hid in every corner, on every ceiling, and behind every chunk of rubble big enough to hide behind.
unit.target: Monstra saxea in formis aranearum – tam ingentia quam parva – in omni angulo, in omni parte laquearum, et post omne fragmentum ruinae, quod late operiri posset, se celaverunt.

unit.source: He was constantly using his sensing skills, trying to stretch them beyond their actual use.
unit.target: Continuo artes suas sensitivas adhibebat, conans eas ultra finem usus extendere.

unit.source: Sam was pretty sure if the skill hadn’t leveled up when he was looking for the ruin, he would be in much bigger trouble with the spiders.
unit.target: Sam satis certus erat, si ars non in gradum elevata esset, dum ruinas quaereret, in magis gravibus difficultatibus cum araneis versatus fuisset.

unit.source: Now he just had to grab the smaller spiders and explode them (having a little fun with the noise they made when they exploded) while simply fighting the bigger ones with his spells.
unit.target: Nunc tantum minoribus araneis prehendendis erat et explodere eos (paulo ludens cum strepitu, quem fecerunt cum explosi essent) dum maiora incantationibus pugnabat.

unit.source: The intelligence behind the monsters didn’t seem the smartest, as all spiders used the same tactic when fighting him.
unit.target: Intelligentia quae monstris imperabat non apparet esse prudens, nam omnes araneae eandem rationem in pugna adhibebant.

unit.source: Then, after a few hours of fighting, he stood before the biggest archway he had seen in the ruins.
unit.target: Deinde, post paucas horas pugnae, stetit coram maximam arcum, quem in ruinis viderat.

unit.source: He made sure to check his equipment, change his sword to a fresh one, chug a potion, and warn Lucky.
unit.target: Curae fuit ut apparatum suum inspiceret, gladium in novum mutaret, poculum potionis biberet, et Lucky admoneret.

unit.source: Then, priming his Mana Shield, he stepped through the threshold.
unit.target: Deinde, scutum Mana praeparans, per limen intravit.

unit.source: Sam found himself in an enormous room, where even his first step into the chamber echoed.
unit.target: Sam se invenit in conclave ingenti, ubi etiam primus eius passus in conclave resonabat.

unit.source: Sadly, he didn’t have enough time to admire the local decoration practices, as the moment he set foot into the room, two roars shook him, the room and the mountain.
unit.target: Heu, non tempus habuit ut ornamenta localia admiraret, nam momento quo pedem in conclave posuit, duo rugitus eum, conclavem et montem concusserunt.

unit.source: At both ends of the giant chamber stood two very familiar golems.
unit.target: In utraque parte conclavis ingentis duo golem noti steterunt.

unit.source: Though their cores were much less exposed than the first one.
unit.target: Quamquam centra eorum longe minus patefacta erant quam primi.

unit.source: Both raised their hands, ending in sharp‑looking claws made of almost metallic‑looking rock and dripping with miasma.
unit.target: Ambae manus elevaverunt, terminantes in unguibus acutis, ex saxo paene metallino aspectu factis et miasmata stillantibus.

unit.source: “Note to self, don’t get hit with that,” he spoke out loud, gulping a little, then glanced down at his shadow.
unit.target: “Nota mihi: noli hoc te percutere,” locutus est voce, paulo guttans, deinde ad umbram suam aspiciens.

unit.source: “Lucky!” The wolf’s head immediately surfaced from the shadow, his eyes looking at him with serious attention.
unit.target: “Lucky!” Caput lupi statim ex umbra ortum est, oculis gravibus in eum spectantibus.

unit.source: “Go far, and attack when there is an opportunity.”
unit.target: “Vade longe, et oppugna cum occasio appareat.”

unit.source: The wolf let out a quiet bark and did something that surprised Sam.
unit.target: Lupus quietum latratum edidit et aliquid fecit, quod Sam miratus est.

unit.source: Instead of jumping out of Sam’s shadow, the wolf dove back into the shadow, disappearing completely.
unit.target: Proinde, cum non ex umbra Sam insiliit, lupus rursus in umbram demersit, omnino evanescens.

unit.source: Sam was about to call out to him when he spotted Lucky emerging, with a wolfish grin on the other end of the chamber from the shadow hiding one of the corners of the room.
unit.target: Sam iam ad eum clamandum parabat, cum Lucky emergentem animadvertit, cum risu lupino in altera parte conclavis, ex umbra anguli celati.

unit.source: Sadly, he didn’t have time to check his notifications, as he had to deal with two rather angry golems.
unit.target: Heu, non tempus habuit ut nuntiationes inspiceret, nam cum duobus golem iracundis agere debebat.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: “Shadow Burst!”

unit.source: Using the speed gained from the skill, he jumped behind the golem on the left, and he immediately had to crouch, as the golem swiped its claws through the air where his head should have been.
unit.target: Arte adeptus velocitate, post golem sinistrum insiluit, et statim se incurvare debuit, quoniam golem unguibus per aerem feriebat, ubi caput eius esse debebat.

unit.source: Apparently, they had been upgraded…
unit.target: Apparenter, meliorati erant…

unit.source: Sam jumped back, sending a blast of mana at the offending arm, pushing up, then sending several consecutive slashes at the area where a visibly thick layer of rock mixed with miasma protected the core.
unit.target: Sam retraxit, et impetum mana in brachium nocens misit, surgens, deinde plures ictus consecutivos in locum, ubi stratum saxi crassum, miasmate mixtum, nucleum protegebat, affecit.

unit.source: Fortunately, the slashes managed to gouge a little line into the material, so he only had to whittle the defenses down.
unit.target: Fortunate, ictus parvam lineam in materiam effoderunt, ut defensionem tantum minuere posset.

unit.source: Sadly, he couldn’t continue with his bombardment, as the golem recovered and its friend was also on the way.
unit.target: Heu, non potuit bombardationem continuare, quoniam golem se recuperavit et amicus eius etiam adveniebat.

unit.source: Sam had to dodge twice, once for each arm as they came down with a wide slashing motion, slamming into the ground and sending debris everywhere.
unit.target: Sam bis evadere debuit, unum pro singulis brachiis, eorum late ictu descendentium in terram contundentes et ruinas ubique proiecentes.

unit.source: Thankfully, his Flow skill allowed him some manner of warning.
unit.target: Gratias, ars Flow ei modum praemonitionis concessit.

unit.source: He watched as the golem raised both of its hands, then mechanically turned towards him, while the other one was thundering towards them.
unit.target: Aspiciens, vidit golem utrumque manum elevare, deinde mechanice ad eum converti, dum alter in eorum partem tonitruans accedebat.

unit.source: For a moment, he despaired a little, not knowing how to win quickly and without putting himself into undue danger, but then an idea sparked in his mind.
unit.target: Per momentum paulum desperavit, nesciens quomodo celeriter vinceret et sine supervacuo periculo se poneret, sed deinde idea in mente eius accensa est.

unit.source: Shadow Burst was on cooldown, but the golems were slow enough for his speed with only the Body Enhancement.
unit.target: Shadow Burst in refectio erat, sed golem satis tarde erant pro celeritate eius cum sola augmentatione corporis.

unit.source: So, with a plan quickly solidifying in his mind, Sam launched himself towards the nearest golem, dodging another swipe in the process.
unit.target: Ita, consilio celeriter in mente solidato, Sam se ad proximum golem contulit, et alium ictum vitans.

unit.source: The golem struck but wasn’t fast enough to hit him, and Sam managed to run past the golem, making sure to stay as close to the body as possible, striking it a few times with his sword, but his eyes were on the other golem.
unit.target: Golem percussit, sed non fuit tam celer ut eum feriret, et Sam potuit praeter golem currere, curesque ut quam proxime ad corpus maneret, aliquoties gladio feriens, sed oculi eius in altero golem erant.

unit.source: The other golem, seeing him coming closer (while the first one was in the process of turning) raised its clawed hands toward Sam and began to charge.
unit.target: Alter golem, eum propius accedentem videns (dum primus conversurus esset), manus unguibus in Sam elevavit et impetum facere coepit.

unit.source: Sam grinned, then skidded to a halt and turned halfway to make sure he saw both golems.
unit.target: Sam risum fecit, deinde subito sistens et semisvertens ut utrumque golem intueceretur.

unit.source: Then, in the next moment, a lot of things happened.
unit.target: Deinde, in proximo momento, multa acciderunt.

unit.source: The first golem finished turning and was facing him and the other golem.
unit.target: Primus golem conversionem perfecit et ad eum ac ad alterum golem conversus erat.

unit.source: The second golem reached his position with arms, claws dripping malevolent miasma, already descending.
unit.target: Secundus golem ad locum eius pervenit, brachiis, unguibus miasmata malevola stillantia, iam descendens.

unit.source: His magic lashed out under his direction, latching onto the outside of the arm of the second golem, and giving a not‑so‑gentle tug while jumping backwards and gleefully watching the spectacle.
unit.target: Magia eius, sub eius directione, prostrata est, ad externum brachii secundi golem conglutinans, et non tam mitis trahitionem faciens, dum retrorsum saliens et spectaculum laete contemplans.

unit.source: The tug on the arms of the second golem was enough to make the swipe an overextended movement, practically launching the arms of the golem directly at the second golem leaning towards his previous position.
unit.target: Tractio in brachiis secundi golem satis fuit ut ictus in motum nimis extensum verti posset, fere mittens brachia golem directe in secundum golem, qui ad priorem positionem inclinabatur.

unit.source: The two golems, claws meeting hardened rock, clashed with a tremendous noise.
unit.target: Duo golem, cum unguibus saxum duratum contingentes, ingenti strepitu collisere.

unit.source: Sam, using the distraction, sprinted behind the back of the first golem and unleashed as much mana as possible concentrated at the tip of his sword.
unit.target: Sam, distractioni utefactus, post dorsum primi golem celeriter cucurrit et quantum mana fieri poterat, ad apicem gladii concentratum, dimisit.

unit.source: Using as much strength as possible, he thrust it towards the core of the monster as the dust settled down around them from the clash.
unit.target: Quantum robur potestatem haberet, gladium in nucleum monstri iniecit, dum pulvis ex concursu circa eos consediit.

unit.source: The sword went through the damaged and slightly worn down armor, piercing the core and causing the magic holding the golem together to fall apart.
unit.target: Gladius per armaturam laesam et leviter exsaccatam transiit, nucleum perforans et magiam, quae golem coniungebat, dissolvere faciens.

unit.source: Sadly, it also resulted in him getting splashed with the miasma leaking from the joints and cracks in the rock that was the body of the golem.
unit.target: Heu, id etiam in eum effecit ut miasma, ex iunctionibus et fissuris in saxo, quod corpus golem constituebat, effluentem, eum tinctum haberet.

unit.source: The second golem stood there for a few seconds, enough time to allow Sam to clean himself with a brief burst of mana and the Clean spell, then the surrounding mana thickened and his Flow skill all but shouted at him to dodge.
unit.target: Secundus golem ibi aliquot secundis stetit, sufficiens ut Sam se purgaret cum brevi impetu mana et incantatione “Clean”, deinde mana circumstans densior facta est, et ars Flow ei modum praemonitionis concessit.

unit.source: He did so, but thanks to the excess mana, the golem was fast enough to clip him in the sides, his Mana Shield dipping but not falling and throwing him to the ground, a little dazed.
unit.target: Id fecit, sed ex nimia mana, golem celer erat ut latus eius laederet, scutum Mana eius deiectum sed non delapsum, eum in terram iactans, paulo attonitum.

unit.source: Thankfully, Lucky chose this exact moment to jump from the shadow of the golem at its back, striking it hard enough to send it staggering, granting Sam enough respite to gather himself, then dove back into the shadow with a joyful howl.
unit.target: Gratias, Lucky hoc eodem momento eligit ut ex umbra golem, quae in tergo eius erat, insiliret, eum satis dure feriens ut titubans iaceretur, Samque quietem concedens, deinde cum laeta ululatu rursus in umbram demersit.

unit.source: Still fast from the buff gained from the excess mana, the golem straightened and, with mechanical fluidity, turned around, and once again began charging at him.
unit.target: Adhuc celer, ex nimia mana auxilio recepto, golem se rectificavit et, cum mechanica fluiditate, conversus est, atque iterum ad eum impetum facere coepit.

unit.source: Sam considered his options, cursing the cooldown of the Shadow Burst, then had a stupid idea.
unit.target: Sam optiones suas consideravit, tempora refectionis Shadow Burst maledicens, deinde stultam ideam finxit.

unit.source: Focusing on his mana, he slapped his hand on the ground in front of him and exclaimed.
unit.target: Manam suam intendens, manum in terram ante se pulsavit et exclamavit.

unit.source: “Earth Wall!”
unit.target: “Murus Terrae!”

unit.source: Instantly, a very well-made and sturdy wall made of the ground rose directly under the leg of the golem.
unit.target: Statim, murus terrae valde bene confectus et firmus, directe sub crure golem ortus est.

unit.source: The golem, thanks to the speed it was going, couldn’t react in time, thus was unbalanced when it stepped on the wall Sam created, and was sent careening.
unit.target: Golem, propter celeritatem suam, non potuit tempore reagere, ita in muro quem Sam creaverat, inaequabiliter incidens, proiciebatur.

unit.source: Sam watched with satisfaction, crouching on the ground, as the golem fell sideways, trying to use its arms to stop it, but the weight of its body, especially with the added armor, was too much for the fast-moving arms.
unit.target: Sam, cum satisfactione aspiciens, in terra se curvans, vidit golem lateraliter cadere, conans brachios suos uti ad illud sistere, sed pondus corporis eius, praesertim cum armatura addita, nimis grave videbatur ad brachios celeriter movendos.

unit.source: They were practically pulverized when the giant rock body landed on them.
unit.target: Practicabiliter illi in pulverem redacti sunt, cum ingens corpus saxi in eos cecidit.

unit.source: To his senses, it was as if the mana around the golem became iridescent with rage and Sam couldn’t help but chuckle.
unit.target: Sensibus eius, quasi mana circa golem iridescens ira facta esset, et Sam non potuit non ridere.

unit.source: “If my enemy is angry, then I’m doing something good!”
unit.target: “Si inimicus meus iratus est, tunc aliquid boni facio!”

unit.source: He stood up and with a few measured steps he was standing next to the golem, and the next moment, his sword channeling once again, too much mana struck down, piercing another core.
unit.target: Surgens paucis gradu mensuratis prope golem stetit, et in proximo momento, gladium suum iterum canalisans, nimis mana percussit, alterum nucleum perforans.

unit.source: The moment the sword’s tip made contact with the core, the mana in the golem’s body fled, flowing somewhere in the distance, and the chamber fell silent.
unit.target: Momento quo apicem gladii nucleo contingit, mana in corpore golem effugit, alicubi in longinquo fluens, et conclave silentium adeptum est.

unit.source: The only thing that could be heard was Sam’s tired panting and Lucky’s excited prowling in the shadows.
unit.target: Unum tantum, quod audiri poterat, erat anhelitus fatigatus Sam et Lucky excitatus in umbris vagans.

unit.source: And among the detritus that was the two golem’s bodies, Sam could see two very familiar shining lights.
unit.target: Et inter detritus corporum duorum golem, Sam duo lucida, valde nota lumina videbat.

unit.source: After the defeat of the two golems, the entire ruin complex fell suspiciously silent.
unit.target: Post cladem duorum golemorum, totus complexus ruinarum in silentium suspicuum cecidit.

unit.source: There were no roars in the distance, nor was the ceiling shaking and raining dust down on Sam.
unit.target: Non erant rugitus in longinquo, nec tectum tremens pulverem super Sam iaciebat.

unit.source: The only thing he could hear was an almost silent noise of water dripping somewhere, the happy panting of Lucky, and his own ragged breath.
unit.target: Unum solum, quod audire poterat, fuit quasi tacitus sonus aquae alicubi stillantis, halitus laetus Lucky, et proprius anhelitus laceratus.

unit.source: With a negligent wave of his hand and a small exertion of his will, Sam retrieved the two marble‑sized items remaining from his enemies.
unit.target: Negligenter manu iactu et parvo impendio voluntatis, Sam duo obiecta marmori magnitudinem habentia ab hostibus reliqua recuperavit.

unit.source: Then he plopped unceremoniously on the ground and leaned back, resting on his hands while closing his eyes in relief.
unit.target: Deinde in terram sine caerimonia cecidit et recubuit, manibus innixus dum oculos solacio clauserat.

unit.source: He mentally went over the facts and experiences so far in the ruin.
unit.target: Animo, res atque experientias usque ad hanc ruinam meditatus est.

unit.source: “Three golems, three items,” he mused, eyes still closed and Lucky snuggling up to him.
unit.target: “Tres golemorum, tres obiecta,” meditatus est, oculis adhuc clausis atque Lucky sibi appropinquans.

unit.source: “At this level, that’s the most I can expect. Probably still have a boss to fight, but the three marbles are probably keys to something…”
unit.target: “Ad hoc gradu, id maxime exspectare possum. Fortasse adhuc habebo principem pugnandum, sed tres marmora fortasse claves ad aliquid sunt...”

unit.source: Opening his eyes, Sam took a quick stock of the situation.
unit.target: Oculos aperiens, Sam celeriter condicionem perpendit.

unit.source: With the help of his Earth Wall spell he quickly raised a minimal cover in the corner of the room for setting up his tent.
unit.target: Per auxilium incantationis “Murus Terrae,” celeriter parvum tegmen in angulo cubiculi ad tabernaculum instituendum erexit.

unit.source: When finished with all that, he logged out for a brief rest, meal, and bathroom break.
unit.target: Post omnia finita, ex systemate discessit ad breve quietem, cibum, et latrinam intermissam.

unit.source: Returning to the game, Sam sat down in front of his tent with Lucky, retrieved his rations and also set up Lucky’s food.
unit.target: Ad ludum rediens, Sam ante tabernaculum cum Lucky consedit, suas mensas cibarias recuperavit et etiam cibum Lucky praeparavit.

unit.source: He watched for a moment, smiling gently, as Lucky enthusiastically began to scarf down his treat.
unit.target: Aliquantulum observavit, leniter subridentes, dum Lucky alacriter deliciis suis vorare inciperet.

unit.source: Then Sam also began to gnaw on his rations, ignoring their taste, while opening his status screen.
unit.target: Tum Sam quoque cibos suos mordere coepit, eos gustum neglegens, dum tabulam status suam aperiebat.

unit.source: Thankfully, his notifications were still set to adaptive, so nothing bothered him during his fight in the ruins, but it was time for his brain to feel the good stuff watching all the numbers go up.
unit.target: Gratias deo, notitiae eius adhuc ad rationem accommodatae erant, itaque nihil eum occupabat in pugna inter ruinas, sed tempus erat ut mens eius laeta bona sentiret dum omnes numeri augerentur.

unit.source: He first navigated to Lucky’s screen, wanting to see what the new skill his wolf companion used was.
unit.target: Primum scrinium Lucky versa est, cupiens videre qua esset nova peritia quam comes lupus eius adhibebat.

unit.source: [Thanks to taking care and fighting in sync with your companion, your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 15!]
unit.target: [Gratias curae et synchroniae certandi cum socio tuo, peritia tua “Vinculum Spirituum” ad Gradum 15 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Your companion, Lucky, has reached Level 15!]
unit.target: [Socius tuus, Lucky, ad Gradum 15 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Lucky has gained a new skill, Shadow Jump!]
unit.target: [Lucky novam peritiam adeptus est, “Saltus Umbrarum!”]

unit.source: [Shadow Jump: Level 0/20 (0%) (Active) The wolf gains the ability to dive into your shadow and emerge from a different shadow. Range: 100 meters. Cooldown: 120 seconds.]
unit.target: [Saltus Umbrarum: Gradus 0/20 (0%) (Activa) Lupus facultatem accipit ut in umbram tuam mergatur et ex alio umbra emerga. Spatium: 100 metra. Tempus recuperationis: 120 secundae.]

unit.source: He reread the skill a few times, but couldn’t help but be impressed.
unit.target: Peritiam iterum aliquoties lectus est, sed non potuit non esse admiratus.

unit.source: The skill was something he could see being useful and powerful.
unit.target: Peritia videbatur utilis atque valida.

unit.source: More importantly, it was a skill that could be improved with time.
unit.target: Maxime quidem, peritia erat quam tempore emendari possit.

unit.source: Most pets and companions belonged to people who weren't using minion or pet‐specific skills.
unit.target: Plurima animalia domestica et comites ad eos pertinebant qui peritias proprias “minion” aut “pet” speciales non adhibebant.

unit.source: Thus, those pets gained skills that couldn't be leveled up.
unit.target: Ita, illis animalibus artes adeptae sunt quarum gradus augeri non poterant.

unit.source: Getting a skill that could advance was incredibly lucky…
unit.target: Acquirere peritiam quae progredi posset, incredibiliter felix erat…

unit.source: After celebrating the skill with a little playtime, he returned his attention to his own status screen.
unit.target: Postquam peritiam cum parvo ludo celebravit, animum suum ad proprium tabulam status redemit.

unit.source: While one of his hands absentmindedly was going through Lucky’s silken fur, to the obvious pleasure of the wolf.
unit.target: Dum una ex manibus eius inconsulte per pilum sericum Lucky percurrit, ad lupum manifeste delectans.

unit.source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
unit.target: [Gratulor! Gradum attigisti!]

unit.source: [You’re now Level 22!]
unit.target: [Nunc Gradus tuus est 22!]

unit.source: [Gained 4 unassigned attribute points!]
unit.target: [Quattuor puncta attributa, nondum distributa, adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Gained 1 MAG point of extensive and creative use of your mana!]
unit.target: [Unum punctum MAG, usus amplo et creativo mana tuae, adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Gained +1 AGI for the impressive display of speed!]
unit.target: [Acquisitum est +1 AGI propter rapiditatis ostentationem praeclaram!]

unit.source: He was a little disappointed at not getting an extra stat point after his fight, but it was pretty obvious to him that even if he hadn't used tricks to defeat the monster, he would have been able to win.
unit.target: Paululum contristatus erat quod extra punctum statum post pugnam non adeptus esset, sed sibi patebat quod, etiam si dolis ad monstrum vincendum non usus fuisset, victor esse potuisset.

unit.source: Grumbling a little, he added the remaining points to STR, DEX, VIT and PER.
unit.target: Paulatim murmure, reliqua puncta ad STR, DEX, VIT et PER adiicivit.

unit.source: Frowning at the disparity between his health and mana, Sam made up his mind that after he was finished with the quest here, he would take some time and shore up his weakness.
unit.target: Cernens inaequalitatem inter salutem et manam suam, Sam constituit post hanc inquisitionem tempus capere atque infirmitatem suam corroborare.

unit.source: There were some basic skills that he would be able to get with little to no trouble.
unit.target: Erant quaedam peritiae fundamentalia quas parvo labore assequi posset.

unit.source: Next, he started reviewing the level‑ups of his skills.
unit.target: Deinde, incrementa peritiarum suarum recensere incipiebat.

unit.source: [Advanced Mana Control is now Level 17!]
unit.target: [Moderatio Manae Provecta nunc Gradus 17 est!]

unit.source: [Stable Mana Control is now Level 7!]
unit.target: [Moderatio Manae Stabilis nunc Gradus 7 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Shield reached Level 30!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae ad Gradum 30 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Controlled Mana Shield reached Level 8!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Moderatum ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Sustained Mana Shield reached level 6!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Thanks to sustaining your Mana Shield through several attacks that covered your entire body, you gain the sub‑skill Layered Mana Shield!]
unit.target: [Gratias quod per plures impetus totum corpus teum tegendum scutum Manae sustinuisse, subperitiam “Scutum Manae Stratum” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Layered Mana Shield: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Allows you to layer your Mana Shield. For every level in the skill, you can create one extra layer over your original Mana Shield. Each layer costs 10% more to create and maintain. The current number of extra layers that can be created: 1. Upon reaching the maximum number of layers (7) there is a possibility to upgrade this sub‑skill into a full skill.]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Stratum: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Permittit tibi scutum Manae in strata disponere. Pro unoquoque gradu in peritia, unum stratum additum supra scutum originale creare potes. Quisque stratum creationem et sustentationem decem centesimas plus onerat. Numerus currentis stratorum additorum qui creari possunt: 1. Cum ad maximum numerum stratorum (7) pervenitur, subperitia in plenam peritiam converteri potest!]

unit.source: Sam stared at his newest sub‑skill and let out a full belly laugh.
unit.target: Sam subperitiam novissimam aspexit et plenam risum ventricosum edidit.

unit.source: One of the most coveted skills by those who had the chance to learn Mana Shield.
unit.target: Una ex peritiis maxime expetendis a iis qui occasionem didicerunt Scutum Manae fuit.

unit.source: Mana Armor, at its base level, was a skill that you could layer.
unit.target: Armatura Manae, in gradu suo basali, erat peritia quae in strata disponi poterat.

unit.source: Though, arguably, a novice mage wouldn’t be able to sustain it.
unit.target: Attamen, dici potest, ne novitius magus eam sustinere posset.

unit.source: Also, another negative aspect of that skill was that it only allowed layering up to three layers and the cost of that doubled every layer.
unit.target: Praeterea, alius aspectus malus eius peritiae erat quod solum usque ad tres strata disponere licebat, et onus cuiusque strati duplicabatur.

unit.source: Compared that to an increase of 10% was rather generous…
unit.target: Hoc comparatum ad incrementum decem centesimarum valde liberaliter videbatur…

unit.source: [Light Ball is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Orbis Lucis nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Clean is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Puritas nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Earth Wall is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Murus Terrae nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Blade is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Lamina Venti nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to making proper use of the spell, you learned Light Ball II!]
unit.target: [Gratias recto usu incantationis, didicisti Orbis Lucis II!]

unit.source: [Thanks to making proper use of the spell, you learned Clean II!]
unit.target: [Gratias recto usu incantationis, didicisti Puritas II!]

unit.source: [Thanks to making creative use of the spell, you learned Earth Wall II!]
unit.target: [Gratias usui creativo incantationis, didicisti Murus Terrae II!]

unit.source: [Thanks to making creative use of the spell, you learned Wind Blade II!]
unit.target: [Gratias usui creativo incantationis, didicisti Lamina Venti II!]

unit.source: [Thanks to using Wind Blade with your Mana Slash and Double Mana Slash, you created the spell Wind Flurry!]
unit.target: [Gratias usu Lamina Venti cum Incisione Manae et Incisione Manae Duplex, creavisti incantationem “Fluctus Venti!”]

unit.source: [Light Ball II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to conjure a ball of light to illuminate your surroundings. You have control over the movement and location of the conjured ball of light. You can increase and decrease its intensity, shape, and color.]
unit.target: [Orbis Lucis II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te globum lucis evocare ad circumiecta tua illuminanda. Imperium habes de motu et loco globi lucis evocati. Eius intensitatem, figuram atque colorem augere atque minuere potes.]

unit.source: [Clean II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to clean a selected surface. You can not only clean physical contaminations but also magical ones. Depends on the strength of the magical contamination. Above a certain level, Clean II only weakens it.]
unit.target: [Puritas II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te superficiem electam purgare. Non solum contaminationes physicas purgare potes, sed etiam quasdam magicas. Vim contaminationis magicae pendet; supra certum gradum, Puritas II eam tantum debilitare potest.]

unit.source: [Earth Wall II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to create a wall made of earth and stone. You have control over the strength, shape, and measurements of the wall. Allows you to strengthen the created wall with extra mana.]
unit.target: [Murus Terrae II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te murum ex terra et lapide creare. Imperium habes de robore, figura et mensuris muri. Permittit murum creatum addito mana corroborare.]

unit.source: [Wind Blade II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to launch a blade of wind. The cutting power and speed of the blade are increased. You have increased control over its movement after creation.]
unit.target: [Lamina Venti II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te lamina venti iniri. Potentia secandi et celeritas laminae augentur; post creationem, melius imperium habes de eius motu.]

unit.source: [Wind Flurry: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a flurry of wind blades aimed in one direction. The damage of the released Wind Blades depends on the Wind Blade spell and your mastery over it.]
unit.target: [Fluctus Venti: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te seriem laminarum venti in unam partem dimittere. Damnum laminis venti dimissis pendet ex incantatione “Lamina Venti” atque tua peritia in ea.]

unit.source: Sam nodded as he read the notification about the spells.
unit.target: Sam annuit dum nuntiationem de incantationibus legerat.

unit.source: They were very basic spells.
unit.target: Erant incantationes valde fundamentales.

unit.source: So it was not a surprise that with his Mana Control and usage, they would level up fast.
unit.target: Ita non mirum erat quod, cum Moderatione Manae et usu eius, celeriter ascenderent.

unit.source: Most spells went up to V before it became impossible to upgrade them.
unit.target: Plurima incantationes ad Gradum V ascendebant antequam eas emendare fieri impossibile factum esset.

unit.source: You could increase that limit by specializing.
unit.target: Hunc terminum potes auget per studium speciale.

unit.source: For example, in air and wind magic, thus allowing your Wind Blade to reach even X.
unit.target: Exempli causa, in magia aeris et venti, ita ut lamina venti tua etiam ad Gradum X perveniret.

unit.source: But for Sam, this was more than enough.
unit.target: Sed pro Sam, hoc supra sufficienter erat.

unit.source: For fun, he conjured a light ball in front of him and spoke a word.
unit.target: Ad ludicrum, globum lucis ante se evocavit et unum verbum locutus est.

unit.source: “Red.”
unit.target: “Rubrum.”

unit.source: The ball turned red.
unit.target: Globus ruber factus est.

unit.source: He smiled, then spent a few minutes playing around with the spell.
unit.target: Subridens, paucos minutas incantatione ludens degit.

unit.source: Earning himself a level in it and recording a video of Lucky chasing after the constantly color‑changing ball of light.
unit.target: Sibi gradum in ea adeptus, et video recordans Lucky, qui globum lucis, colore constanter mutantem, insequebatur.

unit.source: [Mage Sight is now Level 9!]
unit.target: [Visus Magi nunc Gradus 9 est!]

unit.source: [Efficient Mana Slash is now Level 3!]
unit.target: [Incisio Manae Efficax nunc Gradus 3 est!]

unit.source: [Double Mana Slash is now Level 2!]
unit.target: [Incisio Manae Duplex nunc Gradus 2 est!]

unit.source: [Congratulations, you successfully broke through with the skill, Mana Strike!]
unit.target: [Gratulor, peritiam “Mana Strike” feliciter superavisti!]

unit.source: [You gained the sub‑skill, Phasing Strike!]
unit.target: [Subperitiam “Phasing Strike” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [You learned the skill Extended Mana Strike!]
unit.target: [Peritiam “Extended Mana Strike” didicisti!]

unit.source: [Phasing Strike: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Those strikes that you enhance with Mana Strike gain the ability to ignore 2% of armor per skill level.]
unit.target: [Phasing Strike: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Ipsi ictus quos “Mana Strike” amplificas, facultatem habent ut 2% armorum pro quolibet gradu peritiae praetermittant.]

unit.source: [Extended Mana Strike: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) The mana you use to enhance your strikes allows you to extend your reach, be it with your own limbs or weapon. +10% range on your strikes per skill level.]
unit.target: [Extended Mana Strike: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Mana, quam ad ictus augendos utaris, sinit ut tuam extensionem— sive membris tuis sive telum— auferas. +10% spatium ictuum tuorum pro quolibet gradu peritiae.]

unit.source: Sam stared a moment at Phasing Strike.
unit.target: Sam paulisper “Phasing Strike” aspexit.

unit.source: “Ten percent True Damage!” he exclaimed in wonder.
unit.target: “Decem centesimas verae laesionis!” exclamavit miratus.

unit.source: Granted, there were defenses against True Damage, but against the common rabble, that skill was basically a death sentence.
unit.target: Ita vero, defensionēs contra laesionem veram exstabant, sed contra vulgum plebem, illa peritia vere mors iudicabatur.

unit.source: [Mana Disruption is now Level 3!]
unit.target: [Perturbatio Manae nunc Gradus 3 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Body Enhancement reached Level 21!]
unit.target: [Amplificatio Corporis Manae ad Gradum 21 pervenit!]

unit.source: [Thanks to the continuous usage of Mana Body Enhancement, you gained the sub‑skill Mana Influenced Body!]
unit.target: [Gratias continuae usus Amplificationis Corporis Manae, subperitiam “Corpus Manae Influentis” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Mana Influenced Body: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) The mana running through your body enhances your physical attributes passively. +1% to STR, DEX, AGI, END per skill level.]
unit.target: [Corpus Manae Influentis: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passiva) Mana per corpus tuum fluens, virtutes physicas tuas passim auget. +1% ad STR, DEX, AGI, END pro quolibet gradu peritiae.]

unit.source: A nice but limited skill, still Sam was happy.
unit.target: Peritia pulchra sed limitata, tamen Sam laetus erat.

unit.source: The skills he gained during the fight were well worth the exertion.
unit.target: Peritiae quas in pugna adeptus erat, labore suo valde dignae erant.

unit.source: [Discernment is now Level 5!]
unit.target: [Perspicitas nunc Gradus 5 est!]

unit.source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery is now Level 11!]
unit.target: [Peritia Gladii Intermedia nunc Gradus 11 est!]

unit.source: [Stable Stance is now Level 5!]
unit.target: [Stabilis Habitus nunc Gradus 5 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to handling the sword against a multitude of opponents successfully, you gained the sub‑skill Freeform Defense!]
unit.target: [Gratias gladium contra multitudinem adversariorum feliciter tractandi, subperitiam “Defensio Liberae Forma” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Freeform Defense: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) When defending with your sword or parrying, you increase your accuracy and decrease the chance for a blowback.]
unit.target: [Defensio Liberae Forma: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Cum gladio tuo defendis aut paries facis, accuratiam auges et casum repulsionis minues.]

unit.source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique is now Level 3!]
unit.target: [Technica Respirandi Intermedia nunc Gradus 3 est!]

unit.source: [Calm Heart is now Level 17!]
unit.target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc Gradus 17 est!]

unit.source: [Flow is now Level 7!]
unit.target: [Fluxus nunc Gradus 7 est!]

unit.source: [Multitasking is now Level 44!]
unit.target: [Multiplex Opera nunc Gradus 44 est!]

unit.source: [Efficiency is now Level 6!]
unit.target: [Efficientia nunc Gradus 6 est!]

unit.source: Then came the skills from the Shadow skill tree.
unit.target: Deinde peritiae ex arbore peritiarum Umbrarum apparuerunt.

unit.source: If Sam was honest, he was the most excited about these.
unit.target: Sam, sincero animo, de his maxime excitatus erat.

unit.source: After all, they were the basis of his future build.
unit.target: Nimirum, fundamentum futuri eius conformationis erant.
