unit.source: The Shadows were perfect for covert operations while also holding several high‑damage skills that were capable of devastating entire groups if used correctly.
unit.target: Umbrae aptissimae erant ad operationes occultas, atque praeterea continentes plurimas peritias laesionis magnarum, quae totos coetus, si rite adhibitae, dirimere poterant.

unit.source: Not to mention several lesser‑known aspects of the magic…
unit.target: Nisi etiam nonnulla aspecta magica, minus nota, mentione habenda sunt…

unit.source: Sam had big plans for those aspects.
unit.target: Sam magnos consilia pro his aspectibus habebat.

unit.source: [Shadow Cloak is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Pallium Umbrarum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Shadow Footwork is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Agilitas Pedum Umbrarum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to you integrating the skill almost perfectly into your arsenal, you gained the sub‑skill, Shadow Cover!]
unit.target: [Gratias quod peritiam fere perfecte in armamentarium tuum integravisti, subperitiam “Umbram Tegentem” adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Shadow Cover: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) When covered by shadow or darkness, be it natural or artificial, the effectiveness of the skill is increased by 10% for every level.]
unit.target: [Umbram Tegentem: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Cum te umbra aut tenebris— sive naturalibus sive artificialibus— tegende, efficacia peritiae pro quolibet gradu decem centesimas augetur.]

unit.source: [Shadow Burst has reached Level 3!]
unit.target: [Explosio Umbrarum ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

unit.source: Sam spent a few minutes going over his new and old skills, making sure to compare them to his inherited memories and to make sure that his plan going forward was still viable.
unit.target: Sam paucis minutis novas et veteres peritias recensuit, attendens eas ad memorias hereditarias comparare et cur eius consilium futurum adhuc valeat.

unit.source: Satisfied with his gains, he stood up and began going over his equipment.
unit.target: Sua lucri contentus, surrexit et apparatum suum percontari coepit.

unit.source: He exchanged the sword for another one, as he was pretty sure that after overloading it with mana it was on its last legs.
unit.target: Gladium pro alio commutavit, cum satis certus esset postquam eum mana oneratum, ad extremas vires redire.

unit.source: “Can’t wait for the time when I can buy swords made from mana metals!”
unit.target: “Non possum expectare tempus quo gladios ex metallis mana confectos emere possim!”

unit.source: After making sure that his equipment was in order and that Lucky got a sufficient amount of pats on his head, he spoke up.
unit.target: Postquam certus fuit apparatum suum ordinatum esse et Lucky satis de capite pulsatus habere, locutus est.

unit.source: “Lucky, back into the shadow. We are going forward!”
unit.target: “Lucky, rede ad umbram. Progredimur!”

unit.source: He was answered by an excited bark, and Lucky jumped into the air and dived directly into his shadow.
unit.target: Responsum ei datum est latratu excitato, et Lucky in aethera saliit atque directe in suam umbram conclusus est.

unit.source: The corridor after leaving the chamber with the two golems was suspiciously empty.
unit.target: Corridor, postquam cellam cum duobus golemis reliquit, insidiose vacuus erat.

unit.source: He wasn’t besieged by golems dripping miasma, or roaring at him.
unit.target: Non circumdatus erat golemis miasma stillantibus aut ad eum rugientes.

unit.source: The only thing he could hear as he tried to ghost through the corridor was the dripping of water and his own breath.
unit.target: Unum solum, quod audire poterat dum per corridor transeundus esset, erat stillatio aquae et proprius spiritus.

unit.source: To chase away the darkness he summoned his new Light Ball spell, changing the color to red to protect his eyes.
unit.target: Ut tenebras fugeret, novam incantationem “Orbis Lucis” evocavit, colorem ad rubrum mutans ut oculos defenderet.

unit.source: Finally, after a few minutes of overly cautious walking, he could see the light at the end of the tunnel.
unit.target: Denique, post paucas minutis ambulandi nimis cauti, lucem in fine cuniculi videre potuit.

unit.source: The red light of the spell slowly gave away at the light that was appearing in the distance.
unit.target: Ruber lumen incantationis lente cederet luce, quae in longinquo appareret.

unit.source: He hastened his walking a little, but his sword was still raised in a defensive position, ready for any sneak attack, giving the ceiling a glance every few feet.
unit.target: Celerius ambulare conatus est, sed gladium suum in positione defensionis attulit, paratum ad incursiones furtivas, et inter singulos pedum intervalla tectum intuens.

unit.source: As he reached the origin of the light, Sam dismissed his own Light Ball and stepped into the illuminated chamber.
unit.target: Cum ad originem luminis pervenisset, Sam suum “Orbem Lucis” dimisit et in cellam illuminatam ingressus est.

unit.source: It was a small room, containing nothing more than a giant stone door with three small holes in the relief and several stone torches lit up by ethereal white flames.
unit.target: Parva cella erat, nihil amplius continens quam ianuam lapideam ingentem cum tribus foraminibus parvis in bas-relievo et compluras lucernas lapideas, a flammis aetheriis albis accensas.

unit.source: The artwork on the door was a giant tree whose roots surrounded a giant ball and based on the symbols, the ball was radiating light.
unit.target: Opus in ianua depictum erat: ingens arbor, cuius radices globum ingentem circumdonabant, et secundum symbola, globus lucem emanabat.

unit.source: At least, that is how it looked to Sam.
unit.target: Saltem, ita Sam videbatur.

unit.source: The three small holes were on the trunk of the tree carved into the door, lined up vertically.
unit.target: Tres parva foramina erant in truncu arboris in ianua sculpti, verticaliter disposita.

unit.source: Sam didn’t need much prompting.
unit.target: Sam parum exhortationis egit.

unit.source: He retrieved the small shining marbles from his inventory and, one by one, inserted them into the holes in the door and took a big step backward.
unit.target: Parvos lucentes marmoribus ex inventario suo extraxit et, uno post alium, in foramina ianuae inseruit atque magnum gradum retrorsum fecit.

unit.source: He saw too many adventure films to fall into one of these…
unit.target: Vidit nimis pelliculas adventurales ut in talem casum incidere evitarent.

unit.source: The moment the last marble was inserted, it started shining much stronger, the stone torches also flaring and originating from the three marbles, a vertical line of light bisected the door.
unit.target: Mox, cum ultimum marmor inserta est, incipiebat multo fortius fulgere; et faces lapideae ex tribus marmoreis oriundae, linea lucis verticalis ianuam secabant.

unit.source: Though nothing else happened.
unit.target: Attamen, nihil aliud evenit.

unit.source: Sighing a little, Sam stepped forward and gave the doors a push.
unit.target: Paululum suspirans, Sam in antecessum processit et ianuas impulsit.

unit.source: With intense groaning and making noises that would wake the dead, the stone door swung inward, shaking the room a little and showering Sam once again with dust.
unit.target: Cum intensis gemitu et sonis qui mortuos excitare posnerent, ianuam lapideam intus oscillare coepit, cellam paulo concussit et Sam iterum cum pulvere infudit.

unit.source: Shaking off the majority of the dust, sword raised high, defensive skills engaged, and his other hand shining with restrained magic that was ready to be released at the first sign of trouble, Sam stepped into the room.
unit.target: Plerumque pulveris avulsis, gladio alto sublato, peritia defensionis activata, et altera manu magia moderata fulgente, parata ad primo discrimine emittendum, Sam in cellam ingressus est.

unit.source: Thankfully, this chamber was also illuminated by the same stone torches.
unit.target: Gratias, haec cella quoque eadem facularum lapidearum luce illustrata erat.

unit.source: Though this time the flames were tainted by flecks and streaks of darkness.
unit.target: Sed hoc tempore flammas maculae et striae tenebrarum deturpebant.

unit.source: Inside the room was the same thing depicted on the door.
unit.target: Intra cellam idem erat quod in ianua depictum fuit.

unit.source: Just, the entire thing was wrong…
unit.target: Verumtamen, totum recte non conveniebat…

unit.source: The ceiling high up was covered by darkness which was occasionally illuminated by the flickering torches.
unit.target: Tectum alte superiectum tenebris erat, quae interdum micantibus facularum luce illuminabatur.

unit.source: In front of him was a giant ironwood tree carved from stone, the roots an intricate artwork.
unit.target: Ante eum stabat ingens arbor ex ferro ligno sculpta in lapide, cuius radices intricato opere expressae erant.

unit.source: As the artwork on the door depicted it, the roots were enveloping a giant ball of light.
unit.target: Sicut opus in ianua depictum erat, radices globum ingentem lucis complectebantur.

unit.source: The difference between the artwork and reality was that there was the familiar miasma dropping down, like water droplets, from the ceiling.
unit.target: Differentia inter opus et rem constat in eo quod miasma notum, sicut guttas aquae, ex tectu stillabat.

unit.source: They ran down on the bark of the carved tree, finishing their journey by falling on the ball of light, tainting it.
unit.target: In cortice arboris sculptae defluebant, iter absoluentes cadentes in globum lucis atque eum maculantes.

unit.source: Under the ball of light that was almost halfway converted into miasma was a pool of the same miasma, churning and bubbling.
unit.target: Sub globo lucis, qui paene ad dimidium miasma conversus erat, erant piscinae eodem miasma, bullientes et ferventes.

unit.source: As Sam examined it with his Mana Sight, he couldn't help but describe the entire situation as evil.
unit.target: Dum Sam eam per Visum Magi perspexit, non potuit non totam rem mala describere.

unit.source: He barely had the time to take all of this in, as the moment he stepped through the archway a curtain of white flames tainted by black light sprung up behind, locking him into the chamber and the bubbling pool of miasma gave a shuddering breath by way of a giant bubble and began to rise.
unit.target: Vix tempus habuit totum hoc percipere; simul ac per arcum ingrediebatur, velum flammarum albarum nigro lumine tinctum subit, eum in cellam claudens; et piscina miasmatum bulliens, per ingentem bullam tremulum spiritum emittens, sursum crescere coepit.

unit.source: And rise.
unit.target: Et ascendit.

unit.source: And rise up high.
unit.target: Et alte ascendit.

unit.source: In a few seconds, what stood in front of Sam was a giant golem made from the miasma from the now empty pool with a few rocks and stones in its body.
unit.target: In paucis secundis, quod ante Sam stabat, erat ingens golem ex miasma piscinae iam vacua factus, cum paucis saxis et lapidibus in corpore suo.

unit.source: Sam scowled a little because a sludge‑type golem required different skills to defeat than a golem made from solid materials.
unit.target: Sam paulum ore contristatus erat, quia golem generis luti alias peritias ad vincendum requirabat quam golem ex materiis solidis factus.

unit.source: It didn’t even have the courtesy of having a giant glowing orb that Sam could target easily.
unit.target: Neque tamen habebat comitatem ingentis orbis lucentis, quem Sam facile intendere posset.

unit.source: But Sam was a gamer, and he had fought sludge‑type golems thousands, maybe even a million times in different games.
unit.target: Sed Sam lusor erat, et contra golemata luti numerosis, fortasse etiam milionibus vicibus in variis ludis pugnaverat.

unit.source: So, while the controlling intelligence behind the miasma had caused him some trouble, it was not the end of the road.
unit.target: Ita, quamvis intelligentia imperans miasma eum aliqua incommoda attulerit, finis viae non erat.

unit.source: Granted, this entire thing would have been easier with a team of people, but he had come so far alone, he might as well finish it.
unit.target: Certo, totum hoc facilius fuisset cum turma hominum, sed solus tam longe progressus erat ut id perficeret.

unit.source: He didn’t have much time as the monster roared and with it came a giant stream of miasma aimed directly at Sam.
unit.target: Paucum temporis habebat, cum monstrum rugivit et eo una ingens fluxus miasma, directe in Sam destinatus, progressus est.

unit.source: Sam, ready for the attack, raised his left hand and unleashed his own mana opposite of the stream of rapidly approaching miasma.
unit.target: Sam, ad impetum paratus, manum sinistram attoluit et mana sua adversus flumen miasma celeriter appropinquantis effudit.

unit.source: The two streams met in the middle of the chamber, oozing darkness clashing with the pale blue of Sam’s mana.
unit.target: Duae undae in medio cellae convenerunt, tenebra fluentes cum caeruleo pallido mana Sam confractantes.

unit.source: Thankfully, this gave Sam enough time to review the situation.
unit.target: Gratias, hoc Sam satis temporis dedit ut condicionem percontaret.

unit.source: “I don’t have any fire spell strong enough to burn it away and I doubt I could cut it up into enough pieces before I run out of mana.”
unit.target: “Nullam incantationem ignis satis validam habeo ut id comburerim neque fereor an id in satis frusta secare possim antequam mana deficiat.”

unit.source: Looking down at his feet at the smooth rock, he had an idea.
unit.target: Pedibus in saxo laeve intuentibus, ideam accepit.

unit.source: “But I have runes…”
unit.target: “Sed habeo runas…”

unit.source: Pointing his sword down at the front of his feet, he began to move it slowly using mana to extend the cutting edge while carefully maintaining the stream of mana holding back the miasma.
unit.target: Gladium suum ad pedum anteriora vertens, incipiebat lente movere, mana utens ad acuminis secandi extensionem faciendam, dum cura flumen mana miasma cohibens retinebat.

unit.source: Though he made sure to play with the monster a little, pretending that his control slipped and letting the stream of miasma get closer to him.
unit.target: Etsi certus fuit paulum cum monstro ludere, simulans imperium suum lapsum esse et flumen miasma propius accedere concessit.

unit.source: The point was to make sure that the monster thought that they had him on the ropes while he carved his Heart Rune into the smooth stone floor.
unit.target: Intentio erat ut monstrum existimaret se “in funiculo” esse, dum cor runam in laevo lapideo pavimento sculpere contendebat.

unit.source: While he had no skills that could kill the damn monster, he knew the runes for purification and containment.
unit.target: Dum nullas peritias habebat quae damnatum monstrum interficere possent, runas ad purificationem et continentiam noverat.

unit.source: Building a basic rune circle would be rather easy based on the controlling intelligence, as it seemed to only change things after a fight, so it used the sludge‑type to counter the skills that Sam had shown off so far.
unit.target: Circulum runarum fundamentalem condere facillimum esset, secundum intelligentiam imperantem, cum videbatur res solum post pugnam mutare; ideo genus luti ad peritias quas Sam usque ostenderat oppositum habebat.

unit.source: Rookie mistake, but one that Sam would capitalize on.
unit.target: Error puerilis, sed quem Sam ad lucrum exquirere potuit.

unit.source: Finishing the rune, he threw a glance at the golem that was still roaring at him; the miasma leaving his mouth in a stream, like vomit in a frat house during a home game.
unit.target: Runa conficiens, oculum in golem, qui adhuc ad eum rugiebat, iacuit; miasma ex ore eius fluens, quasi vomitus in domo sodalium ludi domestici, effluens.

unit.source: With a quick countdown, he cut off his own mana stream and instantly dodged to the right, letting the miasma splash with a hissing noise against the flame‑curtain, locking him into the chamber.
unit.target: Celeriter numerans, flumen mana suum evellit et statim ad dextrum subsiluit, sinens miasma cum sibilo adversus velum flammarum dispersi, eum in cellam claudens.

unit.source: Taking a few steps, he peppered the monster with a flurry of Wind Blades.
unit.target: Paucis gradibus processit, et monstrum seriem laminarum venti iaculari confregit.

unit.source: Using his newest skill the only thing it did was cut into the miasma which parted like jello and instantly fused back together.
unit.target: Nova peritia utens, tantum id fecit ut in miasma incidens, quod quasi gelatina disrumpit atque statim se iterum coalescere inceperet.

unit.source: But Sam wanted the monster to concentrate on the attacks it had already seen and not on what he was doing on the floor.
unit.target: Sed Sam volebat ut monstrum in impetibus, quos iam vidisset, intenderet, et non in id quod ipse in pavimento faceret.

unit.source: Fortunately, the chamber was circular so Sam didn't have to go far, keeping his Heart Rune in his view, to begin carving his next rune.
unit.target: Fortunate, cella circulare erat, ergo Sam longe ire non debebat, cor runam in conspectu servans, ut proximam runam sculpere inciperet.

unit.source: The monster meanwhile stopped its projectile vomiting and turned towards him, staying in the middle of the room.
unit.target: Interim, monstrum vomitum proiectile cessavit et ad eum conversum est, in medio cellae manens.

unit.source: However, instead of the monster releasing another projectile at him, it spoke, causing Sam to jump a little.
unit.target: Attamen, pro eo quod monstrum alium proiectile in eum dimitteret, locutum est, quod Sam paulum salire fecit.

unit.source: Luckily, he wasn’t carving at the moment of the jump, so the rune wasn’t ruined.
unit.target: Fortunate, non runam sculpere tempore salitus incumbebat, ita ut runa non corrupta esset.

unit.source: “INTRUDER!”
unit.target: “INTRUSUS!”

unit.source: The voice came out hoarse with ominous bubbling in the background as if it was coming from a deep, dark hole.
unit.target: Vox rauca exortus est cum bullientibus sonis ominosis in fundo, velut ex fovea profunda et obscura.

unit.source: Sam, knowing that talking with mysterious entities was never the best idea, just looked at it, while his sword hand was continuing the drawing with him, occasionally glancing down to make sure he was doing it correctly.
unit.target: Sam, sciens loqui cum entitatibus arcanais numquam optimum consilium esse, simpliciter illud aspiciens mansit, dum manus gladii eius delineationem prosequebatur et intermisso oculo deorsum intuens cur recte ageret.

unit.source: Thankfully, the basic runes were simple to draw…
unit.target: Gratias, runae fundamentales simplices erant ad delineandum…

unit.source: “BEFOULER!” Came another roar.
unit.target: “IMPURUS!” exclamavit alter rugitus.

unit.source: Then another.
unit.target: Deinde alterum.

unit.source: “ENEMY!”
unit.target: “HOSTIS!”

unit.source: Having finished the rune, Sam’s answer was another barrage of wind blades directly aimed at the mouth of the golem.
unit.target: Runa finita, responsio Sam alteram seriem laminarum venti directe in os golematis intendentem fuit.

unit.source: The response was pretty predictable.
unit.target: Responsio satis praevisibilis fuit.

unit.source: With a harsh cry of “DIE!” the monster released another stream of miasma at him.
unit.target: Cum aspero clamore “MORI!” monstrum alium fluxum miasma in eum dimittere coepit.

unit.source: This time he didn’t try to counter it, he simply sidestepped it and continued to the next position to begin carving the next rune.
unit.target: Hoc tempore illud repellere conatus non est; sed eam in latere praecurrit et ad proximam positionem processit ut runam sequentem sculpere inciperet.

unit.source: This time the golem and the intelligence behind it seemed to realize that Sam was fast enough to dodge the miasma stream.
unit.target: Hoc tempore golem et intelligentia eius videbantur intellexisse Sam satis celeri esse ut fluxum miasma devinqueret.

unit.source: So, the moment Sam stopped, it raised both of its hands and once again opened its mouth.
unit.target: Ita, quo Sam subsistebat, golem uterque manu attoluit et iterum os aperuit.

unit.source: However, instead of a continuous stream of dark ooze it started spitting bullets of the disgusting material at Sam.
unit.target: Attamen, pro continuo fluxu obscuri luti, globulos materiae foedae in Sam iaculari incipiebat.

unit.source: Sam simply tapped the ground with his foot and raised a curved Earth Wall in front of him, reinforced with his mana.
unit.target: Sam pede terram tetigit et murum Terrae curvam ante se attoluit, mana suo corroboratum.

unit.source: While that cut off his sight, his other senses allowed him to see where the monster was aiming or what it was doing.
unit.target: Dum hoc visum eius abstulit, cetera sensus eum permitterunt videre quo monstrum intendebat vel quid faceret.

unit.source: Seeing the wall rise, the beast roared again.
unit.target: Murum oriente videns, bestia iterum rugivit.

unit.source: “DARKNESS WILL CONSUME YOU!”
unit.target: “TENEBRAE TE DEVORABUNT!”

unit.source: And the barrage of miasma missiles intensified on his Earth Wall.
unit.target: Et agmen miasmatum telorum super Murum Terrae eius intensum factum est.

unit.source: “Oh boy, one of those…” Sam mumbled as he finished carving the third rune.
unit.target: “O puer, unum ex iis…” Sam submurmuravit dum tertiam runam sculpsit.

unit.source: Upon finishing it, he refocused his attention on the barrage and did another quick assessment, not wanting to get hit by the miasma despite his improved Mana Shield.
unit.target: Postquam eam finivit, animum suum in agmina redemit et aliam celerem aestimationem fecit, ne miasma, quamvis Scutum Manae emendatum haberet, percuteretur.

unit.source: He channeled a little more mana into the Earth Wall, protecting him.
unit.target: Paululum plus mana in Murum Terrae infudit, eum protegens.

unit.source: And then exploded it at the monster.
unit.target: Et deinde illud in monstrum concussit.

unit.source: This paused the miasma barrage, allowing him to continue his journey around the stone sculpture and golem while the body of the monster swallowed the debris and made its own.
unit.target: Hoc agmen miasmatum intermisit, quo facto eum permisit ut iter circa sculpturam lapideam et golem pergeret, dum corpus monstri ruinas devorabat et suas partes conficiebat.

unit.source: The moment he found a nice place to carve his rune, another wall rose in front of him, protecting him from the renewed barrage that seemed to be cracking the wall with every impact, causing him to spend mana to repair it.
unit.target: Mox cum locum iucundum invenit ad runam sculpere, alter murus ante eum oriebatur, eum ab agmine renovato protegens, qui, singulis ictibus murum fissionem faciens, eam reparare mana impendere cogebat.

unit.source: It only took a second for Sam to realize that the golem was using the rocks in its body to enhance the projectiles.
unit.target: Solum uno momento Sam intellexit golem ut saxa in corpore suo ad telorum augendum denudaret.

unit.source: “BEFOULER!”
unit.target: “IMPURUS!”

unit.source: Meanwhile, the monster kept his very stimulating commentary up.
unit.target: Interim, monstrum commentarium suum valde excitantem servavit.

unit.source: Sam didn’t dare to drop his concentration for even a second, no matter how much he wanted to slap his face with his palm.
unit.target: Sam ne quidem attentionem dimittere ausus est, quamvis vehementer vultum manu percutere vellebat.

unit.source: Dying right now would set the quest back enough that he would need an entire team to get back to the same position thanks to the monster learning from fights.
unit.target: Morte nunc, re vera, quaestionem satis retardaret ut totam turmam ad eandem positionem redeundam haberet, ob monstrum ex pugnis discens.

unit.source: “DIE!”
unit.target: “MORI!”

unit.source: Ignoring the monster, he reinforced the wall even more and tried to finish the rune as fast as possible.
unit.target: Monstrum ignorans, murum etiam magis corroboravit et conatus est runam quam celerrime conficere.

unit.source: After finishing the fourth rune, the fifth was the same.
unit.target: Postquam quartam runam finivit, quintae idem erant.

unit.source: The miasma golem kept shooting miasma bullets mixed with rock pieces from the exploded Earth Wall at him.
unit.target: Golem miasmaticus perpétuo telis miasmaticis mixtis fragminibus saxorum ex Muris Terrae concussis in eum iaculari pergebat.

unit.source: However, the moment he headed for the sixth one, the controlling intelligence realized that he could keep the Earth Wall intact during the barrage and changed its approach, which turned into a charge.
unit.target: Attamen, momento quo ad sextam runam processit, intelligentia imperans intellexit eum Murum Terrae intactum tenere posse in agmine miasmatico et consilium mutavit, quod in impetum versa est.

unit.source: That is the monster decided to charge at his wall.
unit.target: Id indicat monstrum constituisse in murum eius impetum facere.

unit.source: Panicking a little, Sam channeled more mana into the Earth Wall, increasing both its height and width.
unit.target: Paululum perterruit, Sam plus mana in Murum Terrae infudit, altitudinem atque latitudinem eius augens.

unit.source: The golem smashed against it with a thundering plop, miasma splashing everywhere.
unit.target: Golem illud cum tonitruculo percussit, miasma ubique dispergens.

unit.source: Sam quickly finished the sixth rune, and as the miasma monster began to ooze around the obstacle, he exploded at it again.
unit.target: Sam celeriter sextam runam finivit, et cum monstrum miasmaticum circa obstaculum exundare coepit, iterum in illud concussit.

unit.source: Despite jumping backward at the same time the detonation went off, he was still splashed with enough frothing miasma that the first layer of his Mana Shield practically vanished into the ether.
unit.target: Quamquam simul retrorsum saliit cum detonatio accidit, tamen sufficiens miasma ebulliens eum aspergebat ut primum stratum Scuti Manae fere in aetherem evanuerit.

unit.source: Luckily for him, the golem was practically enveloping the wall when it exploded, so it was partly scattered.
unit.target: Fortunate, golem murum fere complectebatur cum concusserat, ita ut partes eius dispersae sint.

unit.source: This allowed Sam to use the time it brought its body back together to finish the seventh and eighth runes, almost reaching the final spot on the right of the first rune, his Heart Rune.
unit.target: Hoc Sam concessit ut tempore quo corpus golem congregabatur, septimam et octavum runas conficeret, paene ad locum ultimum ad dextram primae runae, cor runae eius, perveniens.

unit.source: The entire chamber was peppered with the exploded remains of his Earth Walls and small pools of miasma were everywhere on the ground, hanging from the wall and covering almost everything.
unit.target: Tota cella erat sparsa reliquiis explosarum Murorum Terrae eius, et parvae piscinae miasmatum ubique in solo erant, ex muro pendentes et fere omnia tegens.

unit.source: By the time Sam reached the last position, for the ninth rune for this very basic rune circle, the golem had pulled itself together, accompanied by a rather pleasant shrieking.
unit.target: Cum Sam ad ultimum locum pervenisset, ad novem runam huius circuli fundamentalis, golem se congregaverat, comitatus iucundo stridore.

unit.source: “ENEMY!”
unit.target: “HOSTIS!”

unit.source: “BEFOULER!”
unit.target: “IMPURUS!”

unit.source: “YOU WILL BE CONSUMED!”
unit.target: “TE DEVORABUNT!”

unit.source: “DARKNESS WILL PREVAIL!”
unit.target: “TENEBRAE PRAEVALEBUNT!”

unit.source: As always, Sam just ignored it and began to carve the last rune, the rune that would close the circle and connect everything together.
unit.target: Ut semelso, Sam id ignoravit et ultimam runam sculpere coepit, runam quae circulum claudere atque omnia coniungere posset.

unit.source: The monster immediately began to charge at him and, raising its arms, it also began shooting balls of miasma at him.
unit.target: Monstrum statim in eum impetum facere coepit et brachia tollens, globos miasmaticos in eum iaculari incipiebat.

unit.source: Scowling at it, Sam raised several walls between himself and the monster, not caring about their quality, just that they held off the golem long enough for him to finish the rune.
unit.target: Ocre vultu, Sam plura muros inter se et monstrum attoluit, qualitate non curans, solum id quod golem satis diu retardaret ut runam conficeret.

unit.source: “YOU WILL BE DESTROYED!”
unit.target: “TE DELEBUNT!”

unit.source: The golem simply enveloped the wall that rose up next to it and smashed the following one with a rock engulfed in miasma.
unit.target: Golem simpliciter murum, qui iuxta eum oriebatur, complectens, sequentem lapide, miasmate involuto, confractus est.

unit.source: But Sam kept creating walls, and it kept the golem slow enough that he could finish the rune.
unit.target: Sed Sam muros creare perseveravit, et hoc golem satis tardavit ut runam conficere posset.

unit.source: The rune glowed briefly with a pale blue light, showing that the circle was completed correctly, causing Sam to grin up at the golem that was leaning over him, arms stretched, ready to envelop him into the miasma.
unit.target: Runa breviter luce caerulea pallida fulgebat, ostendens circulum recte confectum esse, quod Sam subridens ad golem, qui super eum se inclinabat, brachiis extendentibus, paratus eum in miasma complectere, intuebatur.

unit.source: Sam was pretty sure not even his Mana Shield would protect him then from the dangerous ooze.
unit.target: Sam satis certus erat ne Scutum Manae quidem eum tunc a periculoso luto protegere posset.

unit.source: Luckily, he had a nifty little skill.
unit.target: Fortunate, habebat parvam peritiam ingeniosam.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: “Explosio Umbrarum!”

unit.source: He launched himself away from the golem that had smashed down to the ground where he was a moment before like a dark and foul tidal wave.
unit.target: Se a golem, qui paulo ante in terram concusum fuerat, sicut unda alta obscura atque foeda, proiecit.

unit.source: With a few powerful strides, he arrived back at the first position, where he engraved his Heart Rune into the floor, and as the golem gathered itself together, he called out to Lucky.
unit.target: Paucis stridulis potentibus, ad primum locum reversus est, ubi cor runam suam in pavimento inscripsit, et dum golem se congregabat, Lucky vocavit.

unit.source: “Lucky, launch it towards the center!”
unit.target: “Lucky, illum ad centrum proice!”

unit.source: He received no verbal response to his order.
unit.target: Nullam responsionem verbalem praecepto suo accepit.

unit.source: Although, the moment he finished said order, Lucky jumped out of the shadow that danced on the wall thanks to the weird lighting.
unit.target: Tamen, simul ac praeceptum finivit, Lucky ex umbra, quae in muro saltabat ob insolitam lucem, exsiluit.

unit.source: The loyal wolf, then like a shadowy bullet, impacted the golem.
unit.target: Fidelis lupus, dein quasi glans umbratica, golem percussit.

unit.source: Sam was happy to see that the shadows coiling around Lucky affected the spirit within and thus the whole golem, ignoring its liquid body.
unit.target: Sam laetus erat quod umbrae circa Lucky implicatae spiritum intimum commoverent atque ita totum golem, corpus liquidum oblitterans, afficere videbantur.

unit.source: The golem was launched back towards its origin point, not far enough to get it back to the center, but it was enough for Sam that it was fully in the circle.
unit.target: Golem retrorsum ad punctum originis proiectus est, non satis prope ad centrum redeundum, sed Sam satis habebat quod plene in circulo erat.

unit.source: Waiting for Lucky to land outside of the circle, he grinned triumphantly.
unit.target: Exspectans ut Lucky extra circulum terram attingeret, triumphanter subridens fuit.

unit.source: Slamming his hand down on his Heart Rune just as the miasma golem reoriented itself and exclaimed,
unit.target: Manum suam in cor runam contundens, simul ac golem miasmaticus se reorientavit, exclamavit:

unit.source: “Activate!”
unit.target: “Agite!”

unit.source: The moment the word left his mouth the rune under his hands lit up and starting from him the other runes also lit up in sequence, bathing the giant chamber in pale blue light that seemed to be fighting for dominance with the white light streaked with darkness.
unit.target: Momento quo verbum ex ore eius emicuit, runa sub manibus eius accensa est, et ab eo reliquae runae quoque ordine fulserunt, ingentem cameram lumine pallidi caerulei perfusam, quae videbatur cum albo lumine, obscuritate tincto, dominari contendere.

unit.source: While the monster’s eyes shined with unnatural insight, as the controlling intelligence behind the miasma realized (at least partially) what was happening, it roared, but by the time it began to do something the blue light emitted by Sam’s runes surrounded it and the rune circle was activated.
unit.target: Dum oculi monstri insolita perspicacia fulgebant, dum intelligentia regens post miasma saltem partim id quod accidere videbatur intellexit, rugivit; sed cum aliquid agere coepisset, lumen caeruleum a runis Sam emisso eum circumdedit et circulus runarum activatus est.

unit.source: Sam watched as the blue light shining from the runes flashed once, twice, then thrice.
unit.target: Sam aspexit dum lumen caeruleum ex runis semel, bis, deinde ter fulserit.

unit.source: The moment the last flash was over, the intelligence from the eyes of the golem vanished, replaced by the more familiar emptiness he had seen in the other golems.
unit.target: Momento quo ultima micatio finita est, intelligentia ex oculis golem effugit, substituta inania notiore quam in aliis golemis vidisset.

unit.source: But the changes didn’t stop there.
unit.target: Sed mutationes hic non desierunt.

unit.source: The runes flashed once again, sending out a pulse of pale blue light parallel to the ground, sweeping along it inside the rune circle until it reached the golem that was still processing what happened to it.
unit.target: Runae iterum fulserunt, pulsum lucis pallide caeruleae terræ parallelam emiantes, eam intra circulum runarum traiecunt, usque ad golem, qui rem suam adhuc elaborabat.

unit.source: The runes flashed a final time before finally going out, however, the light they released began to pool under the golem, and then began to rise upwards like some kind of scanning from an old sci‑fi movie.
unit.target: Runae ultimo tempore fulserunt antequam tandem exstiterunt; sed lumen, quod emitterunt, coepit sub golem congregari et deinde ascendere, quasi modus perscrutandi ex antiqua pellicula scientiae fictae.

unit.source: The parts that the flat plane of light touched lost their liquid state and, as if drying out insanely fast, turned into a crystallized material akin to obsidian, endlessly reflecting and refracting the white light originating from the stone torches.
unit.target: Partes quas planum lucis attigit, statum liquidum amisit et, quasi celeriter exsiccatae, in materiam crystallizatam similem obsidianae conversae sunt, quae sine fine lumen album a lapide torcia oriens reflexum atque refractum exhibebat.

unit.source: Sam watched fascinated as the golem was struck motionless and slowly but surely transformed from a sludge‑like consistency into what was basically the same material but all the water (or whatever the miasma considered water) sucked out.
unit.target: Sam admiratus aspexit dum golem immobilis caderet et paulatim sed certissime ex consistance limosi in materiam eandem converteretur, cum omnis aqua (aut quidquid miasma aquam appellabat) evanuerit.

unit.source: Effectively turning the sludge type of golem into a crystal type of golem.
unit.target: Effecit itaque ut golem limosus in golem crystallinum converteretur.

unit.source: The moment the pale blue plane of magic reached the top of the head of the golem, it stayed there for a fleeting moment and then simply winked out of existence, leaving behind a golem staring directly at Sam.
unit.target: Momento quo planum magiae pallide caeruleum apicem capitis golem attigit, ibi instante mansit atque deinde prorsus exsistentiam evanuit, relinquens post se golem directē ad Sam spectantem.

unit.source: He grinned, then readied both his sword and magic, because while the sludge golem was rather hard to defeat with physical attacks, a crystal golem was an entirely different story.
unit.target: Risum sublatus est, tum gladium et magiam paravit, quoniam dum golem limosus corporeis ictibus difficile superari videbatur, golem crystallinus prorsus alia erat.

unit.source: Especially with the small white light writhing in the middle of its chest making it look as if the body of the golem was holding the night sky thanks to the refraction.
unit.target: Praesertim cum parvum lumen album in medio pectoris ejus versaretur, ita ut videbatur corpus golem caelum nocturnum tenere, gratia refracti luminis.

unit.source: Obviously, the controlling intelligence was gone, as the golem simply raised its hands and pointed at Sam.
unit.target: Sane, intelligentia regens evanuerat, quippe quod golem simpliciter manus levavit et ad Sam indicavit.

unit.source: He reflexively stepped aside, but to both of their surprise, nothing came from the hands.
unit.target: Reflexive se recedens, sed ad utrorumque admirationem, ex manibus nihil emersit.

unit.source: Sam watched as the golem processed and then tried it a few times before whatever programming left behind by its controller kicked in and gave up on raining deathly projectiles on Sam and simply raised its hands and charged at him.
unit.target: Sam aspexit dum golem rem processit et aliquoties conatus est, antequam quidquid programmatum ab eius regente relictum in effectum venerit et in Sam proiectoria mortifera destinaverit, simpliciter manus levavit et in eum impetum fecit.

unit.source: Sam, still grinning thanks to his plan coming to fruition, simply dodged the strike by jumping to the side.
unit.target: Sam, adhuc risu perfusus ob consilium suum confectum, ictum eludere simulante ad latus salire.

unit.source: “Wind Flurry!”
unit.target: «Turbo Ventorum!»

unit.source: The wind blades launched from his sword raced directly at the center of the chest of the golem, but it raised its hands just in time.
unit.target: Laminae venti a gladio ejus emissae directe in centrum pectoris golem contendebant, sed golem manus justo tempore levavit.

unit.source: Though it damaged the arms, it was still a bother that it missed.
unit.target: Quamvis bracchia laesit, tamen molestum erat quod ictum non pervenisset.

unit.source: Sam clicked his tongue but still continued to dodge the very linear charges of the golem.
unit.target: Sam linguam strinxit, sed tamen impetus lineares golem eludere pergebat.

unit.source: Because while it was smart (and fast) enough to protect its core, it wasn’t smart enough to figure out how to fight with its new body without the intelligence that his rune circle stripped from it.
unit.target: Nam quamquam callidum (et velox) erat ad cor suum protegendum, non satis sapiens erat ut pugnandi rationem cum novo corpore sine illa intelligentia, quam circulus runarum ei abstulit, inveniret.

unit.source: So, it defaulted to the old charge and smash attack pattern.
unit.target: Ergo ad vetus impetum et concussum modum defuit.

unit.source: Which was pretty easy to circumvent…
unit.target: Quod omnino facile circumvenire videbatur…

unit.source: For a hot minute, the only thing that could be heard in the chamber were Sam’s echoing cries of Wind Flurry (while he internally lamented his lack of attack spells and skills) and the sound of the crystalline golem rumbling along the ground and smashing uselessly into the ground as Sam would inevitably dodge their very linear attack.
unit.target: Per brevem momentum, sola in camera audiri potebantur Sam vociferationes "Turbo Ventorum" resonantes (dum internis lamentationibus de defectu incantationum et artium pugnandi affectus erat) atque sonus golem crystallini, qui per terram fremebat et ineptim in terram contundebat, dum Sam inevitabiliter eorum linearem impetum eludebat.

unit.source: Then the sound of a crack could be heard.
unit.target: Tum sonus crepitus audiri potuit.

unit.source: Then another and another, until Sam was listening with a small smile to crystal chunks falling to the ground and shattering into even smaller parts as he watched the left hand of the golem practically fall apart.
unit.target: Tum iterum et iterum, donec Sam cum parvo risu auscultabat fragmenta crystallina in terram cadentia et in particulas minora dissoluentia, dum sinistram manum golem paene dissolvi observebat.

unit.source: First little pieces from the part that Sam targeted with his every cast, then bigger pieces began to fall until the golem was standing there with only a small chunk of crystalline material jutting out of its shoulder.
unit.target: Primum parva fragmenta ex parte quam Sam omni incantatione petivit, deinde maiora cadere coeperunt, donec golem stabat ibi, cum ex humero eius tantum parvum fragmentum materiae crystallinae eminens esset.

unit.source: Sam’s smile turned vicious, and he exclaimed.
unit.target: Risus Sam malitiosis factus est, ac exclamavit.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»

unit.source: Thanks to his increase in speed, he managed to get around the golem while it was trying to process the loss of one of its arms and made sure to use all three seconds of increased speed that the skill granted him.
unit.target: Gratia crescentis celeritatis, circum golem se circumvenire potuit, dum illud damnum unius brachii perpendere conabatur, atque curavit ut omnes tres secundae celeritatis a peritia concessae adhiberentur.

unit.source: He let go of a storm of Wind Blades, mixed with Wind Flurrys as well as Mana Slashes followed by Double Mana Slashes, all aimed at approximately the same spot.
unit.target: Emisit turbam laminarum venti, mixtam cum “Turbo Ventorum” atque ictibus mana, deinde duplici ictu mana, omnes ad fere eundem locum destinatos.

unit.source: As the skill ended and the golem started turning, there was a nice spot on the surprisingly smooth back of the golem, exactly on top where the light seemed to be housed in its body.
unit.target: Cum peritia finem attigit et golem verti coepit, apparuit locus pulcher in tergo golem, prorsus in summitate, ubi lumen in eius corpore degere videbatur.

unit.source: The spot was circular, with cracks radiating everywhere.
unit.target: Locus circularis erat, fissuris ubique radiantibus.

unit.source: He took a few steps backwards, waiting for the golem to take a few steps, ramping up for another pointless charge, then without taking his eyes off his enemy, exclaimed.
unit.target: Aliquot gradus retrocedens, exspectavit ut golem gradus paucos moveret ad alium impetum inutilis parandum, deinde hosti oculos non avertens, exclamavit.

unit.source: “Lucky, once more!”
unit.target: «Lucky, iterum!»

unit.source: The wolf vanished from his shadow, and once again reappeared behind the golem.
unit.target: Lupus ex umbra sua evanuit et iterum post golem apparuit.

unit.source: At the same moment, the golem began to charge and Lucky launched itself at the back of the golem.
unit.target: Eodem tempore, golem impetum facere coepit atque Lucky se ad tergum golem iactavit.

unit.source: The end result was the golem face‑planting with Lucky looking at it wearing a proud look on his face.
unit.target: Exitus fuit ut golem faciem in terram demergeret, dum Lucky eum spectans vultu superbo apparebat.

unit.source: Sam just ran over, grabbed the hilt of his sword with both hands, and as the golem was attempting to stand up with one hand, channeled almost all of his mana into it and with an incoherent yell slammed it down at the spot he had weakened.
unit.target: Sam cucurrit, manubrium gladii utrisque manibus arripuit, et dum golem una manu surgere conabatur, fere omnem vim magicam in eum infudit, inepto clamore eum in loco, quem debilitaverat, deiecit.

unit.source: The golem spasmed a little, then fell motionless, leaving the chamber once again silent.
unit.target: Golem paulo spasit, deinde immotus cecidit, relinquens cameram iterum silentem.

unit.source: And as the golem lay there, Sam watched as the pinpricks of light in its obsidian‑like body went out and with them the torches died down a little, only to come back to life, blazing even stronger, however, they were lacking the black streaks that tainted them previously.
unit.target: Et dum golem ibi iacebat, Sam aspexit quomodo parva puncta lucis in eius corpore, quod obsidiana simile videbatur, extinguebantur, et cum eis torcia aliquantulum exstinguebantur, ut rursus in vitam redire inciperent, fulgentes etiam magis, attamen carentes lineis nigris quae prius eos maculaverant.

unit.source: The wall of white fire that locked him into the room also vanished.
unit.target: Murus ignis albi qui eum in camera claudebat, quoque evanuit.

unit.source: Sam twisted the sword a little, making sure that the monster was dead, then pulled it out, scoffed at the broken tip, and threw it away.
unit.target: Sam gladium paululum quassavit, certus monstrum mortuum esse, deinde gladium extraxit, apicem fractum irridens, et proiecit eum.

unit.source: The low‑quality sword landed with a clang that coincided with the notification sound going off in his head.
unit.target: Gladius ignobilis clangore cecidit, quod cum sono notificationis in mente eius conveniebat.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you defeated the Boss of the Ironwood Glade Ruins!]
unit.target: [Gratulamur, Magistrum Ruinarum Gladis Ironwood superavisti!]

unit.source: The monster in front of him simply collapsed into itself, turning into dust in a few moments, leaving behind a softly glowing white ball.
unit.target: Monstrum coram eo simpliciter in se collapsum est, paucos momentis in pulverem conversum, relinquens post se globulum album leniter fulgentem.

unit.source: Nodding at the confirmation that he was done, he leaned down and softly lifted the glowing ball of light with his palm.
unit.target: Nutans ad confirmationem sui facti, inclinavit se et globulum lucis fulgentis leniter in palma sustulit.

unit.source: He had to shut down his Mage Sight, as the ball of light without the obscuring effect of the dark miasma almost blinded him with its intensity.
unit.target: Oportuit eum "visum magicarum" rescindere, nam globus lucis sine effectu obscuranti miasma fere eum caecaverat intensitate sua.

unit.source: He spent a few moments observing it with his Mana Sense, but the only feeling he got was that it was filled with an overwhelming amount of life energy.
unit.target: Paucis momentis eam cum sensu mana observavit, sed sola sensatio quae ei attigit fuit, eam copia energiae vitae impleri.

unit.source: ‘Probably some kind of energy used to maintain the trees…’
unit.target: ‘Forsitan quaedam energia ad arbores conservandas usurpata…’

unit.source: Looking at the ball of light in his palm and the giant ball of rock cradled by the stone roots that lost almost all of its shine, now that the miasma golem was defeated, Sam knew what he had to do.
unit.target: Observans globulum lucis in palma eius et magnum globum saxi, radicibus lapideis foventem qui fere totum splendorem amisit, nunc quod miasma golem superatum erat, Sam intellexit quid agendum haberet.

unit.source: So, he simply walked up to it and pressed the ball of light into it.
unit.target: Ergo, se appropinquavit et globulum lucis in eum immisit.

unit.source: Technically, he could have stored the ball of life energy away for later use, but that would have invalidated his quest and more than likely would have made him a lot of enemies…
unit.target: Technice, globulum energiae vitae ad usum futurum condere potuisset, sed id expeditionem eius inficeret et verisimiliter multos inimicos ei attulisset…

unit.source: The moment the light sunk into the giant rock, it began to spin with ever‑increasing speed while the light seemed to seep out of the cracks that before were filled with miasma.
unit.target: Momento quo lumen in magnum saxum immittebat, incepit celeritate crescenti gyrari, dum lumen ex fissuris, quondam miasma replentibus, effluere videbatur.

unit.source: This continued until he was watching a rapidly spinning rock in the middle of the room shining with the same light he held in his hands, but somehow more.
unit.target: Hoc perstitit, donec spectabat saxum in media camera celeriter gyrantem, fulgentem eodem lumine quem in manibus tenebat, sed aliquantum amplius.

unit.source: And there was a pleasant feeling radiating from it.
unit.target: Et ex eo emanabat sensus amoenus.

unit.source: Sam felt at peace…
unit.target: Sam se pacatum sensit…

unit.source: “Oh, that is why it was sooo familiar!”
unit.target: «O, ideo tam nota erat!»

unit.source: Sam would forever deny that he yelped in surprise and jumped into the air as a voice sounded next to him.
unit.target: Sam in aeternum negasset se in stupore exclamavisse atque in aethera salisse, cum vox prope eum audiebatur.

unit.source: Looking down at the origin of the voice, he saw to his consternation, the giant cricket that was supposed to be staying outside.
unit.target: Depiciens oculos ad originem vocis, vidit ad suam consternationem ingentem gryllam, quae foris manere debebat.

unit.source: The cricket turned towards him with her entire body and had the gall to smirk at him.
unit.target: Grylla se totum corpore ad eum convertit et ausa est ei subridere.

unit.source: Sam didn’t know how it worked on a cricket body…
unit.target: Sam nesciebat quomodo hoc in corpore gryllae operaretur…

unit.source: “I never said I’d stay outside, child of man.
unit.target: By the way, excellent fight!”

unit.source: After a few moments, Sam managed to grunt out a sentence.
unit.target: Post paucos momenta, Sam verba exclamare potuit.

unit.source: “Thank you?”
unit.target: «Gratias?»

unit.source: “You’re most welcome, young Sam!” came the chirpy reply, and the cricket turned back to staring at the glowing orb of life energy rotating in the middle of the room.
unit.target: «Maxime tibi gratum est, iuven Sam!» inquit laete, et grylla iterum ad globum lucis vitae, qui in media camera gyrabat, spectare coepit.

unit.source: Sam let the silence fill the room for a while as he gained control over his hammering heart, but in the end, he needed to know.
unit.target: Sam silentium in camera aliquantulum praestare permisit, dum cor suum concitato moderabat, sed in fine scire cupiebat.

unit.source: “Why is it so familiar, ma’am?”
unit.target: «Cur ita nota est, domina?»

unit.source: There was a moment as the cricket hummed, then with a poof of magic, turned back into her humanoid form, still standing next to Sam, and reaching out with her hand towards the rotating globe.
unit.target: Momento graviter, grylla murmuravit, deinde, cum magica impetu, in formam humanam rediit, adhuc iuxta Sam stans, manum ad globum gyrantem tendens.

unit.source: She seemed to almost caress the rock.
unit.target: Videbatur paene saxum teneriter palpare.

unit.source: “I was here when this place was made.
unit.target: I was the guardian.

unit.source: She paused and Sam had to fight hard not to roll his eyes at the very cliché development.
unit.target: Illa pausavit, et Sam vehementer contendere debuit ne oculos suos volvere in hoc tam praesuppositum progressu.

unit.source: “But something corrupted the link, something dark and evil.
unit.target: But now that you removed it, it seems the connection is back, and with it, my memories, child of man.”

unit.source: “I’m glad to hear” said Sam, not knowing what else to say.
unit.target: «Gaudeo hoc audire,» inquit Sam, nesciens quid aliud dicere posset.

unit.source: “You should be. If the darkness had been able to completely consume the life energy, then it would have spelled doom for the forest and the land beyond it.”
unit.target: «Tu debes esse; si obscuritas totam vim vitae consumere potuisset, tunc fatum foret silvae et terrae ultra eam.»

unit.source: “Makes sense.”
unit.target: «Sane.»

unit.source: “It does, doesn’t it?” came the whimsical reply as the humanoid cricket continued to caress the rock almost lovingly.
unit.target: «Ita vero, nonne?» inquit iocositer, dum grylla humanoide saxum paene amore teneriter palpabat.

unit.source: Sam glanced at the glowing rock and the humanoid monster that seemed to be almost out of it
unit.target: Sam oculos ad saxum fulgentem et monstrum humanoidem, quod paene ex eo procedere videbatur, coniecit.

unit.source: “Now what?”
unit.target: «Nunc quid?»

unit.source: The monster retrieved her hand from the glowing rock and turned towards him; her face set into a knowing smirk.
unit.target: Monstra manum suam e saxo fulgente recepit et in eum conversum est; vultus eius, sapiens subridens, constitutus est.

unit.source: “Now, child of man, you do me a favor and you can retrieve your prize and leave.”
unit.target: «Nunc, fili hominis, mihi benefac et praemium tuum recipies, atque discedes.»

unit.source: Sam simply raised an inquisitive eyebrow.
unit.target: Sam simpliciter supercilium curiosum levavit.

unit.source: “Up there is a crack where the miasma is seeping in,” she said, pointing upwards into the darkness of the ceiling of the chamber.
unit.target: «In summo est fissura, unde miasma diffunditur,» inquit illa, digitum sursum trahens ad obscuritatem laquearii camerae.

unit.source: “You fix that crack, and I’ll give you what you seek.”
unit.target: «Fissuram illam repara, et dabitur tibi quod quaeris.»

unit.source: “And what about the origin of the miasma?”
unit.target: «Et quid de origine miasmatis?»

unit.source: The answer he received didn’t surprise him much.
unit.target: Responsio quam accepit eum parum miravit.

unit.source: “Don’t worry, now that I’m awake and aware, I can express my displeasure to them about what constitutes as good neighborly behavior!”
unit.target: «Noli timere, nunc quod evigilavi et conscius sum, possum eis exprimere indignationem meam de iis rebus, quae, ut puto, verum bonum vicinorum mores non constituunt!»

unit.source: He couldn’t help but shudder at the tone, but he still couldn’t pity the fools that dabbled in things that resulted in things like the miasma that he had been fighting for the last few hours.
unit.target: Non potuit non tremere ob tonum, sed etiam non potuit misereri stultos, qui in rebus versabantur quae ad miasma similia redibant, quas per horas pugnaverat.

unit.source: Shaking his head, then nodded and headed for one of the sides of the chamber, while the giant humanoid cricket turned back to the glowing rock filled with life energy without a word with Lucky wandering next to her and sitting down and curiously staring at the same rock.
unit.target: Caput concutens, deinde annuit et ad unum latus camerae properavit, dum ingens grylla humanoides ad globum lucis, vita energia implentem, sine verbo redeunavit, atque Lucky iuxta eam vagans sedebat et illud saxum mirabatur.

unit.source: He walked up to the wall, placed his hand on it and cast Earth Wall, creating a foothold.
unit.target: Accessit ad murum, manum in eum posuit et "Murum Terrae" effecit, firmamentum creans.

unit.source: He tested it and, seeing as it took his body weight, he did a few times until he had a very neat but probably dangerous staircase leading up to the ceiling of the chamber.
unit.target: Id probabilavit, et cum pondus corporis eius sustineret, id paucoties repetivit, donec habuit scalas ordinatas sed fortasse periculosas ad laquearium camerae accessum efficiendas.

unit.source: A minute of climbing later he stood under the ceiling looking for the leak like some kind of fantasy contractor.
unit.target: Post minuto ascensu, stetit sub laqueario quaerens effusum sicut aliquis conductarius phantasiarum.

unit.source: ‘Well, an adventurer is a kinda contractor, so it works…’ he mused while searching.
unit.target: ‘Ita, audax viator quasi conductarius est, ergo id operatur…’ meditatus est dum quaerebat.

unit.source: “Ahh, there it is!”
unit.target: «Ahh, ecce, hic est!»

unit.source: After spotting, it took a little maneuvering before he stood under it, giving thanks that he wasn’t afraid of heights, and with a brief application of Earth Wall and a little extra and the crack in the stone ceiling was filled not just on the surface level but deeper inside.
unit.target: Postquam id deprehendit, aliquantulum manœuvrationis necessariae factae sunt, antequam sub eo staret; gratias egit quod altitudines non timuerit, et cum brevi incantatione "Murum Terrae" et paulo addito, fissura in laqueario saxo non solum superne, sed etiam interno implenda fuit.

unit.source: While he was up there, Sam used his Mana Sense to probe in the direction the miasma seemed to be coming from, and almost fell from recoil from touching the dark mana that seemed to permeate the rock.
unit.target: Dum ibi stetit, Sam sensu mana usus est ad indagandum quo miasma videbatur provenire, et paene cecidit ex repugnatione quod tecta obscura mana, quae saxum pervadere videbatur, attigit.

unit.source: ‘That’s some baaad juju…’
unit.target: ‘Haec est vere mala magia…’

unit.source: Following that, he quickly returned to the ground, canceling the Earth Walls he had created.
unit.target: Post hoc celeriter ad terram rediit, Murum Terrae, quod creaverat, revocans.

unit.source: Soon, he was once again standing next to the guardian and Lucky, who were staring at the rotating orb, transfixed.
unit.target: Statim, iterum stetit iuxta custodem et Lucky, qui globum rotientem contemplabant, attoniti.

unit.source: He cleared his throat gently, causing his wolf companion to fall over in surprise and the giant cricket to turn towards him.
unit.target: Leniter guttur emisit, efficens ut comes lupus eius ex admiratione caderet et ingens grylla ad eum converteretur.

unit.source: “It’s done.”
unit.target: «Peractum est.»

unit.source: “I know. Here is your reward.”
unit.target: «Scio. Ecce praemium tuum.»

unit.source: A simple chalice appeared in his hand, made from, to his not‑surprise, ironwood with filigree made from iron.
unit.target: Calix simplex in manu eius apparuit, ex ligno ferreo factus (ut non miraretur), ornatus filigranis ex ferro.

unit.source: “Thank you for your help, child of man.
unit.target: But it is time for you to leave, and for me to chastise a few people…”

unit.source: Sam was about to answer, but between two blinks, he found himself standing back in the clearing from where he entered the ruins.
unit.target: Sam iam respondi vellebat, sed inter duas palpebras se invenit rursus in prato, unde ruinas intraverat, stantem.

unit.source: The archway he used was conspicuously missing, and he could hear in the far distance screams of despair.
unit.target: Arcus quem usus erat manifeste defuit, atque in longinquo clamores desperationis audiri poterant.

unit.source: He hesitated for a moment, but in the end, Sam decided it wasn’t his job to deal with that, so he turned around, motioning for Lucky to follow him, and began to examine the chalice while leisurely walking and trying to ignore the wails of the damned.
unit.target: Paululum dubitavit, sed tandem Sam constituit non suum officium esse id curare; itaque se vertit, Lucky secuti invitans, et calicem examinandum coepit, dum lente ambulabat et gemitus damnatorum praeterire conabatur.

unit.source: The way back to the city of Ironwood was a little more complicated than his journey from it, as several fights between guilds had broken out over the troll farming spots and he had to make an effort to avoid those or sneak through them.
unit.target: Iter ad urbem Ironwood paulo complicatius fuit quam ab ea profectus, cum plures pugnae inter collegia de agris trollorum cultu ortae essent, atque conari debuisset eos vitare aut subreptitius transire.

unit.source: Thankfully, he was lucky enough that nobody spotted him, or if they spotted him, they realized he wasn’t part of the fighting guilds and let him go.
unit.target: Gratias agens, felix fuit quod nemo eum deprehendit, aut si deprehenderunt, cognouerunt eum non esse partem collegiorum bellatorum, atque eum liberaverunt.

unit.source: Just to be sure, he did the entire journey in disguise using his nifty little chameleon mask.
unit.target: Certo scitu, totum iter sub persona furti egit, utens parva larva chameleonis ingeniosa.

unit.source: He arrived back at the city gates, exhausted but triumphant.
unit.target: Rediit ad portas urbis, exhaustus sed triumphans.

unit.source: Ignoring the small beggar child with too white and too many teeth giving him a thumbs up near the road leading to the gates, he checked his clothing and armor and headed towards the old ranger’s house.
unit.target: Neglecto parvo puero mendico, nimis candidus et multos dentes habens, qui prope viam ad portas pollicem tribuens, vestimenta et armaturam inspiciens, versus domum veteris ranger se contulit.

unit.source: He had a quest to complete.
unit.target: Habebat propositum ad exsequendum.

unit.source: Walking through the city, Sam couldn’t help but feel the nervous energy permeating the entire area.
unit.target: Ambulans per urbem, Sam non potuit non sentire vim anxiam, quae totam regionem pervadebat.

unit.source: People were walking faster, almost hunching in on themselves, looking around nervously or even fearfully, and the mana in the air was infested with a very thin layer of cloying miasma that was like sweat on a humid summer day.
unit.target: Homines celerius ambulabant, paene se incurvantes, circumiacentes trepide aut etiam timide, et mana in aere infestata erat tenuissima pellicula miasmatis, sicut sudor in die aestivo umido.

unit.source: It was sticky and clung to the body no matter what one did.
unit.target: Erat viscosum et ad corpus haerebat, quocumque modo ageretur.

unit.source: Thankfully, Sam always had his Mana Shield up, so when the very familiar miasma tried to stick to his skin, it just slid off uselessly.
unit.target: Gratias Deo, Sam semper scutum Manæ tenebat, ita ut cum miasma notissimum ad cutem eius haerere conaretur, inutilem lapsum passum est.

unit.source: Sam scowled and began to hasten his steps towards the old man’s house to finish the quest.
unit.target: Sam vultum contraxit et pedes celeriter ad domum senis properare coepit ut quaestionem perficiat.

unit.source: If the origin of the miasma was related to the people who planned the Monster Break for the city of Ironwood and managed to infest Lady Silvercrest with that parasite, then the destruction of one of their bases would more than likely change their timetables.
unit.target: Si origo miasmatis attinet ad illos qui "Monster Break" pro urbe Ironwood consilium ceperunt et dominam Silvercrest parasitum infesterunt, tunc destructio unius eorum basis verisimiliter eorum tempora mutabit.

unit.source: And because Sam only had the basics of the idea about what they were planning, he didn’t like that.
unit.target: Et quia Sam solum fundamenta ideae de eorum consilio habebat, id non ei placuit.

unit.source: Navigating the shadowed streets of the bad part of the town, he soon arrived back before the old ranger’s house.
unit.target: Per umbratiles vias parte infausta oppidi navigans, mox ad domum veteris silvatici rediit.

unit.source: When he looked around, he thought he saw the flash of somebody with a very small body watching the house, but when he went to take another look, the alley was empty.
unit.target: Cum circumspiciebat, putavit se fulgor aliqui parvuli corporis, qui domum intuēbatur, vidisse; sed cum iterum intuērī conatus est, vicula vacuum apparuit.

unit.source: Shaking his head, he stepped up to the door and knocked.
unit.target: Capite concussus, ad ianuam accessit et pulsavit.

unit.source: Compared to the first time he visited the old man, this time he didn’t have to wait even a few seconds.
unit.target: Comparato primo tempore senem visitando, hoc tempore ne pauca quidem secunda exspectare non debuit.

unit.source: The door was almost wrenched open and old man Marak was standing there with tousled hair and mustache, holding an enchanted watering can.
unit.target: Iana paene abrupte aperta erat et senex Marak ibi stabat, capillis discorsisque et barbata, canistrum incantatum tenens.

unit.source: “Who… Oh, it’s you!” the old man yelled, then grumbled as he recognized Sam.
unit.target: "Quis... O, tu es!" exclamavit senex, deinde murmuravit cum Sam agnovit.

unit.source: “Did you fail?”
unit.target: "Defecisti?"

unit.source: “No, Sir. Item retrieved, monster pacified and…” he didn’t manage to finish his report as the older man grabbed him by the hem of his cloak and pulled him into the house, the door closing behind him automatically.
unit.target: "Non, domine. Res recuperata, monstrum sedatum et..." non potuit relationem suam perficere, cum senex eum a margine pallii arripuit et in domum traxit, ianuam post eum automatice claudens.

unit.source: “Even the walls have ears, you moron…” grumbled the ranger, then placed the watering can next to the door rather aggressively and motioned to Sam to follow him.
unit.target: "Etiam muri aures habent, stulte..." murmurat custos silvestris, deinde canistrum incantatum iuxta ianuam commode posuit et Sam monuit ut eum sequeretur.

unit.source: They returned to the same room where Sam received his quest, took seats in the same chairs, and Sam watched through his senses as the old man performed the same procedure to ascertain if somebody was listening on them (though, it was more forceful than last time).
unit.target: Redierunt in eandem conclave, ubi Sam propositum suum accepit, sedes in eadem subselliis ceperunt, et Sam per sensus intuens vidit senem eandem rationem gerere ad comprobandum si quis eos auscultaret (quamquam cum maiore vi quam prius).

unit.source: Sam spent a moment getting comfortable, while Lucky just left his shadow with a little hop and skip and settled before the roaring fireplace and closed his eyes.
unit.target: Sam momentum consumpsit se commodi restituens, dum Lucky umbram suam parvo saltu relinquens ante focum rugientem consedit et oculos clausit.

unit.source: He chuckled at his companion, then turned towards his quest giver.
unit.target: Sam subridens comiti suo, deinde ad eum qui propositum dedit se convertit.

unit.source: “Is it safe?”
unit.target: "Estne tutum?"

unit.source: “As much as it can be in these times…” came the grumble from the old man. “There is just something in the air…”
unit.target: "Quantum potest in his temporibus esse..." inquit senex murmurans. "Aliquid tamen in aere est..."

unit.source: “Miasma.”
unit.target: "Miasma."

unit.source: “What?”
unit.target: "Quid?"

unit.source: “Miasma is in the air.”
unit.target: "Miasma in aere est."

unit.source: The old man closed his eyes, took a deep breath and Sam watched through his other senses as the mana in the air entered the man’s lung and as he exhaled, left it.
unit.target: Senex oculos clausit, spiritum altum attulit, et Sam per reliquos sensus intuens vidit mana in aere pulmonem senis ingredi et, dum exhalaret, eam relinquere.

unit.source: “Miasma.”
unit.target: "Miasma."

unit.source: “Yes.”
unit.target: "Ita."

unit.source: “By the gods…” The older man shook his head, and then returned his attention to Sam. “Start at the beginning!”
unit.target: "Per deos..." Senex caput concussit et ad Sam evolvit. "Ab initio incipias!"

unit.source: “All right, Sir!” replied Sam while settling back in the chair and began to tell Marak about his journey. “I found the first symbol where you told me and then…”
unit.target: "Recte, domine!" respondit Sam, repositus in subsellio, et coepit narratio eius Marak de itinere suo. "Primum symbolum inveni, ubi me indicavisti, et deinde…"

unit.source: “…and that’s about what I know.”
unit.target: "…et hoc fere est quod scio."

unit.source: Sam finished his explanation, followed by watching the older man as the room fell silent. The only sound that could be heard was the roaring of the fire and Lucky’s gentle breathing.
unit.target: Sam narrationem finivit, et secus senem spectavit dum conclave silentiaque replebatur. Solus sonus auditus erat: ignis rugiens et leni respiratio Lucky.

unit.source: For a long minute, the old man just sat there with his eyes closed, contemplating everything that Sam told him. The forest, the giant cricket monster, the ruin, the miasma and the fights.
unit.target: Per longum momentum, senex ibi sedebat, oculis clausis, omnia quae Sam narraverat meditans: silva, ingens monstrum gryllorum, ruina, miasma, et pugnae.

unit.source: “I see,” spoke the old man up finally, then he opened his eyes and looked at Sam. And as Sam looked back, he couldn’t help but shudder at the look in the old man’s eyes. It radiated anger, sadness, guilt and was tinged with slight greenish light that reminded Sam of a forest after a fresh rain.
unit.target: "Intelligo," inquit senex demum, deinde oculos aperuit et Sam inspicuit. Et cum Sam intuēbatur, non potuit non tremere aspectu oculorum senis, qui iram, tristitiam et culpam efferebant, et leviter viridi lumine tincti erant, qui Sam silvam post recentem pluviam commemorabant.

unit.source: “Thank you, young man. You did me, the woods and the city, a great favor,” continued the old man.
unit.target: "Gratias tibi, iuvenis. Nobis beneficium fecisti."

unit.source: “But now I must ask you to leave. I have certain matters to attend to…”
unit.target: "Sed nunc te rogare habeo ut discedas. Negotia quaedam mihi attendenda sunt…"

unit.source: “You’re going to visit that cricket?”
unit.target: "Illud creticum visitabis?"

unit.source: “Indeed,” the older man answered with a nod. “It is rather dishonorable that we had forgotten one of the protectors of the forest, even if they were asleep. So, I must rectify this.”
unit.target: "Certe," respondit senex, annuendo. "Non honeste est quod unum ex defensoribus silvae oblivissemus, etiam si dormiret; itaque hoc corrigere debeo."

unit.source: Sam nodded in understanding and noting the unspoken dismissal, stood up.
unit.target: Sam intellexit et, tacita expromissione notata, surrexit.

unit.source: Lucky, noticing his movement, also woke up, stretched, and then without a sound, jumped back into his shadow.
unit.target: Lucky, motum eius animadvertens, evigilavit quoque, se extendit, et sine sono in umbram suam saliit.

unit.source: “Then I will take my leave. After all, I have to deliver the Chalice to the Silvercrest family.”
unit.target: "Tum discedam. Omnino, calicem ad familiam Silvercrest tradere mihi oportet."

unit.source: The older man nodded, and for a moment, the multitude of feelings in his eyes was replaced with humor.
unit.target: Senex annuit, et per breve momentum, multitudinem sensuum in oculis eius risu commutavit.

unit.source: “Good luck!” He snickered a little, then while Sam was making sure he had everything with him, he stepped up to one of the shelves and retrieved a rather thick tome.
unit.target: "Bona fortuna!" inquit leviter subridens, deinde dum Sam omnia secum habere curabat, ad unum ex armariis accessit et volumine crasso rapuit.

unit.source: The old man stepped up to Sam, who was watching him interestedly, while inwardly salivating at the thought of what kind of reward he would get.
unit.target: Senex ad Sam accessit, qui eum studiosus intuens erat, interius salivans ad cogitationem praemii quod acciperet.

unit.source: “I noticed during your story that you had some glaring holes in your repertoire, so here, young man. Take it with my thanks!”
unit.target: "Animadverti in tua narratione te hiatus conspicuos in tuo repertorio habere; ideo, iuvenis, accipe hoc cum mea gratitudine!"

unit.source: Sam took the big book and as he held it in his hand he noticed that it was surprisingly light despite its look.
unit.target: Sam magnum librum tulit et, dum in manu tenebat, animadvertit eum prorsus levem esse, non obstante aspectu crasso.

unit.source: “Thank you, sir.”
unit.target: "Gratias tibi ago, domine."

unit.source: Then, without waiting for the old man to say anything else, he turned around and left the house leaving an old man with a renewed purpose behind.
unit.target: Tum, sine senex ulteriorem rem dicere exspectans, se vertit et domum reliquit, senem proposito renovato post se relinquens.

unit.source: The moment he left the last step leading to the old ranger’s home, a notification screen popped up on his screen.
unit.target: Statim, postquam ultimum gradum ad domum veteris silvatici reliquit, schermo nuntiationis subito apparuit.

unit.source: [The quest ‘To peek or not to peek?’ has been completed!]
unit.target: [Quaestus "Speculare an non speculare?" perfectus est!]

unit.source: [You received the ‘Grimoire of Sharp Winds’ as a reward!]
unit.target: [Praemium accepisti: "Grimoire Ventorum Acuorum" !]

unit.source: Sam inhaled as he read the screen, then had to fight not to break out in joyous laughter.
unit.target: Sam inspiravit dum tabulam legebat, et deinde pugnare debuit ne in gaudium risum effunderet.

unit.source: He didn’t receive a spellbook or skill book.
unit.target: Non accepit librum incantationum aut librum artium.

unit.source: He received a Grimoire!
unit.target: Grimoriem accepit!

unit.source: While spell books, scrolls or skill books only contained one spell or skill, a Grimoire, depending on their rarity and origin, could contain anything from one to several dozen spells or skills.
unit.target: Dum libri incantationum, volumina, aut libri artium solum unam incantationem aut artem continebant, Grimoire, secundum raritatem et originem, possit continere ab una usque ad plura duodecim incantationes aut artes.

unit.source: Greater Grimoires sometimes even contained entire branches of magic.
unit.target: Grimoria maiora interdum totos ramos magiae complectebantur.

unit.source: His original reward would have been probably one or two skills or spells, depending on how he did on the quest, but because he managed to finish it the way he did, it was upgraded.
unit.target: Praemium eius originaliter probabiliter unum aut duo incantationes aut artes esse debuit, prout in quaestione se gesserit; sed quia eam perficere potuit, elevatum est.

unit.source: Sam couldn’t wait to open the Grimoire and learn the spells in them.
unit.target: Sam non potuit exspectare ut Grimoriem aperiret et incantationes in ea disceret.

unit.source: Carefully putting away the tome, he pulled his hood up and began walking slowly towards the Cloudy Inn.
unit.target: Diligenter volumine reponens, pallium capitis cepit et lente ad Cloudy Inn ambulare coepit.

unit.source: He needed a proper rest.
unit.target: Ei opus erat requies digna.

unit.source: But as he walked by an unassuming alley, he heard a noise.
unit.target: Sed dum per viculam modicam ambulabat, sonum audivit.

unit.source: “Psst!”
unit.target: "Psst!"

unit.source: Sam closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and turned towards the alley with a forced smile.
unit.target: Sam oculos clausit, spiravit alte, et forzato risu ad viculam se convertit.

unit.source: “Yes?”
unit.target: "Ita?"

unit.source: He wasn’t disappointed, as covered by the shadows was a very familiar street urchin, looking up at him with a mischievous look on their face.
unit.target: Non fuit deiectus, quoniam in umbris apparuerit notus puer vagus, qui eum intuens vultu ludico aspiciebat.

unit.source: “Congratulations!”
unit.target: "Felicitations!"

unit.source: Sam said nothing, just stared at the being masquerading as a boy (or girl, it was really hard to determine).
unit.target: Sam nihil dixit, solum intuens illud ens se puerum (vel puellam, difficile discerni) fingentem.

unit.source: The urchin stared at him for a moment, then scowled and spat at the ground.
unit.target: Puer vagus illum per momentum intuens, deinde vultum contraxit et in terram sputavit.

unit.source: “Ugh, so not fair if you know about it.”
unit.target: "Heu, tam iniustum, si scias."

unit.source: Sam raised an eyebrow, inwardly enjoying the frustration he was causing.
unit.target: Sam supercilium levavit, interiora fruens frustratione quam effecit.

unit.source: “Do you want anything?”
unit.target: "Visne aliquid?"

unit.source: The Fey sighed and nodded.
unit.target: Fey suspiravit et annuit.

unit.source: They reached inside their ratty clothing and retrieved a scroll that seemed to be sparkling as the minimal light in the alley hit it.
unit.target: Intra vestimenta sordida se inseruerunt et volutum, quod minutissimum lumen in vicula incidens micare videbatur, extraxerunt.

unit.source: They held it out for a second, then threw it towards Sam.
unit.target: Illud per momentum extulerunt, deinde in Sam coniecerunt.

unit.source: Unfortunately, he caught it on reflex.
unit.target: Infeliciter, reflexu id apprehendit.

unit.source: Sam froze, a thousand ideas running through his head as he held the still-sparkling scroll in his hand.
unit.target: Sam immobilis factus est, mille cogitationes per caput eius fluentes, dum volutum adhuc micantem in manu tenebat.

unit.source: He looked at the scroll, then back at the urchin who was smirking at him, and Sam knew it was a payback for his earlier actions.
unit.target: Ille volutum intuens, deinde ad urchinum respiciens, qui eum subridens spectabat, intellexit id esse retributionem pro praeviis factis suis.

unit.source: ‘They are a Fey after all…’
unit.target: "Postremo, illi sunt Fey…"

unit.source: “What is this?” he asked, lowering his hand, holding the scroll as far as possible with all the delicacy of a man holding something horrible.
unit.target: "Quid hoc est?" inquit, manum deponens, volutum tenens quantum poterat cum omni subtilitate hominis rem horribile tenentis.

unit.source: “Reward for a task well done,” came the quick answer.
unit.target: "Praemium pro opere bene facto," celeriter inquit.

unit.source: “And what will it cost me?” he asked, already dreading the answer.
unit.target: "Et quid mihi constabit?" inquit, iam metuens responsum.

unit.source: On one hand, he wanted nothing to do with the shenanigans of the Fey, on the other hand, his gamer senses were screaming at him to obtain the probably rare item.
unit.target: Ex una parte nihil cum malis artibus Fey agere volebat; ex altera parte sensus ludicri eius clamabant ut item, probabiliter rarum, obtineret.

unit.source: “Nothing,” spoke the urchin, scowling as if the word caused him physical pain.
unit.target: "Nihil," inquit urchinus, vultu contrito, quasi verbum ipsum dolorem corporalem inferret.

unit.source: “You did us a favor. This is a repayment.”
unit.target: "Nobis beneficium fecisti. Hoc est retributio."

unit.source: Sam wisely decided not to ask what he did because he suspected it would only cause him more headaches.
unit.target: Sapienter Sam decrevit non quaerere quid id significaret, suspiciens id tantum ei ulteriores molestias inferre.

unit.source: Instead, he silently put the scroll away into his inventory.
unit.target: Pro eo silentio volutum in inventarium suum recondidit.

unit.source: As he was about to figure out how to disengage from the conversation, he had a wicked idea.
