unit.target: Dum consilium de conversatione evellenda meditaturus erat, maleficam ideam cepit.

unit.source: “Say, are you guys free?”
unit.target: "Dic, estisne liberi?"

unit.source: The moment the question left his mouth, the brat moping in the shadows perked up and began eying him with interest.
unit.target: Eo momento, postquam quaestio eius ex ore abiit, puer in umbris excitatus est et eum cum studio intuens coepit.

unit.source: “It will cost you, mister!”
unit.target: "Constabit tibi, domine!"

unit.source: He retrieved a handful of silver and threw it towards the Fey, who caught all of it with deft movements and vanished them into their clothing.
unit.target: Argenti manum rapuit et in Fey iactavit, qui totum subtilibus motibus ceperunt et in vestimenta sua absconderunt.

unit.source: “I’m listening.”
unit.target: "Audiō."

unit.source: Sam looked around and after not seeing anybody, leaned closer to the young child.
unit.target: Sam circumspiciebat, et postquam neminem animadvertit, propius ad puerum accessit.

unit.source: “I need you to spread a rumor…”
unit.target: "Te rogo ut rumor diffundas…"

unit.source: The Fey stepped closer, and Sam could almost see them vibrating in excitement.
unit.target: Fey propius accessit, et Sam paene eos in excitamento vibrare vidit.

unit.source: “Yeees?”
unit.target: "Ita?"

unit.source: “Make sure that everyone who needs to know knows, that the Greyskull Guild is planning to raid the warehouse of the Auction House.”
unit.target: "Fac ut omnes, qui scire necesse habeant, sciant Greyskull Guild consilium habere horreum Domus Auctionis dirumpere."

unit.source: “Are they?”
unit.target: "Suntne?"

unit.source: “Of course not.”
unit.target: "Minime."

unit.source: Laughter was his only reply.
unit.target: Risus sola responsio eius fuit.

unit.source: Sam watched as the Fey contemplated his words, and then they nodded.
unit.target: Sam intuens erat, dum Fey verba eius contemplabant, et deinde annuerunt.

unit.source: “It will be done.”
unit.target: "Id fiet."

unit.source: “Good.”
unit.target: "Bene."

unit.source: Following an unspoken signal, both of them took a step back, the young street urchin covered in shadows and Sam bathing in the sickly light of the city.
unit.target: Secuti tacitum signum, uterque gradum retro ceperunt, puer vagus umbris operitus, et Sam in lumine aegroto urbis involutus.

unit.source: Suddenly, Sam heard a crow’s caw and instinctively looked up, searching for the source, and after finding nothing, he looked back down and saw the alley was empty.
unit.target: Subito, Sam corvi stridorem audivit et instinctive surrexit, fontem quaerens; postquam nihil invenit, oculos deflexit et animadvertit viculam vacuum esse.

unit.source: Shaking his head, he returned to his journey towards the inn, trying to forget that the previous meeting ever happened.
unit.target: Capite concussus, iter ad hospitium retulit, conatus oblivisci conventum praeteritum.

unit.source: Back at the inn, he was fussed over by the overly energetic and very loud Andrea, currently dressed in a princess dress that somehow made her look regal yet kinky.
unit.target: In hospitio reversus, Andrea, nimis energica atque valde clamosa, eum curabat; induta veste principis, quae eum regalem sed etiam insolitam efficiebat.

unit.source: Sam didn’t really understand, but the fussing felt nice.
unit.target: Sam non plane intellexit, sed cura eius bene sensa videbatur.

unit.source: After eating a decent meal, he begged off a drinking competition with Andrea, which was taken up by a slightly tipsy adventurer with wandering eyes nearby, and retreated to his room.
unit.target: Postquam edulcis cenam consumpsit, certamen bibendi cum Andrea recusavit, quod a paulo ebrioso adventore cum vagantibus oculis prope suscipiebatur, et se in conclave suo recepit.

unit.source: Chucking off the armor, and changing into more comfortable clothing, he spent a little time organizing his inventory, placing the Grimoire and still obnoxiously sparkling scroll on the table.
unit.target: Arma deponens et in vestimenta commodiiora se induens, parum temporis consumpsit ad suum inventarium ordinandum, posuens Grimoriem et volutum adhuc nimis micantem in mensa.

unit.source: Then he spent a relaxing half an hour feeding and playing with Lucky.
unit.target: Deinde dimidium horae relaxante tempore consumpsit, Lucky alens et ludens cum eo.

unit.source: Running his hand through Lucky’s incredibly soft fur while sitting on the bed, his back to the wall, he took the Grimoire into his hand and channeled a little magic into it.
unit.target: Manum per pilos Lucky incredibiliter molles transcurrens, sedens in lecto cum tergo ad parietem, Grimoriem in manum tulit et paululum magiam in illud infudit.

unit.source: Immediately, it began to shine, and the wind picked up in the room, swirling around him for a few seconds until the book shattered into motes of magic which joined the wind swirling and after a few seconds of theatrics surged into his chest.
unit.target: Statim, incipuit fulgere, et ventus in conclave surrexit, eum per paucas secundas circumvolvens, donec liber in particulas magicae confractus est, quae cum vento circumvolante coniunctae sunt, et post paucas secundas theatricae effusionis in pectus eius irruperunt.

unit.source: He just stared at the notification screen, wanting to know how many spells he would gain.
unit.target: Sam spectabat tabulam nuntiationis, quaerens scire quot incantationes adipiscetur.

unit.source: Sam hoped that Lucky’s Lucky Aura would kick in…
unit.target: Sam sperabat ut aura fortunata Lucky inchoaret…

unit.source: The game didn’t make him wait too long as the wind died down and the light show was finished and the notification screen appeared.
unit.target: Ludus non diu eum exspectare fecit, cum ventus cessavit et spectaculum lucis confectum esset, et tabula nuntiationis apparuit.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you read the Grimoire of Sharp Winds. Several new spells have been inscribed into your own Grimoire!]
unit.target: [Gratulatio, Grimoriem Ventorum Acuorum legisti. Plura nova incantationes in tuo Grimori inscriptae sunt!]

unit.source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Bullet!]
unit.target: [Incantationem "Telum Ventorum" didicisti!]

unit.source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Bullet Barrage!]
unit.target: [Incantationem "Tumultus Telerum Ventorum" didicisti!]

unit.source: [You have learned the spell, Healing Wind!]
unit.target: [Incantationem "Ventus Sanans" didicisti!]

unit.source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Jump!]
unit.target: [Incantationem "Saltus Ventorum" didicisti!]

unit.source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Edge!]
unit.target: [Incantationem "Acies Ventorum" didicisti!]

unit.source: [Wind Bullet: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to launch a bullet made of concentrated wind!]
unit.target: [Telum Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio simplex quae tibi sinit telum ex vento concentrato iaculari!]

unit.source: [Wind Bullet Barrage: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a barrage of wind bullets at your target. The damage of the released Wind Bullets depends on the Wind Bullet spell and your mastery over it.]
unit.target: [Tumultus Telerum Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit multitudinem telerum ventorum in metam tuam iaculari. Damnum telerum ventorum emissorum pendet ex incantatione "Telum Ventorum" et tuae peritiae super eam.]

unit.source: [Healing Wind: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a small gust of refreshing wind that restores a very small amount of stamina and health for the target.]
unit.target: [Ventus Sanans: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit parvum flatus venti refrigerii dimitteri, qui parvam quantitatem staminae et valetudinis destinatae restituat.]

unit.source: [Wind Jump: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to launch yourself upwards (or forward) with a small application of wind.]
unit.target: [Saltus Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio simplex quae tibi sinit te ipsum sursum (aut in ante) propellere cum parva applicatione venti.]

unit.source: [Wind Edge: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to enhance the edge of any bladed weapon you wield with the wind. The blade's cutting power will increase as well its reach.]
unit.target: [Acies Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit aciem cuiuslibet arma cultrata, cum auxilio venti, augere. Potentia caedendi eius et amplitudo augebitur.]

unit.source: Sam stared for a long moment, but before he could celebrate, another screen showed up in front of him.
unit.target: Sam diu intuitus est, sed antequam celebrare potuit, alia tabula in conspectu eius apparuit.

unit.source: [Due to your mastery of mana, and the fact that you mastered one Wind type spell, after learning more than seven Wind spells, you have gained the skill, Wind Affinity!]
unit.target: [Propter dominatum tuam manae et propter id quod unam incantationem venti generis peritatus es, postquam plus quam septem incantationes venti didicisti, adeptus es artem: Affinitas Ventorum!]

unit.source: [Wind Affinity: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) You have a good affinity for the wind. Beings born of the wind will be more favorable to you. The cost of the Wind-type spells and skills is reduced and their power is increased by 0,5% for each skill level.]
unit.target: [Affinitas Ventorum: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivum) Bona affinitas ad ventum tibi competit. Entia ex vento oriunda tibi magis favorabiles erunt. Sumptus incantationum et artium generis venti minuantur, et potentia earum augetur 0,5% pro quolibet gradu artis.]

unit.source: That wasn’t as surprising, but it was still good news.
unit.target: Non tam mirum erat, sed tamen bona nuntia erant.

unit.source: Sam smiled, then went over his new skills, trying to figure out where he would or could use them.
unit.target: Sam subridens deinde novas artes suas examinavit, quaerens ubi eas uti vel adhibere posset.

unit.source: When he started building his skill set, he wasn’t really aiming for wind-type skills, but he couldn’t complain.
unit.target: Cum artem suam instruere coepit, non vere ad artes venti intendebat, sed queri non potuit.

unit.source: It wasn’t the ‘strongest’ element, but, for example, it was the easiest to get a flying spell in this element.
unit.target: Non erat elementum "fortissimum", sed, exempli gratia, facillimum erat incantationem volandi in hoc elemento adipisci.

unit.source: If Sam wanted truly strong spells, without specializing in the element, he would need to delve into the sub-elements.
unit.target: Si Sam incantationes vere validas optaret, sine specialiter in elemento se dedicando, necesse esset in sub-elementa penetrare.

unit.source: Like the Shadows.
unit.target: Sicut umbrae.

unit.source: Shaking his head, he dismissed the screen and reluctantly reached for the scroll that managed to drench the table in glitter.
unit.target: Capite concussus, tabulam nuntiationis abiecit et, invitus, volutum quod mensam in nitore replebat, arripuit.

unit.source: ‘Fricking Fey…’
unit.target: "Maledicti Fey…"

unit.source: Knowing that not opening it would more than likely anger the Fey, he unfurled the scroll with a harsh motion.
unit.target: Sciens quod, si non aperiret, verisimiliter Fey irari posset, volutum cum motu asperso evolvit.

unit.source: [Congratulations, the Fey deemed you worthy of their reward due to your action. We are very sorry!]
unit.target: [Gratulatio, Fey te dignum praemium suum iudicaverunt propter actum tuum. Valde dolemus!]

unit.source: [You gained the skill, Shadow Mirage!]
unit.target: [Artem "Phantasma Umbrarum" adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Shadow Mirage: Level 0/50 (Active) By making use of the Shadows, you are able to create a mirage of yourself near your real body. This mirage will not move, set in the pose as you were at its creation. Leveling up the skill this can be changed, as the mirage learns from its creator. Numbers of Mirages that can be currently created: 1.]
unit.target: [Phantasma Umbrarum: Gradus 0/50 (Activum) Incantatio per qua, utendo umbris, phantasmam tui iuxta corpus verum creare potes. Haec phantasma non movebitur, statu in quo creata fuit servato. Per augenda artem hoc mutari potest, quoniam phantasma ab eius creatore discit. Numerus phantasmatum qui nunc creare possunt: 1.]

unit.source: “Well, this is singularly incredibly awesome, and mostly useless without leveling up…” he murmured, a little in awe.
unit.target: "Heu, hoc est singulariter incredibile, et plerumque inutile, nisi gradus augeas..." murmurat, paulo in admiratione.

unit.source: He knew this skill. In the future that never will be, one of the most famous assassins used this skill to perform countless assassinations on many prominent players, then leaving the scene while people were fighting his mirages.
unit.target: Sciebat hanc artem. In futuro, quod numquam fiet, unus ex clarissimis sicariis hanc artem utebatur ad innumerabiles caedes in pluribus claris lusoribus perficiendas, deinde scenam relinquens dum homines phantasmata eius pugnabant.

unit.source: Dismissing the screen, he threw a disgusted look at the glitter that didn’t vanish when he learned the spell in the scroll and decided it was tomorrow’s Sam’s problem.
unit.target: Dimittens tabulam nuntiationis, aspiciens vultum indignum ad nitorem, qui non evanuit cum incantationem in voluto didiceret, et decrevit id esse problema crastini Sami.

unit.source: Snuggling up to Lucky, he closed his eyes and logged out.
unit.target: Conglutinans Lucky, oculos clausit et sessionem finivit.

unit.source: After logging out, Sam only had the energy to take a quick shower, then quickly fell into his bed.
unit.target: Postquam sessionem clausit, Sam tantum vires habuit ad celerem ablutionem, deinde celeriter in lectum cecidit.

unit.source: Waking up the next day, he did a little housework, a grocery run (there were options to order in, but he wanted to spend at least a little bit of time outside of his apartment), and the usual exercises to keep his body in working condition.
unit.target: Sequenti die evigilans, parva opera domestica peragebat, cibaria emere (quamquam optiones ordinandi erant, sed paulum temporis extra habitationem suam degere volebat), atque exercitia solita ad corpus in bona conditione conservandum.

unit.source: He couldn’t wait until the game got popular enough that they would set the playing hours for everybody because this kind of chaotic living, even with his exercises and healthy food, was taking a toll on his body.
unit.target: Non poterat expectare donec ludus satis popularem redditus esset, ut omnibus horae ludi statuerentur, quoniam talis vita tumultuosa, etiam cum exercitiis et cibo sanato, corpus eius opprimebat.

unit.source: Plopping down in front of his computer, he reluctantly opened the forums for the game as well as several gaming sites that dealt with Magic Unbound, where prominently on the main pages were the posts that celebrated the continuously growing population of the game.
unit.target: Ante computatrum suum se consedens, aversus forum ludi atque plura loca ludicra de Magic Unbound aperuit, ubi in paginis principalibus clare ostendebantur commentarii quae populum ludici in continuo crescere celebrabant.

unit.source: Consequently, the forums were full of posts that cursed the crowded beginner villages as well as the increasing prices due to the demand that so many players made on the system that serviced said villages.
unit.target: Ergo fora plena erant commentariorum maledicentium oppida novicorum congesta, atque pretia crescentia propter exigentiam tot lusorum in systemate, quod illa oppida subministrabat.

unit.source: When Sam read these notes, he had to take a minute to curse as he had planned to set up a simple Merchant company that would provide said goods to these villages and ride the wave of new players.
unit.target: Cum Sam has notas legeret, paulisper obscurare oportuit, quoniam consilium habebat instituendi societatem mercatoriolam simplicem, quae illis oppidis merces suppeditaret et fluctum novorum lusorum sectaret.

unit.source: But now, probably due to his own actions, it was too late.
unit.target: At nunc, fortasse ob suas ipsius actiones, iam sero erat.

unit.source: If the mainstream portals were talking about it, then those who could see the trends were already making money off of it.
unit.target: Si portae principales de ea disserebantur, tunc illi qui inclinationes videre poterant, iam ex ea lucrum faciebant.

unit.source: He would need to focus his efforts somewhere else.
unit.target: Necesse erat eum opera sua alibi impendere.

unit.source: It still felt rather shitty.
unit.target: Adhuc pessime videbatur.

unit.source: In the novels that he had read in his past life, the main character always managed to ride economic waves; always finding the best moment to buy or sell something and here he was, watching as an opportunity vanished in front of him like a fart in the wind.
unit.target: In fabulis quas in vita praeterita legerat, heros principalis semper fluctus oeconomicos navigare potuit; semper optimum momentum aliquid emendi vel vendendi inveniens, et ecce, hic aspexit, ut occasio coram eo evanuerit sicut flatus in vento.

unit.source: Still, it wasn’t the end of the world.
unit.target: Attamen, non erat finis mundi.

unit.source: Exploiting the beginners was one of the things that he planned to use for the creation of his economic foundation in the game, but it wasn’t the only one.
unit.target: Exploitatio novitorum erat una ex rebus, quas consilium retulisset ad fundamentum oeconomicum in ludo constituendum, sed non unica erat.

unit.source: And with how the Silvercrest family quest was going, he suspected that his next several steps would become much easier.
unit.target: Et cum iter familiae Silvercrest procedebat, suspicabatur proximos gradus suos multo facilius futurum esse.

unit.source: The rest of the forums were filled with discussion of every facet of the game, mostly positive, though there was a loud minority who were decrying the complexity and difficulty of the skill system.
unit.target: Reliqua fora plena erant disputatione de omni parte ludi, plerumque positiva, quamquam minoritas strepitosa complexitatem et difficultatem systematis peritiae condemnabat.

unit.source: Though after a cursory look, Sam found that universally the answer to those posts was: ‘git gud noob’.
unit.target: Sed post brevem conspectum, Sam invenit responsum universale in illis commentariis esse: ‘Age melius, ineptule’.

unit.source: He had to agree.
unit.target: Consentire debebat.

unit.source: The skill system of the game wasn’t the easiest, but with a bit of practice and elbow grease, one could learn it without trouble.
unit.target: Systema peritiae ludi non erat facillimum, sed cum parva exercitatione et labore diligenti, id quisque sine difficultate discere poterat.

unit.source: It was the definition of easy to learn, hard to master, once again demonstrating that the developers of the game were thinking in the long term.
unit.target: Id erat exemplum: facile discendum, sed difficile dominandum; iterum ostendebat evolutores ludi in longum tempus cogitare.

unit.source: Of course, there were already videos popping up from experts and experts who were analyzing the emerging economic situation in the game.
unit.target: Certe, iam videa apparuere ex peritis, qui condicionem oeconomicam emergentem in ludo analysabant.

unit.source: Sam checked out a few videos, but he didn’t see anything he didn’t know, so he simply closed them.
unit.target: Sam pauca videa inspiciens, nihilignotum reperit, itaque ea simpliciter clausit.

unit.source: He had better things to do with his time.
unit.target: Meliora erant res ad faciendum tempore suo.

unit.source: Finally, he checked his account on the Shadowland website, but his mailbox was full of people wanting to buy the Life of Blood skill book and other extremely rare, or common skill books that nobody knew where to get.
unit.target: Denique rationem suam in situ Shadowland inspiciens, animadvertit epistularum loculum plenum esse hominum qui librum peritiae "Life of Blood" ac alias peritiae libros, sive rari sive vulgares, emere vellebant, quos nemo sciebat unde compararet.

unit.source: Sam thought about exploiting this and selling a few books for a quick buck, but in the end, he decided it wasn’t worth the risk.
unit.target: Sam de hoc cogitavit ut exploiteret et paucos libros ad celerem lucrum venderet, sed denique decrevit non id periculi esse dignum.

unit.source: He built himself up as a trustworthy and fair information broker and exploiting his customers would only cause him grief in the long term.
unit.target: Se aedificavit ut mercator informationum fidus et iustus, atque abusus clientium suorum ei in longo tempore tantum dolorem afferret.

unit.source: Then, stretching a little, listening as his back popped satisfyingly, he returned to his gaming couch and began the login process.
unit.target: Tum, paulum se extendens, dum audiebat dorsi sonum satisfaciens, rediit ad solium ludi suum et processum conectionis incipiebat.

unit.source: The room he stayed in was still the same as he left it, with only Lucky having moved around while he was logged out, turning around in the bed.
unit.target: Camera in qua mansit adhuc eadem erat quam reliquit, cum solum Lucky, dum sessionem finisset, circa lectum versaretur.

unit.source: This resulted in him ‘waking’ up to a mouthful of the wolf’s tail.
unit.target: Hoc efficit ut evigillarer, accipiendo in ore ictum caudae lupae.

unit.source: Spitting hairs out, he sent a half-hearted glare at the pitifully whining wolf that seemed to be growing at an accelerated pace, already reaching the size of a medium-sized pony.
unit.target: Exspuens, miserabiliterque, misit semiduosum aspectum ad miserrimum lupum querulentem, qui videbatur celeriter crescere, iam ad magnitudinem equi mediocris pervenire.

unit.source: ‘I wonder how big he will get.’ He wondered while he checked his equipment and status screen.
unit.target: ‘Miror, quam magnis fies.’ miratus est, dum instrumenta sua et indicem status examinat.

unit.source: Instead of going downstairs for breakfast, he simply began munching on his rations and began practicing his spells.
unit.target: Pro descendendo ad ientaculum, simpliciter incipiebat cibaria sua manducare et incantationes exercere.

unit.source: “Healing Wind!”
unit.target: “Ventus Sanans!”

unit.source: Calling out, he watched with his senses and Mage Sight as the mana formed into the spell and left his hand; it swirled around Lucky, in a translucent, slightly green-tinged wind, then it sunk into him without any fanfare or effect as the wolf was fully healthy and well-rested.
unit.target: Clamans, sensibus suis et Visu Magico intuens, vidit mana in incantationem coalescere et manum eius relinquere; circa Lucky circumvolavit in vento translucido, paulo viridi tincto, deinde in eum submersum est sine ullo strepitu, cum lupus plene sanus et bene quietus esset.

unit.source: Lucky bore being selected as target practice very well.
unit.target: Lucky valde bene tulit quod electus esset ad exercitationem scopum.

unit.source: Sam repeated it several times, trying to get used to the feeling until he could manage the spell without yelling out its name, earning himself several levels in the spell.
unit.target: Sam id pluries repetivit, conatus assuefacere se sensui, donec incantationem sine nomine exclamare posse constituit, qua plures gradus sibi adeptus est.

unit.source: Finally, he stood in the middle of the room, eyes closed, meditating slightly as the healing winds swirled around him.
unit.target: Denique in medio cellae stetit, oculis clausis, leviter meditans, dum venti sanantes circa eum circumvolitabantur.

unit.source: He kept up with it for a few minutes, but as he felt he was sufficiently familiar with this low-tier spell, he finally let up with the casting and watched as the last of the greenish wind sunk into his body.
unit.target: Hoc per paucos minutos secutus est, sed quoniam sensit se incantationis huius inferioris gradu satis notum habere, tandem incantandi cessavit et observavit ut ultimus ventus viridulo in corpus eius infunderetur.

unit.source: Letting out a satisfied smile, as healing spells if you weren’t specialized in them, were rather rare in lower levels.
unit.target: Satis laetitia efferens, cum incantationes sanantes, nisi in eis specialiter instructus, in gradibus inferioribus rarae erant.

unit.source: Using Healing Wind, he now had a few opportunities to acquire even stronger spells.
unit.target: Per Ventum Sanantem, nunc aliquot occasiones habebat ad incantationes fortiores adipisci.

unit.source: Then he turned his attention towards one of the other spells he had just gained thanks to completing the sub-quest.
unit.target: Tum sensum suum attulit ad unam ex aliis incantationibus, quam nuper ex subquaestionis expletis adeptus erat.

unit.source: Taking up a silly pose, leaning slightly back, head tilted down, arms crossed in front of him and his finger formed into random gang symbols, exclaimed.
unit.target: Statu inepto assumpto, paululum recuens, capite deorsum inclinato, brachiis ante se transpositis, et digito in figuras fortuitas coetus replicandas formans, exclamat.

unit.source: “Shadow Mirage!”
unit.target: “Illusio Umbrarum!”

unit.source: There was a brief burst of mana moving around in his body then it was expelled and formed into first a copy of him out of shadows then a fraction of a second later that shadow gained definition and color and thus there were two of him standing in the room in a silly pose.
unit.target: Brevis effusio manae per corpus eius circumacta est; deinde expulsa, primum exemplar eius ex umbris constitutum, deinde paulo post, illa umbra definitionem et colorem accepit, ita ut duo eius in cella in inepto habitu stanterent.

unit.source: Chuckling slightly, he let go of the pose and began walking around the Mirage as it kept standing there, still as a rock.
unit.target: Exrisus leviter, deposuit statum ineptum et circum Illusio ambulare coepit, dum illa ibi stabat immota sicut saxa.

unit.source: The replicated detail on the mirage was amazing, as he could see individual hairs on his arms, but the stillness was still annoying.
unit.target: Detalii replicati in illusione prodigiosi erant, cum capillos singulos in brachiis videre posset, sed tamen immobilitas vexabat.

unit.source: Although he knew that with enough practice with the skill, they would soon learn (that is, the game system would learn their behavior pattern and fighting style) and would begin to move.
unit.target: Quamquam sciebat, cum satis exercitationis peritiae adsisset, cito didicerent (id est, systema ludi mores ac rationem certandi percepisset) et movere inciperent.

unit.source: But for now, it would be enough to play with the mind of any enemy he came across.
unit.target: Sed nunc, satis erat ut mente cuiusque hostis, quem obveniret, ludere posset.

unit.source: He reached out and tried to touch the mirage but his hand went through the spell and not a moment later the entire thing burst into motes of sparkling mana and shadows, falling to the ground and vanishing entirely.
unit.target: Manum protendit et illud illusorium tangere temptavit, sed manus eius per incantationem transiit, et paulo post totum in micantes particulas manae et umbrarum dissolutum est, in terram cecidens atque penitus evanuit.

unit.source: Nodding to himself, he spent a few minutes memorizing how the spell worked so as not to have to yell the names of the spells, then turned towards Lucky.
unit.target: Se iactans, paucos minutos didicit quomodo incantatio operaretur, ut nomen incantationum non clamaret, deinde ad Lucky se vertit.

unit.source: Sam got on his knees, hugged the wolf to himself, and began murmuring.
unit.target: Sam genua flectit, lupum se complexus est, et submurmuravit.

unit.source: “Okay, Lucky. This is important, so pay attention! I want you…”
unit.target: “Bene, Lucky. Hoc est grave, ergo attende! Te volo…”

unit.source: Heading towards the Silvercrest Manor, dressed in his adventurer clothes, forgoing his Sunday’s best, because he fully expected that one way or another this entire thing would end in a fight, Sam watched with a satisfied smile as the entire city was in a tizzy.
unit.target: Dirigens ad Silvercrest Manerium, indutus vestimentis exploratoris suae, optimas vestes dominicas omittens, quoniam plene exspectabat rem istam in pugnam ducendam esse, Sam cum risu contento spectabat, dum tota urbs in tumultu versabatur.

unit.source: Harried guards walked around, paranoidly looking at everybody, even at each other.
unit.target: Custodes solliciti circumambulabant, omnes spectantes, etiam inter se.

unit.source: Players belonging to guilds were doing the same thing, deadeye-ing people from other guilds, and fights could be seen breaking out everywhere, causing the already agitated guards to become even more stressed.
unit.target: Lusores, qui ad collegia pertinebant, idem agebant, homines ex aliis collegiis intuentes, et pugnae ubique eruptae videbantur, quo custodes iam excitati etiam magis solliciti fierent.

unit.source: Apparently, his little distraction worked really well…
unit.target: Apparuit parva distractione eius vere optime processisse…

unit.source: Cutting through the last alley before approaching the manor directly, he made eye contact with one of the urchins and gave them a small thumbs up.
unit.target: Perveniens per ultimam angustum viam, antequam manerium directe appropinquaret, oculos contulit cum uno ex vagis pueris et parvum digitum levatum dedit.

unit.source: The smile he received in return sent shivers down his spine.
unit.target: Risus reciprocus quem accepit, tremores per dorsum eius intulit.

unit.source: ‘Why do I do this to myself?’ he lamented, continuing his journey.
unit.target: ‘Cur hoc mihi facio?’ lamentatus est, iter suum continuans.

unit.source: Arriving in front of the manor, he was about to announce himself, but the gates immediately opened and one of the guards stepped out for a moment, looked around nervously, and then bade him to follow him with a respectful nod.
unit.target: Ad manerium perveniens, se praedicere paratus erat, sed portae statim apertae sunt et unus ex custodibus paulisper exiit, circumspiciens anxie, deinde ei signum dedit ut sequeretur, cum capite reverenter inclinato.

unit.source: Sam said nothing, just followed him.
unit.target: Sam nihil dixit; tantum eum secutus est.

unit.source: Inside, he was met by a familiar butler.
unit.target: Intus eum occurrit minister domesticus cognitus.

unit.source: “Greetings, good sir. I hope you returned with excellent news!”
unit.target: “Salve, bone vir. Spero te rediisse cum nuntiis praeclaris!”

unit.source: The man’s voice was the patented, even butler voice, but Sam could still hear the undercurrent of worry.
unit.target: Vox viri erat exemplar ministerii domestici, sed Sam tamen subsonum sollicitudinis audire poterat.

unit.source: He gave him a smile and a nod.
unit.target: Ei risum dedit atque caput inclinavit.

unit.source: “Indeed. I got the item.”
unit.target: “Certe, rem adeptus sum.”

unit.source: The butler let out a relieved sigh, and Sam could hear the nearby guards doing the same thing.
unit.target: Minister domesticus leviter suspiravit, et Sam audire potuit custodes proximos idem facere.

unit.source: Apparently, they were rather loyal. ‘Or good actors…’
unit.target: Apparuit eos esse fidelissimos. ‘Vel boni histriones…’

unit.source: “Follow me, then, Sir,” came the clipped reply from the older man.
unit.target: “Sequere me, domine,” venit brevis responsum a viro seniore.

unit.source: He turned elegantly on his heels and began marching towards the manor proper with a pep in his steps.
unit.target: Eleganter in pedibus versatus, se vertit et ad manerium proprium cum vivacitate in passibus incedere coepit.

unit.source: Sam followed him, one hand on his sword and his senses strained to the maximum.
unit.target: Sam eum secutus est, una manu gladio suo tenens, et sensibus suis ad summum excitatis.

unit.source: It was the best time to ambush them…
unit.target: Optimum tempus erat ut eos insidiarentur…

unit.source: Surprisingly, nobody attacked them on the way to the garden where he had his talk with Lord Silvercrest not so long ago.
unit.target: Mirum, nemo eos oppugnare conatus est in via ad hortum, in quo non multo tempore cum Domino Silvercrest colloquium habuerat.

unit.source: Arriving at the well-taken-care-of garden, he immediately understood why the butler took him there.
unit.target: Ad hortum bene curatum perveniens, statim intellexit cur minister domesticus eum illuc duxisset.

unit.source: Where before pristine grass delighted those who visited the manor, now it was covered by a giant slab of thin rock.
unit.target: Ubi ante herba purissima eos qui manerium visitabant delectabat, nunc ingenti lamina tenuis lapidis operiebatur.

unit.source: Carved into the rock were runes, some he recognized, some he didn’t.
unit.target: In lapide incisi erant runae, quarum nonnullas agnoscit, alias non.

unit.source: The runes were in a circle, and inside the circle was a triangle.
unit.target: Runae in circulo erant, et intra circulum triangulum constitutum erat.

unit.source: And the points of the triangle stood three things.
unit.target: Et in verticibus trianguli stabant tres res.

unit.source: The nearest to him contained a small stone plinth, also carved with runic symbols, obviously the intended place of the chalice.
unit.target: Proximum ad eum continebat parvum plinthum lapideum, quo etiam runae incisae erant, manifestum loco calicem destinatum esse.

unit.source: The farthest from him was occupied with a distinguished gentleman in high-quality robes, leaning on a staff that seemed to be radiating magic and perusing a leather-bound notebook with great interest.
unit.target: Eum remotissimum occupabat vir distinguendus, indutus vestimentis praestantissimis, innixus baculo, qui magicam radiare videbatur, et commentarium coriaceum magno studio perlegebat.

unit.source: On the last point was a very simple divan, basically a slab of wood with minimal upholstery and four legs.
unit.target: In ultimo vertice stabat divanus simplex, constitutus ex laminis ligneis cum pauca ornamenta et quattuor cruribus.

unit.source: On it laid the lady of the house, deathly pale, and Sam could see the beads of sweat flowing down her face.
unit.target: Super illum iacebat domina domus, mortu pallidissima, et Sam globulos sudoris e facie eius fluentes videre poterat.

unit.source: The moment he stepped into the garden, every eye in the vicinity was directed at him, including the Lord’s.
unit.target: Statim, cum in hortum intravit, omnes oculi in vicinia ad eum directi erant, etiam Domini.

unit.source: “Adventurer!” came the excited yell, but Sam could see that the Lord was just trying to keep up the façade as his eyes always kept darting at his wife.
unit.target: “Advenator!” inquit voce excitata, sed Sam animadvertit Dominum tantum speciem retinere conari, nam oculi eius semper ad uxorem eius versa erant.

unit.source: “I hope you returned bringing great news!”
unit.target: “Spero te rediisse cum nuntiis praeclaris!”

unit.source: Instead of replying, Sam just reached inside his inventory and retrieved the Chalice of Restraint.
unit.target: Sam, potius quam respondens, intra repositum suum accessit et Calicem Continentiae extraxit.

unit.source: There were multiple gasps of surprise, predominantly from the wizard at the runic circle and another happy one from Lord Silvercrest.
unit.target: Plura suspiria admirationis fiebant, praesertim a mago iuxta circulum runarum, atque alia laeta a Domino Silvercrest.

unit.source: “Ha ha ha! Yes! Most excellent, my friend!”
unit.target: “Ha ha ha! Ita! Praestantissimum, amice!”

unit.source: Taking several giant steps the large man arrived next to Sam and gently took the Chalice from him, holding it in his giant hand gently, and with great care walked it over to the wizard who accepted the artifact with the same care, placing it on the plinth.
unit.target: Vir magnus, compluribus ingentibus passibus, ad Sam accessit et leniter Calicem ab eo abstulit, eam in manu gigantea tenerens, et cum summa cura ad magum perrexit, qui artificium eodem modo accepit, super plinthum deposuit.

unit.source: “Let us commence the ritual!”
unit.target: “Ritualem incipiamus!”

unit.source: The wizard silently nodded, and the runic circle instantly lit up.
unit.target: Magus tacite annuit, et circulus runarum statim illuminatus est.

unit.source: Then the plinth and the Chalice of Restraint began to blaze with very familiar white flames.
unit.target: Tum plinthus et Calix Continentiae incipiebant ardere cum ignibus albis, notis valde familiaribus.

unit.source: Following that, a dome of blue sprung up around the ritual while everybody else watched with bated breath.
unit.target: Postea, domus caerulea circa ritum erupit, dum omnes alii, spiritu retento, spectabant.

unit.source: Sam stepped up to the Lord, whose eyes were glued to his wife’s slumped form.
unit.target: Sam accessit ad Dominum, cuius oculi ad formam prostratam uxoris eius fixi erant.

unit.source: “Are you expecting an attack, sir?”
unit.target: “An impetum exspectas, domine?”

unit.source: The Lord answered without moving his eyes.
unit.target: Dominus respondit, oculos non mutans.

unit.source: “Indeed, my young friend. I even sent my daughter away with a trusted friend.”
unit.target: “Certe, mi iuvenis amice. Etiam filiam meam cum amico fideli misi.”

unit.source: “Good, then I don’t have to convince you to prepare for one.”
unit.target: “Bene, ergo non oportet me te persuadere ut ad impetum praeparas.”

unit.source: The older man chuckled a little and sent him a small smirk.
unit.target: Vir senior parum subridens ei parvum signum dedit.

unit.source: “Fret not, my friend. I know very well what my enemies are capable of!”
unit.target: “Noli sollicitari, mi amice. Bene scio quid hostes mei efficere possint!”

unit.source: Sam nodded, then refocused on his senses.
unit.target: Sam annuit, deinde sensibus suis iterum intendens.

unit.source: His first target was the ritual, curious about it.
unit.target: Prima meta eius erat ritus, de quo curiosus erat.

unit.source: However, it seemed that it was rather simple.
unit.target: Attamen, videbatur satis simplex esse.

unit.source: The wizard was directing with the help of the runic circle the magic of a minor ley line into the chalice and then would probably use that to extract the parasite from the lady of the house.
unit.target: Magus, adiuvatus circulo runarum, magiam ex parva linea arcana in calicem directabat, atque deinde id probabiliter ad extrahendum parasitum ex domina domus adhiberet.

unit.source: He made sure to take a look at the runes (after toggling the recording software on with a small movement of his fingers) for later study, then directed his senses towards the walls of the manor as that was the easiest point of entry.
unit.target: Curo est ut runas inspiceret (post parvum motum digitorum suorum, programmatum recordationis activatum) ad studium ulterius, deinde sensus suos versus muros manerii direxit, quod erat facillimum ingressus punctum.

unit.source: He didn’t have to look long.
unit.target: Non diutius inspicere necesse fuit.

unit.source: The moment his senses went further than the wall, he sensed the build-up of foreign mana.
unit.target: Momento quo sensus eius ultra muros pervenerunt, cumulatum mana alienum sensit.

unit.source: Sighing audibly, he unsheathed his blade, ignored the tensing guards standing around, as well as the fearful maids, and turned towards the wall.
unit.target: Suspirans audibiliter, gladium extraxit, custodum vigiles circumstantium nec non ancillas timidas neglexit, et versus murum se vertit.

unit.source: “What are you doin–” came the question from the Lord, but he was silenced by a loud yell and the sound of something shattering. Probably the defenses of the manor.
unit.target: “Quid facis–” inquit Dominus, sed ille a voce alta et strepitu rei discidentis silentus factus est. Probabiliter defensiones manerii.

unit.source: “ATTACK!”
unit.target: «IMPUGNATE!»

unit.source: Before anyone could react Sam beaned the first attacker jumping over the wall in the head with a well timed Wind Bullet which caused everyone to freeze for a moment as they watched the man tumble to the ground, where he lay, still.
unit.target: Priusquam quisquam reagere posset, Sam primum oppugnatorem, qui super murum insiliens, in capite percussit acerto Proiectili Venti, quo omnes paulisper immobiles facti sunt, dum vir ad terram lapsus, ubi immotus iacebat, spectabant.

unit.source: Then, as one, everyone began moving, and it was chaos.
unit.target: Tum omnes simul movere coeperunt, et chaos praevaluit.

unit.source: For a long moment, as Sam beheld the multitude of enemies scaling the wall in different ways, jumping, climbing or, in one case, gliding over it, he got scared.
unit.target: Diuturno tempore, dum Sam multitudinem hostium spectabat murum variis modis ascendere—saltantibus, scandentibus, aut, in uno casu, planatim transvolantibus—territus est.

unit.source: Not of the enemies.
unit.target: Non hostium.

unit.source: He had already managed to beat it into his head that it was a game and not real, but instead, he got scared of himself.
unit.target: Iam se convincerat id ludum esse, non rem veram; sed proinde se ipsum metu affectum esse sensit.

unit.source: Because, the moment he saw the enemies, all he felt was elation.
unit.target: Nam, momento quo hostes aspexit, totum quod sensit, exsultatio erat.

unit.source: Elation about finally fighting beings smarter than rocks.
unit.target: Exsultatio erat de tandem pugnando contra creaturas sapientioribus quam lapides.

unit.source: Beings that could challenge him.
unit.target: Creaturae quae eum provocare poterant.

unit.source: Beat him even (not that he wanted that)…
unit.target: Eum etiam superare (non enim hoc optabat)…

unit.source: It scared him a little how much the game changed him.
unit.target: Eum paulum terruit, quantum ludus eum mutaverit.

unit.source: How much this opportunity that fell into his lap changed him.
unit.target: Quantum haec occasio, quae in sinu eius cecidit, eum mutaverit.

unit.source: Then he had to stop the introspection as he was beset by several mooks for the lack of a better word.
unit.target: Tum introspectionem relinquere debuit, cum ab pluribus ministris ignobilibus (verbo meliore deficiente) oppressus esset.

unit.source: They were indistinguishable from each other, wearing black, all‑body concealing clothing, only a few of them having a few spikes on their shoulders that set them aside from the others.
unit.target: Inter se non distinguibiles erant, vestimenta nigra gerentes quae totum corpus tegebant, solum pauci ex eis in umeris aculeos habebant, qui eos a reliquis distinguebant.

unit.source: Sam instantly pegged them as team leaders, because his Mana Sight told him they had a marginally bigger amount of mana than the regular mooks.
unit.target: Sam statim eos duces esse reputavit, quoniam Vis Arcanae eius indicavit eos paululum maiorem vim arcanae habere quam ministri ordinarii.

unit.source: Then there were the players.
unit.target: Deinde erant lusores.

unit.source: Of course, they were smart enough to dress up the same as the mooks currently menacing the guards while the maids crowded next to the wall of the manor, clutching their hands and trying to keep quiet and out of the way, but to Sam, it was obvious who they were.
unit.target: Scilicet, callidi satis erant ut eandem vestem induerent, quales mooks, qui nunc custodes minabant, induti essent, dum ancillae iuxta murum manerii congregabant, manus prehendentes et silentium servare conantes; sed Sam illos esse perspicuum habebat.

unit.source: Their mana was unique for every one of them, showing that it was made from several distinct parts, telling Sam that they probably didn’t bother to harmonize their skills and spells.
unit.target: Vis arcana eorum unice in singulis apparuit, ostendens eam ex pluribus partibus distinctis compositam esse, quae Sam indicabat eos verisimiliter non curavisse artes et incantationes suas harmonizare.

unit.source: ‘Probably went for what is cool…’ He scoffed a little, then for a second watched as all the players, without saying a word, began circling the lord of the manor, who was already beset by several mooks.
unit.target: ‘Forsitan optaverunt id quod mirabile videbatur…’ leviter irridens, deinde per momentum observavit omnes lusores, sine verbo, dominum manerii circuitantes, qui a pluribus mooks iam oppresserat.

unit.source: “Haha! You think you can defeat ME?” came the boisterous laugh as the man somehow conjured giant metal gauntlets on his equally gigantic fist and punched them together.
unit.target: “Haha! Existimasne te ME vincere posse?” exclamavit, dum ille nonnullo modo ingentes gauntulas metallorum super pugno suo convocavit et inter se pulsavit.

unit.source: “COME AND SEE!” He roared, but before he could launch himself at the enemy, Sam decided to call out to him.
unit.target: “Veni et vide!” fremuit, sed priusquam in hostem se propellet, Sam eum vocare constituit.

unit.source: “Go for the spikes! They’re the leaders!”
unit.target: “Ad aculeos age! Illi duces sunt!”

unit.source: He saw the mooks visibly flinch at that, and the lord just laughed, ignored the nearest minion that he was originally targeting and jumped towards one of the attackers wearing spikes on his shoulder.
unit.target: Vidit mooks palam pallere, et dominus rideo, proximum ministrum quem primo destinaverat neglexit, et in unum ex aggressoribus, qui aculeos in umero gerebat, saltavit.

unit.source: Unfortunately, Sam didn’t have much time to observe Lord Silvercrest’s fight because several enemy attackers and one of the players (standing in the back) began to menace him.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Sam non multum temporis habuit ad bellum Domini Silvercrest contemplandum, quia quidam hostium aggressores et unus lusorum (in tergo stans) eum minari coeperunt.

unit.source: He gave them a smile, his sword ready for the fight, and made a ‘come here’ motion with his free hand.
unit.target: Illis subridens, gladium ad pugnam paratum habens, cum manu libera motum “veni huc” effecit.

unit.source: The nameless mooks remained silent, but he heard the players scoff.
unit.target: Mooks innominati silentium retinuerunt, sed audivit lusores irridere.

unit.source: Sam smiled and deflected a clean strike, aiming for his jugular, then sidestepped another aiming for his heart, then simply took another back, pivoting and striking at one of the black‑clad minions that were surrounding him.
unit.target: Sam subridens ictum purum deflexit, in jugulum intendens; deinde alium transiecit, in cor petens; et postea retro celeriter se movit, vertebatque et in unum ex ministris nigro vestiti, qui eum circumdederant, percussit.

unit.source: Sadly, they didn’t do the usual evil minion thing of attacking one at a time, so he had to pay a lot of attention to where they were aiming.
unit.target: Tristiter, non secutae sunt consuetudines maleficae ministrorum unius post alium oppugnandi, ita ut ei multum attendendum esset quo intendebantur.

unit.source: Ignoring the crashes in the background as the loud lord of the manor rampaged around and as the guards yelled and grunted while fighting the fodder, he danced between the blades of his enemy, keeping one eye on them and another on the player that seemed to be positioning himself for a one‑strike kill.
unit.target: Neglegens ruinas in fundo, dum altus dominus manerii strepitabat et custodes clamabant, pabulum pugnantes, inter laminas hostis saltavit, unum oculum in eos spectans et alterum in lusorem, qui se ad ictum mortiferum parare videbatur, intendens.

unit.source: Parry, step, parry, pivot, jump a little, step forward, slash and turn, and so on, and on and on…
unit.target: Parry, passus, parry, verti, paulum sali, in antegradum progrediere, caedere et convertere, et ita pergit…

unit.source: Sam could have broken out his spells, but for some reason, the minions were only using weapons and he wanted to know why.
unit.target: Sam incantationes suas pronuntare poterat, sed, quocumque causa, ministri solum arma utebantur; idque scire cupiebat.

unit.source: Oddly, he couldn’t sense anything with his Mana Sense.
unit.target: Mirum quidem, nihil per Sensus Vis Arcanae sentire poterat.

unit.source: ‘Maybe they didn’t want to attract the attention of the rest of the city?’ he wondered as idly sidestepped a strike, continuing the motion of his sword, and lopped the head off of the minion that overextended himself.
unit.target: ‘Forsitan noluerunt reliquae urbis attentionem attrahere?’ mirabatur, dum leviter ictum vitabat, gladium in motu perseverans, et caput ministri, qui se nimis extulerat, abscidit.

unit.source: “One down,” he spoke, hoping to get some reaction from the mooks.
unit.target: “Unus deiectus,” inquit, sperans aliquam reactionem ab illis accipere.

unit.source: But while he could see slight tensing of their bodies, they didn’t react.
unit.target: Sed, quamquam levem tensionem corporum eorum intuari poterat, non responserunt.

unit.source: There was some kind of explosion behind his back, some boisterous laughter, and with a small smile, Sam continued.
unit.target: Explosio aliqua in tergo facta est, et risus strepitosus audiebatur, et cum parvo subridente, Sam pergebat.

unit.source: “My apologies. Seven down.”
unit.target: “Mea culpa. Septem deiecti sunt.”

unit.source: One of the black‑clad mooks raised their dagger, an ugly and dangerous‑looking thing with hooks and teeth everywhere, and suddenly it was bathed in a black light that felt very familiar to Sam.
unit.target: Unus e mooks nigro vestitis gladium sublevavit, rem turpem et periculosam, uncinis et dentibus ubique ornatam, et subito in lucem nigrum, quae Sam nota videbatur, immersum est.

unit.source: ‘So, they were responsible for this…’
unit.target: ‘Ita, ipsi hoc causa erant…’

unit.source: He didn’t wait for his enemy to do anything with that black light, knowing how insidious it was, and with a quick movement, slashed with his sword several times, combining Mana Slash and Wind Flurry several times, aimed at the probable man with the freaky dagger.
unit.target: Non exspectavit hostem quidquid cum illa luce nigra faceret, sciens quam perfida esset, et celeriter gladium suum pluries ictu percusso, coniungens Mana Slash et Wind Flurry, verisimilem virum cum gladium insolitum intendens.

unit.source: Before the rest of them could react, the extremely fast attack crashed into a barrier made of the same light that enveloped the dagger previously.
unit.target: Antequam reliqui responderent, immodicus et celerissimus ictus in obex ex eadem luce, quae gladium prius involverat, concurrit.

unit.source: The two forces fought against each other, but in the end, Sam was Sam and his enemy was a mook.
unit.target: Duae vires inter se certaverunt, sed in fine, Sam erat Sam, et hostis eius erat unus ex ministris ignobilibus.

unit.source: The barrier shattered and the upper body of the assailant fell apart, cut into apple‑sized chunks.
unit.target: Obex confractus est, et corpus superius oppugnatoris in fragmenta, magnitudine malorum, divisum est.

unit.source: He had time to grimace and chastise himself for being needlessly gruesome before the rest of the mooks, visibly angry at the death of their comrade, fell on him, their weapons in the process of being enveloped by the cloying miasma that Sam was beginning to hate.
unit.target: Tempus habuit ut vultum contraxisset et se reprehendisset ob inutile crudelitatem, antequam reliqui mooks, palam irati propter sodalis mortem, in eum incidissent, armis suis in miasma suffocante involventibus.

unit.source: ‘I’m totally getting a purifying skill after this…’
unit.target: ‘Post hoc, certe artem purificantem adipiscar…’

unit.source: He increased the mana flowing into his Mana Shield, then began to deflect the attacks coming.
unit.target: Auguit vim arcanae in suo Scuto Arcana, deinde impetus instantes deflectere coepit.

unit.source: Then he felt a sudden pulse of mana.
unit.target: Tum repente impetum vis arcanae sensit.

unit.source: The mooks around him froze, and the player in the back exclaimed.
unit.target: Mooks, qui eum circumiacabantur, congelaverunt, et lusor in tergo exclamavit.

unit.source: “Dark Bullet: Extreme Strength!”
unit.target: “Telum Obscurum: Robur Extremum!”

unit.source: In front of their outstretched hand was a globe of dark energy, partly made of miasma, and partly from what seemed liquid darkness.
unit.target: Ante manum eorum extensam erat globus energiae obscurae, partim ex miasma confectus, et partim ex eo quod tenebra liquida videbatur.

unit.source: It hung there for a millisecond, and then it was launched directly at Sam and the mooks surrounding him.
unit.target: Illic per brevissimum tempus manebat, deinde directe in Sam et in mooks circum eum missum est.

unit.source: Sam barely had a second to react.
unit.target: Sam vix momentum habuit ut reagere posset.

unit.source: “Wind Jump!”
unit.target: “Saltus Ventorum!”

unit.source: He was just fast enough that the rapidly approaching (and expanding) ball of eldritch energy barely brushed the bottom of his feet, smashing apart the top layer of his mana shield before slamming into the ground and exploding with extreme speed.
unit.target: Erat tam velox ut globus, celeriter appropinquans et expandens energiae arcanae, vix limen pedum eius attingeret, superiorem laminae scuti arcani diruens, antequam in terram iactus et cum extrema celeritate explodiret.

unit.source: The mooks didn’t even have time to scream before they were consumed.
unit.target: Mooks vix tempus habuerunt ad clamandum, antequam devorati essent.

unit.source: ‘Thank god for Flow…’
unit.target: Deo gratias pro Flow.

unit.source: Sending a prayer to RNGods for giving him the skill, he watched as the player was enveloped with the miasma, and his hand lit up again, though thankfully this time the ball was much smaller.
unit.target: Precatum ad RNGods mittens, qui ei hanc facultatem dederat, observavit sicut lusor in miasma involutus est, et manus eius iterum lucebat, quamvis hoc tempore globus multo minor esset.

unit.source: “Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet!”
unit.target: “Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum!”

unit.source: Three bullets were launched at him, and seeing as he was still in the air he simply raised his sword and once again slashed many times, sending a wind‑enhanced storm of flurry against the approaching projectiles at the same moment he reached the apex of his jump.
unit.target: Tria tela in eum iaciebantur, et videns se adhuc in aere esse, gladium suum levavit atque iterum pluries caedens, turbine venti amplificata procella flurry contra appropinquantia projectilia iaciens, eodem momento quo in apicem saltus pervenit.

unit.source: The moment the storm of wind reached the bullet, the two attacks clashed, and the storm chewed up the dark magic like a certain worm eating the sand of a certain planet.
unit.target: Mox, cum tempestas venti telum attigeret, duo impetus concurrerunt, et tempestas obscuram magiam masticavit, velut vermis arenam ex certo planeta edens.

unit.source: And because he barely put any power into it, the spell dissipated before it could reach the player.
unit.target: Et quia vix aliquam vim illi intulit, incantatio evanuit antequam ad lusorem pervenire posset.

unit.source: Visibly angry, the man began to fire more and more bullets of dark magic as the miasma began to grow around.
unit.target: Vir manifeste iratus coepit plura tela magiae obscurae iacere, cum miasma circa eum crescit.

unit.source: As he began to fall, he glanced around, taking in the situation.
unit.target: Dum cadere incipiebat, circumspiciebat et rem contemplabatur.

unit.source: Lord Silvercrest (he really needed to learn his first name) was currently fighting against three players also bathed in the dark miasma, while several mooks with spikes on their clothing were taking potshots at the man.
unit.target: Dominus Silvercrest (primum nomen eius discendum erat) nunc contra tres lusores, qui quoque in miasma obscurum immersi erant, pugnabat, dum plures mooks, aculeos in vestimentis gerentes, impetum in hominem iacebant.

unit.source: The ritual was still ongoing, though the wizard was visibly straining based on the beads of sweat running down his face.
unit.target: Ritus adhuc celebrabatur, quamquam magus palam sudore guttulis a facie eius fluentibus laborabat.

unit.source: The lady of the house was alive but seemed to writhe as black smoke seemed to be rising from her body.
unit.target: Domina domus viva erat, sed videbatur contorta, cum niger fumus e corpore eius surgere videbatur.

unit.source: He landed on his feet, not far from the small crater left behind by the overpowered attack, and sent another flurry of wind blades, canceling the continuously increasing amount of Dark Bullets.
unit.target: In pedes descendit, non procul a parvo cratere relicto post ictum potentissimum, et aliam procellam laminarum venti misit, quantitatem telorum obscurorum continue crescentem evellens.

unit.source: Eyeing the other man, he waited until he began to chant again.
unit.target: Alium hominem intueri, exspectavit donec iterum incantare coepit.

unit.source: “Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet! DARK BULLET!”
unit.target: “Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum! TELUM OBSCURUM!”

unit.source: And launched his own Wind Bullet with a soft whisper.
unit.target: Et suum Telum Venti, cum tenuissimo susurro, iacuit.

unit.source: While he didn’t know how to cast the spell without the verbal trigger, there was no need to yell like the idiot in front of him.
unit.target: Cum nesciret quomodo incantationem sine verbo activante evocaret, non necessarium erat clamare sicut stulte coram eo.

unit.source: “Wind Bullet.”
unit.target: “Telum Venti.”

unit.source: “DARK BULLET! DARK BULLET! DARK BULL-”
unit.target: “TELUM OBSCURUM! TELUM OBSCURUM! TELUM OBSCU-”

unit.source: The bullet of wind struck the other man’s barrier, disrupting his casting and causing the dozen small balls of corrupting darkness in front of him to dissipate with an oddly disappointed hiss.
unit.target: Telum venti obex alterius hominis percussit, incantationem eius interrumpens atque duodecim parvas globulos corruptae tenebris ante eum dissipatos faciens, cum sibilo insolito decepto.

unit.source: Though he wasn’t hurt, the man became very angry.
unit.target: Etsi non laesus erat, vir valde iratus factus est.

unit.source: “What the hell?! Why won’t you die? I did all of…” he visibly swallowed his last words but it was enough for Sam.
unit.target: “Quid di immortales?! Cur non morieris? Omnia feci…” inquit, ultima verba palam subtrahens, sed id Sam satis videbatur.

unit.source: His enemy obviously completed some kind of quest to gain this kind of power.
unit.target: Hostis eius perspicue aliquam quaestionem perfecit ad talem potentiam adipiscendam.

unit.source: Dark magic wasn’t exactly uncommon, but it was considered one of the ‘evil magics’ in the world of Magic Unbound that required rather specific sacrifices to upgrade.
unit.target: Magia obscura non ita rara erat, sed inter “magias malas” in mundo Magic Unbound habita est, quae sacrificia specialia requirebat ad meliorationem.

unit.source: In exchange, it granted rather potent powers even at the beginning.
unit.target: Pro illis, etiam initio, potentissimas virtutes largiebatur.

unit.source: Which he didn’t see in the opponent before him.
unit.target: Quae ipse in adversario coram se non observabat.

unit.source: However, as he observed the man, it seemed that he also came to a decision.
unit.target: Tamen, dum hominem observabat, videbatur etiam consilium cepisse.

unit.source: “It seems I have to use my full power!”
unit.target: “Videtur mihi totam vim meam adhibere oportere!”

unit.source: Physically cringing at the man, he primed his own spell, then launched several Wind Flurries mixed with Mana Slashes at the man.
unit.target: Physice contritus, gladium suum cum vis arcana involvens, et deinde plures Turbina Ventorum cum Mana Slash mixtos in hominem iacuit.

unit.source: This time, at maximum power. It was high time to finish it.
unit.target: Hoc tempore, ad maximum impetum; tempus erat id finire.

unit.source: To his disappointment, the moment his spell reached the man, it crashed into the dark barrier and gave his opponent enough time for a yell.
unit.target: Ad eius delusionem, mox incantatio eius ad hominem perveniens in obex obscurum concurrit, et adversario satis tempus dedit ut clamaret.

unit.source: “Dark Shroud!”
unit.target: “Tegmen Obscurum!”

unit.source: The miasma enveloping the man intensified enough that Sam could feel and see the waves of black mana radiating from the man.
unit.target: Miasma, quod hominem involverat, ita intensum factum est ut Sam fluctus vis arcanae nigrae, a viro radiantes, sentire et videre possent.

unit.source: “Now take THIS!”
unit.target: “Nunc accipe hoc!”

unit.source: “Dark Beam!”
unit.target: “Radius Obscurus!”

unit.source: The moment he heard the man speak, he crouched down and slammed his hand down on the ground, creating an Earth Wall.
unit.target: In momento quo vir loqui audivit, se incurvatum fecerit et manum in terram dejecit, murum terrae creando.

unit.source: The beam crashed into it and Sam had to fight continuously against the corrosive black mana that seemed intent on eating away his mana.
unit.target: Radius incidit in murum, et Sam continenter pugnare oportuit contra corrosivam vim arcanae nigrae, quae manifeste vellebatur manum eius consumere.

unit.source: But thanks to his Mana Disruption, the freaky mana that seemed to destroy anything it came in contact with couldn’t get a hold of his wall of reinforced earth.
unit.target: Sed gratias Disruptione Vis Arcanae eius, vis arcana insueta, quae quicquid attingebat deleere videbatur, murum terrae roboratae eius capere non potuit.

unit.source: After several seconds of intense bombardment, the beam let up, and despite the fight going on around them, Sam could hear the aggravated breathing of his opponent.
unit.target: Post aliquot secundas intenses bombardationis, radius cessavit, et, quamquam pugnatum circa eos continuabat, Sam audire potuit aggravatam respirationem hostis sui.

unit.source: “WHY! WON’T! YOU! DIE!” came the almost incoherent yelling, but Sam ignored it.
unit.target: “CUR! NON! MORI! VELIS!” exclamabant, sed Sam id neglexit.

unit.source: Carefully encasing his blade with Mana, and after a soft whisper with Wind Edge, he spoke two words.
unit.target: Cautissime gladium suum cum vis arcana involvens, et post mollissimum susurro cum Wind Edge, duas verba locutus est.

unit.source: “Shadow Burst!”
unit.target: “Exruptio Umbrae!”

unit.source: With the increased speed, he had time to jump away from his cover as another beam, twice the size of the previous one, slammed into the location he was at, obliterating everything in its path, while he winced at the feeling as the dark mana pulsing from the enemy player increased once again.
unit.target: Cum velocitate aucta, tempus habuit ut a tegmine se abstraheret, dum alter radius, duplo magnitudine praecedenti, in locum, ubi erat, incidens, cuncta in semita sua deleva, dum ipse dolore vultum contraxit, cum vis arcana obscura a lusore hostili pulsans iterum creverat.

unit.source: ‘Apparently, he made a deal with somebody very important…’
unit.target: ‘Manifestum est eum pacto cum aliquo valde importanti fecisse…’

unit.source: The moment the mana increased in the man in front of him, so did in the others.
unit.target: In momento quo vis arcana in viro coram eum creverat, idem in ceteris accidit.

unit.source: ‘Or maybe with somebody, very very important…’
unit.target: ‘Vel fortasse cum aliquo, valde valde importanti…’

unit.source: “OH, COME ON!” came the frustrated yell of the lord who was about to break through their barriers while the rest of the mooks were resting in pieces around them.
unit.target: “O, age!” exclamavit dominus, frustratus, qui ex imminenti obices rumpere parabat, dum reliqui mooks in particulis circa eos quiescebant.

unit.source: Giving another quick glance at the ritual, he saw that smoke rising from the noble lady was increasing, as was the white flame in the chalice.
unit.target: Aliam celerem conspectionem ritu faciens, vidit fumum ex domina nobilis surgere et augeri, sicut flamma alba in calyce.

unit.source: Reaching the man in a second, he thrust his sword forward, pushing a Mana Strike to the very tip of the blade, trying to weave the spells he had on the sword.
unit.target: Ad viro in momento accessit, gladium suum immisit, Mana Strike ad apicem laminae impellens, conans incantationes in gladio suis texere.

unit.source: For a moment that felt like an eternity, Sam feared that he had failed and his sword was stopped by the churning barrier, but then ever so slowly, the sword began to slide forward, picking up speed and ending up in the assailant’s skull through the bottom of his mouth.
unit.target: Per momentum, quod tam diu videbatur, Sam timebat se defecisse et gladium suum propter obex turbidum sisti, sed deinde paulatim gladium incedere coepit, celeritatem accipiens et tandem in calvariam oppugnatoris per infima ora perveniens.

unit.source: For another long moment, the mana surrounding the man churned and spewed, obviously agitated, and Sam would have sworn it was angry at him, before the enemy player’s health vanished and with it, the connection to their patron.
unit.target: Alio momento longo, vis arcana quae hominem circumdabatur, turbine se movebat et eructabat, manifeste commota, et Sam iuravisset eam ei irasse, antequam valitudo lusoris hostilis evanuit, et cum ea, conexio ad patronum eorum.

unit.source: Sam let out a relieved sigh and yanked the sword out of the man, but he had to shake his head in disgust as the miasma began to eat away at it as soon as he stopped channeling mana through it.
unit.target: Sam suspiravit exsolutus et gladium ex homine extraxit, sed caput in fastidio concutere oportuit, cum miasma coepit illud edere, simul ac mana per illud dirigere cessavit.

unit.source: He threw it away and took out another sword from his inventory and turned his attention towards the other fight.
unit.target: Illud abiicivit et alium gladium ex inventario tulit, et animos ad aliam pugnam vertit.

unit.source: Sadly, the intensity of the mana surrounding them didn’t go down with the death of their comrade.
unit.target: Tristiter, intensitas vis arcana quae eos circumdabatur, non cecidit cum sodalis eorum mortuus esset.

unit.source: Hell, it seemed to have grown.
unit.target: Immo, videbatur eam augeri.

unit.source: Taking a stance, he waited for a lull in the fight.
unit.target: Stans, exspectavit intervallum quietis in pugna.

unit.source: It came soon as the fighting parties separated after another clash that left the dark‑clad side with ashen skin (where it could be seen through the rips of their clothing) showing that the incredible amount of uncontrolled mana seemed to have an actual price on their bodies.
unit.target: Mox venit, cum partes pugnantes post aliam concursationem se separaverunt, quae parte nigro vestitam cum cutibus cineribus illustraverunt (per lacunas vestimentorum conspicuas), ostendens incredibilem quantitatem vis arcanae imparatae quasi pretium verum super corpora eorum habere.

unit.source: While the Lord seemed to be in better shape, his gauntlets were starting to get corroded at certain points.
unit.target: Dum Dominus in melioribus condicionibus videbatur, gauntuli eius in quibusdam partibus corrodi coeperunt.

unit.source: Sam didn’t waste another second, already chastising himself for playing around at the beginning, and launched several Wind Flurries at the players trying to make him fail his quest.
unit.target: Sam aliam secundam non perdidit, iam se reprimens quod initio luserat, et plures Turbina Ventorum in lusores misit, qui eum iter suum fallere conabantur.

unit.source: It was mana intensive, but it was so worth it watching them smugly tanking with their barriers, and then seeing said barriers shredded by his Mana Disruption.
unit.target: Erat intensum in vis arcana, sed multum aestimabatur, cum eos vidisset arroganter scuta gerentes, et deinde illa scuta per Disruptionem Vis Arcanae dissoluta.

unit.source: They might have had enormous amounts of mana, but they didn’t even have an iota of control over it.
unit.target: Fortasse ingentem quantitatem vis arcanae habebant, sed ne minimum quidem moderaminis eius possidebant.

unit.source: Of the three players still alive, one of them was diced instantly and the second one got their barriers destroyed, which the lord immediately made use of, pouncing on the man, and turning him from 3D into 2D.
unit.target: Ex tribus lusoribus adhuc viventibus, unus eorum statim deiectus est et alteri obices destructi sunt, quos dominus statim adhibuit, in hominem impetum faciens, eumque ex dimensione tridimensionali in bidimensionalem convertens.

unit.source: The last man yelled something incoherently, but their barrier held.
unit.target: Ultimus vir aliquid incoherent exclamavit, sed obex eorum sustinuit.

unit.source: Then, as Sam was looking around for the suspiciously missing “boss encounter” the mana spiked once again and the man’s body seized up, freezing in place for a moment.
unit.target: Tum, dum Sam circumspiciebat qua “boss encounter” suspecte deerat, vis arcana iterum subito crevit et corpus viri cohibitum est, per momentum congelatum.

unit.source: When the episode was over, their body was relaxed, their eyes were pure black, and the previously fully chaotic mana around them began to swirl in a streamlined fashion that spoke of unbelievable control.
unit.target: Cum episodio confecto esset, corpus eorum relaxatum erat, oculi eorum pura nigri erant, et vis arcana, quondam omnino chaotica, circa eos in ordine rotari coepit, quod incredibilem moderationem significabat.

unit.source: The eyes roamed around, taking in everything, and Sam felt the breath freeze inside him as the eyes landed on him.
unit.target: Oculi circum errabant, omnia capientes, et Sam sensit spiritum suum in se congelari, cum oculi in eum inciderunt.

unit.source: “Befouler!” The voice that came out of the man resembled nothing like how a human would sound. It was deep, echo‑y but at the same time grating and high pitched.
unit.target: “Profanator!” Vox, quae ex viro effluxit, nihil simile auditus humano habebat. Erat profunda, resonans, sed simul asperrima et acro tonis.

unit.source: Despite the seriousness of the situation, Sam couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
unit.target: Quamquam res gravis esset, Sam oculos vertere non potuit, irrisus tamen.

unit.source: “Oh, it’s you…”
unit.target: “O, tu es…”

unit.source: Lord Silvercrest stepped up next to Sam cautiously, eyes never leaving the being that possessed the last enemy alive.
unit.target: Dominus Silvercrest, cautus, iuxta Sam accessit, oculi numquam ab ente, quae ultimum hostem viventem possidebat, discedentibus.

unit.source: “You know this… creature, my friend?”
unit.target: “Scisne hanc creaturam, mi amice?”

unit.source: “Guess who had the chalice?”
unit.target: “Adivina, quis calycem obtinuerit?”

unit.source: “I see…”
unit.target: “Video…”

unit.source: The monster opened the mouth of the human’s body, pointed at Sam, and once again roared.
unit.target: Monstrum os hominis aperuit, ad Sam demonstravit, et iterum fremuit.

unit.source: “BEFOULER!”
unit.target: “PROFANATOR!”

unit.source: And at the same moment, turned around and launched himself at the barrier protecting the lady of the house and the wizard performing.
unit.target: Et eodem momento, se convertit et in obex, qui dominam domus et magum protegebat, se iactavit.

unit.source: Sam launched several attacks, and the man standing next to him roared and jumped after the monster, but they were too slow.
unit.target: Sam plura impetum iaculatus est, et vir iuxta eum fremuit et post monstrum salivit, sed nimis tarde erant.

unit.source: The body reached the barrier with extreme speed and Sam felt a brief pulse of extremely disgusting mana, and then it exploded.
unit.target: Corpus ad obex cum extrema velocitate pervenit, et Sam brevem pulsationem vis arcanae, valde contaminatae, sensit, deinde illa explodit.

unit.source: The lord of the manor let out an anguished roar, but thanks to his senses, Sam saw enough and knew that while everybody was hurt thanks to the explosion (while he remained stable, Mana Shield was eroded on several spots on his body causing several small wounds to appear) the shield protecting the ritual was still intact.
unit.target: Dominus manerii clamor vastus edidit, sed gratias sensibus suis, Sam satis vidit et intellexit quod, quamquam omnes ex explosione laesi erant (dum ipse stabile manebat, Scutum Vis Arcanae in variis partibus corporis eius corrodere consequebatur, parva vulnera efficiens), scutum, quod ritum protegebat, adhuc intactum manebat.

unit.source: Then, as the guards groaned on the ground, and the crying of the maids intensified, there was a small crack.
unit.target: Tum, dum custodes in terra gemebant, et ancillae plorabant, parva fissura apparuit.

unit.source: Then another and another, until everybody could hear the tinkling of something like glass falling and hitting the ground.
unit.target: Deinde altera et altera, donec omnes audire poterunt sonitum quasi vitrei, cadentis et terram percutientis.

unit.source: Through his magical senses, Sam watched as the ritual shield broke down, leaving the participants exposed to the elements.
unit.target: Per sensus magicos suos, Sam vidit scutum ritus confractum esse, relinquens participantes elementis patefactos.

unit.source: Sending a brief burst of unshaped wind at the garden, he sent the dust cloud away that was kicked up after the explosion.
unit.target: Mittens breve impetum venti informis in hortum, nubem pulveris, quae post explosionem ortum erat, abiecit.

unit.source: The moment the dust was cleared away, the Lord took a hesitant step forward and cried out with relief.
unit.target: Quum pulvis deleptus est, Dominus gradum dubitans in antecessum fecit et cum solatio clamavit.

unit.source: “My darling Sylvia!”
unit.target: “Carissima mea Sylvia!”

unit.source: The lady of the house couldn’t answer as she was currently writhing deliriously upon her divan, while the black smoke rising from her body seemed to be being sucked into the Chalice of Restraint while the white flames burned with an intensity that made it hard to look at it.
unit.target: Domina domus respondere non poterat, cum delirius in divano suo convulsabatur, dum niger fumus e corpore eius surgere videbatur et in Calyce Coercitionis attrahi, dum flammae albae tanta intensitate ardebant ut difficile essent contemplandae.

unit.source: All his senses were focused on the lady and the transfer of the parasite from her weakened body into the purifying flames of the Chalice, so it was rather understandable that neither Sam nor anybody else from the household noticed as one of the maids hesitantly began to walk towards the lady of the house.
unit.target: Omnes sensus eius in domina et in translatione parasiti ex corpore eius debilitato in flammas purificantes Calycei intendebant, ita ut satis intellegendum esset neque Sam neque alii ex familia observaverunt, cum una ex ancillis dubitatione ad dominam domus ambulare coepit.

unit.source: His head, however, snapped up from witnessing some rather impressive magic when the very familiar and oh‑so‑hated magic of the dark being returned with a rather small pulse.
unit.target: Caput eius, tamen, subitamente elevatum est, dum aliquid magiae mirabilis observeret, cum vis magica nota atque vehementer odenda entis obscuri parvo impetu rediret.

unit.source: It took only a second for him to find the maid within striking distance of Lady Sylvia, with eyes darker than the darkest night.
unit.target: Unam secundam tantum exigebat ut ancillam in intervallo percutiendi Dominae Sylviae inveniret, oculis nigrioribus quam tenebris obscurissimae noctis.

unit.source: The dark being in the guise of the woman sent him a brief smirk, then raised a sword retrieved from who knows where wreathed in eldritch darkness that seemed to drip misery and struck with reckless abandon.
unit.target: Ens obscurum in forma feminae ei brevem subridens misit, deinde gladium ex ignoto loco evocatum, in tenebris arcani involutum, quae miseriam stillare videbantur, sublevavit et impetu temerario percussit.

unit.source: Then a lot of things happened in a short amount of time.
unit.target: Tum multa in brevi tempore acciderunt.

unit.source: The guards all yelled out, the maids were crying even louder and the man standing next to Sam let out another anguished roar.
unit.target: Custodes omnes clamaverunt, ancillae etiam vehementius flevere, et vir iuxta Sam iterum clamor dolore exemit.

unit.source: “SYLVIA! NOO!”
unit.target: “SYLVIA! NON!”

unit.source: But everybody knew that they would be too late to save the lady’s life.
unit.target: Sed omnes sciebant se sero fore ne vitam dominae servare possent.

unit.source: The only one who didn’t move was Sam, who answered the being’s smirk with a smirk of his own.
unit.target: Solus, qui non movebatur, erat Sam, qui subridens propriam subridentem responsionem dedit.

unit.source: At the exact moment the maid’s hand holding the sword got near the woman, the shadows next to her bubbled, and Lucky, like a shark made of shadows, launched upwards and bit her on the hand, stopping the attack entirely.
unit.target: Ex illo momento quo manus ancillae gladium tenens prope mulierem accedebat, umbrae iuxta eam bullaverunt, et Lucky, ut selachus ex umbris compositus, surrexit et in manum eius mordebat, totum impetum sistens.

unit.source: For a long moment, Sam luxuriated in the feeling of getting one over his enemy, then he watched as Lucky with a violent motion threw the murderous assassin maid away from the lady of the manor, then with deliberately threatening steps left the shadow and protectively stood next to the suffering woman, almost curling up around her.
unit.target: Per longum momentum Sam gaudebat ex sensu se hostem superavisse; deinde observavit Lucky, motu violento, sicariam homicidam ancillam a domina praedii proiicere, atque gradibus minacibus deliberatis umbram relinquens et iuxta feminam dolentem tutus subsistens, fere eam circumplexus.

unit.source: He looked enormous with his fluffy fur puffed in anger.
unit.target: Magnus videbatur, cum pilis lanuginosis in ira inflatis.

unit.source: Instantly, several guards and undercover guards posing as maids were on the false one, pushing her into the ground, but keeping her alive.
unit.target: Statim, plures custodes atque custodes sub specie ancillarum se praebentes illam aggressi sunt, eam in terram impellentes sed viva servantes.

unit.source: Sam didn’t spare any more thought to the assassin as, coincidently, the ritual seemed to be picking up.
unit.target: Sam de sicaria nihil amplius consideravit, quoniam, fortuito, ritu operandi modus augeri videbatur.
