unit.source: The white fire blazing in the chalice grew even brighter and bigger, while the smoke rising from the woman turned into almost liquid as it left her body.
unit.target: Ignis albus in calice ardens factus est clarior atque maior, dum fumus ex muliere oriens, paene in liquorem conversus, ex corpore eius egreditur.

unit.source: The cursed smoke as it left the body began to churn in the air over the ritual circle, expanding then contracting, but it stayed strictly over the rune circle.
unit.target: Fumus maledictus, dum e corpore egreditur, in aere super circulum ritu incipiebat se turbare, expandens atque deinde contrahens, sed rigide super circulum runarum permanebat.

unit.source: The wizard standing at one of the focal points of the ritual never stopped chanting, and the moment the great cloud of miasma and very dark magic began collecting above the ritual increased their pace and volume of chanting.
unit.target: Magus, qui in uno ex punctis focalibus ritu stabat, numquam cessavit carmina recitare; et statim, cum magna nubes miasmatis atque obscurae magiae super ritu congregari coepit, celeritas atque sonus cantionum illius aucti sunt.

unit.source: As the guards who weren’t guarding the oddly docile assassin were starting the cleanup, the lord of the manor stepped up next to Sam, staring at the ritual, most specifically at his wife.
unit.target: Dum custodes, qui sicariam insolite mansuetudine indutae non custodiabant, purgationem inchoabant, dominus praedii iuxta Sam accessit, ritu intuitus, praecipue ad uxorem suam respiciens.

unit.source: Sam said nothing, just watched as slowly, with raised hands and the magic radiating light to his alternative sights, the wizard directed it ever so slowly over the burning white fire which, as soon as it touched the cursed material, began to grow upwards.
unit.target: Sam nihil dixit; tantum spectabat quomodo paulatim, manibus levatis et luce magica alternos oculos illuminante, magus eam omnino lente super ignem album ardentem diregeret, qui, statim ut materia maledicta attigeret, sursum crescere coepit.

unit.source: At first, the flames just barely tickled the bottom of the bubble of miasma, but that was enough to send the miasma running.
unit.target: Primum, flammae vix bullae miasmatis imum titillabant, sed id satis erat ut miasma fugeret.

unit.source: It began to vibrate and churn even stronger, but the ritual held firm.
unit.target: Incipiebat vibrare et vehementius turbare, sed ritu firmiter permanebat.

unit.source: Soon the bubble of miasma was suspended over the flame like a choice of meat and was being burned.
unit.target: Mox bulla miasmatis super flammam suspendebatur, quasi electa pars carnis, et comburebatur.

unit.source: Second by second, it decreased in size, and Sam could see how the pulsing dark magic was also decreasing, as a bonus, the magic in the lady of the house was also calming down, though it was dangerously thin and weak.
unit.target: Secundo per secundum, ea minuebatur, et Sam videre potuit quomodo pulsans obscura magia quoque decresceret; praeterea, magia in domina praedii quoque sedabatur, quamquam periculosē exiguus et debilis videbatur.

unit.source: Sam just watched along calmly as Lord Silvercrest muttered and walked to and fro, fretting for his wife.
unit.target: Sam tantum placide observabat, dum Dominus Silvercrest murmurebat et huc iluc ambulabat, uxori suae sollicite curans.

unit.source: A three focal point ritual was nothing to write home about.
unit.target: Ritus tribus punctis focalibus non erat res, quae domi scribenda esset.

unit.source: In his memories of the future that never will be, he saw several rituals where more than a hundred wizards, sorcerers, and mages had to participate with material costs that would have bankrupted a small country.
unit.target: In memoriis de futuro, quod numquam futurum erit, vidit plures ritos in quibus plus quam centum magi, incantatores atque mages participabant, cum impensis materialibus, quae parvam gentem in ruina converterent.

unit.source: Depressingly, these rituals were mostly performed for the sake of some spoiled second-gen rich heir who wanted to get stronger.
unit.target: Tristiter, hi riti plerumque erant ex causa aliqui indulgens haeredis secundae generationis divitum, qui se fortiorem fieri cupiebat.

unit.source: In truly human fashion, there were actual guilds that specialized in providing exactly this type of ritual with very competitive fees.
unit.target: Vere humanis modis, erant collegia verae, quae specialiter talos ritos, cum feodis valde competitivis, praebere solebant.

unit.source: Of course, there were sinister rituals carried out by necromancers and dark mages. Summoning daemons and other dark beings to do their bidding, or be devoured by the very beings they summoned.
unit.target: Scilicet, erant ritus sinistri per necromantos et magos obscuros peractos. Daemones et alia entia tenebrosa evocabantur ad iussa eorum exsequenda, aut a ipsis entibus, quos vocaverant, devorandi causa.

unit.source: That was why he wanted to learn Runecraft.
unit.target: Ideo voluit artem runarum discere.

unit.source: His hope was that if he knew how rituals worked, then he would have an easier time disrupting them.
unit.target: Spes eius erat, quod, si sciret rituum modum operandi, eos facilius perturbare posset.

unit.source: Sadly, the other Sam didn’t know much about runes besides the basics, so he had almost no insider information about it.
unit.target: Infeliciter, alter Sam de runis, praeter elementa fundamentalia, parum sciebat, ita vix ullam notitiam internam de ea habebat.

unit.source: But that was exactly what made it interesting to him.
unit.target: At hoc erat id ipsum quod illi rem excitantem fecerat.

unit.source: He wasn’t following the steps of the other Sam.
unit.target: Non sequebatur vestigia alterius Sam.

unit.source: He was blazing his own trail…
unit.target: Suam viam propriam sternens…

unit.source: As his thoughts meandered, the ritual let out the biggest pulse to date, and the white flame rose once more, enveloping the bubble of miasma, once, twice, and three times.
unit.target: Dum eius cogitationes vagabantur, ritus maximas pulsationes ad hunc diem emisit, et ignis albus iterum surrexit, bullam miasmatis semel, bis, et ter amplectens.

unit.source: And when the flames came down after the third time, the miasma was gone.
unit.target: Et cum flammae post tertium iter descendentes, miasma evanuit.

unit.source: Sam could physically feel the absence of the cloying miasma from the area.
unit.target: Sam corporali sensu percepiebat absentiam miasmatis opprimens ex illa regione.

unit.source: The entire garden, the maids, guards, the nobles, and even the assassin let out a sigh of relief.
unit.target: Hortus totus, ancillae, custodes, nobiles, atque etiam sicaria suspirum levationis effuderunt.

unit.source: The flame continued to merrily burn while the wizard controlling the ritual changed their chant and over the next few minutes, the magic in the ritual slowly drained away, going back to the ley-lines and the white flame in the chalice slowly decreased in size until it went out completely with a small puff sound.
unit.target: Flamma laete ardebat, dum magus, qui ritu moderabatur, carmen mutavit; et per proximos aliquot minuta, magia in ritu lente defluere coepit, ad lineas magicas rediens, et ignis albus in calice paulatim minuebatur, donec omnino exstinctus est cum parvo sibilo.

unit.source: “Sylvia!” the giant man immediately exclaimed and rushed next to his wife.
unit.target: “Sylvia!” statim exclamavit homo ingens et ad uxorem suam properavit.

unit.source: Sam noticed that the wizard sent the lord an annoyed look but otherwise stayed silent.
unit.target: Sam animadvertit magum domino vultum iracundum misisse, sed reliquum silentium retinuisse.

unit.source: The enormous man stopped on a dime next to the harshly panting noble lady, knelt down, and began to cradle tenderly the woman in his hands.
unit.target: Homo ingens, iuxta nobilem mulierem, quae vehementer halitus faciebat, subsistebat, genu flectit, et mulierem teneriter in manibus amplecti coepit.

unit.source: “You’re alright! You’re alright…”
unit.target: “Bene es! Bene es…”

unit.source: Sam turned away, knowing that he wouldn’t be much use to the man as he could see several people dressed as healers with the sign of the House of Silvercrest rushed over and began to fuss over them and the wizard.
unit.target: Sam se avertit, sciens se parum utilis futurum esse viri, cum videret plures homines indutos ut medicos, signo Domus Silvercrest gerentes, properare atque de eis ac mago curas gerere.

unit.source: Instead, he began to help with the cleanup.
unit.target: Proinde, auxilium in purgatione dare coepit.

unit.source: He collected shattered weapons, armor, and clothing scraps, dug up corrupted ground that was hit by the attacks of the possessed enemy, and shoveled it into boxes brought in.
unit.target: Conlegit arma fracta, loricas, vestimentorumque reliquias; terram corruptam, quae a hoste possesso icta erat, excavat et in arcae adlatae posuit.

unit.source: And sometimes nicked a few things from the corpses.
unit.target: Et interdum quaedam ex cadaveribus subripiebat.

unit.source: An amulet with weird runes, a ring with an unfamiliar symbol, weirdly shaped daggers, and in one case, a very nice bag of money.
unit.target: Monile cum runis insolitis, annulus cum signo ignoto, pugiones forma insolita, et in uno casu, sacculus pecuniae valde decorus.

unit.source: Sam was sure that the Silvercrest servants knew what he was doing (he wasn’t trying to be stealthy) but either they chalked up his behavior to being an adventurer or they didn’t care.
unit.target: Sam certo sciebat servos Silvercrest nosse quid faceret (non furtim agere conabatur), sed aut eius mores tamquam viatorem existimabant aut nihil curabant.

unit.source: Slowly, over an hour, the garden was put in order, though it still showed the signs of a fight happening, the corpses were taken away and the debris was piled in one out-of-the-way corner.
unit.target: Lente, per horam, hortus in ordinem redactus est, quamquam vestigia pugnae adhuc patebant; cadavera ablata sunt et ruinae in angulo remoto conglobatae.

unit.source: Sam was about to find an excuse to leave when the tired-looking butler approached him.
unit.target: Sam paene excusationem invenire volebat ut discederet, cum domesticus fessus vultu ad eum accessit.

unit.source: “Master Adventurer,” he greeted Sam with respect shining in his eyes.
unit.target: “Domine Adventurer,” ille salutavit Sam, cum reverentia in oculis fulgentibus.

unit.source: “Hello,” Sam returned the greeting with a respectful nod.
unit.target: “Salve,” respondit Sam, caput reverenter inclinans.

unit.source: “I bring greetings from the Master.” Lord Silvercrest and his wife have long ago been bundled up and escorted back to the manor.
unit.target: “Salutem a Domino fero.” Dominus Silvercrest et uxor eius olim iam aggregati et ad praedium redducti sunt.

unit.source: “He bids you to return on the morrow to discuss your well-deserved remuneration.”
unit.target: “Imperat ut cras redeas ad rem de mercede tua digna disserenda.”

unit.source: “I assume he was quite louder than that…” said Sam with a small smirk as he began a quick check of his equipment while also letting out a small whistle to call Lucky back to him.
unit.target: “Puto eum multo clarius vocavisse…” inquit Sam, subrisu parvo, dum celeriter apparatum suum percurrere coepit atque parvum sibilum edidit ut Lucky ad se revocarentur.

unit.source: The fortunate wolf was being pampered by several maids.
unit.target: Fortunatus lupus pluribus ancillis comitabatur.

unit.source: Hearing the whistle, he sprung up from his back and, with several powerful jumps, arrived next to him.
unit.target: Sibilum audito, ex tergo surrexit et pluribus saltibus validis iuxta eum accessit.

unit.source: Sam gave him a quick pat on the head and the silly wolf jumped into his shadow with a graceful swan dive.
unit.target: Sam celeriter caput illi pulsavit et lupus ineptus in umbram eius, grati saltu similis cygno, desiluit.

unit.source: “Quite,” replied the butler in a dry tone and turned around, leading Sam to the gates.
unit.target: “Prorsus,” respondit domesticus in tono arido et conversus, Sam ad portas ducens.

unit.source: Leaving the manor grounds was rather funny.
unit.target: Exire ex agris praedii satis ridiculum erat.

unit.source: While inside the manor walls, a small battle had taken place, several skirmishes had broken out throughout the city between rival guilds while the city guards desperately tried to calm things down.
unit.target: Intra muros praedii parva pugna habita erat, et plurimae contentionēs inter collegia adversa per urbem evenere, dum custodes urbis anxie conabantur rem sedare.

unit.source: Naturally, it didn’t help that the promised raid on the Auction House Warehouse didn’t happen, so now everybody was pointing fingers at everybody else. At least, that was what he overheard during his walk.
unit.target: Naturaliter, non prodest quod incursus in Horreum Auctionis promissus non evenisset, ita nunc omnes invicem accusabant; saltem, id erat quod audiverat dum ambulabat.

unit.source: First, he visited the Auction House to check if there was anything that would interest him.
unit.target: Primum, Horreum Auctionis visitavit ad inspiciendum utrum quid eum interesse haberet.

unit.source: He sat down for a little while in one of the corners that were reserved for the independent players while several areas of the Auction House were covered with several clans and guilds who had their people eternally hunt for bargains.
unit.target: Pauci tempore consedit in uno angulo, qui lusoribus independentibus destinatus erat, dum plura spatia Horrei Auctionis occupabantur a variis clanibus et collegiis, qui suos homines ad occasiones mercandi indefesse impellebant.

unit.source: The first thing he noticed was that there were several highly armored guards walking around in the halls of the establishment and when he turned on his Mana Sight, he saw that several servants who were serving the people or answering questions had suspiciously high mana levels.
unit.target: Primum animadvertit plures custodes loricatos per atria ambulare, et cum visum Manam activavit, vidit plures servos, qui populo ministrabant aut quaestiones responderent, altissimos gradus mana ostendentes.

unit.source: Though he had to stop as one of the women who were at the service desk sent him a playful glare.
unit.target: Tamen cessavit, cum una ex mulieribus, quae ad mensam ministerii praesto erat, ei aspectum ludibrium misisset.

unit.source: Sam gave her a respectful nod with a small smile, then returned to browsing.
unit.target: Sam ei caput reverenter inclinavit cum parvo subrisu, deinde ad cursum perlegendum rediit.

unit.source: The material section wasn’t interesting to him as nobody had much chance to find the important mines.
unit.target: Sectio materialis ei non placebat, nam nemo occasionem habebat ad minas importantes inveniendas.

unit.source: Though he made sure to check just to be sure, sadly it was just as empty as he expected.
unit.target: Quamquam inspicere curavit, tristiter, eam tam vacuam inveniit, qualem exspectaverat.

unit.source: The armor and weapon were full of mass-manufactured crap, as was the alchemy section.
unit.target: Lorica et arma erant pleni rebus massim fabricatis, sicut et sectio alchemiae.

unit.source: ‘The novels lied to me. Where is the Thousand Year Old Ginseng? Where is Fire Sword of Awesome?’ he grumbled to himself, then turned his attention to the recipe section.
unit.target: “Novellae mihi mendacia narraverunt. Ubi est Ginseng mille annorum? Ubi est Gladius Ignis Mirabilis?” murmurat sibi, deinde animos convertit ad sectionem praeceptorum.

unit.source: ‘Let’s see… armor, armor, weapon, weapon… potion, potion, addicting drug…’ Once again, nothing interesting. Searching for runes, he came up with nothing.
unit.target: “Videamus… lorica, lorica, arma, arma… potiones, potiones, medicamenta addictiva…” Iterum, nihil interessante; runas quaerens, nihil invenit.

unit.source: Finally, he turned towards the skill book section.
unit.target: Denique animos convertit ad sectionem librorum peritiarum.

unit.source: As expected, the top of the screen was full of the Life of Blood skill book for ludicrous prices while mixed in were some ridiculous skills like Lightning Beam, Blizzard and other, very situational skills.
unit.target: Sicut exspectabatur, summa pagina plena erat librorum peritiarum “Vita Sanguinis” ad pretia ineptissima, inter quas miscebantur aliquae peritiae ridiculae ut “Radium Fulminis” et “Tempestas Glacialis”, quae valde casibus destinatae erant.

unit.source: ‘Soon they will learn the cons of long cast times… And hopefully the concept of friendly fire…’ he mused with an evil smile as he did a few searches.
unit.target: “Mox discent incommoda longorum temporum incantationis… et, spero, notionem ignis amicabilis…” meditabatur cum maligno subrisu, dum quaestiones aliquot faciebat.

unit.source: Searching the wind category yielded him the Wind Drill spell that allowed one to envelop their weapon with a drilling wind effect.
unit.target: In quaerendo in categoria venti, invenit incantationem “Wind Drill”, quae licebat ut apicem armae tuae vento forma terebrantis indutam efficire posses.

unit.source: Mostly useful for spear users, but he wanted to integrate it into his rotation.
unit.target: Praecipue utilis hastariis, sed ille voluit eam in rotatione sua incorporare.

unit.source: The shadow category was empty of anything interesting, which wasn’t a big surprise as it was a rather rare type.
unit.target: Categoria umbrae nihil interessante continebatur, quod non mirum erat, nam rarus esset generis.

unit.source: Then, as promised to himself, he looked into the health-increasing skills.
unit.target: Deinde, ut sibi promissum erat, animadvertit peritias salutem augentis.

unit.source: He discarded the idea of getting several smaller skills that would give him a few percentage improvements because Sam didn’t really want to over-clutter his skill collection.
unit.target: Reiecit ideam adipisci plures peritias minores, quae ei pauca augmentationes in percentualibus afferrebant, quoniam Sam non volebat collectionem peritiarum suarum nimis oneratam esse.

unit.source: Finally, after half an hour of searching, he found a very cheap skill at the bottom of the list for several gold coins.
unit.target: Denique, post dimidium horae quaesitionis, invenit peritiam valde vilescentem in imo indice pro paucis aureis nummis.

unit.source: With shining eyes, he immediately bought out the skill, not even bothering to bid on it. It was just too good of a catch.
unit.target: Oculis fulgentibus, statim peritiam emis, ne etiam contendere curans; erat nimirum praeclara inventio.

unit.source: With that, he stopped his browsing, walked up to the service desk, waited until it was his turn, and was helped by the woman who noticed his snooping.
unit.target: Ita, cursum perlegendum terminavit, accessit ad mensam ministerii, exspectavit usque ad suam partem, et mulier, quae eius furtum animadvertit, eum adiuvit.

unit.source: He paid for the items and put them into his inventory before leaving.
unit.target: Res persolvit et in inventarium suum posuit antequam discessit.

unit.source: From the Auction House, he directly headed to the Cloudy Day Inn.
unit.target: Ex Horreo Auctionis, directe ad “Cloudy Day Inn” profectus est.

unit.source: He ordered a filling meal, as after a fight one needed to replenish his energy, and while Lucky, the great ham, begged for scraps around the dining hall, he tried to fight the urge to open his notifications.
unit.target: Mandavit escam copiosam, quoniam post pugnam vires reficiendas erant, et dum Lucky, magnus “ham”, reliquias circa aula cenaculi petebat, conatus est impetum reprimere ad notificationes suas aperiendas.

unit.source: Finishing his meal and thanking the waitress with a smile, he collected Lucky, who was in the process of charming several waitresses off the clock and retreated to his room.
unit.target: Escam finiens et ancillarī subridente gratias agens, recogit Lucky, qui varias ancillas extra horam alliciebat, et ad cubiculum suum se retraxit.

unit.source: Inside the room, he gave Lucky several high-quality slices of meat and water, then changed into much more comfortable clothing, hopped on the bed, with his back to the wall, and took out the two new skill books.
unit.target: In cella, ille dedit Lucky aliquot partes carnis optimae atque aquam, deinde in vestimenta multo commodius se mutavit, in lectulo insiliit, cum dorso ad parietem, atque duo novos libros peritiarum extraxit.

unit.source: [Congratulations, you’ve learned the spell, Wind Drill!]
unit.target: [Gratulor! Incantationem “Wind Drill” didicisti!]

unit.source: [Wind Drill: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to grant the tip of your weapon wind shaped as a drill, enhancing its penetration ability.]
unit.target: [Wind Drill: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae permittit tibi ut apicem armae tuae vento forma terebrantis induas, eius facultatem penetandi augens.]

unit.source: [Congratulations, you’ve learned the skill, Mana Body!]
unit.target: [Gratulor! Peritias “Corpus Mana” didicisti!]

unit.source: [Mana Body: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Your mana permeates your body, enhancing and improving it. The better the control of your mana is, and the more mana you have, the bigger the effect is. For every 100 Mana Points, it grants you 1 Base Health gain. For every skill level, it increases the Health Regeneration by 0,1.]
unit.target: [Corpus Mana: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passiva) Mana tua per corpus tuum pervadit, idque augens et emendans. Quo melius mana tua regitur, atque quo plura mana habes, eo maior effectus est. Pro omnibus 100 Punctis Mana, 1 punctum salutis basi tibi tribuitur. Pro quolibet gradu peritiae, regenerationem salutis per 0,1 auget.]

unit.source: The moment he learned it and the skill book vanished, he instantly felt mana coursing through his body, reaching every little corner. It was a rather peculiar feeling. Sam didn’t think he could have explained it using words.
unit.target: Mox, cum id didicerit et liber peritiae evanuerit, statim sensit manam per corpus suum fluere, ad omnem angulum pervenientem. Sensatio erat singularis. Sam non existimavit se id verbis explicare posse.

unit.source: It was an awesome skill, especially for him with his humongous amount of mana. And combined with the rest of the skills, it would become a powerhouse soon. Though it made sense why the person selling it was doing so. According to his inherited memories, most people who specialized in mana were hovering around 500-600 Mana points currently. So this would seem like a waste of time and money to get.
unit.target: Peritia praeclara erat, praesertim ei cum ingenti quantitate mana. Et cum reliquis peritiis coniuncta, mox efficacissima facta esset. Rationem habebat cur venditor id ita faceretur: secundum memoria hereditate, plerique qui in mana specialiter versabantur, circiter 500–600 Puncta Mana retinebant. Ergo hoc videbatur quasi tempus et pecuniam perdere.

unit.source: ‘How they would cry later when it turns out you would need to do a very tedious quest to get this book…’
unit.target: “Quomodo postea flere vellent, cum pateat te longam et taediosam inquisitionem ad hunc librum obtinendum agenda esse…”

unit.source: Smirking at his good luck, Sam finally turned towards his notification screen while the satiated Lucky jumped on the bed and laid down next to him.
unit.target: Subrisu fortunæ suo, Sam tandem ad tabulam notificationum convertit, dum Lucky, saties, in lectum insiliit et iuxta eum se collocavit.

unit.source: [Spirit Link is now Level 17!]
unit.target: [Nexus Spiritus nunc Gradus 17 est!]

unit.source: [Your companion, Lucky, has reached Level 18!]
unit.target: [Socius tuus, Lucky, Gradum 18 attigit!]

unit.source: [Lucky’s skill, Shadow Jump is now Level 7!]
unit.target: [Peritia Lucky, “Saltus Umbrae”, nunc Gradus 7 est!]

unit.source: Sadly, Lucky wasn’t lucky enough to learn a new skill. Still, any improvement was good, so he made sure to praise the silly wolf a little before turning to his own notifications.
unit.target: Infeliciter, Lucky non satis felix erat ut novam peritiam disceret. Nihilominus, quaelibet melioratio bona erat, itaque cavit ut paulum lupum ineptum laudaret antequam ad suas notificationes converteret.

unit.source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
unit.target: [Gratulor! Novum gradum adeptus es!]

unit.source: [You’re now Level 23!]
unit.target: [Nunc Gradus 23 es!]

unit.source: [Gained 2 unassigned attribute points!]
unit.target: [Duos punctos attributorum non assignatos adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Gained 1 WIS point because of the wise decisions that you made!]
unit.target: [Unum punctum WIS adeptus es ob decisiones sapientes quas cepisti!]

unit.source: Nodding slightly, he added the two unassigned points to DEX and AGI before continuing.
unit.target: Levis capite inclinans, duos punctos attributorum non assignatos ad DEX atque AGI adiunxit, deinde pergere incipiens.

unit.source: [Advanced Mana Control is now Level 19!]
unit.target: [Imperium Manae Provectum nunc Gradus 19 est!]

unit.source: [Stable Mana Control is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Imperium Manae Stabilum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Mana Shield is now Level 36!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae nunc Gradus 36 est!]

unit.source: [Controlled Mana Shield is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Moderatum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Sustained Mana Shield is now Level 10!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

unit.source: [Layered Mana Shield is now Level 1!]
unit.target: [Scutum Manae Stratificatum nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Congratulations, thanks to your ingenuity you have learned the skill Spell Layering!]
unit.target: [Gratulor, tuae ingeniositati gratia peritiam “Stratificatio Incantationum” didicisti!]

unit.source: [Spell Layering: Level 0/25 (0%) (Passive) Allows you to layer spells onto each other. The synergy depends on the spells themselves. For every level in this skill, you can add another spell to the layering. The current number of spells that can be layered: 2.]
unit.target: [Stratificatio Incantationum: Gradus 0/25 (0%) (Passiva) Permittit tibi incantationes super se imponere. Synergia a ipsa incantationibus dependet. Pro quolibet gradu in hac peritia, incantationem addere potes ad stratificationem. Numerus incantationum, quas super se imponere possis, nunc est: 2.]

unit.source: [Wind Blade II is now Level 2!]
unit.target: [Lamina Ventorum II nunc Gradus 2 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Flurry is now Level 1!]
unit.target: [Flabra Ventorum nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Bullet is now Level 1!]
unit.target: [Sagitta Ventorum nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Healing Wind is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Ventus Sanans nunc Gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Jump is now level 1!]
unit.target: [Saltus Ventorum nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Edge is now Level 3!]
unit.target: [Margo Ventorum nunc Gradus 3 est!]

unit.source: [Wind Affinity is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Affinitas Ventorum nunc Gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: The wind-natured spells were climbing with a steady pace so Sam was satisfied.
unit.target: Incantationes, natura venti, constanter ascendebant, itaque Sam contentus erat.

unit.source: [Shadow Footwork is now Level 14!]
unit.target: [Ambulatio Umbrae nunc Gradus 14 est!]

unit.source: [Shadow Burst is now level 5!]
unit.target: [Explosio Umbrae nunc Gradus 5 est!]

unit.source: Sadly, he didn’t have the opportunity to use his Shadow Mirage skill, but he didn’t really mind. Using a skill like that in real battle was foolish beyond reason.
unit.target: Infeliciter, non habuit occasionem ut peritiam “Mirage Umbrae” uteretur, sed nihil curavit. Talem peritiam in pugna vera adhibere insipienter ultra modum erat.

unit.source: Finally, he turned his attention towards physical skill.
unit.target: Denique animos convertit ad peritiam physicam.

unit.source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery is now Level 12!]
unit.target: [Dominium Ensis Intermedium nunc Gradus 12 est!]

unit.source: [Freeform Defense is now Level 1!]
unit.target: [Defensio Libera nunc Gradus 1 est!]

unit.source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique is now Level 4!]
unit.target: [Technica Respirandi Intermedia nunc Gradus 4 est!]

unit.source: [Calm Heart is now Level 20!]
unit.target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc Gradus 20 est!]

unit.source: [Flow is now Level 11!]
unit.target: [Fluxus nunc Gradus 11 est!]

unit.source: [Thanks to exposure to the corrupting miasma you gained Corruption Resistance.]
unit.target: [Ob expositionem miasmatis corruptivae, Corruptionis Resistendi adeptus es!]

unit.source: [Corruption Resistance: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to exposure, you gained resistance against corruption. Makes it easier to resist the effects of substances and spells that try to corrupt you. Each level increases the resistance by 1%.]
unit.target: [Corruptionis Resistenda: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passiva) Expositione gratias, resistentiam corruptioni adeptus es. Facit ut effectus substantiarum et incantationum, quae te corrumpere conantur, resistere facilius possis. Pro quolibet gradu, resistentia per 1% augetur.]

unit.source: Satisfied with his gains, Sam did a quick read-through of his status, then instead of heading out, he retrieved the loot from the battle and began to examine the runes on the amulet he appropriated from one of the dead assailants.
unit.target: Contentus lucris suis, Sam celeriter statum suum perlegit; deinde, potius quam discedere, praedam ex pugna recuperavit et runas in monile, quod ab uno inter hostes mortuos occupaverat, examinare coepit.

unit.source: Hello World!
unit.target: Salve, mundi!

unit.source: I am a good person.
unit.target: Ego sum bonus homo.
